verses.sanskrit: योऽयं कूर्मो महाविष्णुः कूर्मरूपेण संस्थितः | मन्दराचलमाधार्य देवकार्यमकारयत् ||
verses.transliteration: yo'yaṃ kūrmo mahāviṣṇuḥ kūrmarūpeṇa saṃsthitaḥ | mandarācalamādhārya devakāryamakārayat ||
verses.translation: That Kurma — who is Maha-Vishnu himself, present in the form of the tortoise — having supported Mount Mandara, accomplished the work of the gods.
verses.hindi: यह कूर्म, जो स्वयं महाविष्णु हैं, कूर्म-रूप धारण करके मन्दराचल को धारण किये हुए देवों के कार्य को सम्पन्न किये।
verses.commentary: The Kurma avatar is the most philosophically resonant of all Vishnu's ten forms. The tortoise dives to the bottom of the ocean and becomes the immovable foundation that allows the cosmic churning to generate all good things — nectar, Lakshmi, Dhanvantari, the divine treasures. The teaching: the most productive transformations in life require an immovable centre. The churning can only happen because something holds steady beneath it. Vishnu as Kurma is the principle of stable, unshakeable support that makes creation possible.

verses.sanskrit: अमृतं च विषं चैव उत्पन्नं सागरे महत् | देवा अमृतमादाय विषं शम्भुः प्रपीतवान् ||
verses.transliteration: amṛtaṃ ca viṣaṃ caiva utpannaṃ sāgare mahat | devā amṛtamādāya viṣaṃ śambhuḥ prapītavān ||
verses.translation: Both nectar and poison arose great from the ocean. The gods took the nectar; Shambhu (Shiva) drank the poison.
verses.hindi: महान सागर से अमृत और विष दोनों उत्पन्न हुए। देवों ने अमृत लिया; शम्भु (शिव) ने विष पी लिया।
verses.commentary: The churning produces both halahala (poison) and amrita (nectar) — the same process generates both destruction and immortality. Nobody asked for the poison; it arose on its own. Only Shiva stepped forward to drink it, holding it in his throat (becoming Neelakantha — the blue-throated one), protecting all creation. The Kurma Purana's synthesis of Vishnu and Shiva finds its most perfect expression here: Vishnu provides the foundation that makes the churning possible; Shiva absorbs the poison that the churning produces. Creation requires both: the stable ground AND the one willing to consume what is harmful.

verses.sanskrit: कूर्मो भवामि युगान्ते संवर्तकनिमीलिते | समुद्रमथने काले मन्दरं पर्वतोत्तमम् ||
verses.transliteration: kūrmo bhavāmi yugānte saṃvartakanimīlite | samudramathane kāle mandaraṃ parvatottamam ||
verses.translation: I become the tortoise at the end of the yuga when the universe is dissolved. At the time of churning the ocean, I support the excellent Mandara mountain.
verses.hindi: मैं युग के अंत में कूर्म बनता हूँ, जब संसार समाप्त हो जाता है। समुद्र मंथन के समय, मैं उत्तम मन्दर पर्वत को धारण करता हूँ।
verses.commentary: The Kurma Purana's self-description of Vishnu as the tortoise avatar. Two images: (1) at cosmic dissolution, the universe rests on Vishnu as Kurma — the tortoise withdrawing into its shell represents the cosmos withdrawing into its source. (2) at the churning of the ocean, Kurma supports Mount Mandara on his back — the divine as the stable foundation for the work of transformation. The tortoise is the symbol of stability: when everything churns, the divine provides the unmoving base.

verses.sanskrit: अहमेव परं ब्रह्म अहमेव परः शिवः | अहमेव परं धाम अहमेव परं सुखम् ||
verses.transliteration: ahameva paraṃ brahma ahameva paraḥ śivaḥ | ahameva paraṃ dhāma ahameva paraṃ sukham ||
verses.translation: I alone am supreme Brahman. I alone am supreme Shiva. I alone am the supreme abode. I alone am supreme bliss.
verses.hindi: मैं ही परम ब्रह्म हूँ। मैं ही परम शिव हूँ। मैं ही परम धाम हूँ। मैं ही परम सुख हूँ।
verses.commentary: Shiva speaks from the absolute perspective — not the "I" of the limited ego, but the primordial I-am-ness that is the ground of all experience. The Ishvara Gita here echoes the Kaivalya Upanishad's "Aham eva param Brahma" — the recognition that the seeker and the sought are one. This verse is also the Kurma Purana's characteristic synthesis: Brahman and Shiva are not different ultimate realities. The supreme bliss (param sukham) is not somewhere else; it is this very awareness, recognised in its own nature.

verses.sanskrit: सत्यं वद धर्मं चर स्वाध्यायान्मा प्रमदः | सत्यान्न प्रमदितव्यं धर्मान्न प्रमदितव्यम् ||
verses.transliteration: satyaṃ vada dharmaṃ cara svādhyāyānmā pramadaḥ | satyānna pramaditavyaṃ dharmānna pramaditavyam ||
verses.translation: Speak truth. Practice dharma. Do not neglect self-study. Do not deviate from truth. Do not deviate from dharma.
verses.hindi: सत्य बोलो। धर्म का आचरण करो। स्वाध्याय में आलस्य मत करो। सत्य से विचलित मत होओ। धर्म से विचलित मत होओ।
verses.commentary: The Kurma Purana here echoes the most famous injunction from the Taittiriya Upanishad (satyaṃ vada, dharmaṃ cara). The Uttara Khanda grounds the mystical teachings of the Ishvara Gita in the simplest, most practical instructions: tell the truth, act rightly, keep studying. The greatest philosophical system rests on these three pillars. Without them, the highest metaphysics becomes mere intellectual entertainment.
verses.wordMeaning: The Kurma Purana here echoes the most famous injunction from the Taittiriya Upanishad (satyaṃ vada, dharmaṃ cara). verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानं परं विमोक्षाय वैराग्यं च परं स्मृतम् | भक्तिश्च परमा देवी एष मोक्षस्य सङ्ग्रहः ||
verses.transliteration: jñānaṃ paraṃ vimokṣāya vairāgyaṃ ca paraṃ smṛtam | bhaktiśca paramā devī eṣa mokṣasya saṅgrahaḥ ||
verses.translation: Knowledge (jnana) is supreme for liberation; dispassion (vairagya) is declared supreme; and bhakti (devotion), O Goddess, is the highest. This is the essence of liberation.
verses.hindi: मोक्ष के लिए ज्ञान परम है; वैराग्य परम कहा गया है; और हे देवी! भक्ति सर्वोच्च है। यही मोक्ष का सार है।
verses.commentary: The Ishvara Gita's opening declaration of the three-fold path — the same triple synthesis that runs through all of the Gita literature. Jnana (the eye that sees clearly), Vairagya (the release of what is not real), and Bhakti (the love that moves toward the real) are not three competing paths but three aspects of a single movement. You cannot have genuine knowledge without the dispassion to accept what you see; you cannot sustain dispassion without the love that makes the truth attractive rather than terrifying.

At the centre of this rfot/ia god Visnu sleeps on the couch of the serpent Sesa's body, his feet being kneaded by the goddess Laksmi born of that ocean. The details given infra (KP.I. 49.40-71) show that only the righteous can reach there. These persons are fair complexioned devotees of Narayana. They are free from sorrow, worry, fear of old age and death. King Indradyumna, after his death, attained to this region due to his extreme devotion to Visnu and in the company of Visnu, enjoyed all the pleasures special toHari's devotees, (m'i/c also Bh.P. verses.sanskrit: कुतः सर्वमिदं जातं कस्मिंश्च लयमेष्यति । नियन्ता कश्च सर्वेषां वदस्व पुरुषोत्तम
verses.transliteration: kutaḥ sarvamidaṃ jātaṃ kasmiṃśca layameṣyati / niyantā kaśca sarveṣāṃ vadasva puruṣottama
verses.translation: This is a standard definition repeated in a number of Pmdijas them¬ selves (eg. A 14, G 2.27, Mt. ,64, SVP. Vdyavijia Sam. 1.41, VP.
verses.hindi: सूतजीने कहा--आश्रमोंके सम्बन्धमें पूरे विधि- विधानको सुनकर प्रसन्न मनवाले ऋषियोंने भगवान् हषीकेशको नमस्कार करके पुनः इस प्रकारका वचन कहा मुनिजन बोले-- (भगवन्!) आपने श्रेष्ठ चारों आश्रमोंके विषयमें सब कुछ बतलाया, अब इस समय हमें यह सुननेको इच्छा है कि इस जगत्की सृष्टि कैसे होती है। है पुरुषोत्तम! यह सब (संसार) कहाँसे उत्पन्न
verses.wordMeaning: This is a standard definition repeated in a number of Pmdijas them¬ selves (eg. A 14, G 2.27, Mt. ,64, SVP. Vdyavijia Sam. 1.41, VP.
verses.commentary: Sense: This is a standard definition repeated in a number of Pmdijas them¬ selves (eg. A 14, G 2.27, Mt. ,64, SVP. Vdyavijia Sam. 1.41, VP.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा नारायणो वाक्यमृषीणां कूर्मरूपधृक् । प्राह गम्भीरया वाचा भूतानां प्रभवाप्ययौ
verses.transliteration: śrutvā nārāyaṇo vākyamṛṣīṇāṃ kūrmarūpadhṛk / prāha gambhīrayā vācā bhūtānāṃ prabhavāpyayau
verses.translation: You are called Romaharsana as all your hairs stood on their ends, thanks to the delight on hearing the words of Dvai- payana (Vyasa).
verses.hindi: हुआ, किसमें विलीन होगा और इन सबका नियामक कौन है? यह सब आप बतलायें। ऋषियोंका वचन सुनकर कूर्मरूप धारण करनेवाले तथा सभी भूत- प्राणियोंके उत्पत्ति और विनाशके स्थान भगवान् नारायण गम्भीर वाणीमें बोले ॥ २--४॥
verses.wordMeaning: You are called Romaharsana as all your hairs stood on their ends, thanks to the delight on hearing the words of Dvai- payana (Vyasa).
verses.commentary: Sense: You are called Romaharsana as all your hairs stood on their ends, thanks to the delight on hearing the words of Dvai- payana (Vyasa).

verses.sanskrit: श्रीकूर्म उवाच महेश्वरः परो ऽव्यक्तश्चतुर्व्यूहः सनातनः । अनन्तश्चाप्रमेयश्च नियन्ता विश्वतोमुखः
verses.transliteration: śrīkūrma uvāca maheśvaraḥ paro 'vyaktaścaturvyūhaḥ sanātanaḥ / anantaścāprameyaśca niyantā viśvatomukhaḥ
verses.translation: Formerly, it was your worship alone whom the holy sage Vyasa himself directed to narrate all the compilations of Puranas to the sages.
verses.hindi: श्रीकूर्मने कहा--सर्वत्र (चारों ओर) मुखवाले महेश्वर (प्रकृतिसे) पर, अव्यक्त, चतुर्व्यूह, सनातन, अनन्त, अप्रमेय तथा (समस्त जगत्के) नियन्ता हैं । तत्त्वचिन्तक जिसे प्रधान और प्रकृति कहते हैं और जो सत्-असत्- रूप हैँ, बही अव्यक्त नित्य कारण है
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly, it was your worship alone whom the holy sage Vyasa himself directed to narrate all the compilations of Puranas to the sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, it was your worship alone whom the holy sage Vyasa himself directed to narrate all the compilations of Puranas to the sages.

verses.sanskrit: अव्यक्तं कारणं यत्तन्नित्यं सदसदात्मकम् । प्रधानं प्रकृतिश्चेति यदाहुस्तत्त्वचिन्तकाः
verses.transliteration: avyaktaṃ kāraṇaṃ yattannityaṃ sadasadātmakam / pradhānaṃ prakṛtiśceti yadāhustattvacintakāḥ
verses.translation: The Supreme Person (Lord Visnu) has incarnated himself in your form, with a ray of his own Self, at the time of the sacrificial session of god Svayambhu (the Self-born god Brahma)—a session which extended (over many days). It was on the day of the extraction of the Soma juice {sutyaha)' that you were born in order to recount the Samhita (the sacred text of Pur anas).
verses.hindi: गन्ध, वर्ण और रससे हीन, शब्द-स्पर्शसे रहित, जगद्योनिर्महाभूतं परं ब्रह्म सनातनम्। विग्रहः सर्वभूतानामात्मनाधिष्ठितं महत्
verses.wordMeaning: The Supreme Person (Lord Visnu) has incarnated himself in your form, with a ray of his own Self, at the time of the sacrificial session of god Svayambhu (the Self-born god Brahma)—a session which extended (over many days).…
verses.commentary: Sense: The Supreme Person (Lord Visnu) has incarnated himself in your form, with a ray of his own Self, at the time of the sacrificial session of god Svayambhu (the Self-born god Brahma)—a session which extended (over many days).…

verses.sanskrit: गन्धवर्णरसैर्हेनं शब्दस्पर्शविवर्जितम् । अजरं ध्रुवमक्षय्यं नित्यं स्वात्मन्यवस्थितम्
verses.transliteration: gandhavarṇarasairhenaṃ śabdasparśavivarjitam / ajaraṃ dhruvamakṣayyaṃ nityaṃ svātmanyavasthitam
verses.translation: Hence, O holy Sir, proficient in the interpretation of Puranic lore, we request your worship to narrate the excellent Kurma Purdna. It behoves you to narrate it to us.
verses.hindi: असाम्प्रतमविज्ञेयं ब्रह्माग्रे समवर्तत स एव क्षोभको विप्राः क्षोभ्यश्च परमेश्वरः । स संकोचविकासाभ्यां प्रधानत्वेऽपि च स्थितः
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, O holy Sir, proficient in the interpretation of Puranic lore, we request your worship to narrate the excellent Kurma Purdna. It behoves you to narrate it to us.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, O holy Sir, proficient in the interpretation of Puranic lore, we request your worship to narrate the excellent Kurma Purdna. It behoves you to narrate it to us.

verses.sanskrit: जगद्योनिर्महाभूतं परं ब्रह्म सनातनम् । विग्रहः सर्वभूतानामात्मनाधिष्ठितं महत्
verses.transliteration: jagadyonirmahābhūtaṃ paraṃ brahma sanātanam / vigrahaḥ sarvabhūtānāmātmanādhiṣṭhitaṃ mahat
verses.translation: On hearing the words of the sages, Suta, the most excellent among the knowers of Purams, bowed mentally to his preceptor Vyasa, the son of Satyavati and said:
verses.hindi: महानात्मा मतिर्ब्रह्मा प्रबुद्धः ख्यातिरीश्वरः । वैकारिकस्तैजसश्च भूतादिश्चैव तामसः। त्रिविधोऽयमहंकारो महतः सम्बभूव ह
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the words of the sages, Suta, the most excellent among the knowers of Purams, bowed mentally to his preceptor Vyasa, the son of Satyavati and said:
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of the sages, Suta, the most excellent among the knowers of Purams, bowed mentally to his preceptor Vyasa, the son of Satyavati and said:

verses.sanskrit: अनाद्यन्तमजं सूक्ष्मं त्रिगुणं प्रभवाप्ययम् । असांप्रतमविज्ञेयं ब्रह्माग्रे समवर्तत
verses.transliteration: anādyantamajaṃ sūkṣmaṃ triguṇaṃ prabhavāpyayam / asāṃpratamavijñeyaṃ brahmāgre samavartata
verses.translation: After bowing down to Hari who is the source (i.e. the Creator) of the universe and has assumed the form of the divine Tortoise, I shall narrate that divine story of the Kurma Parana that destroys sins.
verses.hindi: अह॑कारोऽभिमानश्च कर्ता मन्ता च स स्मृतः। पञ्चभूतान्यहंकारात् तन्मात्राणि च जज्ञिरे। इन्द्रियाणि तथा देवाः सर्व तस्यात्मजं जगत्
verses.wordMeaning: After bowing down to Hari who is the source (i.e. the Creator) of the universe and has assumed the form of the divine Tortoise, I shall narrate that divine story of the Kurma Parana that destroys sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: After bowing down to Hari who is the source (i.e. the Creator) of the universe and has assumed the form of the divine Tortoise, I shall narrate that divine story of the Kurma Parana that destroys sins.

verses.sanskrit: गुणसाम्ये तदा तस्मिन् पुरुषे चात्मनि स्थिते । प्राकृतः प्रलयो ज्ञेयो यावद् विश्वसमुद्भवः
verses.transliteration: guṇasāmye tadā tasmin puruṣe cātmani sthite / prākṛtaḥ pralayo jñeyo yāvad viśvasamudbhavaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing it (the divine story) even a sinner attains the highest state of existence. No one should recount this holy story at any time to an atheist or a non-believer.
verses.hindi: अपनी आत्मामें स्थित संसारका बीजरूप, महाभूत, सनातन, परब्रह्म, सभी प्राणियोंको मूर्तिरूप, आत्मासे त्रिगुण, उत्पत्ति और प्रलयका स्थान, शाश्वत तथा अचिज्ञेय ब्रह्म ही आदिमें विद्यमान था
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing it (the divine story) even a sinner attains the highest state of existence. No one should recount this holy story at any time to an atheist or a non-believer.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing it (the divine story) even a sinner attains the highest state of existence. No one should recount this holy story at any time to an atheist or a non-believer.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मी रात्रिरियं प्रोक्ता अहः सृष्टिरुदाहृता । अहर्न विद्यते तस्य न रात्रिर्ह्युपचारतः
verses.transliteration: brāhmī rātririyaṃ proktā ahaḥ sṛṣṭirudāhṛtā / aharna vidyate tasya na rātrirhyupacārataḥ
verses.translation: One should tell this story narrated by Narayana himself to a righteous twice-born (i.e. Brahmana, Ksattriya or a Vaisya) who is faithful and quiescent.
verses.hindi: उस समय गुणोंकी साम्यावस्थारूप उस पुरुषके आत्मस्वरूपमें स्थित होनेपर जबतक विश्वकी सृष्टि नहीं हो जाती, प्राकृत प्रलय (-का समय) जानना चाहिए । यह ब्रह्माकी रात्रि कही गयी है और सृष्टिको ब्रह्माका दिन कहा गया हे, (वास्तवमें) उसका न दिन होता है और न रात होती है
verses.wordMeaning: One should tell this story narrated by Narayana himself to a righteous twice-born (i.e. Brahmana, Ksattriya or a Vaisya) who is faithful and quiescent.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should tell this story narrated by Narayana himself to a righteous twice-born (i.e. Brahmana, Ksattriya or a Vaisya) who is faithful and quiescent.

verses.sanskrit: निशान्ते प्रतिबुद्धो ऽसौ जगदादिरनादिमान् । सर्वभूतमयो ऽव्यक्तो ह्यन्तर्यामीश्वरः परः
verses.transliteration: niśānte pratibuddho 'sau jagadādiranādimān / sarvabhūtamayo 'vyakto hyantaryāmīśvaraḥ paraḥ
verses.translation: A Purana has five characteristics viz. Sarga (Crea¬ tion), (Re-creation after deluge or destruction), Vcma
verses.hindi: आदिसे रहित वह जगतका आदि कारण, सर्वभूतमय, जाग्रत् हुआ। परमेश्वर महेश्वरने प्रकृति एवं पुरुषमें शीघ ही प्रविष्ट होकर परम योगके द्वारा (उनमें) क्षोभ (गति) उत्पन्न किया
verses.wordMeaning: A Purana has five characteristics viz. Sarga (Crea¬ tion), (Re-creation after deluge or destruction), Vcma
verses.commentary: Sense: A Purana has five characteristics viz. Sarga (Crea¬ tion), (Re-creation after deluge or destruction), Vcma

verses.sanskrit: प्रकृतिं पुरुषं चैव प्रविश्याशु महेश्वरः । क्षोभयामास योगेन परेण परमेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: prakṛtiṃ puruṣaṃ caiva praviśyāśu maheśvaraḥ / kṣobhayāmāsa yogena pareṇa parameśvaraḥ
verses.translation: O Brahmanas, after hearing the eighteen Furanas other UpaPurdms have been briefly narrated by the sages.
verses.hindi: जैसे वसन्त ऋतुकी वायु अथवा मद पुरुष एवं स्त्रियोंको (क्षुब्ध करता है) वैसे ही वह योगविग्रह (योगबलसे विविध शरीर-धारणमें समर्थ ईश्वर) प्रकृति एवं पुरुषमें अनृप्रविष्ट होकर क्षोभका कारण बनता है। हे ब्राह्मणो! वही परमेश्वर क्षोभ उत्पन्न करनेवाला है एवं स्वयं क्षुब्ध होनेवाला है, वह प्रलय एवं सृष्टि करनेके कारण प्रधान भी कहलाता है। प्रधान पुरातनपुरुषके क्षुब्ध होनेसे प्रधान (प्रकृति) पुरुषात्मक महद् बीजका
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas, after hearing the eighteen Furanas other UpaPurdms have been briefly narrated by the sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas, after hearing the eighteen Furanas other UpaPurdms have been briefly narrated by the sages.

verses.sanskrit: यथा मदो नरस्त्रीणां यथा वा माधवो ऽनिलः । अनुप्रविष्टः क्षोभाय तथासौ योगमूर्तिमान्
verses.transliteration: yathā mado narastrīṇāṃ yathā vā mādhavo 'nilaḥ / anupraviṣṭaḥ kṣobhāya tathāsau yogamūrtimān
verses.translation: This Brdhmi Sarnhitd is on a par with the four Vedas. In it there are six thousand verses in number.
verses.hindi: आविर्भाव हुआ॥ १४--१६ ॥ इसी कारणसे (वह महद्वीज) महान् आत्मा, मति, ब्रह्मा, प्रबुद्ध, ख्याति, इश्वर, प्रज्ञा, धृति, स्मृति तथा संवित् कहलाता है
verses.wordMeaning: This Brdhmi Sarnhitd is on a par with the four Vedas. In it there are six thousand verses in number.
verses.commentary: Sense: This Brdhmi Sarnhitd is on a par with the four Vedas. In it there are six thousand verses in number.

verses.sanskrit: स एव क्षोभको विप्राः क्षोभ्यश्च परमेश्वरः । स संकोचविकासाभ्यां प्रधानत्वे ऽपि च स्थितः
verses.transliteration: sa eva kṣobhako viprāḥ kṣobhyaśca parameśvaraḥ / sa saṃkocavikāsābhyāṃ pradhānatve 'pi ca sthitaḥ
verses.translation: O great sages, the greatness of Dharma, Artha, Kama and Moksa is completely known from it. The Supreme Controller, the Brahman is also known from this.
verses.hindi: महत्तत्त्वसे समस्त प्राणियोंको सृष्टिका आदि कारण वैकारिक, तैजस तथा तामस--यह तीन प्रकारका अहंकार उत्पन्न हुआ वह अहंकार अभिमान, कर्ता, मन्ता, आत्मा, पुद्गल तथा जीव (नामों)-से कहा गया है। उसी अहंकारसे सभी प्रवृत्तियाँ होती हैं। अहंकारसे पाँच महाभूत (पृथ्वी, जल, तेज, वायु तथा आकाश), पाँच
verses.wordMeaning: O great sages, the greatness of Dharma, Artha, Kama and Moksa is completely known from it. The Supreme Controller, the Brahman is also known from this.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sages, the greatness of Dharma, Artha, Kama and Moksa is completely known from it. The Supreme Controller, the Brahman is also known from this.

verses.sanskrit: प्रधानात् क्षोभ्यमाणाच्च तथा पुंसः पुरातनात् । प्रादुरासीन्महद् बीजं प्रधानपुरुषात्मकम्
verses.transliteration: pradhānāt kṣobhyamāṇācca tathā puṃsaḥ purātanāt / prādurāsīnmahad bījaṃ pradhānapuruṣātmakam
verses.translation: This divine sanctifying story consisting of Sarga (crea¬ tion), Fra/fwj( secondary creation), Varhsa (dynasties), Alanvan- tara (Manu-Ages), and Varhsdmicarita (accounts of the dynasties and the meritorious accounts relating to gods) ® was narrated on a certain occasion.
verses.hindi: इन्द्रियाँ तथा उन इन्द्रियोंके अधिष्ठातृ देवता उत्पन्न हुए। यह सम्पूर्ण जगत् उससे ही उत्पन्न हुआ है मनस्त्वव्यक्तजं प्रोक्तं विकारः प्रथमः स्मृतः । येनासौ जायते कर्ता भूतादींश्रानृपश्यति
verses.wordMeaning: This divine sanctifying story consisting of Sarga (crea¬ tion), Fra/fwj( secondary creation), Varhsa (dynasties), Alanvan- tara (Manu-Ages), and Varhsdmicarita (accounts of the dynasties and the meritorious accounts relating to gods) ® was narrated on a certain occasion.
verses.commentary: Sense: This divine sanctifying story consisting of Sarga (crea¬ tion), Fra/fwj( secondary creation), Varhsa (dynasties), Alanvan- tara (Manu-Ages), and Varhsdmicarita (accounts of the dynasties and the meritorious accounts relating to gods) ® was narrated on a certain occasion.

verses.sanskrit: महानात्मा मतिर्ब्रह्मा प्रबुद्धिः ख्यातिरीश्वरः । प्रज्ञाधृतिः स्मृतिः संविदेतस्मादिति तत् स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: mahānātmā matirbrahmā prabuddhiḥ khyātirīśvaraḥ / prajñādhṛtiḥ smṛtiḥ saṃvidetasmāditi tat smṛtam
verses.translation: This story should be retained in memory by virtuous Brahmanas and others who have mastered the Vedas. I shall tell in details that story which had been formerly narrated by Vyasa.
verses.hindi: बैकारिकादहंकारात् सर्गो वैकारिकोऽभवत्। तैजसानीन्द्रियाणि स्युर्देवा वैकारिका दश एकादशं मनस्तत्र स्वगुणेनोभयात्मकम्। भूततन्मात्रसर्गोऽयं भूतादेरभवन् प्रजा:
verses.wordMeaning: This story should be retained in memory by virtuous Brahmanas and others who have mastered the Vedas. I shall tell in details that story which had been formerly narrated by Vyasa.
verses.commentary: Sense: This story should be retained in memory by virtuous Brahmanas and others who have mastered the Vedas. I shall tell in details that story which had been formerly narrated by Vyasa.

verses.sanskrit: वैकारिकस्तैजसश्च भूतादिश्चैव तामसः । त्रिविधो ऽयमहङ्कारो महतः संबभूव ह
verses.transliteration: vaikārikastaijasaśca bhūtādiścaiva tāmasaḥ / trividho 'yamahaṅkāro mahataḥ saṃbabhūva ha
verses.translation: In days of yore, the gods in co-operation with Dai- tyas and Danavas, made the mountain Mandara their churning rod and churned the milk-ocean, Tor obtaining the nectar.
verses.hindi: आकाशं शुषिरं तस्मादुत्पन्नं शब्दलक्षणम् आकाशस्तु विकुर्वाणः स्पर्शमात्रं ससर्ज ह। वायुरुत्पद्यते तस्मात् तस्य स्पर्शो गुणो मत:
verses.wordMeaning: In days of yore, the gods in co-operation with Dai- tyas and Danavas, made the mountain Mandara their churning rod and churned the milk-ocean, Tor obtaining the nectar.
verses.commentary: Sense: In days of yore, the gods in co-operation with Dai- tyas and Danavas, made the mountain Mandara their churning rod and churned the milk-ocean, Tor obtaining the nectar.

verses.sanskrit: अहङ्कारो ऽबिमानश्च कर्ता मन्ता च स स्मृतः । आत्मा च पुद्गलो जीवो यतः सर्वाः प्रवृत्तयः
verses.transliteration: ahaṅkāro 'bimānaśca kartā mantā ca sa smṛtaḥ / ātmā ca pudgalo jīvo yataḥ sarvāḥ pravṛttayaḥ
verses.translation: While it was being churned. Lord Janardana assumed the form of a divine Tortoise and bore the mountain Mandara on his back with the desire for the welfare of the gods.
verses.hindi: आकाशं शब्दमात्रं यत् स्पर्शमात्रं समावृणोत् । द्विगुणस्तु ततो वायुः शब्दस्पर्शात्मकोऽभवत् त्रिगुणः स्यात् ततो वह्निः स शब्दस्पर्शरूपवान्
verses.wordMeaning: While it was being churned. Lord Janardana assumed the form of a divine Tortoise and bore the mountain Mandara on his back with the desire for the welfare of the gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: While it was being churned. Lord Janardana assumed the form of a divine Tortoise and bore the mountain Mandara on his back with the desire for the welfare of the gods.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चभूतान्यहङ्कारात् तन्मात्राणि च जज्ञिरे । इन्द्रियाणि तथा देवाः सर्वं तस्यात्मजं जगत्
verses.transliteration: pañcabhūtānyahaṅkārāt tanmātrāṇi ca jajñire / indriyāṇi tathā devāḥ sarvaṃ tasyātmajaṃ jagat
verses.translation: On seeing the imperishable Visnu, the cosmic witness (Saksin) assuming the form of a Tortoise, Narada and other great sages along with the gods eulogised the Lord.
verses.hindi: तस्माच्चतुर्गुणा आपो विज्ञेयास्तु रसात्मिकाः अव्यक्तसे उत्पन्न मनको प्रथम विकार माना गया है। इस कारण यह कर्ता एवं भूतादिकोंको देखनेवाला है। वैकारिक अहंकारसे वैकारिक सृष्टि उत्पन्न हुई। इन्द्रियाँ तैजस हैं और (उन इन्द्रियोंके अधिष्ठाता) दस
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing the imperishable Visnu, the cosmic witness (Saksin) assuming the form of a Tortoise, Narada and other great sages along with the gods eulogised the Lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the imperishable Visnu, the cosmic witness (Saksin) assuming the form of a Tortoise, Narada and other great sages along with the gods eulogised the Lord.

verses.sanskrit: मनस्त्वव्यक्तजं प्रोक्तं विकारः प्रथमः स्मृतः । येनासौ जायते कर्ता भूतादींश्चानुपश्यति
verses.transliteration: manastvavyaktajaṃ proktaṃ vikāraḥ prathamaḥ smṛtaḥ / yenāsau jāyate kartā bhūtādīṃścānupaśyati
verses.translation: In the mean time, goddess Sri, the beloved of Nara- yana, emerged (out of the sea ) there while churning. Lord Visnu, the Supreme Person, took possession of her (as his consort).
verses.hindi: उनमें (ग्यारहवाँ) इन्द्रिय मन अपने गुणके कारण उभयात्मक  है। यह भूततन्मात्राओंकी सृष्टि है। भूतादिकोंसे ही प्रजा उत्पन्न हुई। विकारप्रा्त भूतोंने शब्दतन्मात्राको उत्पन्न किया। उस (शब्द तन्मात्रा)-से शब्द लक्षण- वाले तथा अवकाशस्वरूप आकाशको उत्पत्ति हुई। वैकारिक आकाशने स्पर्श तन्मात्राको उत्पन्न किया। उससे वायु उत्पन्न हुआ और वायुका गुण स्पर्श कहा गया है
verses.wordMeaning: In the mean time, goddess Sri, the beloved of Nara- yana, emerged (out of the sea ) there while churning. Lord Visnu, the Supreme Person, took possession of her (as his consort).
verses.commentary: Sense: In the mean time, goddess Sri, the beloved of Nara- yana, emerged (out of the sea ) there while churning. Lord Visnu, the Supreme Person, took possession of her (as his consort).

verses.sanskrit: वैकारिकादहङ्कारात् सर्गो वैकारिको ऽभवत् । तैजसानीन्द्रियाणि स्युर्देवा वैकारिका दश
verses.transliteration: vaikārikādahaṅkārāt sargo vaikāriko 'bhavat / taijasānīndriyāṇi syurdevā vaikārikā daśa
verses.translation: Accompanied by Indra, Narada and other great sages who were fascinated by the brilliance ofVisnu addressed these words conducive to their welfare to Visnu, the unmanifest.
verses.hindi: विकारप्राप्त वायुने रूप तन्मात्राको उत्पन्न किया, वायुसे तेज उत्पन्न हुआ और इसका 'रूप' गुण कहा जाता है। विकारको प्राप्त हुए तेजने भी रस तन्मात्राकी सृष्टि की और उससे फिर जलकी उत्पत्ति हुई, वह जल इस 'रस' गुणका आधार है। विकारको प्राप्त हो रहे जलने गन्ध तन्मात्राको उत्पन्न किया, उससे संघात (पृथ्वीतत्त्व) उत्पन्न हुआ और उसका गुण ' गन्ध' माना गया है
verses.wordMeaning: Accompanied by Indra, Narada and other great sages who were fascinated by the brilliance ofVisnu addressed these words conducive to their welfare to Visnu, the unmanifest.
verses.commentary: Sense: Accompanied by Indra, Narada and other great sages who were fascinated by the brilliance ofVisnu addressed these words conducive to their welfare to Visnu, the unmanifest.

verses.sanskrit: एकादशं मनस्तत्र स्वगुणेनोभयात्मकम् । भूततन्मात्रसर्गो ऽयं भूतादेरभवन् प्रजाः
verses.transliteration: ekādaśaṃ manastatra svaguṇenobhayātmakam / bhūtatanmātrasargo 'yaṃ bhūtāderabhavan prajāḥ
verses.translation: O Lord Narayana, Lord of the Lords of Devas, who have assumed the form of the Universe, be pleased to tell us, the suppliant enquirers, who is this goddess of wide eyes. Be pleased to explain this precisely to us.
verses.hindi: आकाशको शब्द नामक तन्मात्रा है, उसने स्पर्श नामक तन्मात्राको आवृत किया है, इसलिये वायु शब्द तथा स्पर्श-इन दो गुणोंवाला है। उसी प्रकार रूप (नामक) गुण, शब्द एबं स्पर्श दो गुणोंसे आविष्ट है, गुणोंवाला है। शब्द, स्पर्श तथा रूप एवं रस तन्मात्रामें प्रविष्ट हुए, इसलिये रसात्मक जल-तत्त्वको चार गुणों (शब्द, स्पर्श, रूप तथा रस)-से युक्त समझना चाहिए। शब्द, स्पर्श, रूप तथा रस--ये चार गुण गन्ध तन्मात्रामें
verses.wordMeaning: O Lord Narayana, Lord of the Lords of Devas, who have assumed the form of the Universe, be pleased to tell us, the suppliant enquirers, who is this goddess of wide eyes. Be pleased to explain this precisely to us.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Lord Narayana, Lord of the Lords of Devas, who have assumed the form of the Universe, be pleased to tell us, the suppliant enquirers, who is this goddess of wide eyes. Be pleased to explain this precisely to us.

verses.sanskrit: भूतादिस्तु विकुर्वाणः शब्दमात्रं ससर्ज ह । आकाशं शुषिरं तस्मादुत्पन्नं शब्दलक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: bhūtādistu vikurvāṇaḥ śabdamātraṃ sasarja ha / ākāśaṃ śuṣiraṃ tasmādutpannaṃ śabdalakṣaṇam
verses.translation: On hearing their words, Visnu, the suppressor of the Danavas, spoke thus to the sinless Narada and others after cast¬ ing a glance at the goddess.
verses.hindi: प्रविष्ट हुए, इसलिये पञ्च स्थूल महाभूतसे युक्त पृथ्वी तत्त्व पाँच गुणोंवाला कहा गया है इसी कारण ये शान्त, घोर, मूढ तथा विशेष कहलाते हैं। ये परस्पर एक-दूसरेमें प्रविष्ट होनेके कारण आपसमें एक दूसरेको धारण किये रहते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing their words, Visnu, the suppressor of the Danavas, spoke thus to the sinless Narada and others after cast¬ ing a glance at the goddess.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing their words, Visnu, the suppressor of the Danavas, spoke thus to the sinless Narada and others after cast¬ ing a glance at the goddess.

verses.sanskrit: आकाशस्तु विकुर्वाणः स्पर्शमात्रं ससर्ज ह । वायुरुत्पद्यते तस्मात् तस्य स्पर्शो गुणो मतः
verses.transliteration: ākāśastu vikurvāṇaḥ sparśamātraṃ sasarja ha / vāyurutpadyate tasmāt tasya sparśo guṇo mataḥ
verses.translation: This is that great Sakti (potency) of my form and the embodiment of Brahman. She is my beloved Maya, the Infinite, by whom this Universe is sustained.
verses.hindi: हस्त आदि पाँच कर्मेन्द्रिय हैं तथा चक्षु आदि पाँच ज्ञानेन्द्रिय हैं। 'मन” उभयात्मक है अर्थात् संकल्प-विकल्प-रूप कर्म भी करता है तथा उसे सुख-दुःखका ज्ञान भी होता है।
verses.wordMeaning: This is that great Sakti (potency) of my form and the embodiment of Brahman. She is my beloved Maya, the Infinite, by whom this Universe is sustained.
verses.commentary: Sense: This is that great Sakti (potency) of my form and the embodiment of Brahman. She is my beloved Maya, the Infinite, by whom this Universe is sustained.

verses.sanskrit: वायुश्चापि विकुर्वाणो रूपमात्रं ससर्ज ह । ज्योतिरुत्पद्यते वायोस्तद्रूपगुणमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: vāyuścāpi vikurvāṇo rūpamātraṃ sasarja ha / jyotirutpadyate vāyostadrūpaguṇamucyate
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas, it is through her that I fascinate this entire Universe including gods, Asuras and human beings. I withdraw them within me and create them again.
verses.hindi: एककालसमुत्पन्नं जलबुद्बुदवच्च तत्। विशेषेभ्योऽण्डमभवद् बृहत् तदुदकेशयम् तस्मिन् कार्यस्य करणं संसिद्धिः परमेष्ठिनः । प्राकृतेऽण्डे विवृत्तः स क्षेत्रज्ञो ब्रह्मसंज्ञितः
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahmanas, it is through her that I fascinate this entire Universe including gods, Asuras and human beings. I withdraw them within me and create them again.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmanas, it is through her that I fascinate this entire Universe including gods, Asuras and human beings. I withdraw them within me and create them again.

verses.sanskrit: ज्योतिश्चापि विकुर्वाणं रसमात्रं ससर्ज ह । संभवन्ति ततो ऽम्भांसि रसाधाराणि तानि तु
verses.transliteration: jyotiścāpi vikurvāṇaṃ rasamātraṃ sasarja ha / saṃbhavanti tato 'mbhāṃsi rasādhārāṇi tāni tu
verses.translation: Those who, through their spiritual wisdom com¬ prehend the evolution and dissolution of the living beings as well as their arrival i.e. birth and departure i.e. death, realise their Atman and cross this vast Maya.
verses.hindi: आदिकर्ता स भूतानां ब्रह्माग्रे समवर्तत तस्मिन्नण्डेऽभवद् विश्वं सदेवासुरमानुषम्  चन्द्रादित्यौ सनक्षत्रौ सग्रहौ सह वायुना
verses.wordMeaning: Those who, through their spiritual wisdom com¬ prehend the evolution and dissolution of the living beings as well as their arrival i.e. birth and departure i.e. death, realise their Atman and cross this vast Maya.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who, through their spiritual wisdom com¬ prehend the evolution and dissolution of the living beings as well as their arrival i.e. birth and departure i.e. death, realise their Atman and cross this vast Maya.

verses.sanskrit: आपश्चापि विकुर्वन्त्यो गन्धमात्रं ससर्जिरे । संघातो जायते तस्मात् तस्य गन्धो गुणो मतः
verses.transliteration: āpaścāpi vikurvantyo gandhamātraṃ sasarjire / saṃghāto jāyate tasmāt tasya gandho guṇo mataḥ
verses.translation: It is by basing themselves for their support on a particle or a ray of hers that gods Brahma, Isana and all other gods become powerful. She is my entire Sakti.
verses.hindi: आकाशेनावृतो वायुः खं तु भूतादिनावृतम् एते लोका महात्मानः सर्वतत्त्वाभिमानिनः
verses.wordMeaning: It is by basing themselves for their support on a particle or a ray of hers that gods Brahma, Isana and all other gods become powerful. She is my entire Sakti.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is by basing themselves for their support on a particle or a ray of hers that gods Brahma, Isana and all other gods become powerful. She is my entire Sakti.

verses.sanskrit: आकाशं शब्दमात्रं यत् स्पर्शमात्रं समावृणोत् । द्विगुणस्तु ततो वायुः शब्दस्पर्शात्मको ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: ākāśaṃ śabdamātraṃ yat sparśamātraṃ samāvṛṇot / dviguṇastu tato vāyuḥ śabdasparśātmako 'bhavat
verses.translation: She is the mother of all the Universe. She is Prakrit consisting of three Gums (viz. Saliva, Rajas and Tamas). Even in the previous Kalpa, she is born of me already. She is Sri, the lotus-dweller.
verses.hindi: ईश्वरा योगधर्माणो ये चान्ये तत्त्वचिन्तकाः ये सातों महात्मा (महत्, अहंकार आदि तत्त्व) एक-दूसरेके आश्रित होनेके कारण बिना सम्पूर्ण रूपसे मिले सृष्टि करनेमें समर्थ नहीं हो सके॥ ३४॥ पुरुषसे अधिष्ठित और अव्यक्तसे अनुगृहीत होनेके कारण
verses.wordMeaning: She is the mother of all the Universe. She is Prakrit consisting of three Gums (viz. Saliva, Rajas and Tamas). Even in the previous Kalpa, she is born of me already. She is Sri, the lotus-dweller.
verses.commentary: Sense: She is the mother of all the Universe. She is Prakrit consisting of three Gums (viz. Saliva, Rajas and Tamas). Even in the previous Kalpa, she is born of me already. She is Sri, the lotus-dweller.

verses.sanskrit: रूपं तथैवाविशतः शब्दस्पर्शौ गुणावुभौ । त्रिगुणः स्यात् ततो वह्निः स शब्दस्पर्शरूपवान्
verses.transliteration: rūpaṃ tathaivāviśataḥ śabdasparśau guṇāvubhau / triguṇaḥ syāt tato vahniḥ sa śabdasparśarūpavān
verses.translation: She is endowed with four arms bearing in each of her hands the conch, the discus and the lotus. She wears a gar¬ land. She is brilliant like a crore of suns and she deludes all embodied beings.
verses.hindi: महत्तत्त्वसे लेकर विशेष (पञ्चभूत)-पर्यन्त वे सभी (तत्त्व) अण्डको उत्पन्न करते हें विशेषों (महाभूतों)-से एक बारमें ही जलके बुल- बुलेके समान तथा जलमें स्थित वह बृहत् अण्ड उत्पन्न हुआ। उसी (बृहत् अण्ड)-में परमेष्ठीके (सृष्टिस्वरूप) कार्यका करण सिद्ध (निष्पन्न) हुआ। प्राकृत अण्डमें
verses.wordMeaning: She is endowed with four arms bearing in each of her hands the conch, the discus and the lotus. She wears a gar¬ land. She is brilliant like a crore of suns and she deludes all embodied beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: She is endowed with four arms bearing in each of her hands the conch, the discus and the lotus. She wears a gar¬ land. She is brilliant like a crore of suns and she deludes all embodied beings.

verses.sanskrit: शब्द स्पर्शश्च रूपं च रसमात्रं समाविशन् । तस्माच्चतुर्गुणा आपो विज्ञेयास्तु रसात्मिकाः
verses.transliteration: śabda sparśaśca rūpaṃ ca rasamātraṃ samāviśan / tasmāccaturguṇā āpo vijñeyāstu rasātmikāḥ
verses.translation: Neither the gods nor the manes (Pilrs) nor human beings nor even Indra, the king of gods, nor any other embodied being in the world, is capable of crossing (surmounting) this Maya.
verses.hindi: क्षेत्रज्ञ आविर्भूत हुआ जो ब्रह्मा नामसे कहलाया। वे प्रथम शरीर धारण करनेवाले हैं। वे पुरुष कहलाते हैं और समस्त प्राणियोंके आदिकर्ता वे ब्रह्मा सर्वप्रथम उत्पन्न हुए। प्रधानसे परमें स्थित उस पुरुषको हंस, हिरण्यगर्भ, कपिल, छन्दोमूर्ति तथा सनातन कहा जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: Neither the gods nor the manes (Pilrs) nor human beings nor even Indra, the king of gods, nor any other embodied being in the world, is capable of crossing (surmounting) this Maya.
verses.commentary: Sense: Neither the gods nor the manes (Pilrs) nor human beings nor even Indra, the king of gods, nor any other embodied being in the world, is capable of crossing (surmounting) this Maya.

verses.sanskrit: शब्दः स्पर्शश्च रूपं च रसो गन्धं समाविशन् । तसमात् पञ्चगुणा भूमिः स्थूला भूतेषु शब्द्यते
verses.transliteration: śabdaḥ sparśaśca rūpaṃ ca raso gandhaṃ samāviśan / tasamāt pañcaguṇā bhūmiḥ sthūlā bhūteṣu śabdyate
verses.translation: The sages who were thus addressed by Vasudeva spoke to god Visnu: "O lotus-eyed God, say what is it that exists when even the time is terminated {v.L survives in the past, present and future)."
verses.hindi: उस परमात्माका गर्भवेष्टन था मेरु, पर्वत थे गर्भके उस अण्डमें देवताओं, असुरों तथा मनुष्योंसहित सम्पूर्ण विश्व उत्पन्न हुआ तथा ग्रहों, नक्षत्रोंसहित वायु, सूर्य एवं चन्द्रमा भी उत्पन्न हुए
verses.wordMeaning: The sages who were thus addressed by Vasudeva spoke to god Visnu: "O lotus-eyed God, say what is it that exists when even the time is terminated {v.L survives in the past, present and future)."
verses.commentary: Sense: The sages who were thus addressed by Vasudeva spoke to god Visnu: "O lotus-eyed God, say what is it that exists when even the time is terminated {v.L survives in the past, present and future)."

verses.sanskrit: शान्ता घोराश्च मूढाश्च विशेषास्तेन ते स्मृताः । परस्परानुप्रवेशाद् धारयन्ति परस्परम्
verses.transliteration: śāntā ghorāśca mūḍhāśca viśeṣāstena te smṛtāḥ / parasparānupraveśād dhārayanti parasparam
verses.translation: Thereupon Hrsikesa (God Visnu), worshipped by the groups of sages, spoke unto them: "There is the most pro¬ minent twice-born well known by the name Indradyumna.
verses.hindi: अण्ड (ब्रह्माण्ड) बाहरकी ओर अपनेसे दस गुने अधिक जलसे घिरा हुआ है और जल बाहरसे अपनेसे दस गुने अधिक तेजसे आवृत है। तेज बाहरसे अपनेसे दस गुने अधिक वायुसे आवृत है! इसी प्रकार वायु आकाशसे आवृत है और आकाश भूतादि अर्थात् अहंकारसे घिरा हुआ है। जैसे अहंकार महत्तत््वसे आवृत है, वैसे ही महत्तत्त्व अव्यक्तसे आवृत है। ये लोक सर्वतत्त्वाभिमानी महान् स्वरूप-
verses.wordMeaning: Thereupon Hrsikesa (God Visnu), worshipped by the groups of sages, spoke unto them: "There is the most pro¬ minent twice-born well known by the name Indradyumna.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereupon Hrsikesa (God Visnu), worshipped by the groups of sages, spoke unto them: "There is the most pro¬ minent twice-born well known by the name Indradyumna.

verses.sanskrit: एते सप्त महात्मानो ह्यन्योन्यस्य समाश्रयात् । नाशक्नुवन् प्रजाः स्त्रष्टुमसमागम्य कृत्स्नशः
verses.transliteration: ete sapta mahātmāno hyanyonyasya samāśrayāt / nāśaknuvan prajāḥ straṣṭumasamāgamya kṛtsnaśaḥ
verses.translation: Continue to survive on this earth with another par¬ ticle of yours, in your highly blissful state. When the Vaivasvata Manvantard}- elapses, you will enter into me for the sake of creation."
verses.hindi: उन (लोकों)-में उन्हींके आत्मरूप ऐश्वर्यसम्पन्न तथा योगधर्मा (योगधर्मसे युक्त) पुरुष निवास करते हैं और अन्य भी जो तत्त्वचिन्तक हैं, वे भी निवास करते हैं। (वे सभी पुरुष) सर्वज्ञ, शान्त रजोगुणवाले अर्थात् सत्त्वसम्पन्न तथा नित्य ही अत्यन्त प्रसन्न मनवाले हैं। ब्रह्माण्ड इन्हीं प्राकृत सात आवरणोंसे आवृत है
verses.wordMeaning: Continue to survive on this earth with another par¬ ticle of yours, in your highly blissful state. When the Vaivasvata Manvantard}- elapses, you will enter into me for the sake of creation."
verses.commentary: Sense: Continue to survive on this earth with another par¬ ticle of yours, in your highly blissful state. When the Vaivasvata Manvantard}- elapses, you will enter into me for the sake of creation."

verses.sanskrit: पुरुषाधिष्ठितात्वाच्च अव्यक्तानुग्रहेण च । महादादयो विशेषान्ता ह्मण्डमुत्पादयन्ति ते
verses.transliteration: puruṣādhiṣṭhitātvācca avyaktānugraheṇa ca / mahādādayo viśeṣāntā hmaṇḍamutpādayanti te
verses.translation: He realised that I am the deity called Vasudeva in whom the two eternals Vidya and Avidya are lying unmanifest
verses.hindi: एतत् प्राधानिकं कार्य यन्मया बीजमीरितम्। प्रजापतेः परा मूर्तिरितीयं वैदिकी श्रुतिः ब्रह्माण्डमेतत् सकलं सप्तलोकतलान्वितम्। द्वितीयं तस्य देवस्य शरीरं परमेष्ठिन:
verses.wordMeaning: He realised that I am the deity called Vasudeva in whom the two eternals Vidya and Avidya are lying unmanifest
verses.commentary: Sense: He realised that I am the deity called Vasudeva in whom the two eternals Vidya and Avidya are lying unmanifest

verses.sanskrit: एककालसमुत्पन्नं जलबुद्बुदवच्च तत् । विशेषेभ्यो ऽण्डमभवद् बृहत् तदुदकेशयम्
verses.transliteration: ekakālasamutpannaṃ jalabudbudavacca tat / viśeṣebhyo 'ṇḍamabhavad bṛhat tadudakeśayam
verses.translation: He worshipped the Supreme Lord, the support of all living beings, by means of the observance of sacred vows, fasts, rules of spiritual discipline, worship of sacrificial fires and pro¬ pitiation of Brahmanas.
verses.hindi: हिरण्यगर्भा भगवान् ब्रह्मा वै कनकाण्डजः । तृतीयं भगवद्रूपं प्राहुर्वेदार्थवेदिनः चतुर्मुखः स भगवान् जगत्सृष्टौ प्रवर्तते
verses.wordMeaning: He worshipped the Supreme Lord, the support of all living beings, by means of the observance of sacred vows, fasts, rules of spiritual discipline, worship of sacrificial fires and pro¬ pitiation of Brahmanas.
verses.commentary: Sense: He worshipped the Supreme Lord, the support of all living beings, by means of the observance of sacred vows, fasts, rules of spiritual discipline, worship of sacrificial fires and pro¬ pitiation of Brahmanas.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन् कार्यस्य करणं संसिद्धिः परमेष्ठिनः । प्राकृते ऽण्डे विवृत्तः स क्षेत्रज्ञो ब्रह्मसंज्ञितः
verses.transliteration: tasmin kāryasya karaṇaṃ saṃsiddhiḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ / prākṛte 'ṇḍe vivṛttaḥ sa kṣetrajño brahmasaṃjñitaḥ
verses.translation: He worshipped the great God abiding in the hearts of Yogins, turning to him for benediction, making obeisance to him remaining exclusively attached to him and realising him as the greatest goal.
verses.hindi: सत्त्वं गुणमुपाश्रित्य विष्णुर्विश्वेश्वरः स्वयम् अन्तकाले स्वयं देवः सर्वात्मा परमेश्वरः । तमोगुणं समाश्रित्य रुद्रः संहरते जगत्
verses.wordMeaning: He worshipped the great God abiding in the hearts of Yogins, turning to him for benediction, making obeisance to him remaining exclusively attached to him and realising him as the greatest goal.
verses.commentary: Sense: He worshipped the great God abiding in the hearts of Yogins, turning to him for benediction, making obeisance to him remaining exclusively attached to him and realising him as the greatest goal.

verses.sanskrit: स वै शरीरी प्रथमः स वै पुरुष उच्यते । आदिकर्ता स भूतानां ब्रह्माग्रे समवर्तत
verses.transliteration: sa vai śarīrī prathamaḥ sa vai puruṣa ucyate / ādikartā sa bhūtānāṃ brahmāgre samavartata
verses.translation: As he was practising this (course of observance) the Supreme digit (ray) of the Lord once manifested herself to him in the divine form belonging to Visnu.
verses.hindi: एकोऽपि सन्महादेवस्त्रिधासौ समवस्थितः । योगेश्वरः शरीराणि करोति विकरोति च। नानाकृतिक्रियारूपनामवन्ति स्वलीलया
verses.wordMeaning: As he was practising this (course of observance) the Supreme digit (ray) of the Lord once manifested herself to him in the divine form belonging to Visnu.
verses.commentary: Sense: As he was practising this (course of observance) the Supreme digit (ray) of the Lord once manifested herself to him in the divine form belonging to Visnu.

verses.sanskrit: यमाहुः पुरुषं हंसं प्रधानात् परतः स्थितम् । हिरण्यगर्भं कपिलं छन्दोमूर्ति सनातनम्
verses.transliteration: yamāhuḥ puruṣaṃ haṃsaṃ pradhānāt parataḥ sthitam / hiraṇyagarbhaṃ kapilaṃ chandomūrti sanātanam
verses.translation: On seeing the beloved of Lord Visnu, he bowed down his head. He eulogised her with various hymns. With palms folded in reverence, he addressed her as follows:
verses.hindi: त्रिधा विभज्य चात्मानं त्रैकाल्ये सम्प्रवर्तते । सृजते ग्रसते चैव वीक्षते च विशेषतः गुणात्मकत्वात् त्रैकाल्ये तस्मादेकः स उच्यते
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing the beloved of Lord Visnu, he bowed down his head. He eulogised her with various hymns. With palms folded in reverence, he addressed her as follows:
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the beloved of Lord Visnu, he bowed down his head. He eulogised her with various hymns. With palms folded in reverence, he addressed her as follows:

verses.sanskrit: मेरुरुल्बमभूत् तस्य जरायुश्चापि पर्वताः । गर्भोदकं समुद्राश्च तस्यासन् परमात्मनः
verses.transliteration: merurulbamabhūt tasya jarāyuścāpi parvatāḥ / garbhodakaṃ samudrāśca tasyāsan paramātmanaḥ
verses.translation: O goddess of wide eyes, who are you? O auspi¬ cious lady characterised by emblems of Visnu, be pleased to explain precisely the reality about you now.
verses.hindi: आदित्यादादिदेवोऽसौ अजातत्वादजः स्मृतः ब्राह्मणो! (इस विषयमे) केवल इतना ही कहा जा सकता है कि “यह माया बहुत ही गहन है'। बीजरूपसे मैँने जिसका वर्णन किया वह सब प्रधान अर्थात् प्रकृतिका कार्य (व्यापार) है। यह (प्रकृति या
verses.wordMeaning: O goddess of wide eyes, who are you? O auspi¬ cious lady characterised by emblems of Visnu, be pleased to explain precisely the reality about you now.
verses.commentary: Sense: O goddess of wide eyes, who are you? O auspi¬ cious lady characterised by emblems of Visnu, be pleased to explain precisely the reality about you now.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्नण्डे ऽभवद् विश्वं सदेवासुरमानुषम् । चन्द्रादित्यौ सनक्षत्रौ सग्रहौ सह वायुना
verses.transliteration: tasminnaṇḍe 'bhavad viśvaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣam / candrādityau sanakṣatrau sagrahau saha vāyunā
verses.translation: On hearing his speech, the auspicious lady was delighted. She smilingly remembered Visnu and spoke the following pleasing words to the Brahmana.
verses.hindi: माया अन्य और कोई नहीं) प्रजापतिको (ही) परा मूर्ति है--ऐसा वेदोंका अभिमत है सात लोकोंके तलसे युक्त यह सम्पूर्ण ब्रह्माण्ड उन परमेष्ठी देवका दूसरा शरीर हैं। वेदोंके अर्थको ठीक-ठीक जाननेवाले बतलाते हैं कि सोनेके समान वर्णवाले पीत अण्डसे प्रादुर्भूत हिरण्यगर्भ भगवान् ब्रह्मा
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing his speech, the auspicious lady was delighted. She smilingly remembered Visnu and spoke the following pleasing words to the Brahmana.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing his speech, the auspicious lady was delighted. She smilingly remembered Visnu and spoke the following pleasing words to the Brahmana.

verses.sanskrit: अद्भिर्दशगुणाभिश्च बाह्यतो ऽण्डं समावृतम् । आपो दशगुणेनैव तेजसा बाह्यतो वृताः
verses.transliteration: adbhirdaśaguṇābhiśca bāhyato 'ṇḍaṃ samāvṛtam / āpo daśaguṇenaiva tejasā bāhyato vṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Neither the sages nor the gods with Indra as their leader, can see me who am the same as Narayana. I am the Supreme Maya and I am absolutely identical with him.
verses.hindi: भगवानूके तीसरे रूप (शरीर) हैं उन्हीं धीमानूका जो रजोगुणयुक्त अन्य रूप है, वे ही चतुर्मुख भगवान् ब्रह्मा हैं तथा संसारको सृष्टि करते हैं। स्वयं विश्वेश्वर विश्वतोमुख विश्वात्मा भगवान् विष्णु सत्त्वगुणका आश्रय ग्रहणकर उत्पन्न हुए सम्पूर्ण
verses.wordMeaning: Neither the sages nor the gods with Indra as their leader, can see me who am the same as Narayana. I am the Supreme Maya and I am absolutely identical with him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Neither the sages nor the gods with Indra as their leader, can see me who am the same as Narayana. I am the Supreme Maya and I am absolutely identical with him.

verses.sanskrit: तेजो दशगुणेनैव बाह्यतो वायुनावृतम् । आकाशेनावृतो वायुः खं तु भूतादिनावृतम्
verses.transliteration: tejo daśaguṇenaiva bāhyato vāyunāvṛtam / ākāśenāvṛto vāyuḥ khaṃ tu bhūtādināvṛtam
verses.translation: I am not different from Narayana. If pondered pro¬ perly, (you will find that) there is no difference between us. I am identical with Visnu, the Supreme Brahman. He is the highest Lord and Controller.
verses.hindi: (संसार)-का पालन-पोषण करते हैं । अन्तकालमें स्वयं परमेश्वर सर्वात्मा रुद्रदेव तमोगुणका समाश्रयणकर संसारका संहार करते हैं॥५०--५२॥ एक होनेपर भी वे निर्गुण-निरञ्जन महादेव सृष्टि, पालन और संहाररूपी तीन गुणोंके कारण तीन रूपोंमें स्थित हैं। वे कभी एक, कभी दो, कभी तीन तथा कभी अनन्त रूप धारण कर लेते हैं। वे योगेश्वर
verses.wordMeaning: I am not different from Narayana. If pondered pro¬ perly, (you will find that) there is no difference between us. I am identical with Visnu, the Supreme Brahman. He is the highest Lord and Controller.
verses.commentary: Sense: I am not different from Narayana. If pondered pro¬ perly, (you will find that) there is no difference between us. I am identical with Visnu, the Supreme Brahman. He is the highest Lord and Controller.

verses.sanskrit: भूतादिर्महता तद्वदव्यक्तेनावृतो महान् । एते लोका महात्मनः सर्वतत्त्वाभिमानिनः
verses.transliteration: bhūtādirmahatā tadvadavyaktenāvṛto mahān / ete lokā mahātmanaḥ sarvatattvābhimāninaḥ
verses.translation: I have no power over those persons who worship the Supreme Person {Puru?ottama), the support of all living beings, by means of perfect knowledge and the path of (disin¬ terested) Karman.
verses.hindi: (परमात्मा) अपनी लीलासे अनेक आकार, क्रिया, रूप तथा नामवाले शरीरोंका निर्माण करते हैं और फिर संहार कर डालते हैं भक्तोंके कल्याणके लिये ही वे पुनः संहार करते हैं। अपनेको तीन रूपोंमें विभक्तकर तीनों कालोंमें प्रवृत्त होते हैं। इस प्रकार (वे) विशेष रूपसे सृष्टि, संहार और पालनका कार्य करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: I have no power over those persons who worship the Supreme Person {Puru?ottama), the support of all living beings, by means of perfect knowledge and the path of (disin¬ terested) Karman.
verses.commentary: Sense: I have no power over those persons who worship the Supreme Person {Puru?ottama), the support of all living beings, by means of perfect knowledge and the path of (disin¬ terested) Karman.

verses.sanskrit: वसन्ति तत्र पुरुषास्तदात्मानो व्यवस्थिताः । ईश्वरा योगधर्माणो ये चान्ये तत्त्वचिन्तकाः
verses.transliteration: vasanti tatra puruṣāstadātmāno vyavasthitāḥ / īśvarā yogadharmāṇo ye cānye tattvacintakāḥ
verses.translation: Hence, you worship the infinite Lord who has neither beginning nor end. By means of the path of disinterested action
verses.hindi: चूँकि वे (स्वयं ही) प्रजाकी सृष्टि करते हैं, उसका पालन करते हैं और (स्वयं उसका) पुनः संहार करते हैं, इसलिये तीनों कालोंमें (सत्त्व, रज तथा तमरूप) त्रिगुणात्मक होनेसे वे (परमात्मा) एक (अद्वैत) कहलाते हैं। प्रारम्भमें वे सनातन हिरण्यगर्भ प्रादुर्भूत हुए। आदिमें उत्पन्न होनेसे वे आदिदेव तथा अजन्मा होनेसे अज कहलाते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, you worship the infinite Lord who has neither beginning nor end. By means of the path of disinterested action
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, you worship the infinite Lord who has neither beginning nor end. By means of the path of disinterested action

verses.sanskrit: सर्वज्ञाः शान्तरजसो नित्यं मुदितमानसाः । एतैरावरणैरण्डं सप्तभिः प्राकृतैर्वृतम्
verses.transliteration: sarvajñāḥ śāntarajaso nityaṃ muditamānasāḥ / etairāvaraṇairaṇḍaṃ saptabhiḥ prākṛtairvṛtam
verses.translation: On being addressed thus, Indradyumna the promi¬ nent sage of great intellect, bowed down his head to the goddess. With palms folded in reverence, he submitted to her again.
verses.hindi: देवेषु च महादेवो महादेव इति स्मृतः बृहत्त्वाच्य स्मृतो ब्रह्मा परत्वात् परमेश्वर: ।
verses.wordMeaning: On being addressed thus, Indradyumna the promi¬ nent sage of great intellect, bowed down his head to the goddess. With palms folded in reverence, he submitted to her again.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being addressed thus, Indradyumna the promi¬ nent sage of great intellect, bowed down his head to the goddess. With palms folded in reverence, he submitted to her again.

verses.sanskrit: एतावच्छक्यते वक्तुं मायैषा गहना द्विजाः । एतत् प्राधानिकं कार्यं यन्मया बीजमीरितम् । प्रजापतेः परा मूर्तिरितीयं वैदिकी श्रुतिः
verses.transliteration: etāvacchakyate vaktuṃ māyaiṣā gahanā dvijāḥ / etat prādhānikaṃ kāryaṃ yanmayā bījamīritam / prajāpateḥ parā mūrtiritīyaṃ vaidikī śrutiḥ
verses.translation: O Goddess, the Supreme Ruler of the Universe, tell me how Lord Acyuta, the unsullied eternal Ruler of the universe, can be realised.
verses.hindi: ऋषि: सर्वत्रगत्वेन हरिः सर्वहरो यतः। अनुत्पादाच्च पूर्वत्वात् स्वयम्भूरिति स स्मृतः नराणामयनो यस्मात् तेन नारायणः स्मृतः। हरः संसारहरणाद् विभुत्वाद् विष्णुरु च्यते
verses.wordMeaning: O Goddess, the Supreme Ruler of the Universe, tell me how Lord Acyuta, the unsullied eternal Ruler of the universe, can be realised.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Goddess, the Supreme Ruler of the Universe, tell me how Lord Acyuta, the unsullied eternal Ruler of the universe, can be realised.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्माण्डमेतत् सकलं सप्तलोकतलान्वितम् । द्वितीयं तस्य देवस्य शरीरं परमेष्ठिनः
verses.transliteration: brahmāṇḍametat sakalaṃ saptalokatalānvitam / dvitīyaṃ tasya devasya śarīraṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ
verses.translation: Thus requested by the Brahmana, the lotus-wearing goddess told that sage that Narayana himself would impart to him that spiritual knowledge.
verses.hindi: भगवान् सर्वविज्ञानादवनादोमिति स्मृतः। शिवः स निर्मलो यस्माद् विभुः सर्वगतो यतः। तारणात् सर्वदुःखानां तारकः परिंगीयते
verses.wordMeaning: Thus requested by the Brahmana, the lotus-wearing goddess told that sage that Narayana himself would impart to him that spiritual knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus requested by the Brahmana, the lotus-wearing goddess told that sage that Narayana himself would impart to him that spiritual knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्यगर्भो भगवान् ब्रह्मा वै कनकाण्डजः । तृतीयं भगवद्रूपं प्राहुर्वेदार्थवेदिनः
verses.transliteration: hiraṇyagarbho bhagavān brahmā vai kanakāṇḍajaḥ / tṛtīyaṃ bhagavadrūpaṃ prāhurvedārthavedinaḥ
verses.translation: Thus requested by the Brahmana, the lotus-wearing goddess told that sage that Narayana himself would impart to him that spiritual knowledge.
verses.hindi: बहुनात्र किमुक्तेन सर्व ब्रह्ममयं जगत्। अनेकभेदभिन्नस्तु क्रीडते परमेश्वरः अबुद्द्रिपूर्वको विप्रा ब्राह्मी सृष्टि निबोधत
verses.wordMeaning: Thus requested by the Brahmana, the lotus-wearing goddess told that sage that Narayana himself would impart to him that spiritual knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus requested by the Brahmana, the lotus-wearing goddess told that sage that Narayana himself would impart to him that spiritual knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: रजोगुणमयं चान्यद् रूपं तस्यैव धीमतः । चतुर्मुखः स भगवान् जगत्सृष्टौ प्रवर्तते
verses.transliteration: rajoguṇamayaṃ cānyad rūpaṃ tasyaiva dhīmataḥ / caturmukhaḥ sa bhagavān jagatsṛṣṭau pravartate
verses.translation: Thus requested by the Brahmana, the lotus-wearing goddess told that sage that Narayana himself would impart to him that spiritual knowledge.
verses.hindi: वे समस्त प्रजाओंका पालन करते हैं, इसलिये ' प्रजापति ' इस नामसे कहे जाते हैं और देवताओंमें सबसे बड़े देव हैं, इसलिये ' महादेव' कहलाते हैं बृहत् होनेसे वे ब्रह्मा तथा परम (श्रेष्ठ) होनेके कारण परमेश्वर कहे जाते हैं। सबको अपने वशमें रखनेवाले, परंतु स्वयं किसीके वशमें न रहनेके कारण वे ईश्वर (नामसे) परिभाषित किये जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus requested by the Brahmana, the lotus-wearing goddess told that sage that Narayana himself would impart to him that spiritual knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus requested by the Brahmana, the lotus-wearing goddess told that sage that Narayana himself would impart to him that spiritual knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: सृष्टं च पाति सकलं विश्वात्मा विश्वतोमुखः । सत्त्वं गुणमुपाश्रित्य विष्णुर्विश्वेश्वरः स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: sṛṣṭaṃ ca pāti sakalaṃ viśvātmā viśvatomukhaḥ / sattvaṃ guṇamupāśritya viṣṇurviśveśvaraḥ svayam
verses.translation: Thus requested by the Brahmana, the lotus-wearing goddess told that sage that Narayana himself would impart to him that spiritual knowledge.
verses.hindi: उनकी सर्वत्र गति होनेके कारण वे ऋषि और (प्रलयकालमें) सब कुछ हरण करनेके कारण हरि कहलाते हैं । किसीके द्वारा उत्पन्न न होने तथा सर्वप्रथम होनेके कारण 'स्वयम्भू' इस नामसे कहे जाते हैं। सभी मनुष्योंके वे अयन (आश्रय-स्थान) हैं, इसलिये नारायण कहे जाते हैं, संसारका संहार करनेसे हर तथा सर्वत्र व्यापक होनेसे विष्णु कहलाते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Thus requested by the Brahmana, the lotus-wearing goddess told that sage that Narayana himself would impart to him that spiritual knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus requested by the Brahmana, the lotus-wearing goddess told that sage that Narayana himself would impart to him that spiritual knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: अन्तकाले स्वयं देवः सर्वात्मा परमेश्वरः । तमोगुणं समाश्रित्य रुद्रः संहरते जगत्
verses.transliteration: antakāle svayaṃ devaḥ sarvātmā parameśvaraḥ / tamoguṇaṃ samāśritya rudraḥ saṃharate jagat
verses.translation: Thus requested by the Brahmana, the lotus-wearing goddess told that sage that Narayana himself would impart to him that spiritual knowledge.
verses.hindi: (वे) सब कुछ जाननेके कारण भगवान् तथा रक्षा-कार्य करनेसे ३० कहलाते हैं। सभीका विशिष्ट ज्ञान होनेसे सर्वज्ञ तथा सभीके आत्मस्वरूप होनेके कारण वे सर्व कहे जाते हैं। वे मलशून्य हैं, इसलिये शिव और सर्वत्र व्याप्त होनेसे विभु तथा सभी प्रकारके कष्टोंका निवारण करनेसे 'तारक' कहलाते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Thus requested by the Brahmana, the lotus-wearing goddess told that sage that Narayana himself would impart to him that spiritual knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus requested by the Brahmana, the lotus-wearing goddess told that sage that Narayana himself would impart to him that spiritual knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: एको ऽपि सन्महादेवस्त्रिधासौ समवस्थितः । सर्गरक्षालयगुणैर्निर्गुणो ऽपि निरञ्जनः । एकधा स द्विधा चैव त्रिधा च बहुधा पुनः
verses.transliteration: eko 'pi sanmahādevastridhāsau samavasthitaḥ / sargarakṣālayaguṇairnirguṇo 'pi nirañjanaḥ / ekadhā sa dvidhā caiva tridhā ca bahudhā punaḥ
verses.translation: Thus requested by the Brahmana, the lotus-wearing goddess told that sage that Narayana himself would impart to him that spiritual knowledge.
verses.hindi: और अधिक कहनेसे क्या लाभ! यह सारा जगत् ब्रह्ममय ही है और वे परमेश्वर अनेक रूपोंमें विभक्त होकर अनेक क्रीड़ाएँ (लीलाएँ) करते रहते हैं हे ब्राह्मणो! मैंने संक्षेपमें इस अबुद्धिपूर्वक हुए प्राकृत सर्ग (प्राकृत सृष्टि)-का वर्णन किया है। अब आप लोग ब्रह्माकी सृष्टिके सम्बन्धमें सुनें
verses.wordMeaning: Thus requested by the Brahmana, the lotus-wearing goddess told that sage that Narayana himself would impart to him that spiritual knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus requested by the Brahmana, the lotus-wearing goddess told that sage that Narayana himself would impart to him that spiritual knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: योगेश्वरः शरीराणि करोति विकरोति च । नानाकृतिक्रियारूपनामवन्ति स्वलीलया
verses.transliteration: yogeśvaraḥ śarīrāṇi karoti vikaroti ca / nānākṛtikriyārūpanāmavanti svalīlayā
verses.translation: Thus requested by the Brahmana, the lotus-wearing goddess told that sage that Narayana himself would impart to him that spiritual knowledge.
verses.hindi: शर कूर्मपुराण मं ब्रद्याजीकी आयुका वर्णन, युग, मन्वन्तर तथा कल्प आदि कालको गणना, प्राकृत प्रलय तथा कालको महिमाका वर्णन
verses.wordMeaning: Thus requested by the Brahmana, the lotus-wearing goddess told that sage that Narayana himself would impart to him that spiritual knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus requested by the Brahmana, the lotus-wearing goddess told that sage that Narayana himself would impart to him that spiritual knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: हिताय चैव भक्तानां स एव ग्रसते पुनः । त्रिधा विभज्य चात्मानं त्रैकाल्ये संप्रवर्तते । सृजते ग्रसते चैव वीक्षते च विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: hitāya caiva bhaktānāṃ sa eva grasate punaḥ / tridhā vibhajya cātmānaṃ traikālye saṃpravartate / sṛjate grasate caiva vīkṣate ca viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: Thus requested by the Brahmana, the lotus-wearing goddess told that sage that Narayana himself would impart to him that spiritual knowledge.
verses.hindi: स्वयम्भुवो विवृत्तस्य कालसंख्या द्विजोत्तमाः । न शक्यते समाख्यातुं बहुवर्षेरपि स्वयम् कालसंख्या समासेन परार्धद्यकल्पिता। स एव स्यात् परः कालः तदन्ते प्रतिसृज्यते
verses.wordMeaning: Thus requested by the Brahmana, the lotus-wearing goddess told that sage that Narayana himself would impart to him that spiritual knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus requested by the Brahmana, the lotus-wearing goddess told that sage that Narayana himself would impart to him that spiritual knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: यस्मात् सृष्ट्वानुगृह्णाति ग्रसते च पुनः प्रजाः । गुणात्मकत्वात् त्रैकाल्ये तस्मादेकः स उच्यते
verses.transliteration: yasmāt sṛṣṭvānugṛhṇāti grasate ca punaḥ prajāḥ / guṇātmakatvāt traikālye tasmādekaḥ sa ucyate
verses.translation: Thus requested by the Brahmana, the lotus-wearing goddess told that sage that Narayana himself would impart to him that spiritual knowledge.
verses.hindi: काष्ठा पञ्चदश ख्याता निमेषा द्विजसत्तमाः । काष्टास्त्रिशत् कला त्रिंशत् कला मौहूर्तिकी गति: आयनं दक्षिणं रात्रिर्देवानामुत्तरं दिनम्
verses.wordMeaning: Thus requested by the Brahmana, the lotus-wearing goddess told that sage that Narayana himself would impart to him that spiritual knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus requested by the Brahmana, the lotus-wearing goddess told that sage that Narayana himself would impart to him that spiritual knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: अग्रे हिरण्यगर्भः स प्रादुर्भूतः सनातनः । आदित्वादादिदेवो ऽसौ अजातत्वादजः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: agre hiraṇyagarbhaḥ sa prādurbhūtaḥ sanātanaḥ / āditvādādidevo 'sau ajātatvādajaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Thus requested by the Brahmana, the lotus-wearing goddess told that sage that Narayana himself would impart to him that spiritual knowledge.
verses.hindi: त्रिद्ययेकसाहस्त्रमतो विना संध्यांशकेन तु। त्रेताद्वापरतिष्याणां कालज्ञाने प्रकीर्तितम् श्रीकूर्मने कहा-- श्रेष्ठ ब्राह्मणो! स्वयम्भू-ब्रह्माके बीते हुए कालकी गणनाका वर्णन बहुत वर्षोमें भी नहीं किया जा सकता। संक्षेपमें कालकी गणना दो परार्ध कही गयी है। वही परम काल है और उसके बीत
verses.wordMeaning: Thus requested by the Brahmana, the lotus-wearing goddess told that sage that Narayana himself would impart to him that spiritual knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus requested by the Brahmana, the lotus-wearing goddess told that sage that Narayana himself would impart to him that spiritual knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: पातियस्मात् प्रजाः सर्वाः प्रजापतिरिति स्मृतः । देवेषु च महादेवो माहदेव इति स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: pātiyasmāt prajāḥ sarvāḥ prajāpatiriti smṛtaḥ / deveṣu ca mahādevo māhadeva iti smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Thus requested by the Brahmana, the lotus-wearing goddess told that sage that Narayana himself would impart to him that spiritual knowledge.
verses.hindi: जानेपर प्रलय होता है अपने मानसे ब्रह्माकी एक सौ वर्षकी आयु कही गयी है। उसी (ब्रह्माकी एक सौ वर्षकी आयु)-को 'पर' नामसे कहा जाता है और उस परका आधा 'परार्ध' कहलाता है
verses.wordMeaning: Thus requested by the Brahmana, the lotus-wearing goddess told that sage that Narayana himself would impart to him that spiritual knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus requested by the Brahmana, the lotus-wearing goddess told that sage that Narayana himself would impart to him that spiritual knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: बृहत्त्वाच्च स्मृतो ब्रह्मा परत्वात् परमेश्वरः । वशित्वादप्यवश्यत्वादीश्वरः परिभाषितः
verses.transliteration: bṛhattvācca smṛto brahmā paratvāt parameśvaraḥ / vaśitvādapyavaśyatvādīśvaraḥ paribhāṣitaḥ
verses.translation: Thus requested by the Brahmana, the lotus-wearing goddess told that sage that Narayana himself would impart to him that spiritual knowledge.
verses.hindi: द्विजोत्तमो ! पंद्रह निमेषकी एक काष्ठा कही गयी है। तीस काष्ठाकी एक कला और तीस कलाका समय एक मुहूर्त-काल होता है । उतनी ही संख्या अर्थात् तीस मुहूर्तोका एक मानवीय अहोरात्र (दिन-रात) होता है, उतने ही अर्थात् तीस अहोरात्रोंका एक मास होता है जो दो पक्षवाला है। छः मासोंका एक अयन तथा उत्तर एवं दक्षिण नामसे दो अयनोंका एक वर्ष होता है। दक्षिण अयन अर्थात् दक्षिणायन
verses.wordMeaning: Thus requested by the Brahmana, the lotus-wearing goddess told that sage that Narayana himself would impart to him that spiritual knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus requested by the Brahmana, the lotus-wearing goddess told that sage that Narayana himself would impart to him that spiritual knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषिः सर्वत्रगत्वेन हरिः सर्वहरो यतः । अनुत्पादाच्च पूर्वत्वात् स्वयंभूरिति स स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: ṛṣiḥ sarvatragatvena hariḥ sarvaharo yataḥ / anutpādācca pūrvatvāt svayaṃbhūriti sa smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Thus requested by the Brahmana, the lotus-wearing goddess told that sage that Narayana himself would impart to him that spiritual knowledge.
verses.hindi: (देवताओंका) दिन होता है ॥ ४--६॥ (श्रीकूर्मने ब्राह्मणोंसे कहा--) दिव्य बारह हजार वर्षाका सत्य, त्रेता इत्यादि नामसे एक चतुर्युग होता है। उसके विभागोंका वर्णन सुनें
verses.wordMeaning: Thus requested by the Brahmana, the lotus-wearing goddess told that sage that Narayana himself would impart to him that spiritual knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus requested by the Brahmana, the lotus-wearing goddess told that sage that Narayana himself would impart to him that spiritual knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: नराणामयनो यस्मात् तेन नारायणः स्मृतः । हरः संसारहरणाद् विभुत्वाद् विष्णुरुच्यते
verses.transliteration: narāṇāmayano yasmāt tena nārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ / haraḥ saṃsāraharaṇād vibhutvād viṣṇurucyate
verses.translation: Thus requested by the Brahmana, the lotus-wearing goddess told that sage that Narayana himself would impart to him that spiritual knowledge.
verses.hindi: चार हजार दिव्य वर्षाका सत्ययुग होता हे! सत्ययुगको उतने ही सौ वर्षाको अर्थात् चार सौ वर्षांकी संध्या तथा संध्यांश (त्रेतायुगका संधिकाल) होता है। सत्ययुगके संध्यांशको छोड़कर क्रमशः तीन सौ, दो सौ तथा एक सौ--इस प्रकार कुल मिलाकर दिव्य छः सौ वर्षोके द्वापर तथा कलियुगके संध्या तथा संध्यांश होते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Thus requested by the Brahmana, the lotus-wearing goddess told that sage that Narayana himself would impart to him that spiritual knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus requested by the Brahmana, the lotus-wearing goddess told that sage that Narayana himself would impart to him that spiritual knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: भगवान् सर्वविज्ञानादवनादोमिति स्मृतः । सर्वज्ञः सर्वविज्ञानात् सर्वः सर्वमयो यतः
verses.transliteration: bhagavān sarvavijñānādavanādomiti smṛtaḥ / sarvajñaḥ sarvavijñānāt sarvaḥ sarvamayo yataḥ
verses.translation: Thus requested by the Brahmana, the lotus-wearing goddess told that sage that Narayana himself would impart to him that spiritual knowledge.
verses.hindi: कालका ज्ञान करनेके लिये संध्यांशोंसे रहित त्रेता, (दिव्य) वर्षोके कहे गये हैं। कुछ अधिकता लिये यही (दिव्य) बारह हजार वर्षाका कालपरिमाण कहा गया है। इसके इकहत्तर गुना कालको एक मनुका अन्तर अर्थात् एक मन्वन्तरका समय कहा गया है
verses.wordMeaning: Thus requested by the Brahmana, the lotus-wearing goddess told that sage that Narayana himself would impart to him that spiritual knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus requested by the Brahmana, the lotus-wearing goddess told that sage that Narayana himself would impart to him that spiritual knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: शिवः स निर्मलो यस्माद् विभुः सर्वगतो यतः । तारणात् सर्वदुः खानां तारकः परिगीयते
verses.transliteration: śivaḥ sa nirmalo yasmād vibhuḥ sarvagato yataḥ / tāraṇāt sarvaduḥ khānāṃ tārakaḥ parigīyate
verses.translation: Thus requested by the Brahmana, the lotus-wearing goddess told that sage that Narayana himself would impart to him that spiritual knowledge.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मणो दिवसे विप्रा मनवः स्युश्चतुर्दश । स्वायम्भुवादयः सर्वे ततः सावर्णिकादयः मन्वन्तरेण चैकेन सर्वाण्येवान्तराणि वै। व्याख्यातानि न संदेहः कल्पं कल्पेन चैव हि
verses.wordMeaning: Thus requested by the Brahmana, the lotus-wearing goddess told that sage that Narayana himself would impart to him that spiritual knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus requested by the Brahmana, the lotus-wearing goddess told that sage that Narayana himself would impart to him that spiritual knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: बहुनात्र किमुक्तेन सर्वं ब्रह्ममयं जगत् । अनेकभेदभिन्नस्तु क्रीडते परमेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: bahunātra kimuktena sarvaṃ brahmamayaṃ jagat / anekabhedabhinnastu krīḍate parameśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Thus requested by the Brahmana, the lotus-wearing goddess told that sage that Narayana himself would impart to him that spiritual knowledge.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मणः कथितं वर्ष पराख्यं तच्छतं विदुः तस्यान्ते सर्वतत्त्वानां स्वहेतौ प्रकृतौ लयः
verses.wordMeaning: Thus requested by the Brahmana, the lotus-wearing goddess told that sage that Narayana himself would impart to him that spiritual knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus requested by the Brahmana, the lotus-wearing goddess told that sage that Narayana himself would impart to him that spiritual knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येष प्राकृतः सर्गः संक्षेपात् कथितो मया । अबुद्धिपूर्वको विप्रा ब्राह्मीं सृष्टिं निबोधत
verses.transliteration: ityeṣa prākṛtaḥ sargaḥ saṃkṣepāt kathito mayā / abuddhipūrvako viprā brāhmīṃ sṛṣṭiṃ nibodhata
verses.translation: Thus requested by the Brahmana, the lotus-wearing goddess told that sage that Narayana himself would impart to him that spiritual knowledge.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मनारायणेशानां त्रयाणां प्रकृतौ लयः । प्रोच्यते कालयोगेन पुनरेव च सम्भवः
verses.wordMeaning: Thus requested by the Brahmana, the lotus-wearing goddess told that sage that Narayana himself would impart to him that spiritual knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus requested by the Brahmana, the lotus-wearing goddess told that sage that Narayana himself would impart to him that spiritual knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वंविभागे चतुर्थो ऽध्यायः श्रीकूर्म उवाच स्वयंभुवो विवृत्तस्य कालसंख्या द्विजोत्तमाः । न शक्यते समाख्यातुं बहुवर्षैरपि स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvaṃvibhāge caturtho 'dhyāyaḥ śrīkūrma uvāca svayaṃbhuvo vivṛttasya kālasaṃkhyā dvijottamāḥ / na śakyate samākhyātuṃ bahuvarṣairapi svayam
verses.translation: After touching with both of her hands the sage who was bowing to her, she remembered the transcendental Lord Visnu and vanished at that very spot.
verses.hindi: एवं ब्रह्मा च भूतानि वासुदेवोऽपि शंकरः कालेनेव तु सृज्यन्ते स एव ग्रसते पुनः अनादिरेष भगवान् कालोऽनन्तोऽजरोऽमरः। सर्वगत्वात् स्वतन्त्रत्वात् सर्वात्मासौ महेश्वरः
verses.wordMeaning: After touching with both of her hands the sage who was bowing to her, she remembered the transcendental Lord Visnu and vanished at that very spot.
verses.commentary: Sense: After touching with both of her hands the sage who was bowing to her, she remembered the transcendental Lord Visnu and vanished at that very spot.

verses.sanskrit: कालसंख्या समासेन परार्धद्वयकल्पिता । स एव स्यात् परः कालः तदन्ते प्रतिसृज्यते
verses.transliteration: kālasaṃkhyā samāsena parārdhadvayakalpitā / sa eva syāt paraḥ kālaḥ tadante pratisṛjyate
verses.translation: In order to visualize Narayana, he too propitiated by transcendental meditation Lord Hrsikesa (Visnu), the des¬ troyer of the distress of those who bow down to him.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्माणो बहवो रुद्रा ह्यन्ये नारायणादयः एको हि भगवानीशः कालः कविरिति श्रुतिः एकमत्र व्यतीतं तु परार्ध ब्रह्मणो द्विजाः । साम्प्रतं वर्तते तद्वत् तस्य कल्पोऽयमष्टमः
verses.wordMeaning: In order to visualize Narayana, he too propitiated by transcendental meditation Lord Hrsikesa (Visnu), the des¬ troyer of the distress of those who bow down to him.
verses.commentary: Sense: In order to visualize Narayana, he too propitiated by transcendental meditation Lord Hrsikesa (Visnu), the des¬ troyer of the distress of those who bow down to him.

verses.sanskrit: निजेन तस्य मानेन आयुर्वर्षशतं स्मृतम् । तत् पराख्यं तदर्धं च परार्धमभिदीयते
verses.transliteration: nijena tasya mānena āyurvarṣaśataṃ smṛtam / tat parākhyaṃ tadardhaṃ ca parārdhamabhidīyate
verses.translation: Then after lapse of a pretty long period, Narayana the great Yogin, the wearer of yellow garments, the Deity who permeates the universe, manifested himself to him.
verses.hindi: ब्राह्मणो ! ब्रह्माके एक दिनमें चौदह मनु (मन्वन्तर) होते हैं। वे सभी स्वायम्भुव (प्रथम मनु) आदि तथा सावर्णिक के द्वारा सात द्वीपों एवं पर्वतोंवाली इस पृथ्वीका पूरे एक हजार युगोंतक पालन किया जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: Then after lapse of a pretty long period, Narayana the great Yogin, the wearer of yellow garments, the Deity who permeates the universe, manifested himself to him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then after lapse of a pretty long period, Narayana the great Yogin, the wearer of yellow garments, the Deity who permeates the universe, manifested himself to him.

verses.sanskrit: काष्ठा पञ्चदश ख्याता निमेषा द्विजसत्तमाः । काष्ठास्त्रिंशत् कला त्रिंशत् कला मौहूर्तिकी गतिः
verses.transliteration: kāṣṭhā pañcadaśa khyātā nimeṣā dvijasattamāḥ / kāṣṭhāstriṃśat kalā triṃśat kalā mauhūrtikī gatiḥ
verses.translation: On perceiving Lord Visnu, the imperishable Atman (of the universe), approaching him, he knelt on the ground
verses.hindi: एक मन्वन्तरके वर्णनसे अन्य भी-सभी मन्वन्तरोंका वर्णन कर दिया गया है (ऐसा समझना चाहिए) । इसमें संदेह नहीं करना चाहिए। प्रत्येक कल्प (पूर्व) कल्पके समान ही होता है। ब्रह्माका एक दिन एक कल्पके बराबर और रात्रि भी उतनी (अर्थात् एक कल्पके बराबर) ही होती है। विद्वानोंने एक हजार चतुर्युगीका एक कल्प कहा है
verses.wordMeaning: On perceiving Lord Visnu, the imperishable Atman (of the universe), approaching him, he knelt on the ground
verses.commentary: Sense: On perceiving Lord Visnu, the imperishable Atman (of the universe), approaching him, he knelt on the ground

verses.sanskrit: तावत्संख्यैरहोरात्रं मुहूर्तैर्मानुषं स्मृतम् । अहोरात्राणि तावन्ति मासः पक्षद्वयात्मकः
verses.transliteration: tāvatsaṃkhyairahorātraṃ muhūrtairmānuṣaṃ smṛtam / ahorātrāṇi tāvanti māsaḥ pakṣadvayātmakaḥ
verses.translation: O Lord of sacrifices, O imperishable Lord, O Govinda, O consort of Goddess Laksmi, O Kesava the Infinite, O Krsna, O Visnu, O Hrsikesa, obeisance to you, the soul of the universe.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ ब्राह्मणो ! तीन सौ साठ कल्पोंका ब्रह्माका एक वर्ष कहा गया है, उसके सौ गुने (अर्थात् ३६०५१००= ३६,००० कल्पों या १०० वर्षोके) कालको 'पर' इस नामसे जानना चाहिए। ('पर' नामक) उस कालके बीतनेपर सभी तत्त्वोंका अपने मूल कारण प्रकृतिमें लय हो जाता है। इसीलिये विद्वानोंने इसे प्राकृत प्रतिसञ्चर (प्राकृत प्रलय) कहा है। ब्रह्मा, विष्णु एवं महेश तीनोंका प्रकृतिमें लय हो जाता है। पुनः कालयोगसे
verses.wordMeaning: O Lord of sacrifices, O imperishable Lord, O Govinda, O consort of Goddess Laksmi, O Kesava the Infinite, O Krsna, O Visnu, O Hrsikesa, obeisance to you, the soul of the universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Lord of sacrifices, O imperishable Lord, O Govinda, O consort of Goddess Laksmi, O Kesava the Infinite, O Krsna, O Visnu, O Hrsikesa, obeisance to you, the soul of the universe.

verses.sanskrit: तैः षड्भिरयनं वर्षं द्वे ऽयने दक्षिणोत्तरे । अयनं दक्षिणं रात्रिर्देवानामुत्तरं दिनम्
verses.transliteration: taiḥ ṣaḍbhirayanaṃ varṣaṃ dve 'yane dakṣiṇottare / ayanaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ rātrirdevānāmuttaraṃ dinam
verses.translation: Salute to you, the ancient one, to Hari the embodi¬ ment of the universe, to the Cause of creation, maintenance and dissolution of the universe, to the Deity of infinite powers.
verses.hindi: उनका आविर्भाव होना कहा जाता है इस प्रकार ब्रह्मा, जीव, वासुदेव तथा शंकरकी कालके द्वारा ही सर्जना होती है, पुनः वही काल इनका संहार भी करता है। यह काल भगवान् है, अनन्त है, अजर है, अमर है एवं अनादि है। सर्वव्यापी होनेसे,
verses.wordMeaning: Salute to you, the ancient one, to Hari the embodi¬ ment of the universe, to the Cause of creation, maintenance and dissolution of the universe, to the Deity of infinite powers.
verses.commentary: Sense: Salute to you, the ancient one, to Hari the embodi¬ ment of the universe, to the Cause of creation, maintenance and dissolution of the universe, to the Deity of infinite powers.

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यैर्वर्षसहस्त्रैस्तु कृतत्रेतादिसंज्ञितम् । चतुर्युगं द्वादशभिः तद्विभागं निबोधत
verses.transliteration: divyairvarṣasahastraistu kṛtatretādisaṃjñitam / caturyugaṃ dvādaśabhiḥ tadvibhāgaṃ nibodhata
verses.translation: Bow to you who are devoid of the gunas (viz. Sattva, Rajas?Lnd Tamas). I bow again and again to the purest
verses.hindi: स्वतन्त्र होनेसे तथा सबका आत्मस्वरूप होनेसे यह महेश्वर कहलाता है ब्रह्मा, रुद्र तथा नारायण आदि बहुत होते हैं, किंतु भगवान् एक ही है, जो ईश, काल तथा कवि कहलाता है--ऐसा वेदका अभिमत है
verses.wordMeaning: Bow to you who are devoid of the gunas (viz. Sattva, Rajas?Lnd Tamas). I bow again and again to the purest
verses.commentary: Sense: Bow to you who are devoid of the gunas (viz. Sattva, Rajas?Lnd Tamas). I bow again and again to the purest

verses.sanskrit: चत्वार्याहुः सहस्त्राणि वर्षाणां तत्कृतं युगम् । तस्य तावच्छती सन्ध्या सन्ध्यांशश्च कृतस्य तु
verses.transliteration: catvāryāhuḥ sahastrāṇi varṣāṇāṃ tatkṛtaṃ yugam / tasya tāvacchatī sandhyā sandhyāṃśaśca kṛtasya tu
verses.translation: Salute to you the son of Vasudeva (or the Principle immanent in the universe); bow to Visnu, the Cause of the universe. Obeisance to you who are devoid of beginning, xniddle and end. I bow to you who are knowable only through perfect knowledge.
verses.hindi: ब्राह्मणो ! इस समय ब्रह्माजीका एक परार्ध बीत चुका है, अब उनका दूसरा परार्ध चल रहा है, उस (द्वितीय परार्ध)-का यह आठवाँ कल्प चल रहा है। ब्रह्माजीका जो सातवाँ कल्प व्यतीत हो चुका है, विद्वानोंद्वारा वह 'पाद्म' (कल्प) कहा गया है। वर्तमानमें वाराह कल्प चल रहा है, इसके विस्तारका मैं वर्णन करूँगा
verses.wordMeaning: Salute to you the son of Vasudeva (or the Principle immanent in the universe); bow to Visnu, the Cause of the universe. Obeisance to you who are devoid of beginning, xniddle and end. I bow to you who are knowable only through perfect knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: Salute to you the son of Vasudeva (or the Principle immanent in the universe); bow to Visnu, the Cause of the universe. Obeisance to you who are devoid of beginning, xniddle and end. I bow to you who are knowable only through perfect knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिशती द्विशती सन्ध्या तथा चैकशती क्रमात् । अंशकं षट्शतं तस्मात् कृसन्ध्यांशकं विना
verses.transliteration: triśatī dviśatī sandhyā tathā caikaśatī kramāt / aṃśakaṃ ṣaṭśataṃ tasmāt kṛsandhyāṃśakaṃ vinā
verses.translation: Bow to you, who are devoid of modifications; salute to you who are without diversity. Obeisance be to the Deity devoid of difference and non-difference and who are the very embodiment of spiritual bliss.
verses.hindi: “नारायण' नामका निर्वचन, वराहरूपधारी नारायणद्वारा पृथ्वीका उद्धार, सनकादि ऋषियोंद्वारा वराहकी स्तुति आसीदेकार्णवं घोरमविभागं तमोमयम्। शान्तवातादिकं सर्व न प्रज्ञायत किञ्चन
verses.wordMeaning: Bow to you, who are devoid of modifications; salute to you who are without diversity. Obeisance be to the Deity devoid of difference and non-difference and who are the very embodiment of spiritual bliss.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bow to you, who are devoid of modifications; salute to you who are without diversity. Obeisance be to the Deity devoid of difference and non-difference and who are the very embodiment of spiritual bliss.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिद्व्येकसाहस्त्रमतो विना सन्ध्यांशकेन तु । त्रेताद्वापरतिष्याणां कालज्ञाने प्रकीर्तितम्
verses.transliteration: tridvyekasāhastramato vinā sandhyāṃśakena tu / tretādvāparatiṣyāṇāṃ kālajñāne prakīrtitam
verses.translation: I bow to the saviour, the quiescent. Salute to the ■obstructionless Atman. Obeisance to you, O God of infinite forms, I bow again and again to the unembodied one.
verses.hindi: एकार्णवे तदा तस्मिन् नष्टे स्थावरजङ्घमे । तदा समभवद् ब्रह्मा सहस्त्राक्ष: सहस्त्रपात् ब्रह्मा नारायणाख्यस्तु सुष्वाप सलिले तदा॥
verses.wordMeaning: I bow to the saviour, the quiescent. Salute to the ■obstructionless Atman. Obeisance to you, O God of infinite forms, I bow again and again to the unembodied one.
verses.commentary: Sense: I bow to the saviour, the quiescent. Salute to the ■obstructionless Atman. Obeisance to you, O God of infinite forms, I bow again and again to the unembodied one.

verses.sanskrit: एतद् द्वादशसाहस्त्रं साधिकं परिकल्पितम् । तदेकसप्ततिगुणं मनोरन्तरमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: etad dvādaśasāhastraṃ sādhikaṃ parikalpitam / tadekasaptatiguṇaṃ manorantaramucyate
