verses.translation: Obeisance to you the highest Reality; bow to you who transcend the Maya. Obeisance to the highest Ruler, the Brahman, the Supreme Self.
verses.hindi: इमं चोदाहरन्त्यत्र शलोकं नारायणम्प्रति। ब्रह्मस्वरूपिणं देवं जगतः प्रभवाप्ययम् अयनं तस्य ता यस्मात् तेन नारायणः स्मृतः
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you the highest Reality; bow to you who transcend the Maya. Obeisance to the highest Ruler, the Brahman, the Supreme Self.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you the highest Reality; bow to you who transcend the Maya. Obeisance to the highest Ruler, the Brahman, the Supreme Self.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मणो दिवसे विप्रा मनवः स्युश्चतुर्दश । स्वायंभुवादयः सर्वे ततः सावर्णिकादयः
verses.transliteration: brahmaṇo divase viprā manavaḥ syuścaturdaśa / svāyaṃbhuvādayaḥ sarve tataḥ sāvarṇikādayaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance be to you the subtlest one; salute to you the great God. Obeisance to §iva the auspicious one, to Buddha (the Pure one). I bow to You, the Supreme Being {Parame- sfhin).
verses.hindi: तुल्यं युगसहस्त्रस्य नेशं कालमुपास्य सः। शर्वर्यन्ते प्रकुरुते ब्रह्मत्वं सर्गकारणात्॥ अनुमानात् तदुद्धारं कर्तुकामः प्रजापतिः
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance be to you the subtlest one; salute to you the great God. Obeisance to §iva the auspicious one, to Buddha (the Pure one). I bow to You, the Supreme Being {Parame- sfhin).
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance be to you the subtlest one; salute to you the great God. Obeisance to §iva the auspicious one, to Buddha (the Pure one). I bow to You, the Supreme Being {Parame- sfhin).

verses.sanskrit: तैरियं पृथिवी सर्वा सप्तद्वीपा सपर्वता । पूर्णं युगसहस्त्रं वै परिपाल्या नरेश्वरैः
verses.transliteration: tairiyaṃ pṛthivī sarvā saptadvīpā saparvatā / pūrṇaṃ yugasahastraṃ vai paripālyā nareśvaraiḥ
verses.translation: It was by you that all these worlds were created. You alone are the highest goal. You are both the father and the mother unto all living beings, O Purusottama.
verses.hindi: अधृष्यं मनसाप्यन्यैर्वाइसयं ब्रह्मसंज्ञितम् अस्तुवञ्जनलोकस्थाः सिद्धा ब्रह्मर्षयो हरिम्
verses.wordMeaning: It was by you that all these worlds were created. You alone are the highest goal. You are both the father and the mother unto all living beings, O Purusottama.
verses.commentary: Sense: It was by you that all these worlds were created. You alone are the highest goal. You are both the father and the mother unto all living beings, O Purusottama.

verses.sanskrit: मन्वन्तरेण चैकेन सर्वाण्येवान्तराणि वै । व्याख्यातानि न संदेहः कल्पं कल्पेन चैव हि
verses.transliteration: manvantareṇa caikena sarvāṇyevāntarāṇi vai / vyākhyātāni na saṃdehaḥ kalpaṃ kalpena caiva hi
verses.translation: You are the imperishable highest abode. You are the pure consciousness unsullied like the firmament. You are the support of all. You are the unmanifest, the infinite, beyond the darkness of ignorance.
verses.hindi: श्रीकूर्मने कहा-- (सृष्टिके पूर्व) केवल एकमात्र समुद्र ही था अर्थात् सर्वत्र जल-ही-जल था और कुछ नहीं । कोई विभाग नहीं था, घोर अन्धकारमय था। उस समय वायु आदि सभी शान्त थे। कुछ भी जाना नहीं जाता था। स्थावर तथा जंगम (सम्पूर्ण सृष्टि)-के उस एकार्णवमें नष्ट हो जानेपर (विलीन हो जानेपर) उस समय हजार नेत्रों तथा हजार चरणोंवाले ब्रह्मा प्रादुर्भूत हुए। हजार सिरवाले, सोनेके समान वर्णवाले, अतीन्द्रिय,
verses.wordMeaning: You are the imperishable highest abode. You are the pure consciousness unsullied like the firmament. You are the support of all. You are the unmanifest, the infinite, beyond the darkness of ignorance.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are the imperishable highest abode. You are the pure consciousness unsullied like the firmament. You are the support of all. You are the unmanifest, the infinite, beyond the darkness of ignorance.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्ममेकमहः कल्पस्तावती रात्रिरिष्यते । चतुर्युगसहस्त्रं तु कल्पमाहुर्मनीषिणः
verses.transliteration: brāhmamekamahaḥ kalpastāvatī rātririṣyate / caturyugasahastraṃ tu kalpamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ
verses.translation: People perceive the great Atman only in the light of the lamp of knowledge. I resort unto your form—a form which is the highest abode of Visnu.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मा जो नारायण नामवाले पुरुष कहलाते हैं, उस समय जलमें (एकार्णवमें) सोये हुए थे सम्पूर्ण संसारके सृष्टि एवं विनाशके कारण, ब्रह्मस्वरूप नारायणदेवके विषयमें यह श्लोक कहा जाता है--
verses.wordMeaning: People perceive the great Atman only in the light of the lamp of knowledge. I resort unto your form—a form which is the highest abode of Visnu.
verses.commentary: Sense: People perceive the great Atman only in the light of the lamp of knowledge. I resort unto your form—a form which is the highest abode of Visnu.

verses.sanskrit: त्रीणि कल्पशतानि स्युः तथा षष्टिर्द्विजोत्तमाः । ब्रह्मणः कथितं वर्षं पराख्यं तच्छतं विदुः
verses.transliteration: trīṇi kalpaśatāni syuḥ tathā ṣaṣṭirdvijottamāḥ / brahmaṇaḥ kathitaṃ varṣaṃ parākhyaṃ tacchataṃ viduḥ
verses.translation: The Lord, the Atman of all living beings and the creator of them all, smilingly touched (Indradyumna) with both o h if hands while he was eulogising him thus.
verses.hindi: वेदमें ' अप्' अर्थात् 'जल' को 'नार' इस नामसे पहले कहा गया है और वह नार (जल) नरका अयन अर्थात् आश्रय-स्थान है, इस कारण वे 'नारायण' कहे जाते हैं। हजार युगोंके बराबर रात्रिका उपभोग करके वे नारायण (उस प्रलयकालीन) रात्रिके बीत जानेपर सृष्टि करनेके लिये ब्रह्मत्व ग्रहण करते हैं। तदनन्तर उस जल (एकार्णव)-में प्रलीन पृथ्वीको अनुमानद्वारा जानकर प्रजापतिने उसके उद्धारको कामना की
verses.wordMeaning: The Lord, the Atman of all living beings and the creator of them all, smilingly touched (Indradyumna) with both o h if hands while he was eulogising him thus.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Lord, the Atman of all living beings and the creator of them all, smilingly touched (Indradyumna) with both o h if hands while he was eulogising him thus.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यान्ते सर्वतत्त्वानां स्वहेतौ प्रकृतौ लयः । तेनायं प्रोच्यते सद्भिः प्राकृतः प्रतिसंचरः
verses.transliteration: tasyānte sarvatattvānāṃ svahetau prakṛtau layaḥ / tenāyaṃ procyate sadbhiḥ prākṛtaḥ pratisaṃcaraḥ
verses.translation: Even as he was touched by the glorious Lord Visnu the prominent sage realised properly and precisely the Supreme Reality, thanks to his Grace.
verses.hindi: जलमें क्रीडा करते समय (वे) अत्यन्त सुन्दर वराहरूपमें अवस्थित हो गये। (भगवानूका वह स्वरूप) अन्य लोगोंके द्वारा मनसे भी न जाना जा सकने योग्य, वाक्स्वरूप तथा ब्रह्मसंज्ञक है। धराको धारण करनेवाले (उन) धराधर एवं आत्माधारने पृथ्वीका उद्धार करनेके लिये रसातलमें प्रवेश करके अपनी दाढ (द्रष्टा) -द्वारा इसे (रसातलमें डूबी पृथ्वीको) ऊपर निकाला। (नारायणको) दंष्टाके अग्रभागमें अवस्थित
verses.wordMeaning: Even as he was touched by the glorious Lord Visnu the prominent sage realised properly and precisely the Supreme Reality, thanks to his Grace.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even as he was touched by the glorious Lord Visnu the prominent sage realised properly and precisely the Supreme Reality, thanks to his Grace.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मनारायणेशानां त्रयाणां प्रकृतौ लयः । प्रोच्यते कालयोगेन पुनरेव च संभवः
verses.transliteration: brahmanārāyaṇeśānāṃ trayāṇāṃ prakṛtau layaḥ / procyate kālayogena punareva ca saṃbhavaḥ
verses.translation: Even as he was touched by the glorious Lord Visnu the prominent sage realised properly and precisely the Supreme Reality, thanks to his Grace.
verses.hindi: पृथ्वीको देखकर जनलोकमें रहनेवाले सिंद्धों तथा ब्रह्मर्षियोने अपने पौरुषको व्यक्त करनेवाले हरिकी (इस प्रकार) स्तुति की॥८--१०॥ नमस्ते देवदेवाय ब्रह्मणे परमेष्ठिने। पुरुषाय पुराणाय शाश्वताय जयाय च
verses.wordMeaning: Even as he was touched by the glorious Lord Visnu the prominent sage realised properly and precisely the Supreme Reality, thanks to his Grace.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even as he was touched by the glorious Lord Visnu the prominent sage realised properly and precisely the Supreme Reality, thanks to his Grace.

verses.sanskrit: एवं ब्रह्मा च भूतानि वासुदेवो ऽपि शङ्करः । कालेनैव तु सृज्यन्ते स एव ग्रसते पुनः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ brahmā ca bhūtāni vāsudevo 'pi śaṅkaraḥ / kālenaiva tu sṛjyante sa eva grasate punaḥ
verses.translation: Even as he was touched by the glorious Lord Visnu the prominent sage realised properly and precisely the Supreme Reality, thanks to his Grace.
verses.hindi: नमो हिरण्यगर्भाय वेधसे परमात्मने नमस्ते वासुदेवाय विष्णवे विश्वयोनये। नारायणाय देवाय देवानां हितकारिणे
verses.wordMeaning: Even as he was touched by the glorious Lord Visnu the prominent sage realised properly and precisely the Supreme Reality, thanks to his Grace.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even as he was touched by the glorious Lord Visnu the prominent sage realised properly and precisely the Supreme Reality, thanks to his Grace.

verses.sanskrit: अनादिरेष भगवान् कालो ऽनन्तो ऽजरो ऽमरः । सर्वगत्वात् स्वतन्त्रत्वात् सर्वात्मासौ महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: anādireṣa bhagavān kālo 'nanto 'jaro 'maraḥ / sarvagatvāt svatantratvāt sarvātmāsau maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Even as he was touched by the glorious Lord Visnu the prominent sage realised properly and precisely the Supreme Reality, thanks to his Grace.
verses.hindi: अनन्तायाप्रमेयाय कार्याय करणाय च नमो योगाधिगम्याय नमः संकर्षणाय ते
verses.wordMeaning: Even as he was touched by the glorious Lord Visnu the prominent sage realised properly and precisely the Supreme Reality, thanks to his Grace.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even as he was touched by the glorious Lord Visnu the prominent sage realised properly and precisely the Supreme Reality, thanks to his Grace.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्माणो बहवो रुद्रा ह्यन्ये नारायणादयः । एको हि भगवानीशः कालः कविरिति श्रुति
verses.transliteration: brahmāṇo bahavo rudrā hyanye nārāyaṇādayaḥ / eko hi bhagavānīśaḥ kālaḥ kaviriti śruti
verses.translation: Even as he was touched by the glorious Lord Visnu the prominent sage realised properly and precisely the Supreme Reality, thanks to his Grace.
verses.hindi: नमस्त्रिमूर्तये तुभ्यं त्रिधाम्ने दिव्यतेजसे। नमः सिद्धाय पूज्याय गुणत्रयविभाविने इत्थं स भगवान् विष्णुः सनकाद्यैरभिष्टुतः । प्रसादमकरोत् तेषां वराहवपुरीश्वरः
verses.wordMeaning: Even as he was touched by the glorious Lord Visnu the prominent sage realised properly and precisely the Supreme Reality, thanks to his Grace.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even as he was touched by the glorious Lord Visnu the prominent sage realised properly and precisely the Supreme Reality, thanks to his Grace.

verses.sanskrit: एकमत्र व्यतीतं तु परार्धं ब्रह्मणो द्विजाः । सांप्रतं वर्तते तद्वत् तस्य कल्पो ऽयमष्टमः
verses.transliteration: ekamatra vyatītaṃ tu parārdhaṃ brahmaṇo dvijāḥ / sāṃprataṃ vartate tadvat tasya kalpo 'yamaṣṭamaḥ
verses.translation: Even as he was touched by the glorious Lord Visnu the prominent sage realised properly and precisely the Supreme Reality, thanks to his Grace.
verses.hindi: ऋषि बोले--देवाधिदेव, पुराणपुरुष, सनातन, जयस्वरूप परमेष्ठी ब्रह्मको नमस्कार है। सृष्टि करनेवाले तथा सभी अर्थोके ज्ञाता स्वयम्भू! आपको नमस्कार है। हिरण्यगर्भ, वेधा परमात्माको नमस्कार है। विश्वके उत्पत्ति-स्थान, देवोंके हितकारी, वासुदेव, नारायणदेव विष्णुको नमस्कार है । शार्ङ्ग (धनुष), चक्र (सुदर्शन) तथा तलवार (नन्दक) आदि धारण करनेवाले चतुर्मुख! आपको नमस्कार है  सभी प्राणियोंके आत्मरूप, कूरस्थको
verses.wordMeaning: Even as he was touched by the glorious Lord Visnu the prominent sage realised properly and precisely the Supreme Reality, thanks to his Grace.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even as he was touched by the glorious Lord Visnu the prominent sage realised properly and precisely the Supreme Reality, thanks to his Grace.

verses.sanskrit: यो ऽतीतः सप्तमः कल्पः पाद्म इत्युच्यते बुधैः । वाराहो वर्तते कल्पः तस्य वक्ष्यामि विस्तरम्
verses.transliteration: yo 'tītaḥ saptamaḥ kalpaḥ pādma ityucyate budhaiḥ / vārāho vartate kalpaḥ tasya vakṣyāmi vistaram
verses.translation: Even as he was touched by the glorious Lord Visnu the prominent sage realised properly and precisely the Supreme Reality, thanks to his Grace.
verses.hindi: बार-बार नमस्कार है॥ ११--१४॥ वेदके रहस्यरूपको नमस्कार है। वेद-योनिको नमस्कार है। शुद्ध-बुद्धको नमस्कार है। ज्ञानरूपको नमस्कार है। आनन्दस्वरूपको नमस्कार है। जगत्के साक्षी, अनन्त, अप्रमेय तथा कार्य एवं कारणरूपको
verses.wordMeaning: Even as he was touched by the glorious Lord Visnu the prominent sage realised properly and precisely the Supreme Reality, thanks to his Grace.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even as he was touched by the glorious Lord Visnu the prominent sage realised properly and precisely the Supreme Reality, thanks to his Grace.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे पञ्चमो ऽध्यायः श्रीकूर्म उवाच आसीदेकार्णवं घोरमविभागं तमोमयम् । शान्तवातादिकं सर्वं न प्रज्ञायत किञ्चन
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge pañcamo 'dhyāyaḥ śrīkūrma uvāca āsīdekārṇavaṃ ghoramavibhāgaṃ tamomayam / śāntavātādikaṃ sarvaṃ na prajñāyata kiñcana
verses.translation: Therefore, with a delighted mind, he fell at the feet of Janardana. He spoke thus to the yellow-garmented Acyuta, whose eyes were like the full-blown lotus.
verses.hindi: नमस्कार है। पञ्चभूतरूपको नमस्कार है। पञ्चभूतात्मा (पञ्चभूतके अधिष्ठान आत्मा)-को नमस्कार है, मूलप्रकृतिको नमस्कार है। मायारूप आपको नमस्कार है॥ १५--१७॥ हे वराह! आपको नमस्कार है। मत्स्यरूप धारण करनेवालेको नमस्कार है। योगद्वारा जानने योग्यको नमस्कार है। संकर्षण! आपको नमस्कार है। तीन
verses.wordMeaning: Therefore, with a delighted mind, he fell at the feet of Janardana. He spoke thus to the yellow-garmented Acyuta, whose eyes were like the full-blown lotus.
verses.commentary: Sense: Therefore, with a delighted mind, he fell at the feet of Janardana. He spoke thus to the yellow-garmented Acyuta, whose eyes were like the full-blown lotus.

verses.sanskrit: एकार्णवे तदा तस्मिन् नष्टे स्थावरजङ्गमे । तदा समभवद् ब्रह्मा सहस्त्राक्षः सहस्त्रपात्
verses.transliteration: ekārṇave tadā tasmin naṣṭe sthāvarajaṅgame / tadā samabhavad brahmā sahastrākṣaḥ sahastrapāt
verses.translation: Thanks to yourGrace, the perfect knowledge pertain¬ ing to the. Brahman alone, as its object—the knowledge that yields the highest bliss—has been engendered in me dispelling all doubts.
verses.hindi: आपको नमस्कार है। तीन गुणोंको प्रवृत्त करनेवाले सिद्ध एवं पूज्य आपको नमस्कार है । आदित्यके समान वर्णवाले अर्थात् प्रकाशस्वरूप आपको नमस्कार है। पद्मयोनिको नमस्कार है । मूर्त एवं अमूर्तरूपको नमस्कार है। माधवको बारम्बार नमस्कार है
verses.wordMeaning: Thanks to yourGrace, the perfect knowledge pertain¬ ing to the. Brahman alone, as its object—the knowledge that yields the highest bliss—has been engendered in me dispelling all doubts.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thanks to yourGrace, the perfect knowledge pertain¬ ing to the. Brahman alone, as its object—the knowledge that yields the highest bliss—has been engendered in me dispelling all doubts.

verses.sanskrit: सहस्त्रशीर्षा पुरुषो रुक्मवर्णस्त्वतीन्द्रियः । ब्रह्मा नारायणाख्यस्तु सुष्वाप सलिले तदा
verses.transliteration: sahastraśīrṣā puruṣo rukmavarṇastvatīndriyaḥ / brahmā nārāyaṇākhyastu suṣvāpa salile tadā
verses.translation: Obeisance to you Lord Vasudeva, the creator of the universe. O Lord of Yoga, be pleased to enlighten me as to what I should do, O pervader of the universe.
verses.hindi: आपके द्वारा ही सम्पूर्ण सृष्टि हुई है और आपमें ही (वह) विलीन भी हो जायगी। इस सम्पूर्ण जगतका आप पालन करें। आप ही रक्षक हैं, आप ही शरण देनेवाले आश्रय-स्थान हैं सनक आदि (महर्षियों)-के द्वारा इस प्रकार स्तुति किये जानेपर वराह-शरीर धारण करनेवाले सर्वसमर्थ उन भगवान् विष्णुने उनपर कृपा को। इसके बाद पृथ्वीके स्वामी प्रजापतिने पृथ्वीको उसके स्थानमें
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you Lord Vasudeva, the creator of the universe. O Lord of Yoga, be pleased to enlighten me as to what I should do, O pervader of the universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you Lord Vasudeva, the creator of the universe. O Lord of Yoga, be pleased to enlighten me as to what I should do, O pervader of the universe.

verses.sanskrit: इमं चोदाहरन्त्यत्र श्लोकं नारायणं प्रति । ब्रह्मस्वरूपिणं देवं जगतः प्रभवाप्ययम्
verses.transliteration: imaṃ codāharantyatra ślokaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prati / brahmasvarūpiṇaṃ devaṃ jagataḥ prabhavāpyayam
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Indradyumna, Narayana the Consort of goddess LaksmI smilingly said these words which were conducive to the welfare of this entire universe.
verses.hindi: प्रतिष्ठित कर दिया और मनसे उसको धारण करके अपने (वराह)-रूपको छोड़ दिया उस महान् जलराशिके ऊपर विशाल नौकाके समान स्थित पृथ्वी अपने देहके विस्तारके कारण डूबती नहीं है
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the words of Indradyumna, Narayana the Consort of goddess LaksmI smilingly said these words which were conducive to the welfare of this entire universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of Indradyumna, Narayana the Consort of goddess LaksmI smilingly said these words which were conducive to the welfare of this entire universe.

verses.sanskrit: आपो नारा इति प्रोक्ता नाम्ना पूर्वमिति श्रुतिः । अयनं तस्य ता यस्मात् तेन नारायणः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: āpo nārā iti proktā nāmnā pūrvamiti śrutiḥ / ayanaṃ tasya tā yasmāt tena nārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: The Supreme Ruler (Mahesvara) should be wor¬ shipped by the paths of devotion and knowledge, by men abiding by the code of conduct prescribed for the four castes and stages of life, and not otherwise.
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर पृथ्वीको समतल बनाकर उन्होंने प्राक्सर्गदग्धानखिलांस्ततः सर्गेऽदधन्मनः ॥ २५॥  पहली सृष्टिके दग्ध हुए समस्त पर्वतोंको पृथ्वीपर
verses.wordMeaning: The Supreme Ruler (Mahesvara) should be wor¬ shipped by the paths of devotion and knowledge, by men abiding by the code of conduct prescribed for the four castes and stages of life, and not otherwise.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Supreme Ruler (Mahesvara) should be wor¬ shipped by the paths of devotion and knowledge, by men abiding by the code of conduct prescribed for the four castes and stages of life, and not otherwise.

verses.sanskrit: तुल्यं युगसहस्त्रस्य नैशं कालमुपास्य सः । शर्वर्यन्ते प्रकुरुते ब्रह्मत्वं सर्गकारणात्
verses.transliteration: tulyaṃ yugasahastrasya naiśaṃ kālamupāsya saḥ / śarvaryante prakurute brahmatvaṃ sargakāraṇāt
verses.translation: After knowing perfectly that great truth about him as well as his magnificence, the causal relation as well as my functions, he who seeks emancipation should worship the Lord of the universe (Isvara).
verses.hindi: स्थापित किया और सृष्टि (करने)-में अपना मन लगाया नौ प्रकारकी सृष्टि, ब्रह्माजीके मानस पुत्रोंका आविर्भाव, ब्रह्माजीके चारों मुखोंसे चारों वेदोंकी उत्पत्ति इत्यादिका वर्णन
verses.wordMeaning: After knowing perfectly that great truth about him as well as his magnificence, the causal relation as well as my functions, he who seeks emancipation should worship the Lord of the universe (Isvara).
verses.commentary: Sense: After knowing perfectly that great truth about him as well as his magnificence, the causal relation as well as my functions, he who seeks emancipation should worship the Lord of the universe (Isvara).

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तु सलिले तस्मिन् विज्ञायान्तर्गतां महीम् । अनुमानात् तदुद्धारं कर्तुकामः प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: tatastu salile tasmin vijñāyāntargatāṃ mahīm / anumānāt taduddhāraṃ kartukāmaḥ prajāpatiḥ
verses.translation: Eschewing all attachment and realising that the uni¬ verse is illusory, comprehend the identity between the Cosmic soul and individual soul. Thereby you will visualize the Supreme Ruler {Paramehara).
verses.hindi: बहिरन्तश्चाप्रकाशः स्तब्धो निःसंज्ञ एव च। मुख्या नगा इति प्रोक्ता मुख्यसर्गस्तु स स्मृतः ऊर्ध्वस्त्रोत इति प्रोक्तो देवसर्गस्तु सात्त्विक:
verses.wordMeaning: Eschewing all attachment and realising that the uni¬ verse is illusory, comprehend the identity between the Cosmic soul and individual soul. Thereby you will visualize the Supreme Ruler {Paramehara).
verses.commentary: Sense: Eschewing all attachment and realising that the uni¬ verse is illusory, comprehend the identity between the Cosmic soul and individual soul. Thereby you will visualize the Supreme Ruler {Paramehara).

verses.sanskrit: जलक्रीडासु रुचिरं वाराहं रुपमास्थितः । अधृष्यं मनसाप्यन्यैर्वाङ्मयं ब्रह्मसंज्ञितम्
verses.transliteration: jalakrīḍāsu ruciraṃ vārāhaṃ rupamāsthitaḥ / adhṛṣyaṃ manasāpyanyairvāṅmayaṃ brahmasaṃjñitam
verses.translation: What is that transcendental Truth, OJanardana? What is that magnificence? What is called the effect? What is the Cause? Who are you? What is your function?
verses.hindi: प्रकाशा बहिरन्तश्च स्वभावाद् देवसंज्ञिताः श्रीकूर्म बोले--उनके (ब्रह्माके) द्वारा सृष्टिके
verses.wordMeaning: What is that transcendental Truth, OJanardana? What is that magnificence? What is called the effect? What is the Cause? Who are you? What is your function?
verses.commentary: Sense: What is that transcendental Truth, OJanardana? What is that magnificence? What is called the effect? What is the Cause? Who are you? What is your function?

verses.sanskrit: पृथिव्युद्धरणार्थाय प्रविश्य च रसातलम् । दंष्ट्रयाभ्युज्जहारैनामात्माधारो धराधरः
verses.transliteration: pṛthivyuddharaṇārthāya praviśya ca rasātalam / daṃṣṭrayābhyujjahāraināmātmādhāro dharādharaḥ
verses.translation: It is of the nature of eternal Bliss. It is the imperish¬ able light beyond the darkness (of ignorance or nescience). Its eternal glory and rulership is called its magnificence [Vibhuti).
verses.hindi: ही सृष्टि हुई जैसी कि पूर्वके कल्योंमें हुई थी। उन महात्मासे तम, मोह, महामोह, तामिस्र तथा अन्ध नामवाली यह पञ्चपर्वा अविद्या उत्पन्न हुई। उस अभिमानी (देव) -के द्वारा ध्यान करते समय अन्धकारसे ढको हुई नीज-सदुश तथा लोकोंसे आवृत वह सृष्टि पाँच भागोंमें विभाजित होकर स्थित हुई॥ १--३॥
verses.wordMeaning: It is of the nature of eternal Bliss. It is the imperish¬ able light beyond the darkness (of ignorance or nescience). Its eternal glory and rulership is called its magnificence [Vibhuti).
verses.commentary: Sense: It is of the nature of eternal Bliss. It is the imperish¬ able light beyond the darkness (of ignorance or nescience). Its eternal glory and rulership is called its magnificence [Vibhuti).

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा दंष्ट्राग्रविन्यस्तां पृथिवीं प्रथितपौरुषम् । अस्तुवञ्जनलोकस्थाः सिद्धा ब्रह्मर्षयो हरिम्
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā daṃṣṭrāgravinyastāṃ pṛthivīṃ prathitapauruṣam / astuvañjanalokasthāḥ siddhā brahmarṣayo harim
verses.translation: The effect is the universe. The cause is the unmani¬ fest, pure and imperishable {Brahman). I am indeed the Immanent Soul [Antarydmin), the great controller of all beings.
verses.hindi: बाहर एवं भीतरके प्रकाश (ज्ञान)-से शून्य, स्तब्ध (जड) तथा संज्ञा (चेतना)-विहीन नग (अर्थात् पर्वत, वृक्ष आदि) 'मुख्य' इस नामसे कहे जाते हैं और वही मुख्य सर्ग (मुख्य सृष्टि) कहलाता है। प्रभुने उस (मुख्य सर्ग)-को (सृष्टिके विस्तारमें) साधक (समर्थ) न देखकर दूसरी सृष्टिके लिये विचार किया। उनके ऐसा विचार करते ही 'तिर्यक्स्रोत' नामक (पशु-पक्षियों आदिको) सृष्टि हुई। है ब्राह्मणो! क्योंकि वह सृष्टि
verses.wordMeaning: The effect is the universe. The cause is the unmani¬ fest, pure and imperishable {Brahman). I am indeed the Immanent Soul [Antarydmin), the great controller of all beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: The effect is the universe. The cause is the unmani¬ fest, pure and imperishable {Brahman). I am indeed the Immanent Soul [Antarydmin), the great controller of all beings.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषय ऊचुः नमस्ते देवदेवाय ब्रह्मणे परमेष्ठिने । पुरुषाय पुराणाय शाश्वताय जयाय च
verses.transliteration: ṛṣaya ūcuḥ namaste devadevāya brahmaṇe parameṣṭhine / puruṣāya purāṇāya śāśvatāya jayāya ca
verses.translation: Of what nature is the divine knowledge which is based on the three types of Bhdvands (meditations)? How is this universe created formerly and how is it withdrawn again?
verses.hindi: तिर्यक् (तिरछी) चलनेवाली थी, इसलिये तिर्यक्स्रोत सृष्टि कहलाती है। वे (मार्गका उल्लंघन करनेवाले) पशु आदि उत्पथग्राही कहे जाते हैं॥ ४--६॥ उस तिर्यक्स्रोत नामक सृष्टिको भी (सृष्टि-विस्तारके लिये) निष्प्रयोजन जानकर (उन देवने) अन्य सर्गको उत्पन्न किया। वह (सर्ग) ऊर्ध्वस्नोत सात्त्विक सर्ग ' देवसर्ग' नामसे कहा गया। इस देवसर्गके लोगोंमें सुख और प्रीतिकी अधिकता
verses.wordMeaning: Of what nature is the divine knowledge which is based on the three types of Bhdvands (meditations)? How is this universe created formerly and how is it withdrawn again?
verses.commentary: Sense: Of what nature is the divine knowledge which is based on the three types of Bhdvands (meditations)? How is this universe created formerly and how is it withdrawn again?

verses.sanskrit: नमः स्वयंभुवे तुभ्यं स्त्रष्ट्रे सर्वार्थवेदिने । नमो हिरण्यगर्भाय वेधसे परमात्मने
verses.transliteration: namaḥ svayaṃbhuve tubhyaṃ straṣṭre sarvārthavedine / namo hiraṇyagarbhāya vedhase paramātmane
verses.translation: An aerial car of excellent refulgence like the sun appeared in front and it was followed by groups of gods, celes¬ tial singers and bevies of heavenly dancing girls.
verses.hindi: रहती है। वे अंदर तथा बाहर आवरणसे रहित होते हैं तथा स्वभावसे ही अंदर-बाहर प्रकाशसे परिपूर्ण रहते हैं, इसलिये वे देव कहलाते हैं ते च प्रकाशबहुलास्तमोद्रिक्ता रजोऽधिकाः । दुःखोत्कटा: सत्त्वयुता मनुष्याः परिकीर्तिताः १०॥ तं दृष्टा चापरं सर्गममन्यद् भगवानजः। तस्याभिध्यायतः सर्ग सर्गो भूतादिकोऽभवत्
verses.wordMeaning: An aerial car of excellent refulgence like the sun appeared in front and it was followed by groups of gods, celes¬ tial singers and bevies of heavenly dancing girls.
verses.commentary: Sense: An aerial car of excellent refulgence like the sun appeared in front and it was followed by groups of gods, celes¬ tial singers and bevies of heavenly dancing girls.

verses.sanskrit: नमस्ते वासुदेवाय विष्णवे विश्वयोनये । नारायणाय देवाय देवानां हितकारिणे
verses.transliteration: namaste vāsudevāya viṣṇave viśvayonaye / nārāyaṇāya devāya devānāṃ hitakāriṇe
verses.translation: In the middle of that light, he saw the Ancient Being, the highest goal (to be reached). It was a great mass of splendour, incomprehensible and unapproachable to those who hate Brahma.
verses.hindi: खादनाश्चाप्यशीलाश्च भूताद्या: परिकीर्तिताः । इत्येते पञ्च कथिताः सर्गा वै द्विजपुंगवाः प्रथमो महतः सर्गो विज्ञेयो ब्रह्मणस्तु सः। तन्मात्राणां द्वितीयस्तु भूतसर्गो हि स स्मृतः
verses.wordMeaning: In the middle of that light, he saw the Ancient Being, the highest goal (to be reached). It was a great mass of splendour, incomprehensible and unapproachable to those who hate Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the middle of that light, he saw the Ancient Being, the highest goal (to be reached). It was a great mass of splendour, incomprehensible and unapproachable to those who hate Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: नमो ऽस्तु ते चतुर्वक्त्रे शार्ङ्गचक्रासिधारिणे । सर्वभूतात्मभूताय कूटस्थाय नमो नमः
verses.transliteration: namo 'stu te caturvaktre śārṅgacakrāsidhāriṇe / sarvabhūtātmabhūtāya kūṭasthāya namo namaḥ
verses.translation: It is the place where Lord Hiranyagarbha, the partaker of oblations offered to gods and the spirits of the deceased ancestors, abides. That is the primary entrance of the Yogins as established in the Vedanta.
verses.hindi: वैकारिकस्तृतीयस्तु सर्ग ऐन्द्रियकः स्मृतः । तथोर्ध्वस्त्रोतसां षष्ठो देवसर्गस्तु स स्मृतः।
verses.wordMeaning: It is the place where Lord Hiranyagarbha, the partaker of oblations offered to gods and the spirits of the deceased ancestors, abides. That is the primary entrance of the Yogins as established in the Vedanta.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is the place where Lord Hiranyagarbha, the partaker of oblations offered to gods and the spirits of the deceased ancestors, abides. That is the primary entrance of the Yogins as established in the Vedanta.

verses.sanskrit: नमो वेदरहस्याय नमस्ते वेदयोनये । नमो बुद्धाय शुद्धाय नमस्ते ज्ञानरूपिणे
verses.transliteration: namo vedarahasyāya namaste vedayonaye / namo buddhāya śuddhāya namaste jñānarūpiṇe
verses.translation: Becoming identical with the cosmic soul, the soul of all beings. He ascended (and abided) in the blissful, unshakable abode of Brahma, the Supreme Lord endowed with the highest power and glory.
verses.hindi: प्राकृतास्तु त्रयः पूर्वे सर्गास्तेऽबुद्द्विपूर्वकाः । बुद्धिपूर्व प्रवर्तन्ते मुख्याद्या मुनिपुंगवाः अग्रे ससर्ज वै ब्रह्मा मानसानात्मनः समान्।
verses.wordMeaning: Becoming identical with the cosmic soul, the soul of all beings. He ascended (and abided) in the blissful, unshakable abode of Brahma, the Supreme Lord endowed with the highest power and glory.
verses.commentary: Sense: Becoming identical with the cosmic soul, the soul of all beings. He ascended (and abided) in the blissful, unshakable abode of Brahma, the Supreme Lord endowed with the highest power and glory.

verses.sanskrit: नमो ऽस्त्वानन्दरूपाय साक्षिणे जगतां नमः । अनन्तायाप्रमेयाय कार्याय करणाय च
verses.transliteration: namo 'stvānandarūpāya sākṣiṇe jagatāṃ namaḥ / anantāyāprameyāya kāryāya karaṇāya ca
verses.translation: He narrated it in the presence of the King of Devas. I shall recite it to you all. It is conducive to wealth, fame and longevity. It is sacred and it yields Moka to men.
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर निरन्तर सत्यका ध्यान करनेवाले उन देवके चिन्तन करनेपर उसी समय अव्यक्त (प्रकृति)- से (सृष्टि-विस्तारका) साधक अर्वाक्स्रोतवाला साधक (सर्ग) उत्पन्न हुआ। वे (अर्वाक्त्रोत प्राणी) प्रकाश (ञ्ञान)-के बाहुल्यवाले, तमोगुण तथा रजोगुणकी अधिकतावाले, अधिक दु:खवाले और सत्त्वगुणसे सम्पन्न मनुष्य नामसे कहे जाते है
verses.wordMeaning: He narrated it in the presence of the King of Devas. I shall recite it to you all. It is conducive to wealth, fame and longevity. It is sacred and it yields Moka to men.
verses.commentary: Sense: He narrated it in the presence of the King of Devas. I shall recite it to you all. It is conducive to wealth, fame and longevity. It is sacred and it yields Moka to men.

verses.sanskrit: नमस्ते पञ्चबूताय पञ्चभूतात्मने नमः । नमो मूलप्रकृतये मायारूपाय ते नमः
verses.transliteration: namaste pañcabūtāya pañcabhūtātmane namaḥ / namo mūlaprakṛtaye māyārūpāya te namaḥ
verses.translation: The listening to and narration of the Purdna is excellent, O Brahmanas. Hearing even a single chapter, one becomes absolved of all sins.
verses.hindi: उस (मानुष-सर्ग)-को देखकर अजन्मा भगवानूने अन्य सर्गकी रचनाका विचार किया और उनके ऐसे सर्ग-विषयक ध्यान करते ही भूतादि सर्ग उत्पन्न हुआ। वे सभी संग्रह न करनेवाले, फिर भी बाँटनेके स्वभाववाले, उपभोग करनेवाले तथा शीलरहित ' भूतादि' इस नामसे कहे गये हैं । ब्राह्मणश्रेष्ठो! इस प्रकार ये पाँच सर्ग कहे गये हैँ
verses.wordMeaning: The listening to and narration of the Purdna is excellent, O Brahmanas. Hearing even a single chapter, one becomes absolved of all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: The listening to and narration of the Purdna is excellent, O Brahmanas. Hearing even a single chapter, one becomes absolved of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: नमो ऽस्तु ते वराहाय नमस्ते मत्स्यरूपिणे । नमो योगाधिगम्याय नमः सकर्षणाय ते
verses.transliteration: namo 'stu te varāhāya namaste matsyarūpiṇe / namo yogādhigamyāya namaḥ sakarṣaṇāya te
verses.translation: The three diramaj mentioned here are the cults of Visnu, Brahma and iva.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्माका वह पहला सर्ग महत्सर्ग कहा गया है। तन्मात्राओंका दूसरा सर्ग भूतसर्ग कहलाता है। तीसरा वैकारिक सर्ग ऐन्द्रियक सर्ग कहा जाता है। इस प्रकार यह प्राकृत सर्ग आबुद्धिपूर्वक हुआ। चौथा सर्ग मुख्य सर्ग है। स्थावर (जड पदार्थ) मुख्य कहलाते हैं। तिर्यक्त्रोतसे जिस सर्गको बतलाया है वह तिर्यग्योनिवाला
verses.wordMeaning: The three diramaj mentioned here are the cults of Visnu, Brahma and iva.
verses.commentary: Sense: The three diramaj mentioned here are the cults of Visnu, Brahma and iva.

verses.sanskrit: नमस्त्रिमूर्तये तुभ्यं त्रिधाम्ने दिव्यतेजसे । नमः सिद्धाय पूज्याय गुणत्रयविभाविने
verses.transliteration: namastrimūrtaye tubhyaṃ tridhāmne divyatejase / namaḥ siddhāya pūjyāya guṇatrayavibhāvine
verses.translation: The Tripuridra markofSaivas are the three horizontal lines of bhasma (ashes) each line representing the past, present and future (Division of Time that is probably implied here in kdldt mdsau dhrto bhavet / uparyadhobhdvayogdt tripudrasya /)
verses.hindi: जो देवसर्ग कहलाता है। तदनन्तर अर्वाक्स्रोतसोंका सातवा सर्ग है जो मानुष सर्ग है  भूतादिकोंका आठवाँ सर्ग भौतिक सर्ग कहा गया है। नवाँ सर्ग कौमार सर्ग है। इस प्रकार ये नवों सर्ग प्राकृत तथा वैकृत दोनों मुनिश्रेष्ठो! पहलेके तीन सर्ग (महत्सर्ग, भूतसर्ग तथा ऐन्द्रियक सर्ग) प्राकृत सर्ग हैं, जो अबुद्धिपूर्वक होते हैं। और मुख्य आदि सर्ग (अवशिष्ट ६ सर्ग) बुद्धिपूर्वक होते हँ
verses.wordMeaning: The Tripuridra markofSaivas are the three horizontal lines of bhasma (ashes) each line representing the past, present and future (Division of Time that is probably implied here in kdldt mdsau dhrto bhavet / uparyadhobhdvayogdt tripudrasya /)
verses.commentary: Sense: The Tripuridra markofSaivas are the three horizontal lines of bhasma (ashes) each line representing the past, present and future (Division of Time that is probably implied here in kdldt mdsau dhrto bhavet / uparyadhobhdvayogdt tripudrasya /)

verses.sanskrit: तमो ऽस्त्वादित्यवर्णाय नमस्ते पद्मयोनये । नमो ऽमूर्ताय मूर्ताय माधवाय नमो नमः
verses.transliteration: tamo 'stvādityavarṇāya namaste padmayonaye / namo 'mūrtāya mūrtāya mādhavāya namo namaḥ
verses.translation: The Tripuridra markofSaivas are the three horizontal lines of bhasma (ashes) each line representing the past, present and future (Division of Time that is probably implied here in kdldt mdsau dhrto bhavet / uparyadhobhdvayogdt tripudrasya /)
verses.hindi: प्रजापति ब्रह्माजीने सबसे पहले अपने ही समान मानस पुत्रोंको उत्पन्न किया। है ब्राह्मणो! ये पाँचों योगी थे, परम वैराग्यवान् थे और ईश्वरमें उनका मन आसक्त था। (इसलिये) उन्होंने सृष्टि (-के विस्तार)-में अपनी बुद्धि नहीं लगायी
verses.wordMeaning: The Tripuridra markofSaivas are the three horizontal lines of bhasma (ashes) each line representing the past, present and future (Division of Time that is probably implied here in kdldt mdsau dhrto bhavet / uparyadhobhdvayogdt tripudrasya /)
verses.commentary: Sense: The Tripuridra markofSaivas are the three horizontal lines of bhasma (ashes) each line representing the past, present and future (Division of Time that is probably implied here in kdldt mdsau dhrto bhavet / uparyadhobhdvayogdt tripudrasya /)

verses.sanskrit: त्वयैव सृष्टमखिलं त्वय्येव लयमेष्यति । पालयैतज्जगत् सर्वं त्राता त्वं शरणं गति
verses.transliteration: tvayaiva sṛṣṭamakhilaṃ tvayyeva layameṣyati / pālayaitajjagat sarvaṃ trātā tvaṃ śaraṇaṃ gati
verses.translation: The Tripuridra markofSaivas are the three horizontal lines of bhasma (ashes) each line representing the past, present and future (Division of Time that is probably implied here in kdldt mdsau dhrto bhavet / uparyadhobhdvayogdt tripudrasya /)
verses.hindi: तेष्वेवं निरपेक्षेषु लोकसृष्टौ प्रजापति: । तं बोधयामास सुतं जगन्मायो महामुनिः । नारायणो महायोगी योगिचित्तानुरञ्जनः
verses.wordMeaning: The Tripuridra markofSaivas are the three horizontal lines of bhasma (ashes) each line representing the past, present and future (Division of Time that is probably implied here in kdldt mdsau dhrto bhavet / uparyadhobhdvayogdt tripudrasya /)
verses.commentary: Sense: The Tripuridra markofSaivas are the three horizontal lines of bhasma (ashes) each line representing the past, present and future (Division of Time that is probably implied here in kdldt mdsau dhrto bhavet / uparyadhobhdvayogdt tripudrasya /)

verses.sanskrit: इत्थं स भगवान् विष्णुः सनकाद्यैरभिष्टुतः । प्रसादमकरोत् तेषां वराहवपुरीश्वरः
verses.transliteration: itthaṃ sa bhagavān viṣṇuḥ sanakādyairabhiṣṭutaḥ / prasādamakarot teṣāṃ varāhavapurīśvaraḥ
verses.translation: The Tripuridra markofSaivas are the three horizontal lines of bhasma (ashes) each line representing the past, present and future (Division of Time that is probably implied here in kdldt mdsau dhrto bhavet / uparyadhobhdvayogdt tripudrasya /)
verses.hindi: स तप्यमानो भगवान् न किञ्चित् प्रत्यपद्यत ततो दीर्घण कालेन दुःखात् क्रोधो व्यजायत। क्रोधाविष्टस्य नेत्राभ्यां प्रापतन्नश्रुबिन्दवः
verses.wordMeaning: The Tripuridra markofSaivas are the three horizontal lines of bhasma (ashes) each line representing the past, present and future (Division of Time that is probably implied here in kdldt mdsau dhrto bhavet / uparyadhobhdvayogdt tripudrasya /)
verses.commentary: Sense: The Tripuridra markofSaivas are the three horizontal lines of bhasma (ashes) each line representing the past, present and future (Division of Time that is probably implied here in kdldt mdsau dhrto bhavet / uparyadhobhdvayogdt tripudrasya /)

verses.sanskrit: ततः संस्थानमानीय पृथिवीं पृथिवीपतिः । मुमोच रूपं मनसा धारयित्वा प्रिजापतिः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ saṃsthānamānīya pṛthivīṃ pṛthivīpatiḥ / mumoca rūpaṃ manasā dhārayitvā prijāpatiḥ
verses.translation: The Tripuridra markofSaivas are the three horizontal lines of bhasma (ashes) each line representing the past, present and future (Division of Time that is probably implied here in kdldt mdsau dhrto bhavet / uparyadhobhdvayogdt tripudrasya /)
verses.hindi: समुत्पन्नो महादेवः शरण्यो नीललोहितः स एव भगवानीशस्तेजोराशिः सनातनः। यं प्रपश्यन्ति विद्वांसः स्वात्मस्थं परमेश्वरम्
verses.wordMeaning: The Tripuridra markofSaivas are the three horizontal lines of bhasma (ashes) each line representing the past, present and future (Division of Time that is probably implied here in kdldt mdsau dhrto bhavet / uparyadhobhdvayogdt tripudrasya /)
verses.commentary: Sense: The Tripuridra markofSaivas are the three horizontal lines of bhasma (ashes) each line representing the past, present and future (Division of Time that is probably implied here in kdldt mdsau dhrto bhavet / uparyadhobhdvayogdt tripudrasya /)

verses.sanskrit: तस्योपरि जलौघस्य महती नौरिव स्थिता । विततत्वाच्च देहस्य न मही याति संप्लवम्
verses.transliteration: tasyopari jalaughasya mahatī nauriva sthitā / vitatatvācca dehasya na mahī yāti saṃplavam
verses.translation: The Tripuridra markofSaivas are the three horizontal lines of bhasma (ashes) each line representing the past, present and future (Division of Time that is probably implied here in kdldt mdsau dhrto bhavet / uparyadhobhdvayogdt tripudrasya /)
verses.hindi: ओकारं समनुस्मृत्य प्रणम्य च कृताञ्जलिः। तमाह भगवान् ब्रह्मा सृजेमा विविधाः प्रजा: निशम्य भगवान् वाक्यं शंकरो धर्मवाहनः । स्वात्मना सदूशान् रुद्रान् ससर्ज मनसा शिवः । कपर्दिनो निरातङ्कास्त्रनेत्रान् नीललोहितान्
verses.wordMeaning: The Tripuridra markofSaivas are the three horizontal lines of bhasma (ashes) each line representing the past, present and future (Division of Time that is probably implied here in kdldt mdsau dhrto bhavet / uparyadhobhdvayogdt tripudrasya /)
verses.commentary: Sense: The Tripuridra markofSaivas are the three horizontal lines of bhasma (ashes) each line representing the past, present and future (Division of Time that is probably implied here in kdldt mdsau dhrto bhavet / uparyadhobhdvayogdt tripudrasya /)

verses.sanskrit: पृथिवीं तु समीकृत्य पृथिव्यां सो ऽचिनोद् गिरीन् । प्राक्सर्गदग्धानखिलांस्ततः सर्गे ऽदधन्मनः
verses.transliteration: pṛthivīṃ tu samīkṛtya pṛthivyāṃ so 'cinod girīn / prāksargadagdhānakhilāṃstataḥ sarge 'dadhanmanaḥ
verses.translation: The Tripuridra markofSaivas are the three horizontal lines of bhasma (ashes) each line representing the past, present and future (Division of Time that is probably implied here in kdldt mdsau dhrto bhavet / uparyadhobhdvayogdt tripudrasya /)
verses.hindi: तं प्राह भगवान् ब्रह्मा जन्ममृत्युयुताः प्रजाः । लवाः काष्ठाः कलाश्चैव मुहूर्ता दिवसाः क्षपाः । अर्धमासाश्च मासाश्च अयनाब्दयुगादयः
verses.wordMeaning: The Tripuridra markofSaivas are the three horizontal lines of bhasma (ashes) each line representing the past, present and future (Division of Time that is probably implied here in kdldt mdsau dhrto bhavet / uparyadhobhdvayogdt tripudrasya /)
verses.commentary: Sense: The Tripuridra markofSaivas are the three horizontal lines of bhasma (ashes) each line representing the past, present and future (Division of Time that is probably implied here in kdldt mdsau dhrto bhavet / uparyadhobhdvayogdt tripudrasya /)

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षटसाहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे षष्ठो ऽध्यायः श्रीकूर्म उवाच सृष्टिं चिन्तयतस्तस्य कल्पादिषु यथा पुरा । अबुद्धिपूर्वकः सर्गः प्रादुर्भूतस्तमोमयः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭasāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge ṣaṣṭho 'dhyāyaḥ śrīkūrma uvāca sṛṣṭiṃ cintayatastasya kalpādiṣu yathā purā / abuddhipūrvakaḥ sargaḥ prādurbhūtastamomayaḥ
verses.translation: Originally I, God Narayana (God reposing on cosmic waters) alone existed there was nothing else except me. Lying on the coils of serpent Sesa's body as a couch, I resorted to ex¬ tensive deep slumber.
verses.hindi: लोकसृष्टिके कार्यमें उनके इस प्रकार निरपेक्ष (उदासीन) हो जानेपर प्रजापति (ब्रह्मा) मायापति परमेष्ठीकी  मायाके द्वारा तत्काल मोहित कर लिये गये। योगियोंके चित्तका अनुरञ्जन करनेवाले जगत्कर्ता महायोगी, महामुनि नारायणने (अपने) उस पुत्र (ब्रह्मा)-को प्रबुद्ध किया। (तब) उनके द्वारा प्रबुद्ध किये गये विश्वात्मा (ब्रह्मा)-ने परम तप किया, (किंतु) तप करनेपर भी उन भगवान् ब्रह्माको कुछ प्राप्त नहीं हुआ॥ २१--२३॥
verses.wordMeaning: Originally I, God Narayana (God reposing on cosmic waters) alone existed there was nothing else except me. Lying on the coils of serpent Sesa's body as a couch, I resorted to ex¬ tensive deep slumber.
verses.commentary: Sense: Originally I, God Narayana (God reposing on cosmic waters) alone existed there was nothing else except me. Lying on the coils of serpent Sesa's body as a couch, I resorted to ex¬ tensive deep slumber.

verses.sanskrit: तमो मोहो महामोहस्तामिस्त्रश्चान्धसंज्ञितः । अविद्या पञ्चपर्वैषा प्रादुर्भूता महात्मनः
verses.transliteration: tamo moho mahāmohastāmistraścāndhasaṃjñitaḥ / avidyā pañcaparvaiṣā prādurbhūtā mahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: At the close of the night, I woke up and began to think of the creation of the universe once again. O leading sages, thereafter there dawned in me, all of a sudden, a sense of serenity and composure.
verses.hindi: न होनेके कारण उन्हें) दुःखके कारण क्रोध उत्पन्न हुआ। क्रोधसे आविष्ट उन (ब्रह्मा)-के नेत्रोंसे आँसूकी बूंदें गिरीं । उनके (क्रोधके कारण) टेढ़ी भूकुटियोंबाले ललाटसे शरण देनेवाले नीललोहित परमेश्वर महादेव प्रकट हुए। वे ही तेजकी राशि सनातन भगवान् ईश हैं, जिन्हें विद्वान् लोग अपनी आत्मामें स्थित परमेश्वर (परमात्मा)-के रूपमें देखते हैं ॥ २४--२६॥
verses.wordMeaning: At the close of the night, I woke up and began to think of the creation of the universe once again. O leading sages, thereafter there dawned in me, all of a sudden, a sense of serenity and composure.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the close of the night, I woke up and began to think of the creation of the universe once again. O leading sages, thereafter there dawned in me, all of a sudden, a sense of serenity and composure.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चधावस्थितः सर्गो ध्यायतः सो ऽभिमानिनः । संवृतस्तमसा चैव बीजकम्भुवनावृतः
verses.transliteration: pañcadhāvasthitaḥ sargo dhyāyataḥ so 'bhimāninaḥ / saṃvṛtastamasā caiva bījakambhuvanāvṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Therefrom was born the four-faced deity Brahma, the grand-father of the worlds. In the meanwhile, for some unknown reason, wrath was provoked in me.
verses.hindi: ओंकारका सम्यकू रूपसे स्मरणकर और प्रणामकर हाथ जोड़ते हुए भगवान् ब्रह्माने उन (महादेव) -से कहा--इन अनेक प्रकारको प्रजाओंको सृष्टि करें धर्म (वृषभ)-पर आरूढ़ होनेवाले धर्मवाहन मङ्गलकारी भगवान् शिवने (ब्रह्माके) वचनको सुनकर मनसे अपने ही समान जटाधारी, आतंकरहित, तीन नेत्रवाले एवं नीललोहित रुद्रोंको उत्पन्न किया
verses.wordMeaning: Therefrom was born the four-faced deity Brahma, the grand-father of the worlds. In the meanwhile, for some unknown reason, wrath was provoked in me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Therefrom was born the four-faced deity Brahma, the grand-father of the worlds. In the meanwhile, for some unknown reason, wrath was provoked in me.

verses.sanskrit: वर्हिरन्तश्चाप्रकाशः स्तब्धो निः संज्ञ एव च । मुक्या नगा इति प्रोक्ता मुख्यसर्गस्तु स स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: varhirantaścāprakāśaḥ stabdho niḥ saṃjña eva ca / mukyā nagā iti proktā mukhyasargastu sa smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: From my own self was born, O leading sages, the three¬ eyed great god Rudra of furious temperament wielding a trident in his hand.
verses.hindi: उनसे भगवान् ब्रह्माने कहा-जन्म लेनेवाली और मृत्युको प्राप्त होनेवाली प्रजाकी सृष्टि करो। वे ईश बोले-हे जगन्नाथ! मैं मृत्यु एवं वृद्धावस्थाको प्राप्त होनेवाली प्रजाकी सृष्टि नहीं करूंगा। ऐसी अशुभ प्रजाओंको आप ही उत्पन्न करें
verses.wordMeaning: From my own self was born, O leading sages, the three¬ eyed great god Rudra of furious temperament wielding a trident in his hand.
verses.commentary: Sense: From my own self was born, O leading sages, the three¬ eyed great god Rudra of furious temperament wielding a trident in his hand.

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वासाधकं सर्गममन्यदपरं प्रभुः । तस्याभिध्यायतः सर्गस्तिर्यक्स्त्रोतो ऽभ्यवर्तत
verses.transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvāsādhakaṃ sargamamanyadaparaṃ prabhuḥ / tasyābhidhyāyataḥ sargastiryakstroto 'bhyavartata
verses.translation: By his brilliance he resembled the sun, appearing as though he would burn down the three worlds. Then there ap¬ peared goddess Sri with large eyes resembling lotus.
verses.hindi: तब कमलसे उत्पन्न ब्रह्माने (सृष्टि-विस्तारके कार्यसे) रुद्रको रोककर (स्वयं) सभी स्थानाभिमानियोंको उत्पन्न किया, में उन्हें बता रहा हूँ (आपलोग) सुनें जल, अग्नि, अन्तरिक्ष, आकाश, वायु और पृथ्वी इसी प्रकार नदी, समुद्र, पर्वत, वृक्ष, वनस्पति, लव, काष्ठा, कला, मुहूर्त, दिन-रात, अर्धमास, मास, अयन, वर्ष तथा युग आदि
verses.wordMeaning: By his brilliance he resembled the sun, appearing as though he would burn down the three worlds. Then there ap¬ peared goddess Sri with large eyes resembling lotus.
verses.commentary: Sense: By his brilliance he resembled the sun, appearing as though he would burn down the three worlds. Then there ap¬ peared goddess Sri with large eyes resembling lotus.

verses.sanskrit: यस्मात् तिर्यक् प्रवृत्तः स तिर्यक्स्त्रोतस्ततः स्मृतः । पश्वादयस्ते विख्याता उत्पथग्राहिणो द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: yasmāt tiryak pravṛttaḥ sa tiryakstrotastataḥ smṛtaḥ / paśvādayaste vikhyātā utpathagrāhiṇo dvijāḥ
verses.translation: She was extremely beautiful and had a gentle coun¬ tenance. She fascinated all embodied beings. Beaming with a radiant smile, ■ she possessed composure and dignity. She was auspicious and an abode of greatness.
verses.hindi: + छठे अध्यायमें ब्रह्मा और नारायणमें अभेद माना गया है, अतः यहाँ परमेष्ठी शब्द 'नारायण' का वाचक है। स्थानाभिमानिनः सृष्टा साधकानसृजत् पुनः ।
verses.wordMeaning: She was extremely beautiful and had a gentle coun¬ tenance. She fascinated all embodied beings. Beaming with a radiant smile, ■ she possessed composure and dignity. She was auspicious and an abode of greatness.
verses.commentary: Sense: She was extremely beautiful and had a gentle coun¬ tenance. She fascinated all embodied beings. Beaming with a radiant smile, ■ she possessed composure and dignity. She was auspicious and an abode of greatness.

verses.sanskrit: तमप्यसाधकं ज्ञात्वा सर्गमन्यं ससर्ज ह । ऊर्ध्वस्त्रोत इति प्रोक्तो देवसर्गस्तु सात्त्विकः
verses.transliteration: tamapyasādhakaṃ jñātvā sargamanyaṃ sasarja ha / ūrdhvastrota iti prokto devasargastu sāttvikaḥ
verses.translation: Endowed with divine lustre and beautified with divine garlands, she was the great Maya (deluding Potency) belonging to Narayana. She was the eternal primordial nature {Mula prakrti).
verses.hindi: दक्षमत्रिं वसिष्ठं च धर्म संकल्पमेव च प्राणाद् ब्रह्मासृजद् दक्षं चक्षुषश्च मरीचिनम्। शिरसोऽङ्विरसं देवो हृदयाद् भृगुमेव च
verses.wordMeaning: Endowed with divine lustre and beautified with divine garlands, she was the great Maya (deluding Potency) belonging to Narayana. She was the eternal primordial nature {Mula prakrti).
verses.commentary: Sense: Endowed with divine lustre and beautified with divine garlands, she was the great Maya (deluding Potency) belonging to Narayana. She was the eternal primordial nature {Mula prakrti).

verses.sanskrit: ते सुखप्रतिबहुला बहिरन्तश्च नावृताः । प्रकाशा बहिरन्तश्च स्वभावाद् देवसंज्ञिताः
verses.transliteration: te sukhapratibahulā bahirantaśca nāvṛtāḥ / prakāśā bahirantaśca svabhāvād devasaṃjñitāḥ
verses.translation: Filling the entire universe with her lustre she sat by my side. On seeing her. Lord Brahma submitted to me, the Lord of the universe.
verses.hindi: श्रोत्राभ्यामत्रिनामानं धर्म च व्यवसायतः। संकल्पं चैव संकल्पात् सर्वलोकपितामहः पुलस्त्यं च तथोदानाद् व्यानाच्च पुलहं मुनिम्। अपानात् क्रतुमव्यग्रं समानाच्य वसिष्ठकम्
verses.wordMeaning: Filling the entire universe with her lustre she sat by my side. On seeing her. Lord Brahma submitted to me, the Lord of the universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: Filling the entire universe with her lustre she sat by my side. On seeing her. Lord Brahma submitted to me, the Lord of the universe.

verses.sanskrit: ततो ऽबिधायायतस्तस्य सत्याभिध्यायिनस्तदा । प्रादुरासीत् तदाव्यक्तादर्वाक्स्त्रोतस्तु साधकः
verses.transliteration: tato 'bidhāyāyatastasya satyābhidhyāyinastadā / prādurāsīt tadāvyaktādarvākstrotastu sādhakaḥ
verses.translation: O Madhava (consort of Laksmi), employ this Maya of beautiful form for fascinating all living beings so that my extensive creation will flourish thereby.
verses.hindi: इत्येते ब्रह्मणा सृष्टाः साधका गृहमेधिनः । आस्थाय मानवं रूपं धर्मस्तैः सम्प्रवर्तितः ३७॥ ततो देवासुरपितृन् मनुष्यांश्च चतुष्टयम्। सिसृक्षुरम्भांस्येतानि स्वमात्मानमयूयुजत्
verses.wordMeaning: O Madhava (consort of Laksmi), employ this Maya of beautiful form for fascinating all living beings so that my extensive creation will flourish thereby.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Madhava (consort of Laksmi), employ this Maya of beautiful form for fascinating all living beings so that my extensive creation will flourish thereby.

verses.sanskrit: ते च प्रकाशबहुलास्तमोद्रिक्ता रजोधिकाः । दुः खोत्कटाः सत्त्वयुता मनुष्याः परिकीर्तिता
verses.transliteration: te ca prakāśabahulāstamodriktā rajodhikāḥ / duḥ khotkaṭāḥ sattvayutā manuṣyāḥ parikīrtitā
verses.translation: Be far away from those persons who are free from sins and dirt, who are devoted to Prdndydma (breath control) etc., who are attached to Pranava (OM) and who regularly repeat silently the name of Rudra.
verses.hindi: सत्त्वमात्रात्मिकां देवस्तनुमन्यामगृह्णत। ततोऽस्य मुखतो देवा दीव्यतः सम्प्रजज्ञिरि तस्मादहो धर्मयुक्ता देवताः समुपासते
verses.wordMeaning: Be far away from those persons who are free from sins and dirt, who are devoted to Prdndydma (breath control) etc., who are attached to Pranava (OM) and who regularly repeat silently the name of Rudra.
verses.commentary: Sense: Be far away from those persons who are free from sins and dirt, who are devoted to Prdndydma (breath control) etc., who are attached to Pranava (OM) and who regularly repeat silently the name of Rudra.

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा चापरं सर्गममन्यद् भगवानजः । तस्याभिध्यायतः सर्गं सर्गो भूतादिको ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvā cāparaṃ sargamamanyad bhagavānajaḥ / tasyābhidhyāyataḥ sargaṃ sargo bhūtādiko 'bhavat
verses.translation: Tajfia (the institution of sacrifice) came out of them and shone for the purpose of the protection of all Devas. So also did the Mantras of the .gveda, the Yajurveda, the Samaveda and the Atharva-veda.
verses.hindi: सत्त्वमात्रात्मिकामेव ततोऽन्यां जगृहे तनुम्। पितृवन्मन्यमानस्य पितरः सम्प्रजज्ञिरे तस्मादहर्देवतानां रात्रिः स्याद् देवविद्विषाम्। तयोर्मध्ये पितृणां तु मूर्तिः संध्या गरीयसी
verses.wordMeaning: Tajfia (the institution of sacrifice) came out of them and shone for the purpose of the protection of all Devas. So also did the Mantras of the .gveda, the Yajurveda, the Samaveda and the Atharva-veda.
verses.commentary: Sense: Tajfia (the institution of sacrifice) came out of them and shone for the purpose of the protection of all Devas. So also did the Mantras of the .gveda, the Yajurveda, the Samaveda and the Atharva-veda.

verses.sanskrit: ते ऽपरिग्राहिणः सर्वे संविभागरताः पुनः । खादनाश्चाप्यशीलाश्च भूताद्याः परिकीर्तिताः । इत्येते पञ्च कथिताः सर्गा वै द्विजपुङ्गवाः
verses.transliteration: te 'parigrāhiṇaḥ sarve saṃvibhāgaratāḥ punaḥ / khādanāścāpyaśīlāśca bhūtādyāḥ parikīrtitāḥ / ityete pañca kathitāḥ sargā vai dvijapuṅgavāḥ
verses.translation: This eternal and immutable Potency {£akli) is the natural form of Brahma. The Divine speech ( Vdk) which has no beginning or end, was created by the Self-born deity (Brahma).
verses.hindi: स्थानाभिमानियोंकी सर्जना कर पुनः सृष्टिके सहायकों-- वसिष्ठ, धर्म एवं संकल्पको उत्पन्न किया
verses.wordMeaning: This eternal and immutable Potency {£akli) is the natural form of Brahma. The Divine speech ( Vdk) which has no beginning or end, was created by the Self-born deity (Brahma).
verses.commentary: Sense: This eternal and immutable Potency {£akli) is the natural form of Brahma. The Divine speech ( Vdk) which has no beginning or end, was created by the Self-born deity (Brahma).

verses.sanskrit: प्रथमो महतः सर्गो विज्ञेयो ब्रह्मणस्तु सः । तन्मात्राणां द्वितीयस्तु भूतसर्गो हि स स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: prathamo mahataḥ sargo vijñeyo brahmaṇastu saḥ / tanmātrāṇāṃ dvitīyastu bhūtasargo hi sa smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Adharma (unrighteousness) acts as an obstacle in the observance of duties prescribed for one's caste and stage in life, O leading sages, thereby (spiritual) perfection and powers natural to them are not achieved easily by them.
verses.hindi: सभी लोकोंके पितामह ब्रह्मदेवने प्राण (वायु)-से दक्षको उत्पन्न किया, इसी प्रकार नेत्रोंसे मरीचि, सिरसे अङ्गिरा, हृदयसे भृगु, कानोंसे अत्रि नामवाले (ऋषि) - को, व्यवसायसे धर्मको और संकल्पसे संकल्पको तथा ऐसे ही उदान (वायु)-से पुलस्त्य, व्यान (वायु)-से पुलह मुनि, अपान (वायु)-से शान्त स्वभाव क्रतु और समान (वायु)-से वसिष्ठको उत्पन्न किया॥ ३४--३६ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Adharma (unrighteousness) acts as an obstacle in the observance of duties prescribed for one's caste and stage in life, O leading sages, thereby (spiritual) perfection and powers natural to them are not achieved easily by them.
verses.commentary: Sense: Adharma (unrighteousness) acts as an obstacle in the observance of duties prescribed for one's caste and stage in life, O leading sages, thereby (spiritual) perfection and powers natural to them are not achieved easily by them.

verses.sanskrit: वैकारिकस्तृतीयस्तु सर्ग ऐन्द्रियकः स्मृतः । इत्येष प्राकृतः सर्गः संभूतो ऽबुद्धिपूर्वकः
verses.transliteration: vaikārikastṛtīyastu sarga aindriyakaḥ smṛtaḥ / ityeṣa prākṛtaḥ sargaḥ saṃbhūto 'buddhipūrvakaḥ
verses.translation: Formerly Manu, son of the self-born deity (Brahma), enunciated the righteous duties of all persons as he was omnis¬ cient (lit. observer of everything). O Brahmanas, he was the very embodiment of Prajapati created by god Brahma himself.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्माके द्वारा उत्पन्न ये सभी गृहस्थ हैं तथा (सृष्टि- विस्तारके) सहयोगी हैं। मनुष्यका रूप धारणकर इन्होंने धर्मका प्रवर्तन किया। तदनन्तर देवता, असुर, पितर तथा मनुष्य-इन चारोंकी तथा जलकी सृष्टि करनेकी इच्छासे (ब्रह्माने) अपने-आपको नियुक्त किया
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly Manu, son of the self-born deity (Brahma), enunciated the righteous duties of all persons as he was omnis¬ cient (lit. observer of everything). O Brahmanas, he was the very embodiment of Prajapati created by god Brahma himself.
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly Manu, son of the self-born deity (Brahma), enunciated the righteous duties of all persons as he was omnis¬ cient (lit. observer of everything). O Brahmanas, he was the very embodiment of Prajapati created by god Brahma himself.

verses.sanskrit: मुख्यसर्गश्चतुर्थस्तु मुख्या वै स्थावराः स्मृताः । तिर्यक्स्त्रोतस्तु यः प्रोक्तस्तिर्यग्योन्यः स पञ्चमः
verses.transliteration: mukhyasargaścaturthastu mukhyā vai sthāvarāḥ smṛtāḥ / tiryakstrotastu yaḥ proktastiryagyonyaḥ sa pañcamaḥ
verses.translation: Chastisement of the subjects (i.e. the maintenance of law and order) and fighting with the enemies constitute the special Dharma of a Ksattriya while agriculture is the special occupation of a Vaisya. Rendering services to the twice-born castes (Brahmanas, Ksattriyas and Vaisyas) is the means of acquiring Dharma by Sudras.
verses.hindi: संयुक्त आत्मरूपवाले प्रजापतिसे तमोगुणकी मात्राका उद्रेक हुआ। तदनन्तर उनकी जंघासे पहले (तमोगुणी) असुर (योनिके) पुत्र उत्पन्न हुए। असुरोंकी सृष्टिकर पुरुषोत्तमने उस (तमोमय) शरीरका परित्याग कर दिया। उनके द्वारा छोड़ा गया वह शरीर शीप्र ही रात्रिके रूपमें परिवर्तित हो गया। वह (रात्रि) चूँकि अन्धकारकी अधिकतावाली रहती है, अतः उसमें (रात्रिमें) प्रजाएं सोती हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Chastisement of the subjects (i.e. the maintenance of law and order) and fighting with the enemies constitute the special Dharma of a Ksattriya while agriculture is the special occupation of a Vaisya. Rendering services to the twice-born castes (Brahmanas,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Chastisement of the subjects (i.e. the maintenance of law and order) and fighting with the enemies constitute the special Dharma of a Ksattriya while agriculture is the special occupation of a Vaisya. Rendering services to the twice-born castes (Brahmanas,…

verses.sanskrit: तथोर्ध्वस्त्रोतसां षष्ठो देवसर्गस्तु स स्मृतः । ततोर्ऽवाक्स्त्रोतसां सर्गः सप्तमः स तु मानुषः
verses.transliteration: tathordhvastrotasāṃ ṣaṣṭho devasargastu sa smṛtaḥ / tator'vākstrotasāṃ sargaḥ saptamaḥ sa tu mānuṣaḥ
verses.translation: Their means of livelihood is artisanship; their Tajha is whatever they cook righteously. Having established firmly the four classes of the society, he i.e. god Brahma established the four stages of life (Asramas) as well.
verses.hindi: (पुनः) देवने सत्त्वगुणात्मक दूसरे शरीरको धारण किया और तब उनके मुखसे दीप्तिमान् देवता प्रादुर्भूत हुए। उन्होंने (प्रजापतिने) वह शरीर भी छोड़ दिया। वह सत्त्वगुणकी अधिकतावाला शरीर दिन हुआ। धर्मात्मा शरीरको धारण किया। पिताके समान माननेवाले उनके द्वारा पितर उत्पन्न हुए। विश्वकी रचना करनेवाले उन्होंने (ब्रह्माने) पितरोंको सृष्टिकर उस शरीरको भी छोड़ दिया। वह छोड़ा गया शरीर शीघ्र ही संध्याके रूपमें
verses.wordMeaning: Their means of livelihood is artisanship; their Tajha is whatever they cook righteously. Having established firmly the four classes of the society, he i.e. god Brahma established the four stages of life (Asramas) as well.
verses.commentary: Sense: Their means of livelihood is artisanship; their Tajha is whatever they cook righteously. Having established firmly the four classes of the society, he i.e. god Brahma established the four stages of life (Asramas) as well.

verses.sanskrit: अष्टमो भौतिकः सर्गो भूतादीनां प्रकीर्तितः । नवमश्चैव कौमारः प्राकृता वैकृतास्त्विमे
verses.transliteration: aṣṭamo bhautikaḥ sargo bhūtādīnāṃ prakīrtitaḥ / navamaścaiva kaumāraḥ prākṛtā vaikṛtāstvime
verses.translation: He (a householder) is exempted from the above, only if he goes out to another land or when his wife dies. The householder is regarded as the source i. e. the supporter of the other Asramas.
verses.hindi: इसीलिये देवताओंके लिये दिन, देवविद्देषी असुरोंके लिये रात तथा दिन और रातके मध्यकी संध्या जो पितरोंकी मूर्तरूप है, वह प्रशस्त है तस्माद् देवासुराः सर्वे मनवो मानवास्तथा। उपासते सदा युक्ता रात्र््वोर्मध्यमां तनुम्
verses.wordMeaning: He (a householder) is exempted from the above, only if he goes out to another land or when his wife dies. The householder is regarded as the source i. e. the supporter of the other Asramas.
verses.commentary: Sense: He (a householder) is exempted from the above, only if he goes out to another land or when his wife dies. The householder is regarded as the source i. e. the supporter of the other Asramas.

verses.sanskrit: प्राकृतास्तु त्रयः पूर्वे सर्गास्ते ऽबुद्धिपूर्वकाः । बुद्धिपूर्वं प्रवर्तन्ते मुख्याद्या मुनिपुङ्गवाः
verses.transliteration: prākṛtāstu trayaḥ pūrve sargāste 'buddhipūrvakāḥ / buddhipūrvaṃ pravartante mukhyādyā munipuṅgavāḥ
verses.translation: All the other Asramas depend upon him for their subsistence. Hence the stage of a house-holder is regarded as the best of all. As indicated by Srutis, the house-holder's stage of life combines all the four Asramas in one.
verses.hindi: रजोमात्रात्मिका ब्रह्मा तनुमन्यामगृह्णत। ततोऽस्य जज्ञिरे पुत्रा मनुष्या रजसावृताः ततः स भगवान् ब्रह्मा सम्प्राप्य द्विजपुंगवाः । मूर्ति तमोरजःप्रायां पुनरेवाभ्ययूयुजत्
verses.wordMeaning: All the other Asramas depend upon him for their subsistence. Hence the stage of a house-holder is regarded as the best of all. As indicated by Srutis, the house-holder's stage of life combines all the four Asramas in one.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the other Asramas depend upon him for their subsistence. Hence the stage of a house-holder is regarded as the best of all. As indicated by Srutis, the house-holder's stage of life combines all the four Asramas in one.

verses.sanskrit: अग्रे ससर्ज वै ब्रह्मा मानसानात्मनः समान् । सनकं सनातनं चैव तथैव च सनन्दनम् । ऋभुं सनात्कुमारं च पूर्वमेव प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: agre sasarja vai brahmā mānasānātmanaḥ samān / sanakaṃ sanātanaṃ caiva tathaiva ca sanandanam / ṛbhuṃ sanātkumāraṃ ca pūrvameva prajāpatiḥ
verses.translation: Hence, the stage of a householder alone should be known as the only means of acquiring Dharma. One should eschew the.Artha (pursuit of wealth) and Kama (love making) that are devoid of righteousness.
verses.hindi: अन्धकारे क्षुधाविष्टा राक्षसास्तस्य जज्ञिरे। पुत्रास्तमोरजःप्राया बलिनस्ते निशाचराः अग्निष्टोमं च यज्ञानां निर्ममे प्रथमान्मुखात् ५४॥
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, the stage of a householder alone should be known as the only means of acquiring Dharma. One should eschew the.Artha (pursuit of wealth) and Kama (love making) that are devoid of righteousness.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, the stage of a householder alone should be known as the only means of acquiring Dharma. One should eschew the.Artha (pursuit of wealth) and Kama (love making) that are devoid of righteousness.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चैते योगिनो विप्राः परं वैराग्यमास्थिताः । ईश्वरासक्तमनसो न सृष्टौ दधिरे मतिम्
verses.transliteration: pañcaite yogino viprāḥ paraṃ vairāgyamāsthitāḥ / īśvarāsaktamanaso na sṛṣṭau dadhire matim
verses.translation: If a holy act is against the interest of other members of the society, it should not be practised. It is Dharma which is the source of Artha and even of Kama.
verses.hindi: इसीलिये देवता, असुर, (स्वायम्भुव आदि) सभी मनु तथा सभी मनुष्य दिन और रातके मध्यमें सदा स्थित रहनेवाले (संध्यारूपी ) शरीर (मूर्ति)-की उपासना करते हैं (तब) ब्रह्माने रजोगुणको अधिकतावाले अन्य शरीरको धारण किया, जिससे रजोगुणसे आवृत उनके पुत्र उत्पन्न हुए, जो मनुष्य कहलाये
verses.wordMeaning: If a holy act is against the interest of other members of the society, it should not be practised. It is Dharma which is the source of Artha and even of Kama.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a holy act is against the interest of other members of the society, it should not be practised. It is Dharma which is the source of Artha and even of Kama.

verses.sanskrit: तेष्वेवं निरपेक्षेषु लोकसृष्टौ प्रजापतिः । मुमोह मायया सद्यो मायिनः परमेष्ठिनः
verses.transliteration: teṣvevaṃ nirapekṣeṣu lokasṛṣṭau prajāpatiḥ / mumoha māyayā sadyo māyinaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ
verses.translation: The expounders of the Veda state that everything accrues from Dharma. The whole universe consisting of the mobile and immobile beings is sustained by Dharma.
verses.hindi: शरीरको भी छोड़ दिया। वह (छोड़ा गया शरीर) ज्योत्साके रूपमें हो गया, जिसे प्राक्संध्या कहा जाता है हे ब्राह्मणो! भगवान् ब्रह्मा फिर तम तथा रजोमयी मूर्ति (शरीर)-को धारण कर पुनः योगयुक्त हुए। इस शरीरसे अन्धकारमें भूखसे व्याकुल होनेवाले राक्षस पुत्र उत्पन्न हुए। तमोगुण तथा रजोगुणकी अधिकतावाले वे
verses.wordMeaning: The expounders of the Veda state that everything accrues from Dharma. The whole universe consisting of the mobile and immobile beings is sustained by Dharma.
verses.commentary: Sense: The expounders of the Veda state that everything accrues from Dharma. The whole universe consisting of the mobile and immobile beings is sustained by Dharma.

verses.sanskrit: तं बोधयामास सुतं जगन्मायो महामुनिः । नारायणो महायोगी योगिचित्तानुरञ्जनः
verses.transliteration: taṃ bodhayāmāsa sutaṃ jaganmāyo mahāmuniḥ / nārāyaṇo mahāyogī yogicittānurañjanaḥ
verses.translation: Such is the Potency or Sakti called Brdhmi, O
verses.hindi: महान् बलशाली पुत्र निशाचर कहलाये। ऐसे ही सर्प, यक्ष, भूत तथा गन्धर्व उत्पन्न हुए। तदनन्तर रजोगुण तथा तमोगुणसे आविष्ट अन्य प्राणियोंको भी प्रभुने उत्पन्न वयः (अवस्था) -से पक्षियोंको सृष्टि करनेके अनन्तर (ब्रह्माने) वक्षःस्थलसे भेड़ोंको उत्पन्न किया। मुखसे बकरोंको उत्पन्न किया और उदर-देशसे गौओंको सृष्टि की । पैरोंसे हाथियोंसहित घोड़ों, गदहों, गायके समान ही
verses.wordMeaning: Such is the Potency or Sakti called Brdhmi, O
verses.commentary: Sense: Such is the Potency or Sakti called Brdhmi, O

verses.sanskrit: बोधितस्तेन विश्वात्मा तताप परमं तपः । स तप्यमानो भगवान् न किञ्चित् प्रतिपद्यत
verses.transliteration: bodhitastena viśvātmā tatāpa paramaṃ tapaḥ / sa tapyamāno bhagavān na kiñcit pratipadyata
verses.translation: Hence, one should resort XaKarmayoga (the path of disinterested action) accompanied by Jndna (spiritual knowledge). The Vedic Karma is of two types, viz. the Praurtta [Karma that causes continuation in Sarhsdra) and the Nivrtta (Aama causing cessation of mundane existence).
verses.hindi: दूसरे प्रकारको गायों (नीलगाय आदि), मृगों, ऊँटों आदि) योनियोंको उत्पन्न किया । फल-मूलवाली ओषधियाँ उनके रोमोंसे पैदा हुई
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, one should resort XaKarmayoga (the path of disinterested action) accompanied by Jndna (spiritual knowledge). The Vedic Karma is of two types, viz. the Praurtta [Karma that causes continuation in Sarhsdra) and the Nivrtta (Aama causing cessation of mundane existence).
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, one should resort XaKarmayoga (the path of disinterested action) accompanied by Jndna (spiritual knowledge). The Vedic Karma is of two types, viz. the Praurtta [Karma that causes continuation in Sarhsdra) and the Nivrtta (Aama causing cessation of mundane existence).

verses.sanskrit: ततो दीर्घेण कालेन दुखात् क्रोधो व्यजायत । क्रोधाविष्टस्य नेत्राभ्यां प्रापतन्नश्रु बिन्दवः
verses.transliteration: tato dīrgheṇa kālena dukhāt krodho vyajāyata / krodhāviṣṭasya netrābhyāṃ prāpatannaśru bindavaḥ
verses.translation: The act which is based on spiritual knowledge is the Nivrtta Karma and that which is other than this, is called Pravrtta Karma. He who resorts to the Nivrtta type of Karma attains to the highest region viz. Moksa.
verses.hindi: (ब्रह्माजीने अपने) प्रथम (पूर्व) मुखसे गायत्री अग्निष्टोम (नामक यज्ञ)-को उत्पन्न किया। दक्षिण मुखसे यजुर्वेद, त्रिष्टभ् छन्द, पञ्चदश स्तोम (मन्त्रोंका
verses.wordMeaning: The act which is based on spiritual knowledge is the Nivrtta Karma and that which is other than this, is called Pravrtta Karma. He who resorts to the Nivrtta type of Karma attains to the highest region viz. Moksa.
verses.commentary: Sense: The act which is based on spiritual knowledge is the Nivrtta Karma and that which is other than this, is called Pravrtta Karma. He who resorts to the Nivrtta type of Karma attains to the highest region viz. Moksa.

verses.sanskrit: भ्रुकुटीकुटिलात् तस्य ललाटात् परमेश्वरः । समुत्पन्नो महादेवः शरण्यो नीललोहितः
verses.transliteration: bhrukuṭīkuṭilāt tasya lalāṭāt parameśvaraḥ / samutpanno mahādevaḥ śaraṇyo nīlalohitaḥ
verses.translation: I am protecting this universe, the trident-bearing Lord (Siva) will annihilate it. Brahma, Visnu and Mahesvara are mentioned as three Murtis (forms of the Supreme Self).
verses.hindi: का सृजन किया। पश्चिम मुखसे सामवेद, जगती छन्द, सप्तदश स्तोम (मन्त्रॉंका समूह-विशेष) और वैरूप तथा अतिरात्र नामक यज्ञोंको उत्पन्न किया। उत्तर मुखसे इक्कीस शाखाओंवाले अथर्ववेद, अनुष्टुप् छन्द और आप्तोर्याम तथा वैराज (नामक यज्ञ)-को उत्पन्न
verses.wordMeaning: I am protecting this universe, the trident-bearing Lord (Siva) will annihilate it. Brahma, Visnu and Mahesvara are mentioned as three Murtis (forms of the Supreme Self).
verses.commentary: Sense: I am protecting this universe, the trident-bearing Lord (Siva) will annihilate it. Brahma, Visnu and Mahesvara are mentioned as three Murtis (forms of the Supreme Self).

verses.sanskrit: स एव भगवानीशस्तेजोराशिः सनातनः । यं प्रपश्यन्ति विद्वांसः स्वात्मस्थं परमेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: sa eva bhagavānīśastejorāśiḥ sanātanaḥ / yaṃ prapaśyanti vidvāṃsaḥ svātmasthaṃ parameśvaram
verses.translation: Due to their being characterised by the Gums — Rajas, Sattva and Tamas, they are mutually affectionate and inter-depen¬ dent. All of them are but the manifestation of the great Supreme Atman.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मणो हि प्रजासर्ग सृजतस्तु प्रजापतेः सृष्टा चतुष्टयं सर्ग देवर्षिपितृमानुषम्। ततोऽसृजच्य भूतानि स्थावराणि चराणि च
verses.wordMeaning: Due to their being characterised by the Gums — Rajas, Sattva and Tamas, they are mutually affectionate and inter-depen¬ dent. All of them are but the manifestation of the great Supreme Atman.
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to their being characterised by the Gums — Rajas, Sattva and Tamas, they are mutually affectionate and inter-depen¬ dent. All of them are but the manifestation of the great Supreme Atman.

verses.sanskrit: ओङ्कारं समनुस्मृत्य प्रणम्य च कृताञ्जलिः । ताम भगवान् ब्रह्मा सृजेमा विविधाः प्रजाः
verses.transliteration: oṅkāraṃ samanusmṛtya praṇamya ca kṛtāñjaliḥ / tāma bhagavān brahmā sṛjemā vividhāḥ prajāḥ
verses.translation: There are three ASramas called Vaisnava, (per¬ taining to Visnu), Brahma (pertaining to Brahma) and Hard§- rama (pertaining to Siva). He who wears the various symbols (pertaining to a particular god) invariably endears himself to his devotees.
verses.hindi: तेषां ये यानि कर्माणि प्राक्सृष्टौ प्रतिपेदिरे । हिंस्त्राहिंस्त्रे मृदुक्रूरे धर्माधर्मावृतानृते। तद्भाविताः प्रपद्यन्ते तस्मात् तत् तस्य रोचते
verses.wordMeaning: There are three ASramas called Vaisnava, (per¬ taining to Visnu), Brahma (pertaining to Brahma) and Hard§- rama (pertaining to Siva). He who wears the various symbols (pertaining to a particular god) invariably endears himself to his devotees.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are three ASramas called Vaisnava, (per¬ taining to Visnu), Brahma (pertaining to Brahma) and Hard§- rama (pertaining to Siva). He who wears the various symbols (pertaining to a particular god) invariably endears himself to his devotees.

verses.sanskrit: निशम्य भगवान् वाक्यं शङ्करो धर्मवाहनः । स्वात्मना सद्शान् रुद्रान् ससर्ज मनसा शिवः । कपर्दिनो निरातङ्कांस्त्रिनेत्रान् नीललोहितान्
verses.transliteration: niśamya bhagavān vākyaṃ śaṅkaro dharmavāhanaḥ / svātmanā sadśān rudrān sasarja manasā śivaḥ / kapardino nirātaṅkāṃstrinetrān nīlalohitān
verses.translation: One who is devoted to Brahma-vidya should meditate and worship these. The Linga of Sambhu is the most excellent for all devotees.
verses.hindi: प्रजापति ब्रह्माके द्वारा प्रजाओंकी सृष्टि करते समय उनके शरीरसे उच्च एवं निम्न (कोटिके अन्य भी) प्राणियोंकी सृष्टि हुई। देवता, ऋषि, पितर तथा मनुष्य--इन चार प्रकारको सृष्टि करके (ब्रह्माने) चर तथा अचर (सभी) प्राणियोंकी सृष्टि की
verses.wordMeaning: One who is devoted to Brahma-vidya should meditate and worship these. The Linga of Sambhu is the most excellent for all devotees.
verses.commentary: Sense: One who is devoted to Brahma-vidya should meditate and worship these. The Linga of Sambhu is the most excellent for all devotees.

verses.sanskrit: तं प्राह भगवान् ब्रह्मा जन्ममृत्युयुताः प्रजाः । सृजेति सो ऽब्रवीदीशो नाहं मृत्युजरान्विताः । प्रजाः स्त्रक्ष्ये जगन्नाथ सृज त्वमशुभाः प्रजाः
verses.transliteration: taṃ prāha bhagavān brahmā janmamṛtyuyutāḥ prajāḥ / sṛjeti so 'bravīdīśo nāhaṃ mṛtyujarānvitāḥ / prajāḥ strakṣye jagannātha sṛja tvamaśubhāḥ prajāḥ
verses.translation: By wearing the Tripundra mark with its upper and lower parallels what is Pradhana is worn—the Pradhana that consists of three Gums in the form of Brahma, Visnu and Siva. There is no doubt that they are so worn by the mark of trident.
verses.hindi: सर्पोको उत्पन्न किया। नित्य एवं अनित्य-भेदसे चर एवं अचर सृष्टि दो प्रकारकी है। पहलेकी सृष्टियोंमें उन (प्राणियों)-के जो-जो कर्म निश्चित थे अगली सृष्टियोंमें भी उत्पन्न होकर वे बार-बार उन्हीं कर्माको प्राप्त करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: By wearing the Tripundra mark with its upper and lower parallels what is Pradhana is worn—the Pradhana that consists of three Gums in the form of Brahma, Visnu and Siva. There is no doubt that they are so worn by the mark of trident.
verses.commentary: Sense: By wearing the Tripundra mark with its upper and lower parallels what is Pradhana is worn—the Pradhana that consists of three Gums in the form of Brahma, Visnu and Siva. There is no doubt that they are so worn by the mark of trident.

verses.sanskrit: निवार्य च तदा रुद्रं ससर्ज कमलोद्भवः । स्थानाभिमानिनः सर्वान् गदतस्तान् निबोधत
verses.transliteration: nivārya ca tadā rudraṃ sasarja kamalodbhavaḥ / sthānābhimāninaḥ sarvān gadatastān nibodhata
verses.translation: Quoted in the SC in Ahnika prakaratria, and in the Viramitrodaya (VM) Tirtha-prakaia,
verses.hindi: इसीलिये उसी प्रकारकी भावना (संस्कार)-से प्रेरित होकर (वे प्राणी) हिंसक, अहिंसक, कोमल, क्रूर, धर्म-अधर्म तथा सत्य एवं असत्यकी प्रवृत्तियाँ प्राप्त करते हैं और वही (कर्म) उन्हें रुचिकर भी विधाताने स्वयं ही प्राणियोंकी इन्द्रियोंके विषयों, महाभूतों एवं मूर्तियोंमें भिन्नता और विनियोगकी व्यवस्था की है । उन महे धरने प्रारम्भमें वेदके शब्दोंसे ही प्राणियोंके नाम और रूप तथा कर्माकी विविधताका
verses.wordMeaning: Quoted in the SC in Ahnika prakaratria, and in the Viramitrodaya (VM) Tirtha-prakaia,
verses.commentary: Sense: Quoted in the SC in Ahnika prakaratria, and in the Viramitrodaya (VM) Tirtha-prakaia,

verses.sanskrit: अपो ऽग्निरन्तरिक्षं च द्यौर्वायुः पृथिवी तथा । नद्यः समुद्राः शैलाश्च वृक्षा वीरुध एव च
verses.transliteration: apo 'gnirantarikṣaṃ ca dyaurvāyuḥ pṛthivī tathā / nadyaḥ samudrāḥ śailāśca vṛkṣā vīrudha eva ca
verses.translation: Quoted in VM. Tirtha.,
verses.hindi: निर्माण किया। वेदोंमें जिन सिद्धान्तों और आर्ष नामोंका प्रतिपादन हुआ है, उन्हीं नामोंको ब्रह्मा (प्रलयकालीन) रात्रिके अन्तमें उत्पन्न पदार्थांको प्रदान करते हें ॥ ६३--६५॥ प्रलयकालसे पूर्व जो ऋतुएँ और ऋतुओंके चिह्न तथा अनेक प्रकारके रूप (आकार) दिखलायी देते थे, अगले युगोंमें वे उन्ही-उन्हीं (नाम-रूपों तथा) भावोंमें प्रकट होकर दिखलायी देते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Quoted in VM. Tirtha.,
verses.commentary: Sense: Quoted in VM. Tirtha.,

verses.sanskrit: लवाः काष्ठाः कलाश्चैव मुहूर्ता दिवसाः क्षपाः । अर्धमासाश्च मासाश्च अयनाब्दयुगादयः
verses.transliteration: lavāḥ kāṣṭhāḥ kalāścaiva muhūrtā divasāḥ kṣapāḥ / ardhamāsāśca māsāśca ayanābdayugādayaḥ
verses.translation: Quoted in Hemadri's CC Kdla-nirnaya,
verses.hindi: सृष्टि-वर्णनमें ब्रह्माजीसे मनु और शतरूपाका प्रादुर्भाव, स्वायम्भुव मनुके वंशका वर्णन, दक्ष प्रजापतिकी कन्याओंका वर्णन तथा उनका विवाह, धर्म तथा अधर्मको संतानोंका विवरण तमोमात्रावृतो ब्रह्मा तदाशोचत दुःखितः । ततः स विदधे बुद्धिमर्थनिश्चयगामिनीम्
verses.wordMeaning: Quoted in Hemadri's CC Kdla-nirnaya,
verses.commentary: Sense: Quoted in Hemadri's CC Kdla-nirnaya,

verses.sanskrit: स्थानाबिमानिनः सृष्ट्वा साधकानसृजत् पुनः । मरीचिभृग्वङ्गिरसं पुलस्त्यं पुलहं क्रतुम् । दक्षमत्रिं वसिष्ठं च धर्मं संकल्पमेव च
verses.transliteration: sthānābimāninaḥ sṛṣṭvā sādhakānasṛjat punaḥ / marīcibhṛgvaṅgirasaṃ pulastyaṃ pulahaṃ kratum / dakṣamatriṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ ca dharmaṃ saṃkalpameva ca
verses.translation: Quoted with some changes in CC Kdla-nirnaya,
verses.hindi: अथात्मनि समनद्राक्षीत् तमोमात्रां नियामिकाम्। रजःसत्त्वं च संवृत्य वर्तमानां स्वधर्मतः अधर्माचरणो विप्रा हिंसा चाशुभलक्षणा। स्वां तनुं स ततो ब्रह्मा तामपोहत भास्वराम्
verses.wordMeaning: Quoted with some changes in CC Kdla-nirnaya,
verses.commentary: Sense: Quoted with some changes in CC Kdla-nirnaya,

verses.sanskrit: प्राणाद् ब्रह्मासृजद् दक्षं चक्षुषश्च मरीचिनम् । शिरसो ऽङ्गिरसं देवो हृदयाद् भृगुमेव च
verses.transliteration: prāṇād brahmāsṛjad dakṣaṃ cakṣuṣaśca marīcinam / śiraso 'ṅgirasaṃ devo hṛdayād bhṛgumeva ca
verses.translation: But normally an intelligent Brahmana house-holder shall not renounce by eschewing house-holder's life without duly performing sacrifices, and without procreating sons.
verses.hindi: द्विधाकरोत् पुनर्देहमर्धन पुरुघोऽभवत्। स्वायम्भुवो मनुर्देवः सोऽभवत् पुरुषो मुनि: । सा देवी शतरूपाख्या तपः कृत्वा सुदुश्चरम्
verses.wordMeaning: But normally an intelligent Brahmana house-holder shall not renounce by eschewing house-holder's life without duly performing sacrifices, and without procreating sons.
verses.commentary: Sense: But normally an intelligent Brahmana house-holder shall not renounce by eschewing house-holder's life without duly performing sacrifices, and without procreating sons.

verses.sanskrit: श्रोत्राभ्यामत्रिनामानं धर्मं च व्यवसायतः । संकल्पं चैव संकल्पात् सर्वलोकपितामहः
verses.transliteration: śrotrābhyāmatrināmānaṃ dharmaṃ ca vyavasāyataḥ / saṃkalpaṃ caiva saṃkalpāt sarvalokapitāmahaḥ
verses.translation: But, however, if due to the force of growing sense of detachment, he does not feel inclined to lead the life of the house-holder, the spiritually wise excellent Brahmana should renounce then and there his house-holdership, even without performing sacrifices.
verses.hindi: भर्तारं ब्रह्मणः पुत्रं मनुमेवान्वपद्यत। तस्माच्च शतरूपा सा पुत्रद्वयमसूयत श्रीकूर्मने कहा--इस प्रकार स्थावर तथा जङ्गम प्राणियोंकी सृष्टि हुई, किंतु जब उन बुद्धिमान् (ब्रह्मा)- द्वारा उत्पन्न की गयी प्रजाओंमें वृद्धि नहीं हुई, तब तमोगुणकी अधिकतासे आवृत ब्रह्मा दु:खी होकर चिन्ता
verses.wordMeaning: But, however, if due to the force of growing sense of detachment, he does not feel inclined to lead the life of the house-holder, the spiritually wise excellent Brahmana should renounce then and there his house-holdership, even without performing sacrifices.
verses.commentary: Sense: But, however, if due to the force of growing sense of detachment, he does not feel inclined to lead the life of the house-holder, the spiritually wise excellent Brahmana should renounce then and there his house-holdership, even without performing sacrifices.

verses.sanskrit: पुलस्त्यं च तथोदानाद् व्यनाच्च पुलहं मुनिम् । अपानात् क्रतुमव्यग्रं समानाच्च वसिष्ठकम्
verses.transliteration: pulastyaṃ ca tathodānād vyanācca pulahaṃ munim / apānāt kratumavyagraṃ samānācca vasiṣṭhakam
verses.translation: Still (the best course is) after performing various kinds of sacrifices, one should take to the life of a forest hermit and perform penance. Thereafter, becoming completely detached by virtue of his penance, he should renounce (as a Tati).2
verses.hindi: करने लगे और फिर उन्होंने अर्थका निश्चय करनेवाली बुद्धिको ग्रहण किया तदनन्तर उन्होंने स्वधर्मानुसार रजोगुण एवं सत्त्वगुणको आवृत कर स्थित रहनेवाली तथा (कर्मको) नियामिका (तमोवृत्ति)-को अपनी आत्मामें देखा । तत्पश्चात् सत्त्वगुणसे संयुक्त रजोगुणने उस तमोगुणको दूर किया और दूर
verses.wordMeaning: Still (the best course is) after performing various kinds of sacrifices, one should take to the life of a forest hermit and perform penance. Thereafter, becoming completely detached by virtue of his penance, he should renounce (as a Tati).2
verses.commentary: Sense: Still (the best course is) after performing various kinds of sacrifices, one should take to the life of a forest hermit and perform penance. Thereafter, becoming completely detached by virtue of his penance, he should renounce (as a Tati).2

verses.sanskrit: इत्येते ब्रह्मणा सृष्टाः साधका गृहमेधिनः । आस्थाय मानवं रूपं धर्मस्तैः संप्रवर्तितः
verses.transliteration: ityete brahmaṇā sṛṣṭāḥ sādhakā gṛhamedhinaḥ / āsthāya mānavaṃ rūpaṃ dharmastaiḥ saṃpravartitaḥ
verses.translation: Once a householder goes out of his household (renouncing his stage of life as a householder) and resorts to the stage of a forest-dweller {Vdnaprastha), he shall not re-enter the house-holder's stage, nor an ascetic {Sannyasin) go back to the life of a forest-hermit, nor should a Sadhaka householder revert to the life of a religious student.
verses.hindi: हुआ वह तम दो भागोंमें विभक्त हो गया हे ब्राह्मणो! (इस प्रकार दो भागोंमें विभक्त हुए तमसे) अधर्माचरण और अशुभ लक्षणोंवाली हिंसा उत्पन्न हुई। तब ब्रह्माजीने अपने उस प्रकाशमान शरीरको छोड़ दिया
verses.wordMeaning: Once a householder goes out of his household (renouncing his stage of life as a householder) and resorts to the stage of a forest-dweller {Vdnaprastha), he shall not re-enter the house-holder's stage, nor an ascetic {Sannyasin) go back to the life of a forest-hermit,…
