verses.commentary: Sense: Once a householder goes out of his household (renouncing his stage of life as a householder) and resorts to the stage of a forest-dweller {Vdnaprastha), he shall not re-enter the house-holder's stage, nor an ascetic {Sannyasin) go back to the life of a forest-hermit,…

verses.sanskrit: ततो देवासुरपितृन् मनुष्यांश्च चतुष्टयम् । सिसृक्षुरम्भांस्येतानि स्वमात्मानमयूयुजत्
verses.transliteration: tato devāsurapitṛn manuṣyāṃśca catuṣṭayam / sisṛkṣurambhāṃsyetāni svamātmānamayūyujat
verses.translation: A Brahmana should complete the sacrifice called Prdjdpatya or Agneyi and then renounce. The scholarly house¬ holder should renounce through the stage of a forest dweller, in accordance with the injunctions of the Sruti.
verses.hindi: पुनः (पुरातन) पुरुष प्रभुने अपने शरीरको दो भागोंमें बाँटा। आधेसे पुरुष हुआ और आधेसे नारी। तत्पश्चात् (उन्होंने) विराट् पुरुषको उत्पन्न किया नारीको बनाया, वह पृथिवी-लोक तथा द्युलोकको अपनी महिमासे व्याप्तकर प्रतिष्ठित हुई
verses.wordMeaning: A Brahmana should complete the sacrifice called Prdjdpatya or Agneyi and then renounce. The scholarly house¬ holder should renounce through the stage of a forest dweller, in accordance with the injunctions of the Sruti.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmana should complete the sacrifice called Prdjdpatya or Agneyi and then renounce. The scholarly house¬ holder should renounce through the stage of a forest dweller, in accordance with the injunctions of the Sruti.

verses.sanskrit: युक्तात्मनस्तमोमात्रा उद्रिक्ताभूत् प्रजापतेः । ततो ऽस्य जघनात् पूर्वमसुरा जज्ञिरे सुताः
verses.transliteration: yuktātmanastamomātrā udriktābhūt prajāpateḥ / tato 'sya jaghanāt pūrvamasurā jajñire sutāḥ
verses.translation: One who is incapable of performing a //bma and sacrificial rites, physically handicapped persons like a blind man or a lame man, or an indigent Brahmana, if detached, should renounce as a Sannydsin.
verses.hindi: (वह शतरूपा नामवाली नारी) योगके ऐश्वर्य एवं बलसे सम्पन्न तथा ज्ञान-विज्ञानसे युक्त थी। (और) जो पुरुषसे अव्यक्तजन्मा ब्रह्माका विराट् नामक पुत्र उत्पन्न हुआ, वह देवपुरुष मुनि स्वायम्भुव मनुके रूपमें प्रसिद्ध हुआ। शतरूपा नामवाली उस देवीने अत्यन्त कठोर तप करके ब्रह्माजीके पुत्र (स्वायम्भुव) मनुको ही (अपना) पति बनाया और शतरूपाने उनसे (मनुसे) दो पुत्र
verses.wordMeaning: One who is incapable of performing a //bma and sacrificial rites, physically handicapped persons like a blind man or a lame man, or an indigent Brahmana, if detached, should renounce as a Sannydsin.
verses.commentary: Sense: One who is incapable of performing a //bma and sacrificial rites, physically handicapped persons like a blind man or a lame man, or an indigent Brahmana, if detached, should renounce as a Sannydsin.

verses.sanskrit: उत्ससर्जासुरान् सृष्ट्वा तां तनुं पुरुषोत्तमः । सा चोत्सृष्टा तनुस्तेन सद्यो रात्रिरजायत । सा तमोबहुला यस्मात् प्रजास्तस्यांस्वपन्त्यतः
verses.transliteration: utsasarjāsurān sṛṣṭvā tāṃ tanuṃ puruṣottamaḥ / sā cotsṛṣṭā tanustena sadyo rātrirajāyata / sā tamobahulā yasmāt prajāstasyāṃsvapantyataḥ
verses.translation: In the matter of renouncing by any one, the main reason should be Vairdgya (dispassion). Ifone wishes to renounce without being detached, he falls indeed.*
verses.hindi: (इनके अतिरिक्त) दो श्रेष्ठ कन्याएँ भी हुई। उन दो कन्याओंमेंसे स्वायम्भुव मनुने प्रसूति नामक एक कन्या दक्ष प्रजापतिको प्रदान की यज्ञश्च दक्षिणा चैव याभ्यां संवर्धितं जगत्
verses.wordMeaning: In the matter of renouncing by any one, the main reason should be Vairdgya (dispassion). Ifone wishes to renounce without being detached, he falls indeed.*
verses.commentary: Sense: In the matter of renouncing by any one, the main reason should be Vairdgya (dispassion). Ifone wishes to renounce without being detached, he falls indeed.*

verses.sanskrit: सत्त्वमात्रत्मिकां देवस्तनुमन्यामगृह्णत । ततो ऽस्य मुखतो देवा दीव्यतः संप्रजज्ञिरे
verses.transliteration: sattvamātratmikāṃ devastanumanyāmagṛhṇata / tato 'sya mukhato devā dīvyataḥ saṃprajajñire
verses.translation: Or, if a faithful person continues to remain in one ASrama (throughout his life) till death, he is entitled for eternity or Mok?a.
verses.hindi: यज्ञस्य दक्षिणायां तु पुत्रा द्वादश जज्तिरे। यामा इति समाख्याता देवाः स्वायम्भुवेऽन्तरे बुद्धिर्लजा वपुः शान्तिः सिद्धिः कीर्तिस्त्रयोदशी
verses.wordMeaning: Or, if a faithful person continues to remain in one ASrama (throughout his life) till death, he is entitled for eternity or Mok?a.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or, if a faithful person continues to remain in one ASrama (throughout his life) till death, he is entitled for eternity or Mok?a.

verses.sanskrit: त्यक्ता सापि तनुस्तेन सत्त्वप्रायमभूद् दिनम् । तस्मादहो धर्मयुक्ता देवताः समुपासते
verses.transliteration: tyaktā sāpi tanustena sattvaprāyamabhūd dinam / tasmādaho dharmayuktā devatāḥ samupāsate
verses.translation: A person who earns wealth by honest, justifiable means {v.l. one who has given away all his wealth in charity), a quiescent person devoted to Brahma-vidya and the person who strictly observes his religious duties, becomes entitled to attain identity with the Brahman.
verses.hindi: पल्यर्थ प्रतिजग्राह धर्मो दाक्षायणीः शुभाः । ताभ्यः शिष्टा यवीयस्य एकादश सुलोचनाः भृगुर्भवो मरीचिश्च तथा चैवाङ्गिरा मुनिः । पुलस्त्यः पुलहश्चैव क्रतुः परमधर्मवित्
verses.wordMeaning: A person who earns wealth by honest, justifiable means {v.l. one who has given away all his wealth in charity), a quiescent person devoted to Brahma-vidya and the person who strictly observes his religious duties, becomes entitled to attain identity with the Brahman.
verses.commentary: Sense: A person who earns wealth by honest, justifiable means {v.l. one who has given away all his wealth in charity), a quiescent person devoted to Brahma-vidya and the person who strictly observes his religious duties, becomes entitled to attain identity with the Brahman.

verses.sanskrit: सत्त्वमात्रात्मिकामेव ततो ऽन्यां जगृहे तनुम् । पितृवन्मन्यमानस्य पितरः संप्रजज्ञिरे
verses.transliteration: sattvamātrātmikāmeva tato 'nyāṃ jagṛhe tanum / pitṛvanmanyamānasya pitaraḥ saṃprajajñire
verses.translation: A person who resigns all his actions to the Brahman, who is free from attachment, who is devoid of passion of love and who performs his essential righteous duties with a delighted heart, shall attain to the region oiBrahman.
verses.hindi: अत्रिर्वसिष्ठो वह्निश्च पितरश्च यथाक्रमम्। ख्यात्याद्या जगृहुः कन्या मुनयो मुनिसत्तमाः १९ ॥ श्रद्धया आत्मजः कामो दर्पो लक्ष्मीसुतः स्मृतः ।
verses.wordMeaning: A person who resigns all his actions to the Brahman, who is free from attachment, who is devoid of passion of love and who performs his essential righteous duties with a delighted heart, shall attain to the region oiBrahman.
verses.commentary: Sense: A person who resigns all his actions to the Brahman, who is free from attachment, who is devoid of passion of love and who performs his essential righteous duties with a delighted heart, shall attain to the region oiBrahman.

verses.sanskrit: उत्ससर्ज पितृन् सृष्ट्वा ततस्तामपि विश्वसृक् । सापविद्धा तनुस्तेन सद्यः सन्ध्या व्यजायत
verses.transliteration: utsasarja pitṛn sṛṣṭvā tatastāmapi viśvasṛk / sāpaviddhā tanustena sadyaḥ sandhyā vyajāyata
verses.translation: Whatever is there to be given is given by Brahman, everything that is donated is also the Brahman, and it is the Brahman that is given—this is called the highest type of dedica¬ tion unto Brahman {Brahmdrpana)
verses.hindi: यशः कीर्तिसुतस्तद्वदित्येते धर्मसूनवः कामस्य हर्षः पुत्रोऽभूद् देवानन्दो व्यजायत। इत्येष वै सुखोदर्कः सर्गो धर्मस्य कीर्तितः
verses.wordMeaning: Whatever is there to be given is given by Brahman, everything that is donated is also the Brahman, and it is the Brahman that is given—this is called the highest type of dedica¬ tion unto Brahman {Brahmdrpana)
verses.commentary: Sense: Whatever is there to be given is given by Brahman, everything that is donated is also the Brahman, and it is the Brahman that is given—this is called the highest type of dedica¬ tion unto Brahman {Brahmdrpana)

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादहर्देवतानां रात्रिः स्याद् देवविद्विषाम् । तयोर्मध्ये पितॄणां तु मूर्तिः सन्ध्या गरीयसी
verses.transliteration: tasmādahardevatānāṃ rātriḥ syād devavidviṣām / tayormadhye pitṝṇāṃ tu mūrtiḥ sandhyā garīyasī
verses.translation: "I am not the agent or the doer, it is the Brahman alone that makes everything"—this attitude is called Brahmdrpana by sages who visualise the reality.
verses.hindi: जज्ञे हिंसा त्वधर्माद् निकृतिं चानृतं सुतम्। निकृत्यनृतयोर्जज्ञे भयं नरक एव च आकूति नामक दूसरी कन्याको (ब्रह्माजीके) मानस
verses.wordMeaning: "I am not the agent or the doer, it is the Brahman alone that makes everything"—this attitude is called Brahmdrpana by sages who visualise the reality.
verses.commentary: Sense: "I am not the agent or the doer, it is the Brahman alone that makes everything"—this attitude is called Brahmdrpana by sages who visualise the reality.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद् देवासुराः सर्वे मनवो मानवास्तथा । उपासते तदा युक्ता रात्र्यह्नोर्मध्यमां तनुम्
verses.transliteration: tasmād devāsurāḥ sarve manavo mānavāstathā / upāsate tadā yuktā rātryahnormadhyamāṃ tanum
verses.translation: "May the eternal Lord Isa be pleased by means of this rite." He who thinks like this, makes the great dedication of Brahmdrparia.
verses.hindi: प्रजापतिने आकूतिसे दो संतानें प्राप्त कौं--यज्ञ और दक्षिणा, जिनसे संसार वृद्धिको प्राप्त हुआ यज्ञके दक्षिणासे बारह पुत्र उत्पन्न हुए जो स्वायम्भुव मन्वन्तरमें 'याम' इस नामसे प्रसिद्ध देवता हुए और दक्ष प्रजापतिने प्रसूतिसे चौबीस कन्याओंको उत्पन्न किया, उनके नामोंको भलीभाँति सुनो-(वे हैं--) श्रद्धा, लक्ष्मी,
verses.wordMeaning: "May the eternal Lord Isa be pleased by means of this rite." He who thinks like this, makes the great dedication of Brahmdrparia.
verses.commentary: Sense: "May the eternal Lord Isa be pleased by means of this rite." He who thinks like this, makes the great dedication of Brahmdrparia.

verses.sanskrit: रजोमात्रात्मिकां ब्रह्मा तनुमन्यामगृह्णत । ततो ऽस्य जज्ञिरे पुत्रा मनुष्या रजसावृताः
verses.transliteration: rajomātrātmikāṃ brahmā tanumanyāmagṛhṇata / tato 'sya jajñire putrā manuṣyā rajasāvṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Or, the dedication of fruits of all actions unto the Supreme Lord is called the greatest dedication of Karmas. It is the excellent Brahmdrpana.
verses.hindi: सिद्धि तथा तेरहवीं कन्याका नाम है कीर्ति॥ १३--१५॥ दक्ष प्रजापतिकी इन (तेरह दाक्षायणी) मङ्गलमयी कन्याओंको धर्मने पलीरूपमें ग्रहण किया। उन (तेरह कन्याओं)-के अतिरिक्त इनसे सुन्दर आँखोंवाली दक्षकी ग्यारह, अवस्थामें छोटी कन्याएँ और थीं (जिनके नाम हैं-) ख्याति, सती, सम्भूति, स्मृति, प्रीति, क्षमा, संतति, अनसूया, ऊर्जा, स्वाहा तथा स्वधा
verses.wordMeaning: Or, the dedication of fruits of all actions unto the Supreme Lord is called the greatest dedication of Karmas. It is the excellent Brahmdrpana.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or, the dedication of fruits of all actions unto the Supreme Lord is called the greatest dedication of Karmas. It is the excellent Brahmdrpana.

verses.sanskrit: तामप्याशु स तत्याज तनुं सद्यः प्रजापतिः । ज्योत्स्त्रा सा चाभवद्विप्राः प्राक्सन्ध्या याबिधीयते
verses.transliteration: tāmapyāśu sa tatyāja tanuṃ sadyaḥ prajāpatiḥ / jyotstrā sā cābhavadviprāḥ prāksandhyā yābidhīyate
verses.translation: An action performed by a discriminating learned person may be even the bestower of salvation, if it is performed regularly without attachment with the belief that it is binding upon him that he should do it.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! ख्याति, सती आदि जो (ग्यारह) कन्याएँ थीं, उन्हें क्रमशः भृगु, मरीचि, अङ्गिरा मुनि, पुलस्त्य, पुलह, परम धर्मज्ञ क्रतु, अत्रि, वसिष्ठ नामक मुनियों, अग्निदेव और पितरोंने ग्रहण किया श्रद्धाका पुत्र ' काम' तथा लक्ष्मीका पुत्र “दर्प ' नामसे कहा जाता है  धृतिका 'नियम' नामक पुत्र तथा तुष्टिका (पुत्र) 'संतोष' कहलाता है
verses.wordMeaning: An action performed by a discriminating learned person may be even the bestower of salvation, if it is performed regularly without attachment with the belief that it is binding upon him that he should do it.
verses.commentary: Sense: An action performed by a discriminating learned person may be even the bestower of salvation, if it is performed regularly without attachment with the belief that it is binding upon him that he should do it.

verses.sanskrit: ततः स भगवान् ब्रह्मा संप्राप्य द्विजपुङ्गवाः । मूर्ति तमोरजः प्रायां पुनरेवाभ्ययूयुजत्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa bhagavān brahmā saṃprāpya dvijapuṅgavāḥ / mūrti tamorajaḥ prāyāṃ punarevābhyayūyujat
verses.translation: Or, if a Brahmana performs even his daily prescribed righteous duties (like the daily Sandhyd prayers etc.) without dedicating the fruit thereof to the Lord, he is fettered by its fruit.
verses.hindi: पुष्टिका पुत्र 'लाभ' और मेधाका पुत्र ' श्रुत' हुआ। क्रियाका पुत्र 'दण्ड' हुआ और वही 'समय' भी कहलाता है। बुद्धिसे 'बोध' नामक पुत्र और उसी प्रकार 'अप्रमाद' नामक पुत्र भी हुआ। लज्जाका “विनय' नामक पुत्र और वपुका 'व्यवसायक' हुआ। ' क्षेम' शान्तिका पुत्र और 'सुख' सिद्धिका पुत्र हुआ। इसी प्रकार कोर्तिका ' यश' नामक पुत्र हुआ। ये सभी धर्मके पुत्र हुए। कामका 'हर्ष' नामक पुत्र हुआ, जो
verses.wordMeaning: Or, if a Brahmana performs even his daily prescribed righteous duties (like the daily Sandhyd prayers etc.) without dedicating the fruit thereof to the Lord, he is fettered by its fruit.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or, if a Brahmana performs even his daily prescribed righteous duties (like the daily Sandhyd prayers etc.) without dedicating the fruit thereof to the Lord, he is fettered by its fruit.

verses.sanskrit: अन्धकारे क्षुधाविष्टा राक्षसास्तस्य जज्ञिरे । पुत्रास्तमोरजः प्राया बलिनस्ते निशाचराः
verses.transliteration: andhakāre kṣudhāviṣṭā rākṣasāstasya jajñire / putrāstamorajaḥ prāyā balinaste niśācarāḥ
verses.translation: Or, if a Brahmana performs even his daily prescribed righteous duties (like the daily Sandhyd prayers etc.) without dedicating the fruit thereof to the Lord, he is fettered by its fruit.
verses.hindi: धर्मकी सुखदायक सृष्टि कहलाती है अधर्मसे हिंसाने निकृति तथा अनृत नामक पुत्रको उत्पन्न किया। निकृति और अनृतसे भय तथा नरक नामक पुत्र उत्पन्न हुए। माया तथा वेदना-ये दो इनको क्रमशः भय एवं नरककी पल्रियाँ हैं। मायाने भयसे समस्त
verses.wordMeaning: Or, if a Brahmana performs even his daily prescribed righteous duties (like the daily Sandhyd prayers etc.) without dedicating the fruit thereof to the Lord, he is fettered by its fruit.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or, if a Brahmana performs even his daily prescribed righteous duties (like the daily Sandhyd prayers etc.) without dedicating the fruit thereof to the Lord, he is fettered by its fruit.

verses.sanskrit: सर्पा यक्षास्तथा बूता गन्धर्वाः संप्रजज्ञिरे । रजस्तमोभ्यामाविष्टांस्ततो ऽन्यानसृजत् प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: sarpā yakṣāstathā būtā gandharvāḥ saṃprajajñire / rajastamobhyāmāviṣṭāṃstato 'nyānasṛjat prabhuḥ
verses.translation: Or, if a Brahmana performs even his daily prescribed righteous duties (like the daily Sandhyd prayers etc.) without dedicating the fruit thereof to the Lord, he is fettered by its fruit.
verses.hindi: प्राणियोंको मार देनेवाले मृत्युको उत्पन्न किया वेदनाने भी रौरव (नरक नामक पति)-से दुःख
verses.wordMeaning: Or, if a Brahmana performs even his daily prescribed righteous duties (like the daily Sandhyd prayers etc.) without dedicating the fruit thereof to the Lord, he is fettered by its fruit.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or, if a Brahmana performs even his daily prescribed righteous duties (like the daily Sandhyd prayers etc.) without dedicating the fruit thereof to the Lord, he is fettered by its fruit.

verses.sanskrit: वयांसि वयसः सृष्ट्वा अवयो वक्षसो ऽसृजत् । मुखतो ऽजान् ससर्जान्यान् उदराद्गाश्चनिर्ममे
verses.transliteration: vayāṃsi vayasaḥ sṛṣṭvā avayo vakṣaso 'sṛjat / mukhato 'jān sasarjānyān udarādgāścanirmame
verses.translation: Or, if a Brahmana performs even his daily prescribed righteous duties (like the daily Sandhyd prayers etc.) without dedicating the fruit thereof to the Lord, he is fettered by its fruit.
verses.hindi: मृत्योर्व्याधिजराशोकतृष्णाक्रोधाश्च जज्ञिरि॥ २७॥  नामक पुत्र उत्पन्न किया। मृत्युसे व्याधि, जरा, शोक, दुःखोत्तरा: स्मृता होते सर्वे चाधर्मलक्षणाः । नैषां भार्यास्ति पुत्रो वा सर्वे ते ह्यूर्ध्वरेतस:
verses.wordMeaning: Or, if a Brahmana performs even his daily prescribed righteous duties (like the daily Sandhyd prayers etc.) without dedicating the fruit thereof to the Lord, he is fettered by its fruit.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or, if a Brahmana performs even his daily prescribed righteous duties (like the daily Sandhyd prayers etc.) without dedicating the fruit thereof to the Lord, he is fettered by its fruit.

verses.sanskrit: पद्भ्याञ्चाश्वान् समातङ्गान् रासभान् गवयान् मृगान् । उष्ट्रानश्वतरांश्चैव न्यङ्कूनन्यांश्व जातयः । औपध्यः फलमूलिन्यो रोमभ्यस्तस्य जज्ञिरे
verses.transliteration: padbhyāñcāśvān samātaṅgān rāsabhān gavayān mṛgān / uṣṭrānaśvatarāṃścaiva nyaṅkūnanyāṃśva jātayaḥ / aupadhyaḥ phalamūlinyo romabhyastasya jajñire
verses.translation: Or, if a Brahmana performs even his daily prescribed righteous duties (like the daily Sandhyd prayers etc.) without dedicating the fruit thereof to the Lord, he is fettered by its fruit.
verses.hindi: इत्येष तामसः सर्गो जज्ञे धर्मनियामकः। संक्षेपेण मया प्रोक्ता वितृष्टिर्मुनिपुंगवाः तृष्णा तथा क्रोध उत्पन्न हुए
verses.wordMeaning: Or, if a Brahmana performs even his daily prescribed righteous duties (like the daily Sandhyd prayers etc.) without dedicating the fruit thereof to the Lord, he is fettered by its fruit.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or, if a Brahmana performs even his daily prescribed righteous duties (like the daily Sandhyd prayers etc.) without dedicating the fruit thereof to the Lord, he is fettered by its fruit.

verses.sanskrit: गायत्रं च ऋचं चैव त्रिवृत्साम रथन्तरम् । अग्निष्टोमं च यज्ञानां निर्ममे प्रथमान्मुखात्
verses.transliteration: gāyatraṃ ca ṛcaṃ caiva trivṛtsāma rathantaram / agniṣṭomaṃ ca yajñānāṃ nirmame prathamānmukhāt
verses.translation: Or, if a Brahmana performs even his daily prescribed righteous duties (like the daily Sandhyd prayers etc.) without dedicating the fruit thereof to the Lord, he is fettered by its fruit.
verses.hindi: ये सभी उत्तरोत्तर अधिक दुःखदायी कहे गये हैं और अधर्माचरण ही इनका लक्षण है। इनकी न कोई स्त्री है और न कोई पुत्र। ये सभी ऊर्ध्वरेता हैं श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! इस प्रकार धर्मनियामकने तामस
verses.wordMeaning: Or, if a Brahmana performs even his daily prescribed righteous duties (like the daily Sandhyd prayers etc.) without dedicating the fruit thereof to the Lord, he is fettered by its fruit.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or, if a Brahmana performs even his daily prescribed righteous duties (like the daily Sandhyd prayers etc.) without dedicating the fruit thereof to the Lord, he is fettered by its fruit.

verses.sanskrit: यजूंषि त्रैष्टुभं छन्दः स्तोमं पञ्चदशं तथा । बृहत्साम तथोक्थं च दक्षिणादसृजन्मुखात्
verses.transliteration: yajūṃṣi traiṣṭubhaṃ chandaḥ stomaṃ pañcadaśaṃ tathā / bṛhatsāma tathokthaṃ ca dakṣiṇādasṛjanmukhāt
verses.translation: Or, if a Brahmana performs even his daily prescribed righteous duties (like the daily Sandhyd prayers etc.) without dedicating the fruit thereof to the Lord, he is fettered by its fruit.
verses.hindi: सर्गको सृष्टि की। मैंने संक्षेपमें इस विशिष्ट सृष्टिका वर्णन किया शेषशायी नारायणको नाभिसे कमलको उत्पत्ति तथा उसी कमलसे ब्रह्माका प्राकट्य, विष्णु-मायाद्वारा ब्रह्माका मोहित होकर विष्णुसे विवाद करना, भगवान् शंकरका प्राकट्य, विष्णुद्वारा ब्रह्माको शिवका माहात्म्य बताना, ब्रह्माद्वारा शिवकी स्तुति
verses.wordMeaning: Or, if a Brahmana performs even his daily prescribed righteous duties (like the daily Sandhyd prayers etc.) without dedicating the fruit thereof to the Lord, he is fettered by its fruit.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or, if a Brahmana performs even his daily prescribed righteous duties (like the daily Sandhyd prayers etc.) without dedicating the fruit thereof to the Lord, he is fettered by its fruit.

verses.sanskrit: सामानि जागतं छन्दस्तोमं सप्तदशं तथा । वैरूपमतिरात्रं च पश्चिमादसृजन्मुखात्
verses.transliteration: sāmāni jāgataṃ chandastomaṃ saptadaśaṃ tathā / vairūpamatirātraṃ ca paścimādasṛjanmukhāt
verses.translation: Or, if a Brahmana performs even his daily prescribed righteous duties (like the daily Sandhyd prayers etc.) without dedicating the fruit thereof to the Lord, he is fettered by its fruit.
verses.hindi: तथा शिव और विष्णुके एकत्वका प्रतिपादन प्रणम्य वरदं विष्णुं पप्रच्छुः संशयान्विताः
verses.wordMeaning: Or, if a Brahmana performs even his daily prescribed righteous duties (like the daily Sandhyd prayers etc.) without dedicating the fruit thereof to the Lord, he is fettered by its fruit.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or, if a Brahmana performs even his daily prescribed righteous duties (like the daily Sandhyd prayers etc.) without dedicating the fruit thereof to the Lord, he is fettered by its fruit.

verses.sanskrit: एकविशमथर्वाणमाप्तोर्यामाणमेव च । अनुष्टुभं सवैराजमुत्तरादसृजन्मुखात्
verses.transliteration: ekaviśamatharvāṇamāptoryāmāṇameva ca / anuṣṭubhaṃ savairājamuttarādasṛjanmukhāt
verses.translation: Or, if a Brahmana performs even his daily prescribed righteous duties (like the daily Sandhyd prayers etc.) without dedicating the fruit thereof to the Lord, he is fettered by its fruit.
verses.hindi: कथं स भगवानीशः पूर्वजोऽपि पिनाकधृक् । पुत्रत्वमगमच्छम्भुर्ब्रह्मणोऽव्यक्तजन्मनः कथं च भगवाञ्जज्ञे ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः । अण्डजो जगतामीशस्तन्नो वक्तुमिहार्हसि
verses.wordMeaning: Or, if a Brahmana performs even his daily prescribed righteous duties (like the daily Sandhyd prayers etc.) without dedicating the fruit thereof to the Lord, he is fettered by its fruit.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or, if a Brahmana performs even his daily prescribed righteous duties (like the daily Sandhyd prayers etc.) without dedicating the fruit thereof to the Lord, he is fettered by its fruit.

verses.sanskrit: उच्चावचानि भूतानि गात्रेभ्यस्तस्य जज्ञिरे । ब्रह्मणो हि प्रजासर्गं सृजतस्तु प्रजापतेः
verses.transliteration: uccāvacāni bhūtāni gātrebhyastasya jajñire / brahmaṇo hi prajāsargaṃ sṛjatastu prajāpateḥ
verses.translation: Or, if a Brahmana performs even his daily prescribed righteous duties (like the daily Sandhyd prayers etc.) without dedicating the fruit thereof to the Lord, he is fettered by its fruit.
verses.hindi: श्रीकूर्म उवाच शृणुध्वमृषयः सर्वे शंकरस्यामितौजसः। पुत्रत्वं ब्रह्मणस्तस्य पदायोनित्वमेव च आसीदेकार्णवं सर्व न देवाद्या न चर्षयः
verses.wordMeaning: Or, if a Brahmana performs even his daily prescribed righteous duties (like the daily Sandhyd prayers etc.) without dedicating the fruit thereof to the Lord, he is fettered by its fruit.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or, if a Brahmana performs even his daily prescribed righteous duties (like the daily Sandhyd prayers etc.) without dedicating the fruit thereof to the Lord, he is fettered by its fruit.

verses.sanskrit: सृष्ट्वा चतुष्टयं सर्गं देवर्षिपितृमानुषम् । ततो ऽसृजच्च भूतानि स्थावराणि चराणि च
verses.transliteration: sṛṣṭvā catuṣṭayaṃ sargaṃ devarṣipitṛmānuṣam / tato 'sṛjacca bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca
verses.translation: Or, if a Brahmana performs even his daily prescribed righteous duties (like the daily Sandhyd prayers etc.) without dedicating the fruit thereof to the Lord, he is fettered by its fruit.
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले--नारद आदि महर्षियोंने यह वचन सुननेपर संशयग्रस्त होते हुए वरदाता विष्णुको प्रणामकर इस प्रकार पूछा- ऋषियोंने कहा--हे जनार्दन! आपने मुख्य आदिकी सृष्टिका वर्णन किया। अब इस समय जो संशय हमें हो रहा है, उसे आप दूर करें- (ब्रह्मासे) पूर्वमें उत्पन्न होनेपर भी पिनाक नामक धनुषको धारण करनेवाले ईश
verses.wordMeaning: Or, if a Brahmana performs even his daily prescribed righteous duties (like the daily Sandhyd prayers etc.) without dedicating the fruit thereof to the Lord, he is fettered by its fruit.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or, if a Brahmana performs even his daily prescribed righteous duties (like the daily Sandhyd prayers etc.) without dedicating the fruit thereof to the Lord, he is fettered by its fruit.

verses.sanskrit: यक्षान् पिशाचान् गन्धर्वांस्तथैवाप्सरसः शुभाः । नरकिन्नररक्षांसि वयः पुशुमृगोरगान् । अव्ययं च व्ययं चैव द्वयं स्थावरजङ्गमम्
verses.transliteration: yakṣān piśācān gandharvāṃstathaivāpsarasaḥ śubhāḥ / narakinnararakṣāṃsi vayaḥ puśumṛgoragān / avyayaṃ ca vyayaṃ caiva dvayaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam
verses.translation: Or, if a Brahmana performs even his daily prescribed righteous duties (like the daily Sandhyd prayers etc.) without dedicating the fruit thereof to the Lord, he is fettered by its fruit.
verses.hindi: भगवान् शिव किस प्रकार अव्यक्तजन्मा ब्रह्माके पुत्रत्वको प्राप्त हुए और केसे जगत्के स्वामी लोकपितामह अण्डज (हिरण्यगर्भ) भगवान् ब्रह्माको उत्पत्ति हुई, उसे आप हमें बतलायें॥ २--४॥ श्रीकूर्म बोले ऋषियो ! आप सभी सुनें- अमित तेजस्वी शंकर ब्रह्माके पुत्र-रूपमें कैसे हुए और कैसे ब्रह्मा कमलसे उत्पन्न हुए
verses.wordMeaning: Or, if a Brahmana performs even his daily prescribed righteous duties (like the daily Sandhyd prayers etc.) without dedicating the fruit thereof to the Lord, he is fettered by its fruit.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or, if a Brahmana performs even his daily prescribed righteous duties (like the daily Sandhyd prayers etc.) without dedicating the fruit thereof to the Lord, he is fettered by its fruit.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां ये यानि कर्माणि प्राक्सृष्टौ प्रतिपेदिरे । तान्येव ते प्रपद्यन्ते सृज्यमानाः पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ ye yāni karmāṇi prāksṛṣṭau pratipedire / tānyeva te prapadyante sṛjyamānāḥ punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: Or, if a Brahmana performs even his daily prescribed righteous duties (like the daily Sandhyd prayers etc.) without dedicating the fruit thereof to the Lord, he is fettered by its fruit.
verses.hindi: विगत कल्पको समासिपर तीनों लोकोंमें घोर अन्धकार व्याप्त हो गया। सर्वत्र केबल जल-ही-जल था। न कोई देवता आदि थे और न कोई ऋषिजन तत्र नारायणो देवो निर्जने निरुपप्लवे। आश्रित्य शेषशयनं सुष्वाप पुरुषोत्तमः
verses.wordMeaning: Or, if a Brahmana performs even his daily prescribed righteous duties (like the daily Sandhyd prayers etc.) without dedicating the fruit thereof to the Lord, he is fettered by its fruit.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or, if a Brahmana performs even his daily prescribed righteous duties (like the daily Sandhyd prayers etc.) without dedicating the fruit thereof to the Lord, he is fettered by its fruit.

verses.sanskrit: हिंस्त्राहिंस्त्रे मृदुक्रूरे धर्माधर्मावृतानृते । तद्भाविताः प्रपद्यन्ते तस्मात् तत् तस्य रोचते
verses.transliteration: hiṃstrāhiṃstre mṛdukrūre dharmādharmāvṛtānṛte / tadbhāvitāḥ prapadyante tasmāt tat tasya rocate
verses.translation: Or, if a Brahmana performs even his daily prescribed righteous duties (like the daily Sandhyd prayers etc.) without dedicating the fruit thereof to the Lord, he is fettered by its fruit.
verses.hindi: त्रैलोक्यसारं विमलं नाभ्यां पङ्कजमुद्रभौ दिव्यगन्धमयं पुण्यं कर्णिकाकेसरान्वितम्
verses.wordMeaning: Or, if a Brahmana performs even his daily prescribed righteous duties (like the daily Sandhyd prayers etc.) without dedicating the fruit thereof to the Lord, he is fettered by its fruit.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or, if a Brahmana performs even his daily prescribed righteous duties (like the daily Sandhyd prayers etc.) without dedicating the fruit thereof to the Lord, he is fettered by its fruit.

verses.sanskrit: महाभूतेषु नानात्वमिन्द्रियार्थेषु मूर्तिषु । विनियोगं च भूतानां धातैव विदधात् स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: mahābhūteṣu nānātvamindriyārtheṣu mūrtiṣu / viniyogaṃ ca bhūtānāṃ dhātaiva vidadhāt svayam
verses.translation: Or, if a Brahmana performs even his daily prescribed righteous duties (like the daily Sandhyd prayers etc.) without dedicating the fruit thereof to the Lord, he is fettered by its fruit.
verses.hindi: तस्यैवं सुचिरं कालं वर्तमानस्य शार्ङ्गिणः । हिरण्यगर्भो भगवांस्तं देशमुपचक्रमे स तं करेण विश्वात्मा समुत्थाप्य सनातनम्। प्रोवाच मधुरं वाक्यं मायया तस्य मोहितः
verses.wordMeaning: Or, if a Brahmana performs even his daily prescribed righteous duties (like the daily Sandhyd prayers etc.) without dedicating the fruit thereof to the Lord, he is fettered by its fruit.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or, if a Brahmana performs even his daily prescribed righteous duties (like the daily Sandhyd prayers etc.) without dedicating the fruit thereof to the Lord, he is fettered by its fruit.

verses.sanskrit: नामरूपं च भूतानां कृत्यानां च प्रपञ्चनम् । वेदशब्देभ्य एवादौ निर्ममे स महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: nāmarūpaṃ ca bhūtānāṃ kṛtyānāṃ ca prapañcanam / vedaśabdebhya evādau nirmame sa maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Or, if a Brahmana performs even his daily prescribed righteous duties (like the daily Sandhyd prayers etc.) without dedicating the fruit thereof to the Lord, he is fettered by its fruit.
verses.hindi: अस्मिन्नेकार्णवे घोरे निर्जने तमसावृते। एकाकी को भवाज्छेते ब्रूहि मे पुरुषर्षभ उवाच देवं ब्रह्माणं मेघगम्भीरनिःस्वनः
verses.wordMeaning: Or, if a Brahmana performs even his daily prescribed righteous duties (like the daily Sandhyd prayers etc.) without dedicating the fruit thereof to the Lord, he is fettered by its fruit.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or, if a Brahmana performs even his daily prescribed righteous duties (like the daily Sandhyd prayers etc.) without dedicating the fruit thereof to the Lord, he is fettered by its fruit.

verses.sanskrit: आर्षाणि चैव नामानि याश्च वेदेषु दृष्टयः । शर्वर्यन्ते प्रसूतानां तान्येवैभ्यो ददात्यजः
verses.transliteration: ārṣāṇi caiva nāmāni yāśca vedeṣu dṛṣṭayaḥ / śarvaryante prasūtānāṃ tānyevaibhyo dadātyajaḥ
verses.translation: Or, if a Brahmana performs even his daily prescribed righteous duties (like the daily Sandhyd prayers etc.) without dedicating the fruit thereof to the Lord, he is fettered by its fruit.
verses.hindi: भो भो नारायणं देवं लोकानां प्रभवाप्ययम्। महायोगेश्वरं मां त्वं जानीहि पुरुषोत्तमम् मयि पश्य जगत् कृत्स्नं त्वां च लोकपितामहम्। सपर्वतमहाद्वीपं समुद्रैः सपतभिर्वृतम्
verses.wordMeaning: Or, if a Brahmana performs even his daily prescribed righteous duties (like the daily Sandhyd prayers etc.) without dedicating the fruit thereof to the Lord, he is fettered by its fruit.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or, if a Brahmana performs even his daily prescribed righteous duties (like the daily Sandhyd prayers etc.) without dedicating the fruit thereof to the Lord, he is fettered by its fruit.

verses.sanskrit: यथर्तावृतुलिङ्गानि नानारूपाणि पर्यये । दृश्यन्ते तानि तान्येव तथा भावा युगादिषु
verses.transliteration: yathartāvṛtuliṅgāni nānārūpāṇi paryaye / dṛśyante tāni tānyeva tathā bhāvā yugādiṣu
verses.translation: Or, if a Brahmana performs even his daily prescribed righteous duties (like the daily Sandhyd prayers etc.) without dedicating the fruit thereof to the Lord, he is fettered by its fruit.
verses.hindi: जानन्नपि महायोगी को भवानिति वेधसम् ततः प्रहस्य भगवान् ब्रह्मा वेदनिधिः प्रभुः । प्रत्युवाचाम्बुजाभाक्षं सस्मितं श्लक्ष्णया गिरा
verses.wordMeaning: Or, if a Brahmana performs even his daily prescribed righteous duties (like the daily Sandhyd prayers etc.) without dedicating the fruit thereof to the Lord, he is fettered by its fruit.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or, if a Brahmana performs even his daily prescribed righteous duties (like the daily Sandhyd prayers etc.) without dedicating the fruit thereof to the Lord, he is fettered by its fruit.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे सप्तमो ऽध्यायः श्रीकूर्म उवाच एवं भूतानि सृष्टानि स्थावराणि चराणि च । यदा चास्य प्रजाः सृष्टा न व्यवर्धन्त धीमतः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge saptamo 'dhyāyaḥ śrīkūrma uvāca evaṃ bhūtāni sṛṣṭāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca / yadā cāsya prajāḥ sṛṣṭā na vyavardhanta dhīmataḥ
verses.translation: Hence, even if a person who is not learned were to put forth all efforts and resign to the Lord the fruits of all
verses.hindi: उस जनशून्य अत्यन्त शान्त (समुद्रमें) पुरुषोत्तम नारायणदेव शेषनागकी शय्याका आश्रय लेकर सोये हुए थे बाहुवाले होकर वे विद्वानोंके चिन्तनके विषयरूप, सर्वज्ञ, पीतवस्त्रधारी, विशाल नेत्रवाले, नीले बादलके समान वर्णवाले, महाविभूतिस्वरूप, योगियोंके हृदयमें निवास करनेवाले योगात्मा (नारायण) जब किसी समय
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, even if a person who is not learned were to put forth all efforts and resign to the Lord the fruits of all
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, even if a person who is not learned were to put forth all efforts and resign to the Lord the fruits of all

verses.sanskrit: तमोमात्रावृतो ब्रह्मा तदाशोचत दुः खितः । ततः स विदधे बुद्धिमर्थनिश्चयगामिनीम्
verses.transliteration: tamomātrāvṛto brahmā tadāśocata duḥ khitaḥ / tataḥ sa vidadhe buddhimarthaniścayagāminīm
verses.translation: The sin both of this birth as well as that of the previous births is wiped off by the Karman. The doer of the Karman attains serenity of mind and becomes a knower of the Brahman.
verses.hindi: शेषशय्यापर शयन कर रहे थे, तब उनकी नाभिसे लीला करनेके लिये दिव्य अद्भुत, तीनों लोकोंका साररूप, एक स्वच्छ कमल प्रकट हुआ। (वह कमल) सौ योजन विस्तारवाला, तरुण आदित्यके समान प्रकाशमान, पुण्यमय दिव्य गन्धसे सम्पन्न और कर्णिकाएँ तथा केसरसे समन्वित था॥ ८--११॥
verses.wordMeaning: The sin both of this birth as well as that of the previous births is wiped off by the Karman. The doer of the Karman attains serenity of mind and becomes a knower of the Brahman.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sin both of this birth as well as that of the previous births is wiped off by the Karman. The doer of the Karman attains serenity of mind and becomes a knower of the Brahman.

verses.sanskrit: अथात्मनि समद्राक्षीत् तमोमात्रां नियामिकाम् । रजः सत्त्वं च संवृत्य वर्तमानां स्वधर्मतः
verses.transliteration: athātmani samadrākṣīt tamomātrāṃ niyāmikām / rajaḥ sattvaṃ ca saṃvṛtya vartamānāṃ svadharmataḥ
verses.translation: The Toga becomes perfect through Jhdna (spiritual knowledge) accompanied by Karman and the. Jhdnam. association with Karman, becomes free from defects.
verses.hindi: शाङ्ग नामक धनुष धारण करनेवाले शार्ङ्गधन्वा (नारायण) इसी रूपमें बहुत समयसे निवास कर रहे थे तभी एक समय भगवान् हिरण्यगर्भ उस स्थानपर गये। उनकी मायासे मुग्ध उन विश्‍्वात्माने उन (सुप्त) सनातन (पुरुष)-को हाथसे उठाकर यह मधुर वचन कहा
verses.wordMeaning: The Toga becomes perfect through Jhdna (spiritual knowledge) accompanied by Karman and the. Jhdnam. association with Karman, becomes free from defects.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Toga becomes perfect through Jhdna (spiritual knowledge) accompanied by Karman and the. Jhdnam. association with Karman, becomes free from defects.

verses.sanskrit: तमस्तद् व्यनुदत् पश्चात् रजः सत्त्वेन संयुतः । तत् तमः प्रतिनुन्नं वै मिथुनं समजायत
verses.transliteration: tamastad vyanudat paścāt rajaḥ sattvena saṃyutaḥ / tat tamaḥ pratinunnaṃ vai mithunaṃ samajāyata
verses.translation: Hence, by every means should a man, whatever be the stage of life he is engaged in, do the Karman for the satisfaction of Isvara (the Ruler of the universe). He shall then attain salvation, or the state of inactivity {Naiskarmya).
verses.hindi: हे पुरुषश्रेष्ठ! अन्धकारसे आवृत इस घोर, निर्जन एकार्णवमें अकेले सोनेवाले आप कौन हैं? मुझे बतलायें उनके इस वचनको सुनकर मेघके समान गम्भीर स्वरवाले गरुडध्वजने हँसकर ब्रह्मदेवसे कहा-
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, by every means should a man, whatever be the stage of life he is engaged in, do the Karman for the satisfaction of Isvara (the Ruler of the universe). He shall then attain salvation, or the state of inactivity {Naiskarmya).
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, by every means should a man, whatever be the stage of life he is engaged in, do the Karman for the satisfaction of Isvara (the Ruler of the universe). He shall then attain salvation, or the state of inactivity {Naiskarmya).

verses.sanskrit: अधर्माचरणो विप्रा हिंसा चाशुभलक्षणा । स्वां तनुं स ततो ब्रह्मा तामपोहत भास्वराम्
verses.transliteration: adharmācaraṇo viprā hiṃsā cāśubhalakṣaṇā / svāṃ tanuṃ sa tato brahmā tāmapohata bhāsvarām
verses.translation: After attaining the great spiritual knowledge and the state of inactivity or freedom from Karman through His grace, the man, remaining single, quiescent and free from the sense of 'my-ness' becomes released from Sarnsdra even as he is alive.
verses.hindi: (ब्रह्माजी आप) मुझे ही समस्त लोकोंकी उत्पत्ति एवं संहार करनेवाला महायोगेशवर एवं पुरुषोत्तम नारायण- देव जानें। पर्वत और महान् द्वीपोंसे युक्त सात समुद्रोंसे घिरे हुए इस सम्पूर्ण जगतूके साथ ही समस्त लोकोंके पितामह (ब्रह्माजी) आप अपनेको भी मुझमें ही देखें। ऐसा कहकर विश्वात्मा महायोगी हरिने (सब कुछ) जानते हुए भी ब्रह्मारूपी पुरुषसे कहा-आप कौन हैं ? ॥ १६--१८ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: After attaining the great spiritual knowledge and the state of inactivity or freedom from Karman through His grace, the man, remaining single, quiescent and free from the sense of 'my-ness' becomes released from Sarnsdra even as he is alive.
verses.commentary: Sense: After attaining the great spiritual knowledge and the state of inactivity or freedom from Karman through His grace, the man, remaining single, quiescent and free from the sense of 'my-ness' becomes released from Sarnsdra even as he is alive.

verses.sanskrit: द्विधाकरोत् पुनर्देहमर्धेन पुरुषो ऽभवत् । अर्धेन नारी पुरुषो विराजमसृजत् प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: dvidhākarot punardehamardhena puruṣo 'bhavat / ardhena nārī puruṣo virājamasṛjat prabhuḥ
verses.translation: He visualizes the great Atman, the Supreme Brahman, and the great Isvara. Possessing perpetual bliss and free from fallacious semblance, he shall become merged unto that Brahman alone.
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर वेदनिधि प्रभु भगवान् ब्रह्माने हँसकर कमलकी आभाके समान नेत्रवाले तथा मन्द-मन्द मुसकानवाले (भगवान् विष्णुको इस प्रकार) मधुर वाणीमें उत्तर दिया- मय्येव संस्थितं विश्वं ब्रह्माहं विश्वतोमुखः
verses.wordMeaning: He visualizes the great Atman, the Supreme Brahman, and the great Isvara. Possessing perpetual bliss and free from fallacious semblance, he shall become merged unto that Brahman alone.
verses.commentary: Sense: He visualizes the great Atman, the Supreme Brahman, and the great Isvara. Possessing perpetual bliss and free from fallacious semblance, he shall become merged unto that Brahman alone.

verses.sanskrit: नारीं च शतरूपाख्यां योगिनीं ससृजे शुभाम् । सा दिवं पृथिवीं चैव महम्ना व्याप्य संस्थिता
verses.transliteration: nārīṃ ca śatarūpākhyāṃ yoginīṃ sasṛje śubhām / sā divaṃ pṛthivīṃ caiva mahamnā vyāpya saṃsthitā
verses.translation: Hence, one should resort to the path of action incessantly with a serene mind, for the satisfaction and pleasure of the Supreme Lord, and he shall attain his eternal region.
verses.hindi: श्रुत्वा वाचं स भगवान् विष्णुः सत्यपराक्रमः । अनुज्ञाप्याथ योगेन प्रविष्टो ब्रह्मणस्तनुम् त्रैलोक्यमेतत् सकलं सदेवासुरमानुषम्। उदरे तस्य देवस्य दृष्टा विस्मयमागतः
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, one should resort to the path of action incessantly with a serene mind, for the satisfaction and pleasure of the Supreme Lord, and he shall attain his eternal region.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, one should resort to the path of action incessantly with a serene mind, for the satisfaction and pleasure of the Supreme Lord, and he shall attain his eternal region.

verses.sanskrit: योगैश्वर्यबलोपेता ज्ञानविज्ञानसंयुता । यो ऽभवत् पुरुषात् पुत्रो विराडव्यक्तजन्मनः
verses.transliteration: yogaiśvaryabalopetā jñānavijñānasaṃyutā / yo 'bhavat puruṣāt putro virāḍavyaktajanmanaḥ
verses.translation: Thus, the excellent arrangement of the four stages of life in their serial order has been completely recounted to you. No man attains emancipation from Sarnsdra by transgressing this.
verses.hindi: तदास्य वक्त्रान्निष्क्रम्य पन्नगेन्द्रनिकेतनः। अजातशत्रुर्भगवान् पितामहमथाब्रवीत् प्रविश्य लोकान् पश्यैतान् विचित्रान् पुरुषर्षभ
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, the excellent arrangement of the four stages of life in their serial order has been completely recounted to you. No man attains emancipation from Sarnsdra by transgressing this.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, the excellent arrangement of the four stages of life in their serial order has been completely recounted to you. No man attains emancipation from Sarnsdra by transgressing this.

verses.sanskrit: स्वायंभुवो मनुर्देवः सो ऽभवत् पुरुषो मुनिः । सा देवी शतरूपाख्या तपः कृत्वा सुदुश्चरम्
verses.transliteration: svāyaṃbhuvo manurdevaḥ so 'bhavat puruṣo muniḥ / sā devī śatarūpākhyā tapaḥ kṛtvā suduścaram
verses.translation: Puranas are full of echoes from Vedic and Upanisadic texts. Thus sarvarh brahmamayam jagat is a paraphrase of sarvam khalvidath BrahmOy the next verse echoes ekarh sad viprd bahudhd vadanti.
verses.hindi: तानेव लोकान् गर्भस्थानपश्यत् सत्यविक्रमः । पर्यटित्वा तु देवस्य ददृशेऽन्तं न वै हरेः जनार्दनेन ब्रह्मासौ नाभ्यां द्वारमविन्दत
verses.wordMeaning: Puranas are full of echoes from Vedic and Upanisadic texts. Thus sarvarh brahmamayam jagat is a paraphrase of sarvam khalvidath BrahmOy the next verse echoes ekarh sad viprd bahudhd vadanti.
verses.commentary: Sense: Puranas are full of echoes from Vedic and Upanisadic texts. Thus sarvarh brahmamayam jagat is a paraphrase of sarvam khalvidath BrahmOy the next verse echoes ekarh sad viprd bahudhd vadanti.

verses.sanskrit: भर्तारं ब्रह्मणः पुत्रं मनुमेवानुपद्यत । तस्माच्च शतरूपा सा पुत्रद्वयमसूयत
verses.transliteration: bhartāraṃ brahmaṇaḥ putraṃ manumevānupadyata / tasmācca śatarūpā sā putradvayamasūyata
verses.translation: Cf. V. 16 above. As stated therein 'The great seed* {mahad- bija) mentioned therein is the principle called Mahat which is an evolute of Pradhdna. Though it is called ''The effect of Pradhana" (Pradhanikam kdryam), the influence of Purusa explicitly stated in V. 16 above should be taken as implicit here.
verses.hindi: तत्र योगबलेनासौ प्रविश्य कनकाण्डजः। उज्जहारात्मनो रूपं पुष्कराच्यतुराननः विरराजारविन्दस्थः पदढागर्भसमद्युतिः । ब्रह्मा स्वयम्भूर्भगवान् जगद्योनिः पितामहः
verses.wordMeaning: Cf. V. 16 above. As stated therein 'The great seed* {mahad- bija) mentioned therein is the principle called Mahat which is an evolute of Pradhdna. Though it is called ''The effect of Pradhana" (Pradhanikam kdryam), the influence of Purusa explicitly stated in V.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. V. 16 above. As stated therein 'The great seed* {mahad- bija) mentioned therein is the principle called Mahat which is an evolute of Pradhdna. Though it is called ''The effect of Pradhana" (Pradhanikam kdryam), the influence of Purusa explicitly stated in V.…

verses.sanskrit: प्रियव्रतोत्तानपादौ कन्याद्वयमनुत्तमम् । तयोः प्रसूतिं दक्षाय मनुः कन्यां ददौ पुनः
verses.transliteration: priyavratottānapādau kanyādvayamanuttamam / tayoḥ prasūtiṃ dakṣāya manuḥ kanyāṃ dadau punaḥ
verses.translation: From whence was all this universe born? Wherein it will get dissolved? Who is the controller of all these things? O Purusottama (Supreme Person), be pleased to recount this to us.
verses.hindi: प्रोवाच पुरुषं विष्णुं मेघगम्भीरया गिरा में ही धाता (धारण करनेवाला), विधाता (विधान
verses.wordMeaning: From whence was all this universe born? Wherein it will get dissolved? Who is the controller of all these things? O Purusottama (Supreme Person), be pleased to recount this to us.
verses.commentary: Sense: From whence was all this universe born? Wherein it will get dissolved? Who is the controller of all these things? O Purusottama (Supreme Person), be pleased to recount this to us.

verses.sanskrit: प्रजापतिरथाकूतिं मानसो जगृहे रुचिः । आकूत्यां मिथुनं जज्ञे मानसस्य रुचेः शुभम् । यज्ञश्च दक्षिणा चैव याभ्यां संवर्धितं जगत्
verses.transliteration: prajāpatirathākūtiṃ mānaso jagṛhe ruciḥ / ākūtyāṃ mithunaṃ jajñe mānasasya ruceḥ śubham / yajñaśca dakṣiṇā caiva yābhyāṃ saṃvardhitaṃ jagat
verses.translation: On hearing the query submitted by the sages, Narayana who assumed the form of a Tortoise, the imperishable source of all living beings, spoke in a deep majestic tone.
verses.hindi: प्रपितामह हूँ। मुझमें ही (सम्पूर्ण) विश्व स्थित है। मै सभी ओर मुखवाला ब्रह्मा हूँ सत्यपराक्रम वे भगवान् विष्णु (ब्रह्मा)-का वचन सुनकर (उनकी) आज्ञा लेकर योगबलसे ब्रह्माके शरीरमें प्रविष्ट हुए। उन देव (ब्रह्मा)-के उदरमें देवता, असुर तथा मनुष्योंसहित सम्पूर्ण त्रिलोकीको देखकर
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the query submitted by the sages, Narayana who assumed the form of a Tortoise, the imperishable source of all living beings, spoke in a deep majestic tone.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the query submitted by the sages, Narayana who assumed the form of a Tortoise, the imperishable source of all living beings, spoke in a deep majestic tone.

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञस्य दक्षिणायां तु पुत्रा द्वादश जज्ञिरे । यामा इति समाक्यता देवाः स्वायंभुवे ऽन्तरे
verses.transliteration: yajñasya dakṣiṇāyāṃ tu putrā dvādaśa jajñire / yāmā iti samākyatā devāḥ svāyaṃbhuve 'ntare
verses.translation: The Supreme Lord (Mahesvara) is transcendental, unmanifest,- eternal, the Lord of four manifestations (yyuhas viz.
verses.hindi: श्रीविष्णुको (अत्यन्त) आश्चर्य हुआ । तदनन्तर नागराजकी शय्यापर निवास करनेवाले अजातशत्रु वे भगवान् (विष्णु) उनके (ब्रह्माके) मुखसे बाहर निकलकर पितामह (ब्रह्मा)-से बोले पुरुषश्रेष्ठ! आप भी अब इसी प्रकार मेरे उदरमें प्रविष्ट होकर सदा इन विचित्र लोकोंको देखें
verses.wordMeaning: The Supreme Lord (Mahesvara) is transcendental, unmanifest,- eternal, the Lord of four manifestations (yyuhas viz.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Supreme Lord (Mahesvara) is transcendental, unmanifest,- eternal, the Lord of four manifestations (yyuhas viz.

verses.sanskrit: प्रसूत्यां च तथा दक्षश्चतस्त्रो विंशतिं तथा । ससर्ज कन्या नामानि तासां सम्यम् निबोधत
verses.transliteration: prasūtyāṃ ca tathā dakṣaścatastro viṃśatiṃ tathā / sasarja kanyā nāmāni tāsāṃ samyam nibodhata
verses.translation: To him philosophers (or contemplators of Reality) designate as unmanifest, the cause which is eternal and compris¬ ing of the being and non-being as well as the Pradhana and the Prakrti.
verses.hindi: तब भगवान् विष्णुकी यह आह्लाद प्रदान करनेवाली वाणी सुनकर और पुनः उनका ( श्रीविष्णुका) अभिनन्दन कर कुशध्वज (ब्रह्मा)-ने लक्ष्मीपति (भगवान् विष्णु)- के उदरमें प्रवेश किया  सत्यविक्रम (ब्रह्मा)-ने उन्हीं लोकोंको (भगवान् विष्णुके) उदरमें स्थित देखा (जिन्हें श्रीविष्णुने ब्रह्माके उदरमें देखा था) । देवके (उदरमें) भ्रमण करते हुए उन्हें हरि (विष्णु)-का कोई अन्त न दिखायी दिया
verses.wordMeaning: To him philosophers (or contemplators of Reality) designate as unmanifest, the cause which is eternal and compris¬ ing of the being and non-being as well as the Pradhana and the Prakrti.
verses.commentary: Sense: To him philosophers (or contemplators of Reality) designate as unmanifest, the cause which is eternal and compris¬ ing of the being and non-being as well as the Pradhana and the Prakrti.

verses.sanskrit: श्रद्धा लक्ष्मीर्धृतिस्तुष्टिः पुष्टिर्मेधा क्रिया तथा । बुद्धिर्लज्जावपुः शान्तिः सिद्धिः कीर्तिस्त्रयोदशी
verses.transliteration: śraddhā lakṣmīrdhṛtistuṣṭiḥ puṣṭirmedhā kriyā tathā / buddhirlajjāvapuḥ śāntiḥ siddhiḥ kīrtistrayodaśī
verses.translation: The Supreme Brahman is the source of the universe and the Primary element. It is the cosmic body of all living beings, self-dependent and the Mahat presided over by the Atman.
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर महात्मा जनार्दनने (अपनी इन्द्रियोंके) सभी द्वारोंको बंद कर दिया, तब ब्रह्माने उनकी नाभिमें द्वार प्रात किया। सुवर्णमय अण्डसे उत्पन्न चतुर्मुख (ब्रह्मा)-ने योगबलसे उसमें (नाभिमें) प्रवेश कर (नाभिसे उत्पन्न) कमलसे अपने रूपको बाहर निकाला
verses.wordMeaning: The Supreme Brahman is the source of the universe and the Primary element. It is the cosmic body of all living beings, self-dependent and the Mahat presided over by the Atman.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Supreme Brahman is the source of the universe and the Primary element. It is the cosmic body of all living beings, self-dependent and the Mahat presided over by the Atman.

verses.sanskrit: पत्न्यर्थं प्रतिजग्राह धर्मो दाक्षायणीः शुभाः । ताभ्यः शिष्टा यवीयस्य एकादश सुलोचनाः
verses.transliteration: patnyarthaṃ pratijagrāha dharmo dākṣāyaṇīḥ śubhāḥ / tābhyaḥ śiṣṭā yavīyasya ekādaśa sulocanāḥ
verses.translation: Only the Brahman was in existence in the beginning. It has neither beginning nor end; it is unborn and subtle, and consisting of three Gums. It is the source {v.l. the origin and the end) of the universe. It is unknowable, eternal (extending over the past, present and future).
verses.hindi: पद्मगर्भके समान» शोभावाले स्वयम्भू, जगद्योनि, पितामह भगवान् ब्रह्मा अरविन्द (रक्त कमल)-पर बैठे हुए शोभित होने लगे। अपनेको सम्पूर्ण विश्वका स्वामी तथा परम पद (आश्रय) मानते हुए उन्होंने (ब्रह्माने) मेघके समान गम्भीर वाणीमें पुरुषोत्तम विष्णुसे कहा-
verses.wordMeaning: Only the Brahman was in existence in the beginning. It has neither beginning nor end; it is unborn and subtle, and consisting of three Gums. It is the source {v.l. the origin and the end) of the universe. It is unknowable, eternal (extending over the past, present and future).
verses.commentary: Sense: Only the Brahman was in existence in the beginning. It has neither beginning nor end; it is unborn and subtle, and consisting of three Gums. It is the source {v.l. the origin and the end) of the universe. It is unknowable, eternal (extending over the past, present and future).

verses.sanskrit: ख्यातिः सत्यथ संभूतिः स्मृतिः प्रीतिः क्षमा तथा । संततिश्चानसूया च ऊर्जा स्वाहा स्वधा तथा
verses.transliteration: khyātiḥ satyatha saṃbhūtiḥ smṛtiḥ prītiḥ kṣamā tathā / saṃtatiścānasūyā ca ūrjā svāhā svadhā tathā
verses.translation: When there is complete equilibrium of Gums, and the Purusa abides in his own blissful state, one should know that it is the original state of Prakrti or the dissolution pertain¬ ing to Prakrti till the creation of the Universe.
verses.hindi: ५ रक्त कमलके भीतर जैसी अरुणिमा होती है वैसी अरुणिमा (लालिमा-ललाई)-से सुशोभित। किं कृतं भवतेदानीमात्मनो जयकाडूक्षया । एकोऽहं प्रबलो नान्यो मां वे कोऽभिभविष्यति
verses.wordMeaning: When there is complete equilibrium of Gums, and the Purusa abides in his own blissful state, one should know that it is the original state of Prakrti or the dissolution pertain¬ ing to Prakrti till the creation of the Universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: When there is complete equilibrium of Gums, and the Purusa abides in his own blissful state, one should know that it is the original state of Prakrti or the dissolution pertain¬ ing to Prakrti till the creation of the Universe.

verses.sanskrit: भृगुर्भवो मरीचिश्च तथा चैवाङ्गिरा मुनिः । पुलस्त्यः पुलहश्चैव क्रतुः परमधर्मवित्
verses.transliteration: bhṛgurbhavo marīciśca tathā caivāṅgirā muniḥ / pulastyaḥ pulahaścaiva kratuḥ paramadharmavit
verses.translation: At the close of Brahma's night wakes up the Supreme Lord, who (though) himself beginningless, is the origin of the world. Due to his being unmanifest, he is the immanent Lord abiding in all {v.l. avyakto hyantaryami —the unmanifest in¬ dwelling soul).
verses.hindi: श्रुत्वा नारायणो वाक्यं ब्रह्मणो लोकतन्त्रिणः । सान्त्वपूर्वमिदं वाक्यं बभाषे मधुरं हरिः को हि बाधितुमन्विच्छेद् देवदेवं पितामहम्
verses.wordMeaning: At the close of Brahma's night wakes up the Supreme Lord, who (though) himself beginningless, is the origin of the world. Due to his being unmanifest, he is the immanent Lord abiding in all {v.l. avyakto hyantaryami —the unmanifest in¬ dwelling soul).
verses.commentary: Sense: At the close of Brahma's night wakes up the Supreme Lord, who (though) himself beginningless, is the origin of the world. Due to his being unmanifest, he is the immanent Lord abiding in all {v.l. avyakto hyantaryami —the unmanifest in¬ dwelling soul).

verses.sanskrit: अत्रिर्वसिष्ठो वह्निश्च पितरश्च यथाक्रमम् । ख्यात्याद्या जगृहुः कन्या मुनयो मुनिसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: atrirvasiṣṭho vahniśca pitaraśca yathākramam / khyātyādyā jagṛhuḥ kanyā munayo munisattamāḥ
verses.translation: Promptly entering both Prakrti and Purusa, the great God, the Supreme Deity, agitated them by his highest Toga.
verses.hindi: अस्माच्च कारणाद् ब्रह्मन् पुत्रो भवतु मे भवान्। पद्मयोनिरिति ख्यातो मत्त्रियार्थं जगन्मय ततः स भगवान् देवो वरं दत्त्वा किरीटिने। प्रहर्षमतुलं गत्वा पुनर्विष्णुमभाषत
verses.wordMeaning: Promptly entering both Prakrti and Purusa, the great God, the Supreme Deity, agitated them by his highest Toga.
verses.commentary: Sense: Promptly entering both Prakrti and Purusa, the great God, the Supreme Deity, agitated them by his highest Toga.

verses.sanskrit: श्रद्धाया आत्मजः कामो दर्पो लक्ष्मीसुतः स्मृतः । धृत्यास्तु नियमः पुत्रस्तुष्ट्याः संतोष उच्यते
verses.transliteration: śraddhāyā ātmajaḥ kāmo darpo lakṣmīsutaḥ smṛtaḥ / dhṛtyāstu niyamaḥ putrastuṣṭyāḥ saṃtoṣa ucyate
verses.translation: Just as lust enters women or the wind in the spring entering them stirs (passionate) agitations in them, the same way did the Lord, the Toga incarnate.
verses.hindi: भवान् सर्वात्मकोऽनन्तः सर्वेषां परमेश्वरः । सर्वभूतान्तरात्मा वै परं ब्रह्म सनातनम् अहं वै सर्वलोकानामात्मा लोकमहेश्वरः । मन्मयं सर्वमेवेदं ब्रह्माहं पुरुषः परः
verses.wordMeaning: Just as lust enters women or the wind in the spring entering them stirs (passionate) agitations in them, the same way did the Lord, the Toga incarnate.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as lust enters women or the wind in the spring entering them stirs (passionate) agitations in them, the same way did the Lord, the Toga incarnate.

verses.sanskrit: पुष्ट्या लाभः सुतश्चापि मेधापुत्रः श्रुतस्तथा । क्रियायाश्चाभवत् पुत्रो दण्डः समय एव च
verses.transliteration: puṣṭyā lābhaḥ sutaścāpi medhāputraḥ śrutastathā / kriyāyāścābhavat putro daṇḍaḥ samaya eva ca
verses.translation: O Brahmanas, the same Supreme Lord is both the agitator and the agitated (i.e. the subject and object of agita¬ tion). By means of the withdrawal and development. He stabi¬ lises himself in the state of being Pradhana.
verses.hindi: नावाभ्यां विद्यते ह्यन्यो लोकानां परमेश्वरः । एका मूर्तिद्विंधा भिन्ना नारायणपितामहौ तेनैवमुक्तो ब्रह्माणं वासुदेवोऽब्रवीदिदम्। इयं प्रतिज्ञा भवतो विनाशाय भविष्यति
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas, the same Supreme Lord is both the agitator and the agitated (i.e. the subject and object of agita¬ tion). By means of the withdrawal and development. He stabi¬ lises himself in the state of being Pradhana.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas, the same Supreme Lord is both the agitator and the agitated (i.e. the subject and object of agita¬ tion). By means of the withdrawal and development. He stabi¬ lises himself in the state of being Pradhana.

verses.sanskrit: बुद्ध्या बोधः सुतस्तद्वदप्रमादो व्यजायत । लज्जाया विनयः पुत्रो वपुषो व्यवसायकः
verses.transliteration: buddhyā bodhaḥ sutastadvadapramādo vyajāyata / lajjāyā vinayaḥ putro vapuṣo vyavasāyakaḥ
verses.translation: The great seed called Mahat, consisting of both Pradhana and Purusa, appeared when Pradhana and the ancient Purusa were being agitated.
verses.hindi: कि न पश्यसि योगेशं ब्रह्माधिपतिमव्ययम्। प्रधानपुरुषेशानं वेदाहं परमेश्वरम् अनादिनिधनं ब्रह्म तमेव शरणं व्रज ४३॥
verses.wordMeaning: The great seed called Mahat, consisting of both Pradhana and Purusa, appeared when Pradhana and the ancient Purusa were being agitated.
verses.commentary: Sense: The great seed called Mahat, consisting of both Pradhana and Purusa, appeared when Pradhana and the ancient Purusa were being agitated.

verses.sanskrit: क्षेमः शान्तिसुतश्चापि सुखं सिद्धिरजायत । यशः कीर्तिसुतस्तद्वदित्येते धर्मसूनवः
verses.transliteration: kṣemaḥ śāntisutaścāpi sukhaṃ siddhirajāyata / yaśaḥ kīrtisutastadvadityete dharmasūnavaḥ
verses.translation: The great seed called Mahat, consisting of both Pradhana and Purusa, appeared when Pradhana and the ancient Purusa were being agitated.
verses.hindi: आपने अपनी विजयको आकांक्षासे इस समय यह क्या किया (अपनी सभी इन्द्रियोंके द्वारोंको क्यों बंद कर दिया?) 1 एकमात्र मैं ही सबसे बड़ा बलशाली हूँ और कोई नहीं है, मुझे कौन पराजित कर पायेगा ? लोकनियामक ब्रह्माका वचन सुनकर नारायण हरिने सान्त्वनापूर्वक यह मधुर वाक्य कहा
verses.wordMeaning: The great seed called Mahat, consisting of both Pradhana and Purusa, appeared when Pradhana and the ancient Purusa were being agitated.
verses.commentary: Sense: The great seed called Mahat, consisting of both Pradhana and Purusa, appeared when Pradhana and the ancient Purusa were being agitated.

verses.sanskrit: कामस्य हर्षः पुत्रो ऽभूद् देवानन्दो व्यजायत । इत्येष वै सुखोदर्कः सर्गो धर्मस्य कीर्तितः
verses.transliteration: kāmasya harṣaḥ putro 'bhūd devānando vyajāyata / ityeṣa vai sukhodarkaḥ sargo dharmasya kīrtitaḥ
verses.translation: The great seed called Mahat, consisting of both Pradhana and Purusa, appeared when Pradhana and the ancient Purusa were being agitated.
verses.hindi: आप ही धाता, विधाता और स्वयम्भू पितामह हैं। (मैंने) इर्ष्या-द्वेषके कारण अपने (शरीरके) द्वारोंको बंद नहीं किया, अपितु लीला करनेकी इच्छासे ही मैंने ऐसा किया न कि आपको बाधा पहुँचानेकी दृष्टिसे। देवाधिदेव पितामह आपको भला कौन बाधा पहुँचाना चाहेगा। आपको कुछ अन्यथा नहीं समझना चाहिए। आप मेरे लिये सभी प्रकारसे मान्य हैं। मेरे द्वारा जो आपका अपहरण हुआ है, उसमें आप सभी प्रकारसे
verses.wordMeaning: The great seed called Mahat, consisting of both Pradhana and Purusa, appeared when Pradhana and the ancient Purusa were being agitated.
verses.commentary: Sense: The great seed called Mahat, consisting of both Pradhana and Purusa, appeared when Pradhana and the ancient Purusa were being agitated.

verses.sanskrit: जज्ञे हिंसा त्वधर्माद् वै निकृतिं चानृतं सुतम् । निकृत्यनृतयोर्जज्ञे भयं नरक एव च
verses.transliteration: jajñe hiṃsā tvadharmād vai nikṛtiṃ cānṛtaṃ sutam / nikṛtyanṛtayorjajñe bhayaṃ naraka eva ca
verses.translation: The great seed called Mahat, consisting of both Pradhana and Purusa, appeared when Pradhana and the ancient Purusa were being agitated.
verses.hindi: अपना कल्याण ही समझें। इसी कारण ब्रह्मन्! मेरी प्रीतिके लिये आप मेरे पुत्र बनें। जगन्मूर्ति! आप पद्मयोनि’ इस नामसे विख्यात हों॥ ३३--३६॥ तदनन्तर भगवान् देव (ब्रह्मा) -ने किरीटी (विष्णु) - को वर देकर अत्यन्त प्रसन्न होकर पुनः विष्णुसे कहा
verses.wordMeaning: The great seed called Mahat, consisting of both Pradhana and Purusa, appeared when Pradhana and the ancient Purusa were being agitated.
verses.commentary: Sense: The great seed called Mahat, consisting of both Pradhana and Purusa, appeared when Pradhana and the ancient Purusa were being agitated.

verses.sanskrit: माया च वेदना चैव मिथुनं त्विदमेतयोः । भयाज्जज्ञे ऽथ वै माया मृत्युं भूतापहारिणम्
verses.transliteration: māyā ca vedanā caiva mithunaṃ tvidametayoḥ / bhayājjajñe 'tha vai māyā mṛtyuṃ bhūtāpahāriṇam
verses.translation: The great seed called Mahat, consisting of both Pradhana and Purusa, appeared when Pradhana and the ancient Purusa were being agitated.
verses.hindi: आप सभीके आत्मरूप हैं, अनन्त हैँ और सभीके परम ईश्वर हैं। आप सभी प्राणियोंकी अन्तरात्मा हैं तथा आप ही सनातन परब्रह्म हैं। में ही सभी लोकोंकी आत्मा एवं लोकमहेश्वर हूँ। यह सब कुछ मेरा ही स्वरूप है। मैं परम पुरुष ब्रह्मा हूँ। हम दोनोंके अतिरिक्त लोकोंका परमेश्वर दूसरा अन्य कोई नहीं है, नारायण और पितामहके रूपमें एक मूर्ति ही दो भागोंमें विभक्त हुई है॥ ३८--४० ॥
verses.wordMeaning: The great seed called Mahat, consisting of both Pradhana and Purusa, appeared when Pradhana and the ancient Purusa were being agitated.
verses.commentary: Sense: The great seed called Mahat, consisting of both Pradhana and Purusa, appeared when Pradhana and the ancient Purusa were being agitated.

verses.sanskrit: वेदना च सुतं चापि दुः खं जज्ञे ऽथ रौरवात् । मृत्योर्व्याधिजराशोकतृष्णाक्रोधाश्च जज्ञिरे
verses.transliteration: vedanā ca sutaṃ cāpi duḥ khaṃ jajñe 'tha rauravāt / mṛtyorvyādhijarāśokatṛṣṇākrodhāśca jajñire
verses.translation: The great seed called Mahat, consisting of both Pradhana and Purusa, appeared when Pradhana and the ancient Purusa were being agitated.
verses.hindi: उनके (ब्रह्माके) द्वारा ऐसा कहे जानेपर वासुदेव ब्रह्मासे इस प्रकार बोले--यह प्रतिज्ञा" आपके विनाशका कारण बनेगी। क्या आप ब्रह्माधिपति योगेश्वर, अव्यय एवं प्रधान पुरुष ईशान (शंकर)-को नहीं देख रहे हैं? मैं उन परमेश्वरको जानता हूँ। योगीन्द्र तथा सांख्यशास्त्रके ज्ञाता भी जिन महेश्वरका दर्शन नहीं कर पाते, आप उन्हीं अनादिनिधन ब्रह्मकी शरण ग्रहण करें॥ ४१--४३ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: The great seed called Mahat, consisting of both Pradhana and Purusa, appeared when Pradhana and the ancient Purusa were being agitated.
verses.commentary: Sense: The great seed called Mahat, consisting of both Pradhana and Purusa, appeared when Pradhana and the ancient Purusa were being agitated.

verses.sanskrit: दुः खोत्तराः स्मृता ह्येते सर्वे चाधर्मलक्षणाः । नैषां भार्यास्ति पुत्रो वा सर्वे ते ह्यूर्ध्वरेतसः
verses.transliteration: duḥ khottarāḥ smṛtā hyete sarve cādharmalakṣaṇāḥ / naiṣāṃ bhāryāsti putro vā sarve te hyūrdhvaretasaḥ
verses.translation: The great seed called Mahat, consisting of both Pradhana and Purusa, appeared when Pradhana and the ancient Purusa were being agitated.
verses.hindi: हम दोनोंके अतिरिक्त दूसरा परमेश्वर नहीं है-यह प्रतिज्ञा! तत: क्रुद्धोऽम्बुजाभाक्षं ब्रह्मा प्रोवाच केशवम्। भवान् न नूनमात्मानं वेत्ति तत् परमक्षरम्
verses.wordMeaning: The great seed called Mahat, consisting of both Pradhana and Purusa, appeared when Pradhana and the ancient Purusa were being agitated.
verses.commentary: Sense: The great seed called Mahat, consisting of both Pradhana and Purusa, appeared when Pradhana and the ancient Purusa were being agitated.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येष तामसः सर्गो जज्ञे धर्मनियामकः । संक्षेपेण मया प्रोक्ता विसृष्टिर्मुनिपुङ्गवा
verses.transliteration: ityeṣa tāmasaḥ sargo jajñe dharmaniyāmakaḥ / saṃkṣepeṇa mayā proktā visṛṣṭirmunipuṅgavā
verses.translation: The great seed called Mahat, consisting of both Pradhana and Purusa, appeared when Pradhana and the ancient Purusa were being agitated.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्माणं जगतामेकमात्मानं परमं पदम्। नावाभ्यां विद्यते ह्यन्यो लोकानां परमेश्वरः संत्यज्य निद्रां विपुलां स्वमात्मानं विलोकय। तस्य तत् क्रोधजं वाक्यं श्रुत्वा विष्णुरभाषत
verses.wordMeaning: The great seed called Mahat, consisting of both Pradhana and Purusa, appeared when Pradhana and the ancient Purusa were being agitated.
verses.commentary: Sense: The great seed called Mahat, consisting of both Pradhana and Purusa, appeared when Pradhana and the ancient Purusa were being agitated.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे ऽष्टमो ऽध्यायः सूत उवाच एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु वचनं नारदाद्या महर्षयः । प्रणम्य वरदं विष्णुं पप्रच्छुः संशयान्विता
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge 'ṣṭamo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca etacchrutvā tu vacanaṃ nāradādyā maharṣayaḥ / praṇamya varadaṃ viṣṇuṃ papracchuḥ saṃśayānvitā
verses.translation: It is stated in the scriptures that the Mahat, the Atman, the intellect, Brahma, Prabuddhi, Khydti (Faculty of discrimina¬ tion), isoar a, Prajhd (intelligence), DArti, Smrti (memory) and Sarhvit (knowledge)—all these originate from it.'
verses.hindi: न मेऽस्त्यविदितं ब्रह्मन् नान्यथाहं वदामि ते किन्तु मोहयति ब्रह्मन् भवन्तं पारमेश्वरी। मायाशेषविशेषाणां हेतुरात्मसमुद्भवा
verses.wordMeaning: It is stated in the scriptures that the Mahat, the Atman, the intellect, Brahma, Prabuddhi, Khydti (Faculty of discrimina¬ tion), isoar a, Prajhd (intelligence), DArti, Smrti (memory) and Sarhvit (knowledge)—all these originate from it.'
verses.commentary: Sense: It is stated in the scriptures that the Mahat, the Atman, the intellect, Brahma, Prabuddhi, Khydti (Faculty of discrimina¬ tion), isoar a, Prajhd (intelligence), DArti, Smrti (memory) and Sarhvit (knowledge)—all these originate from it.'

verses.sanskrit: ऋषय ऊचुः कथितो भवता सर्गो मुख्यादीनां जनार्दन । इदानीं संशयं चेममस्माकं छेत्तुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration: ṛṣaya ūcuḥ kathito bhavatā sargo mukhyādīnāṃ janārdana / idānīṃ saṃśayaṃ cemamasmākaṃ chettumarhasi
verses.translation: It is traditionally reported that this three-fold Ego viz. Vaikdrika (product of the Sattva Guria), Taijasa (born of Rajas) and Bhutddi (the origin of all elements), the product of Tamas, is evolved from Mahat?'
verses.hindi: एतावदुक्त्वा भगवान् विष्णुस्तूष्णीं बभूव ह। ज्ञात्वा तत् परमं तत्त्वं स्वमात्मानं महेश्वरम् प्रसादं ब्रह्मणे कर्तु प्रादुरासीत् ततो हरः
verses.wordMeaning: It is traditionally reported that this three-fold Ego viz. Vaikdrika (product of the Sattva Guria), Taijasa (born of Rajas) and Bhutddi (the origin of all elements), the product of Tamas, is evolved from Mahat?'
verses.commentary: Sense: It is traditionally reported that this three-fold Ego viz. Vaikdrika (product of the Sattva Guria), Taijasa (born of Rajas) and Bhutddi (the origin of all elements), the product of Tamas, is evolved from Mahat?'

verses.sanskrit: कथं स भगवानीशः पूर्वजो ऽपि पिनाकधृक् । पुत्रत्वमगच्छंभुर्ब्रह्मणो ऽव्यक्तजन्मनः
verses.transliteration: kathaṃ sa bhagavānīśaḥ pūrvajo 'pi pinākadhṛk / putratvamagacchaṃbhurbrahmaṇo 'vyaktajanmanaḥ
verses.translation: Aharfikdra is m.e.nnone.A (in scriptures) as Abhimdna (self-conceit or self-love), the Agent, the thinker, the Supreme Soul and the individual soul abiding in every one, and from whom all actions arise.
verses.hindi: दिव्यां विशालां ग्रथितां ग्रहैः सार्केन्दुतारकैः । मालामत्यद्भुताकारां धारयन् पादलम्बिनीम् तं दृष्टा देवमीशानं ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः । मोहितो माययात्यर्थं पीतवाससमब्रवीत्
verses.wordMeaning: Aharfikdra is m.e.nnone.A (in scriptures) as Abhimdna (self-conceit or self-love), the Agent, the thinker, the Supreme Soul and the individual soul abiding in every one, and from whom all actions arise.
verses.commentary: Sense: Aharfikdra is m.e.nnone.A (in scriptures) as Abhimdna (self-conceit or self-love), the Agent, the thinker, the Supreme Soul and the individual soul abiding in every one, and from whom all actions arise.

verses.sanskrit: कथं च भगवाञ्जज्ञे ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः । अण्डजो जगतामीशस्तन्नो वक्तुमिहार्हसि
verses.transliteration: kathaṃ ca bhagavāñjajñe brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ / aṇḍajo jagatāmīśastanno vaktumihārhasi
verses.translation: The five elements, the subtle potentials of elements {Tanmatras) and all the sense organs (y./. and gods presiding- over them) were evolved out of Ahamkara (the Ego). All the universe is thus born of it.
verses.hindi: अपश्यदीश्वरं देवं ज्वलन्तं विमलेऽम्भसि ज्ञात्वा तत्परमं भावमैश्वरं ब्रह्मभावनम्। प्रोवाचोत्थाय भगवान् देवदेवं पितामहम्
verses.wordMeaning: The five elements, the subtle potentials of elements {Tanmatras) and all the sense organs (y./. and gods presiding- over them) were evolved out of Ahamkara (the Ego). All the universe is thus born of it.
verses.commentary: Sense: The five elements, the subtle potentials of elements {Tanmatras) and all the sense organs (y./. and gods presiding- over them) were evolved out of Ahamkara (the Ego). All the universe is thus born of it.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीकूर्म उवाच शृणुध्वमृषयः सर्वे शङ्करस्यामितौजसः । पुत्रत्वं ब्रह्मणस्तस्य पद्मयोनित्वमेव च
verses.transliteration: śrīkūrma uvāca śṛṇudhvamṛṣayaḥ sarve śaṅkarasyāmitaujasaḥ / putratvaṃ brahmaṇastasya padmayonitvameva ca
verses.translation: The mind is said to be born of Avyakta and is mentioned as the first product whereby it becomes the doer and sees the Bh utadi and other types of Ahamkara.
verses.hindi: अरं देवो महादेव: स्वयंज्योतिः सनातनः । अनादिनिधनोऽचिन्त्यो लोकानामीश्वरो महान् तदनन्तर क्रुद्ध ब्रह्मने कमलकी आभाके समान नेत्रवाले केशवसे कहा--निश्चित ही आप अपने-आपको वह परम अक्षर, जगत्का एकमात्र आत्मरूप, ब्रह्मरूप, परम पद (शरण) नहीं जान रहे हैं। हम दोनोंके
verses.wordMeaning: The mind is said to be born of Avyakta and is mentioned as the first product whereby it becomes the doer and sees the Bh utadi and other types of Ahamkara.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mind is said to be born of Avyakta and is mentioned as the first product whereby it becomes the doer and sees the Bh utadi and other types of Ahamkara.

verses.sanskrit: अतीतकल्पावसाने तमोभूतं जगत् त्रयम् । आसीदेकार्णवं सर्वं न देवाद्या न चर्षयः
verses.transliteration: atītakalpāvasāne tamobhūtaṃ jagat trayam / āsīdekārṇavaṃ sarvaṃ na devādyā na carṣayaḥ
verses.translation: The creation from the Aharhkdra of the Vaikdrika type (which is evolved out of Sattva Gum) was also Vaikdrika. The sense organs are the products of Rajoguna and are called Taijasa, while the Vaikdrikas are the ten Devas presiding over the sense organs.
verses.hindi: अतिरिक्त लोकोंका परमेश्वर और दूसरा कोई विद्यमान नहीं है। आप दीर्घ निद्राका परित्याग कर अपने- आपको देखें (पहचानें) । उनके (ब्रह्माके) इस क्रोधयुक्त वचनको सुनकर विष्णुने कहा--हे कल्याण! इस प्रकार न कहें, इस प्रकार न कहें, (यह उन) महात्माकी निन्दा है। ब्रह्मन्! मेरे लिये कुछ भी अज्ञात नहीं है, मैं आपसे असत्य नहीं कह रहा हूँ। किंतु ब्रह्मन्! आत्मासे समुद्भूत समस्त विशेषोंकी हेतुभूत परमेश्वरकी माया ही आपको
verses.wordMeaning: The creation from the Aharhkdra of the Vaikdrika type (which is evolved out of Sattva Gum) was also Vaikdrika. The sense organs are the products of Rajoguna and are called Taijasa, while the Vaikdrikas are the ten Devas presiding over the sense organs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The creation from the Aharhkdra of the Vaikdrika type (which is evolved out of Sattva Gum) was also Vaikdrika. The sense organs are the products of Rajoguna and are called Taijasa, while the Vaikdrikas are the ten Devas presiding over the sense organs.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र नारायणो देवो निर्जने निरुपप्लवे । आश्रित्य शेषशयनं सुष्वाप पुरुषोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: tatra nārāyaṇo devo nirjane nirupaplave / āśritya śeṣaśayanaṃ suṣvāpa puruṣottamaḥ
verses.translation: The eleventh (sense organ (viz. the mind is of the nature of both by means of its own qualities. O Brahmanas, this creation of gross and subtle elements is evolved out of the Bhutddi (the TdrmsicVgo).
verses.hindi: मोहित कर रही है॥ ४४--४८ ॥ इतना कहकर भगवान् विष्णु अपने आत्मरूप महेश्वरको उस सर्वोत्कृष्ट परम तत्त्वके रूपमें जानकर चुप हो गये
verses.wordMeaning: The eleventh (sense organ (viz. the mind is of the nature of both by means of its own qualities. O Brahmanas, this creation of gross and subtle elements is evolved out of the Bhutddi (the TdrmsicVgo).
verses.commentary: Sense: The eleventh (sense organ (viz. the mind is of the nature of both by means of its own qualities. O Brahmanas, this creation of gross and subtle elements is evolved out of the Bhutddi (the TdrmsicVgo).

verses.sanskrit: सहस्त्रशीर्षा भूत्वा स सहस्त्राक्षः सहस्त्रपात् । सहस्त्रबाहुः सर्वज्ञश्चिन्त्यमानो मनीषिभिः
verses.transliteration: sahastraśīrṣā bhūtvā sa sahastrākṣaḥ sahastrapāt / sahastrabāhuḥ sarvajñaścintyamāno manīṣibhiḥ
verses.translation: It is traditionally said that when the Bhutddi under¬ goes modifications, it creates the subtle element of sound {Sabda- tanmdtra). The ether is born thereof and Sabda (Sound) is con-- sidered to be its quality.
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर ब्रह्माके ऊपर अनुग्रह करनेके लिये प्राणियोंके परम ईश्वर अपरिमेयात्मा (असीम सामर्थ्यसम्पन्न) हर (भगवान् शंकर) वहाँ प्रादुर्भूत हो गये। उन अनन्त (भगवान् शंकर)-के ललाटमें नेत्र था। वे जटामण्डलसे सुशोभित थे। तेजके परम निधि वे भगवान् हाथमें त्रिशूल लिये थे। उन्होंने सूर्य, चन्द्रमा, ग्रहों तथा नक्षत्रोंसे गुँथी हुई अद्भत आकारवाली चरणोंतक लटकती हुई लम्बी दिव्य विशाल मालाको धारण कर रखा था॥५०--५२॥
verses.wordMeaning: It is traditionally said that when the Bhutddi under¬ goes modifications, it creates the subtle element of sound {Sabda- tanmdtra). The ether is born thereof and Sabda (Sound) is con-- sidered to be its quality.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is traditionally said that when the Bhutddi under¬ goes modifications, it creates the subtle element of sound {Sabda- tanmdtra). The ether is born thereof and Sabda (Sound) is con-- sidered to be its quality.

verses.sanskrit: पीतवासा विशालाक्षो नीलजिमूतसन्निभः । महाविभूतिर्योगात्मा योगिनां हृदयालयः
verses.transliteration: pītavāsā viśālākṣo nīlajimūtasannibhaḥ / mahāvibhūtiryogātmā yogināṃ hṛdayālayaḥ
verses.translation: When the ether undergoes transformation, it evolves the subtle element of tangibility {Sparsa-tanmdtra). The wind is born therefrom and they know that its characteristic quality is touch.
verses.hindi: उन ईशानदेवको देखकर मायासे अत्यन्त मोहित लोकपितामह ब्रह्माने (अपनी रक्षाके लिये) पीताम्बरधारी (विष्णु)-से कहा--हे जनार्दन! हाथमें त्रिशूल धारण किये, त्रिनेत्रधारी, तेजकी राशिरूप, अमेयात्मा यह कौन अनन्त पुरुष (यहाँ) चला आ रहा है
verses.wordMeaning: When the ether undergoes transformation, it evolves the subtle element of tangibility {Sparsa-tanmdtra). The wind is born therefrom and they know that its characteristic quality is touch.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the ether undergoes transformation, it evolves the subtle element of tangibility {Sparsa-tanmdtra). The wind is born therefrom and they know that its characteristic quality is touch.

verses.sanskrit: कदाचित् तस्य सुप्तस्य लीलार्थं दिव्यमद्भुतम् । त्रैलोक्यसारं विमलं नाभ्यां पङ्कजमुद्वभौ
verses.transliteration: kadācit tasya suptasya līlārthaṃ divyamadbhutam / trailokyasāraṃ vimalaṃ nābhyāṃ paṅkajamudvabhau
verses.translation: When the wind undergoes transformation, it creates the Tanmdtra of Rupa (form). The fire is born of Vdyu and possession o{Rupa (form or colour) is said to be its characteristic.
verses.hindi: उनके (ब्रह्माके) इस वचनको सुनकर दानवोंका मर्दन करनेवाले विष्णुने निर्मल जलमें देदीप्यमान देव ईश्वरको देखा। ईशवर-सम्बन्धी उस परम भावरूप ब्रह्मभावको जानकर (महेश्वरमें परम तत्त्वका दर्शनकर) भगवान् (विष्णु) उठकर गये और देवदेव पितामहसे कहने लगे-
verses.wordMeaning: When the wind undergoes transformation, it creates the Tanmdtra of Rupa (form). The fire is born of Vdyu and possession o{Rupa (form or colour) is said to be its characteristic.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the wind undergoes transformation, it creates the Tanmdtra of Rupa (form). The fire is born of Vdyu and possession o{Rupa (form or colour) is said to be its characteristic.

verses.sanskrit: शतयोजनविस्तीर्णं तरुणादित्यसन्निभम् । दिव्यगन्धमयं पुण्यं कर्णिकाकेसरान्वितम्
verses.transliteration: śatayojanavistīrṇaṃ taruṇādityasannibham / divyagandhamayaṃ puṇyaṃ karṇikākesarānvitam
verses.translation: When the fire undergoes modification, it creates the subtle Tanmdtra oiRasa (taste or fiuidity). Therefrom the waters originate and are the receptacle of taste {Rasa).
verses.hindi: ये देव स्वयं प्रकाशित होनेवाले, सनातन, आदि और अन्तसे रहित, अचिन्त्य, महान्, समस्त लोकोंके ईश्वर महादेव हैं शंकरः शम्भुरीशानः सर्वात्मा परमेश्वर: । भूतानामधिपो योगी महेशो विमलः शिवः
verses.wordMeaning: When the fire undergoes modification, it creates the subtle Tanmdtra oiRasa (taste or fiuidity). Therefrom the waters originate and are the receptacle of taste {Rasa).
verses.commentary: Sense: When the fire undergoes modification, it creates the subtle Tanmdtra oiRasa (taste or fiuidity). Therefrom the waters originate and are the receptacle of taste {Rasa).

verses.sanskrit: तस्यैवं सुचिरं कालं वर्तमानस्य शार्ङ्गिणः । हिरण्यगर्भो भगवांस्तं देशमुपचक्रमे
verses.transliteration: tasyaivaṃ suciraṃ kālaṃ vartamānasya śārṅgiṇaḥ / hiraṇyagarbho bhagavāṃstaṃ deśamupacakrame
verses.translation: When waters underwent modification, they created the tanmdtra of smell {Gandha). The mass of earth is born therefrom,, and smell is considered to be its specific quality.
verses.hindi: यं प्रपश्यन्ति यतयो ब्रह्मभावेन भाविताः कालो भूत्वा महादेवः केवलो निष्कलः शिवः
verses.wordMeaning: When waters underwent modification, they created the tanmdtra of smell {Gandha). The mass of earth is born therefrom,, and smell is considered to be its specific quality.
verses.commentary: Sense: When waters underwent modification, they created the tanmdtra of smell {Gandha). The mass of earth is born therefrom,, and smell is considered to be its specific quality.

verses.sanskrit: स तं करेण विश्वात्मा समुत्थाप्य सनातनम् । प्रोवाच मधुरं वाक्यं मायया तस्य मोहितः
verses.transliteration: sa taṃ kareṇa viśvātmā samutthāpya sanātanam / provāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ māyayā tasya mohitaḥ
verses.translation: Akdsa (Ether), which has only the Tanmdtras of Sabda enveloped the Sparsa-Tanmdtra. Hence. Vdyu has two qualities viz. Sabda and Sparsa (sound and touch).
verses.hindi: ब्रह्माणं विदधे पूर्वं भवन्तं यः सनातनः। वेदांश्च प्रददौ तुभ्यं सोऽयमायाति शंकरः वासुदेवाभिधानां मामवेहि प्रपितामह ६२॥
verses.wordMeaning: Akdsa (Ether), which has only the Tanmdtras of Sabda enveloped the Sparsa-Tanmdtra. Hence. Vdyu has two qualities viz. Sabda and Sparsa (sound and touch).
verses.commentary: Sense: Akdsa (Ether), which has only the Tanmdtras of Sabda enveloped the Sparsa-Tanmdtra. Hence. Vdyu has two qualities viz. Sabda and Sparsa (sound and touch).

verses.sanskrit: अस्मिन्नेकार्णवे घोरे निर्जने तमसावृते । एकाकी को भवाञ्छेते ब्रूहि मे पुरुषर्षभ
verses.transliteration: asminnekārṇave ghore nirjane tamasāvṛte / ekākī ko bhavāñchete brūhi me puruṣarṣabha
verses.translation: The two Gunas —6'aWa and SparSa enter Rupa. There¬ fore, Vahni (Fire) shall have three Gums viz. Sabda, SparSa and Rupa (Sound, touch and colour).
verses.hindi: किं न पश्यसि योगेशं ब्रह्माधिपतिमव्ययम्। दिव्यं भवतु ते चक्षुर्येन द्रक्ष्यसि तत्परम् लब्ध्वा शैवं तदा चक्षुर्विष्णोर्लोकपितामहः। बुबुधे परमेशानं पुरतः समवस्थितम्
verses.wordMeaning: The two Gunas —6'aWa and SparSa enter Rupa. There¬ fore, Vahni (Fire) shall have three Gums viz. Sabda, SparSa and Rupa (Sound, touch and colour).
verses.commentary: Sense: The two Gunas —6'aWa and SparSa enter Rupa. There¬ fore, Vahni (Fire) shall have three Gums viz. Sabda, SparSa and Rupa (Sound, touch and colour).

verses.sanskrit: तस्य तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा विहस्य गरुडध्वजः । उवाच देवं ब्रह्माणं मेघगम्भीरनिः स्वनः
verses.transliteration: tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā vihasya garuḍadhvajaḥ / uvāca devaṃ brahmāṇaṃ meghagambhīraniḥ svanaḥ
verses.translation: Sound, touch and colour enter Rasa-tanmdtra. Hence waters characterised by taste should be known consisting of four Gvaias.
verses.hindi: प्रपेदे शरणं देवं तमेव पितरं शिवम् ओंकारं समनुस्मृत्य संस्तभ्यात्मानमात्मना। अथर्वशिरसा देवं तुष्टाव च कृताञ्जलिः
verses.wordMeaning: Sound, touch and colour enter Rasa-tanmdtra. Hence waters characterised by taste should be known consisting of four Gvaias.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sound, touch and colour enter Rasa-tanmdtra. Hence waters characterised by taste should be known consisting of four Gvaias.

verses.sanskrit: भो भो नारायणं देवं लोकानां प्रभवाप्ययम् । महायोगेश्वरं मां त्वं जानीहि पुरुषोत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: bho bho nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ lokānāṃ prabhavāpyayam / mahāyogeśvaraṃ māṃ tvaṃ jānīhi puruṣottamam
verses.translation: Sound, touch, colour and taste enveloped Gandha (smell). Hence the earth has five Gums. Among the elements, the earth is mentioned to be the grossest.
verses.hindi: संस्तुतस्तेन भगवान् ब्रह्मणा परमेश्वरः। अवाप परमां प्रीतिं व्याजहार स्मयन्निव मयैवोत्पादितः पूर्व 'लोकसृष्टयर्थमव्ययम्
verses.wordMeaning: Sound, touch, colour and taste enveloped Gandha (smell). Hence the earth has five Gums. Among the elements, the earth is mentioned to be the grossest.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sound, touch, colour and taste enveloped Gandha (smell). Hence the earth has five Gums. Among the elements, the earth is mentioned to be the grossest.

verses.sanskrit: मयि पश्य जगत् कृत्स्नं त्वां च लोकपितामहम् । सपर्वतमहाद्वीपं समुद्रैः सप्तभिर्वृतम्
verses.transliteration: mayi paśya jagat kṛtsnaṃ tvāṃ ca lokapitāmaham / saparvatamahādvīpaṃ samudraiḥ saptabhirvṛtam
verses.translation: Tranquillity, terribleness and dullness have been stated as their special characteristics and they (i.e. these elements) sustain each other by their inter-penetrability.
verses.hindi: स देवदेववचनं निशम्य कमलोद्भवः। निरीक्ष्य विष्णुं पुरुषं प्रणम्याह वृषध्वजम्
verses.wordMeaning: Tranquillity, terribleness and dullness have been stated as their special characteristics and they (i.e. these elements) sustain each other by their inter-penetrability.
verses.commentary: Sense: Tranquillity, terribleness and dullness have been stated as their special characteristics and they (i.e. these elements) sustain each other by their inter-penetrability.

verses.sanskrit: एवमाभाष्य विश्चात्मा प्रोवाच पुरुषं हरिः । जानन्नपि महायोगी को भवानिति वेधसम्
verses.transliteration: evamābhāṣya viścātmā provāca puruṣaṃ hariḥ / jānannapi mahāyogī ko bhavāniti vedhasam
verses.translation: These noblesouled (mighty) elements, though mutu¬ ally resorting were incapable of creating subjects (the universe) without complete union among all of them.
