verses.hindi: भगवन् भूतभव्येश महादेवाम्बिकापते। त्वामेव पुत्रमिच्छामि त्वया वा सदृशं सुतम् ये शंकर, शम्भु, ईशान, सर्वात्मा, परमेश्वर, समस्त प्राणियोंके एकमात्र स्वामी, योगी, महेश, विमल एवं शिवरूप (कल्याणरूप) है । ये ही धाता, विधाता, प्रधान पुरुष और ईश्वर हैं। यतिजन (संन्यासी लोग) ब्रह्मकी भावनासे भावित
verses.wordMeaning: These noblesouled (mighty) elements, though mutu¬ ally resorting were incapable of creating subjects (the universe) without complete union among all of them.
verses.commentary: Sense: These noblesouled (mighty) elements, though mutu¬ ally resorting were incapable of creating subjects (the universe) without complete union among all of them.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रहस्य भगवान् ब्रह्मा वेदनिधिः प्रभुः । प्रत्युवाचाम्बुजाभाक्षं सस्मितं श्लक्ष्णया गिरा
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prahasya bhagavān brahmā vedanidhiḥ prabhuḥ / pratyuvācāmbujābhākṣaṃ sasmitaṃ ślakṣṇayā girā
verses.translation: It is due to their being presided over by Purusa and the blessing of Avyakla that these beginning with Mahat and ending with Viiesa create the cosmic egg.
verses.hindi: होकर जिनका दर्शन करते हँ वे ही केवल, निष्कल, महादेव शिव काल बनकर सम्पूर्ण जगतूकी सृष्टि करते हैं, रक्षा करते हैं और संहार करते हैं ॥ ५८--६० ॥ ये वे ही शंकर आ रहे है, जिन सनातन (देव)- ने पूर्वकालमें आप ब्रह्माको बनाया और आपको वेद प्रदान किया। प्रपितामह! मुझे इनकी ही विश्वयोनि, सनातन एवं वासुदेव नामवाली दूसरी मूर्ति समझो! क्या
verses.wordMeaning: It is due to their being presided over by Purusa and the blessing of Avyakla that these beginning with Mahat and ending with Viiesa create the cosmic egg.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is due to their being presided over by Purusa and the blessing of Avyakla that these beginning with Mahat and ending with Viiesa create the cosmic egg.

verses.sanskrit: अहं धाता विधाता च स्वयंभूः प्रपितामहः । मय्येव संस्थितं विश्वं ब्रह्माहं विश्वतोमुखः
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ dhātā vidhātā ca svayaṃbhūḥ prapitāmahaḥ / mayyeva saṃsthitaṃ viśvaṃ brahmāhaṃ viśvatomukhaḥ
verses.translation: Like bubbles in the water forming simultaneously the (cosmic) egg originated from the simultaneously cumulative effect of ViSesas. It was very huge and it rested on the cosmic waters.
verses.hindi: आप ब्रह्माके भी अधिपति, अव्यय योगेश्‍वरको नहीं देख रहे हैं ? आपकी दिव्य दृष्टि हो जाय, जिससे आप उस परम (तत्त्व)-को देख सकें॥ ६१--६३॥ विष्णुसे इस प्रकार शैव-नेत्र (शिव-सम्बन्धी ज्ञान) प्रातकर लोक-पितामह (ब्रह्मा)-ने सामने अवस्थित परम ईशानको जाना । उन प्रपितामह (ब्रह्मा)-ने ईश्वर-सम्बन्धी परम ज्ञान प्राप्तकर उन्हीं पितृरूप देव शिवकी शरण
verses.wordMeaning: Like bubbles in the water forming simultaneously the (cosmic) egg originated from the simultaneously cumulative effect of ViSesas. It was very huge and it rested on the cosmic waters.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like bubbles in the water forming simultaneously the (cosmic) egg originated from the simultaneously cumulative effect of ViSesas. It was very huge and it rested on the cosmic waters.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा वाचं स भगवान् विष्णुः सत्यपराक्रमः । अनुज्ञाप्याथ योगेन प्रविष्टो ब्रह्मणस्तनुम्
verses.transliteration: śrutvā vācaṃ sa bhagavān viṣṇuḥ satyaparākramaḥ / anujñāpyātha yogena praviṣṭo brahmaṇastanum
verses.translation: When the Egg born of developed, the produc¬
verses.hindi: ग्रहण की। ओंकार (तत्त्व)-का अनुस्मरणकर और आत्माद्वारा मनका निरोधकर उन्होंने अथर्ववेदके मन्त्रोंसे हाथ जोड्ते हुए (उन) देवको प्रार्थना की ॥ ६४--६६ ॥ उन ब्रह्माके द्वारा स्तुति किये जानेपर भगवान् परमेश्वर (शिव)-को परम प्रीति प्राप्त हुई और वे मुसकराते हुए (इस प्रकार) बोले--
verses.wordMeaning: When the Egg born of developed, the produc¬
verses.commentary: Sense: When the Egg born of developed, the produc¬

verses.sanskrit: त्रलोक्यमेतत् सकलं सदेवासुरमानुषम् । उदरे तस्य देवस्य दृष्ट्वा विस्मयमागतः
verses.transliteration: tralokyametat sakalaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣam / udare tasya devasya dṛṣṭvā vismayamāgataḥ
verses.translation: He is the first embodied Being. He is called Purusa. Brahma, the first creator of living beings, existed at the begin¬ ning of the universe.
verses.hindi: तुम मेरे भक्त हो, इसलिये निःसंदेह तुम मेरे ही समान हो। मेरे द्वारा ही पहले संसारकी सृष्टि करनेके लिये तुम अव्ययको उत्पन्न किया गया था। मेरी देहसे कमलसे उत्पन्न उन ब्रह्याने देवाधिदेव (शंकर)- के इस वचनको सुनकर विष्णुकी ओर देखा और उन (परम) पुरुष वृषध्वज (शंकर)-को प्रणामकर उनसे कहा--
verses.wordMeaning: He is the first embodied Being. He is called Purusa. Brahma, the first creator of living beings, existed at the begin¬ ning of the universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: He is the first embodied Being. He is called Purusa. Brahma, the first creator of living beings, existed at the begin¬ ning of the universe.

verses.sanskrit: तदास्य वक्त्रान्निष्क्रम्य पन्नगेन्द्रनिकेतनः । अजातशत्रुर्भगवान् पितामहमथाब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tadāsya vaktrānniṣkramya pannagendraniketanaḥ / ajātaśatrurbhagavān pitāmahamathābravīt
verses.translation: Him the sages call Purusa (one abiding in the body), Swan, Hiranya-garbha (one born of a golden egg), transcendental to Pradhana, of tawny-colour, the embodiment of the Vedas, the eternal.
verses.hindi: हे भगवन्! भूत एवं भविष्यके स्वामी ! महादेव! अम्बिकाके पति! मैं आपको ही पुत्र-रूपमें अथवा आपके ही समान पुत्र प्राप्त करनेकी इच्छा करता हूँ मोहितो5स्मि महादेव मायया सूक्ष्मया त्वया। न जाने परमं भावं याथातथ्येन ते शिव
verses.wordMeaning: Him the sages call Purusa (one abiding in the body), Swan, Hiranya-garbha (one born of a golden egg), transcendental to Pradhana, of tawny-colour, the embodiment of the Vedas, the eternal.
verses.commentary: Sense: Him the sages call Purusa (one abiding in the body), Swan, Hiranya-garbha (one born of a golden egg), transcendental to Pradhana, of tawny-colour, the embodiment of the Vedas, the eternal.

verses.sanskrit: भवानप्येवमेवाद्य शाश्वतं हि ममोहरम् । प्रविश्य लोकान् पश्यैतान् विचित्रान् पुरुषर्षभ
verses.transliteration: bhavānapyevamevādya śāśvataṃ hi mamoharam / praviśya lokān paśyaitān vicitrān puruṣarṣabha
verses.translation: Mount Meru became his foetus and mountains, the embryo. The oceans became the foetal fiuid of that great soul.
verses.hindi: त्वमेव देव भक्तानां भ्राता माता पिता सुहत्। प्रसीद तव पादाब्जं नमामि शरणं गत: व्याजहार तदा पुत्रं समालोक्य जनार्दनम्
verses.wordMeaning: Mount Meru became his foetus and mountains, the embryo. The oceans became the foetal fiuid of that great soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: Mount Meru became his foetus and mountains, the embryo. The oceans became the foetal fiuid of that great soul.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रह्लादनीं वाणी श्रुत्वा तस्याभिनन्द्य च । श्रीपतेरुदरं भूयः प्रविवेश कुशध्वजः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prahlādanīṃ vāṇī śrutvā tasyābhinandya ca / śrīpaterudaraṃ bhūyaḥ praviveśa kuśadhvajaḥ
verses.translation: Within that cosmic Egg evolved the universe consist¬ ing of Devas, Asuras and human beings, the Moon, the Sun, the constellations, the planets and the wind.
verses.hindi: यदर्थितं भगवता तत् करिष्यामि पुत्रक । विज्ञानमैश्वरं दिव्यमुत्पत्स्यति तवानघ त्वमेव सर्वभूतानामादिकर्ता नियोजितः। तथा कुरुष्व देवेश मया लोकपितामह
verses.wordMeaning: Within that cosmic Egg evolved the universe consist¬ ing of Devas, Asuras and human beings, the Moon, the Sun, the constellations, the planets and the wind.
verses.commentary: Sense: Within that cosmic Egg evolved the universe consist¬ ing of Devas, Asuras and human beings, the Moon, the Sun, the constellations, the planets and the wind.

verses.sanskrit: तानेव लोकान् गर्भस्थानपश्यत् सत्यविक्रमः । पर्यटित्वा तु देवस्य ददृशे ऽन्तं न वै हरेः
verses.transliteration: tāneva lokān garbhasthānapaśyat satyavikramaḥ / paryaṭitvā tu devasya dadṛśe 'ntaṃ na vai hareḥ
verses.translation: The Egg is externally encircled by waters ten times in magnitude. The waters are externally wrapped up by fire ten times in magnitude.
verses.hindi: एष नारायणोऽनन्तो ममैव परमा तनु: । भविष्यति तवेशानो योगक्षेमबहो हरि: संस्पृश्य देवं ब्रह्माणं हरिं वचनमब्रवीत्
verses.wordMeaning: The Egg is externally encircled by waters ten times in magnitude. The waters are externally wrapped up by fire ten times in magnitude.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Egg is externally encircled by waters ten times in magnitude. The waters are externally wrapped up by fire ten times in magnitude.

verses.sanskrit: ततो द्वाराणि सर्वाणि पिहितानि महात्मना । जनार्दनेन ब्रह्मासौ नाभ्यां द्वारमविन्दत
verses.transliteration: tato dvārāṇi sarvāṇi pihitāni mahātmanā / janārdanena brahmāsau nābhyāṃ dvāramavindata
verses.translation: The enveloping fires themselves are externally surrounded by the Vdyu (wind) ten times in magnitude. The Vdyu is enveloped by Akdsa (ether) and the ether is encircled by Bhutddi ( Tdmasic Ego).
verses.hindi: श्रुत्वाथ देववचनं विष्णुर्विश्वजगन्मयः। प्राह प्रसन्नया वाचा समालोक्य चतुर्मुखम् तथेत्युक्त्वा महादेवः पुनर्विष्णुमभाषत। भवान् सर्वस्य कार्यस्य कर्ताहमधिहैवतम्
verses.wordMeaning: The enveloping fires themselves are externally surrounded by the Vdyu (wind) ten times in magnitude. The Vdyu is enveloped by Akdsa (ether) and the ether is encircled by Bhutddi ( Tdmasic Ego).
verses.commentary: Sense: The enveloping fires themselves are externally surrounded by the Vdyu (wind) ten times in magnitude. The Vdyu is enveloped by Akdsa (ether) and the ether is encircled by Bhutddi ( Tdmasic Ego).

verses.sanskrit: तत्र योगबलेनासौ प्रविश्य कनकाण्डजः । उज्जहारात्मनो रूपं पुष्कराच्चतुराननः
verses.transliteration: tatra yogabalenāsau praviśya kanakāṇḍajaḥ / ujjahārātmano rūpaṃ puṣkarāccaturānanaḥ
verses.translation: They are omniscient and have their qualities of Rajas subsided. They are perpetually delighted in their minds. The Cosmic Egg is surrounded by these seven sheaths originat¬ ing from Prakrtiy
verses.hindi: भवान् सोमस्त्वहं सूर्यो भवान् रात्रिरहं दिनम् भवान् विद्यात्मिका शक्तिः शक्तिमानहमीश्वरः। योऽहं सुनिष्कलो देवः सोऽपि नारायणः परः
verses.wordMeaning: They are omniscient and have their qualities of Rajas subsided. They are perpetually delighted in their minds. The Cosmic Egg is surrounded by these seven sheaths originat¬ ing from Prakrtiy
verses.commentary: Sense: They are omniscient and have their qualities of Rajas subsided. They are perpetually delighted in their minds. The Cosmic Egg is surrounded by these seven sheaths originat¬ ing from Prakrtiy

verses.sanskrit: विरराजारविन्दस्थः पद्मगर्भसमद्युतिः । ब्रह्मा स्वयंभूर्भगवान् जगद्योनिः पितामहः
verses.transliteration: virarājāravindasthaḥ padmagarbhasamadyutiḥ / brahmā svayaṃbhūrbhagavān jagadyoniḥ pitāmahaḥ
verses.translation: This much can be explained, O Brahmanas. This Mdyd is very mysterious. What has been mentioned asBija (seed) 2 by me, is the working of Pradhdna (the primordial nature).
verses.hindi: एकीभावेन पश्यन्ति योगिनो ब्रह्मवादिनः । पालयैततज्जगत् कृत्स्नं सदेवासुरमानुषम्
verses.wordMeaning: This much can be explained, O Brahmanas. This Mdyd is very mysterious. What has been mentioned asBija (seed) 2 by me, is the working of Pradhdna (the primordial nature).
verses.commentary: Sense: This much can be explained, O Brahmanas. This Mdyd is very mysterious. What has been mentioned asBija (seed) 2 by me, is the working of Pradhdna (the primordial nature).

verses.sanskrit: समन्यमानो विश्वेशमात्मानं परमं पदम् । प्रोवाच पुरुषं विष्णुं मेघगम्भीरया गिरा
verses.transliteration: samanyamāno viśveśamātmānaṃ paramaṃ padam / provāca puruṣaṃ viṣṇuṃ meghagambhīrayā girā
verses.translation: That Pradhdna is the first, primordial body of god Prajapati; it is known through the Vedic tradition. The entire Brahmdnda is endowed with the strength* of the seven spheres.
verses.hindi: महादेव! मैं आपकी सूक्ष्म मायाद्वारा मोहित कर लिया गया हूँ। शिव! मैं आपके परम भावको यथार्थ- रूपमे नहीं जानता हूँ। देव! आप ही भक्तोंके माता- पिता, भाई तथा मित्र हैं। आप प्रसन्न हों। में आपके चरणकमलोंमें प्रणाम करता हूँ और आपको शरण ग्रहण करता हूँ
verses.wordMeaning: That Pradhdna is the first, primordial body of god Prajapati; it is known through the Vedic tradition. The entire Brahmdnda is endowed with the strength* of the seven spheres.
verses.commentary: Sense: That Pradhdna is the first, primordial body of god Prajapati; it is known through the Vedic tradition. The entire Brahmdnda is endowed with the strength* of the seven spheres.

verses.sanskrit: किं कृतं भवतेदानीमात्मनो जयकाङ्क्षया । एको ऽहं प्रबलो नान्यो मां वै को ऽबिभविष्यति
verses.transliteration: kiṃ kṛtaṃ bhavatedānīmātmano jayakāṅkṣayā / eko 'haṃ prabalo nānyo māṃ vai ko 'bibhaviṣyati
verses.translation: By means of Lilas (sportive activity) the Lord of Yoga creates and dissolves bodies of diverse shapes, activities, features and names.
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर जगतूके स्वामी वृषध्वज (शंकर)-ने उनके वचन सुनकर पुत्र (रूप) जनार्दन (विष्णु)-की ओर देखकर (ब्रह्मासे) कहा- हे पुत्रक! तुमने जैसी इच्छा की है मैं वैसा ही करूंगा। अनघ! तुम्हें ईशवर-सम्बन्धी दिव्य ज्ञान प्राप्त होगा। मेरे द्वारा तुम्हीं सभी प्राणियोंके प्रथम स्रष्टाके रूपमें नियुक्त किये गये हो। अतः देवेश! लोकपितामह!
verses.wordMeaning: By means of Lilas (sportive activity) the Lord of Yoga creates and dissolves bodies of diverse shapes, activities, features and names.
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of Lilas (sportive activity) the Lord of Yoga creates and dissolves bodies of diverse shapes, activities, features and names.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा नारायणो वाक्यं ब्रह्मणो लोकतन्त्रिणः । सान्त्वपूर्वमिदं वाक्यं बभाषे मधुरं हरिः
verses.transliteration: śrutvā nārāyaṇo vākyaṃ brahmaṇo lokatantriṇaḥ / sāntvapūrvamidaṃ vākyaṃ babhāṣe madhuraṃ hariḥ
verses.translation: For the welfare of the devotees, he devours them again. He divides himself into three and functions in the three worlds.
verses.hindi: तुम वैसा ही करो। ये नारायण एवं अनन्त (भगवान् विष्णु) मेरी ही श्रेष्ठ मूर्ति हैं। ये ईशान हरि तुम्हारे योग-क्षेमका वहन करनेवाले होंगे ॥ ७५--७७ ॥ ऐसा कहकर प्रसन्नचित्त परमेश्वर (शिव) -ने हाथांसे देव ब्रह्माका स्पर्शकर हरि (विष्णु)-से कहा--हे जगन्मूर्ति! तुम्हारी भक्तिसे मैं तुमपर सर्वथा प्रसन्न हूँ। वर माँगो। तत्त्वत: हम दोनों भिन्न नहीं हैं
verses.wordMeaning: For the welfare of the devotees, he devours them again. He divides himself into three and functions in the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: For the welfare of the devotees, he devours them again. He divides himself into three and functions in the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: भवान् धाता विधाता च स्वयंभूः प्रपितामहः । न मात्सर्याभियोगेन द्वाराणि पिहितानि मे
verses.transliteration: bhavān dhātā vidhātā ca svayaṃbhūḥ prapitāmahaḥ / na mātsaryābhiyogena dvārāṇi pihitāni me
verses.translation: He creates and swallows them. He particularly pro¬ tects them, because after creating the subjects, he blesses them and swallows them again.
verses.hindi: इसके बाद महादेवका वचन सुनकर विश्वमय, जगन्मय विष्णुने चतुर्मुख ब्रह्माकी ओर देखकर प्रीतियुक्त वाणीमें (महादेवसे) कहा-मेरे लिये यही श्लाघनीय वर है कि मैं आप परमेश्वर परमात्माका दर्शन कर रहा हूँ। मेरी आपमें भक्ति हो
verses.wordMeaning: He creates and swallows them. He particularly pro¬ tects them, because after creating the subjects, he blesses them and swallows them again.
verses.commentary: Sense: He creates and swallows them. He particularly pro¬ tects them, because after creating the subjects, he blesses them and swallows them again.

verses.sanskrit: किन्तु लीलार्थमेवैतन्न त्वां बाधितुमिच्छया । को हि बाधितुमन्विच्छेद् देवदेवं पितामहम्
verses.transliteration: kintu līlārthamevaitanna tvāṃ bādhitumicchayā / ko hi bādhitumanvicched devadevaṃ pitāmaham
verses.translation: Hence (due to his persistent existence) in all the three periods of time, he is called one, in view of his being endowed with Gums. At the outset, he manifested himself as the eternal Hiranyagarbha.
verses.hindi: “ऐसा ही हो» यह कहकर महादेवने पुनः विष्णुसे कहा-आप सभी कार्योके कर्ता हैं और में अधिदेवता हूँ। यह सब कुछ मेरा और आपका ही रूप है, इसमें कोई संदेह नहीं है। आप चन्द्रमा हैं, मैं सूर्य हूँ। आप रात्रि हैं, मैं दिन हूँ। आप प्रकृति हैं और मैं ही अव्यक्त पुरुष हूँ। आप ज्ञानरूप हैं और में ज्ञाता हूँ,आप मायारूप हैं और मैं ईश्वर हूँ। आप विद्यात्मिका शक्ति हैं, मैं शक्तिमान् ईश्वर हूँ और निष्कल देव परस्वरूप
verses.wordMeaning: Hence (due to his persistent existence) in all the three periods of time, he is called one, in view of his being endowed with Gums. At the outset, he manifested himself as the eternal Hiranyagarbha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence (due to his persistent existence) in all the three periods of time, he is called one, in view of his being endowed with Gums. At the outset, he manifested himself as the eternal Hiranyagarbha.

verses.sanskrit: न ते ऽन्यथावगन्तव्यं मान्यो मे सर्वथा भवान् । सर्वमन्वय कल्याणं यन्मयापहृतं तव
verses.transliteration: na te 'nyathāvagantavyaṃ mānyo me sarvathā bhavān / sarvamanvaya kalyāṇaṃ yanmayāpahṛtaṃ tava
verses.translation: He is called Adideva (the primordial god) because he is the first one in the beginning; since he is not born, he is called Aja. Since he protects all the subjects, he is called Prajdpati.
verses.hindi: नारायण भी में ही हूँ ब्रह्मवादी योगी (हम दोनोंको) एक भावसे ही देखते हैं। है विश्वात्मन्! बिना आपका आश्रय ग्रहण किये योगी मुझे प्राप्त नहीं कर सकते हैं। आप देवता, असुर तथा मनुष्योंसे युक्त इस सम्पूर्ण जगतका पालन करें
verses.wordMeaning: He is called Adideva (the primordial god) because he is the first one in the beginning; since he is not born, he is called Aja. Since he protects all the subjects, he is called Prajdpati.
verses.commentary: Sense: He is called Adideva (the primordial god) because he is the first one in the beginning; since he is not born, he is called Aja. Since he protects all the subjects, he is called Prajdpati.

verses.sanskrit: अस्माच्च कारणाद् ब्रह्मन् पुत्रो भवतु मे भवान् । पद्मयोनिरिति ख्यातो मत्प्रियार्थं जगन्मय
verses.transliteration: asmācca kāraṇād brahman putro bhavatu me bhavān / padmayoniriti khyāto matpriyārthaṃ jaganmaya
verses.translation: Since he is the greatest Deity among gods, he is designated as Mahadeva\ in view of his vastness, he is called Brahma,', in view of his supreme nature, he is called Paramesvara (the Supreme Ruler).
verses.hindi: इतीदमुक्त्वा भगवाननादिः ऐसा कहकर अपनी मायासे सम्पूर्ण प्राणियोंको
verses.wordMeaning: Since he is the greatest Deity among gods, he is designated as Mahadeva\ in view of his vastness, he is called Brahma,', in view of his supreme nature, he is called Paramesvara (the Supreme Ruler).
verses.commentary: Sense: Since he is the greatest Deity among gods, he is designated as Mahadeva\ in view of his vastness, he is called Brahma,', in view of his supreme nature, he is called Paramesvara (the Supreme Ruler).

verses.sanskrit: ततः स भगवान् देवो वरं दत्त्वा किरीटिने । प्रहर्षमतुलं गत्वा पुनर्विष्णुमभाषत
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa bhagavān devo varaṃ dattvā kirīṭine / praharṣamatulaṃ gatvā punarviṣṇumabhāṣata
verses.translation: He is technically termed ISvara because he is Vasin (full of self-control) and Avaj/a (not liable to be subjected to any one else's control). He is called because he is omni¬ present or capable of going everywhere. He is Hari because he is the remover of every thing.
verses.hindi: मोहित करनेवाले अनादि एवं अनन्तशक्तिसम्पन्न भगवान् जन्म, विकास एवं विनाशसे रहित (अपने) अव्यक्त धाम (स्थान)-को चले गये
verses.wordMeaning: He is technically termed ISvara because he is Vasin (full of self-control) and Avaj/a (not liable to be subjected to any one else's control). He is called because he is omni¬ present or capable of going everywhere. He is Hari because he is the remover of every thing.
verses.commentary: Sense: He is technically termed ISvara because he is Vasin (full of self-control) and Avaj/a (not liable to be subjected to any one else's control). He is called because he is omni¬ present or capable of going everywhere. He is Hari because he is the remover of every thing.

verses.sanskrit: भवान् सर्वात्मको ऽनन्तः सर्वेषां परमेश्वरः । सर्वभूतान्तरात्मा वै परं बह्म सनातनम्
verses.transliteration: bhavān sarvātmako 'nantaḥ sarveṣāṃ parameśvaraḥ / sarvabhūtāntarātmā vai paraṃ bahma sanātanam
verses.translation: He is remembered as Svayambhu because he is unborn and is prior to all. Since he is the goal ( Ay and) of men {Nard) he is called Ndrdyana. {v.l. ndrdndm ayanarn —As his abode is the Cosmic waters).
verses.hindi: विष्णुद्वारा मधु तथा कैटभका वध, नाभिकमलसे ब्रह्माकी उत्पत्ति तथा उनके द्वारा सनकादिकी वर्णन, रुद्रके द्वारा अनेक रूद्रोंकी उत्पत्ति तथा पुनः वैराग्य ग्रहण करना, ब्रह्माद्वारा रुद्रकी स्तुति तथा माहात्म्य-वर्णन, रुद्रद्वारा ब्रह्माको ज्ञानकी प्राप्ति, महादेवका त्रिमूर्तित्व और ब्रह्माद्वारा अनेक प्रकारकी सृष्टि
verses.wordMeaning: He is remembered as Svayambhu because he is unborn and is prior to all. Since he is the goal ( Ay and) of men {Nard) he is called Ndrdyana. {v.l. ndrdndm ayanarn —As his abode is the Cosmic waters).
verses.commentary: Sense: He is remembered as Svayambhu because he is unborn and is prior to all. Since he is the goal ( Ay and) of men {Nard) he is called Ndrdyana. {v.l. ndrdndm ayanarn —As his abode is the Cosmic waters).

verses.sanskrit: अहं वै सर्वलोकानामात्मा लोकमहेश्वरः । मन्मयं सर्वमेवेदं ब्रह्माहं पुरुषः परः
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ vai sarvalokānāmātmā lokamaheśvaraḥ / manmayaṃ sarvamevedaṃ brahmāhaṃ puruṣaḥ paraḥ
verses.translation: He is called Hara, because he removes the (bondage of) worldly existence. He is called Vism because of his omni¬ presence iyibhutva). He is called Bhagavdn, becasuse he knows everything perfectly; he is called OM because he protects {avandt) all.
verses.hindi: गते महेश्वरे देवे स्वाधिवासं पितामहः । तदेव सुमहत् पदाँ भेजे नाभिसमुत्थितम् अथ दीर्घेण कालेन तत्राप्रतिमपौरुषौ। महासुरौ समायातौ भ्रातरौ मधुकैटभौ
verses.wordMeaning: He is called Hara, because he removes the (bondage of) worldly existence. He is called Vism because of his omni¬ presence iyibhutva). He is called Bhagavdn, becasuse he knows everything perfectly; he is called OM because he protects {avandt) all.
verses.commentary: Sense: He is called Hara, because he removes the (bondage of) worldly existence. He is called Vism because of his omni¬ presence iyibhutva). He is called Bhagavdn, becasuse he knows everything perfectly; he is called OM because he protects {avandt) all.

verses.sanskrit: नावाभ्यां विद्यते ह्यन्यो लोकानां परमेश्वरः । एका मूर्तिर्द्विधा भिन्ना नारायणपितामहौ
verses.transliteration: nāvābhyāṃ vidyate hyanyo lokānāṃ parameśvaraḥ / ekā mūrtirdvidhā bhinnā nārāyaṇapitāmahau
verses.translation: He is Sarvajna, because he knows everything. He is Sarva because he is identical with all; since he is free from impurities, he is known as Siva) since he is present everywhere he is called Vibhu.
verses.hindi: कर्णान्तरसमुदभूतौ देवदेवस्य शारङ्गिणः तावागतौ समीक्ष्याह नारायणमजो विभुः। त्रैलोक्यकण्टकावेतावसुरौ हइन्तुमहसि
verses.wordMeaning: He is Sarvajna, because he knows everything. He is Sarva because he is identical with all; since he is free from impurities, he is known as Siva) since he is present everywhere he is called Vibhu.
verses.commentary: Sense: He is Sarvajna, because he knows everything. He is Sarva because he is identical with all; since he is free from impurities, he is known as Siva) since he is present everywhere he is called Vibhu.

verses.sanskrit: तेनैवमुक्तो ब्रह्माणं वासुदेवो ऽब्रवीदिदम् । इयं प्रतिज्ञा भवतो विनाशाय भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: tenaivamukto brahmāṇaṃ vāsudevo 'bravīdidam / iyaṃ pratijñā bhavato vināśāya bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: Since he saves (beings) from all miseries, he is ex¬ tolled as Tdraka. Of what avail is much talk? The entire universe is full Brahma (i.e. identical with Brahman), {v.l. full of i.e. thoroughly pervaded by Visnu)
verses.hindi: तस्य तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा हरिर्नारायणः प्रभुः । आज्ञापयामास तयोर्वधार्थ पुरुषावुभौ व्यनयत् कैटभं विष्णुर्जिष्णुश्च व्यनयन्मधुम्
verses.wordMeaning: Since he saves (beings) from all miseries, he is ex¬ tolled as Tdraka. Of what avail is much talk? The entire universe is full Brahma (i.e. identical with Brahman), {v.l. full of i.e. thoroughly pervaded by Visnu)
verses.commentary: Sense: Since he saves (beings) from all miseries, he is ex¬ tolled as Tdraka. Of what avail is much talk? The entire universe is full Brahma (i.e. identical with Brahman), {v.l. full of i.e. thoroughly pervaded by Visnu)

verses.sanskrit: किं न पश्यसि योगेशं ब्रह्माधिपतिमव्ययम् । प्रधानपुरुषेशानं वेदाहं परमेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: kiṃ na paśyasi yogeśaṃ brahmādhipatimavyayam / pradhānapuruṣeśānaṃ vedāhaṃ parameśvaram
verses.translation: The Supreme Lord differentiating himself in his multiformity, sports about.
verses.hindi: श्रीकूर्मने कहा--महेश्वर देवके अपने निवास- स्थानपर चले जानेके बाद पितामह (ब्रह्मा), (भगवान् विष्णुको) नाभिसे उत्पन्न उसी विशाल सुन्दर कमलपर रहने लगे एक लम्बा समय व्यतीत हो जानेपर वहाँ अतुलित
verses.wordMeaning: The Supreme Lord differentiating himself in his multiformity, sports about.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Supreme Lord differentiating himself in his multiformity, sports about.

verses.sanskrit: यं न पश्यन्ति योगीन्द्राः सांख्या अपि महेश्वरम् । अनादिनिधनं ब्रह्म तमेव शरणं व्रज
verses.transliteration: yaṃ na paśyanti yogīndrāḥ sāṃkhyā api maheśvaram / anādinidhanaṃ brahma tameva śaraṇaṃ vraja
verses.translation: All these Manus are grouped under the name 'Savarni' as the epithet 'Savarni' is common to them all viz. Savarni Manu, Daksa S. (Savarni), Brahma S., Dharma S., Rudra S., Raucya S. and Bhautya S.
verses.hindi: परस्पर भाई थे। देवोंके भी देव शाररङ्गधारी भगवान् विष्णुके कानसे उत्पन्न तथा विशाल पर्वतके समान शरीरवाले और महान् क्रोधसे आविष्ट उन दोनों (मधु- कैटभ) -को आया हुआ देखकर अजन्मा, विभु (ब्रह्मा) - ने नारायणसे कहा--ये दोनों असुर तीनों लोकोंके लिये कण्टक हैं, आप इन्हें मारें
verses.wordMeaning: All these Manus are grouped under the name 'Savarni' as the epithet 'Savarni' is common to them all viz. Savarni Manu, Daksa S. (Savarni), Brahma S., Dharma S., Rudra S., Raucya S. and Bhautya S.
verses.commentary: Sense: All these Manus are grouped under the name 'Savarni' as the epithet 'Savarni' is common to them all viz. Savarni Manu, Daksa S. (Savarni), Brahma S., Dharma S., Rudra S., Raucya S. and Bhautya S.

verses.sanskrit: ततः क्रुद्धो ऽम्बुजाभाक्षं ब्रह्मा प्रोवाच केशवम् । भवान् न नूनमात्मानं वेत्ति तत् परमक्षरम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kruddho 'mbujābhākṣaṃ brahmā provāca keśavam / bhavān na nūnamātmānaṃ vetti tat paramakṣaram
verses.translation: VV. 21-24 are quoted in CCKdla ( ), Kdla-mddhava ( ) and PuTusartha-cintamani ( ). The verses are important as here Time is equated with the Almighty eternal God—the Supra-phenomenal Reality.
verses.hindi: उनके इस वचनको सुनकर प्रभु नारायण हरिने उन दोनोंका वध करनेके लिये (जिष्णु तथा विष्णु नामक) दो पुरुषोंको आज्ञा दी हे ब्राह्मणो! उनकी आज्ञासे उन (विष्णु तथा जिष्णु)-से उन दोनों (मधु-कैटभ) असुरोंका महान् युद्ध हुआ। विष्णुने कैटभको जीता और जिष्णुने मधुको जीता  तदनन्तर स्नेहसे आविष्ट मनवाले हरिने कमलके
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 21-24 are quoted in CCKdla ( ), Kdla-mddhava ( ) and PuTusartha-cintamani ( ). The verses are important as here Time is equated with the Almighty eternal God—the Supra-phenomenal Reality.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 21-24 are quoted in CCKdla ( ), Kdla-mddhava ( ) and PuTusartha-cintamani ( ). The verses are important as here Time is equated with the Almighty eternal God—the Supra-phenomenal Reality.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्माणं जगतामेकमात्मानं परमं पदम् । नावाभ्यां विद्यते ह्यन्यो लोकानां परमेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: brahmāṇaṃ jagatāmekamātmānaṃ paramaṃ padam / nāvābhyāṃ vidyate hyanyo lokānāṃ parameśvaraḥ
verses.translation: VV. 6-9 give Time as follows:
verses.hindi: आसनपर आसीन तथा जगन्नाथ पितामहसे मधुर वचन कहा- प्रभो! मेरे कहनेसे आप अब इस कमलसे नीचे उतरें। तेजोमय, बहुत भारी आपको ढोनेमें मैं असमर्थ हूँ
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 6-9 give Time as follows:
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 6-9 give Time as follows:

verses.sanskrit: संत्यज्य निद्रां विपुलां स्वमात्मानं विलोकय । तस्य तत् क्रोधजं वाक्यं श्रुत्वा विष्णुरभाषत
verses.transliteration: saṃtyajya nidrāṃ vipulāṃ svamātmānaṃ vilokaya / tasya tat krodhajaṃ vākyaṃ śrutvā viṣṇurabhāṣata
verses.translation: That alone will be the greatest span of time. At the close of it, creation of the universe is carried out again. In accordance with his measures, his {Brahma's) duration of life is regarded as of one hundred years.
verses.hindi: अवाप वैष्णवीं निद्रामेकीभूयाथ विष्णुना ब्रह्मा नारायणाख्योऽसौ सुष्वाप सलिले तदा
verses.wordMeaning: That alone will be the greatest span of time. At the close of it, creation of the universe is carried out again. In accordance with his measures, his {Brahma's) duration of life is regarded as of one hundred years.
verses.commentary: Sense: That alone will be the greatest span of time. At the close of it, creation of the universe is carried out again. In accordance with his measures, his {Brahma's) duration of life is regarded as of one hundred years.

verses.sanskrit: मा मैवं वद कल्याण परिवादं महात्मनः । न मे ऽस्त्यविदितं ब्रह्मन् नान्यथाहं वदामिते
verses.transliteration: mā maivaṃ vada kalyāṇa parivādaṃ mahātmanaḥ / na me 'styaviditaṃ brahman nānyathāhaṃ vadāmite
verses.translation: That is called Parardha (v.l. Para). Or (according to some) half of that is called Parardha.
verses.hindi: सोऽनुभूय चिरं कालमानन्दं परमात्मनः! अनाद्यनन्तमद्वैतं स्वात्मानं ब्रह्मसंज्ञितम् ततः प्रभाते योगात्मा भूत्वा देवश्चतुर्मुखः । ससर्ज सृष्टिं तद्रूपां वैष्णवं भावमाश्रितः
verses.wordMeaning: That is called Parardha (v.l. Para). Or (according to some) half of that is called Parardha.
verses.commentary: Sense: That is called Parardha (v.l. Para). Or (according to some) half of that is called Parardha.

verses.sanskrit: किन्तु मोहयति ब्रह्मन् भवन्तं पारमेश्वरी । मायाशेषविशेषाणां हेतुरात्मसमुद्भावा
verses.transliteration: kintu mohayati brahman bhavantaṃ pārameśvarī / māyāśeṣaviśeṣāṇāṃ heturātmasamudbhāvā
verses.translation: Thirty Kasthds make a Kola, and thirty A'a/aj make the duration of a Muhurta. With as many (i.e. thirty) Muhurtas, the period of a human day and night is constituted.
verses.hindi: पुरस्तादसृजद् देवः सनन्दं सनकं तथा। ऋभुं सनत्कुमारं च पूर्वजं तं सनातनम् तेष्वेवं निरपेक्षेषु लोकसृष्टौ पितामहः। बभूव नष्टचेता वै मायया परमेष्ठिनः
verses.wordMeaning: Thirty Kasthds make a Kola, and thirty A'a/aj make the duration of a Muhurta. With as many (i.e. thirty) Muhurtas, the period of a human day and night is constituted.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thirty Kasthds make a Kola, and thirty A'a/aj make the duration of a Muhurta. With as many (i.e. thirty) Muhurtas, the period of a human day and night is constituted.

verses.sanskrit: एतावदुक्त्वा भगवान् विष्णुस्तूष्णीं बभूव ह । ज्ञात्वा तत् परमं तत्त्वं स्वमात्मानं महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: etāvaduktvā bhagavān viṣṇustūṣṇīṃ babhūva ha / jñātvā tat paramaṃ tattvaṃ svamātmānaṃ maheśvaram
verses.translation: A month consists of as many (i.e. thirty) days and nights. It (a month) is comprised of two Paksas (fortnights). Six months make an Ayana and the two Ayanas, the Daksina and Uttar a (Southern and the Northern), make a year.
verses.hindi: ततः पुराणपुरुषो जगन्मूर्तिर्जनार्दनः। कच्चिन्न विस्मृतो देवः शूलपाणिः सनातनः ।
verses.wordMeaning: A month consists of as many (i.e. thirty) days and nights. It (a month) is comprised of two Paksas (fortnights). Six months make an Ayana and the two Ayanas, the Daksina and Uttar a (Southern and the Northern), make a year.
verses.commentary: Sense: A month consists of as many (i.e. thirty) days and nights. It (a month) is comprised of two Paksas (fortnights). Six months make an Ayana and the two Ayanas, the Daksina and Uttar a (Southern and the Northern), make a year.

verses.sanskrit: कुतो ऽप्यपरिमेयात्मा भूतानां परमेश्वरः । प्रसादं ब्रह्मणे कर्तुं प्रादुरासीत् ततो हरः
verses.transliteration: kuto 'pyaparimeyātmā bhūtānāṃ parameśvaraḥ / prasādaṃ brahmaṇe kartuṃ prādurāsīt tato haraḥ
verses.translation: In knowing the duration of Treta, Dvapara and Tisya (i.e. Kali), the above is to be reckoned. Thus, the entire period consists of twelve thousand and some more divine years.
verses.hindi: यदुक्तवानात्मनोऽसौ पुत्रत्वे तव शंकरः ततो दीर्घेण कालेन दुःखात् क्रोधोऽभ्यजायत
verses.wordMeaning: In knowing the duration of Treta, Dvapara and Tisya (i.e. Kali), the above is to be reckoned. Thus, the entire period consists of twelve thousand and some more divine years.
verses.commentary: Sense: In knowing the duration of Treta, Dvapara and Tisya (i.e. Kali), the above is to be reckoned. Thus, the entire period consists of twelve thousand and some more divine years.

verses.sanskrit: ललाटनयनो ऽनन्तो जटामण्डलमण्डितः । त्रिशूलपाणिर्भगवांस्तेजसां परमो निधिः
verses.transliteration: lalāṭanayano 'nanto jaṭāmaṇḍalamaṇḍitaḥ / triśūlapāṇirbhagavāṃstejasāṃ paramo nidhiḥ
verses.translation: Seventyone such sets of four Yugas constitute a Mamanlarad There are fourteen Manus, O Brahmanas. in one day of god Brahma.
verses.hindi: सर्वास्तानश्रुजान् दृष्टा ब्रह्मात्मानमनिन्दत। जहौँ प्राणांश्च भगवान् क्रोधाविष्टः प्रजापतिः सहस्रादित्यसंकाशो युगान्तदहनोपमः
verses.wordMeaning: Seventyone such sets of four Yugas constitute a Mamanlarad There are fourteen Manus, O Brahmanas. in one day of god Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Seventyone such sets of four Yugas constitute a Mamanlarad There are fourteen Manus, O Brahmanas. in one day of god Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यां विशालां ग्रथितां ग्रहैः सार्केन्दुतारकैः । मालामत्यद्भुताकारां धारयन् पादलम्बिनीम्
verses.transliteration: divyāṃ viśālāṃ grathitāṃ grahaiḥ sārkendutārakaiḥ / mālāmatyadbhutākārāṃ dhārayan pādalambinīm
verses.translation: At the close of that period, all living beings get dissolved in Prakrti, their source. Hence, this is called the reabsorp¬ tion into Prakrti {Prdkrta Pratisahcdra) by wise men.
verses.hindi: तब विश्वात्मा (ब्रह्मा) नीचे उतरे और चक्र धारण करनेवाले विष्णुकी देहमें प्रविष्ट होकर वैष्णवी निद्राको प्राप्त हो गये। इस प्रकार विष्णुसे उनकी एकात्मता हो गयी एवं गदा धारण करनेवाले वे नारायण नामवाले ब्रह्मा जलमें सो गये। उन्होंने बहुत समयतक परमात्माके अनादि, अनन्त, आत्मस्वरूप, ब्रह्मसंज्ञक अद्वैत आनन्दका अनुभव किया । तदनन्तर प्रभातकाल होनेपर योगात्मा देव
verses.wordMeaning: At the close of that period, all living beings get dissolved in Prakrti, their source. Hence, this is called the reabsorp¬ tion into Prakrti {Prdkrta Pratisahcdra) by wise men.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the close of that period, all living beings get dissolved in Prakrti, their source. Hence, this is called the reabsorp¬ tion into Prakrti {Prdkrta Pratisahcdra) by wise men.

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा देवमीशानं ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः । मोहितो माययात्यर्थं पीतवाससमब्वीत्
verses.transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvā devamīśānaṃ brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ / mohito māyayātyarthaṃ pītavāsasamabvīt
verses.translation: It is said that in due course of time, Brahma, Narayana and Isa (Rudra), all the three, become merged in Prakrti and their remanifestation also is to take place.
verses.hindi: चतुर्मुख होकर और वैष्णव भावका आश्रय ग्रहणकर उसी प्रकारको (वैष्णवी) सृष्टि करने लगे उन देवने सर्वप्रथम पूर्वजोंके भी पूर्वज सनन्दन, सनक, ऋभु, सनत्कुमार तथा सनातनको उत्पन्न किया। (सुख-दुःख आदि) द्वन्द्व एवं मोह (आसक्ति)-से सर्वथा शून्य एवं परम वैराग्यभावमें स्थित इन सनक
verses.wordMeaning: It is said that in due course of time, Brahma, Narayana and Isa (Rudra), all the three, become merged in Prakrti and their remanifestation also is to take place.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is said that in due course of time, Brahma, Narayana and Isa (Rudra), all the three, become merged in Prakrti and their remanifestation also is to take place.

verses.sanskrit: क एष पुरुषो ऽनन्तः शूलपाणिस्त्रिलोचनः । तेजोराशिरमेयात्मा समायाति जनार्दन
verses.transliteration: ka eṣa puruṣo 'nantaḥ śūlapāṇistrilocanaḥ / tejorāśirameyātmā samāyāti janārdana
verses.translation: Thus, Brahma, the elements (or all living beings)and even Vasudeva and Sankara are created by A'a/a (time). He alone devours them again.
verses.hindi: आदि ऋषियोंने परम तत्त्वको जानकर सृष्टिकार्यमें अपनी बुद्धि नहीं लगायी। उन (सनकादि)-के इस प्रकारके लोक-सृष्टिसे सर्वथा निरपेक्षभावको देखकर पितामह (ब्रह्मा) परमेष्ठी (परमात्मा-जनार्दन)-की मायासे मोहित हो गये। तब जगन्मूर्ति, पुराणपुरुष, जनार्दनने (नाभि) कमलसे उत्पन्न अपने पुत्र (ब्रह्मा)- का मोह नष्ट करनेके लिये उनसे कहा-
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, Brahma, the elements (or all living beings)and even Vasudeva and Sankara are created by A'a/a (time). He alone devours them again.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, Brahma, the elements (or all living beings)and even Vasudeva and Sankara are created by A'a/a (time). He alone devours them again.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा विष्णुर्दानवमर्दनः । अपश्यदीश्वरं देवं ज्वलन्तं विमले ऽम्भसि
verses.transliteration: tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā viṣṇurdānavamardanaḥ / apaśyadīśvaraṃ devaṃ jvalantaṃ vimale 'mbhasi
verses.translation: This Lord Kdla is beginningless, endless, free from old age or decay and immortal. He is the Supreme Ruler be¬ cause of his omnipresence, independence and his state of being the soul of all.
verses.hindi: विष्णु बोले कहीं आप शूलपाणि सनातन- देवको भूल तो नहीं गये उन शंकरने अपनेको आपके पुत्र-रूपमें होनेकी बात कही थी गोविन्दसे चेतना प्राप्तकर पद्मयोनि पितामह प्रजाकी सृष्टि करनेकी इच्छासे परम दुश्चर तप करने लगे। उनके इस प्रकार (दीर्घकालतक) तप करनेपर (भी) किसी भी प्रकारकी सृष्टि नहीं हुई। बहुत समय बीत
verses.wordMeaning: This Lord Kdla is beginningless, endless, free from old age or decay and immortal. He is the Supreme Ruler be¬ cause of his omnipresence, independence and his state of being the soul of all.
verses.commentary: Sense: This Lord Kdla is beginningless, endless, free from old age or decay and immortal. He is the Supreme Ruler be¬ cause of his omnipresence, independence and his state of being the soul of all.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञात्वा तत्परमं भावमैश्वरं ब्रह्मभावनम् । प्रोवाचोत्थाय भगवान् देवदेवं पितामहम्
verses.transliteration: jñātvā tatparamaṃ bhāvamaiśvaraṃ brahmabhāvanam / provācotthāya bhagavān devadevaṃ pitāmaham
verses.translation: There have been many Brahmas, Rudras, Narayanas and others, but there is one Lord controller of all viz. Kdla. He is omniscient. So states the Sruti (Vedas).
verses.hindi: जानेपर उन्हें दुःखसे क्रोध उत्पन्न हुआ क्रोधाविष्ट उनके (ब्रह्माके) नेत्रोंसे आँसूकी बूंद गिरीं। तब उन आँसुओंकी बूँदोंसे भूत-प्रेत उत्पन्न हुए। आँसुओंसे उत्पन्न उन सब (भूत-प्रेतों)-को देखकर क्रोधाविष्ट प्रजापति भगवान् ब्रह्माने अपनी ही निन्दा
verses.wordMeaning: There have been many Brahmas, Rudras, Narayanas and others, but there is one Lord controller of all viz. Kdla. He is omniscient. So states the Sruti (Vedas).
verses.commentary: Sense: There have been many Brahmas, Rudras, Narayanas and others, but there is one Lord controller of all viz. Kdla. He is omniscient. So states the Sruti (Vedas).

verses.sanskrit: अयं देवो महादेवः स्वयञ्ज्योतिः सनातनः । अनादिनिधनो ऽचिन्त्यो लोकानामीश्वरो महान्
verses.transliteration: ayaṃ devo mahādevaḥ svayañjyotiḥ sanātanaḥ / anādinidhano 'cintyo lokānāmīśvaro mahān
verses.translation: O Brahmanas, now the first Parardha of Brahma has elapsed. Now the second half continues and the present Kalpa is the first therein.
verses.hindi: की और अपने प्राणोंका परित्याग कर दिया तदनन्तर प्रभुके मुखसे हजारों सूर्यके समान देदीप्य- मान तथा प्रलयकालीन अग्निके सदृश प्राणमय रुद्र प्रकट हुए
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas, now the first Parardha of Brahma has elapsed. Now the second half continues and the present Kalpa is the first therein.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas, now the first Parardha of Brahma has elapsed. Now the second half continues and the present Kalpa is the first therein.

verses.sanskrit: शङ्करः शंभुरीशानः सर्वात्मा परमेश्वरः । भूतानामधिपो योगी महेशो विमलः शिवः
verses.transliteration: śaṅkaraḥ śaṃbhurīśānaḥ sarvātmā parameśvaraḥ / bhūtānāmadhipo yogī maheśo vimalaḥ śivaḥ
verses.translation: The Kalpa that has expired is called Padma Kalpa
verses.hindi: रुरोद सुस्वरं घोरं देवदेवः स्वयं शिव: । रोदमानं ततो ब्रह्मा मा रोदीरित्यभाषत। रोदनाद् रुद्र इत्येवं लोके ख्यातिं गमिष्यसि २३॥ स्थानानि चेषामष्टानां ददौ लोकपितामहः
verses.wordMeaning: The Kalpa that has expired is called Padma Kalpa
verses.commentary: Sense: The Kalpa that has expired is called Padma Kalpa

verses.sanskrit: एष धाता विधाता च प्रधानपुरुषेश्वरः । यं प्रपश्यन्ति यतयो ब्रह्मभावेन भाविताः
verses.transliteration: eṣa dhātā vidhātā ca pradhānapuruṣeśvaraḥ / yaṃ prapaśyanti yatayo brahmabhāvena bhāvitāḥ
verses.translation: Cf. V 3.46-47 the probable source of KP.
verses.hindi: भीमश्चोग्रो महादेवस्तानि नामानि सप्त वै सूर्यो जलं मही वह्निर्वायुराकाशमेव च। दीक्षितो ब्राह्मणश्चन्द्र इत्येता अष्ट्रमूर्तयः
verses.wordMeaning: Cf. V 3.46-47 the probable source of KP.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. V 3.46-47 the probable source of KP.

verses.sanskrit: सृजत्येष जगत् कृत्स्नं पाति संहरते तथा । कालो भूत्वा महादेवः केवलो निष्कलः शिवः
verses.transliteration: sṛjatyeṣa jagat kṛtsnaṃ pāti saṃharate tathā / kālo bhūtvā mahādevaḥ kevalo niṣkalaḥ śivaḥ
verses.translation: VV. 4 and 5 are quoted from V 4.5 and 6.
verses.hindi: तेषामष्टतनुर्देवो ददाति परमं पदम् सुवर्चला तथैवोमा विकेशी च तथा शिवा। स्वाहा दिशश्च दीक्षा च रोहिणी चेति पत्रयः
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 4 and 5 are quoted from V 4.5 and 6.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 4 and 5 are quoted from V 4.5 and 6.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्माणं विदधे पूर्वं भवन्तं यः सनातनः । वेदांश्च प्रददौ तुभ्यं सो ऽयमायाति शङ्करः
verses.transliteration: brahmāṇaṃ vidadhe pūrvaṃ bhavantaṃ yaḥ sanātanaḥ / vedāṃśca pradadau tubhyaṃ so 'yamāyāti śaṅkaraḥ
verses.translation: Brahma sahasrdksah etc. 'Thousand-headed, thousand-footed' etc. are the epithets of the Cosmic Man in the Purusa Sukta (RV.X.90). KP. wants to identify Brahma with the Cosmic Man here, but these very epithets are used for Visnu {infra 1.9.8). and for Siva (tra II. 35.52) who (in stead
verses.hindi: एवम्प्रकारो भगवान् देवदेवो महेश्वरः। प्रजाधर्म च कामं च त्यक्त्वा वैराग्यमाश्रितः पीत्वा तदक्षरं ब्रह्म शाश्वतं परमामृतम्
verses.wordMeaning: Brahma sahasrdksah etc. 'Thousand-headed, thousand-footed' etc. are the epithets of the Cosmic Man in the Purusa Sukta (RV.X.90). KP. wants to identify Brahma with the Cosmic Man here, but these very epithets are used for Visnu {infra 1.9.8). and for Siva (tra II.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahma sahasrdksah etc. 'Thousand-headed, thousand-footed' etc. are the epithets of the Cosmic Man in the Purusa Sukta (RV.X.90). KP. wants to identify Brahma with the Cosmic Man here, but these very epithets are used for Visnu {infra 1.9.8). and for Siva (tra II.…

verses.sanskrit: अस्यैव चापरां मूर्ति विश्वयोनिं सनातनीम् । वासुदेवाभिधानां मामवेहि प्रपितामह
verses.transliteration: asyaiva cāparāṃ mūrti viśvayoniṃ sanātanīm / vāsudevābhidhānāṃ māmavehi prapitāmaha
verses.translation: They cite this verse in this context, regarding Naraya na, the very embodiment of Brahman (or the Veda) and who is the Lord and the origin of the world and the cause of dissolu¬ tion of the universe!
verses.hindi: प्रजाः सृजेति चादिष्टो ब्रह्मणा नीललोहितः । स्वात्मना सदृशान् रुद्रान् ससर्ज मनसा शिवः कपर्दिनो निरातङ्कान् नीलकण्ठान् पिनाकिनः । त्रिशूलहस्तानृष्टिष्ञान् महानन्दांस्त्रिलोचनान्
verses.wordMeaning: They cite this verse in this context, regarding Naraya na, the very embodiment of Brahman (or the Veda) and who is the Lord and the origin of the world and the cause of dissolu¬ tion of the universe!
verses.commentary: Sense: They cite this verse in this context, regarding Naraya na, the very embodiment of Brahman (or the Veda) and who is the Lord and the origin of the world and the cause of dissolu¬ tion of the universe!

verses.sanskrit: किं न पश्यसि योगेशं ब्रह्माधिपतिमव्ययम् । दिव्यं भवतु ते चक्षुर्येन द्रक्ष्यसि तत्परम्
verses.transliteration: kiṃ na paśyasi yogeśaṃ brahmādhipatimavyayam / divyaṃ bhavatu te cakṣuryena drakṣyasi tatparam
verses.translation: The waters are called Mdrdh} since the waters are born of Nara (The cosmic Man) and since waters constitute his abode {Ayana), he is called as Narayana.*
verses.hindi: वीतरागांश्च सर्वज्ञान् कोटिकोटिशतान् प्रभु: देवोंके भी देव स्वयं शिव उच्च स्वरमेँ घोर रुदन करने लगे। तब रुदन करते हुए उनसे ब्रह्माने “मत रोओ'--इस प्रकारसे कहा। तुम रुदन करनेके कारण 'रुद्र' इस नामसे संसारमें प्रसिद्धि प्राप्त करोगे
verses.wordMeaning: The waters are called Mdrdh} since the waters are born of Nara (The cosmic Man) and since waters constitute his abode {Ayana), he is called as Narayana.*
verses.commentary: Sense: The waters are called Mdrdh} since the waters are born of Nara (The cosmic Man) and since waters constitute his abode {Ayana), he is called as Narayana.*

verses.sanskrit: लब्ध्वा शैवं तदा चक्षुर्विष्णोर्लोकपितामहः । बुबुधे परमेशानं पुरतः समवस्थितम्
verses.transliteration: labdhvā śaivaṃ tadā cakṣurviṣṇorlokapitāmahaḥ / bubudhe parameśānaṃ purataḥ samavasthitam
verses.translation: After spending the nocturnal period equal to a thou¬ sand Tugas and at the end of that night, he assumes the func¬ tions of Brahma for the purpose of creation.
verses.hindi: लोकपितामहने (उन्हें रुद्रके अतिरिक्त) अन्य सात आठ स्थानों (मूर्तियों)-को प्रदान किया
verses.wordMeaning: After spending the nocturnal period equal to a thou¬ sand Tugas and at the end of that night, he assumes the func¬ tions of Brahma for the purpose of creation.
verses.commentary: Sense: After spending the nocturnal period equal to a thou¬ sand Tugas and at the end of that night, he assumes the func¬ tions of Brahma for the purpose of creation.

verses.sanskrit: स लब्ध्वा परमं ज्ञानमैश्वरं प्रपितामहः । प्रपेदे शरणं देवं तमेव पितरं शिवम्
verses.transliteration: sa labdhvā paramaṃ jñānamaiśvaraṃ prapitāmahaḥ / prapede śaraṇaṃ devaṃ tameva pitaraṃ śivam
verses.translation: By inference, he understood that the earth was submerged under water. The Lord of creation® (Prajapati) then became desirous of lifting it up.
verses.hindi: भव, शर्व, ईशान, पशुपति, भीम, उग्र तथा महादेव ये सात नाम हैं। सूर्य, जल, पृथ्वी, अग्नि, वायु, आकाश, दीक्षित ब्राह्मण तथा चन्द्र-ये (रुद्रकी) आठ मूर्तियाँ हैं जो इन आठ स्थानों (मूर्तिरूपों)-में रुद्रका ध्यान
verses.wordMeaning: By inference, he understood that the earth was submerged under water. The Lord of creation® (Prajapati) then became desirous of lifting it up.
verses.commentary: Sense: By inference, he understood that the earth was submerged under water. The Lord of creation® (Prajapati) then became desirous of lifting it up.

verses.sanskrit: ओङ्कारं समनुस्मृत्य संस्तभ्यात्मानमात्मना । अथर्वशिरसा देवं तुष्टाव च कृताञ्जलिः
verses.transliteration: oṅkāraṃ samanusmṛtya saṃstabhyātmānamātmanā / atharvaśirasā devaṃ tuṣṭāva ca kṛtāñjaliḥ
verses.translation: By inference, he understood that the earth was submerged under water. The Lord of creation® (Prajapati) then became desirous of lifting it up.
verses.hindi: देव (भगवान् शिव अपना) परम पद देते हैं सुवर्चला, उमा, विकेशी, शिवा, स्वाहा, दिशाएँ, दीक्षा तथा रोहिणी-ये ही (रुद्रकी आठ) पत्निया हैं। शनैश्चर, शुक्र, लोहिताङ्ग (मंगल), मनोजव (कामदेव), स्कन्द, सर्ग, संतान तथा बुध-ये (आठ उनके) पुत्र
verses.wordMeaning: By inference, he understood that the earth was submerged under water. The Lord of creation® (Prajapati) then became desirous of lifting it up.
verses.commentary: Sense: By inference, he understood that the earth was submerged under water. The Lord of creation® (Prajapati) then became desirous of lifting it up.

verses.sanskrit: संस्तुतस्तेन भगवान् ब्रह्मणा परमेश्वरः । अवाप परमां प्रीतिं व्याजहार स्मयन्निव
verses.transliteration: saṃstutastena bhagavān brahmaṇā parameśvaraḥ / avāpa paramāṃ prītiṃ vyājahāra smayanniva
verses.translation: By inference, he understood that the earth was submerged under water. The Lord of creation® (Prajapati) then became desirous of lifting it up.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकारके देवाधिदेव भगवान् महेश्वरने प्रजाधर्म (सृष्टिकार्य) एवं काम (वासना)-का परित्यागकर वैराग्यका आश्रय ग्रहण किया। उस शाश्वत, परम अमृतरूपी अक्षर ब्रह्मका आस्वादनकर और आत्मामें आत्मतत्त्वका आधानकर वे ईश्वरभावमें स्थित हो गये
verses.wordMeaning: By inference, he understood that the earth was submerged under water. The Lord of creation® (Prajapati) then became desirous of lifting it up.
verses.commentary: Sense: By inference, he understood that the earth was submerged under water. The Lord of creation® (Prajapati) then became desirous of lifting it up.

verses.sanskrit: मत्समस्त्वं न संदेहो मद्भक्तश्च यतो भवान् । मयैवोत्पादितः पूर्वं लोकसृष्ट्यर्थमव्ययम्
verses.transliteration: matsamastvaṃ na saṃdeho madbhaktaśca yato bhavān / mayaivotpāditaḥ pūrvaṃ lokasṛṣṭyarthamavyayam
verses.translation: By inference, he understood that the earth was submerged under water. The Lord of creation® (Prajapati) then became desirous of lifting it up.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्माके द्वारा 'प्रजाकी सृष्टि करो' इस प्रकारका आदेश प्राप्तकर नीललोहित शिवने मनसे अपने ही समान रुद्रोंको सृष्टि को प्रभुने सैकड़ों करोड़ जटाजूट धारण करनेवाले, भयरहित, नीलकण्ठ, पिनाकपाणि, हाथमें त्रिशूल धारण
verses.wordMeaning: By inference, he understood that the earth was submerged under water. The Lord of creation® (Prajapati) then became desirous of lifting it up.
verses.commentary: Sense: By inference, he understood that the earth was submerged under water. The Lord of creation® (Prajapati) then became desirous of lifting it up.

verses.sanskrit: त्वमात्मा ह्यादिपुरुषो मम देहसमुद्भवः । वरं वरय विश्वात्मन् वरदो ऽहं तवानघ
verses.transliteration: tvamātmā hyādipuruṣo mama dehasamudbhavaḥ / varaṃ varaya viśvātman varado 'haṃ tavānagha
verses.translation: By inference, he understood that the earth was submerged under water. The Lord of creation® (Prajapati) then became desirous of lifting it up.
verses.hindi: जरा-मरणसे रहित, विशाल वृषभोंको वाहनरूपमें स्वीकार करनेवाले सर्वज्ञ तथा वीतराग (रुद्रों)-को उत्पन्न किया गुरु (ब्रह्मा)-ने जरा-मरणसे रहित, नीललोहित एवं निर्मल उन अनेक रुद्रोंको देखकर हर (शिव)-
verses.wordMeaning: By inference, he understood that the earth was submerged under water. The Lord of creation® (Prajapati) then became desirous of lifting it up.
verses.commentary: Sense: By inference, he understood that the earth was submerged under water. The Lord of creation® (Prajapati) then became desirous of lifting it up.

verses.sanskrit: स देवदेववचनं निशम्य कमलोद्भवः । निरीक्ष्य विष्णुं पुरुषं प्रणम्याह वृषध्वजम्
verses.transliteration: sa devadevavacanaṃ niśamya kamalodbhavaḥ / nirīkṣya viṣṇuṃ puruṣaṃ praṇamyāha vṛṣadhvajam
verses.translation: By inference, he understood that the earth was submerged under water. The Lord of creation® (Prajapati) then became desirous of lifting it up.
verses.hindi: जरामरणानिर्मुक्तान् व्याजहार हरं गुरुः॥ ३५॥  से कहा  ये आठ स्थान सूर्य, जल आदि आगे गिनाये गये हैं। इनमें रुद्रका निवास है। इसीलिये ये आठ रुद्रकी मूर्ति माने जाते हैं!
verses.wordMeaning: By inference, he understood that the earth was submerged under water. The Lord of creation® (Prajapati) then became desirous of lifting it up.
verses.commentary: Sense: By inference, he understood that the earth was submerged under water. The Lord of creation® (Prajapati) then became desirous of lifting it up.

verses.sanskrit: भगवन् भूतभव्येश महादेवाम्बिकापते । त्वामेव पुत्रमिच्छामि त्वया वा सदृशं सतम्
verses.transliteration: bhagavan bhūtabhavyeśa mahādevāmbikāpate / tvāmeva putramicchāmi tvayā vā sadṛśaṃ satam
verses.translation: By inference, he understood that the earth was submerged under water. The Lord of creation® (Prajapati) then became desirous of lifting it up.
verses.hindi: मा स्त्राक्षीरीदृशीर्देव प्रजा मृत्युविवर्जिता: । अन्याः सृजस्व भूतेश जन्ममृत्युसमन्विता: ततस्तमाह भगवान् कपर्दी कामशासनः।
verses.wordMeaning: By inference, he understood that the earth was submerged under water. The Lord of creation® (Prajapati) then became desirous of lifting it up.
verses.commentary: Sense: By inference, he understood that the earth was submerged under water. The Lord of creation® (Prajapati) then became desirous of lifting it up.

verses.sanskrit: मोहितो ऽस्मि महादेव मायया सूक्ष्मया त्वया । न जाने परमं भावं याथातथ्येन ते शिव
verses.transliteration: mohito 'smi mahādeva māyayā sūkṣmayā tvayā / na jāne paramaṃ bhāvaṃ yāthātathyena te śiva
verses.translation: By inference, he understood that the earth was submerged under water. The Lord of creation® (Prajapati) then became desirous of lifting it up.
verses.hindi: ततः प्रभृति देवोऽसौ न प्रसूतेऽशुभाः प्रजाः। स्थाणुत्वं तेन तस्यासीद् देवदेवस्य शूलिनः
verses.wordMeaning: By inference, he understood that the earth was submerged under water. The Lord of creation® (Prajapati) then became desirous of lifting it up.
verses.commentary: Sense: By inference, he understood that the earth was submerged under water. The Lord of creation® (Prajapati) then became desirous of lifting it up.

verses.sanskrit: त्वमेव देव भक्तानां भ्राता माता पिता सुहृत् । प्रसीद तव पादाब्जं नमामि शरणं गतः
verses.transliteration: tvameva deva bhaktānāṃ bhrātā mātā pitā suhṛt / prasīda tava pādābjaṃ namāmi śaraṇaṃ gataḥ
verses.translation: By inference, he understood that the earth was submerged under water. The Lord of creation® (Prajapati) then became desirous of lifting it up.

verses.sanskrit: अथ दीर्घेण कालेन तत्राप्रतिमपौरुषौ । महासुरौ समायातौ भ्रातरौ मधुकैटभौ
verses.transliteration: atha dīrgheṇa kālena tatrāpratimapauruṣau / mahāsurau samāyātau bhrātarau madhukaiṭabhau
verses.translation: In order to lift up the earth, he entered the nether¬ world. The upholder of the earth, the self-supporting God, lifted up the earth by means of his tusks.
verses.hindi: कारणको नमस्कार है । धर्म ( धर्माचरण) -के द्वारा प्राप्य, योगगम्य आपको नमस्कार है। निष्प्रपञ्चको नमस्कार है। निराभास! आपको नमस्कार है। विश्वरूप ब्रह्म परमात्माको नमस्कार है जगन्मय! आपके द्वारा ही यह सम्पूर्ण (जगत्) रचा गया है, आपमें ही यह सम्पूर्ण विश्व प्रतिष्ठित है और आप ही प्रधानादि समस्त विश्वका संहार करते हैं। आप ईश्वर, महादेव, परब्रह्म, महेश्वर, परमेष्ठी, शिव, शान्त,
verses.wordMeaning: In order to lift up the earth, he entered the nether¬ world. The upholder of the earth, the self-supporting God, lifted up the earth by means of his tusks.
verses.commentary: Sense: In order to lift up the earth, he entered the nether¬ world. The upholder of the earth, the self-supporting God, lifted up the earth by means of his tusks.

verses.sanskrit: क्रोधेन महताविष्टौ महापर्वतविग्रहौ । कर्णान्तरसमुद्भूतौ देवदेवस्य शार्ङ्गिणः
verses.transliteration: krodhena mahatāviṣṭau mahāparvatavigrahau / karṇāntarasamudbhūtau devadevasya śārṅgiṇaḥ
verses.translation: Having observed that the earth is held up on the tips of his tusks, the Siddhas and Brahmana sages stationed in the Janaloka eulogised Hari of celebrated manliness and might.
verses.hindi: पुरुष, निष्कल तथा हर हैं। आप अक्षर, परम ज्योति हैं, आप काल तथा परमेश्वर हैं और आप ही प्रधान पुरुष, भूमि, जल, वायु, अग्नि, आकाश एवं अहंकार ये जिसके रूप हैं, उन ब्रह्मसंज्ञक आपको नमस्कार करता हूँ। द्युलोक जिनका मस्तक है, पृथ्वी पैर है, दिशाएँ जिनको भुजाएँ हैँ और आकाश जिनका उदर
verses.wordMeaning: Having observed that the earth is held up on the tips of his tusks, the Siddhas and Brahmana sages stationed in the Janaloka eulogised Hari of celebrated manliness and might.
verses.commentary: Sense: Having observed that the earth is held up on the tips of his tusks, the Siddhas and Brahmana sages stationed in the Janaloka eulogised Hari of celebrated manliness and might.

verses.sanskrit: तावागतौ समीक्ष्याह नारायणमजो विभुः । त्रैलोक्यकण्टकावेतावसुरौ हन्तुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration: tāvāgatau samīkṣyāha nārāyaṇamajo vibhuḥ / trailokyakaṇṭakāvetāvasurau hantumarhasi
verses.translation: "Obeisance to you, the Lord of gods, to Brahman, Paramefthin, to the ancient Purusa, to the Eternal, to the Victo¬ rious one.
verses.hindi: है, उन विराट् पुरुषको मेरा प्रणाम है। जो अपने प्रकाशसे समस्त दिशाओंको प्रकाशित करते हुए विश्वको अपेक्षित उष्णता प्रदान करते हैं, उन नित्य ब्रह्म तेजोमय सूर्यरूपको नमस्कार है। जो अपने रौद्र तेजोमय शरीरसे (देवताओंको) हव्य तथा पितरोंको कव्य पहुँचाते हैं, उन अग्निस्वरूप (देव)-को नमस्कार है। जो अपने तेजसे सम्पूर्ण जगत्को नित्य संतृप्त करते हैं और
verses.wordMeaning: "Obeisance to you, the Lord of gods, to Brahman, Paramefthin, to the ancient Purusa, to the Eternal, to the Victo¬ rious one.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Obeisance to you, the Lord of gods, to Brahman, Paramefthin, to the ancient Purusa, to the Eternal, to the Victo¬ rious one.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा हरिर्नारायणः प्रभुः । आज्ञापयामास तयोर्वधार्थं पुरुषावुभौ
verses.transliteration: tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā harirnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ / ājñāpayāmāsa tayorvadhārthaṃ puruṣāvubhau
verses.translation: Bow to you the self-born God, to the Creator, to the Omniscient. Salutations to Vedhas born of the Golden Egg, the Supreme Atman.
verses.hindi: सोमरूप चन्द्रदेवको नमस्कार है॥ ५६--६० ॥ जो सम्पूर्ण प्राणियोंका भरण-पोषण करती है और जो (सभी प्राणियोंके) भीतर सदा विचरण करती है, ऐसी वायुरूपात्मक माहेशवरीशक्ति आपको नमस्कार है
verses.wordMeaning: Bow to you the self-born God, to the Creator, to the Omniscient. Salutations to Vedhas born of the Golden Egg, the Supreme Atman.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bow to you the self-born God, to the Creator, to the Omniscient. Salutations to Vedhas born of the Golden Egg, the Supreme Atman.

verses.sanskrit: तदाज्ञया महद्युद्धं तयोस्ताभ्यामभूद् द्विजाः । व्यनयत् कैटभं विष्णुर्जिष्णुश्च व्यनयन्मधुम्
verses.transliteration: tadājñayā mahadyuddhaṃ tayostābhyāmabhūd dvijāḥ / vyanayat kaiṭabhaṃ viṣṇurjiṣṇuśca vyanayanmadhum
verses.translation: Obeisance to you, to Vasudeva, the all-pervader {Visnu), to the source of the universe, to Lord Narayana, to the benefactor ofDevas.
verses.hindi: सृजत्यशेषमेवेदं यः स्वकर्मानुरूपतः । स्वात्मन्यबस्थितस्तस्मै चतुर्वक्त्रात्मने नमः ब्रह्माण्डं योऽखिलाधारस्तस्मै शेषात्मने नमः
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you, to Vasudeva, the all-pervader {Visnu), to the source of the universe, to Lord Narayana, to the benefactor ofDevas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you, to Vasudeva, the all-pervader {Visnu), to the source of the universe, to Lord Narayana, to the benefactor ofDevas.

verses.sanskrit: ततः पद्मासनासीनं जगन्नाथं पितामहम् । बभाषे मधुरं वाक्यं स्नेहाविष्टमना हरिः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ padmāsanāsīnaṃ jagannāthaṃ pitāmaham / babhāṣe madhuraṃ vākyaṃ snehāviṣṭamanā hariḥ
verses.translation: Salutations to you O four-faced Lord, the Wielder of the Sarhga bow, the discus and the sword. Repeated bows to the soul of all living beings who is immovable, unchangeable and the Eternal.
verses.hindi: तं सर्वसाक्षिणं देवं नमस्ये भवतस्तनुम् नित्यानन्दं निराधारं निष्कलं परमं शिवम्। प्रपद्यो परमात्मानं भवन्तं परमेश्वरम्
verses.wordMeaning: Salutations to you O four-faced Lord, the Wielder of the Sarhga bow, the discus and the sword. Repeated bows to the soul of all living beings who is immovable, unchangeable and the Eternal.
verses.commentary: Sense: Salutations to you O four-faced Lord, the Wielder of the Sarhga bow, the discus and the sword. Repeated bows to the soul of all living beings who is immovable, unchangeable and the Eternal.

verses.sanskrit: अस्मान्मयोच्यमानस्त्वं पद्मादवतर प्रभो । नाहं भवन्तं शक्नोमि वोढुं तेजामयं गुरुम्
verses.transliteration: asmānmayocyamānastvaṃ padmādavatara prabho / nāhaṃ bhavantaṃ śaknomi voḍhuṃ tejāmayaṃ gurum
verses.translation: Salutations to the secret of the Vedas; obeisance to the source of the Vedas. Bow to the Enlightened and to the pure one; obeisance to you the very embodiment of knowledge.
verses.hindi: एवं स्तुत्वा महादेवं ब्रह्मा तद्भावभावितः । प्राञ्जलिः प्रणतस्तस्थौ गृणन् ब्रह्म सनातनम् ततस्तस्मै महादेवो दिव्यं योगमनुत्तमम्। ऐश्वर्य ब्रह्मसद्धावं वैराग्यं च ददौ हरः
verses.wordMeaning: Salutations to the secret of the Vedas; obeisance to the source of the Vedas. Bow to the Enlightened and to the pure one; obeisance to you the very embodiment of knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: Salutations to the secret of the Vedas; obeisance to the source of the Vedas. Bow to the Enlightened and to the pure one; obeisance to you the very embodiment of knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: ततो ऽवतीर्य विश्वात्मा देहमाविश्य चक्रिणः । अवाच वैष्णवीं निद्रामेकीभूयाथ विष्णुना
verses.transliteration: tato 'vatīrya viśvātmā dehamāviśya cakriṇaḥ / avāca vaiṣṇavīṃ nidrāmekībhūyātha viṣṇunā
verses.translation: Glory to the Bliss incarnate. Salutations to the Wit¬ ness ( Sakfin) of the worlds. Obeisance to the Infinite, to the unmeasurable, to one who is both the Cause as well as the Effect.
verses.hindi: कराभ्यां सुशुभाभ्यां च संस्पृश्य प्रणतातिहा। व्याजहार स्वयं देवः सोऽनुगृह्ण पितामहम्
verses.wordMeaning: Glory to the Bliss incarnate. Salutations to the Wit¬ ness ( Sakfin) of the worlds. Obeisance to the Infinite, to the unmeasurable, to one who is both the Cause as well as the Effect.
verses.commentary: Sense: Glory to the Bliss incarnate. Salutations to the Wit¬ ness ( Sakfin) of the worlds. Obeisance to the Infinite, to the unmeasurable, to one who is both the Cause as well as the Effect.

verses.sanskrit: सहस्त्रशीर्षनयनः शङ्खचक्रगदाधरः । ब्रह्मा नारायणाख्यो ऽसौ सुष्वाप सलिले तदा
verses.transliteration: sahastraśīrṣanayanaḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ / brahmā nārāyaṇākhyo 'sau suṣvāpa salile tadā
verses.translation: Salutations to you, who constitute the five elements. Obeisance to the soul of the five elements. Bow to the origin of the Primordial Nature {Prakrti). Obeisance to you of the Maya form.
verses.hindi: जो प्राणियोंके अपने-अपने कर्मोके अनुसार इस सम्पूर्ण (जगत्)-की सृष्टि करते हैं, उन अपनी आत्मामें प्रतिष्ठित चतुर्मुखात्मक (ब्रह्मा)-को नमस्कार है। जो अपने आत्मामें प्रतिष्ठित अनुभूतिरूप योगसे (प्रेरित) मायाद्वारा सम्पूर्ण विश्वको आवृतकर शेष (शेषनाग)- की शय्यापर शयन करते हैं, उन विश्वात्माको नमस्कार है। जो चौदह भुवनोंवाले ब्रह्माण्डको नित्य अपने सिरपर धारण किये रहते हैं और जो सभीके आश्रय हैं,
verses.wordMeaning: Salutations to you, who constitute the five elements. Obeisance to the soul of the five elements. Bow to the origin of the Primordial Nature {Prakrti). Obeisance to you of the Maya form.
verses.commentary: Sense: Salutations to you, who constitute the five elements. Obeisance to the soul of the five elements. Bow to the origin of the Primordial Nature {Prakrti). Obeisance to you of the Maya form.

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽनुभूय चिरं कालमानन्दं परमात्मनः । अनाद्यनन्तमद्वैतं स्वात्मानं ब्रह्मसंज्ञितम्
verses.transliteration: so 'nubhūya ciraṃ kālamānandaṃ paramātmanaḥ / anādyanantamadvaitaṃ svātmānaṃ brahmasaṃjñitam
verses.translation: Obeisance to you the Divine Boar. Obeisance to you who incarnated in the form of a fish. Salutations to you who are comprehensible through Yoga. Obeisance to you, O Sankarsana.
verses.hindi: उन शेषात्माको नमस्कार है जो महाप्रलयकालमें दिव्य एवं एकमात्र साक्षीरूप परमानन्दका आस्वादन करते हुए नृत्य करते हैं, उन अनन्त महिमावाले रुद्रात्माको नमस्कार है। जो ईश्वर सभी प्राणियोंके भीतर नियन्ताके रूपमें प्रतिष्ठित रहते
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you the Divine Boar. Obeisance to you who incarnated in the form of a fish. Salutations to you who are comprehensible through Yoga. Obeisance to you, O Sankarsana.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you the Divine Boar. Obeisance to you who incarnated in the form of a fish. Salutations to you who are comprehensible through Yoga. Obeisance to you, O Sankarsana.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभाते योगात्मा भूत्वा देवश्चतुर्मुखः । ससर्ज सृष्टिं तद्रूपां वैष्णवं भावमाश्रितः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhāte yogātmā bhūtvā devaścaturmukhaḥ / sasarja sṛṣṭiṃ tadrūpāṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ bhāvamāśritaḥ
verses.translation: Salutations to you trinity in form, to one possessed of three refulgent abodes, to one of divine lustre. Obeisance to the Siddha, to the Praiseworthy, to him who divided Gunas into three.
verses.hindi: हैं, उन सर्वसाक्षी देब और उनके शरीररूप (देव)-को मैं नमस्कार करता हूँ। निद्रारहित, श्वासको जीतनेवाले, संतुष्ट तथा समदर्शी (योगीजन समाधिमें) जिस ज्योति या प्रकाशका दर्शन करते हैं, उन योगात्माको नमस्कार है। जिस (विद्या)-के द्वारा पुण्यात्मा योगीजन अत्यन्त कठिनतासे पार की जा सकनेवाली मायाको सरलतासे पार कर लेते हैं, उस विद्यास्वरूप (देव)-को नमस्कार है। जिसके प्रकाशसे यह (विश्व) प्रकाशित होता है,
verses.wordMeaning: Salutations to you trinity in form, to one possessed of three refulgent abodes, to one of divine lustre. Obeisance to the Siddha, to the Praiseworthy, to him who divided Gunas into three.
verses.commentary: Sense: Salutations to you trinity in form, to one possessed of three refulgent abodes, to one of divine lustre. Obeisance to the Siddha, to the Praiseworthy, to him who divided Gunas into three.

verses.sanskrit: पुरस्तादसृजद् देवः सनन्दं सनकं तथा । ऋभुं सनत्कुमारं च पुर्वजं तं सनातनम्
verses.transliteration: purastādasṛjad devaḥ sanandaṃ sanakaṃ tathā / ṛbhuṃ sanatkumāraṃ ca purvajaṃ taṃ sanātanam
verses.translation: Salutations be to you whose form is the sun. Obei¬ sance to you the Lotus-born God. Bow to the unembodied as well as the embodied one. Salutations to Madhava (the consort of Laksmi).
verses.hindi: में (उस) अन्धकारसे सर्वथा रहित अर्थात् प्रकाशस्वरूप मात्र ही जिनका स्वरूप है, उन) परमेश्वरको शरण ग्रहण करता हूँ। मैं नित्यानन्दस्वरूप, निराधार, निष्कल परमात्मा, परमेश्वर आप परम शिवको शरण ग्रहण करता हूँ॥ ६५--७० ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Salutations be to you whose form is the sun. Obei¬ sance to you the Lotus-born God. Bow to the unembodied as well as the embodied one. Salutations to Madhava (the consort of Laksmi).
verses.commentary: Sense: Salutations be to you whose form is the sun. Obei¬ sance to you the Lotus-born God. Bow to the unembodied as well as the embodied one. Salutations to Madhava (the consort of Laksmi).

verses.sanskrit: ते द्वन्द्वमोहनिर्मुक्ताः परं वैराग्यमास्थिताः । विदित्वा परमं भावं न सृष्टौ दधिरे मतिम्
verses.transliteration: te dvandvamohanirmuktāḥ paraṃ vairāgyamāsthitāḥ / viditvā paramaṃ bhāvaṃ na sṛṣṭau dadhire matim
verses.translation: Everything has been created by you alone. Every¬ thing has been comprised in you only. Be pleased to protect all this universe. You are the saviour, the refuge and the goal."
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार महादेवकी स्तुतिकर ब्रह्मा उनकी भावनासे भावित होकर सनातन ब्रह्मको सम्बोधित करते हुए विनयपूर्वक हाथ जोड़े हुए खड़े हो गये तदनन्तर महादेव हरने उन्हें सर्वश्रेष्ठ दिव्य योग (ज्ञान), ऐश्वर्य, ब्रह्मकी सद्भावना (ब्रह्मविषयक उत्तम भाव) तथा वैराग्य प्रदान किया। शरणागतोंका कष्ट हरनेवाले उन (शंकर) देवने स्वयं अपने
verses.wordMeaning: Everything has been created by you alone. Every¬ thing has been comprised in you only. Be pleased to protect all this universe. You are the saviour, the refuge and the goal."
verses.commentary: Sense: Everything has been created by you alone. Every¬ thing has been comprised in you only. Be pleased to protect all this universe. You are the saviour, the refuge and the goal."

verses.sanskrit: तेष्वेवं निरपेक्षेषु लोकसृष्टौ पितामहः । बभूव नष्टचेता वै मायया परमेष्ठिनः
verses.transliteration: teṣvevaṃ nirapekṣeṣu lokasṛṣṭau pitāmahaḥ / babhūva naṣṭacetā vai māyayā parameṣṭhinaḥ
verses.translation: Thus Lord Visnu was eulogised by Sanaka and others. The Lord having the form of a Boar, conferred his grace on them.
verses.hindi: मनोरम एवं कल्याणकारी हाथोंके द्वार उनका (ब्रह्माका) स्पर्श किया और उनपर अनुग्रह करके वे बोले- यत्त्वयाभ्यर्थितं ब्रह्मन् पुत्रत्वे भवतो मम। कृतं मया तत् सकलं सृजस्व विविधं जगत्
verses.wordMeaning: Thus Lord Visnu was eulogised by Sanaka and others. The Lord having the form of a Boar, conferred his grace on them.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus Lord Visnu was eulogised by Sanaka and others. The Lord having the form of a Boar, conferred his grace on them.

verses.sanskrit: ततः पुराणपुरुषो जगन्मूर्तिर्जनार्दनः । व्याजहारात्मनः पुत्रं मोहनाशाय पद्मजम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ purāṇapuruṣo jaganmūrtirjanārdanaḥ / vyājahārātmanaḥ putraṃ mohanāśāya padmajam
verses.translation: Then the Supporter of the earth brought the earth to its original position, and gave up his Boar form Vvhich he con¬ ceived of mentally.
verses.hindi: त्रिधा भिन्नोऽस्म्यहं ब्रह्मन् ब्रह्मविष्णुहराख्यया । सर्गरक्षालयगुणैर्निष्कलः परमेश्वर: ममैव दक्षिणादड्राद वामाङ्कात् पुरुषोत्तम:
verses.wordMeaning: Then the Supporter of the earth brought the earth to its original position, and gave up his Boar form Vvhich he con¬ ceived of mentally.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the Supporter of the earth brought the earth to its original position, and gave up his Boar form Vvhich he con¬ ceived of mentally.

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुरुवाच कच्चिन्न विस्मृतो देवः शूलपाणिः सनातनः । यदुक्तवानात्मनो ऽसौ पुत्रत्वे तव शङ्करः
verses.transliteration: viṣṇuruvāca kaccinna vismṛto devaḥ śūlapāṇiḥ sanātanaḥ / yaduktavānātmano 'sau putratve tava śaṅkaraḥ
verses.translation: The earth stationed like a boat above the vast expanse ofwater, did not sink becauseof the vastness ofits extent all round.
verses.hindi: तस्य देवादिदेवस्य शम्भोईदयदेशतः । सम्बभूवाथ रुद्रोऽसावहं तस्यापरा तनुः ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवा ब्रह्मन् सर्गस्थित्यन्तहेतवः । विभज्यात्मानमेकोऽपि स्वेच्छया शंकर: स्थित:
verses.wordMeaning: The earth stationed like a boat above the vast expanse ofwater, did not sink becauseof the vastness ofits extent all round.
verses.commentary: Sense: The earth stationed like a boat above the vast expanse ofwater, did not sink becauseof the vastness ofits extent all round.

verses.sanskrit: अवाप्य संज्ञां गोविन्दात् पद्मयोनिः पितामहः । प्रजाः स्त्रष्टुमनास्तेपे तपः परमदुश्चरम्
verses.transliteration: avāpya saṃjñāṃ govindāt padmayoniḥ pitāmahaḥ / prajāḥ straṣṭumanāstepe tapaḥ paramaduścaram
verses.translation: He levelled the earth and gathered the mountains together on it — mountains which had been burnt in the destruc¬ tion of the previous creation. He then applied his mind to creation.
verses.hindi: निरूपः केवलः स्वच्छो महादेवः स्वभावतः एभ्यः परतरो देवस््त्रिमूर्तिः परमा तनुः । माहेश्वरी त्रिनयना योगिनां शान्तिदा सदा
verses.wordMeaning: He levelled the earth and gathered the mountains together on it — mountains which had been burnt in the destruc¬ tion of the previous creation. He then applied his mind to creation.
verses.commentary: Sense: He levelled the earth and gathered the mountains together on it — mountains which had been burnt in the destruc¬ tion of the previous creation. He then applied his mind to creation.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यैवं तप्यमानस्य न किञ्चित् समवर्तत । ततो दीर्घेण कालेन दुः खात् क्रोधो ऽभ्यजायत
verses.transliteration: tasyaivaṃ tapyamānasya na kiñcit samavartata / tato dīrgheṇa kālena duḥ khāt krodho 'bhyajāyata
verses.translation: VV. 57-60 which are the same as V 5.54-57 describe what was created from the four faces of God Brahma.
verses.hindi: कालो भूत्वा न तमसा मामन्योऽभिभविष्यति एतावदुक्त्वा ब्रह्माणं सोऽभिवन्द्य गुरुं हरः । सहैव मानसैः पुत्रैः क्षणादन्तरधीयत
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 57-60 which are the same as V 5.54-57 describe what was created from the four faces of God Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 57-60 which are the same as V 5.54-57 describe what was created from the four faces of God Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: क्रोधाविष्टस्य नेत्राभ्यां प्रापतन्नश्रुबिन्दवः । ततस्तेभ्यो ऽश्रुबिन्दुभ्यो भूताः प्रेतास्तथाभवन्
verses.transliteration: krodhāviṣṭasya netrābhyāṃ prāpatannaśrubindavaḥ / tatastebhyo 'śrubindubhyo bhūtāḥ pretāstathābhavan
verses.translation: Tanmatras or subtle elements are according to Sankhyas the products of the Tamasa aspect of Aharhkara and as gross elements evolve out of Tanmatras-, this Sarga came to be called Bhuia Sarga or elemental ereation.
verses.hindi: नारायणाख्यो भगवान् यथापूर्व प्रजापतिः नव ब्रह्माण इत्येते पुराणे निश्चयं गताः। सर्वे ते ब्रह्मणा तुल्याः साधका ब्रह्मवादिनः
verses.wordMeaning: Tanmatras or subtle elements are according to Sankhyas the products of the Tamasa aspect of Aharhkara and as gross elements evolve out of Tanmatras-, this Sarga came to be called Bhuia Sarga or elemental ereation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Tanmatras or subtle elements are according to Sankhyas the products of the Tamasa aspect of Aharhkara and as gross elements evolve out of Tanmatras-, this Sarga came to be called Bhuia Sarga or elemental ereation.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वांस्तानश्रुजान् दृष्ट्वा ब्रह्मात्मानमनिन्दन । जहौ प्राणांश्च भगवान् क्रोधाविष्टः प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: sarvāṃstānaśrujān dṛṣṭvā brahmātmānamanindana / jahau prāṇāṃśca bhagavān krodhāviṣṭaḥ prajāpatiḥ
verses.translation: According to Sankhyas, from the vaikarika or sattvika aspect of Aharhkara are evolved the cognitive and conative senses and the internal organ (the mind). Hence this is designated as ''creation pertaining to sense-organs' (Aindriyakas).
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मन्! जो आपने “मेरा पुत्र बनें’ इस प्रकारसे मुझसे प्रार्थना की थी, मैंने उसे (रुद्ररूपमें उत्पन्न होकर) पूर्ण कर दिया। (अब आप) विविध प्रकारके जगतूकी सृष्टि करें। ब्रह्मन्! में ही निष्कल परमेश्वर सृष्टि, रक्षा एवं प्रलय--इन तीन गुणोंसे भावित होकर ब्रह्मा, विष्णु तथा शिव--इन नामोंसे तीन रूपोंमें विभक्त हूँ। आप मेरे ज्येष्ठ पुत्र हैं और सृष्टिकी रचनाके लिये मेरे ही दाहिने अङ्गसे आप बनाये गये हैं। मेरे ही बायें
verses.wordMeaning: According to Sankhyas, from the vaikarika or sattvika aspect of Aharhkara are evolved the cognitive and conative senses and the internal organ (the mind). Hence this is designated as ''creation pertaining to sense-organs' (Aindriyakas).
verses.commentary: Sense: According to Sankhyas, from the vaikarika or sattvika aspect of Aharhkara are evolved the cognitive and conative senses and the internal organ (the mind). Hence this is designated as ''creation pertaining to sense-organs' (Aindriyakas).

verses.sanskrit: तदा प्राणमयो रुद्रः प्रादुरसीत् प्रभीर्मुखात् । सहस्त्रादित्यसंकाशो युगान्तदहनोपमः
verses.transliteration: tadā prāṇamayo rudraḥ prādurasīt prabhīrmukhāt / sahastrādityasaṃkāśo yugāntadahanopamaḥ
verses.translation: One wonders why the elemental-creation {Bhautika sarga) is repeated again here when verse 14 above states that the Sarga of Tanmatras is the elemental creation. The difference being that that creation is abuddhi- purvaka and this is buddM-purvaka. VP. I. 5.24 states instead that the eighth creation is Anugraha
verses.hindi: अङ्गसे पुरुषोत्तम विष्णु उत्पन्न हैं । उन्हीं देवोंमें आदिदेव शम्भुके हृदयप्रदेशसे मैं ही रुद्ररूपमें प्रादुर्भूत हुँ और उन्हींकी अपर मूर्ति हुँ। है ब्रह्मन्! ब्रह्मा, विष्णु तथा शिव (क्रमशः) सृष्टि, स्थिति तथा संहारके हेतु हैं। एक होते हुए भी वे शंकर अपनी इच्छासे अपनेको (तीन रूपोंमें) विभक्तकर स्थित रहते हैं ॥ ७४--७८ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: One wonders why the elemental-creation {Bhautika sarga) is repeated again here when verse 14 above states that the Sarga of Tanmatras is the elemental creation. The difference being that that creation is abuddhi- purvaka and this is buddM-purvaka. VP. I.…
verses.commentary: Sense: One wonders why the elemental-creation {Bhautika sarga) is repeated again here when verse 14 above states that the Sarga of Tanmatras is the elemental creation. The difference being that that creation is abuddhi- purvaka and this is buddM-purvaka. VP. I.…

verses.sanskrit: रुरोद सुस्वरं घोरं देवदेवः स्वयं शिवः । रोदमानं ततो ब्रह्मा मा रोदीरित्यभाषत । रोदनाद् रुद्र इत्येवं लोके ख्यातिं गमिष्यसि
verses.transliteration: ruroda susvaraṃ ghoraṃ devadevaḥ svayaṃ śivaḥ / rodamānaṃ tato brahmā mā rodīrityabhāṣata / rodanād rudra ityevaṃ loke khyātiṃ gamiṣyasi
verses.translation: Having observed that this creation is not accomplishing his object, the Lord thought of another creation. Even as he was pondering, the Tiryak-srotas (oblique currented creation i.e. the animal world) appeared.
verses.hindi: इसी प्रकार अन्य भी जो रूप हैं, वे सब मेरी मायाद्वारा ही निर्मित हैं। स्वरूपतः महादेव स्वच्छ, रूपरहित एवं अद्वितीय हैं वे देव इन त्रिमूर्तियों (ब्रह्मा, विष्णु, महेश)-से उत्कृष्ट एवं श्रेष्ठ शरीरवाले हैं। तीन नेत्रोंवाली वह माहेश्वरी मूर्ति योगियोंको सदा शान्ति प्रदान करनेवाली है
verses.wordMeaning: Having observed that this creation is not accomplishing his object, the Lord thought of another creation. Even as he was pondering, the Tiryak-srotas (oblique currented creation i.e. the animal world) appeared.
verses.commentary: Sense: Having observed that this creation is not accomplishing his object, the Lord thought of another creation. Even as he was pondering, the Tiryak-srotas (oblique currented creation i.e. the animal world) appeared.

verses.sanskrit: अन्यानि सप्त नामानि पत्नीः पुत्रांश्चशाश्वतान् । स्थानानि चैषामष्टानां ददौ लोकपितामहः
verses.transliteration: anyāni sapta nāmāni patnīḥ putrāṃścaśāśvatān / sthānāni caiṣāmaṣṭānāṃ dadau lokapitāmahaḥ
verses.translation: Since it functioned in non-straight ways, it is known as Tiryak-srotas. O Brahmanas, they are well-known as beasts, etc. as those tread the wrong path and go astray.
verses.hindi: योगसे समन्वित उनकी वही परा मूर्ति समझो। वही मैं कालरूप होकर तमोगुणका आश्रय लेकर समस्त विश्वको ग्रस्त कर लेता हूँ, कोई दूसरा तमद्वारा मुझे अभिभूत नहीं कर सकता। निष्पाप कमलोद्भव! जब- जब मुझ सनातनका तुम ध्यान करोगे, तब-तब तुम मेरी समीपता प्राप्त करोगे ॥ ८१--८३ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Since it functioned in non-straight ways, it is known as Tiryak-srotas. O Brahmanas, they are well-known as beasts, etc. as those tread the wrong path and go astray.
verses.commentary: Sense: Since it functioned in non-straight ways, it is known as Tiryak-srotas. O Brahmanas, they are well-known as beasts, etc. as those tread the wrong path and go astray.

verses.sanskrit: भवः शर्वस्तथेशानः पशूनां पतिरेव च । भीमश्चोग्रो महादेवस्तानि नामानि सप्त वै
verses.transliteration: bhavaḥ śarvastatheśānaḥ paśūnāṃ patireva ca / bhīmaścogro mahādevastāni nāmāni sapta vai
verses.translation: Realising that that creation did not accomplish its purpose and hence was incomplete, he created another set of creation. That is called the upward currented [Urdhva-srotas). It v/as the creation of gods, endowed with the quality of' Sattva.
verses.hindi: इतना कहकर गुरु (पिता) ब्रह्माकी वन्दना करके वे हर (महेश्वर) मानस पुत्रोंके साथ क्षणभरमें ही अन्तर्धान हो गये नारायण नामवाले उन भगवानूने योगका अबलम्बन कर प्रजापतिने जैसी सृष्टि पूर्वमें की थी, वैसी ही विविध प्रकारके जगत्की सृष्टि की। योगविद्यासे उन्होंने
verses.wordMeaning: Realising that that creation did not accomplish its purpose and hence was incomplete, he created another set of creation. That is called the upward currented [Urdhva-srotas). It v/as the creation of gods, endowed with the quality of' Sattva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Realising that that creation did not accomplish its purpose and hence was incomplete, he created another set of creation. That is called the upward currented [Urdhva-srotas). It v/as the creation of gods, endowed with the quality of' Sattva.

verses.sanskrit: सूर्यो जलं मही वह्निर्वायुराकाशमेव च । दीक्षितो ब्राह्मणश्चन्द्र इत्येता अष्टमूर्तयः
verses.transliteration: sūryo jalaṃ mahī vahnirvāyurākāśameva ca / dīkṣito brāhmaṇaścandra ityetā aṣṭamūrtayaḥ
verses.translation: They were blessed with abundant happiness and plea¬ sure. They are uncovered i.e. unburdened within and without. They are full of light internally and externally. Naturally they are termed as Devos, the luminous.
verses.hindi: और वसिष्ठको उत्पन्न किया। पुराणोंके अनुसार यह निश्चित है कि ये नौ ब्रह्माण कहलाते हैं । ये सभी ब्रह्माके समान हैं, साधक हैं और ब्रह्मवादी हैं॥ ८५--८७॥ संकल्पं चैव धर्म च युगधर्माश्च शाश्वतान्।
verses.wordMeaning: They were blessed with abundant happiness and plea¬ sure. They are uncovered i.e. unburdened within and without. They are full of light internally and externally. Naturally they are termed as Devos, the luminous.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were blessed with abundant happiness and plea¬ sure. They are uncovered i.e. unburdened within and without. They are full of light internally and externally. Naturally they are termed as Devos, the luminous.

verses.sanskrit: स्थानेष्वेतेषु ये रुद्रं ध्यायन्ति प्रणमन्ति च । तेषामष्टतनुर्देवो ददाति परमं पदम्
verses.transliteration: sthāneṣveteṣu ye rudraṃ dhyāyanti praṇamanti ca / teṣāmaṣṭatanurdevo dadāti paramaṃ padam
verses.translation: Thereafter, he, of truthful (effective) meditation began to contemplate further. Then from the unmanifest appeared the downward currented {Arvak-srotas) creation, competent of accomplishing his purpose (all goals of life).
verses.hindi: जैसा पहले बताया गया था तदनुसार संकल्प, धर्म, स्थानाभिमानिनः सर्वान् यथा ते कथितं पुरा॥ ८८॥  सनातन युगधर्मं तथा सभी स्थानाभिमानी (देवताओं) -
