verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, he, of truthful (effective) meditation began to contemplate further. Then from the unmanifest appeared the downward currented {Arvak-srotas) creation, competent of accomplishing his purpose (all goals of life).
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, he, of truthful (effective) meditation began to contemplate further. Then from the unmanifest appeared the downward currented {Arvak-srotas) creation, competent of accomplishing his purpose (all goals of life).

verses.sanskrit: सुवर्चला तथैवोमा विकेशी च तथा शिवा । स्वाहा दिशश्च दीक्षा च रोहिणी चेति पत्नयः
verses.transliteration: suvarcalā tathaivomā vikeśī ca tathā śivā / svāhā diśaśca dīkṣā ca rohiṇī ceti patnayaḥ
verses.translation: There, they came to be known as human beings — illuminated with the light of knowledge, endowed with the quality of Sattva, contaminated and afflicted with Tamas and dominated Vv'ith Rajas.
verses.hindi: का वर्णन तुम्हें सुनाया गया सती और पार्वतीका आविर्भाव, देवी-माहात्म्य, हेमवती-माहात्म्य, देवीका अष्टोत्तरसहस्त्रनामस्तोत्र, हिमवानुद्वारा देवीकी स्तुति एवं हिमवान्को देवीद्वारा उपदेश, देवीसहर्त्रनामस्तोत्र-जपका माहात्म्य
verses.wordMeaning: There, they came to be known as human beings — illuminated with the light of knowledge, endowed with the quality of Sattva, contaminated and afflicted with Tamas and dominated Vv'ith Rajas.
verses.commentary: Sense: There, they came to be known as human beings — illuminated with the light of knowledge, endowed with the quality of Sattva, contaminated and afflicted with Tamas and dominated Vv'ith Rajas.

verses.sanskrit: शनैश्चरस्तथा शुक्रो लोहिताङ्गो मनोजवः । स्कन्दः सर्गो ऽथ सन्तानो बुधश्चैषां सुताः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: śanaiścarastathā śukro lohitāṅgo manojavaḥ / skandaḥ sargo 'tha santāno budhaścaiṣāṃ sutāḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: On seeing it, the unborn god Brahma thought of another creation. As he was meditating on the creation, the creation of elements etc. ( theBhutadika) took place.
verses.hindi: श्रीकूर्म उवाच एवं सृष्टा मरीच्यादीन् देवदेवः पितामहः । सहैव मानसैः पुत्रैस्तताप परमं तपः तस्यैवं तपतो वक्त्राद् रुद्रः कालाग्रिसंनिभ: । त्रिशूलपाणिरीशानः प्रादुरासीत् त्रिलोचनः
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing it, the unborn god Brahma thought of another creation. As he was meditating on the creation, the creation of elements etc. ( theBhutadika) took place.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing it, the unborn god Brahma thought of another creation. As he was meditating on the creation, the creation of elements etc. ( theBhutadika) took place.

verses.sanskrit: एवंप्रकारो भगवान् देवदेवो महेश्वरः । प्रजाधर्मं च काम च त्यक्त्वा वैराग्यमाश्रितः
verses.transliteration: evaṃprakāro bhagavān devadevo maheśvaraḥ / prajādharmaṃ ca kāma ca tyaktvā vairāgyamāśritaḥ
verses.translation: All of them were possessors of property or house¬ hold, engaged in sharing, swallowers or grabbers and even, lacking in character.
verses.hindi: अर्धनारीनरवपुः दुष्प्रेक््योऽतिभयंकरः । विभजात्मानमित्युक्त्वा ब्रह्मा चान्तर्दधे भयात् तथोक्तोऽसौ द्विधा स्त्रीत्वं पुरुषत्वमथाकरोत्। बिभेद पुरुषत्वं च दशधा चेकधा पुनः
verses.wordMeaning: All of them were possessors of property or house¬ hold, engaged in sharing, swallowers or grabbers and even, lacking in character.
verses.commentary: Sense: All of them were possessors of property or house¬ hold, engaged in sharing, swallowers or grabbers and even, lacking in character.

verses.sanskrit: आत्मन्याध्य चात्मानमैश्वरं भावमास्थितः । पीत्वा तदक्षरं ब्रह्म शाश्वतं परमामृतम्
verses.transliteration: ātmanyādhya cātmānamaiśvaraṃ bhāvamāsthitaḥ / pītvā tadakṣaraṃ brahma śāśvataṃ paramāmṛtam
verses.translation: Thus, O leading Brahmanas, the following five
verses.hindi: एकादशैते कथिता रुद्रास्त्रिभुवनेश्वराः । कपालीशादयो विप्रा देवकार्ये नियोजिताः बिभेद बहुधा देवः स्वरूपैरसितैः सितैः
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, O leading Brahmanas, the following five
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, O leading Brahmanas, the following five

verses.sanskrit: प्रजाः सृजेति चादिष्टो ब्रह्मणा नीललोहितः । स्वात्मना सदृशान् रुद्रान् ससर्ज मनसा शिवः
verses.transliteration: prajāḥ sṛjeti cādiṣṭo brahmaṇā nīlalohitaḥ / svātmanā sadṛśān rudrān sasarja manasā śivaḥ
verses.translation: The second creation is that of the Tanmatras (subtle elements). It is called Bhutasarga (creation by the Bhutas i.e. elements). The third creation is Vaikdrika. It is called Aindriyaka (pertaining to the sense organs), also.
verses.hindi: लक्ष्म्यादयो याभिरीशा विश्वं व्याजोति शांकरी विभज्य पुनरीशानी स्वात्मानं शंकराद् विभोः। महादेवनियोगेन पितामहमुपस्थिता
verses.wordMeaning: The second creation is that of the Tanmatras (subtle elements). It is called Bhutasarga (creation by the Bhutas i.e. elements). The third creation is Vaikdrika. It is called Aindriyaka (pertaining to the sense organs), also.
verses.commentary: Sense: The second creation is that of the Tanmatras (subtle elements). It is called Bhutasarga (creation by the Bhutas i.e. elements). The third creation is Vaikdrika. It is called Aindriyaka (pertaining to the sense organs), also.

verses.sanskrit: कपर्दिनो निरातङ्कान् नीलकण्ठान् पिनाकिनः । त्रिशूलहस्तानृष्टिघ्नान् महानन्दांस्त्रिलोचनान्
verses.transliteration: kapardino nirātaṅkān nīlakaṇṭhān pinākinaḥ / triśūlahastānṛṣṭighnān mahānandāṃstrilocanān
verses.translation: Thus there is the Prdkrtasarga which took place with¬ out the antecedence of the Buddhi (intellect). The fourth one is Mukhyasarga. The immobile beings are meant by the term Mukhya.
verses.hindi: तामाह भगवान् ब्रह्मा दक्षस्य दुहिता भव। सापि तस्य नियोगेन प्रादुरासीत् प्रजापतेः श्रीकूर्मने कहा--इस प्रकार मरीचि आदिकी सृष्टि करके देवोंके देव पितामह (ब्रह्मा अपने) मानस पुत्रोंके साथ परम तप करने लगे
verses.wordMeaning: Thus there is the Prdkrtasarga which took place with¬ out the antecedence of the Buddhi (intellect). The fourth one is Mukhyasarga. The immobile beings are meant by the term Mukhya.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus there is the Prdkrtasarga which took place with¬ out the antecedence of the Buddhi (intellect). The fourth one is Mukhyasarga. The immobile beings are meant by the term Mukhya.

verses.sanskrit: जरामरणनिर्मुक्तान् महावृषभवाहनान् । वीतरागांश्च सर्वज्ञान् कोटिकोटिशतान् प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: jarāmaraṇanirmuktān mahāvṛṣabhavāhanān / vītarāgāṃśca sarvajñān koṭikoṭiśatān prabhuḥ
verses.translation: The creation of Tiryaksrotas i.e. of the beasts and animals, is the fifth creation. The sixth creation is that of the Urdhva-srotas. It is called Devasarga.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार तप करते हुए उनके मुखसे कालाग्निके समान अति भयंकर, हाथमें त्रिशूल धारण किये, कठिनतासे देखे जाने योग्य, अर्धनारीशवरका शरीर धारण किये हुए, त्रिलोचन ईशान रुद्र प्रकट हुए। ' अपना विभाग करो' ऐसा कहकर ब्रह्मा भयसे अन्तर्धान हो गये
verses.wordMeaning: The creation of Tiryaksrotas i.e. of the beasts and animals, is the fifth creation. The sixth creation is that of the Urdhva-srotas. It is called Devasarga.
verses.commentary: Sense: The creation of Tiryaksrotas i.e. of the beasts and animals, is the fifth creation. The sixth creation is that of the Urdhva-srotas. It is called Devasarga.

verses.sanskrit: तान् दृष्ट्वा विविधान् रुद्रान निर्मलान् नीललोहितान् । जरामरणनिर्मुक्तान् व्याजहरा हरं गुरुः
verses.transliteration: tān dṛṣṭvā vividhān rudrāna nirmalān nīlalohitān / jarāmaraṇanirmuktān vyājaharā haraṃ guruḥ
verses.translation: Then the creation of the Arvdk-srotas is the seventh one. That is the creation of the human beings. The eighth creation is Bhautika i. e. of the Bhutas* (elements) etc.
verses.hindi: (ब्रह्माके द्वारा) ऐसा कहे जानेपर उन्होंने स्त्री तथा पुरुषरूपसे दो भाग कर दिये। पुनः पुरुषभागको दस और एक--इस प्रकार ग्यारह भागोंमें बाँट दिया। ये ग्यारह रुद्र त्रिभुवनेश्वर कहलाते हैं। ब्राह्मणो! कपाली-ईश आदि ये सभी एकादश रुद्र देवताओंके कार्यमें नियोजित हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Then the creation of the Arvdk-srotas is the seventh one. That is the creation of the human beings. The eighth creation is Bhautika i. e. of the Bhutas* (elements) etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the creation of the Arvdk-srotas is the seventh one. That is the creation of the human beings. The eighth creation is Bhautika i. e. of the Bhutas* (elements) etc.

verses.sanskrit: मा स्त्राक्षीरीदृशीर्देव प्रजा मृत्युविवर्जिताः । अन्याः सृजस्व भूतेश जन्ममृत्युसमन्विताः
verses.transliteration: mā strākṣīrīdṛśīrdeva prajā mṛtyuvivarjitāḥ / anyāḥ sṛjasva bhūteśa janmamṛtyusamanvitāḥ
verses.translation: When they were indifferent towards the creation of the worlds, Prajapati fainted suddenly by the deluding potency (Maya) of Paramesthin, the master of Maya.
verses.hindi: उन प्रभु देवने सौम्य और रौद्र, शान्त और अशान्त तथा श्वेत और कृष्णरूपोंसे स्त्रीभागको भी अनेक रूपोमें विभक्त किया। है विप्रो! ये ही विभूतियाँ शक्तियोंके रूपमें लक्ष्मी आदि नामोंसे संसारमें विख्यात हैं। शंकरको शक्ति ईशा इन्हींके द्वारा विश्वमें व्याप्त है
verses.wordMeaning: When they were indifferent towards the creation of the worlds, Prajapati fainted suddenly by the deluding potency (Maya) of Paramesthin, the master of Maya.
verses.commentary: Sense: When they were indifferent towards the creation of the worlds, Prajapati fainted suddenly by the deluding potency (Maya) of Paramesthin, the master of Maya.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तमाह भगवान् कपर्दे कामशासनः । नास्ति मे तादृशः सर्गः सृज त्वमशुभाः प्रजाः
verses.transliteration: tatastamāha bhagavān kaparde kāmaśāsanaḥ / nāsti me tādṛśaḥ sargaḥ sṛja tvamaśubhāḥ prajāḥ
verses.translation: The great ascetic and yogin, Narayana, who is the creator of the worlds through Maya and who pleases the minds of yogins wakened him [v.l. wakened up his son).
verses.hindi: पुनः ईशानी (ईशा) अपनेको विभु शंकरसे विभक्तकर महादेवके निर्देशसे वे पितामहके पास गयीं। भगवान् ब्रह्माने इनसे कहा--'दक्षकी पुत्री बनो।' ये भी उनके आदेशसे दक्ष प्रजापतिके यहाँ उत्पन्न हुई (इन्हींका नाम नियोगाद् ब्रह्मणो देवीं ददौ रुद्राय ताँ सतीम्। दक्षाद् रुद्रोऽपि जग्राह स्वकीयामेव शूलभृत्
verses.wordMeaning: The great ascetic and yogin, Narayana, who is the creator of the worlds through Maya and who pleases the minds of yogins wakened him [v.l. wakened up his son).
verses.commentary: Sense: The great ascetic and yogin, Narayana, who is the creator of the worlds through Maya and who pleases the minds of yogins wakened him [v.l. wakened up his son).

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभृति देवो ऽसौ न प्रसूते ऽशुभाः प्रजाः । स्वात्मजैरेव तै रुद्रैर्निवृत्तात्मा ह्यतिष्ठत । स्थाणुत्वं तेन तस्यासीद् देवदेवस्य शूलिनः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhṛti devo 'sau na prasūte 'śubhāḥ prajāḥ / svātmajaireva tai rudrairnivṛttātmā hyatiṣṭhata / sthāṇutvaṃ tena tasyāsīd devadevasya śūlinaḥ
verses.translation: Aroused by him, the soul of the universe [Vihatman i.e. Brahma) performed great penance. Even after performing austere, penance, the Lord did not receive anything.
verses.hindi: प्रजापतिं विनिन्द्रैषा कालेन परमेश्वरी। मेनायामभवत् पुत्री तदा हिमवतः सती हिताय सर्वदेवानां त्रिलोकस्यात्मनोऽपि च
verses.wordMeaning: Aroused by him, the soul of the universe [Vihatman i.e. Brahma) performed great penance. Even after performing austere, penance, the Lord did not receive anything.
verses.commentary: Sense: Aroused by him, the soul of the universe [Vihatman i.e. Brahma) performed great penance. Even after performing austere, penance, the Lord did not receive anything.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानं वैराग्यमैश्वर्यं तपः सत्यं क्षमा धृतिः । स्त्रष्टृत्वमात्मसंबोधो ह्यधिष्ठातृत्वमेव च
verses.transliteration: jñānaṃ vairāgyamaiśvaryaṃ tapaḥ satyaṃ kṣamā dhṛtiḥ / straṣṭṛtvamātmasaṃbodho hyadhiṣṭhātṛtvameva ca
verses.translation: Then after a long time he became angry due to his mental anguish. When he was overwhelmed with anger, drops of tears fell from his eyes.
verses.hindi: सैषा माहेश्वरी देवी शंकरार्धशरीरिणी। शिवा सती हैमवती सुरासुरनमस्कृता तस्याः प्रभावमतुलं सर्वे देवाः सवासवाः । विदन्ति मुनयो वेत्ति शंकरो वा स्वयं हरिः
verses.wordMeaning: Then after a long time he became angry due to his mental anguish. When he was overwhelmed with anger, drops of tears fell from his eyes.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then after a long time he became angry due to his mental anguish. When he was overwhelmed with anger, drops of tears fell from his eyes.

verses.sanskrit: अव्ययानि दशैतानि नित्यं तिष्ठन्ति शङ्करे । स एव शङ्करः साक्षात् पिनाकी परमेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: avyayāni daśaitāni nityaṃ tiṣṭhanti śaṅkare / sa eva śaṅkaraḥ sākṣāt pinākī parameśvaraḥ
verses.translation: From the forehead of the frowning Paramesthin endowed with crooked eyebrows, the great god Siva of dark- blue complexion, a worthy protector, manifested himself.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मणः पद्मयोनित्वं शंकरस्यामितौोजसः इत्याकर्ण्याथ मुनयः कूर्मरूपेण भाषितम्।
verses.wordMeaning: From the forehead of the frowning Paramesthin endowed with crooked eyebrows, the great god Siva of dark- blue complexion, a worthy protector, manifested himself.
verses.commentary: Sense: From the forehead of the frowning Paramesthin endowed with crooked eyebrows, the great god Siva of dark- blue complexion, a worthy protector, manifested himself.

verses.sanskrit: ततः स भगवान् ब्रह्मा वीक्ष्य देवं त्रिलोचनम् । सहैव मानसैः पुत्रैः प्रीतिविस्फारिलोचनः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa bhagavān brahmā vīkṣya devaṃ trilocanam / sahaiva mānasaiḥ putraiḥ prītivisphārilocanaḥ
verses.translation: He himself was Lord Isa, the eternal one, the mass of splendour, whom (spiritually) learned men observe as Para- mesvara (The Supreme Lord) abiding in their souls.
verses.hindi: विष्णुना पुनरेवैनं पप्रच्छुः प्रणता हरिम् कैषा भगवती देवी शंकरार्धशरीरिणी।
verses.wordMeaning: He himself was Lord Isa, the eternal one, the mass of splendour, whom (spiritually) learned men observe as Para- mesvara (The Supreme Lord) abiding in their souls.
verses.commentary: Sense: He himself was Lord Isa, the eternal one, the mass of splendour, whom (spiritually) learned men observe as Para- mesvara (The Supreme Lord) abiding in their souls.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञात्वा परतरं भावमैश्वरं ज्ञानचक्षुषा । तुष्टाव जगतामेकं कृत्वा शिरसि चाञ्जलिम्
verses.transliteration: jñātvā parataraṃ bhāvamaiśvaraṃ jñānacakṣuṣā / tuṣṭāva jagatāmekaṃ kṛtvā śirasi cāñjalim
verses.translation: Recollecting Orhkdra and bowing down with palms joined in reverence, Lord Brahma spoke to him: "create these various subjects."
verses.hindi: शिवा सती हैमवती यथावद् ब्रूहि प॒च्छताम् सांख्यानां परमं सांख्यं ब्रह्मविज्ञानमुत्तमम्। संसारार्णवमग्रानां जन्तूनामेकमोचनम्
verses.wordMeaning: Recollecting Orhkdra and bowing down with palms joined in reverence, Lord Brahma spoke to him: "create these various subjects."
verses.commentary: Sense: Recollecting Orhkdra and bowing down with palms joined in reverence, Lord Brahma spoke to him: "create these various subjects."

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मोवाच नमस्ते ऽस्तु महादेव नमस्ते परमेश्वर । नमः शिवाय देवाय नमस्ते ब्रह्मरूपिणे
verses.transliteration: brahmovāca namaste 'stu mahādeva namaste parameśvara / namaḥ śivāya devāya namaste brahmarūpiṇe
verses.translation: On hearing the words of the Lord, Sankara, the transmitter of piety, the auspicious (Siva) mentally created these sons similar to him viz. Rudras—all with matted hair, possessing three eyes, of dark-blue complexion and free from fear.
verses.hindi: व्योमसंज्ञा परा काष्ठा सेयं हैमवती मता शिवा सर्वगतानन्ता गुणातीता सुनिष्कला। एकानेकविभागस्था ज्ञानरूपातिलालसा
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the words of the Lord, Sankara, the transmitter of piety, the auspicious (Siva) mentally created these sons similar to him viz. Rudras—all with matted hair, possessing three eyes, of dark-blue complexion and free from fear.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of the Lord, Sankara, the transmitter of piety, the auspicious (Siva) mentally created these sons similar to him viz. Rudras—all with matted hair, possessing three eyes, of dark-blue complexion and free from fear.

verses.sanskrit: नमो ऽस्तु ते महेशाय नमः शान्ताय हेतवे । प्रधानपुरुषेशाय योगाधिपतये नमः
verses.transliteration: namo 'stu te maheśāya namaḥ śāntāya hetave / pradhānapuruṣeśāya yogādhipataye namaḥ
verses.translation: He created Marici, Bhrgu, Ahgiras, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu, Daksa, Atri, Vasistha, Dharma and Sarhkalpa.
verses.hindi: (दक्षने) ब्रह्माको आज्ञासे इन सतीदेवीको रुद्रको प्रदान कर दिया। त्रिशूलधारी रुद्रने भी दक्षसे अपनी ही शक्तिको ग्रहण किया कालान्तरमें (यज्ञमें अपने आराध्य शिवका भाग न देखकर) दक्ष प्रजापतिकी निन्दा कर (तथा अपने शरीरका परित्याग कर) वे परमेश्वरी सती पुनः हिमवान्से मेनाकी पुत्री (पार्वती) बनीं । पर्वतश्रेष्ठ हिमवानूने भी पार्वतीको
verses.wordMeaning: He created Marici, Bhrgu, Ahgiras, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu, Daksa, Atri, Vasistha, Dharma and Sarhkalpa.
verses.commentary: Sense: He created Marici, Bhrgu, Ahgiras, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu, Daksa, Atri, Vasistha, Dharma and Sarhkalpa.

verses.sanskrit: नमः कालाय रुद्राय महाग्रासाय शूलिने । नमः पिनाकहस्ताय त्रिनेत्राय नमो नमः
verses.transliteration: namaḥ kālāya rudrāya mahāgrāsāya śūline / namaḥ pinākahastāya trinetrāya namo namaḥ
verses.translation: Brahma, created Daksa out of his vital airs; he created Marici out of his eyes; the Lord created Ahgiras out of his head and Bhrgu from his heart.
verses.hindi: सभी देवताओं, तीनों लोकों तथा स्वयं अपने भी कल्याणके लिये रुद्रको समर्पित कर दिया ये ही शंकरके आधे शरीरमें स्थित रहनेवाली माहेश्वरी देवी शिवा, सती तथा हैमवतीके रूपमें
verses.wordMeaning: Brahma, created Daksa out of his vital airs; he created Marici out of his eyes; the Lord created Ahgiras out of his head and Bhrgu from his heart.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahma, created Daksa out of his vital airs; he created Marici out of his eyes; the Lord created Ahgiras out of his head and Bhrgu from his heart.

verses.sanskrit: नमस्त्रिमूर्तये तुभ्यं ब्रह्मणो जनकाय ते । ब्रह्मविद्याधिपतये ब्रह्मविद्याप्रदायिने
verses.transliteration: namastrimūrtaye tubhyaṃ brahmaṇo janakāya te / brahmavidyādhipataye brahmavidyāpradāyine
verses.translation: He created Atri from his eyes, Dharma out of his energetic exertion; the grand-father of all the worlds created Sarhkalpa out of his conception.
verses.hindi: प्रभावको जानते हैं हे विप्रो! इस प्रकार मैंने आप लोगोंसे अमित तेजस्वी शंकरके पुत्रत्व (पुत्र होनेका) और परमेष्ठी ब्रह्माके पद्मयोनित्व (पद्मयोनि होने)-का वर्णन किया
verses.wordMeaning: He created Atri from his eyes, Dharma out of his energetic exertion; the grand-father of all the worlds created Sarhkalpa out of his conception.
verses.commentary: Sense: He created Atri from his eyes, Dharma out of his energetic exertion; the grand-father of all the worlds created Sarhkalpa out of his conception.

verses.sanskrit: नमो वेदरहस्याय कालकालाय ते नमः । वेदान्तसारसाराय नमो वेदात्ममूर्तये
verses.transliteration: namo vedarahasyāya kālakālāya te namaḥ / vedāntasārasārāya namo vedātmamūrtaye
verses.translation: He created Pulastya out of his vital breath Uddna; he created sage Pulaha out of Vydna', he created the unbewilder- able Kratu out of Apdna and Vasistha out of Samdna.
verses.hindi: सूत बोले--कूर्मरूप धारण किये हुए विष्णुके इस कथनको सुनकर मुनियोंने पुनः हरि (कूर्मरूपधारी विष्णु) - को प्रणाम करते हुए उनसे इस प्रकार पूछा- ऋषियोंने कहा-- (भगवन्!) शंकरके आधे शरीररूपसे प्रतिष्ठित शिवा, सती तथा हैमवती (इत्यादि नामवाली) ये देवी भगवती कोन हैं? हम सभी पूछनेवालोंको आप यथार्थरूपमें वतलायें। उन मुनियोंके इस वचनको
verses.wordMeaning: He created Pulastya out of his vital breath Uddna; he created sage Pulaha out of Vydna', he created the unbewilder- able Kratu out of Apdna and Vasistha out of Samdna.
verses.commentary: Sense: He created Pulastya out of his vital breath Uddna; he created sage Pulaha out of Vydna', he created the unbewilder- able Kratu out of Apdna and Vasistha out of Samdna.

verses.sanskrit: नमो बुद्धाय शुद्धाय योगिनां गुरवे नमः । प्रहीणशोकैर्विविधैर्भूतैः वरिवृताय ते
verses.transliteration: namo buddhāya śuddhāya yogināṃ gurave namaḥ / prahīṇaśokairvividhairbhūtaiḥ varivṛtāya te
verses.translation: Thus these (S'at/Aaa) house-holder sages were created by Brahma. Assuming human form, activities of piety or religion were initiated by them.
verses.hindi: सुनकर पुरुषॉमें उत्तम महायोगी (विष्णु)-ने अपने परम पदका ध्यान करके उन्हें बताया- श्रीकूर्म बोले--प्राचीन कालमें अत्यन्त रमणीय मेरु गिरिके पृष्ठपर (बैठकर) पितामह (ब्रह्मा)-ने यह रहस्यपूर्ण ज्ञान कहा था। यह विशेषरूपसे गोपनीय है। सांख्यशास्त्रके तत्त्वज्ञोंके लिये यह परम सांख्य (तत्त्वज्ञान)
verses.wordMeaning: Thus these (S'at/Aaa) house-holder sages were created by Brahma. Assuming human form, activities of piety or religion were initiated by them.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus these (S'at/Aaa) house-holder sages were created by Brahma. Assuming human form, activities of piety or religion were initiated by them.

verses.sanskrit: नमो ब्रह्मण्यदेवाय ब्रह्माधिपतये नमः । त्रियम्बकाय देवाय नमस्ते परमेष्ठिने
verses.transliteration: namo brahmaṇyadevāya brahmādhipataye namaḥ / triyambakāya devāya namaste parameṣṭhine
verses.translation: Then the holy lord desirous of creating the four viz. Devas, Asuras, Pitrs and human beings, engaged himself therein.
verses.hindi: एवं उत्तम ब्रह्मज्ञान है। यह संसार-सागरमें निमग्न प्राणियोंकी मुक्तिका एकमात्र साधन है (महेश्वरकी) जो ज्ञानरूप, उत्कृष्ट इच्छारूप, व्योम नामवाली तथा पराकाष्ठारूप (अन्तिम प्राप्तव्य) वह माहेश्वरी शक्ति है, ये वही हैमवती कही जाती हैं। (ये हैमवती शक्ति) कल्याण करनेवाली, सर्वत्र
verses.wordMeaning: Then the holy lord desirous of creating the four viz. Devas, Asuras, Pitrs and human beings, engaged himself therein.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the holy lord desirous of creating the four viz. Devas, Asuras, Pitrs and human beings, engaged himself therein.

verses.sanskrit: नमो दिग्वाससे तुभ्यं नमो मुण्डाया दण्डिने । अनादिमलहीनाय ज्ञानगम्याय ते नमः
verses.transliteration: namo digvāsase tubhyaṃ namo muṇḍāyā daṇḍine / anādimalahīnāya jñānagamyāya te namaḥ
verses.translation: When the Atman (soul) of Prajapati was united in yogic trance, the Tamomdtrd (the essence of dark traits) became increased. Then from his loins, the Asuras were born as his sons, at theoutset.
verses.hindi: अनेक रूपोंमें स्थित रहनेवाली, ज्ञानरूप, परम इच्छारूप  स्वाभाविकी च तन्मूला प्रभा भानोरिवामला
verses.wordMeaning: When the Atman (soul) of Prajapati was united in yogic trance, the Tamomdtrd (the essence of dark traits) became increased. Then from his loins, the Asuras were born as his sons, at theoutset.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the Atman (soul) of Prajapati was united in yogic trance, the Tamomdtrd (the essence of dark traits) became increased. Then from his loins, the Asuras were born as his sons, at theoutset.

verses.sanskrit: नमस्ताराय तीर्थाय नमो योगर्धिहेतवे । नमो धर्माधिगम्याय योगगम्याय ते नमः
verses.transliteration: namastārāya tīrthāya namo yogardhihetave / namo dharmādhigamyāya yogagamyāya te namaḥ
verses.translation: The exalted person cast off that physical body, after
verses.hindi: एका माहेश्वरी शक्तिरनेकोपाधियोगतः। परावरेण रूपेण क्रीडते तस्य संनिधौ सेयं करोति सकलं तस्याः कार्यमिदं जगत्। न कार्य नापि करणमीश्वरस्येति सूरयः
verses.wordMeaning: The exalted person cast off that physical body, after
verses.commentary: Sense: The exalted person cast off that physical body, after

verses.sanskrit: नमस्ते निष्प्रपञ्चाय निराभासाय ते नमः । ब्रह्मणे विश्वरूपाय नमस्ते परमात्मने
verses.transliteration: namaste niṣprapañcāya nirābhāsāya te namaḥ / brahmaṇe viśvarūpāya namaste paramātmane
verses.translation: Since that period was abundant in darkness, the created beings sleep during night. The Lord then assumed an¬ other body mainly consisting of Sattva Gum.
verses.hindi: चतस्त्रः शक्तयो देव्याः स्वरूपत्वेन संस्थिताः । अधिष्ठानवशात् तस्याः शृणुध्वं मुनिपुंगवाः चतुर्व्यूहस्ततो देवः प्रोच्यते परमेश्वरः
verses.wordMeaning: Since that period was abundant in darkness, the created beings sleep during night. The Lord then assumed an¬ other body mainly consisting of Sattva Gum.
verses.commentary: Sense: Since that period was abundant in darkness, the created beings sleep during night. The Lord then assumed an¬ other body mainly consisting of Sattva Gum.

verses.sanskrit: त्वयैव सृष्टमखिलं त्वय्येव सकलं स्थितम् । त्वया संह्रियते विश्वं प्रधानाद्यं जगन्मय
verses.transliteration: tvayaiva sṛṣṭamakhilaṃ tvayyeva sakalaṃ sthitam / tvayā saṃhriyate viśvaṃ pradhānādyaṃ jaganmaya
verses.translation: Then from his face (mouth) that was refulgent, gods were born. That body was also cast off by him and the day, mainly of Sattvika nature, was created out of it.
verses.hindi: अनया परया देवः स्वात्मानन्दं समश्नुते। चतुर्ष्वपि च वेदेषु चतुर्मूर्तिर्महेश्वरः सैषा सर्वेश्वरी देवी सर्वभूतप्रवर्तिका। प्रोच्यते भगवान् कालो हरिः प्राणो महेश्वरः
verses.wordMeaning: Then from his face (mouth) that was refulgent, gods were born. That body was also cast off by him and the day, mainly of Sattvika nature, was created out of it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then from his face (mouth) that was refulgent, gods were born. That body was also cast off by him and the day, mainly of Sattvika nature, was created out of it.

verses.sanskrit: त्वमीश्वरो महादेवः परं ब्रह्म महेश्वरः । परमेष्ठी शिवः शान्तः पुरुषो निष्कलो हरः
verses.transliteration: tvamīśvaro mahādevaḥ paraṃ brahma maheśvaraḥ / parameṣṭhī śivaḥ śāntaḥ puruṣo niṣkalo haraḥ
verses.translation: Hence religious minded persons worship Devas endowed with the characteristic of Sattva, during the day time. Then he took up another body endowed mainly of Sattvika nature.
verses.hindi: स कालोऽग्निरहरो रुद्रो गीयते वेदवादिभिः कालः सृजति भूतानि कालः संहरते प्रजाः । सर्वे कालस्य वशगा न कालः कस्यचिद् वशे
verses.wordMeaning: Hence religious minded persons worship Devas endowed with the characteristic of Sattva, during the day time. Then he took up another body endowed mainly of Sattvika nature.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence religious minded persons worship Devas endowed with the characteristic of Sattva, during the day time. Then he took up another body endowed mainly of Sattvika nature.

verses.sanskrit: त्वमक्षरं परं ज्योतिस्त्वं कालः परमेश्वरः । त्वमेव पुरुषो ऽनन्तः प्रधानं प्रकृतिस्तथा
verses.transliteration: tvamakṣaraṃ paraṃ jyotistvaṃ kālaḥ parameśvaraḥ / tvameva puruṣo 'nantaḥ pradhānaṃ prakṛtistathā
verses.translation: The manes who considered him like a father were born from him. After creating the manes (Pitrs) the god who sees everything in the universe, abandoned that body also.
verses.hindi: प्रधानं पुरुषस्तत्त्वं महानात्मा त्वहंकृतिः। कालेनान्यानि तत्त्वानि समाविष्टानि योगिना सैषा मायात्मिका शक्तिः सर्वाकारा सनातनी । वैश्वरूप्यं महेशस्य सर्वदा सम्प्रकाशयेत्
verses.wordMeaning: The manes who considered him like a father were born from him. After creating the manes (Pitrs) the god who sees everything in the universe, abandoned that body also.
verses.commentary: Sense: The manes who considered him like a father were born from him. After creating the manes (Pitrs) the god who sees everything in the universe, abandoned that body also.

verses.sanskrit: भूमिरापो ऽनलो वायुर्व्योमाहङ्कार एव च । यस्य रूपं नमस्यामि भवन्तं ब्रह्मसंज्ञितम्
verses.transliteration: bhūmirāpo 'nalo vāyurvyomāhaṅkāra eva ca / yasya rūpaṃ namasyāmi bhavantaṃ brahmasaṃjñitam
verses.translation: Then the human beings enveloped by the quality called Rajas were born to him as his sons. Prajapati (the creator) then immediately abandoned that body.
verses.hindi: अनन्य तथा उन (शिव)-के तेजसे निष्कल तत्त्वमें प्रतिष्ठित रहनेवाली, सूर्यकी प्रभाके सदृश स्वच्छ तथा उनके आश्रित एवं स्वभावत: प्रवृत्त होनेवाली हैं। वह के संयोगसे उत्तम तथा निम्न रूपसे उन (शिव)-के समीप क्रीडा करती रहती हैं। वे ही यह सम्पूर्ण (सृष्टि इत्यादिका) कार्य करती हैं। यह जगत् उन्हींका कार्य है। ईश्वरका न कोई कार्य है और न कोई करण (साधन)
verses.wordMeaning: Then the human beings enveloped by the quality called Rajas were born to him as his sons. Prajapati (the creator) then immediately abandoned that body.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the human beings enveloped by the quality called Rajas were born to him as his sons. Prajapati (the creator) then immediately abandoned that body.

verses.sanskrit: यस्य द्यौरभवन्मूर्धा पादौ पृथ्वी दिशो भुजाः । आकाशमुदरं तस्मै विराजे प्रणमाम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: yasya dyaurabhavanmūrdhā pādau pṛthvī diśo bhujāḥ / ākāśamudaraṃ tasmai virāje praṇamāmyaham
verses.translation: The demonic night wanderers {Nisacaras) mostly of Tdmasa and Rajasa nature were born as his sons. Similarly, serpents, Yaksas, goblins and celestial singers were born.
verses.hindi: ही होता है--ऐसा विद्वानोंका मत है॥ २१--२५॥ हे श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! उन देवीकी अधिष्ठान (आश्रय)- भेदसे अपने स्वरूपमें प्रतिष्ठित चार शक्तियाँ हैं, उन्हें आप सुनें
verses.wordMeaning: The demonic night wanderers {Nisacaras) mostly of Tdmasa and Rajasa nature were born as his sons. Similarly, serpents, Yaksas, goblins and celestial singers were born.
verses.commentary: Sense: The demonic night wanderers {Nisacaras) mostly of Tdmasa and Rajasa nature were born as his sons. Similarly, serpents, Yaksas, goblins and celestial singers were born.

verses.sanskrit: संतापयति यो विश्वं स्वभाभिर्भासयन् दिशः । ब्रह्मतेजोमयं नित्यं तस्मै सूर्यात्मने नमः
verses.transliteration: saṃtāpayati yo viśvaṃ svabhābhirbhāsayan diśaḥ / brahmatejomayaṃ nityaṃ tasmai sūryātmane namaḥ
verses.translation: The Lord created other beings too, possessed of Rajasic and Tarmsic qualities. After creating the winged tribe (birds) from his vigour and age, he created sheep out of his chest.
verses.hindi: उन शक्तियोंको शान्ति, विद्या, प्रतिष्ठा तथा निवृत्ति- इस प्रकारसे कहा गया है और इसीलिये (अर्थात् इन चारों शक्तियोंसे सम्पन्न होनेके कारण) परमेश्वर देवको भी चतुर्व्यूहात्मक कहा जाता है। इस पराशक्तिके द्वारा देव (महेश्वर) स्वात्मानन्दका उपभोग करते हैं। चारों ही वेदोंमें चतुर्मूर्ति महेश्वर वर्णित हैं
verses.wordMeaning: The Lord created other beings too, possessed of Rajasic and Tarmsic qualities. After creating the winged tribe (birds) from his vigour and age, he created sheep out of his chest.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Lord created other beings too, possessed of Rajasic and Tarmsic qualities. After creating the winged tribe (birds) from his vigour and age, he created sheep out of his chest.

verses.sanskrit: हव्यं वहति यो नित्यं रौद्री तेजोमयो तनुः । कव्यं पितृगणानां च तस्मै वह्न्यात्मने नमः
verses.transliteration: havyaṃ vahati yo nityaṃ raudrī tejomayo tanuḥ / kavyaṃ pitṛgaṇānāṃ ca tasmai vahnyātmane namaḥ
verses.translation: From his mouth, he created other animals such as the goats and from his belly, the cows. From his feet, he created
verses.hindi: उन रुद्र परमात्माके सम्बन्धसे इस अनन्ता (शक्ति)- का महान् अतुलनीय ऐश्वर्य सिद्ध है । वे ही ये सर्वेश्वरी देवी सभी प्राणियोंको प्रवर्तित करती हैं । भगवान् काल, हरि, प्राण तथा महेश्वर कहे जाते हें उनमें ही यह सम्पूर्ण जगत् ओतप्रोत है । वेदवादियों (वैदिकों)-के द्वारा वे ही काल, अग्नि, हर तथा रुद्र- रूपमें गाये जाते हैं। काल सभी प्राणियोंकी सृष्टि करता है, काल ही प्रजाओंका संहार करता है। सभी कालके
verses.wordMeaning: From his mouth, he created other animals such as the goats and from his belly, the cows. From his feet, he created
verses.commentary: Sense: From his mouth, he created other animals such as the goats and from his belly, the cows. From his feet, he created

verses.sanskrit: आप्यायति यो नित्यं स्वधाम्ना सकलं जगत् । पीयते देवतासङ्घैस्तस्मै सोमात्मने नमः
verses.transliteration: āpyāyati yo nityaṃ svadhāmnā sakalaṃ jagat / pīyate devatāsaṅghaistasmai somātmane namaḥ
verses.translation: From his fore-hand (extending from his elbow to the little finger tip), Prajapati created camels and mules, medicinal herbs, fruits and roots were born of the hair on his body.
verses.hindi: वशीभूत हैं और काल किसीके वशमें नहीं है। (वह काल ही) प्रधान, पुरुष, तत्त्व, महान्, आत्मा तथा अहंकार है। योगी कालमें ही अन्य सभी तत्त्व समाविष्ट हैं सम्पूर्ण जगत्को उनकी (ईशकी) संतान और उनकी शक्तिको माया कहा गया है। मायावी पुरुषोत्तम ईश उस (माया)-के द्वारा ही इस (जगत्)-को भ्रमित (मोहित) करते हैं। वही यह सर्वाकारा, सनातनी
verses.wordMeaning: From his fore-hand (extending from his elbow to the little finger tip), Prajapati created camels and mules, medicinal herbs, fruits and roots were born of the hair on his body.
verses.commentary: Sense: From his fore-hand (extending from his elbow to the little finger tip), Prajapati created camels and mules, medicinal herbs, fruits and roots were born of the hair on his body.

verses.sanskrit: विभर्त्यशेषभूतानि यो ऽन्तश्चरति सर्वदा । शक्तिर्माहेश्चरी तुभ्यं तस्मै वाय्वात्मने नमः
verses.transliteration: vibhartyaśeṣabhūtāni yo 'ntaścarati sarvadā / śaktirmāheścarī tubhyaṃ tasmai vāyvātmane namaḥ
verses.translation: From his first (eastern) face he created the Gayatra {°tri) metre, the Rks (Rgveda), the Tri-vrt-stoma mantras, the collection of Sdinan Mantras called Rathantara and Agniftoma among all sacrifices.
verses.hindi: मायात्मिका शक्ति महेशके विश्वरूपत्वको सदा प्रकाशित करती रहती है १-व्यूहका अर्थ शक्ति है।
verses.wordMeaning: From his first (eastern) face he created the Gayatra {°tri) metre, the Rks (Rgveda), the Tri-vrt-stoma mantras, the collection of Sdinan Mantras called Rathantara and Agniftoma among all sacrifices.
verses.commentary: Sense: From his first (eastern) face he created the Gayatra {°tri) metre, the Rks (Rgveda), the Tri-vrt-stoma mantras, the collection of Sdinan Mantras called Rathantara and Agniftoma among all sacrifices.

verses.sanskrit: सृजत्यशेषमेवेदं यः स्वकर्मानुरूपतः । स्वात्मन्यवस्थितस्तस्मै चतुर्वक्त्रात्मने नमः
verses.transliteration: sṛjatyaśeṣamevedaṃ yaḥ svakarmānurūpataḥ / svātmanyavasthitastasmai caturvaktrātmane namaḥ
verses.translation: From his right (southern) face, he created the Tajur Mantras, the Traitubha metre, the collection of Mantras called Pancadasa stoma, and Brhatsdma and Uktha portion of the Samaveda.
verses.hindi: २-कालमें सभी प्रकारका सामर्थ्य है, इसीलिये कालको योगी कहा गया है। अन्याश्च शक्तयो मुख्यास्तस्य देवस्य निर्मिताः । ज्ञानशक्ति: क्रियाशक्ति: प्राणशक्तिरिति त्रयम्
verses.wordMeaning: From his right (southern) face, he created the Tajur Mantras, the Traitubha metre, the collection of Mantras called Pancadasa stoma, and Brhatsdma and Uktha portion of the Samaveda.
verses.commentary: Sense: From his right (southern) face, he created the Tajur Mantras, the Traitubha metre, the collection of Mantras called Pancadasa stoma, and Brhatsdma and Uktha portion of the Samaveda.

verses.sanskrit: यः शेषशयने शेते विश्वमावृत्य मायया । स्वात्मानुभूतियोगेन तस्मै विश्वात्मने नमः
verses.transliteration: yaḥ śeṣaśayane śete viśvamāvṛtya māyayā / svātmānubhūtiyogena tasmai viśvātmane namaḥ
verses.translation: He created from the western face, the Sdman-mantras ( Sdmaveda), the hymns called the Sapta-daia stoma, the Jagati metre, a group of Sdmans called Vairupa and the Atirdtra sacrifice.
verses.hindi: सर्वशक्त्यात्मिका माया दुर्निवारा दुरत्यया। मायावी सर्वशक्तीशः कालः कालकरः प्रभु: करोति कालः सकलं संहरेत् काल एव हि। कालः स्थापयते विश्वं कालाधीनमिदं जगत्
verses.wordMeaning: He created from the western face, the Sdman-mantras ( Sdmaveda), the hymns called the Sapta-daia stoma, the Jagati metre, a group of Sdmans called Vairupa and the Atirdtra sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: He created from the western face, the Sdman-mantras ( Sdmaveda), the hymns called the Sapta-daia stoma, the Jagati metre, a group of Sdmans called Vairupa and the Atirdtra sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: विभर्ति शिरसा नित्यं द्विसप्तभुवनात्मकम् । ब्रह्माण्डं यो ऽखिलाधारस्तस्मै शेषात्मने नमः
verses.transliteration: vibharti śirasā nityaṃ dvisaptabhuvanātmakam / brahmāṇḍaṃ yo 'khilādhārastasmai śeṣātmane namaḥ
verses.translation: From his northern face he created the collection of Mantras called Eka-virhia, the Atharva-mantras, the Aptorydma sacrifice, the Anuftubh metre, and Vairdja portion of the Sdmaveda.
verses.hindi: लब्ध्वा देवाधिदेवस्य संनिधिं परमेष्ठिनः। अनन्तस्याखिलेशस्य शम्भो: कालात्मनः प्रभोः एका सर्वगतानन्ता केवला निष्कला शिवा
verses.wordMeaning: From his northern face he created the collection of Mantras called Eka-virhia, the Atharva-mantras, the Aptorydma sacrifice, the Anuftubh metre, and Vairdja portion of the Sdmaveda.
verses.commentary: Sense: From his northern face he created the collection of Mantras called Eka-virhia, the Atharva-mantras, the Aptorydma sacrifice, the Anuftubh metre, and Vairdja portion of the Sdmaveda.

verses.sanskrit: यः परान्ते परानन्दं पीत्वा दिव्यैकसाक्षिकम् । नृत्यत्यनन्तमहिमा तस्मै रुद्रात्मने नमः
verses.transliteration: yaḥ parānte parānandaṃ pītvā divyaikasākṣikam / nṛtyatyanantamahimā tasmai rudrātmane namaḥ
verses.translation: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.
verses.hindi: एका शक्तिः शिवैकोऽपि शक्तिमानुच्यते शिव: । अभेदं चानृपश्यन्ति योगिनस्तत्त्वचिन्तकाः
verses.wordMeaning: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.
verses.commentary: Sense: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.

verses.sanskrit: यो ऽन्तरा सर्वभूतानां नियन्ता तिष्ठतीश्वरः । तं सर्वसाक्षिणं देवं नमस्ये भवतस्तनुम्
verses.transliteration: yo 'ntarā sarvabhūtānāṃ niyantā tiṣṭhatīśvaraḥ / taṃ sarvasākṣiṇaṃ devaṃ namasye bhavatastanum
verses.translation: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.
verses.hindi: शक्तयो गिरिजा देवी शक्तिमन्तोऽथ शंकरः । विशेषः कथ्यते चायं पुराणे ब्रह्मवादिभिः भोग्या विश्वेश्वरी देवी महेश्वरपतिब्रता। प्रोच्यते भगवान् भोक्ता कपदी नीललोहितः
verses.wordMeaning: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.
verses.commentary: Sense: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.

verses.sanskrit: यं विनिन्द्रा जितश्वासाः संतुष्टाः समदर्शिनः । ज्योतिः पश्यन्ति युञ्जानास्तस्मै योगात्मने नमः
verses.transliteration: yaṃ vinindrā jitaśvāsāḥ saṃtuṣṭāḥ samadarśinaḥ / jyotiḥ paśyanti yuñjānāstasmai yogātmane namaḥ
verses.translation: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.
verses.hindi: मन्ता विश्वेश्वरो देवः शंकरो मन्मथान्तकः। प्रोच्यते मतिरीशानी मन्तव्या च विचारतः प्रोच्यते सर्ववेदेषु मुनिभिस्तत्त्वदर्शिभिः
verses.wordMeaning: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.
verses.commentary: Sense: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.

verses.sanskrit: यया संतरते मायां योगी संक्षीणकल्मषः । अपारतरपर्यन्तां तस्मै विद्यात्मने नमः
verses.transliteration: yayā saṃtarate māyāṃ yogī saṃkṣīṇakalmaṣaḥ / apārataraparyantāṃ tasmai vidyātmane namaḥ
verses.translation: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.
verses.hindi: एतत् प्रदर्शितं दिव्यं देव्या माहात्म्यमुत्तमम्। सर्ववेदान्तवेदेषु निश्चितं ब्रह्मबादिभिः योगिनस्तत् प्रपश्यन्ति महादेव्याः परं पदम्
verses.wordMeaning: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.
verses.commentary: Sense: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.

verses.sanskrit: यस्य भासा विभातीदमद्वयं तमसः परम् । प्रपद्ये तत् परं तत्त्वं तद्रूपं परमेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: yasya bhāsā vibhātīdamadvayaṃ tamasaḥ param / prapadye tat paraṃ tattvaṃ tadrūpaṃ parameśvaram
verses.translation: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.
verses.hindi: उन देवके द्वारा निर्मित ज्ञानशक्ति, क्रियाशक्ति तथा प्राणशक्ति-ये तीन अन्य मुख्य शक्तियाँ हैं। विप्रेन्द्रो ! अनन्त मायाके द्वारा ही सभी शक्तियोंसे युक्त शक्तिमानोंका निर्माण हुआ है, किंतु वह (माया) अनादि है। सभी शक्तियोंकी आत्मरूप वह माया बड़ी कठिनतासे निवारण करने योग्य और बड़े ही कष्टसे पार करने योग्य है। सभी शक्तियोंके स्वामी मायावी प्रभु स्वयं काल हैं और कालको भी उत्पन्न करनेवाले हें
verses.wordMeaning: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.
verses.commentary: Sense: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.

verses.sanskrit: नित्यानन्दं निराधारं निष्कलं परमं शिवम् । प्रपद्ये परमात्मानं भवन्तं परमेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: nityānandaṃ nirādhāraṃ niṣkalaṃ paramaṃ śivam / prapadye paramātmānaṃ bhavantaṃ parameśvaram
verses.translation: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.
verses.hindi: काल ही सब कुछ (उत्पन्न) करता है और काल ही (सबका) संहार करता है  विशवकी स्थापना काल करता है और कालके ही अधीन यह सारा जगत् है देवाधिदेव, परमेष्ठी, अनन्त और अखिल (विशव) - के स्वामी कालात्मा प्रभु शम्भुका सांनिध्य प्राकर वही माया शक्ति, प्रधान, पुरुष एवं माया नामकी शक्तिका रूप धारण करती है। वह शक्ति अद्वितीय सर्वत्र व्याप्त, अन्त-
verses.wordMeaning: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.
verses.commentary: Sense: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.

verses.sanskrit: एवं स्तुत्वा महादेवं ब्रह्मा तद्भावभावितः । प्राञ्जलिः प्रणतस्तस्थौ गृणन् ब्रह्म सनातनम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ stutvā mahādevaṃ brahmā tadbhāvabhāvitaḥ / prāñjaliḥ praṇatastasthau gṛṇan brahma sanātanam
verses.translation: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.
verses.hindi: रहित, केवल, भेदशून्य और कल्याणकारिणी है शक्ति एक है और शिव भी एक हैं। शिव शक्तिमान् कहे जाते हैं। अन्य सभी शक्तियाँ तथा शक्तिमान् (इसी) शक्तिसे उत्पन्न हैं। शक्ति और शक्तिमानूमें भेद कहा जाता है, किंतु तत्त्वका चिन्तन करनेवाले योगीजन
verses.wordMeaning: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.
verses.commentary: Sense: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तस्मै महादेवो दिव्यं योगमनुत्तमम् । ऐश्वर्यं ब्रह्मसद्भावं वैराग्यं च ददौ हरः
verses.transliteration: tatastasmai mahādevo divyaṃ yogamanuttamam / aiśvaryaṃ brahmasadbhāvaṃ vairāgyaṃ ca dadau haraḥ
verses.translation: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.
verses.hindi: (उनमें) परमार्थतः अभेदका ही दर्शन करते हैं। जितनी भी शक्तियाँ हैं वे गिरिजादेवी और जितने भी शक्तिमान् हैं वे शंकर हैं। ब्रह्मवादियोंके द्वारा पुराणमें इनके विषयमें विशेष (रूपसे) कहा जाता है महेश्वरकी पतिव्रता देवी विश्वेश्वरीको भोग्या और नीललोहित जटाधारी भगवान् (शंकर)-को भोक्ता कहा गया है। कामदेवका अन्त करनेवाले, विश्वके स्वामी देव शंकरको मनन करनेवाला मन्ता और
verses.wordMeaning: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.
verses.commentary: Sense: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.

verses.sanskrit: कराभ्यां सुशुभाभ्यां च संस्पृश्य प्रणतार्तिहा । व्याजहरा स्वयं देवः सो ऽनुगृह्य पितामहम्
verses.transliteration: karābhyāṃ suśubhābhyāṃ ca saṃspṛśya praṇatārtihā / vyājaharā svayaṃ devaḥ so 'nugṛhya pitāmaham
verses.translation: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.
verses.hindi: ईशानीको मति एवं विचारद्वारा मानने योग्य (मन्तव्या) कहा गया है ब्राह्मणो ! तत्त्वद्रष्टा मुनियोंके द्वारा सभी वेदोंमें यही कहा गया है कि यह सम्पूर्ण विश्व शक्ति एवं शक्तिमानसे प्रादुर्भूत है । इस प्रकार ब्रह्मवादियोंके द्वारा समस्त वेदान्त एवं वेदोंमें निश्चित किये गये देवीके दिव्य एवं उत्तम
verses.wordMeaning: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.
verses.commentary: Sense: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.

verses.sanskrit: यत्त्वयाभ्यर्थितं ब्रह्मन् पुत्रत्वे भवतो मम । कृतं मया तत् सकलं सृजस्व विविधं जगत्
verses.transliteration: yattvayābhyarthitaṃ brahman putratve bhavato mama / kṛtaṃ mayā tat sakalaṃ sṛjasva vividhaṃ jagat
verses.translation: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.
verses.hindi: माहात्म्यका यह वर्णन किया गया महादेवीका जो सर्वव्यापक, सुक्ष्म, कूटस्थ, अचल तथा ध्रुव परम पद है, उसका योगी साक्षात्कार करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.
verses.commentary: Sense: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिधा भिन्नो ऽस्म्यहं ब्रह्मन् ब्रह्मविष्णुहराख्यया । सर्गरक्षालयगुणैर्निष्कलः परमेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: tridhā bhinno 'smyahaṃ brahman brahmaviṣṇuharākhyayā / sargarakṣālayaguṇairniṣkalaḥ parameśvaraḥ
verses.translation: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.
verses.hindi: हम कूर्मपुराण ति आनन्दमक्षरं ब्रह्म केवलं निष्कलं परम्। योगिनस्तत् प्रपश्यन्ति महादेव्याः परं पदम्
verses.wordMeaning: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.
verses.commentary: Sense: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.

verses.sanskrit: स त्वं ममाग्रजः पुत्रः सृष्टिहेतोर्विनिर्मितः । ममैव दक्षिणादङ्गाद् वामाङ्गात् पुरुषोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: sa tvaṃ mamāgrajaḥ putraḥ sṛṣṭihetorvinirmitaḥ / mamaiva dakṣiṇādaṅgād vāmāṅgāt puruṣottamaḥ
verses.translation: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.
verses.hindi: परात्परतरं तत्त्वं शाश्वतं शिवमच्युतम्। अनन्तप्रकृतौ लीनं देव्यास्तत् परमं पदम् आत्मोपलब्धिविषयं देव्यास्तत् परमं पदम्
verses.wordMeaning: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.
verses.commentary: Sense: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य देवादिदेवस्य शंभोर्हृदयदेशतः । संबभूवाथ रुद्रो ऽसावहं तस्यापरा तनुः
verses.transliteration: tasya devādidevasya śaṃbhorhṛdayadeśataḥ / saṃbabhūvātha rudro 'sāvahaṃ tasyāparā tanuḥ
verses.translation: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.
verses.hindi: आश्रयेत् सर्वभावानामात्मभूतां शिवात्मिकाम् हिताय सर्वभूतानां जाता च तपसावयोः
verses.wordMeaning: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.
verses.commentary: Sense: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवा ब्रह्मन् सर्गस्थित्यन्तहेतवः । विभज्यात्मानमेको ऽपि स्वेच्छया शङ्करः स्थितः
verses.transliteration: brahmaviṣṇuśivā brahman sargasthityantahetavaḥ / vibhajyātmānameko 'pi svecchayā śaṅkaraḥ sthitaḥ
verses.translation: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.
verses.hindi: का त्वं देवि विशालाक्षि शशाङ्कावयवाङ्किते । न जाने त्वामहं वत्से यथावद् ब्रूहि पृच्छते अनन्यामव्ययामेकां यां पश्यन्ति मुमुक्षवः
verses.wordMeaning: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.
verses.commentary: Sense: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.

verses.sanskrit: तथान्यानि च रूपाणि मम मायाकृतानि तु । निरूपः केवलः स्वच्छो महादेवः स्वभावतः
verses.transliteration: tathānyāni ca rūpāṇi mama māyākṛtāni tu / nirūpaḥ kevalaḥ svaccho mahādevaḥ svabhāvataḥ
verses.translation: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.
verses.hindi: महादेवीका जो आनन्दमय, अविनाशी, ब्रह्मरूप, अद्वितीय एवं भेदरहित परम पद है, योगी उसका दर्शन करते हैं। देवीका बह परम पद परसे भी परतर, तत्त्वरूप, सनातन, कल्याणकारी, अच्युत तथा अनन्त प्रकृतिमें लीन है। देवीका वह परम पद शुभ निरञ्जन, शुद्ध, निर्गुण, द्वैतरहित और आत्मज्ञानका विषय है। परम आनन्द चाहनेवालोंके लिये वे ही धात्री तथा विधात्री हैं। वे ईशवरके आश्रयसे संसारके सारे पापोंका
verses.wordMeaning: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.
verses.commentary: Sense: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.

verses.sanskrit: एभ्यः परतरो देवस्त्रिमूर्तिः परमा तनुः । माहेश्वरी त्रिनयना योगिनां शान्तिदा सदा
verses.transliteration: ebhyaḥ parataro devastrimūrtiḥ paramā tanuḥ / māheśvarī trinayanā yogināṃ śāntidā sadā
verses.translation: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.
verses.hindi: विनाश करती हैं। इसलिये मोक्षकी इच्छा करनेवालोंको चाहिए कि वे सभी भावोंकी आत्मस्वरूपा शिवात्मिका परमेश्वरी पार्वतीका आश्रय ग्रहण करें अत्यन्त कठोर तप करनेके अनन्तर शर्वाणी (शंकर- प्रिया)-को पुत्रीरूपमें प्राप्तकर (हिमवान् अपनी) भायकि साथ परमेश्वरी पार्वतीकी शरणमें गये। अपनी इच्छासे उत्पन्न उस श्रेष्ठ मुखवालीको देखकर हिमवान्की पली
verses.wordMeaning: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.
verses.commentary: Sense: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.

verses.sanskrit: तस्या एव परां मूर्ति मामवेहि पितामह । शाश्वतैश्वर्यविज्ञानतेजोयोगसमन्विताम्
verses.transliteration: tasyā eva parāṃ mūrti māmavehi pitāmaha / śāśvataiśvaryavijñānatejoyogasamanvitām
verses.translation: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.
verses.hindi: मेनाने गिरिराज हिमालयसे इस प्रकार कहा- मेना बोलीं राजन्! कमलके समान मुखवाली इस बालिकाको देखो। (यह) हम दोनोंको तपस्या (-के प्रभाव)-से सभी प्राणियोंके कल्याणके लिये उत्पन्न हुई है
verses.wordMeaning: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.
verses.commentary: Sense: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽहं ग्रसामि सकलमधिष्ठाय तमोगुणम् । कालो भूत्वा न तमसा मामन्यो ऽभिभविष्यति
verses.transliteration: so 'haṃ grasāmi sakalamadhiṣṭhāya tamoguṇam / kālo bhūtvā na tamasā māmanyo 'bhibhaviṣyati
verses.translation: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.
verses.hindi: तरुण सूर्यके समान (देदीप्यमान), जटायुक्त, चतुर्मुख, विशाल नेत्रोंवाली, चन्द्रमाको कलाओंके आभूषण धारण की हुई, गुणातीत एवं गुणयुक्त तथा सत्-असतृके भावोंसे रहित साक्षात् देवीको पुत्रीरूपमें देखकर हिमवानूने भूमिपर मस्तक लगाकर प्रणाम किया और उनके तेजसे
verses.wordMeaning: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.
verses.commentary: Sense: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.

verses.sanskrit: यदा यदा हि मां नित्यं विचिन्तयसि पद्मज । तदा तदा मे सान्निध्यं भविष्यति तवानघ
verses.transliteration: yadā yadā hi māṃ nityaṃ vicintayasi padmaja / tadā tadā me sānnidhyaṃ bhaviṣyati tavānagha
verses.translation: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.
verses.hindi: अत्यन्त विह्वल तथा भयभीत होते हुए हाथ जोड़कर उन परमेशवरीसे कहा-- ॥ ५८--६० ॥ हिमवान् बोले--विशाल नेत्रोंवाली तथा चन्द्रमाको कलाओंसे सुशोभित देवि! आप कौन हैं? वत्से! में आपको नहीं जानता हूँ। मुझ पूछनेवालेको आप यथार्थरूपसे बतलायें
verses.wordMeaning: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.
verses.commentary: Sense: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.

verses.sanskrit: एतावदुक्त्वा ब्रह्माणं सो ऽभिवन्द्य गुरुं हरः । सहैव मानसैः पुत्रैः क्षणादन्तरधीयत
verses.transliteration: etāvaduktvā brahmāṇaṃ so 'bhivandya guruṃ haraḥ / sahaiva mānasaiḥ putraiḥ kṣaṇādantaradhīyata
verses.translation: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.
verses.hindi: योगियोंको अभय प्रदान करनेवाली उस परमेश्वरीने गिरिराज (हिमालय)-का वचन सुनकर महाशैलसे कहा-- देवी बोलीं-मोक्षकी इच्छा करनेवाले (मोक्षार्थी) जिस अनन्य, अविनाशी तथा अद्वितीय (शक्ति)-का दर्शन करते हैँ, परमेशवरके आश्रयमें रहनेवाली वही परम शक्ति मुझे समझो
verses.wordMeaning: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.
verses.commentary: Sense: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽपि योगं समास्थाय ससर्ज विविधं जगत् । नारायणाख्यो भगवान् यथापूर्वं प्रिजापतिः
verses.transliteration: so 'pi yogaṃ samāsthāya sasarja vividhaṃ jagat / nārāyaṇākhyo bhagavān yathāpūrvaṃ prijāpatiḥ
verses.translation: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.
verses.hindi: अहं वै सर्वभावानामात्मा सर्वान्तरा शिवा । शाश्वतैश्वर्यविज्ञानमूर्ति: सर्वप्रवर्तिका कोटिसूर्यप्रतीकाशं तेजोबिम्बं निराकुलम्। ज्वालामालासहरस्त्राढ्यं कालानलशतोपमम्
verses.wordMeaning: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.
verses.commentary: Sense: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.

verses.sanskrit: मरीचिभृग्वङ्गिरसं पुलस्त्यं पुलहं क्रतुम् । दक्षमत्रिं वसिष्ठं च सो ऽसृजद् योगविद्यया
verses.transliteration: marīcibhṛgvaṅgirasaṃ pulastyaṃ pulahaṃ kratum / dakṣamatriṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ ca so 'sṛjad yogavidyayā
verses.translation: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.
verses.hindi: दंष्टाकरालं दुर्धर्ष जटामण्डलमण्िडितम्। त्रिशूलवरहस्तं च घोररूपं भयानकम् चन्द्रावयवलक्ष्माणं चन्द्रकोटिसमप्रभम्
verses.wordMeaning: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.
verses.commentary: Sense: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.

verses.sanskrit: नव ब्रह्माण इत्येते पुराणे निश्चयं गताः । सर्वे ते ब्रह्मणा तुल्याः साधका ब्रह्मवादिनः
verses.transliteration: nava brahmāṇa ityete purāṇe niścayaṃ gatāḥ / sarve te brahmaṇā tulyāḥ sādhakā brahmavādinaḥ
verses.translation: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.
verses.hindi: शङ्खचक्रधरं काम्यं त्रिनेत्रं कृत्तिवाससम्। अण्डस्थं चाण्डबाह्यस्थं बाह्यमाभ्यन्तरं परम् सर्वशक्तिमयं शुभ्रं सर्वाकारं सनातनम्। ब्रहमोन्द्रोपेन्द्रयोगीन्द्रर्वन्द्यमानपदाम्बुजम्
verses.wordMeaning: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.
verses.commentary: Sense: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.

verses.sanskrit: संकल्पं चैव धर्मं च युगधर्मांश्च शाश्वतान् । स्थानाभिमानिनः सर्वान् यथा ते कथितं पुरा
verses.transliteration: saṃkalpaṃ caiva dharmaṃ ca yugadharmāṃśca śāśvatān / sthānābhimāninaḥ sarvān yathā te kathitaṃ purā
verses.translation: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.
verses.hindi: दृष्टा तदीदृशं रूपं देव्या माहेश्वरं परम्। भयेन च समाविष्टः स राजा हष्टमानसः आत्मन्याधाय चात्मानमोङ्कारं समनुस्मरन्।
verses.wordMeaning: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.
verses.commentary: Sense: The diverse, high and low living beings were born of his limbs, even as god Brahma, in the capacity of the creator, was engaged in his creative activities.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे देशमो ऽध्यायः श्रीकूर्म उवाच एवं सृष्ट्वा परीच्यादीन् देवदेवः पितामहः । सहैव मानसैः पुत्रैस्तताप परमं तपः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge deśamo 'dhyāyaḥ śrīkūrma uvāca evaṃ sṛṣṭvā parīcyādīn devadevaḥ pitāmahaḥ / sahaiva mānasaiḥ putraistatāpa paramaṃ tapaḥ
verses.translation: I have taken devananda as an adj. qualifying Harsa as V 7.31 records only one son viz. Harsa:
verses.hindi: शिवोमा परमा शक्तिरनन्ता निष्कलामला। अचिन्त्या केवलानन्त्या शिवात्मा परमात्मिका । अनादिरव्यया शुद्धा देवात्मा सर्वगाचला
verses.wordMeaning: I have taken devananda as an adj. qualifying Harsa as V 7.31 records only one son viz. Harsa:
verses.commentary: Sense: I have taken devananda as an adj. qualifying Harsa as V 7.31 records only one son viz. Harsa:

verses.sanskrit: तस्यैवं तपतो वक्त्राद् रुद्रः कालाग्निसन्निभः । त्रिशूलपाणिरीशानः प्रदुरासीत् त्रिलोचनः
verses.transliteration: tasyaivaṃ tapato vaktrād rudraḥ kālāgnisannibhaḥ / triśūlapāṇirīśānaḥ pradurāsīt trilocanaḥ
verses.translation: K -29a is a quotation from V 7.33-35.
verses.hindi: में ही सभी पदार्थोकी आत्मा, सभीके अंदर रहनेवाली, कल्याणकारिणी, सनातन ऐश्वर्य तथा विज्ञानकी मूर्ति और सभीको प्रवृत्त करनेवाली हूँ। मैं अनन्त और अनन्त महिमावाली तथा संसारसागरसे पार उतारनेवाली हूँ। मैं तुम्हें दिव्य दृष्टि प्रदान करती हूँ, मेरे ऐश्वर्यमय रूपको देखो
verses.wordMeaning: K -29a is a quotation from V 7.33-35.
verses.commentary: Sense: K -29a is a quotation from V 7.33-35.

verses.sanskrit: अर्धनारीनरवपुः दुष्प्रेक्ष्यो ऽतिभयङ्करः । विभजात्मानमित्युक्त्वा ब्रह्मा चान्तर्दधे भयात्
verses.transliteration: ardhanārīnaravapuḥ duṣprekṣyo 'tibhayaṅkaraḥ / vibhajātmānamityuktvā brahmā cāntardadhe bhayāt
verses.translation: KP. and VP. (1.7.25) regard Sati as Daksa's daughter, but in L 5.27 she is mind-born from Siva but was adopted by Daksa and given in marriage to god Siva.
verses.hindi: इतना कहकर तथा हिमवानूको स्वयं विशिष्ट ज्ञान प्रदान कर (देवीने) अपना वह परमेशवरमय दिव्य रूप दिखलाया (हिमवानूने) करोड़ों सूर्यके समान (प्रकाशमान) तेजःपुञ्ज, स्थिर, हजारों ज्वालामालाओंसे युक्त, सैकड़ों कालाग्निके समान, भयंकर दाढ़ोंवाला, दुर्धर्ष, जटामण्डलोसे मण्डित, हाथमें त्रिशूल और वरमुद्रा धारण किये,
verses.wordMeaning: KP. and VP. (1.7.25) regard Sati as Daksa's daughter, but in L 5.27 she is mind-born from Siva but was adopted by Daksa and given in marriage to god Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: KP. and VP. (1.7.25) regard Sati as Daksa's daughter, but in L 5.27 she is mind-born from Siva but was adopted by Daksa and given in marriage to god Siva.

verses.sanskrit: तथोक्तो ऽसौ द्विधा स्त्रीत्वं पुरुषत्वमथाकरोत् । बिभेद पुरुषत्वं च दशधा चैकधा पुनः
verses.transliteration: tathokto 'sau dvidhā strītvaṃ puruṣatvamathākarot / bibheda puruṣatvaṃ ca daśadhā caikadhā punaḥ
verses.translation: The Tomas along with Rajas and Sattoa (enveloped by it) was subsequently abandoned by him. But that Tamos, when thus repulsed, became a couple (a pair of living beings).
verses.hindi: अनन्त आश्चर्यासे युक्त, चन्द्रकलासे चिह्नित, करोड़ों चन्द्रमाओंकी आभावाला मुकुट धारण किये, हाथमें गदा लिये, नूपुरोंसे सुशोभित, दिव्य वस्त्र एवं माला धारण किये, दिव्य सुगन्धित अनुलेपन किये हुए, ब्रह्माण्डके बाहर एवं भीतर (सर्वत्र) स्थित, बाहर तथा भीतर सर्वत्र श्रेष्ठ, सर्वशक्तिमय, शुभ्र, सभी आकारोंसे युक्त, सनातन, ब्रह्मा, इन्द्र, विष्णु और श्रेष्ठ योगियोंद्वारा
verses.wordMeaning: The Tomas along with Rajas and Sattoa (enveloped by it) was subsequently abandoned by him. But that Tamos, when thus repulsed, became a couple (a pair of living beings).
verses.commentary: Sense: The Tomas along with Rajas and Sattoa (enveloped by it) was subsequently abandoned by him. But that Tamos, when thus repulsed, became a couple (a pair of living beings).

verses.sanskrit: एकादशैते कथिता रुद्रास्त्रिभुवनेश्वराः । कपालोशादयो विप्रा देवकार्ये नियोजिताः
verses.transliteration: ekādaśaite kathitā rudrāstribhuvaneśvarāḥ / kapālośādayo viprā devakārye niyojitāḥ
verses.translation: The male member was Adharmacarana (practice of evU) and the female member was Hirhsd (violence) of inauspicious characteristics. Then god Brahma cast off that refulgent body of himself.
verses.hindi: सिर एवं मुखवाला और सभीको आवृत कर स्थित रहनेवाला (देवीका वह) परमेश्वर-रूप देखा॥ ६७--७३॥ देवीके इस प्रकारके उस परम माहेश्वर रूपको देखकर वे (पर्वतोंके) राजा (हिमवान्) भयसे आविष्ट होते हुए भी प्रसन्न मनवाले हो गये। (और) अपनी आत्मामें आत्माको प्रतिष्ठितकर (आत्मनिष्ठ होकर) ओङ्कारका
verses.wordMeaning: The male member was Adharmacarana (practice of evU) and the female member was Hirhsd (violence) of inauspicious characteristics. Then god Brahma cast off that refulgent body of himself.
verses.commentary: Sense: The male member was Adharmacarana (practice of evU) and the female member was Hirhsd (violence) of inauspicious characteristics. Then god Brahma cast off that refulgent body of himself.

verses.sanskrit: सौम्यासौम्यैस्तथा शान्ताशान्तैः स्त्रीत्वं च स प्रभुः । बिभेद बहुधा देवः स्वरूपैरसितैः सितैः
verses.transliteration: saumyāsaumyaistathā śāntāśāntaiḥ strītvaṃ ca sa prabhuḥ / bibheda bahudhā devaḥ svarūpairasitaiḥ sitaiḥ
verses.translation: He then split his body. With one half he became a man. With another half, he became a woman. Thus the Lord created the man Virdt.
verses.hindi: स्मरण करते हुए (वे) परमेशवरीके एक हजार आठ नामोंसे उनकी स्तुति करने लगे हिमवानने कहा (हे देवी! आप) शिवा, उमा,
verses.wordMeaning: He then split his body. With one half he became a man. With another half, he became a woman. Thus the Lord created the man Virdt.
verses.commentary: Sense: He then split his body. With one half he became a man. With another half, he became a woman. Thus the Lord created the man Virdt.

verses.sanskrit: ता वै विभूतयो विप्रा विश्रुताः शक्तयो भुवि । लक्ष्म्यादयो याभिरीशा विश्वंव्याप्नोति शाङ्करी
verses.transliteration: tā vai vibhūtayo viprā viśrutāḥ śaktayo bhuvi / lakṣmyādayo yābhirīśā viśvaṃvyāpnoti śāṅkarī
verses.translation: Priyavrata and Uttanapada were those sons. He had two excellent daughters also. Manu gave his daughter called Prasuti to Daksa.
verses.hindi: नित्या, शाश्‍वती, परमाक्षरा, अचिन्त्या, केवला, अनन्त्या, शिवात्मिका, परमात्मिका, अनादि, अव्यया, शुद्धा, देवात्मिका, सर्वगा, अचला  अपनी पुत्रीमें परस्परविरोधी अनेक रूपोंको देखकर भयभीत होना स्वाभाविक है, पर ऐश्वर्यसम्पन्न देवी ही मेरी पुत्री है--यह
verses.wordMeaning: Priyavrata and Uttanapada were those sons. He had two excellent daughters also. Manu gave his daughter called Prasuti to Daksa.
verses.commentary: Sense: Priyavrata and Uttanapada were those sons. He had two excellent daughters also. Manu gave his daughter called Prasuti to Daksa.

verses.sanskrit: विभज्य पुररीशानी स्वात्मानं शङ्कराद् विभोः । महादेवनियोगेन पितामहमुपस्थिता
verses.transliteration: vibhajya purarīśānī svātmānaṃ śaṅkarād vibhoḥ / mahādevaniyogena pitāmahamupasthitā
verses.translation: The mind-born son of Brahma called Ruci, the creater of beings, took (the other daughter of Manu called) Akuti (as his wife). That mind-born son of Brahma, Ruci, begot twin children of Akuti. They were splendid.
verses.hindi: अनुभव कर प्रसन्रचित्त होना भी स्वाभाविक ही है। एकानेकविभागस्था मायातीता सुनिर्मला। महामाहेश्वरी सत्या महादेवी निरञ्जना
verses.wordMeaning: The mind-born son of Brahma called Ruci, the creater of beings, took (the other daughter of Manu called) Akuti (as his wife). That mind-born son of Brahma, Ruci, begot twin children of Akuti. They were splendid.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mind-born son of Brahma called Ruci, the creater of beings, took (the other daughter of Manu called) Akuti (as his wife). That mind-born son of Brahma, Ruci, begot twin children of Akuti. They were splendid.

verses.sanskrit: तामाह भगवान् ब्रह्मा दक्षस्य दुहिता भव । सापि तस्य नियोगेन प्रादुरासीत् प्रजापतेः
verses.transliteration: tāmāha bhagavān brahmā dakṣasya duhitā bhava / sāpi tasya niyogena prādurāsīt prajāpateḥ
verses.translation: They were Yajna and Daksina. Through them the Universe flourished in population. Twelve sons were born to Yajna and Daksina.
verses.hindi: काष्ठा सर्वान्तरस्था च चिच्छक्तिरतिलालसा। नन्दा सर्वात्मिका विद्या ज्योतीरूपामृताक्षरा अनादिनिधनामोघा कारणात्मा कलाकला ।
verses.wordMeaning: They were Yajna and Daksina. Through them the Universe flourished in population. Twelve sons were born to Yajna and Daksina.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were Yajna and Daksina. Through them the Universe flourished in population. Twelve sons were born to Yajna and Daksina.

verses.sanskrit: नियोगाद् ब्रह्मणो देवीं ददौ रुद्राय तां सतीम् । दक्षाद् रुद्रो ऽपि जग्राह स्वकीयामेव शूलभृत्
verses.transliteration: niyogād brahmaṇo devīṃ dadau rudrāya tāṃ satīm / dakṣād rudro 'pi jagrāha svakīyāmeva śūlabhṛt
verses.translation: Danda (Punishment) and Naya (Polity) were the sons ofKriya (Action). Bodha (Enlightenment) and Apramada (Vigilance) were the sons ofBuddhi (Intelligence).
verses.hindi: सर्वशक्तिकलाकारा ज्योत्सत्रा द्यौर्महिमास्पदा। सर्वकार्यनियन्त्री च सर्वभूतेश्वरेशवरी आकाशयोनिर्योगस्था महायोगेश्वरेश्वरी
verses.wordMeaning: Danda (Punishment) and Naya (Polity) were the sons ofKriya (Action). Bodha (Enlightenment) and Apramada (Vigilance) were the sons ofBuddhi (Intelligence).
verses.commentary: Sense: Danda (Punishment) and Naya (Polity) were the sons ofKriya (Action). Bodha (Enlightenment) and Apramada (Vigilance) were the sons ofBuddhi (Intelligence).

verses.sanskrit: प्रजापतिं विनिन्द्यैषा कालेन परमेश्वरी । मेनायामभवत् पुत्री तदा हिमवतः सती
verses.transliteration: prajāpatiṃ vinindyaiṣā kālena parameśvarī / menāyāmabhavat putrī tadā himavataḥ satī
verses.translation: The birth of god Brahma from the lotus grown out of the eai- bilical region of god Visnu is common to many Puranas e.g. Bh. P. III. 8.1-23, L 20, Va. 24.
verses.hindi: सर्गस्थित्यन्तकरणी सुदुर्वाच्या दुरत्यया। शब्दयोनिः शब्दमयी नादाख्या नादविग्रहा प्रधानपुरुषातीता प्रधानपुरुषात्मिका। पुराणी चिन्मयी पुंसामादिः पुरुषरूपिणी
verses.wordMeaning: The birth of god Brahma from the lotus grown out of the eai- bilical region of god Visnu is common to many Puranas e.g. Bh. P. III. 8.1-23, L 20, Va. 24.
verses.commentary: Sense: The birth of god Brahma from the lotus grown out of the eai- bilical region of god Visnu is common to many Puranas e.g. Bh. P. III. 8.1-23, L 20, Va. 24.

verses.sanskrit: स चापि पर्वतवरो ददौ रुद्राय पार्वतीम् । हिताय सर्वदेवानां त्रिलोकस्यात्मनो ऽपि च
verses.transliteration: sa cāpi parvatavaro dadau rudrāya pārvatīm / hitāya sarvadevānāṃ trilokasyātmano 'pi ca
verses.translation: This sort of Pralaya involving the dissolution of only three worlds (bhu, bhuvar and svar) takes place at the end of a Kalpa or Brahma's day. It is called the Naimittika Pralaya.
verses.hindi: व्यक्ताव्यक्तात्मिका कृष्णा रक्ता शुक्ला प्रसूतिका । अकार्या कार्यजननी नित्यं प्रसवधर्मिणी सर्गप्रलयनिर्मुक्ता सृष्टिस्थित्यन्तधर्मिणी । ब्रह्मगर्भा चतुर्विशा पद्मनाभाच्युतात्मिका
verses.wordMeaning: This sort of Pralaya involving the dissolution of only three worlds (bhu, bhuvar and svar) takes place at the end of a Kalpa or Brahma's day. It is called the Naimittika Pralaya.
verses.commentary: Sense: This sort of Pralaya involving the dissolution of only three worlds (bhu, bhuvar and svar) takes place at the end of a Kalpa or Brahma's day. It is called the Naimittika Pralaya.

verses.sanskrit: सैषा माहेश्वरी देवी शङ्करार्धशरीरिणी । शिवा सती हैमवती सुरासुरनमस्कृता
verses.transliteration: saiṣā māheśvarī devī śaṅkarārdhaśarīriṇī / śivā satī haimavatī surāsuranamaskṛtā
verses.translation: How did the Lord Sambhu, the wielder of the Pindka bow, though born earlier than Brahma attain the son-hood of Brahma, born of the unmanifest?
verses.hindi: एका, अनेककिभागस्था (विविध रूपोंमें स्थित), मायातीता, सुनिर्मला, महामाहेश्वरी, सत्या, महादेवी, निरञ्जना, काष्ठा, सर्वान्तरस्था (सभीके हृदयमें स्थित (उत्कृष्ट इच्छारूपा), नन्दा, सर्वात्मिका, विद्या, ज्योतीरूपा, अमृताक्षरा, शान्ति, सभीको प्रतिष्ठा, निवृत्ति, अमृतप्रदा,
verses.wordMeaning: How did the Lord Sambhu, the wielder of the Pindka bow, though born earlier than Brahma attain the son-hood of Brahma, born of the unmanifest?
verses.commentary: Sense: How did the Lord Sambhu, the wielder of the Pindka bow, though born earlier than Brahma attain the son-hood of Brahma, born of the unmanifest?

verses.sanskrit: तस्याः प्रभावमतुलं सर्वे देवाः सवासवाः । विन्दन्ति मुनयो वेत्ति शङ्करो वा स्वयं हरिः
verses.transliteration: tasyāḥ prabhāvamatulaṃ sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ / vindanti munayo vetti śaṅkaro vā svayaṃ hariḥ
verses.translation: How was Lord Brahma, the grand-father of the worlds, the controller of the universe, born from Cosmic Egg? It behoves you to explain to us these.
verses.hindi: अनादिनिधना, अमोघा, कारणात्मिका, कला, अकला, सर्वशक्तिकलाकारा, ज्योत्स्ना, द्यौः (आकाश-
verses.wordMeaning: How was Lord Brahma, the grand-father of the worlds, the controller of the universe, born from Cosmic Egg? It behoves you to explain to us these.
verses.commentary: Sense: How was Lord Brahma, the grand-father of the worlds, the controller of the universe, born from Cosmic Egg? It behoves you to explain to us these.

verses.sanskrit: एतद् वः कथितं विप्राः पुत्रत्वं परमेष्ठिनः । ब्रह्मणः पद्मयोनित्वं शङ्करस्यामितौजसः
verses.transliteration: etad vaḥ kathitaṃ viprāḥ putratvaṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ / brahmaṇaḥ padmayonitvaṃ śaṅkarasyāmitaujasaḥ
verses.translation: O sages, listen all of you, how Sankara of unmeasur¬ ed prowess attained the state of being the son of Brahma, and how god Brahma had the lotus as the source of his origin-
verses.hindi: रूपा), महिमास्पदा, सर्वकार्यनियन्त्री, सर्वभूतेश्वरेश्वरी, अनादि, अव्यक्तगुहा, महानन्दा, सनातनी, आकाश- (कठिन तपसे प्राप्त करने योग्य), प्राणशक्ति, प्राण-
verses.wordMeaning: O sages, listen all of you, how Sankara of unmeasur¬ ed prowess attained the state of being the son of Brahma, and how god Brahma had the lotus as the source of his origin-
verses.commentary: Sense: O sages, listen all of you, how Sankara of unmeasur¬ ed prowess attained the state of being the son of Brahma, and how god Brahma had the lotus as the source of his origin-

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच इत्याकर्ण्याथ मुनयः कूर्मरूपेण भाषितम् । विष्णुना पुनरेवैनं प्रणता हरिम्
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca ityākarṇyātha munayaḥ kūrmarūpeṇa bhāṣitam / viṣṇunā punarevainaṃ praṇatā harim
verses.translation: At the close of the previous Kalpa, the three worlds, Bhu, Bhuvar and Soar sank into complete darkness. There was one great terrible vast sheet of water. There were neither Devas and others nor the sages.
verses.hindi: पुरुषारणि पुरुष (परब्रह्म) ही जिनको अरणि (अग्नि- मन्थनका काष्ठ-विशेष है), सर्गस्थित्यन्तकारिणी, नाद-विग्रहा, प्रधानपुरुषातीता, प्रधानपुरुषात्मिका, पुराणी, चिन्मयी, पुरुषोंकी आदिस्वरूपा, पुरुषरूपिणी,
verses.wordMeaning: At the close of the previous Kalpa, the three worlds, Bhu, Bhuvar and Soar sank into complete darkness. There was one great terrible vast sheet of water. There were neither Devas and others nor the sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the close of the previous Kalpa, the three worlds, Bhu, Bhuvar and Soar sank into complete darkness. There was one great terrible vast sheet of water. There were neither Devas and others nor the sages.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषय ऊचुः कैषा भगवती देवी शङ्करार्धशरीरिणी । शिवा सती हैमवती यथावद् ब्रूहि पृच्छताम्
verses.transliteration: ṛṣaya ūcuḥ kaiṣā bhagavatī devī śaṅkarārdhaśarīriṇī / śivā satī haimavatī yathāvad brūhi pṛcchatām
verses.translation: There, in that isolated place free from disturbance and trouble. Lord Narayana, the Supreme Person, resorted to the Couch of Sesa and slumbered.
verses.hindi: व्यक्ताव्यक्तात्मिका, कृष्णा, रक्ता, शुक्ला, प्रसूतिका, अकार्या, कार्यजननी, नित्यप्रसवधर्मिणी, सर्गप्रलयनिर्मुक्ता, सृष्टिस्थित्यन्तधर्मिणी, ब्रह्मगर्भा, चतुर्विशा (चौबीस तत्तवोंम्पे अन्तिम तत्त्व), पद्मनाभा, अच्युतात्मिका, वैद्युती, शाश्वती, योनि (मूल कारण), जगन्माता, ईश्वरप्रिया, सर्वाधारा, महारूपा, सर्वैश्वर्यसमन्विता
verses.wordMeaning: There, in that isolated place free from disturbance and trouble. Lord Narayana, the Supreme Person, resorted to the Couch of Sesa and slumbered.
verses.commentary: Sense: There, in that isolated place free from disturbance and trouble. Lord Narayana, the Supreme Person, resorted to the Couch of Sesa and slumbered.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा मुनीनां पुरुषोत्तमः । प्रत्युवाच महायोगी ध्यात्वा स्वं परमं पदम्
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ tad vacanaṃ śrutvā munīnāṃ puruṣottamaḥ / pratyuvāca mahāyogī dhyātvā svaṃ paramaṃ padam
verses.translation: Once, when he was asleep, a divine and wonderful lotus that was the quintessence of the three worlds, shone in his umbilical region, for the sake of his diversion.
verses.hindi: महीयसी ब्रह्मयोनिर्महालक्ष्मीसमुद्धवा महाविमानमध्यस्था महानिद्रात्महेतुका । सर्वसाधारणी सूक्ष्मा ह्यविद्या पारमार्थिका
verses.wordMeaning: Once, when he was asleep, a divine and wonderful lotus that was the quintessence of the three worlds, shone in his umbilical region, for the sake of his diversion.
verses.commentary: Sense: Once, when he was asleep, a divine and wonderful lotus that was the quintessence of the three worlds, shone in his umbilical region, for the sake of his diversion.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीकूर्म उवाच पुरा पितामहेनोक्तं मेरुपृष्ठे सुशोभनम् । रहस्यमेतद् विज्ञानं गोपनीयं विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: śrīkūrma uvāca purā pitāmahenoktaṃ merupṛṣṭhe suśobhanam / rahasyametad vijñānaṃ gopanīyaṃ viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: It extended to a hundred Yojanas (1 Yojana= 12 Kilometres). It resembled the morning sun. It had divine fra¬ grance. It was meritorious and endowed with Karnika (pericarp) and Kesaras (filaments).
verses.hindi: अनन्तरूपानन्तस्था देवी पुरुषमोहिनी। अनेकाकारसंस्थाना कालत्रयविवर्जिता ब्रह्मजन्मा हरेर्मूर्तिब्रह्याविष्णुशिवात्मिका । ब्रहोशविष्णुजननी ब्रह्माख्या ब्रह्मसंश्रया
verses.wordMeaning: It extended to a hundred Yojanas (1 Yojana= 12 Kilometres). It resembled the morning sun. It had divine fra¬ grance. It was meritorious and endowed with Karnika (pericarp) and Kesaras (filaments).
verses.commentary: Sense: It extended to a hundred Yojanas (1 Yojana= 12 Kilometres). It resembled the morning sun. It had divine fra¬ grance. It was meritorious and endowed with Karnika (pericarp) and Kesaras (filaments).

verses.sanskrit: सांख्यानां परमं सांख्यं ब्रह्मविज्ञानमुत्तमम् । संसारार्णवमग्नानां जन्तूनामेकमोचनम्
verses.transliteration: sāṃkhyānāṃ paramaṃ sāṃkhyaṃ brahmavijñānamuttamam / saṃsārārṇavamagnānāṃ jantūnāmekamocanam
verses.translation: While Sarhgin (god Visnu) was staying like this for a long time. Lord Hiranyagarbha (Brahma) came to that place.
verses.hindi: वैराग्येश्वर्यधर्मात्मा ब्रह्मामूर्तिहदिस्थिता। अपांयोनि: स्वयम्भूतिर्मानसी तत्त्वसम्भवा ईश्वराणी च शर्वाणी शंकरार्धशरीरिणी । भवानी चैव रुद्राणी महालक्ष्मीरथाम्बिका
verses.wordMeaning: While Sarhgin (god Visnu) was staying like this for a long time. Lord Hiranyagarbha (Brahma) came to that place.
verses.commentary: Sense: While Sarhgin (god Visnu) was staying like this for a long time. Lord Hiranyagarbha (Brahma) came to that place.

verses.sanskrit: या सा माहेश्वरी शक्तिर्ज्ञानरूपातिलालसा । व्योमसंज्ञा परा काष्ठा सेयं हैमवती मता
verses.transliteration: yā sā māheśvarī śaktirjñānarūpātilālasā / vyomasaṃjñā parā kāṣṭhā seyaṃ haimavatī matā
verses.translation: That Visvatman (the Soul of the universe) roused up the eternal deity with his hand. Deluded by his Maya he spoke these sweet words.
verses.hindi: ब्रहोन्द्रोपेन्द्रनमिता शंकरेच्छानुवर्तिनी। ईश्वरार्धासनगता महेश्वरपतिव्रता गुणाढ्या योगजा योग्या ज्ञानमूर्तिविकासिनी। सावित्री कमला लक्ष्मीः श्रीरनन्तोरसिस्थिता
verses.wordMeaning: That Visvatman (the Soul of the universe) roused up the eternal deity with his hand. Deluded by his Maya he spoke these sweet words.
verses.commentary: Sense: That Visvatman (the Soul of the universe) roused up the eternal deity with his hand. Deluded by his Maya he spoke these sweet words.

verses.sanskrit: शिवा सर्वगतानान्ता गुणातीता सुनिष्कला । एकानेकविभागस्था ज्ञानरूपातिलालसा
verses.transliteration: śivā sarvagatānāntā guṇātītā suniṣkalā / ekānekavibhāgasthā jñānarūpātilālasā
verses.translation: O excellent person, tell me who are staying alone in this terrible vast sheet of water, isolated and enveloped in darkness.
verses.hindi: वाग्देवी वरदा वाच्या कीर्तिः सर्वार्थसाधिका। योगीश्वरी ब्रह्मविद्या महाविद्या सुशोभना गुह्यविद्यात्मविद्या च धर्मविद्यात्मभाविता।
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent person, tell me who are staying alone in this terrible vast sheet of water, isolated and enveloped in darkness.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent person, tell me who are staying alone in this terrible vast sheet of water, isolated and enveloped in darkness.
