verses.sanskrit: अनन्या निष्कले तत्त्वे संस्थिता तस्य तेजसा । स्वाभाविकी च तन्मूला प्रभा भानोरिवामला
verses.transliteration: ananyā niṣkale tattve saṃsthitā tasya tejasā / svābhāvikī ca tanmūlā prabhā bhānorivāmalā
verses.translation: On hearing his words the Garuda-bannered Lord laughed and replied to lord Brahma in a voice as majestic as the sound of a cloud.
verses.hindi: शोभा वंशकरी लोला मालिनी परमेष्ठिनी । त्रैलोक्यसुन्दरी रम्या सुन्दरी कामचारिणी पद्ममाला पापहरा विचित्रा मुकुटानना
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing his words the Garuda-bannered Lord laughed and replied to lord Brahma in a voice as majestic as the sound of a cloud.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing his words the Garuda-bannered Lord laughed and replied to lord Brahma in a voice as majestic as the sound of a cloud.

verses.sanskrit: एका माहेश्वरी शक्तिरनेकोपाधियोगतः । परावरेण रूपेण क्रीडते तस्य सन्निधौ
verses.transliteration: ekā māheśvarī śaktiranekopādhiyogataḥ / parāvareṇa rūpeṇa krīḍate tasya sannidhau
verses.translation: O, know me as the Supreme Person, Lord Nara- yana, the source of origin of and the seat of dissolution of the worlds and Mahdyogisvara (great lord of the Yogins).
verses.hindi: कान्ता चित्राम्बरधरा दिव्याभरणभूषिता । हंसाख्या व्योमनिलया जगत्सृष्टिविवर्थिनी ब्रह्मयोनि, महालक्ष्मीसमुद्भवा, महाविमानमध्यस्था, महा- निद्रा, आत्महेतुका, सर्वसाधारणी, सूक्ष्मा, अविद्या, पारमार्थिका
verses.wordMeaning: O, know me as the Supreme Person, Lord Nara- yana, the source of origin of and the seat of dissolution of the worlds and Mahdyogisvara (great lord of the Yogins).
verses.commentary: Sense: O, know me as the Supreme Person, Lord Nara- yana, the source of origin of and the seat of dissolution of the worlds and Mahdyogisvara (great lord of the Yogins).

verses.sanskrit: सेयं करोति सकलं तस्याः कार्यमिदं जगत् । न कार्यं नापि करणमीश्वरस्येति सूरयः
verses.transliteration: seyaṃ karoti sakalaṃ tasyāḥ kāryamidaṃ jagat / na kāryaṃ nāpi karaṇamīśvarasyeti sūrayaḥ
verses.translation: O grandfather of the worlds, within me you see the entire universe including the mountains and the great continents surrounded by seven oceans.
verses.hindi: अनन्तरूपा, अनन्तस्था, देवी, पुरुषमोहिनी, अनेकाकारसंस्थाना, कालत्रयविवर्जिता, ब्रह्मजन्मा, हरिमूर्ति (हरिकी मूर्ति), ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवात्मिका, ब्रह्मेशविष्णुजननी, ब्रह्माख्या, ब्रह्मसंश्रया, व्यक्ता, प्रथमजा, ब्राह्मी, महती, ज्ञानरूपिणी, वैराग्यैश्वर्यधर्मात्मिका, ब्रह्ममूर्ति, हृदिस्थिता, अपांयोनि (जलको योनि),
verses.wordMeaning: O grandfather of the worlds, within me you see the entire universe including the mountains and the great continents surrounded by seven oceans.
verses.commentary: Sense: O grandfather of the worlds, within me you see the entire universe including the mountains and the great continents surrounded by seven oceans.

verses.sanskrit: चतस्त्रः शक्तयो देव्याः स्वरूपत्वेन संस्थिताः । अधिष्ठानवशात् तस्याः शृणुध्वं मुनिपुङ्गवाः
verses.transliteration: catastraḥ śaktayo devyāḥ svarūpatvena saṃsthitāḥ / adhiṣṭhānavaśāt tasyāḥ śṛṇudhvaṃ munipuṅgavāḥ
verses.translation: After addressing that person (Brahma) thus, Hari, the soul of the universe, asked Brahma—"who are you?", though he knew it.
verses.hindi: शंकरार्धशरीरिणी, भवानी, रुद्राणी, महालक्ष्मी, अम्बिका, नित्यमुदितमानसा, ब्रह्ोनद्रोपेन्द्रनमिता, शंकरेच्छानुवर्तिनी, ईश्वरार्धासनगता, महेश्वरपतिव्रता
verses.wordMeaning: After addressing that person (Brahma) thus, Hari, the soul of the universe, asked Brahma—"who are you?", though he knew it.
verses.commentary: Sense: After addressing that person (Brahma) thus, Hari, the soul of the universe, asked Brahma—"who are you?", though he knew it.

verses.sanskrit: शान्तिर्विद्या प्रतिष्ठा च निवृत्तिश्चेतिताः स्मृतः । चतुर्व्यूहस्ततो देवः प्रोच्यते परमेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: śāntirvidyā pratiṣṭhā ca nivṛttiścetitāḥ smṛtaḥ / caturvyūhastato devaḥ procyate parameśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Then lord Brahma, the storehouse of Vedas laughed and replied with a smile to the deity whose eyes resembled the lotus, in words gentle and charming.
verses.hindi: ज्ञानमूर्ति, विकासिनी, सावित्री, कमला, लक्ष्मी, श्री, अनन्तोरसिस्थिता (विष्णुके हृदयमें रहनेवाली), सर्वविद्या, जगज्ज्येष्ठा, सुमङ्गला, वाग्देवी, वरदा, वाच्या, कीर्ति, सर्वार्थसाधिका, योगीश्वरी, ब्रह्मविद्या, महाविद्या, सुशोभना, गुह्यविद्या, आत्मविद्या, धर्मविद्या, आत्मभाविता,
verses.wordMeaning: Then lord Brahma, the storehouse of Vedas laughed and replied with a smile to the deity whose eyes resembled the lotus, in words gentle and charming.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then lord Brahma, the storehouse of Vedas laughed and replied with a smile to the deity whose eyes resembled the lotus, in words gentle and charming.

verses.sanskrit: अनया परया देवः स्वात्मानन्दं समश्नुते । चतुर्ष्वपि च वेदेषु चतुर्मूर्तिर्महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: anayā parayā devaḥ svātmānandaṃ samaśnute / caturṣvapi ca vedeṣu caturmūrtirmaheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: I am the creator and dispenser of destiny. I am the self-born deity. I am the great grandfather. The universe is stationed in me alone. I am Brahma, with faces all round.
verses.hindi: विभावरी, सौम्या, भोगिनी, भोगदायिनी, शोभा, बंशकरी, लोला (चञ्चला), मालिनी, परमेष्ठिनी, त्रैलोक्यसुन्दरी, रम्या, सुन्दरी, कामचारिणी पापहरा, विचित्रा, मुकुरानना, कान्ता, चित्राम्बरधरा,
verses.wordMeaning: I am the creator and dispenser of destiny. I am the self-born deity. I am the great grandfather. The universe is stationed in me alone. I am Brahma, with faces all round.
verses.commentary: Sense: I am the creator and dispenser of destiny. I am the self-born deity. I am the great grandfather. The universe is stationed in me alone. I am Brahma, with faces all round.

verses.sanskrit: अस्यास्त्वनादिसंसिद्धमैश्वर्यमतुलं महत् । तत्सम्बन्धादनन्ताया रुद्रेण परमात्मना
verses.transliteration: asyāstvanādisaṃsiddhamaiśvaryamatulaṃ mahat / tatsambandhādanantāyā rudreṇa paramātmanā
verses.translation: On hearing those words, Visnu of truthful exploits
verses.hindi: निर्यन्त्रा यन्त्रवाहस्था नन्दिनी भद्रकालिका। आदित्यवर्णा कौमारी मयूरवरवाहिनी वृषासनगता गौरी महाकाली सुराचिता। अदितिर्नियता रौद्री पदागर्भा विवाहना
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing those words, Visnu of truthful exploits
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing those words, Visnu of truthful exploits

verses.sanskrit: सैषा सर्वेश्वरी देवी सर्वभूतप्रवर्तिका । प्रोच्यते भगवान् कालो हरिः प्राणो महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: saiṣā sarveśvarī devī sarvabhūtapravartikā / procyate bhagavān kālo hariḥ prāṇo maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: He became surprised on seeing this entire set of the three worlds, including Devas, Asuras and human beings in the abdomen of that god (Brahma).
verses.hindi: महाफलानवद्याड्री कामपूरा विभावरी कौशिकी कर्षणी रात्रिस्त्रिदशार्तिविनाशिनी
verses.wordMeaning: He became surprised on seeing this entire set of the three worlds, including Devas, Asuras and human beings in the abdomen of that god (Brahma).
verses.commentary: Sense: He became surprised on seeing this entire set of the three worlds, including Devas, Asuras and human beings in the abdomen of that god (Brahma).

verses.sanskrit: तत्र सर्वमिदं प्रोतमोतं चैवाखिलं जगत् । स कालो ऽग्निर्हरो रुद्रो गीयते वेदवादिभिः
verses.transliteration: tatra sarvamidaṃ protamotaṃ caivākhilaṃ jagat / sa kālo 'gnirharo rudro gīyate vedavādibhiḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter Visnu, the deity with the Lord of serpents, Sesa as his abode, came out of his mouth and spoke to Pitdmaha (god Brahma, the grand-sire of the world).
verses.hindi: अकलङ्का निराधारा नित्यसिद्धा निरामया कामधेनुर्बृहदगर्भा धीमती मोहनाशिनी। निःसङ्कल्पा निरातङ्का विनया विनयप्रदा
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter Visnu, the deity with the Lord of serpents, Sesa as his abode, came out of his mouth and spoke to Pitdmaha (god Brahma, the grand-sire of the world).
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter Visnu, the deity with the Lord of serpents, Sesa as his abode, came out of his mouth and spoke to Pitdmaha (god Brahma, the grand-sire of the world).

verses.sanskrit: कालः सृजति भूतानि कालः संहरते प्रजाः । सर्वे कालस्य वशगा न कालः कस्यचिद् वशे
verses.transliteration: kālaḥ sṛjati bhūtāni kālaḥ saṃharate prajāḥ / sarve kālasya vaśagā na kālaḥ kasyacid vaśe
verses.translation: O excellent Purusa, in this manner you too enter my eternal abdomen and see all these wonderful worlds.
verses.hindi: ज्चालामालासहस्त्राढ्या देवदेवी मनोन्मनी । महाभगवती दुर्गा वासुदेवसमुद्भवा संध्या सर्वसमुद्भूतिर्ब्रह्मवृक्षाश्रयानतिः। बीजाङ्करसमुद्भूतिर्महाशक्तिर्महामतिः
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Purusa, in this manner you too enter my eternal abdomen and see all these wonderful worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Purusa, in this manner you too enter my eternal abdomen and see all these wonderful worlds.

verses.sanskrit: प्रधानं पुरुषस्तत्त्वं महानात्मा त्वहङ्कृतिः । कालेनान्यानि तत्त्वानि समाविष्टानि योगिना
verses.transliteration: pradhānaṃ puruṣastattvaṃ mahānātmā tvahaṅkṛtiḥ / kālenānyāni tattvāni samāviṣṭāni yoginā
verses.translation: After hearing the pleasing words of the Lord of Laksmi (i.e. Visnu) and approving of them, Kusadhvaja (i.e. Brahma) entered his belly once again.
verses.hindi: विकृतिः शांकरी शास्त्री गणगन्धर्वसेविता वैश्वानरी महाशाला देवसेना गुहप्रिया। महारात्रिः शिवानन्दा शचीदुःस्वप्ननाशिनी
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing the pleasing words of the Lord of Laksmi (i.e. Visnu) and approving of them, Kusadhvaja (i.e. Brahma) entered his belly once again.
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing the pleasing words of the Lord of Laksmi (i.e. Visnu) and approving of them, Kusadhvaja (i.e. Brahma) entered his belly once again.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य सर्वजगत्सूतिः शक्तिर्मायेति विश्रुता । तयेदं भ्रामयेदीशो मायावी पुरुषोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: tasya sarvajagatsūtiḥ śaktirmāyeti viśrutā / tayedaṃ bhrāmayedīśo māyāvī puruṣottamaḥ
verses.translation: Brahma, of truthful exploit, saw the self-same worlds stationed in the womb of the Lord. Ranging about, he did not see any limit of Hari.
verses.hindi: गुहाम्बिका गुणोत्पत्तिर्महापीठा मरुत्सुता निर्यन्त्रा, यन्त्रवाहस्था, नन्दिनी, भद्रकालिका,
verses.wordMeaning: Brahma, of truthful exploit, saw the self-same worlds stationed in the womb of the Lord. Ranging about, he did not see any limit of Hari.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahma, of truthful exploit, saw the self-same worlds stationed in the womb of the Lord. Ranging about, he did not see any limit of Hari.

verses.sanskrit: सैषा मायात्मिका शक्तिः सर्वाकारा सनातनी । वैश्वरूप्यं महेशस्य सर्वदा संप्रकाशयेत्
verses.transliteration: saiṣā māyātmikā śaktiḥ sarvākārā sanātanī / vaiśvarūpyaṃ maheśasya sarvadā saṃprakāśayet
verses.translation: Then all the other openings were closed by the noble-souled Janardana and Brahma found an opening in the umbilical region.
verses.hindi: गौरी, महाकाली, सुराचिता, अदिति, नियता, रौद्री, महाफला, अनवद्याङ्गी, कामपूरा, विभावरी, विचित्ररत्नमुकुय, प्रणतार्तिप्रभञ्जिनी, कौशिकी, कर्षणी, रात्रि,
verses.wordMeaning: Then all the other openings were closed by the noble-souled Janardana and Brahma found an opening in the umbilical region.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then all the other openings were closed by the noble-souled Janardana and Brahma found an opening in the umbilical region.

verses.sanskrit: अन्याश्च शक्तयो मुख्यास्तस्य देवस्य निर्मिताः । ज्ञानशक्तिः क्रियाशक्तिः प्राणशक्तिरिति त्रयम्
verses.transliteration: anyāśca śaktayo mukhyāstasya devasya nirmitāḥ / jñānaśaktiḥ kriyāśaktiḥ prāṇaśaktiriti trayam
verses.translation: The deity born of Golden Egg entered it through his Yogic power. The four-faced Lord manifested himself out of the lotus.
verses.hindi: अकलंका, निराधारा, नित्यसिद्धा, निरामया, कामधेनु, बृहदूर्भा, धीमती, मोहनाशिनी, निःसङ्कल्पा, निरातङ्का, विनया, विनयप्रदा, ज्चालामालासहस्त्राढ्या, देवदेवी, मनोन्मनी, महाभगवती, दुर्गा, वासुदेवसमुद्भवा, संध्या, सर्वसमुद्ूति, ब्रह्मवृक्षाश्रयानति, बीजाङ्कर-
verses.wordMeaning: The deity born of Golden Egg entered it through his Yogic power. The four-faced Lord manifested himself out of the lotus.
verses.commentary: Sense: The deity born of Golden Egg entered it through his Yogic power. The four-faced Lord manifested himself out of the lotus.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वासामेव शक्तीनां शक्तिमन्तो विनिर्मिताः । माययैवाथ विप्रेन्द्राः सा चानादिरनन्तया
verses.transliteration: sarvāsāmeva śaktīnāṃ śaktimanto vinirmitāḥ / māyayaivātha viprendrāḥ sā cānādiranantayā
verses.translation: The self-born God Brahma who is lustrous like the interior of the lotus, the grand-sire and the source of the origin of the Universe, shone resplendent while seated in the lotus.
verses.hindi: संवित्, महाभोगीन्द्रशायिनी, विकृति, शांकरी, शास्त्री, गणगन्धर्वसेविता, वैश्वानरी, महाशाला, देवसेना, गुहप्रिया, महारात्रि, शिवानन्दा, शची, दुःस्वप्ननाशिनी, इज्या, पूज्या, जगद्धात्री, दुर्विज्ञेया, सुरूपिणी, गुहाम्बिका, गुणोत्पत्ति, संसारतारिणी विद्या ब्रह्मवादिमनोलया
verses.wordMeaning: The self-born God Brahma who is lustrous like the interior of the lotus, the grand-sire and the source of the origin of the Universe, shone resplendent while seated in the lotus.
verses.commentary: Sense: The self-born God Brahma who is lustrous like the interior of the lotus, the grand-sire and the source of the origin of the Universe, shone resplendent while seated in the lotus.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वशक्त्यात्मिका माया दुर्निवारा दुरत्यया । मायावी सर्वशक्तीशः कालः कालकारः प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: sarvaśaktyātmikā māyā durnivārā duratyayā / māyāvī sarvaśaktīśaḥ kālaḥ kālakāraḥ prabhuḥ
verses.translation: Considering himself the lord of the universe and the highest seat—the goal to be reached—he spoke to Visnu, the excellent Purusa, with words as majestic as the rumbling sound of the cloud.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्माणी बृहती ब्राह्मी ब्रह्मभूता भवारणिः । हिरण्मयी महारात्रिः संसारपरिवर्तिका सत्त्वशुद्द्रिकरी शुद्द्िर्मलत्रयविनाशिनी
verses.wordMeaning: Considering himself the lord of the universe and the highest seat—the goal to be reached—he spoke to Visnu, the excellent Purusa, with words as majestic as the rumbling sound of the cloud.
verses.commentary: Sense: Considering himself the lord of the universe and the highest seat—the goal to be reached—he spoke to Visnu, the excellent Purusa, with words as majestic as the rumbling sound of the cloud.

verses.sanskrit: करोति कालः सकलं संहरेत् काल एव हि । कालः स्थापयते विश्वं कालाधीनमिदं जगत्
verses.transliteration: karoti kālaḥ sakalaṃ saṃharet kāla eva hi / kālaḥ sthāpayate viśvaṃ kālādhīnamidaṃ jagat
verses.translation: "What is this that has been done by you, desirous of your own victory? I am the only powerful one and no one else. Who will dare attack me?"
verses.hindi: क्षालिनी सन्मयी व्याप्ता तैजसी पदाबोधिका महामायाश्रया मान्या महादेवमनोरमा। व्योमलक्ष्मीः सिंहरथा चेकितानामितप्रभा
verses.wordMeaning: "What is this that has been done by you, desirous of your own victory? I am the only powerful one and no one else. Who will dare attack me?"
verses.commentary: Sense: "What is this that has been done by you, desirous of your own victory? I am the only powerful one and no one else. Who will dare attack me?"

verses.sanskrit: लब्ध्वा देवाधिदेवस्य सन्निधिं परमेष्ठिनः । अनन्तस्याखिलेशस्य शंभोः कालात्मनः प्रभोः
verses.transliteration: labdhvā devādhidevasya sannidhiṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ / anantasyākhileśasya śaṃbhoḥ kālātmanaḥ prabhoḥ
verses.translation: On hearing the words uttered by Brahma, Hari who was reposing on the cosmic waters as his abode and who was ever wakeful, spoke the following sweet words in a conciliatory tone.
verses.hindi: वीरेशवरी विमानस्था विशोका शोकनाशिनी। अनाहता कुण्डलिनी नलिनी पदावासिनी सदानन्दा सदाकीर्तिः सर्वभूता श्रयस्थिता। वाग्देवता ब्रह्मकला कलातीता कलारणिः
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the words uttered by Brahma, Hari who was reposing on the cosmic waters as his abode and who was ever wakeful, spoke the following sweet words in a conciliatory tone.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words uttered by Brahma, Hari who was reposing on the cosmic waters as his abode and who was ever wakeful, spoke the following sweet words in a conciliatory tone.

verses.sanskrit: प्रधानं पुरुषो माया माया चैवं प्रपद्यते । एका सर्वगतानन्ता केवला निष्कला शिवा
verses.transliteration: pradhānaṃ puruṣo māyā māyā caivaṃ prapadyate / ekā sarvagatānantā kevalā niṣkalā śivā
verses.translation: You are the creator and the dispenser of destiny. You are the self-born great grand-father. It was not out of malice that the openings were closed by me.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मश्रीर््रह्महृदया ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवप्रिया। क्षोभिका बन्धिका भेद्या भेदाभेदविवर्जिता। अभिन्नाभिन्नसंस्थाना वंशिनी वंशहारिणी
verses.wordMeaning: You are the creator and the dispenser of destiny. You are the self-born great grand-father. It was not out of malice that the openings were closed by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are the creator and the dispenser of destiny. You are the self-born great grand-father. It was not out of malice that the openings were closed by me.

verses.sanskrit: एका शक्तिः शिवैको ऽपि शक्तिमानुच्यते शिवः । शक्तयः शक्तिमन्तो ऽन्ये सर्वशक्तिसमुद्भवाः
verses.transliteration: ekā śaktiḥ śivaiko 'pi śaktimānucyate śivaḥ / śaktayaḥ śaktimanto 'nye sarvaśaktisamudbhavāḥ
verses.translation: It was only for fun. It was not with a desire to harass you. Who would wish to trouble the grandfather, the Lord of Devas?
verses.hindi: भगिनी भगवत्पली सकला कालकारिणी कपिला कापिला कान्ता कनकाभा कलान्तरा । पुण्या पुष्करिणी भोक्त्री पुरंदरपुरस्सरा
verses.wordMeaning: It was only for fun. It was not with a desire to harass you. Who would wish to trouble the grandfather, the Lord of Devas?
verses.commentary: Sense: It was only for fun. It was not with a desire to harass you. Who would wish to trouble the grandfather, the Lord of Devas?

verses.sanskrit: शक्तिशक्तिमतोर्भेदं वदन्ति परमार्थतः । अभेदं चानुपश्यन्ति योगिनस्तत्त्वचिन्तकाः
verses.transliteration: śaktiśaktimatorbhedaṃ vadanti paramārthataḥ / abhedaṃ cānupaśyanti yoginastattvacintakāḥ
verses.translation: O Brahma, you are not harassed.* In every respect you are worthy of being honoured. O auspicious one, please forgive me the offence committed against you (i.e. if I have offended you), [v.l. whatever has been done by me to you is in the interest of your progeny. ]
verses.hindi: पञ्चब्रह्मसमुत्पत्तिः परमार्थार्थविग्रहा धर्मोदया भानुमती योगिज्ञेया मनोजवा। मनोहरा मनोरक्षा तापसी वेदरूपिणी
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahma, you are not harassed.* In every respect you are worthy of being honoured. O auspicious one, please forgive me the offence committed against you (i.e. if I have offended you), [v.l. whatever has been done by me to you is in the interest of your progeny. ]
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahma, you are not harassed.* In every respect you are worthy of being honoured. O auspicious one, please forgive me the offence committed against you (i.e. if I have offended you), [v.l. whatever has been done by me to you is in the interest of your progeny. ]

verses.sanskrit: शक्तयो गिरजा देवी शक्तिमन्तो ऽथ शङ्करः । विशेषः कथ्यते चायं पुराणे ब्रह्मवादिभिः
verses.transliteration: śaktayo girajā devī śaktimanto 'tha śaṅkaraḥ / viśeṣaḥ kathyate cāyaṃ purāṇe brahmavādibhiḥ
verses.translation: O Brahma, for this very same reason be a son unto me. O deity in the form of the universe, be famous by the name Padmayoni (having lotus as the source of origin) for the sake of my love.
verses.hindi: विद्या, ब्रह्मवादिमनोलया, ब्रह्माणी, बृहती, ब्राह्मी, ब्रह्मभूता, भवारणि, हिरण्मयी, महारात्रि, संसारपरिंवर्तिका, सुमालिनी, सत्त्वशुद्धिकरी, शुद्धि, मलत्रयविनाशिनी, जगत्प्रिया,
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahma, for this very same reason be a son unto me. O deity in the form of the universe, be famous by the name Padmayoni (having lotus as the source of origin) for the sake of my love.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahma, for this very same reason be a son unto me. O deity in the form of the universe, be famous by the name Padmayoni (having lotus as the source of origin) for the sake of my love.

verses.sanskrit: भोग्या विश्वेश्वरी देवी महेश्वरपतिव्रता । प्रोच्यते भगवान् भोक्ता कपर्दे नीललोहितः
verses.transliteration: bhogyā viśveśvarī devī maheśvarapativratā / procyate bhagavān bhoktā kaparde nīlalohitaḥ
verses.translation: Then that Lord conferred the boon to the crowned one (i.e. Visnu). Deriving unparalleled delight, he spoke to Visnu again.
verses.hindi: सन्मयी, व्याप्ता, तैजसी, पद्मबोधिका, महामायाश्रया, मान्या, महादेवमनोरमा, व्योमलक्ष्मी, सिंहरथा, चेकिताना, अमितप्रभा, वीरेश्वरी, विमानस्था, विशोका, शोकनाशिनी, सदाकीर्ति, सर्वभूताश्रयस्थिता, वाग्देवता, ब्रह्मकला, कलातीता, कलारणि, ब्रह्मश्री, ब्रह्महृदया, ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवप्रिया, व्योमशक्ति, क्रियाशक्ति, ज्ञानशक्ति, परागति, क्षोभिका, बन्धिका, भेद्या, भेदाभेदविवर्जिता, अभिन्ना, अभिन्नसंस्थाना,
verses.wordMeaning: Then that Lord conferred the boon to the crowned one (i.e. Visnu). Deriving unparalleled delight, he spoke to Visnu again.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then that Lord conferred the boon to the crowned one (i.e. Visnu). Deriving unparalleled delight, he spoke to Visnu again.

verses.sanskrit: मन्ता विश्वेश्वरो देवः शङ्करो मन्मथान्तकः । प्रोच्यते मतिरीशानी मन्तव्या च विचारतः
verses.transliteration: mantā viśveśvaro devaḥ śaṅkaro manmathāntakaḥ / procyate matirīśānī mantavyā ca vicārataḥ
verses.translation: You are identical with everything. You are infinite. You are the greatest Isvara of all. You are the immanent soul of all living beings. You are the greatest and eternal Brahman.
verses.hindi: कालकारिणी ॥ १३८ १४४॥ योगमाता, गङ्गा, विश्वेश्वरेश्वरी, कपिला, कापिला, कान्ता, कनकाभा, कलान्तरा, पुण्या, पुष्करिणी, भोक्त्री,
verses.wordMeaning: You are identical with everything. You are infinite. You are the greatest Isvara of all. You are the immanent soul of all living beings. You are the greatest and eternal Brahman.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are identical with everything. You are infinite. You are the greatest Isvara of all. You are the immanent soul of all living beings. You are the greatest and eternal Brahman.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येतदखिलं विप्राः शक्तिशक्तिमदुद्भवम् । प्रोच्यते सर्ववेदेषु मुनिभिस्तत्त्वदर्शिभिः
verses.transliteration: ityetadakhilaṃ viprāḥ śaktiśaktimadudbhavam / procyate sarvavedeṣu munibhistattvadarśibhiḥ
verses.translation: I too am the great Isvara, the bright light of the Atman of all the worlds. All the worlds are pervaded by me. I am the Brahman, the transcendental Purusa.
verses.hindi: पञ्चब्रह्मसमुत्पत्ति, परमार्थार्थविग्रहा, धर्मोदया, भानुमती, वेदशक्तिर्वेदमाता वेदविद्याप्रकाशिनी। योगेश्वरेशवरी माता महाशक्तिर्मनोमयी
verses.wordMeaning: I too am the great Isvara, the bright light of the Atman of all the worlds. All the worlds are pervaded by me. I am the Brahman, the transcendental Purusa.
verses.commentary: Sense: I too am the great Isvara, the bright light of the Atman of all the worlds. All the worlds are pervaded by me. I am the Brahman, the transcendental Purusa.

verses.sanskrit: एतत् प्रदर्शितं दिव्यं देव्या माहात्म्यमुत्तमम् । सर्ववेदान्तवेदेषु निश्चितं ब्रह्मवादिभिः
verses.transliteration: etat pradarśitaṃ divyaṃ devyā māhātmyamuttamam / sarvavedāntavedeṣu niścitaṃ brahmavādibhiḥ
verses.translation: There is no superior ruler of the worlds other than we two. We, Narayana and Brahma (the grand-sire of the universe) are but one single body divided into two.
verses.hindi: भारती परमानन्दा परापरविभेदिका। सर्वप्रहरणोपेता काम्या कामेश्वरेश्वरी त्रिविक्रमपदोद्भूता धनुष्पाणिः शिवोदया। सुदुर्लभा धनाध्यक्षा धन्या पिङ्कललोचना
verses.wordMeaning: There is no superior ruler of the worlds other than we two. We, Narayana and Brahma (the grand-sire of the universe) are but one single body divided into two.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no superior ruler of the worlds other than we two. We, Narayana and Brahma (the grand-sire of the universe) are but one single body divided into two.

verses.sanskrit: एकं सर्वगतं सूक्ष्मं कूटस्थमचलं ध्रुवम् । योगिनस्तत् प्रपश्यन्ति महादेव्याः परं पदम्
verses.transliteration: ekaṃ sarvagataṃ sūkṣmaṃ kūṭasthamacalaṃ dhruvam / yoginastat prapaśyanti mahādevyāḥ paraṃ padam
verses.translation: On being addressed thus by him, Vasudeva spoke to Brahma, "This enunciation may lead to your destruction.
verses.hindi: दुर्गा कात्यायनी चण्डी चचिका शान्तविग्रहा हिरण्यवर्णा रजनी जगद्यन्त्रप्रवर्तिका। मन्दराद्रिनिवासा च शारदा स्वर्णमालिनी
verses.wordMeaning: On being addressed thus by him, Vasudeva spoke to Brahma, "This enunciation may lead to your destruction.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being addressed thus by him, Vasudeva spoke to Brahma, "This enunciation may lead to your destruction.

verses.sanskrit: आनन्दमक्षरं ब्रह्म केवलं निष्कलं परम् । योगिनस्तत् प्रपश्यन्ति महादेव्याः परं पदम्
verses.transliteration: ānandamakṣaraṃ brahma kevalaṃ niṣkalaṃ param / yoginastat prapaśyanti mahādevyāḥ paraṃ padam
verses.translation: Don't you see by means of Yogic power, the un¬ changing Lord and master of Brahma, the Lord of Purusa and Prakrti and whom I know as the Supreme Lord ( Parameivara).
verses.hindi: 'कालरात्रिर्महावेगा वीरभद्रप्रिया हिता। भद्रकाली जगन्माता भक्तानां भद्रदायिनी कराला पिङ्गलाकारा नामभेदामहामदा। यशस्विनी यशोदा च षडध्वपरिवर्तिका
verses.wordMeaning: Don't you see by means of Yogic power, the un¬ changing Lord and master of Brahma, the Lord of Purusa and Prakrti and whom I know as the Supreme Lord ( Parameivara).
verses.commentary: Sense: Don't you see by means of Yogic power, the un¬ changing Lord and master of Brahma, the Lord of Purusa and Prakrti and whom I know as the Supreme Lord ( Parameivara).

verses.sanskrit: परात्परतरं तत्त्वं शाश्वतं शिवमच्युतम् । अनन्तप्रकृतौ लीनं देव्यास्तत् परमं पदम्
verses.transliteration: parātparataraṃ tattvaṃ śāśvataṃ śivamacyutam / anantaprakṛtau līnaṃ devyāstat paramaṃ padam
verses.translation: Seek refuge with that Brahman, devoid of beginning and end, the great ruler of the Universe whom neither pro¬ minent Yogins nor Sahkhyas (philosophers or the followers of the school of Kapila) perceive."
verses.hindi: शङ्खिनी पद्मिनी सांख्या सांख्ययोगप्रवतिका। विश्वामरेश्वरेशाना भुक्तिर्मुक्ति; शिवामृता
verses.wordMeaning: Seek refuge with that Brahman, devoid of beginning and end, the great ruler of the Universe whom neither pro¬ minent Yogins nor Sahkhyas (philosophers or the followers of the school of Kapila) perceive."
verses.commentary: Sense: Seek refuge with that Brahman, devoid of beginning and end, the great ruler of the Universe whom neither pro¬ minent Yogins nor Sahkhyas (philosophers or the followers of the school of Kapila) perceive."

verses.sanskrit: शुभं निरञ्जनं शुद्धं निर्गुणं द्वैतवर्जितम् । आत्मोपलब्धिविषयं देव्यास्तत् परमं पदम्
verses.transliteration: śubhaṃ nirañjanaṃ śuddhaṃ nirguṇaṃ dvaitavarjitam / ātmopalabdhiviṣayaṃ devyāstat paramaṃ padam
verses.translation: Cast off your long slumber and observe your own
verses.hindi: वेदशक्ति, वेदमाता, वेदविद्याप्रकाशिनी, योगेश्वरेश्वरी, नन्दिवल्लभा, भारती, परमानन्दा, परापरविभेदिका, सर्वप्रहरणोपेता, काम्या, कामेश्वरेशवरी
verses.wordMeaning: Cast off your long slumber and observe your own
verses.commentary: Sense: Cast off your long slumber and observe your own

verses.sanskrit: सैषा धात्री विधात्री च परमानन्दमिच्छताम् । संसारतापानखिलान् निहन्तीश्वरसंश्रया
verses.transliteration: saiṣā dhātrī vidhātrī ca paramānandamicchatām / saṃsāratāpānakhilān nihantīśvarasaṃśrayā
verses.translation: After saying this much Lord Visnu remained silent. After knov/ing that great principle, his own Atman, (v.l. Mahe- svara), the Lord of Devas i.e. Visnu did not think of saying anything.
verses.hindi: त्रिविक्रमपदोद्भूता, धनुष्पाणि, शिवोदया, सुदुर्लभा, धनाध्यक्षा (गौओंकी माता), रणप्रिया, सत्क्रिया, गिरिजा, शुद्धा, नित्यपुष्टा, निरन्तरा, दुर्गा, कात्यायनी, चण्डी, चचिका, शान्तविग्रहा, हिरण्यवर्णा, रजनी, जगद्यन्त्रप्रवर्तिका, मन्दराद्रि-
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this much Lord Visnu remained silent. After knov/ing that great principle, his own Atman, (v.l. Mahe- svara), the Lord of Devas i.e. Visnu did not think of saying anything.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this much Lord Visnu remained silent. After knov/ing that great principle, his own Atman, (v.l. Mahe- svara), the Lord of Devas i.e. Visnu did not think of saying anything.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद् विमुक्तिमन्विच्छन् पार्वतीं परमेश्वरीम् । आश्रयेत् सर्वभावानामात्मभूतां शिवात्मिकाम्
verses.transliteration: tasmād vimuktimanvicchan pārvatīṃ parameśvarīm / āśrayet sarvabhāvānāmātmabhūtāṃ śivātmikām
verses.translation: God Kara of immeasurable soul, the Supreme Ruler of all beings manifested himself from somewhere to confer grace on god Brahma.
verses.hindi: वरेश्वरी, वन्द्या, दुर्जया, दुरतिक्रमा, कालरात्रि, महावेगा, वीरभद्रप्रिया, हिता, भद्रकाली, जगन्माता, भक्तानां भद्र- दायिनी (भक्तोंका कल्याण करनेवाली), कराला, पिङ्गलाकारा, नामभेदा, अमहामदा, यशस्विनी, यशोदा, षडध्वपरिवर्तिका, शङ्खिनी, पद्मिनी, सांख्या, सांख्ययोगप्रवर्तिका, चैत्रा, संवत्सरारूढा, जगत्सम्पूरणीन्द्रजा,
verses.wordMeaning: God Kara of immeasurable soul, the Supreme Ruler of all beings manifested himself from somewhere to confer grace on god Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: God Kara of immeasurable soul, the Supreme Ruler of all beings manifested himself from somewhere to confer grace on god Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: लब्ध्वा च पुत्रीं शर्वाणीं तपस्तप्त्वा सुदुश्चरम् । सभार्यः शरं यातः पार्वतीं परमेश्वरीम्
verses.transliteration: labdhvā ca putrīṃ śarvāṇīṃ tapastaptvā suduścaram / sabhāryaḥ śaraṃ yātaḥ pārvatīṃ parameśvarīm
verses.translation: The Lord had an eye in his forehead. He was em¬ bellished with clusters of matted hair. He wielded the trident in his hand. He was the reservoir of great splendour.
verses.hindi: विश्वामरेश्वरेशाना, भुक्ति, मुक्ति, शिवा, अमृता अनन्तशयनानन्या नरनारायणोद्भधवा
verses.wordMeaning: The Lord had an eye in his forehead. He was em¬ bellished with clusters of matted hair. He wielded the trident in his hand. He was the reservoir of great splendour.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Lord had an eye in his forehead. He was em¬ bellished with clusters of matted hair. He wielded the trident in his hand. He was the reservoir of great splendour.

verses.sanskrit: तां दृष्ट्वा जायमानां च स्वेच्छयैव वराननाम् । मेना हिमवतः पत्नी प्राहेदं पर्वतेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: tāṃ dṛṣṭvā jāyamānāṃ ca svecchayaiva varānanām / menā himavataḥ patnī prāhedaṃ parvateśvaram
verses.translation: He was wearing a garland of wonderful shape sus¬ pended upto the foot. It was wreathed with planets including the sun, the moon and the stars with utmost skilful scholarship.''
verses.hindi: नृसिंही हैत्यमथनी शङ्खचक्रगदाधरा। संकर्षणसमुत्पत्तिरम्बिकापादसंश्रया महाज्चाला महामूर्तिः सुमूर्तिः सर्वकामधुक् । सुप्रभा सुस्तना गौरी धर्मकामार्थमोक्षदा
verses.wordMeaning: He was wearing a garland of wonderful shape sus¬ pended upto the foot. It was wreathed with planets including the sun, the moon and the stars with utmost skilful scholarship.''
verses.commentary: Sense: He was wearing a garland of wonderful shape sus¬ pended upto the foot. It was wreathed with planets including the sun, the moon and the stars with utmost skilful scholarship.''

verses.sanskrit: मेनोवाच पश्य बालामिमां राजन् राजीवसदृशाननाम् । हिताय सर्वभूतानां जाता च तपसावयोः
verses.transliteration: menovāca paśya bālāmimāṃ rājan rājīvasadṛśānanām / hitāya sarvabhūtānāṃ jātā ca tapasāvayoḥ
verses.translation: On seeing Lord Siva, god Brahma, the grand-sire of the worlds was completely deluded by his Maya. He addressed Visnu, the yellow-robed deity.
verses.hindi: भ्रूमध्यनिलया पूर्वा पुराणपुरुषारणिः। महाविभूतिदा मध्या सरोजनयना समा सर्वशक्त्यासनारूढा धर्माधर्मार्थवर्जिता
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing Lord Siva, god Brahma, the grand-sire of the worlds was completely deluded by his Maya. He addressed Visnu, the yellow-robed deity.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing Lord Siva, god Brahma, the grand-sire of the worlds was completely deluded by his Maya. He addressed Visnu, the yellow-robed deity.

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽपि दृष्ट्वा ततः पुत्रीं तरुणादित्यसन्निभाम् । कपर्दिनीं चतुर्वक्त्रां त्रिनेत्रामतिलालसाम्
verses.transliteration: so 'pi dṛṣṭvā tataḥ putrīṃ taruṇādityasannibhām / kapardinīṃ caturvaktrāṃ trinetrāmatilālasām
verses.translation: "O Janardana, who is this three-eyed person of blue complexion, with the trident in his hand coming this side? He is a mass of splendour and of an immeasurable spirit (Soul)."
verses.hindi: वैराग्यज्ञाननिरता निरालोका निरिन्द्रिया । विचित्रगहनाधारा शाश्वतस्थानवासिनी अशेषदेवतामूर्तिर्देवता वरदेवता। गणाम्बिका गिरेः पुत्री निशुम्भविनिपातिनी
verses.wordMeaning: "O Janardana, who is this three-eyed person of blue complexion, with the trident in his hand coming this side? He is a mass of splendour and of an immeasurable spirit (Soul)."
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Janardana, who is this three-eyed person of blue complexion, with the trident in his hand coming this side? He is a mass of splendour and of an immeasurable spirit (Soul)."

verses.sanskrit: अष्टहस्तां विशालाक्षीं चन्द्रावयवभूषणाम् । निर्गुणां सगुणां साक्षात् सदसद्व्यक्तिवर्जिताम्
verses.transliteration: aṣṭahastāṃ viśālākṣīṃ candrāvayavabhūṣaṇām / nirguṇāṃ saguṇāṃ sākṣāt sadasadvyaktivarjitām
verses.translation: After hearing his words, Visnu, the suppressor of Danavas, saw Lord Isvara (Siva) shining brilliantly in the trans¬ lucent water.
verses.hindi: अनन्तवर्णानन्यस्था शंकरी शान्तमानसा शान्त्यतीता मलातीता निर्विकारा निराश्रया
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing his words, Visnu, the suppressor of Danavas, saw Lord Isvara (Siva) shining brilliantly in the trans¬ lucent water.
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing his words, Visnu, the suppressor of Danavas, saw Lord Isvara (Siva) shining brilliantly in the trans¬ lucent water.

verses.sanskrit: प्रणम्य शिरसा भूमौ तेजसा चातिविह्वलः । भीतः कृताञ्जलिस्तस्याः प्रोवाच परमेश्वरीम्
verses.transliteration: praṇamya śirasā bhūmau tejasā cātivihvalaḥ / bhītaḥ kṛtāñjalistasyāḥ provāca parameśvarīm
verses.translation: Realising that he was the Supreme Reality, the Con- ceiver of Brahma, Visnu stood up and said to god Brahma, the grand-sire of the world and the Lord of Devas.
verses.hindi: शिवाख्या चित्तनिलया शिवज्ञानस्वरूपिणी। हैत्यदानवनिर्मात्री काश्यपी कालकल्पिका शास्त्रयोनिः क्रियामूर्तिश्चतुर्वर्गप्रद्शिका। नारायणी नरोदभूतिः कौमुदी लिङ्गधारिणी
verses.wordMeaning: Realising that he was the Supreme Reality, the Con- ceiver of Brahma, Visnu stood up and said to god Brahma, the grand-sire of the world and the Lord of Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Realising that he was the Supreme Reality, the Con- ceiver of Brahma, Visnu stood up and said to god Brahma, the grand-sire of the world and the Lord of Devas.

verses.sanskrit: हीमवानुवाच का त्वं देवि विशालाक्षि शशाङ्कावयवाङ्किते । न जाने त्वामहं वत्से यथावद् ब्रूहि पृच्छते
verses.transliteration: hīmavānuvāca kā tvaṃ devi viśālākṣi śaśāṅkāvayavāṅkite / na jāne tvāmahaṃ vatse yathāvad brūhi pṛcchate
verses.translation: "This is Lord Mahadeva, the eternal self-luminous deity, having neither the beginning nor the end, the inconceiv¬ able great Ruler of all the worlds.
verses.hindi: कामुको ललिता भावा परापरविभूतिदा। परान्तजातमहिमा बडवा वामलोचना सुभद्रा देवकी सीता वेदवेदाङ्गपारगा। मनस्विनी मन्युमाता महामन्युसमुद्भवा
verses.wordMeaning: "This is Lord Mahadeva, the eternal self-luminous deity, having neither the beginning nor the end, the inconceiv¬ able great Ruler of all the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: "This is Lord Mahadeva, the eternal self-luminous deity, having neither the beginning nor the end, the inconceiv¬ able great Ruler of all the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: गिरीन्द्रवचनं श्रुत्वा ततः सा परमेश्वरी । व्याजहार महाशैलं योगिनामभयप्रदा
verses.transliteration: girīndravacanaṃ śrutvā tataḥ sā parameśvarī / vyājahāra mahāśailaṃ yogināmabhayapradā
verses.translation: He is Sankara (the benefactor), Sambhu (Bestower of welfare) Isana (the Ruler), Paramesvara, (the highest Con¬ troller), the soul of all, the Lord of human beings, the great meditator and the Supreme Isa, the pure and Siva, the auspicious.
verses.hindi: नृसिंही, हैत्यमथनी, शङ्खचक्रगदाधरा, संकर्षणसमुत्पत्ति, अम्बिकापदसंश्रया, अनन्या, नरनारायणोद्धवा, महाज्वाला, महामूर्ति, सुमूर्ति, सर्वकामधुक्, सुप्रभा, सुस्तना, गौरी, धर्मकामार्थमोक्षदा, भ्रूमध्यनिलया, पूर्वा, पुराणपुरुषारणि, महाविभूतिदा, मध्या, सरोजनयना, समा,
verses.wordMeaning: He is Sankara (the benefactor), Sambhu (Bestower of welfare) Isana (the Ruler), Paramesvara, (the highest Con¬ troller), the soul of all, the Lord of human beings, the great meditator and the Supreme Isa, the pure and Siva, the auspicious.
verses.commentary: Sense: He is Sankara (the benefactor), Sambhu (Bestower of welfare) Isana (the Ruler), Paramesvara, (the highest Con¬ troller), the soul of all, the Lord of human beings, the great meditator and the Supreme Isa, the pure and Siva, the auspicious.

verses.sanskrit: देव्युवाच मां विद्ध परमां शक्तिं परमेश्वरसमाश्रयाम् । अनन्यामव्ययामेकां यां पश्यन्ति मुमुक्षवः
verses.transliteration: devyuvāca māṃ viddha paramāṃ śaktiṃ parameśvarasamāśrayām / ananyāmavyayāmekāṃ yāṃ paśyanti mumukṣavaḥ
verses.translation: He is the creator and dispenser of destiny. He is the chief immutable Lord. {v.l. the Lord of Prakrti and Purusa). Only those ascetics who meditate upon him as Brahman, can perceive him.
verses.hindi: सर्वशक्त्यासनारूढा, धर्माधर्मार्थवर्जिता, वैराग्यज्ञाननिरता, निरालोका, निरिन्द्रिया, विचित्रगहनाधारा, शाश्वतस्थानवासिनी, स्थानेश्वरी, निरानन्दा, त्रिशूलवरधारिणी, अशेषदेवतामूर्ति, अनन्यस्था, शंकरी, शान्तमानसा, अगोत्रा, गोमती, गोप्त्री,
verses.wordMeaning: He is the creator and dispenser of destiny. He is the chief immutable Lord. {v.l. the Lord of Prakrti and Purusa). Only those ascetics who meditate upon him as Brahman, can perceive him.
verses.commentary: Sense: He is the creator and dispenser of destiny. He is the chief immutable Lord. {v.l. the Lord of Prakrti and Purusa). Only those ascetics who meditate upon him as Brahman, can perceive him.

verses.sanskrit: अहं वै सर्वभावानात्मा सर्वान्तरा शिवा । शाश्वतैश्वर्यविज्ञानमूर्तिः सर्वप्रवर्तिका
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ vai sarvabhāvānātmā sarvāntarā śivā / śāśvataiśvaryavijñānamūrtiḥ sarvapravartikā
verses.translation: O great-grand-sire of the universe, understand me to be only another form of his—the form that is eternal, the source of origin of the universe and is designated as Vasudeva.
verses.hindi: शान्त्यतीता, मलातीता, निर्विकारा, निराश्रया, शिवाख्या, चित्तनिलया, शिवज्ञानस्वरूपिणी, हैत्यदानवनिर्मात्री, काश्यपी, कालकल्पिका॥ १७४--१८०॥ शास्त्रयोनि, क्रियामूर्ति, चतुर्वर्गप्रदर्शिका, नारायणी, नरोद्भूति, कौमुदी, लिंगधारिणी, कामुकी, ललिता,
verses.wordMeaning: O great-grand-sire of the universe, understand me to be only another form of his—the form that is eternal, the source of origin of the universe and is designated as Vasudeva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great-grand-sire of the universe, understand me to be only another form of his—the form that is eternal, the source of origin of the universe and is designated as Vasudeva.

verses.sanskrit: अनन्तानन्तमहिमा संसारार्णवतारिणी । दिव्यं ददामि ते चक्षुः पश्य मे रूपमैश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: anantānantamahimā saṃsārārṇavatāriṇī / divyaṃ dadāmi te cakṣuḥ paśya me rūpamaiśvaram
verses.translation: Gan you not see that Lord of Yoga the immutable Lord, Brahman? May your eyes be divine, whereby you will be able to see that great Being."
verses.hindi: वामलोचना, सुभद्रा, देवकी, सीता, वेदवेदाङ्गपारगा, हिरण्या राजती हैमी हेमाभरणभूषिता। विभ्राजमाना दुर्ज्ञेया ज्योतिष्टोमफलप्रदा
verses.wordMeaning: Gan you not see that Lord of Yoga the immutable Lord, Brahman? May your eyes be divine, whereby you will be able to see that great Being."
verses.commentary: Sense: Gan you not see that Lord of Yoga the immutable Lord, Brahman? May your eyes be divine, whereby you will be able to see that great Being."

verses.sanskrit: एतावदुक्त्वा विज्ञानं दत्त्वा हिमवते स्वयम् । स्वं रूपं दर्शयामास दिव्यं तत् पारमेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: etāvaduktvā vijñānaṃ dattvā himavate svayam / svaṃ rūpaṃ darśayāmāsa divyaṃ tat pārameśvaram
verses.translation: After securing thus the divine vision from Visnu, Brahma, the grand-father of the world, realised that the highest knowledge incarnate is present in front of him.
verses.hindi: महानिद्रासमुदभूतिरनिद्रा सत्यदेवता। दीर्घा ककुद्धिनी हद्या शान्तिदा शान्तिवर्धिनी लक्ष्म्यादिशक्तिजननी शक्तिचक्रप्रवर्तिका । त्रिशक्तिजननी जन्या षडूर्मिपरिवर्जिता
verses.wordMeaning: After securing thus the divine vision from Visnu, Brahma, the grand-father of the world, realised that the highest knowledge incarnate is present in front of him.
verses.commentary: Sense: After securing thus the divine vision from Visnu, Brahma, the grand-father of the world, realised that the highest knowledge incarnate is present in front of him.

verses.sanskrit: कोटिसूर्यप्रितीकाशं तेजोबिम्बं निराकुलम् । ज्वालामालासहस्त्राढ्यं कालानलशतोपमम्
verses.transliteration: koṭisūryapritīkāśaṃ tejobimbaṃ nirākulam / jvālāmālāsahastrāḍhyaṃ kālānalaśatopamam
verses.translation: Deriving the Supreme knowledge about Siva, the great-grand-father sought refuge in Lord Siva himself (his father).
verses.hindi: सुधामा कर्मकरणी युगान्तदहनात्मिका । संकर्षणी जगदधात्री कामयोनि: किरीटिनी ऐन्द्री त्रैलोक्यनमिता वैष्णवी परमेश्वरी । प्रद्युप्रदयिता दान्ता युग्मदृष्टिस्त्रिलोचना
verses.wordMeaning: Deriving the Supreme knowledge about Siva, the great-grand-father sought refuge in Lord Siva himself (his father).
verses.commentary: Sense: Deriving the Supreme knowledge about Siva, the great-grand-father sought refuge in Lord Siva himself (his father).

verses.sanskrit: दंष्ट्राकरालं दुर्धर्ष जटामण्डलमण्डितम् । त्रिशूलवरहस्तं च घोररूपं भयानकम्
verses.transliteration: daṃṣṭrākarālaṃ durdharṣa jaṭāmaṇḍalamaṇḍitam / triśūlavarahastaṃ ca ghorarūpaṃ bhayānakam
verses.translation: Recollecting Onkdra and concentrating his mind in his own soul, he, with folded palms in reverence, eulogised the Lord by means of the Aiharvasiras Mantras}
verses.hindi: चाणूरहन्तृतनया नीतिज्ञा कामरूपिणी वेदविद्याब्रतस्नाता धर्मशीलानिलाशना। वीरभद्रप्रिया वीरा महाकालसमुद्भवा
verses.wordMeaning: Recollecting Onkdra and concentrating his mind in his own soul, he, with folded palms in reverence, eulogised the Lord by means of the Aiharvasiras Mantras}
verses.commentary: Sense: Recollecting Onkdra and concentrating his mind in his own soul, he, with folded palms in reverence, eulogised the Lord by means of the Aiharvasiras Mantras}

verses.sanskrit: प्रशान्तं सौम्यवदनमनन्ताश्चर्यसंयुतम् । चन्द्रावयवलक्ष्माणं चन्द्रकोटिसमप्रभम्
verses.transliteration: praśāntaṃ saumyavadanamanantāścaryasaṃyutam / candrāvayavalakṣmāṇaṃ candrakoṭisamaprabham
verses.translation: On being eulogised by Brahma, Lord Siva, the Sup¬ reme Ruler felt great affection and pleasure. Smilingly he ad¬ dressed to him.
verses.hindi: मातृका मन्मथोद्भूता वारिजा वाहनप्रिया। करीषिणी सुधावाणी वीणावादनतत्परा सेविता सेविका सेव्या सिनीवाली गरुत्मती। अरुन्धती हिरण्याक्षी मृगाङ्का मानदायिनी
verses.wordMeaning: On being eulogised by Brahma, Lord Siva, the Sup¬ reme Ruler felt great affection and pleasure. Smilingly he ad¬ dressed to him.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being eulogised by Brahma, Lord Siva, the Sup¬ reme Ruler felt great affection and pleasure. Smilingly he ad¬ dressed to him.

verses.sanskrit: किरीटिनं गदाहस्तं नूपुरैरुपशोभितम् । दिव्यमाल्याम्बरधरं दिव्यगन्धानुलेपनम्
verses.transliteration: kirīṭinaṃ gadāhastaṃ nūpurairupaśobhitam / divyamālyāmbaradharaṃ divyagandhānulepanam
verses.translation: O dear child, there is no doubt that you are equal to me, as you are my devotee as well. It was by me alone that you, the Eternal One, were created formerly, for bringing- worlds into being. You are the unchanging one.
verses.hindi: श्रीफला श्रीमती श्रीशा श्रीनिवासा शिवप्रिया । श्रीधरा श्रीकरी कल्या श्रीधरार्धशरीरिणी निहन्त्री हैत्यसङ्घानां सिंहिका सिंहवाहना
verses.wordMeaning: O dear child, there is no doubt that you are equal to me, as you are my devotee as well. It was by me alone that you, the Eternal One, were created formerly, for bringing- worlds into being. You are the unchanging one.
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear child, there is no doubt that you are equal to me, as you are my devotee as well. It was by me alone that you, the Eternal One, were created formerly, for bringing- worlds into being. You are the unchanging one.

verses.sanskrit: शङ्खचक्रधरं काम्यं त्रिनेत्रं कृत्तिवाससम् । अण्डस्थं चाण्डबाह्यस्थं बाह्यमाभ्यन्तरं परम्
verses.transliteration: śaṅkhacakradharaṃ kāmyaṃ trinetraṃ kṛttivāsasam / aṇḍasthaṃ cāṇḍabāhyasthaṃ bāhyamābhyantaraṃ param
verses.translation: You are the Atman, the Primordial Purusa born of my body. O soul of the universe, seek your boon. I am the bes- tower of boons unto you, O sinless one.
verses.hindi: सुषेणा चन्द्रनिलया सुकीर्तिश्छिन्नसंशया। रसज्ञा रसदा रामा लेलिहानामृतस्त्रवा नित्योदिता स्वयंज्योतिरुत्सुका मृतजीवनी। वञ्चदण्डा वज्रजिह्वा वैदेही वज्रविग्रहा
verses.wordMeaning: You are the Atman, the Primordial Purusa born of my body. O soul of the universe, seek your boon. I am the bes- tower of boons unto you, O sinless one.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are the Atman, the Primordial Purusa born of my body. O soul of the universe, seek your boon. I am the bes- tower of boons unto you, O sinless one.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वशक्तिमयं शुभ्रं सर्वाकारं सनातनम् । ब्रह्मोन्द्रोपेन्द्रयोगीन्द्रैर्वन्द्यमानपदाम्बुजम्
verses.transliteration: sarvaśaktimayaṃ śubhraṃ sarvākāraṃ sanātanam / brahmondropendrayogīndrairvandyamānapadāmbujam
verses.translation: After hearing the words of the Lord of Devas, the lotus-born deity glanced at the Purusa, Visnu, bowed to San¬ kara and said:
verses.hindi: 'कर्षिकारकरा कक्ष्या कंसप्राणापहारिणी प्रत्यक्षदेवता दिव्या दिव्यगन्धा दिवापरा
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing the words of the Lord of Devas, the lotus-born deity glanced at the Purusa, Visnu, bowed to San¬ kara and said:
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing the words of the Lord of Devas, the lotus-born deity glanced at the Purusa, Visnu, bowed to San¬ kara and said:

verses.sanskrit: सर्वतः पाणिपादान्तं सर्वतो ऽक्षिशिरोमुखम् । सर्वमावृत्य तिष्ठन्तं ददर्श परमेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: sarvataḥ pāṇipādāntaṃ sarvato 'kṣiśiromukham / sarvamāvṛtya tiṣṭhantaṃ dadarśa parameśvaram
verses.translation: O holy Lord, Lord of the past and future, O Mahadeva. O consort of Ambika, I wish, that you or some one equal to you, be born as my son.
verses.hindi: हिरण्या, राजती, हैमी, हेमाभरणभूषिता, विभ्राजमाना, सत्यदेवता, दीर्घा, ककुद्मिनी, हृद्या, शान्तिदा, शान्तिवर्धिनी,
verses.wordMeaning: O holy Lord, Lord of the past and future, O Mahadeva. O consort of Ambika, I wish, that you or some one equal to you, be born as my son.
verses.commentary: Sense: O holy Lord, Lord of the past and future, O Mahadeva. O consort of Ambika, I wish, that you or some one equal to you, be born as my son.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा तदीदृशं रूपं देव्या माहेश्वरं परम् । भयेन च समाविष्टः स राजा हृष्टमानसः
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā tadīdṛśaṃ rūpaṃ devyā māheśvaraṃ param / bhayena ca samāviṣṭaḥ sa rājā hṛṣṭamānasaḥ
verses.translation: O Mahadeva, I have been deluded by you, through your subtle Maya. O Siva, I do not know your real nature precisely.
verses.hindi: जननी, जन्या, षडूर्मिपरिवर्जिता, सुधामा, कर्मकरणी, युगान्तदहनात्मिका, संकर्षणी, जगद्धात्री, कामयोनि, किरीटिनी, ऐन्द्री, त्रैलोक्यनमिता, वैष्णवी, परमेश्वरी, प्रद्युम्नदयिता, कैलासगिरिवासिनी, चाणूरहन्तृतनया, नीतिज्ञा, कामरूपिणी,
verses.wordMeaning: O Mahadeva, I have been deluded by you, through your subtle Maya. O Siva, I do not know your real nature precisely.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Mahadeva, I have been deluded by you, through your subtle Maya. O Siva, I do not know your real nature precisely.

verses.sanskrit: आत्मन्याधाय चात्मानमोङ्कारं समनुस्मरन् । नाम्नामष्टसहस्त्रेण तुष्टाव परमेश्वरीम्
verses.transliteration: ātmanyādhāya cātmānamoṅkāraṃ samanusmaran / nāmnāmaṣṭasahastreṇa tuṣṭāva parameśvarīm
verses.translation: O Lord, you alone are the mother, father, brother and friend of your devotees. Be pleased. I have sought refuge in you. I bow unto your lotus-like feet.
verses.hindi: लक्ष्म्यादिशक्तिजननी, शक्तिचक्रप्रवर्तिका, वेदविद्यात्रतस्नाता, धर्मशीला, अनिलाशना, वीरभद्र- प्रिया, वीरा, महाकालसमुद्भवा, विद्याधरप्रिया, सिद्धा,
verses.wordMeaning: O Lord, you alone are the mother, father, brother and friend of your devotees. Be pleased. I have sought refuge in you. I bow unto your lotus-like feet.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Lord, you alone are the mother, father, brother and friend of your devotees. Be pleased. I have sought refuge in you. I bow unto your lotus-like feet.

verses.sanskrit: हीमवानुवाच शिवोमा परमा शक्तिरनन्ता निष्कलामला । शान्ता माहेश्वरी नित्या शाश्वती परमाक्षरा
verses.transliteration: hīmavānuvāca śivomā paramā śaktiranantā niṣkalāmalā / śāntā māheśvarī nityā śāśvatī paramākṣarā
verses.translation: On hearing his words, the bull-bannered Lord of the universe spoke to his son, after glancing at Janardana:
verses.hindi: खिला, मातृका, मन्मथोद्भूता, वारिजा, वाहनप्रिया, करीषिणी, सुधावाणी, वीणावादनतत्परा, सेविता, सेविका, सेव्या, सिनीवाली, गरुत्मती, अरुन्धती, हिरण्याक्षी, मृगाङ्का, श्रीफला, श्रीमती, श्रीशा, श्रीनिवासा, शिवप्रिया, श्रीधरा, श्रीकरी, कल्या, श्रीधरार्धशरीरिणी, अनन्तदृष्टि, अक्षुद्रा, धात्रीशा, धनदप्रिया, हैत्यसंघानां निहन्त्री (हैत्यसंघनिहन्त्री), सिंहिका, सिंहवाहना, सुषेणा, चन्द्रनिलया,
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing his words, the bull-bannered Lord of the universe spoke to his son, after glancing at Janardana:
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing his words, the bull-bannered Lord of the universe spoke to his son, after glancing at Janardana:

verses.sanskrit: अचिन्त्या केवलानन्त्या शिवात्मा परमात्मिका । अनादिरव्यया शुद्धा देवात्मा सर्वगाचला
verses.transliteration: acintyā kevalānantyā śivātmā paramātmikā / anādiravyayā śuddhā devātmā sarvagācalā
verses.translation: "O son, I will do whatever has been requested for- by your Lordship. Sinless, divine, perfect knowledge pertain¬ ing to Isvara shall dawn unto you.
verses.hindi: सुकीर्ति, छिन्नसंशया, रसज्ञ, रसदा, रामा, लेलिहाना, अमृतस्रवा, नित्योदिता, स्वयंज्योति, उत्सुका, मृतजीवनी, सौदामिनी, जनानन्दा, भ्रुकुटीकुटिलानना, कर्णिकारकए,
verses.wordMeaning: "O son, I will do whatever has been requested for- by your Lordship. Sinless, divine, perfect knowledge pertain¬ ing to Isvara shall dawn unto you.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O son, I will do whatever has been requested for- by your Lordship. Sinless, divine, perfect knowledge pertain¬ ing to Isvara shall dawn unto you.

verses.sanskrit: एकानेकविभागस्था मायातीता सुनिर्मला । महामाहेश्वरी सत्या महादेवी निरञ्जना
verses.transliteration: ekānekavibhāgasthā māyātītā sunirmalā / mahāmāheśvarī satyā mahādevī nirañjanā
verses.translation: O Lord of Devas, grand-sire of the worlds, you alone have been appointed as the primordial maker of all living beings. Create your Maya for them.
verses.hindi: त्रिसंध्या, हर्षवर्धिनी, प्रत्यक्षदेवता, दिव्या, दिव्यगन्धा, दिवापरा धर्मशास्त्रार्थकुशला धर्मज्ञा धर्मवाहना
verses.wordMeaning: O Lord of Devas, grand-sire of the worlds, you alone have been appointed as the primordial maker of all living beings. Create your Maya for them.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Lord of Devas, grand-sire of the worlds, you alone have been appointed as the primordial maker of all living beings. Create your Maya for them.

verses.sanskrit: काष्ठा सर्वान्तरस्था च चिच्छक्तिरतिलालसा । नन्दा सर्वात्मिका विद्या ज्योतीरूपामृताक्षरा
verses.transliteration: kāṣṭhā sarvāntarasthā ca cicchaktiratilālasā / nandā sarvātmikā vidyā jyotīrūpāmṛtākṣarā
verses.translation: This Narayana is born of me. He is the Supreme form of mine alone. O Isana (Brahma), Hari will be the- bestower of security and prosperity unto you.
verses.hindi: धर्माधर्मविनिर्मात्री धार्मिकाणां शिवप्रदा । धर्मशक्तिर्धर्ममयी विधर्मा विश्वधर्मिणी धर्मान्तरा धर्ममेघा धर्मपूर्वा धनावहा। धर्मोपदेष्टी धर्मात्मा धर्मगम्या धराधरा २०८॥ कापाली शाकला मूर्तिः कला कलितविग्रहा । सर्वशक्तिविनिर्मुक्ता सर्वशक्त्याश्रयाश्रया
verses.wordMeaning: This Narayana is born of me. He is the Supreme form of mine alone. O Isana (Brahma), Hari will be the- bestower of security and prosperity unto you.
verses.commentary: Sense: This Narayana is born of me. He is the Supreme form of mine alone. O Isana (Brahma), Hari will be the- bestower of security and prosperity unto you.

verses.sanskrit: शान्तिः प्रतिष्ठा सर्वेषां निवृत्तिरमृतप्रदा । व्योममूर्तिर्व्योमलया व्योमाधाराच्युतामरा
verses.transliteration: śāntiḥ pratiṣṭhā sarveṣāṃ nivṛttiramṛtapradā / vyomamūrtirvyomalayā vyomādhārācyutāmarā
verses.translation: After saying this. Lord Siva, the Supreme god who was pleased with Brahma, gently touched him with both the hands and spoke these words to Hari:
verses.hindi: प्रधानपुरुषेशेशा महादेवैकसाक्षिणी। सदाशिवा वियन्मूर्तिर्विश्वमूर्तिरमूर्तिका यदेतहैश्वरं रूपं घोरं ते परमेश्वरि। भीतोऽस्मि साम्प्रतं दृष्टा रूपमन्यत् प्रदर्शय
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this. Lord Siva, the Supreme god who was pleased with Brahma, gently touched him with both the hands and spoke these words to Hari:
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this. Lord Siva, the Supreme god who was pleased with Brahma, gently touched him with both the hands and spoke these words to Hari:

verses.sanskrit: अनादिनिधनामोघा कारणात्मा कलाकला । क्रतुः प्रथमजा नाभिरमृतस्यात्मसंश्रया
verses.transliteration: anādinidhanāmoghā kāraṇātmā kalākalā / kratuḥ prathamajā nābhiramṛtasyātmasaṃśrayā
verses.translation: O pervader of the world, I am thoroughly pleased with you as you are my devotee. Choose your boon though really
verses.hindi: एवमुक्ताथ सा देवी तेन शैलेन पार्वती। संहृत्य दर्शयामास स्वरूपमपरं पुनः रक्तपादाम्बुजतलं सुरक्तकरपल्लवम्। श्रीमद् विशालसंवृत्तललाटतिलकोज्चलम्
verses.wordMeaning: O pervader of the world, I am thoroughly pleased with you as you are my devotee. Choose your boon though really
verses.commentary: Sense: O pervader of the world, I am thoroughly pleased with you as you are my devotee. Choose your boon though really

verses.sanskrit: प्राणेश्वरप्रिया माता महामहिषघातिनी । प्राणेश्वरी प्राणरूपा प्रधानपुरुषेश्वरी
verses.transliteration: prāṇeśvarapriyā mātā mahāmahiṣaghātinī / prāṇeśvarī prāṇarūpā pradhānapuruṣeśvarī
verses.translation: On hearing the word of Lord Siva, Visnu the permeater of the universe spoke with delighted voice, looking him in his face.
verses.hindi: भूषितं चारुसर्वाङ्गं भूषणैरतिकोमलम्। दधानमुरसा मालां विशालां हेमनिर्मिताम् निवृत्ति, ज्ञानपारगा, धर्मशास्त्रार्थकुशला, धर्मज्ञा, धर्मवाहना ॥ २०४--२०६॥
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the word of Lord Siva, Visnu the permeater of the universe spoke with delighted voice, looking him in his face.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the word of Lord Siva, Visnu the permeater of the universe spoke with delighted voice, looking him in his face.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वशक्तिकलाकारा ज्योत्स्ना द्योर्महिमास्पदा । सर्वकार्यनियन्त्री च सर्वभूतेश्वरेश्वरी
verses.transliteration: sarvaśaktikalākārā jyotsnā dyormahimāspadā / sarvakāryaniyantrī ca sarvabhūteśvareśvarī
verses.translation: "This alone is the most praiseworthy boon that I shall be able to see you, the Supreme Ruler and the great Atman. May I be blessed with constant devotion unto you."
verses.hindi: धर्माधर्मविनिर्मात्री, धार्मिकाणां शिवप्रदा ( धार्मिकोंका कल्याण करनेवाली), धर्मशक्ति, धर्ममयी, विधर्मा, विश्वधर्मिणी, धर्मान्तरा, धर्ममेघा, धर्मपूर्वा, धनावहा, धर्मोपदेष्ट्री, धर्मात्मा, धर्मगम्या, धराधरा, कापाली, ज्ञानरूपिणी, प्रधानपुरुषेशेशा, महादेवैकसाक्षिणी, सदाशिवा, वियन्मूर्ति, विश्वमूर्ति तथा अमूर्तिका--(के नामसे प्रसिद्ध) हैं॥ २०७--२१० ॥
verses.wordMeaning: "This alone is the most praiseworthy boon that I shall be able to see you, the Supreme Ruler and the great Atman. May I be blessed with constant devotion unto you."
verses.commentary: Sense: "This alone is the most praiseworthy boon that I shall be able to see you, the Supreme Ruler and the great Atman. May I be blessed with constant devotion unto you."

verses.sanskrit: अनादिरव्यक्तगुहा महानन्दा सनातनी । आकाशयोनिर्योगस्था महायोगेश्वरेश्वरी
verses.transliteration: anādiravyaktaguhā mahānandā sanātanī / ākāśayoniryogasthā mahāyogeśvareśvarī
verses.translation: Saying ''so be it", Mahadeva spoke to Visnu again; "You are the doer of all actions, while I am the presiding deity.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार हजार नामोंसे (देवीकी) स्तुति करके वे भयभीत हिमवान् पर्वत पुनः प्रणाम कर हाथ जोड़ते हुए इस प्रकार बोले-- हे परमेश्वरि! यह जो आपका घोर ऐश्वर (विराट्)- रूप है, उसे देखकर मैं इस समय भयभीत हो गया
verses.wordMeaning: Saying ''so be it", Mahadeva spoke to Visnu again; "You are the doer of all actions, while I am the presiding deity.
verses.commentary: Sense: Saying ''so be it", Mahadeva spoke to Visnu again; "You are the doer of all actions, while I am the presiding deity.

verses.sanskrit: महामाया सुदुष्पूरा मूलप्रकृतिरीश्वरी । संसारयोनिः सकला सर्वशक्तिसमुद्भवा
verses.transliteration: mahāmāyā suduṣpūrā mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī / saṃsārayoniḥ sakalā sarvaśaktisamudbhavā
verses.translation: There is no doubt that everything is identical with you as well as with me. You are the moon, while I am the sun. You are the night and I am the day.
verses.hindi: (हिमवान्) पर्वतके द्वारा ऐसा कहे जानेपर उन देवी पार्वतीने अपने उस विराट् रूपको समेटकर दूसरा (सौम्य) रूप उन्हें दिखलाया (देवीका वह रूप) नीले कमलदलके समान (नीलवर्णवाला), नीलकमलके समान सुगन्धियुक्त, दो नेत्र एवं दो भुजावाला, सौम्य, नीले अलकोंसे विभूषित, रक्तकमलके समान चरणतलवाला, सुन्दर लाल पल्लवके
verses.wordMeaning: There is no doubt that everything is identical with you as well as with me. You are the moon, while I am the sun. You are the night and I am the day.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no doubt that everything is identical with you as well as with me. You are the moon, while I am the sun. You are the night and I am the day.

verses.sanskrit: संसारपारा दुर्वारा दुर्निरोक्ष्या दुरासदा । प्राणशक्तिः प्रणविद्या योगिनी परमा कला
verses.transliteration: saṃsārapārā durvārā durnirokṣyā durāsadā / prāṇaśaktiḥ praṇavidyā yoginī paramā kalā
verses.translation: You are the unmanifest Prakrti while I am the' Purusa. You are the knowledge and I am the knower. You are the Maya, while I am the Is vara.
verses.hindi: समान हाथवाला, श्रीयुक्त (वह रूप) विशाल एवं प्रशस्त ललाटपर लगे तिलकसे प्रफुल्लित (था) । (उसके) सभी अङ्ग अत्यन्त कोमल, सुन्दर तथा भूषणोंसे आभूषित थे। (उन देवीने) स्वर्णनिर्मित विशाल मालाको अपने वक्षःस्थलपर धारण कर रखा था। सुन्दर बिम्बफलके समान (रक्त) ओठ मन्द मधुर मुसकानयुक्त था। (चरणोंमें धारण किये) नूपुरोंसे ध्वनि निकल रही थी। (देवीका वह रूप) प्रसन्न मुखवाला तथा दिव्य एवं
verses.wordMeaning: You are the unmanifest Prakrti while I am the' Purusa. You are the knowledge and I am the knower. You are the Maya, while I am the Is vara.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are the unmanifest Prakrti while I am the' Purusa. You are the knowledge and I am the knower. You are the Maya, while I am the Is vara.

verses.sanskrit: महाविभूतिर्दुर्धर्षा मूलप्रकृतिसंभवा । अनाद्यनन्तविभवा परार्था पुरुषारणिः
verses.transliteration: mahāvibhūtirdurdharṣā mūlaprakṛtisaṃbhavā / anādyanantavibhavā parārthā puruṣāraṇiḥ
verses.translation: You are the power born of knowledge, while I am the master of that power. I who am that unsullied Lord so you are the same such Lord Narayana.
verses.hindi: अनन्त महिमामें प्रतिष्ठित था॥ २१४--२१७ ॥ तदीदृशं समालोक्य स्वरूपं शैलसत्तमः । भीतिं संत्यज्य हृष्टात्मा बभाषे परमेश्वरीम्
verses.wordMeaning: You are the power born of knowledge, while I am the master of that power. I who am that unsullied Lord so you are the same such Lord Narayana.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are the power born of knowledge, while I am the master of that power. I who am that unsullied Lord so you are the same such Lord Narayana.

verses.sanskrit: सर्गस्थित्यन्तकरणी सुदुर्वाच्या दुरत्यया । शब्दयोनिः शब्दमयी नादाख्या नादविग्रहा
verses.transliteration: sargasthityantakaraṇī sudurvācyā duratyayā / śabdayoniḥ śabdamayī nādākhyā nādavigrahā
verses.translation: Yogins, expounders of Brahman, see through unity. O Atman of the universe, without resorting to you the Yogin will not attain me. Do you protect the entire universe including Devas, Asuras and human beings."
verses.hindi: त्वय्येव लीयते देवि त्वमेव च परा गति: बदन्ति केचित् त्वामेव प्रकृतिं प्रकृतेः पराम्। अपरे परमार्थज्ञा: शिवेति शिवसंश्रये
verses.wordMeaning: Yogins, expounders of Brahman, see through unity. O Atman of the universe, without resorting to you the Yogin will not attain me. Do you protect the entire universe including Devas, Asuras and human beings."
verses.commentary: Sense: Yogins, expounders of Brahman, see through unity. O Atman of the universe, without resorting to you the Yogin will not attain me. Do you protect the entire universe including Devas, Asuras and human beings."

verses.sanskrit: प्रधानपुरुषातीता प्रधानपुरुषात्मिका । पुराणी चिन्मयी पुंसामादिः पुरुषरूपिणी
verses.transliteration: pradhānapuruṣātītā pradhānapuruṣātmikā / purāṇī cinmayī puṃsāmādiḥ puruṣarūpiṇī
verses.translation: After saying this, the Lord who has no beginning, who deludes the different living beings by means of his own Maya and whose power is unlimited went to his one and only abode which is unmanifest and which is devoid of birth, growth and destruction."
verses.hindi: त्वयि प्रधानं पुरुषो महान् ब्रह्मा तथेश्वरः । अविद्या नियतिर्माया कलाद्याः शतशोऽभवन् त्वामधिष्ठाय योगेशि महादेवो महेश्वरः । प्रधानाद्यं जगत् कृत्स्नं करोति विकरोति च
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this, the Lord who has no beginning, who deludes the different living beings by means of his own Maya and whose power is unlimited went to his one and only abode which is unmanifest and which is devoid of birth, growth and destruction."
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this, the Lord who has no beginning, who deludes the different living beings by means of his own Maya and whose power is unlimited went to his one and only abode which is unmanifest and which is devoid of birth, growth and destruction."

verses.sanskrit: भूतान्तरात्मा कूटस्था महापुरुषसंज्ञिता । जन्ममृत्युजरातीता सर्वशक्तिसमन्विता
verses.transliteration: bhūtāntarātmā kūṭasthā mahāpuruṣasaṃjñitā / janmamṛtyujarātītā sarvaśaktisamanvitā
verses.translation: The v.l. Viivdtmane noted in Ft. Note 1 (of the Venk. Ed.) is equally good. For Viiva is one of the thousand names of Visnu.
verses.hindi: त्वयैव संगतो देवः स्वमानन्दं समश्नुते । त्वमेव परमानन्दस्त्वमेवानन्ददायिनी शिवं सर्वगतं सूक्ष्मं परं ब्रह्म सनातनम्
verses.wordMeaning: The v.l. Viivdtmane noted in Ft. Note 1 (of the Venk. Ed.) is equally good. For Viiva is one of the thousand names of Visnu.
verses.commentary: Sense: The v.l. Viivdtmane noted in Ft. Note 1 (of the Venk. Ed.) is equally good. For Viiva is one of the thousand names of Visnu.

verses.sanskrit: व्यापिनी चानवच्छिन्ना प्रधानानुप्रवेशिनी । क्षेत्रज्ञशक्तिरव्यक्तलक्षणा मलवर्जिता
verses.transliteration: vyāpinī cānavacchinnā pradhānānupraveśinī / kṣetrajñaśaktiravyaktalakṣaṇā malavarjitā
verses.translation: The one-ness of the Trinity of gods (Brahma, Visnu and Siva) and its identification with the Brahman is, as usual, emphasized in these- verses.
verses.hindi: त्वं शक्रः सर्वदेवानां ब्रह्मा ब्रह्मविदामसि। वायुर्बलवतां देवि योगिनां त्वं कुमारकः सांख्यानां कपिलो देवो रुद्राणामसि शंकरः
verses.wordMeaning: The one-ness of the Trinity of gods (Brahma, Visnu and Siva) and its identification with the Brahman is, as usual, emphasized in these- verses.
verses.commentary: Sense: The one-ness of the Trinity of gods (Brahma, Visnu and Siva) and its identification with the Brahman is, as usual, emphasized in these- verses.

verses.sanskrit: अनादिमायसंभिन्ना त्रितत्त्वा प्रकृतिर्गुहा । महामायासमुत्पन्ना तामसी पौरुषी ध्रुवा
verses.transliteration: anādimāyasaṃbhinnā tritattvā prakṛtirguhā / mahāmāyāsamutpannā tāmasī pauruṣī dhruvā
verses.translation: They were born out of the ear-cavities of god Visnu the wielder of the Sarhga bow, the Lord of Devas. They had bodies as huge as a great mountain and they were over-powered with great fury.
verses.hindi: माया त्वं सर्वशक्तीनां कालः कलयतामसि ओङ्कारः सर्वगुह्यानां वर्णानां च द्विजोत्तमः । आश्रमाणां च गार्हस्थ्यमीश्वराणां महेश्वर;
verses.wordMeaning: They were born out of the ear-cavities of god Visnu the wielder of the Sarhga bow, the Lord of Devas. They had bodies as huge as a great mountain and they were over-powered with great fury.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were born out of the ear-cavities of god Visnu the wielder of the Sarhga bow, the Lord of Devas. They had bodies as huge as a great mountain and they were over-powered with great fury.

verses.sanskrit: व्यक्ताव्यक्तात्मिकाकृष्णा रक्ताशुक्ला प्रसूतिका । अकार्या कार्यजननी नित्यं प्रसवधर्मिणी
verses.transliteration: vyaktāvyaktātmikākṛṣṇā raktāśuklā prasūtikā / akāryā kāryajananī nityaṃ prasavadharmiṇī
verses.translation: On seeing them arrived, the un-born Lord Brahma requested Narayana, "It behoves you to slay these Asuras, the thorns in the three worlds."
verses.hindi: पर्वतश्रेष्ठ हिमवान् देवीके इस प्रकारके (सौम्य) स्वरूपको देखकर भयका परित्यागकर प्रसन्न-मन होकर परमेश्वरीसे कहने लगे-- अव्यक्तस्वरूपा आप प्रसन्न होकर दृष्टिगोचर हुई हैं। देवि! आपके द्वारा सम्पूर्ण जगतूकी सृष्टि हुई है, आपे प्रधानादि प्रतिष्ठित हैं और आपमें ही (वह सब ) लीन भी हो जाता है। आप ही परम गति भो हें। शिवके
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing them arrived, the un-born Lord Brahma requested Narayana, "It behoves you to slay these Asuras, the thorns in the three worlds."
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing them arrived, the un-born Lord Brahma requested Narayana, "It behoves you to slay these Asuras, the thorns in the three worlds."

verses.sanskrit: सर्गप्रलयनिर्मुक्ता सृष्टिस्थित्यन्तधर्मिणी । ब्रह्मगर्भा चतुर्विशा पद्मनाभाच्युतात्मिका
verses.transliteration: sargapralayanirmuktā sṛṣṭisthityantadharmiṇī / brahmagarbhā caturviśā padmanābhācyutātmikā
verses.translation: On hearing his words. Lord Hari who abides in the cosmic waters (Narayana) ordered two persons to kill those two Asuras.
verses.hindi: आश्रयमें रहनेवाली देवि! कुछ लोग आपको हौ प्रकृति तथा प्रकृतिसे परे कहते हैं और दूसरे परमार्थको जाननेवाले आपको शिवा कहते हें । आपपमें प्रधान, पुरुष, महान्, ब्रह्मा तथा ईश्वर (प्रतिष्ठित हैं)! (आपसे) अविद्या, नियति, माया और सैकड़ों कला आदिकी उत्पत्ति हुई है॥ २१९--२२२ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing his words. Lord Hari who abides in the cosmic waters (Narayana) ordered two persons to kill those two Asuras.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing his words. Lord Hari who abides in the cosmic waters (Narayana) ordered two persons to kill those two Asuras.

verses.sanskrit: वैद्युती शाश्वती योनिर्जगन्मातेश्वरप्रिया । सर्वाधारा महारूपा सर्वैश्वर्यसमन्विता
verses.transliteration: vaidyutī śāśvatī yonirjaganmāteśvarapriyā / sarvādhārā mahārūpā sarvaiśvaryasamanvitā
verses.translation: At his behest, O Brahmanas, great battle of those two persons with the two Asuras ensued, Jisnu conquered Kaitabha while Visnu vanquished Madhu.
verses.hindi: आप ही वह परमा शक्ति, अनन्ता और परमेष्ठिनी हैं। आप सभी भेदोंसे विनिर्मुक्त और सभी भेदोंके आश्रय एवं स्वयं प्रतिष्ठित हैं। है योगेश्वरी ! आपमें ही अधिष्ठित होकर महादेव महेश्वर प्रधान आदि सम्पूर्ण जगतूको रचना करते हैं और फिर (उसका) संहार करते हैं। आपके ही संयोगसे महादेव स्वात्मानन्दका उपभोग करते हैं। आप ही परमानन्द (रूपा) और आप ही आनन्द प्रदान करनेवाली हैं। आप अक्षर, परमव्योम,
verses.wordMeaning: At his behest, O Brahmanas, great battle of those two persons with the two Asuras ensued, Jisnu conquered Kaitabha while Visnu vanquished Madhu.
verses.commentary: Sense: At his behest, O Brahmanas, great battle of those two persons with the two Asuras ensued, Jisnu conquered Kaitabha while Visnu vanquished Madhu.

verses.sanskrit: विश्वरूपा महागर्भा विश्वेशेच्छानुवर्तिनी । महीयसी ब्रह्मयोनिर्महालक्ष्मीसमुद्भावा
verses.transliteration: viśvarūpā mahāgarbhā viśveśecchānuvartinī / mahīyasī brahmayonirmahālakṣmīsamudbhāvā
verses.translation: Then Hari the Lord of the universe, with his mind overwhelmed with affection, spoke these sweet words to god Brahma, the grand-sire of the worlds, who was seated in the lotus.
verses.hindi: एवं सनातन परम ब्रह्म हैं। देवि! आप सभी देवताओंमें इन्द्र (रूप) और ब्रह्मज्ञानियोंमें ब्रह्मा (रूप) हैं। (आप) बलवानोंमें वायु (रूप) तथा योगियोंमें कुमारक (सनत्कुमार) हैं ॥ २२३--२२७॥ आप कऋऋषियोंमें वसिष्ठ, वेदविदोंमें व्यास हैं। सांख्यशास्त्रके जाननेवालोंमें कपिलदेव तथा रुद्रोंमें शंकर हैं। आप आदित्योंमें उपेन्द्र (विष्णु) तथा वसुओंमे पावक हैं। वेदोंमें आप सामवेद तथा छन्दोंमें गायत्री छन्द
verses.wordMeaning: Then Hari the Lord of the universe, with his mind overwhelmed with affection, spoke these sweet words to god Brahma, the grand-sire of the worlds, who was seated in the lotus.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Hari the Lord of the universe, with his mind overwhelmed with affection, spoke these sweet words to god Brahma, the grand-sire of the worlds, who was seated in the lotus.

verses.sanskrit: महाविमानमध्यस्था महानिद्रात्महेतुका । सर्वसाधारणी सूक्ष्मा ह्यविद्या पारमार्थिका
verses.transliteration: mahāvimānamadhyasthā mahānidrātmahetukā / sarvasādhāraṇī sūkṣmā hyavidyā pāramārthikā
verses.translation: "O Lord, you are being borne by me; you are brilliant and weighty; I am unable to bear you. Hence, please get down from this lotus."
verses.hindi: हैं। विद्याओंमें अध्यात्मविद्या तथा गतियोंमें परम गति हैं। आप सभी शक्तियोंमें माया और संहार करनेवालोंमें काल (रूप) हैं। आप सभी गुह्योंमें ओंकार और वर्णोमे द्विजोत्तम हैं। आश्रमोंमें गृहस्थाश्रम तथा ईश्वरोंमें महेश्वर सर्वोपनिषदां देवि गुह्योपनिषदुच्यसे
verses.wordMeaning: "O Lord, you are being borne by me; you are brilliant and weighty; I am unable to bear you. Hence, please get down from this lotus."
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Lord, you are being borne by me; you are brilliant and weighty; I am unable to bear you. Hence, please get down from this lotus."

verses.sanskrit: अनन्तरूपानन्तस्था देवी पुरुषमोहिनी । अनेकाकारसंस्थाना कालत्रयविवर्जिता
verses.transliteration: anantarūpānantasthā devī puruṣamohinī / anekākārasaṃsthānā kālatrayavivarjitā
verses.translation: Then the soul of the universe, (god Brahma) got down and entered the person of Visnu, the wielder of the discus (Sudarsana). He became united with Visnu and was overcome with the special type of slumber of Visnu.
verses.hindi: आदित्यः सर्वमार्गाणां वाचां देवी सरस्वती त्वं लक्ष्मीश्चारुरूपाणां विष्णुर्मायाविनामसि। अरुन्धती सतीनां त्वं सुपर्णः पततामसि
verses.wordMeaning: Then the soul of the universe, (god Brahma) got down and entered the person of Visnu, the wielder of the discus (Sudarsana). He became united with Visnu and was overcome with the special type of slumber of Visnu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the soul of the universe, (god Brahma) got down and entered the person of Visnu, the wielder of the discus (Sudarsana). He became united with Visnu and was overcome with the special type of slumber of Visnu.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मजन्मा हरेर्मूर्तिर्ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवात्मिका । ब्रह्मेशविष्णुजननी ब्रह्माख्या ब्रह्मसंश्रया
verses.transliteration: brahmajanmā harermūrtirbrahmaviṣṇuśivātmikā / brahmeśaviṣṇujananī brahmākhyā brahmasaṃśrayā
verses.translation: God Brahma, designated as Narayana, and wielding a conch, a discus and a mace {Gada), becoming possessed of him that way, slumbered within the watery expanse, {v.l. possessed of a thousand heads and eyes.)
verses.hindi: सर्वेषां त्वं परं ब्रह्म त्वन्मयं सर्वमेव हि मगोचरं निर्मलमेकरूपम् ।
verses.wordMeaning: God Brahma, designated as Narayana, and wielding a conch, a discus and a mace {Gada), becoming possessed of him that way, slumbered within the watery expanse, {v.l. possessed of a thousand heads and eyes.)
verses.commentary: Sense: God Brahma, designated as Narayana, and wielding a conch, a discus and a mace {Gada), becoming possessed of him that way, slumbered within the watery expanse, {v.l. possessed of a thousand heads and eyes.)

verses.sanskrit: व्यक्ता प्रथमजा ब्राह्मी महती ज्ञानरूपिणी । वैराग्यैश्वर्यधर्मात्मा ब्रह्ममूर्तिर्हृदिस्थिता । अपांयोनिः स्वयंभूतिर्मानसी तत्त्वसंभवा
verses.transliteration: vyaktā prathamajā brāhmī mahatī jñānarūpiṇī / vairāgyaiśvaryadharmātmā brahmamūrtirhṛdisthitā / apāṃyoniḥ svayaṃbhūtirmānasī tattvasaṃbhavā
verses.translation: Fora long time, he enjoyed the bliss of identity with that great soul, devoid of beginning and end and having no second. It was his own Atman.
verses.hindi: यदेव पश्यन्ति जगत्प्रसूतिं ऐश्वर्यविज्ञानविरागधर्मै:
verses.wordMeaning: Fora long time, he enjoyed the bliss of identity with that great soul, devoid of beginning and end and having no second. It was his own Atman.
verses.commentary: Sense: Fora long time, he enjoyed the bliss of identity with that great soul, devoid of beginning and end and having no second. It was his own Atman.

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वराणी च शर्वाणी शङ्करार्धशरीरिणी । भवानी चैव रुद्राणी महालक्ष्मीरथाम्बिका
verses.transliteration: īśvarāṇī ca śarvāṇī śaṅkarārdhaśarīriṇī / bhavānī caiva rudrāṇī mahālakṣmīrathāmbikā
verses.translation: Then in the morning, the Yogic soul termed as Brahman, became the four-faced deity. Resorting to the dispo¬ sition of Visnu, he created beings of the same type.
verses.hindi: समन्वितं देवि नतोऽस्मि रूपम् पुरुषोंमें जो (उत्तम) पुरुष है और जो सभी प्राणियोंक हृदयमें रहनेवाला है, वह एकमात्र आप ही हैं। देवि! आप सभी उपनिषदोंमें गुह्योपनिषत् कही जाती हैं। कल्योंमें आप ईशानकल्प हैं और युगोंमें
verses.wordMeaning: Then in the morning, the Yogic soul termed as Brahman, became the four-faced deity. Resorting to the dispo¬ sition of Visnu, he created beings of the same type.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then in the morning, the Yogic soul termed as Brahman, became the four-faced deity. Resorting to the dispo¬ sition of Visnu, he created beings of the same type.

verses.sanskrit: महेश्वरसमुत्पन्ना भुक्तिमुक्तिफलप्रदा । सर्वेश्वरी सर्ववन्द्या नित्यं मुदितमानसा
verses.transliteration: maheśvarasamutpannā bhuktimuktiphalapradā / sarveśvarī sarvavandyā nityaṃ muditamānasā
verses.translation: The Lord created at the outset Sananda and Sanaka, Rbhu, Sanatkumara and the elder one Sanatana.
verses.hindi: सत्ययुग हैं। सभी भ्रमण करनेवालों (ग्रह-नक्षत्रों आदि)-में आदित्य (सूर्य) तथा वाणियोंमें सरस्वती देवी हैं । सुन्दर रूपवालोंमें आप लक्ष्मी और मायावियोंमें विष्णु हैं। आप पतित्रताओमें अरुन्धती तथा पक्षियोंमें गरुड हैं। आप सूक्तोंमें पुरुषसूक्त, सामगानोंमें ज्येष्ठ साम हैं। जपने योग्य मन्त्रोंमै सावित्री मन्त्र और यजुर्वेदके मन्त्रोंमें शतरुद्रिय आप ही हैं ॥ २३२--२३५॥
verses.wordMeaning: The Lord created at the outset Sananda and Sanaka, Rbhu, Sanatkumara and the elder one Sanatana.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Lord created at the outset Sananda and Sanaka, Rbhu, Sanatkumara and the elder one Sanatana.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मेन्द्रोपेन्द्रनमिता शङ्करेच्छानुवर्तिनी । ईश्वरार्धासनगता महेश्वरपतिव्रता
verses.transliteration: brahmendropendranamitā śaṅkarecchānuvartinī / īśvarārdhāsanagatā maheśvarapativratā
verses.translation: They were free from delusion and mutually clashing opposites such as pleasure and pain. They possessed the greatest detachment. Having realised the highest reality, they directed their attention towards knowledge, {v.l. na srffau dadhire matim "They did not take interest in creation.")
verses.hindi: आप पर्वतोंमें महामेरु और सर्पोमे अनन्त (नाग) हैं। सभीमें आप परब्रह्म हैं, सब कुछ आपमें ही व्याप्त है। में आपके तमोगुणसे परे रहनेवाले उस सत्यरूपको नमस्कार करता हूँ जो समस्त कलाओंसे रहित, अनन्त और आदिस्वरूप हैं  वेदान्तरूपी विज्ञानके अर्थका निश्चय करनेवाले, जगत्के उत्पादक प्रणव नामवाले जिस अद्वितीय आनन्दका साक्षात्कार करते हैं, मैं उसी रूपको शरण ग्रहण करता हूँ। (में) समस्त प्राणियोंके
verses.wordMeaning: They were free from delusion and mutually clashing opposites such as pleasure and pain. They possessed the greatest detachment. Having realised the highest reality, they directed their attention towards knowledge, {v.l.…
verses.commentary: Sense: They were free from delusion and mutually clashing opposites such as pleasure and pain. They possessed the greatest detachment. Having realised the highest reality, they directed their attention towards knowledge, {v.l.…

verses.sanskrit: सकृद्विभाविता सर्वा समुद्रपरिशोषिणी । पार्वती हिमवत्पुत्री परमानन्ददायिनी
verses.transliteration: sakṛdvibhāvitā sarvā samudrapariśoṣiṇī / pārvatī himavatputrī paramānandadāyinī
verses.translation: When they were thus indifferent towards the crea¬ tion of the worlds, god Brahma, the grand-father of the world became despaired due to the Maya of Parameffhin.
verses.hindi: भीतर रहनेवाले, प्रधान और पुरुषके संयोग तथा वियोगके कारण, उत्पत्ति एवं विनाशसे रहित तथा तेजोमय उस प्राण नामवाले रूपको प्रणाम करता हूँ (में) आदि तथा अन्तसे रहित, संसारके आत्मारूप, अनेक रूपोंमें स्थित, प्रकृतिसे परे रहनेवाले, कूटस्थ एवं अव्यक्त शरीर धारण करनेवाले पुरुष नामक आपके रूपको नमस्कार करता हूँ। मैं सभीके
verses.wordMeaning: When they were thus indifferent towards the crea¬ tion of the worlds, god Brahma, the grand-father of the world became despaired due to the Maya of Parameffhin.
verses.commentary: Sense: When they were thus indifferent towards the crea¬ tion of the worlds, god Brahma, the grand-father of the world became despaired due to the Maya of Parameffhin.

verses.sanskrit: गुणाढ्या योगजा योग्या ज्ञानमूर्तिर्विकासिनी । सावित्रीकमला लक्ष्मीः श्रीरनन्तोरसि स्थिता
verses.transliteration: guṇāḍhyā yogajā yogyā jñānamūrtirvikāsinī / sāvitrīkamalā lakṣmīḥ śrīranantorasi sthitā
verses.translation: Then the ancient Purusa, the eternal, the embodi¬ ment of the universe, spoke to his son, the lotus-born god in order to destroy his delusion.
verses.hindi: आश्रयरूप, सम्पूर्ण संसारका विधान करनेवाले, सर्वत्र व्यापत जन्म और मरणसे रहित, सूक्ष्म, विचित्र, त्रिगुणात्मक, प्रधानस्वरूप तथा अलुप्त भेदवाले आपके रूपको प्रणाम करता हूँ। देवि! आपका जो आद्य, महान्, पुरुषात्मक रूप है, जो प्रकृतिमें अवस्थित है, त्रिगुणात्मक मूल बीजरूप है तथा ऐश्वर्य, विज्ञान और विराग-धर्मासे समन्वित है, मैं उसे नमस्कार करता हूँ
verses.wordMeaning: Then the ancient Purusa, the eternal, the embodi¬ ment of the universe, spoke to his son, the lotus-born god in order to destroy his delusion.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the ancient Purusa, the eternal, the embodi¬ ment of the universe, spoke to his son, the lotus-born god in order to destroy his delusion.

verses.sanskrit: सरोजनिलया मुद्रा योगनिद्रा सुरार्दिना । सरस्वती सर्वविद्या जगज्ज्येष्ठा सुमङ्गला
verses.transliteration: sarojanilayā mudrā yoganidrā surārdinā / sarasvatī sarvavidyā jagajjyeṣṭhā sumaṅgalā
verses.translation: "Has this been forgotten that the trident-bearing eternal Lord, Sambhu was requested by you formerly "O Sankara, do you be my son."
verses.hindi: द्विसप्तलोकात्मकमम्बुसंस्थं स्वतेजसा पूरितलोकभेदम्। त्रिकालहेतुं परमेष्ठिसंज्ञं
verses.wordMeaning: "Has this been forgotten that the trident-bearing eternal Lord, Sambhu was requested by you formerly "O Sankara, do you be my son."
verses.commentary: Sense: "Has this been forgotten that the trident-bearing eternal Lord, Sambhu was requested by you formerly "O Sankara, do you be my son."

verses.sanskrit: वाग्देवी वरदा वाच्या कीर्तिः सर्वार्थसाधिका । योगीश्वरी ब्रह्मविद्या महाविद्या सुशोभना
verses.transliteration: vāgdevī varadā vācyā kīrtiḥ sarvārthasādhikā / yogīśvarī brahmavidyā mahāvidyā suśobhanā
verses.translation: Sankara had urged his mind in the guise of his son. The lotus-born god the grand-sire of the world, regained en¬ lightenment through Govinda.
verses.hindi: सहस्त्रबाहुं पुरुषं पुराणम्। नारायणाख्यं प्रणतोऽस्मि रूपम्
verses.wordMeaning: Sankara had urged his mind in the guise of his son. The lotus-born god the grand-sire of the world, regained en¬ lightenment through Govinda.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sankara had urged his mind in the guise of his son. The lotus-born god the grand-sire of the world, regained en¬ lightenment through Govinda.

verses.sanskrit: गुह्यविद्यात्मविद्या च धर्मविद्यात्मभाविता । स्वाहा विश्वंभरा सिद्धिः स्वधा मेधा धृतिः श्रुतिः
verses.transliteration: guhyavidyātmavidyā ca dharmavidyātmabhāvitā / svāhā viśvaṃbharā siddhiḥ svadhā medhā dhṛtiḥ śrutiḥ
verses.translation: As he was inclined to create beings, he performed a very difficult penance. But even though he performed that penance nothing transpired.
verses.hindi: दंष्टाकरालं त्रिदशाभिवन्द्यं युगान्तकालानलकल्परूपम् ।
