verses.wordMeaning: As he was inclined to create beings, he performed a very difficult penance. But even though he performed that penance nothing transpired.
verses.commentary: Sense: As he was inclined to create beings, he performed a very difficult penance. But even though he performed that penance nothing transpired.

verses.sanskrit: नीतिः सुनीतिः सुकृतिर्माधवी नरवाहिनी । अजा विभावरी सौम्या भोगिनी भोगदायिनी
verses.transliteration: nītiḥ sunītiḥ sukṛtirmādhavī naravāhinī / ajā vibhāvarī saumyā bhoginī bhogadāyinī
verses.translation: Then after the lapse of a long time, his grief created wrath in him. From both of his eyes overwhelmed with anger, drops of tears fell down.
verses.hindi: नमामि रूपं तव कालसंज्ञम् ब्रह्मामृतानन्दरसज्ञमेकम्
verses.wordMeaning: Then after the lapse of a long time, his grief created wrath in him. From both of his eyes overwhelmed with anger, drops of tears fell down.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then after the lapse of a long time, his grief created wrath in him. From both of his eyes overwhelmed with anger, drops of tears fell down.

verses.sanskrit: शोभा वंशकरी लोला मालिनी परमेष्ठिनी । त्रैलोक्यसुन्दरी रम्या सुन्दरी कामचारिणी
verses.transliteration: śobhā vaṃśakarī lolā mālinī parameṣṭhinī / trailokyasundarī ramyā sundarī kāmacāriṇī
verses.translation: From them goblins and ghosts cropped up. On seeing all of them in front of him, Brahma censured himself
verses.hindi: सुकोमल देवि विशालशुभ्रं नमामि ते रूपमिदं नमामि ॐ नमस्ते महादेवि नमस्ते परमेश्वरि। नमो भगवतीशानि शिवायै ते नमो नमः
verses.wordMeaning: From them goblins and ghosts cropped up. On seeing all of them in front of him, Brahma censured himself
verses.commentary: Sense: From them goblins and ghosts cropped up. On seeing all of them in front of him, Brahma censured himself

verses.sanskrit: महानुभावा सत्त्वस्था महामहिषमर्दनी । पद्ममाला पापहरा विचित्रा मुकुटानना
verses.transliteration: mahānubhāvā sattvasthā mahāmahiṣamardanī / padmamālā pāpaharā vicitrā mukuṭānanā
verses.translation: Lord Prajapati (Brahma) overcome with wrath gave up his life. Then Rudra, of the nature of Prana (vital air), manifested himself from the mouth of the Lord (god Brahma).
verses.hindi: मया नास्ति समो लोके देवो वा दानवोऽपि वा। जगन्मातैव मत्पुत्री सम्भूता तपसा यतः चौदह लोकात्मक, जलमें अवस्थित, विचित्र भेदवाले, परम पुरुषको ही अपना स्वामी स्वीकार करनेवाले, अनन्त प्राणियोंके निवासस्थान, उस जगदण्ड (ब्रह्माण्ड) -संज्ञक आपके रूपको में नमस्कार करता
verses.wordMeaning: Lord Prajapati (Brahma) overcome with wrath gave up his life. Then Rudra, of the nature of Prana (vital air), manifested himself from the mouth of the Lord (god Brahma).
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Prajapati (Brahma) overcome with wrath gave up his life. Then Rudra, of the nature of Prana (vital air), manifested himself from the mouth of the Lord (god Brahma).

verses.sanskrit: निर्यन्त्रा यन्त्रवाहस्था नन्दिनी भद्रकालिका । आदित्यवर्णा कौमारी मयूरवरवाहिनी
verses.transliteration: niryantrā yantravāhasthā nandinī bhadrakālikā / ādityavarṇā kaumārī mayūravaravāhinī
verses.translation: Lord Siva, the god of gods, with the brilliance of a thousand suns and comparable to the cosmic fire ablaze at the end of the Yugas, cried out loudly and terribly.
verses.hindi: हूँ। (मैं) समग्र वेदरूप, अद्वितीय, आदि, अपने तेजसे. सम्पूर्ण संसारको व्याप्त करनेवाले, तीनों कालोंके कारण तथा सूर्यमण्डलमें प्रतिष्ठित परमेष्ठी नामवाले रूपको नमस्कार करता हूँ। जो हजारों सिरवाले हैं, अनन्त शक्ति-सम्पन्न हैं, हजारों हाथवाले हैं तथा जलके मध्यमें शयन करनेवाले हैं, मैं उन 'नारायण' नामसे प्रसिद्ध पुराणपुरुषके रूपको प्रणाम करता हूँ। (देवि!) आपका जो रूप भयंकर दाढ़वाला, देवताओंद्वारा
verses.wordMeaning: Lord Siva, the god of gods, with the brilliance of a thousand suns and comparable to the cosmic fire ablaze at the end of the Yugas, cried out loudly and terribly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Siva, the god of gods, with the brilliance of a thousand suns and comparable to the cosmic fire ablaze at the end of the Yugas, cried out loudly and terribly.

verses.sanskrit: निर्यन्त्रा यन्त्रवाहस्था नन्दिनी भद्रकालिका । आदित्यवर्णा कौमारी मयूरवरवाहिनी
verses.transliteration: niryantrā yantravāhasthā nandinī bhadrakālikā / ādityavarṇā kaumārī mayūravaravāhinī
verses.translation: Brahma spoke to him as he cried, "O don't cry. You will become well-known in the world as 'Rudra', because of your crying."
verses.hindi: सब प्रकारसे वन्दनीय, प्रलयकालीन अग्निके समान रूपवाला और सम्पूर्ण प्राणियोंके विनाशके लिये कारण- रूप है, में उस काल नामवाले रूपको नमस्कार करता हुँ॥ २४३--२४६॥ (देवि!) मैं आपके शेष नामवाले उस रूपको प्रणाम करता हूँ, जो हजारों फणोंसे सुशोभित है, प्रधान- प्रधान नागराजोंसे पूजित है, जनार्दन नामसे शरीर धारण किये हुए है तथा प्रगाढ निद्रामें है। जिसका ऐश्वर्य
verses.wordMeaning: Brahma spoke to him as he cried, "O don't cry. You will become well-known in the world as 'Rudra', because of your crying."
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahma spoke to him as he cried, "O don't cry. You will become well-known in the world as 'Rudra', because of your crying."

verses.sanskrit: वृषासनगता गौरो महाकाली सुरार्चिता । अदितिर्नियता रौद्री पद्मगर्भा विवाहना
verses.transliteration: vṛṣāsanagatā gauro mahākālī surārcitā / aditirniyatā raudrī padmagarbhā vivāhanā
verses.translation: The grand-father of the world gave him seven other names. He gave him wives and eternal sons. To those eight persons, the grand-sire of the world gave abodes as well.*
verses.hindi: अव्याहत (अबाधित)है, जिसके नेत्र विषम हैं, (जो तीन नेत्रोंसे युक्त है), जो ब्रह्मे अमृतरूपी आनन्द- रसको जाननेवाला है, अद्वितीय है, प्रलयकालमें स्थित रहनेवाला है और जो द्युलोकमें नृत्य करता रहता है (देवि!) में आपके उस रुद्र नामवाले रूपको प्रणाम करता हूँ। देवि! (मैं) शोकसे सर्वथा शून्य, निर्मल, पवित्र, देवताओं तथा असुरोंसे पूजित चरणकमलवाले आपके अत्यन्त कोमल, विशाल एवं उज्ज्वल इस
verses.wordMeaning: The grand-father of the world gave him seven other names. He gave him wives and eternal sons. To those eight persons, the grand-sire of the world gave abodes as well.*
verses.commentary: Sense: The grand-father of the world gave him seven other names. He gave him wives and eternal sons. To those eight persons, the grand-sire of the world gave abodes as well.*

verses.sanskrit: विरूपाक्षी लेलिहाना महापुरनिवासिनी । महाफलानवद्याङ्गी कामपूरा विभावरी
verses.transliteration: virūpākṣī lelihānā mahāpuranivāsinī / mahāphalānavadyāṅgī kāmapūrā vibhāvarī
verses.translation: Those seven names are—(1) Bhava, (2) Sarva, (3) Isana (4) Pasunampati (5) Bhima, (6) Ugra and (7) Mahadeva.
verses.hindi: रूपको नमस्कार करता हूँ, बार-बार नमस्कार करता हूँ। महादेवि! आपको नमस्कार है, परमेश्वरि! आपको नमस्कार है। भगवती ईशानीको नमस्कार है, कल्याणरूपिणी आपको बार-बार नमस्कार है में आपसे व्याप्त हूँ, आप मेरे आधार हैं और आप ही मेरी गति हैं। परमेश्वरि! मैं आपकी ही शरण ग्रहण करता हुँ, आप (मुझपर) प्रसन्न हों। मेरे समान संसारमें देवता या दानव कोई भी नहीं है, क्योंकि (मेरे) तपके कारण आप
verses.wordMeaning: Those seven names are—(1) Bhava, (2) Sarva, (3) Isana (4) Pasunampati (5) Bhima, (6) Ugra and (7) Mahadeva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those seven names are—(1) Bhava, (2) Sarva, (3) Isana (4) Pasunampati (5) Bhima, (6) Ugra and (7) Mahadeva.

verses.sanskrit: विचित्ररत्नमुकुटा प्रणतार्तिप्रभञ्जनी । कौशिकी कर्षणी रात्रिस्त्रिदशार्तिविनाशिनी
verses.transliteration: vicitraratnamukuṭā praṇatārtiprabhañjanī / kauśikī karṣaṇī rātristridaśārtivināśinī
verses.translation: The eight Murtis (cosmic forms of this god) areas follows:— (1) sun, (2) water, (3) earth, (4) fire, (5) wind, (6) ether, (7) initiated Brahmanas and (8) moon.
verses.hindi: जगन्माता ही मेरी पुत्रीके रूपमें उत्पन्न हुई हैं एषा तवाम्बिका देवि किलाभूत् पितृकन्यका । मेनाशेषजगन्मातुरहो पुण्यस्य गौरवम्
verses.wordMeaning: The eight Murtis (cosmic forms of this god) areas follows:— (1) sun, (2) water, (3) earth, (4) fire, (5) wind, (6) ether, (7) initiated Brahmanas and (8) moon.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eight Murtis (cosmic forms of this god) areas follows:— (1) sun, (2) water, (3) earth, (4) fire, (5) wind, (6) ether, (7) initiated Brahmanas and (8) moon.

verses.sanskrit: बहुरूपा सुरूपा च विरूपा रूपवर्जिता । भक्तार्तिशमनी भव्या भवभावविनाशनी
verses.transliteration: bahurūpā surūpā ca virūpā rūpavarjitā / bhaktārtiśamanī bhavyā bhavabhāvavināśanī
verses.translation: The lord endowed with eight bodies bestows the highest region (Mokfa) on those who meditate on him, and bow down to Rudras in these bodies.
verses.hindi: नमामि तव पादाब्जं व्रजामि शरणं शिवाम् अहो मे सुमहद् भाग्यं महादेवीसमागमात्। आज्ञापय महादेवि किं करिष्यामि शंकरि
verses.wordMeaning: The lord endowed with eight bodies bestows the highest region (Mokfa) on those who meditate on him, and bow down to Rudras in these bodies.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord endowed with eight bodies bestows the highest region (Mokfa) on those who meditate on him, and bow down to Rudras in these bodies.

verses.sanskrit: निर्गुणा नित्यविभवा निः सारा निरपत्रपा । यशस्विनी सामगीतिर्भवाङ्गनिलयालया
verses.transliteration: nirguṇā nityavibhavā niḥ sārā nirapatrapā / yaśasvinī sāmagītirbhavāṅganilayālayā
verses.translation: The eight wives are:—Suvarcala, Uma, Vikesi, Siva, Svaha, Disah, Diksa and Rohini.
verses.hindi: उपदेशं गिरिश्रेष्ठ सेवितं ब्रह्मवादिभिः शान्तः समाहितमना दम्भाहं॑कारवर्जितः। तन्निष्ठस्तत्परो भूत्वा तदेव शरणं व्रज
verses.wordMeaning: The eight wives are:—Suvarcala, Uma, Vikesi, Siva, Svaha, Disah, Diksa and Rohini.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eight wives are:—Suvarcala, Uma, Vikesi, Siva, Svaha, Disah, Diksa and Rohini.

verses.sanskrit: दीक्षा विद्याधरी दीप्ता महेन्द्रविनिपातिनी । सर्वातिशायिनी विद्या सर्वसिद्धिप्रदायिनी
verses.transliteration: dīkṣā vidyādharī dīptā mahendravinipātinī / sarvātiśāyinī vidyā sarvasiddhipradāyinī
verses.translation: The sons of these are—Sanaiscara. (the Saturn), Sukra (the Venus), Lohitahga (the Mars), Manojava, Skanda Sarga, Santana and Budha (the Mercury).
verses.hindi: सर्वयज्ञतपोदानैस्तदेवार्चय सर्वदा तदेव मनसा पश्य तद् ध्यायस्व जपस्व च। ममोपदेशात् संसारं नाशयामि तवानघ
verses.wordMeaning: The sons of these are—Sanaiscara. (the Saturn), Sukra (the Venus), Lohitahga (the Mars), Manojava, Skanda Sarga, Santana and Budha (the Mercury).
verses.commentary: Sense: The sons of these are—Sanaiscara. (the Saturn), Sukra (the Venus), Lohitahga (the Mars), Manojava, Skanda Sarga, Santana and Budha (the Mercury).

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेश्वरप्रिया तार्क्ष्या समुद्रान्तरवासिनी । अकलङ्का निराधारा नित्यसिद्धा निरामया
verses.transliteration: sarveśvarapriyā tārkṣyā samudrāntaravāsinī / akalaṅkā nirādhārā nityasiddhā nirāmayā
verses.translation: Lord Mahesvara, Lord of Devas, who was of this nature, eschewed his duty of procreation and desire, and resorted to renunciation.
verses.hindi: ध्यानेन कर्मयोगेन भक्त्या ज्ञानेन चैव हि। प्राप्याहं ते गिरिश्रेष्ठ नान्यथा कर्मकोटिभिः ्रुतिस्मृत्युदितं सम्यक् कर्म वर्णाश्रमात्मकम्। अध्यात्मज्ञानसहितं मुक्तये सततं कुरु
verses.wordMeaning: Lord Mahesvara, Lord of Devas, who was of this nature, eschewed his duty of procreation and desire, and resorted to renunciation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Mahesvara, Lord of Devas, who was of this nature, eschewed his duty of procreation and desire, and resorted to renunciation.

verses.sanskrit: कामधेनुर्बृहद्गर्भा धीमती मोहनाशिनी । निः सङ्कल्पा निरातङ्का विनया विनयप्रदा
verses.transliteration: kāmadhenurbṛhadgarbhā dhīmatī mohanāśinī / niḥ saṅkalpā nirātaṅkā vinayā vinayapradā
verses.translation: Fixing his individual soul into the Supreme Soul and having drunk deep the eternal Supreme Nectar called the imperishable Brahman, he established himself in the divine nature.
verses.hindi: धर्मात् संजायते भक्तिर्भक्त्या सम्प्राप्यते परम्। श्रुतिस्मृतिभ्यामुदितो धर्मो यज्ञादिको मत: देवि! ये पितरोंको कन्या मेना सम्पूर्ण संसारकी मातास्वरूप आपकी माता हैं, अहो! पुण्यके गौरवका क्या कहना ? अमरेशानि! आप मेनाके साथ मेरी सर्वदा रक्षा करें। मैं आपके चरणकमलोंमें नमस्कार करता हूँ
verses.wordMeaning: Fixing his individual soul into the Supreme Soul and having drunk deep the eternal Supreme Nectar called the imperishable Brahman, he established himself in the divine nature.
verses.commentary: Sense: Fixing his individual soul into the Supreme Soul and having drunk deep the eternal Supreme Nectar called the imperishable Brahman, he established himself in the divine nature.

verses.sanskrit: ज्वालामालासहस्त्राढ्या देवदेवी मनोन्मनी । महाभगवती दुर्गा वासुदेवसमुद्भवा
verses.transliteration: jvālāmālāsahastrāḍhyā devadevī manonmanī / mahābhagavatī durgā vāsudevasamudbhavā
verses.translation: When Siva, the god of blue-red complexion, was commanded by Brahma to procreate progeny, he mentally created Rudras, equal and similar to himself.
verses.hindi: और आप कल्याणकारिंणीकी शरणमें हूँ अहो! महादेवीके (मेरे घर) आ जानेसे मेरा बहुत बड़ा सौभाग्य हुआ। महादेवि! शंकरि! आप मुझे आज्ञा दें कि मैं क्या करूँ? ऐसा वचन कहकर वह गिरिराज हिमालय गिरिंजाको देखते हुए एवं
verses.wordMeaning: When Siva, the god of blue-red complexion, was commanded by Brahma to procreate progeny, he mentally created Rudras, equal and similar to himself.
verses.commentary: Sense: When Siva, the god of blue-red complexion, was commanded by Brahma to procreate progeny, he mentally created Rudras, equal and similar to himself.

verses.sanskrit: महेन्द्रोपेन्द्रभगिनी भक्तिगम्या परावरा । ज्ञानज्ञेया जरातीता वेदान्तविषया गतिः
verses.transliteration: mahendropendrabhaginī bhaktigamyā parāvarā / jñānajñeyā jarātītā vedāntaviṣayā gatiḥ
verses.translation: On seeing those various Rudras, pure, blue-red in complexion, immune from death and old age, the preceptor Brahma spoke to Kara.
verses.hindi: हाथ जोड़ते हुए उनके पास खड़े हो गये। जगत्की अरणि (मूल कारण)-रूप उस देवीने उनका (हिमवानूका) वचन सुनकर अपने पति पशुपति (शंकर)-का स्मरणकर मधुर-मधुर मुसकराते हुए पिता (हिमवान्) - देबी बोलीं--गिरिश्रेष्ठ! ब्रह्मवादियोंद्वारा सेवित केवल ईश्वरको ज्ञात इस परम गुह्य उपदेशको
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing those various Rudras, pure, blue-red in complexion, immune from death and old age, the preceptor Brahma spoke to Kara.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing those various Rudras, pure, blue-red in complexion, immune from death and old age, the preceptor Brahma spoke to Kara.

verses.sanskrit: दक्षिणा दहना दाह्या सर्वभूतनमस्कृता । योगमाया विभावज्ञा महामाया महीयसी
verses.transliteration: dakṣiṇā dahanā dāhyā sarvabhūtanamaskṛtā / yogamāyā vibhāvajñā mahāmāyā mahīyasī
verses.translation: O god, do not create such progeny devoid of ■death. O Lord of goblins, create other types of subjects suscep¬ tible to births and deaths.
verses.hindi: अद्भुत एवं ऐश्वर्यसम्पन्न रूपको तुमने देखा है, शान्त एवं एकाग्रमन होकर, दम्भ और अहंकारका सर्वथा परित्यागकर, अत्यन्त निष्ठा रखकर, तत्परायण हो उसी (रूप)-की शरण ग्रहण करो। तात! अनन्य भक्तिपूर्वक मेरे श्रेष्ठ भावका आश्रय ग्रहणकर, सभी यज्ञ, तप, दान (आदि साधनों)-के द्वारा सदा उसी (रूप)-को अर्चना करो। मेरे उपदेशको मानकर मनसे उसी (रूप)-को देखो, उसीका ध्यान करो और
verses.wordMeaning: O god, do not create such progeny devoid of ■death. O Lord of goblins, create other types of subjects suscep¬ tible to births and deaths.
verses.commentary: Sense: O god, do not create such progeny devoid of ■death. O Lord of goblins, create other types of subjects suscep¬ tible to births and deaths.

verses.sanskrit: संध्या सर्वसमुद्भूतिर्ब्रह्मवृक्षाश्रयानतिः । बीजाङ्कुरसमुद्भूतिर्महाशक्तिर्महामतिः
verses.transliteration: saṃdhyā sarvasamudbhūtirbrahmavṛkṣāśrayānatiḥ / bījāṅkurasamudbhūtirmahāśaktirmahāmatiḥ
verses.translation: Then the god with matted hair, the chastiser of Kama, replied, "I don't have such creation. You create such various types of creation." {v.l. Such inauspicious progeny).
verses.hindi: उसीका जप करो। अनघ! में तुम्हारे संसार ( भवबन्धन)- को विनष्ट कर दूँंगी ऐश्वर-योगमें स्थित अपने भक्तोंका मैं इस संसार- सागरसे शीघ्र ही उद्धार कर देती हुँ। गिरिश्रेष्ठ! मैं ध्यान, कर्मयोग, भक्ति तथा ज्ञानके द्वारा ही तुम्हारे लिये प्राप्य हूँ, दूसरे करोड़ों कर्मोके द्वारा मुझे प्राप्त नहीं किया
verses.wordMeaning: Then the god with matted hair, the chastiser of Kama, replied, "I don't have such creation. You create such various types of creation." {v.l. Such inauspicious progeny).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the god with matted hair, the chastiser of Kama, replied, "I don't have such creation. You create such various types of creation." {v.l. Such inauspicious progeny).

verses.sanskrit: ख्यातिः प्रज्ञा चितिः संवित् महाभोगीन्द्रशायिनी । विकृतिः शांसरी शास्त्री गणगन्धर्वसेविता
verses.transliteration: khyātiḥ prajñā citiḥ saṃvit mahābhogīndraśāyinī / vikṛtiḥ śāṃsarī śāstrī gaṇagandharvasevitā
verses.translation: Thereafter, this God does not create auspicious progeny. He remains with his mind withdrawn from activi¬ ties of procreation, and stays with his own sons.
verses.hindi: जा सकता। श्रुति तथा स्मृति-शास्त्रोंमें जो सम्यक् वर्णाश्रमकर्म (धर्म) बतलाया गया है, मुक्ति-प्राप्तिके लिये अध्यात्मज्ञानयुक्त उस (कर्म)-का निरन्तर आचरण करो। धर्मसे भक्ति उत्पन्न होती है और भक्तिसे परम (तत्त्व) प्राप्त होता है। श्रुति एवं स्मृतिद्वारा प्रतिपादित यज्ञादि कर्मको धर्म कहा गया है
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, this God does not create auspicious progeny. He remains with his mind withdrawn from activi¬ ties of procreation, and stays with his own sons.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, this God does not create auspicious progeny. He remains with his mind withdrawn from activi¬ ties of procreation, and stays with his own sons.

verses.sanskrit: वैश्वानरी महाशाला देवसेना गुहप्रिया । महारात्रिः शिवानन्दा शची दुः स्वप्ननाशिनी
verses.transliteration: vaiśvānarī mahāśālā devasenā guhapriyā / mahārātriḥ śivānandā śacī duḥ svapnanāśinī
verses.translation: Bow to god Siva. Obeisance to you, the embodi¬ ment of Brahman, to Lord Mahesa, to the quiescent, to the cause of the universe.
verses.hindi: नान्यतो जायते धर्मो वेदाद् धर्मो हि निर्बभौ। तस्मान्मुमुक्षुर्धर्माथी मद्रूपं वेदमाश्रयेत् तेषामेव च गुप्त्यर्थं वेदानां भगवानजः । ब्राह्मणादीन् ससर्जाथ स्वे स्वे कर्मण्ययोजयत्
verses.wordMeaning: Bow to god Siva. Obeisance to you, the embodi¬ ment of Brahman, to Lord Mahesa, to the quiescent, to the cause of the universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bow to god Siva. Obeisance to you, the embodi¬ ment of Brahman, to Lord Mahesa, to the quiescent, to the cause of the universe.

verses.sanskrit: इज्या पूज्या जगद्धात्री दुर्विज्ञेया सुरूपिणी । गुहाम्बिका गुणोत्पत्तिर्महापीठा मरुत्सुता
verses.transliteration: ijyā pūjyā jagaddhātrī durvijñeyā surūpiṇī / guhāmbikā guṇotpattirmahāpīṭhā marutsutā
verses.translation: Salutations to the Lord of Prakrti and Purusa, to the chief of Yoga, to Kala (time or god of death), to Rudra, to the bearer of the trident and to one making a huge mouthful of the universe.
verses.hindi: ये न कुर्वन्ति तद् धर्म तदर्थ ब्रह्मनिर्मितम्। तेषामधस्तान्नरकांस्तामिस्त्रादीनकल्पयत न च वेदाद् ऋते किञ्जिच्छास्त्रधर्माभिधायकम्। योऽन्यत्र रमते सोऽसौ न सम्भाष्यो द्विजातिभिः
verses.wordMeaning: Salutations to the Lord of Prakrti and Purusa, to the chief of Yoga, to Kala (time or god of death), to Rudra, to the bearer of the trident and to one making a huge mouthful of the universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: Salutations to the Lord of Prakrti and Purusa, to the chief of Yoga, to Kala (time or god of death), to Rudra, to the bearer of the trident and to one making a huge mouthful of the universe.

verses.sanskrit: हव्यवाहान्तरागादिः हव्यवाहसमुद्भवा । जगद्योनिर्जगन्माता जन्ममृत्युजरातिगा
verses.transliteration: havyavāhāntarāgādiḥ havyavāhasamudbhavā / jagadyonirjaganmātā janmamṛtyujarātigā
verses.translation: Obeisance to the wielder of Pinaka bow in the hand. Salutations again and again to the three-eyed god with three¬ fold forms. Bow to you Brahman, the father of god Brahma.
verses.hindi: यानि शास्त्राणि दृश्यन्ते लोकेऽस्मिन् विविधानि तु । श्रुतिस्मृतिविरुद्धानि निष्ठा तेषां हि तामसी कापालं पञ्चरात्रं च यामलं वाममार्हतम्। एवंविधानि चान्यानि मोहनार्थानि तानि तु
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the wielder of Pinaka bow in the hand. Salutations again and again to the three-eyed god with three¬ fold forms. Bow to you Brahman, the father of god Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the wielder of Pinaka bow in the hand. Salutations again and again to the three-eyed god with three¬ fold forms. Bow to you Brahman, the father of god Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: बुद्धिमाता बुद्धिमती पुरुषान्तरवासिनी । तरस्विनी समाधिस्था त्रिनेत्रा दिविसंस्थिता
verses.transliteration: buddhimātā buddhimatī puruṣāntaravāsinī / tarasvinī samādhisthā trinetrā divisaṃsthitā
verses.translation: Obeisance to the master of the knowledge of Brah¬ man and to one imparter of the knowledge of Brahman. Salu¬ tation to the secret of the Vedas (or the knower of the secret of the Vedas) and to the destroyer of Kala.
verses.hindi: वेदार्थवित्तमैः कार्य यत् स्मृतं कर्म वैदिकम्। तत् प्रयत्नेन कुर्वन्ति मत्तप्रियास्ते हि ये नरा: स्वायम्भुवो मनुर्धर्मान् मुनीनां पूर्वमुक्तवान्
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the master of the knowledge of Brah¬ man and to one imparter of the knowledge of Brahman. Salu¬ tation to the secret of the Vedas (or the knower of the secret of the Vedas) and to the destroyer of Kala.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the master of the knowledge of Brah¬ man and to one imparter of the knowledge of Brahman. Salu¬ tation to the secret of the Vedas (or the knower of the secret of the Vedas) and to the destroyer of Kala.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेन्द्रियमनोमाता सर्वभूतहृदि स्थिता । संसारतारिणी विद्या ब्रह्मवादिमनोलया
verses.transliteration: sarvendriyamanomātā sarvabhūtahṛdi sthitā / saṃsāratāriṇī vidyā brahmavādimanolayā
verses.translation: Obeisance to the essential substance of Vedanta, to the embodiment of Vedas [v.l. the Vedanta incarnate.) Bow to the enlightened Rudra, the preceptor ofYogins.
verses.hindi: शरुत्वा चान्येऽपि मुनयस्तन्मुखाद् धर्ममुत्तमम्। चक्रुर्धर्मप्रतिष्ठार्थं धर्मशास्त्राणि चैव हि ब्रह्मणो वचनात् तानि करिष्यन्ति युगे युगे
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the essential substance of Vedanta, to the embodiment of Vedas [v.l. the Vedanta incarnate.) Bow to the enlightened Rudra, the preceptor ofYogins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the essential substance of Vedanta, to the embodiment of Vedas [v.l. the Vedanta incarnate.) Bow to the enlightened Rudra, the preceptor ofYogins.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्माणी बृहती ब्राह्मी ब्रह्मभूता भवारणिः । हिरण्मयी महारात्रिः संसारपरिवर्तिका
verses.transliteration: brahmāṇī bṛhatī brāhmī brahmabhūtā bhavāraṇiḥ / hiraṇmayī mahārātriḥ saṃsāraparivartikā
verses.translation: Obeisance to you who are surrounded by goblins, or beings of various kinds, devoid of sorrows. Salutations to the deity favourable to Brahmanas and to the lord of Brahma.
verses.hindi: अष्टादश पुराणानि व्यासेन कथितानि तु। नियोगाद् ब्रह्मणो राजंस्तेषु धर्मः प्रतिष्ठित: २७९॥ अन्यान्युपपुराणानि तच्छिष्यैः कथितानि तु। युगे युगेऽत्र सर्वेषां कर्ता वै धर्मशास्त्रवित्
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you who are surrounded by goblins, or beings of various kinds, devoid of sorrows. Salutations to the deity favourable to Brahmanas and to the lord of Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you who are surrounded by goblins, or beings of various kinds, devoid of sorrows. Salutations to the deity favourable to Brahmanas and to the lord of Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: सुमालिनी सुरूपा च भाविनी तारिणी प्रभा । उन्मीलनी सर्वसहा सर्वप्रत्ययसाक्षिणी
verses.transliteration: sumālinī surūpā ca bhāvinī tāriṇī prabhā / unmīlanī sarvasahā sarvapratyayasākṣiṇī
verses.translation: Obeisance to the three-eyed primordial deity, to Paramefthin, the quarter-clad (naked), to the staff-bearing recluse.
verses.hindi: शिक्षा कल्पो व्याकरणं निरुक्तं छन्द एव च। ज्योतिःशास्त्रं न्यायविद्या मीमांसा चोपबृंहणम् धर्म किसी अन्यसे उत्पन्न नहीं होता, वेदसे ही धर्म निर्गत है। इसलिये धर्मार्थी एवं मुमुक्षुको चाहिए कि मेरे स्वरूपभूत वेदका आश्रय ग्रहण करे। मेरी ही यह 'वेद' नामवाली पुरातन परा शक्ति ऋक्, यजुष् तथा सामवेदके
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the three-eyed primordial deity, to Paramefthin, the quarter-clad (naked), to the staff-bearing recluse.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the three-eyed primordial deity, to Paramefthin, the quarter-clad (naked), to the staff-bearing recluse.

verses.sanskrit: सुसौम्या चन्द्रवदना ताण्डवासक्तमानसा । सत्त्वशुद्धिकरी शुद्धिर्मलत्रयविनाशिनी
verses.transliteration: susaumyā candravadanā tāṇḍavāsaktamānasā / sattvaśuddhikarī śuddhirmalatrayavināśinī
verses.translation: Salutations to you untouched by the beginning-less impurity of Avidya, to one knowable through perfect enlighten¬ ment. Bow to the saviour, the sanctifier, to the cause of the progress of Yoga.
verses.hindi: रूपमें सृष्टिके आदिमें प्रवर्तित होती है उन्हीं वेदोंकी रक्षाके लिये भगवान् ब्रह्माने ब्राह्मणादिको उत्पन्न कर अपने-अपने कर्मोमें लगाया। ब्रह्माद्वारा बनाये गये उस (वेदविहित वर्णाश्रम) धर्मका जो पालन नहीं करते हैं, उनके लिये (ब्रह्माने) नीचेके लोकोंमें
verses.wordMeaning: Salutations to you untouched by the beginning-less impurity of Avidya, to one knowable through perfect enlighten¬ ment. Bow to the saviour, the sanctifier, to the cause of the progress of Yoga.
verses.commentary: Sense: Salutations to you untouched by the beginning-less impurity of Avidya, to one knowable through perfect enlighten¬ ment. Bow to the saviour, the sanctifier, to the cause of the progress of Yoga.

verses.sanskrit: जगत्प्रिया जगन्मूर्तिस्त्रिमूर्तिरमृताश्रया । निराश्रया निराहारा निरङ्कुरवनोद्भवा
verses.transliteration: jagatpriyā jaganmūrtistrimūrtiramṛtāśrayā / nirāśrayā nirāhārā niraṅkuravanodbhavā
verses.translation: Salutations to one knowable through Dharma (Piety) etc. Obeisance to you approachable through Yogic
verses.hindi: स्थित तामिस्र आदि नरकाँको बनाया है। धर्मका विधान करनेवाले अथवा धर्मको बतलानेवाले वेदको छोड़कर और अन्य कोई शास्त्र नहीं हँ । जो (वेदाभ्यासके अतिरिक्त) अन्यत्र मन लगाते हैं, द्विजातियोंके द्वारा वे सम्भाषण करने योग्य नहीं हैं। इस संसारमें श्रुति एवं स्मृतिके विरुद्ध जो विविध शास्त्र देखे जाते हैं, निश्चय ही उनमें निष्ठा (विश्वास) रखना तमोगुणी (निष्ठा) है। जो कुत्सित शास्त्रोंके प्रभावको बतलाकर मनुष्योंको मोहित
verses.wordMeaning: Salutations to one knowable through Dharma (Piety) etc. Obeisance to you approachable through Yogic
verses.commentary: Sense: Salutations to one knowable through Dharma (Piety) etc. Obeisance to you approachable through Yogic

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्रहस्ता विचित्राङ्गी स्त्रग्विणी पद्मधारिणी । परावरविधानज्ञा महापुरुषपूर्वजा
verses.transliteration: candrahastā vicitrāṅgī stragviṇī padmadhāriṇī / parāvaravidhānajñā mahāpuruṣapūrvajā
verses.translation: Obeisance to Brahman, the embodiment of the uni¬ verse, to you the supreme Atman. Everything in the universe has been created by you alone and everything abides in you only.
verses.hindi: करते हैं, इस संसारमें उन लोगोंको मोहित करनेके लिये मैंने (ऐसे) शास्त्रोंको बनाया है॥ २६९--२७४॥ वेदके अर्थको जाननेबाले श्रेष्ठ विद्वानोंके द्वारा जिस कर्मको वेदसम्मत कहा गया है वही (कर्म) करणीय है और जो मनुष्य प्रयत्नपूर्वक उस कर्मको करते हैं, वे मुझे प्रिय हैं। प्राचीन कालमें विराट् (पुरुष) स्वायम्भुव
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to Brahman, the embodiment of the uni¬ verse, to you the supreme Atman. Everything in the universe has been created by you alone and everything abides in you only.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to Brahman, the embodiment of the uni¬ verse, to you the supreme Atman. Everything in the universe has been created by you alone and everything abides in you only.

verses.sanskrit: विद्येश्वरप्रिया विद्या विद्युज्जिह्वा जितश्रमा । विद्यामयी सहस्त्राक्षी सहस्त्रवदनात्मजा
verses.transliteration: vidyeśvarapriyā vidyā vidyujjihvā jitaśramā / vidyāmayī sahastrākṣī sahastravadanātmajā
verses.translation: O deity identical with the universe, the universe beginning -wixhPrakrti is withdrawn by you. You are the control¬ ler (of the world), the great god, the Supreme Brahman, the great Ruler of the world.
verses.hindi: मनुने सभी वर्णोपर अनुग्रह करनेके लिये मेरी ही आज्ञासे (भृगु आदि) मुनियोंसे धर्म (मनुस्मृति) कहा था। उनके मुखसे श्रेष्ठ धर्मका श्रवणकर अन्य मुनियोंने भी धर्मको प्रतिष्ठाके लिये अन्य धर्मशास्त्रों (स्मृतियों)- की रचना की । प्रलयकालमें उनके ( धर्मशास्त्रोंके) अन्तर्हित हो जानेपर प्रत्येक युगमें वे महर्षिगण ब्रह्माके कहनेपर पुनः उन शास्त्रोंकी रचना करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: O deity identical with the universe, the universe beginning -wixhPrakrti is withdrawn by you. You are the control¬ ler (of the world), the great god, the Supreme Brahman, the great Ruler of the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: O deity identical with the universe, the universe beginning -wixhPrakrti is withdrawn by you. You are the control¬ ler (of the world), the great god, the Supreme Brahman, the great Ruler of the world.

verses.sanskrit: सहस्त्ररश्मिः सत्त्वस्था महेश्वरपदाश्रया । क्षालिनी सन्मयी व्याप्ता तैजसी पद्मबोधिका
verses.transliteration: sahastraraśmiḥ sattvasthā maheśvarapadāśrayā / kṣālinī sanmayī vyāptā taijasī padmabodhikā
verses.translation: You are the Paramesthin, the auspicious, the quiesc¬ ent, the perfect being, Hara. You are the great imperishable spiritual light, you are Kdla and Paramesvara.
verses.hindi: राजन्! ब्रह्माके आदेशसे व्यासजीने अठारह (महा-) पुराणोंको कहा है। उन (पुराणों)-में धर्म प्रतिष्ठित है। अन्य उपपुराण उन व्यासजीके शिष्योंद्ार कहे गये हैं। यहाँ प्रत्येक युगमें इन सभी शास्त्रोंका कर्ता ही धर्मशास्त्रका ज्ञाता होता है। सत्तम! चार वेदोंसहित शिक्षा, कल्प, व्याकरण, निरुक्त, छन्द,
verses.wordMeaning: You are the Paramesthin, the auspicious, the quiesc¬ ent, the perfect being, Hara. You are the great imperishable spiritual light, you are Kdla and Paramesvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are the Paramesthin, the auspicious, the quiesc¬ ent, the perfect being, Hara. You are the great imperishable spiritual light, you are Kdla and Paramesvara.

verses.sanskrit: महामायाश्रया मान्या महादेवमनोरमा । व्योमलक्ष्मीः सिहरथा चेकितानामितप्रभा
verses.transliteration: mahāmāyāśrayā mānyā mahādevamanoramā / vyomalakṣmīḥ siharathā cekitānāmitaprabhā
verses.translation: You alone are the inflnite person, the Pradhana and the Prakrli as well. You are the earth, the waters, the Are, the wind, the ether and the ego.
verses.hindi: और पुराण) ॥ २७९--२८१॥ चतुर्वेहैः सहोक्तानि धर्मो नान्यत्र विद्यते
verses.wordMeaning: You alone are the inflnite person, the Pradhana and the Prakrli as well. You are the earth, the waters, the Are, the wind, the ether and the ego.
verses.commentary: Sense: You alone are the inflnite person, the Pradhana and the Prakrli as well. You are the earth, the waters, the Are, the wind, the ether and the ego.

verses.sanskrit: वीरेश्वरी विमानस्था विशोकाशोकनाशिनी । अनाहता कुण्डलिना नलिनी पद्मवासिनी
verses.transliteration: vīreśvarī vimānasthā viśokāśokanāśinī / anāhatā kuṇḍalinā nalinī padmavāsinī
verses.translation: Obeisance to him, the embodiment of waters whose tresses contained the clouds and in whose limb joints are the rivers and in whose belly are the four oceans.
verses.hindi: एवं पैतामहं धर्म मनुव्यासादयः परम्। स्थापयन्ति ममादेशाद् यावदाभूतसम्प्लवम् ब्रह्मणा सह ते सर्वे सम्प्रासे प्रतिसंचरे । परस्यान्ते कृतात्मानः प्रविशन्ति परं पदम्
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to him, the embodiment of waters whose tresses contained the clouds and in whose limb joints are the rivers and in whose belly are the four oceans.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to him, the embodiment of waters whose tresses contained the clouds and in whose limb joints are the rivers and in whose belly are the four oceans.

verses.sanskrit: सदानन्दा सदाकीर्तिः सर्वभूताश्रयस्थिता । वाग्देवता ब्रह्मकला कलातीता कलारणिः
verses.transliteration: sadānandā sadākīrtiḥ sarvabhūtāśrayasthitā / vāgdevatā brahmakalā kalātītā kalāraṇiḥ
verses.translation: Though I am the perfect Supreme Ruler, I have divided myself unto three with the attributes (i.e. functions) of creation, protection and annihilation. You are my eldest son created for the purpose of carrying on the activity of creation.
verses.hindi: तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन धर्मार्थ वेदमाश्रयेत्। धर्मेण सहितं ज्ञानं परं ब्रह्म प्रकाशयेत् संन्यासिनो गृहस्थाश्च वनस्था ब्रह्मचारिणः
verses.wordMeaning: Though I am the perfect Supreme Ruler, I have divided myself unto three with the attributes (i.e. functions) of creation, protection and annihilation. You are my eldest son created for the purpose of carrying on the activity of creation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Though I am the perfect Supreme Ruler, I have divided myself unto three with the attributes (i.e. functions) of creation, protection and annihilation. You are my eldest son created for the purpose of carrying on the activity of creation.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मश्रीर्ब्रह्महृदया ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवप्रिया । व्योमशक्तिः क्रियाशक्तिर्ज्ञानशक्तिः परागतिः
verses.transliteration: brahmaśrīrbrahmahṛdayā brahmaviṣṇuśivapriyā / vyomaśaktiḥ kriyāśaktirjñānaśaktiḥ parāgatiḥ
verses.translation: Though Sankara stays as the absolute one, it is out of his own will that he had divided himself. I have other forms as well effected by my Maya.
verses.hindi: ते सुनिर्धूततमसो ज्ञानेनैकेन मन्मयाः। सदानन्दास्तु संसारे न जायन्ते पुनः पुन: तस्मात् सर्वप्रकारेण मद्भक्तो मत्परायणः । मामेवार्चय सर्वत्र मेनया सह संगतः
verses.wordMeaning: Though Sankara stays as the absolute one, it is out of his own will that he had divided himself. I have other forms as well effected by my Maya.
verses.commentary: Sense: Though Sankara stays as the absolute one, it is out of his own will that he had divided himself. I have other forms as well effected by my Maya.

verses.sanskrit: क्षोभिका बन्धिका भेद्या भेदाभेदविवर्जिता । अभिन्नाभिन्नसंस्थाना वंशिनी वंशहारिणी
verses.transliteration: kṣobhikā bandhikā bhedyā bhedābhedavivarjitā / abhinnābhinnasaṃsthānā vaṃśinī vaṃśahāriṇī
verses.translation: By nature, the great God Siva is formless, absolute, abiding in his own state or soul. The god who is transcendental to these is the Tri-murti, the triple-formed one, which is the Supreme Person of the Lord.
verses.hindi: ततो मे सकलं रूपं कालाद्यं शरणं व्रज यत्तु मे निष्कलं रूपं चिन्मात्रं केवलं शिवम्। सर्वोपाधिविनिर्मुक्तमनन्तममृतं परम्
verses.wordMeaning: By nature, the great God Siva is formless, absolute, abiding in his own state or soul. The god who is transcendental to these is the Tri-murti, the triple-formed one, which is the Supreme Person of the Lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: By nature, the great God Siva is formless, absolute, abiding in his own state or soul. The god who is transcendental to these is the Tri-murti, the triple-formed one, which is the Supreme Person of the Lord.

verses.sanskrit: गुह्यशक्तिर्गुणातीता सर्वदा सर्वतोमुखी । भगिनी भगवत्पत्नी सकला कालकारिणी
verses.transliteration: guhyaśaktirguṇātītā sarvadā sarvatomukhī / bhaginī bhagavatpatnī sakalā kālakāriṇī
verses.translation: O grand-sire of the world, know me to be that great form, that special personality of Mahesvara with three eyes which always bestow peace unto the Yogins.
verses.hindi: ज्ञानेनैकेन तल्लभ्यं क्लेशेन परमं पदम्। ज्ञानमेव प्रपश्यन्तो मामेव प्रविशन्ति ते इस प्रकार ये चौदह विद्यास्थान कहे गये हैं। इनके अतिरिक्त अन्यत्र धर्म विद्यमान नहीं है
verses.wordMeaning: O grand-sire of the world, know me to be that great form, that special personality of Mahesvara with three eyes which always bestow peace unto the Yogins.
verses.commentary: Sense: O grand-sire of the world, know me to be that great form, that special personality of Mahesvara with three eyes which always bestow peace unto the Yogins.

verses.sanskrit: सर्ववित् सर्वतोभद्रा गुह्यातीता गुहारणिः । प्रक्रिया योगमाता च गङ्गा विश्वेश्वरेश्वरी
verses.transliteration: sarvavit sarvatobhadrā guhyātītā guhāraṇiḥ / prakriyā yogamātā ca gaṅgā viśveśvareśvarī
verses.translation: I have already narrated to you the resolution {san- kalpa), Dharma, various duties special to different Yugas and the deities identifying themselves with the abodes ( sthdnas).
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार मनु, व्यास आदि पितामह ब्रह्माके द्वारा निर्दिष्ट श्रेष्ठ धर्मको मेरे ही आदेशसे प्रलयकालपर्यन्त स्थापित करते हैं । ब्रह्माकी आयु पूर्ण हो जानेपर प्रलय- काल उपस्थित होनेपर वे सभी पुण्यात्मा (व्यासादि) ब्रह्माके साथ ही परम पदमें प्रवेश करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: I have already narrated to you the resolution {san- kalpa), Dharma, various duties special to different Yugas and the deities identifying themselves with the abodes ( sthdnas).
verses.commentary: Sense: I have already narrated to you the resolution {san- kalpa), Dharma, various duties special to different Yugas and the deities identifying themselves with the abodes ( sthdnas).

verses.sanskrit: कपिला कापिला कान्ताकनकाभाकलान्तरा । पुण्या पुष्करिणी भोक्त्री पुरन्दरपुरस्सरा
verses.transliteration: kapilā kāpilā kāntākanakābhākalāntarā / puṇyā puṣkariṇī bhoktrī purandarapurassarā
verses.translation: The same is Supra 2.23b-25a.
verses.hindi: इसलिये धर्मके (परिज्ञानके) लिये सभी प्रकारके प्रयत्नसे वेदका आश्रय ग्रहण करना चाहिए, (इससे) धर्मसहित ज्ञान और परम ब्रह्म प्रकाशित हो जाता है जो सभी प्रकारको आसक्तियोंका परित्याग कर अनन्यभावसे मेरी शरण ग्रहण कर लेते हैं, ईश्वर- सम्बन्धी योगमें स्थित होकर भक्तिपूर्वक सदा मेरी उपासना करते हैं, सभी प्राणियोंपर दया करते हैं, शान्त,
verses.wordMeaning: The same is Supra 2.23b-25a.
verses.commentary: Sense: The same is Supra 2.23b-25a.

verses.sanskrit: पोषणी परमैश्वर्यभूतिदा भूतिभूषणा । पञ्चब्रह्मसमुत्पत्तिः परमार्थार्थविग्रहा
verses.transliteration: poṣaṇī paramaiśvaryabhūtidā bhūtibhūṣaṇā / pañcabrahmasamutpattiḥ paramārthārthavigrahā
verses.translation: Even as he was performing the penance, the three¬ eyed, trident-bearing Isana, Rudra, born of the world-destruc¬ tive fire, manifested himself from his mouth.
verses.hindi: तथा व्रतपरायण हैं, मुझमें जिनका चित्त और प्राण लगा हुआ है, मेरे तत्त्व-वर्णनमें ही जो लगे हुए हैं ऐसे संन्यासी, गृहस्थ, वानप्रस्थ अथवा ब्रह्मचारी जो कोई भी हों, उन नित्य भक्तिमें लगे हुए भक्तोंके माया-तत्त्वसे उत्पन्न सम्पूर्ण अन्धकारका ज्ञानरूपी दीपकके द्वारा मैं अविलम्ब ही विनाश कर देती हूँ। अद्वितीय ज्ञानके द्वारा जिनके अन्धकारका भलीभाँति विनाश हो गया है ऐसे ही मत्परायण (भक्त) सदा आनन्दित रहते हैं और
verses.wordMeaning: Even as he was performing the penance, the three¬ eyed, trident-bearing Isana, Rudra, born of the world-destruc¬ tive fire, manifested himself from his mouth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even as he was performing the penance, the three¬ eyed, trident-bearing Isana, Rudra, born of the world-destruc¬ tive fire, manifested himself from his mouth.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मोदया भानुमती योगिज्ञेय मनोजवा । मनोहरा मनोरक्षा तापसी वेदरूपिणी
verses.transliteration: dharmodayā bhānumatī yogijñeya manojavā / manoharā manorakṣā tāpasī vedarūpiṇī
verses.translation: His body was half-male and half-female and was too terrible to behold. "Divide yourself," saying this Brahma vanished out of fear.
verses.hindi: संसारमें बार-बार जन्म नहीं लेते इसलिये सब प्रकारसे मेरे भक्त और मेरे परायण रहते हुए (तुम) मेनाके साथ सर्वत्र मेरी ही अर्चना करो। यदि तुम मेरे ऐश्वर्यसम्पन्न अव्यय-स्वरूपका ध्यान करनेमें असमर्थ हो तो मेरे आदिकालस्वरूप
verses.wordMeaning: His body was half-male and half-female and was too terrible to behold. "Divide yourself," saying this Brahma vanished out of fear.
verses.commentary: Sense: His body was half-male and half-female and was too terrible to behold. "Divide yourself," saying this Brahma vanished out of fear.

verses.sanskrit: वेदशक्तिर्वेदमाता वेदविद्याप्रकाशिनी । योगेश्वरेश्वरी माता महाशक्तिर्मनोमयी
verses.transliteration: vedaśaktirvedamātā vedavidyāprakāśinī / yogeśvareśvarī mātā mahāśaktirmanomayī
verses.translation: When addressed thus, Rudra separated the male being into ten plus one (eleven) forms.
verses.hindi: कलात्मक रूपकी शरण ग्रहण करो। तात! मेरा जो- जो भी रूप आपके मनको अभीष्ट हो, उसीमें निष्ठा रखो और उसीके परायण होकर उसकी ही आराधनामें संलग्न रहो मेरा जो कलारहित, चिन्मात्र, अद्वितीय, कल्याणकारी, सभी उपाधियोंसे सर्वथा मुक्त, अनन्त, अमर एवं परमरूप है, वह परमपद एकमात्र ज्ञानके द्वारा बड़े ही कष्टसे प्राप्त किया जाता है । ज्ञानका साक्षात्कार करनेवाले
verses.wordMeaning: When addressed thus, Rudra separated the male being into ten plus one (eleven) forms.
verses.commentary: Sense: When addressed thus, Rudra separated the male being into ten plus one (eleven) forms.

verses.sanskrit: विश्वावस्था वियन्मूर्तिर्विद्युन्माला विहायसी । किंनरी सुरभी वन्द्या नन्दिनी नन्दिवल्लभा
verses.transliteration: viśvāvasthā viyanmūrtirvidyunmālā vihāyasī / kiṃnarī surabhī vandyā nandinī nandivallabhā
verses.translation: These eleven are called Rudras. They are the Lords of the three worlds. O Brahmanas, these Rudras, known as Kapalisa and others, were entrusted with the affairs ofDevas.
verses.hindi: लोग मुझमें ही प्रवेश करते हैं मामनाश्रित्य तत् तत्त्वं स्वभावविमलं शिवम् । ज्ञायते न हि राजेन्द्र ततो मां शरणं व्रज
verses.wordMeaning: These eleven are called Rudras. They are the Lords of the three worlds. O Brahmanas, these Rudras, known as Kapalisa and others, were entrusted with the affairs ofDevas.
verses.commentary: Sense: These eleven are called Rudras. They are the Lords of the three worlds. O Brahmanas, these Rudras, known as Kapalisa and others, were entrusted with the affairs ofDevas.

verses.sanskrit: भारती परमानन्दा परापरविभेदिका । सर्वप्रहरणोपेता काम्या कामेश्वरेश्वरी
verses.transliteration: bhāratī paramānandā parāparavibhedikā / sarvapraharaṇopetā kāmyā kāmeśvareśvarī
verses.translation: The Lord divided his female form too into many beings, such as beautiful and ugly, quiet and turbulent, white and black in complexion etc.
verses.hindi: कर्मणा मनसा वाचा शिवं सर्वत्र सर्वदा । समाराधय भावेन ततो यास्यसि तत्पदम् अनाद्यनन्तं परमं महेश्वरमजं शिवम्
verses.wordMeaning: The Lord divided his female form too into many beings, such as beautiful and ugly, quiet and turbulent, white and black in complexion etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Lord divided his female form too into many beings, such as beautiful and ugly, quiet and turbulent, white and black in complexion etc.

verses.sanskrit: अचिन्त्याचिन्त्यविभवा हृल्लेखा कनकप्रभा । कूष्माण्डी धनरत्नाढ्या सुगन्धा गन्धायिनी
verses.transliteration: acintyācintyavibhavā hṛllekhā kanakaprabhā / kūṣmāṇḍī dhanaratnāḍhyā sugandhā gandhāyinī
verses.translation: Those forms, Laksmi and others are the Vibhutis (magnificent excellences) and well-known as Saktis (super¬ human powers) on the earth, O Brahmanas, Goddess Sahkari pervades the whole universe through their forms.
verses.hindi: अह्वैतमचलं ब्रह्म निष्कलं निष्प्रपञ्चकम्। अन्वेष्टव्यं हि तद् ब्रह्म जन्मबन्धनिवृत्तये
verses.wordMeaning: Those forms, Laksmi and others are the Vibhutis (magnificent excellences) and well-known as Saktis (super¬ human powers) on the earth, O Brahmanas, Goddess Sahkari pervades the whole universe through their forms.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those forms, Laksmi and others are the Vibhutis (magnificent excellences) and well-known as Saktis (super¬ human powers) on the earth, O Brahmanas, Goddess Sahkari pervades the whole universe through their forms.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिविक्रमपदोद्भूता धनुष्पाणिः शिवोदया । सुदुर्लभा धनाद्यक्षा धन्या पिङ्गललोचना
verses.transliteration: trivikramapadodbhūtā dhanuṣpāṇiḥ śivodayā / sudurlabhā dhanādyakṣā dhanyā piṅgalalocanā
verses.translation: O Brahmanas, Isani split herself into many more forms {v.l. separated herself from god Siva). At the behest of the great god Sankara, she went and stood near god Brahma, the grand-sire.
verses.hindi: अहंकारं च मात्सर्य कामं क्रोधं परिग्रहम्। अधर्माभिनिवेशं च त्यक्त्वा वैराग्यमास्थितः अन्वीक्ष्य चात्मनात्मानं ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas, Isani split herself into many more forms {v.l. separated herself from god Siva). At the behest of the great god Sankara, she went and stood near god Brahma, the grand-sire.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas, Isani split herself into many more forms {v.l. separated herself from god Siva). At the behest of the great god Sankara, she went and stood near god Brahma, the grand-sire.

verses.sanskrit: शान्तिः प्रभावती दीप्तिः पङ्कजायतलोचना । आद्या हृत्कमलोद्भूता गवां मता रणप्रिया
verses.transliteration: śāntiḥ prabhāvatī dīptiḥ paṅkajāyatalocanā / ādyā hṛtkamalodbhūtā gavāṃ matā raṇapriyā
verses.translation: Lord Brahma told her, "Become the daughter of Daksa." At his behest, she too manifested herself from Daksa, the progenitor of the world.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मभूतः प्रसन्नात्मा सर्वभूताभयप्रदः । ऐश्वरी परमां भक्ति विन्देतानन्यगामिनीम् वीक्षते तत् परं तत्त्वमैश्वरं ब्रह्मनिष्कलम्। सर्वसंसारनिर्मुक्तो ब्रह्मण्येवावतिष्ठते
verses.wordMeaning: Lord Brahma told her, "Become the daughter of Daksa." At his behest, she too manifested herself from Daksa, the progenitor of the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Brahma told her, "Become the daughter of Daksa." At his behest, she too manifested herself from Daksa, the progenitor of the world.

verses.sanskrit: सत्क्रिया गिरिजा शुद्धा नित्यपुष्टा निरन्तरा । दुर्गाकात्यायनीचण्डी चर्चिका शान्तविग्रहा
verses.transliteration: satkriyā girijā śuddhā nityapuṣṭā nirantarā / durgākātyāyanīcaṇḍī carcikā śāntavigrahā
verses.translation: He gave goddess Sati (former Isani) to Rudra in marriage, at the bidding of god Brahma. Rudra the trident¬ bearing deity too accepted the daughter of Daksa who was his own.
verses.hindi: उसीमें (मेरे दिव्य रूपमें) बुद्धि रखनेवाले, उसीमें अपनेको लगानेवाले, उसीमें निष्ठा रखनेवाले तथा उसीके परायण और ज्ञानके द्वारा जिनके समस्त पाप विनष्ट हो गये हैं, वे सभी आवागमनके चक्रमें नहीं पड़ते अर्थात् मोक्षको प्राप्त करते हैं। राजेन्द्र ! मेरी शरण ग्रहण किये बिना परम निर्वाण,निर्मल पद प्राप्त नहीं होता, इसलिये मेरी शरण ग्रहण करो। महाराज! द्वैत या अद्वैत अथवा दोनों ही रूपोंसे मेरी उपासना कर तुम्हें
verses.wordMeaning: He gave goddess Sati (former Isani) to Rudra in marriage, at the bidding of god Brahma. Rudra the trident¬ bearing deity too accepted the daughter of Daksa who was his own.
verses.commentary: Sense: He gave goddess Sati (former Isani) to Rudra in marriage, at the bidding of god Brahma. Rudra the trident¬ bearing deity too accepted the daughter of Daksa who was his own.

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्यवर्णा रजनी जगद्यन्त्रप्रवर्तिका । मन्दराद्रिनिवासा च शारदा स्वर्णमालिनी
verses.transliteration: hiraṇyavarṇā rajanī jagadyantrapravartikā / mandarādrinivāsā ca śāradā svarṇamālinī
verses.translation: Although Mimdmsd is given as a v.l. for Sarvesam, the term Upabrrhharta can be taken as including both Purarta and Mlmamsa to make up the number fourteen of Vidyds.
verses.hindi: उस पदको प्राप्ति हो जायगी ॥ २९६--२९८ ॥ हे राजेन्द्र! बिना मेरा आश्रय लिये स्वभावसे ही निर्मल, उस शिवतत्त्वको जाना नहीं जा सकता, अत; मेरी शरण ग्रहण करो। इसलिये. तुम नित्य, अक्षरस्वरूप एवं रूपरहित ईश्वर (तत्त्व)-की प्रयलपूर्वक आराधना
verses.wordMeaning: Although Mimdmsd is given as a v.l. for Sarvesam, the term Upabrrhharta can be taken as including both Purarta and Mlmamsa to make up the number fourteen of Vidyds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Although Mimdmsd is given as a v.l. for Sarvesam, the term Upabrrhharta can be taken as including both Purarta and Mlmamsa to make up the number fourteen of Vidyds.

verses.sanskrit: रत्नमाला रत्नगर्भा पृथ्वी विश्वप्रमाथिनी । पद्मानना पद्मनिभा नित्यतुष्टामृतोद्भवा
verses.transliteration: ratnamālā ratnagarbhā pṛthvī viśvapramāthinī / padmānanā padmanibhā nityatuṣṭāmṛtodbhavā
verses.translation: KP's list of fourteen vidyds is: 4 Vedas, 6 Ahgas, Dharma- Sastra, Purana, Nyaya, Mimarhsa. The fourteen lores are enumerated in VP. III.6.28 as follows:
verses.hindi: करो। इससे (तुम) बन्धनसे मुक्त हो जाओगे। मन, वाणी तथा कर्मसे बड़े ही भावसे सर्वत्र शिवकी आराधना करो, इससे (तुम) उस पदको प्राप्त करोगे। मेरी मायासे मोहित (प्राणी) उस अनादि, अनन्त, अजन्मा, कल्याणकारी, परम महेश्वर, सभी प्राणियोंके अन्तरमें निवास करनेवाले, सभीके आधार, निरञ्जन, नित्य आनन्दस्वरूप, निराभास, निर्गुण, अन्धकारसे परे,
verses.wordMeaning: KP's list of fourteen vidyds is: 4 Vedas, 6 Ahgas, Dharma- Sastra, Purana, Nyaya, Mimarhsa. The fourteen lores are enumerated in VP. III.6.28 as follows:
verses.commentary: Sense: KP's list of fourteen vidyds is: 4 Vedas, 6 Ahgas, Dharma- Sastra, Purana, Nyaya, Mimarhsa. The fourteen lores are enumerated in VP. III.6.28 as follows:

verses.sanskrit: धुन्वती दुः प्रकम्प्या च सूर्यमाता दृषद्वती । महेन्द्रभगिनी मान्या वरेण्या वरदर्पिता
verses.transliteration: dhunvatī duḥ prakampyā ca sūryamātā dṛṣadvatī / mahendrabhaginī mānyā vareṇyā varadarpitā
verses.translation: On hearing these words of the sages, Visnu the Supreme Person, the great Yogin, meditated on his own Supreme state and replied.
verses.hindi: तथा परमाकाशमे स्थित ब्रह्मसंज्ञक तत्त्वको नहीं जान मेरी मायाद्वारा नित्य सूक्ष्म तमोगुणसे घिरे हुए प्राणी (इस) घोर संसारसागरमें बार-बार जन्म लेते हैं। राजन्! जन्मरूपी बन्धनकी निवृत्तिके लिये अनन्य भक्ति एवं सम्यक् ज्ञानके द्वारा उस ब्रह्मका अन्वेषण करना चाहिए।
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing these words of the sages, Visnu the Supreme Person, the great Yogin, meditated on his own Supreme state and replied.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing these words of the sages, Visnu the Supreme Person, the great Yogin, meditated on his own Supreme state and replied.

verses.sanskrit: कल्याणी कमला रामा पञ्चभूता वरप्रदा । वाच्या वरेश्वरी वन्द्या दुर्जया दुरतिक्रमा
verses.transliteration: kalyāṇī kamalā rāmā pañcabhūtā varapradā / vācyā vareśvarī vandyā durjayā duratikramā
verses.translation: "This mysterious knowledge which is to be closely guarded as a secret, was formerly explained by the grand-sire Brahma on the beautiful plateau of the mountain Meru.
verses.hindi: (राजन्! जो) अहंकार, मात्सर्य, काम, क्रोध, संग्रहकी प्रवृत्ति तथा अधर्माचरणमें रुचिका सर्वथा परित्याग कर अनासक्तभावमें स्थित रहते हैं और सभी प्राणियोंमें अपनेको एवं सभी प्राणियोंको अपनी अन्तरात्मामें स्थित देखते हैं, वे आत्माद्वारा अन्तरात्माका साक्षात्कार कर ब्रह्मको प्राप्त करनेके योग्य बन जाते हैं । सभी प्राणियोंको अभय प्रदान करनेवाले तथा प्रसन्न मनवाले ब्रह्ममें एकीभावसे स्थित, अनन्यगामिनी परम ईश्वरभक्तिको
verses.wordMeaning: "This mysterious knowledge which is to be closely guarded as a secret, was formerly explained by the grand-sire Brahma on the beautiful plateau of the mountain Meru.
verses.commentary: Sense: "This mysterious knowledge which is to be closely guarded as a secret, was formerly explained by the grand-sire Brahma on the beautiful plateau of the mountain Meru.

verses.sanskrit: कालरात्रिर्महावेगा वीरभद्रप्रिया हिता । भद्रकाली जगन्माता भक्तानां भद्रदायिनी
verses.transliteration: kālarātrirmahāvegā vīrabhadrapriyā hitā / bhadrakālī jaganmātā bhaktānāṃ bhadradāyinī
verses.translation: It is the essence of the Sahkhya philosophy to the followers of the Sahkhya system. It is the excellent, perfect knowledge of Brahman. It is the only saviour of the living be¬ ings immersed in the ocean of worldly existence.
verses.hindi: प्राप्त कर लेते हें । वे उस ऐश्वर्ययुक्त निष्कल ब्रह्मतत्त्वका साक्षात् करते हैं और समस्त संसारसे अनासक्त होते हुए एकमात्र ब्रह्ममें ही प्रतिष्ठित हो जाते हैं॥ ३०५--३१०॥ ब्रह्मणो हि प्रतिष्ठायं परस्य परमः शिव: । अनन्तस्याव्ययस्यैकः स्वात्माधारो महेश्वरः
verses.wordMeaning: It is the essence of the Sahkhya philosophy to the followers of the Sahkhya system. It is the excellent, perfect knowledge of Brahman. It is the only saviour of the living be¬ ings immersed in the ocean of worldly existence.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is the essence of the Sahkhya philosophy to the followers of the Sahkhya system. It is the excellent, perfect knowledge of Brahman. It is the only saviour of the living be¬ ings immersed in the ocean of worldly existence.

verses.sanskrit: कराला पिङ्गलाकारा नामभेदामहामदा । यशस्विनी यशोदा च षडध्वपरिवर्तिका
verses.transliteration: karālā piṅgalākārā nāmabhedāmahāmadā / yaśasvinī yaśodā ca ṣaḍadhvaparivartikā
verses.translation: This Haimavati (daughter of mount Himvan) is considered as the highest point of perfection termed as Vyoman (the firmament), the potency of god Mahesvara, the embodi¬ ment of knowledge and ardent desire for it.
verses.hindi: ज्ञानेन कर्मयोगेन भक्तियोगेन वा नृप। सर्वसंसारमुक्त्यर्थमीश्वरं सततं श्रय अन्वीक्ष्य चैतदखिलं यथेष्टं कर्तुमरहसि
verses.wordMeaning: This Haimavati (daughter of mount Himvan) is considered as the highest point of perfection termed as Vyoman (the firmament), the potency of god Mahesvara, the embodi¬ ment of knowledge and ardent desire for it.
verses.commentary: Sense: This Haimavati (daughter of mount Himvan) is considered as the highest point of perfection termed as Vyoman (the firmament), the potency of god Mahesvara, the embodi¬ ment of knowledge and ardent desire for it.

verses.sanskrit: शङ्खिनी पद्मिनी सांख्या सांख्ययोगप्रवर्तिका । चैत्रा संवत्सरारूढा जगत्संपूरणीन्द्रजा
verses.transliteration: śaṅkhinī padminī sāṃkhyā sāṃkhyayogapravartikā / caitrā saṃvatsarārūḍhā jagatsaṃpūraṇīndrajā
verses.translation: She is auspicious (or the consort of god Siva), all pervading, infinite, beyond all gunas, perfect (or the purest). Though absolutely one (undivided), she is abiding in one or more divisions. She is knowledge incarnate and has excessive longing.
verses.hindi: अहं वै याचिता देवैः संजाता परमेश्वरात् । विनिन्द्य दक्षं पितरं महेश्वरविनिन्दकम् धर्मसंस्थापनार्थाय तवाराधनकारणात्। मेनादेहसमुत्पन्ना त्वामेव पितरं श्रिता
verses.wordMeaning: She is auspicious (or the consort of god Siva), all pervading, infinite, beyond all gunas, perfect (or the purest). Though absolutely one (undivided), she is abiding in one or more divisions. She is knowledge incarnate and has excessive longing.
verses.commentary: Sense: She is auspicious (or the consort of god Siva), all pervading, infinite, beyond all gunas, perfect (or the purest). Though absolutely one (undivided), she is abiding in one or more divisions. She is knowledge incarnate and has excessive longing.

verses.sanskrit: शुम्भारिः खेचरीस्वस्था कम्बुग्रीवा कलिप्रिया । खगध्वजी खगारूढा परार्घ्या परमालिनी
verses.transliteration: śumbhāriḥ khecarīsvasthā kambugrīvā kalipriyā / khagadhvajī khagārūḍhā parārghyā paramālinī
verses.translation: She is non-different, stationed in the perfect Reality, thanks to its splendour. Due to that very reason, her lustre is as pure and dazzling as that of the sun.
verses.hindi: स त्वं नियोगाद् देवस्य ब्रह्मणः परमात्मनः । प्रदास्यसे मां रुद्राय स्वयंवरसमागमे तत्सम्बन्धाच्च ते राजन् सर्वे देवाः सवासवाः । त्वां नमस्यन्ति वै तात प्रसीदति च शंकरः
verses.wordMeaning: She is non-different, stationed in the perfect Reality, thanks to its splendour. Due to that very reason, her lustre is as pure and dazzling as that of the sun.
verses.commentary: Sense: She is non-different, stationed in the perfect Reality, thanks to its splendour. Due to that very reason, her lustre is as pure and dazzling as that of the sun.

verses.sanskrit: ऐश्वर्यवर्त्मनिलया विरक्ता गरुडासना । जयन्ती हृद्गुहा रम्या गह्विरेष्ठा गणाग्रणीः
verses.transliteration: aiśvaryavartmanilayā viraktā garuḍāsanā / jayantī hṛdguhā ramyā gahvireṣṭhā gaṇāgraṇīḥ
verses.translation: The Potency of god Mahesvara is one (by herself),
verses.hindi: सम्पूज्य देवमीशानं शरण्यं शरणं व्रज स एवमुक्तो भगवान् देवदेव्या गिरीश्वरः । प्रणम्य शिरसा देवीं प्राञ्जलिः पुनरब्रवीत्
verses.wordMeaning: The Potency of god Mahesvara is one (by herself),
verses.commentary: Sense: The Potency of god Mahesvara is one (by herself),

verses.sanskrit: संकल्पसिद्धा साम्यस्था सर्वविज्ञानदायिनी । कलिकल्पषहन्त्री च गुह्योपनिषदुत्तमा
verses.transliteration: saṃkalpasiddhā sāmyasthā sarvavijñānadāyinī / kalikalpaṣahantrī ca guhyopaniṣaduttamā
verses.translation: It is she who does everything. This universe is the effect of her activity. The wise sages state that Isvara has neither any act to execute nor is he an instrument of anything.
verses.hindi: निशम्य वदनाम्भोजाद् गिरीन्द्रो लोकपूजितः । लोकमातुः परं ज्ञानं योगासक्तोऽभवत् पुनः नियोगाद् ब्रह्मणः साध्वीं देवानां चैव संनिधौ
verses.wordMeaning: It is she who does everything. This universe is the effect of her activity. The wise sages state that Isvara has neither any act to execute nor is he an instrument of anything.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is she who does everything. This universe is the effect of her activity. The wise sages state that Isvara has neither any act to execute nor is he an instrument of anything.

verses.sanskrit: निष्ठा दृष्टिः स्मृतिर्व्याप्तिः पुष्टिस्तुष्टिः क्रियावती । विश्वामरेश्वरेशाना भुक्तिर्मुक्तीः शिवामृता
verses.transliteration: niṣṭhā dṛṣṭiḥ smṛtirvyāptiḥ puṣṭistuṣṭiḥ kriyāvatī / viśvāmareśvareśānā bhuktirmuktīḥ śivāmṛtā
verses.translation: Four potencies of the Goddess abide in their own forms in her, due to the presence (abidance) of the Goddess. Listen to their names, O excellent sages.
verses.hindi: य इमं पठतेऽध्यायं देव्या माहात्म्यकीर्तनम्। शिवस्य संनिधौ भक्त्या शुचिस्तद्भावभावितः सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो दिव्ययोगसमन्वितः । उल्लङ्घ्य ब्रह्मणो लोकं देव्याः स्थानमवाणुयात्
verses.wordMeaning: Four potencies of the Goddess abide in their own forms in her, due to the presence (abidance) of the Goddess. Listen to their names, O excellent sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: Four potencies of the Goddess abide in their own forms in her, due to the presence (abidance) of the Goddess. Listen to their names, O excellent sages.

verses.sanskrit: लोहिता सर्पमाला च भीषणी वनमालिनी । अनन्तशयनानन्या नरनारायणोद्भवा
verses.transliteration: lohitā sarpamālā ca bhīṣaṇī vanamālinī / anantaśayanānanyā naranārāyaṇodbhavā
verses.translation: It is stated that they (the potencies) are Santi (peace), Vidya (knowledge), Pratiftha (stability), and Nivrtti (renunciation). Hence Lord Paramesvara is called as having four manifestations. (Catur-vyuha).
verses.hindi: ये अद्वितीय, अपनी आत्माके आश्रय महेश्वर परमशिव ही अनन्त तथा अव्यय पर ब्रह्मकी प्रतिष्ठा-रूप हैं। राजन्! ज्ञानयोग, कर्मयोग अथवा भक्तियोगके द्वारा समस्त संसारसे मुक्ति प्राप्त करनेके लिये निरन्तर ईश्वरका आश्रय ग्रहण करो। पर्वतराज हिमालय! मैंने यह गुह्य उपदेश तुम्हें प्रदान किया है, इस सम्पूर्ण उपदेशपर विचारकर तुम जैसा चाहो वैसा करो
verses.wordMeaning: It is stated that they (the potencies) are Santi (peace), Vidya (knowledge), Pratiftha (stability), and Nivrtti (renunciation). Hence Lord Paramesvara is called as having four manifestations. (Catur-vyuha).
verses.commentary: Sense: It is stated that they (the potencies) are Santi (peace), Vidya (knowledge), Pratiftha (stability), and Nivrtti (renunciation). Hence Lord Paramesvara is called as having four manifestations. (Catur-vyuha).

verses.sanskrit: नृसिंही दैत्यमथनी शङ्खचक्रगदाधरा । संकर्षणसमुत्पत्तिरम्बिकापादसंश्रया
verses.transliteration: nṛsiṃhī daityamathanī śaṅkhacakragadādharā / saṃkarṣaṇasamutpattirambikāpādasaṃśrayā
verses.translation: The Lord enjoys the greatest bliss (of communion with his Atman) through this great potency. Mahesvara has four forms corresponding to the four Vedas.
verses.hindi: महादेव शंकरकी निन्दा करनेवाले अपने पिता दक्षकी आलोचना कर देवताओंके द्वारा प्रार्थना करनेपर मैं परमेश्वरसे प्रादुर्भूत हुई हूँ। तुम्हारी आराधनाके कारण धर्मकी स्थापना करनेके लिये तुम्हें ही पिताके रूपमें आश्रय बनाकर मैं मेनाकी देहसे उत्पन्न हुई हूँ। आप परमात्मा ब्रह्मदेवके निर्देशसे स्वयंवरके समय मुझे रुद्रको प्रदान करेंगे । राजन्! तात! उस सम्बन्धके कारण इन्द्रसहित सभी देवता आपको नमस्कार करेंगे तथा भगवान् शंकर
verses.wordMeaning: The Lord enjoys the greatest bliss (of communion with his Atman) through this great potency. Mahesvara has four forms corresponding to the four Vedas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Lord enjoys the greatest bliss (of communion with his Atman) through this great potency. Mahesvara has four forms corresponding to the four Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: महाज्वाला महामूर्तिः सुमूर्तिः सर्वकामधुक् । सुप्रभा सुस्तना गौरी धर्मकामार्थमोक्षदा
verses.transliteration: mahājvālā mahāmūrtiḥ sumūrtiḥ sarvakāmadhuk / suprabhā sustanā gaurī dharmakāmārthamokṣadā
verses.translation: Her prosperity and glory is great and unequalled, and is fully accomplished from times immemorial. She is infinite in view of her contact with Rudra, the Supreme Soul.
verses.hindi: भी आपसे प्रसन्न होंगे। इसलिये सभी प्रकारके प्रयत्नोंके द्वारा मुझे ही ईश्वरकी विषयस्वरूपा (ईश्वरका सर्वस्व) समझो और शरण ग्रहण करने योग्य भगवान् शंकरको पूजाकर उनको शरणमें जाओ भगवान् महादेवको देवी (शंकरपत्नी)-के द्वारा इस प्रकार कहे जानेपर वे पर्वतराज हिमालय विनयपूर्वक प्रणामकर हाथ जोडते हुए पुनः महेशवरीसे कहने लगे-महेशानि! आप मुझे परम माहेश्वर योगको
verses.wordMeaning: Her prosperity and glory is great and unequalled, and is fully accomplished from times immemorial. She is infinite in view of her contact with Rudra, the Supreme Soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: Her prosperity and glory is great and unequalled, and is fully accomplished from times immemorial. She is infinite in view of her contact with Rudra, the Supreme Soul.

verses.sanskrit: भ्रूमध्यनिलया पूर्वा पुराणपुरुषारणिः । महाविभूतिदा मध्या सरोजनयना समा
verses.transliteration: bhrūmadhyanilayā pūrvā purāṇapuruṣāraṇiḥ / mahāvibhūtidā madhyā sarojanayanā samā
verses.translation: This Goddess is the sovereign ruler of all. She makes all living beings function. Lord Hari (v.l. Hara) is called Kala, Prana (vital airs) and the Supreme Ruler.
verses.hindi: विस्तारसे बतलाइये और ज्ञान तथा साधर्नोसहित आत्मयोगको भी विस्तारपूर्वक बतलायें (इसपर) भगवती पार्वतीने उन्हें वह परम ज्ञान, श्रेष्ठ आत्मयोग और उसकी प्रा्िके साधनोंको भी विस्तारपूर्वक भलीभाति बतलाया। जगज्जननीके मुखकमलसे परम ज्ञान सुनकर वे लोकपूजित पर्वतराज हिमालय
verses.wordMeaning: This Goddess is the sovereign ruler of all. She makes all living beings function. Lord Hari (v.l. Hara) is called Kala, Prana (vital airs) and the Supreme Ruler.
verses.commentary: Sense: This Goddess is the sovereign ruler of all. She makes all living beings function. Lord Hari (v.l. Hara) is called Kala, Prana (vital airs) and the Supreme Ruler.

verses.sanskrit: अष्टादशभुजानाद्या नीलोत्पलदलप्रभा । सर्वशक्त्यासनारूढा धर्माधर्मार्थवर्जिता
verses.transliteration: aṣṭādaśabhujānādyā nīlotpaladalaprabhā / sarvaśaktyāsanārūḍhā dharmādharmārthavarjitā
verses.translation: This entire universe is warp and woof in him as it, were. That Lord Hara is being extolled as Kalagni (the des¬ tructive fire of the universe) by the expounders of the Vedas.
verses.hindi: पुनः योगमें आसक्त हो गये! (कालान्तरमें हिमालयने) ब्रह्माजीके आदेशसे देवताओंकी संनिधिमें (अपने) सौभाग्यकी अभिवृद्धि समझते हुए साध्वी पार्वतीको महेश्वरके लिये प्रदान किया जो व्यक्ति भगवान् शिवके सांनिध्यमें उनके भावसे भावित होकर पवित्रतापूर्वक देवीके माहात्म्यका वर्णन करनेवाले इस अध्यायका पाठ करता है, बह सभी पापोसे मुक्त हो जाता है और दिव्य योगसे
verses.wordMeaning: This entire universe is warp and woof in him as it, were. That Lord Hara is being extolled as Kalagni (the des¬ tructive fire of the universe) by the expounders of the Vedas.
verses.commentary: Sense: This entire universe is warp and woof in him as it, were. That Lord Hara is being extolled as Kalagni (the des¬ tructive fire of the universe) by the expounders of the Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: वैराग्यज्ञाननिरता निरालोका निरिन्द्रिया । विचित्रगहनाधारा शाश्वतस्थानवासिनी
verses.transliteration: vairāgyajñānaniratā nirālokā nirindriyā / vicitragahanādhārā śāśvatasthānavāsinī
verses.translation: It IS Kola (Time) that creates the living beings. It is he who annihilates the subjects. Everything is subservient to Kala, but Kala is not subordinate to any one.
verses.hindi: समन्वित होकर ब्रह्मलोकको पारकर देवीके स्थानको प्राप्त करता है देव्याः समाहितमनाः सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते
verses.wordMeaning: It IS Kola (Time) that creates the living beings. It is he who annihilates the subjects. Everything is subservient to Kala, but Kala is not subordinate to any one.
verses.commentary: Sense: It IS Kola (Time) that creates the living beings. It is he who annihilates the subjects. Everything is subservient to Kala, but Kala is not subordinate to any one.

verses.sanskrit: स्थानेश्वरी निरानन्दा त्रिशूलवरधारिणी । अशेषदेवतामूर्तिर्देवता वरदेवता । गणाम्बिका गिरेः पुत्री निशुम्भविनिपातिनी
verses.transliteration: sthāneśvarī nirānandā triśūlavaradhāriṇī / aśeṣadevatāmūrtirdevatā varadevatā / gaṇāmbikā gireḥ putrī niśumbhavinipātinī
verses.translation: The principles called Pradham, Purufa, Mahat, Atman, Aharnkdra (ego) and others are all pervaded by Kala, the Yogin.
verses.hindi: नाम्नामष्टसहर्त्रं तु देव्या यत् समुदीरितम्। ज्ञात्वार्कमण्डलगतां सम्भाव्य परमेश्वरीम् संस्मरन् परमं भावं देव्या माहेश्वरं परम्
verses.wordMeaning: The principles called Pradham, Purufa, Mahat, Atman, Aharnkdra (ego) and others are all pervaded by Kala, the Yogin.
verses.commentary: Sense: The principles called Pradham, Purufa, Mahat, Atman, Aharnkdra (ego) and others are all pervaded by Kala, the Yogin.

verses.sanskrit: अवर्ण वर्णरहिता निवर्णा बीजसंभवा । अनन्तवर्णानन्यस्था शङ्करी शान्तमानसा
verses.transliteration: avarṇa varṇarahitā nivarṇā bījasaṃbhavā / anantavarṇānanyasthā śaṅkarī śāntamānasā
verses.translation: His potency is well known as Maya. It has the whole universe for its form. Isa, the wielder of Maya, the excellent Purusa deludes (whirls) this world by means of that (Maya).
verses.hindi: सोऽन्तकाले स्मृतिं लब्ध्वा परं ब्रह्माधिगच्छति पूर्वसंस्कारमाहात्म्याद् ब्रह्मविद्यामवाप्य स:
verses.wordMeaning: His potency is well known as Maya. It has the whole universe for its form. Isa, the wielder of Maya, the excellent Purusa deludes (whirls) this world by means of that (Maya).
verses.commentary: Sense: His potency is well known as Maya. It has the whole universe for its form. Isa, the wielder of Maya, the excellent Purusa deludes (whirls) this world by means of that (Maya).

verses.sanskrit: अगोत्रा गोमती गोप्त्री गुह्यरूपा गुणोत्तरा । गौर्गोर्गव्यप्रिया गौणी गणेश्वरनमस्कृता
verses.transliteration: agotrā gomatī goptrī guhyarūpā guṇottarā / gaurgorgavyapriyā gauṇī gaṇeśvaranamaskṛtā
verses.translation: This potency in the form of Maya assumes all forms.
verses.hindi: शान्तः सर्वगतो भूत्वा शिवसायुज्यमाप्नुयात् श्रीकामः पार्वतीं देवीं पूजयित्वा विधानतः
verses.wordMeaning: This potency in the form of Maya assumes all forms.
verses.commentary: Sense: This potency in the form of Maya assumes all forms.

verses.sanskrit: सत्यमात्रा सत्यसंधा त्रिसंध्या संधिवर्जिता । सर्ववादाश्रया संख्या संख्ययोगसमुद्भवा
verses.transliteration: satyamātrā satyasaṃdhā trisaṃdhyā saṃdhivarjitā / sarvavādāśrayā saṃkhyā saṃkhyayogasamudbhavā
verses.translation: There are three other important powers, evolved by the Lord viz. the power of knowledge, the power of activity and the power of vital airs (Prana Sakti).
verses.hindi: लभते महतीं लक्ष्मीं महादेवप्रसादतः सर्वपापापनोदार्थ देव्या नाम सहस्त्रकम्
verses.wordMeaning: There are three other important powers, evolved by the Lord viz. the power of knowledge, the power of activity and the power of vital airs (Prana Sakti).
verses.commentary: Sense: There are three other important powers, evolved by the Lord viz. the power of knowledge, the power of activity and the power of vital airs (Prana Sakti).

verses.sanskrit: असंख्येयाप्रमेयाख्या शून्या शुद्धकुलोद्भवा । बिन्दुनादसमुत्पत्तिः शंभुवामा शशिप्रभा
verses.transliteration: asaṃkhyeyāprameyākhyā śūnyā śuddhakulodbhavā / bindunādasamutpattiḥ śaṃbhuvāmā śaśiprabhā
verses.translation: For all these powers, the possessors of each of these powers have been created by the Maya alone, O prominent Brahmanas, but she (Maya) is without beginning and imperishable.
verses.hindi: प्रसङ्गात् कथितं विप्रा देव्या माहात्म्यमुत्तमम् । अतः परं प्रजासर्गं भृग्वादीनां निबोधत जो एकाग्रमनसे ब्राह्मणोंके समीपमें देवीके इस (सहस्रनाम) स्तोत्रका पाठ करता है, वह सभी पापोंसे विमुक्त हो जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: For all these powers, the possessors of each of these powers have been created by the Maya alone, O prominent Brahmanas, but she (Maya) is without beginning and imperishable.
verses.commentary: Sense: For all these powers, the possessors of each of these powers have been created by the Maya alone, O prominent Brahmanas, but she (Maya) is without beginning and imperishable.

verses.sanskrit: विसङ्गा भेदरहिता मनोज्ञा मधुसूदनी । महाश्रीः श्रीसमुत्पत्तिस्तमः पारे प्रतिष्ठिता
verses.transliteration: visaṅgā bhedarahitā manojñā madhusūdanī / mahāśrīḥ śrīsamutpattistamaḥ pāre pratiṣṭhitā
verses.translation: Maya who embodied all these potencies, is invincible and unsurmountable. Kala, the wielder of Maya, is the Lord of all these potencies, the lord of destruction (and creation).
verses.hindi: देवीका जो एक सहस्र आठ नामवाला स्तोत्र बतलाया गया है, उसे जानकर सूर्यमण्डलमें स्थित परमेशवरीकी भावना करते हुए गन्ध, पुष्प आदिके द्वारा भक्तियोगपूर्वक उनकी अर्चना द्विजको करनी चाहिए और देवीके परम माहेश्वर श्रेष्ठ भावका अनन्य-मनसे मरणपर्यन्त स्मरण करते हुए इस उपदिष्ट एक हजार आठ नामोंका नित्य जप करना चाहिए। ऐसा करनेसे द्विज अन्त-समयमें (देवीकी) स्मृति प्राप्तकर परब्रह्मको
verses.wordMeaning: Maya who embodied all these potencies, is invincible and unsurmountable. Kala, the wielder of Maya, is the Lord of all these potencies, the lord of destruction (and creation).
verses.commentary: Sense: Maya who embodied all these potencies, is invincible and unsurmountable. Kala, the wielder of Maya, is the Lord of all these potencies, the lord of destruction (and creation).

verses.sanskrit: त्रितत्त्वमाता त्रिविधा सुसूक्ष्मपदसंश्रया । शान्त्यतीता मलातीता निर्विकारा निराश्रया
verses.transliteration: tritattvamātā trividhā susūkṣmapadasaṃśrayā / śāntyatītā malātītā nirvikārā nirāśrayā
verses.translation: Kola does everything. It is Ka alone that annihilates everything. Kola establishes the Universe. This whole Universe is dependent on Kdla.
verses.hindi: अथवा वह विप्र ब्राह्मणोंके पवित्र कुलमें उत्पन्न होता है और पूर्वजन्मके संस्कारोंके प्रभावसे वह ब्रह्मविद्याको प्राप्त करता है। परमेशवर-सम्बन्धी उस परम दिव्य योगको प्राप्तकर वह शान्त तथा सर्वत्र व्याप्त होते हुए शिवसायुज्यको प्राप्त करता है । (जो व्यक्ति प्रातः, मध्याहृ तथा सायं- ) तीनों समय देवीके प्रत्येक नामसे हवन करता है, वह पूतना आदिद्वारा उत्पन्न (अरिष्ट) दोषों तथा ग्रहोंके दोषोंसे मुक्त हो जाता है॥ ३३०--३३२॥
verses.wordMeaning: Kola does everything. It is Ka alone that annihilates everything. Kola establishes the Universe. This whole Universe is dependent on Kdla.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kola does everything. It is Ka alone that annihilates everything. Kola establishes the Universe. This whole Universe is dependent on Kdla.

verses.sanskrit: शिवाख्या चित्तनिलया शिवज्ञानस्वरूपिणी । दैत्यदानवनिर्मात्री काश्यपी कालकल्पिका
verses.transliteration: śivākhyā cittanilayā śivajñānasvarūpiṇī / daityadānavanirmātrī kāśyapī kālakalpikā
verses.translation: The Sakti is one, Siva is also one. Siva is called the possessor of Sakti. There are many other minor powers and possessors of those potencies born of the original Sakti.
verses.hindi: अथवा लक्ष्मीप्रापिको इच्छा करनेवाला द्विज विधिपूर्वक देवीको पूजाकर और उनके पार्श्वभाग (समीप) -में तीन नेत्रवाले भगवान् शंकरको पूजा करता है तथा एक वर्षतक आलस्यरहित होकर प्रतिदिन निरन्तर (देवीके सहस्रनामका) जप करता है, वह महादेव भगवान् शंकरको कृपासे महालक्ष्मीको प्राप्त करता है
verses.wordMeaning: The Sakti is one, Siva is also one. Siva is called the possessor of Sakti. There are many other minor powers and possessors of those potencies born of the original Sakti.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Sakti is one, Siva is also one. Siva is called the possessor of Sakti. There are many other minor powers and possessors of those potencies born of the original Sakti.

verses.sanskrit: शास्त्रयोनिः क्रियामूर्तिश्चतुर्वर्गप्रदर्शिका । नारायणी नरोद्भूतिः कौमुदी लिङ्गधारिणी
verses.transliteration: śāstrayoniḥ kriyāmūrtiścaturvargapradarśikā / nārāyaṇī narodbhūtiḥ kaumudī liṅgadhāriṇī
verses.translation: They (i. e. wise men) declare that from the realistic point of view there is a difference between Saktis and those endowed with them. But Yogins who meditate on Reality, realise non-difference between them.
verses.hindi: इसलिये द्विजातियोंको सभी प्रकारके प्रयलोंके द्वारा सभी पापोसे छुटकारा प्राप्त करनेके लिये देवीके सहस्रनामका जप करना चाहिए  विप्रो! मैंने प्रसङ्गवश देवीका उत्तम माहात्म्य आप लोगोंसे कहा। अब इसके बाद आपलोग भृगु आदि महर्षियोंको प्रजासृष्टिको सुनें
verses.wordMeaning: They (i. e. wise men) declare that from the realistic point of view there is a difference between Saktis and those endowed with them. But Yogins who meditate on Reality, realise non-difference between them.
verses.commentary: Sense: They (i. e. wise men) declare that from the realistic point of view there is a difference between Saktis and those endowed with them. But Yogins who meditate on Reality, realise non-difference between them.

verses.sanskrit: कामुकी ललिता भावा परापरविभूतिदा । परान्तजातमहिमा बडवा वामलोचना
verses.transliteration: kāmukī lalitā bhāvā parāparavibhūtidā / parāntajātamahimā baḍavā vāmalocanā
verses.translation: The goddess Parvati, born of the mountain (Hima¬ laya), comprises all these powers, while the master of these powers is Sankara. The special difference is mentioned in the Purana by the expounders of Brahman or Veda.
verses.hindi: महर्षि भृगु, मरीचि, पुलस्त्य तथा अत्रि आदिद्वारा दक्ष-कन्याओसे उत्पन्न संतान- परम्पराका वर्णन, उनचास अग्नियों, पितरों तथा गङ्गाके प्रादुर्भावका वर्णन भृगोः ख्यात्यां समुत्पन्ना लक्ष्मीर्नारायणप्रिया । देवौ धाताविधातारौ मेरोर्जामातरौ तथा॥
verses.wordMeaning: The goddess Parvati, born of the mountain (Hima¬ laya), comprises all these powers, while the master of these powers is Sankara. The special difference is mentioned in the Purana by the expounders of Brahman or Veda.
verses.commentary: Sense: The goddess Parvati, born of the mountain (Hima¬ laya), comprises all these powers, while the master of these powers is Sankara. The special difference is mentioned in the Purana by the expounders of Brahman or Veda.

verses.sanskrit: सुभद्रा देवकी सीता वेदवेदाङ्गपारगा । मनस्विनी मन्युमाता महामन्युसमुद्भवा
verses.transliteration: subhadrā devakī sītā vedavedāṅgapāragā / manasvinī manyumātā mahāmanyusamudbhavā
verses.translation: The goddess of the universe, the chaste spouse of god Mahesvara is the object worthy of being enjoyed, while Siva the Lord with matted locks of hair and blue-red in complexion is proclaimed as the enjoyer.
verses.hindi: कर्दमं च वरीयांसं सहिष्णुं मुनिसत्तमम् सिनीवालीं कुहूं चैव राकामनुमतिं तथा।
verses.wordMeaning: The goddess of the universe, the chaste spouse of god Mahesvara is the object worthy of being enjoyed, while Siva the Lord with matted locks of hair and blue-red in complexion is proclaimed as the enjoyer.
verses.commentary: Sense: The goddess of the universe, the chaste spouse of god Mahesvara is the object worthy of being enjoyed, while Siva the Lord with matted locks of hair and blue-red in complexion is proclaimed as the enjoyer.

verses.sanskrit: अमृत्युरमृता स्वाहा पुरुहूता पुरुष्टुता । अशोच्या भिन्नविषया हिरण्यरजतप्रिया
verses.transliteration: amṛtyuramṛtā svāhā puruhūtā puruṣṭutā / aśocyā bhinnaviṣayā hiraṇyarajatapriyā
verses.translation: God Sankara, the Lord of the universe, the destroyer of the god of love, is the thinker (the subject), while goddess Isani (Parvati) is proclaimed by the knowers, to be the intellect, the object of thought to be pondered over.
verses.hindi: प्रीत्यां पुलस्त्यो भगवान् दत्तात्रिमसृजत् प्रभुः कन्यां च पुण्डरीकाक्षां सर्वशोभासमन्विताम्
verses.wordMeaning: God Sankara, the Lord of the universe, the destroyer of the god of love, is the thinker (the subject), while goddess Isani (Parvati) is proclaimed by the knowers, to be the intellect, the object of thought to be pondered over.
verses.commentary: Sense: God Sankara, the Lord of the universe, the destroyer of the god of love, is the thinker (the subject), while goddess Isani (Parvati) is proclaimed by the knowers, to be the intellect, the object of thought to be pondered over.

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्या राजती हैमी हेमाभरणभूषिता । विभ्राजमाना दुर्ज्ञेया ज्योतिष्टोमफलप्रदा
verses.transliteration: hiraṇyā rājatī haimī hemābharaṇabhūṣitā / vibhrājamānā durjñeyā jyotiṣṭomaphalapradā
verses.translation: O Brahmanas, that all this universe is the manifest¬ ation of Sakti and Siva (the possessor of Sakti) has been declared in the four Vedas by Sages who visualise Reality.
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले महर्षि भृगुकी “ख्याति” नामक पत्नीसे नारायणको पत्नी लक्ष्मी उत्पन्न हुई तथा धाता एवं विधाता नामक दो देवता भी उनसे उत्पन्न हुए, जो मेरुके जामाता हुए। महात्मा मेरुको आयति तथा नियति नामकी दो कन्याएँ थीं, वे क्रमशः धाता तथा विधाताकी पत्नियाँ थीं, उनसे दो पुत्र उत्पन्न हुए--प्राण और मृकण्डु। मृकण्डुसे मार्कण्डेय हुए तथा प्राणके कान्तिमान् वेदशिरा नामके पुत्र हुए॥ १--३॥
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas, that all this universe is the manifest¬ ation of Sakti and Siva (the possessor of Sakti) has been declared in the four Vedas by Sages who visualise Reality.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas, that all this universe is the manifest¬ ation of Sakti and Siva (the possessor of Sakti) has been declared in the four Vedas by Sages who visualise Reality.

verses.sanskrit: महानिद्रासमुद्भूतिरनिद्रा सत्यदेवता । दीर्घाककुद्मिनी हृद्या शान्तिदा शान्तिवर्धिनी
verses.transliteration: mahānidrāsamudbhūtiranidrā satyadevatā / dīrghākakudminī hṛdyā śāntidā śāntivardhinī
verses.translation: This divine and excellent glory of the goddess has been thus declared. It is so decided by the knowers of Brah¬ man (or the Vedas), in all schools of Vedantic philosophy.
verses.hindi: महर्षि मरीचिके भी सम्भूति (नामक पत्नी)-ने सभी (शुभ) लक्षणोंसे सम्पन्न पौर्णमास नामक पुत्र और चार कन्याओंको उत्पन्न किया। सबसे बड़ी (कन्याका नाम) तुष्टि तथा अन्य तीन कन्याओंका नाम वृष्टि, कृष्टि और अपचिति था। पौर्णमासके विरजा तथा पर्वत नामके दो पुत्र थे
verses.wordMeaning: This divine and excellent glory of the goddess has been thus declared. It is so decided by the knowers of Brah¬ man (or the Vedas), in all schools of Vedantic philosophy.
verses.commentary: Sense: This divine and excellent glory of the goddess has been thus declared. It is so decided by the knowers of Brah¬ man (or the Vedas), in all schools of Vedantic philosophy.

verses.sanskrit: लक्ष्म्यादिशक्तिजननी शक्तिचक्रप्रवर्तिका । त्रिशक्तिजननी जन्या षडूर्मिपरिर्जिता
verses.transliteration: lakṣmyādiśaktijananī śakticakrapravartikā / triśaktijananī janyā ṣaḍūrmiparirjitā
verses.translation: Yogins observed the great abode of Mahadevi which is single, all-pervading, subtle, occupying the highest place, and certainly steady, immovable and eternal.
verses.hindi: प्रजापति पुलहकी पत्नी क्षमाने कर्दम, वरीयान् और उनसे छोटे सहिष्णु नामक श्रेष्ठ मुनिको जन्म दिया जो तपके कारण पाप-रहित थे। उसी प्रकार अत्रिकी नामक पुण्यात्मा पुत्रोंको उत्पन्न किया। महर्षि अङ्गिराकी स्मृति नामक पत्नीने सिनीवाली, कुहू, राका तथा अनुमति (नामवाली) शुभलक्षणसम्पन्न (चार) पुत्रियोंको जन्म दिया। प्रभु भगवान् पुलस्त्यने (अपनी पत्नी) प्रीतिसे
verses.wordMeaning: Yogins observed the great abode of Mahadevi which is single, all-pervading, subtle, occupying the highest place, and certainly steady, immovable and eternal.
verses.commentary: Sense: Yogins observed the great abode of Mahadevi which is single, all-pervading, subtle, occupying the highest place, and certainly steady, immovable and eternal.

verses.sanskrit: सुधामा कर्मकरणी युगान्तदहनात्मिका । संकर्षणी जगद्धात्री कामयोनिः किरीटिनी
verses.transliteration: sudhāmā karmakaraṇī yugāntadahanātmikā / saṃkarṣaṇī jagaddhātrī kāmayoniḥ kirīṭinī
verses.translation: Yogins perceive the Supreme State of the goddess as the imperishable Brahman, blissful, pure and perfect.
verses.hindi: दत्तात्रि (नामक पुत्र)-को उत्पन्न किया। स्वायम्भुव मन्वन्तरके (अपने) पूर्वजन्ममें वे ही अगस्त्य नामसे प्रसिद्ध थे। (पुलस्त्यको प्रीतिसे) वेदबाह (नामक एक अन्य पुत्र) और 'सन्नति' इस नामसे प्रसिद्ध (एक) महर्षि क्रतुकी पत्नी संततिने साठ हजार पुत्रोंको जन्म दिया। वे सभी ऊर्ध्वरेता बालखिल्य इस नामसे प्रसिद्ध हुए। महर्षि वसिष्ठने ऊर्ज्जा नामक पत्नीसे सात पुत्रों और कमलके समान नेत्रवाली तथा सभी प्रकारकी
verses.wordMeaning: Yogins perceive the Supreme State of the goddess as the imperishable Brahman, blissful, pure and perfect.
verses.commentary: Sense: Yogins perceive the Supreme State of the goddess as the imperishable Brahman, blissful, pure and perfect.

verses.sanskrit: ऐन्द्री त्रैलोक्यनमिता वैष्णवी परमेश्वरी । प्रद्युम्नदयिता दान्ता युग्मदृष्टिस्त्रिलोचना
verses.transliteration: aindrī trailokyanamitā vaiṣṇavī parameśvarī / pradyumnadayitā dāntā yugmadṛṣṭistrilocanā
