verses.translation: That great region of the goddess is greater than the greatest. It is the eternal Reality unswerving auspicious, merged within the infinite Prakrti.
verses.hindi: शोभाओंसे सम्पन्न एक कन्याको जन्म दिया योऽसौ रुद्रात्मको वह्निरब्रह्मणस्तनयो द्विजा: । स्वाहा तस्मात् सुतान् लेभे त्रीनुदारान् महौजस:
verses.wordMeaning: That great region of the goddess is greater than the greatest. It is the eternal Reality unswerving auspicious, merged within the infinite Prakrti.
verses.commentary: Sense: That great region of the goddess is greater than the greatest. It is the eternal Reality unswerving auspicious, merged within the infinite Prakrti.

verses.sanskrit: मदोत्कटा हंसगतिः प्रचण्डा चण्डविक्रमा । वृषावेशा वियन्माता विन्ध्यपर्वतवासिनी
verses.transliteration: madotkaṭā haṃsagatiḥ pracaṇḍā caṇḍavikramā / vṛṣāveśā viyanmātā vindhyaparvatavāsinī
verses.translation: It is auspicious, untainted, pure, devoid of gutias and free from duality. That great region of the goddess is achievable through realization of Atman.
verses.hindi: एते चैकोनपञ्चाशद् वह्णयः परिकीर्तिताः सर्वे तपस्विनः प्रोक्ताः सर्वे यज्ञेषु भागिनः। रुद्रात्मकाः स्मृताः सर्वे त्रिपुण्ड्राङ्कितिमस्तकाः
verses.wordMeaning: It is auspicious, untainted, pure, devoid of gutias and free from duality. That great region of the goddess is achievable through realization of Atman.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is auspicious, untainted, pure, devoid of gutias and free from duality. That great region of the goddess is achievable through realization of Atman.

verses.sanskrit: हिमवन्मेरुनिलया कैलासगिरिवासिनी । चाणूरहन्तृतनया नीतिज्ञा कामरूपिणी
verses.transliteration: himavanmerunilayā kailāsagirivāsinī / cāṇūrahantṛtanayā nītijñā kāmarūpiṇī
verses.translation: She is Dhdtri (the creator), and Vidhatri (dispenser of destiny). She dispels with the support of Isvara all the distresses of the worldly existence of those who wish for supreme bliss.
verses.hindi: अयज्चानश्च यज्वानः पितरो ब्रह्मणः स्मृताः । अग्निष्वात्ता बर्हिषदो द्विधा तेषां व्यवस्थितिः ते उभे ब्रह्मवादिन्यौ योगिन्यौ मुनिसत्तमाः
verses.wordMeaning: She is Dhdtri (the creator), and Vidhatri (dispenser of destiny). She dispels with the support of Isvara all the distresses of the worldly existence of those who wish for supreme bliss.
verses.commentary: Sense: She is Dhdtri (the creator), and Vidhatri (dispenser of destiny). She dispels with the support of Isvara all the distresses of the worldly existence of those who wish for supreme bliss.

verses.sanskrit: वेदविद्याव्रतस्नाता धर्मशीलानिलाशना । वीरभद्रप्रिया वीरा महाकालसमुद्भवा
verses.transliteration: vedavidyāvratasnātā dharmaśīlānilāśanā / vīrabhadrapriyā vīrā mahākālasamudbhavā
verses.translation: Hence, one who seeks salvation should resort toi Parvati, the supreme Goddess, the Atman of all living beings, of the nature of Siva (i.e. one with him).
verses.hindi: गङ्गा हिमवतो जज्ञे सर्वलोकैकपावनी स्वयोगाग्रिबलाद् देवीं लेभे पुत्रीं महेश्वरीम्। यथावत् कथितं पूर्व देव्या माहात्म्यमुत्तमम्
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, one who seeks salvation should resort toi Parvati, the supreme Goddess, the Atman of all living beings, of the nature of Siva (i.e. one with him).
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, one who seeks salvation should resort toi Parvati, the supreme Goddess, the Atman of all living beings, of the nature of Siva (i.e. one with him).

verses.sanskrit: विद्याधरप्रिया सिद्धा विद्याधरनिराकृतिः । आप्यायनी हरन्ती च पावनी पोषणी खिला
verses.transliteration: vidyādharapriyā siddhā vidyādharanirākṛtiḥ / āpyāyanī harantī ca pāvanī poṣaṇī khilā
verses.translation: Securing Sarvani as his daughter after performing severe penance, Himavan, accompanied by his wife sought refuge in the great Goddess Parvati.
verses.hindi: शुक्र— (नामवाले) ये (वसिष्ठके) सात महान् ओजस्वी पुत्र थे। द्विजो! ब्रह्माका रुद्रस्वरूप जो वह वह्नि नामक पुत्र था, उससे स्वाहाने महातेजस्वी तीन उदार पुत्रोंको (नामवाले) अग्नि थे। मन्थनद्वारा उत्पन्न अग्निको पवमान और विद्युत्से सम्बद्ध अग्निको पावक कहा जाता है। जो यह सूर्य चमकता है वही शुचि अग्नि कहलाता है  उन (तीनों अग्नियों)-की पैंतालीस संतानें
verses.wordMeaning: Securing Sarvani as his daughter after performing severe penance, Himavan, accompanied by his wife sought refuge in the great Goddess Parvati.
verses.commentary: Sense: Securing Sarvani as his daughter after performing severe penance, Himavan, accompanied by his wife sought refuge in the great Goddess Parvati.

verses.sanskrit: मातृका मन्मथोद्भूता वारिजा वाहनप्रिया । करीषिणी सुधावाणी वीणावादनतत्परा
verses.transliteration: mātṛkā manmathodbhūtā vārijā vāhanapriyā / karīṣiṇī sudhāvāṇī vīṇāvādanatatparā
verses.translation: On seeing that splendid-faced lady(Uma) being born out of her own free will, Mena, the spouse of Himavan said to the King of mountains.
verses.hindi: हुई। (इस प्रकार) पावक, पवमान तथा शुचि (नामक तीन अग्नियाँ) और इन तीनोंके पिता ( रुद्रात्मक अग्नि) एवं (उन तीनों अग्नियोंके पैंतालीस पुत्र) ये सभी मिलाकर उनचास अग्नियाँ कही गयी हैं। ये सभी (उनचास) तपस्वी कहे गये हैं, सभी यज्ञभागके अधिकारी हैं, रुद्रात्मक कहलाते हैं और सभी मस्तकपर त्रिपुण्ड्के चिहृसे अङ्कित रहते हैं॥ १३--१८॥
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing that splendid-faced lady(Uma) being born out of her own free will, Mena, the spouse of Himavan said to the King of mountains.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing that splendid-faced lady(Uma) being born out of her own free will, Mena, the spouse of Himavan said to the King of mountains.

verses.sanskrit: सेविता सेविका सेव्या सिनीवाली गरुत्मती । अरुन्धती हिरण्याक्षी मृगाङ्का मानदायिनी
verses.transliteration: sevitā sevikā sevyā sinīvālī garutmatī / arundhatī hiraṇyākṣī mṛgāṅkā mānadāyinī
verses.translation: "O king, have a look at your daughter with a face resembling the lotus. As a result of our penance, she is born for the welfare of all living beings."
verses.hindi: ब्रह्माके अग्निष्वात्त तथा बर्हिषद् नामक दो पुत्र कहे गये हैं जो पितर हैं। उनमें अयज्चा (यज्ञ न करनेवाले) तथा यज्चा (यज्ञ करनेवाले)-के रूपमें दो प्रकारको व्यवस्था है। मुनिश्रेष्ठो! स्वधाने उनके द्वारा मेना और वैतरणी नामक दो पुत्रियोंको प्राप्त किया। वे दोनों ही ब्रह्मवादिनी और योगिनी थीं। मेनाने मैनाक और उसके अनुज क्रौञ्च (नामक पर्वत)-को जन्म दिया। हिमालयसे समस्त लोकोंको पवित्र करगेमें
verses.wordMeaning: "O king, have a look at your daughter with a face resembling the lotus. As a result of our penance, she is born for the welfare of all living beings."
verses.commentary: Sense: "O king, have a look at your daughter with a face resembling the lotus. As a result of our penance, she is born for the welfare of all living beings."

verses.sanskrit: वसुप्रदा वसुमती वसोर्धारा वसुंधरा । धाराधरा वरारोहा वरावरसहस्त्रदा
verses.transliteration: vasupradā vasumatī vasordhārā vasuṃdharā / dhārādharā varārohā varāvarasahastradā
verses.translation: "O Goddess of wide eyes, ornamented with the crescents of the moon, who are you? O dear child, I do not know you precisely. Please tell me that even as I asked."
verses.hindi: अद्वितीय गङ्गा उत्पन्न हुई। (हिमालयने) अपनी योगाग्निके बलसे (उन) देवी महेश्वरीको पुत्री-रूपमें प्राप्त किया, जिन देवीके उत्तम माहात्म्यको भलीभाति पहले बता दिया गया है मैंने प्रजापति दक्षकी कन्याओंकी संतान-परम्पराका आप लोगोंसे वर्णन किया। अब आप (स्वायम्भुव) मनुकी सृष्टिका वर्णन सुनें
verses.wordMeaning: "O Goddess of wide eyes, ornamented with the crescents of the moon, who are you? O dear child, I do not know you precisely. Please tell me that even as I asked."
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Goddess of wide eyes, ornamented with the crescents of the moon, who are you? O dear child, I do not know you precisely. Please tell me that even as I asked."

verses.sanskrit: श्रीफला श्रीमती श्रीशा श्रीनिवासा शिवप्रिया । श्रीधरा श्रीकरी कल्या श्रीधरार्धशरीरिणी
verses.transliteration: śrīphalā śrīmatī śrīśā śrīnivāsā śivapriyā / śrīdharā śrīkarī kalyā śrīdharārdhaśarīriṇī
verses.translation: On hearing the words of the king of mountains, the supreme Goddess, the bestower of fearlessness {Mokfd) unto the Yogins, addressed the great mountain Himavan thus.
verses.hindi: स्वायम्भुव मनुके वंशका वर्णन, चाक्षुष मनुकी उत्पत्ति, महाराज पृथुका आख्यान, पृथुका वंश-वर्णन, पृथुके पौत्र ' सुशील' का रोचक आख्यान, सुशीलको हिमालयके ' धर्मपद' नामक वनमें महापाशुपत श्वेताश्वतर मुनिके दर्शन तथा उनसे पाशुपत-व्रतका ग्रहण, दक्षके पूर्वजन्मका वृत्तान्त तथा पुनः दक्ष प्रजापतिके रूपमें आविर्भावकी कथा, दक्षद्वारा शंकरका अपमान, सतीद्वारा देह-त्याग तथा शंकरका दक्षको शाप
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the words of the king of mountains, the supreme Goddess, the bestower of fearlessness {Mokfd) unto the Yogins, addressed the great mountain Himavan thus.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of the king of mountains, the supreme Goddess, the bestower of fearlessness {Mokfd) unto the Yogins, addressed the great mountain Himavan thus.

verses.sanskrit: अनन्तदृष्टिरक्षुद्रा धात्रीशा धनदप्रिया । निहन्त्री दैत्यसङ्घानां सिहिका सिहवाहना
verses.transliteration: anantadṛṣṭirakṣudrā dhātrīśā dhanadapriyā / nihantrī daityasaṅghānāṃ sihikā sihavāhanā
verses.translation: Know me to be the Supreme Potency abiding in the great god Mahesvara.
verses.hindi: धर्मज्ञौ सुमहावीयौ शतरूपा व्यजीजनत् भक्तो नारायणे देवे प्राप्तवान् स्थानमुत्तमम्
verses.wordMeaning: Know me to be the Supreme Potency abiding in the great god Mahesvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Know me to be the Supreme Potency abiding in the great god Mahesvara.

verses.sanskrit: सुषेणा चन्द्रनिलया सुकीर्तिश्छिन्नसंशया । रसज्ञा रसदा रामा लेलिहानामृतस्त्रवा
verses.transliteration: suṣeṇā candranilayā sukīrtiśchinnasaṃśayā / rasajñā rasadā rāmā lelihānāmṛtastravā
verses.translation: I am non-different from him, unchanging and the absolute, whom those desirous of salvation perceive. I am the Atman of all conceived beings. I am Siva, the auspicious spouse of God Siva in all respects.
verses.hindi: वसिष्ठवचनाद् देवी तपस्तप्त्वा सुदुश्चरम्। आराध्य पुरुषं विष्णुं शालग्रामे जनार्दनम् नारायणपरान् शुद्धान् स्वधर्मपरिपालकान्
verses.wordMeaning: I am non-different from him, unchanging and the absolute, whom those desirous of salvation perceive. I am the Atman of all conceived beings. I am Siva, the auspicious spouse of God Siva in all respects.
verses.commentary: Sense: I am non-different from him, unchanging and the absolute, whom those desirous of salvation perceive. I am the Atman of all conceived beings. I am Siva, the auspicious spouse of God Siva in all respects.

verses.sanskrit: नित्योदिता स्वयञ्ज्योतिरुत्सुका मृतजीवनी । वज्रदण्डा वज्रजिह्वा वैदेवी वज्रविग्रहा
verses.transliteration: nityoditā svayañjyotirutsukā mṛtajīvanī / vajradaṇḍā vajrajihvā vaidevī vajravigrahā
verses.translation: I am the embodiment of permanent prosperity and perfect knowledge. I am the prime mover of everything and I am endless. My greatness is infinite. I enable people to cross the ocean of worldly existence.
verses.hindi: सोऽजीजनत् पुष्करिण्यां वैरण्यां चाक्षुषं मनुम्। प्रजापतेरात्मजायां वीरणस्य महात्मनः अङ्कं सुमनसं स्वातिं क्रतुमङ्गिरसं शिवम्
verses.wordMeaning: I am the embodiment of permanent prosperity and perfect knowledge. I am the prime mover of everything and I am endless. My greatness is infinite. I enable people to cross the ocean of worldly existence.
verses.commentary: Sense: I am the embodiment of permanent prosperity and perfect knowledge. I am the prime mover of everything and I am endless. My greatness is infinite. I enable people to cross the ocean of worldly existence.

verses.sanskrit: मङ्गल्या मङ्गला माला मलिना मलहारिणी । गान्धर्वो गारुडी चान्द्री कम्बलाश्वतरप्रिया
verses.transliteration: maṅgalyā maṅgalā mālā malinā malahāriṇī / gāndharvo gāruḍī cāndrī kambalāśvatarapriyā
verses.translation: It was ablaze with thousands of flames in clusters resembling hundreds of world-destructive conflagrations (at the end of the world). It was terrible due to its curved fangs and was irresistible. It was embellished with clustres of matted hair.
verses.hindi: येन दुग्धा मही पूर्व प्रजानां हितकारणात्। नियोगाद् ब्रह्मणः सार्ध देवेन्द्रेण महौजसा सूतजी बोले--स्वायम्भुव मनुकी पत्नी शतरूपाने प्रियव्रत तथा उत्तानपाद नामवाले दो पुत्रोंको जन्म दिया, जो धर्मको जाननेवाले तथा महान् पराक्रमी थे। कालान्तरमें उत्तानपादका धुव नामक पुत्र हुआ। भगवान् विष्णुके
verses.wordMeaning: It was ablaze with thousands of flames in clusters resembling hundreds of world-destructive conflagrations (at the end of the world). It was terrible due to its curved fangs and was irresistible. It was embellished with clustres of matted hair.
verses.commentary: Sense: It was ablaze with thousands of flames in clusters resembling hundreds of world-destructive conflagrations (at the end of the world). It was terrible due to its curved fangs and was irresistible. It was embellished with clustres of matted hair.

verses.sanskrit: सौदामिनी जनानन्दा भ्रुकुटीकुटिलानना । कर्णिकारकरा कक्ष्या कंसप्राणापहारिणी
verses.transliteration: saudāminī janānandā bhrukuṭīkuṭilānanā / karṇikārakarā kakṣyā kaṃsaprāṇāpahāriṇī
verses.translation: It wore a crown and was holding a mace, a conch, a discus and an excellent trident in its hands. The terrible form was frightening everyone.
verses.hindi: उस भक्तने उत्तम स्थान प्राप्त किया। ध्रुवकी शम्भुनामक पत्नीने श्लिष्टि तथा भव्य नामक पुत्रोंको जन्म दिया। श्लिष्टिकी सुच्छाया नामक पत्नीने पाँच पुण्यात्मा पुत्रोंको उत्पन्न किया। महर्षि वसिष्ठके कथनानुसार सुच्छाया नामक देवीने अत्यन्त कठोर तप करके शालग्राममें जनार्दन पुरुष विष्णुको आराधना कर रिपु, रिपुञ्जय, विप्र, वृकल तथा वृषतेजस् नामवाले पाँच पुत्रोंको जन्म दिया, जो नारायणमें अनन्य निष्ठा रखनेवाले, शुद्ध तथा अपने
verses.wordMeaning: It wore a crown and was holding a mace, a conch, a discus and an excellent trident in its hands. The terrible form was frightening everyone.
verses.commentary: Sense: It wore a crown and was holding a mace, a conch, a discus and an excellent trident in its hands. The terrible form was frightening everyone.

verses.sanskrit: युगन्धरा युगावर्ता त्रिसंध्या हर्षवर्धनी । प्रत्यक्षदेवता दिव्या दिव्यगन्धा दिवापरा
verses.transliteration: yugandharā yugāvartā trisaṃdhyā harṣavardhanī / pratyakṣadevatā divyā divyagandhā divāparā
verses.translation: (Simultaneously) it was tranquil, charming-faced and gentle and possessed of infinite wonders. It was bedecked with.
verses.hindi: धर्मका विशेषरूपसे पालन करनेवाले थे रिपुको पत्नी बृहतीने सब प्रकारके तेजोंसे सम्पन्न चक्षुष् (नामक पुत्र)-को जन्म दिया। उस चक्षुषूने महात्मा वीरण प्रजापतिको पुष्करिणी  नामवाली पुत्रीसे चाक्षुष मनुको जन्म दिया। अत्यन्त तेजस्वी (चाक्षुष)
verses.wordMeaning: (Simultaneously) it was tranquil, charming-faced and gentle and possessed of infinite wonders. It was bedecked with.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Simultaneously) it was tranquil, charming-faced and gentle and possessed of infinite wonders. It was bedecked with.

verses.sanskrit: शक्रासनगता शाक्री साध्वी नारी शवासना । इष्टा विशिष्टा शिष्टेष्टा शिष्टाशिष्टप्रपूजिता
verses.transliteration: śakrāsanagatā śākrī sādhvī nārī śavāsanā / iṣṭā viśiṣṭā śiṣṭeṣṭā śiṣṭāśiṣṭaprapūjitā
verses.translation: It was bedecked in coronets, it wielded a mace in its hands and was ornamented with anklets. It wore divine gar¬ lands, garments and was besmeared with divine scents and unguents.
verses.hindi: मनुके वैराज प्रजापतिकी कन्या नड्वलासे दस पुत्र उत्पन्न हुए, जो ऊरु, पूरु, शतद्युम्न, तपस्वी, सत्यवाक्, (नामवाले) थे! ऊरुकी पत्नी आग्नेयीने अङ्ग, सुमनस्, स्वाति, क्रतु, अङ्गिरस् एवं शिव (नामवाले) महाबलशाली छः पुत्रोंको उत्पन्न किया। अङ्गसे वेन हुआ और फिर वेनसे वैन्य उत्पन्न हुए। प्रजापालक, महाबलवान् वे ही
verses.wordMeaning: It was bedecked in coronets, it wielded a mace in its hands and was ornamented with anklets. It wore divine gar¬ lands, garments and was besmeared with divine scents and unguents.
verses.commentary: Sense: It was bedecked in coronets, it wielded a mace in its hands and was ornamented with anklets. It wore divine gar¬ lands, garments and was besmeared with divine scents and unguents.

verses.sanskrit: शतरूपा शतावर्ता विनता सुरभिः सुरा । सुरेन्द्रमाता सुद्युम्ना सुषुम्ना सूर्यसंस्थिता
verses.transliteration: śatarūpā śatāvartā vinatā surabhiḥ surā / surendramātā sudyumnā suṣumnā sūryasaṃsthitā
verses.translation: It held a conch and discus. It had a pleasing appear¬ ance with three eyes and it wore the elephant's hide as its robe. It was stationed both within and without the Cosmic Egg. It was both inside and outside of everything.
verses.hindi: वैन्य पृथु नामसे विख्यात हुए। पूर्वकालमें उन्होंने प्रजाओंके कल्याणको कामनासे ब्रह्माके आदेशसे महा- तेजस्वी देवराज इन्द्रके साथ (गोरूपा) पृथ्वीका दोहन किया था  यह पुष्करिणी प्रजापति वीरणकी पुत्री होनेसे वैरणी भी कही जाती है।
verses.wordMeaning: It held a conch and discus. It had a pleasing appear¬ ance with three eyes and it wore the elephant's hide as its robe. It was stationed both within and without the Cosmic Egg. It was both inside and outside of everything.
verses.commentary: Sense: It held a conch and discus. It had a pleasing appear¬ ance with three eyes and it wore the elephant's hide as its robe. It was stationed both within and without the Cosmic Egg. It was both inside and outside of everything.

verses.sanskrit: समीक्ष्या सत्प्रतिष्ठा च निवृत्तिर्ज्ञानपारगा । धर्मशास्त्रार्थकुशला धर्मज्ञा धर्मवाहना
verses.transliteration: samīkṣyā satpratiṣṭhā ca nivṛttirjñānapāragā / dharmaśāstrārthakuśalā dharmajñā dharmavāhanā
verses.translation: It was endowed with all Saktis, was extremely pure (white), omniformed, eternal, its lotus-like feet were revered by gods Brahma, Indra, Upendra (Visnu) and prominent Yogins.
verses.hindi: प्राचीन कालमें वेनके पुत्र पृथुके पैतामह नामक सूतः पौराणिको जज्ञे मायारूपः स्वयं हरि:
verses.wordMeaning: It was endowed with all Saktis, was extremely pure (white), omniformed, eternal, its lotus-like feet were revered by gods Brahma, Indra, Upendra (Visnu) and prominent Yogins.
verses.commentary: Sense: It was endowed with all Saktis, was extremely pure (white), omniformed, eternal, its lotus-like feet were revered by gods Brahma, Indra, Upendra (Visnu) and prominent Yogins.

verses.sanskrit: धर्माधर्मविनिर्मात्री धार्मिकाणां शिवप्रदा । धर्मशक्तिर्धर्ममयी विधर्मा विश्वधर्मिणी
verses.transliteration: dharmādharmavinirmātrī dhārmikāṇāṃ śivapradā / dharmaśaktirdharmamayī vidharmā viśvadharmiṇī
verses.translation: It had hands and feet all round, had eyes, heads and faces in all directions. He saw that Supreme Goddess stand¬ ing before enveloping the universe.
verses.hindi: प्रवक्ता सर्वशास्त्राणां धर्मज्ञो गुणवत्सल: । तं मां वित्त मुनिश्रेष्ठाः पूर्वोदभूतं सनातनम् श्रावयामास मां प्रीत्या पुराणं पुरुषो हरि:
verses.wordMeaning: It had hands and feet all round, had eyes, heads and faces in all directions. He saw that Supreme Goddess stand¬ ing before enveloping the universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: It had hands and feet all round, had eyes, heads and faces in all directions. He saw that Supreme Goddess stand¬ ing before enveloping the universe.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मान्तरा धर्ममेघा धर्मपूर्वा धनावहा । धर्मोपदेष्ट्री धर्मत्मा धर्मगम्या धराधरा
verses.transliteration: dharmāntarā dharmameghā dharmapūrvā dhanāvahā / dharmopadeṣṭrī dharmatmā dharmagamyā dharādharā
verses.translation: On seeing such a form of the Goddess, the form associated with Mahesvara, that king was overwhelmed with awe and was yet delighted at heart.
verses.hindi: तेषां पुराणवक्तृत्वं वृत्तिरासीदजाज्ञया सार्वभौमो महातेजाः स्वधर्मपरिपालकः
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing such a form of the Goddess, the form associated with Mahesvara, that king was overwhelmed with awe and was yet delighted at heart.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing such a form of the Goddess, the form associated with Mahesvara, that king was overwhelmed with awe and was yet delighted at heart.

verses.sanskrit: कापाली शाकला मूर्तिः कला कलितविग्रहा । सर्वशक्तिविनिर्मुक्ता सर्वशक्त्याश्रयाश्रया
verses.transliteration: kāpālī śākalā mūrtiḥ kalā kalitavigrahā / sarvaśaktivinirmuktā sarvaśaktyāśrayāśrayā
verses.translation: Concentrating his mind in his Atman and remem¬ bering Onkara, he eulogised the Supreme Goddess with a thou¬ sand and eight epithets.
verses.hindi: तस्य बाल्यात् प्रभृत्येव भक्तिर्नारायणेऽभवत्। गोवर्धनगिरिं प्राप्य तपस्तेपे जितेन्द्रियः तपसा भगवान् प्रीतः शङ्खचक्रगदाधरः । आगत्य देवो राजानं प्राह दामोदरः स्वयम्
verses.wordMeaning: Concentrating his mind in his Atman and remem¬ bering Onkara, he eulogised the Supreme Goddess with a thou¬ sand and eight epithets.
verses.commentary: Sense: Concentrating his mind in his Atman and remem¬ bering Onkara, he eulogised the Supreme Goddess with a thou¬ sand and eight epithets.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वा सर्वेश्वरी सूक्ष्मा सुसूक्ष्मा ज्ञानरूपिणी । प्रधानपुरुषेशेशा महादेवैकसाक्षिणी । सदाशिवा वियन्मूर्तिर्विश्वमूर्तिरमूर्तिका
verses.transliteration: sarvā sarveśvarī sūkṣmā susūkṣmā jñānarūpiṇī / pradhānapuruṣeśeśā mahādevaikasākṣiṇī / sadāśivā viyanmūrtirviśvamūrtiramūrtikā
verses.translation: 'O Siva, Uma, the great Sakti, Ananta, (Endless) Jifkala (perfect), Amala (the pure), Santa (the quiescent), Mahesvari, NUya (eternal), Sasvatl (permanent). Paramo, (the supreme), Akara (the imperishable).
verses.hindi: धार्मिको रूपसम्पन्नौ सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरौ। एवमुक्त्वा हृषीकेशः स्वकीयां प्रकृतिं गतः
verses.wordMeaning: 'O Siva, Uma, the great Sakti, Ananta, (Endless) Jifkala (perfect), Amala (the pure), Santa (the quiescent), Mahesvari, NUya (eternal), Sasvatl (permanent). Paramo, (the supreme), Akara (the imperishable).
verses.commentary: Sense: 'O Siva, Uma, the great Sakti, Ananta, (Endless) Jifkala (perfect), Amala (the pure), Santa (the quiescent), Mahesvari, NUya (eternal), Sasvatl (permanent). Paramo, (the supreme), Akara (the imperishable).

verses.sanskrit: एवं नाम्नां सहस्त्रेण स्तुत्वासौ हिमवान् गिरिः । भूयः प्रणम्य भीतात्मा प्रोवाचेदं कृताञ्जलिः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ nāmnāṃ sahastreṇa stutvāsau himavān giriḥ / bhūyaḥ praṇamya bhītātmā provācedaṃ kṛtāñjaliḥ
verses.translation: Acintya (Incomprehensible), Kevald (Absolute) An-
verses.hindi: वैन्योऽपि वेदविधिना निश्चलां भक्तिमुद्वहन्। अपालयत् स्वकं राज्यं न्यायेन मधुसूदने अचिरादेव तन्वङ्गी भार्या तस्य शुचिस्मिता। शिखण्डिनं हविर्धानमन्तर्धाना व्यजायत
verses.wordMeaning: Acintya (Incomprehensible), Kevald (Absolute) An-
verses.commentary: Sense: Acintya (Incomprehensible), Kevald (Absolute) An-

verses.sanskrit: यदेतदैश्वरं रूपं घोरं ते परमेश्वरि । भीतो ऽस्मि साम्प्रतं दृष्ट्वा रूपमन्यत् प्रदर्शय
verses.transliteration: yadetadaiśvaraṃ rūpaṃ ghoraṃ te parameśvari / bhīto 'smi sāmprataṃ dṛṣṭvā rūpamanyat pradarśaya
verses.translation: Ekdnekavibhdgasthd* (stationed in one as well as in many divisions). Mdydtitd (transcending Maya), Sunirmald (ex¬ tremely pure), Mahd-Maheivari, Satyd, Mahddevi, Nirarijand (the untainted).
verses.hindi: धार्मिको रूपसम्पन्नो वेदवेदाङ्गपारगः सोऽधीत्य विधिवद् वेदान् धर्मेण तपसि स्थितः । मतिं चक्रे भाग्ययोगात् संन्यासं प्रति धर्मवित्
verses.wordMeaning: Ekdnekavibhdgasthd* (stationed in one as well as in many divisions). Mdydtitd (transcending Maya), Sunirmald (ex¬ tremely pure), Mahd-Maheivari, Satyd, Mahddevi, Nirarijand (the untainted).
verses.commentary: Sense: Ekdnekavibhdgasthd* (stationed in one as well as in many divisions). Mdydtitd (transcending Maya), Sunirmald (ex¬ tremely pure), Mahd-Maheivari, Satyd, Mahddevi, Nirarijand (the untainted).

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्ताथ सा देवी तेन शैलेन पार्वती । संहृत्य दर्शयामास स्वरूपमपरं पुनः
verses.transliteration: evamuktātha sā devī tena śailena pārvatī / saṃhṛtya darśayāmāsa svarūpamaparaṃ punaḥ
verses.translation: Ka}(ha (the highest point), Sarvantarastha (abiding in the hearts of all), Cicchakti (the power of conscious¬ ness), Atilalasd highly solicitous, Nanda (delightful one) Sarvdtmika (of the soul of all), Vidyd (learning), Jyoti-rupd (the embodiment of brilliance), Amrtd (immortal), Akfard (imperish¬ able ).
verses.hindi: स कृत्वा तीर्थसंसेवां स्वाध्याये तपसि स्थितः । जगाम हिमवत्पृष्ठं कदाचित् सिद्धसेवितम् तत्र धर्मपदं नाम धर्मसिद्द्रिप्रदं वनम्। अपश्यद् योगिनां गम्यमगम्यं ब्रह्मविद्विषाम्
verses.wordMeaning: Ka}(ha (the highest point), Sarvantarastha (abiding in the hearts of all), Cicchakti (the power of conscious¬ ness), Atilalasd highly solicitous, Nanda (delightful one) Sarvdtmika (of the soul of all), Vidyd (learning), Jyoti-rupd (the embodiment of brilliance),…
verses.commentary: Sense: Ka}(ha (the highest point), Sarvantarastha (abiding in the hearts of all), Cicchakti (the power of conscious¬ ness), Atilalasd highly solicitous, Nanda (delightful one) Sarvdtmika (of the soul of all), Vidyd (learning), Jyoti-rupd (the embodiment of brilliance),…

verses.sanskrit: नीलोत्पलदलप्रख्यं नीलोत्पलसुगन्धिकम् । द्विनेत्रं द्विभुजं सौम्यं नीलालकविभूषितम्
verses.transliteration: nīlotpaladalaprakhyaṃ nīlotpalasugandhikam / dvinetraṃ dvibhujaṃ saumyaṃ nīlālakavibhūṣitam
verses.translation: Sdnti (peace), Pratifthd {the stability), JVivrtti (renun¬ ciation), Amrtapradd (bestower of immortality), Vyomamurti (having ether as her form), Vyomdlayd (the seat of dissolution of the firmament), Vyomddhdrd (support of the firmament), Acyutd (the unswerving), Amard (the immortal).
verses.hindi: यज्ञ करते समय मायारूपधारी साक्षात् विष्णु ही पौराणिक सूतके रूपमें उत्पन्न हुए। वे सभी शास्त्रोंके प्रवक्ता, धर्मको जाननेवाले तथा वात्सल्यगुणसे सम्पन्न थे। मुनिश्रेष्ठो! प्राचीन कालमें आविर्भूत वही सनातन (विष्णु) मुझे जानो! इस मन्वन्तरमें स्वयं कुष्णद्वैपायन व्यास नामक पुराणपुरुष विष्णुने प्रीतिपूर्वक मुझे पुराण सुनाया। मेरे वंशमें वेदवर्जित जो सूत उत्पन्न हुए, ब्रह्माको आज्ञासे 'पुराणोंका प्रवचन करना” उनको वृत्ति
verses.wordMeaning: Sdnti (peace), Pratifthd {the stability), JVivrtti (renun¬ ciation), Amrtapradd (bestower of immortality), Vyomamurti (having ether as her form), Vyomdlayd (the seat of dissolution of the firmament), Vyomddhdrd (support of the firmament), Acyutd (the unswerving),…
verses.commentary: Sense: Sdnti (peace), Pratifthd {the stability), JVivrtti (renun¬ ciation), Amrtapradd (bestower of immortality), Vyomamurti (having ether as her form), Vyomdlayd (the seat of dissolution of the firmament), Vyomddhdrd (support of the firmament), Acyutd (the unswerving),…

verses.sanskrit: रक्तपादाम्बुजतलं सुरक्तकरपल्लवम् । श्रीमद् विशालसंवृत्तललाटतिलकोज्ज्वलम्
verses.transliteration: raktapādāmbujatalaṃ suraktakarapallavam / śrīmad viśālasaṃvṛttalalāṭatilakojjvalam
verses.translation: Anddinidhand (having neither beginning nor destruc¬ tion), Amoghd (un-failing), Kdrandtmd (the Soul of the cause), Akuldkuld (much agitated), Svatah* prathamajd (self-born at the outset), Amrtasya JVdbhi (navel of immortality), Atmasarhsrayd (the self-supporting or abiding in the self).
verses.hindi: वेनके पुत्र वे पृथु बुद्धिमान्, सत्यसंकल्प, जितेन्द्रिय, सम्पूर्ण पृथ्वीके स्वामी, महान् तेजस्वी तथा अपने धर्मका पालन करनेवाले थे। उनकी बाल्यकालसे ही नारायणमें भक्ति थी । इन्द्रियजयी पृथुने गोवर्धन पर्वतपर जाकर तप किया। शंख, चक्र तथा गदा धारण करनेवाले भगवान् विष्णु तपस्यासे प्रसन्न हो गये। स्वयं भगवान् दामोदर (विष्णु)-ने उनके पास आकर कहा--मेरी कृपासे निश्चित ही तुम्हें सुन्दर रूपसे
verses.wordMeaning: Anddinidhand (having neither beginning nor destruc¬ tion), Amoghd (un-failing), Kdrandtmd (the Soul of the cause), Akuldkuld (much agitated), Svatah* prathamajd (self-born at the outset), Amrtasya JVdbhi (navel of immortality),…
verses.commentary: Sense: Anddinidhand (having neither beginning nor destruc¬ tion), Amoghd (un-failing), Kdrandtmd (the Soul of the cause), Akuldkuld (much agitated), Svatah* prathamajd (self-born at the outset), Amrtasya JVdbhi (navel of immortality),…

verses.sanskrit: भूषितं चारुसर्वाङ्गं भूषणैरतिकोमलम् । दधानमुरसा मालां विशालां हेमनिर्मिताम्
verses.transliteration: bhūṣitaṃ cārusarvāṅgaṃ bhūṣaṇairatikomalam / dadhānamurasā mālāṃ viśālāṃ hemanirmitām
verses.translation: Prdnevarapriyd (beloved of her loving husband), Mdtd (the mother), Makd-Mahi}avdhinP (riding on the great Buffalo) (v.l. Ghdtini the'kiWer oi the great buffalo), Prdneivari (goddess of the vital breath), Prdnarupd (embodiment of vital breath) PradhdnapurueSvari (the controller of Pradhdna and Purufa ).
verses.hindi: सम्पन्न, सभी शस्त्रधारियोंमें श्रेष्ठ दो धर्मात्मा पुत्र होंगे। ऐसा कहकर भगवान् हषीकेश अपने प्राकृतिक रूपमें स्थित हो गये (अपने धाम चले गये)। वैन्य (पृथु) भी भगवान् मधुसूदनमें वैदिक विधानसे निश्चल भक्ति रखते हुए न्यायपूर्वक अपने राज्यका पालन करने लगे॥ १६--२०॥
verses.wordMeaning: Prdnevarapriyd (beloved of her loving husband), Mdtd (the mother), Makd-Mahi}avdhinP (riding on the great Buffalo) (v.l. Ghdtini the'kiWer oi the great buffalo), Prdneivari (goddess of the vital breath),…
verses.commentary: Sense: Prdnevarapriyd (beloved of her loving husband), Mdtd (the mother), Makd-Mahi}avdhinP (riding on the great Buffalo) (v.l. Ghdtini the'kiWer oi the great buffalo), Prdneivari (goddess of the vital breath),…

verses.sanskrit: ईषत्स्मितं सुविम्बोष्ठं नूपुरारावसंयुतम् । प्रसन्नवदनं दिव्यमनन्तमहिमास्पदम्
verses.transliteration: īṣatsmitaṃ suvimboṣṭhaṃ nūpurārāvasaṃyutam / prasannavadanaṃ divyamanantamahimāspadam
verses.translation: Mahamaya, Sudufpura (very difficult to be filled up), Mulaprakrti (the original) Prakrti, Iharl, SarvaJaktikaldkdrd (possessing all potencies, arts or Kalds and shapes), Jyotsnd (moon-light), Dyau (the firmament of moonlight), Mahimdspadd (the cause of grandeur).
verses.hindi: मधुर एवं पवित्र मुसकानवाली तथा कृश शरीरवाली उनकी पत्नी अन्तर्धानाने थोडे ही समयमें शिखण्डी तथा हविर्धान नामक दो पुत्रोंको जन्म दिया। शिखण्डीका पुत्र 'सुशील' नामसे प्रसिद्ध हुआ। वह धार्मिक, रूपसम्पन्न तथा वेद-वेदाङ्गका पारगामी विद्वान् था। विधिपूर्वक वेदोंका अध्ययन कर वह धर्मपूर्वक तपस्यामें स्थित हुआ। भाग्ययोगसे उस धर्मज्ञने संन्यास ग्रहण करनेका विचार किया। वह तीर्थस्थानोंका सेवन करते
verses.wordMeaning: Mahamaya, Sudufpura (very difficult to be filled up), Mulaprakrti (the original) Prakrti, Iharl, SarvaJaktikaldkdrd (possessing all potencies, arts or Kalds and shapes), Jyotsnd (moon-light), Dyau (the firmament of moonlight), Mahimdspadd (the cause of grandeur).
verses.commentary: Sense: Mahamaya, Sudufpura (very difficult to be filled up), Mulaprakrti (the original) Prakrti, Iharl, SarvaJaktikaldkdrd (possessing all potencies, arts or Kalds and shapes), Jyotsnd (moon-light), Dyau (the firmament of moonlight), Mahimdspadd (the cause of grandeur).

verses.sanskrit: तदीदृशं समालोक्य स्वरूपं शैलसत्तमः । भीतिं संत्यज्य हृष्टात्मा बभाषे परमेश्वरीम्
verses.transliteration: tadīdṛśaṃ samālokya svarūpaṃ śailasattamaḥ / bhītiṃ saṃtyajya hṛṣṭātmā babhāṣe parameśvarīm
verses.translation: Sarvakdyaniyantri (the controller of all bodies) Sana bhutehareivari (the goddess of the Lord of all living beings).
verses.hindi: हुए स्वाध्याय तथा तपस्यामें स्थित रहने लगा। एक बार वह सिद्धोंके द्वारा सेवित हिमालय पर्वतपर गया। वहाँ उसने धर्म एवं सिद्धिको प्रदान करनेवाले, योगियोंके लिये प्राप्य, किंतु ब्रह्मसे द्वेष करनेवालोंके लिये अप्राप्य धर्मपद नामक एक वनको देखा
verses.wordMeaning: Sarvakdyaniyantri (the controller of all bodies) Sana bhutehareivari (the goddess of the Lord of all living beings).
verses.commentary: Sense: Sarvakdyaniyantri (the controller of all bodies) Sana bhutehareivari (the goddess of the Lord of all living beings).

verses.sanskrit: हिमवानुवाच अद्य मे सफलं जन्म अद्य मे सफलं तपः । यन्मे साक्षात् त्वमव्यक्ताप्रसन्ना दृष्टिगोचरा
verses.transliteration: himavānuvāca adya me saphalaṃ janma adya me saphalaṃ tapaḥ / yanme sākṣāt tvamavyaktāprasannā dṛṣṭigocarā
verses.translation: Sarhsdrapota (a raft for crossing the ocean o f worldly existence), Durvdrd (unthwartable), Durniriksyd (difficult to be seen), Z)«raj< 2 (fa (inaccessible), Prdnahkti (the vital energy and power), Prdnavidyd (lore of vital breath), Yogini, Paramd kald (the Supreme art).
verses.hindi: मन्दाकिनीजले स्नात्वा संतर्प्य पितृदेवताः । अर्चयित्वा महादेवं पुष्पैः पद्योत्पलादिभिः अधास्मिन्नन्तरेऽपश्यत् समायान्तं महामुनिम्। श्वेताश्वतरनामानं महापाशुपतोत्तमम्
verses.wordMeaning: Sarhsdrapota (a raft for crossing the ocean o f worldly existence), Durvdrd (unthwartable), Durniriksyd (difficult to be seen), Z)«raj< 2 (fa (inaccessible), Prdnahkti (the vital energy and power), Prdnavidyd (lore of vital breath), Yogini, Paramd kald (the Supreme art).
verses.commentary: Sense: Sarhsdrapota (a raft for crossing the ocean o f worldly existence), Durvdrd (unthwartable), Durniriksyd (difficult to be seen), Z)«raj< 2 (fa (inaccessible), Prdnahkti (the vital energy and power), Prdnavidyd (lore of vital breath), Yogini, Paramd kald (the Supreme art).

verses.sanskrit: त्वया सृष्टं जगत् सर्वं प्रधानाद्यन्त्वयि स्थितम् । त्वय्येव लीयते देवि त्वमेव च परा गतिः
verses.transliteration: tvayā sṛṣṭaṃ jagat sarvaṃ pradhānādyantvayi sthitam / tvayyeva līyate devi tvameva ca parā gatiḥ
verses.translation: Mahdvibhuti (the great magnificence), Durdhard (un- slightdihle.), Mulaprakrtisambhavd (born of the primordial nature), Anddyanantavibhavd (having beginningless and endless prosperity), Paramddyd (the earliest one), Apakarsini (who removes away).
verses.hindi: भस्मसंदिग्धसर्वाङ्गं कोपीनाच्छादनान्वितम् । तपसा कर्षितात्मानं शुक्लयज्ञोपवीतिनम् योगीश्वरोऽद्य भगवान् दृष्टो योगविदां वरः
verses.wordMeaning: Mahdvibhuti (the great magnificence), Durdhard (un- slightdihle.), Mulaprakrtisambhavd (born of the primordial nature), Anddyanantavibhavd (having beginningless and endless prosperity), Paramddyd (the earliest one), Apakarsini (who removes away).
verses.commentary: Sense: Mahdvibhuti (the great magnificence), Durdhard (un- slightdihle.), Mulaprakrtisambhavd (born of the primordial nature), Anddyanantavibhavd (having beginningless and endless prosperity), Paramddyd (the earliest one), Apakarsini (who removes away).

verses.sanskrit: वदन्ति केचित् त्वामेव प्रकृतिं प्रकृतेः पराम् । अपरे परमार्थज्ञाः शिवेति शिवसंश्रये
verses.transliteration: vadanti kecit tvāmeva prakṛtiṃ prakṛteḥ parām / apare paramārthajñāḥ śiveti śivasaṃśraye
verses.translation: Sargasthityantakdrani {the. cdMse. oi creation, sustenance and annihilation of the universe), Sudurvdcyd (very difficult to be described), Duratyayd (very difficult to be surmounted), Sabda- yoni (the source of origin of words and sounds), Sabdamayi (of the form of sounds), Ndddkhyd (Having the epithet 'sound'), Nddamgrahd (having Ndda as the physical body, an embodiment of sound).
verses.hindi: किं करिष्यामि शिष्योऽहं तव मां पालयानघ सोऽनुगृह्याथ राजानं सुशीलं शीलसंयुतम्। शिष्यत्वे परिजग्राह तपसा क्षीणकल्मषम्
verses.wordMeaning: Sargasthityantakdrani {the. cdMse. oi creation, sustenance and annihilation of the universe), Sudurvdcyd (very difficult to be described), Duratyayd (very difficult to be surmounted), Sabda- yoni (the source of origin of words and sounds), Sabdamayi (of the form of sounds),…
verses.commentary: Sense: Sargasthityantakdrani {the. cdMse. oi creation, sustenance and annihilation of the universe), Sudurvdcyd (very difficult to be described), Duratyayd (very difficult to be surmounted), Sabda- yoni (the source of origin of words and sounds), Sabdamayi (of the form of sounds),…

verses.sanskrit: त्वयि प्रधानं पुरुषो महान् ब्रह्मा तथेश्वरः । अविद्या नियतिर्माया कलाद्याः शतशो ऽभवन्
verses.transliteration: tvayi pradhānaṃ puruṣo mahān brahmā tatheśvaraḥ / avidyā niyatirmāyā kalādyāḥ śataśo 'bhavan
verses.translation: Anddi (beginningless), Avyaktagund (having unmani¬
verses.hindi: सांन्यासिकं विधिं कृत्स्नं कारयित्वा विचक्षणः । ददौ तहैश्वरं ज्ञानं स्वशाखाविहितं व्रतम् अन्त्याश्रममिति ख्यातं ब्रह्मादिभिरनुष्ठितम्
verses.wordMeaning: Anddi (beginningless), Avyaktagund (having unmani¬
verses.commentary: Sense: Anddi (beginningless), Avyaktagund (having unmani¬

verses.sanskrit: त्वं हि सा परमा शक्तिरनन्ता परमेष्ठिनी । सर्वभेदविनिर्मुक्ता सर्वेभेदाश्रया निजा
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ hi sā paramā śaktiranantā parameṣṭhinī / sarvabhedavinirmuktā sarvebhedāśrayā nijā
verses.translation: Mahamaya, Suduspdrd (very difficult to cross), Mula- prakrti, Ihari, Pradhdmpurusdtitd (beyond Pradhdna and Purufa), Pradhdnapuru.sdtmikd (the soul of Prakrti and Purufa).
verses.hindi: वहाँ सिद्धोंके आश्रमसे सुशोभित तथा विभिन्न प्रकारके कमल-समूहोंसे सम्पन्न निर्मल जलवाली तथा पुण्य प्रदान करनेवाली मन्दाकिनी नामक एक नदी नदीके दक्षिण किनारेपर स्थित मुनीन्द्रं तथा योगियोंसे सेवित पुण्यदायी एक रमणीय आश्रम देखा। उसने मन्दाकिनीके जलमें स्नानकर देवस्वरूप पितरोंको (तर्पण आदिसे) संतृप्तकर विभिन्न वर्णके कमल आदि पुष्पोंके
verses.wordMeaning: Mahamaya, Suduspdrd (very difficult to cross), Mula- prakrti, Ihari, Pradhdmpurusdtitd (beyond Pradhdna and Purufa), Pradhdnapuru.sdtmikd (the soul of Prakrti and Purufa).
verses.commentary: Sense: Mahamaya, Suduspdrd (very difficult to cross), Mula- prakrti, Ihari, Pradhdmpurusdtitd (beyond Pradhdna and Purufa), Pradhdnapuru.sdtmikd (the soul of Prakrti and Purufa).

verses.sanskrit: त्वामधिष्ठाय योगेशि महादेवो महेश्वरः । प्रधानाद्यं जगत् कृत्स्नं करोति विकरोति च
verses.transliteration: tvāmadhiṣṭhāya yogeśi mahādevo maheśvaraḥ / pradhānādyaṃ jagat kṛtsnaṃ karoti vikaroti ca
verses.translation: Purdnd (the ancient one), Cinrmyi (of the form of consciousness), Purfisdm Adi Purufa Rupini (of the form of the primeval Person), Bhutdntarasthd (stationed in the heart ofliving beings), Kutasthd (abiding in the soul oi?l\\), Mahdpurasarh- jnitd (termed as a great Purusa).
verses.hindi: द्वारा भगवान् शंकरको अर्चना की और सूर्यमण्डलमें स्थित भगवान् ईशानका ध्यानकर सिरसे हाथ जोडते हुए प्रकाशमान सूर्यका दर्शन करते हुए वह रुद्राष्टाध्यायी, रुद्रके चरित्र एवं और भी अनेक वेदवर्णित विविध प्रकारके शिव-सम्बन्धी स्तोत्रोंके द्वारा परमेश्वर गिरिशकी स्तुति करने लगा
verses.wordMeaning: Purdnd (the ancient one), Cinrmyi (of the form of consciousness), Purfisdm Adi Purufa Rupini (of the form of the primeval Person), Bhutdntarasthd (stationed in the heart ofliving beings), Kutasthd (abiding in the soul oi?l\\), Mahdpurasarh- jnitd (termed as a great Purusa).
verses.commentary: Sense: Purdnd (the ancient one), Cinrmyi (of the form of consciousness), Purfisdm Adi Purufa Rupini (of the form of the primeval Person), Bhutdntarasthd (stationed in the heart ofliving beings), Kutasthd (abiding in the soul oi?l\\), Mahdpurasarh- jnitd (termed as a great Purusa).

verses.sanskrit: त्वयैव संगतो देवः स्वमानन्दं समश्नुते । त्वमेव परमानन्दस्त्वमेवानन्ददायिनी
verses.transliteration: tvayaiva saṃgato devaḥ svamānandaṃ samaśnute / tvameva paramānandastvamevānandadāyinī
verses.translation: KfetrajfiaJakti (Potency of the soul), Avyaktalakana (of unmanifest characteristics), Malavarjita (Devoid of dirt or impurities), Anadimayasambhinna (who is distinct from the primor¬ dial Maya), Tritattva (having three principles), Prakrtigrahd (having a grasp on Prakrti).
verses.hindi: इसी बीच उसने समस्त अङ्गोंमें भस्म लगाये हुए, कोपीन वस्त्रसे समन्वित, सफेद यज्ञोपवीत धारण किये हुए, तपस्याके द्वारा क्षीण शरीरवाले उत्तम महापाशुपत श्वेताश्वतर नामवाले महामुनिको समीपमें आते हुए देखा। नेत्रोंमें आनन्दाश्रु भरे हुए उसने भगवान् शंकरकी स्तुति समाप्त कर उनके चरणोंमें सिरसे प्रणाम किया और हाथ जोड़ते हुए यह वाक्य कहा-
verses.wordMeaning: KfetrajfiaJakti (Potency of the soul), Avyaktalakana (of unmanifest characteristics), Malavarjita (Devoid of dirt or impurities), Anadimayasambhinna (who is distinct from the primor¬ dial Maya), Tritattva (having three principles), Prakrtigrahd (having a grasp on Prakrti).
verses.commentary: Sense: KfetrajfiaJakti (Potency of the soul), Avyaktalakana (of unmanifest characteristics), Malavarjita (Devoid of dirt or impurities), Anadimayasambhinna (who is distinct from the primor¬ dial Maya), Tritattva (having three principles), Prakrtigrahd (having a grasp on Prakrti).

verses.sanskrit: त्वमक्षरं परं व्योम महज्ज्योतिर्निरञ्जनम् । शिवं सर्वगतं सूक्ष्मं परं ब्रह्मा सनातनम्
verses.transliteration: tvamakṣaraṃ paraṃ vyoma mahajjyotirnirañjanam / śivaṃ sarvagataṃ sūkṣmaṃ paraṃ brahmā sanātanam
verses.translation: MahamayasamutpannS (Born of great Maya), Tdmasi
verses.hindi: में धन्य हूँ, में अनुगृहीत हूँ, जो (आज) मुझे योगज्ञानियोंमें श्रेष्ठ, मुनियोंके ईश्वर साक्षात् भगवान् योगीश्वरके दर्शन हुए। अहो! मेरा बड़ा ही सुन्दर भाग्य है। (आज) मेरे सभी तप सफल हो गये। अनघ! मैं क्या करूँ, आपका मैं शिष्य हूँ, आप मेरी रक्षा करें
verses.wordMeaning: MahamayasamutpannS (Born of great Maya), Tdmasi
verses.commentary: Sense: MahamayasamutpannS (Born of great Maya), Tdmasi

verses.sanskrit: त्वं शक्रः सर्वदेवानां ब्रह्मा ब्रह्मविदामसि । वायुर्बलवतां देवि योगिनां त्वं कुमारकः
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ śakraḥ sarvadevānāṃ brahmā brahmavidāmasi / vāyurbalavatāṃ devi yogināṃ tvaṃ kumārakaḥ
verses.translation: Akdryd (non-effect), Kdryajanani (cause of effect), J\fityam prasavadharmini (having the attribute of continuous procreation), Sargapralayanirmuktd (free from the creation and dissolution), Srtisthityantadharminl (having the attributes of creation, sustenance and annihilation).
verses.hindi: तपस्यासे जिसका सम्पूर्ण कल्मष नष्ट हो गया है, ऐसे उस निष्पाप एवं शीलसम्पन्न 'सुशील' नामवाले राजाके ऊपर अनुग्रह करके (शंकरने अपने) शिष्यरूपमें उसे ग्रहण किया। उन बुद्धिमान् (मुनि)-ने संन्यास- सम्बन्धी सम्पूर्ण विधि करवाकर उसे ईश्वर-सम्बन्धी
verses.wordMeaning: Akdryd (non-effect), Kdryajanani (cause of effect), J\fityam prasavadharmini (having the attribute of continuous procreation), Sargapralayanirmuktd (free from the creation and dissolution), Srtisthityantadharminl (having the attributes of creation, sustenance and annihilation).
verses.commentary: Sense: Akdryd (non-effect), Kdryajanani (cause of effect), J\fityam prasavadharmini (having the attribute of continuous procreation), Sargapralayanirmuktd (free from the creation and dissolution), Srtisthityantadharminl (having the attributes of creation, sustenance and annihilation).

verses.sanskrit: ऋषीणां च वसिष्ठस्त्वं व्यासो वेदविदामसि । सांख्यानां कपिलो देवो रुद्राणामसि शङ्करः
verses.transliteration: ṛṣīṇāṃ ca vasiṣṭhastvaṃ vyāso vedavidāmasi / sāṃkhyānāṃ kapilo devo rudrāṇāmasi śaṅkaraḥ
verses.translation: Brahmagarbhd (having Brahman in the womb), Catur-
verses.hindi: जीवके पाश अर्थात् मायारूपी बन्धनसे मुक्त करनेवाला वह सम्पूर्ण वेदका सार प्रदान किया, साथ ही ब्रह्मा आदिके द्वारा सेवित 'अन्त्याश्रम' नामवाले आश्रमको भी प्रदान किया ब्राह्मणान् क्षत्रियान् वैश्यान् ब्रह्मचर्यपरायणान्
verses.wordMeaning: Brahmagarbhd (having Brahman in the womb), Catur-
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahmagarbhd (having Brahman in the womb), Catur-

verses.transliteration: adhyātmavidyā vidyānāṃ gatīnāṃ param gatiḥ / māyā tvaṃ sarvaśaktīnāṃ kālaḥ kalayatāmasi
verses.translation: Mahiyasi (very great), Brahmayoni (source of origin of Brahma), Mahdlakfmi-samudbhavd (born of MahalaksmI), Mahd- mmdna-madhyasthd (stationed in the middle of the great Vimdna

verses.wordMeaning: Mahiyasi (very great), Brahmayoni (source of origin of Brahma), Mahdlakfmi-samudbhavd (born of MahalaksmI), Mahd- mmdna-madhyasthd (stationed in the middle of the great Vimdna
verses.commentary: Sense: Mahiyasi (very great), Brahmayoni (source of origin of Brahma), Mahdlakfmi-samudbhavd (born of MahalaksmI), Mahd- mmdna-madhyasthd (stationed in the middle of the great Vimdna

verses.sanskrit: ओङ्कारः सर्वगुह्यानां वर्णानां च द्विजात्तमः । आश्रमाणां च गार्हस्थ्यमीश्वराणां महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: oṅkāraḥ sarvaguhyānāṃ varṇānāṃ ca dvijāttamaḥ / āśramāṇāṃ ca gārhasthyamīśvarāṇāṃ maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Sarvasddhdrani (common to all), Suksmd (subtle), Avidyd (nescience), Paramdrtkikd (the real entity), Anantarupd (of infinite form), Anantasthd (stationed in the infinite), Devi (Lumi¬ nous), Puruamohini (fascinator of the Purusa),
verses.hindi: इहैब मुनयः पूर्व मरीच्याद्या महेश्वरम्। दृष्टा तपोबलाज्ज्ञानं लेभिरे सार्वकालिकम् एवमाभाष्य विप्रेन्द्रो देवं ध्यात्वा पिनाकिनम्। आचचक्षे महामन्त्रं यथावत् स्वार्थसिद्धये
verses.wordMeaning: Sarvasddhdrani (common to all), Suksmd (subtle), Avidyd (nescience), Paramdrtkikd (the real entity), Anantarupd (of infinite form), Anantasthd (stationed in the infinite), Devi (Lumi¬ nous), Puruamohini (fascinator of the Purusa),
verses.commentary: Sense: Sarvasddhdrani (common to all), Suksmd (subtle), Avidyd (nescience), Paramdrtkikd (the real entity), Anantarupd (of infinite form), Anantasthd (stationed in the infinite), Devi (Lumi¬ nous), Puruamohini (fascinator of the Purusa),

verses.sanskrit: पुंसां त्वमेकः पुरुषः सर्वभूतहृदि स्थितः । सर्वोपनिषदां देवि गुह्योपनिषदुच्यते
verses.transliteration: puṃsāṃ tvamekaḥ puruṣaḥ sarvabhūtahṛdi sthitaḥ / sarvopaniṣadāṃ devi guhyopaniṣaducyate
verses.translation: Vairdgyaiharyadharmdtmd (of the nature of detach¬
verses.hindi: सर्वपापोपशमनं वेदसारं विमुक्तिदम्। अग्निरित्यादिकं पुण्यमृषिभिः सम्प्रवर्तितम् सोऽपि तद्वचनाद् राजा सुशीलः श्रद्धयान्वितः । साक्षात् पाशुपतो भूत्वा वेदाभ्यासरतोऽभवत्
verses.wordMeaning: Vairdgyaiharyadharmdtmd (of the nature of detach¬
verses.commentary: Sense: Vairdgyaiharyadharmdtmd (of the nature of detach¬

verses.sanskrit: ईशानश्चासि कल्पानां युगानां कृतमेव च । आदित्यः सर्वमार्गाणां वाचां देवि सरस्वती
verses.transliteration: īśānaścāsi kalpānāṃ yugānāṃ kṛtameva ca / ādityaḥ sarvamārgāṇāṃ vācāṃ devi sarasvatī
verses.translation: Hvardni (the consort of Isvara), Sarvdni (wife of Sarva), ankardrdhasaririni (forming half the person of Sankara), Bhavdni, Rudrdni, Mahdlaksmi, Ambikd.
verses.hindi: प्राचीनबर्हिर्भगवान् सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरः। समुद्रतनयायां वै दश पुत्रानजीजनत् प्रचेतसस्ते विख्याता राजानः प्रथितौजसः । अधीतवन्तः स्वं वेदं नारायणपरायणाः
verses.wordMeaning: Hvardni (the consort of Isvara), Sarvdni (wife of Sarva), ankardrdhasaririni (forming half the person of Sankara), Bhavdni, Rudrdni, Mahdlaksmi, Ambikd.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hvardni (the consort of Isvara), Sarvdni (wife of Sarva), ankardrdhasaririni (forming half the person of Sankara), Bhavdni, Rudrdni, Mahdlaksmi, Ambikd.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं लक्ष्मीश्चारुरूपाणां विष्णुर्मायाविनामसि । अरुन्धती सतीनां त्वं सुपर्णः पततामसि
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ lakṣmīścārurūpāṇāṃ viṣṇurmāyāvināmasi / arundhatī satīnāṃ tvaṃ suparṇaḥ patatāmasi
verses.translation: MaheSvarasamutpannd (Born of Mahesvara), ktiphalapradd (yielder of the fruits of enjoyment and salvation), Sarvehari (Goddess of all), Sarvavandyd (worthy of being bowed to by all), Nityarh muditamdnasd (Ever delighted in the mind).
verses.hindi: दक्षो जज्ञे महाभागो यः पूर्व ब्रह्मणः सुतः उस आश्रममें रहनेवाले ब्रह्मचर्यपरायण ब्राह्मण, क्षत्रिय तथा वैश्य शिष्योंको देखकर वे (श्वेताश्वतर मुनि) बोले-मेरे द्वारा प्रवर्तित शाखाका अध्ययन करते हुए योगीजन निष्कल महादेव शिवका ध्यान करते हुए
verses.wordMeaning: MaheSvarasamutpannd (Born of Mahesvara), ktiphalapradd (yielder of the fruits of enjoyment and salvation), Sarvehari (Goddess of all), Sarvavandyd (worthy of being bowed to by all), Nityarh muditamdnasd (Ever delighted in the mind).
verses.commentary: Sense: MaheSvarasamutpannd (Born of Mahesvara), ktiphalapradd (yielder of the fruits of enjoyment and salvation), Sarvehari (Goddess of all), Sarvavandyd (worthy of being bowed to by all), Nityarh muditamdnasd (Ever delighted in the mind).

verses.sanskrit: सूक्तानां पौरुषं सूक्तं ज्येष्ठसाम च सामसु । सावित्री चासि जप्यानां यजुषां शतरुद्रियम्
verses.transliteration: sūktānāṃ pauruṣaṃ sūktaṃ jyeṣṭhasāma ca sāmasu / sāvitrī cāsi japyānāṃ yajuṣāṃ śatarudriyam
verses.translation: Brahmendropendranamitd (Bowed to by Brahma, Indra and Upendra (Visnu), ankarecchdnuvartini (abiding by the wish of Sankara), livardrddhdsanarngatd (Occupant of half the seat of Isvara), MaheSvara-pativratd (The chaste wife of Mahesvara).
verses.hindi: यहाँ निवास करते हैं। भक्तांपर अनुकम्पा करनेके लिये भगवान् महादेव उमाके साथ रमण करते हुए यहाँ प्राचीन कालमें संसारके कल्याणकी कामनासे समस्त जगतूको धारण करनेवाले स्वयं नारायण महादेवकी आराधना करते हुए यहाँ रहते थे। यहींपर देवताओंके भी देवता भगवान् शिवको आराधना कर देवता तथा
verses.wordMeaning: Brahmendropendranamitd (Bowed to by Brahma, Indra and Upendra (Visnu), ankarecchdnuvartini (abiding by the wish of Sankara), livardrddhdsanarngatd (Occupant of half the seat of Isvara), MaheSvara-pativratd (The chaste wife of Mahesvara).
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahmendropendranamitd (Bowed to by Brahma, Indra and Upendra (Visnu), ankarecchdnuvartini (abiding by the wish of Sankara), livardrddhdsanarngatd (Occupant of half the seat of Isvara), MaheSvara-pativratd (The chaste wife of Mahesvara).

verses.sanskrit: पर्वतानां महामेरुरनन्तो भोगिनामसि । सर्वेषां त्वं परं ब्रह्म त्वन्मयं सर्वमेव हि
verses.transliteration: parvatānāṃ mahāmerurananto bhogināmasi / sarveṣāṃ tvaṃ paraṃ brahma tvanmayaṃ sarvameva hi
verses.translation: Sakrdvibkdtd (dawning but once), Sarvdrti-samudraparU- ofini (the drier-up of the ocean of everyone's distress), Pdrvati, Himavatputrl) Daughter of Himavan), Paramdnandaddyini (the bestower of highest bliss).
verses.hindi: दानवोंने महान् सिद्धि प्राप्त की थी और यहींपर प्राचीन कालमें मरीचि आदि ऋषियोंने अपनी तपस्याके प्रभावसे महेश्वरका दर्शनकर सभी कालोंमें उपयोगी-हितकर इसलिये राजेन्द्र! तुम भी तप एवं योगसे समन्वित होकर नित्य ही मेरे साथ रहो, इससे तुम सिद्धि प्राप्त करोगे। ऐसा कहकर उन ब्राह्मण-श्रेष्ठ (श्वेताश्वतर मुनि)-ने पिनाक (नामक धनुष) धारण करनेवाले
verses.wordMeaning: Sakrdvibkdtd (dawning but once), Sarvdrti-samudraparU- ofini (the drier-up of the ocean of everyone's distress), Pdrvati, Himavatputrl) Daughter of Himavan), Paramdnandaddyini (the bestower of highest bliss).
verses.commentary: Sense: Sakrdvibkdtd (dawning but once), Sarvdrti-samudraparU- ofini (the drier-up of the ocean of everyone's distress), Pdrvati, Himavatputrl) Daughter of Himavan), Paramdnandaddyini (the bestower of highest bliss).

verses.sanskrit: रूपं तवोशेषकलाविहीन- मगोचरं निर्मलमेकरूपम् । अनादिमध्यान्तमनन्तामाद्यं नमामि सत्यं तमसः परस्तात्
verses.transliteration: rūpaṃ tavośeṣakalāvihīna- magocaraṃ nirmalamekarūpam / anādimadhyāntamanantāmādyaṃ namāmi satyaṃ tamasaḥ parastāt
verses.translation: Gunddhyd (richiy ondo-wod with good qualities), Togaja (born of Yoga), Yogyd (worthy), Jndnamurti (embodiment of knowledge), VihaHni (expanding and developing), Sduitri, Kamald, Lakmi, §ri, Anantorasisthitd (stationed in the bosom of Ananta).
verses.hindi: भगवान् (शंकर)-का ध्यान करके स्वार्थ-सिद्धिके लिये सभी पापोंका शमन करनेवाले, वेदसारस्वरूप, मुक्ति प्रदान करनेवाले तथा ऋषियोंद्वारा प्रवर्तित ' अग्नि' इत्यादि पुण्यजनक महामन्त्रका उसे (सुशीलको) विधिपूर्वक उपदेश दिया। उनके कथनानुसार ' सुशील' नामक वह राजा भी बड़ी ही श्रद्धासे साक्षात् पाशुपत होकर वेदाभ्यासमें निरत हो गया॥ ४५--४८ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Gunddhyd (richiy ondo-wod with good qualities), Togaja (born of Yoga), Yogyd (worthy), Jndnamurti (embodiment of knowledge), VihaHni (expanding and developing), Sduitri, Kamald, Lakmi, §ri, Anantorasisthitd (stationed in the bosom of Ananta).
verses.commentary: Sense: Gunddhyd (richiy ondo-wod with good qualities), Togaja (born of Yoga), Yogyd (worthy), Jndnamurti (embodiment of knowledge), VihaHni (expanding and developing), Sduitri, Kamald, Lakmi, §ri, Anantorasisthitd (stationed in the bosom of Ananta).

verses.sanskrit: यदेव पश्यन्ति जगत्प्रसूतिं वेदान्तविज्ञानविनिश्चितार्थाः । आनन्दमात्रं प्रणवाभिधानं तदेव रूपं शरणं प्रपद्ये
verses.transliteration: yadeva paśyanti jagatprasūtiṃ vedāntavijñānaviniścitārthāḥ / ānandamātraṃ praṇavābhidhānaṃ tadeva rūpaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadye
verses.translation: Sarojanilayd (having lotus as her abode), Gangd, Toga- nidrd (Yogic slumber), Asurdrdini (destroyer of the Asuras), Sarasvati, Sarvavidyd (all loros), Jagajjyethd (the eldest in the universe); Sumangald (Highly auspicious),
verses.hindi: अपने सभी अङ्गोंमें भस्म धारणकर कन्द, मूल एवं फलोंका आहार करते हुए शान्त, इन्द्रियजयी एवं क्रोधजयी राजाने संन्यास-विधिका आश्रय लिया। हविर्धानने आग्नेयी नामक अपनी पत्नीसे धनुर्वेदमें पारंगत प्राचीन बर्हिष् नामक श्रेष्ठ पुत्रको उत्पन्न किया । सभी शस्त्रधारियोमें श्रेष्ठ भगवान् प्राचीनबर्हिने समुद्रकी पुत्रीसे दस पुत्रोंको उत्पन्न किया। नारायणपरायण तथा अपने तेजके लिये विख्यात प्रचेतस् नामसे प्रसिद्ध उन राजाओंने अपने
verses.wordMeaning: Sarojanilayd (having lotus as her abode), Gangd, Toga- nidrd (Yogic slumber), Asurdrdini (destroyer of the Asuras), Sarasvati, Sarvavidyd (all loros), Jagajjyethd (the eldest in the universe); Sumangald (Highly auspicious),
verses.commentary: Sense: Sarojanilayd (having lotus as her abode), Gangd, Toga- nidrd (Yogic slumber), Asurdrdini (destroyer of the Asuras), Sarasvati, Sarvavidyd (all loros), Jagajjyethd (the eldest in the universe); Sumangald (Highly auspicious),

verses.sanskrit: अशेषभूतान्तरसन्निविष्टं प्रधानपुंयोगवियोगहेतुम् । तेजोमयं जन्मविनाशहीनं प्राणाभिधानं प्रणतो ऽस्मि रूपम्
verses.transliteration: aśeṣabhūtāntarasanniviṣṭaṃ pradhānapuṃyogaviyogahetum / tejomayaṃ janmavināśahīnaṃ prāṇābhidhānaṃ praṇato 'smi rūpam
verses.translation: Vdgdevi (Goddess of speech), Varadd (granter of boons), Avdcyd (Inexpressible), Kirti (fame), Sarvdrthasddkikd
verses.hindi: वेदका अध्ययन किया। इन्हीं दस प्रचेताओंद्वार मारिषा (नामक उनकी पत्नी)-से महाभाग प्रजापति दक्ष (पुत्ररूपमें) उत्पन्न हुए, जो पूर्व समयमें ब्रह्मके पुत्र थे समायान्तं महादेवो दक्षं देव्या गृहं हरः। दृष्टा यथोचितां पूजां दक्षाय प्रददौ स्वयम्
verses.wordMeaning: Vdgdevi (Goddess of speech), Varadd (granter of boons), Avdcyd (Inexpressible), Kirti (fame), Sarvdrthasddkikd
verses.commentary: Sense: Vdgdevi (Goddess of speech), Varadd (granter of boons), Avdcyd (Inexpressible), Kirti (fame), Sarvdrthasddkikd

verses.sanskrit: आद्यन्तहीनं जगदात्मभूतं विभिन्नसंस्थं प्रकृतेः परस्तात् । कूटस्थमव्यक्तवपुस्तवैव नमामि रूपं पुरुषाभिधानम्
verses.transliteration: ādyantahīnaṃ jagadātmabhūtaṃ vibhinnasaṃsthaṃ prakṛteḥ parastāt / kūṭasthamavyaktavapustavaiva namāmi rūpaṃ puruṣābhidhānam
verses.translation: Guhyavidyd (having the secret lore), Atmavidya (the lore of Atman) Dharmavidya (the lore of piety), Atmabhdvitd (puri¬ fied byAtman), Svdhd, Vihambhard (theearth), Siddhi (super-nor¬ mal power or achievement), Svadhd, Medhd (intellect), Dhrti (fortitude), Sruti.
verses.hindi: तदा वै तमसाविष्टः सोऽधिकां ब्रह्मणः सुतः । पूजामनर्हामन्विच्छन् जगाम कुपितो गृहम् तस्य तद्वाक्यमाकर्ण्य सा देवी शंकरप्रिया। विनिन्द्य पितरं दक्षं ददाहात्मानमात्मना
verses.wordMeaning: Guhyavidyd (having the secret lore), Atmavidya (the lore of Atman) Dharmavidya (the lore of piety), Atmabhdvitd (puri¬ fied byAtman), Svdhd, Vihambhard (theearth), Siddhi (super-nor¬ mal power or achievement), Svadhd, Medhd (intellect), Dhrti (fortitude), Sruti.
verses.commentary: Sense: Guhyavidyd (having the secret lore), Atmavidya (the lore of Atman) Dharmavidya (the lore of piety), Atmabhdvitd (puri¬ fied byAtman), Svdhd, Vihambhard (theearth), Siddhi (super-nor¬ mal power or achievement), Svadhd, Medhd (intellect), Dhrti (fortitude), Sruti.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वाश्रयं सर्वजगद्विधानं सर्वत्रगं जन्मविनाशहीनम् । सूक्ष्मं विचित्रं त्रिगुणं प्रधानं नतो ऽस्मि ते रूपमलुप्तभेदम्
verses.transliteration: sarvāśrayaṃ sarvajagadvidhānaṃ sarvatragaṃ janmavināśahīnam / sūkṣmaṃ vicitraṃ triguṇaṃ pradhānaṃ nato 'smi te rūpamaluptabhedam
verses.translation: Niti (policy), Suniti (good policy), Sukrti (good action), Mddhavi, Naravdhinf (having men as vehicle), Pujyd (worthy of being worshipped), Vibhdvati (lustrous), Saumyd (gentle), Bhogini (enjoyer), BhogaSdyini {lying on the body of the serpent).
verses.hindi: ज्ञात्वा तद्भगवान् रुद्रः प्रपन्नार्तिहरो हरः। शशाप दक्षं कुपितः समागत्याथ तदगृहम् त्यक्त्वा देहमिमं ब्रह्मन् क्षत्रियाणां कुलोद्भवः । स्वस्यां सुतायां मूढात्मन् पुत्रमुत्पादयिष्यसि
verses.wordMeaning: Niti (policy), Suniti (good policy), Sukrti (good action), Mddhavi, Naravdhinf (having men as vehicle), Pujyd (worthy of being worshipped), Vibhdvati (lustrous), Saumyd (gentle), Bhogini (enjoyer), BhogaSdyini {lying on the body of the serpent).
verses.commentary: Sense: Niti (policy), Suniti (good policy), Sukrti (good action), Mddhavi, Naravdhinf (having men as vehicle), Pujyd (worthy of being worshipped), Vibhdvati (lustrous), Saumyd (gentle), Bhogini (enjoyer), BhogaSdyini {lying on the body of the serpent).

verses.sanskrit: आद्यं महत् ते पुरुषात्मरूपं प्रकृत्यवस्थं त्रिगुणात्मबीजम् । ऐश्वर्यविज्ञानविरागधर्मैः समन्वितं देवि नतो ऽस्मि रूपम्
verses.transliteration: ādyaṃ mahat te puruṣātmarūpaṃ prakṛtyavasthaṃ triguṇātmabījam / aiśvaryavijñānavirāgadharmaiḥ samanvitaṃ devi nato 'smi rūpam
verses.translation: obhd (beauty), Sankari, Laid (oscillating), Mdlint (wearing the garlands), Paramethini, Trailokyasundari (the most beautiful lady in the three worlds), Namyd (worthy of being bowed to), Sundari (charming), Kdmacdrini (moving about as she pleases).
verses.hindi: एवमुक्त्वा महादेवो ययौ कैलासपर्वतम् । स्वायम्भुवोऽपि कालेन दक्षः प्राचेतसोऽभवत् विसर्ग दक्षपर्यन्तं शृण्वतां पापनाशनम्
verses.wordMeaning: obhd (beauty), Sankari, Laid (oscillating), Mdlint (wearing the garlands), Paramethini, Trailokyasundari (the most beautiful lady in the three worlds), Namyd (worthy of being bowed to), Sundari (charming), Kdmacdrini (moving about as she pleases).
verses.commentary: Sense: obhd (beauty), Sankari, Laid (oscillating), Mdlint (wearing the garlands), Paramethini, Trailokyasundari (the most beautiful lady in the three worlds), Namyd (worthy of being bowed to), Sundari (charming), Kdmacdrini (moving about as she pleases).

verses.sanskrit: द्विसप्तलोकात्मकमम्बुसंस्थं विचित्रभेदं पुरुषैकनाथम् । अनन्तभूतैरधिवासितं ते नतो ऽस्मि रूपं जगदण्डसंज्ञम्
verses.transliteration: dvisaptalokātmakamambusaṃsthaṃ vicitrabhedaṃ puruṣaikanātham / anantabhūtairadhivāsitaṃ te nato 'smi rūpaṃ jagadaṇḍasaṃjñam
verses.translation: Mahdnubhdvd (highly dignified), Sattvasthd (estab¬ lished in the Sattvagma), Mahdmahiamardird (suppressor of the great buffalo), Padmandbhd (lotus-naveiled), Pdpahard (dispeller of sins), Vicitramukutdngadd (having wonderful coronet and bracelets).
verses.hindi: उन दक्षने बुद्धिमान् महेश रुद्रके साथ विवाद किया था, इससे रुद्रद्वारा शाप प्राप्तकर वे प्रचेताओंके पुत्र बने महादेव हरने स्वयं देवी (पार्वती)-के घर आये हुए दक्षको देखकर उनको यथोचित पूजा की। (किंतु) उस समय तमोगुणके आवेशसे समाविष्ट ब्रह्माके पुत्र दक्ष (शंकरद्वारा की गयी अपनी) पूजाको अपर्याप्त
verses.wordMeaning: Mahdnubhdvd (highly dignified), Sattvasthd (estab¬ lished in the Sattvagma), Mahdmahiamardird (suppressor of the great buffalo), Padmandbhd (lotus-naveiled), Pdpahard (dispeller of sins), Vicitramukutdngadd (having wonderful coronet and bracelets).
verses.commentary: Sense: Mahdnubhdvd (highly dignified), Sattvasthd (estab¬ lished in the Sattvagma), Mahdmahiamardird (suppressor of the great buffalo), Padmandbhd (lotus-naveiled), Pdpahard (dispeller of sins), Vicitramukutdngadd (having wonderful coronet and bracelets).

verses.sanskrit: अशेषवेदात्मकमेकमाद्यं स्वतेजसा पूरितलोकभेदम् । त्रिकालहेतुं रपमेष्ठिसंज्ञं नमामि रूपं रविमण्डलस्थम्
verses.transliteration: aśeṣavedātmakamekamādyaṃ svatejasā pūritalokabhedam / trikālahetuṃ rapameṣṭhisaṃjñaṃ namāmi rūpaṃ ravimaṇḍalastham
verses.translation: Kdntd (shining), Citrdmbaradhard {-wearing clothes o£ variegated colours), Divydbharana-bhuitd (bedecked in divine ornaments), Hamsdkhyd (bearing the appellation swan), Vyomanilayd (having the firmament as the abode), Jagatsrstivivar- dhini (increaser of the creation of the universe).
verses.hindi: और अयोग्य समझकर और भी अधिक पूजाकी इच्छा करनेके कारण कुपित होकर अपने घर चले गये। हुई (अपनी पुत्री) सतीकी (उनके) पति (भगवान् शंकर)-के साथ निन्दा करते हुए क्रुद्ध होकर भर्त्सना को ॥ ५५--५७॥
verses.wordMeaning: Kdntd (shining), Citrdmbaradhard {-wearing clothes o£ variegated colours), Divydbharana-bhuitd (bedecked in divine ornaments), Hamsdkhyd (bearing the appellation swan), Vyomanilayd (having the firmament as the abode),…
verses.commentary: Sense: Kdntd (shining), Citrdmbaradhard {-wearing clothes o£ variegated colours), Divydbharana-bhuitd (bedecked in divine ornaments), Hamsdkhyd (bearing the appellation swan), Vyomanilayd (having the firmament as the abode),…

verses.sanskrit: सहस्त्रमूर्धानमनन्तशक्तिं सहस्त्रबाहुं पुरुषं पुराणम् । शयानमन्तः सलिले तथैव नारायणाख्यं प्रणतो ऽस्मि रूपम्
verses.transliteration: sahastramūrdhānamanantaśaktiṃ sahastrabāhuṃ puruṣaṃ purāṇam / śayānamantaḥ salile tathaiva nārāyaṇākhyaṃ praṇato 'smi rūpam
verses.translation: Niyantri (the controller), Yantramadhyasthd (stationed in the middle of the mystic diagram), Nandini (delighter), Bhadrakdlikd, Adityavarnd (having the lustre of the sun), Kauberi (goddess of Kubera).
verses.hindi: (दक्ष बोले--सती !) तुम्हारे पिनाकधारी पतिसे मेरे अन्य जामाता श्रेष्ठ हैं। तुम भी अच्छी पुत्री नहीं हो, इसलिये मेरे घरसे वहीं चले जाओ जहाँसे आयी हो। शंकरप्रिया उन देवी सतीने उस (कठोर) वाक्यको सुनकर पिता दक्षकी निन्दा की और चर्माम्बरधारी अपने स्वामी पशुपतिको प्रणामकर स्वयं ही उन्होंने (योगाग्निद्वारा) अपनेको भस्म कर डाला। तदनन्तर वे ही हिमालयकी तपस्यासे प्रसन्न होकर उनकी पुत्री बनीं
verses.wordMeaning: Niyantri (the controller), Yantramadhyasthd (stationed in the middle of the mystic diagram), Nandini (delighter), Bhadrakdlikd, Adityavarnd (having the lustre of the sun), Kauberi (goddess of Kubera).
verses.commentary: Sense: Niyantri (the controller), Yantramadhyasthd (stationed in the middle of the mystic diagram), Nandini (delighter), Bhadrakdlikd, Adityavarnd (having the lustre of the sun), Kauberi (goddess of Kubera).

verses.sanskrit: दंष्ट्राकरालं त्रिदशाभिवन्द्यं युगान्तकालानलकल्परूपम् । अशेषभूताण्डविनाशहेतुं नमामि रूपं तव कालसंज्ञम्
verses.transliteration: daṃṣṭrākarālaṃ tridaśābhivandyaṃ yugāntakālānalakalparūpam / aśeṣabhūtāṇḍavināśahetuṃ namāmi rūpaṃ tava kālasaṃjñam
verses.translation: Vrsdsanagatd (going about, seated on the bull), Gauri, Mahdkdli, Surdrcitd, (worshipped by Devas), Aditi, Niyatd
verses.hindi: उस बातको जानकर शरणागतोंका कष्ट हरनेवाले भगवान् रुद्र हर दक्षके घर आये और क्रुद्ध होकर उन्हें शाप दिया। ब्रह्मन्! मूढात्मन्! इस शरीरको छोड़कर तुम क्षत्रियोके कुलमें उत्पन्न होओगे और पापवश अकार्यमें तुम्हारी प्रवृत्ति होगी। ऐसा कहकर महादेव कैलासपर्वतपर चले गये और समय आनेपर स्वायम्भुव दक्ष भी प्रचेताओंके पुत्र बने
verses.wordMeaning: Vrsdsanagatd (going about, seated on the bull), Gauri, Mahdkdli, Surdrcitd, (worshipped by Devas), Aditi, Niyatd
verses.commentary: Sense: Vrsdsanagatd (going about, seated on the bull), Gauri, Mahdkdli, Surdrcitd, (worshipped by Devas), Aditi, Niyatd

verses.sanskrit: फणासहस्त्रेण विराजमानं भोगीन्द्रमुख्यैरभिपूज्यमानम् । जनार्दनारूढतनुं प्रसुप्तं नतो ऽस्मि रूपं तव शेषसंज्ञम्
verses.transliteration: phaṇāsahastreṇa virājamānaṃ bhogīndramukhyairabhipūjyamānam / janārdanārūḍhatanuṃ prasuptaṃ nato 'smi rūpaṃ tava śeṣasaṃjñam
verses.translation: Virupaki (with odd number of (i.e. three) eyes), Lelihana (licking up), MahdsuravindUni (destroyer of the great Asura), Mahdphald (bestowing great fruits), Anavadydngi (having faultless, limbs), Kdmarupd (having pleasing features), Vibhdvari (night).
verses.hindi: (सूतजीने इस प्रकार कहा-) आप लोगोंसे मैंने स्वायम्भुव मनुकी दक्षपर्यन्त विशेष सृष्टिका वर्णन किया। (यह वर्णन) सुननेवालोंके पापको नष्ट करनेवाला है हरिद्वारमें दक्षद्वारा यज्ञका आयोजन, यज्ञमें शंकरका भाग न देखकर महर्षि दधीचद्वारा दक्षकी भर्त्सना तथा यज्ञमें भाग लेनेवाले ब्राह्मणोंको शाप, देवी पार्वतीके कहने- पर शंकरद्वारा रुद्रों, भद्रकाली तथा वीरभद्रको प्रकट करना, वीरभद्वादिद्वारा दक्षके यञ्चका विध्वंस, शंकर-पार्वतीका यज्ञस्थलमें प्राकट्य, भयभीत
verses.wordMeaning: Virupaki (with odd number of (i.e. three) eyes), Lelihana (licking up), MahdsuravindUni (destroyer of the great Asura), Mahdphald (bestowing great fruits), Anavadydngi (having faultless, limbs), Kdmarupd (having pleasing features), Vibhdvari (night).
verses.commentary: Sense: Virupaki (with odd number of (i.e. three) eyes), Lelihana (licking up), MahdsuravindUni (destroyer of the great Asura), Mahdphald (bestowing great fruits), Anavadydngi (having faultless, limbs), Kdmarupd (having pleasing features), Vibhdvari (night).

verses.sanskrit: अव्याहतैश्वर्यमयुग्मनेत्रं ब्रह्मामृतानन्दरसज्ञमेकम् । युगान्तशेषं दिवि नृत्यमानं नतो ऽस्मि रूपं तव रुद्रसंज्ञम्
verses.transliteration: avyāhataiśvaryamayugmanetraṃ brahmāmṛtānandarasajñamekam / yugāntaśeṣaṃ divi nṛtyamānaṃ nato 'smi rūpaṃ tava rudrasaṃjñam
verses.translation: Vkitraratnamukutd (having wonderful jewelled coro¬ net), Prariatdrtiprabhanjani (the breaker of the distress of those who bow down), KauHki, Karanl (the dragger), Ratri {night), 'Tridadrtivindiini (destroyer of the distress of Devas).
verses.hindi: दक्षद्वारा शंकर तथा पार्वतीकी स्तुति और वर प्राप्त करना, ब्रह्माद्वारा दक्षको उपदेश और शिव-विष्णुके शिवकी शरण ग्रहण करना
verses.wordMeaning: Vkitraratnamukutd (having wonderful jewelled coro¬ net), Prariatdrtiprabhanjani (the breaker of the distress of those who bow down), KauHki, Karanl (the dragger), Ratri {night), 'Tridadrtivindiini (destroyer of the distress of Devas).
verses.commentary: Sense: Vkitraratnamukutd (having wonderful jewelled coro¬ net), Prariatdrtiprabhanjani (the breaker of the distress of those who bow down), KauHki, Karanl (the dragger), Ratri {night), 'Tridadrtivindiini (destroyer of the distress of Devas).

verses.sanskrit: प्रहीणशोकं विमलं पवित्रं सुरासुरैरर्चितापादपद्मम् । सुकोमलं देवि विशालशुम्रं नमामि ते रूपमिदं नमासि
verses.transliteration: prahīṇaśokaṃ vimalaṃ pavitraṃ surāsurairarcitāpādapadmam / sukomalaṃ devi viśālaśumraṃ namāmi te rūpamidaṃ namāsi
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: देवानां दानवानां च गन्धर्वोरगरक्षसाम्। उत्पत्तिं विस्तरात् सूत ब्रूहि वैवस्वतेऽन्तरे किमकार्षीन्महाबुद्धे श्रोतुमिच्छाम साम्प्रतम्
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.commentary: Sense: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: ॐ नमस्ते महादेवि नमस्ते परमेश्वरि । नमो भगवतीशानि शिवायै ते नमो नमः
verses.transliteration: oṃ namaste mahādevi namaste parameśvari / namo bhagavatīśāni śivāyai te namo namaḥ
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: वक्ष्ये नारायणेनोक्तं पूर्वकल्पानुषङ्गिकम्। त्रिकालबद्धं पापघ्नं प्रजासर्गस्य विस्तरम् देवाश्च सर्वे भागार्थमाहूता विष्णुना सह। सहैव मुनिभिः सर्वेरागता मुनिपुङ्गवाः
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.commentary: Sense: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: त्वन्मयो ऽहं त्वदाधारस्त्वमेव च गतिर्मम । त्वामेव शरणं यास्ये प्रसीद परमेश्वरि
verses.transliteration: tvanmayo 'haṃ tvadādhārastvameva ca gatirmama / tvāmeva śaraṇaṃ yāsye prasīda parameśvari
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: दृष्टा देवकुलं कृत्स्नं शंकरेण विनागतम्। दधीचो नाम विप्रर्षिः प्राचेतसमथाब्रवीत् ब्रह्मादयः पिशाचान्ता यस्याज्ञानुविधायिनः ।
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.commentary: Sense: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: मया नास्ति समो लोके देवो वादानवो ऽपि वा । जगन्मातैव मत्पुत्री संभूता तपसा यतः
verses.transliteration: mayā nāsti samo loke devo vādānavo 'pi vā / jaganmātaiva matputrī saṃbhūtā tapasā yataḥ
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: स देवः साम्प्रतं रुद्रो विधिना किं न पूज्यते सर्वेष्वेव हि यज्ञेषु न भागः परिकल्पितः ।
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.commentary: Sense: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: एषा तवाम्बिका देवि किलाभूत पितृकन्यका । मेनाशेषजगन्मातुरहो वुण्यस्य गौरवम्
verses.transliteration: eṣā tavāmbikā devi kilābhūta pitṛkanyakā / menāśeṣajaganmāturaho vuṇyasya gauravam
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: न मन्त्रा भार्यया सार्ध शंकरस्येति नेज्यते विहस्य दक्षं कुपितो वचः प्राह महामुनिः।
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.commentary: Sense: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: पाहि माममरेशानि मेनया सह सर्वदा । नमामि तव पादाब्जं व्रजामि शरणं शिवाम्
verses.transliteration: pāhi māmamareśāni menayā saha sarvadā / namāmi tava pādābjaṃ vrajāmi śaraṇaṃ śivām
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: शृण्वतां सर्वदेवानां सर्वज्ञानमयः स्वयम् नैमिषीय ऋषि बोले--सूतजी महाराज! वैवस्वत मन्वन्तरमें हुई देवताओं, दानवों, गन्धर्वो, नागों तथा राक्षसोंकी उत्पत्तिको आप विस्तारसे बतलायें। महाबुद्धिमान् सूतजी! इस समय हम यह सुनना चाहते हैं कि प्राचीन
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.commentary: Sense: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: अहो मे सुमहद् भाग्यं महादेवीसमागमात् । आज्ञापय महादेवि किं करिष्यामि शङ्करि
verses.transliteration: aho me sumahad bhāgyaṃ mahādevīsamāgamāt / ājñāpaya mahādevi kiṃ kariṣyāmi śaṅkari
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: कालमें प्रचेताके पुत्र राजा दक्षने भगवान् शंकरसे शाप प्राप्तकर क्या किया था सूतजीने कहा--मैं पूर्वकल्पके प्रसंगमें नारायणद्वार कहे गये (भूत, भविष्य तथा वर्तमान इस प्रकार) तीनों कालोंसे सम्बद्ध तथा पाप हरनेवाले प्रजा-सर्गको विस्तारसे बतलाता हूँ
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.commentary: Sense: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: एतावदुक्त्वा वचनं तदा हिमगिरीश्वरः । संप्रेक्षणमाणो गिरिजां प्राञ्जलिः पार्श्वतो ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: etāvaduktvā vacanaṃ tadā himagirīśvaraḥ / saṃprekṣaṇamāṇo girijāṃ prāñjaliḥ pārśvato 'bhavat
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: प्राचीन कालकी बात है, भगवान् शंकरके शापसे ग्रस्त उन प्रचेतापुत्र राजा दक्षने पूर्व वैरके कारण शंकरको निन्दा कर गङ्गाद्वार हरिषद्वारमें एक यज्ञका अनुष्ठान प्रारम्भ किया  श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! विष्णुके साथ सभी देवता उस यज्ञमें भाग ग्रहण करनेके लिये बुलाये गये। सभी मुनियोंके साथ वे वहाँ आये। शंकरको छोड़कर आये हुए समस्त देव-समूहोंको देखकर दधीच नामक विप्रषिने प्राचेतस-दक्षसे (इस प्रकार) कहा-
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.commentary: Sense: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: अथ सा तस्य वचनं निशम्य जगतो ऽरणिः । सस्मितं प्राह पितरं स्मृत्वा पशुपतिं पतिम्
verses.transliteration: atha sā tasya vacanaṃ niśamya jagato 'raṇiḥ / sasmitaṃ prāha pitaraṃ smṛtvā paśupatiṃ patim
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: दधीच बोले--ब्रह्मा आदिसे लेकर पिशाचतक जिनको आज्ञाका शीघ्र ही अनृपालन करते हैं, उन रुद्र्देवको पूजा इस समय क्यों नहीं की जा रही है ? दक्षने कहा--सभी यज्ञोंमें भार्यासहित शंकरके भाग एवं मन्त्रोंकी परिकल्पना नहीं हुई है, इसलिये उनकी पूजा नहीं की जाती। इसपर साक्षात् सर्वज्ञानमय महामुनि दधीचने कोपपूर्वक हँसते हुए सभी देवताओंको
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.commentary: Sense: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: देव्युवाच शृणुष्व चैतत् परमं गुह्यमीश्वरगोचरम् । उपदेशं गिरिश्रेष्ठ सेवितं ब्रह्मवादिभिः
verses.transliteration: devyuvāca śṛṇuṣva caitat paramaṃ guhyamīśvaragocaram / upadeśaṃ giriśreṣṭha sevitaṃ brahmavādibhiḥ
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: सुनाते हुए दक्षसे कहा-- सम्पूज्यते सर्वयज्ञैर्विदित्वा किल शंकरः
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
