verses.sanskrit: यन्मे साक्षात् परं रूपमैश्वरं दृष्टमद्भुतम् । सर्वशक्तिसमायुक्तमनन्तं प्रेरकं परम्
verses.transliteration: yanme sākṣāt paraṃ rūpamaiśvaraṃ dṛṣṭamadbhutam / sarvaśaktisamāyuktamanantaṃ prerakaṃ param
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: न ह्ययं शंकरो रुद्रः संहर्ता तामसो हरः। नग्नः कपाली विकृतो विश्वात्मा नोपपद्यते ईश्वरो हि जगत्स्रष्टा प्रभुर्नारायणः स्वराद्। सत्त्वात्मकोऽसौ भगवानिज्यते सर्वकर्मसु १२॥
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.commentary: Sense: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: शान्तः समाहितमना दम्भाहङ्कारवर्जितः । तन्निष्ठस्तत्परो भूत्वा तदेव शरणं व्रज
verses.transliteration: śāntaḥ samāhitamanā dambhāhaṅkāravarjitaḥ / tanniṣṭhastatparo bhūtvā tadeva śaraṇaṃ vraja
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: किं त्वया भगवानेष सहस्त्रांशुर्न दृश्यते । सर्वलोकैकसंहर्ता कालात्मा परमेश्वरः यं गृणन्तीह विद्वांसो धार्मिका ब्रह्मवादिनः । सोऽयं साक्षी तीव्ररोचिः कालात्मा शांकरी तनुः
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.commentary: Sense: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: भक्त्या त्वनन्यया तात पद्भावं परमाश्रितः । सर्वयज्ञतपोदानैस्तदेवार्चय सर्वदा
verses.transliteration: bhaktyā tvananyayā tāta padbhāvaṃ paramāśritaḥ / sarvayajñatapodānaistadevārcaya sarvadā
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: एष रूद्रो महादेवः कपर्दी च घृणी हरः। आदित्यो भगवान् सूर्यो नीलग्रीवो विलोहितः पश्यैनं विश्वकर्माणं रुद्रमूर्तिं त्रयीमयम्
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.commentary: Sense: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: तदेव मनसा पश्य तद् ध्यायस्व जपस्व च । ममोपदेशात् संसारं नाशयामि तवानघ
verses.transliteration: tadeva manasā paśya tad dhyāyasva japasva ca / mamopadeśāt saṃsāraṃ nāśayāmi tavānagha
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: य एते द्वादशादित्या आगता यज्ञभागिनः । सर्वे सूर्या इति ज्ञेया न ह्यान्यो विद्यते रविः बाढमित्यब्रुवन् वाक्यं तस्य साहाय्यकारिणः
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.commentary: Sense: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: अहं वै मत्परान् भक्तानैश्वरं योगमास्थितान् । संसारसागरादस्मादुद्धराम्यचिरेण तु
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ vai matparān bhaktānaiśvaraṃ yogamāsthitān / saṃsārasāgarādasmāduddharāmyacireṇa tu
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: निन्दन्तो वैदिकान् मन्त्रान् सर्वभूतपतिं हरम्। अपूजयन् दक्षवाक्यं मोहिता विष्णुमायया देवाश्च सर्वे भागार्थमागता वासवादयः । नापश्यन् देवमीशानमृते नारायणं हरिम्
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.commentary: Sense: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: ध्यानेन कर्मयोगेन भक्त्या ज्ञानेन चैव हि । प्राप्याहं ते गिरिश्रेष्ठ नान्यथा कर्मकोटिभिः
verses.transliteration: dhyānena karmayogena bhaktyā jñānena caiva hi / prāpyāhaṃ te giriśreṣṭha nānyathā karmakoṭibhiḥ
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: हिरण्यगर्भो भगवान् ब्रह्मा ब्रह्मविदां वरः। पश्यतामेव सर्वेषां क्षणादन्तरधीयत दधीच बोले--जिनसे सभीकी प्रवृत्ति होती है और जो इस (विशव)-के परमेश्वर हैं, वे शंकर निश्चय ही सभी यज्ञोंद्वारा ज्ञानपूर्वक पूजित होते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: श्रुतिस्मृत्युदितं सम्यक् कर्म वर्णाश्रमात्मकम् । अध्यात्मज्ञानसहितं मुक्तये सततं कुरु
verses.transliteration: śrutismṛtyuditaṃ samyak karma varṇāśramātmakam / adhyātmajñānasahitaṃ muktaye satataṃ kuru
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: दक्षने कहा--संहार करनेवाले, तमोगुणी, नग्न, कपाल धारण करनेवाले तथा विकृत (वेशवाले) रुद्र, हर, शंकर किसी भी प्रकार विश्वात्मा नहीं हो सकते। संसारको सृष्टि करनेवाले स्वराट्, प्रभु नारायण ही ईश्वर हैं और सभी कर्मोमें उन सत्त्वात्मक भगवान् विष्णुकी पूजा की जाती है
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: धर्मात् संजायते भक्तिर्भक्त्या संप्राप्यते परम् । श्रुतिस्मृतिभ्यामुदितो धर्मो यज्ञादिको मतः
verses.transliteration: dharmāt saṃjāyate bhaktirbhaktyā saṃprāpyate param / śrutismṛtibhyāmudito dharmo yajñādiko mataḥ
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: दधीच बोले- क्या तुम समस्त लोकोंके एकमात्र संहारकर्ता कालस्वरूप, तथा हजारों किरणवाले इन परमेश्वर भगवान् (सूर्य)-को नहीं देख रहे हो। धर्मात्मा, ब्रह्मवादी विद्वान् जिनकी स्तुति करते हैं, वही ये (सूर्य) तीव्र तेजसे सम्पन्न कालात्मक साक्षी यहाँ शंकरके शरीररूपमें ही स्थित हैं। देवी अदितिके पुत्र ये भगवान् सूर्य ही रुद्र, महादेव, कपर्दी, घृणी, हर, नीलग्रीब, विलोहित (नामवाले) हैं। सामवेदका गान
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: नान्यतो जायते धर्मो वेदाद् धर्मो हि निर्बभौ । तस्मान्मुमुक्षुर्धर्मार्थो मद्रूपं वेदमाश्रयेत्
verses.transliteration: nānyato jāyate dharmo vedād dharmo hi nirbabhau / tasmānmumukṣurdharmārtho madrūpaṃ vedamāśrayet
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: करनेवाले तथा अध्वर्यु एवं होताओंके द्वारा हजारों किरणवाले सूर्यकी स्तुति की जाती है। विश्वको रुद्रकी मूर्तिको देखो
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: ममैवैषा परा शक्तिर्वेदसंज्ञा पुरातनी । ऋग्यजुः सामरूपेण सर्गादौ संप्रवर्तते
verses.transliteration: mamaivaiṣā parā śaktirvedasaṃjñā purātanī / ṛgyajuḥ sāmarūpeṇa sargādau saṃpravartate
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: दक्षने कहा--यज्ञमें भाग ग्रहण करनेवाले ये जो बारह (अदिति-पुत्र) आदित्य यहाँ आये हुए हैं, ये सभी सूर्यके नामसे ही जाने जाते हैं। इनसे अतिरिक्त कोई अन्य सूर्य नहीं हैं। ऐसा कहनेपर यज्ञ देखनेकी इच्छासे आये हुए उनके (दक्षके) सहयोगी मुनियोंने (समर्थन करते हुए) दक्षसे कहा-ठीक है। तमोगुणसे आविष्ट मनवाले सैकड़ों-हजारोंकी संख्यामें आये हुए उन लोगोंने भगवान् वृषध्वज शंकरको न देखते हुए
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: तेषामेव च गुप्त्यर्थं वेदानां भगवानजः । ब्राह्मणादीन् ससर्जाथ स्वे स्वे कर्मण्ययोजयत्
verses.transliteration: teṣāmeva ca guptyarthaṃ vedānāṃ bhagavānajaḥ / brāhmaṇādīn sasarjātha sve sve karmaṇyayojayat
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: पुनः उनको निन्दा करनी आरम्भ की । विष्णुकी मायासे मोहित होकर वे वैदिक मन्त्रोंकी निन्दा करते हुए सभी प्राणियोंके एकमात्र स्वामी भगवान् हरकी पूजा न करके दक्षके वचनका अनुमोदन करने लगे। यज्ञमें भाग ग्रहण करनेके लिये आये हुए इन्द्रादि सभी देवताओंने भी नारायण हरिके अतिरिक्त देव ईशान (शंकर)-को भी नहीं देखा (अर्थात् शिवके माहात्म्यको वे जान नहीं पाये) । ब्रह्मज्ञानियोंमे श्रेष्ठ हिरण्यगर्भ भगवान् ब्रह्मा सभीके देखते-
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: ये न कुर्वन्ति तद् धर्मं तदर्थं ब्रह्मनिर्मितम् । तेषामधस्ताद् नरकांस्तामिस्त्रादीनकल्पयत्
verses.transliteration: ye na kurvanti tad dharmaṃ tadarthaṃ brahmanirmitam / teṣāmadhastād narakāṃstāmistrādīnakalpayat
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: देखते क्षणभरमें ही अन्तर्धान हो गये अन्तर्हिते भगवति दक्षो नारायणं हरिम्। रक्षकं जगतां देवं जगाम शरणं स्वयम्
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: न च वेदाद् ऋते किञ्चिच्छास्त्रधर्माभिधायकम् । यो ऽन्यत्ररमतेसो ऽसौनसंभाष्यो द्विजातिभिः
verses.transliteration: na ca vedād ṛte kiñcicchāstradharmābhidhāyakam / yo 'nyatraramateso 'saunasaṃbhāṣyo dvijātibhiḥ
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: प्रवर्तयामास च तं यज्ञं दक्षोऽथ निर्भयः। रक्षते भगवान् विष्णुः शरणागतरक्षकः पुनः प्राह च तं दक्षं दधीचो भगवानृषिः । सम्प्रक्ष्यर्षिगणान् देवान् सर्वान् वै ब्रह्मविद्विषः
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: यानि शास्त्राणि दृश्यन्ते लोके ऽस्मिन् विविधानितु । श्रुतिस्मृतिविरुद्धानि निष्ठा तेषां हि तामसी
verses.transliteration: yāni śāstrāṇi dṛśyante loke 'smin vividhānitu / śrutismṛtiviruddhāni niṣṭhā teṣāṃ hi tāmasī
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: नरः पापमवाप्नोति महद् वै नात्र संशयः दण्डो देवकृतस्तत्र सद्यः पतति दारुणः
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.transliteration: kāpālaṃ pañcarātraṃ ca yāmalaṃ vāmamārhatam / evaṃvidhāni cānyāni mohanārthāni tāni tu
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: समागतान् ब्राह्मणांस्तान् दक्षसाहाय्यकारिणः विनिन्दितो महादेवः शंकरो लोकवन्दितः
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: ये कुशास्त्राभियोगेन मोहयन्तीह मानवान् । मया सृष्टानि शास्त्राणि मोहायैषां भवान्तरे
verses.transliteration: ye kuśāstrābhiyogena mohayantīha mānavān / mayā sṛṣṭāni śāstrāṇi mohāyaiṣāṃ bhavāntare
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: त्यक्त्वा तपोबलं कृत्स्नं गच्छध्वं नरकान् पुनः । भविष्यति हृषीकेश: स्वाश्रितोऽपि पराङ्मुखः एतस्मिन्नन्तरे देवी महादेवं महेश्वरम्।
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: वेदार्थवित्तमैः कार्यं यत् स्मृतं कर्म वैदिकम् । तत् प्रयत्नेन कुर्वन्ति मत्प्रियास्ते हि ये नराः
verses.transliteration: vedārthavittamaiḥ kāryaṃ yat smṛtaṃ karma vaidikam / tat prayatnena kurvanti matpriyāste hi ye narāḥ
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: पत्तिं पशुपतिं देवं ज्ञात्वैतत् प्राह सर्वदृक् दक्षो यज्ञेन यजते पिता मे पूर्वजन्मनि।
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: वर्णानामनुकम्पार्थं मन्नियोगाद् विराट् स्वयम् । स्वायंभुवो मनुर्धार्मान् मुनीनां पूर्वमुक्तवाना
verses.transliteration: varṇānāmanukampārthaṃ manniyogād virāṭ svayam / svāyaṃbhuvo manurdhārmān munīnāṃ pūrvamuktavānā
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: विनिन्द्य भवतो भावमात्मानं चापि शंकर देवाः सहर्षिभिश्रासंस्तत्र साहाय्यकारिणः।
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा चान्ये ऽपि मुनयस्तन्मुखाद् धर्ममुत्तमम् । चक्रुर्धर्मप्रतिष्ठार्थं धर्मशास्त्राणि चैव हि
verses.transliteration: śrutvā cānye 'pi munayastanmukhād dharmamuttamam / cakrurdharmapratiṣṭhārthaṃ dharmaśāstrāṇi caiva hi
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: बिनाशयाशु तं यज्ञं वरमेकं वृणोम्यहम् भगवान् ब्रह्माके अन्तर्धान हो जानेपर स्वयं दक्ष संसारकी रक्षा करनेवाले देव नारायण हरिकी शरणमें गये । तदनन्तर भयसे मुक्त होकर दक्षने वह यज्ञ आरम्भ किया। शरणागतकी रक्षा करनेवाले भगवान् विष्णु
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: तेषु चान्तर्हितेष्वेवं युगान्तेषु महर्षयः । ब्रह्मणो वचनात् तानि करिष्यन्ति युगे युगे
verses.transliteration: teṣu cāntarhiteṣvevaṃ yugānteṣu maharṣayaḥ / brahmaṇo vacanāt tāni kariṣyanti yuge yuge
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: (उस यज्ञकी) रक्षा करने लगे। भगवान् दधीच ऋषिने ब्रह्म (शंकर)-से द्वेष माननेवाले उन सभी ऋषिगणों तथा देवताओंकी ओर देखकर उन दक्षसे पुनः कहा- जो अपूज्य है, उसका पूजन करनेसे और जो पूज्य है, उसका पूजन न करनेसे मनुष्य निश्चित ही महान् पापको प्राप्त करता है, इसमें किंचित् भी संदेह नहीं है। जहाँ दुर्जनोंका आदर होता है और सत्पुरुषोंका अनादर होता है, वहाँ अति शीघ्र ही दारुण हैवी दण्ड उपस्थित
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.commentary: Sense: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: अष्टादश पुराणानि व्यासेन कथितानि तु । नियोगाद् ब्रह्मणो राजंस्तेषु धर्मः प्रतिष्ठितः
verses.transliteration: aṣṭādaśa purāṇāni vyāsena kathitāni tu / niyogād brahmaṇo rājaṃsteṣu dharmaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: होता है। ऐसा कहकर विप्रर्षि दधीचने दक्षकी सहायता करनेके लिये आये हुए उन ईश्वर (शंकर)-से विद्वेष रखनेवाले ब्राह्मणोंको शाप देते हुए कहा-- ॥ २३--२८॥ चूँकि तुम लोगोंने वेदोंकी अवमानना की है और समस्त संसारके द्वारा वन्दित परमेश्वर महादेव शंकरकी निन्दा की है, अत: ईश्वर (शंकर)-से द्वेष रखनेवाले तुम सभी वेदत्रयीसे रहित हो जाओगे और असत्-
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.commentary: Sense: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: अन्यान्युपपुराणानि तच्छिष्यैः कथितानि तु । युगे युगे ऽत्र सर्वेषां कर्ता वै धर्मशास्त्रवित्
verses.transliteration: anyānyupapurāṇāni tacchiṣyaiḥ kathitāni tu / yuge yuge 'tra sarveṣāṃ kartā vai dharmaśāstravit
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: शास्त्रोंमें मन लगाते हुए ईश्वर-मार्ग (शिव-मार्ग)-की निन्दा करोगे तथा घोर कलियुग आनेपर मिथ्या अध्ययन और मिथ्या आचारयुक्त होकर मिथ्या ज्ञानका प्रलाप करनेवाले होओगे, साथ ही कलिके द्वारा उत्पन्न कष्ट एवं दुःखों आदिसे पीड़ित रहोगे। पुनः तुम सभी अपने सम्पूर्ण तपोबलका त्याग करके नरक प्राप्त करोगे। तुम लोगोंके द्वारा हृषीकेश विष्णुके भलीभाँति आश्रय ग्रहण करनेपर भी वे तुम लोगोंसे विमुख ही रहेंगे
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.commentary: Sense: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: शिक्षा कल्पो व्याकरणं निरुक्तं छन्द एव च । ज्योतिः शास्त्रं न्यायविद्या मीमांसा चोपबृंहणम्
verses.transliteration: śikṣā kalpo vyākaraṇaṃ niruktaṃ chanda eva ca / jyotiḥ śāstraṃ nyāyavidyā mīmāṃsā copabṛṃhaṇam
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: ऐसा कहकर तपस्याकी निधि वे विप्रर्षि (दधीच) चुप हो गये और मानसिक रूपसे सम्पूर्ण पापोंका विनाश करनेवाले रुद्रकी शरणमें गये। इसी बीच यह सारी घटना जानकर सर्वदशी (सब कुछ प्रत्यक्ष देखनेवाली) देवी (पार्वती)-ने (अपने) पतिदेव पशुपति महादेव महेशवरसे कहा-
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.commentary: Sense: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: एवं चतुर्दशैतानि विद्यास्थानानि सत्तम । चतुर्वेदैः सहोक्तानि धर्मो नान्यत्र विद्यते
verses.transliteration: evaṃ caturdaśaitāni vidyāsthānāni sattama / caturvedaiḥ sahoktāni dharmo nānyatra vidyate
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: देवी बोलीं शंकर! पूर्वजन्मके मेरे (सतीके) पिता दक्ष यज्ञ कर रहे हैं और आपके भाव तथा स्वरूपकी निन्दा कर रहे हैं। ऋषियोंके साथ देवता वहाँ उनकी सहायता करते हुए उपस्थित हैं। मैं आपसे एक वर माँगती हूँ कि “आप शीघ्र ही उस यज्ञको नष्ट करें'
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: एवं पैतामहं धर्मं मनुव्यासादयः परम् । स्थापयन्ति ममादेशाद् यावदाभूतसंप्लवम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ paitāmahaṃ dharmaṃ manuvyāsādayaḥ param / sthāpayanti mamādeśād yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: एवं विज्ञापितो देव्या देवो देववरः प्रभुः । ससर्ज सहसा रुद्रं दक्षयज्ञजिघांसया दंष्टाकरालं दुष्प्रेक्ष्यं शङ्खचक्रगदाधरम्। दण्डहस्तं महानादं शार्ङ्गिणं भूतिभूषणम्
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.commentary: Sense: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मणा सह ते सर्वे संप्राप्ते प्रतिसंचरे । परस्यान्ते कृतात्मानः प्रविशन्ति परं पदम्
verses.transliteration: brahmaṇā saha te sarve saṃprāpte pratisaṃcare / parasyānte kṛtātmānaḥ praviśanti paraṃ padam
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: वीरभद्र इति ख्यातं देवदेवसमन्वितम्। स जातमात्रो देवेशमुपतस्थे कृताञ्जलिः तमाह दक्षस्य मखं विनाशय शिवोऽस्त्विति। विनिन्द्य मां स यजते गङ्गाद्वारे गणेश्वर
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.commentary: Sense: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन धर्मार्थं वेदमाश्रयेत् । धर्मेण सहितं ज्ञानं परं ब्रह्म प्रकाशयेत्
verses.transliteration: tasmāt sarvaprayatnena dharmārthaṃ vedamāśrayet / dharmeṇa sahitaṃ jñānaṃ paraṃ brahma prakāśayet
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: ततो बन्धुप्रयुक्तेन सिंहेनेकेन लीलया। वीरभद्रेण दक्षस्य विनाशमगमत् क्रतुः मन्युना चोमया सृष्टा भद्रकाली महेश्वरी। तया च सार्ध वृषभं समारुह्य ययौ गणः
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.commentary: Sense: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: ये तु सङ्गान् परित्यज्य मामेव शरणं गताः । उपासते सदा भक्त्या योगमैश्वरमास्थिताः
verses.transliteration: ye tu saṅgān parityajya māmeva śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ / upāsate sadā bhaktyā yogamaiśvaramāsthitāḥ
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: रोमजा इति विख्यातास्तस्य साहाय्यकारिणः शूलशक्तिगदाहस्ताष्टङ्डोपलकरास्तथा । कालाग्निरुद्रसंकाशा नादयन्तो दिशो दश
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: सर्वभूतदयावन्तः शान्ता दान्ता विमत्सराः । अमानिनो बुद्धिमन्तस्तापसाः शंसितव्रताः
verses.transliteration: sarvabhūtadayāvantaḥ śāntā dāntā vimatsarāḥ / amānino buddhimantastāpasāḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: सर्वे सम्प्राप्य तं देशं गङ्काद्वारमिति श्रुतम्। ददृशुर्यज्ञदेशं तं दक्षस्यामिततेजसः देवाङ्कनासहस्त्राढ्यमप्सरोगीतनादितम् । बीणावेणुनिनादाढ्यं वेदवादाभिनादितम्
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: मच्चित्ता मद्गतप्राणा मज्ज्ञानकथने रताः । संन्यासिनो गृहस्थाश्च वनस्था ब्रह्मचारिणः
verses.transliteration: maccittā madgataprāṇā majjñānakathane ratāḥ / saṃnyāsino gṛhasthāśca vanasthā brahmacāriṇaḥ
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: दृष्टा सहर्षिभिर्देवैः समासीनं प्रजापतिम्। देवीके द्वारा ऐसा कहे जानेपर देवताओंमें श्रेष्ठ प्रभु भगवान् (शंकर)-ने दक्षके यज्ञका विध्वंस करनेके
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: तेषां नित्याभियुक्तानां मायातत्त्वसमुत्थितम् । नाशयामि तमः कृत्स्नं ज्ञानदीपने मा चिरात्
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ nityābhiyuktānāṃ māyātattvasamutthitam / nāśayāmi tamaḥ kṛtsnaṃ jñānadīpane mā cirāt
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: प्रलयकालीन अग्निके समान, भयंकर दाढ्युक्त, देखनेमें भयंकर, शंख, चक्र तथा गदा धारण किये, हाथमें दण्ड धारण करनेवाले, घोर नाद करनेवाले, सींगसे बने धनुषको धारण किये, विभूतिसे सुशोभित तथा अनेक देवताओंसे घिरे हुए वीरभद्र नामवाले रुद्रको उत्पन्न किया। उत्पन्न होते ही वह हाथ जोड़कर देवताओंके स्वामी भगवान् शंकरके सम्मुख उपस्थित हुआ॥ ३७--४० ॥

verses.sanskrit: ते सुनिर्धूततमसो ज्ञानेनैकेन मन्मयाः । सदानन्दास्तु संसारे न जायन्ते पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: te sunirdhūtatamaso jñānenaikena manmayāḥ / sadānandāstu saṃsāre na jāyante punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: (शंकरने उससे कहा-) गणेश्वर! दक्षके यज्ञका विध्वंस करो, वह गङ्गाद्वार (हरिद्वार) -में मेरी निन्दा करते हुए यज्ञ कर रहा है  तुम्हारा कल्याण हो। तदनन्तर बन्धु (शिव)-के द्वारा निर्दिष्ट वीरभद्रने सिंहके समान लीला करते हुए अकेले ही दक्षके यज्ञका विध्वंस कर दिया। उमाने भी क्रोध करते हुए महेश्वरी भद्रकालीको उत्पन्न किया, उसके साथ वृषभपर आरूढ़ होकर वह गण (वीरभद्र) वहाँ (गङ्गाद्वार यज्ञमें) गया । बुद्धिमान् उन शंकरने उनकी
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् सर्वप्रकारेण मद्भक्तो मत्परायणः । मामेवार्चय सर्वत्र मेनया सह संगतः
verses.transliteration: tasmāt sarvaprakāreṇa madbhakto matparāyaṇaḥ / māmevārcaya sarvatra menayā saha saṃgataḥ
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: सहायता करनेवाले हजारों दूसरे रुद्रोंको भी उत्पन्न किया। (शंकरके) रोमोंसे उत्पन्न होनेके कारण वे रुद्र ' रोमज' कहलाये। हाथोंमें त्रिशूल, शक्ति, गदा, टङ्क (पत्थर तोड्नेके हथियार-घन, हथौड़ा, छेनी आदि) तथा पत्थर लिये हुए और कालाग्नि रुद्रके समान अत्यन्त भीषण सभी अपनी-अपनी भार्याओंके साथ वृषभरूप आसनपर आरूढ होकर दसों दिशाओंको प्रतिध्वनित करते हुए गणोंमें सर्वश्रेष्ठ वीरभद्रको अपने समूहके बीच रखते हुए जहाँ
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: अशक्तो यदि मे ध्यातुमैश्वरं रूपमव्ययम् । ततो मे सकलं रूपं कालाद्यं शरणं व्रज
verses.transliteration: aśakto yadi me dhyātumaiśvaraṃ rūpamavyayam / tato me sakalaṃ rūpaṃ kālādyaṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: दक्षयज्ञ हो रहा था, उस ओर चल पड़े गङ्गाद्वार (हरिद्वार) नामसे प्रसिद्ध उस देशमें पहुँचकर उन सभीने अमित तेजस्वी दक्षके उस यज्ञस्थलको देखा, जो हजारों देवाङ्गनाओंसे सुशोभित था, अप्सराओंके गीतोंसे मुखरित था, वीणा तथा वेणुके
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: यद् यत् स्वरूपं मे तात मनसो गोचरं भवेत् । तन्निष्ठस्तत्परो भूत्वा तदर्चनपरो भव
verses.transliteration: yad yat svarūpaṃ me tāta manaso gocaraṃ bhavet / tanniṣṭhastatparo bhūtvā tadarcanaparo bhava

verses.hindi: निनादसे प्रतिध्वनित और वेद-मन्त्रोंसे गुञ्जित था। देखकर भद्रकाली तथा रुद्रोंसहित वीरभद्रने हँसते हुए कहा ॥ ४७--४९ ॥

verses.sanskrit: यत्तु मे निष्कलं रूपं चिन्मात्रं केवलं शिवम् । सर्वोपाधिविनिर्मुक्तमनन्तममृतं परम्
verses.transliteration: yattu me niṣkalaṃ rūpaṃ cinmātraṃ kevalaṃ śivam / sarvopādhivinirmuktamanantamamṛtaṃ param
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: अथ चेत् कस्यचिदियमाज्ञा मुनिसुरोत्तमाः। देवा ऊचुर्यज्ञभागे न च मन्त्रा इति प्रभुम्

verses.hindi: ये नाध्वरस्य राजानं पूजयध्वं महेश्वरम् पूज्यते सर्वयज्ञेषु सर्वाभ्युदयसिद्धिदः
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.transliteration: tadbuddhayastadātmānastanniṣṭhāstatparāyaṇāḥ / gacchantyapunarāvṛttiṃ jñānanirdhūtakalmaṣāḥ
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: न मेनिरे ययुर्मन्त्रा देवान् मुक्त्वा स्वमालयम् ततः स रुद्रो भगवान् सभार्यः सगणेश्वरः । स्पृशन् कराभ्यां ब्रह्मर्षि दधीचं प्राह देवताः

verses.sanskrit: मामनाश्रित्य परमं निर्वाणममलं पदम् । प्राप्यते न हि राजेन्द्र ततो मां शरणं व्रज
verses.transliteration: māmanāśritya paramaṃ nirvāṇamamalaṃ padam / prāpyate na hi rājendra tato māṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: इत्युक्त्वा यज्ञशालां तां ददाह गणपुङ्गवः। वीरभद्रोऽपि दीप्तात्मा शक्रस्योद्यच्छतः करम्। व्यष्टम्भयददीनात्मा तथान्येषां दिवौकसाम्
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: एकत्वेन पृथक्त्वेन तथा चोभयतो ऽपि वा । मामुपास्य महाराज ततो यास्यासि तत्पदम्
verses.transliteration: ekatvena pṛthaktvena tathā cobhayato 'pi vā / māmupāsya mahārāja tato yāsyāsi tatpadam
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: भगस्य नेत्रे चोत्पाट्य करजाग्रेण लीलया। निहत्य मुष्टिना दन्तान् पूष्णश्चैवमपातयत् हम सभी अमित तेजस्वी शंकरके अनुचर हैं, यइमें भाग प्राप्त करनेकी इच्छासे यहाँ आये हैं, आप हमें अभीप्सित यज्ञभाग प्रदान करें। अथवा श्रेष्ठ मुनियो और
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: मामनाश्रित्य तत् तत्त्वं स्वभावविमलं शिवम् । ज्ञायते न हि राजेन्द्र ततो मां शरणं व्रज
verses.transliteration: māmanāśritya tat tattvaṃ svabhāvavimalaṃ śivam / jñāyate na hi rājendra tato māṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: ऐसी आज्ञा दी है कि मुझे यज्ञभाग न दें और आप लोगोंका ही सब भाग है। जो ऐसी आज्ञा देनेवाला है, उसे बतलायें, फिर हम उसे देख लेंगे। गणोंके स्वामी वीरभद्रके ऐसा कहे जानेपर प्रजापति दक्षसहित देवताओंने प्रभु (वीरभद्र)-से कहा-' आपको यज्ञभाग देने- सम्बन्धी मन्त्र नहीं हैं'॥ ५०--५२ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् त्वमक्षरं रूपं नित्यं चारूपमैश्वरम् । आराधय प्रयत्नेन ततो बन्धं प्रहास्यसि
verses.transliteration: tasmāt tvamakṣaraṃ rūpaṃ nityaṃ cārūpamaiśvaram / ārādhaya prayatnena tato bandhaṃ prahāsyasi
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: (यह सुनकर वेद-) मन्त्रोंने (मूर्तिमान् स्वरूप धारणकर) देवताओंसे कहा-आपका मन तमोगुणसे आक्रान्त हो गया है, इसीलिये आप यज्ञके स्वामी महेशवरकी पूजा नहीं कर रहे हैं। सभी प्राणियोंके एकमात्र स्वामी और सभी प्राणियोंके शरीर-रूप तथा समस्त अभ्युदय एवं सिद्धियोंको प्रदान करनेवाले हर (शंकर) सभी यज्ञोंमें पूजित होते हैं। ईशान अर्थात् शंकरके बारेमें ऐसा कहे जानेपर भी मायाके कारण नष्ट
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: न वै पश्यन्ति तत् तत्त्वं मोहिता मम मायया । अनाद्यनन्तं परमं महेश्वरमजं शिवम्
verses.transliteration: na vai paśyanti tat tattvaṃ mohitā mama māyayā / anādyanantaṃ paramaṃ maheśvaramajaṃ śivam
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: तुम लोगोंने अपने बलसे गर्वित होकर मन्त्रोंको प्रमाण नहीं माना, इसलिये इसे सहन न कर में आज बलपूर्वक सभीके गर्वको नष्ट करूंगा। ऐसा कहकर गणोंमें श्रेष्ठ बीरभद्रने उस यज्ञशालाको जला डाला और गणेश्वरोंने अत्यन्त क्रुद्ध होकर (यञ्ञशालाके) यूपों (स्तम्भों)-को उखाड़कर फेंक दिया। भयानक सभी गणेश्वरोंने आहुति देनेवालोंसहित पाठ करनेवालों एवं घोड़ेको भी पकड़कर गङ्गाके प्रवाहमें फेंक दिया।
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: सर्वभूतात्मभूतस्थं सर्वाधारं निरञ्जनम् । नित्यानन्दं निराभासं निर्गुणं तमसः परम्
verses.transliteration: sarvabhūtātmabhūtasthaṃ sarvādhāraṃ nirañjanam / nityānandaṃ nirābhāsaṃ nirguṇaṃ tamasaḥ param
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: प्रदीप्त आत्मावाले तथा दीनतारहित वीरभद्रने भी इन्द्रके उठे हुए सौ हाथों तथा अन्य देवताओंके उठे हुए हाथोंको स्तम्भित कर दिया । उन्होंने नाखूनोंके अग्रभागसे खेल-खेलमें ही भग (देवता)-के नेत्रोंको उखाड़ डाला, मुक्केसे मारकर पूषा (देवता)-के दाँतोंको तोड़
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: अद्वैतमचलं ब्रह्म निष्कलं निष्प्रपञ्चकम् । स्वसंवेद्यमवेद्यं तत् परे व्योम्नि व्यवस्थितम्
verses.transliteration: advaitamacalaṃ brahma niṣkalaṃ niṣprapañcakam / svasaṃvedyamavedyaṃ tat pare vyomni vyavasthitam
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: तथा चन्द्रमसं देवं पादाङ्गुष्ठेन लीलया। धर्षयामास बलवान् स्मयमानो गणेश्वरः वह्लेईस्तद्वयं छित्त्वा जिह्वामुत्पाट्य लीलया । जघान मूर्ध्नि पादेन मुनीनपि मुनीश्वराः
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: सूक्ष्मेण तमसा नित्यं वेष्टिता मम मायया । संसारसागरे घोरे जायन्ते च पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: sūkṣmeṇa tamasā nityaṃ veṣṭitā mama māyayā / saṃsārasāgare ghore jāyante ca punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: तथा विष्णुं सगरुडं समायान्तं महाबलः। विव्याध निशितेर्बाणैः स्तम्भयित्वा सुदर्शनम् समालोक्य महाबाहुरागत्य गरुडो गणम्। जघान पक्षैः सहसा ननादाम्बुनिधिर्यथा
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: भक्त्या त्वनन्यया राजन् सम्यग् ज्ञानेन चैव हि । अन्वेष्टव्यं हि तद् ब्रह्म जन्मबन्धनिवृत्तये
verses.transliteration: bhaktyā tvananyayā rājan samyag jñānena caiva hi / anveṣṭavyaṃ hi tad brahma janmabandhanivṛttaye
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: वैनतेयादभ्यधिकान् गरुडं ते प्रदुद्रुवुः अन्तर्हिते वैनतेये भगवान् पदासम्भवः । आगत्य वारयामास वीरभद्रं च केशवम्
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.commentary: Sense: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: अहङ्कारं च मात्सर्यं कामं क्रोधं परिग्रहम् । अधर्माभिनिवेशं च त्यक्त्वा वैराग्यमास्थितः
verses.transliteration: ahaṅkāraṃ ca mātsaryaṃ kāmaṃ krodhaṃ parigraham / adharmābhiniveśaṃ ca tyaktvā vairāgyamāsthitaḥ
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: संस्तूय भगवानीशः साम्बस्तत्रागमत् स्वयम् वीक्ष्य देवाधिदेव तं साम्बं सर्वगणैर्वृतम्। तुष्टाव भगवान् ब्रह्मा दक्षः सर्वे दिवौकसः
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.commentary: Sense: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: सर्वभूतेषु चात्मानं सर्वभूतानि चात्मनि । अन्वीक्ष्य चात्मनात्मानं ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते
verses.transliteration: sarvabhūteṣu cātmānaṃ sarvabhūtāni cātmani / anvīkṣya cātmanātmānaṃ brahmabhūyāya kalpate
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: विशेषात् पार्वतीं देवीमीश्वरार्धशरीरिणीम्। ततो भगवती देवी प्रहसन्ती महेश्वरम्। प्रसन्नमानसा रुद्रं वचः प्राह घृणानिधिः
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मभूतः प्रसन्नात्मा सर्वभूताभयप्रदः । ऐश्वरीं परमां भक्तिं विन्देतानन्यगामिनीम्
verses.transliteration: brahmabhūtaḥ prasannātmā sarvabhūtābhayapradaḥ / aiśvarīṃ paramāṃ bhaktiṃ vindetānanyagāminīm
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: ततः प्रहस्य भगवान् कपर्दी नीललोहितः । उवाच प्रणतान् देवान् प्राचेतसमथो हर: गच्छध्वं देवताः सर्वाः प्रसन्नो भवतामहम्। सम्पूज्यः सर्वयज्ञेषु न निन्द्योऽहं विशेषतः
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.commentary: Sense: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: वीक्षते तत् परं तत्त्वमैश्वरं ब्रह्मनिष्कलम् । सर्वसंसारनिर्मुक्तो ब्रह्मणेयवावतिष्ठते
verses.transliteration: vīkṣate tat paraṃ tattvamaiśvaraṃ brahmaniṣkalam / sarvasaṃsāranirmukto brahmaṇeyavāvatiṣṭhate
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: इसी प्रकार लीला करते हुए बलशाली गणेश्वर वीरभद्रने हँसकर पैरके अँगूठेसे चन्द्रमाको धर्षित कर (रौंद) दिया। अग्नि (देवता)-के दोनों हाथोंको काटकर लीलासे ही उनकी जीभ उखाड़ दी। मुनीश्वरो ! उन्होंने पैरसे मुनियोंके मस्तकपर भी प्रहार किया। साथ ही (उस) महाबली (वीरभद्र)-ने सुदर्शनचक्रको स्तम्भित कर गरुडपर बैठकर आते हुए विष्णुको भी तीक्ष्ण बाणोंसे विद्ध (चोटिल) कर दिया॥ ६२--६४॥
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.commentary: Sense: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मणो हि प्रतिष्ठायं परस्य परमः शिवः । अनन्तस्याव्ययस्यैकः स्वात्माधारो महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: brahmaṇo hi pratiṣṭhāyaṃ parasya paramaḥ śivaḥ / anantasyāvyayasyaikaḥ svātmādhāro maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: महाबाहु गरुडने वहाँ आकर गण (वीरभद्र)-को देखकर अचानक उन्हें अपने पंखोंसे मारा और समुद्रके हजारों गरुडोंको उत्पन्न कर डाला, जो विनतापुत्र गरुडसे भी अधिक बलशाली थे, वे सभी गरुडके ऊपर टूट पड़े। उन (वीरभद्रद्वारा उत्पन्न) गरुडोंको देखकर बुद्धिमान् वे गरुड विष्णुको छोड़कर बड़े ही वेगसे भाग
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.commentary: Sense: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानेन कर्मयोगेन भक्तियोगेन वा नृप । सर्वसंसारमुक्त्यर्थमीश्वरं सततं श्रय
verses.transliteration: jñānena karmayogena bhaktiyogena vā nṛpa / sarvasaṃsāramuktyarthamīśvaraṃ satataṃ śraya
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: उठे, यह एक आश्चर्यकी बात थी। विनताके पुत्र गरुडके अन्तर्धान हो जानेपर कमलसे उत्पन्न भगवान् ब्रह्माने वहाँ उपस्थित होकर वीरभद्र तथा केशवको (युद्ध करनेसे) रोका परमेष्ठी ब्रह्माको महत्ताको समझकर (वीरभद्रे उनकी) स्तुति कर उन्हें प्रसन्न किया। (उस समय) पार्वतीसहित साक्षात् भगवान् शंकर भी वहाँ आये। सभी गणोंसे घिरे हुए पार्वतीसहित उन देवाधिदेव शंकरको
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.commentary: Sense: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: एष गुह्योपदेशस्ते मया दत्तो गिरीश्वर । अन्वीक्ष्य चैतदखिलं यथेष्टं कर्तुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration: eṣa guhyopadeśaste mayā datto girīśvara / anvīkṣya caitadakhilaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ kartumarhasi
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: देखकर भगवान् ब्रह्मा, दक्ष तथा द्युलोकमें रहनेवाले सभी देवता उनकी (भगवान् शंकरको) स्तुति करने लगे। दक्षने विशेषरूपसे शंकरको अर्धाङ्गिनी देवी पार्वतीको हाथ जोड़कर प्रणाम करते हुए नाना प्रकारके स्तोत्रोंसे प्रसन्न किया। तदनन्तर दयाकी निधि देवी भगवतीने हँसते हुए प्रसन्न-मनसे महेश्वर रुद्रसे यह वचन कहा ॥ ६९--७२॥
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: अहं वै याचिता देवैः संजाता परमेश्वरात् । विनिन्द्य दक्षं पितरं महेश्वरविनिन्दकम्
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ vai yācitā devaiḥ saṃjātā parameśvarāt / vinindya dakṣaṃ pitaraṃ maheśvaravinindakam
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: आप ही संसारकी सृष्टि करनेवाले तथा आप ही शासन करनेवाले एवं रक्षक हैं। आप भगवान्को दक्ष तथा देवताओंपर कृपा करनी चाहिए। तदनन्तर जटा धारण करनेवाले नीललोहित भगवान् हरने हँसकर हूँ। सभी यज्ञोंमें विशेषरूपसे मेरी पूजा करनी चाहिए और मेरी निन्दा नहीं करनी चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.commentary: Sense: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: धर्मसंस्थापनार्थाय तवाराधनकारणात् । मेनादेहसमुत्पन्ना त्वामेव पितरं श्रिता
verses.transliteration: dharmasaṃsthāpanārthāya tavārādhanakāraṇāt / menādehasamutpannā tvāmeva pitaraṃ śritā
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: त्यक्त्वा लोकैषणामेतां मद्भक्तो भव यत्नतः तावत् तिष्ठ ममादेशात् स्वाधिकारेषु निर्वृतः
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.commentary: Sense: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: स त्वं नियोगाद् देवस्य ब्रह्मणः परमात्मनः । प्रिदास्यसे मां रुद्राय स्वयंवरसमागमे
verses.transliteration: sa tvaṃ niyogād devasya brahmaṇaḥ paramātmanaḥ / pridāsyase māṃ rudrāya svayaṃvarasamāgame
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: एवमुक्त्वा स भगवान् सपत्नीकः सहानुगः । अदर्शनमनृप्राप्तो दक्षस्यामिततेजसः अन्तर्हिते महादेवे शंकरे पदासम्भवः ।
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: तत्संबन्धाच्च ते राजन् सर्वे देवाः सवासवाः । त्वां नमस्यन्ति वै तात प्रसीदति च शङ्करः
verses.transliteration: tatsaṃbandhācca te rājan sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ / tvāṃ namasyanti vai tāta prasīdati ca śaṅkaraḥ
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: यदाचष्ट स्वयं देवः पालयैतदतन्त्रितः पश्यन्त्येनं ब्रह्मभूता विद्वांसो वेदवादिनः
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन मां विद्धीश्वरगोचराम् । संपूज्य देवमीशानं शरण्यं शरणं व्रज
verses.transliteration: tasmāt sarvaprayatnena māṃ viddhīśvaragocarām / saṃpūjya devamīśānaṃ śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: स्तूयते वैदिकैर्मन्त्रैर्देवदेबो महेश्वरः कर्मणा मनसा वाचा समाराधय यलतः
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.commentary: Sense: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: स एवमुक्तो भगवान् देवदेव्या गिरीश्वरः । प्रणम्य शिरसा देवीं प्राञ्जलिः पुनरब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: sa evamukto bhagavān devadevyā girīśvaraḥ / praṇamya śirasā devīṃ prāñjaliḥ punarabravīt
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: यस्तवैष महायोगी रक्षको विष्णुरव्ययः । स देवदेवो भगवान् महादेवो न संशयः मन्यन्ते ये जगद्योनिं विभिन्नं विष्णुमीश्वरात्। मोहादवेदनिष्ठत्वात् ते यान्ति नरकं नराः
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.commentary: Sense: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: विस्तरेण महेशानि योगं माहेश्वरं परम् । ज्ञानं चैवात्मनो योगं साधनानि प्रचक्ष्व मे
verses.transliteration: vistareṇa maheśāni yogaṃ māheśvaraṃ param / jñānaṃ caivātmano yogaṃ sādhanāni pracakṣva me
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: वेदानुवर्तिनो रुद्रं देवं नारायणं तथा। एकीभावेन पश्यन्ति मुक्तिभाजो भवन्ति ते यो विष्णुः स स्वयं रुद्रो यो रुद्रः स जनार्दनः । इति मत्वा यजेद् देवं स याति परमां गतिम्
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: तस्यैतत् परमं ज्ञानमात्मयोगमनुत्तमम् । यथावद् व्याजहारेशासाधनानिच विस्तरात्
verses.transliteration: tasyaitat paramaṃ jñānamātmayogamanuttamam / yathāvad vyājahāreśāsādhanānica vistarāt
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: हे दक्ष! तुम भी सभीकी रक्षा करनेमें समर्थ मेरे वचनको सुनो-तुम “मैं ही सबसे श्रेष्ठ हूँ” इस लोकेषणा (यशको इच्छा) -का परित्यागकर प्रयत्नपूर्वक मेरे भक्त बनो! इस कल्पके बीत जानेपर मेरी कृपासे तुम गणोंके अधिपति बनोगे । मेरे आदेशसे उस समयतक तुम अपने अधिकारपर शान्तिसे बने रहो
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.commentary: Sense: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: निशम्य वदनाम्भोजाद् गिरीन्द्रो लोकपूजितः । लोकमातुः परं ज्ञानं योगासक्तो ऽभवत्पुनः
verses.transliteration: niśamya vadanāmbhojād girīndro lokapūjitaḥ / lokamātuḥ paraṃ jñānaṃ yogāsakto 'bhavatpunaḥ
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: ऐसा कहकर वे भगवान् शंकर पत्नी पार्वती तथा अपने अनुचरोंसहित अमित तेजस्वी दक्षके लिये अन्तर्धान (अदृश्य) हो गये। महादेव शंकरके अन्तर्धान हो जानेपर साक्षात् पद्मोद्धव ब्रह्माने समस्त संसारके लिये कल्याणकारी बचन कहे--
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.commentary: Sense: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: प्रददौ च महेशाय पार्वतीं भाग्यगौरवात् । नियोगाद् ब्रह्मणः साध्वीं देवानां चैव संनिधौ
verses.transliteration: pradadau ca maheśāya pārvatīṃ bhāgyagauravāt / niyogād brahmaṇaḥ sādhvīṃ devānāṃ caiva saṃnidhau
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: ब्रह्माजीने कहा- (दक्ष!) वृषभध्वज शंकरे प्रसन्न हो जानेपर क्या तुम्हारा मोह दूर हुआ? साक्षात् भगवानूने जो तुमसे कहा है, आलस्यरहित होकर उसका पालन करो। ये परमेश्वर सभी प्राणियोंके हृदयमें निवास करते हैं। वेदवादी ब्रह्मस्वरूप विद्वान् लोग इनका दर्शन करते हैं। वे सभी प्राणियोंके आत्मा, वे ही बीजरूप तथा परम गति हैं। बैदिक मन्त्रोंके द्वारा देवदेव महेश्वरकी स्तुति की जाती है। जो उस
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.commentary: Sense: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: य इमं पठते ऽध्यायं देव्या माहात्म्यकीर्तनम् । शिवस्य संनिधौ भक्त्या सुचिस्तद्भावभावितः
verses.transliteration: ya imaṃ paṭhate 'dhyāyaṃ devyā māhātmyakīrtanam / śivasya saṃnidhau bhaktyā sucistadbhāvabhāvitaḥ
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: अद्वितीय सनातन रुद्रकी अपनी आत्मामें श्रद्धायुक्त मनसे आराधना करता है, वह परमपद अर्थात् मोक्ष प्राप्त करता है। इसलिये आदि, मध्य और अन्तसे रहित परमेश्वरको जानकर मन, वाणी तथा कर्मसे प्रयत्नपूर्वक उनको आराधना करो ॥ ८०--८४॥
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.commentary: Sense: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो दिव्ययोगसमन्वितः । उल्लङ्घ्य ब्रह्मणो लोकन्देव्याः स्थानमवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: sarvapāpavinirmukto divyayogasamanvitaḥ / ullaṅghya brahmaṇo lokandevyāḥ sthānamavāpnuyāt
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: अपना ही विनाश कर डालनेवाली शंकरको निन्दा करना प्रयत्नपूर्वक छोड़ दो, क्योंकि ( भगवान् शंकरको) निन्दा करनेवालेकी सारी क्रियाएँ दोषयुक्त ही होती हैं। जो आपके ये अव्यय तथा महायोगी विष्णु रक्षक हैं, वे भी देवताओंके देव भगवान् महादेव ही हैं, इसमें कोई संशय नहीं। जो आज्ञानसे तथा वेदमें निष्ठा न रखनेके कारण संसारके मूल कारण भगवान् विष्णुको शंकरसे पृथक् मानते हैं, वे मनुष्य नरकमें जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.transliteration: yaścaitat paṭhate stotraṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ samīpataḥ / devyāḥ samāhitamanāḥ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: वेदमार्गका अनुवर्तन करनेवाले लोग रुद्रदेव तथा नारायणको एकोभावसे देखते हैं, अतः वे मुक्तिपदके भागी होते हें जो विष्णु हैं वे ही साक्षात् रुद्र हैं और जो रुद्र हैं, वे ही जनार्दन विष्णु हैं-इस प्रकार समझकर जो देवका पूजन करता है, वह परमगतिको प्राप्त करता है
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.transliteration: nāmnāmaṣṭasahastraṃ tu devyā yat samudīritam / jñātvār'kamaṇḍalagatāṃ saṃbhāvya parameśvarīm

verses.hindi: सृजत्येतज्जगत् सर्व विष्णुस्तत् पश्यती श्वर: । इत्थं जगत् सर्वमिदं रुद्रनारायणोद्धवम् समाश्रयेन्महादेबं शरण्यं ब्रह्मवादिनाम्
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: अभ्यर्च्य गन्धपुष्पाद्यैर्भक्तियोगसमन्वितः । संस्मरन् परमं भावं देव्या माहेश्वरं परम्
verses.transliteration: abhyarcya gandhapuṣpādyairbhaktiyogasamanvitaḥ / saṃsmaran paramaṃ bhāvaṃ devyā māheśvaraṃ param

verses.hindi: जगाम शरणं देवं गोपतिं कुत्तिवाससम् द्विषन्तो मोहिता देवं सम्बभूवुः कलिष्वथ
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: अनन्यमानसो नित्यं जपेदामरणाद् द्विजः । सो ऽन्तकाले स्मृतिं लब्ध्वापरं ब्रह्माधिगच्छति
verses.transliteration: ananyamānaso nityaṃ japedāmaraṇād dvijaḥ / so 'ntakāle smṛtiṃ labdhvāparaṃ brahmādhigacchati
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: पूर्वसंस्कारमाहात्म्याद् ब्रह्मणो वचनादिह निपात्यमाना: कालेन सम्प्राप्यादित्यवर्चसम्। ब्रह्माणं जगतामीशमनुञ्ताताः स्वयम्भुवा
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: अथवा जायते विप्रो ब्राह्मणानां कुले शुचौ । पूर्वसंस्कारमाहात्म्याद् ब्रह्मविद्यामवाप्य सः
verses.transliteration: athavā jāyate vipro brāhmaṇānāṃ kule śucau / pūrvasaṃskāramāhātmyād brahmavidyāmavāpya saḥ
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: भविष्यन्ति यथा पूर्व शंकरस्य प्रसादतः एतद् वः कथितं सर्व दक्षयज्ञनिषूदनम्। शृणुध्वं दक्षपुत्रीणां सर्वासां चैव संततिम्
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: संप्राप्य योगं परमं दिव्यं तत् पारमेश्वरम् । शान्तः सर्वगातो भूत्वा शिवसायुज्यमानप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: saṃprāpya yogaṃ paramaṃ divyaṃ tat pārameśvaram / śāntaḥ sarvagāto bhūtvā śivasāyujyamānapnuyāt
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: विष्णु इस सम्पूर्ण जगत्को सृष्टि करते हैं और शंकर उसकी देख-रेख करते हैं। इस प्रकार यह सारा संसार रुद्र और नारायणद्वारा ही उत्पन्न होता है इसलिये भगवान् शंकरकी निन्दाका परित्याग कर और विष्णुमें भी ध्यान लगाकर ब्रह्मवादियोंके एकमात्र शरण्य महादेवका आश्रय ग्रहण करना चाहिए। इस प्रकार ब्रह्माके वचन सुनकर प्रजापति दक्ष चर्माम्बर
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्येकं चाथ नामानि जुहुयात् सवनत्रयम् । पूतनादिकृतैर्देषैर्ग्रहदोषैश्च मुच्यते
verses.transliteration: pratyekaṃ cātha nāmāni juhuyāt savanatrayam / pūtanādikṛtairdeṣairgrahadoṣaiśca mucyate
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: धारण करनेवाले देव पशुपतिकी शरणमें गये। और जो दूसरे महर्षि दधीचके शापरूपी अग्निसे दग्ध हो गये थे तथा मोहवश शंकरसे द्वेष करनेवाले थे, वे पूर्वजन्मके संस्कारोंके माहात्म्य तथा ब्रह्माके वचनसे सम्पूर्ण तपोबलका त्याग करके कलियुगमें ब्राह्मणोंके कुलमें उत्पन्न होंगे॥ ९१--९४॥
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
