verses.sanskrit: जपेद् वाहरहर्नित्यं संवत्सरमतन्द्रितः । श्रीकामः पार्वतीं देवीं पूजयित्वा विधानतः
verses.transliteration: japed vāharaharnityaṃ saṃvatsaramatandritaḥ / śrīkāmaḥ pārvatīṃ devīṃ pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: रौरव आदि नरकोंमें डाले गये वे सभी (शंकरसे विद्वेष करनेवाले) कल्पान्तमें यथासमय स्वयम्भूकी आज्ञासे आदित्यके समान तेजोमय जगत्के स्वामी ब्रह्मको प्राप्तकर शापसे मुक्त हो जायेगे और तपोयोगद्वारा कृपासे पुनः जैसे पहले थे वैसे ही (विप्रर्षि) हो जायेगे
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: संपूज्य पार्श्वतः शंभुं त्रिनेत्रं भक्तिसंयुतः । लभते महतीं लक्ष्मीं महादेवप्रसादतः
verses.transliteration: saṃpūjya pārśvataḥ śaṃbhuṃ trinetraṃ bhaktisaṃyutaḥ / labhate mahatīṃ lakṣmīṃ mahādevaprasādataḥ
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: प्रसंगवश (मैंने) यह सब दक्ष-यज्ञके विध्वंसको कथा आप लोगोंसे कही। अब आप लोग प्रजापति दक्षको सभी कन्याओंकी संतान-परम्पराका वर्णन सुनें दक्ष-कन्याओंकी संतति, नृसिंहावतार, हिरण्यकशिपु एवं हिरण्याक्ष वधका वर्णन, पृथ्वीका उद्धार, प्रह्माद-चरित, गौतमद्वारा दारुवननिवासी मुनियोंको शाप, अन्धकके साथ महादेवका युद्ध एवं महादेवद्वारा अपने स्वरूपका उपदेश, अन्धकद्वारा महादेवको स्तुति तथा महादेव (शंकर )-द्वारा अन्धकको गाणपत्य-पदकी प्राप्ति, अन्धक-

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन जप्तव्यं हि द्विजातिभिः । सर्वपापानोदार्थं देव्या नाम सहस्त्रकम्
verses.transliteration: tasmāt sarvaprayatnena japtavyaṃ hi dvijātibhiḥ / sarvapāpānodārthaṃ devyā nāma sahastrakam
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: द्वारा देवीको स्तुति और देवीद्वारा अन्धकको पुत्ररूपमें ग्रहण करना तथा विष्णुद्वारा उत्पन्न माताओंसे अपनी तीनों मूर्तियोंका प्रतिपादन ससर्ज देवान् गन्धर्वान् ऋषींश्चैवासुरोरगान्॥
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: प्रसङ्गात् कथितं विप्रा देव्या माहात्म्यमुत्तमम् । अतः परं प्रजासर्गं भृग्वादीनां निबोधत
verses.transliteration: prasaṅgāt kathitaṃ viprā devyā māhātmyamuttamam / ataḥ paraṃ prajāsargaṃ bhṛgvādīnāṃ nibodhata
verses.translation: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.hindi: तदा ससर्ज भूतानि मैथुनेनैव धर्मतः॥ सुतायां धर्मयुक्तायां पुत्राणां तु सहस्त्रकम्॥
verses.wordMeaning: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).
verses.commentary: Sense: Bahurdpd (having many forms), Surupd (having good forms), Virupd (having hideous forms), Rupavarjitd (devoid of iorms), Bhaktdrtiiamani (suppressor of distress of the devotee), Bhavjd (beautiful), BhavatdpavindSini (destroyer of the distress due to worldly existence).

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे एकादशो ऽध्यायः सूत उवाच भृगोः ख्यात्यां समुत्पन्ना लक्ष्मीर्नारायणप्रिया । देवौ धाताविधातारौ मेरोर्जामातरौ तथा
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge ekādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca bhṛgoḥ khyātyāṃ samutpannā lakṣmīrnārāyaṇapriyā / devau dhātāvidhātārau merorjāmātarau tathā
verses.translation: Nirgund (devoid of Gums), Nityavibhavd (having perpetual wealth), Nihsara (of topmost excellence), Nirapatrapd (devoid of bashfulness), Tapasvini (female ascetic), Sdmagiti ( Sdman songs), Bhavdnkanilaydlayd (having the lap of Bhava as abode and residence).
verses.hindi: ददौ स दश धर्माय कश्यपाय त्रयोदश। द्वे चैवाङ्गिरसे तद्वत् तासां वक्ष्येऽथ विस्तरम्॥
verses.wordMeaning: Nirgund (devoid of Gums), Nityavibhavd (having perpetual wealth), Nihsara (of topmost excellence), Nirapatrapd (devoid of bashfulness), Tapasvini (female ascetic), Sdmagiti ( Sdman songs), Bhavdnkanilaydlayd (having the lap of Bhava as abode and residence).
verses.commentary: Sense: Nirgund (devoid of Gums), Nityavibhavd (having perpetual wealth), Nihsara (of topmost excellence), Nirapatrapd (devoid of bashfulness), Tapasvini (female ascetic), Sdmagiti ( Sdman songs), Bhavdnkanilaydlayd (having the lap of Bhava as abode and residence).

verses.sanskrit: आयतिर्नियतिर्मेरोः कन्ये चैव महात्मनः । धाताविधात्रोस्ते भार्ये तयोर्जातौ सुतावुभौ
verses.transliteration: āyatirniyatirmeroḥ kanye caiva mahātmanaḥ / dhātāvidhātroste bhārye tayorjātau sutāvubhau
verses.translation: Dikid (initiation), Vidyddhari, Diptd (illuminated), Mahendravinipdtini (bringing about the downfall of Mahendra), SarvdtUdyini{enceWing everyone), ViSvd (universe), Sarvasiddhipra- ddyini (bestower of all Siddhis).
verses.hindi: धर्मपत्न्यो दश त्वेतास्तासां पुत्रान् निबोधत। विश्वाया विश्वदेवास्तु साध्या साध्यानजीजनत्॥ संकल्पायास्तु संकल्पो धर्मपुत्रा दश स्मृताः
verses.wordMeaning: Dikid (initiation), Vidyddhari, Diptd (illuminated), Mahendravinipdtini (bringing about the downfall of Mahendra), SarvdtUdyini{enceWing everyone), ViSvd (universe), Sarvasiddhipra- ddyini (bestower of all Siddhis).
verses.commentary: Sense: Dikid (initiation), Vidyddhari, Diptd (illuminated), Mahendravinipdtini (bringing about the downfall of Mahendra), SarvdtUdyini{enceWing everyone), ViSvd (universe), Sarvasiddhipra- ddyini (bestower of all Siddhis).

verses.sanskrit: प्राणश्चैव मृकण्डुश्च मार्कण्डेयो मृकण्डुतः । तथा वेदशिरा नाम प्राणस्य द्युतिमान् सुतः
verses.transliteration: prāṇaścaiva mṛkaṇḍuśca mārkaṇḍeyo mṛkaṇḍutaḥ / tathā vedaśirā nāma prāṇasya dyutimān sutaḥ
verses.translation: Kdmadhem (the wish-yielding divine cow), Brhad- garbhd (having a huge womb), Zl/iiOTati(intelligent), Mohandiini (destroyer of delusion). Nihsahkalpd (devoid of conception) Nirdtahkd (devoid of agony), Vinayd (having humility), Vinaya- priyd (fond of modesty).
verses.hindi: प्रत्यूषश्च प्रभासश्च वसवोऽष्टौ प्रकीतिताः ध्रुवस्य पुत्रो भगवान् कालो लोकप्रकालनः
verses.wordMeaning: Kdmadhem (the wish-yielding divine cow), Brhad- garbhd (having a huge womb), Zl/iiOTati(intelligent), Mohandiini (destroyer of delusion). Nihsahkalpd (devoid of conception) Nirdtahkd (devoid of agony), Vinayd (having humility), Vinaya- priyd (fond of modesty).
verses.commentary: Sense: Kdmadhem (the wish-yielding divine cow), Brhad- garbhd (having a huge womb), Zl/iiOTati(intelligent), Mohandiini (destroyer of delusion). Nihsahkalpd (devoid of conception) Nirdtahkd (devoid of agony), Vinayd (having humility), Vinaya- priyd (fond of modesty).

verses.sanskrit: मरीचेरपि संभूतिः पौर्णमासमसूयत । कन्याचतुष्टयं चैव सर्वलक्षणसंयुतम्
verses.transliteration: marīcerapi saṃbhūtiḥ paurṇamāsamasūyata / kanyācatuṣṭayaṃ caiva sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutam
verses.translation: Jvdldmdldsahasrddhyd (richly endowed with thousands of clusters of flames), Devadevi (goddess of Devas), Mano- mayd (constituted of the mind), {v.l. manomani: the exciter of
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले--पूर्वकालमें 'प्रजाकी सृष्टि करो' इस प्रकारकी स्वयम्भू--ब्रह्माकी आज्ञा प्राकर दक्षने की। जब सृष्टि करनेवाले उन दक्षकी वे प्रजाएँ नहीं बढ़ीं, तब उन्होंने मर्यादापूर्वक मिथुन-धर्म (स्त्री-पुरुष- संयोग)-से प्राणियोंकी सृष्टि की । उन्होंने वीरण प्रजापतिकी धर्मपरायणा असिक्नी नामकी कन्यासे एक हजार पुत्रोंको
verses.wordMeaning: Jvdldmdldsahasrddhyd (richly endowed with thousands of clusters of flames), Devadevi (goddess of Devas), Mano- mayd (constituted of the mind), {v.l. manomani: the exciter of
verses.commentary: Sense: Jvdldmdldsahasrddhyd (richly endowed with thousands of clusters of flames), Devadevi (goddess of Devas), Mano- mayd (constituted of the mind), {v.l. manomani: the exciter of

verses.sanskrit: तुष्टिर्ज्येष्ठा तथा वृष्टिः कृष्टिश्चापचितिस्तथा । विरजाः पर्वश्चैव पौर्णमासस्य तौ सुतौ
verses.transliteration: tuṣṭirjyeṣṭhā tathā vṛṣṭiḥ kṛṣṭiścāpacitistathā / virajāḥ parvaścaiva paurṇamāsasya tau sutau
verses.translation: Mahendropendrabhagini (sister ofMahendraand Upen-
verses.hindi: उत्पन्न किया। देवर्षि नारदकी मायासे उन पुत्रोके नष्ट हो जानेपर पुनः उन दक्ष प्रजापतिने वीरणकी पुत्री असिक्नीसे ही साठ कन्याओंको उत्पन्न किया (उन साठ कन्याओंमेंसे) उन्होंने दस धर्मको, तेरह कश्यपको, सत्ताईस चन्द्रमाको, चार अरिष्टनेमिको, दो बहुपुत्रको, दो बुद्धिमान् कृशाश्वको और इसी प्रकार दो कन्याएँ अंगिराको प्रदान कीं। अब मैं उनके वंश-
verses.wordMeaning: Mahendropendrabhagini (sister ofMahendraand Upen-
verses.commentary: Sense: Mahendropendrabhagini (sister ofMahendraand Upen-

verses.sanskrit: क्षमा तु सुषुवे पुत्रान् पुलहस्य प्रजापतेः । कर्दमं च वरीयांसं सहिष्णुं मुनिसत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: kṣamā tu suṣuve putrān pulahasya prajāpateḥ / kardamaṃ ca varīyāṃsaṃ sahiṣṇuṃ munisattamam
verses.translation: Dakind (dexterous, amiable), Dahati (self-immo¬ lation into fire), Dirghd (long), Sarvabhutanamaskrtd (bowed to by all living beings), Togamdyd, Vibhdgajm (knower of the divi¬ sions), Mahdmohd (great delusion), Gariyasi (very great).
verses.hindi: विस्तारका वर्णन करूँगा धर्मकी पत्नियाँ हैं। इनके पुत्रोंके नाम सुनो। विश्वाके विश्वेदेव हुए और साध्याने साध्य नामवाले पुत्रोंको जन्म दिया। मरुत्वतीसे मरुद्गण हुए और वसुसे वसु नामक आठ पुत्र हुए। भानुसे भानुओ और मुहूर्तासे मुहूर्तोंकी
verses.wordMeaning: Dakind (dexterous, amiable), Dahati (self-immo¬ lation into fire), Dirghd (long), Sarvabhutanamaskrtd (bowed to by all living beings), Togamdyd, Vibhdgajm (knower of the divi¬ sions), Mahdmohd (great delusion), Gariyasi (very great).
verses.commentary: Sense: Dakind (dexterous, amiable), Dahati (self-immo¬ lation into fire), Dirghd (long), Sarvabhutanamaskrtd (bowed to by all living beings), Togamdyd, Vibhdgajm (knower of the divi¬ sions), Mahdmohd (great delusion), Gariyasi (very great).

verses.sanskrit: तथैव च कनीयासं तपोनिर्धूतकल्पषम् । अनसूया तथैवात्रेर्जज्ञे पुत्रानकल्पषान्
verses.transliteration: tathaiva ca kanīyāsaṃ taponirdhūtakalpaṣam / anasūyā tathaivātrerjajñe putrānakalpaṣān
verses.translation: Sandhyd (twilight), Sarvasamudbh uti (cause of the origin of everything through the support etc. to Brahma Vidyd i.e. doctrine of Brahman), Bijdnkurasamudbhuti (cause of the origin of seeds and shoots), Mahdsakti, Mahdmati (of great intellect).
verses.hindi: उत्पत्ति हुई। लम्बासे घोष और जामिसे नागवीथी नामक पुत्र उत्पन्न हुए। अरुन्धतीसे सम्पूर्ण पृथ्वीसे सम्बद्ध प्राणियोंकी उत्पत्ति हुई और संकल्पासे संकल्प नामक पुत्र उत्पन्न हुए। इस प्रकार धर्मके (ये) दस पुत्र कहे प्रभास-ये अष्ट वसु कहे गये हैं। आपके वैतण्डय, श्रम, श्रान्त तथा धुनि नामक पुत्र हुए और ध्रुवके पुत्र संसारके संहारक भगवान् काल हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Sandhyd (twilight), Sarvasamudbh uti (cause of the origin of everything through the support etc. to Brahma Vidyd i.e. doctrine of Brahman), Bijdnkurasamudbhuti (cause of the origin of seeds and shoots), Mahdsakti, Mahdmati (of great intellect).
verses.commentary: Sense: Sandhyd (twilight), Sarvasamudbh uti (cause of the origin of everything through the support etc. to Brahma Vidyd i.e. doctrine of Brahman), Bijdnkurasamudbhuti (cause of the origin of seeds and shoots), Mahdsakti, Mahdmati (of great intellect).

verses.sanskrit: सोमं दुर्वाससं चैव दत्तात्रेयं च योगिनम् । स्मृतिश्चाङ्गिरसः पुत्रीर्जज्ञे लक्षणसंयुताः
verses.transliteration: somaṃ durvāsasaṃ caiva dattātreyaṃ ca yoginam / smṛtiścāṅgirasaḥ putrīrjajñe lakṣaṇasaṃyutāḥ
verses.translation: (forgiveness), PrajiM (intellect), Citi (knowl¬ edge), Sat-cit (existence and consciousness), MahdbhogindraSdyini {lying on the couch of the body of the leader of serpents), Vikrti (aberration or change), dfikarl (belonging to Sankara), Sdsti (the rule), Ganagandharvasevitd (served by groups of Ganas and Gandharvas).
verses.hindi: सोमस्य भगवान् वर्चा धरस्य द्रविण: सुतः । पुरोजबोनिलस्य स्यादविज्ञातगतिस्तथा कुमारो ह्वानलस्यासीत् सेनापतिरिति स्मृतः । देवलो भगवान् योगी प्रत्यूषस्याभवत् सुतः । विश्वकर्मा प्रभासस्य शिल्पकर्ता प्रजापति:
verses.wordMeaning: (forgiveness), PrajiM (intellect), Citi (knowl¬ edge), Sat-cit (existence and consciousness), MahdbhogindraSdyini {lying on the couch of the body of the leader of serpents), Vikrti (aberration or change), dfikarl (belonging to Sankara), Sdsti (the rule),…
verses.commentary: Sense: (forgiveness), PrajiM (intellect), Citi (knowl¬ edge), Sat-cit (existence and consciousness), MahdbhogindraSdyini {lying on the couch of the body of the leader of serpents), Vikrti (aberration or change), dfikarl (belonging to Sankara), Sdsti (the rule),…

verses.sanskrit: सिनीवालीं कुहूं चैव राकामनुमतिं तथा । प्रीत्यां पुलस्त्यो भगवान् दत्तात्रिमसृजत् प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: sinīvālīṃ kuhūṃ caiva rākāmanumatiṃ tathā / prītyāṃ pulastyo bhagavān dattātrimasṛjat prabhuḥ
verses.translation: VaUvdnari (the cosmic fire), MahdSdld (the great hall of the divine fire Vaiivdnara), Mahdsend (having great army), Guhapriyd {ionAoi Guha), Mahdrdtri (the great night), Shidnandd (bestower of bliss on Siva), SaciduhsvdpandHni (destroyer of the bad dream of (Saci —Indra's spouse).
verses.hindi: कद्रुर्मुनिश्च धर्मज्ञा तत्पुत्रान् वै निबोधत विवस्वान् सविता पूषा हांशुमान् विष्णुरेव च
verses.wordMeaning: VaUvdnari (the cosmic fire), MahdSdld (the great hall of the divine fire Vaiivdnara), Mahdsend (having great army), Guhapriyd {ionAoi Guha), Mahdrdtri (the great night), Shidnandd (bestower of bliss on Siva),…
verses.commentary: Sense: VaUvdnari (the cosmic fire), MahdSdld (the great hall of the divine fire Vaiivdnara), Mahdsend (having great army), Guhapriyd {ionAoi Guha), Mahdrdtri (the great night), Shidnandd (bestower of bliss on Siva),…

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वजन्मनि सो ऽगस्त्यः स्मृतः स्वायंभुवे ऽन्तरे । वेदबाहुं तथा कन्यां सन्नतिं नाम नामतः
verses.transliteration: pūrvajanmani so 'gastyaḥ smṛtaḥ svāyaṃbhuve 'ntare / vedabāhuṃ tathā kanyāṃ sannatiṃ nāma nāmataḥ
verses.translation: Ijyd (sacrifice), Pujyd (worthy of being worshipped), Jagaddhdtri (the nursing mother of the universe), Durvijneyd
verses.hindi: आराध्य तपसा देवं ब्रह्माणं परमेष्ठिनम्। दृष्टा लेभे वरान् दिव्यान् स्तुत्वासौ विविधैः स्तवैः अथ तस्य बलाद् देवाः सर्व एव सुरर्षयः । बाधितास्ताडिता जम्मुर्देवदेवं पितामहम्
verses.wordMeaning: Ijyd (sacrifice), Pujyd (worthy of being worshipped), Jagaddhdtri (the nursing mother of the universe), Durvijneyd
verses.commentary: Sense: Ijyd (sacrifice), Pujyd (worthy of being worshipped), Jagaddhdtri (the nursing mother of the universe), Durvijneyd

verses.sanskrit: पुत्राणां षष्टिसाहस्त्रं संततिः सुषुवे क्रतोः । ते चोर्ध्वरेतसः सर्वे बालखिल्या इति स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: putrāṇāṃ ṣaṣṭisāhastraṃ saṃtatiḥ suṣuve kratoḥ / te cordhvaretasaḥ sarve bālakhilyā iti smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Guhdmbikd (the Mother of Guha or Karttikeya), Gunotpatti (the cause of origin of all qualities), Mahdpithd (hav¬ ing a highly exalted seat), Marutsutd (daughter of the Maruts), Havyavdhdntardgddi (having fondness etc. for the sacrificial fire), Havyavdhasamudbhavd (born of sacrificial fire).
verses.hindi: शरण्यं शरणं देवं शम्भुं सर्वजगन्मयम्। ब्रह्माणं लोककर्तारं त्रातारं पुरुषं परम्। कूटस्थं जगतामेकं पुराणं पुरुषोत्तमम् स याचितो देववरैर्मुनिभिश्च मुनीश्वराः। सर्वदेवहितार्थाय जगाम कमलासनः
verses.wordMeaning: Guhdmbikd (the Mother of Guha or Karttikeya), Gunotpatti (the cause of origin of all qualities), Mahdpithd (hav¬ ing a highly exalted seat), Marutsutd (daughter of the Maruts), Havyavdhdntardgddi (having fondness etc. for the sacrificial fire),…
verses.commentary: Sense: Guhdmbikd (the Mother of Guha or Karttikeya), Gunotpatti (the cause of origin of all qualities), Mahdpithd (hav¬ ing a highly exalted seat), Marutsutd (daughter of the Maruts), Havyavdhdntardgddi (having fondness etc. for the sacrificial fire),…

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठश्च तथोर्जायां सप्तपुत्रानजीजनत् । कन्यां च पुण्डरीकाक्षां सर्वेशोभासमन्विताम्
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭhaśca tathorjāyāṃ saptaputrānajījanat / kanyāṃ ca puṇḍarīkākṣāṃ sarveśobhāsamanvitām
verses.translation: Jagadyoni (the source of origin of the universe), Jaganmdtd (mother of the universe), Janma-mrtyu-jardtigd (going beyond the barriers of birth, death and old age), Buddhi (intellect), Mahdbuddhimati (possessing great intellect), Purufdnt- ara-vdsini (staying within Picrua).
verses.hindi: दृष्टा देवं जगद्योनिं विष्णुं विश्वगुरुं शिवम्। ववन्दे चरणौ मूर्ध्ना कृताञ्जलिरभाषत भगवान् वर्चा सोमके पुत्र हैं और धरके द्रविण नामक पुत्र हँ । अनिलके पुरोजव तथा अविज्ञातगति नाम- वाले पुत्र हैं। अतुलके पुत्र कुमार हैं जो ' सेनापति' नामसे कहे जाते हैं। प्रत्यूष (नामक वसु)-के महायोगी भगवान्
verses.wordMeaning: Jagadyoni (the source of origin of the universe), Jaganmdtd (mother of the universe), Janma-mrtyu-jardtigd (going beyond the barriers of birth, death and old age), Buddhi (intellect), Mahdbuddhimati (possessing great intellect), Purufdnt- ara-vdsini (staying within Picrua).
verses.commentary: Sense: Jagadyoni (the source of origin of the universe), Jaganmdtd (mother of the universe), Janma-mrtyu-jardtigd (going beyond the barriers of birth, death and old age), Buddhi (intellect), Mahdbuddhimati (possessing great intellect), Purufdnt- ara-vdsini (staying within Picrua).

verses.sanskrit: रजोहश्चोर्ध्वबाहुश्च सवनश्चानघस्तथा । सुतपाः शुक्र इत्येते सप्त पुत्रा महौजसः
verses.transliteration: rajohaścordhvabāhuśca savanaścānaghastathā / sutapāḥ śukra ityete sapta putrā mahaujasaḥ
verses.translation: Tarasvini (of great velocity), Samddhisthd (absorbed in a trance), Trinetrd (having three eyes), Divi samsthitd (station¬ ed into heaven), Sarvendriyamanomdtd (the mother of all sense organs and minds), Sarvabhutahrdisthitd (stationed in the hearts of all living beings).
verses.hindi: देवल नामक पुत्र हुए। इसी प्रकार प्रभासके प्रजापति विश्वकर्मा नामक पुत्र हैं जो शिल्पकारी हैं विनता, ताम्रा, क्रोधवशा, इरा, कद्रु, मुनि तथा धर्मज्ञा-- (दक्षकी ये तेरह कन्याएँ कश्यपकी पत्नियाँ हैं) उनके पुत्रोंके विषयमें सुनो-
verses.wordMeaning: Tarasvini (of great velocity), Samddhisthd (absorbed in a trance), Trinetrd (having three eyes), Divi samsthitd (station¬ ed into heaven), Sarvendriyamanomdtd (the mother of all sense organs and minds), Sarvabhutahrdisthitd (stationed in the hearts of all living beings).
verses.commentary: Sense: Tarasvini (of great velocity), Samddhisthd (absorbed in a trance), Trinetrd (having three eyes), Divi samsthitd (station¬ ed into heaven), Sarvendriyamanomdtd (the mother of all sense organs and minds), Sarvabhutahrdisthitd (stationed in the hearts of all living beings).

verses.sanskrit: यो ऽसौ रुद्रात्मको वह्निर्ब्रह्मणस्तनयो द्विजाः । स्वाहा तस्मात् सुतान् लेभे त्रीनुदारान् महौजसः
verses.transliteration: yo 'sau rudrātmako vahnirbrahmaṇastanayo dvijāḥ / svāhā tasmāt sutān lebhe trīnudārān mahaujasaḥ
verses.translation: Sards dr atdrini (she who enables everyone to cross the ocean of worldly existence), Vidyd (learning), Brahmavddi- manolayd (residing in the minds of the expounders of Brahman) Brahmdnl, Brhati, Brdhmi, Brahmabhutd, Bhavdrani.
verses.hindi: विवस्वान्, सविता, पूषा, अंशुमान् तथा विष्णु—ये सभी पूर्वकालमें चाक्षुष मन्वन्तरमें तुषित नामक देवता थे और वैवस्वत मन्वन्तरमें ये ही अदितिके पुत्र (बारह) आदित्य कहे गये हैं। दितिने कश्यपसे बलवान् दो पुत्रोंको प्राप्त किया। उनमें हिरण्यकशिपु बड़ा था, उसका अनुज हिरण्याक्ष था। हैत्य हिरण्यकशिपु
verses.wordMeaning: Sards dr atdrini (she who enables everyone to cross the ocean of worldly existence), Vidyd (learning), Brahmavddi- manolayd (residing in the minds of the expounders of Brahman) Brahmdnl, Brhati, Brdhmi, Brahmabhutd, Bhavdrani.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sards dr atdrini (she who enables everyone to cross the ocean of worldly existence), Vidyd (learning), Brahmavddi- manolayd (residing in the minds of the expounders of Brahman) Brahmdnl, Brhati, Brdhmi, Brahmabhutd, Bhavdrani.

verses.sanskrit: पावकः पवमानश्च शुचिरग्निश्च ते त्रयः । निर्मथ्यः पवमानः स्याद् वैद्युतः पावकः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: pāvakaḥ pavamānaśca śuciragniśca te trayaḥ / nirmathyaḥ pavamānaḥ syād vaidyutaḥ pāvakaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Hirarmayi (of golden form), Maharatri (great night), Sarhsdraparivartikd (the transformer of the Sarhsdra), Sumdlini (having good garlands, Surupd (having good forms), Bhdvini (purified), Hdrini (wearing necklace), Prabhd (lustre).
verses.hindi: परमेष्ठी ब्रह्माकी आराधनाकर उनका दर्शन किया तथा विविध स्तोत्रोंद्वारा उनकी स्तुतिकर दिव्य वरोंको प्राप्त किया। उसके पराक्रमसे पीड़ित एवं ताडित सभी देवता एवं देवर्षिगण शरण ग्रहण करने योग्य, आश्रयस्वरूप, सर्वजगन्मय, शम्भु देवस्वरूप त्राता, लोककर्ता, परमपुरुष, कूटस्थ, जगत्के एकमात्र पुराण पुरुष पुरुषोत्तम देवोंके देव पितामह ब्रह्माकी शरणमें गये
verses.wordMeaning: Hirarmayi (of golden form), Maharatri (great night), Sarhsdraparivartikd (the transformer of the Sarhsdra), Sumdlini (having good garlands, Surupd (having good forms), Bhdvini (purified), Hdrini (wearing necklace), Prabhd (lustre).
verses.commentary: Sense: Hirarmayi (of golden form), Maharatri (great night), Sarhsdraparivartikd (the transformer of the Sarhsdra), Sumdlini (having good garlands, Surupd (having good forms), Bhdvini (purified), Hdrini (wearing necklace), Prabhd (lustre).

verses.sanskrit: यश्चासौ तपते सूर्यः शुचिरग्निस्त्वसौ स्मृतः । तेषां तु संततावन्ये चत्वारिंश्च पञ्च च
verses.transliteration: yaścāsau tapate sūryaḥ śuciragnistvasau smṛtaḥ / teṣāṃ tu saṃtatāvanye catvāriṃśca pañca ca
verses.translation: Unmilani (the eye-opener), Sarva-sahd (endurer of everything), Sarva-piratyaya-sdkiniiy/ivatssoi allnotions), Susaumyd (very gentle), Candravadand (Moon-faced), Tdniavdsakta-mdnasd (whose mind is interested in the Tdnava dance).
verses.hindi: मुनीशवरो! श्रेष्ठ देवताओं तथा मुनियोंके द्वारा प्रार्थना किये जानेपर सभी देवताओंके कल्याण करनेकी इच्छासे कमलके आसनवाले ब्रह्मा क्षीरसागरके उत्तरी तटपर गये, जहाँ विनीत मुनीन्द्रों तथा देवताओंके द्वारा स्तुति किये जाते हुए हरि ईश्वर निवास करते हैं। जगतूके मूल कारण, विश्वके गुरु, कल्याणमय, विष्णुदेवका दर्शन करके उन्होंने मस्तक झुकाकर चरणोंमें प्रणाम किया और हाथ जोड़कर (इस प्रकार) कहा-
verses.wordMeaning: Unmilani (the eye-opener), Sarva-sahd (endurer of everything), Sarva-piratyaya-sdkiniiy/ivatssoi allnotions), Susaumyd (very gentle), Candravadand (Moon-faced), Tdniavdsakta-mdnasd (whose mind is interested in the Tdnava dance).
verses.commentary: Sense: Unmilani (the eye-opener), Sarva-sahd (endurer of everything), Sarva-piratyaya-sdkiniiy/ivatssoi allnotions), Susaumyd (very gentle), Candravadand (Moon-faced), Tdniavdsakta-mdnasd (whose mind is interested in the Tdnava dance).

verses.sanskrit: पावकः पवमानश्च शुचिस्तेषां पिता च यः । एते चैकोनपञ्चाशद् वह्नयः परिकीर्तितः
verses.transliteration: pāvakaḥ pavamānaśca śucisteṣāṃ pitā ca yaḥ / ete caikonapañcāśad vahnayaḥ parikīrtitaḥ
verses.translation: Sattvasuddhikari (the purifier of the mind), Suddhi
verses.hindi: ब्रह्माने कहा (भगवन्!) आप सभी प्राणियोंकी गति हैं, अनन्त हैं और इस सम्पूर्ण विश्वके आत्मस्वरूप हैं। आप सर्वत्र व्याप्त, सभी देवताओंके शरीररूप, महायोगी तथा सनातन हैं त्वं कर्ता चैव भर्ता च निहन्ता सुरविद्विषाम्। त्रातुमर्हस्यनन्तेश त्राता हि परमेश्वरः
verses.wordMeaning: Sattvasuddhikari (the purifier of the mind), Suddhi
verses.commentary: Sense: Sattvasuddhikari (the purifier of the mind), Suddhi

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे तपस्विनः प्रोक्ताः सर्वे यज्ञेषु भागिनः । रुद्रात्मकाः स्मृताः सर्वे त्रिपुण्ड्राङ्कितमस्तकाः
verses.transliteration: sarve tapasvinaḥ proktāḥ sarve yajñeṣu bhāginaḥ / rudrātmakāḥ smṛtāḥ sarve tripuṇḍrāṅkitamastakāḥ
verses.translation: Sattvasuddhikari (the purifier of the mind), Suddhi
verses.hindi: इत्थं स विष्णुर्भगवान् ब्रह्मणा सम्प्रबोधितः । प्रोवाचोन्निद्रपद्याक्षः पीतवासासुरद्विषः किमर्थ सुमहावीर्या: सप्रजापतिकाः सुराः । इमं देशमनृप्राप्ताः किं वा कार्य करोमि वः
verses.wordMeaning: Sattvasuddhikari (the purifier of the mind), Suddhi
verses.commentary: Sense: Sattvasuddhikari (the purifier of the mind), Suddhi

verses.sanskrit: अयज्वानश्च यज्वानः पितरो ब्रह्मणः स्मृताः । अग्निष्वात्ता बर्हिषदो द्विधा तेषां व्यवस्थितिः
verses.transliteration: ayajvānaśca yajvānaḥ pitaro brahmaṇaḥ smṛtāḥ / agniṣvāttā barhiṣado dvidhā teṣāṃ vyavasthitiḥ
verses.translation: Sattvasuddhikari (the purifier of the mind), Suddhi
verses.hindi: हिरण्यकशिपुर्नाम ब्रह्मणो वरदर्पितः। बाधते भगवन् हैत्यो देवान् सर्वान् सहर्षिभिः श्रुत्वा तद्हैवतैरुक्तं स विष्णुर्लोकभावनः। वधाय हैत्यमुख्यस्य सोऽसृजत् पुरुषं स्वयम्
verses.wordMeaning: Sattvasuddhikari (the purifier of the mind), Suddhi
verses.commentary: Sense: Sattvasuddhikari (the purifier of the mind), Suddhi

verses.sanskrit: तेभ्यः स्वधा सुतां जज्ञे मेनां वैतरणीं तथा । ते उभे ब्रह्मवादिन्यौ योगिन्यौ मुनिसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: tebhyaḥ svadhā sutāṃ jajñe menāṃ vaitaraṇīṃ tathā / te ubhe brahmavādinyau yoginyau munisattamāḥ
verses.translation: Sattvasuddhikari (the purifier of the mind), Suddhi
verses.hindi: हत्वा तं हैत्यराजं त्वं हिरण्यकशिपुं पुनः । इमं देशं समागन्तुं क्षिप्रमर्हसि पौरुषात् महापुरुषमव्यक्तं ययौ हैत्यमहापुरम्
verses.wordMeaning: Sattvasuddhikari (the purifier of the mind), Suddhi
verses.commentary: Sense: Sattvasuddhikari (the purifier of the mind), Suddhi

verses.sanskrit: असूत मेना मैनाकं क्रौञ्चं तस्यानुजं तथा । गङ्गा हिमवतो जज्ञे सर्वलोकैकपावनी
verses.transliteration: asūta menā mainākaṃ krauñcaṃ tasyānujaṃ tathā / gaṅgā himavato jajñe sarvalokaikapāvanī
verses.translation: Sattvasuddhikari (the purifier of the mind), Suddhi
verses.hindi: आरुह्य गरुडं देवो महामेरुरिवापरः आकर्ण्य॒हैत्यप्रवरा महामेघरवोपमम्। समाचचक्षिरे नादं तदा हैत्यपतेर्भयात्
verses.wordMeaning: Sattvasuddhikari (the purifier of the mind), Suddhi
verses.commentary: Sense: Sattvasuddhikari (the purifier of the mind), Suddhi

verses.sanskrit: स्वयोगाग्निबलाद् देवीं लेभे पुत्रीं महेश्वरीं । यथावत् कथितं पूर्वं देव्या माहात्म्यमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: svayogāgnibalād devīṃ lebhe putrīṃ maheśvarīṃ / yathāvat kathitaṃ pūrvaṃ devyā māhātmyamuttamam
verses.translation: Sattvasuddhikari (the purifier of the mind), Suddhi
verses.hindi: श्रदागच्छति महान् पुरुषो देवचोदितः । भैरवं नादं तं जानीमोऽमरार्दन दृष्टा तं गरुडासीनं सूर्यकोटिसमप्रभम्। पुरुषं पर्वताकारं नारायणमिवापरम्
verses.wordMeaning: Sattvasuddhikari (the purifier of the mind), Suddhi
verses.commentary: Sense: Sattvasuddhikari (the purifier of the mind), Suddhi

verses.sanskrit: एषा दक्षस्य कन्यानां मयापत्यानुसंततिः । व्याख्याता भवतामद्य मनोः सृष्टिं निबोधत
verses.transliteration: eṣā dakṣasya kanyānāṃ mayāpatyānusaṃtatiḥ / vyākhyātā bhavatāmadya manoḥ sṛṣṭiṃ nibodhata
verses.translation: Sattvasuddhikari (the purifier of the mind), Suddhi
verses.hindi: आप सभी प्राणियोंकी आत्मा, प्रधान और परा प्रकृति हैं। आप वैराग्य और ऐश्वर्यमें निरत, रागातीत तथा निरञ्जन हैं। आप ही कर्ता-भर्ता तथा देवताओंसे द्वेष रखनेवालोंके संहर्ता हैं। अनन्तेश! आप ही रक्षा करनेवाले परमेश्वर हैं, आप रक्षा करें
verses.wordMeaning: Sattvasuddhikari (the purifier of the mind), Suddhi
verses.commentary: Sense: Sattvasuddhikari (the purifier of the mind), Suddhi

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे द्वादशो ऽध्यायः सूत उवाच प्रियव्रतोत्तानपादौ मनोः स्वायंभुवस्य तु । धर्मज्ञौ सुमहावीर्यौ शतरूपा व्यजीजनत्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge dvādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca priyavratottānapādau manoḥ svāyaṃbhuvasya tu / dharmajñau sumahāvīryau śatarūpā vyajījanat
verses.translation: JVirdsrayd (having no support), Nirdhdrd (having no food), Nirankusapadodbhavd (born of that free curbless region).
verses.hindi: ब्रह्माके द्वारा इस प्रकार भलीभाँति प्रबुद्ध किये जानेपर विकसित कमलके समान नेत्रवाले, पीत वस्त्र धारण करनेवाले तथा असुरोंके द्वेषी भगवान् विष्णु बोले--अत्यन्त वीर्यशाली देवताओ! आपलोग प्रजापतियोके साथ इस स्थानपर किस कारणसे आये हैं अथवा में आप लोगोंका कौन-सा कार्य करूं ?
verses.wordMeaning: JVirdsrayd (having no support), Nirdhdrd (having no food), Nirankusapadodbhavd (born of that free curbless region).
verses.commentary: Sense: JVirdsrayd (having no support), Nirdhdrd (having no food), Nirankusapadodbhavd (born of that free curbless region).

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तूत्तानपादस्य ध्रुवो नाम सुतो ऽभवत् । भक्तो नारायणे देवे प्राप्तवान् स्थानमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: tatastūttānapādasya dhruvo nāma suto 'bhavat / bhakto nārāyaṇe deve prāptavān sthānamuttamam
verses.translation: Vidydmayi (learning incarnate), Sahasrdkfi (having a thousand eyes), Sahasravadandtmajd (daughter of the thousand¬ faced), SahasraraSmi (having a thousand rays), Sattvasthd (stationed in the Sattva-guna ), Maheivarapaddhayd (resorted to or supported by the feet of Mahesvara).
verses.hindi: कारण घमंडसे भरा हुआ हिरण्यकशिपु नामका हैत्य ऋषियोंसहित सभी देवताओंको पीडित कर रहा है। हे पुरुषोत्तम! आपको छोड़कर अन्य सभी प्राणियोंसे वह अवध्य है । जगन्मय! आप उसे मारनेमें समर्थ हैं, आप ही सभीके रक्षक हैं। देवताओंके द्वारा कही गयी उस बातको सुनकर संसारके रक्षक विष्णुने हैत्यप्रमुख उस हिरण्यकशिपुके वधके लिये स्वयं एक पुरुषको उत्पन किया। सुमेरु पर्वतके समान शरीरवाले, घोर रूपवाले,
verses.wordMeaning: Vidydmayi (learning incarnate), Sahasrdkfi (having a thousand eyes), Sahasravadandtmajd (daughter of the thousand¬ faced), SahasraraSmi (having a thousand rays), Sattvasthd (stationed in the Sattva-guna ), Maheivarapaddhayd (resorted to or supported by the feet of Mahesvara).
verses.commentary: Sense: Vidydmayi (learning incarnate), Sahasrdkfi (having a thousand eyes), Sahasravadandtmajd (daughter of the thousand¬ faced), SahasraraSmi (having a thousand rays), Sattvasthd (stationed in the Sattva-guna ), Maheivarapaddhayd (resorted to or supported by the feet of Mahesvara).

verses.sanskrit: ध्रुवात् श्लिष्टिञ्च भव्यं च भार्या शम्भुर्व्यजायत । श्लिष्टेराधत्त सुच्छाया पञ्च पुत्रानकल्पषान्
verses.transliteration: dhruvāt śliṣṭiñca bhavyaṃ ca bhāryā śambhurvyajāyata / śliṣṭerādhatta succhāyā pañca putrānakalpaṣān
verses.translation: KsalinI (one who washes), Mrnmayi (of the nature of earth), Vydptd (pervaded), Taz/ojt (lustrous), Padmabodhikd (opener of the lotus), Mahdmdydsrayd (having the support of the great Maya), Mdnyd (worthy of honour), Mahddevamanoramd (pleasing to the mind of Mahadeva).
verses.hindi: भयानक एवं हाथमें शंख, चक्र, गदा धारण करनेवाले उस पुरुषसे गरुडध्वज (विष्णु)-ने कहा तुम (अपने) पराक्रमसे उस हैत्यराज हिरण्यकशिपुको मारकर पुनः इस स्थानपर शीघ्र ही वापस लौट आओ। विष्णुका वचन सुनकर शंख, चक्र, गदाधारी वह दूसरे महामेरुके समान देव गरुडपर आरूढ़ होकर भीषण नाद
verses.wordMeaning: KsalinI (one who washes), Mrnmayi (of the nature of earth), Vydptd (pervaded), Taz/ojt (lustrous), Padmabodhikd (opener of the lotus), Mahdmdydsrayd (having the support of the great Maya), Mdnyd (worthy of honour), Mahddevamanoramd (pleasing to the mind of Mahadeva).
verses.commentary: Sense: KsalinI (one who washes), Mrnmayi (of the nature of earth), Vydptd (pervaded), Taz/ojt (lustrous), Padmabodhikd (opener of the lotus), Mahdmdydsrayd (having the support of the great Maya), Mdnyd (worthy of honour), Mahddevamanoramd (pleasing to the mind of Mahadeva).

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठवचनाद् देवी तपस्तप्त्वा सुदुश्चरम् । आराध्य पुरुषं विष्णुं शालग्रामे जनार्दनम्
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭhavacanād devī tapastaptvā suduścaram / ārādhya puruṣaṃ viṣṇuṃ śālagrāme janārdanam
verses.translation: Vyomalakfmi (splendour of the firmament),
verses.hindi: करते हुए अव्यक्त, महापुरुष पुरुषोत्तमको प्रणामकर (हिरण्यकशिपु) हैत्यके महानगरकी ओर गया। महामेधकी गर्जनाके समान नादको सुनकर बड़े-बड़े हैत्योंने हैत्यराजसे (हिरण्यकशिपुसे) भयपूर्वक कहा- ॥ ३४--३७॥ हैत्योंने कहा--देवताओंका विनाश करनेवाले हैत्यराज! देवताओंकी प्रेरणा प्राप्त कर कोई महान् पुरुष भीषण नाद करता हुआ आ रहा है, हमें उसे जानना चाहिए। तदनन्तर मुख्य-मुख्य असुरों तथा आयुधोंसे
verses.wordMeaning: Vyomalakfmi (splendour of the firmament),
verses.commentary: Sense: Vyomalakfmi (splendour of the firmament),

verses.sanskrit: रिपुं रिपुञ्जयं विप्रं वृकलं वृषतेजसम् । नारायणपरान् शुद्धान् स्वधर्मपरिपालकान्
verses.transliteration: ripuṃ ripuñjayaṃ vipraṃ vṛkalaṃ vṛṣatejasam / nārāyaṇaparān śuddhān svadharmaparipālakān
verses.translation: Andhatd (non-struck spiritual sound), Kundalini (deco¬ rated with ear-rings or having spiral coils of the Yogic from), JValini, Padmabhdsini (shining through the lotus) Padma-vdsini (dweller in a lotus), Saddnandd(having perpetual bliss), Saddkirti (of perpetual fame), Sarvabhutdhayasthitd (stationed in support of all living beings).
verses.hindi: सुसज्जित प्रहाद आदि पुत्रोंके साथ हिरण्यकशिपु स्वयं वहाँ गया। करोड़ों सूर्यके समान प्रभावाले तथा दूसरे नारायणके समान पर्वताकार गरुडपर बैठे हुए उस दुद्रुवुः केचिदन्योन्यमूचुः सम्भ्वान्तलोचनाः । अयं स देवो देवानां गोप्ता नारायणो रिपुः
verses.wordMeaning: Andhatd (non-struck spiritual sound), Kundalini (deco¬ rated with ear-rings or having spiral coils of the Yogic from), JValini, Padmabhdsini (shining through the lotus) Padma-vdsini (dweller in a lotus), Saddnandd(having perpetual bliss), Saddkirti (of perpetual fame),…
verses.commentary: Sense: Andhatd (non-struck spiritual sound), Kundalini (deco¬ rated with ear-rings or having spiral coils of the Yogic from), JValini, Padmabhdsini (shining through the lotus) Padma-vdsini (dweller in a lotus), Saddnandd(having perpetual bliss), Saddkirti (of perpetual fame),…

verses.sanskrit: रिपोराधत्त बृहती चक्षुषं सर्वतेजसम् । सो ऽजीजनत् पुष्करिण्यां वैरण्यां चाक्षुषं मनुम् । प्रजापतेरात्मजायां वीरणस्य महात्मनः
verses.transliteration: riporādhatta bṛhatī cakṣuṣaṃ sarvatejasam / so 'jījanat puṣkariṇyāṃ vairaṇyāṃ cākṣuṣaṃ manum / prajāpaterātmajāyāṃ vīraṇasya mahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: Vdgdevatd (the deity of speech), Brahmakald (the digit oi Brahman), Kaldtltd (going beyond the digit), Kaldrani (the Arani oi Kala), BrahmaSri (the splendour of Brahman), Brahmahrdayd (the heart of Brahman), Bramha-Viriu-Sivapriyd (beloved of Brahma, Visnu and Siva).
verses.hindi: तानि चाशेषतो देवो नाशयामास लीलया पुत्रा नारायणोदभूतं युयुधुर्मघनिःस्वनाः । प्रहादश्वाप्यनुह्वादः संहादो हाद एव च
verses.wordMeaning: Vdgdevatd (the deity of speech), Brahmakald (the digit oi Brahman), Kaldtltd (going beyond the digit), Kaldrani (the Arani oi Kala), BrahmaSri (the splendour of Brahman), Brahmahrdayd (the heart of Brahman), Bramha-Viriu-Sivapriyd (beloved of Brahma, Visnu and Siva).
verses.commentary: Sense: Vdgdevatd (the deity of speech), Brahmakald (the digit oi Brahman), Kaldtltd (going beyond the digit), Kaldrani (the Arani oi Kala), BrahmaSri (the splendour of Brahman), Brahmahrdayd (the heart of Brahman), Bramha-Viriu-Sivapriyd (beloved of Brahma, Visnu and Siva).

verses.sanskrit: मनोरजायन्त दश नड्वलायां महौजसः । कन्यायां सुमहावीर्या वैराजस्य प्रजापतेः
verses.transliteration: manorajāyanta daśa naḍvalāyāṃ mahaujasaḥ / kanyāyāṃ sumahāvīryā vairājasya prajāpateḥ
verses.translation: Vyomaiakti {the. Sakti of the firmament), Kriyaiakti (the motive force of activity), JnanaJakti (the power of knowl¬ edge), Pardgati (the greatest goal), Kfobhikd (agitator), BandhikS (she who binds), Bhedyd (she who can be differentiated), Bkedd- bhedavivarjitd (devoid of difference and non-difference).
verses.hindi: संहादश्चापि कोौमारमाग्नेयं हाद एव च न शेकुर्बाधितुं विष्णुं वासुदेवं यथा तथा
verses.wordMeaning: Vyomaiakti {the. Sakti of the firmament), Kriyaiakti (the motive force of activity), JnanaJakti (the power of knowl¬ edge), Pardgati (the greatest goal), Kfobhikd (agitator), BandhikS (she who binds), Bhedyd (she who can be differentiated),…
verses.commentary: Sense: Vyomaiakti {the. Sakti of the firmament), Kriyaiakti (the motive force of activity), JnanaJakti (the power of knowl¬ edge), Pardgati (the greatest goal), Kfobhikd (agitator), BandhikS (she who binds), Bhedyd (she who can be differentiated),…

verses.sanskrit: ऊरुः पूरुः शतद्युम्नस्तपस्वी सत्यवाक् शुचिः । अग्निष्टुदतिरात्रश्च सुद्युम्नश्चाभिमन्युकः
verses.transliteration: ūruḥ pūruḥ śatadyumnastapasvī satyavāk śuciḥ / agniṣṭudatirātraśca sudyumnaścābhimanyukaḥ
verses.translation: Abhinnd (non-different), Bhinnasarnsthdnd (having different resting places), VaSini (submissive), VathSahdrini (captivater of the race), Guhyaiakti (having concealed power), Gundtitd (transcender oiGunas), Sarvadd (bestower of everything), Sarvatomukhi (having faces all round).
verses.hindi: प्रगृह्य पादेषु करैः संचिक्षेप ननाद च अदृश्य: प्रययौ तूर्णं यत्र नारायणाः प्रभुः । गत्वा विज्ञापयामास प्रवृत्तमखिलं तथा
verses.wordMeaning: Abhinnd (non-different), Bhinnasarnsthdnd (having different resting places), VaSini (submissive), VathSahdrini (captivater of the race), Guhyaiakti (having concealed power), Gundtitd (transcender oiGunas), Sarvadd (bestower of everything), Sarvatomukhi (having faces all round).
verses.commentary: Sense: Abhinnd (non-different), Bhinnasarnsthdnd (having different resting places), VaSini (submissive), VathSahdrini (captivater of the race), Guhyaiakti (having concealed power), Gundtitd (transcender oiGunas), Sarvadd (bestower of everything), Sarvatomukhi (having faces all round).

verses.sanskrit: ऊरोरजनयत् पुत्रान् षडाग्नेयी महाबलान् । अङ्गं सुमनसं स्वातिं क्रतुमङ्गिरसं शिवम्
verses.transliteration: ūrorajanayat putrān ṣaḍāgneyī mahābalān / aṅgaṃ sumanasaṃ svātiṃ kratumaṅgirasaṃ śivam
verses.translation: Bhagini (fortunate woman), Bhagavatpatni (consort of the lord), Sakald (entire, perfect), Kdlahdrini (remover of Kdla), Sarvavit (knower of all), Sarvatobhadrd (having welfare all round), Guhydtitd (going beyond the hidden), Guhdvali (having groups of caves).
verses.hindi: संचिन्त्य मनसा देवः सर्वज्ञानमयोऽमलः। नरस्यार्धतनुं कृत्वा सिंहस्यार्धतनुं तथा आविर्बभूव सहसा मोहयन् हैत्यपुङ्गवान्
verses.wordMeaning: Bhagini (fortunate woman), Bhagavatpatni (consort of the lord), Sakald (entire, perfect), Kdlahdrini (remover of Kdla), Sarvavit (knower of all), Sarvatobhadrd (having welfare all round), Guhydtitd (going beyond the hidden), Guhdvali (having groups of caves).
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhagini (fortunate woman), Bhagavatpatni (consort of the lord), Sakald (entire, perfect), Kdlahdrini (remover of Kdla), Sarvavit (knower of all), Sarvatobhadrd (having welfare all round), Guhydtitd (going beyond the hidden), Guhdvali (having groups of caves).

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गाद् वेनो ऽभवत् पश्चाद् बैन्यो वेनादजायत । यो ऽसौ पृथुरिति ख्यातः प्रजापालो महाबलः
verses.transliteration: aṅgād veno 'bhavat paścād bainyo venādajāyata / yo 'sau pṛthuriti khyātaḥ prajāpālo mahābalaḥ
verses.translation: Prakriyd (procedure of a rite), Yogamdtd (mother of Yoga), Gangd, Viheivarehari, Kalild (impervious), Kapild (tawny coloured), Kdntd (shining), Kamaldbhd (shining like lotus), Kaldntard (the heart of fine arts).
verses.hindi: दंष्टाकरालो योगात्मा युगान्तदहनोपमः। समारुह्यात्मनः शकितं सर्वसंहारकारिकाम्। भाति नारायणोऽनन्तो यथा मध्यंदिने रवि: सहैव त्वनुजैः सर्वैर्नाशयाशु मयेरितः
verses.wordMeaning: Prakriyd (procedure of a rite), Yogamdtd (mother of Yoga), Gangd, Viheivarehari, Kalild (impervious), Kapild (tawny coloured), Kdntd (shining), Kamaldbhd (shining like lotus), Kaldntard (the heart of fine arts).
verses.commentary: Sense: Prakriyd (procedure of a rite), Yogamdtd (mother of Yoga), Gangd, Viheivarehari, Kalild (impervious), Kapild (tawny coloured), Kdntd (shining), Kamaldbhd (shining like lotus), Kaldntard (the heart of fine arts).

verses.sanskrit: येन दुग्धा मही पूर्वं प्राजानां हितकारणात् । नियोगाद् ब्रह्मणः सार्धं देवेन्द्रेण महौजसा
verses.transliteration: yena dugdhā mahī pūrvaṃ prājānāṃ hitakāraṇāt / niyogād brahmaṇaḥ sārdhaṃ devendreṇa mahaujasā
verses.translation: Punyd (meritorious), Pukarini (having the sacred
verses.hindi: पुरुषको देखकर कोई तो भाग गये और कोई भ्रान्त- दृष्टि होकर आपसमें कहने लगे--“ यह निश्चित ही हमारा शत्रु और देवताओंका रक्षक वही अव्यय नारायण देव है अथवा उसका पुत्र ही यह आया है।' ऐसा कहकर वे उस पुरुषपर शस्त्रोंकी वर्षा करने लगे, किंतु उस देवने लीलासे ही उन सभी शस्त्रोंको नष्ट कर डाला॥ ३८--४२॥
verses.wordMeaning: Punyd (meritorious), Pukarini (having the sacred
verses.commentary: Sense: Punyd (meritorious), Pukarini (having the sacred

verses.sanskrit: वेनपुत्रस्य वितते पुरा पैतामहे मखे । सूतः पौराणिको जज्ञे मायारूपः स्वयं हरिः
verses.transliteration: venaputrasya vitate purā paitāmahe makhe / sūtaḥ paurāṇiko jajñe māyārūpaḥ svayaṃ hariḥ
verses.translation: Pancabrahmasamutpatti (born of five Brahmans viz. Ganesa, Surya, Siva, Visnu and Sakti), Paramdrthdrthavigrahd (embodiment of reality), Dharmodayd (rise of piety), Bhdnumati (possessing rays), Yogijneyd (knowable by Yogins), Manojavd (having the speed of the mind).
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर अतितेजस्वी तथा मेघके समान गर्जना करनेवाले प्रहाद, अनुहाद, संहाद तथा हाद नामक हिरण्यकशिपुके चार पुत्र नारायणसे उत्पन्न उस पुरुषसे युद्ध करने लगे। प्रहादने ब्रह्मास्त्र, अनुहादने वैष्णवास्त्र, संहादने कोमारास्त्र तथा हादने आग्नेयास्त्रका प्रयोग किया
verses.wordMeaning: Pancabrahmasamutpatti (born of five Brahmans viz. Ganesa, Surya, Siva, Visnu and Sakti), Paramdrthdrthavigrahd (embodiment of reality), Dharmodayd (rise of piety), Bhdnumati (possessing rays), Yogijneyd (knowable by Yogins), Manojavd (having the speed of the mind).
verses.commentary: Sense: Pancabrahmasamutpatti (born of five Brahmans viz. Ganesa, Surya, Siva, Visnu and Sakti), Paramdrthdrthavigrahd (embodiment of reality), Dharmodayd (rise of piety), Bhdnumati (possessing rays), Yogijneyd (knowable by Yogins), Manojavd (having the speed of the mind).

verses.sanskrit: प्रवक्ता सर्वशास्त्राणां धर्मज्ञो गुणवत्सलः । तं मां नित्त मुनिश्रेष्ठाः पूर्वोद्भूतं सनातनम्
verses.transliteration: pravaktā sarvaśāstrāṇāṃ dharmajño guṇavatsalaḥ / taṃ māṃ nitta muniśreṣṭhāḥ pūrvodbhūtaṃ sanātanam
verses.translation: Manoramd (delightful to the mind), Manoraskd (having mind in the chest), Tdpasi (an ascetic woman), Vedaru- pini (having the form of Veda), Vedaiakti (having the power of Vedas), Veda-mdtd (mother of the Vedas), Vedavidydprakdiini (revealer of the Vedic Lore).
verses.hindi: वे चारों अस्त्र उस वैष्णव पुरुषके पास पहुँचकर उन वासुदेव विष्णुको किसी भी प्रकार बाँधनेमें समर्थ न हो सके। तदनन्तर महाबाहु महाबलशाली उस पुरुषने उन चारों पुत्रोंके पैरोंको अपने हाथसे पकड़कर उन्हें फेंक दिया और गर्जना की। इस प्रकार पुत्रोंके फेंक
verses.wordMeaning: Manoramd (delightful to the mind), Manoraskd (having mind in the chest), Tdpasi (an ascetic woman), Vedaru- pini (having the form of Veda), Vedaiakti (having the power of Vedas), Veda-mdtd (mother of the Vedas), Vedavidydprakdiini (revealer of the Vedic Lore).
verses.commentary: Sense: Manoramd (delightful to the mind), Manoraskd (having mind in the chest), Tdpasi (an ascetic woman), Vedaru- pini (having the form of Veda), Vedaiakti (having the power of Vedas), Veda-mdtd (mother of the Vedas), Vedavidydprakdiini (revealer of the Vedic Lore).

verses.sanskrit: अस्मिन् मन्वन्तरे व्यासः कृष्णद्वैपायनः स्वयम् । श्रावयामास मां प्रीत्या पुराणं पुरुषो हरिः
verses.transliteration: asmin manvantare vyāsaḥ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaḥ svayam / śrāvayāmāsa māṃ prītyā purāṇaṃ puruṣo hariḥ
verses.translation: Goddess of the lords of Yoga, Mdtd (mother), Mahdiakti, Manomayi (of the nature of the mind), Viivdvasthd (stationed in the universe), Viyanmurti (having the form of the firmament), Vidyunmdld (with lightning as garland), Vihdyasi (of the nature of the sky).
verses.hindi: ही वेगसे उस (पुरुष)-की छातीपर प्रहार किया। उस प्रहारसे पीड़ित होकर वह पुरुष गरुडपर चढ़कर अदृश्य हो गया तथा शीघ्र ही वहाँ गया जहाँ प्रभु नारायण स्थित थे। वहाँ जाकर उसने सम्पूर्ण घटित तब सर्वज्ञामय विमल देवने मनमें विचारकर आधा शरीर मनुष्यका एवं आधा शरीर सिंहका बनाया। नरसिंह-शरीर धारण करनेवाले अव्यक्त देव हैत्य- समूहोंको मोहित करते हुए अकस्मात् हिरण्यकशिपुके
verses.wordMeaning: Goddess of the lords of Yoga, Mdtd (mother), Mahdiakti, Manomayi (of the nature of the mind), Viivdvasthd (stationed in the universe), Viyanmurti (having the form of the firmament), Vidyunmdld (with lightning as garland), Vihdyasi (of the nature of the sky).
verses.commentary: Sense: Goddess of the lords of Yoga, Mdtd (mother), Mahdiakti, Manomayi (of the nature of the mind), Viivdvasthd (stationed in the universe), Viyanmurti (having the form of the firmament), Vidyunmdld (with lightning as garland), Vihdyasi (of the nature of the sky).

verses.sanskrit: मदन्वये तु ये सूताः संभूता वेदवर्जिताः । तेषां पुराणवक्तृत्वं वृत्तिरासीदजाज्ञया
verses.transliteration: madanvaye tu ye sūtāḥ saṃbhūtā vedavarjitāḥ / teṣāṃ purāṇavaktṛtvaṃ vṛttirāsīdajājñayā
verses.translation: Kinnari, Surabhi, Vidya, Nandini, (delighter), Mandi- vallabhd (beloved of Nandin), Bhdrati, (goddess of speech), Paramdnandd (of great bliss), Pardparavibhedikd (distinguisher between the greater and the smaller).
verses.hindi: नगरमें प्रकट हो गये। भयंकर दाढ़ोंवाले योगात्मा तथा प्रलयाग्निके समान अनन्त नारायण अपनी सर्वसंहारकारिणी शक्तिपर आरूढ़ होकर उसी प्रकार प्रकाशित हो रहे थे जैसे मध्याहकालीन सूर्य प्रकाशमान होता है। नरसिंहका शरीर धारण किये उन्हें देखकर उस असुरने अपने बड़े लड़के प्रहादको नरसिंहके वधके लिये प्रेरित किया और कहा-
verses.wordMeaning: Kinnari, Surabhi, Vidya, Nandini, (delighter), Mandi- vallabhd (beloved of Nandin), Bhdrati, (goddess of speech), Paramdnandd (of great bliss), Pardparavibhedikd (distinguisher between the greater and the smaller).
verses.commentary: Sense: Kinnari, Surabhi, Vidya, Nandini, (delighter), Mandi- vallabhd (beloved of Nandin), Bhdrati, (goddess of speech), Paramdnandd (of great bliss), Pardparavibhedikd (distinguisher between the greater and the smaller).

verses.sanskrit: स तु वैन्यः पृथुर्धोमान् सत्यसंधो जितेन्द्रियः । सार्वभौमो महातेजाः स्वधर्मपरिपालकः
verses.transliteration: sa tu vainyaḥ pṛthurdhomān satyasaṃdho jitendriyaḥ / sārvabhaumo mahātejāḥ svadharmaparipālakaḥ
verses.translation: Sarvapraharanopetd (equipped with all weapons), Kdmyd (desirable), Kdmeivaresvari (goddess of Kamesvara), Acintyd (inconceivable), Anantavibhavd (having infinite riches), Bhulekhd (line on the ground), Kanakaprabhd (having golden lustre).
verses.hindi: अपने सभी छोटे भाइयोंके साथ तुम पहलेसे अधिक शक्तिवाले इस नरसिंह-शरीरधारी पुरुषको मेरी प्रेरणासे शीघ्र ही मार डालो तत्संनियोगादसुर: प्रह्मदो विष्णुमव्ययम्। युयुधे सर्वयत्नेन नरसिंहेन निर्जित:
verses.wordMeaning: Sarvapraharanopetd (equipped with all weapons), Kdmyd (desirable), Kdmeivaresvari (goddess of Kamesvara), Acintyd (inconceivable), Anantavibhavd (having infinite riches), Bhulekhd (line on the ground), Kanakaprabhd (having golden lustre).
verses.commentary: Sense: Sarvapraharanopetd (equipped with all weapons), Kdmyd (desirable), Kdmeivaresvari (goddess of Kamesvara), Acintyd (inconceivable), Anantavibhavd (having infinite riches), Bhulekhd (line on the ground), Kanakaprabhd (having golden lustre).

verses.sanskrit: तस्य बाल्यात् प्रभृत्येव भक्तिर्नारायणे ऽभवत् । गोवर्धनगिरिं प्राप्य तपस्तेपे जितेन्द्रियः
verses.transliteration: tasya bālyāt prabhṛtyeva bhaktirnārāyaṇe 'bhavat / govardhanagiriṃ prāpya tapastepe jitendriyaḥ
verses.translation: Kusmdndi, Dhanaratndhyd (endowed with riches and jewels), Sugandhd (sweet smelling), Gandhaddyini (bestower of scents), Trivikramapadodbhutd (born of the feet of Trivikrama {Wisnu), Dhanuspdni (having the bow in the hand), Sivodayd (of auspicious rise).
verses.hindi: ततः संचोदितो हैत्यो हिरण्याक्षस्तदानुज: । ध्यात्वा पशुपतेरस्त्रं ससर्ज च ननाद च तस्य देवादिदेवस्य विष्णोरमिततेजसः । न हानिमकरोदस्त्रं यथा देवस्य शूलिनः
verses.wordMeaning: Kusmdndi, Dhanaratndhyd (endowed with riches and jewels), Sugandhd (sweet smelling), Gandhaddyini (bestower of scents), Trivikramapadodbhutd (born of the feet of Trivikrama {Wisnu), Dhanuspdni (having the bow in the hand), Sivodayd (of auspicious rise).
verses.commentary: Sense: Kusmdndi, Dhanaratndhyd (endowed with riches and jewels), Sugandhd (sweet smelling), Gandhaddyini (bestower of scents), Trivikramapadodbhutd (born of the feet of Trivikrama {Wisnu), Dhanuspdni (having the bow in the hand), Sivodayd (of auspicious rise).

verses.sanskrit: तपसा भगवान् प्रीतः शङ्खचक्रगदाधरः । आगत्य देवो राजानं प्राह दामोदरः स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: tapasā bhagavān prītaḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ / āgatya devo rājānaṃ prāha dāmodaraḥ svayam
verses.translation: Sudurlabhd (very rare), Dhanddhyakfd (presiding deity over riches), Z)A<j7y>a (blessed), Pingalalocand (of reddish brown eyes), Sdnti (peace), Prabhdvati (possessing lustre), Dipti {i\[\immaX.ion), Pankajdyatalocand (having eyes as wide as the lotus).
verses.hindi: मेने सर्वात्मकं देवं वासुदेवं सनातनम् ननाम शिरसा देवं योगिनां हृदयेशयम्
verses.wordMeaning: Sudurlabhd (very rare), Dhanddhyakfd (presiding deity over riches), Z)A<j7y>a (blessed), Pingalalocand (of reddish brown eyes), Sdnti (peace), Prabhdvati (possessing lustre), Dipti {i\[\immaX.ion), Pankajdyatalocand (having eyes as wide as the lotus).
verses.commentary: Sense: Sudurlabhd (very rare), Dhanddhyakfd (presiding deity over riches), Z)A<j7y>a (blessed), Pingalalocand (of reddish brown eyes), Sdnti (peace), Prabhdvati (possessing lustre), Dipti {i\[\immaX.ion), Pankajdyatalocand (having eyes as wide as the lotus).

verses.sanskrit: ध्रमिकौ रूपसंपन्नौ सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरौ । मत्प्रसादादसंदिग्धं पुत्रौ तव भविष्यतः । एकमुक्त्वा हृषीकेशः स्वकीयां प्रकृतिं गतः
verses.transliteration: dhramikau rūpasaṃpannau sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ varau / matprasādādasaṃdigdhaṃ putrau tava bhaviṣyataḥ / ekamuktvā hṛṣīkeśaḥ svakīyāṃ prakṛtiṃ gataḥ
verses.translation: Adyd (the first), Bhuh (the earth), Kamalodbhutd (born of the lotus), Gavdm mdlini (mother of cows), Ranapriyd (fond of battle), Satkriyd (good ritual), GirUd (consort of Girisa), Suddhi (purity), Nityapustd (perpetually nourished), Nirantard (having no weak points).
verses.hindi: स्तुत्वा नारायणे: स्तोत्रैः ऋग्यजुःसामसम्भवैः । निवार्य पितरं भ्रातृन् हिरण्याक्षं तदाब्रवीत् अयं नारायणोऽनन्तः शाश्वतो भगवानजः। पुराणपुरुषो देवो महायोगी जगन्मयः
verses.wordMeaning: Adyd (the first), Bhuh (the earth), Kamalodbhutd (born of the lotus), Gavdm mdlini (mother of cows), Ranapriyd (fond of battle), Satkriyd (good ritual), GirUd (consort of Girisa), Suddhi (purity), Nityapustd (perpetually nourished), Nirantard (having no weak points).
verses.commentary: Sense: Adyd (the first), Bhuh (the earth), Kamalodbhutd (born of the lotus), Gavdm mdlini (mother of cows), Ranapriyd (fond of battle), Satkriyd (good ritual), GirUd (consort of Girisa), Suddhi (purity), Nityapustd (perpetually nourished), Nirantard (having no weak points).

verses.sanskrit: वैन्यो ऽपि वेदविधिना निश्चलां भक्तिमुद्वहन् । अपालयत् स्वकं राज्यं न्यायेन मधुसूदने
verses.transliteration: vainyo 'pi vedavidhinā niścalāṃ bhaktimudvahan / apālayat svakaṃ rājyaṃ nyāyena madhusūdane
verses.translation: Durgd, Kdtydyani, Candi, Carcitdngd (having the limbs besmeared), Suvigrakd (having good body), Hiranya-varnd (of golden colour), Jagati (the 'E.a.rth), Jagad-yantra-pravarttikd (Maker of the machine of this universe function).
verses.hindi: गच्छध्वमेनं शरणं विष्णुमव्यक्तमव्ययम् प्रोवाच पुत्रमत्यर्थं मोहितो विष्णुमायया
verses.wordMeaning: Durgd, Kdtydyani, Candi, Carcitdngd (having the limbs besmeared), Suvigrakd (having good body), Hiranya-varnd (of golden colour), Jagati (the 'E.a.rth), Jagad-yantra-pravarttikd (Maker of the machine of this universe function).
verses.commentary: Sense: Durgd, Kdtydyani, Candi, Carcitdngd (having the limbs besmeared), Suvigrakd (having good body), Hiranya-varnd (of golden colour), Jagati (the 'E.a.rth), Jagad-yantra-pravarttikd (Maker of the machine of this universe function).

verses.sanskrit: अचिरादेव तन्वङ्गो भार्या तस्य सुचिस्मिता । खिखण्डनं हविर्धानमन्तर्धाना व्यजायत
verses.transliteration: acirādeva tanvaṅgo bhāryā tasya sucismitā / khikhaṇḍanaṃ havirdhānamantardhānā vyajāyata
verses.translation: Padmanabhd (having a lotus in the navel), Padmard-- bhd (resembling a lotus), Nityarutd (perpetually angry), Amrtodbhavd (born of the nectar), Dhunvati (shaking), Duspra-
verses.hindi: समागतोऽस्मद्धवनमिदानी कालचोदितः कथं देवो महादेवः शाश्वतः कालवर्जितः। कालेन हन्यते विष्णुः कालात्मा कालरूपधृक्
verses.wordMeaning: Padmanabhd (having a lotus in the navel), Padmard-- bhd (resembling a lotus), Nityarutd (perpetually angry), Amrtodbhavd (born of the nectar), Dhunvati (shaking), Duspra-
verses.commentary: Sense: Padmanabhd (having a lotus in the navel), Padmard-- bhd (resembling a lotus), Nityarutd (perpetually angry), Amrtodbhavd (born of the nectar), Dhunvati (shaking), Duspra-

verses.sanskrit: शिखण्डनो ऽभवत् पुत्रः सुशील इति विश्रुतः । धार्मिको रूपसंपन्नो वेदवेदाङ्गपारगः
verses.transliteration: śikhaṇḍano 'bhavat putraḥ suśīla iti viśrutaḥ / dhārmiko rūpasaṃpanno vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ
verses.translation: Mahendrabhagini (sister of Indra), (gentle),
verses.hindi: उसकी आज्ञा पाकर असुर प्रह्मदने सभी प्रकारके प्रयत्रोंके द्वारा अव्यय विष्णुके साथ युद्ध किया, किंतु वह नरसिंहद्वारा पराजित हो गया। तदनन्तर उस (हिरण्य- कशिपु)-की आज्ञा प्रासकर उसके छोटे भाई हिरण्याक्षने पाशुपतास्त्रका ध्यान करके उसे चलाया और गर्जना की। वह अस्त्र देवाधिदेव अमित तेजस्वी उन विष्णुको, कोई हानि न कर सका जैसे कोई अस्त्र त्रिशूलधारी देव (शंकर)-को हानि नहीं करता
verses.wordMeaning: Mahendrabhagini (sister of Indra), (gentle),
verses.commentary: Sense: Mahendrabhagini (sister of Indra), (gentle),

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽधीत्य विधिवद् वेदान् धर्मेण तपसि स्थितः । मतिं चक्रे भाग्ययोगात् संन्यां प्रति धर्मवित्
verses.transliteration: so 'dhītya vidhivad vedān dharmeṇa tapasi sthitaḥ / matiṃ cakre bhāgyayogāt saṃnyāṃ prati dharmavit
verses.translation: Vacya (expressible), Armreivari (goddess of Devas), Vidya (learning), Durjayd (invincible), Duratikrama (one who cannot be transgressed), Kdlaralri (night of the destruction of the world: identified with Durga), Mahdvegd (of great velocity), Virabhadra-priyd (beloved of Virabhadra), Hitd (benefactress)
verses.hindi: अस्त्रको विफल होते देखकर भाग्यशाली होनेके कारण प्रह्वादने उन देवको सर्वात्मक सनातन वासुदेव ही समझा। उसने सभी शस्त्रोंका परित्याग कर दिया और सत्त्वगुणसम्पन्न चित्तसे योगियोंके हृदयमें निवास करनेवाले देवको सिरसे प्रणाम किया तथा ऋकू, यजुष् तथा सामवेदमें प्राप्त वैष्णव स्तुतियोंके द्वारा स्तुतिकर अपने पिता (हिरण्यकशिपु), भाइयों एवं हिरण्याक्षको युद्ध करनेसे रोकते हुए इस प्रकार कहा- ॥ ५७--५९॥
verses.wordMeaning: Vacya (expressible), Armreivari (goddess of Devas), Vidya (learning), Durjayd (invincible), Duratikrama (one who cannot be transgressed), Kdlaralri (night of the destruction of the world: identified with Durga), Mahdvegd (of great velocity),…
verses.commentary: Sense: Vacya (expressible), Armreivari (goddess of Devas), Vidya (learning), Durjayd (invincible), Duratikrama (one who cannot be transgressed), Kdlaralri (night of the destruction of the world: identified with Durga), Mahdvegd (of great velocity),…

verses.sanskrit: स कृत्वा तीर्थसंसेवां स्वाध्याये तपसि स्थितः । जगाम हिमवत्पृष्ठं कदाचित् सिद्धसेवितम्
verses.transliteration: sa kṛtvā tīrthasaṃsevāṃ svādhyāye tapasi sthitaḥ / jagāma himavatpṛṣṭhaṃ kadācit siddhasevitam
verses.translation: Bhadrakdli, Jaganmdtd, Bhaktdndrfi bhadra-dayini (bes¬ tower of welfare on devotees), Kardld (terrible), Pingaldkdrd (of tawny features), Kamabheda (prob. a misprint for JVdmabliedd — 'having different names, as in the Crt. Ed.), Mahdsvand (of loud voice).
verses.hindi: पुराणपुरुष भगवान् नारायण देव हें । ये धाता, विधाता, अव्यय, ईश्वर, सभी प्राणियोंके अन्तर्यामी तथा गुणातीत हैं। इन अव्यक्त, अव्यय विष्णुकी आप लोग शरण ग्रहण करें
verses.wordMeaning: Bhadrakdli, Jaganmdtd, Bhaktdndrfi bhadra-dayini (bes¬ tower of welfare on devotees), Kardld (terrible), Pingaldkdrd (of tawny features), Kamabheda (prob. a misprint for JVdmabliedd — 'having different names, as in the Crt. Ed.), Mahdsvand (of loud voice).
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhadrakdli, Jaganmdtd, Bhaktdndrfi bhadra-dayini (bes¬ tower of welfare on devotees), Kardld (terrible), Pingaldkdrd (of tawny features), Kamabheda (prob. a misprint for JVdmabliedd — 'having different names, as in the Crt. Ed.), Mahdsvand (of loud voice).

verses.sanskrit: तत्र धर्मपदं नाम धर्मसिद्धिप्रदं वनम् । अपश्यद् योगिनां गम्यमगम्यं ब्रह्मविद्विषाम्
verses.transliteration: tatra dharmapadaṃ nāma dharmasiddhipradaṃ vanam / apaśyad yogināṃ gamyamagamyaṃ brahmavidviṣām
verses.translation: Taiasvini (famous), Tasodd, Saadhva-parivartika}- (revolving through the six paths), Sankhini (variety of woman of that name), Padmini (a woman type), Sdrhkhyd, Sdthkhyayoga- pravartikd (promulgator of Sarhkhya and Yoga systems).
verses.hindi: (प्रहादके) इस प्रकार कहनेपर विष्णुकी मायासे अत्यन्त मोहित दुर्बुद्धि हिरण्यकशिपुने स्वयं पुत्रसे कहा--यह थोड़े पराक्रमवाला नरसिंह सभी प्रकारसे वध करने योग्य है। कालके द्वारा प्रेरित होकर इस समय यह हमारे घरमें ही आ गया है
verses.wordMeaning: Taiasvini (famous), Tasodd, Saadhva-parivartika}- (revolving through the six paths), Sankhini (variety of woman of that name), Padmini (a woman type), Sdrhkhyd, Sdthkhyayoga- pravartikd (promulgator of Sarhkhya and Yoga systems).
verses.commentary: Sense: Taiasvini (famous), Tasodd, Saadhva-parivartika}- (revolving through the six paths), Sankhini (variety of woman of that name), Padmini (a woman type), Sdrhkhyd, Sdthkhyayoga- pravartikd (promulgator of Sarhkhya and Yoga systems).

verses.sanskrit: तत्र मन्दाकिनी नाम सुपुण्या विमला नदी । पद्मोत्पलवनोपेता सिद्धाश्रमविभूषिता
verses.transliteration: tatra mandākinī nāma supuṇyā vimalā nadī / padmotpalavanopetā siddhāśramavibhūṣitā
verses.translation: Caitrd (of the Caitra month), Sarhvatsardrudhd (rid¬ ing on the year), Jagatsampurani (the filler of universe), Dhvaja (the banner), Sumbhdri (enemy of Sumbha), Khecari (moving in the firmament), Svasthd (stationed in heaven), Kambugrivd (conch-necked), Kalipriyd (fond of quarrel).
verses.hindi: पिताका वचन सुनकर महामति प्रह्ादने हँसकर कहा--प्राणियोंके एकमात्र स्वामी इन अव्ययको निन्दा मत करो। सनातन, कालवर्जित, कालात्मा, कालका रूप धारण करनेवाले, महादेव विष्णु देवको काल कैसे मार सकता है। तदनन्तर भाग्यसे प्रेरित हिरण्यकशिपु पुत्रके द्वारा रोके जानेपर भी अव्यय हरिसे लड्ने लगा। (क्रोधसे) अत्यन्त लाल नेत्रोवाले अनन्त विष्णुने प्रहादके देखते- ही-देखते हिरण्य (स्वर्ण)-के समान नयन हैं जिसके,
verses.wordMeaning: Caitrd (of the Caitra month), Sarhvatsardrudhd (rid¬ ing on the year), Jagatsampurani (the filler of universe), Dhvaja (the banner), Sumbhdri (enemy of Sumbha), Khecari (moving in the firmament), Svasthd (stationed in heaven), Kambugrivd (conch-necked),…
verses.commentary: Sense: Caitrd (of the Caitra month), Sarhvatsardrudhd (rid¬ ing on the year), Jagatsampurani (the filler of universe), Dhvaja (the banner), Sumbhdri (enemy of Sumbha), Khecari (moving in the firmament), Svasthd (stationed in heaven), Kambugrivd (conch-necked),…

verses.sanskrit: स तस्या दक्षिणे तीरे मुनीन्द्रैर्योगिभिर्वृतम् । सुपुण्यमाश्रमं रम्यमपश्यत् प्रीतिसंयुतः
verses.transliteration: sa tasyā dakṣiṇe tīre munīndrairyogibhirvṛtam / supuṇyamāśramaṃ ramyamapaśyat prītisaṃyutaḥ
verses.translation: Khagadhuajd (Bird-bannered), Khagdruihd (riding on a bird), Vdrdhi (of the boar incarnation), Pugamdlini (having
verses.hindi: उस हिरण्यनयन (हिरण्याक्ष)-के बड़े भाई हिरण्य- कशिपुको अपने नखोंद्वार विदीर्ण कर डाला॥ ६५--६८॥ नृसिंहदेहसम्भूतैः सिंहैनीता यमालयम्

verses.sanskrit: मन्दाकिनीजले स्त्रात्वा संतर्प्य पितृदेवताः । अर्चयित्वा महादेवं पुष्पैः पद्मोत्पलादिभिः
verses.transliteration: mandākinījale strātvā saṃtarpya pitṛdevatāḥ / arcayitvā mahādevaṃ puṣpaiḥ padmotpalādibhiḥ
verses.translation: Jayanti (victorious), Hrdguhdgamyd (comprehen¬ sible in the cavity of the heart), Gahvaresthd (stationed in the cavity), Gandgrani (chief of the groups), Sarfikalpasiddhd {possess¬ ing achievements by mere conception), Sdmyasthd (stationed in similarity), Sarvavijndnaddyini (bestowerof all perfect enlighten¬ ment).
verses.hindi: ततः संहत्य तद्रूपं हरिर्नारायणः प्रभु: । स्वमेव परमं रूपं ययौ नारायणाह्वयम् गते नारायणे हैत्यः प्रह्वादोऽसुरसत्तमः। अभिषेकेण युक्तेन हिरण्याक्षमयोजयत्
verses.wordMeaning: Jayanti (victorious), Hrdguhdgamyd (comprehen¬ sible in the cavity of the heart), Gahvaresthd (stationed in the cavity), Gandgrani (chief of the groups), Sarfikalpasiddhd {possess¬ ing achievements by mere conception), Sdmyasthd (stationed in similarity),…
verses.commentary: Sense: Jayanti (victorious), Hrdguhdgamyd (comprehen¬ sible in the cavity of the heart), Gahvaresthd (stationed in the cavity), Gandgrani (chief of the groups), Sarfikalpasiddhd {possess¬ ing achievements by mere conception), Sdmyasthd (stationed in similarity),…

verses.sanskrit: ध्यात्वार्कंसंस्थमीशानं शिरस्याधाय चाञ्जलिम् । संप्रेक्षमाणो भास्वन्तं तुष्टाव परमेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: dhyātvārkaṃsaṃsthamīśānaṃ śirasyādhāya cāñjalim / saṃprekṣamāṇo bhāsvantaṃ tuṣṭāva parameśvaram
verses.translation: Kdli Kalkavihantri (destroyer of dirt and hypocrisy), Guhyopanifadultamd (having the excellent secret well guarded), Nisthd (stability), Drti (vision), Smrti (memory), Vydpti (per¬ vasion), Puti (nourishment), Tuti (contentment), Kriydvati (possessing rites).
verses.hindi: लब्ध्वान्धकं महापुत्र तपसाराध्य शंकरम् देवाञ्जित्वा सदेवेन्द्रान् बध्वा च धरणीमिमाम्। नीत्वा रसातलं चक्रे वन्दीमिन्दीवरप्रभाम्
verses.wordMeaning: Kdli Kalkavihantri (destroyer of dirt and hypocrisy), Guhyopanifadultamd (having the excellent secret well guarded), Nisthd (stability), Drti (vision), Smrti (memory), Vydpti (per¬ vasion), Puti (nourishment), Tuti (contentment), Kriydvati (possessing rites).
verses.commentary: Sense: Kdli Kalkavihantri (destroyer of dirt and hypocrisy), Guhyopanifadultamd (having the excellent secret well guarded), Nisthd (stability), Drti (vision), Smrti (memory), Vydpti (per¬ vasion), Puti (nourishment), Tuti (contentment), Kriydvati (possessing rites).

verses.sanskrit: रुद्राध्यायेन गिरिशं रुद्रस्य चरितेन च । अन्यैश्च विविधैः स्तोत्रैः शांभवैर्वेदसंभवैः
verses.transliteration: rudrādhyāyena giriśaṃ rudrasya caritena ca / anyaiśca vividhaiḥ stotraiḥ śāṃbhavairvedasaṃbhavaiḥ
verses.translation: Viivdmareivaresdnd, (controller of the rulers of God), Bhukti (enjoyment), Mukti (liberation), Sivd (auspiciousness), Amrtd (immortality), ZoAi/a (red), S'flr/'ama/a(serpent garlanded), Bhisani (terrible), Vanamdlini (having garlands of sylvan flowers).
verses.hindi: ततः सब्रह्मका देवाः परिम्लानमुखश्रियः। गत्वा विज्ञापयामासुर्विष्णवे हरिमन्दिरम् सर्वदेवमयं शुभ्रं वाराहं वपुरादधे
verses.wordMeaning: Viivdmareivaresdnd, (controller of the rulers of God), Bhukti (enjoyment), Mukti (liberation), Sivd (auspiciousness), Amrtd (immortality), ZoAi/a (red), S'flr/'ama/a(serpent garlanded), Bhisani (terrible), Vanamdlini (having garlands of sylvan flowers).
verses.commentary: Sense: Viivdmareivaresdnd, (controller of the rulers of God), Bhukti (enjoyment), Mukti (liberation), Sivd (auspiciousness), Amrtd (immortality), ZoAi/a (red), S'flr/'ama/a(serpent garlanded), Bhisani (terrible), Vanamdlini (having garlands of sylvan flowers).

verses.sanskrit: अथास्मिन्नन्तरे ऽपश्यत् तमायान्तं महामुनिम् । श्वेताश्वतरनामानं महापाशुपतोत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: athāsminnantare 'paśyat tamāyāntaṃ mahāmunim / śvetāśvataranāmānaṃ mahāpāśupatottamam
verses.translation: AnantaSayand (lying on the serpent Ananta), Anantd (infinite), Marandrdyanodbhavd (born of Nara and Narayana), Nrsimhi (man-lion-formed), Daityamathani (suppressor of the Daityas), Sankhacakragadddhard (wielder of conch, discus and the iron-club).
verses.hindi: स्वामेव प्रकृतिं दिव्यां ययौ विष्णुः परं पदम् तस्मिन् हतेऽमररिपौ प्रह्लादो विष्णुतत्परः । अपालयत् स्वकं राज्यं भावं त्यक्त्वा तदासुरम्
verses.wordMeaning: AnantaSayand (lying on the serpent Ananta), Anantd (infinite), Marandrdyanodbhavd (born of Nara and Narayana), Nrsimhi (man-lion-formed), Daityamathani (suppressor of the Daityas), Sankhacakragadddhard (wielder of conch, discus and the iron-club).
verses.commentary: Sense: AnantaSayand (lying on the serpent Ananta), Anantd (infinite), Marandrdyanodbhavd (born of Nara and Narayana), Nrsimhi (man-lion-formed), Daityamathani (suppressor of the Daityas), Sankhacakragadddhard (wielder of conch, discus and the iron-club).

verses.sanskrit: भस्मसंदिग्धसवाङ्गं कौपीनाच्छादनान्वितम् । तपसा कर्षितात्मानं शुक्लयज्ञोपवीतिनम्
verses.transliteration: bhasmasaṃdigdhasavāṅgaṃ kaupīnācchādanānvitam / tapasā karṣitātmānaṃ śuklayajñopavītinam
verses.translation: Samkar$ani (of the form of Sahkarsana or squeezing and dragging), Samutpatti (origin), Ambikdpddasarhsrayd* (having the feet of Ambika for support), Mahdjvdld (of great flames), Mahdbhuti (of great prosperity), Sumurti (of excellent form), Sarvakdmadhuk (yielding all desires).
verses.hindi: इयाज विधिवद् देवान् विष्णोराराधने रत: । निःसपत्नं तदा राज्यं तस्यासीद् विष्णुवैभवात् तापसं नार्चयामास देवानां चैव मायया
verses.wordMeaning: Samkar$ani (of the form of Sahkarsana or squeezing and dragging), Samutpatti (origin), Ambikdpddasarhsrayd* (having the feet of Ambika for support), Mahdjvdld (of great flames), Mahdbhuti (of great prosperity), Sumurti (of excellent form), Sarvakdmadhuk (yielding all desires).
verses.commentary: Sense: Samkar$ani (of the form of Sahkarsana or squeezing and dragging), Samutpatti (origin), Ambikdpddasarhsrayd* (having the feet of Ambika for support), Mahdjvdld (of great flames), Mahdbhuti (of great prosperity), Sumurti (of excellent form), Sarvakdmadhuk (yielding all desires).

verses.sanskrit: समाप्य संस्तवं शंभोरानन्दास्त्राविलेक्षणः । ववन्दे शिरसा पादौ प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: samāpya saṃstavaṃ śaṃbhorānandāstrāvilekṣaṇaḥ / vavande śirasā pādau prāñjalirvākyamabravīt
verses.translation: Subhrd (white in complexion), Sustand (having
verses.hindi: हिरण्यकशिपुके मार दिये जानेपर भयसे विह्वल महाबली हिरण्याक्ष पुत्र प्रहादको छोड़कर भाग चला। नरसिंहकी देहसे उत्पन्न सिंहोंने (हिरण्यकशिपुके) अनुहाद आदि पुत्रों तथा अन्य सैकड़ों असुरोंको यमलोक पहुँचा दिया। तदनन्तर प्रभु नारायण हरिने उस (नरसिंह) रूपको समेटकर अपने ही नारायण नामवाले श्रेष्ठ रूपको धारण कर लिया तथा अपने धामके लिये
verses.wordMeaning: Subhrd (white in complexion), Sustand (having
verses.commentary: Sense: Subhrd (white in complexion), Sustand (having

verses.sanskrit: धन्यो ऽस्म्यनुगृहीतो ऽस्मि यन्मे साक्षान्मुनीश्वरः । योगीश्वरो ऽद्य भगवान् दृष्टो योगविदां वरः
verses.transliteration: dhanyo 'smyanugṛhīto 'smi yanme sākṣānmunīśvaraḥ / yogīśvaro 'dya bhagavān dṛṣṭo yogavidāṃ varaḥ
verses.translation: Mahavibhutida (bestower of great prosperity), Madhya (the middling), Sarojanayana (lotus-eyed), Asamd (unequalled), Aftadaiabhuja (having eighteen arms), Anadya (having no beginning), Nilotpaladalaprabha (having the lustre of the petals- of a blue lotus).
verses.hindi: नारायणके चले जानेपर असुरश्रेष्ठ हैत्य प्रह्मादने (अपने चाचा) हिरण्याक्षका यथोचित अभिषेक किया। उस (हिरण्याक्ष)-ने युद्धमें देवताओं और मुनियोंको जीतकर उन्हें पीड़ा पहुँचायी और तपस्याके द्वारा शंकरकी आराधना करके अन्धक नामक श्रेष्ठ पुत्र प्राप्त किया। उसने देवराज इन्द्रसहित सभी देवताओंको जीत लिया तथा कमलके समान कान्तिवाली इस पृथ्वीको बाँधकर रसातलमें ले जाकर बंदी बना लिया॥ ७२--७४॥
verses.wordMeaning: Mahavibhutida (bestower of great prosperity), Madhya (the middling), Sarojanayana (lotus-eyed), Asamd (unequalled), Aftadaiabhuja (having eighteen arms), Anadya (having no beginning), Nilotpaladalaprabha (having the lustre of the petals- of a blue lotus).
verses.commentary: Sense: Mahavibhutida (bestower of great prosperity), Madhya (the middling), Sarojanayana (lotus-eyed), Asamd (unequalled), Aftadaiabhuja (having eighteen arms), Anadya (having no beginning), Nilotpaladalaprabha (having the lustre of the petals- of a blue lotus).

verses.sanskrit: अहो मे सुमहद्भाग्यं तपांसि सफलानि मे । किं करिष्यामि शिष्यो ऽहं तव मां पालयानघ
verses.transliteration: aho me sumahadbhāgyaṃ tapāṃsi saphalāni me / kiṃ kariṣyāmi śiṣyo 'haṃ tava māṃ pālayānagha
verses.translation: Sarvasaktydsandru4hd (riding on the seat of all
verses.hindi: तब मुरझायी हुई मुखकी शोभावाले सभी देवता ब्रह्मासहित हरिके निवासमें गये और उन्हें (सारा वृत्तान्त) बतलाया अव्यय उन विश्वात्माने उस हिरण्याक्षके वधका उपाय सोचते हुए सर्वदेवमय स्वच्छ वराहके शरीरको धारण किया। हिरण्याक्षके समीप जाकर पुरुषोत्तमने उसे मार डाला और कल्पके आदिमें (हिरण्याक्षके द्वारा
verses.wordMeaning: Sarvasaktydsandru4hd (riding on the seat of all
verses.commentary: Sense: Sarvasaktydsandru4hd (riding on the seat of all

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽनुगृह्याथ राजानं सुशीलं शीलसंयुतम् । शिष्यत्वे परिजग्राह तपसा क्षीणकल्पषम्
verses.transliteration: so 'nugṛhyātha rājānaṃ suśīlaṃ śīlasaṃyutam / śiṣyatve parijagrāha tapasā kṣīṇakalpaṣam
verses.translation: Vicitragahanddhdrd (support of deep and wonderful things), Sdivatasthdnavdsini (resident of the permanent abobe), Sthdneivari (goddess of the proper abode), Nirdnandd (devoid of bliss), TrUulavaradhdrini (holder of the excellent Trident).
verses.hindi: रसातल ले जायी गयी) इस पृथ्वीका अपने दाढ़ोंद्वारा (उठाकर) उद्धार किया। वणह-रूपका परित्याग कर तथा अपने ही दिव्य (चतुर्भुज )-स्वरूपको धारण किया और वे अपने परम पदकी ओर चले गये॥ ७६--७८ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Vicitragahanddhdrd (support of deep and wonderful things), Sdivatasthdnavdsini (resident of the permanent abobe), Sthdneivari (goddess of the proper abode), Nirdnandd (devoid of bliss), TrUulavaradhdrini (holder of the excellent Trident).
verses.commentary: Sense: Vicitragahanddhdrd (support of deep and wonderful things), Sdivatasthdnavdsini (resident of the permanent abobe), Sthdneivari (goddess of the proper abode), Nirdnandd (devoid of bliss), TrUulavaradhdrini (holder of the excellent Trident).

verses.sanskrit: सांन्यासिकं विधिं कृत्स्नं कारयित्वा विचक्षणः । ददौ तदैश्वरं ज्ञानं स्वशाखाविहितं व्रतम्
verses.transliteration: sāṃnyāsikaṃ vidhiṃ kṛtsnaṃ kārayitvā vicakṣaṇaḥ / dadau tadaiśvaraṃ jñānaṃ svaśākhāvihitaṃ vratam
verses.translation: Aie$adevatdmurti (having the form of the entire group of Devas), Devatdvaradevatd* (the excellent among the deities), Gandmbikd (mother of the gams ), Gireh putri (daughter of the mountain), Nihtmbhavinipdtini (the overthrower of Nisumbha).
verses.hindi: विष्णुपरायण प्रहाद आसुर भावका परित्याग कर अपने राज्यका पालन करने लगा। विष्णुकी आराधनामें निरत रहते हुए उसने विधिपूर्वक देवोंका यज्ञ आदिद्वारा पूजन किया। विष्णुके प्रतापसे उसका राज्य किसी प्रतिद्वन्द्वी (शत्रु) आदिसे रहित था
verses.wordMeaning: Aie$adevatdmurti (having the form of the entire group of Devas), Devatdvaradevatd* (the excellent among the deities), Gandmbikd (mother of the gams ), Gireh putri (daughter of the mountain), Nihtmbhavinipdtini (the overthrower of Nisumbha).
verses.commentary: Sense: Aie$adevatdmurti (having the form of the entire group of Devas), Devatdvaradevatd* (the excellent among the deities), Gandmbikd (mother of the gams ), Gireh putri (daughter of the mountain), Nihtmbhavinipdtini (the overthrower of Nisumbha).

verses.sanskrit: अशेषवेदसारं तत् पशुपाशविमोचनम् । अन्त्याश्रममिति ख्यातं ब्रह्मादिभिरनुष्ठितम्
verses.transliteration: aśeṣavedasāraṃ tat paśupāśavimocanam / antyāśramamiti khyātaṃ brahmādibhiranuṣṭhitam
verses.translation: Avarnd (devoid of castes), Varnarahitd (devoid of colour), Trivarnd (having three castes or colours), Jivasambhavd (cause of birth of the living beings), Amntavarnd (of infinite colours), Ananyasthd (not stationed elsewhere except in the lord), Bankart, Sdntamdnasd (of quiet mind).
verses.hindi: एक बारकी बात है-देवताओंकी मायाके वशीभूत असुर प्रहादने घरमें आये हुए तपस्वी ब्राह्मणकी पूजा नहीं की शशापासुरराजानं क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनः
verses.wordMeaning: Avarnd (devoid of castes), Varnarahitd (devoid of colour), Trivarnd (having three castes or colours), Jivasambhavd (cause of birth of the living beings), Amntavarnd (of infinite colours), Ananyasthd (not stationed elsewhere except in the lord), Bankart,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Avarnd (devoid of castes), Varnarahitd (devoid of colour), Trivarnd (having three castes or colours), Jivasambhavd (cause of birth of the living beings), Amntavarnd (of infinite colours), Ananyasthd (not stationed elsewhere except in the lord), Bankart,…

verses.sanskrit: उवाच शिष्यान् संप्रेक्ष्य ये तदाश्रमवासिनः । ब्राह्मणान् क्षत्रियान् वैश्यान् ब्रह्मचर्यपरायणान्
verses.transliteration: uvāca śiṣyān saṃprekṣya ye tadāśramavāsinaḥ / brāhmaṇān kṣatriyān vaiśyān brahmacaryaparāyaṇān
verses.translation: Agotrd {heiYing no spiritual lineage), Gomati (posse¬ ssing cows or words), Goptri (protectress), Guhyarupd (of secret form), Gunottard (foremost in attributes), Gauh (cow), Gih (word), Gavyapriyd (fond of milk products), Gauni (of Guna traits), Ganeharanamaskrtd (bowed down by the leader of the Gams).
verses.hindi: नारायणस्य देवस्य प्रहादस्यामरद्विषः कृत्वा तु सुमहद् युद्धं विष्णुना तेन निर्जितः। पूर्वसंस्कारमाहात्म्यात् परस्मिन् पुरुषे हरौ। संजातं तस्य विज्ञानं शरण्यं शरणं ययौ
verses.wordMeaning: Agotrd {heiYing no spiritual lineage), Gomati (posse¬ ssing cows or words), Goptri (protectress), Guhyarupd (of secret form), Gunottard (foremost in attributes), Gauh (cow), Gih (word), Gavyapriyd (fond of milk products), Gauni (of Guna traits),…
verses.commentary: Sense: Agotrd {heiYing no spiritual lineage), Gomati (posse¬ ssing cows or words), Goptri (protectress), Guhyarupd (of secret form), Gunottard (foremost in attributes), Gauh (cow), Gih (word), Gavyapriyd (fond of milk products), Gauni (of Guna traits),…

verses.sanskrit: मया प्रवर्तितां शाखामधीत्यैवेह योगिनः । समासते महादेवं ध्यायन्तो निष्कलं शिवम्
verses.transliteration: mayā pravartitāṃ śākhāmadhītyaiveha yoginaḥ / samāsate mahādevaṃ dhyāyanto niṣkalaṃ śivam
verses.translation: Satyabhdmd, Satyasandhd (Strictly adhering to truth), Trisandhyd (having three junctions), Sandhivarjitd (devoid of joints), Sarvavdddirayd (support of all schools of philosphers), Sankhyd (reason), Sdnkhyayogasarmdbhavd (born of the schools, of philosophy —Sdrhkhya and Toga).

verses.transliteration: daśabhyastu pracetobhyo māriṣāyāṃ prajāpatiḥ / dakṣo jajñe mahābhāgo yaḥ pūrvaṃ brahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ

verses.hindi: ततः स भगवान् विष्णुः शरण्यो भक्तवत्सलः । गोपतिं प्राह विप्रे्रानालोक्य प्रणतान् हरिः न वेदबाह्य पुरुषे पुण्यलेशोऽपि शंकर। संगच्छते महादेव धर्मो वेदाद् विनिर्बभौ
verses.wordMeaning: Amanyu (devoid of anger), Amrtasvada (tasting nectar), Puruhuta (one who is often invoked), Purututa (much eulogised),.dfoiyia (not pitiable), fiAmraawVqya (having different objects), Hiranyarajatapriya (fond of gold and silver).

verses.sanskrit: स तु दक्षो महेशेन रुद्रेण सह धीमता । कृत्वा विवादं रुद्रेण शप्तः प्राचेतसो ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: sa tu dakṣo maheśena rudreṇa saha dhīmatā / kṛtvā vivādaṃ rudreṇa śaptaḥ prācetaso 'bhavat
verses.translation: Amanyu (devoid of anger), Amrtasvada (tasting nectar), Puruhuta (one who is often invoked), Purututa (much eulogised),.dfoiyia (not pitiable), fiAmraawVqya (having different objects), Hiranyarajatapriya (fond of gold and silver).
verses.hindi: तब सभी मुनिवरोंने आपसमें मन्त्रणा कर महर्षि गौतमसे पूछा--क्या हमलोग शीघ्र यहाँसे चले जायें? तब गौतमने उन लोगोंको रोकते हुए कहा--पण्डितजनो ! कुछ समय और यहाँ मेरे घरमें सुखपूर्वक रहें, इसके एक कमजोर गाय बनाकर उसे महात्मा गौतमके समीप पहुँचा दिया। गायको देखकर उसकी रक्षाके लिये उत्सुक दयालु मुनिने अपनी गोशालामें उसे बाँध दिया, किंतु वह गाय छूते ही मर गयी॥ ९६--९९॥
verses.wordMeaning: Amanyu (devoid of anger), Amrtasvada (tasting nectar), Puruhuta (one who is often invoked), Purututa (much eulogised),.dfoiyia (not pitiable), fiAmraawVqya (having different objects), Hiranyarajatapriya (fond of gold and silver).
verses.commentary: Sense: Amanyu (devoid of anger), Amrtasvada (tasting nectar), Puruhuta (one who is often invoked), Purututa (much eulogised),.dfoiyia (not pitiable), fiAmraawVqya (having different objects), Hiranyarajatapriya (fond of gold and silver).

verses.sanskrit: समायान्तं महादेवो दक्षं देव्या गृहं हरः । दृष्ट्वा यथोचितां पूजां दक्षाय प्रददौ स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: samāyāntaṃ mahādevo dakṣaṃ devyā gṛhaṃ haraḥ / dṛṣṭvā yathocitāṃ pūjāṃ dakṣāya pradadau svayam
verses.translation: Amanyu (devoid of anger), Amrtasvada (tasting nectar), Puruhuta (one who is often invoked), Purututa (much eulogised),.dfoiyia (not pitiable), fiAmraawVqya (having different objects), Hiranyarajatapriya (fond of gold and silver).
verses.hindi: शोकसे अत्यन्त दुःखी वे महामुनि उस समय किंकर्तव्यविमूढ़-से हो गये। तब शीघ्र ही मुनियोंने ऐसे उन (गौतम मुनि)-से कहा-- हे द्विजश्रेष्ठ! जबतक यह गोहत्या आपके शरीरमें (व्याप्त) रहेगी, तबतक आपके यहाँ अन्न नहीं ग्रहण करना चाहिए, इसलिये हमलोग जा रहे हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Amanyu (devoid of anger), Amrtasvada (tasting nectar), Puruhuta (one who is often invoked), Purututa (much eulogised),.dfoiyia (not pitiable), fiAmraawVqya (having different objects), Hiranyarajatapriya (fond of gold and silver).
verses.commentary: Sense: Amanyu (devoid of anger), Amrtasvada (tasting nectar), Puruhuta (one who is often invoked), Purututa (much eulogised),.dfoiyia (not pitiable), fiAmraawVqya (having different objects), Hiranyarajatapriya (fond of gold and silver).

verses.sanskrit: तदा वै तमसाविष्टः सो ऽदिकां ब्रह्मणः सुतः । पूजामनर्हामन्विच्छन् जगाम कुपितो गृहम्
verses.transliteration: tadā vai tamasāviṣṭaḥ so 'dikāṃ brahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ / pūjāmanarhāmanvicchan jagāma kupito gṛham
verses.translation: Amanyu (devoid of anger), Amrtasvada (tasting nectar), Puruhuta (one who is often invoked), Purututa (much eulogised),.dfoiyia (not pitiable), fiAmraawVqya (having different objects), Hiranyarajatapriya (fond of gold and silver).
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार पापके वशीभूत हुए वे (मुनिजन) प्रसन्न होकर पहलेके ही समान तप करनेके लिये शुभ देवदारु वनमें चले गये। उन गौतम मुनिने उन मुनियोंकी मायाद्वारा करायी गयी गोहत्याको किसी प्रकारसे जान लिया और अत्यन्त क्रुद्ध होकर (इस प्रकार) शाप दिया
verses.wordMeaning: Amanyu (devoid of anger), Amrtasvada (tasting nectar), Puruhuta (one who is often invoked), Purututa (much eulogised),.dfoiyia (not pitiable), fiAmraawVqya (having different objects), Hiranyarajatapriya (fond of gold and silver).
