verses.sanskrit: कदाचित् स्वगृहं प्राप्तां सतीं दक्षः सुदुर्मनाः । भर्त्रा सह विनिन्द्यैनां भर्त्सयामसा वै रुषा
verses.transliteration: kadācit svagṛhaṃ prāptāṃ satīṃ dakṣaḥ sudurmanāḥ / bhartrā saha vinindyaināṃ bhartsayāmasā vai ruṣā
verses.translation: Amanyu (devoid of anger), Amrtasvada (tasting nectar), Puruhuta (one who is often invoked), Purututa (much eulogised),.dfoiyia (not pitiable), fiAmraawVqya (having different objects), Hiranyarajatapriya (fond of gold and silver).
verses.hindi: महापातकियोंके समान ये लोग वेदसे बहिष्कृत हो जायेगे और शापके कारण बार-बार जन्म लेनेवाले होंगे । भोजनसे बची हुई जूठनके समान वे सभी (शापसे भयभीत होकर) सर्वव्यापक देवेश शंकर तथा अव्यय विष्णुके पास पहुँचकर उनकी लौकिक स्तुतियोंसे स्तुति करने लगे
verses.wordMeaning: Amanyu (devoid of anger), Amrtasvada (tasting nectar), Puruhuta (one who is often invoked), Purututa (much eulogised),.dfoiyia (not pitiable), fiAmraawVqya (having different objects), Hiranyarajatapriya (fond of gold and silver).
verses.commentary: Sense: Amanyu (devoid of anger), Amrtasvada (tasting nectar), Puruhuta (one who is often invoked), Purututa (much eulogised),.dfoiyia (not pitiable), fiAmraawVqya (having different objects), Hiranyarajatapriya (fond of gold and silver).

verses.sanskrit: अन्ये जामातरः श्रेष्ठा भर्तुस्तव पिनाकिनः । त्वमप्यसत्सुतास्माकं गृहाद् गच्छ यथागतम्
verses.transliteration: anye jāmātaraḥ śreṣṭhā bhartustava pinākinaḥ / tvamapyasatsutāsmākaṃ gṛhād gaccha yathāgatam
verses.translation: Amanyu (devoid of anger), Amrtasvada (tasting nectar), Puruhuta (one who is often invoked), Purututa (much eulogised),.dfoiyia (not pitiable), fiAmraawVqya (having different objects), Hiranyarajatapriya (fond of gold and silver).
verses.hindi: हे देवदेव (विष्णु) ! है महादेव! (शंकर) आप दोनों भक्तोंका कष्ट दूर करनेवाले हैं और इच्छानुसार योगका अवलम्बन करनेवाले हैं। आप हम लोगोंकी पापसे रक्षा करें। तब समीपमें स्थित विष्णुकी ओर देखकर वृषभध्वज शंकरने कहा-बताइये कि ये पुण्यकी इच्छा करनेवाले लोग क्या चाहते हैं? तब भक्तवत्सल, शरण्य हरि उन भगवान् विष्णुने विनीत श्रेष्ठ ब्राह्मणोंकी ओर देखकर शंकरजीसे कहा--
verses.wordMeaning: Amanyu (devoid of anger), Amrtasvada (tasting nectar), Puruhuta (one who is often invoked), Purututa (much eulogised),.dfoiyia (not pitiable), fiAmraawVqya (having different objects), Hiranyarajatapriya (fond of gold and silver).
verses.commentary: Sense: Amanyu (devoid of anger), Amrtasvada (tasting nectar), Puruhuta (one who is often invoked), Purututa (much eulogised),.dfoiyia (not pitiable), fiAmraawVqya (having different objects), Hiranyarajatapriya (fond of gold and silver).

verses.sanskrit: तस्य तद्वाक्यमाकर्ण्य सा देवी शङ्करप्रिया । विनिन्द्य पितरं दक्षं ददाहात्मानमात्मना
verses.transliteration: tasya tadvākyamākarṇya sā devī śaṅkarapriyā / vinindya pitaraṃ dakṣaṃ dadāhātmānamātmanā
verses.translation: Amanyu (devoid of anger), Amrtasvada (tasting nectar), Puruhuta (one who is often invoked), Purututa (much eulogised),.dfoiyia (not pitiable), fiAmraawVqya (having different objects), Hiranyarajatapriya (fond of gold and silver).
verses.hindi: शंकर! वेदबाह्य पुरुषमें पुण्यका लेशमात्र भी नहीं रहता। है महादेव! वेदसे ही धर्म उत्पन्न हुआ है अस्माभिः सर्व एवेमे गन्तारो नरकानपि
verses.wordMeaning: Amanyu (devoid of anger), Amrtasvada (tasting nectar), Puruhuta (one who is often invoked), Purututa (much eulogised),.dfoiyia (not pitiable), fiAmraawVqya (having different objects), Hiranyarajatapriya (fond of gold and silver).

verses.sanskrit: प्रणम्य पशुभर्तारं भर्तारं कृत्तिवाससम् । हिमवद्दुहिता साभूत् तपसा तस्य तोषिता
verses.transliteration: praṇamya paśubhartāraṃ bhartāraṃ kṛttivāsasam / himavadduhitā sābhūt tapasā tasya toṣitā
verses.translation: Amanyu (devoid of anger), Amrtasvada (tasting nectar), Puruhuta (one who is often invoked), Purututa (much eulogised),.dfoiyia (not pitiable), fiAmraawVqya (having different objects), Hiranyarajatapriya (fond of gold and silver).
verses.hindi: तस्माद् वै वेदबाह्यानां रक्षणार्थाय पापिनाम्। विमोहनाय शास्त्राणि करिष्यामो वृषध्वज चकार मोहशास्त्राणि केशवोऽपि शिवेरितः
verses.wordMeaning: Amanyu (devoid of anger), Amrtasvada (tasting nectar), Puruhuta (one who is often invoked), Purututa (much eulogised),.dfoiyia (not pitiable), fiAmraawVqya (having different objects), Hiranyarajatapriya (fond of gold and silver).

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञात्वा तद्भागवान् रुद्रः प्रपन्नार्तिहरो हरः । शशाप दक्षं कुपितः समागत्याथ तद्गृहम्
verses.transliteration: jñātvā tadbhāgavān rudraḥ prapannārtiharo haraḥ / śaśāpa dakṣaṃ kupitaḥ samāgatyātha tadgṛham
verses.translation: Amanyu (devoid of anger), Amrtasvada (tasting nectar), Puruhuta (one who is often invoked), Purututa (much eulogised),.dfoiyia (not pitiable), fiAmraawVqya (having different objects), Hiranyarajatapriya (fond of gold and silver).
verses.hindi: कापालं नाकुलं वामं भैरवं पूर्वपश्चिमम्। पञ्चरात्रं पाशुपतं तथान्यानि सहस्त्रशः जायन्तो मानुषे लोके क्षीणपापचयास्ततः ।
verses.wordMeaning: Amanyu (devoid of anger), Amrtasvada (tasting nectar), Puruhuta (one who is often invoked), Purututa (much eulogised),.dfoiyia (not pitiable), fiAmraawVqya (having different objects), Hiranyarajatapriya (fond of gold and silver).

verses.sanskrit: त्यक्त्वा देहमिमं ब्रह्मन् क्षत्रियाणां कुलोद्भवः । स्वस्यां सुतायां मूढात्मा पुत्रमुत्पादयिष्यसि
verses.transliteration: tyaktvā dehamimaṃ brahman kṣatriyāṇāṃ kulodbhavaḥ / svasyāṃ sutāyāṃ mūḍhātmā putramutpādayiṣyasi
verses.translation: Amanyu (devoid of anger), Amrtasvada (tasting nectar), Puruhuta (one who is often invoked), Purututa (much eulogised),.dfoiyia (not pitiable), fiAmraawVqya (having different objects), Hiranyarajatapriya (fond of gold and silver).
verses.hindi: एवमीश्वरविष्णुभ्यां चोदितास्ते महर्षयः । आदेशं प्रत्यपद्यन्त शिरसाऽसुरविद्विषोः मोहयन्त इमं लोकमवतीर्य महीतले। चकार शंकरो भिक्षां हितायैषां द्विजैः सह
verses.wordMeaning: Amanyu (devoid of anger), Amrtasvada (tasting nectar), Puruhuta (one who is often invoked), Purututa (much eulogised),.dfoiyia (not pitiable), fiAmraawVqya (having different objects), Hiranyarajatapriya (fond of gold and silver).

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा महादेवो ययौ कालासपर्वतम् । स्वायंभुवो ऽपि कालेन दक्षः प्राचेतसो ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā mahādevo yayau kālāsaparvatam / svāyaṃbhuvo 'pi kālena dakṣaḥ prācetaso 'bhavat
verses.translation: Amanyu (devoid of anger), Amrtasvada (tasting nectar), Puruhuta (one who is often invoked), Purututa (much eulogised),.dfoiyia (not pitiable), fiAmraawVqya (having different objects), Hiranyarajatapriya (fond of gold and silver).
verses.hindi: विमोहयँल्लोकमिमं जटामण्डलमण्डितः निक्षिप्य पार्वतीं देवीं विष्णावमिततेजसि। नियोज्याङ्कभवं रुद्रं भैरवं दुष्टनिग्रहे
verses.wordMeaning: Amanyu (devoid of anger), Amrtasvada (tasting nectar), Puruhuta (one who is often invoked), Purututa (much eulogised),.dfoiyia (not pitiable), fiAmraawVqya (having different objects), Hiranyarajatapriya (fond of gold and silver).

verses.sanskrit: एतद् वः कथितं सर्वं मनोः स्वायंभुवस्य तु । विसर्गं दक्षपर्यन्तं शृण्वतां पापनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: etad vaḥ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ manoḥ svāyaṃbhuvasya tu / visargaṃ dakṣaparyantaṃ śṛṇvatāṃ pāpanāśanam
verses.translation: Amanyu (devoid of anger), Amrtasvada (tasting nectar), Puruhuta (one who is often invoked), Purututa (much eulogised),.dfoiyia (not pitiable), fiAmraawVqya (having different objects), Hiranyarajatapriya (fond of gold and silver).
verses.hindi: दत्त्वा नारायणे देवीं नन्दिनं कुलनन्दिनम्। संस्थाप्य तत्र गणपान् देवानिन्द्रपुरोगमान् प्रस्थितेऽथ महादेवे विष्णुर्विश्वतनुः स्वयम्। स्त्रीरूपधारी नियतं सेवते स्म महेश्वरीम्
verses.wordMeaning: Amanyu (devoid of anger), Amrtasvada (tasting nectar), Puruhuta (one who is often invoked), Purututa (much eulogised),.dfoiyia (not pitiable), fiAmraawVqya (having different objects), Hiranyarajatapriya (fond of gold and silver).
verses.commentary: Sense: Amanyu (devoid of anger), Amrtasvada (tasting nectar), Puruhuta (one who is often invoked), Purututa (much eulogised),.dfoiyia (not pitiable), fiAmraawVqya (having different objects), Hiranyarajatapriya (fond of gold and silver).

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्माहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे त्रयोदशो ऽध्यायः नैमिषीया ऊचुः देवानां दानवानां च गन्धर्वोरगरक्षसाम् । उत्पत्तिं विस्तरात् सूत ब्रूहि वैवस्वते ऽन्तरे
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭmāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge trayodaśo 'dhyāyaḥ naimiṣīyā ūcuḥ devānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca gandharvoragarakṣasām / utpattiṃ vistarāt sūta brūhi vaivasvate 'ntare
verses.translation: Hiranyarajani (golden night),Haima {go\den),Hema- hharanabhiifita (bedecked in golden ornaments), Vibhrajamana (shining), Durjneya (incomprehensible), Jyotiftomaphalaprada (bestower of the fruits of sacrifice Jyotistoma).
verses.hindi: तथापि महेश्वर! भक्तवत्सलताके कारण नरकोंमें जानेवाले इन सभीकी हमारे द्वारा रक्षा की जानी चाहिए ऐसा उचित प्रतीत होता है। इसलिये वृषभध्वज! वेदबाह्य पापियोंकी रक्षा करने एवं उन्हें मोहित करनेके लिये मैं शास्त्रोंकी रचना करूँगा। इस प्रकार मुरारि माधवसे प्रेरित किये गये रुद्रने मोहित करनेवाले शास्त्रोंकी बनाया और उसी प्रकार शिवसे प्रेरणा प्राप्त केशवने भी ऐसे ही शास्त्रोंकी रचना को। कापाल,
verses.wordMeaning: Hiranyarajani (golden night),Haima {go\den),Hema- hharanabhiifita (bedecked in golden ornaments), Vibhrajamana (shining), Durjneya (incomprehensible), Jyotiftomaphalaprada (bestower of the fruits of sacrifice Jyotistoma).
verses.commentary: Sense: Hiranyarajani (golden night),Haima {go\den),Hema- hharanabhiifita (bedecked in golden ornaments), Vibhrajamana (shining), Durjneya (incomprehensible), Jyotiftomaphalaprada (bestower of the fruits of sacrifice Jyotistoma).

verses.sanskrit: स शप्तः शंभुना पूर्वं दक्षः प्राचेतसो नृपः । किमकार्षोन्महाबुद्धे श्रोतुमिच्छाम सांप्रतम्
verses.transliteration: sa śaptaḥ śaṃbhunā pūrvaṃ dakṣaḥ prācetaso nṛpaḥ / kimakārṣonmahābuddhe śrotumicchāma sāṃpratam
verses.translation: Mahanidrasamudbhuti (born of great slumber),.dm'rfra (having no slumber), Satyadevata (a true deity), Dirgha (long), Kakudmini (lofty), Hrdya (hearty), Santida (bestower of peace), Santivardhini (increaserof peace).
verses.hindi: अन्य भी सहस्रों शास्त्रोंकी रचना करके उन देवोंने उन (वेदबाह्य)-से कहा--इन शास्त्रोंमें बताये गये कर्माको करनेके कारण बहुत कल्पोंतक आप सब घोर अन्धकारपूर्ण नरकोंमें गिरेंगे और फिर पाप-समूहके क्षीण हो जानेपर मनुष्यलोक प्राप्त करेंगे। पुनः ईश्वरकी आराधनाके बलपर पुण्यवानोंकी गति प्राप्त करेंगे। आप सभी मेरी प्रसन्नताके लिये ऐसा ही करें, आप लोगोंके निस्तारणका अर्थात् दोषमुक्त होनेका इसके अतिरिक्त अन्य कोई
verses.wordMeaning: Mahanidrasamudbhuti (born of great slumber),.dm'rfra (having no slumber), Satyadevata (a true deity), Dirgha (long), Kakudmini (lofty), Hrdya (hearty), Santida (bestower of peace), Santivardhini (increaserof peace).
verses.commentary: Sense: Mahanidrasamudbhuti (born of great slumber),.dm'rfra (having no slumber), Satyadevata (a true deity), Dirgha (long), Kakudmini (lofty), Hrdya (hearty), Santida (bestower of peace), Santivardhini (increaserof peace).

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच वक्ष्ये नारायणेनोक्तं पूर्वकल्पानुषङ्गिकम् । त्रिकालबद्धं पापघ्नं प्रजासर्गस्य विस्तरम्
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca vakṣye nārāyaṇenoktaṃ pūrvakalpānuṣaṅgikam / trikālabaddhaṃ pāpaghnaṃ prajāsargasya vistaram
verses.translation: Lak?myadiiaktijanani (mother of Laksmi and other Saktis ), Sakticakrapravartika (the cause or mover of the cycle or a group of Saktis), Triiakti-Janani (mother of the three Saktis), Janya (A bride's maid or a mother's friend), Sadurmiparivarjita (devoid of the six waves viz. sorrow, delusion, hunger, thirst, old age and death).
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार शिव तथा विष्णुके द्वारा प्रेरणा प्राप्तकर उन महर्षियोंने असुरोंसे द्वेष करनेवाले उन दोनों देवोंकी आज्ञाको सिरसे स्वीकार किया। पुनः उन लोगोंने भी दूसरे शास्त्रोंकी रचना कर उनमें प्रवृत्त होनेवाले शिष्योंको पढ़ाया तथा उन शास्त्रोंके पढ्नेका फल भी बताया
verses.wordMeaning: Lak?myadiiaktijanani (mother of Laksmi and other Saktis ), Sakticakrapravartika (the cause or mover of the cycle or a group of Saktis), Triiakti-Janani (mother of the three Saktis), Janya (A bride's maid or a mother's friend), Sadurmiparivarjita (devoid of the six waves viz.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Lak?myadiiaktijanani (mother of Laksmi and other Saktis ), Sakticakrapravartika (the cause or mover of the cycle or a group of Saktis), Triiakti-Janani (mother of the three Saktis), Janya (A bride's maid or a mother's friend), Sadurmiparivarjita (devoid of the six waves viz.…

verses.sanskrit: स शप्तः शंभुना पूर्वं दक्षः प्राचेतसो नृपः । विनिन्द्य पूर्ववैरेण गङ्गाद्वरे ऽयजद् भवम्
verses.transliteration: sa śaptaḥ śaṃbhunā pūrvaṃ dakṣaḥ prācetaso nṛpaḥ / vinindya pūrvavaireṇa gaṅgādvare 'yajad bhavam
verses.translation: Sudhauta (well washed), Karmakarani (performer of activities), Tuganta-dahanatmika (of the nature of the fire at the close of the Yugas), Sarhkarani (dragging and seizing), Jagaddhatri (mother of the universe) Kdmayoni (source of origin of Kama), Kiritini (wearing the crown).
verses.hindi: शिवने इन (ब्राह्मणों)-के कल्याणके लिये पृथ्वीपर अवतार लेकर लोगोंको मोहित करते हुए ब्राह्मणोंके साथ भिक्षावृत्ति ग्रहण की  कपालोंकी मालाका आभूषण धारणकर, चिता-भस्म लगाकर और जटामण्डलसे मण्डित हो इस लोकको मोहित किया। देवी पार्वतीको अमित तेजस्वी विष्णुके समीप रखा और दुष्टोंका निग्रह करनेके लिये अपने अङ्गसे उत्पन्न रुद्र भैरवको नियुक्त किया। देवीको नारायणके समीप रखकर कुलनन्दन
verses.wordMeaning: Sudhauta (well washed), Karmakarani (performer of activities), Tuganta-dahanatmika (of the nature of the fire at the close of the Yugas), Sarhkarani (dragging and seizing), Jagaddhatri (mother of the universe) Kdmayoni (source of origin of Kama), Kiritini (wearing the crown).
verses.commentary: Sense: Sudhauta (well washed), Karmakarani (performer of activities), Tuganta-dahanatmika (of the nature of the fire at the close of the Yugas), Sarhkarani (dragging and seizing), Jagaddhatri (mother of the universe) Kdmayoni (source of origin of Kama), Kiritini (wearing the crown).

verses.sanskrit: देवाश्च सर्वे भागार्थमाहूता विष्णुना सह । सहैव मुनिभिः सर्वैरागता मुनिपुङ्गवाः
verses.transliteration: devāśca sarve bhāgārthamāhūtā viṣṇunā saha / sahaiva munibhiḥ sarvairāgatā munipuṅgavāḥ
verses.translation: Aindri (belonging to Indra), Trailokyanamitd (bowed to by the three worlds), Vaisnavi, Paramesvari, Pradyumna-dayitd (beloved of Pradyumna), Ddtri (donor), Yugmadrti (having a ■pair of visions), Trilocand (three-eyed).
verses.hindi: नन्दीको वहाँ रखा तथा इन्द्रादि देवों एवं गणपोंको भी वहाँ स्थापित किया महादेवके जानेके पश्चात् विश्वतनु साक्षात् विष्णु स्त्री-रूप धारण करके महेश्वरी पार्वतीकी भलीभाँति सेवा करने लगे
verses.wordMeaning: Aindri (belonging to Indra), Trailokyanamitd (bowed to by the three worlds), Vaisnavi, Paramesvari, Pradyumna-dayitd (beloved of Pradyumna), Ddtri (donor), Yugmadrti (having a ■pair of visions), Trilocand (three-eyed).
verses.commentary: Sense: Aindri (belonging to Indra), Trailokyanamitd (bowed to by the three worlds), Vaisnavi, Paramesvari, Pradyumna-dayitd (beloved of Pradyumna), Ddtri (donor), Yugmadrti (having a ■pair of visions), Trilocand (three-eyed).

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा देवकुलं कृत्स्नं शङ्करेण विनागतम् । दधीचो नाम विप्रर्षिः प्राचेतसमथाब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā devakulaṃ kṛtsnaṃ śaṅkareṇa vināgatam / dadhīco nāma viprarṣiḥ prācetasamathābravīt
verses.translation: Madotkatd (excessively rapturous), Hamsagati (having the gait of a swan), Pracandd (very fierce), Candavikramd (of fierce exploits), Vrdvesd} (having enthudasm for piety), Viyanmdtd (mother of the firmament), Vindhyaparvatavdsini (residing on the Vindhya Mountains).
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मा हुताशन: शक्रो यमोन्ये सुरपुङ्गवाः । सिषेविरे महादेवीं स्त्रीवेशं शोभनं गता: नन्दीश्वरश्च भगवान् शम्भोरत्यन्तवल्लभ: । द्वारदेशे गणाध्यक्षो यथापूर्वमतिष्ठत
verses.wordMeaning: Madotkatd (excessively rapturous), Hamsagati (having the gait of a swan), Pracandd (very fierce), Candavikramd (of fierce exploits), Vrdvesd} (having enthudasm for piety), Viyanmdtd (mother of the firmament), Vindhyaparvatavdsini (residing on the Vindhya Mountains).
verses.commentary: Sense: Madotkatd (excessively rapturous), Hamsagati (having the gait of a swan), Pracandd (very fierce), Candavikramd (of fierce exploits), Vrdvesd} (having enthudasm for piety), Viyanmdtd (mother of the firmament), Vindhyaparvatavdsini (residing on the Vindhya Mountains).

verses.sanskrit: दधीच उवाच ब्रह्मादयः पिशाचान्ता यस्याज्ञानुविधायिनः । स देवः सांप्रतं रुद्रो विधिना किं न पूज्यते
verses.transliteration: dadhīca uvāca brahmādayaḥ piśācāntā yasyājñānuvidhāyinaḥ / sa devaḥ sāṃprataṃ rudro vidhinā kiṃ na pūjyate
verses.translation: Himavanmerunilayd (having her abode in mountains Himavat and Meru), Kaildsagirivdsini (residing on the Mountain Kailasa), Cdnurahantrtanayd (daughter of the slayer of Ganura),
verses.hindi: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे हैत्यो हान्थको नाम दुर्मतिः । आहर्तुकामो गिरिजामाजगामाथ मन्दरम् सम्प्राप्तमन्धकं दृष्टा शंकरः कालभेरव: । न्यषेधयदमेयात्मा कालरूपधरो हरः
verses.wordMeaning: Himavanmerunilayd (having her abode in mountains Himavat and Meru), Kaildsagirivdsini (residing on the Mountain Kailasa), Cdnurahantrtanayd (daughter of the slayer of Ganura),
verses.commentary: Sense: Himavanmerunilayd (having her abode in mountains Himavat and Meru), Kaildsagirivdsini (residing on the Mountain Kailasa), Cdnurahantrtanayd (daughter of the slayer of Ganura),

verses.sanskrit: दक्ष उवाच सर्वेष्वेव हि यज्ञेषु न भागः परिकल्पितः । न मन्त्रा भार्यया सार्धं शङ्करस्येति नेज्यते
verses.transliteration: dakṣa uvāca sarveṣveva hi yajñeṣu na bhāgaḥ parikalpitaḥ / na mantrā bhāryayā sārdhaṃ śaṅkarasyeti nejyate
verses.translation: Vedavidya (Vedic Lore), Vratasnata (one who has performed the holy ablution after observance of holy vows), Brahmaiailanivdsini * (residing on i he Mountain Brahmasaila), Virabhadrapraja (progeny of Virabhadra), v.l. Vira-bhadra-Priya (beloved of vira bhava)Vira (heroic) Mahakamasamudbhava{horn of great love).
verses.hindi: शूलेनोरसि तं हैत्यमाजघान वृषध्वजः ततः सहस्त्रशो हैत्यः ससर्जान्धकसंज्ञितान्। नन्दिषेणादयो हैत्यैरन्धकैरभिनिर्जिताः
verses.wordMeaning: Vedavidya (Vedic Lore), Vratasnata (one who has performed the holy ablution after observance of holy vows), Brahmaiailanivdsini * (residing on i he Mountain Brahmasaila), Virabhadrapraja (progeny of Virabhadra), v.l.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Vedavidya (Vedic Lore), Vratasnata (one who has performed the holy ablution after observance of holy vows), Brahmaiailanivdsini * (residing on i he Mountain Brahmasaila), Virabhadrapraja (progeny of Virabhadra), v.l.…

verses.sanskrit: विहस्य दक्षं कुपितो वचः प्राह महामुनिः । शृण्वतां सर्वदेवानां सर्वज्ञानमयः स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: vihasya dakṣaṃ kupito vacaḥ prāha mahāmuniḥ / śṛṇvatāṃ sarvadevānāṃ sarvajñānamayaḥ svayam
verses.translation: Vidyadharapriya (beloved o f the Vidyadharas),.JtWffAa (of achievement), Vidyadharanirakrti (refutation of the Vidya- dhara), Apyayani (developer and nourisher), Haranti (captiva¬ ting), Pdvani (sanctifier), Pojani (nourisher),/fa/a (arts, digits).
verses.hindi: घण्टाकर्णो मेघनादश्चण्डेशश्चण्डतापनः । विनायको मेघवाहः सोमनन्दी च वैद्युतः सर्वेऽन्धकं हैत्यवरं सम्प्राप्यातिबलान्विताः । युयुधुः शूलशक्त््यृष्टरिगिरिकूटपरश्चधेः
verses.wordMeaning: Vidyadharapriya (beloved o f the Vidyadharas),.JtWffAa (of achievement), Vidyadharanirakrti (refutation of the Vidya- dhara), Apyayani (developer and nourisher), Haranti (captiva¬ ting), Pdvani (sanctifier), Pojani (nourisher),/fa/a (arts, digits).
verses.commentary: Sense: Vidyadharapriya (beloved o f the Vidyadharas),.JtWffAa (of achievement), Vidyadharanirakrti (refutation of the Vidya- dhara), Apyayani (developer and nourisher), Haranti (captiva¬ ting), Pdvani (sanctifier), Pojani (nourisher),/fa/a (arts, digits).

verses.sanskrit: दधीच उवाच यतः प्रवृत्तिर्विश्वेषां यश्चास्य परमेश्वरः । संपूज्यते सर्वयज्ञैर्विदित्वा किल शङ्करः
verses.transliteration: dadhīca uvāca yataḥ pravṛttirviśveṣāṃ yaścāsya parameśvaraḥ / saṃpūjyate sarvayajñairviditvā kila śaṅkaraḥ
verses.translation: Mdtrkd (a divine mother), Manmathodbhutd (born of Kama), Vdrijd (born of water), Vdhanapriyd (fond of the vehicle), Kariini (goddess of wealth), Sudhavdm (nectar-speech- ed), Vindvddanatatpard (exclusively devoted to playing the lute).
verses.hindi: हैत्येन्द्रेणातिबलिना क्षिप्तास्ते शतयोजनम् कालसूर्यप्रतीकाशा भेरवं त्वभिदुद्रुवुः
verses.wordMeaning: Mdtrkd (a divine mother), Manmathodbhutd (born of Kama), Vdrijd (born of water), Vdhanapriyd (fond of the vehicle), Kariini (goddess of wealth), Sudhavdm (nectar-speech- ed), Vindvddanatatpard (exclusively devoted to playing the lute).
verses.commentary: Sense: Mdtrkd (a divine mother), Manmathodbhutd (born of Kama), Vdrijd (born of water), Vdhanapriyd (fond of the vehicle), Kariini (goddess of wealth), Sudhavdm (nectar-speech- ed), Vindvddanatatpard (exclusively devoted to playing the lute).

verses.sanskrit: न ह्यं शङ्करो रुद्रः संहर्ता तामसो हरः । नग्नः कपाली विकृतो विश्वात्मा नोपपद्यते
verses.transliteration: na hyaṃ śaṅkaro rudraḥ saṃhartā tāmaso haraḥ / nagnaḥ kapālī vikṛto viśvātmā nopapadyate
verses.translation: Sevitd (one who is served), Sevikd (nurse), Sevyd (worthy of being served), Sinivdli (new moon night with the moon slightly visible), Garutmati (having Garuda), Armdhati, Hiranyd-
verses.hindi: हा हेति शब्दः सुमहान् बभूवातिभयङ्करः। युयोध भेरवो रुद्रः शूलमादाय भीषणम् दृष्राऽन्धकानां सुबलं दुर्जयं तर्जितो हरः। जगाम शरणं देवं वासुदेवमजं विभुम्
verses.wordMeaning: Sevitd (one who is served), Sevikd (nurse), Sevyd (worthy of being served), Sinivdli (new moon night with the moon slightly visible), Garutmati (having Garuda), Armdhati, Hiranyd-
verses.commentary: Sense: Sevitd (one who is served), Sevikd (nurse), Sevyd (worthy of being served), Sinivdli (new moon night with the moon slightly visible), Garutmati (having Garuda), Armdhati, Hiranyd-

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वरो हि जगत्स्त्रष्टा प्रभुर्नारायणः स्वराट् । सत्त्वात्मको ऽसौ भगवानिज्यते सर्वकर्मसु
verses.transliteration: īśvaro hi jagatstraṣṭā prabhurnārāyaṇaḥ svarāṭ / sattvātmako 'sau bhagavānijyate sarvakarmasu
verses.translation: Vasupradd (bestower of wealth), Vasumati{the earth), Vasordhdrd (continuous flow of riches), Vasundhard (earth holding riches), Dhdrd-dhard (holding continuous current), Vardrohd (possessing excellent waist), Pardvdsasahasradd (bestower of thous¬ ands of great residences).
verses.hindi: सोऽसृजद् भगवान् विष्णुर्देवीनां शतमुत्तमम्। देवीपार्श्वस्थितो देवो विनाशायामरद्विषाम् तदान्धकसहस्त्रं तु देवीभिर्यमसादनम्। नीतं केशवमाहात्म्याल्लीलयैव रणाजिरे
verses.wordMeaning: Vasupradd (bestower of wealth), Vasumati{the earth), Vasordhdrd (continuous flow of riches), Vasundhard (earth holding riches), Dhdrd-dhard (holding continuous current), Vardrohd (possessing excellent waist), Pardvdsasahasradd (bestower of thous¬ ands of great residences).

verses.translation: Kdpdlisakald (the digit of the lord Kapalin), Murti (form), Kaldkalitavigrahd (having the body constructed of the Kolas (digits)), Sarvasaktivinirmuktd (free from all Saktis), Sarvas- aktydsraydlrayd (the supporter of the supporter of all the Saktis ).
verses.hindi: विभज्य संस्थितो देवः स्वात्मानं बहुधेश्वरः ईश्वरको आया हुआ जानकर सभी गणेश्वर उनके पासमें आकर इस प्रकार स्थित हो गये जैसे द्विज सूर्यकी उपासनामें स्थित रहते हैं। अयोगियोंके लिये दुर्गम पुण्यशाली भवनमें प्रवेशकर शिवने नन्दी, भैरवदेव
verses.wordMeaning: Kdpdlisakald (the digit of the lord Kapalin), Murti (form), Kaldkalitavigrahd (having the body constructed of the Kolas (digits)), Sarvasaktivinirmuktd (free from all Saktis), Sarvas- aktydsraydlrayd (the supporter of the supporter of all the Saktis ).
verses.commentary: Sense: Kdpdlisakald (the digit of the lord Kapalin), Murti (form), Kaldkalitavigrahd (having the body constructed of the Kolas (digits)), Sarvasaktivinirmuktd (free from all Saktis), Sarvas- aktydsraydlrayd (the supporter of the supporter of all the Saktis ).

verses.sanskrit: अपूज्यपूजने चैव पूज्यानां चाप्यपूजने । नरः पापमवाप्नोति महद् वै नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: apūjyapūjane caiva pūjyānāṃ cāpyapūjane / naraḥ pāpamavāpnoti mahad vai nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Sarvd (all), Sarvesvari (goddess of all), Sukrtid (subtle), Sukfmajndnasvarupini (having the subtle knowledge as the form), Pradhdnapurufefd (goddess of Pradhana and Purusa), Isa (Controller), Mahddevaikasdkim (the sole witness of Mahadeva).
verses.hindi: उन देव शंकरने प्रणाम करनेवाले नन्दीके ऊपर कृपा करके उनका सिर सूँघा और केशवका आलिङ्गन किया। महादेवको देखकर प्रीतिसे विकसित आँखोंवाली उन देवीने उन ईश्वरके चरणोंमें सिरसे प्रणाम किया । तदनन्तर शंकरप्रिया पार्वतीने उन्हें विजयका समाचार कहा और (शंकरके) पार्श्वमें स्थित रहनेवाले भैरवने विनयपूर्वक विष्णुके माहात्म्यको भी (उन्हें) बताया। उस विजय (-के समाचार) तथा केशव विष्णुके पराक्रमको सुनकर
verses.wordMeaning: Sarvd (all), Sarvesvari (goddess of all), Sukrtid (subtle), Sukfmajndnasvarupini (having the subtle knowledge as the form), Pradhdnapurufefd (goddess of Pradhana and Purusa), Isa (Controller), Mahddevaikasdkim (the sole witness of Mahadeva).
verses.commentary: Sense: Sarvd (all), Sarvesvari (goddess of all), Sukrtid (subtle), Sukfmajndnasvarupini (having the subtle knowledge as the form), Pradhdnapurufefd (goddess of Pradhana and Purusa), Isa (Controller), Mahddevaikasdkim (the sole witness of Mahadeva).

verses.sanskrit: असतां प्रग्रहो यत्र सतां चैव विमानना । दण्डो देवकृतस्तत्र सद्यः पतति दारुणः
verses.transliteration: asatāṃ pragraho yatra satāṃ caiva vimānanā / daṇḍo devakṛtastatra sadyaḥ patati dāruṇaḥ
verses.translation: Saddsivd {Perpetually auspicious), Viyanm urti (having the ether as the form), Vedamurti (having the Vedas for her form) Amurtikd (Formless).
verses.hindi: शम्भु भगवान् शंकर देवी पार्वतीके साथ श्रेष्ठ आसनपर विराजमान हुए। तदनन्तर मरीचि आदि प्रमुख द्विज तथा सभी देवगण देवाधिदेव त्रिलोचनका दर्शन करनेके लिये मन्दराचलपर आये॥ १४१--१४५॥ जिन्होंने हैत्य (अन्धक)-की सेनाको पहले जीता था, वे श्रेष्ठ सौ देवियाँ भी ईशके दर्शनोंकी लालसासे वहाँ आयीं। चन्द्रमारूपी आभूषणसे विभूषित शंकरको देवी पार्वतीके साथ श्रेष्ठ आसनपर विराजमान देखकर
verses.wordMeaning: Saddsivd {Perpetually auspicious), Viyanm urti (having the ether as the form), Vedamurti (having the Vedas for her form) Amurtikd (Formless).
verses.commentary: Sense: Saddsivd {Perpetually auspicious), Viyanm urti (having the ether as the form), Vedamurti (having the Vedas for her form) Amurtikd (Formless).

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा तु विप्रर्षिः शशापेश्वरविद्विषः । समागतान् ब्राह्मणांस्तान् दक्षसाहाय्यकारिणः
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā tu viprarṣiḥ śaśāpeśvaravidviṣaḥ / samāgatān brāhmaṇāṃstān dakṣasāhāyyakāriṇaḥ
verses.translation: It had only two eyes and arms. It was gentle. It was embellished with blue forelocks. The soles of the feet were red like lotus. The hands resembling the tender sprouts were very red.
verses.hindi: (उन) देवियोंने आदरपूर्वक उन्हें प्रणाम किया और अत्यन्त प्रेमसे वे गान करने लगीं। पिनाकी (शंकर)- के वामभागमें स्थित देवी गिरिजा एवं शंकरके आसनपर उनके साथ विराजमान प्रसन्नचित्त नारायणको (उन देवियोंने) प्रणाम किया। देवी पार्वती और नारायणके साथ सिंहासनपर बैठे हुए देव शंकरको प्रणामकर उन श्रेष्ठ स्त्रियोंने पूछा-
verses.wordMeaning: It had only two eyes and arms. It was gentle. It was embellished with blue forelocks. The soles of the feet were red like lotus. The hands resembling the tender sprouts were very red.
verses.commentary: Sense: It had only two eyes and arms. It was gentle. It was embellished with blue forelocks. The soles of the feet were red like lotus. The hands resembling the tender sprouts were very red.

verses.sanskrit: यस्माद् बहिष्कृता वेदा भवद्भिः परमेश्वरः । विनिन्दितो महादेवः शङ्करो लोकवन्दितः
verses.transliteration: yasmād bahiṣkṛtā vedā bhavadbhiḥ parameśvaraḥ / vinindito mahādevaḥ śaṅkaro lokavanditaḥ
verses.translation: It was endowed with the glorious display of delicacy. The Tilaka on the forehead was bright. All the limbs bedecked with ornaments were very tender and beautiful.
verses.hindi: कन्याओं (देवियों )-ने कहा--अपनी कान्तिसे प्रकाशित होनेवाले आप कौन हैं? बाल सूर्यके समान आभावाली यह (बाला) कौन है? और कमलके समान विशाल नेत्रोंवाले एवं अपने शरीरके कारण शोभायमान यह कौन पुरुष है ?
verses.wordMeaning: It was endowed with the glorious display of delicacy. The Tilaka on the forehead was bright. All the limbs bedecked with ornaments were very tender and beautiful.
verses.commentary: Sense: It was endowed with the glorious display of delicacy. The Tilaka on the forehead was bright. All the limbs bedecked with ornaments were very tender and beautiful.

verses.sanskrit: भविष्यध्वं त्रयीबाह्याः सर्वे ऽपीश्वरविद्विषः । निन्दन्तो ह्यैश्वरं मार्गं कुशास्त्रासक्तमानसाः
verses.transliteration: bhaviṣyadhvaṃ trayībāhyāḥ sarve 'pīśvaravidviṣaḥ / nindanto hyaiśvaraṃ mārgaṃ kuśāstrāsaktamānasāḥ
verses.translation: The form was wearing a garland round its bosom. The garland was big and golden; light smile flickered on the bimba fruit like lips.'The anklets produced a tinkling sound.
verses.hindi: उनके वचन सुनकर श्रेष्ठ वृषभपर आरूढ़ होनेवाले सम्पूर्ण प्राणियोंके स्वामी, महायोगी अव्यय (शिव)-ने कहा--मैँ अपनेको नारायण तथा सनातन जगन्माता गौरी आदि अनेक रूपोंमें विभक्तकर स्थित रहनेवाला देव न मे विदुः परं तत्त्वं देवाद्या न महर्षयः ।
verses.wordMeaning: The form was wearing a garland round its bosom. The garland was big and golden; light smile flickered on the bimba fruit like lips.'The anklets produced a tinkling sound.
verses.commentary: Sense: The form was wearing a garland round its bosom. The garland was big and golden; light smile flickered on the bimba fruit like lips.'The anklets produced a tinkling sound.

verses.sanskrit: मिथ्याधीतसमाचारा मिथ्याज्ञानप्रलापिनः । प्राप्य घोरं कलियुगं कलिजैः किल पीडिताः
verses.transliteration: mithyādhītasamācārā mithyājñānapralāpinaḥ / prāpya ghoraṃ kaliyugaṃ kalijaiḥ kila pīḍitāḥ
verses.translation: You alone are the supreme bliss. You alone are the bestower of the greatest bliss. You are the imperishable firma¬ ment, the unsullied ethereal light.
verses.hindi: मेरे परम तत्त्वको न तो देवता आदि जानते हैं और एकोऽयं वेद विश्वात्मा भवानी विष्णुरेव च॥ १५३॥  न महर्षि। एकमात्र विश्वात्मा ये विष्णु और भवानी ही
verses.wordMeaning: You alone are the supreme bliss. You alone are the bestower of the greatest bliss. You are the imperishable firma¬ ment, the unsullied ethereal light.
verses.commentary: Sense: You alone are the supreme bliss. You alone are the bestower of the greatest bliss. You are the imperishable firma¬ ment, the unsullied ethereal light.

verses.sanskrit: त्यक्त्वा तपोबलं कृत्स्नं गच्छध्वं नरकान् पुनः । भविष्यति हृषीकेशः स्वाश्रितो ऽपि पराङ्मुखः
verses.transliteration: tyaktvā tapobalaṃ kṛtsnaṃ gacchadhvaṃ narakān punaḥ / bhaviṣyati hṛṣīkeśaḥ svāśrito 'pi parāṅmukhaḥ
verses.translation: You are the auspicious, subtle, eternal, omnipresent, great Brahman. You are Indra among all gods. You are Brahma among the knower of Brahman.
verses.hindi: अहं हि निष्क्रियः शान्तः केवलो निष्परिग्रहः । मामेव केशवं देवमाहुर्देवीमथाम्बिकाम् एष धाता विधाता च कारणं कार्यमेव च। कर्ता कारयिता विष्णुर्भुक्तिमुक्तिफलप्रदः
verses.wordMeaning: You are the auspicious, subtle, eternal, omnipresent, great Brahman. You are Indra among all gods. You are Brahma among the knower of Brahman.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are the auspicious, subtle, eternal, omnipresent, great Brahman. You are Indra among all gods. You are Brahma among the knower of Brahman.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा तु विप्रर्षिर्विरराम तपोनिधिः । जगाम मनसा रुद्रमशेषाघविनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā tu viprarṣirvirarāma taponidhiḥ / jagāma manasā rudramaśeṣāghavināśanam
verses.translation: O Goddess, you are Vayu (the wind god), among the powerful ones. You are Kumara (lord Karttikeya), among Yogins; among the sages, you are Vasistha and among the knowers of the Vedas, you are Vyasa.
verses.hindi: भोक्ता पुमानप्रमेयः संहर्ता कालरूपधृक् । स्रष्ठा पाता वासुदेवो विश्वात्मा विश्वतोमुखः कूटस्थो ह्यक्षरो व्यापी योगी नारायणः स्वयम्। तारकः पुरुषो ह्यात्मा केवलं परमं पदम्
verses.wordMeaning: O Goddess, you are Vayu (the wind god), among the powerful ones. You are Kumara (lord Karttikeya), among Yogins; among the sages, you are Vasistha and among the knowers of the Vedas, you are Vyasa.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Goddess, you are Vayu (the wind god), among the powerful ones. You are Kumara (lord Karttikeya), among Yogins; among the sages, you are Vasistha and among the knowers of the Vedas, you are Vyasa.

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे देवी महादेवं महेश्वरम् । पतिं पशुपतिं देवं ज्ञात्वैतत् प्राह सर्वदृक्
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare devī mahādevaṃ maheśvaram / patiṃ paśupatiṃ devaṃ jñātvaitat prāha sarvadṛk
verses.translation: Among the followers of the system of Saihkhya, you are lord Kapila; among the Rudras, you are Sankara; among the Adityas (sons of Aditi), you are Upendra (Visnu); among the Vasus, you are Pavaka (fire-god).
verses.hindi: तयाहं संगतो देव्या केवलो निष्कलः परः । पश्याम्यशेषमेवेदं यस्तद् वेद स मुच्यते तस्मादनादिमद्वैतं विष्णुमात्मानमी श्वरम्। एकमेव विजानीध्वं ततो यास्यथ निर्वृतिम्
verses.wordMeaning: Among the followers of the system of Saihkhya, you are lord Kapila; among the Rudras, you are Sankara; among the Adityas (sons of Aditi), you are Upendra (Visnu); among the Vasus, you are Pavaka (fire-god).
verses.commentary: Sense: Among the followers of the system of Saihkhya, you are lord Kapila; among the Rudras, you are Sankara; among the Adityas (sons of Aditi), you are Upendra (Visnu); among the Vasus, you are Pavaka (fire-god).

verses.sanskrit: देव्युवाच दक्षो यज्ञेन यजते पिता मे पूर्वजन्मनि । विनिन्द्य भवतो भावमात्मानं चापि शङ्कर
verses.transliteration: devyuvāca dakṣo yajñena yajate pitā me pūrvajanmani / vinindya bhavato bhāvamātmānaṃ cāpi śaṅkara
verses.translation: Among the Vedas, you are the Samaveda; among the metres, you are Gayatri; among lores, you are the spiritual science, (Adhyatma Vidya); among the goals, you are the ultimate goal (i.e. Salvation).
verses.hindi: मन्यन्ते विष्णुमव्यक्तमात्मानं श्रद्धयान्विताः । ये भिन्नदृष्ट्यापीशानं पूजयन्तो न मे प्रिया: पच्यमाना न मुच्यन्ते कल्पकोटिशतैरपि
verses.wordMeaning: Among the Vedas, you are the Samaveda; among the metres, you are Gayatri; among lores, you are the spiritual science, (Adhyatma Vidya); among the goals, you are the ultimate goal (i.e. Salvation).
verses.commentary: Sense: Among the Vedas, you are the Samaveda; among the metres, you are Gayatri; among lores, you are the spiritual science, (Adhyatma Vidya); among the goals, you are the ultimate goal (i.e. Salvation).

verses.sanskrit: देवाः सहर्षिभिश्चासंस्तत्र साहाय्यकारिणः । विनाशयाशु तं यज्ञं वरमेकं वृणोम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: devāḥ saharṣibhiścāsaṃstatra sāhāyyakāriṇaḥ / vināśayāśu taṃ yajñaṃ varamekaṃ vṛṇomyaham
verses.translation: Among all the Saktis (Potencies), you are Maya; among the calculators, you zx&Kala (Time); among all mystic secrets, you are Orhkdra and among the castes, the excellent Brahmana.
verses.hindi: तस्मादशेषभूतानां रक्षको विष्णुरव्ययः । यथावदिह विज्ञाय ध्येयः सर्वापदि प्रभुः श्रुत्वा भगवतो वाक्यं देव्यः सर्वगणेश्वराः । नेमुर्नारायणं देवं देवीं च हिमशैलजाम्
verses.wordMeaning: Among all the Saktis (Potencies), you are Maya; among the calculators, you zx&Kala (Time); among all mystic secrets, you are Orhkdra and among the castes, the excellent Brahmana.
verses.commentary: Sense: Among all the Saktis (Potencies), you are Maya; among the calculators, you zx&Kala (Time); among all mystic secrets, you are Orhkdra and among the castes, the excellent Brahmana.

verses.sanskrit: एवं विज्ञापितो देव्या देवो देववरः प्रभुः । ससर्ज सहसा रुद्रं दक्षयज्ञजिघांसया
verses.transliteration: evaṃ vijñāpito devyā devo devavaraḥ prabhuḥ / sasarja sahasā rudraṃ dakṣayajñajighāṃsayā
verses.translation: Among the Akamas (stages in life), you are the status called the householder; among Isvaras (deities) you are Mahesvara; among men, you are the on\y Purusa —male, abiding
verses.hindi: भवानीपादयुगले नारायणपदाम्बुजे ततो नारायणं देवं गणेशा मातरोऽपि च। न पश्यन्ति जगत्सूतिं तददभुतमिवाभवत्
verses.wordMeaning: Among the Akamas (stages in life), you are the status called the householder; among Isvaras (deities) you are Mahesvara; among men, you are the on\y Purusa —male, abiding
verses.commentary: Sense: Among the Akamas (stages in life), you are the status called the householder; among Isvaras (deities) you are Mahesvara; among men, you are the on\y Purusa —male, abiding

verses.sanskrit: सहस्त्रशीर्षपादं च सहस्त्राक्षं महाभुजम् । सहस्त्रपाणिं दुर्धर्षं युगान्तानलसन्निभम्
verses.transliteration: sahastraśīrṣapādaṃ ca sahastrākṣaṃ mahābhujam / sahastrapāṇiṃ durdharṣaṃ yugāntānalasannibham
verses.translation: O Goddess, among all the Upanisads, you are called Guhyopanisad, (v.l. Brahmopanisad)*; among the Kalpas, you are Isana and among the Yugas you are the Krta Yuga.
verses.hindi: (मुझे) जानते हैं। मैं ही निष्क्रिय, शान्त, अद्वितीय और परिग्रहशून्य हूँ। मुझे ही केशव, देव तथा देवी अम्बिका कहा जाता है ये विष्णु ही स्वयं धाता, विधाता, कारण, कार्य, कर्ता, कारयिता (कार्यके लिये प्रेरित करनेवाले) और भुक्ति तथा मुक्तिस्वरूप फलको प्रदान करनेवाले हैं। (ये ही) भोक्ता, अप्रमेय पुरुष, संहर्ता, कालका रूप
verses.wordMeaning: O Goddess, among all the Upanisads, you are called Guhyopanisad, (v.l. Brahmopanisad)*; among the Kalpas, you are Isana and among the Yugas you are the Krta Yuga.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Goddess, among all the Upanisads, you are called Guhyopanisad, (v.l. Brahmopanisad)*; among the Kalpas, you are Isana and among the Yugas you are the Krta Yuga.

verses.sanskrit: दंष्ट्राकरालं दुष्प्रेक्ष्यं शङ्खचक्रगदाधरम् । दण्डहस्तं महानादं शार्ङ्गिणं भूतिभूषणम्
verses.transliteration: daṃṣṭrākarālaṃ duṣprekṣyaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam / daṇḍahastaṃ mahānādaṃ śārṅgiṇaṃ bhūtibhūṣaṇam
verses.translation: Among all the paths, you are the solar path; among all the words (speeches), you are the goddess Sarasvati; among those of comely forms, you are Laksmi; among the wielders of Maya, you are Visnu.
verses.hindi: धारण करनेवाले, सृष्टि तथा पालन करनेवाले, विश्वात्मा, सर्वव्यापक, वासुदेव, कूटस्थ, अविनाशी, व्यापी, योगी, नारायण, तारक, पुरुष, आत्मा और अद्वितीय परम पद हैं॥ १५५--१५७॥ ये माहेश्वरी गौरी मेरी निरञ्जन शक्ति हैं। वेद
verses.wordMeaning: Among all the paths, you are the solar path; among all the words (speeches), you are the goddess Sarasvati; among those of comely forms, you are Laksmi; among the wielders of Maya, you are Visnu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Among all the paths, you are the solar path; among all the words (speeches), you are the goddess Sarasvati; among those of comely forms, you are Laksmi; among the wielders of Maya, you are Visnu.

verses.sanskrit: वीरभद्र इति ख्यातं देवदेवसमन्वितम् । स जातमात्रो देवेशमुपतस्थे कृताञ्जलिः
verses.transliteration: vīrabhadra iti khyātaṃ devadevasamanvitam / sa jātamātro deveśamupatasthe kṛtāñjaliḥ
verses.translation: Among the chaste women, you are Arundhati; among those who fly, you are Suparna (Garuda); among the hymns, you are the Puru$a Sukta and among Samans, you are the Jye$tha Soman.
verses.hindi: हैं। इन्हींसे यह सब उत्पन्न हुआ है और इन्हींमें लय भी हो जायगा। ये ही सभी प्राणियोंकी गतियोंमें उत्तम गति हैं इन्हीं देवीके साथ अद्वितीय, निष्कल तथा परमस्वरूप मैं इस सम्पूर्ण (विश्व)-का साक्षात्कार करता हूँ। जो इस (तत्त्व)-को जानता है, वह मुक्त हो जाता है। इसलिये अनादि, अद्वैत विष्णु और आत्मस्वरूप ईश्वर
verses.wordMeaning: Among the chaste women, you are Arundhati; among those who fly, you are Suparna (Garuda); among the hymns, you are the Puru$a Sukta and among Samans, you are the Jye$tha Soman.
verses.commentary: Sense: Among the chaste women, you are Arundhati; among those who fly, you are Suparna (Garuda); among the hymns, you are the Puru$a Sukta and among Samans, you are the Jye$tha Soman.

verses.sanskrit: तमाह दक्षस्य मखं विनाशय शिवोस्त्विति । विनिन्द्य मां स यजते गङ्गाद्वारे गणेश्वर
verses.transliteration: tamāha dakṣasya makhaṃ vināśaya śivostviti / vinindya māṃ sa yajate gaṅgādvāre gaṇeśvara
verses.translation: You are the Savitri Mantra, among all Japyas {Mantras to be repeated); among the Yajur Mantras, you are atamdriya', among the mountains you are the great Meru and among serpents, you are Ananta {Se$a).
verses.hindi: (शंकर)-को एक ही समझो। इससे तुम लोगोंको शान्ति विष्णुको भिन्न मानकर शिवकी पूजा करते हैं, वे मुझे प्रिय नहीं हैं। जो लोग जगतूको उत्पन्न करनेवाले (विष्णु)- से द्वेष रखते हैं (वे सभी) मोहित व्यक्ति रौरव आदि नरकोंमें पड़े रहते हैं और सैकड़ों करोड़ कल्पोंमें भी
verses.wordMeaning: You are the Savitri Mantra, among all Japyas {Mantras to be repeated); among the Yajur Mantras, you are atamdriya', among the mountains you are the great Meru and among serpents, you are Ananta {Se$a).
verses.commentary: Sense: You are the Savitri Mantra, among all Japyas {Mantras to be repeated); among the Yajur Mantras, you are atamdriya', among the mountains you are the great Meru and among serpents, you are Ananta {Se$a).

verses.sanskrit: ततो बन्धुप्रयुक्तेन सिंहेनैकेन लीलया । वीरभद्रेण दक्षस्य विनाशमगमत् क्रतुः
verses.transliteration: tato bandhuprayuktena siṃhenaikena līlayā / vīrabhadreṇa dakṣasya vināśamagamat kratuḥ
verses.translation: I seek refuge in that form alone which, those people, who have come to a definite conclusion by means of the perfect knowledge of Vedanta, observed as a source of the origin of the universe, and which is absolute bliss and is called Pranava (Om).
verses.hindi: मुक्त नहीं होते। इसलिये सम्पूर्ण प्राणियोंके रक्षक अव्यय विष्णुको भलीभाँति समझकर समस्त आपत्तियोंमें उन प्रभुका ध्यान करना चाहिए सभी देवियों और गणेश्वरोंने भगवान्के वाक्यको सुनकर नारायण देव तथा हिमालयकी पुत्री देवी (पार्वती) - को प्रणाम किया और भक्तजनोंके प्रिय ईशान भगवान् शंकर तथा भवानीके चरणयुगल एवं नारायणके चरणकमलोंमें
verses.wordMeaning: I seek refuge in that form alone which, those people, who have come to a definite conclusion by means of the perfect knowledge of Vedanta, observed as a source of the origin of the universe, and which is absolute bliss and is called Pranava (Om).
verses.commentary: Sense: I seek refuge in that form alone which, those people, who have come to a definite conclusion by means of the perfect knowledge of Vedanta, observed as a source of the origin of the universe, and which is absolute bliss and is called Pranava (Om).

verses.sanskrit: मन्युना चोमया सृष्टा भद्रकाली महेश्वरी । तया च सार्धं वृषभं समारुह्य ययौ गणः
verses.transliteration: manyunā comayā sṛṣṭā bhadrakālī maheśvarī / tayā ca sārdhaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ samāruhya yayau gaṇaḥ
verses.translation: I am bowing to that form which has entered the inner core of all living beings, which is the cause of the union and separation of the Pradhana and Puru$a, which is resplendent, which is devoid of birth and destruction and which is termed as Prana (vital breath).
verses.hindi: भक्तिकी प्रार्थना की। तदनन्तर गणेश्वरों और मातृदेवियोंने जगतको उत्पन्न करनेवाले नारायण देवको नहीं देखा यह एक आश्चर्य-जैसा ही हुआ तदन्तरे महाहैत्यो हान्थको मन्मथार्दितः। मोहितो गिरिजां देवीमाहर्तु गिरिमाययौ
verses.wordMeaning: I am bowing to that form which has entered the inner core of all living beings, which is the cause of the union and separation of the Pradhana and Puru$a, which is resplendent, which is devoid of birth and destruction and which is termed as Prana (vital breath).
verses.commentary: Sense: I am bowing to that form which has entered the inner core of all living beings, which is the cause of the union and separation of the Pradhana and Puru$a, which is resplendent, which is devoid of birth and destruction and which is termed as Prana (vital breath).

verses.sanskrit: अन्ये सहस्त्रशो रुद्रा निसृष्टास्तेन धीमता । रोमजा इति विख्यातास्तस्य साहाय्यकारिणः
verses.transliteration: anye sahastraśo rudrā nisṛṣṭāstena dhīmatā / romajā iti vikhyātāstasya sāhāyyakāriṇaḥ
verses.translation: I pay obeisance unto the form designated as Puru$a —a form which has neither beginning nor end, which is the soul of the universe and which is stationed separately and beyond Prakrti, which is the supreme soul and of unmanifest body.
verses.hindi: अथानन्तवपुः श्रीमान् योगी नारायणोऽमलः । तत्रैवाविरभूद् हैत्यैर्युद्धाय पुरुषोत्तमः युद्धाय विष्णुं गणदेवमुख्यैः । शिलादपुत्रेण च मातृकाभिः
verses.wordMeaning: I pay obeisance unto the form designated as Puru$a —a form which has neither beginning nor end, which is the soul of the universe and which is stationed separately and beyond Prakrti, which is the supreme soul and of unmanifest body.
verses.commentary: Sense: I pay obeisance unto the form designated as Puru$a —a form which has neither beginning nor end, which is the soul of the universe and which is stationed separately and beyond Prakrti, which is the supreme soul and of unmanifest body.

verses.sanskrit: शूलशक्तिगदाहस्ताष्टङ्कोपलकरास्तथा । कालाग्निरुद्रसंकाशा नादयन्तो दिशो दश
verses.transliteration: śūlaśaktigadāhastāṣṭaṅkopalakarāstathā / kālāgnirudrasaṃkāśā nādayanto diśo daśa
verses.translation: I salute to your form which has no difference of colour or form, which is the support of everything; which fashions the entire universe, which is omnipresent, devoid of birth or death; which is subtle, variegated, and which possesses three gunas and is called Pradhana.
verses.hindi: स कालरुद्रोऽभिजगाम देवः स देवदेवः प्रययौ पुरस्तात्।
verses.wordMeaning: I salute to your form which has no difference of colour or form, which is the support of everything; which fashions the entire universe, which is omnipresent, devoid of birth or death; which is subtle, variegated, and which possesses three gunas and is called Pradhana.
verses.commentary: Sense: I salute to your form which has no difference of colour or form, which is the support of everything; which fashions the entire universe, which is omnipresent, devoid of birth or death; which is subtle, variegated, and which possesses three gunas and is called Pradhana.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे वृषासनारूढाः सभार्याश्चातिभीषणाः । समावृत्य गणश्रेष्ठं ययुर्दक्षमखं प्रति
verses.transliteration: sarve vṛṣāsanārūḍhāḥ sabhāryāścātibhīṣaṇāḥ / samāvṛtya gaṇaśreṣṭhaṃ yayurdakṣamakhaṃ prati
verses.translation: O Goddess, I bow unto your form which is the first great one, called Purufa, which is stationed in Prakrti, which is a seed with the three gums of the Atman, which is endowed with all contradictory attributes like prosperity and perfect knowledge (v.l. detachment and Dharma).
verses.hindi: जगाम देवोऽपि सहस्त्रबाहुः रराज मध्ये भगवान् सुराणां
verses.wordMeaning: O Goddess, I bow unto your form which is the first great one, called Purufa, which is stationed in Prakrti, which is a seed with the three gums of the Atman, which is endowed with all contradictory attributes like prosperity and perfect knowledge (v.l. detachment and Dharma).
verses.commentary: Sense: O Goddess, I bow unto your form which is the first great one, called Purufa, which is stationed in Prakrti, which is a seed with the three gums of the Atman, which is endowed with all contradictory attributes like prosperity and perfect knowledge (v.l. detachment and Dharma).

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे शंप्राप्य तं देशं गङ्गाद्वारमिति श्रुतम् । ददृशुर्यज्ञदेशं तं दक्षस्यामिततेजसः
verses.transliteration: sarve śaṃprāpya taṃ deśaṃ gaṅgādvāramiti śrutam / dadṛśuryajñadeśaṃ taṃ dakṣasyāmitatejasaḥ
verses.translation: I pay respect unto your form which is termed as ■"the Cosmic Egg" which consists of twice seven (i.e. fourteen) worlds, and is stationed in waters, which consists of wonderful varieties, the only Lord of which is Purusa and which is occu¬ pied by different (v.l. innumerable beings).
verses.hindi: स्त्रिलोक दृष्टि्भगवानिवार्कः जगत्यनादिर्भगवानमेयो पपात देवोपरि पुष्पवृष्टिः १७३॥
verses.wordMeaning: I pay respect unto your form which is termed as ■"the Cosmic Egg" which consists of twice seven (i.e. fourteen) worlds, and is stationed in waters, which consists of wonderful varieties, the only Lord of which is Purusa and which is occu¬ pied by different (v.l.…
verses.commentary: Sense: I pay respect unto your form which is termed as ■"the Cosmic Egg" which consists of twice seven (i.e. fourteen) worlds, and is stationed in waters, which consists of wonderful varieties, the only Lord of which is Purusa and which is occu¬ pied by different (v.l.…

verses.sanskrit: देवाङ्गनासहस्त्राढ्यमप्सरोगीतनादितम् । वीणावेणुनिनादाढ्यं वेदवादाभिनादितम्
verses.transliteration: devāṅganāsahastrāḍhyamapsarogītanāditam / vīṇāveṇuninādāḍhyaṃ vedavādābhināditam
verses.translation: I bow unto your form named Paramesthin which it stationed in the solar sphere, is the cause of the three units of time (the past, the present and the future), which is theembodi- ment of all the Vedas, which is the only one and the earliest and which has fully enveloped all the different worlds by your brilliance.
verses.hindi: समावृतं देवरिपुर्गणेशैः । युयोध शक्रेण समातृकाभि- समाययौ यत्र स कालरुद्रो
verses.wordMeaning: I bow unto your form named Paramesthin which it stationed in the solar sphere, is the cause of the three units of time (the past, the present and the future), which is theembodi- ment of all the Vedas,…
verses.commentary: Sense: I bow unto your form named Paramesthin which it stationed in the solar sphere, is the cause of the three units of time (the past, the present and the future), which is theembodi- ment of all the Vedas,…

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा सहर्षिभिर्देवैः समासीनं प्रजापतिम् । उवाच भद्रया रुद्रैर्वोरभद्रः स्मयन्निव
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā saharṣibhirdevaiḥ samāsīnaṃ prajāpatim / uvāca bhadrayā rudrairvorabhadraḥ smayanniva
verses.translation: I bow unto the form of yours termed as Narayana which has a thousand heads and thousand arms, which is of infinite power, which is the ancient Purufa reposing within the cosmic waters.
verses.hindi: दृष्ट्रान्धकं समायान्तं भगवान् गरुडध्वजः । व्याजहार महादेवं भेरवं भूतिभूषणम् हन्तुमर्हसि हैत्येशमन्धकं लोककण्टकम् । त्वामृते भगवान् शक्तो हन्ता नान्योऽस्य विद्यते
verses.wordMeaning: I bow unto the form of yours termed as Narayana which has a thousand heads and thousand arms, which is of infinite power, which is the ancient Purufa reposing within the cosmic waters.
verses.commentary: Sense: I bow unto the form of yours termed as Narayana which has a thousand heads and thousand arms, which is of infinite power, which is the ancient Purufa reposing within the cosmic waters.

verses.sanskrit: वयं ह्यनुचराः सर्वे शर्वस्यामिततेजसः । भागाभिलप्सया प्राप्ता भागान् यच्छध्वमीप्सितान्
verses.transliteration: vayaṃ hyanucarāḥ sarve śarvasyāmitatejasaḥ / bhāgābhilapsayā prāptā bhāgān yacchadhvamīpsitān
verses.translation: I pay my respects unto your form designated as Kdla (death or time), which is terrible due to its curved fangs, which is worthy of being worshipped by gods, which has the form of the world-destructive fire at the close ofYugas and which is the cause of destruction of the entire universe.
verses.hindi: त्य हर्ता सर्वलोकानां कालात्मा हौश्वरी तनु: । स्तूयते विविधैर्मचैरवेदविद्धिर्बिचक्षणै: इसी बीच कामदेवके द्वारा पीडित महाहैत्य अन्धक मोहित होता हुआ देवी गिरिजाको हरण करनेके लिये पर्वतपर आया
verses.wordMeaning: I pay my respects unto your form designated as Kdla (death or time), which is terrible due to its curved fangs, which is worthy of being worshipped by gods,…
verses.commentary: Sense: I pay my respects unto your form designated as Kdla (death or time), which is terrible due to its curved fangs, which is worthy of being worshipped by gods,…

verses.sanskrit: अथ चेत् कस्यचिदियमाज्ञा मुनिसुरोत्तमाः । भागो भवद्भ्यो देयस्तु नास्मभ्यमिति कथ्यताम् । तं ब्रूताज्ञापयति यो वेत्स्यामो हि वयं ततः
verses.transliteration: atha cet kasyacidiyamājñā munisurottamāḥ / bhāgo bhavadbhyo deyastu nāsmabhyamiti kathyatām / taṃ brūtājñāpayati yo vetsyāmo hi vayaṃ tataḥ
verses.translation: I bow unto your form called Sesa which shines with its thousand hoods, which is being worshipped even by the chiefs of serpents and on which sleeping Janardana is reposing.
verses.hindi: इसके बाद विराट्शरीरधारी, श्रीमान्, योगी, निर्मल नारायण पुरुषोत्तम हैत्योंसे युद्ध करनेके लिये वहीं प्रकट हो गये। तदनन्तर वे कालरुद्रदेव भगवान् विष्णुको अपने पार्श्वमें करके तथा मुख्य गणदेवों, शिलादपुत्र नन्दी और मातृकाओंको साथ लेकर युद्धके लिये स्वयं गये। अग्निके समान त्रिशूलको लेकर वे देवदेव (शंकर) आगे-आगे चले। उन श्रेष्ठ गणराजों तथा हजार बाहुवाले देव (विष्णु)-ने भी उनका अनुगमन
verses.wordMeaning: I bow unto your form called Sesa which shines with its thousand hoods, which is being worshipped even by the chiefs of serpents and on which sleeping Janardana is reposing.
verses.commentary: Sense: I bow unto your form called Sesa which shines with its thousand hoods, which is being worshipped even by the chiefs of serpents and on which sleeping Janardana is reposing.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्ता गणेशेन प्रजापतिपुरः सराः । देवा ऊचुर्यज्ञभागे न च मन्त्रा इति प्रभुम्
verses.transliteration: evamuktā gaṇeśena prajāpatipuraḥ sarāḥ / devā ūcuryajñabhāge na ca mantrā iti prabhum
verses.translation: I bow down to your form termed Rudra which possesses unobstructed glory, which has the odd number (i.e. three) of eyes, which is the sole knower of the taste of nectar of the bliss of Brahman and which surviving even after the end of Yugas, dances in the heavens.
verses.hindi: किया। देवताओंके बीचमें उस समय मेघके समान वर्णवाले गरुडवाहन भगवान् विष्णु उसी प्रकार सुशोभित हो रहे थे, जिस प्रकार सुमेरु पर्वतके शिखरपर आरूढ तीनों लोकोंके नेत्र-स्वरूप भगवान् सूर्य सुशोभित होते अनादि, अमेय त्रिशूलपाणि भगवान् हर हजारों स्वरूप धारणकर पृथ्वीपर प्रकट हुए। (उस समय) आकाशमें सुन्दर शब्द होने लगा तथा उन देवके ऊपर (आकाशसे) पुष्पवृष्टि होने लगी। गणेश्वरोंके राजा
verses.wordMeaning: I bow down to your form termed Rudra which possesses unobstructed glory, which has the odd number (i.e. three) of eyes, which is the sole knower of the taste of nectar of the bliss of Brahman and which surviving even after the end of Yugas, dances in the heavens.
verses.commentary: Sense: I bow down to your form termed Rudra which possesses unobstructed glory, which has the odd number (i.e. three) of eyes, which is the sole knower of the taste of nectar of the bliss of Brahman and which surviving even after the end of Yugas, dances in the heavens.

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्रा ऊचुः सुरान् यूयं तमोपहतचेतसः । ये नाध्वरस्य राजानं पूजयध्वं महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: mantrā ūcuḥ surān yūyaṃ tamopahatacetasaḥ / ye nādhvarasya rājānaṃ pūjayadhvaṃ maheśvaram
verses.translation: O Bhavani, I bow unto this delicate, white-com- plexioned form of yours, devoid of sorrow and without any definite shape (v.l. free from impurities and sanctifying). O Goddess with lotus-like tender feet worshipped by gods and Asuras, you shine in your purity and tenderness.
verses.hindi: शिवको गणेश्वरोंद्वारा घिरे हुए आते देखकर देवशत्रु अन्धक, इन्द्र तथा मातृकाओं, गणों और सभी प्रधान- प्रधान देवताओंके साथ युद्ध करने लगा। अपने बाहुबलसे युद्धमें सभीको जीतकर वह सत्त्वविहीन (अन्धक) अनन्त तेजस्वी शम्भुके समीप गया, जहाँ वे कालरुद्र विमानपर बैठे हुए थे। अन्धकको आते हुए देखकर भगवान् गरुडध्वजने विभूतिसे सुशोभित भैरव महादेवसे कहा-- ॥ १७३--१७६ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: O Bhavani, I bow unto this delicate, white-com- plexioned form of yours, devoid of sorrow and without any definite shape (v.l. free from impurities and sanctifying). O Goddess with lotus-like tender feet worshipped by gods and Asuras, you shine in your purity and tenderness.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Bhavani, I bow unto this delicate, white-com- plexioned form of yours, devoid of sorrow and without any definite shape (v.l. free from impurities and sanctifying). O Goddess with lotus-like tender feet worshipped by gods and Asuras, you shine in your purity and tenderness.

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वरः सर्वभूतानां सर्वभूततनुर्हरः । पूज्यते सर्वयज्ञेषु सर्वाभ्युदसिद्धिदः
verses.transliteration: īśvaraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ sarvabhūtatanurharaḥ / pūjyate sarvayajñeṣu sarvābhyudasiddhidaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance be to you, O great Goddess. Saluta-
verses.hindi: (भगवन्!) आप संसारके कण्टकरूप हैत्यपति अन्धकको मारनेमें समर्थ हैं। आपको छोड़कर इसे मारनेमें और कोई दूसरा समर्थ नहीं है। आप सभी लोकोंका संहार करनेवाले ईश्वरके कालमय शरीर हैं। वेदोंको जाननेवाले दिद्वानोंके द्वारा विविध मन्त्रॉसे आपकी स्तुति की जाती है
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance be to you, O great Goddess. Saluta-
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance be to you, O great Goddess. Saluta-

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्ता अपीशानं मायया नष्टचेतसः । न मेनिरे ययुर्मन्त्रा देवान् मुक्त्वा स्वमालयम्
verses.transliteration: evamuktā apīśānaṃ māyayā naṣṭacetasaḥ / na menire yayurmantrā devān muktvā svamālayam
verses.translation: I am identical with you, and I am having you as my support. You alone are my goal. I seek refuge in you alone. O Supreme Goddess, be gracious unto me.
verses.hindi: स वासुदेवस्य वचो निशम्य भगवान् हर: । निरीक्ष्य विष्णुं हनने हैत्येन्द्रस्य मतिं दधौ जगाम देवतानीकं गणानां हर्षमुत्तमम्। स्तुवन्ति भेरवं देवमन्तरिक्षचरा जना:
verses.wordMeaning: I am identical with you, and I am having you as my support. You alone are my goal. I seek refuge in you alone. O Supreme Goddess, be gracious unto me.
verses.commentary: Sense: I am identical with you, and I am having you as my support. You alone are my goal. I seek refuge in you alone. O Supreme Goddess, be gracious unto me.

verses.sanskrit: ततः स रुद्रो भगवान् सभार्यः सगणेश्वरः । स्पृशन् कराभ्यां ब्रह्मर्षि दधीचं प्राह देवताः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa rudro bhagavān sabhāryaḥ sagaṇeśvaraḥ / spṛśan karābhyāṃ brahmarṣi dadhīcaṃ prāha devatāḥ
verses.translation: In this world, neither Devas nor Danavas are equal to me since, thanks to my penance, the mother of the universe herself has been born as my daughter.
verses.hindi: जयानन्त महादेव कालमूर्ते सनातन। त्वमग्निः सर्वभूतानामन्तश्चरसि नित्यशः त्वं यज्ञस्त्वं वषदकारस्त्वं धाता हरिरव्ययः । त्वं ब्रह्मा त्वं महादेवस्त्वं धाम परमं पदम्
verses.wordMeaning: In this world, neither Devas nor Danavas are equal to me since, thanks to my penance, the mother of the universe herself has been born as my daughter.
verses.commentary: Sense: In this world, neither Devas nor Danavas are equal to me since, thanks to my penance, the mother of the universe herself has been born as my daughter.

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्राः प्रमाणं न कृता युष्माभिर्बलगर्वितैः । यस्मात् प्रसह्य तस्माद् वो नाशयाम्यद्य गर्वितम्
verses.transliteration: mantrāḥ pramāṇaṃ na kṛtā yuṣmābhirbalagarvitaiḥ / yasmāt prasahya tasmād vo nāśayāmyadya garvitam
verses.translation: O Goddess, this Mena, the daughter of the Pitrs, has become your mother, although you are the mother of the entire universe. O how glorious is my merit!*
verses.hindi: ओढङ्कारमूर्तिर्योगात्मा त्रयीनेत्रस्त्रिलोचनः। महाविभूतिर्दवेशो जयाशेषजगत्पते ततः कालाग्निरुद्रोऽसौ गृहीत्वान्धकमीश्वरः । त्रिशूलाग्रेषु विन्यस्य प्रननर्त सतां गतिः
verses.wordMeaning: O Goddess, this Mena, the daughter of the Pitrs, has become your mother, although you are the mother of the entire universe. O how glorious is my merit!*
verses.commentary: Sense: O Goddess, this Mena, the daughter of the Pitrs, has become your mother, although you are the mother of the entire universe. O how glorious is my merit!*

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा यज्ञशालां तां ददाह गणपुङ्गवः । गणेश्वराश्च संक्रुद्धा यूपानुत्पाट्य चिक्षिपुः
verses.transliteration: ityuktvā yajñaśālāṃ tāṃ dadāha gaṇapuṅgavaḥ / gaṇeśvarāśca saṃkruddhā yūpānutpāṭya cikṣipuḥ
verses.translation: O Goddess of the immortal Devas, protect me for ever, along with Mena. I bow unto your lotus-like feet. I seek refuge in Siva (v.l. Sivam i.e. in you who are the consort of Siva).
verses.hindi: दृष्टरान्धकं देवगणाः शूलप्रोतं पितामहः । प्रणेमुरीश्वरं देवं भेरवं भवमोचकम् अन्तरिक्षेऽप्सरः सङ्का नृत्यन्ति स्म मनोरमा:
verses.wordMeaning: O Goddess of the immortal Devas, protect me for ever, along with Mena. I bow unto your lotus-like feet. I seek refuge in Siva (v.l. Sivam i.e. in you who are the consort of Siva).
verses.commentary: Sense: O Goddess of the immortal Devas, protect me for ever, along with Mena. I bow unto your lotus-like feet. I seek refuge in Siva (v.l. Sivam i.e. in you who are the consort of Siva).

verses.sanskrit: प्रस्तोत्रा सह होत्रा च अश्वं चैव गणेश्वराः । गृहीत्वा भीषणाः सर्वे गङ्गास्त्रोतसि चिक्षिपुः
verses.transliteration: prastotrā saha hotrā ca aśvaṃ caiva gaṇeśvarāḥ / gṛhītvā bhīṣaṇāḥ sarve gaṅgāstrotasi cikṣipuḥ
verses.translation: Ah! This is my great fortune due to my association with the great Goddess. O Mahadevi, command me what I should do, O Sahkari (consort of Sankara).
verses.hindi: संस्थापितोऽथ शूलाग्रे सोऽन्धको दग्धकिल्बिषः। कालं कविं योगवियोगहेतुम्
verses.wordMeaning: Ah! This is my great fortune due to my association with the great Goddess. O Mahadevi, command me what I should do, O Sahkari (consort of Sankara).
verses.commentary: Sense: Ah! This is my great fortune due to my association with the great Goddess. O Mahadevi, command me what I should do, O Sahkari (consort of Sankara).

verses.sanskrit: वीरभद्रो ऽपि दीप्तात्मा शक्रस्योद्यच्छतः करम् । व्यष्टम्भयददीनात्मा तथान्येषां दिवौकसाम्
verses.transliteration: vīrabhadro 'pi dīptātmā śakrasyodyacchataḥ karam / vyaṣṭambhayadadīnātmā tathānyeṣāṃ divaukasām
verses.translation: After speaking these words, the Lord of mountains, Himavan stood by the side of Girija (Parvati) looking at her with palms joined in reverence.
verses.hindi: दंष्ट्राकरालं दिवि नृत्यमानं हुताशवक्त्रं ज्वलनार्करूपम्।
verses.wordMeaning: After speaking these words, the Lord of mountains, Himavan stood by the side of Girija (Parvati) looking at her with palms joined in reverence.
verses.commentary: Sense: After speaking these words, the Lord of mountains, Himavan stood by the side of Girija (Parvati) looking at her with palms joined in reverence.

verses.sanskrit: भगस्य नेत्रे चोत्पाट्य करजाग्रेण लीलया । निहत्य मुष्टिना दन्तान् पूष्णश्चैवमपातयत्
verses.transliteration: bhagasya netre cotpāṭya karajāgreṇa līlayā / nihatya muṣṭinā dantān pūṣṇaścaivamapātayat
verses.translation: Then, on hearing his words and remembering her consort Pasupati (God Sankara) Parvati the Arani (the kindling piece of wood i.e. the cause of the origin) of the universe, smilingly spoke to her father.
verses.hindi: वासुदेवका वचन सुनकर उन भगवान् हरने विष्णुकी ओर देखकर हैत्येन्द्र अन्धकको मारनेका विचार किया, गणोंका हर्ष बढ़ाते हुए वे करनेवाले लोग भैरवदेवको (इस प्रकार) स्तुति करने लगे
verses.wordMeaning: Then, on hearing his words and remembering her consort Pasupati (God Sankara) Parvati the Arani (the kindling piece of wood i.e. the cause of the origin) of the universe, smilingly spoke to her father.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then, on hearing his words and remembering her consort Pasupati (God Sankara) Parvati the Arani (the kindling piece of wood i.e. the cause of the origin) of the universe, smilingly spoke to her father.

verses.sanskrit: तथा चन्द्रमसं देवं पादाङ्गुष्ठेन लीलया । धर्षयामास बलवान् स्मयमानो गणेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: tathā candramasaṃ devaṃ pādāṅguṣṭhena līlayā / dharṣayāmāsa balavān smayamāno gaṇeśvaraḥ
verses.translation: "O excellent one among the mountains, at the outset, listen to this secret instruction regarding Isvara, It is resorted to by the expounders of Brahman.
verses.hindi: अनन्त! महादेव! आप सनातन हैं, कालकी मूर्ति हैं, आपकी जय हो। आप अग्निरूप और सभी प्राणियोंके भीतर सहैव निवास करनेवाले हैं। आप ही यज्ञ, आप ही वषट्कार और आप ही धाता अव्यय हरि हैं। आप ही ब्रह्मा, महादेव और आप ही तेजःस्वरूप परमपद हैं। (आप) प्रणवमूर्ति, योगात्मा, वेदत्रयीरूप तीन नेत्रवाले त्रिलोचन हैं। आप महाविभूतिस्वरूप, देवताओंके स्वामी हैं। है सम्पूर्ण
verses.wordMeaning: "O excellent one among the mountains, at the outset, listen to this secret instruction regarding Isvara, It is resorted to by the expounders of Brahman.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O excellent one among the mountains, at the outset, listen to this secret instruction regarding Isvara, It is resorted to by the expounders of Brahman.

verses.sanskrit: वह्नेर्हस्तद्वयं छित्त्वा जिह्वामुत्पाट्य लीलया । जघान मूर्ध्नि पादेन मुनीनपि मुनीश्वराः
verses.transliteration: vahnerhastadvayaṃ chittvā jihvāmutpāṭya līlayā / jaghāna mūrdhni pādena munīnapi munīśvarāḥ
verses.translation: O father, with unswerving single-minded devotion, you resort only to that form (of mine) and worship it
verses.hindi: संसारके स्वामी! आपको जय हो तदनन्तर सज्जनोंके आश्रयस्थान एवं प्रलयकालीन अग्निके समान भयंकर वे ईश्वर अन्धक हैत्यको पकड़कर अपने त्रिशूलके अग्रभागमें रखकर नाचने लगे। त्रिशूलपर पिरोये हुए अन्धकको देखकर पितामह
verses.wordMeaning: O father, with unswerving single-minded devotion, you resort only to that form (of mine) and worship it
verses.commentary: Sense: O father, with unswerving single-minded devotion, you resort only to that form (of mine) and worship it

verses.sanskrit: तथा विष्णुं सहरुडं समायान्तं महाबलः । विव्याध निशेतैर्बाणैः स्तम्भयित्वा सुदर्शनम्
verses.transliteration: tathā viṣṇuṃ saharuḍaṃ samāyāntaṃ mahābalaḥ / vivyādha niśetairbāṇaiḥ stambhayitvā sudarśanam
verses.translation: Visualise only that one (form) mentally. Meditate on it, worship that, according to my instructions. I shall relieve you of your worldly existence {Sarhsara) and sufferings, O sin¬ less one.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मा तथा देवगण, संसारसागरसे मुक्त करनेवाले भैेरवदेवको प्रणाम करने लगे मुनि तथा सिद्धजन स्तुति करने लगे और गन्धर्व, किन्नर गान करने लगे तथा अन्तरिक्षमें रमणीय अप्सराओंके समूह नृत्य करने लगे। तदनन्तर त्रिशूलके अग्रभागमें स्थापित उस अन्धकके सभी पाप दग्ध
verses.wordMeaning: Visualise only that one (form) mentally. Meditate on it, worship that, according to my instructions. I shall relieve you of your worldly existence {Sarhsara) and sufferings, O sin¬ less one.
verses.commentary: Sense: Visualise only that one (form) mentally. Meditate on it, worship that, according to my instructions. I shall relieve you of your worldly existence {Sarhsara) and sufferings, O sin¬ less one.

verses.sanskrit: समालोक्य महाबाहुरागत्य गरुडो गणम् । जघान पक्षैः सहसा ननादाम्बुनिधिर्यथा
verses.transliteration: samālokya mahābāhurāgatya garuḍo gaṇam / jaghāna pakṣaiḥ sahasā nanādāmbunidhiryathā
verses.translation: Ere long I shall lift you up from the ocean ofworldly existence—you who have resorted to the divine Yoga by means of deep devotion.*
verses.hindi: (नष्ट) हो गये, उसे सम्पूर्ण ज्ञान प्रात हो गया और वह परमेश्वरकी स्तुति करने लगा-- अन्थकने ( स्तुति करते हुए) कहा समाधिमें
verses.wordMeaning: Ere long I shall lift you up from the ocean ofworldly existence—you who have resorted to the divine Yoga by means of deep devotion.*
verses.commentary: Sense: Ere long I shall lift you up from the ocean ofworldly existence—you who have resorted to the divine Yoga by means of deep devotion.*

verses.sanskrit: ततः सहस्त्रशो भद्रः ससर्ज गरुडान् स्वयम् । वैनतेयादभ्यधिकान् गरुडं ते प्रदुद्रुवुः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sahastraśo bhadraḥ sasarja garuḍān svayam / vainateyādabhyadhikān garuḍaṃ te pradudruvuḥ
verses.translation: O excellent mountain, I am attainable to you only through meditation, the path of desireless action, of devotion and of spiritual knowledge, but not otherwise through crores of ritualistic acts.
verses.hindi: स्वरूप, कालरूप, कवि तथा संयोग एवं वियोगके कारणरूप ईश्वर-तत्त्वको जानते हैं, मैं उन अद्वितीय भगवानको सिरसे प्रणाम करता हूँ। भयंकर दाढ़ोंवाले, आकाशमें नृत्य करते हुए, अग्निके समान मुखवाले, प्रज्वलित सूर्यके समान स्वरूपवाले, हजारों पैर, आँख तथा सिरोंसे युक्त आप अद्वितीय रुद्रको मैं प्रणाम करता हूँ
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent mountain, I am attainable to you only through meditation, the path of desireless action, of devotion and of spiritual knowledge, but not otherwise through crores of ritualistic acts.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent mountain, I am attainable to you only through meditation, the path of desireless action, of devotion and of spiritual knowledge, but not otherwise through crores of ritualistic acts.

verses.sanskrit: तान् दृष्ट्वा गरुडो धीमान् पलायत महाजवः । विसृज्य माधवं वेगात् तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्
verses.transliteration: tān dṛṣṭvā garuḍo dhīmān palāyata mahājavaḥ / visṛjya mādhavaṃ vegāt tadadbhutamivābhavat
verses.translation: For the sake of liberation for Sarhsara, carry out properly forever all the duties prescribed in Srutis and Smrtis. Do them well—the rites and duties meant for the four castes and stages of life, in combination with spiritual knowledge.
verses.hindi: जयादिदेवामरपूजिताडच्े त्वमग्निरेको बहुधाभिपूज्यसे
verses.wordMeaning: For the sake of liberation for Sarhsara, carry out properly forever all the duties prescribed in Srutis and Smrtis. Do them well—the rites and duties meant for the four castes and stages of life, in combination with spiritual knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: For the sake of liberation for Sarhsara, carry out properly forever all the duties prescribed in Srutis and Smrtis. Do them well—the rites and duties meant for the four castes and stages of life, in combination with spiritual knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: अन्तर्हिते वैनतेये भगवान् पद्मसंभवः । आगत्य वारयामास वीरभद्रं च केशवम्
verses.transliteration: antarhite vainateye bhagavān padmasaṃbhavaḥ / āgatya vārayāmāsa vīrabhadraṃ ca keśavam
verses.translation: It is from Dharma that Bhakti {devotion) is generated. The supreme goal viz. Brahman is attained through Bhakti. Dharma is the activity like the performance of sacrifices and other duties prescribed in the Srutis and Smrtis.
verses.hindi: वाय्वादिभेहैररि्रिलात्मरूप त्वामेकमाहुः पुरुषं पुराण-
verses.wordMeaning: It is from Dharma that Bhakti {devotion) is generated. The supreme goal viz. Brahman is attained through Bhakti. Dharma is the activity like the performance of sacrifices and other duties prescribed in the Srutis and Smrtis.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is from Dharma that Bhakti {devotion) is generated. The supreme goal viz. Brahman is attained through Bhakti. Dharma is the activity like the performance of sacrifices and other duties prescribed in the Srutis and Smrtis.

verses.sanskrit: प्रसादयामास च तं गौरवात् परमेष्ठिनः । संस्तूय भगवानीशः साम्बस्तत्रागमत् स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: prasādayāmāsa ca taṃ gauravāt parameṣṭhinaḥ / saṃstūya bhagavānīśaḥ sāmbastatrāgamat svayam
verses.translation: Dharma does not arise out of anything else. It is from the Vedas that the Dharma shines forth. Hence, one who is desirous ofliberation and who seeks Dharma should resort to the Vedas which are my embodiment.
verses.hindi: त्वमन्तको योगिगणाभिजुष्टः एकोऽन्तरात्मा बहुधा निविष्टो
verses.wordMeaning: Dharma does not arise out of anything else. It is from the Vedas that the Dharma shines forth. Hence, one who is desirous ofliberation and who seeks Dharma should resort to the Vedas which are my embodiment.
verses.commentary: Sense: Dharma does not arise out of anything else. It is from the Vedas that the Dharma shines forth. Hence, one who is desirous ofliberation and who seeks Dharma should resort to the Vedas which are my embodiment.

verses.sanskrit: वीक्ष्य देवाधिदेवं तं साम्बं सर्वगणैर्वृतम् । तुष्टाव भगवान् ब्रह्मा दक्षः सर्वे दिवौकसः
verses.transliteration: vīkṣya devādhidevaṃ taṃ sāmbaṃ sarvagaṇairvṛtam / tuṣṭāva bhagavān brahmā dakṣaḥ sarve divaukasaḥ
verses.translation: It is my own ancient and supreme potency that is termed as the Vedas. That potency arises and functions at the beginning of creation, in the forms of Rk, Tajus and Sdman.
verses.hindi: भवन्तमाहुः शिवमेव केचित् त्वमक्षरं ब्रह्म परं पवित्र-
verses.wordMeaning: It is my own ancient and supreme potency that is termed as the Vedas. That potency arises and functions at the beginning of creation, in the forms of Rk, Tajus and Sdman.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is my own ancient and supreme potency that is termed as the Vedas. That potency arises and functions at the beginning of creation, in the forms of Rk, Tajus and Sdman.

verses.sanskrit: विशेषात् पार्वतीं देवीमीश्वरार्धशरीरिणीम् । स्तोत्रैर्नानाविधैर्दक्षः प्रणम्य च कृताञ्जलिः
verses.transliteration: viśeṣāt pārvatīṃ devīmīśvarārdhaśarīriṇīm / stotrairnānāvidhairdakṣaḥ praṇamya ca kṛtāñjaliḥ
verses.translation: It is in order to protect those Vedas that the birth¬ less Lord Brahma created Brahmanas and others, and engaged them in their respective duties.
verses.hindi: हंसः प्राणो मृत्युरन्तोऽसि यज्ञः। प्रजापतिर्भगवानेकरुद्रो नीलग्रीवः स्तूयसे वेदविद्भिः
verses.wordMeaning: It is in order to protect those Vedas that the birth¬ less Lord Brahma created Brahmanas and others, and engaged them in their respective duties.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is in order to protect those Vedas that the birth¬ less Lord Brahma created Brahmanas and others, and engaged them in their respective duties.

verses.sanskrit: ततो भगवती देवी प्रहसन्ती महेश्वरम् । प्रसन्नमानसा रुद्रं वचः प्राह घृणानिधिः
verses.transliteration: tato bhagavatī devī prahasantī maheśvaram / prasannamānasā rudraṃ vacaḥ prāha ghṛṇānidhiḥ
verses.translation: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.
verses.hindi: नारायणस्त्वं जगतामथादिः सदाशिवस्त्वं परमेश्वरोऽसि
verses.wordMeaning: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.
verses.commentary: Sense: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.

verses.sanskrit: त्वमेव जगतः स्त्रष्टा शासिता चैव रक्षकः । अनुग्राह्यो भगवता दक्षश्चापि दिवौकसः
verses.transliteration: tvameva jagataḥ straṣṭā śāsitā caiva rakṣakaḥ / anugrāhyo bhagavatā dakṣaścāpi divaukasaḥ
verses.translation: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.
verses.hindi: हे आदिदेव! देवताओंके द्वारा आपके चरणोंकी पूजा की जाती है, आप विभागरहित, शुद्ध तत्त्वस्वरूप हैं, आपकी जय हो। अद्वितीय अग्निरूप आप वायु आदि भेदोंसे बहुत प्रकारसे पूजित होते हैं और अखिल आत्मरूप हैं। सूर्यके समान वर्णवाले पुराणपुरुष!
verses.wordMeaning: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.
verses.commentary: Sense: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रहस्य भगवान् कपर्दे नीललोहितः । उवाच प्रणतान् देवान् प्राचेतसमथो हरः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prahasya bhagavān kaparde nīlalohitaḥ / uvāca praṇatān devān prācetasamatho haraḥ
verses.translation: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.
verses.hindi: एकमात्र आपको ही तम (मायारूप अन्धकार)-से परे कहा जाता है। आप इस (संसार)-के साक्षी हैं, निरन्तर इसका पालन करते हैं और आप ही संहार करनेवाले हैं। आप योगियोंके समूहोंद्वारा सेवित होते रहते हैं। अद्वितीय, अन्तरात्मारूप आप देह आदि विशेष पदार्थोसे रहित होते हुए (विभिन्न) देहोंमें अनेक प्रकारसे स्थित रहते हैं। आप आत्मशब्द (' आत्मा' शब्दसे बोध्य) और परमात्मतत्त्व है । कुछ लोग आपको ही शिव कहते
verses.wordMeaning: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.
verses.commentary: Sense: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.

verses.sanskrit: गच्छध्वं देवताः सर्वाः प्रसन्नो भवतामहम् । संपूज्यः सर्वयज्ञेषु न निन्द्यो ऽहं विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: gacchadhvaṃ devatāḥ sarvāḥ prasanno bhavatāmaham / saṃpūjyaḥ sarvayajñeṣu na nindyo 'haṃ viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.
verses.hindi: ओंकार शब्दसे वाच्य, अविनाशी, पर ब्रह्म हैं। आप स्वयं वेदवाक्योंमें ' ईश्वर '-शब्दसे सिद्ध हैं और समस्त विशेष पदार्थांसे शून्य हें । आप इन्द्र, वरुण, अग्नि, हंस, प्राण, मृत्यु, अन्त एवं यज्ञ हैं । वेदको जाननेवालोंके द्वारा आपके नीलकण्ठ, एकरुद्र, प्रजापति और भगवत्स्वरूपकी स्तुति की जाती है। आप संसारके आदि और नारायण हैं, आप ही पितामह और प्रपितामह हैं। वेदान्तशास्त्र तथा गुह्य उपनिषदोंमें
verses.wordMeaning: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.
verses.commentary: Sense: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं चापि शृणु मे दक्ष वचनं सर्वरक्षणम् । त्यक्त्वा लोकैषणामेतां मद्भक्तो भव यत्नतः
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ cāpi śṛṇu me dakṣa vacanaṃ sarvarakṣaṇam / tyaktvā lokaiṣaṇāmetāṃ madbhakto bhava yatnataḥ
verses.translation: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.
verses.hindi: आप ही सदाशिव और परमेश्वर इस नामसे वर्णित हैं॥ १९३--१९५॥ तमोगुणसे परे, परम परमात्मा, पञ्चपदान्तरस्वरूप, ब्राह्मी, वैष्णवी एवं शाक्त--तीनों शक्तियोंसे अतीत,
verses.wordMeaning: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.
verses.commentary: Sense: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.

verses.sanskrit: भविष्यसि गणेशानः कल्पान्ते ऽनुग्रहान्मम । तावत् तिष्ठ ममादेशात् स्वाधिकारेषु निर्वृतः
verses.transliteration: bhaviṣyasi gaṇeśānaḥ kalpānte 'nugrahānmama / tāvat tiṣṭha mamādeśāt svādhikāreṣu nirvṛtaḥ
verses.translation: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.
verses.hindi: आप परमात्माको नमस्कार है ब्रह्मा-विष्णु एवं शिव--इन त्रिमूर्तिरूप, अनन्त पदात्मक, आत्ममूर्ति, जगन्निवास और जगन्मयको नमस्कार है। ललारमें नेत्र धारण करनेवाले तथा लोगोंके हृदयमें स्थित आपको नमस्कार है। मुनीन्द्रों तथा सिद्धोंद्वारा जिनके
verses.wordMeaning: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.
verses.commentary: Sense: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा स भगवान् सपत्नीकः सहानुगः । अदर्शनमनुप्राप्तो दक्षस्यामिततेजसः
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā sa bhagavān sapatnīkaḥ sahānugaḥ / adarśanamanuprāpto dakṣasyāmitatejasaḥ
verses.translation: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.
verses.hindi: चरणकमलोंकी पूजा की जाती है, ऐसे नागराजोंकी माला धारण करनेवाले आपको नमस्कार है ऐश्वर्यधर्मासनसंस्थिताय
verses.wordMeaning: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.
verses.commentary: Sense: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.

verses.sanskrit: अन्तर्हिते महादेवे शङ्करे पद्मसंभवः । व्याजहार स्वयं दक्षमशेषजगतो हितम्
verses.transliteration: antarhite mahādeve śaṅkare padmasaṃbhavaḥ / vyājahāra svayaṃ dakṣamaśeṣajagato hitam
verses.translation: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.
verses.hindi: नमोऽस्तु ते देव हिरण्यबाहो नमोऽम्बिकायाः पतये मृडाय
verses.wordMeaning: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.
