verses.commentary: Sense: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मोवाच किं तवापगतो मोहः प्रसन्ने वृषभध्वजे । यदाचष्ट स्वयं देवः पालयैतदतन्द्रितः
verses.transliteration: brahmovāca kiṃ tavāpagato mohaḥ prasanne vṛṣabhadhvaje / yadācaṣṭa svayaṃ devaḥ pālayaitadatandritaḥ
verses.translation: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.
verses.hindi: त्रिकालहीनामलधामधाम्ने नमो महेशाय नमः शिवाय
verses.wordMeaning: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.
verses.commentary: Sense: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषामेव भूतानां हृद्येष वसतीश्वरः । पश्यन्त्येनं ब्रह्मभूता विद्वांसो वेदवादिनः
verses.transliteration: sarveṣāmeva bhūtānāṃ hṛdyeṣa vasatīśvaraḥ / paśyantyenaṃ brahmabhūtā vidvāṃso vedavādinaḥ
verses.translation: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.
verses.hindi: एवं स्तुवन्तं भगवान् शूलाग्रादवरोप्य तम्। तुष्टः प्रोवाच हस्ताभ्यां स्पृष्टाथ परमेश्वरः प्रीतोऽहं सर्वथा हैत्य स्तवेनानेन साम्प्रतम्। सम्प्राप्य गाणपत्यं मे संनिधाने वसामरः
verses.wordMeaning: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.
verses.commentary: Sense: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.

verses.sanskrit: स आत्मा सर्वभूतानां स बीजं परमा गतिः । स्तूयते वैदिकैर्मन्त्रैर्देवदेवो महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: sa ātmā sarvabhūtānāṃ sa bījaṃ paramā gatiḥ / stūyate vaidikairmantrairdevadevo maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.
verses.hindi: अरोगश्छिन्नसंदेहो देवैरपि सुपूजितः। नन्दीश्वरस्यानुचरः सर्वदुःखविवर्जितः एवं व्याहृतमात्रे तु देवदेवेन देवताः। गणेश्वरा महादेवमन्धकं देवसंनिधौ
verses.wordMeaning: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.
verses.commentary: Sense: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.

verses.sanskrit: तमर्चयति यो रुद्रं स्वात्मन्येकं सनातनम् । चेतसा भावयुक्तेन स याति परमं पदम्
verses.transliteration: tamarcayati yo rudraṃ svātmanyekaṃ sanātanam / cetasā bhāvayuktena sa yāti paramaṃ padam
verses.translation: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.
verses.hindi: सहस्रसूर्यसंकाशं त्रिनेत्रं चन्द्रचिह्नितम्। नीलकण्ठं जटामौलिं शूलासक्तमहाकरम् उवाच भगवान् विष्णुर्द्वदेवं स्मयन्निव २०६॥ स्थाने तव महादेव प्रभावः पुरुषो महान्। नेक्षतेऽज्चानजान् दोषान् गृह्णाति च गुणानपि
verses.wordMeaning: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.
verses.commentary: Sense: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादनादिमध्यान्तं विज्ञाय परमेश्वरम् । कर्मणा मनसा वाचा समाराधय यत्नतः
verses.transliteration: tasmādanādimadhyāntaṃ vijñāya parameśvaram / karmaṇā manasā vācā samārādhaya yatnataḥ
verses.translation: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.
verses.hindi: इतीरितोऽथ भैरवो गणेशदेवपुङ्गवैः । सकेशवः सहान्धको जगाम शंकरान्तिकम् निरीक्ष्य देवमागतं स शंकरः सहान्धकम्। समाधवं समातृकं जगाम निर्वृतिं हरः
verses.wordMeaning: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.
verses.commentary: Sense: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.

verses.sanskrit: यत्नात् परिहरेशस्य निन्दामात्मविनाशनीम् । भवन्ति सर्वदोषाय निन्दकस्य क्रिया यतः
verses.transliteration: yatnāt parihareśasya nindāmātmavināśanīm / bhavanti sarvadoṣāya nindakasya kriyā yataḥ
verses.translation: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.
verses.hindi: ऐश्वर्यमय धर्मके आसनपर विराजमान रहनेवाले, परमोत्कृष्ट एवं संसारको उत्पन्न करनेवाले आपको नमस्कार है । हजारों चन्द्रमा और सूर्योके समान नेत्रवाले तथा सुन्दर मध्यभागवाले सोमस्वरूप आपको नमस्कार है । हिरण्यबाहो! देव! आपको नमस्कार है। अम्बिकाके पति मृड! आपको नमस्कार है। अत्यन्त गुह्य, गुहान्तर, वेदान्तरूपी विज्ञानके द्वारा निश्चित किये गये तीनों कालोंके प्रभावसे रहित, शुद्ध तेजोमय
verses.wordMeaning: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.
verses.commentary: Sense: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.

verses.sanskrit: यस्तवैष महायोगी रक्षको विष्णुरव्ययः । स देवदेवो भगवान् महादेवो न संशयः
verses.transliteration: yastavaiṣa mahāyogī rakṣako viṣṇuravyayaḥ / sa devadevo bhagavān mahādevo na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.
verses.hindi: स्थानवाले महेशको नमस्कार है, शिवको नमस्कार है॥ १९८--२०० ॥ इस प्रकार स्तुति कर रहे उस (अन्धक)-को प्रसन्‍न होकर भगवान् परमेश्वरने त्रिशूलके अग्रभागसे उतारा और हाथोंसे स्पर्श करते हुए कहा--हैत्य! इस समय तुम्हारे द्वारा की गयी इस स्तुतिसे मैं तुमपर
verses.wordMeaning: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.
verses.commentary: Sense: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.

verses.sanskrit: मन्यन्ते ये जगद्योनिं विभिन्नं विष्णुमीश्वरात् । मोहादवेदनिष्ठत्वात् ते यान्ति नरकं नराः
verses.transliteration: manyante ye jagadyoniṃ vibhinnaṃ viṣṇumīśvarāt / mohādavedaniṣṭhatvāt te yānti narakaṃ narāḥ
verses.translation: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.
verses.hindi: अत्यन्त प्रसन्न हुँ। तुम गणपति-पद प्राकर अमर होकर मेरे समीपमें निवास करो। तुम रोगोंसे रहित, संदेहशून्य, सभी दुःखोंसे रहित और नन्दीश्वरके अनुचर होकर देवताओंके द्वारा भलीभाँति पूजित हजारों सूर्यके समान प्रकाशमान, त्रिनेत्रधारी, चन्द्रमाके चिहसे सुशोभित, नीलकण्ठ, जटा-मुकुटधारी, विशाल भुजामें त्रिशूल धारण किये तथा महादेवरूपमें विद्यमान उस अन्धक हैत्यको देव शंकरके समीपमें
verses.wordMeaning: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.
verses.commentary: Sense: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.

verses.sanskrit: वेदानुवर्तिनो रुद्रं देवं नारायणं तथा । एकीभावेन पश्यन्ति मुक्तिभाजो भवन्ति ते
verses.transliteration: vedānuvartino rudraṃ devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ tathā / ekībhāvena paśyanti muktibhājo bhavanti te
verses.translation: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.
verses.hindi: स्थित देखकर देवता तथा गणेश्वर अत्यन्त आश्चर्य- चकित हो गये और उसकी स्तुति करने लगे। तदनन्तर भगवान् विष्णुने हँसते हुए देवाधिदेव शिवसे कहा ॥ २०४--२०६ ॥ महादेव! आपने उचित ही प्रभाव दिखलाया। महान् पुरुष आज्ञानसे उत्पन्न दोषोंको नहीं देखते और गुणोंको ही ग्रहण करते हैं। इतना कहे जानेके बाद गणेश्वरो, श्रेष्ठ देवों, केशव तथा अन्धकके साथ भैरव शंकरके
verses.wordMeaning: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.
verses.commentary: Sense: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.

verses.sanskrit: यो विष्णुः स स्वयं रुद्रो यो रुद्रः स जनार्दनः । इति मत्वा यजेद् देवं स याति परमां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: yo viṣṇuḥ sa svayaṃ rudro yo rudraḥ sa janārdanaḥ / iti matvā yajed devaṃ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim
verses.translation: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.
verses.hindi: पास गये। अन्धक, विष्णु तथा मातृकाओंके साथ देव (भेरव)-को आया देखकर उन कल्याणकारी हरको परम शान्ति प्राप्त हुई। हिरण्याक्षके पुत्र (अन्धक)-का हाथ पकड़कर ईश्वर (शंकर) वहाँ गये, जहाँ शंकरप्रिया विलोक्य सा समागतं भवं भवार्तिहारिणम्।
verses.wordMeaning: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.
verses.commentary: Sense: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.

verses.sanskrit: सृजत्येतज्जगत् सर्वं विष्णुस्तत् पश्यतीश्वरः । इत्थं जगत् सर्वमिदं रुद्रनारायणोद्भवम्
verses.transliteration: sṛjatyetajjagat sarvaṃ viṣṇustat paśyatīśvaraḥ / itthaṃ jagat sarvamidaṃ rudranārāyaṇodbhavam
verses.translation: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.
verses.hindi: संसारके दुःखोंका हरण करनेवाले भव (शंकर)- अवाप सान्धकं सुखं प्रसादमन्धकं प्रति॥ २११॥  को अन्धकके साथ आया देखकर उन्हें सुख प्राप्त हुआ,
verses.wordMeaning: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.
verses.commentary: Sense: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् त्यक्त्वा हरेर्निन्दां विष्णावपि समाहितः । समाश्रयेन्महादेवं शरण्यं ब्रह्मवादिनाम्
verses.transliteration: tasmāt tyaktvā harernindāṃ viṣṇāvapi samāhitaḥ / samāśrayenmahādevaṃ śaraṇyaṃ brahmavādinām
verses.translation: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.
verses.hindi: अथान्धको महेश्वरी ददर्श देवपा्श्वगाम्। पपात दण्डवत् क्षितौ ननाम पादपद्ायोः नमामि देववल्लभामनादिमद्रिजामिमाम्। यतः प्रधानपूरुषौ निहन्ति याखिलं जगत्
verses.wordMeaning: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.
verses.commentary: Sense: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.

verses.sanskrit: उपश्रुत्याथ वचनं विरिञ्चस्य प्रजापतिः । जगाम शरणं देवं गोपतिं कृत्तिवाससम्
verses.transliteration: upaśrutyātha vacanaṃ viriñcasya prajāpatiḥ / jagāma śaraṇaṃ devaṃ gopatiṃ kṛttivāsasam
verses.translation: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.
verses.hindi: विभाति या शिवासने शिवेन साकमव्यया। हिरण्मयेऽतिनिर्मले नमामि तामिमामजाम् नमामि या गुणातिगा गिरीशपुत्रिकामिमाम्
verses.wordMeaning: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.
verses.commentary: Sense: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.

verses.sanskrit: ये ऽन्ये शापाग्निनिर्दग्धा दधीचस्य महर्षयः । द्विषन्तो मोहिता देवं संबभूवुः कलिष्वथ
verses.transliteration: ye 'nye śāpāgninirdagdhā dadhīcasya maharṣayaḥ / dviṣanto mohitā devaṃ saṃbabhūvuḥ kaliṣvatha
verses.translation: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.
verses.hindi: क्षमस्व देवि शैलजे कृतं मया विमोहतः। संस्तुता हैत्यपतिना पुत्रत्वे जगृहेऽन्धकम्
verses.wordMeaning: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.
verses.commentary: Sense: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.

verses.sanskrit: त्यक्त्वा तपोबलं कृत्स्नं विप्राणां कुलसंभवाः । पूर्वसंस्कारमहात्म्याद् ब्रह्मणो वचनादिह
verses.transliteration: tyaktvā tapobalaṃ kṛtsnaṃ viprāṇāṃ kulasaṃbhavāḥ / pūrvasaṃskāramahātmyād brahmaṇo vacanādiha
verses.translation: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.
verses.hindi: यत्र सा तामसी विष्णोर्मूर्तिः संहारकारिका। समास्ते हरिरव्यक्तो नृसिंहाकृतिरीश्वरः कालाग्निरुद्रो भगवान् युयोजात्मानमात्मनि
verses.wordMeaning: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.
verses.commentary: Sense: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.

verses.sanskrit: मुक्तशापास्ततः सर्वे कल्पान्ते रौरवादिषु । निपात्यमानाः कालेन संप्राप्यादित्यवर्चसम् । ब्रह्माणं जगतामीशमनुज्ञाताः स्वयंभुवा
verses.transliteration: muktaśāpāstataḥ sarve kalpānte rauravādiṣu / nipātyamānāḥ kālena saṃprāpyādityavarcasam / brahmāṇaṃ jagatāmīśamanujñātāḥ svayaṃbhuvā
verses.translation: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.
verses.hindi: युञ्जतस्तस्य देवस्य सर्वा एवाथ मातर: । बुभुक्षिता महादेवं प्रणम्याहुस्त्रिशूलिनम् बुभुक्षिता महादेव अनुज्ञा दीयतां त्वया। त्रैलोक्यं भक्षयिष्यामो नान्यथा तृप्तिरस्ति नः
verses.wordMeaning: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.
verses.commentary: Sense: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.

verses.sanskrit: समाराध्य तपोयोगादीशानं त्रिदशाधिपम् । भविष्यन्ति यथा पूर्वं शङ्करस्य प्रसादतः
verses.transliteration: samārādhya tapoyogādīśānaṃ tridaśādhipam / bhaviṣyanti yathā pūrvaṃ śaṅkarasya prasādataḥ
verses.translation: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.
verses.hindi: एतावदुक्त्वा वचनं मातरो विष्णुसम्भवाः । भक्षयाञ्जक्रिरे सर्व त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् ततः स भैरवो देवो नृसिंहवपुषं हरिम्। दध्यौ नारायणं देवं क्षणात् प्रादुरभूद्धरिः
verses.wordMeaning: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.
verses.commentary: Sense: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.

verses.sanskrit: एतद् वः कथितं सर्वं दक्षयज्ञनिषूदनम् । शृणुध्वं दक्षपुत्रीणां सर्वासां चैव संततिम्
verses.transliteration: etad vaḥ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ dakṣayajñaniṣūdanam / śṛṇudhvaṃ dakṣaputrīṇāṃ sarvāsāṃ caiva saṃtatim
verses.translation: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.
verses.hindi: तब उन्होंने अन्धकपर कृपा की। अन्धक शंकरके पार्श्वभागमें स्थित महेशवरीको देखा। वह पृथ्वीपर दण्डके समान गिर गया और देवीके चरणकमलोंमें प्रणाम किया जिनसे प्रधान (प्रकृति) और पुरुष उत्पन्न हुए हैं और जो सम्पूर्ण विश्वका संहार करनेवाली हैं, उन अनादि शंकरप्रिया अद्रितनया (पर्वतपुत्री) -को में प्रणाम करता हूँ। जो अति निर्मल, हिरण्मय, मंगलकारी
verses.wordMeaning: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.
verses.commentary: Sense: The hells such as Tamisra and others were created beneath the earth by god Brahma for those people who do not practise the duties prescribed in my Dharma.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे चतुर्दशो ऽध्यायः सूत उवाच प्रजाः सृजेति व्यादिष्टः पूर्वं दक्षः स्वयंभुवा । ससर्ज देवान् गन्धर्वान् ऋषींश्चैवासुरोरगान्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge caturdaśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca prajāḥ sṛjeti vyādiṣṭaḥ pūrvaṃ dakṣaḥ svayaṃbhuvā / sasarja devān gandharvān ṛṣīṃścaivāsuroragān
verses.translation: There is no scripture other than the Vedas which lays down what is Dharma. A person who takes delight in other things (not sanctioned by the Vedas), should not be even talked to by twice-born persons viz. Brahmanas, Ksatriyas and Vaisyas.
verses.hindi: आसनपर भगवान् शिवके साथ सुशोभित होती हैं, उन अव्यय और अजन्माको मैं नमस्कार करता हूँ। सभी भेदोंसे रहित उन उमाको मैं प्रणाम करता हूँ, जिनके भीतर सम्पूर्ण संसार उत्पन्न होता है और विनाशको प्राप्त होता रहता है। जो न उत्पन्न होती हैं, न विनाशको प्राप्त होती हैं और न बढ़ती ही हैं, उन गुणातीत हिमालयकी पुत्री उमाको मैं नमस्कार करता हूँ । देवि! शैलपुत्रि! मैंने मोहित होकर जो किया उसके लिये आप मुझे क्षमा
verses.wordMeaning: There is no scripture other than the Vedas which lays down what is Dharma. A person who takes delight in other things (not sanctioned by the Vedas), should not be even talked to by twice-born persons viz. Brahmanas, Ksatriyas and Vaisyas.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no scripture other than the Vedas which lays down what is Dharma. A person who takes delight in other things (not sanctioned by the Vedas), should not be even talked to by twice-born persons viz. Brahmanas, Ksatriyas and Vaisyas.

verses.sanskrit: यदास्य सृजमानस्य न व्यवर्धन्त ताः प्रजाः । तदा ससर्ज भूतानि मैथुनेनैव धर्मतः
verses.transliteration: yadāsya sṛjamānasya na vyavardhanta tāḥ prajāḥ / tadā sasarja bhūtāni maithunenaiva dharmataḥ
verses.translation: Those various scriptures which are contrary to Srutis and Smrtis seen in this world, are based on Tamo-gum or ignorance. Belief in them or practising in accordance with them is a Tdmasa activity.
verses.hindi: करें। देवताओं तथा असुरोंसे पूजित आपके चरणकमलोंको मैं नमस्कार करता हूँ भक्तिसे विनम्र हुए हैत्यपतिके इस प्रकार स्तुति किये जानेपर भगवती गौरी पार्वतीने उस अन्धकको पुत्ररूपमें स्वीकार किया
verses.wordMeaning: Those various scriptures which are contrary to Srutis and Smrtis seen in this world, are based on Tamo-gum or ignorance. Belief in them or practising in accordance with them is a Tdmasa activity.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those various scriptures which are contrary to Srutis and Smrtis seen in this world, are based on Tamo-gum or ignorance. Belief in them or practising in accordance with them is a Tdmasa activity.

verses.sanskrit: असिक्न्यां जनयामास वीरणस्य प्रजापतेः । सुतायां धर्मयुक्तायां पुत्राणां तु सहस्त्रकम्
verses.transliteration: asiknyāṃ janayāmāsa vīraṇasya prajāpateḥ / sutāyāṃ dharmayuktāyāṃ putrāṇāṃ tu sahastrakam
verses.translation: They i.e. those contrary to Vedas are the cults of Kapala, Bhairava, (v.l. Pancaratras), Yamala, Varna, and Arhata and others similar to these also.
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर रुद्रसे उत्पन्न परमेश्वर भैरव शम्भुकी आज्ञासे मातृकाओंके साथ पाताल गये। जहाँ विष्णुको संहारकारिणी तामसी मूर्तिके रूपमें नृसिंहाकृति ईश्वर अव्यक्त हरि स्थित हैं। तदनन्तर शेषसे भी पूजित कालाग्नि रुद्र अनन्ताकृति भगवान् शम्भुने स्वयंको परमात्मतत्त्वसे संयुक्त कर दिया। उन देवके (परमात्मासे) संयोग करते समय सभी बुभुक्षित मातृकाओंने त्रिशूलधारी महादेवको प्रणामकर कहा-
verses.wordMeaning: They i.e. those contrary to Vedas are the cults of Kapala, Bhairava, (v.l. Pancaratras), Yamala, Varna, and Arhata and others similar to these also.
verses.commentary: Sense: They i.e. those contrary to Vedas are the cults of Kapala, Bhairava, (v.l. Pancaratras), Yamala, Varna, and Arhata and others similar to these also.

verses.sanskrit: तेषु पुत्रेषु नष्टेषु मायया नारदस्य सः । षष्टिं दक्षो ऽसृजत् कन्या वैरण्यां वै प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: teṣu putreṣu naṣṭeṣu māyayā nāradasya saḥ / ṣaṣṭiṃ dakṣo 'sṛjat kanyā vairaṇyāṃ vai prajāpatiḥ
verses.translation: In another incarnation of mine, these scriptureshaving been promulgated by me to delude the people who themselves try to mislead other persons by propagating their false scrip¬ tures.
verses.hindi: मातृकाओंने कहा--महादेव! हम भूखी हैं। आप आज्ञा दें, हम तीनों लोकोंका भक्षण करेंगी, हमारी और किसी प्रकारसे तृप्ति नहीं होगी। इतनी बात कहकर विष्णुसे उत्पन्न वे मातृकाएँ चराचरसहित सम्पूर्ण त्रिलोकीका भक्षण करने लगीं
verses.wordMeaning: In another incarnation of mine, these scriptureshaving been promulgated by me to delude the people who themselves try to mislead other persons by propagating their false scrip¬ tures.
verses.commentary: Sense: In another incarnation of mine, these scriptureshaving been promulgated by me to delude the people who themselves try to mislead other persons by propagating their false scrip¬ tures.

verses.sanskrit: ददौ स दश धर्माय कश्यपाय त्रयोदश । विंशत् सप्त च सोमाय चतस्त्रो ऽरिष्टनेमिने
verses.transliteration: dadau sa daśa dharmāya kaśyapāya trayodaśa / viṃśat sapta ca somāya catastro 'riṣṭanemine
verses.translation: What is prescribed inthemrftjas activity belonging to the Vedas, should be pursued by those who are the most excellent ones among the knowers of meaning and the significance of the Vedas. Those men who strenuously pursue those activities are liked by me.
verses.hindi: तब उन भैरवदेवने नुसिंह-शरीरधारी नारायण-देव हरिका ध्यान किया। हरि क्षणभरमें ही प्रकट हो गये निवारयाशु त्रैलोक्यं त्वदीया भगवन्निति
verses.wordMeaning: What is prescribed inthemrftjas activity belonging to the Vedas, should be pursued by those who are the most excellent ones among the knowers of meaning and the significance of the Vedas. Those men who strenuously pursue those activities are liked by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: What is prescribed inthemrftjas activity belonging to the Vedas, should be pursued by those who are the most excellent ones among the knowers of meaning and the significance of the Vedas. Those men who strenuously pursue those activities are liked by me.

verses.sanskrit: द्वे चैव बहुपुत्राय द्वे कृशाश्वाय धीमते । द्वे चैवाङ्गिरसे तद्वत् तासां वक्ष्ये ऽथ निस्तरम्
verses.transliteration: dve caiva bahuputrāya dve kṛśāśvāya dhīmate / dve caivāṅgirase tadvat tāsāṃ vakṣye 'tha nistaram
verses.translation: It is out of compassion (and for the welfare of) all the four castes that the great personality Svayambhuva Manu himself formerly promulgated the Code of Dharma to the sages, at my behest.
verses.hindi: संस्मृता विष्णुना देव्यो नृसिंहवपुषा पुनः । उपतस्थुर्महादेबं नरसिंहाकृतिं च तम् सम्प्राप्य संनिधिं विष्णोः सर्वाः संहारकारिकाः । प्रददुः शम्भवे शक्तिं भेरवायातितेजसे
verses.wordMeaning: It is out of compassion (and for the welfare of) all the four castes that the great personality Svayambhuva Manu himself formerly promulgated the Code of Dharma to the sages, at my behest.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is out of compassion (and for the welfare of) all the four castes that the great personality Svayambhuva Manu himself formerly promulgated the Code of Dharma to the sages, at my behest.

verses.sanskrit: अरुन्धती वसुर्जामी लम्बा भानुर्मरुत्वती । संकल्पा च मुहूर्ता च साध्या विश्वा च भामिनी
verses.transliteration: arundhatī vasurjāmī lambā bhānurmarutvatī / saṃkalpā ca muhūrtā ca sādhyā viśvā ca bhāminī
verses.translation: After hearing the excellent Dharmas from his mouth (as propounded by him), other sages also composed other scriptures as codes of Dharmas or pious behaviour, for establish¬ ing the Dharma.
verses.hindi: व्याजहार हृषीकेशो ये भक्ताः शूलपाणिनः । ये च मां संस्मरन्तीह पालनीयाः प्रयत्नतः ममैव मूर्तिरतुला सर्वसंहारकारिका। महेश्वरांशसम्भूता भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदा त्वियम्
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing the excellent Dharmas from his mouth (as propounded by him), other sages also composed other scriptures as codes of Dharmas or pious behaviour, for establish¬ ing the Dharma.
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing the excellent Dharmas from his mouth (as propounded by him), other sages also composed other scriptures as codes of Dharmas or pious behaviour, for establish¬ ing the Dharma.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मपत्न्यो दश त्वेतास्तासां पुत्रान् निबोधत । विश्वाया विश्वदेवास्तु साध्या साध्यानजीजनत्
verses.transliteration: dharmapatnyo daśa tvetāstāsāṃ putrān nibodhata / viśvāyā viśvadevāstu sādhyā sādhyānajījanat
verses.translation: When at the end of Yugas, these codes vanish, the sages would compose them in every Yuga at the instance of god Brahma.
verses.hindi: अनन्तो भगवान् कालो द्विधावस्था ममैव तु। तामसी राजसी मूर्तिर्देवदेवश्चतुर्मुखः सोऽयं देवो दुराधर्षः कालो लोकप्रकालनः । भक्षयिष्यति कल्पान्ते रुद्रात्मा निखिलं जगत्
verses.wordMeaning: When at the end of Yugas, these codes vanish, the sages would compose them in every Yuga at the instance of god Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: When at the end of Yugas, these codes vanish, the sages would compose them in every Yuga at the instance of god Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: मरुत्वन्तो मरुत्वत्यां वसवो ऽष्टौ वसोः सुताः । भानोस्तु भानवश्चैव मुहूर्ता वै मुहूर्तजाः
verses.transliteration: marutvanto marutvatyāṃ vasavo 'ṣṭau vasoḥ sutāḥ / bhānostu bhānavaścaiva muhūrtā vai muhūrtajāḥ
verses.translation: O King, at the behest of god Brahma, eighteen major Purdms have been recounted by Vyasa and others. Dharma is well established (and expounded) in them.
verses.hindi: या सा विमोहिका मू्तिर्मम नारायणाह्वया। सत्त्वोद्रिक्ता जगत् कृत्स्नं संस्थापयति नित्यदा स हि विष्णुः परं ब्रह्म परमात्मा परा गतिः । मूलप्रकृतिरव्यक्ता सदानन्देति कथ्यते
verses.wordMeaning: O King, at the behest of god Brahma, eighteen major Purdms have been recounted by Vyasa and others. Dharma is well established (and expounded) in them.
verses.commentary: Sense: O King, at the behest of god Brahma, eighteen major Purdms have been recounted by Vyasa and others. Dharma is well established (and expounded) in them.

verses.sanskrit: लम्बायाश्चाथ घोषो वै नागवीथी तु जामिजा । पृथिवीविषयं सर्वमरुन्दत्यामजायत । संकल्पायास्तु संकल्पो धर्मपुत्रा दश स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: lambāyāścātha ghoṣo vai nāgavīthī tu jāmijā / pṛthivīviṣayaṃ sarvamarundatyāmajāyata / saṃkalpāyāstu saṃkalpo dharmaputrā daśa smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Other minor Puranas have been narrated by his (Vyasa's) disciples. The author of each of these treatises is the knowerof the Dhaxma-Sdstras, in every Yuga.
verses.hindi: इत्येवं बोधिता देव्यो विष्णुना विश्वमातरः। प्रपेदिरे महादेवं तमेव शरणं हरिम् माहात्म्यं देवदेवस्य भैरवस्यामितौजसः
verses.wordMeaning: Other minor Puranas have been narrated by his (Vyasa's) disciples. The author of each of these treatises is the knowerof the Dhaxma-Sdstras, in every Yuga.
verses.commentary: Sense: Other minor Puranas have been narrated by his (Vyasa's) disciples. The author of each of these treatises is the knowerof the Dhaxma-Sdstras, in every Yuga.

verses.sanskrit: आपो ध्रुवश्च सोमश्च धरश्चैवानिलो ऽनलः । प्रत्यूषश्च प्रभासश्च वसवो ऽष्टौ प्रकीर्तिताः
verses.transliteration: āpo dhruvaśca somaśca dharaścaivānilo 'nalaḥ / pratyūṣaśca prabhāsaśca vasavo 'ṣṭau prakīrtitāḥ
verses.translation: Sik?a (phonetics), (the rules regarding holy
verses.hindi: (भैरवदेवने) उन्हें बतलाते हुए कहा--भगवन्! आपकी ये मातृकाएँ त्रिलोकीका भक्षण कर रही हैं, इन्हें आप शीघ्र ही रोकें नरसिंह-शरीरधारी विष्णुके द्वारा पुनः उन देवियोंका स्मरण किये जानेपर वे उन नरसिंहरूपवाले महादेवके पास आ पहुँचीं। संहार करनेवाली उन सभी शक्तियोने विष्णुके समीप आकर भैरवरूपधारी अति तेजस्वी
verses.wordMeaning: Sik?a (phonetics), (the rules regarding holy
verses.commentary: Sense: Sik?a (phonetics), (the rules regarding holy

verses.sanskrit: आपस्य पुत्रो वैतण्ड्यः श्रमः श्रान्तो धुनिस्तथा । ध्रुवस्य पुत्रो भगवान् कालो लोकप्रकालनः
verses.transliteration: āpasya putro vaitaṇḍyaḥ śramaḥ śrānto dhunistathā / dhruvasya putro bhagavān kālo lokaprakālanaḥ
verses.translation: Thus there are fourteen lores which have been promulgated along with the four Vedas. Dharma does not exist elsewhere outside these texts, O excellent Brahmanas.
verses.hindi: शम्भुको शक्ति प्रदान कर दी उन मातृकाओंने जगत्को उत्पन्न करनेवाले नृसिंह, भैरव तथा शेषनागको क्षणभरमें ही एक होते हुए देखा। हषीकेशने कहा-शूलपाणि भगवान् शंकरके जो भक्त हैं और जो मेरा स्मरण करते हैं, प्रयत्न-
verses.wordMeaning: Thus there are fourteen lores which have been promulgated along with the four Vedas. Dharma does not exist elsewhere outside these texts, O excellent Brahmanas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus there are fourteen lores which have been promulgated along with the four Vedas. Dharma does not exist elsewhere outside these texts, O excellent Brahmanas.

verses.sanskrit: सोमस्य भगवान् वर्चा धरस्य द्रविणः सुतः । पुरोजवो ऽनिलस्य स्यादविज्ञातगतिस्तथा
verses.transliteration: somasya bhagavān varcā dharasya draviṇaḥ sutaḥ / purojavo 'nilasya syādavijñātagatistathā
verses.translation: Thus, it is at my behest that Manu, Vyasa and others established Dharma as expounded by god Brahma, till the dissolution of the world of living beings takes place.
verses.hindi: पूर्वक उनका यहाँ पालन करना चाहिए। महेश्वरके अंशसे उत्पन्न, सबका संहार करनेवाली यह मेरी ही अतुलनीय मूर्ति है। यह भुक्ति और मुक्तिको प्रदान करनेवाली है भगवान् अनन्त और काल मेरी ही दो प्रकारकी तामसी अवस्थाएँ हैं। देवाधिदेव चतुर्मुख ब्रह्मा मेरी राजसी मूर्ति हैं। वे ही ये संसारका संहार करनेवाले दुर्धर्ष कालदेव हैं। कल्पका अन्त होनेपर ये रुद्रात्मा
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, it is at my behest that Manu, Vyasa and others established Dharma as expounded by god Brahma, till the dissolution of the world of living beings takes place.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, it is at my behest that Manu, Vyasa and others established Dharma as expounded by god Brahma, till the dissolution of the world of living beings takes place.

verses.sanskrit: कुमारो ह्यनलस्यासीत् सेनापतिरिति स्मृतः । देवलो भगवान् योगी प्रत्यूषस्याभवत् सुतः । विश्वकर्मा प्रभासस्य शिल्पकर्ता प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: kumāro hyanalasyāsīt senāpatiriti smṛtaḥ / devalo bhagavān yogī pratyūṣasyābhavat sutaḥ / viśvakarmā prabhāsasya śilpakartā prajāpatiḥ
verses.translation: When the time of the dissolution of the world arrives, all these great-souled ones, after attaining realization of the Atman, enter the great region along with Brahma.
verses.hindi: सम्पूर्ण विश्वका भक्षण करेंगे। सबको मोहित करनेवाली सत्त्वगुणसम्पन्ना मेरी 'नारायण' इस नामवाली जो मूर्ति है, वह नित्य समस्त संसारकी स्थापना करती है। (मेरी) उस (मूर्ति)-को विष्णु, परम ब्रह्म, परमात्मा, परमगति, मूलप्रकृति, अव्यक्त और सदानन्द-इस प्रकारसे कहा जाता है। विष्णुके द्वारा इस प्रकार समझानेपर देवीरूप उन सभी मातृकाओंने उन्हीं महादेव हरिकी शरण ग्रहण की
verses.wordMeaning: When the time of the dissolution of the world arrives, all these great-souled ones, after attaining realization of the Atman, enter the great region along with Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the time of the dissolution of the world arrives, all these great-souled ones, after attaining realization of the Atman, enter the great region along with Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: अदितिर्दितिर्दनुस्तद्वदरिष्टा सुरसा तथा । सुरभिर्विनता चैव ताम्र क्रोधवशा इरा । कद्रुर्मुनिश्च धर्मज्ञा तत्पुत्रान् वै निबोधत
verses.transliteration: aditirditirdanustadvadariṣṭā surasā tathā / surabhirvinatā caiva tāmra krodhavaśā irā / kadrurmuniśca dharmajñā tatputrān vai nibodhata
verses.translation: Hence, for thesake of carrying out duties prescribed by Dharma, one should resort to the Vedas in every possible way. Knowledge accompanied by Dharma shall reveal the great Brahman.
verses.hindi: मैंने आप लोगोंसे अन्धकके विनाश और अमित ओजस्वी देवाधिदेव भैरवके माहात्म्यका सम्पूर्ण वर्णन किया १२२ श्र कूर्मपुराण हि
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, for thesake of carrying out duties prescribed by Dharma, one should resort to the Vedas in every possible way. Knowledge accompanied by Dharma shall reveal the great Brahman.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, for thesake of carrying out duties prescribed by Dharma, one should resort to the Vedas in every possible way. Knowledge accompanied by Dharma shall reveal the great Brahman.

verses.sanskrit: अंशो धाता भगस्त्वष्टा मित्रो ऽथ वरुणोर्ऽयमा । विवस्वान् सविता पूषा ह्यंशुमान् विष्णुरेव च
verses.transliteration: aṃśo dhātā bhagastvaṣṭā mitro 'tha varuṇor'yamā / vivasvān savitā pūṣā hyaṃśumān viṣṇureva ca
verses.translation: By shaking off their darkness (of ignorance) by means of perfect knowledge, they enjoy (spiritual) bliss perpe¬ tually, inasmuch as they are fully identical.with me. They are not bom again and again in the Sarhsara (as they are liberated).
verses.hindi: सनत्कुमारद्वारा आत्मज्ञान प्राप्तकर प्रह्माद-पुत्र विरोचनका योगमें संलग्न होना, विरोचन- पुत्र बलिद्वारा देवताओंको पराजित करना, देवमाता अदितिका दुःखी होना तथा विष्णुसे प्रार्थनाकर पुत्ररूपमें उनके उत्पन्न होनेका वर प्राप्त करना, अदितिके गर्भमें विष्णुका प्रवेश, विष्णुका वामनरूपमें आविर्भाव, बलिके यज्ञमें वामनका प्रवेश तथा तीन पग भूमिकी याचना, तीसरे पगसे नापते समय ब्रह्माण्ड-भेदन, गङ्गाकी उत्पत्ति तथा भक्तिका वर प्राकर बलि आदिका पातालमें प्रवेश
verses.wordMeaning: By shaking off their darkness (of ignorance) by means of perfect knowledge, they enjoy (spiritual) bliss perpe¬ tually, inasmuch as they are fully identical.with me. They are not bom again and again in the Sarhsara (as they are liberated).
verses.commentary: Sense: By shaking off their darkness (of ignorance) by means of perfect knowledge, they enjoy (spiritual) bliss perpe¬ tually, inasmuch as they are fully identical.with me. They are not bom again and again in the Sarhsara (as they are liberated).

verses.sanskrit: तुषिता नाम ते पूर्वं चाक्षुषस्यान्तरे मनोः । वैवस्वते ऽन्तरे प्रोक्ता आदित्याश्चादितेः सुताः
verses.transliteration: tuṣitā nāma te pūrvaṃ cākṣuṣasyāntare manoḥ / vaivasvate 'ntare proktā ādityāścāditeḥ sutāḥ
verses.translation: Therefore, devoting yourself to me in every way and being fully absorbed in me, worship me exclusively, seek¬ ing me mentally as your refuge, (v.l. along with Mena).
verses.hindi: श्रीकूर्म उवाच श्रीकूर्मने कहा--प्राचीन कालमें अन्धकके निगृहीत अन्धके निगृहीते वै प्रह्लादस्य महात्मनः। हो जानेपर महात्मा प्रह्मदका विरोचन नामका पुत्र राजा विरोचनो नाम सुतो बभूव नृपतिः पुरा॥ १ ॥  बना। उस महान् असुरने देवेन्द्रसहित देवताओंको जीतकर धर्मपूर्वक चराचर त्रिलोकीका बहुत वर्षोतक
verses.wordMeaning: Therefore, devoting yourself to me in every way and being fully absorbed in me, worship me exclusively, seek¬ ing me mentally as your refuge, (v.l. along with Mena).
verses.commentary: Sense: Therefore, devoting yourself to me in every way and being fully absorbed in me, worship me exclusively, seek¬ ing me mentally as your refuge, (v.l. along with Mena).

verses.sanskrit: दितिः पुत्रद्वयं लेभे कश्यपाद् बलसंयुतम् । हिरण्यकशिपुं ज्येष्ठं हिरण्याक्षं तथापरम्
verses.transliteration: ditiḥ putradvayaṃ lebhe kaśyapād balasaṃyutam / hiraṇyakaśipuṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ hiraṇyākṣaṃ tathāparam
verses.translation: If you are incapable of meditating on my unchanging lordly form, seek refuge in my great form beginning with Kala (Time), (v.l. kaladhyam —perfect-form).
verses.hindi: ed य । ३ ॥  पालन किया। उसके इस प्रकार रहते हुए एक बार hp र सचराचरम्॥ २ ॥ कभी विष्णुसे प्रेरित होकर महामुनि भगवान् सनत्कुमार तस्यैवं वर्तमानस्य कदाचिद् विष्णुचोदितः । उसके नगरमें आये। सिंहासनपर बैठे हुए उस महान् सनत्कुमारो भगवान् पुरं प्राप महामुनिः॥ ३ ॥ असुरने ब्रह्माजीके पुत्र (सनत्कुमार)-को देखकर
verses.wordMeaning: If you are incapable of meditating on my unchanging lordly form, seek refuge in my great form beginning with Kala (Time), (v.l. kaladhyam —perfect-form).
verses.commentary: Sense: If you are incapable of meditating on my unchanging lordly form, seek refuge in my great form beginning with Kala (Time), (v.l. kaladhyam —perfect-form).

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्यकशिपुर्दैत्यो महाबलपराक्रमः । आराध्य तपसा देवं ब्रह्माणं परमेष्ठिनम् । दृष्ट्वालेभेवरान् दिव्यान् स्तुत्वासौ विविधैः स्तवै
verses.transliteration: hiraṇyakaśipurdaityo mahābalaparākramaḥ / ārādhya tapasā devaṃ brahmāṇaṃ parameṣṭhinam / dṛṣṭvālebhevarān divyān stutvāsau vividhaiḥ stavai
verses.translation: Hence, O my father, stabilise yourself in that form of mine which comes within the ken of your mind. Be devoted to that and be engaged in worshipping it.
verses.hindi: दृष्टा सिंहासनगतो ब्रह्मपुत्र महासुरः । (आसनसे) उठकर सिरसे उन्हें प्रणाम किया और हाथ ननामोत्थाय शिरसा प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यमब्रबीत्॥ ४ ॥  जोड़कर यह वाक्य कहा- ॥ १--४॥ धन्योऽस्म्यनुगृहीतोऽस्मि सम्प्राप्तो मे पुरातनः । आज मैं धन्य हुआ, कृतार्थ हुआ जो ये ब्रह्मज्ञानी, योगीश्वरोऽद्य भगवान् यतोऽसौ ब्रह्मवित् स्वयम्॥ ५ ॥  पुरातन योगीश्वर भगवान् स्वयं यहाँ आ गये हैं। हे ब्रह्मन्! देवस्वरूप पितामह ब्रह्माजीके पुत्र! आप किस
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, O my father, stabilise yourself in that form of mine which comes within the ken of your mind. Be devoted to that and be engaged in worshipping it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, O my father, stabilise yourself in that form of mine which comes within the ken of your mind. Be devoted to that and be engaged in worshipping it.

verses.sanskrit: अथ तस्य बलाद् देवाः सर्व एव सुरर्षयः । बाधितास्ताडिता जग्मुर्देवदेवं पितामहम्
verses.transliteration: atha tasya balād devāḥ sarva eva surarṣayaḥ / bādhitāstāḍitā jagmurdevadevaṃ pitāmaham
verses.translation: With the intellect concentrated on it, with the Atman dwelling on it and stabilised therein, and having that as the ultimate resort, they shake off all their sins, by means of perfect knowledge and attain that stage from which there is no return to Sarhsara.
verses.hindi: किमर्थमागतो ब्रह्मन् स्वयं देवः पितामहः । प्रयोजनसे यहाँ आये हैं, मुझे बतलायें। मैं आपका ब्रूहि मे ब्रह्मणः पुत्र किं कार्य करवाण्यहम् ॥ ६ ॥  कौन-सा कार्य करूँ सोऽब्रवीद् भगवान् देवो धर्मयुक्तं महासुरम्। वे भगवान् देव धर्मात्मा महासुर (विरोचन)-से
verses.wordMeaning: With the intellect concentrated on it, with the Atman dwelling on it and stabilised therein, and having that as the ultimate resort, they shake off all their sins, by means of perfect knowledge and attain that stage from which there is no return to Sarhsara.
verses.commentary: Sense: With the intellect concentrated on it, with the Atman dwelling on it and stabilised therein, and having that as the ultimate resort, they shake off all their sins, by means of perfect knowledge and attain that stage from which there is no return to Sarhsara.

verses.sanskrit: शरण्यं शरणं देवं शंभुं सर्वजगन्मयम् । ब्रह्माणं लोककर्तारं त्रातारं पुरुषं परम् । कूटस्थं जगतामेकं पुराणं पुरुषोत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ devaṃ śaṃbhuṃ sarvajaganmayam / brahmāṇaṃ lokakartāraṃ trātāraṃ puruṣaṃ param / kūṭasthaṃ jagatāmekaṃ purāṇaṃ puruṣottamam
verses.translation: O Lord of Kings, without resorting to me, that great state of bliss, the region devoid of impurities, is not attained. Hence, seek refuge in me.
verses.hindi: द्रष्टुमभ्यागतोऽहं वै भवन्तं भाग्यवानसि॥ ७ ॥  बोले--मैं आपको ही देखने आया हूँ, आप भाग्यशाली हैत्यानां हैं। हैत्यश्रेष्ठ! हैत्योके लिये यह (धार्मिक) नीतिं सुदुर्लभा नीतिरेषा हैत्यानां हैत्यसत्तम। अत्यन्त दुर्लभ है । निश्चय ही तीनों लोकोंमें तुम्हारे समान त्रिलोके धार्मिको नूनं त्वादृशोऽन्यो न विद्यते॥ ८ ॥  कोई दूसरा धार्मिक नहीं है। ऐसा कहे जानेपर असुरराज इत्युक्तोऽसुरराजस्तं पुनः प्राह महामुनिम्। (विरोचन)-ने उन महामुनिसे पुनः कहा--ब्रह्मज्ञानियोंमें
verses.wordMeaning: O Lord of Kings, without resorting to me, that great state of bliss, the region devoid of impurities, is not attained. Hence, seek refuge in me.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Lord of Kings, without resorting to me, that great state of bliss, the region devoid of impurities, is not attained. Hence, seek refuge in me.

verses.sanskrit: स याचितो देववरैर्मुनिभिश्च मुनीश्वराः । सर्वदेवहितार्थाय जगाम कमलासनः
verses.transliteration: sa yācito devavarairmunibhiśca munīśvarāḥ / sarvadevahitārthāya jagāma kamalāsanaḥ
verses.translation: O protector of the earth, by worshipping me in identity or in separateness, or in both ways, you will attain that region, (v.l. my region).
verses.hindi: धर्माणां परम धर्म मे ब्रहावित्तम॥ ९ ॥  सर्वश्रेष्ठ! आप मुझे धर्मोमें जो श्रेष्ठ धर्म हो, उसे धर्माणां परमं हि र बतलायें। उन भगवान् योगीने महात्मा हैत्येन्द्रको सोऽब्रवीद् भगवान् योगी हैत्येन्द्राय महात्मने। आत्मञ्चानरूपी और सब प्रकारसे अत्यन्त रहस्यमय श्रेष्ठ सर्वगुह्यतमं धर्ममात्मज्ञानमनुत्तमम्॥ १०॥  धर्म बतलाया
verses.wordMeaning: O protector of the earth, by worshipping me in identity or in separateness, or in both ways, you will attain that region, (v.l. my region).
verses.commentary: Sense: O protector of the earth, by worshipping me in identity or in separateness, or in both ways, you will attain that region, (v.l. my region).

verses.sanskrit: संस्तूयमानः प्रणतैर्मुनीन्द्रैरमरैरपि । क्षीरोदस्योत्तरं कूलं यत्रास्ते हरिरीश्वरः
verses.transliteration: saṃstūyamānaḥ praṇatairmunīndrairamarairapi / kṣīrodasyottaraṃ kūlaṃ yatrāste harirīśvaraḥ
verses.translation: O leader of Kings, without resorting to me that Reality which is pure by nature and auspicious, is not compre¬ hended. Hence, seek refuge in me.
verses.hindi: उन्होंने (महात्मा विरोचनने) परम ज्ञान प्राकर उन्हे स लब्ध्या परमं ज्ञानं दत्त्वा च गुरुदक्षिणाम् । (सनत्कुमारको) गुरुदक्षिणा प्रदान की तथा राज्य अपने निधाय पुत्रे तद्राज्यं योगाभ्यासरतोऽभवत्॥ ११॥  पुत्र (बलि)-को सौंपकर वे योगाभ्यासमें निरत हो गये ब्रह्मण्यो धार्मिकोऽत्यर्थ विजिग्येऽथ पुरंदरम्
verses.wordMeaning: O leader of Kings, without resorting to me that Reality which is pure by nature and auspicious, is not compre¬ hended. Hence, seek refuge in me.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leader of Kings, without resorting to me that Reality which is pure by nature and auspicious, is not compre¬ hended. Hence, seek refuge in me.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा देवं जगद्योनिं विष्णुं विश्वगुरुं शिवम् । ववन्दे चरणौ मूर्ध्ना कृताञ्जलिरभाषत
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā devaṃ jagadyoniṃ viṣṇuṃ viśvaguruṃ śivam / vavande caraṇau mūrdhnā kṛtāñjalirabhāṣata
verses.translation: You should hence propitiate strenuously the im¬ perishable and eternal divine form. Thereafter, you will eschew the blindness of ignorance (v.l. bondage).
verses.hindi: जगाम निर्जितो विष्णुं देवं शरणमच्युतम् तदन्तरेऽदितिर्देवी देवमाता सुदुःखिता। हैत्येन्द्राणां वधार्थाय पुत्रो मे स्यादिति स्वयम्
verses.wordMeaning: You should hence propitiate strenuously the im¬ perishable and eternal divine form. Thereafter, you will eschew the blindness of ignorance (v.l. bondage).
verses.commentary: Sense: You should hence propitiate strenuously the im¬ perishable and eternal divine form. Thereafter, you will eschew the blindness of ignorance (v.l. bondage).

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मोवाच त्वं गतिः सर्वभूतानामनन्तो ऽस्यखिलात्मकः । व्यापी सर्वामरवपुर्महायोगी सनातनः
verses.transliteration: brahmovāca tvaṃ gatiḥ sarvabhūtānāmananto 'syakhilātmakaḥ / vyāpī sarvāmaravapurmahāyogī sanātanaḥ
verses.translation: Worship devotedly Siva everywhere and forever, physically, mentally and verbally. Thereafter, due to that purity, you will attain to his region.
verses.hindi: प्रपन्ना विष्णुमव्यक्तं शरण्यं शरणं हरिम् कृत्वा हृत्पदाकिञ्जल्के निष्कलं परमं पदम्। वासुदेवमनाद्यन्तमानन्दं व्योम केवलम्
verses.wordMeaning: Worship devotedly Siva everywhere and forever, physically, mentally and verbally. Thereafter, due to that purity, you will attain to his region.
verses.commentary: Sense: Worship devotedly Siva everywhere and forever, physically, mentally and verbally. Thereafter, due to that purity, you will attain to his region.

verses.sanskrit: त्वमात्मा सर्वभूतानां प्रधानं प्रकृतिः परा । वैराग्यैश्वर्यनिरतो रागातीतो निरञ्जनः
verses.transliteration: tvamātmā sarvabhūtānāṃ pradhānaṃ prakṛtiḥ parā / vairāgyaiśvaryanirato rāgātīto nirañjanaḥ
verses.translation: Those who are always enveloped by my Maya with the subtle darkness of ignorance, are born again and again in the terrible ocean in the worldly existence.
verses.hindi: प्रसन्नो भगवान् विष्णुः शङ्खचक्रगदाधरः । आविर्बभूव योगात्मा देवमातुः पुरो हरिः दृष्टा समागतं विष्णुमदितिर्भक्तिसंयुता। मेने कृतार्थमात्मानं तोषयामास केशवम्
verses.wordMeaning: Those who are always enveloped by my Maya with the subtle darkness of ignorance, are born again and again in the terrible ocean in the worldly existence.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who are always enveloped by my Maya with the subtle darkness of ignorance, are born again and again in the terrible ocean in the worldly existence.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं कर्ता चैव भर्ता च निहन्ता सुरविद्विषाम् । त्रातुमर्हस्यनन्तेश त्राता हि परमेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ kartā caiva bhartā ca nihantā suravidviṣām / trātumarhasyananteśa trātā hi parameśvaraḥ
verses.translation: O King, it is with single-minded devotion and perfect knowledge that the Brahman should besought, for warding off the bondage of birth.
verses.hindi: नमो विष्णवे कालरूपाय तुभ्यं नमः कालरुद्राय संहारकर्त्रे नमो वासुदेवाय तुभ्यं नमस्ते
verses.wordMeaning: O King, it is with single-minded devotion and perfect knowledge that the Brahman should besought, for warding off the bondage of birth.
verses.commentary: Sense: O King, it is with single-minded devotion and perfect knowledge that the Brahman should besought, for warding off the bondage of birth.

verses.sanskrit: इत्थं स विष्णुर्भगवान् ब्रह्मणा संप्रबोधितः । प्रोवाचोन्निद्रपद्माक्षः पीतवासासुरद्विषः
verses.transliteration: itthaṃ sa viṣṇurbhagavān brahmaṇā saṃprabodhitaḥ / provāconnidrapadmākṣaḥ pītavāsāsuradviṣaḥ
verses.translation: One who has become one with the Brahman revels in his own soul, bestows fearlessness on all living beings. He attains spiritual powers and prosperity and great devotion, not conceiving anyone else (i.e. is exclusively devoted to me).
verses.hindi: नमो धर्मविज्ञाननिष्ठाय तुभ्यं नमस्ते वराहाय भूयो नमस्ते नमो वेदविज्ञानधर्माभिगम्य। नमो देवदेवादिदेवादिदेव प्रभो विश्वयोनेऽथ भूयो नमस्ते
verses.wordMeaning: One who has become one with the Brahman revels in his own soul, bestows fearlessness on all living beings. He attains spiritual powers and prosperity and great devotion, not conceiving anyone else (i.e. is exclusively devoted to me).
verses.commentary: Sense: One who has become one with the Brahman revels in his own soul, bestows fearlessness on all living beings. He attains spiritual powers and prosperity and great devotion, not conceiving anyone else (i.e. is exclusively devoted to me).

verses.sanskrit: किमर्थं सुमहावीर्याः सप्रजापतिकाः सुराः । इमं देशमनुप्राप्ताः किं वा कार्यं करोमि वः
verses.transliteration: kimarthaṃ sumahāvīryāḥ saprajāpatikāḥ surāḥ / imaṃ deśamanuprāptāḥ kiṃ vā kāryaṃ karomi vaḥ
verses.translation: That Supreme Reality, the lordly, unsullied, per¬ fect Brahman is perceived by him. Becoming free from all ties of all worldly existence, he stays established only in the Brahman itself.
verses.hindi: उनका वह बलि नामक महान् असुर पुत्र अभ्युदयकी प्राप्तिके लिये उसने इन्द्रको भी जीत लिया था। सभी देवताओंसे घिरे हुए इन्द्रने उसके साथ महान् युद्ध करते हुए पराजित होकर अच्युत विष्णुदेवकी शरण ग्रहण की
verses.wordMeaning: That Supreme Reality, the lordly, unsullied, per¬ fect Brahman is perceived by him. Becoming free from all ties of all worldly existence, he stays established only in the Brahman itself.
verses.commentary: Sense: That Supreme Reality, the lordly, unsullied, per¬ fect Brahman is perceived by him. Becoming free from all ties of all worldly existence, he stays established only in the Brahman itself.

verses.sanskrit: देवा ऊचुः हिरण्यकशिपुर्नाम ब्रह्मणो वरदर्पितः । बाधते भगवन् दैत्यो देवान् सर्वान् सहर्षिभिः
verses.transliteration: devā ūcuḥ hiraṇyakaśipurnāma brahmaṇo varadarpitaḥ / bādhate bhagavan daityo devān sarvān saharṣibhiḥ
verses.translation: The great Siva is the receptacle of the Supreme- Brahman. That great lord is non-different, unchanging and the support of the Atman.
verses.hindi: इसी बीच अत्यन्त दुःखी होकर देवताओंकी माता तपोराशि, परम तपोरूप देवी अदितिने हैत्येन्द्रोके वधके लिये “स्वयं भगवान् ही मेरे पुत्र हों' इस संकल्पको लेकर अत्यन्त महान् कठोर तप किया । अपने हृदयरूपी कमलकलिकामें निष्कल, परम पद, अनादि, अनन्त, आनन्दस्वरूप, व्योममय, अद्वितीय वासुदेवका ध्यान करती हुई वे शरणागतवत्सल अव्यक्त, हरि विष्णुकी शरणमें गयीं। प्रसन्न होकर शङ्ख-चक्र तथा गदा धारण
verses.wordMeaning: The great Siva is the receptacle of the Supreme- Brahman. That great lord is non-different, unchanging and the support of the Atman.
verses.commentary: Sense: The great Siva is the receptacle of the Supreme- Brahman. That great lord is non-different, unchanging and the support of the Atman.

verses.sanskrit: अवध्यः सर्वभूतानां त्वामृते पुरुषोत्तम । हन्तुमर्हसि सर्वेषां त्वं त्रातासि जगन्मय
verses.transliteration: avadhyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ tvāmṛte puruṣottama / hantumarhasi sarveṣāṃ tvaṃ trātāsi jaganmaya
verses.translation: O King, either through the path of perfect knowl¬ edge, or through the path of action or through that of devotion or through Yogic practice, seek asylum in ISvara for the purpose of liberation from all worldly existence.
verses.hindi: करनेवाले योगात्मा हरि भगवान् विष्णु देवमाता (अदिति)- के समक्ष प्रकट हो गये। विष्णुको सामने देखकर भक्तिपरायणा अदितिने अपनेको कृतार्थ माना और वे केशवको स्तुतिसे प्रसन्न करने लगीं॥ १४--१८॥ अदितिने कहा--समस्त दुःखसमूहोंके नाश करनेके लिये एकमात्र कारणरूप आपकी जय हो। अनन्त माहात्म्य-सम्पन्न तथा योगाभियुक्त! (योगमें प्रतिक्षण निरत) आपकी जय हो। आदि, मध्य और अन्तसे रहित
verses.wordMeaning: O King, either through the path of perfect knowl¬ edge, or through the path of action or through that of devotion or through Yogic practice, seek asylum in ISvara for the purpose of liberation from all worldly existence.
verses.commentary: Sense: O King, either through the path of perfect knowl¬ edge, or through the path of action or through that of devotion or through Yogic practice, seek asylum in ISvara for the purpose of liberation from all worldly existence.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा तद्दैवतैरुक्तं स विष्णुर्लोकभावनः । वधाय दैत्यमुख्यस्य सो ऽसृजत् पुरुषं स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: śrutvā taddaivatairuktaṃ sa viṣṇurlokabhāvanaḥ / vadhāya daityamukhyasya so 'sṛjat puruṣaṃ svayam
verses.translation: O Lord of mountains, this is the secret instruction that is imparted unto you by me. After pondering over this, it behoves you to do as you please.
verses.hindi: विज्ञानमूर्ते! आपकी जय हो। अशेषकल्प (जिनमें किसी भी प्रकारके विषयका विराम नहीं है) तथा विशुद्ध आनन्दस्वरूप! आपकी जय हो। कालरूप विष्णु! आपको नमस्कार है। नरसिंहरूपधारी शेष! आपको नमस्कार है। संहार करनेवाले कालरुद्रको नमस्कार है। वासुदेव! आपको बार-बार नमस्कार है। विश्वरूपी मायाका विधान करनेवाले! आपको नमस्कार है। योगद्वारा जानने योग्य सत्यरूप! आपको नमस्कार
verses.wordMeaning: O Lord of mountains, this is the secret instruction that is imparted unto you by me. After pondering over this, it behoves you to do as you please.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Lord of mountains, this is the secret instruction that is imparted unto you by me. After pondering over this, it behoves you to do as you please.

verses.sanskrit: मेरुपर्वतवर्ष्माणं घोररूपं भयानकम् । शङ्खचक्रगदापाणिं तं प्राह गरुडध्वजः
verses.transliteration: meruparvatavarṣmāṇaṃ ghorarūpaṃ bhayānakam / śaṅkhacakragadāpāṇiṃ taṃ prāha garuḍadhvajaḥ
verses.translation: At the bidding of the great-souled god Brahma, the universal Atman, you will give me to Rudra in the Svayarhvara type of marriage with him (where the bride selects her partner for life from among the suitors).
verses.hindi: है। धर्म एवं ज्ञाननिष्ठ! आपको नमस्कार है। है वराहरूप ! आपको बार-बार नमस्कार है। हजारों सूर्य और चन्द्रमाको आभाके समान प्रकाशयुक्त मूर्तिवाले! आपको नमस्कार है। वेदोंमें प्रतिपादित विशिष्ट ज्ञान और धर्मद्वारा प्रात होनेवाले! आपको नमस्कार है। देवदेवादिदेव आदिदेव! आपको नमस्कार है। प्रभो! आप विश्वके योनिरूप हैं, आपको बार-बार नमस्कार है
verses.wordMeaning: At the bidding of the great-souled god Brahma, the universal Atman, you will give me to Rudra in the Svayarhvara type of marriage with him (where the bride selects her partner for life from among the suitors).
verses.commentary: Sense: At the bidding of the great-souled god Brahma, the universal Atman, you will give me to Rudra in the Svayarhvara type of marriage with him (where the bride selects her partner for life from among the suitors).

verses.sanskrit: हत्वा तं दैत्यराजं त्वं हिरण्यकशिपुं पुनः । इमं देशं समागन्तुं क्षिप्रमर्हसि पौरुषात्
verses.transliteration: hatvā taṃ daityarājaṃ tvaṃ hiraṇyakaśipuṃ punaḥ / imaṃ deśaṃ samāgantuṃ kṣipramarhasi pauruṣāt
verses.translation: O King, on account that alliance, all Devos (gods) including Indra, will bow unto you. O father, god Sankara will become pleased thereby.
verses.hindi: शिवायैकरूपाय भूयो नमस्ते एवं स भगवान् कृष्णो देवमात्रा जगन्मयः । तोषितश्छन्दयामास वरेण प्रहसन्निव
verses.wordMeaning: O King, on account that alliance, all Devos (gods) including Indra, will bow unto you. O father, god Sankara will become pleased thereby.
verses.commentary: Sense: O King, on account that alliance, all Devos (gods) including Indra, will bow unto you. O father, god Sankara will become pleased thereby.

verses.sanskrit: निशम्य वैष्णवं वाक्यं प्रणम्य पुरुषोत्तमम् । महापुरुषमव्यक्तं ययौ दैत्यमहापुरम्
verses.transliteration: niśamya vaiṣṇavaṃ vākyaṃ praṇamya puruṣottamam / mahāpuruṣamavyaktaṃ yayau daityamahāpuram
verses.translation: Making all possible efforts, realise me who am a close companion of lord Siva. After worshipping lord Isana (Siva), seek refuge in him who is worthy of being the resort.
verses.hindi: त्वामेव पुत्रं देवानां हिताय वरये वरम् तथास्त्वित्याह भगवान् प्रपन्नजनवत्सलः। दत्त्वा बरानप्रमेयस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत
verses.wordMeaning: Making all possible efforts, realise me who am a close companion of lord Siva. After worshipping lord Isana (Siva), seek refuge in him who is worthy of being the resort.
verses.commentary: Sense: Making all possible efforts, realise me who am a close companion of lord Siva. After worshipping lord Isana (Siva), seek refuge in him who is worthy of being the resort.

verses.sanskrit: विमुञ्चन् भैरवं नादं शङ्खचक्रगदाधरः । आरुह्य गरुडं देवो महामेरुरिवापरः
verses.transliteration: vimuñcan bhairavaṃ nādaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ / āruhya garuḍaṃ devo mahāmerurivāparaḥ
verses.translation: Thus addressed by the goddess of Devas, Himavan, the king of mountains, bowed down his head before the goddess. With palms joined in reverence, he spoke again:
verses.hindi: ततो बहुतिथे काले भगवन्तं जनार्दनम्। दधार गर्भ देवानां माता नारायणं स्वयम् समाविष्टे हृषीकेशे देवमातुरथोदरम्। उत्पाता जज्ञिरे घोरा बलेर्वैरोचनेः पुरे
verses.wordMeaning: Thus addressed by the goddess of Devas, Himavan, the king of mountains, bowed down his head before the goddess. With palms joined in reverence, he spoke again:
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus addressed by the goddess of Devas, Himavan, the king of mountains, bowed down his head before the goddess. With palms joined in reverence, he spoke again:

verses.sanskrit: आकर्ण्य दैत्यप्रवरा महामेघरवोपमम् । समाचचक्षिरे नादं तदा दैत्यपतेर्भयात्
verses.transliteration: ākarṇya daityapravarā mahāmegharavopamam / samācacakṣire nādaṃ tadā daityapaterbhayāt
verses.translation: "O Consort of the Supreme Ruler! Be pleased m expound to me the Yoga pertaining to Mahesvara, the knowl¬ edge of the soul and the means of meditating on him."
verses.hindi: निरीक्ष्य सर्वानुत्पातान् हैत्येन्द्रो भयविह्वलः । किमुत्पाता भवेत् कार्यमस्माकं किंनिमित्तकाः
verses.wordMeaning: "O Consort of the Supreme Ruler! Be pleased m expound to me the Yoga pertaining to Mahesvara, the knowl¬ edge of the soul and the means of meditating on him."
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Consort of the Supreme Ruler! Be pleased m expound to me the Yoga pertaining to Mahesvara, the knowl¬ edge of the soul and the means of meditating on him."

verses.sanskrit: असुरा ऊचुः कश्चिदागच्छति महान् पुरुषो देवचोदितः । विमुञ्चन् भैरवं नादं तं जानीमो ऽमरार्दन
verses.transliteration: asurā ūcuḥ kaścidāgacchati mahān puruṣo devacoditaḥ / vimuñcan bhairavaṃ nādaṃ taṃ jānīmo 'marārdana
verses.translation: The great goddess narrated in details and in pre¬ cision to him, the great knowledge, the excellent Yoga of Atman and the means thereof.
verses.hindi: नमस्कृत्य हषीकेशमिदं वचनमब्रवीत् यो यज्ञैरिज्यते विष्णुर्यस्य सर्वमिदं जगत्। दधारासुरनाशार्थं माता तं त्रिदिवौकसाम्
verses.wordMeaning: The great goddess narrated in details and in pre¬ cision to him, the great knowledge, the excellent Yoga of Atman and the means thereof.
verses.commentary: Sense: The great goddess narrated in details and in pre¬ cision to him, the great knowledge, the excellent Yoga of Atman and the means thereof.

verses.sanskrit: ततः सहासुरवरैर्हिरण्यकशिपुः स्वयम् । संनद्धैः सायुधैः पुत्रैः प्रह्रादाद्यैस्तदा ययौ
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sahāsuravarairhiraṇyakaśipuḥ svayam / saṃnaddhaiḥ sāyudhaiḥ putraiḥ prahrādādyaistadā yayau
verses.translation: On hearing that great perfect knowledge from the lotus-like face of the mother of the worlds, the Lord of mountains who was worshipped by the entire world, became interested in Yogic meditation.
verses.hindi: स वासुदेवो देवानां मातुर्देह समाविशत् न यस्य देवा जानन्ति स्वरूपं परमार्थतः । स विष्णुरदितेर्देहं स्वेच्छयाऽद्य समाविशत्
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing that great perfect knowledge from the lotus-like face of the mother of the worlds, the Lord of mountains who was worshipped by the entire world, became interested in Yogic meditation.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing that great perfect knowledge from the lotus-like face of the mother of the worlds, the Lord of mountains who was worshipped by the entire world, became interested in Yogic meditation.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा तं गरुडासीनं सूर्यकोटिसमप्रभम् । पुरुषं पर्वताकारं नारायणमिवापरम्
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā taṃ garuḍāsīnaṃ sūryakoṭisamaprabham / puruṣaṃ parvatākāraṃ nārāyaṇamivāparam
verses.translation: As a result of the greatness of his great fortune and at the behest of god Brahma, he gave Parvatl, the chaste lady, unto Mahesvara (Siva), in the presence of all Devas.
verses.hindi: सोऽवतीर्णो महायोगी पुराणपुरुषो हरिः सत्यनिष्ठ शम्भो! आपको नमस्कार है। कारणरूप! विश्वरूप! आपको नमस्कार है। योगपीठके मध्यमें विराजमान रहनेवाले! आपको नमस्कार है। है एकरूप शिव! आपको बार-बार नमस्कार है
verses.wordMeaning: As a result of the greatness of his great fortune and at the behest of god Brahma, he gave Parvatl, the chaste lady, unto Mahesvara (Siva), in the presence of all Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: As a result of the greatness of his great fortune and at the behest of god Brahma, he gave Parvatl, the chaste lady, unto Mahesvara (Siva), in the presence of all Devas.

verses.sanskrit: दुद्रुवुः केचिदन्योन्ममूचुः संभ्रान्तलोचनाः । अयं स देवो देवानां गोप्ता नारायणो रिपुः
verses.transliteration: dudruvuḥ kecidanyonmamūcuḥ saṃbhrāntalocanāḥ / ayaṃ sa devo devānāṃ goptā nārāyaṇo ripuḥ
verses.translation: He who reads this Hymn near Brahmanas with con¬ centration of mind and mental purity becomes free from all sins.
verses.hindi: देवमाता (अदिति)-के द्वारा इस प्रकार प्रसन्न किये जानेपर जगन्मय उन भगवान् कृष्ण-(विष्णु)-ने किंचित् हँसते हुए वर माँगनेके लिये कहा
verses.wordMeaning: He who reads this Hymn near Brahmanas with con¬ centration of mind and mental purity becomes free from all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who reads this Hymn near Brahmanas with con¬ centration of mind and mental purity becomes free from all sins.

verses.sanskrit: अस्माकमव्ययो नूनं तत्सुतो वा समागतः । इत्युक्त्वा शस्त्रवर्षाणि ससृजुः पुरुषाय ते । तानि चाशेषतो देवो नाशयामास लीलया
verses.transliteration: asmākamavyayo nūnaṃ tatsuto vā samāgataḥ / ityuktvā śastravarṣāṇi sasṛjuḥ puruṣāya te / tāni cāśeṣato devo nāśayāmāsa līlayā
verses.translation: Or the Brahmana shall be reborn in the pure family of a Brahmana and thanks to the greatness of the pre¬ vious impressions, he shall attain the spiritual lore about the Brahman {Brahma-Vidya).
verses.hindi: सिरसे भूमिमें प्रणाम करते हुए तथा श्रेष्ठ वर माँगते हुए उसने (अदितिने) कहा--मैं देवताओंके कल्याणके लिये आपको ही पुत्ररूपमें प्राप्त करनेका वर माँगती हूँ। शरणागतवत्सल अप्रमेय भगवान् 'ऐसा ही हो' इतना कहकर तथा बरोंको प्रदानकर वहींपर अन्तर्धान हो गये
verses.wordMeaning: Or the Brahmana shall be reborn in the pure family of a Brahmana and thanks to the greatness of the pre¬ vious impressions, he shall attain the spiritual lore about the Brahman {Brahma-Vidya).
verses.commentary: Sense: Or the Brahmana shall be reborn in the pure family of a Brahmana and thanks to the greatness of the pre¬ vious impressions, he shall attain the spiritual lore about the Brahman {Brahma-Vidya).

verses.sanskrit: तदा हिरण्यकशिपोश्चत्वारः प्रथितौजसः । पुत्रा नारायणोद्भूतं युयुधुर्मेघनिः स्वनाः । प्रह्रादश्चाप्यनुह्रादः संह्रादो ह्राद एव च
verses.transliteration: tadā hiraṇyakaśipoścatvāraḥ prathitaujasaḥ / putrā nārāyaṇodbhūtaṃ yuyudhurmeghaniḥ svanāḥ / prahrādaścāpyanuhrādaḥ saṃhrādo hrāda eva ca
verses.translation: After attaining the great divine Yoga of Parames- vara, he becomes quiescent and fully controlled and attains. Sdyujya (identity) with Siva.
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर बहुत समय बीतनेके पश्चात् देवताओंको माता (अदिति)-ने साक्षात् नारायण भगवान् जनार्दनको गर्भमै धारण किया। देवमाताके उदरमें हृषीकेशके प्रविष्ट होते ही विरोचनपुत्र बलिके नगरमें भयंकर उत्पात होने लगे। सभी उपद्रबोंको देखकर भयसे विहल हुआ हैत्यराज (बलि) वृद्ध पितामह असुर प्रहादको प्रणामकर कहने लगा--
verses.wordMeaning: After attaining the great divine Yoga of Parames- vara, he becomes quiescent and fully controlled and attains. Sdyujya (identity) with Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: After attaining the great divine Yoga of Parames- vara, he becomes quiescent and fully controlled and attains. Sdyujya (identity) with Siva.

verses.sanskrit: प्रह्रादः प्राहिणोद् ब्राह्ममनुह्रादो ऽथ वैष्णवम् । संह्रादश्चापि कौमारमाग्नेयं ह्राद एव च
verses.transliteration: prahrādaḥ prāhiṇod brāhmamanuhrādo 'tha vaiṣṇavam / saṃhrādaścāpi kaumāramāgneyaṃ hrāda eva ca
verses.translation: He who, at each of three (morning, midday and evening) sessions of Homa, oblates offerings one per each name (v.l. epithet of the goddess mentioned above) becomes free from the evil effects of epidemics (like cholera) and malefic planets.
verses.hindi: बलिने कहा--महाप्राज्ञ पितामह! हमारे नगरमें इस समय ये उत्पात क्यों हो रहे हैं, इनका कारण क्या है? हमें क्या करना चाहिए? उसकी बात सुनकर महासुर (प्रह्माद)-ने देरतक ध्यान किया और फिर हषीकेशको नमस्कार करके यह वचन कहा-
verses.wordMeaning: He who, at each of three (morning, midday and evening) sessions of Homa, oblates offerings one per each name (v.l. epithet of the goddess mentioned above) becomes free from the evil effects of epidemics (like cholera) and malefic planets.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who, at each of three (morning, midday and evening) sessions of Homa, oblates offerings one per each name (v.l. epithet of the goddess mentioned above) becomes free from the evil effects of epidemics (like cholera) and malefic planets.

verses.sanskrit: तानि तं पुरुषं प्राप्य चत्वार्यस्त्राणि वैष्णवम् । न शेकुर्बाधितुं विष्णुं वासुदेवं यथा तथा
verses.transliteration: tāni taṃ puruṣaṃ prāpya catvāryastrāṇi vaiṣṇavam / na śekurbādhituṃ viṣṇuṃ vāsudevaṃ yathā tathā
verses.translation: One who is desirous of attaining prosperity shall duly perform the worship of the goddess Parvatl and repeat Japa every day for a year, with great attention.
verses.hindi: प्रह्लाद बोले--यज्ञोंद्वारा जिन विष्णुका यजन किया जाता है और यह सम्पूर्ण विश्व जिनका (स्वरूप) है, देवताओंकी माता (अदिति)-ने उन्हें ही असुरोंके विनाशके लिये (गर्भमें) धारण किया है! समस्त विश्व जिनसे अभिन्न है और जो समस्त विश्वसे भिन्न भी है, उन वासुदेवने देवताओंकी माताके शरीरमें प्रवेश किया है। देवता भी जिनके स्वरूपको यथार्थतः नहीं जानते वे विष्णु ही इस समय अपनी इच्छासे अदितिके देहमें
verses.wordMeaning: One who is desirous of attaining prosperity shall duly perform the worship of the goddess Parvatl and repeat Japa every day for a year, with great attention.
verses.commentary: Sense: One who is desirous of attaining prosperity shall duly perform the worship of the goddess Parvatl and repeat Japa every day for a year, with great attention.

verses.sanskrit: अथासौ चतुरः पुत्रान् महाबाहुर्महाबलः । प्रगृह्य पादेषु करैः संचिक्षेप ननाद च
verses.transliteration: athāsau caturaḥ putrān mahābāhurmahābalaḥ / pragṛhya pādeṣu karaiḥ saṃcikṣepa nanāda ca
verses.translation: After worshipping the three-eyed Sambhu with great devotion side by side with her, the devotee derives great fortune, thanks to the grace of Mahadeva.
verses.hindi: प्रविष्ट हुए हैं जिनसे सम्पूर्ण प्राणी उत्पन्न होते हैं और जहाँ नाशको प्राप्त होते हैं वे महायोगी पुराणपुरुष हरि अवतीर्ण हुए हँ
verses.wordMeaning: After worshipping the three-eyed Sambhu with great devotion side by side with her, the devotee derives great fortune, thanks to the grace of Mahadeva.
verses.commentary: Sense: After worshipping the three-eyed Sambhu with great devotion side by side with her, the devotee derives great fortune, thanks to the grace of Mahadeva.

verses.sanskrit: विमुक्तेष्वथ पुत्रेषु हिरण्यकशिपुः स्वयम् । पादेन ताडयामास वेगेनोरसि तं बली
verses.transliteration: vimukteṣvatha putreṣu hiraṇyakaśipuḥ svayam / pādena tāḍayāmāsa vegenorasi taṃ balī
verses.translation: Hence, in order to ward ofT all sins, the thousand names of the goddess should be recited as used for Japa, by the twice-born ones in all earnestness.
verses.hindi: सत्तामात्रात्मरूपोऽसौ विष्णुरंशेन जायते यस्य सा जगतां माता शक्तिस्तद्धर्मधारिणी । माया भगवती लक्ष्मी: सोऽवतीर्णो जनार्दन:
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, in order to ward ofT all sins, the thousand names of the goddess should be recited as used for Japa, by the twice-born ones in all earnestness.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, in order to ward ofT all sins, the thousand names of the goddess should be recited as used for Japa, by the twice-born ones in all earnestness.

verses.sanskrit: स तेन पीडितो ऽत्यर्थं गरुडेन तथाऽशुगः । अदृश्यः प्रययौ तूर्णं यत्र नारायणः प्रभुः । गत्वा विज्ञापयामास प्रवृत्तमखिलं तथा
verses.transliteration: sa tena pīḍito 'tyarthaṃ garuḍena tathā'śugaḥ / adṛśyaḥ prayayau tūrṇaṃ yatra nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ / gatvā vijñāpayāmāsa pravṛttamakhilaṃ tathā
verses.translation: "O Brahmanas, (as a casual reference) the excellent greatness of the goddess has been recounted incidently. Henceforth, listen and understand the creation of subjects by Bhrgu and others."
verses.hindi: यस्य सा तामसी मूर्ति: शंकरो राजसी तनु: । ब्रह्मा संजायते विष्णुरंशेनेकेन सत्त्वभृत् जगाम शरणं विश्वं पालयामास धर्मतः
verses.wordMeaning: "O Brahmanas, (as a casual reference) the excellent greatness of the goddess has been recounted incidently. Henceforth, listen and understand the creation of subjects by Bhrgu and others."
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Brahmanas, (as a casual reference) the excellent greatness of the goddess has been recounted incidently. Henceforth, listen and understand the creation of subjects by Bhrgu and others."

verses.sanskrit: संचिन्त्य मनसा देवः सर्वज्ञानमयो ऽमलः । नरस्यार्धतनुं कृत्वा सिंहस्यार्धतनुं तथा
verses.transliteration: saṃcintya manasā devaḥ sarvajñānamayo 'malaḥ / narasyārdhatanuṃ kṛtvā siṃhasyārdhatanuṃ tathā
verses.translation: It is probably Samyasa. HD. II. 1. 417 gives a number of synonyms for sannydsin viz. parivrdf, parivrdjaka, bhiksu, muni, yati but this des¬ criptive name of dSrama is not given in it.
verses.hindi: काले प्रासे महाविष्णुं देवानां हर्षवर्धनम्। असूत कश्यपाच्चैनं देवमातादितिः स्वयम् नीलमेघप्रतीकाशं भ्राजमानं श्रियावृतम्
verses.wordMeaning: It is probably Samyasa. HD. II. 1. 417 gives a number of synonyms for sannydsin viz. parivrdf, parivrdjaka, bhiksu, muni, yati but this des¬ criptive name of dSrama is not given in it.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is probably Samyasa. HD. II. 1. 417 gives a number of synonyms for sannydsin viz. parivrdf, parivrdjaka, bhiksu, muni, yati but this des¬ criptive name of dSrama is not given in it.

verses.sanskrit: नृसिंहवपुरव्यक्तो हिरण्यकशिपोः पुरे । आविर्बभूव सहसा मोहयन् दैत्यपुङ्गवान्
verses.transliteration: nṛsiṃhavapuravyakto hiraṇyakaśipoḥ pure / āvirbabhūva sahasā mohayan daityapuṅgavān
verses.translation: Instead of this reading {dhydyanto) viSvam aiSvaram the Ft. Note ( in our Vehkatesvara Press—Text) gives a better reading: mskalam divam I "meditating on the perfect, indivisible Siva".
verses.hindi: उपेन्द्रमिन्द्रप्रमुखा ब्रह्मा चर्षिगणैर्वृतः कृतोपनयनो वेदानध्यैष्ट भगवान् हरिः। समाचारं भरद्वाजात् त्रिलोकाय प्रदर्शयन्
verses.wordMeaning: Instead of this reading {dhydyanto) viSvam aiSvaram the Ft. Note ( in our Vehkatesvara Press—Text) gives a better reading: mskalam divam I "meditating on the perfect, indivisible Siva".
verses.commentary: Sense: Instead of this reading {dhydyanto) viSvam aiSvaram the Ft. Note ( in our Vehkatesvara Press—Text) gives a better reading: mskalam divam I "meditating on the perfect, indivisible Siva".

verses.sanskrit: दंष्ट्राकरालो योगात्मा युगान्तदहनोपमः । समारुह्यात्मनः शक्तिं सर्वसंहारकारिकाम् । भाति नारायणो ऽनन्तो यथा मध्यन्दिने रविः
verses.transliteration: daṃṣṭrākarālo yogātmā yugāntadahanopamaḥ / samāruhyātmanaḥ śaktiṃ sarvasaṃhārakārikām / bhāti nārāyaṇo 'nanto yathā madhyandine raviḥ
verses.translation: Sisti and Bhavya were born of Dhruva and Sambhu was born of Bhavya.
verses.hindi: स यत् प्रमाणं कुरुते लोकस्तदनुवर्तते ततः कालेन मतिमान् बलिवैरोचनिः स्वयम्। यज्ञर्यज्ञेश्वरं विष्णुमर्चयामास सर्वगम्
verses.wordMeaning: Sisti and Bhavya were born of Dhruva and Sambhu was born of Bhavya.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sisti and Bhavya were born of Dhruva and Sambhu was born of Bhavya.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा नृसिंहवपुषं प्रह्रादं ज्येष्ठपुत्रकम् । वधाय प्रेरयामास नरसिहस्य सो ऽसुरः
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā nṛsiṃhavapuṣaṃ prahrādaṃ jyeṣṭhaputrakam / vadhāya prerayāmāsa narasihasya so 'suraḥ
verses.translation: Sambhuti bore the son Purnamasa to Marici as well as four daughters endowed with all auspicious characteristics.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मर्षयः समाजग्मुर्यज्ञवाटं महात्मन: विज्ञाय विष्णुर्भगवान् भरद्वाजप्रचोदितः। आस्थाय वामनं रूपं यज्ञदेशमथागमत्
verses.wordMeaning: Sambhuti bore the son Purnamasa to Marici as well as four daughters endowed with all auspicious characteristics.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sambhuti bore the son Purnamasa to Marici as well as four daughters endowed with all auspicious characteristics.

verses.sanskrit: इमं नृसिंहवपुषं पूर्वस्माद् बहुशक्तिकम् । सहैव त्वनुजैः सर्वैर्नाशयाशु मयेरितः
verses.transliteration: imaṃ nṛsiṃhavapuṣaṃ pūrvasmād bahuśaktikam / sahaiva tvanujaiḥ sarvairnāśayāśu mayeritaḥ
verses.translation: Tusti was the eldest. Then came Vrsti, Krsti and Apaciti. The two sons of Purnamasa were Virajas and Parvata.
verses.hindi: सम्प्राप्यासुरराजस्य समीपं भिक्षुको हरिः। स्वपाहैर्विमितं देशमयाचत बलिं त्रिभिः जिनमें नाम, जाति आदिकी परिकल्पना नहीं होती, सत्तामात्रसे व्याप्त रहनेवाले आत्मरूप वे ही विष्णु अपने अंशरूपसे प्रकट हो रहे हैं। जगत्की मातृरूपा और उसके (जगत्के) धर्मको धारण करनेवाली, भगवती लक्ष्मी
verses.wordMeaning: Tusti was the eldest. Then came Vrsti, Krsti and Apaciti. The two sons of Purnamasa were Virajas and Parvata.
verses.commentary: Sense: Tusti was the eldest. Then came Vrsti, Krsti and Apaciti. The two sons of Purnamasa were Virajas and Parvata.

verses.sanskrit: तत्संनियोगादसुरः प्रह्रादो विष्णुमव्ययम् । युयुधे सर्वयत्नेन नरसिंहेन निर्जितः
verses.transliteration: tatsaṃniyogādasuraḥ prahrādo viṣṇumavyayam / yuyudhe sarvayatnena narasiṃhena nirjitaḥ
verses.translation: They were—Anga, Sumanas, Khyati, Kratu, Angirasa and Siva. Afterwards Vena was born of Anga. Vainya (alias Prthu) was born of Vena.
verses.hindi: जिनकी मायारूपी शक्ति हैं, वे जनार्दन ही अवतीर्ण हुए हैं। जिनकी तामसी मूर्ति शंकर हैं और राजसी मूर्ति ब्रह्मा हैं वे सत्त्वगुणको धारण करनेवाले विष्णु ही अपने एक अंशसे प्रकट हो रहे हें गोविन्दको इस प्रकार समझकर भक्तिसे विनप्र- चित्त हो उन्हींकी शरणमें जाओ, इससे तुम शान्ति प्राप्त करोगे। तब प्रह्णादके वचनसे विरोचनपुत्र बलि हरिकी शरण ग्रहण करता हुआ धर्मपूर्वक विश्वका पालन करने
verses.wordMeaning: They were—Anga, Sumanas, Khyati, Kratu, Angirasa and Siva. Afterwards Vena was born of Anga. Vainya (alias Prthu) was born of Vena.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were—Anga, Sumanas, Khyati, Kratu, Angirasa and Siva. Afterwards Vena was born of Anga. Vainya (alias Prthu) was born of Vena.

verses.sanskrit: ततः संचोदितो दैत्यो हिरण्याक्षस्तदानुजः । ध्यात्वा पशुपतेरस्त्रं ससर्ज च ननाद च
verses.transliteration: tataḥ saṃcodito daityo hiraṇyākṣastadānujaḥ / dhyātvā paśupaterastraṃ sasarja ca nanāda ca
verses.translation: Santati gave birth to sixty thousand sons from Kratu. All of them were of sublimated sexuality and are called Ba (Va) lakhilyas.
verses.hindi: समय आनेपर कश्यपसे स्वयं देवमाता अदितिने दिया। वे (भगवान् विष्णु) चार भुजावाले, विशाल नेत्रवाले, श्रीवत्ससे सुशोभित वक्षःस्थलवाले, नीले मेघके समान, शोभासे व्याप्त एवं प्रकाशमान थे। सभी
verses.wordMeaning: Santati gave birth to sixty thousand sons from Kratu. All of them were of sublimated sexuality and are called Ba (Va) lakhilyas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Santati gave birth to sixty thousand sons from Kratu. All of them were of sublimated sexuality and are called Ba (Va) lakhilyas.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य देवादिदेवस्य विष्णोरमिततेजसः । न हानिमकरोदस्त्रं यथा देवस्य शूलिनः
verses.transliteration: tasya devādidevasya viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ / na hānimakarodastraṃ yathā devasya śūlinaḥ
verses.translation: Svaha bore three dignified sons of great prowess, O Brahmanas, to Vahni (fire), the son ofBrahma and of the form of Rudra.
verses.hindi: ऋषिगणोंसे आवृत ब्रह्मा उनके समीपमें गये। उपनयन (यज्ञोपवीत-संस्कार) हो जानेके बाद भगवान् हरिने तीनों लोकोंको प्रदर्शित करते हुए भरद्वाजसे वेदों और सदाचारका अध्ययन किया॥ ४१--४४॥ इस प्रकार वे प्रभु लौकिक (लोक-कल्याणकारी) मार्ग दिखाते हैं। वे जैसा प्रमाण उपस्थित करते हैं, संसार उसीका अनुवर्तन करता है। तदनन्तर समयानुसार विरोचनके पुत्र बुद्धिमान् बलिने यज्ञोंके द्वारा सर्वव्यापी
verses.wordMeaning: Svaha bore three dignified sons of great prowess, O Brahmanas, to Vahni (fire), the son ofBrahma and of the form of Rudra.
verses.commentary: Sense: Svaha bore three dignified sons of great prowess, O Brahmanas, to Vahni (fire), the son ofBrahma and of the form of Rudra.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा पराहतं त्वस्त्रं प्रह्रादो भाग्यगौरवात् । मेने सर्वात्मकं देवं वासुदेवं सनातनम्
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā parāhataṃ tvastraṃ prahrādo bhāgyagauravāt / mene sarvātmakaṃ devaṃ vāsudevaṃ sanātanam
verses.translation: They were Pavaka, Pavamana and Suciragni or Suci. The fire produced by attrition is called Pavamana; the fire from lightning is called as Pavaka.
verses.hindi: यज्ञेश्वर विष्णुकी स्वयं अर्चना की  उसने (दक्षिणारूपमें) बहुत-सा धन देकर ब्राह्मणोंकी पूजा की । उस महात्माके यज्ञस्थलमें ब्रह्मर्षि आये। (यज्ञ हो रहा है ऐसा) जानकर भरद्वाजसे प्रेरणा प्राप्तकर भगवान् विष्णु वामनरूप धारणकर यज्ञदेशमें आये॥ ४५--४८ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: They were Pavaka, Pavamana and Suciragni or Suci. The fire produced by attrition is called Pavamana; the fire from lightning is called as Pavaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were Pavaka, Pavamana and Suciragni or Suci. The fire produced by attrition is called Pavamana; the fire from lightning is called as Pavaka.

verses.sanskrit: संत्यज्य सर्वशस्त्राणि सत्त्वयुक्तेन चेतसा । ननाम शिरसा देवं योगिनां हृदयेशयम्
verses.transliteration: saṃtyajya sarvaśastrāṇi sattvayuktena cetasā / nanāma śirasā devaṃ yogināṃ hṛdayeśayam
verses.translation: Going up to the mountain Govardhana, he perform¬ ed a penance after subduing the sense-organs. Lord Visnu the wielder of a conch, a discus and the iron club was delighted at his penance.
verses.hindi: शरीरपर कुष्णमृगका चर्म तथा उपवीत (यज्ञोपवीत- जनेऊ) धारण किये, पलाशके दण्डसे सुशोभित, जटा धारण किये तथा भस्मसे मण्डित वे ब्राह्मण बेदमन्त्रोंका उच्चारण करते हुए असुरराज बलिके समीप आये। उन भिक्षुक (वेशधारी) हरिने बलिसे अपने तीन पगोंद्वारा नापी गयी भूमिको याचना की
verses.wordMeaning: Going up to the mountain Govardhana, he perform¬ ed a penance after subduing the sense-organs. Lord Visnu the wielder of a conch, a discus and the iron club was delighted at his penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: Going up to the mountain Govardhana, he perform¬ ed a penance after subduing the sense-organs. Lord Visnu the wielder of a conch, a discus and the iron club was delighted at his penance.

verses.sanskrit: स्तुत्वा नारायणैः स्तोत्रैः ऋग्यजुः सामसंभवैः । निवार्य पितरं भ्रातृन् हिरण्याक्षं तदाब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: stutvā nārāyaṇaiḥ stotraiḥ ṛgyajuḥ sāmasaṃbhavaiḥ / nivārya pitaraṃ bhrātṛn hiraṇyākṣaṃ tadābravīt
verses.translation: The son of Vena had unswerving devotion. He ruled over his kingdom in accordance with the injunctions of the Vedas constantly thinking over and remembering Madhusudana (or Visnu).
verses.hindi: प्रीणातु देवो हरिरव्ययाकृतिः। विचिन्त्य देवस्य कराग्रपल्लवे मथान्तरिक्षं दिवमादिदेवः।
verses.wordMeaning: The son of Vena had unswerving devotion. He ruled over his kingdom in accordance with the injunctions of the Vedas constantly thinking over and remembering Madhusudana (or Visnu).
verses.commentary: Sense: The son of Vena had unswerving devotion. He ruled over his kingdom in accordance with the injunctions of the Vedas constantly thinking over and remembering Madhusudana (or Visnu).

verses.sanskrit: अयं नारायणो ऽनन्तः शाश्वतो भगवानजः । पुराणपुरुषो देवो महायोगी जगन्मयः
verses.transliteration: ayaṃ nārāyaṇo 'nantaḥ śāśvato bhagavānajaḥ / purāṇapuruṣo devo mahāyogī jaganmayaḥ
verses.translation: Ere long, his wife (Antardhana) of slender limbs and pure smiles gave birth to Sikhandin and Havirdhana through Antardhana (internal meditation).
verses.hindi: प्रकर्तुकामः शरणं प्रपन्नम् आक्रम्य लोकत्रयमीशपादः
verses.wordMeaning: Ere long, his wife (Antardhana) of slender limbs and pure smiles gave birth to Sikhandin and Havirdhana through Antardhana (internal meditation).
verses.commentary: Sense: Ere long, his wife (Antardhana) of slender limbs and pure smiles gave birth to Sikhandin and Havirdhana through Antardhana (internal meditation).

verses.sanskrit: अयं धाता विधाता च स्वयञ्ज्योतिर्निरञ्जनः । प्रधानपुरुषस्तत्त्वं मूलप्रकृतिरव्ययः
verses.transliteration: ayaṃ dhātā vidhātā ca svayañjyotirnirañjanaḥ / pradhānapuruṣastattvaṃ mūlaprakṛtiravyayaḥ
verses.translation: A son who became famous by the name Susila was born to Sikhandin. He was righteous, endowed with beauty and a master of the Vedas and the Vedahgas.
verses.hindi: प्राजापत्याद् ब्रह्मलोकं जगाम। ये तत्र लोके निवसन्ति सिद्धाः ५४॥ अथोपतस्थे भगवाननादिः
verses.wordMeaning: A son who became famous by the name Susila was born to Sikhandin. He was righteous, endowed with beauty and a master of the Vedas and the Vedahgas.
verses.commentary: Sense: A son who became famous by the name Susila was born to Sikhandin. He was righteous, endowed with beauty and a master of the Vedas and the Vedahgas.

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वरः सर्वभूतानामन्तर्यामी गुणातिगः । गच्छध्वमेनं शरणं विष्णुमव्यक्तमव्ययम्
