verses.transliteration: īśvaraḥ sarvabhūtānāmantaryāmī guṇātigaḥ / gacchadhvamenaṃ śaraṇaṃ viṣṇumavyaktamavyayam
verses.translation: He studied the Vedas duly and virtuously and was established in penance. As good luck would have it, that knower of Dharma became inclined towards renunciation.
verses.hindi: पितामहस्तोषयामास विष्णुम्। गङ्केत्युक्ता ब्रह्मणा व्योमसंस्था
verses.wordMeaning: He studied the Vedas duly and virtuously and was established in penance. As good luck would have it, that knower of Dharma became inclined towards renunciation.
verses.commentary: Sense: He studied the Vedas duly and virtuously and was established in penance. As good luck would have it, that knower of Dharma became inclined towards renunciation.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्ते सुदुर्बुद्धिर्हिरण्यकशिपुः स्वयम् । प्रोवाच पुत्रमत्यर्थं मोहितो विष्णुमायया
verses.transliteration: evamukte sudurbuddhirhiraṇyakaśipuḥ svayam / provāca putramatyarthaṃ mohito viṣṇumāyayā
verses.translation: Eager that he was in the Self study (of the Vedas) and the performance of penance he resorted to holy centres.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्माणमेकं पुरुषं स्वबीजम्। दृष्टा देवास्तत्र तत्र स्तुवन्ति
verses.wordMeaning: Eager that he was in the Self study (of the Vedas) and the performance of penance he resorted to holy centres.
verses.commentary: Sense: Eager that he was in the Self study (of the Vedas) and the performance of penance he resorted to holy centres.

verses.sanskrit: अयं सर्वात्मना वध्यो नृसिंहो ऽल्पपराक्रमः । समागतो ऽस्मद्भवनमिदानीं कालचोदितः
verses.transliteration: ayaṃ sarvātmanā vadhyo nṛsiṃho 'lpaparākramaḥ / samāgato 'smadbhavanamidānīṃ kālacoditaḥ
verses.translation: There he saw a holy forest named Dhamnavana which affords the achievement of Dharma—a place accessible to the Yogins and inaccessible to the haters of Brahman.
verses.hindi: आलोक्य तं पुरुषं विश्वकायं महान् बलिर्भक्तियोगेन विष्णुम्। ननाम नारायणमेकमव्ययं स्वचेतसा यं प्रणमन्ति देवाः ५८ ॥ तमब्रवीद् भगवानादिकर्ता भूत्वा पुनर्वामनो वासुदेवः।
verses.wordMeaning: There he saw a holy forest named Dhamnavana which affords the achievement of Dharma—a place accessible to the Yogins and inaccessible to the haters of Brahman.
verses.commentary: Sense: There he saw a holy forest named Dhamnavana which affords the achievement of Dharma—a place accessible to the Yogins and inaccessible to the haters of Brahman.

verses.sanskrit: विहस्य पितरं पुत्रो वचः प्राह महामतिः । मा निन्दस्वैनमीशानं भूतानामेकमव्ययम्
verses.transliteration: vihasya pitaraṃ putro vacaḥ prāha mahāmatiḥ / mā nindasvainamīśānaṃ bhūtānāmekamavyayam
verses.translation: A very holy and pure river named Mandakini flowed there. It was endowed with clusterous growth of red and blue lotuses and was bedecked with the hermitages of the Siddhas.
verses.hindi: ममैव हैत्याधिपतेऽधुनेदं लोकत्रयं भवता भावदत्तम्
verses.wordMeaning: A very holy and pure river named Mandakini flowed there. It was endowed with clusterous growth of red and blue lotuses and was bedecked with the hermitages of the Siddhas.
verses.commentary: Sense: A very holy and pure river named Mandakini flowed there. It was endowed with clusterous growth of red and blue lotuses and was bedecked with the hermitages of the Siddhas.

verses.sanskrit: कथं देवो महादेवः शाश्वतः कालवर्जितः । कालेन हन्यते विष्णुः कालात्मा कालरूपधृक्
verses.transliteration: kathaṃ devo mahādevaḥ śāśvataḥ kālavarjitaḥ / kālena hanyate viṣṇuḥ kālātmā kālarūpadhṛk
verses.translation: On its southern bank, he saw a beautiful and very holy hermitage occupied by leading sages and Yogins and felt delighted.
verses.hindi: प्रणम्य मूर्ध्ना पुनरेव हैत्यो निपातयामास जलं कराग्रे। बलिने भावपूर्वक विष्णुके दोनों चरणोंको धोकर स्वर्णनिर्मित भृङ्गार (टोटीदार पात्र) लेकर उन्हें आचमन कराया और “मैं आपको आपके ही तीन पगवाली (भूमि) देता हूँ, इससे अव्यय आकृतिवाले देव हरि
verses.wordMeaning: On its southern bank, he saw a beautiful and very holy hermitage occupied by leading sages and Yogins and felt delighted.
verses.commentary: Sense: On its southern bank, he saw a beautiful and very holy hermitage occupied by leading sages and Yogins and felt delighted.

verses.sanskrit: ततः सुवर्णकशिपुर्दुरात्मा विधिचोदितः । निवारितो ऽपि पुत्रेण युयोध हरिमव्ययम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ suvarṇakaśipurdurātmā vidhicoditaḥ / nivārito 'pi putreṇa yuyodha harimavyayam
verses.translation: He propitiated Girisa (god Siva) by means of (reciting) Rudradhyaya and the CanVa (narrative) of Rudra, as well as by many different kinds of hymns of Sambhu, taken from the Vedas.
verses.hindi: प्रसन्न हों' ऐसा संकल्पकर उन देवके कराग्रपल्लबपर सुशीतल जल गिराया। शरणमें आये हुए उस हैत्यराजको आसक्तिरहित बनानेकी इच्छासे उन आदिदेवने पृथ्वी, अन्तरिक्ष और झुलोकमें पाद-विक्षेप किया। तीनों लोकोंको आक्रान्तकर ईश्वरका चरण प्रजापतिके लोकसे ब्रह्मलोकमें पहुँचा। उस लोकमें निवास करनेवाले जो सिद्धजन थे, उन्होंने हजारों आदित्यके समान (प्रकाशमान)
verses.wordMeaning: He propitiated Girisa (god Siva) by means of (reciting) Rudradhyaya and the CanVa (narrative) of Rudra, as well as by many different kinds of hymns of Sambhu, taken from the Vedas.
verses.commentary: Sense: He propitiated Girisa (god Siva) by means of (reciting) Rudradhyaya and the CanVa (narrative) of Rudra, as well as by many different kinds of hymns of Sambhu, taken from the Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: संरक्तनयनो ऽन्तो हिरण्यनयनाग्रजम् । नखैर्विदारयामास प्रह्रादस्यैव पश्यतः
verses.transliteration: saṃraktanayano 'nto hiraṇyanayanāgrajam / nakhairvidārayāmāsa prahrādasyaiva paśyataḥ
verses.translation: In the meantime (while praying) he saw the great sage named Svetasvatara coming. He was the most excellent among the great devotees of Pasupati (god Siva).
verses.hindi: उस चरणको प्रणाम किया॥ ५१--५४॥ तदनन्तर अनादि भगवान् पितामहने वहाँ उपस्थित होकर विष्णुको प्रसन्न किया। उस ब्रह्माण्डके ऊपरी कपालको भेदकर पुनः वह चरण दिव्य आवरणोंमें चला गया। उस अण्डका भेदन होनेसे पुण्य करनेवालाँद्वारा सेवित वह शीतल महाजल नीचे गिरा। तभीसे आकाशमें
verses.wordMeaning: In the meantime (while praying) he saw the great sage named Svetasvatara coming. He was the most excellent among the great devotees of Pasupati (god Siva).
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meantime (while praying) he saw the great sage named Svetasvatara coming. He was the most excellent among the great devotees of Pasupati (god Siva).

verses.sanskrit: हते हिरण्यकशिपौ हिरण्याक्षो महाबलः । विसृज्य पुत्रं प्रह्रादं दुद्रुवे भयविह्वलः
verses.transliteration: hate hiraṇyakaśipau hiraṇyākṣo mahābalaḥ / visṛjya putraṃ prahrādaṃ dudruve bhayavihvalaḥ
verses.translation: He had applied Bhasma (ashes) all over his limbs. The loin cloth was the only covering garment he had. His body was emaciated due to the performance of penance. He was wearing a white sacred thread.
verses.hindi: स्थित वह नदियोंमें श्रेष्ठ नदी प्रवर्तित हुई जिसे ब्रह्माने 'गङ्गा' नामसे अभिहित किया ईश्वरका वह चरण महान्, प्रधान, प्रकृति, स्वबीज- स्वरूप अद्वितीय पुरुष ब्रह्मपर्यन्त पहुँचकर स्थित हो गया। उस अव्यय पदका दर्शनकर विभिन्न स्थानोंके
verses.wordMeaning: He had applied Bhasma (ashes) all over his limbs. The loin cloth was the only covering garment he had. His body was emaciated due to the performance of penance. He was wearing a white sacred thread.
verses.commentary: Sense: He had applied Bhasma (ashes) all over his limbs. The loin cloth was the only covering garment he had. His body was emaciated due to the performance of penance. He was wearing a white sacred thread.

verses.sanskrit: अनुह्रादादयः पुत्रा अन्ये च शतशो ऽसुराः । नृसिंहदेहसंभूतैः सिंहैर्नोता यमालयम्
verses.transliteration: anuhrādādayaḥ putrā anye ca śataśo 'surāḥ / nṛsiṃhadehasaṃbhūtaiḥ siṃhairnotā yamālayam
verses.translation: After concluding his eulogy of Sambhu, he bowed down his head at his feet. His eyes were rendered dim due to tears (ofjoy). With palms joined in reverence, he spoke these words.
verses.hindi: विष्णुको देखकर महान् बलिने उन अद्वितीय अव्यय नारायणको अपने भक्तिपूरित चित्तसे प्रणाम किया, जिन्हें सभी देवता प्रणाम करते रहते हैं आदिकर्ता भगवान् वासुदेवने पुनः वामनरूप धारणकर उस (बलि)-से कहा--हैत्याधिपते! इस समय भक्तिपूर्वक आपके द्वारा दिये गये ये तीनों लोक अब मेरे ही हैं
verses.wordMeaning: After concluding his eulogy of Sambhu, he bowed down his head at his feet. His eyes were rendered dim due to tears (ofjoy). With palms joined in reverence, he spoke these words.
verses.commentary: Sense: After concluding his eulogy of Sambhu, he bowed down his head at his feet. His eyes were rendered dim due to tears (ofjoy). With palms joined in reverence, he spoke these words.

verses.sanskrit: ततः संहृत्य तद्रूपं हरिर्नारायणः प्रभुः । स्वमेव परमं रूपं ययौ नारायणाह्वयम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ saṃhṛtya tadrūpaṃ harirnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ / svameva paramaṃ rūpaṃ yayau nārāyaṇāhvayam
verses.translation: "I am contented, blessed. Since the leading sage and Yogin, the holy Lord, the most excellent among the knowers of Yoga has been personally seen by me.
verses.hindi: हैत्यने पुनः सिरेसे प्रणामकर हाथोंके अग्रभागमें जल गिराया (और कहा-) अनन्तधाम! त्रिविक्रम! हैत्यं जगदन्तरात्मा पातालमूलं प्रविशेति भूयः
verses.wordMeaning: "I am contented, blessed. Since the leading sage and Yogin, the holy Lord, the most excellent among the knowers of Yoga has been personally seen by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: "I am contented, blessed. Since the leading sage and Yogin, the holy Lord, the most excellent among the knowers of Yoga has been personally seen by me.

verses.sanskrit: गते नारायणे दैत्यः प्रह्रादो ऽसुरसत्तमः । अभिषेकेण युक्तेन हिरण्याक्षमयोजयत्
verses.transliteration: gate nārāyaṇe daityaḥ prahrādo 'surasattamaḥ / abhiṣekeṇa yuktena hiraṇyākṣamayojayat
verses.translation: Ah! My good luck is indeed great. My penances have become fruitful. What shall I do? O sinless one, I am your disciple. Save me."
verses.hindi: भुक्त्वा भोगान् देवतानामलभ्यान्। प्रवेक्ष्यसे कल्पदाहे पुनर्माम्
verses.wordMeaning: Ah! My good luck is indeed great. My penances have become fruitful. What shall I do? O sinless one, I am your disciple. Save me."
verses.commentary: Sense: Ah! My good luck is indeed great. My penances have become fruitful. What shall I do? O sinless one, I am your disciple. Save me."

verses.sanskrit: स बाधयामास सुरान् रणे जित्वा मुनीनपि । लब्ध्वान्धकं महापुत्रं तपसाराध्य शङ्करम्
verses.transliteration: sa bādhayāmāsa surān raṇe jitvā munīnapi / labdhvāndhakaṃ mahāputraṃ tapasārādhya śaṅkaram
verses.translation: He blessed the King of very good conduct and ■gentle behaviour. He accepted him as his disciple, for he had ■wiped off all his sins, thanks to his penance.
verses.hindi: उक्त्वैवं हैत्यसिंहं तं विष्णुः सत्यपराक्रमः । पुरंदराय त्रैलोक्यं ददौ विष्णुरुरुक्रमः संस्तुवन्ति महायोगं सिद्धा देवर्षिकिन्नराः। ब्रह्मा शक्रोऽथ भगवान् रुद्रादित्यमरुद्गणाः
verses.wordMeaning: He blessed the King of very good conduct and ■gentle behaviour. He accepted him as his disciple, for he had ■wiped off all his sins, thanks to his penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: He blessed the King of very good conduct and ■gentle behaviour. He accepted him as his disciple, for he had ■wiped off all his sins, thanks to his penance.

verses.sanskrit: देवाञ्जित्वा सदेवेन्द्रान् बध्वाच धरणीमिमाम् । नीत्वा रसातलं चक्रे वन्दीमिन्दीवरप्रभाम्
verses.transliteration: devāñjitvā sadevendrān badhvāca dharaṇīmimām / nītvā rasātalaṃ cakre vandīmindīvaraprabhām
verses.translation: The clever sage made him perform all rites pertaining to sannjdsa and then bestowed on him the divine knowledge (about Siva) for which the holy rites had been laid down in his own branch of the Vedas.
verses.hindi: कृत्वैतददभुतं कर्म विष्णुर्वामनरूपधृक् । पश्यतामेव सर्वेषां तत्रैवान्तरधीयत सोऽपि हैत्यवरः श्रीमान् पातालं प्राप चोदितः । प्रहादेनासुरवरैर्विष्णुना विष्णुतत्परः
verses.wordMeaning: The clever sage made him perform all rites pertaining to sannjdsa and then bestowed on him the divine knowledge (about Siva) for which the holy rites had been laid down in his own branch of the Vedas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The clever sage made him perform all rites pertaining to sannjdsa and then bestowed on him the divine knowledge (about Siva) for which the holy rites had been laid down in his own branch of the Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: ततः सब्रह्मका देवाः परिम्लानमुखश्रियः । गत्वा विज्ञापयामासुर्विष्णवे हरिमन्दिरम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sabrahmakā devāḥ parimlānamukhaśriyaḥ / gatvā vijñāpayāmāsurviṣṇave harimandiram
verses.translation: He gave him the entire essence of the Vedas, that secures the release of the Pasu (Individual soul) from the Pdia (the binding noose of Avidyd). It is famous as the Antydiramd}- (the last stage of life). It has been performed by Brahma and others.
verses.hindi: अपृच्छद् विष्णुमाहात्म्यं भक्तियोगमनुत्तमम्। पूजाविधानं प्रह्लादं तदाहासौ चकार सः प्रणतगतिं प्रणिधाय कर्मयोगम्
verses.wordMeaning: He gave him the entire essence of the Vedas, that secures the release of the Pasu (Individual soul) from the Pdia (the binding noose of Avidyd). It is famous as the Antydiramd}- (the last stage of life). It has been performed by Brahma and others.
verses.commentary: Sense: He gave him the entire essence of the Vedas, that secures the release of the Pasu (Individual soul) from the Pdia (the binding noose of Avidyd). It is famous as the Antydiramd}- (the last stage of life). It has been performed by Brahma and others.

verses.sanskrit: स चिन्तयित्वा विश्वात्मा तद्वधोपायमव्ययः । सर्वेदेवमयं शुभ्रं वाराहं वपुरादधे
verses.transliteration: sa cintayitvā viśvātmā tadvadhopāyamavyayaḥ / sarvedevamayaṃ śubhraṃ vārāhaṃ vapurādadhe
verses.translation: Glancing at all his disciples, those who resided in that hermitage viz. Brahmanas, Ksattriyas and Vaisyas who were all interested in maintaining celibacy, he said thus:
verses.hindi: अमित पराक्रमी! मैं अपने-आपको तुम्हें प्रदान करता हूँ। प्रह्मादके पुत्रके भी पुत्र अर्थात् बलिके द्वारा भलीभाँति दिया हुआ तीनों लोक ग्रहणकर संसारके अन्तरात्मा शङ्खपाणि (भगवान् विष्णु)-ने हैत्यसे पुनः कहा--(अब आप) पातालमूलमें प्रवेश करें। आप वहाँ नित्य रहते हुए देवताओंको भी प्राप्त न होनेवाले भोगोंका उपभोगकर भक्तियोगद्वारा मेरा निरन्तर ध्यान करते रहें। कल्पान्त होनेपर पुनः मुझमें ही (आप)
verses.wordMeaning: Glancing at all his disciples, those who resided in that hermitage viz. Brahmanas, Ksattriyas and Vaisyas who were all interested in maintaining celibacy, he said thus:
verses.commentary: Sense: Glancing at all his disciples, those who resided in that hermitage viz. Brahmanas, Ksattriyas and Vaisyas who were all interested in maintaining celibacy, he said thus:

verses.sanskrit: गत्वा हिरण्यनयनं हत्वा तं पुरुषोत्तमः । दंष्ट्रयोद्धारयामास कल्पादौ धरणीमिमाम्
verses.transliteration: gatvā hiraṇyanayanaṃ hatvā taṃ puruṣottamaḥ / daṃṣṭrayoddhārayāmāsa kalpādau dharaṇīmimām
verses.translation: "It is only after studying the branch of knowledge initiated by me that the Yogins attain Mahadeva after medi¬ tating on the universe as the creation of the Lord.
verses.hindi: प्रवेश करेंगे ॥ ६०--६२ ॥ उस हैत्यश्रेष्ठठे इस प्रकार कहकर सत्यपराक्रम तथा विशाल डगोंवाले विष्णुने तीनों लोक इन्द्रको दे दिये। सिद्ध, देवता, ऋषि, किन्नर, ब्रह्मा, इन्द्र, भगवान् रुद्र, आदित्य तथा मरुद्रण (उन) महायोगीकी स्तुति
verses.wordMeaning: "It is only after studying the branch of knowledge initiated by me that the Yogins attain Mahadeva after medi¬ tating on the universe as the creation of the Lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: "It is only after studying the branch of knowledge initiated by me that the Yogins attain Mahadeva after medi¬ tating on the universe as the creation of the Lord.

verses.sanskrit: त्यक्त्वा वराहसंस्थानं संस्थाप्य च सुरद्विजान् स्वामेव प्रकृतिं दिव्यां ययौ विष्णुः परं पदम्
verses.transliteration: tyaktvā varāhasaṃsthānaṃ saṃsthāpya ca suradvijān svāmeva prakṛtiṃ divyāṃ yayau viṣṇuḥ paraṃ padam
verses.translation: It is here that the Lord Mahadeva sporting along with his consort Uma, occupies the place, with a desire to bless the devotees.
verses.hindi: ऐसा अद्भुत कार्य करके वामन-रूप धारण करनेवाले विष्णु सभीके देखते-ही-देखते वहाँ अन्तर्धान हो गये। वह विष्णुपरायण श्रीसम्पन्न हैत्यश्रेष्ठ (बलि) भी विष्णुसे प्रेरित होकर प्रह्माद एवं अन्य श्रेष्ठ असुरोंके साथ पातालमें चला गया
verses.wordMeaning: It is here that the Lord Mahadeva sporting along with his consort Uma, occupies the place, with a desire to bless the devotees.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is here that the Lord Mahadeva sporting along with his consort Uma, occupies the place, with a desire to bless the devotees.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन् हते ऽमररिपौ प्रह्रादौ विष्णुतत्परः । अपालयत् स्वकंराज्यं भावं त्यक्त्वा तदाऽसुरम्
verses.transliteration: tasmin hate 'mararipau prahrādau viṣṇutatparaḥ / apālayat svakaṃrājyaṃ bhāvaṃ tyaktvā tadā'suram
verses.translation: Formerly, Narayana himself, the creator of the entire universe, propitiated Mahadeva here with a desire for the welfare of the worlds.
verses.hindi: उसने प्रह्मादसे विष्णुका माहात्म्य, श्रेष्ठतम भक्तियोग तथा पूजनका विधान पूछा। तब उनके द्वारा बताये कर्मयोगका आचरण कर वह शरणागतोंके आश्रयस्थल, हाथोंमें चक्र, तलवार तथा शंख धारण करनेवाले, कमलके समान नेत्रवाले, अप्रमेय ईश्वरकी शरणमे गया
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly, Narayana himself, the creator of the entire universe, propitiated Mahadeva here with a desire for the welfare of the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, Narayana himself, the creator of the entire universe, propitiated Mahadeva here with a desire for the welfare of the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: इयाज विधिवद् देवान् विष्णोराराधने रतः । निः सपत्नं तदा राज्यं तस्यासीद् विष्णुवैभवात्
verses.transliteration: iyāja vidhivad devān viṣṇorārādhane rataḥ / niḥ sapatnaṃ tadā rājyaṃ tasyāsīd viṣṇuvaibhavāt
verses.translation: It is after propitiating Lord Isana (Siva) the deity of even Devas, that Devas and Danavas attained great mira¬ culous powers here.
verses.hindi: ब्राह्मणो! इस प्रकार यह (भगवान्) वामनके पराक्रमको मैंने बतलाया। ये पुरुषोत्तम सदा देवताओंके स देवकार्याणि सदा करोति पुरुषोत्तमः॥ ६९॥  कायाँको करते रहते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: It is after propitiating Lord Isana (Siva) the deity of even Devas, that Devas and Danavas attained great mira¬ culous powers here.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is after propitiating Lord Isana (Siva) the deity of even Devas, that Devas and Danavas attained great mira¬ culous powers here.

verses.sanskrit: ततः कदाचिदसुरो ब्राह्मणं गृहमागतम् । तापसं नार्चयामास देवानां चैव मायया
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kadācidasuro brāhmaṇaṃ gṛhamāgatam / tāpasaṃ nārcayāmāsa devānāṃ caiva māyayā
verses.translation: It was here itself that Marici and all other sages perceived Mahesvara through the power of their penance and attained eternal perfect knowledge.
verses.hindi: ति कूर्मपुराण क्त बलिपुत्र बाणासुरका वृत्तान्त, दक्ष प्रजापतिकी दनु, सुरसा आदि कन्याओंकी संतानोंका वर्णन
verses.wordMeaning: It was here itself that Marici and all other sages perceived Mahesvara through the power of their penance and attained eternal perfect knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: It was here itself that Marici and all other sages perceived Mahesvara through the power of their penance and attained eternal perfect knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: स तेन तापसो ऽत्यर्थं मोहितेनावमानितः । शशापासुरराजानं क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनः
verses.transliteration: sa tena tāpaso 'tyarthaṃ mohitenāvamānitaḥ / śaśāpāsurarājānaṃ krodhasaṃraktalocanaḥ
verses.translation: Hence, O leading king, you too stay here practis¬ ing penance and Yoga. You stay with me permanently and thereby you will attain Siddhi."
verses.hindi: सोऽतीव शंकरे भक्तो राजा राज्यमपालयत्। त्रैलोक्यं वशमानीय बाधयामास वासवम्॥ ततः शक्रादयो देवा गत्वोचुः कृत्तिवाससम्।
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, O leading king, you too stay here practis¬ ing penance and Yoga. You stay with me permanently and thereby you will attain Siddhi."
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, O leading king, you too stay here practis¬ ing penance and Yoga. You stay with me permanently and thereby you will attain Siddhi."

verses.sanskrit: यत्तद्वलं समाश्रित्य ब्राह्मणानवमन्यसे । सा भक्तिर्वैष्णवी दिव्या विनाशं ते गमिष्यति
verses.transliteration: yattadvalaṃ samāśritya brāhmaṇānavamanyase / sā bhaktirvaiṣṇavī divyā vināśaṃ te gamiṣyati
verses.translation: After addressing thus, the leading Brahmana meditat¬ ed on Lord Siva, the wielder of the Pinaka bow. He then imparted precisely the great Mantra for the achievement of every thing ( v.l. of his objectives).
verses.hindi: व्याहतो हैवतैः सर्वैर्देवदेवो महेश्वरः। ददाह बाणस्य पुरं शरेणैकेन लीलया॥ संस्तुतो भगवानीशः शंकरो नीललोहितः।
verses.wordMeaning: After addressing thus, the leading Brahmana meditat¬ ed on Lord Siva, the wielder of the Pinaka bow. He then imparted precisely the great Mantra for the achievement of every thing ( v.l. of his objectives).
verses.commentary: Sense: After addressing thus, the leading Brahmana meditat¬ ed on Lord Siva, the wielder of the Pinaka bow. He then imparted precisely the great Mantra for the achievement of every thing ( v.l. of his objectives).

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा प्रययौ तूर्णं प्रह्रादस्य गृहाद् द्विजः । मुमोह राज्यसंसक्तः सो ऽपि शापबलात् ततः
verses.transliteration: ityuktvā prayayau tūrṇaṃ prahrādasya gṛhād dvijaḥ / mumoha rājyasaṃsaktaḥ so 'pi śāpabalāt tataḥ
verses.translation: That Mantra suppresses all sins. It is the essence of the Vedas. It yields liberation. It is the holy Mantra begin¬ ning with the word Agni. It has been initiated (made to function) by the sages.
verses.hindi: तारस्तथा शम्बरश्च कपिलः शंकरस्तथा। स्वर्भानुर्वृषपर्वा च प्राधान्येन प्रकीर्तिताः ॥ अनन्ताद्या महानागाः काद्रवेयाः प्रकीर्तिताः १०॥
verses.wordMeaning: That Mantra suppresses all sins. It is the essence of the Vedas. It yields liberation. It is the holy Mantra begin¬ ning with the word Agni. It has been initiated (made to function) by the sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: That Mantra suppresses all sins. It is the essence of the Vedas. It yields liberation. It is the holy Mantra begin¬ ning with the word Agni. It has been initiated (made to function) by the sages.

verses.sanskrit: बाधयामास विप्रेन्द्रान् न विवेद जनार्दनम् । पितुर्वधमनुस्मृत्य क्रोधं चक्रे हरिं प्रति
verses.transliteration: bādhayāmāsa viprendrān na viveda janārdanam / piturvadhamanusmṛtya krodhaṃ cakre hariṃ prati
verses.translation: At his instance King Susila, endowed with faith, became a devotee of Pasupati and was engaged in the study of the Vedas.
verses.hindi: शुकीं श्येनीं च भासी च सुग्रीवां गृध्रिकां शुचिम् खसा वै यक्षरक्षांसि मुनिरप्सरसस्तथा।
verses.wordMeaning: At his instance King Susila, endowed with faith, became a devotee of Pasupati and was engaged in the study of the Vedas.
verses.commentary: Sense: At his instance King Susila, endowed with faith, became a devotee of Pasupati and was engaged in the study of the Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: तयोः समभवद् युद्धं सुघोरं रोमहर्षणम् । नारायणस्य देवस्य प्रह्रादस्यामरद्विषः
verses.transliteration: tayoḥ samabhavad yuddhaṃ sughoraṃ romaharṣaṇam / nārāyaṇasya devasya prahrādasyāmaradviṣaḥ
verses.translation: He applied the sacred ashes (Aorma) all over his body. He lived on roots, fruits and bulbous roots. He was quie¬ scent and had full self-control. He subdued his anger and resorted to the procedure of renunciation.
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले--बलिके महान् बल और पराक्रमवाले सौ पुत्र थे, उनमें प्रधान पुत्रका नाम 'बाण' था, जो द्युतिमान् और अत्यन्त बलवान् था। भगवान् शंकरे अत्यन्त भक्तिवाले उस राजा (बाण)-ने राज्यका पालन करते हुए त्रिलोकीको अपने वशमें करके इन्द्रको पीड़ित किया। तब इन्द्रादि देवता कृत्तिवासा (शंकर)-के पास जाकर कहने लगे (भगवन्!) आपका भक्त 'बाण' नामक महान् असुर हमें पीडित कर रहा है॥ १--३॥
verses.wordMeaning: He applied the sacred ashes (Aorma) all over his body. He lived on roots, fruits and bulbous roots. He was quie¬ scent and had full self-control. He subdued his anger and resorted to the procedure of renunciation.
verses.commentary: Sense: He applied the sacred ashes (Aorma) all over his body. He lived on roots, fruits and bulbous roots. He was quie¬ scent and had full self-control. He subdued his anger and resorted to the procedure of renunciation.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा तु सुमहद् युद्धं विष्णुना तेन निर्जितः । पुर्वसंस्कारमाहात्म्यात् परस्मिन् पुरुषे हरौ । संजातं तस्य विज्ञानं शरण्यं शरणं ययौ
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā tu sumahad yuddhaṃ viṣṇunā tena nirjitaḥ / purvasaṃskāramāhātmyāt parasmin puruṣe harau / saṃjātaṃ tasya vijñānaṃ śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau
verses.translation: Havirdhana begot a son named Pracinabarhis in Agneyi. He was a master of the science of archery.
verses.hindi: सभी देवताओंके द्वारा ऐसा कहे जानेपर देवाधिदेव महेश्वरने एक बाणसे लीलापूर्वक 'बाण' के नगरको दग्ध कर दिया। उस नगरके जलनेपर बाण त्रिशूलधारी, गोपति (वृषवाहन) नीललोहित ईशान रुद्रको शरणमें गया शम्भुके लिंगको सिरपर धारणकर वह निर्भयतापूर्वक अपने नगरसे बाहर निकल गया और परमेश्वर (शंकर)- की स्तुति करने लगा। स्तुति करनेपर नीललोहित, शंकर भगवान् ईशने स्रेहवश उस बाणासुरको गणपतिका
verses.wordMeaning: Havirdhana begot a son named Pracinabarhis in Agneyi. He was a master of the science of archery.
verses.commentary: Sense: Havirdhana begot a son named Pracinabarhis in Agneyi. He was a master of the science of archery.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभृति दैत्येन्द्रो ह्यनन्यां भक्तिमुद्वहन् । नारायणे महायोगमवाप पुरुषोत्तमे
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhṛti daityendro hyananyāṃ bhaktimudvahan / nārāyaṇe mahāyogamavāpa puruṣottame
verses.translation: Lord Pracinabarhis, who was the most excellent among the wielders of all sorts of weapons, begot of the daughter of the ocean, ten sons.
verses.hindi: दनुके तार आदि अत्यन्त भीषण पुत्र हुए। उनमें तार, शम्बर, कपिल, शंकर, स्वर्भानु तथा वृषपर्वा प्रधान कहे गये हैं। द्विजो! दक्षप्रजापतिको कन्या सुरसाके अनेक फणोंवाले हजार सर्प पुत्ररूपमें हुए। इसी प्रकार अरिष्टाने हजारों आकाशचारी महात्मा गन्धर्वोको उत्पन्न किया। अनन्त आदि महानाग कद्रूके पुत्र कहे गये हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Lord Pracinabarhis, who was the most excellent among the wielders of all sorts of weapons, begot of the daughter of the ocean, ten sons.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Pracinabarhis, who was the most excellent among the wielders of all sorts of weapons, begot of the daughter of the ocean, ten sons.

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्यकशिपोः पुत्रे योगसंसक्तचेतसि । अवाप तन्महद् राज्यमन्धको ऽसुरपुङ्गवः
verses.transliteration: hiraṇyakaśipoḥ putre yogasaṃsaktacetasi / avāpa tanmahad rājyamandhako 'surapuṅgavaḥ
verses.translation: They were well known as Pracetasas. They were kings of reputed power. Devoted to Narayana, they studied their respective Vedas.
verses.hindi: द्विजश्रेष्ठो ! ताम्राने छः कन्याओंको जन्म दिया, जो शुकी, श्येनी, भासी, सुग्रीवा, गृध्रिका तथा शुचि नामवाली हैं। सुरभिने गौओं तथा महिषियों (भैंसों)-को उत्पन्न किया। इराने सभी प्रकारके वृक्ष, लता, वल्ली तथा तृण-जातिवालोंको जन्म दिया। द्विजसत्तमो! खसाने यक्षो तथा राक्षसोंको, मुनिने अप्सराओंको और क्रोधवशाने राक्षसोंको उत्पन्न किया॥ ११--१३॥
verses.wordMeaning: They were well known as Pracetasas. They were kings of reputed power. Devoted to Narayana, they studied their respective Vedas.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were well known as Pracetasas. They were kings of reputed power. Devoted to Narayana, they studied their respective Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्यनेत्रतनयः शंभोर्देहसमुद्भवः । मन्दरस्थामुमां देवीं चकमे पर्वतात्मजाम्
verses.transliteration: hiraṇyanetratanayaḥ śaṃbhordehasamudbhavaḥ / mandarasthāmumāṃ devīṃ cakame parvatātmajām
verses.translation: Daksa who had been the blessed son of Brahma formerly and a progenitor as well, was reborn of Marisa and the ten Pracetas collectively.
verses.hindi: १-कृत्ति (व्याघ्रचर्म) -को वसन (वस्त्र) -रूपमें धारण करनेवाले। २-'दनु' दक्षप्रजापतिकी कन्या है। इसका विवाह कश्यपसे हुआ था। आराध्य तपसा रुद्रं महादेवं तथारुणः। सारथ्ये कल्पितः पूर्व प्रीतेनार्कस्य शम्भुना
verses.wordMeaning: Daksa who had been the blessed son of Brahma formerly and a progenitor as well, was reborn of Marisa and the ten Pracetas collectively.
verses.commentary: Sense: Daksa who had been the blessed son of Brahma formerly and a progenitor as well, was reborn of Marisa and the ten Pracetas collectively.

verses.sanskrit: पुरा दारुवने पुण्ये मुनयो गृहमेधिनः । ईश्वराराधनार्थाय तपश्चेरुः सहस्त्रशः
verses.transliteration: purā dāruvane puṇye munayo gṛhamedhinaḥ / īśvarārādhanārthāya tapaśceruḥ sahastraśaḥ
verses.translation: That Daksa carried on a verbal dispute with the intelligent Rudra, the great Isa. He was cursed by Rudra and he thereby became the son of Pracetas.
verses.hindi: एते कश्यपदायादाः कीर्तिताः स्थाणुजङ्गमाः । वैवस्वतेऽन्तरे ह्यस्मिञ्छुण्वतां पापनाशनाः कृशाश्वस्य तु देवर्षेर्देवप्रहरणाः सुताः।
verses.wordMeaning: That Daksa carried on a verbal dispute with the intelligent Rudra, the great Isa. He was cursed by Rudra and he thereby became the son of Pracetas.
verses.commentary: Sense: That Daksa carried on a verbal dispute with the intelligent Rudra, the great Isa. He was cursed by Rudra and he thereby became the son of Pracetas.

verses.sanskrit: ततः कदाचिन्महति कालयोगेन दुस्तरा । अनावृष्टिरतीवोग्रा ह्यासीद् भूतविनाशिनी
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kadācinmahati kālayogena dustarā / anāvṛṣṭiratīvogrā hyāsīd bhūtavināśinī
verses.translation: Seeing that Daksa was coming to his residence, he along with his consort personally accorded him befitting worship.
verses.hindi: मन्वन्तरेषु नियतं तुल्यैः कार्य: स्वनामभिः विनताके दो विख्यात पुत्र हुए-गरुड तथा अरुण। उनमेंसे बुद्धिमान् गरुडने दुस्तर तप करके भगवान् शंकरको कृपासे साक्षात् हरिके वाहन होनेका सौभाग्य प्राप्त किया। इसी प्रकार पूर्वकालमें अरुणने महादेव
verses.wordMeaning: Seeing that Daksa was coming to his residence, he along with his consort personally accorded him befitting worship.
verses.commentary: Sense: Seeing that Daksa was coming to his residence, he along with his consort personally accorded him befitting worship.

verses.sanskrit: समेत्य सर्वे मुनयो गौतमं तपसां निधिम् । अयाचन्त क्षुधाविष्टा आहारं प्राणधारणम्
verses.transliteration: sametya sarve munayo gautamaṃ tapasāṃ nidhim / ayācanta kṣudhāviṣṭā āhāraṃ prāṇadhāraṇam
verses.translation: Then the son of Brahma (Daksa) who had been infested with the Tamo-Guna yearned for more worship than he deserved. He became infuriated and went away to his house (in a huff).
verses.hindi: रुद्रकी तपस्याद्वारा आराधना की, इससे महादेवने प्रसन्न होकर उसे सूर्यका सारथी बना दिया इस वैवस्वत मन्वन्तरमें स्थावर तथा जंगम-रूप ये (महर्षि) कश्यपके वंशज कहे गये हैं। इनका वर्णन सुननेवालोंके पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Then the son of Brahma (Daksa) who had been infested with the Tamo-Guna yearned for more worship than he deserved. He became infuriated and went away to his house (in a huff).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the son of Brahma (Daksa) who had been infested with the Tamo-Guna yearned for more worship than he deserved. He became infuriated and went away to his house (in a huff).

verses.sanskrit: स तेभ्यः प्रददावन्नं मृष्टं बहुतरं बुधः । सर्वे बुबुजिरे विप्रा निर्विशङ्केन चेतसा
verses.transliteration: sa tebhyaḥ pradadāvannaṃ mṛṣṭaṃ bahutaraṃ budhaḥ / sarve bubujire viprā nirviśaṅkena cetasā
verses.translation: Once, when Sati had come to her own house, the evil-minded Daksa used word of abuse to her and angrily scolded her along with her husband.
verses.hindi: शोभन व्रतवाले द्विजो! (दक्षकी) सत्ताईस कन्याएँ चन्द्रमाकी पत्रियाँ कही गयी हैं। अरिष्टनेमिकी पल्नियोंकी सोलह संतानें हुई। विद्वान् बहुपुत्रके चार विद्युत् नाम- वाले पुत्र कहे गये हैं। इसी प्रकार अङ्गिराके पुत्र ब्रह्मा- द्वारा सम्मान-प्रा् श्रेष्ठ ऋषि थे। देवर्षि कुशाश्वके पुत्र देवप्रहरण अर्थात् देवोंके शस्त्र थे। हजार युगोंका अन्त होनेपर विभिन्न मन्वन्तरोंमें ये अपने नामोंके समान कार्योके साथ निश्चितरूपसे पुनः उत्पन्न होते हैं॥ १७--१९ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Once, when Sati had come to her own house, the evil-minded Daksa used word of abuse to her and angrily scolded her along with her husband.
verses.commentary: Sense: Once, when Sati had come to her own house, the evil-minded Daksa used word of abuse to her and angrily scolded her along with her husband.

verses.sanskrit: गते तु द्वादशे वर्षे कल्पान्त इव शङ्करी । बभूव वृष्टिर्महती यथापूर्वमभूज्जगत्
verses.transliteration: gate tu dvādaśe varṣe kalpānta iva śaṅkarī / babhūva vṛṣṭirmahatī yathāpūrvamabhūjjagat
verses.translation: ''All my other sons-in-law are superior to your hus¬ band the wielder of the Pinaka bow. You too are an evil daughter among my good daughters. Hence go away from this house (back to your place) in the manner you had come.
verses.hindi: महर्षि कश्यप तथा पुलस्त्य आदि ऋषियोंके वंशका वर्णन, रावण तथा कुम्भकर्ण आदिकी उत्पत्ति, वसिष्ठके वंश-वर्णनमें व्यास, शुकदेव आदिको उत्पत्तिकी कथा, भगवान् शंकरका ही शुकदेवके रूपमें आविर्भूत होना एतानुत्पाद्य पुत्रांस्तु प्रजासंतानकारणात्। कश्यपो गोत्रकामस्तु चचार सुमहत् तपः
verses.wordMeaning: ''All my other sons-in-law are superior to your hus¬ band the wielder of the Pinaka bow. You too are an evil daughter among my good daughters. Hence go away from this house (back to your place) in the manner you had come.
verses.commentary: Sense: ''All my other sons-in-law are superior to your hus¬ band the wielder of the Pinaka bow. You too are an evil daughter among my good daughters. Hence go away from this house (back to your place) in the manner you had come.

verses.sanskrit: ततः सर्वे मुनिवराः समामन्त्र्य परस्परम् । महर्षि गौतमं प्रोचुर्गच्छाम इति वेगतः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sarve munivarāḥ samāmantrya parasparam / maharṣi gautamaṃ procurgacchāma iti vegataḥ
verses.translation: On hearing his words, the goddess, the beloved of Sankara censured her father, Daksa, and burned herself by means of her own self (by Yogic process).
verses.hindi: वत्सरश्चासितश्चेव तावुभौ ब्रह्मवादिनौ असितस्यैकपर्णायां ब्रह्मिष्ठः समपद्यत। नाम्ना वै देवलः पुत्रो योगाचार्यो महातपाः
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing his words, the goddess, the beloved of Sankara censured her father, Daksa, and burned herself by means of her own self (by Yogic process).
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing his words, the goddess, the beloved of Sankara censured her father, Daksa, and burned herself by means of her own self (by Yogic process).

verses.sanskrit: निवारयामास च तान् कञ्चित् कालं यथासुखम् । उषित्वा मद्गृहे ऽवश्यं गच्छध्वमिति पण्डिताः
verses.transliteration: nivārayāmāsa ca tān kañcit kālaṃ yathāsukham / uṣitvā madgṛhe 'vaśyaṃ gacchadhvamiti paṇḍitāḥ
verses.translation: After bowing to her husband Pasupati, the wearer of elephant's hide, she became the daughter of Himavan, being delighted at his penance.
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले--प्रजाकी अभिवृद्धिके लिये इन पुत्रोंको उत्पन्न कर पुत्राभिलाषी कश्यप अत्यन्त महान् तप करने लगे। कठोर तप कर रहे उनके “वत्सर' तथा 'असित' नामके दो पुत्र हुए। वे दोनों ही ब्रह्मवादी थे। वत्सरसे नैधुव और रैभ्य नामके महान् यशस्वी पुत्र उत्पन्न हुए। रैभ्यके तेजस्वियोंमें श्रेष्ठ रैभ्य नामक पुत्र हुआ। च्यवन ऋषिकी (सुमेधा नामवाली) पुत्री महात्मा नैश्रुवकी
verses.wordMeaning: After bowing to her husband Pasupati, the wearer of elephant's hide, she became the daughter of Himavan, being delighted at his penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: After bowing to her husband Pasupati, the wearer of elephant's hide, she became the daughter of Himavan, being delighted at his penance.

verses.sanskrit: ततो मायामयीं सृष्ट्वा कृशां गां सर्व एव ते । समीपं प्रापयामासुगौतमस्य महात्मनः
verses.transliteration: tato māyāmayīṃ sṛṣṭvā kṛśāṃ gāṃ sarva eva te / samīpaṃ prāpayāmāsugautamasya mahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: On knowing her (dead in this manner) Lord Rudra, Kara, the dispeller of dejectedness of those who resort to him, became infuriated and after coming to his house, cursed Daksa.
verses.hindi: पत्नी थी। सुमेधाने "कुण्डपायी' पुत्रोंको उत्पन्न किया। असितकी एकपर्णा नामक पत्नीने ब्रह्यिष्ठ पुत्रको उत्पन्न किया जो देवल नामवाले थे, वे योगके आचार्य, शाण्डिल्या नैधुवा रैभ्यास्त्रयः पक्षास्तु काश्यपाः । नरप्रकृतयो विप्राः पुलस्त्यस्य वदामि वः
verses.wordMeaning: On knowing her (dead in this manner) Lord Rudra, Kara, the dispeller of dejectedness of those who resort to him, became infuriated and after coming to his house, cursed Daksa.
verses.commentary: Sense: On knowing her (dead in this manner) Lord Rudra, Kara, the dispeller of dejectedness of those who resort to him, became infuriated and after coming to his house, cursed Daksa.

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽनुवीक्ष्य कृपाविष्टस्तस्याः संरक्षणोत्सुकः । गोष्ठे तां बन्धयामास स्पृष्टमात्रा ममार सा
verses.transliteration: so 'nuvīkṣya kṛpāviṣṭastasyāḥ saṃrakṣaṇotsukaḥ / goṣṭhe tāṃ bandhayāmāsa spṛṣṭamātrā mamāra sā
verses.translation: 'After abandoning this body, born of Brahma, be born in the family of Ksattriyas. You will be a foolish-minded person and will beget a son of your own daughter.'
verses.hindi: ऋषिस्त्वैलविलिस्तस्यां विश्रवाः समपद्यत । तस्य पत्प्यश्चतस्त्रस्तु पौलस्त्यकुलवर्धिकाः पुष्पोत्कटा च राका च कैकसी देववर्णिनी! रूपलावण्यसम्पन्नास्तासां वै शृणुत प्रजा:
verses.wordMeaning: 'After abandoning this body, born of Brahma, be born in the family of Ksattriyas. You will be a foolish-minded person and will beget a son of your own daughter.'
verses.commentary: Sense: 'After abandoning this body, born of Brahma, be born in the family of Ksattriyas. You will be a foolish-minded person and will beget a son of your own daughter.'

verses.sanskrit: स शोकेनाभिसंतप्तः कार्याकार्यं महामुनिः । न पश्यति स्म सहसा तादृशं मुनयो ऽब्रुवन्
verses.transliteration: sa śokenābhisaṃtaptaḥ kāryākāryaṃ mahāmuniḥ / na paśyati sma sahasā tādṛśaṃ munayo 'bruvan
verses.translation: Imprecating him thus, Mahadeva went to the moun¬ tain Kailasa. Daksa too, the son of the self-bom deity (Brahma) became Pracetasa (son of the Pracetasas) in due course.
verses.hindi: ज्येष्ठं वैश्रवणं तस्य सुषुवे देवरूपिणी। कैकसी जनयत् पुत्रं रावणं राक्षसाधिपम् कुम्भकर्ण शूर्पणखां तथैव च विभीषणम्। पुष्पोत्कटा व्यजनयत् पुत्रान् विश्रवसः शुभान्
verses.wordMeaning: Imprecating him thus, Mahadeva went to the moun¬ tain Kailasa. Daksa too, the son of the self-bom deity (Brahma) became Pracetasa (son of the Pracetasas) in due course.
verses.commentary: Sense: Imprecating him thus, Mahadeva went to the moun¬ tain Kailasa. Daksa too, the son of the self-bom deity (Brahma) became Pracetasa (son of the Pracetasas) in due course.

verses.sanskrit: गोवध्येयं द्विजश्रेष्ठ यावत् तव शरीरगा । तावत् ते ऽन्नं न भोक्तव्यं गच्छामो वयमेव हि
verses.transliteration: govadhyeyaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha yāvat tava śarīragā / tāvat te 'nnaṃ na bhoktavyaṃ gacchāmo vayameva hi
verses.translation: Thus all details of creation of Svayambhuva Manu, upto Daksa have been narrated to you. This story dispels the sins of those who hear this."
verses.hindi: कुम्भीनसी तथा कन्यां राकायां श्रृणुत प्रजा: इत्येते क्रूरकर्माणः पौलस्त्या राक्षसा दश। सर्वे तपोबलोत्कृष्टा रुद्रभक्ताः सुभीषणाः
verses.wordMeaning: Thus all details of creation of Svayambhuva Manu, upto Daksa have been narrated to you. This story dispels the sins of those who hear this."
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus all details of creation of Svayambhuva Manu, upto Daksa have been narrated to you. This story dispels the sins of those who hear this."

verses.sanskrit: तेन ते मुदिताः सन्तो देवदारुवनं शुभम् । जग्मुः पापवशं नीतास्तपश्चर्तुं यथा पुरा
verses.transliteration: tena te muditāḥ santo devadāruvanaṃ śubham / jagmuḥ pāpavaśaṃ nītāstapaścartuṃ yathā purā
verses.translation: It is probably Samyasa. HD. II. 1. 417 gives a number of synonyms for sannydsin viz. parivrdf, parivrdjaka, bhiksu, muni, yati but this des¬ criptive name of dSrama is not given in it.
verses.hindi: भूताः पिशाचाः सर्पाश्च शूकरा हस्तिनस्तथा भृगोरप्यभवच्छक्रो हैत्याचार्यो महातपाः।
verses.wordMeaning: It is probably Samyasa. HD. II. 1. 417 gives a number of synonyms for sannydsin viz. parivrdf, parivrdjaka, bhiksu, muni, yati but this des¬ criptive name of dSrama is not given in it.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is probably Samyasa. HD. II. 1. 417 gives a number of synonyms for sannydsin viz. parivrdf, parivrdjaka, bhiksu, muni, yati but this des¬ criptive name of dSrama is not given in it.

verses.sanskrit: स तेषां मायया जातां गोवध्यां गौतमो मुनिः । केनापि हेतुना ज्ञात्वा शशापातीवकोपनः
verses.transliteration: sa teṣāṃ māyayā jātāṃ govadhyāṃ gautamo muniḥ / kenāpi hetunā jñātvā śaśāpātīvakopanaḥ
verses.translation: Instead of this reading {dhydyanto) viSvam aiSvaram the Ft. Note ( in our Vehkatesvara Press—Text) gives a better reading: mskalam divam I "meditating on the perfect, indivisible Siva".
verses.hindi: नारदस्तु बसिष्ठाय ददौ देवीमरुन्धतीम्। ऊर्ध्वरेतास्तत्र मुनिः शापाद् दक्षस्य नारद: महान् तपस्वी शाण्डिल्योंमें श्रेष्ठ, श्रीमान्, सभी तत्त्वार्थोको जाननेवाले तथा विद्वान् थे। पार्वतीके पति भगवान् शंकरको कृपासे उन्होंने श्रेष्ठ योग प्राप्त किया॥ १--६॥
verses.wordMeaning: Instead of this reading {dhydyanto) viSvam aiSvaram the Ft. Note ( in our Vehkatesvara Press—Text) gives a better reading: mskalam divam I "meditating on the perfect, indivisible Siva".
verses.commentary: Sense: Instead of this reading {dhydyanto) viSvam aiSvaram the Ft. Note ( in our Vehkatesvara Press—Text) gives a better reading: mskalam divam I "meditating on the perfect, indivisible Siva".

verses.sanskrit: भविष्यन्ति त्रयीबाह्या महापातकिभिः समाः । बभूवुस्ते तथा शापाज्जायमानाः पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: bhaviṣyanti trayībāhyā mahāpātakibhiḥ samāḥ / babhūvuste tathā śāpājjāyamānāḥ punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: Sisti and Bhavya were born of Dhruva and Sambhu was born of Bhavya.
verses.hindi: कश्यपवंशीय और मानव प्रकृतिवाली हैं। ब्राह्मणो! आपको अब पुलस्त्य ऋषिके वंशको बताता हूँ। विप्रो! तृणबिन्दुकी एक पुत्री थी जो इलविला नामसे प्रसिद्ध थी। उन राजर्षिने वह कन्या पुलस्त्यको प्रदान की। उस इलविलासे विश्रवा ऋषि उत्पन्न हुए। उनकी पुष्पोत्कटा, राका, कैकसी तथा देववर्णिनी नामकी चार पलियां थीं, जो पुलस्त्यके वंशको बढ़ानेवाली तथा रूप और लावण्यसे सम्पन्न थीं। अब आप उनकी संतानोंको सुनें- ॥ ७--१०॥
verses.wordMeaning: Sisti and Bhavya were born of Dhruva and Sambhu was born of Bhavya.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sisti and Bhavya were born of Dhruva and Sambhu was born of Bhavya.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे संप्राप्य देवेशं शङ्करं विष्णुमव्ययम् । अस्तुवन् लौकिकैः स्तोत्रैरुच्छिष्टा इव सर्वगौ
verses.transliteration: sarve saṃprāpya deveśaṃ śaṅkaraṃ viṣṇumavyayam / astuvan laukikaiḥ stotrairucchiṣṭā iva sarvagau
verses.translation: Sambhuti bore the son Purnamasa to Marici as well as four daughters endowed with all auspicious characteristics.
verses.hindi: उनकी देवरूपिणी (देववर्णिनी) (नामक पत्नी)- ने ज्येष्ठ वैश्रवण (कुबेर)-को जन्म दिया। कैकसीने राक्षसोंके अधिपति रावण नामक पुत्र और इसी प्रकार कुम्भकर्ण, शूर्पणखा तथा विभीषणको जन्म दिया । पुष्पोत्कयने भी महोदर, प्रहस्त, महापार्श्व और खर नामक विश्रवाके शुभ पुत्रों और कुम्भीनसी नामक कन्याको जन्म दिया। अब आप राकाकी संतान सुनें-॥ ११--१३॥ त्रिशिरा, दूषण तथा महाबली विद्युज्जिह--ये राकाके
verses.wordMeaning: Sambhuti bore the son Purnamasa to Marici as well as four daughters endowed with all auspicious characteristics.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sambhuti bore the son Purnamasa to Marici as well as four daughters endowed with all auspicious characteristics.

verses.sanskrit: देवदेवौ महादेवौ भक्तानामार्तिनाशनौ । कामवृत्त्या महायोगौ पापान्नस्त्रातुमर्हथः
verses.transliteration: devadevau mahādevau bhaktānāmārtināśanau / kāmavṛttyā mahāyogau pāpānnastrātumarhathaḥ
verses.translation: Tusti was the eldest. Then came Vrsti, Krsti and Apaciti. The two sons of Purnamasa were Virajas and Parvata.
verses.hindi: पुत्र थे। पुलस्त्यके ये सभी दस राक्षस-पुत्र क्रूर कर्म करनेवाले, अत्यन्त भयंकर, उत्कट तपोबलवाले और रुद्रके भक्त थे। मृग, व्याल, दाढ़ोंवाले (प्राणी), भूत, पिशाच, सर्प, शूकर तथा हाथी-ये सभी पुलह (ऋषि) -के पुत्र हैं। उस वैवस्वत मन्वन्तरमें (महर्षि) क्रतुको संतानहीन कहा गया है। प्रजापति कश्यप मरीचिके पुत्र थे। भृगुके भी शुक्र नामक पुत्र हुए जो हैत्योंके आचार्य, महान् तपस्वी, स्वाध्याय तथा योगपरायण,
verses.wordMeaning: Tusti was the eldest. Then came Vrsti, Krsti and Apaciti. The two sons of Purnamasa were Virajas and Parvata.
verses.commentary: Sense: Tusti was the eldest. Then came Vrsti, Krsti and Apaciti. The two sons of Purnamasa were Virajas and Parvata.

verses.sanskrit: तदा पार्श्वस्थितं विष्णुं संप्रेक्ष्य वृषभध्वजः । किमेतेषां भवेत् कार्यं प्राह पुण्यैषिणामिति
verses.transliteration: tadā pārśvasthitaṃ viṣṇuṃ saṃprekṣya vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ / kimeteṣāṃ bhavet kāryaṃ prāha puṇyaiṣiṇāmiti
verses.translation: They were—Anga, Sumanas, Khyati, Kratu, Angirasa and Siva. Afterwards Vena was born of Anga. Vainya (alias Prthu) was born of Vena.
verses.hindi: अत्यन्त तेजस्वी और शंकरके भक्त थे। श्रेष्ठ ब्राह्मणो! अत्रिकी बहुत-सी पल्रियाँ थीं। वे पतिव्रता तथा आपसमें बहनें थीं। हमने सुना है कि वे घृताचीसे उत्पन्न कुशाश्वकी पुत्रियाँ थीं ॥ १४--१८॥ उन्होंने उन पत्रियोंसे महान् ओजस्वी, वेद-वेदाङ्ग- परायण और तपस्याद्वारा अपने पापोंको नष्ट करनेवाले कल्याणकारी आत्रेयों (स्वस्त्यात्रेयों)-को उत्पन्न किया। नारदने देवी अरुन्धतीको वसिष्ठके लिये प्रदान किया।
verses.wordMeaning: They were—Anga, Sumanas, Khyati, Kratu, Angirasa and Siva. Afterwards Vena was born of Anga. Vainya (alias Prthu) was born of Vena.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were—Anga, Sumanas, Khyati, Kratu, Angirasa and Siva. Afterwards Vena was born of Anga. Vainya (alias Prthu) was born of Vena.

verses.sanskrit: ततः स भगवान् विष्णुः शरण्यो भक्तवत्सलः । गोपतिं प्राह विप्रेन्द्रानालोक्य प्रणतान् हरिः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa bhagavān viṣṇuḥ śaraṇyo bhaktavatsalaḥ / gopatiṃ prāha viprendrānālokya praṇatān hariḥ
verses.translation: Santati gave birth to sixty thousand sons from Kratu. All of them were of sublimated sexuality and are called Ba (Va) lakhilyas.
verses.hindi: दक्षके शापसे नारद मुनि ऊर्ध्वरेता हो गये आराध्य देवदेवेशमीशानं त्रिपुरान्तकम्। लेभे त्वप्रतिमं पुत्रं कृष्णद्वैपायनं प्रभुम्
verses.wordMeaning: Santati gave birth to sixty thousand sons from Kratu. All of them were of sublimated sexuality and are called Ba (Va) lakhilyas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Santati gave birth to sixty thousand sons from Kratu. All of them were of sublimated sexuality and are called Ba (Va) lakhilyas.

verses.sanskrit: न वेदबाह्ये पुरुषे पुण्यलेशो ऽपि शङ्कर । संगच्छते महादेव धर्मो वेदाद् विनिर्बभौ
verses.transliteration: na vedabāhye puruṣe puṇyaleśo 'pi śaṅkara / saṃgacchate mahādeva dharmo vedād vinirbabhau
verses.translation: Svaha bore three dignified sons of great prowess, O Brahmanas, to Vahni (fire), the son ofBrahma and of the form of Rudra.
verses.hindi: द्वैपायनाच्छुको जज्ञे भगवानेव शंकरः। अंशांशेनावतीयोर्व्या स्वं प्राप परमं पदम् कन्या कीर्तिमती चैव योगमाता धृतव्रता
verses.wordMeaning: Svaha bore three dignified sons of great prowess, O Brahmanas, to Vahni (fire), the son ofBrahma and of the form of Rudra.
verses.commentary: Sense: Svaha bore three dignified sons of great prowess, O Brahmanas, to Vahni (fire), the son ofBrahma and of the form of Rudra.

verses.sanskrit: तथापि भक्तवात्सल्याद् रक्षितव्या महेश्वर । अस्माभिः सर्व एवेमे गन्तारो नरकानपि
verses.transliteration: tathāpi bhaktavātsalyād rakṣitavyā maheśvara / asmābhiḥ sarva eveme gantāro narakānapi
verses.translation: They were Pavaka, Pavamana and Suciragni or Suci. The fire produced by attrition is called Pavamana; the fire from lightning is called as Pavaka.
verses.hindi: एतेऽत्र वंश्याः कथिता ब्राह्मणा ब्रह्मवादिनाम्। अत ऊर्ध्व निबोधध्वं कश्यपाद्राजसंततिम् नारदकी मायासे हर्यश्वोंके नष्ट हो जानेपर क्रोधसे लाल आँखोंवाले दक्षने नारदको (इस प्रकार) शाप दिया--
verses.wordMeaning: They were Pavaka, Pavamana and Suciragni or Suci. The fire produced by attrition is called Pavamana; the fire from lightning is called as Pavaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were Pavaka, Pavamana and Suciragni or Suci. The fire produced by attrition is called Pavamana; the fire from lightning is called as Pavaka.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद् वै वेदबाह्यानां रक्षणार्थाय पापिनाम् । विमोहनाय शास्त्राणि करिष्यामो वृषध्वज
verses.transliteration: tasmād vai vedabāhyānāṃ rakṣaṇārthāya pāpinām / vimohanāya śāstrāṇi kariṣyāmo vṛṣadhvaja
verses.translation: Going up to the mountain Govardhana, he perform¬ ed a penance after subduing the sense-organs. Lord Visnu the wielder of a conch, a discus and the iron club was delighted at his penance.
verses.hindi: 'द्विज! चूँकि आपकी मायासे मेरे सभी पुत्र सभी प्रकारसे विनाशको प्राप्त हो गये, अत: आप भी संतानरहित होंगे।' वसिष्ठने अरुन्धतीसे शक्ति नामक पुत्र उत्पन्न किया। शक्तिके पराशर हुए जो श्रीसम्पन्न, सर्वज्ञ तथा तपस्वियोंमें श्रेष्ठ थे। उन्होंने त्रिपुरका नाश करनेवाले देवाधिदेव शंकरकी आराधनाकर कृष्णद्वैपायन नामवाले अप्रतिम एवं शक्तिसम्पन्न पुत्रको प्राप्त किया ॥ २२--२४॥
verses.wordMeaning: Going up to the mountain Govardhana, he perform¬ ed a penance after subduing the sense-organs. Lord Visnu the wielder of a conch, a discus and the iron club was delighted at his penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: Going up to the mountain Govardhana, he perform¬ ed a penance after subduing the sense-organs. Lord Visnu the wielder of a conch, a discus and the iron club was delighted at his penance.

verses.sanskrit: एवं संबोधितो रुद्रो माधवेन मुरारिणा । चकार मोहशास्त्राणि केशवो ऽपि शिवेरितः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ saṃbodhito rudro mādhavena murāriṇā / cakāra mohaśāstrāṇi keśavo 'pi śiveritaḥ
verses.translation: The son of Vena had unswerving devotion. He ruled over his kingdom in accordance with the injunctions of the Vedas constantly thinking over and remembering Madhusudana (or Visnu).
verses.hindi: भगवान् शंकर ही शुक नामसे द्वैपायनके पुत्र हुए। पृथ्वीपर अपने अंशांशरूपसे उत्पन्न होकर (पुनः) अपने परम पदको प्राप्त हुए। शुकके महान् तपस्वी पाँच पुत्र हुए, वे भूरिश्रवा, प्रभु, शम्भु, कृष्ण तथा पाँचवें गौर नामवाले थे। साथ ही कीर्तिमती नामकी एक कन्या भी हुई, जो योगमाता और ब्रतपरायणा थी
verses.wordMeaning: The son of Vena had unswerving devotion. He ruled over his kingdom in accordance with the injunctions of the Vedas constantly thinking over and remembering Madhusudana (or Visnu).
verses.commentary: Sense: The son of Vena had unswerving devotion. He ruled over his kingdom in accordance with the injunctions of the Vedas constantly thinking over and remembering Madhusudana (or Visnu).

verses.sanskrit: कापालं नाकुलं वामं भैरवं पूर्वपश्चिमम् । पञ्चरात्रं पाशुपतं तथान्यानि सहस्त्रशः
verses.transliteration: kāpālaṃ nākulaṃ vāmaṃ bhairavaṃ pūrvapaścimam / pañcarātraṃ pāśupataṃ tathānyāni sahastraśaḥ
verses.translation: Ere long, his wife (Antardhana) of slender limbs and pure smiles gave birth to Sikhandin and Havirdhana through Antardhana (internal meditation).
verses.hindi: इन ब्रह्मवादी ब्राह्मणोंके वंशजोंका यह वर्णन किया गया, अब आगे कश्यपसे उत्पन्न क्षत्रिय संतानोंका वर्णन सुनो-- सूर्यबंश-बर्णनमें वैवस्वत मनुकी संतानोंका वर्णन, युवनाश्वको गौतमका उपदेश, महातपस्वी राजा वसुमनाकी कथा, वसुमनाके अश्वमेध-यज्ञमें ऋषियों तथा
verses.wordMeaning: Ere long, his wife (Antardhana) of slender limbs and pure smiles gave birth to Sikhandin and Havirdhana through Antardhana (internal meditation).
verses.commentary: Sense: Ere long, his wife (Antardhana) of slender limbs and pure smiles gave birth to Sikhandin and Havirdhana through Antardhana (internal meditation).

verses.sanskrit: सृष्ट्वा तानूचतुर्देवौ कुर्वाणाः शास्त्रचोदितम् । पतन्तो निरये घोरे बहून् कल्पान् पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: sṛṣṭvā tānūcaturdevau kurvāṇāḥ śāstracoditam / patanto niraye ghore bahūn kalpān punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: A son who became famous by the name Susila was born to Sikhandin. He was righteous, endowed with beauty and a master of the Vedas and the Vedahgas.
verses.hindi: हिमालयमें जाकर तप करना और अन्तमें उसे शिवपदकी प्राप्ति सूतजी बोले अदितिने कश्यपसे शक्तिशाली ' आदित्य' नामक पुत्रको उत्पन्न किया। उस आदित्यकी
verses.wordMeaning: A son who became famous by the name Susila was born to Sikhandin. He was righteous, endowed with beauty and a master of the Vedas and the Vedahgas.
verses.commentary: Sense: A son who became famous by the name Susila was born to Sikhandin. He was righteous, endowed with beauty and a master of the Vedas and the Vedahgas.

verses.sanskrit: जायन्तो मानुषे लोके क्षीणपापचयास्ततः । ईश्वराराधनबलाद् गच्छध्वं सुकृतां गतिम् । वर्तध्वं मत्प्रसादेन नान्यथा निष्कृतिर्हि वः
verses.transliteration: jāyanto mānuṣe loke kṣīṇapāpacayāstataḥ / īśvarārādhanabalād gacchadhvaṃ sukṛtāṃ gatim / vartadhvaṃ matprasādena nānyathā niṣkṛtirhi vaḥ
verses.translation: He studied the Vedas duly and virtuously and was established in penance. As good luck would have it, that knower of Dharma became inclined towards renunciation.
verses.hindi: संज्ञा राज्ञी प्रभा छाया पुत्रांस्तासां निबोधत॥ १॥  उनके पुत्रोंको सुनो--त्वष्टा (विश्वकर्मा)-की पुत्री संज्ञाने सूर्यसे श्रेष्ठ मनु, यम और यमुनाको उत्पन्न किया और
verses.wordMeaning: He studied the Vedas duly and virtuously and was established in penance. As good luck would have it, that knower of Dharma became inclined towards renunciation.
verses.commentary: Sense: He studied the Vedas duly and virtuously and was established in penance. As good luck would have it, that knower of Dharma became inclined towards renunciation.

verses.sanskrit: एवमीश्वरविष्णुभ्यां चोदितास्ते महर्षयः । आदेशं प्रत्यपद्यन्त शिरसासुरविद्विषोः
verses.transliteration: evamīśvaraviṣṇubhyāṃ coditāste maharṣayaḥ / ādeśaṃ pratyapadyanta śirasāsuravidviṣoḥ
verses.translation: Eager that he was in the Self study (of the Vedas) and the performance of penance he resorted to holy centres.
verses.hindi: यमं च यमुनां चैव राज्ञी रैवतमेव च॥ २॥  राज्ञीने रैवतको उत्पन्न किया। प्रभाने आदित्यसे प्रभातको शनिं च तपतीं चैव विष्टिं चैव यथाक्रमम्॥ ३॥  विष्टि नामक संतानोंको जन्म दिया
verses.wordMeaning: Eager that he was in the Self study (of the Vedas) and the performance of penance he resorted to holy centres.
verses.commentary: Sense: Eager that he was in the Self study (of the Vedas) and the performance of penance he resorted to holy centres.

verses.sanskrit: चक्रुस्ते ऽन्यानि शास्त्राणि तत्र तत्र रताः पुनः । शिष्यानध्यापयामासुर्दर्शयित्वा फलानि तु
verses.transliteration: cakruste 'nyāni śāstrāṇi tatra tatra ratāḥ punaḥ / śiṣyānadhyāpayāmāsurdarśayitvā phalāni tu
verses.translation: There he saw a holy forest named Dhamnavana which affords the achievement of Dharma—a place accessible to the Yogins and inaccessible to the haters of Brahman.
verses.hindi: नरिष्यन्तश्च नाभागो हारिष्ट: कारुषकस्तथा। पृषश्षश्च महातेजा नवैते शक्रसंनिभाः असूत सौम्यजं देवी पुरूरवसमुत्तमम्। पितृणां तृसिकर्तारं बुधादिति हि नः श्रुतम्
verses.wordMeaning: There he saw a holy forest named Dhamnavana which affords the achievement of Dharma—a place accessible to the Yogins and inaccessible to the haters of Brahman.
verses.commentary: Sense: There he saw a holy forest named Dhamnavana which affords the achievement of Dharma—a place accessible to the Yogins and inaccessible to the haters of Brahman.

verses.sanskrit: मोहयन्त इमं लोकमवतीर्य महीतले । चकार शङ्करो भिक्षां हितायैषां द्विजैः सह
verses.transliteration: mohayanta imaṃ lokamavatīrya mahītale / cakāra śaṅkaro bhikṣāṃ hitāyaiṣāṃ dvijaiḥ saha
verses.translation: A very holy and pure river named Mandakini flowed there. It was endowed with clusterous growth of red and blue lotuses and was bedecked with the hermitages of the Siddhas.
verses.hindi: इक्ष्वाकोश्चाभवद् वीरो विकुक्षिर्नाम पार्थिवः । तेषां ज्येष्ठः ककुत्स्थोऽभूत् काकुत्स्थो हि सुयोधनः ।
verses.wordMeaning: A very holy and pure river named Mandakini flowed there. It was endowed with clusterous growth of red and blue lotuses and was bedecked with the hermitages of the Siddhas.
verses.commentary: Sense: A very holy and pure river named Mandakini flowed there. It was endowed with clusterous growth of red and blue lotuses and was bedecked with the hermitages of the Siddhas.

verses.sanskrit: कपालमालाभरणः प्रेतभस्मावगुण्ठितः । विमोहयंल्लोकमिमं जटामण्डलमण्डितः
verses.transliteration: kapālamālābharaṇaḥ pretabhasmāvaguṇṭhitaḥ / vimohayaṃllokamimaṃ jaṭāmaṇḍalamaṇḍitaḥ
verses.translation: On its southern bank, he saw a beautiful and very holy hermitage occupied by leading sages and Yogins and felt delighted.
verses.hindi: विश्वकादार्द्रको धीमान् युवनाश्वस्तु तत्सुतः । स गोकर्णमनृप्राप्य युवनाश्वः प्रतापवान्
verses.wordMeaning: On its southern bank, he saw a beautiful and very holy hermitage occupied by leading sages and Yogins and felt delighted.
verses.commentary: Sense: On its southern bank, he saw a beautiful and very holy hermitage occupied by leading sages and Yogins and felt delighted.

verses.sanskrit: निक्षिप्य पार्वतीं देवीं विष्णावमिततेजसि । नियोज्याङ्गभवं रुद्रं भैरवं दुष्टनिग्रहे
verses.transliteration: nikṣipya pārvatīṃ devīṃ viṣṇāvamitatejasi / niyojyāṅgabhavaṃ rudraṃ bhairavaṃ duṣṭanigrahe
verses.translation: He propitiated Girisa (god Siva) by means of (reciting) Rudradhyaya and the CanVa (narrative) of Rudra, as well as by many different kinds of hymns of Sambhu, taken from the Vedas.
verses.hindi: प्रणम्य दण्डवद् भूमौ पुत्रकामो महीपतिः । अपृच्छत् कर्मणा केन धार्मिकं प्राप्नुयात् सुतम् आराध्य पूर्वपुरुषं नारायणमनामयम्। अनादिनिधनं देवं धार्मिकं प्राप्नुयात् सुतम्
verses.wordMeaning: He propitiated Girisa (god Siva) by means of (reciting) Rudradhyaya and the CanVa (narrative) of Rudra, as well as by many different kinds of hymns of Sambhu, taken from the Vedas.
verses.commentary: Sense: He propitiated Girisa (god Siva) by means of (reciting) Rudradhyaya and the CanVa (narrative) of Rudra, as well as by many different kinds of hymns of Sambhu, taken from the Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: दत्त्वा नारायणे देवीं नन्दिनं कुलनन्दिनम् । संस्थाप्य तत्र गणपान् देवानिन्द्रपुरोगमान्
verses.transliteration: dattvā nārāyaṇe devīṃ nandinaṃ kulanandinam / saṃsthāpya tatra gaṇapān devānindrapurogamān
verses.translation: In the meantime (while praying) he saw the great sage named Svetasvatara coming. He was the most excellent among the great devotees of Pasupati (god Siva).
verses.hindi: यस्य पुत्रः स्वयं ब्रह्मा पौत्रः स्यान्नीललोहितः । तमादिकृष्णमीशानमाराध्याप्नोति सत्सुतम् न यस्य भगवान् ब्रह्मा प्रभावं वेत्ति तत्त्वत: । तमाराध्य हृषीकेशं प्राप्नुयाद्धार्मिकं सुतम्
verses.wordMeaning: In the meantime (while praying) he saw the great sage named Svetasvatara coming. He was the most excellent among the great devotees of Pasupati (god Siva).
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meantime (while praying) he saw the great sage named Svetasvatara coming. He was the most excellent among the great devotees of Pasupati (god Siva).

verses.sanskrit: प्रस्थिते ऽथ महादेवे विष्णुर्विश्वतनुः स्वयम् । स्त्रीरूपधारी नियतं सेवते स्म महेश्वरीम्
verses.transliteration: prasthite 'tha mahādeve viṣṇurviśvatanuḥ svayam / strīrūpadhārī niyataṃ sevate sma maheśvarīm
verses.translation: He had applied Bhasma (ashes) all over his limbs. The loin cloth was the only covering garment he had. His body was emaciated due to the performance of penance. He was wearing a white sacred thread.
verses.hindi: आराधयन्महायोगं वासुदेवं सनातनम् + राजा सुद्युप्रकी कथामें 'इला' की उत्पत्तिका वर्णन है।
verses.wordMeaning: He had applied Bhasma (ashes) all over his limbs. The loin cloth was the only covering garment he had. His body was emaciated due to the performance of penance. He was wearing a white sacred thread.
verses.commentary: Sense: He had applied Bhasma (ashes) all over his limbs. The loin cloth was the only covering garment he had. His body was emaciated due to the performance of penance. He was wearing a white sacred thread.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मा हुताशनः शक्रो यमो ऽन्ये सुरपुङ्गवाः । सिषेविरे महादेवीं स्त्रीवेशं शोभनं गताः
verses.transliteration: brahmā hutāśanaḥ śakro yamo 'nye surapuṅgavāḥ / siṣevire mahādevīṃ strīveśaṃ śobhanaṃ gatāḥ
verses.translation: After concluding his eulogy of Sambhu, he bowed down his head at his feet. His eyes were rendered dim due to tears (ofjoy). With palms joined in reverence, he spoke these words.
verses.hindi: प्रथम मनुके नौ पुत्र थे जो इक्ष्वाकु, नभग, धृष्ट, शर्याति, नरिष्यन्त, नाभाग, अरिष्ट, कारुषक तथा पृषध्र नामवाले थे। ये नवों पुत्र इन्द्रियजयी, महान् तेजसे सम्पन्न तथा इन्द्रके समान थे (मनुकी) ज्येष्ठ एवं बरिष्ठ (पुत्री) इलाने सोमवंशकी अभिवृद्धिके लिये बुधके भवनमें जाकर सोमपुत्र (बुध)-के साथ संगति की और हमने सुना है कि उस देवीने बुधसे श्रेष्ठ पुरूरवाको उत्पन्न किया। वह
verses.wordMeaning: After concluding his eulogy of Sambhu, he bowed down his head at his feet. His eyes were rendered dim due to tears (ofjoy). With palms joined in reverence, he spoke these words.
verses.commentary: Sense: After concluding his eulogy of Sambhu, he bowed down his head at his feet. His eyes were rendered dim due to tears (ofjoy). With palms joined in reverence, he spoke these words.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वरश्च भगवान् शंभोरत्यन्तवल्लभः । द्वारदेशे गणाध्यक्षो यथापूर्वमतिष्ठत
verses.transliteration: nandīśvaraśca bhagavān śaṃbhoratyantavallabhaḥ / dvāradeśe gaṇādhyakṣo yathāpūrvamatiṣṭhata
verses.translation: "I am contented, blessed. Since the leading sage and Yogin, the holy Lord, the most excellent among the knowers of Yoga has been personally seen by me.
verses.hindi: पितरोंको तृप्ति प्रदान करनेवाला था। (पुत्र प्राप्त करनेके उपरान्त इलाको) विशुद्ध पुरुषत्वकी प्राप्ति हुई जो सुद्युम्न नामसे विख्यात हुआ। (पुरुषरूपमें) इलाने उत्कल, गय तथा विनताश्व नामक तीन पुत्रोंको प्राप्त किया, तदनन्तर वह पुनः स्त्री हो गयी, वे सभी अतुलनीय कीर्तिमान् तथा ब्रह्मपरायण थे
verses.wordMeaning: "I am contented, blessed. Since the leading sage and Yogin, the holy Lord, the most excellent among the knowers of Yoga has been personally seen by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: "I am contented, blessed. Since the leading sage and Yogin, the holy Lord, the most excellent among the knowers of Yoga has been personally seen by me.

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे दैत्यो ह्यन्धको नाम दुर्मतिः । आहर्तुकामो गिरिजामाजगामाथ मन्दरम्
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare daityo hyandhako nāma durmatiḥ / āhartukāmo girijāmājagāmātha mandaram
verses.translation: Ah! My good luck is indeed great. My penances have become fruitful. What shall I do? O sinless one, I am your disciple. Save me."
verses.hindi: मनुके ज्येष्ठ पुत्र इक्ष्वाकुसे विकुक्षि नामक वीर राजा हुए। विकुक्षि सौ पुत्रॉमें ज्येष्ठ थे। उनके पंद्रह पुत्र हुए। उनमें ककुत्स्थ सबसे बड़े थे। ककुत्स्थका पुत्र सुयोधन था। सुयोधनसे श्रीमान् पृथु उत्पन्न हुए और विश्वक पृथुके पुत्र थे। विश्वकसे बुद्धिमान् आर्द्रक हुए और उनके पुत्र युवनाश्व हुए। प्रतापी वे युवनाश्व गोकर्ण तीर्थमें गये
verses.wordMeaning: Ah! My good luck is indeed great. My penances have become fruitful. What shall I do? O sinless one, I am your disciple. Save me."
verses.commentary: Sense: Ah! My good luck is indeed great. My penances have become fruitful. What shall I do? O sinless one, I am your disciple. Save me."

verses.sanskrit: संप्राप्तमन्धकं दृष्ट्वा शङ्करः कालभैरवः । न्यषेधयदमेयात्मा कालरूपधरो हरः
verses.transliteration: saṃprāptamandhakaṃ dṛṣṭvā śaṅkaraḥ kālabhairavaḥ / nyaṣedhayadameyātmā kālarūpadharo haraḥ
verses.translation: He blessed the King of very good conduct and ■gentle behaviour. He accepted him as his disciple, for he had ■wiped off all his sins, thanks to his penance.
verses.hindi: वहाँ तप कर रहे अग्रि-सदृश विप्र गौतमका दर्शन- कर पुत्र-प्रापिकी इच्छासे युवनाश्वने भूमिमें दण्डवत् प्रणाम किया और उनसे (गौतमसे) पूछा- (भगवन्!) किस कर्मके द्वारा धर्मात्मा पुत्रको प्राप्त किया जा गौतमने कहा--आदि और अन्तसे रहित, अनामय, पूर्वपुरुष नारायणदेवकी आराधनासे धर्मात्मा पुत्रकी प्राप्ति होती है । जिनके पुत्र स्वयं ब्रह्मा हैं और (जिनके) पौत्र नीललोहित शंकर हैं, उन आदिकृष्ण ईशानको
verses.wordMeaning: He blessed the King of very good conduct and ■gentle behaviour. He accepted him as his disciple, for he had ■wiped off all his sins, thanks to his penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: He blessed the King of very good conduct and ■gentle behaviour. He accepted him as his disciple, for he had ■wiped off all his sins, thanks to his penance.

verses.sanskrit: तयोः समभवद् युद्धं सुघोरं रोमहर्षणम् । शूलेनोरसि तं दैत्यमाजघान वृषध्वजः
verses.transliteration: tayoḥ samabhavad yuddhaṃ sughoraṃ romaharṣaṇam / śūlenorasi taṃ daityamājaghāna vṛṣadhvajaḥ
verses.translation: The clever sage made him perform all rites pertaining to sannjdsa and then bestowed on him the divine knowledge (about Siva) for which the holy rites had been laid down in his own branch of the Vedas.
verses.hindi: आराधनासे (मनुष्य) सत्पुत्र प्राप्त करता है। भगवान् ब्रह्मा भी जिनके प्रभावको तत्त्वत: नहीं जानते हैं, उन हषीकेशकी आराधनासे धार्मिक पुत्रको प्राप्त करना चाहिए ॥ १४--१६॥ गौतमके वचनको सुनकर उस पृथ्वीपति युवनाश्वने महायोगी सनातन वासुदेवकी आराधना प्रारम्भ की
verses.wordMeaning: The clever sage made him perform all rites pertaining to sannjdsa and then bestowed on him the divine knowledge (about Siva) for which the holy rites had been laid down in his own branch of the Vedas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The clever sage made him perform all rites pertaining to sannjdsa and then bestowed on him the divine knowledge (about Siva) for which the holy rites had been laid down in his own branch of the Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: ततः सहस्त्रशो दैत्यः ससर्जान्धकसंज्ञितान् । नन्दिषेणादयो दैत्यैरन्धकैरभिनिर्जिताः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sahastraśo daityaḥ sasarjāndhakasaṃjñitān / nandiṣeṇādayo daityairandhakairabhinirjitāḥ
verses.translation: He gave him the entire essence of the Vedas, that secures the release of the Pasu (Individual soul) from the Pdia (the binding noose of Avidyd). It is famous as the Antydiramd}- (the last stage of life). It has been performed by Brahma and others.
verses.hindi: लेभे त्वप्रतिमं पुत्रं विष्णुभक्तमनुत्तमम्। मान्धातारं महाप्राज्ञं सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरम् विष्णुवृद्धः सुतस्तस्य त्वनरण्योऽभवत् पर: । बृहदश्वोऽनरण्यस्य हर्यश्वस्तत्सुतोऽभवत्
verses.wordMeaning: He gave him the entire essence of the Vedas, that secures the release of the Pasu (Individual soul) from the Pdia (the binding noose of Avidyd). It is famous as the Antydiramd}- (the last stage of life). It has been performed by Brahma and others.
verses.commentary: Sense: He gave him the entire essence of the Vedas, that secures the release of the Pasu (Individual soul) from the Pdia (the binding noose of Avidyd). It is famous as the Antydiramd}- (the last stage of life). It has been performed by Brahma and others.

verses.sanskrit: घण्टाकर्णो मेघनादश्चण्डेशश्चण्डतापनः । विनायको मेघवाहः सोमनन्दी च वैद्युतः
verses.transliteration: ghaṇṭākarṇo meghanādaścaṇḍeśaścaṇḍatāpanaḥ / vināyako meghavāhaḥ somanandī ca vaidyutaḥ
verses.translation: Glancing at all his disciples, those who resided in that hermitage viz. Brahmanas, Ksattriyas and Vaisyas who were all interested in maintaining celibacy, he said thus:
verses.hindi: सोऽतीव धार्मिको राजा कर्दमस्य प्रजापतेः । प्रसादाद्धार्मिक पुत्रं लेभे सूर्यपरायणम् स तु सूर्य समभ्यर्च्य राजा वसुमनाः शुभम्। लेभे त्वप्रतिमं पुत्रं त्रिधन्वानमरिंदमम्
verses.wordMeaning: Glancing at all his disciples, those who resided in that hermitage viz. Brahmanas, Ksattriyas and Vaisyas who were all interested in maintaining celibacy, he said thus:
verses.commentary: Sense: Glancing at all his disciples, those who resided in that hermitage viz. Brahmanas, Ksattriyas and Vaisyas who were all interested in maintaining celibacy, he said thus:

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे ऽन्धकं दैत्यवरं संप्राप्यातिबलान्विताः । युयुधुः शूलशक्त्यृष्टिगिरिकूटपरश्वधैः
verses.transliteration: sarve 'ndhakaṃ daityavaraṃ saṃprāpyātibalānvitāḥ / yuyudhuḥ śūlaśaktyṛṣṭigirikūṭaparaśvadhaiḥ
verses.translation: "It is only after studying the branch of knowledge initiated by me that the Yogins attain Mahadeva after medi¬ tating on the universe as the creation of the Lord.
verses.hindi: स्वाध्यायवान् दानशीलस्तितिक्षुर्धर्मतत्परः ऋषयस्तु समाजम्मुर्यज्ञवाटं महात्मनः । वसिष्ठकश्यपमुखा देवाश्चेन्द्रपुरोगमाः
verses.wordMeaning: "It is only after studying the branch of knowledge initiated by me that the Yogins attain Mahadeva after medi¬ tating on the universe as the creation of the Lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: "It is only after studying the branch of knowledge initiated by me that the Yogins attain Mahadeva after medi¬ tating on the universe as the creation of the Lord.

verses.sanskrit: भ्रामयित्वाथ हस्ताभ्यां गृहीतचरणद्वयाः । दैत्येन्द्रेणातिबलिना क्षिप्तास्ते शतयोजनम्
verses.transliteration: bhrāmayitvātha hastābhyāṃ gṛhītacaraṇadvayāḥ / daityendreṇātibalinā kṣiptāste śatayojanam
verses.translation: It is here that the Lord Mahadeva sporting along with his consort Uma, occupies the place, with a desire to bless the devotees.
verses.hindi: समाप्य विधिवद् यज्ञं वसिष्ठादीन् द्विजोत्तमान् (आराधनाके फलस्वरूप) उसका वीर पुत्र हुआ जो ' श्रावस्ति' इस नामसे विख्यात हुआ। उसने गौडदेशमें श्रावस्ति नामक महापुरीका निर्माण किया
verses.wordMeaning: It is here that the Lord Mahadeva sporting along with his consort Uma, occupies the place, with a desire to bless the devotees.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is here that the Lord Mahadeva sporting along with his consort Uma, occupies the place, with a desire to bless the devotees.

verses.sanskrit: ततो ऽन्धकनिसृष्टास्ते शतशो ऽथ सहस्त्रशः । कालसूर्यप्रतीकाशा भैरवं त्वभिदुद्रुवुः
verses.transliteration: tato 'ndhakanisṛṣṭāste śataśo 'tha sahastraśaḥ / kālasūryapratīkāśā bhairavaṃ tvabhidudruvuḥ
verses.translation: Formerly, Narayana himself, the creator of the entire universe, propitiated Mahadeva here with a desire for the welfare of the worlds.
verses.hindi: उससे (श्रावस्तिसे) बृहदश्व उत्पन्न हुए और उससे कुवलयाश्वक उत्पन्न हुए। धुन्धु नामक महान् असुरको मारनेके कारण वे धुन्धुमारके नामसे प्रसिद्ध हुए। श्रेष्ठ द्विजो! धुन्धुमारके तीन पुत्र कहे गये हैं-दुढाश्व, दण्डाश्च तथा कपिलाश्व। दृढाश्वका प्रमोद और प्रमोदका पुत्र हर्यश्च था। हर्यश्चका पुत्र निकुम्भ था और निकुम्भसे संहताश्वक उत्पन्न हुआ। संहताश्वकके कुशाश्च तथा रणाश्व—ये दो पुत्र हुए। रणाश्वका युद्धमें इन्द्रके तुल्य
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly, Narayana himself, the creator of the entire universe, propitiated Mahadeva here with a desire for the welfare of the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, Narayana himself, the creator of the entire universe, propitiated Mahadeva here with a desire for the welfare of the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: हा हेति शब्दः सुमहान् बभूवातिभयङ्करः । युयोध भैरवो रुद्रः शूलमादाय भीषणम्
verses.transliteration: hā heti śabdaḥ sumahān babhūvātibhayaṅkaraḥ / yuyodha bhairavo rudraḥ śūlamādāya bhīṣaṇam
verses.translation: It is after propitiating Lord Isana (Siva) the deity of even Devas, that Devas and Danavas attained great mira¬ culous powers here.
verses.hindi: बलशाली युवनाश्व नामक पुत्र हुआ युवनाश्वने ऋषियोंकी कृपासे वारुणी नामक यागका (वारुणी नामकी इष्टिका) अनुष्ठान करके अप्रतिम महान् बुद्धिमान्, शस्त्रधारियोंमें सर्वश्रेष्ठ तथा उत्तम विष्णुभक्त मान्धाता नामक पुत्रको प्राप्त किया। मान्धाताके
verses.wordMeaning: It is after propitiating Lord Isana (Siva) the deity of even Devas, that Devas and Danavas attained great mira¬ culous powers here.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is after propitiating Lord Isana (Siva) the deity of even Devas, that Devas and Danavas attained great mira¬ culous powers here.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वान्धकानां सुबलं दुर्जयं तर्जितो हरः । जगाम शरणं देवं वासुदेवमजं विभुम्
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvāndhakānāṃ subalaṃ durjayaṃ tarjito haraḥ / jagāma śaraṇaṃ devaṃ vāsudevamajaṃ vibhum
verses.translation: It was here itself that Marici and all other sages perceived Mahesvara through the power of their penance and attained eternal perfect knowledge.
verses.hindi: नामक पुत्र हुए। युद्धमें वे सभी इन्द्रके समान थे। अम्बरीषका पुत्र दूसरा युवनाश्व कहलाता है। युवनाश्वका पुत्र हरित और उसका पुत्र हारित हुआ पुरुकुत्सका नर्मदा (नामक पल्ली)-से महायशस्वी त्रसद्दस्यु नामक पुत्र उत्पन्न हुआ और उसका पुत्र सम्भूति हुआ। उसका (सम्भूतिका) विष्णुवृद्ध तथा दूसरा अनरण्य नामक पुत्र हुआ। अनरण्यका बृहदश्व
verses.wordMeaning: It was here itself that Marici and all other sages perceived Mahesvara through the power of their penance and attained eternal perfect knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: It was here itself that Marici and all other sages perceived Mahesvara through the power of their penance and attained eternal perfect knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽसृजद् भगवान् विष्णुर्देवीनां शतमुत्तमम् । देवीपार्श्वस्थितो देवो विनाशायामरद्विषाम्
verses.transliteration: so 'sṛjad bhagavān viṣṇurdevīnāṃ śatamuttamam / devīpārśvasthito devo vināśāyāmaradviṣām
verses.translation: Hence, O leading king, you too stay here practis¬ ing penance and Yoga. You stay with me permanently and thereby you will attain Siddhi."
verses.hindi: और उसका पुत्र हर्यश्च हुआ। यही हर्यश्च अत्यन्त धार्मिक राजारूपमें विख्यात हुआ । इसने कर्दम प्रजापतिकी कृपासे धार्मिक सूर्यभक्त (वसुमना नामक) पुत्रको प्राप्त किया। इस वसुमना नामक राजाने सूर्यकी आराधनासे शत्रुओंका दमन करनेवाले अप्रतिम कल्याणकारी त्रिधन्वा नामक पुत्रको प्राप्त किया। श्रेष्ठ द्विजो! स्वाध्यायनिरत, दानशील, सहिष्णु तथा धर्मपरायण (उस) राजाने शत्रुओंको जीतकर अश्वमेध नामक यज्ञ किया
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, O leading king, you too stay here practis¬ ing penance and Yoga. You stay with me permanently and thereby you will attain Siddhi."
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, O leading king, you too stay here practis¬ ing penance and Yoga. You stay with me permanently and thereby you will attain Siddhi."

verses.sanskrit: तथान्धकसहस्त्रं तु देवीभिर्यमसादनम् । नीतं केशवमाहात्म्याल्लीलयैव रणाजिरे
verses.transliteration: tathāndhakasahastraṃ tu devībhiryamasādanam / nītaṃ keśavamāhātmyāllīlayaiva raṇājire
verses.translation: After addressing thus, the leading Brahmana meditat¬ ed on Lord Siva, the wielder of the Pinaka bow. He then imparted precisely the great Mantra for the achievement of every thing ( v.l. of his objectives).
verses.hindi: उस महात्माके यज्ञस्थलमें वसिष्ठ तथा कश्यप आदि प्रमुख ऋषिगण तथा इन्द्र आदि देवता आये। विधिपूर्वक यज्ञ पूर्ण करके उन वसिष्ठ आदि द्विजोत्तमोंको प्रणामकर महाराज (वसुमना)-ने विनयपूर्वक उनसे  इस वंशवर्णनके अनुसार यह तीसरा युवनाश्व है। पहला आर्द्रकका पुत्र, दूसरा रणाश्वका पुत्र और तीसरा यह अम्बरीषका पुत्र ।
verses.wordMeaning: After addressing thus, the leading Brahmana meditat¬ ed on Lord Siva, the wielder of the Pinaka bow. He then imparted precisely the great Mantra for the achievement of every thing ( v.l. of his objectives).
verses.commentary: Sense: After addressing thus, the leading Brahmana meditat¬ ed on Lord Siva, the wielder of the Pinaka bow. He then imparted precisely the great Mantra for the achievement of every thing ( v.l. of his objectives).

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा पराहतं सैन्यमन्धको ऽपि महासुरः । पराङ्मुखोरणात् तस्मात् पलायत महाजवः
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā parāhataṃ sainyamandhako 'pi mahāsuraḥ / parāṅmukhoraṇāt tasmāt palāyata mahājavaḥ
verses.translation: That Mantra suppresses all sins. It is the essence of the Vedas. It yields liberation. It is the holy Mantra begin¬ ning with the word Agni. It has been initiated (made to function) by the sages.
verses.hindi: शर कूर्मपुराण शर किंस्विच्छेयस्करतरं लोकेऽस्मिन् ब्राह्मणर्षभाः ।
verses.wordMeaning: That Mantra suppresses all sins. It is the essence of the Vedas. It yields liberation. It is the holy Mantra begin¬ ning with the word Agni. It has been initiated (made to function) by the sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: That Mantra suppresses all sins. It is the essence of the Vedas. It yields liberation. It is the holy Mantra begin¬ ning with the word Agni. It has been initiated (made to function) by the sages.

verses.sanskrit: ततः क्रीडां महादेवः कृत्वा द्वादशवार्षिकीम् । हिताय लोके भक्तानामाजगामाथ मन्दरम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ krīḍāṃ mahādevaḥ kṛtvā dvādaśavārṣikīm / hitāya loke bhaktānāmājagāmātha mandaram
verses.translation: At his instance King Susila, endowed with faith, became a devotee of Pasupati and was engaged in the study of the Vedas.
verses.hindi: यज्ञस्तपो वा संन्यासो ब्रूत मे सर्ववेदिनः अधीत्य वेदान् विधिवत् पुत्रानुत्पाद्य धर्मतः ।
verses.wordMeaning: At his instance King Susila, endowed with faith, became a devotee of Pasupati and was engaged in the study of the Vedas.
verses.commentary: Sense: At his instance King Susila, endowed with faith, became a devotee of Pasupati and was engaged in the study of the Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: संप्राप्तमीश्वरं ज्ञात्वा सर्व एव गणेश्वराः । समागम्योपतस्थुस्तं भानुमन्तमिव द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: saṃprāptamīśvaraṃ jñātvā sarva eva gaṇeśvarāḥ / samāgamyopatasthustaṃ bhānumantamiva dvijāḥ
verses.translation: He applied the sacred ashes (Aorma) all over his body. He lived on roots, fruits and bulbous roots. He was quie¬ scent and had full self-control. He subdued his anger and resorted to the procedure of renunciation.
verses.hindi: इष्टा यज्ञेश्वरं य॑ज्ञेर्गच्छेद् वनमथात्मवान् आराध्य तपसा देवं योगिनं परमेष्ठिनम्।
verses.wordMeaning: He applied the sacred ashes (Aorma) all over his body. He lived on roots, fruits and bulbous roots. He was quie¬ scent and had full self-control. He subdued his anger and resorted to the procedure of renunciation.
verses.commentary: Sense: He applied the sacred ashes (Aorma) all over his body. He lived on roots, fruits and bulbous roots. He was quie¬ scent and had full self-control. He subdued his anger and resorted to the procedure of renunciation.

verses.sanskrit: प्रविश्य भवनं पुण्यमयुक्तानां दुरासदम् । ददर्श नन्दिनं देवं भैरवं केशवं शिवः
verses.transliteration: praviśya bhavanaṃ puṇyamayuktānāṃ durāsadam / dadarśa nandinaṃ devaṃ bhairavaṃ keśavaṃ śivaḥ
verses.translation: Havirdhana begot a son named Pracinabarhis in Agneyi. He was a master of the science of archery.
verses.hindi: प्रव्रजेद् विधिवद् यज्ञैरिष्ट्वा पूर्व सुरोत्तमान् यमाहुरेकं पुरुषं पुराणं परमेश्वरम्।
verses.wordMeaning: Havirdhana begot a son named Pracinabarhis in Agneyi. He was a master of the science of archery.
verses.commentary: Sense: Havirdhana begot a son named Pracinabarhis in Agneyi. He was a master of the science of archery.

verses.sanskrit: प्रणामप्रवणं देवं सो ऽनुगृह्याथ नन्दिनम् । आघ्राय मूर्धनीशानः केशवं परिषस्वजे
verses.transliteration: praṇāmapravaṇaṃ devaṃ so 'nugṛhyātha nandinam / āghrāya mūrdhanīśānaḥ keśavaṃ pariṣasvaje
verses.translation: Lord Pracinabarhis, who was the most excellent among the wielders of all sorts of weapons, begot of the daughter of the ocean, ten sons.
verses.hindi: तमाराध्य सहस्त्रांशु तपसा मोक्षमाप्नुयात् ३६॥ बीजं भगवता येन स देवस्तपसेज्यते
verses.wordMeaning: Lord Pracinabarhis, who was the most excellent among the wielders of all sorts of weapons, begot of the daughter of the ocean, ten sons.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Pracinabarhis, who was the most excellent among the wielders of all sorts of weapons, begot of the daughter of the ocean, ten sons.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा देवी महादेवं प्रीतिविस्फारितेक्षणा । ननाम शिरसा तस्य पादयोरीश्वरस्य सा
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā devī mahādevaṃ prītivisphāritekṣaṇā / nanāma śirasā tasya pādayorīśvarasya sā
verses.translation: They were well known as Pracetasas. They were kings of reputed power. Devoted to Narayana, they studied their respective Vedas.
verses.hindi: योऽग्निः सर्वात्मकोऽनन्तः स्वयम्भूर्विश्वतोमुखः। स रूद्रस्तपसोग्रेण पूज्यते नेतरैर्मखैः यो यज्ञैरिज्यते देवो जातवेदाः सनातनः। स सर्वहैबततनुः पूज्यते तपसेश्वरः
verses.wordMeaning: They were well known as Pracetasas. They were kings of reputed power. Devoted to Narayana, they studied their respective Vedas.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were well known as Pracetasas. They were kings of reputed power. Devoted to Narayana, they studied their respective Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: निवेद्य विजयं तस्मै शङ्करायाथ शङ्करी । भैरवो विष्णुमाहात्म्यं प्रणतः पार्श्वगो ऽवदत्
verses.transliteration: nivedya vijayaṃ tasmai śaṅkarāyātha śaṅkarī / bhairavo viṣṇumāhātmyaṃ praṇataḥ pārśvago 'vadat
verses.translation: Daksa who had been the blessed son of Brahma formerly and a progenitor as well, was reborn of Marisa and the ten Pracetas collectively.
verses.hindi: स देवदेवस्तपसा पूजनीयः सनातनः सहर्त्रनयनो देवः साक्षी स तु प्रजापतिः । प्रसीदति महायोगी पूजितस्तपसा परः
verses.wordMeaning: Daksa who had been the blessed son of Brahma formerly and a progenitor as well, was reborn of Marisa and the ten Pracetas collectively.
verses.commentary: Sense: Daksa who had been the blessed son of Brahma formerly and a progenitor as well, was reborn of Marisa and the ten Pracetas collectively.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा तद्विजयं शंभुर्विक्रमं केशवस्य च । समास्ते भगवानीशो देव्या सह वरासने
verses.transliteration: śrutvā tadvijayaṃ śaṃbhurvikramaṃ keśavasya ca / samāste bhagavānīśo devyā saha varāsane
verses.translation: That Daksa carried on a verbal dispute with the intelligent Rudra, the great Isa. He was cursed by Rudra and he thereby became the son of Pracetas.
