verses.hindi: प्रा्ाध्ययनयज्ञस्य लब्धपुत्रस्य चैव हि। नान्तरेण तपः कश्चिद्धर्मः शास्त्रेषु दृश्यते वसुमनाने कहा-- श्रेष्ठ ब्राह्मणो! आप सब कुछ जाननेवाले हैं । मुझे यह बतलाइये कि इस संसारमें यज्ञ, तप अथवा संन्यासमें कौन अधिक श्रेयस्कर है ?
verses.wordMeaning: That Daksa carried on a verbal dispute with the intelligent Rudra, the great Isa. He was cursed by Rudra and he thereby became the son of Pracetas.
verses.commentary: Sense: That Daksa carried on a verbal dispute with the intelligent Rudra, the great Isa. He was cursed by Rudra and he thereby became the son of Pracetas.

verses.sanskrit: ततो देवगणाः सर्वे मरीचिप्रमुखा द्विजाः । आजग्मुर्मन्दरं द्रुष्टं देवदेवं त्रिलोचनम्
verses.transliteration: tato devagaṇāḥ sarve marīcipramukhā dvijāḥ / ājagmurmandaraṃ druṣṭaṃ devadevaṃ trilocanam
verses.translation: Seeing that Daksa was coming to his residence, he along with his consort personally accorded him befitting worship.
verses.hindi: वसिष्ठ बोले आत्मवानूको चाहिए कि वह वेदोंका विधिवत् अध्ययन करके धर्मपूर्वक पुत्रोंको उत्पन्न करे और यज्ञोंद्वारा यज्ञेश्वरका यजनकर वनमें जाय पुलस्त्यने कहा--सर्वप्रथम श्रेष्ठ देवोंको यञ्द्वारा अर्चना करके और तपस्याद्वारा योगी देव परमेश्वरको आराधना करके विधिपूर्वक संन्यास ग्रहण करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: Seeing that Daksa was coming to his residence, he along with his consort personally accorded him befitting worship.
verses.commentary: Sense: Seeing that Daksa was coming to his residence, he along with his consort personally accorded him befitting worship.

verses.sanskrit: येन तद् विजितं पूर्वं देवीनां शतमुत्तमम् । समागतं दैत्यसैन्यमीश्दर्शनवाञ्छया
verses.transliteration: yena tad vijitaṃ pūrvaṃ devīnāṃ śatamuttamam / samāgataṃ daityasainyamīśdarśanavāñchayā
verses.translation: Then the son of Brahma (Daksa) who had been infested with the Tamo-Guna yearned for more worship than he deserved. He became infuriated and went away to his house (in a huff).
verses.hindi: पुलह बोले-जिन्हें अद्वितीय, पुराणपुरुष तथा परमेश्वर कहा गया है, उन सहस्त्रकिरण (सूर्य)-की तपस्याद्वारा आराधना करके मोक्ष प्राप्त करना चाहिए जमदग्मिने कहा--जिन भगवान् ईश्वरने अजन्मा (ब्रह्म )-की नाभिमें अद्वितीय बीज (जगत्कारण ब्रह्मा)- को स्थापित किया, उन देवकी तपस्याद्वारा आराधना को जानी चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: Then the son of Brahma (Daksa) who had been infested with the Tamo-Guna yearned for more worship than he deserved. He became infuriated and went away to his house (in a huff).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the son of Brahma (Daksa) who had been infested with the Tamo-Guna yearned for more worship than he deserved. He became infuriated and went away to his house (in a huff).

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा वरासनासीनं देव्या चन्द्रविभूषणम् । प्रणेमुरादराद् देव्यो गायन्ति स्मातिलालसाः
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā varāsanāsīnaṃ devyā candravibhūṣaṇam / praṇemurādarād devyo gāyanti smātilālasāḥ
verses.translation: Once, when Sati had come to her own house, the evil-minded Daksa used word of abuse to her and angrily scolded her along with her husband.
verses.hindi: विश्वामित्रने कहा--जो अग्निस्वरूप, सर्वात्मक, अनन्त, स्वयम्भू तथा सर्वतोमुख हैं, वे रुद्र उग्र तपस्याद्वारा पूजनीय हैं न कि अन्य किसी दूसरे यज्ञ आदि साधनोंद्वारा भरद्वाज बोले--यजोंद्रार जिन सनातन अग्निदेवकी पूजा की जाती है, वे सभी देवताओंके विग्रहरूप परमेश्वर ही तपके द्वारा पूजित होते हँ
verses.wordMeaning: Once, when Sati had come to her own house, the evil-minded Daksa used word of abuse to her and angrily scolded her along with her husband.
verses.commentary: Sense: Once, when Sati had come to her own house, the evil-minded Daksa used word of abuse to her and angrily scolded her along with her husband.

verses.sanskrit: प्रणेमुर्गिरिजां देवीं वामपार्श्वे पिनाकिनः । देवासनगतं देवं नारायणमनामयम्
verses.transliteration: praṇemurgirijāṃ devīṃ vāmapārśve pinākinaḥ / devāsanagataṃ devaṃ nārāyaṇamanāmayam
verses.translation: ''All my other sons-in-law are superior to your hus¬ band the wielder of the Pinaka bow. You too are an evil daughter among my good daughters. Hence go away from this house (back to your place) in the manner you had come.
verses.hindi: अत्रि बोले--वे महेश्वर अत्यन्त महान् तपके द्वारा पूजे जाते हँ, जिनसे यह सब उत्पन्न हुआ है और प्रजापति जिनकी संतान हैं गौतमने कहा--जिससे प्रधान अर्थात् पुरुष और प्रकृति उत्पन्न हुए हैं और जिनकी शक्तिसे यह जगत् (उत्पन्न) हुआ है, वे सनातन देवाधिदेव तपस्याद्वारा पूजनीय हैं
verses.wordMeaning: ''All my other sons-in-law are superior to your hus¬ band the wielder of the Pinaka bow. You too are an evil daughter among my good daughters. Hence go away from this house (back to your place) in the manner you had come.
verses.commentary: Sense: ''All my other sons-in-law are superior to your hus¬ band the wielder of the Pinaka bow. You too are an evil daughter among my good daughters. Hence go away from this house (back to your place) in the manner you had come.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा सिंहासनासीनं देव्या नारायणेन च । प्रणम्य देवमीशानं पृष्टवत्यो वराङ्गनाः
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā siṃhāsanāsīnaṃ devyā nārāyaṇena ca / praṇamya devamīśānaṃ pṛṣṭavatyo varāṅganāḥ
verses.translation: On hearing his words, the goddess, the beloved of Sankara censured her father, Daksa, and burned herself by means of her own self (by Yogic process).
verses.hindi: कश्यपने कहा--तपद्वारा आराधना करनेसे वे क्रतु बोले--अध्ययनरूपी यज्ञ पूर्ण कर पुत्र प्रात कर लेनेवाले पुरुषके लिये तपस्याके अतिरिक्त कोई और दूसरा धर्म शास्त्रोंमें दिखायी नहीं देता
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing his words, the goddess, the beloved of Sankara censured her father, Daksa, and burned herself by means of her own self (by Yogic process).
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing his words, the goddess, the beloved of Sankara censured her father, Daksa, and burned herself by means of her own self (by Yogic process).

verses.sanskrit: कन्या ऊचुः कस्त्वं विभ्राजसे कान्त्या केयं बालरविप्रभा । को ऽन्वयं भ्ति वपुषा पङ्कजायतलोचनः
verses.transliteration: kanyā ūcuḥ kastvaṃ vibhrājase kāntyā keyaṃ bālaraviprabhā / ko 'nvayaṃ bhti vapuṣā paṅkajāyatalocanaḥ
verses.translation: After bowing to her husband Pasupati, the wearer of elephant's hide, she became the daughter of Himavan, being delighted at his penance.
verses.hindi: इत्याकर्ण्य स राजर्षिस्तान् प्रणम्यातिहष्टधीः । विसर्जयित्वा सम्पूज्य त्रिधन्वानमथाब्रवीत् आराधयिष्ये तपसा देवमेकाक्षराह्वयम्। प्राणं बृहन्तं पुरुषमादित्यान्तरसंस्थितम्
verses.wordMeaning: After bowing to her husband Pasupati, the wearer of elephant's hide, she became the daughter of Himavan, being delighted at his penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: After bowing to her husband Pasupati, the wearer of elephant's hide, she became the daughter of Himavan, being delighted at his penance.

verses.sanskrit: निशम्य तासां वचनं वृषेन्द्रवरवाहनः । व्याजहार महायोगी भूताधिपतिरव्ययः
verses.transliteration: niśamya tāsāṃ vacanaṃ vṛṣendravaravāhanaḥ / vyājahāra mahāyogī bhūtādhipatiravyayaḥ
verses.translation: On knowing her (dead in this manner) Lord Rudra, Kara, the dispeller of dejectedness of those who resort to him, became infuriated and after coming to his house, cursed Daksa.
verses.hindi: त्वं तु धर्मरतो नित्यं पालयैतदतन्द्रितः। चातुर्वणर्यसमायुक्तमशेषं क्षितिमण्डलम् हिमवच्छिखरे रम्ये देवदारुवने शुभे। कन्दमूलफलाहारो मुन्यन्नैरयजत् सुरान्
verses.wordMeaning: On knowing her (dead in this manner) Lord Rudra, Kara, the dispeller of dejectedness of those who resort to him, became infuriated and after coming to his house, cursed Daksa.
verses.commentary: Sense: On knowing her (dead in this manner) Lord Rudra, Kara, the dispeller of dejectedness of those who resort to him, became infuriated and after coming to his house, cursed Daksa.

verses.sanskrit: अहं नारायणो गौरी जगन्माता सनातनी । विभज्य संस्थितो देवः स्वात्मानं बहुधेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ nārāyaṇo gaurī jaganmātā sanātanī / vibhajya saṃsthito devaḥ svātmānaṃ bahudheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: 'After abandoning this body, born of Brahma, be born in the family of Ksattriyas. You will be a foolish-minded person and will beget a son of your own daughter.'
verses.hindi: जजाप मनसा देवीं सावित्रीं वेदमातरम् तस्यैवं जपतो देवः स्वयम्भूः परमेश्वरः । हिरण्यगर्भो विश्वात्मा तं देशमगमत् स्वयम्
verses.wordMeaning: 'After abandoning this body, born of Brahma, be born in the family of Ksattriyas. You will be a foolish-minded person and will beget a son of your own daughter.'
verses.commentary: Sense: 'After abandoning this body, born of Brahma, be born in the family of Ksattriyas. You will be a foolish-minded person and will beget a son of your own daughter.'

verses.sanskrit: न मे विदुः परं तत्त्वं देवाद्या न महर्षयः । एको ऽयं वेद विश्वात्मा भवानी विष्णुरेव च
verses.transliteration: na me viduḥ paraṃ tattvaṃ devādyā na maharṣayaḥ / eko 'yaṃ veda viśvātmā bhavānī viṣṇureva ca
verses.translation: Imprecating him thus, Mahadeva went to the moun¬ tain Kailasa. Daksa too, the son of the self-bom deity (Brahma) became Pracetasa (son of the Pracetasas) in due course.
verses.hindi: दृष्टा देवं समायान्तं ब्रह्माणं विश्वतोमुखम्। ननाम शिरसा तस्य पादयोर्नाम कीर्तयन् ५१ ॥ नमो देवाधिदेवाय ब्रह्मणे परमात्मने। हिरण्यमूर्तये तुभ्यं सहस्त्राक्षाय वेधसे पुरुषाय पुराणाय योगिनां गुरवे नमः
verses.wordMeaning: Imprecating him thus, Mahadeva went to the moun¬ tain Kailasa. Daksa too, the son of the self-bom deity (Brahma) became Pracetasa (son of the Pracetasas) in due course.
verses.commentary: Sense: Imprecating him thus, Mahadeva went to the moun¬ tain Kailasa. Daksa too, the son of the self-bom deity (Brahma) became Pracetasa (son of the Pracetasas) in due course.

verses.sanskrit: अहं हि निष्क्रियः शान्तः केवलो निष्परिग्रहः । मामेव केशवं देवमाहुर्देवीमथाम्बिकाम्
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ hi niṣkriyaḥ śāntaḥ kevalo niṣparigrahaḥ / māmeva keśavaṃ devamāhurdevīmathāmbikām
verses.translation: Thus all details of creation of Svayambhuva Manu, upto Daksa have been narrated to you. This story dispels the sins of those who hear this."
verses.hindi: ततः प्रसन्नो भगवान् विरिञ्चो विश्वभावनः । जपेयं देवदेवेश गायत्रीं वेदमातरम्। भूयो वर्षशतं साग्रं तावदायुर्भवेन्मम
verses.wordMeaning: Thus all details of creation of Svayambhuva Manu, upto Daksa have been narrated to you. This story dispels the sins of those who hear this."
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus all details of creation of Svayambhuva Manu, upto Daksa have been narrated to you. This story dispels the sins of those who hear this."

verses.sanskrit: एष धाता विधाता च कारणं कार्यमेव च । कर्ता कारयिता विष्णुर्भुक्तिमुक्तिफलप्रदः
verses.transliteration: eṣa dhātā vidhātā ca kāraṇaṃ kāryameva ca / kartā kārayitā viṣṇurbhuktimuktiphalapradaḥ
verses.translation: This protest against non-inclusion of god Siva'in the invitees of the sacrifice by sage Dadhica is not in the Bh. P. or NP. (both Vaisnava Puranas) but is found in the Vdyu 1.30.103-106 (but Dadhica's curse to all sages is not intheVayu), in SK. P. MaheSvara Kkapda 1.2.14-32 (but no curse by Dadhica but a simple walk-out), in SP. Rudra Samhitd 27.26-50 too, Dadhica protests and walks away. Dadhica's curse to all the sacrificial priests appears to be KP's contribution. KP, however, shares some verses with the Vayu e.g.
verses.hindi: बाढमित्याह विश्वात्मा समालोक्य नराधिपम् स्पृष्टा कराभ्यां सुप्रीतस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत ऐसा सुनकर अत्यन्त प्रसन्न मनवाले उस वसुमना राजर्षिने उन द्विजश्रेष्ठोंको प्रणाम किया और पूजनकर
verses.wordMeaning: This protest against non-inclusion of god Siva'in the invitees of the sacrifice by sage Dadhica is not in the Bh. P. or NP. (both Vaisnava Puranas) but is found in the Vdyu 1.30.103-106 (but Dadhica's curse to all sages is not intheVayu), in SK. P.…
verses.commentary: Sense: This protest against non-inclusion of god Siva'in the invitees of the sacrifice by sage Dadhica is not in the Bh. P. or NP. (both Vaisnava Puranas) but is found in the Vdyu 1.30.103-106 (but Dadhica's curse to all sages is not intheVayu), in SK. P.…

verses.sanskrit: भोक्ता पुमानप्रमेयः संहर्ता कालरूपधृक् । स्त्रष्टा पाता वासुदेवो विश्वात्मा विश्वतोमुखः
verses.transliteration: bhoktā pumānaprameyaḥ saṃhartā kālarūpadhṛk / straṣṭā pātā vāsudevo viśvātmā viśvatomukhaḥ
verses.translation: In the Bh. P. and other Puranas, Siva, as a revenge of the self- immolation of his consort Sati, destroyed the sacrifice of Daksa. In KP., however, the goddess (the daughter of Himavan) remembers her i-.sult in the previous birth by Daksa, when in his previous birth, he was her father, and in order to wreak revenge of her insult in that birth by her then father, she urges god Siva to destroy his sacrifice in this new incarnation!
verses.hindi: त्रिधन्वासे (इस प्रकार) कहा--तपद्वारा मैं सूर्यमण्डलके मध्यमें स्थित, प्राणरूप अद्वितीय अक्षर नामक ब्रह्म पुरुषकी आराधना करूँगा। तुम धर्ममें निरत होकर चातुर्वर्ण्यसे समन्वित इस सम्पूर्ण पृथ्वीमण्डलका आलस्यरहित होकर पालन करो॥ ४४--४६॥
verses.wordMeaning: In the Bh. P. and other Puranas, Siva, as a revenge of the self- immolation of his consort Sati, destroyed the sacrifice of Daksa. In KP., however, the goddess (the daughter of Himavan) remembers her i-.sult in the previous birth by Daksa, when in his previous birth,…
verses.commentary: Sense: In the Bh. P. and other Puranas, Siva, as a revenge of the self- immolation of his consort Sati, destroyed the sacrifice of Daksa. In KP., however, the goddess (the daughter of Himavan) remembers her i-.sult in the previous birth by Daksa, when in his previous birth,…

verses.sanskrit: कृटस्थो ह्यक्षरो व्यापी योगी नारायणः स्वयम् । तारकः पुरुषो ह्यात्मा केवलं परमं पदम्
verses.transliteration: kṛṭastho hyakṣaro vyāpī yogī nārāyaṇaḥ svayam / tārakaḥ puruṣo hyātmā kevalaṃ paramaṃ padam
verses.translation: I shall recount the creation of the subjects in con¬ tinuity with the previous kalpa as mentioned by Narayana. The story dispels sins and it will be sustained in all the three units of Time (i.e. the past, present and future).
verses.hindi: ऐसा कहकर वह अनघ राजा वसुमना अपने पुत्र (त्रिधन्वा)-को राज्य सौंपकर सर्वोत्तम तपस्या करनेके लिये वनमें चला गया। ये वसुमना राजा हिमालयके शिखरपर स्थित रमणीय शुभ देवदारु वनमें रहते हुए कन्दमूल एवं फलोंका आहार करते हुए मुनियोंके अन्न (नीवार आदि)-से देवताओंकी प्रसन्नताके लिये यज्ञ (आराधना) करने लगे। तपस्याद्वारा नष्ट हुए पापोंवाले उन्होंने सौ वर्षोसे भी अधिक समयतक वेदमाता देवी
verses.wordMeaning: I shall recount the creation of the subjects in con¬ tinuity with the previous kalpa as mentioned by Narayana. The story dispels sins and it will be sustained in all the three units of Time (i.e. the past, present and future).
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall recount the creation of the subjects in con¬ tinuity with the previous kalpa as mentioned by Narayana. The story dispels sins and it will be sustained in all the three units of Time (i.e. the past, present and future).

verses.sanskrit: सैषा माहेश्वरी गौरी मम शक्तिर्निरञ्जना । सान्ता सत्या सदानन्दा परं पदमिति श्रुतिः
verses.transliteration: saiṣā māheśvarī gaurī mama śaktirnirañjanā / sāntā satyā sadānandā paraṃ padamiti śrutiḥ
verses.translation: On being cursed by Sambhu, Daksa, the Royal son of Pracetas, censured Bhava due to the previous enmity and performed a Tdjna (sacrifice) at Gangadvara (i.e. near the source of the river Ganga).
verses.hindi: सावित्रीका मानसिक जप किया। उनके इस प्रकार जप करते रहनेपर ही स्वयम्भू देव परमेश्वर हिरण्यगर्भ विश्वात्मा स्वयं उस स्थानपर गये । विश्वतोमुख ब्रह्मदेवको आते हुए देखकर उन्होंने अपना नाम बोलते हुए उनके चरणोंमें सिरसे प्रणाम किया और इस प्रकार कहा-- ॥ ४७--५१ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: On being cursed by Sambhu, Daksa, the Royal son of Pracetas, censured Bhava due to the previous enmity and performed a Tdjna (sacrifice) at Gangadvara (i.e. near the source of the river Ganga).
verses.commentary: Sense: On being cursed by Sambhu, Daksa, the Royal son of Pracetas, censured Bhava due to the previous enmity and performed a Tdjna (sacrifice) at Gangadvara (i.e. near the source of the river Ganga).

verses.sanskrit: अस्याः सर्वमिदं जातमत्रैव लयमेष्यति । एषैव सर्वभूतानां गतीनामुत्तमा गतिः
verses.transliteration: asyāḥ sarvamidaṃ jātamatraiva layameṣyati / eṣaiva sarvabhūtānāṃ gatīnāmuttamā gatiḥ
verses.translation: All Devas were invoked along with Visnu in order to receive their respective shares. All leading sages came there along with all other sages.
verses.hindi: देवाधिदेव परमात्मा ब्रह्मको नमस्कार है। सहस्त्र नेत्रोंवाले हिरण्यमूर्ति आप वेधाको नमस्कार है। धाता और विधाताको नमस्कार है, वेदात्ममूर्तिको नमस्कार है। सांख्य तथा योगद्वारा ज्ञात होनेवाले ज्ञान-मूर्तिको नमस्कार है। सभी अर्थोंके ज्ञाता, सृष्टिकर्ता, त्रिमूर्तिरूप आपको नमस्कार है। योगियोंके गुरु पुराणपुरुषको नमस्कार है
verses.wordMeaning: All Devas were invoked along with Visnu in order to receive their respective shares. All leading sages came there along with all other sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: All Devas were invoked along with Visnu in order to receive their respective shares. All leading sages came there along with all other sages.

verses.sanskrit: तयाहं संगतो देव्या केवलो निष्कलः परः । पश्याम्यशेषमेवेदं यस्तद् वेद स मुच्यते
verses.transliteration: tayāhaṃ saṃgato devyā kevalo niṣkalaḥ paraḥ / paśyāmyaśeṣamevedaṃ yastad veda sa mucyate
verses.translation: On seeing the entire host of Devas arrived, except¬ ing Sankara, the Brahmana sage named Dadhica spoke thus to Pracetasa (Daksa).
verses.hindi: तब प्रसन्न होकर विश्वभावन भगवान् ब्रह्माने कहा-- “वर मांगो, तुम्हारा कल्याण हो, मैं तुम्हें वर दूँगा ' राजाने कहा--देवदेवेश! मैं पुनः सौ वर्षसे अधिक समयतक इस वेदमाता गायत्रीका जप कर सकूँ, इसके लिये उतनी ही मेरी आयु हो। राजाको देखकर विश्वात्माने ' बहुत अच्छा' ऐसा कहा और प्रसन्न
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing the entire host of Devas arrived, except¬ ing Sankara, the Brahmana sage named Dadhica spoke thus to Pracetasa (Daksa).
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the entire host of Devas arrived, except¬ ing Sankara, the Brahmana sage named Dadhica spoke thus to Pracetasa (Daksa).

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादनादिमद्वैतं विष्णुमात्मानमीश्वरम् । एकमेव विजानीध्वं ततो यास्यथ निर्वृतिम्
verses.transliteration: tasmādanādimadvaitaṃ viṣṇumātmānamīśvaram / ekameva vijānīdhvaṃ tato yāsyatha nirvṛtim
verses.translation: "How is it that Rudra is not being worshipped now duly—Rudra, the lord, whose behests every one beginning with Brahma and ending with the Pisacas (Ghosts), carries out?"
verses.hindi: होकर हाथोंसे (राजाका) स्पर्शकर वे वहीं अन्तर्धान हो गये तस्य पूर्णे वर्षशते भगवानुग्रदीधितिः । प्रादुरासीन्महायोगी भानोर्मण्डलमध्यतः
verses.wordMeaning: "How is it that Rudra is not being worshipped now duly—Rudra, the lord, whose behests every one beginning with Brahma and ending with the Pisacas (Ghosts), carries out?"
verses.commentary: Sense: "How is it that Rudra is not being worshipped now duly—Rudra, the lord, whose behests every one beginning with Brahma and ending with the Pisacas (Ghosts), carries out?"

verses.sanskrit: मन्यन्ते विष्णुमव्यक्तमात्मानं श्रद्धयान्विताः । ये भिन्नदृष्ट्यापीशानं पूजयन्तो न मे प्रियाः
verses.transliteration: manyante viṣṇumavyaktamātmānaṃ śraddhayānvitāḥ / ye bhinnadṛṣṭyāpīśānaṃ pūjayanto na me priyāḥ
verses.translation: "In all Tajhas the share to Sankara is not allotted. Sankara is not being worshipped because there are no Mantras of Sankara along with his wife."
verses.hindi: स्वयम्भुबमनाद्यन्तं ब्रह्माणं विस्मयं गतः त्रयीमयाय रूद्राय कालरूपाय हेतवे
verses.wordMeaning: "In all Tajhas the share to Sankara is not allotted. Sankara is not being worshipped because there are no Mantras of Sankara along with his wife."
verses.commentary: Sense: "In all Tajhas the share to Sankara is not allotted. Sankara is not being worshipped because there are no Mantras of Sankara along with his wife."

verses.sanskrit: द्विषन्ति ये जगत्सूतिं मोहिता रौरवादिषु । पच्यमाना न मुच्यन्ते कल्पकोटिशतैरपि
verses.transliteration: dviṣanti ye jagatsūtiṃ mohitā rauravādiṣu / pacyamānā na mucyante kalpakoṭiśatairapi
verses.translation: The infuriated great sage laughed at Daksa derisively and said these words even as all Devas were listening. The sage possessed all types of knowledge himself. He was as if an embodiment of knowledge).
verses.hindi: तदा प्राह महादेवो राजानं प्रीतमानसः । इमानि मे रहस्यानि नामानि शृणु चानघ जपस्वानन्यचेतस्को मय्यासक्तमना नृप
verses.wordMeaning: The infuriated great sage laughed at Daksa derisively and said these words even as all Devas were listening. The sage possessed all types of knowledge himself. He was as if an embodiment of knowledge).
verses.commentary: Sense: The infuriated great sage laughed at Daksa derisively and said these words even as all Devas were listening. The sage possessed all types of knowledge himself. He was as if an embodiment of knowledge).

verses.sanskrit: तसमादशेषभूतानां रक्षको विष्णुरव्ययः । यथावदिह विज्ञाय ध्येयः सर्वापदि प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: tasamādaśeṣabhūtānāṃ rakṣako viṣṇuravyayaḥ / yathāvadiha vijñāya dhyeyaḥ sarvāpadi prabhuḥ
verses.translation: "How is it that Sankara is not known well and hence not worshipped by means of all Tajnas? It is he who is known as Parameivara and it is from him, the soul of the universe that every thing begins to function, {v.l. He is the source of every thing).
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मचारी मिताहारो भस्मनिष्ठः समाहितः। जपेदामरणाद् रुद्रं स याति परमं पदम् इत्युक्त्वा भगवान् रुद्रो भक्तानुग्रहकाम्यया। पुनः संवत्सरशतं राज्ञे ह्यायुरकल्पयत्
verses.wordMeaning: "How is it that Sankara is not known well and hence not worshipped by means of all Tajnas? It is he who is known as Parameivara and it is from him, the soul of the universe that every thing begins to function, {v.l. He is the source of every thing).
verses.commentary: Sense: "How is it that Sankara is not known well and hence not worshipped by means of all Tajnas? It is he who is known as Parameivara and it is from him, the soul of the universe that every thing begins to function, {v.l. He is the source of every thing).

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा भगवतो वाक्यं देव्यः सर्वगणेश्वराः । नेमुर्नारायणं देवं देवीं च हिमशैलजाम्
verses.transliteration: śrutvā bhagavato vākyaṃ devyaḥ sarvagaṇeśvarāḥ / nemurnārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ devīṃ ca himaśailajām
verses.translation: "Indeed he is not Sankara (benefactor), but is Rudra, the annihilator. He is only the Tamasa (possessor of Tamo-gam) Hara. He is known as a naked mendicant holding the human skull. It is not proper to call him the soul of the universe.
verses.hindi: राजापि तपसा रुद्रं जजापानन्यमानसः। भस्मच्छन्नस्त्रिषवणं स्नात्वा शान्तः समाहितः योगप्रवृत्तिरभवत् कालात् कालात्मकं परम्
verses.wordMeaning: "Indeed he is not Sankara (benefactor), but is Rudra, the annihilator. He is only the Tamasa (possessor of Tamo-gam) Hara. He is known as a naked mendicant holding the human skull. It is not proper to call him the soul of the universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Indeed he is not Sankara (benefactor), but is Rudra, the annihilator. He is only the Tamasa (possessor of Tamo-gam) Hara. He is known as a naked mendicant holding the human skull. It is not proper to call him the soul of the universe.

verses.sanskrit: प्रार्थयामासुरीशाने भक्तिं भक्तजनप्रिये । भवानीपादयुगले नारायणपदाम्बुजे
verses.transliteration: prārthayāmāsurīśāne bhaktiṃ bhaktajanapriye / bhavānīpādayugale nārāyaṇapadāmbuje
verses.translation: Indeed Isvara, the lord and creator of the universe is Lord Narayana, Hari. This glorions Lord of Sattvic nature is worshipped in all holy rites."
verses.hindi: वर-प्राप्त वह श्रीमान् (राजा) भी तीनों समयोंमें ख्रान करते हुए तथा कन्दमूल एवं फलोंका आहार करते हुए अत्यन्त प्रसन्न-मनसे शान्तिपूर्वक जप करने लगे। उनके (जप करते हुए) सौ वर्ष पूरा होनेपर सूर्यमण्डलके मध्यसे प्रज्वलित किरणोंवाले महायोगी भगवान् प्रकट हुए। मण्डलमें स्थित उन सनातन, स्वयम्भू, अनादिं, अनन्त तथा वेदज्ञ ब्रह्माको देखकर वे राजा आश्चर्यचकित हुए। उन्होंने वैदिक मन्त्रों तथा विशेषरूपसे गायत्री
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed Isvara, the lord and creator of the universe is Lord Narayana, Hari. This glorions Lord of Sattvic nature is worshipped in all holy rites."
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed Isvara, the lord and creator of the universe is Lord Narayana, Hari. This glorions Lord of Sattvic nature is worshipped in all holy rites."

verses.sanskrit: ततो नारायणं देवं गणेशा मातरो ऽपि च । न पश्यन्ति जगत्सूतिं तद्भुतमिवाभवत्
verses.transliteration: tato nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ gaṇeśā mātaro 'pi ca / na paśyanti jagatsūtiṃ tadbhutamivābhavat
verses.translation: "Is not this lord of a thousand rays (the sun-god) seen by you? He is the sole annihilator of worlds. He is Paramesvara in the form of Kala.
verses.hindi: (मन्त्र)-द्वारा उनकी स्तुति की। क्षणभरमें ही उन्होंने उन परमेश्वर पुरुषको चार मुखवाले, जटा तथा मुकुटधारी, आठ हाथ तथा तीन नेत्रवाले, चन्द्रकलाओंसे चिहित अर्धनारीश्वर शरीरवाले, अपनी किरणांद्वारा सम्पूर्ण जगत्को प्रकाशित करते हुए, रक्तवस्त्र धारण किये, रक्तवर्णवाले
verses.wordMeaning: "Is not this lord of a thousand rays (the sun-god) seen by you? He is the sole annihilator of worlds. He is Paramesvara in the form of Kala.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Is not this lord of a thousand rays (the sun-god) seen by you? He is the sole annihilator of worlds. He is Paramesvara in the form of Kala.

verses.sanskrit: तदन्तरे महादैत्यो ह्यन्धको मन्मथार्दितः । मोहितो गिरिजां देवीमाहर्तुं गिरिमाययौ
verses.transliteration: tadantare mahādaityo hyandhako manmathārditaḥ / mohito girijāṃ devīmāhartuṃ girimāyayau
verses.translation: It is him that the righteous scholars, the expounders of the Brahman, pray to. He is the witness of everything. He is the body of Sankara of intense brilliance and he is of the form of Kala.
verses.hindi: हरके रूपमें देखा उन्हें देखकर उन्हींके भावसे भावित होकर परम सद्भावसे राजाने सिरसे रुद्रको प्रणाम किया और सावित्री-मन्त्र तथा इस स्तोत्रसे स्तुति की। वेदत्रयीरूप, रुद्र, कालरूप, कारणस्वरूप भासमान परमेष्ठी नीलकण्ठको
verses.wordMeaning: It is him that the righteous scholars, the expounders of the Brahman, pray to. He is the witness of everything. He is the body of Sankara of intense brilliance and he is of the form of Kala.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is him that the righteous scholars, the expounders of the Brahman, pray to. He is the witness of everything. He is the body of Sankara of intense brilliance and he is of the form of Kala.

verses.sanskrit: अथानन्तवपुः श्रीमान् योगी नारायणो ऽमलः । तत्रैवाविरभूद् दैत्यैर्युद्धाय पुरुषोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: athānantavapuḥ śrīmān yogī nārāyaṇo 'malaḥ / tatraivāvirabhūd daityairyuddhāya puruṣottamaḥ
verses.translation: He is Rudra, the great god. He is the kind-hearted Hara, Kapalin {v. 1. of matted hair). He is the lord Aditya, the sun-god. He is the blue-necked and Vilohita (very ruddy).
verses.hindi: तब प्रसन्न मनवाले महादेवने राजासे कहा-हे निष्पाप! मेरे इन गोपनीय नामोंको सुनो। ये सभी वेदोंमें वर्णित हैं तथा संसार (सागर)-का नाश करनेवाले हैं। राजन्! पवित्र होकर इन नामोंसे मुझे निरन्तर नमस्कार करो। राजन्! यजुर्वेदसे साररूपमें उद्धत शतरुद्रीका अनन्यमन होकर मुझमें मन लगाकर जप करो। जो ब्रह्मचर्यं धारणकर, संयमित आहार ग्रहणकर, भस्मका लेपकर एकाग्रतापूर्वक मरणपर्यन्त रुद्रका जप करता है,
verses.wordMeaning: He is Rudra, the great god. He is the kind-hearted Hara, Kapalin {v. 1. of matted hair). He is the lord Aditya, the sun-god. He is the blue-necked and Vilohita (very ruddy).
verses.commentary: Sense: He is Rudra, the great god. He is the kind-hearted Hara, Kapalin {v. 1. of matted hair). He is the lord Aditya, the sun-god. He is the blue-necked and Vilohita (very ruddy).

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वाथ पार्श्वे भगवन्तमीशो युद्धाय विष्णुं गणदेवमुख्यैः । शिलादपुत्रेण च मातृकाभिः स कालरुद्रो ऽभिजगाम देवः
verses.transliteration: kṛtvātha pārśve bhagavantamīśo yuddhāya viṣṇuṃ gaṇadevamukhyaiḥ / śilādaputreṇa ca mātṛkābhiḥ sa kālarudro 'bhijagāma devaḥ
verses.translation: He is eulogised as one of a thousand rays by the singers of Saman hymns, the Hotrs and the Adhvaryus. See him. ols Rudramurti (one of the terrible form), of the creator of the universe and an embodiment of three Vedas."
verses.hindi: वह परम पद प्राप्त करता है। ऐसा कहकर भक्तपर अनुग्रह करनेकी इच्छासे भगवान् रुद्रने राजाको आयु पुनः सौ वर्षोतक कर दी॥ ६६--७० ॥ राजा वसुमनाको परम ज्ञान और वैराग्य प्रदानकर परमेश्वर रुद्र क्षणभरमें ही अन्तर्धान हो गये। यह एक आश्चर्य ही हुआ। राजाने भी तीनों कालोंमें स्रानकर, भस्म धारणकर, शान्त और एकाग्रतापूर्वक
verses.wordMeaning: He is eulogised as one of a thousand rays by the singers of Saman hymns, the Hotrs and the Adhvaryus. See him. ols Rudramurti (one of the terrible form), of the creator of the universe and an embodiment of three Vedas."
verses.commentary: Sense: He is eulogised as one of a thousand rays by the singers of Saman hymns, the Hotrs and the Adhvaryus. See him. ols Rudramurti (one of the terrible form), of the creator of the universe and an embodiment of three Vedas."

verses.sanskrit: त्रिशूलमादाय कृशानुकल्पं स देवदेवः प्रययौ पुरस्तात् । तमन्वयुस्ते गणराजवर्या जगाम देवो ऽपि सहस्त्रबाहुः
verses.transliteration: triśūlamādāya kṛśānukalpaṃ sa devadevaḥ prayayau purastāt / tamanvayuste gaṇarājavaryā jagāma devo 'pi sahastrabāhuḥ
verses.translation: "The twelve Adityas have come here as the sharers in the Tajha. All of them should be known as suns. There is no other Sun."
verses.hindi: अनन्य-मनसे तपस्याद्वारा रुद्रका जप किया। जप करते हुए उन राजाके पुनः सौ वर्ष पूरे हो जानेपर उसमें योगकी प्रवृत्ति हुई और यथासमय उन्होंने श्रेष्ठ कालात्मक परमेष्ठीके उस वेदसार नामक स्थानको प्राप्त
verses.wordMeaning: "The twelve Adityas have come here as the sharers in the Tajha. All of them should be known as suns. There is no other Sun."
verses.commentary: Sense: "The twelve Adityas have come here as the sharers in the Tajha. All of them should be known as suns. There is no other Sun."

verses.sanskrit: रराज मध्ये भगवान् सुराणां विवाहनो वारिदवर्णवर्णः । तदा सुमेरोः शिखराधिरूढ- स्त्रिलोकदृष्टिर्भगवानिवार्कः
verses.transliteration: rarāja madhye bhagavān surāṇāṃ vivāhano vāridavarṇavarṇaḥ / tadā sumeroḥ śikharādhirūḍha- strilokadṛṣṭirbhagavānivārkaḥ
verses.translation: When he said thus, the sages who had come to assist him as well as to witness the rajna said to Daksa, "That is exactly so."
verses.hindi: भानोः स मण्डलं शुभ्रं ततो यातो महेश्वरम्॥ ७४॥  किया जो सूर्यका शुभ्र मण्डल है। तदनन्तर वे महेश्वरको सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो ब्रह्मलोके महीयते
verses.wordMeaning: When he said thus, the sages who had come to assist him as well as to witness the rajna said to Daksa, "That is exactly so."
verses.commentary: Sense: When he said thus, the sages who had come to assist him as well as to witness the rajna said to Daksa, "That is exactly so."

verses.sanskrit: जगत्यनादिर्भगवानमेयो हरः सहस्त्राकृतिराविरासीत् । त्रिशूलपाणिर्गगने सुघोषः पपात देवोपरि पुष्पवृष्टिः
verses.transliteration: jagatyanādirbhagavānameyo haraḥ sahastrākṛtirāvirāsīt / triśūlapāṇirgagane sughoṣaḥ papāta devopari puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ
verses.translation: Vasava (Indra) and all other Devas came there for their shares. They did not see Lord Isana (Siva) except Nara- yana, Hari.
verses.hindi: प्राप्त हुए ॥ ७१--७४॥ राजाके इस उत्तम चरितको जो पढ़ता है अथवा सुनता है, वह सभी पापोंसे मुक्त होकर ब्रह्मलोकमें प्रतिष्ठा प्राप्त करता है
verses.wordMeaning: Vasava (Indra) and all other Devas came there for their shares. They did not see Lord Isana (Siva) except Nara- yana, Hari.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vasava (Indra) and all other Devas came there for their shares. They did not see Lord Isana (Siva) except Nara- yana, Hari.

verses.sanskrit: समागतं वीक्ष्य गणेशराजं समावृतं देवरिपुर्गणेशैः । युयोध शक्रेण समातृकाभि- र् गणैरशेषैरमपप्रधानैः
verses.transliteration: samāgataṃ vīkṣya gaṇeśarājaṃ samāvṛtaṃ devaripurgaṇeśaiḥ / yuyodha śakreṇa samātṛkābhi- r gaṇairaśeṣairamapapradhānaiḥ
verses.translation: Even as all of them were watching. Lord Hiranya- garbha (born out of a golden egg) Brahma, the most excellent among the knowers of Brahman vanished, in a moment.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे बद्साहस्रथां संहितायां पूर्वाविभागे एकोनविंशोऽध्यायः इक्ष्वाकु-वंश-वर्णनके प्रसंगमें श्रीराम-कथाका प्रतिपादन, श्रीरामद्वारा सेतु-बन्धन और रामेश्वर-लिंगकी स्थापना, शंकर-पार्वतीका प्रकट होकर रामेश्वर- लिंगके माहात्म्यको बतलाना, श्रीरामको लव-कुश-पुत्रोंकी प्राप्ति तथा इक्ष्चाकु-वंशके अन्तिम राजाओंका वंश-वर्णन
verses.wordMeaning: Even as all of them were watching. Lord Hiranya- garbha (born out of a golden egg) Brahma, the most excellent among the knowers of Brahman vanished, in a moment.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even as all of them were watching. Lord Hiranya- garbha (born out of a golden egg) Brahma, the most excellent among the knowers of Brahman vanished, in a moment.

verses.sanskrit: विजित्य सर्वानपि बाहुवीर्यात् स संयुगे शंभुमनन्तधाम । समाययौ यत्र स कालरुद्रो विमानमारुह्य विहीनसत्त्वः
verses.transliteration: vijitya sarvānapi bāhuvīryāt sa saṃyuge śaṃbhumanantadhāma / samāyayau yatra sa kālarudro vimānamāruhya vihīnasattvaḥ
verses.translation: When lord Brahma vanished, Daksa personally sought refuge in Narayana, Hari, the saviour of the worlds.
verses.hindi: त्रिधन्वा राजपुत्रस्तु धर्मेणापालयन्महीम्! विजयश्च सुदेवश्च धुन्धुपुत्रौ बभूवतुः । विजयस्याभवत् पुत्रः कारुको नाम वीर्यवान्
verses.wordMeaning: When lord Brahma vanished, Daksa personally sought refuge in Narayana, Hari, the saviour of the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: When lord Brahma vanished, Daksa personally sought refuge in Narayana, Hari, the saviour of the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वान्धकं समयान्तं भगवान् गरुडध्वजः । व्याजहार महादेवं भैरवं भूतिभूषणम्
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvāndhakaṃ samayāntaṃ bhagavān garuḍadhvajaḥ / vyājahāra mahādevaṃ bhairavaṃ bhūtibhūṣaṇam
verses.translation: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.hindi: कारुकस्य वृकः पुत्रस्तस्माद् बाहुरजायत। सगरस्तस्य पुत्रोऽभूद् राजा परमधार्मिकः प्रसादाद् देवदेवस्य महादेवस्य धीमतः
verses.wordMeaning: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).

verses.sanskrit: हन्तुमर्हसि दैत्येशमन्धकं लोककण्टकम् । त्वामृते भगवान् शक्तो हन्ता नान्यो ऽस्य विद्यते
verses.transliteration: hantumarhasi daityeśamandhakaṃ lokakaṇṭakam / tvāmṛte bhagavān śakto hantā nānyo 'sya vidyate
verses.translation: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.hindi: भगीरथस्य तपसा देवः प्रीतमना हरः। बभार शिरसा गङ्गां सोमान्ते सोमभूषणः सूतजी बोले राजपुत्र त्रिधन्वाने पृथ्वीका धर्मपूर्वक पालन किया। उसका एक विद्वान् पुत्र हुआ जो त्रय्यारुण नामसे प्रसिद्ध हुआ। उसको (त्रय्यारुणको) सत्यव्रत नामका महान् बलवान् पुत्र हुआ। सत्यधना नामक
verses.wordMeaning: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).

verses.sanskrit: त्वं हर्ता सर्वलोकानां कालात्मा ह्यैश्वरी तनुः । स्तूयते विविधैर्मन्त्रर्वेदविद्भिर्विचक्षणैः
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ hartā sarvalokānāṃ kālātmā hyaiśvarī tanuḥ / stūyate vividhairmantrarvedavidbhirvicakṣaṇaiḥ
verses.translation: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.hindi: उसको पत्नीने हरिश्चन्द्रको जन्म दिया। हरिश्चन्द्रको रोहित नामवाला पराक्रमी पुत्र हुआ। रोहितका हरित और उसका पुत्र धुन्धु हुआ। धुन्धुके विजय और सुदेव-ये दो पुत्र हुए। विजयका कारुक नामका वीर पुत्र हुआ। कारुकका पुत्र वृक और उससे बाहु (नामक पुत्र) उत्पन्न हुआ। उस बाहुका पुत्र सगर हुआ जो परम धार्मिक था। सगरकी दो पलियाँ थीं-- प्रभा और भानुमती । और्वाग्निने उन दोनोंसे पूजित होकर
verses.wordMeaning: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).

verses.sanskrit: स वासुदेवस्य वचो निशम्य भगवान् हरः । निरीक्ष्य विष्णुं हनने दैत्यन्द्रस्य मतिं दधौ
verses.transliteration: sa vāsudevasya vaco niśamya bhagavān haraḥ / nirīkṣya viṣṇuṃ hanane daityandrasya matiṃ dadhau
verses.translation: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.hindi: (वरके फलस्वरूप) भानुमतीने असमञ्जस नामक पुत्रको ग्रहण किया और कल्याणी प्रभाने साठ हजार पुत्रोंको प्रात किया। असमञ्जसके पुत्र अंशुमान् नामक राजा थे, उनके पुत्र दिलीप तथा दिलीपसे भगीरथ हुए, जिन्होंने तपस्या करके देवाधिदेव धीमान् महादेवकी कृपासे भागीरथी गङ्गाको (पृथ्वीपर) अवतारित किया
verses.wordMeaning: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).

verses.sanskrit: जगाम देवतानीकं गणानां हर्षमुत्तमम् । स्तुवन्ति भैरवं देवमन्तरिक्षचरा जनाः
verses.transliteration: jagāma devatānīkaṃ gaṇānāṃ harṣamuttamam / stuvanti bhairavaṃ devamantarikṣacarā janāḥ
verses.translation: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.hindi: भगीरथको तपस्यासे प्रसन्न हुए मनवाले चन्द्रभूषण देव हरने अपने सिरपर स्थित चन्द्रमाके अग्रभागमें गङ्गाको धारण किया वसिष्ठस्तु महातेजाः क्षेत्रे कल्माषपादके । अश्मकं जनयामास तमिक्ष्वाकुकुलध्वजम्
verses.wordMeaning: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).

verses.sanskrit: जयानन्त महादेव कालमूर्ते सनातन । त्वमग्निः सर्वभूतानामन्तश्चरसि नित्यशः
verses.transliteration: jayānanta mahādeva kālamūrte sanātana / tvamagniḥ sarvabhūtānāmantaścarasi nityaśaḥ
verses.translation: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.hindi: स हि रामभयाद राजा वनं प्राप सुदु:खितः रघोरजः समुत्पन्नो राजा दशरथस्ततः । रामो दाशरथिवीरो धर्मज्ञो लोकविश्रुतः १७॥
verses.wordMeaning: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).

verses.sanskrit: त्वं यत्रज्ञस्त्वं वषट्कारस्त्वं धाता हरिरव्ययः । त्वं ब्रह्मा त्वं महादेवस्त्वं धाम परमं पदम्
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ yatrajñastvaṃ vaṣaṭkārastvaṃ dhātā hariravyayaḥ / tvaṃ brahmā tvaṃ mahādevastvaṃ dhāma paramaṃ padam
verses.translation: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.hindi: सर्वे शक्रसमा युद्धे विष्णुशक्तिसमन्विताः। जज्ञे रावणनाशार्थ विष्णुरंशेन विश्वकृत् सीता त्रिलोकविख्याता शीलौदार्यगुणान्विता
verses.wordMeaning: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).

verses.sanskrit: ओङ्कारमूर्तिर्योगात्मा त्रयीनेत्रस्त्रिलोचनः । महाविभूतिर्देवेशो जयाशेषजगत्पते
verses.transliteration: oṅkāramūrtiryogātmā trayīnetrastrilocanaḥ / mahāvibhūtirdeveśo jayāśeṣajagatpate
verses.translation: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.hindi: तपसा तोषिता देवी जनकेन गिरीन्द्रजा। प्रायच्छज्ानकीं सीतां राममेवाश्रिता पतिम् प्रीतश्च भगवानीशस्त्रिशूली नीललोहितः । प्रददौ शत्रुनाशार्थ जनकायादभुतं धनुः
verses.wordMeaning: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).

verses.sanskrit: ततः कालाग्निरुद्रो ऽसौ गृहीत्वान्धकमीश्वरः । त्रिशूलाग्रेषु विन्यस्य प्रननर्त सतां गतिः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kālāgnirudro 'sau gṛhītvāndhakamīśvaraḥ / triśūlāgreṣu vinyasya prananarta satāṃ gatiḥ
verses.translation: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.hindi: स राजा जनको विद्वान् दातुकामः सुतामिमाम्। अधोषयदमित्रघ्नो लोकेऽस्मिन् द्विजपुंगवाः भगीरथका भी श्रुत नामक पुत्र हुआ और उसका पुत्र हुआ नाभाग। उससे सिन्धुद्वीप हुआ। उस सिन्धुद्वीपका पुत्र अयुतायु और उसका पुत्र ऋतुपर्ण हुआ । ऋतुपर्णका सुदास नामका धार्मिक पुत्र हुआ। उसका पुत्र सौदास
verses.wordMeaning: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वान्धकं देवगणाः शूलप्रोतं पितामहः । प्रणेमुरीश्वरं देवं भैरवं भवमोचकम्
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvāndhakaṃ devagaṇāḥ śūlaprotaṃ pitāmahaḥ / praṇemurīśvaraṃ devaṃ bhairavaṃ bhavamocakam
verses.translation: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.hindi: हुआ जो कल्माषपाद नामसे विख्यात हुआ कल्माषपादके क्षेत्रमें महातेजस्वी बसिष्ठने इक्ष्वाकु- वंशके पताकारूप अश्मक नामक पुत्रको उत्पन्न कराया। अश्मकको उत्कला नामक पत्नीसे नकुल नामक राजा उत्पन्न हुआ। वह राजा परशुरामके भयसे अत्यन्त
verses.wordMeaning: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).

verses.sanskrit: अस्तुवन् मुनयः सिद्धा जगुर्गन्धर्विकिंनराः । अन्तरिक्षे ऽप्सरः सङ्घा नृत्यन्तिस्म मनोरमाः
verses.transliteration: astuvan munayaḥ siddhā jagurgandharvikiṃnarāḥ / antarikṣe 'psaraḥ saṅghā nṛtyantisma manoramāḥ
verses.translation: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.hindi: दुःखित होकर वन चला गया। उसने 'नारी-कवच' धारण कर रखा था। उस (नकुल)-से शतरथ हुआ और उससे श्रीमान् बिलिबिलि उत्पन्न हुआ। उसका पुत्र वृद्धशर्मा था। उस वृद्धशर्मासे विश्वसह और उसका पुत्र खट्वाङ्ग नामसे विख्यात हुआ। उसका पुत्र दीर्घबाहु और उससे रघु उत्पन्न हुआ॥ १३--१६॥
verses.wordMeaning: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).

verses.sanskrit: संस्थापितो ऽथशूलाग्रे सो ऽन्धको दग्धकिल्बिषः । उत्पन्नाखिलविज्ञानस्तुष्टाव परमेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: saṃsthāpito 'thaśūlāgre so 'ndhako dagdhakilbiṣaḥ / utpannākhilavijñānastuṣṭāva parameśvaram
verses.translation: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.hindi: रघुका अज उत्पन्न हुआ और उससे राजा दशरथ हुए। दशरथके पुत्र राम वीर, धर्मज्ञ और लोकमें प्रसिद्ध हुए। दशरथके ही पुत्र भरत, लक्ष्मण तथा शत्रुघ्न भी थे। ये सभी महान् बलशाली, युद्धमें इन्द्रके समान और विष्णुकी शक्तिसे सम्पन्न थे। राबणका विनाश करनेके लिये विश्वकर्ता विष्णु ही इन लोगोंके रूपमें अंशरूपसे प्रकट हुए थे
verses.wordMeaning: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).

verses.sanskrit: अन्धक उवाच नमामि मूर्ध्ना भगवन्तमेकं समाहिता यं विदुरीशतत्त्वम् । पुरातनं पुण्यमनन्तरूपं कालं कविं योगवियोगहेतुम्
verses.transliteration: andhaka uvāca namāmi mūrdhnā bhagavantamekaṃ samāhitā yaṃ vidurīśatattvam / purātanaṃ puṇyamanantarūpaṃ kālaṃ kaviṃ yogaviyogahetum
verses.translation: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.hindi: रामको सौभाग्यशालिनी कल्याणी पत्नी जनककी पुत्री सीता थीं। वे शील एवं उदारता आदि गुणोंसे सम्पन्न और तीनों लोकोंमें विख्यात थीं। जनकके द्वारा तपस्यासे संतुष्ट की गयी गिरिराजपुत्री पार्वतीने उन्हे जानकी सीताको प्रदान किया। सीताने रामको ही पति बनाया
verses.wordMeaning: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).

verses.sanskrit: दंष्ट्राकरालं दिवि नृत्यमानं हुताशवक्त्रं ज्वलनार्करूपम् । सहस्त्रपादाक्षिशिरोभियुक्तं भवन्तमेकं प्रणमामि रुद्रम्
verses.transliteration: daṃṣṭrākarālaṃ divi nṛtyamānaṃ hutāśavaktraṃ jvalanārkarūpam / sahastrapādākṣiśirobhiyuktaṃ bhavantamekaṃ praṇamāmi rudram
verses.translation: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.hindi: त्रिशूल धारण करनेवाले, नीललोहित भगवान् ईश (शंकर)-ने प्रसन्न होकर शत्रुओंके विनाशके लिये जनकको अद्भुत धनुष प्रदान किया था। श्रेष्ठ द्विजो! उस विद्वान् शत्रुनाशक राजा जनकने इस कन्याका दान करनेकी इच्छासे संसारमें यह घोषणा करवायी कि देवता या दानव जो कोई भी इस धनुषको उठानेमें समर्थ होगा, वह सीताको प्राप्त कर सकता है
verses.wordMeaning: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).

verses.sanskrit: जयादिदेवामरपूजिताङ्घ्रे विभागहीनामलतत्त्वरूप । त्वमग्निरेको बहुधाभिपूज्यसे वाय्वादिभेदैरखिलात्मरूप
verses.transliteration: jayādidevāmarapūjitāṅghre vibhāgahīnāmalatattvarūpa / tvamagnireko bahudhābhipūjyase vāyvādibhedairakhilātmarūpa
verses.translation: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.hindi: » परशुरामद्वारा पृथ्वीके क्षत्रियशून्य किये जानेके समय स्त्रियोंक मध्य रहकर नकुलने अपनी रक्षा की थी, इसलिये उसे ' नारी- कवच ' कहा जाता है।
verses.wordMeaning: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).

verses.sanskrit: त्वामेकमाहुः पुरुषं पुराणम् आदित्यवर्णं तमसः परस्तात् । त्वं पश्यसीदं परिपास्यजस्त्रं त्वमन्तको योगिगणाभिजुष्टः
verses.transliteration: tvāmekamāhuḥ puruṣaṃ purāṇam ādityavarṇaṃ tamasaḥ parastāt / tvaṃ paśyasīdaṃ paripāsyajastraṃ tvamantako yogigaṇābhijuṣṭaḥ
verses.translation: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.hindi: उद्वाह च तां कन्यां पार्वतीमिव शंकरः। रामः परमधर्मात्मा सेनामिव च षण्मुखः ततो बहुतिथे काले राजा दशरथः स्वयम्। रामं ज्येष्ठं सुतं वीरं राजानं कर्तुमारभत्
verses.wordMeaning: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).

verses.sanskrit: एको ऽन्तरात्मा बहुधा निविष्टो देहेषु देहादिविशेषहीनः । त्वमात्मशब्दं परमात्मतत्त्वं भवन्तमाहुः शिवमेव केचित्
verses.transliteration: eko 'ntarātmā bahudhā niviṣṭo deheṣu dehādiviśeṣahīnaḥ / tvamātmaśabdaṃ paramātmatattvaṃ bhavantamāhuḥ śivameva kecit
verses.translation: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.hindi: तस्याथ पत्नी सुभगा कैकेयी चारु भाषिणी । निवारयामास पतिं प्राह सम्श्रान्तमानसा मत्सुतं भरतं वीरं राजानं कर्तुमर्हसि। पूर्वमेव वरो यस्माद् दत्तो मे भवता यतः
verses.wordMeaning: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).

verses.sanskrit: त्वमक्षरं ब्रह्म परं पवित्र- मानन्दरूपं प्रणवाभिधानम् । त्वमीश्वरो वेदपदेषु सिद्धः स्वयं प्रभो ऽशेषविशेषहीनः
verses.transliteration: tvamakṣaraṃ brahma paraṃ pavitra- mānandarūpaṃ praṇavābhidhānam / tvamīśvaro vedapadeṣu siddhaḥ svayaṃ prabho 'śeṣaviśeṣahīnaḥ
verses.translation: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.hindi: स तस्या वचनं श्रुत्वा राजा दुःखितमानसः । बाढमित्यब्रवीद् वाक्यं तथा रामोऽपि धर्मवित् दुःखशोकाभिसंतप्तौ बभूवतुररिंदमौ
verses.wordMeaning: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).

verses.sanskrit: त्वमिन्द्ररूपो वरुणाग्निरूपो हंसः प्राणो मृत्युरन्तासि यज्ञः । प्रजापतिर्भगवानेकरुद्रो नीलग्रीवः स्तूयसे वेदविद्भिः
verses.transliteration: tvamindrarūpo varuṇāgnirūpo haṃsaḥ prāṇo mṛtyurantāsi yajñaḥ / prajāpatirbhagavānekarudro nīlagrīvaḥ stūyase vedavidbhiḥ
verses.translation: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.hindi: वानराणामभूत् सख्यं रामस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः जगाम रावणपुरीं लङ्कां सागरसंस्थिताम्
verses.wordMeaning: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).

verses.sanskrit: नारायणस्त्वं जगतामथादिः पितामहस्त्वं प्रपितामहश्च । वेदान्तगुह्योपनिषत्सु गीतः सदाशिवस्त्वं परमेश्वरो ऽसि
verses.transliteration: nārāyaṇastvaṃ jagatāmathādiḥ pitāmahastvaṃ prapitāmahaśca / vedāntaguhyopaniṣatsu gītaḥ sadāśivastvaṃ parameśvaro 'si
verses.translation: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.hindi: ऐसा जानकर बलवान् प्रभु रामने जनकके घर जाकर उस धनुषको उठाकर खेल-खेलमें ही तोड़ डाला। तदनन्तर परम धर्मात्मा रामने उस कन्याका उसी प्रकार पाणिग्रहण किया, जैसे शंकरने पार्वतीका और कार्तिकेयने सेना (देवसेना)-का पाणिग्रहण किया
verses.wordMeaning: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).

verses.sanskrit: नमः परस्तात् तमसः परस्मै परात्मने पञ्चपदान्तराय । त्रिशक्त्यतीताय निरञ्जनाय सहस्त्रशक्त्यासनसंस्थिताय
verses.transliteration: namaḥ parastāt tamasaḥ parasmai parātmane pañcapadāntarāya / triśaktyatītāya nirañjanāya sahastraśaktyāsanasaṃsthitāya
verses.translation: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर बहुत दिन बीत जानेपर राजा दशरथने स्वयं अपने बड़े पुत्र वीर रामको युवराज बनानेका कार्य आरम्भ किया। तब उनकी सौभाग्यशालिनी मधुरभाषिणी कैकेयी नामक पत्नीने भ्रान्तमन होकर पतिको (रामके राज्याभिषेकसे) रोका और कहा कि मेरे वीर पुत्र भरतको राजा बनायें, क्योंकि आपने पहले मुझे वर दे रखा है
verses.wordMeaning: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).

verses.sanskrit: त्रिमूर्तये ऽनन्दपदात्ममूर्ते जगन्निवासाय जगन्मयाय । नमो ललाटार्पितलोचनाय नमो जनानां हृदि संस्थिताय
verses.transliteration: trimūrtaye 'nandapadātmamūrte jagannivāsāya jaganmayāya / namo lalāṭārpitalocanāya namo janānāṃ hṛdi saṃsthitāya
verses.translation: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.hindi: उसका वचन सुनकर उस राजाने अत्यन्त दु:खित- मनसे कहा--' अच्छा, ऐसा ही हो'। तब धर्मको जाननेवाले आत्मवान् अच्युत राम भी पिताके चरणोंमें प्रणामकर (वनवासकी) प्रतिज्ञा कर लक्ष्मणके साथ सपत्नीक वनको चले गये। बुद्धिमान् तथा महाबलवान् प्रभु ( श्रीराम) भी चौदह वर्षतक लक्ष्मणके साथ वहाँ (वनमें) रहे। वनमें निवास करते समय कभी रावण नामका राक्षस संन्यासीका वेष धारणकर सीताका हरण कर लिया और
verses.wordMeaning: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).

verses.sanskrit: फणीन्द्रहाराय नमो ऽस्तु तुभ्यं मुनीन्द्रसिद्धार्चितपादयुग्म । ऐश्वर्यधर्मासनसंस्थिताय नमः परान्ताय भवोद्भवाय
verses.transliteration: phaṇīndrahārāya namo 'stu tubhyaṃ munīndrasiddhārcitapādayugma / aiśvaryadharmāsanasaṃsthitāya namaḥ parāntāya bhavodbhavāya
verses.translation: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.hindi: उन्हें अपनी पुरी (लंका)-में ले गया शत्रुनाशक राम और लक्ष्मण सीताको न देखकर दुःख एवं शोकसे अत्यन्त संतत हो गये और उनकी इन्द्रियाँ व्याकुल हो गयीं
verses.wordMeaning: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).

verses.sanskrit: सहस्त्रचन्द्रार्कविलोचनाय नमो ऽस्तु ते सोम सुमध्यमाय । नमो ऽस्तु ते देव हिरण्यबाहो नमो ऽम्बिकायाः पतये मृडाय
verses.transliteration: sahastracandrārkavilocanāya namo 'stu te soma sumadhyamāya / namo 'stu te deva hiraṇyabāho namo 'mbikāyāḥ pataye mṛḍāya
verses.translation: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.hindi: द्विजोत्तमो! यथासमय अक्लिष्टकर्मा रामकी कपि सुग्रीव तथा वानरोंसे मित्रता हो गयी। वायुपुत्र महातेजस्वी वीर हनुमान् नामक वानर सुग्रीवके अनुगामी और सदा रामके प्रिय थे। वे परम धैर्य धारणकर “उन सीताको लाउँगा' इस प्रकार रामसे प्रतिज्ञापूर्वक कहकर सीताको देखनेके लिये तत्पर हो गये तथा सागरपर्यन्त सारी पृथ्वीपर विचरण करने लगे। (इस प्रकार सीताको ढूँढ़ते-ढूँढ़ते) सागरमें बसी हुई रावणकी पुरी लंकामें
verses.wordMeaning: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).

verses.sanskrit: नमो ऽतिगुह्याय गुहान्तराय वेदान्तविज्ञानसुनिश्चिताय । त्रिकालहीनामलधामधाम्ने नमो महेशाय नमः शिवाय
verses.transliteration: namo 'tiguhyāya guhāntarāya vedāntavijñānasuniścitāya / trikālahīnāmaladhāmadhāmne namo maheśāya namaḥ śivāya
verses.translation: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.hindi: गये। वहाँ उन्होंने राक्षसियोंसे घिरी हुई पवित्र, अश्रुपूर्ण आँखोंवाली, अनिन्दित, रमणीय तथा पवित्र सीताको निर्जन देशमें एक वृक्षके नीचे स्थित देखा। वहाँ भगवती सीता नीलकमलके समान श्यामवर्णवाले राम तथा आत्मसंयमी लक्ष्मणका स्मरण कर रही थीं॥ ३४--३९ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).

verses.sanskrit: एवं स्तुवन्तं भगवान् शूलाग्रादवरोप्य तम् । तुष्टः प्रोवाच हस्ताभ्यां स्पृष्ट्वाथ परमेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ stuvantaṃ bhagavān śūlāgrādavaropya tam / tuṣṭaḥ provāca hastābhyāṃ spṛṣṭvātha parameśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.hindi: कृत्वाथ वानरशतैलंङ्कामार्ग महोदधेः। सेतुं परमधर्मात्मा रावणं हतवान् प्रभुः
verses.wordMeaning: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).

verses.sanskrit: प्रीतो ऽहं सर्वथा दैत्य स्तवेनानेन सांप्रतम् । संप्राप्य गाणपत्यं मे सन्निधाने वसामरः
verses.transliteration: prīto 'haṃ sarvathā daitya stavenānena sāṃpratam / saṃprāpya gāṇapatyaṃ me sannidhāne vasāmaraḥ
verses.translation: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.hindi: सेतुमध्ये महादेवमीशानं कृत्तिवाससम्। स्थापयामास लिङड्गस्थं पूजयामास राघवः तस्य देवो महादेवः पार्वत्या सह शंकरः। प्रत्यक्षमेव भगवान् दत्तवान् वरमुत्तमम्
verses.wordMeaning: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).

verses.sanskrit: अरोगश्छिन्नसंदेहो देवैरपि सुपूजितः । नन्दीश्वरस्यानुचरः सर्वदुः खविवर्जितः
verses.transliteration: arogaśchinnasaṃdeho devairapi supūjitaḥ / nandīśvarasyānucaraḥ sarvaduḥ khavivarjitaḥ
verses.translation: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.hindi: महापातकसंयुक्तास्तेषां पापं विनश्यतु अन्यानि चैव पापानि स्त्रातस्यात्र महोदधौ। दर्शनादेव लिङ्गस्य नाशं यान्ति न संशयः
verses.wordMeaning: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).

verses.sanskrit: एवं व्याहृतमात्रे तु देवदेवेन देवताः । गणेश्वरा महादेवमन्धकं देवसन्निधौ
verses.transliteration: evaṃ vyāhṛtamātre tu devadevena devatāḥ / gaṇeśvarā mahādevamandhakaṃ devasannidhau
verses.translation: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.hindi: यावत् सेतुश्च तावच्य स्थास्याम्यत्र तिरोहितः ५१ ॥ स्मरणादेव लिङ्गस्य दिनपापं प्रणश्यति
verses.wordMeaning: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).

verses.sanskrit: सहस्त्रसूर्यसंकाशं त्रिनेत्रं चन्द्रचिह्नितम् । नीलकण्ठं जटामौलिं शूलासक्तमहाकरम्
verses.transliteration: sahastrasūryasaṃkāśaṃ trinetraṃ candracihnitam / nīlakaṇṭhaṃ jaṭāmauliṃ śūlāsaktamahākaram
verses.translation: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.hindi: रामोऽपि पालयामास राज्यं धर्मपरायणः । अभिषिक्तो महातेजा भरतेन महाबलः एकान्तमें सीताको स्वयं अपना परिंचय देकर उनका संदेह मिटानेके लिये उन्होंने ( श्रीहनुमान्ने) रामको अंगूठी उन्हें प्रदान को
verses.wordMeaning: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा तं तुष्टुवुर्दैत्यमाश्चर्यं परमं गताः । उवाच भगवान् विष्णुर्देवदेवं स्मयन्निव
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā taṃ tuṣṭuvurdaityamāścaryaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ / uvāca bhagavān viṣṇurdevadevaṃ smayanniva
verses.translation: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.hindi: पतिकी परम सुन्दर अँगूठीको देखकर प्रतिके कारण विस्फारित नेत्रोंवाली सीताने रामको (ही) आया हुआ माना। तब सीताको देखकर उन्होंने आश्वासन दिया और कहा--'मैं आपको रामके पास ले चलूँगा।' ऐसा कहकर महाबाहु (हनुमान्) पुनः रामके पास चले आये। आत्मवान् (हनुमान्) रामसे सीता-दर्शनकी बात बताकर सामने खड़े हो गये। राम-लक्ष्मणने उनको साधुवादसे सत्कृत किया
verses.wordMeaning: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).

verses.sanskrit: स्थाने तव महादेव प्रभावः पुरुषो महान् । नेक्षते ऽज्ञानजान् दोषान् गृह्णाति च गुणानपि
verses.transliteration: sthāne tava mahādeva prabhāvaḥ puruṣo mahān / nekṣate 'jñānajān doṣān gṛhṇāti ca guṇānapi
verses.translation: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर बलवान् रामने हनुमान् तथा लक्ष्मणके साथ राक्षसोंसे स्वयं युद्ध करनेका निश्चय किया। और सैकड़ों वानरोंद्वारा महासमुद्रमें लंका जानेके लिये मार्गके रूपमें पुलका निर्माण किया गया तथा उसी पुलके सहारे महासमुद्रको पारकर शत्रुहन्ता परम धर्मात्मा प्रभु (श्रीराम)-ने वायुपुत्र हनुमान्की सहायतासे पत्नियों, पुत्रों तथा भाइयोंसहित रावणको मार डाला और भगवती सीताको वापस ले आये॥ ४४--४६॥
verses.wordMeaning: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).

verses.sanskrit: इतीरितो ऽथ भैरवो गणेशदेवपुङ्गवैः । सकेशवः सहान्धको जगाम शङ्करान्तिकम्
verses.transliteration: itīrito 'tha bhairavo gaṇeśadevapuṅgavaiḥ / sakeśavaḥ sahāndhako jagāma śaṅkarāntikam
verses.translation: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.hindi: राघवने सेतुके मध्यमें चर्माम्बर धारण करनेवाले महादेव ईशानकी लिङ्गरूपमें प्रतिष्ठाकर उनकी पूजा की। (इस रामेश्वर-प्रतिष्ठाके समय) पार्वतीसहित महादेव भगवान् शंकरदेवने प्रत्यक्ष रूपमें श्रेष्ठ वर प्रदान करते हुए श्रीरामसे कहा--'जो द्विजाति तुम्हारे द्वारा स्थापित इस (रामेशवर) लिंगका दर्शन करेंगे उनके बड़े-से- बड़े पाप नष्ट हो जायँगे। महासमुद्रमें स्नान करनेवालेके अन्य जो भी पाप (अर्थात् उपपातक आदि) हैं वे इस
verses.wordMeaning: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).

verses.sanskrit: निरीक्ष्य देवमागतं सशङ्करः सहान्धकम् । समाधवं समातृकं जगाम निर्वृतिं हरः
verses.transliteration: nirīkṣya devamāgataṃ saśaṅkaraḥ sahāndhakam / samādhavaṃ samātṛkaṃ jagāma nirvṛtiṃ haraḥ
verses.translation: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.hindi: लिंगके दर्शनमात्रसे ही नष्ट हो जायँगे, इसमें संदेह नहीं है। जबतक पर्वत स्थित रहेंगे, जबतक यह पृथ्वी रहेगी और जबतक यह सेतु रहेगा, तबतक मैं गुप्तरूपसे यहाँ प्रतिष्ठित रहूँगा। यहाँ किया गया स्नान, दान, जप तथा श्राद्ध अक्षय होगा। इस (रामेश्वर) लिंगके स्मरण करने मात्रसे ही दिनभरका पाप नष्ट हो जायगा॥ ४७--५२॥
verses.wordMeaning: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).

verses.sanskrit: प्रगृह्य पाणिनेश्वरो हिरण्यलोचनात्मजम् । जगाम यत्र शैलजा विमानमीशवल्लभा
verses.transliteration: pragṛhya pāṇineśvaro hiraṇyalocanātmajam / jagāma yatra śailajā vimānamīśavallabhā
verses.translation: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.hindi: ऐसा कहकर भगवान् शम्भुने रघुवंशी रामका आलिंगन किया और नन्दी तथा अपने गणोंके साथ वे रुद्र (शम्भु) वहीं अन्तर्धान हो गये। भरतके द्वारा अभिषिक्त होकर महाबली, महातेजस्वी तथा धर्मपरायण रामने भी राज्यका पालन किया
verses.wordMeaning: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).

verses.sanskrit: विलोक्य सा समागतं भवं भवार्तिहारिणम् । अवाप सान्धकं सुखं प्रसादमन्धकं प्रति
verses.transliteration: vilokya sā samāgataṃ bhavaṃ bhavārtihāriṇam / avāpa sāndhakaṃ sukhaṃ prasādamandhakaṃ prati
verses.translation: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.hindi: यज्ञेन ज्ञहन्तारमश्वमेधेन शंकरम् नभसः पुण्डरीकाख्यः क्षेमधन्वा च तत्सुतः । तस्य पुत्रोऽभवद् वीरो देवानीकः प्रतापवान्
verses.wordMeaning: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).

verses.sanskrit: अथान्धको महेश्वरीं ददर्श देवपार्श्वगाम् । पपात दण्डवत्क्षितौ ननाम पादपद्मयोः
verses.transliteration: athāndhako maheśvarīṃ dadarśa devapārśvagām / papāta daṇḍavatkṣitau nanāma pādapadmayoḥ
verses.translation: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.hindi: तस्माच्यन्द्रावलोकस्तु तारापीडस्तु तत्सुतः सर्वे प्राधान्यतः प्रोक्ताः समासेन द्विजोत्तमाः ६०॥ य इमं शृणुयान्नित्यमिक्ष्वाकोर्वशमुत्तमम्।
verses.wordMeaning: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).

verses.sanskrit: नमामि देववल्लभामनादिमद्रिजामिमाम् । यतः प्रधानपूरुषौ निहन्ति याखिलं जगत्
verses.transliteration: namāmi devavallabhāmanādimadrijāmimām / yataḥ pradhānapūruṣau nihanti yākhilaṃ jagat
verses.translation: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.hindi: विशेष रूपसे उन्होंने सभी ब्राह्मणोंकी पूजा की और अश्वमेध यज्ञके द्वारा यज्ञहन्ता ईश्वर शंकरकी अर्चना की रामके 'कुश' नामसे विख्यात तथा सुन्दर महान् भाग्यशाली, सभी तत्त्वार्थोंको जाननेवाले बुद्धिमान् 'लव' नामसे विख्यात दो पुत्र हुए। कुशसे अतिथि उत्पन्न हुआ और उसका पुत्र निषध हुआ। निषधका पुत्र नल और
verses.wordMeaning: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).

verses.sanskrit: विभाति या शिवासने शिवेन साकमव्यया । हिरण्मये ऽतिनिर्मले नमामि तामिमामजाम्
verses.transliteration: vibhāti yā śivāsane śivena sākamavyayā / hiraṇmaye 'tinirmale namāmi tāmimāmajām
verses.translation: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.hindi: उसका पुत्र नभस हुआ। नभससे पुण्डरीक नामवाला पुत्र हुआ और क्षेमधन्वा उसका पुत्र था  उस क्षेमधन्वाका देवानीक नामक वीर एवं प्रतापी पुत्र हुआ। उस (देवानीक)-का पुत्र अहीनगु और उसका पुत्र सहस्वान् हुआ। उससे चन्द्रावलोक तथा उसका पुत्र तारापीड हुआ। तारापीडसे चन्द्रगिरि तथा चन्द्रगिरिका भानुवित्त हुआ। उस (भानुवित्त)-से श्रुतायु नामक पुत्र हुआ। ये सभी इक्ष्वाकुके वंशज हैं। द्विजोत्तमो! संक्षेपमें इनमें प्रधान-
verses.wordMeaning: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).

verses.sanskrit: यदन्तराखिलं जगज्जगन्ति यान्ति संक्षयम् । नमामि यत्र तामुमामशेषबेदवर्जिताम्
verses.transliteration: yadantarākhilaṃ jagajjaganti yānti saṃkṣayam / namāmi yatra tāmumāmaśeṣabedavarjitām
verses.translation: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.hindi: प्रधान (राजाओं)-को बताया गया है जो इस श्रेष्ठ इक्ष्वाकुवंशके वर्णनको सुनेगा, वह सभी
verses.wordMeaning: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).

verses.sanskrit: न जायते नहीयते न वर्धते च तामुमाम् । नमामि या गुणातिगा गिरीशपुत्रिकामिमाम्
verses.transliteration: na jāyate nahīyate na vardhate ca tāmumām / namāmi yā guṇātigā girīśaputrikāmimām
verses.translation: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.hindi: सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो स्वर्गलोके महीयते॥ ६९॥ । पापोंसे निर्मुक्त होकर स्वर्गलोकमें प्रतिष्ठित होगा इक्कीसवा अध्याय चन्द्रबंशके राजाओंका वृत्तान्त, यदुवंश-वर्णनमें कार्तवीर्यार्जुनके पाँच पुत्रोंका आख्यान, परम विष्णुभक्त राजा जयध्वजकी कथा, विदेह दानवका पराक्रम तथा जयध्वजद्वारा विष्णुके अनुग्रहसे उसका वध, विश्वामित्रद्वारा विष्णुकी आराधनाका जयध्वजको
verses.wordMeaning: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).

verses.sanskrit: क्षमस्व देवि शैलजे कृतं मया विमाहतः । सुरासुरैर्यदर्चितं नमामि ते पदाम्बुजम्
verses.transliteration: kṣamasva devi śailaje kṛtaṃ mayā vimāhataḥ / surāsurairyadarcitaṃ namāmi te padāmbujam
verses.translation: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.hindi: उपदेश करना और जयध्वजको विष्णुका दर्शन ऐल: पुरूरवाश्वाथ राजा राज्यमपालयत्
verses.wordMeaning: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).

verses.sanskrit: इत्थं भगवती गौरी भक्तिनम्रेण पार्वती । संस्तुता दैत्यपतिना पुत्रत्वे जगृहे ऽन्धकम्
verses.transliteration: itthaṃ bhagavatī gaurī bhaktinamreṇa pārvatī / saṃstutā daityapatinā putratve jagṛhe 'ndhakam
verses.translation: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.hindi: रोमहर्षणने कहा--इलाका पुत्र राजा पुरूरवा राज्यका पालन करने लगा। उसको इन्द्रके समान नहुषः प्रथमस्तेषां धर्मज्ञो लोकविश्रुतः ।
verses.wordMeaning: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).

verses.sanskrit: ततः स मातृभिः सार्धं भैरवो रुद्रसंभवः । जगामानुज्ञया शंभोः पातालं परमेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa mātṛbhiḥ sārdhaṃ bhairavo rudrasaṃbhavaḥ / jagāmānujñayā śaṃbhoḥ pātālaṃ parameśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.hindi: तथा श्रुतायु नामवाले छः पुत्र हुए। ये उर्वशीके दिव्य पुत्र थे हमने सुना है कि आयुको स्वर्भानु (राहु)-की कन्या प्रभासे पाँच महान् ओजस्वी पुत्र हुए थे। उनमें नहुष प्रथम (पुत्र) था, जो धर्मज्ञ और लोकमें विख्यात था।
verses.wordMeaning: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).

verses.sanskrit: यत्र सा तामसी विष्णोर्मूर्तिः संहारकारिका । समास्ते हरिरव्यक्तो नृसिंहाकृतिरीश्वरः
verses.transliteration: yatra sā tāmasī viṣṇormūrtiḥ saṃhārakārikā / samāste hariravyakto nṛsiṃhākṛtirīśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.hindi: भगवान् शंकरने दक्षके यज्ञका विध्वंस कराया था इसलिये उनको यज्ञहन्ता कहा जाता है। यतिर्ययातिः संयातिरायतिः पञ्चकोऽशवकः
verses.wordMeaning: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).

verses.sanskrit: ततो ऽनन्ताकृतिः शंभुः शेषेणापि सुपूजितः । कालाग्निरुद्रो भगवान् युयोजात्मानमात्मनि
verses.transliteration: tato 'nantākṛtiḥ śaṃbhuḥ śeṣeṇāpi supūjitaḥ / kālāgnirudro bhagavān yuyojātmānamātmani
verses.translation: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.hindi: देवयानीमुशनसः सुतां भार्यामवाप स: । शर्मिष्ठामासुरीं चैव तनयां वृषपर्वणः यदुं च तुर्वसुं चैव देवयानी व्यजायत। दरुह्युं चानुं च पूरुं च शर्मिष्ठा चाप्यजीजनत्
verses.wordMeaning: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).

verses.sanskrit: युञ्जतस्तस्य देवस्य सर्वा एवाथ मातरः । बुभुक्षिता महादेवं प्रणम्याहुस्त्रिशूलिनम्
verses.transliteration: yuñjatastasya devasya sarvā evātha mātaraḥ / bubhukṣitā mahādevaṃ praṇamyāhustriśūlinam
verses.translation: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.hindi: दक्षिणापरयो राजा यदुं ज्येष्ठं न्ययोजयत्। प्रतीच्यामुत्तरायां च द्रुह्युं चानुमकल्पयत् तैरियं पृथिवी सर्वा धर्मतः परिपालिता। राजापि दारसहितो वनं प्राप महायशाः
verses.wordMeaning: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).

verses.sanskrit: मातर ऊचुः बुभुक्षिता महादेव अनुज्ञा दीयतां त्वया । त्रैलोक्यं भक्षयिष्यामो नान्यथा तृप्तिरस्तिनः
verses.transliteration: mātara ūcuḥ bubhukṣitā mahādeva anujñā dīyatāṃ tvayā / trailokyaṃ bhakṣayiṣyāmo nānyathā tṛptirastinaḥ
verses.translation: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.hindi: यदोरप्यभवन् पुत्राः पञ्च देवसुतोपमाः। सुताः शतजितोऽप्यासंस्त्रयः परमधार्मिकाः
verses.wordMeaning: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).

verses.sanskrit: एतावदुक्त्वा वचनं मातरो विष्णुसंभवाः । भक्षयाञ्चक्रिरे सर्वं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम्
verses.transliteration: etāvaduktvā vacanaṃ mātaro viṣṇusaṃbhavāḥ / bhakṣayāñcakrire sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram
verses.translation: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.hindi: हैहयश्च हयश्चैव राजा वेणुहयः परः। हैहयस्याभवत् पुत्रो धर्म इत्यभिविश्रुतः तस्य पुत्रोऽभवद् विप्रा धर्मनेत्रः प्रतापवान्। धर्मनेत्रस्य कीर्तिस्तु संजितस्तत्सुतोऽभवत्
verses.wordMeaning: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).

verses.sanskrit: ततः स भैरवो देवो नृसिंहवपुषं हरिम् । दध्यौ नारायणं देवं क्षणात्प्रादुरभूद्धरिः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa bhairavo devo nṛsiṃhavapuṣaṃ harim / dadhyau nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ kṣaṇātprādurabhūddhariḥ
verses.translation: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.hindi: दुर्दमस्य सुतो धीमान् धनको नाम वीर्यवान्। धनकस्य तु दायादाश्चत्वारो लोकसम्मताः कृतौजाश्च चतुर्थोऽभूत् कार्तवीरयोऽर्जुनोऽभवत्
verses.wordMeaning: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).

verses.sanskrit: विज्ञापयामास च तं भक्षयन्तीह मातरः । निवारयाशु त्रैलोक्यं त्वदीया भगवन्निति
verses.transliteration: vijñāpayāmāsa ca taṃ bhakṣayantīha mātaraḥ / nivārayāśu trailokyaṃ tvadīyā bhagavanniti
verses.translation: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.hindi: कृतास्त्रा बलिनः शूरा धर्मात्मानो मनस्विनः पितरोंकी कन्या विरजासे नहुषको यति, ययाति, संयाति, आयाति तथा पाँचवें अश्वक नामवाले इन्द्रके समान तेजस्वी महाबलशाली पाँच पुत्र उत्पन्न हुए। इन पाँचोंमेंसे ययाति महान् बलशाली और पराक्रमी था।
verses.wordMeaning: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).

verses.sanskrit: संस्मृता विष्णुना देव्यो नृसिंहवपुषा पुनः । उपतस्थुर्महादेवं नरसिंहाकृतिं च तम्
verses.transliteration: saṃsmṛtā viṣṇunā devyo nṛsiṃhavapuṣā punaḥ / upatasthurmahādevaṃ narasiṃhākṛtiṃ ca tam
verses.translation: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
