verses.hindi: उसने शुक्राचार्यकी पुत्री देवयानी तथा वृषपर्वाको असुर-वंशमें उत्पन्न शर्मिष्ठा नामकी कन्याको पल्लीरूपमें देवयानीने यदु तथा तुर्वसुको जन्म दिया। इसी प्रकार शर्मिष्ठाने भी द्रुह्यु, अनु तथा पूरुको उत्पन्न किया। उस (ययाति)-ने अनिन्दित ज्येष्ठ पुत्र यदुका अतिक्रमणकर पिताके वचनका पालन करनेवाले छोटे पुत्र पूरुको ही
verses.wordMeaning: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).

verses.sanskrit: संप्राप्य सन्निधिं विष्णोः सर्वाः संहारकारिकाः । प्रददुः शंभवे शक्तिं भैरवायातितेजसे
verses.transliteration: saṃprāpya sannidhiṃ viṣṇoḥ sarvāḥ saṃhārakārikāḥ / pradaduḥ śaṃbhave śaktiṃ bhairavāyātitejase
verses.translation: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.hindi: राजा ययातिने दक्षिण-पूर्व दिशामें तुर्वसु नामक पुत्रको, दक्षिण-पश्चिम दिशामें ज्येष्ठ पुत्र यदुको, पश्चिममें द्रुझुको और उत्तर दिशामें अनुको (राजाके रूपमें) नियुक्त किया। उन्होंने इस सम्पूर्ण पृथ्वीका धर्मपूर्वक पालन किया। महायशस्वी राजा (ययाति) भी पत्नीसहित वन चले गये। यदुके भी देवपुत्रोंके समान सहस्रजित्, क्रोष्ट नील, अजित तथा रघु नामक पाँच पुत्र हुए, उनमें सहस्रजित् सबसे बड़ा था
verses.wordMeaning: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).

verses.sanskrit: अपश्यंस्ता जगत्सूतिं नृसिंहमथ भैरवम् । क्षणादेकत्वमापन्नं शेषाहिं चापि मातरः
verses.transliteration: apaśyaṃstā jagatsūtiṃ nṛsiṃhamatha bhairavam / kṣaṇādekatvamāpannaṃ śeṣāhiṃ cāpi mātaraḥ
verses.translation: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.hindi: सहस्रजित्का उसीके समान शतजित् नामका पुत्र राजा था। शतजित्के भी हैहय, हय और वेणुहय नामक परम धार्मिक तीन पुत्र थे। हैहयका पुत्र “धर्म” नामसे विख्यात हुआ विप्रो! उसका (धर्मका) धर्मनेत्र नामवाला प्रतापी पुत्र हुआ। धर्मनेत्रका कीर्ति और उसका पुत्र संजित हुआ। संजितका महिष्मान् हुआ और उसका पुत्र भद्रश्रेण्य था। भब्रश्रेण्यका दुर्दम नामका पुत्र राजा था।
verses.wordMeaning: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).

verses.sanskrit: व्याजहार हृषीकेशो ये भक्ताः शूलपाणिनः । ये च मां संस्मरन्तीह पालनीयाः प्रयत्नतः
verses.transliteration: vyājahāra hṛṣīkeśo ye bhaktāḥ śūlapāṇinaḥ / ye ca māṃ saṃsmarantīha pālanīyāḥ prayatnataḥ
verses.translation: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.hindi: दुर्दमका धनक नामवाला बुद्धिमान् और वीर्यवान् पुत्र था। धनकके लोकमें सम्मानित चार पुत्र हुए--कृतवीर्य, कृताग्नि, कृतवर्मा तथा चौथा कृतौजा। कृतवीर्यका पुत्र अर्जुन हुआ। वह हजार बाहुओंवाला, द्ुतिमान् तथा धनुर्वेद जाननेवालोंमें श्रेष्ठ था। जमदग्निके पुत्र जनार्दन परशुराम उस (सहस््रार्जुन)-के लिये मृत्युरूप हुए। (अर्थात् परशुरामके द्वारा वह मारा गया)
verses.wordMeaning: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).

verses.sanskrit: ममैव मूर्तिरतुला सर्वसंहारकारिका । महेश्वरांशसंभूता भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदा त्वियम्
verses.transliteration: mamaiva mūrtiratulā sarvasaṃhārakārikā / maheśvarāṃśasaṃbhūtā bhuktimuktipradā tviyam
verses.translation: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.hindi: उस (सहस्रबाहु)-के सौ पुत्र थे, जिनमें पाँच पुत्र महारथी, अस्त्र-सम्पन्न, बली, शूर, धर्मात्मा तथा मनस्वी थे शूरश्च शूरसेनश्च धृष्णः कृष्णस्तथैव च। जयध्वजश्च बलवान् नारायणपरो नृपः
verses.wordMeaning: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).

verses.sanskrit: अनन्तो भगवान् कालो द्विधावस्था ममैव तु । तामसी राजसी मूर्तिर्देवदेवश्चतुर्मुखः
verses.transliteration: ananto bhagavān kālo dvidhāvasthā mamaiva tu / tāmasī rājasī mūrtirdevadevaścaturmukhaḥ
verses.translation: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.hindi: शूरसेनादयः सर्वे चत्वारः प्रथितौजसः । रुद्रभक्ता महात्मानः पूजयन्ति स्म शंकरम् जयध्वजस्तु मतिमान् देवं नारायणं हरिम्। जगाम शरणं विष्णुं हैवतं धर्मतत्परः
verses.wordMeaning: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽयं देवो दुराधर्षः कालो लोकप्रकालनः । भक्षयिष्यति कल्पान्ते रुद्रात्मा निखिलं जगत्
verses.transliteration: so 'yaṃ devo durādharṣaḥ kālo lokaprakālanaḥ / bhakṣayiṣyati kalpānte rudrātmā nikhilaṃ jagat
verses.translation: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.hindi: तमूचुरितरे पुत्रा नायं धर्मस्तवानघ। ईश्वराराधनरतः पितास्माकमभूदिति तानब्रवीन्महातेजा एष धर्मः परो मम। विष्णोरंशेन सम्भूता राजानो यन्महीतले
verses.wordMeaning: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).

verses.sanskrit: या सा विमोहिका मूर्तिर्मम नारायणाह्वया । सत्त्वोद्रिक्ताजगत् कृत्स्नं संस्थापयति नित्यदा
verses.transliteration: yā sā vimohikā mūrtirmama nārāyaṇāhvayā / sattvodriktājagat kṛtsnaṃ saṃsthāpayati nityadā
verses.translation: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.hindi: राज्यं पालयतावश्यं भगवान् पुरुषोत्तमः । पूजनीयो यतो विष्णुः पालको जगतो हरिः सात्त्विकी राजसी चैव तामसी च स्वयम्भुवः!
verses.wordMeaning: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).

verses.sanskrit: स हि विष्णुः परं ब्रह्म परमात्मा परा गतिः । मूलप्रकृतिरव्यक्ता सदानन्देति कथ्यते
verses.transliteration: sa hi viṣṇuḥ paraṃ brahma paramātmā parā gatiḥ / mūlaprakṛtiravyaktā sadānandeti kathyate
verses.translation: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.hindi: सत्त्वात्मा भगवान् विष्णुः संस्थापयति सर्वदा। सृजेद् ब्रह्मा रजोमूर्तिः संहरेत् तामसो हरः आराध्यो भगवान् विष्णुः केशवः केशिमर्दनः
verses.wordMeaning: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).

verses.sanskrit: इत्येवं बोधिता देव्यो विष्णुना विश्वमातरः । प्रपेदिरे महादेवं तमेव शरणं हरिम्
verses.transliteration: ityevaṃ bodhitā devyo viṣṇunā viśvamātaraḥ / prapedire mahādevaṃ tameva śaraṇaṃ harim
verses.translation: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.hindi: अयं हि भगवान् रुद्रः सर्व जगदिदं शिवः। तमोगुणं समाश्रित्य कल्पान्ते संहरेत् प्रभु: ततस्तानब्रवीद् राजा विचिन्त्यासौ जयध्वजः । सत्त्वेन मुच्यते जन्तुः सत्त्वात्मा भगवान् हरिः
verses.wordMeaning: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).

verses.sanskrit: एतद् वः कथितं सर्वं मयान्धकनिबर्हणम् । माहात्म्यं देवदेवस्य भैरवस्यामितौजसः
verses.transliteration: etad vaḥ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ mayāndhakanibarhaṇam / māhātmyaṃ devadevasya bhairavasyāmitaujasaḥ
verses.translation: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.hindi: तमूचुर्भ्रातरो रुद्रः सेवितः सात्तिचकैर्जनैः। मोचयेत् सत्त्वसंयुक्तः पूजयेशं ततो हरम् स्वधर्मो मुक्तये पन्था नान्यो मुनिभिरिष्यते
verses.wordMeaning: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the fearless Daksa resumed the Tajna. Lord Visnu, the protector of those who seek refuge, was his patron deity (the saviour).

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे पञ्चदशो ऽध्यायः श्रीकूर्म उवाच अन्दके निगृहीते वै प्रह्लादस्य महात्मनः । विरोचनो नाम सुतो बभूव नृपतिः पुरा
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge pañcadaśo 'dhyāyaḥ śrīkūrma uvāca andake nigṛhīte vai prahlādasya mahātmanaḥ / virocano nāma suto babhūva nṛpatiḥ purā
verses.translation: Observing that all Devas and sages were antagonistic to Rudra, the holy sage Dadhica spoke thus to Daksa:
verses.hindi: जयध्वज बलवान् तथा नारायणका भक्त था। शूरसेन आदि चार पुत्र महात्मा एवं अति तेजस्वी और रुद्रके भक्त थे। वे सभी शंकरको पूजा करते थे। धर्मपरायण एवं बुद्धिमान् जयध्वज नारायण देव हरि विष्णु देवताकी शरणमें गया। अन्य पुत्रों (उसके चार भाइयों)-ने उससे कहा--अनघ ! यह तुम्हारा धर्म नहीं है। हमारे पिता शंकरको आराधना करते थे
verses.wordMeaning: Observing that all Devas and sages were antagonistic to Rudra, the holy sage Dadhica spoke thus to Daksa:
verses.commentary: Sense: Observing that all Devas and sages were antagonistic to Rudra, the holy sage Dadhica spoke thus to Daksa:

verses.sanskrit: देवाञ्जित्वा सदेवेन्द्रान बहून् वर्षान् महासुरः । पालयामास धर्मेण त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम्
verses.transliteration: devāñjitvā sadevendrāna bahūn varṣān mahāsuraḥ / pālayāmāsa dharmeṇa trailokyaṃ sacarācaram
verses.translation: "There is no doubt in this that a man incurs great sin in worshipping one who is not worthy of worship and in not worshipping those who deserve worship.
verses.hindi: इसपर महातेजस्वी (जयध्वज)-ने उनसे कहा यही मेरा श्रेष्ठ धर्म है। पृथ्वीपर जो भी राजा हुए हैं, वे सभी विष्णुके अंशसे उत्पन्न हुए हैं। राज्यका परिपालन करनेवालोंको चाहिए कि भगवान् पुरुषोत्तमकी अवश्य आराधना करें। क्योंकि हरिं विष्णु संसारके पालनकर्ता हैं। स्वयम्भू (विष्णु)-की सात्तिवको, राजसी तथा तामसी ये तीन मूर्तियाँ कही गयी हैं, जो क्रमशः सृष्टि, पालन तथा संहार करनेवाली हैं । सत्त्वगुणसम्पन्न भगवान् विष्णु
verses.wordMeaning: "There is no doubt in this that a man incurs great sin in worshipping one who is not worthy of worship and in not worshipping those who deserve worship.
verses.commentary: Sense: "There is no doubt in this that a man incurs great sin in worshipping one who is not worthy of worship and in not worshipping those who deserve worship.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यैवं वर्तमानस्य कदाचिद् विष्णुचोदितः । सनत्कुमारो भगवान् पुरं प्राप महामुनिः
verses.transliteration: tasyaivaṃ vartamānasya kadācid viṣṇucoditaḥ / sanatkumāro bhagavān puraṃ prāpa mahāmuniḥ
verses.translation: The terrible punishment meted out by divine interces¬ sion is sudden and terrible in that place where bad men are received well and good men are slighted."
verses.hindi: नित्य पालन करते हैं । रजोमूर्ति ब्रह्मा सृष्टि करते हैं और तमोगुणात्मक हर संहार करते हैं। अतएव राज्यका पालन करनेवाले राजाओंके लिये केशीका मर्दन करनेवाले केशव भगवान् विष्णु आराधनीय हैं उस (जयध्वज)-का वचन सुनकर उसके दूसरे मनस्वी भाइयोंने कहा--मुक्तिप्राप्तिकी इच्छा करनेवालोंके लिये संहार करनेवाले रुद्र ही पूजनीय हैं। ये ही कल्याणकारी प्रभु भगवान् रुद्र कल्पान्तमें तमोगुणका
verses.wordMeaning: The terrible punishment meted out by divine interces¬ sion is sudden and terrible in that place where bad men are received well and good men are slighted."
verses.commentary: Sense: The terrible punishment meted out by divine interces¬ sion is sudden and terrible in that place where bad men are received well and good men are slighted."

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा सिहासनगतो ब्रह्मपुत्रं महासुरः । ननामोत्थाय शिरसा प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā sihāsanagato brahmaputraṃ mahāsuraḥ / nanāmotthāya śirasā prāñjalirvākyamabravīt
verses.translation: After saying thus, the Brahmana sage cursed those Brahmanas who were antagonistic to Isvara (Siva) and who had come there to render assistance to Daksa.
verses.hindi: आश्रय लेकर इस सम्पूर्ण जगतूका संहार करते हैं। इनकी जो अति घोर तेजोमयी परा मूर्ति है, वही विद्या (ज्ञान-विवेक)-स्वरूप है। शक्ति-रूपमें उसीके द्वारा त्रिशूल धारण करनेवाले शंकर सम्पूर्ण संसारका संहार तब वह राजा जयध्वज कुछ विचार करके उनसे बोला-सत्त्वगुणद्वारा ही प्राणी मुक्त होता है और वे भगवान् सत्त्वात्मक हैं
verses.wordMeaning: After saying thus, the Brahmana sage cursed those Brahmanas who were antagonistic to Isvara (Siva) and who had come there to render assistance to Daksa.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying thus, the Brahmana sage cursed those Brahmanas who were antagonistic to Isvara (Siva) and who had come there to render assistance to Daksa.

verses.sanskrit: धन्यो ऽस्म्यनुगृहीतो ऽस्मि संप्राप्तो मे पुरातनः । योगीश्वरो ऽद्य भगवान् यतो ऽसौ ब्रह्मवित् स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: dhanyo 'smyanugṛhīto 'smi saṃprāpto me purātanaḥ / yogīśvaro 'dya bhagavān yato 'sau brahmavit svayam
verses.translation: After saying thus, the Brahmana sage, the storehouse of penance ceased (to speak). He mentally thought of Rudra, the destroyer of all sins.
verses.hindi: इसपर भाइयोंने उससे कहा--सात्त्विकजनोंके द्वारा सेवित रुद्र सत्त्वगुणसे सम्पन्न होकर मुक्त करते हैं, अत: ईश्वर हरकी पूजा करो। तब राजपुत्र जयध्वजने हँसते हुए कहा-मुक्तिके लिये स्वधर्म-पालन ही एकमात्र मार्ग है। मुनिलोग अन्य (धर्म)-की इच्छा नहीं करते
verses.wordMeaning: After saying thus, the Brahmana sage, the storehouse of penance ceased (to speak). He mentally thought of Rudra, the destroyer of all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying thus, the Brahmana sage, the storehouse of penance ceased (to speak). He mentally thought of Rudra, the destroyer of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: किमर्थमागतो ब्रह्मन् स्वयं देवः पितामहः । ब्रूहि मे ब्रह्मणः पुत्र किं कार्यं करवाण्यहम्
verses.transliteration: kimarthamāgato brahman svayaṃ devaḥ pitāmahaḥ / brūhi me brahmaṇaḥ putra kiṃ kāryaṃ karavāṇyaham
verses.translation: In the meantime, the all-knowing goddess learnt this and spoke to the great god, Mahesvara, her husband as the lord of Pasus.
verses.hindi: तथा च वैष्णवी शक्तिर्नृपाणां देवता सदा। आराधनं परो धर्मो मुरारेरमितौजसः यदर्जुनोऽस्मज्जनकः स्वधर्म कृतवानिति
verses.wordMeaning: In the meantime, the all-knowing goddess learnt this and spoke to the great god, Mahesvara, her husband as the lord of Pasus.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meantime, the all-knowing goddess learnt this and spoke to the great god, Mahesvara, her husband as the lord of Pasus.

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽब्रवीद् भगवान् देवो धर्मयुक्तं महासुरम् । द्रष्टुमभ्यागतो ऽहं वै भवन्तं भाग्यवानसि
verses.transliteration: so 'bravīd bhagavān devo dharmayuktaṃ mahāsuram / draṣṭumabhyāgato 'haṃ vai bhavantaṃ bhāgyavānasi
verses.translation: O Sankara, Daksa who had been my father in the previous birth is performing a Tajna after censuring your status and your own self
verses.hindi: एवं विवादे वितते शूरसेनोऽब्रवीद् बच: । प्रमाणमृषयो ह्यत्र ब्रूयुस्ते यत् तथैव तत् या यस्याभिमता पुंसः सा हि तस्यैव देवता
verses.wordMeaning: O Sankara, Daksa who had been my father in the previous birth is performing a Tajna after censuring your status and your own self
verses.commentary: Sense: O Sankara, Daksa who had been my father in the previous birth is performing a Tajna after censuring your status and your own self

verses.sanskrit: सुदुर्लभा नीतिरेषा दैत्यानां दैत्यसत्तम । त्रिलोके धार्मिको नूनं त्वादृशो ऽन्यो न विद्यते
verses.transliteration: sudurlabhā nītireṣā daityānāṃ daityasattama / triloke dhārmiko nūnaṃ tvādṛśo 'nyo na vidyate
verses.translation: The gods and the great sages are assembled there rendering him assistance. Please destroy that sacrifice immediaely. I am choosing this boon.
verses.hindi: किन्तु कार्यविशेषेण पूजिताश्चेष्टदा नृणाम्। विशेषात् सर्वदा नायं नियमो ह्यन्यथा नृपाः नृपाणां हैवतं विष्णुस्तथैव च पुरंदरः। विप्राणामग्निरादित्यो ब्रह्मा चैव पिनाकधृक्
verses.wordMeaning: The gods and the great sages are assembled there rendering him assistance. Please destroy that sacrifice immediaely. I am choosing this boon.
verses.commentary: Sense: The gods and the great sages are assembled there rendering him assistance. Please destroy that sacrifice immediaely. I am choosing this boon.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्तो ऽसुरराजस्तं पुनः प्राह महामुनिम् । धर्माणां परमं धर्मं ब्रूहि मे ब्रह्मवित्तम
verses.transliteration: ityukto 'surarājastaṃ punaḥ prāha mahāmunim / dharmāṇāṃ paramaṃ dharmaṃ brūhi me brahmavittama
verses.translation: Thus implored by the goddess, the great Lord, the Lord of Devas, created Rudra immediately with a desire to destroy the Yajha of Daksa.
verses.hindi: देवानां हैवतं विष्णुर्दानवानां त्रिशूलभृत्। गन्धर्वाणां तथा सोमो यक्षाणामपि कथ्यते विद्याधराणां वाग्देवी साध्यानां भगवान् रविः। रक्षसां शंकरो रुद्रः किंनराणां च पार्वती
verses.wordMeaning: Thus implored by the goddess, the great Lord, the Lord of Devas, created Rudra immediately with a desire to destroy the Yajha of Daksa.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus implored by the goddess, the great Lord, the Lord of Devas, created Rudra immediately with a desire to destroy the Yajha of Daksa.

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽब्रवीद् भगवान् योगी दैत्येन्द्राय महात्मने । सर्वगुह्यतमं धर्ममात्मज्ञानमनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: so 'bravīd bhagavān yogī daityendrāya mahātmane / sarvaguhyatamaṃ dharmamātmajñānamanuttamam
verses.translation: Siva spoke to him thus: "O Ganesvara (leader of the attendants). Blessings unto you. After censuring me, Daksa is performing a Tajna, at Gahgadvara, (near the source of the river Gahga). Destroy that sacrifice of Daksa."
verses.hindi: ऋषीणां हैवतं ब्रह्मा महादेवश्च शूलभृत्। मनूनां स्यादुमा देवी तथा विष्णुः सभास्करः गृहस्थानां च सर्वे स्युर्तब्रह्मा वै ब्रह्मचारिणाम्।
verses.wordMeaning: Siva spoke to him thus: "O Ganesvara (leader of the attendants). Blessings unto you. After censuring me, Daksa is performing a Tajna, at Gahgadvara, (near the source of the river Gahga). Destroy that sacrifice of Daksa."
verses.commentary: Sense: Siva spoke to him thus: "O Ganesvara (leader of the attendants). Blessings unto you. After censuring me, Daksa is performing a Tajna, at Gahgadvara, (near the source of the river Gahga). Destroy that sacrifice of Daksa."

verses.sanskrit: स लब्ध्वा परमं ज्ञानं दत्त्वा च गुरुदक्षिणाम् । निधाय पुत्रे तद्राज्यं योगाभ्यासरतो ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: sa labdhvā paramaṃ jñānaṃ dattvā ca gurudakṣiṇām / nidhāya putre tadrājyaṃ yogābhyāsarato 'bhavat
verses.translation: Then the sacrifice of Daksa was destroyed by Vira¬ bhadra playfully like a single lion released from bondage.
verses.hindi: भूतानां भगवान् रुद्रः कूष्माण्डानां विनायकः। सर्वेषां भगवान् ब्रह्मा देवदेवः प्रजापतिः इत्येवं भगवान् ब्रह्मा स्वयं देवोऽभ्यभाषत। तस्माजयध्वजो नूनं विष्णवाराधनमरहति
verses.wordMeaning: Then the sacrifice of Daksa was destroyed by Vira¬ bhadra playfully like a single lion released from bondage.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the sacrifice of Daksa was destroyed by Vira¬ bhadra playfully like a single lion released from bondage.

verses.sanskrit: स तस्य पुत्रो मतिमान् बलिर्नाम महासुरः । ब्रह्मण्यो धार्मिको ऽत्यर्थं विजिग्ये ऽथ पुरन्दरम्
verses.transliteration: sa tasya putro matimān balirnāma mahāsuraḥ / brahmaṇyo dhārmiko 'tyarthaṃ vijigye 'tha purandaram
verses.translation: Bhadrakali, Mahesvari was created angrily by Uma. Gana (the attendant Virabhadra) rode on the bull and went along with her.
verses.hindi: साथ ही राजाओंके लिये वैष्णवी शक्ति ही सदा करना परम धर्म है
verses.wordMeaning: Bhadrakali, Mahesvari was created angrily by Uma. Gana (the attendant Virabhadra) rode on the bull and went along with her.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhadrakali, Mahesvari was created angrily by Uma. Gana (the attendant Virabhadra) rode on the bull and went along with her.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा तेन महद् युद्धं शक्रः सर्वामरैर्वृतः । जगाम निर्जितो विष्णुं देवं शरणमच्युतम्
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā tena mahad yuddhaṃ śakraḥ sarvāmarairvṛtaḥ / jagāma nirjito viṣṇuṃ devaṃ śaraṇamacyutam
verses.translation: Thousands of other Rudras, who became famous as Romajas (born of hair) were created by that intelligent being in order to assist him (Virabhadra).
verses.hindi: तब बुद्धिमानोंमें श्रेष्ठ राजपुत्र कृष्ण (जयध्वजके भाई)-ने उससे (जयध्वजसे) कहा--हम लोगोंके पिता अर्जुनने (सहस्नार्जुन या कार्तवीर्यार्जुनने) जिसे स्वधर्म माना है (वही हम लोगोंको भी मान्य होना चाहिए)। इस प्रकार विवादके बढ़ जानेपर शूरसेन (जयध्वजके दूसरे भाई)-ने यह बात कही-इस विषयमें ऋषि ही प्रमाण हैं, अतः वे जैसा कहेंगे, हम लोगोंको वैसा ही करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: Thousands of other Rudras, who became famous as Romajas (born of hair) were created by that intelligent being in order to assist him (Virabhadra).
verses.commentary: Sense: Thousands of other Rudras, who became famous as Romajas (born of hair) were created by that intelligent being in order to assist him (Virabhadra).

verses.sanskrit: तदन्तरे ऽदितिर्देवी देवमाता सुदुः खिता । दैत्येन्द्राणां वधार्थाय पुत्रो मे स्यादिति स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: tadantare 'ditirdevī devamātā suduḥ khitā / daityendrāṇāṃ vadhārthāya putro me syāditi svayam
verses.translation: They wielded tridents, Saktis and iron clubs in their hands. They had sticks, pebbles and stones in their hands. They resembled Rudra and the Kalagni (terrible fire of dissolu¬ tion of the universe). They made the ten quarters reverberate with their shouts and sounds.
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर वे सभी राजश्रेष्ठ तैयार होकर सपर्षियोंके आश्रममें गये और (उन) ब्रह्मनादियोंसे पूछा- वासिष्ठ आदि उन मुनियोंने तत्त्वकी बात बताते हुए उनसे कहा-जिस पुरुषको जो देवता अभिमत हो, वही उसका अभीष्ट देवता है। किंतु किसी विशेष कार्यसे पूजित (तत्तद्-देवता) मनुष्योंको अभीष्ट फल प्रदान करते हैं। राजाओ! विशेष अर्थात् किसी उद्देश्यसे की जानेवाली पूजा सदा नहीं की जाती, क्योंकि कामनापरक
verses.wordMeaning: They wielded tridents, Saktis and iron clubs in their hands. They had sticks, pebbles and stones in their hands. They resembled Rudra and the Kalagni (terrible fire of dissolu¬ tion of the universe). They made the ten quarters reverberate with their shouts and sounds.
verses.commentary: Sense: They wielded tridents, Saktis and iron clubs in their hands. They had sticks, pebbles and stones in their hands. They resembled Rudra and the Kalagni (terrible fire of dissolu¬ tion of the universe). They made the ten quarters reverberate with their shouts and sounds.

verses.sanskrit: तताप सुमहद् घोरं तपोराशिस्तपः परम् । प्रपन्ना विष्णुमव्यक्तं शरण्यं शरणं हरिम्
verses.transliteration: tatāpa sumahad ghoraṃ taporāśistapaḥ param / prapannā viṣṇumavyaktaṃ śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ harim
verses.translation: All of them were very terrible. Accompanied by their wives, they rode on the bulls. They went thus towards the place of sacrifice of Daksa, surrounded the leading Gana (i.e. Virabhadra).
verses.hindi: आराधनाके नियम दूसरे प्रकारके होते हैं (वे सदा सब स्थितियाँमें पालनीय नहीं हो सकते) । राजाओंके देवता विष्णु और इन्द्र हैं। ब्राह्मणोंके देवता अग्नि, सूर्य, ब्रह्म तथा पिनाकधारी शिव हैं । देवताओंके देवता विष्णु और दानवोंके त्रिशूलधारी शिव हैं। गन्धर्वो और यक्षोंके
verses.wordMeaning: All of them were very terrible. Accompanied by their wives, they rode on the bulls. They went thus towards the place of sacrifice of Daksa, surrounded the leading Gana (i.e. Virabhadra).
verses.commentary: Sense: All of them were very terrible. Accompanied by their wives, they rode on the bulls. They went thus towards the place of sacrifice of Daksa, surrounded the leading Gana (i.e. Virabhadra).

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा हृत्पद्मकिञ्जल्के निष्कलं परमं पदम् । वासुदेवमनाद्यन्तमानन्दं व्योम केवलम्
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā hṛtpadmakiñjalke niṣkalaṃ paramaṃ padam / vāsudevamanādyantamānandaṃ vyoma kevalam
verses.translation: "All of us are the followers of Sarva (Siva) of immeasurable brilliance. We have come here desirous of receiv¬ ing our shares. Give the desired shares to us.*
verses.hindi: विद्याधरोंके देवता वाग्देवी तथा साध्योंके भगवान् सूर्य हँ राक्षसोंके शंकर रुद्र और किंनरोंकी देवता पार्वती हैं। ऋषियोंके देवता ब्रह्मा और त्रिशूलधारी महादेव हैं। मनुष्योंके देवता उमा देवी, विष्णु तथा सूर्य हैं । गृहस्थोंके लिये सभी देवता (पूज्य) हैं। ब्रह्मचारियोंके देवता ब्रह्मा, वैखानसोंके सूर्य तथा संन्यासियोंके महेश्वर देवता हैं। भूतोंके भगवान् रुद्र, कूष्माण्डोंके विनायक और देवाधि- देव प्रजापति भगवान् ब्रह्मा सभीके देवता हैं
verses.wordMeaning: "All of us are the followers of Sarva (Siva) of immeasurable brilliance. We have come here desirous of receiv¬ ing our shares. Give the desired shares to us.*
verses.commentary: Sense: "All of us are the followers of Sarva (Siva) of immeasurable brilliance. We have come here desirous of receiv¬ ing our shares. Give the desired shares to us.*

verses.sanskrit: प्रसन्नो भगवान् विष्णुः शङ्खचक्रगदाधरः । आविर्बभूव योगात्मा देवमातुः पुरो हरिः
verses.transliteration: prasanno bhagavān viṣṇuḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ / āvirbabhūva yogātmā devamātuḥ puro hariḥ
verses.translation: O excellent sages, if this is some one's deception,** let this be told that the shares are to be given to you and not to us."
verses.hindi: (सप्तर्षियोंने कहा) स्वयं भगवान् ब्रह्माने ही यह कहा है, इसलिये निश्चित ही जयध्वज विष्णुको आराधना करनेके योग्य हैं। तब वे सभी उन्हें प्रणामकर परम सुन्दर अपनी पुरीको चले गये और युद्धमें सभी शत्रुओंको जीतकर पृथ्वीका पालन करने लगे
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent sages, if this is some one's deception,** let this be told that the shares are to be given to you and not to us."
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent sages, if this is some one's deception,** let this be told that the shares are to be given to you and not to us."

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा समागतं विष्णुमदितिर्भक्तिसंयुता । मेने कृतार्थमात्मानं तोषयामास केशवम्
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā samāgataṃ viṣṇumaditirbhaktisaṃyutā / mene kṛtārthamātmānaṃ toṣayāmāsa keśavam
verses.translation: Inform him, who commands you thus. We shall know from him. Devas the foremost among whom was Prajapati Daksa on being addressed thus, by the leader of Ganas, spoke:
verses.hindi: दंष्टाकरालो दीप्तात्मा युगान्तदहनोपमः। शूलमादाय सूर्याभं नादयन् वै दिशो दश तन्नादश्रवणान्मर्त्यास्तत्र ये निवसन्ति ते। तत्यजुर्जीवितं त्वन्ये दुद्रुवुर्भयविह्लाः
verses.wordMeaning: Inform him, who commands you thus. We shall know from him. Devas the foremost among whom was Prajapati Daksa on being addressed thus, by the leader of Ganas, spoke:
verses.commentary: Sense: Inform him, who commands you thus. We shall know from him. Devas the foremost among whom was Prajapati Daksa on being addressed thus, by the leader of Ganas, spoke:

verses.sanskrit: अदितिरुवाच जयाशेषदुः खौघनाशैकहेतो जयानन्तमाहात्म्ययोगाभियुक्त । जयानादिमध्यान्तविज्ञानमूर्ते जयाशेषकल्पामलानन्दरूप
verses.transliteration: aditiruvāca jayāśeṣaduḥ khaughanāśaikaheto jayānantamāhātmyayogābhiyukta / jayānādimadhyāntavijñānamūrte jayāśeṣakalpāmalānandarūpa
verses.translation: It is him that the learned persons who have become merged in Brahman and who expound Vedas realise. He is the Atman of all living beings. He is the seed (cause) and the ultimate goal.
verses.hindi: ततः सर्वे सुसंयत्ताः कार्तवीर्यात्मजास्तदा। युयुधुर्दानवं शक्तिगिरिकूटासिमुदगरेः शूरसेनादयः पञ्च राजानस्तु महाबलाः । युद्धाय कृतसंरम्भा विदेहं त्वभिदुद्रुवुः
verses.wordMeaning: It is him that the learned persons who have become merged in Brahman and who expound Vedas realise. He is the Atman of all living beings. He is the seed (cause) and the ultimate goal.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is him that the learned persons who have become merged in Brahman and who expound Vedas realise. He is the Atman of all living beings. He is the seed (cause) and the ultimate goal.

verses.sanskrit: नमो विष्णवे कालरूपाय तुभ्यं नमो नारसिंहाय शेषाय तुभ्यम् । नमः कालरुद्राय संहारकर्त्रे नमो वासुदेवाय तुभ्यं नमस्ते
verses.transliteration: namo viṣṇave kālarūpāya tubhyaṃ namo nārasiṃhāya śeṣāya tubhyam / namaḥ kālarudrāya saṃhārakartre namo vāsudevāya tubhyaṃ namaste
verses.translation: Thus, the entire story of destruction of Daksa's sacrifice has been recounted to you. Now listen to the progeny of the daughters of Daksa."
verses.hindi: शूरोऽस्त्रं प्राहिणोद् रौद्रं शूरसेनस्तु वारुणम्। प्राजापत्यं तथा कृष्णो वायव्यं धृष्ण एव च न दानवं चालयितुं शशाकान्तकसंनिभम्
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, the entire story of destruction of Daksa's sacrifice has been recounted to you. Now listen to the progeny of the daughters of Daksa."
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, the entire story of destruction of Daksa's sacrifice has been recounted to you. Now listen to the progeny of the daughters of Daksa."

verses.sanskrit: नमो विश्वमायाविधानाय तुभ्यं नमो योगगम्याय सत्याय तुभ्यम् । नमो धर्मविज्ञाननिष्ठाय तुभ्यं नमस्ते वराहाय भूयो नमस्ते
verses.transliteration: namo viśvamāyāvidhānāya tubhyaṃ namo yogagamyāya satyāya tubhyam / namo dharmavijñānaniṣṭhāya tubhyaṃ namaste varāhāya bhūyo namaste
verses.translation: According to Vamana P. Gh. 63, the demon Andhaka was Siva's son entrusted as a foster-child to Hiranyaksa. Andhaka entertained erotic passion for his mother Parvati and demanded her of Siva. In response to Siva's challenge, he fought with Siva who discomfiting him transformed him into his Gaa chief called Bhrngi.
verses.hindi: विष्णुं ग्रसिष्णुं लोकादिमप्रमेयमनामयम्। त्रातारं पुरुषं पूर्व श्रीपतिं पीतवाससम् आदेशाद् वासुदेवस्य भक्तानुग्रहकारणात्
verses.wordMeaning: According to Vamana P. Gh. 63, the demon Andhaka was Siva's son entrusted as a foster-child to Hiranyaksa. Andhaka entertained erotic passion for his mother Parvati and demanded her of Siva. In response to Siva's challenge,…
verses.commentary: Sense: According to Vamana P. Gh. 63, the demon Andhaka was Siva's son entrusted as a foster-child to Hiranyaksa. Andhaka entertained erotic passion for his mother Parvati and demanded her of Siva. In response to Siva's challenge,…

verses.sanskrit: नमस्ते सहस्त्रार्कचन्द्राभमूर्ते नमो वेदविज्ञानधर्माभिगम्य । नमो देवदेवादिदेवादिदेव प्रभो विश्वयोने ऽथ भूयो नमस्ते
verses.transliteration: namaste sahastrārkacandrābhamūrte namo vedavijñānadharmābhigamya / namo devadevādidevādideva prabho viśvayone 'tha bhūyo namaste
verses.translation: According to the Bh. P. VII.10.23, Nrsimha commanded Prahrada to occupy the throne of his father. V 23.32 endorses the same. But here Prahrada crowned his uncle Hiranyaksa as the Daitya chief.
verses.hindi: जग्राह जगतां योनिं स्मृत्वा नारायणं नृपः। प्राहिणोद् वै विदेहाय दानवेभ्यो यथा हरिः तस्मिन् हते देवरिपौ शूराद्या भ्रातरो नृपाः। समाययुः पुरीं रम्यां भ्रातरं चाप्यपूजयन्
verses.wordMeaning: According to the Bh. P. VII.10.23, Nrsimha commanded Prahrada to occupy the throne of his father. V 23.32 endorses the same. But here Prahrada crowned his uncle Hiranyaksa as the Daitya chief.
verses.commentary: Sense: According to the Bh. P. VII.10.23, Nrsimha commanded Prahrada to occupy the throne of his father. V 23.32 endorses the same. But here Prahrada crowned his uncle Hiranyaksa as the Daitya chief.

verses.sanskrit: नमः शंभवे सत्यनिष्ठाय तुभ्यं नमो हेतवे विश्वरूपाय तुभ्यम् । नमो योगपीठान्तरस्थाय तुभ्यं शिवायैकरूपाय भूयो नमस्ते
verses.transliteration: namaḥ śaṃbhave satyaniṣṭhāya tubhyaṃ namo hetave viśvarūpāya tubhyam / namo yogapīṭhāntarasthāya tubhyaṃ śivāyaikarūpāya bhūyo namaste
verses.translation: A thousand sons he begot of Asikni,' the righteous daughter of Prajapati Virana.
verses.hindi: श्रुत्वाजगाम भगवान् जयध्वजपराक्रमम्। कार्तवीर्यसुतं द्रष्टुं विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः विप्रेन्द्रो ! तदनन्तर किसी दिन सभी प्राणियोंके लिये भयंकर विदेह नामका दानव उनकी पुरीमें चला आया। भयंकर दाढ़ोंवाला, प्रलयकालीन अग्रिके समान उद्दीप्त (वह दानव) सूर्यके समान चमकते हुए शूलको लेकर
verses.wordMeaning: A thousand sons he begot of Asikni,' the righteous daughter of Prajapati Virana.
verses.commentary: Sense: A thousand sons he begot of Asikni,' the righteous daughter of Prajapati Virana.

verses.sanskrit: एवं स भगवान् कृष्णो देवमात्रा जगन्मयः । तोषितश्छन्दयामास वरेण प्रहसन्निव
verses.transliteration: evaṃ sa bhagavān kṛṣṇo devamātrā jaganmayaḥ / toṣitaśchandayāmāsa vareṇa prahasanniva
verses.translation: When those sons were lost through the deception of Narada, Prajapati Daksa, begot sixty daughters of Virini.®
verses.hindi: दसों दिशाओंमें गरजने लगा। उसकी (भयंकर) गर्जनाको सुनकर वहाँ रहनेवाले कुछ मनुष्योंने प्राण त्याग दिये और दूसरे भयसे विह्वल होकर भाग पड़े॥ ४९--५१॥ तब कार्तवीर्ये सभी पुत्र सावधान होकर शक्ति (सेना), पर्वतशिला, तलवार तथा मुद्गरोंसे उस दानवके साथ युद्ध करने लगे। ब्राह्मणो! उस भयंकर दानवने शूलसे उन सभीका हँसते हुए वैसे ही निवारण कर
verses.wordMeaning: When those sons were lost through the deception of Narada, Prajapati Daksa, begot sixty daughters of Virini.®
verses.commentary: Sense: When those sons were lost through the deception of Narada, Prajapati Daksa, begot sixty daughters of Virini.®

verses.sanskrit: प्रणम्य शिरसा भूमौ सा वब्रे वरमुत्तमम् । त्वामेव पुत्रं देवानां हिताय वरये वरम्
verses.transliteration: praṇamya śirasā bhūmau sā vabre varamuttamam / tvāmeva putraṃ devānāṃ hitāya varaye varam
verses.translation: You are all-pervading. All immortal Devas cons¬ titute your physical body. You are the eternal great Yogin. You are the Atman of all living beings. You are the Chief and great Prakrti.
verses.hindi: दिया जैसे प्रलयकालमें भैरव करते हैं। तब महाबली शूरसेन आदि वे पाँच राजा युद्धके लिये तैयारी कर विदेह दानवपर टूर पड़े शुरने रौद्रास्त्र, शुरसेने वारुणास्त्र, कृष्णने प्राजापत्यास्त्र,
verses.wordMeaning: You are all-pervading. All immortal Devas cons¬ titute your physical body. You are the eternal great Yogin. You are the Atman of all living beings. You are the Chief and great Prakrti.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are all-pervading. All immortal Devas cons¬ titute your physical body. You are the eternal great Yogin. You are the Atman of all living beings. You are the Chief and great Prakrti.

verses.sanskrit: तथास्त्वित्याह भगवान् प्रपन्नजनवत्सलः । दत्त्वा वरानप्रमेयस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत
verses.transliteration: tathāstvityāha bhagavān prapannajanavatsalaḥ / dattvā varānaprameyastatraivāntaradhīyata
verses.translation: You are interested and engaged in detachment and prosperity. You are beyond the scope of speech. You are pure. You are the maker and the sustainer. You are the annihilator of the enemies of gods.
verses.hindi: आग्रेयास्त्र चलाया, किंतु उस दानवने शूलसे उन सभी अस्त्रोंको तोड़ डाला। तब महावीर्यशाली कृष्णने भीषण गदा लेकर मन्त्रसे उसे अभिमन्त्रित कर वेगपूर्वक फेंका और गर्जना की। वह गदा उस विदेहकी पत्थरके समान छातीपर लगकर भी यमराज-तुल्य उस दानवको विचलित करनेमें समर्थ न हो सकी
verses.wordMeaning: You are interested and engaged in detachment and prosperity. You are beyond the scope of speech. You are pure. You are the maker and the sustainer. You are the annihilator of the enemies of gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are interested and engaged in detachment and prosperity. You are beyond the scope of speech. You are pure. You are the maker and the sustainer. You are the annihilator of the enemies of gods.

verses.sanskrit: ततो बहुतिथे काले भगवन्तं जनार्दनम् । दधार गर्भं देवानां माता नारायणं स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: tato bahutithe kāle bhagavantaṃ janārdanam / dadhāra garbhaṃ devānāṃ mātā nārāyaṇaṃ svayam
verses.translation: ''This is that lord Narayana, the protector of Devas and our immutable enemy, or definitely his son."
verses.hindi: उसके महान् पौरुषको देखकर भयग्रस्त हो वे सभी लोकादि, ग्रसिष्णु, त्राणकर्ता, पूर्वपुरुष, श्रीपति और पीताम्बरधारी जगत्पति विष्णुका स्मरण किया। स्मरण करते ही भक्तपर अनुग्रह करनेके लिये वासुदेवकी आज्ञासे दस हजार सूर्योके समान प्रकाशमान चक्र प्रकट हुआ।
verses.wordMeaning: ''This is that lord Narayana, the protector of Devas and our immutable enemy, or definitely his son."
verses.commentary: Sense: ''This is that lord Narayana, the protector of Devas and our immutable enemy, or definitely his son."

verses.sanskrit: समाविष्टे हृषीकेशे देवमातुरथोदरम् । उत्पाता जज्ञिरे घोरा बलेर्वैरोचनेः पुरे
verses.transliteration: samāviṣṭe hṛṣīkeśe devamāturathodaram / utpātā jajñire ghorā balervairocaneḥ pure
verses.translation: After saying this, they showered a volley of arrows and other weapons on that Male being. That lord sportively destroyed them (the weapons). He was not wounded.
verses.hindi: राजा (जयध्वज)-ने जगद्योनि नारायणका ध्यानकर उस चक्रको ग्रहण किया और विदेह (दानव)-पर उसी प्रकार चलाया जैसे विष्णु दानवोंपर चलाते हैं॥ ५९--६२ ॥ सुदर्शनचक्र उस भयंकर दानवके कंधेपर लगा और उसने उसके पर्वत-शिखरके समान सिरको पृथ्वीपर गिरा दिया। देवताओकि शत्रु उस (विदेह दानव)-के मारे जानेपर राजा शूर आदि सभी भाई अपनी रमणीय पुरीमें चले
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this, they showered a volley of arrows and other weapons on that Male being. That lord sportively destroyed them (the weapons). He was not wounded.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this, they showered a volley of arrows and other weapons on that Male being. That lord sportively destroyed them (the weapons). He was not wounded.

verses.sanskrit: निरीक्ष्य सर्वानुत्पातान् दैत्येन्द्रो भयविह्वलः । प्रह्लादमसुरं वृद्धं प्रणम्याह पितामहम्
verses.transliteration: nirīkṣya sarvānutpātān daityendro bhayavihvalaḥ / prahlādamasuraṃ vṛddhaṃ praṇamyāha pitāmaham
verses.translation: Because he was eagerly attached to the kingdom he was deluded due to the force of the curse. He began to harass the leading Brahmanas. He did not understand Visnu.
verses.hindi: आये और उन्होंने भाई (जयध्वज)-की पूजा की। महामुनि भगवान् विश्वामित्र जयध्वजके पराक्रमको सुनकर उस कीर्तवीर्य पुत्रको देखने आये तमागतमथो दृष्टा राजा सम्भ्रान्तमानस: । समावेश्यासने रम्ये पूजयामास भावत:
verses.wordMeaning: Because he was eagerly attached to the kingdom he was deluded due to the force of the curse. He began to harass the leading Brahmanas. He did not understand Visnu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Because he was eagerly attached to the kingdom he was deluded due to the force of the curse. He began to harass the leading Brahmanas. He did not understand Visnu.

verses.sanskrit: बलिरुवाच पितामह महाप्राज्ञ जायन्ते ऽस्मत्पुरे ऽधुना । किमुत्पाता भवेत् कार्यमस्माकं किंनिमित्तकाः
verses.transliteration: baliruvāca pitāmaha mahāprājña jāyante 'smatpure 'dhunā / kimutpātā bhavet kāryamasmākaṃ kiṃnimittakāḥ
verses.translation: Due to the greatness of the previous impressions and culture, he regained his perfect knowledge of Visnu the great Purusa. He sought shelter in him, as he was worthy of being the refuge.
verses.hindi: उवाच भगवान् घोरः प्रसादाद् भवतो5सुरः । निपातितो मया संख्ये विदेहो दानवेश्वरः त्वद्वाक्याच्छिन्नसंदेहो विष्णुं सत्यपराक्रमम्।
verses.wordMeaning: Due to the greatness of the previous impressions and culture, he regained his perfect knowledge of Visnu the great Purusa. He sought shelter in him, as he was worthy of being the refuge.
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to the greatness of the previous impressions and culture, he regained his perfect knowledge of Visnu the great Purusa. He sought shelter in him, as he was worthy of being the refuge.

verses.sanskrit: निशम्य तस्य वचनं चिरं ध्यात्वा महासुरः । नमस्कृत्य हृषीकेशमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: niśamya tasya vacanaṃ ciraṃ dhyātvā mahāsuraḥ / namaskṛtya hṛṣīkeśamidaṃ vacanamabravīt
verses.translation: Thereafter, the leading Daitya had undeflected devotion to Visnu the most excellent of all Purufas and attained Yoga.
verses.hindi: यक्ष्यामि परमेशानं विष्णुं पद्मदलेक्षणम्। कथं केन विधानेन सम्पूज्यो हरिरीश्वरः कोऽयं नारायणो देवः किम्प्रभावश्च सुव्रत। सर्वमेतन्ममाचक्ष्व परं कौतूहलं हि मे
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, the leading Daitya had undeflected devotion to Visnu the most excellent of all Purufas and attained Yoga.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, the leading Daitya had undeflected devotion to Visnu the most excellent of all Purufas and attained Yoga.

verses.sanskrit: प्रह्लाद उवाच यो यज्ञैरिज्यते विष्णुर्यस्य सर्वमिदं जगत् । दधारासुरनाशार्थं माता तं त्रिदिवौकसाम्
verses.transliteration: prahlāda uvāca yo yajñairijyate viṣṇuryasya sarvamidaṃ jagat / dadhārāsuranāśārthaṃ mātā taṃ tridivaukasām
verses.translation: When the son of Hiranyakasipu became eagerly attached to Yoga, the leading Asura, Andhaka obtained (i.e. succeeded to) that kingdom.
verses.hindi: स विष्णुः सर्वभूतात्मा तमाश्रित्य विमुच्यते स्ववर्णाश्रमधर्मेण पूज्योऽयं पुरुषोत्तमः । अकामहतभावेन समाराध्यो न चान्यथा
verses.wordMeaning: When the son of Hiranyakasipu became eagerly attached to Yoga, the leading Asura, Andhaka obtained (i.e. succeeded to) that kingdom.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the son of Hiranyakasipu became eagerly attached to Yoga, the leading Asura, Andhaka obtained (i.e. succeeded to) that kingdom.

verses.sanskrit: यस्मादभिन्नं सकलं भिद्यते यो ऽखिलादपि । स वासुदेवो देवानां मातुर्देहं समाविशत्
verses.transliteration: yasmādabhinnaṃ sakalaṃ bhidyate yo 'khilādapi / sa vāsudevo devānāṃ māturdehaṃ samāviśat
verses.translation: (The Raksasa) the son of Hiranyaksa born of Siva's body, loved goddess Uma, the daughter of the mountain, stationed on Mandara.
verses.hindi: एतावदुक्त्वा भगवान् विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः । शूराद्यैः पूजितो विप्रा जगामाथ स्वमालयम् अथ शूरादयो देवमयजन्त महेश्वरम्। यज्ञेन यज्ञगम्यं तं निष्कामा रुद्रमव्ययम्
verses.wordMeaning: (The Raksasa) the son of Hiranyaksa born of Siva's body, loved goddess Uma, the daughter of the mountain, stationed on Mandara.
verses.commentary: Sense: (The Raksasa) the son of Hiranyaksa born of Siva's body, loved goddess Uma, the daughter of the mountain, stationed on Mandara.

verses.sanskrit: न यस्य देवा जानन्ति स्वरूपं परमार्थतः । स विष्णुरदितेर्देहं स्वेच्छयाद्य समाविशत्
verses.transliteration: na yasya devā jānanti svarūpaṃ paramārthataḥ / sa viṣṇuraditerdehaṃ svecchayādya samāviśat
verses.translation: Formerly, thousands of householder saints performed penance in order to propitiate Isvara, in the holy forest of Daruvana (Pine forest).
verses.hindi: तान् वसिष्ठस्तु भगवान् याजयामास सर्ववित्। गौतमोऽत्रिरगस्त्यश्च सर्वे रुद्रपरायणाः विश्वामित्रस्तु भगवान् जयध्वजमरिंदमम्। याजयामास भूतादिमादिदेवं जनार्दनम्
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly, thousands of householder saints performed penance in order to propitiate Isvara, in the holy forest of Daruvana (Pine forest).
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, thousands of householder saints performed penance in order to propitiate Isvara, in the holy forest of Daruvana (Pine forest).

verses.sanskrit: यस्माद् भवन्ति भूतानि यत्र संयान्ति संक्षयम् । सो ऽवतीर्णो महायोगी पुराणपुरुषो हरिः
verses.transliteration: yasmād bhavanti bhūtāni yatra saṃyānti saṃkṣayam / so 'vatīrṇo mahāyogī purāṇapuruṣo hariḥ
verses.translation: Then, once upon a time, a great drought insurmount¬ able due to its being of a long duration befell that country. It was very fierce and destructive of all living beings.
verses.hindi: तस्य यज्ञे महायोगी साक्षात् देवः स्वयं हरिः। आविरासीत् स भगवान् तददभुतमिवाभवत् सर्वपापविमुक्तात्मा विष्णुलोकं स गच्छति
verses.wordMeaning: Then, once upon a time, a great drought insurmount¬ able due to its being of a long duration befell that country. It was very fierce and destructive of all living beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then, once upon a time, a great drought insurmount¬ able due to its being of a long duration befell that country. It was very fierce and destructive of all living beings.

verses.sanskrit: न यत्र विद्यते नामजात्यादिपरिकल्पना । सत्तामात्रात्मरूपो ऽसौ विष्णुरंशेन जायते
verses.transliteration: na yatra vidyate nāmajātyādiparikalpanā / sattāmātrātmarūpo 'sau viṣṇuraṃśena jāyate
verses.translation: The sages who were overwhelmed with hunger, approached in a body to Gautama the storehouse of penance, and requested him for food for the sustenance of their lives.
verses.hindi: उनको (विश्वामित्रको) आया देखकर आश्चर्यचकित मनवाले राजा (जयध्वज)-ने सुन्दर आसनपर उन्हें बिठाया और भक्तिभावसे उनकी पूजा की तथा कहा-- भगवन्! आपको ही कृपासे मैंने युद्धमें भयंकर असुर दानवेश्वर विदेहको मार गिराया। आपके कहनेसे में संशयमुक्त होकर सत्यपराक्रमी विष्णुको शरणमें गया और उन्होंने मेरे ऊपर शुभ अनुग्रह किया। कमलदलके समान नेत्रवाले, परम ईशान विष्णुका में पूजन करूँगा,
verses.wordMeaning: The sages who were overwhelmed with hunger, approached in a body to Gautama the storehouse of penance, and requested him for food for the sustenance of their lives.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sages who were overwhelmed with hunger, approached in a body to Gautama the storehouse of penance, and requested him for food for the sustenance of their lives.

verses.sanskrit: यस्य सा जगतां माता शक्तिस्तद्धर्मधारिणी । माया भगवती लक्ष्मीः सो ऽवतीर्णो जनार्दनः
verses.transliteration: yasya sā jagatāṃ mātā śaktistaddharmadhāriṇī / māyā bhagavatī lakṣmīḥ so 'vatīrṇo janārdanaḥ
verses.translation: That sensible sage gave them ample sweet cooked food of various kind. The Brahmanas partook of the food with their minds free from hesitatiori.
verses.hindi: उन इश्वर हरिका किस विधानसे किस प्रकार पूजन किया जाना चाहिए। सुब्रत! ये नारायण देव कोन हैं? उनका क्या प्रभाव है? यह सब मुझे बतलाइये, मुझे (इस विषयमें) अत्यधिक कौतूहल है ॥ ६६--७०॥ विश्वामित्रने कहा --जिनसे सभी प्राणियोंकी प्रवृत्ति होती है और जिनमें यह सम्पूर्ण जगत् (प्रतिष्ठित) है, वे विष्णु सभी प्राणियोंके आत्मरूप हैं, उनका आश्रय ग्रहण करनेसे मुक्ति प्राप्त होती है। अपने-अपने वर्ण
verses.wordMeaning: That sensible sage gave them ample sweet cooked food of various kind. The Brahmanas partook of the food with their minds free from hesitatiori.
verses.commentary: Sense: That sensible sage gave them ample sweet cooked food of various kind. The Brahmanas partook of the food with their minds free from hesitatiori.

verses.sanskrit: यस्य सा तामसी मूर्तिः शङ्करो राजसी तनुः । ब्रह्मा संजायते विष्णुरंशेनैकेन सत्त्वभृत्
verses.transliteration: yasya sā tāmasī mūrtiḥ śaṅkaro rājasī tanuḥ / brahmā saṃjāyate viṣṇuraṃśenaikena sattvabhṛt
verses.translation: When the twelfth year elapsed as if the end of the world was over (and new order prevailed) bringing happiness and welfare to the world, the whole of the universe became as it was before (regained its previous stage).
verses.hindi: और आश्रमधर्ममें स्थित रहते हुए केवल निष्कामभावसे उन पुरुषोत्तम (विष्णु)-का पूजन करना चाहिए अन्य किसी भावसे नहीं इतना कहकर महामुनि भगवान् विश्वामित्र उन शूरसेन आदिके द्वारा पूजित होकर अपने निवास- स्थानको चले गये। तदनन्तर शूरसेन आदिने यज्ञके द्वारा कामनारहित होकर यज्ञ-गम्य उन अव्यय रुद्रदेव
verses.wordMeaning: When the twelfth year elapsed as if the end of the world was over (and new order prevailed) bringing happiness and welfare to the world, the whole of the universe became as it was before (regained its previous stage).
verses.commentary: Sense: When the twelfth year elapsed as if the end of the world was over (and new order prevailed) bringing happiness and welfare to the world, the whole of the universe became as it was before (regained its previous stage).

verses.sanskrit: इत्थं विचिन्त्य गोविन्दं भक्तिनम्रेण चेतसा । तमेव गच्छ शरणं ततो यास्यसि निर्वृतिम्
verses.transliteration: itthaṃ vicintya govindaṃ bhaktinamreṇa cetasā / tameva gaccha śaraṇaṃ tato yāsyasi nirvṛtim
verses.translation: Then all those leading sages took leave of one another. They said to the great sage Gautama—"We are going quickly."
verses.hindi: महेश्वरका यजन किया सर्वज्ञ भगवान् वसिष्ठ तथा रुद्रभक्त, गौतम, अत्रि तथा आगस्त्यने उन लोगोंका यज्ञ कराया। भगवान् बिश्वामित्रने शत्रुओंका दमन करनेवाले जयध्वजसे प्राणियोंके आदि कारण आदिदेव जनार्दन-सम्बन्धी
verses.wordMeaning: Then all those leading sages took leave of one another. They said to the great sage Gautama—"We are going quickly."
verses.commentary: Sense: Then all those leading sages took leave of one another. They said to the great sage Gautama—"We are going quickly."

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रह्लादवचनाद् बलिर्वैरोचनिर्हरिम् । जगाम शरणं विश्वं पालयामास धर्मतः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prahlādavacanād balirvairocanirharim / jagāma śaraṇaṃ viśvaṃ pālayāmāsa dharmataḥ
verses.translation: He prevented them by saying thus, "O Scholars 1 Be pleased to stay comfortably at your pleasure in my house for some more time and you may go at your leisure."
verses.hindi: (विष्णु) यज्ञ कराया। उस (जयध्वज)-के यञ्ञमें महायोगी देव स्वयं भगवान् हरि साक्षात् प्रकट हुए। यह जो जयध्वजके इस पराक्रमको नित्य सुनेगा, वह सभी पापोंसे मुक्त होकर विष्णुलोकको प्राप्त करेगा
verses.wordMeaning: He prevented them by saying thus, "O Scholars 1 Be pleased to stay comfortably at your pleasure in my house for some more time and you may go at your leisure."
verses.commentary: Sense: He prevented them by saying thus, "O Scholars 1 Be pleased to stay comfortably at your pleasure in my house for some more time and you may go at your leisure."

verses.sanskrit: काले प्राप्ते महाविष्णुं देवानां हर्षवर्धनम् । असूत कश्यपाच्चैनं देवमातादितिः स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: kāle prāpte mahāviṣṇuṃ devānāṃ harṣavardhanam / asūta kaśyapāccainaṃ devamātāditiḥ svayam
verses.translation: Then all of them created an illusory black cow and took it near the noble-souled Gautama.
verses.hindi: जयध्वजके बंश-वर्णनमें राजा दुर्जयका आख्यान, महामुनि कण्वद्वारा दुर्जयको वाराणसीके विश्वेश्वर-लिंगका माहात्म्य बतलाना, दुर्जयका वाराणसी जाकर पाप-मुक्त होना तथा सहस्त्रजित्-वंशका वर्णन शतपुत्रास्तु तस्यासन् तालजङ्घाः प्रकीर्तिताः
verses.wordMeaning: Then all of them created an illusory black cow and took it near the noble-souled Gautama.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then all of them created an illusory black cow and took it near the noble-souled Gautama.

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्भुजं विशालाक्षं श्रीवत्साङ्कितवक्षसम् । नीलमेघप्रतीकाशं भ्राजमानं श्रियावृतम्
verses.transliteration: caturbhujaṃ viśālākṣaṃ śrīvatsāṅkitavakṣasam / nīlameghapratīkāśaṃ bhrājamānaṃ śriyāvṛtam
verses.translation: On observing it, the sage was overwhelmed with
verses.hindi: वृषप्रभृतयश्चान्ये यादवाः पुण्यकर्मिणः वृषो वंशकरस्तेषां तस्य पुत्रोऽभवन्मधुः । मधोः पुत्रशतं त्वासीद् वृषणस्तस्य वंशभाक्
verses.wordMeaning: On observing it, the sage was overwhelmed with
verses.commentary: Sense: On observing it, the sage was overwhelmed with

verses.sanskrit: उपतस्थुः सुराः सर्वे सिद्धाः साध्याश्च चारणाः । उपेन्द्रमिन्द्रप्रमुखा ब्रह्मा चर्षिगमैर्वृतः
verses.transliteration: upatasthuḥ surāḥ sarve siddhāḥ sādhyāśca cāraṇāḥ / upendramindrapramukhā brahmā carṣigamairvṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Extremely distressed with grief, the great sage could not understand what should be done and what should not be done. The other sages spoke to that sage.
verses.hindi: पतिब्रतासीत् पतिना स्वधर्मपरिपालिका स कदाचिन्महाभागः कालिन्दीतीरसंस्थिताम्। अपश्यदुर्वशीं देवीं गायन्तीं मधुरस्वनाम्
verses.wordMeaning: Extremely distressed with grief, the great sage could not understand what should be done and what should not be done. The other sages spoke to that sage.
verses.commentary: Sense: Extremely distressed with grief, the great sage could not understand what should be done and what should not be done. The other sages spoke to that sage.

verses.sanskrit: कृतोपनयनो वेदानध्यैष्ट भगवान् हरिः । समाचारं भरद्वाजात् त्रिलोकाय प्रदर्शयन्
verses.transliteration: kṛtopanayano vedānadhyaiṣṭa bhagavān hariḥ / samācāraṃ bharadvājāt trilokāya pradarśayan
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmana, as long as the sin of the slaughter of the cow sticks to your person, food served by you should not be eaten. We are, therefore, going away.
verses.hindi: ततः कामाहतमनास्तत्समीपमुपेत्य वै। प्रोवाच सुचिरं कालं देवि रन्तुं मयाहसि सा देवी नृपतिं दृष्ट्वा रूपलावण्यसंयुतम्। रेमे तेन चिरं कालं कामदेवमिवापरम्
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahmana, as long as the sin of the slaughter of the cow sticks to your person, food served by you should not be eaten. We are, therefore, going away.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmana, as long as the sin of the slaughter of the cow sticks to your person, food served by you should not be eaten. We are, therefore, going away.

verses.sanskrit: एवं हि लौकिकं मार्गं प्रदर्शयति स प्रभुः । स यत् प्रमाणं कुरुते लोकस्तदनुवर्तते
verses.transliteration: evaṃ hi laukikaṃ mārgaṃ pradarśayati sa prabhuḥ / sa yat pramāṇaṃ kurute lokastadanuvartate
verses.translation: On being permitted by him, they, being subject to this sin, went to the auspicious Devadaru Vana (Pine forest) in order perform penance as before.
verses.hindi: कालात् प्रबुद्धो राजा तामुर्वशीं प्राह शोभनाम्। गमिष्यामि पुरीं रम्यां हसन्ती साब्रवीद् वचः सूतजीने कहा--जयध्वजका एक पुत्र था जो तालजङ्घ नामसे प्रसिद्ध था। उसके सौ पुत्र हुए जो तालजङ्क ही कहलाते थे। उनमें वीतिहोत्र नामका महान् बलवान् राजा सबसे बड़ा था। दूसरे वृष इत्यादि
verses.wordMeaning: On being permitted by him, they, being subject to this sin, went to the auspicious Devadaru Vana (Pine forest) in order perform penance as before.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being permitted by him, they, being subject to this sin, went to the auspicious Devadaru Vana (Pine forest) in order perform penance as before.

verses.sanskrit: ततः कालेन मतिमान् बलिर्वैरोचनिः स्वयम् । यज्ञैर्यज्ञेश्वरं विष्णुमर्चयामास सर्वगम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kālena matimān balirvairocaniḥ svayam / yajñairyajñeśvaraṃ viṣṇumarcayāmāsa sarvagam
verses.translation: By some reason the sage Gautama came to know of their fraud of imputing the sin of killing the illusory cow and cursed them in great anger.
verses.hindi: नामवाले यादव पुण्यकर्मा थे। उनमें वृष वंशको बढ़ानेवाला था, उसका मधु नामक पुत्र हुआ। मधुके सौ पुत्र हुए, किंतु उनमें वृषण ही उस (मधु)-का वंशधर हुआ। वीतिहोत्रका भी विश्रुत अथवा अनन्त नामवाला एक पुत्र हुआ। उसका पुत्र दुर्जय हुआ जो सभी शास्त्रोंका ज्ञाता था। उसकी भार्या रूपवती तथा सभी गुणोंसे अलंकृत तथा पतिब्रता थी, वह पति दुर्जयके साथ अपने धर्मका पालन करती थी
verses.wordMeaning: By some reason the sage Gautama came to know of their fraud of imputing the sin of killing the illusory cow and cursed them in great anger.
verses.commentary: Sense: By some reason the sage Gautama came to know of their fraud of imputing the sin of killing the illusory cow and cursed them in great anger.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणान् पूजयामास दत्त्वा बहुतरं धनम् । ब्रह्मर्षयः समाजग्मुर्यज्ञवाटं महात्मनः
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇān pūjayāmāsa dattvā bahutaraṃ dhanam / brahmarṣayaḥ samājagmuryajñavāṭaṃ mahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: "They will be ineligible for the study of the three Vedas and be on a par with the great sinners. As a result of this curse, they will be born again and again."
verses.hindi: कालिन्दी नदीके किनारे बैठी हुई मधुर स्वरमें गीत गाती हुई देवी उर्वशीको देखा। तब कामके द्वारा विचलित मनवाला वह उसके समीपमें गया और कहने लगा-- देवि! चिरकालतक मेरे साथ रमण करो'। रूप और लावण्यसे सम्पन्न तथा दूसरे कामदेवके समान उस राजाको देखकर उस देवीने चिरकालतक उसके साथ
verses.wordMeaning: "They will be ineligible for the study of the three Vedas and be on a par with the great sinners. As a result of this curse, they will be born again and again."
verses.commentary: Sense: "They will be ineligible for the study of the three Vedas and be on a par with the great sinners. As a result of this curse, they will be born again and again."

verses.sanskrit: विज्ञाय विष्णुर्भगवान् भरद्वाजप्रचोदितः । आस्थाय वामनं रूपं यज्ञदेशमथागमत्
verses.transliteration: vijñāya viṣṇurbhagavān bharadvājapracoditaḥ / āsthāya vāmanaṃ rūpaṃ yajñadeśamathāgamat
verses.translation: Then, glancing a t Visnu who was staying by his side, the bull-bannered lord said—"What is to be done in regard to those people who desire to acquire merit?".
verses.hindi: बहुत समयके बाद ज्ञान होनेपर राजाने उस रमणीय उर्वशीसे कहा-- अब मैं अपनी सुन्दर पुरीको जाऊँगा।' इसपर वह हँसते हुए कहने लगी--राजसुन्दर! आपके साथ इतने उपभोगसे मुझे प्रसन्नता (संतुष्टि) नहीं हुई है, अतः पुनः एक वर्षतक यहाँ और ठहरें
verses.wordMeaning: Then, glancing a t Visnu who was staying by his side, the bull-bannered lord said—"What is to be done in regard to those people who desire to acquire merit?".
verses.commentary: Sense: Then, glancing a t Visnu who was staying by his side, the bull-bannered lord said—"What is to be done in regard to those people who desire to acquire merit?".

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णाजिनोपवीताङ्ग आषाढेन विराजितः । ब्राह्मणो जटिलो वेदानुद्गिरन् भस्ममण्डितः
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇājinopavītāṅga āṣāḍhena virājitaḥ / brāhmaṇo jaṭilo vedānudgiran bhasmamaṇḍitaḥ
verses.translation: After looking at the leading Brahmanas who had bowed down, lord Visnu, Hari, favourably disposed towards his devotees and worthy of being the refuge, spoke to Gopati (Lord of the Bull i.e. Siva).
verses.hindi: इसपर बुद्धिमान् (राजा)-ने उस (उर्वशी)-से कहा- में अपनी पुरीमें जाकर पुनः शीघ्र ही यहाँ वापस लौटूँगा, इसलिये मुझे जानेकी आज्ञा दो। उस सुभगाने उससे कहा-राजन्! वैसा ही कीजिये, किंतु तबतक आप पुनः किसी अन्य अप्सराके साथ रमण न करें। ' अच्छा' ऐसा कहकर वह शीघ्र ही परम शोभन अपनी पुरीको चला गया। (पुरीमें) जाकर अपनी पतिव्रता पत्नीको देखकर वह राजा भयभीत हो गया
verses.wordMeaning: After looking at the leading Brahmanas who had bowed down, lord Visnu, Hari, favourably disposed towards his devotees and worthy of being the refuge, spoke to Gopati (Lord of the Bull i.e. Siva).
verses.commentary: Sense: After looking at the leading Brahmanas who had bowed down, lord Visnu, Hari, favourably disposed towards his devotees and worthy of being the refuge, spoke to Gopati (Lord of the Bull i.e. Siva).

verses.sanskrit: संप्राप्यासुरराजस्य समीपं भिक्षुको हरिः । स्वपादैर्विमितं देशमयाचत बलिं त्रिभिः
verses.transliteration: saṃprāpyāsurarājasya samīpaṃ bhikṣuko hariḥ / svapādairvimitaṃ deśamayācata baliṃ tribhiḥ
verses.translation: "O Sankara! Not even particle of merit can go with (i.e. will be found in) a person excluded from the Vedas. For Dharma comes shining out of the Vedas.
verses.hindi: ति कूर्मपुराण के तद् ब्रूहि मे यथा तत्त्वं न राज्ञां कीर्तये त्विदम्
verses.wordMeaning: "O Sankara! Not even particle of merit can go with (i.e. will be found in) a person excluded from the Vedas. For Dharma comes shining out of the Vedas.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Sankara! Not even particle of merit can go with (i.e. will be found in) a person excluded from the Vedas. For Dharma comes shining out of the Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: प्रक्षाल्य चरणौ विष्णोर्बलिर्भासमन्वितः । आचामयित्वा भृङ्गारमादाय स्वर्णनिर्मितम्
verses.transliteration: prakṣālya caraṇau viṣṇorbalirbhāsamanvitaḥ / ācāmayitvā bhṛṅgāramādāya svarṇanirmitam
verses.translation: Still, O Mahesvara, all these people, though they head on to hells, should be saved by us, in view of our affection towards our devotees.
verses.hindi: स तस्या वाक्यमाकर्ण्य लज्जावनतचेतन: । नोवाच किंचित्नृपतिर्ज्ञानदूष्ट्या विवेद सा न भेतव्यं त्वया स्वामिन् कार्य पापविशोधनम्। भीते त्वयि महाराज राष्ट्रं ते नाशमेष्यति
verses.wordMeaning: Still, O Mahesvara, all these people, though they head on to hells, should be saved by us, in view of our affection towards our devotees.
verses.commentary: Sense: Still, O Mahesvara, all these people, though they head on to hells, should be saved by us, in view of our affection towards our devotees.

verses.sanskrit: दास्ये तवेदं भवते पदत्रयं प्रीणातु देवो हरिरव्ययाकृतिः । विचिन्त्य देवस्य कराग्रपल्लवे निपातयामास जलं सुशीतलम्
verses.transliteration: dāsye tavedaṃ bhavate padatrayaṃ prīṇātu devo hariravyayākṛtiḥ / vicintya devasya karāgrapallave nipātayāmāsa jalaṃ suśītalam
verses.translation: Still, O Mahesvara, all these people, though they head on to hells, should be saved by us, in view of our affection towards our devotees.
verses.hindi: तदा स राजा द्युतिमान् निर्गत्य तु पुरात् ततः । गत्वा कण्वाश्रमं पुण्यं दृष्ट्रा तत्र महामुनिम् सोऽतीव कामुको राजा गन्धर्वेणाथ तेन हि। चकार सुमहद् युद्धं मालामादातुमुद्यतः
verses.wordMeaning: Still, O Mahesvara, all these people, though they head on to hells, should be saved by us, in view of our affection towards our devotees.
verses.commentary: Sense: Still, O Mahesvara, all these people, though they head on to hells, should be saved by us, in view of our affection towards our devotees.

verses.sanskrit: विचक्रमे पृथिवीमेष एता- मथान्तरिक्षं दिवमादिदेवः । व्यपेतरागं दितिजेश्वरं तं प्रकर्तुकामः शरणं प्रपन्नम्
verses.transliteration: vicakrame pṛthivīmeṣa etā- mathāntarikṣaṃ divamādidevaḥ / vyapetarāgaṃ ditijeśvaraṃ taṃ prakartukāmaḥ śaraṇaṃ prapannam
verses.translation: Still, O Mahesvara, all these people, though they head on to hells, should be saved by us, in view of our affection towards our devotees.
verses.hindi: जगाम तामप्सरसं कालिन्दीं द्रष्टमादरात् अदृष्टाप्सरसं तत्र कामबाणाभिपीडितः । बभ्राम सकलां पृथ्वी सप्तद्वीपसमन्विताम्
verses.wordMeaning: Still, O Mahesvara, all these people, though they head on to hells, should be saved by us, in view of our affection towards our devotees.
verses.commentary: Sense: Still, O Mahesvara, all these people, though they head on to hells, should be saved by us, in view of our affection towards our devotees.

verses.sanskrit: आक्रम्य लोकत्रयमीशपादः प्राजापत्याद् ब्रह्मलोकं जगाम । प्रणेमुरादित्यसहस्त्रकल्पं ये तत्र लोके निवसन्ति सिद्धाः
verses.transliteration: ākramya lokatrayamīśapādaḥ prājāpatyād brahmalokaṃ jagāma / praṇemurādityasahastrakalpaṃ ye tatra loke nivasanti siddhāḥ
verses.translation: Still, O Mahesvara, all these people, though they head on to hells, should be saved by us, in view of our affection towards our devotees.
verses.hindi: कामं संदधिरे घोरं भूषितं चित्रमालया उस राजाको पीन पयोधरोंवाली उस गुणवती तथा पतिव्रता भार्याने डरे हुए (पति)-को देखकर प्रसन्न वाणीसे कहा--स्वामिन्! आज आप डर क्यों रहे हैं, जो भी बात हो मुझे सत्य-सत्य बतलायें । इस प्रकारका भय
verses.wordMeaning: Still, O Mahesvara, all these people, though they head on to hells, should be saved by us, in view of our affection towards our devotees.
verses.commentary: Sense: Still, O Mahesvara, all these people, though they head on to hells, should be saved by us, in view of our affection towards our devotees.

verses.sanskrit: अथोपतस्थे भगवाननादिः पितामहास्तोषयामास विष्णुम् । भित्त्वा तदण्डस्य कपालमूर्ध्वं जगाम दिव्यावरणानि भूयः
verses.transliteration: athopatasthe bhagavānanādiḥ pitāmahāstoṣayāmāsa viṣṇum / bhittvā tadaṇḍasya kapālamūrdhvaṃ jagāma divyāvaraṇāni bhūyaḥ
verses.translation: Still, O Mahesvara, all these people, though they head on to hells, should be saved by us, in view of our affection towards our devotees.
verses.hindi: राजाओंके लिये कीर्तिकर नहीं है उसकी बात सुनकर उस (राजा)-का मन लज्जासे झुक गया। राजा कुछ भी नहीं बोला, किंतु उस (रानी)-ने ज्ञानदृष्टिसे (सब कुछ) जान लिया। (वह बोली ) स्वामिन्! आपको डरना नहीं चाहिए। पापका
verses.wordMeaning: Still, O Mahesvara, all these people, though they head on to hells, should be saved by us, in view of our affection towards our devotees.
verses.commentary: Sense: Still, O Mahesvara, all these people, though they head on to hells, should be saved by us, in view of our affection towards our devotees.

verses.sanskrit: अथाण्डभेदान्निपपात शीतलं महाजलं तत् पुण्यकृद्भिश्चजुष्टम् । प्रवर्तते चापि सरिद्वरा तदा गङ्गेत्युक्ता ब्रह्मणा व्योमसंस्था
verses.transliteration: athāṇḍabhedānnipapāta śītalaṃ mahājalaṃ tat puṇyakṛdbhiścajuṣṭam / pravartate cāpi saridvarā tadā gaṅgetyuktā brahmaṇā vyomasaṃsthā
verses.translation: Still, O Mahesvara, all these people, though they head on to hells, should be saved by us, in view of our affection towards our devotees.
verses.hindi: प्रायश्चित्त (शोधन) करना चाहिए। है महाराज! आपके भयभीत रहनेसे आपका राष्ट्र नष्ट हो जायगा तब वह द्युतिमान् राजा अपने नगरसे बाहर निकलकर पित्र कण्वके आश्रममें गया। वहाँ महामुनि (कण्व)-का दर्शनकर तथा कण्वके मुखसे प्रायश्चित्तकी कल्याणकारी विधि सुनकर प्रायश्चित्तके द्वारा आत्मशुद्धिके
verses.wordMeaning: Still, O Mahesvara, all these people, though they head on to hells, should be saved by us, in view of our affection towards our devotees.
verses.commentary: Sense: Still, O Mahesvara, all these people, though they head on to hells, should be saved by us, in view of our affection towards our devotees.

verses.sanskrit: गत्वा महान्तं प्रकृतिं प्रधानं ब्रह्माणमेकं पुरुषं स्वबीजम् । अतिष्ठदीशस्य पदं तदव्ययं दृष्ट्वा देवास्तत्र तत्र स्तुवन्ति
verses.transliteration: gatvā mahāntaṃ prakṛtiṃ pradhānaṃ brahmāṇamekaṃ puruṣaṃ svabījam / atiṣṭhadīśasya padaṃ tadavyayaṃ dṛṣṭvā devāstatra tatra stuvanti
verses.translation: Still, O Mahesvara, all these people, though they head on to hells, should be saved by us, in view of our affection towards our devotees.
verses.hindi: उद्देश्यसे वह महाबलवान् (राजा दुर्जय) हिमालय पर्वतको ओर गया। उस राजेन््रने मार्गमें (जाते समय) आकाशमें अपने तेजसे प्रकाशित होते हुए गन्धर्वश्रेष्ठींमें उत्तम एक गन्धर्वको देखा, जो दिव्य मालासे विभूषित था । मालाको देखकर शत्रुओंका विनाश करनेवाले (उस राजाको) श्रेष्ठ अप्सरा उर्वशीका स्मरण हो आया। उसने मनमें विचार किया कि यह (माला) तो उस (उर्वशी)- के ही योग्य है॥ १८--२१ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Still, O Mahesvara, all these people, though they head on to hells, should be saved by us, in view of our affection towards our devotees.
verses.commentary: Sense: Still, O Mahesvara, all these people, though they head on to hells, should be saved by us, in view of our affection towards our devotees.

verses.sanskrit: आलोक्य तं पुरुषं विश्वकायं महान् बलिर्भक्तियोगेन विष्णुम् । ननाम नारायणमेकमव्ययं स्वचेतसा यं प्रणमन्ति देवाः
verses.transliteration: ālokya taṃ puruṣaṃ viśvakāyaṃ mahān balirbhaktiyogena viṣṇum / nanāma nārāyaṇamekamavyayaṃ svacetasā yaṃ praṇamanti devāḥ
verses.translation: Still, O Mahesvara, all these people, though they head on to hells, should be saved by us, in view of our affection towards our devotees.
verses.hindi: तब माला प्राप्त करनेको उद्यत उस अत्यन्त कामुक राजाने उस गन्धर्वके साथ महान् युद्ध किया। ब्राह्मणो! युद्धमें गन्धर्वोको जीतकर और माला लेकर वह दुर्जय उस अप्सराको देखनेके लिये आदरपूर्वक कालिन्दीके किनारे गया। वहाँ अप्सराको न देखकर कामदेवके बाणसे अत्यन्त पीडित वह सात द्वीपोंसे युक्त सम्पूर्ण पृथ्वीपर घूमने लगा। उर्वशीके दर्शनके लिये उत्सुक वह हिमालयके पार्भागको पारकर उस श्रेष्ठ पर्वतपर
verses.wordMeaning: Still, O Mahesvara, all these people, though they head on to hells, should be saved by us, in view of our affection towards our devotees.
verses.commentary: Sense: Still, O Mahesvara, all these people, though they head on to hells, should be saved by us, in view of our affection towards our devotees.

verses.sanskrit: तमब्रवीद् भगवानादिकर्ता भूत्वा पुनर्वामनो वासुदेवः । ममैव दैत्याधिपते ऽधुनेदं लोकत्रयं भवता भावदत्तम्
verses.transliteration: tamabravīd bhagavānādikartā bhūtvā punarvāmano vāsudevaḥ / mamaiva daityādhipate 'dhunedaṃ lokatrayaṃ bhavatā bhāvadattam
verses.translation: Still, O Mahesvara, all these people, though they head on to hells, should be saved by us, in view of our affection towards our devotees.
verses.hindi: पहुँचा जो 'हेमकूट' नामसे विख्यात है॥ २२--२५॥ वहाँ उन-उन स्थानोंमें रहनेवाली वे श्रेष्ठ अप्सराएं उस विचित्र मालासे विभूषित एवं सिंहके समान पराक्रमवाले राजाको देखकर अत्यन्त कामासक्त हो गयीं। उर्वशीके वाक्यका स्मरण करते हुए और उसीमें आसक्त मनवाले
verses.wordMeaning: Still, O Mahesvara, all these people, though they head on to hells, should be saved by us, in view of our affection towards our devotees.
verses.commentary: Sense: Still, O Mahesvara, all these people, though they head on to hells, should be saved by us, in view of our affection towards our devotees.

verses.sanskrit: प्रणम्य मूर्ध्ना पुनरेव दैत्यो निपातयामास जलं कराग्रे । दास्ये तवात्मानमनन्तधाम्ने त्रिविक्रमायामितविक्रमाय
verses.transliteration: praṇamya mūrdhnā punareva daityo nipātayāmāsa jalaṃ karāgre / dāsye tavātmānamanantadhāmne trivikramāyāmitavikramāya
verses.translation: Still, O Mahesvara, all these people, though they head on to hells, should be saved by us, in view of our affection towards our devotees.
verses.hindi: उस राजाने उन सभी (अप्सराओं)-को नहीं देखा और वह पर्वतोंके शिखरोंपर चला गया तत्राप्यप्सरसं दिव्यामदृष्टा कामपीडितः। देवलोकं महामेरुं ययौ देवपराक्रमः
verses.wordMeaning: Still, O Mahesvara, all these people, though they head on to hells, should be saved by us, in view of our affection towards our devotees.
verses.commentary: Sense: Still, O Mahesvara, all these people, though they head on to hells, should be saved by us, in view of our affection towards our devotees.

verses.sanskrit: प्रगृह्य सूनोरपि संप्रदत्तं प्रह्लादसूनोरथ शङ्खपाणिः । जगाद दैत्यं जगदन्तरात्मा पातालमूलं प्रविशेति भूयः
verses.transliteration: pragṛhya sūnorapi saṃpradattaṃ prahlādasūnoratha śaṅkhapāṇiḥ / jagāda daityaṃ jagadantarātmā pātālamūlaṃ praviśeti bhūyaḥ
verses.translation: Still, O Mahesvara, all these people, though they head on to hells, should be saved by us, in view of our affection towards our devotees.
verses.hindi: स तत्र मानसं नाम सरस्त्रैलोक्यविश्रुतम्। भेजे शृङ्गाण्यतिक्रम्य स्वबाहुबलभावितः स मालया तदा देवीं भूषितां प्रेक्ष्य मोहितः । रेमे कृतार्थमात्मानं जानानः सुचिरं तया
verses.wordMeaning: Still, O Mahesvara, all these people, though they head on to hells, should be saved by us, in view of our affection towards our devotees.
verses.commentary: Sense: Still, O Mahesvara, all these people, though they head on to hells, should be saved by us, in view of our affection towards our devotees.

verses.sanskrit: समास्यतां भवता तत्र नित्यं भुक्त्वा भोगान् देवतानामलभ्यान् । ध्यायस्व मां सततं भक्तियोगात् प्रवेक्ष्यसे कल्पदाहे पुनर्माम्
verses.transliteration: samāsyatāṃ bhavatā tatra nityaṃ bhuktvā bhogān devatānāmalabhyān / dhyāyasva māṃ satataṃ bhaktiyogāt pravekṣyase kalpadāhe punarmām
verses.translation: Still, O Mahesvara, all these people, though they head on to hells, should be saved by us, in view of our affection towards our devotees.
verses.hindi: तदोर्वशी कामरूपा राज्ञे स्वं रूपमुत्कटम्। सरोमशं पिङ्गलाक्षं दर्शयामास सर्वदा धिङ्मामिति विनिश्चित्य तपः कर्तु समारभत्
verses.wordMeaning: Still, O Mahesvara, all these people, though they head on to hells, should be saved by us, in view of our affection towards our devotees.
verses.commentary: Sense: Still, O Mahesvara, all these people, though they head on to hells, should be saved by us, in view of our affection towards our devotees.

verses.sanskrit: उक्त्वैवं दैत्यसिंहं तं विष्णुः सत्यपराक्रमः । पुरन्दराय त्रैलोक्यं ददौ विष्णुरुरुक्रमः
verses.transliteration: uktvaivaṃ daityasiṃhaṃ taṃ viṣṇuḥ satyaparākramaḥ / purandarāya trailokyaṃ dadau viṣṇururukramaḥ
verses.translation: Still, O Mahesvara, all these people, though they head on to hells, should be saved by us, in view of our affection towards our devotees.
verses.hindi: वीक्ष्य तं राजशार्दूलं प्रसन्नो भगवानृषिः। कर्तुकामो हि निर्बीजं तस्याघमिदमब्रवीत् वहाँ भी दिव्य अप्सरा (उर्वशी)-को न देखकर
verses.wordMeaning: Still, O Mahesvara, all these people, though they head on to hells, should be saved by us, in view of our affection towards our devotees.
verses.commentary: Sense: Still, O Mahesvara, all these people, though they head on to hells, should be saved by us, in view of our affection towards our devotees.

verses.sanskrit: संस्तुवन्ति महायोगं सिद्धा देवर्षिकिन्नराः । ब्रह्मा शक्रो ऽथ भगवान् रुद्रादित्यमरुद्गणाः
verses.transliteration: saṃstuvanti mahāyogaṃ siddhā devarṣikinnarāḥ / brahmā śakro 'tha bhagavān rudrādityamarudgaṇāḥ
verses.translation: Still, O Mahesvara, all these people, though they head on to hells, should be saved by us, in view of our affection towards our devotees.
verses.hindi: प्रभावसे गिरिशिखरोंको पार करता हुआ वह तीनों लोकोंमें विख्यात “मानस” नामक सरोवरपर पहुँचा। उसने उसके (मानसरोवरके) किनारेपर विचरण करती को देखा और वह माला उसे दे दी॥ २८--३०॥
verses.wordMeaning: Still, O Mahesvara, all these people, though they head on to hells, should be saved by us, in view of our affection towards our devotees.
verses.commentary: Sense: Still, O Mahesvara, all these people, though they head on to hells, should be saved by us, in view of our affection towards our devotees.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वैतदद्भुतं कर्म विष्णुर्वामनरूपधृक् । पश्यतामेव सर्वेषां तत्रैवान्तरधीयत
verses.transliteration: kṛtvaitadadbhutaṃ karma viṣṇurvāmanarūpadhṛk / paśyatāmeva sarveṣāṃ tatraivāntaradhīyata
verses.translation: Still, O Mahesvara, all these people, though they head on to hells, should be saved by us, in view of our affection towards our devotees.
verses.hindi: तब उस देवीको मालासे विभूषित देखकर वह मोहित हो गया तथा अपनेको कृतार्थ समझते हुए उसने चिरकालतक उसके साथ रमण किया। अनन्तर उर्वशीने श्रेष्ठ राजासे कहा-राजन्! आपने पहले पुरीमें जाकर क्या किया, व्यर्थ ही आप वहाँ गये
verses.wordMeaning: Still, O Mahesvara, all these people, though they head on to hells, should be saved by us, in view of our affection towards our devotees.
verses.commentary: Sense: Still, O Mahesvara, all these people, though they head on to hells, should be saved by us, in view of our affection towards our devotees.

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽपि दैत्यवरः श्रीमान् पातालं प्राप चोदितः । प्रह्लादेनासुरवरैर्विष्णुना विष्णुतत्परः
verses.transliteration: so 'pi daityavaraḥ śrīmān pātālaṃ prāpa coditaḥ / prahlādenāsuravarairviṣṇunā viṣṇutatparaḥ
verses.translation: Still, O Mahesvara, all these people, though they head on to hells, should be saved by us, in view of our affection towards our devotees.
verses.hindi: तब उसने पत्रीद्वारा कही गयी वह बात, कण्व ऋषिका दर्शन तथा मालाका अपहरण--सभी कुछ उसे बता दिया उसके द्वारा कही गयी इन बातोंको सुनकर
verses.wordMeaning: Still, O Mahesvara, all these people, though they head on to hells, should be saved by us, in view of our affection towards our devotees.
verses.commentary: Sense: Still, O Mahesvara, all these people, though they head on to hells, should be saved by us, in view of our affection towards our devotees.

verses.sanskrit: अपृच्छद् विष्णुमाहात्मयं भक्तियोगमनुत्तमम् । पूजाविधानं प्रह्लादं तदाहासौ चकार सः
verses.transliteration: apṛcchad viṣṇumāhātmayaṃ bhaktiyogamanuttamam / pūjāvidhānaṃ prahlādaṃ tadāhāsau cakāra saḥ
verses.translation: Still, O Mahesvara, all these people, though they head on to hells, should be saved by us, in view of our affection towards our devotees.
verses.hindi: ऐसा कहा। अन्यथा आपको कण्व शाप दे देंगे और आपकी प्रिया भी मुझे शाप दे देगी। बार-बार उसके कहनेपर भी (कामरूपी) मदसे मोहित हुए महाराजने उसका साथ नहीं छोड़ा, उसमें ही मन तदनन्तर इच्छानुसार रूप धारण कर लेनेवाली उर्वशी राजाको रोमोंसे युक्त, पिङ्गल वर्णके नेत्रोंवाला अपना उत्कट रूप सदा दिखलाने लगी। (उसका वह वीभत्स रूप देखकर) उसके प्रति विरक्त मनवाले
verses.wordMeaning: Still, O Mahesvara, all these people, though they head on to hells, should be saved by us, in view of our affection towards our devotees.
verses.commentary: Sense: Still, O Mahesvara, all these people, though they head on to hells, should be saved by us, in view of our affection towards our devotees.

verses.sanskrit: अथ रथचरणासिशङ्खपाणिं सरसिजोलचनमीशमप्रमेयम् । शरणमुपपयौ स भावयोगात् प्रणतगतिं प्रणिधाय कर्मयोगम्
verses.transliteration: atha rathacaraṇāsiśaṅkhapāṇiṃ sarasijolacanamīśamaprameyam / śaraṇamupapayau sa bhāvayogāt praṇatagatiṃ praṇidhāya karmayogam
verses.translation: Still, O Mahesvara, all these people, though they head on to hells, should be saved by us, in view of our affection towards our devotees.
verses.hindi: राजाने कण्व (मुनि)-द्वारा कही गयी बातका स्मरणकर 'मुझे धिक्कार है' ऐसा निश्चयकर तप करना प्रारम्भ किया। राजाने बारह वर्षतक कन्द-मूल और फलका आहार किया और पुनः बारह वर्षोतक केवल वायुका कण्वके आश्रममें जाकर राजाने डरते-डरते अप्सराके साथ निवास करने और पुनः उत्तम तपस्या करनेकी सारी बातें उन्हें बता दीं। उस श्रेष्ठ राजाको देखकर प्रसन्न हुए भगवान् ऋषि (कण्व)-ने उसके पापको समूल नष्ट
verses.wordMeaning: Still, O Mahesvara, all these people, though they head on to hells, should be saved by us, in view of our affection towards our devotees.
verses.commentary: Sense: Still, O Mahesvara, all these people, though they head on to hells, should be saved by us, in view of our affection towards our devotees.

verses.sanskrit: एष वः कथितो विप्रा वामनस्य पराक्रमः । स देवकार्याणि सदा करोति पुरुषोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: eṣa vaḥ kathito viprā vāmanasya parākramaḥ / sa devakāryāṇi sadā karoti puruṣottamaḥ
verses.translation: Still, O Mahesvara, all these people, though they head on to hells, should be saved by us, in view of our affection towards our devotees.
verses.hindi: करनेकी इच्छासे यह कहा- आस्ते मोचयितुं लोकं तत्र देवो महेश्वरः
verses.wordMeaning: Still, O Mahesvara, all these people, though they head on to hells, should be saved by us, in view of our affection towards our devotees.
verses.commentary: Sense: Still, O Mahesvara, all these people, though they head on to hells, should be saved by us, in view of our affection towards our devotees.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे षोडशो ऽध्याय बलेः पुत्रशतं त्वासीन्महाबलपराक्रमम् । तेषां प्रधानो द्युतिमान् बाणो नाम महाबलः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge ṣoḍaśo 'dhyāya baleḥ putraśataṃ tvāsīnmahābalaparākramam / teṣāṃ pradhāno dyutimān bāṇo nāma mahābalaḥ
verses.translation: Hence, O Bull-bannered lord, we shall compose scriptures for deluding the sinners and for saving those who are out of the pale of the Vedas."
verses.hindi: स्नात्वा संतर्प्य विधिवद् गड़ायां देवता: पितृन्। दृष्टा विश्वेश्वर लिङ्गं किल्बिषान्मोक्ष्यसेऽखिलात् वाराणस्यां हरं दृष्टा पापान्मुक्तोऽभवत् तत:
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, O Bull-bannered lord, we shall compose scriptures for deluding the sinners and for saving those who are out of the pale of the Vedas."
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, O Bull-bannered lord, we shall compose scriptures for deluding the sinners and for saving those who are out of the pale of the Vedas."

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽतीव शङ्करे भक्तो राजा राज्यमपालयत् । त्रैलोक्यं वशमानीय बाधयामास वासवम्
verses.transliteration: so 'tīva śaṅkare bhakto rājā rājyamapālayat / trailokyaṃ vaśamānīya bādhayāmāsa vāsavam
verses.translation: Thus addressed by Visnu, the slayer of Mura, Rudra composed, deluding Scriptures and Kesava too did the same, on being urged by Siva.
verses.hindi: याजयामास तं कण्वो याचितो घृणया मुनिः बभूव जातमात्रं तं राजानमुपतस्थिरे
verses.wordMeaning: Thus addressed by Visnu, the slayer of Mura, Rudra composed, deluding Scriptures and Kesava too did the same, on being urged by Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus addressed by Visnu, the slayer of Mura, Rudra composed, deluding Scriptures and Kesava too did the same, on being urged by Siva.

verses.sanskrit: ततः शक्रादयो देवा गत्वोचुः कृत्तिवाससम् । त्वदीयो बाधते ह्यस्मान् बाणो नाम महासुरः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ śakrādayo devā gatvocuḥ kṛttivāsasam / tvadīyo bādhate hyasmān bāṇo nāma mahāsuraḥ
verses.translation: They were the treatises of the cults of Kapala, Nakula, Varna, Bhairava, both of Western and Eastern variety, Pancaratra, Pasupata and thousands of other cults as well.
verses.hindi: उर्वश्यां च महावीर्याः सप्त देवसुतोपमाः । कन्या जगृहिरे सर्वा गन्धर्वदयिता द्विजाः बंशः पापहरो नृणां क्रोष्टोरपि निबोधत
verses.wordMeaning: They were the treatises of the cults of Kapala, Nakula, Varna, Bhairava, both of Western and Eastern variety, Pancaratra, Pasupata and thousands of other cults as well.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were the treatises of the cults of Kapala, Nakula, Varna, Bhairava, both of Western and Eastern variety, Pancaratra, Pasupata and thousands of other cults as well.
