verses.sanskrit: व्याहृतो दैवदैः सर्वैर्देवदेवो महेश्वरः । ददाह बाणस्य पुरं शरेणैकेन लीलया
verses.transliteration: vyāhṛto daivadaiḥ sarvairdevadevo maheśvaraḥ / dadāha bāṇasya puraṃ śareṇaikena līlayā
verses.translation: Only this Soul of the universe (Lord Siva), goddess Bhavani and Visnu know the Supreme Reality. I am verily desireless, quiescent, absolute and devoid of possession.
verses.hindi: कण्व बोले--(राजन्! तुम) ईश्वर जहाँ विशेषरूपसे निवास करते हैं, उस दिव्य वाराणसीपुरीमें जाओ। संसारको मुक्त करनेके लिये महेश्वर देव वहाँ रहते हैं। गङ्गामें स्नानकर विधिपूर्वक देवताओं एवं पितरोंका तर्पणकर विश्वेश्वर लिङ्गका दर्शन करनेसे तुम सम्पूर्ण पापोंसे मुक्त हो जाओगे
verses.wordMeaning: Only this Soul of the universe (Lord Siva), goddess Bhavani and Visnu know the Supreme Reality. I am verily desireless, quiescent, absolute and devoid of possession.
verses.commentary: Sense: Only this Soul of the universe (Lord Siva), goddess Bhavani and Visnu know the Supreme Reality. I am verily desireless, quiescent, absolute and devoid of possession.

verses.sanskrit: दह्यमाने पुरे तस्मिन् बाणो रुद्रं त्रिशूलिनम् । ययौ शरणमीशानं गोपतिं नीललोहितम्
verses.transliteration: dahyamāne pure tasmin bāṇo rudraṃ triśūlinam / yayau śaraṇamīśānaṃ gopatiṃ nīlalohitam
verses.translation: They call me Kesava and goddess Ambika as Laksmi. He is the creator and the dispenser of destiny. He is the cause as well as the effect.
verses.hindi: इसके बाद कण्वको सिरसे प्रणामकर और उनकी आज्ञा प्रातकर वह दुर्जय वाराणसीमें गया और भगवान् शंकरका दर्शनकर पापसे मुक्त हो गया (तदनन्तर वह) अपनी सुन्दर पुरीमें जाकर पृथ्वीका पालन करने लगा। प्रार्थना करनेपर कण्व मुनिने कृपा करके उसका यज्ञ कराया। उसका बुद्धिमान् पुत्र 'सुप्रतीक' इस नामसे विख्यात हुआ। उत्पन्न होते ही
verses.wordMeaning: They call me Kesava and goddess Ambika as Laksmi. He is the creator and the dispenser of destiny. He is the cause as well as the effect.
verses.commentary: Sense: They call me Kesava and goddess Ambika as Laksmi. He is the creator and the dispenser of destiny. He is the cause as well as the effect.

verses.sanskrit: मूर्धन्याधाय तल्लिङ्गं शांभवं भीतवर्जितः । निर्गत्य तु पुरात् तस्मात् तुष्टाव परमेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: mūrdhanyādhāya talliṅgaṃ śāṃbhavaṃ bhītavarjitaḥ / nirgatya tu purāt tasmāt tuṣṭāva parameśvaram
verses.translation: Visnu does himself and makes others do. He is the bestower of worldly pleasures and liberation as the fruits (of actions). He is the enjoyer and the incomprehensible and unmeasurable Purusa. He is the annihilator, assuming the form of Kala.
verses.hindi: उसे (लोगोंने) राजा मान लिया। ब्राह्मणो! उर्वशीसे देवपुत्रोंके समान महान् वीर्यवान् सात पुत्र हुए। उन्होंने गन्धर्वोको कन्याओंको अपनी पत्नी बनाया॥ ४४--४६॥ आप लोगोंसे (मैंने) यह मनुष्योंके पापको नष्ट करनेवाला सहस्रजित्का उत्तम वंश भलीभाँति बतलाया। अब क्रोष्टुके वंशको भी सुनें
verses.wordMeaning: Visnu does himself and makes others do. He is the bestower of worldly pleasures and liberation as the fruits (of actions). He is the enjoyer and the incomprehensible and unmeasurable Purusa. He is the annihilator, assuming the form of Kala.
verses.commentary: Sense: Visnu does himself and makes others do. He is the bestower of worldly pleasures and liberation as the fruits (of actions). He is the enjoyer and the incomprehensible and unmeasurable Purusa. He is the annihilator, assuming the form of Kala.

verses.sanskrit: संस्तुतो भगवानीशः शङ्करो नीललोहितः । गाणपत्येन बाणं तं योजयामास भावतः
verses.transliteration: saṃstuto bhagavānīśaḥ śaṅkaro nīlalohitaḥ / gāṇapatyena bāṇaṃ taṃ yojayāmāsa bhāvataḥ
verses.translation: He is the creator, protector, the pervading God, the soul of the universe, with faces in all directions. He is the indwelling soul of all, the immutable, all-pervader Yogin, Narayana, the undecaying Being.
verses.hindi: यदुवंश-वर्णनमें क्रोष्ट्रवंशी राजाओंका वृत्तान्त, राजा नवरथकी कथा, सात्त्वतवंश- वर्णनमें अक्रूरकी उत्पत्ति, राजा आनकदुन्दुभिका आख्यान, कंस एवं वसुदेब-देवकीकी उत्पत्ति, वसुदेवका बंश-वर्णन, देबकीके अन्य पुत्रोंकी उत्पत्ति, रोहिणीसे संकर्षण-बलराम तथा देवकीसे श्रीकृष्णका आविर्भाव,वासुदेव कृष्णका वंश-वर्णन
verses.wordMeaning: He is the creator, protector, the pervading God, the soul of the universe, with faces in all directions. He is the indwelling soul of all, the immutable, all-pervader Yogin, Narayana, the undecaying Being.
verses.commentary: Sense: He is the creator, protector, the pervading God, the soul of the universe, with faces in all directions. He is the indwelling soul of all, the immutable, all-pervader Yogin, Narayana, the undecaying Being.

verses.sanskrit: अथाभवन् दनोः पुत्रास्ताराद्या ह्यतिभीषणाः । तारस्तथा शम्बरश्च कपिलः शङ्करस्तथा । स्वर्भानुर्वृषपर्वा च प्राधान्येन प्रकीर्तिताः
verses.transliteration: athābhavan danoḥ putrāstārādyā hyatibhīṣaṇāḥ / tārastathā śambaraśca kapilaḥ śaṅkarastathā / svarbhānurvṛṣaparvā ca prādhānyena prakīrtitāḥ
verses.translation: Lord Visnu by his side and accompanied by the Chief leaders of Ganas, the son of Silada (i.e. Nandisvara) and the mothers, Lord Isa, Kala-Rudra went to fight.
verses.hindi: क्रोष्टोरेको ऽभवत् पुत्रो वृजिनीवानिति श्रुतिः । तस्य पुत्रो महान् स्वातिरुशदगुस्तत्सुतोऽभवत् अथ चैत्ररथिरलोके शशबिन्दुरिति स्मृतः
verses.wordMeaning: Lord Visnu by his side and accompanied by the Chief leaders of Ganas, the son of Silada (i.e. Nandisvara) and the mothers, Lord Isa, Kala-Rudra went to fight.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Visnu by his side and accompanied by the Chief leaders of Ganas, the son of Silada (i.e. Nandisvara) and the mothers, Lord Isa, Kala-Rudra went to fight.

verses.sanskrit: सुरसायाः सहस्त्रं तु सर्पाणामभवद् द्विजाः । अनेकशिरसां तद्वत् खेचराणां महात्मनाम्
verses.transliteration: surasāyāḥ sahastraṃ tu sarpāṇāmabhavad dvijāḥ / anekaśirasāṃ tadvat khecarāṇāṃ mahātmanām
verses.translation: * Seeing that the king of the chiefs of Ganas sur¬ rounded by the Lords of Ganas, had arrived, the enemy of gods (Andhaka) fought with god Indra, the 'mothers' and with the whole of army of Ganas as well as prominent immortals.
verses.hindi: तस्य पुत्रः पृथुयशा राजाभूद् धर्मतत्परः। पृथुकर्मा च तत्पुत्रस्तस्मात् पृथुजयोऽभवत् सूतजीने कहा--क्रोष्टुका एक पुत्र हुआ जो वृजिनीवान् नामसे प्रसिद्ध हुआ। उसका महान् पुत्र स्वाति हुआ और उसका पुत्र उशद्गु हुआ। उशद्गुका चित्ररथ नामका बलवान् पुत्र हुआ। चित्ररथका पुत्र लोकमें शशबिन्दु
verses.wordMeaning: * Seeing that the king of the chiefs of Ganas sur¬ rounded by the Lords of Ganas, had arrived, the enemy of gods (Andhaka) fought with god Indra, the 'mothers' and with the whole of army of Ganas as well as prominent immortals.
verses.commentary: Sense: * Seeing that the king of the chiefs of Ganas sur¬ rounded by the Lords of Ganas, had arrived, the enemy of gods (Andhaka) fought with god Indra, the 'mothers' and with the whole of army of Ganas as well as prominent immortals.

verses.sanskrit: अरिष्टा जनयामास गन्धर्वाणां सहस्त्रकम् । अनन्ताद्या महानागाः काद्रवेयाः प्रकीर्तिताः
verses.transliteration: ariṣṭā janayāmāsa gandharvāṇāṃ sahastrakam / anantādyā mahānāgāḥ kādraveyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ
verses.translation: After defeating all by means of the prowess of his arms in the battle, he (i.e. Andhaka), riding his own aerial car, came to the place where Siva of infinite splendour and Kalarudra
verses.hindi: नामसे विख्यात हुआ। उसका पृथुयशा नामवाला पुत्र धर्मपरायण राजा हुआ। उसका पुत्र पृथुकर्मा और उससे पृथुजय हुआ॥ १--३॥ पृथुकीर्तिरभूत् तस्मात् प॒थुदानस्ततोऽभवत्।
verses.wordMeaning: After defeating all by means of the prowess of his arms in the battle, he (i.e. Andhaka), riding his own aerial car, came to the place where Siva of infinite splendour and Kalarudra
verses.commentary: Sense: After defeating all by means of the prowess of his arms in the battle, he (i.e. Andhaka), riding his own aerial car, came to the place where Siva of infinite splendour and Kalarudra

verses.sanskrit: ताम्रा च जनयामास षट् कन्या द्विजपुङ्गवाः । शुकीं श्येनीं च भासीं च सुग्रीवाङ्गृध्रिकां शुचिम्
verses.transliteration: tāmrā ca janayāmāsa ṣaṭ kanyā dvijapuṅgavāḥ / śukīṃ śyenīṃ ca bhāsīṃ ca sugrīvāṅgṛdhrikāṃ śucim
verses.translation: On seeing Andhaka approaching, the Garuda-ban- nered Lord spoke to Bhairava, the great Lord besmeared with ashes as adornment.
verses.hindi: उससे पृथुकीर्ति और उससे पृथुदान हुआ। उसका पृथुश्रवास्तस्य पुत्रस्तस्यासीत् पृथुसत्तम:॥ ४ ॥  पुत्र पृथुश्रवा और उसका पुत्र था--पृथुसत्तम
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing Andhaka approaching, the Garuda-ban- nered Lord spoke to Bhairava, the great Lord besmeared with ashes as adornment.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing Andhaka approaching, the Garuda-ban- nered Lord spoke to Bhairava, the great Lord besmeared with ashes as adornment.

verses.sanskrit: गास्तथा जनयामास सुरभिर्महिषीस्तथा । इरा वृक्षलतावल्लीस्तृणजातीश्च सर्वशः
verses.transliteration: gāstathā janayāmāsa surabhirmahiṣīstathā / irā vṛkṣalatāvallīstṛṇajātīśca sarvaśaḥ
verses.translation: "O Lord, it behoves you to slay Andhaka the lord of Daityas and a thorn unto the worlds. Excepting you there is no one else who can kill him.
verses.hindi: परावृतः सुतो जज्ञे ज्यामघो लोकविश्रुतः । तस्माद् विदर्भः संजज्ञे विदर्भात् क्रथकैशिकौ वपुष्मतो बृहन्मेधा श्रीदेवस्तत्सुतोऽभवत्। तस्य वीतरथो विप्रा रुद्रभक्तो महाबल:
verses.wordMeaning: "O Lord, it behoves you to slay Andhaka the lord of Daityas and a thorn unto the worlds. Excepting you there is no one else who can kill him.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Lord, it behoves you to slay Andhaka the lord of Daityas and a thorn unto the worlds. Excepting you there is no one else who can kill him.

verses.sanskrit: खसा वै यक्षरक्षांसि मुनिरप्सरसस्तथा । रक्षोगणं क्रोधवशा जनयामास सत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: khasā vai yakṣarakṣāṃsi munirapsarasastathā / rakṣogaṇaṃ krodhavaśā janayāmāsa sattamāḥ
verses.translation: You are the annihilator of all worlds, the lordly person, the embodiment of Kala. You are being eulogised by means of various Mantras by those persons who know the Vedas."
verses.hindi: दानधर्मरतो नित्यं सम्यकृशीलपरायणः दुद्राव महताविष्टो भयेन मुनिपुंगवाः
verses.wordMeaning: You are the annihilator of all worlds, the lordly person, the embodiment of Kala. You are being eulogised by means of various Mantras by those persons who know the Vedas."
verses.commentary: Sense: You are the annihilator of all worlds, the lordly person, the embodiment of Kala. You are being eulogised by means of various Mantras by those persons who know the Vedas."

verses.sanskrit: विनतायाश्च पुत्रौ द्वौ प्रख्यातौ गरुडारुणौ । तयोश्च गरुडो धीमान् तपस्तप्त्वा सुदुश्चरम् । प्रसादाच्छूनिलः प्राप्तो वाहनत्वं हरेः स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: vinatāyāśca putrau dvau prakhyātau garuḍāruṇau / tayośca garuḍo dhīmān tapastaptvā suduścaram / prasādācchūnilaḥ prāpto vāhanatvaṃ hareḥ svayam
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Vasudeva, Lord Siva looked meaningfully at Visnu and determined in his mind to kill the lord of Daityas.
verses.hindi: दुर्योधनोऽग्रिसंकाशः शूलासक्तमहाकरः राजा नवरथो भीत्या नातिदूरादनुत्तमम्। अपश्यत् परमं स्थानं सरस्वत्या सुगोपितम्
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the words of Vasudeva, Lord Siva looked meaningfully at Visnu and determined in his mind to kill the lord of Daityas.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of Vasudeva, Lord Siva looked meaningfully at Visnu and determined in his mind to kill the lord of Daityas.

verses.sanskrit: आराध्य तपसा रुद्रं मह्देवं तथारुणः । सारथ्ये कल्पितः पूर्वं प्रीतेनार्कस्य शंभुना
verses.transliteration: ārādhya tapasā rudraṃ mahdevaṃ tathāruṇaḥ / sārathye kalpitaḥ pūrvaṃ prītenārkasya śaṃbhunā
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Vasudeva, Lord Siva looked meaningfully at Visnu and determined in his mind to kill the lord of Daityas.
verses.hindi: ववन्दे शिरसा दृष्टा साक्षाद देवी सरस्वतीम् हे श्रेष्ठ ब्राह्मणो! उस (पृथुसत्तम)-का पुत्र उशना हुआ और उसका सितेषु पुत्र हुआ। फिर उसका रुक्मकवच और उस (रुक्मकवच)-का परावृत् हुआ
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the words of Vasudeva, Lord Siva looked meaningfully at Visnu and determined in his mind to kill the lord of Daityas.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of Vasudeva, Lord Siva looked meaningfully at Visnu and determined in his mind to kill the lord of Daityas.

verses.sanskrit: एते कश्यपदायादाः कीर्तिताः स्थाणुजङ्गमाः । वैवस्वते ऽन्ते ह्यस्मिञ्छृण्वतां पापनाशनाः
verses.transliteration: ete kaśyapadāyādāḥ kīrtitāḥ sthāṇujaṅgamāḥ / vaivasvate 'nte hyasmiñchṛṇvatāṃ pāpanāśanāḥ
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Vasudeva, Lord Siva looked meaningfully at Visnu and determined in his mind to kill the lord of Daityas.
verses.hindi: परावृत्ने संसारमें विख्यात ज्यामघ नामक पुत्र उत्पन्न किया। उससे विदर्भ उत्पन्न हुआ और विदर्भसे क्रथ, कैशिक और तीसरा रोमपाद नामक पुत्र हुआ। उस (रोमपाद)-का पुत्र बभ्रु राजा था। धृति उसका पुत्र हुआ और उसका भी संस्त नामक पुत्र उत्पन्न हुआ। संस्तका विश्वसह नामवाला बलवान् पुत्र था। उसका पुत्र महान् पराक्रमी प्रजावान् और उसका पुत्र कौशिक हुआ। उस (कौशिक)-का बुद्धिमान् सुमन्तु नामक पुत्र
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the words of Vasudeva, Lord Siva looked meaningfully at Visnu and determined in his mind to kill the lord of Daityas.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of Vasudeva, Lord Siva looked meaningfully at Visnu and determined in his mind to kill the lord of Daityas.

verses.sanskrit: सप्तविंशत् सुताः प्रोक्ताः सोमपत्न्यश्च सुव्रताः । अरिष्टनेमिपत्नीनामपत्यानीह षोडश
verses.transliteration: saptaviṃśat sutāḥ proktāḥ somapatnyaśca suvratāḥ / ariṣṭanemipatnīnāmapatyānīha ṣoḍaśa
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Vasudeva, Lord Siva looked meaningfully at Visnu and determined in his mind to kill the lord of Daityas.
verses.hindi: था और उसका पुत्र अनल था। कैशिकका पुत्र चेदि था और उस चेदिके पुत्र चैद्य हुए। उन चैद्योंमें ज्योतिष्मान् प्रधान था और वपुष्मान् उसका पुत्र हुआ। वपुष्मान्से बृहन्मेधा और श्रीदेव उसका पुत्र हुआ। ब्राह्मणो! उसका वीतरथ नामक पुत्र महान् बलशाली और रुद्रका भक्त था
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the words of Vasudeva, Lord Siva looked meaningfully at Visnu and determined in his mind to kill the lord of Daityas.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of Vasudeva, Lord Siva looked meaningfully at Visnu and determined in his mind to kill the lord of Daityas.

verses.sanskrit: बहुपुत्रस्य विदुषश्चतस्त्रो विद्युतः स्मृताः । तद्वदङ्गिरसः पुत्रा ऋषयो ब्रह्मसत्कृताः
verses.transliteration: bahuputrasya viduṣaścatastro vidyutaḥ smṛtāḥ / tadvadaṅgirasaḥ putrā ṛṣayo brahmasatkṛtāḥ
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Vasudeva, Lord Siva looked meaningfully at Visnu and determined in his mind to kill the lord of Daityas.
verses.hindi: ब्राह्मणो ! क्रथका पुत्र कुन्ति और उसका पुत्र वृष्ण हुआ। वृष्णिसे निवृत्ति उत्पन्न हुआ और दशार्ह उसका पुत्र हुआ। दशार्हका पुत्र आरोह था और उसका जीमूत पुत्र हुआ। जीमूतका विकृति नामक बलवान् पुत्र शत्रु- वीरोंका नाशक था! उसका भीमरथ नामक पुत्र हुआ, उससे नवरथ हुआ, जो नित्य दानधर्ममें परायण तथा पूर्णरूपसे शील-सम्पन्न था॥ ११--१३॥
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the words of Vasudeva, Lord Siva looked meaningfully at Visnu and determined in his mind to kill the lord of Daityas.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of Vasudeva, Lord Siva looked meaningfully at Visnu and determined in his mind to kill the lord of Daityas.

verses.sanskrit: कुशाश्वस्य तु देवर्षेर्देवप्रहरणाः सुताः । एते युगसहस्त्रान्ते जायन्ते पुनरेव हि । मन्वन्तरेषु नियतं तुल्यैः कार्यैः स्वनामभिः
verses.transliteration: kuśāśvasya tu devarṣerdevapraharaṇāḥ sutāḥ / ete yugasahastrānte jāyante punareva hi / manvantareṣu niyataṃ tulyaiḥ kāryaiḥ svanāmabhiḥ
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Vasudeva, Lord Siva looked meaningfully at Visnu and determined in his mind to kill the lord of Daityas.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! किसी समय आखेटके लिये जाते हुए वह (नवरथ) एक बलवान् राक्षसको देखकर अत्यन्त भयभीत होकर भागने लगा। अग्निके समान प्रज्वलित वह महाबलवान् दुर्योधन नामक राक्षस क्रुद्ध होकर अपने विशाल हाथमें शूल लेकर उसके पीछे दौड़ा
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the words of Vasudeva, Lord Siva looked meaningfully at Visnu and determined in his mind to kill the lord of Daityas.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of Vasudeva, Lord Siva looked meaningfully at Visnu and determined in his mind to kill the lord of Daityas.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे सप्तदशो ऽध्यायः सूत उवाच एतानुत्पाद्य पुत्रांस्तु प्रजासंतानकारणात् । कश्यपो गोत्रकामस्तु चचार सुमहत् तपः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge saptadaśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca etānutpādya putrāṃstu prajāsaṃtānakāraṇāt / kaśyapo gotrakāmastu cacāra sumahat tapaḥ
verses.translation: He went to the army of Devas which increased the delight of the Ganas. All beings moving about in the firmament eulogised lord Bhairava thus.
verses.hindi: भयभीत राजा नवरथने समीपमें ही (देवी) सरस्वतीसे रक्षित एक परम श्रेष्ठ स्थान देखा। वह बुद्धिमान् राजा अति शीघ्र ही वहाँ पहुँचा और साक्षात् देवी सरस्वतीका दर्शन करके उसने सिर झुकाकर प्रणाम नमस्यामि महादेवीं साक्षाद देवीं सरस्वतीम्। वाग्देवतामनाद्यन्तामीश्वरीं ब्रह्मचारिणीम्
verses.wordMeaning: He went to the army of Devas which increased the delight of the Ganas. All beings moving about in the firmament eulogised lord Bhairava thus.
verses.commentary: Sense: He went to the army of Devas which increased the delight of the Ganas. All beings moving about in the firmament eulogised lord Bhairava thus.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य वै तपतो ऽत्यर्थं प्रादुर्भूतौ सुताविमौ । वत्सरश्चासितश्चैव तावुभौ ब्रह्मवादिनौ
verses.transliteration: tasya vai tapato 'tyarthaṃ prādurbhūtau sutāvimau / vatsaraścāsitaścaiva tāvubhau brahmavādinau
verses.translation: "Bevictorious O infinite Mahadeva, the embodiment of the eternal Kala. You are fire. You are omnipresent. You stay within all living beings.
verses.hindi: नमस्ये परमानन्दां चित्कलां ब्रह्मरूपिणीम्। पाहि मां परमेशानि भीतं शरणमागतम् एतस्मिन्नन्तरे क्रुद्धो राजानं राक्षसेश्वरः। हन्तुं समागतः स्थानं यत्र देवी सरस्वती
verses.wordMeaning: "Bevictorious O infinite Mahadeva, the embodiment of the eternal Kala. You are fire. You are omnipresent. You stay within all living beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Bevictorious O infinite Mahadeva, the embodiment of the eternal Kala. You are fire. You are omnipresent. You stay within all living beings.

verses.sanskrit: वत्सरान्नैध्रुवो जज्ञे रैभ्यश्च सुमहायशाः । रैभ्यस्य जज्ञिरे रैभ्याः पुत्रा द्युतिमतां वराः
verses.transliteration: vatsarānnaidhruvo jajñe raibhyaśca sumahāyaśāḥ / raibhyasya jajñire raibhyāḥ putrā dyutimatāṃ varāḥ
verses.translation: You are the annihilator as well as the maker of the worlds (v.l. you are the sacrifice and the Va$at-kard ). You are the creator. You are the unchanging Visnu, god Brahma and Mahadeva. You are the Supreme lustre and the greatest abode.
verses.hindi: त्रिलोकमातुस्तत्स्थानं शशाङ्कादित्यसंनिभम् ततः प्रणम्य हृष्टात्मा राजा नवरथः पराम्।
verses.wordMeaning: You are the annihilator as well as the maker of the worlds (v.l. you are the sacrifice and the Va$at-kard ). You are the creator. You are the unchanging Visnu, god Brahma and Mahadeva. You are the Supreme lustre and the greatest abode.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are the annihilator as well as the maker of the worlds (v.l. you are the sacrifice and the Va$at-kard ). You are the creator. You are the unchanging Visnu, god Brahma and Mahadeva. You are the Supreme lustre and the greatest abode.

verses.sanskrit: च्यवनस्य सुता पत्नी नैध्रुवस्य महात्मनः । सुमेधा जनयामास पुत्रान् वै कुण्डपायिनः
verses.transliteration: cyavanasya sutā patnī naidhruvasya mahātmanaḥ / sumedhā janayāmāsa putrān vai kuṇḍapāyinaḥ
verses.translation: You are OmAara incarnate, the Soul of Yoga, with three Vedas as your three eyes. You are the Lord of the universe endowed with Supreme potency. Be victorious, O infinite master of the world."
verses.hindi: स्थापयामास देवेशीं तत्र भक्तिसमन्वितः। ईजे च विविधैर्यज्ञेहोमैदेवी सरस्वतीम्
verses.wordMeaning: You are OmAara incarnate, the Soul of Yoga, with three Vedas as your three eyes. You are the Lord of the universe endowed with Supreme potency. Be victorious, O infinite master of the world."
verses.commentary: Sense: You are OmAara incarnate, the Soul of Yoga, with three Vedas as your three eyes. You are the Lord of the universe endowed with Supreme potency. Be victorious, O infinite master of the world."

verses.sanskrit: असितस्यैकपर्णायां ब्रह्मिष्ठः समपद्यत । नाम्ना वै देवलः पुत्रो योगाचार्यो महातपाः
verses.transliteration: asitasyaikaparṇāyāṃ brahmiṣṭhaḥ samapadyata / nāmnā vai devalaḥ putro yogācāryo mahātapāḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, this controller of the world Kalagni- rudra, the goal of the good, pierced Andhaka with the tips of his trident and danced.
verses.hindi: देव्या भक्तो महातेजाः शकुनिस्तस्य चात्मजः तस्मात् करम्भः सम्भूतो देवरातोऽभवत् ततः।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, this controller of the world Kalagni- rudra, the goal of the good, pierced Andhaka with the tips of his trident and danced.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, this controller of the world Kalagni- rudra, the goal of the good, pierced Andhaka with the tips of his trident and danced.

verses.sanskrit: शाण्डिल्यानां परः श्रीमान् सर्वतत्त्वार्थवित् सुधीः । प्रसादात् पार्वतीशस्य योगमुत्तममाप्तवान्
verses.transliteration: śāṇḍilyānāṃ paraḥ śrīmān sarvatattvārthavit sudhīḥ / prasādāt pārvatīśasya yogamuttamamāptavān
verses.translation: On seeing Andhaka transfixed to the trident, god Brahma and the groups of Devas bowed to Lord Bhairava, the releaser from worldly bondage.
verses.hindi: ईजे स चाश्वमेधेन देवक्षत्रश्च तत्सुतः अथांशोः सत्त्वतो नाम विष्णुभक्तः प्रतापवान्।
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing Andhaka transfixed to the trident, god Brahma and the groups of Devas bowed to Lord Bhairava, the releaser from worldly bondage.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing Andhaka transfixed to the trident, god Brahma and the groups of Devas bowed to Lord Bhairava, the releaser from worldly bondage.

verses.sanskrit: शाण्डिल्या नैध्रु वारैभ्यास्त्रयः पक्षास्तु काश्यपाः । नरप्रकृतयो विप्राः पुलस्त्यस्य वदामि वः
verses.transliteration: śāṇḍilyā naidhru vāraibhyāstrayaḥ pakṣāstu kāśyapāḥ / naraprakṛtayo viprāḥ pulastyasya vadāmi vaḥ
verses.translation: The sages and siddhas eulogised him. The Gandharvas and Kinnaras sang. The charming groups of celes¬ tial damsels danced in the sky.
verses.hindi: स नारदस्य वचनाद् वासुदेवार्चनान्वितम्। उस शत्रुजयीने हाथ जोडते हुए अभीष्ट स्तुतियोंद्वारा स्तुति की, वह भूमिपर दण्डवत् गिर पडा और कहा-- “मैं आपकी शरणमें आया हूँ। आप अनादि, अनन्त, ब्रह्मचारिणी, ईश्वरी, महादेवी, वाग्देवता साक्षात् देवी
verses.wordMeaning: The sages and siddhas eulogised him. The Gandharvas and Kinnaras sang. The charming groups of celes¬ tial damsels danced in the sky.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sages and siddhas eulogised him. The Gandharvas and Kinnaras sang. The charming groups of celes¬ tial damsels danced in the sky.

verses.sanskrit: तृणबिन्दोः सुता विप्रा नाम्ना त्विलविला स्मृता । पुलस्त्याय स राजर्षिस्तां कन्यां प्रत्यपादयत्
verses.transliteration: tṛṇabindoḥ sutā viprā nāmnā tvilavilā smṛtā / pulastyāya sa rājarṣistāṃ kanyāṃ pratyapādayat
verses.translation: Fixed to the tip of the trident, the demon Andhaka had all his sins burned down. He gained perfect knowledge of
verses.hindi: सरस्वतीको नमस्कार करता हूँ । जगत्की मूल कारणरूपा, परम कलास्वरूपा, तीन नेत्रवाली, मस्तकपर चन्द्रमाको धारण करनेवाली एवं हिरण्यगर्भकी महिषी योगिनीको नमस्कार है॥ १८--२०॥ चित्कलारूप, परमानन्दस्वरूपा ब्रह्मरूपिणीको नमस्कार है। परमेशानि! भयभीत होकर मैं आपकी शरणमें आया हूँ, मेरी रक्षा करो
verses.wordMeaning: Fixed to the tip of the trident, the demon Andhaka had all his sins burned down. He gained perfect knowledge of
verses.commentary: Sense: Fixed to the tip of the trident, the demon Andhaka had all his sins burned down. He gained perfect knowledge of

verses.sanskrit: ऋषिस्त्वैलविलिस्तस्यां विश्रवाः समपद्यत । तस्य पत्न्यश्चतस्त्रस्तु पौलस्त्यकुलवर्धिकाः
verses.transliteration: ṛṣistvailavilistasyāṃ viśravāḥ samapadyata / tasya patnyaścatastrastu paulastyakulavardhikāḥ
verses.translation: "I bow down my head to the only lord with great concentration. I bow down to the ancient holy one whom they know as the Principle of Isa. He is the Kala of infinite form. He is the poet, the cause of Toga (union) and Viyoga (separa¬ tion).
verses.hindi: इसी बीच क्रुद्ध वह राक्षसराज राजाको मारनेके लिये उसी स्थानपर आ पहुँचा, जहाँ देवी सरस्वती थीं। बलसे दर्पित वह राक्षस शूल उठाकर तीनों लोकोंकी जननीके उस सूर्य और चन्द्रमाके समान प्रकाशित स्थानमें प्रवेश करनेकी चेष्टा करने लगा। इसी बीच किसी प्रलयकालीन सूर्यके समान महान् बलशालीने शूलसे उसके वक्षःस्थलको विदीर्ण कर पृथ्वीपर गिरा दिया और कहा-महाराज! आप अब निर्भय होकर
verses.wordMeaning: "I bow down my head to the only lord with great concentration. I bow down to the ancient holy one whom they know as the Principle of Isa. He is the Kala of infinite form. He is the poet, the cause of Toga (union) and Viyoga (separa¬ tion).
verses.commentary: Sense: "I bow down my head to the only lord with great concentration. I bow down to the ancient holy one whom they know as the Principle of Isa. He is the Kala of infinite form. He is the poet, the cause of Toga (union) and Viyoga (separa¬ tion).

verses.sanskrit: पुष्पोत्कटा च राका च कैकसी देववर्णिनी । रूपलावण्यसंपन्नास्तासां वै शृणुत प्रजाः
verses.transliteration: puṣpotkaṭā ca rākā ca kaikasī devavarṇinī / rūpalāvaṇyasaṃpannāstāsāṃ vai śṛṇuta prajāḥ
verses.translation: I bow unto you the absolute Rudra, who are terrible due to the curved fangs, who dance in the firmament, giving out fire from your mouth, whose form is that of the blazing sun and who are endowed with a thousand feet, eyes and heads.
verses.hindi: शीघ्र ही इस स्थानसे चले जाय, यहाँ अब फिर रुके नहीं, राक्षस मारा जा चुका है॥ २२--२५॥ ब्राह्मणो! तब प्रसन्न मनवाला वह नवरथ उन परादेवीको प्रणामकर इन्द्रकी नगरीके समान अपनी नगरीको चला गया। वहाँ उसने भक्तियुक्त होकर देवेश्वरी सरस्वतीकी स्थापना की और विविध यज्ञों
verses.wordMeaning: I bow unto you the absolute Rudra, who are terrible due to the curved fangs, who dance in the firmament, giving out fire from your mouth, whose form is that of the blazing sun and who are endowed with a thousand feet, eyes and heads.
verses.commentary: Sense: I bow unto you the absolute Rudra, who are terrible due to the curved fangs, who dance in the firmament, giving out fire from your mouth, whose form is that of the blazing sun and who are endowed with a thousand feet, eyes and heads.

verses.sanskrit: ज्येष्ठं वैश्रवणं तस्य सुषुवे देवरूपिणी । कैकसी जनयत् पुत्रं रावणं राक्षसाधिपम्
verses.transliteration: jyeṣṭhaṃ vaiśravaṇaṃ tasya suṣuve devarūpiṇī / kaikasī janayat putraṃ rāvaṇaṃ rākṣasādhipam
verses.translation: Victory to you, the primordial deity whose feet are worshipped by the immortals. You are indivisible, a personifica¬ tion of the pure spirit. You are the one (sacrificial) fire worship¬ ped in various ways; you abide in all souls through external differences.
verses.hindi: तथा होमोंके द्वारा उन देवीका यजन किया। उसका दशरथ नामक परम धार्मिक पुत्र था। वह महातेजस्वी देवीका भक्त था। उसका पुत्र शकुनि था। उससे करम्भ हुआ, उसका देवरात हुआ, उसने अश्वमेध यज्ञ किया (जिसके फलस्वरूप) उसको देवक्षत्र नामक पुत्र हुआ। उस (देवक्षत्र)-का पुत्र मधु हुआ, उससे कुरुवश हुआ। उसके सुत्रामा तथा अनु नामक दो पुत्र हुए
verses.wordMeaning: Victory to you, the primordial deity whose feet are worshipped by the immortals. You are indivisible, a personifica¬ tion of the pure spirit. You are the one (sacrificial) fire worship¬ ped in various ways; you abide in all souls through external differences.
verses.commentary: Sense: Victory to you, the primordial deity whose feet are worshipped by the immortals. You are indivisible, a personifica¬ tion of the pure spirit. You are the one (sacrificial) fire worship¬ ped in various ways; you abide in all souls through external differences.

verses.sanskrit: कुम्भकर्णं शूर्पणखां तथैव च विभीषणम् । पुष्पोत्कटा व्यजनयत् पुत्रान् विश्रवसः शुभान्
verses.transliteration: kumbhakarṇaṃ śūrpaṇakhāṃ tathaiva ca vibhīṣaṇam / puṣpotkaṭā vyajanayat putrān viśravasaḥ śubhān
verses.translation: They call you the only ancient Purusa, with the brilliance of the sun and beyond darkness. You observe all this and protect it eternally. You are the annihilator, who are served by the groups of Yogins.
verses.hindi: अनुका पुरुकुत्स हुआ तथा उसका पुत्र अंशु था। अंशुका पुत्र सत्त्वत था, जो विष्णुभक्त, प्रतापी, महात्मा, दानशील और धनुर्वेद जाननेवालोंमें श्रेष्ठ था। उसने नारदजीके कहनेपर वासुदेवको पूजासे युक्त शास्त्रका प्रवर्तन किया, जिसे कुण्डगोलकोंने सुना
verses.wordMeaning: They call you the only ancient Purusa, with the brilliance of the sun and beyond darkness. You observe all this and protect it eternally. You are the annihilator, who are served by the groups of Yogins.
verses.commentary: Sense: They call you the only ancient Purusa, with the brilliance of the sun and beyond darkness. You observe all this and protect it eternally. You are the annihilator, who are served by the groups of Yogins.

verses.sanskrit: महोदरं प्रहस्तं च महापार्श्वं खरं तथा । कुम्भीनसीं तथा कन्यां राकायां शृणुत प्रजाः
verses.transliteration: mahodaraṃ prahastaṃ ca mahāpārśvaṃ kharaṃ tathā / kumbhīnasīṃ tathā kanyāṃ rākāyāṃ śṛṇuta prajāḥ
verses.translation: You are the only inner soul and conscience placed in many ways in the different bodies, but you are devoid of peculiarities of the bodies, etc.
verses.hindi: कुण्डगोलक--कुण्ड-पतिके जीवित रहते हुए परपुरुषसे उत्पन्न पुत्र। गोलक--पतिके मर जानेपर परपुरुषसे उत्पन्न पुत्र। प्रवर्तते महाशास्त्रं कुण्डादीनां हितावहम्
verses.wordMeaning: You are the only inner soul and conscience placed in many ways in the different bodies, but you are devoid of peculiarities of the bodies, etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are the only inner soul and conscience placed in many ways in the different bodies, but you are devoid of peculiarities of the bodies, etc.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिशिरा दूषणश्चैव विद्युज्जिह्वो महाबलः । इत्येते क्रूरकर्माणः पौलस्त्या राक्षसा दश । सर्वे तपोबलोत्कृष्टा रुद्रभक्ताः सुभीषणाः
verses.transliteration: triśirā dūṣaṇaścaiva vidyujjihvo mahābalaḥ / ityete krūrakarmāṇaḥ paulastyā rākṣasā daśa / sarve tapobalotkṛṣṭā rudrabhaktāḥ subhīṣaṇāḥ
verses.translation: You are the imperishable Brahman, the most sacred form, embodiment of bliss called Pranava (Om). You are the wellknown Self-born Isvara, ths master of those who know Vedas, devoid of all special characteristics.
verses.hindi: पुण्यश्लोको महाराजस्तेन वै तत्प्रवर्तितम् अन्धकं वै महाभोजं वृष्णिं देवावृधं नृपम्। ज्येष्ठं च भजमानाख्यं धनुर्वेदविदां वरम्
verses.wordMeaning: You are the imperishable Brahman, the most sacred form, embodiment of bliss called Pranava (Om). You are the wellknown Self-born Isvara, ths master of those who know Vedas, devoid of all special characteristics.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are the imperishable Brahman, the most sacred form, embodiment of bliss called Pranava (Om). You are the wellknown Self-born Isvara, ths master of those who know Vedas, devoid of all special characteristics.

verses.sanskrit: पुलहस्य मृगाः पुत्राः सर्वे व्यालाश्च दंष्ट्रिणः । भूताः पिशाचाः सर्पाश्च शूकरा हस्तिनस्तथा
verses.transliteration: pulahasya mṛgāḥ putrāḥ sarve vyālāśca daṃṣṭriṇaḥ / bhūtāḥ piśācāḥ sarpāśca śūkarā hastinastathā
verses.translation: You are of the form of Indra, Varuna and Agni. You are haihsa (swan), prana (the vital breath), death and final destruction. You are Yajna, Lord Prajapati. You are eulogised as the unique blue-necked god, by those who know the Vedas.
verses.hindi: तेषां देवावृधो राजा चचार परमं तप: । पुत्रः सर्वगुणोपेतो मम भूयादिति प्रभुः तस्य बभ्नुरिति ख्यातः पुण्यश्लोकोऽभवन्नृपः। धार्मिको रूपसम्पन्नस्तत्त्वज्ञानरतः सदा
verses.wordMeaning: You are of the form of Indra, Varuna and Agni. You are haihsa (swan), prana (the vital breath), death and final destruction. You are Yajna, Lord Prajapati. You are eulogised as the unique blue-necked god, by those who know the Vedas.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are of the form of Indra, Varuna and Agni. You are haihsa (swan), prana (the vital breath), death and final destruction. You are Yajna, Lord Prajapati. You are eulogised as the unique blue-necked god, by those who know the Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: अनपत्यः क्रतुस्तस्मिन् स्मृतो वैवस्वते ऽन्तरे । मरीचेः कश्यपः पुत्रः स्वयमेव प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: anapatyaḥ kratustasmin smṛto vaivasvate 'ntare / marīceḥ kaśyapaḥ putraḥ svayameva prajāpatiḥ
verses.translation: You are Narayana, the beginningless cause of the world. You are Pitamaha (grandfather) and Prapitamaha (great-grandfather) [of the universe]. You are sung about in the occult passages of Vedanta and the mystic Upanisads. You are the ever-auspicious (Sadasiva), Supreme Ruler (Paramesvara).
verses.hindi: महाभोजकुले जाता भोजा वैमार्तिकास्तथा। प्रसेनस्तु महाभागः सत्राजिन्नाम चोत्तमः
verses.wordMeaning: You are Narayana, the beginningless cause of the world. You are Pitamaha (grandfather) and Prapitamaha (great-grandfather) [of the universe]. You are sung about in the occult passages of Vedanta and the mystic Upanisads. You are the ever-auspicious (Sadasiva),…
verses.commentary: Sense: You are Narayana, the beginningless cause of the world. You are Pitamaha (grandfather) and Prapitamaha (great-grandfather) [of the universe]. You are sung about in the occult passages of Vedanta and the mystic Upanisads. You are the ever-auspicious (Sadasiva),…

verses.sanskrit: भृगोरप्यभवच्छुक्रो दैत्याचार्यो महातपाः । स्वाध्याययोगनिरतो हरभक्तो महाद्युतिः
verses.transliteration: bhṛgorapyabhavacchukro daityācāryo mahātapāḥ / svādhyāyayoganirato harabhakto mahādyutiḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to the greatest Being beyond darkness (of ignorance), the great Atman pervading the fourteen worlds. Salute to one who has excelled the three Saktis, to the unsullied one stationed in the seat of thousand Saktis (poten¬ cies).
verses.hindi: श्वफल्कः काशिराजस्य सुतां भार्यामविन्दत। उपमङ्गस्तथा मङ्करन्ये च बहवः सुताः
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the greatest Being beyond darkness (of ignorance), the great Atman pervading the fourteen worlds. Salute to one who has excelled the three Saktis, to the unsullied one stationed in the seat of thousand Saktis (poten¬ cies).
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the greatest Being beyond darkness (of ignorance), the great Atman pervading the fourteen worlds. Salute to one who has excelled the three Saktis, to the unsullied one stationed in the seat of thousand Saktis (poten¬ cies).

verses.sanskrit: अत्रेः पत्न्यो ऽभवन् बह्व्यः सोदर्यास्ताः पतिव्रताः । कृशाश्वस्य तु विप्रेन्द्रा घृताच्यामिति मे श्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: atreḥ patnyo 'bhavan bahvyaḥ sodaryāstāḥ pativratāḥ / kṛśāśvasya tu viprendrā ghṛtācyāmiti me śrutam
verses.translation: Obeisance to the triple-formed deity whose personal form comprises infinite region, who is the receptacle of the world and its embodiment. Salute to you who are stationed in. the heart of the people. Bow to you the wearer of the great serpent as a necklace.
verses.hindi: अक्रूरस्य स्मृतः पुत्रो देववानिति विश्रुतः । उपदेवश्च पुण्यात्मा तयोर्विश्वप्रमाथिनौ अन्धकात् काश्यदुहिता लेभे च चतुरः सुतान्। कुकुरं भजमानं च शुचिं कम्बलबर्हिषम्
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the triple-formed deity whose personal form comprises infinite region, who is the receptacle of the world and its embodiment. Salute to you who are stationed in. the heart of the people. Bow to you the wearer of the great serpent as a necklace.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the triple-formed deity whose personal form comprises infinite region, who is the receptacle of the world and its embodiment. Salute to you who are stationed in. the heart of the people. Bow to you the wearer of the great serpent as a necklace.

verses.sanskrit: स तासु जनयामास स्वस्त्यात्रेयान् महौजसः । वेदवेदाङ्गनिरतांस्तपसा हतकिल्बिषान्
verses.transliteration: sa tāsu janayāmāsa svastyātreyān mahaujasaḥ / vedavedāṅganiratāṃstapasā hatakilbiṣān
verses.translation: O lord, whose lotus-like feet are worshipped by the leading sages and siddhas! Obeisance to one who is firmly seated in the seat of prosperity and piety; Obeisance to the ultimate end, to the source of origin of the worldly existence, the embodiment of a thousand moons and a thousand suns.
verses.hindi: उसके नामसे सात्त्वत ऐसा विख्यात कुण्डादिकोंके लिये कल्याणकारी सुन्दर शास्त्र प्रवर्तित हुआ। उस (सत्त्वत)-का सभी शास्त्रोंमें पारंगत सात्त्वत नामक पुत्र हुआ, वह महाराज पुण्यश्लोक था। उसने उस सात्त्वत शास्त्रका प्रवर्तन किया। सत्त्वसम्पन्न सात्वतकी पत्नी कौशल्याने अन्धक, महाभोज, वृष्णि, राजा देवावृध तथा धनुर्वेदज्ञोमें श्रेष्ठ भजमान नामक ज्येष्ठ पुत्रको जन्म
verses.wordMeaning: O lord, whose lotus-like feet are worshipped by the leading sages and siddhas! Obeisance to one who is firmly seated in the seat of prosperity and piety; Obeisance to the ultimate end, to the source of origin of the worldly existence,…
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, whose lotus-like feet are worshipped by the leading sages and siddhas! Obeisance to one who is firmly seated in the seat of prosperity and piety; Obeisance to the ultimate end, to the source of origin of the worldly existence,…

verses.sanskrit: नारदस्तु वसिष्ठाय ददौ देवीमरुन्धतीम् । ऊर्ध्वरेतास्तत्र मुनिः शापाद् दक्षस्य नारदः
verses.transliteration: nāradastu vasiṣṭhāya dadau devīmarundhatīm / ūrdhvaretāstatra muniḥ śāpād dakṣasya nāradaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to one who is accompanied by Uma, of beautiful waist. Golden-armed Lord, obeisance to you. Salute to one with the fire, the moon and the sun as eyes. Bow to the gracious consort of Ambika.
verses.hindi: उनमेंसे राजा देवावृधने 'मुझे सभी गुणोंसे सम्पन्न शक्तिशाली पुत्र हो' इस आशयसे परम तप किया। उसका पुत्र बभ्रु नामसे विख्यात पुण्यश्लोक राजा हुआ। वह धर्मात्मा, रूप-सम्पन्न तथा सदा तत्त्वज्ञान-परायण रहता था। भजमानके सृञ्जयी (पल्ली)-से भजमान ही नामवाले (अनेक) पुत्र हुए। उनमेंसे निमि तथा कृकण--ये दो प्रधान तथा विख्यात थे। महाभोजके वंशमें भोज तथा वैमार्तिक उत्पन्न हुए। वृष्णिके बलवान्
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one who is accompanied by Uma, of beautiful waist. Golden-armed Lord, obeisance to you. Salute to one with the fire, the moon and the sun as eyes. Bow to the gracious consort of Ambika.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one who is accompanied by Uma, of beautiful waist. Golden-armed Lord, obeisance to you. Salute to one with the fire, the moon and the sun as eyes. Bow to the gracious consort of Ambika.

verses.sanskrit: हर्यश्वेषु तु नष्टेषु मायया नारदस्य तु । शशाप नारदं दक्षः क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनः
verses.transliteration: haryaśveṣu tu naṣṭeṣu māyayā nāradasya tu / śaśāpa nāradaṃ dakṣaḥ krodhasaṃraktalocanaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to one who is accompanied by Uma, of beautiful waist. Golden-armed Lord, obeisance to you. Salute to one with the fire, the moon and the sun as eyes. Bow to the gracious consort of Ambika.
verses.hindi: सुमित्र, अनमित्र तथा शिनि हुए। अनमित्रसे निघ्न हुआ और निष्नके महाभाग्यवान् प्रसेन तथा श्रेष्ठ सत्राजित् नामवाले दो पुत्र हुए कनिष्ठ वृष्णिनन्दन अनमित्रसे शिनि उत्पन्न हुआ। उसका सत्यक नामक पुत्र हुआ जो सत्य बोलनेवाला तथा सत्यसम्पन्न था। सत्यकका पुत्र युयुधान और उसका पुत्र असङ्ग हुआ। उसका पुत्र बुद्धिमान् कुणि
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one who is accompanied by Uma, of beautiful waist. Golden-armed Lord, obeisance to you. Salute to one with the fire, the moon and the sun as eyes. Bow to the gracious consort of Ambika.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one who is accompanied by Uma, of beautiful waist. Golden-armed Lord, obeisance to you. Salute to one with the fire, the moon and the sun as eyes. Bow to the gracious consort of Ambika.

verses.sanskrit: यस्मान्मम सुताः सर्वे भवतो मायया द्विज । क्षयं नीतास्त्वशेषेण निरपत्यो भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: yasmānmama sutāḥ sarve bhavato māyayā dvija / kṣayaṃ nītāstvaśeṣeṇa nirapatyo bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: Obeisance to one who is accompanied by Uma, of beautiful waist. Golden-armed Lord, obeisance to you. Salute to one with the fire, the moon and the sun as eyes. Bow to the gracious consort of Ambika.
verses.hindi: था और युगन्धर उसका पुत्र हुआ। वृष्णिको माद्रीसे यदुनन्दन पृश्रि नामक पुत्र उत्पन्न हुआ। पृश्रिको श्वफल्क तथा चित्रक नामवाले दो पुत्र हुए। श्वफल्कने काशिराजकी पुत्रीको अपनी भार्या बनाया और उससे मङ्गु नामवाले उनके बहुतसे पुत्र थे। अक्रूरका देववान् इस नामसे प्रसिद्ध पुत्र कहा गया है। पुण्यात्मा उपदेव भी उसका पुत्र हुआ। उन दोनोंको विश्व तथा प्रमाथी नामक दो पुत्र हुए
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one who is accompanied by Uma, of beautiful waist. Golden-armed Lord, obeisance to you. Salute to one with the fire, the moon and the sun as eyes. Bow to the gracious consort of Ambika.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one who is accompanied by Uma, of beautiful waist. Golden-armed Lord, obeisance to you. Salute to one with the fire, the moon and the sun as eyes. Bow to the gracious consort of Ambika.

verses.sanskrit: अरुन्धत्यां वसिष्ठस्तु शक्तिमुत्पादयत् सुतम् । शक्तेः पराशरः श्रीमान् सर्वज्ञस्तपतां वरः
verses.transliteration: arundhatyāṃ vasiṣṭhastu śaktimutpādayat sutam / śakteḥ parāśaraḥ śrīmān sarvajñastapatāṃ varaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to one who is accompanied by Uma, of beautiful waist. Golden-armed Lord, obeisance to you. Salute to one with the fire, the moon and the sun as eyes. Bow to the gracious consort of Ambika.
verses.hindi: चित्रकके पृथु, विपृथु, अश्वग्रीव, सुबाहु, सुपार्श्वक तथा गवेषण नामक पुत्र हुए। काश्यकी पुत्रीने अन्धकसे पुत्रोंको प्राप्त किया। कुकुरका पुत्र वृष्णि हुआ और वृष्णिका पुत्र कपोतरोमा विपुल हुआ। उसका पुत्र विलोमक हुआ
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one who is accompanied by Uma, of beautiful waist. Golden-armed Lord, obeisance to you. Salute to one with the fire, the moon and the sun as eyes. Bow to the gracious consort of Ambika.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one who is accompanied by Uma, of beautiful waist. Golden-armed Lord, obeisance to you. Salute to one with the fire, the moon and the sun as eyes. Bow to the gracious consort of Ambika.

verses.sanskrit: आराध्य देवदेवेशमीशानं त्रिपुरान्तकम् । लेभे त्वप्रतिमं पुत्रं कृष्णाद्वैपायनं प्रभुम्
verses.transliteration: ārādhya devadeveśamīśānaṃ tripurāntakam / lebhe tvapratimaṃ putraṃ kṛṣṇādvaipāyanaṃ prabhum
verses.translation: Obeisance to one who is accompanied by Uma, of beautiful waist. Golden-armed Lord, obeisance to you. Salute to one with the fire, the moon and the sun as eyes. Bow to the gracious consort of Ambika.
verses.hindi: ति कूर्मपुराण शर उस (विलोमक)-का विद्वान् नल नामक पुत्र हुआ
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one who is accompanied by Uma, of beautiful waist. Golden-armed Lord, obeisance to you. Salute to one with the fire, the moon and the sun as eyes. Bow to the gracious consort of Ambika.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one who is accompanied by Uma, of beautiful waist. Golden-armed Lord, obeisance to you. Salute to one with the fire, the moon and the sun as eyes. Bow to the gracious consort of Ambika.

verses.sanskrit: द्वैपायनाच्छ्रको जज्ञे भगवानेव शङ्करः । अंशांशेनावतीर्योर्व्यां स्वं प्राप परमं पदम्
verses.transliteration: dvaipāyanācchrako jajñe bhagavāneva śaṅkaraḥ / aṃśāṃśenāvatīryorvyāṃ svaṃ prāpa paramaṃ padam
verses.translation: Obeisance to one who is accompanied by Uma, of beautiful waist. Golden-armed Lord, obeisance to you. Salute to one with the fire, the moon and the sun as eyes. Bow to the gracious consort of Ambika.
verses.hindi: ख्यायते तस्य नामानुरनोरानकदुन्दुभिः ॥ ४९॥  जो तुम्बुरुका मित्र था, अनु भी उसका नाम हुआ। वरं तस्मै ददौ देवो ब्रह्मा लोकमहेश्वरः
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one who is accompanied by Uma, of beautiful waist. Golden-armed Lord, obeisance to you. Salute to one with the fire, the moon and the sun as eyes. Bow to the gracious consort of Ambika.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one who is accompanied by Uma, of beautiful waist. Golden-armed Lord, obeisance to you. Salute to one with the fire, the moon and the sun as eyes. Bow to the gracious consort of Ambika.

verses.sanskrit: शुकस्याप्यभवन् पुत्राः पञ्चात्यन्ततपस्विनः । भूरिश्रवाः प्रभुः शंभुः कृष्णो गौरश्च पञ्चमः । कन्या कीर्तिमती चैव योगमाता धृतव्रता
verses.transliteration: śukasyāpyabhavan putrāḥ pañcātyantatapasvinaḥ / bhūriśravāḥ prabhuḥ śaṃbhuḥ kṛṣṇo gauraśca pañcamaḥ / kanyā kīrtimatī caiva yogamātā dhṛtavratā
verses.translation: Obeisance to one who is accompanied by Uma, of beautiful waist. Golden-armed Lord, obeisance to you. Salute to one with the fire, the moon and the sun as eyes. Bow to the gracious consort of Ambika.
verses.hindi: वंशस्य चाक्षयां कीर्ति गानयोगमनुत्तमम्। गुरोरभ्यधिकं विप्राः कामरूपित्वमेव च तस्य गानरतस्याथ भगवानम्बिकापतिः। कन्यारत्नं ददौ देवो दुर्लभं त्रिदशैरपि
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one who is accompanied by Uma, of beautiful waist. Golden-armed Lord, obeisance to you. Salute to one with the fire, the moon and the sun as eyes. Bow to the gracious consort of Ambika.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one who is accompanied by Uma, of beautiful waist. Golden-armed Lord, obeisance to you. Salute to one with the fire, the moon and the sun as eyes. Bow to the gracious consort of Ambika.

verses.sanskrit: एते ऽत्र वंश्याः कथिता ब्राह्मणा ब्रह्मवादिनाम् । अत ऊर्ध्वं निबोधध्वं कश्यपाद्राजसंततिम्
verses.transliteration: ete 'tra vaṃśyāḥ kathitā brāhmaṇā brahmavādinām / ata ūrdhvaṃ nibodhadhvaṃ kaśyapādrājasaṃtatim
verses.translation: Obeisance to one who is accompanied by Uma, of beautiful waist. Golden-armed Lord, obeisance to you. Salute to one with the fire, the moon and the sun as eyes. Bow to the gracious consort of Ambika.
verses.hindi: तया स सङ्गतो राजा गानयोगमनुत्तमम्। अशिक्षयदमित्रघ्नः प्रियां तां भ्रान्तलोचनाम् रूपलावण्यसम्पन्नां हीमतीमपि कन्यकाम्
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one who is accompanied by Uma, of beautiful waist. Golden-armed Lord, obeisance to you. Salute to one with the fire, the moon and the sun as eyes. Bow to the gracious consort of Ambika.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one who is accompanied by Uma, of beautiful waist. Golden-armed Lord, obeisance to you. Salute to one with the fire, the moon and the sun as eyes. Bow to the gracious consort of Ambika.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे अष्टादशो ऽध्यायः सूत उवाच अदितिः सुषुवे पुत्रमादित्यं कश्यपात् प्रभुम् । तस्यादित्यस्य चैवसीद् भार्याणां तु चतुष्टयम् । संज्ञा राज्ञी प्रभा छाया पुत्रांस्तासां निबोधत
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge aṣṭādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca aditiḥ suṣuve putramādityaṃ kaśyapāt prabhum / tasyādityasya caivasīd bhāryāṇāṃ tu catuṣṭayam / saṃjñā rājñī prabhā chāyā putrāṃstāsāṃ nibodhata
verses.translation: Obeisance to the mysterious Lord concealed within the inmost cavity of the heart. Salute to the Lord who can be properly comprehended by the perfect knowledge of Vedanta. Bow to the great God Siva who is (transcendental to and there¬ fore) devoid of the three times (past, present and future), whose abode (or lustre) is o f spotless splendour.
verses.hindi: शिक्षयामास विधिवद् गानविद्यां च कन्यकाम् पुत्रैः पौत्रैः सपत्नीको राजा गानविशारदः।
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the mysterious Lord concealed within the inmost cavity of the heart. Salute to the Lord who can be properly comprehended by the perfect knowledge of Vedanta. Bow to the great God Siva who is (transcendental to and there¬ fore) devoid of the three times (past,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the mysterious Lord concealed within the inmost cavity of the heart. Salute to the Lord who can be properly comprehended by the perfect knowledge of Vedanta. Bow to the great God Siva who is (transcendental to and there¬ fore) devoid of the three times (past,…

verses.sanskrit: संज्ञा त्वाष्ट्री च सुषुवे सूर्यान्मनुमनुत्तमम् । यमं च यमुनां चैव राज्ञी रैवतमेव च
verses.transliteration: saṃjñā tvāṣṭrī ca suṣuve sūryānmanumanuttamam / yamaṃ ca yamunāṃ caiva rājñī raivatameva ca
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the glorious lord set him down from the tip of his trident. Being pleased with him, he touched him with both of his hands and spoke thus:—
verses.hindi: पूजयामास गानेन देवं त्रिपुरनाशनम् अनुका पुत्र आनकदुन्दुभि हुआ
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the glorious lord set him down from the tip of his trident. Being pleased with him, he touched him with both of his hands and spoke thus:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the glorious lord set him down from the tip of his trident. Being pleased with him, he touched him with both of his hands and spoke thus:—

verses.sanskrit: प्रभा प्रभातमादित्याच्छाया सावर्णमात्मजम् । शनिं च तपतीं चैव विष्टिं चैव यथाक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: prabhā prabhātamādityācchāyā sāvarṇamātmajam / śaniṃ ca tapatīṃ caiva viṣṭiṃ caiva yathākramam
verses.translation: "O Daitya, in every respect I am pleased with this eulogy now. After attaining the status of the leader of Ganas, stay forever in my vicinity.
verses.hindi: ब्राह्मणो ! उसने गोवर्धन पर्वतपर जाकर महान् तप किया। तब लोकमहेश्वर देव ब्रह्माने उसे वर प्रदान किया और कहा--तुम्हारे बंशकी अक्षय कीर्ति होगी तथा तुम्हें गुरुसे भी अधिक श्रेष्ठ गानयोग (संगीत- कलाको स्वाभाविक प्रतिभा) और इच्छानुसार रूप धारण करनेको योग्यता प्राप्त होगी
verses.wordMeaning: "O Daitya, in every respect I am pleased with this eulogy now. After attaining the status of the leader of Ganas, stay forever in my vicinity.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Daitya, in every respect I am pleased with this eulogy now. After attaining the status of the leader of Ganas, stay forever in my vicinity.

verses.sanskrit: मनोस्तु प्रथमस्यासन् नव पुत्रास्तु संयमाः । इक्ष्वाकुर्नभगश्चैव धृष्टः शर्यातिरेव च
verses.transliteration: manostu prathamasyāsan nava putrāstu saṃyamāḥ / ikṣvākurnabhagaścaiva dhṛṣṭaḥ śaryātireva ca
verses.translation: You shall be free from ailments. All your doubts will be cleared. You will be worshipped well, even by Devas. Be the follower of Nandisvara; be devoid of all miseries".
verses.hindi: वर प्राप्तकर प्रशान्त (मनवाले) उसने देवताओंद्वारा पूजित, वरणीय और वृषवाहन स्थाणु (शंकर)-की गान (संगीत) -द्वारा पूजा की  गानमें रत उस (आनकदुन्दुभि)- को भगवान् देव अम्बिकापति (शंकर)-ने देवताओंके लिये भी दुर्लभ विवाह करने योग्य कन्यारूपी रत्न प्रदान किया । भार्या-रूपमें उसका साथ प्राप्तकर शत्रुनाशक राजाने उस चञ्चल आँखोंबाली अपनी प्रिया भ्रान्तलोचनाको श्रेष्ठ गानयोग सिखलाया। (राजाने) उससे सुन्दर भुजावाले
verses.wordMeaning: You shall be free from ailments. All your doubts will be cleared. You will be worshipped well, even by Devas. Be the follower of Nandisvara; be devoid of all miseries".
verses.commentary: Sense: You shall be free from ailments. All your doubts will be cleared. You will be worshipped well, even by Devas. Be the follower of Nandisvara; be devoid of all miseries".

verses.sanskrit: नरिष्यन्तश्च नाभागो ह्यरिष्टः कारुषकस्तथा । पृषध्रश्च महातेजा नवैते शक्रसन्निभाः
verses.transliteration: nariṣyantaśca nābhāgo hyariṣṭaḥ kāruṣakastathā / pṛṣadhraśca mahātejā navaite śakrasannibhāḥ
verses.translation: On seeing him thus, they were surprised much; they eulogised the Daitya. Lord Visnu smilingly said to the lord of Devas.
verses.hindi: शोभन नामक पुत्र तथा रूप और लावण्यसे सम्पन्न हीमती नामकी कन्याको उत्पन्न किया तब माता (भ्रान्तलोचना) -ने बाल्यावस्थामें ही उस शोभन नामक पुत्रको तथा कन्या (हीमती)-को भी विधिवत् गानविद्याकी शिक्षा प्रदान की। उपनयन होनेके अनन्तर विधिपूर्वक गुरुसे वेदोंका अध्ययनकर (शोभनने)
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing him thus, they were surprised much; they eulogised the Daitya. Lord Visnu smilingly said to the lord of Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing him thus, they were surprised much; they eulogised the Daitya. Lord Visnu smilingly said to the lord of Devas.

verses.sanskrit: इला ज्येष्ठा वरिष्ठा च सोमवंशविवृद्धये । बुधस्य गत्वा भवनं सोमपुत्रेण संगता
verses.transliteration: ilā jyeṣṭhā variṣṭhā ca somavaṃśavivṛddhaye / budhasya gatvā bhavanaṃ somaputreṇa saṃgatā
verses.translation: "O Mahadeva, your greatness is but meet and proper. A really great man does not take cognizance of defects due to one's caste ( v.l. ignorance). He takes in account their good attributes.
verses.hindi: गन्धर्वाकी मानसी नामक कन्यासे विवाह किया और उससे वीणा बजानेका तत्त्व जाननेवाले तथा संगीतशास्त्रमें पारंगत पाँच श्रेष्ठ पुत्रोंको उत्पन्न किया॥ ५६--५८॥ पुत्र-पौत्र तथा पत्नीसहित गानविद्यामें पारंगत उस राजाने गायनद्वारा त्रिपुरका नाश करनेवाले देव (शंकर)- की पूजा की। लक्ष्मीके सदृश विशाल नेत्रोंवाली जो हीमती नामकी कन्या थी, सुबाहु नामक गन्धर्व उसे
verses.wordMeaning: "O Mahadeva, your greatness is but meet and proper. A really great man does not take cognizance of defects due to one's caste ( v.l. ignorance). He takes in account their good attributes.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Mahadeva, your greatness is but meet and proper. A really great man does not take cognizance of defects due to one's caste ( v.l. ignorance). He takes in account their good attributes.

verses.sanskrit: असूत सौम्यजं देवी पुरूरवसमुत्तमम् । पितॄणां तृप्तिकर्तारं बुधादिति हि नः श्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: asūta saumyajaṃ devī purūravasamuttamam / pitṝṇāṃ tṛptikartāraṃ budhāditi hi naḥ śrutam
verses.translation: On being addressed thus, Bhairava, the leading Deva and Chief of the Ganas, went near Sankara accompanied by Kesava and the Daitya Andhaka.
verses.hindi: लेकर अपनी पुरीमें चला गया। अत्यन्त तेजस्वी गन्धर्वको भी उस (हीमती)-से सुषेण, वीर, सुग्रीव, सुभोज तथा नरवाहन नामके पुत्र हुए आनकदुन्दुभिका अभिजित् नामक एक वीर पुत्र था। अभिजित्का पुनर्वसु और उससे आहुकका जन्म हुआ
verses.wordMeaning: On being addressed thus, Bhairava, the leading Deva and Chief of the Ganas, went near Sankara accompanied by Kesava and the Daitya Andhaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being addressed thus, Bhairava, the leading Deva and Chief of the Ganas, went near Sankara accompanied by Kesava and the Daitya Andhaka.

verses.sanskrit: संप्राप्य पुंस्त्वममलं सुद्युम्न इति विश्रुतः । इला पुत्रत्रयं लेभे पुनः स्त्रीत्वमविन्दत
verses.transliteration: saṃprāpya puṃstvamamalaṃ sudyumna iti viśrutaḥ / ilā putratrayaṃ lebhe punaḥ strītvamavindata
verses.translation: Isvara (Sankara) grasped the son of Hiranyaksa (Andhaka) with his hand and went to the place where there stood the aerial chariot of the daughter of the mountain. On seeing her husband, the remover of worldly distress arrived along with Andhaka, the beloved of Isa expressed happiness and pleasure on behalf of Andhaka.
verses.hindi: आहुकस्योग्रसेनश्च देवकश्च द्विजोत्तमाः । देवकस्य सुता वीरा जज्ञिरे त्रिदशोपमाः देववानृपदेवश्च सुदेवो देवरक्षितः। तेषां स्वसारः सप्तासन् वसुदेवाय ता ददौ
verses.wordMeaning: Isvara (Sankara) grasped the son of Hiranyaksa (Andhaka) with his hand and went to the place where there stood the aerial chariot of the daughter of the mountain. On seeing her husband, the remover of worldly distress arrived along with Andhaka,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Isvara (Sankara) grasped the son of Hiranyaksa (Andhaka) with his hand and went to the place where there stood the aerial chariot of the daughter of the mountain. On seeing her husband, the remover of worldly distress arrived along with Andhaka,…

verses.sanskrit: उत्कलश्च गयश्चैव विनताश्वस्तथैव च । सर्वे ते ऽप्रतिमप्रख्याः प्रपन्नाः कमलोद्भवम्
verses.transliteration: utkalaśca gayaścaiva vinatāśvastathaiva ca / sarve te 'pratimaprakhyāḥ prapannāḥ kamalodbhavam
verses.translation: When Andhaka saw Mahesvari at the side of the lord, he fell on the ground like a staff; he bowed down at the lotus-like feet of the goddess—"I bow down to the beloved of the lord, the beginningless one, the daughter of the mountain from whom Pradhana and Purusa originate and who destroys the entire universe.
verses.hindi: वृकदेबोपदेबा च तथान्या देवरक्षिता । श्रीदेवा शान्तिदेवा च सहदेवा च सुत्रता । देवकी चापि तासां तु वरिष्ठाभूत् सुमध्यमा उग्रसेनस्य पुत्रोऽभून्न्यग्रोधः कंस एव च। सुभूमी राष्ट्रपालश्च तुष्टरिमाञ्छङ्कुरेव च
verses.wordMeaning: When Andhaka saw Mahesvari at the side of the lord, he fell on the ground like a staff; he bowed down at the lotus-like feet of the goddess—"I bow down to the beloved of the lord, the beginningless one,…
verses.commentary: Sense: When Andhaka saw Mahesvari at the side of the lord, he fell on the ground like a staff; he bowed down at the lotus-like feet of the goddess—"I bow down to the beloved of the lord, the beginningless one,…

verses.sanskrit: इक्ष्वाकोश्चाभवद् वीरो विकुक्षिर्नाम पार्थिवः । ज्येष्ठः पुत्रशतस्यापि दश पञ्च च तत्सुताः
verses.transliteration: ikṣvākoścābhavad vīro vikukṣirnāma pārthivaḥ / jyeṣṭhaḥ putraśatasyāpi daśa pañca ca tatsutāḥ
verses.translation: I bow unto that daughter of Himalaya mountain, who is unchanging and who shines in the purest golden seat of Siva along with him, within whom the entire universe is held and wherein all the worlds undergo dissolution. I bow down to that Uma who is devoid of all defects, (v.l. One who is adored by god as well as by demons).
verses.hindi: कृतवर्माथ तत्पुत्रो देवरस्तत्सुतः स्मृतः। स शूरस्तत्सुतो धीमान् वसुदेवोऽथ तत्सुतः वसुदेवान्महाबाहुर्वासुदेवो जगदगुरुः। बभूव देवकीपुत्रो देवैरभ्यर्थितो हरिः
verses.wordMeaning: I bow unto that daughter of Himalaya mountain, who is unchanging and who shines in the purest golden seat of Siva along with him, within whom the entire universe is held and wherein all the worlds undergo dissolution. I bow down to that Uma who is devoid of all defects, (v.l.…
verses.commentary: Sense: I bow unto that daughter of Himalaya mountain, who is unchanging and who shines in the purest golden seat of Siva along with him, within whom the entire universe is held and wherein all the worlds undergo dissolution. I bow down to that Uma who is devoid of all defects, (v.l.…

verses.sanskrit: तेषाञ्ज्येष्ठः ककुत्स्थो ऽभूत् काकुत्स्थो हि सुयोधनः । सुयोधनात् पृथुः श्रीमान् विश्वकश्च पृथोः सुतः
verses.transliteration: teṣāñjyeṣṭhaḥ kakutstho 'bhūt kākutstho hi suyodhanaḥ / suyodhanāt pṛthuḥ śrīmān viśvakaśca pṛthoḥ sutaḥ
verses.translation: She is not born, she does not become decreased, she does not increase. I bow down to that Uma who transcends all Gunas. I bow down to the daughter of the lord of mountains. O Goddess, O daughter of the mountain, forgive what has been committed by me out of delusion. I bow down to your lotus-like feet saluted by Devas and Asuras.
verses.hindi: रोहिणी च महाभागा वसुदेवस्य शोभना। असूत पत्नी संकर्ष रामं ज्येष्ठं हलायुधम् स एव परमात्मासौ वासुदेवो जगन्मयः । हलायुधः स्वयं साक्षाच्छेषः संकर्षणः प्रभुः
verses.wordMeaning: She is not born, she does not become decreased, she does not increase. I bow down to that Uma who transcends all Gunas. I bow down to the daughter of the lord of mountains. O Goddess, O daughter of the mountain, forgive what has been committed by me out of delusion.…
verses.commentary: Sense: She is not born, she does not become decreased, she does not increase. I bow down to that Uma who transcends all Gunas. I bow down to the daughter of the lord of mountains. O Goddess, O daughter of the mountain, forgive what has been committed by me out of delusion.…

verses.sanskrit: विश्वकादार्द्रको धीमान् युवनाश्वस्तु तत्सुतः । स गोकर्णमनुप्राप्य युवनाश्वः प्रतापवान्
verses.transliteration: viśvakādārdrako dhīmān yuvanāśvastu tatsutaḥ / sa gokarṇamanuprāpya yuvanāśvaḥ pratāpavān
verses.translation: Thus eulogised by the lord of Daityas, humble with devotion, the blessed goddess Parvati accepted Andhaka as her son.
verses.hindi: बभूव तस्यां देवक्यां रोहिण्यामपि माधवः उमादेहसमुद्भूता योगनिद्रा च कौशिकी। नियोगाद् वासुदेवस्य यशोदातनया ह्यभूत्
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised by the lord of Daityas, humble with devotion, the blessed goddess Parvati accepted Andhaka as her son.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised by the lord of Daityas, humble with devotion, the blessed goddess Parvati accepted Andhaka as her son.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा तु गौतमं विप्रं तपन्तमनलप्रभम् । प्रणम्य दण्डवद् भूमौ पुत्रकामो महीपतिः । अपृच्छत् कर्मणा केन धार्मिकं प्राप्नुयात् सुतम्
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā tu gautamaṃ vipraṃ tapantamanalaprabham / praṇamya daṇḍavad bhūmau putrakāmo mahīpatiḥ / apṛcchat karmaṇā kena dhārmikaṃ prāpnuyāt sutam
verses.translation: Then at the behest of Sambhu, the great lord Bhairava, born of Rudra, went to Patala along with the matriarchs.
verses.hindi: ये चान्ये वसुदेवस्य वासुदेवाग्रजाः सुता: । प्रागेव कंसस्तान् सर्वान् जघान मुनिपुंगवाः
verses.wordMeaning: Then at the behest of Sambhu, the great lord Bhairava, born of Rudra, went to Patala along with the matriarchs.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then at the behest of Sambhu, the great lord Bhairava, born of Rudra, went to Patala along with the matriarchs.

verses.sanskrit: गौतम उवाच आराध्य पूर्वपुरुषं नारायणमनामयम् । अनादिनिधनं देवं धार्मिकं प्राप्नुयात् सुतम्
verses.transliteration: gautama uvāca ārādhya pūrvapuruṣaṃ nārāyaṇamanāmayam / anādinidhanaṃ devaṃ dhārmikaṃ prāpnuyāt sutam
verses.translation: It was here that the Tamasa form of Visnu, the cause of annihilation of the world existed. The unmanifest lord Hari remains there in the form of Nrsirhha (Man-lion).
verses.hindi: सुषेणश्च तथोदायी भद्रसेनो महाबलः । ऋजुदासो भद्रदासः कीर्तिमानपि पूर्वजः हतेष्वेतेषु सर्वेषु रोहिणी वसुदेवतः!
verses.wordMeaning: It was here that the Tamasa form of Visnu, the cause of annihilation of the world existed. The unmanifest lord Hari remains there in the form of Nrsirhha (Man-lion).
verses.commentary: Sense: It was here that the Tamasa form of Visnu, the cause of annihilation of the world existed. The unmanifest lord Hari remains there in the form of Nrsirhha (Man-lion).

verses.sanskrit: यस्य पुत्रः स्वयं ब्रह्मा पौत्रः स्यान्नीललोहितः । तमादिकृष्णमीशानमाराध्याप्नोति सत्सुतम्
verses.transliteration: yasya putraḥ svayaṃ brahmā pautraḥ syānnīlalohitaḥ / tamādikṛṣṇamīśānamārādhyāpnoti satsutam
verses.translation: Then Sambhu of the form of Ananta (the infinite) was well worshipped by even Sesa; Lord Kalagni Rudra united his own Atman to the Supreme Soul.
verses.hindi: असूत रामं लोकेशं बलभद्रं हलायुधम् जातेऽथ रामे देवानामादिमात्मानमच्युतम्।
verses.wordMeaning: Then Sambhu of the form of Ananta (the infinite) was well worshipped by even Sesa; Lord Kalagni Rudra united his own Atman to the Supreme Soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Sambhu of the form of Ananta (the infinite) was well worshipped by even Sesa; Lord Kalagni Rudra united his own Atman to the Supreme Soul.

verses.sanskrit: न यस्य भगवान् ब्रह्मा प्रभावं वेत्ति तत्त्वतः । तमाराध्य हृषीकेशं प्राप्नुयाद्धार्मिकं सुतम्
verses.transliteration: na yasya bhagavān brahmā prabhāvaṃ vetti tattvataḥ / tamārādhya hṛṣīkeśaṃ prāpnuyāddhārmikaṃ sutam
verses.translation: Even as the lord was in the Yogic unison, the hungry mothers bowed down to the three-eyed Mahadeva and said to him:
verses.hindi: असूत देवकी कृष्णं श्रीवत्साङ्कितवक्षसम् तस्यामुत्पादयामास पुत्रौ द्वौ निशठोल्मुको
verses.wordMeaning: Even as the lord was in the Yogic unison, the hungry mothers bowed down to the three-eyed Mahadeva and said to him:
verses.commentary: Sense: Even as the lord was in the Yogic unison, the hungry mothers bowed down to the three-eyed Mahadeva and said to him:

verses.sanskrit: स गौतमवचः श्रुत्वा युवनाश्वो महीपतिः । आराधयन्महायोगं वासुदेवं सनातनम्
verses.transliteration: sa gautamavacaḥ śrutvā yuvanāśvo mahīpatiḥ / ārādhayanmahāyogaṃ vāsudevaṃ sanātanam
verses.translation: "O Mahadeva, we are hungry. It behoves you to permit us. We shall eat up the three worlds. We will have no satisfaction otherwise."
verses.hindi: द्विजोत्तमो! आहुकके दो पुत्र हुए--उग्रसेन और देवक। देवकके देवताओंके समान देववान्, उपदेव, सुदेव तथा देवरक्षित नामवाले चार वीर पुत्र हुए। इनकी सात बहनें थीं--वृकदेवा, उपदेवा, देवरक्षिता, श्रीदेवा, शान्तिदेवा, सहदेवा, सुव्रता तथा देवकी। इनमें सुन्दर मध्यभागवाली देवकी सबसे बड़ी थी। ये सभी वसुदेवको दी गर्यी
verses.wordMeaning: "O Mahadeva, we are hungry. It behoves you to permit us. We shall eat up the three worlds. We will have no satisfaction otherwise."
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Mahadeva, we are hungry. It behoves you to permit us. We shall eat up the three worlds. We will have no satisfaction otherwise."

verses.sanskrit: तस्य पुत्रो ऽभवद् वीरः श्रावस्तिरिति विश्रुतः । निर्मिता येन श्रावस्तिर्गौडदेशे महापुरी
verses.transliteration: tasya putro 'bhavad vīraḥ śrāvastiriti viśrutaḥ / nirmitā yena śrāvastirgauḍadeśe mahāpurī
verses.translation: After saying this much, the Mothersborn of Visnu, devoured the three worlds including the mobile and immobile beings.
verses.hindi: उग्रसेनके न्यग्रोध, कंस, सुभूमि, राष्ट्रपाल, तुष्टिमान् तथा शङ्कु नामवाले पुत्र थे। भजमानका प्रख्यात विदूरथ नामवाला पुत्र हुआ। उसका पुत्र शूर, उससे शमि और शमिका प्रतिक्षत्र नामक पुत्र हुआ। उस (प्रतिक्षत्र)- से स्वयम्भोज और उससे शत्रुओंको ताप पहुँचानेवाला पुत्र हृदिक हुआ। उसका पुत्र कृतवर्मा और उसका पुत्र देवर कहलाया। उस शूरसे धीमान् हुआ और उसका पुत्र वसुदेव था
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this much, the Mothersborn of Visnu, devoured the three worlds including the mobile and immobile beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this much, the Mothersborn of Visnu, devoured the three worlds including the mobile and immobile beings.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माच्च बृहदश्वो ऽभूत् तस्मात् कुवलयाश्वकः । धुन्धुमारत्वमगमद् धुन्धुं हत्वा महासुरम्
verses.transliteration: tasmācca bṛhadaśvo 'bhūt tasmāt kuvalayāśvakaḥ / dhundhumāratvamagamad dhundhuṃ hatvā mahāsuram
verses.translation: Then lord Bhairava meditated on lord Narayana, Hari with the physical form of Man-lion and bowed down to him with palms joined in reverence.
verses.hindi: विष्णु वसुदेवसे देवकी-पुत्रके रूपमें प्रकट हुए। वसुदेवकी महाभाग्यशालिनी सुन्दर रोहिणी नामक पत्नीने हलको आयुधके रूपमें धारण करनेवाले ज्येष्ठ पुत्र संकर्षण राम (बलराम)-को जन्म दिया। वह परमात्मा (विष्णु) ही ये जगन्मय (वसुदेवपुत्र) वासुदेव हँ । हलायुध (बलराम) संकर्षण स्वयं साक्षात् प्रभु शेष हैं॥ ६९--७१ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Then lord Bhairava meditated on lord Narayana, Hari with the physical form of Man-lion and bowed down to him with palms joined in reverence.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then lord Bhairava meditated on lord Narayana, Hari with the physical form of Man-lion and bowed down to him with palms joined in reverence.

verses.sanskrit: धुन्धुमारस्य तनयास्त्रयः प्रोक्ता द्विजोत्तमाः । दृढाश्वश्चैव दण्डाश्वः कपिलाश्वस्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: dhundhumārasya tanayāstrayaḥ proktā dvijottamāḥ / dṛḍhāśvaścaiva daṇḍāśvaḥ kapilāśvastathaiva ca
verses.translation: After reaching the vicinity of Visnu, all those des¬ tructive deities transferred their powers unto Sambhu, Bhairava, of excessive refulgence.
verses.hindi: भृगुके शापके कारण वे माधव विष्णु भी मनुष्य- शरीर स्वीकार कर उन देवकी तथा रोहिणीसे उत्पन्न हुए। उमाकी देहसे उत्पन्न योगनिद्रारूप कौशिकीदेवी वासुदेवकी आज्ञासे यशोदाकी पुत्री हुई मुनिश्रेष्ठो ! वसुदेवके अन्य जो वासुदेव नामवाले ज्येष्ठ पुत्र थे उन सबको कंसने पहले ही मार डाला। सुषेण, उदायी, भद्रसेन, महाबल, ऋजुदास, भद्रदास और पूर्वमें उत्पन्न कीर्तिमान्-इन सभी (वासुदेवके बड़े भाइयों) -
verses.wordMeaning: After reaching the vicinity of Visnu, all those des¬ tructive deities transferred their powers unto Sambhu, Bhairava, of excessive refulgence.
verses.commentary: Sense: After reaching the vicinity of Visnu, all those des¬ tructive deities transferred their powers unto Sambhu, Bhairava, of excessive refulgence.

verses.sanskrit: दृढाश्वस्य प्रमोदस्तु हर्यश्वस्तस्य चात्मजः । हर्यश्वस्य निकुम्भस्तु निकुम्भात् संहताश्वकः
verses.transliteration: dṛḍhāśvasya pramodastu haryaśvastasya cātmajaḥ / haryaśvasya nikumbhastu nikumbhāt saṃhatāśvakaḥ
verses.translation: The mothers then saw the most terrible Man-lion, the source of origin of the universe, and the serpent Sesa attain¬ ing unity instantaneously.
verses.hindi: के मारे जानेपर रोहिणीने वसुदेवसे संसारके स्वामी हलायुध बलभद्र राम (बलराम)-को जन्म दिया॥ ७४--७६॥ राम (बलराम)-के उत्पन्न होनेके पश्चात् देवकीने
verses.wordMeaning: The mothers then saw the most terrible Man-lion, the source of origin of the universe, and the serpent Sesa attain¬ ing unity instantaneously.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mothers then saw the most terrible Man-lion, the source of origin of the universe, and the serpent Sesa attain¬ ing unity instantaneously.

verses.sanskrit: कृशाश्वश्च रणाश्वश्च संहताश्वस्य वै सुतौ । युवनाश्वो रणाश्वस्य शक्रतुल्यबलो युधि
verses.transliteration: kṛśāśvaśca raṇāśvaśca saṃhatāśvasya vai sutau / yuvanāśvo raṇāśvasya śakratulyabalo yudhi
verses.translation: "Those who are the devotees of the trident-wielding lord and those who remember me should be assiduously protected.
verses.hindi: सुशोभित वक्षःस्थलवाले अच्युत कृष्णको जन्म दिया बलरामकी सुन्दर गुणोंसे युक्त रेवती नामकी भार्या थीं । उन्होंने उनसे निशठ तथा उल्मुक नामक दो पुत्रोंको उत्पन्न किया
verses.wordMeaning: "Those who are the devotees of the trident-wielding lord and those who remember me should be assiduously protected.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Those who are the devotees of the trident-wielding lord and those who remember me should be assiduously protected.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा तु वारुणीमिष्टिमृषीणां वै प्रसादतः । लेभे त्वप्रतिमं पुत्रं विष्णुभक्तमनुत्तमम् । मान्धातारं महाप्राज्ञं सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरम्
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā tu vāruṇīmiṣṭimṛṣīṇāṃ vai prasādataḥ / lebhe tvapratimaṃ putraṃ viṣṇubhaktamanuttamam / māndhātāraṃ mahāprājñaṃ sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ varam
verses.translation: This unequalled form that destroys everything is my own, and is born of Mahesvara's person. It bestows worldly pleasures and liberation.
verses.hindi: घोडशस्त्रीसहस्त्राणि कृष्णस्याक्लिष्टकर्मण: । बभूवुरात्मजास्तासु शतशोऽथ सहस्त्रश: रुक्मिण्यां वासुदेवस्य महाबलपराक्रमाः । विशिष्टाः सर्वपुत्राणां सम्बभूवुरिमे सुता:
verses.wordMeaning: This unequalled form that destroys everything is my own, and is born of Mahesvara's person. It bestows worldly pleasures and liberation.
verses.commentary: Sense: This unequalled form that destroys everything is my own, and is born of Mahesvara's person. It bestows worldly pleasures and liberation.

verses.sanskrit: मान्धातुः पुरुकुत्सो ऽभूदम्बरीषश्च वीर्यवान् । मुचुकुन्दश्च पुण्यात्मा सर्वे शक्रसमा युधि
verses.transliteration: māndhātuḥ purukutso 'bhūdambarīṣaśca vīryavān / mucukundaśca puṇyātmā sarve śakrasamā yudhi
verses.translation: Lord Kala, the infinite and the four-faced Brahma, the god of gods are but two aspects viz. Tamasa and Rajasa, of mine, (the former being characterised by the Tamasa and the latter by the Rajasa aspect).
verses.hindi: मम त्वं पुण्डरीकाक्ष विशिष्टं गुणवत्तमम् । सुरेशसदूशं पुत्रं देहि दानवसूदन समारेभे तपः कर्तु तपोनिधिररिंदमः
verses.wordMeaning: Lord Kala, the infinite and the four-faced Brahma, the god of gods are but two aspects viz. Tamasa and Rajasa, of mine, (the former being characterised by the Tamasa and the latter by the Rajasa aspect).
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Kala, the infinite and the four-faced Brahma, the god of gods are but two aspects viz. Tamasa and Rajasa, of mine, (the former being characterised by the Tamasa and the latter by the Rajasa aspect).

verses.sanskrit: अम्बरीषस्य दायादो युवनाश्वो ऽपरः स्मृतः । हरितो युवनाश्वस्य हारितस्तत्सुतो ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: ambarīṣasya dāyādo yuvanāśvo 'paraḥ smṛtaḥ / harito yuvanāśvasya hāritastatsuto 'bhavat
verses.translation: It is I that utterly unthwartable god Kala, the calculator of the universe, who, at the end of the kalpa, will devour the entire universe by assuming the form of Rudra.
verses.hindi: तच्छृणुध्वं मुनिश्रेष्ठा यथासौ देवकीसुतः । दृष्टा लेभे सुतं रुद्रं तप्त्वा तीव्रं महत् तपः (वसुदेव-देवकीसे उत्पन्न साक्षात् विष्णु) अक्लिष्टकर्मा श्रीकुष्णकी सोलह हजार पल्रियाँ थीं और उनसे सैकड़ों हजारों पुत्र हुए। वासुदेव श्रीकृष्णकी पत्नी रुक्मिणीसे
verses.wordMeaning: It is I that utterly unthwartable god Kala, the calculator of the universe, who, at the end of the kalpa, will devour the entire universe by assuming the form of Rudra.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is I that utterly unthwartable god Kala, the calculator of the universe, who, at the end of the kalpa, will devour the entire universe by assuming the form of Rudra.

verses.sanskrit: पुरुकुत्सस्य दायादस्त्रसदस्युर्महायशाः । नर्मदायां समुत्पन्नः संभूतिस्तत्सुतो ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: purukutsasya dāyādastrasadasyurmahāyaśāḥ / narmadāyāṃ samutpannaḥ saṃbhūtistatsuto 'bhavat
verses.translation: That fascinating form of mine which abounds in Sattva gum and is called Narayana, stabilises and protects the universe for ever.
verses.hindi: सम्पन्न पुत्र हुए। ये पुत्र सभी पुत्रोंमें विशिष्ट हुए ॥ ७९--८१॥ रुक्मिणीसे उत्पन्न इन वीर पुत्रोंको देखकर पवित्र मुसकानवाली पत्नी जाम्बवतीने अपने पति जनार्दन श्रीकृष्णसे कहा-पुण्डरीकाक्ष! दानवसूदन! आप मुझे इन्द्रके समान विशिष्ट गुणवानोंमें श्रेष्ठ पुत्र प्रदान करें। जाम्बवतीका
verses.wordMeaning: That fascinating form of mine which abounds in Sattva gum and is called Narayana, stabilises and protects the universe for ever.
verses.commentary: Sense: That fascinating form of mine which abounds in Sattva gum and is called Narayana, stabilises and protects the universe for ever.

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुवृद्धः सुतस्तस्य त्वनरण्यो ऽभवत् परः । बृहदशवो ऽनरण्यस्य हर्यश्वस्तत्सुतो ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: viṣṇuvṛddhaḥ sutastasya tvanaraṇyo 'bhavat paraḥ / bṛhadaśavo 'naraṇyasya haryaśvastatsuto 'bhavat
verses.translation: That Visnu, the greatest Brahman, the Supreme Atman, the ultimate goal, the unmanifest primordial nature, is mentioned as Sadananda (ever blissful)."
verses.hindi: कथन सुनकर शत्रुओंका दमन करनेवाले तपोनिधि जगन्नाथ स्वयं हरिने तप करना प्रारम्भ किया॥ ८२--८४॥ मुनिश्रेष्ठो ! उन देवकीपुत्र ( श्रीकृष्ण) -ने जिस प्रकार अत्यन्त तीव्र महान् तपके द्वारा रुद्रका दर्शनकर पुत्र प्राप्त किया, उस (वृत्तान्त)-को आपलोग सुनें
verses.wordMeaning: That Visnu, the greatest Brahman, the Supreme Atman, the ultimate goal, the unmanifest primordial nature, is mentioned as Sadananda (ever blissful)."
verses.commentary: Sense: That Visnu, the greatest Brahman, the Supreme Atman, the ultimate goal, the unmanifest primordial nature, is mentioned as Sadananda (ever blissful)."

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽतीव धार्मिको राजा कर्दमस्य प्रजापतेः । प्रसादाद्धार्मिकं पुत्रं लेभे सूर्यपरायणम्
verses.transliteration: so 'tīva dhārmiko rājā kardamasya prajāpateḥ / prasādāddhārmikaṃ putraṃ lebhe sūryaparāyaṇam
verses.translation: The goddesses, the Vaisnavite matriarchs who were thus enlightened by Visnu sought ultimate refuge in that great lord alone.
verses.hindi: पुत्र-प्रासिके लिये तपस्या करने-हेतु भगवान् श्रीकृष्णका महामुनि उपमन्युके आश्रममें जाना, महामुनि उपमन्युद्वारा उन्हें पाशुपत-योग प्रदान करना, तपस्यामें निरत कृष्णको शिव-पार्वतीका दर्शन और श्रीकृष्णद्वारा उनकी स्तुति करना, शिवद्वारा पुत्रप्राप्तिका वर देना तथा माता पार्वतीद्वारा अनेक वर देना और शिवके साथ श्रीकृष्णका कैलास-गमन
verses.wordMeaning: The goddesses, the Vaisnavite matriarchs who were thus enlightened by Visnu sought ultimate refuge in that great lord alone.
verses.commentary: Sense: The goddesses, the Vaisnavite matriarchs who were thus enlightened by Visnu sought ultimate refuge in that great lord alone.

verses.sanskrit: स तु सूर्यं समभ्यर्च्य राजा वसुमनाः शुभम् । लेभे त्वप्रतिमं पुत्रं त्रिधन्वानमरिन्दमम्
verses.transliteration: sa tu sūryaṃ samabhyarcya rājā vasumanāḥ śubham / lebhe tvapratimaṃ putraṃ tridhanvānamarindamam
verses.translation: The episode of the incarnation of Mahavisnu as the son of Aditi- Kasyapa and his subsequent assumption of the cosmic form, etc. as given here closely follows the version in the Bh. P. VIII skandha & not the one in Pd. P. wherein he (Mahavisnu) pushes the demon Dhundhu the same way. The significant difference between the Vamana episode in the KP & Bh. P. is that in the KP. Sukra does not come in the way of Bali while he was about to donate three paces of land, and Visnu does not push Bali down to the nether world. Bali saw the transformation of the dwarf Vamana into the cosmic figure and occupying the three worlds with three steps and his re¬ assumption of a dwarf (Vamana) form. He completes the formality of gift by pouring water on his hand and as p)er his advice enters Patala to lead a life devoted to Visnu.
verses.hindi: अथ देवो हृषीकेशो भगवान् पुरुषोत्तमः। तताप घोरं पुत्रार्थ निदानं तपसस्तपः सूतजी बोले--हषीकेश भगवान् पुरुषोत्तम देवने पुत्र-प्रामिके लिये तपस्याके निदान-रूपमें (सर्वोत्कृष्ट)
verses.wordMeaning: The episode of the incarnation of Mahavisnu as the son of Aditi- Kasyapa and his subsequent assumption of the cosmic form, etc. as given here closely follows the version in the Bh. P. VIII skandha & not the one in Pd. P.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The episode of the incarnation of Mahavisnu as the son of Aditi- Kasyapa and his subsequent assumption of the cosmic form, etc. as given here closely follows the version in the Bh. P. VIII skandha & not the one in Pd. P.…

verses.sanskrit: अयजच्चाश्वमेधेन शत्रून् जित्वा द्विजोत्तमाः । स्वाध्यायवान् दानशीलस्तितिक्षुर्धर्मतत्परः
verses.transliteration: ayajaccāśvamedhena śatrūn jitvā dvijottamāḥ / svādhyāyavān dānaśīlastitikṣurdharmatatparaḥ
verses.translation: The KP. differs from the NP. about the end of Virocana. Here he is said to have abdicated the throne in favour of his son Bali and have resorted to the path of Yoga, while in the NP he, at the request of his queen, gave up his life as a price for the water used for washing the feet of the old Brahmin (god Visnu in disguise).
verses.hindi: घोर तपस्या की । अपनी इच्छासे ही अवतीर्ण कृतकृत्य, विश्वको धारण करनेवाले ये श्रीकृष्ण (अपने) स्वरूपके मूल ईश्वर-भावका परिज्ञान करानेके लिये (उत्तम तपः- स्थलके अन्वेषणके बहाने पक्षिराज गरुड़पर आरूढ होकर) विचरण करने लगे। हाथोंमें शङ्ख, चक्र, गदा
verses.wordMeaning: The KP. differs from the NP. about the end of Virocana. Here he is said to have abdicated the throne in favour of his son Bali and have resorted to the path of Yoga, while in the NP he, at the request of his queen,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The KP. differs from the NP. about the end of Virocana. Here he is said to have abdicated the throne in favour of his son Bali and have resorted to the path of Yoga, while in the NP he, at the request of his queen,…

verses.sanskrit: ऋषयस्तु समाजग्मुर्यज्ञवाटं महात्मनः । वसिष्ठकश्यपमुखा देवाश्चेन्द्रपुरोगमाः
verses.transliteration: ṛṣayastu samājagmuryajñavāṭaṃ mahātmanaḥ / vasiṣṭhakaśyapamukhā devāścendrapurogamāḥ
verses.translation: While he was reigning thus, once, the holy lord, the great sage, Sanatkumara came to his city at the instance of Visnu.
verses.hindi: लिये तथा श्रीवत्सके चिहसे चिहित ( श्रीकृष्ण) योगियोंद्वारा सेवित, अनेक प्रकारके पक्षिसमूहोंसे व्याप्त मुनीन्द्र शङ्खचक्रगदापाणिः श्रीवत्सकृतलक्षण: ॥ ४॥  महात्मा उपमन्युके आश्रममें पहुंचे ॥ १--४॥
verses.wordMeaning: While he was reigning thus, once, the holy lord, the great sage, Sanatkumara came to his city at the instance of Visnu.
verses.commentary: Sense: While he was reigning thus, once, the holy lord, the great sage, Sanatkumara came to his city at the instance of Visnu.

verses.sanskrit: तान् प्रणम्य महाराजः पप्रच्छ विनयान्वितः । समाप्य विधिवद् यज्ञं वसिष्ठादीन् द्विजोत्तमान्
verses.transliteration: tān praṇamya mahārājaḥ papraccha vinayānvitaḥ / samāpya vidhivad yajñaṃ vasiṣṭhādīn dvijottamān
verses.translation: The great Asura who had been seated on the throne, got up and went near the son of Brahma. He bent down his head and with palms joined in reverence, spoke these words.
verses.hindi: जो तपस्या उत्कृष्ट तपस्याके लिये दृष्टान्त होती है, तपस्याकी सत्यताका निकष (कसौटी) होती है, उसे तपस्याका नानाद्रुमलताकोर्ण
verses.wordMeaning: The great Asura who had been seated on the throne, got up and went near the son of Brahma. He bent down his head and with palms joined in reverence, spoke these words.
verses.commentary: Sense: The great Asura who had been seated on the throne, got up and went near the son of Brahma. He bent down his head and with palms joined in reverence, spoke these words.

verses.sanskrit: वसुमना उवाच किंस्विच्छेयस्करतरं लोके ऽस्मिन् ब्राह्मणर्षभाः । यज्ञस्तपो वा संन्यासो ब्रूत मे सर्ववेदिनः
verses.transliteration: vasumanā uvāca kiṃsviccheyaskarataraṃ loke 'smin brāhmaṇarṣabhāḥ / yajñastapo vā saṃnyāso brūta me sarvavedinaḥ
