verses.translation: "Blessed I am and favoured with grace, since the glorious Lord of Yogins, the expert knower of the Vedas or Brahman, has today personally visited my excellent town.
verses.hindi: सिंहर््षणरभाकीर्ण शार्दूलगजसंयुतम्। विमलस्वादुपानीयैः सरोभिरुपशोभितम् आरामैर्विविधेर्जुष्टं देवतायतनैः शुभैः। ऋषिकैर्षिपुत्रैश्च महामुनिगणैस्तथा
verses.wordMeaning: "Blessed I am and favoured with grace, since the glorious Lord of Yogins, the expert knower of the Vedas or Brahman, has today personally visited my excellent town.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Blessed I am and favoured with grace, since the glorious Lord of Yogins, the expert knower of the Vedas or Brahman, has today personally visited my excellent town.

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठ उवाच अधीत्य वेदान् विधिवत् पुत्रानुत्पाद्य धर्मतः । इष्ट्वा यज्ञेश्वरं यज्ञैर् गच्छेद वनमथात्मवान्
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭha uvāca adhītya vedān vidhivat putrānutpādya dharmataḥ / iṣṭvā yajñeśvaraṃ yajñair gaccheda vanamathātmavān
verses.translation: O scholarly Brahmana, why have you come? You are the lord Pitamaha himself. O son of Brahma, tell me, what behest shall I carry out for you?
verses.hindi: वेदाध्ययनसम्पन्नैः सेवितं चाग्रिहोत्रिभिः । योगिभिर्ध्याननिरतेर्नासाग्रगतलोचने: नदीभिरभितो जुष्टं जापकैर्ब्रह्मवादिभिः
verses.wordMeaning: O scholarly Brahmana, why have you come? You are the lord Pitamaha himself. O son of Brahma, tell me, what behest shall I carry out for you?
verses.commentary: Sense: O scholarly Brahmana, why have you come? You are the lord Pitamaha himself. O son of Brahma, tell me, what behest shall I carry out for you?

verses.sanskrit: पुलस्त्य उवाच आराध्य तपसा देवं योगिनं परमेष्ठिनम् । प्रव्रजेद् विधिवद् यज्ञैरिष्ट्वा पूर्वं सुरोत्तमान्
verses.transliteration: pulastya uvāca ārādhya tapasā devaṃ yoginaṃ parameṣṭhinam / pravrajed vidhivad yajñairiṣṭvā pūrvaṃ surottamān
verses.translation: The holy lord spoke to the great Asura endowed with piety: I have come here to see you. You are very fortunate.
verses.hindi: सेवितं तापसैः पुण्यैरीशाराधनतत्परैः । प्रशान्तैः सत्यसंकल्पैर्निःशोकैर्निरुपद्रवैः सेवितं तापसैर्नित्यं ज्ञानिभिर्ब्रह्मचारिभिः
verses.wordMeaning: The holy lord spoke to the great Asura endowed with piety: I have come here to see you. You are very fortunate.
verses.commentary: Sense: The holy lord spoke to the great Asura endowed with piety: I have come here to see you. You are very fortunate.

verses.sanskrit: पुलह उवाच यमाहुरेकं पुरुषं पुराणं परमेश्वरम् । तमाराध्य सहस्त्रांशुं तपसा मोक्षमाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: pulaha uvāca yamāhurekaṃ puruṣaṃ purāṇaṃ parameśvaram / tamārādhya sahastrāṃśuṃ tapasā mokṣamāpnuyāt
verses.translation: O excellent Daitya, this sort of policy is very rare among Daityas. There is certainly no other righteous person like you in the three worlds.
verses.hindi: गङ्गा भगवती नित्यं वहत्येवाघनाशिनी प्रोचुरन्योन्यमव्यक्तमादिदेवं महामुनिम्
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Daitya, this sort of policy is very rare among Daityas. There is certainly no other righteous person like you in the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Daitya, this sort of policy is very rare among Daityas. There is certainly no other righteous person like you in the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: जमदग्निरुवाच अजस्य नाभावध्येकमीश्वरेण समर्पितम् । बीजं भगवता येन स देवस्तपसेज्यते
verses.transliteration: jamadagniruvāca ajasya nābhāvadhyekamīśvareṇa samarpitam / bījaṃ bhagavatā yena sa devastapasejyate
verses.translation: The king of Asuras who had been addressed thus, spoke again to the great sage—O holy one, the most excel¬ lent among the knowers of Brahman, elucidate unto me the greatest of all virtues.
verses.hindi: अयं स भगवानेकः साक्षान्नारायणः परः। आगच्छत्यधुना देवः पुराणपुरुषः स्वयम् वह आश्रम विविध प्रकारके वृक्ष और लताओंसे व्याप्त, अनेक प्रकारके पुष्पोंसे सुशोभित, ऋषियोंके आश्रमोंसे युक्त तथा वेदमन्त्रोंको ध्वनियोंसे निनादित था। सिंह, भालू, शरभ, व्याघ्र और हाथियोंसे व्याप्त था;
verses.wordMeaning: The king of Asuras who had been addressed thus, spoke again to the great sage—O holy one, the most excel¬ lent among the knowers of Brahman, elucidate unto me the greatest of all virtues.
verses.commentary: Sense: The king of Asuras who had been addressed thus, spoke again to the great sage—O holy one, the most excel¬ lent among the knowers of Brahman, elucidate unto me the greatest of all virtues.

verses.sanskrit: विश्वामित्र उवाच यो ऽग्निः सर्वात्मको ऽनन्तः स्वयंभूर्विश्वतोमुखः । स रुद्रस्तपसोग्रेण पूज्यते नेतरैर्मखैः
verses.transliteration: viśvāmitra uvāca yo 'gniḥ sarvātmako 'nantaḥ svayaṃbhūrviśvatomukhaḥ / sa rudrastapasogreṇa pūjyate netarairmakhaiḥ
verses.translation: The glorious Yogi imparted to the noble-sou led king of Daityas the secret-most perfect knowledge of the Atman which is the highest Dharma.
verses.hindi: स्वच्छ, स्वादयुक्त, पीने योग्य जलवाले सरोवरोंसे सुशोभित था; विविध प्रकारके उद्यानों तथा शुभ देवमन्दिरोंसे सम्पन्न था। ऋषियों, ऋषिपुत्रो, महामुनिगणों, वेदाध्ययनसम्पन्न तथा अग्निहोत्र करनेवालोंसे सेवित था नासिकाके अग्रभागमें जिनकी दृष्टि लगी हुई है, ऐसे ध्यानपरायण योगियोंसे युक्त, सभी प्रकारसे पवित्र, तत्त्वदर्शी ज्ञानियोंसे सेवित और चारों ओर नदियोंसे घिरा था। वह आश्रम ब्रह्मवादी जापकों, शंकरकी आराधनामें निरत पवित्र तपस्वियोंसे
verses.wordMeaning: The glorious Yogi imparted to the noble-sou led king of Daityas the secret-most perfect knowledge of the Atman which is the highest Dharma.
verses.commentary: Sense: The glorious Yogi imparted to the noble-sou led king of Daityas the secret-most perfect knowledge of the Atman which is the highest Dharma.

verses.sanskrit: भरद्वाज उवाच यो यज्ञैरिज्यते देवो जातवेदाः सनातनः । स सर्वदैवततनुः पूज्यते तपसेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: bharadvāja uvāca yo yajñairijyate devo jātavedāḥ sanātanaḥ / sa sarvadaivatatanuḥ pūjyate tapaseśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Having obtained the greatest knowledge and given Dakfina (money by way of fees) unto the preceptor, he entrusted the burden of kingdom to his son and he became interested in the regular practice of Yoga.
verses.hindi: सेवित, सत्यसंकल्पवाले, परम शान्त, शोक तथा उपद्रबरहित, यथाविधि सभी अआङ्गोंमें भस्म लगाये हुए रुद्रके जपमें परायण, मुण्डित या मात्र जटा रखे हुए तथा जटाके समान शिखावाले अन्य तपस्वियों, ज्ञानियों और ब्रह्मचारियोंसे नित्य सेवित था
verses.wordMeaning: Having obtained the greatest knowledge and given Dakfina (money by way of fees) unto the preceptor, he entrusted the burden of kingdom to his son and he became interested in the regular practice of Yoga.
verses.commentary: Sense: Having obtained the greatest knowledge and given Dakfina (money by way of fees) unto the preceptor, he entrusted the burden of kingdom to his son and he became interested in the regular practice of Yoga.

verses.sanskrit: अत्रिरुवाच यतः सर्वमिदं जातं यस्यापत्यं प्रजापतिः । तपः सुमहदास्थाय पूज्यते स महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: atriruvāca yataḥ sarvamidaṃ jātaṃ yasyāpatyaṃ prajāpatiḥ / tapaḥ sumahadāsthāya pūjyate sa maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: That son of his was the great and intelligent Asura named Bali. He was favourably disposed towards Brahmanas. He was extremely virtuous. Then he conquered Purandara.
verses.hindi: वहाँ सिंद्धोंके आश्रमोंसे सुशोभित उस रमणीय श्रेष्ठ आश्रममें पापोंका नाश करनेवाली भगवती गङ्गा नित्य तपस्वियोंको ढूँढ़-दूँढ़कर उनके समीप जाकर उन्हें सविधि प्रणाम किया और स्तुतिपूर्वक उनकी पूजा की
verses.wordMeaning: That son of his was the great and intelligent Asura named Bali. He was favourably disposed towards Brahmanas. He was extremely virtuous. Then he conquered Purandara.
verses.commentary: Sense: That son of his was the great and intelligent Asura named Bali. He was favourably disposed towards Brahmanas. He was extremely virtuous. Then he conquered Purandara.

verses.sanskrit: गौतम उवाच यतः प्रधानपुरुषौ यस्य शक्तिमयं जगत् । स देवदेवस्तपसा पूजनीयः सनातनः
verses.transliteration: gautama uvāca yataḥ pradhānapuruṣau yasya śaktimayaṃ jagat / sa devadevastapasā pūjanīyaḥ sanātanaḥ
verses.translation: Indra, surrounded by all Devas fought a great battle with him. On being defeated, he sought refuge in lord Visnu, Acyuta (the infallible).
verses.hindi: (श्रीकृष्ण)-को देखकर उन्होंने (तपस्वियोंने) भक्तिपूर्वक प्रणाम किया और अव्यक्त, आदिदेव, महामुनि तथा उन सनातन (देव)-का हृदयमें ध्यानकर वैदिक मन्त्रोंसे उनकी स्तुति करने लगे और आपसमें कहने लगे ये वही अद्वितीय परम साक्षात् नारायण भगवान् हैं। स्वयं पुराणपुरुष देव ही इस समय आये हुए हैं। ये ही अव्यय हैं, सृष्टि करनेवाले, संहार करनेवाले तथा पालन करनेवाले ये ही हैं। अमूर्त होते हुए भी ये मूर्तिमान्
verses.wordMeaning: Indra, surrounded by all Devas fought a great battle with him. On being defeated, he sought refuge in lord Visnu, Acyuta (the infallible).
verses.commentary: Sense: Indra, surrounded by all Devas fought a great battle with him. On being defeated, he sought refuge in lord Visnu, Acyuta (the infallible).

verses.sanskrit: कश्यप उवाच सहस्त्रनयनो देवः साक्षी स तु प्रजापतिः । प्रसीदति महायोगी पूजितस्तपसा परः
verses.transliteration: kaśyapa uvāca sahastranayano devaḥ sākṣī sa tu prajāpatiḥ / prasīdati mahāyogī pūjitastapasā paraḥ
verses.translation: In the filament of the lotus of her heart, she con¬ centrated her mind on Vasudeva, the unsullied great region, devoid of beginning and end, the blissful, unique firmament.
verses.hindi: होकर मुनियोंको देखनेके लिये यहाँ आये हुए हैं। ये धाता, विधाता और सर्वव्यापी ही आ रहे हैं। ये अनादि, अक्षय, अनन्त, महाभूत और महेश्वर हैं वाणीके अगोचर गोविन्द हरि उन (तपस्वियों)-के वचनोंको सुनते हुए शीघ्र ही उन महात्मा (उपमन्यु)- के स्थानपर गये
verses.wordMeaning: In the filament of the lotus of her heart, she con¬ centrated her mind on Vasudeva, the unsullied great region, devoid of beginning and end, the blissful, unique firmament.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the filament of the lotus of her heart, she con¬ centrated her mind on Vasudeva, the unsullied great region, devoid of beginning and end, the blissful, unique firmament.

verses.sanskrit: क्रतुरुवाच प्राप्ताध्ययनयज्ञस् लब्धपुत्रस्य चैव हि । नान्तरेण तपः कश्चिद्धर्मः शास्त्रेषु दृश्यते
verses.transliteration: kraturuvāca prāptādhyayanayajñas labdhaputrasya caiva hi / nāntareṇa tapaḥ kaściddharmaḥ śāstreṣu dṛśyate
verses.translation: The delighted lord Visnu, Hari the wielder of a conch, a discus and a mace {Sankha, Cakra and Gada), the Yogic Atman appeared in front of the mother of Devas.
verses.hindi: चकार देवकीसूनुर्देवर्षिपितृतर्पणम् समीक्ष्य वासुदेवं तं शार्ङ्गशङ्टासिधारिणम् । तस्थिरे निश्चलाः सर्वे शुभाङ्गं तन्निवासिनः
verses.wordMeaning: The delighted lord Visnu, Hari the wielder of a conch, a discus and a mace {Sankha, Cakra and Gada), the Yogic Atman appeared in front of the mother of Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The delighted lord Visnu, Hari the wielder of a conch, a discus and a mace {Sankha, Cakra and Gada), the Yogic Atman appeared in front of the mother of Devas.

verses.sanskrit: इत्याकर्ण्य स राजर्षिस्तान् प्रणम्यातिहृष्टधीः । विसर्जयित्वा संपूज्य त्रिधन्वानमथाब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: ityākarṇya sa rājarṣistān praṇamyātihṛṣṭadhīḥ / visarjayitvā saṃpūjya tridhanvānamathābravīt
verses.translation: On seeing Visnu arrived, Aditi endowed with devotion considered herself as having attained her objects. She propitiated Kesava with the following eulogy.
verses.hindi: अथावगाह्य गङ्गायां कृत्वा देवादितर्पणम्। आदाय पुष्पवर्याणि मुनीन्द्रस्याविशद् गृहम् जटाचीरधरं शान्तं ननाम शिरसा मुनिम्
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing Visnu arrived, Aditi endowed with devotion considered herself as having attained her objects. She propitiated Kesava with the following eulogy.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing Visnu arrived, Aditi endowed with devotion considered herself as having attained her objects. She propitiated Kesava with the following eulogy.

verses.sanskrit: आराधयिष्ये तपसा देवमेकाक्षराह्वयम् । प्राणं बृहन्तं पुरुषमादित्यान्तरसंस्थितम्
verses.transliteration: ārādhayiṣye tapasā devamekākṣarāhvayam / prāṇaṃ bṛhantaṃ puruṣamādityāntarasaṃsthitam
verses.translation: Be victorious, O sole cause of destruction of all (lit. the floods of) miseries; Hail to you. Hail to you, O Lord, endowed with the advent of infinite greatness, glory to you. O Lord, with perfect knowledge as your physical form, O Lord devoid of beginning, middle and end. Victory to you, O one resembling the Ether; O one with unsullied bliss as your form
verses.hindi: आलोक्य कृष्णमायान्तं पूजयामास तत्त्ववित् । आसने चासयामास योगिनां प्रथमातिथिम् विष्णुमव्यक्तसंस्थानं शिष्यभावेन संस्थितम्
verses.wordMeaning: Be victorious, O sole cause of destruction of all (lit. the floods of) miseries; Hail to you. Hail to you, O Lord, endowed with the advent of infinite greatness, glory to you. O Lord, with perfect knowledge as your physical form, O Lord devoid of beginning, middle and end.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Be victorious, O sole cause of destruction of all (lit. the floods of) miseries; Hail to you. Hail to you, O Lord, endowed with the advent of infinite greatness, glory to you. O Lord, with perfect knowledge as your physical form, O Lord devoid of beginning, middle and end.…

verses.sanskrit: त्वं तु धर्मरतो नित्यं पालयैतदतन्द्रितः । चातुर्वर्ण्यसमायुक्तमशेषं क्षितिमण्डलम्
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ tu dharmarato nityaṃ pālayaitadatandritaḥ / cāturvarṇyasamāyuktamaśeṣaṃ kṣitimaṇḍalam
verses.translation: Obeisance to Visnu of the from of Kala. Salutations to you the Man-lion. Bow to you, to Sesa, Obeisance to Kalarudra, the cause of annihilation; Obeisance to you Vasudeva, salutations to you.
verses.hindi: स्वागतं ते हृषीकेश सफलानि तपांसि न: । यत् साक्षादेव विश्वात्मा मदगेहं विष्णुरागतः तादूशस्याथ भवतः किमागमनकारणम्।
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to Visnu of the from of Kala. Salutations to you the Man-lion. Bow to you, to Sesa, Obeisance to Kalarudra, the cause of annihilation; Obeisance to you Vasudeva, salutations to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to Visnu of the from of Kala. Salutations to you the Man-lion. Bow to you, to Sesa, Obeisance to Kalarudra, the cause of annihilation; Obeisance to you Vasudeva, salutations to you.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा स तद्राज्यं निधायात्मभवे नृपः । जगामारण्यमनघस्तपश्चर्तुमनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā sa tadrājyaṃ nidhāyātmabhave nṛpaḥ / jagāmāraṇyamanaghastapaścartumanuttamam
verses.translation: Obeisance to you, the wielder of Universal Maya. Obeisance to you, the Reality, comprehensible only through Yoga. Obeisance to you, founded in virtue and perfect knowledge. Obeisance to you, Varaha (the divine Boar); Obeisance to you again and again.
verses.hindi: शरुत्वोपमन्योस्तद् वाक्यं भगवान् केशिमर्दनः । व्याजहार महायोगी वचनं प्रणिपत्य तम् कथं स भगवानीशो दृश्यो योगविदां वरः। मयाचिरेण कुत्राहं द्रक्ष्यामि तमुमापतिम्
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you, the wielder of Universal Maya. Obeisance to you, the Reality, comprehensible only through Yoga. Obeisance to you, founded in virtue and perfect knowledge. Obeisance to you, Varaha (the divine Boar); Obeisance to you again and again.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you, the wielder of Universal Maya. Obeisance to you, the Reality, comprehensible only through Yoga. Obeisance to you, founded in virtue and perfect knowledge. Obeisance to you, Varaha (the divine Boar); Obeisance to you again and again.

verses.sanskrit: हिमवच्छिखरे रम्ये देवदारुवने शुभे । कन्दमूलफलाहारो मुन्यन्नैरयजत् सुरान्
verses.transliteration: himavacchikhare ramye devadāruvane śubhe / kandamūlaphalāhāro munyannairayajat surān
verses.translation: Obeisance to you, O Lord with form resembling (re¬ fulgent like) a thousand suns and moons. Obeisance to you, O Lord, accessible only through perfect Vedic knowledge and piety. Obeisance to the upholder of the Earth. Obeisance to the unmeasurable. Obeisance to you, O Lord, the source of the origin of the Universe. Obeisance again and again unto you.
verses.hindi: उन यदुवंशी देवकीपुत्र श्रीकृष्णने प्रत्येक तीर्थमें श्रद्धापूर्वक आचमनकर (मार्जनकर) देवता, ऋषि और पितरोंका तर्पण किया और मुनीश्वरोंके द्वारा नदियोंके किनारे स्थापित अमिततेजस्वी शंकरके लिङ्गोंको पूजा बहाँके निवासियोंने जहाँ-जहाँ भी जनार्दनको आते हुए देखा, वहाँ-वहाँ पुष्पों तथा अक्षतोंसे उनको पूजा को । शार्ङ्गधनुष, शङ्ख तथा असि धारण करनेवाले एवं शुभ अङ्गोंवाले उन वासुदेबका दर्शनकर वहाँ
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you, O Lord with form resembling (re¬ fulgent like) a thousand suns and moons. Obeisance to you, O Lord, accessible only through perfect Vedic knowledge and piety. Obeisance to the upholder of the Earth. Obeisance to the unmeasurable. Obeisance to you, O Lord,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you, O Lord with form resembling (re¬ fulgent like) a thousand suns and moons. Obeisance to you, O Lord, accessible only through perfect Vedic knowledge and piety. Obeisance to the upholder of the Earth. Obeisance to the unmeasurable. Obeisance to you, O Lord,…

verses.sanskrit: संवत्सरशतं साग्रं तपोनिर्धूतकल्मषः । जजाप मनसा देवीं सावित्ररिं वेदमातरम्
verses.transliteration: saṃvatsaraśataṃ sāgraṃ taponirdhūtakalmaṣaḥ / jajāpa manasā devīṃ sāvitrariṃ vedamātaram
verses.translation: Obeisance to you, Sambhu founded in truth. Salu¬ tations to you, the cause of and embodiment for the form of the universe. Obeisance to you stationed in the middle of Yogic seat (meditation). Obeisance to you, the auspicious one of single form. Salutations to you again and again.
verses.hindi: रहनेवाले सभी निश्चल-से खड़े हो गये। वहाँ (योगमें) आरूढ़ होनेके इच्छुक जिन लोगोंके मन समाधिस्थ थे, चे भी जनार्दन हरिको अपने सम्मुख देखकर उनका दर्शन करनेके लिये अपनी इन्द्रियोंको बहिर्मुख कर इधर श्रीकृष्णने गङ्गामें अवगाहन करनेके पश्चात्
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you, Sambhu founded in truth. Salu¬ tations to you, the cause of and embodiment for the form of the universe. Obeisance to you stationed in the middle of Yogic seat (meditation). Obeisance to you, the auspicious one of single form. Salutations to you again and again.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you, Sambhu founded in truth. Salu¬ tations to you, the cause of and embodiment for the form of the universe. Obeisance to you stationed in the middle of Yogic seat (meditation). Obeisance to you, the auspicious one of single form. Salutations to you again and again.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यैवं जपतो देवः स्वयंभूः परमेश्वरः । हिरण्यगर्भो विश्वात्मा तं देशमगमत् स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: tasyaivaṃ japato devaḥ svayaṃbhūḥ parameśvaraḥ / hiraṇyagarbho viśvātmā taṃ deśamagamat svayam
verses.translation: Lord Visnu, identical with the universe, who was thus propitiated by the mother of Devas, laughingly told her to choose the boon she wished.
verses.hindi: उत्तमोत्तम पुष्प आदि लेकर श्रेष्ठ मुनि (उपमन्यु)-के गृहमें प्रवेश किया। योगियोंमें श्रेष्ठ, भस्मसे अवलिप्त शरीरवाले, जटा और चीरधारी उन शान्त मुनिको देखकर ( श्रीकृष्णने) सिर झुकाकर उन्हें प्रणाम किया कृष्णको आते हुए देखकर तत्त्वज्ञ उन मुनिने योगियोंके प्रथम पूज्य उन्हें आसनपर बिठाया और उनको पूजा को
verses.wordMeaning: Lord Visnu, identical with the universe, who was thus propitiated by the mother of Devas, laughingly told her to choose the boon she wished.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Visnu, identical with the universe, who was thus propitiated by the mother of Devas, laughingly told her to choose the boon she wished.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा देवं समायान्तं ब्रह्माणं विश्वतोमुखम् । ननाम शिरसा तस्य पादयोर्नाम कीर्तयन्
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā devaṃ samāyāntaṃ brahmāṇaṃ viśvatomukham / nanāma śirasā tasya pādayornāma kīrtayan
verses.translation: Bowing down her head on the ground, she chose the excellent boon—"For the welfare of Devas, I choose this boon that pray, you be my son."
verses.hindi: (मुनिने कहा--)हम जानते हैँ कि वाणीके उत्पत्ति- स्थान, परमपदरूप, अव्यक्त शरीरवाले विष्णु शिष्यके रूपमें उपस्थित हुए हैं । हृषीकेश! आपका स्वागत है, हमारे तप सफल हुए जो साक्षात् विश्वात्मा विष्णु ही मेरे घर आये हैं। प्रयत्न करते हुए भी योगी तथा मुनिजन आपको देख नहीं पाते, ऐसे आपके यहाँ आनेका प्रयोजन क्या है? उपमन्युके उस वाक्यको सुनकर केशीका मर्दन करनेवाले महायोगी भगवानूने उन्हें
verses.wordMeaning: Bowing down her head on the ground, she chose the excellent boon—"For the welfare of Devas, I choose this boon that pray, you be my son."
verses.commentary: Sense: Bowing down her head on the ground, she chose the excellent boon—"For the welfare of Devas, I choose this boon that pray, you be my son."

verses.sanskrit: नमो देवाधिदेवाय ब्रह्मणे परमात्मने । हिर्ण्यमूर्तये तुभ्यं सहस्त्राक्षाय वेधसे
verses.transliteration: namo devādhidevāya brahmaṇe paramātmane / hirṇyamūrtaye tubhyaṃ sahastrākṣāya vedhase
verses.translation: The Lord favourably disposed towards those who resort to him said, "So be it." The incomprehensible Lord vanished there itself, after granting the boon.
verses.hindi: श्रीकृष्ण बोले भगवन्! भगवान् शंकरके दर्शनोंके लिये उत्सुक मैं आया हूँ। कृत्तिवासा गिरीश (भगवान् शंकर)-का दर्शन करनेकी मेरी उत्कट इच्छा है। योगविदोंमें श्रेष्ठ भगवान् ईशका शीघ्र ही कैसे दर्शन कर सकता हूँ. उन उमापतिको मैं कहाँ देख पाऊँगा
verses.wordMeaning: The Lord favourably disposed towards those who resort to him said, "So be it." The incomprehensible Lord vanished there itself, after granting the boon.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Lord favourably disposed towards those who resort to him said, "So be it." The incomprehensible Lord vanished there itself, after granting the boon.

verses.sanskrit: नमो धात्रे विधात्रे च नमो वेदात्ममूर्तये । सांख्ययोगाधिगम्याय नमस्ते ज्ञानमूर्तये
verses.transliteration: namo dhātre vidhātre ca namo vedātmamūrtaye / sāṃkhyayogādhigamyāya namaste jñānamūrtaye
verses.translation: After a lapse of time the mother of Devas conceived Janardana, Lord Narayana himself, in her womb.
verses.hindi: इत्याह भगवानुक्तो दृश्यते परमेश्वर: । भक्त्या चोग्रेण तपसा तत्कुरुष्वेह यत्नतः इहेश्वरं देवदेवं मुनीन्द्रा ब्रह्मवादिनः । ध्यायन्तो ऽत्रासते देवं जापिनस्तापसाश्च ये
verses.wordMeaning: After a lapse of time the mother of Devas conceived Janardana, Lord Narayana himself, in her womb.
verses.commentary: Sense: After a lapse of time the mother of Devas conceived Janardana, Lord Narayana himself, in her womb.

verses.sanskrit: नमस्त्रिमूर्तये तुभ्यं स्त्रष्ट्रे सर्वार्थवेदिने । पुरुषाय पुराणाय योगिनां गुरवे नमः
verses.transliteration: namastrimūrtaye tubhyaṃ straṣṭre sarvārthavedine / puruṣāya purāṇāya yogināṃ gurave namaḥ
verses.translation: When Hrsikesa occupied the womb of the mother of Devas, evil portents of terrible nature happened in the city of Bali, the son of Virocana.
verses.hindi: इह देव: सपत्नीको भगवान् वृषभध्वजः । क्रीडते विविधेर्भूतिर्योगिभिः परिवारितः लेभे महेश्चराद् योगं वसिष्ठो भगवानृषिः
verses.wordMeaning: When Hrsikesa occupied the womb of the mother of Devas, evil portents of terrible nature happened in the city of Bali, the son of Virocana.
verses.commentary: Sense: When Hrsikesa occupied the womb of the mother of Devas, evil portents of terrible nature happened in the city of Bali, the son of Virocana.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रसन्नो भगवान् विरिञ्चो विश्वभावनः । वरं वरय भद्रं ते वरदो ऽस्मीत्यभाषत
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prasanno bhagavān viriñco viśvabhāvanaḥ / varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te varado 'smītyabhāṣata
verses.translation: On seeing the evil portents, the leader of the Daityas became agitated due to fear. He bowed to Prahlada, the aged Asura and his grandfather, and said to him:—
verses.hindi: इहैव भगवान् व्यासः कृष्णद्वैपायनः प्रभुः । दृष्टा तं परमं ज्ञानं लब्धवानीश्वरेश्वरम् अविन्दत् पुत्रकान् रुद्रात् सुरभिर्भक्तिसंयुता
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing the evil portents, the leader of the Daityas became agitated due to fear. He bowed to Prahlada, the aged Asura and his grandfather, and said to him:—
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the evil portents, the leader of the Daityas became agitated due to fear. He bowed to Prahlada, the aged Asura and his grandfather, and said to him:—

verses.sanskrit: राजोवाच जपेयं देवदेवेश गायत्रीं वेदमातरम् । भूयो वर्षशतं साग्रं तावदायुर्भवेन्मम
verses.transliteration: rājovāca japeyaṃ devadeveśa gāyatrīṃ vedamātaram / bhūyo varṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ tāvadāyurbhavenmama
verses.translation: "O grandfather of great intelligence, why does this portentous phenomena happen in this city of ours. What may be the reason thereof? What should be done now"?
verses.hindi: इहैव देवताः पूर्व कालाद् भीता महेश्वरम् । दृष्टवन्तो हरं श्रीमन्निर्भया निर्वृतिं ययुः इहाराध्य महादेवं सावर्णिस्तपतां वरः। लब्धवान् परमं योगं ग्रन्थकारत्वमुत्तमम्
verses.wordMeaning: "O grandfather of great intelligence, why does this portentous phenomena happen in this city of ours. What may be the reason thereof? What should be done now"?
verses.commentary: Sense: "O grandfather of great intelligence, why does this portentous phenomena happen in this city of ours. What may be the reason thereof? What should be done now"?

verses.sanskrit: बाढमित्याह विश्वात्मा समालोक्य नराधिपम् । स्पृष्ट्वा कराभ्यां सुप्रीतस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत
verses.transliteration: bāḍhamityāha viśvātmā samālokya narādhipam / spṛṣṭvā karābhyāṃ suprītastatraivāntaradhīyata
verses.translation: "O grandfather of great intelligence, why does this portentous phenomena happen in this city of ours. What may be the reason thereof? What should be done now"?
verses.hindi: पौराणिकीं सुपुण्यार्था सच्छिष्येषु द्विजातिषु इहेव संहितां दृष्टा कापेयः शांशपायनः । महादेवं चकारेमां पौराणीं तन्नियोगतः। द्वादशैव सहस्त्राणि श्लोकानां पुरुषोत्तम
verses.wordMeaning: "O grandfather of great intelligence, why does this portentous phenomena happen in this city of ours. What may be the reason thereof? What should be done now"?
verses.commentary: Sense: "O grandfather of great intelligence, why does this portentous phenomena happen in this city of ours. What may be the reason thereof? What should be done now"?

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽपि लब्धवरः श्रीमान् जजापातिप्रसन्नधीः । शान्तस्त्रिषवणस्नायी कन्दमूलफलाशनः
verses.transliteration: so 'pi labdhavaraḥ śrīmān jajāpātiprasannadhīḥ / śāntastriṣavaṇasnāyī kandamūlaphalāśanaḥ
verses.translation: "O grandfather of great intelligence, why does this portentous phenomena happen in this city of ours. What may be the reason thereof? What should be done now"?
verses.hindi: इह प्रवर्तिता पुण्या द्व्यष्टसाहस्त्रिकोत्तरा । वायवीयोत्तरं नाम पुराणं वेदसम्मितम्। इहेव ख्यापितं शिष्यैः शांशपायनभाषितम् चकार तन्नियोगेन योगशास्त्रमनुत्तमम्
verses.wordMeaning: "O grandfather of great intelligence, why does this portentous phenomena happen in this city of ours. What may be the reason thereof? What should be done now"?
verses.commentary: Sense: "O grandfather of great intelligence, why does this portentous phenomena happen in this city of ours. What may be the reason thereof? What should be done now"?

verses.sanskrit: तस्य पूर्णे वर्षशते भगवानुग्रदीधितिः । प्रादुरासीन्महायोगी भानोर्मण्डलमध्यतः
verses.transliteration: tasya pūrṇe varṣaśate bhagavānugradīdhitiḥ / prādurāsīnmahāyogī bhānormaṇḍalamadhyataḥ
verses.translation: "O grandfather of great intelligence, why does this portentous phenomena happen in this city of ours. What may be the reason thereof? What should be done now"?
verses.hindi: इहैव भृगुणा पूर्व तप्त्वा वै परमं तपः। शुक्रो महेश्वरात् पुत्रो लब्धो योगविदां वरः तस्मादिहैव देवेशं तपस्तप्त्वा महेश्वरम्। द्रष्टम्हसि विश्वेशमुग्रं भीमं कपर्दिनम्
verses.wordMeaning: "O grandfather of great intelligence, why does this portentous phenomena happen in this city of ours. What may be the reason thereof? What should be done now"?
verses.commentary: Sense: "O grandfather of great intelligence, why does this portentous phenomena happen in this city of ours. What may be the reason thereof? What should be done now"?

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा वेदविदुषं मण्डलस्थं सनातनम् । स्वयंभुवमनाद्यन्तं ब्रह्माणं विस्मयं गतः
verses.transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvā vedaviduṣaṃ maṇḍalasthaṃ sanātanam / svayaṃbhuvamanādyantaṃ brahmāṇaṃ vismayaṃ gataḥ
verses.translation: "O grandfather of great intelligence, why does this portentous phenomena happen in this city of ours. What may be the reason thereof? What should be done now"?
verses.hindi: एवमुक्त्वा ददौ ज्ञानमुपमन्युर्महामुनिः। व्रतं पाशुपतं योगं कृष्णायाक्लिष्टकर्मणे ऐसा कहे जानेपर भगवान् (उपमन्यु)-ने कहा-- तीव्र भक्ति एवं तपस्याके द्वारा वे परमेश्वर देखे जा सकते हैं, इसलिये ऐसा हीं प्रयत्न करो। ब्रह्मवादी मुनीन्द्र, जप करनेवाले तथा जो तपस्वी हैं वे, यहाँ उन
verses.wordMeaning: "O grandfather of great intelligence, why does this portentous phenomena happen in this city of ours. What may be the reason thereof? What should be done now"?
verses.commentary: Sense: "O grandfather of great intelligence, why does this portentous phenomena happen in this city of ours. What may be the reason thereof? What should be done now"?

verses.sanskrit: तुष्टाव वैदिकैर्मन्त्रैः सावित्र्या च विशेषतः । क्षणादपश्यत् पुरुषं तमेव परमेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: tuṣṭāva vaidikairmantraiḥ sāvitryā ca viśeṣataḥ / kṣaṇādapaśyat puruṣaṃ tameva parameśvaram
verses.translation: "O grandfather of great intelligence, why does this portentous phenomena happen in this city of ours. What may be the reason thereof? What should be done now"?
verses.hindi: देव ईश्वर देवाधिदेवका ध्यान करते हुए निवास कर रहे हैं। यहाँ भगवान् देव वृषभध्वज पत्नी (पार्वती)-सहित तथा विविध भूतों और योगियोंसे घिरे हुए सदा क्रीड़ा करते हें ॥ ३४--३६॥ प्राचीन कालमें इस आश्रममें कठोर तप करके भगवान् वसिष्ठ ऋषिने महेश्वर रुद्रसे योग प्राप्त किया था। यहीं प्रभु कृष्णद्वैपायन भगवान् व्यासने उन ईश्वरोंके भी ईश्वर (भगवान् शंकर)-का दर्शनकर परम ज्ञान प्राप्त
verses.wordMeaning: "O grandfather of great intelligence, why does this portentous phenomena happen in this city of ours. What may be the reason thereof? What should be done now"?
verses.commentary: Sense: "O grandfather of great intelligence, why does this portentous phenomena happen in this city of ours. What may be the reason thereof? What should be done now"?

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्मुखं जटामौलिमष्टहस्तं त्रिलोचनम् । चन्द्रावयवलक्षमाणं नरनारीतनुं हरम्
verses.transliteration: caturmukhaṃ jaṭāmaulimaṣṭahastaṃ trilocanam / candrāvayavalakṣamāṇaṃ naranārītanuṃ haram
verses.translation: "O grandfather of great intelligence, why does this portentous phenomena happen in this city of ours. What may be the reason thereof? What should be done now"?
verses.hindi: किया था। इसी रमणीय श्रेष्ठ आश्रममें सुरभिने भक्तिपूर्वक तपस्या करके जटाधारी रुद्रसे पुत्रोंको प्राप्त किया था। पूर्वकालमें कालसे भयभीत देवताओंने यहींपर श्रीमान् हर (महाकाल)-का दर्शनकर भयसे रहित होकर शान्ति प्राप्त की थी । तपस्वियोंमें श्रेष्ठ द्विज सावर्णिने यहींपर महादेवकी आराधना करके परम योग तथा उत्तम ग्रन्थरचनाकी शक्ति प्राप्त की थी। तभी उन्होंने कल्याणकारिणी सुन्दर पुण्य प्रदान करनेवाली पुराणसंहिताका निर्माणकर सत्-शिष्यों
verses.wordMeaning: "O grandfather of great intelligence, why does this portentous phenomena happen in this city of ours. What may be the reason thereof? What should be done now"?
verses.commentary: Sense: "O grandfather of great intelligence, why does this portentous phenomena happen in this city of ours. What may be the reason thereof? What should be done now"?

verses.sanskrit: भासयन्तं जगत् कृत्स्नं नीलकण्ठं स्वरश्मिभिः । रक्ताम्बरधरं रक्तं रक्तमाल्यानुलेपनम्
verses.transliteration: bhāsayantaṃ jagat kṛtsnaṃ nīlakaṇṭhaṃ svaraśmibhiḥ / raktāmbaradharaṃ raktaṃ raktamālyānulepanam
verses.translation: "O grandfather of great intelligence, why does this portentous phenomena happen in this city of ours. What may be the reason thereof? What should be done now"?
verses.hindi: और द्विजातियोंमें उसका प्रवर्तन किया पुरुषोत्तम! इसी स्थानपर कापेय शांशपायनने महादेवका दर्शनकर उनकी आज्ञा प्राप्त करके बारह हजार श्लोकोंवाली इस (कूर्मरूपधारी भगवान् विष्णुके द्वारा वर्णित) पुराणसंहिताका निर्माण किया। वेदसम्मत पुण्य
verses.wordMeaning: "O grandfather of great intelligence, why does this portentous phenomena happen in this city of ours. What may be the reason thereof? What should be done now"?
verses.commentary: Sense: "O grandfather of great intelligence, why does this portentous phenomena happen in this city of ours. What may be the reason thereof? What should be done now"?

verses.sanskrit: तद्भावभावितो दृष्ट्वा सद्भावेन परेण हि । ननाम शिरसा रुद्रं सावित्र्यानेन चैव हि
verses.transliteration: tadbhāvabhāvito dṛṣṭvā sadbhāvena pareṇa hi / nanāma śirasā rudraṃ sāvitryānena caiva hi
verses.translation: "O grandfather of great intelligence, why does this portentous phenomena happen in this city of ours. What may be the reason thereof? What should be done now"?
verses.hindi: वायवीयपुराणसंहिताका सोलह हजार श्लोकोंवाला उत्तरभाग यहींपर प्रवर्तित हुआ। यहींपर शांशपायनद्वारा कही गयी पुराणसंहिताका प्रचार उनके शिष्योंने किया महायोगी याज्ञवल्क्यने यहींपर तपस्याद्वारा शंकरका दर्शन करके उनकी आज्ञासे श्रेष्ठ योगशास्त्रका निर्माण किया था। पूर्वकालमें भृगुने यहीं परम तप करके महेश्वरसे योगज्ञोंमें श्रेष्ठ शुक्र नामक पुत्रको प्राप्त किया
verses.wordMeaning: "O grandfather of great intelligence, why does this portentous phenomena happen in this city of ours. What may be the reason thereof? What should be done now"?
verses.commentary: Sense: "O grandfather of great intelligence, why does this portentous phenomena happen in this city of ours. What may be the reason thereof? What should be done now"?

verses.sanskrit: नमस्ते नीलकण्ठाय भास्वते परमेष्ठिने । त्रयीमयाय रुद्राय कालरूपाय हेतवे
verses.transliteration: namaste nīlakaṇṭhāya bhāsvate parameṣṭhine / trayīmayāya rudrāya kālarūpāya hetave
verses.translation: "O grandfather of great intelligence, why does this portentous phenomena happen in this city of ours. What may be the reason thereof? What should be done now"?
verses.hindi: था। इसलिये यहींपर तपस्या करके देवताओंके ईश, महेश्वर विश्वेश, उग्र, भीम कपर्दीका आप दर्शन करें। ऐसा कहकर महामुनि उपमन्युने सुन्दर कर्म करनेवाले कृष्णको पाशुपत-योग, पाशुपत-व्रत और पाशुपत-ज्ञान स तेन मुनिवर्येण व्याहतो मधुसूदनः । तत्रैव तपसा देवं रुद्रमाराधयत् प्रभुः
verses.wordMeaning: "O grandfather of great intelligence, why does this portentous phenomena happen in this city of ours. What may be the reason thereof? What should be done now"?
verses.commentary: Sense: "O grandfather of great intelligence, why does this portentous phenomena happen in this city of ours. What may be the reason thereof? What should be done now"?

verses.sanskrit: तदा प्राह महादेवो राजानं प्रीतमानसः । इमानि मे रहस्यानि नामानि शृणु चानघ
verses.transliteration: tadā prāha mahādevo rājānaṃ prītamānasaḥ / imāni me rahasyāni nāmāni śṛṇu cānagha
verses.translation: "O grandfather of great intelligence, why does this portentous phenomena happen in this city of ours. What may be the reason thereof? What should be done now"?
verses.hindi: जजाप रुद्रमनिशं शिवैकाहितमानसः ततो बहुतिथे काले सोमः सोमार्थभूषण: । अदृश्यत महादेवो व्योम्नि देव्या महेश्वरः
verses.wordMeaning: "O grandfather of great intelligence, why does this portentous phenomena happen in this city of ours. What may be the reason thereof? What should be done now"?
verses.commentary: Sense: "O grandfather of great intelligence, why does this portentous phenomena happen in this city of ours. What may be the reason thereof? What should be done now"?

verses.sanskrit: सर्ववेदेषु गीतानि संसारशमनानि तु । नमस्कुरुष्व नृपते एभिर्मां सततं शुचिः
verses.transliteration: sarvavedeṣu gītāni saṃsāraśamanāni tu / namaskuruṣva nṛpate ebhirmāṃ satataṃ śuciḥ
verses.translation: "O grandfather of great intelligence, why does this portentous phenomena happen in this city of ours. What may be the reason thereof? What should be done now"?
verses.hindi: पिनाकिनं शूलिनं देवदेवम्। देव्या महादेवमसौ परश्चधासक्तकरं त्रिनेत्रं
verses.wordMeaning: "O grandfather of great intelligence, why does this portentous phenomena happen in this city of ours. What may be the reason thereof? What should be done now"?
verses.commentary: Sense: "O grandfather of great intelligence, why does this portentous phenomena happen in this city of ours. What may be the reason thereof? What should be done now"?

verses.sanskrit: अध्यायं शतरुद्रीयं यजुषां सारमुद्धृतम् । जपस्वानन्यचेतस्को मय्यासक्तमना नृप
verses.transliteration: adhyāyaṃ śatarudrīyaṃ yajuṣāṃ sāramuddhṛtam / japasvānanyacetasko mayyāsaktamanā nṛpa
verses.translation: "O grandfather of great intelligence, why does this portentous phenomena happen in this city of ours. What may be the reason thereof? What should be done now"?
verses.hindi: प्रभुं पुराणं पुरुषं पुरस्तात् न यस्य देवा न पितामहोऽपि
verses.wordMeaning: "O grandfather of great intelligence, why does this portentous phenomena happen in this city of ours. What may be the reason thereof? What should be done now"?
verses.commentary: Sense: "O grandfather of great intelligence, why does this portentous phenomena happen in this city of ours. What may be the reason thereof? What should be done now"?

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मचारी मिताहारो भस्मनिष्ठः समाहितः । जपेदामरणाद् रुद्रं स याति परमं पदम्
verses.transliteration: brahmacārī mitāhāro bhasmaniṣṭhaḥ samāhitaḥ / japedāmaraṇād rudraṃ sa yāti paramaṃ padam
verses.translation: "O grandfather of great intelligence, why does this portentous phenomena happen in this city of ours. What may be the reason thereof? What should be done now"?
verses.hindi: तमादिदेवं पुरतो ददर्श ५५॥ पितामहं लोकगुरुं दिविस्थम्
verses.wordMeaning: "O grandfather of great intelligence, why does this portentous phenomena happen in this city of ours. What may be the reason thereof? What should be done now"?
verses.commentary: Sense: "O grandfather of great intelligence, why does this portentous phenomena happen in this city of ours. What may be the reason thereof? What should be done now"?

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा भगवान् रुद्रो भक्तानुग्रहकाम्यया । पुनः संवत्सरशतं राज्ञे ह्यायुरकल्पयत्
verses.transliteration: ityuktvā bhagavān rudro bhaktānugrahakāmyayā / punaḥ saṃvatsaraśataṃ rājñe hyāyurakalpayat
verses.translation: "O grandfather of great intelligence, why does this portentous phenomena happen in this city of ours. What may be the reason thereof? What should be done now"?
verses.hindi: त्रिलोक भर्तुः पुरतोऽन्वपश्यत् उन श्रेष्ठ मुनिके कहनेसे वे प्रभु मधुसूदन वहींपर तपस्याद्वारा रुद्रकी आराधना करने लगे। सभी अङ्गोमें यथाविधि भस्म धारण करके, मुण्डित एवं वल्कल वस्त्रधारी होकर अनन्य-मनसे शिवमें चित्तको समाहिंतकर
verses.wordMeaning: "O grandfather of great intelligence, why does this portentous phenomena happen in this city of ours. What may be the reason thereof? What should be done now"?
verses.commentary: Sense: "O grandfather of great intelligence, why does this portentous phenomena happen in this city of ours. What may be the reason thereof? What should be done now"?

verses.sanskrit: दत्त्वास्मै तत् परं ज्ञानं वैराग्यं परमेश्वरः । क्षणादन्तर्दधे रुद्रस्तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्
verses.transliteration: dattvāsmai tat paraṃ jñānaṃ vairāgyaṃ parameśvaraḥ / kṣaṇādantardadhe rudrastadadbhutamivābhavat
verses.translation: "O grandfather of great intelligence, why does this portentous phenomena happen in this city of ours. What may be the reason thereof? What should be done now"?
verses.hindi: निरन्तर रुद्रसम्बन्धी मन्त्रोंका जप करने लगे। तदनन्तर बहुत समय बीत जानेके बाद अर्धचन्द्रमाको आभूषणरूपमें धारण किये सोमरूप महादेव महेश्वर देवी पार्वतीके साथ आकाशमें दिखलायी पड़े॥ ४९--५१ ॥ तथा चित्र-विचित्र माला धारण किये हुए, सिंहके चर्म- रूपी वस्त्रसे समस्त अङ्गोंको आच्छादित किये हुए देवाधिदेव महादेवको देवी पार्वतीके साथ देखा । हाथमें परशु धारण किये हुए, नृसिंहके चर्मसे आच्छादित
verses.wordMeaning: "O grandfather of great intelligence, why does this portentous phenomena happen in this city of ours. What may be the reason thereof? What should be done now"?
verses.commentary: Sense: "O grandfather of great intelligence, why does this portentous phenomena happen in this city of ours. What may be the reason thereof? What should be done now"?

verses.sanskrit: राजापि तपसा रुद्रं जजापानन्यमानसः । भस्मच्छन्नस्त्रिषवणं स्नात्वा शान्तः समाहितः
verses.transliteration: rājāpi tapasā rudraṃ jajāpānanyamānasaḥ / bhasmacchannastriṣavaṇaṃ snātvā śāntaḥ samāhitaḥ
verses.translation: "O grandfather of great intelligence, why does this portentous phenomena happen in this city of ours. What may be the reason thereof? What should be done now"?
verses.hindi: शरीरवाले, प्रणवका उच्चारण कर रहे तथा सहस्रं सूर्योके समान श्रेष्ठ त्रिलोचन-- भगवान् शंकरका श्रीकृष्णने दर्शन किया। उन्होंने ( श्रीकृष्णने) अपने समक्ष पुराणपुरुष, सनातन प्रभु, योगी, इश्वर, अणुसे भी सूक्ष्म, अनन्तशक्तियुक्त प्राणेश्वर शम्भुको देखा। जिन (रुद्र)-के प्रभावका
verses.wordMeaning: "O grandfather of great intelligence, why does this portentous phenomena happen in this city of ours. What may be the reason thereof? What should be done now"?
verses.commentary: Sense: "O grandfather of great intelligence, why does this portentous phenomena happen in this city of ours. What may be the reason thereof? What should be done now"?

verses.sanskrit: जपतस्तस्य नृपतेः पूर्णे वर्षशते पुनः । योगप्रवृत्तिरभवत् कालात् कालात्मकं परम्
verses.transliteration: japatastasya nṛpateḥ pūrṇe varṣaśate punaḥ / yogapravṛttirabhavat kālāt kālātmakaṃ param
verses.translation: "O grandfather of great intelligence, why does this portentous phenomena happen in this city of ours. What may be the reason thereof? What should be done now"?
verses.hindi: आजतक वर्णन नहीं कर पाये, उन आदिदेवको श्रीकृष्णने सामने देखा। उस समय उन्होंने भगवान् शंकरके वामभागमें शङ्कु, तलवार तथा चक्र धारण किये आत्मरूप, अव्यक्त, अनन्त तथा अनन्तरूपवाले आदिदेव (विष्णु)-को देखा। वे भी बहुत-सी स्तुतियोंके द्वारा ईश (शंकर)-की ही स्तुति कर रहे थे
verses.wordMeaning: "O grandfather of great intelligence, why does this portentous phenomena happen in this city of ours. What may be the reason thereof? What should be done now"?
verses.commentary: Sense: "O grandfather of great intelligence, why does this portentous phenomena happen in this city of ours. What may be the reason thereof? What should be done now"?

verses.sanskrit: विवेश तद् वेदसारं स्थानं वै परमेष्ठिनः । भानोः स मण्डलं शुभ्रं ततो यातो महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: viveśa tad vedasāraṃ sthānaṃ vai parameṣṭhinaḥ / bhānoḥ sa maṇḍalaṃ śubhraṃ tato yāto maheśvaram
verses.translation: "O grandfather of great intelligence, why does this portentous phenomena happen in this city of ours. What may be the reason thereof? What should be done now"?
verses.hindi: उन (भगवान् शंकर)-के दक्षिण भागमें उन्होंने (श्रीकृष्णने) हंसपर आसीन, अत्यन्त प्रभाववाले, देवताओंके स्वामी लोकगुरु पितामहको आकाशमें हाथ जोड़े हुए ईशको स्तुति करते देखा। उन्होंने (श्रीकृष्णने) तीनों लोकोंके स्वामी (श्रीशंकर)-के सम्मुख हजारों सूर्योंके समान गणेश्वरो, अमित प्रभाववाले नन्दीश्वरादिकों तथा मयूरसहित अग्नि-सदृश कुमार कार्तिकेयको देखा
verses.wordMeaning: "O grandfather of great intelligence, why does this portentous phenomena happen in this city of ours. What may be the reason thereof? What should be done now"?
verses.commentary: Sense: "O grandfather of great intelligence, why does this portentous phenomena happen in this city of ours. What may be the reason thereof? What should be done now"?

verses.sanskrit: यः पठेच्छृणुयाद् वापि राज्ञश्चरितमुत्तमम् । सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो ब्रह्मलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyād vāpi rājñaścaritamuttamam / sarvapāpavinirmukto brahmaloke mahīyate
verses.translation: "O grandfather of great intelligence, why does this portentous phenomena happen in this city of ours. What may be the reason thereof? What should be done now"?
verses.hindi: बद्धाञ्जलिर्विष्णुरुदारबुद्द्रः । प्रणम्य देव्या गिरिशं सभक्त्या ब्रह्माधिपं त्वामृषयो वदन्ति।
verses.wordMeaning: "O grandfather of great intelligence, why does this portentous phenomena happen in this city of ours. What may be the reason thereof? What should be done now"?
verses.commentary: Sense: "O grandfather of great intelligence, why does this portentous phenomena happen in this city of ours. What may be the reason thereof? What should be done now"?

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे एकोनविशो ऽध्यायः सूत उवाच त्रिधन्वा राजपुत्रस्तु धर्मेणापालयन्महीम् । तस्य पुत्रो ऽभवद् विद्वांस्त्रय्यारुण इति स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge ekonaviśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca tridhanvā rājaputrastu dharmeṇāpālayanmahīm / tasya putro 'bhavad vidvāṃstrayyāruṇa iti smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: After hearing his words, and meditating for a long time, the great Asura bowed down to Hrsikesa and spoke these words;
verses.hindi: त्वं ब्रह्मा हरिरथ विश्वयोनिरग्निः संहर्ता दिनकरमण्डलाधिवासः। प्राणस्त्वं हुतवहवासवादिभेद-
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing his words, and meditating for a long time, the great Asura bowed down to Hrsikesa and spoke these words;
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing his words, and meditating for a long time, the great Asura bowed down to Hrsikesa and spoke these words;

verses.sanskrit: तस्य सत्यव्रतो नाम कुमारो ऽभून्महाबलः । भार्या सत्यधना नाम हरिश्चन्द्रमजीजनत्
verses.transliteration: tasya satyavrato nāma kumāro 'bhūnmahābalaḥ / bhāryā satyadhanā nāma hariścandramajījanat
verses.translation: "For the purpose of slaying the Asuras, the mother of the heaven-dwellers has conceived in her womb that Visnu who is v/orshipped by means of Tajhas and to whom belongs this entire universe.
verses.hindi: स्त्वामेकं शरणमुपैमि देवमीशम् सांख्यास्त्वां विगुणमथाहुरेकरूपं
verses.wordMeaning: "For the purpose of slaying the Asuras, the mother of the heaven-dwellers has conceived in her womb that Visnu who is v/orshipped by means of Tajhas and to whom belongs this entire universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: "For the purpose of slaying the Asuras, the mother of the heaven-dwellers has conceived in her womb that Visnu who is v/orshipped by means of Tajhas and to whom belongs this entire universe.

verses.sanskrit: हरिश्चन्द्रस्य पुत्रो ऽभूद् रोहितो नाम वीर्यवान् । हरितो रोहितस्याथ धुन्धुस्तस्य सुतो ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: hariścandrasya putro 'bhūd rohito nāma vīryavān / harito rohitasyātha dhundhustasya suto 'bhavat
verses.translation: That Vasudeva from whom everything is non-differ- ent and who differs from everything, has entered the womb of the mother of Devas.
verses.hindi: त्वामेकं शरणमुपैमि देवमीशम् नित्यं त्वाहमुपैमि सत्यविभवं विश्वेश्वरं तं शिवम्
verses.wordMeaning: That Vasudeva from whom everything is non-differ- ent and who differs from everything, has entered the womb of the mother of Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: That Vasudeva from whom everything is non-differ- ent and who differs from everything, has entered the womb of the mother of Devas.

verses.sanskrit: विजयश्च सुदेवश्च धुन्धुपुत्रौ बभूवतुः । विजयस्याभवत् पुत्रः कारुको नाम वीर्यवान्
verses.transliteration: vijayaśca sudevaśca dhundhuputrau babhūvatuḥ / vijayasyābhavat putraḥ kāruko nāma vīryavān
verses.translation: That Lord Visnu whose form even Devas do not know precisely, has entered today the body of Aditi by his own wish.
verses.hindi: 3७ नमो नीलकण्ठाय त्रिनेत्राय च रंहसे। महादेवाय ते नित्यमीशानाय नमो नमः उनके पीछेको ओर मरीचि, अत्रि, पुलह, पुलस्त्य,
verses.wordMeaning: That Lord Visnu whose form even Devas do not know precisely, has entered today the body of Aditi by his own wish.
verses.commentary: Sense: That Lord Visnu whose form even Devas do not know precisely, has entered today the body of Aditi by his own wish.

verses.sanskrit: कारुकस्य वृकः पुत्रस्तस्माद् बाहुरजायत । सगरस्तस्य पुत्रौऽभूद् राजा परमधार्मिकः
verses.transliteration: kārukasya vṛkaḥ putrastasmād bāhurajāyata / sagarastasya putrau'bhūd rājā paramadhārmikaḥ
verses.translation: That Hari, the ancient Purusa, the great Yogin from whom the living beings originate, and wherein they attain dissolution, has now incarnated.
verses.hindi: उन उदार बुद्धिवाले विष्णु (कृष्ण)-ने भक्तिपूर्वक हाथ जोडते हुए देवी पार्वतीसहित शंकरको प्रणाम किया तथा अपने हृदयमें आत्म-स्वरूपका ध्यानकर देवताओंमें प्रधान शंकरको मन्त्रोंद्वारा स्तुति कौ-- श्रीकृष्ण बोले--शाश्वत! सबके मूलकारण! आपको नमस्कार है। ऋषिलोग आपको ब्रह्माका भी अधिपति कहते हैं । संतजन तप, सत्त्व, रज एवं तमोगुण और सब कुछ आपको ही बतलाते हैं। आप ब्रह्मा,
verses.wordMeaning: That Hari, the ancient Purusa, the great Yogin from whom the living beings originate, and wherein they attain dissolution, has now incarnated.
verses.commentary: Sense: That Hari, the ancient Purusa, the great Yogin from whom the living beings originate, and wherein they attain dissolution, has now incarnated.

verses.sanskrit: द्वे भार्ये सगरस्यापि प्रभा भानुमती तथा । ताभ्यामाराधितः प्रादादौर्वाग्निर्वरमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: dve bhārye sagarasyāpi prabhā bhānumatī tathā / tābhyāmārādhitaḥ prādādaurvāgnirvaramuttamam
verses.translation: That Visnu, wherein the conception of name, caste, etc. has no place and who is of the mere form of existence, is being born with a portion of himself.
verses.hindi: विष्णु, विश्वयोनि, अग्नि, संहर्ता और सूर्यमण्डलमें निवास करनेवाले हैं। प्राण, हुतवह (अग्नि) तथा इन्द्रादि विविध देव आप ही हैं। मैं अद्वितीय देव ईशकी शरणमें आया हूँ। सांख्यशास्त्रवाले आपको एकरूप और गुणातीत कहते हैं। योगिजन हृदयमें रहनेवाले आपकी सतत उपासना करते हैं। वेद आपको रुद्र, अग्नि नामसे कहते हैं। में आप ईशदेवकी शरणमें आया हूँ
verses.wordMeaning: That Visnu, wherein the conception of name, caste, etc. has no place and who is of the mere form of existence, is being born with a portion of himself.
verses.commentary: Sense: That Visnu, wherein the conception of name, caste, etc. has no place and who is of the mere form of existence, is being born with a portion of himself.

verses.sanskrit: एकं भानुमती पुत्रमगृह्णादसमञ्जसम् । प्रभा षष्टिसहस्त्रं तु पुत्राणां जगृहे शुभा
verses.transliteration: ekaṃ bhānumatī putramagṛhṇādasamañjasam / prabhā ṣaṣṭisahastraṃ tu putrāṇāṃ jagṛhe śubhā
verses.translation: That Janardana, whose power is the mother of the Universe, Maya, goddess Laksmi, who is the sustainer of the Dharma, has incarnated.
verses.hindi: मनुष्य आपके चरणमें मात्र एक पुष्प अथवा एक बिल्वपत्र ही चढ़ाकर संसार-बन्धनसे विमुक्त हो जाता है। सिंद्धों तथा योगियोंद्वारा सेवित आपके चरणकमलोंका स्मरणकर आपको कृपासे मनुष्य सभी पापोंको विनष्ट कर डालता है। तत्त्वज्ञ लोग जिन्हें सभी प्रकारके विभागसे रहित, निर्मल, अन्तर्हदयमें अवस्थित, ज्योति, अनन्त,
verses.wordMeaning: That Janardana, whose power is the mother of the Universe, Maya, goddess Laksmi, who is the sustainer of the Dharma, has incarnated.
verses.commentary: Sense: That Janardana, whose power is the mother of the Universe, Maya, goddess Laksmi, who is the sustainer of the Dharma, has incarnated.

verses.sanskrit: असमञ्सस्य तनयो ह्यंशुमान् नाम पार्थिवः । तस्य पुत्रो दिलीपस्तु दिलीपात् तु भगीरथः
verses.transliteration: asamañsasya tanayo hyaṃśumān nāma pārthivaḥ / tasya putro dilīpastu dilīpāt tu bhagīrathaḥ
verses.translation: He whose form constituted of Tamas is Rudra and whose body is formed of the Rajo-gma is Brahma and whose form sustained by Sattva-guna is Visnu.
verses.hindi: और अन्तसे रहित स्थानरूप कहते हैं और यह (संसार) जिनसे उत्पन्न होता है, ऐसे आप सत्यविभव, सनातन विश्वेश्वर शिवकी शरणमें मैं आया हूँ प्रणवरूप नीलकण्ठ, त्रिलोचन और शक्तिरूप आपको नमस्कार है । आप महादेव तथा नित्य ईशानको बार-बार नमस्कार है । पिनाक नामक धनुष धारण करनेवाले आपको नमस्कार है, मुण्ड और दण्ड धारण करनेवाले आपको नमस्कार
verses.wordMeaning: He whose form constituted of Tamas is Rudra and whose body is formed of the Rajo-gma is Brahma and whose form sustained by Sattva-guna is Visnu.
verses.commentary: Sense: He whose form constituted of Tamas is Rudra and whose body is formed of the Rajo-gma is Brahma and whose form sustained by Sattva-guna is Visnu.

verses.sanskrit: येन भागीरथी गङ्गा तपः कृत्वावतारिता । प्रसादाद् देवदेवस्य महादेवस्य धीमतः
verses.transliteration: yena bhāgīrathī gaṅgā tapaḥ kṛtvāvatāritā / prasādād devadevasya mahādevasya dhīmataḥ
verses.translation: Thinking thus about Govinda, with a mind humble due to devotion, seek shelter in him alone. Thereby, you will attain great bliss."
verses.hindi: है। हाथमें वज्र धारण करनेवाले, दिशारूपी वस्त्रवाले कपर्दी (जटाधारी) आपको नमस्कार है नमो भेरवनादाय कालरूपाय दष्ट्रिणे। नागयज्ञोपवीताय नमस्ते वहिरेतसे
verses.wordMeaning: Thinking thus about Govinda, with a mind humble due to devotion, seek shelter in him alone. Thereby, you will attain great bliss."
verses.commentary: Sense: Thinking thus about Govinda, with a mind humble due to devotion, seek shelter in him alone. Thereby, you will attain great bliss."

verses.sanskrit: भगीरथस्य तपसा देवः प्रीतमना हरः । बभार शिरसा गङ्गां सोमान्ते सोमभूषणः
verses.transliteration: bhagīrathasya tapasā devaḥ prītamanā haraḥ / babhāra śirasā gaṅgāṃ somānte somabhūṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, at the instance of Prahlada, Bali, the son
verses.hindi: नमोऽस्तु ते गिरीशाय स्वाहाकाराय ते नम: । नमो मुक्ताइहासाय भीमाय च नमो नमः नमस्ते कामनाशाय नमः कालप्रमाथिने। नमो भेरववेषाय हराय च निषङ्गिणे
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, at the instance of Prahlada, Bali, the son
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, at the instance of Prahlada, Bali, the son

verses.sanskrit: भगीरथसुतश्चापि श्रुतो नाम बभूव ह । नाभागस्तस्य दायादः सिन्धुद्वीपस्ततो ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: bhagīrathasutaścāpi śruto nāma babhūva ha / nābhāgastasya dāyādaḥ sindhudvīpastato 'bhavat
verses.translation: When the proper time arrived, Aditi, the mother of Devas, bore to Kasyapa, the son, Mahavisnu himself, the increaser of the delight of Devas.
verses.hindi: नमोऽस्तु ते त्र्यम्बकाय नमस्ते कुत्तिवाससे। नमोऽम्बिकाधिपतये पशूनां पतये नमः नमो हैवतनाथाय देवानुगतलिङ्गिने । कुमारगुरवे तुभ्यं देवदेवाय ते नमः
verses.wordMeaning: When the proper time arrived, Aditi, the mother of Devas, bore to Kasyapa, the son, Mahavisnu himself, the increaser of the delight of Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the proper time arrived, Aditi, the mother of Devas, bore to Kasyapa, the son, Mahavisnu himself, the increaser of the delight of Devas.

verses.sanskrit: अयुतायुः सुतस्तस्य ऋतुपर्णस्तु तत्सुतः । ऋतुपर्णस्य पुत्रो ऽभूत् सुदासो नाम धार्मिकाः । सौदासस्तस्य तनयः ख्यातः कल्माषपादकः
verses.transliteration: ayutāyuḥ sutastasya ṛtuparṇastu tatsutaḥ / ṛtuparṇasya putro 'bhūt sudāso nāma dhārmikāḥ / saudāsastasya tanayaḥ khyātaḥ kalmāṣapādakaḥ
verses.translation: (She gave birth to Vi?nu) who had four arms and large eyes, whose chest is marked by Srivatsa emblem, who resembles the blue cloud (in complexion), who was resplendent and surrounded by glorious halo (Sri—or goddess of wealth).
verses.hindi: नमो यज्ञाधिपतये नमस्ते ब्रह्मचारिणे। मृगव्याधाय महते ब्रह्माधिपतये नमः मह्यं सर्वात्मना कामान् प्रयच्छ परमेश्वर
verses.wordMeaning: (She gave birth to Vi?nu) who had four arms and large eyes, whose chest is marked by Srivatsa emblem, who resembles the blue cloud (in complexion), who was resplendent and surrounded by glorious halo (Sri—or goddess of wealth).
verses.commentary: Sense: (She gave birth to Vi?nu) who had four arms and large eyes, whose chest is marked by Srivatsa emblem, who resembles the blue cloud (in complexion), who was resplendent and surrounded by glorious halo (Sri—or goddess of wealth).

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठस्तु महातेजाः क्षेत्रे कल्माषपादके । अश्मकं जनयामसा तमिक्ष्वाकुकुलध्वजम्
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭhastu mahātejāḥ kṣetre kalmāṣapādake / aśmakaṃ janayāmasā tamikṣvākukuladhvajam
verses.translation: Devas, Siddhas, Sadhyas, Garanas, of whom Indra was the head and Brahma surrounded by the groups of sages approached Upendra* (god Visnu) (for worshipping him).
verses.hindi: एवं हि भक्त्या देवेशमभिष्ट्य स माधव: । पपात पादयोर्विप्रा देवदेव्योः स दण्डवत् उत्थाप्य भगवान् सोमः कृष्णं केशिनिषूदनम्।
verses.wordMeaning: Devas, Siddhas, Sadhyas, Garanas, of whom Indra was the head and Brahma surrounded by the groups of sages approached Upendra* (god Visnu) (for worshipping him).
verses.commentary: Sense: Devas, Siddhas, Sadhyas, Garanas, of whom Indra was the head and Brahma surrounded by the groups of sages approached Upendra* (god Visnu) (for worshipping him).

verses.sanskrit: अश्मकस्योत्कलायां तु नकुलो नाम पार्थिवः । स हि रामभयाद् राजा वनं प्राप सुदुः खितः
verses.transliteration: aśmakasyotkalāyāṃ tu nakulo nāma pārthivaḥ / sa hi rāmabhayād rājā vanaṃ prāpa suduḥ khitaḥ
verses.translation: Lord Hari, whose investiture with the sacred thread was performed, studied the Vedas and the code of good con¬ duct from Sage Bharadvaja holding it as a model for the people in the three worlds.
verses.hindi: भयंकर नाद करनेवाले तथा दाढ़वाले कालस्वरूप आपको नमस्कार है । नागोंको यज्ञोपवीतके रूपमें धारण करनेवाले और अग्निस्वरूप वीर्यवाले आपको नमस्कार है। गिरीश! आपको नमस्कार है, स्वाहाकार! आपको नमस्कार है, उन्मुक्त अट्टहास करनेवाले आपको नमस्कार है और भीमरूप आपको बार-बार नमस्कार है। कामदेवका विनाश करनेवाले आपको नमस्कार है, कालका मन्थन करनेवाले आपको नमस्कार है, भयानक
verses.wordMeaning: Lord Hari, whose investiture with the sacred thread was performed, studied the Vedas and the code of good con¬ duct from Sage Bharadvaja holding it as a model for the people in the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Hari, whose investiture with the sacred thread was performed, studied the Vedas and the code of good con¬ duct from Sage Bharadvaja holding it as a model for the people in the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: विभ्रत् स नारीकवचं तस्माच्छतरथो ऽभवत् । तस्माद् बिलिबिलिः श्रीमान्वृद्धशर्माचतत्सुतः
verses.transliteration: vibhrat sa nārīkavacaṃ tasmācchataratho 'bhavat / tasmād bilibiliḥ śrīmānvṛddhaśarmācatatsutaḥ
verses.translation: Thus the Lord points out the worldly course of con¬ duct. The common people follow what he does as they consider him the authority.
verses.hindi: वेष धारण करनेवाले आपको नमस्कार है और निषङ्ग (तरकस)-धारी हरको नमस्कार है॥ ६८--७०॥ तीन आँखोंवाले आपको नमस्कार है, गजचर्म धारण करनेवाले आपको नमस्कार है। अम्बिकाके स्वामीको नमस्कार है और पशुपतिको नमस्कार है। आकाशरूप आपको और आकाशके अधिपतिको नमस्कार
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the Lord points out the worldly course of con¬ duct. The common people follow what he does as they consider him the authority.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the Lord points out the worldly course of con¬ duct. The common people follow what he does as they consider him the authority.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद् विश्वसहस्तस्मात् खट्वाङ्ग इति विश्रुतः । दीर्घबाहुः सुतस्तस्य रघुस्तस्मादजायत
verses.transliteration: tasmād viśvasahastasmāt khaṭvāṅga iti viśrutaḥ / dīrghabāhuḥ sutastasya raghustasmādajāyata
verses.translation: Then, in course of time, the intelligent Bali, son of Virocana, worshipped Visnu, the all-pervading Lord of Yajnas by performance of Yajnas.
verses.hindi: है। नर और नारीका शरीर धारण करनेवाले अर्धनारीश्वर तथा सांख्य और योगका प्रवर्तन करनेवाले आपको नमस्कार है। देवताओंके स्वामी और देवताओंद्वारा आराधित लिङ्गवाले आपको नमस्कार है। कुमारके गुरु (कार्तिकेयके पिता) आपको तथा देवाधिदेव आपको नमस्कार है । यज्ञके अधिपतिको नमस्कार है, ब्रह्मचारीको नमस्कार है। महान् मृगव्याध तथा ब्रह्माधिपतिको नमस्कार है। हंसरूपको नमस्कार है, विश्वरूप तथा
verses.wordMeaning: Then, in course of time, the intelligent Bali, son of Virocana, worshipped Visnu, the all-pervading Lord of Yajnas by performance of Yajnas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then, in course of time, the intelligent Bali, son of Virocana, worshipped Visnu, the all-pervading Lord of Yajnas by performance of Yajnas.

verses.sanskrit: रघोरजः समुत्पन्नो राजा दशरथस्ततः । रामो दाशरथिर्वोरो धर्मज्ञो लोकविश्रुतः
verses.transliteration: raghorajaḥ samutpanno rājā daśarathastataḥ / rāmo dāśarathirvoro dharmajño lokaviśrutaḥ
verses.translation: He worshipped Brahmanas after giving them abun¬ dant wealth. Brahmana sages came to the sacrificial hall of the noble soul.
verses.hindi: मोहित करनेवालेको बार-बार नमस्कार है। योगी, योगसे प्राप्त होने योग्य तथा योग ही जिनकी माया है ऐसे आपको नमस्कार है प्राणोंका पालन करनेवाले (प्राणिमात्रके प्राणरक्षक) और घंटानादप्रियको नमस्कार है। कपाली आपको नमस्कार है, नक्षत्रोंके स्वामीको नमस्कार है। आपको नमस्कार है, नमस्कार है, नमस्कार है, पुनः आपको
verses.wordMeaning: He worshipped Brahmanas after giving them abun¬ dant wealth. Brahmana sages came to the sacrificial hall of the noble soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: He worshipped Brahmanas after giving them abun¬ dant wealth. Brahmana sages came to the sacrificial hall of the noble soul.

verses.sanskrit: भरतो लक्ष्मणश्चैव शत्रुघ्नश्च महाबलः । सर्वे शक्रसमा युद्धे विष्णुशक्तिसमन्विताः । जज्ञे रावणनाशार्थं विष्णुरंशेन विश्वकृत्
verses.transliteration: bharato lakṣmaṇaścaiva śatrughnaśca mahābalaḥ / sarve śakrasamā yuddhe viṣṇuśaktisamanvitāḥ / jajñe rāvaṇanāśārthaṃ viṣṇuraṃśena viśvakṛt
verses.translation: Lord Vi?nu came to know of this and urged by Bharadvaja, he came to the place of Yajna assuming the form of a Vamana (Dwarf).
verses.hindi: बार-बार नमस्कार है। परमेश्वर! आप मेरी अभीष्ट इच्छाओंको सभी प्रकारसे मुझे प्रदान करें विप्रो! इस प्रकार वे माधव भक्तिपूर्वक देवेशकी स्तुतिकर देव और देवी अर्थात् शंकर-पार्वतीके चरणोंमें दण्डवत् गिर पड़े। मेधके समान गम्भीर ध्वनिवाले भगवान् शंकरने केशीको मारनेवाले कृष्णको उठाकर
verses.wordMeaning: Lord Vi?nu came to know of this and urged by Bharadvaja, he came to the place of Yajna assuming the form of a Vamana (Dwarf).
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Vi?nu came to know of this and urged by Bharadvaja, he came to the place of Yajna assuming the form of a Vamana (Dwarf).

verses.sanskrit: रामस्य सुभगा भार्या जनकस्यात्मजा शुभा । सीता त्रिलोकविख्याता शीलौदार्यगुणान्विता
verses.transliteration: rāmasya subhagā bhāryā janakasyātmajā śubhā / sītā trilokavikhyātā śīlaudāryaguṇānvitā
verses.translation: With the hide of a black antelope and the sacred thread (as the upper garment) and shining with the sacred staff of a Palasa tree in his hand, the extremely brilliant Brahmana (Visnu, the Dwarf) with matted hair, came there reciting the Vedas.
verses.hindi: किमर्थ पुण्डरीकाक्ष तपस्तप्तं त्वयाव्यय। त्वमेव दाता सर्वेषां कामानां कामिनामिह त्वं हि सा परमा मूर्तिर्मम नारायणाह्वया। नानवासं त्वया तात विद्यते पुरुषोत्तम
verses.wordMeaning: With the hide of a black antelope and the sacred thread (as the upper garment) and shining with the sacred staff of a Palasa tree in his hand, the extremely brilliant Brahmana (Visnu, the Dwarf) with matted hair, came there reciting the Vedas.
verses.commentary: Sense: With the hide of a black antelope and the sacred thread (as the upper garment) and shining with the sacred staff of a Palasa tree in his hand, the extremely brilliant Brahmana (Visnu, the Dwarf) with matted hair, came there reciting the Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: तपसा तोषिता देवी जनकेन गिरीन्द्रजा । प्रायच्छज्जानकीं सीतां राममेवाश्रिता पतिम्
verses.transliteration: tapasā toṣitā devī janakena girīndrajā / prāyacchajjānakīṃ sītāṃ rāmamevāśritā patim
verses.translation: Coming near the king of Asuras, Hari the mendicant begged him for the space traversed by three steps of his own feet.
verses.hindi: वेत्थ नारायणानन्तमात्मानं परमेश्वरम्। महादेवं महायोगं स्वेन योगेन केशव उवाच वीक्ष्य विश्वेशं देवीं च हिमशेलजाम्
verses.wordMeaning: Coming near the king of Asuras, Hari the mendicant begged him for the space traversed by three steps of his own feet.
verses.commentary: Sense: Coming near the king of Asuras, Hari the mendicant begged him for the space traversed by three steps of his own feet.

verses.sanskrit: प्रीतश्च भगवानीशस्त्रिशूली नीललोहितः । प्रददौ शत्रुनाशार्थं जनकायाद्भुतं धनुः
verses.transliteration: prītaśca bhagavānīśastriśūlī nīlalohitaḥ / pradadau śatrunāśārthaṃ janakāyādbhutaṃ dhanuḥ
verses.translation: The Lord of the Daityas had sought refuge in him. Desirous of making him free from covetousness and other passions, the primordial Lord covered, in his strides, the Earth, firmament and heaven.
verses.hindi: ज्ञातं हि भवता सर्व स्वेन योगेन शंकर। इच्छाम्यात्मसमं पुत्रं त्वद्भक्तं देहि शंकर देवीमालोक्य गिरिजां केशवं परिषस्वजे
verses.wordMeaning: The Lord of the Daityas had sought refuge in him. Desirous of making him free from covetousness and other passions, the primordial Lord covered, in his strides, the Earth, firmament and heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Lord of the Daityas had sought refuge in him. Desirous of making him free from covetousness and other passions, the primordial Lord covered, in his strides, the Earth, firmament and heaven.

verses.sanskrit: स राजा जनको विद्वान् दातुकामः सुतामिमाम् । अघोषयदमित्रघ्नो लोके ऽस्मिन् द्विजपुङ्गवाः
verses.transliteration: sa rājā janako vidvān dātukāmaḥ sutāmimām / aghoṣayadamitraghno loke 'smin dvijapuṅgavāḥ
verses.translation: The foot of the Lord traversed the three worlds, and went to the Brahmaloka from the region of Prajapati. The leading gods, the chief of whom were the Adityas, and the Siddhas who stayed there bowed unto him [v.l. who was refulgent like a thousand suns.]
verses.hindi: ततः सा जगतां माता शंकरार्धशरीरिणी। व्याजहार हृषीकेशं देवी हिमगिरीन्द्रजा अनन्यामीश्वरे भक्तिमात्मन्यपि च केशव
verses.wordMeaning: The foot of the Lord traversed the three worlds, and went to the Brahmaloka from the region of Prajapati. The leading gods, the chief of whom were the Adityas, and the Siddhas who stayed there bowed unto him [v.l. who was refulgent like a thousand suns.]
verses.commentary: Sense: The foot of the Lord traversed the three worlds, and went to the Brahmaloka from the region of Prajapati. The leading gods, the chief of whom were the Adityas, and the Siddhas who stayed there bowed unto him [v.l. who was refulgent like a thousand suns.]

verses.sanskrit: इदं धनुः समादातुं यः शक्नोति जगत्त्रये । देवो वा दानवो वापि स सीतां लब्धुमर्हति
verses.transliteration: idaṃ dhanuḥ samādātuṃ yaḥ śaknoti jagattraye / devo vā dānavo vāpi sa sītāṃ labdhumarhati
verses.translation: The Primordial Lord, the beginningless grandsire of the world, offered worship to him and propitiated him. After cracking the Upper crest of the Cosmic egg, he em¬ bellished with divine ornaments went again.
verses.hindi: त्वं हिं नारायणः साक्षात् सर्वात्मा पुरुषोत्तमः । प्रार्थितो हैवतैः पूर्व संजातो देवकीसुतः इमानिमान् वरानिष्टान् मत्तो गृह्णीष्व केशव।
verses.wordMeaning: The Primordial Lord, the beginningless grandsire of the world, offered worship to him and propitiated him. After cracking the Upper crest of the Cosmic egg, he em¬ bellished with divine ornaments went again.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Primordial Lord, the beginningless grandsire of the world, offered worship to him and propitiated him. After cracking the Upper crest of the Cosmic egg, he em¬ bellished with divine ornaments went again.

verses.sanskrit: विज्ञाय रामो बलवान् जनकस्य गृहं प्रभुः । भञ्जयामास चादाय गत्वासौ लीलयैव हि
verses.transliteration: vijñāya rāmo balavān janakasya gṛhaṃ prabhuḥ / bhañjayāmāsa cādāya gatvāsau līlayaiva hi
verses.translation: Thanks to the breaking of the Egg, the great cool water resorted to by the meritorious, flowed over. The excellent river was designated as Ganga by god Brahma. It was stationed in the sky.
verses.hindi: एवमुक्तस्तया कृष्णो महादेव्या जनार्दनः । आशिषं शिरसागृह्णाद् देवोऽप्याह महेश्वरः प्रगृह्य कृष्णं भगवानथेशः
verses.wordMeaning: Thanks to the breaking of the Egg, the great cool water resorted to by the meritorious, flowed over. The excellent river was designated as Ganga by god Brahma. It was stationed in the sky.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thanks to the breaking of the Egg, the great cool water resorted to by the meritorious, flowed over. The excellent river was designated as Ganga by god Brahma. It was stationed in the sky.

verses.sanskrit: उद्ववाह च तां कन्यां पार्वतीमिव शङ्करः । रामः परमधर्मात्मा सेनामिव च षण्मुखः
verses.transliteration: udvavāha ca tāṃ kanyāṃ pārvatīmiva śaṅkaraḥ / rāmaḥ paramadharmātmā senāmiva ca ṣaṇmukhaḥ
verses.translation: After reaching the great Prakrti, Pradhana, the source of Brahman and then the sole Purusa, the seed (origin) of the universe, he stabilised his foot at the unchanging region of I sa. Seeing it, the gods eulogised it at those different places.
verses.hindi: करेण देव्या सह देवदेवः। सम्पूज्यमानो मुनिभिः सुरेशै- पुण्डरीकाक्ष! अव्यय! आपने तप क्यों किया है। (क्योंकि) आप ही कामना करनेवालोंकी सभी कामनाओंको पूर्ण करनेवाले हैं। आप ही मेरी नारायण नामवाली परम मूर्ति हैं। पुरुषोत्तम ! तात! आपके लिये
verses.wordMeaning: After reaching the great Prakrti, Pradhana, the source of Brahman and then the sole Purusa, the seed (origin) of the universe, he stabilised his foot at the unchanging region of I sa. Seeing it, the gods eulogised it at those different places.
verses.commentary: Sense: After reaching the great Prakrti, Pradhana, the source of Brahman and then the sole Purusa, the seed (origin) of the universe, he stabilised his foot at the unchanging region of I sa. Seeing it, the gods eulogised it at those different places.

verses.sanskrit: ततो बहुतिथे काले राजा दशरथः स्वयम् । रामं ज्येष्ठं सुतं वीरं राजानं कर्तुमारभत्
verses.transliteration: tato bahutithe kāle rājā daśarathaḥ svayam / rāmaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ sutaṃ vīraṃ rājānaṃ kartumārabhat
verses.translation: On seeing that Purusa with the universe for his physical body, Bali the great, bowed to Visnu with devotion.
verses.hindi: कुछ भी अप्राप्य नहीं है। केशव! अपने योगद्वारा आप अपनेको नारायण, अनन्त, परमेश्वर, महादेव और उनका वह वचन सुनकर हँसते हुए श्रीकृष्णने विश्वेश्वर तथा हिमालय-पुत्री देवी पार्वतीको ओर देखकर वृषध्वज शंकरसे कहा--प्रभो शंकर! आपको अपने योगद्वारा सब कुछ ज्ञात है। में अपने ही समान
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing that Purusa with the universe for his physical body, Bali the great, bowed to Visnu with devotion.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing that Purusa with the universe for his physical body, Bali the great, bowed to Visnu with devotion.

verses.sanskrit: तस्याथ पत्नी सुभगा कैकेयी चारुभाषिणी । निवारयामास पतिं प्राह संभ्रान्तमानसा
verses.transliteration: tasyātha patnī subhagā kaikeyī cārubhāṣiṇī / nivārayāmāsa patiṃ prāha saṃbhrāntamānasā
verses.translation: Lord Vasudeva, the primordial creator became a Dwarf once again and said to him—"O Lord of Daityas, in effect, the three worlds have been given over to me by you yourself."
verses.hindi: ऐसा पुत्र चाहता हूँ, जो आपका भक्त हो, श्रीशंकर! आप मुझे प्रदान करें। प्रसन्न-मन होकर विश्वात्मा हरने 'तथास्तु' ऐसा कहकर और देवी पार्वतीकी ओर देखकर केशवका आलिङ्गन किया तदनन्तर शंकरके आधे शरीरमें स्थित, संसारको माता हिमालय पर्वतको पुत्री देवी (पार्वती) हषीकेशसे बोलीं। अच्युत! केशव! वत्स! मैं ईश्वर (शंकर)- में तथा मुझमें भी सर्वदा रहनेवाली आपकी अनन्त,
verses.wordMeaning: Lord Vasudeva, the primordial creator became a Dwarf once again and said to him—"O Lord of Daityas, in effect, the three worlds have been given over to me by you yourself."
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Vasudeva, the primordial creator became a Dwarf once again and said to him—"O Lord of Daityas, in effect, the three worlds have been given over to me by you yourself."

verses.sanskrit: मत्सुतं भरतं वीरं राजानं कर्तुमर्हसि । पूर्वमेव वरो यस्माद् दत्तो मे भवता यतः
verses.transliteration: matsutaṃ bharataṃ vīraṃ rājānaṃ kartumarhasi / pūrvameva varo yasmād datto me bhavatā yataḥ
verses.translation: Bowing down again his head, the Daitya poured water at the tip of his hand (and said), "I shall offer myself unto you of infinite splendour and abode, to Trivikrama of unmeasured stride."
verses.hindi: निश्चल और अनन्य भक्तिको जानती हूँ। आप ही साक्षात् नारायण और सर्वात्मा पुरुषोत्तम हैं। पूर्वकालमें देवताओंके द्वारा प्रार्थना किये जानेपर आप देवकीके पुत्रके रूपमें उत्पन्न हुए थे। आप अपने आत्मरूपको तथा अपने निर्मल पदको स्वयं देखें। हम दोनोंमें कोई भेद नहीं है। विद्वान् लोग (हम दोनोंको) एक रूपसे देखते हें । केशव! आप इन अभीष्ट वरोंको मुझसे ग्रहण करें। आपको सर्वज्ञता, ऐश्वर्य, वह परमेश्वर-सम्बन्धी ज्ञान, शिवमें निश्चल
verses.wordMeaning: Bowing down again his head, the Daitya poured water at the tip of his hand (and said), "I shall offer myself unto you of infinite splendour and abode, to Trivikrama of unmeasured stride."
verses.commentary: Sense: Bowing down again his head, the Daitya poured water at the tip of his hand (and said), "I shall offer myself unto you of infinite splendour and abode, to Trivikrama of unmeasured stride."

verses.sanskrit: स तस्या वचनं श्रुत्वा राजा दुः खितमानसः । बाढमित्यब्रवीद् वाक्यं तथा रामो ऽपि धर्मवित्
verses.transliteration: sa tasyā vacanaṃ śrutvā rājā duḥ khitamānasaḥ / bāḍhamityabravīd vākyaṃ tathā rāmo 'pi dharmavit
verses.translation: After accepting dana (lit. what has been offered) from Bali, the son of Prahlada's son, Sahkha-pani (i.e. the conch¬ armed deity Visnu), the immanent soul of the universe spoke again to Daitya: "Enter the root (the downmost part) of the nether world.
verses.hindi: भक्ति तथा अपनेमें श्रेष्ठ बल प्राप्त हो उन महादेवीके द्वारा ऐसा कहे जानेपर जनार्दन कृष्णने उनके (वररूपी) आशीर्वादको शिरोधार्य किया। देव महेश्वरने भी कृष्णसे ऐसा ही कहा अर्थात् आशीर्वाद प्रदान किया। तब देवताओं तथा मुनियोंसे
verses.wordMeaning: After accepting dana (lit. what has been offered) from Bali, the son of Prahlada's son, Sahkha-pani (i.e. the conch¬ armed deity Visnu), the immanent soul of the universe spoke again to Daitya: "Enter the root (the downmost part) of the nether world.
verses.commentary: Sense: After accepting dana (lit. what has been offered) from Bali, the son of Prahlada's son, Sahkha-pani (i.e. the conch¬ armed deity Visnu), the immanent soul of the universe spoke again to Daitya: "Enter the root (the downmost part) of the nether world.

verses.sanskrit: प्रणम्याथ पितुः पादौ लक्ष्मणेन सहाच्युतः । ययौ वनं सपत्नीकः कृत्वा समयमात्मवान्
verses.transliteration: praṇamyātha pituḥ pādau lakṣmaṇena sahācyutaḥ / yayau vanaṃ sapatnīkaḥ kṛtvā samayamātmavān
verses.translation: Enjoying pleasures unavailable even to gods, stay there permanently. By the path of devotion, meditate on me continuously. At the close of the Kalpa, you will enter me once again."
verses.hindi: पूजित होते हुए देवाधिदेव गिरीश भगवान् शंकर कृष्णका हाथ पकड़कर देवी पार्वतीके साथ कैलास पर्वतपर चले गये श्रीकृष्णका कैलास पर्वतपर विहार करना, श्रीकृष्णको द्वारका बुलानेके लिये गरुडका कैलासपर जाना, श्रीकृष्णका द्वारका-आगमन, द्वारकामें श्रीकृष्णका स्वागत तथा उनका दर्शन करनेके लिये देवताओं तथा मार्कण्डेय आदि मुनियोंका आना, कृष्णके द्वारा महर्षि मार्कण्डेयको शिव-तत्त्व तथा लिङ्ग-तत्त्वका माहात्म्य बतलाना तथा
verses.wordMeaning: Enjoying pleasures unavailable even to gods, stay there permanently. By the path of devotion, meditate on me continuously. At the close of the Kalpa, you will enter me once again."
verses.commentary: Sense: Enjoying pleasures unavailable even to gods, stay there permanently. By the path of devotion, meditate on me continuously. At the close of the Kalpa, you will enter me once again."

verses.sanskrit: संवत्सराणां चत्वारि दश चैव महाबलः । उवास तत्र मतिमान् लक्ष्मणेन सह प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: saṃvatsarāṇāṃ catvāri daśa caiva mahābalaḥ / uvāsa tatra matimān lakṣmaṇena saha prabhuḥ
verses.translation: After advising this to that lion-like Daitya, Visnu of great strides and of truthful exploits, gave the three worlds unto Indra.
verses.hindi: स्वयं शिवका पूजन करना, ब्रह्मा-विष्णुद्वारा शिवके महालिङ्गका दर्शन तथा लिङ्गस्तुति, लिङ्गार्चनका प्रवर्तन रराम भगवान् सोमः केशवेन महेश्वरः
verses.wordMeaning: After advising this to that lion-like Daitya, Visnu of great strides and of truthful exploits, gave the three worlds unto Indra.
verses.commentary: Sense: After advising this to that lion-like Daitya, Visnu of great strides and of truthful exploits, gave the three worlds unto Indra.

verses.sanskrit: कदाचिद् वसतो ऽरण्ये रावणो नाम राक्षसः । परिव्राजकवेषेण सीतां हृत्वा ययौ पुरीम्
verses.transliteration: kadācid vasato 'raṇye rāvaṇo nāma rākṣasaḥ / parivrājakaveṣeṇa sītāṃ hṛtvā yayau purīm
verses.translation: Siddhas, Devas, sages, Kinnaras, gods Brahma, Indra, Lord Rudra and Adityas (the sun-gods) and the group of Maruts eulogised the Deity of great Yoga.
verses.hindi: पूजयाञ्चक्रिरे कृष्णं देवदेवमथाच्युतम् चतुर्बाहुमुदाराङ्कं कालमेघसमप्रभम् ।
verses.wordMeaning: Siddhas, Devas, sages, Kinnaras, gods Brahma, Indra, Lord Rudra and Adityas (the sun-gods) and the group of Maruts eulogised the Deity of great Yoga.
verses.commentary: Sense: Siddhas, Devas, sages, Kinnaras, gods Brahma, Indra, Lord Rudra and Adityas (the sun-gods) and the group of Maruts eulogised the Deity of great Yoga.

verses.sanskrit: अदृष्ट्वा लक्ष्मणो रामः सीतामाकुलितेन्द्रियौ । दुः खशोकाभिसंतप्तौ बभूवतुररिन्दमौ
verses.transliteration: adṛṣṭvā lakṣmaṇo rāmaḥ sītāmākulitendriyau / duḥ khaśokābhisaṃtaptau babhūvaturarindamau
verses.translation: After performing that miraculous feat, Visnu who had assumed the form of a dwarf (Vamana) vanished there itself even as all of them were watching.
verses.hindi: भ्राजमानं श्रिया दिव्यं युवानमतिकोमलम्। पद्याङ्गिनयने चारु सुस्मितं सुगतिप्रदम् कदाचित् तत्र लीलार्थं देवकीनन्दवर्धनः । भ्राजमानः श्रिया कृष्णश्चचार गिरिकन्दरे
verses.wordMeaning: After performing that miraculous feat, Visnu who had assumed the form of a dwarf (Vamana) vanished there itself even as all of them were watching.
verses.commentary: Sense: After performing that miraculous feat, Visnu who had assumed the form of a dwarf (Vamana) vanished there itself even as all of them were watching.

verses.sanskrit: ततः कदाचित् कपिना सुग्रीवेण द्विजोत्तमाः । वानराणामभूत् सख्यं रामस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kadācit kapinā sugrīveṇa dvijottamāḥ / vānarāṇāmabhūt sakhyaṃ rāmasyākliṣṭakarmaṇaḥ
verses.translation: Being urged by Prahlada and other leading Asuras, the excellent Daitya Bali, the glorious devotee of Visnu went to Patala.
verses.hindi: गन्धर्वकन्यका दिव्यास्तद्वदप्सरसां वराः। दृष्टा चकमिरे कृष्णं स्त्रस्तवस्त्रविभूषणाः काश्चिद् गायन्ति विविधां गीतिं गीतविशारदाः। सम्प्रेक्ष्य देवकीसूनुं सुन्दर्यः काममोहिताः
verses.wordMeaning: Being urged by Prahlada and other leading Asuras, the excellent Daitya Bali, the glorious devotee of Visnu went to Patala.
verses.commentary: Sense: Being urged by Prahlada and other leading Asuras, the excellent Daitya Bali, the glorious devotee of Visnu went to Patala.

verses.sanskrit: सुग्रीवस्यानुगो वीरो हनुमान् न्म वानरः । वायुपुत्रौ महातेजा रामस्यासीत् प्रियः सदा
verses.transliteration: sugrīvasyānugo vīro hanumān nma vānaraḥ / vāyuputrau mahātejā rāmasyāsīt priyaḥ sadā
verses.translation: He asked Prahlada about the greatness of Visnu, the excellent path of devotion and the procedure of his worship. He (Prahlada) explained all these and he (Bali) did in accord¬ ance with it.
verses.hindi: काश्चिद्विलासबहुला नृत्यन्ति स्म तदग्रतः । सम्प्रेक्ष्य संस्थिताः काश्चित् पपुस्तद्ठदनामृतम् सूतजी बोले--मेरु शिखरके स्वर्णिम कैलास पर्वतपर पहुँचकर महेश्वर भगवान् शंकर केशव ( श्रीकुष्ण)- के साथ विहार करने लगे। कैलास पर्वतपर निवास करनेवालोंने उन देवाधिदेव, अच्युत, महात्मा श्रीकृष्णको
verses.wordMeaning: He asked Prahlada about the greatness of Visnu, the excellent path of devotion and the procedure of his worship. He (Prahlada) explained all these and he (Bali) did in accord¬ ance with it.
verses.commentary: Sense: He asked Prahlada about the greatness of Visnu, the excellent path of devotion and the procedure of his worship. He (Prahlada) explained all these and he (Bali) did in accord¬ ance with it.

verses.sanskrit: स कृत्वा परमं धैर्यं रामाय कृतनिश्चयः । आनयिष्यामि तां सीतामित्युक्त्वा विचचार ह
verses.transliteration: sa kṛtvā paramaṃ dhairyaṃ rāmāya kṛtaniścayaḥ / ānayiṣyāmi tāṃ sītāmityuktvā vicacāra ha
verses.translation: With great emotional attachment, he sought refuge in the Deity holding a discus and a conch in hand—the
verses.hindi: देखकर उनकी पूजा की। उन्होंने चार भुजावाले, उदार अङ्गोंवाले, प्रलयकालीन मेघके समान प्रभावाले, मुकुटधारी, हाथमें धनुष धारण किये, श्रीवत्ससे सुशोभित वक्षःस्थलवाले, वक्षःस्थलपर उत्तम वैजयन्तीकी माला धारण किये, शोभासे सुशोभित दिव्य अति कोमल, युवावस्थावाले, कमल (वर्ण)-के समान (रक्त) चरण एवं नेत्रवाले, अत्यन्त सुन्दर, मुसकराते हुए अच्छी गति प्रदान
verses.wordMeaning: With great emotional attachment, he sought refuge in the Deity holding a discus and a conch in hand—the
verses.commentary: Sense: With great emotional attachment, he sought refuge in the Deity holding a discus and a conch in hand—the

verses.sanskrit: महीं सागरपर्यन्तां सीतादर्शनतत्परः । जगाम रावणपुरीं लङ्कां सागरसंस्थिताम्
verses.transliteration: mahīṃ sāgaraparyantāṃ sītādarśanatatparaḥ / jagāma rāvaṇapurīṃ laṅkāṃ sāgarasaṃsthitām
verses.translation: O Brahmanas, the exploits of Vamana have been thus described to you. That Purusottama accomplishes the tasks of Devas.
