verses.hindi: करनेवाले अच्युत (श्रीकृष्ण)-को पूजा को॥ १--५॥ वहाँ किसी समय माता देवकीके आनन्दको बढ़ानेवाले शोभासम्पन्न श्रीकृष्ण लीलाके निमित्त कैलास पर्वतकी गुहामें विचरण करने लगे। सभी प्रमुख गन्धर्वो,
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas, the exploits of Vamana have been thus described to you. That Purusottama accomplishes the tasks of Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas, the exploits of Vamana have been thus described to you. That Purusottama accomplishes the tasks of Devas.

verses.sanskrit: तत्राथ निर्जने देशे वृक्ष्मूले शुचिस्मिताम् । अपश्यदमलां सीतां राक्षसीभिः समावृताम्
verses.transliteration: tatrātha nirjane deśe vṛkṣmūle śucismitām / apaśyadamalāṃ sītāṃ rākṣasībhiḥ samāvṛtām
verses.translation: It appears that with the exception of Prahlada, the Asuras were pro-Siva & some of their chiefs were absorbed as chief attendants of Siva.
verses.hindi: वहाँ उन जगन्मय (श्रीकुष्ण)-को देखा और परम आश्चर्यचकित होकर वे आनन्दसे प्रफुल्लित नेत्रवाले हो गये तथा उन महात्माके मस्तकपर पुष्पोंकी वर्षा करने लगे। दिव्य गन्धवोँकी कन्याएँ तथा उसी प्रकार श्रेष्ठ अप्सराएँ कृष्णको देखकर अव्यवस्थित वस्त्राभूषणवाली होकर उनकी कामना करने लगीं। गायनमें पारंगत कुछ सुन्दरियाँ काममोहित होकर देवकीपुत्रकी ओर देखकर विविध प्रकारके गीत गाने लगीं
verses.wordMeaning: It appears that with the exception of Prahlada, the Asuras were pro-Siva & some of their chiefs were absorbed as chief attendants of Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears that with the exception of Prahlada, the Asuras were pro-Siva & some of their chiefs were absorbed as chief attendants of Siva.

verses.sanskrit: अश्रुपूर्णेक्षणां हृद्यां संस्मरन्तीमनिन्दिताम् । राममिन्दीवरश्यामं लक्ष्मणं चात्मसंस्थितम्
verses.transliteration: aśrupūrṇekṣaṇāṃ hṛdyāṃ saṃsmarantīmaninditām / rāmamindīvaraśyāmaṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ cātmasaṃsthitam
verses.translation: That king was a great devotee of Sankara. He ruled over the kingdom. After subjugating the three worlds, he harassed Indra.
verses.hindi: कुछ अत्यन्त विलासप्रिय (कन्याएँ) उनके आगे नृत्य करने लगीं और कुछ वहीं स्थित होकर उनकी ओर देखकर उनके वदनामृतका पान करने लगीं काञ्चिद् भूषणवर्याणि स्वाड्रादादाय सादरम्। भूषयाञ्चक्रिरे कृष्णं कामिन्यो लोकभूषणम्
verses.wordMeaning: That king was a great devotee of Sankara. He ruled over the kingdom. After subjugating the three worlds, he harassed Indra.
verses.commentary: Sense: That king was a great devotee of Sankara. He ruled over the kingdom. After subjugating the three worlds, he harassed Indra.

verses.sanskrit: निवेदयित्वा चात्मानं सीतायै रहसि स्वयम् । असंशयाय प्रददावस्यै रामाङ्गुलीयकम्
verses.transliteration: nivedayitvā cātmānaṃ sītāyai rahasi svayam / asaṃśayāya pradadāvasyai rāmāṅgulīyakam
verses.translation: Then Indra and other Devas went to Krttivasas (Elephant-hide-robed god Siva) and said to him, "The great Asura named Bana who is your protege, is harassing us."
verses.hindi: काश्चिद् भूषणवर्याणि समादाय तदङ्कतः । स्वात्मानं भूषयामासुः स्वात्मगैरपि माधवम् काश्चिदागत्य कृष्णस्य समीपं काममोहिताः । चुचुम्बुर्वदनाम्भोजं हरेर्मुग्धमृगेक्षणाः
verses.wordMeaning: Then Indra and other Devas went to Krttivasas (Elephant-hide-robed god Siva) and said to him, "The great Asura named Bana who is your protege, is harassing us."
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Indra and other Devas went to Krttivasas (Elephant-hide-robed god Siva) and said to him, "The great Asura named Bana who is your protege, is harassing us."

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वाङ्गुलीयकं सीता पत्युः परमशोभनम् । मेने समागतं रामं प्रीतिविस्फारितेक्षणा
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvāṅgulīyakaṃ sītā patyuḥ paramaśobhanam / mene samāgataṃ rāmaṃ prītivisphāritekṣaṇā
verses.translation: Thus addressed by Devas, Lord Mahesvara, Lord of Devas, burned Bana's city sportively with a single arrow.
verses.hindi: प्रगृह्य काश्चिद् गोविन्दं करेण भवनं स्वकम्। प्रापयामासुर्लोकादिं मायया तस्य मोहिताः तासां स भगवान् कृष्णः कामान् कमललोचनः । बहूनि कृत्वा रूपाणि पूरयामास लीलया
verses.wordMeaning: Thus addressed by Devas, Lord Mahesvara, Lord of Devas, burned Bana's city sportively with a single arrow.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus addressed by Devas, Lord Mahesvara, Lord of Devas, burned Bana's city sportively with a single arrow.

verses.sanskrit: समाश्वास्य तदा सीतां दृष्ट्वा रामस्य चान्तिकम् । नयिष्ये त्वां महाबाहुरुक्त्वा रामं ययौ पुनः
verses.transliteration: samāśvāsya tadā sītāṃ dṛṣṭvā rāmasya cāntikam / nayiṣye tvāṃ mahābāhuruktvā rāmaṃ yayau punaḥ
verses.translation: When the city was being burned, Bana sought refuge in the Trident-bearing Lord Rudra, the Lord of the Bull, Isa, Nila-lohita (of blue-red complexion).
verses.hindi: एवं वै सुचिरं कालं देवदेवपुरे हरिः। रेमे नारायणः श्रीमान् मायया मोहयञ्जगत् गते बहुतिथे काले द्वारवत्यां निवासिनः । बभूवुर्विह्ृला भीता गोविन्दविरहे जनाः
verses.wordMeaning: When the city was being burned, Bana sought refuge in the Trident-bearing Lord Rudra, the Lord of the Bull, Isa, Nila-lohita (of blue-red complexion).
verses.commentary: Sense: When the city was being burned, Bana sought refuge in the Trident-bearing Lord Rudra, the Lord of the Bull, Isa, Nila-lohita (of blue-red complexion).

verses.sanskrit: निवेदयित्वा रामाय सीतादर्शनमात्मवान् । तस्थौ रामेण पुरतो लक्ष्मणेन च पूजितः
verses.transliteration: nivedayitvā rāmāya sītādarśanamātmavān / tasthau rāmeṇa purato lakṣmaṇena ca pūjitaḥ
verses.translation: Bearing thatLihga of Sambhu over his head, he came out of the city and devoid of passion (v.l. fear) eulogised the Supreme Ruler.
verses.hindi: अदृष्ट्रा तत्र गोविन्दं प्रणम्य शिरसा मुनिम्। आजगामोपमन्युं तं पुरीं द्वारवतीं पुनः तदन्तरे महाहैत्या राक्षसाश्चातिभीषणाः। आजगम्मुद्वारकां शुभ्रां भीषयन्तः सहस्त्रशः
verses.wordMeaning: Bearing thatLihga of Sambhu over his head, he came out of the city and devoid of passion (v.l. fear) eulogised the Supreme Ruler.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bearing thatLihga of Sambhu over his head, he came out of the city and devoid of passion (v.l. fear) eulogised the Supreme Ruler.

verses.sanskrit: ततः स रामो बलवान् सार्धं हनुमता स्वयम् । लक्ष्मणेन च युद्धाय बुद्धिं चक्रे हि रक्षसाम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa rāmo balavān sārdhaṃ hanumatā svayam / lakṣmaṇena ca yuddhāya buddhiṃ cakre hi rakṣasām
verses.translation: Lord Isa, Sankara, Nilalohita, on being eulogised, (and propitiated) lovingly engaged Bana in the chieftancy of the Ganasd
verses.hindi: एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु नारदो भगवानृषिः । दृष्टा कैलासशिखरे कृष्णं द्वारवतीं गतः प्रोचुर्नारायणो नाथः कुत्रास्ते भगवान् हरिः
verses.wordMeaning: Lord Isa, Sankara, Nilalohita, on being eulogised, (and propitiated) lovingly engaged Bana in the chieftancy of the Ganasd
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Isa, Sankara, Nilalohita, on being eulogised, (and propitiated) lovingly engaged Bana in the chieftancy of the Ganasd

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वाथ वानरशतैर्लङ्कामार्गं महोदधेः । सेतुं परमधर्मात्मा रावणं हतवान् प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: kṛtvātha vānaraśatairlaṅkāmārgaṃ mahodadheḥ / setuṃ paramadharmātmā rāvaṇaṃ hatavān prabhuḥ
verses.translation: Similarly, the terrible sons of Danu were Tara and others. Out of them Tara, Sambara, Kapila, Sankara (?) (a better v.l. Sancara), Svarbhanu, and Vrsaparvan have been glorified as the prominent ones.
verses.hindi: स तानुवाच भगवान् कैलासशिखरे हरिः। रमतेऽद्य महायोगिन् तं दृष्टराहमिहागतः जगामाकाशगो विप्राः कैलासं गिरिमुत्तमम्
verses.wordMeaning: Similarly, the terrible sons of Danu were Tara and others. Out of them Tara, Sambara, Kapila, Sankara (?) (a better v.l. Sancara), Svarbhanu, and Vrsaparvan have been glorified as the prominent ones.
verses.commentary: Sense: Similarly, the terrible sons of Danu were Tara and others. Out of them Tara, Sambara, Kapila, Sankara (?) (a better v.l. Sancara), Svarbhanu, and Vrsaparvan have been glorified as the prominent ones.

verses.sanskrit: सपत्नीकं च ससुतं सभ्रातृकमरिदमः । आनयामास तां सीतां वायुपुत्रसहायवान्
verses.transliteration: sapatnīkaṃ ca sasutaṃ sabhrātṛkamaridamaḥ / ānayāmāsa tāṃ sītāṃ vāyuputrasahāyavān
verses.translation: Similarly, the terrible sons of Danu were Tara and others. Out of them Tara, Sambara, Kapila, Sankara (?) (a better v.l. Sancara), Svarbhanu, and Vrsaparvan have been glorified as the prominent ones.
verses.hindi: ददर्श देवकीसूनुं भवने रत्नमण्डिते। वरासनस्थं गोविन्दं देवदेवान्तिके हरिम् महादेवगणैः सिद्धैर्योगिभिः परिवारितम्
verses.wordMeaning: Similarly, the terrible sons of Danu were Tara and others. Out of them Tara, Sambara, Kapila, Sankara (?) (a better v.l. Sancara), Svarbhanu, and Vrsaparvan have been glorified as the prominent ones.
verses.commentary: Sense: Similarly, the terrible sons of Danu were Tara and others. Out of them Tara, Sambara, Kapila, Sankara (?) (a better v.l. Sancara), Svarbhanu, and Vrsaparvan have been glorified as the prominent ones.

verses.sanskrit: सेतुमध्ये महादेवमीशानं कृत्तिवाससम् । स्थापयामास लिङ्गस्थं पूजयामास राघवः
verses.transliteration: setumadhye mahādevamīśānaṃ kṛttivāsasam / sthāpayāmāsa liṅgasthaṃ pūjayāmāsa rāghavaḥ
verses.translation: Similarly, the terrible sons of Danu were Tara and others. Out of them Tara, Sambara, Kapila, Sankara (?) (a better v.l. Sancara), Svarbhanu, and Vrsaparvan have been glorified as the prominent ones.
verses.hindi: कुछ कामिनियाँ (कन्याएं) अपने अङ्गोंसे श्रेष्ठ आभूषणोंको उतारकर उनसे लोकभूषण कृष्णको आदरपूर्वक आभूषित करने लगीं। कुछ उनके अद्भोंसे श्रेष्ठ आभूषणोंको लेकर अपनेको तथा अपने आभूषणोंसे माधवको सजाने लगीं। कतिपय मुग्ध मृगके समान नयनोंवाली काम- मोहित (कन्याएँ) हरि कृष्णके समीपमें जाकर उनके मुखकमलका स्पर्श करने लगीं। उनकी मायासे मोहित कुछ अप्सराएँ लोकोंके आदि कारण गोविन्दका हाथ
verses.wordMeaning: Similarly, the terrible sons of Danu were Tara and others. Out of them Tara, Sambara, Kapila, Sankara (?) (a better v.l. Sancara), Svarbhanu, and Vrsaparvan have been glorified as the prominent ones.
verses.commentary: Sense: Similarly, the terrible sons of Danu were Tara and others. Out of them Tara, Sambara, Kapila, Sankara (?) (a better v.l. Sancara), Svarbhanu, and Vrsaparvan have been glorified as the prominent ones.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य देवो महादेवः पार्वत्या सह शङ्करः । प्रत्यक्षमेव भगवान् दत्तवान् वरमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: tasya devo mahādevaḥ pārvatyā saha śaṅkaraḥ / pratyakṣameva bhagavān dattavān varamuttamam
verses.translation: Similarly, the terrible sons of Danu were Tara and others. Out of them Tara, Sambara, Kapila, Sankara (?) (a better v.l. Sancara), Svarbhanu, and Vrsaparvan have been glorified as the prominent ones.
verses.hindi: पकड़कर उन्हें अपने भवनमें ले गयीं उन कमललोचन भगवान् श्रीकुष्णने बहुतसे रूप धारणकर लीलापूर्वक उनकी अभीष्ट कामनाओंकी पूर्ति की। इस प्रकार श्रीमान् नारायण हरिने संसारको (अपनी) मायासे मोहित करते हुए देवाधिदेव शंकरके
verses.wordMeaning: Similarly, the terrible sons of Danu were Tara and others. Out of them Tara, Sambara, Kapila, Sankara (?) (a better v.l. Sancara), Svarbhanu, and Vrsaparvan have been glorified as the prominent ones.
verses.commentary: Sense: Similarly, the terrible sons of Danu were Tara and others. Out of them Tara, Sambara, Kapila, Sankara (?) (a better v.l. Sancara), Svarbhanu, and Vrsaparvan have been glorified as the prominent ones.

verses.sanskrit: यत् त्वया स्थापितं लिङ्गं द्रक्ष्यन्तीह द्विजातयः । महापातकसंयुक्तास्तेषां पापं विनश्यतु
verses.transliteration: yat tvayā sthāpitaṃ liṅgaṃ drakṣyantīha dvijātayaḥ / mahāpātakasaṃyuktāsteṣāṃ pāpaṃ vinaśyatu
verses.translation: Similarly, the terrible sons of Danu were Tara and others. Out of them Tara, Sambara, Kapila, Sankara (?) (a better v.l. Sancara), Svarbhanu, and Vrsaparvan have been glorified as the prominent ones.
verses.hindi: नगरमें बहुत समयतक रमण किया बहुत दिन व्यतीत होनेपर द्वारिकापुरीके रहनेवाले लोग गोविन्दके विरहमें भयभीत एवं विह्वल हो गये।
verses.wordMeaning: Similarly, the terrible sons of Danu were Tara and others. Out of them Tara, Sambara, Kapila, Sankara (?) (a better v.l. Sancara), Svarbhanu, and Vrsaparvan have been glorified as the prominent ones.
verses.commentary: Sense: Similarly, the terrible sons of Danu were Tara and others. Out of them Tara, Sambara, Kapila, Sankara (?) (a better v.l. Sancara), Svarbhanu, and Vrsaparvan have been glorified as the prominent ones.

verses.sanskrit: अन्यानि चैव पापानि स्नातस्यात्र महोदधौ । दर्शनादेव लिङ्गसल्य नाशं यान्ति न संशयः
verses.transliteration: anyāni caiva pāpāni snātasyātra mahodadhau / darśanādeva liṅgasalya nāśaṃ yānti na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Similarly, the terrible sons of Danu were Tara and others. Out of them Tara, Sambara, Kapila, Sankara (?) (a better v.l. Sancara), Svarbhanu, and Vrsaparvan have been glorified as the prominent ones.
verses.hindi: उनको ढूँढ़ते हुए उस हिमालय पर्वतपर गये। वहाँ गोविन्दको न देखकर उन उपमन्युको विनयपूर्वक प्रणामकर पुनः द्वारवतीपुरीमें लौट आये। इसी बीच अत्यन्त भयंकर हजारों महाहैत्य तथा राक्षस भय उत्पन्न करते हुए सुन्दर द्वारकामें आ पहुँचे। कृष्णके समान
verses.wordMeaning: Similarly, the terrible sons of Danu were Tara and others. Out of them Tara, Sambara, Kapila, Sankara (?) (a better v.l. Sancara), Svarbhanu, and Vrsaparvan have been glorified as the prominent ones.
verses.commentary: Sense: Similarly, the terrible sons of Danu were Tara and others. Out of them Tara, Sambara, Kapila, Sankara (?) (a better v.l. Sancara), Svarbhanu, and Vrsaparvan have been glorified as the prominent ones.

verses.sanskrit: यावत् स्थास्यन्ति गिरयो यावदेषा च मेदिनी । यावत् सेतुश्च तावच्च स्थास्याम्यत्र तिरोहितः
verses.transliteration: yāvat sthāsyanti girayo yāvadeṣā ca medinī / yāvat setuśca tāvacca sthāsyāmyatra tirohitaḥ
verses.translation: Similarly, the terrible sons of Danu were Tara and others. Out of them Tara, Sambara, Kapila, Sankara (?) (a better v.l. Sancara), Svarbhanu, and Vrsaparvan have been glorified as the prominent ones.
verses.hindi: उन्हें मारकर उस शुभ पुरीको रक्षा को इसी समय भगवान् नारद ऋषि कैलास शिखरपर श्रीकृष्णका दर्शनकर द्वारकापुरीमें गये। उन नारद ऋषिको देखकर वहाँ (द्वारकामें) निवास करनेवाले सभीने पूछा--' नारायण, नाथ, भगवान् हरि कहाँ हैं ?'
verses.wordMeaning: Similarly, the terrible sons of Danu were Tara and others. Out of them Tara, Sambara, Kapila, Sankara (?) (a better v.l. Sancara), Svarbhanu, and Vrsaparvan have been glorified as the prominent ones.
verses.commentary: Sense: Similarly, the terrible sons of Danu were Tara and others. Out of them Tara, Sambara, Kapila, Sankara (?) (a better v.l. Sancara), Svarbhanu, and Vrsaparvan have been glorified as the prominent ones.

verses.sanskrit: स्नानं दानं जपः श्राद्धं भविष्यत्यक्ष्यं कृतम् । स्मरणादेव लिङ्गस्य दिनपापं प्रणश्यति
verses.transliteration: snānaṃ dānaṃ japaḥ śrāddhaṃ bhaviṣyatyakṣyaṃ kṛtam / smaraṇādeva liṅgasya dinapāpaṃ praṇaśyati
verses.translation: Similarly, the terrible sons of Danu were Tara and others. Out of them Tara, Sambara, Kapila, Sankara (?) (a better v.l. Sancara), Svarbhanu, and Vrsaparvan have been glorified as the prominent ones.
verses.hindi: उन्होंने (नारदने) उनसे कहा कि भगवान् हरि कैलास शिखरपर रमण कर रहे हैं, मैं उन महायोगीको देखकर आज यहाँ आया हूँ विप्रो! उनका वचन सुनकर आकाशमें चलनेवाले पक्षियोंमें श्रेष्ठ वे गरुड श्रेष्ठ पर्वत केलासपर गये। उन्होंने देवकीपुत्र गोविन्द हरिको देवाधिदेव (शंकर) - के समीप रलमण्डित भवनमें एक श्रेष्ठ आसनपर
verses.wordMeaning: Similarly, the terrible sons of Danu were Tara and others. Out of them Tara, Sambara, Kapila, Sankara (?) (a better v.l. Sancara), Svarbhanu, and Vrsaparvan have been glorified as the prominent ones.
verses.commentary: Sense: Similarly, the terrible sons of Danu were Tara and others. Out of them Tara, Sambara, Kapila, Sankara (?) (a better v.l. Sancara), Svarbhanu, and Vrsaparvan have been glorified as the prominent ones.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा भगवाञ्छंभुः परिष्वज्य तु राघवम् । सनन्दी सगणो रुद्रस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत
verses.transliteration: ityuktvā bhagavāñchaṃbhuḥ pariṣvajya tu rāghavam / sanandī sagaṇo rudrastatraivāntaradhīyata
verses.translation: Similarly, the terrible sons of Danu were Tara and others. Out of them Tara, Sambara, Kapila, Sankara (?) (a better v.l. Sancara), Svarbhanu, and Vrsaparvan have been glorified as the prominent ones.
verses.hindi: विराजमान देखा। (वहाँ) देवता, दिव्य स्त्रियाँ, महादेवके गण, सिद्ध तथा योगीजन चारों ओरसे घेरकर उनकी उपासना कर रहे थे प्रणम्य दण्डवद् भूमौ सुपर्णः शंकरं शिवम्। निवेदयामास हरेः प्रवृत्तिं द्वारके पुरे
verses.wordMeaning: Similarly, the terrible sons of Danu were Tara and others. Out of them Tara, Sambara, Kapila, Sankara (?) (a better v.l. Sancara), Svarbhanu, and Vrsaparvan have been glorified as the prominent ones.
verses.commentary: Sense: Similarly, the terrible sons of Danu were Tara and others. Out of them Tara, Sambara, Kapila, Sankara (?) (a better v.l. Sancara), Svarbhanu, and Vrsaparvan have been glorified as the prominent ones.

verses.sanskrit: रामो ऽपि पालयामास राज्यं धर्मपरायणः । अभिषिक्तो महातेजा भरतेन महाबलः
verses.transliteration: rāmo 'pi pālayāmāsa rājyaṃ dharmaparāyaṇaḥ / abhiṣikto mahātejā bharatena mahābalaḥ
verses.translation: Similarly, the terrible sons of Danu were Tara and others. Out of them Tara, Sambara, Kapila, Sankara (?) (a better v.l. Sancara), Svarbhanu, and Vrsaparvan have been glorified as the prominent ones.
verses.hindi: ततः प्रणम्य शिरसा शंकरं नीललोहितम्। आजगाम पुरीं कृष्ण: सोऽनुज्ञातो हरेण तु वचोभिरमृतास्वाहैर्मानितो मधुसूदनः
verses.wordMeaning: Similarly, the terrible sons of Danu were Tara and others. Out of them Tara, Sambara, Kapila, Sankara (?) (a better v.l. Sancara), Svarbhanu, and Vrsaparvan have been glorified as the prominent ones.
verses.commentary: Sense: Similarly, the terrible sons of Danu were Tara and others. Out of them Tara, Sambara, Kapila, Sankara (?) (a better v.l. Sancara), Svarbhanu, and Vrsaparvan have been glorified as the prominent ones.

verses.sanskrit: विशेषाढ् ब्राह्मणान् सर्वान् पूजयामसचेश्वरम् । यज्ञेन यज्ञहन्तारमश्वमेधेन शङ्करम्
verses.transliteration: viśeṣāḍh brāhmaṇān sarvān pūjayāmasaceśvaram / yajñena yajñahantāramaśvamedhena śaṅkaram
verses.translation: Similarly, the terrible sons of Danu were Tara and others. Out of them Tara, Sambara, Kapila, Sankara (?) (a better v.l. Sancara), Svarbhanu, and Vrsaparvan have been glorified as the prominent ones.
verses.hindi: गते मुररिपौ नैव कामिन्यो मुनिपुङ्गवाः । निशेव चन्द्ररहिता विना तेन चकाशिरे पताकाभिर्विशालाभिर्ध्वजै रत्नपरिष्कृतेः । लाजादिभिः पुरीं रम्यां भूषयाञ्चक्रिरे तदा
verses.wordMeaning: Similarly, the terrible sons of Danu were Tara and others. Out of them Tara, Sambara, Kapila, Sankara (?) (a better v.l. Sancara), Svarbhanu, and Vrsaparvan have been glorified as the prominent ones.
verses.commentary: Sense: Similarly, the terrible sons of Danu were Tara and others. Out of them Tara, Sambara, Kapila, Sankara (?) (a better v.l. Sancara), Svarbhanu, and Vrsaparvan have been glorified as the prominent ones.

verses.sanskrit: रामस्य तनयो जज्ञे कुश इत्यभिविश्रुतः । लवश्च सुमहाभागः सर्वतत्त्वार्थवित् सुधीः
verses.transliteration: rāmasya tanayo jajñe kuśa ityabhiviśrutaḥ / lavaśca sumahābhāgaḥ sarvatattvārthavit sudhīḥ
verses.translation: Similarly, the terrible sons of Danu were Tara and others. Out of them Tara, Sambara, Kapila, Sankara (?) (a better v.l. Sancara), Svarbhanu, and Vrsaparvan have been glorified as the prominent ones.
verses.hindi: मुमुचुः पुष्पवर्षाणि वसुदेवसुतोपरि वरासने महायोगी भाति देवीभिरन्वितः
verses.wordMeaning: Similarly, the terrible sons of Danu were Tara and others. Out of them Tara, Sambara, Kapila, Sankara (?) (a better v.l. Sancara), Svarbhanu, and Vrsaparvan have been glorified as the prominent ones.
verses.commentary: Sense: Similarly, the terrible sons of Danu were Tara and others. Out of them Tara, Sambara, Kapila, Sankara (?) (a better v.l. Sancara), Svarbhanu, and Vrsaparvan have been glorified as the prominent ones.

verses.sanskrit: अतिथिस्तु कुशाज्जज्ञे निषधस्तत्सुतो ऽभवत् । नलस्तु निषधस्याभून्नभस्तमादजायत
verses.transliteration: atithistu kuśājjajñe niṣadhastatsuto 'bhavat / nalastu niṣadhasyābhūnnabhastamādajāyata
verses.translation: Similarly, the terrible sons of Danu were Tara and others. Out of them Tara, Sambara, Kapila, Sankara (?) (a better v.l. Sancara), Svarbhanu, and Vrsaparvan have been glorified as the prominent ones.
verses.hindi: भ्राजते मालया देवो यथा देव्या समन्वित: आजम्मुर्दवगन्धर्वा द्रष्टुं लोकादिमव्ययम्। महर्षयः पूर्वजाता मार्कण्डेयादयो द्विजाः
verses.wordMeaning: Similarly, the terrible sons of Danu were Tara and others. Out of them Tara, Sambara, Kapila, Sankara (?) (a better v.l. Sancara), Svarbhanu, and Vrsaparvan have been glorified as the prominent ones.
verses.commentary: Sense: Similarly, the terrible sons of Danu were Tara and others. Out of them Tara, Sambara, Kapila, Sankara (?) (a better v.l. Sancara), Svarbhanu, and Vrsaparvan have been glorified as the prominent ones.

verses.sanskrit: नभसः पुण्डरीकाख्यः क्षेमधन्वा च तत्सुतः । तस्य पुत्रो ऽभवद् वीरो देवानीकः प्रतापवान्
verses.transliteration: nabhasaḥ puṇḍarīkākhyaḥ kṣemadhanvā ca tatsutaḥ / tasya putro 'bhavad vīro devānīkaḥ pratāpavān
verses.translation: Similarly, the terrible sons of Danu were Tara and others. Out of them Tara, Sambara, Kapila, Sankara (?) (a better v.l. Sancara), Svarbhanu, and Vrsaparvan have been glorified as the prominent ones.
verses.hindi: ततः स भगवान् कृष्णो मार्कण्डेयं समागतम्। ननामोत्थाय शिरसा स्वासनं च ददौ हरिः गरुडने कल्याणकारी शंकरको भूमिपर दण्डवत् प्रणाम किया और द्वारकापुरीका समाचार हरिसे निवेदन किया। तदनन्तर नीललोहित शंकरको विनयपूर्वक प्रणामकर और उन हरकी आज्ञा प्राप्तकर स्त्रीसमूहोंद्वारा
verses.wordMeaning: Similarly, the terrible sons of Danu were Tara and others. Out of them Tara, Sambara, Kapila, Sankara (?) (a better v.l. Sancara), Svarbhanu, and Vrsaparvan have been glorified as the prominent ones.
verses.commentary: Sense: Similarly, the terrible sons of Danu were Tara and others. Out of them Tara, Sambara, Kapila, Sankara (?) (a better v.l. Sancara), Svarbhanu, and Vrsaparvan have been glorified as the prominent ones.

verses.sanskrit: अहीनगुस्तस्य सुतो सहस्वांस्तत्सुतो ऽभवत् । तस्माच्चन्द्रावलोकस्तु तारापीडस्तु तत्सुतः
verses.transliteration: ahīnagustasya suto sahasvāṃstatsuto 'bhavat / tasmāccandrāvalokastu tārāpīḍastu tatsutaḥ
verses.translation: Similarly, the terrible sons of Danu were Tara and others. Out of them Tara, Sambara, Kapila, Sankara (?) (a better v.l. Sancara), Svarbhanu, and Vrsaparvan have been glorified as the prominent ones.
verses.hindi: पूजित और अमृतके समान मधुर स्वादुयुक्त वचनोंसे आरूढ़ होकर अपनी पुरीको चले। शंख, चक्र तथा गदाधारी शत्रुहन्ता महायोगीको जाते हुए देखकर गन्धर्व तथा श्रेष्ठ अप्सराओंने उनका अनुगमन किया। विश्वात्मा गोविन्द हरि उन सभी अङ्गनाओंको विदाकर शीघ्र ही
verses.wordMeaning: Similarly, the terrible sons of Danu were Tara and others. Out of them Tara, Sambara, Kapila, Sankara (?) (a better v.l. Sancara), Svarbhanu, and Vrsaparvan have been glorified as the prominent ones.
verses.commentary: Sense: Similarly, the terrible sons of Danu were Tara and others. Out of them Tara, Sambara, Kapila, Sankara (?) (a better v.l. Sancara), Svarbhanu, and Vrsaparvan have been glorified as the prominent ones.

verses.sanskrit: तारापीडाच्चन्द्रगिरिर्भानुवित्तस्ततो ऽभवत् । श्रुतायुरभवत् तस्मादेते इक्ष्वाकुवंशजाः । सर्वे प्राधान्यतः प्रोक्ताः समासेन द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: tārāpīḍāccandragirirbhānuvittastato 'bhavat / śrutāyurabhavat tasmādete ikṣvākuvaṃśajāḥ / sarve prādhānyataḥ proktāḥ samāsena dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: Similarly, the terrible sons of Danu were Tara and others. Out of them Tara, Sambara, Kapila, Sankara (?) (a better v.l. Sancara), Svarbhanu, and Vrsaparvan have been glorified as the prominent ones.
verses.hindi: उस दिव्य पुरी द्वारवतीको गये मुनिश्रेष्ठो ! उन मुरारिके चले जानेपर वे कामिनियाँ चन्द्रमारहित रात्रिके समान शोभाहीन हो गयीं । पुरवासियोंने श्रीकृष्णके आगमनके शुभ समाचारको सुनकर शीघ्र दिव्य एवं मङ्गलमयी द्वारवती पुरीको सुसज्जित किया।
verses.wordMeaning: Similarly, the terrible sons of Danu were Tara and others. Out of them Tara, Sambara, Kapila, Sankara (?) (a better v.l. Sancara), Svarbhanu, and Vrsaparvan have been glorified as the prominent ones.
verses.commentary: Sense: Similarly, the terrible sons of Danu were Tara and others. Out of them Tara, Sambara, Kapila, Sankara (?) (a better v.l. Sancara), Svarbhanu, and Vrsaparvan have been glorified as the prominent ones.

verses.sanskrit: य इमं शृणुयान्नित्यमिक्ष्वाकोर्वंशमुत्तमम् । सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो स्वर्गलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: ya imaṃ śṛṇuyānnityamikṣvākorvaṃśamuttamam / sarvapāpavinirmukto svargaloke mahīyate
verses.translation: Similarly, the terrible sons of Danu were Tara and others. Out of them Tara, Sambara, Kapila, Sankara (?) (a better v.l. Sancara), Svarbhanu, and Vrsaparvan have been glorified as the prominent ones.
verses.hindi: श्रीकुष्णके आमगनसे अति प्रसन्न द्वारकावासियोंने विशाल पताकाओं और रल्रोंसे जटित ध्वजों तथा लाजा आदि माङ्गलिक वस्तुओंसे सुन्दर पुरीको सजा दिया। मधुर स्वरवाले विविध वाद्यों, हजारों शंखों तथा वीणाओंको वे लोग बजाने लगे। गोविन्दके शुभपुरी द्वारवतीमें प्रवेश करते ही युवती स्त्रियाँ मधुर स्वरमें गान करने लर्गी। उन ईशान (कृष्ण)-को देखकर वे नृत्य करने लगीं और महलोंके ऊपर स्थित स्त्रियाँ वसुदेवपुत्र श्रीकृष्णके
verses.wordMeaning: Similarly, the terrible sons of Danu were Tara and others. Out of them Tara, Sambara, Kapila, Sankara (?) (a better v.l. Sancara), Svarbhanu, and Vrsaparvan have been glorified as the prominent ones.
verses.commentary: Sense: Similarly, the terrible sons of Danu were Tara and others. Out of them Tara, Sambara, Kapila, Sankara (?) (a better v.l. Sancara), Svarbhanu, and Vrsaparvan have been glorified as the prominent ones.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे विशो ऽध्यायः रोमहर्षण उवाच ऐलः पुरूरवाश्चाथ राजा राज्यमपालयत् । तस्य पुत्रा बभूवुर्हि षडिन्द्रसमतेजसः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge viśo 'dhyāyaḥ romaharṣaṇa uvāca ailaḥ purūravāścātha rājā rājyamapālayat / tasya putrā babhūvurhi ṣaḍindrasamatejasaḥ
verses.translation: O Brahmanas, Surasa gave birth to a thousand serpents as well as to thousands of noble-souled, multi-headed, heaven-wanderers.
verses.hindi: भवनमें प्रवेशकर महायोगी कृष्ण आशीर्वादोंसे अभिनन्दित होते हुए अत्यन्त रमणीय शुक्लवर्णके मण्डपमें स्थित एक श्रेष्ठ आसनपर अपनी पत्नियोंके साथ सुशोभित हुए। वे चारों ओरसे शङ्ख आदि प्रमुख पुत्रों तथा हजारों स्त्रियोंसे घिरे हुए थे
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas, Surasa gave birth to a thousand serpents as well as to thousands of noble-souled, multi-headed, heaven-wanderers.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas, Surasa gave birth to a thousand serpents as well as to thousands of noble-souled, multi-headed, heaven-wanderers.

verses.sanskrit: आयुर्मायुरमावायुर्विश्वायुश्चैव वीर्यवान् । शतायुश्च श्रुतायुश्च दिव्याश्चैवोर्वशीसुताः
verses.transliteration: āyurmāyuramāvāyurviśvāyuścaiva vīryavān / śatāyuśca śrutāyuśca divyāścaivorvaśīsutāḥ
verses.translation: Arista gave birth to a thousand Gandharvas. Ananta and other great serpents are glorified as the sons of Kadru.
verses.hindi: वैजयन्ती मालासे विभूषित उस रमणीय श्रेष्ठ आसनपर अच्युत श्रीकृष्ण जाम्बवतीके साथ उसी प्रकार सुशोभित हुए जैसे देवी उमाके साथ महादेव। ब्राह्मणो! उन अव्यय तथा लोकोंके आदि कारण ( श्रीकृष्ण)-का दर्शन करनेके लिये देवता, गन्धर्व और पूर्वज मार्कण्डेय आदि महर्षि वहाँ आये। तब उन भगवान् श्रीकृष्ण हरिने मार्कण्डेयजीको आया देखकर आसनसे उठकर विनयपूर्वक प्रणाम किया और उन्हें
verses.wordMeaning: Arista gave birth to a thousand Gandharvas. Ananta and other great serpents are glorified as the sons of Kadru.
verses.commentary: Sense: Arista gave birth to a thousand Gandharvas. Ananta and other great serpents are glorified as the sons of Kadru.

verses.sanskrit: आयुषस्तनया वीराः पञ्चैवासन् महौजसः । स्वर्भानुतनयायां वै प्रभायामिति नः श्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: āyuṣastanayā vīrāḥ pañcaivāsan mahaujasaḥ / svarbhānutanayāyāṃ vai prabhāyāmiti naḥ śrutam
verses.translation: O leading Brahmanas, Tamra gave birth to six daughters Suki, Syeni, Bhasi, Sugriva, Granthika (v.l. Grdh- rika) and Suci.
verses.hindi: तदा मध्याह्ृसमये देवदेवः स्वयं हरिः। स्नात्वा शुक्लाम्बरो भानुमुपातिष्ठत् कृताञ्जलिः जजाप जाप्यं विधिवत् प्रेक्षमाणो दिवाकरम्। तर्पयामास देवेशो देवान् मुनिगणान् पितृन्
verses.wordMeaning: O leading Brahmanas, Tamra gave birth to six daughters Suki, Syeni, Bhasi, Sugriva, Granthika (v.l. Grdh- rika) and Suci.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading Brahmanas, Tamra gave birth to six daughters Suki, Syeni, Bhasi, Sugriva, Granthika (v.l. Grdh- rika) and Suci.

verses.sanskrit: नहुषः प्रथमस्तेषां धर्मज्ञो लोकविश्रुतः । नहुषस्य तु दायादाः षडिन्द्रोपमतेजसः
verses.transliteration: nahuṣaḥ prathamasteṣāṃ dharmajño lokaviśrutaḥ / nahuṣasya tu dāyādāḥ ṣaḍindropamatejasaḥ
verses.translation: Surabhi gave birth to the cows and buffaloes. Ira gave birth to trees, creepers, vines and grasses of all kinds.
verses.hindi: प्रविश्य देवभवनं मार्कण्डेयेन चैव हि। पूजयामास लिङ्गस्थं भूतेशं भूतिभूषणम् भोजयित्वा मुनिवरं ब्राह्मणानभिपूज्य च
verses.wordMeaning: Surabhi gave birth to the cows and buffaloes. Ira gave birth to trees, creepers, vines and grasses of all kinds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Surabhi gave birth to the cows and buffaloes. Ira gave birth to trees, creepers, vines and grasses of all kinds.

verses.sanskrit: उत्पन्नाः पितृकन्यायां विरजायां महाबलाः । यतिर्ययातिः संयातिरायातिः पञ्चको ऽश्वकः
verses.transliteration: utpannāḥ pitṛkanyāyāṃ virajāyāṃ mahābalāḥ / yatiryayātiḥ saṃyātirāyātiḥ pañcako 'śvakaḥ
verses.translation: Similarly, Muni gave birth to Yaksas, Raksasas, and Apsaras. O excellent saints, it was out of anger that she gave birth to the groups of Raksasas.
verses.hindi: कथाः पौराणिकीः पुण्याश्चक्रे पुत्रादिभिर्वृत: अथैतत् सर्वमखिलं दृष्टा कर्म महामुनिः । मार्कण्डेयो हसन् कृष्णं बभाषे मधुरं वचः
verses.wordMeaning: Similarly, Muni gave birth to Yaksas, Raksasas, and Apsaras. O excellent saints, it was out of anger that she gave birth to the groups of Raksasas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Similarly, Muni gave birth to Yaksas, Raksasas, and Apsaras. O excellent saints, it was out of anger that she gave birth to the groups of Raksasas.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां ययातिः पञ्चानां महाबलपराक्रमः । देवयानीमुखनसः सुतां भार्यामवाप सः । शर्मिष्ठामासुरीं चैव तनयां वृषपर्वणः
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ yayātiḥ pañcānāṃ mahābalaparākramaḥ / devayānīmukhanasaḥ sutāṃ bhāryāmavāpa saḥ / śarmiṣṭhāmāsurīṃ caiva tanayāṃ vṛṣaparvaṇaḥ
verses.translation: The two famous sons of Vinata were Garuda and Aruna. Out of them, intelligent Garuda performed a very difficult penance. Thanks to the favour of the Trident-bearing deity, he attained the status of the vehicle of Hari.
verses.hindi: कः समाराध्यते देवो भवता कर्मभिः शुभेः। ब्रूहि त्वं कर्मभिः पूज्यो योगिनां ध्येय एव च त्वं हि तत् परमं ब्रह्म निर्वाणममलं पदम्। भारावतरणार्थाय जातो वृष्णिकुले प्रभुः
verses.wordMeaning: The two famous sons of Vinata were Garuda and Aruna. Out of them, intelligent Garuda performed a very difficult penance. Thanks to the favour of the Trident-bearing deity, he attained the status of the vehicle of Hari.
verses.commentary: Sense: The two famous sons of Vinata were Garuda and Aruna. Out of them, intelligent Garuda performed a very difficult penance. Thanks to the favour of the Trident-bearing deity, he attained the status of the vehicle of Hari.

verses.sanskrit: यदुं च तुर्वसुं चैव देवयानी व्यजायत । द्रुह्युं चानुं च पूरुं च शर्मिष्ठा चाप्यजीजनत्
verses.transliteration: yaduṃ ca turvasuṃ caiva devayānī vyajāyata / druhyuṃ cānuṃ ca pūruṃ ca śarmiṣṭhā cāpyajījanat
verses.translation: Aruna propitiated Lord Mahadeva by means of penance. He was engaged in the charioteer-hood of the Sun- god by Sambhu who was pleased with him.
verses.hindi: तमब्रवीन्महाबाहुः कृष्णो ब्रह्मविदां वर: । भृण्वतामेव पुत्राणां सर्वेषां प्रहसन्निव तथापि देवमीशानं पूजयामि सनातनम्
verses.wordMeaning: Aruna propitiated Lord Mahadeva by means of penance. He was engaged in the charioteer-hood of the Sun- god by Sambhu who was pleased with him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Aruna propitiated Lord Mahadeva by means of penance. He was engaged in the charioteer-hood of the Sun- god by Sambhu who was pleased with him.

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽभ्यषिञ्चदतिक्रम्य ज्येष्ठं यदुमनिन्दितम् । पुरुमेव कनीयासं पितुर्वचनपालकम्
verses.transliteration: so 'bhyaṣiñcadatikramya jyeṣṭhaṃ yadumaninditam / purumeva kanīyāsaṃ piturvacanapālakam
verses.translation: These mobile and immobile beings are the des¬ cendants of Kasyapa born in the Vaivasvata Manvantara which have been described to you. It destroys the sins of those who hear.
verses.hindi: न मे विप्रास्ति कर्तव्यं नानवाप्तं कथञ्चन । पूजयामि तथापीशं जानन्नेतत् परं शिवम् न वै पश्यन्ति तं देवं मायया मोहिता जनाः । ततोऽहं स्वात्मनो मूलं ज्ञापयन् पूजयामि तम्
verses.wordMeaning: These mobile and immobile beings are the des¬ cendants of Kasyapa born in the Vaivasvata Manvantara which have been described to you. It destroys the sins of those who hear.
verses.commentary: Sense: These mobile and immobile beings are the des¬ cendants of Kasyapa born in the Vaivasvata Manvantara which have been described to you. It destroys the sins of those who hear.

verses.sanskrit: दिशि दक्षिणपूर्वस्यां तुर्वसुं पुत्रमादिशत् । दक्षिणापरयो राजा यदुं ज्येष्ठं न्ययोजयत् । प्रतीच्यामुत्तारायां च द्रुह्युं चानुमकल्पयत्
verses.transliteration: diśi dakṣiṇapūrvasyāṃ turvasuṃ putramādiśat / dakṣiṇāparayo rājā yaduṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ nyayojayat / pratīcyāmuttārāyāṃ ca druhyuṃ cānumakalpayat
verses.translation: O man of holy vows, the twenty-seven daughters of Daksa are said to be the wives of the Moon. There were many (v.l. sixteen) children born to the wives of Aristanemi.
verses.hindi: न च लिङ्वार्चनात् पुण्यं लोकेऽस्मिन् भीतिनाशनम्। तथा लिङ्गे हितायैषां लोकानां पूजयेच्छिवम् ५८॥ लम्बी भुजाओंवाले हरिने प्रणामके द्वारा उन ऋषिगणोंकी पूजा करके और उनके मनोरथोंको प्रदान करके उन्हें विदा किया
verses.wordMeaning: O man of holy vows, the twenty-seven daughters of Daksa are said to be the wives of the Moon. There were many (v.l. sixteen) children born to the wives of Aristanemi.
verses.commentary: Sense: O man of holy vows, the twenty-seven daughters of Daksa are said to be the wives of the Moon. There were many (v.l. sixteen) children born to the wives of Aristanemi.

verses.sanskrit: तैरियं पृथिवी सर्वा धर्मतः परिपालिता । राजापि दारसहितो नवं प्राप महायशाः
verses.transliteration: tairiyaṃ pṛthivī sarvā dharmataḥ paripālitā / rājāpi dārasahito navaṃ prāpa mahāyaśāḥ
verses.translation: Svastyatreya is the seer of two sOktas of the RV—V. 50, 51. It is; reasonable to assume that he was the son of Atri and Svastyatreyas are his descendants.
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर मध्याहकालमें स्वयं देवाधिदेव हरिने स्नानकर शुक्ल वस्त्र धारण किये और हाथ जोड़कर सूर्यकी आराधना को। दिवाकर सूर्यको ओर देखते हुए उन्होंने विधिपूर्वक मन्त्रोंका जप किया। उन देवेश्वरने देवताओं, मुनिगणों और पितरोंका तर्पण किया
verses.wordMeaning: Svastyatreya is the seer of two sOktas of the RV—V. 50, 51. It is; reasonable to assume that he was the son of Atri and Svastyatreyas are his descendants.
verses.commentary: Sense: Svastyatreya is the seer of two sOktas of the RV—V. 50, 51. It is; reasonable to assume that he was the son of Atri and Svastyatreyas are his descendants.

verses.sanskrit: यदोरप्यभवन् पुत्राः पञ्च देवसुतोपमाः । सहस्त्रजित् तथाज्येष्ठः क्रोषटुर्नालो ऽजितोरघुः
verses.transliteration: yadorapyabhavan putrāḥ pañca devasutopamāḥ / sahastrajit tathājyeṣṭhaḥ kroṣaṭurnālo 'jitoraghuḥ
verses.translation: Suka is a celibate recluse in the Bh. P. The Devi Bhagavata (Skandha I) credits him with a wife, Pivari, daughter of Pitrs and four sons—Krsna, Gauraprabha, Bhuri, Devasruta and a daughter, Kirti who was given in marriage to Anu, the son of King Vibhraja. The information in KP. about the sons and daughters of Suka is different though both agree that Suka raised a family.
verses.hindi: (मुनि) मार्कण्डेयके साथ देवमन्दिरमें प्रवेशकर उन्होंने लिङ्गमें प्रतिष्ठित भस्मविभूषित भूतेश्वर ( श्रीशंकर) - की पूजा की। मनुष्योंके नियामक उन्होंने स्वयं सभी नियमोंको पूर्णकर ब्राह्मणोंकी पूजा की और मुनीश्वर (मार्कण्डेय)-को भोजन कराया। विप्रेन्द्रो! तदुपरान्त पुत्रों आदिसे घिरे हुए अच्युतने आत्मनिष्ठ होकर मार्कण्डेयजीसे पुराणोंको पुण्यदायिनी कथाको सुना। इन सारे कर्माको देखकर महामुनि मार्कण्डेयने श्रीकृष्णसे
verses.wordMeaning: Suka is a celibate recluse in the Bh. P. The Devi Bhagavata (Skandha I) credits him with a wife, Pivari, daughter of Pitrs and four sons—Krsna, Gauraprabha, Bhuri, Devasruta and a daughter, Kirti who was given in marriage to Anu, the son of King Vibhraja. The information in KP.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Suka is a celibate recluse in the Bh. P. The Devi Bhagavata (Skandha I) credits him with a wife, Pivari, daughter of Pitrs and four sons—Krsna, Gauraprabha, Bhuri, Devasruta and a daughter, Kirti who was given in marriage to Anu, the son of King Vibhraja. The information in KP.…

verses.sanskrit: सहस्त्रजित्सुतस्तद्वच्छतजिन्नाम पार्थिवः । सुताः शतजितो ऽप्यासंस्त्रयः परमधार्मिकाः
verses.transliteration: sahastrajitsutastadvacchatajinnāma pārthivaḥ / sutāḥ śatajito 'pyāsaṃstrayaḥ paramadhārmikāḥ
verses.translation: From Vatsara were born Naidhruva and Raibhya of very great fame. The sons born of Raibhya were Sudras (?) (v.l. Vaidyas) ♦ who were the most excellent among the learned ones (or knowers of Veda).
verses.hindi: हँसते हुए मधुर वचन कहा मार्कण्डेयजी बोले--(देव!) कर्मोद्वारा आपकी ही पूजा की जाती है और योगियोंके ध्येय भी आप ही हैं, फिर आप शुभ कर्मोके द्वारा किस देवताको आराधना कर रहे हैं, यह मुझे बतलायें। आप ही वे
verses.wordMeaning: From Vatsara were born Naidhruva and Raibhya of very great fame. The sons born of Raibhya were Sudras (?) (v.l. Vaidyas) ♦ who were the most excellent among the learned ones (or knowers of Veda).
verses.commentary: Sense: From Vatsara were born Naidhruva and Raibhya of very great fame. The sons born of Raibhya were Sudras (?) (v.l. Vaidyas) ♦ who were the most excellent among the learned ones (or knowers of Veda).

verses.sanskrit: हैहयश्च हयश्चैव राजा वेणुहयः परः । हैहयस्याभवत् पुत्रो धर्म इत्यभिविश्रुतः
verses.transliteration: haihayaśca hayaścaiva rājā veṇuhayaḥ paraḥ / haihayasyābhavat putro dharma ityabhiviśrutaḥ
verses.translation: The daughter of Gyavana named Sumedhawas the wife of the noble-souled Naidhruva. She gave birth to the sons called Kundapayins.
verses.hindi: परम ब्रह्म हैं, निर्वाणरूप हैं और निर्मल पद हैं। (पृथ्वीका) भार उतारनेके लिये आप प्रभु ही वृष्णि- कुलमें अवतरित हुए हैं। सभी पुत्रोंके सुनते हुए ही ब्रह्मज्ञानियोंमे श्रेष्ठ महाबाहु कृष्णने उनसे (मार्कण्डेयजीसे) हँसते हुए कहा- ॥ ५२--५४॥
verses.wordMeaning: The daughter of Gyavana named Sumedhawas the wife of the noble-souled Naidhruva. She gave birth to the sons called Kundapayins.
verses.commentary: Sense: The daughter of Gyavana named Sumedhawas the wife of the noble-souled Naidhruva. She gave birth to the sons called Kundapayins.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य पुत्रो ऽभवद् विप्रा धर्मनेत्रः प्रतापवान् । धर्मनेत्रस्य कीर्तिस्तु संजितस्तत्सुतो ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: tasya putro 'bhavad viprā dharmanetraḥ pratāpavān / dharmanetrasya kīrtistu saṃjitastatsuto 'bhavat
verses.translation: A son called Devala who was devoted to the Brahman (or expert in the Vedas) was born of Asita and Ekaparna. He was a preceptor of Yoga and performed great penance.
verses.hindi: श्रीभगवान्ने कहा-- आपने जो कुछ भी कहा, सब सत्य ही कहा है, इसमें संशय नहीं है तथापि मैं सनातनदेव ईशान (शंकर)-की पूजा करता हूँ। विप्र! मुझे न तो कुछ करना है और न मुझे कुछ अप्राप्त है, फिर भी यह जानते हुए भी मैं परम शिव ईशकी पूजा करता हूँ। मायासे मोहित लोग उन देव (शंकर)-का साक्षात्कार नहीं कर पाते। परंतु मैं अपने मूलका परिचय देते हुए उनकी पूजा करता हूँ। इस संसारमें लिङ्गार्चनसे अधिक कोई
verses.wordMeaning: A son called Devala who was devoted to the Brahman (or expert in the Vedas) was born of Asita and Ekaparna. He was a preceptor of Yoga and performed great penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: A son called Devala who was devoted to the Brahman (or expert in the Vedas) was born of Asita and Ekaparna. He was a preceptor of Yoga and performed great penance.

verses.sanskrit: महिष्मान् संजितस्याभूद् भद्रश्रेण्यस्तदन्वयः । भद्रश्रेण्यस्य दायादो दुर्दमो नाम पार्थिवः
verses.transliteration: mahiṣmān saṃjitasyābhūd bhadraśreṇyastadanvayaḥ / bhadraśreṇyasya dāyādo durdamo nāma pārthivaḥ
verses.translation: Sandilyawas extremely glorious, pure and a knower of the true principles. By the grace of the Lord of Parvati, he attained the Yogic liberation (v.l. attained excellent Yoga).
verses.hindi: पुण्य और भयका नाश करनेवाला (कर्म) नहीं है। अतः इन लोकों (प्राणिमात्र)-के कल्याणके लिये लिङ्गमें शिवकी पूजा करनी चाहिए  मेरे भी मूल (सर्वाधिष्ठान) महादेव शंकर ही हैं-यह सबको बतानेके लिये मैं लिङ्गस्वरूप भगवान् शंकरकी पूजा करता हूँ।
verses.wordMeaning: Sandilyawas extremely glorious, pure and a knower of the true principles. By the grace of the Lord of Parvati, he attained the Yogic liberation (v.l. attained excellent Yoga).
verses.commentary: Sense: Sandilyawas extremely glorious, pure and a knower of the true principles. By the grace of the Lord of Parvati, he attained the Yogic liberation (v.l. attained excellent Yoga).

verses.sanskrit: दुर्दमस्य सुतो धीमान् धनको नाम वीर्यवान् । धनकस्य तु दायादाश्चत्वारो लोकसम्मताः
verses.transliteration: durdamasya suto dhīmān dhanako nāma vīryavān / dhanakasya tu dāyādāścatvāro lokasammatāḥ
verses.translation: O Brahmanas, the three sons, viz. Sandilya, Naidhruva and Raibhya of the family of Kasyapa had human tempera¬ ment (or are the sources or patriarchs of human beings). I shall now mention the children of Pulastya.
verses.hindi: एष देवो महादेवः सदा संसारभीरुभिः। वेदा महेश्वरं देवमाहुर्लिङ्गिनमव्ययम्
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas, the three sons, viz. Sandilya, Naidhruva and Raibhya of the family of Kasyapa had human tempera¬ ment (or are the sources or patriarchs of human beings). I shall now mention the children of Pulastya.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas, the three sons, viz. Sandilya, Naidhruva and Raibhya of the family of Kasyapa had human tempera¬ ment (or are the sources or patriarchs of human beings). I shall now mention the children of Pulastya.

verses.sanskrit: कृतवीर्यः कृताग्निश्च कृतवर्मा तथैव च । कृतौजाश्च चतुर्थो ऽभूत् कार्तवीर्योर्ऽजुनो ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: kṛtavīryaḥ kṛtāgniśca kṛtavarmā tathaiva ca / kṛtaujāśca caturtho 'bhūt kārtavīryor'juno 'bhavat
verses.translation: O Brahmanas, the daughter of Trnabindu was named Ailavila. The royal sage gave that daughter in marriage to sage Pulastya.
verses.hindi: पुरा चैकार्णवे घोरे नष्टे स्थावरजङ्गमे। प्रबोधार्थ ब्रह्मणो मे प्रादुर्भूतः स्वयं शिव: तस्मात् कालात् समारभ्य ब्रह्मा चाहं सहैव हि। पूजयावो महादेवं लोकानां हितकाम्यया
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas, the daughter of Trnabindu was named Ailavila. The royal sage gave that daughter in marriage to sage Pulastya.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas, the daughter of Trnabindu was named Ailavila. The royal sage gave that daughter in marriage to sage Pulastya.

verses.sanskrit: सहस्त्रबाहुर्द्युतिमान् धनुर्वेदविदां वरः । तस्य रामो ऽभवन्मृत्युर्जामदग्न्यो जनार्दनः
verses.transliteration: sahastrabāhurdyutimān dhanurvedavidāṃ varaḥ / tasya rāmo 'bhavanmṛtyurjāmadagnyo janārdanaḥ
verses.translation: The son of Ailavila was the sage Visravas. He had four wives who made the family of Pulastya flourish.
verses.hindi: श्रीभगवानुवाच आसीदेकार्णवं घोरमविभागं तमोमयम्। मध्ये चैकार्णवे तस्मिन् शङ्खचक्रगदाधरः कोटिसूर्यप्रतीकाशं भ्राजमानं श्रियावृतम्
verses.wordMeaning: The son of Ailavila was the sage Visravas. He had four wives who made the family of Pulastya flourish.
verses.commentary: Sense: The son of Ailavila was the sage Visravas. He had four wives who made the family of Pulastya flourish.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य पुत्रशतान्यासन् पञ्च तत्र महारथाः । कृतास्त्रा बलिनः शूरा धर्मात्मानो नमस्विनः
verses.transliteration: tasya putraśatānyāsan pañca tatra mahārathāḥ / kṛtāstrā balinaḥ śūrā dharmātmāno namasvinaḥ
verses.translation: They were Puspotkata, Vaka, Kaikasi and Deva- varnini. Listen to the progeny of these who were richly en¬ dowed with comely features and beauty.
verses.hindi: चतुर्वक्त्रं महायोगिन् पुरुषं काञ्चनप्रभम्। कृष्णाजिनधरं देवमृग्यजुःसामभिः स्तुतम् वैदिक सिद्धान्तोंको जाननेवाले लोग इस लिङ्गको मेरा ही स्वरूप कहते हैं। इसीलिये मैं स्वयमेव आत्मस्वरूप ईशानका पूजन करता हूँ। मैं उन्हीं (शंकर)-की परम मूर्ति हुँ, मैं शिवस्वरूप ही हुँ, इसमें
verses.wordMeaning: They were Puspotkata, Vaka, Kaikasi and Deva- varnini. Listen to the progeny of these who were richly en¬ dowed with comely features and beauty.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were Puspotkata, Vaka, Kaikasi and Deva- varnini. Listen to the progeny of these who were richly en¬ dowed with comely features and beauty.

verses.sanskrit: शूरश्च शूरसेनश्च धृष्णः कृष्णस्तथैव च । जयध्वजश्च बलवान् नारायणपरो नृपः
verses.transliteration: śūraśca śūrasenaśca dhṛṣṇaḥ kṛṣṇastathaiva ca / jayadhvajaśca balavān nārāyaṇaparo nṛpaḥ
verses.translation: The children begot of Vaka were Mahodara, Pra- hasta, Mahaparsva, Khara and the daughter Kumbhinasi.
verses.hindi: कोई संदेह नहीं  वेदोंमें ऐसा ही निश्चय किया गया है कि हम दोनोंमें कोई भेद विद्यमान नहीं है। संसारसे भयभीत लोगोंको इन देव महादेवका सदा ध्यान, पूजन और वन्दन करना चाहिए तथा लिङ्गमें महेश्वरको सदा प्रतिष्ठित समझना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: The children begot of Vaka were Mahodara, Pra- hasta, Mahaparsva, Khara and the daughter Kumbhinasi.
verses.commentary: Sense: The children begot of Vaka were Mahodara, Pra- hasta, Mahaparsva, Khara and the daughter Kumbhinasi.

verses.sanskrit: शूरसेनादयः सर्वे चत्वारः प्रथितौजसः । रुद्रभक्ता महात्मानः पूजयन्ति स्म शङ्करम्
verses.transliteration: śūrasenādayaḥ sarve catvāraḥ prathitaujasaḥ / rudrabhaktā mahātmānaḥ pūjayanti sma śaṅkaram
verses.translation: Trisiras, Dusana and Vidyujjihva of great strength were also his sons. Thus there were these ten Raksasas of cruel actions in the family of Pulastya. All of them were endowed with the power of penance and physical strength. They were the devotees of Rudra and were extremely terrible.
verses.hindi: श्रीमार्कण्डेयजीने पूछा--विशाल नेत्रोंवाले देवश्रेष्ठ कृष्ण! आप इस गूढ़ एवं श्रेष्ठ विषयको बतलायें कि लिङ्ग क्या है और लिङ्गमें किसकी पूजा होती है ? श्रीभगवानूने कहा--ज्योतिःस्वरूप, अक्षर, अव्यक्त आनन्दको लिङ्ग” कहा गया है और वेद महेश्वरदेवको अव्यय तथा लिङ्ग धारण करनेवाला कहते हें । प्राचीन कालमें जब सर्वत्र जल-ही-जल एकार्णव हो गया और
verses.wordMeaning: Trisiras, Dusana and Vidyujjihva of great strength were also his sons. Thus there were these ten Raksasas of cruel actions in the family of Pulastya. All of them were endowed with the power of penance and physical strength.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Trisiras, Dusana and Vidyujjihva of great strength were also his sons. Thus there were these ten Raksasas of cruel actions in the family of Pulastya. All of them were endowed with the power of penance and physical strength.…

verses.sanskrit: जयध्वजस्तु मतिमान् देवं नारायणं हरिम् । जगाम शरणं विष्णुं दैवतं धर्मतत्परः
verses.transliteration: jayadhvajastu matimān devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ harim / jagāma śaraṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ daivataṃ dharmatatparaḥ
verses.translation: Pulaha's sons were the deer, serpent, fanged beasts, Bhutas (goblins), PiMcas, bears, boars and elephants.
verses.hindi: स्थावर-जङ्गम सब नष्ट हो गया, तब ब्रह्मा तथा मुझे प्रबोधित करनेके लिये उसी एकार्णवमें शिवका प्रादुर्भाव हुआ। उसी समयसे लोकोंके कल्याणको कामनासे ब्रह्मा तथा मैं दोनों ही सदा महादेवकी पूजा करते हें ॥६३--६५॥
verses.wordMeaning: Pulaha's sons were the deer, serpent, fanged beasts, Bhutas (goblins), PiMcas, bears, boars and elephants.
verses.commentary: Sense: Pulaha's sons were the deer, serpent, fanged beasts, Bhutas (goblins), PiMcas, bears, boars and elephants.

verses.sanskrit: तमूचुरितरे पुत्रा नायं धर्मस्तवानघ । ईश्वराराधनरतः पितास्माकमभूदिति
verses.transliteration: tamūcuritare putrā nāyaṃ dharmastavānagha / īśvarārādhanarataḥ pitāsmākamabhūditi
verses.translation: In the Vaivasvata Manvantara, Kratu was childless. Kasyapa who himself was a Prajapati, was the son of Marici.
verses.hindi: श्रीमार्कण्डेयजी बोले श्रीकृष्ण! अब आप यह बतलायें कि पूर्वकालमें आप लोगोंको ज्ञान देनेके लिये वह ईश्वरका परम पदरूप लिङ्ग किस प्रकार स्वयं प्रकट हुआ श्रीभगवानूने कहा-- (प्रलयकालमें) विभाग- रहित, तमोमय भयंकर एकमात्र समुद्र (एकार्णव) ही था। उस एकार्णवके मध्यभागमें शंख, चक्र, गदा धारण करनेवाला युक्तात्मा सनातन में
verses.wordMeaning: In the Vaivasvata Manvantara, Kratu was childless. Kasyapa who himself was a Prajapati, was the son of Marici.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the Vaivasvata Manvantara, Kratu was childless. Kasyapa who himself was a Prajapati, was the son of Marici.

verses.sanskrit: तानब्रवीन्महातेजा एष धर्मः परो मम । विष्णोरंशेन संभूता राजानो यन्महीतले
verses.transliteration: tānabravīnmahātejā eṣa dharmaḥ paro mama / viṣṇoraṃśena saṃbhūtā rājāno yanmahītale
verses.translation: Sukra the preceptor of the Daityas and a sage of great penance was born of Bhrgu. He was engaged in selfstudy of Vedas and the practice of Yoga. He was a devotee of Hara and was excessively brilliant.
verses.hindi: बाहुवाला होकर शयन कर रहा था। इसी बीच मैंने दूर स्थित अमित प्रभावाले, करोड़ों सूर्यके समान प्रकाशमान, शोभासम्पन्न, कृष्णमृगका चर्म धारण किये हुए, ऋक्, यजुः तथा सामवेदद्वारा  लिङ्गका अर्थ है कारण। यहाँ प्रसंगानुसार लिङ्गका अर्थ मूल कारण है  मूल कारण परमेश्वर ही हैं। वे ज्योतिःस्वरूप अक्षर एवं आनन्दस्वरूप हैं, इसीलिये यहाँ लिङ्गको ज्योतिःस्वरूप, आनन्दरूप कहा है।
verses.wordMeaning: Sukra the preceptor of the Daityas and a sage of great penance was born of Bhrgu. He was engaged in selfstudy of Vedas and the practice of Yoga. He was a devotee of Hara and was excessively brilliant.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sukra the preceptor of the Daityas and a sage of great penance was born of Bhrgu. He was engaged in selfstudy of Vedas and the practice of Yoga. He was a devotee of Hara and was excessively brilliant.

verses.sanskrit: राज्यं पालयतावश्यं भगवान् पुरुषोत्तमः । पूजनीयो यतो विष्णुः पालको जगतो हरिः
verses.transliteration: rājyaṃ pālayatāvaśyaṃ bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ / pūjanīyo yato viṣṇuḥ pālako jagato hariḥ
verses.translation: Atri's son was Vahni and his uterine-brother was Naidhruva. It is heard by us that sons were born of GhrtacI from Krsasva, the Brahmana sage.
verses.hindi: व्याजहार स्वयं ब्रह्मा स्मयमानो महाद्युतिः कस्त्वं कुतो वा किं चेह तिष्ठसे वद मे प्रभो । अहं कर्ता हि लोकानां स्वयम्भूः प्रपितामहः
verses.wordMeaning: Atri's son was Vahni and his uterine-brother was Naidhruva. It is heard by us that sons were born of GhrtacI from Krsasva, the Brahmana sage.
verses.commentary: Sense: Atri's son was Vahni and his uterine-brother was Naidhruva. It is heard by us that sons were born of GhrtacI from Krsasva, the Brahmana sage.

verses.sanskrit: सात्त्विकी राजसी चैव तामसी च स्वयंभुवः । तिस्त्रस्तु मूर्तयः प्रोक्ताः सृष्टिस्थित्यन्तहेतवः
verses.transliteration: sāttvikī rājasī caiva tāmasī ca svayaṃbhuvaḥ / tistrastu mūrtayaḥ proktāḥ sṛṣṭisthityantahetavaḥ
verses.translation: He begot of her Svastyatreyas' of great prowess. They were devoted to Vedas and Vedahgas and had destroyed thei r sins through penance.
verses.hindi: एवमुक्तस्तदा तेन ब्रह्मणाहमुवाच ह। अहं कर्तास्मि लोकानां संहर्ता च पुनः पुनः प्रबोधार्थं परं लिङ्गं प्रादुर्भूतं शिवात्मकम्
verses.wordMeaning: He begot of her Svastyatreyas' of great prowess. They were devoted to Vedas and Vedahgas and had destroyed thei r sins through penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: He begot of her Svastyatreyas' of great prowess. They were devoted to Vedas and Vedahgas and had destroyed thei r sins through penance.

verses.sanskrit: सत्त्वात्मा भगवान् विष्णुः संस्थापयति सर्वदा । सृजेद् ब्रह्मा रजोमूर्तिः संहरेत् तामसो हरः
verses.transliteration: sattvātmā bhagavān viṣṇuḥ saṃsthāpayati sarvadā / sṛjed brahmā rajomūrtiḥ saṃharet tāmaso haraḥ
verses.translation: Narada gave the gentle lady Arundhatl to Vasistha. As a result of the curse of Daksa, Narada led a celibate life.
verses.hindi: कालानलसमप्रख्यं ज्चालामालासमाकुलम्। क्षयवृद्धिविनिर्मुक्तमादिमध्यान्तवर्जितम् ततो मामाह भगवानधो गच्छ त्वमाशु वै। अन्तमस्य विजानीम ऊर्ध्व गच्छेऽहमित्यजः
verses.wordMeaning: Narada gave the gentle lady Arundhatl to Vasistha. As a result of the curse of Daksa, Narada led a celibate life.
verses.commentary: Sense: Narada gave the gentle lady Arundhatl to Vasistha. As a result of the curse of Daksa, Narada led a celibate life.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मान्महीपतीनां तु राज्यं पालयतामयम् । आराध्यो भगवान् विष्णुः केशवः केशिमर्दनः
verses.transliteration: tasmānmahīpatīnāṃ tu rājyaṃ pālayatāmayam / ārādhyo bhagavān viṣṇuḥ keśavaḥ keśimardanaḥ
verses.translation: When Haryasvas (the sons of Daksa) were lost due to the Maya (delusive advice) of Narada, Daksa with eyes red shot with anger cursed Narada.
verses.hindi: पितामहोऽप्यहं नान्तं ज्ञातवन्तौ समाः शतम् ततो विस्मयमापन्नौ भीतौ देवस्य शूलिनः । मायया मोहितौ तस्य ध्यायन्तौ विश्वमीश्वरम्
verses.wordMeaning: When Haryasvas (the sons of Daksa) were lost due to the Maya (delusive advice) of Narada, Daksa with eyes red shot with anger cursed Narada.
verses.commentary: Sense: When Haryasvas (the sons of Daksa) were lost due to the Maya (delusive advice) of Narada, Daksa with eyes red shot with anger cursed Narada.

verses.sanskrit: निशम्य तस्य वचनं भ्रातरो ऽन्ये मनस्विनः । प्रोचुः संहारकृद् रुद्रः पूजनीयो मुमुक्षुभिः
verses.transliteration: niśamya tasya vacanaṃ bhrātaro 'nye manasvinaḥ / procuḥ saṃhārakṛd rudraḥ pūjanīyo mumukṣubhiḥ
verses.translation: "O Brahmana, since all my sons were destroyed by you through deceitfulness, you will be devoid of issues."
verses.hindi: प्रोच्चरन्तौ महानादमोङ्कारं परमं पदम्। ब्रह्मविष्णू ऊचतुः
verses.wordMeaning: "O Brahmana, since all my sons were destroyed by you through deceitfulness, you will be devoid of issues."
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Brahmana, since all my sons were destroyed by you through deceitfulness, you will be devoid of issues."

verses.sanskrit: अयं हि भगवान् रुद्रः सर्वं जगदिदं शिवः । तमोगुणं समाश्रित्य कल्पान्ते संहरेत् प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: ayaṃ hi bhagavān rudraḥ sarvaṃ jagadidaṃ śivaḥ / tamoguṇaṃ samāśritya kalpānte saṃharet prabhuḥ
verses.translation: Vasistha begot of Arundhatl the son Sakti. From Sakti was born the glorious Parasara, the omniscient and the most excellent among the performers of penance.
verses.hindi: नमः शिवाय शान्ताय ब्रहाणे लिङ्गमूर्तये नमः शिवाय शान्ताय ब्रह्मणे लिङ्गमूर्तये
verses.wordMeaning: Vasistha begot of Arundhatl the son Sakti. From Sakti was born the glorious Parasara, the omniscient and the most excellent among the performers of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vasistha begot of Arundhatl the son Sakti. From Sakti was born the glorious Parasara, the omniscient and the most excellent among the performers of penance.

verses.sanskrit: या सा घोरतरा मूर्तिरस्य तेजामयी परा । संहरेद् विद्यया सर्वं संसारं शूलभृत् तया
verses.transliteration: yā sā ghoratarā mūrtirasya tejāmayī parā / saṃhared vidyayā sarvaṃ saṃsāraṃ śūlabhṛt tayā
verses.translation: After propitiating the Lord of the chief of Devas, Isana, the slayer of the Tripuras, he obtained the unrivalled son—the holy Lord Krsnadvaipayana.
verses.hindi: स्तुत हो रहे काञ्चनके समान आभावाले महायोगी चतुर्मुख देव पुरुषको देखा। क्षणभरमें ही वे योगज्ञानियोंमें श्रेष्ठ, महाद्युति ब्रह्मा मुसकराते हुए स्वयं मेरे पास आये और कहने लगे- प्रभो! मुझे बतलायें कि आप कौन हैं, कहाँसे आये हैं और किस कारणसे यहाँ स्थित हैं। मैं लोकोंका निर्माण करनेवाला स्वयम्भू प्रपितामह (ब्रह्मा) हूँ। उन ब्रह्माके द्वारा ऐसा कहे जानेपर मैंने उनसे (ब्रह्मासे)
verses.wordMeaning: After propitiating the Lord of the chief of Devas, Isana, the slayer of the Tripuras, he obtained the unrivalled son—the holy Lord Krsnadvaipayana.
verses.commentary: Sense: After propitiating the Lord of the chief of Devas, Isana, the slayer of the Tripuras, he obtained the unrivalled son—the holy Lord Krsnadvaipayana.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तानब्रवीद् राजा विचिन्त्यासौ जयध्वजः । सत्त्वेन मुच्यते जन्तुः सत्त्वात्मा भगवान् हरिः
verses.transliteration: tatastānabravīd rājā vicintyāsau jayadhvajaḥ / sattvena mucyate jantuḥ sattvātmā bhagavān hariḥ
verses.translation: §uka was born of Dvaipayana. It was Lord Sankara himself who incarnated on the Earth with a part of his personality and then attained his own great region. This Suka had five sons who were great ascetics. They were Bhurisravas, Prabhu, Sambhu, Krsna and Gaura, the fifth.
verses.hindi: कहा-में पुनः-पुनः लोकोंकी सृष्टि करनेवाला हूँ और मैं ही संहार करनेवाला हूँ । परमेष्ठीकी मायाके कारण इस प्रकारका विवाद बढ़नेपर (हम लोगोंको) यथार्थ स्थितिका ज्ञान करानेके लिये (उस समय) शिवरूप परम लिङ्ग प्रादुर्भूत हुआ। वह लिङ्ग प्रलय- कालीन अग्निके समान अनेक ज्चालामालाओंसे व्याप्त, क्षय एवं वृद्धिसे मुक्त और आदि, मध्य तथा अन्तसे
verses.wordMeaning: §uka was born of Dvaipayana. It was Lord Sankara himself who incarnated on the Earth with a part of his personality and then attained his own great region. This Suka had five sons who were great ascetics. They were Bhurisravas, Prabhu, Sambhu, Krsna and Gaura, the fifth.
verses.commentary: Sense: §uka was born of Dvaipayana. It was Lord Sankara himself who incarnated on the Earth with a part of his personality and then attained his own great region. This Suka had five sons who were great ascetics. They were Bhurisravas, Prabhu, Sambhu, Krsna and Gaura, the fifth.

verses.sanskrit: तमूचुर्भ्रातरो रुद्रः सेवितः सात्त्विकैर्जनैः । मोचयेत् सत्त्वसंयुक्तः पूजयेशं ततो हरम्
verses.transliteration: tamūcurbhrātaro rudraḥ sevitaḥ sāttvikairjanaiḥ / mocayet sattvasaṃyuktaḥ pūjayeśaṃ tato haram
verses.translation: He had daughters ako viz. Kirtimatl, Yogamata and Dhrtavrata. These persons of the family of Atri, the expounders of Brahman, have been narrated by Brahma. Henceforth (listen to) and understand the royal progeny (born) from Kasyapa.
verses.hindi: तब भगवान् शंकरने मुझसे कहा-तुम शीघ्र ही (इस लिङ्गके) नीचेकी ओर जाओ और इसके अन्तका पता लगाओ और ये अजन्मा ब्रह्मा (इसके) ऊपरकी ओर जायँ। तदनन्तर शीघ्र ही प्रतिज्ञा करके हम दोनों ऊपर तथा नीचेको ओर गये, किंतु पितामह तथा मैं सैकड़ों वर्षोमें भी उसका अन्त नहीं जान सके। तदनन्तर त्रिशूलधारी देवकी मायासे मोहित, भयभीत एवं आश्चर्यचकित हम दोनों उन विश्वरूप ईश्वरका ध्यान
verses.wordMeaning: He had daughters ako viz. Kirtimatl, Yogamata and Dhrtavrata. These persons of the family of Atri, the expounders of Brahman, have been narrated by Brahma. Henceforth (listen to) and understand the royal progeny (born) from Kasyapa.
verses.commentary: Sense: He had daughters ako viz. Kirtimatl, Yogamata and Dhrtavrata. These persons of the family of Atri, the expounders of Brahman, have been narrated by Brahma. Henceforth (listen to) and understand the royal progeny (born) from Kasyapa.

verses.sanskrit: अथाब्रवीद् राजपुत्रः प्रहसन् वै जयध्वजः । स्वधर्मो मुक्तये पन्था नान्यो मुनिभिरष्यते
verses.transliteration: athābravīd rājaputraḥ prahasan vai jayadhvajaḥ / svadharmo muktaye panthā nānyo munibhiraṣyate
verses.translation: These verses emphasize the identity of the sun-god, Siva, Brahma as they are the forms of one Reality [ekath sat), the Para-brahman.
verses.hindi: करने लगे और परमपद महानाद ओंकारका उच्चारण करते हुए नप्रतापूर्वक हाथ जोड़कर श्रेष्ठ शम्भुकी स्तुति करने लगे-- ॥ ७६--७९॥ ब्रह्मा तथा विष्णुने कहा--विविध अनादि विकारोंसे मुक्त संसाररूपी रोगके अनादि वैद्यस्वरूप शम्भु, शिव, शान्त, लिङ्गमूर्तिवाले ब्रह्मको नमस्कार है । प्रलयकालीन समुद्रमें स्थित रहनेवाले, सृष्टि और प्रलयके कारणरूप
verses.wordMeaning: These verses emphasize the identity of the sun-god, Siva, Brahma as they are the forms of one Reality [ekath sat), the Para-brahman.
verses.commentary: Sense: These verses emphasize the identity of the sun-god, Siva, Brahma as they are the forms of one Reality [ekath sat), the Para-brahman.

verses.sanskrit: तथा च वैष्णवी शक्तिर्नृपाणां देवता सदा । आराधनं परो धर्मो पुरारेरमितौजसः
verses.transliteration: tathā ca vaiṣṇavī śaktirnṛpāṇāṃ devatā sadā / ārādhanaṃ paro dharmo purāreramitaujasaḥ
verses.translation: Quoted in CG. Kdla nirnaya
verses.hindi: शिव, शान्त, लिङ्गमूर्तिधारी ब्रह्माको नमस्कार है। ज्वालामालाओंसे घिरे हुए शरीरवाले, प्रज्वलित स्तम्भरूप शिव, शान्त, लिङ्गमूर्तिवाले ब्रह्मको नमस्कार है। आदि, मध्य और अन्तसे रहित स्वभावतः निर्मल तेजोरूप शिव, शान्त तथा लिङ्गरूपी मूर्तिको धारण करनेवाले ब्रह्मको नमस्कार है॥ ८०--८३॥
verses.wordMeaning: Quoted in CG. Kdla nirnaya
verses.commentary: Sense: Quoted in CG. Kdla nirnaya

verses.sanskrit: तमब्रवीद् राजपुत्रः कृष्णो मतिमतां वरः । यदर्जुनो ऽस्मज्जनकः स्वधर्मं कृतवानिति
verses.transliteration: tamabravīd rājaputraḥ kṛṣṇo matimatāṃ varaḥ / yadarjuno 'smajjanakaḥ svadharmaṃ kṛtavāniti
verses.translation: All these were of un-paralleled glory. They sought refuge in the lotus-born deity. From Iksvaku was born the heroic king named Vikuksi.
verses.hindi: महादेवाय महते ज्योतिषेऽनन्ततेजसे। नमः शिवाय शान्ताय ब्रह्मणे लिङ्गमूर्तये प्रधानपुरुषेशाय व्योमरूपाय वेधसे। नमः शिवाय शान्ताय ब्रह्मणे लिङ्गमूर्तये
verses.wordMeaning: All these were of un-paralleled glory. They sought refuge in the lotus-born deity. From Iksvaku was born the heroic king named Vikuksi.
verses.commentary: Sense: All these were of un-paralleled glory. They sought refuge in the lotus-born deity. From Iksvaku was born the heroic king named Vikuksi.

verses.sanskrit: एवं विवादे वितते शूरसेनो ऽब्रवीद् वचः । प्रमाणमृषयो ह्यत्र ब्रूयुस्ते यत् तथैव तत्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ vivāde vitate śūraseno 'bravīd vacaḥ / pramāṇamṛṣayo hyatra brūyuste yat tathaiva tat
verses.translation: He was his eldest son. He had fifteen sons. The eldest of them was Kakutstha. Kakutstha's son was Suyodhana.
verses.hindi: निर्विकाराय सत्याय नित्यायामलतेजसे। नमः शिवाय शान्ताय ब्रह्मणे लिङ्गमूर्तये वेदान्तसाररूपाय कालरूपाय धीमते। नमः शिवाय शान्ताय ब्रह्मणे लिङ्गमूर्तये
verses.wordMeaning: He was his eldest son. He had fifteen sons. The eldest of them was Kakutstha. Kakutstha's son was Suyodhana.
verses.commentary: Sense: He was his eldest son. He had fifteen sons. The eldest of them was Kakutstha. Kakutstha's son was Suyodhana.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्ते राजशार्दूलाः पप्रच्छुर्ब्रह्मवादिनः । गत्वा सर्वे सुसंरब्धाः सप्तर्षोणां तदाश्रमम्
verses.transliteration: tataste rājaśārdūlāḥ papracchurbrahmavādinaḥ / gatvā sarve susaṃrabdhāḥ saptarṣoṇāṃ tadāśramam
verses.translation: The glorious Prthu was born of Suyodhana. Visvaka was Prthu's son. From Visvaka was born the intelligent Ardraka, Yuvanasva was his son.
verses.hindi: भाति देवो महायोगी सूर्यकोटिसमप्रभः वक्त्रकोटिसहस्त्रेण ग्रसमान इवाम्बरम्। सहस्त्रहस्तचरणः सूर्यसोमाग्रिलोचन:
verses.wordMeaning: The glorious Prthu was born of Suyodhana. Visvaka was Prthu's son. From Visvaka was born the intelligent Ardraka, Yuvanasva was his son.
verses.commentary: Sense: The glorious Prthu was born of Suyodhana. Visvaka was Prthu's son. From Visvaka was born the intelligent Ardraka, Yuvanasva was his son.

verses.sanskrit: तानब्रुवंस्ते मुनयो वसिष्ठाद्या यथार्थतः । या यस्याभिमता पुंसः सा हि तस्यैव देवता
verses.transliteration: tānabruvaṃste munayo vasiṣṭhādyā yathārthataḥ / yā yasyābhimatā puṃsaḥ sā hi tasyaiva devatā
verses.translation: "After propitiating the primordial person Narayana, free from ailments, the Lord without beginning or destruction, one shall obtain a righteous son.
verses.hindi: पिनाकपाणिर्भगवान् कृत्तिवासास्त्रिशूलभूत्। व्यालयज्ञोपवीतश्च मेघदुन्दुभिनिःस्वनः अथोवाच महादेवः प्रीतोऽहं सुरसत्तमौ। पश्येतं मां महादेवं भयं सर्व प्रमुच्यताम्
verses.wordMeaning: "After propitiating the primordial person Narayana, free from ailments, the Lord without beginning or destruction, one shall obtain a righteous son.
verses.commentary: Sense: "After propitiating the primordial person Narayana, free from ailments, the Lord without beginning or destruction, one shall obtain a righteous son.

verses.sanskrit: किन्तु कार्यविशेषेण पूजिताश्चेष्टदा नृणाम् । विशेषात् सर्वदा नायं नियमो ह्यन्यथा नृपाः
verses.transliteration: kintu kāryaviśeṣeṇa pūjitāśceṣṭadā nṛṇām / viśeṣāt sarvadā nāyaṃ niyamo hyanyathā nṛpāḥ
verses.translation: By propitiating the ruler of the Universe, the pri¬ mordial Kr?na whose son is Brahma himself and whose grandson is Nilalohita (i.e. Siva), one begets a good son.
verses.hindi: अयं मे दक्षिणे पार्श्वे ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः । वामपार्श्वे च मे विष्णुः पालको हृदये हरः एवमुक्त्वाथ मां देवो महादेवः स्वयं शिवः। आलिङ्गघ देवं ब्रह्माणं प्रसादाभिमुखोऽभवत्
verses.wordMeaning: By propitiating the ruler of the Universe, the pri¬ mordial Kr?na whose son is Brahma himself and whose grandson is Nilalohita (i.e. Siva), one begets a good son.
verses.commentary: Sense: By propitiating the ruler of the Universe, the pri¬ mordial Kr?na whose son is Brahma himself and whose grandson is Nilalohita (i.e. Siva), one begets a good son.

verses.sanskrit: नृपाणां दैवतं विष्णुस्तथैव च पुरन्दरः । विप्राणामग्निरादित्यो ब्रह्मा चैव पिनाकधृक्
verses.transliteration: nṛpāṇāṃ daivataṃ viṣṇustathaiva ca purandaraḥ / viprāṇāmagnirādityo brahmā caiva pinākadhṛk
verses.translation: By propitiating Hrsikesa, whose power and influence even Lord Brahma does not comprehend factually, one shall have a righteous son."
verses.hindi: ऊचतुः प्रेक्ष्य तद्वक्त्रं नारायणपितामहौ भक्तिर्भवतु नौ नित्यं त्वयि देव महेश्वरे
verses.wordMeaning: By propitiating Hrsikesa, whose power and influence even Lord Brahma does not comprehend factually, one shall have a righteous son."
verses.commentary: Sense: By propitiating Hrsikesa, whose power and influence even Lord Brahma does not comprehend factually, one shall have a righteous son."

verses.sanskrit: देवानां दैवतं विष्णुर्दानवानां त्रिशूलभृत् । गन्धर्वाणां तथा सोमो यक्षाणामपि कथ्यते
verses.transliteration: devānāṃ daivataṃ viṣṇurdānavānāṃ triśūlabhṛt / gandharvāṇāṃ tathā somo yakṣāṇāmapi kathyate
verses.translation: From him was born Brhadasva and from him was born Kuvalayasva. He became known as Dhundhumara by killing the great Asura Dhundhu.
verses.hindi: ततः स भगवानीशः प्रहसन् परमेश्वर: । उवाच मां महादेवः प्रीतः प्रीतेन चेतसा प्रलयस्थितिसर्गाणां कर्ता त्वं धरणीपते। वत्स वत्स हरे विश्वं पालयैतच्चराचरम्
verses.wordMeaning: From him was born Brhadasva and from him was born Kuvalayasva. He became known as Dhundhumara by killing the great Asura Dhundhu.
verses.commentary: Sense: From him was born Brhadasva and from him was born Kuvalayasva. He became known as Dhundhumara by killing the great Asura Dhundhu.

verses.sanskrit: विद्याधराणां वाग्देवी साध्यानां भगवान्रविः । रक्षसां शङ्करो रुद्रः किंनराणां च पार्वती
verses.transliteration: vidyādharāṇāṃ vāgdevī sādhyānāṃ bhagavānraviḥ / rakṣasāṃ śaṅkaro rudraḥ kiṃnarāṇāṃ ca pārvatī
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas, it is said that Dhundhu¬ mara had three sons. They were Drdhasva, Dandasva and Kapilasva.
verses.hindi: त्रिधा भिन्नोऽस्म्यहं विष्णो ब्रह्मविष्णुहराख्यया । सर्गरक्षालयगुणैरनिर्गुणोऽपि निरञ्जनः महादेव, महान्, ज्योतिःस्वरूप, अनन्त तेजस्वी लिङ्गविग्रह शिव, शान्त, ब्रह्मको नमस्कार है। प्रधान पुरुषके भी ईश, व्योमस्वरूप, वेधा (ब्रह्म) और लिङ्गविग्रह शिव, शान्त ब्रह्मको नमस्कार है । निर्विकार,
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahmanas, it is said that Dhundhu¬ mara had three sons. They were Drdhasva, Dandasva and Kapilasva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmanas, it is said that Dhundhu¬ mara had three sons. They were Drdhasva, Dandasva and Kapilasva.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषीणां दैवतं ब्रह्मा महादेवश्च शूलभृत् । मनूनां स्यादुमा देवी तथा विष्णुः सभास्करः
verses.transliteration: ṛṣīṇāṃ daivataṃ brahmā mahādevaśca śūlabhṛt / manūnāṃ syādumā devī tathā viṣṇuḥ sabhāskaraḥ
verses.translation: Pramoda was the son of Drdhasva, his son was Haryasva, Nikumbha was the son of Haryasva and from Nikumbha was born Sarhhatasva.
verses.hindi: सत्य, नित्य विमल तेजरूप लिङ्गविग्रह शान्त, शिव ब्रह्मको नमस्कार है। वेदान्तसार-स्वरूप, कालरूप, धीमान् लिङ्गमूर्ति शिव, शान्त ब्रह्मको नमस्कार इस प्रकार स्तुति करते रहनेपर महायोगी महेश्वर देव प्रकट हो गये और हजारों करोड़ मुखसे आकाशको मानो ग्रास बनाते हुए करोड़ों सूर्यके समान सुशोभित
verses.wordMeaning: Pramoda was the son of Drdhasva, his son was Haryasva, Nikumbha was the son of Haryasva and from Nikumbha was born Sarhhatasva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Pramoda was the son of Drdhasva, his son was Haryasva, Nikumbha was the son of Haryasva and from Nikumbha was born Sarhhatasva.

verses.sanskrit: गृहस्थानां च सर्वे स्युर्ब्रह्मा वै ब्रह्मचारिणाम् । वैखानसानामर्कः स्याद् यतीनां च महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: gṛhasthānāṃ ca sarve syurbrahmā vai brahmacāriṇām / vaikhānasānāmarkaḥ syād yatīnāṃ ca maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Krtasva and Ranasva were the sons of Sarhhitasva; Yuvanasva whose strength in battle was equal to that of Indra was the son of Ranasva.
verses.hindi: अग्निरूप (तीन) नयनवाले, पिनाकधनुषको हाथमें धारण करनेवाले, चर्माम्बरधारी, त्रिशूलधारी, सर्पका यज्ञोपवीत धारण करनेवाले और मेघ तथा दुन्दुभिके सदृश स्वरवाले भगवान् महादेवने कहा--श्रेष्ठ देवो! मैं प्रसन्न हूँ । मुझ महादेवकी ओर देखो और समस्त भयका परित्याग करो। पूर्वकालमें तुम दोनों सनातन (देव) मेरे शरीरसे उत्पन्न हुए थे। मेरे दक्षिण पार्श्वमें ये लोकपितामह ब्रह्मा, वाम पार्श्वमें पालनकर्ता विष्णु और हृदयमें हर
verses.wordMeaning: Krtasva and Ranasva were the sons of Sarhhitasva; Yuvanasva whose strength in battle was equal to that of Indra was the son of Ranasva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Krtasva and Ranasva were the sons of Sarhhitasva; Yuvanasva whose strength in battle was equal to that of Indra was the son of Ranasva.

verses.sanskrit: भूतानां भगवान् रुद्रः कूष्माण्डानां विनायकः । सर्वेषां भगवान् ब्रह्मा देवदेवः प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: bhūtānāṃ bhagavān rudraḥ kūṣmāṇḍānāṃ vināyakaḥ / sarveṣāṃ bhagavān brahmā devadevaḥ prajāpatiḥ
verses.translation: By performing the (sacrifice) of Varuna and
verses.hindi: स्थित हैं। मैं तुम दोनोंपर भलीभाँति प्रसन्न हूँ, इसलिये यथेष्ट वर प्रदान करुँगा। ऐसा कहकर महादेव शिव स्वयं मुझे तथा देव ब्रह्माका आलिङ्गन कर अनुग्रह प्रदान करनेके लिये उद्यत हुए तदनन्तर प्रसन्न मनवाले नारायण तथा पितामहने महेश्वरको प्रणामकर उनके मुखकी ओर देखते हुए कहा-देव! यदि प्रीति उत्पन्न हुई है और यदि आप हम दोनोंको वर देना चाहते हैँ तो (यह वर दें कि)
verses.wordMeaning: By performing the (sacrifice) of Varuna and
verses.commentary: Sense: By performing the (sacrifice) of Varuna and

verses.sanskrit: इत्येवं भगवान् ब्रह्मा स्वयं देवो ऽभ्यभाषत । तस्माज्जयध्वजो नूनं विष्ण्वाराधनमर्हति
verses.transliteration: ityevaṃ bhagavān brahmā svayaṃ devo 'bhyabhāṣata / tasmājjayadhvajo nūnaṃ viṣṇvārādhanamarhati
verses.translation: Harita was the son of Yuvanasva and Harita was his son. Purukutsa's successor was Trasadasyu of great fame.
verses.hindi: हम दोनोंको आप महेश्वरमें नित्य भक्ति बनी रहे। तब उन प्रसन्न हुए परम ईश्वर भगवान् ईश महादेवने प्रसन्न मनसे हँसते हुए मुझसे कहा- ॥ ९४--९६॥ देव बोले धरणीपते! वत्स हरि! तुम सृष्टि, पालन और प्रलयके कर्ता हो। इस चराचर विश्वका पालन करो। है विष्णो! मैं निर्गुण तथा निरञ्जन होते हुए भी सृष्टि, रक्षा तथा प्रलयके लिये अपेक्षित गुणोंके द्वारा
verses.wordMeaning: Harita was the son of Yuvanasva and Harita was his son. Purukutsa's successor was Trasadasyu of great fame.
verses.commentary: Sense: Harita was the son of Yuvanasva and Harita was his son. Purukutsa's successor was Trasadasyu of great fame.

verses.sanskrit: तान् प्रणम्याथ ते जग्मुः पुरीं परमशोभनाम् । पालयाञ्चक्रिरे पृथ्वीं जित्वा सर्वरिपून् रणे
verses.transliteration: tān praṇamyātha te jagmuḥ purīṃ paramaśobhanām / pālayāñcakrire pṛthvīṃ jitvā sarvaripūn raṇe
verses.translation: Sambhuti, bom of Narmada, is known as his son. His son was Visnuvrddha and his son was Anaranya. Brhadasva was the son of Anaranya and Haryasva was his son.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मा, विष्णु तथा हर नामसे तीन रूपोंमें विभक्त हूँ। विष्णो! मोहका परित्याग करो, इन पितामहका पालन करो। ये सनातन भगवान् आपके पुत्र होंगे एवमुक्त्वा महादेवो ब्रह्माणं मुनिसत्तम। अनुगृह्य च मां देवस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत
verses.wordMeaning: Sambhuti, bom of Narmada, is known as his son. His son was Visnuvrddha and his son was Anaranya. Brhadasva was the son of Anaranya and Haryasva was his son.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sambhuti, bom of Narmada, is known as his son. His son was Visnuvrddha and his son was Anaranya. Brhadasva was the son of Anaranya and Haryasva was his son.

verses.sanskrit: ततः कदाचिद् विप्रेन्द्रा विदेहो नाम दानवः । भीषणः सर्वसत्त्वानां पुरीं तेषां समाययौ
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kadācid viprendrā videho nāma dānavaḥ / bhīṣaṇaḥ sarvasattvānāṃ purīṃ teṣāṃ samāyayau
verses.translation: He was an extremely righteous king. By the grace of Kardama, the Prajapati, he begota virtuous son devoted to theSun.
verses.hindi: ततः प्रभृति लोकेषु लिङ्गार्चा सुप्रतिष्ठिता। लिङ्गं तल्लयनाद् ब्रह्मन् ब्रह्मणः परमं वपुः एतद बुध्यन्ति योगज्ञा न देवा न च दानवाः
verses.wordMeaning: He was an extremely righteous king. By the grace of Kardama, the Prajapati, he begota virtuous son devoted to theSun.
verses.commentary: Sense: He was an extremely righteous king. By the grace of Kardama, the Prajapati, he begota virtuous son devoted to theSun.

verses.sanskrit: दंष्ट्राकरालो दीप्तात्मा युगान्तदहनोपमः । शूलमादाय सूर्याभं नादयन् वै दिशो दश
verses.transliteration: daṃṣṭrākarālo dīptātmā yugāntadahanopamaḥ / śūlamādāya sūryābhaṃ nādayan vai diśo daśa
verses.translation: That son, king Vasumanas, worshipped the sun-god and obtained the blessed son Tridhanvan who was without an equal and who had suppressed his enemies.
verses.hindi: एतद्धि परमं ज्ञानमव्यक्तं शिवसञ्ज्ितम्। येन सूक्ष्ममचिन्त्यं तत् पश्यन्ति ज्ञानचक्षुषः तस्मै भगवते नित्यं नमस्कारं प्रकुर्महे । महादेवाय रुद्राय देवदेवाय लिड्डिने
verses.wordMeaning: That son, king Vasumanas, worshipped the sun-god and obtained the blessed son Tridhanvan who was without an equal and who had suppressed his enemies.
verses.commentary: Sense: That son, king Vasumanas, worshipped the sun-god and obtained the blessed son Tridhanvan who was without an equal and who had suppressed his enemies.

verses.sanskrit: तन्नादश्रवणान्मर्त्यास्तत्र ये निवसन्ति ते । तत्यजुर्जोवितं त्वन्ये दुद्रुवुर्भयविह्वलाः
verses.transliteration: tannādaśravaṇānmartyāstatra ye nivasanti te / tatyajurjovitaṃ tvanye dudruvurbhayavihvalāḥ
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas, after conquering his enemies, he performed a horse-sacrifice. The king practised self-study of the Vedas, was liberal-minded and desirous of crossing the ocean of worldly existence (v.l. forbearing) and devoted to piety.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मणे वामदेवाय त्रिनेत्राय महीयसे। शंकराय महेशाय गिरीशाय शिवाय च एवं स वासुदेवेन व्याहतो मुनिपुङ्गवः । जगाम मनसा देवमीशानं विश्वतोमुखम् १०९॥
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahmanas, after conquering his enemies, he performed a horse-sacrifice. The king practised self-study of the Vedas, was liberal-minded and desirous of crossing the ocean of worldly existence (v.l. forbearing) and devoted to piety.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmanas, after conquering his enemies, he performed a horse-sacrifice. The king practised self-study of the Vedas, was liberal-minded and desirous of crossing the ocean of worldly existence (v.l. forbearing) and devoted to piety.

verses.sanskrit: ततः सर्वे सुसंयत्ताः कार्तवीर्यात्मजास्तदा । युयुधुर्दानवं शक्तिगिरिकूटासिमुद्गरैः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sarve susaṃyattāḥ kārtavīryātmajāstadā / yuyudhurdānavaṃ śaktigirikūṭāsimudgaraiḥ
verses.translation: The sages, the chief of whom were Vasistha and Kasyapa, and devas headed by Indra came to the sacrificial hall of the noble-souled king.
verses.hindi: प्रणम्य शिरसा कृष्णमनुज्ञातो महामुनिः। जगाम चेप्सितं देशं देवदेवस्य शूलिनः शृणुयाद् वा पठेद् वापि सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते
verses.wordMeaning: The sages, the chief of whom were Vasistha and Kasyapa, and devas headed by Indra came to the sacrificial hall of the noble-souled king.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sages, the chief of whom were Vasistha and Kasyapa, and devas headed by Indra came to the sacrificial hall of the noble-souled king.

verses.sanskrit: तान् सर्वान् दानवो विप्राः शूलेन प्रहसन्निव । वारयामास घोरात्मा कल्पान्ते भैरवो यथा
verses.transliteration: tān sarvān dānavo viprāḥ śūlena prahasanniva / vārayāmāsa ghorātmā kalpānte bhairavo yathā
verses.translation: After duly concluding the Taj ha, the great king endowed with humility bowed down to Vasistha and other excellent Brahmanas and asked them:
verses.hindi: वासुदेवस्य विप्रेन्द्राः पापं मुञ्चति मानव: जपेद् वाहरहर्नित्यं ब्रह्मलोके महीयते। एवमाह महायोगी कृष्णद्वैपायनः प्रभु:
verses.wordMeaning: After duly concluding the Taj ha, the great king endowed with humility bowed down to Vasistha and other excellent Brahmanas and asked them:
verses.commentary: Sense: After duly concluding the Taj ha, the great king endowed with humility bowed down to Vasistha and other excellent Brahmanas and asked them:

verses.sanskrit: शूरसेनादयः पञ्च राजानस्तु महाबलाः । युद्धाय कृतसंरम्भा विदेहं त्वभिदुद्रुवुः
verses.transliteration: śūrasenādayaḥ pañca rājānastu mahābalāḥ / yuddhāya kṛtasaṃrambhā videhaṃ tvabhidudruvuḥ
verses.translation: O leading Brahmanas, which is more conducive to welfare in this world? Is it sacrifice, penance or renunciation Be pleased to tell me, O knowers of everything.
verses.hindi: कल्पके आदिमे मैं भी आपके मुखसे प्रकट होकर घोर रूप धारणकर हाथमें शूल धारण किये आपका क्रोधज पुत्र बनूँगा मुनिश्रेष्ठ! इस प्रकार कहकर भगवान् महादेव मुझपर तथा ब्रह्मापर कृपा करके वहींपर अन्तर्धान हो गये। ब्रह्मन्! तबसे लोकमें लिङ्गका पूजन प्रतिष्ठित हो गया। लीन होनेसे वह लिङ्ग कहा जाता है। लिङ्ग
verses.wordMeaning: O leading Brahmanas, which is more conducive to welfare in this world? Is it sacrifice, penance or renunciation Be pleased to tell me, O knowers of everything.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading Brahmanas, which is more conducive to welfare in this world? Is it sacrifice, penance or renunciation Be pleased to tell me, O knowers of everything.

verses.sanskrit: शूरो ऽस्त्रं प्राहिणोद् रौद्रं शूरसेनस्तु वारुणम् । प्राजापत्यं तथा कृष्णो वायव्यं धृष्ण एव च
verses.transliteration: śūro 'straṃ prāhiṇod raudraṃ śūrasenastu vāruṇam / prājāpatyaṃ tathā kṛṣṇo vāyavyaṃ dhṛṣṇa eva ca
verses.translation: After studying the Vedas duly, after begetting and
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मका श्रेष्ठ शरीर है अनघ! मैंने इस लिङ्गका माहात्म्य तुम्हें बताया। इसे न देवता जानते हैं न दानव, केवल योगज्ञ लोग ही जानते हैं। यह शिव नामवाला अव्यक्त परम ज्ञान है। ज्ञानदृष्टिवाले इसीके द्वारा उस सूक्ष्म अचिन्त्य
verses.wordMeaning: After studying the Vedas duly, after begetting and
verses.commentary: Sense: After studying the Vedas duly, after begetting and

verses.sanskrit: जयध्वजश्च कौबेरमैन्द्रमाग्नेयमेव च । भञ्जयामास शूलेन तान्यस्त्राणि स दानवः
verses.transliteration: jayadhvajaśca kauberamaindramāgneyameva ca / bhañjayāmāsa śūlena tānyastrāṇi sa dānavaḥ
verses.translation: Having at first performed sacrifices for excellent gods according to proper procedure (& formalities) and having propitiated the Supreme Lord, the Yogin, one should take to renunciation.2
verses.hindi: (तत्त्व)-का दर्शन करते हैं। इस लिङ्गस्वरूप देवाधि- देव महादेव भगवान् रुद्रको हम नित्य नमस्कार करते हैं वेदके रहस्यरूप आपको नमस्कार है, नीलकण्ठको नमस्कार है। विशेष भय उत्पन्न करनेवाले, शान्त, स्थाणु तथा कारणरूपको नमस्कार है। वामदेव, त्रिलोचन, महिमावान्, ब्रह्म, शंकर, महेश, गिरीश तथा शिवको
verses.wordMeaning: Having at first performed sacrifices for excellent gods according to proper procedure (& formalities) and having propitiated the Supreme Lord, the Yogin, one should take to renunciation.2
verses.commentary: Sense: Having at first performed sacrifices for excellent gods according to proper procedure (& formalities) and having propitiated the Supreme Lord, the Yogin, one should take to renunciation.2

verses.sanskrit: ततः कृष्णो महावीर्यो गदामादाय भीषणाम् । स्पृष्ट्वा मन्त्रेण तरसा चिक्षेप न ननाद च
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kṛṣṇo mahāvīryo gadāmādāya bhīṣaṇām / spṛṣṭvā mantreṇa tarasā cikṣepa na nanāda ca
verses.translation: By means of penance, one shall propitiate that thousand-rayed deity whom they call the sole ancient Person and the Supreme Lord, and shall obtain liberation.
verses.hindi: नमस्कार है। सदा इन्हें नमस्कार करो, मनसे शंकरका ध्यान करो। इससे शीघ्र ही संसारसागरसे पार हो जाओगे इस प्रकार वासुदेवके द्वारा कहे जानेपर उन मुनिश्रेष्ठ (मार्कण्डेय)-ने विश्वतोमुख देव ईशान (शंकर)-का ध्यान किया। श्रीकृष्णको विनयपूर्वक प्रणामकर उनकी आज्ञा प्राकर महामुनि (मार्कण्डेय) त्रिशूल धारण करनेवाले
