verses.wordMeaning: By means of penance, one shall propitiate that thousand-rayed deity whom they call the sole ancient Person and the Supreme Lord, and shall obtain liberation.
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of penance, one shall propitiate that thousand-rayed deity whom they call the sole ancient Person and the Supreme Lord, and shall obtain liberation.

verses.sanskrit: संप्राप्य सा गादास्योरो विदेहस्य शिलोपमम् । न दानवं चालयितुं शशाकान्तकसंनिभम्
verses.transliteration: saṃprāpya sā gādāsyoro videhasya śilopamam / na dānavaṃ cālayituṃ śaśākāntakasaṃnibham
verses.translation: The Lord who is unborn, the maker of the Universe, the eternal seed of the Universe, and the immanent soul of all living beings, is worshipped by means of penance.
verses.hindi: देवाधिदेवके अभीष्ट स्थानको चले गये जो इस श्रेष्ठ लिङ्गाध्यायको सुनेगा, सुनायेगा अथवा पढ़ेगा, वह सभी पापोंसे मुक्त हो जायगा। विप्रेन्द्रो! वासुदेवके इस श्रेष्ठ तपश्चरणको एक बार भी सुननेवाला मनुष्य पापसे मुक्त हो जाता है अथवा प्रतिदिन इसका
verses.wordMeaning: The Lord who is unborn, the maker of the Universe, the eternal seed of the Universe, and the immanent soul of all living beings, is worshipped by means of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Lord who is unborn, the maker of the Universe, the eternal seed of the Universe, and the immanent soul of all living beings, is worshipped by means of penance.

verses.sanskrit: दुद्रुवुस्ते भयग्रस्ता दृष्ट्वा तस्यातिपौरुषम् । जयध्वजस्तु मतिमान् सस्मार जगतः पतिम्
verses.transliteration: dudruvuste bhayagrastā dṛṣṭvā tasyātipauruṣam / jayadhvajastu matimān sasmāra jagataḥ patim
verses.translation: The Lord who is unborn, the maker of the Universe, the eternal seed of the Universe, and the immanent soul of all living beings, is worshipped by means of penance.
verses.hindi: निरन्तर जप करनेसे ब्रह्मलोकमें प्रतिष्ठित होता है--ऐसा महायोगी प्रभु कृष्णद्वैपायनने कहा है  प्राणीको पापसे विरत करनेके लिये अन्य उपाय न होनेपर भगवान् शंकर भय भी उत्पन्न करते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Lord who is unborn, the maker of the Universe, the eternal seed of the Universe, and the immanent soul of all living beings, is worshipped by means of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Lord who is unborn, the maker of the Universe, the eternal seed of the Universe, and the immanent soul of all living beings, is worshipped by means of penance.

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुं ग्रसिष्णुं लोकादिमप्रमेयमनामयम् । त्रातारं पुरुषं पूर्वं श्रीपतिं पीतवाससम्
verses.transliteration: viṣṇuṃ grasiṣṇuṃ lokādimaprameyamanāmayam / trātāraṃ puruṣaṃ pūrvaṃ śrīpatiṃ pītavāsasam
verses.translation: The Lord who is unborn, the maker of the Universe, the eternal seed of the Universe, and the immanent soul of all living beings, is worshipped by means of penance.
verses.hindi: श्रीकृष्णको महेश्वरकी कृपासे साम्ब नामक पुत्रकी प्राप्ति, कंसादिका वध, भृगु आदि महर्षियोंका द्वारकामें आना, भृगु आदि मुनियोंसे श्रीकृष्णद्वारा स्वधामगमनकी बात बताना, शिवसे द्वेष करनेवालोंको नरककी प्राप्तिका वर्णन तथा शिवकी महिमा बताना, नारायणका अपने कुलका संहारकर स्वधामगमन तथा वंश-वर्णनका उपसंहार
verses.wordMeaning: The Lord who is unborn, the maker of the Universe, the eternal seed of the Universe, and the immanent soul of all living beings, is worshipped by means of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Lord who is unborn, the maker of the Universe, the eternal seed of the Universe, and the immanent soul of all living beings, is worshipped by means of penance.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रादुरभूच्चक्रं सूर्यायुतसमप्रभम् । आदेशाद् वासुदेवस्य भक्तानुग्रहकारणात्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prādurabhūccakraṃ sūryāyutasamaprabham / ādeśād vāsudevasya bhaktānugrahakāraṇāt
verses.translation: The Lord who is unborn, the maker of the Universe, the eternal seed of the Universe, and the immanent soul of all living beings, is worshipped by means of penance.
verses.hindi: स्थापयित्वा जगत् कृत्स्नं लोके धर्माश्च शाश्चतान्। चक्रे नारायणो गन्तुं स्वस्थानं बुद्द्रिमुत्तमाम् आजम्मुद्वारकाँं द्रष्टुं कृतकार्यं सनातनम्
verses.wordMeaning: The Lord who is unborn, the maker of the Universe, the eternal seed of the Universe, and the immanent soul of all living beings, is worshipped by means of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Lord who is unborn, the maker of the Universe, the eternal seed of the Universe, and the immanent soul of all living beings, is worshipped by means of penance.

verses.sanskrit: जग्राह जगतां योनिं स्मृत्वा नारायणं नृपः । प्राहिणोद् वै विदेहाय दानवेभ्यो यथा हरिः
verses.transliteration: jagrāha jagatāṃ yoniṃ smṛtvā nārāyaṇaṃ nṛpaḥ / prāhiṇod vai videhāya dānavebhyo yathā hariḥ
verses.translation: The Lord who is unborn, the maker of the Universe, the eternal seed of the Universe, and the immanent soul of all living beings, is worshipped by means of penance.
verses.hindi: गमिष्ये तत् परं स्थानं स्वकीयं विष्णुसंज्ञितम्। कृतानि सर्वकार्याणि प्रसीदध्वं मुनीश्वराः ७ ॥ भविष्यन्ति जनाः सर्वे ह्यस्मिन् पापानुवर्तिनः
verses.wordMeaning: The Lord who is unborn, the maker of the Universe, the eternal seed of the Universe, and the immanent soul of all living beings, is worshipped by means of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Lord who is unborn, the maker of the Universe, the eternal seed of the Universe, and the immanent soul of all living beings, is worshipped by means of penance.

verses.sanskrit: संप्राप्य तस्य घोरस्य स्कन्धदेशं सुदर्शनम् । पृथिव्यां पातयामास शिरो ऽद्रिशिखराकृति
verses.transliteration: saṃprāpya tasya ghorasya skandhadeśaṃ sudarśanam / pṛthivyāṃ pātayāmāsa śiro 'driśikharākṛti
verses.translation: The Lord who is unborn, the maker of the Universe, the eternal seed of the Universe, and the immanent soul of all living beings, is worshipped by means of penance.
verses.hindi: प्रवर्तयध्वं मज्ज्ञानं ब्राह्मणानां हितावहम्। येनेमे कलिजैः पापैर्मुच्यन्ते हि द्विजोत्तमाः तेषां नश्यतु तत् पापं भक्तानां पुरुषोत्तमे
verses.wordMeaning: The Lord who is unborn, the maker of the Universe, the eternal seed of the Universe, and the immanent soul of all living beings, is worshipped by means of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Lord who is unborn, the maker of the Universe, the eternal seed of the Universe, and the immanent soul of all living beings, is worshipped by means of penance.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन् हते देवरिपौ शीराद्या भ्रातरो नृपाः । समाययुः पुरीं रम्यां भ्रातरं चाप्यपूजयन्
verses.transliteration: tasmin hate devaripau śīrādyā bhrātaro nṛpāḥ / samāyayuḥ purīṃ ramyāṃ bhrātaraṃ cāpyapūjayan
verses.translation: The Lord who is unborn, the maker of the Universe, the eternal seed of the Universe, and the immanent soul of all living beings, is worshipped by means of penance.
verses.hindi: ये ब्राह्मणा वंशजाता युष्माकं वै सहस्त्रशः । तेषां नारायणे भक्तिर्भविष्यति कलौ युगे परात् परतरं यान्ति नारायणपरायणाः। न ते तत्र गमिष्यन्ति ये द्विषन्ति महेश्वरम्
verses.wordMeaning: The Lord who is unborn, the maker of the Universe, the eternal seed of the Universe, and the immanent soul of all living beings, is worshipped by means of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Lord who is unborn, the maker of the Universe, the eternal seed of the Universe, and the immanent soul of all living beings, is worshipped by means of penance.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वाजगाम भगवान् जयध्वजपराक्रमम् । कार्तवीर्यसुतं द्रष्टुं विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः
verses.transliteration: śrutvājagāma bhagavān jayadhvajaparākramam / kārtavīryasutaṃ draṣṭuṃ viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ
verses.translation: The Lord who is unborn, the maker of the Universe, the eternal seed of the Universe, and the immanent soul of all living beings, is worshipped by means of penance.
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले--तदनन्तर महे धरसे वर प्राप्त किये हुए कृष्णने जाम्बवतीसे महात्मा साम्ब नामक श्रेष्ठ पुत्रको उत्पन्न किया । प्रद्युम्रको भी महाबलवान् अनिरुद्ध नामक पुत्र हुआ। गुणोंसे सम्पन्न वे दोनों कृष्णके ही असुरोंको मारकर लीलापूर्वक इन्द्रको जीतकर तथा महान् असुर बाणको पराजितकर, सम्पूर्ण संसारको प्रतिष्ठितकर और लोकमें शाश्वत धर्मोंको स्थापनाकर नारायणने अपने धाममें जानेका श्रेष्ठ विचार किया।
verses.wordMeaning: The Lord who is unborn, the maker of the Universe, the eternal seed of the Universe, and the immanent soul of all living beings, is worshipped by means of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Lord who is unborn, the maker of the Universe, the eternal seed of the Universe, and the immanent soul of all living beings, is worshipped by means of penance.

verses.sanskrit: तमागतमथो दृष्ट्वा राजा संभ्रान्तमानसः । समावेश्यासने रम्ये पूजयामास भावतः
verses.transliteration: tamāgatamatho dṛṣṭvā rājā saṃbhrāntamānasaḥ / samāveśyāsane ramye pūjayāmāsa bhāvataḥ
verses.translation: The Lord who is unborn, the maker of the Universe, the eternal seed of the Universe, and the immanent soul of all living beings, is worshipped by means of penance.
verses.hindi: ब्राह्मणो! इसी बीच भृगु आदि (महर्षि) अवतारके समस्त प्रयोजनोंसे निवृत्त सनातन ईश्वर कृष्णका दर्शन करनेके लिये द्वारकामें आये विश्वात्मा (कृष्ण)-ने बुद्धिमान् बलरामके साथ आसनोंपर विराजमान भृगु आदि महर्षियोंको प्रणामकर और पूजनकर उनसे कहा--मुनीश्वरो! सभी कार्य किये जा चुके हैं। अब मैं विष्णुसंज्ञक अपने उस परमधामको
verses.wordMeaning: The Lord who is unborn, the maker of the Universe, the eternal seed of the Universe, and the immanent soul of all living beings, is worshipped by means of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Lord who is unborn, the maker of the Universe, the eternal seed of the Universe, and the immanent soul of all living beings, is worshipped by means of penance.

verses.sanskrit: उवाच भगवान् घोरः प्रसादाद् भवतो ऽसुरः । निपातितो मया संख्ये विदेहो दानवेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: uvāca bhagavān ghoraḥ prasādād bhavato 'suraḥ / nipātito mayā saṃkhye videho dānaveśvaraḥ
verses.translation: The Lord who is unborn, the maker of the Universe, the eternal seed of the Universe, and the immanent soul of all living beings, is worshipped by means of penance.
verses.hindi: जाऊँगा, आप लोग प्रसन्न हों। इस समय अशुभ घोर कलियुग आ गया है। इसमें सभी लोग पापाचरण करनेवाले हो जायेंगे । श्रेष्ठ ब्राह्मणो ! आप लोग ब्राह्मणोंके लिये कल्याणकारी मेरा ज्ञान प्रवर्तित करें, जिससे ये लोग कलिद्वारा उत्पन्न पापोंसे मुक्त हो सकें ॥ ६--९॥
verses.wordMeaning: The Lord who is unborn, the maker of the Universe, the eternal seed of the Universe, and the immanent soul of all living beings, is worshipped by means of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Lord who is unborn, the maker of the Universe, the eternal seed of the Universe, and the immanent soul of all living beings, is worshipped by means of penance.

verses.sanskrit: त्वद्वाक्याच्छिन्नसंदेहो विष्णुं सत्यपराक्रमम् । प्रपन्नः शरणं तेन प्रसादो मे कृतः शुभः
verses.transliteration: tvadvākyācchinnasaṃdeho viṣṇuṃ satyaparākramam / prapannaḥ śaraṇaṃ tena prasādo me kṛtaḥ śubhaḥ
verses.translation: The Lord who is unborn, the maker of the Universe, the eternal seed of the Universe, and the immanent soul of all living beings, is worshipped by means of penance.
verses.hindi: कलियुगमें जो लोग एक बार भी मुझ प्रभुका स्मरण करेंगे, उन पुरुषोत्तमके भक्तोंका पाप नष्ट हो जायगा। द्विजो! जो कलियुगमें भक्तिपूर्वक वैदिक विधि-विधानसे नित्य मेरा पूजन करेंगे, वे मेरे पदको आप लोगोंके वंशमें जो हजारों ब्राह्मण उत्पन्न होंगे, उनकी कलियुगमें नारायणमें भक्ति होगी। नारायणके भक्तजन परसे परतर स्थानको प्राप्त करते हैं, किंतु जो महेश्वरसे द्वेष रखते हैं, वे वहाँ नहीं जाते
verses.wordMeaning: The Lord who is unborn, the maker of the Universe, the eternal seed of the Universe, and the immanent soul of all living beings, is worshipped by means of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Lord who is unborn, the maker of the Universe, the eternal seed of the Universe, and the immanent soul of all living beings, is worshipped by means of penance.

verses.sanskrit: यक्ष्यामि परमेशानं विष्णुं पद्मदलेक्षणम् । कथं केन विधानेन संपूज्यो हरिरीश्वरः
verses.transliteration: yakṣyāmi parameśānaṃ viṣṇuṃ padmadalekṣaṇam / kathaṃ kena vidhānena saṃpūjyo harirīśvaraḥ
verses.translation: The Lord who is unborn, the maker of the Universe, the eternal seed of the Universe, and the immanent soul of all living beings, is worshipped by means of penance.
verses.hindi: ध्यानं होमं तपस्तप्तं ज्ञानं यज्ञादिको विधि: । तेषां विनश्यति क्षिप्रं ये निन्दन्ति पिनाकिनम् यो मां समाश्रयेन्नित्यमेकान्तं भावमाश्रित: । विनिन्द्य देवमीशानं स याति नरकायुतम्
verses.wordMeaning: The Lord who is unborn, the maker of the Universe, the eternal seed of the Universe, and the immanent soul of all living beings, is worshipped by means of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Lord who is unborn, the maker of the Universe, the eternal seed of the Universe, and the immanent soul of all living beings, is worshipped by means of penance.

verses.sanskrit: को ऽयं नारायणो देवः किंप्रभावश्च सुव्रत । सर्वमेतन्ममाचक्ष्व परं कौतूहलं हि मे
verses.transliteration: ko 'yaṃ nārāyaṇo devaḥ kiṃprabhāvaśca suvrata / sarvametanmamācakṣva paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me
verses.translation: The Lord who is unborn, the maker of the Universe, the eternal seed of the Universe, and the immanent soul of all living beings, is worshipped by means of penance.
verses.hindi: कर्मणा मनसा वाचा तद्धक्तेष्वपि यत्नतः द्विषन्तो देवमीशानं युष्माकं वंशसम्भवाः। शप्ताश्च गौतमेनोर्व्यां न सम्भाष्या द्विजोत्तमैः
verses.wordMeaning: The Lord who is unborn, the maker of the Universe, the eternal seed of the Universe, and the immanent soul of all living beings, is worshipped by means of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Lord who is unborn, the maker of the Universe, the eternal seed of the Universe, and the immanent soul of all living beings, is worshipped by means of penance.

verses.sanskrit: विश्वामित्र उवाच यतः प्रवृत्तिर्भूतानां यस्मिन् सर्वमिदं जगत् । स विष्णुः सर्वभूतात्मा तमाश्रित्य विमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: viśvāmitra uvāca yataḥ pravṛttirbhūtānāṃ yasmin sarvamidaṃ jagat / sa viṣṇuḥ sarvabhūtātmā tamāśritya vimucyate
verses.translation: The Lord who is unborn, the maker of the Universe, the eternal seed of the Universe, and the immanent soul of all living beings, is worshipped by means of penance.
verses.hindi: ततो नारायणः कृष्णो लीलयैव जगन्मयः । संहृत्य स्वकुलं सर्व ययौ तत् परमं पदम् इत्येष वः समासेन राज्ञां वंशोऽनुकीर्तितः। न शक्यो विस्तराद् वक्तुं किं भूयः श्रोतुमिच्छथ
verses.wordMeaning: The Lord who is unborn, the maker of the Universe, the eternal seed of the Universe, and the immanent soul of all living beings, is worshipped by means of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Lord who is unborn, the maker of the Universe, the eternal seed of the Universe, and the immanent soul of all living beings, is worshipped by means of penance.

verses.sanskrit: स्ववर्णाश्रमधर्मेण पूज्यो ऽयं पुरुषोत्तमः । अकामहतभावेन समाराध्यो न चान्यथा
verses.transliteration: svavarṇāśramadharmeṇa pūjyo 'yaṃ puruṣottamaḥ / akāmahatabhāvena samārādhyo na cānyathā
verses.translation: The Lord who is unborn, the maker of the Universe, the eternal seed of the Universe, and the immanent soul of all living beings, is worshipped by means of penance.
verses.hindi: सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तः स्वर्गलोके महीयते जो पिनाक धारण करनेवाले शिवकी निन्दा करते हैं, उनका ध्यान, होम, किया गया तप, ज्ञान तथा यज्ञादि सभी विधान शीघ्र ही नष्ट हो जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: The Lord who is unborn, the maker of the Universe, the eternal seed of the Universe, and the immanent soul of all living beings, is worshipped by means of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Lord who is unborn, the maker of the Universe, the eternal seed of the Universe, and the immanent soul of all living beings, is worshipped by means of penance.

verses.sanskrit: एतावदुक्त्वा भगवान विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः । शूराद्यैः पूजितो विप्रा जगामाथ स्वमालयम्
verses.transliteration: etāvaduktvā bhagavāna viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ / śūrādyaiḥ pūjito viprā jagāmātha svamālayam
verses.translation: The Lord who is unborn, the maker of the Universe, the eternal seed of the Universe, and the immanent soul of all living beings, is worshipped by means of penance.
verses.hindi: जो ईशान (शंकर) देवकी निन्दा कर नित्य अनन्य भावसे मेरा आश्रय ग्रहण करता है, वह दस हजार वर्षोतक नरकमें रहता है। इसलिये द्विजो! मन, वाणी तथा कर्मसे पशुपति तथा उनके भक्तोंकी भी निन्दाका प्रयत्नपूर्वक परित्याग करना चाहिए। द्विजोत्तमो! दक्ष प्रजापतिके यज्ञमें दधीचने आपके वंशमें उत्पन्न जिन ब्राह्मणोंको देव ईशानसे द्वेष करनेके कारण शाप दिया था, वे सभी कलियुगमें पृथ्वीपर उत्पन्न होंगे । भक्तोंद्वारा
verses.wordMeaning: The Lord who is unborn, the maker of the Universe, the eternal seed of the Universe, and the immanent soul of all living beings, is worshipped by means of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Lord who is unborn, the maker of the Universe, the eternal seed of the Universe, and the immanent soul of all living beings, is worshipped by means of penance.

verses.sanskrit: अथ शूरादयो देवमयजन्त महेश्वरम् । यज्ञेन यज्ञगम्यं तं निष्कामा रुद्रमव्ययम्
verses.transliteration: atha śūrādayo devamayajanta maheśvaram / yajñena yajñagamyaṃ taṃ niṣkāmā rudramavyayam
verses.translation: The Lord who is unborn, the maker of the Universe, the eternal seed of the Universe, and the immanent soul of all living beings, is worshipped by means of penance.
verses.hindi: प्रयत्नपूर्वक उनका परित्याग करना चाहिए। महर्षि गौतमद्वारा शापप्रास लोगोंसे भी श्रेष्ठ ब्राह्मणोंको बात नहीं करनी चाहिए॥ १५--१८ ॥ कृष्णद्वारा इस प्रकार कहे जानेपर वे सभी श्रेष्ठ महर्षि “ठीक है' ऐसा कहकर शीघ्र ही अपने स्थानोंको चले गये। तदनन्तर जगन्मय नारायण कृष्ण लीलापूर्वक अपने सारे कुलका संहारकर अपने परमधामको पधार
verses.wordMeaning: The Lord who is unborn, the maker of the Universe, the eternal seed of the Universe, and the immanent soul of all living beings, is worshipped by means of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Lord who is unborn, the maker of the Universe, the eternal seed of the Universe, and the immanent soul of all living beings, is worshipped by means of penance.

verses.sanskrit: तान् वसिष्ठस्तु भगवान् याजयामास सर्ववित् । गौतमो ऽत्रिरगस्त्यश्च सर्वे रुद्रपरायणाः
verses.transliteration: tān vasiṣṭhastu bhagavān yājayāmāsa sarvavit / gautamo 'triragastyaśca sarve rudraparāyaṇāḥ
verses.translation: The Lord who is unborn, the maker of the Universe, the eternal seed of the Universe, and the immanent soul of all living beings, is worshipped by means of penance.
verses.hindi: (सूतजीने ऋषियोंसे कहा--) संक्षेपमें यह राजवंश आप लोगोंको बताया गया, विस्तारपूर्वक इसका वर्णन नहीं हो सकता। अब आप पुनः क्या सुनना चाहते हैं? जो इन बंशोंके शुभ वर्णनको पढ़ता है अथवा सुनता है, वह सभी पापोंसे मुक्त हो जाता है तथा स्वर्गलोकमें आदर प्राप्त करता है
verses.wordMeaning: The Lord who is unborn, the maker of the Universe, the eternal seed of the Universe, and the immanent soul of all living beings, is worshipped by means of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Lord who is unborn, the maker of the Universe, the eternal seed of the Universe, and the immanent soul of all living beings, is worshipped by means of penance.

verses.sanskrit: विश्वामित्रस्तु भगवान् जयध्वजमरिन्दमम् । याजयामास भूतादिमादिदेवं जनार्दनम्
verses.transliteration: viśvāmitrastu bhagavān jayadhvajamarindamam / yājayāmāsa bhūtādimādidevaṃ janārdanam
verses.translation: The Lord who is unborn, the maker of the Universe, the eternal seed of the Universe, and the immanent soul of all living beings, is worshipped by means of penance.
verses.hindi: व्यासदेवद्वारा अर्जुनको सत्ययुगादि चारों युगोंके धर्मोका उपदेश, व्यासद्वारा एक वेद-संहिताका चतुर्धा विभाजन, चारों युगोंमें चतुष्पाद धर्मकी विभिन्न स्थितिका निदर्शन तथा कलियुगमें धर्मके हासका प्रतिपादन गते नारायणे कृष्णे स्वमेव परमं पदम्। पार्थः परमधर्मात्मा पाण्डवः शत्रुतापनः
verses.wordMeaning: The Lord who is unborn, the maker of the Universe, the eternal seed of the Universe, and the immanent soul of all living beings, is worshipped by means of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Lord who is unborn, the maker of the Universe, the eternal seed of the Universe, and the immanent soul of all living beings, is worshipped by means of penance.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य यज्ञे महायोगी साक्षाद् देवः स्वयं हरिः । आविरासीत् स भगवान् तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्
verses.transliteration: tasya yajñe mahāyogī sākṣād devaḥ svayaṃ hariḥ / āvirāsīt sa bhagavān tadadbhutamivābhavat
verses.translation: The Lord who is unborn, the maker of the Universe, the eternal seed of the Universe, and the immanent soul of all living beings, is worshipped by means of penance.
verses.hindi: कृत्वा चैवोत्तरविधिं शोकेन महतावृतः । अपश्यत् पथि गच्छन्तं कृष्णद्वैपायनं मुनिम् शिष्यैः प्रशिष्यैरभितः संवृतं ब्रह्मवादिनम्। पपात दण्डवद् भूमौ त्यक्त्वा शोकं तदार्जुनः
verses.wordMeaning: The Lord who is unborn, the maker of the Universe, the eternal seed of the Universe, and the immanent soul of all living beings, is worshipped by means of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Lord who is unborn, the maker of the Universe, the eternal seed of the Universe, and the immanent soul of all living beings, is worshipped by means of penance.

verses.sanskrit: य इमं शृणुयान्नित्यं जयध्वजपराक्रमम् । सर्वपापविमुक्तात्मा विष्णुलोकं स गच्छति
verses.transliteration: ya imaṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ jayadhvajaparākramam / sarvapāpavimuktātmā viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati
verses.translation: The Lord who is unborn, the maker of the Universe, the eternal seed of the Universe, and the immanent soul of all living beings, is worshipped by means of penance.
verses.hindi: संदर्शनाद् वै भवतः शोको मे विपुलो गतः । इदानीं मम यत् कार्य ब्रूहि पद्मदलेक्षण ६ ॥ उपविश्य नदीतीरे शिष्यैः परिवृतो मुनिः
verses.wordMeaning: The Lord who is unborn, the maker of the Universe, the eternal seed of the Universe, and the immanent soul of all living beings, is worshipped by means of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Lord who is unborn, the maker of the Universe, the eternal seed of the Universe, and the immanent soul of all living beings, is worshipped by means of penance.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे एकविशो ऽध्यायः सूत उवाच जयध्वजस्य पुत्रो ऽभूत् तालाजङ्घ इति स्मृतः । शतपुत्रास्तु तस्यासन् तालजङ्घाः प्रकीर्तिताः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge ekaviśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca jayadhvajasya putro 'bhūt tālājaṅgha iti smṛtaḥ / śataputrāstu tasyāsan tālajaṅghāḥ prakīrtitāḥ
verses.translation: That Rudra, who is the Fire-god, the soul of all, who is infinite, who is self-born, and who has faces all round is wor¬ shipped by means of severe penance and not through other sacrifices.
verses.hindi: ततो गच्छामि देवस्य वाराणसीं महापुरीम् अस्मिन् कलियुगे घोरे लोकाः पापानुवर्तिनः । भविष्यन्ति महापापा वर्णाश्रमविवर्जिताः
verses.wordMeaning: That Rudra, who is the Fire-god, the soul of all, who is infinite, who is self-born, and who has faces all round is wor¬ shipped by means of severe penance and not through other sacrifices.
verses.commentary: Sense: That Rudra, who is the Fire-god, the soul of all, who is infinite, who is self-born, and who has faces all round is wor¬ shipped by means of severe penance and not through other sacrifices.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां ज्येष्ठो महावीर्यो वीतिहोत्रो ऽभवन्नृपः । वृषप्रभृतयश्चान्ये यादवाः पुण्यकर्मिणः
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ jyeṣṭho mahāvīryo vītihotro 'bhavannṛpaḥ / vṛṣaprabhṛtayaścānye yādavāḥ puṇyakarmiṇaḥ
verses.translation: That eternal Vasudeva, the lord who is worshipped by means of Tajnas and whose form is constituted of all deities, is the Supreme Lord; he should be worshipped.
verses.hindi: सर्वपापप्रशमनं प्रायश्चित्तं कलौ युगे भविष्यन्ति महात्मानो धार्मिकाः सत्यवादिनः
verses.wordMeaning: That eternal Vasudeva, the lord who is worshipped by means of Tajnas and whose form is constituted of all deities, is the Supreme Lord; he should be worshipped.
verses.commentary: Sense: That eternal Vasudeva, the lord who is worshipped by means of Tajnas and whose form is constituted of all deities, is the Supreme Lord; he should be worshipped.

verses.sanskrit: वृषो वंशकरस्तेषां तस्य पुत्रो ऽभवन्मधुः । मधोः पुत्रशतं त्वासीद् वृषणस्तस्य वंशभाक्
verses.transliteration: vṛṣo vaṃśakarasteṣāṃ tasya putro 'bhavanmadhuḥ / madhoḥ putraśataṃ tvāsīd vṛṣaṇastasya vaṃśabhāk
verses.translation: That great Supreme Ruler from whom all this Universe is born and whose offspring is god Brahma (the progenitor of the world) is worshipped only by taking recourse to austere penance.
verses.hindi: त्वं हि लोकेषु विख्यातो धृतिमाञ् जनवत्सलः । पालयाद्य परं धर्म स्वकीयं मुच्यसे भयात् पृष्टवान् प्रणिपत्यासौ युगधर्मान् द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.wordMeaning: That great Supreme Ruler from whom all this Universe is born and whose offspring is god Brahma (the progenitor of the world) is worshipped only by taking recourse to austere penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: That great Supreme Ruler from whom all this Universe is born and whose offspring is god Brahma (the progenitor of the world) is worshipped only by taking recourse to austere penance.

verses.sanskrit: वीतिहोत्रसुतश्चापि विश्रुतो ऽनन्त इत्युत । दुर्जयस्तस्य पुत्रो ऽबूत् सर्वशास्त्रविशारदः
verses.transliteration: vītihotrasutaścāpi viśruto 'nanta ityuta / durjayastasya putro 'būt sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ
verses.translation: That eternal Lord of gods, the lord from whom
verses.hindi: तस्मै प्रोवाच सकलं मुनिः सत्यवतीसुतः । प्रणम्य देवमीशानं युगधर्मान् सनातनान् ऋषियोंने कहा--सूतजी ! सत्य, त्रेता, द्वापर तथा कलि--ये चार युग हैं, अब (आप) इनके स्वभावका संक्षेपमें वर्णन कीजिये
verses.wordMeaning: That eternal Lord of gods, the lord from whom
verses.commentary: Sense: That eternal Lord of gods, the lord from whom

verses.sanskrit: तस्य भार्या रूपवती गुणैः सर्वैरलङ्कृता । पतिव्रतासीत् पतिना स्वधर्मपरिपालिका
verses.transliteration: tasya bhāryā rūpavatī guṇaiḥ sarvairalaṅkṛtā / pativratāsīt patinā svadharmaparipālikā
verses.translation: The lord of thousand eye, Sambhu, the cosmic
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले--नारायण कृष्णके अपने परमधाम चले जानेपर शत्रुओंको पीडा पहुँचानेवाले परम धर्मात्मा पाण्डुपुत्र पार्थ (अर्जुन) और्ध्वहैहिक क्रिया करके महान् शोकसे आवृत हो गये। (उन्होंने) मार्गमें जाते हुए ब्रह्मवादी कृष्णद्वैपायन (व्यास) मुनिको शिष्यों, प्रशिष्योंसे चारों ओरसे घिरे हुए देखा। तब शोकका परित्यागकर अर्जुनने भूमिपर दण्डवत् गिरकर प्रणाम किया और परम प्रीतिसे कहा--महामुने ! प्रभो! आप कहाँसे आ रहे
verses.wordMeaning: The lord of thousand eye, Sambhu, the cosmic
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord of thousand eye, Sambhu, the cosmic

verses.sanskrit: स कदाचिन्महाभागः कालिन्दीतीरसंस्थिताम् । अपश्यदुर्वशीं देवीं गायन्तीं मधुरस्वनाम्
verses.transliteration: sa kadācinmahābhāgaḥ kālindītīrasaṃsthitām / apaśyadurvaśīṃ devīṃ gāyantīṃ madhurasvanām
verses.translation: To a person who has concluded Vedic study and per¬
verses.hindi: हैं और किस देशकी ओर इस समय शीप्रतापूर्वक जा रहे हैं? आपका दर्शन करनेसे ही मेरा महान् शोक दूर हो गया है। कमलपत्रके समान नेत्रवाले (व्यासजी महाराज)! इस समय मेरा जो कर्तव्य हो, उसे आप बतलायें। तब शिष्योंसे घिरे हुए महायोगी कृष्णद्वैपायन मुनिने नदीके किनारे बैठकर स्वयं कहा- ॥ २--७॥
verses.wordMeaning: To a person who has concluded Vedic study and per¬
verses.commentary: Sense: To a person who has concluded Vedic study and per¬

verses.sanskrit: ततः कामाहतमनास्तत्समीपमुपेत्य वै । प्रोवाच सुचिरं कालं देवि रन्तुं मयार्ऽहसि
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kāmāhatamanāstatsamīpamupetya vai / provāca suciraṃ kālaṃ devi rantuṃ mayār'hasi
verses.translation: On hearing these statements that saintly king be¬ came highly delighted in his mind. He bowed to and worshipped them. After bidding farewell to them, he spoke to Tridhanvan.
verses.hindi: व्यासजी बोले--पाण्डुके पुत्र (अर्जुन) ! यह घोर कलियुग आ गया है। इसलिये मैं भगवान् शंकरकी महापुरी वाराणसी जा रहा हूँ। इस भयंकर कलियुगे लोग पापाचरण करनेवाले, वर्ण तथा आश्रमधर्मसे रहित महान् पापी होंगे। कलियुगमें सभी पापोंका शमन करनेके लिये वाराणसीपुरीके सेवनको छोड़कर अन्य दूसरा कोई प्रायश्चित्त मैं नहीं देखता
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing these statements that saintly king be¬ came highly delighted in his mind. He bowed to and worshipped them. After bidding farewell to them, he spoke to Tridhanvan.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing these statements that saintly king be¬ came highly delighted in his mind. He bowed to and worshipped them. After bidding farewell to them, he spoke to Tridhanvan.

verses.sanskrit: सा देवी नृपतिं दृष्ट्वा रूपलावण्यसंयुतम् । रेमे तेन चिरं कालं कामदेवमिवापरम्
verses.transliteration: sā devī nṛpatiṃ dṛṣṭvā rūpalāvaṇyasaṃyutam / reme tena ciraṃ kālaṃ kāmadevamivāparam
verses.translation: "By means of penance I shall propitiate the Lord designated with the single syllable OM, the great Purusa, the vital spirit stationed in the middle of Aditya.
verses.hindi: सत्य, त्रेता तथा द्वापर--इन सभी (युगों)-में मनुष्य महात्मा, धार्मिक तथा सत्यवादी होते हैं। आप संसारमें प्रजावत्सल तथा धृतिमान्के रूपमें विख्यात हैं, अतः अपने परम धर्मका पालन करें, इससे आप भयसे मुक्त हो जायंगे। द्विजोत्तमो! भगवान् (व्यास)-के द्वारा ऐसा कहनेपर शत्रुके पुरको जीतनेवाले पृथा (कुन्ती)-के पुत्र पार्थ (अर्जुन) -ने इन्हें प्रणामकर युगधर्मोको पूछा। सत्यवतीके पुत्र व्यासमुनिने भगवान् शंकरको प्रणामकर
verses.wordMeaning: "By means of penance I shall propitiate the Lord designated with the single syllable OM, the great Purusa, the vital spirit stationed in the middle of Aditya.
verses.commentary: Sense: "By means of penance I shall propitiate the Lord designated with the single syllable OM, the great Purusa, the vital spirit stationed in the middle of Aditya.

verses.sanskrit: कालात् प्रबुद्धो राजा तामुर्वशीं प्राह शोभनाम् । गमिष्यामि पुरीं रम्यां हसन्ती साब्रवीद् वचः
verses.transliteration: kālāt prabuddho rājā tāmurvaśīṃ prāha śobhanām / gamiṣyāmi purīṃ ramyāṃ hasantī sābravīd vacaḥ
verses.translation: But you should be devoted to Dharma forever. Eternally vigilant, protect the entire earthly realm consisting of the four castes of people."
verses.hindi: सम्पूर्ण सनातन युगधर्मोको उन्हें बतलाया॥ ११--१४॥ वक्ष्यामि ते समासेन युगधर्मान् नरेश्वर। न शक्यते मया पार्थ विस्तरेणाभिभाषितुम्
verses.wordMeaning: But you should be devoted to Dharma forever. Eternally vigilant, protect the entire earthly realm consisting of the four castes of people."
verses.commentary: Sense: But you should be devoted to Dharma forever. Eternally vigilant, protect the entire earthly realm consisting of the four castes of people."

verses.sanskrit: न ह्यनेनोपभोगेन भवता राजसुन्दर । प्रीतिः संजायते मह्यं स्थातव्यं वत्सरं पुनः
verses.transliteration: na hyanenopabhogena bhavatā rājasundara / prītiḥ saṃjāyate mahyaṃ sthātavyaṃ vatsaraṃ punaḥ
verses.translation: After saying so, the sinless king entrusted the king¬ dom to the care of his son. In order to perform the excellent penance, he went to the forest.
verses.hindi: द्वापरे यज्ञमेवाहुर्दानमेव कलौ युगे ब्रह्मा कृतयुगे देवस्त्रेतायां भगवान् रविः। द्वापरे देवतं विष्णुः कलौ रूद्रो महेश्वरः
verses.wordMeaning: After saying so, the sinless king entrusted the king¬ dom to the care of his son. In order to perform the excellent penance, he went to the forest.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying so, the sinless king entrusted the king¬ dom to the care of his son. In order to perform the excellent penance, he went to the forest.

verses.sanskrit: तामब्रवीत् स मतिमान् गत्वा शीघ्रतरं पुरीम् । आगमिष्यामि भूयो ऽत्र तन्मे ऽनुज्ञातुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration: tāmabravīt sa matimān gatvā śīghrataraṃ purīm / āgamiṣyāmi bhūyo 'tra tanme 'nujñātumarhasi
verses.translation: Resorting to the forest of Devadaru {Pinus Devadaru) trees on the beautiful peaks of the Himalaya, he worshipped gods with bulbous and other roots and fmits grown in the forest and subsisted on them.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मा विष्णुस्तथा सूर्यः सर्व एव कलिष्वपि। पूज्यते भगवान् रुद्रश्चतुर्ष्वपि पिनाकधृक् आद्ये कृतयुगे धर्मश्चतुष्पादः सनातनः।
verses.wordMeaning: Resorting to the forest of Devadaru {Pinus Devadaru) trees on the beautiful peaks of the Himalaya, he worshipped gods with bulbous and other roots and fmits grown in the forest and subsisted on them.
verses.commentary: Sense: Resorting to the forest of Devadaru {Pinus Devadaru) trees on the beautiful peaks of the Himalaya, he worshipped gods with bulbous and other roots and fmits grown in the forest and subsisted on them.

verses.sanskrit: तमब्रवीत् सा सुभगा तथा कुरु विशांपते । नान्ययाप्सरसा तावद् रन्तव्यं भवत् पुनः
verses.transliteration: tamabravīt sā subhagā tathā kuru viśāṃpate / nānyayāpsarasā tāvad rantavyaṃ bhavat punaḥ
verses.translation: Shaking off his sins by means of penance, he mentally repeated the Mantra of goddess Savitri, the mother of the Vedas, for a hundred years and more.
verses.hindi: विशोकाः सत्त्वबहुला एकान्तबहुलास्तथा। ध्याननिष्ठास्तपोनिष्ठा महादेवपरायणाः ता वै निष्कामचारिण्यो नित्यं मुदितमानसाः । पर्वतोदधिवासिन्यो ह्यनिकेताः परंतप
verses.wordMeaning: Shaking off his sins by means of penance, he mentally repeated the Mantra of goddess Savitri, the mother of the Vedas, for a hundred years and more.
verses.commentary: Sense: Shaking off his sins by means of penance, he mentally repeated the Mantra of goddess Savitri, the mother of the Vedas, for a hundred years and more.

verses.sanskrit: ओमित्युक्त्वा ययौ तूर्णं पुरीं परमशोभनाम् । गत्वा पतिव्रतां पत्नीं दृष्ट्वा बीतो ऽभवन्नृपः
verses.transliteration: omityuktvā yayau tūrṇaṃ purīṃ paramaśobhanām / gatvā pativratāṃ patnīṃ dṛṣṭvā bīto 'bhavannṛpaḥ
verses.translation: While he was performing penance like this, the self- born lord, the great Isvara, Hiranyagarbha, the Atman of the Universe came to that spot himself
verses.hindi: रसोल्लासा कालयोगात् त्रेताख्ये नश्यते ततः । तस्यां सिद्धौ प्रणष्टायामन्या सिद्धिरवर्तत सकृदेव तया वृष्ट्या संयुक्ते पुथिवीतले। प्रादुरासंस्तदा तासां वृक्षा वै गृहसंज्ञिताः
verses.wordMeaning: While he was performing penance like this, the self- born lord, the great Isvara, Hiranyagarbha, the Atman of the Universe came to that spot himself
verses.commentary: Sense: While he was performing penance like this, the self- born lord, the great Isvara, Hiranyagarbha, the Atman of the Universe came to that spot himself

verses.sanskrit: संप्रेक्ष्य सा गुणवती भार्या तस्य पतिव्रता । भीतं प्रसन्नया प्राह वाचा पीनपयोधरा
verses.transliteration: saṃprekṣya sā guṇavatī bhāryā tasya pativratā / bhītaṃ prasannayā prāha vācā pīnapayodharā
verses.translation: On seeing Lord Brahma with faces all round, coming there, the king bowed down his head at his feet and glorified his name.
verses.hindi: व्यासजी बोले- -नरेश्वर ! पार्थ! संक्षेपमें युगधर्मोको तुम्हें बतलाता हूँ, मैं विस्तारसे वर्णन नहीं कर सकता हूँ। पार्थ! विद्वानोंद्ारा पहला कृतयुग कहा गया है, कलियुग कहा गया है। कृतयुगमें ध्यान, त्रेतामें ज्ञान, द्वापरमें यज्ञ तथा कलियुगमें एकमात्र दान ही श्रेष्ठ साधन बताया गया है। कृतयुगमें ब्रह्मा देवता होते हैं, इसी प्रकार त्रेतामें भगवान् सूर्य, द्वापरमें देवता विष्णु और
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing Lord Brahma with faces all round, coming there, the king bowed down his head at his feet and glorified his name.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing Lord Brahma with faces all round, coming there, the king bowed down his head at his feet and glorified his name.

verses.sanskrit: स्वामिन् किमत्र भवतो भीतिरद्य प्रवर्तते । तद् ब्रूहि मे यथा तत्त्वं न राज्ञां कीर्तये त्विदम्
verses.transliteration: svāmin kimatra bhavato bhītiradya pravartate / tad brūhi me yathā tattvaṃ na rājñāṃ kīrtaye tvidam
verses.translation: "Obeisance to you O Brahman, the supreme God, the Supreme Soul, the gold-complexioned creator with a thousand eyes.
verses.hindi: कलियुगमें महेश्वर रुद्र ही मुख्य देवता हैं। ब्रह्मा, विष्णु तथा सूर्यये सभी कलियुगमें पूजित होते हैं, किंतु पिनाकधारी भगवान् रुद्र चारों युगोंमें पूजे जाते हैं। सर्वप्रथम कृतयुगमें सनातनधर्म चार चरणोंवाला था, त्रेतामें तीन चरणोंवाला तथा द्वापरमें दो चरणोंसे स्थित हुआ, किंतु कलियुगमें तीन चरणोंसे रहित होकर केवल सत्तामात्रसे स्थित रहता है॥ १५--२० ॥
verses.wordMeaning: "Obeisance to you O Brahman, the supreme God, the Supreme Soul, the gold-complexioned creator with a thousand eyes.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Obeisance to you O Brahman, the supreme God, the Supreme Soul, the gold-complexioned creator with a thousand eyes.

verses.sanskrit: स तस्या वाक्यमाकर्ण्य लज्जावनतचेतनः । नोवाच किञ्चिन्नृपतिर्ज्ञानदृष्ट्या विवेद सा
verses.transliteration: sa tasyā vākyamākarṇya lajjāvanatacetanaḥ / novāca kiñcinnṛpatirjñānadṛṣṭyā viveda sā
verses.translation: Salutations to the creator and the dispenser of destiny. Hail to you the embodiment of all gods. Obeisance to you, the embodiment of spiritual knowledge, comprehensible through the knowledge and practice of Sarhkhya and Yoga.
verses.hindi: कृतयुगमें स्त्री-पुरुषके संयोगसे उत्पत्ति होती थी और लोगोंको आजीविका साक्षात् (आनन्द) रससे आनन्दसे तृप्त और भोगसे सम्पन्न रहती थीं। पुरञ्जय! उन प्रजाओंमें उत्तम और अधमका भेद नहीं था, सभी निर्विशेष थे। उस कृतयुगमें प्रजाकी आयु, सुख और रूप समान था। सम्पूर्ण प्रजा शोकसे रहित, सत्त्वगुणके
verses.wordMeaning: Salutations to the creator and the dispenser of destiny. Hail to you the embodiment of all gods. Obeisance to you, the embodiment of spiritual knowledge, comprehensible through the knowledge and practice of Sarhkhya and Yoga.
verses.commentary: Sense: Salutations to the creator and the dispenser of destiny. Hail to you the embodiment of all gods. Obeisance to you, the embodiment of spiritual knowledge, comprehensible through the knowledge and practice of Sarhkhya and Yoga.

verses.sanskrit: न भेतव्यं त्वया स्वामिन् कार्यं पापविशोधनम् । भीते त्वयि महाराज राष्ट्रं ते नाशमेष्यति
verses.transliteration: na bhetavyaṃ tvayā svāmin kāryaṃ pāpaviśodhanam / bhīte tvayi mahārāja rāṣṭraṃ te nāśameṣyati
verses.translation: Obeisance to you, the Trinity, the Creator, the Omniscient One. Hail to the ancient Purusa, the preceptor of the Yogins."
verses.hindi: बाहुल्यसे युक्त, एकान्तप्रेमी, ध्याननिष्ठ, तपोनिष्ठ तथा महादेव शंकरकी भक्त थी। परंतप! वे प्रजाएँ निष्कामकर्म करनेवाली, नित्य प्रसन्न मनवाली और पर्वतों एवं समुद्रके किनारे रहनेवाली थीं, उनका कोई घर नहीं तदनन्तर कालके प्रभावसे त्रेता नामक युगमें (सत्य- युगका) आनन्दोल्लास नष्ट हो जाता है, (कृतयुगकी) उस सिद्धिका लोप होनेपर अन्य सिद्धि प्रवर्तित होती है। मेघमें जलकी कमी होनेपर मेघ और विद्युत्से वृष्टि
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you, the Trinity, the Creator, the Omniscient One. Hail to the ancient Purusa, the preceptor of the Yogins."
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you, the Trinity, the Creator, the Omniscient One. Hail to the ancient Purusa, the preceptor of the Yogins."

verses.sanskrit: तदा स राजा द्युतिमान् निर्गत्य तु पुरात् ततः । गत्वा कण्वाश्रमं पुण्यं दृष्ट्वा तत्र महामुनिम्
verses.transliteration: tadā sa rājā dyutimān nirgatya tu purāt tataḥ / gatvā kaṇvāśramaṃ puṇyaṃ dṛṣṭvā tatra mahāmunim
verses.translation: Then, lord Brahma, the creator of the Universe, be¬ came delighted and said,—"Welfare unto you. Choose the boon. I am the granter of boons."
verses.hindi: उत्पन्न हुई। पृथ्वीतलपर एक बार ही उस वृष्टिका संयोग होनेसे उन प्रजाओंके लिये गृहसंज्ञक वृक्षोंका प्रादुर्भाव हुआ। उन (वृक्षों)-से ही उनके सब कार्य सम्पन्न होने लगे। त्रेतायुगके प्रारम्भमें वह समस्त प्रजा उनसे ही (अपनी जीविकाका) निर्वाह करती थी
verses.wordMeaning: Then, lord Brahma, the creator of the Universe, be¬ came delighted and said,—"Welfare unto you. Choose the boon. I am the granter of boons."
verses.commentary: Sense: Then, lord Brahma, the creator of the Universe, be¬ came delighted and said,—"Welfare unto you. Choose the boon. I am the granter of boons."

verses.sanskrit: निशम्य कण्ववदनात् प्रायश्चित्तविधिं शुभम् । जगाम हिमवत्पृष्ठं समुद्दिश्य महाबलः
verses.transliteration: niśamya kaṇvavadanāt prāyaścittavidhiṃ śubham / jagāma himavatpṛṣṭhaṃ samuddiśya mahābalaḥ
verses.translation: "O lord of the lords of Devas, I wish to perform the Japa of Gayatri, the mother of the Vedas, once again. May
verses.hindi: सत्ययुगमें स्वयं मेघ जलमय होते थे। उनमें इतनी जलकी प्रचुरता होती थी कि किसी अन्यके सहयोगके बिना ही वे वृष्टि करते थे। पर त्रेतायुगमें मेघोंकी जलमयता प्रतिहत हो गयी। फलतः विद्युत्के सहयोगसे ही मेघ वृष्टि कर पाते थे। ततः कालेन महता तासामेव विपर्ययात्। रागलोभात्मको भावस्तदा ह्याकस्मिकोऽभवत्
verses.wordMeaning: "O lord of the lords of Devas, I wish to perform the Japa of Gayatri, the mother of the Vedas, once again. May
verses.commentary: Sense: "O lord of the lords of Devas, I wish to perform the Japa of Gayatri, the mother of the Vedas, once again. May

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽपश्यत् पथि राजेन्द्रो गन्धर्ववरमुत्तमम् । भ्राजमानं श्रिया व्योम्नि भूषितं दिव्यमालया
verses.transliteration: so 'paśyat pathi rājendro gandharvavaramuttamam / bhrājamānaṃ śriyā vyomni bhūṣitaṃ divyamālayā
verses.translation: Glancing at the king, the Atman of the Universe (i.e. Brahma) said—"So be it". Stroking him gently with his hands, the delighted Lord vanished there itself.
verses.hindi: विपर्ययेण तासां तु तेन तत्कालभाविना। अमाक्षिकं महावीर्य पुटके पुटके मधु
verses.wordMeaning: Glancing at the king, the Atman of the Universe (i.e. Brahma) said—"So be it". Stroking him gently with his hands, the delighted Lord vanished there itself.
verses.commentary: Sense: Glancing at the king, the Atman of the Universe (i.e. Brahma) said—"So be it". Stroking him gently with his hands, the delighted Lord vanished there itself.

verses.sanskrit: वीक्ष्य मालाममित्रघ्नः सस्माराप्सरसां वराम् । उर्वशीं तां मनश्चक्रे तस्या एवेयमर्हति
verses.transliteration: vīkṣya mālāmamitraghnaḥ sasmārāpsarasāṃ varām / urvaśīṃ tāṃ manaścakre tasyā eveyamarhati
verses.translation: The glorious king on securing the boon was much delighted, and he repeated the Japa. He was tranquil. He used to take his holy ablution thrice a day and he subsisted on fruits, roots and bulbous roots.
verses.hindi: ततः कालान्तरेणैव पुनर्लोभावृतास्तदा। वृक्षांस्तान् पर्यगृह्णन्त मधु चामाक्षिकं बलात् वार्तायाः साधिका हान्या वृष्ट्रिस्तासां निकामतः
verses.wordMeaning: The glorious king on securing the boon was much delighted, and he repeated the Japa. He was tranquil. He used to take his holy ablution thrice a day and he subsisted on fruits, roots and bulbous roots.
verses.commentary: Sense: The glorious king on securing the boon was much delighted, and he repeated the Japa. He was tranquil. He used to take his holy ablution thrice a day and he subsisted on fruits, roots and bulbous roots.

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽतीव कामुको राजा गन्धर्वेणाथ तेन हि । चकार सुमहद् युद्धं मालामादातुमुद्यतः
verses.transliteration: so 'tīva kāmuko rājā gandharveṇātha tena hi / cakāra sumahad yuddhaṃ mālāmādātumudyataḥ
verses.translation: When hundred years were completed, the lord of fierce-rays (the Sun-god), the great Yogin, appeared in front of him from the middle of the Solar sphere.
verses.hindi: तासां वृष्ट्यूदकानीह यानि निम्नेर्गतानि तु। अवहन् वृष्टिसंतत्या स्त्रोतः स्थानानि निम्नगाः ये पुनस्तदपां स्तोका आपन्नाः पृथिवीतले। अपां भूमेश्च संयोगादोषध्यस्तास्तदाभवन्
verses.wordMeaning: When hundred years were completed, the lord of fierce-rays (the Sun-god), the great Yogin, appeared in front of him from the middle of the Solar sphere.
verses.commentary: Sense: When hundred years were completed, the lord of fierce-rays (the Sun-god), the great Yogin, appeared in front of him from the middle of the Solar sphere.

verses.sanskrit: विजित्य समरे मालां गृहीत्वा दुर्जयो द्विजाः । जगाम तामप्सरसं कालिन्दीं द्रष्टुमादरात्
verses.transliteration: vijitya samare mālāṃ gṛhītvā durjayo dvijāḥ / jagāma tāmapsarasaṃ kālindīṃ draṣṭumādarāt
verses.translation: On seeing the eternal Lord stationed in the solar sphere, the self-born lord Brahma, the embodiment of the Vedas, he was surprised.
verses.hindi: ५ कर्तव्य-पालनमें प्रमाद होनेसे विपर्यय (करने योग्य कर्मका न करना, न करने योग्य कर्मका करना) होता है। यह विपर्यय तदनन्तर बहुत समय व्यतीत होनेपर उन प्रजाओंके ही विपर्ययसे उनमें अचानक ही राग और लोभका भाव उत्पन्न हो गया  तदनन्तर उनके उलट-फेर (दिनचर्यामें व्यत्यय)-के कारण उस समयके प्रभाववश वे गृह-
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing the eternal Lord stationed in the solar sphere, the self-born lord Brahma, the embodiment of the Vedas, he was surprised.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the eternal Lord stationed in the solar sphere, the self-born lord Brahma, the embodiment of the Vedas, he was surprised.

verses.sanskrit: अदृष्ट्वाप्सरसं तत्र कामबाणाभिपीडितः । बभ्राम सकलां पृथ्वीं सप्तद्वीपसमन्विताम्
verses.transliteration: adṛṣṭvāpsarasaṃ tatra kāmabāṇābhipīḍitaḥ / babhrāma sakalāṃ pṛthvīṃ saptadvīpasamanvitām
verses.translation: With his mind overwhelmed with great emotion and with extremely deep devotion, he bowed down his head and eulogised him with the Savitri Mantra.
verses.hindi: तब उन (वृक्षों)-के नष्ट हो जानेपर मिथुनधर्मसे उत्पन्न सत्यका ध्यान करनेवाले वे सभी प्रजाजन विभ्रान्त होकर उस पूर्व वर्णित सिद्धिका ध्यान करने लगे। उस समय (सत्यका ध्यान करनेके कारण) उन प्रजाओंके (लुप्त) वे गृह-संज्ञक वृक्ष पुनः प्रादुर्भूत हो गये। वे वस्त्रो, आभूषणों तथा फलोंको उत्पन्न करने लगे। उन प्रजाओंके लिये उन वृक्षोंके प्रत्येक पत्रपुटोंमें गन्ध, वर्ण और रससे समन्वित, बिना मधु-मक्खियोंके
verses.wordMeaning: With his mind overwhelmed with great emotion and with extremely deep devotion, he bowed down his head and eulogised him with the Savitri Mantra.
verses.commentary: Sense: With his mind overwhelmed with great emotion and with extremely deep devotion, he bowed down his head and eulogised him with the Savitri Mantra.

verses.sanskrit: आक्रम्य हिमवत्पार्श्वमुर्वशीदर्शनोत्सुकः । जगाम शैलप्रवरं हेमकूटमिति श्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: ākramya himavatpārśvamurvaśīdarśanotsukaḥ / jagāma śailapravaraṃ hemakūṭamiti śrutam
verses.translation: "Obeisance to you the blue-throated Lord, the brilliant Paramesthin. Salutations to Rudra of the form of the three Vedas {Trayi). Obeisance to the embodiment ofKala, the cause of all."
verses.hindi: बना हुआ महान् शक्तिशाली मधु उत्पन्न होता था। उसी (मधु)-से त्रेतायुगके आरम्भमें वे प्रजाएँ जीवन-निर्वाह करती थीं। उस सिद्धिके कारण वे सारी प्रजाएँ हृष्ट- पुष्ट तथा ज्वरसे रहित थीं। तदनन्तर कालान्तरमें वे सभी पुनः लोभके वशीभूत हो गये। अब वे उन वृक्षों तथा उनसे उत्पन्न अमाक्षिक (मक्षिकाद्वारा न बनाये हुए) मधुको बलपूर्वक ग्रहण करने लगे॥ ३१--३५॥
verses.wordMeaning: "Obeisance to you the blue-throated Lord, the brilliant Paramesthin. Salutations to Rudra of the form of the three Vedas {Trayi). Obeisance to the embodiment ofKala, the cause of all."
verses.commentary: Sense: "Obeisance to you the blue-throated Lord, the brilliant Paramesthin. Salutations to Rudra of the form of the three Vedas {Trayi). Obeisance to the embodiment ofKala, the cause of all."

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तत्राप्सरोवर्या दृष्ट्वा तं सिंहविक्रमम् । कामं संदधिरे घोरं भूषितं चित्रमालया
verses.transliteration: tatra tatrāpsarovaryā dṛṣṭvā taṃ siṃhavikramam / kāmaṃ saṃdadhire ghoraṃ bhūṣitaṃ citramālayā
verses.translation: Then the great lord delighted in his mind, said to the
verses.hindi: उनके इस प्रकार पुनः लोभ करनेके कारण उत्पन्न दुष्कर्मसे वे कल्पवृक्ष कहीं-कहीं मधुके साथ ही नष्ट हो गये। तब अत्यन्त शीत, वर्षा एवं धूपसे अत्यधिक दुःखी उन्होंने (शीत-उष्ण आदि) द्वन्द्वोंसे पीडित होते हुए आवरणोंकी रचना की। तब मधुसहित कल्पवृक्षोंके नष्ट हो जानेपर उन्होंने द्वन्द्रोके निराकरणका उपाय विचारकर जीविका-निर्वाहके साधनोंका चिन्तन किया। तदनन्तर त्रेतायुगमें उन प्रजाओंको जीविकाको सिद्ध
verses.wordMeaning: Then the great lord delighted in his mind, said to the
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the great lord delighted in his mind, said to the

verses.sanskrit: संस्मरन्नुर्वशीवाक्यं तस्यां संसक्तमानसः । न पश्यति स्मताः सर्वागिरिशृङ्गाणिजग्मिवान्
verses.transliteration: saṃsmarannurvaśīvākyaṃ tasyāṃ saṃsaktamānasaḥ / na paśyati smatāḥ sarvāgiriśṛṅgāṇijagmivān
verses.translation: They are sung about in all the Vedas. They subdue and suppress the worldly existence. O king, with purity make obeisance to me through these.
verses.hindi: करनेवाली अन्य सिद्धि पुनः प्रादुर्भूत हुई और उनको इच्छाके अनुकूल वृष्टि हुई निरन्तर वर्षाके कारण जो जल नीचेकी ओर प्रवाहित हुआ, उससे उन (प्रजाओं)-के लिये अनेक स्रोतों तथा नदियोंकी उत्पत्ति हुई। जब पृथ्वीतलपर थोड़ा जल एकत्र हो गया तो भूमि और जलका संयोग होनेसे
verses.wordMeaning: They are sung about in all the Vedas. They subdue and suppress the worldly existence. O king, with purity make obeisance to me through these.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are sung about in all the Vedas. They subdue and suppress the worldly existence. O king, with purity make obeisance to me through these.

verses.sanskrit: तत्राप्यप्सरसं दिव्यामदृष्ट्वा कामपीडितः । देवलोकं महामेरुं ययौ देवपराक्रमः
verses.transliteration: tatrāpyapsarasaṃ divyāmadṛṣṭvā kāmapīḍitaḥ / devalokaṃ mahāmeruṃ yayau devaparākramaḥ
verses.translation: Recite the aiarudriya Mantra which is the quintes¬ sence of the Yajur Mantras. O king, perform Japa with your mind not dwelling on any one else but attached to me.
verses.hindi: अनेक प्रकारकी औषधियाँ उत्पन्न हो गयीं ही परम्परया दुर्दृष्टका कारण होता है। यह दुर्दृष्ट ही राग, द्वेष तथा लोभकी भावना उत्पन्न करता है।
verses.wordMeaning: Recite the aiarudriya Mantra which is the quintes¬ sence of the Yajur Mantras. O king, perform Japa with your mind not dwelling on any one else but attached to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Recite the aiarudriya Mantra which is the quintes¬ sence of the Yajur Mantras. O king, perform Japa with your mind not dwelling on any one else but attached to me.

verses.sanskrit: स तत्र मानसं नाम सरस्त्रैलोक्यविश्रुतम् । भेजे शृङ्गाण्यतिक्रम्य स्वबाहुबलभावितः
verses.transliteration: sa tatra mānasaṃ nāma sarastrailokyaviśrutam / bheje śṛṅgāṇyatikramya svabāhubalabhāvitaḥ
verses.translation: Maintaining celibacy, observing fast, with concentra¬ tion of mind and attachment to Bhasma (holy ashes), one should perform the Japa of Rudra till the time of death. He then attains the great region."
verses.hindi: वबसुदारधनाद्यांस्तु बलात् कालबलेन तु मर्यादायाः प्रतिष्ठार्थं ज्ञात्वैतद् भगवानजः। ससर्ज क्षत्रियान् ब्रह्मा ब्राह्मणानां हिताय च
verses.wordMeaning: Maintaining celibacy, observing fast, with concentra¬ tion of mind and attachment to Bhasma (holy ashes), one should perform the Japa of Rudra till the time of death. He then attains the great region."
verses.commentary: Sense: Maintaining celibacy, observing fast, with concentra¬ tion of mind and attachment to Bhasma (holy ashes), one should perform the Japa of Rudra till the time of death. He then attains the great region."

verses.sanskrit: स तस्य तीरे सुभगां चरन्तीमतिलालसाम् । दृष्टवाननवद्याङ्गीं तस्यै मालां ददौ पुनः
verses.transliteration: sa tasya tīre subhagāṃ carantīmatilālasām / dṛṣṭavānanavadyāṅgīṃ tasyai mālāṃ dadau punaḥ
verses.translation: After saying this. Lord Rudra, with a desire of blessing his devotee, granted a further lease of life to the king for a hundred years.
verses.hindi: यज्ञप्रवर्तनं चैव पशुहिंसाविवर्जितम् एको वेदश्चतुष्पादस्त्रेतास्विह विधीयते। वेदव्यासैश्चतुर्धा तु व्यस्यते द्वापरादिषु
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this. Lord Rudra, with a desire of blessing his devotee, granted a further lease of life to the king for a hundred years.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this. Lord Rudra, with a desire of blessing his devotee, granted a further lease of life to the king for a hundred years.

verses.sanskrit: स मालया तदा देवीं भूषितां प्रेक्ष्य मोहितः । रेमे कृतार्थमात्मानं जानानः सुचिरं तया
verses.transliteration: sa mālayā tadā devīṃ bhūṣitāṃ prekṣya mohitaḥ / reme kṛtārthamātmānaṃ jānānaḥ suciraṃ tayā
verses.translation: After granting him the great perfect knowledge and detachment, Rudra, Paiamesvara, vanished instantaneously. That was very wonderful.
verses.hindi: ऋषिपुत्रैः पुनर्भेदाद् भिद्यन्ते दृष्टिविभ्रमैः । मन्त्रब्राह्मणविन्यासैः स्वरवर्णविपर्ययैः इतिहासपुराणानि धर्मशास्त्राणि सुव्रत ५३॥
verses.wordMeaning: After granting him the great perfect knowledge and detachment, Rudra, Paiamesvara, vanished instantaneously. That was very wonderful.
verses.commentary: Sense: After granting him the great perfect knowledge and detachment, Rudra, Paiamesvara, vanished instantaneously. That was very wonderful.

verses.sanskrit: अथोर्वशी राजवर्यं रतान्ते वाक्यमब्रवीत् । किं कृतं भवता पूर्वं पुरीं गत्वा वृथा नृप
verses.transliteration: athorvaśī rājavaryaṃ ratānte vākyamabravīt / kiṃ kṛtaṃ bhavatā pūrvaṃ purīṃ gatvā vṛthā nṛpa
verses.translation: The king also performed the Japa of Rudra with a concentrated mind. He smeared ashes over his body, performed holy ablution three times (per day). He was tranquil and had full concentration of mind.
verses.hindi: वाङ्मनःकायजेर्दुः खैनिर्वेदो जायते नृणाम् निर्वेदाज्जायते तेषां दुःखमोक्षविचारणा । विचारणाच्च वैराग्यं वैराग्याद् दोषदर्शनम्
verses.wordMeaning: The king also performed the Japa of Rudra with a concentrated mind. He smeared ashes over his body, performed holy ablution three times (per day). He was tranquil and had full concentration of mind.
verses.commentary: Sense: The king also performed the Japa of Rudra with a concentrated mind. He smeared ashes over his body, performed holy ablution three times (per day). He was tranquil and had full concentration of mind.

verses.sanskrit: स तस्यै सर्वमाचष्ट पत्न्या यत् समुदीरितम् । कण्वस्य दर्शनं चैव मालापहरणं तथा
verses.transliteration: sa tasyai sarvamācaṣṭa patnyā yat samudīritam / kaṇvasya darśanaṃ caiva mālāpaharaṇaṃ tathā
verses.translation: Whoever reads or even listens to the excellent life- story of this king, is absolved of all sins and is worshipped in the region of Brahma.
verses.hindi: बिना जोते-बोये ही विभिन्न ऋतुओंमें होनेवाले पुष्प एवं फलोंसे युक्त चौदह प्रकारके ग्राम्य एवं जंगली वृक्ष और गुल्म उत्पन्न हो गये। तदनन्तर त्रेतायुगके प्रभावसे भवितव्यतावश उन प्रजाओंमें निश्चितरूपसे सब प्रकारसे अपनी शक्तिके अनुसार बलपूर्वक नदियों, क्षेत्रों, पर्वतों, वृक्षों, गुल्मों तथा औषधियोंपर अधिकार जमाना प्रारम्भ किया। उनके विपरीत आचरणके कारण वे सभी औषधियाँ पृथ्वीमें प्रविष्ट हो गयीं। तब महाराज पृथुने
verses.wordMeaning: Whoever reads or even listens to the excellent life- story of this king, is absolved of all sins and is worshipped in the region of Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Whoever reads or even listens to the excellent life- story of this king, is absolved of all sins and is worshipped in the region of Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वैतद् व्याहृतं तेन गच्छेत्याह हितैषिणी । शापं दास्यति ते कण्वो ममापि भवतः प्रिया
verses.transliteration: śrutvaitad vyāhṛtaṃ tena gacchetyāha hitaiṣiṇī / śāpaṃ dāsyati te kaṇvo mamāpi bhavataḥ priyā
verses.translation: VV. 48b-53a quoted in Dalapatiraja's Nrsijhha-prasada Tirtha-sdra (Varanasi 1936)
verses.hindi: पितामहके आदेशसे पृथ्वीका दोहन किया ॥ ४२--४५ ॥ तदनन्तर कालके प्रभावसे वे सभी प्रजाएँ क्रोधाभिभूत होकर एक-दूसरेकी जमीन, धन, स्त्री आदिको बलपूर्वक ग्रहण करने लगे। ऐसी अव्यवस्था देखकर भगवान् ब्रह्माने मर्यादाको रक्षा करनेके लिये और ब्राह्मणोंके
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 48b-53a quoted in Dalapatiraja's Nrsijhha-prasada Tirtha-sdra (Varanasi 1936)
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 48b-53a quoted in Dalapatiraja's Nrsijhha-prasada Tirtha-sdra (Varanasi 1936)

verses.sanskrit: तयासकृन्महाराजः प्रोक्तो ऽपि मदमोहितः । न तत्यजाथ तत्पार्श्वं तत्र संन्यस्तमानसः
verses.transliteration: tayāsakṛnmahārājaḥ prokto 'pi madamohitaḥ / na tatyajātha tatpārśvaṃ tatra saṃnyastamānasaḥ
verses.translation: A very powerful son named Satyavrata was born to him. His wife Satyadhana gave birth to Hariscandra.
verses.hindi: कल्याणके लिये क्षत्रियोंकी सृष्टि की । प्रभुने त्रेतायुगमें वर्ण तथा आश्रमको व्यवस्था और पशुहिंसासे रहित यज्ञोंका प्रवर्तन किया। द्वापरमें लोगोंमें सदा मतभेद, राग, लोभ, युद्ध तथा तत्त्वोंके निश्चयका असामर्थ्य रहता है। एक ही वेद त्रेतामें चार पादोंमें विभक्त किया जाता है और द्वापर आदि युगोंमें वेदव्यासके द्वारा वही वेद चार भागोंमें बाँटा जाता है? ॥ ४६--५० ॥
verses.wordMeaning: A very powerful son named Satyavrata was born to him. His wife Satyadhana gave birth to Hariscandra.
verses.commentary: Sense: A very powerful son named Satyavrata was born to him. His wife Satyadhana gave birth to Hariscandra.

verses.sanskrit: ततोर्वशी कामरूपा राज्ञे स्वं रूपमुत्कटम् । सुरोमशं पिङ्गलाक्षं दर्शयामास सर्वदा
verses.transliteration: tatorvaśī kāmarūpā rājñe svaṃ rūpamutkaṭam / suromaśaṃ piṅgalākṣaṃ darśayāmāsa sarvadā
verses.translation: A very powerful son named Satyavrata was born to him. His wife Satyadhana gave birth to Hariscandra.
verses.hindi: ऋषिपुत्रोंने पुनः भ्रान्तदृष्ट्या मन्त्र और ब्राह्मणोंके विन्यास तथा स्वर एवं वर्णके व्यतिक्रमसे विभक्त वेदोंके पुनः विभाग किये। वैदिक ऋषियोंने कहीं-कहीं समानता, विशेषता और दृष्टि-भेदके आधारपर ऋक् , यजुः एवं साम-संज्ञक मन्त्रोंकी संहिताओंका संकलन किया। हे सुव्रत! (उन ऋषियोंने) ब्राह्मण, कल्पसूत्र, मन्त्रों, इतिहास- पुराण और धर्मशास्त्रोंका उपदेश किया है
verses.wordMeaning: A very powerful son named Satyavrata was born to him. His wife Satyadhana gave birth to Hariscandra.
verses.commentary: Sense: A very powerful son named Satyavrata was born to him. His wife Satyadhana gave birth to Hariscandra.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यां विरक्तचेतस्कः स्मृत्वा कण्वाभिभाषितम् । धिङ्मामिति विनिश्चित्यतपः कर्तुं समारभत्
verses.transliteration: tasyāṃ viraktacetaskaḥ smṛtvā kaṇvābhibhāṣitam / dhiṅmāmiti viniścityatapaḥ kartuṃ samārabhat
verses.translation: A very powerful son named Satyavrata was born to him. His wife Satyadhana gave birth to Hariscandra.
verses.hindi: वाणी तथा शरीर-सम्बन्धी दु:खोंके कारण मनुष्योंको निर्वेद उत्पन्न होता है। फिर निर्वेदके कारण उनमें दुःखसे मुक्ति पानेका विचार पैदा होता है और विचारसे वैराग्य उत्पन्न होता है तथा वैराग्यसे अपने दोष दिखलायी पड़ते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: A very powerful son named Satyavrata was born to him. His wife Satyadhana gave birth to Hariscandra.
verses.commentary: Sense: A very powerful son named Satyavrata was born to him. His wife Satyadhana gave birth to Hariscandra.

verses.sanskrit: संवत्सरद्वादशकं कन्दमूलफलाशनः । भूय एव द्वादशकं वायुभक्षो ऽभवन्नृपः
verses.transliteration: saṃvatsaradvādaśakaṃ kandamūlaphalāśanaḥ / bhūya eva dvādaśakaṃ vāyubhakṣo 'bhavannṛpaḥ
verses.translation: A very powerful son named Satyavrata was born to him. His wife Satyadhana gave birth to Hariscandra.
verses.hindi: १-सुख-सुविधाकी अधिकता भी राग आदिका कारण बनती है। २-सत्य एवं त्रेतायुगमें वेद एक ही होता है, उसके पाद चार होते हैं। द्वापर एवं कलियुगमें एक वेद चार वेदके रूपमें विभक्त हो जाता है। इन चार वेदोंकी ११३ शाखाएँ होती हैं। अध्येताओंके सामर्थ्यकी दृष्टिसे इसे व्यास कहते हैं। आद्ये कृते तु धर्मोऽस्ति स त्रेतायां प्रवर्तते । द्वापरे व्याकुलीभूत्वा प्रणश्यति कलौ युगे
verses.wordMeaning: A very powerful son named Satyavrata was born to him. His wife Satyadhana gave birth to Hariscandra.
verses.commentary: Sense: A very powerful son named Satyavrata was born to him. His wife Satyadhana gave birth to Hariscandra.

verses.sanskrit: गत्वा कण्वाश्रमं भीत्या तस्मै सर्वं न्यवेदयत् । वासमप्सरसा भूयस्तपोयोगमनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: gatvā kaṇvāśramaṃ bhītyā tasmai sarvaṃ nyavedayat / vāsamapsarasā bhūyastapoyogamanuttamam
verses.translation: A very powerful son named Satyavrata was born to him. His wife Satyadhana gave birth to Hariscandra.
verses.hindi: दोष-दर्शनके कारण द्वापरमें ज्ञान उत्पन्न होता है। द्वापरमें यह वृत्ति रजोगुण और तमोगुणसे युक्त कही गयी हैं। आद्य (सर्वप्रथम) कृतयुगमें धर्म प्रतिष्ठित था,
verses.wordMeaning: A very powerful son named Satyavrata was born to him. His wife Satyadhana gave birth to Hariscandra.
verses.commentary: Sense: A very powerful son named Satyavrata was born to him. His wife Satyadhana gave birth to Hariscandra.

verses.sanskrit: वीक्ष्य तं राजशार्दूलं प्रसन्नो भगवानृषिः । कर्तुकामो हि निर्बोजं तस्याघमिदमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: vīkṣya taṃ rājaśārdūlaṃ prasanno bhagavānṛṣiḥ / kartukāmo hi nirbojaṃ tasyāghamidamabravīt
verses.translation: A very powerful son named Satyavrata was born to him. His wife Satyadhana gave birth to Hariscandra.
verses.hindi: वह त्रेतामें भी रहता हे, द्वापरमें व्याकुल होकर वह धर्म कलियुगमें विलुप्त हो जाता है कलियुगके धर्मोका वर्णन, कलियुगमें शिव-पूजनको विशेष महिमाका ख्यापन, व्यासकृत शिवस्तुति, व्यासप्रेरित अर्जुनका शिवपुरीमें जाना और व्यासद्वारा शिवभक्त अर्जुनकी महिमा
verses.wordMeaning: A very powerful son named Satyavrata was born to him. His wife Satyadhana gave birth to Hariscandra.
verses.commentary: Sense: A very powerful son named Satyavrata was born to him. His wife Satyadhana gave birth to Hariscandra.

verses.sanskrit: गच्छ वाराणसीं दिव्यामीश्वराध्युषितां पुरीम् । आस्ते मोचयितुं लोकं तत्र देवो महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: gaccha vārāṇasīṃ divyāmīśvarādhyuṣitāṃ purīm / āste mocayituṃ lokaṃ tatra devo maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: A very powerful son named Satyavrata was born to him. His wife Satyadhana gave birth to Hariscandra.
verses.hindi: कलौ प्रमारको रोगः सततं क्षुद्भयं तथा। अनावृष्टिभयं घोरं देशानां च विपर्ययः अधार्मिका अनाचारा महाकोपाल्पचेतसः। अनृतं वदन्ति ते लुब्धास्तिष्ये जाताः सुदुः प्रजाः ३॥
verses.wordMeaning: A very powerful son named Satyavrata was born to him. His wife Satyadhana gave birth to Hariscandra.
verses.commentary: Sense: A very powerful son named Satyavrata was born to him. His wife Satyadhana gave birth to Hariscandra.

verses.sanskrit: स्नात्वा संतर्प्य विधिवद् गङ्गायान्देवताः पितॄन् । दृष्ट्वा विश्वेश्वरं लिङ्गङ्किल्बिषान्मोक्ष्यसे ऽखिलात्
verses.transliteration: snātvā saṃtarpya vidhivad gaṅgāyāndevatāḥ pitṝn / dṛṣṭvā viśveśvaraṃ liṅgaṅkilbiṣānmokṣyase 'khilāt
verses.translation: A very powerful son named Satyavrata was born to him. His wife Satyadhana gave birth to Hariscandra.
verses.hindi: विप्राणां कर्मदोषैश्व प्रजानां जायते भयम् राजानः शूद्रभूयिष्ठा ब्राह्मणान् बाधयन्ति च। भ्रूणहत्या वीरहत्या प्रजायेते नरेश्वर
verses.wordMeaning: A very powerful son named Satyavrata was born to him. His wife Satyadhana gave birth to Hariscandra.
verses.commentary: Sense: A very powerful son named Satyavrata was born to him. His wife Satyadhana gave birth to Hariscandra.

verses.sanskrit: प्रणम्य शिरसा कण्वमनुज्ञाप्य च दुर्जयः । वाराणस्यां हरं दृष्ट्वा पापान्मुक्तो ऽभवत् ततः
verses.transliteration: praṇamya śirasā kaṇvamanujñāpya ca durjayaḥ / vārāṇasyāṃ haraṃ dṛṣṭvā pāpānmukto 'bhavat tataḥ
verses.translation: A very powerful son named Satyavrata was born to him. His wife Satyadhana gave birth to Hariscandra.
verses.hindi: व्यासजीने कहा--कलियुगमें मनुष्य सदा तमोगुणसे आवृत रहते हैं, इसीलिये माया, असूया (गुणोंमें दोषदर्शन) तथा तपस्ियोंके वधमें ही लगे रहते हैं। कलियुगमें प्राणहन्ता रोग, निरन्तर भूखका कष्ट, अवर्षणका भयंकर भय तथा देशोंका उलट-फेर होता रहता है। कलियुगमें उत्पन्न हुए दुष्ट मनुष्य अधार्मिक, सदाचारसे रहित, अत्यन्त क्रोधी, दुर्बल चित्तवाले तथा लोभी होते हैं और झूठ बोलते हैं। ब्राह्मणोंके असत् उद्देश्य, असत्
verses.wordMeaning: A very powerful son named Satyavrata was born to him. His wife Satyadhana gave birth to Hariscandra.
verses.commentary: Sense: A very powerful son named Satyavrata was born to him. His wife Satyadhana gave birth to Hariscandra.

verses.sanskrit: जगाम स्वपुरीं शुभ्रां पालयामास मेदिनीम् । याजयामास तं कण्वो याचितो घृणया मुनिः
verses.transliteration: jagāma svapurīṃ śubhrāṃ pālayāmāsa medinīm / yājayāmāsa taṃ kaṇvo yācito ghṛṇayā muniḥ
verses.translation: A very powerful son named Satyavrata was born to him. His wife Satyadhana gave birth to Hariscandra.
verses.hindi: अध्ययन, दुराचार तथा दूषित शास्त्रोंके अभ्यास और बुरे कर्मके दोषसे प्रजामें भय उत्पन्न होता है। द्विजाति लोग कलियुगमें वेदोंका अध्ययन नहीं करते और न यज्ञ ही करते हैं। अल्प बुद्धिवाले (यज्ञ करनेकी योग्यतासे रहित) लोग यज्ञ करते हैं और अन्यायपूर्वक वेदोंको पढ़ते हैं॥ १--५॥
verses.wordMeaning: A very powerful son named Satyavrata was born to him. His wife Satyadhana gave birth to Hariscandra.
verses.commentary: Sense: A very powerful son named Satyavrata was born to him. His wife Satyadhana gave birth to Hariscandra.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य पुत्रो ऽथ मतिमान् सुप्रतीक इति श्रुतः । बभूव जातमात्रं तं राजानमुपतस्थिरे
verses.transliteration: tasya putro 'tha matimān supratīka iti śrutaḥ / babhūva jātamātraṃ taṃ rājānamupatasthire
verses.translation: A very powerful son named Satyavrata was born to him. His wife Satyadhana gave birth to Hariscandra.
verses.hindi: कलियुगमें शूद्रोंका ब्राह्मणोंके साथ मन्त्र, योनि, शयन, आसन और भोजनके द्वारा सम्बन्ध हो जायगा। नरेश्वर! अधिकांश राजा शूद्र होंगे, जो वस्तुतः राजा होनेके लिये अयोग्य होंगे; वे ब्राह्मणोंको पीडित करेंगे।  ब्राह्मणोंके शूद्र छोटे भाई हैं। बड़े भाईका छोटे भाईके प्रति अतिशय स्नेह होता है, अतः ब्राह्मण शूद्रोंसे स्नेहपूर्ण व्यवहार करते
verses.wordMeaning: A very powerful son named Satyavrata was born to him. His wife Satyadhana gave birth to Hariscandra.
verses.commentary: Sense: A very powerful son named Satyavrata was born to him. His wife Satyadhana gave birth to Hariscandra.

verses.sanskrit: उर्वश्यां च महावीर्याः सप्त देवसुतोपमाः । कन्या जगृहिरे सर्वा जन्धर्वदयिता द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: urvaśyāṃ ca mahāvīryāḥ sapta devasutopamāḥ / kanyā jagṛhire sarvā jandharvadayitā dvijāḥ
verses.translation: A very powerful son named Satyavrata was born to him. His wife Satyadhana gave birth to Hariscandra.
verses.hindi: ही हैं और यही अन्य युगोंमें था, पर कलिमें सत्त्वगुणकी कमी होनेसे ऐसे व्यवहारका प्राय: अभाव हो जाता है तथा अधिकार, योग्यता एवं मर्यादाका अतिक्रमण कर लोभ या भयवश ब्राह्मण मन्त्रदीक्षा, योनि (बैवाहिक सम्बन्ध) आदि करने लगते हैं। यह यथार्थतः अनुचित है ही। स्तान॑ होमं जपं दानं देवतानां तथार्चनम्। अन्यानि चैव कर्माणि न कुर्वन्ति द्विजातयः
verses.wordMeaning: A very powerful son named Satyavrata was born to him. His wife Satyadhana gave birth to Hariscandra.
verses.commentary: Sense: A very powerful son named Satyavrata was born to him. His wife Satyadhana gave birth to Hariscandra.

verses.sanskrit: एष व कथितः सम्यक् सहस्त्रजित उत्तमः । वंशः पापहरो नृणां क्रोष्टोरपि निबोधत
verses.transliteration: eṣa va kathitaḥ samyak sahastrajita uttamaḥ / vaṃśaḥ pāpaharo nṛṇāṃ kroṣṭorapi nibodhata
verses.translation: A very powerful son named Satyavrata was born to him. His wife Satyadhana gave birth to Hariscandra.
verses.hindi: विनिन्दन्ति महादेवं ब्राह्मणान् पुरुषोत्तमम्। आम्नायधर्मशास्त्राणि पुराणानि कलौ युगे कुर्वन्त्यवेददृष्टानि कर्माणि विविधानि तु। स्वधर्मेऽभिरुचिर्नेव ब्राह्मणानां प्रजायते
verses.wordMeaning: A very powerful son named Satyavrata was born to him. His wife Satyadhana gave birth to Hariscandra.
verses.commentary: Sense: A very powerful son named Satyavrata was born to him. His wife Satyadhana gave birth to Hariscandra.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे द्वाविशो ऽध्यायः सूत उवाच क्रोष्टोरेको ऽभवत् पुत्रो वृजिनीवानिति श्रुतिः । तस्य पुत्रो महान् स्वातिरुशद्गुस्तत्सुतो ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge dvāviśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca kroṣṭoreko 'bhavat putro vṛjinīvāniti śrutiḥ / tasya putro mahān svātiruśadgustatsuto 'bhavat
verses.translation: Hariscandra had a valorous son known as Rohita. Rohita's son was Vrka from whom was born Bahu.
verses.hindi: बहुयाचनको लोको भविष्यति परस्परम् अट्टशूला जनपदाः शिवशूलाश्चतुष्पथाः । प्रमदाः केशशूलिन्यो भविष्यन्ति कलौ युगे
verses.wordMeaning: Hariscandra had a valorous son known as Rohita. Rohita's son was Vrka from whom was born Bahu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hariscandra had a valorous son known as Rohita. Rohita's son was Vrka from whom was born Bahu.

verses.sanskrit: उशद्गोरभवत् पुत्रो नाम्ना चित्ररथो बली । अथ चैत्ररथिर्लोके शशबिन्दुरिति स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: uśadgorabhavat putro nāmnā citraratho balī / atha caitrarathirloke śaśabinduriti smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Harita was Rohita's son. Dhundhu was his son.. Vijaya and Sudeva were the two sons of Dhundhu.
verses.hindi: शुक्लदन्ता जिनाख्याश्च मुण्डाः काषायवाससः । शूद्रा धर्म चरिष्यन्ति युगान्ते समुपस्थिते अधर्माभिनिवेशित्वात् तमोवृत्तं कलौ स्मृतम्
verses.wordMeaning: Harita was Rohita's son. Dhundhu was his son.. Vijaya and Sudeva were the two sons of Dhundhu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Harita was Rohita's son. Dhundhu was his son.. Vijaya and Sudeva were the two sons of Dhundhu.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य पुत्रः पृथुयशा राजाभूद् धर्मतत्परः । पृथुकर्मा च तत्पुत्रस्तस्मात् पृथुजयो ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: tasya putraḥ pṛthuyaśā rājābhūd dharmatatparaḥ / pṛthukarmā ca tatputrastasmāt pṛthujayo 'bhavat
verses.translation: Vasistha of great splendour begot of the wife of Kalmasapada the son, Asmaka who became a noble scion of the Iksvaku dynasty.
verses.hindi: काषायिणोऽथ निर्ग्रन्थास्तथा कापालिकाश्च ये। वेदविक्रयिणश्चान्ये तीर्थविक्रयिणः परे ज्ञात्वा न हिंसते राजा कलौ कालबलेन तु
verses.wordMeaning: Vasistha of great splendour begot of the wife of Kalmasapada the son, Asmaka who became a noble scion of the Iksvaku dynasty.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vasistha of great splendour begot of the wife of Kalmasapada the son, Asmaka who became a noble scion of the Iksvaku dynasty.

verses.sanskrit: पृथुकीर्तिरभूत् तस्मात् पृथुदानस्ततो ऽभवत् । पृथुश्रवास्तस्य पुत्रस्तस्यासीत् पृथुसत्तमः
verses.transliteration: pṛthukīrtirabhūt tasmāt pṛthudānastato 'bhavat / pṛthuśravāstasya putrastasyāsīt pṛthusattamaḥ
verses.translation: From Raghu was born Aja and king Dasaratha was born of him. The heroic Rama, the world famous knower of Dharma, was the son of Dasaratha.
verses.hindi: सेवावसरमालोक्य द्वारि तिष्ठन्ति च द्विजाः १-पंथ-विशेष । २-अपने पुण्यको बेचनेवाले।
verses.wordMeaning: From Raghu was born Aja and king Dasaratha was born of him. The heroic Rama, the world famous knower of Dharma, was the son of Dasaratha.
verses.commentary: Sense: From Raghu was born Aja and king Dasaratha was born of him. The heroic Rama, the world famous knower of Dharma, was the son of Dasaratha.

verses.sanskrit: उशना तस्य पुत्रो ऽबूत् सितेषुस्तत्सुतो ऽभवत् । तस्याभूद् रुक्मकवचः परावृत् तस्य सत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: uśanā tasya putro 'būt siteṣustatsuto 'bhavat / tasyābhūd rukmakavacaḥ parāvṛt tasya sattamāḥ
verses.translation: Bharata, Laksmana, and Satrughna of great strength also were his sons. All of them were equal to Indra on the battle-field. They were endowed with Visnu's Sakti.
verses.hindi: (कलियुगमें) द्विजाति लोग स्नान, होम, जप, दान, करेंगे। कलियुगमें महादेव शंकर, पुरुषोत्तम विष्णु, ब्राह्मणों, वेदों, धर्मशास्त्रों और पुराणोंकी लोग निन्दा करते हैं। (सभी लोग) वेदमें अविहित अनेक प्रकारके कर्माको करते हैं तथा ब्राह्मणोंकी अपने धर्ममें रुचि नहीं
verses.wordMeaning: Bharata, Laksmana, and Satrughna of great strength also were his sons. All of them were equal to Indra on the battle-field. They were endowed with Visnu's Sakti.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bharata, Laksmana, and Satrughna of great strength also were his sons. All of them were equal to Indra on the battle-field. They were endowed with Visnu's Sakti.

verses.sanskrit: परावृतः सुतो जज्ञे ज्यामघो लोकविश्रुतः । तस्माद् विदर्भः संजज्ञे विदर्भात् क्रथकैशिकौ
verses.transliteration: parāvṛtaḥ suto jajñe jyāmagho lokaviśrutaḥ / tasmād vidarbhaḥ saṃjajñe vidarbhāt krathakaiśikau
verses.translation: Visnu, the enjoyer of the whole universe, was born with a part of his personality for the destruction of Ravana. The blessed wife of Rama was the beautiful daughter of Janaka.
verses.hindi: लोग कुत्सित आचारवाले एवं व्यर्थके पाखण्डोंसे युक्त हो जायेगे और संसार परस्परमें बहुत याचना करनेवाला हो जायगा। कलियुगमें जनपद अन्नविक्रयी, चौराहे वेदके विक्रयस्थल तथा स्त्रियाँ वेश्यावृत्तिवाली हो जायँगी । युगका अन्त आनेपर सफेद दाँतोंबाले, जिन नामवाले, मुण्डित, काषायवस्त्रधारी शूद्र पर- धर्माचरण करने लगेंगे। (लोग) अनाज और वसस्त्रकी चोरी करनेवाले होंगे। चोर लोग चोरोंकी ही चोरी करेंगे और
verses.wordMeaning: Visnu, the enjoyer of the whole universe, was born with a part of his personality for the destruction of Ravana. The blessed wife of Rama was the beautiful daughter of Janaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Visnu, the enjoyer of the whole universe, was born with a part of his personality for the destruction of Ravana. The blessed wife of Rama was the beautiful daughter of Janaka.

verses.sanskrit: रोमपादस्तृतीयस्तु बभ्रुस्तस्यात्मजो नृपः । धृतिस्तस्याभवत् पुत्रः संस्तस्तस्याप्यभूत् सुतः
verses.transliteration: romapādastṛtīyastu babhrustasyātmajo nṛpaḥ / dhṛtistasyābhavat putraḥ saṃstastasyāpyabhūt sutaḥ
verses.translation: After being crowned by Bharata, the powerful and highly splendoured Rama duly honoured the Brahmanas and worshipped Isvara.
verses.hindi: दूसरे चोर उस चोरका चुरायेंगे। दुःखको अधिकता होगी, अल्प आयु होगी, देहमें आलस्य तथा रोग रहेगा। अधर्ममें विशेष प्रवृत्तिके कारण कलियुगमें सभी व्यवहार तामस होंगे॥ ११--१५॥ कुछ लोग काषायवस्त्र धारण करनेवाले, कुछ निर्ग्रन्थ (यज्ञोपवीत, शिखा आदिसे विहीन पंथवाले), कापालिक, वेदविक्रयी तथा कुछ लोग तीर्थविक्रयी? हो जायेंगे। (कलियुगमें) राजाका संरक्षण प्राप्तकर
verses.wordMeaning: After being crowned by Bharata, the powerful and highly splendoured Rama duly honoured the Brahmanas and worshipped Isvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: After being crowned by Bharata, the powerful and highly splendoured Rama duly honoured the Brahmanas and worshipped Isvara.

verses.sanskrit: संस्तस्य पुत्रो बलवान् नाम्ना विश्वसहस्तु सः । तस्य पुत्रो महावीर्यः प्रजावान् कौशिकस्ततः । अभूत् तस्य सुतो धीमान् सुमन्तुस्तत्सुतो ऽनलः
verses.transliteration: saṃstasya putro balavān nāmnā viśvasahastu saḥ / tasya putro mahāvīryaḥ prajāvān kauśikastataḥ / abhūt tasya suto dhīmān sumantustatsuto 'nalaḥ
verses.translation: He worshipped god Sankara the destroyer of Daksa's Tajna, by performing a horse-sacrifice. Rama begot a son who was well-known by the name Kusa.
verses.hindi: अल्पबुद्धिवाले शूद्र आसनपर स्थित द्विजोंको देखकर नहीं चलते (द्विजोचित व्यवहार नहीं करते) तथा श्रेष्ठ द्विजोंको प्रताडित करते है । परंतप! कलियुगमें समयके प्रभावसे द्विजोंके मध्यमें शूद्र उच्च आसनपर बैठते हैं, किंतु राजा जानकर भी उन्हें दण्ड नहीं देता। अल्प ज्ञान, अल्प भाग्य तथा अल्प बलवाले द्विज लोग पुष्पोंके द्वारा, मनोविनोदके साधन 'हास' आदिसे तथा अन्य माङ्गलिक पदार्थोंसे शूद्रोंकी पूजा करते हैं? । राजन्! शूद्र
verses.wordMeaning: He worshipped god Sankara the destroyer of Daksa's Tajna, by performing a horse-sacrifice. Rama begot a son who was well-known by the name Kusa.
verses.commentary: Sense: He worshipped god Sankara the destroyer of Daksa's Tajna, by performing a horse-sacrifice. Rama begot a son who was well-known by the name Kusa.

verses.sanskrit: कैशिकस्य सुतश्चेदिश्चैद्यास्तस्याभवन् सुताः । तेषां प्रधानो ज्योतिष्मान् वपुष्मांस्तत्सुतो ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: kaiśikasya sutaścediścaidyāstasyābhavan sutāḥ / teṣāṃ pradhāno jyotiṣmān vapuṣmāṃstatsuto 'bhavat
verses.translation: Lava also, the highly fortunate and intelligent one knowing all principles and topics, was his son. Atithi was born of Kusa and Nisadha was his son.
verses.hindi: लोग पूजित श्रेष्ठ द्विजोंकी ओर देखतेतक नहीं और द्विज सेवाके अवसरको प्रतीक्षा करते हुए उनके दरवाजेपर खड़े रहते हैं ३-यदि कोई बड़ा लोभ या भयबश अपनेसे छोटेकी पूजा या अमर्यादित ढंगसे चापलूसी करे तो यह उचित नहीं है, निषिद्ध है।
verses.wordMeaning: Lava also, the highly fortunate and intelligent one knowing all principles and topics, was his son. Atithi was born of Kusa and Nisadha was his son.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lava also, the highly fortunate and intelligent one knowing all principles and topics, was his son. Atithi was born of Kusa and Nisadha was his son.

verses.sanskrit: वपुष्मतो बृहन्मेधा श्रीदेवस्तत्सुतो ऽभवत् । तस्य वीतरथो विप्रा रुद्रभक्तो महाबलः
verses.transliteration: vapuṣmato bṛhanmedhā śrīdevastatsuto 'bhavat / tasya vītaratho viprā rudrabhakto mahābalaḥ
verses.translation: Nala was the son of Nisadha. Nabhas was born of him. Pundarikaksa was born of Nabhas and Ksemadhanvan was his son.
verses.hindi: सेवन्ते ब्राह्मणास्तत्र स्तुवन्ति स्तुतिभिः कलौ पठन्ति वैदिकान् मन्त्रान् नास्तिक्यं घोरमाश्रिताः
verses.wordMeaning: Nala was the son of Nisadha. Nabhas was born of him. Pundarikaksa was born of Nabhas and Ksemadhanvan was his son.
verses.commentary: Sense: Nala was the son of Nisadha. Nabhas was born of him. Pundarikaksa was born of Nabhas and Ksemadhanvan was his son.

verses.sanskrit: क्रथस्याप्यभवत् कुन्ती वृष्णी तस्याभवत् सुतः । वृष्णेर्निवृत्तिरुत्पन्नो दशार्हस्तस्य तु द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: krathasyāpyabhavat kuntī vṛṣṇī tasyābhavat sutaḥ / vṛṣṇernivṛttirutpanno daśārhastasya tu dvijāḥ
verses.translation: His son was the heroic Devanika of great valour. Ahinagu was his son and had Mahasvan as his son.
verses.hindi: तपोयज्ञफलानां च विक्रेतारो द्विजोत्तमाः। यतयश्च भविष्यन्ति शतशोऽथ सहस्त्रशः गायन्ति लौकिकेगनिर्देबतानि नराधिप
verses.wordMeaning: His son was the heroic Devanika of great valour. Ahinagu was his son and had Mahasvan as his son.
verses.commentary: Sense: His son was the heroic Devanika of great valour. Ahinagu was his son and had Mahasvan as his son.

verses.sanskrit: दशार्हपुत्रोप्यारोहो जीमूतस्तत्सुतो ऽभवत् । जैमूतिरभवद् वीरो विकृतिः परवीरहा
verses.transliteration: daśārhaputropyāroho jīmūtastatsuto 'bhavat / jaimūtirabhavad vīro vikṛtiḥ paravīrahā
verses.translation: From him was born Gandravaloka. Taradhisa was his son. Gandragiri was born of Taradhisa. Then was born Bhanuvitta.
verses.hindi: वामपाशुपताचारास्तथा वै पाञ्चरात्रिकाः। भविष्यन्ति कलौ तस्मिन् ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रियास्तथा ज्ञानकर्मण्युपरते लोके निष्क्रियतां गते। कीटमूषकसर्पाश्च धर्षयिष्यन्ति मानवान्
verses.wordMeaning: From him was born Gandravaloka. Taradhisa was his son. Gandragiri was born of Taradhisa. Then was born Bhanuvitta.
verses.commentary: Sense: From him was born Gandravaloka. Taradhisa was his son. Gandragiri was born of Taradhisa. Then was born Bhanuvitta.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य भीमरथः पुत्रः तस्मान्नवरथो ऽभवत् । दानधर्मरतो नित्यं सम्यक्शीलपरायणः
verses.transliteration: tasya bhīmarathaḥ putraḥ tasmānnavaratho 'bhavat / dānadharmarato nityaṃ samyakśīlaparāyaṇaḥ
verses.translation: Srutayu was born of him. These are the descendants born in the race of Iksvaku. O excellent Brahmanas the im¬ portant ones have been narrated in brief.
verses.hindi: निन्दन्ति च महादेवं तमसाविष्टचेतसः। वृथा धर्म चरिष्यन्ति कलौ तस्मिन् युगान्तिके कलियुगमें शूद्रसे जीविका पानेवाले ब्राह्मण वाहनमें स्थित शूद्रोंको घेरकर स्तुतियोंद्वारा उनकी प्रशंसा करते हैं और सेवा करते हैं। शूद्रोंसे जीविका प्राप्त करनेवाले (ब्राह्मण) शूद्रोंको वेद, पढ़ाते हैं। घोर नास्तिकतावादी
verses.wordMeaning: Srutayu was born of him. These are the descendants born in the race of Iksvaku. O excellent Brahmanas the im¬ portant ones have been narrated in brief.
verses.commentary: Sense: Srutayu was born of him. These are the descendants born in the race of Iksvaku. O excellent Brahmanas the im¬ portant ones have been narrated in brief.

verses.sanskrit: कदाचिन्मृगयां यातो दृष्ट्वा राक्षसमूर्जितम् । दुद्राव महातविष्टो भयेन मुनिपुङ्गवाः
verses.transliteration: kadācinmṛgayāṃ yāto dṛṣṭvā rākṣasamūrjitam / dudrāva mahātaviṣṭo bhayena munipuṅgavāḥ
verses.translation: He who listens to this excellent race of Iksvaku everyday shall be freed from all sins. He is honoured in the heavenly region.
verses.hindi: (शूद्र) वैदिक मन्त्रोंको पढ़ते हैं। जिनकी श्रेष्ठ द्विजके रूपमें समाजमें मान्यता होती है, वे लोग (अपने) तप एवं यज्ञके फलोंका विक्रय करनेवाले होते हैं। (आलस्य या प्रतिष्ठाके लिये) सैकड़ों एवं हजारोंकी संख्यामें लोग संन्यासी हो जायँगे। है निष्पाप राजन्! (कलियुगमें लोग) पढे हुएको भूल जाते हैं, अध्ययनके फल ज्ञानके लिये उत्सुक नहीं रहते। (वे) लौकिक गीतोंसे देवताओंकी स्तुति करते हैं॥२१--२४॥
verses.wordMeaning: He who listens to this excellent race of Iksvaku everyday shall be freed from all sins. He is honoured in the heavenly region.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who listens to this excellent race of Iksvaku everyday shall be freed from all sins. He is honoured in the heavenly region.

verses.sanskrit: अन्वधावत संक्रुद्धो राक्षसस्तं महाबलः । दुर्योधनो ऽग्निसंकाशः शूलासक्तमहाकरः
verses.transliteration: anvadhāvata saṃkruddho rākṣasastaṃ mahābalaḥ / duryodhano 'gnisaṃkāśaḥ śūlāsaktamahākaraḥ
verses.translation: Quoted in Nitydcarapaddhatiy p.,47. This discussion shows the tolerant attitude and an attempt to amalgamate the Vedic and Puranic deities. The evolution of Hinduism from Vedism becomes clear through such passages which show a transition towards all-comprehensive Puranic re igion.
verses.hindi: कलियुगमें ब्राह्मण तथा क्षत्रिय वाममार्गी, पाशुपताचारी तथा पाञ्चरात्रिक हो जायँगे। ज्ञान तथा कर्मका लोप हो जाने और लोगोंके निष्क्रिय हो जानेपर कीड़े, चूहे तथा सर्प लोगोंको कष्ट पहुँचायेंगे। प्राचीन कालमें दक्ष प्रजापतिके यज्ञमें दधीचके शापसे दग्ध हुए द्विज ब्राह्मणोंके कुलमें उत्पन्न होंगे। कलियुगके अन्त समयमें तमोगुणसे व्याप्त मनवाले लोग महादेवको निन्दा करेंगे और व्यर्थके धर्मो (धर्माभासों)-का आचरण
verses.wordMeaning: Quoted in Nitydcarapaddhatiy p.,47. This discussion shows the tolerant attitude and an attempt to amalgamate the Vedic and Puranic deities.…
