verses.commentary: Sense: Quoted in Nitydcarapaddhatiy p.,47. This discussion shows the tolerant attitude and an attempt to amalgamate the Vedic and Puranic deities.…

verses.sanskrit: राजा नवरथो भीत्या नातिदूरादनुत्तमम् । अपश्यत् परमं स्थानं सरस्वत्या सुगोपितम्
verses.transliteration: rājā navaratho bhītyā nātidūrādanuttamam / apaśyat paramaṃ sthānaṃ sarasvatyā sugopitam
verses.translation: This was in recognition of the goodness of Puru in transferring his youth when his father Yayati became prematurely decrepit due to the curse of Sukra. It was after enjoying life for one thousand years from the borrowed youth of his son Puru, that Yayati is credited to have uttered the famous verse:
verses.hindi: करेंगे तथा जो दूसरे महात्मा गौतमके शापसे दग्ध हुए लोग थे, वे सभी ब्राह्मण आदि अपनी-अपनी जातियोंमें उत्पन्न होंगे १-शूद्र चौथे वर्णका नाम हैं। शूद्र शब्दसे किसी हीनभावको समझना कथमपि शास्त्रसम्मत नहीं है। अपने छोटे भाईके
verses.wordMeaning: This was in recognition of the goodness of Puru in transferring his youth when his father Yayati became prematurely decrepit due to the curse of Sukra. It was after enjoying life for one thousand years from the borrowed youth of his son Puru,…
verses.commentary: Sense: This was in recognition of the goodness of Puru in transferring his youth when his father Yayati became prematurely decrepit due to the curse of Sukra. It was after enjoying life for one thousand years from the borrowed youth of his son Puru,…

verses.sanskrit: स तद्वेगेन महता संप्राप्य मतिमान् नृपः । ववन्दे शिरसा दृष्ट्वा साक्षाद् देवीं सरस्वतीम्
verses.transliteration: sa tadvegena mahatā saṃprāpya matimān nṛpaḥ / vavande śirasā dṛṣṭvā sākṣād devīṃ sarasvatīm
verses.translation: We have heard the report that five heroic sons of great prowess were born to Ayus from Prabha, the daughter of Svarbhanu.
verses.hindi: प्रति हीनभाव अपनाना सर्वथा अनुचित है। वेदोंके अध्ययनसे विरत रहनेके लिये शूट्रोंको आदेश अवश्य दिया गया है, पर इसके मूलमें उनके प्रति कल्याणको भावना ही निहित है। यह वास्तविकता है कि समग्र वेदोंका यथावत् अध्ययन करनेपर ही उनके द्वारा वह ज्ञान प्राप्त किया जा सकता है, जो अधूरा न होकर परिपूर्ण होता है तथा सही अर्थमें कल्याणका साधन बनता है। जिन मनीषियोंने समग्र वेदोंका आकलन किया है, उन लोगोंने निरपेक्ष-भावसे यह भलीभाँति समझा है तथा परीक्षापूर्वक अनुभव किया है कि समग्र वेदोंका अध्ययन तीव्रतम तप एवं कठोरतम परिश्रम (सुदीर्धकालिक)-के बिना कथमपि सम्भव नहीं है और यह सुदीर्घकालिक तीव्रतम तप एवं कठोरतम परिश्रम प्रिय अनुज (छोटे भाई) शूद्र एवं अति कोमल प्रकृतिवाली स्त्रियाँ कथमपि नहीं कर सकतीं। अतएव विशेषकर इन्हींके कल्याणके लिये महाभारत तथा अन्यान्य पुराण आदि ग्रन्थोंका आविर्भाव हुआ। इन ग्रन्थॉमें सरल एवं रोचक पद्धतिसे वे ही ज्ञान-विज्ञान वर्णित हैं, जो वेदोंमें वर्णित हैं। योग्यता, अधिकार
verses.wordMeaning: We have heard the report that five heroic sons of great prowess were born to Ayus from Prabha, the daughter of Svarbhanu.
verses.commentary: Sense: We have heard the report that five heroic sons of great prowess were born to Ayus from Prabha, the daughter of Svarbhanu.

verses.sanskrit: तुष्टाव वाग्भिरिष्टाभिर्बद्धाञ्जलिरमित्रजित् । पपात दण्डवद् भूमौ त्वामहं शरणं गतः
verses.transliteration: tuṣṭāva vāgbhiriṣṭābhirbaddhāñjaliramitrajit / papāta daṇḍavad bhūmau tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ
verses.translation: Among those five, Yayati was the strongest and most valiant. He married DevayanI, the daughter of Usanas (Sukra).
verses.hindi: एवं अध्ययनके विधानके अनुसार इन (महाभारत आदि)-को अपनी अपेक्षाके अनुकूल जान-समझकर करनेसे कल्याण अवश्य ही प्राप्त होता है, जो वेदोंके समग्र अध्ययनसे प्राप्त होता है। इससे स्पष्ट है कि ज्ञानरूप फलकी दृष्टिसे मानव क्या प्राणिमात्र अपनी सामर्थ्यके अनुसार समान हैं। अतः वेदोंको पढ्नेके विषयमें जो शास्त्रीय व्यवस्था है, उसके प्रति अन्यथा-दृष्टि अपनाना EF २-यहाँ वाममार्ग आदिकी निन्दामें तात्पर्य नहीं है। वैदिक मार्गको स्तुतिमें तात्पर्य है। शुद्ध सात्त्विक भावकी प्रमुखता वैदिक मार्गमें है, अत: वैदिक मार्ग प्रशस्ततम है । वाममार्ग आदिमें तो तामस-भाव एवं राजस-भावकी प्रमुखता है। अतः ये प्रशस्त
verses.wordMeaning: Among those five, Yayati was the strongest and most valiant. He married DevayanI, the daughter of Usanas (Sukra).
verses.commentary: Sense: Among those five, Yayati was the strongest and most valiant. He married DevayanI, the daughter of Usanas (Sukra).

verses.sanskrit: नमस्यामि महादेवीं साक्षाद् देवीं सरस्वतीम् । वाग्देवतामनाद्यन्तामीश्वरीं ब्रह्मचारिणीम्
verses.transliteration: namasyāmi mahādevīṃ sākṣād devīṃ sarasvatīm / vāgdevatāmanādyantāmīśvarīṃ brahmacāriṇīm
verses.translation: He married Sarmistha also, the Asura lady, the daughter of Vrsaparvan. DevayanI gave birth to Yadu and Turvasu.
verses.hindi: विनिन्दन्ति हषीकेशं ब्राह्मणान् ब्रह्मवादिनः । वेदबाह्याव्रताचारा दुराचारा वृथाश्रमाः तमसाविष्टमनसो वैडालवृत्तिकाधमाः
verses.wordMeaning: He married Sarmistha also, the Asura lady, the daughter of Vrsaparvan. DevayanI gave birth to Yadu and Turvasu.
verses.commentary: Sense: He married Sarmistha also, the Asura lady, the daughter of Vrsaparvan. DevayanI gave birth to Yadu and Turvasu.

verses.sanskrit: नमस्ये जगतां योनिं योगिनीं परमां कलाम् । हिरण्यगर्भमहिषीं त्रिनेत्रां चन्द्रशेखराम्
verses.transliteration: namasye jagatāṃ yoniṃ yoginīṃ paramāṃ kalām / hiraṇyagarbhamahiṣīṃ trinetrāṃ candraśekharām
verses.translation: The king entrusted the South-western territory to the care of the eldest son Yadu. He appointed Druhyu and Anu tn rule over the western and northern territories respectively.
verses.hindi: कलौ रुद्रो महादेवो लोकानामीश्वरः पर: । न देवता भवेन्नृणां देवतानां च हैवतम् करिष्यत्यवताराणि शंकरो नीललोहितः । श्रौतस्मार्तप्रतिष्ठार्थं भक्तानां हितकाम्यया
verses.wordMeaning: The king entrusted the South-western territory to the care of the eldest son Yadu. He appointed Druhyu and Anu tn rule over the western and northern territories respectively.
verses.commentary: Sense: The king entrusted the South-western territory to the care of the eldest son Yadu. He appointed Druhyu and Anu tn rule over the western and northern territories respectively.

verses.sanskrit: नमस्ये परमानन्दां चित्कलां ब्रह्मरूपिणीम् । पाहि मां परमेशानि भीतं शरणमागतम्
verses.transliteration: namasye paramānandāṃ citkalāṃ brahmarūpiṇīm / pāhi māṃ parameśāni bhītaṃ śaraṇamāgatam
verses.translation: The whole of this Earth was righteously ruled by them. The king of great fame, thereafter, went to the forest accompanied by his wife.
verses.hindi: उपदेक्ष्यति तज्ज्ञानं शिष्याणां ब्रह्मसंज्ञितम्। सर्ववेदान्तसारं हि धर्मान् वेदनिदर्शितान् ये तं विप्रा निषेवन्ते येन केनोपचारतः। विजित्य कलिजान् दोषान् यान्ति ते परमं पदम्
verses.wordMeaning: The whole of this Earth was righteously ruled by them. The king of great fame, thereafter, went to the forest accompanied by his wife.
verses.commentary: Sense: The whole of this Earth was righteously ruled by them. The king of great fame, thereafter, went to the forest accompanied by his wife.

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे क्रुद्धो राजानं राक्षसेश्वरः । हन्तुं समागतः स्थानं यत्र देवी सरस्वती
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare kruddho rājānaṃ rākṣaseśvaraḥ / hantuṃ samāgataḥ sthānaṃ yatra devī sarasvatī
verses.translation: Yadu too had five sons comparable to the sons of Devas. They were Sahasrajit, the most excellent Krostii, Nila, Jina and Raghu.
verses.hindi: अनायासेन सुमहत् पुण्यमाप्नोति मानवः । अनेकदोषदुष्टस्य कलेरेष महान् गुणः यथा रुद्रनमस्कारः सर्वकर्मफलो ध्रुवम् । अन्यदेवनमस्कारान्न तत्फलमवाप्नुयात्
verses.wordMeaning: Yadu too had five sons comparable to the sons of Devas. They were Sahasrajit, the most excellent Krostii, Nila, Jina and Raghu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Yadu too had five sons comparable to the sons of Devas. They were Sahasrajit, the most excellent Krostii, Nila, Jina and Raghu.

verses.sanskrit: समुद्यम्य तदा शूलं प्रवेष्टुं बलदर्पितः । त्रिलोकमातुस्तत्स्थानं शशाङ्कादित्यसंन्निभम्
verses.transliteration: samudyamya tadā śūlaṃ praveṣṭuṃ baladarpitaḥ / trilokamātustatsthānaṃ śaśāṅkādityasaṃnnibham
verses.translation: The son of Sahasrajit was the king Satajit. Satajit too had three highly virtuous sons.
verses.hindi: महादेवनमस्कारो ध्यानं दानमिति श्रुतिः तस्मादनीश्वरानन्यान् त्यक्त्वा देवं महेश्वरम्। समाश्रयेद् विरूपाक्षं यदीच्छेत् परमं पदम्
verses.wordMeaning: The son of Sahasrajit was the king Satajit. Satajit too had three highly virtuous sons.
verses.commentary: Sense: The son of Sahasrajit was the king Satajit. Satajit too had three highly virtuous sons.

verses.sanskrit: तदन्तरे महद् भूतं युगान्तादित्यसन्निभम् । शूलेनोरसि निर्भिद्य पातयामास तं भुवि
verses.transliteration: tadantare mahad bhūtaṃ yugāntādityasannibham / śūlenorasi nirbhidya pātayāmāsa taṃ bhuvi
verses.translation: They were Haihaya, Haya, and the King Venuhaya. Haihaya had a son who became well-known as Dharma.
verses.hindi: नार्चयन्तीह ये रुद्रं शिवं त्रिदशवन्दितम्। तेषां दानं तपो यज्ञो वृथा जीवितमेव च नमो रुद्राय महते देवदेवाय शूलिने। त्र्यम्बकाय त्रिनेत्राय योगिनां गुरवे नम:
verses.wordMeaning: They were Haihaya, Haya, and the King Venuhaya. Haihaya had a son who became well-known as Dharma.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were Haihaya, Haya, and the King Venuhaya. Haihaya had a son who became well-known as Dharma.

verses.sanskrit: गच्छेत्याह महाराज न स्थातव्यं त्वया पुनः । इदानीं निर्भयस्तूर्णं स्थाने ऽस्मिन् राक्षसो हतः
verses.transliteration: gacchetyāha mahārāja na sthātavyaṃ tvayā punaḥ / idānīṃ nirbhayastūrṇaṃ sthāne 'smin rākṣaso hataḥ
verses.translation: O Brahmanas, his son was Dharmanetra the valor¬ ous. Dharmanetra's son was Kirti and Sanjita was his son.
verses.hindi: वेदोंमे निषिद्ध व्रत और आचारका पालन करनेवाले, दुराचारी तथा व्यर्थका श्रम (धर्म-मोक्षविरोधी अर्थमात्र साधक काम अथवा दुर्जनतावश लोगोंको पीड़ा देनेवाले काम) करनेवाले लोग हृषीकेश (श्रीविष्णु) तथा ब्रह्मवादी ब्राह्मणोंकी निन्दा करेंगे
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas, his son was Dharmanetra the valor¬ ous. Dharmanetra's son was Kirti and Sanjita was his son.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas, his son was Dharmanetra the valor¬ ous. Dharmanetra's son was Kirti and Sanjita was his son.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रणम्य हृष्टात्मा राजा नवरथः पराम् । पुरीं जगाम विप्रेन्द्राः पुरन्दरपुरोपमाम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ praṇamya hṛṣṭātmā rājā navarathaḥ parām / purīṃ jagāma viprendrāḥ purandarapuropamām
verses.translation: Mahisma was the son of Sanjita whose descendant son was Bhadrasrenya. Bhadrasrenya's successor was the king called Durdama.
verses.hindi: तमोगुणसे आविष्ट मनवाले तथा दिखावटी धर्माचरण करनेवाले अधम लोग अनेक प्रलोभनोंको दिखाकर सब लोगोंको मोहित करेंगे। कलियुगमें लोकोंके ईश्वर, देव (आराध्य) नहीं रहेंगे, पर भक्तोंक कल्याणकी कामनासे तथा श्रौत एवं स्मार्त धर्मकी प्रतिष्ठाके लिये नीललोहित शंकर अनेक अवतार धारण करेंगे। वे समस्त वेदान्तके साररूप उस ब्रह्मसंज्ञक ज्ञानको और वेदमें बताये गये
verses.wordMeaning: Mahisma was the son of Sanjita whose descendant son was Bhadrasrenya. Bhadrasrenya's successor was the king called Durdama.
verses.commentary: Sense: Mahisma was the son of Sanjita whose descendant son was Bhadrasrenya. Bhadrasrenya's successor was the king called Durdama.

verses.sanskrit: स्थापयामास देवेशीं तत्र भक्तिसमन्वितः । ईजे च विविधैर्यज्ञैर्हेमैर्देवीं सरस्वतीम्
verses.transliteration: sthāpayāmāsa deveśīṃ tatra bhaktisamanvitaḥ / īje ca vividhairyajñairhemairdevīṃ sarasvatīm
verses.translation: Durdama's son was the intelligent and valiant king named Andhaka. Andhaka's four successors were highly res¬ pected by the public.
verses.hindi: धर्मोको शिष्योंको प्रदान करेंगे। जो ब्राह्मण जिस-किसी भी उपायसे उन (शंकर)-की सेवा करेंगे, वे कलिके दोषोंको जीतकर परमपदको प्राप्त करेंगे॥ ३१--३५ ॥ अनेक दोषोंसे दूषित कलिका यह महान् गुण है कि इसके युगमें मनुष्य अनायास महान् पुण्य प्राप्त कर लेता है। इसलिये महेश्वर-सम्बन्धी युग प्राप्तकर विशेषरूपसे ब्राह्मणोंको सभी प्रकारके प्रयत्रोंसे ईशान रुद्रकी शरण
verses.wordMeaning: Durdama's son was the intelligent and valiant king named Andhaka. Andhaka's four successors were highly res¬ pected by the public.
verses.commentary: Sense: Durdama's son was the intelligent and valiant king named Andhaka. Andhaka's four successors were highly res¬ pected by the public.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य चासीद् दशरथः पुत्रः परमधार्मिकः । देव्या भक्तो महातेजाः शकुनिस्तस्य चात्मजः
verses.transliteration: tasya cāsīd daśarathaḥ putraḥ paramadhārmikaḥ / devyā bhakto mahātejāḥ śakunistasya cātmajaḥ
verses.translation: He had hundreds of sons. But five of them were great heroes. They were well-versed in the use of miraculous missiles, heroic, strong, virtuous and learned.
verses.hindi: ग्रहण करनी चाहिए। जो प्रसन्नर-मनसे विरूपाक्ष, कृत्तिवासा, ईशान रुद्रको नमस्कार करते हैं, वे परमपदको प्राप्त करते हैं। जिस प्रकार रुद्रको किया गया नमस्कार निश्चितरूपसे सभी कामनाओंको पूर्ण करता है, उस प्रकार अन्य देवोंको नमस्कार करनेसे वैसा फल नहीं होता। इस प्रकारके कलियुगमें दोषोंको दूर करनेका एकमात्र उपाय है महादेवको नमस्कार, उनका ध्यान और शास्त्रानुसार दान-एऐसा वेदका मत है॥ ३६--४० ॥
verses.wordMeaning: He had hundreds of sons. But five of them were great heroes. They were well-versed in the use of miraculous missiles, heroic, strong, virtuous and learned.
verses.commentary: Sense: He had hundreds of sons. But five of them were great heroes. They were well-versed in the use of miraculous missiles, heroic, strong, virtuous and learned.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् करम्भः संभूतो देवरातो ऽभवत् ततः । ईजे स चाश्वमेधेन देवक्षत्रश्च तत्सुतः
verses.transliteration: tasmāt karambhaḥ saṃbhūto devarāto 'bhavat tataḥ / īje sa cāśvamedhena devakṣatraśca tatsutaḥ
verses.translation: They were Sura, Surasena, Krsna and Dhrsna, as well as Jayadhvaja, the powerful king who was devoted to Narayana.
verses.hindi: इसलिये यदि परमपद प्राप्त करनेकी इच्छा हो तो अन्य अनीश्वरो (महेश्वरकी कृपासे ही शक्ति प्राप्त करनेवाले अन्य देवों)-को छोड़कर एकमात्र देव विरूपाक्ष महेश्वरका आश्रय ग्रहण करना चाहिए। जो हैं, उनका किया हुआ दान, तप, यज्ञ और जीवन व्यर्थ ही होता है
verses.wordMeaning: They were Sura, Surasena, Krsna and Dhrsna, as well as Jayadhvaja, the powerful king who was devoted to Narayana.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were Sura, Surasena, Krsna and Dhrsna, as well as Jayadhvaja, the powerful king who was devoted to Narayana.

verses.sanskrit: मधुस्तस्य तु दायादस्तस्मात् कुरुवशो ऽभवत् । पुत्रद्वयमभूत् तस्य सुत्रामा चानुरेव च
verses.transliteration: madhustasya tu dāyādastasmāt kuruvaśo 'bhavat / putradvayamabhūt tasya sutrāmā cānureva ca
verses.translation: The first four sons viz. Sura and others were well- known for their prowess. They were noble souls, devoted to Rudra, used to worship god Sankara.
verses.hindi: त्रिशूल धारण करनेवाले देवाधिदेव महान् रुद्रको नमस्कार है। त्र्यम्बक, त्रिलोचन, योगियोंके गुरुके लिये नमस्कार है नमोऽस्तु वामदेवाय महादेवाय वेधसे। शम्भवे स्थाणवे नित्यं शिवाय परमेष्ठिने। नमः सोमाय रुद्राय महाग्रासाय हेतवे
verses.wordMeaning: The first four sons viz. Sura and others were well- known for their prowess. They were noble souls, devoted to Rudra, used to worship god Sankara.
verses.commentary: Sense: The first four sons viz. Sura and others were well- known for their prowess. They were noble souls, devoted to Rudra, used to worship god Sankara.

verses.sanskrit: अनोस्तु पुरुकुत्सो ऽभूदंशुस्तस्य च रिक्थभाक् । अथांशोः सत्त्वतो नाम विष्णुभक्तः प्रतापवान् । महात्मा दाननिरतो धनुर्वेदविदां वरः
verses.transliteration: anostu purukutso 'bhūdaṃśustasya ca rikthabhāk / athāṃśoḥ sattvato nāma viṣṇubhaktaḥ pratāpavān / mahātmā dānanirato dhanurvedavidāṃ varaḥ
verses.translation: Jayadhvaja was intelligent and devoted to religion. He sought shelter under Narayana, Visnu, Hari.
verses.hindi: प्रपद्योऽहं विरूपाक्षं शरण्यं ब्रह्मचारिणम्। महादेवं महायोगमीशानं चाम्बिकापतिम् संसारतारणं रुद्रं ब्रह्माणं ब्रह्मणोऽधिपम्। शाश्वतं सर्वगं शान्तं ब्रह्मण्यं ब्राह्मणप्रियम्
verses.wordMeaning: Jayadhvaja was intelligent and devoted to religion. He sought shelter under Narayana, Visnu, Hari.
verses.commentary: Sense: Jayadhvaja was intelligent and devoted to religion. He sought shelter under Narayana, Visnu, Hari.

verses.sanskrit: स नारदस्य वचनाद् वासुदेवार्चनान्वितम् । शास्त्रं प्रवर्तयामास कुण्डगोलादिभिः श्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: sa nāradasya vacanād vāsudevārcanānvitam / śāstraṃ pravartayāmāsa kuṇḍagolādibhiḥ śrutam
verses.translation: The other sons told him—"O sinless one, this is not your Dharma as it is well-known that our father was engaged in the propitiation of Isvara (Siva)."
verses.hindi: कपर्दिनं कालमूर्तिममूर्ति परमेश्वरम्। एकमूर्ति महामूर्ति वेदवेद्यं दिवस्पतिम् कालाग्निं कालदहनं कामदं कामनाशनम्
verses.wordMeaning: The other sons told him—"O sinless one, this is not your Dharma as it is well-known that our father was engaged in the propitiation of Isvara (Siva)."
verses.commentary: Sense: The other sons told him—"O sinless one, this is not your Dharma as it is well-known that our father was engaged in the propitiation of Isvara (Siva)."

verses.sanskrit: तस्य नाम्ना तु विख्यातं सात्त्वतं नाम शोभनम् । प्रवर्तते महाशास्त्रं कुण्डादीनां हितावहम्
verses.transliteration: tasya nāmnā tu vikhyātaṃ sāttvataṃ nāma śobhanam / pravartate mahāśāstraṃ kuṇḍādīnāṃ hitāvaham
verses.translation: The highly brilliant son (Jayadhvaja) replied to them: "This is my highest holy duty as all the kings in the world have been born through the parts of Visnu.
verses.hindi: नमस्ये गिरिशं देवं चन्द्रावयवभूषणम्। उग्रं पशुपतिं भीमं भास्करं तमसः परम्
verses.wordMeaning: The highly brilliant son (Jayadhvaja) replied to them: "This is my highest holy duty as all the kings in the world have been born through the parts of Visnu.
verses.commentary: Sense: The highly brilliant son (Jayadhvaja) replied to them: "This is my highest holy duty as all the kings in the world have been born through the parts of Visnu.

verses.sanskrit: सात्त्वतस्तस्य पुत्रो ऽभूत् सर्वशास्त्रविशारदः । पुण्यश्लोको महाराजस्तेन वै तत्प्रवर्तितम्
verses.transliteration: sāttvatastasya putro 'bhūt sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ / puṇyaśloko mahārājastena vai tatpravartitam
verses.translation: The protector of a kingdom is certainly the Lord Purusottama. The unconquered Visnu, Hari, the protector of the worlds, should be worshipped.
verses.hindi: मन्वन्तरेण चैकेन सर्वाण्येवान्तराणि वै। नमश्चकार तमृषिं कृष्णद्वैपायनं प्रभुम्। सर्वज्ञं सर्वकर्तारं साक्षाद् विष्णुं व्यवस्थितम्
verses.wordMeaning: The protector of a kingdom is certainly the Lord Purusottama. The unconquered Visnu, Hari, the protector of the worlds, should be worshipped.
verses.commentary: Sense: The protector of a kingdom is certainly the Lord Purusottama. The unconquered Visnu, Hari, the protector of the worlds, should be worshipped.

verses.sanskrit: सात्त्वतः सत्त्वसंपन्नः कौशल्यां सुषुवे सुतान् । अन्धकं वै महाभोजं वृष्णिं देवावृधं नृपम् । ज्येष्ठं च भजमानाख्यं धनुर्वेदविदां वरम्
verses.transliteration: sāttvataḥ sattvasaṃpannaḥ kauśalyāṃ suṣuve sutān / andhakaṃ vai mahābhojaṃ vṛṣṇiṃ devāvṛdhaṃ nṛpam / jyeṣṭhaṃ ca bhajamānākhyaṃ dhanurvedavidāṃ varam
verses.translation: It has been proclaimed that the self-born deity has three forms—constituted of Sattva, Rajas and TomaJ respectively and they are the causes of creation, sustenance and destruction of the universe.
verses.hindi: कराभ्यां सुशुभाभ्यां च संस्पृश्य प्रणतं मुनिः महादेव, वेधा, वामदेव, शम्भु, स्थाणु, परमेष्ठी शिवको नित्य नमस्कार है। सोम, रुद्र, महाग्रास (महाप्रलयमें समस्त प्रपञ्चको अपनेमें लीन कर लेनेवाले) तथा कारणरूपको नमस्कार है
verses.wordMeaning: It has been proclaimed that the self-born deity has three forms—constituted of Sattva, Rajas and TomaJ respectively and they are the causes of creation, sustenance and destruction of the universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: It has been proclaimed that the self-born deity has three forms—constituted of Sattva, Rajas and TomaJ respectively and they are the causes of creation, sustenance and destruction of the universe.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां देवावृधो राजा चचार परमं तपः । पुत्रः सर्वगुणोपेतो मम भूयादिति प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ devāvṛdho rājā cacāra paramaṃ tapaḥ / putraḥ sarvaguṇopeto mama bhūyāditi prabhuḥ
verses.translation: Lord Visnu, the Sattvic soul forever sustains (the universe). The Rajasaic form Brahma creates and the Tamasa form Rudra annihilates it.
verses.hindi: में विरूपाक्ष, शरण ग्रहण करने योग्य, ब्रह्मचारी, महायोगस्वरूप, ईशान तथा अम्बिकापति महादेवको शरण ग्रहण करता हूँ। योगियोंको योग प्रदान करनेवाले, योगमायासे आवृत, योगियोंके गुरु, आचार्य, योगिगम्य पिनाकी, संसारसे उद्धार करनेवाले, रुद्र, ब्रह्मा, ब्रह्माधिपति, शाश्वत, सर्वव्यापी, शान्त, ब्राह्मणोंके रक्षक तथा ब्राह्मणप्रिय, जटाधारी, कालमूर्ति, अमूर्ति, एकमूर्ति, महामूर्ति, वेदवेद्य और द्युलोकके स्वामी परमेश्वर तथा नीलकण्ठ, विश्वमूर्ति,
verses.wordMeaning: Lord Visnu, the Sattvic soul forever sustains (the universe). The Rajasaic form Brahma creates and the Tamasa form Rudra annihilates it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Visnu, the Sattvic soul forever sustains (the universe). The Rajasaic form Brahma creates and the Tamasa form Rudra annihilates it.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य बभ्रुरिति ख्यातः पुण्यश्लोको ऽभवन्नृपः । धार्मिको रूपसंपन्नस्तत्त्वज्ञानरतः सदा
verses.transliteration: tasya babhruriti khyātaḥ puṇyaśloko 'bhavannṛpaḥ / dhārmiko rūpasaṃpannastattvajñānarataḥ sadā
verses.translation: Hence, Lord Visnu, Kesava the suppressor of Kesin, is the deity worthy of being propitiated by kings who protect their respective kingdoms."
verses.hindi: सर्वत्र व्याप्त रहनेवाले, विश्वरेता (जिनके वीर्यसे ही समस्त विश्वको उत्पत्ति हुई है), कालाग्निरूप, कालका दहन करनेवाले, कामनाओंको प्रदान करनेवाले एवं कामदेवका नाश करनेवाले, चन्द्रमाके अवयवको अर्थात् द्वितीयाके चन्द्रमाको आभूषणके रूपमें धारण करनेवाले देव गिरिश, विशेषरूपसे रक्तवर्णवाले, ग्रास बना लेनेवाले (महाप्रलयमें सबको अपने उदरमें डाल लेनेवाले), आदित्य, उग्र, पशुपति, भीम, भास्कर तथा अन्धकारसे
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, Lord Visnu, Kesava the suppressor of Kesin, is the deity worthy of being propitiated by kings who protect their respective kingdoms."
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, Lord Visnu, Kesava the suppressor of Kesin, is the deity worthy of being propitiated by kings who protect their respective kingdoms."

verses.sanskrit: भजमानस्य सृञ्जय्यां भजमाना विजज्ञिरे । तेषां प्रधानौ विख्यातौ निमिः कृकण एव च
verses.transliteration: bhajamānasya sṛñjayyāṃ bhajamānā vijajñire / teṣāṃ pradhānau vikhyātau nimiḥ kṛkaṇa eva ca
verses.translation: On hearing his words, the other steady-minded bro¬ thers said,—"Rudra, the annihilator should be worshipped by those who seek liberation.
verses.hindi: परे रहनेवाले परमेष्ठीको मैं नमस्कार करता हूँ ॥ ४५--५०॥ मन्वन्तरकी समापिपर्यन्त बीते हुए तथा भविष्यमें आनेवाले युगों (कलियुगों)-का संक्षेपमें यह लक्षण बताया गया है, निःसंदेह एक मन्वन्तर (-के कथन)-से सभी मन्वन्तरों तथा एक कल्प (-के कथन)-से अन्य कल्पोंका
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing his words, the other steady-minded bro¬ thers said,—"Rudra, the annihilator should be worshipped by those who seek liberation.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing his words, the other steady-minded bro¬ thers said,—"Rudra, the annihilator should be worshipped by those who seek liberation.

verses.sanskrit: महाभोजकुले जाता भोजा वैमार्तिकास्तथा । वृष्णेः सुमित्रो बलवाननमित्रः शिनस्तथा
verses.transliteration: mahābhojakule jātā bhojā vaimārtikāstathā / vṛṣṇeḥ sumitro balavānanamitraḥ śinastathā
verses.translation: This Rudra is verily the Supreme Deity. At the end of the Kalpa period. Lord Siva, resorting to the Tamo-guna, will annihilate the whole of this world.
verses.hindi: भी कथन हो गया  बीते हुए तथा आनेवाले सभी मन्वन्तरोंमें समान नाम एवं रूपवाले सभी अधिष्ठाता (देवता, सपर्षि तथा इन्द्र आदि) होते हें ॥ ५१--५३ ॥ भगवान् (व्यास)-के ऐसा कहनेपर श्वेतवाहन किरीटधारी (अर्जुन)-ने ईशान (भगवान् शंकर)-में निश्चल परम भक्ति धारण की। उन्होंने उन सर्वज्ञ, सब कुछ करनेवाले, साक्षात् विष्णुके रूपमें अवस्थित प्रभु
verses.wordMeaning: This Rudra is verily the Supreme Deity. At the end of the Kalpa period. Lord Siva, resorting to the Tamo-guna, will annihilate the whole of this world.
verses.commentary: Sense: This Rudra is verily the Supreme Deity. At the end of the Kalpa period. Lord Siva, resorting to the Tamo-guna, will annihilate the whole of this world.

verses.sanskrit: अनमित्रादभून्निघ्नो निघ्नस्य द्वौ बभूवतुः । प्रसेनस्तु महाभागः सत्राजिन्नाम चोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: anamitrādabhūnnighno nighnasya dvau babhūvatuḥ / prasenastu mahābhāgaḥ satrājinnāma cottamaḥ
verses.translation: The trident-bearing lord dissolves the world by means of Vidya at the outset* and then by means of his Supremely terrible and the most refulgent form."
verses.hindi: कृष्णद्वेपायन ऋषिको नमस्कार किया शज्रुके नगरको जीतनेवाले तथा विनीत उन पार्थ (अर्जुन)-को व्यासमुनिने अपने दोनों सुन्दर, शुभ हाथोंसे स्पर्श करते हुए पुनः कहा
verses.wordMeaning: The trident-bearing lord dissolves the world by means of Vidya at the outset* and then by means of his Supremely terrible and the most refulgent form."
verses.commentary: Sense: The trident-bearing lord dissolves the world by means of Vidya at the outset* and then by means of his Supremely terrible and the most refulgent form."

verses.sanskrit: अनमित्राच्छिनिर्जज्ञे कनिष्ठाद् वृष्णिनन्दनात् । सत्यवान् सत्यसंपन्नः सत्यकस्तत्सुतो ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: anamitrācchinirjajñe kaniṣṭhād vṛṣṇinandanāt / satyavān satyasaṃpannaḥ satyakastatsuto 'bhavat
verses.translation: Then pondering over it, king Jayadhvaja spoke to- them—"The creature is liberated through Sattva Gum and Lord Hari is constituted of Sattva Guna."
verses.hindi: त्रैलोक्ये शंकरे नूनं भक्तः परपुरञ्जय दृष्टवानसि तं देवं विश्वाक्षं विश्वतोमुखम्। प्रत्यक्षमेव सर्वेशं रुद्रं सर्वजगदगुरुम्
verses.wordMeaning: Then pondering over it, king Jayadhvaja spoke to- them—"The creature is liberated through Sattva Gum and Lord Hari is constituted of Sattva Guna."
verses.commentary: Sense: Then pondering over it, king Jayadhvaja spoke to- them—"The creature is liberated through Sattva Gum and Lord Hari is constituted of Sattva Guna."

verses.sanskrit: सात्यकिर्युयुधानस्तु तस्यासङ्गो ऽभवत् सुतः । कुणिस्तस्य सुतो धीमांस्तस्य पुत्रो युगन्धरः
verses.transliteration: sātyakiryuyudhānastu tasyāsaṅgo 'bhavat sutaḥ / kuṇistasya suto dhīmāṃstasya putro yugandharaḥ
verses.translation: The brothers replied to him—"If Rudra is served by the Sattvika people he liberates them. One who is endowed with Sattva Guna shall always worship Siva."
verses.hindi: ज्ञानं तहैश्वरं दिव्यं यथावद् विदितं त्वया। स्वयमेव हृषीकेशः: प्रीत्योबाच सनातन: गच्छ गच्छ स्वकं स्थानं न शोकं कर्तुमर्हसि । व्रजस्व परया भक्त्या शरण्यं शरणं शिवम्
verses.wordMeaning: The brothers replied to him—"If Rudra is served by the Sattvika people he liberates them. One who is endowed with Sattva Guna shall always worship Siva."
verses.commentary: Sense: The brothers replied to him—"If Rudra is served by the Sattvika people he liberates them. One who is endowed with Sattva Guna shall always worship Siva."

verses.sanskrit: माद्रया वृष्णेः सुतो जज्ञे पृश्निर्वै यदुनन्दनः । जज्ञाते तनयौ पृश्नेः श्वफल्कश्चित्रकश्च ह
verses.transliteration: mādrayā vṛṣṇeḥ suto jajñe pṛśnirvai yadunandanaḥ / jajñāte tanayau pṛśneḥ śvaphalkaścitrakaśca ha
verses.translation: Then prince Jayadhvaja laughingly remarked:—"It is proper that one's own Dharma should be followed for salva¬ tion. No other method is prescribed by sages.
verses.hindi: एवमुक्त्वा स भगवाननुगृह्यार्जुनं प्रभुः। जगाम शंकरपुरी समाराधयितुं भवम् पाण्डवेयोऽपि तद्वाक्यात् सम्प्राप्य शरणं शिवम्। संत्यज्य सर्वकर्माणि तद्भक्तिपरमोऽभवत्
verses.wordMeaning: Then prince Jayadhvaja laughingly remarked:—"It is proper that one's own Dharma should be followed for salva¬ tion. No other method is prescribed by sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then prince Jayadhvaja laughingly remarked:—"It is proper that one's own Dharma should be followed for salva¬ tion. No other method is prescribed by sages.

verses.sanskrit: श्वफल्कः काशिराजस्य सुतां भार्यामविन्दत । तस्यामजनयत् पुत्रमक्रूरं नाम धार्मिकम् । उपमङ्गुस्तथा मङ्गुरन्ये च बहवः सुताः
verses.transliteration: śvaphalkaḥ kāśirājasya sutāṃ bhāryāmavindata / tasyāmajanayat putramakrūraṃ nāma dhārmikam / upamaṅgustathā maṅguranye ca bahavaḥ sutāḥ
verses.translation: So the propitiation of Visnu of unmeasured prowess is the greatest Dharma of kings who always uphold the power derived from him."
verses.hindi: मुक्त्वा सत्यवतीसूनुं कृष्णं वा देवकीसुतम् पाराशर्याय मुनये व्यासायामिततेजसे
verses.wordMeaning: So the propitiation of Visnu of unmeasured prowess is the greatest Dharma of kings who always uphold the power derived from him."
verses.commentary: Sense: So the propitiation of Visnu of unmeasured prowess is the greatest Dharma of kings who always uphold the power derived from him."

verses.sanskrit: अक्रूरस्य स्मृतः पुत्रो देववानिति विश्रुतः । उपदेवश्च पुण्यात्मा तयोर्विश्वप्रमाथिनौ
verses.transliteration: akrūrasya smṛtaḥ putro devavāniti viśrutaḥ / upadevaśca puṇyātmā tayorviśvapramāthinau
verses.translation: Another son of the king, Kfsna the most excellent among the intelligent ones, spoke to him—"What our father Arjuna has done is the holy dharma.''
verses.hindi: कृष्णद्वैपायनः साक्षाद् विष्णुरेव सनातनः। को ह्यान्यस्तत्त्वतो रुद्रं वेत्ति तं परमेश्वरम् पाराशर्य महात्मानं योगिनं विष्णुमव्ययम्
verses.wordMeaning: Another son of the king, Kfsna the most excellent among the intelligent ones, spoke to him—"What our father Arjuna has done is the holy dharma.''
verses.commentary: Sense: Another son of the king, Kfsna the most excellent among the intelligent ones, spoke to him—"What our father Arjuna has done is the holy dharma.''

verses.sanskrit: चित्रकस्याभवत् पुत्रः पृथुर्विपृथुरेव च । अश्वग्रीवः सुबाहुश्च सुपार्श्वकगवेषणौ
verses.transliteration: citrakasyābhavat putraḥ pṛthurvipṛthureva ca / aśvagrīvaḥ subāhuśca supārśvakagaveṣaṇau
verses.translation: When the dispute thus continued Surasena spoke these words—"In this matter the sages are our authority. What they say in this matter must be correct."
verses.hindi: शत्रुके नगरको जीतनेवाले (अर्जुन!) निश्चय ही तीनों लोकोंमें तुम्हारे समान शंकरका भक्त कोई दूसरा नहीं है, तुम धन्य हो, अनुगृहीत (भगवान् शंकरके आनुग्रहके भाजन) हो। तुमने सभी ओर नेत्र तथा सभी ओर मुखवाले, सारे संसारके गुरु, सर्वेश, रुद्रदेवका प्रत्यक्ष ही दर्शन किया है। ईश्वर (शंकर)-सम्बन्धी दिव्य ज्ञान तुम्हें यथार्थरूपसे विदित है। स्वयं सनातन हृषीकेशने प्रीतिपूर्वक तुम्हें सब बतलाया था। शीघ्र
verses.wordMeaning: When the dispute thus continued Surasena spoke these words—"In this matter the sages are our authority. What they say in this matter must be correct."
verses.commentary: Sense: When the dispute thus continued Surasena spoke these words—"In this matter the sages are our authority. What they say in this matter must be correct."

verses.sanskrit: अन्धकात् काश्यदुहिता लेभे च चतुरः सुतान् । कुकुरं भजमानं च शुचिं कम्बलबर्हिषम्
verses.transliteration: andhakāt kāśyaduhitā lebhe ca caturaḥ sutān / kukuraṃ bhajamānaṃ ca śuciṃ kambalabarhiṣam
verses.translation: Then all those prominent among kings being ex¬ tremely agitated in mind, went to the hermitage of Seven sages who were the expounders of the Brahman (or the Vedas) and usked them.
verses.hindi: अपने स्थानको जाओ, तुम शोक करने योग्य नहीं हो। शरणागतवत्सल शिवकी परा भक्तिको शरण ग्रहण करो॥ ५७--६० ॥ ऐसा कहकर वे भगवान् प्रभु (व्यास) अर्जुनपर कृपा करके शंकरकी आराधना करनेके लिये शंकरकी पुरीको गये। पाण्डुपुत्र अर्जुन भी उनके कहनेसे शिवकी शरणमें पहुंचे और सभी कर्मोंका परित्यागकर उनकी
verses.wordMeaning: Then all those prominent among kings being ex¬ tremely agitated in mind, went to the hermitage of Seven sages who were the expounders of the Brahman (or the Vedas) and usked them.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then all those prominent among kings being ex¬ tremely agitated in mind, went to the hermitage of Seven sages who were the expounders of the Brahman (or the Vedas) and usked them.

verses.sanskrit: कुकुरस्य सुतो वृष्णिर्वृष्णेस्तु तनयो ऽभवत् । कपोतरोमा विपुलस्तस्य पुत्रो विलोमकः
verses.transliteration: kukurasya suto vṛṣṇirvṛṣṇestu tanayo 'bhavat / kapotaromā vipulastasya putro vilomakaḥ
verses.translation: Those sages headed by Vasistha and others conveyed to them the truth in matter:—"Whatever deity appeals to a man is his deity.
verses.hindi: भक्तिमें ही दत्तचित्त हो गये सत्यवतीके पुत्र व्यास या देवकीके पुत्र कृष्णको छोड़कर अन्य कोई भी अर्जुनके समान शंकरकी भक्ति करनेवाला न तो हुआ और न होगा। उन सत्यस्वरूप, धीमान् पराशरके पुत्र अमित तेजस्वी भगवान् व्यासमुनिको
verses.wordMeaning: Those sages headed by Vasistha and others conveyed to them the truth in matter:—"Whatever deity appeals to a man is his deity.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those sages headed by Vasistha and others conveyed to them the truth in matter:—"Whatever deity appeals to a man is his deity.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यासीत् तुम्बुरुसखा विद्वान् पुत्रो नलः किल । ख्यायते तस्य नामानुरनोरानकदुन्दुभिः
verses.transliteration: tasyāsīt tumburusakhā vidvān putro nalaḥ kila / khyāyate tasya nāmānuranorānakadundubhiḥ
verses.translation: But if the deity is worshipped for a specific purpose it bestows what is liked by men. By special worship it bestows everything. O kings, this principle or rule cannot be other¬ wise.
verses.hindi: नित्य नमस्कार है। कृष्णद्वैपायन (व्यास) साक्षात् सनातन विष्णु ही हैं, इनके अतिरिक्त उन परमेश्वर रुद्रको यथार्थरूपसे अन्य कौन जानता है। इन सत्यवतीनन्दन, पराशरपुत्र, महात्मा योगी, अव्यय विष्णुस्वरूप कृष्णद्वैपायन (व्यास) ऋषिको आपलोग नमस्कार करें। इस प्रकारसे कहे जानेपर सभी मुनियोंने एकाग्रचित्त होकर सत्यवतीके पुत्र उन महात्मा व्यासको नमस्कार किया
verses.wordMeaning: But if the deity is worshipped for a specific purpose it bestows what is liked by men. By special worship it bestows everything. O kings, this principle or rule cannot be other¬ wise.
verses.commentary: Sense: But if the deity is worshipped for a specific purpose it bestows what is liked by men. By special worship it bestows everything. O kings, this principle or rule cannot be other¬ wise.

verses.sanskrit: स गोवर्धनमासाद्य तताप विपुलं तपः । वरं तस्मै ददौ देवो ब्रह्मा लोकमहेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: sa govardhanamāsādya tatāpa vipulaṃ tapaḥ / varaṃ tasmai dadau devo brahmā lokamaheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: The deities of kings are:— Visnu as well as Isa (Siva) and Purandara (Indra). The deities of Brahmanas are:—Agni (the fire-god), Aditya (the sun-god), Brahma and the Pinaka-wielding deity (Siva).
verses.hindi: व्यासजीका वाराणसी-गमन, व्याससे जेमिनि आदि ऋषियोंका धर्मसम्बन्धी प्रश्न, व्यासका उन्हें शिव-पार्वती-संवाद बताना, अविमुक्तक्षेत्र वाराणसीका माहात्म्य, वाराणसी-सेवनका विशेष फल प्राप्य वाराणसी दिव्यां कृष्णद्वैपायनो मुनि: । किमकार्षीन्महाबुद्द्ः श्रोतुं कौतूहलं हि नः
verses.wordMeaning: The deities of kings are:— Visnu as well as Isa (Siva) and Purandara (Indra). The deities of Brahmanas are:—Agni (the fire-god), Aditya (the sun-god), Brahma and the Pinaka-wielding deity (Siva).
verses.commentary: Sense: The deities of kings are:— Visnu as well as Isa (Siva) and Purandara (Indra). The deities of Brahmanas are:—Agni (the fire-god), Aditya (the sun-god), Brahma and the Pinaka-wielding deity (Siva).

verses.sanskrit: वंशस्य चाक्षयां कीर्ति गानयोगमनुत्तमम् । गुरोरभ्यधिकं विप्राः कामरूपित्वमेव च
verses.transliteration: vaṃśasya cākṣayāṃ kīrti gānayogamanuttamam / gurorabhyadhikaṃ viprāḥ kāmarūpitvameva ca
verses.translation: The deity of Devas is Visnu, of Danavas is the Trident-bearing lord; Soma (moon) is said to be the deity of Gandharvas and Yaksas.
verses.hindi: प्राप्य वाराणसीं दिव्यामुपस्पृश्य महामुनिः । पूजयामास जाह्वव्यां देवं विश्वेश्वरं शिवम् तमागतं मुनिं दृष्टा तत्र ये निवसन्ति वै। पूजयाञ्चक्रिरे व्यासं मुनयो मुनिपुङ्गवम्
verses.wordMeaning: The deity of Devas is Visnu, of Danavas is the Trident-bearing lord; Soma (moon) is said to be the deity of Gandharvas and Yaksas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The deity of Devas is Visnu, of Danavas is the Trident-bearing lord; Soma (moon) is said to be the deity of Gandharvas and Yaksas.

verses.sanskrit: स लब्ध्वा वरमव्यग्रो वरेण्यं वृषवाहनम् । पूजयामास गानेन स्थाणुं त्रिदशपूजितम्
verses.transliteration: sa labdhvā varamavyagro vareṇyaṃ vṛṣavāhanam / pūjayāmāsa gānena sthāṇuṃ tridaśapūjitam
verses.translation: The deity of Vidyadharas is the goddess of speech; of Siddhasis Lord Hari; of Raksasas is Sankara, Rudra and of Kinnaras is Parvatl.
verses.hindi: पप्रच्छुः प्रणताः सर्वे कथाः पापविनाशिनीः । महादेवाश्रयाः पुण्या मोक्षधर्मान् सनातनान् स चापि कथयामास सर्वज्ञो भगवानृषिः। माहात्म्यं देवदेवस्य धर्मान् वेदनिदर्शितान्॥ तेषां मध्ये मुनीन्द्राणां व्यासशिष्यो महामुनिः । पृष्टवान् जैमिनिर्व्यासं गूढमर्थं सनातनम्
verses.wordMeaning: The deity of Vidyadharas is the goddess of speech; of Siddhasis Lord Hari; of Raksasas is Sankara, Rudra and of Kinnaras is Parvatl.
verses.commentary: Sense: The deity of Vidyadharas is the goddess of speech; of Siddhasis Lord Hari; of Raksasas is Sankara, Rudra and of Kinnaras is Parvatl.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य गानरतस्याथ भगवानम्बिकापतिः । कन्यारत्नं ददौ देवो दुर्लभं त्रिदशैरपि
verses.transliteration: tasya gānaratasyātha bhagavānambikāpatiḥ / kanyāratnaṃ dadau devo durlabhaṃ tridaśairapi
verses.translation: The deity of sages is, Lord Brahma as well as Mahadeva, the wielder of the trident. Goddess Uma is worthy of being respected by women, so also are Visnu, Isa and Bhas- kara (the sun-god).
verses.hindi: केचिद् ध्यानं प्रशंसन्ति धर्ममेवापरे जनाः । अन्ये सांख्यं तथा योगं तपस्त्वन्ये महर्षयः ब्रह्मचर्यमथो मौनमन्ये प््राहुर्महर्षयः। अहिंसां सत्यमप्यन्ये संन्यासमपरे विदुः
verses.wordMeaning: The deity of sages is, Lord Brahma as well as Mahadeva, the wielder of the trident. Goddess Uma is worthy of being respected by women, so also are Visnu, Isa and Bhas- kara (the sun-god).
verses.commentary: Sense: The deity of sages is, Lord Brahma as well as Mahadeva, the wielder of the trident. Goddess Uma is worthy of being respected by women, so also are Visnu, Isa and Bhas- kara (the sun-god).

verses.sanskrit: तया स सङ्गतो राजा गानयोगमनुत्तमम् । अशिक्षयदमित्रघ्नः प्रियां तां भ्रान्तलोचनाम्
verses.transliteration: tayā sa saṅgato rājā gānayogamanuttamam / aśikṣayadamitraghnaḥ priyāṃ tāṃ bhrāntalocanām
verses.translation: All these are the deities of householders. The Brahman shall be the deity of Brahmacarins (religious students under the vow of celibacy). The deity of Vaikhdnasas (recluses) shall be Arka (the sun-god) and the deity of ascetics {Sannyasins) shall be Mahesvara.
verses.hindi: केचिद् दयां प्रशंसन्ति दानमध्ययनं तथा। तीर्थयात्रां तथा केचिदन्ये चेन्द्रियनिग्रहम् किमेतेषां भवेज्यायः प्रत्रूहि मुनिपुङ्गव। यदि वा विद्यतेऽप्यन्यद् गुह्यं तद्वक्तुमर्हसि
verses.wordMeaning: All these are the deities of householders. The Brahman shall be the deity of Brahmacarins (religious students under the vow of celibacy). The deity of Vaikhdnasas (recluses) shall be Arka (the sun-god) and the deity of ascetics {Sannyasins) shall be Mahesvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: All these are the deities of householders. The Brahman shall be the deity of Brahmacarins (religious students under the vow of celibacy). The deity of Vaikhdnasas (recluses) shall be Arka (the sun-god) and the deity of ascetics {Sannyasins) shall be Mahesvara.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यामुत्पादयामास सुभुजं नाम शोभनम् । रूपलावण्यसंपन्नां ह्रीमतीमपि कन्यकाम्
verses.transliteration: tasyāmutpādayāmāsa subhujaṃ nāma śobhanam / rūpalāvaṇyasaṃpannāṃ hrīmatīmapi kanyakām
verses.translation: The god of goblins is Lord Rudra, that of Kusrnandas is Vinayaka, and the deity of every one is Lord Brahma, the progenitor and the lord of devas.
verses.hindi: शरुत्वा स जैमिनेर्वाक्यं कृष्णद्वैपायनो मुनिः । प्राह गम्भीरया वाचा प्रणम्य वृषकेतनम् ऋषियोंने कहा-- (सूतजी !) महाबुद्धिमान् कृष्ण- द्वैपायन (व्यास) मुनिने दिव्य वाराणसीपुरीमें पहुँचकर क्या किया? इस विषयको सुननेके लिये हम लोगोंको कोतूहल है
verses.wordMeaning: The god of goblins is Lord Rudra, that of Kusrnandas is Vinayaka, and the deity of every one is Lord Brahma, the progenitor and the lord of devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The god of goblins is Lord Rudra, that of Kusrnandas is Vinayaka, and the deity of every one is Lord Brahma, the progenitor and the lord of devas.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तं जननी पुत्रं बाल्ये वयसि शोभनम् । शिक्षयामास विधिवद् गानविद्यां च कन्यकाम्
verses.transliteration: tatastaṃ jananī putraṃ bālye vayasi śobhanam / śikṣayāmāsa vidhivad gānavidyāṃ ca kanyakām
verses.translation: Lord Brahma himself has proclaimed thus. Hence Jayadhvaja certainly deserves the propitiation of Visnu.
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले--दिव्य वाराणसीमें पहुँचकर महा- मुनिने गङ्गामें आचमनकर (स्त्रानकर) विश्वेश्वर देव शिवका पूजन किया। उन मुनि (व्यासजी)-को आया देखकर वहाँ निवास करनेवाले मुनियोंने मुनिश्रेष्ठ व्यासको पूजा को। उन सभीने महादेवसे सम्बद्ध पापोंका नाश करनेवाली पुण्यदायिनी कथा तथा सनातन मोक्षध्मोंको विनयपूर्वक पूछा। सर्वज्ञ उन भगवान् (व्यास) ऋषिने भी देवाधिदेव (शिव)-का माहात्म्य
verses.wordMeaning: Lord Brahma himself has proclaimed thus. Hence Jayadhvaja certainly deserves the propitiation of Visnu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Brahma himself has proclaimed thus. Hence Jayadhvaja certainly deserves the propitiation of Visnu.

verses.sanskrit: कृतोपनयनो वेदानधीत्य विधिवद् गुरोः । उद्ववाहात्मजां कन्यां गन्धर्वाणां तु मानसीम्
verses.transliteration: kṛtopanayano vedānadhītya vidhivad guroḥ / udvavāhātmajāṃ kanyāṃ gandharvāṇāṃ tu mānasīm
verses.translation: But Hari should be worshipped by men after realising his identity with Rudra. Otherwise Hari may not annihilate the enemy of the king."
verses.hindi: तथा वेदमें निर्दिष्ट धर्मोका वर्णन किया। उन मुनियोंके मध्य व्यासके शिष्य महामुनि जैमिनिने व्यासजीसे सनातन गूढ़ अर्थ पूछा जैमिनिने कहा-- भगवन्! एक संशयको आप यथार्थरूपसे दूर करें, क्योंकि आप परम ऋषिको कुछ भी अविदित नहीं है। कुछ लोग ध्यानकी प्रशंसा करते हैं, कुछ दूसरे धर्मको ही प्रशंसा करते हैं। अन्य लोग
verses.wordMeaning: But Hari should be worshipped by men after realising his identity with Rudra. Otherwise Hari may not annihilate the enemy of the king."
verses.commentary: Sense: But Hari should be worshipped by men after realising his identity with Rudra. Otherwise Hari may not annihilate the enemy of the king."

verses.sanskrit: तस्यामुत्पादयामास पञ्च पुत्राननुत्तमान् । वीणावादनतत्त्वज्ञान् गानशास्त्रविशारदान्
verses.transliteration: tasyāmutpādayāmāsa pañca putrānanuttamān / vīṇāvādanatattvajñān gānaśāstraviśāradān
verses.translation: Thereafter, they bowed to them and returned to their extremely splendid city. After conquering the enemies in the battle, they protected the Earth.
verses.hindi: सांख्य तथा योगको, कुछ महर्षि तपको, कोई ब्रह्मचर्यको और दूसरे महर्षि मौन धारणको, कुछ अहिंसा एवं सत्यको तथा कुछ विद्वान् संन्यासको श्रेष्ठ बताते हैं। कुछ लोग दयाको प्रशंसा करते हैं तो कुछ दान तथा अध्ययनकी। इसी प्रकार कुछ तीर्थयात्राको तथा दूसरे लोग इन्द्रियनिग्रहको महत्त्व देते हैं। मुनिश्रेष्ठ! इनमेंसे बतलायें कि कोन सर्वाधिक श्रेष्ठ है अथवा अन्य भी यदि कोई गुह्य साधन हो तो उसे आप बतलायें॥ ७--११॥
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, they bowed to them and returned to their extremely splendid city. After conquering the enemies in the battle, they protected the Earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, they bowed to them and returned to their extremely splendid city. After conquering the enemies in the battle, they protected the Earth.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रैः पौत्रैः सपत्नीको राजा गानविशारदः । पूजयामास गानेन देवं त्रिपुरनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: putraiḥ pautraiḥ sapatnīko rājā gānaviśāradaḥ / pūjayāmāsa gānena devaṃ tripuranāśanam
verses.translation: O Brahmanas, then, on one occasion a certain Danava named Videha who terrified all beings, came to their city.
verses.hindi: जेमिनिकी बात सुनकर वे कृष्णद्वैपायन मुनि वृषभध्वज (शंकर)-को प्रणाम करते हुए गम्भीर वाणीमें बोले- भगवान् ( व्यास )-ने कहा--महाभाग्यशाली मुने! आप धन्य हैं, धन्य हैं। आपने जो पूछा है, मैं उस गुह्यतमसे भी गुह्य (तत्त्व)-को कहता हुँ, अन्य सभी महर्षि भी सुनें
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas, then, on one occasion a certain Danava named Videha who terrified all beings, came to their city.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas, then, on one occasion a certain Danava named Videha who terrified all beings, came to their city.

verses.sanskrit: ह्रीमती चापि या कन्या श्रीरिवायतलोचना । सुबाहुर्नाम गन्धर्वस्तामादाय ययौ पुरीम्
verses.transliteration: hrīmatī cāpi yā kanyā śrīrivāyatalocanā / subāhurnāma gandharvastāmādāya yayau purīm
verses.translation: He was terrible due to his fangs; his body was blazing (i.e. he had a resplendent personality) like fire at the world-destruction, at the close of Tugas. He was wielding a spear sparkling like the sun. His roaring sound reverberated in the ten quarters.
verses.hindi: गूढमप्राज्ञविद्िष्टं सेवितं सूक्ष्मदर्शिभिः मेरुशृङ्गे पुरा देवमीशानं त्रिपुरद्विषम्।
verses.wordMeaning: He was terrible due to his fangs; his body was blazing (i.e. he had a resplendent personality) like fire at the world-destruction, at the close of Tugas. He was wielding a spear sparkling like the sun. His roaring sound reverberated in the ten quarters.
verses.commentary: Sense: He was terrible due to his fangs; his body was blazing (i.e. he had a resplendent personality) like fire at the world-destruction, at the close of Tugas. He was wielding a spear sparkling like the sun. His roaring sound reverberated in the ten quarters.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यामप्यभवन् पुत्रा गन्धर्वस्य सुतेजसः । सुषेणवीरसुग्रीवसुभोजनरवाहनाः
verses.transliteration: tasyāmapyabhavan putrā gandharvasya sutejasaḥ / suṣeṇavīrasugrīvasubhojanaravāhanāḥ
verses.translation: Men who lived there lost their lives on hearing that shout; others became frightened and fled.
verses.hindi: देवासनगता देवी महादेवमपृच्छत देवदेव महादेव भक्तानामार्तिनाशन।
verses.wordMeaning: Men who lived there lost their lives on hearing that shout; others became frightened and fled.
verses.commentary: Sense: Men who lived there lost their lives on hearing that shout; others became frightened and fled.

verses.sanskrit: अथासीदभिजित् पुत्रो वीरस्त्वानकदुन्दुभेः । पुनर्वसुश्चाभिजितः संबभूवाहुकः सुतः
verses.transliteration: athāsīdabhijit putro vīrastvānakadundubheḥ / punarvasuścābhijitaḥ saṃbabhūvāhukaḥ sutaḥ
verses.translation: With great determination they rushed at Videha. Sura discharged the miraculous weapon of Rudra; Surasena hurled the missile of Varuna.
verses.hindi: कथं त्वां पुरुषो देवमचिरादेव पश्यति सांख्ययोगस्तथा ध्यानं कर्मयोगोऽथ वैदिकः ।
verses.wordMeaning: With great determination they rushed at Videha. Sura discharged the miraculous weapon of Rudra; Surasena hurled the missile of Varuna.
verses.commentary: Sense: With great determination they rushed at Videha. Sura discharged the miraculous weapon of Rudra; Surasena hurled the missile of Varuna.

verses.sanskrit: आहुकस्योग्रसेनश्च देवकश्च द्विजोत्तमाः । देवकस्य सुता वीरा जज्ञिरे त्रिदशोपमाः
verses.transliteration: āhukasyograsenaśca devakaśca dvijottamāḥ / devakasya sutā vīrā jajñire tridaśopamāḥ
verses.translation: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.
verses.hindi: आयासबहुला लोके यानि चान्यानि शंकर येन विश्रान्तचित्तानां योगिनां कर्मिणामपि! दृश्यो हि भगवान् सूक्ष्मः सर्वेषामथ देहिनाम्
verses.wordMeaning: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.
verses.commentary: Sense: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.

verses.sanskrit: देववानुपदेवश्च सुदेवो देवरक्षितः । तेषां स्वसारः सप्तासन् वसुदेवाय ता ददौ
verses.transliteration: devavānupadevaśca sudevo devarakṣitaḥ / teṣāṃ svasāraḥ saptāsan vasudevāya tā dadau
verses.translation: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.
verses.hindi: एतद् गुह्यतमं ज्ञानं गूढं ब्रह्मादिसेवितम्। हिताय सर्वभक्तानां ब्रूहि कामाङ्गनाशन तत्र भक्ता महादेवि मदीयं व्रतमास्थिताः । निवसन्ति महात्मानः परं नियममास्थिताः
verses.wordMeaning: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.
verses.commentary: Sense: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.

verses.sanskrit: वृकदेवोपदेवा च तथान्या देवरक्षिता । श्रीदेवा शान्तिदेवा च सहदेवा सहदेवा च सुव्रता । देवकी चापि तासां तु वरिष्ठाभूत् सुमध्यमा
verses.transliteration: vṛkadevopadevā ca tathānyā devarakṣitā / śrīdevā śāntidevā ca sahadevā sahadevā ca suvratā / devakī cāpi tāsāṃ tu variṣṭhābhūt sumadhyamā
verses.translation: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.
verses.hindi: भूर्लोके नैव संलग्रमन्तरिक्षे ममालयम्। अयुक्तास्तन्न पश्यन्ति युक्ताः पश्यन्ति चेतसा कालो भूत्वा जगदिदं संहराम्यत्र सुन्दरि
verses.wordMeaning: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.
verses.commentary: Sense: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.

verses.sanskrit: अग्रसेनस्य पुत्रो ऽभून्न्यग्रोधः कंस एव च । सुभूमी राष्ट्रपालश्च तुष्टिमाञ्छङ्कुरेव च
verses.transliteration: agrasenasya putro 'bhūnnyagrodhaḥ kaṃsa eva ca / subhūmī rāṣṭrapālaśca tuṣṭimāñchaṅkureva ca
verses.translation: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.
verses.hindi: अज्ञानी लोग जिससे द्वेष करते हैं और सूक्ष्मदर्शी जिसका सेवन करते हैं, वह गूढ़ सनातन ज्ञान प्राचीन कालमें ईश्वर (शंकर)-के द्वारा कहा गया है। जो श्रद्धारहित हो, परमेष्ठी (शंकर)-का भक्त न हो और वेदसे द्वेष रखता हो, ऐसे व्यक्तिको सभी ज्ञानोंमें उत्तम इस शुभ ज्ञानको नहीं प्रदान करना चाहिए। प्राचीन कालमें मेरु-शिखरपर भगवान् शंकरके साथ एक ही आसनपर स्थित देवी पार्वतीने त्रिपुरारि देव, ईशान
verses.wordMeaning: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.
verses.commentary: Sense: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.

verses.sanskrit: भजमानादबूत् पुत्रः प्रख्यातो ऽसौ विदूरथः । तस्य शूरः शमिस्तस्मात् प्रतिक्षत्रस्ततो ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: bhajamānādabūt putraḥ prakhyāto 'sau vidūrathaḥ / tasya śūraḥ śamistasmāt pratikṣatrastato 'bhavat
verses.translation: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.
verses.hindi: महादेवसे पूछा-- ॥ १४--१६॥ देवीने कहा--देवाधिदेव महादेव! आप भक्तोंके कष्टको दूर करनेवाले हैं। पुरुष किस प्रकार शीघ्र ही आप देवका दर्शन कर सकता है? कामदेवका विनाश करनेवाले शंकर! लोकमें सांख्ययोग, ध्यान, वैदिक
verses.wordMeaning: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.
verses.commentary: Sense: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.

verses.sanskrit: स्वयंभोजस्ततस्तस्माद् हृदिकः शत्रुतापनः । कृतवर्माथ तत्पुत्रो देवरस्तत्सुतः स्मृतः । स शूरस्तत्सुतो धीमान् वसुदेवो ऽथ तत्सुतः
verses.transliteration: svayaṃbhojastatastasmād hṛdikaḥ śatrutāpanaḥ / kṛtavarmātha tatputro devarastatsutaḥ smṛtaḥ / sa śūrastatsuto dhīmān vasudevo 'tha tatsutaḥ
verses.translation: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.
verses.hindi: कर्मयोग और अन्य भी अनेक अधिक परिश्रमसाध्य (उपाय) बतलाये गये हैं। (उनमें) जो ब्रह्मा आदिद्वारा सेवित उपाय या अत्यन्त गुह्य एवं गूढ ज्ञान हो, उसे आप हम सभी भक्तोंके कल्याणके लिये बतलायें, जिससे भ्रान्तचित्तवालो अथवा कर्मयोगी मनुष्यों एवं समस्त देहधारियोंको सूक्ष्म भगवान्का दर्शन हो सके॥ १७--२० ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.
verses.commentary: Sense: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.

verses.sanskrit: वसुदेवावन्महाबाहुर्वासुदेवो जगद्गुरुः । बभूव देवकीपुत्रो देवैरभ्यर्थितो हरिः
verses.transliteration: vasudevāvanmahābāhurvāsudevo jagadguruḥ / babhūva devakīputro devairabhyarthito hariḥ
verses.translation: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.
verses.hindi: ईश्वर बोले--परम ऋषियोंने जिस विज्ञानको कहा है, अज्ञानियोंने जिस ज्ञानका विरोध किया है और जो अकथनीय है, उसे मैं तत्त्वत: तुमसे कहता हूँ। पुरी वाराणसी मेरा परम गुद्यतम क्षेत्र है। यह सभी प्राणियोंको संसारसागरसे पार उतारनेवाली है। महादेवि! यहाँ मेरे व्रतको धारण करनेवाले भक्त तथा श्रेष्ठ नियमका आश्रय ग्रहण करनेवाले महात्मा निवास करते हैं। यह मेरा अविमुक्त (काशीक्षेत्र) सभी तीर्थोमें उत्तम, सभी स्थानोंमें
verses.wordMeaning: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.
verses.commentary: Sense: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.

verses.sanskrit: रोहिणी च महाभागा वसुदेवस्य शोभना । असूत पत्नी संकर्षं रामं ज्येष्ठं हलायुधम्
verses.transliteration: rohiṇī ca mahābhāgā vasudevasya śobhanā / asūta patnī saṃkarṣaṃ rāmaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ halāyudham
verses.translation: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ और सभी ज्ञानोंमें उत्तम ज्ञानरूप है॥ २१--२४॥ इस दिव्य भूमिमें महाश्‍्मशानरूपी  काशीमें अन्य अनेक पवित्र स्थान, तीर्थ तथा मन्दिर प्रतिष्ठित हैं। मेरा गृहस्वरूप (यह वाराणसी क्षेत्र) भूलोकसे सम्बद्ध नहीं है, अपितु अन्तरिक्षमें (अवस्थित) है, अयोगियोंको इसके
verses.wordMeaning: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.
verses.commentary: Sense: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.

verses.sanskrit: स एव परमात्मासौ वासुदेवो जगन्मयः । हलायुधः स्वयं साक्षाच्छेषः संकर्षणः प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: sa eva paramātmāsau vāsudevo jaganmayaḥ / halāyudhaḥ svayaṃ sākṣāccheṣaḥ saṃkarṣaṇaḥ prabhuḥ
verses.translation: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.
verses.hindi: दर्शन नहीं होते। जो योगी हैं वे ध्यानमें इसका दर्शन करते हैं। सुन्दरी! यह महाश्‍्मशानके नामसे विख्यात है और इसे अविमुक्त (क्षेत्र) भी कहा जाता है। में कालरूप होकर यहाँ इस संसारका संहार करता हूँ॥ २५--२७॥  काशीमें मरण होनेपर स्थूल, सूक्ष्म एवं कारण--इन तीनों शरीरोंका सदाके लिये नाश हो जाता है, इसीलिये काशीको
verses.wordMeaning: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.
verses.commentary: Sense: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.

verses.sanskrit: भृगुशापच्छलेनैव मानयन् मानुषीं तनुम् । बभूत तस्यां देवक्यां रोहिण्यामपि माधवः
verses.transliteration: bhṛguśāpacchalenaiva mānayan mānuṣīṃ tanum / babhūta tasyāṃ devakyāṃ rohiṇyāmapi mādhavaḥ
verses.translation: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.
verses.hindi: महाश्मशान कहते हैं। देवीदं सर्वगुह्यानां स्थानं प्रियतमं मम। मद्धक्तास्तत्र गच्छन्ति मामेव प्रविशन्ति ते
verses.wordMeaning: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.
verses.commentary: Sense: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.

verses.sanskrit: उमादेहसमुद्भूता योगनिद्रा च कौशीकी । नियोगाद् वासुदेवस्य यशोदातनया ह्यभूत्
verses.transliteration: umādehasamudbhūtā yoganidrā ca kauśīkī / niyogād vāsudevasya yaśodātanayā hyabhūt
verses.translation: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.
verses.hindi: जन्मान्तरसहस्त्रेषु यत्पापं पूर्वसंचितम्। अविमुक्तं प्रविष्टस्य तत्सर्वं व्रजति क्षयम् ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रिया वैश्याः शूद्रा ये वर्णसंकराः। स्त्रियो म्लेच्छाश्च ये चान्ये संकीर्णाः पापयोनयः
verses.wordMeaning: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.
verses.commentary: Sense: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.

verses.sanskrit: ये चान्ये वसुदेवस्य वासुदेवाग्रजाः सुताः । प्रागेव कंसस्तान् सर्वान् जघान मुनिपुङ्गवाः
verses.transliteration: ye cānye vasudevasya vāsudevāgrajāḥ sutāḥ / prāgeva kaṃsastān sarvān jaghāna munipuṅgavāḥ
verses.translation: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.
verses.hindi: कीटाः पिपीलिकाश्चैव ये चान्ये मृगपक्षिणः । कालेन निधनं प्राता अविमुक्ते वरानने शिवे मम पुरे देवि जायन्ते तत्र मानवाः
verses.wordMeaning: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.
verses.commentary: Sense: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.

verses.sanskrit: सुषेणश्च तथोदायी भद्रसेनो महाबलः । ऋजुदासो भद्रदासः कीर्तिमानपि पूर्वजः
verses.transliteration: suṣeṇaśca tathodāyī bhadraseno mahābalaḥ / ṛjudāso bhadradāsaḥ kīrtimānapi pūrvajaḥ
verses.translation: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.
verses.hindi: मोक्षं सुदुर्लभं मत्वा संसारं चातिभीषणम्। अश्मना चरणौ हत्वा वाराणस्यां वसेन्नरः यत्र तत्र विपन्नस्य गतिः संसारमोक्षिणी
verses.wordMeaning: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.
verses.commentary: Sense: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.

verses.sanskrit: हतेष्वेतेषु सर्वेषु रोहिणी वसुदेवतः । असूत रामं लोकेशं बलभद्रं हलायुधम्
verses.transliteration: hateṣveteṣu sarveṣu rohiṇī vasudevataḥ / asūta rāmaṃ lokeśaṃ balabhadraṃ halāyudham
verses.translation: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.
verses.hindi: अविमुक्तं न सेवन्ते मूढा ये तमसावृताः । बिण्मूत्ररेतसां मध्ये ते वसन्ति पुनः पुनः हन्यमानोऽपि यो विद्वान् वसेद् विघ्नशतैरपि। स याति परमं स्थानं यत्र गत्वा न शोचति
verses.wordMeaning: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.
verses.commentary: Sense: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.

verses.sanskrit: जाते ऽथ रामे देवानामादिमात्मानमच्युतम् । असूत देवकी कृष्णं श्रीवत्साङ्कितवक्षसम्
verses.transliteration: jāte 'tha rāme devānāmādimātmānamacyutam / asūta devakī kṛṣṇaṃ śrīvatsāṅkitavakṣasam
verses.translation: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.
verses.hindi: जन्ममृत्युजरामुक्तं परं यान्ति शिवालयम्। अपुनर्मरणानां हि सा गतिर्मोक्षकाङ्क्षिणाम्। न दानैर्न तपोभिश्च न यज्ञैर्नापि विद्यया। प्राप्यते गतिरुत्कृष्टा याविमुक्ते तु लभ्यते
verses.wordMeaning: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.
verses.commentary: Sense: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.

verses.sanskrit: रेवती नाम रामस्य भार्यासीत् सुगुणान्विता । तस्यामुत्पादयामास पुत्रौ द्वौ निशठोल्मुकौ
verses.transliteration: revatī nāma rāmasya bhāryāsīt suguṇānvitā / tasyāmutpādayāmāsa putrau dvau niśaṭholmukau
verses.translation: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.
verses.hindi: देवि! सभी गुह्य स्थानोंमें यह मेरा सर्वाधिक प्रिय स्थान है। मेरै भक्त यहाँ आते ही मुझमें ही प्रविष्ट हो जाते हैं। यहाँ किया हुआ दान, जप, होम, यज्ञ, तप, कर्म, ध्यान, अध्ययन और ज्ञानार्जन--सब कुछ अक्षय हो जाता है। अविमुक्त क्षेत्रमें प्रविष्ट होनेवालेका हजारों जन्मान्तरोंमे किया हुआ जो पूर्वसंचित पाप है, वह सब नष्ट हो जाता है॥ २८--३० ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.
verses.commentary: Sense: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.

verses.sanskrit: षोडशस्त्रीसहस्त्राणि कृष्णस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः । बभूवुरात्मजास्तासु शतशो ऽथ सहस्त्रशः
verses.transliteration: ṣoḍaśastrīsahastrāṇi kṛṣṇasyākliṣṭakarmaṇaḥ / babhūvurātmajāstāsu śataśo 'tha sahastraśaḥ
verses.translation: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.
verses.hindi: वरानने! अविमुक्त (वाराणसी) क्षेत्रमें कालवश मृत्युको प्राप्त--ब्राह्मण, क्षत्रिय, वैश्य, शूद्र, वर्णसंकर, स्त्री, म्लेच्छ, अन्य संकीर्ण पाप योनिवाले सभी मानव प्राणी, कोडे, चींटी तथा जो भी अन्य मृग-पक्षी आदि हैं-ये सभी सिरपर अर्धचन्द्र धारण करनेवाले, त्रिनेत्र तथा महावृषभ (नन्दी)- को वाहन बनानेवाले (शिव- स्वरूप) मानव बनकर मेरे कल्याणमय पुरमें उत्पन्न होते हैं। अविमुक्त क्षेत्रमै मरा हुआ कोई पापी नरकमें
verses.wordMeaning: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.
verses.commentary: Sense: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.

verses.sanskrit: चारुदेष्णः सुचारुश्च चारुवेषो यशोधरः । चारुश्रवाश्चारुयशाः प्रद्युम्नः शङ्ख एव च
verses.transliteration: cārudeṣṇaḥ sucāruśca cāruveṣo yaśodharaḥ / cāruśravāścāruyaśāḥ pradyumnaḥ śaṅkha eva ca
verses.translation: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.
verses.hindi: नहीं जाता है, ईश्वर (शंकर)-से कृपा-प्राप्त वे सभी परम गति प्राप्त करते हैं। मोक्षको अत्यन्त दुर्लभ और संसारको अत्यन्त भीषण समझकर पत्थरद्वारा पैरोंको तोड़कर मनुष्यको वाराणसीमें निवास करना चाहिए॥ ३१--३५॥ परमेश्वरी! तपस्याद्वारा पवित्र हुए प्राणीके लिये भी जहाँ-कहीँ मरनेपर संसारसे मुक्त करनेवाली गति दुर्लभ होती है। शैलपुत्री! मेरै अनुग्रहसे (वह गति) यहाँ प्राप्त हो जाती है। मेरी मायासे विमोहित अज्ञानी लोग
verses.wordMeaning: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.
verses.commentary: Sense: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.

verses.sanskrit: रुक्मिण्य वासुदेवस्यां महाबलपराक्रमाः । विशिष्टाः सर्वपुत्राणां संबभूवुरिम् सुताः
verses.transliteration: rukmiṇya vāsudevasyāṃ mahābalaparākramāḥ / viśiṣṭāḥ sarvaputrāṇāṃ saṃbabhūvurim sutāḥ
verses.translation: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.
verses.hindi: इस तत्त्वको नहीं समझते हैं। अज्ञानसे आवृत मूढ़ लोग अविमुक्त क्षेत्रका सेवन नहीं करते, वे मल- मूत्र और रजोवीर्य (-से युक्त नरक)-के बीच बार- बार निवास करते हैं। सैकड़ों विघ्रोंसे आहत होनेपर भी जो विद्वान् (वाराणसीमें) निवास करते हैं, वे उस परम स्थानको प्राप्त करते हैं, जहाँ जानेपर शोक नहीं करना पड़ता॥ ३६--३९ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.
verses.commentary: Sense: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.

verses.sanskrit: तान् दृष्ट्वा तनयान् वीरान् रौक्मिणेयाञ्जनार्दनम् । जाम्बवत्यब्रवीत् कृष्णं भार्या तस्य शुचिस्मिता
verses.transliteration: tān dṛṣṭvā tanayān vīrān raukmiṇeyāñjanārdanam / jāmbavatyabravīt kṛṣṇaṃ bhāryā tasya śucismitā
verses.translation: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.
verses.hindi: (वे) जन्म, मृत्यु और जरारहित होकर शिकके श्रेष्ठ निवासस्थानको प्राप्त करते हैं। पुनः मरणको न प्राप्त करनेवाले मोक्षार्थियोंकी वह सद्गति होती है, जिसे प्रातकर पण्डित लोग (स्वयंको) कृतकृत्य मानते हैं। अविमुक्त क्षेत्रमें जो उत्कृष्ट गति प्राप्त होती है, वह न दानोंसे, न विविध तपोंसे, न यज्ञोंसे और न विद्याद्वारा ही प्राप्त की जा सकती है
verses.wordMeaning: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.
verses.commentary: Sense: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.

verses.sanskrit: मम त्वं पुण्डरीकाक्ष विशिष्टं गुणवत्तमम् । सुरेशसदृशं पुत्रं देहि दानवसूदन
verses.transliteration: mama tvaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣa viśiṣṭaṃ guṇavattamam / sureśasadṛśaṃ putraṃ dehi dānavasūdana
verses.translation: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.
verses.hindi: अविमुक्तं परं तत्त्वमविमुक्तं परं शिवम् कृत्वा वै नैष्ठिकीं दीक्षामविमुक्ते वसन्ति ये। तेषां तत्परमं ज्ञानं ददाम्यन्ते परं पदम्
verses.wordMeaning: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.
verses.commentary: Sense: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.

verses.sanskrit: जात्बवत्या वचः श्रुत्वा जगन्नाथः स्वयं हरिः । समारेभे तपः कर्तुं तपोनिधिररिन्दमः
verses.transliteration: jātbavatyā vacaḥ śrutvā jagannāthaḥ svayaṃ hariḥ / samārebhe tapaḥ kartuṃ taponidhirarindamaḥ
verses.translation: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.
verses.hindi: केदारं भद्रकर्ण च गया पुष्करमेव च कुरुक्षेत्रं रूद्रकोटिरनर्मदाम्रातकेश्वरम्। शालिग्रामं च कुब्जाम्रं कोकामुखमनुत्तमम्। प्रभासं विजयेशानं गोकर्ण भद्रकर्णकम्
verses.wordMeaning: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.
verses.commentary: Sense: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.

verses.sanskrit: तच्छृणुध्वं मुनिश्रेष्ठा यथासौ देवकीसुतः । दृष्ट्वा लेभे सुतं रुद्रं तप्त्वा तीव्रं महत् तपः
verses.transliteration: tacchṛṇudhvaṃ muniśreṣṭhā yathāsau devakīsutaḥ / dṛṣṭvā lebhe sutaṃ rudraṃ taptvā tīvraṃ mahat tapaḥ
verses.translation: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.
verses.hindi: एतानि पुण्यस्थानानि त्रैलोक्ये विश्रुतानि ह। न यास्यन्ति परं मोक्षं वाराणस्यां यथा मृताः प्रविष्टा नाशयेत् पापं जन्मान्तरशतैः कृतम्
verses.wordMeaning: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.
verses.commentary: Sense: Krsna discharged the missile of Prajapati {Brahmas- tra) and Dhrsna discharged that of Vayu. Jayadhvaja dis¬ charged the miraculous weapons of Kubera, Indra and Agni.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे त्रयोविंशो ऽध्यायः सूत उवाच अथ देवो हृषीकेशो भगवान् पुरुषोत्तमः । तताप घोरं पुत्रार्थं निदानं तपसस्तपः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge trayoviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca atha devo hṛṣīkeśo bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ / tatāpa ghoraṃ putrārthaṃ nidānaṃ tapasastapaḥ
verses.translation: He is Visnu having the four manifestations [Vyuhas) but he himself is said to be devoid of Vyuha. He is the great Atman, the Supreme abode, the highest firmament. He is the ultimate highest region.
verses.hindi: यदि पापो यदि शठो यदि वाऽधार्मिको नरः। वाराणसीं समासाद्य पुनाति सकलं नरः वाराणस्यां महादेवं येऽर्चयन्ति स्तुवन्ति वै। सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तास्ते विज्ञेया गणेश्वराः
verses.wordMeaning: He is Visnu having the four manifestations [Vyuhas) but he himself is said to be devoid of Vyuha. He is the great Atman, the Supreme abode, the highest firmament. He is the ultimate highest region.
verses.commentary: Sense: He is Visnu having the four manifestations [Vyuhas) but he himself is said to be devoid of Vyuha. He is the great Atman, the Supreme abode, the highest firmament. He is the ultimate highest region.

verses.sanskrit: स्वेच्छयाप्यवतीर्णो ऽसौ कृतकृत्यो ऽपि विश्वधृक् । चचार स्वात्मनो मूलं बोधयन् भावमैश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: svecchayāpyavatīrṇo 'sau kṛtakṛtyo 'pi viśvadhṛk / cacāra svātmano mūlaṃ bodhayan bhāvamaiśvaram
verses.translation: Expounders of Brahman call him the Brahman of three syllables OM. He is Vasudeva, the soul of the universe, the Yogic Atman and the Supreme person.
verses.hindi: ये भक्ता देवदेवेशे वाराणस्यां वसन्ति वै। ते विन्दन्ति परं मोक्षमेकेनैव तु जन्मना यत्र योगस्तथा ज्ञानं मुक्तिरेकेन जन्मना। अविमुक्तं समासाद्य नान्यद् गच्छेत् तपोवनम्
verses.wordMeaning: Expounders of Brahman call him the Brahman of three syllables OM. He is Vasudeva, the soul of the universe, the Yogic Atman and the Supreme person.
verses.commentary: Sense: Expounders of Brahman call him the Brahman of three syllables OM. He is Vasudeva, the soul of the universe, the Yogic Atman and the Supreme person.

verses.sanskrit: जगाम योगिभिर्जुष्टं नानापक्षिसमाकुलम् । आश्रमं तूपमन्योर्वै मुनीन्द्रस्य महात्मनः
verses.transliteration: jagāma yogibhirjuṣṭaṃ nānāpakṣisamākulam / āśramaṃ tūpamanyorvai munīndrasya mahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: Devoid of passion, they worshipped the unchanging Rudra accessible through Tajna, through the performance of Yajna. The holy sage, venerable Vasistha, the knowerof Dharma, presided over their Tajna.
verses.hindi: विद्वानोंका यह कहना है कि अनेक (ब्राह्मणादि) वर्णवाले मनुष्यों, वर्णरहित चण्डालादिकों, घृणित व्यक्तियों तथा जो पापों तथा विशिष्ट पापों (महापापों)-से युक्त देहवाले हैं, उनके लिये अविमुक्त क्षेत्र (वाराणसीका सेवन ही) परम ओषधि है। अविमुक्त (क्षेत्र) परम ज्ञान है। अविमुक्त (क्षेत्र) परम पद है। अविमुक्त (क्षेत्र) परम तत्त्व है और अविमुक्त (क्षेत्र) परम कल्याण है। नैष्ठिकी दीक्षा ग्रहण कर जो अविमुक्त (क्षेत्र)-में निवास
verses.wordMeaning: Devoid of passion, they worshipped the unchanging Rudra accessible through Tajna, through the performance of Yajna. The holy sage, venerable Vasistha, the knowerof Dharma, presided over their Tajna.
verses.commentary: Sense: Devoid of passion, they worshipped the unchanging Rudra accessible through Tajna, through the performance of Yajna. The holy sage, venerable Vasistha, the knowerof Dharma, presided over their Tajna.

verses.sanskrit: तपत्त्रिराजमारूढः सुपर्णमतितेजसम् । शङ्खचक्रगदापाणिः श्रीवत्सकृतलक्षणः
verses.transliteration: tapattrirājamārūḍhaḥ suparṇamatitejasam / śaṅkhacakragadāpāṇiḥ śrīvatsakṛtalakṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: After realising Visnu as the greatest form of Rudra, Jayadhvaja performed the worship of Visnu assiduously.
verses.hindi: करते हैं, उन्हें मैं श्रेष्ठ ज्ञान और अन्तमें परम पद प्रदान करता हुँ ॥ ४२--४४॥ प्रयाग, पुण्यदायी नैमिषारण्य, महालय श्रीशैल, केदार, भद्रकर्ण, गया, पुष्कर, कुरुक्षेत्र, रुद्रकोटि, नर्मदा, आम्रातकेश्वर, शालिग्राम, कुन्जाम्र, श्रेष्ठ कोकामुख, प्रभास, विजयेशान, गोकर्ण तथा भद्रकर्ण-ये सभी पवित्र तीर्थ तीनों लोकोंमें
verses.wordMeaning: After realising Visnu as the greatest form of Rudra, Jayadhvaja performed the worship of Visnu assiduously.
verses.commentary: Sense: After realising Visnu as the greatest form of Rudra, Jayadhvaja performed the worship of Visnu assiduously.

verses.sanskrit: नानाद्रुमलताकीर्णं नानापुष्पोपशोभितम् । ऋषीणामाश्रमैर्जुष्टं वेदघोषनिनादितम्
verses.transliteration: nānādrumalatākīrṇaṃ nānāpuṣpopaśobhitam / ṛṣīṇāmāśramairjuṣṭaṃ vedaghoṣanināditam
verses.translation: He who always listens to this story of exploits of Jayadhvaja shall be freed from all sins. He goes to the region of Visnu.
verses.hindi: विख्यात हैं, किंतु जिस प्रकार वाराणसीमें मरे हुए व्यक्तियोंको परम मोक्ष प्राप्त होता है, वैसा अन्यत्र प्राप्त नहीं होता। वाराणसीमें प्रविष्ट त्रिपथगामिनी (स्वर्ग, पाताल एवं भूलोक इस प्रकार तीन पथोंमें प्रवाहित होनेवाली) गङ्गा सैकड़ों जन्मोंमें किये हुए पापोंको नष्ट करनेमें अपना विशिष्ट स्थान रखती है ॥ ४५--४८ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: He who always listens to this story of exploits of Jayadhvaja shall be freed from all sins. He goes to the region of Visnu.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who always listens to this story of exploits of Jayadhvaja shall be freed from all sins. He goes to the region of Visnu.

verses.sanskrit: सिंहर्क्षशरभाकीर्णं शार्दूलगजसंयुतम् । विमलस्वादुपानीयैः सरोभिरुपशोभितम्
verses.transliteration: siṃharkṣaśarabhākīrṇaṃ śārdūlagajasaṃyutam / vimalasvādupānīyaiḥ sarobhirupaśobhitam
verses.hindi: गङ्गा, श्राद्ध, दान, तप, जप तथा व्रत वाराणसीमें सभी सुलभ हैं, परंतु अन्यत्र दुर्लभ हैं। वाराणसीमें स्थित मनुष्य ऐसा ज्ञान अत्यल्प परिश्रमसे प्राप्त कर लेता है, जिसके सहारे वायुभक्षी होकर नित्य हवन करता है, यज्ञ करता है, दान देता है तथा देवताओंकी पूजा करता है। मनुष्य पापी हो, शठ हो अथवा अधार्मिक हो, तब भी वाराणसीमें पहुंचकर अपने संसर्गमें रहनेवाले सबको पवित्र कर देता है। वाराणसीमें जो महादेवकी
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. V 11.26-30.

verses.sanskrit: आरामैर्विविधैर्जुष्टं देवतायतनैः शुभैः । ऋषिकैरृषिपुत्रैश्च महामुनिगणैस्तथा
verses.transliteration: ārāmairvividhairjuṣṭaṃ devatāyatanaiḥ śubhaiḥ / ṛṣikairṛṣiputraiśca mahāmunigaṇaistathā
verses.translation: This romantic dalliance between king Durjaya and heavenly damsel Urvasi seems to be the special contribution of the KP., as PE. is silent about it despite the seven Dur jayas mentioned on The source of this legend is obviously the Vedic dialogue between Pururavas and Urvasi.
verses.hindi: स्तुति करते हैँ, अर्चना करते हैं, उन्हें सभी पापोंसे मुक्त (शंकरके) गणेश्वर समझना चाहिए दूसरे स्थानमें योग, ज्ञान, संन्यास अथवा अन्य उपायॉसे हजारों जन्मोंमें वह परमपद--मोक्ष प्राप्त होता है, किंतु देवदेवेश शंकरके जो भक्त वाराणसीमें निवास करते हैं, वे एक ही जन्ममें परमपद-मोक्षको प्राप्त कर लेते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: This romantic dalliance between king Durjaya and heavenly damsel Urvasi seems to be the special contribution of the KP., as PE. is silent about it despite the seven Dur jayas mentioned on The source of this legend is obviously the Vedic dialogue between Pururavas and Urvasi.
verses.commentary: Sense: This romantic dalliance between king Durjaya and heavenly damsel Urvasi seems to be the special contribution of the KP., as PE. is silent about it despite the seven Dur jayas mentioned on The source of this legend is obviously the Vedic dialogue between Pururavas and Urvasi.

verses.sanskrit: वेदाध्ययनसंपन्नैः सेवितं चाग्निहोत्रिभिः । योगिभिर्ध्याननिरतैर्नासाग्रगतलोचनैः
verses.transliteration: vedādhyayanasaṃpannaiḥ sevitaṃ cāgnihotribhiḥ / yogibhirdhyānaniratairnāsāgragatalocanaiḥ
verses.translation: Vr?a was the founder of their family. His son was Madhu. Madhu had a hundred sons, but Vrsana only had continued his race.
verses.hindi: जहाँ एक ही जन्ममें योग, ज्ञान अथवा मुक्ति मिल जाती है, उस अविमुक्त (वाराणसी) क्षेत्रमें पहुँचकर फिर किसी दूसरे तपोवनमें नहीं जाना चाहिए तदेव गुह्यां गुह्यानामेतद् विज्ञाय मुच्यते
verses.wordMeaning: Vr?a was the founder of their family. His son was Madhu. Madhu had a hundred sons, but Vrsana only had continued his race.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vr?a was the founder of their family. His son was Madhu. Madhu had a hundred sons, but Vrsana only had continued his race.

verses.sanskrit: उपेतं सर्वतः पुण्यं ज्ञानिभिस्तत्त्वदर्शिभिः । नदीभिरभितो जुष्टं जापकैर्ब्रह्मवादिभिः
verses.transliteration: upetaṃ sarvataḥ puṇyaṃ jñānibhistattvadarśibhiḥ / nadībhirabhito juṣṭaṃ jāpakairbrahmavādibhiḥ
verses.translation: Vitihotra's son was well-known as Ananta. Durjaya who was an expert in all sacred lores, was his son.
verses.hindi: पुरी वाराणसी तेभ्यः स्थानेभ्यो ह्यधिका शुभा यत्र साक्षान्महादेवो देहान्ते स्वयमीश्वरः । व्याचष्टे तारकं ब्रह्म तत्रैव ह्यविमुक्तकम्
verses.wordMeaning: Vitihotra's son was well-known as Ananta. Durjaya who was an expert in all sacred lores, was his son.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vitihotra's son was well-known as Ananta. Durjaya who was an expert in all sacred lores, was his son.

verses.sanskrit: सेवितं तापसैः पुण्यैरीशाराधनतत्परैः । प्रशान्तैः सत्यसंकल्पैर्निः शोकैर्निरुपद्रवैः
verses.transliteration: sevitaṃ tāpasaiḥ puṇyairīśārādhanatatparaiḥ / praśāntaiḥ satyasaṃkalpairniḥ śokairnirupadravaiḥ
verses.translation: His wife was very beautiful and endowed with all good virtues. She was chaste, devoted to her husband, and she assiduously performed her religious duty, alongwith her husband.
verses.hindi: एकेन जन्मना देवि वाराणस्यां तदाप्नुयात् यत्र नारायणो देवो महादेवो दिवेश्वरः
verses.wordMeaning: His wife was very beautiful and endowed with all good virtues. She was chaste, devoted to her husband, and she assiduously performed her religious duty, alongwith her husband.
verses.commentary: Sense: His wife was very beautiful and endowed with all good virtues. She was chaste, devoted to her husband, and she assiduously performed her religious duty, alongwith her husband.
