verses.sanskrit: भस्मावदातसर्वाङ्गै रुद्रजाप्यपरायणैः । मुण्डितैर्जटिलैः शुद्धैस्तथान्यैश्च शिखाजटैः । सेवितं तापसैर्नित्य ज्ञानिभिर्ब्रह्मचारिभिः
verses.transliteration: bhasmāvadātasarvāṅgai rudrajāpyaparāyaṇaiḥ / muṇḍitairjaṭilaiḥ śuddhaistathānyaiśca śikhājaṭaiḥ / sevitaṃ tāpasairnitya jñānibhirbrahmacāribhiḥ
verses.translation: Once, that great king saw the celestial damsel UrvasI seated on the banks of Yamuna singing in sweet tone.
verses.hindi: तत्र देवाः सगन्धर्वाः सयक्षोरगराक्षसाः । उपासते मां सततं देवदेवं पितामहम् महापातकिनो ये च ये तेभ्यः पापकृत्तमाः । वाराणसीं समासाद्य ते यान्ति परमां गतिम्
verses.wordMeaning: Once, that great king saw the celestial damsel UrvasI seated on the banks of Yamuna singing in sweet tone.
verses.commentary: Sense: Once, that great king saw the celestial damsel UrvasI seated on the banks of Yamuna singing in sweet tone.

verses.sanskrit: तत्राश्रमवरे रम्ये सिद्धाश्रमविभूषिते । गङ्गा भगवती नित्यं वहत्येवाघनाशिनी
verses.transliteration: tatrāśramavare ramye siddhāśramavibhūṣite / gaṅgā bhagavatī nityaṃ vahatyevāghanāśinī
verses.translation: With his mind struck by the cupid, he approached her and said:—"O celestial lady, it behoves you to indulge in sexual intercourse with me for a long time."
verses.hindi: तस्मान्मुमुक्षुर्नियतो वसेद् वै मरणान्तिकम्। बाराणस्यां महादेवाऱ्ज्ञानं लब्ध्वा विमुच्यते किन्तु विघ्ना भविष्यन्ति पापोपहतचेतसः । ततो नैव चरेत् पापं कायेन मनसा गिरा
verses.wordMeaning: With his mind struck by the cupid, he approached her and said:—"O celestial lady, it behoves you to indulge in sexual intercourse with me for a long time."
verses.commentary: Sense: With his mind struck by the cupid, he approached her and said:—"O celestial lady, it behoves you to indulge in sexual intercourse with me for a long time."

verses.sanskrit: स तानन्विष्य विश्वात्मा तापसान् वीतकल्मषान् । प्रणामेनाथ वचसा पूजयामास माधवः
verses.transliteration: sa tānanviṣya viśvātmā tāpasān vītakalmaṣān / praṇāmenātha vacasā pūjayāmāsa mādhavaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing the king endowed with comely features and beauty like another god of love, the celestial lady indulged in amorous sports with him for a long time.
verses.hindi: एतद् रहस्यं वेदानां पुराणानां च सुव्रताः । अविमुक्ताश्रयं ज्ञानं न कश्चिद् वेत्ति तत्त्वत: देव्यै देवेन कथितं सर्वपापविनाशनम्
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing the king endowed with comely features and beauty like another god of love, the celestial lady indulged in amorous sports with him for a long time.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the king endowed with comely features and beauty like another god of love, the celestial lady indulged in amorous sports with him for a long time.

verses.sanskrit: ते ते दृष्ट्वा जगद्योनिं शङ्खचक्रगदाधरम् । प्रणेमुर्भक्तिसंयुक्ता योगिनां परमं गुरुम्
verses.transliteration: te te dṛṣṭvā jagadyoniṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam / praṇemurbhaktisaṃyuktā yogināṃ paramaṃ gurum
verses.translation: Becoming enlightened after a long time, the king said to the charming Urvasi—"I shall go to my beautiful city." She then laughingly said these words:
verses.hindi: ति कूर्मपुराण ति चूँकि मैं वाराणसी क्षेत्र कभी नहीं छोडता, इसलिये वह अविमुक्त (क्षेत्र) कहलाता है, यही गुद्योंमें अत्यन्त गुह्य (ज्ञान) है। इसे जानकर मनुष्य मुक्त हो जाता है। है सुभ्रु (सुन्दर भौंहोंवाली)! ज्ञान” (ब्रह्मज्ञान)
verses.wordMeaning: Becoming enlightened after a long time, the king said to the charming Urvasi—"I shall go to my beautiful city." She then laughingly said these words:
verses.commentary: Sense: Becoming enlightened after a long time, the king said to the charming Urvasi—"I shall go to my beautiful city." She then laughingly said these words:

verses.sanskrit: स्तुवन्ति वैदिकैर्मन्त्रैः कृत्वा हृदि सनातनम् । प्रोचुरन्योन्यमव्यक्तमादिदेवं महामुनिम्
verses.transliteration: stuvanti vaidikairmantraiḥ kṛtvā hṛdi sanātanam / procuranyonyamavyaktamādidevaṃ mahāmunim
verses.translation: "O charming king, I am not fully satisfied with this much of enjoyment with you. You must stay one more year."
verses.hindi: और अज्ञान (ब्रह्मज्ञानका साधनरूप ज्ञान)-में निरत तथा परमानन्दकी इच्छा करनेवालोंकी जो गति बतलायी गयी है, वह अविमुक्त (क्षेत्र)-में मरनेवालोंको प्राप्त होती हैं। अविमुक्तरूप देह (विराट्) -में जिन क्षेत्रोंका वर्णन हुआ है, उन सभी क्षेत्रोमें वाराणसीपुरी अधिक
verses.wordMeaning: "O charming king, I am not fully satisfied with this much of enjoyment with you. You must stay one more year."
verses.commentary: Sense: "O charming king, I am not fully satisfied with this much of enjoyment with you. You must stay one more year."

verses.sanskrit: अयं स भगवानेकः साक्षान्नारायणः परः । अगच्छत्यधुना देवः पुराणपुरुषः स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: ayaṃ sa bhagavānekaḥ sākṣānnārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ / agacchatyadhunā devaḥ purāṇapuruṣaḥ svayam
verses.translation: The intelligent king told her, "I shall go to the city and shall come back immediately. It behoves you to permit me.
verses.hindi: यह अविमुक्त क्षेत्र ऐसा है, जहाँ साक्षात् महादेव ईश्वर देहान्त होनेके समय तारक ब्रह्मका उपदेश देते हैं। देवि! जो वह परतर तत्त्व ' अविमुक्त’ नामसे कहा जाता है, वह वाराणसीमें एक जन्ममें ही प्राप्त हो जाता है। (विराट्के) भौंहोंके मध्य, नाभिके मध्य, हृदयमें, मूर्धामें तथा आदित्यमें जिस प्रकार अविमुक्त स्थित है, उसी प्रकार वाराणसीमें अविमुक्त क्षेत्र प्रतिष्ठित है॥ ५९--६१॥
verses.wordMeaning: The intelligent king told her, "I shall go to the city and shall come back immediately. It behoves you to permit me.
verses.commentary: Sense: The intelligent king told her, "I shall go to the city and shall come back immediately. It behoves you to permit me.

verses.sanskrit: अयमेवाव्ययः स्त्रष्टा संहर्ता चैव रक्षकः । अमूर्तो मूर्तिमान् भूत्वा मुनीन् द्रष्टुमिहागतः
verses.transliteration: ayamevāvyayaḥ straṣṭā saṃhartā caiva rakṣakaḥ / amūrto mūrtimān bhūtvā munīn draṣṭumihāgataḥ
verses.translation: That beautiful lady spoke to him,—"My dear king I agree. But you must not indulge in sexual intercourse with any other celestial lady."
verses.hindi: वरुणा और असीके मध्य वाराणसीपुरी है। वहाँ अविमुक्त नामक नित्य तत्त्व स्थित है। जहाँ नारायण देव और महादेव दिवेश्वर (सुरलोकके अधिपति) स्थित हैं, उस वाराणसीसे श्रेष्ठ स्थान न कोई हुआ है और न कोई होगा। वहाँ गन्धर्वो, यक्षों, नागों तथा राक्षसोंसहित सभी देवता मुझ देवाधिदेव पितामहको सतत उपासना करते हैं॥६२--६४॥
verses.wordMeaning: That beautiful lady spoke to him,—"My dear king I agree. But you must not indulge in sexual intercourse with any other celestial lady."
verses.commentary: Sense: That beautiful lady spoke to him,—"My dear king I agree. But you must not indulge in sexual intercourse with any other celestial lady."

verses.sanskrit: एष धाता विधाता च समागच्छति सर्वगः । अनादिरक्षयो ऽनन्तो महाभूतो महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: eṣa dhātā vidhātā ca samāgacchati sarvagaḥ / anādirakṣayo 'nanto mahābhūto maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: 'Amen' said he, and immediately went to his ex¬ cellent city. After returning there, he saw his chaste wife and became extremely frightened.
verses.hindi: जो महापापी हैं और उनसे भी जो अधिक पाप करनेवाले (अतिपातकी) हैं, वे वाराणसी पहुँचकर परम गतिको प्राप्त करते हैं। इसलिये मोक्षार्थीको मरणपर्यन्त वाराणसीमें निश्चितरूपसे निवास करना चाहिए । वाराणसीमें महादेवसे ज्ञान प्राप्तकर मनुष्य मुक्त हो जाता है। किंतु पापसे आक्रान्त चित्तवालोंको विप्र होते हैं। इसलिये शरीर, मन और वाणीसे पाप नहीं करना चाहिए। सुव्रतो ! (उत्तम व्रतोंका पालन करनेवाले)
verses.wordMeaning: 'Amen' said he, and immediately went to his ex¬ cellent city. After returning there, he saw his chaste wife and became extremely frightened.
verses.commentary: Sense: 'Amen' said he, and immediately went to his ex¬ cellent city. After returning there, he saw his chaste wife and became extremely frightened.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा श्रुत्वा हरिस्तेषां वचांसि वचनातिगः । ययौ स तूर्णं गोविन्दः स्थानं तस्य महात्मनः
verses.transliteration: śrutvā śrutvā haristeṣāṃ vacāṃsi vacanātigaḥ / yayau sa tūrṇaṃ govindaḥ sthānaṃ tasya mahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing him alarmed, his chaste wife of good qualities, the lady with plump breasts, spoke to him with pleas¬ ing words.
verses.hindi: यह वेदों और पुराणोंका रहस्य है। अविमुक्तसे सम्बद्ध ज्ञानको कोई तत्त्वत: जानता नहीं है महादेवने देवताओं, ऋषियों तथा परमेष्ठियोंके समक्ष देवी पार्वतीसे सभी पापोंको विनष्ट करनेवाले इस ज्ञानको कहा था
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing him alarmed, his chaste wife of good qualities, the lady with plump breasts, spoke to him with pleas¬ ing words.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing him alarmed, his chaste wife of good qualities, the lady with plump breasts, spoke to him with pleas¬ ing words.

verses.sanskrit: उपस्पृश्याथ भावेन तीर्थे तीर्थे स यादवः । चकार देवकीसूनुर्देवर्षिपितृतर्पणम्
verses.transliteration: upaspṛśyātha bhāvena tīrthe tīrthe sa yādavaḥ / cakāra devakīsūnurdevarṣipitṛtarpaṇam
verses.translation: "O Lord, why are you under the spell of fear. Such fear is not conducive to the enhancement of your reputa¬ tion as a king."
verses.hindi: यहाँ मूलमें 'ज्ञान' का अर्थ है विज्ञान (ब्रह्मज्ञान) तथा अज्ञानका अर्थ है किंचित् न्यून ज्ञान (ब्रह्मज्ञानका साधन ज्ञान) । यथा नारायणाः श्रेष्ठो देवानां पुरुषोत्तम: । यथेश्वराणां गिरिशः स्थानानां चैतदुत्तमम्
verses.wordMeaning: "O Lord, why are you under the spell of fear. Such fear is not conducive to the enhancement of your reputa¬ tion as a king."
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Lord, why are you under the spell of fear. Such fear is not conducive to the enhancement of your reputa¬ tion as a king."

verses.sanskrit: नदीनां तीरसंस्थानि स्थापितानि मुनीश्वरैः । लिङ्गानि पूजयामास शंभोरमिततेजसः
verses.transliteration: nadīnāṃ tīrasaṃsthāni sthāpitāni munīśvaraiḥ / liṅgāni pūjayāmāsa śaṃbhoramitatejasaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing her words, the king was overwhelmed with shame in his mind. He did not speak anything. But she knew everything through her vision of knowledge.
verses.hindi: ते विन्दन्ति परं क्षेत्रमविमुक्तं शिवालयम् ये स्मरन्ति सदा कालं विन्दन्ति च पुरीमिमाम्। तेषां विनश्यति क्षिप्रमिहामुत्र च पातकम्
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing her words, the king was overwhelmed with shame in his mind. He did not speak anything. But she knew everything through her vision of knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing her words, the king was overwhelmed with shame in his mind. He did not speak anything. But she knew everything through her vision of knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा दृष्ट्वा समायान्तं यत्र यत्र जनार्दनम् । पूजयाञ्चक्रिरे पुष्पैरक्षतैस्तत्र वासिनः
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭvā samāyāntaṃ yatra yatra janārdanam / pūjayāñcakrire puṣpairakṣataistatra vāsinaḥ
verses.translation: "O king, you need not be afraid. Atonement must be made by you for your sin. O great king, if you are afraid, your kingdom will go to ruins."
verses.hindi: यानि चेह प्रकुर्वन्ति पातकानि कृतालयाः । नाशयेत् तानि सर्वाणि देवः कालतनुः शिवः आगच्छतामिदं स्थानं सेवितुं मोक्षकाङ्किणाम्। मृतानां च पुनर्जन्म न भूयो भवसागरे
verses.wordMeaning: "O king, you need not be afraid. Atonement must be made by you for your sin. O great king, if you are afraid, your kingdom will go to ruins."
verses.commentary: Sense: "O king, you need not be afraid. Atonement must be made by you for your sin. O great king, if you are afraid, your kingdom will go to ruins."

verses.sanskrit: समीक्ष्य वासुदेवं तं शार्ङ्गशङ्खासिधारिणम् । तस्थिरे निश्चलाः सर्वे शुभाङ्गं तन्निवासिनः
verses.transliteration: samīkṣya vāsudevaṃ taṃ śārṅgaśaṅkhāsidhāriṇam / tasthire niścalāḥ sarve śubhāṅgaṃ tannivāsinaḥ
verses.translation: On the way, the leading king saw in the sky, a very excellent Gandharva bedecked in a divine garland, shining gloriously.
verses.hindi: तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन वाराणस्यां वसेन्नरः । योगी वाप्यथवाऽयोगी पापी वा पुण्यकुत्तमः इत्येवमुक्त्वा भगवान् व्यासो वेदविदां वरः । सहेव शिष्यप्रवरैर्वाराणस्यां चचार ह
verses.wordMeaning: On the way, the leading king saw in the sky, a very excellent Gandharva bedecked in a divine garland, shining gloriously.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the way, the leading king saw in the sky, a very excellent Gandharva bedecked in a divine garland, shining gloriously.

verses.sanskrit: यानि तत्रारुरुक्षूणां मानसानि जनार्दनम् । दृष्ट्वा समीहितान्यासन् निष्क्रामन्ति पुराहिरम्
verses.transliteration: yāni tatrārurukṣūṇāṃ mānasāni janārdanam / dṛṣṭvā samīhitānyāsan niṣkrāmanti purāhiram
verses.translation: O Brahmanas, the invincible king defeated him in the battle and seized the garland. Eager to see that celestial damsel, he went to Yamuna.
verses.hindi: जिस प्रकार देवताओंमें पुरुषोत्तम नारायण श्रेष्ठ हैं, जिस प्रकार ईश्वरोंमें गिरिश (महादेव) श्रेष्ठ हें, वैसे ही सभी स्थानोंमें यह (अविमुक्त क्षेत्र) श्रेष्ठ है। जिन्होंने पूर्वजन्ममें रुद्रकी उपासना की है, वे ही परम अविमुक्त क्षेत्र नामक शिवके निवासस्थानको प्राप्त करते हैं। कलिके दोषोंके कारण जिनकी बुद्धि उपहत हो गयी है, वह परमेष्ठीके उस स्थानको जान नहीं सकते॥ ७०--७२॥
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas, the invincible king defeated him in the battle and seized the garland. Eager to see that celestial damsel, he went to Yamuna.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas, the invincible king defeated him in the battle and seized the garland. Eager to see that celestial damsel, he went to Yamuna.

verses.sanskrit: अथावगाह्य गङ्गायां कृत्वा देवादितर्पणम् । आदाय पुष्पवर्याणि मुनीन्द्रस्याविशद् गृहम्
verses.transliteration: athāvagāhya gaṅgāyāṃ kṛtvā devāditarpaṇam / ādāya puṣpavaryāṇi munīndrasyāviśad gṛham
verses.translation: Unable to see her there and afflicted by the arrows of the god of love, Kama, he wandered all over the Earth con¬ sisting of seven continents.
verses.hindi: जो सर्वदा कालरूप शिवका और इस पुरी (वाराणसी)- का स्मरण करते रहते हैं, उनका इस लोक और अन्य लोकका पाप शीघ्र ही नष्ट हो जाता है। यहाँ निवास करनेवाले जो पाप करते हैं, कालस्वरूप देव शिव उन सबको नष्ट कर देते हें
verses.wordMeaning: Unable to see her there and afflicted by the arrows of the god of love, Kama, he wandered all over the Earth con¬ sisting of seven continents.
verses.commentary: Sense: Unable to see her there and afflicted by the arrows of the god of love, Kama, he wandered all over the Earth con¬ sisting of seven continents.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा तं योगिनां श्रेष्ठं भस्मोद्धूलितविग्रहम् । जटाचीरधरं शान्तं ननाम शिरसा मुनिम्
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā taṃ yogināṃ śreṣṭhaṃ bhasmoddhūlitavigraham / jaṭācīradharaṃ śāntaṃ nanāma śirasā munim
verses.translation: It is heard that in his eagerness to see UrvaH, he crossed the ridges of the Himalayas and scaled Hemakuta, the most excellent mountain.
verses.hindi: मोक्षकी इच्छासे इस स्थानका सेवन करनेके लिये जो यहाँ आते हैं, उन्हें मृत्युके अनन्तर पुन: भवसागरमें जन्म नहीं लेना पडता  इसीलिये चाहे योगी हो, अयोगी हो अथवा पापी हो या श्रेष्ठ पुण्यकर्मा हो, जैसा भी हो, उसे सभी प्रयत्रोंसे वाराणसीमें ही निवास करना चाहिए। वेदके वचनसे, माता-पिताके कहनेसे अथवा गुरुके वचनसे भी अविमुक्त क्षेत्र-वाराणसीमें आनेके विचारका परित्याग नहीं करना चाहिए॥ ७५--७७॥
verses.wordMeaning: It is heard that in his eagerness to see UrvaH, he crossed the ridges of the Himalayas and scaled Hemakuta, the most excellent mountain.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is heard that in his eagerness to see UrvaH, he crossed the ridges of the Himalayas and scaled Hemakuta, the most excellent mountain.

verses.sanskrit: आलोक्य कृष्णमायान्तं पूजयामास तत्त्ववित् । आसने चासयामास योगिनां प्रथमातिथिम्
verses.transliteration: ālokya kṛṣṇamāyāntaṃ pūjayāmāsa tattvavit / āsane cāsayāmāsa yogināṃ prathamātithim
verses.translation: In all these difiFerent places, excellent celestial ladies saw him, the king of brave exploits, bedecked in the wonder¬ ful garland. They were smitten with violent love for him.
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले--ऐसा कहकर वेदविदोंमें श्रेष्ठ भगवान् व्यास प्रधान शिष्योंके साथ वाराणसीमें विचरण करने लगे  वाराणसीकी स्तुतिमें तात्पर्य है न कि वेदवाक्यों, माता-पिता एवं गुरुके वचनोंके उल्लङ्कनमें तात्पर्य है।
verses.wordMeaning: In all these difiFerent places, excellent celestial ladies saw him, the king of brave exploits, bedecked in the wonder¬ ful garland. They were smitten with violent love for him.
verses.commentary: Sense: In all these difiFerent places, excellent celestial ladies saw him, the king of brave exploits, bedecked in the wonder¬ ful garland. They were smitten with violent love for him.

verses.sanskrit: उवाच वचसां योनिं जानीमः परमं पदम् । विष्णुमव्यक्तसंस्थानं शिष्यभावेन संस्थितम्
verses.transliteration: uvāca vacasāṃ yoniṃ jānīmaḥ paramaṃ padam / viṣṇumavyaktasaṃsthānaṃ śiṣyabhāvena saṃsthitam
verses.translation: Remembering the warning (lit. words) of UrvasI and with his mind exclusively attached to her, he did not care to glance at any of them at all, and he climbed the peaks of the mountain.
verses.hindi: वाराणसीके ओंकारेश्वर और कृत्तिवासेश्वर लिड्रोंका माहात्म्य, शंकरके कृत्तिवासा नाम पड़नेका वृत्तान्त स शिष्यैः संवृतो धीमान् गुरुद्वपायनो मुनि: ।
verses.wordMeaning: Remembering the warning (lit. words) of UrvasI and with his mind exclusively attached to her, he did not care to glance at any of them at all, and he climbed the peaks of the mountain.
verses.commentary: Sense: Remembering the warning (lit. words) of UrvasI and with his mind exclusively attached to her, he did not care to glance at any of them at all, and he climbed the peaks of the mountain.

verses.sanskrit: स्वागतं ते हृषीकेश सफलानि तपांसि नः । यद् साक्षादेव विश्वात्मा मद्गेहं विष्णुरागतः
verses.transliteration: svāgataṃ te hṛṣīkeśa saphalāni tapāṃsi naḥ / yad sākṣādeva viśvātmā madgehaṃ viṣṇurāgataḥ
verses.translation: Not seeing the celestial damsel there also, he became all the more afflicted by passion. Endowed with divine exploits, he went to the great Meru, the region of Devas.
verses.hindi: जगाम विपुलं लिङ्गमोंकारं मुक्तिदायकम्॥ तत्राभ्यर्च्य महादेवं शिष्यैः सह महामुनिः । इदं तद् विमलं लिङ्गमोंकारं नाम शोभनम्।
verses.wordMeaning: Not seeing the celestial damsel there also, he became all the more afflicted by passion. Endowed with divine exploits, he went to the great Meru, the region of Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Not seeing the celestial damsel there also, he became all the more afflicted by passion. Endowed with divine exploits, he went to the great Meru, the region of Devas.

verses.sanskrit: त्वां न पश्यन्ति मुनयो यतन्तो ऽपि हि योगिनः । तादृशस्याथ भवतः किमागमनकारणम्
verses.transliteration: tvāṃ na paśyanti munayo yatanto 'pi hi yoginaḥ / tādṛśasyātha bhavataḥ kimāgamanakāraṇam
verses.translation: Facilitated by the strength of his arms, he crossed over the peak and reached the lake Manasa well known in the three worlds.
verses.hindi: सेवितं सूरिभिर्नित्यं वाराणस्यां विमोक्षदम्॥ अत्र साक्षान्महादेवः पञ्जचायतनविग्रहः । रमते भगवान् रुद्रो जन्तूनामपवर्गदः॥
verses.wordMeaning: Facilitated by the strength of his arms, he crossed over the peak and reached the lake Manasa well known in the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Facilitated by the strength of his arms, he crossed over the peak and reached the lake Manasa well known in the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वोपमन्योस्तद् वाक्यं भगवान् केशिमर्दनः । व्याजहार महायोगी वचनं प्रणिपत्य तम्
verses.transliteration: śrutvopamanyostad vākyaṃ bhagavān keśimardanaḥ / vyājahāra mahāyogī vacanaṃ praṇipatya tam
verses.translation: He saw the lady of spotless limbs on its banks. The blessed lady was playfully moving about there and he gave her the garland.
verses.hindi: तदेतद् विमलं लिङ्गमोङ्कारे समवस्थितम् ॥ पञ्चानामपि देवानां ब्रह्मादीनां सदाश्रयम्। ओकारबोधकं लिङ्गं पञ्चायतनमुच्यते॥
verses.wordMeaning: He saw the lady of spotless limbs on its banks. The blessed lady was playfully moving about there and he gave her the garland.
verses.commentary: Sense: He saw the lady of spotless limbs on its banks. The blessed lady was playfully moving about there and he gave her the garland.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीकृष्ण उवाच भगवन् द्रष्टुमिच्छामि गिरीशं कृत्तिवाससम् । संप्राप्तो भवतः स्थानं भगवद्दर्शनोत्सुकः
verses.transliteration: śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca bhagavan draṣṭumicchāmi girīśaṃ kṛttivāsasam / saṃprāpto bhavataḥ sthānaṃ bhagavaddarśanotsukaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing her bedecked in the garland, he was much fascinated.Realising that he was the most blessed, he had sexual dalliance with her for a long time.
verses.hindi: संस्मरेहैश्वरं लिङ्गं पञ्जायतनमव्ययम्। अत्र देवर्षयः पूर्व सिद्धा ब्रह्मार्षयस्तथा।
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing her bedecked in the garland, he was much fascinated.Realising that he was the most blessed, he had sexual dalliance with her for a long time.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing her bedecked in the garland, he was much fascinated.Realising that he was the most blessed, he had sexual dalliance with her for a long time.

verses.sanskrit: कथं स भगवानीशो दृश्यो योगविदां वरः । मयाचिरेण कुत्राहं द्रक्ष्यामि तमुमापतिम्
verses.transliteration: kathaṃ sa bhagavānīśo dṛśyo yogavidāṃ varaḥ / mayācireṇa kutrāhaṃ drakṣyāmi tamumāpatim
verses.translation: At the end of the sexual intercourse, UrvasI enquir¬ ed of the leading king,—"O heroic king, what was done by you after going to the city?"
verses.hindi: उपास्य देवमीशानं प्राप्तवन्तः परं पदम् गोचर्ममात्रं विप्रेन्द्रा ओढङ्करेश्वरमुत्तमम्
verses.wordMeaning: At the end of the sexual intercourse, UrvasI enquir¬ ed of the leading king,—"O heroic king, what was done by you after going to the city?"
verses.commentary: Sense: At the end of the sexual intercourse, UrvasI enquir¬ ed of the leading king,—"O heroic king, what was done by you after going to the city?"

verses.sanskrit: इत्याह भगवानुक्तो दृश्यते परमेश्वरः । भक्त्या चोग्रेण तपसा तत्कुरुष्वेह यत्नतः
verses.transliteration: ityāha bhagavānukto dṛśyate parameśvaraḥ / bhaktyā cogreṇa tapasā tatkuruṣveha yatnataḥ
verses.translation: He told her everything that had been advised to by his wife, his meeting with Kanva and the seizing of the garland.
verses.hindi: कृत्तिवासेश्वरं लिङ्गं मध्यमेश्वरमुत्तमम्। विश्वेश्वर तथोंकारं कपर्दीश्वरमेव च
verses.wordMeaning: He told her everything that had been advised to by his wife, his meeting with Kanva and the seizing of the garland.
verses.commentary: Sense: He told her everything that had been advised to by his wife, his meeting with Kanva and the seizing of the garland.

verses.sanskrit: इहेश्वरं देवदेवं मुनीन्द्रा ब्रह्मवादिनः । ध्यायन्तो ऽत्रासते देवं जापिनस्तापसाश्च ये
verses.transliteration: iheśvaraṃ devadevaṃ munīndrā brahmavādinaḥ / dhyāyanto 'trāsate devaṃ jāpinastāpasāśca ye
verses.translation: On hearing what had been mentioned by him, the celestial lady, his well-wisher, spoke to him—"Go. Otherwise Kanva will curse you and your beloved wife will curse me."
verses.hindi: एवमुक्त्वा ययौ कृष्णः पाराशर्यो महामुनिः । कृत्तिवासेश्वरं लिङ्गं द्रष्टुं देवस्य शूलिनः
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing what had been mentioned by him, the celestial lady, his well-wisher, spoke to him—"Go. Otherwise Kanva will curse you and your beloved wife will curse me."
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing what had been mentioned by him, the celestial lady, his well-wisher, spoke to him—"Go. Otherwise Kanva will curse you and your beloved wife will curse me."

verses.sanskrit: इह देवः सपत्नीको भगवान् वृषभध्वजः । क्रीडते विविधैर्भूतैर्योगिभिः परिवारितः
verses.transliteration: iha devaḥ sapatnīko bhagavān vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ / krīḍate vividhairbhūtairyogibhiḥ parivāritaḥ
verses.translation: Though entreated by her thus repeatedly, the great king was so much fascinated by her charms and was so comp¬ letely attached to her in his mind, that he refused to comply with her request.
verses.hindi: भूमिकी एक विशिष्ट माप। सूतजी बोले--शिष्योंसे घिरे हुए बुद्धिमान् वे गुरु द्वैपायन मुनि मुक्तिं प्रदान करनेवाले विशाल ओङ्कार लिङ्गकी संनिधिमें गये। शिष्योंके साथ महामुनिने वहाँ महादेवकी भलीभाँति पूजा करके पवित्र आत्मावाले
verses.wordMeaning: Though entreated by her thus repeatedly, the great king was so much fascinated by her charms and was so comp¬ letely attached to her in his mind, that he refused to comply with her request.
verses.commentary: Sense: Though entreated by her thus repeatedly, the great king was so much fascinated by her charms and was so comp¬ letely attached to her in his mind, that he refused to comply with her request.

verses.sanskrit: इहाश्रमे पुरा रुद्रात् तपस्तप्त्वा सुदारुणम् । लेभे महेश्वराद् योगं वसिष्ठो भगवानृषिः
verses.transliteration: ihāśrame purā rudrāt tapastaptvā sudāruṇam / lebhe maheśvarād yogaṃ vasiṣṭho bhagavānṛṣiḥ
verses.translation: Then UrvasI who could assume any form as she pleased, always exhibited to the king her hideous form, which was very ugly, full of hair and with tawny coloured eyes.
verses.hindi: मुनियोंको उस ओङ्कार लिङ्गका माहात्म्य बताया ओङ्कार नामवाला यह लिङ्ग पवित्र एवं सुन्दर है, इसके स्मरणमात्रसे सभी पापोंसे मुक्ति मिल जाती है। वाराणसीमें विद्वानोंके द्वारा मुक्ति प्रदान करनेवाले इस अतिश्रेष्ठ ज्ञानरूप उत्तम पञ्चायतनको नित्य पूजा को
verses.wordMeaning: Then UrvasI who could assume any form as she pleased, always exhibited to the king her hideous form, which was very ugly, full of hair and with tawny coloured eyes.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then UrvasI who could assume any form as she pleased, always exhibited to the king her hideous form, which was very ugly, full of hair and with tawny coloured eyes.

verses.sanskrit: इहैव भगवान् व्यसः कृष्णद्वैपायनः प्रभुः । दृष्ट्वा तं परमं ज्ञानं लब्धवानीश्वरेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: ihaiva bhagavān vyasaḥ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaḥ prabhuḥ / dṛṣṭvā taṃ paramaṃ jñānaṃ labdhavānīśvareśvaram
verses.translation: For twelve years, he restricted his diet to fruits, roots and bulbous roots. Then the king spent another twelve years subsisting on the air only.
verses.hindi: जाती है । यहाँ प्राणियोंको मोक्ष देनेवाले साक्षात् महादेव भगवान् रुद्र पञ्चायतन-शरीर धारणकर रमण करते रहते हैं॥ ३--५॥ जो वह पाशुपत ज्ञान 'पञ्चार्थ' शब्दसे कहा जाता है, वही ज्ञान इस पवित्र लिङ्गके रूपमें ओड्ठारमें अवस्थित है। अतीता शान्ति, शान्ति, उत्कृष्ट कलावाली विद्या, प्रतिष्ठा और निवृत्ति-इन्हीं पाँच अर्थोके लिये
verses.wordMeaning: For twelve years, he restricted his diet to fruits, roots and bulbous roots. Then the king spent another twelve years subsisting on the air only.
verses.commentary: Sense: For twelve years, he restricted his diet to fruits, roots and bulbous roots. Then the king spent another twelve years subsisting on the air only.

verses.sanskrit: इहाश्रमवरे रम्ये तपस्तप्त्वा कपर्दिनः । अविन्दत् पुत्रकान् रुद्रात् सुरभिर्भक्तिसंयुता
verses.transliteration: ihāśramavare ramye tapastaptvā kapardinaḥ / avindat putrakān rudrāt surabhirbhaktisaṃyutā
verses.translation: He went to Kanva's hermitage and out of fear, told him everything, his cohabitation with the celestial lady and his performance of excellent penance, once again.
verses.hindi: इनके प्रतिनिधि-रूपमें महादेवका (ओङ्कार) लिङ्ग प्रतिष्ठित है। ब्रह्मा आदि पाँच देवोंका भी नित्य आश्रयरूप यही ओङ्कारबोधक लिङ्ग पञ्चायतन कहलाता है। अविनाशी पञ्चायतनरूप ईश्वरीय लिङ्गका स्मरण करना चाहिए, ऐसा करनेसे मनुष्य देहान्त होनेपर आनन्दस्वरूप परम ज्योतिमें प्रवेश करता है । पूर्वकालमें देवर्षियों, ब्रह्मर्षियों तथा सिद्धोंने यहीँपर भगवान् ईशानको उपासना कर परमपद प्राप्त किया था । विप्रेन्द्रो ! मत्स्योदरीके
verses.wordMeaning: He went to Kanva's hermitage and out of fear, told him everything, his cohabitation with the celestial lady and his performance of excellent penance, once again.
verses.commentary: Sense: He went to Kanva's hermitage and out of fear, told him everything, his cohabitation with the celestial lady and his performance of excellent penance, once again.

verses.sanskrit: इहैव देवताः पूर्वं कालाद् भीता महेश्वरम् । दृष्टवन्तो हरं श्रीमन्निर्भया निर्वृतिं ययुः
verses.transliteration: ihaiva devatāḥ pūrvaṃ kālād bhītā maheśvaram / dṛṣṭavanto haraṃ śrīmannirbhayā nirvṛtiṃ yayuḥ
verses.translation: On seeing that tiger-like (great) king, the holy sage became delighted. Desirous of eradicating even the seeds of his sins, he advised thus:
verses.hindi: किनारे गोचर्मके बराबर गुह्यतम शुभ पुण्य स्थान है, वही ओड्कारेश्वरका उत्तम क्षेत्र है॥ ६--११॥ द्विजोत्तमो! कृत्तिवासे श्वर, श्रेष्ठ मध्यमेश्वर, विश्वेश्वर, ओङ्कारेश्वर तथा कपर्दीधर--ये वाराणसीके गुह्य लिङ्ग हैं, बिना शंकरकी कृपाके कोई इन्हें यहाँ जान नहीं सकता। ऐसा कहकर पराशरके पुत्र महामुनि कृष्णद्वैपायन
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing that tiger-like (great) king, the holy sage became delighted. Desirous of eradicating even the seeds of his sins, he advised thus:
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing that tiger-like (great) king, the holy sage became delighted. Desirous of eradicating even the seeds of his sins, he advised thus:

verses.sanskrit: इहाराध्य महादेवं सावर्णिस्तपतां वरः । लब्धवान् परमं योगं ग्रन्थकारत्वमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: ihārādhya mahādevaṃ sāvarṇistapatāṃ varaḥ / labdhavān paramaṃ yogaṃ granthakāratvamuttamam
verses.translation: "Go to Varanasi, the divine city inhabited bylsvara. Lord Mahesvara resides there in order to liberate the whole- world.
verses.hindi: शूलधारी महादेवके कृत्तिवासेश्वर नामक लिङ्गका दर्शन करने गये कथयामास शिष्येभ्यो भगवान् ब्रह्मवित्तमः
verses.wordMeaning: "Go to Varanasi, the divine city inhabited bylsvara. Lord Mahesvara resides there in order to liberate the whole- world.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Go to Varanasi, the divine city inhabited bylsvara. Lord Mahesvara resides there in order to liberate the whole- world.

verses.sanskrit: प्रवर्तयामास शुभां कृत्वा वै संहितां द्विजः । पौराणिकीं सुपुण्यार्थां सच्छिष्येषु द्विजातिषु
verses.transliteration: pravartayāmāsa śubhāṃ kṛtvā vai saṃhitāṃ dvijaḥ / paurāṇikīṃ supuṇyārthāṃ sacchiṣyeṣu dvijātiṣu
verses.translation: By taking holy ablution in Gahga, by propiti¬ ating the deities and Pitrs duly and by seeing the Lihga of Visvesvara, you will be liberated from sins instantaneously."
verses.hindi: अस्मिन् स्थाने पुरा हैत्यो हस्ती भूत्वा भवान्तिकम्। ब्राह्मणान् हन्तुमायातो येऽत्र नित्यमुपासते तेषां लिङ्गान्महादेवः प्रादुरासीत् त्रिलोचनः । रक्षणार्थ द्विजश्रेष्ठा भक्तानां भक्तवत्सलः
verses.wordMeaning: By taking holy ablution in Gahga, by propiti¬ ating the deities and Pitrs duly and by seeing the Lihga of Visvesvara, you will be liberated from sins instantaneously."
verses.commentary: Sense: By taking holy ablution in Gahga, by propiti¬ ating the deities and Pitrs duly and by seeing the Lihga of Visvesvara, you will be liberated from sins instantaneously."

verses.sanskrit: इहैव संहितां दृष्ट्वा कापेयः शांशपायनः । महादेवं चकारेमां पौराणीं तन्नियोगतः । द्वादशैव सहस्त्राणि श्लोकानां पुरुषोत्तम
verses.transliteration: ihaiva saṃhitāṃ dṛṣṭvā kāpeyaḥ śāṃśapāyanaḥ / mahādevaṃ cakāremāṃ paurāṇīṃ tanniyogataḥ / dvādaśaiva sahastrāṇi ślokānāṃ puruṣottama
verses.translation: He bowed down to Kanva with his head, and received his permission. The invincible king had the vision of Hara at Varanasi and became absolved of all sins.
verses.hindi: हत्वा गजाकृतिं हैत्यं शूलेनावज्ञया हरः। वासस्तस्याकरोत् कृत्तिं कृत्तिवासेश्वरस्ततः अत्र सिद्धिं परां प्राप्ता मुनयो मुनिपुंगवाः । तेनेव च शरीरेण प्रा्तास्तत् परमं पदम्
verses.wordMeaning: He bowed down to Kanva with his head, and received his permission. The invincible king had the vision of Hara at Varanasi and became absolved of all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: He bowed down to Kanva with his head, and received his permission. The invincible king had the vision of Hara at Varanasi and became absolved of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: इह प्रवर्तिता पुण्या द्व्यष्टसाहस्त्रिकोत्तरा । वायवीयोत्तरं नाम पुराणं वेदसंमितम् । इहैव ख्यापितं शिष्यैः शांशपायनभाषितम्
verses.transliteration: iha pravartitā puṇyā dvyaṣṭasāhastrikottarā / vāyavīyottaraṃ nāma purāṇaṃ vedasaṃmitam / ihaiva khyāpitaṃ śiṣyaiḥ śāṃśapāyanabhāṣitam
verses.translation: He went back to his splendid city and performed a sacrifice on the Earth. On being requested, the sage Kanva, out of compassion, presided over the sacrifice.
verses.hindi: विद्या विद्येश्वरा रुद्राः शिवा ये च प्रकीर्तिताः । कृत्तिवासेश्वरं लिङ्गं नित्यमावृत्य संस्थिताः ज्ञात्वा कलियुगं घोरमधर्मबहुलं जना: । कृत्तिवासं न मुञ्चन्ति कृतार्थास्ते न संशय:
verses.wordMeaning: He went back to his splendid city and performed a sacrifice on the Earth. On being requested, the sage Kanva, out of compassion, presided over the sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: He went back to his splendid city and performed a sacrifice on the Earth. On being requested, the sage Kanva, out of compassion, presided over the sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: याज्ञवल्क्यो महायोगी दृष्ट्वात्र तपसा हरम् । चकार तन्नियोगेन योगशास्त्रमनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: yājñavalkyo mahāyogī dṛṣṭvātra tapasā haram / cakāra tanniyogena yogaśāstramanuttamam
verses.translation: His son was the intelligent Supratika. People acclaim¬ ed him as their king since his very birth.
verses.hindi: जन्मान्तरसहस्त्रेण मोक्षोऽन्यत्राप्यते न वा। एकेन जन्मना मोक्षः कृत्तिवासे तु लभ्यते गोपितं देवदेवेन महादेवेन शम्भुना
verses.wordMeaning: His son was the intelligent Supratika. People acclaim¬ ed him as their king since his very birth.
verses.commentary: Sense: His son was the intelligent Supratika. People acclaim¬ ed him as their king since his very birth.

verses.sanskrit: इहैव भृगुणा पूर्वं तप्त्वा वै परमं तपः । शुक्रो महेश्वरात् पुत्रो लब्धो योगविदां वरः
verses.transliteration: ihaiva bhṛguṇā pūrvaṃ taptvā vai paramaṃ tapaḥ / śukro maheśvarāt putro labdho yogavidāṃ varaḥ
verses.translation: From Urvasi, he had seven sons, comparable to- Devas and endowed with great prowess. All of them took daughters of Gandharvas as their wives, O Brahmanas.
verses.hindi: उपासते महादेवं जपन्ति शतरुद्रियम् स्तुवन्ति सततं देवं त्र्यम्बकं कृत्तिवाससम्। ध्यायन्ति हृदये देवं स्थाणुं सर्वान्तरं शिवम्
verses.wordMeaning: From Urvasi, he had seven sons, comparable to- Devas and endowed with great prowess. All of them took daughters of Gandharvas as their wives, O Brahmanas.
verses.commentary: Sense: From Urvasi, he had seven sons, comparable to- Devas and endowed with great prowess. All of them took daughters of Gandharvas as their wives, O Brahmanas.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादिहैव देवेशं तपस्तप्त्वा महेश्वरम् । द्रष्टुमर्हसि विश्वेशमुग्रं भीमं कपर्दिनम्
verses.transliteration: tasmādihaiva deveśaṃ tapastaptvā maheśvaram / draṣṭumarhasi viśveśamugraṃ bhīmaṃ kapardinam
verses.translation: Thus, the excellent race of Sahasrajit has been re¬ counted to you. It is a race that dispels sins of men. Now hear and understand the dynasty of Krostu too."
verses.hindi: गायन्ति सिद्धाः किल गीतकानि तेषामथैकेन भवेन्मुक्ति-
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, the excellent race of Sahasrajit has been re¬ counted to you. It is a race that dispels sins of men. Now hear and understand the dynasty of Krostu too."
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, the excellent race of Sahasrajit has been re¬ counted to you. It is a race that dispels sins of men. Now hear and understand the dynasty of Krostu too."

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा ददौ ज्ञानमुपमन्युर्महामुनिः । व्रतं पाशुपतं योगं कृष्णायाक्लिष्टकर्मणे
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā dadau jñānamupamanyurmahāmuniḥ / vrataṃ pāśupataṃ yogaṃ kṛṣṇāyākliṣṭakarmaṇe
verses.translation: This indicates the lower social status of the Satvata Sastra in its early stage.
verses.hindi: सम्प्राप्य लोके जगतामभीष्ट  कृत्ति चर्मको कहते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: This indicates the lower social status of the Satvata Sastra in its early stage.
verses.commentary: Sense: This indicates the lower social status of the Satvata Sastra in its early stage.

verses.sanskrit: स तेन मुनिवर्येण व्याहृतो मधुसूदनः । तत्रैव तपसा देवं रुद्रमाराधयत् प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: sa tena munivaryeṇa vyāhṛto madhusūdanaḥ / tatraiva tapasā devaṃ rudramārādhayat prabhuḥ
verses.translation: Apart from the uncomplimentary flight of the 'highly mighty' {sttmahabala) king Navaratha from a demon and seeking refuge in the temple of goddess Sarasvati, the concept of Sarasvati as delineated in these eulogis¬ tic verses shows a fusion of Parvati and Sarasvati. Though Sarasvati is called ■the daughter of Brahma, and is credited to have created a superior spirit to
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मज्ञानियोंमें श्रेष्ठ भगवान् व्यासने शिष्योंके साथ लिङ्गका पूजनकर शिष्योंको कृत्तिवासेश्वरका माहात्म्य बतलाया प्राचीन कालमें एक हैत्य हाथीका रूप धारणकर यहाँ शंकरके समीप नित्य उपासना करनेवाले ब्राह्मणोंको मारनेके लिये आया। द्विजश्रेष्ठो! उन भक्तोंकी रक्षाके लिये इस लिङ्गसे भक्तवत्सल महादेव त्रिलोचन प्रकट
verses.wordMeaning: Apart from the uncomplimentary flight of the 'highly mighty' {sttmahabala) king Navaratha from a demon and seeking refuge in the temple of goddess Sarasvati, the concept of Sarasvati as delineated in these eulogis¬ tic verses shows a fusion of Parvati and Sarasvati.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Apart from the uncomplimentary flight of the 'highly mighty' {sttmahabala) king Navaratha from a demon and seeking refuge in the temple of goddess Sarasvati, the concept of Sarasvati as delineated in these eulogis¬ tic verses shows a fusion of Parvati and Sarasvati.…

verses.sanskrit: भस्मौद्धूलितसर्वाङ्गो मुण्डो वल्कलसंयुतः । जजाप रुद्रमनिशं शिवैकाहितमानसः
verses.transliteration: bhasmauddhūlitasarvāṅgo muṇḍo valkalasaṃyutaḥ / jajāpa rudramaniśaṃ śivaikāhitamānasaḥ
verses.translation: For V. 9 (b) here of the Crt. edt. reads Kaiiikasya sutaS Cedis Caidyas tasydbhavan sutdh /
verses.hindi: हुए। हाथीकी आकृतिवाले उस हैत्यको अवज्ञा- पूर्वक शूलसे मारकर शंकरने उसके चर्मका वस्त्र धारण किया। उसी समयसे वे कृत्तिवासेश्वर हो श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! यहाँ मुनियोंने परम सिद्धि प्राप्त की और उसी शरीरसे परम पद अर्थात् मोक्ष भी प्राप्त किया। विद्या, विद्येश्वर, रुद्र एवं शिव नामसे कहे जानेवाले कृत्तिवासेश्वर लिङ्गको सभी देवता नित्य आवृतकर
verses.wordMeaning: For V. 9 (b) here of the Crt. edt. reads Kaiiikasya sutaS Cedis Caidyas tasydbhavan sutdh /
verses.commentary: Sense: For V. 9 (b) here of the Crt. edt. reads Kaiiikasya sutaS Cedis Caidyas tasydbhavan sutdh /

verses.sanskrit: ततो बहुतिथे काले सोमः सोमार्धभूषणः । अदृश्यत महादेवो व्योम्नि देव्या महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: tato bahutithe kāle somaḥ somārdhabhūṣaṇaḥ / adṛśyata mahādevo vyomni devyā maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: From him was born Prthuklrti, whose son was Prthudana. His (Prthudana's) son was Prthusravas and his son was Prthusattama.2
verses.hindi: स्थित रहते हैं। घोर कलियुग और अधार्मिक लोगोंकी बहुलताको समझकर जो लोग कृत्तिवासेश्वरका परित्याग नहीं करते वे निःसंदेह कृतार्थ हो जाते हैं। हजारों जन्मान्तरोंमें भी दूसरे स्थानपर मोक्ष प्राप्त होता हो अथवा नहीं, किंतु कृत्तिवास-क्षेत्रमें एक जन्ममें ही मोक्ष प्राप्त हो जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: From him was born Prthuklrti, whose son was Prthudana. His (Prthudana's) son was Prthusravas and his son was Prthusattama.2
verses.commentary: Sense: From him was born Prthuklrti, whose son was Prthudana. His (Prthudana's) son was Prthusravas and his son was Prthusattama.2

verses.sanskrit: किरीटिनं गदिनं चित्रमालं पिनाकिनं शूलिनं देवदेवम् । शार्दूलचर्माम्बरसंवृताङ्गं देव्या महादेवमसौ ददर्श
verses.transliteration: kirīṭinaṃ gadinaṃ citramālaṃ pinākinaṃ śūlinaṃ devadevam / śārdūlacarmāmbarasaṃvṛtāṅgaṃ devyā mahādevamasau dadarśa
verses.translation: Usanas was his son. His son was Satesu. From him was born Rukmakavaca whose son was Paravrtta.
verses.hindi: लोगोंका कहना है कि सभी सिंद्धोंका आश्रयरूप यह स्थान देवाधिदेव महादेव शम्भुके द्वारा सुरक्षित है। प्रत्येक युगमें वेदमें पारंगत इन्द्रियनिग्रही ब्राह्मण यहाँ महादेवको उपासना करते हें और शतरुद्रियका जप करते हैं। हृदयमें सर्वान्तरात्मा स्थाणुदेव शिवका ध्यान करते हुए कृत्तिवासा त्र्यम्बक देव (त्रिलोचन महादेव) - की निरन्तर स्तुति करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Usanas was his son. His son was Satesu. From him was born Rukmakavaca whose son was Paravrtta.
verses.commentary: Sense: Usanas was his son. His son was Satesu. From him was born Rukmakavaca whose son was Paravrtta.

verses.sanskrit: परश्वधासक्तकरं त्रिनेत्रं नृसिंहचर्मावृतसर्वगात्रम् । समुद्गिरन्तं प्रणवं बृहन्तं सहस्त्रसूर्यप्रतिमं ददर्श
verses.transliteration: paraśvadhāsaktakaraṃ trinetraṃ nṛsiṃhacarmāvṛtasarvagātram / samudgirantaṃ praṇavaṃ bṛhantaṃ sahastrasūryapratimaṃ dadarśa
verses.translation: Yamagha (Jyamagha) well known all over the world was born as his son. From him was born Vidarbha. Kratha and Kausika were born of Vidarbha.
verses.hindi: विप्रो! सिद्धजन यह गीत गाते हैं कि जो लोग वाराणसीमें निवास करते हैं और कृत्तिवासा भगवान् शिवकी शरण ग्रहण करते हैं, उनकी एक ही जन्ममें मुक्ति हो जाती है। इस लोकमें संसारको अभीष्ट अत्यन्त दुर्लभ विप्रकुलमें जन्म प्राप्तकर संयमी लोग ध्यानमें समाधिस्थ होकर रुद्रका जप करते हैं और चित्तमें
verses.wordMeaning: Yamagha (Jyamagha) well known all over the world was born as his son. From him was born Vidarbha. Kratha and Kausika were born of Vidarbha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Yamagha (Jyamagha) well known all over the world was born as his son. From him was born Vidarbha. Kratha and Kausika were born of Vidarbha.

verses.sanskrit: प्रभुं पुराणं पुरुषं पुरस्तात् सनातनं योगिनमीशितारम् । अणोरणीयांसमनन्तशक्तिं प्राणेश्वरं शंभुमसौ ददर्श
verses.transliteration: prabhuṃ purāṇaṃ puruṣaṃ purastāt sanātanaṃ yoginamīśitāram / aṇoraṇīyāṃsamanantaśaktiṃ prāṇeśvaraṃ śaṃbhumasau dadarśa
verses.translation: Lomapada was his third son. King Babhru was his (Lomapada's) son. His* son was Dhrti whose son was Sveta.
verses.hindi: महेश्वरका ध्यान करते रहते हँ यजन्ति यज्ञेरभिसंधिहीना: स्तुवन्ति रुद्रं प्रणमन्ति शम्भुम्
verses.wordMeaning: Lomapada was his third son. King Babhru was his (Lomapada's) son. His* son was Dhrti whose son was Sveta.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lomapada was his third son. King Babhru was his (Lomapada's) son. His* son was Dhrti whose son was Sveta.

verses.sanskrit: न यस्य देवा न पितामहो ऽपि नेन्द्रो न चाग्निर्वरुणो न मृत्युः । प्रभावमद्यापि वदन्ति रुद्रं तमादिदेवं पुरतो ददर्श
verses.transliteration: na yasya devā na pitāmaho 'pi nendro na cāgnirvaruṇo na mṛtyuḥ / prabhāvamadyāpi vadanti rudraṃ tamādidevaṃ purato dadarśa
verses.translation: The powerful son of Sveta is called by the name Visvasaha. His son Kausika of great virility is known for his prowess.
verses.hindi: स्थाणुं प्रपद्ये गिरिशं पुराणम्। वाराणसीमें निवास करनेवाले श्रेष्ठ मुनिजन प्रभु
verses.wordMeaning: The powerful son of Sveta is called by the name Visvasaha. His son Kausika of great virility is known for his prowess.
verses.commentary: Sense: The powerful son of Sveta is called by the name Visvasaha. His son Kausika of great virility is known for his prowess.

verses.sanskrit: तदान्वपश्यद् गिरिशस्य वामे स्वात्मानमव्यक्तमनन्तरूपम् । स्तुवन्तमीशं बहुभिर्वचोभिः शङ्खासिचक्रार्पितहस्तमाद्यम्
verses.transliteration: tadānvapaśyad giriśasya vāme svātmānamavyaktamanantarūpam / stuvantamīśaṃ bahubhirvacobhiḥ śaṅkhāsicakrārpitahastamādyam
verses.translation: The chief among them was Dyutiman. His son was Vapusman. Brhanmedhas was Vapusman's son whose son was Srideva.
verses.hindi: शंकरकी आराधना करते हैं, फलकी आकांक्षा किये बिना यज्ञोंद्वारा (उनका) यजन करते हैं, रुद्र-रूपमें उनकी स्तुति करते हैं और शम्भु-रूपमें उन्हें प्रणाम करते हैं विशुद्ध योगके आश्रयरूप भवको नमस्कार है, मैं
verses.wordMeaning: The chief among them was Dyutiman. His son was Vapusman. Brhanmedhas was Vapusman's son whose son was Srideva.
verses.commentary: Sense: The chief among them was Dyutiman. His son was Vapusman. Brhanmedhas was Vapusman's son whose son was Srideva.

verses.sanskrit: कृताञ्जलिं दक्षिणतः सुरेशं हंसाधिरूढं पुरुषं ददर्श । स्तुवानमीशस्य परं प्रभावं पितामहं लोकगुरुं दिवस्थम्
verses.transliteration: kṛtāñjaliṃ dakṣiṇataḥ sureśaṃ haṃsādhirūḍhaṃ puruṣaṃ dadarśa / stuvānamīśasya paraṃ prabhāvaṃ pitāmahaṃ lokaguruṃ divastham
verses.translation: O Brahmanas, his son was Vitaratha. He was very powerful. He was a devotee of Rudra. Kratha's son was Kunti and Vr?ni was his son.
verses.hindi: स्थाणु पुराण गिरिशकी शरण ग्रहण करता हूँ, हदयमें अवस्थित रुद्रका स्मरण करता हुँ और महादेवको
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas, his son was Vitaratha. He was very powerful. He was a devotee of Rudra. Kratha's son was Kunti and Vr?ni was his son.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas, his son was Vitaratha. He was very powerful. He was a devotee of Rudra. Kratha's son was Kunti and Vr?ni was his son.

verses.sanskrit: गणेश्वरानर्कसहस्त्रकल्पान् नन्दीश्वरादीनमितप्रभावान् । त्रिलोकभर्तुः पुरतो ऽन्वपश्यत् कुमारमग्निपतिमं सशाखम्
verses.transliteration: gaṇeśvarānarkasahastrakalpān nandīśvarādīnamitaprabhāvān / trilokabhartuḥ purato 'nvapaśyat kumāramagnipatimaṃ saśākham
verses.translation: I pay obeisance to the three-eyed, moon-crested ■goddess born of Hiranyagarbha (god Brahma) who is the Supreme Bliss, the digit of Cit (the consciousness aspect of the Brahman, nay) the very embodiment of the Brahman itself.
verses.hindi: महादेवमनेकरूपम्॥ २९॥  अनेक रूपोंमें स्थित मानता हुँ वाराणसीके कपर्दीशवर लिङ्गका माहात्म्य, पिशाचमोचन-कुण्डमें स्नान करनेकी महिमा, वहाँ स्नान करनेसे पिशाचयोनिसे मुक्ति प्राप्त करनेका आख्यान, शंकुकर्णकोी कथा तथा शंकुकर्णकृत ब्रह्मपार-स्तव
verses.wordMeaning: I pay obeisance to the three-eyed, moon-crested ■goddess born of Hiranyagarbha (god Brahma) who is the Supreme Bliss, the digit of Cit (the consciousness aspect of the Brahman, nay) the very embodiment of the Brahman itself.
verses.commentary: Sense: I pay obeisance to the three-eyed, moon-crested ■goddess born of Hiranyagarbha (god Brahma) who is the Supreme Bliss, the digit of Cit (the consciousness aspect of the Brahman, nay) the very embodiment of the Brahman itself.

verses.sanskrit: मरीचिमत्रिं पुलहं पुलस्त्यं प्रचेतसं दक्षमथापि कण्वम् । पराशरं तत्परतो वसिष्ठं स्वायंभुवं चापि मनुं ददर्श
verses.transliteration: marīcimatriṃ pulahaṃ pulastyaṃ pracetasaṃ dakṣamathāpi kaṇvam / parāśaraṃ tatparato vasiṣṭhaṃ svāyaṃbhuvaṃ cāpi manuṃ dadarśa
verses.translation: He worshipped goddess Sarasvati by means of differ¬ ent Tajnas and Homos (sacrificial offerings). His son was Dasaratha who was extremely virtuous.
verses.hindi: समाभाष्य मुनीन् धीमान् देवदेवस्य शूलिनः । जगाम लिङ्गं तद् द्रष्टुं कपर्दीश्वरमव्ययम् मृगीमेकां भक्षयितुं कपर्दीश्वरमुत्तमम्
verses.wordMeaning: He worshipped goddess Sarasvati by means of differ¬ ent Tajnas and Homos (sacrificial offerings). His son was Dasaratha who was extremely virtuous.
verses.commentary: Sense: He worshipped goddess Sarasvati by means of differ¬ ent Tajnas and Homos (sacrificial offerings). His son was Dasaratha who was extremely virtuous.

verses.sanskrit: तुष्टाव मन्त्रैरमरप्रधानं बद्धाञ्जलिर्विष्णुरुदारबुद्धिः । प्रणम्य देव्या गिरिशं सभक्त्या स्वात्मन्यथात्मानमसौ विचिन्त्य
verses.transliteration: tuṣṭāva mantrairamarapradhānaṃ baddhāñjalirviṣṇurudārabuddhiḥ / praṇamya devyā giriśaṃ sabhaktyā svātmanyathātmānamasau vicintya
verses.translation: He was a devotee of the goddess Sarasvati and was endowed with great splendour. Sakuni was his son. From him was born Karambha. His son was Devarata.
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले--मुनियोंसे इस प्रकार कहकर बुद्धिमान् (व्यासजी) देवाधिदेव त्रिशूली (भगवान् शंकर)-के कपर्दीश्वर नामक अव्यय लिङ्गका दर्शन करने गये। ब्राह्मणो ! वहाँ पिशाचमोचन तीर्थमें स्नानकर विधिपूर्वक पितरोंका तर्पणकर उन्होंने त्रिशूल धारण करनेवाले शंकरको पूजा कौ
verses.wordMeaning: He was a devotee of the goddess Sarasvati and was endowed with great splendour. Sakuni was his son. From him was born Karambha. His son was Devarata.
verses.commentary: Sense: He was a devotee of the goddess Sarasvati and was endowed with great splendour. Sakuni was his son. From him was born Karambha. His son was Devarata.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीकृष्ण उवाच नमो ऽस्तु ते शाश्वत सर्वयोने ब्रह्माधिपं त्वामृषयो वदन्ति । तपश्च सत्त्वं च रजस्तमश्च त्वामेव सर्व प्रवदन्ति सन्तः
verses.transliteration: śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca namo 'stu te śāśvata sarvayone brahmādhipaṃ tvāmṛṣayo vadanti / tapaśca sattvaṃ ca rajastamaśca tvāmeva sarva pravadanti santaḥ
verses.translation: He performed a horse-sacrifice. Devaksatra was his son. His successor was Madhu and from him was born Kuru.
verses.hindi: वहाँ गुरुदेव (व्यास)-के साथ उन मुनियोंने एक आश्चर्य देखा । उन्होंने इसे क्षेत्रका माहात्म्य समझा और गिरिश हरको प्रणाम किया। कोई भयंकर रूपवाला व्याघ्र एक मृगीका भक्षण करनेके लिये वहाँ श्रेष्ठ कपर्दीशवरके समीपमें आया। भयभीत मनवाली वह मृगी वहाँ प्रदक्षिणा करते-करते दौड़ती हुई अत्यन्त व्याकुल हो जानेसे व्याघ्रके वशीभूत हो गयी
verses.wordMeaning: He performed a horse-sacrifice. Devaksatra was his son. His successor was Madhu and from him was born Kuru.
verses.commentary: Sense: He performed a horse-sacrifice. Devaksatra was his son. His successor was Madhu and from him was born Kuru.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं ब्रह्मा हरिरथ विश्वयोनिरग्निः संहर्ता दिनकरमण्डलाधिवासः । प्राणस्त्वं हुतवहवासवादिभेद- सत्वामेकं शरणमुपैमि देवमीशम्
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ brahmā hariratha viśvayoniragniḥ saṃhartā dinakaramaṇḍalādhivāsaḥ / prāṇastvaṃ hutavahavāsavādibheda- satvāmekaṃ śaraṇamupaimi devamīśam
verses.translation: He had two sons viz. Sutraman and Anu. Ann's son was Priyagotra. The inheritor of his riches was Aihsu.
verses.hindi: अपने तीक्ष्ण नखोंसे उसे विदीर्णकर वह महान् बलशाली व्याघ्र उन मुनियोंको देखकर दूसरे जनशून्य स्थानको ओर चला गया। कपर्दीशके समक्ष ही मृत्युको प्राप्त वह बाल-अवस्थावाली मृगी आकाशमें चमकते हुए सूर्यके समान प्रभावाली, महाज्चालारूपा,
verses.wordMeaning: He had two sons viz. Sutraman and Anu. Ann's son was Priyagotra. The inheritor of his riches was Aihsu.
verses.commentary: Sense: He had two sons viz. Sutraman and Anu. Ann's son was Priyagotra. The inheritor of his riches was Aihsu.

verses.sanskrit: सांख्यास्त्वां विगुणमथाहुरेकरूपं योगास्त्वां सततमुपासते हृदिस्थम् । वेदास्त्वामभिदधतीह रुद्रमग्निं त्वामेकं शरणमुपैमि देवमीशम्
verses.transliteration: sāṃkhyāstvāṃ viguṇamathāhurekarūpaṃ yogāstvāṃ satatamupāsate hṛdistham / vedāstvāmabhidadhatīha rudramagniṃ tvāmekaṃ śaraṇamupaimi devamīśam
verses.translation: Aihsu's son was a valorous devotee of Visnu, Andhaka (v.l. satvata"") byname. He was a noble soul, engaged in charitable gifts. He was the foremost among those who know Dhanurveda (the science of Archery).
verses.hindi: त्रिनेत्रा नीलकण्ठा च शशाङ्काङ्कितमूर्धजा । वृषाधिरूढा पुरुषैस्तादूशैरेव संवृता तेषां प्रोवाच भगवान् देवाग्रे चोपविश्य सः। कपर्दीशस्य माहात्म्यं प्रणम्य वृषभध्वजम्
verses.wordMeaning: Aihsu's son was a valorous devotee of Visnu, Andhaka (v.l. satvata"") byname. He was a noble soul, engaged in charitable gifts. He was the foremost among those who know Dhanurveda (the science of Archery).
verses.commentary: Sense: Aihsu's son was a valorous devotee of Visnu, Andhaka (v.l. satvata"") byname. He was a noble soul, engaged in charitable gifts. He was the foremost among those who know Dhanurveda (the science of Archery).

verses.sanskrit: त्वात्पादे कुसुममथापि पत्रमेकं दत्त्वासौ भवति विमुक्तविश्वबन्धः । सर्वाघं प्रणुदति सिद्धयोगिजुष्टं स्मृत्वा ते पदयुगलं भवत्प्रसादात्
verses.transliteration: tvātpāde kusumamathāpi patramekaṃ dattvāsau bhavati vimuktaviśvabandhaḥ / sarvāghaṃ praṇudati siddhayogijuṣṭaṃ smṛtvā te padayugalaṃ bhavatprasādāt
verses.translation: At the instance of Narada, he, engaged in worship¬ ping Vasudeva, composed the sacred scripture (usually) listened to by Kunda (son born of an adulterous woman), Gola (widow's son) and others.
verses.hindi: इदं देवस्य तल्लिङ्गं कपर्दीश्वरमुत्तमम्। स्मृत्वैवाशेषपापौघं क्षिप्रमस्य विमुञ्चति कामक्रोधादयो दोषा वाराणसीनिवासिनाम्। विघ्नाः सर्वे विनश्यन्ति कपर्दीश्वरपूजनात्
verses.wordMeaning: At the instance of Narada, he, engaged in worship¬ ping Vasudeva, composed the sacred scripture (usually) listened to by Kunda (son born of an adulterous woman), Gola (widow's son) and others.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the instance of Narada, he, engaged in worship¬ ping Vasudeva, composed the sacred scripture (usually) listened to by Kunda (son born of an adulterous woman), Gola (widow's son) and others.

verses.sanskrit: यस्याशेषविभागहीनममलं हृद्यन्तरावस्थितं तत्त्वं ज्योतिरनन्तमेकमचलं सत्यं परं सर्वगम् । स्थानं प्राहुरनादिमध्यनिधनं यस्मादिदं जायते नित्यं त्वामहमुपैमि सत्यविभवंविश्वेश्वरन्तंशिवम्
verses.transliteration: yasyāśeṣavibhāgahīnamamalaṃ hṛdyantarāvasthitaṃ tattvaṃ jyotiranantamekamacalaṃ satyaṃ paraṃ sarvagam / sthānaṃ prāhuranādimadhyanidhanaṃ yasmādidaṃ jāyate nityaṃ tvāmahamupaimi satyavibhavaṃviśveśvarantaṃśivam
verses.translation: A great scripture well known after his name, auspi¬ cious to Satvatas and conducive to the welfare of Kunda and others has been still current.
verses.hindi: तस्मात् सहैव द्रष्टव्यं कपर्दीश्वरमुत्तमम्। पूजितव्यं प्रयत्नेन स्तोतव्यं वैदिकैः स्तवैः जायते योगसंसिद्धः सा षण्मासे न संशयः
verses.wordMeaning: A great scripture well known after his name, auspi¬ cious to Satvatas and conducive to the welfare of Kunda and others has been still current.
verses.commentary: Sense: A great scripture well known after his name, auspi¬ cious to Satvatas and conducive to the welfare of Kunda and others has been still current.

verses.sanskrit: ॐ नमो नीलकण्ठाय त्रिनेत्राय च रंहसे । महादेवाय ते नित्यमीशानाय नमो नमः
verses.transliteration: oṃ namo nīlakaṇṭhāya trinetrāya ca raṃhase / mahādevāya te nityamīśānāya namo namaḥ
verses.translation: Satvata was his son. He was expert in all scriptures (or branches of knowledge) and a great king of meritorious reputation. They say that sacred lore (viz. Satvata Sastra) was founded by him.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्महत्यादयः पापा विनश्यन्त्यस्य पूजनात्। पिशाचमोचने कुण्डे स्त्रातस्यात्र समीपतः शंकुकर्ण इति ख्यातः पूजयामास शंकरम्। जजाप रुद्रमनिशं प्रणवं ब्रह्मरूपिणम्
verses.wordMeaning: Satvata was his son. He was expert in all scriptures (or branches of knowledge) and a great king of meritorious reputation. They say that sacred lore (viz. Satvata Sastra) was founded by him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Satvata was his son. He was expert in all scriptures (or branches of knowledge) and a great king of meritorious reputation. They say that sacred lore (viz. Satvata Sastra) was founded by him.

verses.sanskrit: नमः पिनाकिने तुभ्यं नमो मुण्डाय दण्डिने । नमस्ते वज्रहस्ताय दिग्वस्त्राय कपर्दिने
verses.transliteration: namaḥ pinākine tubhyaṃ namo muṇḍāya daṇḍine / namaste vajrahastāya digvastrāya kapardine
verses.translation: While performing penance he wished thus: May a son endowed with good qualities be born to me." A king of auspicious fame, and a sovereign ruler over all, well known as Babhru was his son.
verses.hindi: पुष्पधूपादिभिः स्तोत्रैर्नमस्कारैः प्रदक्षिणैः । उवास तत्र योगात्मा कृत्वा दीक्षां तु नैष्ठिकीम् तं दृष्टा स मुनिश्रेष्ठः कृपया परया युतः। प्रोवाच को भवान् कस्माद् देशाद् देशमिमं श्रितः
verses.wordMeaning: While performing penance he wished thus: May a son endowed with good qualities be born to me." A king of auspicious fame, and a sovereign ruler over all, well known as Babhru was his son.
verses.commentary: Sense: While performing penance he wished thus: May a son endowed with good qualities be born to me." A king of auspicious fame, and a sovereign ruler over all, well known as Babhru was his son.

verses.sanskrit: नमो भैरवनादाय कालरूपाय दंष्ट्रिणे । नागयज्ञोपवीताय नमस्ते वह्निरेतसे
verses.transliteration: namo bhairavanādāya kālarūpāya daṃṣṭriṇe / nāgayajñopavītāya namaste vahniretase
verses.translation: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*
verses.hindi: पूर्वजन्मन्यहं विप्रो धनधान्यसमन्वितः। पुत्रपौत्रादिभिर्युक्तः कुटुम्बभरणोत्सुकः तीन नेत्रोंबाली, नीलकण्ठवाली, चन्द्रमासे सुशोभित मस्तकवाली और वृषभपर आरूढ़ तथा शिवके समान ही पुरुषोंसे समन्वित दिखलायी पड़ी। उसके मस्तकपर आकाशचारी (गन्धर्व आदि) फूलोंकी वर्षा कर रहे थे।
verses.wordMeaning: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*
verses.commentary: Sense: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*

verses.sanskrit: नमो ऽस्तु ते गिरीशाय स्वाहाकाराय ते नमः । नमो मुक्ताट्टहासाय भीमाय च नमो नमः
verses.transliteration: namo 'stu te girīśāya svāhākārāya te namaḥ / namo muktāṭṭahāsāya bhīmāya ca namo namaḥ
verses.translation: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर वह स्वयं गणेश्वर होकर तत्क्षण ही अदृश्य आश्चर्य देखकर अच्युतस्वरूप गुरु (व्यास)-से कपर्दीश्वरका माहात्म्य पूछा॥ ६--१० ॥
verses.wordMeaning: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*
verses.commentary: Sense: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*

verses.sanskrit: नमस्ते कामनाशाय नमः कालप्रमाथिने । नमो भैरववेषाय हराय च निषङ्गिणे
verses.transliteration: namaste kāmanāśāya namaḥ kālapramāthine / namo bhairavaveṣāya harāya ca niṣaṅgiṇe
verses.translation: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*
verses.hindi: उन भगवान् व्यासने (कपर्दीश्वर) देवके समीपमें बैठकर वृषभध्वजको प्रणाम करके कपर्दीशका माहात्म्य उन्हें बतलाया  यह देवका वही श्रेष्ठ कपर्दी धर नामक लिङ्ग है, जिसका स्मरणमात्र करनेसे ही स्मरण करनेवालेका अशेष पापसमूह शीघ्र ही नष्ट हो जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*
verses.commentary: Sense: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*

verses.sanskrit: नमो ऽस्तु ते त्र्यम्बकाय नमस्ते कृत्तिवाससे । नमो ऽम्बिकाधिपतये पशूनां पतये नमः
verses.transliteration: namo 'stu te tryambakāya namaste kṛttivāsase / namo 'mbikādhipataye paśūnāṃ pataye namaḥ
verses.translation: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*
verses.hindi: वाराणसीमें निवास करनेवाले लोगोंके काम, क्रोध आदि दोष और सभी विघ्न कपर्दीधरका पूजन करनेसे विनष्ट हो जाते हैं। इसलिये श्रेष्ठ कपर्दीश्वरका सदा ही दर्शन करना चाहिए, प्रयत्नपूर्वक पूजन करना चाहिए और वैदिक स्तोत्रोंसे उनकी स्तुति करनी चाहिए। शान्त चित्तवाले योगियोंको यहाँ नियमित ध्यान करते हुए छः महीनेमें ही उत्कृष्ट योगसिद्धि प्राप्त हो जाती है, इसमें कोई संशय नहीं है॥ १३--१५॥
verses.wordMeaning: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*
verses.commentary: Sense: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*

verses.sanskrit: नमस्ते व्योमरूपाय व्योमाधिपतये नमः । नरनारीशरीराय सांख्ययोगप्रवर्तिने
verses.transliteration: namaste vyomarūpāya vyomādhipataye namaḥ / naranārīśarīrāya sāṃkhyayogapravartine
verses.translation: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*
verses.hindi: यहाँ समीपमें स्थित पिशाचमोचन कुण्डमें स्नानकर इस लिङ्गका पूजन करनेसे ब्रह्महत्या आदि सभी पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं। ब्राह्मणो! प्राचीन कालमें शंकुकर्ण नामसे प्रसिद्ध कठोर व्रतवाले तपस्वीने इस क्षेत्रमें शंकरको पूजा को थी। वह रात-दिन प्रणव एवं ब्रह्मस्वरूप रुद्रका जप करता था। निष्ठापूर्वक दीक्षा ग्रहण कर वह योगात्मा पुष्प, धूप आदिसे तथा स्तोत्र, नमस्कार एवं प्रदक्षिणाके द्वारा (पूजा करता हुआ) वहाँ
verses.wordMeaning: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*
verses.commentary: Sense: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*

verses.sanskrit: नमो दैवतनाथाय देवानुगतलिङ्गिने । कुमारगुरवे तुभ्यं देवदेवाय ते नमः
verses.transliteration: namo daivatanāthāya devānugataliṅgine / kumāragurave tubhyaṃ devadevāya te namaḥ
verses.translation: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*
verses.hindi: रहने लगा। किसी दिन उसने भूखसे व्याकुल अस्थि एवं चर्मसे व्याप्त शरीरवाले और बार-बार साँस ले रहे एक आते हुए प्रेतको देखा। उसे देखकर उस श्रेष्ठ मुनिने अत्यन्त कृपासे युक्त होकर उससे कहा-आप कौन हैं? कहाँसे इस देशमें आये हैं ?॥ १६--२० ॥
verses.wordMeaning: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*
verses.commentary: Sense: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*

verses.sanskrit: तमो यज्ञाधिपतये नमस्ते ब्रह्मचारिणे । मृगव्याधाय महते ब्रह्माधिपतये नमः
verses.transliteration: tamo yajñādhipataye namaste brahmacāriṇe / mṛgavyādhāya mahate brahmādhipataye namaḥ
verses.translation: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*
verses.hindi: क्षुधासे पीडित पिशाचने उससे कहा--पूर्वजन्ममें मैं धनधान्यसे सम्पन्न, पुत्र-पौत्रादिकोंसे युक्त, परिवारके भरण-पोषणमें उत्सुक रहनेवाला एक ब्राह्मण था, न पूजिता मया देवा गावोऽप्यतिथयस्तथा। न कदाचित् कृतं पुण्यमल्पं वा स्वल्पमेव वा
verses.wordMeaning: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*
verses.commentary: Sense: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*

verses.sanskrit: नमो हंसाय विश्वाय मोहनाय नमो नमः । योगिने योगगम्याय योगमायाय ते नमः
verses.transliteration: namo haṃsāya viśvāya mohanāya namo namaḥ / yogine yogagamyāya yogamāyāya te namaḥ
verses.translation: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*
verses.hindi: एकदा भगवान् देवो गोवृषेश्वरवाहनः । विश्वेश्वरो वाराणस्यां दृष्ट: स्पृष्टो नमस्कृतः तदाचिरेण कालेन पञ्चत्वमहमागतः। न दृष्टं तन्मया घोरं यमस्य वदनं मुने
verses.wordMeaning: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*
verses.commentary: Sense: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*

verses.sanskrit: नमस्ते प्राणपालाय घण्टानादप्रियाय च । कपालिने नमस्तुभ्यं ज्योतिषां पतये नमः
verses.transliteration: namaste prāṇapālāya ghaṇṭānādapriyāya ca / kapāline namastubhyaṃ jyotiṣāṃ pataye namaḥ
verses.translation: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*
verses.hindi: इत्युक्तः शङ्कुकर्णोऽथ पिशाचमिदमब्रवीत्। त्वादूशो न हि लोकेऽस्मिन् विद्यते पुण्यकृत्तमः यत् त्वया भगवान् पूर्व दृष्टो विश्वेश्वरः शिव: । संस्पृष्टो वन्दितो भूयः कोऽन्यस्त्वत्सदूशो भुवि
verses.wordMeaning: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*
verses.commentary: Sense: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*

verses.sanskrit: नमो नमो नमस्तुभ्यं भूय एव नमो नमः । मह्यं सर्वात्मना कामान् प्रयच्छ परमेश्वर
verses.transliteration: namo namo namastubhyaṃ bhūya eva namo namaḥ / mahyaṃ sarvātmanā kāmān prayaccha parameśvara
verses.translation: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*
verses.hindi: तेन कर्मविपाकेन देशमेतं समागतः । स एवमुक्तो मुनिना पिशाचो दयालुना देववरं
verses.wordMeaning: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*
verses.commentary: Sense: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*

verses.sanskrit: एवं हि भक्त्या देवेशमभिष्टूय स माधवः । पपात पादयोर्विप्रा देवदेव्योः स दण्डवत्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ hi bhaktyā deveśamabhiṣṭūya sa mādhavaḥ / papāta pādayorviprā devadevyoḥ sa daṇḍavat
verses.translation: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*
verses.hindi: तदावगाढो मुनिसंनिधाने विभाति रुहैरभितो दिविस्थैः
verses.wordMeaning: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*
verses.commentary: Sense: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*

verses.sanskrit: उत्थाप्य भगवान् सोमः कृष्णं केशिनिषूदनम् । बभाषे मधुरं वाक्यं मेघगम्भीरनिः स्वनः
verses.transliteration: utthāpya bhagavān somaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ keśiniṣūdanam / babhāṣe madhuraṃ vākyaṃ meghagambhīraniḥ svanaḥ
verses.translation: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*
verses.hindi: सबालखिल्यादिभिरेष देवो यथोदये भान्रशेषदेवः किंतु मैंने न तो कभी देवताओंकी पूजा की न गायोंको और न तो अतिथियोंकी, मैंने कभी छोटे-से भी छोटा पुण्य नहीं किया। एक बारकी बात है कि वाराणसीमें मैंने वृषभवाहन भगवान् विश्वेश्वरदेवका दर्शन किया,
verses.wordMeaning: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*
verses.commentary: Sense: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*

verses.sanskrit: किमर्थं पुण्डरीकाक्ष तपस्तप्तं त्वयाव्यय । त्वमेव दाता सर्वेषां कामानां कामिनामिह
verses.transliteration: kimarthaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣa tapastaptaṃ tvayāvyaya / tvameva dātā sarveṣāṃ kāmānāṃ kāmināmiha
verses.translation: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*
verses.hindi: स्पर्श किया और उन्हें नमस्कार किया। तदनन्तर बहुत थोड़े ही समयके बाद मेरी मृत्यु हो गयी। है मुने! (इसी पुण्यके कारण) मुझे यमके भयानक मुखको तो नहाँ देखना पड़ा, पर इस प्रकारकी पिशाचयोनि प्राप्तकर भूख और प्याससे व्याकुल मैं वाराणसीमें ही भटक रहा हूँ। इस समय मुझे हित और अहितका कुछ भी ज्ञान नहीं है। प्रभो! मेरे उद्धारका यदि कोई उपाय आप देखते हों तो उसे करें, आपको नमस्कार है, मैं आपको शरणे
verses.wordMeaning: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*
verses.commentary: Sense: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*

verses.sanskrit: त्वं हि सा परमा मूर्तिर्मम नारायणाह्वया । नानवाप्तं त्वया तात विद्यते पुरुषोत्तम
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ hi sā paramā mūrtirmama nārāyaṇāhvayā / nānavāptaṃ tvayā tāta vidyate puruṣottama
verses.translation: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*
verses.hindi: ऐसा कहे जानेपर शंकुकर्णने पिशाचसे कहा- तुम्हारे समान इस संसारमें श्रेष्ठ पुण्य कर्म करनेवाला और कोई नहीं है, जो कि तुमने पूर्वकालमें विश्वेश्वर भगवान् शिवका दर्शन किया, उनका स्पर्श किया और वन्दना की, फिर संसारमें तुम्हारे समान और कौन हो सकता है? उस कर्मके परिणामस्वरूप ही तुम इस स्थानपर पहुँचे हो। अब तुम एकाग्रमन होकर इस कुण्डमे शीघ्र ही स्नान करो। जिससे इस कुत्सित (पिशाचकी)
verses.wordMeaning: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*
verses.commentary: Sense: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*

verses.sanskrit: वेत्थ नारायणानन्तमात्मानं परमेश्वरम् । महादेवं महायोगं स्वेन योगेन केशव
verses.transliteration: vettha nārāyaṇānantamātmānaṃ parameśvaram / mahādevaṃ mahāyogaṃ svena yogena keśava
verses.translation: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*
verses.hindi: योनिसे तुम शीघ्र ही छुटकारा प्राप्त कर सको दयालु मुनिके ऐसा कहनेपर उस पिशाचने देवश्रेष्ठ त्रिलोचन, अनुशास्ता भगवान् कपर्दीश्‍वरका स्मरण कर मनको एकाग्र करते हुए (कुण्डमें) स्नान किया
verses.wordMeaning: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*
verses.commentary: Sense: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा तद्वचनं कृष्णः प्रहसन् वै वृषध्वजम् । उवाच वीक्ष्य विश्वेशं देवीं च हिमशैलजाम्
verses.transliteration: śrutvā tadvacanaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ prahasan vai vṛṣadhvajam / uvāca vīkṣya viśveśaṃ devīṃ ca himaśailajām
verses.translation: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर स्नान किया हुआ वह मुनिके समीप ही मृत्युको प्राप्त हो गया और पुनः सूर्यके समान प्रकाशित विमानमें स्थित हो वह दिव्य आभूषणोंको धारण किये तथा चन्द्रमाके चिह्वसे सुशोभित सुन्दर मस्तकसे युक्त (पुरुषके रूपमें) दिखायी पड़ा। वह आकाशमें स्थित रहनेवाले रुद्रों, अप्रमेय योगियों तथा बालखिल्य आदि ऋषियोंसे चारों ओरसे आवृत होते हुए उसी प्रकार सुशोभित हो रहा था, जिस प्रकार
verses.wordMeaning: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*
verses.commentary: Sense: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञातं हि भवता सर्वं स्वेन योगेन शङ्कर । इच्छाम्यात्मसमं पुत्रं त्वद्भक्तं देहि शङ्कर
verses.transliteration: jñātaṃ hi bhavatā sarvaṃ svena yogena śaṅkara / icchāmyātmasamaṃ putraṃ tvadbhaktaṃ dehi śaṅkara
verses.translation: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*
verses.hindi: सभी देवताओंके भी देवता सूर्यदेबता उदयकालमें दिखलायी पड़ते हैं स्तुवन्ति सिद्धा दिवि देवसङ्घा
verses.wordMeaning: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*
verses.commentary: Sense: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*

verses.sanskrit: तथास्त्वित्याह विश्वात्मा प्रहृष्टमनसा हरः । देवीमालोक्य गिरिजां केशवं परिषस्वजे
verses.transliteration: tathāstvityāha viśvātmā prahṛṣṭamanasā haraḥ / devīmālokya girijāṃ keśavaṃ pariṣasvaje
verses.translation: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*
verses.hindi: मुनिः प्रहृष्टो मनसा महेशम्। त्वां ब्रह्मपारं हदि संनिविष्टं
verses.wordMeaning: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*
verses.commentary: Sense: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*

verses.sanskrit: ततः सा जगतां माता शङ्करार्धशरीरिणी । व्याजहार हृषीकेशं देवी हिमगिरीन्द्रजा
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sā jagatāṃ mātā śaṅkarārdhaśarīriṇī / vyājahāra hṛṣīkeśaṃ devī himagirīndrajā
verses.translation: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*
verses.hindi: महामुनिं ब्रह्ममयं पवित्रम् त्वां ब्रह्मपारं प्रणमामि शम्भुं
verses.wordMeaning: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*
verses.commentary: Sense: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*

verses.sanskrit: वत्स जाने तवानन्तां निश्चलां सर्वदाच्युत । अनन्यामीश्वरे भक्तिमात्मन्यपि च केशव
verses.transliteration: vatsa jāne tavānantāṃ niścalāṃ sarvadācyuta / ananyāmīśvare bhaktimātmanyapi ca keśava
verses.translation: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*
verses.hindi: येनावृतं सर्वमिदं शिवेन। तं ब्रह्मपारं भगवन्तमीशं
verses.wordMeaning: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*
verses.commentary: Sense: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*

verses.sanskrit: त्वं हि नारायणः साक्षात् सर्वात्मा पुरुषोत्तमः । प्रार्थितो दैवतैः पूर्वं संजातो दैवकीसुतः
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ hi nārāyaṇaḥ sākṣāt sarvātmā puruṣottamaḥ / prārthito daivataiḥ pūrvaṃ saṃjāto daivakīsutaḥ
verses.translation: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*
verses.hindi: अलिङ्गमालोकविहीनरूपं स्वयम्प्रभं चित्पतिमेकरुद्रम्। तं ब्रह्मपारं परमेश्वर त्वां
verses.wordMeaning: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*
verses.commentary: Sense: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*

verses.sanskrit: पश्य त्वमात्मनात्मानमात्मीयममलं पदम् । नावयोर्विद्यते भेद एवं पश्यन्ति सूरयः
verses.transliteration: paśya tvamātmanātmānamātmīyamamalaṃ padam / nāvayorvidyate bheda evaṃ paśyanti sūrayaḥ
verses.translation: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*
verses.hindi: नमस्करिष्ये न यतोऽन्यदस्ति आकाशमें सिद्ध तथा देवताओंके समूह (उसकी) स्तुति कर रहे थे। दिव्य सुन्दर अप्सराएँ नृत्य कर रही थीं और गन्धर्व, विद्याधर तथा किंनर आदि जलसे स्निग्ध पुष्पोंको वृष्टि कर रहे थे
verses.wordMeaning: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*
verses.commentary: Sense: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*

verses.sanskrit: इमानिमान् वरानिष्टान् मत्तो गृह्णीष्व केशव । सर्वज्ञत्वं तथैश्वर्यं ज्ञानं तत् पारमेश्वरम् । ईश्वरे निश्चलां भक्तिमात्मन्यपि परं बलम्
verses.transliteration: imānimān varāniṣṭān matto gṛhṇīṣva keśava / sarvajñatvaṃ tathaiśvaryaṃ jñānaṃ tat pārameśvaram / īśvare niścalāṃ bhaktimātmanyapi paraṃ balam
verses.translation: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*
verses.hindi: मुनियोंके समूहोंसे स्तुति किये जाते हुए उसने भगवानूकी कृपासे ज्ञान प्राप्त किया और वह उस त्रयीमय श्रेष्ठ मण्डलमें प्रविष्ट हो गया जहाँ रुद्र प्रकाशित होते हैं। पिशाचयोनिको प्राप्त उस (पुरुष) - को मुक्त हुआ देखकर वह मुनि अत्यन्त प्रसन्न-मनसे महेशका ध्यानकर और कवि अद्वितीय रुूद्राग्निको प्रणामकर उन जटाधारी (शिव)-को स्तुति करने लगे
verses.wordMeaning: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*
verses.commentary: Sense: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तस्तया कृष्णो महादेव्या जनार्दनः । आशिषं शिरसाहृङ्णाद् देवो ऽप्याह महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: evamuktastayā kṛṣṇo mahādevyā janārdanaḥ / āśiṣaṃ śirasāhṛṅṇād devo 'pyāha maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*
verses.hindi: शंकुकर्णने कहा--में परात्पर, अद्वितीय, सबके रक्षक, पुराणपुरुष, योगेश्वर, नियामक, आदित्य, अग्निरूप एवं कपिल (वृषभ)-पर अधिष्ठित आप कपर्दीकी शरण ग्रहण करता हूँ में हृदयमें संनिविष्ट, हिरण्मय, योगी, आदि एवं अन्तरूप, द्युलोकमें स्थित, महामुनि, पवित्र और ब्रह्मस्वरूप आप ब्रह्मपार रुद्रकी शरणमें जाता हूँ। में हजारों चरण, नेत्र और सिरोंसे युक्त, हजारों
verses.wordMeaning: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*
verses.commentary: Sense: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*

verses.sanskrit: प्रगृह्य कृष्णं भगवानथेशः करेण देव्या सह देवदेवः । संपूज्यमानो मुनिभिः सुरेशै- र् जगाम कैलासगिरिं गिरीशः
verses.transliteration: pragṛhya kṛṣṇaṃ bhagavānatheśaḥ kareṇa devyā saha devadevaḥ / saṃpūjyamāno munibhiḥ sureśai- r jagāma kailāsagiriṃ girīśaḥ
verses.translation: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*
verses.hindi: बाहुवाले, अन्धकारसे परे रहनेवाले, हिरण्यगर्भके अधिपति और तीन नेत्रवाले आप ज्ञानातीत शम्भुको प्रणाम करता हूँ। जिनसे संसारकी उत्पत्ति तथा विनाश होता है और जिन शिवने इस सम्पूर्ण (विश्व)- को आवृत कर रखा है, उन्हीं ज्ञानातीत भगवान् ईशको प्रणाम कर मैं उनको नित्य शरण ग्रहण करता हूँ। में अलिङ्ग- (निराकार) और आलोकरहित रूपवाले, स्वयं प्रभावान्, चित्-शक्तिके स्वामी, अद्वितीय
verses.wordMeaning: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*
verses.commentary: Sense: He was virtuous, endowed with beauty and always engaged in attaining the knowledge of Truth. From Bhajamana were born Bhajamanas who resorted to divine Sri (glory).*

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपूराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे चतुर्विशो ऽध्यायः सूत उवाच प्रविश्य मेरुशिखरं कैलासं कनकप्रभम् । रराम भगवान् सोमः केशवेन महेश्वरः
