verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapūrāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge caturviśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca praviśya meruśikharaṃ kailāsaṃ kanakaprabham / rarāma bhagavān somaḥ keśavena maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Nimi and Krkana were the most well-known and the most important among them. Bhojas and Vaimatrkas were born in the family of Mahabhoja.
verses.hindi: रुद्ररूप, ज्ञानसे अतीत आप परमेश्वरको नमस्कार करता हूँ, क्योंकि आपसे भिन्न अन्य कुछ है ही नहीं ॥ ३७--४० ॥  महेशवरका रूप किसी भी आलोक (प्रकाश)-से आलोकित (प्रकाशित) नहीं होता, अपितु स्वयं प्रकाशमान है और उसीके
verses.wordMeaning: Nimi and Krkana were the most well-known and the most important among them. Bhojas and Vaimatrkas were born in the family of Mahabhoja.
verses.commentary: Sense: Nimi and Krkana were the most well-known and the most important among them. Bhojas and Vaimatrkas were born in the family of Mahabhoja.

verses.sanskrit: अपश्यंस्तं महात्मानं कैलासगिरिवासिनः । पूजयाञ्चक्रिरे कृष्णं देवदेवमथाच्युतम्
verses.transliteration: apaśyaṃstaṃ mahātmānaṃ kailāsagirivāsinaḥ / pūjayāñcakrire kṛṣṇaṃ devadevamathācyutam
verses.translation: From Vrsni were born Sumitra, the powerful, as well as Anamitra and Timi. From Anamitra was bom Nighna. Nighna had two sons.
verses.hindi: प्रकाशसे समस्त प्रपञ्च सूर्य, चन्द्र आदि प्रकाशित हैं। पश्यन्ति देवं प्रणतोऽस्मि नित्यं
verses.wordMeaning: From Vrsni were born Sumitra, the powerful, as well as Anamitra and Timi. From Anamitra was bom Nighna. Nighna had two sons.
verses.commentary: Sense: From Vrsni were born Sumitra, the powerful, as well as Anamitra and Timi. From Anamitra was bom Nighna. Nighna had two sons.

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्बाहुमुदाराङ्गं कालमेघसमप्रभम् । किरीटिनं शार्ङ्गपाणि श्रीवत्साङ्कितवक्षसम्
verses.transliteration: caturbāhumudārāṅgaṃ kālameghasamaprabham / kirīṭinaṃ śārṅgapāṇi śrīvatsāṅkitavakṣasam
verses.translation: They were the highly fortunate Prasena and the excellent one named Satrajit. From Anamitra, the son of Vrsni, was born Sini (rather 'Sini') as the youngest son.
verses.hindi: तं ब्रह्मपारं भवतः स्वरूपम् तं ब्रह्मपारं प्रणतोऽस्मि नित्यं
verses.wordMeaning: They were the highly fortunate Prasena and the excellent one named Satrajit. From Anamitra, the son of Vrsni, was born Sini (rather 'Sini') as the youngest son.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were the highly fortunate Prasena and the excellent one named Satrajit. From Anamitra, the son of Vrsni, was born Sini (rather 'Sini') as the youngest son.

verses.sanskrit: दीर्घबाहुं विशालाक्षं पीतवाससमच्युतम् । दधानमुरसा मालां वैजयन्तीमनुत्तमाम्
verses.transliteration: dīrghabāhuṃ viśālākṣaṃ pītavāsasamacyutam / dadhānamurasā mālāṃ vaijayantīmanuttamām
verses.translation: He was truthful in speech. He was richly endowed with fidelity. Satyaka was his son. Satyaka's son was Yuyudhana. His son was Asahga.
verses.hindi: सब्रह्माविज्ञानमभेदमेकम्  तं ब्रह्मपारं प्रणतोऽस्मि नित्यम्
verses.wordMeaning: He was truthful in speech. He was richly endowed with fidelity. Satyaka was his son. Satyaka's son was Yuyudhana. His son was Asahga.
verses.commentary: Sense: He was truthful in speech. He was richly endowed with fidelity. Satyaka was his son. Satyaka's son was Yuyudhana. His son was Asahga.

verses.sanskrit: भ्राजमानं श्रिया दिव्यं युवानमतिकोमलम् । पद्माङ्घ्रिनयनं चारु सुस्मितं सुगतिप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: bhrājamānaṃ śriyā divyaṃ yuvānamatikomalam / padmāṅghrinayanaṃ cāru susmitaṃ sugatipradam
verses.translation: He begot of her a virtuous son named Akrura. He had many other sons Upamahgu, Mahgu and others.
verses.hindi: यतः प्रधानं पुरुषः पुराणो विवर्तते यं प्रणमन्ति देवाः।
verses.wordMeaning: He begot of her a virtuous son named Akrura. He had many other sons Upamahgu, Mahgu and others.
verses.commentary: Sense: He begot of her a virtuous son named Akrura. He had many other sons Upamahgu, Mahgu and others.

verses.sanskrit: कदाचित् तत्र लीलार्थं देवकीनन्दवर्धनः । भ्राजमानः श्रीया कृष्णश्चचार गिरिकन्दरे
verses.transliteration: kadācit tatra līlārthaṃ devakīnandavardhanaḥ / bhrājamānaḥ śrīyā kṛṣṇaścacāra girikandare
verses.translation: Akrura's son was well known as Devavan and the divine-souled Upadeva who had sons called Visva and Prama- thin.
verses.hindi: कालं बृहन्तं भवतः स्वरूपम् शिवं प्रपद्ये हरमिन्दुमौलिं
verses.wordMeaning: Akrura's son was well known as Devavan and the divine-souled Upadeva who had sons called Visva and Prama- thin.
verses.commentary: Sense: Akrura's son was well known as Devavan and the divine-souled Upadeva who had sons called Visva and Prama- thin.

verses.sanskrit: गन्धर्वाप्सरसां मुख्या नागकन्याश्च कृत्स्नशः । सिद्धा यक्षाश्च गन्धर्वास्तत्र तत्र जगन्मयम्
verses.transliteration: gandharvāpsarasāṃ mukhyā nāgakanyāśca kṛtsnaśaḥ / siddhā yakṣāśca gandharvāstatra tatra jaganmayam
verses.translation: Citraka's sons were Prthu, Viprthu, Asvagriva, Subahu, Sudhasvaka (v.l. Suparsvaka) and Gaveksaka (v.l. Gavesana).
verses.hindi: स्तुत्वैवं शङ्कुकर्णोऽसौ भगवन्तं कपर्दिनम्। पपात दण्डवद् भूमौ प्रोच्चरन् प्रणवं परम् तत्क्षणात् परमं लिङ्गं प्रादुर्भूतं शिवात्मकम्। ज्ञानमानन्दमद्वैतं कोटिकालाग्निसंनिभम्
verses.wordMeaning: Citraka's sons were Prthu, Viprthu, Asvagriva, Subahu, Sudhasvaka (v.l. Suparsvaka) and Gaveksaka (v.l. Gavesana).
verses.commentary: Sense: Citraka's sons were Prthu, Viprthu, Asvagriva, Subahu, Sudhasvaka (v.l. Suparsvaka) and Gaveksaka (v.l. Gavesana).

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वाश्चर्यं परं गत्वा हर्षादुत्फुल्लोचनाः । मुमुचुः पुष्पवर्षाणि तस्य मूर्ध्नि महात्मनः
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvāścaryaṃ paraṃ gatvā harṣādutphullocanāḥ / mumucuḥ puṣpavarṣāṇi tasya mūrdhni mahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: He begot of the daughter of Andhaka, four sons, viz. Kukura, Bhajamana, Samika and Balagarvita.
verses.hindi: शङ्कुकर्णोऽथ मुक्तात्मा तदात्मा सर्वगोऽमलः। निलिल्ये विमले लिङ्गे तददभुतमिवाभवत् य इमां शृणुयान्नित्यं कथां पापप्रणाशिनीम्। भक्तः पापविशुद्धात्मा रुद्रसामीप्यमाप्नुयात्
verses.wordMeaning: He begot of the daughter of Andhaka, four sons, viz. Kukura, Bhajamana, Samika and Balagarvita.
verses.commentary: Sense: He begot of the daughter of Andhaka, four sons, viz. Kukura, Bhajamana, Samika and Balagarvita.

verses.sanskrit: गन्धर्वकन्यका दिव्यास्तद्वदप्सरसां वराः । दृष्ट्वा चकमिरे कृष्णं स्त्रस्तवस्त्रविभूषणाः
verses.transliteration: gandharvakanyakā divyāstadvadapsarasāṃ varāḥ / dṛṣṭvā cakamire kṛṣṇaṃ strastavastravibhūṣaṇāḥ
verses.translation: Kukura's son was Vrsni and Vrsni's son was Kapotaroman and his son was Vilomaka.
verses.hindi: गुहा (वुद्धि) -के ईश। सबीज योग (सविकल्पक समाधि)-का त्याग करनेवाले परमार्थभूत योगिजन निर्विकल्पक समाधि लगाकर आपके जिस रूपका दर्शन करते हैं, में आपके उसी ज्ञानातीत स्वरूपको नित्य प्रणाम करता
verses.wordMeaning: Kukura's son was Vrsni and Vrsni's son was Kapotaroman and his son was Vilomaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kukura's son was Vrsni and Vrsni's son was Kapotaroman and his son was Vilomaka.

verses.sanskrit: काश्चिद् गायन्ति विविधां गीतिं गीतविशारदाः । संप्रेक्ष्य देवकीसूनुं सुन्दर्यः काममोहिताः
verses.transliteration: kāścid gāyanti vividhāṃ gītiṃ gītaviśāradāḥ / saṃprekṣya devakīsūnuṃ sundaryaḥ kāmamohitāḥ
verses.translation: The scholarly Tama (v.l. Nala) a friend of Tum- buru was his son. The son of Tama was Anakadundubhi.
verses.hindi: हूँ। जिनमें न तो किसी नाम (तथा रूप) आदि विशेष (गुणों)-को कोई कल्पना है और जिनका न कोई स्वरूप दिखलायी पड़ता है, प्रणामपूर्वक उन ब्रह्मपार स्वयम्भूकी शरणमें में जाता हूँ। वैदिक सिद्धान्तोंके अनुगामी आपके जिस स्वरूपको विदेह, ब्रह्मविज्ञानमय, अभेदरूप (अद्वितीय) इन अनेक प्रकारोंसे जानते हैं, आपके उस ब्रह्मपार स्वरूपको मैं नित्य प्रणाम करता हूँ। जिसके प्रधान (प्रकृति)
verses.wordMeaning: The scholarly Tama (v.l. Nala) a friend of Tum- buru was his son. The son of Tama was Anakadundubhi.
verses.commentary: Sense: The scholarly Tama (v.l. Nala) a friend of Tum- buru was his son. The son of Tama was Anakadundubhi.

verses.sanskrit: काश्चिद्विलासबहुला नृत्यन्ति स्म तदग्रतः । संप्रेक्ष्य संस्थिताः काश्चित् पपुस्तद्वदनामृतम्
verses.transliteration: kāścidvilāsabahulā nṛtyanti sma tadagrataḥ / saṃprekṣya saṃsthitāḥ kāścit papustadvadanāmṛtam
verses.translation: He went to Govardhana and performed extensive penance. Lord Brahma, the supreme Ruler of the worlds, grant¬ ed a boon to him.
verses.hindi: और पुराण पुरुष विवर्त (परिणाम) हैं तथा देवता जिसे प्रणाम करते हैं, उस ज्योतिमें संनिविष्ट ज्योतिर्मय आपके बृहत् काल-स्वरूपको मैं नमस्कार करता हूँ। में सनातन गुहेशकी शरणमें जाता हूँ। मैं स्थाणु गिरिश पुरारिके शरणागत हूँ, मैं चन्द्रमौलि हर, शिवको शरण ग्रहण करता हूँ। में पिनाक धारण करनेवाले आपकी शरणमें जाता हूँ ॥ ४१--४५॥
verses.wordMeaning: He went to Govardhana and performed extensive penance. Lord Brahma, the supreme Ruler of the worlds, grant¬ ed a boon to him.
verses.commentary: Sense: He went to Govardhana and performed extensive penance. Lord Brahma, the supreme Ruler of the worlds, grant¬ ed a boon to him.

verses.sanskrit: काश्चिद् भूषणवर्याणि स्वाङ्गादादाय सादरम् । भूषयाञ्चक्रिरे कृष्णं कामिन्यो लोकभूषणम्
verses.transliteration: kāścid bhūṣaṇavaryāṇi svāṅgādādāya sādaram / bhūṣayāñcakrire kṛṣṇaṃ kāminyo lokabhūṣaṇam
verses.translation: To him who was engaged in music. Lord Siva, the consort of Parvatl, gave the jewel of a girl inaccessible even to Devas.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार भगवान् कपर्दीकी स्तुति कर श्रेष्ठ ओंकारका उच्चारण करता हुआ वह शंकुकर्ण दण्डवत् अद्वितीय, करोड़ों प्रलयकालीन अग्निके समान, शिवात्मक श्रेष्ठ लिङ्ग प्रादुर्भूत हुआ। तब मुक्त आत्मावाला, तादात्म्यस्वरूपवाला, सर्वव्यापी, विशुद्ध हुआ वह शंकुकर्ण निर्मल लिङ्गमें विलीन हो गया। यह एक अद्भुत-सी
verses.wordMeaning: To him who was engaged in music. Lord Siva, the consort of Parvatl, gave the jewel of a girl inaccessible even to Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: To him who was engaged in music. Lord Siva, the consort of Parvatl, gave the jewel of a girl inaccessible even to Devas.

verses.sanskrit: काश्चिद् भूषणवर्याणि समादाय तदङ्गतः । स्वात्मानं बूषयामासुः स्वात्मगैरपि माधवम्
verses.transliteration: kāścid bhūṣaṇavaryāṇi samādāya tadaṅgataḥ / svātmānaṃ būṣayāmāsuḥ svātmagairapi mādhavam
verses.translation: Thereafter, the mother taught that beautiful son in his childhood as well as the daughter, the art of music systematically.
verses.hindi: यह मैंने आप लोगोंको कपर्दीका रहस्य एवं माहात्म्य बतलाया। इसे कोई नहीं जानता। विद्वान् भी इस विषयमें आज्ञानसे मोहित हो जाते हैं। जो भक्त पापका नाश करनेवाली इस कथाको नित्य सुनता है, वह पापसे विमुक्त शुद्धात्मा होकर रुद्रकी समीपताको प्राप्त कर लेता है
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, the mother taught that beautiful son in his childhood as well as the daughter, the art of music systematically.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, the mother taught that beautiful son in his childhood as well as the daughter, the art of music systematically.

verses.sanskrit: काश्चिदागत्य कृष्णस्य समीपं काममोहिताः । चुचुम्बुर्वदनाम्भोजं हरेर्मुग्धमृगेक्षणाः
verses.transliteration: kāścidāgatya kṛṣṇasya samīpaṃ kāmamohitāḥ / cucumburvadanāmbhojaṃ harermugdhamṛgekṣaṇāḥ
verses.translation: After the investiture with the sacred thread, he learned the Vedas from a preceptor. He married the mental daughter of the Gandharvas (or a Gandharva girl called Manasi).
verses.hindi: और जो मनुष्य नित्य प्रातः एवं मध्याहृकालमें शुद्धतापूर्वक इस ब्रह्मपार नामक महान् स्तवका पाठ करेगा, वह परम योगको प्राप्त कर लेगा इहैव नित्यं वत्स्यामो देवदेवं कपर्दिनम् ।
verses.wordMeaning: After the investiture with the sacred thread, he learned the Vedas from a preceptor. He married the mental daughter of the Gandharvas (or a Gandharva girl called Manasi).
verses.commentary: Sense: After the investiture with the sacred thread, he learned the Vedas from a preceptor. He married the mental daughter of the Gandharvas (or a Gandharva girl called Manasi).

verses.sanskrit: प्रगृह्य काश्चिद् गोविन्दं करेण भवनं स्वकम् । प्रापयामासुर्लोकादिं मायया तस्य मोहिताः
verses.transliteration: pragṛhya kāścid govindaṃ kareṇa bhavanaṃ svakam / prāpayāmāsurlokādiṃ māyayā tasya mohitāḥ
verses.translation: In her he begot five excellent sons, who knew the technique of playing on the Vina and were experts in the science of music.
verses.hindi: 'मैं यहीं नित्य निवास करूँगा, देवदेव कपर्दीका द्रक्ष्यामः सततं देवं पूजयामोऽथ शूलिनम्॥ ५२॥  दर्शन करूंगा और त्रिशूल धारण करनेवाले देवकी
verses.wordMeaning: In her he begot five excellent sons, who knew the technique of playing on the Vina and were experts in the science of music.
verses.commentary: Sense: In her he begot five excellent sons, who knew the technique of playing on the Vina and were experts in the science of music.

verses.sanskrit: तासां स भगवान् कृष्णः कामान् कमललोचनः । बहूनि कृत्वा रूपाणि पूरयामास लीलया
verses.transliteration: tāsāṃ sa bhagavān kṛṣṇaḥ kāmān kamalalocanaḥ / bahūni kṛtvā rūpāṇi pūrayāmāsa līlayā
verses.translation: Accompanied by his sons, grandsons and wife, the king, a wise and expert musician, worshipped the lord (Siva), destroyer ofTripuras, by means of music.
verses.hindi: इत्युक्त्वा भगवान् व्यासः शिष्यैः सह महामुनिः । निरन्तर पूजा करता रहूँगा।' ऐसा कहकर शिष्योंके साथ युक्तात्मा महामुनि व्यासने कपर्दीको पूजा करते हुए वहीं
verses.wordMeaning: Accompanied by his sons, grandsons and wife, the king, a wise and expert musician, worshipped the lord (Siva), destroyer ofTripuras, by means of music.
verses.commentary: Sense: Accompanied by his sons, grandsons and wife, the king, a wise and expert musician, worshipped the lord (Siva), destroyer ofTripuras, by means of music.

verses.sanskrit: एवं वै सुचिरं कालं देवदेवपुरे हरिः । रेमे नारायणः श्रीमान् मायया मोहयञ्जगत्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ vai suciraṃ kālaṃ devadevapure hariḥ / reme nārāyaṇaḥ śrīmān māyayā mohayañjagat
verses.translation: A Gandharva named Subahu took Hrimati who was beautiful in all limbs, with large eyes like Sri, to his city.
verses.hindi: व्यासजीद्वारा वाराणसीके मध्यमेश्वर महादेव तथा मन्दाकिनीकी महिमाका वर्णन उषित्वा तत्र भगवान् कपर्दीशान्तिके पुनः । द्रष्टुं ययौ मध्यमेशं बहुवर्षगणान् प्रभुः
verses.wordMeaning: A Gandharva named Subahu took Hrimati who was beautiful in all limbs, with large eyes like Sri, to his city.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Gandharva named Subahu took Hrimati who was beautiful in all limbs, with large eyes like Sri, to his city.

verses.sanskrit: गते बहुतिथे काले द्वारवत्यां निवासिनः । बभूवुर्विह्वला भीता गोविन्दविरहे जनाः
verses.transliteration: gate bahutithe kāle dvāravatyāṃ nivāsinaḥ / babhūvurvihvalā bhītā govindavirahe janāḥ
verses.translation: To that Gandharva of good refulgence, these sons were born of her—viz. Susena, Dhira, Sugriva, Subhoja and Naravahana.
verses.hindi: नदीं वरिमलपानीयां दृष्टा हृष्टोऽभवन्मुनिः स त्ामन्वीक्ष्य मुनिभिः सह द्वैपायनः प्रभुः । चकार भावपूतात्मा स्त्रानं स्त्रानविधानवित्
verses.wordMeaning: To that Gandharva of good refulgence, these sons were born of her—viz. Susena, Dhira, Sugriva, Subhoja and Naravahana.
verses.commentary: Sense: To that Gandharva of good refulgence, these sons were born of her—viz. Susena, Dhira, Sugriva, Subhoja and Naravahana.

verses.sanskrit: ततः सुपर्णो बलवान् पूर्वमेव विसजितः । कृष्णेन मार्गमाणस्तं हिमवन्तं ययौ गिरिम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ suparṇo balavān pūrvameva visajitaḥ / kṛṣṇena mārgamāṇastaṃ himavantaṃ yayau girim
verses.translation: Abhijit was the son of Candanodakadundubhi* (?) Punarvasu was born of Abhijit. Ahuka was born thereafter.
verses.hindi: संतर्प्य विधिवद् देवानृषीन् पितृगणांस्तथा। पूजयामास लोकादिं पुष्पैर्नानाविधेर्भवम् ओंकारासक्तमनसो वेदाध्ययनतत्पराः। जटिला मुण्डिताश्चापि शुक्लयज्ञोपवीतिनः
verses.wordMeaning: Abhijit was the son of Candanodakadundubhi* (?) Punarvasu was born of Abhijit. Ahuka was born thereafter.
verses.commentary: Sense: Abhijit was the son of Candanodakadundubhi* (?) Punarvasu was born of Abhijit. Ahuka was born thereafter.

verses.sanskrit: अदृष्ट्वा तत्र गोविन्दं प्रणम्य शिरसा मुनिम् । आजगामोपमन्युं तं पुरीं द्वारवतीं पुनः
verses.transliteration: adṛṣṭvā tatra govindaṃ praṇamya śirasā munim / ājagāmopamanyuṃ taṃ purīṃ dvāravatīṃ punaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas, Ahuka had two sons, viz- Ugrasena and Devaka. Devaka's sons were born heroes com¬ parable to Devas.
verses.hindi: केचिदपरे चाप्यवाससः। शान्ता वेदान्तज्ञानतत्पराः दृष्टा द्वेपायनं विप्राः शिष्यैः परिवृतं मुनिम्। पूजयित्वा यथान्यायमिदं वचनमनब्रुवन्
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahmanas, Ahuka had two sons, viz- Ugrasena and Devaka. Devaka's sons were born heroes com¬ parable to Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmanas, Ahuka had two sons, viz- Ugrasena and Devaka. Devaka's sons were born heroes com¬ parable to Devas.

verses.sanskrit: तदन्तरे महादैत्या राक्षसाश्चातिभीषणाः । आजग्मुर्द्वारकां शुभ्रां भीषयन्तः सहस्त्रशः
verses.transliteration: tadantare mahādaityā rākṣasāścātibhīṣaṇāḥ / ājagmurdvārakāṃ śubhrāṃ bhīṣayantaḥ sahastraśaḥ
verses.translation: They were Devavan, Upadeva, Sudeva and Devaraksita. They had seven sisters. He gave them to Vasudeva.
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले--वहाँ कपर्दीश (कपर्दीशवर)-के समीपमें बहुत वर्षोतक निवास कर भगवान् प्रभु (वेदव्यास) पुनः मध्यमेश्वर (लिङ्ग)-का दर्शन करने गये। वहाँ ऋषि-समूहोंसे सेवित स्वच्छ जलवाली पवित्र मन्दाकिनी नामक नदीका दर्शन कर मुनि (व्यास) प्रसन्न हो गये
verses.wordMeaning: They were Devavan, Upadeva, Sudeva and Devaraksita. They had seven sisters. He gave them to Vasudeva.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were Devavan, Upadeva, Sudeva and Devaraksita. They had seven sisters. He gave them to Vasudeva.

verses.sanskrit: स तान् सुपर्णो बलवान् कृष्णतुल्यपराक्रमः । हत्वा युद्धेन महता रक्षति स्म पुरीं शुभाम्
verses.transliteration: sa tān suparṇo balavān kṛṣṇatulyaparākramaḥ / hatvā yuddhena mahatā rakṣati sma purīṃ śubhām
verses.translation: Subhumi, Rastrapala, Tustiman and Sanku (also were his sons). The well-known son Viduratha was born of Bhajamana.
verses.hindi: उसे देखकर पवित्र आत्मभाववाले तथा स्नानके विधानको जाननेवाले उन द्वैपायन प्रभुने मुनियोंके साथ स्नान किया। विधिपूर्वक देवताओं, ऋषियों तथा पितरोंका तर्पण किया और नाना प्रकारके पुष्पोंद्वारा लोकके आदि कारण भवको पूजा को। प्रमुख शिष्योंके साथ सत्यवतीके पुत्र व्यासने (उस क्षेत्रमें) प्रवेशकर त्रिशूलधारी ईशान मध्यमेशवरका पूजन किया। तदनन्तर सारे शरीरमें भस्म धारण किये हुए शान्त पाशुपत लोग
verses.wordMeaning: Subhumi, Rastrapala, Tustiman and Sanku (also were his sons). The well-known son Viduratha was born of Bhajamana.
verses.commentary: Sense: Subhumi, Rastrapala, Tustiman and Sanku (also were his sons). The well-known son Viduratha was born of Bhajamana.

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु नारदो भगवानृषिः । दृष्ट्वा कैलासशिखरे कृष्णं द्वारवतीं गतः
verses.transliteration: etasminneva kāle tu nārado bhagavānṛṣiḥ / dṛṣṭvā kailāsaśikhare kṛṣṇaṃ dvāravatīṃ gataḥ
verses.translation: His son was Surasama (equal to the Sun) and from him was born Pratiksatra. From him was born Svayambhoja. From him was born Dhatrika, the chastiser of his enemies.
verses.hindi: अर्थात् पशुपतिके भक्तगण पाशुपत ईश्वर मध्यमेश्वर रुद्रका दर्शन करने आये उनका मन ओंकारके जपमें लगा था, वे सभी वेदोंके अध्ययनमें तत्पर थे। वे शुक्ल यज्ञोपवीत धारण किये थे, कोई जटा रखाये थे और कोई मुण्डित थे।
verses.wordMeaning: His son was Surasama (equal to the Sun) and from him was born Pratiksatra. From him was born Svayambhoja. From him was born Dhatrika, the chastiser of his enemies.
verses.commentary: Sense: His son was Surasama (equal to the Sun) and from him was born Pratiksatra. From him was born Svayambhoja. From him was born Dhatrika, the chastiser of his enemies.

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा नारदमृषिं सर्वे तत्र निवासिनः । प्रोचुर्नारायणो नाथः कुत्रास्ते भगवान् हरिः
verses.transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvā nāradamṛṣiṃ sarve tatra nivāsinaḥ / procurnārāyaṇo nāthaḥ kutrāste bhagavān hariḥ
verses.translation: Krtavarma was his son. Surasena was his son. Vasudeva was his son who was engaged in religious rites.
verses.hindi: थे। वे ब्रह्मचर्यपरायण, शान्त और वेदान्तके ज्ञानमें तत्पर थे। विप्रो! शिष्योंसे घिरे हुए द्वैपायन मुनिको देखकर यथोक्त विधिसे उनका पूजनकर उन्होंने (पाशुपत भक्तोंने) यह वचन कहा-- को भवान् कुत आयातः सह शिष्यैर्महामुने । प्रोचुः पैलादयः शिष्यास्तानृषीन् ब्रह्मभावितान्
verses.wordMeaning: Krtavarma was his son. Surasena was his son. Vasudeva was his son who was engaged in religious rites.
verses.commentary: Sense: Krtavarma was his son. Surasena was his son. Vasudeva was his son who was engaged in religious rites.

verses.sanskrit: स तानुवाच भगवान् कैलसशिखरे हरिः । रमते ऽद्य महायोगीं तं दृष्ट्वाहमिहागतः
verses.transliteration: sa tānuvāca bhagavān kailasaśikhare hariḥ / ramate 'dya mahāyogīṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvāhamihāgataḥ
verses.translation: From Vasudeva was born the powerful-armed Vasu¬ deva, the preceptor of the universe. Hari (Visnu), on being requested by Devas, became the son of Devaki.
verses.hindi: अयं सत्यवतीसूनुः कृष्णद्वैपायनो मुनिः। व्यासः स्वयं हृषीकेशो येन वेदाः पृथक् कृताः यस्य देवो महादेवः साक्षादेव पिनाकधृक् । अंशांशेनाभवत् पुत्रो नाम्ना शुक इति प्रभुः
verses.wordMeaning: From Vasudeva was born the powerful-armed Vasu¬ deva, the preceptor of the universe. Hari (Visnu), on being requested by Devas, became the son of Devaki.
verses.commentary: Sense: From Vasudeva was born the powerful-armed Vasu¬ deva, the preceptor of the universe. Hari (Visnu), on being requested by Devas, became the son of Devaki.

verses.sanskrit: तस्योपश्रुत्य वचनं सुपर्णः पततां वरः । जगामाकाशगो विप्राः कैलासं गिरिमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: tasyopaśrutya vacanaṃ suparṇaḥ patatāṃ varaḥ / jagāmākāśago viprāḥ kailāsaṃ girimuttamam
verses.translation: The blessed lady Rohini, the splendid wife of Vasu- deva, gave birth to Sahkarsana, the eldest son known as Rama, with a plough as his special weapon.
verses.hindi: यः स साक्षान्महादेवं सर्वभावेन शंकरम्। प्रपन्नः परया भक्त्या यस्य तज्ज्ञानमैश्वरम् प्रसादाद् देवदेवस्य यत् तन्माहेश्वरं परम्
verses.wordMeaning: The blessed lady Rohini, the splendid wife of Vasu- deva, gave birth to Sahkarsana, the eldest son known as Rama, with a plough as his special weapon.
verses.commentary: Sense: The blessed lady Rohini, the splendid wife of Vasu- deva, gave birth to Sahkarsana, the eldest son known as Rama, with a plough as his special weapon.

verses.sanskrit: ददर्श देवकीसूनुं भवने रत्नमण्डिते । वरासनस्थं गोविन्दं देवदेवान्तिके हरिम्
verses.transliteration: dadarśa devakīsūnuṃ bhavane ratnamaṇḍite / varāsanasthaṃ govindaṃ devadevāntike harim
verses.translation: Vasudeva, pervading the universe was the supreme Atman himself. Lord Sarhkarsana, the wielder of the plough as his weapon was Sesa himself
verses.hindi: क्षिप्रं पश्येम तं देवं श्रुत्वा भगवतो मुखात् तत्क्षणादेव विमलं सम्भूतं ज्योतिरुत्तमम्। लीनास्तत्रैव ते विप्राः क्षणादन्तरधीयत
verses.wordMeaning: Vasudeva, pervading the universe was the supreme Atman himself. Lord Sarhkarsana, the wielder of the plough as his weapon was Sesa himself
verses.commentary: Sense: Vasudeva, pervading the universe was the supreme Atman himself. Lord Sarhkarsana, the wielder of the plough as his weapon was Sesa himself

verses.sanskrit: उपास्यमानममरैर्दिव्यस्त्रीभिः समन्ततः । महादेवगणैः सिद्धैर्योगिभिः परिवारितम्
verses.transliteration: upāsyamānamamarairdivyastrībhiḥ samantataḥ / mahādevagaṇaiḥ siddhairyogibhiḥ parivāritam
verses.translation: Under the pretext of Bhrgu's curse, he honoured a human body. Madhava was born of DevakI as well as of Rohini.
verses.hindi: ततः शिष्यान् समाहूय भगवान् ब्रह्मवित्तमः। प्रोवाच मध्यमेशस्य माहात्म्यं पैलपूर्वकान् अस्मिन् स्थाने स्वयं देवो देव्या सह महेश्वरः । रमते भगवान् नित्यं रुद्रैश्च परिवारितः
verses.wordMeaning: Under the pretext of Bhrgu's curse, he honoured a human body. Madhava was born of DevakI as well as of Rohini.
verses.commentary: Sense: Under the pretext of Bhrgu's curse, he honoured a human body. Madhava was born of DevakI as well as of Rohini.

verses.sanskrit: प्रणम्य दण्डवद् भूमौ सुपर्णः शङ्करं शिवम् । निवेदयामास हरेः प्रवृत्तिं द्वारके पुरे
verses.transliteration: praṇamya daṇḍavad bhūmau suparṇaḥ śaṅkaraṃ śivam / nivedayāmāsa hareḥ pravṛttiṃ dvārake pure
verses.translation: Kausiki, the Yogic-slumber born of Uma's body, became the daughter of Yasoda, at the behest of Vasudeva.
verses.hindi: अत्र पूर्वं हृषीकेशो विश्वात्मा देवकीसुतः । उवास वत्सरं कृष्णः सदा पाशुपतेर्वृतः तस्य ते बहवः शिष्या ब्रह्मचर्यपरायणाः। लब्ध्या तद्वचनाज्जञानं दृष्टवन्तो महेश्वरम्
verses.wordMeaning: Kausiki, the Yogic-slumber born of Uma's body, became the daughter of Yasoda, at the behest of Vasudeva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kausiki, the Yogic-slumber born of Uma's body, became the daughter of Yasoda, at the behest of Vasudeva.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रणम्य शिरसा शङ्करं नीललोहितम् । आजगाम पुरीं कृष्णः सो ऽनुज्ञातो हरेण तु
verses.transliteration: tataḥ praṇamya śirasā śaṅkaraṃ nīlalohitam / ājagāma purīṃ kṛṣṇaḥ so 'nujñāto hareṇa tu
verses.translation: O excellent sages, the sons born to Vasudeva as elder brothers of Vasudeva had been killed by Karhsa already before.
verses.hindi: तस्य देवो महादेवः प्रत्यक्षं नीललोहितः । ददौ कृष्णस्य भगवान् वरदो वरमुत्तमम् तेषां तहैश्वरं ज्ञानमुत्पत््यति जगन्मय
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent sages, the sons born to Vasudeva as elder brothers of Vasudeva had been killed by Karhsa already before.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent sages, the sons born to Vasudeva as elder brothers of Vasudeva had been killed by Karhsa already before.

verses.sanskrit: आरुह्य कश्यपसुतं स्त्रीगणैरभिपूजितः । वचोभिरमृतास्वादैर्मानितो मधुसूदनः
verses.transliteration: āruhya kaśyapasutaṃ strīgaṇairabhipūjitaḥ / vacobhiramṛtāsvādairmānito madhusūdanaḥ
verses.translation: When Rama was born, Devaki gave birth to Krsna, Acyuta, the first among Devas, the Atman whose chest had been marked by the curl of golden hair called Srivatsa.
verses.hindi: महामुने! आप कौन हैं? शिष्योंके साथ कहाँसे आये हैं। तब पैल आदि व्यास-शिष्योंने उन ब्रह्मभावको प्राप्त ऋषियोंसे कहा--ये सत्यवतीके पुत्र कृष्णद्वैपायन व्यास मुनि हैं। ये स्वयं हृषीकेश हैं, जिन्होंने वेदोंका विभाजन किया। पिनाकको धारण करनेवाले साक्षात् प्रभु महादेव ही अपने अंशांशसे इनके शुक नामक पुत्र हुए। वे सभी भावोंसे, परम भक्तिके द्वारा साक्षात् महादेव शंकरके शरणागत हुए हैं और जिन्हें ईश्वर-
verses.wordMeaning: When Rama was born, Devaki gave birth to Krsna, Acyuta, the first among Devas, the Atman whose chest had been marked by the curl of golden hair called Srivatsa.
verses.commentary: Sense: When Rama was born, Devaki gave birth to Krsna, Acyuta, the first among Devas, the Atman whose chest had been marked by the curl of golden hair called Srivatsa.

verses.sanskrit: वीक्ष्य यान्तममित्रघ्नं गन्धर्वाप्सरसां वराः । अन्वगच्छन् महोयोगं शङ्खचक्रगदाधरम्
verses.transliteration: vīkṣya yāntamamitraghnaṃ gandharvāpsarasāṃ varāḥ / anvagacchan mahoyogaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam
verses.translation: Rama's wifewas Revati by name. Shewas endowed with good qualities. He begot of her two sons Nisita and Ulmuka.
verses.hindi: सम्बन्धी परम ज्ञान उपलब्ध है तब वे सभी पशुपतिके भक्त प्रसन्न हो गये, उन्हें रोमाञ्च हो आया। एकाग्रमनसे उन्होंने सत्यवतीके पुत्र व्यासको प्रणाम किया और कहा- भगवन्! देवदेवको कृपासे जो परमेष्ठीका श्रेष्ठ माहेश्वर विज्ञान है, वह
verses.wordMeaning: Rama's wifewas Revati by name. Shewas endowed with good qualities. He begot of her two sons Nisita and Ulmuka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Rama's wifewas Revati by name. Shewas endowed with good qualities. He begot of her two sons Nisita and Ulmuka.

verses.sanskrit: विसर्जयित्वा विश्वात्मा सर्वा एवाङ्गना हरिः । ययौ स तूर्णं गोविन्दो दिव्यां द्वारवतीं पुरीम्
verses.transliteration: visarjayitvā viśvātmā sarvā evāṅganā hariḥ / yayau sa tūrṇaṃ govindo divyāṃ dvāravatīṃ purīm
verses.translation: Srikrsna, of indefatigable activities had sixteen thousand wives. The sons born to them were hundreds and thousands.
verses.hindi: आपको ज्ञात है। अत: आप हमें वह श्रेष्ठ अव्यक्त, गोपनीय रहस्य बतलायें, ताकि आपके मुखसे उसे सुनकर हम शीघ्र ही उन देवका दर्शन कर सकें तदनन्तर सुमन्तु आदि उन प्रमुख शिष्योंको विदाकर योगविदोंमें श्रेष्ठ व्यासने उन योगियोंको श्रेष्ठ ज्ञान
verses.wordMeaning: Srikrsna, of indefatigable activities had sixteen thousand wives. The sons born to them were hundreds and thousands.
verses.commentary: Sense: Srikrsna, of indefatigable activities had sixteen thousand wives. The sons born to them were hundreds and thousands.

verses.sanskrit: गते मुररिपौ नैव कामिन्यो मुनिपुङ्गवाः । निशेव चन्द्ररहिता विना तेन चकाशिरे
verses.transliteration: gate muraripau naiva kāminyo munipuṅgavāḥ / niśeva candrarahitā vinā tena cakāśire
verses.translation: On seeing the heroic sons born to Rukmini from Janardana, Jambavati, his wife of pure smiles, said to Krsna.
verses.hindi: प्रकर हुई और क्षणभरमें ही वे पाशुपत भक्तगण उसीमें लीन हो गये और अन्तर्धान हो गये तदनन्तर पैल आदि प्रमुख शिष्योंको बुलाकर श्रेष्ठ ब्रह्मज्ञानी भगवान् (व्यास)-ने मध्यमेशका माहात्म्य उन्हें बतलाया। स्वयं भगवान् महेश्वर देव देवीके साथ तथा रुद्रगणोंसे घिरे नित्य इस स्थानपर रमण
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing the heroic sons born to Rukmini from Janardana, Jambavati, his wife of pure smiles, said to Krsna.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the heroic sons born to Rukmini from Janardana, Jambavati, his wife of pure smiles, said to Krsna.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा पौरजनास्तूर्णं कृष्णागमनमुत्तमम् । मण्डयाञ्चक्रिरे दिव्यां पुरीं द्वारवतीं शुभाम्
verses.transliteration: śrutvā paurajanāstūrṇaṃ kṛṣṇāgamanamuttamam / maṇḍayāñcakrire divyāṃ purīṃ dvāravatīṃ śubhām
verses.translation: "O slayer of Danavas, O lotus-eyed one, please grant me a son of excellent qualities, who will be honoured by- lord of Devas."
verses.hindi: यहीँपर पूर्वकालमें देवकीके पुत्र विश्वात्मा हृषीकेश कृष्ण हरि पाशुपतोंसे आवृत रहते हुए, समस्त शरीरे भस्म धारणकर रुद्र-तत्त्वके अनुसंधानमें तत्पर हुए थे तथा पाशुपत व्रत धारणकर शम्भुकी आराधना करते हुए एक वर्षतक निवास किये थे। उनके (व्यासके) ब्रह्मचर्य-परायण बहुतसे विज्ञ शिष्योंने उनके वचनसे ज्ञान प्राकर महेश्वरका दर्शन किया। वर प्रदान करनेवाले नीललोहित देव साक्षात् भगवान् ' महादेवने'
verses.wordMeaning: "O slayer of Danavas, O lotus-eyed one, please grant me a son of excellent qualities, who will be honoured by- lord of Devas."
verses.commentary: Sense: "O slayer of Danavas, O lotus-eyed one, please grant me a son of excellent qualities, who will be honoured by- lord of Devas."

verses.sanskrit: पताकाभिर्विशालाभिर्ध्वजै रत्नपरिष्कृतैः । लाजादिभिः पुरीं रम्यां भूषयाञ्चक्रिरे तदा
verses.transliteration: patākābhirviśālābhirdhvajai ratnapariṣkṛtaiḥ / lājādibhiḥ purīṃ ramyāṃ bhūṣayāñcakrire tadā
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Jambavati, Jagannatha, Hari, himself a store of penance, the suppressor of enemies, began to perform a penance.
verses.hindi: उन कृष्णको उत्तम वर प्रदान किया। जगन्मय! जो मेरे भक्त विधिपूर्वक आप गोविन्दकी अर्चना करेंगे, उन्हें ईश्वर-सम्बन्धी परम ज्ञान प्राप्त होगा येऽत्र द्रक्ष्यन्ति देवेशं स्त्रात्वा रुद्रं पिनाकिनम्। ब्रह्महत्यादिकं पापं तेषामाशु विनश्यति २७॥
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the words of Jambavati, Jagannatha, Hari, himself a store of penance, the suppressor of enemies, began to perform a penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of Jambavati, Jagannatha, Hari, himself a store of penance, the suppressor of enemies, began to perform a penance.

verses.sanskrit: अवादयन्त विविधान् वादित्रान् मधुरस्वनान् । शङ्खान् सहस्त्रशो दध्मुर्वोणावादान् वितेनिरे
verses.transliteration: avādayanta vividhān vāditrān madhurasvanān / śaṅkhān sahastraśo dadhmurvoṇāvādān vitenire
verses.translation: O excellent sages, listen how the son of Devaki per¬ formed a severe and great penance, saw Rudra and obtained a son.
verses.hindi: प्राणांस्त्यजन्ति ये मर्त्याः पापकर्मरता अपि । ते यान्ति तत् परं स्थानं नात्र कार्या विचारणा धन्यास्तु खलु ते विप्रा मन्दाकिन्यां कृतोदकाः । अर्चयन्ति महादेवं मध्यमेश्वरमीश्चरम्
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent sages, listen how the son of Devaki per¬ formed a severe and great penance, saw Rudra and obtained a son.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent sages, listen how the son of Devaki per¬ formed a severe and great penance, saw Rudra and obtained a son.

verses.sanskrit: प्रविष्टमात्रे गोविन्दे पुरीं द्वारवतीं शुभाम् । अगायन् मधुरं गानं स्त्रियो यौवनशालिनः
verses.transliteration: praviṣṭamātre govinde purīṃ dvāravatīṃ śubhām / agāyan madhuraṃ gānaṃ striyo yauvanaśālinaḥ
verses.translation: Savarni of Somadatta clan was one of the six disciples of Roma- harsana. He is credited to have composed a Purana Samhita of his own vide VP. III. 6 16-18, Bh. P. XII. 7.5-7.
verses.hindi: संनिहत्यामुपस्पृश्य राहुग्रस्ते दिवाकरे। एवमुक्त्वा महायोगी मध्यमेशान्तिके प्रभुः । उवास सुचिरं कालं पूजयन् वै महेश्वरम्
verses.wordMeaning: Savarni of Somadatta clan was one of the six disciples of Roma- harsana. He is credited to have composed a Purana Samhita of his own vide VP. III. 6 16-18, Bh. P. XII. 7.5-7.
verses.commentary: Sense: Savarni of Somadatta clan was one of the six disciples of Roma- harsana. He is credited to have composed a Purana Samhita of his own vide VP. III. 6 16-18, Bh. P. XII. 7.5-7.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा ननृतुरीशानं स्थिताः प्रासादमूर्धसु । मुमुचुः पुष्पवर्षाणि वसुदेवसुतोपरि
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā nanṛturīśānaṃ sthitāḥ prāsādamūrdhasu / mumucuḥ puṣpavarṣāṇi vasudevasutopari
verses.translation: Though A.S. Gupta emends this verse as kapeyo samsapayanah Vayu II. 61.56-58 mentions 'Susarma of Saihsapayana Gotra' as the disciple of Romaharsana. He is said to have composed a Purana Sarhhita of 8600 verses vide my Intro, to the A'P
verses.hindi: निस्संदेह मेरी कृपासे आप मेरे भक्त द्विजातियोंके प्रणम्य, आराध्य और ध्येय होंगे। जो यहाँ स्नानकर पिनाकी रुद्र देवेशवरका दर्शन करेंगे, उनके ब्रह्महत्या आदि सभी पाप शीघ्र ही नष्ट हो जायेगे। जो पापकर्मपरायण भी मनुष्य यहाँ प्राणोंका त्याग करेंगे, वे परम स्थानको प्राप्त करेंगे, इसमें कोई विचार नहीं करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: Though A.S. Gupta emends this verse as kapeyo samsapayanah Vayu II. 61.56-58 mentions 'Susarma of Saihsapayana Gotra' as the disciple of Romaharsana. He is said to have composed a Purana Sarhhita of 8600 verses vide my Intro, to the A'P
verses.commentary: Sense: Though A.S. Gupta emends this verse as kapeyo samsapayanah Vayu II. 61.56-58 mentions 'Susarma of Saihsapayana Gotra' as the disciple of Romaharsana. He is said to have composed a Purana Sarhhita of 8600 verses vide my Intro, to the A'P

verses.sanskrit: प्रविश्य भवनं कृष्ण आशीर्वादाभिवर्धितः । वरासने महायोगी भाति देवीभिरन्वितः
verses.transliteration: praviśya bhavanaṃ kṛṣṇa āśīrvādābhivardhitaḥ / varāsane mahāyogī bhāti devībhiranvitaḥ
verses.translation: The correct reading appears to be "Saihsapayana.'
verses.hindi: विप्रो! वे निश्चय ही धन्य हैं जो मन्दाकिनीमें स्नानकर ईश्वर महादेव मध्यमेशवरकी पूजा करते हैं। ब्राह्मणो ! यहाँपर एक बार भी किया गया स्नान, दान, तप, श्राद्ध तथा पिण्डदान सात पीढ़ियोंतक कुलको पवित्र कर देता है
verses.wordMeaning: The correct reading appears to be "Saihsapayana.'
verses.commentary: Sense: The correct reading appears to be "Saihsapayana.'

verses.sanskrit: सुरम्ये मण्डपे शुभ्रे शङ्खाद्यैः परिवारितः । आत्मजैरभितो मुख्यैः स्त्रीसहस्त्रैश्च संवृतः
verses.transliteration: suramye maṇḍape śubhre śaṅkhādyaiḥ parivāritaḥ / ātmajairabhito mukhyaiḥ strīsahastraiśca saṃvṛtaḥ
verses.translation: (Defective) The Brahmana popularised the meritori¬ ous Purana-sarhhita by the favour of excellent Brahmanas (?). Here the Purana narration of Vaisampayana® was proclaimed by his disciples.
verses.hindi: सूर्यके राहुसे ग्रस्त किये जानेपर अर्थात् ग्रहणकालमें संनिहती (कुरुक्षेत्र तीर्थ)-में स्नान करनेसे जो फल मनुष्यको प्राप्त होता है, उससे दस गुना अधिक फल यहाँ मन्दाकिनीमें स्नानसे प्राप्त होता है। ऐसा कहकर महायोगी प्रभु (व्यास)-ने महेश्‍वरकी पूजा करते हुए मध्यमेश्वरके समीपमें ही बहुत समयतक निवास किया
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective) The Brahmana popularised the meritori¬ ous Purana-sarhhita by the favour of excellent Brahmanas (?). Here the Purana narration of Vaisampayana® was proclaimed by his disciples.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective) The Brahmana popularised the meritori¬ ous Purana-sarhhita by the favour of excellent Brahmanas (?). Here the Purana narration of Vaisampayana® was proclaimed by his disciples.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रासनवरे रम्ये जाम्बवत्या सहाच्युतः । भ्राजते मालया देवो यथा देव्या समन्वितः
verses.transliteration: tatrāsanavare ramye jāmbavatyā sahācyutaḥ / bhrājate mālayā devo yathā devyā samanvitaḥ
verses.translation: Yajhavalkya, ihe great Yogin, perceived Hara here by means of his penance and composed the excellent Yogasastra as directed by him.
verses.hindi: वाराणसी-माहात्म्यके प्रसंगमें व्यासजीका शिष्योंके साथ विभिन्न तीर्थोमें गमन, ब्रह्मतीर्थका आख्यान, व्यासजीद्वारा विश्वेश्वर लिङ्गका पूजन तथा वहाँ रहते हुए शिवाराधना, एक दिन भिक्षा न मिलनेपर क्रोधाविष्ट व्यासजीका वाराणसीके निवासियोंको शाप देनेके लिये उद्यत होना, उसी समय देवी पार्वतीका प्रकट होना, देवीका व्यासको वाराणसी त्यागनेकी आज्ञा, पुनः स्तुतिसे प्रसन्न देवीके द्वारा
verses.wordMeaning: Yajhavalkya, ihe great Yogin, perceived Hara here by means of his penance and composed the excellent Yogasastra as directed by him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Yajhavalkya, ihe great Yogin, perceived Hara here by means of his penance and composed the excellent Yogasastra as directed by him.

verses.sanskrit: आजग्मुर्देवगन्धर्वा द्रष्टुं लोकादिमव्ययम् । महर्षयः पूर्वजाता मार्कण्डेयादयो द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: ājagmurdevagandharvā draṣṭuṃ lokādimavyayam / maharṣayaḥ pūrvajātā mārkaṇḍeyādayo dvijāḥ
verses.translation: was here that Bhrgu performed an unprecedented great penance formerly and obtained from Mahesvara, the son Sukra who was the most excellent among the knowers of Yoga.
verses.hindi: जगाम भगवान् व्यासो जैमिनिप्रमुखैर्वृतः आकाशाख्यं महातीर्थं तीर्थं चेवार्षभं परम्। स्वर्नीलं च महातीर्थं गौरीतीर्थमनुत्तमम्
verses.wordMeaning: was here that Bhrgu performed an unprecedented great penance formerly and obtained from Mahesvara, the son Sukra who was the most excellent among the knowers of Yoga.
verses.commentary: Sense: was here that Bhrgu performed an unprecedented great penance formerly and obtained from Mahesvara, the son Sukra who was the most excellent among the knowers of Yoga.

verses.sanskrit: ततः स भगवान् कृष्णो मार्कण्डेयं समागतम् । ननामोत्थाय शिरसा स्वासनं च ददौ हरिः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa bhagavān kṛṣṇo mārkaṇḍeyaṃ samāgatam / nanāmotthāya śirasā svāsanaṃ ca dadau hariḥ
verses.translation: Hence O, lord of Devas, perform a very severe penance here itself. You really deserve to visualize the terrible fierce Kapardin, the lord of the universe."
verses.hindi: शिष्योंसे आवृत भगवान् व्यास सभी गुह्य तीथाँ और देवमन्दिरोंमें गये। द्विजश्रेष्ठो! वे परम तीर्थ प्रयाग, प्रयागसे भी अधिक शुभ तीर्थ विश्वरूप, श्रेष्ठ तालतीर्थ, आकाश नामक महातीर्थ, श्रेष्ठ प्राजापत्यं तथा तीर्थ स्वर्गद्वारं तथैव च। जम्बुके श्वरमित्युक्तं धर्माख्यं तीर्थमुत्तमम्
verses.wordMeaning: Hence O, lord of Devas, perform a very severe penance here itself. You really deserve to visualize the terrible fierce Kapardin, the lord of the universe."
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence O, lord of Devas, perform a very severe penance here itself. You really deserve to visualize the terrible fierce Kapardin, the lord of the universe."

verses.sanskrit: संपूज्य तानृषिगणान् प्रणामेन महाभुजः । विसर्जयामास हरिर्दत्त्वा तदभिवाञ्छितान्
verses.transliteration: saṃpūjya tānṛṣigaṇān praṇāmena mahābhujaḥ / visarjayāmāsa harirdattvā tadabhivāñchitān
verses.translation: After saying thus, the great sage Upamanyu granted the perfect knowledge, the holy rite pertaining to Pasupata doctrine and its yogic practice to Krsna of indefatigable activity.
verses.hindi: नारायणं परं तीर्थ वायुतीर्थमनुत्तमम् पर्वताख्यं महागुह्यं मणिकर्णमनुत्तमम्। घटोत्कचं तीर्थवरं श्रीतीर्थं च पितामहम्
verses.wordMeaning: After saying thus, the great sage Upamanyu granted the perfect knowledge, the holy rite pertaining to Pasupata doctrine and its yogic practice to Krsna of indefatigable activity.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying thus, the great sage Upamanyu granted the perfect knowledge, the holy rite pertaining to Pasupata doctrine and its yogic practice to Krsna of indefatigable activity.

verses.sanskrit: तदा मध्याह्नसमये देवदेवः स्वयं हरिः । स्नात्वा शुक्लाम्बरो भानुमुपतिष्ठत् कृताञ्जलिः
verses.transliteration: tadā madhyāhnasamaye devadevaḥ svayaṃ hariḥ / snātvā śuklāmbaro bhānumupatiṣṭhat kṛtāñjaliḥ
verses.translation: Advised thus by the excellent sage. Lord Madhu- sudana (the slayer of Madhu) propitiated lord Rudra there itself, by means of penance.
verses.hindi: गङ्कातीर्थं तु देवेशं ययातेस्तीर्थमुत्तमम्। कापिलं चैव सोमेशं ब्रह्मतीर्थमनुत्तमम् अत्र लिङ्गं पुरानीय ब्रह्मा स्त्रातुं यदा गतः। तदानीं स्थापयामास विष्णुस्तल्लिङ्गमेश्वरम्
verses.wordMeaning: Advised thus by the excellent sage. Lord Madhu- sudana (the slayer of Madhu) propitiated lord Rudra there itself, by means of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: Advised thus by the excellent sage. Lord Madhu- sudana (the slayer of Madhu) propitiated lord Rudra there itself, by means of penance.

verses.sanskrit: जजाप जाप्यं विधिवत् प्रेक्षमाणो दिवाकरम् । तर्पयामास देवेशो देवेशो देवान् मुनिगणान् पितॄन्
verses.transliteration: jajāpa jāpyaṃ vidhivat prekṣamāṇo divākaram / tarpayāmāsa deveśo deveśo devān munigaṇān pitṝn
verses.translation: He smeared Bhasma (ashes) all over his body. He tonsured his head and wore bark garments. With his mind exclusively dedicated to Siva, he performed Japa (muttering the mantra) of Rudra continuously.
verses.hindi: ततः स्त्रात्वा समागत्य ब्रह्मा प्रोवाच तं हरिम्। मयानीतमिदं लिङ्ग कस्मात् स्थापितवानसि तमाह विष्णुस्त्वत्तोऽपि रुद्रे भक्तिदूढा मम। तस्मात् प्रतिष्ठितं लिङ्गं नाप्ना तव भविष्यति
verses.wordMeaning: He smeared Bhasma (ashes) all over his body. He tonsured his head and wore bark garments. With his mind exclusively dedicated to Siva, he performed Japa (muttering the mantra) of Rudra continuously.
verses.commentary: Sense: He smeared Bhasma (ashes) all over his body. He tonsured his head and wore bark garments. With his mind exclusively dedicated to Siva, he performed Japa (muttering the mantra) of Rudra continuously.

verses.sanskrit: प्रविश्य देवभवनं मार्कण्डेयेन चैव हि । पूजयामास लिङ्गस्थं भूतेशं भूतिभूषणम्
verses.transliteration: praviśya devabhavanaṃ mārkaṇḍeyena caiva hi / pūjayāmāsa liṅgasthaṃ bhūteśaṃ bhūtibhūṣaṇam
verses.translation: Then after a lapse of a long period, the great god Mahesvara (Siva) accompanied by Uma and decorated with a half-moon on his crest was seen by him in the sky.
verses.hindi: भूतेश्वर तथा तीर्थ तीर्थं धर्मसमुद्भवम्। गन्धर्वतीर्थ परमं वाह्वेयं तीर्थमुत्तमम् केदारतीर्थमुग्राख्यं कालञ्जरमनुत्तमम्। सारस्वतं प्रभासं च भद्रकर्ण हृदं शुभम्
verses.wordMeaning: Then after a lapse of a long period, the great god Mahesvara (Siva) accompanied by Uma and decorated with a half-moon on his crest was seen by him in the sky.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then after a lapse of a long period, the great god Mahesvara (Siva) accompanied by Uma and decorated with a half-moon on his crest was seen by him in the sky.

verses.sanskrit: समाप्य नियमं सर्वं नियन्तासौ नृणां स्वयम् । भोजयित्वा मुनिवरं ब्राह्मणानभिपूज्य च
verses.transliteration: samāpya niyamaṃ sarvaṃ niyantāsau nṛṇāṃ svayam / bhojayitvā munivaraṃ brāhmaṇānabhipūjya ca
verses.translation: He saw Mahadeva alongwith the goddess. He had a crown, he wielded the iron club. He wore garlands of variegated colours. He held the Pinaka bow and the trident. The lord of Devas had covered all his limbs by means of a tiger-skin garment.
verses.hindi: लौकिकाख्यं महीतीर्थं तीर्थ चैव महालयम् । हिरण्यगर्भ गोप्रेक्ष्यं तीर्थ चैव वृषध्वजम् उपशान्तं शिवं चैव व्याघेश्वरमनुत्तमम्। त्रिलोचनं महातीर्थं लोलार्क चोत्तराह्वयम्
verses.wordMeaning: He saw Mahadeva alongwith the goddess. He had a crown, he wielded the iron club. He wore garlands of variegated colours. He held the Pinaka bow and the trident. The lord of Devas had covered all his limbs by means of a tiger-skin garment.
verses.commentary: Sense: He saw Mahadeva alongwith the goddess. He had a crown, he wielded the iron club. He wore garlands of variegated colours. He held the Pinaka bow and the trident. The lord of Devas had covered all his limbs by means of a tiger-skin garment.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वात्मयोगं विप्रेन्द्रा मार्कण्डेयेन चाच्युतः । कथाः पौराणिकीः पुण्याश्चक्रे पुत्रादिभिर्वृतः
verses.transliteration: kṛtvātmayogaṃ viprendrā mārkaṇḍeyena cācyutaḥ / kathāḥ paurāṇikīḥ puṇyāścakre putrādibhirvṛtaḥ
verses.translation: He saw in front of him Sambhu, the lord of the vital airs {Prams) —the lord, the ancient Purusa who is eternal and who is a Yogin and the overlord of infinite power who is minuter than the minutest.
verses.hindi: कपालमोचनं तीर्थं ब्रह्महत्याविनाशकम्। शुक्रेश्वरं महापुण्यमानन्दपुरमुत्तमम् उपोष्य तत्र तत्रासौ पाराशर्यो महामुनिः
verses.wordMeaning: He saw in front of him Sambhu, the lord of the vital airs {Prams) —the lord, the ancient Purusa who is eternal and who is a Yogin and the overlord of infinite power who is minuter than the minutest.
verses.commentary: Sense: He saw in front of him Sambhu, the lord of the vital airs {Prams) —the lord, the ancient Purusa who is eternal and who is a Yogin and the overlord of infinite power who is minuter than the minutest.

verses.sanskrit: अथैतत् सर्वमखिलं दृष्ट्वा कर्म महामुनिः । मार्कण्डेयो हसन् कृष्णं बभाषे मधुरं वचः
verses.transliteration: athaitat sarvamakhilaṃ dṛṣṭvā karma mahāmuniḥ / mārkaṇḍeyo hasan kṛṣṇaṃ babhāṣe madhuraṃ vacaḥ
verses.translation: He saw the three-eyed lord whose hand wielded an axe, whose body was smeared with ashes and who was covered with the hide of a man-lion; who was uttering the Pramva OM, who was huge in size and (in resplendence) who resembled a thousand suns.
verses.hindi: प्राजापत्य तीर्थ, स्वर्गद्वार, जम्बुकेश्वर, धर्म ( धर्मारण्य) परम नारायण तीर्थ, श्रेष्ठ वायु तीर्थ, परम गुह्य ज्ञानतीर्थ,
verses.wordMeaning: He saw the three-eyed lord whose hand wielded an axe, whose body was smeared with ashes and who was covered with the hide of a man-lion; who was uttering the Pramva OM, who was huge in size and (in resplendence) who resembled a thousand suns.
verses.commentary: Sense: He saw the three-eyed lord whose hand wielded an axe, whose body was smeared with ashes and who was covered with the hide of a man-lion; who was uttering the Pramva OM, who was huge in size and (in resplendence) who resembled a thousand suns.

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच कः समाराध्यते देवो भवता कर्मभिः शुभैः । ब्रूहि त्वं कर्मभिः पूज्यो योगिनां ध्येय एव च
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca kaḥ samārādhyate devo bhavatā karmabhiḥ śubhaiḥ / brūhi tvaṃ karmabhiḥ pūjyo yogināṃ dhyeya eva ca
verses.translation: He saw in front of him Rudra, the primordial deity whose prowess neither Devas nor god Brahma, the grandsire of the world, nor Indra, nor fire-god, nor Varuna, nor the god of Death could describe in full, even to this day.
verses.hindi: सूर्यतीर्थ, महागुह्य पर्वत नामक तीर्थ, अनुत्तम मणिकर्ण, देवेश तीर्थ, उत्तम ययातितीर्थ, कपिल तीर्थ, सोमेश
verses.wordMeaning: He saw in front of him Rudra, the primordial deity whose prowess neither Devas nor god Brahma, the grandsire of the world, nor Indra, nor fire-god, nor Varuna, nor the god of Death could describe in full, even to this day.
verses.commentary: Sense: He saw in front of him Rudra, the primordial deity whose prowess neither Devas nor god Brahma, the grandsire of the world, nor Indra, nor fire-god, nor Varuna, nor the god of Death could describe in full, even to this day.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं हि तत् परमं ब्रह्म निर्वाणममलं पदम् । भारावतरणार्थाय जातो वृष्णिकुले प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ hi tat paramaṃ brahma nirvāṇamamalaṃ padam / bhārāvataraṇārthāya jāto vṛṣṇikule prabhuḥ
verses.translation: Then he observed on the left of Girisa his self, the unmanifest form of infinite, who was eulogising the lord by means of many words of praise and who was the primordial deity whose hands held conch, sword and discus.
verses.hindi: तीर्थ तथा अनुत्तम ब्रह्मतीर्थमें गये प्राचीन कालमें जब ब्रह्मा यहाँ (ब्रह्मतीर्थमें) लिङ्ग लाकर स्नान करने चले गये, तब विष्णुने उस ईश्वरके लिङ्गको यहाँ स्थापित कर दिया। जब स्नान करके ब्रह्म आये तो उन्होंने विष्णुसे पूछा--मेरे द्वारा लाये गये इस
verses.wordMeaning: Then he observed on the left of Girisa his self, the unmanifest form of infinite, who was eulogising the lord by means of many words of praise and who was the primordial deity whose hands held conch, sword and discus.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then he observed on the left of Girisa his self, the unmanifest form of infinite, who was eulogising the lord by means of many words of praise and who was the primordial deity whose hands held conch, sword and discus.

verses.sanskrit: तमब्रवीन्महाबाहुः कृष्णो ब्रह्मविदां वरः । शृण्वतामेव पुत्राणां सर्वेषां प्रहसन्निव
verses.transliteration: tamabravīnmahābāhuḥ kṛṣṇo brahmavidāṃ varaḥ / śṛṇvatāmeva putrāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ prahasanniva
verses.translation: On his right side, he saw a Puru$a (Being) with palms folded in reverence and seated on a swan. He was the Lord of Devas, the grandsire of the Universe, the preceptor of the world, stationed in heaven. He was eulogizing the great prowess of Isa (God Siva).
verses.hindi: लिङ्गको आपने क्यों स्थापित कर दिया। इसपर विष्णुने उनसे कहा--मेरी रुद्रमें आपसे भी अधिक दृढ़ भक्ति है, इसलिये मैंने लिङ्गको यहाँ प्रतिष्ठित कर दिया, यह आपके नामसे ही प्रसिद्ध होगा तीर्थोमें गये) भूतेश्वर तीर्थ, धर्मसमुद्भव तीर्थ, परम
verses.wordMeaning: On his right side, he saw a Puru$a (Being) with palms folded in reverence and seated on a swan. He was the Lord of Devas, the grandsire of the Universe, the preceptor of the world, stationed in heaven. He was eulogizing the great prowess of Isa (God Siva).
verses.commentary: Sense: On his right side, he saw a Puru$a (Being) with palms folded in reverence and seated on a swan. He was the Lord of Devas, the grandsire of the Universe, the preceptor of the world, stationed in heaven. He was eulogizing the great prowess of Isa (God Siva).

verses.sanskrit: श्रीभगवानुवाच भवता कथितं सर्वं तथ्यमेव न संशयः । तथापि देवमीशानं पूजयामि सनातनम्
verses.transliteration: śrībhagavānuvāca bhavatā kathitaṃ sarvaṃ tathyameva na saṃśayaḥ / tathāpi devamīśānaṃ pūjayāmi sanātanam
verses.translation: He saw in front of the ruler of the three worlds the chieftains of the Ganas (attendants) resembling a thousand suns (in brilliance), Nandisvara and others of immeasurable prowess, Kumara, as refulgent as the fire and Ganesa as well.
verses.hindi: तीर्थ, केदारतीर्थ, उग्र नामक तीर्थ, अनुत्तम कालञ्जर तीर्थ, सारस्वत तीर्थ, प्रभासतीर्थ, भद्रकर्णहृद नामक तीर्थ, शिवतीर्थ, अनुत्तम व्याघ्रेश्वरतीर्थ, त्रिलोचनतीर्थ, महातीर्थ, लोलार्क तीर्थ, उत्तर नामक तीर्थ, ब्रह्महत्या-
verses.wordMeaning: He saw in front of the ruler of the three worlds the chieftains of the Ganas (attendants) resembling a thousand suns (in brilliance), Nandisvara and others of immeasurable prowess, Kumara, as refulgent as the fire and Ganesa as well.
verses.commentary: Sense: He saw in front of the ruler of the three worlds the chieftains of the Ganas (attendants) resembling a thousand suns (in brilliance), Nandisvara and others of immeasurable prowess, Kumara, as refulgent as the fire and Ganesa as well.

verses.sanskrit: न मे विप्रास्ति कर्तव्यं नानवाप्तं कथञ्चन । पूजयामि तथापीशं जानन्नैतत् परं शिवम्
verses.transliteration: na me viprāsti kartavyaṃ nānavāptaṃ kathañcana / pūjayāmi tathāpīśaṃ jānannaitat paraṃ śivam
verses.translation: In front of him, he saw sages Marici, Atri, Pulaha, Pulastya, Pracetas, Daksa, Kanva, Parasara, Vasistha and Svayambhuva Manu.
verses.hindi: तीर्थोका वर्णन किया गया हैं, तीर्थोंकी संख्याका विस्तार नहीं बताया जा सकता। पराशरके पुत्र महामुनि (व्यास) इन सभी तीर्थामें स्नानकर पिनाकी (भगवान् शंकर)-की पूजाकर, वहाँ-वहाँ उपवासकर तर्पयित्वा पितृन् देवान् कृत्वा पिण्डप्रदानकम्। जगाम पुनरेवापि यत्र विश्वेश्वरः शिवः
verses.wordMeaning: In front of him, he saw sages Marici, Atri, Pulaha, Pulastya, Pracetas, Daksa, Kanva, Parasara, Vasistha and Svayambhuva Manu.
verses.commentary: Sense: In front of him, he saw sages Marici, Atri, Pulaha, Pulastya, Pracetas, Daksa, Kanva, Parasara, Vasistha and Svayambhuva Manu.

verses.sanskrit: न वै पश्यन्ति तं देवं मायया मोहिता जनाः । ततो ऽहं स्वात्मनो मूलं ज्ञापयन् पूजयामि तम्
verses.transliteration: na vai paśyanti taṃ devaṃ māyayā mohitā janāḥ / tato 'haṃ svātmano mūlaṃ jñāpayan pūjayāmi tam
verses.translation: Then contemplating over the universal Atman within his self {Atman), the noble-minded Visnu, with his palms folded bowed down with devotion to god Siva alongwith his heavenly consort Parvati and eulogised the chief of all gods (viz. Siva) with sacred hymns.
verses.hindi: स्नात्वाभ्यर्च्य परं लिङ्गं शिष्यैः सह महामुनिः । उवाच शिष्यान् धर्मात्मा स्वान् देशान् गन्तुमर्हथ वासं च तत्र नियतो वाराणस्यां चकार स:
verses.wordMeaning: Then contemplating over the universal Atman within his self {Atman), the noble-minded Visnu, with his palms folded bowed down with devotion to god Siva alongwith his heavenly consort Parvati and eulogised the chief of all gods (viz. Siva) with sacred hymns.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then contemplating over the universal Atman within his self {Atman), the noble-minded Visnu, with his palms folded bowed down with devotion to god Siva alongwith his heavenly consort Parvati and eulogised the chief of all gods (viz. Siva) with sacred hymns.

verses.sanskrit: न च लिङ्गार्चनात् पुण्यं लोकेस्मिन् भीतिनाशनम् । तथा लिङ्गे हितायैषां लोकानां पूजयेच्छिवम्
verses.transliteration: na ca liṅgārcanāt puṇyaṃ lokesmin bhītināśanam / tathā liṅge hitāyaiṣāṃ lokānāṃ pūjayecchivam
verses.translation: "Obeisance be to you, O eternal one! O, posses¬ sor of all Yogas (v.l. source of the universe)! Brahma and other sages regard you as Tamas, Sattva, Rajas and the mixture of all these three. Saintly people call you alone as 'All' (identical with everything) (or embodiment of everything like sattva, rajas and tamas.
verses.hindi: भेक्षाहारो विशुद्धात्मा ब्रह्मचर्यपरायणः कदाचिद् वसता तत्र व्यासेनामिततेजसा। भ्रममाणेन भिक्षा तु नेव लब्धा द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.wordMeaning: "Obeisance be to you, O eternal one! O, posses¬ sor of all Yogas (v.l. source of the universe)! Brahma and other sages regard you as Tamas, Sattva, Rajas and the mixture of all these three.…
verses.commentary: Sense: "Obeisance be to you, O eternal one! O, posses¬ sor of all Yogas (v.l. source of the universe)! Brahma and other sages regard you as Tamas, Sattva, Rajas and the mixture of all these three.…

verses.sanskrit: यो ऽहं तल्लिङ्गमित्याहुर्वेदवादविदो जनाः । ततो ऽहमात्ममीशानं पूजयाम्यात्मनैव तु
verses.transliteration: yo 'haṃ talliṅgamityāhurvedavādavido janāḥ / tato 'hamātmamīśānaṃ pūjayāmyātmanaiva tu
verses.translation: O Rudra, you are Brahma and Hari. You are the maker of the Universe and its annihilator. You reside in the orb of the sun. You are the Prana (vital breath), the fire-god, Indra and other different beings. I seek refuge in you alone, the God and the Lord.
verses.hindi: तत्क्षणे सा महादेवी शंकरार्धशरीरिणी। प्रादुरासीत् स्वयं प्रीत्या वेषं कृत्वा तु मानुषम् गृहाण भिक्षां मत्तस्त्वमुक्त्वैवं प्रददौ शिवा
verses.wordMeaning: O Rudra, you are Brahma and Hari. You are the maker of the Universe and its annihilator. You reside in the orb of the sun. You are the Prana (vital breath), the fire-god, Indra and other different beings. I seek refuge in you alone, the God and the Lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Rudra, you are Brahma and Hari. You are the maker of the Universe and its annihilator. You reside in the orb of the sun. You are the Prana (vital breath), the fire-god, Indra and other different beings. I seek refuge in you alone, the God and the Lord.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यैव परमा मूर्तिस्तन्मयो ऽहं न संशयः । नावयोर्द्यिते भेदो वेदेष्वेवं विनिश्चयः
verses.transliteration: tasyaiva paramā mūrtistanmayo 'haṃ na saṃśayaḥ / nāvayordyite bhedo vedeṣvevaṃ viniścayaḥ
verses.translation: The Sarhkhyas (the followers of the Saihkhya school ofPhilosophy) say that you are one (the invaritable form),devoid ofGunas. Those who abide by Yoga system of philosophy always worship you as enthroned in the heart. The Vedas mention you
verses.hindi: उवाच च महादेवी क्रोधनस्त्वं भवान् यतः । इह क्षेत्रे न वस्तव्यं कृतघ्नोऽसि त्वया सदा एवमुक्तः स भगवान् ध्यानाज्ज्ञात्वा परां शिवाम्। उवाच प्रणतो भूत्वा स्तुत्वा च प्रवरैः स्तवैः
verses.wordMeaning: The Sarhkhyas (the followers of the Saihkhya school ofPhilosophy) say that you are one (the invaritable form),devoid ofGunas. Those who abide by Yoga system of philosophy always worship you as enthroned in the heart. The Vedas mention you
verses.commentary: Sense: The Sarhkhyas (the followers of the Saihkhya school ofPhilosophy) say that you are one (the invaritable form),devoid ofGunas. Those who abide by Yoga system of philosophy always worship you as enthroned in the heart. The Vedas mention you

verses.sanskrit: एष देवो महादेवः सदा संसारभीरुभिः । ध्येयः पूज्यश्च वन्द्यश्च ज्ञेयो लिङ्गे महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: eṣa devo mahādevaḥ sadā saṃsārabhīrubhiḥ / dhyeyaḥ pūjyaśca vandyaśca jñeyo liṅge maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: By offering a single flower or leaf at your foot, one becomes released from the bondage of the world. By remem¬ bering the pair of your feet served by Siddhas and Yogins, one dispels all sins by means of your grace.
verses.hindi: चतुर्दश्यामथाष्ट्म्यां प्रवेशं देहि शांकरि। एवमस्त्वित्यनुज्ञाय देवी चान्तरधीयत एवं स भगवान् व्यासो महायोगी पुरातनः । ज्ञात्वा क्षेत्रगुणान् सर्वान् स्थितस्तस्याथ पार्श्वतः
verses.wordMeaning: By offering a single flower or leaf at your foot, one becomes released from the bondage of the world. By remem¬ bering the pair of your feet served by Siddhas and Yogins, one dispels all sins by means of your grace.
verses.commentary: Sense: By offering a single flower or leaf at your foot, one becomes released from the bondage of the world. By remem¬ bering the pair of your feet served by Siddhas and Yogins, one dispels all sins by means of your grace.

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच किं तल्लिङ्गं सुरश्रेष्ठ लिङ्गे संपूज्यते च कः । ब्रूहि कृष्ण विशालाक्ष गहनं ह्येतदुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca kiṃ talliṅgaṃ suraśreṣṭha liṅge saṃpūjyate ca kaḥ / brūhi kṛṣṇa viśālākṣa gahanaṃ hyetaduttamam
verses.translation: OM, Obeisance to the blue-throated, three-eyed (Siva, the velocity incarnate). Obeisance, again and again to you forever, O Mahadeva, Isana.
verses.hindi: एवं व्यासं स्थितं ज्ञात्वा क्षेत्रं सेवन्ति पण्डिताः । तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन वाराणस्यां वसेन्नरः कर पुनः वहीं गये, जहाँ विश्वेश्वर शिव स्थित हैं
verses.wordMeaning: OM, Obeisance to the blue-throated, three-eyed (Siva, the velocity incarnate). Obeisance, again and again to you forever, O Mahadeva, Isana.
verses.commentary: Sense: OM, Obeisance to the blue-throated, three-eyed (Siva, the velocity incarnate). Obeisance, again and again to you forever, O Mahadeva, Isana.

verses.sanskrit: अव्यक्तं लिङ्गमित्याहुरानन्दं ज्योतिरक्षरम् । वेदा महेस्वरं देवमाहुर्लिङ्गिनमव्ययम्
verses.transliteration: avyaktaṃ liṅgamityāhurānandaṃ jyotirakṣaram / vedā mahesvaraṃ devamāhurliṅginamavyayam
verses.translation: Obeisance to you the wielder of the Pinaka bow. Salutations to the staff-bearer of tonsured head. Bow to you, the wielder of thunderbolt in the hand, to god with matted hair {Kapardin) and with the quarters for your robes.
verses.hindi: शिष्योंके साथ धर्मात्मा महामुनिने स्नानकर उस परम (विश्वेश्वर) लिङ्गको पूजा की और शिष्योंसे कहा-अब आप अपने-अपने स्थानोंको जा सकते हैं। द्विजो! महात्मा (व्यास)-को प्रणाम कर वे पैल आदि (शिष्य) चले गये और उन व्यासजीने नियमित-रूपसे वाराणसीमें वास किया। वे शान्त, जितेन्द्रिय, विशुद्धात्मा एवं ब्रह्मचर्य-परायण होकर तीनों संध्याओंमें स्नान करते थे तथा भिक्षाद्वारा प्राप्त आहार करते हुए पिनाकीकी
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you the wielder of the Pinaka bow. Salutations to the staff-bearer of tonsured head. Bow to you, the wielder of thunderbolt in the hand, to god with matted hair {Kapardin) and with the quarters for your robes.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you the wielder of the Pinaka bow. Salutations to the staff-bearer of tonsured head. Bow to you, the wielder of thunderbolt in the hand, to god with matted hair {Kapardin) and with the quarters for your robes.

verses.sanskrit: पुरा चैकार्णवे घोरे नष्टे स्थावरजङ्गमे । प्रबोधार्थं ब्रह्मणो मे प्रादुर्भूतः स्वयं शिवः
verses.transliteration: purā caikārṇave ghore naṣṭe sthāvarajaṅgame / prabodhārthaṃ brahmaṇo me prādurbhūtaḥ svayaṃ śivaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to you of terrible roar, to the fanged one, the embodiment of Kala. Bow to one with the serpent for your sacred thread; salutation to you with fire for your semen.
verses.hindi: आराधनामें लगे रहते थे॥ २२ २४॥ द्विजोत्तमो! वहाँ रहते हुए एक दिन अमित तेजस्वी व्यासजीको भ्रमण करते रहनेपर भी भिक्षा नहीं प्राप्त हुई। तब उनका शरीर क्रोधाविष्ट हो गया, (उन्होंने विचार किया कि) यहाँ रहनेवाले मनुष्योंके लिये ऐसे
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you of terrible roar, to the fanged one, the embodiment of Kala. Bow to one with the serpent for your sacred thread; salutation to you with fire for your semen.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you of terrible roar, to the fanged one, the embodiment of Kala. Bow to one with the serpent for your sacred thread; salutation to you with fire for your semen.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् कालात् समारभ्य ब्रह्मा चाहं सदैव हि । पूजयावो महादेवं लोकानां हितकाम्यया
verses.transliteration: tasmāt kālāt samārabhya brahmā cāhaṃ sadaiva hi / pūjayāvo mahādevaṃ lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā
verses.translation: Obeisance to you, Girisa, to you Svahakara (the consecrator by the utterance of Svahd). Salutations to you who laugh boisterously. Obeisance again and again to the terrible one.
verses.hindi: विघ्नकी सृष्टि करूँ, जिससे उनकी सिद्धि नष्ट हो जाय, पर तत्क्षण ही शंकरको अर्धाङ्गिनी साक्षात् महादेवी (पार्वती) मानुष-वेष धारणकर प्रसन्न-मुद्रामें प्रकट हो गयीं। (और बोलीं) मुझसे भिक्षा ग्रहण करें। ऐसा कहकर पार्वतीने (उन्हें) भिक्षा दीं
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you, Girisa, to you Svahakara (the consecrator by the utterance of Svahd). Salutations to you who laugh boisterously. Obeisance again and again to the terrible one.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you, Girisa, to you Svahakara (the consecrator by the utterance of Svahd). Salutations to you who laugh boisterously. Obeisance again and again to the terrible one.

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच कथं लिङ्गमभूत् पूर्वमैश्वरं परमं पदम् । प्रबोधार्थं स्वयं कृष्ण वक्तुमर्हसि सांप्रतम्
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca kathaṃ liṅgamabhūt pūrvamaiśvaraṃ paramaṃ padam / prabodhārthaṃ svayaṃ kṛṣṇa vaktumarhasi sāṃpratam
verses.translation: Obeisance to you, the destroyer of Kama. Bow to the Suppressor of Kala. Salutation to Hara of terrible apparel, to Hara, the archer.
verses.hindi: महादेवीने कहा--मुने! आप क्रोधी तथा कृतघ्न हैं, अतः आपको सदा इस क्षेत्रमें नहीं रहना चाहिए। पार्वती हैं --ऐसा समझकर प्रणाम किया और श्रेष्ठ स्तुतियोंसे स्तुति कर उनसे कहा-हे शंकरवल्लभे!
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you, the destroyer of Kama. Bow to the Suppressor of Kala. Salutation to Hara of terrible apparel, to Hara, the archer.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you, the destroyer of Kama. Bow to the Suppressor of Kala. Salutation to Hara of terrible apparel, to Hara, the archer.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीभगवानुवाच आसोदेकार्णवं घोरमविभागं तमोमयम् । मध्ये चैकार्णवे तस्मिन् शङ्खचक्रगदाधरः
verses.transliteration: śrībhagavānuvāca āsodekārṇavaṃ ghoramavibhāgaṃ tamomayam / madhye caikārṇave tasmin śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to you the three-eyed, the elephant- hide-robed one; salutation to the lord of Parvati. Bow to the lord of Pasus (Individual souls).
verses.hindi: करने दें। 'ऐसा ही हो” ऐसी आज्ञा देकर देवी अन्तर्धान हो गरयी इस प्रकार महायोगी भगवान् व्यासजी क्षेत्र (वाराणसी )-के सभी गुणों (विशेषताओं)-को समझते हुए उस (वाराणसी)-के पार्श्वभागमें रहने लगे। इस प्रकार व्यासजीको स्थित हुआ जानकर विद्वान् लोग
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you the three-eyed, the elephant- hide-robed one; salutation to the lord of Parvati. Bow to the lord of Pasus (Individual souls).
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you the three-eyed, the elephant- hide-robed one; salutation to the lord of Parvati. Bow to the lord of Pasus (Individual souls).

verses.sanskrit: सहस्त्रशीर्षा भूत्वाहं सहस्त्राक्षः सहस्त्रपात् सहस्त्रबाहुर्युक्तात्मा शयितो ऽहं सनातनः
verses.transliteration: sahastraśīrṣā bhūtvāhaṃ sahastrākṣaḥ sahastrapāt sahastrabāhuryuktātmā śayito 'haṃ sanātanaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to you of the form of the firmament; obei¬ sance to the lord of the firmament; to the one with a body half female and half male; obeisance to the promulgator of Sarhkhya and Yoga systems of philosophy.
verses.hindi: (उस) क्षेत्रका सेवन करते हैं। अतः मनुष्यको सभी प्रयत्नकर वाराणसीमें निवास करना चाहिए श्राद्धे वा हैविके कार्ये रात्रावहनि वा द्विजा: । नदीनां चैव तीरेषु देवतायतनेषु च
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you of the form of the firmament; obei¬ sance to the lord of the firmament; to the one with a body half female and half male; obeisance to the promulgator of Sarhkhya and Yoga systems of philosophy.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you of the form of the firmament; obei¬ sance to the lord of the firmament; to the one with a body half female and half male; obeisance to the promulgator of Sarhkhya and Yoga systems of philosophy.

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे दूरता पश्यमि ह्यमितप्रभम् । कोटिसूर्यप्रतीकाशं भ्राजमानं श्रियावृतम्
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare dūratā paśyami hyamitaprabham / koṭisūryapratīkāśaṃ bhrājamānaṃ śriyāvṛtam
verses.translation: Bow to the ruler of Bhairavas. Obeisance to one whose Lihga is worshipped by Devas. Salutation to the father of Kumara. Obeisance to you, the lord of Devas.
verses.hindi: का माहात्म्य पढ़ता है, सुनता है अथवा शान्त द्विजोंको सुनाता है, वह भी परम गतिको प्राप्त करता है। द्विजो! जो स्नान करनेके अनन्तर श्राद्धमें, देवकार्यमें, रात अथवा दिनमें, नदियोंके किनारोंपर अथवा देवमन्दिरोंमे
verses.wordMeaning: Bow to the ruler of Bhairavas. Obeisance to one whose Lihga is worshipped by Devas. Salutation to the father of Kumara. Obeisance to you, the lord of Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bow to the ruler of Bhairavas. Obeisance to one whose Lihga is worshipped by Devas. Salutation to the father of Kumara. Obeisance to you, the lord of Devas.

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्वरक्त्रं महायोगं पुरुषं काञ्चनप्रभम् । कृष्णाजिरधरं देवमृग्यजुः सामभिः स्तुतम्
verses.transliteration: caturvaraktraṃ mahāyogaṃ puruṣaṃ kāñcanaprabham / kṛṣṇājiradharaṃ devamṛgyajuḥ sāmabhiḥ stutam
verses.translation: Obeisance to the lord of Yajnas, the ideal celibate. Obeisance to the great hunter of deer. Salutation to the overlord of Brahma.
verses.hindi: मनको एकाग्र कर दम्भ तथा मात्सर्यसे रहित होकर नमस्कारपूर्वक ईश (शिव)-का जप करता है, उसे जपेदीशं नमस्कृत्य स याति परमां गतिम्॥ ३६॥  परमगति प्राप्त होती है॥ ३४--३६॥
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the lord of Yajnas, the ideal celibate. Obeisance to the great hunter of deer. Salutation to the overlord of Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the lord of Yajnas, the ideal celibate. Obeisance to the great hunter of deer. Salutation to the overlord of Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: निमेषमात्रेण स मां प्राप्तो योगविदां वरः । व्याजहार स्वयं ब्रह्मा स्मयमानो महाद्युतिः
verses.transliteration: nimeṣamātreṇa sa māṃ prāpto yogavidāṃ varaḥ / vyājahāra svayaṃ brahmā smayamāno mahādyutiḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to Hama (the Swan), to the universe; salutations again and again to the fascinating one. Obeisance to you, the Yogin, to one accessible through Yoga, the master of Yogic Maya.
verses.hindi: प्रयागका माहात्म्य, मार्कण्डेय-युधिष्ठिर-संबाद, प्रयागमें संगम-स्तानका फल प्रयागस्य च माहात्म्यं यत्र देवः पितामहः
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to Hama (the Swan), to the universe; salutations again and again to the fascinating one. Obeisance to you, the Yogin, to one accessible through Yoga, the master of Yogic Maya.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to Hama (the Swan), to the universe; salutations again and again to the fascinating one. Obeisance to you, the Yogin, to one accessible through Yoga, the master of Yogic Maya.

verses.sanskrit: कस्त्वं कुतो वा किं चेह तिष्ठसे वह मे प्रभो । अहं कर्ता हि लोकानां स्वयंभूः प्रपितामहः
verses.transliteration: kastvaṃ kuto vā kiṃ ceha tiṣṭhase vaha me prabho / ahaṃ kartā hi lokānāṃ svayaṃbhūḥ prapitāmahaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to you, the protector of life, to one fond of the sound of bells; obeisance to you, bearer of the skull; obei¬ sance to the lord of luminaries.
verses.hindi: शोकेन महताविष्टो मुमोह स युधिष्ठिर अचिरेणाथ कालेन मार्कण्डेयो महातपाः । सम्प्रा्ो हास्तिनपुरं राजद्वारे स तिष्ठति
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you, the protector of life, to one fond of the sound of bells; obeisance to you, bearer of the skull; obei¬ sance to the lord of luminaries.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you, the protector of life, to one fond of the sound of bells; obeisance to you, bearer of the skull; obei¬ sance to the lord of luminaries.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तस्तदा तेन ब्रह्मणाहमुवाच ह । अहं कर्तास्मि लोकानां संहर्ता च पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: evamuktastadā tena brahmaṇāhamuvāca ha / ahaṃ kartāsmi lokānāṃ saṃhartā ca punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance, again and again be to you. Salutations, again and again, O Paramesvara, grant unto me all of my desires."
verses.hindi: मार्कण्डेयो द्रष्टुंमिच्छंस्त्वामास्ते द्वार्यसौ मुनि: त्वरितो धर्मपुत्रस्तु द्वारमेत्याह तत्परम्। स्वागतं ते महाप्राज्ञ स्वागतं ते महामुने
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance, again and again be to you. Salutations, again and again, O Paramesvara, grant unto me all of my desires."
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance, again and again be to you. Salutations, again and again, O Paramesvara, grant unto me all of my desires."

verses.sanskrit: एवं विवादे वितते मायया परमेष्ठिनः । प्रबोधार्थं परं लिङ्गं प्रादुर्भूतं शिवात्मकम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ vivāde vitate māyayā parameṣṭhinaḥ / prabodhārthaṃ paraṃ liṅgaṃ prādurbhūtaṃ śivātmakam
verses.translation: O Brahmanas, after eulogising the lord of Devas thus with devotion, (Krsna) Madhava fell at the feet of the lord and the goddess (Uma) prostrate like a staff.
verses.hindi: ऋषियोंने कहा--सुत्रत ! अविमुक्त (क्षेत्र वाराणसी)- के माहात्म्यका आपने भलीभाँति वर्णन किया। अब इस समय प्रयागका माहात्म्य बतलायें । सूतजी ! आप समस्त अर्थोको जाननेवाले हैं, अब आप वहाँ (प्रयाग)-के जो महान् प्रसिद्ध तीर्थ हैं, उन्हें हमें बताइये
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas, after eulogising the lord of Devas thus with devotion, (Krsna) Madhava fell at the feet of the lord and the goddess (Uma) prostrate like a staff.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas, after eulogising the lord of Devas thus with devotion, (Krsna) Madhava fell at the feet of the lord and the goddess (Uma) prostrate like a staff.

verses.sanskrit: कालानलसमप्रख्यं ज्वालामालासमाकुलम् । क्षयवृद्धिविनिर्मुक्तमादिमध्यान्तवर्जितम्
verses.transliteration: kālānalasamaprakhyaṃ jvālāmālāsamākulam / kṣayavṛddhivinirmuktamādimadhyāntavarjitam
verses.translation: After lifting up Kr?na, the slayer of Kesin, the lord accompanied by Uma spoke these sweet words with the majestic- rumbling sound of a cloud.
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले--ऋषियो! आप सभी सुनें। मैं विस्तारसे आप लोगोंको प्रयागका माहात्म्य बतलाता हुँ, जहाँ पितामह देव स्थित हैं। (महर्षि) मार्कण्डेयने कुन्तीके पुत्र महात्मा युधिष्ठिरसे जो कुछ कहा था, वही में आपलोगोंको बताता हूँ
verses.wordMeaning: After lifting up Kr?na, the slayer of Kesin, the lord accompanied by Uma spoke these sweet words with the majestic- rumbling sound of a cloud.
verses.commentary: Sense: After lifting up Kr?na, the slayer of Kesin, the lord accompanied by Uma spoke these sweet words with the majestic- rumbling sound of a cloud.

verses.sanskrit: ततो मामाह भगवानधो गच्छ त्वमाशु वै । अन्तमस्य विजानीम ऊर्ध्वं गच्छे ऽहमित्यजः
verses.transliteration: tato māmāha bhagavānadho gaccha tvamāśu vai / antamasya vijānīma ūrdhvaṃ gacche 'hamityajaḥ
verses.translation: "O Lotus-eyed Krsna, why is this penance being performed by you? You alone are the bestower of all desires and holy rites.
verses.hindi: भाइयोंके साथ सभी कौरवोंको मारनेके उपरान्त राजा युधिष्ठिर महान् शोकसे आविष्ट होकर मोहसे तपस्वी मार्कण्डेय मुनि हस्तिनापुरमें आये और राजमहलके द्वारपर खड़े हो गये
verses.wordMeaning: "O Lotus-eyed Krsna, why is this penance being performed by you? You alone are the bestower of all desires and holy rites.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Lotus-eyed Krsna, why is this penance being performed by you? You alone are the bestower of all desires and holy rites.

verses.sanskrit: तदाशु समयं कृत्वा गतावूर्ध्वमधश्च द्वौ । पितामहो ऽप्यहं नान्तं ज्ञातवन्तौ समाः शतम्
verses.transliteration: tadāśu samayaṃ kṛtvā gatāvūrdhvamadhaśca dvau / pitāmaho 'pyahaṃ nāntaṃ jñātavantau samāḥ śatam
verses.translation: Indeed you alone are that great form of mine named Narayana. O Purusottama, the entire universe, cannot exist without you.
verses.hindi: उन्हें देखकर द्वारपालने भी शीघ्र जाकर राजा (युधिष्ठिर)-से कहा-आपके दर्शनकी इच्छासे मुनि मार्कण्डेय द्वारपर खड़े हैं। धर्मपुत्र युधिष्ठिर शीघ्र ही महामुने! आपका स्वागत है, स्वागत है । आज मेरा जन्म सफल हो गया, आज मेरा कुल तर गया। महामुने! आपके प्रसन्न होनेपर आज मेरे पितृगण संतुष्ट हो गये
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed you alone are that great form of mine named Narayana. O Purusottama, the entire universe, cannot exist without you.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed you alone are that great form of mine named Narayana. O Purusottama, the entire universe, cannot exist without you.

verses.sanskrit: ततो विस्मयमापन्नौ भीतौ देवस्य शूलिनः । मायया मोहितौ तस्य ध्यायन्तौ विश्वमीश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: tato vismayamāpannau bhītau devasya śūlinaḥ / māyayā mohitau tasya dhyāyantau viśvamīśvaram
verses.translation: O Narayana, you know the infinite Atman, the Supreme Lord, Mahadeva, the master of great Yoga, by means of your own Yoga, O Kesava."
verses.hindi: युधिष्ठिरो महात्मेति पूजयामास तं मुनिम् किमर्थ मुह्यसे विद्वन् सर्व ज्ञात्वाहमागतः
verses.wordMeaning: O Narayana, you know the infinite Atman, the Supreme Lord, Mahadeva, the master of great Yoga, by means of your own Yoga, O Kesava."
verses.commentary: Sense: O Narayana, you know the infinite Atman, the Supreme Lord, Mahadeva, the master of great Yoga, by means of your own Yoga, O Kesava."

verses.sanskrit: प्रोच्चारन्तौ महानादमोङ्कारं परमं पदम् । प्रह्वाञ्जलिपुटोपेतौ शंभुं तुष्टुवतुः परम्
verses.transliteration: proccārantau mahānādamoṅkāraṃ paramaṃ padam / prahvāñjalipuṭopetau śaṃbhuṃ tuṣṭuvatuḥ param
verses.translation: On hearing his words, Krsna laughingly gazed at the bull-bannered lord of the universe, and the goddess, the daughter of the mountain Himavan and addressed:
verses.hindi: ततो युधिष्ठिरो राजा प्रणम्याह महामुनिम्। कथय त्वं समासेन येन मुच्येत किल्बिषैः अस्माभिः कौरवैः सार्ध प्रसङ्गान्मुनिपुंगव
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing his words, Krsna laughingly gazed at the bull-bannered lord of the universe, and the goddess, the daughter of the mountain Himavan and addressed:
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing his words, Krsna laughingly gazed at the bull-bannered lord of the universe, and the goddess, the daughter of the mountain Himavan and addressed:

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मविष्णू ऊचतुः । अनादिमलसंसाररोगवैद्याय शंभवे । नमः शिवाय शान्ताय ब्रह्मणे लिङ्गमूर्तये
verses.transliteration: brahmaviṣṇū ūcatuḥ / anādimalasaṃsārarogavaidyāya śaṃbhave / namaḥ śivāya śāntāya brahmaṇe liṅgamūrtaye
verses.translation: "O Sankara, everything has been understood by you by means of your own Yoga. O bestower of bliss, I wish to have a son equal to me. Grant unto me a son who will be your devotee."
verses.hindi: मुच्यते पातकादस्मात् तद् भवान् वक्तुमर्हति प्रयागगमनं श्रेष्ठं नराणां पापनाशनम्
verses.wordMeaning: "O Sankara, everything has been understood by you by means of your own Yoga. O bestower of bliss, I wish to have a son equal to me. Grant unto me a son who will be your devotee."
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Sankara, everything has been understood by you by means of your own Yoga. O bestower of bliss, I wish to have a son equal to me. Grant unto me a son who will be your devotee."

verses.sanskrit: प्रलयार्णवसंस्थाय प्रलयोद्भूतिहेतवे । नमः शिवाय शान्ताय ब्रह्मणे लिङ्गमूर्तये
verses.transliteration: pralayārṇavasaṃsthāya pralayodbhūtihetave / namaḥ śivāya śāntāya brahmaṇe liṅgamūrtaye
verses.translation: "So be it" said the Atman of the universe, Kara with a delighted mind. Looking at the goddess, the daughter of the mountain, he embraced Kesava.
verses.hindi: तत्र देवो महादेवो रुद्रो विश्वामरेश्वरः। समास्ते भगवान् ब्रह्मा स्वयम्भूरपि हैवतेः मृतानां का गतिस्तत्र स्तातानामपि कि फलम्
verses.wordMeaning: "So be it" said the Atman of the universe, Kara with a delighted mind. Looking at the goddess, the daughter of the mountain, he embraced Kesava.
verses.commentary: Sense: "So be it" said the Atman of the universe, Kara with a delighted mind. Looking at the goddess, the daughter of the mountain, he embraced Kesava.

verses.sanskrit: ज्वालामालावृताङ्गाय ज्वलनस्तम्भरूपिणे । नमः शिवाय शान्ताय ब्रह्मणे लिङ्गमूर्तये
verses.transliteration: jvālāmālāvṛtāṅgāya jvalanastambharūpiṇe / namaḥ śivāya śāntāya brahmaṇe liṅgamūrtaye
verses.translation: Thereafter, that goddess, the mother of the worlds, the sharer of half the body of Sankara, the daughter of the mountain Himavan, spoke to Hfslkesa (Krsna).
verses.hindi: एतत् प्रजापतिक्षेत्रं त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतम्। अत्र स्त्रात्वा दिवं यान्ति ये मृतास्तेऽपुनर्भवाः तत्र ब्रह्मादयो देवा रक्षां कुर्वन्ति संगताः। बहून्यन्यानि तीर्थानि सर्वपापापहानि तु
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, that goddess, the mother of the worlds, the sharer of half the body of Sankara, the daughter of the mountain Himavan, spoke to Hfslkesa (Krsna).
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, that goddess, the mother of the worlds, the sharer of half the body of Sankara, the daughter of the mountain Himavan, spoke to Hfslkesa (Krsna).

verses.sanskrit: आदिमध्यान्तहीनाय स्वबावामलदीप्तये । नमः शिवाय शान्ताय ब्रह्मणे लिङ्गमूर्तये
verses.transliteration: ādimadhyāntahīnāya svabāvāmaladīptaye / namaḥ śivāya śāntāya brahmaṇe liṅgamūrtaye
verses.translation: "O infinite one, I know the unflinching exclusive devotion you always cherish towards Mahesvara and also towards me, O Kesava.
verses.hindi: संक्षेपेण प्रवक्ष्यामि प्रयागस्येह कीर्तनम् महात्मा युधिष्ठिरने उन मुनिको सिंहासनपर बैठाकर पादप्रक्षालन, पूजन इत्यादिके द्वारा उनका सम्मान किया
verses.wordMeaning: "O infinite one, I know the unflinching exclusive devotion you always cherish towards Mahesvara and also towards me, O Kesava.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O infinite one, I know the unflinching exclusive devotion you always cherish towards Mahesvara and also towards me, O Kesava.

verses.sanskrit: महादेवाय महते ज्योतिषे ऽनन्ततेजसे । नमः शिवाय शान्ताय ब्रह्मणे लिङ्गमूर्तये
verses.transliteration: mahādevāya mahate jyotiṣe 'nantatejase / namaḥ śivāya śāntāya brahmaṇe liṅgamūrtaye
verses.translation: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.
verses.hindi: तब प्रसन्न होकर मार्कण्डेयने युधिष्ठिरसे कहा-- विद्वन्! आप मोह क्यों कर रहे हैं सभी कुछ जानकर ही मैं यहाँ आया हुँ। तदनन्तर राजा युधिष्ठिरने प्रणामकर महामुनिसे कहा-आप संक्षेपमें (कोई उपाय) बतलायें, जिससे में पापोंसे मुक्त हो सकूँ
verses.wordMeaning: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.

verses.sanskrit: प्रधानपुरुषेशाय व्योमरूपाय वेधसे । नमः शिवाय शान्ताय ब्रह्मणे लिङ्गमूर्तये
verses.transliteration: pradhānapuruṣeśāya vyomarūpāya vedhase / namaḥ śivāya śāntāya brahmaṇe liṅgamūrtaye
verses.translation: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.
