verses.hindi: हे मुनिश्रेष्ठ! हमने (युद्धके) प्रसंगवश कौरवोंके साथ अनेक निरपराध मनुष्योंको युद्धमें मारा है, अतः आप वह (कोई उपाय) बतलायें, जिससे हिंसाजनित दोष एवं जन्मान्तरमें किये गये पापों तथा इस पापसे भी मार्कण्डेयने कहा--हे राजन् ! भारत! महाभाग! आप जो मुझसे पूछते हैं उसे सुनें-मनुष्योंके लिये पापको नष्ट करने-हेतु प्रयागको यात्रा करना श्रेष्ठ (उपाय) है। वहाँ सभी देवताओंके ईश्वर महादेव
verses.wordMeaning: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.

verses.sanskrit: निर्विकाराय सत्याय नित्यायामलतेजसे । नमः शिवाय शान्ताय ब्रह्मणे लिङ्गमूर्तये
verses.transliteration: nirvikārāya satyāya nityāyāmalatejase / namaḥ śivāya śāntāya brahmaṇe liṅgamūrtaye
verses.translation: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.
verses.hindi: रुद्र्देव और स्वयम्भू भगवान् ब्रह्मा देवताओंके साथ विराजमान हैं युधिष्ठिर बोले भगवन्! में सुनना चाहता हूँ कि प्रयाग जानेका क्या फल है? वहाँ मरनेवालोंकी कौन गति होती है और वहाँ स्नान करनेवालोंको क्या फल मिलता है ? जो प्रयागमें निवास करते हैं, उन्हें क्या फल
verses.wordMeaning: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.

verses.sanskrit: वेदान्तसाररूपाय कालरूपाय धीमते । नमः शिवाय शान्ताय ब्रह्मणे लिङ्गमूर्तये
verses.transliteration: vedāntasārarūpāya kālarūpāya dhīmate / namaḥ śivāya śāntāya brahmaṇe liṅgamūrtaye
verses.translation: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.
verses.hindi: मिलता है, आपको यह सब कुछ ज्ञात है, अतः मुझे वह सब बताये, आपको नमस्कार है मार्कण्डेयने कहा--वत्स! प्राचीन कालमें महर्षियोंद्वारा कही गयी (प्रयागकी महिमा) एवं प्रयाग-निवासका फल आदि जो कुछ मैंने सुना है, उसे मैं भलीभाँति आपको बतलाऊँगा। यह प्रजापति-
verses.wordMeaning: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.

verses.sanskrit: एवं संस्तूयमानस्तु व्यक्तो भूत्वा महेश्वरः । भाति देवो महायोगी सूर्यकोटिसमप्रभः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ saṃstūyamānastu vyakto bhūtvā maheśvaraḥ / bhāti devo mahāyogī sūryakoṭisamaprabhaḥ
verses.translation: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.
verses.hindi: क्षेत्र तीनों लोकोंमें विख्यात है । यहाँपर स्नान करनेवाले स्वर्गलोकमें जाते हैं और जो यहाँ मृत्युको प्राप्त होते हैं, उनका पुनर्जन्म नहीं होता। यहाँ ब्रह्मा आदि देवता मिलकर (प्रयाग-निवासियोंको) रक्षा करते हैं और सभी पापोंको दूर करनेवाले अन्य भी अनेक तीर्थ यहाँ हैं। मैं सैकड़ों वर्षॉमें भी उनका वर्णन नहीं कर सकता तथापि संक्षेपमें ही प्रयाग (-की महिमा)-का कीर्तन करता हूँ
verses.wordMeaning: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.

verses.sanskrit: वक्त्रकोटिसहस्त्रेण ग्रसमान इवाम्बरम् । सहस्त्रहस्तचरणः सूर्यसोमाग्निलोचनः
verses.transliteration: vaktrakoṭisahastreṇa grasamāna ivāmbaram / sahastrahastacaraṇaḥ sūryasomāgnilocanaḥ
verses.translation: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.
verses.hindi: साठ हजार धनुष जाहवी (गङ्गा)-की रक्षा करते यमुनां रक्षति सदा सविता सप्तवाहनः॥ २३॥  हैं और सात अश्वोंको वाहन बनानेवाले सवितादेव सदा
verses.wordMeaning: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.

verses.sanskrit: पिनाकपाणिर्भगवान् कृत्तिवासास्त्रिशूलभृत् । व्यालयज्ञोपवीतश्च मेघदुन्दुभिनिः स्वनः
verses.transliteration: pinākapāṇirbhagavān kṛttivāsāstriśūlabhṛt / vyālayajñopavītaśca meghadundubhiniḥ svanaḥ
verses.translation: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.
verses.hindi: मण्डलं रक्षति हरिः सर्वदेवैश्च सम्मितम् स्थानं रक्षन्ति वै देवाः सर्वपापहरं शुभम्
verses.wordMeaning: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.

verses.sanskrit: अथोवाच महादेवः प्रीतो ऽहं सुरसत्तमौ । पश्येतं मां महादेवं भयं सर्वं प्रमुच्यताम्
verses.transliteration: athovāca mahādevaḥ prīto 'haṃ surasattamau / paśyetaṃ māṃ mahādevaṃ bhayaṃ sarvaṃ pramucyatām
verses.translation: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.
verses.hindi: स्वकर्मणावृतो लोको नैव गच्छति तत्पदम्। स्वल्पं स्वल्पतरं पापं यदा तस्य नराधिप। प्रयागं स्मरमाणस्य सर्वमायाति संक्षयम् दर्शनात् तस्य तीर्थस्य नाम संकीर्तनादपि। मृत्तिकालम्भनाद् वापि नरः पापात् प्रमुच्यते
verses.wordMeaning: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.

verses.sanskrit: युवां प्रसूतौ गात्रेभ्यो मम पूर्वं सनातनौ । अयं मे दक्षिणे पार्श्वे ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः । वामपार्श्वे च मे विष्णुः पालको हृदये हरः
verses.transliteration: yuvāṃ prasūtau gātrebhyo mama pūrvaṃ sanātanau / ayaṃ me dakṣiṇe pārśve brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ / vāmapārśve ca me viṣṇuḥ pālako hṛdaye haraḥ
verses.translation: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.
verses.hindi: प्रयागं विशतः पुंसः पापं नश्यति तत्क्षणात् अपि दुष्कृतकर्मासौ लभते परमां गतिम्
verses.wordMeaning: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.

verses.sanskrit: प्रीतो ऽहं युवयोः सम्यक् वरं दद्मि यथेप्सितम् । एवमुक्त्वाथ मां देवो महादेवः स्वयं शिवः । आलिङ्ग्य देवं ब्रह्माणं प्रसादाभिमुखो ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: prīto 'haṃ yuvayoḥ samyak varaṃ dadmi yathepsitam / evamuktvātha māṃ devo mahādevaḥ svayaṃ śivaḥ / āliṅgya devaṃ brahmāṇaṃ prasādābhimukho 'bhavat
verses.translation: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.
verses.hindi: कीर्तनान्मुच्यते पापाद् दृष्ट्रा भद्राणि पश्यति। तथोपस्पृश्य राजेन्द्र स्वर्गलोके महीयते दीप्तकाञ्जनवणभिर्विमानेर्भानुवर्णिभिः । ईप्सिताँल्लभते कामान् वदन्ति मुनिपुंगवाः
verses.wordMeaning: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रहृष्टमनसौ प्रणिपत्य महेश्वरम् । ऊचतुः प्रेक्ष्य तद्वक्त्रं नारायणपितामहौ
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prahṛṣṭamanasau praṇipatya maheśvaram / ūcatuḥ prekṣya tadvaktraṃ nārāyaṇapitāmahau
verses.translation: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.
verses.hindi: वराङ्गनासमाकी्णेर्मोदते शुभलक्षणः यमुनाकी रक्षा करते हैं । प्रयागमें विशेषरूपसे इन्द्र स्वयं निवास करते हें । समस्त देवोंसे युक्त विष्णु प्रयागमण्डलको रक्षा करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.

verses.sanskrit: यदि प्रीतिः समुत्पन्ना यदि देयो वरश्च नौ । भक्तिर्भवतु नौ नित्यं त्वयि देव महेश्वरे
verses.transliteration: yadi prītiḥ samutpannā yadi deyo varaśca nau / bhaktirbhavatu nau nityaṃ tvayi deva maheśvare
verses.translation: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.
verses.hindi: (प्रयागके विशाल) वटवृक्षकी रक्षा हाथमें त्रिशूल धारण करनेवाले महेश्वर नित्य करते हैं और सभी पापोंको हरनेवाले इस शुभ स्थानकी रक्षा सभी देवता करते हैं। है नराधिप! जो लोग अपने कर्मोसे घिरे हैं
verses.wordMeaning: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.

verses.sanskrit: ततः स भगवानीशः प्रहसन् परमेश्वरः । उवाच मां महादेवः प्रीतः प्रीतेन चेतसा
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa bhagavānīśaḥ prahasan parameśvaraḥ / uvāca māṃ mahādevaḥ prītaḥ prītena cetasā
verses.translation: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.
verses.hindi: तथा जिनका छोटेसे भी छोटा पाप बचा रहता है, वे लोग उस मोक्ष-पदको प्राप्त नहीं करते, किंतु प्रयागका स्मरण करनेवालेका यह सभी कुछ (पाप एवं कर्म) नष्ट हो जाता है इस (प्रयाग) तीर्थके दर्शन करनेसे, नामका संकीर्तन करनेसे अथवा यहाँकी मिट्टीका स्पर्श करनेसे भी मनुष्य पापसे मुक्त हो जाता है । राजेन्द्र ! यहाँ (प्रयागमें) पाँच कुण्ड हैं, जिनके बीचमें जाहवी (गङ्गा) स्थित है।
verses.wordMeaning: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.

verses.sanskrit: देव उवाच प्रलयस्थितिसर्गाणां कर्ता त्वं धरणीपते । वत्स वत्स हरे विश्वं पालयैतच्चराचरम्
verses.transliteration: deva uvāca pralayasthitisargāṇāṃ kartā tvaṃ dharaṇīpate / vatsa vatsa hare viśvaṃ pālayaitaccarācaram
verses.translation: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.
verses.hindi: प्रयागमें प्रवेश करनेवालेका पाप तत्क्षण ही नष्ट हो जाता है। सहस्रों योजन दूरसे भी जो मनुष्य गङ्गाका स्मरण करता है, वह दुष्कृत करनेवाला होनेपर भी परम गतिको प्राप्त करता है॥ २७--२९॥
verses.wordMeaning: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिधा भिन्नो ऽस्म्यहं विष्णो ब्रह्मविष्णुहराख्यया । सर्गरक्षालयगुणैर्निर्गुणो ऽपि निरञ्जनः
verses.transliteration: tridhā bhinno 'smyahaṃ viṣṇo brahmaviṣṇuharākhyayā / sargarakṣālayaguṇairnirguṇo 'pi nirañjanaḥ
verses.translation: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.
verses.hindi: हे राजेन्द्र! (प्रयागका नाम-) कीर्तन करगेसे (मनुष्य) पापसे मुक्त हो जाता है और इसका दर्शन करनेसे (उसे सर्वत्र) मङ्गल-ही-मङ्गल दिखलायी पड़ता है तथा यहाँ आचमन (इसके जलसे स्नान) करनेसे स्वर्गलोकमें प्रतिष्ठा प्राप्त होती है
verses.wordMeaning: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.

verses.sanskrit: संमोहं त्यज भो विष्णो पालयैनं पितामहम् । भविष्यत्येष भगवांस्तव पुत्रः सनातनः
verses.transliteration: saṃmohaṃ tyaja bho viṣṇo pālayainaṃ pitāmaham / bhaviṣyatyeṣa bhagavāṃstava putraḥ sanātanaḥ
verses.translation: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.
verses.hindi: कोई मनुष्य व्याधिग्रस्त हो, दीन हो अथवा क्रुद्ध हो, यदि वह प्रयत्नपूर्वक गङ्गा-यमुनाके समीप पहुँचकर प्राण-त्याग करता है तो वह सूर्यके समान उद्दीप, स्वर्णिम आभावाले विमानोंसे युक्त होकर अभीष्ट पदार्थोंको प्राप्त
verses.wordMeaning: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.

verses.sanskrit: अहं च भवतो वक्त्रात् कल्पादौ घोररूपधृक् । शूलपाणिर्भविष्यामि क्रोधजस्तव पुत्रकः
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ ca bhavato vaktrāt kalpādau ghorarūpadhṛk / śūlapāṇirbhaviṣyāmi krodhajastava putrakaḥ
verses.translation: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.
verses.hindi: करता है-एऐसा श्रेष्ठ मुनिजनोंका कहना है वह शुभ लक्षणोंबाला (मनुष्य) सभी रत्नोंसे युक्त अनेक प्रकारकी दिव्य ध्वजाओंसे परिपूर्ण और वराङ्गनाओसे समन्वित होकर आनन्दित होता है। शयन करनेपर वह गीत और वाद्यकी ध्वनिसे जगाया जाता है, जबतक वह
verses.wordMeaning: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा महादेवो ब्रह्माणं मुनिसत्तम । अनुगृह्य च मां देवस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā mahādevo brahmāṇaṃ munisattama / anugṛhya ca māṃ devastatraivāntaradhīyata
verses.translation: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.
verses.hindi: जन्मका स्मरण नहीं करता, तबतक स्वर्गमें प्रतिष्ठित रहता है
verses.wordMeaning: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रभृति लोकेषु लिङ्गार्चा सुप्रतिष्ठिता । लिङ्ग तल्लयनाद् ब्रह्मन् ब्रह्मणः परमं वपुः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prabhṛti lokeṣu liṅgārcā supratiṣṭhitā / liṅga tallayanād brahman brahmaṇaḥ paramaṃ vapuḥ
verses.translation: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.
verses.hindi: तस्मात् स्वर्गात् परिभ्रष्टः क्षीणकर्मा नरोत्तम । हिरण्यरलसम्पूर्ण समृद्धे जायते कुले तदेव स्मरते तीर्थ स्मरणात् तत्र गच्छति। देशस्थो यदि वारण्ये विदेशे यदि वा गृहे
verses.wordMeaning: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.

verses.sanskrit: एतल्लिङ्गस्य माहात्म्यं भाषितं ते मयानघ । एतद् बुध्यन्ति योगज्ञा न देवा न च दानवाः
verses.transliteration: etalliṅgasya māhātmyaṃ bhāṣitaṃ te mayānagha / etad budhyanti yogajñā na devā na ca dānavāḥ
verses.translation: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मलोकमवाप्नोति वदन्ति मुनिपुंगवाः
verses.wordMeaning: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.

verses.sanskrit: एतद्धि परमं ज्ञानमव्यक्तं शिवसंज्ञितम् । येन सूक्ष्ममचिन्त्यं तत् पश्यन्ति ज्ञान वक्षुषः
verses.transliteration: etaddhi paramaṃ jñānamavyaktaṃ śivasaṃjñitam / yena sūkṣmamacintyaṃ tat paśyanti jñāna vakṣuṣaḥ
verses.translation: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.
verses.hindi: सर्वकामफला वृक्षा मही यत्र हिरण्मयी। ऋषयो मुनयः सिद्धास्तत्र लोके स गच्छति मोदते मुनिभिः सार्ध स्वकृतेनेह कर्मणा
verses.wordMeaning: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मै भगवते नित्यं नमस्कारं प्रकुर्महे । महादेवाय रुद्राय देवदेवाय लिङ्गिने
verses.transliteration: tasmai bhagavate nityaṃ namaskāraṃ prakurmahe / mahādevāya rudrāya devadevāya liṅgine
verses.translation: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.
verses.hindi: सिद्धचारणगन्धर्वैः पूज्यते दिवि हैवतैः। ततः स्वर्गात् परिभ्रष्टो जम्बूद्वीपपतिर्भवेत्
verses.wordMeaning: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.

verses.sanskrit: नमो वेदरहस्याय नीलकण्ठाय वै नमः । विभीषणाय शान्ताय स्थाणवे हेतवे नमः
verses.transliteration: namo vedarahasyāya nīlakaṇṭhāya vai namaḥ / vibhīṣaṇāya śāntāya sthāṇave hetave namaḥ
verses.translation: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.
verses.hindi: ततः शुभानि कर्माणि चिन्तयानः पुनः पुनः। कर्मणा मनसा वाचा सत्यधर्मप्रतिष्ठितः
verses.wordMeaning: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मणे वामदेवाय त्रिनेत्राय महीयसे । शङ्कराय महेशाय गिरीशाय शिवाय च
verses.transliteration: brahmaṇe vāmadevāya trinetrāya mahīyase / śaṅkarāya maheśāya girīśāya śivāya ca
verses.translation: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.
verses.hindi: स्वकार्ये पितृकार्ये वा देवताभ्यर्चनेऽपि वा। निष्फलं तस्य तत् तीर्थ यावत् तत्फलमश्नुते
verses.wordMeaning: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.

verses.sanskrit: नमः कुरुष्व सततं ध्यायस्व मनसा हरम् । संसारसागरादस्मादचिरादुत्तरिष्यसि
verses.transliteration: namaḥ kuruṣva satataṃ dhyāyasva manasā haram / saṃsārasāgarādasmādacirāduttariṣyasi
verses.translation: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.
verses.hindi: तावदवर्षसहस्त्राणि रुद्रलोके महीयते नरोत्तम! (पुण्य) कर्मोके क्षीण होनेपर स्वर्गसे च्युत होकर वह स्वर्ण तथा रत्नोंसे परिपूर्ण समृद्ध कुलमें जन्म लेता है और इसी तीर्थ (प्रयाग)-का स्मरण करता है। स्मरण होनेपर पुनः वहाँ जाता है। अपने देश, विदेश,
verses.wordMeaning: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.

verses.sanskrit: एवं स वासुदेवेन व्याहृतो मुनिपुङ्गवः । जगाम मनसा देवमीशानं विश्वतोमुखम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ sa vāsudevena vyāhṛto munipuṅgavaḥ / jagāma manasā devamīśānaṃ viśvatomukham
verses.translation: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.
verses.hindi: अरण्य अथवा घरमें जो प्रयागका स्मरण करते हुए प्राणोंका परित्याग करता है, वह ब्रह्मलोक प्राप्त करता है, ऐसा श्रेष्ठ मुनि कहते हैं। वह उस लोकमें जाता है, जहाँके सभी वृक्ष इच्छानुसार फल देते हैं, जहाँकी
verses.wordMeaning: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.

verses.sanskrit: प्रणम्य शिरसा कृष्णमनुज्ञातो महामुनिः । जगाम चेप्सितं देशं देवदेवस्य शूलिनः
verses.transliteration: praṇamya śirasā kṛṣṇamanujñāto mahāmuniḥ / jagāma cepsitaṃ deśaṃ devadevasya śūlinaḥ
verses.translation: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.
verses.hindi: भूमि स्वर्णमयी है और जहाँ ऋषि, मुनि तथा सिद्धजन रहते हैं अपने किये कर्मोके कारण वह सहस्रं स्त्रियोंसे रमणीय मन्दाकिनीके शुभ तटपर मुनियोंके साथ आनन्द प्राप्त करता है। वह स्वर्गमें सिद्ध, चारण, गन्धर्व तथा देवताओंसे पूजित होता है, तदनन्तर स्वर्गसे च्युत होनेपर वह (पुरुष)
verses.wordMeaning: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.

verses.sanskrit: य इमं श्रावयेन्नित्यं लिङ्गाध्यायमनुत्तमम् । शृणुयाद् वा पठेद् वापि सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: ya imaṃ śrāvayennityaṃ liṅgādhyāyamanuttamam / śṛṇuyād vā paṭhed vāpi sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
verses.translation: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.
verses.hindi: जम्बूद्वीपका स्वामी होता है । तदुपरान्त वह बार-बार शुभ कर्मोका चिन्तन करता हुआ गुणवान् तथा धनसम्पन्न हो जाता है और मन, वाणी तथा कर्मसे सत्यधर्मपर प्रतिष्ठित रहता है, इसमें कोई संशय नहीं है॥ ३९--४१ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा सकृदपि ह्येतत् तपश्चरणमुत्तमम् । वासुदेवस्य विप्रेन्द्राः पापं मुञ्चिति मानवः
verses.transliteration: śrutvā sakṛdapi hyetat tapaścaraṇamuttamam / vāsudevasya viprendrāḥ pāpaṃ muñciti mānavaḥ
verses.translation: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.
verses.hindi: जो व्यक्ति स्वकार्य, पितृकार्यं अथवा देवताकी पूजा करते समय गङ्गा और यमुनाके मध्यमें ग्राम, सुवर्ण, मोती या अन्य कोई पदार्थ प्रतिग्रह (दान)-में लेता है, उसे तीर्थका पुण्य उस समयतक नहीं मिलता है, जबतक वह दानमें लिये हुए पदार्थका भोग करता रहता है। अतः तीर्थो तथा पवित्र मन्दिरोंमें दान नहीं लेना चाहिए । द्विजको सभी प्रकारके प्रयोजनोंमें सावधान रहना चाहिए ॥ ४२--४४॥
verses.wordMeaning: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.

verses.sanskrit: जपेद् वाहरहर्नित्यं ब्रह्मलोके महीयते । एवमाह महायोगी कृष्णद्वैपायनः प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: japed vāharaharnityaṃ brahmaloke mahīyate / evamāha mahāyogī kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaḥ prabhuḥ
verses.translation: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ (युधिष्ठिर) ! जो व्यक्ति (प्रयागमें) कपिल अथवा पाटलवर्णकी, सुवर्णमण्डित सींगवाली, रजतमण्डित खुरोंवाली, वस्त्रसे आच्छादित कण्ठवाली पयस्विनी गायका दान करता है, वह उतने हजार वर्षोतक
verses.wordMeaning: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are Narayana, the Supreme Person, the veritable Atman of all. You were born as Devaki's son as you had been entreated to do so by gods formerly.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे पञ्चविंशो ऽध्यायः सूत उवाच ततो लब्धवरः कृष्णो जाम्बवत्यां महेश्वरात् । अजीजनन्महात्मानं साम्बमात्मजमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge pañcaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca tato labdhavaraḥ kṛṣṇo jāmbavatyāṃ maheśvarāt / ajījananmahātmānaṃ sāmbamātmajamuttamam
verses.translation: See Atman through your own Atman now. There is no difference between us. Sages know us to be identical.
verses.hindi: रुद्रलोकमें पूजित होता है, जितने उस गायके शरीरमें रोम होते हैं इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे वद्साहय्रथां संहितायां पूर्वविधागे चतुल्तरिशोउध्याय:
verses.wordMeaning: See Atman through your own Atman now. There is no difference between us. Sages know us to be identical.
verses.commentary: Sense: See Atman through your own Atman now. There is no difference between us. Sages know us to be identical.

verses.sanskrit: प्रद्युम्नस्याप्यभूत् पुत्रो ह्यनिरुद्धो महाबलः । तावुभौ गुणसंपन्नौ कृष्णस्यैवापरे तनू
verses.transliteration: pradyumnasyāpyabhūt putro hyaniruddho mahābalaḥ / tāvubhau guṇasaṃpannau kṛṣṇasyaivāpare tanū
verses.translation: O Kesava, accept these desired boons from me viz. Omniscience, prosperity and the knowledge pertaining to the Supreme Lord.
verses.hindi: + इसका तात्पर्य यह है कि तीर्थमे निवास अन्तःकरणको शुद्धिके लिये ही होता है, अतः लोभरहित होकर अनासक्त-भावसे
verses.wordMeaning: O Kesava, accept these desired boons from me viz. Omniscience, prosperity and the knowledge pertaining to the Supreme Lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Kesava, accept these desired boons from me viz. Omniscience, prosperity and the knowledge pertaining to the Supreme Lord.

verses.sanskrit: हत्वा च कंसं नरकमन्यांश्च शतशो ऽसुरान् । विजित्य लीलया शक्रं जित्वा बाणं महासुरम्
verses.transliteration: hatvā ca kaṃsaṃ narakamanyāṃśca śataśo 'surān / vijitya līlayā śakraṃ jitvā bāṇaṃ mahāsuram
verses.translation: The KP. tries to emphasize the oneness of the trinity of gods in so many places in order to counteract the divisive tendencies in different sects in those times.
verses.hindi: तीर्थमें निवास करना चाहिए। इसीलिये तीर्थमें यदि कोई लोभवश या आसक्तिवश दान लेता है तो यह प्रतिग्रह लोभको बढ़ायेगा तथा अन्तःकरणकी शुद्धिमें बाधक होगा। अत: दाताके कल्याणमात्रके लिये भले ही दान लिया जाय, पर लोभवश दान नहीं लेना चाहिए । साथ ही जप-तप आदि प्रायश्चित्तद्वारा इसका निराकरण भी करना चाहिए। प्रयाग-माहात्म्य, प्रयागके विभिन्न तीर्थोकी महिमा, त्रिपथगा गङ्काका माहात्म्य, गङ्गास्तानका फल
verses.wordMeaning: The KP. tries to emphasize the oneness of the trinity of gods in so many places in order to counteract the divisive tendencies in different sects in those times.
verses.commentary: Sense: The KP. tries to emphasize the oneness of the trinity of gods in so many places in order to counteract the divisive tendencies in different sects in those times.

verses.sanskrit: स्थापयित्वा जगत् कृत्स्नं लोके धर्मांश्च शाश्वतान् । चक्रे नारायणो गन्तुं स्वस्थानं बुद्धिमुत्तमाम्
verses.transliteration: sthāpayitvā jagat kṛtsnaṃ loke dharmāṃśca śāśvatān / cakre nārāyaṇo gantuṃ svasthānaṃ buddhimuttamām
verses.translation: The residents of Kailasa mountain saw that noble- souled Krsna. They worshipped Acyuta in the same manner as the lord of Devas.
verses.hindi: नरके वसते घोरे समाः कल्पशतायुतम्।
verses.wordMeaning: The residents of Kailasa mountain saw that noble- souled Krsna. They worshipped Acyuta in the same manner as the lord of Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The residents of Kailasa mountain saw that noble- souled Krsna. They worshipped Acyuta in the same manner as the lord of Devas.

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे विप्रा भृग्वाद्याः कृष्णमीश्वरम् । आजग्मुर्द्वारकां द्रष्टुं कृतकार्यं सनातनम्
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare viprā bhṛgvādyāḥ kṛṣṇamīśvaram / ājagmurdvārakāṃ draṣṭuṃ kṛtakāryaṃ sanātanam
verses.translation: On one occasion, Krsna the increaser of the delight ofDevakI, roamed about in the mountain caves for the purpose of sport.
verses.hindi: न स पश्यति तं घोरं नरकं तेन कर्मणा। उत्तरान् स कुरून् गत्वा मोदते कालमक्षयम् ॥ सर्वलोकानतिक्रम्य रुद्रलोकं स गच्छति॥ तत्र ब्रह्मादयो देवा दिशश्च सदिगीश्वराः । लोकपालाश्च सिद्धाश्च पितरो लोकसम्मताः॥
verses.wordMeaning: On one occasion, Krsna the increaser of the delight ofDevakI, roamed about in the mountain caves for the purpose of sport.
verses.commentary: Sense: On one occasion, Krsna the increaser of the delight ofDevakI, roamed about in the mountain caves for the purpose of sport.

verses.sanskrit: स तानुवाच विश्वात्मा प्रणिपत्याभिपूज्य च । आसनेषूपविष्टान् वै सह रामेण धीमता
verses.transliteration: sa tānuvāca viśvātmā praṇipatyābhipūjya ca / āsaneṣūpaviṣṭān vai saha rāmeṇa dhīmatā
verses.translation: On seeing Krsna who was eulogised well, the Gandharva girls as well as the excellent divine Apsaras with brilliant ornaments* (*v.l. with their garments and ornaments slipping down) loved him (passionately).
verses.hindi: हरिश्च भगवानास्ते प्रजापतिपुरस्कृतः
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing Krsna who was eulogised well, the Gandharva girls as well as the excellent divine Apsaras with brilliant ornaments* (*v.l. with their garments and ornaments slipping down) loved him (passionately).
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing Krsna who was eulogised well, the Gandharva girls as well as the excellent divine Apsaras with brilliant ornaments* (*v.l. with their garments and ornaments slipping down) loved him (passionately).

verses.sanskrit: गमिष्ये तत् परं स्थानं स्वकीयं विष्णुसंज्ञितम् । कृतानि सर्वकार्याणि प्रसीदध्वं मुनीश्वराः
verses.transliteration: gamiṣye tat paraṃ sthānaṃ svakīyaṃ viṣṇusaṃjñitam / kṛtāni sarvakāryāṇi prasīdadhvaṃ munīśvarāḥ
verses.translation: Some of them who were skilled musicians were fascinated and overwhelmed with lust, on seeing the handsome son of Devaki and began to sing different songs.
verses.hindi: गङ्कायमुनयोर्मध्ये पृथिव्या जघनं स्मृतम्। प्रयागं राजशार्दूल त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतम्
verses.wordMeaning: Some of them who were skilled musicians were fascinated and overwhelmed with lust, on seeing the handsome son of Devaki and began to sing different songs.
verses.commentary: Sense: Some of them who were skilled musicians were fascinated and overwhelmed with lust, on seeing the handsome son of Devaki and began to sing different songs.

verses.sanskrit: इदं कलियुगं घोरं संप्राप्तमधुनाशुभम् । भविष्यन्ति जनाः सर्वे ह्यस्मिन् पापानुवर्तिनः
verses.transliteration: idaṃ kaliyugaṃ ghoraṃ saṃprāptamadhunāśubham / bhaviṣyanti janāḥ sarve hyasmin pāpānuvartinaḥ
verses.translation: Some of the girls full of amorous diversion danced in front of him. Some of them looked at him smilingly imbibing the nectar-like beauty of his face.
verses.hindi: नाभिके नीचेका स्त्रियोंका कोमल भाग जघन है।
verses.wordMeaning: Some of the girls full of amorous diversion danced in front of him. Some of them looked at him smilingly imbibing the nectar-like beauty of his face.
verses.commentary: Sense: Some of the girls full of amorous diversion danced in front of him. Some of them looked at him smilingly imbibing the nectar-like beauty of his face.

verses.sanskrit: प्रवर्तयध्वं मज्ज्ञानं ब्राह्मणानां हितावहम् । येनेमे कलिजैः पापैर्मुच्यन्ते हि द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: pravartayadhvaṃ majjñānaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ hitāvaham / yeneme kalijaiḥ pāpairmucyante hi dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: Some of the girls took off the excellent ornaments from their limbs and embellished Krsna with due respect— Krsna who himself was an ornament of the worlds.
verses.hindi: मार्कण्डेयने कहा --वत्स ! ऋषियोंके द्वारा प्रतिपादित विधानके अनुसार तीर्थयात्राकी विधिके क्रमको मैंने जैसे देखा और सुना, वह तुमसे कहता हूँ प्रयागतीर्थकी यात्रा करनेवाला कोई मनुष्य यदि कहीं बैलपर आरूढ़ होकर गमन करता है तो उसका भी फल सुनो- वह व्यक्ति दस हजार कल्पोंतक घोर नरकमें वास करता है, क्योंकि गौका भयंकर दारुण
verses.wordMeaning: Some of the girls took off the excellent ornaments from their limbs and embellished Krsna with due respect— Krsna who himself was an ornament of the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Some of the girls took off the excellent ornaments from their limbs and embellished Krsna with due respect— Krsna who himself was an ornament of the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: ये मां जनाः संस्मरन्ति कलौ सकृदपि प्रभुम् । तेषां नश्यतु तत् पापं भक्तानां पुरुषोत्तमे
verses.transliteration: ye māṃ janāḥ saṃsmaranti kalau sakṛdapi prabhum / teṣāṃ naśyatu tat pāpaṃ bhaktānāṃ puruṣottame
verses.translation: Some of them took off the excellent ornaments from his body and bedecked themselves, and adorned Madhava with their own ornaments.
verses.hindi: क्रोध इसके बाद ही दूर होता है। बेलको सवारी बनानेवाले मनुष्यके पितर उसका (तर्पण आदिमें दिया) जल ग्रहण नहीं करते हैं। जो अपने सभी पुत्रं एवं बालकोंको अपने ही समान यहाँ (प्रयागमें) खान
verses.wordMeaning: Some of them took off the excellent ornaments from his body and bedecked themselves, and adorned Madhava with their own ornaments.
verses.commentary: Sense: Some of them took off the excellent ornaments from his body and bedecked themselves, and adorned Madhava with their own ornaments.

verses.sanskrit: येर्ऽचयिष्यन्तिमां भक्त्या नित्यं कलियुगे द्विजाः । विधाना वेददृष्टेन ते गमिष्यन्ति तत् पदम्
verses.transliteration: yer'cayiṣyantimāṃ bhaktyā nityaṃ kaliyuge dvijāḥ / vidhānā vedadṛṣṭena te gamiṣyanti tat padam
verses.translation: A certain fawn-eyed damsel, fascinated by passionate love, approached Krsna and kissed his lotus-like face.
verses.hindi: कराता है तथा उन्हें (गङ्गा-यमुनाका) जल पिलाता है और उनके हाथों ब्राह्मणोंको दान कराता है (उसे उत्तम गति प्राप्त होती है) । जो मनुष्य ऐश्वर्य, लोभ या मोहवश यानद्वारा (तीर्थमें) जाता है, उसकी वह तीर्थयात्रा निष्फल होती है, इसलिये (तीर्थयात्रामें) यानका परित्यां करना चाहिए ॥ २--५॥
verses.wordMeaning: A certain fawn-eyed damsel, fascinated by passionate love, approached Krsna and kissed his lotus-like face.
verses.commentary: Sense: A certain fawn-eyed damsel, fascinated by passionate love, approached Krsna and kissed his lotus-like face.

verses.sanskrit: ये ब्राह्मणा वंशजाता युष्माकं वै सहस्त्रशः । तेषां नारायणे भक्तिर्भविष्यति कलौ युगे
verses.transliteration: ye brāhmaṇā vaṃśajātā yuṣmākaṃ vai sahastraśaḥ / teṣāṃ nārāyaṇe bhaktirbhaviṣyati kalau yuge
verses.translation: Catching hold of the hand of Govinda, the first cause of the worlds, a certain girl who was deluded by his Maya, took him to her own house.
verses.hindi: जो व्यक्ति गङ्गा-यमुनाके मध्य आर्ष विवाहपद्धतिसे अपने ऐश्वर्यके अनुकूल धनका व्ययकर कन्याका दान करता है, वह उस कर्मके कारण घोर नरकका दर्शन नहीं करता और उत्तर कुरुमें जाकर अनन्त कालतक
verses.wordMeaning: Catching hold of the hand of Govinda, the first cause of the worlds, a certain girl who was deluded by his Maya, took him to her own house.
verses.commentary: Sense: Catching hold of the hand of Govinda, the first cause of the worlds, a certain girl who was deluded by his Maya, took him to her own house.

verses.sanskrit: परात् परतरं यान्ति नारायणपरायणाः । न ते तत्र गमिष्यन्ति ये द्विषन्ति महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: parāt parataraṃ yānti nārāyaṇaparāyaṇāḥ / na te tatra gamiṣyanti ye dviṣanti maheśvaram
verses.translation: Assuming multifarious forms sportively, the lotus-eyed Lord Krsna fulfilled their desires.
verses.hindi: आनन्दोपभोग करता है (प्रयागमें अक्षय) वटबुक्षके नीचे जाकर जो प्राणोंका परित्याग करता है, वह सभी लोकोंका अतिक्रमण कर रुद्रलोकको जाता है। वहाँ ब्रह्मा आदि देवता, दिक्पालोंसहित दिशाएँ, लोकपाल, सिद्ध, लोकमें मान्य
verses.wordMeaning: Assuming multifarious forms sportively, the lotus-eyed Lord Krsna fulfilled their desires.
verses.commentary: Sense: Assuming multifarious forms sportively, the lotus-eyed Lord Krsna fulfilled their desires.

verses.sanskrit: ध्यानं होमं तपस्तप्तं ज्ञानं यज्ञादिको विधिः । तेषां विनश्यति क्षिप्रं ये निन्दन्ति पिनाकिनम्
verses.transliteration: dhyānaṃ homaṃ tapastaptaṃ jñānaṃ yajñādiko vidhiḥ / teṣāṃ vinaśyati kṣipraṃ ye nindanti pinākinam
verses.translation: Thus, for a long time, the glorious Hari, Narayana sported in the city of the lord of Devas, fascinating the whole universe with his Maya.
verses.hindi: पितर, सनत्कुमार आदि प्रमुख तथा दूसरे ब्रह्मर्षि, नाग, सुपर्ण एवं सिद्धगण तथा भगवान् हरि और प्रजापति प्रभृति नित्य निवास करते हैं॥ ८--१०॥
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, for a long time, the glorious Hari, Narayana sported in the city of the lord of Devas, fascinating the whole universe with his Maya.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, for a long time, the glorious Hari, Narayana sported in the city of the lord of Devas, fascinating the whole universe with his Maya.

verses.sanskrit: यो मां समाश्रयेन्नित्यमेकान्तं भावमाश्रितः । विनिन्द्य देवमीशानं स याति नरकायुतम्
verses.transliteration: yo māṃ samāśrayennityamekāntaṃ bhāvamāśritaḥ / vinindya devamīśānaṃ sa yāti narakāyutam
verses.translation: When a great deal of time elapsed, the residents of Dvaravati became weakened and dispirited as well as frightened on being separated from Govinda.
verses.hindi: गङ्गा-यमुनाके मध्यको पृथ्वीका जघन कहा गया है। है राजशार्दूल! प्रयाग तीनों लोकोंमें विख्यात है न मातृवचनात् तात न लोकवचनादपि। मतिरुत्क्रमणीया ते प्रयागगमनं प्रति
verses.wordMeaning: When a great deal of time elapsed, the residents of Dvaravati became weakened and dispirited as well as frightened on being separated from Govinda.
verses.commentary: Sense: When a great deal of time elapsed, the residents of Dvaravati became weakened and dispirited as well as frightened on being separated from Govinda.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् सा परिहर्तव्या निन्दा पशुपतौ द्विजाः । कर्मणा मनसा वाचा तद्भक्तेष्वपि यत्नतः
verses.transliteration: tasmāt sā parihartavyā nindā paśupatau dvijāḥ / karmaṇā manasā vācā tadbhakteṣvapi yatnataḥ
verses.translation: Then the powerful Garuda who had been dispatched at the outset, went to the mountain Himavan searching for Krsna everywhere.
verses.hindi: दश तीर्थसहस्त्राण घष्ट्रिकोट्यस्तथापरे। तेषां सांनिध्यमत्रैव तीर्थानां कुरुनन्दन
verses.wordMeaning: Then the powerful Garuda who had been dispatched at the outset, went to the mountain Himavan searching for Krsna everywhere.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the powerful Garuda who had been dispatched at the outset, went to the mountain Himavan searching for Krsna everywhere.

verses.sanskrit: ये तु दक्षाध्वरे शप्ता दधीयेन द्विजोत्तमाः । भविष्यन्ति कलौ भक्तैः परिहार्याः प्रयत्नतः
verses.transliteration: ye tu dakṣādhvare śaptā dadhīyena dvijottamāḥ / bhaviṣyanti kalau bhaktaiḥ parihāryāḥ prayatnataḥ
verses.translation: Then the powerful Garuda who had been dispatched at the outset, went to the mountain Himavan searching for Krsna everywhere.
verses.hindi: न ते जीवन्ति लोकेऽस्मिन् यत्र तत्र युधिष्ठिर ये प्रयागं न सम्प्राप्तास्त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतम् मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्यः शशाङ्क इव राहुणा
verses.wordMeaning: Then the powerful Garuda who had been dispatched at the outset, went to the mountain Himavan searching for Krsna everywhere.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the powerful Garuda who had been dispatched at the outset, went to the mountain Himavan searching for Krsna everywhere.

verses.sanskrit: द्विषन्तो देवमीशानं युष्माकं वंशसंभवाः । शप्ताश्च गौतमेनोर्व्यां न संभाष्या द्विजोत्तमैः
verses.transliteration: dviṣanto devamīśānaṃ yuṣmākaṃ vaṃśasaṃbhavāḥ / śaptāśca gautamenorvyāṃ na saṃbhāṣyā dvijottamaiḥ
verses.translation: Then the powerful Garuda who had been dispatched at the outset, went to the mountain Himavan searching for Krsna everywhere.
verses.hindi: तत्र गत्वा नरः स्थानं महादेवस्य धीमतः। आत्मानं तारयेत् पूर्व दशातीतान् दशापरान्
verses.wordMeaning: Then the powerful Garuda who had been dispatched at the outset, went to the mountain Himavan searching for Krsna everywhere.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the powerful Garuda who had been dispatched at the outset, went to the mountain Himavan searching for Krsna everywhere.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येवमुक्ताः कृष्णेन सर्व एव महर्षयः । ओमित्युक्त्वा ययुस्तूर्णंस्वानि स्थानानि सत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: ityevamuktāḥ kṛṣṇena sarva eva maharṣayaḥ / omityuktvā yayustūrṇaṃsvāni sthānāni sattamāḥ
verses.translation: Then the powerful Garuda who had been dispatched at the outset, went to the mountain Himavan searching for Krsna everywhere.
verses.hindi: स्वर्गलोकमवाप्नोति यावदाहूतसम्प्लवम् पूर्वपाश्वे तु गङ्गायास्त्रैलोक्ये ख्यातिमान् नृप।
verses.wordMeaning: Then the powerful Garuda who had been dispatched at the outset, went to the mountain Himavan searching for Krsna everywhere.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the powerful Garuda who had been dispatched at the outset, went to the mountain Himavan searching for Krsna everywhere.

verses.sanskrit: ततो नारायणः कृष्णो लीलयैव जगन्मयः । संहृत्य स्वकुलं सर्वं ययौ तत् परमं पदम्
verses.transliteration: tato nārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇo līlayaiva jaganmayaḥ / saṃhṛtya svakulaṃ sarvaṃ yayau tat paramaṃ padam
verses.translation: Then the powerful Garuda who had been dispatched at the outset, went to the mountain Himavan searching for Krsna everywhere.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मचारी जितक्रोधस््त्रिरात्रं यदि तिष्ठति। सर्वपापविशुद्धात्मा सोऽश्वमेधफलं लभेत्
verses.wordMeaning: Then the powerful Garuda who had been dispatched at the outset, went to the mountain Himavan searching for Krsna everywhere.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the powerful Garuda who had been dispatched at the outset, went to the mountain Himavan searching for Krsna everywhere.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येष वः समासेन राज्ञां वंशो ऽनुकीर्तितः । न शक्यो विस्तराद् वक्तुं किं भूयः श्रोतुमिच्छथ
verses.transliteration: ityeṣa vaḥ samāsena rājñāṃ vaṃśo 'nukīrtitaḥ / na śakyo vistarād vaktuṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchatha
verses.translation: Then the powerful Garuda who had been dispatched at the outset, went to the mountain Himavan searching for Krsna everywhere.
verses.hindi: हंसप्रपतनं नाम तीर्थ त्रैलोक्यविश्रुतम् वहाँ (गङ्गा-यमुनाके) संगमपर जो कठोर ब्रत धारणकर अभिषेक-स्रान करता है, वह अश्वमेध तथा राजसूय-यज्ञोंके समान फल प्राप्त करता है
verses.wordMeaning: Then the powerful Garuda who had been dispatched at the outset, went to the mountain Himavan searching for Krsna everywhere.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the powerful Garuda who had been dispatched at the outset, went to the mountain Himavan searching for Krsna everywhere.

verses.sanskrit: यः पठेच्छृणुयाद् वापि वंशानां कथनं शुभम् । सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तः स्वर्गलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyād vāpi vaṃśānāṃ kathanaṃ śubham / sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ svargaloke mahīyate
verses.translation: Then the powerful Garuda who had been dispatched at the outset, went to the mountain Himavan searching for Krsna everywhere.
verses.hindi: हे तात! माताके कहने अथवा अन्य लोगोंके कहनेपर भी प्रयाग जानेको बुद्धिका उत्क्रमण (परित्याग) नहीं करना चाहिए। है कुरुनन्दन! यहाँपर प्रमुख दस हजार तीर्थ तथा साठ करोड़ दूसरे तीर्थोका
verses.wordMeaning: Then the powerful Garuda who had been dispatched at the outset, went to the mountain Himavan searching for Krsna everywhere.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the powerful Garuda who had been dispatched at the outset, went to the mountain Himavan searching for Krsna everywhere.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे षड्विंशो ऽध्यायः ऋषय ऊचुः कृतं त्रेता द्वापरं च कलिश्चेति चतुर्युगम् । एषां स्वभावं सूताद्य कथयस्व समासतः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge ṣaḍviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ṛṣaya ūcuḥ kṛtaṃ tretā dvāparaṃ ca kaliśceti caturyugam / eṣāṃ svabhāvaṃ sūtādya kathayasva samāsataḥ
verses.translation: Unable to see Govinda there, he bowed down his head to the sage Upamanyu and came back to Dvaravati again.
verses.hindi: सांनिध्य है। योगयुक्त सत्त्वगुणी मनीषीकी जो गति होती है, वही गति गङ्गा-यमुनाके संगमपर प्राण त्याग करनेवालेकी होती है। है युधिष्ठिर! तीनों लोकोंमें विख्यात प्रयागमें जो नहीं पहुंचते, जहाँ-कहीं भी निवास करनेवाले वे लोग इस संसारमें जीवित रहते हुए भी मृतकके तुल्य हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Unable to see Govinda there, he bowed down his head to the sage Upamanyu and came back to Dvaravati again.
verses.commentary: Sense: Unable to see Govinda there, he bowed down his head to the sage Upamanyu and came back to Dvaravati again.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच गते नारायणे कृष्णे स्वमेव परमं पदम् । पार्थः परमधर्मात्मा पाण्डवः शत्रुतापनः
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca gate nārāyaṇe kṛṣṇe svameva paramaṃ padam / pārthaḥ paramadharmātmā pāṇḍavaḥ śatrutāpanaḥ
verses.translation: In the meanwhile, thousands of terrible Raksasas came to the splendid city of Dvaraka and threatened it.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार परम पदरूप इस प्रयागतीर्थका दर्शनकर मनुष्य सभी पापोंसे उसी प्रकार मुक्त हो जाता है, जैसे चन्द्रमा राहुसे मुक्त हो जाता है। यमुनाके दक्षिण
verses.wordMeaning: In the meanwhile, thousands of terrible Raksasas came to the splendid city of Dvaraka and threatened it.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meanwhile, thousands of terrible Raksasas came to the splendid city of Dvaraka and threatened it.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा चेवोत्तरविधिं शोकेन महतावृतः । अपश्यत् पथि गच्छन्तं कृष्णद्वैपायनं मुनिम्
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā cevottaravidhiṃ śokena mahatāvṛtaḥ / apaśyat pathi gacchantaṃ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaṃ munim
verses.translation: The powerful Garuda whose exploit was similar to that of Krsna killed them in a great battle and saved the splendid city.
verses.hindi: हैं। वहाँ त्रान करने और जल पीनेसे सभी पापोंसे मुक्ति हो जाती है धीमान् महादेवके उस स्थानपर जाकर मनुष्य अपनेको तथा दस पूर्वकी और दस बादकी सभी पीढ़ियोंको तार देता है। वहाँ स्नान करनेसे मनुष्य अश्वमेधका फल प्राप्त करता है तथा महाप्रलयपर्यन्त
verses.wordMeaning: The powerful Garuda whose exploit was similar to that of Krsna killed them in a great battle and saved the splendid city.
verses.commentary: Sense: The powerful Garuda whose exploit was similar to that of Krsna killed them in a great battle and saved the splendid city.

verses.sanskrit: शिष्यैः प्रशिष्यैरभितः संवृतं ब्रह्मवादिनम् । पपात दण्डवद् भूमौ त्यक्त्वा शोकं तदार्ऽजुनः
verses.transliteration: śiṣyaiḥ praśiṣyairabhitaḥ saṃvṛtaṃ brahmavādinam / papāta daṇḍavad bhūmau tyaktvā śokaṃ tadār'junaḥ
verses.translation: At that time, Narada, the holy sage, who happened to see Kfsna on the peak ofKailasa, went to Dvaravati.
verses.hindi: स्वर्गलोक प्राप्त करता है
verses.wordMeaning: At that time, Narada, the holy sage, who happened to see Kfsna on the peak ofKailasa, went to Dvaravati.
verses.commentary: Sense: At that time, Narada, the holy sage, who happened to see Kfsna on the peak ofKailasa, went to Dvaravati.

verses.sanskrit: उवाच परमप्रीतः कस्माद् देशान्महामुने । इदानीं गच्छसि क्षिप्रं कं वा देशं प्रति प्रभो
verses.transliteration: uvāca paramaprītaḥ kasmād deśānmahāmune / idānīṃ gacchasi kṣipraṃ kaṃ vā deśaṃ prati prabho
verses.translation: On seeing the sage Narada, all those residents spoke to him—"Where is the lord and master Narayana Hari?"
verses.hindi: हे राजन्! गङ्गाके पूर्वी तटपर तीनों लोकोंमें है। वहाँ ब्रह्मचर्यपूर्वक तथा क्रोधजयी होकर तीन रात्रि निवास करनेवाला (मनुष्य) सभी पापोंसे निर्मुक्त होकर अश्वमेधका फल प्रात करता है। प्रतिष्ठान नामक स्थानके उत्तर तथा भागीरथीकी बायीं ओर तीनों लोकोंमें
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing the sage Narada, all those residents spoke to him—"Where is the lord and master Narayana Hari?"
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the sage Narada, all those residents spoke to him—"Where is the lord and master Narayana Hari?"

verses.sanskrit: संदर्शनाद् वै भवतः शोको मे विपुलो गतः । इदानीं मम यत् कार्यं ब्रूहि पद्मदलेक्षण
verses.transliteration: saṃdarśanād vai bhavataḥ śoko me vipulo gataḥ / idānīṃ mama yat kāryaṃ brūhi padmadalekṣaṇa
verses.translation: He told them—"Lord Hari, the great Yogin, is sporting about on the peak of Kailasa. I have come here after seeing him."
verses.hindi: विख्यात हंसप्रपतन नामक तीर्थ है। उसके स्मरणमात्रसे अश्वमेधका फल प्राप्त होता है और (वहाँ जानेवाला व्यक्ति) जबतक सूर्य एवं चन्द्रमा हैं, तबतक स्वर्गमें प्रतिष्ठा प्राप्त करता है
verses.wordMeaning: He told them—"Lord Hari, the great Yogin, is sporting about on the peak of Kailasa. I have come here after seeing him."
verses.commentary: Sense: He told them—"Lord Hari, the great Yogin, is sporting about on the peak of Kailasa. I have come here after seeing him."

verses.sanskrit: तमुवाच महायोगी कृष्णद्वैपायनः स्वयम् । उपविश्य नदीतिरे शिष्यैः परिवृतो मुनिः
verses.transliteration: tamuvāca mahāyogī kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaḥ svayam / upaviśya nadītire śiṣyaiḥ parivṛto muniḥ
verses.translation: O Brahmanas, on hearing his words, Garuda, the most excellent among the fliers (birds), went to the excellent mountain Kailasa through the sky.
verses.hindi: इसका तात्पर्य प्रयागमें निवास करनेसे है न कि माता आदि गुरुजनोंके वचनका उल्लंघन करनेमें। आस्ते स पितृभिः सार्ध स्वर्गलोके नराधिप
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas, on hearing his words, Garuda, the most excellent among the fliers (birds), went to the excellent mountain Kailasa through the sky.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas, on hearing his words, Garuda, the most excellent among the fliers (birds), went to the excellent mountain Kailasa through the sky.

verses.sanskrit: इदं कलियुगं घोरं संप्राप्तं पाण्डुनन्दन । ततो गच्छामि देवस्य वाराणसीं महापुरीम्
verses.transliteration: idaṃ kaliyugaṃ ghoraṃ saṃprāptaṃ pāṇḍunandana / tato gacchāmi devasya vārāṇasīṃ mahāpurīm
verses.translation: In a mansion embellished with jewels, he sawGovinda the son of Devaki. Lord Hari was seated near the lord of Devas.
verses.hindi: अथ संध्यावटे रम्ये ब्रह्मचारी जितेन्द्रियः । नरः शुचिरुपासीत ब्रह्मलोकमवाप्नुयात्
verses.wordMeaning: In a mansion embellished with jewels, he sawGovinda the son of Devaki. Lord Hari was seated near the lord of Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: In a mansion embellished with jewels, he sawGovinda the son of Devaki. Lord Hari was seated near the lord of Devas.

verses.sanskrit: अस्मिन् कलियुगे घोरे लोकाः पापानुवर्तिनः । भविष्यन्ति महापापा वर्णाश्रमविवर्जिताः
verses.transliteration: asmin kaliyuge ghore lokāḥ pāpānuvartinaḥ / bhaviṣyanti mahāpāpā varṇāśramavivarjitāḥ
verses.translation: He was surrounded and served by the immortals and the celestial women. The attendants of Mahadeva, Siddhas, and Yogins stood round him.
verses.hindi: कोटितीर्थं समाश्रित्य यस्तु प्राणान् परित्यजेत्। कोटिवर्षसहस्त्राणि स्वर्गलोके महीयते सिद्धक्षेत्रं हि तज्ज्ञेयं नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.wordMeaning: He was surrounded and served by the immortals and the celestial women. The attendants of Mahadeva, Siddhas, and Yogins stood round him.
verses.commentary: Sense: He was surrounded and served by the immortals and the celestial women. The attendants of Mahadeva, Siddhas, and Yogins stood round him.

verses.sanskrit: नान्यत् पश्यामि जन्तूनांमुक्त्वा वाराणसीं पुरीम् । सर्वपापप्रशमनं प्रायश्चित्तं कलौ युगे
verses.transliteration: nānyat paśyāmi jantūnāṃmuktvā vārāṇasīṃ purīm / sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ prāyaścittaṃ kalau yuge
verses.translation: Prostrating himself like a staff on the ground and honouring auspicious Sankara, Suparna intimated to Hari what was happening at the city of Dvaraka.
verses.hindi: दिवि तारयते देवांस्तेन त्रिपथगा स्मृता
verses.wordMeaning: Prostrating himself like a staff on the ground and honouring auspicious Sankara, Suparna intimated to Hari what was happening at the city of Dvaraka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Prostrating himself like a staff on the ground and honouring auspicious Sankara, Suparna intimated to Hari what was happening at the city of Dvaraka.

verses.sanskrit: कृतं त्रेता द्वापरं च सर्वेष्वेतेषु वै नराः । भविष्यन्ति महात्मानो धार्मिकाः सत्यवादिनः
verses.transliteration: kṛtaṃ tretā dvāparaṃ ca sarveṣveteṣu vai narāḥ / bhaviṣyanti mahātmāno dhārmikāḥ satyavādinaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing Krsna the destroyer of enemies depart¬ ing, the excellent-most Gandharvas (Divine musicians) and Apsaras (celestial ladies) followed that great Yogin, the wielder of conch, discus and mace.
verses.hindi: तावदवर्षसहस्त्राणि स्वर्गलोके महीयते मोक्षदा सर्वभूतानां महापातकिनामपि
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing Krsna the destroyer of enemies depart¬ ing, the excellent-most Gandharvas (Divine musicians) and Apsaras (celestial ladies) followed that great Yogin, the wielder of conch, discus and mace.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing Krsna the destroyer of enemies depart¬ ing, the excellent-most Gandharvas (Divine musicians) and Apsaras (celestial ladies) followed that great Yogin, the wielder of conch, discus and mace.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं हि लोकेषु विख्यातो धृतिमाञ् जनवत्सलः । पालयाद्य परं धर्मं स्वकीयं मुच्यसे भयात्
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ hi lokeṣu vikhyāto dhṛtimāñ janavatsalaḥ / pālayādya paraṃ dharmaṃ svakīyaṃ mucyase bhayāt
verses.translation: Hari the Atman of the Universe bade farewell to the ladies. Govinda hastened to the heaven-like splendid city of Dvaravati.
verses.hindi: सर्वेषामेव भूतानां पापोपहतचेतसाम्। गतिमन्वेषमाणानां नास्ति गङ्गासमा गतिः
verses.wordMeaning: Hari the Atman of the Universe bade farewell to the ladies. Govinda hastened to the heaven-like splendid city of Dvaravati.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hari the Atman of the Universe bade farewell to the ladies. Govinda hastened to the heaven-like splendid city of Dvaravati.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तो भगवता पार्थः परपुरञ्जयः । पृष्टवान् प्रणिपत्यासौ युगधर्मान् द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: evamukto bhagavatā pārthaḥ parapurañjayaḥ / pṛṣṭavān praṇipatyāsau yugadharmān dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: O leading sages, when the lord, the enemy of the Asuras, went away, the passionately loving women became pale like the night devoid of the moon.
verses.hindi: माहेश्वरात् परिभ्रष्टा सर्वपापहरा शुभा कृते युगे तु तीर्थानि त्रेतायां पुष्करं परम्। द्वापरे तु कुरुक्षेत्रं कलौ गङ्गा विशिष्यते
verses.wordMeaning: O leading sages, when the lord, the enemy of the Asuras, went away, the passionately loving women became pale like the night devoid of the moon.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading sages, when the lord, the enemy of the Asuras, went away, the passionately loving women became pale like the night devoid of the moon.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मै प्रोवाच सकलं मुनिः सत्यवतीसुतः । प्रणम्य देवमीशानं युगधर्मान् सनातनान्
verses.transliteration: tasmai provāca sakalaṃ muniḥ satyavatīsutaḥ / praṇamya devamīśānaṃ yugadharmān sanātanān
verses.translation: On hearing about the excellent arrival of Krsna, the citizens immediately decorated the splendid city of Dvaravati.
verses.hindi: गङ्कामेव निषेवेत प्रयागे तु विशेषतः। नान्यत् कलियुगोद्भूतं मलं हन्तुं सुदुष्कृतम्
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing about the excellent arrival of Krsna, the citizens immediately decorated the splendid city of Dvaravati.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing about the excellent arrival of Krsna, the citizens immediately decorated the splendid city of Dvaravati.

verses.sanskrit: वक्ष्यामि ते समासेन युगधर्मान् नरेश्वर । न शक्यते मया पार्थ विस्तरेणाभिभाषितुम्
verses.transliteration: vakṣyāmi te samāsena yugadharmān nareśvara / na śakyate mayā pārtha vistareṇābhibhāṣitum
verses.translation: The people adorned and embellished the beautiful city with garlands, fastoons, etc., with large banners and by means of flag-staffs both within and without.
verses.hindi: जो व्यक्ति उर्वशीके हंसके समान अति धवल रम्य, विस्तृत तटपर प्राणोंका परित्याग करता है, उसका भी जो फल है, वह सुनो--हे नराधिप! वह व्यक्ति साठ हजार साठ सौ वर्षोंतक पितरोंके साथ स्वर्गलोकमें निवास करता है। रमणीय संध्यावट (प्रयागके वट- विशेष)-के नीचे जो मनुष्य जितेन्द्रिय होकर ब्रह्मचर्यपूर्वक पित्रतासे उपासना करता है, वह ब्रह्मलोक प्राप्त करता है। जो कोटितीर्थ (प्रयागमें स्थित तीर्थ)-में पहुँचकर
verses.wordMeaning: The people adorned and embellished the beautiful city with garlands, fastoons, etc., with large banners and by means of flag-staffs both within and without.
verses.commentary: Sense: The people adorned and embellished the beautiful city with garlands, fastoons, etc., with large banners and by means of flag-staffs both within and without.

verses.sanskrit: आद्यं कृतयुगं प्रोक्तं ततस्त्रेतायुगं बुधैः । तृतीयं द्वापरं पार्थ चतुर्थं कलिरुच्यते
verses.transliteration: ādyaṃ kṛtayugaṃ proktaṃ tatastretāyugaṃ budhaiḥ / tṛtīyaṃ dvāparaṃ pārtha caturthaṃ kalirucyate
verses.translation: They played on different musical instruments of sweet tone. They blew thousands of conches and broadcast notes of lute all round.
verses.hindi: प्राणोंका परित्याग करता है, वह हजार करोड़ वर्षोतक स्वर्गलोकमें पूजित होता है। जहाँ बहुतसे तीर्थो एवं तपोवनोंसे युक्त महाभागा गङ्गा विद्यमान हैं, उस क्षेत्रको सिद्धक्षेत्र जानना चाहिए, इसमें किसी भी प्रकारका
verses.wordMeaning: They played on different musical instruments of sweet tone. They blew thousands of conches and broadcast notes of lute all round.
verses.commentary: Sense: They played on different musical instruments of sweet tone. They blew thousands of conches and broadcast notes of lute all round.

verses.sanskrit: ध्यानं परं कृतयुगे त्रेतायां ज्ञानमुच्यते । द्वापरे यज्ञमेवाहुर्दानमेव कलौ युगे
verses.transliteration: dhyānaṃ paraṃ kṛtayuge tretāyāṃ jñānamucyate / dvāpare yajñamevāhurdānameva kalau yuge
verses.translation: No sooner did Govinda enter the splendid city of Dvaravati than the women, resplendent in their youthful charms, sang sweet songs.
verses.hindi: विचार (संशय) करना उचित नहीं है। गङ्गा पृथ्वीपर मनुष्योंको तारती है, नीचे पाताल लोकमें नागोंको तारती है और झुलोकमें देवताओंको तारती है, इसलिये यह त्रिपथगा कही जाती है॥ २५--३०॥ जितने वर्षतक पुरुषकी अस्थियाँ गङ्गामें रहती हैं, उतने हजार वर्षोतक वह स्वर्गलोकमें पूजित होता है। (गङ्गा) सभी तीर्थोमें परम तीर्थ और नदियोंमें श्रेष्ठ नदी है, वह सभी प्राणियों, यहाँतक कि महापातकियोंको
verses.wordMeaning: No sooner did Govinda enter the splendid city of Dvaravati than the women, resplendent in their youthful charms, sang sweet songs.
verses.commentary: Sense: No sooner did Govinda enter the splendid city of Dvaravati than the women, resplendent in their youthful charms, sang sweet songs.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मा कृतयुगे देवस्त्रेतायां भगवान् रविः । द्वापरे दैवतं विष्णुः कलौ रुद्रो महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: brahmā kṛtayuge devastretāyāṃ bhagavān raviḥ / dvāpare daivataṃ viṣṇuḥ kalau rudro maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Standing on the tops of the mansions, they espied the great lord and began to dance and showered the son of Vasudeva with flowers.
verses.hindi: भी मोक्ष प्रदान करनेवाली है। गङ्गा (स्नान) सर्वत्र
verses.wordMeaning: Standing on the tops of the mansions, they espied the great lord and began to dance and showered the son of Vasudeva with flowers.
verses.commentary: Sense: Standing on the tops of the mansions, they espied the great lord and began to dance and showered the son of Vasudeva with flowers.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मा विष्णुस्तथा सूर्यः सर्व एव कलिष्वपि । पूज्यते भगवान् रुद्रश्चतुर्ष्वपि पिनाकधृक्
verses.transliteration: brahmā viṣṇustathā sūryaḥ sarva eva kaliṣvapi / pūjyate bhagavān rudraścaturṣvapi pinākadhṛk
verses.translation: After entering the city lord Krsna was highly blessed with benedictions. The great Yogin, attended by the gentle ladies, shone in the excellent seat.
verses.hindi: गङ्गासागर-इन तीन स्थानोंमें दुर्लभ होती है। (उत्तम) गतिकी इच्छा करनेवाले तथा पापसे उपहत चित्तवाले सभी प्राणियोंके लिये गङ्गाके समान और कोई दूसरी गति नहीँ है॥३१--३४॥ यह सभी पवित्र वस्तुओंसे अधिक पवित्र और सभी मङ्गलकारी पदार्थोसे अधिक माङ्गलिक है। महेश्वर (-के मस्तक)-से होकर इस लोकमें आनेके कारण यह सभी पापोंका हरण करनेवाली और शुभ है।
verses.wordMeaning: After entering the city lord Krsna was highly blessed with benedictions. The great Yogin, attended by the gentle ladies, shone in the excellent seat.
verses.commentary: Sense: After entering the city lord Krsna was highly blessed with benedictions. The great Yogin, attended by the gentle ladies, shone in the excellent seat.

verses.sanskrit: आद्ये कृतयुगे धर्मश्चतुष्पादः सनातनः । त्रेतायुगे त्रिपादः स्याद् द्विपादो द्वापरे स्थितः । त्रिपादहीनस्तिष्ये तु सत्तामात्रेण तिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: ādye kṛtayuge dharmaścatuṣpādaḥ sanātanaḥ / tretāyuge tripādaḥ syād dvipādo dvāpare sthitaḥ / tripādahīnastiṣye tu sattāmātreṇa tiṣṭhati
verses.translation: O Brahmanas, in order to pay visit to Krsna the immutable cause of the world, gods, Gandharvas and great elderly sages like Markandeya and others, came there.
verses.hindi: सत्ययुगमें अनेक तीर्थ होते हैं, त्रेताका श्रेष्ठ तीर्थ पुष्कर है, द्वापरका कुरुक्षेत्र है और कलियुगमें गङ्गाकी ही विशेषता है। गङ्गाकी ही सेवा करनी चाहिए, विशेष- रूपसे प्रयागमें गङ्गाकी सेवा करनी चाहिए। कलियुगमें
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas, in order to pay visit to Krsna the immutable cause of the world, gods, Gandharvas and great elderly sages like Markandeya and others, came there.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas, in order to pay visit to Krsna the immutable cause of the world, gods, Gandharvas and great elderly sages like Markandeya and others, came there.

verses.sanskrit: कृते तु मिथुनोत्पत्तिर्वृत्तिः साक्षाद् रसोल्लसा । प्रजास्तृप्ताः सदा सर्वाः सदानन्दाश्च भोगिनः
verses.transliteration: kṛte tu mithunotpattirvṛttiḥ sākṣād rasollasā / prajāstṛptāḥ sadā sarvāḥ sadānandāśca bhoginaḥ
verses.translation: Then Lord Krsna, Hari, got up and bowed down his head to Markandeya who had come there. He offered him his own seat.
verses.hindi: उत्पन्न अत्यन्त कठिन पापको दूर करनेमें कोई अन्य तीर्थ समर्थ नहीं है ॥ ३५--३७॥  प्रयाग-संगमके समीप कोई तट-विशेष।
verses.wordMeaning: Then Lord Krsna, Hari, got up and bowed down his head to Markandeya who had come there. He offered him his own seat.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Lord Krsna, Hari, got up and bowed down his head to Markandeya who had come there. He offered him his own seat.

verses.sanskrit: अधमोत्तमत्वं नास्त्यासां निर्विशेषाः पुरञ्जय । तुल्यमायुः सुखं रूपं तासां तस्मिन् कृते युगे
verses.transliteration: adhamottamatvaṃ nāstyāsāṃ nirviśeṣāḥ purañjaya / tulyamāyuḥ sukhaṃ rūpaṃ tāsāṃ tasmin kṛte yuge
verses.translation: After honouring those sages with his head bent down, Hari, in the company of his followers, bestowed on them what they desired and bade them farewell.
verses.hindi: अकामो वा सकामो वा गङ्गायां यो विपद्यते।
verses.wordMeaning: After honouring those sages with his head bent down, Hari, in the company of his followers, bestowed on them what they desired and bade them farewell.
verses.commentary: Sense: After honouring those sages with his head bent down, Hari, in the company of his followers, bestowed on them what they desired and bade them farewell.

verses.sanskrit: विशोकाः सत्त्वबहुला एकान्तबहुलास्तथा । ध्याननिष्ठास्तपोनिष्ठा महादेवपरायणाः
verses.transliteration: viśokāḥ sattvabahulā ekāntabahulāstathā / dhyānaniṣṭhāstaponiṣṭhā mahādevaparāyaṇāḥ
verses.translation: Then at midday. Lord Hari himself, the lord of Devas, had his ablution, wore white garments and prayed to the sun with palms joined in reverence.
verses.hindi: इच्छा अथवा अनिच्छापूर्वक जो गङ्गामें मृत्यु प्राप्त स मृतो जायते स्वर्गे नरकं च न पश्यति॥ ३८ ॥  करता है, वह मृत व्यक्ति स्वर्ग जाता है और नरकका
verses.wordMeaning: Then at midday. Lord Hari himself, the lord of Devas, had his ablution, wore white garments and prayed to the sun with palms joined in reverence.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then at midday. Lord Hari himself, the lord of Devas, had his ablution, wore white garments and prayed to the sun with palms joined in reverence.

verses.sanskrit: ता वै निष्कामचारिण्यो नित्यं मुदितमानसाः । पर्वतोदधिवासिन्यो ह्यनिकेतः परन्तप
verses.transliteration: tā vai niṣkāmacāriṇyo nityaṃ muditamānasāḥ / parvatodadhivāsinyo hyaniketaḥ parantapa
verses.translation: With his gaze fixed on the sun-god, he duly per¬ formed Japa (repetition) of the holy mantras which are to be muttered. The lord of Devas performed Tarpana for Devas, Pitrsdind sages.
verses.hindi: प्रयाग-माहात्म्य, माघमासमें संगमस्तानका फल, त्रिमाघीकी महिमा, प्रयागमें प्राण-त्याग करनेका फल
verses.wordMeaning: With his gaze fixed on the sun-god, he duly per¬ formed Japa (repetition) of the holy mantras which are to be muttered. The lord of Devas performed Tarpana for Devas, Pitrsdind sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: With his gaze fixed on the sun-god, he duly per¬ formed Japa (repetition) of the holy mantras which are to be muttered. The lord of Devas performed Tarpana for Devas, Pitrsdind sages.

verses.sanskrit: रसोल्लासा कालयोगात् त्रेताख्ये नश्यते ततः । तस्यां सिद्धौ प्रणष्टायामन्या सिद्धिरवर्तत
verses.transliteration: rasollāsā kālayogāt tretākhye naśyate tataḥ / tasyāṃ siddhau praṇaṣṭāyāmanyā siddhiravartata
verses.translation: Entering the temple of the lord in the company of Markandeya, he worshipped the lord of Bhutas (Siva) adorned with Bhasma, (who was) embodied in the Linga.
verses.hindi: माघमासे गमिष्यन्ति गङ्ायमुनसंगमम् प्रयागे माघमासे तु त्र्यहं स्नातस्य तत् फलम्
verses.wordMeaning: Entering the temple of the lord in the company of Markandeya, he worshipped the lord of Bhutas (Siva) adorned with Bhasma, (who was) embodied in the Linga.
verses.commentary: Sense: Entering the temple of the lord in the company of Markandeya, he worshipped the lord of Bhutas (Siva) adorned with Bhasma, (who was) embodied in the Linga.

verses.sanskrit: अपां सौक्ष्म्ये प्रतिहते तदा मेघात्मना तु वै । मेघेभ्यः स्तनयित्नुभ्यः प्रवृत्तं वृष्टिसर्जनम्
verses.transliteration: apāṃ saukṣmye pratihate tadā meghātmanā tu vai / meghebhyaḥ stanayitnubhyaḥ pravṛttaṃ vṛṣṭisarjanam
verses.translation: On observing all these rites (performed by Krsna) Markandeya, the great sage, laughingly addressed these sweet words to Krsna.
verses.hindi: गङ्गायमुनयोर्मध्ये कार्षाग्निं यस्तु साधयेत्। अहीनाङ्गोऽप्यरोगश्च पञ्चेन्द्रियसमन्वितः
verses.wordMeaning: On observing all these rites (performed by Krsna) Markandeya, the great sage, laughingly addressed these sweet words to Krsna.
verses.commentary: Sense: On observing all these rites (performed by Krsna) Markandeya, the great sage, laughingly addressed these sweet words to Krsna.

verses.sanskrit: सकृदेव तया वृष्ट्या संयुक्ते पृथिवीतले । प्रादुरासंस्तदा तासां वृक्षा वै गृहसंज्ञिताः
verses.transliteration: sakṛdeva tayā vṛṣṭyā saṃyukte pṛthivītale / prādurāsaṃstadā tāsāṃ vṛkṣā vai gṛhasaṃjñitāḥ
verses.translation: "Who is the lord propitiated by you by means of these auspicious rites, when you yourself are worthy of being
verses.hindi: तावद्वर्षसहस्त्राणि स्वर्गलोके महीयते जलप्रवेशं यः कुर्यात् संगमे लोकविश्रुते ।
verses.wordMeaning: "Who is the lord propitiated by you by means of these auspicious rites, when you yourself are worthy of being
verses.commentary: Sense: "Who is the lord propitiated by you by means of these auspicious rites, when you yourself are worthy of being

verses.sanskrit: सर्वप्रत्युपयोगस्तु तासां तेभ्यः प्रजायते । वर्तयन्ति स्म तेभ्यस्तास्त्रेतायुगमुखे प्रजाः
verses.transliteration: sarvapratyupayogastu tāsāṃ tebhyaḥ prajāyate / vartayanti sma tebhyastāstretāyugamukhe prajāḥ
verses.translation: You are that Supreme Brahman, the final liberation, the pure one, the highest region (or goal of all). It is for lightening the burden of the earth that you have taken birth in the family of Vrsnis."
verses.hindi: सोमलोकमवाप्नोति सोमेन सह मोदते। षष्टिं वर्षसहस्त्राणि षष्टिं वर्षशतानि च
verses.wordMeaning: You are that Supreme Brahman, the final liberation, the pure one, the highest region (or goal of all). It is for lightening the burden of the earth that you have taken birth in the family of Vrsnis."
verses.commentary: Sense: You are that Supreme Brahman, the final liberation, the pure one, the highest region (or goal of all). It is for lightening the burden of the earth that you have taken birth in the family of Vrsnis."

verses.sanskrit: ततः कालेन महता तासामेव विपर्यतात् । रागलोभात्मको भावस्तदा ह्याकस्मिको ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kālena mahatā tāsāmeva viparyatāt / rāgalobhātmako bhāvastadā hyākasmiko 'bhavat
verses.translation: The mighty-armed Krsna, the foremost among the knowers of Brahman, laughingly spoke to him even as all his sons were listening.
verses.hindi: स्वर्गतः शक्रलोकेऽसौ मुनिगन्धर्वसेवितः। ततो भ्रष्टस्तु राजेन्द्र समृद्धे जायते कुले शतं वर्षसहस्त्राणि स्वर्गलोके महीयते
verses.wordMeaning: The mighty-armed Krsna, the foremost among the knowers of Brahman, laughingly spoke to him even as all his sons were listening.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mighty-armed Krsna, the foremost among the knowers of Brahman, laughingly spoke to him even as all his sons were listening.

verses.sanskrit: विपर्ययेण तासां तु तेन तत्कालभाविना । प्रणश्यन्ति ततः सर्वे वृक्षास्ते गृहसंज्ञिताः
verses.transliteration: viparyayeṇa tāsāṃ tu tena tatkālabhāvinā / praṇaśyanti tataḥ sarve vṛkṣāste gṛhasaṃjñitāḥ
verses.translation: "Undoubtedly everything spoken by you is true. Still, I am worshipping the eternal lord Isana (Siva).
verses.hindi: मार्कण्डेयने कहा-- (युधिष्ठिर!) गङ्गा और यमुनाके संगमपर माघ महीनेमें साठ हजार साठ सौ तीर्थ जाते हैं। सौ हजार गौओंका भलीभाँति दान करनेका जो फल होता है, वही फल प्रयागमें माघमासमें तीन दिन स्नान
verses.wordMeaning: "Undoubtedly everything spoken by you is true. Still, I am worshipping the eternal lord Isana (Siva).
verses.commentary: Sense: "Undoubtedly everything spoken by you is true. Still, I am worshipping the eternal lord Isana (Siva).

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तेषु प्रनष्टेषु विभ्रान्ता मैथुनोद्भवाः । अभिध्यायन्ति तां सिद्धिं सत्याभिध्यायिनस्तदा
verses.transliteration: tatasteṣu pranaṣṭeṣu vibhrāntā maithunodbhavāḥ / abhidhyāyanti tāṃ siddhiṃ satyābhidhyāyinastadā
verses.translation: Undoubtedly there is no obligation on me to do anything. Nor there is anything not obtained by me. Realizing as I do the Supreme Lord Siva, I worship the Lord.
verses.hindi: करनेका होता है। गङ्गा और यमुनाके संगमपर जो करीषाग्निका सेवन करता है, वह अहीनाङ्ग (हीन अङ्गसे रहित) अर्थात् सम्पूर्ण अवयवोंसे सम्पन्न, रोगरहित तथा पाँचों इन्द्रियोंसे युक्त होता है॥ १--३॥ मान देनेवाले (युधिष्ठिर) ! उस मनुष्यके शरीरमें जितने रोमकूप होते हैं, उतने हजार वर्षोतक वह स्वर्गलोकमें पूजित होता है। तदनन्तर स्वर्गसे भ्रष्ट होनेपर वह जम्बूद्दीपका स्वामी होता है और विपुल भोगोंका
verses.wordMeaning: Undoubtedly there is no obligation on me to do anything. Nor there is anything not obtained by me. Realizing as I do the Supreme Lord Siva, I worship the Lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: Undoubtedly there is no obligation on me to do anything. Nor there is anything not obtained by me. Realizing as I do the Supreme Lord Siva, I worship the Lord.

verses.sanskrit: प्रादुर्बभूवुस्तासां तु वृक्षास्ते गृहसंज्ञिताः । वस्त्राणि ते प्रसूयन्ते फलान्याभरणानि च
verses.transliteration: prādurbabhūvustāsāṃ tu vṛkṣāste gṛhasaṃjñitāḥ / vastrāṇi te prasūyante phalānyābharaṇāni ca
verses.translation: Those people deluded by Maya do not visualize the lord. I, therefore, worship indicating him to be my original cause.
verses.hindi: उपभोग करनेके अनन्तर वह पुन: इस तीर्थ (प्रयाग)- को प्राप्त करता हे
verses.wordMeaning: Those people deluded by Maya do not visualize the lord. I, therefore, worship indicating him to be my original cause.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those people deluded by Maya do not visualize the lord. I, therefore, worship indicating him to be my original cause.

verses.sanskrit: तेष्वेव जायते तासां गन्धवर्णरसान्वितम् । अमाक्षिकं महावीर्यं पुटके पुटके मधु
verses.transliteration: teṣveva jāyate tāsāṃ gandhavarṇarasānvitam / amākṣikaṃ mahāvīryaṃ puṭake puṭake madhu
verses.translation: There is nothing more meritorious than the worship of Linga in the world. Nothing else is destructive of misfortune. So one should worship Siva embodied in Linga for the benefit of all these people (in the world).
verses.hindi: (गङ्गा-यमुनाके) लोक-प्रसिद्ध संगमपर जो जलमें प्रवेश करता है, वह जिस प्रकार राहुसे ग्रस्त चन्द्रमा मुक्त हो जाता है, वैसे ही सभी पापोंसे मुक्त हो जाता है। वह चन्द्रलोकमें जाता है और साठ हजार साठ सौ वर्षोतक चन्द्रमाके साथ आनन्दोपभोग करता है। हे राजेन्द्र! तदुपरान्त मुनियों एवं गन्धर्वोसे सेवित वह स्वर्गलोकसे इन्द्रलोकमें जाता है और वहाँसे भ्रष्ट होनेपर इस लोकमें आकर धनवानोंके कुलमें जन्म लेता है। जो
verses.wordMeaning: There is nothing more meritorious than the worship of Linga in the world. Nothing else is destructive of misfortune. So one should worship Siva embodied in Linga for the benefit of all these people (in the world).
verses.commentary: Sense: There is nothing more meritorious than the worship of Linga in the world. Nothing else is destructive of misfortune. So one should worship Siva embodied in Linga for the benefit of all these people (in the world).

verses.sanskrit: तेन ता वर्तयन्ति स्म त्रेतायुगमुखे प्रिजाः । हृष्टपुष्टास्तया सिद्ध्या सर्वा वै विगतज्वराः
verses.transliteration: tena tā vartayanti sma tretāyugamukhe prijāḥ / hṛṣṭapuṣṭāstayā siddhyā sarvā vai vigatajvarāḥ
verses.translation: People expert in the Vedic lore say that what I am, is (God Siva's) symbol (i.e. I am identical with Linga ). I, therefore, worship Lord Siva who is my own pure Atman, by means of my own self.
verses.hindi: मनुष्य (यहाँ प्रयागमें) पैर ऊपर और सिर नीचे करके लोहेकी धाराका पान (तपस्या-विशेष) करता है, बह सौ हजार वर्षातक स्वर्गलोकमें पूजित होता है
verses.wordMeaning: People expert in the Vedic lore say that what I am, is (God Siva's) symbol (i.e. I am identical with Linga ). I, therefore, worship Lord Siva who is my own pure Atman, by means of my own self.
verses.commentary: Sense: People expert in the Vedic lore say that what I am, is (God Siva's) symbol (i.e. I am identical with Linga ). I, therefore, worship Lord Siva who is my own pure Atman, by means of my own self.

verses.sanskrit: ततः कालान्तरेणैव पुनर्लोभावृतास्तदा । वृक्षांस्तान् पर्यगृह्णन्त मधु चामाक्षिकं बलात्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kālāntareṇaiva punarlobhāvṛtāstadā / vṛkṣāṃstān paryagṛhṇanta madhu cāmākṣikaṃ balāt
verses.translation: There is no doubt that I am his highest form and that I am identical with him. The Vedas declare that undoubtedly there is no difference between both of us at all.'-
verses.hindi: करीष-सूखा गोमय। इससे अग्नि बनाकर उसके मध्य तपस्या करना। २१० + कूर्मपुराण +
verses.wordMeaning: There is no doubt that I am his highest form and that I am identical with him. The Vedas declare that undoubtedly there is no difference between both of us at all.'-
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no doubt that I am his highest form and that I am identical with him. The Vedas declare that undoubtedly there is no difference between both of us at all.'-

verses.sanskrit: तासां तेनापचारेण पुनर्लोभकृतेन वै । प्रणष्टामधुना सार्धं कल्पवृक्षाः क्वचित् क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: tāsāṃ tenāpacāreṇa punarlobhakṛtena vai / praṇaṣṭāmadhunā sārdhaṃ kalpavṛkṣāḥ kvacit kvacit
verses.translation: This Lord Mahadeva who is the Supreme Ruler should always be offered sacrifices, worshipped, respected and realized in the Linga form by those who are afraid of the miseries of worldly existence."
verses.hindi: तस्माद् भ्रष्टस्तु राजेन्द्र अग्निहोत्री भवेन्नरः । राजेन्द्र! बहाँसे भ्रष्ट होनेपर वह मनुष्य अग्निहोत्री भुक्त्वा तु विपुलान् भोगांस्तत् तीर्थं भजते पुनः॥ ९०॥  होता है और विपुल भोगोंका उपभोग करके पुनः इस (प्रयाग) तीर्थका सेवन करता है। जो अपना शरीर काटता है अथवा पक्षियोंको देता है, ऐसे पक्षियोंद्वारा
verses.wordMeaning: This Lord Mahadeva who is the Supreme Ruler should always be offered sacrifices, worshipped, respected and realized in the Linga form by those who are afraid of the miseries of worldly existence."
verses.commentary: Sense: This Lord Mahadeva who is the Supreme Ruler should always be offered sacrifices, worshipped, respected and realized in the Linga form by those who are afraid of the miseries of worldly existence."

verses.sanskrit: शीतवर्षातपैस्तीव्रै स्ततस्ता दुः खिता भृशम् । द्वन्द्वैः संपीड्यमानास्तु चक्रुरावरणानि च
verses.transliteration: śītavarṣātapaistīvrai statastā duḥ khitā bhṛśam / dvandvaiḥ saṃpīḍyamānāstu cakrurāvaraṇāni ca
verses.translation: "O excellent god, what is that Linga? Who is being worshipped in the Linga? O Krsna of wide eyes, explain it, as this is an excellent and profound mystery."
verses.hindi: यः स्वदेहं विकर्तेद् वा शकुनिभ्यः प्रयच्छति। खाये गये (मांसवाले) उस पुरुषको भी जो फल प्राप्त विहगैरुपभुक्तस्य शृणु तस्यापि यत्फलम्॥ ११॥  होता है, उसे सुनो- शतं वर्षसहस्त्राण सोमलोके महीयते। वह सौ हजार वर्षोतक चन्द्रलोकमें पूजित होता है, ततस्तस्मात् परिभ्रष्टो राजा भवति धार्मिकः॥ १२॥  तदनन्तर वहाँसे च्युत होनेपर धार्मिक, गुणवान्, रूपसम्पन्न, गुणवान् रूपसम्पन्नो विद्वान् सुप्रियवाक्यवान्। विद्वान् और सुन्दर तथा प्रिय वचन बोलनेवाला राजा
verses.wordMeaning: "O excellent god, what is that Linga? Who is being worshipped in the Linga? O Krsna of wide eyes, explain it, as this is an excellent and profound mystery."
verses.commentary: Sense: "O excellent god, what is that Linga? Who is being worshipped in the Linga? O Krsna of wide eyes, explain it, as this is an excellent and profound mystery."

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा द्वन्द्वप्रतीघातान् वार्तोपायमचिन्तयन् । नष्टेषु मधुना सार्धं कल्पवृक्षेषु वै तदा
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā dvandvapratīghātān vārtopāyamacintayan / naṣṭeṣu madhunā sārdhaṃ kalpavṛkṣeṣu vai tadā
verses.translation: "How did the Linga, the highest region of Isvara, originate formerly to rouse you? O Krsna, it behoves you to explain this now, for the purpose of my enlightenment."
verses.hindi: भुक्त्वा तु विपुलान् भोगांस्तत् तीर्थं भजते पुनः ॥ १३॥  होता है एवं विपुल भोगोंको भोगकर पुनः इस तीर्थका उत्तरे यमुनातीरे प्रयागस्य तु दक्षिणे। सेवन करता है । प्रयागके दक्षिणमें यमुनाके उत्तरी तटपर
verses.wordMeaning: "How did the Linga, the highest region of Isvara, originate formerly to rouse you? O Krsna, it behoves you to explain this now, for the purpose of my enlightenment."
