verses.commentary: Sense: "How did the Linga, the highest region of Isvara, originate formerly to rouse you? O Krsna, it behoves you to explain this now, for the purpose of my enlightenment."

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रादुर्बभौ तासां सिद्धिस्त्रेतायुगे पुनः । वार्तायाः साधिका ह्यन्या वृष्टिस्तासां निकामतः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prādurbabhau tāsāṃ siddhistretāyuge punaḥ / vārtāyāḥ sādhikā hyanyā vṛṣṭistāsāṃ nikāmataḥ
verses.translation: "O [Lord! Please tell me: Who are you? Whence have you come? Why do you stand here? I am the creator of the worlds. I am the self-born Prapitamaha (the great grand¬ father) of the Universe."
verses.hindi: ऋणप्रमोचनं नाम तीर्थ तु परमं स्मृतम्॥ १४॥ ऋणप्रमोचन नामका एक श्रेष्ठ तीर्थ कहा गया है। वहाँ द ह स्पृत्तम्॥ १४॥  खानकर एकरात्रिपर्यन्त निवास करनेवाला पुरुष ऋणोंसे एकरात्रोषितः स्नात्वा ऋणैस्तत्र प्रमुच्यते। मुक्त हो जाता है, सूर्यलोक प्राप्त करता है तथा सदाके सूर्यलोकमवाप्नोति अनृणश्च सदा भवेत् ॥ ९५॥  लिये ऋणमुक्त हो जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: "O [Lord! Please tell me: Who are you? Whence have you come? Why do you stand here? I am the creator of the worlds. I am the self-born Prapitamaha (the great grand¬ father) of the Universe."
verses.commentary: Sense: "O [Lord! Please tell me: Who are you? Whence have you come? Why do you stand here? I am the creator of the worlds. I am the self-born Prapitamaha (the great grand¬ father) of the Universe."

verses.sanskrit: तासां वृष्ट्यूदकानीह यानि निम्नैर्गतानि तु । अवहन् वृष्टिसंतत्या स्त्रोतः स्थानानि निम्नगाः
verses.transliteration: tāsāṃ vṛṣṭyūdakānīha yāni nimnairgatāni tu / avahan vṛṣṭisaṃtatyā strotaḥ sthānāni nimnagāḥ
verses.translation: Thus addressed by Brahma I spoke to him: "I am the creator and the annihilator of worlds again and again."
verses.hindi: प्रयाग-माहात्म्य, यमुनाकी महिमा, यमुनाके तटवर्ती तीर्थोका वर्णन, गङ्कामें सभी तीर्थोकी स्थिति, मार्कण्डेय-युधिष्ठिर-संवादकी समाप्ति
verses.wordMeaning: Thus addressed by Brahma I spoke to him: "I am the creator and the annihilator of worlds again and again."
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus addressed by Brahma I spoke to him: "I am the creator and the annihilator of worlds again and again."

verses.sanskrit: ये पुनस्तदपां स्तोका आपन्नाः पृथिवीतले । अपां भूणेश्च संयोगादोषध्यस्तास्तदाभवन्
verses.transliteration: ye punastadapāṃ stokā āpannāḥ pṛthivītale / apāṃ bhūṇeśca saṃyogādoṣadhyastāstadābhavan
verses.translation: When the dispute increased due to the deluding power of Paramesthin (Siva), the great Linga, constituting the nature of Siva, manifested itself before us to enlighten us.
verses.hindi: मार्कण्डेय उवाच मार्कण्डेयने कहा-- (राजन् युधिष्ठिर!) सूर्यको तीनों लोकोंमें विख्यात पुत्री महाभागा देवी यमुना नदी यहाँपर मिली हैं । जिस मार्गसे गङ्गा प्रवाहित हुई हैं, उस मार्गसे यमुना भी गयी हैं। सहस्रो योजन दूरपर भी (यमुना) येनैव निःसृता गङ्गा तेनैव यमुना गता। नाम लेनेसे पापोंको नष्ट कर देनेवाली है । युधिष्ठिर! इस योजनानां सहस्रेषु कीर्तनात् पापनाशिनी ॥ २॥  यमुनामें स्नान करने तथा इसका जल पीनेसे मनुष्य सभी पापोंसे मुक्त होकर अपने सात पीढ़ियोंके कुलोंको पवित्र कर देता है। जो यहाँ प्राणोंका परित्याग करता
verses.wordMeaning: When the dispute increased due to the deluding power of Paramesthin (Siva), the great Linga, constituting the nature of Siva, manifested itself before us to enlighten us.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the dispute increased due to the deluding power of Paramesthin (Siva), the great Linga, constituting the nature of Siva, manifested itself before us to enlighten us.

verses.sanskrit: अफालकृष्टाश्चानुप्ता ग्राम्यारण्याश्चतुर्दश । ऋतुपुष्पफलैश्चैव वृक्षगुल्माश्च जज्ञिरे
verses.transliteration: aphālakṛṣṭāścānuptā grāmyāraṇyāścaturdaśa / ṛtupuṣpaphalaiścaiva vṛkṣagulmāśca jajñire
verses.translation: It was dazzlingly lustrous like the fire at the time •of world destruction, ablaze with wreaths of fire, devoid of any •decrease or increase and without any beginning, middle or end.
verses.hindi: है, वह परम गतिको प्राप्त करता है। यमुनाके दक्षिणी तटपर अग्नितीर्थ नामका एक विख्यात तीर्थ है। यमुनाके अग्नितीर्थमिति ख्यातं यमुनादक्षिणे तटे। पश्चिमी भागमें धर्मराजका 'अनरक' नामक तीर्थ कहा पश्चिमे धर्मराजस्य तीर्थ त्वनरकं स्मृतम्। गया है। यहाँ स्नान करनेवाले स्वर्ग जाते हैं और जो यहाँ
verses.wordMeaning: It was dazzlingly lustrous like the fire at the time •of world destruction, ablaze with wreaths of fire, devoid of any •decrease or increase and without any beginning, middle or end.
verses.commentary: Sense: It was dazzlingly lustrous like the fire at the time •of world destruction, ablaze with wreaths of fire, devoid of any •decrease or increase and without any beginning, middle or end.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रादुरभूत् तासां रागो लोभश्च सर्वशः । अवश्यं भाविनार्ऽथे न त्रेतायुगवशेन वै
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prādurabhūt tāsāṃ rāgo lobhaśca sarvaśaḥ / avaśyaṃ bhāvinār'the na tretāyugavaśena vai
verses.translation: It was dazzlingly lustrous like the fire at the time •of world destruction, ablaze with wreaths of fire, devoid of any •decrease or increase and without any beginning, middle or end.
verses.hindi: तत्र स्नात्वा दिवं यान्ति ये मृतास्तेऽपुनर्भवाः ॥ ४॥  मृत्युको प्राप्त होते हैं, उनका पुनर्जन्म नहीं होता तपनस्य सुता देवी त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुता। समागता महाभागा यमुना यत्र निम्नगा
verses.wordMeaning: It was dazzlingly lustrous like the fire at the time •of world destruction, ablaze with wreaths of fire, devoid of any •decrease or increase and without any beginning, middle or end.
verses.commentary: Sense: It was dazzlingly lustrous like the fire at the time •of world destruction, ablaze with wreaths of fire, devoid of any •decrease or increase and without any beginning, middle or end.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्ताः पर्यगृह्णन्त नदीक्षेत्राणि पर्वतान् । वृक्षगुल्मौषधीश्चैव प्रसह्य तु यथाबलम्
verses.transliteration: tatastāḥ paryagṛhṇanta nadīkṣetrāṇi parvatān / vṛkṣagulmauṣadhīścaiva prasahya tu yathābalam
verses.translation: It was dazzlingly lustrous like the fire at the time •of world destruction, ablaze with wreaths of fire, devoid of any •decrease or increase and without any beginning, middle or end.
verses.hindi: १-ज्ञानकी पराकाष्ठामें शरीरके प्रति ममताका सर्वथा अभाव हो जाता है। ऐसी स्थितिमें शरीरका काटना या अपने शरीरका मांस पक्षियोंको समर्पित करना (प्राण-कल्याण-बुद्धिमात्रसे) विशेष तप है। दधीचि, शिवि, जीमूतवाहन आदिके दृष्टान्त द्रष्टव्य हैं। २-न नरक=अनरक इस तीर्थमें स्नान आदि करनेसे नरकमें नहीं जाना पड़ता, इसलिये इसका नाम 'अनरक' है।
verses.wordMeaning: It was dazzlingly lustrous like the fire at the time •of world destruction, ablaze with wreaths of fire, devoid of any •decrease or increase and without any beginning, middle or end.
verses.commentary: Sense: It was dazzlingly lustrous like the fire at the time •of world destruction, ablaze with wreaths of fire, devoid of any •decrease or increase and without any beginning, middle or end.

verses.sanskrit: विपर्ययेण तासां ता ओषध्यो विविशुर्महीम् । पितामहनियोगेन दुदोह पृथिवीं पृथुः
verses.transliteration: viparyayeṇa tāsāṃ tā oṣadhyo viviśurmahīm / pitāmahaniyogena dudoha pṛthivīṃ pṛthuḥ
verses.translation: It was dazzlingly lustrous like the fire at the time •of world destruction, ablaze with wreaths of fire, devoid of any •decrease or increase and without any beginning, middle or end.
verses.hindi: धर्मराजं महापापैर्मुच्यते नात्र संशयः दश तीर्थसहस्राणि त्रिंशत्कोट्यस्तथापराः। प्रयागे संस्थितानि स्युरेवमाहुर्मनीषिणः
verses.wordMeaning: It was dazzlingly lustrous like the fire at the time •of world destruction, ablaze with wreaths of fire, devoid of any •decrease or increase and without any beginning, middle or end.
verses.commentary: Sense: It was dazzlingly lustrous like the fire at the time •of world destruction, ablaze with wreaths of fire, devoid of any •decrease or increase and without any beginning, middle or end.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्ता जगृहुः सर्वा अन्योन्यं क्रोधमूर्छिताः । वसुदारधनाद्यांस्तु बलात् कालबलेन तु
verses.transliteration: tatastā jagṛhuḥ sarvā anyonyaṃ krodhamūrchitāḥ / vasudāradhanādyāṃstu balāt kālabalena tu
verses.translation: It was dazzlingly lustrous like the fire at the time •of world destruction, ablaze with wreaths of fire, devoid of any •decrease or increase and without any beginning, middle or end.
verses.hindi: तिस्त्रः कोट्योऽर्धकोटी च तीर्थानां वायुरब्रवीत् । दिवि भूम्यन्तरिश्षे च तत्सर्व जाह्नवी स्मृता
verses.wordMeaning: It was dazzlingly lustrous like the fire at the time •of world destruction, ablaze with wreaths of fire, devoid of any •decrease or increase and without any beginning, middle or end.
verses.commentary: Sense: It was dazzlingly lustrous like the fire at the time •of world destruction, ablaze with wreaths of fire, devoid of any •decrease or increase and without any beginning, middle or end.

verses.sanskrit: मर्यादायाः प्रतिष्ठार्थं ज्ञात्वैतद् भगवानजः । ससर्ज क्षत्रियान् ब्रह्मा ब्राह्मणानां हिताय च
verses.transliteration: maryādāyāḥ pratiṣṭhārthaṃ jñātvaitad bhagavānajaḥ / sasarja kṣatriyān brahmā brāhmaṇānāṃ hitāya ca
verses.translation: It was dazzlingly lustrous like the fire at the time •of world destruction, ablaze with wreaths of fire, devoid of any •decrease or increase and without any beginning, middle or end.
verses.hindi: सिद्धिक्षेत्र तु तज्ज्ञेयं गङ्कातीरसमाश्रितम् यत्र देवो महादेवो देव्या सह महेश्वरः । आस्ते वटेश्वरो नित्यं तत् तीर्थ तत् तपोवनम्
verses.wordMeaning: It was dazzlingly lustrous like the fire at the time •of world destruction, ablaze with wreaths of fire, devoid of any •decrease or increase and without any beginning, middle or end.
verses.commentary: Sense: It was dazzlingly lustrous like the fire at the time •of world destruction, ablaze with wreaths of fire, devoid of any •decrease or increase and without any beginning, middle or end.

verses.sanskrit: वर्णाश्रमव्यवस्थां च त्रेतायां कृतवान् प्रभुः । यज्ञप्रवर्तनं चैव पशुहिंसाविवर्जितम्
verses.transliteration: varṇāśramavyavasthāṃ ca tretāyāṃ kṛtavān prabhuḥ / yajñapravartanaṃ caiva paśuhiṃsāvivarjitam
verses.translation: It was dazzlingly lustrous like the fire at the time •of world destruction, ablaze with wreaths of fire, devoid of any •decrease or increase and without any beginning, middle or end.
verses.hindi: सुहृदां च जपेत् कर्णे शिष्यस्यानुगतस्य तु
verses.wordMeaning: It was dazzlingly lustrous like the fire at the time •of world destruction, ablaze with wreaths of fire, devoid of any •decrease or increase and without any beginning, middle or end.
verses.commentary: Sense: It was dazzlingly lustrous like the fire at the time •of world destruction, ablaze with wreaths of fire, devoid of any •decrease or increase and without any beginning, middle or end.

verses.sanskrit: द्वापरेष्वथ विद्यन्ते मतिभेदाः सदा नृणाम् । रागो लोभस्तथा युद्धं तत्त्वानामविनिश्चयः
verses.transliteration: dvāpareṣvatha vidyante matibhedāḥ sadā nṛṇām / rāgo lobhastathā yuddhaṃ tattvānāmaviniścayaḥ
verses.translation: It was dazzlingly lustrous like the fire at the time •of world destruction, ablaze with wreaths of fire, devoid of any •decrease or increase and without any beginning, middle or end.
verses.hindi: इदं पुण्यमिदं रम्यं पावनं धर्म्यमुत्तमम् महर्षीणामिदं गुह्यं सर्वपापप्रमोचनम्। अत्राधीत्य द्विजोऽध्यायं निर्मलत्वमवाप्नुयात्
verses.wordMeaning: It was dazzlingly lustrous like the fire at the time •of world destruction, ablaze with wreaths of fire, devoid of any •decrease or increase and without any beginning, middle or end.
verses.commentary: Sense: It was dazzlingly lustrous like the fire at the time •of world destruction, ablaze with wreaths of fire, devoid of any •decrease or increase and without any beginning, middle or end.

verses.hindi: प्रयागमें स्थित विशाल वटवृक्षके नीचे प्रतिष्ठित लिङ्ग वटेश्वर लिङ्ग है। भुवनकोश-वर्णनमें राजा प्रियत्रतके वंशका वर्णन, प्रियत्रतके पुत्र राजा अग्मीश्नके वंशका वर्णन, जम्बू आदि सात द्वीपोंका तथा वर्षोका वर्णन, जम्बूद्वीपके नौ वर्षोमे राजा अग्रीधके नाभि, किंपुरुष आदि नौ पुत्रोंका आधिपत्य

verses.translation: Thereafter, we were surprised, we got afraid of the Trideni-bearing lord, as we were deluded by his Maya. We began to meditate on the universe and its Lord.

verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the deity devoid of beginning, middle and end, to one who by nature is spotless refulgence. Obeisance to Siva, the quiescent, infinite Brahman of the form of Lihga.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the deity devoid of beginning, middle and end, to one who by nature is spotless refulgence. Obeisance to Siva, the quiescent, infinite Brahman of the form of Lihga.

verses.sanskrit: विनिन्दन्ति महादेवं ब्राह्मणान् पुरुषोत्तमम् । आम्नायधर्मशास्त्राणि पुराणानि कलौ युगे
verses.transliteration: vinindanti mahādevaṃ brāhmaṇān puruṣottamam / āmnāyadharmaśāstrāṇi purāṇāni kalau yuge
verses.translation: Obeisance to the lord of Pradhana and Purusa. Obeisance to the Vedhas (Creator), of the form of the firma¬ ment. Obeisance to Siva, the quiescent Brahman of the form of Lihga.
verses.hindi: ऋषियोंने कहा--हे सूतजी! आपने स्वायम्भुव मन्वन्तरको शुभ सृष्टिको बतलाया, अब इस समय हम लोग त्रैलोक्य-मण्डलका वर्णन सुनना चाहते हैं । जितने सागर, द्वीप, वर्ष, पर्वत, वन तथा नदियाँ हैं और सूर्य
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the lord of Pradhana and Purusa. Obeisance to the Vedhas (Creator), of the form of the firma¬ ment. Obeisance to Siva, the quiescent Brahman of the form of Lihga.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the lord of Pradhana and Purusa. Obeisance to the Vedhas (Creator), of the form of the firma¬ ment. Obeisance to Siva, the quiescent Brahman of the form of Lihga.

verses.sanskrit: कुर्वन्त्यवेददृष्टानि कर्माणि विविधानि तु । स्वधर्मे ऽभिरुचिर्नैव ब्राह्मणानां प्रिजायते
verses.transliteration: kurvantyavedadṛṣṭāni karmāṇi vividhāni tu / svadharme 'bhirucirnaiva brāhmaṇānāṃ prijāyate
verses.translation: Hail to you the immutable, eternal Reality of in¬ comparable splendour, the embodiment of the essence of Vedanta and of the form of Kala (Time or Death).
verses.hindi: आदि ग्रहोंकी जो स्थिति है, इन सभीका वर्णन करें। हे सूतजी! यह सब कुछ जिसके आधारपर टिका है और प्राचीन कालमें यह पृथ्वी जिन रजाओकि अधिकारमें रही है, उन सभी विषयोंका संक्षेपमें आप वर्णन करें॥ २--४॥ सूतजीने कहा--देवोंके आदिदेव, अप्रमेय, प्रभविष्णु विष्णुको नमस्कार कर मैं उन धीमानूद्वारा जो कुछ कहा गया है, उसे बताता हूँ-
verses.wordMeaning: Hail to you the immutable, eternal Reality of in¬ comparable splendour, the embodiment of the essence of Vedanta and of the form of Kala (Time or Death).
verses.commentary: Sense: Hail to you the immutable, eternal Reality of in¬ comparable splendour, the embodiment of the essence of Vedanta and of the form of Kala (Time or Death).

verses.sanskrit: कुशीलचर्याः पाषण्डैर्वृथारूपैः समावृताः । बहुयाचनको लोको भविष्यति परस्परम्
verses.transliteration: kuśīlacaryāḥ pāṣaṇḍairvṛthārūpaiḥ samāvṛtāḥ / bahuyācanako loko bhaviṣyati parasparam
verses.translation: Have a look at me, the great Deva; may all your fears be eschewed. Formerly, both of you, the eternal ones, were born of my limbs.
verses.hindi: पूर्वमें स्वायम्भुव मनुके जिस प्रियव्रत नामक पुत्रका वर्णन किया गया है उस (प्रियत्रत)-को प्रजापतिके समान दस पुत्र हुए। अग्नीध्र, अग्निबाहु, वपुष्मान्,
verses.wordMeaning: Have a look at me, the great Deva; may all your fears be eschewed. Formerly, both of you, the eternal ones, were born of my limbs.
verses.commentary: Sense: Have a look at me, the great Deva; may all your fears be eschewed. Formerly, both of you, the eternal ones, were born of my limbs.

verses.sanskrit: अट्टशूला जनपदाः शिवशूलाश्चतुष्पथाः । प्रमदाः केशशूलिन्यो भविष्यन्ति कलौ युगे
verses.transliteration: aṭṭaśūlā janapadāḥ śivaśūlāścatuṣpathāḥ / pramadāḥ keśaśūlinyo bhaviṣyanti kalau yuge
verses.translation: This Brahma, the grandfather of the worlds is in my right side; Visnu, Hari the protector of the worlds is in the left side, and Kara resides in the heart.
verses.hindi: और सभी प्राणियोंपर दया करनेवाला ज्योतिष्मान् नामक योगपरायण थे। पूर्वजन्मोंका स्मरण करनेवाले इन महाभाग्यशालियों (विरक्तों)-का मन राज्यकार्यमें नहीं लगा। (अतः) प्रियव्रतने (अपने अन्य) उन सात पुत्रोंको सात द्वीपोंमें अभिषिक्त कर दिया। राजाने अग्नीध्र नामक
verses.wordMeaning: This Brahma, the grandfather of the worlds is in my right side; Visnu, Hari the protector of the worlds is in the left side, and Kara resides in the heart.
verses.commentary: Sense: This Brahma, the grandfather of the worlds is in my right side; Visnu, Hari the protector of the worlds is in the left side, and Kara resides in the heart.

verses.sanskrit: शुक्लदन्ताजिनाख्याश्च मुण्डाः काषायवाससः । शूद्रा धर्मं चरिष्यन्ति युगान्ते समुपस्थिते
verses.transliteration: śukladantājinākhyāśca muṇḍāḥ kāṣāyavāsasaḥ / śūdrā dharmaṃ cariṣyanti yugānte samupasthite
verses.translation: O my dearly beloved Hari, protect this universe consisting of the mobile and immobile beings. O Visnu, I am in the three different forms with the names Brahma, Visnu and Hara.i
verses.hindi: पुत्रको जम्बूद्वीपका स्वामी बनाया। उन्होंने मेधातिथिको प्लक्षद्वीपका राजा बनाया और वपुष्मान्को शाल्मलि- द्वीपमें राजाके रूपमें अभिषिक्त किया
verses.wordMeaning: O my dearly beloved Hari, protect this universe consisting of the mobile and immobile beings. O Visnu, I am in the three different forms with the names Brahma, Visnu and Hara.i
verses.commentary: Sense: O my dearly beloved Hari, protect this universe consisting of the mobile and immobile beings. O Visnu, I am in the three different forms with the names Brahma, Visnu and Hara.i

verses.sanskrit: शस्यचौरा भविष्यन्ति तथा चैलाभिमर्षिणः । चौराश्चौरस्य हर्तारो हर्तुर्हर्ता तथापरः
verses.transliteration: śasyacaurā bhaviṣyanti tathā cailābhimarṣiṇaḥ / caurāścaurasya hartāro harturhartā tathāparaḥ
verses.translation: Though I am devoid of Gunas and unsullied, I am threefold due to the attributes for the function of creation, sustenance and dissolution. O Visnu, eschew your delusion and protect this god Brahma, the grand-sire of the worlds.
verses.hindi: प्रभु (प्रियत्रत)-ने ज्योतिष्मान्को कुशद्वीपका राजा बनाया और द्युतिमानूको क्रौञ्चद्वीपका राजा बननेका आदेश दिया। प्रजापति प्रियव्रतने हव्यको शाकद्वीपका स्वामी बनाया और सवनको पुष्करद्वीपका अधिपति पुष्करे सवनस्यापि महावीतः सुतोऽभवत्। धातकिश्चैव द्वावेतौ पुत्रौ पुत्रवतां वरौ
verses.wordMeaning: Though I am devoid of Gunas and unsullied, I am threefold due to the attributes for the function of creation, sustenance and dissolution. O Visnu, eschew your delusion and protect this god Brahma, the grand-sire of the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Though I am devoid of Gunas and unsullied, I am threefold due to the attributes for the function of creation, sustenance and dissolution. O Visnu, eschew your delusion and protect this god Brahma, the grand-sire of the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: दुः खप्रचुरताल्पायुर्देहोत्सादः सरोगता । अधर्माभिनिवेशित्वात् तमोवृत्तं कलौ स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: duḥ khapracuratālpāyurdehotsādaḥ sarogatā / adharmābhiniveśitvāt tamovṛttaṃ kalau smṛtam
verses.translation: It is called Linga, O Brahmana, because it is the Supreme form of the Brahman. O sinless one, thus the glory of Linga has been narrated to you by me.
verses.hindi: नाम्ना तु धातकेश्चापि धातकीखण्डमुच्यते
verses.wordMeaning: It is called Linga, O Brahmana, because it is the Supreme form of the Brahman. O sinless one, thus the glory of Linga has been narrated to you by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is called Linga, O Brahmana, because it is the Supreme form of the Brahman. O sinless one, thus the glory of Linga has been narrated to you by me.

verses.sanskrit: काषायिणो ऽथ निर्ग्रन्थास्तथा कापालिकाश्च ये । वेदविक्रयिणश्चान्ये तीर्थविक्रयिणः परे
verses.transliteration: kāṣāyiṇo 'tha nirgranthāstathā kāpālikāśca ye / vedavikrayiṇaścānye tīrthavikrayiṇaḥ pare
verses.translation: Only those who know Yoga, but neither Devas nor Danavas, can understand this. This is the greatest knowledge unrevealed and designated as Siva-lore.
verses.hindi: आनन्दश्च शिवश्चैव क्षेमकश्च ध्रुवस्तथा प्लक्षद्वीपादिषु ज्ञेयः शाकद्वीपान्तिकेषु वै। वर्णाश्रमविभागेन स्वधर्मो मुक्तये द्विजाः
verses.wordMeaning: Only those who know Yoga, but neither Devas nor Danavas, can understand this. This is the greatest knowledge unrevealed and designated as Siva-lore.
verses.commentary: Sense: Only those who know Yoga, but neither Devas nor Danavas, can understand this. This is the greatest knowledge unrevealed and designated as Siva-lore.

verses.sanskrit: आसनस्थान् द्विजान् दृष्ट्वा न चलन्त्यल्पबुद्धयः । ताडयन्ति द्विजेन्द्रांश्च शूद्रा राजोपजीविनः
verses.transliteration: āsanasthān dvijān dṛṣṭvā na calantyalpabuddhayaḥ / tāḍayanti dvijendrāṃśca śūdrā rājopajīvinaḥ
verses.translation: We pay obeisance to that lord forever whereby those who are endowed with the vision of knowledge see that Lord, subtle and incomprehensible.
verses.hindi: रम्यो हिरण्वांश्च कुरु भद्राश्वः केतुमालकः
verses.wordMeaning: We pay obeisance to that lord forever whereby those who are endowed with the vision of knowledge see that Lord, subtle and incomprehensible.
verses.commentary: Sense: We pay obeisance to that lord forever whereby those who are endowed with the vision of knowledge see that Lord, subtle and incomprehensible.

verses.sanskrit: उच्चासनस्थाः शूद्रास्तु द्विजमध्ये परन्तप । ज्ञात्वा न हिंसते राजा कलौ कालबलेन तु
verses.transliteration: uccāsanasthāḥ śūdrāstu dvijamadhye parantapa / jñātvā na hiṃsate rājā kalau kālabalena tu
verses.translation: Obeisance to lord Mahadeva, the lord of Devas, to Bhrhgin. Salutations to the blue-throated one, to the mystic secret of the Vedas.
verses.hindi: जम्बूद्वीपेश्ररो राजा स चाग्नीधो महामतिः । विभज्य नवधा तेभ्यो यथान्यायं ददौ पुनः पुष्करमें सवनको भी महावीत तथा धातकि नामक दो पुत्र हुए। पुत्रवानोंके पुत्रोंमें ये दोनों ही पुत्र श्रेष्ठ थे। उन महात्मा (महावीत)-के नामसे उस वर्षको महावीतवर्ष कहा गया है और धातकिके भी नामसे धातकिखण्ड
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to lord Mahadeva, the lord of Devas, to Bhrhgin. Salutations to the blue-throated one, to the mystic secret of the Vedas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to lord Mahadeva, the lord of Devas, to Bhrhgin. Salutations to the blue-throated one, to the mystic secret of the Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: पुष्पैश्च हसितैश्चैव तथान्यैर्मङ्गलैर्द्विजाः । शूद्रानभ्यर्चयन्त्यल्पश्रुतभग्यबलान्विताः
verses.transliteration: puṣpaiśca hasitaiścaiva tathānyairmaṅgalairdvijāḥ / śūdrānabhyarcayantyalpaśrutabhagyabalānvitāḥ
verses.translation: Hail to the terrible one, to the quiescent Sthanu, to the cause of the Universe, the Brahman, to Vamadeva, to the three-eyed greatest Lord.
verses.hindi: कहा जाता है। शाकद्वीपके राजा हव्यको जलद, कुमार,
verses.wordMeaning: Hail to the terrible one, to the quiescent Sthanu, to the cause of the Universe, the Brahman, to Vamadeva, to the three-eyed greatest Lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hail to the terrible one, to the quiescent Sthanu, to the cause of the Universe, the Brahman, to Vamadeva, to the three-eyed greatest Lord.

verses.sanskrit: न प्रेक्षन्ते ऽर्चितांश्चापि शूद्रा द्विजवरान् नृप । सेवावसरमालोक्य द्वारि तिष्ठन्ति च द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: na prekṣante 'rcitāṃścāpi śūdrā dvijavarān nṛpa / sevāvasaramālokya dvāri tiṣṭhanti ca dvijāḥ
verses.translation: Always pay obeisance to Sankara, Mahesa, Girisa, Siva. Ever meditate on Mahesvara. Ere longyou will be liberat¬ ed from this ocean of worldly existence." Thus the leading sage was advised by Vasudeva.
verses.hindi: महाद्रुम नामक पुत्र हुआ ॥ १४--१६॥ (इन सातों पुत्रोंके राज्यक्षेत्र इनके नामसे एक-एक वर्ष कहलाये--इसीलिये) जलदका जलद नामक प्रथम वर्ष कहा जाता है। कुमारका कौमार नामक वर्ष, इसी प्रकार तीसरा सुकुमारक (वर्ष), चौथा मणीचक,
verses.wordMeaning: Always pay obeisance to Sankara, Mahesa, Girisa, Siva. Ever meditate on Mahesvara. Ere longyou will be liberat¬ ed from this ocean of worldly existence." Thus the leading sage was advised by Vasudeva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Always pay obeisance to Sankara, Mahesa, Girisa, Siva. Ever meditate on Mahesvara. Ere longyou will be liberat¬ ed from this ocean of worldly existence." Thus the leading sage was advised by Vasudeva.

verses.sanskrit: वाहनस्थान् समावृत्य शूद्राञ् शूद्रोपजीविनः । सेवन्ते ब्राह्मणास्तत्र स्तुवन्ति स्तुतिभिः कलौ
verses.transliteration: vāhanasthān samāvṛtya śūdrāñ śūdropajīvinaḥ / sevante brāhmaṇāstatra stuvanti stutibhiḥ kalau
verses.translation: This refers to Gautama's curse to Brahmanas who with a desire to return to their hermitages after 12 years' famine were not allowed to do so through persuasion by Gautama. They created a fake cow which died at the prohibitive word of Gautama and thus left him as he was the killer of a cow.
verses.hindi: नामक वर्ष है। क्रौञ्चद्वीपके राजा द्युतिमान्को भी पुत्र हुए। उनमें कुशल पहला, मनोहर दूसरा, उष्ण तीसरा पुत्र कहा गया है और चौथा पुत्र प्रवर नामसे जाना जाता
verses.wordMeaning: This refers to Gautama's curse to Brahmanas who with a desire to return to their hermitages after 12 years' famine were not allowed to do so through persuasion by Gautama.…
verses.commentary: Sense: This refers to Gautama's curse to Brahmanas who with a desire to return to their hermitages after 12 years' famine were not allowed to do so through persuasion by Gautama.…

verses.sanskrit: अध्यापयन्ति वै वेदाञ् शूद्राञ् शूद्रोपजीविनः । पठन्ति वैदिकान् मन्त्रान् नास्तिक्यं घोरमाश्रिताः
verses.transliteration: adhyāpayanti vai vedāñ śūdrāñ śūdropajīvinaḥ / paṭhanti vaidikān mantrān nāstikyaṃ ghoramāśritāḥ
verses.translation: Aniruddha ofgreat strength was the son of Pradyuma. Both of them were richly endowed with good qualities; they were as if the other two bodies of Krsna himself.
verses.hindi: दुन्दुभि सातवाँ पुत्र था। उनके (अपने ही) नामसे प्रसिद्ध सुन्दर देश क्रौञ्चद्वीपमें स्थित हैं। कुशद्वीपमें ज्योतिष्मानुको महान् ओजस्वी सात पुत्र हुए। उद्भेद, सातवा कपिल कहा गया है
verses.wordMeaning: Aniruddha ofgreat strength was the son of Pradyuma. Both of them were richly endowed with good qualities; they were as if the other two bodies of Krsna himself.
verses.commentary: Sense: Aniruddha ofgreat strength was the son of Pradyuma. Both of them were richly endowed with good qualities; they were as if the other two bodies of Krsna himself.

verses.sanskrit: तपोयज्ञफलानां च विक्रेतारो द्विजोत्तमाः । यतयश्च भविष्यन्ति शतशो ऽथ सहस्त्रशः
verses.transliteration: tapoyajñaphalānāṃ ca vikretāro dvijottamāḥ / yatayaśca bhaviṣyanti śataśo 'tha sahastraśaḥ
verses.translation: In the meanwhile, Bhrgu, and other Brahmanas came to Dvaraka in order to see the eternal lord Krsna who had accomplished his mission.
verses.hindi: हे सुब्रतो! इस (कुशद्वीप)-में उनके नामसे युक्त वर्ष हैं। इसी प्रकार उन अन्य द्वीपोमें भी स्थिति समझनी चाहिए। शाल्मलद्वीपके स्वामी वपुष्मानूके श्वेत, हरित,
verses.wordMeaning: In the meanwhile, Bhrgu, and other Brahmanas came to Dvaraka in order to see the eternal lord Krsna who had accomplished his mission.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meanwhile, Bhrgu, and other Brahmanas came to Dvaraka in order to see the eternal lord Krsna who had accomplished his mission.

verses.sanskrit: नाशयन्ति ह्यधीतानि नाधिगच्छन्ति चानघ । गायन्ति लौकिकैर्गानैर्दैवतानि नराधिप
verses.transliteration: nāśayanti hyadhītāni nādhigacchanti cānagha / gāyanti laukikairgānairdaivatāni narādhipa
verses.translation: After bowing to and worshipping them and when they had been comfortably seated alongwith the intelligent Rama, the Atman of the universe (i.e. Krsna) said to them.
verses.hindi: नामक पुत्र थे। प्लक्षद्दीपके राजा मेधातिथिके भी सात पुत्र हुए। उनमें ज्येष्ठ पुत्र शान्तभय था। इसके अतिरिक्त शिशिर, सुखोदय, आनन्द, शिव, क्षेमक तथा ध्रुव द्विजो! प्लक्षद्वीप आदिसे लेकर शाकद्वीपतक वर्ण और आश्रमके भेदसे स्वधर्म (पालन)-को मुक्तिका साधन समझना चाहिए है श्रेष्ठ द्विजो! जम्बूट्वीपके अधिपति अग्रीध्रके भी महान् बलशाली पुत्र थे, उनके नाम सुनो-
verses.wordMeaning: After bowing to and worshipping them and when they had been comfortably seated alongwith the intelligent Rama, the Atman of the universe (i.e. Krsna) said to them.
verses.commentary: Sense: After bowing to and worshipping them and when they had been comfortably seated alongwith the intelligent Rama, the Atman of the universe (i.e. Krsna) said to them.

verses.sanskrit: वामपाशुपताचारास्तथा वै पाञ्चरात्रिकाः । भविष्यन्ति कलौ तस्मिन् ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रियास्तथा
verses.transliteration: vāmapāśupatācārāstathā vai pāñcarātrikāḥ / bhaviṣyanti kalau tasmin brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyāstathā
verses.translation: "O great sages, I shall now go to my Supreme abode known as "Visnu's region." All the tasks of my mission have been fulfilled. Be pleased to permit me.
verses.hindi: भद्राश्च तथा केतुमालक नामक नौ पुत्र थे
verses.wordMeaning: "O great sages, I shall now go to my Supreme abode known as "Visnu's region." All the tasks of my mission have been fulfilled. Be pleased to permit me.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O great sages, I shall now go to my Supreme abode known as "Visnu's region." All the tasks of my mission have been fulfilled. Be pleased to permit me.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानकर्मण्युपरते लोके निष्क्रियतां गते । कीटमूषकसर्पाश्च धर्षयिष्यन्ति मानवान्
verses.transliteration: jñānakarmaṇyuparate loke niṣkriyatāṃ gate / kīṭamūṣakasarpāśca dharṣayiṣyanti mānavān
verses.translation: Now, the inauspicious and terrible Kali Age has set in. In this Age the people will become the followers of sinful activities.
verses.hindi: जम्बुद्वीपेश्वर महामति उन राजा अग्रीध्रने (जम्बृद्वीपको) नौ भागोंमें बाँटकर न्यायानुसार उन (पुत्रों)-को दे दिया गन्धमादनवर्ष तु केतुमालाय दत्तवान्
verses.wordMeaning: Now, the inauspicious and terrible Kali Age has set in. In this Age the people will become the followers of sinful activities.
verses.commentary: Sense: Now, the inauspicious and terrible Kali Age has set in. In this Age the people will become the followers of sinful activities.

verses.sanskrit: कुर्वान्ति चावताराणि ब्राह्मणानां कुलेषु वै । दधीचशापनिर्दग्धाः पुरा दक्षाध्वरे द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: kurvānti cāvatārāṇi brāhmaṇānāṃ kuleṣu vai / dadhīcaśāpanirdagdhāḥ purā dakṣādhvare dvijāḥ
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas, you propagate that perfect knowledge which is beneficial to the ignorant and whereby these will be absolved of the sins of Kali Age.
verses.hindi: तस्वर्षभोऽभवत् पुत्रो मरुदेव्यां महाद्युतिः
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahmanas, you propagate that perfect knowledge which is beneficial to the ignorant and whereby these will be absolved of the sins of Kali Age.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmanas, you propagate that perfect knowledge which is beneficial to the ignorant and whereby these will be absolved of the sins of Kali Age.

verses.sanskrit: निन्दन्ति च महादेवं तमसाविष्टचेतसः । वृथा धर्मं चरिष्यन्ति कलौ तस्मिन् युगान्तिके
verses.transliteration: nindanti ca mahādevaṃ tamasāviṣṭacetasaḥ / vṛthā dharmaṃ cariṣyanti kalau tasmin yugāntike
verses.translation: Those persons who remember me, the Supreme Lord, even once, in this Kali age, their sins perish.
verses.hindi: तपसा कर्षितोऽत्यर्थं कुशो धमनिसंततः । ज्ञानयोगरतो भूत्वा महापाशुपतोऽभवत् (अग्नीध्रने) नाभिको दक्षिण दिशामें स्थित हिम नामक वर्ष प्रदान किया। तदनन्तर किंपुरुषको हेमकूट नामक वर्ष दिया। पिता (अग्नीध्र)-ने हरिको तृतीय नैषध नामक वर्ष प्रदान किया और इलावृतको मेरुके
verses.wordMeaning: Those persons who remember me, the Supreme Lord, even once, in this Kali age, their sins perish.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those persons who remember me, the Supreme Lord, even once, in this Kali age, their sins perish.

verses.sanskrit: ये चान्ये शापनिर्दग्धा गौतमस्य महात्मनः । सर्वे ते च भविष्यन्ति ब्राह्मणाद्याः स्वजातिषु
verses.transliteration: ye cānye śāpanirdagdhā gautamasya mahātmanaḥ / sarve te ca bhaviṣyanti brāhmaṇādyāḥ svajātiṣu
verses.translation: Those twice-born ones who worship me everyday with great devotion in the Kali Age, in accordance with the injunction prescribed in the Vedas, will go to my region.
verses.hindi: मध्यमें स्थित इलावृत (नामक वर्ष) दिया  पिताने रम्यको नीलाचलयुक्त वर्ष प्रदान किया और जो उत्तरमें स्थित श्वेतवर्ष है, उसे हिरण्वान्को दिया। शृंगवान् पर्वतके उत्तरमें स्थित (उत्तरकुरु नामक) वर्ष कुरुको दिया और मेरुके पूर्वम
verses.wordMeaning: Those twice-born ones who worship me everyday with great devotion in the Kali Age, in accordance with the injunction prescribed in the Vedas, will go to my region.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those twice-born ones who worship me everyday with great devotion in the Kali Age, in accordance with the injunction prescribed in the Vedas, will go to my region.

verses.sanskrit: विनिन्दन्ति हृषीकेशं ब्राह्मणान् ब्रह्मवादिनः । वेदबाह्यव्रताचारा दुराचारा वृथाश्रमाः
verses.transliteration: vinindanti hṛṣīkeśaṃ brāhmaṇān brahmavādinaḥ / vedabāhyavratācārā durācārā vṛthāśramāḥ
verses.translation: Thousands of Brahmanas, born of your family, will cherish devotion towards Narayana, in the Kali Age.
verses.hindi: स्थित (भद्राश्व नामक) वर्ष भद्राश्वको दिया तथा गन्धमादन नामक वर्ष केतुमालको प्रदान किया इन वर्षामें अपने पुत्रोंको अभिषिक्त कर राजा (अग्नीध्र) संसारके कष्टको जानकर तपस्या करनेके लिये वनमें चले गये। जिन महात्मा नाभिके पास हिम नामक वर्ष था, उन्हें मरुदेवीसे महान् द्युतिमान् ऋषभ नामक पुत्र
verses.wordMeaning: Thousands of Brahmanas, born of your family, will cherish devotion towards Narayana, in the Kali Age.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thousands of Brahmanas, born of your family, will cherish devotion towards Narayana, in the Kali Age.

verses.sanskrit: मोहयन्ति जनान् सर्वान् दर्शयित्वा फलानि च । तमसाविष्टमनसो वैडालवृत्तिकाधमाः
verses.transliteration: mohayanti janān sarvān darśayitvā phalāni ca / tamasāviṣṭamanaso vaiḍālavṛttikādhamāḥ
verses.translation: The people who are devoted to Narayana attain the deity that is greater than the greatest. Those who hate Mahes- vara will not attain it.
verses.hindi: हुआ  ऋषभको सौ पुत्रोंमें सबसे ज्येष्ठ भरत नामक वीर पुत्र उत्पन्न हुआ। भरत नामक पुत्रको पृथ्वीके अधिपतिके रूपमें अभिषिक्त कर राजा ऋषभ वानप्रस्थाश्रमका आश्रय लेकर यथाविधि तप करने लगे। तपस्यासे अत्यन्त क्षीण
verses.wordMeaning: The people who are devoted to Narayana attain the deity that is greater than the greatest. Those who hate Mahes- vara will not attain it.
verses.commentary: Sense: The people who are devoted to Narayana attain the deity that is greater than the greatest. Those who hate Mahes- vara will not attain it.

verses.sanskrit: कलौ रुद्रो महादेवो लोकानामीश्वरः परः । न देवता भवेन्नृणां देवतानां च दैवतम्
verses.transliteration: kalau rudro mahādevo lokānāmīśvaraḥ paraḥ / na devatā bhavennṛṇāṃ devatānāṃ ca daivatam
verses.translation: The meditation, the Yogic practice, the penance performed, the knowledge obtained, the Yajna and other rites of those people who hate Mahesvara, perish immediately.
verses.hindi: होनेके कारण वे इतने कृश हो गये कि उनके शरीरकी नाडियाँ दीखती थीं । (तपःपूत वे) ज्ञानयोगपरायण होकर (उन) भरतको भी सुमति नामक परम धार्मिक पुत्र हुआ  सुमतिका पुत्र तेजस और उस (तैजस) -से इन्दरद्युप् उत्पन्न हुआ। उस इन्द्रद्युम्रका पुत्र परमेष्ठी हुआ और उस (परमेष्टी) -का पुत्र प्रतीहार हुआ। उस प्रतीहारका जो
verses.wordMeaning: The meditation, the Yogic practice, the penance performed, the knowledge obtained, the Yajna and other rites of those people who hate Mahesvara, perish immediately.
verses.commentary: Sense: The meditation, the Yogic practice, the penance performed, the knowledge obtained, the Yajna and other rites of those people who hate Mahesvara, perish immediately.

verses.sanskrit: करिष्यत्यवताराणि शङ्करो नीललोहितः । श्रौतस्मार्तप्रतिष्ठार्थं भक्तानां हितकाम्यया
verses.transliteration: kariṣyatyavatārāṇi śaṅkaro nīlalohitaḥ / śrautasmārtapratiṣṭhārthaṃ bhaktānāṃ hitakāmyayā
verses.translation: Even he who worships me everyday with single- minded devotion but speaks ill of god Siva, falls into ten thousand hells for ten thousand years.
verses.hindi: पुत्र उत्पन्न हुआ, वह प्रतिहर्ताके नामसे विख्यात हुआ। उससे भव, भवसे उद्गीथ तथा उस (उद्गीथ) -से प्रस्ताव नामक पुत्रकी उत्पत्ति हुई । उस (प्रस्ताव)-से पृथु एवं पृथुसे रक्त उत्पन्न हुआ और रक्तको भी गय नामक पुत्र
verses.wordMeaning: Even he who worships me everyday with single- minded devotion but speaks ill of god Siva, falls into ten thousand hells for ten thousand years.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even he who worships me everyday with single- minded devotion but speaks ill of god Siva, falls into ten thousand hells for ten thousand years.

verses.sanskrit: उपदेक्ष्यति तज्ज्ञानं शिष्याणां ब्रह्मसंज्ञितम् । सर्ववेदान्तसारं हि धर्मान् वेदनिदर्शितान्
verses.transliteration: upadekṣyati tajjñānaṃ śiṣyāṇāṃ brahmasaṃjñitam / sarvavedāntasāraṃ hi dharmān vedanidarśitān
verses.translation: Hence, O Brahmanas, the censuring of godofPasupati should be avoided mentally, physically and verbally, by my devotees, by all means.
verses.hindi: हुआ। गयका पुत्र नर और उसका पुत्र विराट् हुआ। उस (विराट्)-का पुत्र महावीर्य और उससे धीमान् (नामक पुत्र) उत्पन्न हुआ॥ ३७--४० ॥ उस (धीमान्)-से महान्त नामक पुत्र हुआ और उसका पुत्र भौवन हुआ। उस (भौवन)-का त्वष्ट हुआ। उस (त्वष्टा)-से विरज तथा विरजसे रज नामक पुत्र उत्पन्न हुआ
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, O Brahmanas, the censuring of godofPasupati should be avoided mentally, physically and verbally, by my devotees, by all means.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, O Brahmanas, the censuring of godofPasupati should be avoided mentally, physically and verbally, by my devotees, by all means.

verses.sanskrit: ये तं विप्रा निषेवन्ते येन केनोपचारतः । विजित्यकलिजान् दोषान् यान्ति ते परमं पदम्
verses.transliteration: ye taṃ viprā niṣevante yena kenopacārataḥ / vijityakalijān doṣān yānti te paramaṃ padam
verses.translation: Those excellent Brahmanas who had been cursed by Dadhica in the course of the sacrifice performed by Daksa, should be shunned carefully by the devotees in the Kali Age.
verses.hindi: पाशुपत (पशुपति-महादेवको परम ध्येय माननेवाला) व्रत है। इसमें पूर्ण परिनिष्ठित परम विरक्त मनुष्य महापाशुपत कहा
verses.wordMeaning: Those excellent Brahmanas who had been cursed by Dadhica in the course of the sacrifice performed by Daksa, should be shunned carefully by the devotees in the Kali Age.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those excellent Brahmanas who had been cursed by Dadhica in the course of the sacrifice performed by Daksa, should be shunned carefully by the devotees in the Kali Age.

verses.sanskrit: अनायासेन सुमहत् पुण्यमाप्नोति मानवः । अनेकदोषदुष्टस्य कलेरेष महान् गुणः
verses.transliteration: anāyāsena sumahat puṇyamāpnoti mānavaḥ / anekadoṣaduṣṭasya kalereṣa mahān guṇaḥ
verses.translation: Your descendants on the earth who censure lord I Sana and who have been cursed by Gautama, are not worthy of being conversed with by the excellent Brahmanas."
verses.hindi: द्विजो! उस रजस्को शतजित् नामक पुत्र हुआ तेषां प्रधानो बलवान् विश्वज्योतिरिति स्मृतः॥ ४२॥  और उसके सौ पुत्र हुए। उनमें जो प्रधान और बलवान्
verses.wordMeaning: Your descendants on the earth who censure lord I Sana and who have been cursed by Gautama, are not worthy of being conversed with by the excellent Brahmanas."
verses.commentary: Sense: Your descendants on the earth who censure lord I Sana and who have been cursed by Gautama, are not worthy of being conversed with by the excellent Brahmanas."

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन प्राप्य माहेश्वरं युगम् । विशेषाद् ब्राह्मणो रुद्रमीशानं शरणं व्रजेत्
verses.transliteration: tasmāt sarvaprayatnena prāpya māheśvaraṃ yugam / viśeṣād brāhmaṇo rudramīśānaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajet
verses.translation: All those great sages who were thus addressed by Krsna said Orh (i.e. Amen). Those excellent men hastened to their respective abodes.
verses.hindi: आराध्य देवं ब्रह्माणं क्षेमकं नाम पार्थिवम्।
verses.wordMeaning: All those great sages who were thus addressed by Krsna said Orh (i.e. Amen). Those excellent men hastened to their respective abodes.
verses.commentary: Sense: All those great sages who were thus addressed by Krsna said Orh (i.e. Amen). Those excellent men hastened to their respective abodes.

verses.sanskrit: ये नमन्ति विरूपाक्षमीशानं कृत्तिवाससम् । प्रसन्नचेतसो रुद्रं ते यान्ति परमं पदम्
verses.transliteration: ye namanti virūpākṣamīśānaṃ kṛttivāsasam / prasannacetaso rudraṃ te yānti paramaṃ padam
verses.translation: Thereafter, Narayana, Krsna, the pervader of the world, sportingly dissolved his own race and attained that Supreme region.
verses.hindi: था, वह विश्वज्योति नामसे प्रसिद्ध हुआ। देव ब्रह्माकी आराधना कर (विश्वज्योतिने) क्षेमक नामके महाबाहु और शत्रुमर्दन तथा धर्मज्ञ राजाको पुत्ररूपमें उत्पन्न असूत पुत्रं धर्मज्ञं महाबाहुमरिंदमम्॥ ४३॥  किया
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, Narayana, Krsna, the pervader of the world, sportingly dissolved his own race and attained that Supreme region.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, Narayana, Krsna, the pervader of the world, sportingly dissolved his own race and attained that Supreme region.

verses.sanskrit: यथा रुद्रनमस्कारः सर्वकर्मफलो ध्रुवम् । अन्यदेवनमस्कारान्न तत्फलमवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: yathā rudranamaskāraḥ sarvakarmaphalo dhruvam / anyadevanamaskārānna tatphalamavāpnuyāt
verses.translation: Thus the race of kings has been succinctly recoun¬ ted to you. It is impossible to describe it in detail. What is it that you wish to hear further?
verses.hindi: एते पुरस्ताद् राजानो महासत्त्वा महौजसः । एषां वंशप्रसूतैश्च भुक्तेयं पृथिवी पुरा
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the race of kings has been succinctly recoun¬ ted to you. It is impossible to describe it in detail. What is it that you wish to hear further?
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the race of kings has been succinctly recoun¬ ted to you. It is impossible to describe it in detail. What is it that you wish to hear further?

verses.sanskrit: एवंविधे कलियुगे दोषाणामेकशोधनम् । महादेवनमस्कारो ध्यानं दानमिति श्रुतिः
verses.transliteration: evaṃvidhe kaliyuge doṣāṇāmekaśodhanam / mahādevanamaskāro dhyānaṃ dānamiti śrutiḥ
verses.translation: He who reads or listens to the auspicious narration of the races shall be freed from all sins. He is honoured in the heavenly world.
verses.hindi: पूर्वकालमें ये महासत्त्वसम्पन्न और महान् ओजस्वी राजा थे। इनके वंशमें उत्पन्न लोगोंने प्राचीन कालमें इस पृथ्वीका उपभोग किया 'भू' आदि सात लोकोंका वर्णन, ग्रह-नक्षत्रोंकी स्थितिका वर्णन तथा उनका परिमाप, सूर्यरथका वर्णन, पूर्व आदि दिशाओंमें स्थित इन्द्रादि देवोंकी अमरावती आदि पुरियोंका नाम-निर्देश, सूर्यकी महिमा
verses.wordMeaning: He who reads or listens to the auspicious narration of the races shall be freed from all sins. He is honoured in the heavenly world.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who reads or listens to the auspicious narration of the races shall be freed from all sins. He is honoured in the heavenly world.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादनीश्वरानन्यान् त्यक्त्वा देवं महेश्वरम् । समाश्रयेद् विरूपाक्षं यदीच्छेत् परमं पदम्
verses.transliteration: tasmādanīśvarānanyān tyaktvā devaṃ maheśvaram / samāśrayed virūpākṣaṃ yadīcchet paramaṃ padam
verses.translation: O Suta, do narrate succinctly to us, the power (v.l. nature) of the four Yugas viz.;—Krta, Treta, Dvapara and Kali.
verses.hindi: त्रैलोक्यस्यास्य मानं वो न शक्यं विस्तरेण तु
verses.wordMeaning: O Suta, do narrate succinctly to us, the power (v.l. nature) of the four Yugas viz.;—Krta, Treta, Dvapara and Kali.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Suta, do narrate succinctly to us, the power (v.l. nature) of the four Yugas viz.;—Krta, Treta, Dvapara and Kali.

verses.sanskrit: नार्चयन्तीह ये रुद्रं शिवं त्रिदशवन्दितम् । तेषां दानं तपो यज्ञो वृथा जीवितमेव च
verses.transliteration: nārcayantīha ye rudraṃ śivaṃ tridaśavanditam / teṣāṃ dānaṃ tapo yajño vṛthā jīvitameva ca
verses.translation: The expounder of Brahman was followed and surround¬ ed by his disciples and their disciples. Then Arjuna eschewed his grief and prostrated himself on the ground like a staff.
verses.hindi: भूर्लोकोऽथ भुवर्लोकः स्वर्लोकोऽथ महस्ततः। जनस्तपश्च सत्यं च लोकास्त्वण्डोद्भवा मताः तावद् भूर्लोक आख्यातः पुराणे द्विजपुंगवाः
verses.wordMeaning: The expounder of Brahman was followed and surround¬ ed by his disciples and their disciples. Then Arjuna eschewed his grief and prostrated himself on the ground like a staff.
verses.commentary: Sense: The expounder of Brahman was followed and surround¬ ed by his disciples and their disciples. Then Arjuna eschewed his grief and prostrated himself on the ground like a staff.

verses.sanskrit: नमो रुद्राय महते देवदेवाय शूलिने । त्र्यम्बकाय त्रिनेत्राय योगिनां गुरवे नमः
verses.transliteration: namo rudrāya mahate devadevāya śūline / tryambakāya trinetrāya yogināṃ gurave namaḥ
verses.translation: Sitting on the banks of the river and surrounded by his disciples, the sage, the great Yogin Krsnadvaipayana said to him.
verses.hindi: यावत्प्रमाणो भूर्लोको विस्तरात् परिमण्डलात्। भुवर्लोकोऽपि तावान् स्यान्मण्डलाद् भास्करस्य तु
verses.wordMeaning: Sitting on the banks of the river and surrounded by his disciples, the sage, the great Yogin Krsnadvaipayana said to him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sitting on the banks of the river and surrounded by his disciples, the sage, the great Yogin Krsnadvaipayana said to him.

verses.sanskrit: नमो ऽस्तु वामदेवाय महादेवाय वेधसे । शंभवे स्थाणवे नित्यं शिवाय परमेष्ठिने । नमः शोमाय रुद्राय महाग्रासाय हेतवे
verses.transliteration: namo 'stu vāmadevāya mahādevāya vedhase / śaṃbhave sthāṇave nityaṃ śivāya parameṣṭhine / namaḥ śomāya rudrāya mahāgrāsāya hetave
verses.translation: W 2 and 3 quoted in ParaSara-madhava, Prayasdtta VV. 9 and 10.
verses.hindi: स्वर्लोकः स समाख्यातस्तत्र वायोस्तु नेमयः आवहः प्रवहश्चैव तथैवानुवहः परः। संवहो विवहश्चाथ तदूर्ध्वं स्यात् परावहः
verses.wordMeaning: W 2 and 3 quoted in ParaSara-madhava, Prayasdtta VV. 9 and 10.
verses.commentary: Sense: W 2 and 3 quoted in ParaSara-madhava, Prayasdtta VV. 9 and 10.

verses.sanskrit: प्रपद्ये ऽहं विरूपाक्षं शरण्यं ब्रह्मचारिणम् । महादेवं महायोगमीशानं चाम्बिकापतिम्
verses.transliteration: prapadye 'haṃ virūpākṣaṃ śaraṇyaṃ brahmacāriṇam / mahādevaṃ mahāyogamīśānaṃ cāmbikāpatim
verses.translation: Quoted from Manu I. 86. Cf. Mbh. Santi 23.28, Vdyu. 8.65-66.
verses.hindi: तथा परिवहश्चोर्ध्व वायोर्वै सप्त नेमयः। भूमेर्योजनलक्षे तु भानोर्वे मण्डलं स्थितम्
verses.wordMeaning: Quoted from Manu I. 86. Cf. Mbh. Santi 23.28, Vdyu. 8.65-66.
verses.commentary: Sense: Quoted from Manu I. 86. Cf. Mbh. Santi 23.28, Vdyu. 8.65-66.

verses.sanskrit: योगिनां योगदातारं योगमायासमावृतम् । योगिनां कुरुमाचार्यं योगिगम्यं पिनाकिनम्
verses.transliteration: yogināṃ yogadātāraṃ yogamāyāsamāvṛtam / yogināṃ kurumācāryaṃ yogigamyaṃ pinākinam
verses.translation: In the Kali Age, I do not see any other atonement capable of absolving the sins of creatures except staying at Varanasi.i
verses.hindi: सूतजीने कहा--हे द्विजोत्तमो! अब मैं आप लोगोंसे संक्षेपमें इस त्रैलोक्यके परिमाणका वर्णन करूँगा, क्योंकि इसका विस्तारसे वर्णन नहीं किया जा सकता। (सृष्टिके आदिमें) भूलोक, भुवर्लोक, स्वर्लोक, महर्लोक, जनलोक, तपोलोक तथा सत्यलोक-ये (सातो) लोक अण्डसे उत्पन्न बताये गये हैं
verses.wordMeaning: In the Kali Age, I do not see any other atonement capable of absolving the sins of creatures except staying at Varanasi.i
verses.commentary: Sense: In the Kali Age, I do not see any other atonement capable of absolving the sins of creatures except staying at Varanasi.i

verses.sanskrit: संसारतारणं रुद्रं ब्रह्माणं ब्रह्मणो ऽधिपम् । शाश्वतं सर्वगं ब्रह्मण्यं ब्राह्मणप्रियम्
verses.transliteration: saṃsāratāraṇaṃ rudraṃ brahmāṇaṃ brahmaṇo 'dhipam / śāśvataṃ sarvagaṃ brahmaṇyaṃ brāhmaṇapriyam
verses.translation: In all the three Yugas viz. Kfta, Treta and Dvapara, men will be noble-souled, virtuous and truthful in speech.
verses.hindi: द्विजश्रेष्ठो ! सूर्य और चन्द्रमाकी किरणोंसे जहाँतकका भाग प्रकाशित होता है, उतने भागको पुराणमें भूलोक कहा गया है। सूर्यके परिमण्डलसे भूलोकका जितना परिमाण है, उतना ही विस्तार भुवर्लोकका भी सूर्यके
verses.wordMeaning: In all the three Yugas viz. Kfta, Treta and Dvapara, men will be noble-souled, virtuous and truthful in speech.
verses.commentary: Sense: In all the three Yugas viz. Kfta, Treta and Dvapara, men will be noble-souled, virtuous and truthful in speech.

verses.sanskrit: कपर्दिनं कालमूर्तिममूर्ति परमेश्वरम् । एकमूर्ति महामूर्ति वेदवेद्यं दिवस्पतिम्
verses.transliteration: kapardinaṃ kālamūrtimamūrti parameśvaram / ekamūrti mahāmūrti vedavedyaṃ divaspatim
verses.translation: You are famous in the three worlds as one endowed with fortitude and endearing to the people. Observe your own great duty now in this age. You will be thereby free from fear."
verses.hindi: मण्डलसे है। आकाशमें ऊपरकी ओर जहां ध्रुव (तारा) स्थित है, वहाँतकके मण्डलको स्वर्लोक कहा जाता है। वहाँ वायुकी नेमियाँ हैं। आवह, प्रवह, अनुवह, संवह, विवह तथा उसके ऊपर परावह और उसके ऊपर परिवह नामक वायुकी सात नेमियाँ हैं। भूमिसे एक लाख योजन ऊपर सूर्यका मण्डल स्थित है
verses.wordMeaning: You are famous in the three worlds as one endowed with fortitude and endearing to the people. Observe your own great duty now in this age. You will be thereby free from fear."
verses.commentary: Sense: You are famous in the three worlds as one endowed with fortitude and endearing to the people. Observe your own great duty now in this age. You will be thereby free from fear."

verses.sanskrit: नीलकण्ठं विश्वमूर्ति व्यापिनं विश्वरेतसम् । कालाग्निं कालदहनं कामदं कामनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: nīlakaṇṭhaṃ viśvamūrti vyāpinaṃ viśvaretasam / kālāgniṃ kāladahanaṃ kāmadaṃ kāmanāśanam
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas, on being advised thus by the holy sage, Partha, the conqueror of cities of enemies, bowed to him and asked him about the respective duties in the different Yugas.
verses.hindi: चक्र (रथके पहिया)-के ऊपर लोहेकी गोलाकार हाल (परिधि) लगी होती है, इसीके कारण चक्र बिखरता नहीं है। इसी
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahmanas, on being advised thus by the holy sage, Partha, the conqueror of cities of enemies, bowed to him and asked him about the respective duties in the different Yugas.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmanas, on being advised thus by the holy sage, Partha, the conqueror of cities of enemies, bowed to him and asked him about the respective duties in the different Yugas.

verses.sanskrit: नमस्ये गिरिशं देवं चन्द्रावयवभूषणम् । विलोहितं लेलिहानमाहित्यं परमेष्ठिनम् । उग्रं पशुपतिं भीमं भास्करं तमसः परम्
verses.transliteration: namasye giriśaṃ devaṃ candrāvayavabhūṣaṇam / vilohitaṃ lelihānamāhityaṃ parameṣṭhinam / ugraṃ paśupatiṃ bhīmaṃ bhāskaraṃ tamasaḥ param
verses.translation: After bowing down to lord Isana, the son of Satyavati expounded to him everything about the eternal Tugadharmas (the duties in the respective Ages).
verses.hindi: गोलाकार हाल (परिधि)-को नेमि कहते हैं। लक्षे दिवाकरस्यापि मण्डलं शशिन: स्मृतम्। नक्षत्रमण्डलं कृत्स्नं तल्लक्षेण प्रकाशते
verses.wordMeaning: After bowing down to lord Isana, the son of Satyavati expounded to him everything about the eternal Tugadharmas (the duties in the respective Ages).
verses.commentary: Sense: After bowing down to lord Isana, the son of Satyavati expounded to him everything about the eternal Tugadharmas (the duties in the respective Ages).

verses.sanskrit: इत्येतल्लक्षणं प्रोक्तं युगानां वै समासतः । अतीतानागतानां वै यावन्मन्वन्तरक्षयः
verses.transliteration: ityetallakṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ yugānāṃ vai samāsataḥ / atītānāgatānāṃ vai yāvanmanvantarakṣayaḥ
verses.translation: After bowing down to lord Isana, the son of Satyavati expounded to him everything about the eternal Tugadharmas (the duties in the respective Ages).
verses.hindi: अङ्गारकोऽपि शुक्रस्य तत्प्रमाणो व्यवस्थितः । लक्षद्वयेन भौमस्य स्थितो देवपुरोहितः
verses.wordMeaning: After bowing down to lord Isana, the son of Satyavati expounded to him everything about the eternal Tugadharmas (the duties in the respective Ages).
verses.commentary: Sense: After bowing down to lord Isana, the son of Satyavati expounded to him everything about the eternal Tugadharmas (the duties in the respective Ages).

verses.sanskrit: मन्वन्तरेण चैकेन सर्वाण्येवान्तराणि वै । व्याख्यातानि न संदेहः कल्पः कल्पेन चैव हि
verses.transliteration: manvantareṇa caikena sarvāṇyevāntarāṇi vai / vyākhyātāni na saṃdehaḥ kalpaḥ kalpena caiva hi
verses.translation: After bowing down to lord Isana, the son of Satyavati expounded to him everything about the eternal Tugadharmas (the duties in the respective Ages).
verses.hindi: सप्तर्षिमण्डलं तस्माल्लक्षमात्रे प्रकाशते तत्र धर्मः स भगवान् विष्णुर्नारायणः स्थितः
verses.wordMeaning: After bowing down to lord Isana, the son of Satyavati expounded to him everything about the eternal Tugadharmas (the duties in the respective Ages).
verses.commentary: Sense: After bowing down to lord Isana, the son of Satyavati expounded to him everything about the eternal Tugadharmas (the duties in the respective Ages).

verses.sanskrit: मन्वन्तरेषु सर्वेषु अतीतानागतेषु वै । तुल्याभिमानिनः सर्वे नामरूपैर्भवन्त्युत
verses.transliteration: manvantareṣu sarveṣu atītānāgateṣu vai / tulyābhimāninaḥ sarve nāmarūpairbhavantyuta
verses.translation: After bowing down to lord Isana, the son of Satyavati expounded to him everything about the eternal Tugadharmas (the duties in the respective Ages).
verses.hindi: सर्वावरनिकृष्टानि तारकामण्डलानि तु। योजनान्यर्धमात्राणि तेभ्यो हृस्वं न विद्यते
verses.wordMeaning: After bowing down to lord Isana, the son of Satyavati expounded to him everything about the eternal Tugadharmas (the duties in the respective Ages).
verses.commentary: Sense: After bowing down to lord Isana, the son of Satyavati expounded to him everything about the eternal Tugadharmas (the duties in the respective Ages).

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तो भगवता किरीटी श्वेतवाहनः । बभार परमां भक्तिमीशाने ऽव्यभिचारिणीम्
verses.transliteration: evamukto bhagavatā kirīṭī śvetavāhanaḥ / babhāra paramāṃ bhaktimīśāne 'vyabhicāriṇīm
verses.translation: After bowing down to lord Isana, the son of Satyavati expounded to him everything about the eternal Tugadharmas (the duties in the respective Ages).
verses.hindi: सूर्यसे भी एक लाख (योजन) ऊपरके भागमें चन्द्रमाका मण्डल कहा गया है। उससे एक लाख योजनपर स्थित सम्पूर्ण नक्षत्र-मण्डल प्रकाशित होता है हे विप्रो! नक्षत्रमण्डलसे उत्तर दो लाख योजनकी दूरीपर बुध है। बुधसे उतने प्रमाणको दूरीपर शुक्र स्थित है । शुक्रसे उतने ही प्रमाणपर मंगलकी स्थिति है। मंगलसे दो लाख योजनकी दूरीपर देवताओंके पुरोहित
verses.wordMeaning: After bowing down to lord Isana, the son of Satyavati expounded to him everything about the eternal Tugadharmas (the duties in the respective Ages).
verses.commentary: Sense: After bowing down to lord Isana, the son of Satyavati expounded to him everything about the eternal Tugadharmas (the duties in the respective Ages).

verses.sanskrit: नमश्चकार तमृषिं कृष्णद्वैपायनं प्रभुम् । सर्वज्ञं सर्वकर्तारं स्क्षाद् विष्णुं व्यवस्थितम्
verses.transliteration: namaścakāra tamṛṣiṃ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaṃ prabhum / sarvajñaṃ sarvakartāraṃ skṣād viṣṇuṃ vyavasthitam
verses.translation: After bowing down to lord Isana, the son of Satyavati expounded to him everything about the eternal Tugadharmas (the duties in the respective Ages).
verses.hindi: बृहस्पति स्थित हैं। बृहस्पतिसे दो लाख योजन दूर सूर्यपुत्र शनैश्चर स्थित है। यह ग्रहोंका मण्डल है। ग्रहोंके उस मण्डलसे लाख योजनकी दूरीपर सपर्षि- मण्डल प्रकाशित होता है। ऋषियोंके मण्डल (सप्तर्षि-
verses.wordMeaning: After bowing down to lord Isana, the son of Satyavati expounded to him everything about the eternal Tugadharmas (the duties in the respective Ages).
verses.commentary: Sense: After bowing down to lord Isana, the son of Satyavati expounded to him everything about the eternal Tugadharmas (the duties in the respective Ages).

verses.sanskrit: तमुवाच पुनर्व्यासः पाथं परपुरञ्जयम् । कराभ्यां सुशुभाभ्यां च संस्पृश्य प्रणतं मुनिः
verses.transliteration: tamuvāca punarvyāsaḥ pāthaṃ parapurañjayam / karābhyāṃ suśubhābhyāṃ ca saṃspṛśya praṇataṃ muniḥ
verses.translation: After bowing down to lord Isana, the son of Satyavati expounded to him everything about the eternal Tugadharmas (the duties in the respective Ages).
verses.hindi: मण्डल) -से एक लाख योजन ऊपर ध्रुव स्थित है। ध्रुव सम्पूर्ण ज्योतिश्चक्रका केन्द्र-रूप है। वहाँ धर्मरूप नारायण भगवान् विष्णु स्थित हैं सूर्यका व्यास नौ हजार योजन कहा गया है। उसका तीन गुना सूर्यमण्डलका विस्तार है। सूर्यके विस्तारका दो गुना चन्द्रमाका विस्तार कहा गया है। उन दोनोंके तुल्य राहु उन दोनोंके नीचे भ्रमण करता है। पृथ्वीकी
verses.wordMeaning: After bowing down to lord Isana, the son of Satyavati expounded to him everything about the eternal Tugadharmas (the duties in the respective Ages).
verses.commentary: Sense: After bowing down to lord Isana, the son of Satyavati expounded to him everything about the eternal Tugadharmas (the duties in the respective Ages).

verses.sanskrit: धन्यो ऽस्यनुगृहीतो ऽसि त्वादृशो ऽन्यो न विद्यते । त्रैलोक्ये शङ्करे नूनं भक्तः परपुरञ्जय
verses.transliteration: dhanyo 'syanugṛhīto 'si tvādṛśo 'nyo na vidyate / trailokye śaṅkare nūnaṃ bhaktaḥ parapurañjaya
verses.translation: After bowing down to lord Isana, the son of Satyavati expounded to him everything about the eternal Tugadharmas (the duties in the respective Ages).
verses.hindi: छायाको लेकर मण्डलाकारनिर्मित राहुका जो तीसरा बृहत् स्थान है, वह तमोमय है। चन्द्रमाका सोलहवाँ भाग शुक्रका है। शुक्रसे चतुर्थांश कम बृहस्पति (-का विस्तार) जानना चाहिए। बृहस्पतिसे चतुर्थांश कम
verses.wordMeaning: After bowing down to lord Isana, the son of Satyavati expounded to him everything about the eternal Tugadharmas (the duties in the respective Ages).
verses.commentary: Sense: After bowing down to lord Isana, the son of Satyavati expounded to him everything about the eternal Tugadharmas (the duties in the respective Ages).

verses.sanskrit: दृष्टवानसि तं देवं विश्वाक्षं विश्वतोमुखम् । प्रत्यक्षमेव सर्वेशं रुद्रं सर्वजगद्गुरुम्
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭavānasi taṃ devaṃ viśvākṣaṃ viśvatomukham / pratyakṣameva sarveśaṃ rudraṃ sarvajagadgurum
verses.translation: After bowing down to lord Isana, the son of Satyavati expounded to him everything about the eternal Tugadharmas (the duties in the respective Ages).
verses.hindi: मंगल एवं शनि--इन दोनोंका मण्डल कहा गया है। इन दोनोंके मण्डल तथा विस्तारसे चतुर्थांश कम बुधका मण्डल है। तारा और नक्षत्ररूपी जो शरीरधारी हैं, वे सभी मण्डल एवं विस्तारसे बुधके तुल्य हैं जो तारा एवं नक्षत्र-रूप हैं, वे एक-दूसरेसे पाँच, चार, तीन या दो सौ योजन कम विस्तारवाले हैं। सभी छोटे-बड़े ताराओंका मण्डल (ग्रह-पिण्डोंसे छोटे और एक) योजन या आधे योजन परिमाणवाले हैं, उनसे
verses.wordMeaning: After bowing down to lord Isana, the son of Satyavati expounded to him everything about the eternal Tugadharmas (the duties in the respective Ages).
verses.commentary: Sense: After bowing down to lord Isana, the son of Satyavati expounded to him everything about the eternal Tugadharmas (the duties in the respective Ages).

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानं तदैश्वरं दिव्यं यथावद् विदितं त्वया । स्वयमेव हृषीकेशः प्रीत्योवाच सनातनः
verses.transliteration: jñānaṃ tadaiśvaraṃ divyaṃ yathāvad viditaṃ tvayā / svayameva hṛṣīkeśaḥ prītyovāca sanātanaḥ
verses.translation: After bowing down to lord Isana, the son of Satyavati expounded to him everything about the eternal Tugadharmas (the duties in the respective Ages).
verses.hindi: छोटा कोई विद्यमान नहीं है। उनसे ऊपर दूरगामी जो शनि, बृहस्पति तथा मंगल हैं, उन्हें मन्दगतिसे विचरण करनेवाला समझना चाहिए। उनसे नीचे जो दूसरे सूर्य, चन्द्रमा, बुध तथा शुक्र-चार महाग्रह हैं, ये शीघ्र
verses.wordMeaning: After bowing down to lord Isana, the son of Satyavati expounded to him everything about the eternal Tugadharmas (the duties in the respective Ages).
verses.commentary: Sense: After bowing down to lord Isana, the son of Satyavati expounded to him everything about the eternal Tugadharmas (the duties in the respective Ages).

verses.sanskrit: गच्छ गच्छ स्वकं स्थानं न शोकं कर्तुमर्हसि । व्रजस्व परया भक्त्या शरण्यं शरणं शिवम्
verses.transliteration: gaccha gaccha svakaṃ sthānaṃ na śokaṃ kartumarhasi / vrajasva parayā bhaktyā śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ śivam
verses.translation: After bowing down to lord Isana, the son of Satyavati expounded to him everything about the eternal Tugadharmas (the duties in the respective Ages).
verses.hindi: ज्योतिषमें अश्विनी आदि २७ अथवा ' अभिजत्' नामके नक्षत्रको लेकर २८ नक्षत्र प्रसिद्ध हँ--ये ही आकाशमें नक्षत्र नामसे विद्यमान हैं । इनके अतिरिक्त आकाशमें अगणित ज्योतिष्पिण्ड हैं, वे ही 'तारा' कहे जाते हैं। योजनानां सहस्त्राणि भास्करस्य रथो नव। ईषादण्डस्तथैव स्याद् द्विगुणो द्विजसत्तमाः
verses.wordMeaning: After bowing down to lord Isana, the son of Satyavati expounded to him everything about the eternal Tugadharmas (the duties in the respective Ages).
verses.commentary: Sense: After bowing down to lord Isana, the son of Satyavati expounded to him everything about the eternal Tugadharmas (the duties in the respective Ages).

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा स भगवाननुगृह्यार्जुनं प्रभुः । जगाम शङ्करपुरीं समाराधयितुं भवम्
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā sa bhagavānanugṛhyārjunaṃ prabhuḥ / jagāma śaṅkarapurīṃ samārādhayituṃ bhavam
verses.translation: After bowing down to lord Isana, the son of Satyavati expounded to him everything about the eternal Tugadharmas (the duties in the respective Ages).
verses.hindi: सार्धकोटिस्तथा सप्त नियुतान्यधिकानि तु। योजनानां तु तस्याक्षस्तत्र चक्रं प्रतिष्ठितम्
verses.wordMeaning: After bowing down to lord Isana, the son of Satyavati expounded to him everything about the eternal Tugadharmas (the duties in the respective Ages).
verses.commentary: Sense: After bowing down to lord Isana, the son of Satyavati expounded to him everything about the eternal Tugadharmas (the duties in the respective Ages).

verses.sanskrit: पाण्डवेयो ऽपि तद् वाक्यात् संप्राप्य शरणं शिवम् । संत्यज्य सर्वकर्माणि तद्भक्तिपरमो ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: pāṇḍaveyo 'pi tad vākyāt saṃprāpya śaraṇaṃ śivam / saṃtyajya sarvakarmāṇi tadbhaktiparamo 'bhavat
verses.translation: After bowing down to lord Isana, the son of Satyavati expounded to him everything about the eternal Tugadharmas (the duties in the respective Ages).
verses.hindi: त्रिनाभिमति पञ्चारे षण्णेमिन्यक्षयात्मके । संवत्सरमये कृत्सत्रं कालचक्रं प्रतिष्ठितम् २९॥ काष्ठां गतो दक्षिणतः क्षिेषुरिव सर्पति। ज्योतिषां चक्रमादाय देवदेवः प्रजापतिः
verses.wordMeaning: After bowing down to lord Isana, the son of Satyavati expounded to him everything about the eternal Tugadharmas (the duties in the respective Ages).
verses.commentary: Sense: After bowing down to lord Isana, the son of Satyavati expounded to him everything about the eternal Tugadharmas (the duties in the respective Ages).

verses.sanskrit: नार्जुनेन समः शंभोर्भक्त्या भूतो भविष्यति । मुक्त्वा सत्यवतीसूनुं कृष्णं वा देवकीसुतम्
verses.transliteration: nārjunena samaḥ śaṃbhorbhaktyā bhūto bhaviṣyati / muktvā satyavatīsūnuṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vā devakīsutam
verses.translation: After bowing down to lord Isana, the son of Satyavati expounded to him everything about the eternal Tugadharmas (the duties in the respective Ages).
verses.hindi: जब सूर्य दक्षिणायनके मार्गमें विचरण करता है, तब वह (सूर्य) सभी ग्रहोंके निम्न भागोंमें भ्रमण करता है। उसके ऊपर विस्तृत मण्डल बनाकर चन्द्रमा विचरण करता है। सम्पूर्ण नक्षत्र-मण्डल चन्द्रमासे ऊपर
verses.wordMeaning: After bowing down to lord Isana, the son of Satyavati expounded to him everything about the eternal Tugadharmas (the duties in the respective Ages).
verses.commentary: Sense: After bowing down to lord Isana, the son of Satyavati expounded to him everything about the eternal Tugadharmas (the duties in the respective Ages).

verses.sanskrit: तस्मै भगवते नित्यं नमः सत्याय धीमते । पाराशर्याय मुनये व्यासायामिततेजसे
verses.transliteration: tasmai bhagavate nityaṃ namaḥ satyāya dhīmate / pārāśaryāya munaye vyāsāyāmitatejase
verses.translation: After bowing down to lord Isana, the son of Satyavati expounded to him everything about the eternal Tugadharmas (the duties in the respective Ages).
verses.hindi: नक्षत्रोंसे ऊपर बुध, बुधसे ऊपर शुक्र, शुक्रसे ऊपर मंगल और मंगलसे ऊपर बृहस्पति है। उस बृहस्पतिसे भी ऊपर शनैश्वर, उससे ऊपर सप्तर्षि-मण्डल तथा सपर्षि-मण्डलके ऊपर धुव स्थित है हे श्रेष्ठ द्विजो! भास्करका रथ नौ हजार योजनका है। उसका ईषादण्ड' उसी प्रकार दो गुना (अर्थात् अठारह हजार योजनका) है। उसका धुरा डेढ़ करोड़ सत्तर लाख योजनका है और उसीमें चक्र (रथका
verses.wordMeaning: After bowing down to lord Isana, the son of Satyavati expounded to him everything about the eternal Tugadharmas (the duties in the respective Ages).
verses.commentary: Sense: After bowing down to lord Isana, the son of Satyavati expounded to him everything about the eternal Tugadharmas (the duties in the respective Ages).

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णद्वैपायनः साक्षाद् विष्णुरेव सनातनः । को ह्यन्यस्तत्त्वतो रुद्रं वेत्ति तं परमेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaḥ sākṣād viṣṇureva sanātanaḥ / ko hyanyastattvato rudraṃ vetti taṃ parameśvaram
verses.translation: After bowing down to lord Isana, the son of Satyavati expounded to him everything about the eternal Tugadharmas (the duties in the respective Ages).
verses.hindi: पहिया) प्रतिष्ठित है। तीन नाभि, पाँच अरेरे और छः नेमियोंवाले संवत्सरमय उस अक्षय चक्रमें यह सम्पूर्ण कालचक्र प्रतिष्ठित है। द्विजोत्तमो! सूर्यके रथका दूसरा
verses.wordMeaning: After bowing down to lord Isana, the son of Satyavati expounded to him everything about the eternal Tugadharmas (the duties in the respective Ages).
verses.commentary: Sense: After bowing down to lord Isana, the son of Satyavati expounded to him everything about the eternal Tugadharmas (the duties in the respective Ages).

verses.sanskrit: नमः कुरुध्वं तमृषिं कृष्णं सत्यवतीसुतम् । पाराशर्यं महात्मानं योगिनं विष्णुमव्ययम्
verses.transliteration: namaḥ kurudhvaṃ tamṛṣiṃ kṛṣṇaṃ satyavatīsutam / pārāśaryaṃ mahātmānaṃ yoginaṃ viṣṇumavyayam
verses.translation: After bowing down to lord Isana, the son of Satyavati expounded to him everything about the eternal Tugadharmas (the duties in the respective Ages).
verses.hindi: योजनका है॥ २७--३०॥ दोनों ओरके युगार्ध (जूआ)-का प्रमाण उस अक्ष (धुरे)-के परिमाणके बराबर है। धुरेके आधारमें स्थित हस्व अक्ष उस युगार्ध (जूआ)-के बराबर है। द्वितीय अक्षमें स्थित उस (रथ)-का चक्र मानसाचलपर स्थित
verses.wordMeaning: After bowing down to lord Isana, the son of Satyavati expounded to him everything about the eternal Tugadharmas (the duties in the respective Ages).
verses.commentary: Sense: After bowing down to lord Isana, the son of Satyavati expounded to him everything about the eternal Tugadharmas (the duties in the respective Ages).

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तास्तु मुनयः सर्व एव समीहिताः । प्रेणेमुस्तं महात्मानं व्यासं सत्यवतीसुतम्
verses.transliteration: evamuktāstu munayaḥ sarva eva samīhitāḥ / preṇemustaṃ mahātmānaṃ vyāsaṃ satyavatīsutam
verses.translation: After bowing down to lord Isana, the son of Satyavati expounded to him everything about the eternal Tugadharmas (the duties in the respective Ages).
verses.hindi: है। सात छन्द (उस रथके) अश्व हैं। उनके नाम सुनो-
verses.wordMeaning: After bowing down to lord Isana, the son of Satyavati expounded to him everything about the eternal Tugadharmas (the duties in the respective Ages).
verses.commentary: Sense: After bowing down to lord Isana, the son of Satyavati expounded to him everything about the eternal Tugadharmas (the duties in the respective Ages).

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे अष्टाविंशो ऽध्यायः ऋषय ऊचुः प्राप्य वाराणसीं दिव्यां कृष्णद्वैपायनो मुनिः । किमकार्षोन्महाबुद्धिः श्रोतुं कौतूहलं हि नः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge aṣṭāviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ṛṣaya ūcuḥ prāpya vārāṇasīṃ divyāṃ kṛṣṇadvaipāyano muniḥ / kimakārṣonmahābuddhiḥ śrotuṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ
verses.translation: O lord of men, I shall tell you the Tugadharmas succi¬ nctly, as it is not possible to explain them in detail by me.
verses.hindi: त्रिष्टपू-ये (सात) छन्द सूर्यके (सात) अश्व कहे गये हैं। मानसाचलपर पूर्व दिशामें महेन्द्रकी महापुरी है। दक्षिणमें यमकी, पश्चिममें वरुणकी, उत्तरमें सोमकी नगरी है, उनके (भी)नाम सुनो-अमरावती, संयमनी, सुखा तथा विभा--ये क्रमसे इन्द्रादिकी महापुरियाँ हैं। दक्षिण दिशामें स्थित देवोंके भी देव प्रजापति (सूर्य) ज्योतिश्चक्रको ग्रहणकर प्रक्षिप्त बाणके समान भ्रमण करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: O lord of men, I shall tell you the Tugadharmas succi¬ nctly, as it is not possible to explain them in detail by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord of men, I shall tell you the Tugadharmas succi¬ nctly, as it is not possible to explain them in detail by me.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच प्राप्य वाराणसी दिव्यामुपस्पृश्य महामुनिः । पूजयामास जाह्नव्यां देवं विश्वेश्वरं शिवम्
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca prāpya vārāṇasī divyāmupaspṛśya mahāmuniḥ / pūjayāmāsa jāhnavyāṃ devaṃ viśveśvaraṃ śivam
verses.translation: O Partha, the first Yuga is said to be Krta by scholars, then comes Treta-, the third Yuga is Dvapara and Kali is the fourth.
verses.hindi: १-ईषादण्डयह रथका अवयव-विशेष है। यह अवयव-विशेष उन दो लम्बे दण्डोंको समझना चाहिए जो रथके आगे होते हैं। इन्हींके मध्य एक या अपेक्षानुसार एकसे अधिक अश्व जोड़े जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: O Partha, the first Yuga is said to be Krta by scholars, then comes Treta-, the third Yuga is Dvapara and Kali is the fourth.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Partha, the first Yuga is said to be Krta by scholars, then comes Treta-, the third Yuga is Dvapara and Kali is the fourth.

verses.sanskrit: तमागतं पुनिं दृष्ट्वा तत्र ये निवसन्ति वै । पूजयाञ्चक्रिरे व्यासं मुनयो मुनिपुङ्गवम्
verses.transliteration: tamāgataṃ puniṃ dṛṣṭvā tatra ye nivasanti vai / pūjayāñcakrire vyāsaṃ munayo munipuṅgavam
verses.translation: It is said that meditation and penance are enjoined (as the important dharma) in the Krta Age, attainment of perfect knowledge in the Treta Age, performance of sacrifices in the Dvapara Age and charitable gifts in the Kali Age.
verses.hindi: २-नाभि-रथके चक्रके बीचका भाग, जिसमें चारों ओरसे काष्ठ जुड़े रहते हैं। ३-नाभिके चारों ओर जो काष्ठ जुड़े रहते हैं, वे ही 'अर' या ' आर' कहे जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: It is said that meditation and penance are enjoined (as the important dharma) in the Krta Age, attainment of perfect knowledge in the Treta Age, performance of sacrifices in the Dvapara Age and charitable gifts in the Kali Age.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is said that meditation and penance are enjoined (as the important dharma) in the Krta Age, attainment of perfect knowledge in the Treta Age, performance of sacrifices in the Dvapara Age and charitable gifts in the Kali Age.

verses.sanskrit: पप्रच्छुः प्रणताः सर्वे कथाः पापविनाशनीः । महादेवाश्रयाः पुण्या मोक्षधर्मान् सनातनान्
verses.transliteration: papracchuḥ praṇatāḥ sarve kathāḥ pāpavināśanīḥ / mahādevāśrayāḥ puṇyā mokṣadharmān sanātanān
verses.translation: Brahma is the deity in the Krta Yuga, in Treta, it is lord Ravi (sun), the deity in Dvapara is Visnu and Mahesvara is the lord in Kali Age.
verses.hindi: ४-नेमि-रथके चक्रके ऊपरवाली लोहेकी परिधि (हाल) ।
verses.wordMeaning: Brahma is the deity in the Krta Yuga, in Treta, it is lord Ravi (sun), the deity in Dvapara is Visnu and Mahesvara is the lord in Kali Age.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahma is the deity in the Krta Yuga, in Treta, it is lord Ravi (sun), the deity in Dvapara is Visnu and Mahesvara is the lord in Kali Age.

verses.sanskrit: स चापि कथयामास सर्वज्ञो भगवानृषिः । माहात्म्यं देवदेवस्य धर्मान् वेदनिदर्शितान्
verses.transliteration: sa cāpi kathayāmāsa sarvajño bhagavānṛṣiḥ / māhātmyaṃ devadevasya dharmān vedanidarśitān
verses.translation: Brahma, Visnu and the sun-god, all these are wor¬ shipped in the Kali Age too. But the Pinaka-bearing lord Rudra is worshipped in all the four Yugas.
verses.hindi: दिवसस्य रविर्मध्ये सर्वकालं व्यवस्थित: । सप्तद्वीपेषु विप्रेन्द्रा निशामध्यस्य सम्मुखम् उदयास्तमने चैव सर्वकालं तु सम्मुखे। अशेषासु दिशास्वेव तथैव विदिशासु च
verses.wordMeaning: Brahma, Visnu and the sun-god, all these are wor¬ shipped in the Kali Age too. But the Pinaka-bearing lord Rudra is worshipped in all the four Yugas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahma, Visnu and the sun-god, all these are wor¬ shipped in the Kali Age too. But the Pinaka-bearing lord Rudra is worshipped in all the four Yugas.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां मध्ये मुनीन्द्राणां व्यासशिष्यो महामुनिः । पृष्टवान् जैमिनिर्व्यासं गूढमर्थं सनातनम्
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ madhye munīndrāṇāṃ vyāsaśiṣyo mahāmuniḥ / pṛṣṭavān jaiminirvyāsaṃ gūḍhamarthaṃ sanātanam
verses.translation: In the first Krtayuga, Dharma is glorified as having full four feet. In Treta it becomes three-footed while it is two-footed in Dvapara.
verses.hindi: करोत्यहस्तथा रात्रिं विमुञ्चन् मेदिनीं द्विजाः
verses.wordMeaning: In the first Krtayuga, Dharma is glorified as having full four feet. In Treta it becomes three-footed while it is two-footed in Dvapara.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the first Krtayuga, Dharma is glorified as having full four feet. In Treta it becomes three-footed while it is two-footed in Dvapara.

verses.sanskrit: जैमिनिरुवाच भगवन् संशयं त्वेकं छेत्तुमर्हसि तत्त्वतः । न विद्यते ह्यविदितं भवता परमर्षिणा
verses.transliteration: jaiminiruvāca bhagavan saṃśayaṃ tvekaṃ chettumarhasi tattvataḥ / na vidyate hyaviditaṃ bhavatā paramarṣiṇā
verses.translation: O scorcher of enemies, the people stayed on moun¬ tains and in the ocean (or on the seashore). They had no fixed abode. O Brahmanas, in due course of time, in the Yuga called Treta, their taste and pleasure disappeared.
verses.hindi: दिवाकरकरैरेतत् पूरितं भुवनत्रयम्। त्रैलोक्यं कथितं सद्धिर्लोकानां मुनिपुंगवाः आदित्यमूलमखिलं त्रिलोकं नात्र संशयः। भवत्यस्मात् जगत् कृत्स्नं सदेवासुरमानुषम् ४१ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: O scorcher of enemies, the people stayed on moun¬ tains and in the ocean (or on the seashore). They had no fixed abode. O Brahmanas, in due course of time, in the Yuga called Treta, their taste and pleasure disappeared.
verses.commentary: Sense: O scorcher of enemies, the people stayed on moun¬ tains and in the ocean (or on the seashore). They had no fixed abode. O Brahmanas, in due course of time, in the Yuga called Treta, their taste and pleasure disappeared.

verses.sanskrit: केचिद् ध्यानं प्रशंसन्ति धर्ममेवापरे जनाः । अन्ये सांख्यं तथा योगं तपस्त्वन्ये महर्षयः
verses.transliteration: kecid dhyānaṃ praśaṃsanti dharmamevāpare janāḥ / anye sāṃkhyaṃ tathā yogaṃ tapastvanye maharṣayaḥ
verses.translation: All of them were delighted and contented and free from ailments, thanks to that Siddhi. Again after the lapse of some more time, they were overcome by their greed.
verses.hindi: सर्वात्मा सर्वलोकेशो महादेवः प्रजापतिः । सूर्य एव त्रिलोकस्य मूलं परमहैवतम्
verses.wordMeaning: All of them were delighted and contented and free from ailments, thanks to that Siddhi. Again after the lapse of some more time, they were overcome by their greed.
verses.commentary: Sense: All of them were delighted and contented and free from ailments, thanks to that Siddhi. Again after the lapse of some more time, they were overcome by their greed.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मचर्यमथो मौनमन्ये प्राहर्महर्षयः । अहिंसां सत्यमप्यन्ये संन्यासमपरे विदुः
verses.transliteration: brahmacaryamatho maunamanye prāharmaharṣayaḥ / ahiṃsāṃ satyamapyanye saṃnyāsamapare viduḥ
verses.translation: Being afflicted by mutually opposite types of climates, they made coverings (shelters) and clothes. After devising means that counteracted the contradictory climatic changes, they began to think of agriculture and trade.
verses.hindi: द्वादशान्ये तथादित्या देवास्ते येऽधिकारिणः। निर्वहन्ति पदं तस्य तदंशा विष्णुमूर्तयः यजन्ति यसेर्विविधैद्विजेन्द्रा- श्छन्दोमयं ब्रह्ममयं पुराणम्
verses.wordMeaning: Being afflicted by mutually opposite types of climates, they made coverings (shelters) and clothes. After devising means that counteracted the contradictory climatic changes, they began to think of agriculture and trade.
verses.commentary: Sense: Being afflicted by mutually opposite types of climates, they made coverings (shelters) and clothes. After devising means that counteracted the contradictory climatic changes, they began to think of agriculture and trade.

verses.sanskrit: केचिद् दयां प्रशंसन्ति दानमध्ययनं तथा । तीर्थयात्रां तथा केचिदन्ये चेन्द्रियनिग्रहम्
verses.transliteration: kecid dayāṃ praśaṃsanti dānamadhyayanaṃ tathā / tīrthayātrāṃ tathā kecidanye cendriyanigraham
verses.translation: When the Kalpa trees were lost alongwith honey in the Treta Yuga, further Siddhis appeared before them.
verses.hindi: विप्रेन्द्रो ! सात द्वीपोंमें दिनके मध्य एवं रात्रिके अर्धभागमें सूर्य सदा सम्मुख रहता है, उदय और अस्तके समय भी सदा सम्मुख रहता है। ये ईश्वर (सूर्य) कुम्हारके चक्रके समान सभी दिशाओं तथा
verses.wordMeaning: When the Kalpa trees were lost alongwith honey in the Treta Yuga, further Siddhis appeared before them.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the Kalpa trees were lost alongwith honey in the Treta Yuga, further Siddhis appeared before them.

verses.sanskrit: किमेतेषां भवेज्ज्यायः प्रब्रूहि मुनिपुङ्गव । यदि वा विद्यते ऽप्यन्यद् गुह्यं तद्वक्तुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration: kimeteṣāṃ bhavejjyāyaḥ prabrūhi munipuṅgava / yadi vā vidyate 'pyanyad guhyaṃ tadvaktumarhasi
verses.translation: Due to the inevitability of the course of events and as it was the effect of Treta Yuga, people forcibly occupied the river banks and fields as well as mountains.
verses.hindi: विदिशाओंमें भ्रमण करते हैं। है द्विजो! पृथ्वीका त्याग करते हुए ये दिन और रात्रिका निर्माण करते हैं। ये तीनों भुवन सूर्यकी किरणोंसे व्याप्त हैं। है मुनिश्रेष्ठो! विद्वानोंने (समस्त) लोकोंको त्रैलोक्यके नामसे कहा सम्पूर्ण त्रिलोकीके मूल सूर्य ही हैं, इसमें संशय नहीं । देवता, असुर तथा मनुष्योंसे युक्त सम्पूर्ण जगत् इन्हींसे उत्पन्न होता है । रुद्र, इन्द्र, उपेन्द्र, चन्द्रमा एवं श्रेष्ठ विप्रो तथा समस्त देवताओंका जो तेज है,
verses.wordMeaning: Due to the inevitability of the course of events and as it was the effect of Treta Yuga, people forcibly occupied the river banks and fields as well as mountains.
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to the inevitability of the course of events and as it was the effect of Treta Yuga, people forcibly occupied the river banks and fields as well as mountains.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा स जैमिनेर्वाक्यं कृष्णद्वैपायनो मुनिः । प्राह गम्भीरया वाचा प्रणम्य वृषकेतनम्
verses.transliteration: śrutvā sa jaiminervākyaṃ kṛṣṇadvaipāyano muniḥ / prāha gambhīrayā vācā praṇamya vṛṣaketanam
verses.translation: They seized trees, hedges and medicinal herbs forcibly. Due to this misdemeanour and aberration of theirs, the medicinal herbs entered Earth.
verses.hindi: द्युतिमानोंका जो प्रकाश है और समस्त लोकोंका जो सम्पूर्ण तेज है, (वह सूर्यका ही तेज है) । सूर्य ही सभी लोकोंके स्वामी, सर्वात्मा, प्रजापति, महान् देव, तीनों लोकोंके मूल और परम देवता हैं। इसी प्रकार
verses.wordMeaning: They seized trees, hedges and medicinal herbs forcibly. Due to this misdemeanour and aberration of theirs, the medicinal herbs entered Earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: They seized trees, hedges and medicinal herbs forcibly. Due to this misdemeanour and aberration of theirs, the medicinal herbs entered Earth.

verses.sanskrit: साधु साधु महाभाग यत्पृष्टं भवता मुने । वक्ष्ये गुह्यतमाद् गुह्यं श्रुण्वन्त्वन्ये महर्षयः
verses.transliteration: sādhu sādhu mahābhāga yatpṛṣṭaṃ bhavatā mune / vakṣye guhyatamād guhyaṃ śruṇvantvanye maharṣayaḥ
verses.translation: Later, king Prthu milked these out of Earth at the behest of Pitamaha, god Brahma, grabbed them all in their senseless fury against each other.
verses.hindi: अधिकारी-रूपमें जो अन्य बारह आदित्य देवता हैं, वे उन्हीं सूर्यके अंश हैं और विष्णुके मूर्तिरूप हैं। वे उन्हींके पद (कार्य)-को सम्पन्न करते हँ ॥ ४१--४४॥ गन्धर्व, देवता, नाग तथा किन्नर आदि सभी हजारों किरणोंवाले सूर्यको नमस्कार करते हैं। श्रेष्ठ द्विज विविध यज्ञोके द्वारा छन्दोमय एवं ब्रह्मस्वरूप पुरातन सूर्यदेवका यजन करते हें
verses.wordMeaning: Later, king Prthu milked these out of Earth at the behest of Pitamaha, god Brahma, grabbed them all in their senseless fury against each other.
verses.commentary: Sense: Later, king Prthu milked these out of Earth at the behest of Pitamaha, god Brahma, grabbed them all in their senseless fury against each other.

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वरेण पुरा प्रोक्तं ज्ञानमेतत् सनातनम् । गूढमप्राज्ञविद्विष्टं सेवितं सूक्ष्मदर्शिभिः
verses.transliteration: īśvareṇa purā proktaṃ jñānametat sanātanam / gūḍhamaprājñavidviṣṭaṃ sevitaṃ sūkṣmadarśibhiḥ
verses.translation: In the beginning of all Dvapara Yugas, they (i.e. the Vedas )are divided into four by Vedavyasas. (They are many because they are different in the different sets of four Yugas). The Vedas differ due to the difference (or delusion) in the visions among the sons of sages or altered visions.
verses.hindi: सूर्य-रथ तथा द्वादश आदित्योंके नाम, सूर्य-रथके अधिष्ठातृ देवता आदिका वर्णन, सूर्यकी महिमा
