verses.wordMeaning: In the beginning of all Dvapara Yugas, they (i.e. the Vedas )are divided into four by Vedavyasas. (They are many because they are different in the different sets of four Yugas).…
verses.commentary: Sense: In the beginning of all Dvapara Yugas, they (i.e. the Vedas )are divided into four by Vedavyasas. (They are many because they are different in the different sets of four Yugas).…

verses.sanskrit: नाश्रद्दधाने दातव्यं नाभक्ते परमेष्ठिनः । न वेदविद्विषु शुभं ज्ञाननानां ज्ञानमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: nāśraddadhāne dātavyaṃ nābhakte parameṣṭhinaḥ / na vedavidviṣu śubhaṃ jñānanānāṃ jñānamuttamam
verses.translation: The Saihhitas of RK, Yajus and Saman are being recited by the great sages by introducing Mantras and Brahmanas with due changes in accents and syllables.
verses.hindi: स रथोऽधिष्ठितो देवैरादित्यैर्वसुभिस्तथा। गन्धर्वेरप्सरोभिश्च ग्रामणीसर्पराक्षसेः भगस्त्वष्टा च विष्णुश्च द्वादशैते दिवाकराः । आप्याययन्ति वै भानुं वसन्तादिषु वै क्रमात्
verses.wordMeaning: The Saihhitas of RK, Yajus and Saman are being recited by the great sages by introducing Mantras and Brahmanas with due changes in accents and syllables.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Saihhitas of RK, Yajus and Saman are being recited by the great sages by introducing Mantras and Brahmanas with due changes in accents and syllables.

verses.sanskrit: मेरुशृङ्गे पुरा देवमीशानं त्रिपुरद्विषम् । देवासनगता देवी महादेवमपृच्छत
verses.transliteration: meruśṛṅge purā devamīśānaṃ tripuradviṣam / devāsanagatā devī mahādevamapṛcchata
verses.translation: After reflection and investigation they become free from attachment. Then, they begin to see defects. It is due to realisation of defects that knowledge becomes possible in Dvapara.
verses.hindi: जमदग्निः कौशिकश्च मुनयो ब्रह्मवादिनः । स्तुवन्ति देवं विविधेश्छन्दोभिस्ते यथाक्रमम्
verses.wordMeaning: After reflection and investigation they become free from attachment. Then, they begin to see defects. It is due to realisation of defects that knowledge becomes possible in Dvapara.
verses.commentary: Sense: After reflection and investigation they become free from attachment. Then, they begin to see defects. It is due to realisation of defects that knowledge becomes possible in Dvapara.

verses.sanskrit: देव्युवाच देवदेव महादेव भक्तानामार्तिनाशन । कथं त्वां पुरुषो देवमचिरादेव पश्यति
verses.transliteration: devyuvāca devadeva mahādeva bhaktānāmārtināśana / kathaṃ tvāṃ puruṣo devamacirādeva paśyati
verses.translation: O Brahmanas, the behaviour in Dvapara is due to mixture of Rajas and Tamos. The Dharma that prevailed in the first (i.e. Krta) Yuga continued in Treta Age.
verses.hindi: रथस्वनोऽथ वरुणः सुषेणः सेनजित् तथा ग्रामण्यो देवदेवस्य कुर्वतेऽभीशुसंग्रहम्
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas, the behaviour in Dvapara is due to mixture of Rajas and Tamos. The Dharma that prevailed in the first (i.e. Krta) Yuga continued in Treta Age.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas, the behaviour in Dvapara is due to mixture of Rajas and Tamos. The Dharma that prevailed in the first (i.e. Krta) Yuga continued in Treta Age.

verses.sanskrit: सांख्ययोगस्तथा ध्यानं कर्मयोगो ऽथ वैदिकः । आयासबहुला लोके यानि चान्यानि शङ्कर
verses.transliteration: sāṃkhyayogastathā dhyānaṃ karmayogo 'tha vaidikaḥ / āyāsabahulā loke yāni cānyāni śaṅkara
verses.translation: It becomes agitated in Dvapara Yuga and it is destroyed in Kali Age.
verses.hindi: सर्पो व्याघ्रस्तथापश्च वातो विद्युद् दिवाकरः
verses.wordMeaning: It becomes agitated in Dvapara Yuga and it is destroyed in Kali Age.
verses.commentary: Sense: It becomes agitated in Dvapara Yuga and it is destroyed in Kali Age.

verses.sanskrit: येन विब्रान्तचित्तानां योगिनां कर्मिणामपि । दृश्यो हि भगवान् सूक्ष्मः सर्वेषामथ देहिनाम्
verses.transliteration: yena vibrāntacittānāṃ yogināṃ karmiṇāmapi / dṛśyo hi bhagavān sūkṣmaḥ sarveṣāmatha dehinām
verses.translation: VV. 54-55 constitute an explanatory paraphrase of dhata yathapirvam akalpayat /
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मोपेतश्च विप्रेन्द्रा यज्ञोपेतस्तथैव च। राक्षसप्रवरा होते प्रयान्ति पुरतः क्रमात् धनंजयो महापद्मस्तथा कर्कोटको द्विजाः । कम्बलाश्वतरश्चेैव वहन्त्येनं यथाक्रमम्
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 54-55 constitute an explanatory paraphrase of dhata yathapirvam akalpayat /
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 54-55 constitute an explanatory paraphrase of dhata yathapirvam akalpayat /

verses.sanskrit: एतद् गुह्यतमं ज्ञानं गूढं ब्रह्मादिसेवितम । हिताय सर्वभक्तानां ब्रूहि कामाङ्गनाशन
verses.transliteration: etad guhyatamaṃ jñānaṃ gūḍhaṃ brahmādisevitama / hitāya sarvabhaktānāṃ brūhi kāmāṅganāśana
verses.translation: Epidemics of fatal disease, perpetual fear of hunger and starvation, fear of droughts and destruction of countries prevail in Kali Age.
verses.hindi: उग्रसेनो वसुरुचिरर्वावसुरथापरः
verses.wordMeaning: Epidemics of fatal disease, perpetual fear of hunger and starvation, fear of droughts and destruction of countries prevail in Kali Age.
verses.commentary: Sense: Epidemics of fatal disease, perpetual fear of hunger and starvation, fear of droughts and destruction of countries prevail in Kali Age.

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वर उवाच अवाच्यमेतद् विज्ञानं ज्ञानमज्ञैर्बहिष्कृतम् । वक्ष्ये तव यथा तत्त्वं यदुक्तं परमर्षिभिः
verses.transliteration: īśvara uvāca avācyametad vijñānaṃ jñānamajñairbahiṣkṛtam / vakṣye tava yathā tattvaṃ yaduktaṃ paramarṣibhiḥ
verses.translation: Utterly bad subjects born in Kali Yuga are im¬ pious, deficient in food and highly furious but lacking in brilli¬ ance, liars and greedy.
verses.hindi: चित्रसेनस्तथोर्णायुर्धतराष्ट्रो द्विजोत्तमाः। मेनका सहजन्या च प्रम्लोचा च द्विजोत्तमा;
verses.wordMeaning: Utterly bad subjects born in Kali Yuga are im¬ pious, deficient in food and highly furious but lacking in brilli¬ ance, liars and greedy.
verses.commentary: Sense: Utterly bad subjects born in Kali Yuga are im¬ pious, deficient in food and highly furious but lacking in brilli¬ ance, liars and greedy.

verses.sanskrit: परं गुह्यतमं क्षेत्रं मम वाराणसी पुरी । सर्वेषामेव भूतानां संसारार्णवतारिणी
verses.transliteration: paraṃ guhyatamaṃ kṣetraṃ mama vārāṇasī purī / sarveṣāmeva bhūtānāṃ saṃsārārṇavatāriṇī
verses.translation: The fear of subjects is heightened due to ill per¬ formance of Yajnas, faulty study of the Vedas, evil conducts and misleading heretical scriptures and defects in the rites of Brahmanas.
verses.hindi: सूतजीने कहा--वे (सूर्यदेव) (सभी) देवों,
verses.wordMeaning: The fear of subjects is heightened due to ill per¬ formance of Yajnas, faulty study of the Vedas, evil conducts and misleading heretical scriptures and defects in the rites of Brahmanas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The fear of subjects is heightened due to ill per¬ formance of Yajnas, faulty study of the Vedas, evil conducts and misleading heretical scriptures and defects in the rites of Brahmanas.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र भक्ता महादेवि मदीयं व्रतमास्थिताः । निवसन्ति महात्मानः परं नियममास्थिताः
verses.transliteration: tatra bhaktā mahādevi madīyaṃ vratamāsthitāḥ / nivasanti mahātmānaḥ paraṃ niyamamāsthitāḥ
verses.translation: In this age, twice-born persons do not study the Vedas or perform sacrifices (or worship). People of low intellec¬ tual capacity will perform sacrifices and study the Vedas.
verses.hindi: रहते हें । धाता, अर्यमा, मित्र, वरुण, इन्द्र, विवस्वान्, पूषा, पर्जन्य, अंशु, भग, त्वष्टा तथा विष्णु-ये बारह आदित्य हैं। ये क्रमशः वसन्त आदि ऋतुओंमें भानुको आप्यायित करते हैं। पुलस्त्य, पुलह, अत्रि, वसिष्ठ, तथा कौशिक--ये ब्रह्मवादी मुनि अनेक प्रकारके छन्दों (वैदिक मन्त्रों)-के द्वारा क्रमशः सूर्यदेवकी स्तुति करते हैं ॥ १--५॥
verses.wordMeaning: In this age, twice-born persons do not study the Vedas or perform sacrifices (or worship). People of low intellec¬ tual capacity will perform sacrifices and study the Vedas.
verses.commentary: Sense: In this age, twice-born persons do not study the Vedas or perform sacrifices (or worship). People of low intellec¬ tual capacity will perform sacrifices and study the Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तमं सर्वतीर्थानां स्थानानामुत्तमं च तत् । ज्ञानानामुत्तमं ज्ञानमविमुक्तं परं मम
verses.transliteration: uttamaṃ sarvatīrthānāṃ sthānānāmuttamaṃ ca tat / jñānānāmuttamaṃ jñānamavimuktaṃ paraṃ mama
verses.translation: In Kaliyuga, the Sudras will have close association with the Brahmanas by the use of spells and incantations as well as through the sharing of beds, seats and food.
verses.hindi: सुषेण, सेनजित्, ताक्ष्य, अरिष्टनेमि, रथजित् और सत्यजित्-ये (बारह) ग्रामणी देवोंके देव सूर्यकी रश्मियोंका संग्रह करते हैं। है विप्रेन्द्रो! हेति, प्रहेति, पौरुषेय, वध, सर्प, व्याघ्र, आप, वात, विद्युत्, दिवाकर,
verses.wordMeaning: In Kaliyuga, the Sudras will have close association with the Brahmanas by the use of spells and incantations as well as through the sharing of beds, seats and food.
verses.commentary: Sense: In Kaliyuga, the Sudras will have close association with the Brahmanas by the use of spells and incantations as well as through the sharing of beds, seats and food.

verses.sanskrit: स्थानान्तरं पवित्राणि तीर्थान्यायतनानि च । श्मशानसंस्थितान्येव दिव्यभूमिगतानि च
verses.transliteration: sthānāntaraṃ pavitrāṇi tīrthānyāyatanāni ca / śmaśānasaṃsthitānyeva divyabhūmigatāni ca
verses.translation: The kings who will be mostly Sudras will harass the Brahmanas. Killing of the foetus and heroes will be of common practice among kings.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मोपेत और यज्ञोपेत-ये (बारह) श्रेष्ठ राक्षस क्रमसे सूर्यके आगे-आगे चलते हैं। है द्विजो! वासुकि, ऐरावत, धनंजय, महापद्म, कर्कोटक, कम्बल तथा अश्वतर-ये (बारह) नाग क्रमशः इन सूर्यदेवको वहन करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: The kings who will be mostly Sudras will harass the Brahmanas. Killing of the foetus and heroes will be of common practice among kings.
verses.commentary: Sense: The kings who will be mostly Sudras will harass the Brahmanas. Killing of the foetus and heroes will be of common practice among kings.

verses.sanskrit: भूर्लोके नैव संलग्नमन्तरिक्षे ममालयम् । अयुक्तास्तन्न पश्यन्ति युक्ताः पश्यन्ति चेतसा
verses.transliteration: bhūrloke naiva saṃlagnamantarikṣe mamālayam / ayuktāstanna paśyanti yuktāḥ paśyanti cetasā
verses.translation: The twice-born people will not perform ablutions. Harms, Japas, offer of charitable gifts, worship of deities and other holy rites.
verses.hindi: उग्रसेन, वसुरुचि, अर्वावसु, चित्रसेन, उर्णायु,
verses.wordMeaning: The twice-born people will not perform ablutions. Harms, Japas, offer of charitable gifts, worship of deities and other holy rites.
verses.commentary: Sense: The twice-born people will not perform ablutions. Harms, Japas, offer of charitable gifts, worship of deities and other holy rites.

verses.sanskrit: श्मसानमेतद् विख्यातमविमुक्तमिति श्रुतम् । कालो भूत्वा जगदिदं संहराम्यत्र सुन्दरि
verses.transliteration: śmasānametad vikhyātamavimuktamiti śrutam / kālo bhūtvā jagadidaṃ saṃharāmyatra sundari
verses.translation: In Kali age, the people censure Mahadeva, Purusottama, Brahmanas, Vedas, Dharmasastras and Puranas.
verses.hindi: करनेवाले गन्धर्व क्रमशः षड्ज आदि स्वरोंके द्वारा विविध प्रकारके गीतोंसे सूर्यके समीप गान करते रहते हैं। है द्विजोत्तमो! अप्सराओंमें श्रेष्ठ अप्सरा क्रतुस्थला, पुञ्जिक-स्थला, मेनका, सहजन्या, प्रम्लोचा,
verses.wordMeaning: In Kali age, the people censure Mahadeva, Purusottama, Brahmanas, Vedas, Dharmasastras and Puranas.
verses.commentary: Sense: In Kali age, the people censure Mahadeva, Purusottama, Brahmanas, Vedas, Dharmasastras and Puranas.

verses.sanskrit: देवीदं सर्वगुह्यानां स्थानं प्रियतमं मम । मद्भक्तास्तत्र गच्छन्ति मामेव प्रविशन्ति ते
verses.transliteration: devīdaṃ sarvaguhyānāṃ sthānaṃ priyatamaṃ mama / madbhaktāstatra gacchanti māmeva praviśanti te
verses.translation: People perform various rites not found in the Vedas. The Bralunanas would not have any interest in their prescribed pious rites and duties.
verses.hindi: तोषयन्ति महादेवं भानुमात्मानमव्ययम्
verses.wordMeaning: People perform various rites not found in the Vedas. The Bralunanas would not have any interest in their prescribed pious rites and duties.
verses.commentary: Sense: People perform various rites not found in the Vedas. The Bralunanas would not have any interest in their prescribed pious rites and duties.

verses.sanskrit: दत्तं जप्तं हुतं चेष्टं तपस्तप्तं कृतं च यत् । ध्यानमध्ययनं ज्ञानं सर्वं तत्राक्षयं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: dattaṃ japtaṃ hutaṃ ceṣṭaṃ tapastaptaṃ kṛtaṃ ca yat / dhyānamadhyayanaṃ jñānaṃ sarvaṃ tatrākṣayaṃ bhavet
verses.translation: People will have evil activities and conduct of life. They will be surrounded by useless dissembling heretics. They will be begging one another on many occasions.
verses.hindi: एवं देवा वसन्त्यर्के द्वौ द्वौ मासौ क्रमेण तु। सूर्यमाप्याययन्त्येते तेजसा तेजसां निधिम् सर्पा वहन्ति देवेशं यातुधानाः प्रयान्ति च
verses.wordMeaning: People will have evil activities and conduct of life. They will be surrounded by useless dissembling heretics. They will be begging one another on many occasions.
verses.commentary: Sense: People will have evil activities and conduct of life. They will be surrounded by useless dissembling heretics. They will be begging one another on many occasions.

verses.sanskrit: जन्मान्तरसहस्त्रेषु यत्पापं पूर्वसंचितम् । अविमुक्तं प्रविष्टस्य तत्सर्वं व्रजति क्षयम्
verses.transliteration: janmāntarasahastreṣu yatpāpaṃ pūrvasaṃcitam / avimuktaṃ praviṣṭasya tatsarvaṃ vrajati kṣayam
verses.translation: In Kali age, common people will begin to sell cooked food. The Vedas will be sold on the cross-roads, and youthful maidens will sell their bodies.
verses.hindi: भूतानामशुभं कर्म व्यपोहन्तीह कीर्तिताः
verses.wordMeaning: In Kali age, common people will begin to sell cooked food. The Vedas will be sold on the cross-roads, and youthful maidens will sell their bodies.
verses.commentary: Sense: In Kali age, common people will begin to sell cooked food. The Vedas will be sold on the cross-roads, and youthful maidens will sell their bodies.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रिया वैश्याः शूद्रा ये वर्णसंकराः । स्त्रियो म्लेच्छाश्च ये चान्ये संकीर्णाः पापयोनयः
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrā ye varṇasaṃkarāḥ / striyo mlecchāśca ye cānye saṃkīrṇāḥ pāpayonayaḥ
verses.translation: When the close of Yuga is imminent, Sudras calling themselves Jims (subduers of sense organs) will perform holy rites by shaving off their heads, wearing ochre robes and black-antelope skins and keeping their teeth white.
verses.hindi: एते सहैव सूर्येण भ्रमन्ति दिवि सानुगाः। विमाने च स्थिता नित्यं कामगे वातरंहसि एतेषामेव देवानां यथावीर्यं यथातपः । यथायोगं यथासत्त्वं स एष तपति प्रभुः
verses.wordMeaning: When the close of Yuga is imminent, Sudras calling themselves Jims (subduers of sense organs) will perform holy rites by shaving off their heads, wearing ochre robes and black-antelope skins and keeping their teeth white.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the close of Yuga is imminent, Sudras calling themselves Jims (subduers of sense organs) will perform holy rites by shaving off their heads, wearing ochre robes and black-antelope skins and keeping their teeth white.

verses.sanskrit: कोटाः पिपीलिकाश्चैव ये चान्ये मृगपक्षिणः । कालेन निधनं प्राप्ता अविमुक्ते वरानने
verses.transliteration: koṭāḥ pipīlikāścaiva ye cānye mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ / kālena nidhanaṃ prāptā avimukte varānane
verses.translation: People will be plunderers of crops of others and- deprivers of (other people's) clothes. Thieves will be robbers
verses.hindi: अहोरात्रव्यवस्थानकारणं स प्रजापतिः। पितृदेवमनुष्यादीन् स सदाप्याययेद् रविः
verses.wordMeaning: People will be plunderers of crops of others and- deprivers of (other people's) clothes. Thieves will be robbers
verses.commentary: Sense: People will be plunderers of crops of others and- deprivers of (other people's) clothes. Thieves will be robbers

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्रार्धमौलयस्त्र्यक्षा महावृषभवाहनाः । शिवे मम पुरे देवि जायन्ते तत्र मानवाः
verses.transliteration: candrārdhamaulayastryakṣā mahāvṛṣabhavāhanāḥ / śive mama pure devi jāyante tatra mānavāḥ
verses.translation: It is stated in Smrtis that in the Kali age there will be prevalence of extreme misery, shortness of life-span, •exhaustion of physical bodies, spread of sickness, sinful activi¬ ties arising from attachment to Adharma.
verses.hindi: तत्र देवो महादेवो भास्वान् साक्षान्महेश्वरः । भासते वेदविदुषां नीलग्रीवः सनातनः स एष देवो भगवान् परमेष्ठी प्रजापतिः । स्थानं तद् विदुरादित्यं वेदज्ञा वेदविग्रहम्
verses.wordMeaning: It is stated in Smrtis that in the Kali age there will be prevalence of extreme misery, shortness of life-span, •exhaustion of physical bodies, spread of sickness, sinful activi¬ ties arising from attachment to Adharma.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is stated in Smrtis that in the Kali age there will be prevalence of extreme misery, shortness of life-span, •exhaustion of physical bodies, spread of sickness, sinful activi¬ ties arising from attachment to Adharma.

verses.sanskrit: नाविमुक्ते मृतः कश्चिन्नरकं याति किल्बिषी । ईश्वरानुगृहीता हि सर्वे यान्ति परां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: nāvimukte mṛtaḥ kaścinnarakaṃ yāti kilbiṣī / īśvarānugṛhītā hi sarve yānti parāṃ gatim
verses.translation: There will be some people wearing ochre-coloured robes, some going naked (Jainas), some bearing skulls (Kapali- kas), some will sell Vedas while others will sell sacred places.
verses.hindi: आदि ऋतुओंमें विविध ताण्डव आदि (नृत्यों)-के द्वारा इन अव्यय, आत्मस्वरूप महान् देवता भानुको संतुष्ट करती हैं॥ १२--१६॥
verses.wordMeaning: There will be some people wearing ochre-coloured robes, some going naked (Jainas), some bearing skulls (Kapali- kas), some will sell Vedas while others will sell sacred places.
verses.commentary: Sense: There will be some people wearing ochre-coloured robes, some going naked (Jainas), some bearing skulls (Kapali- kas), some will sell Vedas while others will sell sacred places.

verses.sanskrit: मोक्षं सुदुर्लभं मत्वा संसारं चातिभीषणम् । अश्मना चरणौ हत्वा वाराणस्यां वसेन्नरः
verses.transliteration: mokṣaṃ sudurlabhaṃ matvā saṃsāraṃ cātibhīṣaṇam / aśmanā caraṇau hatvā vārāṇasyāṃ vasennaraḥ
verses.translation: Seeing the Brahmanas seated, people of petty intellect will make them move; Sudras depending upon kings may even strike the leading Brahmanas.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार ये देवता क्रमश: दो-दो महीनोंमे (वसन्त आदि ६ ऋतुओंमें) सूर्यमें प्रतिष्ठित रहते हुए तेजोनिधि सूर्यको अपने तेजसे आप्यायित करते हैं। मुनिगण स्वयंरचित स्तुतियोंसे सूर्यकी स्तुति करते रहते हैं और अप्सराएँ एवं गन्धर्व नृत्य तथा गीतोंके द्वारा इनकी उपासना करते हें
verses.wordMeaning: Seeing the Brahmanas seated, people of petty intellect will make them move; Sudras depending upon kings may even strike the leading Brahmanas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Seeing the Brahmanas seated, people of petty intellect will make them move; Sudras depending upon kings may even strike the leading Brahmanas.

verses.sanskrit: दुर्लभा तपसा चापि पूतस्य परमेश्वरि । यत्र तत्र विपन्नस्य गतिः संसारमोक्षणी
verses.transliteration: durlabhā tapasā cāpi pūtasya parameśvari / yatra tatra vipannasya gatiḥ saṃsāramokṣaṇī
verses.translation: O tormentor of enemies, Sudras will be occupying lofty seats in the middle of Brahmanas. In Kali age, as a result of the influence of times, the king will dishonour the Brahmins.
verses.hindi: ग्रामणी, यक्ष और भूतगण (सूर्यदेवसे) रश्मियोंका संग्रह करते हैं, सर्प देवताओंके ईश (सूर्य)-को वहन करते हैं और राक्षस (उनके आगे-आगे) चलते हैं। बालखिल्य नामक मुनिगण सूर्यको आवृतकर उदयाचलसे
verses.wordMeaning: O tormentor of enemies, Sudras will be occupying lofty seats in the middle of Brahmanas. In Kali age, as a result of the influence of times, the king will dishonour the Brahmins.
verses.commentary: Sense: O tormentor of enemies, Sudras will be occupying lofty seats in the middle of Brahmanas. In Kali age, as a result of the influence of times, the king will dishonour the Brahmins.

verses.sanskrit: प्रसादाज्जायते ह्येतन्मम शैलेन्द्रनन्दिनि । अप्रबुद्धा न पश्यन्ति मम मायाविमोहिताः
verses.transliteration: prasādājjāyate hyetanmama śailendranandini / aprabuddhā na paśyanti mama māyāvimohitāḥ
verses.translation: Brahmanas, of insufficient learning, possessing ill-luck and no great strength will begin to serve Sudras with flowers, ornaments and other auspicious articles.
verses.hindi: अस्ताचलतक ले जाते हैं । (पूर्वमें कहे गये) ये (द्वादश आदित्य) तपते, बरसते, प्रकाश करते, बहते एवं सृष्टि करते हैं। इनका कीर्तन करनेपर ये प्राणियोंके अशुभ कर्मोंको दूर करते हैं। ये नित्य कामचारी तथा वायुके समान गतिवाले विमानपर सूर्यके साथ अपने अनुचरोंसहित आकाशमें भ्रमण करते हैं। ये क्रमशः वर्षा, ताप एवं प्रजाको आनन्द प्रदान करते हुए प्रलयपर्यन्त सभी प्राणियोंकी रक्षा करते हैं। ये प्रभु
verses.wordMeaning: Brahmanas, of insufficient learning, possessing ill-luck and no great strength will begin to serve Sudras with flowers, ornaments and other auspicious articles.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahmanas, of insufficient learning, possessing ill-luck and no great strength will begin to serve Sudras with flowers, ornaments and other auspicious articles.

verses.sanskrit: अविमुक्तं न सेवन्ति मूढा ये तमसावृताः । विण्मूत्ररेतसां मध्ये ते वसन्ति पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: avimuktaṃ na sevanti mūḍhā ye tamasāvṛtāḥ / viṇmūtraretasāṃ madhye te vasanti punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: O king, Sudras will not cast a glance at the Brahmanas, worthy of respect and worship. It is the Brahmanas who would stand at their threshold awaiting an opportunity for service.
verses.hindi: सूर्य इन्हीं देवोंके वीर्य, तप, योग और सत्त्वके अनुसार (प्राणिमात्रको) ताप देते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: O king, Sudras will not cast a glance at the Brahmanas, worthy of respect and worship. It is the Brahmanas who would stand at their threshold awaiting an opportunity for service.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, Sudras will not cast a glance at the Brahmanas, worthy of respect and worship. It is the Brahmanas who would stand at their threshold awaiting an opportunity for service.

verses.sanskrit: हन्यमानो ऽपि यो विद्वान् वसेद् विघ्नशतैरपि । स याति परमं स्थानं यत्र गत्वा न शोचति
verses.transliteration: hanyamāno 'pi yo vidvān vased vighnaśatairapi / sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra gatvā na śocati
verses.translation: In Kaliyuga, the Brahmanas, dependent on the Sudras, hover round and serve the Sudras seated in their vehicles and eulogise them by songs of praise and prayer.
verses.hindi: वे प्रजापति (सूर्य) दिन और रात्रिकी व्यवस्थाके कारण हैं। ये सूर्य पितरों, देवों तथा मनुष्य आदि सभीको सदा आप्यायित करते हैं। वेदज्ञोंके (आराध्य) सनातन, नीलग्रीव, महादेव साक्षात् देव महादेव महेश्वर ही सूर्यके रूपमें प्रकाशित होते हैं। वेदज्ञ लोग आदित्य (सूर्य)-को वेदका विग्रह (शरीर ही) मानते हैं और यही वेदविग्रह आदित्य, देव भगवान् परमेष्ठ प्रजापति हैं
verses.wordMeaning: In Kaliyuga, the Brahmanas, dependent on the Sudras, hover round and serve the Sudras seated in their vehicles and eulogise them by songs of praise and prayer.
verses.commentary: Sense: In Kaliyuga, the Brahmanas, dependent on the Sudras, hover round and serve the Sudras seated in their vehicles and eulogise them by songs of praise and prayer.

verses.sanskrit: जन्ममृत्युजरामुक्तं परं याति शिवालयम् । अपुनर्मरणानां हि सा गतिर्मोक्षकाङ्क्षिणाम् । यां प्राप्य कृतकृत्यः स्यादिति मन्यन्ति पण्डताः
verses.transliteration: janmamṛtyujarāmuktaṃ paraṃ yāti śivālayam / apunarmaraṇānāṃ hi sā gatirmokṣakāṅkṣiṇām / yāṃ prāpya kṛtakṛtyaḥ syāditi manyanti paṇḍatāḥ
verses.translation: Dependent on Sudras, they teach them Vedas. Due to the calamity of appeasing those without Vedas, they resort to terrible atheism.
verses.hindi: सूर्यकी प्रधान सात रश्मियोंके नाम, इनके द्वारा ग्रहोंका आप्यायन, सूर्यकी अन्य हजारों नाडियोंका वर्णन तथा उनका कार्य, बारह महीनोंके बारह सूर्योके नाम तथा छः ऋतुओंमें उनका वर्ण, आठ ग्रहोंका वर्णन, सोमके रथका वर्णन, देवोंद्वारा चन्द्रकलाओंका पान करना, पितरोंद्वारा अमावस्याको चन्द्रमाकी
verses.wordMeaning: Dependent on Sudras, they teach them Vedas. Due to the calamity of appeasing those without Vedas, they resort to terrible atheism.
verses.commentary: Sense: Dependent on Sudras, they teach them Vedas. Due to the calamity of appeasing those without Vedas, they resort to terrible atheism.

verses.sanskrit: न दानैर्न तपोभिश्च न यज्ञैर्नापि विद्यया । प्राप्यते गतिरुत्कृष्टा याविमुक्ते तु लभ्यते
verses.transliteration: na dānairna tapobhiśca na yajñairnāpi vidyayā / prāpyate gatirutkṛṣṭā yāvimukte tu labhyate
verses.translation: Even the excellent ones among Brahmanas will sell the merit of penance, sacrifices and arts. As to Sannyasins, there will be hundreds and thousands.
verses.hindi: कलाका पान, बुध आदि ग्रहोंके रथका वर्णन एवमेष महादेवो देवदेवः पितामह: । करोति नियतं कालं कालात्मा ह्यैश्वरी तनुः
verses.wordMeaning: Even the excellent ones among Brahmanas will sell the merit of penance, sacrifices and arts. As to Sannyasins, there will be hundreds and thousands.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even the excellent ones among Brahmanas will sell the merit of penance, sacrifices and arts. As to Sannyasins, there will be hundreds and thousands.

verses.sanskrit: नानावर्णा विवर्णाश्च चण्डालाद्या जुगुप्सिताः । किल्बिषैः पूर्णदेहा ये विशिष्टैः पातकैस्तथा । भेषजं परमं तेषामविमुक्तं विदुर्बुधाः
verses.transliteration: nānāvarṇā vivarṇāśca caṇḍālādyā jugupsitāḥ / kilbiṣaiḥ pūrṇadehā ye viśiṣṭaiḥ pātakaistathā / bheṣajaṃ paramaṃ teṣāmavimuktaṃ vidurbudhāḥ
verses.translation: O ruler of men, destroying their own pious rites, they •do not attain that region. They sing about deities with worldly songs.
verses.hindi: तस्य ये रश्मयो विप्राः सर्वलोकप्रदीपकाः।
verses.wordMeaning: O ruler of men, destroying their own pious rites, they •do not attain that region. They sing about deities with worldly songs.
verses.commentary: Sense: O ruler of men, destroying their own pious rites, they •do not attain that region. They sing about deities with worldly songs.

verses.sanskrit: अविमुक्तं परं ज्ञानमविमुक्तं परं पदम् । अविमुक्तं परं तत्त्वमविमुक्तं परं शिवम्
verses.transliteration: avimuktaṃ paraṃ jñānamavimuktaṃ paraṃ padam / avimuktaṃ paraṃ tattvamavimuktaṃ paraṃ śivam
verses.translation: In Kali age, there will be Brahmanas as well as
verses.hindi: सुषुम्नो हरिकेशश्च विश्वकर्मा तथैव च। अर्वावसुरिति ख्यातः स्वराडन्यः प्रकीर्तितः ।
verses.wordMeaning: In Kali age, there will be Brahmanas as well as
verses.commentary: Sense: In Kali age, there will be Brahmanas as well as

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा वै नैष्ठिकीं दीक्षामविमुक्ते वसन्ति ये । तेषां तत्परमं ज्ञानं ददाम्यन्ते परं पदम्
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā vai naiṣṭhikīṃ dīkṣāmavimukte vasanti ye / teṣāṃ tatparamaṃ jñānaṃ dadāmyante paraṃ padam
verses.translation: When perfect knowledge and the holy rites are lost, when the whole world has become inactive, insects, mice, and serpents will harass human beings.
verses.hindi: हरिकेशस्तु यः प्रोक्तो रश्मिर्नक्षत्रपोषकः
verses.wordMeaning: When perfect knowledge and the holy rites are lost, when the whole world has become inactive, insects, mice, and serpents will harass human beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: When perfect knowledge and the holy rites are lost, when the whole world has become inactive, insects, mice, and serpents will harass human beings.

verses.sanskrit: प्रायागं नैमिषं पुण्यं श्रीशैलो ऽथ महालयः । केदारं भद्रकर्णं च गया पुष्करमेव च
verses.transliteration: prāyāgaṃ naimiṣaṃ puṇyaṃ śrīśailo 'tha mahālayaḥ / kedāraṃ bhadrakarṇaṃ ca gayā puṣkarameva ca
verses.translation: Those Brahmanas who had been burnt completely in the fire of the curse of goddess Sati formerly during Daksa's sacrifice, will be reborn in the families of Brahmanas.
verses.hindi: विश्वकर्मा तथा रश्मिर्बुधं पुष्णाति सर्वदा । विश्वव्यचास्तु यो रश्मिः शुक्रं पुष्णाति नित्यदा एवं सूर्यप्रभावेण सर्वा नक्षत्रतारकाः । वर्धन्ते वर्धिता नित्यं नित्यमाप्याययन्ति च
verses.wordMeaning: Those Brahmanas who had been burnt completely in the fire of the curse of goddess Sati formerly during Daksa's sacrifice, will be reborn in the families of Brahmanas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those Brahmanas who had been burnt completely in the fire of the curse of goddess Sati formerly during Daksa's sacrifice, will be reborn in the families of Brahmanas.

verses.sanskrit: कुरुक्षेत्रं रुद्रकोटिर्नर्मदाम्रातकेश्वरम् । शालिग्रामं च कुब्जाम्रं कोकामुखमनुत्तमम् । प्रभासं विजयेशानं गोकर्णं भद्रकर्णकम्
verses.transliteration: kurukṣetraṃ rudrakoṭirnarmadāmrātakeśvaram / śāligrāmaṃ ca kubjāmraṃ kokāmukhamanuttamam / prabhāsaṃ vijayeśānaṃ gokarṇaṃ bhadrakarṇakam
verses.translation: In the Kaliyuga, towards the close of that age, they, with their mind overwhelmed by Tamas, will censure Mahadeva. Theirs will be a futile pursuit of Dharma.
verses.hindi: वन्दनाश्चैव याज्याश्च केतना भूतनास्तथा। अमृता नाम ताः सर्वा रश्मयो वृष्टिसर्जना:
verses.wordMeaning: In the Kaliyuga, towards the close of that age, they, with their mind overwhelmed by Tamas, will censure Mahadeva. Theirs will be a futile pursuit of Dharma.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the Kaliyuga, towards the close of that age, they, with their mind overwhelmed by Tamas, will censure Mahadeva. Theirs will be a futile pursuit of Dharma.

verses.sanskrit: एतानि पुण्यस्थानानि त्रैलोक्ये विश्रुतानि ह । न यास्यन्ति परं मोक्षं वाराणस्यां यथा मृताः
verses.transliteration: etāni puṇyasthānāni trailokye viśrutāni ha / na yāsyanti paraṃ mokṣaṃ vārāṇasyāṃ yathā mṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Although the Kali age is defective in many respects, there is one great good point in it viz. a man derives very great merit without any great strain.
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले--इस प्रकार ये महादेव कालात्मा ऐश्वर्यमय विग्रहवाले देवाधिदेव पितामह (सूर्य) कालका नियमन करते हैं। विप्रो! सभी लोकोंको प्रकाशित करनेवाली उनकी जो रश्मियाँ हैं, उनमें भी ग्रहोंकी योनिरूप सात रश्मियाँ अत्यन्त श्रेष्ठ हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Although the Kali age is defective in many respects, there is one great good point in it viz. a man derives very great merit without any great strain.
verses.commentary: Sense: Although the Kali age is defective in many respects, there is one great good point in it viz. a man derives very great merit without any great strain.

verses.sanskrit: वाराणस्यां विशेषेण गङ्गा त्रिपथगामिनी । प्रविष्टा नाशयेत् पापं जन्मान्तरशतैः कृतम्
verses.transliteration: vārāṇasyāṃ viśeṣeṇa gaṅgā tripathagāminī / praviṣṭā nāśayet pāpaṃ janmāntaraśataiḥ kṛtam
verses.translation: Hence, after reaching the Yuga belonging to Mches- vara, a Brahmana shall, by all means and with special care, seek refuge in Rudra, I Sana.
verses.hindi: सुषुग्न, हरिकेश, विश्वकर्मा, विश्वव्यचा, संयद्ठसु, अर्वावसु तथा स्वराडू--ये सात रश्मियाँ कही गयी हैं। सुषुम्र नामक सूर्यकी रश्मि चन्द्रमाकी चाँदनीको पुष्ट करती है। यह सुषुम्र रश्मि तिरछे रूपसे ऊपरको जानेवाली
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, after reaching the Yuga belonging to Mches- vara, a Brahmana shall, by all means and with special care, seek refuge in Rudra, I Sana.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, after reaching the Yuga belonging to Mches- vara, a Brahmana shall, by all means and with special care, seek refuge in Rudra, I Sana.

verses.sanskrit: अन्यत्र सुलभा गङ्गा श्राद्धं दानं तपो जपः । व्रतानि सर्वमेवैतद् वाराणस्यां सुदुर्लभम्
verses.transliteration: anyatra sulabhā gaṅgā śrāddhaṃ dānaṃ tapo japaḥ / vratāni sarvamevaitad vārāṇasyāṃ sudurlabham
verses.translation: Those who bow down to Isana of three eyes and wearing the elephant's hide, shall become delighted in their minds and attain to Rudra and his greatest region.
verses.hindi: कही गयी है। हरिकेश नामक जो रश्मि कही गयी है, वह नक्षत्रोंका पोषण करनेवाली है । विश्वकर्मा नामक रश्मि सदा बुध (ग्रह)-का पोषण करती है। विश्वव्यचा नामको जो रश्मि हे, वह नित्य शुक्र (ग्रह)-का पोषण करती है। संयद्दसु नामसे प्रसिद्ध रश्मि मंगलका पोषण करती है और प्रभु सूर्यकी अर्वावसु नामक रश्मि बृहस्पतिका पोषण करती है तथा सातवीं सुराटू (स्वराड्) नामक रश्मि शनेश्वरका पोषण करती है॥ ३--७॥
verses.wordMeaning: Those who bow down to Isana of three eyes and wearing the elephant's hide, shall become delighted in their minds and attain to Rudra and his greatest region.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who bow down to Isana of three eyes and wearing the elephant's hide, shall become delighted in their minds and attain to Rudra and his greatest region.

verses.sanskrit: यजेत जुहुयान्नित्यं ददात्यर्चयते ऽमरान् । वायुभक्षश्च सततं वाराणस्यां स्तितो नरः
verses.transliteration: yajeta juhuyānnityaṃ dadātyarcayate 'marān / vāyubhakṣaśca satataṃ vārāṇasyāṃ stito naraḥ
verses.translation: Just as the obeisance paid to Rudra certainly yields all desired fmits, one shall not derive that benefit by making salutations to other deities.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार सूर्यके प्रभावसे सभी नक्षत्र एवं तारे नित्य बढ़ते हैं तथा वृद्धि प्राप्तकर नित्य दूसरोंको आप्यायित करते हैं । द्युलोक एवं पृथ्वीसे सम्बद्ध समस्त तेज-समूह और निशा-सम्बन्धी तम-अन्धकारका नित्य
verses.wordMeaning: Just as the obeisance paid to Rudra certainly yields all desired fmits, one shall not derive that benefit by making salutations to other deities.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as the obeisance paid to Rudra certainly yields all desired fmits, one shall not derive that benefit by making salutations to other deities.

verses.sanskrit: यदि पापो यदि शठो यदि वाधार्मिको नरः । वाराणसीं समासाद्य पुनाति सकलं नरः
verses.transliteration: yadi pāpo yadi śaṭho yadi vādhārmiko naraḥ / vārāṇasīṃ samāsādya punāti sakalaṃ naraḥ
verses.translation: In the Kali Yuga of such a nature, the only means of purifying defects is the obeisance rendered to Mahadeva, meditating on him and offering charitable gifts—So says the Sruti.
verses.hindi: आदान अर्थात् ग्रहण करनेके कारण प्रभु (सूर्य)-को आदित्य कहा जाता है  हजारों नेत्रवाले वे अपनी हजारों नाडियों (किरणों)-द्वारा चारों ओरके नदियों, समुद्रों, कूपों, स्थावर तथा जङ्गम और नहरों आदिके जलका ग्रहण करते हैं। उनकी हजारों रश्मियाँ शीत, वर्षा एवं उष्णताको सृष्टि करनेवाली हैं और उनमें चार सौ विचित्र मूर्तिस्वरूपा रश्मियाँ वर्षा करती हैं वन्दना, याज्या, केतना और भूतना-ये अमृता नामवाली सभी
verses.wordMeaning: In the Kali Yuga of such a nature, the only means of purifying defects is the obeisance rendered to Mahadeva, meditating on him and offering charitable gifts—So says the Sruti.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the Kali Yuga of such a nature, the only means of purifying defects is the obeisance rendered to Mahadeva, meditating on him and offering charitable gifts—So says the Sruti.

verses.sanskrit: वाराणस्यां महादेवं येर्ऽचयन्ति स्तुवन्ति वै । सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तास्ते विज्ञेया गणेश्वराः
verses.transliteration: vārāṇasyāṃ mahādevaṃ yer'cayanti stuvanti vai / sarvapāpavinirmuktāste vijñeyā gaṇeśvarāḥ
verses.translation: Hence, if one wishes to attain the highest beatitude one should eschew all gods other than god Siva and resort to the three-eyed Mahesvara.
verses.hindi: रश्मियाँ वर्षा करनेवाली हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, if one wishes to attain the highest beatitude one should eschew all gods other than god Siva and resort to the three-eyed Mahesvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, if one wishes to attain the highest beatitude one should eschew all gods other than god Siva and resort to the three-eyed Mahesvara.

verses.sanskrit: अन्यत्र योगज्ञानाभ्यां संन्यासादथवान्यतः । प्राप्यते तत् परं स्थानं सहस्त्रेणैव जन्मना
verses.transliteration: anyatra yogajñānābhyāṃ saṃnyāsādathavānyataḥ / prāpyate tat paraṃ sthānaṃ sahastreṇaiva janmanā
verses.translation: Futile indeed is the very life, the charitable gifts, the penance and the performance of sacrifice of those people who do not worship Rudra, Siva, who is saluted by Devas.
verses.hindi: समं बिभर्ति ताभिः स मनुष्यपितृदेवताः । वसन्ते ग्रैष्मिके चैव शते: स तपति त्रिभिः ।
verses.wordMeaning: Futile indeed is the very life, the charitable gifts, the penance and the performance of sacrifice of those people who do not worship Rudra, Siva, who is saluted by Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Futile indeed is the very life, the charitable gifts, the penance and the performance of sacrifice of those people who do not worship Rudra, Siva, who is saluted by Devas.

verses.sanskrit: ये भक्ता देवदेवेशे वाराणस्यां वसन्ति वै । ते विन्दन्ति परं मोक्षमेकेनैव तु जन्मना
verses.transliteration: ye bhaktā devadeveśe vārāṇasyāṃ vasanti vai / te vindanti paraṃ mokṣamekenaiva tu janmanā
verses.translation: Obeisance to Rudra the great God of gods, Mahadeva, to the trident-bearing Tryambaka, Trinetra (the three-eyed god). Salutations to the preceptor of Yogins.
verses.hindi: वरुणो माघमासे तु सूर्यः पूषा तु फाल्गुने । चैत्रे मासि भवेदंशो धाता वैशाखतापनः
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to Rudra the great God of gods, Mahadeva, to the trident-bearing Tryambaka, Trinetra (the three-eyed god). Salutations to the preceptor of Yogins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to Rudra the great God of gods, Mahadeva, to the trident-bearing Tryambaka, Trinetra (the three-eyed god). Salutations to the preceptor of Yogins.

verses.sanskrit: यत्र योगस्तथा ज्ञानं मुक्तिरेकेन जन्मना । अविमुक्तं समासाद्य नान्यद् गच्छेत् तपोवनम्
verses.transliteration: yatra yogastathā jñānaṃ muktirekena janmanā / avimuktaṃ samāsādya nānyad gacchet tapovanam
verses.translation: Hail to the lord of Devas, to Mahadeva, to Vedhas (creator), to Sambhu. Obeisance forever to Sthanu, to Siva the Paramesthin.
verses.hindi: पर्जन्योऽश्वयुजि त्वष्टा कार्तिके मासि भास्करः। मार्गशीर्षे भवेन्मित्रः पौषे विष्णुः सनातन: पञ्चरश्मिसहस्त्राणि वरुणस्यार्ककर्मणि। षड्भिः सहस्त्रैः पूषा तु देवोंऽशः सप्तभिस्तथा
verses.wordMeaning: Hail to the lord of Devas, to Mahadeva, to Vedhas (creator), to Sambhu. Obeisance forever to Sthanu, to Siva the Paramesthin.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hail to the lord of Devas, to Mahadeva, to Vedhas (creator), to Sambhu. Obeisance forever to Sthanu, to Siva the Paramesthin.

verses.sanskrit: यतो मया न मुक्तं तदविमुक्तं ततः स्मृतम् । तदेव गुह्यं गुह्यानामेतद् विज्ञाय मुच्यते
verses.transliteration: yato mayā na muktaṃ tadavimuktaṃ tataḥ smṛtam / tadeva guhyaṃ guhyānāmetad vijñāya mucyate
verses.translation: Salutations to Rudra accompaniedjby Uma, to Maha- grasa (devouring all in a mouthful), the cause of the universe. I resort to the three-eyed celibate worthy of being a refuge.
verses.hindi: विवस्वान् दशभिः पाति पात्येकादशभिर्भगः
verses.wordMeaning: Salutations to Rudra accompaniedjby Uma, to Maha- grasa (devouring all in a mouthful), the cause of the universe. I resort to the three-eyed celibate worthy of being a refuge.
verses.commentary: Sense: Salutations to Rudra accompaniedjby Uma, to Maha- grasa (devouring all in a mouthful), the cause of the universe. I resort to the three-eyed celibate worthy of being a refuge.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानाज्ञानाभिनिष्ठानां परमानन्दमिच्छताम् । या गतिर्विहिता सुभ्रु साविमुक्ते मृतस्य तु
verses.transliteration: jñānājñānābhiniṣṭhānāṃ paramānandamicchatām / yā gatirvihitā subhru sāvimukte mṛtasya tu
verses.translation: I bow to the extremely red god, who puts forth his tongue, to the sungod, Paramesthin, the fierce Pasupati, to the terrible deity, to the refulgent sun, to the Supreme penance (v.l. beyond darkness).
verses.hindi: षड्भी रश्मिसहस्त्रैस्तु विष्णुस्तपति विश्वसृक् वसन्ते कपिलः सूर्यो ग्रीष्मे काञ्जनसप्रभः ।
verses.wordMeaning: I bow to the extremely red god, who puts forth his tongue, to the sungod, Paramesthin, the fierce Pasupati, to the terrible deity, to the refulgent sun, to the Supreme penance (v.l. beyond darkness).
verses.commentary: Sense: I bow to the extremely red god, who puts forth his tongue, to the sungod, Paramesthin, the fierce Pasupati, to the terrible deity, to the refulgent sun, to the Supreme penance (v.l. beyond darkness).

verses.sanskrit: यानि चैवाविमुक्तस्य देहे तूक्तानि कृत्स्नशः । पुरी वाराणसी तेभ्यः स्थानेभ्यो ह्यधिकाशुभा
verses.transliteration: yāni caivāvimuktasya dehe tūktāni kṛtsnaśaḥ / purī vārāṇasī tebhyaḥ sthānebhyo hyadhikāśubhā
verses.translation: Thus the characteristics of the Yugas have been ■succinctly recounted as also of the Yugas that have gone by and that are yet to come until the end of the Manvantara.
verses.hindi: नाडीस्वरूपिणी तीन सौ रश्मियाँ हिमकी सृष्टि करती हैं। मेषी, पौषी तथा ह्वादिनी नामकी रश्मियाँ हिमकी सृष्टि करनेवाली हैं। ये सभी रश्मियाँ पीत वर्णकी और चन्द्रा नामवाली हैं। शुक्रा, ककुभू और विश्वभृत् नामक सभी
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the characteristics of the Yugas have been ■succinctly recounted as also of the Yugas that have gone by and that are yet to come until the end of the Manvantara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the characteristics of the Yugas have been ■succinctly recounted as also of the Yugas that have gone by and that are yet to come until the end of the Manvantara.

verses.sanskrit: यत्र साक्षान्महादेवो देहान्ते स्वयमीश्वरः । व्याचष्टे तारकं ब्रह्म तत्रैव ह्यविमुक्तकम्
verses.transliteration: yatra sākṣānmahādevo dehānte svayamīśvaraḥ / vyācaṣṭe tārakaṃ brahma tatraiva hyavimuktakam
verses.translation: Thus the characteristics of the Yugas have been ■succinctly recounted as also of the Yugas that have gone by and that are yet to come until the end of the Manvantara.
verses.hindi: रश्मियोंका नाम शुक्रा है। ये तीनों प्रकारकी रश्मियाँ धूपको सृष्टि करनेवाली हैं उनके द्वारा वे (सूर्य) समान-रूपसे मनुष्यों, पितरों तथा देवताओंका पोषण करते हैं। वे (इन किरणोंके माध्यमसे) मनुष्योंको औषधके द्वारा, पितरोंको स्वधाके द्वारा और देवताओंको अमृतके द्वारा-इस प्रकार
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the characteristics of the Yugas have been ■succinctly recounted as also of the Yugas that have gone by and that are yet to come until the end of the Manvantara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the characteristics of the Yugas have been ■succinctly recounted as also of the Yugas that have gone by and that are yet to come until the end of the Manvantara.

verses.sanskrit: यत् तत् परतरं तत्त्वमविमुक्तमिति श्रुतम् । एकेन जन्मना देवि वाराणस्यां तदाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: yat tat parataraṃ tattvamavimuktamiti śrutam / ekena janmanā devi vārāṇasyāṃ tadāpnuyāt
verses.translation: Thus the characteristics of the Yugas have been ■succinctly recounted as also of the Yugas that have gone by and that are yet to come until the end of the Manvantara.
verses.hindi: तीनोंको तीन पदाथाँद्वारा संतृप्त करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the characteristics of the Yugas have been ■succinctly recounted as also of the Yugas that have gone by and that are yet to come until the end of the Manvantara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the characteristics of the Yugas have been ■succinctly recounted as also of the Yugas that have gone by and that are yet to come until the end of the Manvantara.

verses.sanskrit: भ्रूमध्ये नाभिमध्ये च हृदये चैव मूर्धनि । यथाविमुक्तादित्ये वाराणस्यां व्यवस्थितम्
verses.transliteration: bhrūmadhye nābhimadhye ca hṛdaye caiva mūrdhani / yathāvimuktāditye vārāṇasyāṃ vyavasthitam
verses.translation: Thus the characteristics of the Yugas have been ■succinctly recounted as also of the Yugas that have gone by and that are yet to come until the end of the Manvantara.
verses.hindi: वे (सूर्य) वसन्त एवं ग्रीष्म ऋतुमें तीन सौ किरणोंसे तपते हैं । शरद् और वर्षा ऋतुमें चार सौ रश्मियोंके द्वारा वर्षा करते हैं तथा हेमन्त एवं शिशिर ऋतुमें तीन सौ रश्मियोंसे हिम प्रदान करते हैं। माघमासमें सूर्यका नाम वरुण होता है, फाल्गुनमें वे पूषा कहलाते हैं । सूर्य चेत्र- मासमें अंश, वैशाखमें धाता, ज्येष्ठा-मूल अर्थात् ज्येष्ठ- मासमें इन्द्र, आषाढ्में सविता, श्रावणमें विवस्वान् तथा भाद्रपदमासमें भग कहे जाते हैं । (ये ही) सूर्य आश्चिनमें
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the characteristics of the Yugas have been ■succinctly recounted as also of the Yugas that have gone by and that are yet to come until the end of the Manvantara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the characteristics of the Yugas have been ■succinctly recounted as also of the Yugas that have gone by and that are yet to come until the end of the Manvantara.

verses.sanskrit: वरणायास्तथा चास्या मध्ये वाराणसी पुरी । तत्रैव संस्थितं तत्त्वं नित्यमेवाविमुक्तकम्
verses.transliteration: varaṇāyāstathā cāsyā madhye vārāṇasī purī / tatraiva saṃsthitaṃ tattvaṃ nityamevāvimuktakam
verses.translation: Thus the characteristics of the Yugas have been ■succinctly recounted as also of the Yugas that have gone by and that are yet to come until the end of the Manvantara.
verses.hindi: पर्जन्य, कार्तिकमें त्वष्टा, मार्गशीर्षमें मित्र और पौषमें सनातन विष्णु कहलाते हैँ
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the characteristics of the Yugas have been ■succinctly recounted as also of the Yugas that have gone by and that are yet to come until the end of the Manvantara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the characteristics of the Yugas have been ■succinctly recounted as also of the Yugas that have gone by and that are yet to come until the end of the Manvantara.

verses.sanskrit: वाराणस्याः परं स्थानं न भूतं न भविष्यति । यत्र नारायणो देवो महादेवो दिवेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: vārāṇasyāḥ paraṃ sthānaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati / yatra nārāyaṇo devo mahādevo diveśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Thus the characteristics of the Yugas have been ■succinctly recounted as also of the Yugas that have gone by and that are yet to come until the end of the Manvantara.
verses.hindi: वरुण (नामक सूर्य)-की पाँच हजार रश्मियाँ सूर्यका कार्य सम्पादित करती हैं। इसी प्रकार पूषा छ; हजार, अंश देव सात हजार, धाता आठ हजार, शतक्रतु इन्द्र नौ हजार, विवस्वान् दस हजार और भग ग्यारह हजार रश्मियोंसे पालन करते हैं। मित्र नामक सूर्य सात हजार और त्वष्टा आठ हजार रश्मियोंसे तपते हैं। अर्यमा दस हजार रश्मियोंसे पालन करते हैं और पर्जन्य नौ हजार रश्मियोंसे ताप प्रदान करते हैं। विश्वकी सृष्टि
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the characteristics of the Yugas have been ■succinctly recounted as also of the Yugas that have gone by and that are yet to come until the end of the Manvantara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the characteristics of the Yugas have been ■succinctly recounted as also of the Yugas that have gone by and that are yet to come until the end of the Manvantara.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र देवाः सगन्धर्वाः सयक्षोरगराक्षसाः । उपासते मां सततं देवदेवं पितामहम्
verses.transliteration: tatra devāḥ sagandharvāḥ sayakṣoragarākṣasāḥ / upāsate māṃ satataṃ devadevaṃ pitāmaham
verses.translation: Thus the characteristics of the Yugas have been ■succinctly recounted as also of the Yugas that have gone by and that are yet to come until the end of the Manvantara.
verses.hindi: करनेवाले विष्णु (नामक सूर्य) छः हजार रश्मियोंसे तपते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the characteristics of the Yugas have been ■succinctly recounted as also of the Yugas that have gone by and that are yet to come until the end of the Manvantara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the characteristics of the Yugas have been ■succinctly recounted as also of the Yugas that have gone by and that are yet to come until the end of the Manvantara.

verses.sanskrit: महापातकिनो ये च ये तेभ्यः पापकृत्तमाः । वाराणसीं समासाद्य ते यान्ति परमां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: mahāpātakino ye ca ye tebhyaḥ pāpakṛttamāḥ / vārāṇasīṃ samāsādya te yānti paramāṃ gatim
verses.translation: Thus the characteristics of the Yugas have been ■succinctly recounted as also of the Yugas that have gone by and that are yet to come until the end of the Manvantara.
verses.hindi: प्रभु सूर्य वसन्त ऋतुमें कपिल (भुरे) वर्णके, ग्रीष्ममें स्वर्णके समान, वर्षामें श्वेत, शरदमें पाण्डुर (सफेद-मिश्रित पीले) रंगके, हेमन्तमें तॉबेके समान वर्णवाले और शिशिरमें सूर्य लोहित (लाल) वर्णके होते हैं । सूर्य ओषधियोंमें बलका आधान करते हैं, पितरोंको स्वधा और देवताओंको अमरत्व-इस प्रकार तीनोंको तीन पदार्थ प्रदान करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the characteristics of the Yugas have been ■succinctly recounted as also of the Yugas that have gone by and that are yet to come until the end of the Manvantara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the characteristics of the Yugas have been ■succinctly recounted as also of the Yugas that have gone by and that are yet to come until the end of the Manvantara.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मान्मुमुक्षुर्नियतो वसेद् वै मरणान्तिकम् । वाराणस्यां महादेवाज्ज्ञानं लब्ध्वा विमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: tasmānmumukṣurniyato vased vai maraṇāntikam / vārāṇasyāṃ mahādevājjñānaṃ labdhvā vimucyate
verses.translation: Thus the characteristics of the Yugas have been ■succinctly recounted as also of the Yugas that have gone by and that are yet to come until the end of the Manvantara.
verses.hindi: भौमो मन्दस्तथा राहुः केतुमानपि चाष्टमः
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the characteristics of the Yugas have been ■succinctly recounted as also of the Yugas that have gone by and that are yet to come until the end of the Manvantara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the characteristics of the Yugas have been ■succinctly recounted as also of the Yugas that have gone by and that are yet to come until the end of the Manvantara.

verses.sanskrit: किन्तु विघ्ना भविष्यन्ति पापोपहतचेतसः । ततो नैव चरेत् पापं कायेन मनसा गिरा
verses.transliteration: kintu vighnā bhaviṣyanti pāpopahatacetasaḥ / tato naiva caret pāpaṃ kāyena manasā girā
verses.translation: Thus the characteristics of the Yugas have been ■succinctly recounted as also of the Yugas that have gone by and that are yet to come until the end of the Manvantara.
verses.hindi: भ्राम्यमाणा यथायोगं भ्रमन्त्यनुदिवाकरम् यस्माद् बहति तान् वायुः प्रवहस्तेन स स्मृतः
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the characteristics of the Yugas have been ■succinctly recounted as also of the Yugas that have gone by and that are yet to come until the end of the Manvantara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the characteristics of the Yugas have been ■succinctly recounted as also of the Yugas that have gone by and that are yet to come until the end of the Manvantara.

verses.sanskrit: एतद् रहस्यं वेदानां पुराणानां च सुव्रताः । अविमुक्ताश्रयं ज्ञानं न कश्चिद् वेत्ति तत्त्वतः
verses.transliteration: etad rahasyaṃ vedānāṃ purāṇānāṃ ca suvratāḥ / avimuktāśrayaṃ jñānaṃ na kaścid vetti tattvataḥ
verses.translation: Thus the characteristics of the Yugas have been ■succinctly recounted as also of the Yugas that have gone by and that are yet to come until the end of the Manvantara.
verses.hindi: वामदक्षिणतो युक्ता दश तेन निशाकरः
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the characteristics of the Yugas have been ■succinctly recounted as also of the Yugas that have gone by and that are yet to come until the end of the Manvantara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the characteristics of the Yugas have been ■succinctly recounted as also of the Yugas that have gone by and that are yet to come until the end of the Manvantara.

verses.sanskrit: देवतानामृषीणां च शृण्वतां परमेष्ठिनाम् । देव्यै देवेन कथितं सर्वपापविनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: devatānāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca śṛṇvatāṃ parameṣṭhinām / devyai devena kathitaṃ sarvapāpavināśanam
verses.translation: Thus the characteristics of the Yugas have been ■succinctly recounted as also of the Yugas that have gone by and that are yet to come until the end of the Manvantara.
verses.hindi: स सोमः शुक्लपक्षे तु भास्करे परतः स्थिते। आपूर्यते परस्यान्तः सततं दिवसक्रमात् एकेन रश्मिना विप्राः सुषुम्नाख्येन भास्करः
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the characteristics of the Yugas have been ■succinctly recounted as also of the Yugas that have gone by and that are yet to come until the end of the Manvantara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the characteristics of the Yugas have been ■succinctly recounted as also of the Yugas that have gone by and that are yet to come until the end of the Manvantara.

verses.sanskrit: यथा नारायणः श्रेष्ठो देवानां पुरुषोत्तमः । यथेश्वराणां गिरिशः स्थानानां चैतदुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: yathā nārāyaṇaḥ śreṣṭho devānāṃ puruṣottamaḥ / yatheśvarāṇāṃ giriśaḥ sthānānāṃ caitaduttamam
verses.translation: Thus the characteristics of the Yugas have been ■succinctly recounted as also of the Yugas that have gone by and that are yet to come until the end of the Manvantara.
verses.hindi: सम्पूर्णमर्धमासेन तं सोमममृतात्मकम्। पिबन्ति देवता विप्रा यतस्तेऽमृतभोजनाः
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the characteristics of the Yugas have been ■succinctly recounted as also of the Yugas that have gone by and that are yet to come until the end of the Manvantara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the characteristics of the Yugas have been ■succinctly recounted as also of the Yugas that have gone by and that are yet to come until the end of the Manvantara.

verses.sanskrit: यैः समाराधितो रुद्रः पूर्वस्मिन्नेव जन्मनि । ते विन्दन्ति परं क्षेत्रमविमुक्तं शिवालयम्
verses.transliteration: yaiḥ samārādhito rudraḥ pūrvasminneva janmani / te vindanti paraṃ kṣetramavimuktaṃ śivālayam
verses.translation: Thus the characteristics of the Yugas have been ■succinctly recounted as also of the Yugas that have gone by and that are yet to come until the end of the Manvantara.
verses.hindi: ततः पञ्चदशे भागे किंचिच्छिष्टे कलात्मके । अपराह्णे पितृगणा जघन्यं पर्युपासते पिबन्ति द्विकलं कालं शिष्ट्रा तस्य कला तु या। सुधामृतमयीं पुण्यां तामिन्दोरमृतात्मिकाम्
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the characteristics of the Yugas have been ■succinctly recounted as also of the Yugas that have gone by and that are yet to come until the end of the Manvantara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the characteristics of the Yugas have been ■succinctly recounted as also of the Yugas that have gone by and that are yet to come until the end of the Manvantara.

verses.sanskrit: कलिकल्मषसंभूता येषामुपहता मतिः । न तेषां वेदितुं शक्यं स्थानं तत् परमेष्ठिनः
verses.transliteration: kalikalmaṣasaṃbhūtā yeṣāmupahatā matiḥ / na teṣāṃ vedituṃ śakyaṃ sthānaṃ tat parameṣṭhinaḥ
verses.translation: Thus the characteristics of the Yugas have been ■succinctly recounted as also of the Yugas that have gone by and that are yet to come until the end of the Manvantara.
verses.hindi: न सोमस्य विनाशः स्यात् सुधा देवैस्तु पीयते। एवं सूर्यनिमित्तस्य क्षयो वृद्धिश्च सत्तमाः
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the characteristics of the Yugas have been ■succinctly recounted as also of the Yugas that have gone by and that are yet to come until the end of the Manvantara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the characteristics of the Yugas have been ■succinctly recounted as also of the Yugas that have gone by and that are yet to come until the end of the Manvantara.

verses.sanskrit: ये स्मरन्ति सदा कालं विन्दन्ति च पुरीमिमाम् । तेषां विनश्यति क्षिप्रमिहामुत्र च पातकम्
verses.transliteration: ye smaranti sadā kālaṃ vindanti ca purīmimām / teṣāṃ vinaśyati kṣipramihāmutra ca pātakam
verses.translation: Thus the characteristics of the Yugas have been ■succinctly recounted as also of the Yugas that have gone by and that are yet to come until the end of the Manvantara.
verses.hindi: हे द्विजो! अन्य आठ ग्रहोंको सूर्यसे अधिष्ठित जानना चाहिए। चन्द्रमा, चन्द्रमाका पुत्र बुध, शुक्र, बृहस्पति, मंगल, शनि, राहु तथा केतु नामक आठवाँ ग्रह है। वातरश्मियोंके द्वारा ध्रुवमें आबद्ध वे सभी ग्रह (अपनी कक्षामें) भ्रमण करते हुए यथास्थान सूर्यकी परिक्रमा करते हैं। द्विजो! वायुचक्रसे प्रेरित (ग्रहगण) अलातचक्रके समान भ्रमण करते हैं। चूँकि वायु उनका वहन करती है, इसलिये उसे 'प्रवह' कहा जाता है।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the characteristics of the Yugas have been ■succinctly recounted as also of the Yugas that have gone by and that are yet to come until the end of the Manvantara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the characteristics of the Yugas have been ■succinctly recounted as also of the Yugas that have gone by and that are yet to come until the end of the Manvantara.

verses.sanskrit: यानि चेह प्रकुर्वन्ति पातकानि कृतालयाः । नाशयेत् तानि सर्वाणि देवः कालतनुः शिवः
verses.transliteration: yāni ceha prakurvanti pātakāni kṛtālayāḥ / nāśayet tāni sarvāṇi devaḥ kālatanuḥ śivaḥ
verses.translation: Thus the characteristics of the Yugas have been ■succinctly recounted as also of the Yugas that have gone by and that are yet to come until the end of the Manvantara.
verses.hindi: सोमका रथ तीन चक्रोंवाला है। उसके वाम और दक्षिण भागमें कुन्द पुष्पके समान वर्णवाले दस अश्व जुते हैं, इसी रथसे निशाकर चन्द्रमा सूर्यके समान (अपनी) कक्षामें स्थित होकर नक्षत्रोंके मध्य परिश्रमण करता है।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the characteristics of the Yugas have been ■succinctly recounted as also of the Yugas that have gone by and that are yet to come until the end of the Manvantara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the characteristics of the Yugas have been ■succinctly recounted as also of the Yugas that have gone by and that are yet to come until the end of the Manvantara.

verses.sanskrit: आगच्छतामिदं स्थानं सेवितुं मोक्षकाङ्क्षिणाम् । मृतानां च पुनर्जनम् न भूयो भवसागरे
verses.transliteration: āgacchatāmidaṃ sthānaṃ sevituṃ mokṣakāṅkṣiṇām / mṛtānāṃ ca punarjanam na bhūyo bhavasāgare
verses.translation: Thus the characteristics of the Yugas have been ■succinctly recounted as also of the Yugas that have gone by and that are yet to come until the end of the Manvantara.
verses.hindi: हे विप्रेन्द्रो! चन्द्रमाको रश्मियोंकी क्रमशः हास और वृद्धि होती रहती है। दिनके क्रमानुसार शुक्लपक्षमें चन्द्रमाके परभागमें स्थित सूर्य सोम (चन्द्र )-को निरन्तर आपूरित करता है हे विप्रो! देवताओंद्वारा (अमृत) पान किये जानेके कारण क्षीण हुए चन्द्रमाको सूर्य सुषुम्न नामक एक रश्मि (किरण)-से नित्य आप्यायित करते हैं। सूर्यके तेजसे चन्द्रमाका यह (क्षीण) शरीर पुष्ट होता है, अतएव
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the characteristics of the Yugas have been ■succinctly recounted as also of the Yugas that have gone by and that are yet to come until the end of the Manvantara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the characteristics of the Yugas have been ■succinctly recounted as also of the Yugas that have gone by and that are yet to come until the end of the Manvantara.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन वाराणस्यां वसेन्नरः । योगी वाप्यथवायोगी पापी वा पुण्यकृत्तमः
verses.transliteration: tasmāt sarvaprayatnena vārāṇasyāṃ vasennaraḥ / yogī vāpyathavāyogī pāpī vā puṇyakṛttamaḥ
verses.translation: Thus the characteristics of the Yugas have been ■succinctly recounted as also of the Yugas that have gone by and that are yet to come until the end of the Manvantara.
verses.hindi: दिनके क्रमानुसार पूर्णिमाको वह चन्द्रमा सम्पूर्ण रूपसे दिखायी देता है। है विप्रो! देवता उस अमृतस्वरूप सम्पूर्ण सोमका आधे महीनेतक पान करते हैं, क्योंकि वे (देवता) अमृतका भोजन करनेवाले होते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the characteristics of the Yugas have been ■succinctly recounted as also of the Yugas that have gone by and that are yet to come until the end of the Manvantara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the characteristics of the Yugas have been ■succinctly recounted as also of the Yugas that have gone by and that are yet to come until the end of the Manvantara.

verses.sanskrit: न वेदवचनात् पित्रोर्न चैव गुरुवादतः । मतिरुत्क्रमणीया स्यादविमुक्तगतिं प्रति
verses.transliteration: na vedavacanāt pitrorna caiva guruvādataḥ / matirutkramaṇīyā syādavimuktagatiṃ prati
verses.translation: Thus the characteristics of the Yugas have been ■succinctly recounted as also of the Yugas that have gone by and that are yet to come until the end of the Manvantara.
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर पंद्रहवें भागके किंचित् कलात्मक भाग शेष बचनेपर अपराहुमें पितृगण उस अन्तिम भागका सेवन करते हैं। पितृगण चन्द्रमाकी अवशिष्ट अमृतस्वरूपिणी अमृतमयी तथा पवित्र सुधा नामक कलाका दो लव (कालविशेष)-तक पान करते हैं॥ ३१--३५॥
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the characteristics of the Yugas have been ■succinctly recounted as also of the Yugas that have gone by and that are yet to come until the end of the Manvantara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the characteristics of the Yugas have been ■succinctly recounted as also of the Yugas that have gone by and that are yet to come until the end of the Manvantara.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच इत्येवमुक्त्वा भगवान् व्यासो वेदविदां वरः । सहैव शिष्यप्रवरैर्वाराणस्यां चचार ह
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca ityevamuktvā bhagavān vyāso vedavidāṃ varaḥ / sahaiva śiṣyapravarairvārāṇasyāṃ cacāra ha
verses.translation: Thus the characteristics of the Yugas have been ■succinctly recounted as also of the Yugas that have gone by and that are yet to come until the end of the Manvantara.
verses.hindi: अमावस्याके दिन (चन्द्रमाकी) किरणोंसे निकलनेवाले स्वधा नामक अमृतका पान करनेसे पितर महीनेभरके लिये तृप्ति प्राप्त कर स्वस्थ हो जाते हैं। देवताओंके द्वारा (चन्द्रमाके) अमृतका पान किये जानेपर सोमका
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the characteristics of the Yugas have been ■succinctly recounted as also of the Yugas that have gone by and that are yet to come until the end of the Manvantara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the characteristics of the Yugas have been ■succinctly recounted as also of the Yugas that have gone by and that are yet to come until the end of the Manvantara.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वंविभागे एकोनत्रिशो ऽध्यायः सूत उवाच स शिष्यैः संवृतो धीमान् गुरुर्द्वैपायनो मुनिः । जगाम विपुलं लिङ्गमोङ्कारं मुक्तिदायकम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvaṃvibhāge ekonatriśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca sa śiṣyaiḥ saṃvṛto dhīmān gururdvaipāyano muniḥ / jagāma vipulaṃ liṅgamoṅkāraṃ muktidāyakam
verses.translation: There is no doubt in this that all the Manvantaras are explained when one Manvantara is explained; all the Kalpas •are explained through the explanation of one.
verses.hindi: विनाश नहीं होता। श्रेष्ठ जनो! इस प्रकार सूर्यके कारण चन्द्रमाके क्षय एवं वृद्धिका क्रम चलता है। सोमके पुत्र (बुध)-के रथमें वायुके समान वेगवाले जलसे उत्पन्न आठ घोड़े जुते रहते हैं। वह बुध उसी रथसे सर्वत्र २२४  कूर्मपुराण
verses.wordMeaning: There is no doubt in this that all the Manvantaras are explained when one Manvantara is explained; all the Kalpas •are explained through the explanation of one.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no doubt in this that all the Manvantaras are explained when one Manvantara is explained; all the Kalpas •are explained through the explanation of one.

verses.sanskrit: तत्राभ्यर्च्य महादेवं शिष्यैः सह महामुनिः । प्रोवाच तस्य माहात्म्यं मुनीनां भावितात्मनाम्
verses.transliteration: tatrābhyarcya mahādevaṃ śiṣyaiḥ saha mahāmuniḥ / provāca tasya māhātmyaṃ munīnāṃ bhāvitātmanām
verses.translation: In the Manvantaras, both past and the future, all people are of identical names and forms and they identify themselves with the same.''
verses.hindi: शुक्रस्य भूमिजैरश्वैः स्यन्दनो दशभिर्वृतः । शुक्रका रथ भूमिसे उत्पन्न दस घोड़ोंसे और अष्टाभिश्चाथ भौमस्य रथो हैमः सुशोभन: ॥ ३९ ॥  मंगलका स्वर्णमय अत्यन्त सुन्दर रथ आठ घोड़ोंसे युक्त रहता है। बृहस्पतिका भी आठ घोड़ोंवाला रथ स्वर्णसे
verses.wordMeaning: In the Manvantaras, both past and the future, all people are of identical names and forms and they identify themselves with the same.''
verses.commentary: Sense: In the Manvantaras, both past and the future, all people are of identical names and forms and they identify themselves with the same.''

verses.sanskrit: इदं तद् विमलं लिङ्गमोङ्कारं नाम शोभनम् । अस्य स्मरणमात्रेण मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः
verses.transliteration: idaṃ tad vimalaṃ liṅgamoṅkāraṃ nāma śobhanam / asya smaraṇamātreṇa mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ
verses.translation: Thus advised by the holy sage, Svetavahana (Arjuna) •cherished in himself the greatest and unswerving devotion to Isana.
verses.hindi: बहस्पतेरथाष्टाश्व: स्यन्दनो हेमनिर्मितः। निर्मित है। शनिका लोहेसे बना हुआ रथ तमोमय है रथस्तमोमयोऽष्टाश्वो मन्दस्यायसनिर्मितः। और आठ घोड़ोंवाला है। सूर्यके शत्रु राहु और केतुके स्वर्भानोर्भास्करारेश्च तथा षड्भिर्हयेर्वृतः॥ ४०॥  रथ छः-छः अश्चोंसे युक्त हैं एते महाग्रहाणां वै समाख्याता रथा नव। इस प्रकार महाग्रहोंके नौ रथोंका वर्णन किया गया!
verses.wordMeaning: Thus advised by the holy sage, Svetavahana (Arjuna) •cherished in himself the greatest and unswerving devotion to Isana.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus advised by the holy sage, Svetavahana (Arjuna) •cherished in himself the greatest and unswerving devotion to Isana.

verses.sanskrit: एतत् परतरं ज्ञानं पञ्चयतनमुत्तमम् । सेवितं सूरिभिर्नित्यं वाराणस्यां विमोक्षदम्
verses.transliteration: etat parataraṃ jñānaṃ pañcayatanamuttamam / sevitaṃ sūribhirnityaṃ vārāṇasyāṃ vimokṣadam
verses.translation: He made obeisance to the holy sage Krsnadvaipayana who was omniscient, the creator of all, who was established as Visnu himself.
verses.hindi: सर्वे ध्रुवे महाभागा निबद्धा वातरश्मिभिः॥ ४१॥  ये सभी महाभाग (ग्रह) वायुकी रश्मियोंके द्वारा धुवमें आबद्ध हैं। सभी ग्रह, नक्षत्र और तारागण भी धुवमें
verses.wordMeaning: He made obeisance to the holy sage Krsnadvaipayana who was omniscient, the creator of all, who was established as Visnu himself.
verses.commentary: Sense: He made obeisance to the holy sage Krsnadvaipayana who was omniscient, the creator of all, who was established as Visnu himself.

verses.sanskrit: अत्र साक्षान्महादेवः पञ्चायतनविग्रहः । रमते भगवान् रुद्रो जन्तूनामपवर्गदः
verses.transliteration: atra sākṣānmahādevaḥ pañcāyatanavigrahaḥ / ramate bhagavān rudro jantūnāmapavargadaḥ
verses.translation: Stroking Partha, the conqueror of enemies' cities who bowed to him, by means of his splendid hands, sage Vyasa spoke to him again.
verses.hindi: ग्रहर्क्षताराधिष्ण्यानि ध्रुवे बद्धान्यशेषतः । पूर्णतः निबद्ध हैं । वायुकी रश्मियोंद्वारा परिचालित होकर भ्रमन्ति श्रामयन्त्येनं सर्वाण्यनिलरश्मिभिः॥ ४२॥  ये सभी परिभ्रमण करते रहते हें
verses.wordMeaning: Stroking Partha, the conqueror of enemies' cities who bowed to him, by means of his splendid hands, sage Vyasa spoke to him again.
verses.commentary: Sense: Stroking Partha, the conqueror of enemies' cities who bowed to him, by means of his splendid hands, sage Vyasa spoke to him again.

verses.sanskrit: यत् तत् पाशुपतं ज्ञानं पञ्चार्थमिति शब्द्यते । तदेतद् विमलं लिङ्गमोङ्कारे समवस्थितम्
verses.transliteration: yat tat pāśupataṃ jñānaṃ pañcārthamiti śabdyate / tadetad vimalaṃ liṅgamoṅkāre samavasthitam
verses.translation: "You are blessed, favourite with the Lord. In all the three worlds there is certainly no other person like you who is a devotee of Sankara, and the conqueror of enemies' cities.
verses.hindi: महः आदि सात लोकों तथा सात पातालोंका और वहाँके निवासियोंका वर्णन, वैष्णवी तथा शाम्भवी शक्तियोंका वर्णन
verses.wordMeaning: "You are blessed, favourite with the Lord. In all the three worlds there is certainly no other person like you who is a devotee of Sankara, and the conqueror of enemies' cities.
verses.commentary: Sense: "You are blessed, favourite with the Lord. In all the three worlds there is certainly no other person like you who is a devotee of Sankara, and the conqueror of enemies' cities.

verses.sanskrit: शान्त्यतीता तथा शान्तिर्विद्या चैव परा कला । प्रतिष्ठा च निवृत्तिश्च पञ्चार्थं लिङ्गमैश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: śāntyatītā tathā śāntirvidyā caiva parā kalā / pratiṣṭhā ca nivṛttiśca pañcārthaṃ liṅgamaiśvaram
verses.translation: You have directly perceived that lord Rudra who has tiniversal vision, has faces all round, who is the very embodi¬ ment of the imiverse.
verses.hindi: सूत उवाच सूतजी बोले--हे द्विजश्रेष्ठो! ध्रुवके ऊपर एक ध्रुवादूर्ध्वं महर्लोकः कोटियोजनविस्तृतः करोड़ योजन विस्तारवाला महर्लोक है। वहाँ कल्पके 'कल्पाधिकारिणस्तत्र संस्थिता द्विजपुंगवाः ॥ ९॥  अधिकारीगण निवास करते हैं। इसी प्रकार महलोंकसे जनलोको महर्लोकात् तथा कोटिद्वयात्मकः । ऊपर दो करोड़ योजनवाला जनलोक है। वहाँ ब्रह्माके सनन्दनादयस्तत्र संस्थिता ब्रह्मणः सुताः॥ २॥  (मानस) पुत्र सनन्दन आदि रहते हैं। जनलोकसे दा जनलोकात् तपोलोकः कोटित्रयसमन्वित: तलाक तीन कोड त ला वहा. आह
verses.wordMeaning: You have directly perceived that lord Rudra who has tiniversal vision, has faces all round, who is the very embodi¬ ment of the imiverse.
verses.commentary: Sense: You have directly perceived that lord Rudra who has tiniversal vision, has faces all round, who is the very embodi¬ ment of the imiverse.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चानामपि देवानां ब्रह्मादीनां सदाश्रयम् । ओङ्कारबोधकं लिङ्गं पञ्चायतनमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: pañcānāmapi devānāṃ brahmādīnāṃ sadāśrayam / oṅkārabodhakaṃ liṅgaṃ pañcāyatanamucyate
verses.translation: That divine lordly knowledge has been precisely understood by you. The eternal Hrsikesa (Vyasa, his incarna¬ tion) himself has recounted it to you, out of delight.
verses.hindi: वैराज नामक देवता रहते हैं । प्राजापत्यलोक अर्थात् वैराजास्तत्र वै देवाः स्थिता दाहविवर्जिताः॥ ३॥  तपोलोकके ऊपर छ, करोड योजनका सत्यलोक है।
verses.wordMeaning: That divine lordly knowledge has been precisely understood by you. The eternal Hrsikesa (Vyasa, his incarna¬ tion) himself has recounted it to you, out of delight.
verses.commentary: Sense: That divine lordly knowledge has been precisely understood by you. The eternal Hrsikesa (Vyasa, his incarna¬ tion) himself has recounted it to you, out of delight.

verses.sanskrit: संस्मरेदैश्वरं लिङ्गं पञ्चायतनमव्ययम् । देहान्ते तत्परं ज्योतिरानन्दं विशते बुधः
verses.transliteration: saṃsmaredaiśvaraṃ liṅgaṃ pañcāyatanamavyayam / dehānte tatparaṃ jyotirānandaṃ viśate budhaḥ
verses.translation: Do you go to your own abode. It does not behove you to grieve over it. With the greatest devotion seek refuge in 5iva worthy of being the refuge."
verses.hindi: प्राजापत्यात् सत्यलोकः कोटिषद्केन संयुतः । वहाँ अपुनर्मारक (जन्म-मरणसे रहित जन) रहते हैं। अपुनर्मारकास्तत्र ब्रहालोकस्तु स स्मृतः॥ ४॥  वह ब्रह्मलोक कहा गया है। यहाँ परम योगामृतका पान अत्र लोकगुरुब्रह्मया विश्वात्मा विश्वतोमुख: । कर विश्वतोमुख विश्वात्मा लोकगुरु ब्रह्मा योगियोंके साथ आस्ते स योगिभिर्नित्यं पीत्वा योगामृतं परम्॥ ५॥  नित्य निवास करते हैं॥१--५॥ विशन्ति यतयः शान्ता नैष्ठिका ब्रह्मचारिणः। शान्त स्वभाववाले यतिगण, नैष्ठिक ब्रह्मचारी, योगी,
verses.wordMeaning: Do you go to your own abode. It does not behove you to grieve over it. With the greatest devotion seek refuge in 5iva worthy of being the refuge."
verses.commentary: Sense: Do you go to your own abode. It does not behove you to grieve over it. With the greatest devotion seek refuge in 5iva worthy of being the refuge."

verses.sanskrit: अत्र देवर्षयः पूर्वं सिद्धा ब्रह्मर्षयस्तथा । उपास्य देवमीशानं प्राप्तवन्तः परं पदम्
verses.transliteration: atra devarṣayaḥ pūrvaṃ siddhā brahmarṣayastathā / upāsya devamīśānaṃ prāptavantaḥ paraṃ padam
verses.translation: After saying this and having blessed Arjuna, the holy sage went to Sankara's city in order to propitiate Siva.
verses.hindi: योगिनस्तापसाः सिद्धा जापकाः परमेष्ठिनम्॥ ६॥  तपस्वी, सिद्ध तथा परमेष्ठीका जप करनेवाले यहाँ प्रवेश करते हैं। परमपदको प्राप्त करनेवाले योगियोंका वह एकमात्र
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this and having blessed Arjuna, the holy sage went to Sankara's city in order to propitiate Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this and having blessed Arjuna, the holy sage went to Sankara's city in order to propitiate Siva.

verses.sanskrit: मत्स्योदर्यास्तटे पुण्यं स्थानं गुह्यतमं शुभम् । गोचर्ममात्रं विप्रेन्द्रा ओङ्कारेश्वरमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: matsyodaryāstaṭe puṇyaṃ sthānaṃ guhyatamaṃ śubham / gocarmamātraṃ viprendrā oṅkāreśvaramuttamam
verses.translation: At his instance, Pandu's son Arjuna sought refuge in Siva. He eschewed all karmas. He became devoted to him through spiritual knowledge.
verses.hindi: द्वारं तद्योगिनामेकं गच्छतां परमं पदम्। द्वार है। वहाँ पहुँचकर (लोग) शोक नहीं करते। वही तत्र गत्वा न शोचन्ति स विष्णुः स च शंकरः॥ ७॥  (यहाँ निवास करनेवाला) विष्णु है, शंकर है
verses.wordMeaning: At his instance, Pandu's son Arjuna sought refuge in Siva. He eschewed all karmas. He became devoted to him through spiritual knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: At his instance, Pandu's son Arjuna sought refuge in Siva. He eschewed all karmas. He became devoted to him through spiritual knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्तिवासेश्वरं लिङ्गः मध्यमेश्वरमुत्तमम् । विश्वेश्वरं तथोङ्कारं कपर्देश्वरमेव च
verses.transliteration: kṛttivāseśvaraṃ liṅgaḥ madhyameśvaramuttamam / viśveśvaraṃ tathoṅkāraṃ kapardeśvarameva ca
verses.translation: Excepting the son of Satyavati (Vyasa) and Krsna, the son of Devaki, neither anyone has been, nor will be born who is equal to Arjuna in the matter of devotion to Sambhu.
verses.hindi: + दाह-तापसे रहित (हैहिक, हैविक, भौतिक तापोंसे सर्वथा मुक्त) ।
verses.wordMeaning: Excepting the son of Satyavati (Vyasa) and Krsna, the son of Devaki, neither anyone has been, nor will be born who is equal to Arjuna in the matter of devotion to Sambhu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Excepting the son of Satyavati (Vyasa) and Krsna, the son of Devaki, neither anyone has been, nor will be born who is equal to Arjuna in the matter of devotion to Sambhu.

verses.sanskrit: एतानि गुह्यलिङ्गानि वाराणस्यां द्विजोत्तमाः । न कश्चिदिह जानाति विना शंभोरनुग्रहात्
verses.transliteration: etāni guhyaliṅgāni vārāṇasyāṃ dvijottamāḥ / na kaścidiha jānāti vinā śaṃbhoranugrahāt
verses.translation: Obeisance forever, to the holy sage Vyasa son of Parasara, who is quiescent, intelligent and of unmeasured splendour,
verses.hindi: सूर्यकोटिप्रतीकाशं पुरं तस्य दुरासदम्। न मे वर्णयितुं शक्यं ज्चालामालासमाकुलम् तत्र नारायणस्यापि भवनं ब्रह्मणः पुरे।
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance forever, to the holy sage Vyasa son of Parasara, who is quiescent, intelligent and of unmeasured splendour,
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance forever, to the holy sage Vyasa son of Parasara, who is quiescent, intelligent and of unmeasured splendour,

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा ययौ कृष्णः पाराशर्यो महामुनिः । कृत्तिवासेश्वरं लिङ्गं द्रष्टुं देवस्य शूलिनः
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā yayau kṛṣṇaḥ pārāśaryo mahāmuniḥ / kṛttivāseśvaraṃ liṅgaṃ draṣṭuṃ devasya śūlinaḥ
verses.translation: Krsnadvaip ayana is the eternal Visnu incar¬ nate. Who else can know in reality Rudra Paramesvara (the Supreme Lord).
verses.hindi: स विष्णुलोकः कथितः पुनरावृत्तिवर्जितः। यान्ति तत्र महात्मानो ये प्रपन्ना जनार्दनम्
verses.wordMeaning: Krsnadvaip ayana is the eternal Visnu incar¬ nate. Who else can know in reality Rudra Paramesvara (the Supreme Lord).
verses.commentary: Sense: Krsnadvaip ayana is the eternal Visnu incar¬ nate. Who else can know in reality Rudra Paramesvara (the Supreme Lord).

verses.sanskrit: समभ्यर्च्य तथा शिष्यैर्माहात्म्यं कृत्तिवाससः । कथयामास शिष्येभ्यो भगवान् ब्रह्मवित्तमः
verses.transliteration: samabhyarcya tathā śiṣyairmāhātmyaṃ kṛttivāsasaḥ / kathayāmāsa śiṣyebhyo bhagavān brahmavittamaḥ
verses.translation: "Pay obeisance to that sage Krsnadvaipayana (Vyasa), the son of Satyavati and of Parasara, who was a Yogin of noble soul, the immutable Visnu himself."
verses.hindi: ऊर्ध्व तद् ब्रह्मसदनात् पुरं ज्योतिर्मयं शुभम्। वह्निना च परिक्षिप्तं तत्रास्ते भगवान् भवः देव्या सह महादेवश्चिन्त्यमानो मनीषिभिः। योगिभिः शतसाहस्त्रेर्भूति रुद्रैश्च संवृतः
verses.wordMeaning: "Pay obeisance to that sage Krsnadvaipayana (Vyasa), the son of Satyavati and of Parasara, who was a Yogin of noble soul, the immutable Visnu himself."
verses.commentary: Sense: "Pay obeisance to that sage Krsnadvaipayana (Vyasa), the son of Satyavati and of Parasara, who was a Yogin of noble soul, the immutable Visnu himself."

verses.sanskrit: अस्मिन् स्थाने पुरा दैत्यो हस्ती भूत्वा भवान्तिकम् । ब्राह्मणान् हन्तुमायातो ये ऽत्र नित्यमुपासते
verses.transliteration: asmin sthāne purā daityo hastī bhūtvā bhavāntikam / brāhmaṇān hantumāyāto ye 'tra nityamupāsate
verses.translation: Thus addressed, the sages bowed to the noble Vyasa, the son of Satyavati, with the concentration of mind.
verses.hindi: तत्र ते यान्ति नियता द्विजा वै ब्रह्मचारिणः । महादेवपराः शान्तास्तापसा ब्रह्मवादिनः
verses.wordMeaning: Thus addressed, the sages bowed to the noble Vyasa, the son of Satyavati, with the concentration of mind.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus addressed, the sages bowed to the noble Vyasa, the son of Satyavati, with the concentration of mind.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां लिङ्गान्महादेवः प्रादुरासीत् त्रिलोचनः । रक्षणार्थं द्विजश्रेष्ठा भक्तानां भक्तवत्सलः
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ liṅgānmahādevaḥ prādurāsīt trilocanaḥ / rakṣaṇārthaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhā bhaktānāṃ bhaktavatsalaḥ
verses.translation: In Yoga, certain parts of the body are believed to be locations ■of certain holy centres. For example Sri-parvata at the crest (head), Kedara at the forehead, Varanasi between the eyebrows. The Jdbala- • darianopanisad gives the list as follows:
verses.hindi: निर्ममा निरहंकाराः कामक्रोधविवर्जिताः। द्रक्ष्यन्ति ब्रह्मणा युक्ता रुद्रलोकः स वै स्मृतः एते सप्त महालोका: पृथिव्याः परिकीर्तिताः ।
verses.wordMeaning: In Yoga, certain parts of the body are believed to be locations ■of certain holy centres. For example Sri-parvata at the crest (head), Kedara at the forehead, Varanasi between the eyebrows. The Jdbala- • darianopanisad gives the list as follows:
verses.commentary: Sense: In Yoga, certain parts of the body are believed to be locations ■of certain holy centres. For example Sri-parvata at the crest (head), Kedara at the forehead, Varanasi between the eyebrows. The Jdbala- • darianopanisad gives the list as follows:

verses.sanskrit: हत्वा गजाकृतिं दैत्यं शूलेनावज्ञया हरः । वसस्तस्याकरोत् कृत्तिं कृत्तिवासेश्वरस्ततः
verses.transliteration: hatvā gajākṛtiṃ daityaṃ śūlenāvajñayā haraḥ / vasastasyākarot kṛttiṃ kṛttivāseśvarastataḥ
verses.translation: Smaidna is another name of Varanasi, the explanation of which is given here. The verse is repeated in Pd. P. I. 33.14. This explanation is repeated in SK. P. IV. 30.103-4.
verses.hindi: प्रासादेर्विविधैः शुध्रेर्देवतायतनैर्युतम्
verses.wordMeaning: Smaidna is another name of Varanasi, the explanation of which is given here. The verse is repeated in Pd. P. I. 33.14. This explanation is repeated in SK. P. IV. 30.103-4.
verses.commentary: Sense: Smaidna is another name of Varanasi, the explanation of which is given here. The verse is repeated in Pd. P. I. 33.14. This explanation is repeated in SK. P. IV. 30.103-4.

verses.sanskrit: अत्र सिद्धिं परां प्राप्ता मुनयो मुनिपुङ्गवाः । तेनैव च शरीरेण प्राप्तास्तत् परमं पदम्
verses.transliteration: atra siddhiṃ parāṃ prāptā munayo munipuṅgavāḥ / tenaiva ca śarīreṇa prāptāstat paramaṃ padam
verses.translation: On seeing that the sage Vyasa had come there, the sages who resided there, worshipped that leading sage.
verses.hindi: शैलं रसातलं विप्राः शार्करं हि तलातलम्। सुपर्णेन मुनिश्रेष्ठास्तथा वासुकिना शुभम्। रसातलमिति ख्यातं तथान्यैश्च निषेवितम्
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing that the sage Vyasa had come there, the sages who resided there, worshipped that leading sage.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing that the sage Vyasa had come there, the sages who resided there, worshipped that leading sage.

verses.sanskrit: विद्या विद्येश्वरा रुद्राः शिवाये च प्रकीर्तिताः । कृत्तिवासेश्वरं लिङ्गं नित्यमावृत्य संस्थिताः
verses.transliteration: vidyā vidyeśvarā rudrāḥ śivāye ca prakīrtitāḥ / kṛttivāseśvaraṃ liṅgaṃ nityamāvṛtya saṃsthitāḥ
verses.translation: Bowing down to him all of them requested him to relate the meritorious story with reference to Mahadeva, that destroyed all sins. They asked him about the eternal holy rites leading to salvation.
verses.hindi: विरोचनहिरण्याक्षतक्षकाद्यैश्च सेवितम्। तलातलमिति ख्यातं सर्वशोभासमन्वितम्
verses.wordMeaning: Bowing down to him all of them requested him to relate the meritorious story with reference to Mahadeva, that destroyed all sins. They asked him about the eternal holy rites leading to salvation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bowing down to him all of them requested him to relate the meritorious story with reference to Mahadeva, that destroyed all sins. They asked him about the eternal holy rites leading to salvation.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञात्वा कलियुगं घोरमधर्मबहुलं जनाः । कृत्तिवासं न मुञ्चन्ति कृतार्थास्ते न संशयः
verses.transliteration: jñātvā kaliyugaṃ ghoramadharmabahulaṃ janāḥ / kṛttivāsaṃ na muñcanti kṛtārthāste na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: The omniscient, great and holy sage recounted to them the greatness of the Lord of Devas—the greatness based on piety as pointed out by the Vedas.*
verses.hindi: वैनतेयादिभिश्चैब कालनेमिपुरोगमैः । पूर्वदेवैः समाकीर्णं सुतलं च तथापरैः नितलं यवनाद्यैश्च तारकाग्निमुखैस्तथा। महान्तकाद्यैनागैश्च प्रह्वादेनासुरेण च
verses.wordMeaning: The omniscient, great and holy sage recounted to them the greatness of the Lord of Devas—the greatness based on piety as pointed out by the Vedas.*
verses.commentary: Sense: The omniscient, great and holy sage recounted to them the greatness of the Lord of Devas—the greatness based on piety as pointed out by the Vedas.*

verses.sanskrit: जन्मान्तरसहस्त्रेण मोक्षो ऽन्यत्राप्यते न वा । एकेन जन्मना मोक्षः कृत्तिवासे तु लभ्यते
verses.transliteration: janmāntarasahastreṇa mokṣo 'nyatrāpyate na vā / ekena janmanā mokṣaḥ kṛttivāse tu labhyate
verses.translation: Among those leading sages Jaimini, the great sage and disciple of Vyasa, asked Vyasa about the eternal and mystic significance of those religious duties.
verses.hindi: वितलं चैव विख्यातं कम्बलाहीन्द्रसेवित्म्। महाजम्भेन वीरेण हयग्रीवेण वै तथा
