verses.wordMeaning: Among those leading sages Jaimini, the great sage and disciple of Vyasa, asked Vyasa about the eternal and mystic significance of those religious duties.
verses.commentary: Sense: Among those leading sages Jaimini, the great sage and disciple of Vyasa, asked Vyasa about the eternal and mystic significance of those religious duties.

verses.sanskrit: आलयः सर्वसिद्धानामेतत् स्थानं वदन्ति हि । गोपितं देवदेवेन महादेवेन शंभुना
verses.transliteration: ālayaḥ sarvasiddhānāmetat sthānaṃ vadanti hi / gopitaṃ devadevena mahādevena śaṃbhunā
verses.translation: Among those leading sages Jaimini, the great sage and disciple of Vyasa, asked Vyasa about the eternal and mystic significance of those religious duties.
verses.hindi: शंकुकर्णेन सम्भिन्नं तथा नमुचिपूर्वकैः। तथान्यैर्विविधैनागैस्तलं चैव सुशोभनम् करोड़ों सूर्यके समान उन (ब्रह्मा)-का वह पुर अत्यन्त दुर्गम है। अग्निशिखाकी मालाओंसे समन्वित उस पुरका मैं वर्णन नहीं कर सकता। ब्रह्माके उस पुरमें नारायणका भी भवन है। वहाँ मायामय परम मायावान्
verses.wordMeaning: Among those leading sages Jaimini, the great sage and disciple of Vyasa, asked Vyasa about the eternal and mystic significance of those religious duties.
verses.commentary: Sense: Among those leading sages Jaimini, the great sage and disciple of Vyasa, asked Vyasa about the eternal and mystic significance of those religious duties.

verses.sanskrit: युगे युगे ह्यत्र दान्ता ब्राह्मणा वेदपारागाः । उपासते महादेवं जपन्ति शतरुद्रियम्
verses.transliteration: yuge yuge hyatra dāntā brāhmaṇā vedapārāgāḥ / upāsate mahādevaṃ japanti śatarudriyam
verses.translation: Among those leading sages Jaimini, the great sage and disciple of Vyasa, asked Vyasa about the eternal and mystic significance of those religious duties.
verses.hindi: श्रीमान् हरि शयन करते हैं। पुनरागमनसे रहित वह विष्णुलोक कहा गया है। जो जनार्दनके शरणागत हैं, वे महात्मा वहाँ जाते हैं। उस ब्रह्म-सदनसे ऊपर ज्योतिर्मय, अग्निसे व्याप्त कल्याणकारी पुर है। वहाँ
verses.wordMeaning: Among those leading sages Jaimini, the great sage and disciple of Vyasa, asked Vyasa about the eternal and mystic significance of those religious duties.
verses.commentary: Sense: Among those leading sages Jaimini, the great sage and disciple of Vyasa, asked Vyasa about the eternal and mystic significance of those religious duties.

verses.sanskrit: स्तुवन्ति सततं देवं त्र्यम्बकं कृत्तिवाससम् । ध्यायन्ति हृदये देवं स्थाणुं सर्वान्तरं शिवम्
verses.transliteration: stuvanti satataṃ devaṃ tryambakaṃ kṛttivāsasam / dhyāyanti hṛdaye devaṃ sthāṇuṃ sarvāntaraṃ śivam
verses.translation: Among those leading sages Jaimini, the great sage and disciple of Vyasa, asked Vyasa about the eternal and mystic significance of those religious duties.
verses.hindi: सेकड़ों-हजारों योगियों, भूतों तथा रुद्रोंसे परिवृत, मनीषियोंके द्वारा ध्यान किये जाते हुए वे भगवान् भव महादेव देवी पार्वतीके साथ निवास करते हैं वहाँ वे ही जाते हैं जो संयमी ब्राह्मण हैं, ब्रह्मचारी हैं, महादेवपरायण हैं, शान्त, तपस्वी और ब्रह्मवादी हैं, ममत्वरहित, अहंकारशून्य तथा काम-क्रोधसे रहित हैं। ब्रह्मज्ञानसम्पन्न ये (व्यक्ति इस लोकका) दर्शन करते हैं ।
verses.wordMeaning: Among those leading sages Jaimini, the great sage and disciple of Vyasa, asked Vyasa about the eternal and mystic significance of those religious duties.
verses.commentary: Sense: Among those leading sages Jaimini, the great sage and disciple of Vyasa, asked Vyasa about the eternal and mystic significance of those religious duties.

verses.sanskrit: गायन्ति सिद्धाः किल गीतकानि ये वाराणस्यां निवसन्ति विप्राः । तेषामथैकेन भवेन मुक्तिर् ये कृत्तिवासं शरणं प्रपन्नाः
verses.transliteration: gāyanti siddhāḥ kila gītakāni ye vārāṇasyāṃ nivasanti viprāḥ / teṣāmathaikena bhavena muktir ye kṛttivāsaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapannāḥ
verses.translation: Among those leading sages Jaimini, the great sage and disciple of Vyasa, asked Vyasa about the eternal and mystic significance of those religious duties.
verses.hindi: उस लोकको रुद्रलोक कहा गया है
verses.wordMeaning: Among those leading sages Jaimini, the great sage and disciple of Vyasa, asked Vyasa about the eternal and mystic significance of those religious duties.
verses.commentary: Sense: Among those leading sages Jaimini, the great sage and disciple of Vyasa, asked Vyasa about the eternal and mystic significance of those religious duties.

verses.sanskrit: संप्राप्य लोके जगतामभीष्टं सुदुर्लभं विप्रकुलेषु जन्म । ध्याने समाधाय जपन्ति रुद्रं ध्यायन्ति चित्ते यतयो महेशम्
verses.transliteration: saṃprāpya loke jagatāmabhīṣṭaṃ sudurlabhaṃ viprakuleṣu janma / dhyāne samādhāya japanti rudraṃ dhyāyanti citte yatayo maheśam
verses.translation: Among those leading sages Jaimini, the great sage and disciple of Vyasa, asked Vyasa about the eternal and mystic significance of those religious duties.
verses.hindi: हे द्विजो! पृथ्वीके ये सात महालोक कहे गये हैं। (पृथ्वीके) अधोभागमें महातल आदि (सात) पाताल हैं। महातल नामक पाताल सभी रलोंसे सुशोभित और अनेक प्रकारके महलों और शुभ्र देवमन्दिरोंसे सम्पन्न है। वह (महातल) अनन्त (नाग), धीमान् मुचुकुन्द एवं पाताल-स्वर्गवासी राजा बलिसे युक्त है। है विप्रो! रसातल शैलमय है, तलातल शर्करामय है । सुतल पीत वर्णका कहा गया है। नितल विद्रुम (मूँगे)-के समान
verses.wordMeaning: Among those leading sages Jaimini, the great sage and disciple of Vyasa, asked Vyasa about the eternal and mystic significance of those religious duties.
verses.commentary: Sense: Among those leading sages Jaimini, the great sage and disciple of Vyasa, asked Vyasa about the eternal and mystic significance of those religious duties.

verses.sanskrit: आराधयन्ति प्रभुमीशितारं वाराणसीमध्यगता मुनिन्द्राः । यजन्ति यज्ञैरभिसंधिहीनाः स्तुवन्ति रुद्रं प्रणमन्ति शंभुम्
verses.transliteration: ārādhayanti prabhumīśitāraṃ vārāṇasīmadhyagatā munindrāḥ / yajanti yajñairabhisaṃdhihīnāḥ stuvanti rudraṃ praṇamanti śaṃbhum
verses.translation: Among those leading sages Jaimini, the great sage and disciple of Vyasa, asked Vyasa about the eternal and mystic significance of those religious duties.
verses.hindi: वर्णवाला, वितल श्वेत वर्णका और तल कृष्ण वर्णका कहा गया है
verses.wordMeaning: Among those leading sages Jaimini, the great sage and disciple of Vyasa, asked Vyasa about the eternal and mystic significance of those religious duties.
verses.commentary: Sense: Among those leading sages Jaimini, the great sage and disciple of Vyasa, asked Vyasa about the eternal and mystic significance of those religious duties.

verses.sanskrit: नमो भवायामलयोगधाम्ने स्थाणुं प्रपद्ये गिरिशं पुराणम् । स्मरामि रुद्रं हृदये निविष्टं जाने महादेवमनेकरूपम्
verses.transliteration: namo bhavāyāmalayogadhāmne sthāṇuṃ prapadye giriśaṃ purāṇam / smarāmi rudraṃ hṛdaye niviṣṭaṃ jāne mahādevamanekarūpam
verses.translation: Among those leading sages Jaimini, the great sage and disciple of Vyasa, asked Vyasa about the eternal and mystic significance of those religious duties.
verses.hindi: हे मुनिश्रेष्ठो! शुभ रसातल गरुड, वासुकि (नाग) तथा अन्य (महात्माओं)-से सेवित कहा गया है। सभी शोभाओंसे युक्त तलातल विरोचन, हिरण्याक्ष तथा तक्षक आदिके द्वारा सेवित कहा गया है। सुतल वैनतेय आदि पक्षी, कालनेमि प्रभृति दूसरे श्रेष्ठ असुरोंसे समाकीर्ण है। तारक, अग्निमुख आदि यवन और महान् अन्तक आदि नागों तथा असुर प्रह्वादसे नितल नामक पाताल सेवित है। वितल नामक प्रसिद्ध पाताल कम्बल
verses.wordMeaning: Among those leading sages Jaimini, the great sage and disciple of Vyasa, asked Vyasa about the eternal and mystic significance of those religious duties.
verses.commentary: Sense: Among those leading sages Jaimini, the great sage and disciple of Vyasa, asked Vyasa about the eternal and mystic significance of those religious duties.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागेत्रिंशो ऽध्यायः सूत उवाच समाभाष्य मुनीन् धीमान् देवदेवस्य शूलिनः । जगाम लिङ्गं तद् द्रष्टुं कपर्देश्वरमव्ययम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāgetriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca samābhāṣya munīn dhīmān devadevasya śūlinaḥ / jagāma liṅgaṃ tad draṣṭuṃ kapardeśvaramavyayam
verses.translation: O holy sage, it behoves you, the omniscient one, to dispel one of our doubts. There is nothing which is unknown to you, the great sage,
verses.hindi: नामक नागराज, महाजम्भ और वीर हयग्रीवसे सेवित है। तल नामक पाताल शंकुकर्णसे युक्त तथा प्रधान नमुचि आदि हैत्यों और अन्य विविध प्रकारके नागोंसे सुशोभित है॥ १९--२४॥
verses.wordMeaning: O holy sage, it behoves you, the omniscient one, to dispel one of our doubts. There is nothing which is unknown to you, the great sage,
verses.commentary: Sense: O holy sage, it behoves you, the omniscient one, to dispel one of our doubts. There is nothing which is unknown to you, the great sage,

verses.sanskrit: स्नात्वा तत्र विधानेन तर्पयित्वा पितॄन् द्विजाः । पिशाचमोचने तीर्थे पूजयामास शूलिनम्
verses.transliteration: snātvā tatra vidhānena tarpayitvā pitṝn dvijāḥ / piśācamocane tīrthe pūjayāmāsa śūlinam
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Jaimini, Sage Krsnadvai- payana bowed down to the bull-bannered deity (Siva) and said in a majestic tone.
verses.hindi: तेषामधस्तान्नरका मायाद्या: परिकोर्तिताः । पापिनस्तेषु पच्यन्ते न ते वर्णयितुं क्षमा: कालाग्निरुद्रो योगात्मा नारसिंहो ऽपि माधव:
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the words of Jaimini, Sage Krsnadvai- payana bowed down to the bull-bannered deity (Siva) and said in a majestic tone.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of Jaimini, Sage Krsnadvai- payana bowed down to the bull-bannered deity (Siva) and said in a majestic tone.

verses.sanskrit: तत्राश्चर्यमपश्यंस्ते मुनयो गुरुणा सह । मेनिरे क्षेत्रमाहात्म्यं प्रणेमुर्गिरिशं हरम्
verses.transliteration: tatrāścaryamapaśyaṃste munayo guruṇā saha / menire kṣetramāhātmyaṃ praṇemurgiriśaṃ haram
verses.translation: O excessively blessed one, excellent, very nice. O sage, I shall explain what has been asked by you. It is the secret of secrets. May the other sages too hear it.
verses.hindi: योऽनन्तः पठ्यते देवो नागरूपी जनार्दनः । तदाधारमिदं सर्व स कालाग्निमपाश्रितः
verses.wordMeaning: O excessively blessed one, excellent, very nice. O sage, I shall explain what has been asked by you. It is the secret of secrets. May the other sages too hear it.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excessively blessed one, excellent, very nice. O sage, I shall explain what has been asked by you. It is the secret of secrets. May the other sages too hear it.

verses.sanskrit: कश्चिदभ्याजगामेदं शार्दूलो घोररूपधृक् । मृगीमेकां भक्षयितुं कपर्देश्वरमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: kaścidabhyājagāmedaṃ śārdūlo ghorarūpadhṛk / mṛgīmekāṃ bhakṣayituṃ kapardeśvaramuttamam
verses.translation: This eternal perfect knowledge was explained by Isvara formerly. It is a great secret disliked by non-intelligent persons but resorted to by men of subtle vision.
verses.hindi: तमाविश्य महायोगी कालस्तद्वदनोत्थित: । विषज्चालामयोऽन्तेऽसौ जगत् संहरति स्वयम् सहस्त्रमायोऽप्रतिमः संहर्ता शंकरोद्भवः। तामसी शाम्भवी मूर्तिः कालो लोकप्रकालनः
verses.wordMeaning: This eternal perfect knowledge was explained by Isvara formerly. It is a great secret disliked by non-intelligent persons but resorted to by men of subtle vision.
verses.commentary: Sense: This eternal perfect knowledge was explained by Isvara formerly. It is a great secret disliked by non-intelligent persons but resorted to by men of subtle vision.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र सा भीतहृदया कृत्वा कृत्वा प्रदक्षिणम् । धावमाना सुसंभ्रान्ता व्याघ्रस्य वशमागता
verses.transliteration: tatra sā bhītahṛdayā kṛtvā kṛtvā pradakṣiṇam / dhāvamānā susaṃbhrāntā vyāghrasya vaśamāgatā
verses.translation: This excellent knowledge, the best among all types of knowledge, should not be imparted to one who has no faith, nor to one who is not a devotee of Paramesthin; nor should it be given to one who is not the knower of Vedas.
verses.hindi: उन (पातालों)-के नीचे माया आदि नरक कहे गये हैं, उनमें पापी लोग यातना पाते हैं। उनका वर्णन नहीं किया जा सकता। पाताललोकके नीचे शेष नामवाली वैष्णवी मूर्ति विद्यमान है । जिसे कालाग्नि रुद्र,
verses.wordMeaning: This excellent knowledge, the best among all types of knowledge, should not be imparted to one who has no faith, nor to one who is not a devotee of Paramesthin; nor should it be given to one who is not the knower of Vedas.
verses.commentary: Sense: This excellent knowledge, the best among all types of knowledge, should not be imparted to one who has no faith, nor to one who is not a devotee of Paramesthin; nor should it be given to one who is not the knower of Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: तां विदार्य नखैस्तीक्ष्णैः शार्दूलः सुमहाबलः । जगाम चान्यं विजनं देशं दृष्ट्वा मुनीश्वरान्
verses.transliteration: tāṃ vidārya nakhaistīkṣṇaiḥ śārdūlaḥ sumahābalaḥ / jagāma cānyaṃ vijanaṃ deśaṃ dṛṣṭvā munīśvarān
verses.translation: The goddess, seated on her divine seat on the peak of Aleru asked Mahadeva, Isana, the enemy of the Tripuras.
verses.hindi: योगात्मा, नारसिंह, माधव, अनन्त, देव और नागरूपी जनार्दन भी कहा जाता है। यह सब उन्हींके आधारपर (टिका) है और वे कालाग्निके आश्रित हैं। उनमें प्रविष्ट होकर और उनके मुखसे प्रकट हुई विषकी ज्चालारूप होकर महायोगी काल स्वयं अन्तमें जगतका संहार करते हैं॥ २५--२८॥
verses.wordMeaning: The goddess, seated on her divine seat on the peak of Aleru asked Mahadeva, Isana, the enemy of the Tripuras.
verses.commentary: Sense: The goddess, seated on her divine seat on the peak of Aleru asked Mahadeva, Isana, the enemy of the Tripuras.

verses.sanskrit: मृतमात्रा च सा बाला कपर्देशाग्रतो मृगी । अदृश्यत महाज्वाला व्योम्नि सूर्यसमप्रभा
verses.transliteration: mṛtamātrā ca sā bālā kapardeśāgrato mṛgī / adṛśyata mahājvālā vyomni sūryasamaprabhā
verses.translation: O Mahadeva, O lord of Devas, O destroyer of the distress of devotees, how can a man perceive you, the lord, in a short while?
verses.hindi: हजारों मायावाला एवं शंकरसे उत्पन्न अद्वितीय (काल) संहार करनेवाला है। वह शम्भुकी तामसी मूर्ति है। काल ही लोकोंका संहार करता है
verses.wordMeaning: O Mahadeva, O lord of Devas, O destroyer of the distress of devotees, how can a man perceive you, the lord, in a short while?
verses.commentary: Sense: O Mahadeva, O lord of Devas, O destroyer of the distress of devotees, how can a man perceive you, the lord, in a short while?

verses.sanskrit: त्रिनेत्रा नीलकण्ठा च शशाङ्काङ्कितमूर्धजा । वृषाधिरूढा पुरुषैस्तादृशैरेव संवृता
verses.transliteration: trinetrā nīlakaṇṭhā ca śaśāṅkāṅkitamūrdhajā / vṛṣādhirūḍhā puruṣaistādṛśaireva saṃvṛtā
verses.translation: O Sankara, the systems of Sarhkhya and Yoga, the penance, the meditation, the Vedic path of action and other things as well, they say, are very strenuous and tedious.
verses.hindi: सात महाद्वीपों और सात महासागरोंका परिमाण, जम्बूद्वीप तथा मेरुपर्वतकी स्थिति, भारत तथा किंपुरुष आदि वर्षोंका वर्णन, वर्षपर्वतोंकी स्थिति, जम्बूद्वीपके नाम पड़नेका कारण, जम्बूद्वीपके नदी एवं पर्वतोंका और वहाँके निवासियोंका वर्णन एतद् ब्रह्माण्डमाख्यातं चतुर्दशविधं महत्। अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि भूर्लोकस्यास्य निर्णयम्
verses.wordMeaning: O Sankara, the systems of Sarhkhya and Yoga, the penance, the meditation, the Vedic path of action and other things as well, they say, are very strenuous and tedious.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Sankara, the systems of Sarhkhya and Yoga, the penance, the meditation, the Vedic path of action and other things as well, they say, are very strenuous and tedious.

verses.sanskrit: पुष्पवृष्टिं विमुञ्चिन्ति खेचरास्तस्य मूर्धनि । गणेश्वरः स्वयं भूत्वा न दृष्टस्तत्क्षणात् ततः
verses.transliteration: puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ vimuñcinti khecarāstasya mūrdhani / gaṇeśvaraḥ svayaṃ bhūtvā na dṛṣṭastatkṣaṇāt tataḥ
verses.translation: This knowledge, excluded by (i.e. incomprehensible to) the ignorant, is of great mysterious meaning and is not to be revealed to anybody else. I shall explain it to you, precisely, as mentioned by great sages.
verses.hindi: पञ्चाशत्कोटिविस्तीर्णा ससमुद्रा धरा स्मृता। द्वीपैश्च सप्तभिर्युक्ता योजनानां समासतः
verses.wordMeaning: This knowledge, excluded by (i.e. incomprehensible to) the ignorant, is of great mysterious meaning and is not to be revealed to anybody else. I shall explain it to you, precisely, as mentioned by great sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: This knowledge, excluded by (i.e. incomprehensible to) the ignorant, is of great mysterious meaning and is not to be revealed to anybody else. I shall explain it to you, precisely, as mentioned by great sages.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वैतदाश्चर्यवरं जैमिनिप्रमुखा द्विजाः । कपर्देश्वरमाहात्म्यं पप्रच्छुर्गुरुमच्युतम्
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvaitadāścaryavaraṃ jaiminipramukhā dvijāḥ / kapardeśvaramāhātmyaṃ papracchurgurumacyutam
verses.translation: The city of Varanasi is my secret-most holy centre. It is the cause that enables all living beings to cross the ocean of worldly existence.
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले--इस चौदह (सात पाताल तथा सात ऊर्ध्वलोक) प्रकारके महान् ब्रह्माण्डका वर्णन किया गया। इसके बाद इस भूलोकके निर्णयको कहूँगा । ( भूलोकमें) जम्बूह्वीप प्रधान है। (इसके अतिरिक्त) पुष्कर द्वीप है। ये सातो महाद्वीप सात समुद्रोंसे घिरे हैं, एक द्वीपसे दूसरा द्वीप तथा एक सागरसे दूसरा सागर महान् कहा गया है। क्षारोदक, इक्षुरसोदक, सुरोदक,
verses.wordMeaning: The city of Varanasi is my secret-most holy centre. It is the cause that enables all living beings to cross the ocean of worldly existence.
verses.commentary: Sense: The city of Varanasi is my secret-most holy centre. It is the cause that enables all living beings to cross the ocean of worldly existence.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां प्रोवाच भगवान् देवाग्रे चोपविश्य सः । कपर्देशस्य माहात्म्यं प्रणम्य वृषभध्वजम्
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ provāca bhagavān devāgre copaviśya saḥ / kapardeśasya māhātmyaṃ praṇamya vṛṣabhadhvajam
verses.translation: The great-souled devotees of mine who have taken to the observance of my vows and who adhere to those great observances, stay at that place.
verses.hindi: महासागर हैं। संक्षेपमें समुद्रसहित यह पृथ्वी पचास करोड़ योजन विस्तारवाली कही जाती है। यह सात द्वीपोंसे परिवेष्टित है समस्त द्वीपोंके मध्यमें शुभ जम्बूद्वीप स्थित है। उसके बीचमें स्वर्णके समान आभावाला
verses.wordMeaning: The great-souled devotees of mine who have taken to the observance of my vows and who adhere to those great observances, stay at that place.
verses.commentary: Sense: The great-souled devotees of mine who have taken to the observance of my vows and who adhere to those great observances, stay at that place.

verses.sanskrit: इदं देवस्य तल्लिङ्गं कपर्दोश्वरमुत्तमम् । स्मृत्वैवाशेषपापौघं क्षिप्रमस्य विमुञ्चति
verses.transliteration: idaṃ devasya talliṅgaṃ kapardośvaramuttamam / smṛtvaivāśeṣapāpaughaṃ kṣipramasya vimuñcati
verses.translation: It is the most excellent of all holy centres; the best of all abodes; the most excellent of all types of knowledge; it is my sacred place Avimukta.
verses.hindi: महामेरु कहा गया है ॥ १--६॥ भूपदास्यास्य शैलोऽसौ कर्णिकात्वेन संस्थितः
verses.wordMeaning: It is the most excellent of all holy centres; the best of all abodes; the most excellent of all types of knowledge; it is my sacred place Avimukta.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is the most excellent of all holy centres; the best of all abodes; the most excellent of all types of knowledge; it is my sacred place Avimukta.

verses.sanskrit: कामक्रोधादयो दोषा वाराणसीनिवासिनाम् । विघ्नाः सर्वे विनश्यन्ति कपर्देश्वरपूजनात्
verses.transliteration: kāmakrodhādayo doṣā vārāṇasīnivāsinām / vighnāḥ sarve vinaśyanti kapardeśvarapūjanāt
verses.translation: The holy centres and shrines situated in other places, in heaven, on earth and in cremation grounds are all found here.
verses.hindi: रसेन तस्याः प्रख्याता तत्र जम्बूनदीति वै। सरित् प्रवर्तते चापि पीयते तत्र वासिभिः
verses.wordMeaning: The holy centres and shrines situated in other places, in heaven, on earth and in cremation grounds are all found here.
verses.commentary: Sense: The holy centres and shrines situated in other places, in heaven, on earth and in cremation grounds are all found here.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् सदैव द्रष्टव्यं कपर्देश्वरमुत्तमम् । पूजितव्यं प्रयत्नेन स्तोतव्यं वैदिकैः स्तवैः
verses.transliteration: tasmāt sadaiva draṣṭavyaṃ kapardeśvaramuttamam / pūjitavyaṃ prayatnena stotavyaṃ vaidikaiḥ stavaiḥ
verses.translation: My abode is not in contact with the earth, it is in the firmament. Those who are not liberated do not perceive it; the liberated ones observe it through the mind.
verses.hindi: उसकी ऊँचाई चौरासी हजार योजन है। नीचेकी ओर यह सोलह योजनतक प्रविष्ट है और ऊपरकी ओर बत्तीस योजन विस्तृत है। उस पर्वतके मूलमें सभी ओर सोलह हजार योजनका विस्तार है। यह पर्वत इस पृथ्वीरूप कमलकी कर्णिकाके रूपमें अवस्थित है। इसके दक्षिणमें हिमवान्, हेमकूट तथा निषध और उत्तरमें नील, श्वेत एवं श्रृंगी नामक वर्षपर्वत हैं। इनमें
verses.wordMeaning: My abode is not in contact with the earth, it is in the firmament. Those who are not liberated do not perceive it; the liberated ones observe it through the mind.
verses.commentary: Sense: My abode is not in contact with the earth, it is in the firmament. Those who are not liberated do not perceive it; the liberated ones observe it through the mind.

verses.sanskrit: ध्यायतामत्र नियतं योगिनां शान्तचेतसाम् । जायते योगसंसिद्धिः सा षण्मासे न संशयः
verses.transliteration: dhyāyatāmatra niyataṃ yogināṃ śāntacetasām / jāyate yogasaṃsiddhiḥ sā ṣaṇmāse na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: This city is known as Avimukta (not deserted by me). It is the well-known cremation ground. O beautiful women; it is here that I annihilate this universe after becoming Kala.
verses.hindi: परिमाणवाले हैं और अन्य (वर्षपर्वत) दस योजन कम विस्तारवाले हैं। इनकी ऊँचाई दो हजार योजनकी है और उनका विस्तार भी उतना ही है॥७--१०॥
verses.wordMeaning: This city is known as Avimukta (not deserted by me). It is the well-known cremation ground. O beautiful women; it is here that I annihilate this universe after becoming Kala.
verses.commentary: Sense: This city is known as Avimukta (not deserted by me). It is the well-known cremation ground. O beautiful women; it is here that I annihilate this universe after becoming Kala.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्महत्यादयः पापा विनश्यन्त्यस्य पूजनात् । पिशाचमोचने कुण्डे स्नातस्यात्र समीपतः
verses.transliteration: brahmahatyādayaḥ pāpā vinaśyantyasya pūjanāt / piśācamocane kuṇḍe snātasyātra samīpataḥ
verses.translation: O goddess, of all my secret abodes, this is the most lovable to me. Whenever my devotees go here, they enter me alone.
verses.hindi: हे द्विजो! मेरुके दक्षिण भागमें प्रथम भारतवर्ष, भी वैसे ही स्थित हैं। उसके उत्तरमें रम्यक, हिरण्मय एवं उत्तरकुरुवर्ष स्थित है। ये सभी भारतवर्षके समान हैं
verses.wordMeaning: O goddess, of all my secret abodes, this is the most lovable to me. Whenever my devotees go here, they enter me alone.
verses.commentary: Sense: O goddess, of all my secret abodes, this is the most lovable to me. Whenever my devotees go here, they enter me alone.

verses.sanskrit: अस्मिन् क्षेत्रे पुरा विप्रास्तपस्वी शंसितव्रतः । शङ्कुकर्ण इति ख्यातः पूजयामास शङ्करम् । जजाप रुद्रमनिशं प्रणवं ब्रह्मरूपिणम्
verses.transliteration: asmin kṣetre purā viprāstapasvī śaṃsitavrataḥ / śaṅkukarṇa iti khyātaḥ pūjayāmāsa śaṅkaram / jajāpa rudramaniśaṃ praṇavaṃ brahmarūpiṇam
verses.translation: What is offered there as a charitable gift, the Japa performed there, the Homas, the Yajhas and the penances performed there, the meditation, the study of the Vedas and the knowledge pursued there—all these shall be inexhaustible in benefit here.
verses.hindi: द्विजश्रेष्ठो! इनमेंसे प्रत्येक नौ हजार योजनका है। इनके मध्यमें इलावृतवर्ष है और इसके मध्यमें उन्नत मेरु पर्वत है। है महाभागो! वहाँ मेरुके चारों ओर नौ हजार योजनका इलावृत नामक वर्ष है। वहाँ चार पर्वत
verses.wordMeaning: What is offered there as a charitable gift, the Japa performed there, the Homas, the Yajhas and the penances performed there, the meditation, the study of the Vedas and the knowledge pursued there—all these shall be inexhaustible in benefit here.
verses.commentary: Sense: What is offered there as a charitable gift, the Japa performed there, the Homas, the Yajhas and the penances performed there, the meditation, the study of the Vedas and the knowledge pursued there—all these shall be inexhaustible in benefit here.

verses.sanskrit: पुष्पधूपादिभिः स्तोत्रैर्नमस्कारैः प्रदक्षिणैः । उवास तत्र योगात्मा कृत्वा दीक्षां तु नैष्ठिकीम
verses.transliteration: puṣpadhūpādibhiḥ stotrairnamaskāraiḥ pradakṣiṇaiḥ / uvāsa tatra yogātmā kṛtvā dīkṣāṃ tu naiṣṭhikīma
verses.translation: All sins accumulated previously in the course of thousands of births are annihilated, the moment one enters the holy centre of Avimukta.
verses.hindi: हैं। मेरुके व्यासके रूपमें विरचित इनकी ऊँचाई दस हजार योजन है। इसके पूर्वमें मन्दर, दक्षिणमें गन्धमादन, पश्चिम पार्श्वमें विपुल और उत्तरमें सुपार्श्व नामक पर्वत कहा गया हैं॥ १३--१५॥ उसमें (सुपार्श्व पर्वतमें) कदम्ब, जम्बू, पीपल और वट वृक्ष हैं। है महर्षियो! यही जम्बूवृक्ष जम्बूद्वीप नाम पड्नेका कारण है। उस जम्बूवृक्षके फल महान् हाथीके प्रमाणवाले होते हैं । पर्वतके पृष्ठपर गिरनेसे वे विशीर्ण
verses.wordMeaning: All sins accumulated previously in the course of thousands of births are annihilated, the moment one enters the holy centre of Avimukta.
verses.commentary: Sense: All sins accumulated previously in the course of thousands of births are annihilated, the moment one enters the holy centre of Avimukta.

verses.sanskrit: कदाचिदागतं प्रेतं पश्यति स्म क्षुधान्वितम् । अस्थिचर्मपिनद्धाङ्गं निः श्वसन्तं मुहुर्मुहुः
verses.transliteration: kadācidāgataṃ pretaṃ paśyati sma kṣudhānvitam / asthicarmapinaddhāṅgaṃ niḥ śvasantaṃ muhurmuhuḥ
verses.translation: A sinner dying in Avimukta never goes to hell. All of them blessed by Isvara, attain the great goal.
verses.hindi: हो जाते हैं। वहाँ उनके रससे प्रवाहित होनेवाली नदी जम्बूनदीके नामसे विख्यात है। वहाँके निवासी उस रसका पान किया करते हैं। वहाँ उस रस (जल)-का पान करनेसे स्वस्थ मनवाले मनुष्योंको न स्वेद (पसीना)
verses.wordMeaning: A sinner dying in Avimukta never goes to hell. All of them blessed by Isvara, attain the great goal.
verses.commentary: Sense: A sinner dying in Avimukta never goes to hell. All of them blessed by Isvara, attain the great goal.

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा स मुनिश्रेष्ठः कृपया परया युतः । प्रोवाच को भवान् कस्माद् देशाद् देशमिमंश्रितः
verses.transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvā sa muniśreṣṭhaḥ kṛpayā parayā yutaḥ / provāca ko bhavān kasmād deśād deśamimaṃśritaḥ
verses.translation: Realising that salvation is very difficult to achieve and the world is very terrible, a man should strike his feet with stone and stay on in Varanasi.
verses.hindi: होता है, न उनमें दुर्गन्धि होती है, न वृद्धावस्था आती है और न ही उनकी इन्द्रियाँ क्षीण होती हैं। उस (जम्बू नदी)-के तटपर स्थित मिट्टीके रसका वायु शोषण कर लेता है, जिससे जाम्बूनद नामक सुवर्ण होता है, सिद्धगण उसीका आभूषण धारण करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Realising that salvation is very difficult to achieve and the world is very terrible, a man should strike his feet with stone and stay on in Varanasi.
verses.commentary: Sense: Realising that salvation is very difficult to achieve and the world is very terrible, a man should strike his feet with stone and stay on in Varanasi.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मै पिशाचः क्षुधया पीड्यमानो ऽब्रवीद् वचः । पूर्वजन्मन्यहं विप्रो धनधान्यसमन्वितः । पुत्रपौत्रादिभिर्युक्तः कुटुम्बभरणोत्सुकः
verses.transliteration: tasmai piśācaḥ kṣudhayā pīḍyamāno 'bravīd vacaḥ / pūrvajanmanyahaṃ vipro dhanadhānyasamanvitaḥ / putrapautrādibhiryuktaḥ kuṭumbabharaṇotsukaḥ
verses.translation: O Paramesvarl, it is very rare that a living being attains penance * there, but to him who dies there, the goal is conducive to liberation from worldly existence.
verses.hindi: भद्राश्वः पूर्वतो मेरोः केतुमालश्च पश्चिमे। वर्ष द्वे तु मुनिश्रेष्ठास्तयोर्मध्ये इलावृतम्
verses.wordMeaning: O Paramesvarl, it is very rare that a living being attains penance * there, but to him who dies there, the goal is conducive to liberation from worldly existence.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Paramesvarl, it is very rare that a living being attains penance * there, but to him who dies there, the goal is conducive to liberation from worldly existence.

verses.sanskrit: न पूजिता मया देवा गावो ऽप्यतिथयस्तथा । न कदाचित् कृतं पुण्यमल्पं वा स्वल्पमेव वा
verses.transliteration: na pūjitā mayā devā gāvo 'pyatithayastathā / na kadācit kṛtaṃ puṇyamalpaṃ vā svalpameva vā
verses.translation: O daughter of the lord of mountains, thanks to my grace, sin perishes here. But insensible men, deluded by my Maya do not perceive it.
verses.hindi: सरांस्येतानि चत्वारि देवभोग्यानि सर्वदा वैकङ्को मणिशैलश्च ऋक्षवांश्चाचलोत्तमाः
verses.wordMeaning: O daughter of the lord of mountains, thanks to my grace, sin perishes here. But insensible men, deluded by my Maya do not perceive it.
verses.commentary: Sense: O daughter of the lord of mountains, thanks to my grace, sin perishes here. But insensible men, deluded by my Maya do not perceive it.

verses.sanskrit: एकदा भगवान् देवो गोवृषेश्वरवाहनः । विश्वेश्वरो वाराणस्यां दृष्टः स्पृष्टे नमस्कृतः
verses.transliteration: ekadā bhagavān devo govṛṣeśvaravāhanaḥ / viśveśvaro vārāṇasyāṃ dṛṣṭaḥ spṛṣṭe namaskṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Those who are deluded and enveloped by darkness do not perceive Avimukta. They enter in the midst of faeces, urine and semen again and again.
verses.hindi: वेणुमांश्चैव मेघश्च निषधो देवपर्वतः । इत्येते देवरचिताः सिद्धावासाः प्रकीर्तिताः
verses.wordMeaning: Those who are deluded and enveloped by darkness do not perceive Avimukta. They enter in the midst of faeces, urine and semen again and again.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who are deluded and enveloped by darkness do not perceive Avimukta. They enter in the midst of faeces, urine and semen again and again.

verses.sanskrit: तदाचिरेण कालेन पञ्चत्वमहमागतः । न दृष्टं नन्मया घोरं यमस्य वदनं मुने
verses.transliteration: tadācireṇa kālena pañcatvamahamāgataḥ / na dṛṣṭaṃ nanmayā ghoraṃ yamasya vadanaṃ mune
verses.translation: If buffeted by hundreds of calamities, a person enters and stays at my city, he attains the highest beatitude from which there is no return.
verses.hindi: अरुणोदस्य सरसः पूर्वतः केसराचलः। त्रिकूटशिखरश्चेच पतङ्गो रुचकस्तथा इत्येते देवचरिता उत्कटाः पर्वतोत्तमाः
verses.wordMeaning: If buffeted by hundreds of calamities, a person enters and stays at my city, he attains the highest beatitude from which there is no return.
verses.commentary: Sense: If buffeted by hundreds of calamities, a person enters and stays at my city, he attains the highest beatitude from which there is no return.

verses.sanskrit: ईदृशीं योनिमापन्नः पैशाचीं क्षुधयान्वितः । पिपासयाधुनाक्रान्तो न जानामि हिताहितम्
verses.transliteration: īdṛśīṃ yonimāpannaḥ paiśācīṃ kṣudhayānvitaḥ / pipāsayādhunākrānto na jānāmi hitāhitam
verses.translation: He enters the abode of Siva that is free from births, deaths and old age. That is the goal of those who seek salvation, who have no further fear of death.
verses.hindi: महाभद्रस्य सरसो दक्षिणे केसराचलः।
verses.wordMeaning: He enters the abode of Siva that is free from births, deaths and old age. That is the goal of those who seek salvation, who have no further fear of death.
verses.commentary: Sense: He enters the abode of Siva that is free from births, deaths and old age. That is the goal of those who seek salvation, who have no further fear of death.

verses.sanskrit: यदि कञ्चित् समुद्धर्तुमुपायं पश्यसि प्रभो । कुरुष्व तं नमस्तुभ्यं त्वामहं शरणं गतः
verses.transliteration: yadi kañcit samuddhartumupāyaṃ paśyasi prabho / kuruṣva taṃ namastubhyaṃ tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ
verses.translation: Avitnukta is the greatest knowledge, Avimukta is the greatest region, Avimukta is the greatest principle, Avimukta is the greatest and the most auspicious Bliss.
verses.hindi: एते पर्वतराजानः सिद्धगन्धर्वसेविता: असितोदस्य सरसः पश्चिमे केसराचलः। शङ्खकूटोऽथ वृषभो हंसो नागस्तथा परः
verses.wordMeaning: Avitnukta is the greatest knowledge, Avimukta is the greatest region, Avimukta is the greatest principle, Avimukta is the greatest and the most auspicious Bliss.
verses.commentary: Sense: Avitnukta is the greatest knowledge, Avimukta is the greatest region, Avimukta is the greatest principle, Avimukta is the greatest and the most auspicious Bliss.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्तः शङ्कुकर्णो ऽथ पिशाचमिदमब्रवीत् । त्वादृशो न हि लोके ऽस्मिन् विद्यते पुण्यकृत्तमः
verses.transliteration: ityuktaḥ śaṅkukarṇo 'tha piśācamidamabravīt / tvādṛśo na hi loke 'smin vidyate puṇyakṛttamaḥ
verses.translation: At the end I bestow the greatest knowledge and the greatest region, on those who take an irrevocable vow of staying in Avimukta.
verses.hindi: 'कालाञ्जनः शुक्रशैलो नीलः कमल एव च।
verses.wordMeaning: At the end I bestow the greatest knowledge and the greatest region, on those who take an irrevocable vow of staying in Avimukta.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the end I bestow the greatest knowledge and the greatest region, on those who take an irrevocable vow of staying in Avimukta.

verses.sanskrit: यत् त्वया भगवान् पूर्वं दृष्टो विश्वेश्वरः शिवः । संस्पृष्टो वन्दितो भूयः को ऽन्यस्त्वत्सदृशो भुवि
verses.transliteration: yat tvayā bhagavān pūrvaṃ dṛṣṭo viśveśvaraḥ śivaḥ / saṃspṛṣṭo vandito bhūyaḥ ko 'nyastvatsadṛśo bhuvi
verses.translation: Therefore, one shall not commit sins physically, mentally or verbally. O excellent Brahmanas, this is the secret of the Vedas and the Puranas.
verses.hindi: इत्येते देवगन्धर्वसिद्धसङ्कनिषेविताः । सरसो मानसस्येह उत्तरे केसराचलः मेरुके पूर्वमें भद्राश्व, पश्चिममें केतुमाल नामक दो वर्ष हैं। मुनिश्रेष्ठो! उन दोनोंके मध्य इलावृत वर्ष है। पूर्वमें चैत्ररथ नामक वन, दक्षिणमें गन्धमादन, पश्चिममें वैभ्राज और उत्तरमें सवितृवन स्थित है। उन (वनों)-
verses.wordMeaning: Therefore, one shall not commit sins physically, mentally or verbally. O excellent Brahmanas, this is the secret of the Vedas and the Puranas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Therefore, one shall not commit sins physically, mentally or verbally. O excellent Brahmanas, this is the secret of the Vedas and the Puranas.

verses.sanskrit: तेन कर्मविपाकेन देशमेतं समागतः । स्नानं कुरुष्व शीघ्रं त्वमस्मिन् कुण्डे समाहितः । येनेमां कुत्सितां योनिं क्षिप्रमेव प्रहास्यसि
verses.transliteration: tena karmavipākena deśametaṃ samāgataḥ / snānaṃ kuruṣva śīghraṃ tvamasmin kuṇḍe samāhitaḥ / yenemāṃ kutsitāṃ yoniṃ kṣiprameva prahāsyasi
verses.translation: After saying this, the holy lord Vyasa, the most excellent among the knowers of the Vedas, went to Varanasi along with his excellent disciples.
verses.hindi: में अरुणोद, महाभद्र, असितोद और मानस नामक- ये चार सरोवर हैं। ये सदा देवताओंद्वारा उपभोग किये जाने योग्य हैं। सितान्त, कुमुद्वान्, कुरुरी, माल्यवान्,
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this, the holy lord Vyasa, the most excellent among the knowers of the Vedas, went to Varanasi along with his excellent disciples.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this, the holy lord Vyasa, the most excellent among the knowers of the Vedas, went to Varanasi along with his excellent disciples.

verses.sanskrit: स एवमुक्तो मुनिना पिशाचो दयालुना देववरं त्रिनेत्रम् । स्मृत्वा कपर्देश्वरमीशितारं चक्रे समाधाय मनो ऽवगाहम्
verses.transliteration: sa evamukto muninā piśāco dayālunā devavaraṃ trinetram / smṛtvā kapardeśvaramīśitāraṃ cakre samādhāya mano 'vagāham
verses.translation: For derivation see the legend in VV. 16-18. For its glory cf. NP. II. 49.6-10, Pd. P. I. 34.10. In fact KP. VV. 3-29 in this chapter are practically the same as Pd. P. I. 34.1-25.
verses.hindi: मन्दर, वेणुमान्, मेघ, निषध एवं देवपर्वत-इन सभी रेष्ठ पर्वतोंकी रचना देवताओंद्वारा हुई है और इहे सिद्धोंका आवास कहा जाता है॥ २१--२५॥ अरुणोद सरोवरके पूर्वमें केसराचल, त्रिकूट-
verses.wordMeaning: For derivation see the legend in VV. 16-18. For its glory cf. NP. II. 49.6-10, Pd. P. I. 34.10. In fact KP. VV. 3-29 in this chapter are practically the same as Pd. P. I. 34.1-25.
verses.commentary: Sense: For derivation see the legend in VV. 16-18. For its glory cf. NP. II. 49.6-10, Pd. P. I. 34.10. In fact KP. VV. 3-29 in this chapter are practically the same as Pd. P. I. 34.1-25.

verses.sanskrit: तदावगाढो मुनिसंनिधाने ममार दिव्याभरणोपपन्नः । अदृश्यतार्कप्रतिमे विमाने शशाङ्कचिह्नाङ्कितचारुमौलिः
verses.transliteration: tadāvagāḍho munisaṃnidhāne mamāra divyābharaṇopapannaḥ / adṛśyatārkapratime vimāne śaśāṅkacihnāṅkitacārumauliḥ
verses.translation: After worshipping Mahadeva, there, alongwith his disciples, the great sage recounted its greatness to the sages whose souls are purified by meditation.
verses.hindi: पिशाचक, पञ्चशैल, कैलास और पर्वतोंमें उत्तम हिमवान्-ये सभी देवताओंद्वारा सेवित अत्यन्त श्रेष्ठ पर्वत हैं
verses.wordMeaning: After worshipping Mahadeva, there, alongwith his disciples, the great sage recounted its greatness to the sages whose souls are purified by meditation.
verses.commentary: Sense: After worshipping Mahadeva, there, alongwith his disciples, the great sage recounted its greatness to the sages whose souls are purified by meditation.

verses.sanskrit: विभाति रुद्रैरभितो दिवस्थैः समावृतो योगिभैरप्रमेयैः । सबालखिल्यादिभिरेष देवो यथोदये भानुरशेषदेवः
verses.transliteration: vibhāti rudrairabhito divasthaiḥ samāvṛto yogibhairaprameyaiḥ / sabālakhilyādibhireṣa devo yathodaye bhānuraśeṣadevaḥ
verses.translation: This is that stainless Linga Othkara by name. It is very splendid. By its sheer memory, one is released from all sins.
verses.hindi: महाभद्र सरोवरके दक्षिणमें-केसराचल, शिखिवास, सिद्धों और गन्धर्वोसे सेवित हें ॥ ३०--३४॥
verses.wordMeaning: This is that stainless Linga Othkara by name. It is very splendid. By its sheer memory, one is released from all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: This is that stainless Linga Othkara by name. It is very splendid. By its sheer memory, one is released from all sins.

verses.sanskrit: स्तुवन्ति सिद्धा दिवि देवसङ्घा नृत्यन्ति दिव्याप्सरसो ऽभिरामाः । मुञ्चन्ति वृष्टिं कुसुमाम्बुमिश्रां गन्धर्वविद्याधरकिंनराद्याः
verses.transliteration: stuvanti siddhā divi devasaṅghā nṛtyanti divyāpsaraso 'bhirāmāḥ / muñcanti vṛṣṭiṃ kusumāmbumiśrāṃ gandharvavidyādharakiṃnarādyāḥ
verses.translation: It is here that the excellent supreme knowledge of five Ayatanas (five-faced Siva?), capable of granting absolute emancipation from Saihsara, has been always worshipped by the sages.
verses.hindi: असितोद सरोवरके पश्चिममें केसराचल, शंखकूट, वृषभ, हंस, नाग, कालाञ्जन, शुक्रशैल, नील, कमल,
verses.wordMeaning: It is here that the excellent supreme knowledge of five Ayatanas (five-faced Siva?), capable of granting absolute emancipation from Saihsara, has been always worshipped by the sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is here that the excellent supreme knowledge of five Ayatanas (five-faced Siva?), capable of granting absolute emancipation from Saihsara, has been always worshipped by the sages.

verses.sanskrit: संस्तूयमानो ऽथ मुनीन्द्रसङ्घै- रवाप्य बोधं भगवात्प्रसादात् । समाविशन्मण्डलमेतदग्र्यं त्रयीमयं यत्र विभाति रुद्रः
verses.transliteration: saṃstūyamāno 'tha munīndrasaṅghai- ravāpya bodhaṃ bhagavātprasādāt / samāviśanmaṇḍalametadagryaṃ trayīmayaṃ yatra vibhāti rudraḥ
verses.translation: Here the glorious Lord Rudra, god Mahadeva himself who has assumed five-bodied {Pancayatand) form and who bes¬ tows Moksa on living beings, sports.
verses.hindi: महाकपिल--ये सभी (पर्वत) देव, गन्धर्व और सिद्धोके समूहोंद्वारा सेवित हैं। मानसरोवरके उत्तरमें केसराचल नामक पर्वत है॥ ३५--३७॥ इन प्रधान शैलोंके मध्य क्रमानुसार घाटियाँ, सरोवर
verses.wordMeaning: Here the glorious Lord Rudra, god Mahadeva himself who has assumed five-bodied {Pancayatand) form and who bes¬ tows Moksa on living beings, sports.
verses.commentary: Sense: Here the glorious Lord Rudra, god Mahadeva himself who has assumed five-bodied {Pancayatand) form and who bes¬ tows Moksa on living beings, sports.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा विमुक्तं स पिशाचभूतं मुनिः प्रहृष्टो मनसा महेशम् । विचिन्त्य रुद्रं कविमेकमग्निं प्रणम्य तुष्टाव कपर्दिनं तम्
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā vimuktaṃ sa piśācabhūtaṃ muniḥ prahṛṣṭo manasā maheśam / vicintya rudraṃ kavimekamagniṃ praṇamya tuṣṭāva kapardinaṃ tam
verses.translation: What is mentioned as the knowledge pertaining to Pasupati and which has five topics or imports is this stainless Linga situated at Oihkara.
verses.hindi: सन्ति चैवान्तरद्रोण्यः सरांसि च वनानि च॥ ३८ ॥  और अनेक वन हैं। वहाँ प्रसन्न, रजोगुणरहित और सभी
verses.wordMeaning: What is mentioned as the knowledge pertaining to Pasupati and which has five topics or imports is this stainless Linga situated at Oihkara.
verses.commentary: Sense: What is mentioned as the knowledge pertaining to Pasupati and which has five topics or imports is this stainless Linga situated at Oihkara.

verses.sanskrit: शङ्कुकर्ण उवाच कपर्दिनं त्वां परतः परस्ताद् गोप्तारमेकं पुरुषं पुराणम् । व्रजामि योगेश्वरमीशितार- मादित्यमग्निं कपिलाधिरूढम्
verses.transliteration: śaṅkukarṇa uvāca kapardinaṃ tvāṃ parataḥ parastād goptāramekaṃ puruṣaṃ purāṇam / vrajāmi yogeśvaramīśitāra- mādityamagniṃ kapilādhirūḍham
verses.translation: The five topics are super-quiescence, supreme peace, knowledge, stability and cessation. These five are the five aspects of the Linga of Isvara.
verses.hindi: वसन्ति तत्र मुनयः सिद्धाश्च ब्रह्मभाविताः । दुःखोंसे विनिर्मुक्त ब्रह्मवादी मुनि और सिद्ध निवास
verses.wordMeaning: The five topics are super-quiescence, supreme peace, knowledge, stability and cessation. These five are the five aspects of the Linga of Isvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: The five topics are super-quiescence, supreme peace, knowledge, stability and cessation. These five are the five aspects of the Linga of Isvara.

verses.sanskrit: त्वां ब्रह्मपारं हृदि सन्निविष्टं हिरण्मयं योगिनमादिमन्तम् । व्रजामि रुद्रं शरणं दिवस्थं महामुनिं ब्रह्ममयं पवित्रम्
verses.transliteration: tvāṃ brahmapāraṃ hṛdi sanniviṣṭaṃ hiraṇmayaṃ yoginamādimantam / vrajāmi rudraṃ śaraṇaṃ divasthaṃ mahāmuniṃ brahmamayaṃ pavitram
verses.translation: The Linga designated as Oihkara is called Pancaya- tana (having five abodes) as it is the support of the five deities viz. Brahma and others.
verses.hindi: प्रसन्नाः शान्तरजसः सर्वदुःखविवर्जिताः॥ ३९॥  करते हैँ
verses.wordMeaning: The Linga designated as Oihkara is called Pancaya- tana (having five abodes) as it is the support of the five deities viz. Brahma and others.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Linga designated as Oihkara is called Pancaya- tana (having five abodes) as it is the support of the five deities viz. Brahma and others.

verses.sanskrit: सहस्त्रपादाक्षिशिरो ऽभियुक्तं सहस्त्रबाहुं नमसः परस्तात् । त्वां ब्रहामपारं प्रणमामि शंभुं हिरण्यगर्भाधिपतिं त्रिनेत्रम्
verses.transliteration: sahastrapādākṣiśiro 'bhiyuktaṃ sahastrabāhuṃ namasaḥ parastāt / tvāṃ brahāmapāraṃ praṇamāmi śaṃbhuṃ hiraṇyagarbhādhipatiṃ trinetram
verses.translation: If at the time of death, one remembers the Linga pertaining to Isvara, the unchanging Pancayatana Linga, one enters the Supreme light and bliss.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मा, शंकर, इन्द्र, अग्नि, वरुण आदि देवताओंकी पुरियोंका तथा वहाँके निवासियोंका वर्णन, गङ्ाकी चार धाराओं और आठ मर्यादापर्वतोंका वर्णन मेरोरुपरि विख्याता देवदेवस्य वेधसः
verses.wordMeaning: If at the time of death, one remembers the Linga pertaining to Isvara, the unchanging Pancayatana Linga, one enters the Supreme light and bliss.
verses.commentary: Sense: If at the time of death, one remembers the Linga pertaining to Isvara, the unchanging Pancayatana Linga, one enters the Supreme light and bliss.

verses.sanskrit: यतः प्रसूतिर्जगतो विनाशो येनावृतं सर्वमिदं शिवेन । तं ब्रह्मपारं भगवन्तमीशं प्रणम्य नित्यं शरणं प्रपद्ये
verses.transliteration: yataḥ prasūtirjagato vināśo yenāvṛtaṃ sarvamidaṃ śivena / taṃ brahmapāraṃ bhagavantamīśaṃ praṇamya nityaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadye
verses.translation: Formerly, the celestial sages, the Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages had worshipped Lord Is ana here and had attained thereby the greatest region (viz. Moksa).
verses.hindi: तत्रास्ते भगवान् ब्रह्मा विश्वात्मा विश्वभावनः । उपास्यमानो योगीन्द्रर्मुनीन्द्रोपेन्द्रशंकरेः
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly, the celestial sages, the Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages had worshipped Lord Is ana here and had attained thereby the greatest region (viz. Moksa).
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, the celestial sages, the Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages had worshipped Lord Is ana here and had attained thereby the greatest region (viz. Moksa).

verses.sanskrit: अलिङ्गमालोकविहीनरूपं स्वयंप्रभं चित्पतिमेकरुद्रम् । तं ब्रह्मपारं परमेश्वरं त्वां नमस्करिष्ये न यतो ऽन्यदस्ति
verses.transliteration: aliṅgamālokavihīnarūpaṃ svayaṃprabhaṃ citpatimekarudram / taṃ brahmapāraṃ parameśvaraṃ tvāṃ namaskariṣye na yato 'nyadasti
verses.translation: Formerly, the celestial sages, the Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages had worshipped Lord Is ana here and had attained thereby the greatest region (viz. Moksa).
verses.hindi: तत्र देवेश्वरेशानं विश्वात्मानं प्रजापतिम्! सनत्कुमारो भगवानृपास्ते नित्यमेव हि तत्र देवादिदेवस्य शम्भोरमिततेजसः। दीप्तमायतनं शुक्र पुरस्ताद् ब्रह्मणः स्थितम्
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly, the celestial sages, the Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages had worshipped Lord Is ana here and had attained thereby the greatest region (viz. Moksa).
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, the celestial sages, the Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages had worshipped Lord Is ana here and had attained thereby the greatest region (viz. Moksa).

verses.sanskrit: यं योगिनस्त्यक्तसबीजयोगा लब्ध्वा समाधिं परमार्थभूताः । पश्यन्ति देवं प्रणतो ऽस्मि नित्यं तं ब्रह्मपारं भवतः स्वरूपम्
verses.transliteration: yaṃ yoginastyaktasabījayogā labdhvā samādhiṃ paramārthabhūtāḥ / paśyanti devaṃ praṇato 'smi nityaṃ taṃ brahmapāraṃ bhavataḥ svarūpam
verses.translation: Formerly, the celestial sages, the Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages had worshipped Lord Is ana here and had attained thereby the greatest region (viz. Moksa).
verses.hindi: दिव्यकान्तिसमायुक्तं चतुर्द्वारं सुशोभनम्। महषिगणसंकीर्ण ब्रह्माविद्धिर्निषेवितम्
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly, the celestial sages, the Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages had worshipped Lord Is ana here and had attained thereby the greatest region (viz. Moksa).
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, the celestial sages, the Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages had worshipped Lord Is ana here and had attained thereby the greatest region (viz. Moksa).

verses.sanskrit: न यत्र नामादिविशेषकॢप्ति- र् न संदृशे तिष्ठति यत्स्वरूपम् । तं ब्रह्मपारं प्रणतो ऽस्मि नित्यं स्वयंभुवं त्वां शरणं प्रपद्ये
verses.transliteration: na yatra nāmādiviśeṣakḷpti- r na saṃdṛśe tiṣṭhati yatsvarūpam / taṃ brahmapāraṃ praṇato 'smi nityaṃ svayaṃbhuvaṃ tvāṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadye
verses.translation: Formerly, the celestial sages, the Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages had worshipped Lord Is ana here and had attained thereby the greatest region (viz. Moksa).
verses.hindi: देव्या सह महादेवः शशाङ्कार्काग्रिलोचनः । तत्र वेदविदः शान्ता मुनयो ब्रह्मचारिणः । पूजयन्ति महादेवं तापसाः सत्यवादिनः
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly, the celestial sages, the Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages had worshipped Lord Is ana here and had attained thereby the greatest region (viz. Moksa).
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, the celestial sages, the Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages had worshipped Lord Is ana here and had attained thereby the greatest region (viz. Moksa).

verses.sanskrit: यद् वेदवादाभिरता विदेहं सब्रह्मविज्ञानमभेदमेकम् । पश्यन्त्यनेकं भवतः स्वरूपं सब्रह्मपारं प्रणतो ऽस्मि नित्यम्
verses.transliteration: yad vedavādābhiratā videhaṃ sabrahmavijñānamabhedamekam / paśyantyanekaṃ bhavataḥ svarūpaṃ sabrahmapāraṃ praṇato 'smi nityam
verses.translation: Formerly, the celestial sages, the Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages had worshipped Lord Is ana here and had attained thereby the greatest region (viz. Moksa).
verses.hindi: तेषां साक्षान्महादेवो मुनीनां ब्रह्मवादिनाम्। गृह्णाति पूजां शिरसा पार्वत्या परमेश्वरः
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly, the celestial sages, the Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages had worshipped Lord Is ana here and had attained thereby the greatest region (viz. Moksa).
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, the celestial sages, the Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages had worshipped Lord Is ana here and had attained thereby the greatest region (viz. Moksa).

verses.sanskrit: यतः प्रधानं पुरुषः पुराणो विवर्तते यं प्रणमन्ति देवाः । नमामि तं ज्योतिषि संनिविष्टं कालं बृहन्तं भवतः स्वरूपम्
verses.transliteration: yataḥ pradhānaṃ puruṣaḥ purāṇo vivartate yaṃ praṇamanti devāḥ / namāmi taṃ jyotiṣi saṃniviṣṭaṃ kālaṃ bṛhantaṃ bhavataḥ svarūpam
verses.translation: Formerly, the celestial sages, the Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages had worshipped Lord Is ana here and had attained thereby the greatest region (viz. Moksa).
verses.hindi: उपासते सहस्त्राक्षं देवास्तत्र सहस्त्रशः ये धार्मिका वेदविदो यागहोमपरायणाः। तेषां तत् परमं स्थानं देवानामपि दुर्लभम्
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly, the celestial sages, the Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages had worshipped Lord Is ana here and had attained thereby the greatest region (viz. Moksa).
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, the celestial sages, the Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages had worshipped Lord Is ana here and had attained thereby the greatest region (viz. Moksa).

verses.sanskrit: व्रजामि नित्यं शरणं गुहेशं स्थाणुं प्रपद्ये गिरिशं पुरारिम् । शिवं प्रपद्ये हरमिन्दुमौलिं पिनाकिनं त्वां शरणं व्रजामि
verses.transliteration: vrajāmi nityaṃ śaraṇaṃ guheśaṃ sthāṇuṃ prapadye giriśaṃ purārim / śivaṃ prapadye haramindumauliṃ pinākinaṃ tvāṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmi
verses.translation: Formerly, the celestial sages, the Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages had worshipped Lord Is ana here and had attained thereby the greatest region (viz. Moksa).
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले-देवाधिदेव ब्रह्माको मेरु पर्वतके
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly, the celestial sages, the Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages had worshipped Lord Is ana here and had attained thereby the greatest region (viz. Moksa).
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, the celestial sages, the Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages had worshipped Lord Is ana here and had attained thereby the greatest region (viz. Moksa).

verses.sanskrit: स्तुत्वैवं शङ्कुकर्णो ऽसौ भगवन्तं कपर्दिनम् । पपात दण्डवद् भूमौ प्रोच्चरन् प्रणवं परम्
verses.transliteration: stutvaivaṃ śaṅkukarṇo 'sau bhagavantaṃ kapardinam / papāta daṇḍavad bhūmau proccaran praṇavaṃ param
verses.translation: Formerly, the celestial sages, the Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages had worshipped Lord Is ana here and had attained thereby the greatest region (viz. Moksa).
verses.hindi: है। वहाँ विश्वभावन विश्वात्मा भगवान् ब्रह्मा रहते हैं। योगीन्द्र, मुनीन्द्र, उपेन्द्र (विष्णु) और शंकर उनकी उपासना करते रहते हैं। वहाँ भगवान् सनत्कुमार नित्य ही ईशान देवेश्वर विश्वात्मा प्रजापतिकी उपासना करते हैं। वे (सनत्कुमार) योगात्मा सिद्ध, ऋषि, गन्धर्व तथा
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly, the celestial sages, the Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages had worshipped Lord Is ana here and had attained thereby the greatest region (viz. Moksa).
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, the celestial sages, the Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages had worshipped Lord Is ana here and had attained thereby the greatest region (viz. Moksa).

verses.sanskrit: तत्क्षणात् परमं लिङ्गं प्रादुर्भूतं शिवात्मकम् । ज्ञानमानन्दमद्वैतं कोटिकालाग्निसन्निभम्
verses.transliteration: tatkṣaṇāt paramaṃ liṅgaṃ prādurbhūtaṃ śivātmakam / jñānamānandamadvaitaṃ koṭikālāgnisannibham
verses.translation: Formerly, the celestial sages, the Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages had worshipped Lord Is ana here and had attained thereby the greatest region (viz. Moksa).
verses.hindi: हैं और वहाँ निवास करते हैं॥ १--४॥
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly, the celestial sages, the Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages had worshipped Lord Is ana here and had attained thereby the greatest region (viz. Moksa).
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, the celestial sages, the Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages had worshipped Lord Is ana here and had attained thereby the greatest region (viz. Moksa).

verses.sanskrit: शङ्कुकर्णो ऽथ मुक्तात्मा तदात्मा सर्वगो ऽमलः । निलिल्ये विमले लिङ्गे तद्भुतमिवाभवत्
verses.transliteration: śaṅkukarṇo 'tha muktātmā tadātmā sarvago 'malaḥ / nililye vimale liṅge tadbhutamivābhavat
verses.translation: Formerly, the celestial sages, the Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages had worshipped Lord Is ana here and had attained thereby the greatest region (viz. Moksa).
verses.hindi: वहाँ देवोंके आदिदेव अमित तेजस्वी शंकरका शुभ्र एवं दीस्तियुक्त मन्दिर है, जो ब्रह्माके (आयतनके) सामने स्थित है। (यह मन्दिर) दिव्य कान्तिसे सुसम्पन्न, चार द्वारोंसे युक्त, अत्यन्त सुन्दर महर्षियाँसे पूर्ण और ब्रह्मज्ञानियांद्वार सेवित है। चन्द्रमा, सूर्य एवं अग्निस्वरूप (तीन) नेत्रोंवाले प्रमथेशवर विश्वेश महादेव देवी (पार्वती) एवं प्रमथगणोंके साथ वहाँ रमण करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly, the celestial sages, the Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages had worshipped Lord Is ana here and had attained thereby the greatest region (viz. Moksa).
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, the celestial sages, the Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages had worshipped Lord Is ana here and had attained thereby the greatest region (viz. Moksa).

verses.sanskrit: एतद् रहस्यमाख्यातं माहात्म्यं वः कपर्दिनः । न कश्चिद् वेत्ति तमसा विद्वानप्यत्र मुह्यति
verses.transliteration: etad rahasyamākhyātaṃ māhātmyaṃ vaḥ kapardinaḥ / na kaścid vetti tamasā vidvānapyatra muhyati
verses.translation: Formerly, the celestial sages, the Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages had worshipped Lord Is ana here and had attained thereby the greatest region (viz. Moksa).
verses.hindi: वहाँ वेदज्ञ शान्तचित्त मुनि, ब्रह्मचारी, तपस्वी और सत्यवादी लोग महादेवकी पूजा करते हैं । इन ब्रह्मवादी मुनियोंको पूजाको पार्वतीके साथ साक्षात् परमेश्वर महादेव सिरसे आदरपूर्वक स्वीकार करते हें । वहीं श्रेष्ठ
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly, the celestial sages, the Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages had worshipped Lord Is ana here and had attained thereby the greatest region (viz. Moksa).
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, the celestial sages, the Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages had worshipped Lord Is ana here and had attained thereby the greatest region (viz. Moksa).

verses.sanskrit: य इमां शृणुयान्नित्यं कथां पापप्रणाशिनीम् । भक्तः पापविशुद्धात्मा रुद्रसामीप्यमाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: ya imāṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśinīm / bhaktaḥ pāpaviśuddhātmā rudrasāmīpyamāpnuyāt
verses.translation: Formerly, the celestial sages, the Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages had worshipped Lord Is ana here and had attained thereby the greatest region (viz. Moksa).
verses.hindi: पर्वत (मेरु)-पर पूर्वको ओर इन्द्रको सभी शोभाओंसे समन्वित अमरावती नामको श्रेष्ठ पुरी है अप्सराओंका समूह, गान-परायण गन्धर्व तथा हजारों
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly, the celestial sages, the Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages had worshipped Lord Is ana here and had attained thereby the greatest region (viz. Moksa).
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, the celestial sages, the Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages had worshipped Lord Is ana here and had attained thereby the greatest region (viz. Moksa).

verses.sanskrit: पठेच्च सततं शुद्धो ब्रह्मपारं महास्तवम् । प्रातर्मध्याह्नसमये स योगं प्राप्नुयात् परम्
verses.transliteration: paṭhecca satataṃ śuddho brahmapāraṃ mahāstavam / prātarmadhyāhnasamaye sa yogaṃ prāpnuyāt param
verses.translation: Formerly, the celestial sages, the Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages had worshipped Lord Is ana here and had attained thereby the greatest region (viz. Moksa).
verses.hindi: धार्मिक हैं, वेदज्ञ हैं, यज्ञ एवं होमपरायण हैं, उनका वह परम स्थान देवताओंके लिये भी दुर्लभ है
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly, the celestial sages, the Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages had worshipped Lord Is ana here and had attained thereby the greatest region (viz. Moksa).
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, the celestial sages, the Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages had worshipped Lord Is ana here and had attained thereby the greatest region (viz. Moksa).

verses.sanskrit: इहैव नित्यं वत्स्यामो देवदेवं कपर्दिनम् । द्रक्ष्यामः सततं देवं पूजयामो ऽथ शूलिनम्
verses.transliteration: ihaiva nityaṃ vatsyāmo devadevaṃ kapardinam / drakṣyāmaḥ satataṃ devaṃ pūjayāmo 'tha śūlinam
verses.translation: Formerly, the celestial sages, the Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages had worshipped Lord Is ana here and had attained thereby the greatest region (viz. Moksa).
verses.hindi: तस्य दक्षिणदिग्भागे वह्वेरमिततेजसः। तेजोवती नाम पुरी दिव्याश्चर्यसमन्विता तत्रास्ते भगवान् वह्विर्राजमानः स्वतेजसा । जपिनां होमिनां स्थानं दानवानां दुरासदम्
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly, the celestial sages, the Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages had worshipped Lord Is ana here and had attained thereby the greatest region (viz. Moksa).
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, the celestial sages, the Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages had worshipped Lord Is ana here and had attained thereby the greatest region (viz. Moksa).

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा भगवान् व्यासः शिष्यैः सह महामुनिः । उवास तत्र युक्तात्मा पूजयन् वै कपर्दिनम्
verses.transliteration: ityuktvā bhagavān vyāsaḥ śiṣyaiḥ saha mahāmuniḥ / uvāsa tatra yuktātmā pūjayan vai kapardinam
verses.translation: Formerly, the celestial sages, the Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages had worshipped Lord Is ana here and had attained thereby the greatest region (viz. Moksa).
verses.hindi: नास्ना संयमनी दिव्या सिद्धगन्धर्वसेविता
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly, the celestial sages, the Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages had worshipped Lord Is ana here and had attained thereby the greatest region (viz. Moksa).
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, the celestial sages, the Siddhas and the Brahmanical sages had worshipped Lord Is ana here and had attained thereby the greatest region (viz. Moksa).

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे एकत्रिशोध्यायः सूत उवाच उषित्वा तत्र भगवान् कपर्देशान्तिके पुनः । द्रष्टुं ययौ मध्यमेशं बहुवर्षगणान् प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge ekatriśodhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca uṣitvā tatra bhagavān kapardeśāntike punaḥ / draṣṭuṃ yayau madhyameśaṃ bahuvarṣagaṇān prabhuḥ
verses.translation: O prominent Brahmanas, on the bank of Matsyodari, there is an excellent place, the secretmost, auspicious spot of the extent of a Gocarma known as the excellent Oihkara.
verses.hindi: तत्र वैवस्वतं देवं देवाद्याः पर्युपासते। स्थानं तत् सत्यसंधानां लोके पुण्यकृतां नृणाम् रक्षोवती नाम पुरी राक्षसेः सर्वतो वृता
verses.wordMeaning: O prominent Brahmanas, on the bank of Matsyodari, there is an excellent place, the secretmost, auspicious spot of the extent of a Gocarma known as the excellent Oihkara.
verses.commentary: Sense: O prominent Brahmanas, on the bank of Matsyodari, there is an excellent place, the secretmost, auspicious spot of the extent of a Gocarma known as the excellent Oihkara.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र मन्दाकिनीं पुण्यामृषिसङ्गनिषेविताम् । नदीं विमलपानीयां दृष्ट्वा हृष्टो ऽभवन्मुनिः
verses.transliteration: tatra mandākinīṃ puṇyāmṛṣisaṅganiṣevitām / nadīṃ vimalapānīyāṃ dṛṣṭvā hṛṣṭo 'bhavanmuniḥ
verses.translation: After saying this, the great sage, Krsna, the son of Parasara, went to see the Krttivasesvara Linga of the Trident¬ bearing Lord.
verses.hindi: तत्र तं निर्क्रतिं देवं राक्षसाः पर्युपासते। गच्छन्ति तां धर्मरता ये वै तामसवृत्तयः
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this, the great sage, Krsna, the son of Parasara, went to see the Krttivasesvara Linga of the Trident¬ bearing Lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this, the great sage, Krsna, the son of Parasara, went to see the Krttivasesvara Linga of the Trident¬ bearing Lord.

verses.sanskrit: स तामन्वीक्ष्य मुनिभिः सह द्वैपायनः प्रभुः । चकार भावपूतात्मा स्नानं स्नानविधानवित्
verses.transliteration: sa tāmanvīkṣya munibhiḥ saha dvaipāyanaḥ prabhuḥ / cakāra bhāvapūtātmā snānaṃ snānavidhānavit
verses.translation: After worshipping it along with his disciples, the holy sage, the most excellent among the knowers of Brahman, men¬ tioned the greatness of Krttivasas (the deity wearing elephant hide) to the Brahmanas.
verses.hindi: नाम्ना शुद्धवती पुण्या सर्वकामर्द्धिसंयुता तत्राप्सरोगणैः सिद्धैः सेव्यमानोऽमराधिपः। आस्ते स वरुणो राजा तत्र गच्छन्ति येऽम्बुदाः । तीर्थयात्रापरा नित्यं ये च लोकेऽघमर्षिणः
verses.wordMeaning: After worshipping it along with his disciples, the holy sage, the most excellent among the knowers of Brahman, men¬ tioned the greatness of Krttivasas (the deity wearing elephant hide) to the Brahmanas.
verses.commentary: Sense: After worshipping it along with his disciples, the holy sage, the most excellent among the knowers of Brahman, men¬ tioned the greatness of Krttivasas (the deity wearing elephant hide) to the Brahmanas.

verses.sanskrit: संतर्प्य विधिवद् देवानृषीन् पितृगणांस्तथा । पूजयामास लोकादिं पुष्पैर्नानाविधैर्भवम्
verses.transliteration: saṃtarpya vidhivad devānṛṣīn pitṛgaṇāṃstathā / pūjayāmāsa lokādiṃ puṣpairnānāvidhairbhavam
verses.translation: "Formerly aDaitya assumed the form of an elephant in this place and came near Bhava (Siva) to kill those Brahmanas who worship the lord here everyday.
verses.hindi: अप्सरोगणगन्धर्वैः सेव्यमानोऽमरप्रभुः । प्राणायामपरा मर्त्या स्थानं तद यान्ति शाश्वतम्
verses.wordMeaning: "Formerly aDaitya assumed the form of an elephant in this place and came near Bhava (Siva) to kill those Brahmanas who worship the lord here everyday.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Formerly aDaitya assumed the form of an elephant in this place and came near Bhava (Siva) to kill those Brahmanas who worship the lord here everyday.

verses.sanskrit: प्रविश्य शिष्यप्रवरैः सार्धं सत्यवतीसुतः । मध्यमेश्वरमीशानमर्चयामास शूलिनम्
verses.transliteration: praviśya śiṣyapravaraiḥ sārdhaṃ satyavatīsutaḥ / madhyameśvaramīśānamarcayāmāsa śūlinam
verses.translation: O Excellent Brahmanas, in order to protect those devotees, the three-eyed Mahadeva, favourably disposed to the devotees, appeared out of the Lihga.
verses.hindi: नाम्ना कान्तिमती शुभ्रा तत्र सोमो विराजते तत्र ये भोगनिरता स्वधर्म पर्युपासते। तेषां तद् रचितं स्थानं नानाभोगसमन्वितम्
verses.wordMeaning: O Excellent Brahmanas, in order to protect those devotees, the three-eyed Mahadeva, favourably disposed to the devotees, appeared out of the Lihga.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Excellent Brahmanas, in order to protect those devotees, the three-eyed Mahadeva, favourably disposed to the devotees, appeared out of the Lihga.

verses.sanskrit: ततः पाशुपताः शान्ता भस्मोद्धूलितविग्रहाः । द्रष्टुं समागता रुद्रं मध्यमेश्वरमीश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ pāśupatāḥ śāntā bhasmoddhūlitavigrahāḥ / draṣṭuṃ samāgatā rudraṃ madhyameśvaramīśvaram
verses.translation: Contemptuously Kara killed the Daitya of the form of an elephant with his trident. Its hide he made his robe. Hence the lord is Krtti vases vara.
verses.hindi: तस्याश्च पूर्वदिग्भागे शंकरस्य महापुरी। नाम्ना यशोवती पुण्या सर्वेषां सुदुरासदा
verses.wordMeaning: Contemptuously Kara killed the Daitya of the form of an elephant with his trident. Its hide he made his robe. Hence the lord is Krtti vases vara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Contemptuously Kara killed the Daitya of the form of an elephant with his trident. Its hide he made his robe. Hence the lord is Krtti vases vara.

verses.sanskrit: ओङ्कारासक्तमनसो वेदाध्ययनतत्पराः । जटिला मुण्डिताश्चापि शुक्लयज्ञोपवीतिनः
verses.transliteration: oṅkārāsaktamanaso vedādhyayanatatparāḥ / jaṭilā muṇḍitāścāpi śuklayajñopavītinaḥ
verses.translation: O leading sages, the sages attained the greatest Siddhi here. They attained the greatest region with their own body.
verses.hindi: तत्रेशानस्य भवनं रुद्रविष्णुतनोः शुभम्। गणेश्वरस्य विपुलं तत्रास्ते स गणैर्वृतः १-विवस्वान्-विव=ुरश्मिऽकिरणसे युक्त सूर्य
verses.wordMeaning: O leading sages, the sages attained the greatest Siddhi here. They attained the greatest region with their own body.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading sages, the sages attained the greatest Siddhi here. They attained the greatest region with their own body.

verses.sanskrit: कौपीनवसनाः केचिदपरे चाप्यवाससः । ब्रह्मचर्यरताः शान्ता वेदान्तज्ञानतत्पराः
verses.transliteration: kaupīnavasanāḥ kecidapare cāpyavāsasaḥ / brahmacaryaratāḥ śāntā vedāntajñānatatparāḥ
verses.translation: Those who are glorified as Vidya, Vidyesvaras, Rudras and Sivas surround the Krttivasesvara Linga forever, and abide here.
verses.hindi: उसके दक्षिण दिशामें अमित तेजस्वी अग्निको दिव्य आश्चर्योसे युक्त तेजोबती नामकी पुरी स्थित है। भगवान् वहि अपने तेजसे प्रकाशित होते हुए वहाँ रहते हैं। जप करनेवालों तथा होम करनेवालोंका वह स्थान
verses.wordMeaning: Those who are glorified as Vidya, Vidyesvaras, Rudras and Sivas surround the Krttivasesvara Linga forever, and abide here.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who are glorified as Vidya, Vidyesvaras, Rudras and Sivas surround the Krttivasesvara Linga forever, and abide here.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा द्वैपायनं विप्राः शिष्यैः परिवृतं मुनिम् । पूजयित्वा यथान्यायमिदं वचनमब्रुवन्
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā dvaipāyanaṃ viprāḥ śiṣyaiḥ parivṛtaṃ munim / pūjayitvā yathānyāyamidaṃ vacanamabruvan
verses.translation: There is no doubt about this that those persons who realize that this Kaliyuga is terrible and full of evil do not leave Krttivasa and achieve their highest object in life.
verses.hindi: दानवोंके लिये दुष्प्राप्य है श्रेष्ठ (मेरु) पर्वतपर दक्षिण भागमें यमराजको भी सिद्धों तथा गन्धर्वोसे सेवित संयमनी नामक दिव्य महापुरी है। वहाँ देवादिगण विवस्वान् (सूर्य) देवकी उपासना करते रहते हैं। वह स्थान संसारमें पुण्य
verses.wordMeaning: There is no doubt about this that those persons who realize that this Kaliyuga is terrible and full of evil do not leave Krttivasa and achieve their highest object in life.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no doubt about this that those persons who realize that this Kaliyuga is terrible and full of evil do not leave Krttivasa and achieve their highest object in life.

verses.sanskrit: को भवान् कुत आयातः सह शिष्यैर्महामुने । प्रोचुः पैलादयः शिष्यास्तानृषीन् ब्रह्मभावितान्
verses.transliteration: ko bhavān kuta āyātaḥ saha śiṣyairmahāmune / procuḥ pailādayaḥ śiṣyāstānṛṣīn brahmabhāvitān
verses.translation: In other places, salvation may or may not be attained in the course of a thousand births. But at the shrine of Krt- tiva, salvation is obtained in the course of a single birth.
verses.hindi: करनेवाले सत्यत्रती मनुष्योंका है। उसके पश्चिम भागमें महात्मा निर्क्रतिकी रक्षोबती नामक पुरी है, जो चारों ओरसे राक्षसोंसे घिरी है । वहाँ राक्षस निर्ऋतिदेवकी उपासना करते हैं तथा जो तमोगुणी जीविकावाले होते
verses.wordMeaning: In other places, salvation may or may not be attained in the course of a thousand births. But at the shrine of Krt- tiva, salvation is obtained in the course of a single birth.
verses.commentary: Sense: In other places, salvation may or may not be attained in the course of a thousand births. But at the shrine of Krt- tiva, salvation is obtained in the course of a single birth.

verses.sanskrit: अयं सत्यवतीसूनुः कृष्णद्वैपायनो मुनिः । व्यासः स्वयं हृषीकेशो येन वेदाः पृथक् कृताः
verses.transliteration: ayaṃ satyavatīsūnuḥ kṛṣṇadvaipāyano muniḥ / vyāsaḥ svayaṃ hṛṣīkeśo yena vedāḥ pṛthak kṛtāḥ
verses.translation: They say that this abode is the place of residence of all Siddhas. It is protected by MahMeva, Sambhu, the lord of Devas.
verses.hindi: हुए भी धार्मिक होते हैं, वे उसी पुरीमें जाते हैं। पश्चिममें इस श्रेष्ठ पर्वतपर सभी प्रकारकी कामनाओंकी समृद्धिसे समन्वित वरुणकी शुद्धवती नामकी पुण्य महापुरी है यहाँ अप्सराओं तथा सिद्धोंसे सेवित अमराधिप राजा वरुण रहते हैं। यहाँ वे ही मनुष्य जाते हैं, जो संसारमें नित्य जलदान करते हैं, तीर्थयात्रा-परायण रहते हैं और जो अघमर्षण किया करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: They say that this abode is the place of residence of all Siddhas. It is protected by MahMeva, Sambhu, the lord of Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: They say that this abode is the place of residence of all Siddhas. It is protected by MahMeva, Sambhu, the lord of Devas.

verses.sanskrit: यस्य देवो महादेवः साक्षादेव पिनाकधृक् । अंशांशेनाभवत् पुत्रो नाम्ना शुक इति प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: yasya devo mahādevaḥ sākṣādeva pinākadhṛk / aṃśāṃśenābhavat putro nāmnā śuka iti prabhuḥ
verses.translation: In every Yuga, the Brahmanas of self-control, the masters of the Vedas, worship Mahadeva. They perform the japa of the Satarudriya Mantra.
verses.hindi: उस (शुद्धवती पुरी)-के उत्तरभागमें वायु देवताकी भी गन्धवती नामवाली पवित्र महापुरी स्थित है। वहाँ प्रभञ्जन (वायुदेवता) निवास करते हैं। देवोंके स्वामी इन वायुदेवताकी अप्सराओंके समूह और गन्धर्व सेवा
verses.wordMeaning: In every Yuga, the Brahmanas of self-control, the masters of the Vedas, worship Mahadeva. They perform the japa of the Satarudriya Mantra.
verses.commentary: Sense: In every Yuga, the Brahmanas of self-control, the masters of the Vedas, worship Mahadeva. They perform the japa of the Satarudriya Mantra.

verses.sanskrit: यः स साक्षान्महादेवं सर्वभावेन शङ्करम् । प्रपन्नः परया भक्त्या यस्य तज्ज्ञानमैश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: yaḥ sa sākṣānmahādevaṃ sarvabhāvena śaṅkaram / prapannaḥ parayā bhaktyā yasya tajjñānamaiśvaram
verses.translation: Meditating in their hearts on Sthanu, Siva, who is present within everyone, they forever eulogize the three-eyed Mahadeva.
verses.hindi: करते रहते हैं। जो प्राणायाम-परायण मनुष्य हैं, वे इस शाश्वत स्थानमें जाते हैं उसके पूर्व दिशामें सोम (चन्द्रमा)-की कान्तिमती नामवाली शुभ श्रेष्ठ पुरी है, वहाँ चन्द्रमा विराजमान रहते हैं, जो भोगपरायण रहते हुए अपने धर्मका पालन करते हैं उन्हींके लिये वहाँपर अनेक प्रकारके
verses.wordMeaning: Meditating in their hearts on Sthanu, Siva, who is present within everyone, they forever eulogize the three-eyed Mahadeva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Meditating in their hearts on Sthanu, Siva, who is present within everyone, they forever eulogize the three-eyed Mahadeva.

verses.sanskrit: ततः पाशुपताः सर्वे हृष्टसर्वतनूरुहाः । नेमुरव्यग्रमनसः प्रोचुः सत्यवतीसुतम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ pāśupatāḥ sarve hṛṣṭasarvatanūruhāḥ / nemuravyagramanasaḥ procuḥ satyavatīsutam
verses.translation: Siddhas verily sang songs to those Brahmanas who have resided in Varanasi and seek refuge in Krttivasa.
verses.hindi: भोगोंसे युक्त स्थान बना! है। उसके पूर्वकी ओर (भगवान् शंकरकी यशोवती नामक पवित्र महापुरी है, जो सभीके लिये दुर्लभ है, वहाँ रुद्र एवं विष्णुमय शरीरवाले गणाधिपति ईशान (शंकर)-का विशाल भवन है
verses.wordMeaning: Siddhas verily sang songs to those Brahmanas who have resided in Varanasi and seek refuge in Krttivasa.
verses.commentary: Sense: Siddhas verily sang songs to those Brahmanas who have resided in Varanasi and seek refuge in Krttivasa.

verses.sanskrit: भगवन् भवता ज्ञातं विज्ञानं परमेष्ठिनः । प्रिसादाद् देवदेवस्य यत् तन्माहेश्वरं परम्
verses.transliteration: bhagavan bhavatā jñātaṃ vijñānaṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ / prisādād devadevasya yat tanmāheśvaraṃ param
verses.translation: After securing the birth in the families of the Brah¬ manas very rare in the world and liked by all the worlds, the ascetics have recourse to meditation, perform the Japa of Rudra and meditate on Mahesa in their minds.
verses.hindi: २-कुछ लोग ऐसे होते हैं जो धर्मनिष्ठ होते हैं, पर जन्म-जन्मान्तरके संस्कारवश उनमें मृत्युके समय भोगवासना शेष रह जाती है, ऐसे लोग चन्द्रलोकको प्रास करते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: After securing the birth in the families of the Brah¬ manas very rare in the world and liked by all the worlds, the ascetics have recourse to meditation, perform the Japa of Rudra and meditate on Mahesa in their minds.
verses.commentary: Sense: After securing the birth in the families of the Brah¬ manas very rare in the world and liked by all the worlds, the ascetics have recourse to meditation, perform the Japa of Rudra and meditate on Mahesa in their minds.

verses.sanskrit: तद्वदास्माकमव्यक्तं रहस्यं गुह्यमुत्तमम् । क्षिप्रं पश्येम तं देवं श्रुत्वा भगवतो मुखात्
verses.transliteration: tadvadāsmākamavyaktaṃ rahasyaṃ guhyamuttamam / kṣipraṃ paśyema taṃ devaṃ śrutvā bhagavato mukhāt
verses.translation: The leading sages in Varanasi propitiate the lord and the Ruler. Without attachment and desire, they perform Yajnas, eulogise Rudra and bow down to Sambhu.
verses.hindi: निवासः कल्पितः पूर्व देवदेवेन शूलिना
verses.wordMeaning: The leading sages in Varanasi propitiate the lord and the Ruler. Without attachment and desire, they perform Yajnas, eulogise Rudra and bow down to Sambhu.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leading sages in Varanasi propitiate the lord and the Ruler. Without attachment and desire, they perform Yajnas, eulogise Rudra and bow down to Sambhu.

verses.sanskrit: विसर्जयित्वा ताञ्छिष्यान् सुमन्तुप्रमुखांस्ततः । प्रोवाच तत्परं ज्ञानं योगिभ्यो योगवित्तमः
verses.transliteration: visarjayitvā tāñchiṣyān sumantupramukhāṃstataḥ / provāca tatparaṃ jñānaṃ yogibhyo yogavittamaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to Bhava of pure emotions and splendour; I resort to Sthanu, Girisa, the ancient deity. I remember Rudra who has entered my heart. I know that Mahadeva of many forms."
verses.hindi: विष्णुपादाद् विनिष्क्रान्ता प्लावयित्वेन्दुमण्डलम्। समन्ताद् ब्रह्मणः पुर्या गङ्गा पतति वै दिवः सीता चालकनन्दा च सुचक्षुर्भद्रनामिका
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to Bhava of pure emotions and splendour; I resort to Sthanu, Girisa, the ancient deity. I remember Rudra who has entered my heart. I know that Mahadeva of many forms."
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to Bhava of pure emotions and splendour; I resort to Sthanu, Girisa, the ancient deity. I remember Rudra who has entered my heart. I know that Mahadeva of many forms."

verses.sanskrit: तत्क्षणादेव विमलं संभूतं ज्योतिरुत्तमम् । लीनास्तत्रैव ते विप्राः क्षणादन्तरधीयत
verses.transliteration: tatkṣaṇādeva vimalaṃ saṃbhūtaṃ jyotiruttamam / līnāstatraiva te viprāḥ kṣaṇādantaradhīyata
verses.translation: The legend explaining the name Piidca-mocana (deliverer from the joni of Pisacas or goblins) is given below in VV. 15-35. The legend is repeated in Pd. P.I. 34.
verses.hindi: पश्चिमं केतुमालाख्यं वर्ष गत्वैति चार्णवम्
verses.wordMeaning: The legend explaining the name Piidca-mocana (deliverer from the joni of Pisacas or goblins) is given below in VV. 15-35. The legend is repeated in Pd. P.I. 34.
verses.commentary: Sense: The legend explaining the name Piidca-mocana (deliverer from the joni of Pisacas or goblins) is given below in VV. 15-35. The legend is repeated in Pd. P.I. 34.

verses.sanskrit: ततः शिष्यान् समाहूय भगवान् ब्रह्मवित्तमः । प्रोवाच मध्यमेशस्य माहात्म्यं पैलपूर्वकान्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ śiṣyān samāhūya bhagavān brahmavittamaḥ / provāca madhyameśasya māhātmyaṃ pailapūrvakān
verses.translation: O Brahmanas, he took his bath in the holy centre Picamocana, performed the Tarpana rite for the Pitrs in accordance with the injunctions and worshipped Sulin (the trident-bearing deity).
verses.hindi: तयोर्मध्यगतो मेरुः कर्णिकाकारसंस्थितः भारताः केतुमालाश्च भद्राश्वाः कुरवस्तथा । पत्राणि लोकपदास्य मर्यादाशैलबाह्यतः
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas, he took his bath in the holy centre Picamocana, performed the Tarpana rite for the Pitrs in accordance with the injunctions and worshipped Sulin (the trident-bearing deity).
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas, he took his bath in the holy centre Picamocana, performed the Tarpana rite for the Pitrs in accordance with the injunctions and worshipped Sulin (the trident-bearing deity).

verses.sanskrit: अस्मिन् स्थाने स्वयं देवो देव्या सह महेश्वरः । रमते भगवान् नित्यं रुद्रैश्च परिवारितः
verses.transliteration: asmin sthāne svayaṃ devo devyā saha maheśvaraḥ / ramate bhagavān nityaṃ rudraiśca parivāritaḥ
verses.translation: Those sages saw a wonderful event there in the company of their preceptor, whereby they accepted the great¬ ness of the shrine and bowed down to Hara, Girisa.
verses.hindi: जठरो देवकूटश्च मर्यादापर्वतावुभौ। दक्षिणोत्तरमायामावानीलनिषधायतौ
verses.wordMeaning: Those sages saw a wonderful event there in the company of their preceptor, whereby they accepted the great¬ ness of the shrine and bowed down to Hara, Girisa.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those sages saw a wonderful event there in the company of their preceptor, whereby they accepted the great¬ ness of the shrine and bowed down to Hara, Girisa.

verses.sanskrit: अत्र पूर्वं हृषीकेशो विश्वात्मा देवकीसुतः । उवास वत्सरं कृष्णः सदा पाशुपतैर्वृतः
verses.transliteration: atra pūrvaṃ hṛṣīkeśo viśvātmā devakīsutaḥ / uvāsa vatsaraṃ kṛṣṇaḥ sadā pāśupatairvṛtaḥ
verses.translation: A certain tiger of hideous features approached the excellent Kapardisvara shrine in order to devour a hind.
verses.hindi: गणोंसे आवृत (शंकरदेव) उसमें रहते हैं। पूर्वकालमें देवोंके देव शूल धारण करनेवाले शंकरने वहाँपर परमेष्ठीके भोगाभिलाषी भक्तोंका निवास-स्थान बनाया था। विष्णुके चरणसे निकली हुई गङ्गा चन्द्रमण्डलको आप्लावित कर स्वर्गसे ब्रह्मपुरीके चारों ओर गिरती हैं
verses.wordMeaning: A certain tiger of hideous features approached the excellent Kapardisvara shrine in order to devour a hind.
verses.commentary: Sense: A certain tiger of hideous features approached the excellent Kapardisvara shrine in order to devour a hind.

verses.sanskrit: भस्मोद्धूलितसर्वाङ्गो रुद्राध्ययनतत्परः । आराधयन् हरिः शंभुं कृत्वा पाशुपतं व्रतम्
verses.transliteration: bhasmoddhūlitasarvāṅgo rudrādhyayanatatparaḥ / ārādhayan hariḥ śaṃbhuṃ kṛtvā pāśupataṃ vratam
verses.translation: The hind was much frightened in her mind. In her agitation,' she ran round and round the shrine and ultimately submitted to the tiger.
verses.hindi: द्विजो! वे वहाँ गिरकर सीता, अलकनन्दा, सुचक्षु एवं भद्रा नामसे चार भागोंमें (दिशाओंमें) विभक्त हो गयी हैं। अन्तरिक्षसे निकलकर सीता नामक गङ्गा एक शैलसे दूसरे शैलपर जाती हुई पूर्व दिशामें भद्राश्ववर्षमें
verses.wordMeaning: The hind was much frightened in her mind. In her agitation,' she ran round and round the shrine and ultimately submitted to the tiger.
verses.commentary: Sense: The hind was much frightened in her mind. In her agitation,' she ran round and round the shrine and ultimately submitted to the tiger.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य ते बहवः शिष्या ब्रह्मचर्यपरायणाः । लब्ध्वा तद्वचनाज्ज्ञानं दृष्टवन्तो महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: tasya te bahavaḥ śiṣyā brahmacaryaparāyaṇāḥ / labdhvā tadvacanājjñānaṃ dṛṣṭavanto maheśvaram
verses.translation: The tiger of very great strength tore the hind with its sharp claws and on seeing the leading sages, it went away to another isolated forest.
verses.hindi: प्रवाहित होती हुई समुद्रमें जाती हैं हे द्विजोत्तमो! इसी प्रकार अलकनन्दा नामक गङ्गा दक्षिण दिशासे भारतवर्षमें आनेके बाद सात भागोंमें विभक्त होकर सागरमें जाती हैं। ऐसे ही सुचक्षु नामक गङ्गा पश्चिम दिशाके सभी पर्वतोंका अतिक्रमण करके
verses.wordMeaning: The tiger of very great strength tore the hind with its sharp claws and on seeing the leading sages, it went away to another isolated forest.
verses.commentary: Sense: The tiger of very great strength tore the hind with its sharp claws and on seeing the leading sages, it went away to another isolated forest.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य देवो महादेवः प्रत्यक्षं नीललोहितः । ददौ कृष्णास्य भगवान वरदो वरमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: tasya devo mahādevaḥ pratyakṣaṃ nīlalohitaḥ / dadau kṛṣṇāsya bhagavāna varado varamuttamam
verses.translation: When that hind fell dead in front of Kapardisvara a great flame of fire lustrous like the sun was seen in the sky.
verses.hindi: पश्चिम दिशाके केतुमाल नामक वर्षमें प्रवाहित होकर समुद्रमें जाती हैं। महर्षियो! भद्रा नामक गङ्गा उत्तर दिशाके पर्वतों और उत्तरकुरुवर्षका अतिक्रमण कर उत्तर समुद्रमें मिलती हैं। माल्यवान् तथा गन्धमादन
verses.wordMeaning: When that hind fell dead in front of Kapardisvara a great flame of fire lustrous like the sun was seen in the sky.
verses.commentary: Sense: When that hind fell dead in front of Kapardisvara a great flame of fire lustrous like the sun was seen in the sky.

verses.sanskrit: येर्ऽचयिष्यन्ति गोविन्दं मद्भक्ता विधिपूर्वकम् । तेषां तदैश्वरं ज्ञानमुत्पत्स्यति जगन्मय
verses.transliteration: yer'cayiṣyanti govindaṃ madbhaktā vidhipūrvakam / teṣāṃ tadaiśvaraṃ jñānamutpatsyati jaganmaya
verses.translation: When that hind fell dead in front of Kapardisvara a great flame of fire lustrous like the sun was seen in the sky.
verses.hindi: पर्वत नील तथा निषध पर्वतोंके समान विस्तारवाले हैं। उन दोनोंके मध्यमें कर्णिकाके आकारके समान मेरु (पर्वत) स्थित है। इन मर्यादापर्वतोंके बाहरकी ओर संसाररूपी कमलके पत्रोंके रूपमें भारतवर्ष, केतुमाल, भद्राश्व और कुरुवर्ष स्थित हैं॥ ३१--३५॥
verses.wordMeaning: When that hind fell dead in front of Kapardisvara a great flame of fire lustrous like the sun was seen in the sky.
verses.commentary: Sense: When that hind fell dead in front of Kapardisvara a great flame of fire lustrous like the sun was seen in the sky.

verses.sanskrit: नमस्योर्ऽचयितव्यश्च ध्यातव्यो मत्परैर्जनैः । भविष्यसि न संदेहो मत्प्रसादाद् द्विजातिभिः
