verses.transliteration: namasyor'cayitavyaśca dhyātavyo matparairjanaiḥ / bhaviṣyasi na saṃdeho matprasādād dvijātibhiḥ
verses.translation: When that hind fell dead in front of Kapardisvara a great flame of fire lustrous like the sun was seen in the sky.
verses.hindi: जठर एवं देवकूट नामक दो मर्यादापर्वत नील और निषध पर्वतोंतक दक्षिणोत्तर-दिशामें फैले हुए हैं। गन्धमादन और कैलास नामक दोनों पर्वत पूर्व-पश्चिममें फैले हुए हैं, (ये) अस्सी योजन विस्तारवाले हैं और समुद्रके
verses.wordMeaning: When that hind fell dead in front of Kapardisvara a great flame of fire lustrous like the sun was seen in the sky.
verses.commentary: Sense: When that hind fell dead in front of Kapardisvara a great flame of fire lustrous like the sun was seen in the sky.

verses.sanskrit: ये ऽत्र द्रक्ष्यन्ति देवेशं स्नात्वा रुद्रं पिनाकिनम् । ब्रह्महत्यादिकं पापं तेषामाशु विनश्यति
verses.transliteration: ye 'tra drakṣyanti deveśaṃ snātvā rudraṃ pinākinam / brahmahatyādikaṃ pāpaṃ teṣāmāśu vinaśyati
verses.translation: When that hind fell dead in front of Kapardisvara a great flame of fire lustrous like the sun was seen in the sky.
verses.hindi: अंदरतक स्थित हैं। निषध और पारियात्र नामक दो मर्यादापर्वत मेरुकी पश्चिम दिशामें पूर्वके पर्वतोंके समान स्थित हैं। इसी प्रकार उत्तरमें त्रिशृङ्ग और जारुधि नामक दो वर्षपर्वत हैं। ये पूर्व-पश्चिममें फैले हुए हैं तथा समुद्रके भीतरतक स्थित हैं
verses.wordMeaning: When that hind fell dead in front of Kapardisvara a great flame of fire lustrous like the sun was seen in the sky.
verses.commentary: Sense: When that hind fell dead in front of Kapardisvara a great flame of fire lustrous like the sun was seen in the sky.

verses.sanskrit: प्राणांस्त्यजन्ति ये मर्त्याः पापकर्मरता अपि । ते यान्ति तत् परं स्थानं नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.transliteration: prāṇāṃstyajanti ye martyāḥ pāpakarmaratā api / te yānti tat paraṃ sthānaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā
verses.translation: When that hind fell dead in front of Kapardisvara a great flame of fire lustrous like the sun was seen in the sky.
verses.hindi: हे द्विजो! मैंने यहाँ इन आठ मर्यादापर्वतोंको बतलाया। है महर्षियो! मेरुके चारों दिशाओंमें जठर आदि (वर्षपर्वत) स्थित हैं
verses.wordMeaning: When that hind fell dead in front of Kapardisvara a great flame of fire lustrous like the sun was seen in the sky.
verses.commentary: Sense: When that hind fell dead in front of Kapardisvara a great flame of fire lustrous like the sun was seen in the sky.

verses.sanskrit: धन्यास्तु खलु ते विप्रा मन्दाकिन्यां कृतोदकाः । अर्चयन्ति महादेवं मध्यमेश्वरमीश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: dhanyāstu khalu te viprā mandākinyāṃ kṛtodakāḥ / arcayanti mahādevaṃ madhyameśvaramīśvaram
verses.translation: When that hind fell dead in front of Kapardisvara a great flame of fire lustrous like the sun was seen in the sky.
verses.hindi: केतुमाल, भद्राश्व, रम्यकवर्ष तथा वहाँके निवासियोंका वर्णन, हरिवर्षमें स्थित विष्णुके विमानका वर्णन, जम्बूद्वीपके वर्णनमें भारतवर्षके कुलपर्वतों, महानदियों, जनपदों और वहाँके निवासियोंका वर्णन, भारतवर्षमें चार युगोंकी स्थितिका प्रतिपादन केतुमाले नराः कालाः सर्वे पनसभोजनाः।
verses.wordMeaning: When that hind fell dead in front of Kapardisvara a great flame of fire lustrous like the sun was seen in the sky.
verses.commentary: Sense: When that hind fell dead in front of Kapardisvara a great flame of fire lustrous like the sun was seen in the sky.

verses.sanskrit: स्नानं दानं तपः श्राद्धं पिण्डनिर्वपणं त्विह । एकैकशः कृतं विप्राः पुनात्यासप्तमं कुलम्
verses.transliteration: snānaṃ dānaṃ tapaḥ śrāddhaṃ piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ tviha / ekaikaśaḥ kṛtaṃ viprāḥ punātyāsaptamaṃ kulam
verses.translation: When that hind fell dead in front of Kapardisvara a great flame of fire lustrous like the sun was seen in the sky.
verses.hindi: रम्यके पुरुषा नार्यो रमन्ते रजतप्रभाः।
verses.wordMeaning: When that hind fell dead in front of Kapardisvara a great flame of fire lustrous like the sun was seen in the sky.
verses.commentary: Sense: When that hind fell dead in front of Kapardisvara a great flame of fire lustrous like the sun was seen in the sky.

verses.sanskrit: संनिहत्यामुपस्पृश्य राहुग्रस्ते दिवाकरे । यत् फलं लभते मर्त्यस्तस्माद् दशगुणं त्विह
verses.transliteration: saṃnihatyāmupaspṛśya rāhugraste divākare / yat phalaṃ labhate martyastasmād daśaguṇaṃ tviha
verses.translation: When that hind fell dead in front of Kapardisvara a great flame of fire lustrous like the sun was seen in the sky.
verses.hindi: एकादशसहस्त्राणि शतानि दश पञ्च च। जीवन्ति पुरुषा नार्यो देवलोकस्थिता इव॥ सर्वे ते मैथुनाज्जाताः नित्यं सुखनिषेविन: । चन्द्रद्वीपे महादेवं यजन्ति सततं शिवम्॥
verses.wordMeaning: When that hind fell dead in front of Kapardisvara a great flame of fire lustrous like the sun was seen in the sky.
verses.commentary: Sense: When that hind fell dead in front of Kapardisvara a great flame of fire lustrous like the sun was seen in the sky.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा महायोगी मध्यमेशान्ति के प्रभुः । उवास सुचिरं कालं पूजयन् वै महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā mahāyogī madhyameśānti ke prabhuḥ / uvāsa suciraṃ kālaṃ pūjayan vai maheśvaram
verses.translation: When that hind fell dead in front of Kapardisvara a great flame of fire lustrous like the sun was seen in the sky.
verses.hindi: यजन्ति सततं देवं चतुर्मूर्ति चतुर्मुखम्।
verses.wordMeaning: When that hind fell dead in front of Kapardisvara a great flame of fire lustrous like the sun was seen in the sky.
verses.commentary: Sense: When that hind fell dead in front of Kapardisvara a great flame of fire lustrous like the sun was seen in the sky.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे द्वात्रिंशो ऽध्यायः सूत उवाच ततः सर्वाणि गुह्यानि तीर्थान्यायतनानि च । जगाम भगवान् व्यासो जैमिनिप्रमुखैर्वृतः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge dvātriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca tataḥ sarvāṇi guhyāni tīrthānyāyatanāni ca / jagāma bhagavān vyāso jaiminipramukhairvṛtaḥ
verses.translation: (The flame of Are) had three eyes. It was blue¬ necked and the crest was marked by the moon. It was seated on
verses.hindi: तत्र नारायणं देवं विश्वयोनिं सनातनम्। सूतजीने कहा-केतुमालवर्षके पुरुष कृष्णवर्णके होते हैं और सभी पनस (कटहल)-का भोजन करनेवाले होते हैं। वहाँको स्त्रियाँ कमलपत्रके समान वर्णवाली होती हैं। ये सभी दस हजार वर्षतक जीवित रहते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: (The flame of Are) had three eyes. It was blue¬ necked and the crest was marked by the moon. It was seated on
verses.commentary: Sense: (The flame of Are) had three eyes. It was blue¬ necked and the crest was marked by the moon. It was seated on

verses.sanskrit: प्रयागं परमं तीर्थं प्रयागादधिकं शुभम् । विश्वरूपं तथा तीर्थं तालतीर्थमनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: prayāgaṃ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ prayāgādadhikaṃ śubham / viśvarūpaṃ tathā tīrthaṃ tālatīrthamanuttamam
verses.translation: The firmament-dwellers showered flowers on his head. He became the Ganesvara himself and vanished at the same instant.
verses.hindi: भद्राश्ववर्षके पुरुष शुक्ल वर्णके होते हैं और स्त्रिया चन्द्रमाकी किरणों (चाँदनी)-के समान वर्णवाली होती हैं। ये सब आमका आहार करते हैं तथा दस हजार वर्षतक जीवित रहते हैं। रम्यकवर्षके पुरुष और
verses.wordMeaning: The firmament-dwellers showered flowers on his head. He became the Ganesvara himself and vanished at the same instant.
verses.commentary: Sense: The firmament-dwellers showered flowers on his head. He became the Ganesvara himself and vanished at the same instant.

verses.sanskrit: आकाशाख्यं महातीर्थं तीर्थं चैवार्षभं परम् । स्वर्नोलं च महातीर्थं गौरीतीर्थमनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: ākāśākhyaṃ mahātīrthaṃ tīrthaṃ caivārṣabhaṃ param / svarnolaṃ ca mahātīrthaṃ gaurītīrthamanuttamam
verses.translation: On seeing this wonderful event, (the disciples) the -chief of whom was Jaimini asked the infallible preceptor about the greatness of Kapardisvara.
verses.hindi: स्त्रियाँ-सभी चाँदीकी प्रभाके समान दिखायी देते हैं। ये सत्त्वभावमें स्थित रहनेवाले होते हैं तथा वटवृक्षके फलका भोजन करते हैं और ग्यारह हजार पाँच सौ वर्षोतक जीवित रहते हैं । हिरण्मयवर्षमें सोनेकी आभावाले निवास करते हैं, सभी लकुच (बड्हरके फल)-का भोजन करते हैं और बारह हजार पाँच सौ वर्षतक सभी स्त्री-पुरुष उसी प्रकार जीवित रहते हैं, जैसे कि देवलोकमें स्थित हों॥ १--४॥
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing this wonderful event, (the disciples) the -chief of whom was Jaimini asked the infallible preceptor about the greatness of Kapardisvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing this wonderful event, (the disciples) the -chief of whom was Jaimini asked the infallible preceptor about the greatness of Kapardisvara.

verses.sanskrit: प्राजापत्यं तथा तीर्थं स्वर्गद्वारं तथैव च । जम्बुकेश्वरमित्युक्तं धर्माख्यं तीर्थमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: prājāpatyaṃ tathā tīrthaṃ svargadvāraṃ tathaiva ca / jambukeśvaramityuktaṃ dharmākhyaṃ tīrthamuttamam
verses.translation: After bowing down to the bull-bannered deity and sitting in front of the lord, the holy sage recounted the greatness ■of Kapardisa.
verses.hindi: कुरुवर्षमें दुग्धाहार करनेवाले श्यामवर्णके (स्त्री-
verses.wordMeaning: After bowing down to the bull-bannered deity and sitting in front of the lord, the holy sage recounted the greatness ■of Kapardisa.
verses.commentary: Sense: After bowing down to the bull-bannered deity and sitting in front of the lord, the holy sage recounted the greatness ■of Kapardisa.

verses.sanskrit: गयातीर्थं महातीर्थं तीर्थं चैव महानदी । नारायणं परं तीर्थं वायुतीर्थमनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: gayātīrthaṃ mahātīrthaṃ tīrthaṃ caiva mahānadī / nārāyaṇaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ vāyutīrthamanuttamam
verses.translation: This excellent Lihga of Lord Kapardisvara should be worshipped assiduously and with care and eulogised by the Vedic hymns.
verses.hindi: हैं। वे सभी मैथुनसे उत्पन्न होते हैं, नित्य सुखोपभोगी होते हैं और चन्द्रद्वीपमें महादेव शिवकी निरन्तर उपासना करते हैं। है विप्रो! इसी प्रकार किंपुरुषवर्षके मनुष्य स्वर्ण-वर्णके समान होते हैं। पाकड़ वृक्षके फलोंका भोजन करनेवाले ये दस हजार वर्षतक जीवित रहते हैं। ये भक्तियुक्त होकर आदरसहित मनको ध्यानमें समाधिस्थकर चतुर्मूर्ति चतुर्मुख देव (ब्रह्मा) -की निरन्तर उपासना करते रहते हैं। इसी प्रकार हरिवर्षमें रहनेवाले
verses.wordMeaning: This excellent Lihga of Lord Kapardisvara should be worshipped assiduously and with care and eulogised by the Vedic hymns.
verses.commentary: Sense: This excellent Lihga of Lord Kapardisvara should be worshipped assiduously and with care and eulogised by the Vedic hymns.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानतीर्थं परं गुह्यं वाराहं तीर्थमुत्तमम् । यमतीर्थं महापुण्यं तीर्थं संवर्तकं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: jñānatīrthaṃ paraṃ guhyaṃ vārāhaṃ tīrthamuttamam / yamatīrthaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ tīrthaṃ saṃvartakaṃ śubham
verses.translation: To the Yogins of quiescent minds, who regularly meditate here, the accomplishment of Yogic Siddhi occurs ■within six months. There is no doubt about it.
verses.hindi: महारजत (स्वर्ण)-के समान आभावाले होते हैं। वे दस हजार वर्षतक जीवित रहते है । ईखके रसका भोजन करते हैं। यहाँ ये मनुष्य विष्णुकी भावनासे भावित होकर विश्वयोनि नारायणदेव विष्णुकी सदा
verses.wordMeaning: To the Yogins of quiescent minds, who regularly meditate here, the accomplishment of Yogic Siddhi occurs ■within six months. There is no doubt about it.
verses.commentary: Sense: To the Yogins of quiescent minds, who regularly meditate here, the accomplishment of Yogic Siddhi occurs ■within six months. There is no doubt about it.

verses.sanskrit: अग्नितीर्थं द्विजश्रेष्ठाः कलशेश्वरमुत्तमम् । नागतीर्थं सोमतीर्थं सूर्यतीर्थं तथैव च
verses.transliteration: agnitīrthaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ kalaśeśvaramuttamam / nāgatīrthaṃ somatīrthaṃ sūryatīrthaṃ tathaiva ca
verses.translation: If one takes one's bath in the holy tankofPisa- camocana near this place and worships this lord, the sins like Brahmana-slaughter and other similar sins perish.
verses.hindi: उपासते सदा विष्णुं मानवा विष्णुभाविताः॥ १०॥  उपासना करते हैं॥ ५--१०॥  महारजत शब्द स्वर्णका पर्याय है। (अमरकोश २। ९। ९५)
verses.wordMeaning: If one takes one's bath in the holy tankofPisa- camocana near this place and worships this lord, the sins like Brahmana-slaughter and other similar sins perish.
verses.commentary: Sense: If one takes one's bath in the holy tankofPisa- camocana near this place and worships this lord, the sins like Brahmana-slaughter and other similar sins perish.

verses.sanskrit: पर्वताख्यं महागुह्यं मणिकर्णमनुत्तमम् । घटोत्कचं तीर्थवरं श्रीतीर्थं च पितामहम्
verses.transliteration: parvatākhyaṃ mahāguhyaṃ maṇikarṇamanuttamam / ghaṭotkacaṃ tīrthavaraṃ śrītīrthaṃ ca pitāmaham
verses.translation: O Brahmanas, formerly a great ascetic of praiseworthy holy rites, well-known as Sahkukarna, worshipped the trident¬ bearing lord.
verses.hindi: विमानं वासुदेवस्य पारिजातवनाश्रितम्
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas, formerly a great ascetic of praiseworthy holy rites, well-known as Sahkukarna, worshipped the trident¬ bearing lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas, formerly a great ascetic of praiseworthy holy rites, well-known as Sahkukarna, worshipped the trident¬ bearing lord.

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गातीर्थं तु देवेशं ययातेस्तीर्थमुत्तमम् । कापिलं चैव सोमेशं ब्रह्मतीर्थमनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: gaṅgātīrthaṃ tu deveśaṃ yayātestīrthamuttamam / kāpilaṃ caiva someśaṃ brahmatīrthamanuttamam
verses.translation: He performed the Japa of the Pramva (Orh) having' the form of Rudra. He ■worshipped Rudra constantly by means of flowers, incense etc. and hymns, obeisances and circumambula- tions,
verses.hindi: प्राकोरैर्दशभिर्युक्तं दुराधर्ष सुदुर्गमम् स्फाटिकैर्मण्डपैर्युक्तं देवराजगृहोपमम्। स्वर्णस्तम्भसहरस्त्रैश्न सर्वतः समलंकृतम्
verses.wordMeaning: He performed the Japa of the Pramva (Orh) having' the form of Rudra. He ■worshipped Rudra constantly by means of flowers, incense etc. and hymns, obeisances and circumambula- tions,
verses.commentary: Sense: He performed the Japa of the Pramva (Orh) having' the form of Rudra. He ■worshipped Rudra constantly by means of flowers, incense etc. and hymns, obeisances and circumambula- tions,

verses.sanskrit: अत्र लिङ्गं पुरानीय ब्रह्मा स्नातुं यदा गतः । तदानीं स्थापयामास विष्णुस्तल्लिङ्गमैश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: atra liṅgaṃ purānīya brahmā snātuṃ yadā gataḥ / tadānīṃ sthāpayāmāsa viṣṇustalliṅgamaiśvaram
verses.translation: Taking up a perpetual initiation and celibacy the Yogic soul stayed there. Once he saw a very hungry ghost who had arrived there.
verses.hindi: नारायणपरैः शुद्धैर्वेदाध्ययनतत्परैः
verses.wordMeaning: Taking up a perpetual initiation and celibacy the Yogic soul stayed there. Once he saw a very hungry ghost who had arrived there.
verses.commentary: Sense: Taking up a perpetual initiation and celibacy the Yogic soul stayed there. Once he saw a very hungry ghost who had arrived there.

verses.sanskrit: ततः स्नात्वा समागत्य ब्रह्मा प्रोवाच तं हरिम् । मयानीतमिदं लिङ्गं कस्मात् स्थापितवानसि
verses.transliteration: tataḥ snātvā samāgatya brahmā provāca taṃ harim / mayānītamidaṃ liṅgaṃ kasmāt sthāpitavānasi
verses.translation: He was a mere skeleton of bones covered with bare skin and was heaving deep sighs again and again. On seeing him, the leading sage was overwhelmed with great sympathy.
verses.hindi: योगिभिश्च समाकीर्ण ध्यायद्धिः पुरुषं हरिम्। स्तुवद्धिः सततं मन्त्रै्नमस्यद्भिशच माधवम् तत्र देवादिदेवस्य विष्णोरमिततेजसः। राजानः सर्वकालं तु महिमानं प्रकुर्वते
verses.wordMeaning: He was a mere skeleton of bones covered with bare skin and was heaving deep sighs again and again. On seeing him, the leading sage was overwhelmed with great sympathy.
verses.commentary: Sense: He was a mere skeleton of bones covered with bare skin and was heaving deep sighs again and again. On seeing him, the leading sage was overwhelmed with great sympathy.

verses.sanskrit: तमाह विष्णुस्त्वत्तो ऽपि रुद्रे भक्तिर्दृढा मम । तस्मात् प्रतिष्ठितं लिङ्गंनाम्ना तव भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: tamāha viṣṇustvatto 'pi rudre bhaktirdṛḍhā mama / tasmāt pratiṣṭhitaṃ liṅgaṃnāmnā tava bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: He said—"who are you, sir? From which land have you come over to this place?" The ghost who was being afflicted by hunger spoke these words to him.
verses.hindi: भारते तु स्त्रियः पुंसो नानावर्णाः प्रकीर्तिताः । नानादेवार्चने युक्ता नानाकर्माणि कुर्वते। परमायुः स्मृतं तेषां शतं वर्षाणि सुव्रताः
verses.wordMeaning: He said—"who are you, sir? From which land have you come over to this place?" The ghost who was being afflicted by hunger spoke these words to him.
verses.commentary: Sense: He said—"who are you, sir? From which land have you come over to this place?" The ghost who was being afflicted by hunger spoke these words to him.

verses.sanskrit: भूतेश्वरं तथा तीर्थं तीर्थं धर्मसमुद्भवम् । गन्धर्वतीर्थं परमं वाह्नेयं तीर्थमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: bhūteśvaraṃ tathā tīrthaṃ tīrthaṃ dharmasamudbhavam / gandharvatīrthaṃ paramaṃ vāhneyaṃ tīrthamuttamam
verses.translation: "I was a Brahmana in my previous birth. I was endowed with plenty of wealth and foodgrains. I was blessed with sons, grandsons, etc. I was eager to maintain the family.
verses.hindi: नानाहाराश्च जीवन्ति पुण्यपापनिमित्ततः। नवयोजनसाहस्त्रं वर्षमेतत् प्रकीर्तितम्। कर्मभूमिरियं विप्रा नराणामधिकारिणाम् इन्द्रद्यप्नः कशेरुमांस्ताप्रवर्णो गभस्तिमान्। नागद्वीपस्तथा सौम्यो गन्धर्वस्त्वथ वारुणः
verses.wordMeaning: "I was a Brahmana in my previous birth. I was endowed with plenty of wealth and foodgrains. I was blessed with sons, grandsons, etc. I was eager to maintain the family.
verses.commentary: Sense: "I was a Brahmana in my previous birth. I was endowed with plenty of wealth and foodgrains. I was blessed with sons, grandsons, etc. I was eager to maintain the family.

verses.sanskrit: दौर्वासिकं व्योमतीर्थं चन्द्रतीर्थं द्विजोत्तमाः । चित्राङ्गदेश्वरं पुण्यं पुण्यं विद्याधरेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: daurvāsikaṃ vyomatīrthaṃ candratīrthaṃ dvijottamāḥ / citrāṅgadeśvaraṃ puṇyaṃ puṇyaṃ vidyādhareśvaram
verses.translation: Neither Devas, nor cows nor guests were worshipped by me. Even a minor meritorious deed, even the slightest of good action was not performed by me.
verses.hindi: वहाँ पारिजातके वनमें शुद्ध स्फटिकका बना हुआ चन्द्रमाको शुभ्र कान्तिके समान कान्तिवाला वासुदेवका एक विमान है । चार द्वारों, चार तोरणोंसे समन्वित तथा दस प्राकारोंसे युक्त (वह विमान) अनृपम, दुराधर्ष और
verses.wordMeaning: Neither Devas, nor cows nor guests were worshipped by me. Even a minor meritorious deed, even the slightest of good action was not performed by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Neither Devas, nor cows nor guests were worshipped by me. Even a minor meritorious deed, even the slightest of good action was not performed by me.

verses.sanskrit: केदारतीर्थमुग्राख्यं कालञ्जरमनुत्तमम् । सारस्वतं प्रभासं च भद्रकर्णं ह्रदं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: kedāratīrthamugrākhyaṃ kālañjaramanuttamam / sārasvataṃ prabhāsaṃ ca bhadrakarṇaṃ hradaṃ śubham
verses.translation: Once Lord Rudra, with the lordly bull for his vehicle, the lord of the universe was seen at Varanasi. He was touched and bowed to by me.
verses.hindi: दुर्गम है। यह स्फटिकके मण्डपोंसे युक्त देवराजके भवनके समान है तथा सभी ओरसे हजारों स्वर्ण- स्तम्भोंसे अलंकृत है। इसमें सोनेकी सीढ़ियाँ हैं। यह दिव्य सिंहासनोंसे समन्वित, सभी प्रकारकी शोभाओंसे सम्पन्न तथा नाना प्रकारके रत्नोंसे सुशोभित है। स्वादिष्ट जलवाले सरोवरों और नदियोंसे शोभित है। वह स्थान नारायण-परायण, पवित्र, वेदाध्ययनमें तत्पर, पुरुष हरिका ध्यान करनेवाले लोगों तथा निरन्तर
verses.wordMeaning: Once Lord Rudra, with the lordly bull for his vehicle, the lord of the universe was seen at Varanasi. He was touched and bowed to by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Once Lord Rudra, with the lordly bull for his vehicle, the lord of the universe was seen at Varanasi. He was touched and bowed to by me.

verses.sanskrit: लौकिकाख्यं महातीर्थं तीर्थं चैव वृषध्वजम् । हिरण्यगर्भं गोप्रेक्ष्यं तीर्थं चैव वृषध्वजम्
verses.transliteration: laukikākhyaṃ mahātīrthaṃ tīrthaṃ caiva vṛṣadhvajam / hiraṇyagarbhaṃ goprekṣyaṃ tīrthaṃ caiva vṛṣadhvajam
verses.translation: Then, ere long, I passed away. O sage but the terrible face of Yama was not seen.
verses.hindi: करनेवाले योगियोंसे व्याप्त रहता है
verses.wordMeaning: Then, ere long, I passed away. O sage but the terrible face of Yama was not seen.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then, ere long, I passed away. O sage but the terrible face of Yama was not seen.

verses.sanskrit: उपशान्तं शिवं चैव व्याघ्रेश्वरमनुत्तमम् । त्रिलोचनं महातीर्थं लोलार्कं चोत्तराह्वयम्
verses.transliteration: upaśāntaṃ śivaṃ caiva vyāghreśvaramanuttamam / trilocanaṃ mahātīrthaṃ lolārkaṃ cottarāhvayam
verses.translation: Having fallen into this ghoulish form of existence, I am so much afflicted by hunger and so much overwhelmed with thirst that I do not know what is beneficial or detrimental to me.
verses.hindi: वहाँ राजा लोग देवोंके आदिदेव अमित तेजस्वी विष्णुकी महिमाका सभी कालोंमें कीर्तन करते रहते हैं । शृंगार करनेमें तत्पर युवावस्थावाली एवं विलासिनी मनोरम स्त्रियाँ यहाँ सदा नृत्य एवं गान करती रहती हैं । इलावृतवर्षमें कमलके समान वर्णवाले जामुनके फलके रसका सेवन करनेवाले तथा तेरह हजार वर्षकी स्थिर आयुवाले व्यक्ति निवास करते हैं। भारतवर्षके स्त्री और पुरुष अनेक वर्णके बताये गये हैं। ये विविध प्रकारके
verses.wordMeaning: Having fallen into this ghoulish form of existence, I am so much afflicted by hunger and so much overwhelmed with thirst that I do not know what is beneficial or detrimental to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Having fallen into this ghoulish form of existence, I am so much afflicted by hunger and so much overwhelmed with thirst that I do not know what is beneficial or detrimental to me.

verses.sanskrit: कपालमोचनं तीर्थं ब्रह्महत्याविनाशनम् । शुक्रेश्वरं महापुण्यमानन्दपुरमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: kapālamocanaṃ tīrthaṃ brahmahatyāvināśanam / śukreśvaraṃ mahāpuṇyamānandapuramuttamam
verses.translation: O holy lord, if you see any remedy for uplifting me from this ghostly type of existence please do it. I bow down to you. I seek refuge in you."
verses.hindi: प्रकारके कर्माको करते हैं। है सुव्रतो! इनकी परम आयु सौ वर्षकी कही गयी है। अनेक प्रकारका आहार करनेवाले वे अपने पुण्य-पापके निमित्तसे जीवित रहते हैं। यह वर्ष नौ हजार योजन विस्तारवाला कहा गया है।
verses.wordMeaning: O holy lord, if you see any remedy for uplifting me from this ghostly type of existence please do it. I bow down to you. I seek refuge in you."
verses.commentary: Sense: O holy lord, if you see any remedy for uplifting me from this ghostly type of existence please do it. I bow down to you. I seek refuge in you."

verses.sanskrit: एवमादीनि तीर्थानि प्राधान्यात् कथितानि तु । न शक्यं विस्तराद् वक्तुं तीर्थसंख्या द्विजात्तमाः
verses.transliteration: evamādīni tīrthāni prādhānyāt kathitāni tu / na śakyaṃ vistarād vaktuṃ tīrthasaṃkhyā dvijāttamāḥ
verses.translation: Sahkukarna who was addressed thus, said to the ghost:—"There is none else in this world like you, who is of the greatest meritorious deeds.
verses.hindi: हे विप्रो! यह अधिकारी पुरुषोंकी कर्मभूमि है पारियात्र-ये सात कुलपर्वत यहाँ हैं। इन्द्रद्युम्न, कशेरुमान्,
verses.wordMeaning: Sahkukarna who was addressed thus, said to the ghost:—"There is none else in this world like you, who is of the greatest meritorious deeds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sahkukarna who was addressed thus, said to the ghost:—"There is none else in this world like you, who is of the greatest meritorious deeds.

verses.sanskrit: तेषु सर्वेषु तीर्थेषु स्नात्वाभ्यर्च्य पिनाकिनम् । उपोष्य तत्र तत्रासौ पाराशर्यो महामुनिः
verses.transliteration: teṣu sarveṣu tīrtheṣu snātvābhyarcya pinākinam / upoṣya tatra tatrāsau pārāśaryo mahāmuniḥ
verses.translation: Since, formerly. Lord Siva, the Lord of the universe, was seen, touched and saluted by you, who else can be equal to you in this world?
verses.hindi: वारुण-(इन आठ द्वीपोंके अतिरिक्त) यह नवाँ द्वीप सागरसे घिरा हुआ है। यह द्वीप दक्षिणोत्तरमें एक हजार योजनमें फैला हुआ है। उसके पूर्वमें किरात, पश्चिममें
verses.wordMeaning: Since, formerly. Lord Siva, the Lord of the universe, was seen, touched and saluted by you, who else can be equal to you in this world?
verses.commentary: Sense: Since, formerly. Lord Siva, the Lord of the universe, was seen, touched and saluted by you, who else can be equal to you in this world?

verses.sanskrit: तर्पयित्वा पितॄन् देवान् कृत्वा पिण्डप्रिदानकम् । जगाम पुनरेवापि यत्र विश्वेश्वरः शिवः
verses.transliteration: tarpayitvā pitṝn devān kṛtvā piṇḍapridānakam / jagāma punarevāpi yatra viśveśvaraḥ śivaḥ
verses.translation: That Piiaca (ghost) who had been thus advised by the merciful sage, remembered the three-eyed excellent lord Kapardlsvara, the ruler of the universe, concentrated his mind and took his ablution into the holy pond.
verses.hindi: देवताओंके विमान एक अति श्रेष्ठ प्रासादके समान ही सभी सुविधाओंसे युक्त होते हैं-जैसे पुष्पक विमान, कपिलके द्वारा देवहूतिको दिया गया कामग विमान आदि।
verses.wordMeaning: That Piiaca (ghost) who had been thus advised by the merciful sage, remembered the three-eyed excellent lord Kapardlsvara, the ruler of the universe, concentrated his mind and took his ablution into the holy pond.
verses.commentary: Sense: That Piiaca (ghost) who had been thus advised by the merciful sage, remembered the three-eyed excellent lord Kapardlsvara, the ruler of the universe, concentrated his mind and took his ablution into the holy pond.

verses.sanskrit: स्नात्वाभ्यर्च्य परं लिङ्गं शिष्यैः सह महामुनिः । उवाच शिष्यान् धर्मात्मा स्वान् देशान् गन्तुमर्हथा
verses.transliteration: snātvābhyarcya paraṃ liṅgaṃ śiṣyaiḥ saha mahāmuniḥ / uvāca śiṣyān dharmātmā svān deśān gantumarhathā
verses.translation: As a result of the plunge, he died in the vicinity of the sage. He was then seen in an aerial chariot that resembled the sun himself,bedecked with divine ornaments with his beauti¬ ful crest marked by the moon.
verses.hindi: इरावती वितस्ता च विपाशा देविका कुहूः
verses.wordMeaning: As a result of the plunge, he died in the vicinity of the sage. He was then seen in an aerial chariot that resembled the sun himself,bedecked with divine ornaments with his beauti¬ ful crest marked by the moon.
verses.commentary: Sense: As a result of the plunge, he died in the vicinity of the sage. He was then seen in an aerial chariot that resembled the sun himself,bedecked with divine ornaments with his beauti¬ ful crest marked by the moon.

verses.sanskrit: ते प्रणम्य महात्मानं जग्मुः पैलादयो द्विजाः । वासं च तत्र नियतो वाराणस्यां चकार सः
verses.transliteration: te praṇamya mahātmānaṃ jagmuḥ pailādayo dvijāḥ / vāsaṃ ca tatra niyato vārāṇasyāṃ cakāra saḥ
verses.translation: Rising up and surrounded by Rudras stationed in heaven and by incomprehensible Yogins, he shone like the rising sun, the lord of all, surrounded by Valakhilya sages and others.
verses.hindi: गोमती धूतपापा च बाहुदा च दृषद्वती। कौशिकी लोहिता चैव हिमवत्पादनिःसृताः शिग्रुः स्वशिल्पापि तथा पारियात्राश्रयाः स्मृताः
verses.wordMeaning: Rising up and surrounded by Rudras stationed in heaven and by incomprehensible Yogins, he shone like the rising sun, the lord of all, surrounded by Valakhilya sages and others.
verses.commentary: Sense: Rising up and surrounded by Rudras stationed in heaven and by incomprehensible Yogins, he shone like the rising sun, the lord of all, surrounded by Valakhilya sages and others.

verses.sanskrit: शान्तो दान्तस्त्रिषवणंस्नात्वाभ्यर्च्य पिनाकिनम् । भैक्षाहारो विशुद्धात्मा ब्रह्मचर्यपरायणः
verses.transliteration: śānto dāntastriṣavaṇaṃsnātvābhyarcya pinākinam / bhaikṣāhāro viśuddhātmā brahmacaryaparāyaṇaḥ
verses.translation: In heaven, Siddhas and Devas began to eulogise; the charming celestial Apsaras danced; the Gandharvas, Vidyadharas, Kinnaras and others showered flowers with bees hovering round them.*
verses.hindi: मन्दाकिनी चित्रकूटा तामसी च पिशाचिका
verses.wordMeaning: In heaven, Siddhas and Devas began to eulogise; the charming celestial Apsaras danced; the Gandharvas, Vidyadharas, Kinnaras and others showered flowers with bees hovering round them.*
verses.commentary: Sense: In heaven, Siddhas and Devas began to eulogise; the charming celestial Apsaras danced; the Gandharvas, Vidyadharas, Kinnaras and others showered flowers with bees hovering round them.*

verses.sanskrit: कदाचिद् वसता तत्र व्यासेनामिततेजसा । भ्रममाणेन भिक्षा तु नैव लब्धा द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: kadācid vasatā tatra vyāsenāmitatejasā / bhramamāṇena bhikṣā tu naiva labdhā dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: After attaining spiritual enlightenment through the grace of divine Lord, he, being eulogised by groups of eminent sages, entered the foremost sphere of the sun consisting of three Vedas where Rudra himself shines.
verses.hindi: ऋक्षवत्पादजा नद्यः सर्वपापहरा नृणाम् वेण्या वैतरणी चैव बलाका च कुमुद्दती
verses.wordMeaning: After attaining spiritual enlightenment through the grace of divine Lord, he, being eulogised by groups of eminent sages, entered the foremost sphere of the sun consisting of three Vedas where Rudra himself shines.
verses.commentary: Sense: After attaining spiritual enlightenment through the grace of divine Lord, he, being eulogised by groups of eminent sages, entered the foremost sphere of the sun consisting of three Vedas where Rudra himself shines.

verses.sanskrit: ततः क्रोधावृततनुर्नराणामिह वासिनाम् । विघ्नं सृजामि सर्वेषां येन सिद्धिर्विहीयते
verses.transliteration: tataḥ krodhāvṛtatanurnarāṇāmiha vāsinām / vighnaṃ sṛjāmi sarveṣāṃ yena siddhirvihīyate
verses.translation: On seeing the goblin-like ghost liberated, the sage was delighted. He mentally thought of Mahesa, Rudra, the foremost of the wise. He bowed down to and eulogised Kapardin.
verses.hindi: तुङ्गभद्रा सुप्रयोगा कावेरी च द्विजोत्तमाः। दक्षिणापथगा नद्यः सह्ापादविनिःसृताः
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing the goblin-like ghost liberated, the sage was delighted. He mentally thought of Mahesa, Rudra, the foremost of the wise. He bowed down to and eulogised Kapardin.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the goblin-like ghost liberated, the sage was delighted. He mentally thought of Mahesa, Rudra, the foremost of the wise. He bowed down to and eulogised Kapardin.

verses.sanskrit: तत्क्षणे सा महादेवी शङ्करार्धशरीरिणी । प्रादुरासीत् स्वयं प्रीत्या वेषं कृत्वा तु मानुषम्
verses.transliteration: tatkṣaṇe sā mahādevī śaṅkarārdhaśarīriṇī / prādurāsīt svayaṃ prītyā veṣaṃ kṛtvā tu mānuṣam
verses.translation: "I bow down to the eternal ancient Purusa, the sole protector, greater than the greatest. I go unto the master of Yoga, the ruler, the sun, the fire, mounted on the large mass, (a better v.l. beyond Kapila).
verses.hindi: ऋषिकुल्या त्रिसामा च मन्दगा मन्दगामिनी । रूपा पालासिनी चेव ऋषिका वंशकारिणी। शुक्तिमत्पादसंजाताः सर्वपापहरा नृणाम् सर्वपापहराः पुण्याः स्नानदानादिकर्मसु
verses.wordMeaning: "I bow down to the eternal ancient Purusa, the sole protector, greater than the greatest. I go unto the master of Yoga, the ruler, the sun, the fire, mounted on the large mass, (a better v.l. beyond Kapila).
verses.commentary: Sense: "I bow down to the eternal ancient Purusa, the sole protector, greater than the greatest. I go unto the master of Yoga, the ruler, the sun, the fire, mounted on the large mass, (a better v.l. beyond Kapila).

verses.sanskrit: भो भो व्यास महाबुद्धे शप्तव्या भवता न हि । गृहाण भिक्षां मत्तस्त्वमुक्त्वैवं प्रददौ शिवा
verses.transliteration: bho bho vyāsa mahābuddhe śaptavyā bhavatā na hi / gṛhāṇa bhikṣāṃ mattastvamuktvaivaṃ pradadau śivā
verses.translation: "I bow down to the eternal ancient Purusa, the sole protector, greater than the greatest. I go unto the master of Yoga, the ruler, the sun, the fire, mounted on the large mass, (a better v.l. beyond Kapila).
verses.hindi: पूर्वदेशादिकाश्चैव कामरूपनिवासिनः
verses.wordMeaning: "I bow down to the eternal ancient Purusa, the sole protector, greater than the greatest. I go unto the master of Yoga, the ruler, the sun, the fire, mounted on the large mass, (a better v.l. beyond Kapila).
verses.commentary: Sense: "I bow down to the eternal ancient Purusa, the sole protector, greater than the greatest. I go unto the master of Yoga, the ruler, the sun, the fire, mounted on the large mass, (a better v.l. beyond Kapila).

verses.sanskrit: उवाच च महादेवी क्रोधनस्त्वं भवान् यतः । इह क्षेत्रे न वस्तव्यं कृतघ्नो ऽसि त्वया सदा
verses.transliteration: uvāca ca mahādevī krodhanastvaṃ bhavān yataḥ / iha kṣetre na vastavyaṃ kṛtaghno 'si tvayā sadā
verses.translation: "I bow down to the eternal ancient Purusa, the sole protector, greater than the greatest. I go unto the master of Yoga, the ruler, the sun, the fire, mounted on the large mass, (a better v.l. beyond Kapila).
verses.hindi: मालका मालवाश्चैव पारियात्रनिवासिनः। यहाँके मनुष्य यज्ञ, युद्ध और वाणिज्यद्वारा जीवन- निर्वाह करते हैं। (यहाँ) पर्वतोंसे निकली हुई पवित्र नदियाँ प्रवाहित होती हैं। शतद्रु, चन्द्रभागा, सरयू यमुना, इरावती, वितस्ता, विपाशा, देविका, कुहू,
verses.wordMeaning: "I bow down to the eternal ancient Purusa, the sole protector, greater than the greatest. I go unto the master of Yoga, the ruler, the sun, the fire, mounted on the large mass, (a better v.l. beyond Kapila).
verses.commentary: Sense: "I bow down to the eternal ancient Purusa, the sole protector, greater than the greatest. I go unto the master of Yoga, the ruler, the sun, the fire, mounted on the large mass, (a better v.l. beyond Kapila).

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तः स भगवान् ध्यानाज्ज्ञात्वा परां शिवाम् । उवाच प्रणतो भूत्वा स्तुत्वा च प्रवरैः स्तवैः
verses.transliteration: evamuktaḥ sa bhagavān dhyānājjñātvā parāṃ śivām / uvāca praṇato bhūtvā stutvā ca pravaraiḥ stavaiḥ
verses.translation: "I bow down to the eternal ancient Purusa, the sole protector, greater than the greatest. I go unto the master of Yoga, the ruler, the sun, the fire, mounted on the large mass, (a better v.l. beyond Kapila).
verses.hindi: गोमती, धूतपापा, बाहुदा, दृषद्दती, कोशिको तथा लोहिता- ये सभी नदियाँ हिमालयकी तलहटीसे निकली हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: "I bow down to the eternal ancient Purusa, the sole protector, greater than the greatest. I go unto the master of Yoga, the ruler, the sun, the fire, mounted on the large mass, (a better v.l. beyond Kapila).
verses.commentary: Sense: "I bow down to the eternal ancient Purusa, the sole protector, greater than the greatest. I go unto the master of Yoga, the ruler, the sun, the fire, mounted on the large mass, (a better v.l. beyond Kapila).

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्दश्यामथाष्टम्यां प्रवेशं देहि शाङ्करि । एवमस्त्वित्यनुज्ञाय देवी चान्तरधीयत
verses.transliteration: caturdaśyāmathāṣṭamyāṃ praveśaṃ dehi śāṅkari / evamastvityanujñāya devī cāntaradhīyata
verses.translation: "I bow down to the eternal ancient Purusa, the sole protector, greater than the greatest. I go unto the master of Yoga, the ruler, the sun, the fire, mounted on the large mass, (a better v.l. beyond Kapila).
verses.hindi: शिग्रु तथा स्वशिल्पा-ये नदियाँ पारियात्र पर्वतका आश्रय लेनेवाली कही गयी हैं चित्रकूटा, तामसी, पिशाचिका, चित्रोत्पला, विपाशा, मञ्जुला तथा वालुवाहिनी नामक ये ऋक्षवान् पर्वतके नीचेके भागसे निकली हुई नदियाँ मनुष्योंके सभी पापोंका हरण करनेवाली हैं। तापी, पयोष्णी, निर्विन्ध्या,
verses.wordMeaning: "I bow down to the eternal ancient Purusa, the sole protector, greater than the greatest. I go unto the master of Yoga, the ruler, the sun, the fire, mounted on the large mass, (a better v.l. beyond Kapila).
verses.commentary: Sense: "I bow down to the eternal ancient Purusa, the sole protector, greater than the greatest. I go unto the master of Yoga, the ruler, the sun, the fire, mounted on the large mass, (a better v.l. beyond Kapila).

verses.sanskrit: एवं स भगवान् व्यासो महायोगी पुरातनः । ज्ञात्वा क्षेत्रगुणान् सर्वान् स्थितस्तस्याथ पार्श्वतः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ sa bhagavān vyāso mahāyogī purātanaḥ / jñātvā kṣetraguṇān sarvān sthitastasyātha pārśvataḥ
verses.translation: "I bow down to the eternal ancient Purusa, the sole protector, greater than the greatest. I go unto the master of Yoga, the ruler, the sun, the fire, mounted on the large mass, (a better v.l. beyond Kapila).
verses.hindi: शीघ्रोदा, महानदी, वेण्या, वैतरणी, बलाका, कुमुद्वती, तोया, महागौरी, दुर्गा और अन्तःशिला नामकी ये नदियाँ विन्ध्यके निचले भागसे निकली हैं और शुभ हैं तथा पवित्र जलवाली हैं। है द्विजोत्तमो! गोदावरी, भीमरथी,
verses.wordMeaning: "I bow down to the eternal ancient Purusa, the sole protector, greater than the greatest. I go unto the master of Yoga, the ruler, the sun, the fire, mounted on the large mass, (a better v.l. beyond Kapila).
verses.commentary: Sense: "I bow down to the eternal ancient Purusa, the sole protector, greater than the greatest. I go unto the master of Yoga, the ruler, the sun, the fire, mounted on the large mass, (a better v.l. beyond Kapila).

verses.sanskrit: एवं व्यासं स्थितं ज्ञात्वा क्षेत्रं सेवन्ति पण्डिताः । तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन वाराणस्यां वसेन्नरः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ vyāsaṃ sthitaṃ jñātvā kṣetraṃ sevanti paṇḍitāḥ / tasmāt sarvaprayatnena vārāṇasyāṃ vasennaraḥ
verses.translation: "I bow down to the eternal ancient Purusa, the sole protector, greater than the greatest. I go unto the master of Yoga, the ruler, the sun, the fire, mounted on the large mass, (a better v.l. beyond Kapila).
verses.hindi: कृष्णा, वर्णा, मत्सरी, तुङ्गभद्रा, सुप्रयोगा तथा कावेरी- ये नदियाँ दक्षिणकी ओर जानेवाली तथा सह्यपर्वतके पादमूलसे निकली हें ॥ ३१--३५॥ मलय पर्वतसे निकली ये सभी नदियाँ शीतल जलवाली कही गयी हैं। ऋषिकुल्या, त्रिसामा, मन्दगा, मन्दगामिनी, रूपा, पालासिनी, ऋषिका तथा वंशकारिणी--ये नदियाँ शुक्तिमान् पर्वतके निम्न भागसे उत्पन्न हैं और मनुष्योंके
verses.wordMeaning: "I bow down to the eternal ancient Purusa, the sole protector, greater than the greatest. I go unto the master of Yoga, the ruler, the sun, the fire, mounted on the large mass, (a better v.l. beyond Kapila).
verses.commentary: Sense: "I bow down to the eternal ancient Purusa, the sole protector, greater than the greatest. I go unto the master of Yoga, the ruler, the sun, the fire, mounted on the large mass, (a better v.l. beyond Kapila).

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच यः पठेदविमुक्तस्य माहात्म्यं शृणुयादपि । श्रावयेद् वा द्विजान् शान्तान् सो ऽपियातिपराङ्गतिम्
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca yaḥ paṭhedavimuktasya māhātmyaṃ śṛṇuyādapi / śrāvayed vā dvijān śāntān so 'piyātiparāṅgatim
verses.translation: "I bow down to the eternal ancient Purusa, the sole protector, greater than the greatest. I go unto the master of Yoga, the ruler, the sun, the fire, mounted on the large mass, (a better v.l. beyond Kapila).
verses.hindi: सभी पापोंको हरण करनेवाली हैं
verses.wordMeaning: "I bow down to the eternal ancient Purusa, the sole protector, greater than the greatest. I go unto the master of Yoga, the ruler, the sun, the fire, mounted on the large mass, (a better v.l. beyond Kapila).
verses.commentary: Sense: "I bow down to the eternal ancient Purusa, the sole protector, greater than the greatest. I go unto the master of Yoga, the ruler, the sun, the fire, mounted on the large mass, (a better v.l. beyond Kapila).

verses.sanskrit: श्राद्धे वा दैविके कार्ये रात्रावहनि वा द्विजाः । नदीनां चैव तीरेषु देवतायतनेषु च
verses.transliteration: śrāddhe vā daivike kārye rātrāvahani vā dvijāḥ / nadīnāṃ caiva tīreṣu devatāyataneṣu ca
verses.translation: "I bow down to the eternal ancient Purusa, the sole protector, greater than the greatest. I go unto the master of Yoga, the ruler, the sun, the fire, mounted on the large mass, (a better v.l. beyond Kapila).
verses.hindi: हे द्विजश्रेष्ठो! इन सभी (महानदियों)-की सैकड़ों नदियाँ और उपनदियाँ हैं, जो सभी पापोंको हरनेवाली तथा स्नान, दान आदि कर्मोमें पवित्र हैं। उनमें ये कुरु, पाञ्चाल, मध्यदेश आदिके लोग, पूर्वके देशोमें रहनेवाले, कामरूपके निवासी, पुण्डू, कलिङ्ग तथा मगध देशके लोग, समस्त दाक्षिणात्य तथा (इनके
verses.wordMeaning: "I bow down to the eternal ancient Purusa, the sole protector, greater than the greatest. I go unto the master of Yoga, the ruler, the sun, the fire, mounted on the large mass, (a better v.l. beyond Kapila).
verses.commentary: Sense: "I bow down to the eternal ancient Purusa, the sole protector, greater than the greatest. I go unto the master of Yoga, the ruler, the sun, the fire, mounted on the large mass, (a better v.l. beyond Kapila).

verses.sanskrit: स्नात्वा समाहितमना दम्भमात्सर्यवर्जितः । जपेदीशं नमस्कृत्य स याति परमां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: snātvā samāhitamanā dambhamātsaryavarjitaḥ / japedīśaṃ namaskṛtya sa yāti paramāṃ gatim
verses.translation: "I bow down to the eternal ancient Purusa, the sole protector, greater than the greatest. I go unto the master of Yoga, the ruler, the sun, the fire, mounted on the large mass, (a better v.l. beyond Kapila).
verses.hindi: जाति-विशेषके लोग), मालक, मालव, पारियात्रमें
verses.wordMeaning: "I bow down to the eternal ancient Purusa, the sole protector, greater than the greatest. I go unto the master of Yoga, the ruler, the sun, the fire, mounted on the large mass, (a better v.l. beyond Kapila).
verses.commentary: Sense: "I bow down to the eternal ancient Purusa, the sole protector, greater than the greatest. I go unto the master of Yoga, the ruler, the sun, the fire, mounted on the large mass, (a better v.l. beyond Kapila).

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे त्रयस्त्रिशो ऽध्यायः ऋषय ऊचुः माहात्म्यमविमुक्तस्य यथावत् तदुदीरितम् । इदानीं तु प्रयागस्य माहात्म्यं ब्रूहि सुव्रत
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge trayastriśo 'dhyāyaḥ ṛṣaya ūcuḥ māhātmyamavimuktasya yathāvat tadudīritam / idānīṃ tu prayāgasya māhātmyaṃ brūhi suvrata
verses.translation: I seek refuge in you, the Brahman, (i.e. Vedas), the golden one, abiding in the hearts of Yogins, devoid of beginning. I seek refuge in you stationed in heaven, the holy great sage, composed of Brahman.
verses.hindi: मद्रा रामास्तथाम्बष्ठा: पारसीकास्तथैव च। आसां पिबन्ति सलिलं वसन्ति सरितां सदा न तेषु शोको नायासो नोद्वेग: क्षुद्भयं न च
verses.wordMeaning: I seek refuge in you, the Brahman, (i.e. Vedas), the golden one, abiding in the hearts of Yogins, devoid of beginning. I seek refuge in you stationed in heaven, the holy great sage, composed of Brahman.
verses.commentary: Sense: I seek refuge in you, the Brahman, (i.e. Vedas), the golden one, abiding in the hearts of Yogins, devoid of beginning. I seek refuge in you stationed in heaven, the holy great sage, composed of Brahman.

verses.sanskrit: यानि तीर्थानि तत्रैव विश्रुतानि महान्ति वै । इदानीं कथयास्माकं सूत सर्वार्थविद् भवान्
verses.transliteration: yāni tīrthāni tatraiva viśrutāni mahānti vai / idānīṃ kathayāsmākaṃ sūta sarvārthavid bhavān
verses.translation: I bow unto you, beyond Brahman, Sambhu endowed with a thousand feet, eyes and heads, having a thousand arms,
verses.hindi: स्वस्थाः प्रजा निरातङ्काः सर्वदुःखविवर्जिताः ।
verses.wordMeaning: I bow unto you, beyond Brahman, Sambhu endowed with a thousand feet, eyes and heads, having a thousand arms,
verses.commentary: Sense: I bow unto you, beyond Brahman, Sambhu endowed with a thousand feet, eyes and heads, having a thousand arms,

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच शृणुध्वमृषयः सर्वे विस्तरेण ब्रवीमि वः । प्रयागस्य च माहात्म्यं यत्र देवः पितामहः
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca śṛṇudhvamṛṣayaḥ sarve vistareṇa bravīmi vaḥ / prayāgasya ca māhātmyaṃ yatra devaḥ pitāmahaḥ
verses.translation: For ever I bow down to and seek refuge in Siva, Lord Isa, the other shore of Brahman, from whom the universe origi¬ nates and by whom the auspicious one, the universe is dissolved and all these have been brought up.
verses.hindi: मद्र, राम, अम्बष्ठ तथा पारसी लोग इन नदियोंके किनारे रहते हैं और इन (नदियों)-का जल पीते हैं॥ ३८--४२ ॥ कवियों (मनीषियों)-ने भारतवर्षमें--कृत (सत्य), त्रेता, द्वापर तथा कलि--इन चार युगोंको बताया है। ये (युग) अन्यत्र कहीं नहीं होते
verses.wordMeaning: For ever I bow down to and seek refuge in Siva, Lord Isa, the other shore of Brahman, from whom the universe origi¬ nates and by whom the auspicious one, the universe is dissolved and all these have been brought up.
verses.commentary: Sense: For ever I bow down to and seek refuge in Siva, Lord Isa, the other shore of Brahman, from whom the universe origi¬ nates and by whom the auspicious one, the universe is dissolved and all these have been brought up.

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेयेन कथितं कौन्तेयाय महात्मने । यथा युधिष्ठिरायैतत् तद्वक्ष्ये भवतामहम्
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeyena kathitaṃ kaunteyāya mahātmane / yathā yudhiṣṭhirāyaitat tadvakṣye bhavatāmaham
verses.translation: I bov/ down to you, the Sole Rudra, beyond all ■symbols, of unmanifest form, self-luminous, the Lord of con¬ sciousness, the Supreme Lord who is beyond Brahman and beyond whom nothing exists.
verses.hindi: हे महर्षियो! किंपुरुष आदि जो आठ वर्ष हैं, उनमें न शोक है, न परिश्रम है, न उद्देग है और न भूखका भय है। (वहाँ) सारी प्रजा स्वस्थ, आतङ्करहित तथा सभी प्रकारके दुःखोंसे मुक्त रहती है। सभी स्थिर
verses.wordMeaning: I bov/ down to you, the Sole Rudra, beyond all ■symbols, of unmanifest form, self-luminous, the Lord of con¬ sciousness, the Supreme Lord who is beyond Brahman and beyond whom nothing exists.
verses.commentary: Sense: I bov/ down to you, the Sole Rudra, beyond all ■symbols, of unmanifest form, self-luminous, the Lord of con¬ sciousness, the Supreme Lord who is beyond Brahman and beyond whom nothing exists.

verses.sanskrit: निहत्य कौरवान सर्वान् भ्रातृभिः सह पार्थिवः । शोकेन महाताविष्टा मुमोह स युधिष्ठिरः
verses.transliteration: nihatya kauravāna sarvān bhrātṛbhiḥ saha pārthivaḥ / śokena mahātāviṣṭā mumoha sa yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
verses.translation: I bow unto your form which is beyond Brahman {Brahmapara), the lord whom the Yogins visualize after attaining Samadhi (the trance) wherein the Sabija form is eschewed (i.e. in the nirvikalpa samadhi) when the Yogins become one with the Supreme Atman.
verses.hindi: यौवनवाले होते हैं और अनेक प्रकारके भावोंसे रमण रमन्ति विविधैर्भावैः सर्वाश्च स्थिरयौवनाः ॥ ४५ ॥  करते रहते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: I bow unto your form which is beyond Brahman {Brahmapara), the lord whom the Yogins visualize after attaining Samadhi (the trance) wherein the Sabija form is eschewed (i.e. in the nirvikalpa samadhi) when the Yogins become one with the Supreme Atman.
verses.commentary: Sense: I bow unto your form which is beyond Brahman {Brahmapara), the lord whom the Yogins visualize after attaining Samadhi (the trance) wherein the Sabija form is eschewed (i.e. in the nirvikalpa samadhi) when the Yogins become one with the Supreme Atman.

verses.sanskrit: अचिरेणाथ कालेन मार्कण्डेयो महातपाः । संप्राप्तो हास्तिनपुरं राजद्वारे स तिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: acireṇātha kālena mārkaṇḍeyo mahātapāḥ / saṃprāpto hāstinapuraṃ rājadvāre sa tiṣṭhati
verses.translation: I bow forever to you who are the ultimate form of BTzhmdin {Brahma-para) which transcends names and which has no special gratifications and whose form is beyond the ken of sight.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे पट्साहरत्रधां संहितायां पूर्वाविभागे पञ्चचत्वारिशोउध्याय:
verses.wordMeaning: I bow forever to you who are the ultimate form of BTzhmdin {Brahma-para) which transcends names and which has no special gratifications and whose form is beyond the ken of sight.
verses.commentary: Sense: I bow forever to you who are the ultimate form of BTzhmdin {Brahma-para) which transcends names and which has no special gratifications and whose form is beyond the ken of sight.

verses.sanskrit: द्वारपालो ऽपि तं दृष्ट्वा राज्ञः कथितवान् द्रुतम् । मार्कण्डेयो द्रष्टुमिच्छंस्त्वामास्ते द्वार्यसौ मुनिः
verses.transliteration: dvārapālo 'pi taṃ dṛṣṭvā rājñaḥ kathitavān drutam / mārkaṇḍeyo draṣṭumicchaṃstvāmāste dvāryasau muniḥ
verses.translation: I pay obeisance for ever to that ultimate shore of Brahman whom those who are absorbed in Vedic discussion realise to be formless, the very embodiment of knowl¬ edge about Brahman, undifferentiated, one without a second yet they perceive it in multifarious form.
verses.hindi: विभिन्न पर्वतोंपर स्थित देवताओंके पुरोंका वर्णन तथा वहाँके निवासियों, नदियों, सरोवरों और भवनोंका वर्णन, जम्बूद्वीपके वर्णनका उपसंहार स्फाटिकं देवदेवस्य विमानं परमेष्ठिनः
verses.wordMeaning: I pay obeisance for ever to that ultimate shore of Brahman whom those who are absorbed in Vedic discussion realise to be formless, the very embodiment of knowl¬ edge about Brahman, undifferentiated, one without a second yet they perceive it in multifarious form.
verses.commentary: Sense: I pay obeisance for ever to that ultimate shore of Brahman whom those who are absorbed in Vedic discussion realise to be formless, the very embodiment of knowl¬ edge about Brahman, undifferentiated, one without a second yet they perceive it in multifarious form.

verses.sanskrit: त्वरितो धर्मपुत्रस्तु द्वारमेत्याह तत्परम् । स्वागतं ते महाप्राज्ञ स्वागतं ते महामुने
verses.transliteration: tvarito dharmaputrastu dvārametyāha tatparam / svāgataṃ te mahāprājña svāgataṃ te mahāmune
verses.translation: I bow for ever to your huge form called Kala from which the Pradhana and Ancient Purusa have come out as a Vivaria (illusion), to whom Devas pay respects, which is en¬ veloped in brilliance.
verses.hindi: अथ देवादिदेवस्य भूतेशस्य त्रिशूलिनः । देवाः सिद्धगणा यक्षाः पूजां नित्यं प्रकुर्वते
verses.wordMeaning: I bow for ever to your huge form called Kala from which the Pradhana and Ancient Purusa have come out as a Vivaria (illusion), to whom Devas pay respects, which is en¬ veloped in brilliance.
verses.commentary: Sense: I bow for ever to your huge form called Kala from which the Pradhana and Ancient Purusa have come out as a Vivaria (illusion), to whom Devas pay respects, which is en¬ veloped in brilliance.

verses.sanskrit: अद्य मे सफलं जन्म अद्य मे तारितं कुलम् । अद्य मे पितरस्तुष्टास्त्वयि तुष्टे महामुने
verses.transliteration: adya me saphalaṃ janma adya me tāritaṃ kulam / adya me pitarastuṣṭāstvayi tuṣṭe mahāmune
verses.translation: Forever, I seek refuge in Mahesa, I resort to Sthanu, Girisa, the ancient deity. I resort to Siva, the moon-crested Hara, the wielder of the Pinaka bo'w."
verses.hindi: स देवो गिरिशः सार्ध महादेव्या महेश्वरः । भूतेः परिवृतो नित्यं भाति तत्र पिनाकधृक् निवासः कोटियक्षाणां कुबेरस्य च धीमतः । तत्रापि देवदेवस्य भवस्यायतनं महत्
verses.wordMeaning: Forever, I seek refuge in Mahesa, I resort to Sthanu, Girisa, the ancient deity. I resort to Siva, the moon-crested Hara, the wielder of the Pinaka bo'w."
verses.commentary: Sense: Forever, I seek refuge in Mahesa, I resort to Sthanu, Girisa, the ancient deity. I resort to Siva, the moon-crested Hara, the wielder of the Pinaka bo'w."

verses.sanskrit: सिंहासनमुपस्थाप्य पादशौचार्चनादिभिः । युधिष्ठिरो महात्मेति पूजयामास तं मुनिम्
verses.transliteration: siṃhāsanamupasthāpya pādaśaucārcanādibhiḥ / yudhiṣṭhiro mahātmeti pūjayāmāsa taṃ munim
verses.translation: After eulogising Lord Kapardin thus, Sankukarna fell on the ground like a staff, repeating the auspicious Pranava Mantra ( Orti).
verses.hindi: मन्दाकिनी तत्र दिव्या रम्या सुविमलोदका।
verses.wordMeaning: After eulogising Lord Kapardin thus, Sankukarna fell on the ground like a staff, repeating the auspicious Pranava Mantra ( Orti).
verses.commentary: Sense: After eulogising Lord Kapardin thus, Sankukarna fell on the ground like a staff, repeating the auspicious Pranava Mantra ( Orti).

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेयस्ततस्तुष्टः प्रोवाच स युधिष्ठिरम् । किमर्थं मुह्यसे विद्वन् सर्वं ज्ञात्वाहमागतः
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeyastatastuṣṭaḥ provāca sa yudhiṣṭhiram / kimarthaṃ muhyase vidvan sarvaṃ jñātvāhamāgataḥ
verses.translation: At the same instant the greatest Linga of the nature •of Siva manifested itself there; it was of the nature of knowledge
verses.hindi: देवदानवगन्धर्वयक्षराक्षसकिंनरैः  उपस्पृष्टजला नित्यं सुपुण्या सुमनोरमा तासां कूलेषु देवस्य स्थानानि परमेष्ठिनः। देवर्षिगणजुष्टानि तथा नारायणस्य च
verses.wordMeaning: At the same instant the greatest Linga of the nature •of Siva manifested itself there; it was of the nature of knowledge
verses.commentary: Sense: At the same instant the greatest Linga of the nature •of Siva manifested itself there; it was of the nature of knowledge

verses.sanskrit: ततो युधिष्ठिरो राजा प्रणम्याह महामुनिम् । कथय त्वं समासेन येन मुच्येत किल्बिषैः
verses.transliteration: tato yudhiṣṭhiro rājā praṇamyāha mahāmunim / kathaya tvaṃ samāsena yena mucyeta kilbiṣaiḥ
verses.translation: That pure spotless sage Sahkukarna, of the nature of the soul of all, became merged in the stainless Linga; It was something miraculous.
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले-हेमकूट पर्वतके शिखरपर बड़े- बड़े गुंबदोंसे सुशोभित स्फटिकसे बना हुआ देवाधिदेव परमेष्ठी (शिव)-का एक विमान है। वहाँ देवता, सिद्धगण तथा यक्ष देवोंके आदिदेव भूतेश त्रिशूलीकी
verses.wordMeaning: That pure spotless sage Sahkukarna, of the nature of the soul of all, became merged in the stainless Linga; It was something miraculous.
verses.commentary: Sense: That pure spotless sage Sahkukarna, of the nature of the soul of all, became merged in the stainless Linga; It was something miraculous.

verses.sanskrit: निहता वहवो युद्धे पुंसो निरपराधिनः । अस्माभिः कौरवैः सार्धं प्रसङ्गान्मुनिपुङ्गव
verses.transliteration: nihatā vahavo yuddhe puṃso niraparādhinaḥ / asmābhiḥ kauravaiḥ sārdhaṃ prasaṅgānmunipuṅgava
verses.translation: This great secret, the greatness of Kapardin has been narrated. Due to Tamas Guna no one understands it, even a scholar becomes deluded in this regard.
verses.hindi: नित्य पूजा करते हैं। वे पिनाक धारण करनेवाले गिरिश महेश्वर महादेवीके साथ भूतगणोंसे आवृत होते हुए नित्य वहाँ सुशोभित होते हैं पर्वत है तथा जहाँ करोड़ों यक्षों तथा बुद्धिमान् कुबेरका निवास है, वहीँपर देवाधिदेव शंकरका विशाल मन्दिर है। वहाँ नाना प्रकारके अनेक कमलोंसे अलंकृत
verses.wordMeaning: This great secret, the greatness of Kapardin has been narrated. Due to Tamas Guna no one understands it, even a scholar becomes deluded in this regard.
verses.commentary: Sense: This great secret, the greatness of Kapardin has been narrated. Due to Tamas Guna no one understands it, even a scholar becomes deluded in this regard.

verses.sanskrit: येन हिंसासमुद्भूताज्जन्मान्तरकृतादपि । मुच्यते पातकादस्मात् तद् भवान् वक्तुमर्हति
verses.transliteration: yena hiṃsāsamudbhūtājjanmāntarakṛtādapi / mucyate pātakādasmāt tad bhavān vaktumarhati
verses.translation: The devotee who listens to this sin-destroying episode will be absolved of all sins and shall attain forever the proximity to Rudra.
verses.hindi: नदी है। देवता, दानव, गन्धर्व, यक्ष, राक्षस और किंनर उस अत्यन्त पवित्र तथा मनोरम नदीके जलका नित्य स्पर्श (स्नान, आचमन आदि) करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: The devotee who listens to this sin-destroying episode will be absolved of all sins and shall attain forever the proximity to Rudra.
verses.commentary: Sense: The devotee who listens to this sin-destroying episode will be absolved of all sins and shall attain forever the proximity to Rudra.

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच शृणु राजन् महाभाग यन्मां पृच्छसि भारत् । प्रयागगमनं श्रेष्ठं नराणां पापनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca śṛṇu rājan mahābhāga yanmāṃ pṛcchasi bhārat / prayāgagamanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ narāṇāṃ pāpanāśanam
verses.translation: The pure-hearted person who always reads the great hymn called Brahmapara both in the morning and at midday shall attain Yoga.
verses.hindi: अन्य भी स्वर्णकमलोंसे सुशोभित वहाँ सैकड़ों नदियाँ हैं। इनके तटोंपर देवताओं तथा ऋषिगणोंसे सेवित परमेष्ठी देव और नारायणके मन्दिर हँ तत्राथ देवदेवस्य विष्णोर्विश्वामरेशितुः। सुपुण्यं भवनं रम्यं सर्वरत्नोपशोभितम्
verses.wordMeaning: The pure-hearted person who always reads the great hymn called Brahmapara both in the morning and at midday shall attain Yoga.
verses.commentary: Sense: The pure-hearted person who always reads the great hymn called Brahmapara both in the morning and at midday shall attain Yoga.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र देवो महादेवो रुद्रो विश्वामरेश्वरः । समास्ते भगवान् ब्रह्मा स्वयंभूरपि दैवदैः
verses.transliteration: tatra devo mahādevo rudro viśvāmareśvaraḥ / samāste bhagavān brahmā svayaṃbhūrapi daivadaiḥ
verses.translation: This chapter deals mainly with the Madhyamesvara linga at Varanasi. It need not be confused with the one in Panca Kedara for which vide De 145. *VV. 2-16 in this chapter are the same as Pd. P.I.37.1-19.
verses.hindi: तत्र नारायणः श्रीमान् लक्ष्म्या सह जगत्पतिः ।
verses.wordMeaning: This chapter deals mainly with the Madhyamesvara linga at Varanasi. It need not be confused with the one in Panca Kedara for which vide De 145. *VV. 2-16 in this chapter are the same as Pd. P.I.37.1-19.
verses.commentary: Sense: This chapter deals mainly with the Madhyamesvara linga at Varanasi. It need not be confused with the one in Panca Kedara for which vide De 145. *VV. 2-16 in this chapter are the same as Pd. P.I.37.1-19.

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच भगवञ्च्छ्रोतुमिच्छामि प्रयागगमने फलम् । मृतानां का गतिस्तत्र स्नातानामपि किं फलम्
verses.transliteration: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca bhagavañcchrotumicchāmi prayāgagamane phalam / mṛtānāṃ kā gatistatra snātānāmapi kiṃ phalam
verses.translation: * There he saw the river Mandakini of translucent, sanctifying waters, served by groups of sages. On seeing it, the sage became glad.
verses.hindi: तत्र हैमं चतुर्द्वारं वञ्चनीलादिमण्डितम्। सुपुण्यं सुमहत् स्थानं ब्रह्मणोऽव्यक्तजन्मनः तत्र देवर्षयो विप्राः सिद्धा ब्रह्मर्षयो5परे। उपासते सदा देवं पितामहमजं परम्
verses.wordMeaning: * There he saw the river Mandakini of translucent, sanctifying waters, served by groups of sages. On seeing it, the sage became glad.
verses.commentary: Sense: * There he saw the river Mandakini of translucent, sanctifying waters, served by groups of sages. On seeing it, the sage became glad.

verses.sanskrit: ये वसन्ति प्रयागे तु ब्रूहि तेषां तु किं फलम् । भवता विदितं ह्येतत् तन्मे ब्रूहि नमो ऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: ye vasanti prayāge tu brūhi teṣāṃ tu kiṃ phalam / bhavatā viditaṃ hyetat tanme brūhi namo 'stu te
verses.translation: Beholding intently (at the river), the holy sage Dvai- payana whose mind was purified with deep devotional feelings and who was himself the knower of the rites of ablutions, took his holy bath along with sages.
verses.hindi: स तैः सम्पूजितो नित्यं देव्या सह चतुर्मुखः । आस्ते हिताय लोकानां शान्तानां परमा गति:
verses.wordMeaning: Beholding intently (at the river), the holy sage Dvai- payana whose mind was purified with deep devotional feelings and who was himself the knower of the rites of ablutions, took his holy bath along with sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: Beholding intently (at the river), the holy sage Dvai- payana whose mind was purified with deep devotional feelings and who was himself the knower of the rites of ablutions, took his holy bath along with sages.

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच कथयिष्यामि ते वत्स या चेष्टा यच्च तत्फलम् । पुरा महर्षिभिः सम्यक् कथ्यमानं मया श्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca kathayiṣyāmi te vatsa yā ceṣṭā yacca tatphalam / purā maharṣibhiḥ samyak kathyamānaṃ mayā śrutam
verses.translation: After duly performing Tarpana rites to Devas, to the sages, to the PUrs, he performed the worship of trident-bearing Madhyamesvara, I Sana god Siva.
verses.hindi: तत्रासौ भगवान् नित्यमास्ते शिष्यैः समावृतः । प्रशान्तदोषैरक्षुदरैर्तरह्मविद्धिर्महात्मभिः शङ्को मनोहरश्चैव कौशिकः कृष्ण एव च। सुमना वेदनादश्च शिष्यास्तस्य प्रधानतः
verses.wordMeaning: After duly performing Tarpana rites to Devas, to the sages, to the PUrs, he performed the worship of trident-bearing Madhyamesvara, I Sana god Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: After duly performing Tarpana rites to Devas, to the sages, to the PUrs, he performed the worship of trident-bearing Madhyamesvara, I Sana god Siva.

verses.sanskrit: एतत् प्रजापतिक्षेत्रं त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतम् । अत्र स्नात्वा दिवं यान्ति ये मृतास्ते ऽपुनर्भवाः
verses.transliteration: etat prajāpatikṣetraṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam / atra snātvā divaṃ yānti ye mṛtāste 'punarbhavāḥ
verses.translation: Then the tranquil devotees of Pasupati who had besmeared their bodies with Bhasma (sacred ashes) came to see Madhyamesvara, Isvara, Rudra.
verses.hindi: उपासते महावीर्या ब्रह्मविद्यापरायणाः
verses.wordMeaning: Then the tranquil devotees of Pasupati who had besmeared their bodies with Bhasma (sacred ashes) came to see Madhyamesvara, Isvara, Rudra.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the tranquil devotees of Pasupati who had besmeared their bodies with Bhasma (sacred ashes) came to see Madhyamesvara, Isvara, Rudra.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र ब्रह्मादयो देवा रक्षां कुर्वन्ति संगताः । बहून्यन्यानि तीर्थानि सर्वपापापहानि तु
verses.transliteration: tatra brahmādayo devā rakṣāṃ kurvanti saṃgatāḥ / bahūnyanyāni tīrthāni sarvapāpāpahāni tu
verses.translation: On seeing sage Dvaipayana surrounded by his disciples, the Brahmanas worshipped him suitably and spoke these words.
verses.hindi: सांनिध्यं कुरुते भूयो देव्या सह महेश्वरः तेषु योगरता विप्रा जापकाः संयतेन्द्रियाः । ब्रह्मण्यासक्तमनसो रमन्ते ज्ञानतत्पराः
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing sage Dvaipayana surrounded by his disciples, the Brahmanas worshipped him suitably and spoke these words.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing sage Dvaipayana surrounded by his disciples, the Brahmanas worshipped him suitably and spoke these words.

verses.sanskrit: कथितुं नेह शक्नोमि बहुवर्षशतैरपि । संक्षेपेण प्रवक्ष्यामि प्रयागस्येह कीर्तनम्
verses.transliteration: kathituṃ neha śaknomi bahuvarṣaśatairapi / saṃkṣepeṇa pravakṣyāmi prayāgasyeha kīrtanam
verses.translation: "Who are you, O great sage? Whence have you come along with your disciples?" Paila and other disciples spoke to those sages purified by means of piety.
verses.hindi: (हेमकूटके) अन्तिम शुभ्र शिखरपर पारिजात वृक्षोंका सुन्दर वन है। वहाँ स्फटिकोंसे बने हुए खम्भोंसे युक्त, स्वर्णसे बना गोपुरवाला इन्द्रका रत्नमण्डित एक विशाल भवन है। वहाँपर समस्त देवताओंके नियामक
verses.wordMeaning: "Who are you, O great sage? Whence have you come along with your disciples?" Paila and other disciples spoke to those sages purified by means of piety.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Who are you, O great sage? Whence have you come along with your disciples?" Paila and other disciples spoke to those sages purified by means of piety.

verses.sanskrit: षष्टिर्धनुः सहस्त्राणि यानि रक्षन्ति जाह्नवीम् । यमुनां रक्षति सदा सविता सप्तवाहनः
verses.transliteration: ṣaṣṭirdhanuḥ sahastrāṇi yāni rakṣanti jāhnavīm / yamunāṃ rakṣati sadā savitā saptavāhanaḥ
verses.translation: "This is the son of Satyavati, the holy sage Krsna- dvaipayana. He is Vyasa and Hrsikesa (Visnu) himself by whom the Vedas have been classified."
verses.hindi: देवाधिदेव विष्णुका एक अत्यन्त पवित्र और रमणीय भवन है, जो सभी रत्नोंसे सुशोभित है । वहाँ संसारके स्वामी, सभी देवताओंमें श्रेष्ठ, पूज्यमान, सनातन श्रीमान् नारायण लक्ष्मीके साथ निवास करते हें इसी प्रकार वसुधार नामक पर्वतपर (आठ) वसुओंके रत्नोंसे मण्डित, देवताओंसे द्वेष करनेवाले असुरोंके लिये अपराजेय पवित्र आठ स्थान हैं। रत्नधार नामक श्रेष्ठ पर्वतपर सिद्धोंके आवाससे युक्त महात्मा सप्तर्षियोंके
verses.wordMeaning: "This is the son of Satyavati, the holy sage Krsna- dvaipayana. He is Vyasa and Hrsikesa (Visnu) himself by whom the Vedas have been classified."
verses.commentary: Sense: "This is the son of Satyavati, the holy sage Krsna- dvaipayana. He is Vyasa and Hrsikesa (Visnu) himself by whom the Vedas have been classified."

verses.sanskrit: प्रयागे तु विशेषेण स्वयं वसति वासवः । मण्डलं रक्षति हरिः सर्वदेवैश्च सम्मितम्
verses.transliteration: prayāge tu viśeṣeṇa svayaṃ vasati vāsavaḥ / maṇḍalaṃ rakṣati hariḥ sarvadevaiśca sammitam
verses.translation: To him, god Mahadeva, the Pinaka-bearing lord himself, became the son named Suka, with a portion of his part.
verses.hindi: पवित्र सात आश्रम हैं। वहाँ अव्यक्तजन्मा ब्रह्माका सोनेसे बना हुआ चार द्वारोंवाला, हीरे एवं नील मणि आदिसे मण्डित अत्यन्त पवित्र विशाल स्थान है
verses.wordMeaning: To him, god Mahadeva, the Pinaka-bearing lord himself, became the son named Suka, with a portion of his part.
verses.commentary: Sense: To him, god Mahadeva, the Pinaka-bearing lord himself, became the son named Suka, with a portion of his part.

verses.sanskrit: न्यग्रोधं रक्षते नित्यं शूलपाणिर्महेश्वरः । स्थानं रक्षन्ति वै देवाः सर्वपापहरं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: nyagrodhaṃ rakṣate nityaṃ śūlapāṇirmaheśvaraḥ / sthānaṃ rakṣanti vai devāḥ sarvapāpaharaṃ śubham
verses.translation: He has resorted to Mahadeva, Sankara, with heart and soul and the greatest devotion and has attained that perfect divine knowledge."
verses.hindi: हे विप्रो! वहाँ देवर्षि, ब्रह्मर्षि, सिद्ध तथा दूसरे लोग अजन्मा परम पितामह देवकी सदा उपासना करते हैं। उनके द्वारा नित्य भलीभाँति पूजित शान्तचित्तवालोंके परम गतिरूप वे चतुर्मुख ब्रह्मा देवीके साथ लोकोंके कल्याणके लिये वहाँ रहते हें
verses.wordMeaning: He has resorted to Mahadeva, Sankara, with heart and soul and the greatest devotion and has attained that perfect divine knowledge."
verses.commentary: Sense: He has resorted to Mahadeva, Sankara, with heart and soul and the greatest devotion and has attained that perfect divine knowledge."

verses.sanskrit: स्वकर्मणावृतो लोको नैव गच्छति तत्पदम् । स्वल्पं स्वल्पतरं पापं यदा तस्य नराधिप । प्रयागं स्मरमाणस्य सर्वमायाति संक्षयम्
verses.transliteration: svakarmaṇāvṛto loko naiva gacchati tatpadam / svalpaṃ svalpataraṃ pāpaṃ yadā tasya narādhipa / prayāgaṃ smaramāṇasya sarvamāyāti saṃkṣayam
verses.translation: Thereafter, all those devotees of Pasupati, with hairs standing on end due to excessive delight, spoke to Vya, the son of Satyavati, with a quiescent mind.
verses.hindi: (उस हेमकूटके) एक ऊँचे शिखरपर महापद्योसे अलंकृत, सुगन्धित, स्वच्छ एवं अमृतके समान जलवाला एक पवित्र विशाल तालाब है। वहाँपर (महर्षि) जेगीषव्यका योगीन्द्रोंसे सुशोभित एक आश्रम है। शान्त दोषोंवाले
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, all those devotees of Pasupati, with hairs standing on end due to excessive delight, spoke to Vya, the son of Satyavati, with a quiescent mind.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, all those devotees of Pasupati, with hairs standing on end due to excessive delight, spoke to Vya, the son of Satyavati, with a quiescent mind.

verses.sanskrit: दर्शनात् तस्य तीर्थस्य नाम संकीर्तनादपि । मुत्तिकालम्भनाद् वापि नरः पापात् प्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: darśanāt tasya tīrthasya nāma saṃkīrtanādapi / muttikālambhanād vāpi naraḥ pāpāt pramucyate
verses.translation: "O holy lord, the knowledge of Paramesthin has been acquired by you by the grace of the lord of Devas. It is the greatest knowledge pertaining to Mahesvara.
verses.hindi: महान् ब्रह्मविज्ञानी एवं महात्मास्वरूप शिष्योंसे आवृत भगवान् (जैगीषव्य) वहाँ नित्य निवास करते हैं उनके प्रधान शिष्य हँ । योगपरायण, शान्त, भस्मसे उपलि शरीरवाले, महावीर्य (उत्कृष्ट शक्तिसम्पन्न) तथा ब्रह्मविद्या- परायण वे सभी (भगवान्की) उपासना करते हैं। उन शान्तचित्त यतियोंपर अनुग्रह करनेके लिये महेश्वर देवीके
verses.wordMeaning: "O holy lord, the knowledge of Paramesthin has been acquired by you by the grace of the lord of Devas. It is the greatest knowledge pertaining to Mahesvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O holy lord, the knowledge of Paramesthin has been acquired by you by the grace of the lord of Devas. It is the greatest knowledge pertaining to Mahesvara.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्च कुण्डानि राजेन्द्र येषां मध्ये तु जाह्नवी । प्रयागं विशतः पुंसः पापं नश्यति तत्क्षणात्
verses.transliteration: pañca kuṇḍāni rājendra yeṣāṃ madhye tu jāhnavī / prayāgaṃ viśataḥ puṃsaḥ pāpaṃ naśyati tatkṣaṇāt
verses.translation: Hence, expound this excellent, unrevealed mystic secret to us without any agitation. May we see the lord quickly after hearing about him through your oral utterance."
verses.hindi: साथ (उस स्थानपर) निवास करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, expound this excellent, unrevealed mystic secret to us without any agitation. May we see the lord quickly after hearing about him through your oral utterance."
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, expound this excellent, unrevealed mystic secret to us without any agitation. May we see the lord quickly after hearing about him through your oral utterance."

verses.sanskrit: योजनानां सहस्त्रेषु गङ्गां यः स्मरते नरः । अपि दुष्कृतकर्मासौ लभते परमां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: yojanānāṃ sahastreṣu gaṅgāṃ yaḥ smarate naraḥ / api duṣkṛtakarmāsau labhate paramāṃ gatim
verses.translation: After dismissing those disciples the chief of whom was sage Sumantu, the most excellent among the knowers of Yoga explained to the Yogins that great knowledge.
verses.hindi: उस उत्तम गिरिश्रेष्ठपर योगयुक्त मनवाले मुनियोंके अन्य कई आश्रम तथा सरोवर और नदियाँ हैं। उनमें योग-परायण, जप करनेवाले, संयत इन्द्रियोंवाले एवं ब्रह्मनिष्ठ मनवाले, ज्ञानतत्पर विप्रगण रमण करते हैं ध्यायन्ति देवमीशानं येन सर्वमिदं ततम्
verses.wordMeaning: After dismissing those disciples the chief of whom was sage Sumantu, the most excellent among the knowers of Yoga explained to the Yogins that great knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: After dismissing those disciples the chief of whom was sage Sumantu, the most excellent among the knowers of Yoga explained to the Yogins that great knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: कीर्तनान्मुच्यते पापाद् दृष्ट्वा भद्राणि पश्यति । तथोपस्पृश्य राजेन्द्र स्वर्गलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: kīrtanānmucyate pāpād dṛṣṭvā bhadrāṇi paśyati / tathopaspṛśya rājendra svargaloke mahīyate
verses.translation: At that same instant a pure and excellent mass of brilliant light manifested itself there. Those Brahmanas got themselves merged there and vanished in a moment.
verses.hindi: तत्रास्ते भगवानिन्द्रः शच्या सह सुरेश्वरः
verses.wordMeaning: At that same instant a pure and excellent mass of brilliant light manifested itself there. Those Brahmanas got themselves merged there and vanished in a moment.
verses.commentary: Sense: At that same instant a pure and excellent mass of brilliant light manifested itself there. Those Brahmanas got themselves merged there and vanished in a moment.

verses.sanskrit: व्याधितो यदि वा दीनः क्रूद्धो वापि भवेन्नरः । गङ्गायमुनमासाद्य त्यजेत् प्राणान् प्रयत्नतः
verses.transliteration: vyādhito yadi vā dīnaḥ krūddho vāpi bhavennaraḥ / gaṅgāyamunamāsādya tyajet prāṇān prayatnataḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, the revered sage, the most excellent one among the knowers of Brahman, recalled Paila and all other disciples and recounted the greatness of Madhyamesa.
verses.hindi: उपास्यमाना विविधैः शक्तिभेहैरितस्ततः। पीत्वा योगामृतं लब्ध्वा साक्षादानन्दमैश्वरम् राक्षसानां पुराणि स्युः सरांसि शतशो द्विजाः
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, the revered sage, the most excellent one among the knowers of Brahman, recalled Paila and all other disciples and recounted the greatness of Madhyamesa.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, the revered sage, the most excellent one among the knowers of Brahman, recalled Paila and all other disciples and recounted the greatness of Madhyamesa.

verses.sanskrit: दीप्तकाञ्चनवर्णाभैर्विमानैर्भानुवर्णिभिः । ईप्सितांल्लभते कामान् वदन्ति मुनिपुङ्गवाः
verses.transliteration: dīptakāñcanavarṇābhairvimānairbhānuvarṇibhiḥ / īpsitāṃllabhate kāmān vadanti munipuṅgavāḥ
verses.translation: It is here that the supreme lord Siva indulges in sport alongwith his consort Parvati, in the company of ganas.
verses.hindi: प्राकारगोपुरोपेते मणितोरणमण्डितम्
verses.wordMeaning: It is here that the supreme lord Siva indulges in sport alongwith his consort Parvati, in the company of ganas.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is here that the supreme lord Siva indulges in sport alongwith his consort Parvati, in the company of ganas.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वरत्नमयैर्दिव्यैर्नानाध्वजसमाकुलैः । वराङ्गनासमाकीर्णैर्मोदते शुभलक्षणः
verses.transliteration: sarvaratnamayairdivyairnānādhvajasamākulaiḥ / varāṅganāsamākīrṇairmodate śubhalakṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: It is here that formerly Krsna, son of DevakI, Hrsikesa stayed continuously for one year, surrounded by Pasupatas.
verses.hindi: स तत्र गरुडः श्रीमान् साक्षाद् विष्णुरिवापरः । ध्यात्वास्ते तत् परं ज्योतिरात्मानं विष्णुमव्ययम् अन्यच्च भवनं पुण्यं श्रीशृङ्गे मुनिपुंगवाः । श्रीदेव्या: सर्वरत्नाढ्यं हैमं सुमणितोरणम्
verses.wordMeaning: It is here that formerly Krsna, son of DevakI, Hrsikesa stayed continuously for one year, surrounded by Pasupatas.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is here that formerly Krsna, son of DevakI, Hrsikesa stayed continuously for one year, surrounded by Pasupatas.

verses.sanskrit: गीतवादित्रनिर्घोषैः प्रसुप्तः प्रतिबुध्यते । यावन्न स्मरते जन्म तापत् स्वर्गे महीयते
verses.transliteration: gītavāditranirghoṣaiḥ prasuptaḥ pratibudhyate / yāvanna smarate janma tāpat svarge mahīyate
verses.translation: Besmearing his body entirely with Bhasma, and devot¬ ed to the propitiation of Rudra, Hari performed the holy vow pertaining to Pasupati and propitiated Sambhu.
verses.hindi: अनन्तविभवा लक्ष्मीर्जगत्सम्मोहनोत्सुका
verses.wordMeaning: Besmearing his body entirely with Bhasma, and devot¬ ed to the propitiation of Rudra, Hari performed the holy vow pertaining to Pasupati and propitiated Sambhu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Besmearing his body entirely with Bhasma, and devot¬ ed to the propitiation of Rudra, Hari performed the holy vow pertaining to Pasupati and propitiated Sambhu.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् स्वर्गात् परिभ्रष्टः क्षीणकर्मा नरोत्तम । हिरण्यरत्नसंपूर्णे समृद्धे जायते कुले
verses.transliteration: tasmāt svargāt paribhraṣṭaḥ kṣīṇakarmā narottama / hiraṇyaratnasaṃpūrṇe samṛddhe jāyate kule
verses.translation: Besmearing his body entirely with Bhasma, and devot¬ ed to the propitiation of Rudra, Hari performed the holy vow pertaining to Pasupati and propitiated Sambhu.
verses.hindi: अध्यास्ते देवगन्धर्वसिद्धचारणवन्दिता। विचिन्त्य जगतो योनिं स्वशक्तिकिरणोज्चला तत्रैव देवदेवस्य विष्णोरायतनं महत्। सरांसि तत्र चत्वारि विचित्रकमलाश्रया
verses.wordMeaning: Besmearing his body entirely with Bhasma, and devot¬ ed to the propitiation of Rudra, Hari performed the holy vow pertaining to Pasupati and propitiated Sambhu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Besmearing his body entirely with Bhasma, and devot¬ ed to the propitiation of Rudra, Hari performed the holy vow pertaining to Pasupati and propitiated Sambhu.

verses.sanskrit: तदेव स्मरते तीर्थं स्मरणात् तत्र गच्छति । देशस्थो यदि वारण्ये विदेशे यदि वा गृहे
verses.transliteration: tadeva smarate tīrthaṃ smaraṇāt tatra gacchati / deśastho yadi vāraṇye videśe yadi vā gṛhe
verses.translation: Besmearing his body entirely with Bhasma, and devot¬ ed to the propitiation of Rudra, Hari performed the holy vow pertaining to Pasupati and propitiated Sambhu.
verses.hindi: (समाधिस्थ रहते हे) । (वे) स्वयंमें आत्मनिष्ठ होकर शिखाके अन्तिम मूलभाग(ब्रह्मरन्ध्र)-में स्थित ईशान देवका ध्यान करते हैँ, जिनसे इस सम्पूर्ण (जगत्)- का विस्तार हुआ है। सुमेघ (नामक पर्वत)-पर हजारों
verses.wordMeaning: Besmearing his body entirely with Bhasma, and devot¬ ed to the propitiation of Rudra, Hari performed the holy vow pertaining to Pasupati and propitiated Sambhu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Besmearing his body entirely with Bhasma, and devot¬ ed to the propitiation of Rudra, Hari performed the holy vow pertaining to Pasupati and propitiated Sambhu.

verses.sanskrit: प्रयागं स्मरमाणस्तु यस्तु प्राणान् परित्यजेत् । ब्रह्मलोकमवाप्नोति वदन्ति मुनिपुङ्गवाः
verses.transliteration: prayāgaṃ smaramāṇastu yastu prāṇān parityajet / brahmalokamavāpnoti vadanti munipuṅgavāḥ
verses.translation: Besmearing his body entirely with Bhasma, and devot¬ ed to the propitiation of Rudra, Hari performed the holy vow pertaining to Pasupati and propitiated Sambhu.
verses.hindi: सूर्योके समान प्रकाशमान इन्द्रका एक स्थान है! करते हैं । गजशैलपर दुर्गाका मणियोंसे बने तोरणवाला एक भवन है। साक्षात् महेश्वरी भगवती दुर्गा वहाँ निवास करती हैं । योगामृतका पान करके अर्थात् योगको आत्मसात् कर लेनेके कारण साक्षात् योगेश्वरी और
verses.wordMeaning: Besmearing his body entirely with Bhasma, and devot¬ ed to the propitiation of Rudra, Hari performed the holy vow pertaining to Pasupati and propitiated Sambhu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Besmearing his body entirely with Bhasma, and devot¬ ed to the propitiation of Rudra, Hari performed the holy vow pertaining to Pasupati and propitiated Sambhu.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वकामफला वृक्षा मही यत्र हिरण्मयी । ऋषयो मुनयः सिद्धास्तत्र लोके स गच्छति
verses.transliteration: sarvakāmaphalā vṛkṣā mahī yatra hiraṇmayī / ṛṣayo munayaḥ siddhāstatra loke sa gacchati
verses.translation: Besmearing his body entirely with Bhasma, and devot¬ ed to the propitiation of Rudra, Hari performed the holy vow pertaining to Pasupati and propitiated Sambhu.
verses.hindi: (ईश्वर अर्धनारीश्वर महेशवरकी अर्धाङ्गिनी होनेके कारण) ईश्वरका साक्षात् आनन्द प्राकर विविध प्रकारकी शक्तियोंके रूपमें इतस्ततः उपासित होती रहती हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Besmearing his body entirely with Bhasma, and devot¬ ed to the propitiation of Rudra, Hari performed the holy vow pertaining to Pasupati and propitiated Sambhu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Besmearing his body entirely with Bhasma, and devot¬ ed to the propitiation of Rudra, Hari performed the holy vow pertaining to Pasupati and propitiated Sambhu.

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रीसहस्त्राकुले रम्ये मन्दाकिन्यास्तटे शुभे । मोदते मुनिभिः सार्धं स्वकृतेनेह कर्मणा
verses.transliteration: strīsahastrākule ramye mandākinyāstaṭe śubhe / modate munibhiḥ sārdhaṃ svakṛteneha karmaṇā
verses.translation: Besmearing his body entirely with Bhasma, and devot¬ ed to the propitiation of Rudra, Hari performed the holy vow pertaining to Pasupati and propitiated Sambhu.
verses.hindi: हे द्विजो! विविध धातुओंसे देदीप्यमान सुनील पर्वतके शिखरपर राक्षसोंके नगर तथा सैकड़ों सरोवर हैं । विप्रो! इसी प्रकार शतशृंग नामक महान् पर्वतपर स्फटिक स्तम्भोंसे बने हुए अमित तेजस्वी यक्षोंके सौ नगर हैं। श्वेतोदर पर्वतके शिखरपर महात्मा सुपर्ण (गरुड)-का अनेक प्राकार और गोपुरोंसे युक्त तथा मणियोंसे बने तोरणोंसे मण्डित पुर है। वहाँ साक्षात् दूसरे विष्णुके समान वे श्रीमान् गरुड उन परम
verses.wordMeaning: Besmearing his body entirely with Bhasma, and devot¬ ed to the propitiation of Rudra, Hari performed the holy vow pertaining to Pasupati and propitiated Sambhu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Besmearing his body entirely with Bhasma, and devot¬ ed to the propitiation of Rudra, Hari performed the holy vow pertaining to Pasupati and propitiated Sambhu.

verses.sanskrit: सिद्धचारणगन्धर्वैः पूज्यते दिवि दैवतैः । ततः स्वर्गात् परिभ्रष्टो जम्बुद्वीपपतिर्भवेत्
verses.transliteration: siddhacāraṇagandharvaiḥ pūjyate divi daivataiḥ / tataḥ svargāt paribhraṣṭo jambudvīpapatirbhavet
verses.translation: Besmearing his body entirely with Bhasma, and devot¬ ed to the propitiation of Rudra, Hari performed the holy vow pertaining to Pasupati and propitiated Sambhu.
verses.hindi: ज्योतिःस्वरूप आत्मरूप अव्यय विष्णुका ध्यान करते रहते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Besmearing his body entirely with Bhasma, and devot¬ ed to the propitiation of Rudra, Hari performed the holy vow pertaining to Pasupati and propitiated Sambhu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Besmearing his body entirely with Bhasma, and devot¬ ed to the propitiation of Rudra, Hari performed the holy vow pertaining to Pasupati and propitiated Sambhu.

verses.sanskrit: ततः शुभानि कर्माणि चिन्तयानः पुनः पुनः । गुणवान् वित्तसंपन्नो भवतीह न संशयः । कर्मणा मनसा वाचा सत्यधर्मप्रतिष्ठितः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ śubhāni karmāṇi cintayānaḥ punaḥ punaḥ / guṇavān vittasaṃpanno bhavatīha na saṃśayaḥ / karmaṇā manasā vācā satyadharmapratiṣṭhitaḥ
verses.translation: Besmearing his body entirely with Bhasma, and devot¬ ed to the propitiation of Rudra, Hari performed the holy vow pertaining to Pasupati and propitiated Sambhu.
verses.hindi: मुनिश्रेष्ठो! श्रीशृृंगपर श्रीदेवीका दूसरा भी एक पवित्र भवन है, जो सभी रत्नॉसे पूर्ण तथा स्वर्णसे बना हुआ है और सुन्दर मणियॉसे बने तोरणवाला है। वहाँ विष्णुको अति मनोरम परम शक्ति (वे लक्ष्मी) संसारके मूल कारण (विष्णु)-का चिन्तन करती हुई विशेषरूपसे निवास करती हैं। वे लक्ष्मी अनन्त ऐश्वर्यवाली, संसारको मोहित करनेमें उत्सुक, देवताओं, गन्धर्वो, सिद्धों तथा चारणोंसे वन्दित हैं और अपनी
verses.wordMeaning: Besmearing his body entirely with Bhasma, and devot¬ ed to the propitiation of Rudra, Hari performed the holy vow pertaining to Pasupati and propitiated Sambhu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Besmearing his body entirely with Bhasma, and devot¬ ed to the propitiation of Rudra, Hari performed the holy vow pertaining to Pasupati and propitiated Sambhu.

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गायमुनयोर्मध्ये यस्तु ग्रामं प्रतीच्छति । सुवर्णमथ मुक्तां वा तथैवान्यान् प्रतिग्रहान्
verses.transliteration: gaṅgāyamunayormadhye yastu grāmaṃ pratīcchati / suvarṇamatha muktāṃ vā tathaivānyān pratigrahān
verses.translation: Besmearing his body entirely with Bhasma, and devot¬ ed to the propitiation of Rudra, Hari performed the holy vow pertaining to Pasupati and propitiated Sambhu.
