verses.hindi: शक्तिकी किरणोंसे प्रकाशित हैं। वहीं देवाधिदेव विष्णुका विशाल भवन है तथा वहींपर विचित्र कमलोंवाले चार सरोवर हैं। इसी प्रकार सहस्रशिखर (पर्वत)-पर रोकी सीढ़ियोंसे बने हुए और सरोवरोंसे
verses.wordMeaning: Besmearing his body entirely with Bhasma, and devot¬ ed to the propitiation of Rudra, Hari performed the holy vow pertaining to Pasupati and propitiated Sambhu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Besmearing his body entirely with Bhasma, and devot¬ ed to the propitiation of Rudra, Hari performed the holy vow pertaining to Pasupati and propitiated Sambhu.

verses.sanskrit: स्वकार्ये पितृकार्ये वा देवताभ्यर्चने ऽपि वा । निष्फलं तस्य तत् तीर्थं यावत् तत्फलमश्नुते
verses.transliteration: svakārye pitṛkārye vā devatābhyarcane 'pi vā / niṣphalaṃ tasya tat tīrthaṃ yāvat tatphalamaśnute
verses.translation: Besmearing his body entirely with Bhasma, and devot¬ ed to the propitiation of Rudra, Hari performed the holy vow pertaining to Pasupati and propitiated Sambhu.
verses.hindi: सुशोभित विद्याधरोंके आठ पुर हें ॥ ३१--३५॥ नद्यो विमलपानीयाश्‍चित्रनीलोत्पलाकरा: । कर्णिकारवनं दिव्यं तत्रास्ते शंकरोमया
verses.wordMeaning: Besmearing his body entirely with Bhasma, and devot¬ ed to the propitiation of Rudra, Hari performed the holy vow pertaining to Pasupati and propitiated Sambhu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Besmearing his body entirely with Bhasma, and devot¬ ed to the propitiation of Rudra, Hari performed the holy vow pertaining to Pasupati and propitiated Sambhu.

verses.sanskrit: अतस्तीर्थे न गृह्णीयात् पुण्येष्वायतनेषु च । निमित्तेषु च सर्वेषु अप्रमत्तो द्विजो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: atastīrthe na gṛhṇīyāt puṇyeṣvāyataneṣu ca / nimitteṣu ca sarveṣu apramatto dvijo bhavet
verses.translation: Besmearing his body entirely with Bhasma, and devot¬ ed to the propitiation of Rudra, Hari performed the holy vow pertaining to Pasupati and propitiated Sambhu.
verses.hindi: गन्धर्वकिंनराकीर्ण संवृतं सिद्धपुंगवैः। भास्वद्धित्तिसमाकीर्ण महाप्रासादसंकुलम्
verses.wordMeaning: Besmearing his body entirely with Bhasma, and devot¬ ed to the propitiation of Rudra, Hari performed the holy vow pertaining to Pasupati and propitiated Sambhu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Besmearing his body entirely with Bhasma, and devot¬ ed to the propitiation of Rudra, Hari performed the holy vow pertaining to Pasupati and propitiated Sambhu.

verses.sanskrit: कपिलां पाटलावर्णां यस्तु धेनुं प्रयच्छति । स्वर्णशृङ्गीं रौप्यखुरां चैलकण्ठां पयस्विनीम्
verses.transliteration: kapilāṃ pāṭalāvarṇāṃ yastu dhenuṃ prayacchati / svarṇaśṛṅgīṃ raupyakhurāṃ cailakaṇṭhāṃ payasvinīm
verses.translation: Besmearing his body entirely with Bhasma, and devot¬ ed to the propitiation of Rudra, Hari performed the holy vow pertaining to Pasupati and propitiated Sambhu.
verses.hindi: गणेश्वराङ्गनाजुष्टं धार्मिकाणां सुदर्शनम्। तत्र सा वसते देवी नित्यं योगपरायणा पश्यन्ति तत्र मुनयः सिद्धा ये ब्रह्मवादिनः
verses.wordMeaning: Besmearing his body entirely with Bhasma, and devot¬ ed to the propitiation of Rudra, Hari performed the holy vow pertaining to Pasupati and propitiated Sambhu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Besmearing his body entirely with Bhasma, and devot¬ ed to the propitiation of Rudra, Hari performed the holy vow pertaining to Pasupati and propitiated Sambhu.

verses.sanskrit: यावद् रोमाणि तस्या वै सन्ति गात्रेषु सत्तम । तावद् वर्षसहस्त्राणि रुद्रलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: yāvad romāṇi tasyā vai santi gātreṣu sattama / tāvad varṣasahastrāṇi rudraloke mahīyate
verses.translation: Besmearing his body entirely with Bhasma, and devot¬ ed to the propitiation of Rudra, Hari performed the holy vow pertaining to Pasupati and propitiated Sambhu.
verses.hindi: सरांसि सिद्धजुष्टानि देवभोग्यानि सत्तमाः
verses.wordMeaning: Besmearing his body entirely with Bhasma, and devot¬ ed to the propitiation of Rudra, Hari performed the holy vow pertaining to Pasupati and propitiated Sambhu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Besmearing his body entirely with Bhasma, and devot¬ ed to the propitiation of Rudra, Hari performed the holy vow pertaining to Pasupati and propitiated Sambhu.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे चतुस्त्रिशो ऽध्यायः मार्कण्डेय उवाच कथयिष्यामि ते वत्स तीर्थयात्राविधिक्रमम् । आर्षेण तु विधानेन यथा दृष्टं यथा श्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge catustriśo 'dhyāyaḥ mārkaṇḍeya uvāca kathayiṣyāmi te vatsa tīrthayātrāvidhikramam / ārṣeṇa tu vidhānena yathā dṛṣṭaṃ yathā śrutam
verses.translation: Many of his disciples devoted to the vow of celibacy attained perfect knowledge, through his advice and perceived Mahesvara.
verses.hindi: चित्रसेनादयो यत्र समायान्त्यर्थिनः सदा। सा पुरी सर्वरत्नाढ्या नैकप्रस्त्रवणेर्युता अनेकानि पुराणि स्युः कोमुदे चापि सुव्रताः । रुद्राणां शान्तरजसामीश्वरापितचेतसाम्
verses.wordMeaning: Many of his disciples devoted to the vow of celibacy attained perfect knowledge, through his advice and perceived Mahesvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Many of his disciples devoted to the vow of celibacy attained perfect knowledge, through his advice and perceived Mahesvara.

verses.sanskrit: प्रयागतीर्थयात्रार्थो यः प्रयाति नरः क्वचित् । बलीवर्दं समारूढः शृणु तस्यापि यत्फलम्
verses.transliteration: prayāgatīrthayātrārtho yaḥ prayāti naraḥ kvacit / balīvardaṃ samārūḍhaḥ śṛṇu tasyāpi yatphalam
verses.translation: Lord Mahadeva, the blue-red complexioned God appeared directly before Krsna. The bestower of boons that he is, the lord conferred upon him excellent boons.
verses.hindi: वहाँ स्वच्छ जलवाली नदियाँ तथा अनेक प्रकारके प्रफुल्लित नीलकमल हैं और कर्णिकारका एक दिव्य वन है, उमाके साथ शंकर वहाँ विराजमान रहते हैं। पारियात्र नामक महाशैलपर महालक्ष्मीका सुन्दर पुर है,
verses.wordMeaning: Lord Mahadeva, the blue-red complexioned God appeared directly before Krsna. The bestower of boons that he is, the lord conferred upon him excellent boons.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Mahadeva, the blue-red complexioned God appeared directly before Krsna. The bestower of boons that he is, the lord conferred upon him excellent boons.

verses.sanskrit: नरके वसते घोरे समाः कल्पशतायुतम् । ततो निवर्तते घोरो गवां क्रोधो हि दारुणः । सलिलं च न गृह्णन्ति पितरस्तस्य देहिनः
verses.transliteration: narake vasate ghore samāḥ kalpaśatāyutam / tato nivartate ghoro gavāṃ krodho hi dāruṇaḥ / salilaṃ ca na gṛhṇanti pitarastasya dehinaḥ
verses.translation: "O embodiment of the Universe! Those of my devo¬ tees who worship Govinda with due rites and formalities, will have engendered in them this divine knowledge pertaining to Isvara (Siva).
verses.hindi: जो रमणीय प्रासादोंसे युक्त, घण्टा एवं चामरसे अलंकृत, इतस्ततः नृत्य करती हुई अप्सराओंके समूहसे सुशोभित, मृदंग एवं मुरजकी ध्वनिसे गुञ्जित, वीणा तथा वेणुकी झंकारसे निनादित, गन्धर्व तथा किंनरोंसे आकीर्ण, श्रेष्ठ सिद्धोंसे आवृत, चमकते हुए दीवालोंसे पूर्ण, बड़े-बड़े महलोंसे घनीभूत, गणेश्वरोंकी अङ्गनाओंसे सेवित और धार्मिक जनोंके द्वारा सरलतापूर्वक प्रत्यक्ष करने योग्य है। वहाँ योगपरायण, श्रेष्ठ त्रिशूल धारण करनेवाली,
verses.wordMeaning: "O embodiment of the Universe! Those of my devo¬ tees who worship Govinda with due rites and formalities, will have engendered in them this divine knowledge pertaining to Isvara (Siva).
verses.commentary: Sense: "O embodiment of the Universe! Those of my devo¬ tees who worship Govinda with due rites and formalities, will have engendered in them this divine knowledge pertaining to Isvara (Siva).

verses.sanskrit: यस्तु पुत्रांस्तथा बालान् स्नापयेत् पाययेत् तथा । यथात्मना तथा सर्वान् दानं विप्रेषु दापयेत्
verses.transliteration: yastu putrāṃstathā bālān snāpayet pāyayet tathā / yathātmanā tathā sarvān dānaṃ vipreṣu dāpayet
verses.translation: There is no doubt in this that you will be the Isa, worthy of being worshipped and meditated by the twice-born people devoted to me, thanks to my grace."
verses.hindi: तीन नेत्रवाली, सभी शक्तियोंसे आवृत और सदसन्मयी देवी महालक्ष्मी महादेवी नित्य निवास करती हैं। वहाँ जो ब्रह्मवादी मुनि और सिद्ध हैं-वे उनका दर्शन करते हैं ॥ ३६--४१॥
verses.wordMeaning: There is no doubt in this that you will be the Isa, worthy of being worshipped and meditated by the twice-born people devoted to me, thanks to my grace."
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no doubt in this that you will be the Isa, worthy of being worshipped and meditated by the twice-born people devoted to me, thanks to my grace."

verses.sanskrit: ऐश्वर्याल्लोभमोहाद् वा गच्छेद् यानेन यो नरः । निष्फलं तस्य तत् तीर्थं तसमाद्यानं विवर्जयेत्
verses.transliteration: aiśvaryāllobhamohād vā gacched yānena yo naraḥ / niṣphalaṃ tasya tat tīrthaṃ tasamādyānaṃ vivarjayet
verses.translation: The sins due to Brahmana-slaughter, etc. of those people who visit the lord of Devas and who meditate on Pinaka- bearing lord, perish quickly.
verses.hindi: सुपार्श्वके उत्तरभागमें सरस्वतीका उत्तम पुर है। श्रेष्ठ जनो! वहाँ देवताओंके उपभोग करने योग्य तथा सिद्धोंसे सेवित अनेक सरोवर हैं। पाण्डुर पर्वतके शिखरपर अनेक प्रकारके वृक्षोंसे भरे हुए और दिव्य स्त्रियोंसे परिपूर्ण गन्धर्वोके सौ पुर हैं। उनमें अनेक प्रकारके भोगोंमें तत्पर और काम-मदसे उन्मत्त श्रेष्ठ स्त्रियाँ तथा पुरुष अनेक प्रकारके विलासोंद्वारा भोगमें तत्पर रहते हैं और प्रसन्नतापूर्वक सदा क्रीडा (मनोविनोद)
verses.wordMeaning: The sins due to Brahmana-slaughter, etc. of those people who visit the lord of Devas and who meditate on Pinaka- bearing lord, perish quickly.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sins due to Brahmana-slaughter, etc. of those people who visit the lord of Devas and who meditate on Pinaka- bearing lord, perish quickly.

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गायमुनयोर्मध्ये यस्तु कन्यां प्रयच्छति । आर्षेण तु विवाहेन यथा विभवविस्तरम्
verses.transliteration: gaṅgāyamunayormadhye yastu kanyāṃ prayacchati / ārṣeṇa tu vivāhena yathā vibhavavistaram
verses.translation: Those of Brahmanas who, though engaged in sinful activities, give up their life (at this sacred place) will attain to that Supreme abode. No doubt need be entertained in this respect.
verses.wordMeaning: Those of Brahmanas who, though engaged in sinful activities, give up their life (at this sacred place) will attain to that Supreme abode. No doubt need be entertained in this respect.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those of Brahmanas who, though engaged in sinful activities, give up their life (at this sacred place) will attain to that Supreme abode. No doubt need be entertained in this respect.

verses.sanskrit: न स पश्यति तं घोरं नरकं तेन कर्मणा । उत्तरान् स कुरून् गत्वा मोदते कालमक्षयम्
verses.transliteration: na sa paśyati taṃ ghoraṃ narakaṃ tena karmaṇā / uttarān sa kurūn gatvā modate kālamakṣayam
verses.translation: O Brahmanas! They are verily the blessed ones who take a holy dip in MandakinI and worship the great God, the excellent Madhyamesvara (Lihga).
verses.hindi: अञ्जनगिरिके शिखरपर स््त्रयोंका श्रेष्ठ पुर है, जिसमें रतिकी इच्छा करनेवाली रम्भा आदि अप्सराएं निवास करती हैं। चित्रसेन आदि (गन्धर्व) जहाँ सदा अभिलाषीके रूपमें आया करते हैं, वह पुरी सभी रलोंसे परिपूर्ण तथा अनेक झरनोंसे सम्पन्न है
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas! They are verily the blessed ones who take a holy dip in MandakinI and worship the great God, the excellent Madhyamesvara (Lihga).
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas! They are verily the blessed ones who take a holy dip in MandakinI and worship the great God, the excellent Madhyamesvara (Lihga).

verses.sanskrit: वटमूलं समाश्रित्य यस्तु प्राणान् परित्यजेत् । सर्वलोकानतिक्रम्य रुद्रलोकं स गच्छति
verses.transliteration: vaṭamūlaṃ samāśritya yastu prāṇān parityajet / sarvalokānatikramya rudralokaṃ sa gacchati
verses.translation: O Brahmanas, anyone of these rites, viz. ablution, charitable gifts, penance, Sraddha and offering of the balls of rice (as pinda) performed duly at this place sanctifies upto the seventh generation.
verses.hindi: (रजोगुणके कारण होनेवाली चंचलतासे रहित) तथा शंकरमें अर्पित चित्तवाले रुद्रोंके अनेक पुर हैं, उनमें परम ज्योति अर्थात् परब्रह्मका प्रत्यक्ष करनेवाले तथा महेशके अन्तरमें विचरण करनेवाले महायोगी रुद्रगण
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas, anyone of these rites, viz. ablution, charitable gifts, penance, Sraddha and offering of the balls of rice (as pinda) performed duly at this place sanctifies upto the seventh generation.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas, anyone of these rites, viz. ablution, charitable gifts, penance, Sraddha and offering of the balls of rice (as pinda) performed duly at this place sanctifies upto the seventh generation.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र ब्रह्मादयो देवा दिशश्च सदिगीश्वराः । लोकपालाश्च सिद्धाश्च पितरो लोकसंमताः
verses.transliteration: tatra brahmādayo devā diśaśca sadigīśvarāḥ / lokapālāśca siddhāśca pitaro lokasaṃmatāḥ
verses.translation: If they are performed at Kuruksetra when the sun is devoured by Rahu (at the time of solar eclipse), the benefit that a man derives therefrom is tenfold."
verses.hindi: रहते हैं, यह स्थान बहुत उत्तम है » कर्णिकार--वृक्षविशेप, कठचम्पा या कर्णियार नामसे कई जगहोंमें प्रसिद्ध।
verses.wordMeaning: If they are performed at Kuruksetra when the sun is devoured by Rahu (at the time of solar eclipse), the benefit that a man derives therefrom is tenfold."
verses.commentary: Sense: If they are performed at Kuruksetra when the sun is devoured by Rahu (at the time of solar eclipse), the benefit that a man derives therefrom is tenfold."

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमारप्रमुखास्तथा ब्रह्मर्षयो ऽपरे । नागाः सुपार्णाः सिद्धाश्च तथा नित्यं समासते । हरिश्च भगवानास्ते प्रजापतिपुरस्कृतः
verses.transliteration: sanatkumārapramukhāstathā brahmarṣayo 'pare / nāgāḥ supārṇāḥ siddhāśca tathā nityaṃ samāsate / hariśca bhagavānāste prajāpatipuraskṛtaḥ
verses.translation: After saying thus, the great Yogin stayed fora long time in the vicinity of Madhyamesa, worshipping Mahesvara.
verses.hindi: तथा च जारुधेः भृङ्गे देवदेवस्य धीमतः । दीप्तमायतनं पुण्यं भास्करस्यामितौजसः
verses.wordMeaning: After saying thus, the great Yogin stayed fora long time in the vicinity of Madhyamesa, worshipping Mahesvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying thus, the great Yogin stayed fora long time in the vicinity of Madhyamesa, worshipping Mahesvara.

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गायमुनयोर्मध्ये पृथिव्या जघनं स्मृतम् । प्रयागं राजशार्दूल त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: gaṅgāyamunayormadhye pṛthivyā jaghanaṃ smṛtam / prayāgaṃ rājaśārdūla triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam
verses.translation: The story of Vyasa's stay at Varanasi, his curse to the town and expulsion from the place and permission for entry on the 8th and the l4th
verses.hindi: रमते तत्र रम्योऽसौ भगवान् शीतदीधितिः तत्रास्ते भगवान् ब्रह्मा सिद्धसङ्वैरभिष्टुतः । सावित्र्या सह विश्वात्मा वासुदेवादिभिर्युतः
verses.wordMeaning: The story of Vyasa's stay at Varanasi, his curse to the town and expulsion from the place and permission for entry on the 8th and the l4th
verses.commentary: Sense: The story of Vyasa's stay at Varanasi, his curse to the town and expulsion from the place and permission for entry on the 8th and the l4th

verses.sanskrit: तत्राभिषेकं यः कुर्यात् संगमे संशितव्रतः । तुल्यं फलवाप्नोति राजसूयाश्वमेधयोः
verses.transliteration: tatrābhiṣekaṃ yaḥ kuryāt saṃgame saṃśitavrataḥ / tulyaṃ phalavāpnoti rājasūyāśvamedhayoḥ
verses.translation: The highly sacred place Prayaga, Visvarupa (which is) more auspicious than Prayaga, the unsurpassable sacred pond Kalatirtha.
verses.hindi: सनन्दनादयो यत्र वसन्ति मुनिपुंगवाः
verses.wordMeaning: The highly sacred place Prayaga, Visvarupa (which is) more auspicious than Prayaga, the unsurpassable sacred pond Kalatirtha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The highly sacred place Prayaga, Visvarupa (which is) more auspicious than Prayaga, the unsurpassable sacred pond Kalatirtha.

verses.sanskrit: न मातृवचनात् तात न लोकवचनादपि । मतिरुत्क्रमणीया ते प्रयागगामनं प्रति
verses.transliteration: na mātṛvacanāt tāta na lokavacanādapi / matirutkramaṇīyā te prayāgagāmanaṃ prati
verses.translation: The extremely holy place called Akasa and the excellent sacred pond Anusa (v.l. Rsabha), the great TIrtha Svarlina and Gauri TIrtha that surpasses all.
verses.hindi: नातिदूरेण तस्याथ हैत्याचार्यस्य धीमतः कर्दमस्याश्रमं पुण्यं तत्रास्ते भगवानृषिः
verses.wordMeaning: The extremely holy place called Akasa and the excellent sacred pond Anusa (v.l. Rsabha), the great TIrtha Svarlina and Gauri TIrtha that surpasses all.
verses.commentary: Sense: The extremely holy place called Akasa and the excellent sacred pond Anusa (v.l. Rsabha), the great TIrtha Svarlina and Gauri TIrtha that surpasses all.

verses.sanskrit: दश तीर्थ सहस्त्राणि षष्टिकोट्यस्तथापरे । तेषां सान्निध्यमत्रैव तीर्थानां कुरुनन्दन
verses.transliteration: daśa tīrtha sahastrāṇi ṣaṣṭikoṭyastathāpare / teṣāṃ sānnidhyamatraiva tīrthānāṃ kurunandana
verses.translation: The excellent sacred places Prajapatya as well as Svargadvara and what is called Jambukesvara and the excellent TIrtha known as Garma (Dharma?).
verses.hindi: सनत्कुमारो भगवांस्तत्रास्ते ब्रह्मवित्तमः
verses.wordMeaning: The excellent sacred places Prajapatya as well as Svargadvara and what is called Jambukesvara and the excellent TIrtha known as Garma (Dharma?).
verses.commentary: Sense: The excellent sacred places Prajapatya as well as Svargadvara and what is called Jambukesvara and the excellent TIrtha known as Garma (Dharma?).

verses.sanskrit: या गतिर्योगयुक्तस्य सत्त्वस्थस्य मनीषिणः । सा गतिस्त्यजतः प्राणान् गङ्गायमुनसंगमे
verses.transliteration: yā gatiryogayuktasya sattvasthasya manīṣiṇaḥ / sā gatistyajataḥ prāṇān gaṅgāyamunasaṃgame
verses.translation: The great TIrtha Gaya and the MahanadI TIrtha, the highly sacred Narayana TIrtha and the unsurpassable Vayu TIrtha.
verses.hindi: सरांसि विमला नद्यो देवानामालयानि च सिद्धलिङ्गानि पुण्यानि मुनिभिः स्थापितानि तु। वन्यान्याश्रमवर्याणि संख्यातुं नेव शक्नुयाम्
verses.wordMeaning: The great TIrtha Gaya and the MahanadI TIrtha, the highly sacred Narayana TIrtha and the unsurpassable Vayu TIrtha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The great TIrtha Gaya and the MahanadI TIrtha, the highly sacred Narayana TIrtha and the unsurpassable Vayu TIrtha.

verses.sanskrit: न ते जीवन्ति लोके ऽस्मिन् यत्र तत्र युधिष्ठिर । ये प्रयागं न संप्राप्तास्त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: na te jīvanti loke 'smin yatra tatra yudhiṣṭhira / ye prayāgaṃ na saṃprāptāstriṣu lokeṣu viśrutam
verses.translation: Supremely sacred but hidden Jnanatirtha and the excellent TIrtha Varaha; the highly meritorious Yama TIrtha and the great Sarhvartaka TIrtha.
verses.hindi: पिञ्जर गिरिके शिखरपर गणेशोंके तीन पुर तथा (वहीं) कपिल(शिखर)-पर नन्दीशवरकी पुरी है, वहाँ उत्तम यशवाले यतिगण निवास करते हैं। इसी प्रकार जारुधि पर्वतके शिखरपर अमित तेजस्वी बुद्धिमान्
verses.wordMeaning: Supremely sacred but hidden Jnanatirtha and the excellent TIrtha Varaha; the highly meritorious Yama TIrtha and the great Sarhvartaka TIrtha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Supremely sacred but hidden Jnanatirtha and the excellent TIrtha Varaha; the highly meritorious Yama TIrtha and the great Sarhvartaka TIrtha.

verses.sanskrit: एवं दृष्ट्वा तु तत् तीर्थं प्रयागं परमं पदम् । मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्यः शशाङ्क इव राहुणा
verses.transliteration: evaṃ dṛṣṭvā tu tat tīrthaṃ prayāgaṃ paramaṃ padam / mucyate sarvapāpebhyaḥ śaśāṅka iva rāhuṇā
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas! He visited Agni TIrtha and the excellent Kalakesvara TIrtha, Naga TIrtha, Soma Tirtha and Surya TIrtha.
verses.hindi: देवाधिदेव भास्करका दीसियुक्त पवित्र भवन है। उसीके उत्तर दिग्भागमें चन्द्रमाका उत्तम स्थान है, वहाँ शीत किरणोंवाले ये रम्य भगवान् (चन्द्रमा) रहते हैं॥४९--५१॥ हे महर्षियो! हंसशैलपर एक दूसरा दिव्य भवन है, जो एक हजार योजन विस्तारवाला है और सुवर्ण तथा मणिसे निर्मित तोरणवाला है। वहाँ सिद्धोंके समूहसे सेवित और वासुदेव आदिसे युक्त विश्वात्मा भगवान्
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahmanas! He visited Agni TIrtha and the excellent Kalakesvara TIrtha, Naga TIrtha, Soma Tirtha and Surya TIrtha.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmanas! He visited Agni TIrtha and the excellent Kalakesvara TIrtha, Naga TIrtha, Soma Tirtha and Surya TIrtha.

verses.sanskrit: कम्बलाश्वतरौ नागौ यमुनादक्षिणे तटे । तत्र स्नात्वा च पीत्वा च मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः
verses.transliteration: kambalāśvatarau nāgau yamunādakṣiṇe taṭe / tatra snātvā ca pītvā ca mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ
verses.translation: The excellent meritorious Tirtha Parvata, the excel¬ lent Manikarna, the prominent sacred place Ghatotkaca Tirtha, Sri Tirtha and Pitamaha Tirtha.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मा सावित्रीके साथ रहते हैं। उसके दक्षिण दिग्विभागमें सिद्धोंका श्रेष्ठ पुर है, जहाँ सनन्दन आदि श्रेष्ठ मुनि
verses.wordMeaning: The excellent meritorious Tirtha Parvata, the excel¬ lent Manikarna, the prominent sacred place Ghatotkaca Tirtha, Sri Tirtha and Pitamaha Tirtha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The excellent meritorious Tirtha Parvata, the excel¬ lent Manikarna, the prominent sacred place Ghatotkaca Tirtha, Sri Tirtha and Pitamaha Tirtha.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र गत्वा नरः स्थानं महादेवस्य धीमतः । आत्मानं तारयेत् पूर्वं दशातीतान् दशापरान्
verses.transliteration: tatra gatvā naraḥ sthānaṃ mahādevasya dhīmataḥ / ātmānaṃ tārayet pūrvaṃ daśātītān daśāparān
verses.translation: (Vyasa visited) Gahga Tirtha, the excellent sacred place Devesa, Kapila, Somesa as well as the unsurpassable Brahma Tirtha.
verses.hindi: पञ्चशैलके शिखरपर दानवोंके तीन पुर हैं। उसके समीप ही सुगन्ध शैलके शिखरपर हैत्योंके आचार्य बुद्धिमान् भगवान् कर्दम क्रषिका नदियोंसे सुशोभित एक पवित्र आश्रम है उसीके पूर्व दिग्भागमें कुछ दक्षिण दिशाकी ओर ब्रह्मज्ञानियोंमें श्रेष्ठ भगवान् सनत्कुमार रहते हैं। हे मुनीश्वरो! इन सभी शैलों तथा अन्य शैलोंमें भी अनेक सरोवर, स्वच्छ जलवाली नदियाँ और देवताओंके
verses.wordMeaning: (Vyasa visited) Gahga Tirtha, the excellent sacred place Devesa, Kapila, Somesa as well as the unsurpassable Brahma Tirtha.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Vyasa visited) Gahga Tirtha, the excellent sacred place Devesa, Kapila, Somesa as well as the unsurpassable Brahma Tirtha.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वाभिषेकं तु नरः सो ऽश्वमेधफलं लभेत् । स्वर्गलोकमवाप्नोति यावदाहूतसंप्लवम्
verses.transliteration: kṛtvābhiṣekaṃ tu naraḥ so 'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet / svargalokamavāpnoti yāvadāhūtasaṃplavam
verses.translation: (Vyasa visited the following sacred places): The sacred place Bhutesvara, and the Dharma-samudbhava (born of Dharma) Tirtha, extremely auspicious Gandharva Tirtha and excellent Vahneya Tirtha (pertaining to the Fire-God).
verses.hindi: भवन हैं। वहाँ जो मुनियोंद्वारा स्थापित पवित्र सिद्ध लिड्र, वन तथा श्रेष्ठ आश्रम हैं, उनकी गणना मैं नहीं कर सकता। यह संक्षेपमें जम्बूद्वीपका विस्तार बतलाया गया, सैकड़ों वर्षोमें भी मैं इसके विस्तारका
verses.wordMeaning: (Vyasa visited the following sacred places): The sacred place Bhutesvara, and the Dharma-samudbhava (born of Dharma) Tirtha, extremely auspicious Gandharva Tirtha and excellent Vahneya Tirtha (pertaining to the Fire-God).
verses.commentary: Sense: (Vyasa visited the following sacred places): The sacred place Bhutesvara, and the Dharma-samudbhava (born of Dharma) Tirtha, extremely auspicious Gandharva Tirtha and excellent Vahneya Tirtha (pertaining to the Fire-God).

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वपार्श्वे तु गङ्गायास्त्रैलोक्यख्यातिमान् नृप । अवचः सर्वसामुद्रः प्रतिष्ठानं च विश्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: pūrvapārśve tu gaṅgāyāstrailokyakhyātimān nṛpa / avacaḥ sarvasāmudraḥ pratiṣṭhānaṃ ca viśrutam
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas! (He then visited) the holy centre pertaining to sage Durvasas, Homa Tirtha (v.l. vyoma-
verses.hindi: वर्णन नहीं कर सकता॥ ५७--६० ॥ प्लक्ष आदि महाद्वीपों, वहाँके पर्वतों, नदियों तथा निवासियोंका वर्णन, श्‍वेतद्वीपमें स्थित नारायणपुरका वर्णन, वहाँ वैकुण्ठमें रहनेवाले लक्ष्मीपति शेषशायी नारायणकी महिमाका ख्यापन
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahmanas! (He then visited) the holy centre pertaining to sage Durvasas, Homa Tirtha (v.l. vyoma-
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmanas! (He then visited) the holy centre pertaining to sage Durvasas, Homa Tirtha (v.l. vyoma-

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मचारी जितक्रोधस्त्रिरात्रं यदि तिष्ठति । सर्वपापविशुद्धात्मा सो ऽश्वमेधफलं लभेत्
verses.transliteration: brahmacārī jitakrodhastrirātraṃ yadi tiṣṭhati / sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā so 'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet
verses.translation: Kedara, known as the most prominent holy place, the unsurpassable Kalanjara, Sarasvata, Prabhasa, Khetakarna and the auspicious Hara Tirtha.
verses.hindi: तत्र देवर्षिगन्धर्वैः सिद्धैश्च भगवानजः ।
verses.wordMeaning: Kedara, known as the most prominent holy place, the unsurpassable Kalanjara, Sarasvata, Prabhasa, Khetakarna and the auspicious Hara Tirtha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kedara, known as the most prominent holy place, the unsurpassable Kalanjara, Sarasvata, Prabhasa, Khetakarna and the auspicious Hara Tirtha.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तरेण प्रतिष्ठानं भागीरथ्यास्तु सव्यतः । हंसप्रपतनं नाम तीर्थं त्रैलोक्यविश्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: uttareṇa pratiṣṭhānaṃ bhāgīrathyāstu savyataḥ / haṃsaprapatanaṃ nāma tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam
verses.translation: The great Tirtha called Laukika and the sacred Himalaya, Hiranyagarbha, the sacred place famous as Go (or Gopreksya) and Vrsadhvaja.
verses.hindi: न तत्र पापकर्तारः पुरुषा वा कथञ्चन॥ तासु ब्रह्मर्षयो नित्यं पितामहमुपासते॥
verses.wordMeaning: The great Tirtha called Laukika and the sacred Himalaya, Hiranyagarbha, the sacred place famous as Go (or Gopreksya) and Vrsadhvaja.
verses.commentary: Sense: The great Tirtha called Laukika and the sacred Himalaya, Hiranyagarbha, the sacred place famous as Go (or Gopreksya) and Vrsadhvaja.

verses.sanskrit: अश्वमेधफलं तत्र स्मृतमात्रात् तु जायते । यावच्चन्द्रश्च सूर्यश्च तावत् स्वर्गे महीयते
verses.transliteration: aśvamedhaphalaṃ tatra smṛtamātrāt tu jāyate / yāvaccandraśca sūryaśca tāvat svarge mahīyate
verses.translation: (He visited Tirthas called) Upasanta, Siva, the excellent Vyaghresvara, the great Tirtha Trilocana, Lolarka and the one called Uttara.
verses.hindi: अनुतप्ता शिखी चैव विपापा त्रिदिवा कृता। अमृता सुकृता चैव नामतः परिकीर्तिताः ॥
verses.wordMeaning: (He visited Tirthas called) Upasanta, Siva, the excellent Vyaghresvara, the great Tirtha Trilocana, Lolarka and the one called Uttara.
verses.commentary: Sense: (He visited Tirthas called) Upasanta, Siva, the excellent Vyaghresvara, the great Tirtha Trilocana, Lolarka and the one called Uttara.

verses.sanskrit: उर्वशीपुलिने रम्ये विपुले हंसपाण्डुरे । परित्यजतियः प्राणान् शृणु तस्यापि यत् फलम्
verses.transliteration: urvaśīpuline ramye vipule haṃsapāṇḍure / parityajatiyaḥ prāṇān śṛṇu tasyāpi yat phalam
verses.translation: These holy centres have been mentioned in view of their importance. It is impossible to enumerate all these Tirthas in detail, O excellent Brahmanas.
verses.hindi: आर्यकाः कुरवाश्चैव विदशा भाविनस्तथा। ब्रह्वाक्षत्रियविदशूद्वास्तस्मिन् द्वीपे प्रकीर्तिताः
verses.wordMeaning: These holy centres have been mentioned in view of their importance. It is impossible to enumerate all these Tirthas in detail, O excellent Brahmanas.
verses.commentary: Sense: These holy centres have been mentioned in view of their importance. It is impossible to enumerate all these Tirthas in detail, O excellent Brahmanas.

verses.sanskrit: षष्टिवर्षसहस्त्राणि षष्टिवर्षशतानि च । आस्ते स पितृभिः सार्धं स्वर्गलोके नराधिप
verses.transliteration: ṣaṣṭivarṣasahastrāṇi ṣaṣṭivarṣaśatāni ca / āste sa pitṛbhiḥ sārdhaṃ svargaloke narādhipa
verses.translation: The great sage took holy bath and worshipped Mahalihga along with his disciples and told them—''You may go as you please."
verses.hindi: इज्यते भगवान् सोमो वर्णेस्तत्र निवासिभिः ।
verses.wordMeaning: The great sage took holy bath and worshipped Mahalihga along with his disciples and told them—''You may go as you please."
verses.commentary: Sense: The great sage took holy bath and worshipped Mahalihga along with his disciples and told them—''You may go as you please."

verses.sanskrit: अथं संध्यावटे रम्ये ब्रह्मचारी जितेन्द्रियः । नरः शुचिरुपासीत ब्रह्मलोकमवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: athaṃ saṃdhyāvaṭe ramye brahmacārī jitendriyaḥ / naraḥ śucirupāsīta brahmalokamavāpnuyāt
verses.translation: After bowing down to the noble soul, Paila and other Brahmanas went away. But he (Vyasa) made his permanent abode at Varanasi.
verses.hindi: तेषां च सोमसायुज्यं सारूप्यं मुनिपुंगवाः सर्वे धर्मपरा नित्यं नित्यं मुदितमानसाः ।
verses.wordMeaning: After bowing down to the noble soul, Paila and other Brahmanas went away. But he (Vyasa) made his permanent abode at Varanasi.
verses.commentary: Sense: After bowing down to the noble soul, Paila and other Brahmanas went away. But he (Vyasa) made his permanent abode at Varanasi.

verses.sanskrit: कोटितीर्थं समाश्रित्य यस्तु प्राणान् परित्यजेत् । कोटिवर्षसहस्त्राणि स्वर्गलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: koṭitīrthaṃ samāśritya yastu prāṇān parityajet / koṭivarṣasahastrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate
verses.translation: He was quiescent, self-controlled. He took bath three times a day and worshipped the Pinaka-bearing deity. He main¬ tained his livelihood on alms. He remained a purihed soul devoted to the vow of celibacy.
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले--जम्बूद्वी पके विस्तारसे दुगुने विस्तारमें चारों ओरसे क्षार सागरको आवृतकर प्लक्षद्वीप स्थित है। श्रेष्ठ विप्रो! प्लक्षद्वीपमें सीधे विस्तारवाले, सुन्दर पर्वोंवाले तथा सिद्धोंके समूहोंसे सेवित सात कुलपर्वत
verses.wordMeaning: He was quiescent, self-controlled. He took bath three times a day and worshipped the Pinaka-bearing deity. He main¬ tained his livelihood on alms. He remained a purihed soul devoted to the vow of celibacy.
verses.commentary: Sense: He was quiescent, self-controlled. He took bath three times a day and worshipped the Pinaka-bearing deity. He main¬ tained his livelihood on alms. He remained a purihed soul devoted to the vow of celibacy.

verses.sanskrit: यत्र गङ्गा महाभागा बहुतीर्थतपोवना । सिद्धक्षेत्रं हि तज्ज्ञेयं नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.transliteration: yatra gaṅgā mahābhāgā bahutīrthatapovanā / siddhakṣetraṃ hi tajjñeyaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā
verses.translation: He was quiescent, self-controlled. He took bath three times a day and worshipped the Pinaka-bearing deity. He main¬ tained his livelihood on alms. He remained a purihed soul devoted to the vow of celibacy.
verses.hindi: हैं। उनमें गोमेद पहला है, दूसरा चन्द्र पर्वत कहलाता है। इसी प्रकार नारद, दुन्दुभि, सोम, ऋषभ तथा सातवां वैभ्राज नामक पर्वत कहा गया है, जो ब्रह्माको अत्यन्त प्रिय है । वहाँ देवर्षियों, गन्धर्वो तथा सिद्धोंके द्वारा सबके साक्षी, विश्वको सृष्टि करनेवाले विश्वात्मा भगवान् अज (ब्रह्मा)-की उपासना की जाती है
verses.wordMeaning: He was quiescent, self-controlled. He took bath three times a day and worshipped the Pinaka-bearing deity. He main¬ tained his livelihood on alms. He remained a purihed soul devoted to the vow of celibacy.
verses.commentary: Sense: He was quiescent, self-controlled. He took bath three times a day and worshipped the Pinaka-bearing deity. He main¬ tained his livelihood on alms. He remained a purihed soul devoted to the vow of celibacy.

verses.sanskrit: क्षितौ तारयते मर्त्यान् नागांस्तारयते ऽप्यधः । दिवि तारयते देवांस्तेन त्रिपथगा स्मृता
verses.transliteration: kṣitau tārayate martyān nāgāṃstārayate 'pyadhaḥ / divi tārayate devāṃstena tripathagā smṛtā
verses.translation: He was quiescent, self-controlled. He took bath three times a day and worshipped the Pinaka-bearing deity. He main¬ tained his livelihood on alms. He remained a purihed soul devoted to the vow of celibacy.
verses.hindi: उन (पर्वतों)-में पवित्र जनपद हैं। वहाँ न कोई आधि है, न कोई व्याधि। वहाँ रहनेवाले पुरुष किसी भी प्रकारका पाप नहीं करते हैं। समुद्रकी ओर जानेवाली उन वर्षपर्वतोंकी सात नदियाँ हैं, उनमें ब्रह्मर्षि
verses.wordMeaning: He was quiescent, self-controlled. He took bath three times a day and worshipped the Pinaka-bearing deity. He main¬ tained his livelihood on alms. He remained a purihed soul devoted to the vow of celibacy.
verses.commentary: Sense: He was quiescent, self-controlled. He took bath three times a day and worshipped the Pinaka-bearing deity. He main¬ tained his livelihood on alms. He remained a purihed soul devoted to the vow of celibacy.

verses.sanskrit: यावदस्थीनि गङ्गायां तिष्ठन्ति पुरुषस्य तु । तावद् वर्षसहस्त्राणि स्वर्गलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: yāvadasthīni gaṅgāyāṃ tiṣṭhanti puruṣasya tu / tāvad varṣasahastrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate
verses.translation: He was quiescent, self-controlled. He took bath three times a day and worshipped the Pinaka-bearing deity. He main¬ tained his livelihood on alms. He remained a purihed soul devoted to the vow of celibacy.
verses.hindi: नित्य पितामहकी उपासना करते हैं। (वे नदियाँ) अनुतप्ता, शिखी, विपापा, त्रिदिवा, कृता, अमृता और सुकृता नामवाली कही गयी हैं॥ ५--७॥ इनके अतिरिक्त असंख्य छोटी-छोटी नदियाँ तथा बहुतसे सरोवर भी वहाँपर हैं। यहाँ (सत्य, त्रेता आदि रूपमें)युगोंकी व्यवस्था नहीं है और सभी पुरुष दीर्घायु होते हैं। इस द्वीपमें आर्यक, कुरव, विदश तथा भावी
verses.wordMeaning: He was quiescent, self-controlled. He took bath three times a day and worshipped the Pinaka-bearing deity. He main¬ tained his livelihood on alms. He remained a purihed soul devoted to the vow of celibacy.
verses.commentary: Sense: He was quiescent, self-controlled. He took bath three times a day and worshipped the Pinaka-bearing deity. He main¬ tained his livelihood on alms. He remained a purihed soul devoted to the vow of celibacy.

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थानां परमं तीर्थं नदीनां परमा नदी । मोक्षदा सर्वभूतानां महापातकिनामपि
verses.transliteration: tīrthānāṃ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ nadīnāṃ paramā nadī / mokṣadā sarvabhūtānāṃ mahāpātakināmapi
verses.translation: He was quiescent, self-controlled. He took bath three times a day and worshipped the Pinaka-bearing deity. He main¬ tained his livelihood on alms. He remained a purihed soul devoted to the vow of celibacy.
verses.hindi: नामक ब्राह्मण, क्षत्रिय, वैश्य एवं शूद्र कहे गये हैं
verses.wordMeaning: He was quiescent, self-controlled. He took bath three times a day and worshipped the Pinaka-bearing deity. He main¬ tained his livelihood on alms. He remained a purihed soul devoted to the vow of celibacy.
verses.commentary: Sense: He was quiescent, self-controlled. He took bath three times a day and worshipped the Pinaka-bearing deity. He main¬ tained his livelihood on alms. He remained a purihed soul devoted to the vow of celibacy.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वत्र सुलभा गङ्गा त्रिषु स्थानेषु दुर्लभा । गङ्गाद्वारे प्रयागे च गङ्गासागरसंगमे
verses.transliteration: sarvatra sulabhā gaṅgā triṣu sthāneṣu durlabhā / gaṅgādvāre prayāge ca gaṅgāsāgarasaṃgame
verses.translation: He was quiescent, self-controlled. He took bath three times a day and worshipped the Pinaka-bearing deity. He main¬ tained his livelihood on alms. He remained a purihed soul devoted to the vow of celibacy.
verses.hindi: हे मुनिश्रेष्ठो! यहाँ रहनेवाले विभिन्न वर्णवालोंके द्वारा भगवान् सोमकी पूजा की जाती है, उन्हें सोमका सायुज्य और सारूप्य (नामक मोक्ष) प्राप्त होता है। वहाँके सभी लोग नित्य धर्मपरायण और नित्य प्रसन्नचित्त रहते हैं तथा रोगरहित होकर पाँच हजार वर्षतक जीवित रहते हैं। प्लक्षद्वीपके दुगुने प्रमाणमें चारों ओर इक्षुरसके समुद्रको आवेष्टितकर शाल्मलि नामक द्वीप स्थित है। वहाँ भी सात वर्ष और सात
verses.wordMeaning: He was quiescent, self-controlled. He took bath three times a day and worshipped the Pinaka-bearing deity. He main¬ tained his livelihood on alms. He remained a purihed soul devoted to the vow of celibacy.
verses.commentary: Sense: He was quiescent, self-controlled. He took bath three times a day and worshipped the Pinaka-bearing deity. He main¬ tained his livelihood on alms. He remained a purihed soul devoted to the vow of celibacy.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषामे भूतानां पापोपहतचेतसाम् । गतिमन्वेषमाणानां नास्ति गङ्गासमा गतिः
verses.transliteration: sarveṣāme bhūtānāṃ pāpopahatacetasām / gatimanveṣamāṇānāṃ nāsti gaṅgāsamā gatiḥ
verses.translation: He was quiescent, self-controlled. He took bath three times a day and worshipped the Pinaka-bearing deity. He main¬ tained his livelihood on alms. He remained a purihed soul devoted to the vow of celibacy.
verses.hindi: ही कुलपर्वत हैं, (वे पर्वत) सीधे फैले हुए और सुन्दर पर्वोवाले हैं। है सुव्रतो! (वहाँ) सात नदियों भी हैं
verses.wordMeaning: He was quiescent, self-controlled. He took bath three times a day and worshipped the Pinaka-bearing deity. He main¬ tained his livelihood on alms. He remained a purihed soul devoted to the vow of celibacy.
verses.commentary: Sense: He was quiescent, self-controlled. He took bath three times a day and worshipped the Pinaka-bearing deity. He main¬ tained his livelihood on alms. He remained a purihed soul devoted to the vow of celibacy.

verses.sanskrit: पवित्राणां पवित्रं च मङ्गलानां च मङ्गलम् । माहेश्वरात् परिभ्रष्टा सर्वपापहरा शुभा
verses.transliteration: pavitrāṇāṃ pavitraṃ ca maṅgalānāṃ ca maṅgalam / māheśvarāt paribhraṣṭā sarvapāpaharā śubhā
verses.translation: He was quiescent, self-controlled. He took bath three times a day and worshipped the Pinaka-bearing deity. He main¬ tained his livelihood on alms. He remained a purihed soul devoted to the vow of celibacy.
verses.hindi: निवृत्तिश्चेति ता नद्यः स्मृता पापहरा नृणाम् तेषां तस्याथ सायुज्यं सारूप्यं च सलोकता
verses.wordMeaning: He was quiescent, self-controlled. He took bath three times a day and worshipped the Pinaka-bearing deity. He main¬ tained his livelihood on alms. He remained a purihed soul devoted to the vow of celibacy.
verses.commentary: Sense: He was quiescent, self-controlled. He took bath three times a day and worshipped the Pinaka-bearing deity. He main¬ tained his livelihood on alms. He remained a purihed soul devoted to the vow of celibacy.

verses.sanskrit: कृते युगे तु तीर्थानि त्रेतायां पुष्करं परम् । द्वापरे तु कुरुक्षेत्रं कलौ गङ्गां विशिष्यते
verses.transliteration: kṛte yuge tu tīrthāni tretāyāṃ puṣkaraṃ param / dvāpare tu kurukṣetraṃ kalau gaṅgāṃ viśiṣyate
verses.translation: He was quiescent, self-controlled. He took bath three times a day and worshipped the Pinaka-bearing deity. He main¬ tained his livelihood on alms. He remained a purihed soul devoted to the vow of celibacy.
verses.hindi: कपिला ब्राह्मणाः प्रोक्ता राजानश्चारुणास्तथा।
verses.wordMeaning: He was quiescent, self-controlled. He took bath three times a day and worshipped the Pinaka-bearing deity. He main¬ tained his livelihood on alms. He remained a purihed soul devoted to the vow of celibacy.
verses.commentary: Sense: He was quiescent, self-controlled. He took bath three times a day and worshipped the Pinaka-bearing deity. He main¬ tained his livelihood on alms. He remained a purihed soul devoted to the vow of celibacy.

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गामेव निषेवेत प्रयागे तु विशेषतः । नान्यत् कलियुगोद्भूतं मलं हन्तुं सुदुष्कृतम्
verses.transliteration: gaṅgāmeva niṣeveta prayāge tu viśeṣataḥ / nānyat kaliyugodbhūtaṃ malaṃ hantuṃ suduṣkṛtam
verses.translation: He was quiescent, self-controlled. He took bath three times a day and worshipped the Pinaka-bearing deity. He main¬ tained his livelihood on alms. He remained a purihed soul devoted to the vow of celibacy.
verses.hindi: धुतपापा शिवा चैव पवित्रा सम्मता तथा। विद्युदम्भा मही चेति नह्यस्तत्र जलावहाः तासु ब्रह्माणमीशानं देवाद्याः पर्युपासते
verses.wordMeaning: He was quiescent, self-controlled. He took bath three times a day and worshipped the Pinaka-bearing deity. He main¬ tained his livelihood on alms. He remained a purihed soul devoted to the vow of celibacy.
verses.commentary: Sense: He was quiescent, self-controlled. He took bath three times a day and worshipped the Pinaka-bearing deity. He main¬ tained his livelihood on alms. He remained a purihed soul devoted to the vow of celibacy.

verses.sanskrit: अकामो वा सकामो वा गङ्गायां यो विपद्यते । स मृतो जायते स्वर्गे नरकं च न पश्यति
verses.transliteration: akāmo vā sakāmo vā gaṅgāyāṃ yo vipadyate / sa mṛto jāyate svarge narakaṃ ca na paśyati
verses.translation: He was quiescent, self-controlled. He took bath three times a day and worshipped the Pinaka-bearing deity. He main¬ tained his livelihood on alms. He remained a purihed soul devoted to the vow of celibacy.
verses.hindi: वैश्याः स्नेहास्तु मन्देहा शूद्रास्तत्र प्रकीर्तिताः
verses.wordMeaning: He was quiescent, self-controlled. He took bath three times a day and worshipped the Pinaka-bearing deity. He main¬ tained his livelihood on alms. He remained a purihed soul devoted to the vow of celibacy.
verses.commentary: Sense: He was quiescent, self-controlled. He took bath three times a day and worshipped the Pinaka-bearing deity. He main¬ tained his livelihood on alms. He remained a purihed soul devoted to the vow of celibacy.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे पञ्चत्रिंशो ऽध्यायः मार्कण्डेय उवाच षष्टिस्तीर्थसहस्त्राणि षष्टिस्तीर्थशतानि च । माघमासे गमिष्यन्ति गङ्गायमुनसंगमम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge pañcatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ṣaṣṭistīrthasahastrāṇi ṣaṣṭistīrthaśatāni ca / māghamāse gamiṣyanti gaṅgāyamunasaṃgamam
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas, on one occasion while he stayed there, Vyasa, of unmeasured splendour wandered for the sake of alms but he did not get anything.
verses.hindi: यथोक्तकारिणः सर्वे सर्वे भूतहिते रताः यजन्ति विविधेर्यज्ञेत्रह्माणं परमेष्ठिनम्। तेषां च ब्रह्मसायुज्यं सारूप्यं च सलोकता
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahmanas, on one occasion while he stayed there, Vyasa, of unmeasured splendour wandered for the sake of alms but he did not get anything.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmanas, on one occasion while he stayed there, Vyasa, of unmeasured splendour wandered for the sake of alms but he did not get anything.

verses.sanskrit: गवां शतसहस्त्रस्य सम्यग् दत्तस्य यत् फलम् । प्रयागे माघमासे तु त्र्यहं स्नातस्य तत् फलम्
verses.transliteration: gavāṃ śatasahastrasya samyag dattasya yat phalam / prayāge māghamāse tu tryahaṃ snātasya tat phalam
verses.translation: Then the sage was overwhelmed by great anger. He said "I shall create obstacles for all men staying here whereby their achievement will become deficient."
verses.hindi: क्रौञ्चो वामनकश्चैव तृतीयश्चान्धकारकः। देवावृच्य विविन्दश्च पुण्डरीकस्तथैव च।
verses.wordMeaning: Then the sage was overwhelmed by great anger. He said "I shall create obstacles for all men staying here whereby their achievement will become deficient."
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the sage was overwhelmed by great anger. He said "I shall create obstacles for all men staying here whereby their achievement will become deficient."

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गायमुनयोर्मध्ये कार्षाग्निं यस्तु साधयेत् । अहीनाङ्गो ऽप्यरोगश्च पञ्चेन्द्रियसमन्वितः
verses.transliteration: gaṅgāyamunayormadhye kārṣāgniṃ yastu sādhayet / ahīnāṅgo 'pyarogaśca pañcendriyasamanvitaḥ
verses.translation: At the very same instant, the great goddess, the sharer of half the body of Sankara, assumed human form and appeared there out of affection.
verses.hindi: ख्यातिश्च पुण्डरीका च नद्यः प्राधान्यतः स्मृताः पुष्कराः पुष्कला धन्यास्तिष्यास्तस्य क्रमेण वै।
verses.wordMeaning: At the very same instant, the great goddess, the sharer of half the body of Sankara, assumed human form and appeared there out of affection.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the very same instant, the great goddess, the sharer of half the body of Sankara, assumed human form and appeared there out of affection.

verses.sanskrit: यावन्ति रोमकूपाणि तस्य गात्रेषु मानद । तावद् वर्षसहस्त्राणि स्वर्गलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: yāvanti romakūpāṇi tasya gātreṣu mānada / tāvad varṣasahastrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate
verses.translation: Then the great goddess told him again—"O sage, since you are irascible, you must not stay here as you are always ungrateful."
verses.hindi: तथा ककुद्वान्-ये सात (कुल) पर्वत हैं। योनी, तोया,
verses.wordMeaning: Then the great goddess told him again—"O sage, since you are irascible, you must not stay here as you are always ungrateful."
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the great goddess told him again—"O sage, since you are irascible, you must not stay here as you are always ungrateful."

verses.sanskrit: जलप्रवेशं यः कुर्यात् संगमे लोकविश्रुते । राहुग्रस्तो यथा सोमो विमुक्तः सर्वपातकैः
verses.transliteration: jalapraveśaṃ yaḥ kuryāt saṃgame lokaviśrute / rāhugrasto yathā somo vimuktaḥ sarvapātakaiḥ
verses.translation: Then the great goddess told him again—"O sage, since you are irascible, you must not stay here as you are always ungrateful."
verses.hindi: सात नदियाँ मनुष्योंका पाप हरण करनेवाली कही गयी हैं। है द्विजश्रेष्ठो! उनमें (यहाँके निवासियोंमें) न लोभ है, न क्रोध है और न (यहाँ) युगकी व्यवस्था ही है। यहाँके सभी लोग रोगरहित होकर जीवित रहते हैं। यहाँके सभी वर्णोके लोग निरन्तर सनातन वायुदेवका यजन करते हैं, इन्हें उन (वायुदेव)-का सायुज्य, सारूप्य तथा सालोक्य (नामक मोक्ष) प्राप्त होता है ॥ १४--१७॥
verses.wordMeaning: Then the great goddess told him again—"O sage, since you are irascible, you must not stay here as you are always ungrateful."
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the great goddess told him again—"O sage, since you are irascible, you must not stay here as you are always ungrateful."

verses.sanskrit: ततः स्वर्गात् परिभ्रष्टो जम्बूद्वीपपतिर्भवेत् । स भुक्त्वा विपुलान् भोगांस्तत् तीर्थं भजते पुनः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ svargāt paribhraṣṭo jambūdvīpapatirbhavet / sa bhuktvā vipulān bhogāṃstat tīrthaṃ bhajate punaḥ
verses.translation: Thus addressed, the holy lord realised the great goddess Siva through meditation. With humility he bowed down, eulogised her with excellent hymns and said:
verses.hindi: हे द्विजो! इस (शाल्मलि) द्वीपमें ब्राह्मण कपिल वर्णके और क्षत्रिय अरुण वर्णके कहे गये हैं। वैश्य पीतवर्णके तथा वृषल (शूद्र) कृष्ण वर्णके बतलाये गये हैं। शाल्मलद्वीपके दुगुने विस्तारमें चारों ओरसे सुरोदसागरको
verses.wordMeaning: Thus addressed, the holy lord realised the great goddess Siva through meditation. With humility he bowed down, eulogised her with excellent hymns and said:
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus addressed, the holy lord realised the great goddess Siva through meditation. With humility he bowed down, eulogised her with excellent hymns and said:

verses.sanskrit: सोमलोकमवाप्नोति सोमेन सह मोदते । षष्टिं वर्षसहस्त्राणि षष्टिं वर्षशतानि च
verses.transliteration: somalokamavāpnoti somena saha modate / ṣaṣṭiṃ varṣasahastrāṇi ṣaṣṭiṃ varṣaśatāni ca
verses.translation: O Sankari, be pleased to permit me to enter the city on the Astami and Caturdasi (eighth and the fourteenth) day." saying 'so be it', the goddess permitted him and disappeared.
verses.hindi: आवेष्टित कर कुशद्वीप स्थित है। विद्रुम, हेम, द्युतिमान्, पर्वत हैं । यहाँ धुतपापा, शिवा, पवित्रा, संमता, विद्युदम्भा और मही (नामक) जलसे पूर्ण नदियाँ हैं ॥ १८--२१॥
verses.wordMeaning: O Sankari, be pleased to permit me to enter the city on the Astami and Caturdasi (eighth and the fourteenth) day." saying 'so be it', the goddess permitted him and disappeared.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Sankari, be pleased to permit me to enter the city on the Astami and Caturdasi (eighth and the fourteenth) day." saying 'so be it', the goddess permitted him and disappeared.

verses.sanskrit: स्वर्गतः शक्रलोके ऽसौ मुनिगन्धर्वसेवितः । ततो भ्रष्टस्तु राजेन्द्र समृद्धे जायते कुले
verses.transliteration: svargataḥ śakraloke 'sau munigandharvasevitaḥ / tato bhraṣṭastu rājendra samṛddhe jāyate kule
verses.translation: Thus the holy sage Vyasa, the ancient great Yogi realised the good points of the holy centre, and stayed near it.
verses.hindi: हे विप्रो! यहाँ मणिके समान स्वच्छ जलवाली अन्य भी सैकड़ों नदियाँ हैं। इनमें देवता आदि ईशान ब्रह्माकी उपासना करते हैं। विप्रो! वहाँके ब्राह्मण द्रविण,
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the holy sage Vyasa, the ancient great Yogi realised the good points of the holy centre, and stayed near it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the holy sage Vyasa, the ancient great Yogi realised the good points of the holy centre, and stayed near it.

verses.sanskrit: अधः शिरास्त्वयोधारामुर्ध्वपादः पिबेन्नरः । शतं वर्षसहस्त्राणि स्वर्गलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: adhaḥ śirāstvayodhārāmurdhvapādaḥ pibennaraḥ / śataṃ varṣasahastrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate
verses.translation: It is after knowing that Vyasa was stationed in the holy centre, that the learned men resorted to it. Hence a man should by all means, reside in Varanasi.
verses.hindi: हैं । यहाँके सभी लोग विशिष्ट ज्ञानसे सम्पन्न, मैत्री आदि गुणोंसे समन्वित, विहित कर्माको करनेवाले तथा सभी प्राणियोंके हित-चिन्तनमें लगे रहते हैं। ये विविध यज्ञोंद्वारा परमेष्ठी ब्रह्माका यजन करते हैं और उन्हें ब्रह्माका सायुज्य, सारूप्य तथा सालोक्य (मोक्ष) प्राप्त होता है
verses.wordMeaning: It is after knowing that Vyasa was stationed in the holy centre, that the learned men resorted to it. Hence a man should by all means, reside in Varanasi.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is after knowing that Vyasa was stationed in the holy centre, that the learned men resorted to it. Hence a man should by all means, reside in Varanasi.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद् भ्रष्टस्तु राजेन्द्र अग्निहोत्री भवेन्नरः । भुक्त्वा तु विपुलान् भोगांस्तत् तीर्थं भजते पुनः
verses.transliteration: tasmād bhraṣṭastu rājendra agnihotrī bhavennaraḥ / bhuktvā tu vipulān bhogāṃstat tīrthaṃ bhajate punaḥ
verses.translation: He who reads the greatness of Avimukta, listens to it or narrates it to the quiescent Brahmanas, attains the Supreme goal.
verses.hindi: हे विप्रो! कुशद्वीपके दुगुने विस्तारमें चारों ओर घृतसमुद्रको आवेष्टित करके क्रौञ्चद्वीप स्थित है। क्रौञ्च, वामनक, अन्धकारक, देवावृत्, विविन्द, पुण्डरीक तथा दुन्दुभिस्वन नामक सात पर्वत यहाँ कहे गये
verses.wordMeaning: He who reads the greatness of Avimukta, listens to it or narrates it to the quiescent Brahmanas, attains the Supreme goal.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who reads the greatness of Avimukta, listens to it or narrates it to the quiescent Brahmanas, attains the Supreme goal.

verses.sanskrit: यः स्वदेहं विकर्तेद् वा शकुनिभ्यः प्रयच्छति । विहगैरुपभुक्तस्य शृणु तस्यापि यत्फलम्
verses.transliteration: yaḥ svadehaṃ vikarted vā śakunibhyaḥ prayacchati / vihagairupabhuktasya śṛṇu tasyāpi yatphalam
verses.hindi: हैं। गौरी, कुमुद्वती, संध्या, रात्रि, मनोजवा, ख्याति तथा पुण्डरीक-ये प्रधान नदियाँ यहाँ कही गयी हैं। क्रमशः पुष्कर, पुष्कल, धन्य तथा तिष्य नामसे यहाँ कहे जाते हैं

verses.sanskrit: शतं वर्षसहस्त्राणि सोमलोके महीयते । ततस्तस्मात् परिभ्रष्टो राजा भवति धार्मिकः
verses.transliteration: śataṃ varṣasahastrāṇi somaloke mahīyate / tatastasmāt paribhraṣṭo rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ
verses.hindi: अर्चयन्ति महादेवं यज्ञदानसमाधिभि: । व्रतोपवासैर्विविधैरहोमैः स्वाध्यायतर्पणैः

verses.sanskrit: गुणवान् रूपसंपन्नो विद्वान् सुप्रियवाक्यवान् । भुक्त्वा तु विपुलान् भोगांस्तततीर्थं भजते पुनः
verses.transliteration: guṇavān rūpasaṃpanno vidvān supriyavākyavān / bhuktvā tu vipulān bhogāṃstatatīrthaṃ bhajate punaḥ
verses.hindi: सलोकता च सामीप्यं जायते तत्प्रसादतः उदयो रैवतश्चैव श्यामाकोऽस्तगिरिस्तथा। आम्बिकेयस्तथा रम्यः केशरी चेति पर्वताः

verses.sanskrit: उत्तरे यमुनातीरे प्रयागस्य तु दक्षिणे । ऋणप्रमोचनं नाम तीर्थं तु परमं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: uttare yamunātīre prayāgasya tu dakṣiṇe / ṛṇapramocanaṃ nāma tīrthaṃ tu paramaṃ smṛtam
verses.hindi: सुकुमारी कुमारी च नलिनी रेणुका तथा। इक्षुका धेनुका चैव गभस्तिश्चेति निम्नगाः

verses.sanskrit: एकरात्रोषितः स्नात्वा ऋणैस्तत्र प्रमुच्यते । सूर्यलोकमवाप्नोति अनृणश्च सदा भवेत्
verses.transliteration: ekarātroṣitaḥ snātvā ṛṇaistatra pramucyate / sūryalokamavāpnoti anṛṇaśca sadā bhavet
verses.hindi: अनामया ह्यशोकाश्च रागद्वेषविवर्जिताः यजन्ति सततं देवं सर्वलोकेकसाक्षिणम्। ब्रतोपवासैर्विविधैर्देवदेवं दिवाकरम्

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे षट्त्रिंशो ऽध्यायः मार्कण्डय उवाच तपनस्य सुता देवी त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुता । समागता महाभागा यमुना यत्र निम्नगा
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge ṣaṭtriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ mārkaṇḍaya uvāca tapanasya sutā devī triṣu lokeṣu viśrutā / samāgatā mahābhāgā yamunā yatra nimnagā
verses.translation: For the abidance of deities protecting different parts of Prayaga Cf. Mt. 4-10 Pd. P. I. 41 6-10.
verses.hindi: सलोकता च विप्रेन्द्रा जायते तत्प्रसादतः
verses.wordMeaning: For the abidance of deities protecting different parts of Prayaga Cf. Mt. 4-10 Pd. P. I. 41 6-10.
verses.commentary: Sense: For the abidance of deities protecting different parts of Prayaga Cf. Mt. 4-10 Pd. P. I. 41 6-10.

verses.sanskrit: येनैव निः सृता गङ्गा तेनैव यमुना गता । योजनानां सहस्त्रेषु कीर्तनात् पापनाशनी
verses.transliteration: yenaiva niḥ sṛtā gaṅgā tenaiva yamunā gatā / yojanānāṃ sahastreṣu kīrtanāt pāpanāśanī
verses.translation: Cf. Mt. 12 and with slight variations A 6-7 and Mbh. Vana 85.80.
verses.hindi: श्वेतद्वीपश्च तन्मध्ये नारायणपरायणाः श्वेतास्तत्र नरा नित्यं जायन्ते विष्णुतत्पराः
verses.wordMeaning: Cf. Mt. 12 and with slight variations A 6-7 and Mbh. Vana 85.80.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. Mt. 12 and with slight variations A 6-7 and Mbh. Vana 85.80.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र स्नात्वा च पीत्वा च यमुनायां युधिष्ठिर । सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तः पुनात्यासप्तमं कुलम् । प्राणांस्त्यजति यस्तत्र स याति परमां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: tatra snātvā ca pītvā ca yamunāyāṃ yudhiṣṭhira / sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ punātyāsaptamaṃ kulam / prāṇāṃstyajati yastatra sa yāti paramāṃ gatim
verses.translation: To you all I shall relate it, as it had been narrated to the noble-souled Yudhisthira, son of KuntI, by Markandeya.
verses.hindi: नित्यपुष्टा निरातङ्का नित्यानन्दाश्च भोगिनः। नारायणपराः सर्वे नारायणपरायणाः
verses.wordMeaning: To you all I shall relate it, as it had been narrated to the noble-souled Yudhisthira, son of KuntI, by Markandeya.
verses.commentary: Sense: To you all I shall relate it, as it had been narrated to the noble-souled Yudhisthira, son of KuntI, by Markandeya.

verses.sanskrit: अग्नितीर्थमिति ख्यातं यमुनादक्षिण तटे । पश्चिमे धर्मराजस्य तीर्थं त्वनरकं स्मृतम् । तत्र स्नात्वा दिवं यान्ति ये मृतास्ते ऽपुनर्भवाः
verses.transliteration: agnitīrthamiti khyātaṃ yamunādakṣiṇa taṭe / paścime dharmarājasya tīrthaṃ tvanarakaṃ smṛtam / tatra snātvā divaṃ yānti ye mṛtāste 'punarbhavāḥ
verses.translation: After killing the Kauravas, king Yudhisthira, along- with his brothers, was overwhelmed with deep sorrow and. became deluded.
verses.hindi: केचिद् ध्यानपरा नित्यं योगिनः संयतेन्द्रियाः । केचिज्जपन्ति तप्यन्ति केचिद् विज्ञानिनोऽपरे अन्ये निर्बीजयोगेन ब्रह्मभावेन भाविताः । ध्यायन्ति तत् परं व्योम वासुदेवं परं पदम्
verses.wordMeaning: After killing the Kauravas, king Yudhisthira, along- with his brothers, was overwhelmed with deep sorrow and. became deluded.
verses.commentary: Sense: After killing the Kauravas, king Yudhisthira, along- with his brothers, was overwhelmed with deep sorrow and. became deluded.

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णपक्षे चतुर्दश्यां स्नात्वा संतर्पयेच्छुचिः । धर्मराजं महापापैर्मुच्यते नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ snātvā saṃtarpayecchuciḥ / dharmarājaṃ mahāpāpairmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Not long after that. Sage Markandeya of great penance, came to Hastinapura and stood at the entrance-gate of the palace.
verses.hindi: एकान्तिनो निरालम्बा महाभागवताः परे। पश्यन्ति परमं ब्रह्म विष्ण्वाख्यं तमसः परम्
verses.wordMeaning: Not long after that. Sage Markandeya of great penance, came to Hastinapura and stood at the entrance-gate of the palace.
verses.commentary: Sense: Not long after that. Sage Markandeya of great penance, came to Hastinapura and stood at the entrance-gate of the palace.

verses.sanskrit: दश तीर्थसहस्त्राणि त्रिंशत्कोट्यस्तथापराः । प्रयागे संस्थितानि स्युरेवमाहुर्मनीषिणः
verses.transliteration: daśa tīrthasahastrāṇi triṃśatkoṭyastathāparāḥ / prayāge saṃsthitāni syurevamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing him, the gatekeeper reported immediately- to the king: "Desirous of seeing you. Sage Markandeya is waiting at the gate."
verses.hindi: ये यज्ञ, दान, समाधि, व्रत, उपवास, विविध होम, स्वाध्याय एवं तर्पणद्वारा महादेवकी अर्चना करते हैं। इन्हें महादेवकी कृपासे उनका (रुद्रका) अति दुर्लभ सायुज्य, सारूप्य, सालोक्य तथा सामीप्य (मोक्ष) प्राप्त हे विप्रो! क्रौद्धद्वीपके दुगुने विस्तारमें चारों ओरसे दधिसमुद्रको आवृतकर शाकद्वीप स्थित है। (यहाँ) उदय, रैवत, श्यामाक, अस्तगिरि, आम्बिकेय, रम्य तथा केशरी-ये पर्वत हैं। यहाँ सुकुमारी, कुमारी, नलिनी,
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing him, the gatekeeper reported immediately- to the king: "Desirous of seeing you. Sage Markandeya is waiting at the gate."
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing him, the gatekeeper reported immediately- to the king: "Desirous of seeing you. Sage Markandeya is waiting at the gate."

verses.sanskrit: तिस्त्रः कोट्योर्ऽधकोटी च तीर्थानां वायुरब्रवीत् । दिवि भूम्यन्तरिक्षे च तत्सर्वं जाह्नवी स्मृता
verses.transliteration: tistraḥ koṭyor'dhakoṭī ca tīrthānāṃ vāyurabravīt / divi bhūmyantarikṣe ca tatsarvaṃ jāhnavī smṛtā
verses.translation: Yudhisthira, the son of Dharma, rushed hurriedly to- the gate and greeted him. "O great sage, welcome to you who have come to our door.
verses.hindi: रेणुका, इक्षुका, धेनुका और गभस्ति-ये नदियाँ हैं। इनका जल पीकर यहाँके मनुष्य (सुखमय) जीवन व्यतीत करते हैं। ये रोगरहित, शोकविहीन और राग- द्वेषसे मुक्त रहते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Yudhisthira, the son of Dharma, rushed hurriedly to- the gate and greeted him. "O great sage, welcome to you who have come to our door.
verses.commentary: Sense: Yudhisthira, the son of Dharma, rushed hurriedly to- the gate and greeted him. "O great sage, welcome to you who have come to our door.

verses.sanskrit: यत्र गङ्गा महाभागा स देशस्तत् तपोवनम् । सिद्धिक्षेत्रं तु तज्ज्ञेयं गङ्गातीरसमाश्रितम्
verses.transliteration: yatra gaṅgā mahābhāgā sa deśastat tapovanam / siddhikṣetraṃ tu tajjñeyaṃ gaṅgātīrasamāśritam
verses.translation: Fruitful has been my life today; my family has been emancipated from Samsara; O Sage, when you are pleased with, me, my ancestors will ever feel contented."
verses.hindi: मगध, मानव तथा मन्दग कहलाते हैं । ये सभी लोकोंके एकमात्र साक्षी देवाधिदेव सूर्यदेवका विविध व्रत एवं उपवासोंद्वारा निरन्तर यजन करते हैं। है विप्रेन्द्रों सूर्यके अनुग्रहसे इन्हें उनकी सायुज्यता, सामीप्यता, सारूप्यता और सालोक्यता प्राप्त होती है॥ ३६--३८ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Fruitful has been my life today; my family has been emancipated from Samsara; O Sage, when you are pleased with, me, my ancestors will ever feel contented."
verses.commentary: Sense: Fruitful has been my life today; my family has been emancipated from Samsara; O Sage, when you are pleased with, me, my ancestors will ever feel contented."

verses.sanskrit: यत्र देवो महादेवो देव्या सह महेश्वरः । आस्ते वटेश्वरो नित्यं तत् तीर्थं तत् तपोवनम्
verses.transliteration: yatra devo mahādevo devyā saha maheśvaraḥ / āste vaṭeśvaro nityaṃ tat tīrthaṃ tat tapovanam
verses.translation: Thus, the noble-souled Yudhisthira worshipped that sage by seating him on the throne, offering him water for wash¬ ing his feet and by duly honouring him.
verses.hindi: शाकट्टीपको आवृत करके क्षीरोद सागर स्थित है, उसके मध्यमें श्वेतद्दीप है। वहाँ नारायण-परायण लोग रहते हैं। वहाँ नाना आश्चयोंसे समन्वित अनेक पवित्र जनपद हैं। वहाँके मनुष्य श्वेतवर्णके और नित्य
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, the noble-souled Yudhisthira worshipped that sage by seating him on the throne, offering him water for wash¬ ing his feet and by duly honouring him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, the noble-souled Yudhisthira worshipped that sage by seating him on the throne, offering him water for wash¬ ing his feet and by duly honouring him.

verses.sanskrit: इदं सत्यं द्विजातीनां साधूनामात्मजस्य च । सुहृदां च जपेत् कर्णे शिष्यस्यानुगतस्य तु
verses.transliteration: idaṃ satyaṃ dvijātīnāṃ sādhūnāmātmajasya ca / suhṛdāṃ ca japet karṇe śiṣyasyānugatasya tu
verses.translation: On being asked, Markandeya enquired of Yudhisthira "Why do you get bewildered? It is after knowing everything that I have come."
verses.hindi: विष्णुको भक्तिमें तत्पर रहते हैं वहाँ न कोई आधि-व्याधि है, न वृद्धावस्था हैं तथा न मृत्युका भय ही है। सभी लोग नारायणके भक्त तथा क्रोध-लोभसे रहित, माया एवं मात्सर्यसे मुक्त, नित्य पुष्ट, आतङ्करहित, नित्य आनन्दयुक्त,
verses.wordMeaning: On being asked, Markandeya enquired of Yudhisthira "Why do you get bewildered? It is after knowing everything that I have come."
verses.commentary: Sense: On being asked, Markandeya enquired of Yudhisthira "Why do you get bewildered? It is after knowing everything that I have come."

verses.sanskrit: इदं धन्यमिदं स्वर्ग्यमिदं मेध्यमिदं सुखम् । इदं पुण्यमिदं रम्यं पावनं धर्म्यमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: idaṃ dhanyamidaṃ svargyamidaṃ medhyamidaṃ sukham / idaṃ puṇyamidaṃ ramyaṃ pāvanaṃ dharmyamuttamam
verses.translation: Then king Yudhisthira bowed down his head and said: "Tell succinctly those things whereby I shall get rid of my sin.
verses.hindi: भोग करनेवाले तथा नारायण-परायण रहते हैं। वहाँके
verses.wordMeaning: Then king Yudhisthira bowed down his head and said: "Tell succinctly those things whereby I shall get rid of my sin.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then king Yudhisthira bowed down his head and said: "Tell succinctly those things whereby I shall get rid of my sin.

verses.sanskrit: महर्षोणामिदं गुह्यं सर्वपापप्रमोचनम् । अत्राधीत्य द्विजो ऽध्यायं निर्मलत्वमवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: maharṣoṇāmidaṃ guhyaṃ sarvapāpapramocanam / atrādhītya dvijo 'dhyāyaṃ nirmalatvamavāpnuyāt
verses.translation: O excellent sage, in the battle where we clashed with the Kauravas, many innocent persons have been killed by us.
verses.hindi: हें, कोई जप करते हैं, कोई तप करते हैं और कुछ लोग विशिष्ट ज्ञान-सम्पन्न हैं। दूसरे निर्बीज योगके द्वारा ब्रह्मभावसे भावित होकर उन परम व्योमरूप, परमपद वासुदेवका ध्यान करते हैं। कुछ तम (आज्ञान)-से परे विष्णु नामक परम ब्रह्मका दर्शन करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent sage, in the battle where we clashed with the Kauravas, many innocent persons have been killed by us.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent sage, in the battle where we clashed with the Kauravas, many innocent persons have been killed by us.

verses.sanskrit: यश्चेदं शृणुयान्नित्यं तीर्थं पुण्यं सदा शुचिः । जातिस्मरित्वं लभते नाकपृष्ठे च मोदते
verses.transliteration: yaścedaṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ tīrthaṃ puṇyaṃ sadā śuciḥ / jātismaritvaṃ labhate nākapṛṣṭhe ca modate
verses.translation: It behoves you to recount that remedy whereby we shall be relieved of sin brought about by violence as well as accumulated in the course of several previous births."
verses.hindi: सर्वे चतुर्भुजाकारा: शद्धुचक्रगदाधरा:। सुपीतवाससः सर्वे श्रीवत्साङ्कितवक्षसः
verses.wordMeaning: It behoves you to recount that remedy whereby we shall be relieved of sin brought about by violence as well as accumulated in the course of several previous births."
verses.commentary: Sense: It behoves you to recount that remedy whereby we shall be relieved of sin brought about by violence as well as accumulated in the course of several previous births."

verses.sanskrit: प्राप्यन्ते तानितीर्थानि सद्भिः शिष्टानुदर्शिभिः । स्नाहि तीर्थेषु कौरव्य न च वक्रमतिर्भव
verses.transliteration: prāpyante tānitīrthāni sadbhiḥ śiṣṭānudarśibhiḥ / snāhi tīrtheṣu kauravya na ca vakramatirbhava
verses.translation: It behoves you to recount that remedy whereby we shall be relieved of sin brought about by violence as well as accumulated in the course of several previous births."
verses.hindi: अन्ये महेश्वरपरास्त्रिपुण्ड्राङ्कितमस्तकाः । स्वयोगोद्धूतकिरणा महागरुडवाहनाः तत्र नारायणस्यान्यद् दुर्गमं दुरतिक्रमम्। नारायणं नाम पुरं व्यासाद्यैरुपशोभितम्
verses.wordMeaning: It behoves you to recount that remedy whereby we shall be relieved of sin brought about by violence as well as accumulated in the course of several previous births."
verses.commentary: Sense: It behoves you to recount that remedy whereby we shall be relieved of sin brought about by violence as well as accumulated in the course of several previous births."

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा स भगवान् मार्कण्डेयो महामुनिः । तीर्तानि कथयामास पृथिव्यां यानि कानिचित्
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā sa bhagavān mārkaṇḍeyo mahāmuniḥ / tīrtāni kathayāmāsa pṛthivyāṃ yāni kānicit
verses.translation: It behoves you to recount that remedy whereby we shall be relieved of sin brought about by violence as well as accumulated in the course of several previous births."
verses.hindi: हेमप्राकारसंयुक्तं स्फाटिकैर्मण्डपैर्युतम् ।
verses.wordMeaning: It behoves you to recount that remedy whereby we shall be relieved of sin brought about by violence as well as accumulated in the course of several previous births."
verses.commentary: Sense: It behoves you to recount that remedy whereby we shall be relieved of sin brought about by violence as well as accumulated in the course of several previous births."

verses.sanskrit: भूसमुद्रादिसंस्थानं प्रमाणं ज्योतिषां स्थितम् । पृष्टः प्रोवाच सकलमुक्त्वाथ प्रययो मुनिः
verses.transliteration: bhūsamudrādisaṃsthānaṃ pramāṇaṃ jyotiṣāṃ sthitam / pṛṣṭaḥ provāca sakalamuktvātha prayayo muniḥ
verses.translation: It behoves you to recount that remedy whereby we shall be relieved of sin brought about by violence as well as accumulated in the course of several previous births."
verses.hindi: हर्म्यप्राकारसंयुक्तमट्डालकसमाकुलम् नन्दनैर्विविधाकारैः स्त्रवन्तीभिश्च शोभितम्। सरोभिः सर्वतो युक्तं वीणावेणुनिनादितम्
verses.wordMeaning: It behoves you to recount that remedy whereby we shall be relieved of sin brought about by violence as well as accumulated in the course of several previous births."
verses.commentary: Sense: It behoves you to recount that remedy whereby we shall be relieved of sin brought about by violence as well as accumulated in the course of several previous births."

verses.sanskrit: य इदं कल्यमुत्थाय पठते ऽथ शृणोति वा । मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्यो रुद्रलोकं स गच्छति
verses.transliteration: ya idaṃ kalyamutthāya paṭhate 'tha śṛṇoti vā / mucyate sarvapāpebhyo rudralokaṃ sa gacchati
verses.translation: It behoves you to recount that remedy whereby we shall be relieved of sin brought about by violence as well as accumulated in the course of several previous births."
verses.hindi: पताकाभिर्विचित्राभिरनेकाभिश्च शोभितम्।
verses.wordMeaning: It behoves you to recount that remedy whereby we shall be relieved of sin brought about by violence as well as accumulated in the course of several previous births."
verses.commentary: Sense: It behoves you to recount that remedy whereby we shall be relieved of sin brought about by violence as well as accumulated in the course of several previous births."

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पुर्वविभागे सप्तत्रिंशो ऽध्यायः श्रीकूर्म उवाच एवमुक्तास्तु मुनयो नैमिषीया महामतिम् । पप्रच्छुरुत्तरं सूतं पृथिव्यादिविनिर्णयम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ purvavibhāge saptatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ śrīkūrma uvāca evamuktāstu munayo naimiṣīyā mahāmatim / papracchuruttaraṃ sūtaṃ pṛthivyādivinirṇayam
verses.translation: O highly blessed king, listen. O scion of the family of Bharata, what you ask me shall be explained. Visiting Prayaga is excellent as it is destructive of the sins of men."
verses.hindi: हंसकारण्डवाकीर्ण चक्रवाकोपशोभितम्। चतुद्वारमनौपम्यमगम्यं देवविद्विषाम्
verses.wordMeaning: O highly blessed king, listen. O scion of the family of Bharata, what you ask me shall be explained. Visiting Prayaga is excellent as it is destructive of the sins of men."
verses.commentary: Sense: O highly blessed king, listen. O scion of the family of Bharata, what you ask me shall be explained. Visiting Prayaga is excellent as it is destructive of the sins of men."

verses.sanskrit: ऋषय ऊचुः कथितो भवता सूत सर्गः स्वयंभुवः शुभः । इदानीं श्रोतुमिच्छामस्त्रिलोकस्यास्य मण्डलम्
verses.transliteration: ṛṣaya ūcuḥ kathito bhavatā sūta sargaḥ svayaṃbhuvaḥ śubhaḥ / idānīṃ śrotumicchāmastrilokasyāsya maṇḍalam
verses.translation: O ruler of men, lord Mahadeva, Rudra, stayed there. Lord Brahma, the self-born deity, abides there alongwith other Devas.
verses.hindi: तत्र तत्राप्सरःसङ्कर्नृत्यद्भिरु पशोभितम्। नानागीतविधानज्ञैर्देवानामपि दुर्लभेः
verses.wordMeaning: O ruler of men, lord Mahadeva, Rudra, stayed there. Lord Brahma, the self-born deity, abides there alongwith other Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: O ruler of men, lord Mahadeva, Rudra, stayed there. Lord Brahma, the self-born deity, abides there alongwith other Devas.

verses.sanskrit: यावन्तः सागरा द्वीपास्तथा वर्षाणि पर्वताः । वनानि सरितः सूर्यग्रहाणां स्थितिरेव च
verses.transliteration: yāvantaḥ sāgarā dvīpāstathā varṣāṇi parvatāḥ / vanāni saritaḥ sūryagrahāṇāṃ sthitireva ca
verses.translation: "O holy lord, I wish to hear about the fruit of pilgrimage to Prayaga. What is the goal attained by the persons who die there? What is the merit that accrues to those who take their ablutions there?
verses.hindi: नानाविलाससम्पन्नैः कामुकैरतिकोमलैः । प्रभूतचन्द्रवदनैर्नूपुरारावसंयुतैः ® गोपुर--नगरका बड़ा फाटक अथवा फाटक मात्र।
verses.wordMeaning: "O holy lord, I wish to hear about the fruit of pilgrimage to Prayaga. What is the goal attained by the persons who die there? What is the merit that accrues to those who take their ablutions there?
verses.commentary: Sense: "O holy lord, I wish to hear about the fruit of pilgrimage to Prayaga. What is the goal attained by the persons who die there? What is the merit that accrues to those who take their ablutions there?

verses.sanskrit: यदाधारमिदं कृत्स्नं येषां पृथ्वी पुरा त्वियम् । नृपाणां तत्समासेन सूत वक्तुमिहार्हसि
verses.transliteration: yadādhāramidaṃ kṛtsnaṃ yeṣāṃ pṛthvī purā tviyam / nṛpāṇāṃ tatsamāsena sūta vaktumihārhasi
verses.translation: Mention the benefit derived by those who reside in Prayaga. Indeed this is known to you. Please relate it to me. Obeisance be to you."
verses.hindi: धारण करनेवाले, सुन्दर पीताम्बर धारण करनेवाले एवं श्रीवत्ससे अङ्कित वक्षःस्थलवाले हें
verses.wordMeaning: Mention the benefit derived by those who reside in Prayaga. Indeed this is known to you. Please relate it to me. Obeisance be to you."
verses.commentary: Sense: Mention the benefit derived by those who reside in Prayaga. Indeed this is known to you. Please relate it to me. Obeisance be to you."

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच वक्ष्ये देवादिदेवाय विष्णवे प्रभविष्णवे । नमस्कृत्वाप्रमेयाय यदुक्तं तेन धीमता
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca vakṣye devādidevāya viṣṇave prabhaviṣṇave / namaskṛtvāprameyāya yaduktaṃ tena dhīmatā
verses.translation: "O dear one, I shall recount to you the fruit of ablutions in Prayaga. It was heard by me as it was being recount¬ ed by great sages formerly.
verses.hindi: अन्य (कुछ) लोग महेश्वरके भक्त हें  वे मस्तकपर त्रिपुण्ड धारण करते हैं। वे अपने योगसे उत्पन्न रश्मियोंसे लोकको प्रकाशित करते हैं और महागरुड उनके वाहन हैं। सभी शक्तियोंसे सम्पन्न, नित्य आनन्दसे पूर्ण, शुद्धान्तःकरण तथा विष्णुके अन्तरमें विचरण करनेवाले पुरुष वहाँ रहते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: "O dear one, I shall recount to you the fruit of ablutions in Prayaga. It was heard by me as it was being recount¬ ed by great sages formerly.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O dear one, I shall recount to you the fruit of ablutions in Prayaga. It was heard by me as it was being recount¬ ed by great sages formerly.

verses.sanskrit: स्वायंभुवस्य तु मनोः प्रागुक्तो यः प्रियव्रतः । पुत्रस्तस्याभवन् पुत्राः प्रजापतिसमा दश
verses.transliteration: svāyaṃbhuvasya tu manoḥ prāgukto yaḥ priyavrataḥ / putrastasyābhavan putrāḥ prajāpatisamā daśa
verses.translation: This is the holy place sacred to Prajapati. It is well- known in the three worlds. By taking their bath here, people attain heaven. Those who die here are not reborn.
verses.hindi: वहाँ व्यास आदिसे सुशोभित नारायणका दूसरा दुर्गम तथा दुर्लङ्कय नारायण नामक एक पुर है। वह पुर सोनेके परकोटेसे युक्त, स्फटिकके मण्डपोंसे समन्वित, हजारों प्रकारकी प्रभाओऑसे अलंकृत, अत्यन्त
verses.wordMeaning: This is the holy place sacred to Prajapati. It is well- known in the three worlds. By taking their bath here, people attain heaven. Those who die here are not reborn.
verses.commentary: Sense: This is the holy place sacred to Prajapati. It is well- known in the three worlds. By taking their bath here, people attain heaven. Those who die here are not reborn.

verses.sanskrit: अग्नीध्रश्चाग्निबाहुश्च वपुष्मान् द्युतिमांस्तथा । मेधा मेधातिथिर्हव्यः सवनः पुत्र एव च
verses.transliteration: agnīdhraścāgnibāhuśca vapuṣmān dyutimāṃstathā / medhā medhātithirhavyaḥ savanaḥ putra eva ca
verses.translation: Brahma and other Devas gathering together at that place afford protection. There are many other holy places there, that dispel sins.
verses.hindi: सुन्दर और दुराधर्ष है तथा सोनेके प्रासादोंसे युक्त एवं अनेक बड़ी-बड़ी अट्टालिकाओंसे व्याप्त है। वह पुर स्वर्णसे बने हजारों विचित्र गोपुरों और नाना प्रकारके रत्नोंसे सुशोभित है, साथ ही वह स्वच्छ आसनोंसे युक्त एवं विविध प्रकारसे अलंकृत है। वह पुर विविध प्रकारके उद्यानों और नदियोंसे शोभित है। सब ओरसे सरोवरांसे युक्त और वीणा तथा वेणुकी ध्वनिसे निनादित है। विचित्र प्रकारकी अनेक पताकाओंसे
verses.wordMeaning: Brahma and other Devas gathering together at that place afford protection. There are many other holy places there, that dispel sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahma and other Devas gathering together at that place afford protection. There are many other holy places there, that dispel sins.

verses.sanskrit: ज्योतिष्मान् दशमस्तेषां महाबलपराक्रमः । धार्मिको दाननिरतः सर्वभूतानुकम्पकः
verses.transliteration: jyotiṣmān daśamasteṣāṃ mahābalaparākramaḥ / dhārmiko dānanirataḥ sarvabhūtānukampakaḥ
verses.translation: I cannot recount it in even hundreds of years. I shall succinctly narrate to you the glory of Prayaga.
verses.hindi: शोभित है। सब ओरसे वीथियों और रत्नसे विभूषित सीढ़ियोंसे युक्त हे
verses.wordMeaning: I cannot recount it in even hundreds of years. I shall succinctly narrate to you the glory of Prayaga.
verses.commentary: Sense: I cannot recount it in even hundreds of years. I shall succinctly narrate to you the glory of Prayaga.

verses.sanskrit: मेधाग्निबाहुपुत्रास्तु त्रयो योगपरायणाः । जातिस्मरा महाभागा न राज्ये दधिरे मतिम्
verses.transliteration: medhāgnibāhuputrāstu trayo yogaparāyaṇāḥ / jātismarā mahābhāgā na rājye dadhire matim
verses.translation: Prayaga extends over an area of sixty thousand Dhanus—that includes Gahga. The sun-god with seven horses to his chariots always protects Yamuna.
verses.hindi: सैकड़ों, हजारों स्त्रियोंसे सम्पन्न तथा दिव्य गानसे समन्वित है। हंस एवं सारस पक्षियोंसे व्याप्त है, चक्रवाकोंसे सुशोभित है। उसमें अनृपमेय चार द्वार हैं तथा वह सुरद्रेषी असुरोंके लिये अगम्य है। (वह पुर) विविध प्रकारके गीतोंको जाननेवाले देवताओंके लिये भी दुर्लभ, नाना विलासोंसे सम्पन्न, कामके अभिलाषी, अतिकोमल, पूर्ण चन्द्रमाके समान मुखवाले, नूपुरकी ध्वनिसे युक्त, मन्द मुसकानवाले, सुन्दर बिम्बके
verses.wordMeaning: Prayaga extends over an area of sixty thousand Dhanus—that includes Gahga. The sun-god with seven horses to his chariots always protects Yamuna.
verses.commentary: Sense: Prayaga extends over an area of sixty thousand Dhanus—that includes Gahga. The sun-god with seven horses to his chariots always protects Yamuna.

verses.sanskrit: प्रियव्रतो ऽभ्यषिञ्चद् वै सप्तद्वीपेषु सप्त तान् । जम्बुद्वीपेश्वरं पुत्रमग्नीध्रमकरोन्नृपः
verses.transliteration: priyavrato 'bhyaṣiñcad vai saptadvīpeṣu sapta tān / jambudvīpeśvaraṃ putramagnīdhramakaronnṛpaḥ
verses.translation: Indra himself abides in Prayaga. Hari protects this zone which is revered by all Devas.
verses.hindi: समान ओठवाले, मुग्ध मृगशावकके समान नेत्रवाले, सम्पूर्ण ऐश्वर्योसे सम्पन्न, अलंकृत, क्षीण कटिभागवाले, राजहंसके समान सुन्दर चालवाले, अच्छे वेषवाले,
verses.wordMeaning: Indra himself abides in Prayaga. Hari protects this zone which is revered by all Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indra himself abides in Prayaga. Hari protects this zone which is revered by all Devas.

verses.sanskrit: प्लक्ष्द्वीपेश्वरश्चैव तेन मेधातिथिः कृतः । शाल्मलेशं वपुष्मन्तं नरेन्द्रमभिषिक्तवान्
verses.transliteration: plakṣdvīpeśvaraścaiva tena medhātithiḥ kṛtaḥ / śālmaleśaṃ vapuṣmantaṃ narendramabhiṣiktavān
verses.translation: Mahesvara, armed with the trident, protects the Myagrodha (holy fig tree) for ever. Devas protect the holy place that is auspicious and dispels all sins.
verses.hindi: मधुर स्वरवाले, बोल-चालमें प्रवीण, दिव्य अलड्कारोंसे श्रीमत्पवित्रं देवस्य श्रीपतेरमितौजसः। तस्य मध्येऽतितेजस्कमुच्चप्राकारतोरणम्
verses.wordMeaning: Mahesvara, armed with the trident, protects the Myagrodha (holy fig tree) for ever. Devas protect the holy place that is auspicious and dispels all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Mahesvara, armed with the trident, protects the Myagrodha (holy fig tree) for ever. Devas protect the holy place that is auspicious and dispels all sins.

verses.sanskrit: ज्योतिष्मन्तं कुशद्वीपे राजानं कृतवान् प्रभुः । द्युतिमन्तं च राजानं क्रौञ्चद्वीपे समादिशत्
verses.transliteration: jyotiṣmantaṃ kuśadvīpe rājānaṃ kṛtavān prabhuḥ / dyutimantaṃ ca rājānaṃ krauñcadvīpe samādiśat
verses.translation: By touching or being sprinkled with its water, a person is honoured in the region of gods, even if such a man be sickly, indigent or infuriated.
verses.hindi: तन्मध्ये भगवानेकः पुण्डरीकदलद्युतिः। शेतेऽशेषजगत्सूतिः शेषाहिशयने हरिः
verses.wordMeaning: By touching or being sprinkled with its water, a person is honoured in the region of gods, even if such a man be sickly, indigent or infuriated.
verses.commentary: Sense: By touching or being sprinkled with its water, a person is honoured in the region of gods, even if such a man be sickly, indigent or infuriated.

verses.sanskrit: शाकद्वीपेश्वरं चापि हव्यं चक्रे प्रियव्रतः । पुष्कराधिपतिं चक्रे सवनं च प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: śākadvīpeśvaraṃ cāpi havyaṃ cakre priyavrataḥ / puṣkarādhipatiṃ cakre savanaṃ ca prajāpatiḥ
verses.translation: It is the redeemer of Pitrs and destructive of sins. The ocean of worldly existence is crossed by those who take up residence at Prayaga.
verses.hindi: सा च देवी जगद्दन्द्या पादमूले हरिप्रिया। समास्ते तन्मना नित्यं पीत्वा नारायणामृतम् न तत्राधार्मिका यान्ति न च देवान्तराश्रयाः । वैकुण्ठं नाम तत् स्थानं त्रिदशैरपि वन्दितम्
verses.wordMeaning: It is the redeemer of Pitrs and destructive of sins. The ocean of worldly existence is crossed by those who take up residence at Prayaga.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is the redeemer of Pitrs and destructive of sins. The ocean of worldly existence is crossed by those who take up residence at Prayaga.

verses.sanskrit: पुष्करे सवनस्यापि महावीतः सुतो ऽभवत् । धातिकिश्चैव द्वावेतौ पुत्रौ पुत्रवतां वरौ
verses.transliteration: puṣkare savanasyāpi mahāvītaḥ suto 'bhavat / dhātikiścaiva dvāvetau putrau putravatāṃ varau
verses.translation: Leading sages say that one derives desired pleasures if one casts off one's life with special efforts after reaching the confluence ofGahga and Yamuna.
verses.hindi: एतावच्छक्यते वक्तुं नारायणपुरं हि तत्
verses.wordMeaning: Leading sages say that one derives desired pleasures if one casts off one's life with special efforts after reaching the confluence ofGahga and Yamuna.
verses.commentary: Sense: Leading sages say that one derives desired pleasures if one casts off one's life with special efforts after reaching the confluence ofGahga and Yamuna.

verses.sanskrit: महावीतं स्मृतं वर्षं तस्य नाम्ना महात्मनः । नाम्ना तु धातकेश्चापि धातकीखण्डमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: mahāvītaṃ smṛtaṃ varṣaṃ tasya nāmnā mahātmanaḥ / nāmnā tu dhātakeścāpi dhātakīkhaṇḍamucyate
verses.translation: Hence, one should not receive gifts in Tirthas or holy shrines. A Brahmana should be alert in the case ofall conditions.
verses.hindi: स एव परमं ब्रह्म वासुदेवः सनातनः। शेते नारायणः श्रीमान् मायया मोहयञ्जगत् नारायणादिदं जातं तस्मिन्नेव व्यवस्थितम् । तमेवाभ्येति कल्पान्ते स एव परमा गति:
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, one should not receive gifts in Tirthas or holy shrines. A Brahmana should be alert in the case ofall conditions.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, one should not receive gifts in Tirthas or holy shrines. A Brahmana should be alert in the case ofall conditions.

verses.sanskrit: शाकद्वीपेश्वरस्याथ हव्यस्याप्यभवन् सुताः । जलदश्च कुमारश्च सुकुमारो मणीचकः । कुसुमोत्तरो ऽथ मोदाकिः सप्तमः स्यान्महाद्रुमः
verses.transliteration: śākadvīpeśvarasyātha havyasyāpyabhavan sutāḥ / jaladaśca kumāraśca sukumāro maṇīcakaḥ / kusumottaro 'tha modākiḥ saptamaḥ syānmahādrumaḥ
verses.translation: W. 26-27 Cf. Mt. 34-42; Pd. 43.34-42; N 63. 140-149. The textual similarity is worth noting.
verses.hindi: विभूषित, स्तनके भारसे कुछ झुके हुए, मदके कारण चञ्चल नेत्रोंबाले, अनेक वर्णोके अङ्गरागसे सुशोभित अङ्गोंवाले, नाना प्रकारके भोग और रतिमें अनुराग रखनेवालों और जहा-तहाँ नृत्य करते हुए अप्सरा-
verses.wordMeaning: W. 26-27 Cf. Mt. 34-42; Pd. 43.34-42; N 63. 140-149. The textual similarity is worth noting.
