verses.commentary: Sense: W. 26-27 Cf. Mt. 34-42; Pd. 43.34-42; N 63. 140-149. The textual similarity is worth noting.

verses.sanskrit: जलदं जलदस्याथ वर्षं प्रथममुच्यते । कुमारस्य तु कौमारं तृतीयं सुकुमारकम्
verses.transliteration: jaladaṃ jaladasyātha varṣaṃ prathamamucyate / kumārasya tu kaumāraṃ tṛtīyaṃ sukumārakam
verses.hindi: समूहोंसे सुशोभित हें ॥ ५४--५९ ॥ उद्यानोंसे सुशोभित असंख्य गुणोंवाला वह पवित्र पुर
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. Mt. 43; A 13.

verses.sanskrit: मणीचकं चतुर्थं तु पञ्चमं कुसुमोत्तरम् । मोदाकं षष्ठमित्युक्तं सप्तमं तु महाद्रुमम्
verses.transliteration: maṇīcakaṃ caturthaṃ tu pañcamaṃ kusumottaram / modākaṃ ṣaṣṭhamityuktaṃ saptamaṃ tu mahādrumam
verses.hindi: लक्ष्मीपति (विष्णु) देवका वह पुर श्रीसे सम्पन्न और पवित्र है। उसके मध्यमें अत्यन्त तेजसे सम्पन्न, ऊँचे प्राकार तथा तोरणोंसे युक्त और योगियोंके लिये भी दुर्लभ विष्णुका दिव्य स्थान है। उसके मध्यमें कमलदलके

verses.sanskrit: क्रौञ्चद्वीपेश्वरस्यापि सुता द्युतिमतो ऽभवन् । कुशलः प्रथमस्तेषां द्वितीयस्तु मनोहरः
verses.transliteration: krauñcadvīpeśvarasyāpi sutā dyutimato 'bhavan / kuśalaḥ prathamasteṣāṃ dvitīyastu manoharaḥ
verses.translation: Cf. Mt. 54, Garuda I. 81.1-2.
verses.hindi: समान द्युतिवाले, सम्पूर्ण जगत्के उत्पादक, भगवान् हरि शेषनागको शय्यापर शयन करते हैं स्वात्मानन्दरूपी अमृतका पान करते हुए सनन्दन आदि योगीऱ्द्रोद्वारा तमोगुणसे अतीत श्रेष्ठ उन (श्रीहरि)- का चिन्तन किया जाता है। क्षीरसागरकी कन्या लक्ष्मी सुन्दर पीताम्बर धारण करनेवाले, अनन्त, महामायाके
verses.wordMeaning: Cf. Mt. 54, Garuda I. 81.1-2.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. Mt. 54, Garuda I. 81.1-2.

verses.sanskrit: उष्णस्तृतीयः संप्रोक्तश्चतुर्थः प्रवरः स्मृतः । अन्धकारो मुनिश्चैव दुन्दुभिश्चैव सप्तमः । तेषां स्वनामभिर्देशाः क्रौञ्चद्वीपाश्रयाः शुभाः
verses.transliteration: uṣṇastṛtīyaḥ saṃproktaścaturthaḥ pravaraḥ smṛtaḥ / andhakāro muniścaiva dundubhiścaiva saptamaḥ / teṣāṃ svanāmabhirdeśāḥ krauñcadvīpāśrayāḥ śubhāḥ
verses.translation: He who resorts to the root of the holy Banyan tree and abandons his life there, goes to the northern Kurus and rejoices for endless time.
verses.hindi: अधिपति तथा महान् भुजाओंवाले विष्णुके दोनों चरण नित्य पकड़े रहती हैं। जगत्की वन्दनीया हरिप्रिया वे देवी नारायणामृतका पानकर उन्हींमें मन लगाकर उनके चरणमूलमें नित्य विराजमान रहती हैं
verses.wordMeaning: He who resorts to the root of the holy Banyan tree and abandons his life there, goes to the northern Kurus and rejoices for endless time.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who resorts to the root of the holy Banyan tree and abandons his life there, goes to the northern Kurus and rejoices for endless time.

verses.sanskrit: ज्योतिष्मतः कुशद्वीपे सप्तैवासन् महौजसः । उद्भेदो वेणुमांश्चैवाश्वरथो लम्बनो धृतिः । षष्ठः प्रभाकारश्चापि सप्तमः कपिलः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: jyotiṣmataḥ kuśadvīpe saptaivāsan mahaujasaḥ / udbhedo veṇumāṃścaivāśvaratho lambano dhṛtiḥ / ṣaṣṭhaḥ prabhākāraścāpi saptamaḥ kapilaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: O tiger among kings, Prayaga is well-known in the three worlds. The middle of Gahga and Yamuna is known as the 'loin-region' of the Earth.®
verses.hindi: वहाँ (श्वेतद्वीपके नारायणपुरमें) न अधार्मिक जा पाते हैं और न दूसरे देवका आश्रय ग्रहण करनेवाले। है। उसका सम्पूर्ण रूपसे वर्णन करनेमें मेरी बुद्धि समर्थ नहीं है। उस नारायणपुरका मैं इतना ही वर्णन कर सकता हूँ। परम ब्रह्म सनातन वासुदेव श्रीमान् नारायण अपनी मायाद्वारा संसारको मोहित करते हुए वहाँ शयन
verses.wordMeaning: O tiger among kings, Prayaga is well-known in the three worlds. The middle of Gahga and Yamuna is known as the 'loin-region' of the Earth.®
verses.commentary: Sense: O tiger among kings, Prayaga is well-known in the three worlds. The middle of Gahga and Yamuna is known as the 'loin-region' of the Earth.®

verses.sanskrit: स्वनामचिह्नितान् यत्र तथा वर्षाणि सुव्रताः । ज्ञेयानि सप्त तान्येषु द्वीपेष्वेवं न यो मतः
verses.transliteration: svanāmacihnitān yatra tathā varṣāṇi suvratāḥ / jñeyāni sapta tānyeṣu dvīpeṣvevaṃ na yo mataḥ
verses.translation: A person of praiseworthy religious vows, who per¬ forms ablutions in the confluence attains the benefit equal to that of performing the Rajasuya and the horse-sacrifice.
verses.hindi: करते हैं। यह सब कुछ नारायणसे ही उत्पन्न है, उन्हीमे स्थित है और कल्पान्तमें उन्हींको प्राप्त होता है। वे ही परम गति हैं
verses.wordMeaning: A person of praiseworthy religious vows, who per¬ forms ablutions in the confluence attains the benefit equal to that of performing the Rajasuya and the horse-sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: A person of praiseworthy religious vows, who per¬ forms ablutions in the confluence attains the benefit equal to that of performing the Rajasuya and the horse-sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: शाल्मलद्वीपनाथस्य सुताश्चासन् वपुष्मतः । श्वेतश्च हरितश्चैव जीमूतो रोहितस्तथा । वैद्युतौ मानसश्चैव सप्तमः सुप्रभो मतः
verses.transliteration: śālmaladvīpanāthasya sutāścāsan vapuṣmataḥ / śvetaśca haritaścaiva jīmūto rohitastathā / vaidyutau mānasaścaiva saptamaḥ suprabho mataḥ
verses.translation: O dear one, neither at the instance of the mother nor at the report of the common people should your mind to perform pilgrimage to Prayaga, be dissuaded.
verses.hindi: पुष्करद्वीपकी स्थिति तथा विस्तारका वर्णन, संक्षेपमें अव्यक्तसे सृष्टिका प्रतिपादन क्षीरार्णवं समाश्रित्य द्वीपः पुष्करसंवृतः
verses.wordMeaning: O dear one, neither at the instance of the mother nor at the report of the common people should your mind to perform pilgrimage to Prayaga, be dissuaded.
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear one, neither at the instance of the mother nor at the report of the common people should your mind to perform pilgrimage to Prayaga, be dissuaded.

verses.sanskrit: प्लक्षद्वीपेश्वरस्यापि सप्त मेधातिथेः सुताः । ज्येष्ठः शान्तभयस्तेषां शिशिरश्च सुखोदयः । आनन्दश्च शिवश्चैव क्षेमकश्च ध्रुवस्तथा
verses.transliteration: plakṣadvīpeśvarasyāpi sapta medhātitheḥ sutāḥ / jyeṣṭhaḥ śāntabhayasteṣāṃ śiśiraśca sukhodayaḥ / ānandaśca śivaścaiva kṣemakaśca dhruvastathā
verses.translation: O scion of the family of Kurus, sixty thousand Tirthas and other sixty crores of sacred places are present here (at Prayaga).
verses.hindi: तावदेव च विस्तीर्णः सर्वतः परिमण्डलः ॥
verses.wordMeaning: O scion of the family of Kurus, sixty thousand Tirthas and other sixty crores of sacred places are present here (at Prayaga).
verses.commentary: Sense: O scion of the family of Kurus, sixty thousand Tirthas and other sixty crores of sacred places are present here (at Prayaga).

verses.sanskrit: प्लक्षद्वीपादिषु ज्ञेयः शाकद्वीपान्तिकेषु वै । वर्णाश्रमविभागेन स्वधर्मो मुक्तये द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: plakṣadvīpādiṣu jñeyaḥ śākadvīpāntikeṣu vai / varṇāśramavibhāgena svadharmo muktaye dvijāḥ
verses.translation: The goal attained by one who gives up his life at the confluence of Gahga and Yamuna is the same as obtained by a learned man who has renounced the world as a Sannyasin and who is endowed with Yogic power.
verses.hindi: महावीतं स्मृतं वर्ष धातकीखण्डमेव च स्वादूदकेनोदधिना पुष्करः परिवारितः। तस्मिन् द्वीपे महावृक्षो न्यग्रोधोऽमरपूजितः
verses.wordMeaning: The goal attained by one who gives up his life at the confluence of Gahga and Yamuna is the same as obtained by a learned man who has renounced the world as a Sannyasin and who is endowed with Yogic power.
verses.commentary: Sense: The goal attained by one who gives up his life at the confluence of Gahga and Yamuna is the same as obtained by a learned man who has renounced the world as a Sannyasin and who is endowed with Yogic power.

verses.sanskrit: जम्बुद्वीपेश्वरस्यापि पुत्रास्त्वासन् महाबलाः । अग्नीध्रस्य द्विजश्रेष्ठास्तन्नामानि निबोधत
verses.transliteration: jambudvīpeśvarasyāpi putrāstvāsan mahābalāḥ / agnīdhrasya dvijaśreṣṭhāstannāmāni nibodhata
verses.translation: O Yudhisthira! People staying in different parts of the world do not live a real life in this world (if they do not
verses.hindi: तस्मिन् निवसति ब्रह्मा विश्वात्मा विश्वभावनः । तत्रैव मुनिशार्दूलाः शिवनारायणालयः
verses.wordMeaning: O Yudhisthira! People staying in different parts of the world do not live a real life in this world (if they do not
verses.commentary: Sense: O Yudhisthira! People staying in different parts of the world do not live a real life in this world (if they do not

verses.sanskrit: नाभिः किंपुरुषश्चैव तथा हरिरिलावृतः । रम्यो हिरण्वांश्च कुरुर्भद्राश्वः केतुमाहलकः
verses.transliteration: nābhiḥ kiṃpuruṣaścaiva tathā haririlāvṛtaḥ / ramyo hiraṇvāṃśca kururbhadrāśvaḥ ketumāhalakaḥ
verses.translation: Thus on seeing the holy place Prayaga, the greatest region, one is absolved of all sins like the moon from the clutches of Rahu.
verses.hindi: वसत्यत्र महादेवो हरोऽर्धहरिरव्ययः। सम्पूज्यमानो ब्रह्माद्यैः कुमाराद्यैश्च योगिभिः । स्वस्थास्तत्र प्रजाः सर्वा ब्रह्मणा सदूशत्विषः। निरामया विशोकाश्च रागद्ठेषविवर्जिताः
verses.wordMeaning: Thus on seeing the holy place Prayaga, the greatest region, one is absolved of all sins like the moon from the clutches of Rahu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus on seeing the holy place Prayaga, the greatest region, one is absolved of all sins like the moon from the clutches of Rahu.

verses.sanskrit: जम्बुद्वीपेश्वरो राजा स चाग्नीध्रो महामतिः । विभज्य नवधा तेभ्यो यथान्यायं ददौ पुनः
verses.transliteration: jambudvīpeśvaro rājā sa cāgnīdhro mahāmatiḥ / vibhajya navadhā tebhyo yathānyāyaṃ dadau punaḥ
verses.translation: Kambala and Asvatara are the two Nagas on the southern bank of Yamuna. By taking ablution there and drinking the waters thereof, one is relieved of all sins.
verses.hindi: न वर्णाश्रमधर्माश्च न नद्यो न च पर्वताः
verses.wordMeaning: Kambala and Asvatara are the two Nagas on the southern bank of Yamuna. By taking ablution there and drinking the waters thereof, one is relieved of all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kambala and Asvatara are the two Nagas on the southern bank of Yamuna. By taking ablution there and drinking the waters thereof, one is relieved of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: नाभेस्तु दक्षिणं वर्षं हिमाह्वं प्रददौ पुनः । हेमकूटं ततो वर्षं ददौ किंपुरुषाय तु
verses.transliteration: nābhestu dakṣiṇaṃ varṣaṃ himāhvaṃ pradadau punaḥ / hemakūṭaṃ tato varṣaṃ dadau kiṃpuruṣāya tu
verses.translation: If an intelligent man goes there and takes his bath there*, he will redeem ten previous generations and ten future generations by the grace of Mahadeva.
verses.hindi: परेण पुष्करस्याथ समावृत्य स्थितो महान्। स्वादूदकसमुद्रस्तु समन्ताद् द्विजसत्तमाः परेण तस्य महती दूश्यते लोकसंस्थितिः । काञ्चनी द्विगुणा भूमिः सर्वा चैव शिलोपमा
verses.wordMeaning: If an intelligent man goes there and takes his bath there*, he will redeem ten previous generations and ten future generations by the grace of Mahadeva.
verses.commentary: Sense: If an intelligent man goes there and takes his bath there*, he will redeem ten previous generations and ten future generations by the grace of Mahadeva.

verses.sanskrit: तृतीयं नैषधं वर्षं हरये दत्तवान् पिता । इलावृताय प्रददौ मेरुमध्यमिलावृतम्
verses.transliteration: tṛtīyaṃ naiṣadhaṃ varṣaṃ haraye dattavān pitā / ilāvṛtāya pradadau merumadhyamilāvṛtam
verses.translation: By performing ablutions, a man obtains the fruit of a horse sacrifice. He attains the heavenly world (and stays there) till the dissolution of all living beings (at the time of Pralaya).
verses.hindi: प्रकाशश्चाप्रकाशश्च लोकालोकः स उच्यते
verses.wordMeaning: By performing ablutions, a man obtains the fruit of a horse sacrifice. He attains the heavenly world (and stays there) till the dissolution of all living beings (at the time of Pralaya).
verses.commentary: Sense: By performing ablutions, a man obtains the fruit of a horse sacrifice. He attains the heavenly world (and stays there) till the dissolution of all living beings (at the time of Pralaya).

verses.sanskrit: नीलाचलाश्रितं वर्षं रम्याय प्रददौ पिता । श्वेतं यदुत्तरं वर्षं पित्रा दत्तं हिरण्वते
verses.transliteration: nīlācalāśritaṃ varṣaṃ ramyāya pradadau pitā / śvetaṃ yaduttaraṃ varṣaṃ pitrā dattaṃ hiraṇvate
verses.translation: On the eastern side of Ganga a man** becomes famous in the three worlds (if he dies there). There is a famous cavity in the earth called Sarva-Samudra and the well-known (township called) Pratisthana (mod. Jhusi, near Allahabad, across Ganga).
verses.hindi: तावानेव च विस्तारो लोकालोको महागिरिः सूतजी बोले--शाकट्वीपके दुगुने विस्तारमें क्षीरसागरके आश्रित पुष्कर नामक द्वीप स्थित है। है विप्रेन्द्रो! यहाँ मानसोत्तर नामक एक ही पर्वत है। यह साढ़े पचास हजार योजन ऊँचा है और चारों ओर विस्तारमें इसका
verses.wordMeaning: On the eastern side of Ganga a man** becomes famous in the three worlds (if he dies there). There is a famous cavity in the earth called Sarva-Samudra and the well-known (township called) Pratisthana (mod. Jhusi, near Allahabad, across Ganga).
verses.commentary: Sense: On the eastern side of Ganga a man** becomes famous in the three worlds (if he dies there). There is a famous cavity in the earth called Sarva-Samudra and the well-known (township called) Pratisthana (mod. Jhusi, near Allahabad, across Ganga).

verses.sanskrit: यदुत्तरं शृङ्गवतो वर्षं तत् कुरुवे ददौ । मेरोः पूर्वेण यद् वर्षं भद्राश्वाय न्यवेदयत् । गन्धमादनवर्षं तु केतुमालाय दत्तवान्
verses.transliteration: yaduttaraṃ śṛṅgavato varṣaṃ tat kuruve dadau / meroḥ pūrveṇa yad varṣaṃ bhadrāśvāya nyavedayat / gandhamādanavarṣaṃ tu ketumālāya dattavān
verses.translation: If a person stays there for three nights observing celibacy and with his anger controlled, he being absolved of all sins and of.pure soul gets the fruit of performing a horse- sacrifice.
verses.hindi: परिमण्डल अर्थात् घेरा भी उतने ही परिमाणका है। इस द्वीपके ही पश्चिमको ओर आधे भागमें मानसोत्तर नामसे एक ही महापर्वत अपनी विशेष स्थितिके कारण दो भागोंमें बेटा है। इस ट्वीपमें दो शुभ एवं पवित्र जनपद
verses.wordMeaning: If a person stays there for three nights observing celibacy and with his anger controlled, he being absolved of all sins and of.pure soul gets the fruit of performing a horse- sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a person stays there for three nights observing celibacy and with his anger controlled, he being absolved of all sins and of.pure soul gets the fruit of performing a horse- sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: वर्षेष्वेतेषु तान् पुत्रानभिषिच्य नराधिपः । संसारकष्टतां ज्ञात्वा तपस्तेपे वनं गतः
verses.transliteration: varṣeṣveteṣu tān putrānabhiṣicya narādhipaḥ / saṃsārakaṣṭatāṃ jñātvā tapastepe vanaṃ gataḥ
verses.translation: To the north of Pratisthana and to the left hand side of Ganga, there is a Tirtha Haihsaprapatana. It is wellknown in the three worlds.
verses.hindi: कहे गये हैं। वे दोनों मानस पर्वतके अनु-मण्डल हैं। (ये) महावीत तथा धातकी खण्ड नामक वर्ष कहे गये हैं। पुष्करद्वीप (स्वादूदक समुद्र) स्वादिष्ट जलवाले समुद्रसे चारों ओरसे घिरा है। उस द्वीपमें देवताओंद्दारा पूजित न्यग्रोध (वट)-का एक महान् वृक्ष है॥ १--५॥
verses.wordMeaning: To the north of Pratisthana and to the left hand side of Ganga, there is a Tirtha Haihsaprapatana. It is wellknown in the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: To the north of Pratisthana and to the left hand side of Ganga, there is a Tirtha Haihsaprapatana. It is wellknown in the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: हिमाह्वयं तु यस्यैतन्नाभेरासीन्महात्मनः । तस्यर्षभो ऽभवत् पुत्रो मरुदेव्यां महाद्युतिः
verses.transliteration: himāhvayaṃ tu yasyaitannābherāsīnmahātmanaḥ / tasyarṣabho 'bhavat putro marudevyāṃ mahādyutiḥ
verses.translation: To the north of Pratisthana and to the left hand side of Ganga, there is a Tirtha Haihsaprapatana. It is wellknown in the three worlds.
verses.hindi: उसी (द्वीप)-में विश्वभावन विश्वात्मा ब्रह्मा रहते हैं । मुनिश्रेष्ठो ! वहींपर शिवनारायणका मन्दिर है। यहाँ आधे भागमें हर (एवं आधेमें) अव्यय हरिके रूपमें (अर्थात् हरिहरात्मक रूपमें) महादेव निवास करते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: To the north of Pratisthana and to the left hand side of Ganga, there is a Tirtha Haihsaprapatana. It is wellknown in the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: To the north of Pratisthana and to the left hand side of Ganga, there is a Tirtha Haihsaprapatana. It is wellknown in the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषभाद् भरतो जज्ञे वीरः पुत्रशताग्रजः । सो ऽभिषिच्यर्षभः पुत्रं भरतं पृथिवीपतिः । वानप्रस्थाश्रमं गत्वा तपस्तेपे यथाविधि
verses.transliteration: ṛṣabhād bharato jajñe vīraḥ putraśatāgrajaḥ / so 'bhiṣicyarṣabhaḥ putraṃ bharataṃ pṛthivīpatiḥ / vānaprasthāśramaṃ gatvā tapastepe yathāvidhi
verses.translation: To the north of Pratisthana and to the left hand side of Ganga, there is a Tirtha Haihsaprapatana. It is wellknown in the three worlds.
verses.hindi: यहाँ ब्रह्मा आदि देवताओं, कुमार (सनत्कुमार) आदि कृष्णपिङ्गल पूजित होते हैं। यहाँकी सारी प्रजा स्वस्थ है, ब्रह्माके समान प्रभावान् है और रोग, शोक, राग तथा द्वेषसे रहित है। वहाँ सत्य, असत्य, उत्तम, मध्यम, अधम (-का विभेद) नहीं है। न वर्णाश्रम धर्म है, न
verses.wordMeaning: To the north of Pratisthana and to the left hand side of Ganga, there is a Tirtha Haihsaprapatana. It is wellknown in the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: To the north of Pratisthana and to the left hand side of Ganga, there is a Tirtha Haihsaprapatana. It is wellknown in the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: तपसा कर्षितो ऽत्यर्थं कृशो धमनिसंततः । ज्ञानयोगरतो भूत्वा महापाशुपतो ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: tapasā karṣito 'tyarthaṃ kṛśo dhamanisaṃtataḥ / jñānayogarato bhūtvā mahāpāśupato 'bhavat
verses.translation: To the north of Pratisthana and to the left hand side of Ganga, there is a Tirtha Haihsaprapatana. It is wellknown in the three worlds.
verses.hindi: नदियाँ हैं और न पर्वत हैं। है द्विजसत्तमो! पुष्कर द्वीपके परे उसे चारों ओरसे घेरते हुए महान् स्वादूदक सागर स्थित है॥ ६--१० ॥
verses.wordMeaning: To the north of Pratisthana and to the left hand side of Ganga, there is a Tirtha Haihsaprapatana. It is wellknown in the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: To the north of Pratisthana and to the left hand side of Ganga, there is a Tirtha Haihsaprapatana. It is wellknown in the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: सुमतिर्भरतस्याभूत् पुत्रः परमधार्मिकः । सुमतेस्तैजसस्तस्मादिन्द्रिद्युम्नो व्यजायत
verses.transliteration: sumatirbharatasyābhūt putraḥ paramadhārmikaḥ / sumatestaijasastasmādindridyumno vyajāyata
verses.translation: To the north of Pratisthana and to the left hand side of Ganga, there is a Tirtha Haihsaprapatana. It is wellknown in the three worlds.
verses.hindi: उसके अनन्तर महती लोकस्थिति दिखलायी पड़ती है। वहाँकी द्विगुणित समस्त भूमि स्वर्णमयी और शिलाके समान है। उसके आगे सूर्यमण्डलकी मर्यादास्वरूप एक मर्यादा पर्वत है। (इसका एक भाग) प्रकाशित (तथा दूसरा) अप्रकाशित रहता है। इसीलिये वह लोकालोक (पर्वत) कहलाता है, लोकालोक नामक इस महान् पर्वतकी ऊँचाई दस हजार योजन कही गयी है और उतना ही इसका विस्तार (फैलाव)
verses.wordMeaning: To the north of Pratisthana and to the left hand side of Ganga, there is a Tirtha Haihsaprapatana. It is wellknown in the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: To the north of Pratisthana and to the left hand side of Ganga, there is a Tirtha Haihsaprapatana. It is wellknown in the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: परमेष्ठी सुतस्तस्मात् प्रतीहारस्तदन्वयः । प्रतिहर्तेति विख्यात उत्पन्नस्तस्य चात्मजः
verses.transliteration: parameṣṭhī sutastasmāt pratīhārastadanvayaḥ / pratiharteti vikhyāta utpannastasya cātmajaḥ
verses.translation: To the north of Pratisthana and to the left hand side of Ganga, there is a Tirtha Haihsaprapatana. It is wellknown in the three worlds.
verses.hindi: एते सप्त महालोका: पातालाः सप्त कीर्तिताः । ब्रह्माण्डस्यैष विस्तारः संक्षेपेण मयोदितः
verses.wordMeaning: To the north of Pratisthana and to the left hand side of Ganga, there is a Tirtha Haihsaprapatana. It is wellknown in the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: To the north of Pratisthana and to the left hand side of Ganga, there is a Tirtha Haihsaprapatana. It is wellknown in the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: भवस्तस्मादथोद्गीथः प्रस्तावस्तत्सुतो ऽभवत् । पृथुस्ततस्ततो रक्तो रक्तस्यापि गयः सुतः
verses.transliteration: bhavastasmādathodgīthaḥ prastāvastatsuto 'bhavat / pṛthustatastato rakto raktasyāpi gayaḥ sutaḥ
verses.translation: To the north of Pratisthana and to the left hand side of Ganga, there is a Tirtha Haihsaprapatana. It is wellknown in the three worlds.
verses.hindi: अण्डानामीदूशानां तु कोटयो ज्ञेयाः सहस्त्रशः । सर्वगत्वात् प्रधानस्य कारणस्याव्ययात्मनः तत्र तत्र चतुर्वक्त्रा रुद्रा नारायणादयः
verses.wordMeaning: To the north of Pratisthana and to the left hand side of Ganga, there is a Tirtha Haihsaprapatana. It is wellknown in the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: To the north of Pratisthana and to the left hand side of Ganga, there is a Tirtha Haihsaprapatana. It is wellknown in the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: नरो गयस्य तनयस्तस्य पुत्रो विराडभूत् । तस्य पुत्रो महावीर्यो धीमांस्तस्मादजायत
verses.transliteration: naro gayasya tanayastasya putro virāḍabhūt / tasya putro mahāvīryo dhīmāṃstasmādajāyata
verses.translation: To the north of Pratisthana and to the left hand side of Ganga, there is a Tirtha Haihsaprapatana. It is wellknown in the three worlds.
verses.hindi: तदव्यक्तमिति ज्ञेयं तद् ब्रह्म परमं पदम्
verses.wordMeaning: To the north of Pratisthana and to the left hand side of Ganga, there is a Tirtha Haihsaprapatana. It is wellknown in the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: To the north of Pratisthana and to the left hand side of Ganga, there is a Tirtha Haihsaprapatana. It is wellknown in the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: महान्तो ऽपि ततश्चाभूद् भौवनस्तत्सुतो ऽभवत् । त्वष्टा त्वष्टुश्च विरजो रजस्तस्याप्यभूत् सुतः
verses.transliteration: mahānto 'pi tataścābhūd bhauvanastatsuto 'bhavat / tvaṣṭā tvaṣṭuśca virajo rajastasyāpyabhūt sutaḥ
verses.translation: To the north of Pratisthana and to the left hand side of Ganga, there is a Tirtha Haihsaprapatana. It is wellknown in the three worlds.
verses.hindi: भूमौ रसातले चेव आकाशे पवनेऽनले । अर्णवेषु च सर्वेषु दिवि चैव न संशयः अण्डाद् ब्रह्मा समुत्पन्नस्तेन सृष्टमिदं जगत्
verses.wordMeaning: To the north of Pratisthana and to the left hand side of Ganga, there is a Tirtha Haihsaprapatana. It is wellknown in the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: To the north of Pratisthana and to the left hand side of Ganga, there is a Tirtha Haihsaprapatana. It is wellknown in the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: शतजिद् रजसस्तस्य जज्ञे पुत्रशतं द्विजाः । तेषां प्रधानो बलवान् विश्वज्योतिरिति स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: śatajid rajasastasya jajñe putraśataṃ dvijāḥ / teṣāṃ pradhāno balavān viśvajyotiriti smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: To the north of Pratisthana and to the left hand side of Ganga, there is a Tirtha Haihsaprapatana. It is wellknown in the three worlds.
verses.hindi: इस पर्वतको सभी ओरसे आवृतकर अन्धकार स्थित है और यह अन्धकार अण्डकटाह (चारों ओर विद्यमान ब्रह्माण्डरूपी कटाह)-के द्वारा चारों ओरसे परिवेष्टित है । यह अण्डकटाह ही सात महालोक और
verses.wordMeaning: To the north of Pratisthana and to the left hand side of Ganga, there is a Tirtha Haihsaprapatana. It is wellknown in the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: To the north of Pratisthana and to the left hand side of Ganga, there is a Tirtha Haihsaprapatana. It is wellknown in the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: आराध्य देवं ब्रह्माणं क्षेमकं नाम पार्थिवम् । असूत पुत्रं धर्मज्ञं महाबाहुमरिन्दमम्
verses.transliteration: ārādhya devaṃ brahmāṇaṃ kṣemakaṃ nāma pārthivam / asūta putraṃ dharmajñaṃ mahābāhumarindamam
verses.translation: To the north of Pratisthana and to the left hand side of Ganga, there is a Tirtha Haihsaprapatana. It is wellknown in the three worlds.
verses.hindi: सात पातालके रूपमें प्रसिद्ध है। मैंने संक्षेपमें ब्रह्माण्डका यह विस्तार बतलाया । प्रधान, कारणरूप और अव्ययात्माके सर्वव्यापी होनेके कारण इस प्रकारके हजारों करोड़ ब्रह्माण्ड हैं, ऐसा समझना चाहिए॥ १४--१६॥ इन सभी ब्रह्माण्डोंमें चौदह भुवन होते हैं, इन सभीमें चतुर्मुख ब्रह्मा, रुद्र तथा नारायण आदि होते हैं। है विप्रो! (ब्रह्माण्डके) चारों ओर सात आवरण हैं, वे परिमाणमें क्रमश: एक दूसरेसे दस गुना अधिक
verses.wordMeaning: To the north of Pratisthana and to the left hand side of Ganga, there is a Tirtha Haihsaprapatana. It is wellknown in the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: To the north of Pratisthana and to the left hand side of Ganga, there is a Tirtha Haihsaprapatana. It is wellknown in the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: एते पुरस्ताद् राजानो महासत्त्वा महौजसः । एषां वंशप्रसूतैश्च भुक्तेयं पृथिवी पुरा
verses.transliteration: ete purastād rājāno mahāsattvā mahaujasaḥ / eṣāṃ vaṃśaprasūtaiśca bhukteyaṃ pṛthivī purā
verses.translation: To the north of Pratisthana and to the left hand side of Ganga, there is a Tirtha Haihsaprapatana. It is wellknown in the three worlds.
verses.hindi: हैं। यहाँ मनीषी लोग जाते हैं। अनन्त, अद्वितीय, अव्यक्त, अनादिनिधन, महत् और जगतूके प्रकृतिस्वरूप अक्षर (ब्रह्म) इन सभी (आवरणों)- का अतिक्रमण- कर विद्यमान रहते हैं। इनकी कोई संख्या नहीं होती,
verses.wordMeaning: To the north of Pratisthana and to the left hand side of Ganga, there is a Tirtha Haihsaprapatana. It is wellknown in the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: To the north of Pratisthana and to the left hand side of Ganga, there is a Tirtha Haihsaprapatana. It is wellknown in the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे अष्टात्रिंशो ऽध्यायः सूत उवाच अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि संक्षेपेण द्विजोत्तमाः । त्रैलोक्यस्यास्य मानं वो न शक्यं विस्तरेण तु
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge aṣṭātriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi saṃkṣepeṇa dvijottamāḥ / trailokyasyāsya mānaṃ vo na śakyaṃ vistareṇa tu
verses.translation: By its mere remembrance the fruit of a horse sacrifice accrues to one. He is honoured in heaven as long as the moon and the sun shine.
verses.hindi: इसीलिये इन्हें अनन्त कहा जाता है। इन्हें ही अव्यक्त समझना चाहिए। ये ही ब्रह्म परम पद (अन्तिम प्राप्तव्य) हैं ॥ १७--२० ॥ ये अनन्त सर्वत्र सभी स्थानोंमें हैं, ऐसा कहा गया हे। इनका जो अव्यय माहात्म्य है, मैंने भी पूर्वमें उसका वर्णन किया है। वही ये (परमात्मा) ही भूमि, रसातल, आकाश, वायु, अग्नि, सभी समुद्रों तथा स्वर्ग-- सर्वत्र, सभी स्थानोंमें विद्यमान हैं, इसमें कोई संदेह नहीं। ये
verses.wordMeaning: By its mere remembrance the fruit of a horse sacrifice accrues to one. He is honoured in heaven as long as the moon and the sun shine.
verses.commentary: Sense: By its mere remembrance the fruit of a horse sacrifice accrues to one. He is honoured in heaven as long as the moon and the sun shine.

verses.sanskrit: भूर्लोको ऽथ भुवर्लोकः स्वर्लोको ऽथ महस्ततः । जनस्तपश्च सत्यं च लोकास्त्वण्डोद्भवा मताः
verses.transliteration: bhūrloko 'tha bhuvarlokaḥ svarloko 'tha mahastataḥ / janastapaśca satyaṃ ca lokāstvaṇḍodbhavā matāḥ
verses.translation: Listen to the fruit that one attains if one casts off one's life in the wide beautiful sand bank of Gahga named Urvasipulina which is white like swans or which appears white due to the swarms of swans.
verses.hindi: ही महाद्युतिमान् पुरुषोत्तम अन्धकार तथा (प्रकाशात्मा) सत्त्वमें विद्यमान होते हुए अपने अड्रोंको अनेक रूपोंमें विभक्तकर क्रीडा करते हैं। महेश्वर अव्यक्तसे परे हैं। अण्ड अव्यक्तसे उत्पन्न होता है। अण्डसे ब्रह्मा उत्पन
verses.wordMeaning: Listen to the fruit that one attains if one casts off one's life in the wide beautiful sand bank of Gahga named Urvasipulina which is white like swans or which appears white due to the swarms of swans.
verses.commentary: Sense: Listen to the fruit that one attains if one casts off one's life in the wide beautiful sand bank of Gahga named Urvasipulina which is white like swans or which appears white due to the swarms of swans.

verses.sanskrit: सूर्याचन्द्रमसोर्यावत् किरणैरवभासते । तावद् भूर्लोक आख्यातः पुराणे द्विजपुङ्गवाः
verses.transliteration: sūryācandramasoryāvat kiraṇairavabhāsate / tāvad bhūrloka ākhyātaḥ purāṇe dvijapuṅgavāḥ
verses.translation: O ruler of men, he stays along with the Pitrs in the heavenly world for sixtysix thousand (lit. sixty thousand and sixty hundred) years.
verses.hindi: हैं और उन्होंने इस संसारकी सृष्टि की है॥ २१--२४॥ स्वारोचिषसे वैवस्वत मन्वन्तरतकके देवता, सप्तर्षि, इन्द्र आदिका वर्णन, नारायणद्वारा ही विभिन्न मन्वन्तरोंमें सृष्टि आदिका प्रतिपादन, भगवान् विष्णुकी चार मूर्तियोंका विवेचन, विष्णुका माहात्म्य
verses.wordMeaning: O ruler of men, he stays along with the Pitrs in the heavenly world for sixtysix thousand (lit. sixty thousand and sixty hundred) years.
verses.commentary: Sense: O ruler of men, he stays along with the Pitrs in the heavenly world for sixtysix thousand (lit. sixty thousand and sixty hundred) years.

verses.sanskrit: यावत्प्रमाणो भूर्लोको विस्तरात् परिमण्डलात् । भुवर्लोको ऽपि तावान्स्यान्मण्डलाद् भास्करस्य तु
verses.transliteration: yāvatpramāṇo bhūrloko vistarāt parimaṇḍalāt / bhuvarloko 'pi tāvānsyānmaṇḍalād bhāskarasya tu
verses.translation: If a man remains celibate and pure and performs worship with concentration of the mind, in the beautiful Sandhyavata, he shall attain Brahmaloka.
verses.hindi: वेदशाखाप्रणयनं देवदेवस्य धीमतः। तथावतारान् धर्मार्थमीशानस्य कलौ युगे
verses.wordMeaning: If a man remains celibate and pure and performs worship with concentration of the mind, in the beautiful Sandhyavata, he shall attain Brahmaloka.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a man remains celibate and pure and performs worship with concentration of the mind, in the beautiful Sandhyavata, he shall attain Brahmaloka.

verses.sanskrit: ऊर्ध्वंयन्मण्डलाद् व्योमध्रुवोयावद्व्यवस्थितः । स्वर्लोकः स समाख्यातस्तत्र वायोस्तु नेमयः
verses.transliteration: ūrdhvaṃyanmaṇḍalād vyomadhruvoyāvadvyavasthitaḥ / svarlokaḥ sa samākhyātastatra vāyostu nemayaḥ
verses.translation: He who casts off his life after reaching Koti-tirtha, is honoured in the heavenly world for a thousand crores of years.
verses.hindi: कियन्तो देवदेवस्य शिष्याः कलियुगेषु वै। एतत् सर्व समासेन सूत वक्तुमिहार्हसि॥ पारावताश्च तुषिता देवाः स्वारोचिषेऽन्तरे! विपश्चिन्नाम देवेन्द्रो बभूवासुरसूदनः
verses.wordMeaning: He who casts off his life after reaching Koti-tirtha, is honoured in the heavenly world for a thousand crores of years.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who casts off his life after reaching Koti-tirtha, is honoured in the heavenly world for a thousand crores of years.

verses.sanskrit: आवहः प्रवहश्चैव तथैवानुवहः परः । संवहो विवहश्चाथ तदूर्ध्वं स्यात् परावहः
verses.transliteration: āvahaḥ pravahaścaiva tathaivānuvahaḥ paraḥ / saṃvaho vivahaścātha tadūrdhvaṃ syāt parāvahaḥ
verses.translation: No doubt need be entertained about the fact that the area through which the highly blessed Gahga which has many sacred places and penance groves on its bank, flows is known as a Siddhi Ksetra.
verses.hindi: सुशान्तिस्तत्र देवेन्द्रो बभूवामित्रकर्षणः
verses.wordMeaning: No doubt need be entertained about the fact that the area through which the highly blessed Gahga which has many sacred places and penance groves on its bank, flows is known as a Siddhi Ksetra.
verses.commentary: Sense: No doubt need be entertained about the fact that the area through which the highly blessed Gahga which has many sacred places and penance groves on its bank, flows is known as a Siddhi Ksetra.

verses.sanskrit: तथा परिवहश्चोर्ध्वं वायोर्वै सप्त नेमयः । भूमेर्योजनलक्षे तु भानोर्वै मण्डलं स्थितम्
verses.transliteration: tathā parivahaścordhvaṃ vāyorvai sapta nemayaḥ / bhūmeryojanalakṣe tu bhānorvai maṇḍalaṃ sthitam
verses.translation: Gahga is called Tripatha (having triple paths) because it redeems human beings on the Earth, serpents in the nether- worlds and Devas in the heaven.
verses.hindi: सुधामानस्तथा सत्याः शिवाश्चाथ प्रतर्दनाः । वशवर्तिनश्च पञ्चैते गणा द्वादशकाः स्मृताः तामसस्यान्तरे देवाः सुरा वाहरयस्तथा। सत्याश्च सुधियश्चैव सप्तविंशतिका गणा:
verses.wordMeaning: Gahga is called Tripatha (having triple paths) because it redeems human beings on the Earth, serpents in the nether- worlds and Devas in the heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gahga is called Tripatha (having triple paths) because it redeems human beings on the Earth, serpents in the nether- worlds and Devas in the heaven.

verses.sanskrit: लक्षे दिवाकरस्यापि मण्डलं शशिनः स्मृतम् । नक्षत्रमण्डलं कृत्स्नं तल्लक्षेण प्रकाशते
verses.transliteration: lakṣe divākarasyāpi maṇḍalaṃ śaśinaḥ smṛtam / nakṣatramaṇḍalaṃ kṛtsnaṃ tallakṣeṇa prakāśate
verses.translation: As long as the bones of a man lie in Gahga, he is honoured in the heavenly world for so many thousand years.®
verses.hindi: शिबिरिन्द्रस्तथैवासीच्छतयज्ञोपलक्षणः । बभूव शंकरे भक्तो महादेवार्चने रतः
verses.wordMeaning: As long as the bones of a man lie in Gahga, he is honoured in the heavenly world for so many thousand years.®
verses.commentary: Sense: As long as the bones of a man lie in Gahga, he is honoured in the heavenly world for so many thousand years.®

verses.sanskrit: द्वेलक्षे ह्युत्तरे विप्रा बुधो नक्षत्रमण्डलात् । तावत्प्रमाणभागे तु बुधस्याप्युशनाः स्थितः
verses.transliteration: dvelakṣe hyuttare viprā budho nakṣatramaṇḍalāt / tāvatpramāṇabhāge tu budhasyāpyuśanāḥ sthitaḥ
verses.translation: Gahga is the sacred-most of the sacred places. It is the holiest of holy rivers. It is the bestower of salvation for all living beings, even to the great sinners.
verses.hindi: ऋषियोंने कहा (सूतजी!) आप हमें बीते हुए तथा आनेवाले जो मन्वन्तर हैं, उन्हें (बतलाइये) और द्वापर युगके व्यासोंको भी बतलायें। सूतजी! वेदको शाखाओंका प्रणयन कैसे हुआ, धर्म (-को स्थापना) - के लिये कलियुगमें हुए देवाधिदेव बुद्धिमान् ईशान (व्यास)-के कितने अवतार हुए और कलियुगोंमें देवाधिदेव (व्यास) -के कितने शिष्य हुए--यह सब भी आप संक्षेपमें बतलायें
verses.wordMeaning: Gahga is the sacred-most of the sacred places. It is the holiest of holy rivers. It is the bestower of salvation for all living beings, even to the great sinners.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gahga is the sacred-most of the sacred places. It is the holiest of holy rivers. It is the bestower of salvation for all living beings, even to the great sinners.

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गारको ऽपि शुक्रस्य तत्प्रमाणो व्यवस्थितः । लक्षद्वयेन भौमस्य स्थितो देवपुरोहितः
verses.transliteration: aṅgārako 'pi śukrasya tatpramāṇo vyavasthitaḥ / lakṣadvayena bhaumasya sthito devapurohitaḥ
verses.translation: Gahga is easy of access everywhere but is of difficult access in three places viz. at Gahgadvara (place of source), at Prayaga and at its confluence with the ocean.*
verses.hindi: स्वारोचिष मनु हुए। पुनः उत्तम, तामस, रैवत तथा चाक्षुष मनु हुए। ये छः बीते हुए मनु हैं। इस समय सूर्यके पुत्र वैवस्वतका यह सातवाँ मन्वन्तर प्रवृत्त है। कल्पके आदिमें होनेवाले स्वायम्भुव मन्वन्तरका वर्णन
verses.wordMeaning: Gahga is easy of access everywhere but is of difficult access in three places viz. at Gahgadvara (place of source), at Prayaga and at its confluence with the ocean.*
verses.commentary: Sense: Gahga is easy of access everywhere but is of difficult access in three places viz. at Gahgadvara (place of source), at Prayaga and at its confluence with the ocean.*

verses.sanskrit: सौरिर्द्विलक्षेण गुरोर् ग्रहाणामथ मण्डलम् । सप्तर्षिमण्डलं तस्माल्लक्षमात्रे प्रिकाशते
verses.transliteration: saurirdvilakṣeṇa guror grahāṇāmatha maṇḍalam / saptarṣimaṇḍalaṃ tasmāllakṣamātre prikāśate
verses.translation: There is no goal (means of salvation) on a par with Gahga to the living beings whose minds are overwhelmed by sins and who are in search of way of deliverance from sins.
verses.hindi: मैंने किया। इसके अनन्तर स्वारोचिष मनुका वर्णन स्वारोचिष मन्वन्तरमें पारावत तथा तुषित नामके
verses.wordMeaning: There is no goal (means of salvation) on a par with Gahga to the living beings whose minds are overwhelmed by sins and who are in search of way of deliverance from sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no goal (means of salvation) on a par with Gahga to the living beings whose minds are overwhelmed by sins and who are in search of way of deliverance from sins.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषीणां मण्डलादूर्ध्वं लक्षमात्रे स्थितो ध्रुवः । मेढीभूतः समस्तस्य ज्योतिश्चक्रस्य वै ध्रुवः । तत्र धर्मः स भगवान् विष्णुर्नारायणः स्थितः
verses.transliteration: ṛṣīṇāṃ maṇḍalādūrdhvaṃ lakṣamātre sthito dhruvaḥ / meḍhībhūtaḥ samastasya jyotiścakrasya vai dhruvaḥ / tatra dharmaḥ sa bhagavān viṣṇurnārāyaṇaḥ sthitaḥ
verses.translation: It is the most sacred of all sacred things. It is the most auspicious of all auspicious things. It has fallen off from
verses.hindi: नामके देवेन्द्र हुए। ऊर्ज, स्तम्भ, प्राण, दान्त, वृषभ, तिमिर और अर्वरीवान्-ये सात सप्तर्षि हुए
verses.wordMeaning: It is the most sacred of all sacred things. It is the most auspicious of all auspicious things. It has fallen off from
verses.commentary: Sense: It is the most sacred of all sacred things. It is the most auspicious of all auspicious things. It has fallen off from

verses.sanskrit: नवयोजनसाहस्त्रो विष्कम्भः सवितुः स्मृतः । त्रिगुणस्तस्य विस्तारो मण्डलस्य प्रमाणतः
verses.transliteration: navayojanasāhastro viṣkambhaḥ savituḥ smṛtaḥ / triguṇastasya vistāro maṇḍalasya pramāṇataḥ
verses.translation: The best Tirtha in the Krta Yuga is Naimisa forest; in the Treta, the Puskara lake is the most excellent; in the Dvapara, Kuruksetra is the most excellent and in the Kali age, Gahga is of special efficacy in washing off sins.
verses.hindi: स्वारोचिषके चैत्र और किंपुरुष आदि पुत्र थे। इस प्रकार दूसरे मन्वन्तरको मैंने बतलाया, अब इसके परवर्ती (मन्वन्तर)-का वर्णन सुनिये। है विप्रो! तीसरे मन्वन्तरमें उत्तम नामके मनु और शत्रुनाशक सुशान्ति नामवाले देवेन्द्र हुए। सुधामा, सत्य, शिव, प्रतर्दन और वशवर्ती-बारह-बारह देवताओंवाले-ये पाँच गण कहे गये हैं। रज, ऊर्ध्व, ऊर्ध्वबाहु, सबल, अनय, सुतपा और शुक्र-ये सात सप्तर्षि हुए
verses.wordMeaning: The best Tirtha in the Krta Yuga is Naimisa forest; in the Treta, the Puskara lake is the most excellent; in the Dvapara, Kuruksetra is the most excellent and in the Kali age, Gahga is of special efficacy in washing off sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: The best Tirtha in the Krta Yuga is Naimisa forest; in the Treta, the Puskara lake is the most excellent; in the Dvapara, Kuruksetra is the most excellent and in the Kali age, Gahga is of special efficacy in washing off sins.

verses.sanskrit: द्विगुणस्तस्य विस्ताराद् विस्तारः शशिनः स्मृतः । तुल्यस्तयोस्तु स्वर्भानुर्भूत्वाधस्तात् प्रसर्पति
verses.transliteration: dviguṇastasya vistārād vistāraḥ śaśinaḥ smṛtaḥ / tulyastayostu svarbhānurbhūtvādhastāt prasarpati
verses.translation: People resort to Gahga alone and that too especially at Prayaga. O king, there is no other antidote for the terrible Kaliyuga ♦.
verses.hindi: तामस मन्वन्तरमें सुर, वाहरि, सत्य तथा सुधी-ये सत्ताईस-सत्ताईसकी संख्यावाले गणदेवता थे। इसी प्रकार सौ यज्ञोंको करनेवाले शिबि नामक इन्द्र थे । वे शंकरके भक्त और महादेवकी आराधनामें रत रहते थे
verses.wordMeaning: People resort to Gahga alone and that too especially at Prayaga. O king, there is no other antidote for the terrible Kaliyuga ♦.
verses.commentary: Sense: People resort to Gahga alone and that too especially at Prayaga. O king, there is no other antidote for the terrible Kaliyuga ♦.

verses.sanskrit: अद्धृत्य पृथिवीच्छायां निर्मितो मण्डलाकृतिः । स्वर्भानोस्तु वृहत् स्थानं तृतीयं यत् तमोमयम्
verses.transliteration: addhṛtya pṛthivīcchāyāṃ nirmito maṇḍalākṛtiḥ / svarbhānostu vṛhat sthānaṃ tṛtīyaṃ yat tamomayam
verses.translation: I f a man dies in Gahga whether willingly or without any desire, goes straight to Heaven and does not see hell.
verses.hindi: ज्योतिर्धर्मा पृथु: काव्यश्चैत्रोऽग्निर्वनकस्तथा। 'पीवरस्त्वृषयो होते सप्त तत्रापि चान्तरे एते देवगणास्तत्र चतुर्दश चतुर्दश
verses.wordMeaning: I f a man dies in Gahga whether willingly or without any desire, goes straight to Heaven and does not see hell.
verses.commentary: Sense: I f a man dies in Gahga whether willingly or without any desire, goes straight to Heaven and does not see hell.

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्रस्य षोडशो भागो भार्गवस्य विधीयते । भार्गवात् पादहीनस्तु विज्ञेयो वै बृहस्पतिः
verses.transliteration: candrasya ṣoḍaśo bhāgo bhārgavasya vidhīyate / bhārgavāt pādahīnastu vijñeyo vai bṛhaspatiḥ
verses.translation: For Rffamocana Tirtha Gf. Pd. P. I. 44.20.
verses.hindi: बेदबाहुः सुधामा च पर्जन्यश्च महामुनिः ।
verses.wordMeaning: For Rffamocana Tirtha Gf. Pd. P. I. 44.20.
verses.commentary: Sense: For Rffamocana Tirtha Gf. Pd. P. I. 44.20.

verses.sanskrit: बृहस्पतेः पादहीनौ वक्रसौरावुभौ स्मृतौ । विस्तारान्मण्डलाच्चैव पादहीनस्तयोर्बुधः
verses.transliteration: bṛhaspateḥ pādahīnau vakrasaurāvubhau smṛtau / vistārānmaṇḍalāccaiva pādahīnastayorbudhaḥ
verses.translation: Verbatim the same as Mt. 7. Cf. Mbh. Anusasana 25.36-37.
verses.hindi: प्रियव्रतान्वया होते चत्वारो मनवः स्मृताः मनोजवस्तथैवेन्द्रो देवानपि निबोधत
verses.wordMeaning: Verbatim the same as Mt. 7. Cf. Mbh. Anusasana 25.36-37.
verses.commentary: Sense: Verbatim the same as Mt. 7. Cf. Mbh. Anusasana 25.36-37.

verses.sanskrit: तारानक्षत्ररूपाणि वपुष्मन्तीह यानि वै । बुधेन तानि तुल्यानि विस्तारान्मण्डलात् तथा
verses.transliteration: tārānakṣatrarūpāṇi vapuṣmantīha yāni vai / budhena tāni tulyāni vistārānmaṇḍalāt tathā
verses.translation: Cf. Pd. P. I. 44.8.
verses.hindi: महानुभावा लेख्याश्च पञ्चैते ह्यष्टका गणा:
verses.wordMeaning: Cf. Pd. P. I. 44.8.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. Pd. P. I. 44.8.

verses.sanskrit: तारानक्षत्ररूपाणि हीनानि तु परस्परात् । शतानि पञ्च चत्वारि त्रीणि द्वे चैव योजने
verses.transliteration: tārānakṣatrarūpāṇi hīnāni tu parasparāt / śatāni pañca catvāri trīṇi dve caiva yojane
verses.translation: For suicide by self-immolation to cow-dung fire, this text is similar to Mt. 9, N 63.154, Pd. P. I. 44.3. Vide Prof. K.C. Chatto- padhyaya's Paper on 'Suicide at Prayaga' (Journal U.P. Hist. Society X. 65ff). The practice became outdated even before the advent of the British as Kalivarjya, vide HD. III. p , 958-59.
verses.hindi: विवस्वतः सुतो विप्राः श्राद्धदेवो महाद्युतिः । आदित्या वसवो रुद्रा देवास्तत्र मरुद्रणाः । पुरंदरस्तथैवेन्द्रो बभूव परवीरहा
verses.wordMeaning: For suicide by self-immolation to cow-dung fire, this text is similar to Mt. 9, N 63.154, Pd. P. I. 44.3. Vide Prof. K.C. Chatto- padhyaya's Paper on 'Suicide at Prayaga' (Journal U.P. Hist. Society X. 65ff).…
verses.commentary: Sense: For suicide by self-immolation to cow-dung fire, this text is similar to Mt. 9, N 63.154, Pd. P. I. 44.3. Vide Prof. K.C. Chatto- padhyaya's Paper on 'Suicide at Prayaga' (Journal U.P. Hist. Society X. 65ff).…

verses.sanskrit: सर्वावरनिकृष्टानि तारकामण्डलानि तु । योजनान्यर्धमात्राणि तेभ्यो ह्रस्वं न विद्यते
verses.transliteration: sarvāvaranikṛṣṭāni tārakāmaṇḍalāni tu / yojanānyardhamātrāṇi tebhyo hrasvaṃ na vidyate
verses.translation: After enjoying extensive pleasures, he falls off from heaven and becomes the lord of Jambudvipa. He attains the same Tirtha once again.
verses.hindi: विष्णुशक्तिरनौपम्या सत्तवोद्रिक्ता स्थिता स्थितौ । तदंशभूता राजानः सर्वे च त्रिदिबौकसः
verses.wordMeaning: After enjoying extensive pleasures, he falls off from heaven and becomes the lord of Jambudvipa. He attains the same Tirtha once again.
verses.commentary: Sense: After enjoying extensive pleasures, he falls off from heaven and becomes the lord of Jambudvipa. He attains the same Tirtha once again.

verses.sanskrit: उपरिष्टात् त्रयस्तेषां ग्रहा ये दूरसर्पिणः । सौरो ऽङ्गिराश्च वक्रश्च ज्ञेया मन्दविचारिणः
verses.transliteration: upariṣṭāt trayasteṣāṃ grahā ye dūrasarpiṇaḥ / sauro 'ṅgirāśca vakraśca jñeyā mandavicāriṇaḥ
verses.translation: If (in order to cast off his body) a person enters water at the world famous confluence (at Prayaga), he becomes liberated from all sins, as the moon devoured by Rahu becomes completely brilliant after the eclipse.
verses.hindi: रुचेः प्रजापतेर्यज्ञस्तदंशेनाभवद् द्विजाः ततः पुनरसौ देवः प्राते स्वारोचिषेऽन्तरे। तुषितायां समुत्पन्नस्तुषितैः सह हैवतैः
verses.wordMeaning: If (in order to cast off his body) a person enters water at the world famous confluence (at Prayaga), he becomes liberated from all sins, as the moon devoured by Rahu becomes completely brilliant after the eclipse.
verses.commentary: Sense: If (in order to cast off his body) a person enters water at the world famous confluence (at Prayaga), he becomes liberated from all sins, as the moon devoured by Rahu becomes completely brilliant after the eclipse.

verses.sanskrit: तेभ्यो ऽधस्ताच्च चत्वारः पुनरन्ये महाग्रहाः । सूर्यः सौमो बुधश्चैव भार्गवश्चैव शीघ्रगाः
verses.transliteration: tebhyo 'dhastācca catvāraḥ punaranye mahāgrahāḥ / sūryaḥ saumo budhaścaiva bhārgavaścaiva śīghragāḥ
verses.translation: He attains Somaloka (region of the moon) and he rejoices with Soma (the moon) for sixty-six thousand years.
verses.hindi: औत्तमेऽप्यन्तरे विष्णु: सत्यैः सह सुरोत्तमैः। सत्यायामभवत् सत्यः सत्यरूपो जनार्दनः
verses.wordMeaning: He attains Somaloka (region of the moon) and he rejoices with Soma (the moon) for sixty-six thousand years.
verses.commentary: Sense: He attains Somaloka (region of the moon) and he rejoices with Soma (the moon) for sixty-six thousand years.

verses.sanskrit: दक्षिणायनमार्गस्थो यदा चरति रश्मिमान् । तदा सर्वग्रहाणां स सूर्यो ऽधस्तात् प्रसर्पति
verses.transliteration: dakṣiṇāyanamārgastho yadā carati raśmimān / tadā sarvagrahāṇāṃ sa sūryo 'dhastāt prasarpati
verses.translation: From heaven he rejoices in Indra's world resorted to by sages and Gandharvas. O leader of kings, falling off from that place, he is born in a prosperous family.
verses.hindi: उस मन्वन्तरमें भी ज्योतिर्धर्मा, पृथु, काव्य, चैत्र, अग्नि, वनक और पीवर नामक--ये सात ऋषि हुए। विप्रेनद्रो ! पाँचवें मन्वन्तरमें रैवत नामवाले मनु और असुरोंका मर्दन करनेवाले वसु नामवाले इन्द्र हुए। अमिताभ, भूतरय, वैकुण्ठ और स्वच्छमेधा-ये चौदह-चौदहकी संख्यावाले (चार) गणदेवता थे। है विप्रो! रैवत मन्वन्तरे
verses.wordMeaning: From heaven he rejoices in Indra's world resorted to by sages and Gandharvas. O leader of kings, falling off from that place, he is born in a prosperous family.
verses.commentary: Sense: From heaven he rejoices in Indra's world resorted to by sages and Gandharvas. O leader of kings, falling off from that place, he is born in a prosperous family.

verses.sanskrit: विस्तीर्णं मण्डलं कृत्वा तस्योर्ध्वं चरते शशी । नक्षत्रमण्डलं कृत्स्नं सोमादूर्ध्वं प्रसर्पति
verses.transliteration: vistīrṇaṃ maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā tasyordhvaṃ carate śaśī / nakṣatramaṇḍalaṃ kṛtsnaṃ somādūrdhvaṃ prasarpati
verses.translation: If a man stands topsyturvy with the legs up and the head below and drinks water from the current of Ganga he is honoured in the heavenly world for seven thousand years.
verses.hindi: और महामुनि-ये सप्तर्षि हुए। स्वारोचिष, उत्तम, तामस तथा रैवत--ये चार मनु प्रियव्रतके वंशज कहे जाते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: If a man stands topsyturvy with the legs up and the head below and drinks water from the current of Ganga he is honoured in the heavenly world for seven thousand years.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a man stands topsyturvy with the legs up and the head below and drinks water from the current of Ganga he is honoured in the heavenly world for seven thousand years.

verses.sanskrit: नक्षत्रेभ्यो बुधश्चोर्ध्वं बुधादूर्ध्वं तु भार्गवः । वक्रस्तु भार्गवादूर्ध्वं वक्रादूर्ध्वं बृहस्पतिः
verses.transliteration: nakṣatrebhyo budhaścordhvaṃ budhādūrdhvaṃ tu bhārgavaḥ / vakrastu bhārgavādūrdhvaṃ vakrādūrdhvaṃ bṛhaspatiḥ
verses.translation: O leader of kings, fallen off from that place, the man becomes the performer of the rite of Agnihotra. Enjoying extensive pleasures, he resorts to that Tirtha once again.
verses.hindi: हे द्विजो ! छठे मन्वन्तरके मनु चाक्षुष हैं । इस मन्वन्तरके इन्द्रका नाम मनोजव है। (अब) देवताओंको सुनो- महानुभाव आठ-आठकी संख्यावाले देवताओंके गण हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: O leader of kings, fallen off from that place, the man becomes the performer of the rite of Agnihotra. Enjoying extensive pleasures, he resorts to that Tirtha once again.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leader of kings, fallen off from that place, the man becomes the performer of the rite of Agnihotra. Enjoying extensive pleasures, he resorts to that Tirtha once again.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माच्छनैश्चरो ऽपुयूर्ध्वं तस्मात् सप्तर्षिमण्डलम् । ऋषीणां चैव सप्तानान्ध्रु वश्चोर्ध्वं व्यवस्थितः
verses.transliteration: tasmācchanaiścaro 'puyūrdhvaṃ tasmāt saptarṣimaṇḍalam / ṛṣīṇāṃ caiva saptānāndhru vaścordhvaṃ vyavasthitaḥ
verses.hindi: सहिष्णु—ये सात कल्याणकारी ऋषि हैं
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. Mt. 27; Pd. 45.27.

verses.sanskrit: योजनानां सहस्त्राणि भास्करस्य रथो नव । ईषादण्डस्तथैव स्याद् द्विगुणो द्विजसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: yojanānāṃ sahastrāṇi bhāskarasya ratho nava / īṣādaṇḍastathaiva syād dviguṇo dvijasattamāḥ
verses.translation: Yamuna goes along the same path through which Gahga flows, glorifying the name of which thousands of Yojanas away, is destructive of sins.
verses.hindi: विप्रो! विवस्वान्के पुत्र बुद्धिमान् एवं महान् तेजस्वी श्राद्धदेव इस समय सातवें मन्वन्तरके मनु हैं । आदित्य, वसुगण, रुद्र तथा मरुद्रण इसमें देवता हैं । इसी प्रकार वीर शत्रुओंका नाश करनेवाले पुरन्दर नामवाले (इस मन्वन्तरके) इन्द्र हैं। वसिष्ठ, कश्यप, अत्रि, जमदग्नि, गौतम, विश्वामित्र तथा भरद्वाज-ये सात सप्तर्षि हैं। (इस मन्वन्तरमें) विष्णुको अनृपम सत्त्वगुणमयी शक्ति (सृष्टि)-की रक्षाके लिये स्थित है। सभी राजा और सभी देवगण इसी
verses.wordMeaning: Yamuna goes along the same path through which Gahga flows, glorifying the name of which thousands of Yojanas away, is destructive of sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Yamuna goes along the same path through which Gahga flows, glorifying the name of which thousands of Yojanas away, is destructive of sins.

verses.sanskrit: सार्धकोटिस्तथा सप्त नियुतान्यधिकानि तु । योजनानां तु तस्याक्षस्तत्र चक्रं प्रतिष्ठितम्
verses.transliteration: sārdhakoṭistathā sapta niyutānyadhikāni tu / yojanānāṃ tu tasyākṣastatra cakraṃ pratiṣṭhitam
verses.translation: There is no doubt in this that a pure person who takes his bath there on the fourteenth day in the dark half of the lunar month and propitiates Dharmaraja, becomes free from great sins.
verses.hindi: (विष्णुशक्ति)-के अंशसे उत्पन्न हैं। द्विजो! स्वायम्भुव मन्वन्तरमें सर्वप्रथम प्रजापति रुचिका आकूति (नामक पत्ली)-से यज्ञ नामक मानस पुत्र हुआ, यह विष्णुका अंश था। तदनन्तर पुनः वे ही देव (विष्णु) स्वारोचिष
verses.wordMeaning: There is no doubt in this that a pure person who takes his bath there on the fourteenth day in the dark half of the lunar month and propitiates Dharmaraja, becomes free from great sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no doubt in this that a pure person who takes his bath there on the fourteenth day in the dark half of the lunar month and propitiates Dharmaraja, becomes free from great sins.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिनाभिमति पञ्चारे षष्णेमिन्यक्षयात्मके । संवत्सरमेय कृत्स्नं कालचक्रं प्रतिष्ठितम्
verses.transliteration: trinābhimati pañcāre ṣaṣṇeminyakṣayātmake / saṃvatsarameya kṛtsnaṃ kālacakraṃ pratiṣṭhitam
verses.translation: The learned men have proclaimed thus that there are ten thousand holy places and there are ten crores of other sacred spots also abiding in Prayaga.
verses.hindi: मन्वन्तरके आनेपर तुषितासे तुषित नामके देवताओंके साथ उत्पन्न हुए॥ २३--२८ ॥ औत्तम मन्वन्तरमें सत्यरूप जनार्दन विष्णु सत्य नामक श्रेष्ठ देवताओंके साथ सत्य नामधारी सत्यासे उत्पन्न हुए और तामस नामक मन्वन्तर आनेपर साक्षात् ये हरि ही हरि नामक देवताओंके साथ हर्यासे
verses.wordMeaning: The learned men have proclaimed thus that there are ten thousand holy places and there are ten crores of other sacred spots also abiding in Prayaga.
verses.commentary: Sense: The learned men have proclaimed thus that there are ten thousand holy places and there are ten crores of other sacred spots also abiding in Prayaga.

verses.sanskrit: चत्कारिंशत् सहस्त्राणि द्वितीयो ऽक्षो विवस्वतः । पञ्चान्यानि तु सार्धानि स्यन्दनस्य द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: catkāriṃśat sahastrāṇi dvitīyo 'kṣo vivasvataḥ / pañcānyāni tu sārdhāni syandanasya dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: Vayu has mentioned of three and a half crores of Tirthas in heaven, in the firmament and on the Earth. Gahga is stated to be on par with all these.
verses.hindi: हरि इस नामसे उत्पन्न हुए
verses.wordMeaning: Vayu has mentioned of three and a half crores of Tirthas in heaven, in the firmament and on the Earth. Gahga is stated to be on par with all these.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vayu has mentioned of three and a half crores of Tirthas in heaven, in the firmament and on the Earth. Gahga is stated to be on par with all these.

verses.sanskrit: अक्षप्रमाणमुभयोः प्रमाणं तद्युगार्धयोः । ह्रस्वो ऽक्षस्तद्युगार्धेन ध्रुवाधारे रथस्य तु
verses.transliteration: akṣapramāṇamubhayoḥ pramāṇaṃ tadyugārdhayoḥ / hrasvo 'kṣastadyugārdhena dhruvādhāre rathasya tu
verses.translation: The region through which the highly blessed Gahga flows is itself a penance-grove, the tract of land which resorts to the banks of Gahga is known as Siddhi-ksetra.
verses.hindi: सम्भूतो मानसैः सार्ध देवैः सह महाद्युतिः विकुण्ठायामसौ जज्ञे वैकुण्ठैहैवतैः सह
verses.wordMeaning: The region through which the highly blessed Gahga flows is itself a penance-grove, the tract of land which resorts to the banks of Gahga is known as Siddhi-ksetra.
verses.commentary: Sense: The region through which the highly blessed Gahga flows is itself a penance-grove, the tract of land which resorts to the banks of Gahga is known as Siddhi-ksetra.

verses.sanskrit: द्वितीये ऽक्षे तु तच्चक्रं संस्थितं मानसाचले । हयाश्च सप्त छन्दांसि तन्नामानि निबोधत
verses.transliteration: dvitīye 'kṣe tu taccakraṃ saṃsthitaṃ mānasācale / hayāśca sapta chandāṃsi tannāmāni nibodhata
verses.translation: That is a holy place, that is the penance-grove, where god Mahesvara, Mahadeva, the overlord of Devas resides alongwith Madhava.
verses.hindi: वामनः कश्यपाद् विष्णुरदित्यां सम्बभूव ह
verses.wordMeaning: That is a holy place, that is the penance-grove, where god Mahesvara, Mahadeva, the overlord of Devas resides alongwith Madhava.
verses.commentary: Sense: That is a holy place, that is the penance-grove, where god Mahesvara, Mahadeva, the overlord of Devas resides alongwith Madhava.

verses.sanskrit: गायत्री च बृहत्युष्णिक् जगती पङ्क्तिरेव च । अनष्टुप् त्रिष्टुबित्युक्ताश्छन्दांसि हरयो हरेः
verses.transliteration: gāyatrī ca bṛhatyuṣṇik jagatī paṅktireva ca / anaṣṭup triṣṭubityuktāśchandāṃsi harayo hareḥ
verses.translation: This truth has to be repeatedly communicated into the ears of twice-borns, of good men, of the son, of the friends as well as into the ears of the closely following (i.e. devoted) disciple:
verses.hindi: त्रिभिः क्रमैरिमाँल्लोकाञ्जित्वा येन महात्मना। पुरन्दराय त्रैलोक्यं दत्तं निहतकण्टकम् तस्मात् स वै स्मृतो विष्णुर्विशेर्धातोः प्रवेशनात् ३६॥
verses.wordMeaning: This truth has to be repeatedly communicated into the ears of twice-borns, of good men, of the son, of the friends as well as into the ears of the closely following (i.e. devoted) disciple:
verses.commentary: Sense: This truth has to be repeatedly communicated into the ears of twice-borns, of good men, of the son, of the friends as well as into the ears of the closely following (i.e. devoted) disciple:

verses.sanskrit: मानसोपरि माहेन्द्री प्राच्यां दिशि महापुरी । दक्षिणे न यमस्याथ वरुणस्य तु पश्चिमे
verses.transliteration: mānasopari māhendrī prācyāṃ diśi mahāpurī / dakṣiṇe na yamasyātha varuṇasya tu paścime
verses.translation: This truth has to be repeatedly communicated into the ears of twice-borns, of good men, of the son, of the friends as well as into the ears of the closely following (i.e. devoted) disciple:
verses.hindi: एष सर्व सृजत्यादौ पाति हन्ति च केशवः। भूतान्तरात्मा भगवान् नारायण इति श्रुतिः
verses.wordMeaning: This truth has to be repeatedly communicated into the ears of twice-borns, of good men, of the son, of the friends as well as into the ears of the closely following (i.e. devoted) disciple:
verses.commentary: Sense: This truth has to be repeatedly communicated into the ears of twice-borns, of good men, of the son, of the friends as well as into the ears of the closely following (i.e. devoted) disciple:

verses.sanskrit: उत्तरेण तु सोमस्य तन्नामानि निबोधत । अमरावती संयमनी सुखा चैव विभा क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: uttareṇa tu somasya tannāmāni nibodhata / amarāvatī saṃyamanī sukhā caiva vibhā kramāt
verses.translation: This truth has to be repeatedly communicated into the ears of twice-borns, of good men, of the son, of the friends as well as into the ears of the closely following (i.e. devoted) disciple:
verses.hindi: एकांशेन जगत् सर्व व्याप्य नारायणः स्थितः। चतुर्धा संस्थितो व्यापी सगुणो निर्गुणोऽपि च एका भगवतो मूर्तिज्ञानरूपा शिवामला। वासुदेवाभिधाना सा गुणातीता सुनिष्कला
verses.wordMeaning: This truth has to be repeatedly communicated into the ears of twice-borns, of good men, of the son, of the friends as well as into the ears of the closely following (i.e. devoted) disciple:
verses.commentary: Sense: This truth has to be repeatedly communicated into the ears of twice-borns, of good men, of the son, of the friends as well as into the ears of the closely following (i.e. devoted) disciple:

verses.sanskrit: काष्ठां गतो दक्षिणतः क्षिप्तेषुरिव सर्पति । ज्योतिषां चक्रमादाय देवदेवः प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: kāṣṭhāṃ gato dakṣiṇataḥ kṣipteṣuriva sarpati / jyotiṣāṃ cakramādāya devadevaḥ prajāpatiḥ
verses.translation: This truth has to be repeatedly communicated into the ears of twice-borns, of good men, of the son, of the friends as well as into the ears of the closely following (i.e. devoted) disciple:
verses.hindi: द्वितीया कालसंज्ञान्या तामसी शेषसंज्ञिता। निहन्ति सकलं चान्ते वैष्णवी परमा तनुः
verses.wordMeaning: This truth has to be repeatedly communicated into the ears of twice-borns, of good men, of the son, of the friends as well as into the ears of the closely following (i.e. devoted) disciple:
verses.commentary: Sense: This truth has to be repeatedly communicated into the ears of twice-borns, of good men, of the son, of the friends as well as into the ears of the closely following (i.e. devoted) disciple:

verses.sanskrit: दिवसस्य रविर्मध्ये सर्वकालं व्यवस्थितः । सप्तद्वीपेषु विप्रेन्द्रा निशामध्यस्य संमुखम्
verses.transliteration: divasasya ravirmadhye sarvakālaṃ vyavasthitaḥ / saptadvīpeṣu viprendrā niśāmadhyasya saṃmukham
verses.translation: This truth has to be repeatedly communicated into the ears of twice-borns, of good men, of the son, of the friends as well as into the ears of the closely following (i.e. devoted) disciple:
verses.hindi: जगत् स्थापयते सर्व स विष्णुः प्रकृतिर्थुवा चतुर्थी वासुदेवस्य मूर्तिर्ब्राह्मीति संज्ञिता राजसी चानिरुद्धाख्या प्रद्युम्नः सृष्टिकारिका
verses.wordMeaning: This truth has to be repeatedly communicated into the ears of twice-borns, of good men, of the son, of the friends as well as into the ears of the closely following (i.e. devoted) disciple:
verses.commentary: Sense: This truth has to be repeatedly communicated into the ears of twice-borns, of good men, of the son, of the friends as well as into the ears of the closely following (i.e. devoted) disciple:

verses.sanskrit: उदयास्तमने चैव सर्वकालं तु संमुखे । अशेषासु दिशास्वेव तथैव विदिशासु च
verses.transliteration: udayāstamane caiva sarvakālaṃ tu saṃmukhe / aśeṣāsu diśāsveva tathaiva vidiśāsu ca
verses.translation: This truth has to be repeatedly communicated into the ears of twice-borns, of good men, of the son, of the friends as well as into the ears of the closely following (i.e. devoted) disciple:
verses.hindi: नारायणाख्यो ब्रह्माऽसौ प्रजासर्गं करोति सः
verses.wordMeaning: This truth has to be repeatedly communicated into the ears of twice-borns, of good men, of the son, of the friends as well as into the ears of the closely following (i.e. devoted) disciple:
verses.commentary: Sense: This truth has to be repeatedly communicated into the ears of twice-borns, of good men, of the son, of the friends as well as into the ears of the closely following (i.e. devoted) disciple:

verses.sanskrit: कुलालचक्रपर्यन्तो भ्रमन्नेष यथेश्वरः । करोत्यहस्तथा रात्रिं विमुञ्चन् मेदिनीं द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: kulālacakraparyanto bhramanneṣa yatheśvaraḥ / karotyahastathā rātriṃ vimuñcan medinīṃ dvijāḥ
verses.translation: This truth has to be repeatedly communicated into the ears of twice-borns, of good men, of the son, of the friends as well as into the ears of the closely following (i.e. devoted) disciple:
verses.hindi: या सा नारायणतनुः प्रद्युम्नाख्या मुनीश्वराः । तया सम्मोहयेद् विश्वं सदेवासुरमानुषम् रेवत मन्वन्तरमें भी मानस नामक देवताओंके साथ महान् द्युतिमान् हरि सम्भूतिसे मानस नामसे उत्पन्न हुए । चाक्षुष मन्वन्तरमें भी वे पुरुषोत्तम वैकुण्ठ नामक देवताओंके साथ विकुण्ठासे वैकुण्ठ नामसे उत्पन्न हुए और वैवस्वत
verses.wordMeaning: This truth has to be repeatedly communicated into the ears of twice-borns, of good men, of the son, of the friends as well as into the ears of the closely following (i.e. devoted) disciple:
verses.commentary: Sense: This truth has to be repeatedly communicated into the ears of twice-borns, of good men, of the son, of the friends as well as into the ears of the closely following (i.e. devoted) disciple:

verses.sanskrit: दिवाकरकरैरेतत् पूरितं भुवनत्रयम् । त्रैलोक्यं कथितं सद्भिर्लोकानां मुनिपुङ्गवाः
verses.transliteration: divākarakarairetat pūritaṃ bhuvanatrayam / trailokyaṃ kathitaṃ sadbhirlokānāṃ munipuṅgavāḥ
verses.translation: This truth has to be repeatedly communicated into the ears of twice-borns, of good men, of the son, of the friends as well as into the ears of the closely following (i.e. devoted) disciple:
verses.hindi: नामक मन्वन्तर आनेपर वे विष्णु कश्यप और अदितिसे वामन नामसे उत्पन्न हुए। इन्हीं महात्माने अपने तीन पगोंसे समस्त लोकोंको जीतकर पुरन्दर इन्द्रको निष्कण्टक त्रैलोक्य (-का राज्य) प्रदान किया
verses.wordMeaning: This truth has to be repeatedly communicated into the ears of twice-borns, of good men, of the son, of the friends as well as into the ears of the closely following (i.e. devoted) disciple:
verses.commentary: Sense: This truth has to be repeatedly communicated into the ears of twice-borns, of good men, of the son, of the friends as well as into the ears of the closely following (i.e. devoted) disciple:

verses.sanskrit: आदित्यमूलमखिलं त्रिलोकं नात्र संशयः । भवत्यस्मात् जगत् कृत्स्नं सदेवासुरमानुषम्
verses.transliteration: ādityamūlamakhilaṃ trilokaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ / bhavatyasmāt jagat kṛtsnaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣam
verses.translation: This truth has to be repeatedly communicated into the ears of twice-borns, of good men, of the son, of the friends as well as into the ears of the closely following (i.e. devoted) disciple:
verses.hindi: हे विप्रो! सात मन्वन्तरोंमें ये ही सात उन (विष्णु)- के विग्रह हुए, जिनसे प्रजाओंकी रक्षा हुई! महात्मा वामनने इस सम्पूर्ण विश्वको व्याप्त किया था, इसीलिये “विश्' धातुका प्रवेश अर्थ होनेके कारण वे (वामन) विष्णु कहलाये। ये केशव प्रारम्भमें समस्त प्रपञ्चकी सृष्टि करते हैं, उसकी रक्षा करते हैं और (अन्तमें) उसका संहार करते हैं । भगवान् नारायण सभी प्राणियोंकी अन्तरात्मा हैँ-एऐसा वेदका कथन है
verses.wordMeaning: This truth has to be repeatedly communicated into the ears of twice-borns, of good men, of the son, of the friends as well as into the ears of the closely following (i.e. devoted) disciple:
verses.commentary: Sense: This truth has to be repeatedly communicated into the ears of twice-borns, of good men, of the son, of the friends as well as into the ears of the closely following (i.e. devoted) disciple:

verses.sanskrit: रुद्रेन्द्रोपेन्द्रचन्द्राणां विप्रेन्द्राणां दिवौकसाम् । द्युतिर्द्युतिमतां कृत्स्नं यत्तेजः सार्वलौकिकम्
verses.transliteration: rudrendropendracandrāṇāṃ viprendrāṇāṃ divaukasām / dyutirdyutimatāṃ kṛtsnaṃ yattejaḥ sārvalaukikam
verses.translation: This truth has to be repeatedly communicated into the ears of twice-borns, of good men, of the son, of the friends as well as into the ears of the closely following (i.e. devoted) disciple:
verses.hindi: ये नारायण अपने एक अंशसे सम्पूर्ण संसारको व्याप्तकर प्रतिष्ठित रहते हैं। ये निर्गुण होते हुए भी सगुण रूपसे चार भागोंमें विभक्त होकर सर्वत्र व्याप्त रहनेवाले हैं। (ये ही चार भाग भगवान् नारायणकी चार मूर्तियाँ
verses.wordMeaning: This truth has to be repeatedly communicated into the ears of twice-borns, of good men, of the son, of the friends as well as into the ears of the closely following (i.e. devoted) disciple:
verses.commentary: Sense: This truth has to be repeatedly communicated into the ears of twice-borns, of good men, of the son, of the friends as well as into the ears of the closely following (i.e. devoted) disciple:

verses.sanskrit: सर्वात्मा सर्वलोकेशो महादेवः प्रजापतिः । सूर्य एव त्रिलोकस्य मूलं परमदैवतम्
verses.transliteration: sarvātmā sarvalokeśo mahādevaḥ prajāpatiḥ / sūrya eva trilokasya mūlaṃ paramadaivatam
verses.translation: This truth has to be repeatedly communicated into the ears of twice-borns, of good men, of the son, of the friends as well as into the ears of the closely following (i.e. devoted) disciple:
verses.hindi: हैं। इनमें) भगवानूको वासुदेव नामवाली पहली मूर्ति ज्ञानरूप, कल्याणकारिणी, निर्मल, गुणातीत और कलारहित है। दूसरी काल और शेष नामवाली वह तामसी मूर्ति विष्णुकी परम विग्रहरूपा मूर्ति है। यही अन्तमें सबका संहार करती है। इसी प्रकार सत्त्वगुणमयी प्रद्युम्न नामवाली अन्य (तीसरी) मूर्ति सम्पूर्ण जगतूकी स्थापना (पालन) करती है, यही विष्णुकी धुवा प्रकृति है। इन तीनों मूर्तियोंके अतिरिक्त वासुदेवकी ब्राह्मी तथा अनिरुद्ध
verses.wordMeaning: This truth has to be repeatedly communicated into the ears of twice-borns, of good men, of the son, of the friends as well as into the ears of the closely following (i.e. devoted) disciple:
verses.commentary: Sense: This truth has to be repeatedly communicated into the ears of twice-borns, of good men, of the son, of the friends as well as into the ears of the closely following (i.e. devoted) disciple:

verses.sanskrit: द्वादशान्ये तथादित्या देवास्ते ये ऽधिकारिणः । निर्वहन्ति पदं तस्य तदंशा विष्णुमूर्तयः
verses.transliteration: dvādaśānye tathādityā devāste ye 'dhikāriṇaḥ / nirvahanti padaṃ tasya tadaṃśā viṣṇumūrtayaḥ
verses.translation: This truth has to be repeatedly communicated into the ears of twice-borns, of good men, of the son, of the friends as well as into the ears of the closely following (i.e. devoted) disciple:
verses.hindi: नामवाली चौथी राजसी मूर्ति है, यह प्रद्युम्न नामक मूर्ति सृष्टि करनेवाली है
verses.wordMeaning: This truth has to be repeatedly communicated into the ears of twice-borns, of good men, of the son, of the friends as well as into the ears of the closely following (i.e. devoted) disciple:
verses.commentary: Sense: This truth has to be repeatedly communicated into the ears of twice-borns, of good men, of the son, of the friends as well as into the ears of the closely following (i.e. devoted) disciple:

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे नमस्यन्ति सहस्त्रभानुं गन्धर्वदेवोरगकिन्वन्नराद्याः । यजन्ति यज्ञैर्विविधैर्द्विजेन्द्रा- श्छन्दोमयं ब्रह्ममयं पुराणम्
verses.transliteration: sarve namasyanti sahastrabhānuṃ gandharvadevoragakinvannarādyāḥ / yajanti yajñairvividhairdvijendrā- śchandomayaṃ brahmamayaṃ purāṇam
verses.translation: This truth has to be repeatedly communicated into the ears of twice-borns, of good men, of the son, of the friends as well as into the ears of the closely following (i.e. devoted) disciple:
verses.hindi: जो प्रभु सम्पूर्ण (सृष्टि)-के रूपमें होकर प्रद्युम्नके साथ शयन करते हैं, नारायण नामवाले वे ही ब्रह्मा प्रजाकी सृष्टि करते हैं। मुनीश्वरो! वह जो प्रद्युम्न नामवाली नारायणकी मूर्ति है, उसके द्वारा वे (नारायण) देवता, असुर तथा मनुष्यासे युक्त विश्वको मोहित करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: This truth has to be repeatedly communicated into the ears of twice-borns, of good men, of the son, of the friends as well as into the ears of the closely following (i.e. devoted) disciple:
verses.commentary: Sense: This truth has to be repeatedly communicated into the ears of twice-borns, of good men, of the son, of the friends as well as into the ears of the closely following (i.e. devoted) disciple:

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितार्या पूर्वविभागे एकोनचत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः सूत उवाच स रथो ऽधिष्ठितो देवैरादित्यैर्वसुभिस्तथा । गन्धर्वैरप्सरोभिश्च ग्रामणीसर्पराक्षसैः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāryā pūrvavibhāge ekonacatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca sa ratho 'dhiṣṭhito devairādityairvasubhistathā / gandharvairapsarobhiśca grāmaṇīsarparākṣasaiḥ
verses.translation: "This {Tirtha) is blissful or conducive to wealth and attainment of heaven; it is pure, meritorious, beautiful, sacred, excellent and it heightens piety.
verses.hindi: सैब सर्वजगत्सूतिः प्रकृतिः परिकीर्तिता। वासुदेवो ह्यनन्तात्मा केवलो निर्गुणो हरिः
verses.wordMeaning: "This {Tirtha) is blissful or conducive to wealth and attainment of heaven; it is pure, meritorious, beautiful, sacred, excellent and it heightens piety.
verses.commentary: Sense: "This {Tirtha) is blissful or conducive to wealth and attainment of heaven; it is pure, meritorious, beautiful, sacred, excellent and it heightens piety.

verses.sanskrit: धातार्ऽयमाथ मित्रश्च वरुणः शक्र एव च । विवस्वानथ पूषा च पर्जन्यश्चांशुरेव च
verses.transliteration: dhātār'yamātha mitraśca varuṇaḥ śakra eva ca / vivasvānatha pūṣā ca parjanyaścāṃśureva ca
verses.translation: This is destructive of all sins; this is a great secret of the great sages. A Brahmana who pursues his self-study of the Vedas here shall attain purity.
verses.hindi: प्रधानं पुरुषं कालस्तत्त्वत्रयमनुत्तमम्। वासुदेवात्मकं नित्यमेतद् विज्ञाय मुच्यते बिभेद वासुदेवोऽसौ प्रद्युम्नो हरिरव्ययः
verses.wordMeaning: This is destructive of all sins; this is a great secret of the great sages. A Brahmana who pursues his self-study of the Vedas here shall attain purity.
verses.commentary: Sense: This is destructive of all sins; this is a great secret of the great sages. A Brahmana who pursues his self-study of the Vedas here shall attain purity.

verses.sanskrit: भगस्त्वष्टा च विष्णुश्च द्वादशैते दिवाकराः । आप्यायन्ति वै भानुं वसन्तादिषु वै क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: bhagastvaṣṭā ca viṣṇuśca dvādaśaite divākarāḥ / āpyāyanti vai bhānuṃ vasantādiṣu vai kramāt
verses.translation: The pure man who always listens to this holy centre of great merit, always derives ability to recollect previous birth. He rejoices in heaven.
verses.hindi: कृष्णद्वैपायनो व्यासो विष्णुर्नारायणः स्वयम्। अपान्तरतमाः पूर्व स्वेच्छया ह्यभवद्धरिः
verses.wordMeaning: The pure man who always listens to this holy centre of great merit, always derives ability to recollect previous birth. He rejoices in heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: The pure man who always listens to this holy centre of great merit, always derives ability to recollect previous birth. He rejoices in heaven.

verses.sanskrit: पुलस्त्यः पुलहश्चात्रिर्वसिष्ठश्चाङ्गिरा भृगुः । भरद्वाजो गौतमश्च कश्यपः क्रतुरेव च
verses.transliteration: pulastyaḥ pulahaścātrirvasiṣṭhaścāṅgirā bhṛguḥ / bharadvājo gautamaśca kaśyapaḥ kratureva ca
verses.translation: Those Tirtkas are attained by good men, who guide disciplined persons. O scion of the family of Kurus, perform ablution in the Tirthas. Do not be of crooked intellect."
verses.hindi: अनाद्यन्तं परं ब्रह्म न देवा नर्षयो विदुः। एकोऽयं वेद भगवान् व्यासो नारायणः प्रभु: इत्येतद् विष्णुमाहात्म्यमुक्तं वो मुनिपुंगवाः । एतत् सत्यं पुनः सत्यमेवं ज्ञात्वा न न मुहाति
verses.wordMeaning: Those Tirtkas are attained by good men, who guide disciplined persons. O scion of the family of Kurus, perform ablution in the Tirthas. Do not be of crooked intellect."
verses.commentary: Sense: Those Tirtkas are attained by good men, who guide disciplined persons. O scion of the family of Kurus, perform ablution in the Tirthas. Do not be of crooked intellect."

verses.sanskrit: जमदग्निः कौशिकश्च मुनयो ब्रह्मवादिनः । स्तुवन्ति देवं विविधैश्छन्दोभिस्ते यथाक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: jamadagniḥ kauśikaśca munayo brahmavādinaḥ / stuvanti devaṃ vividhaiśchandobhiste yathākramam
verses.translation: After saying thus, the holy and great sage Markandeya recounted to him the Tirthas that are on the earth.
verses.hindi: वही सम्पूर्ण संसारको उत्पन्न करनेवाली प्रकृति कहे गये हैं। अनन्तात्मा वासुदेव हरि अद्वितीय एवं निर्गुण हैं। प्रधान, पुरुष और काल--ये श्रेष्ठ तीन तत्त्व नित्य वासुदेवमय हैं। इनको जान लेनेपर मुक्ति
verses.wordMeaning: After saying thus, the holy and great sage Markandeya recounted to him the Tirthas that are on the earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying thus, the holy and great sage Markandeya recounted to him the Tirthas that are on the earth.

verses.sanskrit: रथकृच्च रथौज्श्च रथचित्रः सुबाहुकः । रथस्वनो ऽथ वरुणः सुषेणः सेनजित् तथा
verses.transliteration: rathakṛcca rathaujśca rathacitraḥ subāhukaḥ / rathasvano 'tha varuṇaḥ suṣeṇaḥ senajit tathā
verses.translation: He who gets up early in the morning, listens to or recites this is released from all sins. He goes to Rudraloka.
verses.hindi: उन अच्युत वासुदेव नामक प्रद्युम्न अव्यय हरिने चतुष्पादात्मक एक वेदको चार भागोंमें विभक्त किया। पूर्वकालमें स्वयं अपान्तरतमा नारायण हरि विष्णु ही स्वेच्छासे कृष्णद्वैपायन व्यास हुए। आदि और अन्तरहित परम ब्रह्मको न तो देवता जानते हैं और न ऋषि ही, एकमात्र प्रभु नारायणरूप ये भगवान् व्यास ही उन्हे जानते हैं॥ ४७--४९ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: He who gets up early in the morning, listens to or recites this is released from all sins. He goes to Rudraloka.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who gets up early in the morning, listens to or recites this is released from all sins. He goes to Rudraloka.

verses.sanskrit: तार्क्ष्यश्चारिष्टनेमिश्च रथजित् सत्यजित् तथा । ग्रामण्यो देवदेवस्य कुर्वते ऽभीशुसंग्रहम्
verses.transliteration: tārkṣyaścāriṣṭanemiśca rathajit satyajit tathā / grāmaṇyo devadevasya kurvate 'bhīśusaṃgraham
verses.translation: Babha is the first Tirthankara of Jainas. Puranas try to assimilate even non-Vedic sects such as Pahcaratra, Pasupata, Jainism, Buddhism and others and try to create one homogeneous Indian society out of diverse elements, faiths and sects.
verses.hindi: हे मुनिश्रेष्ठो! मैंने आप लोगोंको यह विष्णुका माहात्म्य बतलाया, यह सत्य है, पुनः सत्य है, ऐसा जाननेसे मोह नहीं होता
verses.wordMeaning: Babha is the first Tirthankara of Jainas. Puranas try to assimilate even non-Vedic sects such as Pahcaratra, Pasupata, Jainism, Buddhism and others and try to create one homogeneous Indian society out of diverse elements, faiths and sects.
verses.commentary: Sense: Babha is the first Tirthankara of Jainas. Puranas try to assimilate even non-Vedic sects such as Pahcaratra, Pasupata, Jainism, Buddhism and others and try to create one homogeneous Indian society out of diverse elements, faiths and sects.

verses.sanskrit: अथ हेतिः प्रहेतिश्च पौरुषेयो वधस्तथा । सर्पो व्याघ्रस्तथापश्च वातो विद्युद् दिवाकरः
verses.transliteration: atha hetiḥ prahetiśca pauruṣeyo vadhastathā / sarpo vyāghrastathāpaśca vāto vidyud divākaraḥ
verses.translation: The auspicious creation of the Svayambhuva Manu has been recounted by you. Now we wish to hear about the spheres of the three worlds.
verses.hindi: अद्ठाईस व्यासोंका वर्णन, अट्टाईसवें कृष्णद्वैपायनद्वारा वेदसंहिताका विभाजन तथा पुराणेतिहासकी रचना, वेदको शाखाओंका विस्तार तथा विष्णुके माहात्म्यका कथन बिभेद बहुधा वेदं नियोगाद् ब्रह्मणः प्रभोः । द्वितीये द्वापरे चैव वेदव्यासः प्रजापतिः
verses.wordMeaning: The auspicious creation of the Svayambhuva Manu has been recounted by you. Now we wish to hear about the spheres of the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: The auspicious creation of the Svayambhuva Manu has been recounted by you. Now we wish to hear about the spheres of the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मोपेतश्च विप्रेन्द्रा यज्ञोपेतस्तथैव च । राक्षसप्रवरा ह्येते प्रयान्ति पुरतः क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: brahmopetaśca viprendrā yajñopetastathaiva ca / rākṣasapravarā hyete prayānti purataḥ kramāt
verses.translation: After making obeisance to Visnu, the mighty, incom¬ prehensible, overlord of Devas, I shall report to you what has been formerly narrated by that intelligent one.
verses.hindi: सविता पञ्चमे व्यासः षष्ठे मृत्युः प्रकीर्तितः
verses.wordMeaning: After making obeisance to Visnu, the mighty, incom¬ prehensible, overlord of Devas, I shall report to you what has been formerly narrated by that intelligent one.
verses.commentary: Sense: After making obeisance to Visnu, the mighty, incom¬ prehensible, overlord of Devas, I shall report to you what has been formerly narrated by that intelligent one.

verses.sanskrit: वासुकिः कङ्कनीरश्च तक्षकः सर्पपुङ्गवः । एलापत्रः शङ्खपालस्तथैरावतसंज्ञितः
verses.transliteration: vāsukiḥ kaṅkanīraśca takṣakaḥ sarpapuṅgavaḥ / elāpatraḥ śaṅkhapālastathairāvatasaṃjñitaḥ
verses.translation: Priyavrata who has been mentioned before as the son of Svayambhuva Manu had ten sons who were on par with Prajapatis.
verses.hindi: एकादशे तु त्रिवृषः शततेजास्ततः परः। त्रयोदशे तथा धर्मस्तरक्षुस्तु चतुर्दशे सूतजी बोले--इस वर्तमान मन्वन्तरके प्रारम्भिक प्रथम द्वापरमें महान् विभु स्वायम्भुव मनुको व्यास माना गया है। प्रभु ब्रह्माकी आज्ञासे उन्होंने वेदका अनेक प्रकारसे विभाजन किया। दूसरे द्वापरमें प्रजापति वेदव्यास
verses.wordMeaning: Priyavrata who has been mentioned before as the son of Svayambhuva Manu had ten sons who were on par with Prajapatis.
verses.commentary: Sense: Priyavrata who has been mentioned before as the son of Svayambhuva Manu had ten sons who were on par with Prajapatis.

verses.sanskrit: धनञ्जयो महापद्मस्तथा कर्कोटको द्विजाः । कम्बलाश्वतरश्चैव वहन्त्येनं यथाक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: dhanañjayo mahāpadmastathā karkoṭako dvijāḥ / kambalāśvataraścaiva vahantyenaṃ yathākramam
verses.translation: The three sons viz. Medha, Agnibahu and Putra were devoted to Yoga. Those highly blessed ones, who were capable of remembering their previous births, did not feel inclined to rule over the kingdom.
verses.hindi: हुए। तीसरेमें शुक्राचार्य व्यास हुए और चौथेमें बृहस्पति (व्यास) हुए। पाँचवेंमें सूर्य व्यास हुए और छठेमे मृत्युको व्यास कहा गया है। इसी प्रकार सातवेंमें इन्द्र और आठवेंमें वसिष्ठ (व्यास) माने गये हैं। नवेंमें
verses.wordMeaning: The three sons viz. Medha, Agnibahu and Putra were devoted to Yoga. Those highly blessed ones, who were capable of remembering their previous births, did not feel inclined to rule over the kingdom.
verses.commentary: Sense: The three sons viz. Medha, Agnibahu and Putra were devoted to Yoga. Those highly blessed ones, who were capable of remembering their previous births, did not feel inclined to rule over the kingdom.

verses.sanskrit: तुम्बुरुर्नारदो हाहा हूहूर्विश्वावसुस्तथा । उग्रसेनो वसुरुचिरर्वावसुरथापरः
verses.transliteration: tumbururnārado hāhā hūhūrviśvāvasustathā / ugraseno vasurucirarvāvasurathāparaḥ
verses.translation: King Priyavrata crowned the other seven sons to rule over the seven continents. He made his son Agnidhra the ruler of Jambudvipa.
verses.hindi: सारस्वत तथा दसवेंमें त्रिधामा (व्यास) माने गये हें । ग्यारहवेंमें त्रिवृष तदनन्तर (बारहबेंमें) शततेजा, तेरहवेंमें धर्म और चौदहवेंमें तरक्षु (व्यास) कहे गये हैं  अपान्तरतमा-यह आर्पप्रयोग ' अप्=जलके अन्तरतम अर्थात् जलके अन्तस्तलमें शयन करनेवालेके' अर्थमें हो सकता है। यदि ' अपारान्ततमा' पाठ हो तो जिनका अन्ततम=सर्वान्तिम शेष अपार है- अगम्य है--यह अर्थ मानकर प्रस्तुत प्रसंग समञ्जस हो
verses.wordMeaning: King Priyavrata crowned the other seven sons to rule over the seven continents. He made his son Agnidhra the ruler of Jambudvipa.
verses.commentary: Sense: King Priyavrata crowned the other seven sons to rule over the seven continents. He made his son Agnidhra the ruler of Jambudvipa.

verses.sanskrit: चित्रसेनस्तथोर्णायुर्धृतराष्ट्रो द्विजोत्तमाः । सूर्यवर्चा द्वादशैते गन्धर्वा गायतां वराः । गायन्ति विविधैर्गानैर्भानुं षड्जादिभिः क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: citrasenastathorṇāyurdhṛtarāṣṭro dvijottamāḥ / sūryavarcā dvādaśaite gandharvā gāyatāṃ varāḥ / gāyanti vividhairgānairbhānuṃ ṣaḍjādibhiḥ kramāt
verses.translation: Medhatithi was made the ruler of Plaksadvipa by him. He crowned Vapusman as the ruler of Salmalidvipa.
verses.hindi: सप्तविंशे तथा व्यासो जातूकर्णो महामुनिः ।
verses.wordMeaning: Medhatithi was made the ruler of Plaksadvipa by him. He crowned Vapusman as the ruler of Salmalidvipa.
verses.commentary: Sense: Medhatithi was made the ruler of Plaksadvipa by him. He crowned Vapusman as the ruler of Salmalidvipa.

verses.sanskrit: क्रतुस्थलाप्सरोवर्या तथान्या पुञ्जिकस्थला । मेनका सहजन्या च प्रम्लोचा च द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: kratusthalāpsarovaryā tathānyā puñjikasthalā / menakā sahajanyā ca pramlocā ca dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: The lord appointed Jyotisman as the king of Kusa- dvipa. He ordered Dyuti to be the king of Krauncadvipa.
verses.hindi: स एव सर्ववेदानां पुराणानां प्रदर्शकः । पाराशर्यो महायोगी कृष्णद्वेपायनो हरिः आराध्य देवमीशानं दृष्टा साम्बं त्रिलोचनम् । तत्प्रसादादसौ व्यासं वेदानामकरोत् प्रभुः
