verses.wordMeaning: The lord appointed Jyotisman as the king of Kusa- dvipa. He ordered Dyuti to be the king of Krauncadvipa.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord appointed Jyotisman as the king of Kusa- dvipa. He ordered Dyuti to be the king of Krauncadvipa.

verses.sanskrit: अनुम्लोचा घृतीची च विश्वाची चोर्वशी तथा । अन्या च पूर्वचित्तिः स्यादन्या चैव तिलोत्तमा
verses.transliteration: anumlocā ghṛtīcī ca viśvācī corvaśī tathā / anyā ca pūrvacittiḥ syādanyā caiva tilottamā
verses.translation: Priyavrata made Havya the monarch of Sakadvipa. Prajapati Priyavrata installed Savana the ruler of Puskara.
verses.hindi: पैलं तेषां चतुर्थं च पञ्चमं मां महामुनिः
verses.wordMeaning: Priyavrata made Havya the monarch of Sakadvipa. Prajapati Priyavrata installed Savana the ruler of Puskara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Priyavrata made Havya the monarch of Sakadvipa. Prajapati Priyavrata installed Savana the ruler of Puskara.

verses.sanskrit: ताण्डवैर्विविधैरेनं वसन्तादिषु वै क्रमात् । तोषयन्ति महादेवं भानुमात्मानमव्ययम्
verses.transliteration: tāṇḍavairvividhairenaṃ vasantādiṣu vai kramāt / toṣayanti mahādevaṃ bhānumātmānamavyayam
verses.translation: The overlord of men crowned those sons as Kings of these Varsas (sub-continents). After realising the worthlessness of the world, he went to the forest for performing penance.
verses.hindi: ऋग्वेदश्रावकं पैलं जग्राह स महामुनिः । इतिहासपुराणानि प्रवक्तुं मामयोजयत्
verses.wordMeaning: The overlord of men crowned those sons as Kings of these Varsas (sub-continents). After realising the worthlessness of the world, he went to the forest for performing penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: The overlord of men crowned those sons as Kings of these Varsas (sub-continents). After realising the worthlessness of the world, he went to the forest for performing penance.

verses.sanskrit: एवं देवा वसन्त्यर्के द्वौ द्वौ मासौ क्रमेण तु । सूर्यमाप्याययन्त्येते तेजसा तेजसां निधिम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ devā vasantyarke dvau dvau māsau krameṇa tu / sūryamāpyāyayantyete tejasā tejasāṃ nidhim
verses.translation: The noble-souled Nabhi whose sub-continent was named Hima, begot of Merudevi the highly brilliant son Rsabha.i
verses.hindi: चातुर्होत्रमभूद् यस्मिस्तेन यज्ञमथाकरोत्
verses.wordMeaning: The noble-souled Nabhi whose sub-continent was named Hima, begot of Merudevi the highly brilliant son Rsabha.i
verses.commentary: Sense: The noble-souled Nabhi whose sub-continent was named Hima, begot of Merudevi the highly brilliant son Rsabha.i

verses.sanskrit: ग्रथितैः स्वैर्वचोभिस्तु स्तुवन्ति मुनयो रविम् । गन्धर्वाप्सरसश्चैनं नृत्यगेयैरुपासते
verses.transliteration: grathitaiḥ svairvacobhistu stuvanti munayo ravim / gandharvāpsarasaścainaṃ nṛtyageyairupāsate
verses.translation: Taijasa was the off-spring of Sumati. From him was born Indradyumna of great brilliance. From him was born the son Paramesthin and Pratihara was a scion of his family.
verses.hindi: औद्वात्रै सामभिश्चक्रे ब्रह्मत्वं चाप्यथर्वभिः शाखानां तु शतेनैव यजुर्वेदमथाकरोत्
verses.wordMeaning: Taijasa was the off-spring of Sumati. From him was born Indradyumna of great brilliance. From him was born the son Paramesthin and Pratihara was a scion of his family.
verses.commentary: Sense: Taijasa was the off-spring of Sumati. From him was born Indradyumna of great brilliance. From him was born the son Paramesthin and Pratihara was a scion of his family.

verses.sanskrit: ग्रामणीयक्षभूतानि कुर्वते ऽभीषुसंग्रहम् । सर्पा वहन्ति देवेशं यातुधानाः प्रयान्ति च
verses.transliteration: grāmaṇīyakṣabhūtāni kurvate 'bhīṣusaṃgraham / sarpā vahanti deveśaṃ yātudhānāḥ prayānti ca
verses.translation: The son born to him became well-known as Prati- harta. From him was born Bhava whose son was Udgitha. Prastavi was his son.
verses.hindi: पंद्रहवेंमें त्र्यारुणि, सोलहवेंमें धनंजय, सत्रहवेंमें कृतंजय और अठारहवेंमें ऋतंजयको व्यास कहा गया है। तदनन्तर (उन्नीसवेंमें) भरद्वाज व्यास हुए। उससे आगे (बीसवेंमें) गौतम हुए। राजश्रवा इक्कीसवें (द्वापर)-
verses.wordMeaning: The son born to him became well-known as Prati- harta. From him was born Bhava whose son was Udgitha. Prastavi was his son.
verses.commentary: Sense: The son born to him became well-known as Prati- harta. From him was born Bhava whose son was Udgitha. Prastavi was his son.

verses.sanskrit: बालखिल्या नयन्त्यस्तं परिवार्योदयाद् रविम् । एते तपन्ति वर्षन्ति भान्ति वान्ति सृजन्ति च । भूतानामशुभं कर्म व्यपोहन्तीह कीर्तिताः
verses.transliteration: bālakhilyā nayantyastaṃ parivāryodayād ravim / ete tapanti varṣanti bhānti vānti sṛjanti ca / bhūtānāmaśubhaṃ karma vyapohantīha kīrtitāḥ
verses.translation: The son born to him became well-known as Prati- harta. From him was born Bhava whose son was Udgitha. Prastavi was his son.
verses.hindi: में और फिर (बाईसवेंमें) श्रेष्ठ शुष्मायण व्यास हुए। तेईसवेंमें तृणबिन्दु और उसके बाद (चौबीसवेंमें) वाल्मीकिको व्यास कहा गया है । पच्चीसबेंमें शक्ति और छब्बीसवेंमें पराशर ही व्यास हुए हे द्विजो! सत्ताईसवेंमें महामुनि जातूकर्ण व्यास हुए और फिर इस अट्ठाईसवें द्वापर युगमें पराशरके पुत्र कृष्णद्वैपायन व्यास हुए। वे ही सभी वेदों और पुराणोंके प्रदर्शक हैं। पराशरके पुत्र महायोगी कृष्णद्वैपायन हरिने
verses.wordMeaning: The son born to him became well-known as Prati- harta. From him was born Bhava whose son was Udgitha. Prastavi was his son.
verses.commentary: Sense: The son born to him became well-known as Prati- harta. From him was born Bhava whose son was Udgitha. Prastavi was his son.

verses.sanskrit: एते सहैव सूर्येण भ्रमन्ति दिवि सानुगाः । विमाने च स्थितो नित्यं कामगे वातरंहसि
verses.transliteration: ete sahaiva sūryeṇa bhramanti divi sānugāḥ / vimāne ca sthito nityaṃ kāmage vātaraṃhasi
verses.translation: The son born to him became well-known as Prati- harta. From him was born Bhava whose son was Udgitha. Prastavi was his son.
verses.hindi: पार्वतीके साथ त्रिलोचन शंकरको आराधना करके उनका दर्शन किया और उन्हींके अनुग्रहसे उन प्रभु व्यासने वेदोंका विभाग किया। तदनन्तर उन महामुनिने वेदके पारंगत चार शिष्योंको ग्रहण किया। (ये चार
verses.wordMeaning: The son born to him became well-known as Prati- harta. From him was born Bhava whose son was Udgitha. Prastavi was his son.
verses.commentary: Sense: The son born to him became well-known as Prati- harta. From him was born Bhava whose son was Udgitha. Prastavi was his son.

verses.sanskrit: वर्षन्तश्च तपन्तश्च ह्लादयन्तश्च वै प्रजाः । गोपयन्तीह भूतानि सर्वाणीहायुगक्षयात्
verses.transliteration: varṣantaśca tapantaśca hlādayantaśca vai prajāḥ / gopayantīha bhūtāni sarvāṇīhāyugakṣayāt
verses.translation: The son born to him became well-known as Prati- harta. From him was born Bhava whose son was Udgitha. Prastavi was his son.
verses.hindi: शिष्य) जैमिनि, सुमन्तु, वैशम्पायन और चौथे पैल हैं। उन महामुनिने ऋग्वेदके श्रोता पैलको ऋग्वेद और यजुर्वेदके प्रवक्ता वैशम्पायनको यजुर्वेद ग्रहण कराया। इसी तरह उन्होंने सामवेदके श्रोता जेमिनिको सामवेद तथा अथर्ववेदके श्रोता ऋषिश्रेष्ठ सुमन्तुको अथर्ववेदका
verses.wordMeaning: The son born to him became well-known as Prati- harta. From him was born Bhava whose son was Udgitha. Prastavi was his son.
verses.commentary: Sense: The son born to him became well-known as Prati- harta. From him was born Bhava whose son was Udgitha. Prastavi was his son.

verses.sanskrit: एतेषामेव देवानां यथावीर्यं यथातपः । यथायोगं यथासत्त्वं स एष तपति प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: eteṣāmeva devānāṃ yathāvīryaṃ yathātapaḥ / yathāyogaṃ yathāsattvaṃ sa eṣa tapati prabhuḥ
verses.translation: The son born to him became well-known as Prati- harta. From him was born Bhava whose son was Udgitha. Prastavi was his son.
verses.hindi: ग्रहण कराया। ऐसे ही इतिहास तथा पुराणोंके प्रवचनमें मुझे श्रीकृष्णद्वेपायनने नियुक्त किया
verses.wordMeaning: The son born to him became well-known as Prati- harta. From him was born Bhava whose son was Udgitha. Prastavi was his son.
verses.commentary: Sense: The son born to him became well-known as Prati- harta. From him was born Bhava whose son was Udgitha. Prastavi was his son.

verses.sanskrit: अहोरात्रव्यवस्थानकारणं स प्रजापतिः । पितृदेवमनुष्यादीन् स सदाप्यायेद् रविः
verses.transliteration: ahorātravyavasthānakāraṇaṃ sa prajāpatiḥ / pitṛdevamanuṣyādīn sa sadāpyāyed raviḥ
verses.translation: The son born to him became well-known as Prati- harta. From him was born Bhava whose son was Udgitha. Prastavi was his son.
verses.hindi: (प्रारम्भमें) यजुर्वेद एक ही था। उसका चार भाग हुआ। उसीसे चातुर्होत्रको उत्पत्ति हुई और उससे (श्रीव्यासने) यज्ञ किया। द्विजोत्तमो! (उस यज्ञमें) यजुर्वेदके मन्त्रोद्वारा अध्वर्युसे सम्बद्ध कर्म, ऋक्- अथर्वमन्त्रोंके द्वारा ब्रह्माका कर्म सम्पन्न हुआ। तदनन्तर उन प्रभुने ऋचाओंको अलग कर ऋग्वेदका प्रणयन किया। इसी प्रकार यजुर्मन्त्रोंके समूहको यजुर्वेद" और साममन्त्रोंके समूहको सामवेदसंहिता बनायी। पहले
verses.wordMeaning: The son born to him became well-known as Prati- harta. From him was born Bhava whose son was Udgitha. Prastavi was his son.
verses.commentary: Sense: The son born to him became well-known as Prati- harta. From him was born Bhava whose son was Udgitha. Prastavi was his son.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र देवो महादेवो भास्वान् साक्षान्महेश्वरः । भासते वेदविदुषां नीलग्रीवः सनातनः
verses.transliteration: tatra devo mahādevo bhāsvān sākṣānmaheśvaraḥ / bhāsate vedaviduṣāṃ nīlagrīvaḥ sanātanaḥ
verses.translation: The son born to him became well-known as Prati- harta. From him was born Bhava whose son was Udgitha. Prastavi was his son.
verses.hindi: उन्होंने ऋग्वेदको इक्कीस भागों (शाखाओं)-में और यजुर्वेदको सौ शाखाओंमें विभक्त किया
verses.wordMeaning: The son born to him became well-known as Prati- harta. From him was born Bhava whose son was Udgitha. Prastavi was his son.
verses.commentary: Sense: The son born to him became well-known as Prati- harta. From him was born Bhava whose son was Udgitha. Prastavi was his son.

verses.sanskrit: स एष देवो भगवान् परमेष्ठी प्रजापतिः । स्थानं तद् विदुरादित्यं वेदज्ञा वेदविग्रहम्
verses.transliteration: sa eṣa devo bhagavān parameṣṭhī prajāpatiḥ / sthānaṃ tad vidurādityaṃ vedajñā vedavigraham
verses.translation: The son born to him became well-known as Prati- harta. From him was born Bhava whose son was Udgitha. Prastavi was his son.
verses.hindi: यहाँ यजुर्वेद एवं सामवेदसे यजुःसंहिता एवं सामसंहिता समझनी चाहिए। वेदका दूसरा भाग 'ब्राह्मण' होता है। वह केवल अथर्वाणमथो वेदं बिभेद नवकेन तु
verses.wordMeaning: The son born to him became well-known as Prati- harta. From him was born Bhava whose son was Udgitha. Prastavi was his son.
verses.commentary: Sense: The son born to him became well-known as Prati- harta. From him was born Bhava whose son was Udgitha. Prastavi was his son.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे चत्वारिशो ऽध्यायः सूत उवाच एवमेष महादेवो देवदेवः पितामहः । करोति नियतं कालं कालात्मा ह्यैश्वरी तनुः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge catvāriśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca evameṣa mahādevo devadevaḥ pitāmahaḥ / karoti niyataṃ kālaṃ kālātmā hyaiśvarī tanuḥ
verses.translation: From him was born Prthu, whose son was Nakta; Nakta's son is known as Gaya; Nara was Gaya's son; his son was Viraj.
verses.hindi: भेहैरष्टादशैर्व्यासः पुराणं कृतवान् प्रभुः। सोऽयमेकश्चतुष्पादो वेदः पूर्व पुरातनात्
verses.wordMeaning: From him was born Prthu, whose son was Nakta; Nakta's son is known as Gaya; Nara was Gaya's son; his son was Viraj.
verses.commentary: Sense: From him was born Prthu, whose son was Nakta; Nakta's son is known as Gaya; Nara was Gaya's son; his son was Viraj.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य ये रश्मयो विप्राः सर्वलोकप्रदीपकाः । तेषां श्रेष्ठाः पुनः सप्त रश्मयो ग्रहयोनयः
verses.transliteration: tasya ye raśmayo viprāḥ sarvalokapradīpakāḥ / teṣāṃ śreṣṭhāḥ punaḥ sapta raśmayo grahayonayaḥ
verses.translation: The chapter deals with ancient Indian astronomy which according to modern advances in that science is outdated—especially the distances and positions and dimensions of planets mentioned appear to be rather imaginary. The credit of creating the world is given to the sun and god Mahadeva is- identified with him (v. 27).
verses.hindi: ओङ्कारो ब्रह्मणो जातः सर्वदोषविशोधनः। वेदवेद्यो हिं भगवान् वासुदेवः सनातनः स गीयते परो वेदे यो वेहैनं स वेदवित्। एतत् परतरं ब्रह्म ज्योतिरानन्दमुत्तमम्
verses.wordMeaning: The chapter deals with ancient Indian astronomy which according to modern advances in that science is outdated—especially the distances and positions and dimensions of planets mentioned appear to be rather imaginary.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The chapter deals with ancient Indian astronomy which according to modern advances in that science is outdated—especially the distances and positions and dimensions of planets mentioned appear to be rather imaginary.…

verses.sanskrit: सुषुम्नो हरिकेशश्च विश्वकर्मा तथैव च । विश्वव्यचाः पुनश्चान्यः संयद्वसुरतः परः
verses.transliteration: suṣumno harikeśaśca viśvakarmā tathaiva ca / viśvavyacāḥ punaścānyaḥ saṃyadvasurataḥ paraḥ
verses.translation: The following are the worlds originating from the- Cosmic Egg viz. Bhurloka, Bhuvarloka, Svarloka, Maharloka, Janaloka, Tapoloka, and Satyaloka.
verses.hindi: बेदवाक्योदितं तत्त्वं वासुदेवः परं पदम्। वेदवेद्यमिमं वेत्ति वेदं वेदपरो मुनिः
verses.wordMeaning: The following are the worlds originating from the- Cosmic Egg viz. Bhurloka, Bhuvarloka, Svarloka, Maharloka, Janaloka, Tapoloka, and Satyaloka.
verses.commentary: Sense: The following are the worlds originating from the- Cosmic Egg viz. Bhurloka, Bhuvarloka, Svarloka, Maharloka, Janaloka, Tapoloka, and Satyaloka.

verses.sanskrit: अर्वावसुरिति ख्यातः स्वराडन्यः प्रकीर्तितः । सुपुम्नः सूर्यरश्मिस्तु पुष्णाति शिशिरद्युतिम्
verses.transliteration: arvāvasuriti khyātaḥ svarāḍanyaḥ prakīrtitaḥ / supumnaḥ sūryaraśmistu puṣṇāti śiśiradyutim
verses.translation: O leading Brahmanas, the extent of space illuminated by the rays of the sun and the moon is called Bhurloka in the Puranas.
verses.hindi: स वेदवेद्यो भगवान् वेदमूतिर्महे श्वर: । स एव वेदो वेद्यश्च तमेवाश्रित्य मुच्यते इत्येदक्षरं वेद्यमोङ्कारं वेदमव्ययम्। अवेद्यं च विजानाति पाराशर्यो महामुनिः
verses.wordMeaning: O leading Brahmanas, the extent of space illuminated by the rays of the sun and the moon is called Bhurloka in the Puranas.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading Brahmanas, the extent of space illuminated by the rays of the sun and the moon is called Bhurloka in the Puranas.

verses.sanskrit: तिर्यगूर्ध्वप्रचारो ऽसौ सुषुम्नः परिपठ्यते । हरिकेशस्तु यः प्रोक्तो रश्मिर्नक्षत्रपोषकः
verses.transliteration: tiryagūrdhvapracāro 'sau suṣumnaḥ paripaṭhyate / harikeśastu yaḥ prokto raśmirnakṣatrapoṣakaḥ
verses.translation: Bhuvarloka is of the same extent in area and circum¬ ference as the Bhurloka and is above it upto the sphere of the sun.
verses.hindi: इसी प्रकार उन्होंने सामवेदको हजार शाखाओंमें विभक्त किया तथा अथर्ववेदको नौ भागों (शाखाओं)- में बाटा
verses.wordMeaning: Bhuvarloka is of the same extent in area and circum¬ ference as the Bhurloka and is above it upto the sphere of the sun.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhuvarloka is of the same extent in area and circum¬ ference as the Bhurloka and is above it upto the sphere of the sun.

verses.sanskrit: विश्वकर्मा तथा रश्मिर्बुधं पुष्णाति सर्वदा । विश्वव्यचास्तु यो रश्मिः शुक्रं पुष्णाति नित्यदा
verses.transliteration: viśvakarmā tathā raśmirbudhaṃ puṣṇāti sarvadā / viśvavyacāstu yo raśmiḥ śukraṃ puṣṇāti nityadā
verses.translation: The sphere of the moon is stationed at a distance of a hundred thousand Yojanas from the sphere of the sun. The entire stellar sphere shines at a distance of a hundred thousand Yojanas above the moon.
verses.hindi: प्रभु व्यासने पुराणसंहिताके अठारह भेद किये। पूर्वकालमें सभी दोषोंको दूर करनेवाला पुरातन वही चतुष्पाद प्रणवरूप एक वेद ब्रह्मासे आविर्भूत हुआ। सनातन भगवान् वासुदेव वेदोंद्वारा जानने योग्य हैं। वेदोंद्वारा उन्हीं परम (पुरुष)-का गान किया जाता है। जो इन्हें (परम पुरुषको) जानता है, वही वेदको जाननेवाला है। ये ही परात्पर ब्रह्म, ज्योतिरूप और श्रेष्ठ आनन्द हैं। बेदवाक्योंद्वारा प्रतिपादित तत्त्व वासुदेव ही
verses.wordMeaning: The sphere of the moon is stationed at a distance of a hundred thousand Yojanas from the sphere of the sun. The entire stellar sphere shines at a distance of a hundred thousand Yojanas above the moon.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sphere of the moon is stationed at a distance of a hundred thousand Yojanas from the sphere of the sun. The entire stellar sphere shines at a distance of a hundred thousand Yojanas above the moon.

verses.sanskrit: संयद्वसुरिति ख्यातः स पुष्णाति च लोहितम् । वृहस्पतिं प्रपुष्णाति रश्मिरर्वावसुः प्रभोः । शनैश्चरं प्रपुष्णाति सप्तमस्तु सुराट् तथा
verses.transliteration: saṃyadvasuriti khyātaḥ sa puṣṇāti ca lohitam / vṛhaspatiṃ prapuṣṇāti raśmirarvāvasuḥ prabhoḥ / śanaiścaraṃ prapuṣṇāti saptamastu surāṭ tathā
verses.translation: O Brahmanas, Budha (the Mercury) is at a distance of two hundred thousand Yojanas from the stellar sphere. Usanas (the Venus) is stationed at the same distance from the Mercury.
verses.hindi: परमपद हैं । वेदपरायण मुनि वेदोंद्वारा जानने योग्य इन्ही (वासुदेवरूप) वेदको जानते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas, Budha (the Mercury) is at a distance of two hundred thousand Yojanas from the stellar sphere. Usanas (the Venus) is stationed at the same distance from the Mercury.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas, Budha (the Mercury) is at a distance of two hundred thousand Yojanas from the stellar sphere. Usanas (the Venus) is stationed at the same distance from the Mercury.

verses.sanskrit: एवं सूर्यप्रभावेन सर्वा नक्षत्रतारकाः । वर्धन्ते वर्धिता नित्यं नित्यमाप्याययन्ति च
verses.transliteration: evaṃ sūryaprabhāvena sarvā nakṣatratārakāḥ / vardhante vardhitā nityaṃ nityamāpyāyayanti ca
verses.translation: Ahgaraka (the Mars) is stationed at the same dis¬ tance from Sukra (the Venus). The preceptor of Devas, Brhaspati (i.e. the Jupiter) is stationed at a distance of two hundred thousand Yojanas fromBhauma (i.e. the Mars).
verses.hindi: जो परम अवेद्यको जानते हैं तथा वेदनिष्ठ, सदेश्वर, वेदमूर्ति, महेश्वर हैं, वे भगवान् वेदोंद्वारा ज्ञात होने योग्य हैं। वे ही भगवान् वेद हैं, वे ही (वेदसे) जानने योग्य हैं और उन्हींका आश्रय ग्रहण करनेसे मुक्ति मिलती है। पराशरके पुत्र महामुनि वेदव्यास (ही) इस अविनाशी,
verses.wordMeaning: Ahgaraka (the Mars) is stationed at the same dis¬ tance from Sukra (the Venus). The preceptor of Devas, Brhaspati (i.e. the Jupiter) is stationed at a distance of two hundred thousand Yojanas fromBhauma (i.e. the Mars).
verses.commentary: Sense: Ahgaraka (the Mars) is stationed at the same dis¬ tance from Sukra (the Venus). The preceptor of Devas, Brhaspati (i.e. the Jupiter) is stationed at a distance of two hundred thousand Yojanas fromBhauma (i.e. the Mars).

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यानां पार्थिवानां च नैशानां चैव सर्वशः । आदानान्नित्यमादित्यस्तेजसां तमसां प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: divyānāṃ pārthivānāṃ ca naiśānāṃ caiva sarvaśaḥ / ādānānnityamādityastejasāṃ tamasāṃ prabhuḥ
verses.translation: Sauri (i.e. the Saturn) is stationed at a distance of two hundred thousand Yojanas from the Jupiter. The sphere of the seven sages (i.e. the Great Bear) shines at a distance of a hundred thousand Yojanas from the sphere of the planets.
verses.hindi: अर्थात् ज्ञात न हो सकने योग्य (परमतत्त्व)-को भी जानते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Sauri (i.e. the Saturn) is stationed at a distance of two hundred thousand Yojanas from the Jupiter. The sphere of the seven sages (i.e. the Great Bear) shines at a distance of a hundred thousand Yojanas from the sphere of the planets.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sauri (i.e. the Saturn) is stationed at a distance of two hundred thousand Yojanas from the Jupiter. The sphere of the seven sages (i.e. the Great Bear) shines at a distance of a hundred thousand Yojanas from the sphere of the planets.

verses.sanskrit: आदत्ते स तु नाडीनां सहस्त्रेण समन्ततः । नादेयांश्चैव सामुद्रान् कूप्यांश्चैव सहस्त्रदृक् । स्थावराञ्जङ्गमांश्चैव यच्च कुल्यादिकं पयः
verses.transliteration: ādatte sa tu nāḍīnāṃ sahastreṇa samantataḥ / nādeyāṃścaiva sāmudrān kūpyāṃścaiva sahastradṛk / sthāvarāñjaṅgamāṃścaiva yacca kulyādikaṃ payaḥ
verses.translation: Above the sphere of the seven sages, at a distance of a hundred Yojanas is stationed Dhruva (the Pole star) * Dhruva is verily the pivot or the axis of the stellar system. Lord Visnu, Narayana, Dharma himself is abiding there.
verses.hindi: कलियुगमें महादेवके अवतारो तथा उनके शिष्योंका वर्णन, भविष्यमें होनेवाले सात महादेवावताराणि कलौ शृणुत सुव्रताः
verses.wordMeaning: Above the sphere of the seven sages, at a distance of a hundred Yojanas is stationed Dhruva (the Pole star) * Dhruva is verily the pivot or the axis of the stellar system. Lord Visnu, Narayana, Dharma himself is abiding there.
verses.commentary: Sense: Above the sphere of the seven sages, at a distance of a hundred Yojanas is stationed Dhruva (the Pole star) * Dhruva is verily the pivot or the axis of the stellar system. Lord Visnu, Narayana, Dharma himself is abiding there.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य रश्मिसहस्त्रं तच्छीतवर्षोष्णनिस्त्रवम् । तासां चतुः शतं नाड्यो वर्षन्ते चित्रमूर्तयः
verses.transliteration: tasya raśmisahastraṃ tacchītavarṣoṣṇanistravam / tāsāṃ catuḥ śataṃ nāḍyo varṣante citramūrtayaḥ
verses.translation: The diameter of the sun's sphere is known as nine thousand Yojanas. The circumference is three times that.
verses.hindi: आद्ये कलियुगे श्वेतो देवदेवो महाद्युतिः । नाम्ना हिताय विप्राणामभूद् वैवस्वतेऽन्तरे
verses.wordMeaning: The diameter of the sun's sphere is known as nine thousand Yojanas. The circumference is three times that.
verses.commentary: Sense: The diameter of the sun's sphere is known as nine thousand Yojanas. The circumference is three times that.

verses.sanskrit: वन्दनाश्चैव याज्याश्च केतना भूतनास्तथा । अमृता नाम ताः सर्वा रश्मयो वृष्टिसर्जनाः
verses.transliteration: vandanāścaiva yājyāśca ketanā bhūtanāstathā / amṛtā nāma tāḥ sarvā raśmayo vṛṣṭisarjanāḥ
verses.translation: The extent of the moon is known as twice the extent of the sun. Svarbhanu (i.e. the evil planet Rahu) assumes a size equal to them and approaches them.
verses.hindi: गोकर्णश्चाभवत् तस्माद् गुहावासः शिखण्डयथ। जटामाल्यड्हासश्च दारुको लाङ्गली क्रमात् तीर्थ कायावतारे स्याद् देवेशो नकुलीश्वरः
verses.wordMeaning: The extent of the moon is known as twice the extent of the sun. Svarbhanu (i.e. the evil planet Rahu) assumes a size equal to them and approaches them.
verses.commentary: Sense: The extent of the moon is known as twice the extent of the sun. Svarbhanu (i.e. the evil planet Rahu) assumes a size equal to them and approaches them.

verses.sanskrit: हिमोद्वाहाश्च ता नाड्यो रश्मयस्त्रिशतं पुनः । रश्म्यो मेष्यश्च पौष्यश्च ह्लादिन्यो हिमसर्जनाः । चन्द्रास्ता नामतः सर्वाः पीताभाः स्युर्गभस्तयः
verses.transliteration: himodvāhāśca tā nāḍyo raśmayastriśataṃ punaḥ / raśmyo meṣyaśca pauṣyaśca hlādinyo himasarjanāḥ / candrāstā nāmataḥ sarvāḥ pītābhāḥ syurgabhastayaḥ
verses.translation: He is created with a.spherical shape after extracting the shadow of the earth. The extensive third abode of Rahu is full of darkness.
verses.hindi: तत्र देवादिदेवस्य चत्वारः सुतपोधनाः। शिष्या बभूदुश्चान्येषां प्रत्येकं मुनिपुंगवाः
verses.wordMeaning: He is created with a.spherical shape after extracting the shadow of the earth. The extensive third abode of Rahu is full of darkness.
verses.commentary: Sense: He is created with a.spherical shape after extracting the shadow of the earth. The extensive third abode of Rahu is full of darkness.

verses.sanskrit: शुक्राश्च ककुभश्चैव गावो विश्वभृतस्तथा । शुक्रास्ता नामतः सर्वास्त्रिविधा घर्मसर्जनाः
verses.transliteration: śukrāśca kakubhaścaiva gāvo viśvabhṛtastathā / śukrāstā nāmataḥ sarvāstrividhā gharmasarjanāḥ
verses.translation: Sukra (the Venus) is one-sixteenth of the dimension of the moon in extent. Brhaspati (the Jupiter) should be known as one-fourth less than the dimension of the Venus.
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले---सुत्रतो ! द्वापरमें (होनेवाले) वेदव्यासके अवतारोंको कहा गया, अब (आपलोग) कलियुगमें होनेवाले महादेवके अवतारोंको सुनें-वैवस्वत मन्वन्तरके पहले कलियुगमें विप्रोंके हितार्थ अतितेजस्वी देवाधिदेव (शंकर) श्वेत नामसे पर्वतोंमें श्रेष्ठ हिमालयके रमणीय छगल नामक शिखरपर अवतरित हुए। उनके शिष्य शिखायुक्त और अमित प्रभावाले हुए। श्वेत, श्वेतशिख, श्वेतास्य तथा श्वेतलोहित-ये चार वेदके पारंगत महात्मा
verses.wordMeaning: Sukra (the Venus) is one-sixteenth of the dimension of the moon in extent. Brhaspati (the Jupiter) should be known as one-fourth less than the dimension of the Venus.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sukra (the Venus) is one-sixteenth of the dimension of the moon in extent. Brhaspati (the Jupiter) should be known as one-fourth less than the dimension of the Venus.

verses.sanskrit: समं बिभर्ति ताभिः स मनुष्यपितृदेवताः । मनुष्यानौषधेनेह स्वधया च पितॄनपि । अमृतेन सुरान् सर्वांस्त्रिभिस्त्ररिंस्तर्पयत्यसौ
verses.transliteration: samaṃ bibharti tābhiḥ sa manuṣyapitṛdevatāḥ / manuṣyānauṣadheneha svadhayā ca pitṝnapi / amṛtena surān sarvāṃstribhistrariṃstarpayatyasau
verses.translation: Both Bhauma (the Mars) and Saura (the Saturn) are known as being a one-fourth less than Brhaspati (the Jupiter). In extent and circumference, Budha (the Mercury) is one-fourth less than the above two.
verses.hindi: ब्राह्मण (प्रथम कलियुगमें) थे॥ १--४॥
verses.wordMeaning: Both Bhauma (the Mars) and Saura (the Saturn) are known as being a one-fourth less than Brhaspati (the Jupiter). In extent and circumference, Budha (the Mercury) is one-fourth less than the above two.
verses.commentary: Sense: Both Bhauma (the Mars) and Saura (the Saturn) are known as being a one-fourth less than Brhaspati (the Jupiter). In extent and circumference, Budha (the Mercury) is one-fourth less than the above two.

verses.sanskrit: वसन्ते ग्रैष्मिके चैव शतैः स तपति त्रिभिः । शरद्यपि च वर्षासु चतुर्भैः संप्रवर्षति । हेमन्ते शिशिरे चैव हिममुत्सृजति त्रिभिः
verses.transliteration: vasante graiṣmike caiva śataiḥ sa tapati tribhiḥ / śaradyapi ca varṣāsu caturbhaiḥ saṃpravarṣati / hemante śiśire caiva himamutsṛjati tribhiḥ
verses.translation: The forms of the stars and the constellations taken together in a body are equal to Budha in extent as well as in circumference.
verses.hindi: सुभान, दमन, सुहोत्र, कङ्कण और योगीन्द्र लोकाक्षिके रूपमें क्रमशः दूसरेसे छठे कलियुगतक महादेवका अवतार हुआ तथा सातवें (कलियुग)-में जैगीषव्य नामसे महादेवका अवतार हुआ। आठवेंमें दधिवाह, नवेंमें प्रभु वृषभ, दसवेंमें भृगु और उसके आगे (ग्यारहवें कलियुगमें) उग्रके रूपमें महादेवका अवतार हुआ। बारहवेंमें अत्रि, तेरहवेंमें बली, चौदहवेंमें गौतम और उसके बाद (पंद्रहवें कलियुगमें) वेदशीर्षाके
verses.wordMeaning: The forms of the stars and the constellations taken together in a body are equal to Budha in extent as well as in circumference.
verses.commentary: Sense: The forms of the stars and the constellations taken together in a body are equal to Budha in extent as well as in circumference.

verses.sanskrit: वरुणो माघमासे तु सूर्यः पूषा तु फल्गुने । चैत्रे मासि भवेदंशो धाता वैशाखतापनः
verses.transliteration: varuṇo māghamāse tu sūryaḥ pūṣā tu phalgune / caitre māsi bhavedaṃśo dhātā vaiśākhatāpanaḥ
verses.translation: The stars and constellations are smaller or larger in mutual comparison by five hundred, four hundred, three hundred or two hundred Yojanas (in extent).
verses.hindi: रूपमें महादेव अवतरित हुए
verses.wordMeaning: The stars and constellations are smaller or larger in mutual comparison by five hundred, four hundred, three hundred or two hundred Yojanas (in extent).
verses.commentary: Sense: The stars and constellations are smaller or larger in mutual comparison by five hundred, four hundred, three hundred or two hundred Yojanas (in extent).

verses.sanskrit: ज्येष्ठामूले भवेदिन्द्रः आषाढे सविता रविः । विवस्वान् श्रावणे मासि प्रौष्ठपद्यां भगः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: jyeṣṭhāmūle bhavedindraḥ āṣāḍhe savitā raviḥ / vivasvān śrāvaṇe māsi prauṣṭhapadyāṃ bhagaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: The stellar spheres are lesser in extent (nikrstani). * Their dimensions are only half a Yo\zxa,{Tojananyardha-rnatrani*). None (no heavenly body) is smaller than they.
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर क्रमशः गोकर्ण, गुहावास, शिखण्डी, जयमाली, अट्टहास, दारुक, लाङ्गली और इनके बाद श्वेत, शूली, नकुलीशके रूपमें महादेवका अवतार हुआ
verses.wordMeaning: The stellar spheres are lesser in extent (nikrstani). * Their dimensions are only half a Yo\zxa,{Tojananyardha-rnatrani*). None (no heavenly body) is smaller than they.
verses.commentary: Sense: The stellar spheres are lesser in extent (nikrstani). * Their dimensions are only half a Yo\zxa,{Tojananyardha-rnatrani*). None (no heavenly body) is smaller than they.

verses.sanskrit: पर्जन्यो ऽश्वयुजि त्वष्टाकार्तिके मासि भास्करः । मार्गशीर्ष भवेन्मित्रः पौषे विष्णुः सनातनः
verses.transliteration: parjanyo 'śvayuji tvaṣṭākārtike māsi bhāskaraḥ / mārgaśīrṣa bhavenmitraḥ pauṣe viṣṇuḥ sanātanaḥ
verses.translation: The three planets stationed above traverse the greatest distance. The planets Saturn, Jupiter and Mars should be known as moving slowly.
verses.hindi: वैवस्वत मन्वन्तरमें त्रिशूल धारण करनेवाले प्रभु शम्भुके अट्ठाईस अवतार कहे गये हैं। अन्तिम कलियुगमें कायावतार नामक तीर्थमें देवेश्वर नकुलीश्वरके रूपमें महादेवका अवतार होगा। मुनिपुंगवो! उस समय देवोंके
verses.wordMeaning: The three planets stationed above traverse the greatest distance. The planets Saturn, Jupiter and Mars should be known as moving slowly.
verses.commentary: Sense: The three planets stationed above traverse the greatest distance. The planets Saturn, Jupiter and Mars should be known as moving slowly.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चरश्मिसहस्त्राणि वरुणस्यार्ककर्मणि । षड्भिः सहस्त्रैः पूषा तु देव्ॐशः सप्तभिस्तथा
verses.transliteration: pañcaraśmisahastrāṇi varuṇasyārkakarmaṇi / ṣaḍbhiḥ sahastraiḥ pūṣā tu devoṃśaḥ saptabhistathā
verses.translation: Four great planets are beneath them: the Sun, the moon, the Mercury and the Venus have fast movements.
verses.hindi: आदिदेव (महादेव)-के तीव्र तपस्याके धनी चार शिष्य हुए। अन्य अवतारोंमें भी प्रत्येकके (चार) शिष्य हुए। वे सभी प्रसन्न मनवाले, इन्द्रियनिग्रही और ईश्वरकी भक्ति करनेवाले थे। उन श्रेष्ठ योग जाननेवाले योगियोंका मैं क्रमशः वर्णन करता हुँ-
verses.wordMeaning: Four great planets are beneath them: the Sun, the moon, the Mercury and the Venus have fast movements.
verses.commentary: Sense: Four great planets are beneath them: the Sun, the moon, the Mercury and the Venus have fast movements.

verses.sanskrit: धाताष्टभिः सहस्त्रैस्तु नवभिस्तु शतक्रतुः । विवस्वान् दशभिः पाति पात्येकादशभिर्भगः
verses.transliteration: dhātāṣṭabhiḥ sahastraistu navabhistu śatakratuḥ / vivasvān daśabhiḥ pāti pātyekādaśabhirbhagaḥ
verses.translation: When the sun moves in Daksinayana (southern transit) it traverses far below the previous planets.
verses.hindi: दुन्दुभिः शतरूपश्च ऋचीकः केतुमांस्तथा। विकेशश्च विशोकश्च विशाप: शापनाशनः
verses.wordMeaning: When the sun moves in Daksinayana (southern transit) it traverses far below the previous planets.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the sun moves in Daksinayana (southern transit) it traverses far below the previous planets.

verses.sanskrit: सप्तभिस्तपते मित्रस्त्वष्टा चैवाष्टभिस्तपेत् । अर्यमा दशभैः पाति पर्जन्यो नवभिस्तपेत् । षड्भी रश्मिसहस्त्रैस्तु विष्णुस्तपति विश्वसृक्
verses.transliteration: saptabhistapate mitrastvaṣṭā caivāṣṭabhistapet / aryamā daśabhaiḥ pāti parjanyo navabhistapet / ṣaḍbhī raśmisahastraistu viṣṇustapati viśvasṛk
verses.translation: Enlarging its sphere the moon traverses above it. The entire stellar sphere moves above the moon.
verses.hindi: दालभ्यश्च महायोगी धर्मात्मानो महौजसः। सुधामा विरजाश्चैव शङ्खपात्रज एव च कपिलश्चासुरिश्चैव वोढुः पञ्चशिखो मुनि:
verses.wordMeaning: Enlarging its sphere the moon traverses above it. The entire stellar sphere moves above the moon.
verses.commentary: Sense: Enlarging its sphere the moon traverses above it. The entire stellar sphere moves above the moon.

verses.sanskrit: वसन्ते कपिलः सूर्यो ग्रीष्मे काञ्चनसप्रभः । श्वेतो वर्षासु वर्णेन पाण्डुरः शरदि प्रभुः । हेमन्ते ताम्रवर्णः स्याच्छिशिरे लोहितो रविः
verses.transliteration: vasante kapilaḥ sūryo grīṣme kāñcanasaprabhaḥ / śveto varṣāsu varṇena pāṇḍuraḥ śaradi prabhuḥ / hemante tāmravarṇaḥ syācchiśire lohito raviḥ
verses.translation: Budha (the Mercury) is above the star, the Venus is above the Mercury, Vakra (the Mars) is above the Venus and the Jupiter is above the Mars.
verses.hindi: बलबन्धुर्निरामित्रः केतुश्॒द्गस्तपोधनः
verses.wordMeaning: Budha (the Mercury) is above the star, the Venus is above the Mercury, Vakra (the Mars) is above the Venus and the Jupiter is above the Mars.
verses.commentary: Sense: Budha (the Mercury) is above the star, the Venus is above the Mercury, Vakra (the Mars) is above the Venus and the Jupiter is above the Mars.

verses.sanskrit: ओषधीषु बलं धत्ते स्वधामपि पितृष्वथ । सूर्यो ऽमरत्वममृते त्रयं त्रिषु नियच्छति
verses.transliteration: oṣadhīṣu balaṃ dhatte svadhāmapi pitṛṣvatha / sūryo 'maratvamamṛte trayaṃ triṣu niyacchati
verses.translation: The Saturn is above that (the Jupiter) and further above is the sphere of the seven Sages (Great Bear). Dhruva (Pole star) is stationed above the seven sages.
verses.hindi: लम्बोदरश्च लम्बश्च लम्बाक्षो लम्बकेशकः । सुधामा काश्यपश्चैव वसिष्ठो विरजास्तथा । अत्रिरुग्रस्तथा चैव श्रवणोऽथ श्रविष्ठकः
verses.wordMeaning: The Saturn is above that (the Jupiter) and further above is the sphere of the seven Sages (Great Bear). Dhruva (Pole star) is stationed above the seven sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Saturn is above that (the Jupiter) and further above is the sphere of the seven Sages (Great Bear). Dhruva (Pole star) is stationed above the seven sages.

verses.sanskrit: अन्ये चाष्टौ ग्रहा ज्ञेयाः सूर्येणाधिष्ठिता द्विजाः । चन्द्रमाः सोमपुत्रश्च शुक्रश्चैव बृहस्पतिः । भौमो मन्दस्तथा राहुः केतुमानपि चाष्टमः
verses.transliteration: anye cāṣṭau grahā jñeyāḥ sūryeṇādhiṣṭhitā dvijāḥ / candramāḥ somaputraśca śukraścaiva bṛhaspatiḥ / bhaumo mandastathā rāhuḥ ketumānapi cāṣṭamaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas, the chariot of the sun is nine thousand Yojanas long. The length of the shafts is twice that.
verses.hindi: उतथ्यो वामदेवश्च महाकायो महानिलः। वाचश्रवाः सुपीकश्च श्यावाश्व: सपथीश्वरः
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahmanas, the chariot of the sun is nine thousand Yojanas long. The length of the shafts is twice that.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmanas, the chariot of the sun is nine thousand Yojanas long. The length of the shafts is twice that.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे ध्रुवे निबद्धा वै ग्रहास्ते वातरश्मिभिः । भ्राम्यमाणा यथायोगं भ्रमन्त्यनुदिवाकरम्
verses.transliteration: sarve dhruve nibaddhā vai grahāste vātaraśmibhiḥ / bhrāmyamāṇā yathāyogaṃ bhramantyanudivākaram
verses.translation: Its axle is one crore and a half and seven million {niyuta) Yojanas and the wheel is fixed there.
verses.hindi: हिरण्यनाभः कोशल्यो लोकाक्षिः कुथुमिस्तथा । सुमन्तुर्वर्चरी विद्वान् कबन्धः कुशिकन्धरः प्लक्षो दार्भायणिश्चैव केतुमान् गौतमस्तथा । भल्लापी मधुपिङ्गश्च श्वेतकेतुस्तपोनिधिः
verses.wordMeaning: Its axle is one crore and a half and seven million {niyuta) Yojanas and the wheel is fixed there.
verses.commentary: Sense: Its axle is one crore and a half and seven million {niyuta) Yojanas and the wheel is fixed there.

verses.sanskrit: अलातचक्रवद् यान्ति वातचक्रेरिता द्विजाः । यस्माद् वहति तान् वायुः प्रवहस्तेन स स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: alātacakravad yānti vātacakreritā dvijāḥ / yasmād vahati tān vāyuḥ pravahastena sa smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: The entire Kalacakra (wheel of time) is fixed there in the form of the year having three times seven (v.l. three) Nabhis (i.e. naives), five spokes and six rims.
verses.hindi: उशिजो बृहदुक्थश्च देवल: कपिरेव च। शालिहोत्रोऽग्निवेश्यश्च युवनाश्वः शरद्वसुः
verses.wordMeaning: The entire Kalacakra (wheel of time) is fixed there in the form of the year having three times seven (v.l. three) Nabhis (i.e. naives), five spokes and six rims.
verses.commentary: Sense: The entire Kalacakra (wheel of time) is fixed there in the form of the year having three times seven (v.l. three) Nabhis (i.e. naives), five spokes and six rims.

verses.sanskrit: रथस्त्रिचक्रः सोमस्य कुन्दाभास्तस्य वाजिनः । वामदक्षिणतो युक्ता दश तेन निशाकरः
verses.transliteration: rathastricakraḥ somasya kundābhāstasya vājinaḥ / vāmadakṣiṇato yuktā daśa tena niśākaraḥ
verses.translation: ** O excellent Brahmanas, the second axle of the
verses.hindi: छगलः कुण्डकर्णश्च कुम्भश्चैव प्रवाहकः । उलूको विद्युतश्चैव शाद्वलो ह्याश्वलायनः अक्षपादः कुमारश्च उलूको वत्स एव च। कुशिकश्चैव गर्गश्च मित्रको ऋष्य एव च
verses.wordMeaning: ** O excellent Brahmanas, the second axle of the
verses.commentary: Sense: ** O excellent Brahmanas, the second axle of the

verses.sanskrit: वीथ्याश्रयाणि चरति नक्षत्राणि रविर्यथा । ह्रासवृद्धी च विप्रेन्द्रा ध्रुवाधाराणि सर्वदा
verses.transliteration: vīthyāśrayāṇi carati nakṣatrāṇi raviryathā / hrāsavṛddhī ca viprendrā dhruvādhārāṇi sarvadā
verses.translation: The length of both the axles is half that of both the yokes. The short axle with the short pole of the chariot has the Polar star as its support.
verses.hindi: विमला ब्रह्मभूयिष्ठा ज्ञानयोगपरायणाः
verses.wordMeaning: The length of both the axles is half that of both the yokes. The short axle with the short pole of the chariot has the Polar star as its support.
verses.commentary: Sense: The length of both the axles is half that of both the yokes. The short axle with the short pole of the chariot has the Polar star as its support.

verses.sanskrit: स सोमः शुक्लपक्षे तु भास्करे परतः स्थिते । आपूर्यते परस्यान्तः सततं दिवसक्रमात्
verses.transliteration: sa somaḥ śuklapakṣe tu bhāskare parataḥ sthite / āpūryate parasyāntaḥ satataṃ divasakramāt
verses.translation: The second axle to which the wheel of the chariot is fixed is on the Manasa mountain. His seven horses are the seven metres. Understand their names.
verses.hindi: शतरूप, ऋचीक, केतुमान्, विकेश, विशोक, विशाप, विरजा और शङ्कपात्रज-ये धर्मात्मा और महान् ओजस्वी थे
verses.wordMeaning: The second axle to which the wheel of the chariot is fixed is on the Manasa mountain. His seven horses are the seven metres. Understand their names.
verses.commentary: Sense: The second axle to which the wheel of the chariot is fixed is on the Manasa mountain. His seven horses are the seven metres. Understand their names.

verses.sanskrit: क्षीणायितं सुरैः सोममाप्यायति नित्यदा । एकेन रश्मिना विप्राः सुषुम्नाख्येन भास्करः
verses.transliteration: kṣīṇāyitaṃ suraiḥ somamāpyāyati nityadā / ekena raśminā viprāḥ suṣumnākhyena bhāskaraḥ
verses.translation: The horses of the sun are the metres viz. Gayatri (It has 6 syllables in a quarter); Brhati (9 syllables in a quarter or foot); Usnik (7 syllables in a foot); Jagati (12 syllables in a foot), Pankti (10 syllables in a foot); Anustup (8 syllables in a foot) and Tristup (11 syllables in a foot).
verses.hindi: (ऐसे ही) सारस्वत, मेघ, घनवाह, सुवाहन, कपिल, आसुरि, वोढु, मुनि, पञ्चशिख, पराशर, गर्ग, भार्गव, अङ्गिरा, बलबन्धु, निरामित्र, तपोधन, केतुश्रृंग, लम्बोदर, लम्ब, लम्बाक्ष, लम्बकेशक, सर्वज्ञ, समबुद्धि,
verses.wordMeaning: The horses of the sun are the metres viz. Gayatri (It has 6 syllables in a quarter); Brhati (9 syllables in a quarter or foot); Usnik (7 syllables in a foot); Jagati (12 syllables in a foot), Pankti (10 syllables in a foot);…
verses.commentary: Sense: The horses of the sun are the metres viz. Gayatri (It has 6 syllables in a quarter); Brhati (9 syllables in a quarter or foot); Usnik (7 syllables in a foot); Jagati (12 syllables in a foot), Pankti (10 syllables in a foot);…

verses.sanskrit: एषा सूर्यस्य वीर्येण सोमस्याप्यायिता तनुः । पौर्णमास्यां स दृश्येत संपूर्णे दिवसक्रमात्
verses.transliteration: eṣā sūryasya vīryeṇa somasyāpyāyitā tanuḥ / paurṇamāsyāṃ sa dṛśyeta saṃpūrṇe divasakramāt
verses.translation: The horses of the sun are the metres viz. Gayatri (It has 6 syllables in a quarter); Brhati (9 syllables in a quarter or foot); Usnik (7 syllables in a foot); Jagati (12 syllables in a foot), Pankti (10 syllables in a foot); Anustup (8 syllables in a foot) and Tristup (11 syllables in a foot).
verses.hindi: साध्य, सत्य, सुधामा, काश्यप, वसिष्ठ, विरजा, अत्रि, उग्र, श्रवण, श्रविष्ठक, कुणि, कुणिबाहु, उतथ्य, वामदेव, महाकाय, महानिल, वाचश्रवा,
verses.wordMeaning: The horses of the sun are the metres viz. Gayatri (It has 6 syllables in a quarter); Brhati (9 syllables in a quarter or foot); Usnik (7 syllables in a foot); Jagati (12 syllables in a foot), Pankti (10 syllables in a foot);…
verses.commentary: Sense: The horses of the sun are the metres viz. Gayatri (It has 6 syllables in a quarter); Brhati (9 syllables in a quarter or foot); Usnik (7 syllables in a foot); Jagati (12 syllables in a foot), Pankti (10 syllables in a foot);…

verses.sanskrit: संपूर्णमर्धमासेन तं सोमममृतात्मकम् । पिबन्ति देवता विप्रा यतस्ते ऽमृतभोजनाः
verses.transliteration: saṃpūrṇamardhamāsena taṃ somamamṛtātmakam / pibanti devatā viprā yataste 'mṛtabhojanāḥ
verses.translation: The horses of the sun are the metres viz. Gayatri (It has 6 syllables in a quarter); Brhati (9 syllables in a quarter or foot); Usnik (7 syllables in a foot); Jagati (12 syllables in a foot), Pankti (10 syllables in a foot); Anustup (8 syllables in a foot) and Tristup (11 syllables in a foot).
verses.hindi: महादेवके अवतारोंके थे) ॥ १६--२१॥ (इनके अतिरिक्त) हिरण्यनाभ, कौशल्य, लोकाक्षि,
verses.wordMeaning: The horses of the sun are the metres viz. Gayatri (It has 6 syllables in a quarter); Brhati (9 syllables in a quarter or foot); Usnik (7 syllables in a foot); Jagati (12 syllables in a foot), Pankti (10 syllables in a foot);…
verses.commentary: Sense: The horses of the sun are the metres viz. Gayatri (It has 6 syllables in a quarter); Brhati (9 syllables in a quarter or foot); Usnik (7 syllables in a foot); Jagati (12 syllables in a foot), Pankti (10 syllables in a foot);…

verses.sanskrit: ततः पञ्चदशे भागे किञ्चिच्छिष्टे कलात्मके । अपराह्णे पितृगणा जघन्यं पर्युपासते
verses.transliteration: tataḥ pañcadaśe bhāge kiñcicchiṣṭe kalātmake / aparāhṇe pitṛgaṇā jaghanyaṃ paryupāsate
verses.translation: The horses of the sun are the metres viz. Gayatri (It has 6 syllables in a quarter); Brhati (9 syllables in a quarter or foot); Usnik (7 syllables in a foot); Jagati (12 syllables in a foot), Pankti (10 syllables in a foot); Anustup (8 syllables in a foot) and Tristup (11 syllables in a foot).
verses.hindi: प्लक्ष, दार्भायणि, केतुमान्, गौतम, भल्लापी, मधुपिङ्ग, तपोनिधि श्वेतकेतु, उशिज, बृहदुक्थ, देवल, कपि, शालिहोत्र, अग्निवेश्य, युवनाश्व, शरढसु, छगल, कुण्डकर्ण, योगियोंके समस्त अवतारोंकी आवृत्तिमें ये ही महात्मा शिष्य होते हैं। ये सभी शुद्ध, ब्रह्मभूयिष्ठ और ज्ञान-योगपरायण हैं। ब्राह्मणोंके कल्याणके लिये तथा वेदोंकी स्थापनाके लिये योगेश्‍वर( परब्रह्म) -के आदेशसे
verses.wordMeaning: The horses of the sun are the metres viz. Gayatri (It has 6 syllables in a quarter); Brhati (9 syllables in a quarter or foot); Usnik (7 syllables in a foot); Jagati (12 syllables in a foot), Pankti (10 syllables in a foot);…
verses.commentary: Sense: The horses of the sun are the metres viz. Gayatri (It has 6 syllables in a quarter); Brhati (9 syllables in a quarter or foot); Usnik (7 syllables in a foot); Jagati (12 syllables in a foot), Pankti (10 syllables in a foot);…

verses.sanskrit: पिबन्ति द्विकलं कालं शिष्टा तस्य कला तुया । सुधामृतमयीं पुण्यां तामन्दोरमृतात्मिकाम्
verses.transliteration: pibanti dvikalaṃ kālaṃ śiṣṭā tasya kalā tuyā / sudhāmṛtamayīṃ puṇyāṃ tāmandoramṛtātmikām
verses.translation: The horses of the sun are the metres viz. Gayatri (It has 6 syllables in a quarter); Brhati (9 syllables in a quarter or foot); Usnik (7 syllables in a foot); Jagati (12 syllables in a foot), Pankti (10 syllables in a foot); Anustup (8 syllables in a foot) and Tristup (11 syllables in a foot).
verses.hindi: (ये महात्मा) अवतार धारण करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: The horses of the sun are the metres viz. Gayatri (It has 6 syllables in a quarter); Brhati (9 syllables in a quarter or foot); Usnik (7 syllables in a foot); Jagati (12 syllables in a foot), Pankti (10 syllables in a foot);…
verses.commentary: Sense: The horses of the sun are the metres viz. Gayatri (It has 6 syllables in a quarter); Brhati (9 syllables in a quarter or foot); Usnik (7 syllables in a foot); Jagati (12 syllables in a foot), Pankti (10 syllables in a foot);…

verses.sanskrit: निः सृतं तदमावास्यां गभस्तिभ्यः स्वधामृतम् । मासतृप्तिमपाप्यग्र्यां पितरः सन्ति निर्वृताः
verses.transliteration: niḥ sṛtaṃ tadamāvāsyāṃ gabhastibhyaḥ svadhāmṛtam / māsatṛptimapāpyagryāṃ pitaraḥ santi nirvṛtāḥ
verses.translation: The horses of the sun are the metres viz. Gayatri (It has 6 syllables in a quarter); Brhati (9 syllables in a quarter or foot); Usnik (7 syllables in a foot); Jagati (12 syllables in a foot), Pankti (10 syllables in a foot); Anustup (8 syllables in a foot) and Tristup (11 syllables in a foot).
verses.hindi: योगी-महादेब-विष्णु आदि। ये लोग परम योगी हैं। तर्पयन्त्यर्चयन्त्येतान् ब्रह्मविद्यामवाप्नुयुः
verses.wordMeaning: The horses of the sun are the metres viz. Gayatri (It has 6 syllables in a quarter); Brhati (9 syllables in a quarter or foot); Usnik (7 syllables in a foot); Jagati (12 syllables in a foot), Pankti (10 syllables in a foot);…
verses.commentary: Sense: The horses of the sun are the metres viz. Gayatri (It has 6 syllables in a quarter); Brhati (9 syllables in a quarter or foot); Usnik (7 syllables in a foot); Jagati (12 syllables in a foot), Pankti (10 syllables in a foot);…

verses.sanskrit: न सोमस्य विनाशः स्यात् सुधा देवैस्तु पीयते । एवं सूर्यनिमित्तस्य क्षयो वृद्धिश्च सत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: na somasya vināśaḥ syāt sudhā devaistu pīyate / evaṃ sūryanimittasya kṣayo vṛddhiśca sattamāḥ
verses.translation: The horses of the sun are the metres viz. Gayatri (It has 6 syllables in a quarter); Brhati (9 syllables in a quarter or foot); Usnik (7 syllables in a foot); Jagati (12 syllables in a foot), Pankti (10 syllables in a foot); Anustup (8 syllables in a foot) and Tristup (11 syllables in a foot).
verses.hindi: अयं वः कथितो ह्यंशः पूर्वो नारायणेरितः । भूतभव्यैर्वर्तमानैराख्यानैरुपबृंहितः
verses.wordMeaning: The horses of the sun are the metres viz. Gayatri (It has 6 syllables in a quarter); Brhati (9 syllables in a quarter or foot); Usnik (7 syllables in a foot); Jagati (12 syllables in a foot), Pankti (10 syllables in a foot);…
verses.commentary: Sense: The horses of the sun are the metres viz. Gayatri (It has 6 syllables in a quarter); Brhati (9 syllables in a quarter or foot); Usnik (7 syllables in a foot); Jagati (12 syllables in a foot), Pankti (10 syllables in a foot);…

verses.sanskrit: सोमपुत्रस्य चाष्टाभिर्वाजिभिर्वायुवेगिभिः । वारिजैः स्यन्दनो युक्तस्तेनासौ याति सर्वतः
verses.transliteration: somaputrasya cāṣṭābhirvājibhirvāyuvegibhiḥ / vārijaiḥ syandano yuktastenāsau yāti sarvataḥ
verses.translation: The horses of the sun are the metres viz. Gayatri (It has 6 syllables in a quarter); Brhati (9 syllables in a quarter or foot); Usnik (7 syllables in a foot); Jagati (12 syllables in a foot), Pankti (10 syllables in a foot); Anustup (8 syllables in a foot) and Tristup (11 syllables in a foot).
verses.hindi: स सर्वपापनिर्मुक्तो ब्रह्मणा सह मोदते पठेद् देवालये स्नात्वा नदीतीरेषु चैव हि। नारायणं नमस्कृत्य भावेन पुरुषोत्तमम्
verses.wordMeaning: The horses of the sun are the metres viz. Gayatri (It has 6 syllables in a quarter); Brhati (9 syllables in a quarter or foot); Usnik (7 syllables in a foot); Jagati (12 syllables in a foot), Pankti (10 syllables in a foot);…
verses.commentary: Sense: The horses of the sun are the metres viz. Gayatri (It has 6 syllables in a quarter); Brhati (9 syllables in a quarter or foot); Usnik (7 syllables in a foot); Jagati (12 syllables in a foot), Pankti (10 syllables in a foot);…

verses.sanskrit: शुक्रस्य भूमिजैरश्वैः स्यन्दनो दशभिर्वृतः । अष्टबिश्चाथ भौमस्य रथो हैमः सुशोभनः
verses.transliteration: śukrasya bhūmijairaśvaiḥ syandano daśabhirvṛtaḥ / aṣṭabiścātha bhaumasya ratho haimaḥ suśobhanaḥ
verses.translation: The horses of the sun are the metres viz. Gayatri (It has 6 syllables in a quarter); Brhati (9 syllables in a quarter or foot); Usnik (7 syllables in a foot); Jagati (12 syllables in a foot), Pankti (10 syllables in a foot); Anustup (8 syllables in a foot) and Tristup (11 syllables in a foot).
verses.hindi: नमो देवादिदेवाय देवानां परमात्मने। पुरुषाय पुराणाय विष्णवे कूर्मरूपिणे
verses.wordMeaning: The horses of the sun are the metres viz. Gayatri (It has 6 syllables in a quarter); Brhati (9 syllables in a quarter or foot); Usnik (7 syllables in a foot); Jagati (12 syllables in a foot), Pankti (10 syllables in a foot);…
verses.commentary: Sense: The horses of the sun are the metres viz. Gayatri (It has 6 syllables in a quarter); Brhati (9 syllables in a quarter or foot); Usnik (7 syllables in a foot); Jagati (12 syllables in a foot), Pankti (10 syllables in a foot);…

verses.sanskrit: बृहस्पतेरथाष्टाश्वः स्यन्दनो हेमनिर्मितः । रथस्तमोमयो ऽष्टाश्वो मन्दस्यायसनिर्मितः । स्वर्भानोर्भास्करारेश्च तथा षड्भिर्हयैर्वृतः
verses.transliteration: bṛhaspaterathāṣṭāśvaḥ syandano hemanirmitaḥ / rathastamomayo 'ṣṭāśvo mandasyāyasanirmitaḥ / svarbhānorbhāskarāreśca tathā ṣaḍbhirhayairvṛtaḥ
verses.translation: The horses of the sun are the metres viz. Gayatri (It has 6 syllables in a quarter); Brhati (9 syllables in a quarter or foot); Usnik (7 syllables in a foot); Jagati (12 syllables in a foot), Pankti (10 syllables in a foot); Anustup (8 syllables in a foot) and Tristup (11 syllables in a foot).
verses.hindi: जो ब्राह्मण सर्वदा इनका स्मरण करते हैं, इन्हें नमस्कार करते हैं, इनका तर्पण करते हैं और इनकी पूजा करते हैं, वे ब्रह्मविद्याको प्राप्त कर लेते हैं। वैवस्वत मन्वन्तरका विस्तारसे वर्णन किया। सावर्ण (आठवाँ) तथा (नवाँ) दक्षसावर्ण मन्वन्तर भविष्यमें होंगे। दसवाँ ब्रह्मसावर्ण, ग्यारहवाँ धर्मसावर्ण, बारहवाँ रुद्रसावर्ण तथा तेरहवाँ रोचमान मन्वन्तर है । चौदहवाँ भौत्य मन्वन्तर कहा गया है। ये मनु क्रमसे भविष्यमें
verses.wordMeaning: The horses of the sun are the metres viz. Gayatri (It has 6 syllables in a quarter); Brhati (9 syllables in a quarter or foot); Usnik (7 syllables in a foot); Jagati (12 syllables in a foot), Pankti (10 syllables in a foot);…
verses.commentary: Sense: The horses of the sun are the metres viz. Gayatri (It has 6 syllables in a quarter); Brhati (9 syllables in a quarter or foot); Usnik (7 syllables in a foot); Jagati (12 syllables in a foot), Pankti (10 syllables in a foot);…

verses.sanskrit: एते महाग्रहाणां वै समाख्याता रथा नव । सर्वे ध्रुवे महाभागा निबद्धा वातरश्मिभिः
verses.transliteration: ete mahāgrahāṇāṃ vai samākhyātā rathā nava / sarve dhruve mahābhāgā nibaddhā vātaraśmibhiḥ
verses.translation: The horses of the sun are the metres viz. Gayatri (It has 6 syllables in a quarter); Brhati (9 syllables in a quarter or foot); Usnik (7 syllables in a foot); Jagati (12 syllables in a foot), Pankti (10 syllables in a foot); Anustup (8 syllables in a foot) and Tristup (11 syllables in a foot).
verses.hindi: मैंने नारायणद्वारा कहे गये भूत, भविष्य तथा वर्तमानके आख्यानोंसे उपबृंहित इस पूर्वभागको आप लोगोंसे कहा। जो (ब्राह्मण) इसे पढ़ेगा, सुनेगा अथवा श्रेष्ठ द्विजोंको सुनायेगा, बह सभी पापोंसे मुक्त होकर
verses.wordMeaning: The horses of the sun are the metres viz. Gayatri (It has 6 syllables in a quarter); Brhati (9 syllables in a quarter or foot); Usnik (7 syllables in a foot); Jagati (12 syllables in a foot), Pankti (10 syllables in a foot);…
verses.commentary: Sense: The horses of the sun are the metres viz. Gayatri (It has 6 syllables in a quarter); Brhati (9 syllables in a quarter or foot); Usnik (7 syllables in a foot); Jagati (12 syllables in a foot), Pankti (10 syllables in a foot);…

verses.sanskrit: ग्रहर्क्षताराधिष्ण्यानि ध्रुवे बद्धान्येशेषतः । भ्रमन्ति भ्रामयन्त्येनं सर्वाण्यनिलरश्मिभिः
verses.transliteration: graharkṣatārādhiṣṇyāni dhruve baddhānyeśeṣataḥ / bhramanti bhrāmayantyenaṃ sarvāṇyanilaraśmibhiḥ
verses.translation: The horses of the sun are the metres viz. Gayatri (It has 6 syllables in a quarter); Brhati (9 syllables in a quarter or foot); Usnik (7 syllables in a foot); Jagati (12 syllables in a foot), Pankti (10 syllables in a foot); Anustup (8 syllables in a foot) and Tristup (11 syllables in a foot).
verses.hindi: ब्रह्माके साथ आनन्द प्राप्त करेगा। स्नान करनेके अनन्तर नदियोंके किनारोॉंपर अथवा देवमन्दिरमें भक्तिभावसे पुरुषोत्तम नारायणको नमस्कार कर इसका पाठ करना चाहिए  देवोंके आदिदेव, देवोंके परमात्मा, पुराण पुरुष कूर्मरूपी विष्णुको नमस्कार है॥ ३२--३५॥
verses.wordMeaning: The horses of the sun are the metres viz. Gayatri (It has 6 syllables in a quarter); Brhati (9 syllables in a quarter or foot); Usnik (7 syllables in a foot); Jagati (12 syllables in a foot), Pankti (10 syllables in a foot);…
verses.commentary: Sense: The horses of the sun are the metres viz. Gayatri (It has 6 syllables in a quarter); Brhati (9 syllables in a quarter or foot); Usnik (7 syllables in a foot); Jagati (12 syllables in a foot), Pankti (10 syllables in a foot);…

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे एकचत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः सूत उवाच ध्रुवादूर्ध्वं महर्लोकः कोटियोजनविस्तृतः । कल्पाधिकारिणस्तत्र संस्थिता द्विजपुङ्गवाः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge ekacatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca dhruvādūrdhvaṃ maharlokaḥ koṭiyojanavistṛtaḥ / kalpādhikāriṇastatra saṃsthitā dvijapuṅgavāḥ
verses.translation: Taking with him the constellations of the Zodiac, Pitamaha (i.e. the sun-god), the lord of gods, moves rapidly to the Southern direction like a discharged shaft.
verses.hindi: द्विजोंको आगे करके पुराण-श्रवबण करानेकी विधि है। पुराण-श्रवणका अधिकार अन्य वर्णोको भी है । द्विज मुख्यरूपसे सात्त्विक वृत्तिके होते हैं तथा प्राणिमात्रका कल्याण ही इनका लक्ष्य होता है, इसीलिये इसकी प्रमुखता है।
verses.wordMeaning: Taking with him the constellations of the Zodiac, Pitamaha (i.e. the sun-god), the lord of gods, moves rapidly to the Southern direction like a discharged shaft.
verses.commentary: Sense: Taking with him the constellations of the Zodiac, Pitamaha (i.e. the sun-god), the lord of gods, moves rapidly to the Southern direction like a discharged shaft.

verses.sanskrit: जनलोको महर्लोकात् तथा कोटिद्वयातमकः । सनन्दनादयस्तत्र संस्थिता ब्रह्मणः सुताः
verses.transliteration: janaloko maharlokāt tathā koṭidvayātamakaḥ / sanandanādayastatra saṃsthitā brahmaṇaḥ sutāḥ
verses.translation: O leading Brahmantis! In the seven continents, the sun at mid-day and at middle of the night always stands face to face (i.e. faces opposite directions).
verses.hindi: ब्रह्माण्डस्यास्य विस्तारो मन्वन्तरविनिश्चयः तत्रेश्वरेश्वरो देवो वर्णिभिर्धर्मतत्परैः । ज्ञानयोगरतैर्नित्यमाराध्यः कथितस्त्वया
verses.wordMeaning: O leading Brahmantis! In the seven continents, the sun at mid-day and at middle of the night always stands face to face (i.e. faces opposite directions).
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading Brahmantis! In the seven continents, the sun at mid-day and at middle of the night always stands face to face (i.e. faces opposite directions).

verses.sanskrit: जलोकात् तपोलोकः कोटित्रयसमन्वितः । वैराजास्तत्र वै देवाः स्थिता दाहविवर्जिताः
verses.transliteration: jalokāt tapolokaḥ koṭitrayasamanvitaḥ / vairājāstatra vai devāḥ sthitā dāhavivarjitāḥ
verses.translation: The rising and the setting of the sun are always opposed (to each other comparatively) in different directions as well as in the intermediate quarters, O prominent Brahmanas.
verses.hindi: त्वं हि नारायणात् साक्षात् कृष्णद्वैपायनात् प्रभो । अवाप्ताखिलविज्ञानस्तत्त्वां पृच्छामहे पुन:
verses.wordMeaning: The rising and the setting of the sun are always opposed (to each other comparatively) in different directions as well as in the intermediate quarters, O prominent Brahmanas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The rising and the setting of the sun are always opposed (to each other comparatively) in different directions as well as in the intermediate quarters, O prominent Brahmanas.

verses.sanskrit: प्राजापत्यात् सत्यलोकः कोटिषट्केन संयुतः । अपुनर्मारकास्तत्र ब्रह्मलोकस्तु स स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: prājāpatyāt satyalokaḥ koṭiṣaṭkena saṃyutaḥ / apunarmārakāstatra brahmalokastu sa smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: While this Lord (the sun-god) moves like the rotating wheel of a potter, he makes the night* as he leaves the earth, O Brahmanas.
verses.hindi: आजगाम मुनिश्रेष्ठा यत्र सत्रं समासते तं दृष्टा वेदविद्वांसं कालमेघसमद्युतिम्। व्यासं कमलपत्राक्षं प्रणेमुद्विजिपुंगवाः
verses.wordMeaning: While this Lord (the sun-god) moves like the rotating wheel of a potter, he makes the night* as he leaves the earth, O Brahmanas.
verses.commentary: Sense: While this Lord (the sun-god) moves like the rotating wheel of a potter, he makes the night* as he leaves the earth, O Brahmanas.

verses.sanskrit: अत्र लोकगुरुर्ब्रह्मा विश्वात्मा विश्वतोमुखः । आस्ते स योगिभिर्नित्यं पीत्वा योगामृतं परम्
verses.transliteration: atra lokagururbrahmā viśvātmā viśvatomukhaḥ / āste sa yogibhirnityaṃ pītvā yogāmṛtaṃ param
verses.translation: The three worlds are illuminated by the rays of the sun; that has been declared £is Trailokya (a triple world) by good persons, to the people, O Brahmanas.
verses.hindi: पृष्टास्तेऽनामयं विप्राः शौनकाद्या महामुनिम्। समाश्चास्यासनं तस्मै तदयोग्यं समकल्पयन्
verses.wordMeaning: The three worlds are illuminated by the rays of the sun; that has been declared £is Trailokya (a triple world) by good persons, to the people, O Brahmanas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The three worlds are illuminated by the rays of the sun; that has been declared £is Trailokya (a triple world) by good persons, to the people, O Brahmanas.

verses.sanskrit: विशन्ति यतयः शान्ता नैष्ठिका ब्रह्मचारिणः । योगिनस्तापसाः सिद्धा जापकाः परमेष्ठिनम्
verses.transliteration: viśanti yatayaḥ śāntā naiṣṭhikā brahmacāriṇaḥ / yoginastāpasāḥ siddhā jāpakāḥ parameṣṭhinam
verses.translation: There is no doubt in this that the three worlds have their original source in the Aditya (the sun god). The entire universe including Devas, Asuras and human beings originates from it.
verses.hindi: ऋषियोंने कहा--(सूतजी!) आपने स्वायम्भुव मन्वन्तरकी सृष्टि तदुपरान्त इस ब्रह्माण्डका विस्तार और (अन्य विभिन्न) मन्वन्तरोंके विषयमें भलीभाति बतलाया तथा उन (मन्वन्तरों)-में धर्मपरायण ज्ञानयोगी वर्णधर्मके अनुयायियोंके नित्य आराध्य ईश्वरोंक ईश्वर देवका भी वर्णन आपने किया। इसीके साथ ही आपने सम्पूर्ण संसारके दुःखोंको नष्ट करनेवाले एकमात्र ब्रह्मविषयक उस उत्तम ज्ञानका भी वर्णन किया, जिसके द्वारा हम उस
verses.wordMeaning: There is no doubt in this that the three worlds have their original source in the Aditya (the sun god). The entire universe including Devas, Asuras and human beings originates from it.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no doubt in this that the three worlds have their original source in the Aditya (the sun god). The entire universe including Devas, Asuras and human beings originates from it.

verses.sanskrit: द्वारं तद्योगिनामेकं गच्छतां परमं पदम् । तत्र गत्वा न शोचन्ति स विष्णुः स च शङ्करः
verses.transliteration: dvāraṃ tadyogināmekaṃ gacchatāṃ paramaṃ padam / tatra gatvā na śocanti sa viṣṇuḥ sa ca śaṅkaraḥ
verses.translation: The lustrous sun conquered the worlds of Rudra, Indra, Upendra (Visnu), Candra (the moon), of the leading Brahmanas and the heaven dwellers. ♦He conquered the worlds.
verses.hindi: परम तत्त्वको देख सकते हैं । प्रभो! आपने साक्षात् नारायण कृष्णद्वैपायन (व्यासजी)-से सम्पूर्ण तत्त्वज्ञान प्राप्त किया है, इसलिये हम आपसे पुनः पूछते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: The lustrous sun conquered the worlds of Rudra, Indra, Upendra (Visnu), Candra (the moon), of the leading Brahmanas and the heaven dwellers. ♦He conquered the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lustrous sun conquered the worlds of Rudra, Indra, Upendra (Visnu), Candra (the moon), of the leading Brahmanas and the heaven dwellers. ♦He conquered the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: सूर्यकोटिप्रतीकाशं पुरं तस्य दुरासदम् । न मे वर्णयितुं शक्यं ज्वालामालासमाकुलम्
verses.transliteration: sūryakoṭipratīkāśaṃ puraṃ tasya durāsadam / na me varṇayituṃ śakyaṃ jvālāmālāsamākulam
verses.translation: This sun is the Atman of all; is the lord of the worlds; he is the great Deva and Prajapati; he is the root of this world; he is the greatest deity.
verses.hindi: मुनियोंके उस वाक्यको सुनकर पौराणिक सूतजीने प्रभु कृष्ण-द्वैपायनका स्मरणकर कहना प्रारम्भ किया। इसी बीच कृष्ण-द्वैपायन व्यास स्वयं वहाँ पहुँच गये जहाँ श्रेष्ठ मुनिजन यज्ञ कर रहे थे। कृष्ण मेघके समान द्युतिवाले तथा कमलपत्रके समान नेत्रवाले उन वेदके विद्वान् व्यासजीको देखकर श्रेष्ठ द्विजोंने उन्हें
verses.wordMeaning: This sun is the Atman of all; is the lord of the worlds; he is the great Deva and Prajapati; he is the root of this world; he is the greatest deity.
verses.commentary: Sense: This sun is the Atman of all; is the lord of the worlds; he is the great Deva and Prajapati; he is the root of this world; he is the greatest deity.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र नारायणस्यापि भवनं ब्रह्मणः पुरे । शेते तत्र हरिः श्रीमान् मायी मायामयः परः
verses.transliteration: tatra nārāyaṇasyāpi bhavanaṃ brahmaṇaḥ pure / śete tatra hariḥ śrīmān māyī māyāmayaḥ paraḥ
verses.translation: There are other twelve Adityas (sons of Aditi); they are Devas who are authorised and who fulfil their duties. They are the parts of Visnu; they are the different forms of Visnu.
verses.hindi: रोमहर्षण सूतजीने भी उन्हें देखकर भूमिपर गिरकर दण्डवत् प्रणाम किया और गुरुकी प्रदक्षिणाकर हाथ जोड़ते हुए उनके पार्श्वभागमें खड़े हो गये। महामुनि (व्यास)-के द्वारा आरोग्यके विषयमें प्रश्‍न पूछे जानेपर
verses.wordMeaning: There are other twelve Adityas (sons of Aditi); they are Devas who are authorised and who fulfil their duties. They are the parts of Visnu; they are the different forms of Visnu.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are other twelve Adityas (sons of Aditi); they are Devas who are authorised and who fulfil their duties. They are the parts of Visnu; they are the different forms of Visnu.

verses.sanskrit: स विष्णुलोकः कथितः पुनरावृत्तिवर्जितः । यान्ति तत्र महात्मानो ये प्रपन्ना जनार्दनम्
verses.transliteration: sa viṣṇulokaḥ kathitaḥ punarāvṛttivarjitaḥ / yānti tatra mahātmāno ye prapannā janārdanam
verses.translation: All including Gandharvas, Yaksas, serpents, Kinnaras and others make obeisance to the thousand armed deity; the leading sages worship the ancient deity the embodi¬ ment of the Chandas (vedic metre) and the eternal Brahman, by means of different Yajnas.
verses.hindi: उसका यथोचित उत्तर देकर शौनक आदि महामुनियोंने व्यासजीको आश्वस्त किया तथा उनके योग्य आसन उन्हें प्रदान किया तदनन्तर पराशरजीके पुत्र प्रभु (व्यास)-ने उनसे पूछा-क्या आप लोगोंके तप, स्वाध्याय तथा श्रवण किये गये वेदादिकी हानि तो नहीं हो रही है?
verses.wordMeaning: All including Gandharvas, Yaksas, serpents, Kinnaras and others make obeisance to the thousand armed deity; the leading sages worship the ancient deity the embodi¬ ment of the Chandas (vedic metre) and the eternal Brahman, by means of different Yajnas.
verses.commentary: Sense: All including Gandharvas, Yaksas, serpents, Kinnaras and others make obeisance to the thousand armed deity; the leading sages worship the ancient deity the embodi¬ ment of the Chandas (vedic metre) and the eternal Brahman, by means of different Yajnas.

verses.sanskrit: ऊर्ध्वं तद् ब्रह्मसदनात् पुरं ज्योतिर्मयं शुभम् । वह्निना च परिक्षिप्तं तत्रास्ते भगवान् भवः
verses.transliteration: ūrdhvaṃ tad brahmasadanāt puraṃ jyotirmayaṃ śubham / vahninā ca parikṣiptaṃ tatrāste bhagavān bhavaḥ
verses.translation: These twelve Adityas (Sun-gods) are supposed to be the portions or amSas of the sun-god and the twelve forms of Visnu. The provision of ages, Gandharvas, celestial damsels, etc. to each (minor) sun-god is a Puranic concept of solar paraphernalia. The deities of these attendants (Gandharvas, Apsaras, Yaksas, sages, etc.) are detailed in this chapter.
verses.hindi: तब उन सूतने अपने गुरु महामुनि (व्यास)-को प्रणामकर
verses.wordMeaning: These twelve Adityas (Sun-gods) are supposed to be the portions or amSas of the sun-god and the twelve forms of Visnu. The provision of ages, Gandharvas, celestial damsels, etc. to each (minor) sun-god is a Puranic concept of solar paraphernalia.…
verses.commentary: Sense: These twelve Adityas (Sun-gods) are supposed to be the portions or amSas of the sun-god and the twelve forms of Visnu. The provision of ages, Gandharvas, celestial damsels, etc. to each (minor) sun-god is a Puranic concept of solar paraphernalia.…

verses.sanskrit: देव्या सह महादेवश्चिन्त्यमानो मनीषिभिः । योगिभिः शतसाहस्त्रैर्भूतै रुद्रैश्च संवृतः
verses.transliteration: devyā saha mahādevaścintyamāno manīṣibhiḥ / yogibhiḥ śatasāhastrairbhūtai rudraiśca saṃvṛtaḥ
verses.translation: The Gandharvas and Apsaras worship him by singing songs and performing dances. The presiding deities of villages — (Gramanis), Yaksas and Bhutas hold the reins.
verses.hindi: ततः स सूतः स्वगुरुं प्रणम्याह महामुनिम्। ज्ञानं तद् ब्रह्मविषयं मुनीनां वक्तुमर्हसि इमे हि मुनयः शान्तास्तापसा धर्मतत्पराः । शुश्रूषा जायते चैषां वक्तुमर्हसि तत्त्वत:
verses.wordMeaning: The Gandharvas and Apsaras worship him by singing songs and performing dances. The presiding deities of villages — (Gramanis), Yaksas and Bhutas hold the reins.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Gandharvas and Apsaras worship him by singing songs and performing dances. The presiding deities of villages — (Gramanis), Yaksas and Bhutas hold the reins.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र ते यान्ति नियता द्विजा वै ब्रह्मचारिणः । मदादेवपराः शान्तास्तापसा ब्रह्मवादिनः
verses.transliteration: tatra te yānti niyatā dvijā vai brahmacāriṇaḥ / madādevaparāḥ śāntāstāpasā brahmavādinaḥ
verses.translation: The serpents bear the lord of Devas; the Yatudhanas go ahead of him. The Valakhilyas (thumb-sized sages) surround the rising sun and go along with him till sunset.
verses.hindi: मुनीनां व्याहृतं पूर्व विष्णुना कूर्मरूपिणा
verses.wordMeaning: The serpents bear the lord of Devas; the Yatudhanas go ahead of him. The Valakhilyas (thumb-sized sages) surround the rising sun and go along with him till sunset.
verses.commentary: Sense: The serpents bear the lord of Devas; the Yatudhanas go ahead of him. The Valakhilyas (thumb-sized sages) surround the rising sun and go along with him till sunset.

verses.sanskrit: निर्ममा निरहङ्काराः कामक्रोधविवर्जिताः । द्रक्ष्यन्ति ब्रह्मणा युक्ता रुद्रलोकः स वै स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: nirmamā nirahaṅkārāḥ kāmakrodhavivarjitāḥ / drakṣyanti brahmaṇā yuktā rudralokaḥ sa vai smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: They are glorified as those who give heat, shower rain, shine, blow, create, and annihilate the inauspicious activities of living beings.
verses.hindi: श्रुत्वा सूतस्य वचनं मुनिः सत्यवतीसुतः । प्रणम्य शिरसा रुद्रं वचः प्राह सुखावहम् वक्ष्ये देवो महादेवः पृष्टो योगीश्वरे: पुरा। सनत्कुमारप्रमुखैः स्वयं यत् समभाषत
verses.wordMeaning: They are glorified as those who give heat, shower rain, shine, blow, create, and annihilate the inauspicious activities of living beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are glorified as those who give heat, shower rain, shine, blow, create, and annihilate the inauspicious activities of living beings.

verses.sanskrit: एते सप्त महालोकाः पृथिव्याः परिकीर्तिताः । महातलादयश्चाधः पातालाः सन्ति वै द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: ete sapta mahālokāḥ pṛthivyāḥ parikīrtitāḥ / mahātalādayaścādhaḥ pātālāḥ santi vai dvijāḥ
verses.translation: These followers of the sun accompany the sun as he moves on in heaven. They are always seated in the aerial chariot that has the velocity of wind and that can go wherever it wishes to go.
verses.hindi: अङ्गिरा रुद्रसहितो भृगुः परमधर्मवित्
verses.wordMeaning: These followers of the sun accompany the sun as he moves on in heaven. They are always seated in the aerial chariot that has the velocity of wind and that can go wherever it wishes to go.
verses.commentary: Sense: These followers of the sun accompany the sun as he moves on in heaven. They are always seated in the aerial chariot that has the velocity of wind and that can go wherever it wishes to go.

verses.sanskrit: महातलं च पातालं सर्वरत्नोपशोभितम् । प्रासादैर्विविधैः शुभ्रैर्देवतायतनैर्युतम्
verses.transliteration: mahātalaṃ ca pātālaṃ sarvaratnopaśobhitam / prāsādairvividhaiḥ śubhrairdevatāyatanairyutam
verses.translation: They protect all living beings in due order of Yugas (v.l. end of Yugas) by showering rains, giving heat and by delighting the people.
verses.hindi: कणादः कपिलो योगी वामदेवो महामुनिः । शुक्रो वसिष्ठो भगवान् सर्वे संयतमानसाः तप्तवन्तस्तपो घोरं पुण्ये बदरिकाश्रमे
verses.wordMeaning: They protect all living beings in due order of Yugas (v.l. end of Yugas) by showering rains, giving heat and by delighting the people.
verses.commentary: Sense: They protect all living beings in due order of Yugas (v.l. end of Yugas) by showering rains, giving heat and by delighting the people.

verses.sanskrit: अनन्तेन च संयुक्तं मुचुकुन्देन धीमता । नृपेण बलिना चैव पातालस्वर्गवासिना
verses.transliteration: anantena ca saṃyuktaṃ mucukundena dhīmatā / nṛpeṇa balinā caiva pātālasvargavāsinā
verses.translation: Lord sun gives heat in accordance with the virility, penance, yogic power and the inherent vigour of Devas.
verses.hindi: अपश्यंस्ते महायोगमृषिं धर्मसुतं शुचिम्। नारायणमनाद्यन्तं नरेण सहितं तदा
verses.wordMeaning: Lord sun gives heat in accordance with the virility, penance, yogic power and the inherent vigour of Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord sun gives heat in accordance with the virility, penance, yogic power and the inherent vigour of Devas.

verses.sanskrit: शैलं रसातलं विप्राः शार्करं हि तलातलम् । पीतं सुतलमित्युक्तं नितलं विद्रुमप्रभम् । सितं हि वितलं प्रोक्तं तलं चैव सितेतरम्
verses.transliteration: śailaṃ rasātalaṃ viprāḥ śārkaraṃ hi talātalam / pītaṃ sutalamityuktaṃ nitalaṃ vidrumaprabham / sitaṃ hi vitalaṃ proktaṃ talaṃ caiva sitetaram
verses.translation: That Prajapati (Lord of subjects) is the cause of demarcation of night and day. The sun nourishes perpetually the Pitrs, Devas, human beings and others.
verses.hindi: विज्ञाय वाञ्छितं तेषां भगवानपि सर्ववित्। प्राह गम्भीरया वाचा किमर्थ तप्यते तपः साक्षान्नारायणं देवमागतं सिद्धिसूचकम्
verses.wordMeaning: That Prajapati (Lord of subjects) is the cause of demarcation of night and day. The sun nourishes perpetually the Pitrs, Devas, human beings and others.
verses.commentary: Sense: That Prajapati (Lord of subjects) is the cause of demarcation of night and day. The sun nourishes perpetually the Pitrs, Devas, human beings and others.

verses.sanskrit: सुपर्णेन मुनिश्रेष्ठास्तथा वासुकिना शुभम् । रसातलमिति ख्यातं तथान्यैश्च निषेवितम्
verses.transliteration: suparṇena muniśreṣṭhāstathā vāsukinā śubham / rasātalamiti khyātaṃ tathānyaiśca niṣevitam
verses.translation: The great lord, the radiant sun, is Lord Mahesvara himself. The eternal blue-necked lord (Siva) of those who know the Vedas, shines forth.
verses.hindi: बयं संशयमापन्नाः सर्वे वै ब्रह्मवादिनः ।
verses.wordMeaning: The great lord, the radiant sun, is Lord Mahesvara himself. The eternal blue-necked lord (Siva) of those who know the Vedas, shines forth.
verses.commentary: Sense: The great lord, the radiant sun, is Lord Mahesvara himself. The eternal blue-necked lord (Siva) of those who know the Vedas, shines forth.

verses.sanskrit: विरोचनहिरण्याक्षतक्षकाद्यैश्च सेवितम् । तलातलमिति ख्यातं सर्वशोभासमन्वितम्
verses.transliteration: virocanahiraṇyākṣatakṣakādyaiśca sevitam / talātalamiti khyātaṃ sarvaśobhāsamanvitam
verses.translation: It is this god who is the progenitor of the world, Paramesthin. The knowers of the Vedas, the embodiments of the Vedas know that his abode is in the Sun-god Aditya.
verses.hindi: त्वं हि तद् वेत्थ परमं सर्वज्ञो भगवानृषिः। नारायणः स्वयं साक्षात् पुराणोऽव्यक्तपूरुषः किं कारणमिदं कृत्स्नं कोऽनुसंसरते सदा। कश्चिदात्मा च का मुक्तिः संसारः किंनिमित्तकः
verses.wordMeaning: It is this god who is the progenitor of the world, Paramesthin. The knowers of the Vedas, the embodiments of the Vedas know that his abode is in the Sun-god Aditya.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is this god who is the progenitor of the world, Paramesthin. The knowers of the Vedas, the embodiments of the Vedas know that his abode is in the Sun-god Aditya.

verses.sanskrit: वैनतेयादिभिश्चैव कालनेमिपुरोगमैः । पूर्वदेवैः समाकीर्णं सुतलं च तथापरैः
verses.transliteration: vainateyādibhiścaiva kālanemipurogamaiḥ / pūrvadevaiḥ samākīrṇaṃ sutalaṃ ca tathāparaiḥ
verses.translation: Puranas evince great interest in cosmogony, cosmology and cosmo¬ graphy as an area lying between philosophy and theology. They are more interested in trying to solve the mysteries of the supreme soul and the universe rather than the matter-of-fact world around them. This topic has been discussed practically in all Puranas like the Bh.P. (V. 16.1-25), NP. (1.3.37-49). Though the imaginary nature of their concepts is obvious, we may, however, suggest that the idea of the planets receiving their power and existence from the rays of the sun might be the Puranic way of suggesting that all planets are born from the sun.
verses.hindi: कहा-आप ब्रह्मविषयक ज्ञान मुनियोंको बतलायें। ये मुनि शान्त, तपस्वी तथा धर्मपरायण हैं। इन्हें सुननेको इच्छा है, आप (कुपया) यधार्थरूपसे ब्रह्मविषयक सर्वोच्च ज्ञानका उपदेश करें। मोक्ष प्रदान करनेवाले
verses.wordMeaning: Puranas evince great interest in cosmogony, cosmology and cosmo¬ graphy as an area lying between philosophy and theology. They are more interested in trying to solve the mysteries of the supreme soul and the universe rather than the matter-of-fact world around them.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Puranas evince great interest in cosmogony, cosmology and cosmo¬ graphy as an area lying between philosophy and theology. They are more interested in trying to solve the mysteries of the supreme soul and the universe rather than the matter-of-fact world around them.…

verses.sanskrit: नितलं यवनाद्यैश्च तारकाग्निमुखैस्तथा । महान्तकाद्यैर्नागैश्च प्रह्मादेनासुरेण च
verses.transliteration: nitalaṃ yavanādyaiśca tārakāgnimukhaistathā / mahāntakādyairnāgaiśca prahmādenāsureṇa ca
verses.translation: O Brahmanas, out of his rays which are the illuminators of the worlds, the most excellent among them are the seven rays, the purifiers of the houses (v.l. graha-yonayah —"sources of planets").
verses.hindi: जिस दिव्य ज्ञानको आपने मुझे तथा पूर्वकालमें कूर्मरूप धारणकर विष्णुने मुनियोंको बतलाया था (इस समय आप उसी ज्ञानका उपदेश दें) । सूतके वचन सुनकर सत्यवतीके पुत्र मुनि (व्यास)-ने रुद्रको मस्तकद्वारा प्रणामकर सुखदायक वचन कहा
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas, out of his rays which are the illuminators of the worlds, the most excellent among them are the seven rays, the purifiers of the houses (v.l. graha-yonayah —"sources of planets").
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas, out of his rays which are the illuminators of the worlds, the most excellent among them are the seven rays, the purifiers of the houses (v.l. graha-yonayah —"sources of planets").

verses.sanskrit: वितलं चैव विख्यातं कम्बलाहीन्द्रसेवितम् । महाजम्भेन वीरेण हयग्रीवेण वै तथा
verses.transliteration: vitalaṃ caiva vikhyātaṃ kambalāhīndrasevitam / mahājambhena vīreṇa hayagrīveṇa vai tathā
verses.translation: O Brahmanas, out of his rays which are the illuminators of the worlds, the most excellent among them are the seven rays, the purifiers of the houses (v.l. graha-yonayah —"sources of planets").
verses.hindi: व्यासजी बोले--प्राचीन कालमें सनत्कुमार आदि प्रमुख योगीश्वरोंद्वारा पूछनेपर स्वयं प्रभु महादेवने जो कहा था, उसीको मैं कहता हूँ। सनत्कुमार, सनक, सनन्दन, अंगिरा, रुद्रसहित परम धर्मज्ञ भृगु, कणाद,
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas, out of his rays which are the illuminators of the worlds, the most excellent among them are the seven rays, the purifiers of the houses (v.l. graha-yonayah —"sources of planets").
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas, out of his rays which are the illuminators of the worlds, the most excellent among them are the seven rays, the purifiers of the houses (v.l. graha-yonayah —"sources of planets").

verses.sanskrit: शङ्कुकर्णेन संभिन्नं तथा नमुचिपूर्वकैः । तथान्यैर्विवधैर्नागैस्तलं चैव सुशोभनम्
verses.transliteration: śaṅkukarṇena saṃbhinnaṃ tathā namucipūrvakaiḥ / tathānyairvivadhairnāgaistalaṃ caiva suśobhanam
verses.translation: O Brahmanas, out of his rays which are the illuminators of the worlds, the most excellent among them are the seven rays, the purifiers of the houses (v.l. graha-yonayah —"sources of planets").
verses.hindi: कपिल, योगी महामुनि वामदेव, शुक्र तथा भगवान् वसिष्ठ--इन सभी संयमित चित्तवाले मुनियोंने संशयान्वित होनेपर परस्पर परामर्श करके पवित्र बदरिकाश्रममें घोर तप किया। तब उन लोगोंने आदि और अन्तसे रहित धर्मपुत्र महायोगी पवित्र नारायण नामक ऋषिका नरके साथ दर्शन किया। उन भक्तिसम्पन्न योगियोंने वेदोंमें वर्णित विविध स्तोत्रोंद्वारा स्तुति करके उन श्रेष्ठ योगीको प्रणाम किया सर्वज्ञ भगवान् (नारायण)-
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas, out of his rays which are the illuminators of the worlds, the most excellent among them are the seven rays, the purifiers of the houses (v.l. graha-yonayah —"sources of planets").
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas, out of his rays which are the illuminators of the worlds, the most excellent among them are the seven rays, the purifiers of the houses (v.l. graha-yonayah —"sources of planets").

verses.sanskrit: तेषामधस्तान्नरका मायाद्याः परिकीर्तिताः । पापिनस्तेषु पच्यन्ते न ते वर्णयितुं क्षमाः
verses.transliteration: teṣāmadhastānnarakā māyādyāḥ parikīrtitāḥ / pāpinasteṣu pacyante na te varṇayituṃ kṣamāḥ
verses.translation: O Brahmanas, out of his rays which are the illuminators of the worlds, the most excellent among them are the seven rays, the purifiers of the houses (v.l. graha-yonayah —"sources of planets").
verses.hindi: ने उनके अभीष्टको जानकर पुनः गम्भीर वाणीमें उनसे पूछा कि आपलोग किस प्रयोजनसे तपस्या कर रहे है ?॥ १५--२१॥
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas, out of his rays which are the illuminators of the worlds, the most excellent among them are the seven rays, the purifiers of the houses (v.l. graha-yonayah —"sources of planets").
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas, out of his rays which are the illuminators of the worlds, the most excellent among them are the seven rays, the purifiers of the houses (v.l. graha-yonayah —"sources of planets").

verses.sanskrit: पातालानामधश्चास्ते शेषाख्या वैष्णवी तनुः । कालाग्निरुद्रो योगात्मा नारसिंहो ऽपि माधवः
verses.transliteration: pātālānāmadhaścāste śeṣākhyā vaiṣṇavī tanuḥ / kālāgnirudro yogātmā nārasiṃho 'pi mādhavaḥ
verses.translation: O Brahmanas, out of his rays which are the illuminators of the worlds, the most excellent among them are the seven rays, the purifiers of the houses (v.l. graha-yonayah —"sources of planets").
verses.hindi: प्रसन्न मनवाले ऋषियोंने जिनका शुभ आगमन अभीष्ट-सिद्धिकी निश्चित सूचना देता है (ऐसे) उन विश्वात्मा, सनातन साक्षात् नारायणदेवसे कहा- (भगवन्!) हम सभी ब्रह्मवादी संशयमें पड़ गये हैं। आप पुरुषोत्तम हैं, हम एकमात्र आपकी शरणमें आये हैं। आप उस परम तत्त्वको जाननेवाले हैं, सर्वज्ञ, भगवान् ऋषि तथा स्वयं साक्षात् नारायण अव्यक्त पुराणपुरुष हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas, out of his rays which are the illuminators of the worlds, the most excellent among them are the seven rays, the purifiers of the houses (v.l. graha-yonayah —"sources of planets").
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas, out of his rays which are the illuminators of the worlds, the most excellent among them are the seven rays, the purifiers of the houses (v.l. graha-yonayah —"sources of planets").

verses.sanskrit: यो ऽनन्तः पठ्येते देवो नागरूपी जनार्दनः । तदाधारमिदं सर्वं स कालाग्निमपाश्रितः
verses.transliteration: yo 'nantaḥ paṭhyete devo nāgarūpī janārdanaḥ / tadādhāramidaṃ sarvaṃ sa kālāgnimapāśritaḥ
verses.translation: O Brahmanas, out of his rays which are the illuminators of the worlds, the most excellent among them are the seven rays, the purifiers of the houses (v.l. graha-yonayah —"sources of planets").
verses.hindi: परमेश्वर ! आपको छोड़कर अन्य कोई दूसरा जानेवाला नहीं है, हमें सुननेकी इच्छा है, आप सम्पूर्ण संशयको दूर करनेमें समर्थ हैं। इस सम्पूर्ण (कार्यरूप जगत्)-का कारण क्या है? कौन नित्य गतिशील रहता है? आत्मा
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas, out of his rays which are the illuminators of the worlds, the most excellent among them are the seven rays, the purifiers of the houses (v.l. graha-yonayah —"sources of planets").
