verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas, out of his rays which are the illuminators of the worlds, the most excellent among them are the seven rays, the purifiers of the houses (v.l. graha-yonayah —"sources of planets").

verses.sanskrit: तमाविश्य महायोगी कालस्तद्वदनोत्थितः । विषज्वालामयो ऽन्ते ऽसौ जगत् संहरति स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: tamāviśya mahāyogī kālastadvadanotthitaḥ / viṣajvālāmayo 'nte 'sau jagat saṃharati svayam
verses.translation: O Brahmanas, out of his rays which are the illuminators of the worlds, the most excellent among them are the seven rays, the purifiers of the houses (v.l. graha-yonayah —"sources of planets").
verses.hindi: कौन है ? मुक्ति क्या है और संसार (-की रचना)-का क्या प्रयोजन है ? इस संसारका चलानेवाला शासक कौन हैं? कः संसारयतीशान: को वा सर्व प्रपश्यति। कि तत् परतरं ब्रह्म सर्व नो वक्तुमर्हसि २७॥
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas, out of his rays which are the illuminators of the worlds, the most excellent among them are the seven rays, the purifiers of the houses (v.l. graha-yonayah —"sources of planets").
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas, out of his rays which are the illuminators of the worlds, the most excellent among them are the seven rays, the purifiers of the houses (v.l. graha-yonayah —"sources of planets").

verses.sanskrit: सहस्त्रमायो ऽप्रतिमः संहर्ता शङ्करोद्भवः । तामसी शांभवी मूर्तिः कालो लोकप्रकालनः
verses.transliteration: sahastramāyo 'pratimaḥ saṃhartā śaṅkarodbhavaḥ / tāmasī śāṃbhavī mūrtiḥ kālo lokaprakālanaḥ
verses.translation: O Brahmanas, out of his rays which are the illuminators of the worlds, the most excellent among them are the seven rays, the purifiers of the houses (v.l. graha-yonayah —"sources of planets").
verses.hindi: श्रीवत्सवक्षसं देवं तप्तजाम्बूनदप्रभम्
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas, out of his rays which are the illuminators of the worlds, the most excellent among them are the seven rays, the purifiers of the houses (v.l. graha-yonayah —"sources of planets").
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas, out of his rays which are the illuminators of the worlds, the most excellent among them are the seven rays, the purifiers of the houses (v.l. graha-yonayah —"sources of planets").

verses.sanskrit: इती श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे द्विचत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः सूत उवाच एतद् ब्रह्माण्डमाख्यातं चतुर्दशविधं महत् । अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि भूर्लोकस्यास्य निर्णयम्
verses.transliteration: itī śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge dvicatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca etad brahmāṇḍamākhyātaṃ caturdaśavidhaṃ mahat / ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi bhūrlokasyāsya nirṇayam
verses.translation: This Susumla is described to be moving sideways (horizontally) and upwards. The ray that is said to be Harikesa is the nourisher of the lustre of the stars.
verses.hindi: न दृष्टस्तत्क्षणादेव नरस्तस्यैब तेजसा तदन्तरे महादेवः शशाङ्काङ्कितशेखरः । प्रसादाभिमुखो रूद्रः प्रादुरासीन्महेश्वरः
verses.wordMeaning: This Susumla is described to be moving sideways (horizontally) and upwards. The ray that is said to be Harikesa is the nourisher of the lustre of the stars.
verses.commentary: Sense: This Susumla is described to be moving sideways (horizontally) and upwards. The ray that is said to be Harikesa is the nourisher of the lustre of the stars.

verses.sanskrit: जम्बुद्वीपः प्रधानो ऽयं प्लक्षः शाल्मल एव च । कुशः क्रौञ्चश्च शाकश्च पुष्करश्चैव सप्तमः
verses.transliteration: jambudvīpaḥ pradhāno 'yaṃ plakṣaḥ śālmala eva ca / kuśaḥ krauñcaśca śākaśca puṣkaraścaiva saptamaḥ
verses.translation: The ray Visvakarman perpetually nurtures Budha (the Mercury). The ray that is named Visvasravas always nourishes Sukra (the Venus).
verses.hindi: जयेश्वर महादेव जय भूतपते शिव। जयाशेषमुनीशान तपसाभिप्रपूजित
verses.wordMeaning: The ray Visvakarman perpetually nurtures Budha (the Mercury). The ray that is named Visvasravas always nourishes Sukra (the Venus).
verses.commentary: Sense: The ray Visvakarman perpetually nurtures Budha (the Mercury). The ray that is named Visvasravas always nourishes Sukra (the Venus).

verses.sanskrit: एते सप्त महाद्वीपाः समुद्रैः सप्तभिर्वृताः । द्वीपाद् द्वीपो महानुक्तः सागरादपि सागरः
verses.transliteration: ete sapta mahādvīpāḥ samudraiḥ saptabhirvṛtāḥ / dvīpād dvīpo mahānuktaḥ sāgarādapi sāgaraḥ
verses.translation: The ray which is well-known as Sarhyadvasu, develops the Mars. The lordly ray Arvavasu affords nourishment to the Jupiter very well.
verses.hindi: जयानन्त जगज्जन्मत्राणसंहारकारण जयाम्बिकापते देव नमस्ते परमेश्वर ३५॥ संस्तुतो भगवानीशस्त््यम्बको भक्तवत्सलः । समालिङ्गथ हृषीकेशं प्राह गम्भीरया गिरा
verses.wordMeaning: The ray which is well-known as Sarhyadvasu, develops the Mars. The lordly ray Arvavasu affords nourishment to the Jupiter very well.
verses.commentary: Sense: The ray which is well-known as Sarhyadvasu, develops the Mars. The lordly ray Arvavasu affords nourishment to the Jupiter very well.

verses.sanskrit: क्षारोदेक्षुरसोदश्च सुरोदश्च घृतोदकः । दध्योदः क्षीरसलिलः स्वादूदश्चेति सागराः
verses.transliteration: kṣārodekṣurasodaśca surodaśca ghṛtodakaḥ / dadhyodaḥ kṣīrasalilaḥ svādūdaśceti sāgarāḥ
verses.translation: He has a thousand rays exuding chillness, rain and heat. Among them four hundred Nadis (i.e. rays) of the variegated forms shower rains.
verses.hindi: किमर्थ पुण्डरीकाक्ष मुनीन्द्रा ब्रह्मवादिनः । इमं समागता देशं किं वा कार्य मयाच्युत
verses.wordMeaning: He has a thousand rays exuding chillness, rain and heat. Among them four hundred Nadis (i.e. rays) of the variegated forms shower rains.
verses.commentary: Sense: He has a thousand rays exuding chillness, rain and heat. Among them four hundred Nadis (i.e. rays) of the variegated forms shower rains.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चाशत्कोटिविस्तीर्णा ससमुद्रा धरा स्मृता । द्वीपैश्च सप्तभिर्युक्ता योजनानां समासतः
verses.transliteration: pañcāśatkoṭivistīrṇā sasamudrā dharā smṛtā / dvīpaiśca saptabhiryuktā yojanānāṃ samāsataḥ
verses.translation: The rays called Candragas, Gahas, Kancanas, Satanas* which are called Nectarine {Amrta) create showers.
verses.hindi: आकर्ण्य भगवद्वाक्यं देवदेवो जनार्दनः । प्राह देवो महादेवं प्रसादाभिमुखं स्थितम् इमे हि मुनयो देव तापसाः क्षीणकल्मषाः । अभ्यागता मां शरणं सम्यग् दर्शनकाङ्किणः
verses.wordMeaning: The rays called Candragas, Gahas, Kancanas, Satanas* which are called Nectarine {Amrta) create showers.
verses.commentary: Sense: The rays called Candragas, Gahas, Kancanas, Satanas* which are called Nectarine {Amrta) create showers.

verses.sanskrit: जम्बूद्वीपः समस्तानां द्वीपानां मध्यतः शुभः । तस्य मध्ये महामेरुर्विश्रुतः कनकप्रभः
verses.transliteration: jambūdvīpaḥ samastānāṃ dvīpānāṃ madhyataḥ śubhaḥ / tasya madhye mahāmerurviśrutaḥ kanakaprabhaḥ
verses.translation: The sun deposits Amrta (nectar) in the immortal beings. Thus in the three beings he deposits the three articles. O Brahmanas, there are eight other planets which are presided over by the sun.
verses.hindi: यदि प्रसन्नो भगवान् मुनीनां भावितात्मनाम् । संनिधौ मम तज्ज्ञानं दिव्यं वक्तुमिहार्हसि
verses.wordMeaning: The sun deposits Amrta (nectar) in the immortal beings. Thus in the three beings he deposits the three articles. O Brahmanas, there are eight other planets which are presided over by the sun.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sun deposits Amrta (nectar) in the immortal beings. Thus in the three beings he deposits the three articles. O Brahmanas, there are eight other planets which are presided over by the sun.

verses.sanskrit: चतुरशीतिसाहस्त्रो योजनैस्तस्य चोच्छ्रयः । प्रविष्टः षोडशाधस्ताद्द्वात्रिंशन्मूर्ध्नि विस्तृतः
verses.transliteration: caturaśītisāhastro yojanaistasya cocchrayaḥ / praviṣṭaḥ ṣoḍaśādhastāddvātriṃśanmūrdhni vistṛtaḥ
verses.translation: They are: the Moon, Mercury, Venus, Jupiter, Mars, Saturn, Rahu and Ketu.
verses.hindi: त्वं हि वेत्थ स्वमात्मानं न ह्यान्यो विद्यते शिव। ततस्त्वमात्मनात्मानं मुनीन्द्रेभ्यः प्रदर्शय एवमुक्त्वा हृषीकेशः प्रोवाच मुनिपुङ्गवान् । प्रदर्शयन् योगसिद्धिं निरीक्ष्य वृषभध्वजम्
verses.wordMeaning: They are: the Moon, Mercury, Venus, Jupiter, Mars, Saturn, Rahu and Ketu.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are: the Moon, Mercury, Venus, Jupiter, Mars, Saturn, Rahu and Ketu.

verses.sanskrit: मूले षोडशसाहस्त्रो विस्तारस्तस्य सर्वतः । भूपद्मास्यास्य शैलो ऽसौ कर्णिकात्वेन संस्थितः
verses.transliteration: mūle ṣoḍaśasāhastro vistārastasya sarvataḥ / bhūpadmāsyāsya śailo 'sau karṇikātvena saṃsthitaḥ
verses.translation: The planets are fixed to the Pole star {Dhruva) by the wind-rays whirling in their own orbit, they follow the sun.
verses.hindi: संदर्शनान्महेशस्य शंकरस्याथ शूलिनः। कृतार्थ स्वयमात्मानं ज्ञातुमर्हथ तत्त्वतः
verses.wordMeaning: The planets are fixed to the Pole star {Dhruva) by the wind-rays whirling in their own orbit, they follow the sun.
verses.commentary: Sense: The planets are fixed to the Pole star {Dhruva) by the wind-rays whirling in their own orbit, they follow the sun.

verses.sanskrit: हिमवान् हेमकूटश्च निषधश्चास्य दक्षिणे । नीलः श्वेतश्च शृङ्गी च उत्तरे वर्षपर्वताः
verses.transliteration: himavān hemakūṭaśca niṣadhaścāsya dakṣiṇe / nīlaḥ śvetaśca śṛṅgī ca uttare varṣaparvatāḥ
verses.translation: They move about like the firebrand in a circle, when urged by the whirlwind. Since the wind propels and bears them, it is named Pravaha.
verses.hindi: अथवा सबका द्रष्टा कौन है ? परात्पर ब्रह्म क्या है? यह सब आप हमें बतलायें॥ २३--२७॥ ऐसा कहे जानेपर मुनियोंने तपस्वी-रूपका परित्याग किये हुए, अपने तेजद्वारा प्रतिष्ठित, प्रकाशमण्डलसे मण्डित, वक्ष:स्थलमें श्रीवत्स धारण किये हुए, तप्त स्वर्णके समान आभावाले और हाथोंमें शंख, चक्र, गदा तथा शार्ङ्ग
verses.wordMeaning: They move about like the firebrand in a circle, when urged by the whirlwind. Since the wind propels and bears them, it is named Pravaha.
verses.commentary: Sense: They move about like the firebrand in a circle, when urged by the whirlwind. Since the wind propels and bears them, it is named Pravaha.

verses.sanskrit: लक्षप्रमाणौ द्वौ मध्ये दशहीनास्तथा परे । सहस्त्रद्वितयोच्छ्रायास्तावद्विस्तारिणश्च ते
verses.transliteration: lakṣapramāṇau dvau madhye daśahīnāstathā pare / sahastradvitayocchrāyāstāvadvistāriṇaśca te
verses.translation: In the bright half of the month, when the sun is in the opposite direction of the moon, the other (back) side of the moon is always filled up with those brilliant rays. (v.l. ever according to the order of the days.)
verses.hindi: नामका धनुष धारण किये हुए लक्ष्मीसहित विमल एवं द्युतिमान् पुरुषोत्तम देवका दर्शन किया । उस समय उन्हींके तेजके कारण नर (ऋषि) नहीं दिखलायी पड़े॥ २८--३०॥
verses.wordMeaning: In the bright half of the month, when the sun is in the opposite direction of the moon, the other (back) side of the moon is always filled up with those brilliant rays. (v.l. ever according to the order of the days.)
verses.commentary: Sense: In the bright half of the month, when the sun is in the opposite direction of the moon, the other (back) side of the moon is always filled up with those brilliant rays. (v.l. ever according to the order of the days.)

verses.sanskrit: भारतं दक्षिणं वर्षं ततः किंपुरुषं स्मृतम् । हरिवर्षं तथैवान्यन्मेरोर्दक्षिणतो द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: bhārataṃ dakṣiṇaṃ varṣaṃ tataḥ kiṃpuruṣaṃ smṛtam / harivarṣaṃ tathaivānyanmerordakṣiṇato dvijāḥ
verses.translation: (In the dark half) when the moon is emaciated and drunk by Devas, the sun nourishes it forever, O Brahmanas, by a single ray called Susumla.
verses.hindi: उसी समय चन्द्रमासे अंकित मस्तकवाले महादेव महेश्वर रुद्र प्रसन्नतापूर्वक प्रकट हुए। चन्द्रभूषण जगन्नाथ त्रिलोचनका दर्शनकर प्रसन्न मनवाले वे सभी (मुनि) भक्तिपूर्वक उन परमेश्वरकी स्तुति करने लगे ईश्वरकी जय हो । भूतपति महादेव शिवकी जय हो। सभी मुनियोंके स्वामी तथा तपस्याद्वारा भलीभाँति प्रपूजित होनेवाले आपकी जय हो  सहस्तमूर्ति! विश्वात्मन्! संसाररूपी यन्त्रके प्रवर्तक और संसारके जन्म, रक्षा और संहारके
verses.wordMeaning: (In the dark half) when the moon is emaciated and drunk by Devas, the sun nourishes it forever, O Brahmanas, by a single ray called Susumla.
verses.commentary: Sense: (In the dark half) when the moon is emaciated and drunk by Devas, the sun nourishes it forever, O Brahmanas, by a single ray called Susumla.

verses.sanskrit: रम्यकं चोत्तरं वर्षं तस्यैवानुहिरण्मयम् । उत्तराः कुरवश्चैव यथैते भरतास्तथा
verses.transliteration: ramyakaṃ cottaraṃ varṣaṃ tasyaivānuhiraṇmayam / uttarāḥ kuravaścaiva yathaite bharatāstathā
verses.translation: This body of the moon is developed by the prowess of the sun. By gradually becoming bigger everyday, it is seen complete and full on the Full Moon day.
verses.hindi: कारण है अनन्त! आपकी जय हो। हजारों चरणवाले, ईशान, शम्भु, योगीन्द्रोंद्वारा वन्दित अम्बिकापति! आपकी जय हो। परमेश्वरदेव ! आपको नमस्कार है॥ ३३--३५॥
verses.wordMeaning: This body of the moon is developed by the prowess of the sun. By gradually becoming bigger everyday, it is seen complete and full on the Full Moon day.
verses.commentary: Sense: This body of the moon is developed by the prowess of the sun. By gradually becoming bigger everyday, it is seen complete and full on the Full Moon day.

verses.sanskrit: नवसाहस्त्रमेकैकमेतेषां द्विजसत्तमाः । इलावृतं च तन्मध्ये तन्मध्ये मेरुरुच्छ्रितः
verses.transliteration: navasāhastramekaikameteṣāṃ dvijasattamāḥ / ilāvṛtaṃ ca tanmadhye tanmadhye merurucchritaḥ
verses.translation: O Brahmanas, the deities drink the full moon consist¬ ing of Amrta in the course of half a month. This is so because their diet consists of Nectar.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार स्तुति किये जानेपर भक्तवत्सल भगवान् त्र्यम्बक ईशने हृषीकेशका आलिंगनकर गम्भीर वाणीमें कहा- है अच्युत ! पुण्डरीकाक्ष ! ये ब्रह्मवादी मुनीन्द्र किस कारणसे इस स्थानपर आये हैं अथवा मुझे क्या करना है ? भगवानूके वाक्यको सुनकर देवाधिदेव जनार्दनदेवने कृपा करनेके लिये उद्यत सामने स्थित महादेवसे कहा--देव! ये सभी मुनिगण तपस्वी और निष्पाप हैं, ये लोग भलीभाँति तत्त्वदर्शनकी इच्छासे मेरी शरणमें आये हैं । है भगवन्!
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas, the deities drink the full moon consist¬ ing of Amrta in the course of half a month. This is so because their diet consists of Nectar.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas, the deities drink the full moon consist¬ ing of Amrta in the course of half a month. This is so because their diet consists of Nectar.

verses.sanskrit: मेरोश्चतुर्दिशं तत्र नवसाहस्त्रविस्तृतम् । इलावृतं महाभागाश्चात्वारस्तत्र पर्वताः । विष्कम्भा रचिता मेरोर्योजनायुतमुच्छ्रिताः
verses.transliteration: meroścaturdiśaṃ tatra navasāhastravistṛtam / ilāvṛtaṃ mahābhāgāścātvārastatra parvatāḥ / viṣkambhā racitā meroryojanāyutamucchritāḥ
verses.translation: When a fifteenth of it remains, consisting of a single digit, the groups of Pitrs drink the last portion in the afternoon.
verses.hindi: यदि आप प्रसन्न हैं तो मेरे समीप इन भावनामय मुनियोंको वह दिव्य ज्ञान प्रदान करें॥ ३६--४० ॥
verses.wordMeaning: When a fifteenth of it remains, consisting of a single digit, the groups of Pitrs drink the last portion in the afternoon.
verses.commentary: Sense: When a fifteenth of it remains, consisting of a single digit, the groups of Pitrs drink the last portion in the afternoon.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वेण मन्दरो नाम दक्षिणे गन्धमादनः । विपुलः पश्चिमे पार्श्वे सुपार्श्वश्चोत्तरे स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: pūrveṇa mandaro nāma dakṣiṇe gandhamādanaḥ / vipulaḥ paścime pārśve supārśvaścottare smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: They drink for the period of two Lavas, * the Kala of the moon that remains. The digit of the moon is constituted of nectar and is auspicious.
verses.hindi: शिव! केवल आप ही अपने-आपको जानते हैं दूसरा कोई आपको जाननेवाला नहीं है। अतः आप स्वयं इन मुनीन्द्रोंको अपना स्वरूप दिखलायें। ऐसा कहकर हषीकेशने योगसिद्धियोंको दिखाते हुए वृषभध्वजकी ओर देखकर श्रेष्ठ मुनियोंसे कहा-(हे मुनिगणो!) त्रिशूल धारण करनेवाले शंकर महेशके दर्शनसे आपलोग अपने-आपको कृतार्थ समझें। आपलोग यथार्थरूपसे
verses.wordMeaning: They drink for the period of two Lavas, * the Kala of the moon that remains. The digit of the moon is constituted of nectar and is auspicious.
verses.commentary: Sense: They drink for the period of two Lavas, * the Kala of the moon that remains. The digit of the moon is constituted of nectar and is auspicious.

verses.sanskrit: कदम्बस्तेषु जम्बुश्च पिप्पलो वट एव च । जम्बूद्वीपस्य सा जम्बूर्नामहेतुर्महर्षयः
verses.transliteration: kadambasteṣu jambuśca pippalo vaṭa eva ca / jambūdvīpasya sā jambūrnāmaheturmaharṣayaḥ
verses.translation: By imbibing the nectar called Svadha oozing out of the rays on the new Moon day, the Pitrs become satisfied for the period of a month.
verses.hindi: निशम्य विष्णुवचनं प्रणम्य वृषभध्वजम्। सनत्कुमारप्रमुखाः पृच्छन्ति स्म महेश्वरम्
verses.wordMeaning: By imbibing the nectar called Svadha oozing out of the rays on the new Moon day, the Pitrs become satisfied for the period of a month.
verses.commentary: Sense: By imbibing the nectar called Svadha oozing out of the rays on the new Moon day, the Pitrs become satisfied for the period of a month.

verses.sanskrit: महागजप्रमाणानि जम्ब्वास्तस्याः फलानि च । पतन्ति भूभृतः पृष्ठे शीर्यमाणानि सर्वतः
verses.transliteration: mahāgajapramāṇāni jambvāstasyāḥ phalāni ca / patanti bhūbhṛtaḥ pṛṣṭhe śīryamāṇāni sarvataḥ
verses.translation: O excellent one, the moon is not destroyed but only the nectar is drunk to the fill. Thus the decrease and increase of the moon are dependent on the sun.
verses.hindi: अथास्मिन्नन्तरे दिव्यमासनं विमलं शिवम्। किमप्यचिन्त्यं गगनादीश्वराह समुद्बभौ तत्राससाद योगात्मा विष्णुना सह विश्वकृत्। तेजसा पूरयन् विश्वं भाति देवो महेश्वर:
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent one, the moon is not destroyed but only the nectar is drunk to the fill. Thus the decrease and increase of the moon are dependent on the sun.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent one, the moon is not destroyed but only the nectar is drunk to the fill. Thus the decrease and increase of the moon are dependent on the sun.

verses.sanskrit: रसेन तस्याः प्रख्याता तत्र जम्बूनदीति वै । सरित् प्रवर्तते चापि पीयते तत्र वासिभिः
verses.transliteration: rasena tasyāḥ prakhyātā tatra jambūnadīti vai / sarit pravartate cāpi pīyate tatra vāsibhiḥ
verses.translation: The chariot of the son of the moon (i.e. Budha—the Mercury) is yoked to eight horses that have the velocity of the wind and that are born of water. He moves about all round in that chariot.
verses.hindi: तं ते देवादिदेवेशं शंकरं ब्रह्मवादिनः । विभ्राजमानं विमले तस्मिन् ददृशुरासने
verses.wordMeaning: The chariot of the son of the moon (i.e. Budha—the Mercury) is yoked to eight horses that have the velocity of the wind and that are born of water. He moves about all round in that chariot.
verses.commentary: Sense: The chariot of the son of the moon (i.e. Budha—the Mercury) is yoked to eight horses that have the velocity of the wind and that are born of water. He moves about all round in that chariot.

verses.sanskrit: न स्वेदो न च दौर्गन्ध्यं न जरा नेन्द्रियक्षयः । तत्पानात् सुस्थमनसां नराणां तत्र जायते
verses.transliteration: na svedo na ca daurgandhyaṃ na jarā nendriyakṣayaḥ / tatpānāt susthamanasāṃ narāṇāṃ tatra jāyate
verses.translation: The chariot of Sukra (the Venus) is yoked to ten horses bom of the Earth. The beautiful golden chariot of Bhauma (the Mars) is yoked to eight horses.
verses.hindi: अनन्यतेजसं शान्तं शिवं ददूशिरे किल स वासुदेवमासीनं तमीशं ददृशुः किल
verses.wordMeaning: The chariot of Sukra (the Venus) is yoked to ten horses bom of the Earth. The beautiful golden chariot of Bhauma (the Mars) is yoked to eight horses.
verses.commentary: Sense: The chariot of Sukra (the Venus) is yoked to ten horses bom of the Earth. The beautiful golden chariot of Bhauma (the Mars) is yoked to eight horses.

verses.sanskrit: तीरमृत्तत्र संप्राप्य वायुना सुविशोषिता । जाम्बूनदाख्यं भवति सुवर्णं सिद्धभूषणम्
verses.transliteration: tīramṛttatra saṃprāpya vāyunā suviśoṣitā / jāmbūnadākhyaṃ bhavati suvarṇaṃ siddhabhūṣaṇam
verses.translation: All these blessed ones are fixed to Dhruva by the strings of wind. The planets, stars, constellations and other abodes are entirely fixed to Dhruva. They whirl and cause others to whirl by the wind-made reins.
verses.hindi: प्रोवाच पृष्टो भगवान् मुनीनां परमेश्वरः। निरीक्ष्य पुण्डरीकाक्षं स्वात्मयोगमनुत्तमम्
verses.wordMeaning: All these blessed ones are fixed to Dhruva by the strings of wind. The planets, stars, constellations and other abodes are entirely fixed to Dhruva. They whirl and cause others to whirl by the wind-made reins.
verses.commentary: Sense: All these blessed ones are fixed to Dhruva by the strings of wind. The planets, stars, constellations and other abodes are entirely fixed to Dhruva. They whirl and cause others to whirl by the wind-made reins.

verses.sanskrit: भद्राश्वः पूर्वतो मेरोः केतुमालश्च पश्चिमे । वर्षे द्वे तु मुनिश्रेष्ठास्तयोर्मध्ये इलावृतम्
verses.transliteration: bhadrāśvaḥ pūrvato meroḥ ketumālaśca paścime / varṣe dve tu muniśreṣṭhāstayormadhye ilāvṛtam
verses.translation: Maharloka is above the Pole Star. It extends to a crore of Yojanas. O leading Brahmanas, the persons inhabiting there are entitled to the life span of a Kalpa.
verses.hindi: ज्ञान प्राप्त करने योग्य हैं, सामने प्रत्यक्ष स्थित विश्वेशसे (उस तत्त्वज्ञानके विषयमें) पूछें। मेरी संनिधिमें ये यथार्थरूपसे वर्णन करनेमें समर्थ हैं। विष्णुका (यह) वचन सुनकर तथा वृषभध्वजको प्रणामकर सनत्कुमार आदि (ऋषियों )-ने महेशवरसे पूछा ॥ ४१--४५॥
verses.wordMeaning: Maharloka is above the Pole Star. It extends to a crore of Yojanas. O leading Brahmanas, the persons inhabiting there are entitled to the life span of a Kalpa.
verses.commentary: Sense: Maharloka is above the Pole Star. It extends to a crore of Yojanas. O leading Brahmanas, the persons inhabiting there are entitled to the life span of a Kalpa.

verses.sanskrit: वनं चैत्ररथं पूर्वे दक्षिणे गन्धमादनम् । वैभ्राजं पश्चिमे विद्यादुत्तरे सवितुर्वनम्
verses.transliteration: vanaṃ caitrarathaṃ pūrve dakṣiṇe gandhamādanam / vaibhrājaṃ paścime vidyāduttare saviturvanam
verses.translation: Janaloka is above Maharloka. Its spatial magnitude is two crores of Yojanas. Sanaka and other sons of Brahma are stationed there.
verses.hindi: इसी बीच आकाशसे ईश्वरके योग्य एक अचिन्त्य दिव्य निर्मल आसन प्रकट हुआ। विश्वकर्ता वे योगात्मा (महेश्वर) विष्णुसहित उस आसनपर बैठ गये। अपने तेजसे विश्वको पूरित करते हुए महेश्वर देव वहाँ सुशोभित
verses.wordMeaning: Janaloka is above Maharloka. Its spatial magnitude is two crores of Yojanas. Sanaka and other sons of Brahma are stationed there.
verses.commentary: Sense: Janaloka is above Maharloka. Its spatial magnitude is two crores of Yojanas. Sanaka and other sons of Brahma are stationed there.

verses.sanskrit: अरुणोदं महाभद्रमसितोदं च मानसम् । सरांस्येतानि चत्वारि देवयोग्यानि सर्वदा
verses.transliteration: aruṇodaṃ mahābhadramasitodaṃ ca mānasam / sarāṃsyetāni catvāri devayogyāni sarvadā
verses.translation: Tapoloka is above Janaloka. It extends to three crores of Yojanas. Devas called Virajas who live there are immune from consumption by fire.
verses.hindi: हो रहे थे। उन ब्रह्मवादियोंने उन प्रकाशमान देवाधिदेव शंकरका उस निर्मल आसनपर सुशोभित होते हुए दर्शन किया। योगमें स्थित लोग अपनी आत्मामें जिन आत्मस्वरूप ईश्वरका दर्शन करते हैं, उन्हीं अनन्य तेजस्वी शान्तस्वरूप शिवको उन ब्रह्मवादियोंने देखा, जिनसे समस्त प्राणियोंको उत्पत्ति होती है और जिनमें यह सब विलीन हो जाता है, उन प्राणियोंके ईशको ब्रह्मवादियोंने आसनपर विराजमान देखा । जिनके भीतर यह सम्पूर्ण संसार है और यह जगत्
verses.wordMeaning: Tapoloka is above Janaloka. It extends to three crores of Yojanas. Devas called Virajas who live there are immune from consumption by fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: Tapoloka is above Janaloka. It extends to three crores of Yojanas. Devas called Virajas who live there are immune from consumption by fire.

verses.sanskrit: सितान्तश्च कुमुद्वांश्च कुरुरी माल्यवांस्तथा । वैकङ्को मणिशैलश्च ऋक्षवांश्चाचलोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: sitāntaśca kumudvāṃśca kururī mālyavāṃstathā / vaikaṅko maṇiśailaśca ṛkṣavāṃścācalottamāḥ
verses.translation: Satyaloka is above the world of Prajapatis. It extends to six crores of Yojanas. It is a region where there is no death again. It is also named as Brahmaloka.
verses.hindi: जिनसे अभिन्न है, उन परमेश्वरको वासुदेवके साथ आसनपर
verses.wordMeaning: Satyaloka is above the world of Prajapatis. It extends to six crores of Yojanas. It is a region where there is no death again. It is also named as Brahmaloka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Satyaloka is above the world of Prajapatis. It extends to six crores of Yojanas. It is a region where there is no death again. It is also named as Brahmaloka.

verses.sanskrit: महानीलो ऽथ रुचकः सबिन्दुर्मन्दरस्तथा । वेणुमांश्चैव मेघश्च निषधो देवपर्वतः । इत्येते देवरचिताः सिद्धावासाः प्रकीर्तिताः
verses.transliteration: mahānīlo 'tha rucakaḥ sabindurmandarastathā / veṇumāṃścaiva meghaśca niṣadho devaparvataḥ / ityete devaracitāḥ siddhāvāsāḥ prakīrtitāḥ
verses.translation: Here in the Satyaloka god Brahma, the preceptor of the world, the soul and the efficient cause of the Universe ever abides in the company of Yogis by drinking the Supreme nectar of Yoga.
verses.hindi: मुनियोंके पूछनेपर परमेश्वर (महेश्वर) भगवान् पुण्डरीकाक्ष (विष्णु)-की ओर देखकर अपने श्रेष्ठ योगका वर्णन करने लगे। शान्त मनवाले अनघ मुनियो! आप सभी लोग सुनें-में ईश्वरद्वारा कहे गये ज्ञानका वर्णन यथोचितरूपसे कर रहा हुँ
verses.wordMeaning: Here in the Satyaloka god Brahma, the preceptor of the world, the soul and the efficient cause of the Universe ever abides in the company of Yogis by drinking the Supreme nectar of Yoga.
verses.commentary: Sense: Here in the Satyaloka god Brahma, the preceptor of the world, the soul and the efficient cause of the Universe ever abides in the company of Yogis by drinking the Supreme nectar of Yoga.

verses.sanskrit: अरुणोदस्य सरसः पूर्वतः केसराचलः । त्रिकूटशिखरश्चैव पतङ्गो रुचकस्तथा
verses.transliteration: aruṇodasya sarasaḥ pūrvataḥ kesarācalaḥ / trikūṭaśikharaścaiva pataṅgo rucakastathā
verses.translation: Quiescent recluses, the perpetual Brahmacarins (celi¬ bates), Yogins, Siddhas, ascetics and performers of the Japa of Paramesthin reside there.
verses.hindi: आत्मतत्त्वके स्वरूपका निरूपण, सांख्य एवं योगके ज्ञानका अभेद, आत्मसाक्षात्कारके साधनोंका वर्णन
verses.wordMeaning: Quiescent recluses, the perpetual Brahmacarins (celi¬ bates), Yogins, Siddhas, ascetics and performers of the Japa of Paramesthin reside there.
verses.commentary: Sense: Quiescent recluses, the perpetual Brahmacarins (celi¬ bates), Yogins, Siddhas, ascetics and performers of the Japa of Paramesthin reside there.

verses.sanskrit: निषधो वसुधारश्च कलिङ्गस्त्रिशिखः शुभः । समूलो वसुधारश्च कुरवश्चैव सानुमान्
verses.transliteration: niṣadho vasudhāraśca kaliṅgastriśikhaḥ śubhaḥ / samūlo vasudhāraśca kuravaścaiva sānumān
verses.translation: His (Brahma's) city which is very difficult to attain resembles one crore of suns in brilliance and is emblazoned with clusters of fiery flames and as such it is impossible for me to describe it.
verses.hindi: यन्न देवा विजानन्ति यतन्तोऽपि द्विजातयः इदं ज्ञानं समाश्रित्य ब्रह्मभूता द्विजोत्तमाः ।
verses.wordMeaning: His (Brahma's) city which is very difficult to attain resembles one crore of suns in brilliance and is emblazoned with clusters of fiery flames and as such it is impossible for me to describe it.
verses.commentary: Sense: His (Brahma's) city which is very difficult to attain resembles one crore of suns in brilliance and is emblazoned with clusters of fiery flames and as such it is impossible for me to describe it.

verses.sanskrit: ताम्रातश्च विशालश्च कुमुदो वेणुर्वतः । एकशृङ्गो महाशैलो गजशैलः पिशाचकः
verses.transliteration: tāmrātaśca viśālaśca kumudo veṇurvataḥ / ekaśṛṅgo mahāśailo gajaśailaḥ piśācakaḥ
verses.translation: There in the city of Brahma is the abode of Narayana also. The glorious Hari, the wielder ofMaya lies down there.
verses.hindi: ईश्वरने कहा--द्विजो ! देवता लोग प्रयत्न करनेपर भी जिसे नहीं जान पाते हैं, मेरा यह विज्ञान अत्यन्त गुह्य है, सनातन है एवं बतलाने योग्य (भी) नहीं है। इस ज्ञानका आश्रय ग्रहणकर श्रेष्ठ द्विजगणोंने ब्रह्मभावको
verses.wordMeaning: There in the city of Brahma is the abode of Narayana also. The glorious Hari, the wielder ofMaya lies down there.
verses.commentary: Sense: There in the city of Brahma is the abode of Narayana also. The glorious Hari, the wielder ofMaya lies down there.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चशैलो ऽथ कैलासो हिमवांशचाचलोत्तमः । इत्येते देवचरिता उत्कटाः पर्वतोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: pañcaśailo 'tha kailāso himavāṃśacācalottamaḥ / ityete devacaritā utkaṭāḥ parvatottamāḥ
verses.translation: It is called Visnuloka. There is no return from there to Sarhsara. The noble-souled people who have resorted to Janardana can go there.
verses.hindi: प्राप्त किया है। (इस ज्ञानके कारण) पूर्वकालमें भी ब्रह्मबादियोंको पुनः संसारमें आना नहीं पड़ा (अर्थात् न संसारं प्रपद्यान्ते पूर्वेऽपि ब्रह्मबादिनः॥ २॥  इस ज्ञानसे ब्रह्मभाव अवश्य प्राप्त होता है और ब्रह्मभाव
verses.wordMeaning: It is called Visnuloka. There is no return from there to Sarhsara. The noble-souled people who have resorted to Janardana can go there.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is called Visnuloka. There is no return from there to Sarhsara. The noble-souled people who have resorted to Janardana can go there.

verses.sanskrit: महाभद्रस्य सरसो दक्षिणे केसराचलः । शिखिवासश्च वैदूर्यः कपिलो गन्धमादनः
verses.transliteration: mahābhadrasya saraso dakṣiṇe kesarācalaḥ / śikhivāsaśca vaidūryaḥ kapilo gandhamādanaḥ
verses.translation: It is called Visnuloka. There is no return from there to Sarhsara. The noble-souled people who have resorted to Janardana can go there.
verses.hindi: वक्ष्ये भक्तिमतामद्य युष्माकं ब्रह्मवादिनाम्
verses.wordMeaning: It is called Visnuloka. There is no return from there to Sarhsara. The noble-souled people who have resorted to Janardana can go there.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is called Visnuloka. There is no return from there to Sarhsara. The noble-souled people who have resorted to Janardana can go there.

verses.sanskrit: जारुधिश्च सुगन्धिश्च श्रीशृङ्गश्चाचलोत्तमः । सुपार्श्वश्च सुपक्षश्च कङ्कः कपिल एव च
verses.transliteration: jārudhiśca sugandhiśca śrīśṛṅgaścācalottamaḥ / supārśvaśca supakṣaśca kaṅkaḥ kapila eva ca
verses.translation: It is called Visnuloka. There is no return from there to Sarhsara. The noble-souled people who have resorted to Janardana can go there.
verses.hindi: स कालोऽऱग्निस्तदव्यक्तं स एवेदमिति श्रुतिः स मायी मायया बद्ध: करोति विविधास्तनूः
verses.wordMeaning: It is called Visnuloka. There is no return from there to Sarhsara. The noble-souled people who have resorted to Janardana can go there.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is called Visnuloka. There is no return from there to Sarhsara. The noble-souled people who have resorted to Janardana can go there.

verses.sanskrit: पिञ्जरो भद्रशैलश्च सुरसश्च महाबलः । अञ्जनो मधुमांस्तद्वत् कुमुदो मुकुटस्तथा
verses.transliteration: piñjaro bhadraśailaśca surasaśca mahābalaḥ / añjano madhumāṃstadvat kumudo mukuṭastathā
verses.translation: It is called Visnuloka. There is no return from there to Sarhsara. The noble-souled people who have resorted to Janardana can go there.
verses.hindi: न रूपरसगन्धाश्च नाहं कर्ता न वागपि
verses.wordMeaning: It is called Visnuloka. There is no return from there to Sarhsara. The noble-souled people who have resorted to Janardana can go there.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is called Visnuloka. There is no return from there to Sarhsara. The noble-souled people who have resorted to Janardana can go there.

verses.sanskrit: सहस्त्रशिखरश्चैव पाण्डुरः कृष्ण एव च । पारिजातो महाशैलस्तथैव कपिलोदकः
verses.transliteration: sahastraśikharaścaiva pāṇḍuraḥ kṛṣṇa eva ca / pārijāto mahāśailastathaiva kapilodakaḥ
verses.translation: It is called Visnuloka. There is no return from there to Sarhsara. The noble-souled people who have resorted to Janardana can go there.
verses.hindi: न कर्ता न च भोक्ता वा न च प्रकृतिपूरुषौ। न माया नेव च प्राणश्चैतन्यं परमार्थतः यथा प्रकाशतमसोः सम्बन्धो नोपपद्यते। तद्ठहैक्यं न सम्बन्धः प्रपञ्चपरमात्मनोः
verses.wordMeaning: It is called Visnuloka. There is no return from there to Sarhsara. The noble-souled people who have resorted to Janardana can go there.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is called Visnuloka. There is no return from there to Sarhsara. The noble-souled people who have resorted to Janardana can go there.

verses.sanskrit: सुषेणः पुण्डरीकश्च महामेघस्तथैव च । एते पर्वतराजानः सिद्धगन्धर्वसेविताः
verses.transliteration: suṣeṇaḥ puṇḍarīkaśca mahāmeghastathaiva ca / ete parvatarājānaḥ siddhagandharvasevitāḥ
verses.translation: It is called Visnuloka. There is no return from there to Sarhsara. The noble-souled people who have resorted to Janardana can go there.
verses.hindi: छायातपौ यथा लोके परस्परविलक्षणौ। तद्वत् प्रपञ्चपुरुघौ विभिन्नौ परमार्थतः
verses.wordMeaning: It is called Visnuloka. There is no return from there to Sarhsara. The noble-souled people who have resorted to Janardana can go there.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is called Visnuloka. There is no return from there to Sarhsara. The noble-souled people who have resorted to Janardana can go there.

verses.sanskrit: असितोदस्य सरसः पश्चिमे केसराचलः । शङ्खकूटो ऽथ वृषभो हंसो नागस्तथा परः
verses.transliteration: asitodasya sarasaḥ paścime kesarācalaḥ / śaṅkhakūṭo 'tha vṛṣabho haṃso nāgastathā paraḥ
verses.translation: It is called Visnuloka. There is no return from there to Sarhsara. The noble-souled people who have resorted to Janardana can go there.
verses.hindi: यद्यात्मा मलिनोऽस्वस्थो विकारी स्यात् स्वभावतः । नहि तस्य भवेन्मुक्तिर्जन्मान्तरशतैरपि विकारहीनं निर्दुःखमानन्दात्मानमव्ययम्
verses.wordMeaning: It is called Visnuloka. There is no return from there to Sarhsara. The noble-souled people who have resorted to Janardana can go there.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is called Visnuloka. There is no return from there to Sarhsara. The noble-souled people who have resorted to Janardana can go there.

verses.sanskrit: कालाञ्जनः शुक्रशैलो नीलः कमल एव च । पुष्पकश्च सुमेघश्च वाराहो विरजास्तथा । मयूरः कपिलश्चैव महाकपिल एव च
verses.transliteration: kālāñjanaḥ śukraśailo nīlaḥ kamala eva ca / puṣpakaśca sumeghaśca vārāho virajāstathā / mayūraḥ kapilaścaiva mahākapila eva ca
verses.translation: It is called Visnuloka. There is no return from there to Sarhsara. The noble-souled people who have resorted to Janardana can go there.
verses.hindi: अहं कर्ता सुखी दुःखी कृशः स्थूलेति या मतिः। सा चाहंकारकर्तृत्वादात्मन्यारोप्यते जनैः
verses.wordMeaning: It is called Visnuloka. There is no return from there to Sarhsara. The noble-souled people who have resorted to Janardana can go there.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is called Visnuloka. There is no return from there to Sarhsara. The noble-souled people who have resorted to Janardana can go there.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येते देवगन्धर्वसिद्धसङ्घनिषेविताः । सरसो मानसस्येह उत्तरे केसराचलाः
verses.transliteration: ityete devagandharvasiddhasaṅghaniṣevitāḥ / saraso mānasasyeha uttare kesarācalāḥ
verses.translation: It is called Visnuloka. There is no return from there to Sarhsara. The noble-souled people who have resorted to Janardana can go there.
verses.hindi: प्राप्त करनेके अनन्तर पुनः संसारमें आगमन नहीं होता) । यह ज्ञान गुह्यसे भी गुह्यतम है, इस साक्षात् ज्ञानको प्रयत्नपूर्वक गोपनीय रखना चाहिए। आप भक्तिसम्पन्न ब्रह्मवादियोंको आज मैं यह ज्ञान बतलाऊँगा सभीका अन्तरतम साक्षात् चिन्मात्र और तमोगुणसे परे है, वही (आत्मा) अन्तर्यामी है, पुरुष है, वही प्राण है, वही महेश्वर है, वही काल तथा अग्निं है और वही अव्यक्त है-एऐसा श्रुतिका कथन है
verses.wordMeaning: It is called Visnuloka. There is no return from there to Sarhsara. The noble-souled people who have resorted to Janardana can go there.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is called Visnuloka. There is no return from there to Sarhsara. The noble-souled people who have resorted to Janardana can go there.

verses.sanskrit: एतेषां शैलमुख्यानामन्तरेषु यथाक्रमम् । सन्ति चैवान्तरद्रोण्यः सरांसि च वनानि च
verses.transliteration: eteṣāṃ śailamukhyānāmantareṣu yathākramam / santi caivāntaradroṇyaḥ sarāṃsi ca vanāni ca
verses.translation: It is called Visnuloka. There is no return from there to Sarhsara. The noble-souled people who have resorted to Janardana can go there.
verses.hindi: इसीसे संसार उत्पन्न होता है और इसीमें विलीन हो जाता है। बह मायाका नियामक मायासे आबद्ध होकर अपनी इच्छासे मायाको अङ्गीकार कर विविध शरीरोंको उत्पन्न करता है । यह प्रभु आत्मा न तो गतिशील है और
verses.wordMeaning: It is called Visnuloka. There is no return from there to Sarhsara. The noble-souled people who have resorted to Janardana can go there.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is called Visnuloka. There is no return from there to Sarhsara. The noble-souled people who have resorted to Janardana can go there.

verses.sanskrit: वसन्ति तत्र मुनयः सिद्धाश्च ब्रह्मभाविताः । प्रसन्नाः शान्तरजसः सर्वदुः खविवर्जिताः
verses.transliteration: vasanti tatra munayaḥ siddhāśca brahmabhāvitāḥ / prasannāḥ śāntarajasaḥ sarvaduḥ khavivarjitāḥ
verses.translation: It is called Visnuloka. There is no return from there to Sarhsara. The noble-souled people who have resorted to Janardana can go there.
verses.hindi: न गतिप्रेरक है। न यह पृथ्वी है, न जल है, न तेज है, न वायु है और न आकाश ही है यह न प्राण है, न मन है, न अव्यक्त है, न शब्द है, न स्पर्श है, न रूप, न रस और न गन्ध ही है। न अभिमानी  है, न वाणी ही है। द्विजोत्तमो! यह न हाथ, न पैर, न पायु (शौचेन्द्रिय) और न उपस्थ (मूत्रेन्द्रिय), न कर्ता, न भोक्ता
verses.wordMeaning: It is called Visnuloka. There is no return from there to Sarhsara. The noble-souled people who have resorted to Janardana can go there.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is called Visnuloka. There is no return from there to Sarhsara. The noble-souled people who have resorted to Janardana can go there.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां सहितायां पूर्वविभागे त्रिचत्वारिशो ऽध्यायः सूत उवाच चतुर्दशसहस्त्रणि योजनानां महापुरी । मेरोरुपरि विख्याता देवदेवस्य वेधसः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ sahitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge tricatvāriśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca caturdaśasahastraṇi yojanānāṃ mahāpurī / merorupari vikhyātā devadevasya vedhasaḥ
verses.translation: The great lord is accompanied by the goddess. He is being meditated upon by the learned men. He is surrounded by hundreds and thousands of Bhutas, Yogins and Rudras.
verses.hindi: तथा प्रकृति-पुरुष भी नहीं है। माया भी नहीं है, प्राण भी नहीं है, अपितु परमार्थत: चैतन्यमात्र है
verses.wordMeaning: The great lord is accompanied by the goddess. He is being meditated upon by the learned men. He is surrounded by hundreds and thousands of Bhutas, Yogins and Rudras.
verses.commentary: Sense: The great lord is accompanied by the goddess. He is being meditated upon by the learned men. He is surrounded by hundreds and thousands of Bhutas, Yogins and Rudras.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रास्ते भगवान् ब्रह्मा विश्वात्मा विश्वभावनः । उपास्यमानो योगीन्द्रैर्मुनीन्द्रोपेन्द्रशङ्करैः
verses.transliteration: tatrāste bhagavān brahmā viśvātmā viśvabhāvanaḥ / upāsyamāno yogīndrairmunīndropendraśaṅkaraiḥ
verses.translation: Those who are devoted to Mahadeva, the quiescent, truthful ascetics who observe celibacy, go there.
verses.hindi: जिस प्रकार प्रकाश और अन्धकारका कोई सम्बन्ध नहीं हो सकता, उसी प्रकार (सांसारिक) प्रपञ्च और परमात्माका भी कोई ऐक्य (अभेद्य आदि) सम्बन्ध नहीं हो सकता जिस प्रकार संसारमें धूप और छाया एक-दूसरेसे विलक्षण हैं, वैसे ही पुरुष तथा प्रपञ्च भी तत्त्वत: एक-दूसरेसे भिन्न हैं। यदि आत्मा स्वभावसे मलिन, अस्वस्थ तथा विकारयुक्त होता तो उसकी मुक्ति सैकड़ों
verses.wordMeaning: Those who are devoted to Mahadeva, the quiescent, truthful ascetics who observe celibacy, go there.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who are devoted to Mahadeva, the quiescent, truthful ascetics who observe celibacy, go there.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र देवेश्वरेशानं विश्वात्मानं प्रजापतिम् । सनत्कुमारो भगवानुपास्ते नित्यमेव हि
verses.transliteration: tatra deveśvareśānaṃ viśvātmānaṃ prajāpatim / sanatkumāro bhagavānupāste nityameva hi
verses.translation: Only those who are devoid of Mamatva (the feeling of my-ness), those who are not egotistic, those who are devoid of passion and fury will see the lord. It is verily named as Rudraloka.
verses.hindi: जन्मोंमें भी नहीं होती। योगयुक्त मुनिजन परमार्थतः अपने विकाररहित, दुःखशून्य, आनन्दस्वरूप, अव्यय आत्माका दर्शन करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Only those who are devoid of Mamatva (the feeling of my-ness), those who are not egotistic, those who are devoid of passion and fury will see the lord. It is verily named as Rudraloka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Only those who are devoid of Mamatva (the feeling of my-ness), those who are not egotistic, those who are devoid of passion and fury will see the lord. It is verily named as Rudraloka.

verses.sanskrit: स सिद्धैरृषिगन्धर्वैः पूज्यमानः सुरैरपि । समास्ते योगयुक्तत्मा पीत्वा तत्परमामृतम्
verses.transliteration: sa siddhairṛṣigandharvaiḥ pūjyamānaḥ surairapi / samāste yogayuktatmā pītvā tatparamāmṛtam
verses.translation: That Patala is associated with Sesa and the intelli¬ gent Mucakunda as well as inhabited by king Balin, resident of heavenly region (in that Patala).
verses.hindi: मैं कर्ता हुँ, सुखी, दुःखी, कृश एवं स्थूल हँ-- इस प्रकारकी जो बुद्धि है, वह मनुष्योंके द्वारा अहंकारके कारण ही अपनी आत्मामें आरोपित है। वेदके विद्वान् लोग (आत्माको) साक्षी, प्रकृतिसे परे, भोक्ता, अक्षर, शुद्ध तथा सर्वत्र सम रूपसे व्याप्त बतलाते हैं। अतएव
verses.wordMeaning: That Patala is associated with Sesa and the intelli¬ gent Mucakunda as well as inhabited by king Balin, resident of heavenly region (in that Patala).
verses.commentary: Sense: That Patala is associated with Sesa and the intelli¬ gent Mucakunda as well as inhabited by king Balin, resident of heavenly region (in that Patala).

verses.sanskrit: तत्र देवादिदेवस्य शंभोरमिततेजसः । दीप्तमायतनं शुभ्रं पुरस्ताद् ब्रह्मणः स्थितम्
verses.transliteration: tatra devādidevasya śaṃbhoramitatejasaḥ / dīptamāyatanaṃ śubhraṃ purastād brahmaṇaḥ sthitam
verses.translation: O Brahmanas, the Rasatala is full of rocks, Talatala is full of gravel, Sutala is yellow and Vitala has the lustre of coral.
verses.hindi: ' अहम्' इस शब्दका प्रयोक्ता नहीं है, न अहम्' यह शब्द ही है।
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas, the Rasatala is full of rocks, Talatala is full of gravel, Sutala is yellow and Vitala has the lustre of coral.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas, the Rasatala is full of rocks, Talatala is full of gravel, Sutala is yellow and Vitala has the lustre of coral.

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यकान्तिसमायुक्तं चतुर्धारं सुशोभनम् । महर्षिगणसंकीर्णं ब्रह्मविद्भिर्निषेवितम्
verses.transliteration: divyakāntisamāyuktaṃ caturdhāraṃ suśobhanam / maharṣigaṇasaṃkīrṇaṃ brahmavidbhirniṣevitam
verses.translation: Vitala is white. Tala is black. O excellent sages, it is auspicious, thanks to Vasuki of good colour.
verses.hindi: अहंकाराविवेकेन कर्ताहमिति मन्यते प्रधानं प्रकृतिं बुद्धवा कारणं ब्रह्मवादिनः
verses.wordMeaning: Vitala is white. Tala is black. O excellent sages, it is auspicious, thanks to Vasuki of good colour.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vitala is white. Tala is black. O excellent sages, it is auspicious, thanks to Vasuki of good colour.

verses.sanskrit: देव्या सह महादेवः शशाङ्कार्काग्निलोचनः । रमते तत्र विश्वेशः प्रमथैः प्रमथेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: devyā saha mahādevaḥ śaśāṅkārkāgnilocanaḥ / ramate tatra viśveśaḥ pramathaiḥ pramatheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: What is known as Rasatala is resorted to by Virocana, Hiranyaksa, and Taraka. It is inhabited by others as well.
verses.hindi: स्वात्मानमक्षरं ब्रह्म नावबुद्धयेत तत्त्वत:
verses.wordMeaning: What is known as Rasatala is resorted to by Virocana, Hiranyaksa, and Taraka. It is inhabited by others as well.
verses.commentary: Sense: What is known as Rasatala is resorted to by Virocana, Hiranyaksa, and Taraka. It is inhabited by others as well.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र वेदविदः शान्ता मुनयो ब्रह्मचारिणः । पूजयन्ति महादेवं तापसाः सत्यवादिनः
verses.transliteration: tatra vedavidaḥ śāntā munayo brahmacāriṇaḥ / pūjayanti mahādevaṃ tāpasāḥ satyavādinaḥ
verses.translation: It is inhabited by the heroic Mahajambha, the intelligent Hayagriva, Sahkukarna, Namuci and others.
verses.hindi: कर्मण्यस्य भवेद् दोषः पुण्यापुण्यमिति स्थितिः । तद्ृशादेव सर्वेषां सर्वदेहसमुद्धवः यथा हि धूमसम्पर्कान्नाकाशो मलिनो भवेत्। अन्तःकरणजेभावैरात्मा तद्वन्न लिप्यते
verses.wordMeaning: It is inhabited by the heroic Mahajambha, the intelligent Hayagriva, Sahkukarna, Namuci and others.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is inhabited by the heroic Mahajambha, the intelligent Hayagriva, Sahkukarna, Namuci and others.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां साक्षान्महादेवो मुनीनां ब्रह्मवादिनाम् । गृह्णाति पूजां शिरसा पार्वत्या परमेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ sākṣānmahādevo munīnāṃ brahmavādinām / gṛhṇāti pūjāṃ śirasā pārvatyā parameśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Tala is beautiful through the residence of other serpents. Below Patalas are the hells, Kurma and others, which are oft mentioned.
verses.hindi: यथा स्वप्रभया भाति केवलः स्फटिकोऽमलः। उपाधिहीनो विमलस्तथैवात्मा प्रकाशते
verses.wordMeaning: Tala is beautiful through the residence of other serpents. Below Patalas are the hells, Kurma and others, which are oft mentioned.
verses.commentary: Sense: Tala is beautiful through the residence of other serpents. Below Patalas are the hells, Kurma and others, which are oft mentioned.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रैव पर्वतवरे शक्रस्य परमा पुरी । नाम्नामरावती पूर्वे सर्वशोभासमन्विता
verses.transliteration: tatraiva parvatavare śakrasya paramā purī / nāmnāmarāvatī pūrve sarvaśobhāsamanvitā
verses.translation: The sinners are 'cooked' there which cannot be des¬ cribed adequately. The form of Visnu, called Sesa is lying beneath Patala.
verses.hindi: यह संसार सभी प्राणियोंके अज्ञानके कारण ही है। अज्ञानसे अन्यथा (विपरीत) ज्ञान होता है अर्थात् अज्ञानका नाश ज्ञानसे ही होता है और यह प्रकृतिसंगत (प्राणियोंके मूल स्वभावके सर्वथा अनुकूल शाश्वत शान्तिरूप) होता है॥ १४--१६॥
verses.wordMeaning: The sinners are 'cooked' there which cannot be des¬ cribed adequately. The form of Visnu, called Sesa is lying beneath Patala.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sinners are 'cooked' there which cannot be des¬ cribed adequately. The form of Visnu, called Sesa is lying beneath Patala.

verses.sanskrit: तमिन्द्रमप्सरः सङ्घा गन्धर्वा गीततत्पराः । उपासते सहस्त्राक्षं देवास्तत्र सहस्त्रशः
verses.transliteration: tamindramapsaraḥ saṅghā gandharvā gītatatparāḥ / upāsate sahastrākṣaṃ devāstatra sahastraśaḥ
verses.translation: He is Rudra, the fire of world destruction, the Yogic Atman, Narasiihha and Madhava. He is Janardana in the form of a serpent who is said to be lord Ananta. All this has him for support and he has the fire of destruction for support.
verses.hindi: अहंकारसे उत्पन्न अक्रिवेकके कारण स्वयं ज्योतिरूप, नित्य प्रकाशयुक्त सर्वव्यापी परम पुरुष अपनेको “मैं कर्ता हूँ? ऐसा मानता है। ब्रह्मवादी ऋषिगण प्रधान, प्रकृति और कारणको समझकर सत् एवं असत्-स्वरूप,
verses.wordMeaning: He is Rudra, the fire of world destruction, the Yogic Atman, Narasiihha and Madhava. He is Janardana in the form of a serpent who is said to be lord Ananta. All this has him for support and he has the fire of destruction for support.
verses.commentary: Sense: He is Rudra, the fire of world destruction, the Yogic Atman, Narasiihha and Madhava. He is Janardana in the form of a serpent who is said to be lord Ananta. All this has him for support and he has the fire of destruction for support.

verses.sanskrit: ये धार्मिका वेदविदो यागहोमपरायणाः । तेषां तत् परमं स्थानं देवानामपि दुर्लभम्
verses.transliteration: ye dhārmikā vedavido yāgahomaparāyaṇāḥ / teṣāṃ tat paramaṃ sthānaṃ devānāmapi durlabham
verses.translation: Having entered him (Visnu), the great Yogin, Kala who resides in his mouth (v.l. who comes out of his mouth at the time of world-destruction) and who is the Ruler becomes full of poisonous flames and annihilates the whole universe.
verses.hindi: अव्यक्त नित्यतत्त्वका साक्षात्कार करते हैं। कूटस्थ एवं निरञ्जन होते हुए भी यह आत्मा उस (प्रधान, प्रकृति आदि)-से संगत होकर स्वात्मस्वरूप अक्षर ब्रह्मका यथार्थरूपसे ज्ञान नहीं कर पाता अनात्मतत्त्वमें आत्मविषयक विज्ञानसे ही दुःख होता है तथा इसी प्रकारकी भ्रान्तिके कारण ही राग, द्वेष आदि सभी दोष उत्पन्न होते हैं । इसके (भ्रान्त पुरुषके) कर्ममें ही दोष होता है, इसी कारण पाप-पुण्यकी स्थिति बनती
verses.wordMeaning: Having entered him (Visnu), the great Yogin, Kala who resides in his mouth (v.l. who comes out of his mouth at the time of world-destruction) and who is the Ruler becomes full of poisonous flames and annihilates the whole universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: Having entered him (Visnu), the great Yogin, Kala who resides in his mouth (v.l. who comes out of his mouth at the time of world-destruction) and who is the Ruler becomes full of poisonous flames and annihilates the whole universe.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य दक्षिणदिग्भागे वह्नेरमिततेजसः । तेजोवती नाम पुरी दिव्याश्चर्यसमन्विता
verses.transliteration: tasya dakṣiṇadigbhāge vahneramitatejasaḥ / tejovatī nāma purī divyāścaryasamanvitā
verses.translation: Kala, comparable to a thousand destructive forces, (v.l. who is incomparable and is the master of a thousand mayas), the annihilator, Sankara and Bhava, the Tamasa form of god Sambhu is the reckoner of the world.
verses.hindi: है और उन कर्मोके अनुसार ही सभी प्रकारके देहकी उत्पत्ति होती है। यह आत्मा नित्य, सर्वव्यापी, कूटस्थ और दोषोंसे रहित है। यह अद्वितीय आत्मा मायारूप शक्तिके कारण भिन्न-भिन्न प्रतीत होता है, स्वभावत:
verses.wordMeaning: Kala, comparable to a thousand destructive forces, (v.l. who is incomparable and is the master of a thousand mayas), the annihilator, Sankara and Bhava, the Tamasa form of god Sambhu is the reckoner of the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kala, comparable to a thousand destructive forces, (v.l. who is incomparable and is the master of a thousand mayas), the annihilator, Sankara and Bhava, the Tamasa form of god Sambhu is the reckoner of the world.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रास्ते भगवान् वह्निर्भ्राजमानः स्वतेजसा । जपिनां होमिनां स्थानं दानवानां दुरासदम्
verses.transliteration: tatrāste bhagavān vahnirbhrājamānaḥ svatejasā / japināṃ homināṃ sthānaṃ dānavānāṃ durāsadam
verses.translation: These lakes are around Mt. Meru as follows: Arunoda in the east, Mahabhadra in the north, Asitoda (rather 'Sitoda' as in the Vdyii P.) in the west and Manasa in the south.
verses.hindi: इसमें भेद नहीं है इसी कारण मुनिजन आत्माको परमार्थतः अद्वैत ही कहते है । व्यक्त (महत्तत्त्व, अहंतत्त्व आदि) -के स्वभावसे जो भेद दिखलायी पड़ता है और यह भेद मूलतः माया (प्रकृति)-के कारण ही है तथा यह आत्मा (पुरुष)-के
verses.wordMeaning: These lakes are around Mt. Meru as follows: Arunoda in the east, Mahabhadra in the north, Asitoda (rather 'Sitoda' as in the Vdyii P.) in the west and Manasa in the south.
verses.commentary: Sense: These lakes are around Mt. Meru as follows: Arunoda in the east, Mahabhadra in the north, Asitoda (rather 'Sitoda' as in the Vdyii P.) in the west and Manasa in the south.

verses.sanskrit: दक्षिणे पर्वतवरे यमस्यापि महापुरी । नाम्ना संयमनी दिव्या सिद्धगन्धर्वसेविता
verses.transliteration: dakṣiṇe parvatavare yamasyāpi mahāpurī / nāmnā saṃyamanī divyā siddhagandharvasevitā
verses.translation: The Purana-writer gives a poetic description of the mountain ranges that branch off from Mt. Meru (the Pamirs) in four directions. Meru
verses.hindi: आश्रित होकर ही सब कुछ करती है । जैसे धुएँके सम्पर्कसे आकाश मलिन नहीं होता, वैसे ही अन्तःकरणसे उत्पन्न होनेवाले भावोंसे आत्मा लिप्त नहीं होता। जैसे अद्वितीय शुद्ध स्फटिक अपनी आभासे प्रकाशित होता है, वैसे ही
verses.wordMeaning: The Purana-writer gives a poetic description of the mountain ranges that branch off from Mt. Meru (the Pamirs) in four directions. Meru
verses.commentary: Sense: The Purana-writer gives a poetic description of the mountain ranges that branch off from Mt. Meru (the Pamirs) in four directions. Meru

verses.sanskrit: तत्र वैवस्वतं देवं देवाद्याः पर्युपासते । स्थानं तत् सत्यसंधानां लोके पुण्यकृतां नृणाम्
verses.transliteration: tatra vaivasvataṃ devaṃ devādyāḥ paryupāsate / sthānaṃ tat satyasaṃdhānāṃ loke puṇyakṛtāṃ nṛṇām
verses.translation: These seven great continents are encircled by seven oceans. The latter the continent, the greater it is in extent than the previous one, the latter ocean is said to be greater than the former.
verses.hindi: उपाधियोंसे रहित निर्मल आत्मा (अपने ही प्रकाशसे) प्रकाशित होता है । विद्वान् लोग इस संसारको ज्ञानस्वरूप ही कहते हैं, परंतु दूसरे कुत्सित दृष्टि रखनेवाले अज्ञानी लोग इसे अर्थस्वरूप (विषयस्वरूप) मानते हैं भ्रान्त दृष्टिवाले पुरुषोंके द्वारा स्वभावतः कूटस्थ, निर्गुण, सर्वव्यापी और चैतन्य आत्मा अर्थरूपसे ही देखा जाता है। जिस प्रकार शुद्ध स्फटिक गुज्ञा आदि
verses.wordMeaning: These seven great continents are encircled by seven oceans. The latter the continent, the greater it is in extent than the previous one, the latter ocean is said to be greater than the former.
verses.commentary: Sense: These seven great continents are encircled by seven oceans. The latter the continent, the greater it is in extent than the previous one, the latter ocean is said to be greater than the former.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यास्तु पश्चिमे भागे निरृतेस्तु महात्मनः । रक्षोवती नाम पुरी राक्षसैः सर्वतो वृता
verses.transliteration: tasyāstu paścime bhāge nirṛtestu mahātmanaḥ / rakṣovatī nāma purī rākṣasaiḥ sarvato vṛtā
verses.translation: The seven oceans are: Karoda (ocean of salt water). Iksurasoda (ocean of sugar-cane juice), Suroda (ocean of wine), Ghrtoda (ocean of ghee), Dadhyoda (ocean of curd) Kslra- salila (ocean milk), svaduda (ocean of Sweetwater).
verses.hindi: यथा संलक्ष्यते रक्त: केवलः स्फटिको जनैः । रक्तिकाद्युपधानेन तद्वत् परमपूरुषः
verses.wordMeaning: The seven oceans are: Karoda (ocean of salt water). Iksurasoda (ocean of sugar-cane juice), Suroda (ocean of wine), Ghrtoda (ocean of ghee), Dadhyoda (ocean of curd) Kslra- salila (ocean milk), svaduda (ocean of Sweetwater).
verses.commentary: Sense: The seven oceans are: Karoda (ocean of salt water). Iksurasoda (ocean of sugar-cane juice), Suroda (ocean of wine), Ghrtoda (ocean of ghee), Dadhyoda (ocean of curd) Kslra- salila (ocean milk), svaduda (ocean of Sweetwater).

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तं निरृतिं देवं राक्षसाः पर्युपासते । गच्छन्ति तां धर्मरता ये वै तामसवृत्तयः
verses.transliteration: tatra taṃ nirṛtiṃ devaṃ rākṣasāḥ paryupāsate / gacchanti tāṃ dharmaratā ye vai tāmasavṛttayaḥ
verses.translation: The earth alongwith the oceans and seven con¬ tinents extends to fifty crores of Yojanas all round.
verses.hindi: सर्वभूतेषु चात्मानं ब्रह्म सम्पद्यते तदा एकीभूतः परेणासौ तदा भवति केवलः
verses.wordMeaning: The earth alongwith the oceans and seven con¬ tinents extends to fifty crores of Yojanas all round.
verses.commentary: Sense: The earth alongwith the oceans and seven con¬ tinents extends to fifty crores of Yojanas all round.

verses.sanskrit: पश्चिमे पर्वतवरे वरुणस्य महापुरी । नाम्ना सुद्धवती पुण्या सर्वकामर्धिसंयुता
verses.transliteration: paścime parvatavare varuṇasya mahāpurī / nāmnā suddhavatī puṇyā sarvakāmardhisaṃyutā
verses.translation: Jambudvipa is situated in the middle of conti¬ nents. In its centre is the well-known mountain Mahameru that has the golden lustre.
verses.hindi: यदा सर्वे प्रमुच्यन्ते कामा येऽस्य हृदि स्थिताः । तदासावमृतीभूतः क्षेमं गच्छति पण्डितः
verses.wordMeaning: Jambudvipa is situated in the middle of conti¬ nents. In its centre is the well-known mountain Mahameru that has the golden lustre.
verses.commentary: Sense: Jambudvipa is situated in the middle of conti¬ nents. In its centre is the well-known mountain Mahameru that has the golden lustre.

verses.sanskrit: तत्राप्सरोगणैः सिद्धैः सेव्यमानो ऽमराधिपः । आस्ते स वरुणो राजा तत्र गच्छन्ति ये ऽम्बुदाः । तीर्थयात्रापरी नित्यं ये च लोके ऽधमर्षिणः
verses.transliteration: tatrāpsarogaṇaiḥ siddhaiḥ sevyamāno 'marādhipaḥ / āste sa varuṇo rājā tatra gacchanti ye 'mbudāḥ / tīrthayātrāparī nityaṃ ye ca loke 'dhamarṣiṇaḥ
verses.translation: Its height is eightyfour thousand Yojanas. It has gone sixteen thousand Yojanas down below. On the top it extends to thirtytwo thousand Yojanas.
verses.hindi: तत एव च विस्तारं ब्रह्म सम्पद्यते तदा यदा पश्यति चात्मानं केवलं परमार्थतः । मायामात्रं जगत् कृत्स्नं तदा भवति निर्वृतः
verses.wordMeaning: Its height is eightyfour thousand Yojanas. It has gone sixteen thousand Yojanas down below. On the top it extends to thirtytwo thousand Yojanas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Its height is eightyfour thousand Yojanas. It has gone sixteen thousand Yojanas down below. On the top it extends to thirtytwo thousand Yojanas.

verses.sanskrit: तस्या उत्तरदिग्भागे वायोरपि महापुरी । नाम्ना गन्धवती पुण्या तत्रास्ते ऽसौ प्रभञ्जनः
verses.transliteration: tasyā uttaradigbhāge vāyorapi mahāpurī / nāmnā gandhavatī puṇyā tatrāste 'sau prabhañjanaḥ
verses.translation: Its extent at its root (i.e. base) is sixteen thousand Yojanas all round. This mountain resembles the pericarp of the lotus of the Earth.
verses.hindi: केवलं ब्रह्मविज्ञानं जायतेऽसौ तदा शिवः
verses.wordMeaning: Its extent at its root (i.e. base) is sixteen thousand Yojanas all round. This mountain resembles the pericarp of the lotus of the Earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Its extent at its root (i.e. base) is sixteen thousand Yojanas all round. This mountain resembles the pericarp of the lotus of the Earth.

verses.sanskrit: अप्सरोगणगन्धर्वैः सेव्यमानो ऽमरप्रभुः । प्राणायामपरामर्त्यास्थानन्तद्यान्ति शाश्वतम्
verses.transliteration: apsarogaṇagandharvaiḥ sevyamāno 'maraprabhuḥ / prāṇāyāmaparāmartyāsthānantadyānti śāśvatam
verses.translation: To its south are the mountains Himavan, Hemakuta and Nisadha. The Varsa (boundary) mountains to the north are Nila, Sveta and Srhgin.
verses.hindi: यथा नदीनदा लोके सागरेणैकतां ययुः । तद्वदात्माक्षरेणासौ निष्कलेनैकतां ब्रजेत् अज्ञानेनावृतं लोको विज्ञानं तेन मुहाति
verses.wordMeaning: To its south are the mountains Himavan, Hemakuta and Nisadha. The Varsa (boundary) mountains to the north are Nila, Sveta and Srhgin.
verses.commentary: Sense: To its south are the mountains Himavan, Hemakuta and Nisadha. The Varsa (boundary) mountains to the north are Nila, Sveta and Srhgin.

verses.sanskrit: तस्याः पूर्वेण दिग्भागे सोमस्य परमा पुरी । नाम्ना कान्तिमती शुभ्रा तत्र सोमो विराजते
verses.transliteration: tasyāḥ pūrveṇa digbhāge somasya paramā purī / nāmnā kāntimatī śubhrā tatra somo virājate
verses.translation: The two middle ranges of mountains are a hundred thousand Yojanas in extent. The others are each ten thousand Yojanas less in order. Their height is two thousand Yojanas and the length is as much.
verses.hindi: उपाधिके कारण लोगोंको लाल वर्णका-सा दिखलायी पड़ता है, वैसे ही परम पुरुष भी (मायाके द्वारा नाम- रूपात्मक उपाधियुक्त प्रतीत होनेके कारण अनेक रूपोंमें दिखलायी पड़ता) है। इस कारण मोक्षे अभिलाषियोंको
verses.wordMeaning: The two middle ranges of mountains are a hundred thousand Yojanas in extent. The others are each ten thousand Yojanas less in order. Their height is two thousand Yojanas and the length is as much.
verses.commentary: Sense: The two middle ranges of mountains are a hundred thousand Yojanas in extent. The others are each ten thousand Yojanas less in order. Their height is two thousand Yojanas and the length is as much.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र ये भोगनिरता स्वधर्मं पुर्यपासते । तेषां तद् रचितं स्थानं नानाभोगसमन्वितम्
verses.transliteration: tatra ye bhoganiratā svadharmaṃ puryapāsate / teṣāṃ tad racitaṃ sthānaṃ nānābhogasamanvitam
verses.translation: Bharata is the first Varsa (sub-continent); then is the Kimpurusa Varsa, the other one is Harivarsa. O Brahmanas, All these are to the South of Meru.
verses.hindi: अक्षर, शुद्ध, नित्य, सर्वव्यापी तथा अव्यय उस आत्माका श्रवण, मनन तथा उपासना करनी चाहिए। (जिससे माया (अज्ञान)-की निवृत्ति हो तथा शुद्ध आत्मतत्त्वका ज्ञान प्राप्त हो) योगीके मनमें जब सर्वत्र व्याप्त रहनेवाला चैतन्य सदा प्रकाशित होता है, तब वह योगी बिना किसी व्यवधानके आत्मभाव प्राप्त कर लेता है
verses.wordMeaning: Bharata is the first Varsa (sub-continent); then is the Kimpurusa Varsa, the other one is Harivarsa. O Brahmanas, All these are to the South of Meru.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bharata is the first Varsa (sub-continent); then is the Kimpurusa Varsa, the other one is Harivarsa. O Brahmanas, All these are to the South of Meru.

verses.sanskrit: तस्याश्च पूर्वदिग्भागे शङ्करस्य महापुरी । नाम्ना यशोवती पुण्या सर्वेषां सुदुरासदा
verses.transliteration: tasyāśca pūrvadigbhāge śaṅkarasya mahāpurī / nāmnā yaśovatī puṇyā sarveṣāṃ sudurāsadā
verses.translation: On four sides of Mt. Meru, there is Ilavrta which is nine thousand Yojanas in extent (on all sides of Meru). There are four mountains in Ilavfta, O highly fortunate ones.
verses.hindi: (योगी) जब सभी प्राणियोंको अपनी आत्मामें अच्छी प्रकार स्थित देख लेता है और सभी प्राणियोंमें अपनेको स्थित देखता है, तब उसे ब्रह्मभावकी प्राप्ति हो जाती है। जब (योगी) समाधिकी अवस्थामें किसी भी प्राणीको (अपनेसे
verses.wordMeaning: On four sides of Mt. Meru, there is Ilavrta which is nine thousand Yojanas in extent (on all sides of Meru). There are four mountains in Ilavfta, O highly fortunate ones.
verses.commentary: Sense: On four sides of Mt. Meru, there is Ilavrta which is nine thousand Yojanas in extent (on all sides of Meru). There are four mountains in Ilavfta, O highly fortunate ones.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रेशानस्य भवनं रुद्रविष्णुतनोः शुभम् । घमेश्वरस्य विपुलं तत्रास्ते स गणैर्वृतः
verses.transliteration: tatreśānasya bhavanaṃ rudraviṣṇutanoḥ śubham / ghameśvarasya vipulaṃ tatrāste sa gaṇairvṛtaḥ
verses.translation: They are as if constructed as the support of Mt Meru and they are ten thousand Yojanas in height. The mountain to the east is Mandara and that to the south is Gandhamadana.
verses.hindi: भिन्न) नहीं देखता (अर्थात् समस्त प्रपञ्जमें आत्मदर्शन करता है), तब वह उस परतत्त्वसे एकात्मभाव प्राप्त कर लेता है और अद्वितीय हो जाता है। उसके हृदयमें स्थित सभी कामनाएँ जब समाप्त हो जाती हैं तब वह पण्डित अमृतस्वरूप होकर (परम) कल्याण प्रात कर लेता है (योगी) जब प्राणियोंके पार्थक्यको एक तत्त्वमें स्थित देखता है और उसी (तत्त्व)-से उनका विस्तार होना समझता है, तब उसे ब्रह्मकी प्राप्ति हो जाती है। जब वह परमार्थतः (सर्वत्र)
verses.wordMeaning: They are as if constructed as the support of Mt Meru and they are ten thousand Yojanas in height. The mountain to the east is Mandara and that to the south is Gandhamadana.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are as if constructed as the support of Mt Meru and they are ten thousand Yojanas in height. The mountain to the east is Mandara and that to the south is Gandhamadana.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र भोगाभिलिप्सूनां भक्तानां परमेष्ठिनः । निवासः कल्पितः पूर्वं देवदेवेन शूलिना
verses.transliteration: tatra bhogābhilipsūnāṃ bhaktānāṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ / nivāsaḥ kalpitaḥ pūrvaṃ devadevena śūlinā
verses.translation: The mountain Vipula is on the western side and Suparsva is on the northern mountain. On each of the mountains stands a Kadamba, a Jambu, a Pippala and a Vata (banyan) tree respectively.
verses.hindi: केवल अद्वितीय आत्माको ही देखता है और सम्पूर्ण जगत्को मायामात्र समझता है, तब वह मुक्त हो जाता है॥ ३१--३५॥ जब योगीको जन्म, जरा, दुःख और समस्त व्याधियोंके एकमात्र औषध अद्वितीय ब्रह्मका ज्ञान हो जाता है, तब
verses.wordMeaning: The mountain Vipula is on the western side and Suparsva is on the northern mountain. On each of the mountains stands a Kadamba, a Jambu, a Pippala and a Vata (banyan) tree respectively.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mountain Vipula is on the western side and Suparsva is on the northern mountain. On each of the mountains stands a Kadamba, a Jambu, a Pippala and a Vata (banyan) tree respectively.

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुपादाद् विनिष्क्रान्ता प्लावयित्वेन्दुमण्डलम् । समन्ताद् ब्रह्मणः पुर्यां गङ्गा पतति वै दिवः
verses.transliteration: viṣṇupādād viniṣkrāntā plāvayitvendumaṇḍalam / samantād brahmaṇaḥ puryāṃ gaṅgā patati vai divaḥ
verses.translation: O great sages, the Jambu tree is the cause of the name of the continent, Jambudvipa. The fruits of the Jambu tree are of the size of a huge elephant.
verses.hindi: वह शिवरूप हो जाता है। जिस प्रकार संसारमें नद एवं नदियाँ सागरके साथ एकरूपताको प्राप्त करती हैं, उसी प्रकार यह आत्मा (जीवात्मा) निष्कल अक्षर (ब्रह्म)-के साथ एकत्व प्राप्त करता है इसलिये विज्ञानका ही अस्तित्व है, प्रपञ्च और संसरणशील संसारका अस्तित्व नहीं है। विज्ञान अज्ञानसे आवृत रहता है, इसीसे संसार (जीव) मोहमें पड़ता है। ज्ञान निर्मल, सुक्ष्म, निर्विकल्पक और अव्यय है, अज्ञानके अतिरिक्त जो
verses.wordMeaning: O great sages, the Jambu tree is the cause of the name of the continent, Jambudvipa. The fruits of the Jambu tree are of the size of a huge elephant.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sages, the Jambu tree is the cause of the name of the continent, Jambudvipa. The fruits of the Jambu tree are of the size of a huge elephant.

verses.sanskrit: सा तत्र पतिता दिक्षु चतुर्धा ह्यभवद् द्विजाः । सीता चालकनन्दा च सुचक्षुर्भद्रनामिका
verses.transliteration: sā tatra patitā dikṣu caturdhā hyabhavad dvijāḥ / sītā cālakanandā ca sucakṣurbhadranāmikā
verses.translation: They fall on the top of the mountain all round and they are shattered and strewn about. With the juice thereof the well-known Jambu river flows on the mountain.
verses.hindi: कुछ है, वह विज्ञान है--ऐसा मेरा मत है। यह आप लोगोंको सांख्य नामक परमोत्तम ज्ञान बतलाया। यह सम्पूर्ण वेदान्तका सार है। इसमें चित्तकी एकाग्रता ही योग है॥ ३८--४० ॥
verses.wordMeaning: They fall on the top of the mountain all round and they are shattered and strewn about. With the juice thereof the well-known Jambu river flows on the mountain.
verses.commentary: Sense: They fall on the top of the mountain all round and they are shattered and strewn about. With the juice thereof the well-known Jambu river flows on the mountain.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वेण सीता शैलात् तु शैलं यात्यन्तरिक्षतः । ततश्च पूर्ववर्षेण भद्राश्वेनैति चार्णवम्
verses.transliteration: pūrveṇa sītā śailāt tu śailaṃ yātyantarikṣataḥ / tataśca pūrvavarṣeṇa bhadrāśvenaiti cārṇavam
verses.translation: The river flows and it is drunk by the residents of the place whereby they have no perspiration, no bad odour, no old age nor any disability of sense-organs.
verses.hindi: यदेव योगिनो यान्ति सांख्यैस्तदधिगम्यते। एकं सांख्यं च योगं च यः पश्यति स तत्त्ववित् कीर्तितः सर्ववेदेषु सर्वात्मा सर्वतोमुखः
verses.wordMeaning: The river flows and it is drunk by the residents of the place whereby they have no perspiration, no bad odour, no old age nor any disability of sense-organs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The river flows and it is drunk by the residents of the place whereby they have no perspiration, no bad odour, no old age nor any disability of sense-organs.

verses.sanskrit: तथैवालकनन्दा च दक्षिणादेत्य भारतम् । प्रयाति सागरं भित्त्वा सप्तभेदा द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: tathaivālakanandā ca dakṣiṇādetya bhāratam / prayāti sāgaraṃ bhittvā saptabhedā dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: The river flows and it is drunk by the residents of the place whereby they have no perspiration, no bad odour, no old age nor any disability of sense-organs.
verses.hindi: सर्वकामः सर्वरसः सर्वगन्धोऽजरोऽमरः । सर्वतः पाणिपादोऽहमन्तर्यामी सनातनः
verses.wordMeaning: The river flows and it is drunk by the residents of the place whereby they have no perspiration, no bad odour, no old age nor any disability of sense-organs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The river flows and it is drunk by the residents of the place whereby they have no perspiration, no bad odour, no old age nor any disability of sense-organs.

verses.sanskrit: सुचक्षुः पश्चिमगिरीनतीत्य सकलांस्तथा । पश्चिमं केतुमालाख्यं वर्षं गत्वैति चार्णवम्
verses.transliteration: sucakṣuḥ paścimagirīnatītya sakalāṃstathā / paścimaṃ ketumālākhyaṃ varṣaṃ gatvaiti cārṇavam
verses.translation: The river flows and it is drunk by the residents of the place whereby they have no perspiration, no bad odour, no old age nor any disability of sense-organs.
verses.hindi: अचक्षुरपि पश्यामि तथाकर्णः श्ृणोम्यहम् निर्गुणामलरूपस्य यत्तहैश्वर्यमुत्तमम्
verses.wordMeaning: The river flows and it is drunk by the residents of the place whereby they have no perspiration, no bad odour, no old age nor any disability of sense-organs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The river flows and it is drunk by the residents of the place whereby they have no perspiration, no bad odour, no old age nor any disability of sense-organs.

verses.sanskrit: भद्रा तथोत्तरगिरीनुत्तरांश्च तथा कुरून् । अतीत्य चोत्तराम्भोधिं समभ्येति महर्षयः
verses.transliteration: bhadrā tathottaragirīnuttarāṃśca tathā kurūn / atītya cottarāmbhodhiṃ samabhyeti maharṣayaḥ
verses.translation: The river flows and it is drunk by the residents of the place whereby they have no perspiration, no bad odour, no old age nor any disability of sense-organs.
verses.hindi: यन्न देवा विजानन्ति मोहिता मम मायया। वक्ष्ये समाहिता यूयं श्रृणुध्वं ब्रह्मवादिनः
verses.wordMeaning: The river flows and it is drunk by the residents of the place whereby they have no perspiration, no bad odour, no old age nor any disability of sense-organs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The river flows and it is drunk by the residents of the place whereby they have no perspiration, no bad odour, no old age nor any disability of sense-organs.

verses.sanskrit: आनीलनिषधायामौ माल्यवान् गन्धमादनः । तयोर्मध्यगतो मेरुः कर्णिकाकारसंस्थितः
verses.transliteration: ānīlaniṣadhāyāmau mālyavān gandhamādanaḥ / tayormadhyagato meruḥ karṇikākārasaṃsthitaḥ
verses.translation: The river flows and it is drunk by the residents of the place whereby they have no perspiration, no bad odour, no old age nor any disability of sense-organs.
verses.hindi: प्रेरयामि तथापीदं कारणं सूरयो विदुः योगसे ज्ञान उत्पन्न होता है और ज्ञानसे योग प्रवर्तित (स्थिर) होता है। योग तथा ज्ञानसम्पन्न (पुरुष)-के लिये कुछ भी प्राप्त करना शेष नहीं रह जाता। योगी जिसे प्राप्त करते हैं, सांख्यवेत्ताओंके द्वारा भी वही प्राप्त
verses.wordMeaning: The river flows and it is drunk by the residents of the place whereby they have no perspiration, no bad odour, no old age nor any disability of sense-organs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The river flows and it is drunk by the residents of the place whereby they have no perspiration, no bad odour, no old age nor any disability of sense-organs.

verses.sanskrit: भारताः केतुमालाश्च भद्राश्वाः कुरवस्तथा । पत्राणि लोकपद्मस्य मर्यादाशैलबाह्यतः
verses.transliteration: bhāratāḥ ketumālāśca bhadrāśvāḥ kuravastathā / patrāṇi lokapadmasya maryādāśailabāhyataḥ
verses.translation: The river flows and it is drunk by the residents of the place whereby they have no perspiration, no bad odour, no old age nor any disability of sense-organs.
verses.hindi: किया जाता है। जो सांख्य और योगको एक ही समझता है, वह तत्त्वज्ञानी होता है
verses.wordMeaning: The river flows and it is drunk by the residents of the place whereby they have no perspiration, no bad odour, no old age nor any disability of sense-organs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The river flows and it is drunk by the residents of the place whereby they have no perspiration, no bad odour, no old age nor any disability of sense-organs.

verses.sanskrit: जठरो देवकूटश्च मर्यादापर्वतावुभौ । दक्षिणोत्तरमायामावानीलनिषधायतौ
verses.transliteration: jaṭharo devakūṭaśca maryādāparvatāvubhau / dakṣiṇottaramāyāmāvānīlaniṣadhāyatau
verses.translation: The river flows and it is drunk by the residents of the place whereby they have no perspiration, no bad odour, no old age nor any disability of sense-organs.
verses.hindi: विप्रो! ऐश्वर्य (आठ प्रकारको सिद्धियों एवं अन्य वैभव आदि)-में आसक्तचित्त अन्य योगीजन उसीमें डूबे रहते हैं, अतएव उन्हें आत्मतत्त्व प्राप्त नहीं होता-ऐसा श्रुतिवचन है । जो सर्वव्यापी, दिव्य ऐश्वर्यरूप, अचल और महत् (सर्वश्रेष्ठ) है, उसे ज्ञान और योगसम्पन्न पुरुष देहान्त होनेपर प्राप्त करते हैं । सम्पूर्ण वेदोंमें सर्वात्मा, सर्वतोमुखके रूपमें प्रतिपादित, अव्यक्त, मायावी (मायाका अधिष्ठाता) तथा परमेश्वरस्वरूप मैं ही यह आत्मा हूँ
verses.wordMeaning: The river flows and it is drunk by the residents of the place whereby they have no perspiration, no bad odour, no old age nor any disability of sense-organs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The river flows and it is drunk by the residents of the place whereby they have no perspiration, no bad odour, no old age nor any disability of sense-organs.

verses.sanskrit: गन्धमादनकैलासौ पूर्वपश्चायतावुभौ । अशीतियोजनायामावर्णवान्तर्व्यवस्थितौ
verses.transliteration: gandhamādanakailāsau pūrvapaścāyatāvubhau / aśītiyojanāyāmāvarṇavāntarvyavasthitau
verses.translation: The river flows and it is drunk by the residents of the place whereby they have no perspiration, no bad odour, no old age nor any disability of sense-organs.
verses.hindi: मैं अन्तर्यामी, सनातन, सर्वकाम, सर्वरस, सर्वगन्ध,
verses.wordMeaning: The river flows and it is drunk by the residents of the place whereby they have no perspiration, no bad odour, no old age nor any disability of sense-organs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The river flows and it is drunk by the residents of the place whereby they have no perspiration, no bad odour, no old age nor any disability of sense-organs.

verses.sanskrit: निषधः पारियात्रश्च मर्यादापर्वताविमौ । मेरोः पश्चिमदिग्भागे यथापूर्वौ तथा स्थितौ
verses.transliteration: niṣadhaḥ pāriyātraśca maryādāparvatāvimau / meroḥ paścimadigbhāge yathāpūrvau tathā sthitau
verses.translation: The river flows and it is drunk by the residents of the place whereby they have no perspiration, no bad odour, no old age nor any disability of sense-organs.
verses.hindi: पैरके बिना भी मैं गति करने एवं ग्रहण करनेवाला हूँ। (सभी प्राणियोंके) हृदयमें स्थित हूँ। बिना नेत्रोंके भी देखता हूँ और बिना कानोंके भी मैं सुनता हूँ। में इस समस्त प्रपञ्चको जानता हूँ, परंतु मुझे कोई नहीं जानता। तत्त्वदर्शी लोग मुझे अद्वितीय महान् पुरुष कहते हैं। सूक्ष्मदशी ऋषि गुणरहित और विशुद्धरूप आत्माके हेतुस्वरूप उस श्रेष्ठ ऐश्वर्य (सर्वोत्कृष्ट ज्ञान) -का दर्शन (साक्षात्कार) करते हैं। ब्रह्मवादियो ! मेरी मायासे मोहित होनेके कारण देवता भी
verses.wordMeaning: The river flows and it is drunk by the residents of the place whereby they have no perspiration, no bad odour, no old age nor any disability of sense-organs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The river flows and it is drunk by the residents of the place whereby they have no perspiration, no bad odour, no old age nor any disability of sense-organs.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिशृङ्गो जारुधैस्तद्वदुत्तरे वर्षपर्वतौ । पूर्वपश्चायतावेतौ अर्णवान्तर्व्यवस्थितौ
verses.transliteration: triśṛṅgo jārudhaistadvaduttare varṣaparvatau / pūrvapaścāyatāvetau arṇavāntarvyavasthitau
verses.translation: The river flows and it is drunk by the residents of the place whereby they have no perspiration, no bad odour, no old age nor any disability of sense-organs.
verses.hindi: जिस (तत्त्व) -को नहीं जानते उसे मैं कहता हूँ, आप लोग ध्यान लगाकर सुनें-
verses.wordMeaning: The river flows and it is drunk by the residents of the place whereby they have no perspiration, no bad odour, no old age nor any disability of sense-organs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The river flows and it is drunk by the residents of the place whereby they have no perspiration, no bad odour, no old age nor any disability of sense-organs.

verses.sanskrit: मर्यादापर्वताः प्रोक्ता अष्टाविह मया द्विजाः । जठराद्याः स्थिता मेरोश्चतुर्दिक्षु महर्षयः
verses.transliteration: maryādāparvatāḥ proktā aṣṭāviha mayā dvijāḥ / jaṭharādyāḥ sthitā meroścaturdikṣu maharṣayaḥ
verses.translation: The river flows and it is drunk by the residents of the place whereby they have no perspiration, no bad odour, no old age nor any disability of sense-organs.
verses.hindi: मायातीत मैं स्वभावतः सबका अनुशास्ता नहीं हूँ, तथापि इस जगत्को मैं प्रेरित करता हुँ, विद्वान् लोग इसका कारण जानते हैं (वह कारण अहैतुकी कृपा ही हैं।) । मेरा जो अत्यन्त गुह्यतम तथा सर्वव्यापी देह है, तत्त्वदर्शी योगीजन उसमें प्रविष्ट होते हैं और मेरे अविनाशी सायुज्य (नामक मोक्ष) -को प्राप्त करते हैं। मेरी विश्वरूपिणी माया उनके वशमें रहती है। वे मेरे साथ (मेरा सायुज्य प्राप्तकर) परम शुद्धि और निर्वाणको प्राप्त करते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The river flows and it is drunk by the residents of the place whereby they have no perspiration, no bad odour, no old age nor any disability of sense-organs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The river flows and it is drunk by the residents of the place whereby they have no perspiration, no bad odour, no old age nor any disability of sense-organs.

verses.sanskrit: इती श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे चतुश्चत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः सूत उवाच केतुमाले नराः कालाः सर्वे पनसभोजनाः । स्त्रियश्चोत्पलपत्राभा जीवन्ति च वर्षायुतम्
verses.transliteration: itī śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge catuścatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca ketumāle narāḥ kālāḥ sarve panasabhojanāḥ / striyaścotpalapatrābhā jīvanti ca varṣāyutam
verses.translation: In between these important mountains, there are inner water reservoirs, lakes and forests.
verses.hindi: न तेषां पुनरावृत्तिः कल्पकोटिशतैरपि।
verses.wordMeaning: In between these important mountains, there are inner water reservoirs, lakes and forests.
verses.commentary: Sense: In between these important mountains, there are inner water reservoirs, lakes and forests.

verses.sanskrit: भद्राश्वे पुरुषाः शुक्लाः स्त्रियश्चन्द्रांशुसन्निभाः । दश वर्षसहस्त्राणि जीवन्ते आम्रभोजनाः
verses.transliteration: bhadrāśve puruṣāḥ śuklāḥ striyaścandrāṃśusannibhāḥ / daśa varṣasahastrāṇi jīvante āmrabhojanāḥ
verses.translation: Sages, Siddhas and ascetics sanctified by meditation on Brahman inhabit there. They are delighted, free from all distresses and sorrows and have their Rajas attribute subdued.
verses.hindi: मेरी कृपासे सेकड़ों-करोड़ों कल्पोंमें भी उनका पुनर्जन्म प्रसादान्मम योगीन्द्रा एतद् वेदानुशासनम्॥ ५४॥  नहीं होता। योगीन्द्रो! यह वेदोंका अनुशासन है
verses.wordMeaning: Sages, Siddhas and ascetics sanctified by meditation on Brahman inhabit there. They are delighted, free from all distresses and sorrows and have their Rajas attribute subdued.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sages, Siddhas and ascetics sanctified by meditation on Brahman inhabit there. They are delighted, free from all distresses and sorrows and have their Rajas attribute subdued.

verses.sanskrit: रम्यके पुरुषा नार्यो रमन्ते रजतप्रभाः । दशवर्षसहस्त्राणि शतानि दश पञ्च च । जीवन्ति चैव सत्त्वस्था न्यग्रोधफलभोजनाः
verses.transliteration: ramyake puruṣā nāryo ramante rajataprabhāḥ / daśavarṣasahastrāṇi śatāni daśa pañca ca / jīvanti caiva sattvasthā nyagrodhaphalabhojanāḥ
verses.translation: De identifies Sita with the jaxartes (sir-Daria), Sucaksu with the Oxus, and Bhadra with the Yarkand or Zarafshan. M. Ali differs but the description of the rivers and the regions watered by them tallies more with M. Ali's description in Op. Cit. Ch. IV (and also Chs. V-VIII).
verses.hindi: नापुत्रशिष्ययोगिभ्यो दातव्यं ब्रह्मवादिभिः ।
verses.wordMeaning: De identifies Sita with the jaxartes (sir-Daria), Sucaksu with the Oxus, and Bhadra with the Yarkand or Zarafshan. M. Ali differs but the description of the rivers and the regions watered by them tallies more with M. Ali's description in Op. Cit. Ch. IV (and also Chs. V-VIII).
verses.commentary: Sense: De identifies Sita with the jaxartes (sir-Daria), Sucaksu with the Oxus, and Bhadra with the Yarkand or Zarafshan. M. Ali differs but the description of the rivers and the regions watered by them tallies more with M. Ali's description in Op. Cit. Ch. IV (and also Chs. V-VIII).

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्मये हिरण्याभाः सर्वे च लकुचाशनाः । एकादशसहस्त्राणि शतानि दश पञ्च च । जीवन्ति पुरुषा नार्यो देवलोकस्थिता इव
verses.transliteration: hiraṇmaye hiraṇyābhāḥ sarve ca lakucāśanāḥ / ekādaśasahastrāṇi śatāni daśa pañca ca / jīvanti puruṣā nāryo devalokasthitā iva
verses.translation: There resides lord Brahma, the soul of the Universe, the creator of the universe. He is being worshipped by leading Yogins, prominent sages as well as by Indra, Visnu and Sankara.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मवादियोंको चाहिए कि वे मेरे द्वारा कहे गये इस सांख्य-योग-समन्वित विज्ञानको (अपने) पुत्र, शिष्य एवं योगियोंके अतिरिक्त और किसी दूसरेको मदुक्तमेतद् विज्ञानं सांख्ययोगसमाश्रयम्॥ ५५॥  प्रदान न करें
verses.wordMeaning: There resides lord Brahma, the soul of the Universe, the creator of the universe. He is being worshipped by leading Yogins, prominent sages as well as by Indra, Visnu and Sankara.
verses.commentary: Sense: There resides lord Brahma, the soul of the Universe, the creator of the universe. He is being worshipped by leading Yogins, prominent sages as well as by Indra, Visnu and Sankara.

verses.sanskrit: त्रयोदशसहस्त्राणि शतानि दश पञ्च च । जीवन्ति कुरुवर्षे तु श्यामाङ्गाः क्षीरभोजनाः
