verses.transliteration: trayodaśasahastrāṇi śatāni daśa pañca ca / jīvanti kuruvarṣe tu śyāmāṅgāḥ kṣīrabhojanāḥ
verses.translation: Holy lord Sanatkumara perpetually adores Prajapati, I Sana (the Lord), the chief of Devas, the soul of the universe.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षद्साहस्रघां संहितायामुपरिविभागे (ईशवरगीतासु ) द्वितीयोऽध्यायः
verses.wordMeaning: Holy lord Sanatkumara perpetually adores Prajapati, I Sana (the Lord), the chief of Devas, the soul of the universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: Holy lord Sanatkumara perpetually adores Prajapati, I Sana (the Lord), the chief of Devas, the soul of the universe.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे मिथुनजाताश्च नित्यं सुखनिषेविनः । चन्द्रद्वीपे महादेवं यजन्ति सततं शिवम्
verses.transliteration: sarve mithunajātāśca nityaṃ sukhaniṣevinaḥ / candradvīpe mahādevaṃ yajanti satataṃ śivam
verses.translation: With his soul absorbed in Yoga he drinks the excellent nectar. He stays there while being worshipped by Siddhas, sages, Gandharvas and gods.
verses.hindi: अव्यक्त शिवतत्त्वसे सृष्टिका कथन, परमात्माके स्वरूपका वर्णन तथा प्रधान, पुरुष एवं महदादि तत्त्वोंसे सृष्टिका क्रम-वर्णन, शिवस्वरूपका निरूपण अव्यक्तादभवत् कालः प्रधानं पुरुषः परः। तेभ्यः सर्वमिदं जातं तस्माद् ब्रह्ममयं जगत्
verses.wordMeaning: With his soul absorbed in Yoga he drinks the excellent nectar. He stays there while being worshipped by Siddhas, sages, Gandharvas and gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: With his soul absorbed in Yoga he drinks the excellent nectar. He stays there while being worshipped by Siddhas, sages, Gandharvas and gods.

verses.sanskrit: तथा किंपुरुषे विप्रा मानवा हेमसन्निभाः । दशवर्षहस्त्राणि जीवन्ति प्लक्षभोजनाः
verses.transliteration: tathā kiṃpuruṣe viprā mānavā hemasannibhāḥ / daśavarṣahastrāṇi jīvanti plakṣabhojanāḥ
verses.translation: The splendid and brilliant abode of Sambhu of immeasurable splendour, the overlord of Devas, is situated there in front of the abode of god Brahma.
verses.hindi: सर्वतः श्रुतिमल्लोके सर्वमावृत्य तिष्ठति
verses.wordMeaning: The splendid and brilliant abode of Sambhu of immeasurable splendour, the overlord of Devas, is situated there in front of the abode of god Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: The splendid and brilliant abode of Sambhu of immeasurable splendour, the overlord of Devas, is situated there in front of the abode of god Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: यजन्ति सततं देवं चतुर्मूर्ति चतुर्मुखम् । ध्याने मनः समाधाय सादरं भक्तिसंयुताः
verses.transliteration: yajanti satataṃ devaṃ caturmūrti caturmukham / dhyāne manaḥ samādhāya sādaraṃ bhaktisaṃyutāḥ
verses.translation: It is endowed with divine splendour. It is very splendid and it has four doors. It is full of great sages. It is resorted to by the knowers of Brahman.
verses.hindi: तयोरनादिरुद्दिष्टः कालः संयोजकः परः ईशवरने कहा--अव्यक्त (तत्त्व)-से काल, प्रधान तथा परम पुरुष उत्पन्न हुए। उन (कालादि)-से यह समस्त जगत् उत्पन्न हुआ, इसलिये यह जगत् ब्रह्ममय है। जिसके हाथ और पैरका प्रसार सर्वत्र है, जिसके
verses.wordMeaning: It is endowed with divine splendour. It is very splendid and it has four doors. It is full of great sages. It is resorted to by the knowers of Brahman.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is endowed with divine splendour. It is very splendid and it has four doors. It is full of great sages. It is resorted to by the knowers of Brahman.

verses.sanskrit: तथा च हरिवर्षे तु महारजतसन्निभाः । दशवर्षसहस्त्राणि जीवन्तीक्षुरसाशिनः
verses.transliteration: tathā ca harivarṣe tu mahārajatasannibhāḥ / daśavarṣasahastrāṇi jīvantīkṣurasāśinaḥ
verses.translation: God Mahadeva, the ruler of the universe and the lord of Pramathas (goblins, ghosts and other attendants of Siva) with the sun, moon and fire as his eyes, sports there with the goddess Uma while accompanied by Pramathas.
verses.hindi: नेत्र, मस्तक, मुख एवं कर्ण सर्वत्र वर्तमान हैं एवं जो समस्त (विश्व)-को आवृतकर स्थित है, वही (ब्रह्म) है
verses.wordMeaning: God Mahadeva, the ruler of the universe and the lord of Pramathas (goblins, ghosts and other attendants of Siva) with the sun, moon and fire as his eyes, sports there with the goddess Uma while accompanied by Pramathas.
verses.commentary: Sense: God Mahadeva, the ruler of the universe and the lord of Pramathas (goblins, ghosts and other attendants of Siva) with the sun, moon and fire as his eyes, sports there with the goddess Uma while accompanied by Pramathas.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र नारायणं देवं विश्वयोनिं सनातनम् । उपासते सदा विष्णुं मानवा विष्णुभाविताः
verses.transliteration: tatra nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ viśvayoniṃ sanātanam / upāsate sadā viṣṇuṃ mānavā viṣṇubhāvitāḥ
verses.translation: The knowers of the Vedas, the quiescent truthful sages observing celibacy adore Mahadeva by means of their penance.
verses.hindi: वह सभी इन्द्रियोंके गुणोंके आभासवाला है, अर्थात् सभी इन्द्रियोंके गुण उसमें प्रतीत होते हैं; किंतु सभी इन्द्रियोंसे रहित है। वह सभीका आधार है, सदा आनन्दस्वरूप, अव्यक्त और द्वैतसे रहित (अद्वैत तत्त्व) है। वह सभी उपमानोंसे रहित (निरुपमेय) इन्द्रियोंद्वारा प्रमाणोंसे ज्ञात न होने योग्य, निर्विकल्प, निराभास, सभीका आश्रय, परम अमृतस्वरूप, अभिन्न, भिन्नरूपसे
verses.wordMeaning: The knowers of the Vedas, the quiescent truthful sages observing celibacy adore Mahadeva by means of their penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: The knowers of the Vedas, the quiescent truthful sages observing celibacy adore Mahadeva by means of their penance.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र चन्द्रप्रभं शुभ्रं शुद्धस्फटिकनिर्मितम् । विमानं वासुदेवस्य पारिजातवनाश्रितम्
verses.transliteration: tatra candraprabhaṃ śubhraṃ śuddhasphaṭikanirmitam / vimānaṃ vāsudevasya pārijātavanāśritam
verses.translation: Accompanied byParvati, lord Mahadeva, the Supreme Lord, directly accepts with his head the worship of those sages of devoted and purified Atman.
verses.hindi: परम व्योमरूप है, उसे विद्वान् लोग जानते हैं॥ ३--५॥
verses.wordMeaning: Accompanied byParvati, lord Mahadeva, the Supreme Lord, directly accepts with his head the worship of those sages of devoted and purified Atman.
verses.commentary: Sense: Accompanied byParvati, lord Mahadeva, the Supreme Lord, directly accepts with his head the worship of those sages of devoted and purified Atman.

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्धारमनोपम्यं चतुस्तोरणसंयुतम् । प्राकारैर्दशभिर्युक्तं दुराधर्षं सुदुर्गमम्
verses.transliteration: caturdhāramanopamyaṃ catustoraṇasaṃyutam / prākārairdaśabhiryuktaṃ durādharṣaṃ sudurgamam
verses.translation: There, on the excellent mountain itself but to its east is situated the greatest city of Indra called Amaravati. It is endowed with all splendour and beauty.
verses.hindi: वह सभी प्राणियोंका आत्मा है, वह बाहर- भीतर सर्वत्र व्याप्त रहनेवाला परम तत्त्व है। में (भी) वही सर्वव्यापी, शान्त, ज्ञानात्मा परमेश्वर हूँ। मुझ अव्यक्त स्वरूपवालेके द्वारा ही इस विश्वका विस्तार हुआ है । सभी प्राणी मुझमें ही अवस्थित हैं, जो उसे जानता है, वह वेदज्ञ है प्रधान और पुरुष--ये ही दो तत्त्व कहे गये हैं। अनादि उत्कृष्ट कालको ही उन दोनोंका परम संयोजक कहा गया है
verses.wordMeaning: There, on the excellent mountain itself but to its east is situated the greatest city of Indra called Amaravati. It is endowed with all splendour and beauty.
verses.commentary: Sense: There, on the excellent mountain itself but to its east is situated the greatest city of Indra called Amaravati. It is endowed with all splendour and beauty.

verses.sanskrit: स्फाटिकैर्मण्डपैर्युक्तं देवराजगृहोपमम् । स्वर्णस्तम्भसहस्त्रैश्च सर्वतः समलङ्कृतम्
verses.transliteration: sphāṭikairmaṇḍapairyuktaṃ devarājagṛhopamam / svarṇastambhasahastraiśca sarvataḥ samalaṅkṛtam
verses.translation: The heavenly ladies, Siddhas, Gandharvas, and Caranas and gods in thousands, worship the deity of a thousand-eyed Indra there.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मवादीका पुत्र अनुशासित ही होगा, इसलिये पुत्रको ज्ञानका अधिकारी माना गया है।
verses.wordMeaning: The heavenly ladies, Siddhas, Gandharvas, and Caranas and gods in thousands, worship the deity of a thousand-eyed Indra there.
verses.commentary: Sense: The heavenly ladies, Siddhas, Gandharvas, and Caranas and gods in thousands, worship the deity of a thousand-eyed Indra there.

verses.sanskrit: हेमसोपानसंयुक्तं नानारत्नोपशोभितम् । दिव्यसिंहासनोपेतं सर्वशोभासमन्वितम्
verses.transliteration: hemasopānasaṃyuktaṃ nānāratnopaśobhitam / divyasiṃhāsanopetaṃ sarvaśobhāsamanvitam
verses.translation: That is the highest abode of those who are virtuous, the knowers of the Vedas and devoted to the performance of sacrifices and Homas. It is inaccessible even to Devas.
verses.hindi: अहँकारविमुक्तत्वात् प्रोच्यते पञ्चविंशकः आद्यो विकारः प्रकृतेर्महानात्मेति कथ्यते। विज्ञानशक्तिर्विज्ञाता ह्यहंकारस्तदुत्थितः
verses.wordMeaning: That is the highest abode of those who are virtuous, the knowers of the Vedas and devoted to the performance of sacrifices and Homas. It is inaccessible even to Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: That is the highest abode of those who are virtuous, the knowers of the Vedas and devoted to the performance of sacrifices and Homas. It is inaccessible even to Devas.

verses.sanskrit: सरोभिः स्वादुपानीयैर्नदीभिश्चोपशोभितम् । नारायणपरैः शुद्धैर्वेदाध्ययनतत्परैः
verses.transliteration: sarobhiḥ svādupānīyairnadībhiścopaśobhitam / nārāyaṇaparaiḥ śuddhairvedādhyayanatatparaiḥ
verses.translation: To the south of it is the city of the Fire-god of bound¬ less splendour. It is named Tejovati and it is full of divine miracles.
verses.hindi: एक एव महानात्मा सोऽहंकारोऽभिधीयते।
verses.wordMeaning: To the south of it is the city of the Fire-god of bound¬ less splendour. It is named Tejovati and it is full of divine miracles.
verses.commentary: Sense: To the south of it is the city of the Fire-god of bound¬ less splendour. It is named Tejovati and it is full of divine miracles.

verses.sanskrit: योगिभिश्च समाकीर्णं ध्यायद्भिः पुरुषं हरिम् । स्तुवद्भिः सततं मन्त्रैर्नमस्यद्भिश्च माधवम्
verses.transliteration: yogibhiśca samākīrṇaṃ dhyāyadbhiḥ puruṣaṃ harim / stuvadbhiḥ satataṃ mantrairnamasyadbhiśca mādhavam
verses.translation: There stays lord Agni the fire-god shining with his brilliance. It is the abode of the performers of Japas and Homas. It is difficult of access to the sons of Danu.
verses.hindi: स विज्ञानात्मकस्तस्य मनः स्यादुपकारकम् स चाविवेकः प्रकृतौ सङ्गात् कालेन सोऽभवत्
verses.wordMeaning: There stays lord Agni the fire-god shining with his brilliance. It is the abode of the performers of Japas and Homas. It is difficult of access to the sons of Danu.
verses.commentary: Sense: There stays lord Agni the fire-god shining with his brilliance. It is the abode of the performers of Japas and Homas. It is difficult of access to the sons of Danu.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र देवादिदेवस्य विष्णोरमिततेजसः । राजानः सर्वकालं तु महिमानं प्रकुर्वते
verses.transliteration: tatra devādidevasya viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ / rājānaḥ sarvakālaṃ tu mahimānaṃ prakurvate
verses.translation: The great city of Yama is on the southern mountain. It is named Sarhyamani. It is divine and endowed with all types of splendour.
verses.hindi: कालः सृजति भूतानि कालः संहरति प्रजाः । सर्वे कालस्य वशगा न कालः कस्यचिद् वशे
verses.wordMeaning: The great city of Yama is on the southern mountain. It is named Sarhyamani. It is divine and endowed with all types of splendour.
verses.commentary: Sense: The great city of Yama is on the southern mountain. It is named Sarhyamani. It is divine and endowed with all types of splendour.

verses.sanskrit: गायन्ति चैव नृत्यन्ति विलासिन्यो मनोरमाः । स्त्रियो यौवनशालिन्यः सदा मण्डनतत्पराः
verses.transliteration: gāyanti caiva nṛtyanti vilāsinyo manoramāḥ / striyo yauvanaśālinyaḥ sadā maṇḍanatatparāḥ
verses.translation: There Devas and others adore lord Vaivasvata (i.e. Yama). It is the abode of those who adhere to truth, and of those who perform meritorious deeds in the world.
verses.hindi: प्रोच्यते भगवान् प्राणः सर्वज्ञः पुरुषोत्तमः मनसश्चाप्यहंकारमहंकारान्महान् परः
verses.wordMeaning: There Devas and others adore lord Vaivasvata (i.e. Yama). It is the abode of those who adhere to truth, and of those who perform meritorious deeds in the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: There Devas and others adore lord Vaivasvata (i.e. Yama). It is the abode of those who adhere to truth, and of those who perform meritorious deeds in the world.

verses.sanskrit: इलावृते पद्मवर्णा जम्बूफलरसाशिनः । त्रयोदश सहस्त्राणि वर्षाणां वै स्थिरायुषः
verses.transliteration: ilāvṛte padmavarṇā jambūphalarasāśinaḥ / trayodaśa sahastrāṇi varṣāṇāṃ vai sthirāyuṣaḥ
verses.translation: To the west of that is the city of the noble-souled Nirrti. It is named Raksovati and it is encircled by Raksasas.
verses.hindi: पुरुषाद् भगवान् प्राणस्तस्य सर्वमिदं जगत्
verses.wordMeaning: To the west of that is the city of the noble-souled Nirrti. It is named Raksovati and it is encircled by Raksasas.
verses.commentary: Sense: To the west of that is the city of the noble-souled Nirrti. It is named Raksovati and it is encircled by Raksasas.

verses.sanskrit: भारते तु स्त्रियः पुंसो नानावर्णाः प्रकीर्तिताः । नानादेवार्चने युक्ता नानाकर्माणि कुर्वते । परमायुः स्मृतं तेषां शतं वर्षाणि सुव्रताः
verses.transliteration: bhārate tu striyaḥ puṃso nānāvarṇāḥ prakīrtitāḥ / nānādevārcane yuktā nānākarmāṇi kurvate / paramāyuḥ smṛtaṃ teṣāṃ śataṃ varṣāṇi suvratāḥ
verses.translation: There the Raksasas worship lord Nairrta. Those who are devoted to piety but whose activities are urged by Tamas go to that city.
verses.hindi: ति कूर्मपुराण ति (प्रधान, पुरुष और काल--) ये तीनों तत्त्व अनादि, अन्तरहित, अव्यक्त (परम तत्त्व)-में स्थित हैं। वह (परम तत्त्व) तदात्मक (प्रधान आदिका प्रेरक होते हुए भी) तद्भिन्न (उनसे सर्वथा असंस्पृष्ट) है, वह
verses.wordMeaning: There the Raksasas worship lord Nairrta. Those who are devoted to piety but whose activities are urged by Tamas go to that city.
verses.commentary: Sense: There the Raksasas worship lord Nairrta. Those who are devoted to piety but whose activities are urged by Tamas go to that city.

verses.sanskrit: नानाहाराश्च जीवन्ति पुण्यपापनिमित्ततः । नवयोजनसाहस्त्रं वर्षमेतत् प्रकीर्तितम् । कर्मभूमिरियं विप्रा नराणामधिकारिणाम्
verses.transliteration: nānāhārāśca jīvanti puṇyapāpanimittataḥ / navayojanasāhastraṃ varṣametat prakīrtitam / karmabhūmiriyaṃ viprā narāṇāmadhikāriṇām
verses.translation: On the western mountain is the great city of Varuna known by the name of Suddhavatl. It is meritorious and it is endowed with all desirable objects and affluence.
verses.hindi: (परम तत्त्व) मेरा ही रूप है, यह विद्वान् लोग ही जानते हैं। जो महत् (तत्त्व)-से लेकर विशेषपर्यन्त समस्त संसारको उत्पन्न करती है, वह सभी देहधारियोंको मोहित करनेवाली प्रकृति कही गयी है। जो प्रकृतिस्थ
verses.wordMeaning: On the western mountain is the great city of Varuna known by the name of Suddhavatl. It is meritorious and it is endowed with all desirable objects and affluence.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the western mountain is the great city of Varuna known by the name of Suddhavatl. It is meritorious and it is endowed with all desirable objects and affluence.

verses.sanskrit: महेन्द्रो मलयः सह्यः शुक्तिमानृक्षपर्वतः । विन्ध्यश्च पारियात्रश्च सप्तात्र कुलपर्वताः
verses.transliteration: mahendro malayaḥ sahyaḥ śuktimānṛkṣaparvataḥ / vindhyaśca pāriyātraśca saptātra kulaparvatāḥ
verses.translation: There stays king Varuna. The king is served by Siddhas, bevies of celestial damsels and the lords of immortal beings. Those who make gifts of water go there.
verses.hindi: होकर प्रकृतिके गुणोंका उपभोग करता है, वह पुरुष है। अहंकार (अहं-तत्त्व)-से विमुक्त होनेके कारण वह पुरुष पचीसवाँ तत्त्व कहा गया है प्रकृतिके प्रथम विकारको महान् आत्मा (महत्तत्त्व) कहते हैं। उस विज्ञानशक्तिसे सम्पन्न विज्ञाता (' अहम्' अर्थात् अभिमानका मूल कारण) अहंकार उत्पन्न होता है। वही एक महान्” आत्मा 'अहंकार' कहलाता है।
verses.wordMeaning: There stays king Varuna. The king is served by Siddhas, bevies of celestial damsels and the lords of immortal beings. Those who make gifts of water go there.
verses.commentary: Sense: There stays king Varuna. The king is served by Siddhas, bevies of celestial damsels and the lords of immortal beings. Those who make gifts of water go there.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रद्युम्नः कशेरुमांस्ताम्रवर्णो गभस्तिमान् । नागद्वीपस्तथा सौम्यो गन्धर्वस्त्वथ वारुणः
verses.transliteration: indradyumnaḥ kaśerumāṃstāmravarṇo gabhastimān / nāgadvīpastathā saumyo gandharvastvatha vāruṇaḥ
verses.translation: To the north of that city is the great and sacred city of Vayu known by the name Gandhavati. There stays the Wind-god.
verses.hindi: तत्त्वचिन्तकोंके द्वारा वह “जीव” तथा ' अन्तरात्मा' इस नामसे कहा गया है
verses.wordMeaning: To the north of that city is the great and sacred city of Vayu known by the name Gandhavati. There stays the Wind-god.
verses.commentary: Sense: To the north of that city is the great and sacred city of Vayu known by the name Gandhavati. There stays the Wind-god.

verses.sanskrit: अयं तु नवमस्तेषां द्वीपः सागरसंवृतः । योजनानां सहस्त्रं तु द्वीपो ऽयं दक्षिणोत्तरः
verses.transliteration: ayaṃ tu navamasteṣāṃ dvīpaḥ sāgarasaṃvṛtaḥ / yojanānāṃ sahastraṃ tu dvīpo 'yaṃ dakṣiṇottaraḥ
verses.translation: The great lord is served by the celestial ladies and Gandharvas. Brahmanas devoted to Pranayamas (restraint over breath) attain that eternal abode.
verses.hindi: जीवनमें उसीके द्वारा सुख एवं दुःख आदि सभीका अनुभव होता है। वह विज्ञानस्वरूप (विविध सांसारिक ज्ञानका मूल) है। उस (अहंकार)-का उपकारक मन है। उससे अविवेक उत्पन्न होता है और फिर उस अविवेकसे पुरुषका संसार बनता है । ' प्रकृति 'से कालका सम्पर्क होनेसे वह अविवेक उत्पन्न होता है। काल ही प्राणियोंकी सृष्टि करता है और काल ही प्रजाओंका संहार करता है। सभी कालके वशीभूत हैं, काल
verses.wordMeaning: The great lord is served by the celestial ladies and Gandharvas. Brahmanas devoted to Pranayamas (restraint over breath) attain that eternal abode.
verses.commentary: Sense: The great lord is served by the celestial ladies and Gandharvas. Brahmanas devoted to Pranayamas (restraint over breath) attain that eternal abode.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वे किरातास्तस्यान्ते पशिचमे यवनास्तथा । ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रिया वैश्य मध्ये शूद्रास्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: pūrve kirātāstasyānte paśicame yavanāstathā / brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśya madhye śūdrāstathaiva ca
verses.translation: To the east of that city is the great city of Soma. It is the splendid city known by the name Kantimati wherein shines the Moon-god.
verses.hindi: किसीके वशमें नहीं है
verses.wordMeaning: To the east of that city is the great city of Soma. It is the splendid city known by the name Kantimati wherein shines the Moon-god.
verses.commentary: Sense: To the east of that city is the great city of Soma. It is the splendid city known by the name Kantimati wherein shines the Moon-god.

verses.sanskrit: इज्यायुद्धवणिज्याभिर्वर्तयन्त्यत्र मानवाः । स्त्रवन्ते पावना नद्यः पर्वतेभ्यो विनिः सृताः
verses.transliteration: ijyāyuddhavaṇijyābhirvartayantyatra mānavāḥ / stravante pāvanā nadyaḥ parvatebhyo viniḥ sṛtāḥ
verses.translation: That abode which is abounding in various objects of pleasure is the proper place for those who are devoted to virtuous activities and who worshipfully take up their respective religious duties.
verses.hindi: वह सनातन (काल) अन्तःप्रविष्ट होकर इस सम्पूर्ण (विश्व)-का नियमन करता है। इस कालको भगवान्, प्राण, सर्वज्ञ तथा पुरुषोत्तम कहा जाता है। मनीषियोंने मनको सभी इन्द्रियोंसे उत्कृष्ट एवं मनसे अधिक उत्कृष्ट अहंकारको और अहंकारसे उत्कृष्ट महानूको (महत्तत्त्व) बतलाया है। महत्से उत्कृष्ट अव्यक्त, अव्यक्तसे उत्कृष्ट पुरुष तथा पुरुषसे उत्कृष्ट भगवान् प्राण हैं। यह सम्पूर्ण संसार उसीसे है। प्राणसे परतर व्योम है और व्योमसे
verses.wordMeaning: That abode which is abounding in various objects of pleasure is the proper place for those who are devoted to virtuous activities and who worshipfully take up their respective religious duties.
verses.commentary: Sense: That abode which is abounding in various objects of pleasure is the proper place for those who are devoted to virtuous activities and who worshipfully take up their respective religious duties.

verses.sanskrit: शतद्रुश्चन्द्रभागा च सरयूर्यमुना तथा । इरावती वितस्ता च विपाशा देविका कुहूः
verses.transliteration: śatadruścandrabhāgā ca sarayūryamunā tathā / irāvatī vitastā ca vipāśā devikā kuhūḥ
verses.translation: To the east of that city is the great city of Sankara. It is a meritorious city known as Yasovati. It is difficult of access to all.
verses.hindi: अतीत अग्नि ईश्वर है। में वही सर्वव्यापी, शान्त, ज्ञानस्वरूप परमेश्वर हुँ । मुझसे उत्कृष्ट और कोई तत्त्व नहीं है। मुझे जान लेनेसे मुक्ति हो जाती है॥ १७--२० ॥
verses.wordMeaning: To the east of that city is the great city of Sankara. It is a meritorious city known as Yasovati. It is difficult of access to all.
verses.commentary: Sense: To the east of that city is the great city of Sankara. It is a meritorious city known as Yasovati. It is difficult of access to all.

verses.sanskrit: गोमती धूतपापा च बाहुदा च दृषद्वती । कौशिकी लोहिता चैव हिमवत्पादनिः सृताः
verses.transliteration: gomatī dhūtapāpā ca bāhudā ca dṛṣadvatī / kauśikī lohitā caiva himavatpādaniḥ sṛtāḥ
verses.translation: The auspicious abode of Isana, the overlord of the Ganas, which is very large and presided over by Rudra is there. He stays there surrounded by the Ganas.
verses.hindi: सृष्टिमँ अहंकारका महत्त्वपूर्ण स्थान होनेसे उसके लिये “महान् आत्मा' यह लाक्षणिक प्रयोग है। इस संसारमें एकमात्र मुझ अव्यक्त, व्योमरूप
verses.wordMeaning: The auspicious abode of Isana, the overlord of the Ganas, which is very large and presided over by Rudra is there. He stays there surrounded by the Ganas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The auspicious abode of Isana, the overlord of the Ganas, which is very large and presided over by Rudra is there. He stays there surrounded by the Ganas.

verses.sanskrit: वेदस्मृतिर्वेदवती व्रतघ्नी त्रिदिवा तथा । पर्णाशा वन्दना चैव सदानीरा मनोरमा
verses.transliteration: vedasmṛtirvedavatī vrataghnī tridivā tathā / parṇāśā vandanā caiva sadānīrā manoramā
verses.translation: It was there that the residence of the devotees of Paramesthin who are desirous of enjoyment of pleasures has been assigned by the trident-bearing lord of Devas.
verses.hindi: ऋते मामेकमव्यक्तं व्योमरूपं महेश्वरम्॥ २१ ॥  महेश्वरको छोड़कर कोई भी स्थावर-जंगमात्मक तत्त्व
verses.wordMeaning: It was there that the residence of the devotees of Paramesthin who are desirous of enjoyment of pleasures has been assigned by the trident-bearing lord of Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: It was there that the residence of the devotees of Paramesthin who are desirous of enjoyment of pleasures has been assigned by the trident-bearing lord of Devas.

verses.sanskrit: चर्मण्वती तथा दूर्या विदिशा वेत्रवत्यपि । शिग्रुः स्वशिल्पापि तथा पारियात्राश्रयाः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: carmaṇvatī tathā dūryā vidiśā vetravatyapi / śigruḥ svaśilpāpi tathā pāriyātrāśrayāḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Flowing out from Visnu's feet and flooding the sphere of the Moon, Gahga falls all round the city of god Brahma.
verses.hindi: मायी मायामयो देवः कालेन सह सङ्गतः मत्संनिधावेष कालः करोति सकलं जगत्।
verses.wordMeaning: Flowing out from Visnu's feet and flooding the sphere of the Moon, Gahga falls all round the city of god Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Flowing out from Visnu's feet and flooding the sphere of the Moon, Gahga falls all round the city of god Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदा सुरसा शोण दशार्णा च महानदी । मन्दाकिनी चित्रकूटा तामसी च पिशाचिका
verses.transliteration: narmadā surasā śoṇa daśārṇā ca mahānadī / mandākinī citrakūṭā tāmasī ca piśācikā
verses.translation: O Brahmanas, after falling there it became divided into four branches in accordance with the four quarters. The branches are called: Sita, Alakananda, Sucaksu and Bhadra.
verses.hindi: नित्य नहीं है अर्थात् महेशवरको छोड़कर सब कुछ अनित्य है। वही मैं मायावी तथा मायामय देव कालके संसर्गसे सम्पूर्ण (संसार)-की सदा सृष्टि करता हूँ और (फिर) संहार करता हूँ। मेरे सांनिध्यमें ही यह
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas, after falling there it became divided into four branches in accordance with the four quarters. The branches are called: Sita, Alakananda, Sucaksu and Bhadra.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas, after falling there it became divided into four branches in accordance with the four quarters. The branches are called: Sita, Alakananda, Sucaksu and Bhadra.

verses.sanskrit: चित्रोत्पला विपाशा च मञ्जुला वालुवाहिनी । ऋक्षवत्पादजा नद्यः सर्वपापहरा नृणाम्
verses.transliteration: citrotpalā vipāśā ca mañjulā vāluvāhinī / ṛkṣavatpādajā nadyaḥ sarvapāpaharā nṛṇām
verses.translation: Sita flows through the aerial path from mountain to mountain along the east of Meru. Flowing through the eastern sub-continent across Bhadrasva, it falls into the sea.
verses.hindi: काल (तत्त्व) सम्पूर्ण जगतूकी (सृष्टि) करता है। वेदका यह कथन है कि अनन्तात्मा ही उस (काल)- नियोजयत्यनन्तात्मा ह्येतद् वेदानुशासनम्॥ २३॥  को (इस कार्यमें) नियोजित करता है
verses.wordMeaning: Sita flows through the aerial path from mountain to mountain along the east of Meru. Flowing through the eastern sub-continent across Bhadrasva, it falls into the sea.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sita flows through the aerial path from mountain to mountain along the east of Meru. Flowing through the eastern sub-continent across Bhadrasva, it falls into the sea.

verses.sanskrit: तापी पयोष्णी निर्विन्ध्या शीघ्रोदा च महानदी । वेण्या वैतरणी चैव बलाका च कुमुद्वती
verses.transliteration: tāpī payoṣṇī nirvindhyā śīghrodā ca mahānadī / veṇyā vaitaraṇī caiva balākā ca kumudvatī
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas! Similarly, Alakananda, entering the Bharata Varsa from the south of Meru splits itself into seven branches and falls into the ocean.
verses.hindi: शिव-भक्तिका माहात्म्य, शिवोपासनाकी सुगमता, ज्ञानरूप शिवस्वरूपका वर्णन, शिवकी तीन प्रकारको शक्तियोंका प्रतिपादन, शिवके परम तत्वका निरूपण
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahmanas! Similarly, Alakananda, entering the Bharata Varsa from the south of Meru splits itself into seven branches and falls into the ocean.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmanas! Similarly, Alakananda, entering the Bharata Varsa from the south of Meru splits itself into seven branches and falls into the ocean.

verses.sanskrit: तोया चैव महागैरी दुर्गा चान्तः शिला तथा । विन्ध्यपादप्रसूतास्ता नद्यः पुण्यजलाः शुभाः
verses.transliteration: toyā caiva mahāgairī durgā cāntaḥ śilā tathā / vindhyapādaprasūtāstā nadyaḥ puṇyajalāḥ śubhāḥ
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas! Similarly, Alakananda, entering the Bharata Varsa from the south of Meru splits itself into seven branches and falls into the ocean.
verses.hindi: वक्ष्ये समाहिता यूयं शृणुध्वं ब्रह्मवादिनः । माहात्म्यं देवदेवस्य येनेदं सम्प्रवर्तते मां सर्वसाक्षिणं लोको न जानाति मुनीश्वराः
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahmanas! Similarly, Alakananda, entering the Bharata Varsa from the south of Meru splits itself into seven branches and falls into the ocean.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmanas! Similarly, Alakananda, entering the Bharata Varsa from the south of Meru splits itself into seven branches and falls into the ocean.

verses.sanskrit: सोदावरी भीमरथी कृष्णा वर्णा च मत्सरी । तुङ्गभ्द्रा सुप्रयोगा कावेरी च द्विजोत्तमाः । दक्षिणापथगा नद्यः सह्यपादविनिः सृताः
verses.transliteration: sodāvarī bhīmarathī kṛṣṇā varṇā ca matsarī / tuṅgabhdrā suprayogā kāverī ca dvijottamāḥ / dakṣiṇāpathagā nadyaḥ sahyapādaviniḥ sṛtāḥ
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas! Similarly, Alakananda, entering the Bharata Varsa from the south of Meru splits itself into seven branches and falls into the ocean.
verses.hindi: सोऽहं धाता विधाता च कालोऽग्निर्विश्वतोमुखः
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahmanas! Similarly, Alakananda, entering the Bharata Varsa from the south of Meru splits itself into seven branches and falls into the ocean.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmanas! Similarly, Alakananda, entering the Bharata Varsa from the south of Meru splits itself into seven branches and falls into the ocean.

verses.sanskrit: ऋतुमाला ताम्रपर्णो पुष्पवत्युत्पलावती । मलयान्निः सृता नद्यः सर्वाः शीतजलाः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: ṛtumālā tāmraparṇo puṣpavatyutpalāvatī / malayānniḥ sṛtā nadyaḥ sarvāḥ śītajalāḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas! Similarly, Alakananda, entering the Bharata Varsa from the south of Meru splits itself into seven branches and falls into the ocean.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मा च मनवः शक्रो ये चान्ये प्रथितौजसः सर्वे लोका नमस्यन्ति ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः । ध्यायन्ति योगिनो देवं भूताधिपतिमीश्वरम्
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahmanas! Similarly, Alakananda, entering the Bharata Varsa from the south of Meru splits itself into seven branches and falls into the ocean.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmanas! Similarly, Alakananda, entering the Bharata Varsa from the south of Meru splits itself into seven branches and falls into the ocean.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषिकुल्या त्रिसामा च मन्दगा मन्दगामिनी । रूपा पालासिनी चैव ऋषिका वंशकारिणी । शुक्तिमत्पादसंजाताः सर्वपापहरा नृणाम्
verses.transliteration: ṛṣikulyā trisāmā ca mandagā mandagāminī / rūpā pālāsinī caiva ṛṣikā vaṃśakāriṇī / śuktimatpādasaṃjātāḥ sarvapāpaharā nṛṇām
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas! Similarly, Alakananda, entering the Bharata Varsa from the south of Meru splits itself into seven branches and falls into the ocean.
verses.hindi: अहं हि सर्वहविषां भोक्ता चैव फलप्रदः । सर्वदेवतनुर्भूत्वा सर्वात्मा सर्वसंस्थितः
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahmanas! Similarly, Alakananda, entering the Bharata Varsa from the south of Meru splits itself into seven branches and falls into the ocean.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmanas! Similarly, Alakananda, entering the Bharata Varsa from the south of Meru splits itself into seven branches and falls into the ocean.

verses.sanskrit: आसां नद्युपनद्यश्च शतशो द्विजपुङ्गवाः । सर्वपापहराः पुण्याः स्नानदानादिकर्मसु
verses.transliteration: āsāṃ nadyupanadyaśca śataśo dvijapuṅgavāḥ / sarvapāpaharāḥ puṇyāḥ snānadānādikarmasu
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas! Similarly, Alakananda, entering the Bharata Varsa from the south of Meru splits itself into seven branches and falls into the ocean.
verses.hindi: ईश्वर बोले--हे ब्रह्मवादियो! आपलोग ध्यान लगाकर सुनें। जिससे यह सभी प्रवर्तित होता है, उस देवाधिदेवके माहात्म्यको मैं बताता हूँ में न तो विविध प्रकारके तपसे, न दानसे और न यज्ञोंसे ही जानने योग्य हूँ। बिना उत्तम भक्तिके मनुष्य मुझे जान नहीं सकता। सर्वत्र व्याप्त रहनेवाला मैं सभी भावोंके अन्तःमें प्रविष्ट रहता हूँ। परंतु मुनीश्वरो ! मुझ
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahmanas! Similarly, Alakananda, entering the Bharata Varsa from the south of Meru splits itself into seven branches and falls into the ocean.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmanas! Similarly, Alakananda, entering the Bharata Varsa from the south of Meru splits itself into seven branches and falls into the ocean.

verses.sanskrit: तास्विमे कुरुपाञ्चाला मध्यदेशादयो जनाः । पूर्वदेशादिकाश्चैव कामरूपनिवासिनः
verses.transliteration: tāsvime kurupāñcālā madhyadeśādayo janāḥ / pūrvadeśādikāścaiva kāmarūpanivāsinaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas! Similarly, Alakananda, entering the Bharata Varsa from the south of Meru splits itself into seven branches and falls into the ocean.
verses.hindi: सर्वसाक्षीको संसार जान नहीं पाता। जिसके भीतर यह सब प्रतिष्ठित है और जो परम तत्त्व सभीके अन्त:में स्थित है, मैं वही धाता, विधाता, काल, अग्नि तथा सभी ओर मुखवाला हूँ। सभी मुनि, देवता, ब्रह्मा, मनु, इन्द्र और जो
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahmanas! Similarly, Alakananda, entering the Bharata Varsa from the south of Meru splits itself into seven branches and falls into the ocean.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmanas! Similarly, Alakananda, entering the Bharata Varsa from the south of Meru splits itself into seven branches and falls into the ocean.

verses.sanskrit: पुण्ड्राः कलिङ्गामगधा दाक्षिणात्याश्चकृत्स्नशः । तथापरान्ताः सौराष्ट्राः शूद्राभीरास्तथार्ऽबुदाः
verses.transliteration: puṇḍrāḥ kaliṅgāmagadhā dākṣiṇātyāścakṛtsnaśaḥ / tathāparāntāḥ saurāṣṭrāḥ śūdrābhīrāstathār'budāḥ
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas! Similarly, Alakananda, entering the Bharata Varsa from the south of Meru splits itself into seven branches and falls into the ocean.
verses.hindi: अत्यन्त तेजस्वी हैं, वे भी मुझे नहीं देख पाते॥ २--५॥ वेद मुझ अद्वितीय परमेश्वरको निरन्तर स्तुति किया करते हैं। ब्राह्मण अनेक प्रकारके वैदिक यज्ञोंके द्वारा अग्निस्वरूप मेरा यजन करते हैं। सभी लोक तथा लोकपितामह ब्रह्मा मुझे नमस्कार करते हैं। योगी जन
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahmanas! Similarly, Alakananda, entering the Bharata Varsa from the south of Meru splits itself into seven branches and falls into the ocean.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmanas! Similarly, Alakananda, entering the Bharata Varsa from the south of Meru splits itself into seven branches and falls into the ocean.

verses.sanskrit: मालका मालवाश्चैव पारियात्रनिवासिनः । सौवीराः सैन्धवा हूणा शाल्वाः कल्पनिवासिनः
verses.transliteration: mālakā mālavāścaiva pāriyātranivāsinaḥ / sauvīrāḥ saindhavā hūṇā śālvāḥ kalpanivāsinaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas! Similarly, Alakananda, entering the Bharata Varsa from the south of Meru splits itself into seven branches and falls into the ocean.
verses.hindi: सभी प्राणियोंके अधिपति (मुझ) ईश्वर देवका ध्यान करते हैं। सबकी आत्मा और सर्वव्यापी मैं ही सभी देवोंके शरीरोंको धारण कर सम्पूर्ण हवियोंका भोक्ता एवं सभी फलोंका प्रदाता हूँ॥ ६--८॥
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahmanas! Similarly, Alakananda, entering the Bharata Varsa from the south of Meru splits itself into seven branches and falls into the ocean.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmanas! Similarly, Alakananda, entering the Bharata Varsa from the south of Meru splits itself into seven branches and falls into the ocean.

verses.sanskrit: मद्रा रामास्तथाम्बष्ठाः पारसीकास्तथैव च । आसां पिबन्ति सलिलं वसन्ति सरितां सदा
verses.transliteration: madrā rāmāstathāmbaṣṭhāḥ pārasīkāstathaiva ca / āsāṃ pibanti salilaṃ vasanti saritāṃ sadā
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas! Similarly, Alakananda, entering the Bharata Varsa from the south of Meru splits itself into seven branches and falls into the ocean.
verses.hindi: मां पश्यन्तीह विद्वांसो धार्मिका वेदवादिनः । तेषां संनिहितो नित्यं ये भक्त्या मामुपासते ब्राह्मणा: क्षत्रिया वैश्या धार्मिका मामुपासते। तेषां ददामि तत् स्थानमानन्दं परमं पदम्
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahmanas! Similarly, Alakananda, entering the Bharata Varsa from the south of Meru splits itself into seven branches and falls into the ocean.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmanas! Similarly, Alakananda, entering the Bharata Varsa from the south of Meru splits itself into seven branches and falls into the ocean.

verses.sanskrit: चत्वारि भारते वर्षे युगानि कवयो ऽब्रुवन् । कृतं त्रेता द्वापरं च कलिश्चान्यत्र न क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: catvāri bhārate varṣe yugāni kavayo 'bruvan / kṛtaṃ tretā dvāparaṃ ca kaliścānyatra na kvacit
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas! Similarly, Alakananda, entering the Bharata Varsa from the south of Meru splits itself into seven branches and falls into the ocean.
verses.hindi: अन्येऽपि ये विकर्मस्थाः शूद्राद्या नीचजातयः । भक्तिमन्तः प्रमुच्यन्ते कालेन मयि संगताः
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahmanas! Similarly, Alakananda, entering the Bharata Varsa from the south of Meru splits itself into seven branches and falls into the ocean.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmanas! Similarly, Alakananda, entering the Bharata Varsa from the south of Meru splits itself into seven branches and falls into the ocean.

verses.sanskrit: यानि किंपुरुषाद्यानि वर्षाण्यष्टौ महर्षयः । न तेषु शोको नायासो नोद्वेगः क्षुद्भयं न च
verses.transliteration: yāni kiṃpuruṣādyāni varṣāṇyaṣṭau maharṣayaḥ / na teṣu śoko nāyāso nodvegaḥ kṣudbhayaṃ na ca
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas! Similarly, Alakananda, entering the Bharata Varsa from the south of Meru splits itself into seven branches and falls into the ocean.
verses.hindi: यो वै निन्दति तं मूढो देवदेवं स निन्दति। यो हि तं पूजयेद् भक्त्या स पूजयति मां सदा पत्रं पुष्पं फलं तोयं मदाराधनकारणात्।
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahmanas! Similarly, Alakananda, entering the Bharata Varsa from the south of Meru splits itself into seven branches and falls into the ocean.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmanas! Similarly, Alakananda, entering the Bharata Varsa from the south of Meru splits itself into seven branches and falls into the ocean.

verses.sanskrit: स्वस्थाः प्रजा निरातङ्काः सर्वदुः खविवर्जिताः । रमन्ति विविधैर्भावैः सर्वाश्च स्थिरयौवनाः
verses.transliteration: svasthāḥ prajā nirātaṅkāḥ sarvaduḥ khavivarjitāḥ / ramanti vividhairbhāvaiḥ sarvāśca sthirayauvanāḥ
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas! Similarly, Alakananda, entering the Bharata Varsa from the south of Meru splits itself into seven branches and falls into the ocean.
verses.hindi: अहं हि जगतामादौ ब्रह्माणं परमेष्ठिनम्। विधाय दत्तवान् वेदानशेषानात्मनिःसृतान्
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahmanas! Similarly, Alakananda, entering the Bharata Varsa from the south of Meru splits itself into seven branches and falls into the ocean.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmanas! Similarly, Alakananda, entering the Bharata Varsa from the south of Meru splits itself into seven branches and falls into the ocean.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे पञ्चचत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः सूत उवाच हेमकूटगिरेः शृङ्गे महाकूटैः सुशोभनम् । स्फाटिकं देवदेवस्य विमानं परमेष्ठिनः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge pañcacatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca hemakūṭagireḥ śṛṅge mahākūṭaiḥ suśobhanam / sphāṭikaṃ devadevasya vimānaṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ
verses.translation: The Sucaksu crosses the western mountains, enters the western Varsa called Ketumala and flows into the ocean.
verses.hindi: धार्मिकाणां च गोप्ताहं निहन्ता वेदविद्विषाम् अहं वै सर्वसंसारान्मोचको योगिनामिह। संसारहेतुरेवाहं सर्वसंसारवर्जितः
verses.wordMeaning: The Sucaksu crosses the western mountains, enters the western Varsa called Ketumala and flows into the ocean.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Sucaksu crosses the western mountains, enters the western Varsa called Ketumala and flows into the ocean.

verses.sanskrit: अथ देवादिदेवस्य भूतेशस्य त्रिशूलिनः । देवाः सिद्धगणा यक्षाः पूजां नित्यं प्रकुर्वते
verses.transliteration: atha devādidevasya bhūteśasya triśūlinaḥ / devāḥ siddhagaṇā yakṣāḥ pūjāṃ nityaṃ prakurvate
verses.translation: O great sages, the Bhadra traverses through the chain of northern mountains and the northern Kurus and falls into the northern ocean.
verses.hindi: मायावी मामिका शक्तिर्माया लोकविमोहिनी
verses.wordMeaning: O great sages, the Bhadra traverses through the chain of northern mountains and the northern Kurus and falls into the northern ocean.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sages, the Bhadra traverses through the chain of northern mountains and the northern Kurus and falls into the northern ocean.

verses.sanskrit: स देवो गिरिशः सार्धं महादेव्या महेश्वरः । भूतैः परिवृतो नित्यं भाति तत्र पिनाकधृक्
verses.transliteration: sa devo giriśaḥ sārdhaṃ mahādevyā maheśvaraḥ / bhūtaiḥ parivṛto nityaṃ bhāti tatra pinākadhṛk
verses.translation: The mountain Malyavan and Gandhamadana extend upto Nila and Nisadha. In the middle of the two chains of mountains Mt. Meru stands like the pericarp of a lotus.
verses.hindi: एका सर्वान्तरा शक्तिः करोति विविधं जगत्। आस्थाय ब्रह्मणो रूपं मन्मयी मदधिष्ठिता भूत्वा नारायणोऽनन्तो जगन्नाथो जगन्मयः
verses.wordMeaning: The mountain Malyavan and Gandhamadana extend upto Nila and Nisadha. In the middle of the two chains of mountains Mt. Meru stands like the pericarp of a lotus.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mountain Malyavan and Gandhamadana extend upto Nila and Nisadha. In the middle of the two chains of mountains Mt. Meru stands like the pericarp of a lotus.

verses.sanskrit: विभक्तचारुशिखरः कैलासो यत्र पर्वतः । निवासः कोटियक्षाणां कुबेरस्य च धीमतः । तत्रापि देवदेवस्य भवस्यायतनं महत्
verses.transliteration: vibhaktacāruśikharaḥ kailāso yatra parvataḥ / nivāsaḥ koṭiyakṣāṇāṃ kuberasya ca dhīmataḥ / tatrāpi devadevasya bhavasyāyatanaṃ mahat
verses.translation: The sub-continents Bharata, Ketumala, Bhadrasva and the Kurus are the petals of the lotus of the universe outside the Border-mountains.
verses.hindi: धार्मिक वेदनिष्ठ विद्वान् मेरा दर्शन करते हें । जो भक्तिपूर्वक मेरी उपासना करते हैं, मैं नित्य उनके समीपमें रहता हूँ । धार्मिक ब्राह्मण, क्षत्रिय तथा वैश्य मेरी उपासना करते हें । मैं उन्हें आनन्दस्वरूप परमपद
verses.wordMeaning: The sub-continents Bharata, Ketumala, Bhadrasva and the Kurus are the petals of the lotus of the universe outside the Border-mountains.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sub-continents Bharata, Ketumala, Bhadrasva and the Kurus are the petals of the lotus of the universe outside the Border-mountains.

verses.sanskrit: मन्दाकिनी तत्र दिव्या रम्या सुविमलोदका । नदी नानाविधैः पद्मैरनेकैः समलङ्कृता
verses.transliteration: mandākinī tatra divyā ramyā suvimalodakā / nadī nānāvidhaiḥ padmairanekaiḥ samalaṅkṛtā
verses.translation: Jathara and Devakuta are the two boundary moun¬ tains extending from the south to the north as far as Nila and Nisadha mountains.
verses.hindi: नामक स्थान प्रदान करता हूँ अन्य भी जो विपरीत कर्म करनेके कारण शूद्र आदि निम्न जातियोंमें हैं, भक्तिपरायण होनेपर वे भी मुक्त हो जाते हैं और यथासमय मुझमें लीन हो जाते हैं । मेरे भक्त विनाशको प्राप्त नहीं होते, मेरे भक्त पापोंसे
verses.wordMeaning: Jathara and Devakuta are the two boundary moun¬ tains extending from the south to the north as far as Nila and Nisadha mountains.
verses.commentary: Sense: Jathara and Devakuta are the two boundary moun¬ tains extending from the south to the north as far as Nila and Nisadha mountains.

verses.sanskrit: देवदानवगन्धर्वयक्षराक्षसकिंनरैः । उपस्पृष्टजला नित्यं सुपुण्या सुमनोरमा
verses.transliteration: devadānavagandharvayakṣarākṣasakiṃnaraiḥ / upaspṛṣṭajalā nityaṃ supuṇyā sumanoramā
verses.translation: Gandhamadana and Kailasa extend from east to west. They go deep within the ocean to the extent of eighty Yojanas.
verses.hindi: रहित हो जाते हैं। मैंने प्रारम्भमें ही यह प्रतिज्ञा कर रखी है कि मेरे भक्तका विनाश नहीं होता। जो उस (भक्त)-को निन्दा करता है, वह मूढ देवाधिदेव (शंकर)- की ही निन्दा करता है और जो उस (भक्त)-को
verses.wordMeaning: Gandhamadana and Kailasa extend from east to west. They go deep within the ocean to the extent of eighty Yojanas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gandhamadana and Kailasa extend from east to west. They go deep within the ocean to the extent of eighty Yojanas.

verses.sanskrit: अन्याश्च नद्यः शतशः स्वर्णपद्मैरलङ्कृताः । तासां कूलेषु देवस्य स्थानानि परमेष्ठिनः । देवर्षिगणजुष्टानि तथा नारायणस्य च
verses.transliteration: anyāśca nadyaḥ śataśaḥ svarṇapadmairalaṅkṛtāḥ / tāsāṃ kūleṣu devasya sthānāni parameṣṭhinaḥ / devarṣigaṇajuṣṭāni tathā nārāyaṇasya ca
verses.translation: Nisadha and Pariyatra are the two border-mountains situated as before to the west of Meru.
verses.hindi: भक्तिपूर्वक पूजा करता है, (समझो कि) वह सदा मेरी ही पूजा करता है। मेरी आराधनाके लिये जो नियमपूर्वक पत्र, पुष्प, फल तथा जल मुझे प्रदान करता हैं, वह मेरा प्रिय भक्त है, ऐसा समझना चाहिए मैंने ही संसारको सृष्टिके प्रारम्भमें परमेष्ठी ब्रह्माको सृष्टिकर अपनेसे प्रादुर्भूत सम्पूर्ण वेदोंको उन्हें प्रदान किया। मैं ही सभी योगियोंका अव्यय गुरु, धार्मिक जनोंका रक्षक तथा वेदसे द्वेष रखनेवालोंको विनष्ट
verses.wordMeaning: Nisadha and Pariyatra are the two border-mountains situated as before to the west of Meru.
verses.commentary: Sense: Nisadha and Pariyatra are the two border-mountains situated as before to the west of Meru.

verses.sanskrit: सितान्तशिखरे चापि पारिजातवनं शुभम् । तत्र शक्रस्य विपुलं भवनं रत्नमण्डितम् । स्फाटिकस्तम्भसंयुक्तं हेमगोपुरसंयुतम्
verses.transliteration: sitāntaśikhare cāpi pārijātavanaṃ śubham / tatra śakrasya vipulaṃ bhavanaṃ ratnamaṇḍitam / sphāṭikastambhasaṃyuktaṃ hemagopurasaṃyutam
verses.translation: Trisrhga and Jarudhi are the Varsa mountains in the north. They run east and west between the two oceans.
verses.hindi: में ही योगियोंको समस्त संसारसे मुक्त करनेवाला हूँ। मैं ही संसारका कारण और सम्पूर्ण संसारसे विवर्जित (असंसृष्ट) हूँ। मैं ही संहार करनेवाला और मैं ही सृष्टि तथा पालन करनेवाला मायावी हूँ। मेरी शक्ति माया है,
verses.wordMeaning: Trisrhga and Jarudhi are the Varsa mountains in the north. They run east and west between the two oceans.
verses.commentary: Sense: Trisrhga and Jarudhi are the Varsa mountains in the north. They run east and west between the two oceans.

verses.sanskrit: तत्राथ देवदेवस्य विष्णोर्विश्वामरेशितुः । सुपुण्यं भवनं रम्यं सर्वरत्नोपशोभितम्
verses.transliteration: tatrātha devadevasya viṣṇorviśvāmareśituḥ / supuṇyaṃ bhavanaṃ ramyaṃ sarvaratnopaśobhitam
verses.translation: O Brahmanas! O great sages! The eight border- mountains have been described by me. Jathara and other mountains are stationed all round the Meru.
verses.hindi: वह संसारको मोहित करनेवाली है मेरी ही जो पराशक्ति है, वह 'विद्या' इस नामसे कही जाती है। योगियोंके हृदयमें रहते हुए मैं उस मायाको नष्ट कर देता हूँ। सभी शक्तियोंका प्रवर्तन करनेवाला तथा निवर्तन करनेवाला मैं ही हूँ। मैं सभीका
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas! O great sages! The eight border- mountains have been described by me. Jathara and other mountains are stationed all round the Meru.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas! O great sages! The eight border- mountains have been described by me. Jathara and other mountains are stationed all round the Meru.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र नारायणः श्रीमान् लक्ष्म्या सह जगत्पतिः । आस्ते सर्वामरश्रेष्ठः पूज्यमानः सनातनः
verses.transliteration: tatra nārāyaṇaḥ śrīmān lakṣmyā saha jagatpatiḥ / āste sarvāmaraśreṣṭhaḥ pūjyamānaḥ sanātanaḥ
verses.translation: Rtumala or Krtamala (Vaigai which rises in Kottai-Malai Peak of Cardamom Hills?)
verses.hindi: आधार और अमृतका आश्रय-स्थान हुँ । मुझमें अधिष्ठित और मेरी स्वरूपभूता जो सबके अन्तरमें स्थित अद्वितीय शक्ति है, वह ब्रह्माका रूप धारणकर विविध प्रकारके संसारकी सृष्टि करती है और जो मेरी दूसरी
verses.wordMeaning: Rtumala or Krtamala (Vaigai which rises in Kottai-Malai Peak of Cardamom Hills?)
verses.commentary: Sense: Rtumala or Krtamala (Vaigai which rises in Kottai-Malai Peak of Cardamom Hills?)

verses.sanskrit: तथा च वसुधारे तु वसूनां रत्नमण्डितम् । स्थानानामष्टकं पुण्यं दुराधर्षं सुरद्विषाम्
verses.transliteration: tathā ca vasudhāre tu vasūnāṃ ratnamaṇḍitam / sthānānāmaṣṭakaṃ puṇyaṃ durādharṣaṃ suradviṣām
verses.translation: M. Ali attributes the sources of the river to the Mahendra Parvata and not to Gandha-madana. But one wonders why other rivers of ( Op. Cit., ) the Mahendra Parvata are not given when Vayu and Mt.P. mention them.
verses.hindi: विपुल शक्ति है, वह अनन्त, जगन्नाथ, जगन्मय और नारायणका रूप धारणकर संसारको स्थापना (पालन आदि कार्य) करती है तामसी मे समाख्याता कालाख्या रुद्ररूपिणी
verses.wordMeaning: M. Ali attributes the sources of the river to the Mahendra Parvata and not to Gandha-madana. But one wonders why other rivers of ( Op. Cit., ) the Mahendra Parvata are not given when Vayu and Mt.P. mention them.
verses.commentary: Sense: M. Ali attributes the sources of the river to the Mahendra Parvata and not to Gandha-madana. But one wonders why other rivers of ( Op. Cit., ) the Mahendra Parvata are not given when Vayu and Mt.P. mention them.

verses.sanskrit: रत्नधारे गिरिवरे सप्तर्षोणां महात्मनाम् । सप्ताश्रमाणि पुण्यानि सिद्धावासयुतानि तु
verses.transliteration: ratnadhāre girivare saptarṣoṇāṃ mahātmanām / saptāśramāṇi puṇyāni siddhāvāsayutāni tu
verses.translation: The rivers from mt. Sa (Su-) ktiman: Palasini (Jonk—Raipur Dist., M. P.),Rsika (Rsikulya, according to M. Ali — Op, Cit., ).
verses.hindi: ध्यानेन मां प्रपश्यन्ति केचिज्ज्ञानेन चापरे। अपरे भक्तियोगेन कर्मयोगेन चापरे
verses.wordMeaning: The rivers from mt. Sa (Su-) ktiman: Palasini (Jonk—Raipur Dist., M. P.),Rsika (Rsikulya, according to M. Ali — Op, Cit., ).
verses.commentary: Sense: The rivers from mt. Sa (Su-) ktiman: Palasini (Jonk—Raipur Dist., M. P.),Rsika (Rsikulya, according to M. Ali — Op, Cit., ).

verses.sanskrit: तत्र हैमं चतुर्द्वारं वज्रनीलादिमण्डितम् । सुपुण्यं सुमहत् स्थानं ब्रह्मणो ऽव्यक्तजन्मनः
verses.transliteration: tatra haimaṃ caturdvāraṃ vajranīlādimaṇḍitam / supuṇyaṃ sumahat sthānaṃ brahmaṇo 'vyaktajanmanaḥ
verses.translation: The list of peoples and their provinces in Bharata is illustrative and not exhaustive. Cf. Mt. 34 ff.
verses.hindi: अन्ये च ये त्रयो भक्ता मदाराधनकाङ्क्षिणः । तेऽपि मां प्राप्नुवन्त्येव नावर्तन्ते च वै पुनः करोति कालो भगवान् महायोगेश्वरः स्वयम्
verses.wordMeaning: The list of peoples and their provinces in Bharata is illustrative and not exhaustive. Cf. Mt. 34 ff.
verses.commentary: Sense: The list of peoples and their provinces in Bharata is illustrative and not exhaustive. Cf. Mt. 34 ff.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र देवर्षयो विप्राः सिद्धा ब्रह्मर्षयो ऽपरे । उपासते सदा देवं पितामहमजं परम्
verses.transliteration: tatra devarṣayo viprāḥ siddhā brahmarṣayo 'pare / upāsate sadā devaṃ pitāmahamajaṃ param
verses.translation: Nepal (De., ).
verses.hindi: योगेश्वरोऽसौ भगवान् महादेवो महान् प्रभुः
verses.wordMeaning: Nepal (De., ).
verses.commentary: Sense: Nepal (De., ).

verses.sanskrit: स तैः संपूजितो नित्यं देव्या सह चतुर्मुखः । आस्ते हिताय लोकानां शान्तानां परमा गतिः
verses.transliteration: sa taiḥ saṃpūjito nityaṃ devyā saha caturmukhaḥ / āste hitāya lokānāṃ śāntānāṃ paramā gatiḥ
verses.translation: People in the Kuruvarsa,* live for fourteen thousand and five hundred years. Their bodies are dark in colour and they regularly take in milk as their diet.
verses.hindi: प्रोच्यते भगवान् ब्रह्मा महान् ब्रह्ममयोऽमलः सोऽहं प्रेरयिता देवः परमानन्दमाश्रितः। नृत्यामि योगी सततं यस्तद् वेद स वेदवित्
verses.wordMeaning: People in the Kuruvarsa,* live for fourteen thousand and five hundred years. Their bodies are dark in colour and they regularly take in milk as their diet.
verses.commentary: Sense: People in the Kuruvarsa,* live for fourteen thousand and five hundred years. Their bodies are dark in colour and they regularly take in milk as their diet.

verses.sanskrit: अथैकशृङ्गशिखरे महापद्मैरलङ्कृतम् । स्वच्छामृतजलं पुण्यं सुगन्धं सुमहत् सरः
verses.transliteration: athaikaśṛṅgaśikhare mahāpadmairalaṅkṛtam / svacchāmṛtajalaṃ puṇyaṃ sugandhaṃ sumahat saraḥ
verses.translation: In the continent Candradvipa, people are born of legal cohabitation. They are perpetually happy. They always worship Siva, the great lord.
verses.hindi: प्रसन्नचेतसे देयं धार्मिकायाहिताग्रये
verses.wordMeaning: In the continent Candradvipa, people are born of legal cohabitation. They are perpetually happy. They always worship Siva, the great lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the continent Candradvipa, people are born of legal cohabitation. They are perpetually happy. They always worship Siva, the great lord.

verses.sanskrit: जैगीषव्याश्रमं तत्र योगीन्द्रैरुपशोभितम् । तत्रासौ भगवान् नित्यमास्ते शिष्यैः समावृतः । प्रशान्तदोषैरक्षुद्रैर्ब्रह्मविद्भिर्महात्मभिः
verses.transliteration: jaigīṣavyāśramaṃ tatra yogīndrairupaśobhitam / tatrāsau bhagavān nityamāste śiṣyaiḥ samāvṛtaḥ / praśāntadoṣairakṣudrairbrahmavidbhirmahātmabhiḥ
verses.translation: O Brahmanas, men in the Kimpurusa® continent resemble gold in complex. With Plaksa (fruits) for their food, they live for ten thousand years.
verses.hindi: मेरी तीसरी जो रुद्ररूपिणी काल नामक महती तामसी शक्ति है, वह समस्त जगतका संहार करती है भक्तियोगके द्वारा और कुछ कर्मयोगके द्वारा मेरा दर्शन करते हैं। जो किसी अन्य प्रकारसे नहीं, अपितु केवल ज्ञानद्वारा नित्य मेरी आराधना करता है, वह सभी भक्तोंमें मुझे प्रिय है, प्रियतर है अर्थात् अत्यन्त प्रिय है।
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas, men in the Kimpurusa® continent resemble gold in complex. With Plaksa (fruits) for their food, they live for ten thousand years.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas, men in the Kimpurusa® continent resemble gold in complex. With Plaksa (fruits) for their food, they live for ten thousand years.

verses.sanskrit: शङ्खो मनोहरश्चैव कौशिकः कृष्ण एव च । सुमना वेदनादश्च शिष्यास्तस्य प्रधानतः
verses.transliteration: śaṅkho manoharaścaiva kauśikaḥ kṛṣṇa eva ca / sumanā vedanādaśca śiṣyāstasya pradhānataḥ
verses.translation: Endowed with reverential devotion and with their mind concentrated on meditation, they always worship the four¬ armed lord with four heads.
verses.hindi: अन्य भी जो मेरी आराधना करनेके अभिलाषी तीन (प्रकारके) भक्त हैं, वे भी मुझे ही प्राप्त करते हैं और उनका पुनर्जन्म नहीं होता। मेरे द्वारा ही यह सम्पूर्ण प्रधान और पुरुषरूप संसार व्याप्त है। यह विश्व मुझमें
verses.wordMeaning: Endowed with reverential devotion and with their mind concentrated on meditation, they always worship the four¬ armed lord with four heads.
verses.commentary: Sense: Endowed with reverential devotion and with their mind concentrated on meditation, they always worship the four¬ armed lord with four heads.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे योगरताः शान्ता भस्मोद्धूलितविग्रहाः । उपासते महावीर्या ब्रह्मविद्यापरायणाः
verses.transliteration: sarve yogaratāḥ śāntā bhasmoddhūlitavigrahāḥ / upāsate mahāvīryā brahmavidyāparāyaṇāḥ
verses.translation: In the continent Harivarsa,' the people resemble Maharajata (i.e. gold). Imbibing sugarcane juice, they live for ten thousand years.
verses.hindi: ही स्थित है और मेरे द्वारा ही संसार प्रेरित किया जाता है हे विप्रो! परम योगमें ही सदा निरत रहनेवाला मैं प्रेरक नहीं हूँ, तथापि सम्पूर्ण जगत्को मैं प्रेरित करता हूँ, इस (रहस्य)-को जो जानता है, वह अमर हो जाता है। अपने स्वभाववश प्रवर्तमान समस्त
verses.wordMeaning: In the continent Harivarsa,' the people resemble Maharajata (i.e. gold). Imbibing sugarcane juice, they live for ten thousand years.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the continent Harivarsa,' the people resemble Maharajata (i.e. gold). Imbibing sugarcane juice, they live for ten thousand years.

verses.sanskrit: तेषामनुग्रिहार्थाय यतीनां शान्तचेतसाम् । सान्निध्यं कुरुते भूयो देव्या सह महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: teṣāmanugrihārthāya yatīnāṃ śāntacetasām / sānnidhyaṃ kurute bhūyo devyā saha maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: There, the people always worship with devotion god Visnu, Lord Narayana, the eternal source of the origin of the universe.
verses.hindi: जगतका मैं साक्षीमात्र हूँ। महायोगेश्वर भगवान् काल स्वयं ही (जगत्की सृष्टि) करते हें । विद्वानोंने शास्त्रॉमें जिसे योग, योगी और माया कहा है, वह सब प्रभु महादेव भगवान् महायोगेशवर ही हैं अर्थात् योगेश्वर
verses.wordMeaning: There, the people always worship with devotion god Visnu, Lord Narayana, the eternal source of the origin of the universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: There, the people always worship with devotion god Visnu, Lord Narayana, the eternal source of the origin of the universe.

verses.sanskrit: अन्यानिचाश्रमाणि स्युस्तस्मिन् गिरिवरोत्तमे । मुनीनां युक्तमनसां सरांसि सरितस्तथा
verses.transliteration: anyānicāśramāṇi syustasmin girivarottame / munīnāṃ yuktamanasāṃ sarāṃsi saritastathā
verses.translation: There, in the grove of Parijata trees is a splendid palace of Lord Vasudeva. It is white, brilliant like the moon and it resembles pure crystal.
verses.hindi: महादेवमें ही यह सब कल्पित है परमेष्ठी सभी तत्त्वोसे परे हैं अत: सभी तत्त्वोंका महत्त्व ही भगवान् ब्रह्माके रूपमें प्रसिद्ध है और ये भगवान् ब्रह्मा ब्रह्ममय एवं अमल हैं। जो मुझे ही महायोगेश्वरोंका भी ईश्वर समझता है, वह निर्विकल्प
verses.wordMeaning: There, in the grove of Parijata trees is a splendid palace of Lord Vasudeva. It is white, brilliant like the moon and it resembles pure crystal.
verses.commentary: Sense: There, in the grove of Parijata trees is a splendid palace of Lord Vasudeva. It is white, brilliant like the moon and it resembles pure crystal.

verses.sanskrit: तेषु योगरता विप्रा जापकाः संयतेन्द्रियाः । ब्रह्मण्यासक्तमनसो रमन्ते ज्ञानतत्पराः
verses.transliteration: teṣu yogaratā viprā jāpakāḥ saṃyatendriyāḥ / brahmaṇyāsaktamanaso ramante jñānatatparāḥ
verses.translation: With its four entrances with four arched door-ways and its ten surrounding ramparts, it is incomparable, impassable and invincible.
verses.hindi: (समाधि)-योगसे युक्त होता है, इसमें संदेह नहीं। परमानन्दका आश्रयण करनेवाला वही मैं प्रेरित करनेवाला देवता हूँ। मैं योगी निरन्तर नृत्य करता (प्राणिमात्रके हृदयमें सदा विद्यमान) रहता हूँ, जो ऐसा
verses.wordMeaning: With its four entrances with four arched door-ways and its ten surrounding ramparts, it is incomparable, impassable and invincible.
verses.commentary: Sense: With its four entrances with four arched door-ways and its ten surrounding ramparts, it is incomparable, impassable and invincible.

verses.sanskrit: आत्मन्यात्मानमाधाय शिखान्तान्तरमास्थितम् । धायायन्ति देवमीशानं येन सर्वमिदं ततम्
verses.transliteration: ātmanyātmānamādhāya śikhāntāntaramāsthitam / dhāyāyanti devamīśānaṃ yena sarvamidaṃ tatam
verses.translation: It is provided with a crystal hall adorned all round with thousands of golden columns. It stands comparison with the residential palace of the king of gods.
verses.hindi: जानता है वह वेदज्ञ है यह अत्यन्त गुह्य ज्ञान सभी वेदोंमें प्रतिष्ठित है। इसे प्रसन्नचित्त, धार्मिक तथा अग्निहोत्रीको प्रदान करना चाहिए  इसका आशय यह है कि महेश्वर प्रेरक होते हुए भी प्रेरणाकी आसक्तिसे सर्वथा रहित हैं। अहैतुकी कृपावश ही प्रेरक बनते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: It is provided with a crystal hall adorned all round with thousands of golden columns. It stands comparison with the residential palace of the king of gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is provided with a crystal hall adorned all round with thousands of golden columns. It stands comparison with the residential palace of the king of gods.

verses.sanskrit: सुमेघे वासवस्थानं सहस्त्रादित्यसंनिभम् । तत्रास्ते भगवानिन्द्रः शच्या सह सुरेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: sumeghe vāsavasthānaṃ sahastrādityasaṃnibham / tatrāste bhagavānindraḥ śacyā saha sureśvaraḥ
verses.translation: It is fitted with golden stairs and is beautified with various kinds of jewels. It is furnished with a celestial throne and it is endowed with all brilliance and beauty.
verses.hindi: ऋषियोंको दिव्य नृत्य करते हुए भगवान् शंकरका आकाशमें दर्शन, मुनियोंद्वारा महेश्वरकी भावपूर्ण स्तुति करना
verses.wordMeaning: It is fitted with golden stairs and is beautified with various kinds of jewels. It is furnished with a celestial throne and it is endowed with all brilliance and beauty.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is fitted with golden stairs and is beautified with various kinds of jewels. It is furnished with a celestial throne and it is endowed with all brilliance and beauty.

verses.sanskrit: गजशैले तु दुर्गाया भवनं मणितारणम् । आस्ते भगवती दुर्गा तत्र साक्षान्महेश्वरी
verses.transliteration: gajaśaile tu durgāyā bhavanaṃ maṇitāraṇam / āste bhagavatī durgā tatra sākṣānmaheśvarī
verses.translation: There, on all occasions, the kings eulogise the greatness of Visnu of unmeasured splendour, the overlord of Devas.
verses.hindi: एतावदुक्त्वा भगवान् योगिनां परमे श्वर: । नृत्यमानं महादेवं विष्णुना गगनेऽमले॥
verses.wordMeaning: There, on all occasions, the kings eulogise the greatness of Visnu of unmeasured splendour, the overlord of Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: There, on all occasions, the kings eulogise the greatness of Visnu of unmeasured splendour, the overlord of Devas.

verses.sanskrit: उपास्यमाना विविधैः शक्तिभेदैरितस्ततः । पीत्वा योगामृतं लब्ध्वा साक्षादानन्दमैश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: upāsyamānā vividhaiḥ śaktibhedairitastataḥ / pītvā yogāmṛtaṃ labdhvā sākṣādānandamaiśvaram
verses.translation: Charming young ladies always interested in bedecking themselves sing and dance there.
verses.hindi: तमीशं सर्वभूतानामाकाशे ददृशुः किल॥
verses.wordMeaning: Charming young ladies always interested in bedecking themselves sing and dance there.
verses.commentary: Sense: Charming young ladies always interested in bedecking themselves sing and dance there.

verses.sanskrit: सुनीलस्य गिरेः शृङ्गे नानाधातुसमुज्ज्वले । राक्षसानां पुराणि स्युः सरांसि शतशो द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: sunīlasya gireḥ śṛṅge nānādhātusamujjvale / rākṣasānāṃ purāṇi syuḥ sarāṃsi śataśo dvijāḥ
verses.translation: In the sub-continent Ilavrta, the people have the colour of the lotus. They drink the juice of Jambu fruits
verses.hindi: तमेव मोचकं रुद्रमाकाशे ददृशुः परम्॥ सहस्त्रशिरसं देवं सहस्त्रचरणाकृतिम्।
verses.wordMeaning: In the sub-continent Ilavrta, the people have the colour of the lotus. They drink the juice of Jambu fruits
verses.commentary: Sense: In the sub-continent Ilavrta, the people have the colour of the lotus. They drink the juice of Jambu fruits

verses.sanskrit: तथा पुरशतं विप्राः शतशृङ्गे महाचले । स्फाटिकस्तम्भसंयुक्तं यक्षाणाममितौजसाम्
verses.transliteration: tathā puraśataṃ viprāḥ śataśṛṅge mahācale / sphāṭikastambhasaṃyuktaṃ yakṣāṇāmamitaujasām
verses.translation: In the Bharata sub-continent, the women and men are of various complexions. They are engaged in the worship of many gods, and they perform different kinds of holy rites and professions.
verses.hindi: वसानं चर्म वैयाघ्रं शूलासक्तमहाकरम्।
verses.wordMeaning: In the Bharata sub-continent, the women and men are of various complexions. They are engaged in the worship of many gods, and they perform different kinds of holy rites and professions.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the Bharata sub-continent, the women and men are of various complexions. They are engaged in the worship of many gods, and they perform different kinds of holy rites and professions.

verses.sanskrit: श्वेतोदरगिरेः शृङ्गे सुपर्णस्य महात्मनः । प्राकारगोपुरोपेतं मणितोरणमण्डितम्
verses.transliteration: śvetodaragireḥ śṛṅge suparṇasya mahātmanaḥ / prākāragopuropetaṃ maṇitoraṇamaṇḍitam
verses.translation: O sages of holy vows, their maximum expectation of life is a hundred years. This sub-continent is reported as extend¬ ing to nine thousand Yojanas.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्माण्डं तेजसा स्वेन सर्वमावृत्य च स्थितम्। दंष्टाकरालं दुर्धर्ष सूर्यकोटिसमप्रभम्
verses.wordMeaning: O sages of holy vows, their maximum expectation of life is a hundred years. This sub-continent is reported as extend¬ ing to nine thousand Yojanas.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sages of holy vows, their maximum expectation of life is a hundred years. This sub-continent is reported as extend¬ ing to nine thousand Yojanas.

verses.sanskrit: स तत्र गरुडः श्रीमान् साक्षाद् विष्णुरिवापरः । ध्यात्वास्ते तत् परं ज्योतिरात्मानं विष्णुमव्ययम्
verses.transliteration: sa tatra garuḍaḥ śrīmān sākṣād viṣṇurivāparaḥ / dhyātvāste tat paraṃ jyotirātmānaṃ viṣṇumavyayam
verses.translation: This continent extends from the south to the north for a thousand Yojanas. To the east of it there are Kiratas and to the west are Yavanas.
verses.hindi: नृत्यन्तं ददृशुर्देवं विश्वकर्माणमीश्वरम्
verses.wordMeaning: This continent extends from the south to the north for a thousand Yojanas. To the east of it there are Kiratas and to the west are Yavanas.
verses.commentary: Sense: This continent extends from the south to the north for a thousand Yojanas. To the east of it there are Kiratas and to the west are Yavanas.

verses.sanskrit: अन्यच्च भवनं पुण्यं श्रीशृङ्गे मुनिपुङ्गवाः । श्रीदेव्याः सर्वरत्नाढ्यं हैमं सुमणितोरणम्
verses.transliteration: anyacca bhavanaṃ puṇyaṃ śrīśṛṅge munipuṅgavāḥ / śrīdevyāḥ sarvaratnāḍhyaṃ haimaṃ sumaṇitoraṇam
verses.translation: The people who live herein are the Brahmanas, Xsatriyas and Vaisyas who maintain themselves with Yajnas, lighting and trading activities. The Sudras stay amongst them { serving them).
verses.hindi: महादेवं महायोगं देवानामपि हैवतम्। 'कालात्मानं कालकालं देवदेवं महेश्वरम्
verses.wordMeaning: The people who live herein are the Brahmanas, Xsatriyas and Vaisyas who maintain themselves with Yajnas, lighting and trading activities. The Sudras stay amongst them { serving them).
verses.commentary: Sense: The people who live herein are the Brahmanas, Xsatriyas and Vaisyas who maintain themselves with Yajnas, lighting and trading activities. The Sudras stay amongst them { serving them).

verses.sanskrit: तत्र सा परमा शक्तिर्विष्णोरतिमनोरमा । अनन्तविभवा लक्ष्मीर्जगत्संमोहनोत्सुका
verses.transliteration: tatra sā paramā śaktirviṣṇoratimanoramā / anantavibhavā lakṣmīrjagatsaṃmohanotsukā
verses.translation: The rivers originating from Saktiman (Suktiman) mountain® are Ksipra, Palasini, Rsika and Varhsadharini. They dispel all sins of men.
verses.hindi: व्यासजी बोले--इतना कहकर योगियोंके परमेश्वर भगवान् (शिव) परम ऐश्वर्यमय भाव प्रदर्शित करते हुए नृत्य करने लगे। उन मुनियोंने परम तेजोनिधि ईशान महादेवको विष्णुके साथ नृत्य करते हुए स्वच्छ
verses.wordMeaning: The rivers originating from Saktiman (Suktiman) mountain® are Ksipra, Palasini, Rsika and Varhsadharini. They dispel all sins of men.
verses.commentary: Sense: The rivers originating from Saktiman (Suktiman) mountain® are Ksipra, Palasini, Rsika and Varhsadharini. They dispel all sins of men.

verses.sanskrit: अध्यास्ते देवगन्धर्वसिद्धचारणवन्दिता । विचिन्त्य जगतोयोनिं स्वशक्तिकिरणोज्ज्वला
verses.transliteration: adhyāste devagandharvasiddhacāraṇavanditā / vicintya jagatoyoniṃ svaśaktikiraṇojjvalā
verses.translation: O leading Brahmanas, the branches and tributaries of these rivers are in hundreds. For ablution, charitable gifts and other rites (on their banks), these rivers are meritorious and destructive of all sins.
verses.hindi: आकाशमें देखा । योगके तत्त्वको जाननेवाले संयतचित्त योगी ही जिन्हें जान पाते हैं, उन सभी प्राणियोंके ईशको आकाशमें मुनियोंने देखा। यह (सम्पूर्ण जगत्) जिनकी मायासे निर्मित है और जिनके द्वारा यह जगत् प्रेरित होता है, उन साक्षात् विश्वेशको विप्रोंने नृत्य करते हुए देखा। जिनके चरण-कमलका स्मरण करके पुरुष आज्ञानसे उत्पन्न भयसे छुटकारा पा लेता है, उन्हीं भूतेशको मुनियोंने नृत्य करते हुए देखा॥ १--५॥
verses.wordMeaning: O leading Brahmanas, the branches and tributaries of these rivers are in hundreds. For ablution, charitable gifts and other rites (on their banks), these rivers are meritorious and destructive of all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading Brahmanas, the branches and tributaries of these rivers are in hundreds. For ablution, charitable gifts and other rites (on their banks), these rivers are meritorious and destructive of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रैव देवदेवस्य विष्णोरायतनं महत् । सरांसि तत्र चत्वारि विचित्रकमलाश्रया
verses.transliteration: tatraiva devadevasya viṣṇorāyatanaṃ mahat / sarāṃsi tatra catvāri vicitrakamalāśrayā
verses.translation: Wise men have said that there are four Yugasin the Bharata sub-continent and not anywhere else. They are Krta, Treta, Dvapara and Kali.
verses.hindi: लोग जिनके ज्योतिर्मय स्वरूपका दर्शन करते हैं, (विप्रजनोंको) वे ही योगी दिखलायी पड़े। जो भक्तवत्सल (देव) प्रसन्न होनेपर शीघ्र ही आज्ञानसे मुक्त कर देते हैं, उन्हीं मुक्त करनेवाले परम रुद्रको (उन्होंने)
verses.wordMeaning: Wise men have said that there are four Yugasin the Bharata sub-continent and not anywhere else. They are Krta, Treta, Dvapara and Kali.
verses.commentary: Sense: Wise men have said that there are four Yugasin the Bharata sub-continent and not anywhere else. They are Krta, Treta, Dvapara and Kali.

verses.sanskrit: तथा सहस्त्रशिखरे विद्याधरपुराष्टकम् । रत्नसोपानसंयुक्तं सरोभिश्चोपशोभितम्
verses.transliteration: tathā sahastraśikhare vidyādharapurāṣṭakam / ratnasopānasaṃyuktaṃ sarobhiścopaśobhitam
verses.translation: O great sages, in the eight sub-continents such as Kiihpurusa and others there is neither sorrow nor dispiritedness, neither the fear of hunger nor any sort of exertion.
verses.hindi: आकाशमें देखा। (ब्राह्मणोंने) हजारों सिरवाले, हजारों चरणोंको आकृतिसे युक्त, हजारों बाहुवाले, जटायुक्त, अर्धचन्द्रको मस्तकपर धारण करनेवाले, व्याघ्रके चर्मको वस्त्ररूपमें धारण करनेवाले, महान् भुजामें त्रिशूल धारण करनेवाले, हाथमें दण्ड धारण किये, वेदत्रयीरूप
verses.wordMeaning: O great sages, in the eight sub-continents such as Kiihpurusa and others there is neither sorrow nor dispiritedness, neither the fear of hunger nor any sort of exertion.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sages, in the eight sub-continents such as Kiihpurusa and others there is neither sorrow nor dispiritedness, neither the fear of hunger nor any sort of exertion.

verses.sanskrit: नद्यो विमलपानीयाश्चित्रनीलोत्पलाकराः । कर्णिकारवनं द्विव्यं तत्रास्ते शङ्करोमया
verses.transliteration: nadyo vimalapānīyāścitranīlotpalākarāḥ / karṇikāravanaṃ dvivyaṃ tatrāste śaṅkaromayā
verses.translation: The subjects are happy and comfortable. They are devoid of agony; they are free from all sorts of misery. All of them enjoy steady and perpetual youth and sport themselves in various ways.
verses.hindi: अपने तेजसे सम्पूर्ण ब्रह्माण्डको आवृतकर स्थित हुए, भयंकर दाढ़ोंवाले, दुर्धर्ष, करोड़ों सूर्योके समान आभावाले, अण्डके अंदर स्थित और अण्डके बाहर स्थित, परम
verses.wordMeaning: The subjects are happy and comfortable. They are devoid of agony; they are free from all sorts of misery. All of them enjoy steady and perpetual youth and sport themselves in various ways.
verses.commentary: Sense: The subjects are happy and comfortable. They are devoid of agony; they are free from all sorts of misery. All of them enjoy steady and perpetual youth and sport themselves in various ways.

verses.sanskrit: पारियात्रे महाशैले महालक्ष्म्याः पुरं शुभम् । रम्यप्रासादसंयुक्तं घण्टाचामरभूषितम्
verses.transliteration: pāriyātre mahāśaile mahālakṣmyāḥ puraṃ śubham / ramyaprāsādasaṃyuktaṃ ghaṇṭācāmarabhūṣitam
verses.translation: This chapter gives a mythological description of the abodes of gods etc. in Jambudvipa. M. Ali in The Geog. of the Purdrias has located some of these mountains. It appears that Jambudvipa covered practically the major part of Eurasia (and probably some part ofN. Africa also).
verses.hindi: उत्पन्न करनेवाले और सम्पूर्ण जगत्को जलानेवाले विश्वकर्मा (समस्त कर्मोके अधिष्ठाता) देवको नृत्य करते हुए देखा॥ ६--११॥ ब्रह्मवादी मुनियोंने महादेव, महायोगस्वरूप, देवोंके भी देव, पशुपति ईशान, ज्योतियोंके भी अविनश्वर ज्योतिःस्वरूप, पिनाकी, विशालाक्ष, भव-रोगियोंके औषध, कालात्मा, कालके भी काल, देवाधिदेव, महेश्वर,
verses.wordMeaning: This chapter gives a mythological description of the abodes of gods etc. in Jambudvipa. M. Ali in The Geog. of the Purdrias has located some of these mountains. It appears that Jambudvipa covered practically the major part of Eurasia (and probably some part ofN. Africa also).
verses.commentary: Sense: This chapter gives a mythological description of the abodes of gods etc. in Jambudvipa. M. Ali in The Geog. of the Purdrias has located some of these mountains. It appears that Jambudvipa covered practically the major part of Eurasia (and probably some part ofN. Africa also).

verses.sanskrit: नृत्यद्भिरप्सरः सङ्घैरितश्चेतश्च शोभितम् । मृदङ्गमुरजोद्घुष्टं वीणावेणुनिनादितम्
verses.transliteration: nṛtyadbhirapsaraḥ saṅghairitaścetaśca śobhitam / mṛdaṅgamurajodghuṣṭaṃ vīṇāveṇunināditam
verses.translation: There, Devas and Siddhas alongwith the sages, always perform the worship of the Trident-bearing overlord of Devas, the ruler of living beings.
verses.hindi: शाश्चतैश्वर्यविभवं धर्माधारं दुरासदम्। महेनद्रोपेन्द्रनमितं महर्षिगणवन्दितम्
verses.wordMeaning: There, Devas and Siddhas alongwith the sages, always perform the worship of the Trident-bearing overlord of Devas, the ruler of living beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: There, Devas and Siddhas alongwith the sages, always perform the worship of the Trident-bearing overlord of Devas, the ruler of living beings.

verses.sanskrit: गन्धर्वकिंनराकीर्णं संवृतं सिद्धपुङ्गवैः । भास्वद्भित्तिसमाकीर्णं महाप्रासादसंकुलम्
verses.transliteration: gandharvakiṃnarākīrṇaṃ saṃvṛtaṃ siddhapuṅgavaiḥ / bhāsvadbhittisamākīrṇaṃ mahāprāsādasaṃkulam
verses.translation: Mahadeva, the Pinaka-bearing lord, Mahesvara, Girisa, accompanied by the goddess, shines there forever, surrounded by his goblins.
verses.hindi: योगिनां परमं ब्रह्म योगिनां योगवन्दितम्। योगिनां हृदि तिष्ठन्तं योगमायासमावृतम् क्षणेन जगतो योनिं नारायणमनामयम्। इश्वरेणैकतापन्नमपश्यन् ब्रह्मवादिनः
verses.wordMeaning: Mahadeva, the Pinaka-bearing lord, Mahesvara, Girisa, accompanied by the goddess, shines there forever, surrounded by his goblins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Mahadeva, the Pinaka-bearing lord, Mahesvara, Girisa, accompanied by the goddess, shines there forever, surrounded by his goblins.

verses.sanskrit: गणेश्वराङ्गनाजुष्टं धार्मिकाणां सुदर्शनम् । तत्र सा वसते देवी नित्यं योगपरायणा
verses.transliteration: gaṇeśvarāṅganājuṣṭaṃ dhārmikāṇāṃ sudarśanam / tatra sā vasate devī nityaṃ yogaparāyaṇā
verses.translation: Mount Kailasa with its beautiful and separate peaks stands there. It is the residence of a crore of Yaksas and of the intelligent Kubera.
verses.hindi: दृष्टा तहैश्वरं रूपं रुूद्रनारायणात्मकम्। कृतार्थ मेनिरे सन्तः स्वात्मानं ब्रह्मवादिनः
verses.wordMeaning: Mount Kailasa with its beautiful and separate peaks stands there. It is the residence of a crore of Yaksas and of the intelligent Kubera.
verses.commentary: Sense: Mount Kailasa with its beautiful and separate peaks stands there. It is the residence of a crore of Yaksas and of the intelligent Kubera.

verses.sanskrit: महालक्ष्मीर्महादेवी त्रिशूलवरधारिणी । त्रिनेत्रा सर्वशसक्तीभिः संवृता सदसन्मया । पश्यन्ति तत्र मुनयः सिद्धा ये ब्रह्मवादिनः
verses.transliteration: mahālakṣmīrmahādevī triśūlavaradhāriṇī / trinetrā sarvaśasaktībhiḥ saṃvṛtā sadasanmayā / paśyanti tatra munayaḥ siddhā ye brahmavādinaḥ
verses.translation: On the banks of those rivers are the abodes of Lord Paramesthin as well as of Narayana. They are resorted to by Devas and sages.
verses.hindi: सनत्कुमारः सनको भृगुश्च रुद्रोऽङ्गिरा वामदेवोऽथ शुक्रो
verses.wordMeaning: On the banks of those rivers are the abodes of Lord Paramesthin as well as of Narayana. They are resorted to by Devas and sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the banks of those rivers are the abodes of Lord Paramesthin as well as of Narayana. They are resorted to by Devas and sages.

verses.sanskrit: सुपार्श्वस्योत्तरे भागे सरस्वत्याः पुरोत्तमम् । सरांसि सिद्धजुष्टानि देवभोग्यानि सत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: supārśvasyottare bhāge sarasvatyāḥ purottamam / sarāṃsi siddhajuṣṭāni devabhogyāni sattamāḥ
verses.translation: It is here that the venerable sage stays always surrounded by all his distinguished disciples who are noble- souled, devoid of faults and sins, and knowers of Brahman.
verses.hindi: ओङ्कारमुच्चार्य विलोक्य देव-
verses.wordMeaning: It is here that the venerable sage stays always surrounded by all his distinguished disciples who are noble- souled, devoid of faults and sins, and knowers of Brahman.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is here that the venerable sage stays always surrounded by all his distinguished disciples who are noble- souled, devoid of faults and sins, and knowers of Brahman.

verses.sanskrit: पाण्डुरस्य गिरेः शृङ्गे विचित्रद्रुमसंकुले । सन्धर्वाणां पुरशतं दिव्यस्त्रीभिः समावृतम्
verses.transliteration: pāṇḍurasya gireḥ śṛṅge vicitradrumasaṃkule / sandharvāṇāṃ puraśataṃ divyastrībhiḥ samāvṛtam
verses.translation: In order to bless the recluses of tranquil minds, Mahesvara remains near them there along with the goddess.
verses.hindi: समस्तुवन् ब्रह्ममयैर्वचोभि- त्वामेकमीशं पुरुषं पुराणं
verses.wordMeaning: In order to bless the recluses of tranquil minds, Mahesvara remains near them there along with the goddess.
verses.commentary: Sense: In order to bless the recluses of tranquil minds, Mahesvara remains near them there along with the goddess.

verses.sanskrit: तेषु नित्यं मदोत्सिक्ता वरनार्यस्तथैव च । क्रीडन्ति मुदिता नित्यं विलासैर्भोगतत्पराः
verses.transliteration: teṣu nityaṃ madotsiktā varanāryastathaiva ca / krīḍanti muditā nityaṃ vilāsairbhogatatparāḥ
verses.translation: On that excellent mountain, there are many her¬ mitages of sages whose minds are absorbed in Yoga. There are many lakes and rivers too.
verses.hindi: प्रचेतसं ब्रह्ममयं त्वां पश्यन्ति मुनयो ब्रह्मयोनिं
verses.wordMeaning: On that excellent mountain, there are many her¬ mitages of sages whose minds are absorbed in Yoga. There are many lakes and rivers too.
verses.commentary: Sense: On that excellent mountain, there are many her¬ mitages of sages whose minds are absorbed in Yoga. There are many lakes and rivers too.

verses.sanskrit: अञ्जनस्य गिरेः शृङ्गे नारीणां पुरमुत्तमम् । वसन्ति तत्राप्सरसो रम्भाद्या रतिलालसाः
verses.transliteration: añjanasya gireḥ śṛṅge nārīṇāṃ puramuttamam / vasanti tatrāpsaraso rambhādyā ratilālasāḥ
verses.translation: In those hermitages blissfully live Brahmanas engaged in Yoga, the performers of Japa, of fully controlled sense-organs and of minds attached to and absorbed in the Brahman, and devoted to spiritual knowledge.
verses.hindi: उमापति, विरूपाक्ष, परम योगानन्दमय, ज्ञान-वैराग्यके धर्मके आधार, दुरासद (दुष्प्राप्प), महेन्द्र तथा उपेन्द्र (विष्णु) -द्वारा नमस्कृत, महर्षिगणोंद्वारा वन्दित, सभी शक्तियोंके आधार, महायोगेश्वरोंके भी ईश्वर, योगियोंके परम ब्रह्म, योगियोंके योगद्वारा वन्दित, योगियोंके हृदयमें
verses.wordMeaning: In those hermitages blissfully live Brahmanas engaged in Yoga, the performers of Japa, of fully controlled sense-organs and of minds attached to and absorbed in the Brahman, and devoted to spiritual knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: In those hermitages blissfully live Brahmanas engaged in Yoga, the performers of Japa, of fully controlled sense-organs and of minds attached to and absorbed in the Brahman, and devoted to spiritual knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: चित्रसेनादयो यत्र समायान्त्यर्थिनः सदा । सा पुरी सर्वरत्नाढ्या नैकप्रस्त्रवणैर्युता
verses.transliteration: citrasenādayo yatra samāyāntyarthinaḥ sadā / sā purī sarvaratnāḍhyā naikaprastravaṇairyutā
verses.translation: In those hermitages blissfully live Brahmanas engaged in Yoga, the performers of Japa, of fully controlled sense-organs and of minds attached to and absorbed in the Brahman, and devoted to spiritual knowledge.
verses.hindi: स्थित, योगमायासे समावृत, जगत्के योनिरूप तथा अनामय नारायणको क्षणमात्रमें ईश्वर अर्थात् शंकरके साथ एकाकार होते हुए देखा॥ १२--१७॥
verses.wordMeaning: In those hermitages blissfully live Brahmanas engaged in Yoga, the performers of Japa, of fully controlled sense-organs and of minds attached to and absorbed in the Brahman, and devoted to spiritual knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: In those hermitages blissfully live Brahmanas engaged in Yoga, the performers of Japa, of fully controlled sense-organs and of minds attached to and absorbed in the Brahman, and devoted to spiritual knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: अनेकानि पुराणि स्युः कौमुदे चापि सुव्रताः । रुद्राणां शान्तरजसामीश्वरार्पितचेतसाम्
verses.transliteration: anekāni purāṇi syuḥ kaumude cāpi suvratāḥ / rudrāṇāṃ śāntarajasāmīśvarārpitacetasām
verses.translation: In those hermitages blissfully live Brahmanas engaged in Yoga, the performers of Japa, of fully controlled sense-organs and of minds attached to and absorbed in the Brahman, and devoted to spiritual knowledge.
verses.hindi: रुद्रके उस ऐश्वर्यमय नारायणात्मक रूपको देखकर ब्रह्मवादी संतोंने अपने-आपको कृतार्थ माना । सनत्कुमार, सनक, भृगु, सनातन, सनन्दन, रुद्र, अंगिरा, वामदेव, शुक्र, महर्षि अत्रि, कपिल तथा मरीचि-इन ऋषियोंने पद्मनाभ विष्णुको वामभागमें विराजित किये हुए उन जगतूके नियामक रुद्रका दर्शन किया और हृदयमें स्थित उनका ध्यान करके सिरसे विनयपूर्वक प्रणामकर पुनः अपने मस्तकपर अञ्जलि बाँधकर प्रणाम
verses.wordMeaning: In those hermitages blissfully live Brahmanas engaged in Yoga, the performers of Japa, of fully controlled sense-organs and of minds attached to and absorbed in the Brahman, and devoted to spiritual knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: In those hermitages blissfully live Brahmanas engaged in Yoga, the performers of Japa, of fully controlled sense-organs and of minds attached to and absorbed in the Brahman, and devoted to spiritual knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: तेषु रुद्रा महायोगा महेशान्तरचारिणः । समासते परं ज्योतिरारूढाः स्थानमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: teṣu rudrā mahāyogā maheśāntaracāriṇaḥ / samāsate paraṃ jyotirārūḍhāḥ sthānamuttamam
verses.translation: In those hermitages blissfully live Brahmanas engaged in Yoga, the performers of Japa, of fully controlled sense-organs and of minds attached to and absorbed in the Brahman, and devoted to spiritual knowledge.
verses.hindi: ओंकारका उच्चारण करनेके उपरान्त अपने शरीरके भीतर (हृदयरूपी) गुहामें निहित उन देवका दर्शन करके आनन्दसे परिपूर्ण विस्तृत आत्मावाले वे (मुनिगण) वैदिक मन्त्रोंके द्वारा (उन देवकी) स्तुति करने लगे
verses.wordMeaning: In those hermitages blissfully live Brahmanas engaged in Yoga, the performers of Japa, of fully controlled sense-organs and of minds attached to and absorbed in the Brahman, and devoted to spiritual knowledge.
