verses.commentary: Sense: In those hermitages blissfully live Brahmanas engaged in Yoga, the performers of Japa, of fully controlled sense-organs and of minds attached to and absorbed in the Brahman, and devoted to spiritual knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: पिञ्जरस्य गिरेः शृङ्गे गणेशानां पुरत्रयम् । नन्दीश्वरस्य कपिले तत्रास्ते सुयशा यतिः
verses.transliteration: piñjarasya gireḥ śṛṅge gaṇeśānāṃ puratrayam / nandīśvarasya kapile tatrāste suyaśā yatiḥ
verses.translation: In those hermitages blissfully live Brahmanas engaged in Yoga, the performers of Japa, of fully controlled sense-organs and of minds attached to and absorbed in the Brahman, and devoted to spiritual knowledge.
verses.hindi: मुनियोंने कहा--आप एकमात्र ईश्वर, पुराणपुरुष, प्राणेश्वर, अनन्त योगरूप, हृदयमें संनिविष्ट, प्रचेता, पवित्र एवं ब्रह्ममय रुद्रको हम सभी प्रणाम करते हैं। इन्द्रियोंका दमन करनेवाले तथा शान्त मुनिगण ध्यानके द्वारा अपने ही शरीरमें अचल, निर्मल, स्वर्णके समान वर्णवाले, ब्रह्मयोनि, उत्कृष्टसे भी अत्यन्त उत्कृष्ट (प्राणिमात्रके हृदयमें विद्यमान) आप कविका दर्शन करते हैं। संसारकी सृष्टि आपसे ही हुई है। आप
verses.wordMeaning: In those hermitages blissfully live Brahmanas engaged in Yoga, the performers of Japa, of fully controlled sense-organs and of minds attached to and absorbed in the Brahman, and devoted to spiritual knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: In those hermitages blissfully live Brahmanas engaged in Yoga, the performers of Japa, of fully controlled sense-organs and of minds attached to and absorbed in the Brahman, and devoted to spiritual knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: तथा च जारुधैः शृङ्गे देवदेवस्य धीमतः । दीप्तमायतनं पुण्यं भास्करस्यामितौजसः
verses.transliteration: tathā ca jārudhaiḥ śṛṅge devadevasya dhīmataḥ / dīptamāyatanaṃ puṇyaṃ bhāskarasyāmitaujasaḥ
verses.translation: In those hermitages blissfully live Brahmanas engaged in Yoga, the performers of Japa, of fully controlled sense-organs and of minds attached to and absorbed in the Brahman, and devoted to spiritual knowledge.
verses.hindi: सभीके आत्मरूप और परम अणुरूप हैं। महापुरुष आपको ही सब कुछ और सुक्ष्मसे भी सूक्ष्म तथा महानसे भी महान् कहते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: In those hermitages blissfully live Brahmanas engaged in Yoga, the performers of Japa, of fully controlled sense-organs and of minds attached to and absorbed in the Brahman, and devoted to spiritual knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: In those hermitages blissfully live Brahmanas engaged in Yoga, the performers of Japa, of fully controlled sense-organs and of minds attached to and absorbed in the Brahman, and devoted to spiritual knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यैवोत्तरदिग्भागे चन्द्रस्थानमनुत्तमम् । रमते तत्र रम्यो ऽसौ भगवान् शीतदीधितिः
verses.transliteration: tasyaivottaradigbhāge candrasthānamanuttamam / ramate tatra ramyo 'sau bhagavān śītadīdhitiḥ
verses.translation: In those hermitages blissfully live Brahmanas engaged in Yoga, the performers of Japa, of fully controlled sense-organs and of minds attached to and absorbed in the Brahman, and devoted to spiritual knowledge.
verses.hindi: त्वत्तोऽधिजातः पुरुषः पुराण: । त्वयैवेदं भ्राम्यते ब्रह्मचक्रं
verses.wordMeaning: In those hermitages blissfully live Brahmanas engaged in Yoga, the performers of Japa, of fully controlled sense-organs and of minds attached to and absorbed in the Brahman, and devoted to spiritual knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: In those hermitages blissfully live Brahmanas engaged in Yoga, the performers of Japa, of fully controlled sense-organs and of minds attached to and absorbed in the Brahman, and devoted to spiritual knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: अन्यच्च भवनं दिव्यं हंसशैले महर्षयः । सहस्त्रयोजनायामं सुवर्णमणितोरणम्
verses.transliteration: anyacca bhavanaṃ divyaṃ haṃsaśaile maharṣayaḥ / sahastrayojanāyāmaṃ suvarṇamaṇitoraṇam
verses.translation: In those hermitages blissfully live Brahmanas engaged in Yoga, the performers of Japa, of fully controlled sense-organs and of minds attached to and absorbed in the Brahman, and devoted to spiritual knowledge.
verses.hindi: पश्यामस्त्वां परमाकाशमध्ये
verses.wordMeaning: In those hermitages blissfully live Brahmanas engaged in Yoga, the performers of Japa, of fully controlled sense-organs and of minds attached to and absorbed in the Brahman, and devoted to spiritual knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: In those hermitages blissfully live Brahmanas engaged in Yoga, the performers of Japa, of fully controlled sense-organs and of minds attached to and absorbed in the Brahman, and devoted to spiritual knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रास्ते भगवान् ब्रह्मा सिद्धसङ्घैरभिष्टुतः । सावित्र्या सह विश्वात्मा वासुदेवादिभिर्युतः
verses.transliteration: tatrāste bhagavān brahmā siddhasaṅghairabhiṣṭutaḥ / sāvitryā saha viśvātmā vāsudevādibhiryutaḥ
verses.translation: In those hermitages blissfully live Brahmanas engaged in Yoga, the performers of Japa, of fully controlled sense-organs and of minds attached to and absorbed in the Brahman, and devoted to spiritual knowledge.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मानन्दमनुभूयानुभूय 3»कारस्ते वाचको मुक्तिबीजं
verses.wordMeaning: In those hermitages blissfully live Brahmanas engaged in Yoga, the performers of Japa, of fully controlled sense-organs and of minds attached to and absorbed in the Brahman, and devoted to spiritual knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: In those hermitages blissfully live Brahmanas engaged in Yoga, the performers of Japa, of fully controlled sense-organs and of minds attached to and absorbed in the Brahman, and devoted to spiritual knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य दक्षिणदिग्भागे सिद्धानां पुरमुत्तमम् । सनन्दनादयो यत्र वसन्ति मुनिपुङ्गवाः
verses.transliteration: tasya dakṣiṇadigbhāge siddhānāṃ puramuttamam / sanandanādayo yatra vasanti munipuṅgavāḥ
verses.translation: In those hermitages blissfully live Brahmanas engaged in Yoga, the performers of Japa, of fully controlled sense-organs and of minds attached to and absorbed in the Brahman, and devoted to spiritual knowledge.
verses.hindi: स्वयम्प्रभं भवतो यत्प्रकाशम्
verses.wordMeaning: In those hermitages blissfully live Brahmanas engaged in Yoga, the performers of Japa, of fully controlled sense-organs and of minds attached to and absorbed in the Brahman, and devoted to spiritual knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: In those hermitages blissfully live Brahmanas engaged in Yoga, the performers of Japa, of fully controlled sense-organs and of minds attached to and absorbed in the Brahman, and devoted to spiritual knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चशैलस्य शिखरे दानवानां पुरत्रयम् । नातिदूरेण तस्याथ दैत्यचार्यस्य धीमतः
verses.transliteration: pañcaśailasya śikhare dānavānāṃ puratrayam / nātidūreṇa tasyātha daityacāryasya dhīmataḥ
verses.translation: In those hermitages blissfully live Brahmanas engaged in Yoga, the performers of Japa, of fully controlled sense-organs and of minds attached to and absorbed in the Brahman, and devoted to spiritual knowledge.
verses.hindi: विशन्ति त्वां यतयो ब्रह्मनिष्ठाः एको वेदो बहुशाखो ह्यनन्त-
verses.wordMeaning: In those hermitages blissfully live Brahmanas engaged in Yoga, the performers of Japa, of fully controlled sense-organs and of minds attached to and absorbed in the Brahman, and devoted to spiritual knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: In those hermitages blissfully live Brahmanas engaged in Yoga, the performers of Japa, of fully controlled sense-organs and of minds attached to and absorbed in the Brahman, and devoted to spiritual knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: सुगन्धशैलशिखरे सरिद्भिरुपशोभितम् । कर्दमस्याश्रमं पुण्यं तत्रास्ते भगवानृषिः
verses.transliteration: sugandhaśailaśikhare saridbhirupaśobhitam / kardamasyāśramaṃ puṇyaṃ tatrāste bhagavānṛṣiḥ
verses.translation: In those hermitages blissfully live Brahmanas engaged in Yoga, the performers of Japa, of fully controlled sense-organs and of minds attached to and absorbed in the Brahman, and devoted to spiritual knowledge.
verses.hindi: स्त्वामेवैकं बोधयत्येकरूपम्।
verses.wordMeaning: In those hermitages blissfully live Brahmanas engaged in Yoga, the performers of Japa, of fully controlled sense-organs and of minds attached to and absorbed in the Brahman, and devoted to spiritual knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: In those hermitages blissfully live Brahmanas engaged in Yoga, the performers of Japa, of fully controlled sense-organs and of minds attached to and absorbed in the Brahman, and devoted to spiritual knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यैव पूर्वदिग्भागे किञ्चिद् वै दक्षिणाश्रिते । सनत्कुमारो भगवांस्तत्रास्ते ब्रह्मवित्तमः
verses.transliteration: tasyaiva pūrvadigbhāge kiñcid vai dakṣiṇāśrite / sanatkumāro bhagavāṃstatrāste brahmavittamaḥ
verses.translation: In those hermitages blissfully live Brahmanas engaged in Yoga, the performers of Japa, of fully controlled sense-organs and of minds attached to and absorbed in the Brahman, and devoted to spiritual knowledge.
verses.hindi: एको रुद्रस्त्वं करोषीह विश्वं जगतूके अन्तरात्मा-स्वरूप हिरण्यगर्भ पुराणपुरुष आपसे उत्पन्न हुए हैं। आपद्वारा उत्पन्न किये गये उस (पुराणपुरुष)-ने उत्पन्न होते ही यथाविधि सम्पूर्ण संसारको सृष्टि की। आपसे ही सभी वेद उत्पन्न हुए
verses.wordMeaning: In those hermitages blissfully live Brahmanas engaged in Yoga, the performers of Japa, of fully controlled sense-organs and of minds attached to and absorbed in the Brahman, and devoted to spiritual knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: In those hermitages blissfully live Brahmanas engaged in Yoga, the performers of Japa, of fully controlled sense-organs and of minds attached to and absorbed in the Brahman, and devoted to spiritual knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेष्वेतेषु शैलेषु ततान्येषु मुनीश्वराः । सरांसि विमला नद्यो देवानामालयानि च
verses.transliteration: sarveṣveteṣu śaileṣu tatānyeṣu munīśvarāḥ / sarāṃsi vimalā nadyo devānāmālayāni ca
verses.translation: In those hermitages blissfully live Brahmanas engaged in Yoga, the performers of Japa, of fully controlled sense-organs and of minds attached to and absorbed in the Brahman, and devoted to spiritual knowledge.
verses.hindi: हैं और अन्तमें आपमें ही वे स्थिति पाते हैं। हम अपने हृदयमें स्थित जगत्के कारणरूप आपको नृत्य करते हुए देख रहे हैं। आपके द्वारा ही इस ब्रह्मचक्रको चलाया जाता है, आप मायावी और जगत्के एकमात्र
verses.wordMeaning: In those hermitages blissfully live Brahmanas engaged in Yoga, the performers of Japa, of fully controlled sense-organs and of minds attached to and absorbed in the Brahman, and devoted to spiritual knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: In those hermitages blissfully live Brahmanas engaged in Yoga, the performers of Japa, of fully controlled sense-organs and of minds attached to and absorbed in the Brahman, and devoted to spiritual knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: सिद्धलिङ्गानि पुण्यानि मुनिभिः स्थापितानि तु । वन्यान्याश्रमवर्याणि संख्यातुं नैव शक्नुयाम्
verses.transliteration: siddhaliṅgāni puṇyāni munibhiḥ sthāpitāni tu / vanyānyāśramavaryāṇi saṃkhyātuṃ naiva śaknuyām
verses.translation: In those hermitages blissfully live Brahmanas engaged in Yoga, the performers of Japa, of fully controlled sense-organs and of minds attached to and absorbed in the Brahman, and devoted to spiritual knowledge.
verses.hindi: स्वामी हैं। हम दिव्य नृत्य करनेवाले आप योगात्मा चित्पतिकी शरणमें आये हैं, आपको हम नमस्कार करते हैं। परम आकाशके मध्यमें नृत्य कर रहे आपका हम दर्शन करते हैं और आपकी महिमाका स्मरण करते हैं। अनेक रूपोंमें स्थित सर्वात्मा ब्रह्मानन्दका हम बार-बार अनुभव कर रहे हैं
verses.wordMeaning: In those hermitages blissfully live Brahmanas engaged in Yoga, the performers of Japa, of fully controlled sense-organs and of minds attached to and absorbed in the Brahman, and devoted to spiritual knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: In those hermitages blissfully live Brahmanas engaged in Yoga, the performers of Japa, of fully controlled sense-organs and of minds attached to and absorbed in the Brahman, and devoted to spiritual knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: एष संक्षेपतः प्रोक्तो जम्बूद्वीपस्य विस्तरः । न शक्यं विस्तराद् वक्तुं मया वर्षशतैरपि
verses.transliteration: eṣa saṃkṣepataḥ prokto jambūdvīpasya vistaraḥ / na śakyaṃ vistarād vaktuṃ mayā varṣaśatairapi
verses.translation: In those hermitages blissfully live Brahmanas engaged in Yoga, the performers of Japa, of fully controlled sense-organs and of minds attached to and absorbed in the Brahman, and devoted to spiritual knowledge.
verses.hindi: आपका वाचक ओङ्कार मुक्तिका बीज है, आप अक्षर तथा प्रकृतिमें गूढरूपसे स्थित हैं। इसीलिये संतजन आपको सत्यस्वरूप और आपके प्रकाशको स्वयं प्रकाशित बताते हैं। सभी वेद सतत आपकी
verses.wordMeaning: In those hermitages blissfully live Brahmanas engaged in Yoga, the performers of Japa, of fully controlled sense-organs and of minds attached to and absorbed in the Brahman, and devoted to spiritual knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: In those hermitages blissfully live Brahmanas engaged in Yoga, the performers of Japa, of fully controlled sense-organs and of minds attached to and absorbed in the Brahman, and devoted to spiritual knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे षट्चत्वारिशो ऽध्यायः सूत उवाच जम्बूद्वीपस्य विस्ताराद् द्विगुणेन समन्ततः । संवेष्टयित्वा क्षारोदं प्लक्षद्वीपो व्यवस्थितः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge ṣaṭcatvāriśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca jambūdvīpasya vistārād dviguṇena samantataḥ / saṃveṣṭayitvā kṣārodaṃ plakṣadvīpo vyavasthitaḥ
verses.translation: With their Atman (individual soul) fixed on the Cosmic soul, they meditate on the lord Isana stationed on the peak of the mountain but pervading the universe.
verses.hindi: स्तुति करते हैं। दोषरहित ऋषिगण आपको नमस्कार करते हैं तथा शान्त-चित्त, सत्यसंध ब्रह्मनिष्ठ यतिजन आप सर्वश्रेष्ठमें प्रवेश करते हैं बहुत शाखाओंवाला एक अनन्त वेद आपके अद्वितीय एवं एकरूपका बोध कराता है। जो लोग जानने योग्य आपकी शरण ग्रहण करते हैं, उन्हींको शाश्वत शान्ति प्राप्त होती है, अन्य किसीको नहीं। आप
verses.wordMeaning: With their Atman (individual soul) fixed on the Cosmic soul, they meditate on the lord Isana stationed on the peak of the mountain but pervading the universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: With their Atman (individual soul) fixed on the Cosmic soul, they meditate on the lord Isana stationed on the peak of the mountain but pervading the universe.

verses.sanskrit: प्लक्षद्वीपे च विप्रेन्द्राः सप्तासन् कुलपर्वताः । ऋज्वायताः सुपर्वाणः सिद्धसङ्घनिषेविताः
verses.transliteration: plakṣadvīpe ca viprendrāḥ saptāsan kulaparvatāḥ / ṛjvāyatāḥ suparvāṇaḥ siddhasaṅghaniṣevitāḥ
verses.translation: There is Sumegha, the abode of Indra, resembling a thousand suns in brilliance. There abides Lord Indra, the overlord of gods, alongwith his consort Saci.
verses.hindi: ईश, अनादि, तेजोराशि, ब्रह्मा, विश्वरूप, परमेष्ठी और वरिष्ठ हैं । नित्य मुक्त और स्वयं ज्योतिरूप अचल (योगी) स्वात्मानन्दका अनुभव कर (आपमें) प्रविष्ट होते हैँ
verses.wordMeaning: There is Sumegha, the abode of Indra, resembling a thousand suns in brilliance. There abides Lord Indra, the overlord of gods, alongwith his consort Saci.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is Sumegha, the abode of Indra, resembling a thousand suns in brilliance. There abides Lord Indra, the overlord of gods, alongwith his consort Saci.

verses.sanskrit: गोमेदः प्रथमस्तेषां द्वितीयश्चन्द्र उच्यते । नारादो दुन्दुभिश्चैव सोमश्च ऋषभस्तथा । वैभ्राजः सप्तमः प्रोक्तो ब्रह्मणो ऽत्यन्तवल्लभः
verses.transliteration: gomedaḥ prathamasteṣāṃ dvitīyaścandra ucyate / nārādo dundubhiścaiva somaśca ṛṣabhastathā / vaibhrājaḥ saptamaḥ prokto brahmaṇo 'tyantavallabhaḥ
verses.translation: The abode of Durga is on the mountain Gajasaila. It has jewelled portals. Goddess Durga, the great Isvari herself stays there.
verses.hindi: आप अद्वितीय रुद्र ही इस विश्वकी सृष्टि करते हैं। विश्वरूप आप सबका पालन करते हैं और यह (विश्व) अन्तमें आपमें ही विलीन हो जाता है। हम आपको नमस्कार करते हैं और आपके शरणागत हैं त्वामेकमाहुः कविमेकरुद्रं
verses.wordMeaning: The abode of Durga is on the mountain Gajasaila. It has jewelled portals. Goddess Durga, the great Isvari herself stays there.
verses.commentary: Sense: The abode of Durga is on the mountain Gajasaila. It has jewelled portals. Goddess Durga, the great Isvari herself stays there.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र देवर्षिगन्धर्वैः सिद्धैश्च भगवानजः । उपास्यते स विश्वात्मा साक्षी सर्वस्य विश्वसृक्
verses.transliteration: tatra devarṣigandharvaiḥ siddhaiśca bhagavānajaḥ / upāsyate sa viśvātmā sākṣī sarvasya viśvasṛk
verses.translation: Waited upon and served everywhere by different Saktis (divine powers), she drinks the Yogic nectar pertaining to Lord Siva, after obtaining it directly from him.
verses.hindi: इन्द्रं मृत्युमनिलं चेकितानं
verses.wordMeaning: Waited upon and served everywhere by different Saktis (divine powers), she drinks the Yogic nectar pertaining to Lord Siva, after obtaining it directly from him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Waited upon and served everywhere by different Saktis (divine powers), she drinks the Yogic nectar pertaining to Lord Siva, after obtaining it directly from him.

verses.sanskrit: तेषु पुण्या जनपदा नाधयो व्याधयो न च । न तत्र पापकर्तारः पुरुषा वा कथञ्चन
verses.transliteration: teṣu puṇyā janapadā nādhayo vyādhayo na ca / na tatra pāpakartāraḥ puruṣā vā kathañcana
verses.translation: O Brahmanas, on the summit of the mountain Sunila, shining brilliantly, thanks to the various kinds of mine¬ rals, are the cities of Raksasas as well as hundreds of lakes.
verses.hindi: धातारमादित्यमनेकरूपम् त्वमव्ययः शाश्वतधर्मगोप्ता
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas, on the summit of the mountain Sunila, shining brilliantly, thanks to the various kinds of mine¬ rals, are the cities of Raksasas as well as hundreds of lakes.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas, on the summit of the mountain Sunila, shining brilliantly, thanks to the various kinds of mine¬ rals, are the cities of Raksasas as well as hundreds of lakes.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां नद्यश्च सप्तैव वर्षाणां तु समुद्रगाः । तासु ब्रह्मर्षयो नित्यं पितामहपुपासते
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ nadyaśca saptaiva varṣāṇāṃ tu samudragāḥ / tāsu brahmarṣayo nityaṃ pitāmahapupāsate
verses.translation: O Brahmanas, similarly, on the mountain Mahacala that has a hundred (beautified) peaks, there are hundreds of cities with crystal columns. They are inhabited by Yaksas of boundless prowess.
verses.hindi: त्वमेव विष्णुश्चतुराननस्त्वं
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas, similarly, on the mountain Mahacala that has a hundred (beautified) peaks, there are hundreds of cities with crystal columns. They are inhabited by Yaksas of boundless prowess.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas, similarly, on the mountain Mahacala that has a hundred (beautified) peaks, there are hundreds of cities with crystal columns. They are inhabited by Yaksas of boundless prowess.

verses.sanskrit: अनुतप्ता शिखी चैव विपापा त्रिदिवा कृता । अमृता सुकृता चैव नामतः परिकीर्तिताः
verses.transliteration: anutaptā śikhī caiva vipāpā tridivā kṛtā / amṛtā sukṛtā caiva nāmataḥ parikīrtitāḥ
verses.translation: On the summit of the mountain Svetodara is the city of the noble-souled Suparna (Garuda). It has ramparts and arched gateways and is embellished with jewelled portals.
verses.hindi: त्वमेव रुद्रो भगवानधीशः। त्वामेकमाहु: पुरुषं पुराण-
verses.wordMeaning: On the summit of the mountain Svetodara is the city of the noble-souled Suparna (Garuda). It has ramparts and arched gateways and is embellished with jewelled portals.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the summit of the mountain Svetodara is the city of the noble-souled Suparna (Garuda). It has ramparts and arched gateways and is embellished with jewelled portals.

verses.sanskrit: क्षुद्रनद्यस्त्वसंख्याताः सरांसि सुबहून्यपि । न चैतेषु युगावस्था पुरुषा वै चिरायुषः
verses.transliteration: kṣudranadyastvasaṃkhyātāḥ sarāṃsi subahūnyapi / na caiteṣu yugāvasthā puruṣā vai cirāyuṣaḥ
verses.translation: The glorious Garuda stays there like another Visnu incarnate. He meditates upon the Supreme, immutable refulgence, within his Atman.
verses.hindi: खं ब्रह्म शून्यं प्रकृतिं निर्गुणं च
verses.wordMeaning: The glorious Garuda stays there like another Visnu incarnate. He meditates upon the Supreme, immutable refulgence, within his Atman.
verses.commentary: Sense: The glorious Garuda stays there like another Visnu incarnate. He meditates upon the Supreme, immutable refulgence, within his Atman.

verses.sanskrit: आर्यकाः कुरवाश्चैव विदशा भाविनस्तथा । ब्रह्मक्षत्रियविट्शूद्रास्तस्मिन् द्वीपे प्रकीर्तिताः
verses.transliteration: āryakāḥ kuravāścaiva vidaśā bhāvinastathā / brahmakṣatriyaviṭśūdrāstasmin dvīpe prakīrtitāḥ
verses.translation: O leading sages, there is another holy abode of Goddess Sri on the peak called Srisrhga. It is of gold, richly endowed with jewels and fitted with portals studded with jewels.
verses.hindi: यदव्ययं निर्मलमेकरूपम् । परायणं ब्रह्मतनुं पवित्रम्।
verses.wordMeaning: O leading sages, there is another holy abode of Goddess Sri on the peak called Srisrhga. It is of gold, richly endowed with jewels and fitted with portals studded with jewels.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading sages, there is another holy abode of Goddess Sri on the peak called Srisrhga. It is of gold, richly endowed with jewels and fitted with portals studded with jewels.

verses.sanskrit: इज्यते भगवान् सोमो वर्णैस्तत्र निवासिभिः । तेषां च सोमसायुज्यं सारूप्यं मुनिपुङ्गवाः
verses.transliteration: ijyate bhagavān somo varṇaistatra nivāsibhiḥ / teṣāṃ ca somasāyujyaṃ sārūpyaṃ munipuṅgavāḥ
verses.translation: At that very place is the great abode of Visnu, the lord of Devas. There are four lakes there, containing beautiful lotuses of variegated colours.
verses.hindi: मनो नियम्य प्रणिधाय कायं प्रसादयामो वयमेकमीशम्
verses.wordMeaning: At that very place is the great abode of Visnu, the lord of Devas. There are four lakes there, containing beautiful lotuses of variegated colours.
verses.commentary: Sense: At that very place is the great abode of Visnu, the lord of Devas. There are four lakes there, containing beautiful lotuses of variegated colours.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे धर्मपरा नित्यं नित्यं मुदितमानसाः । पञ्चवर्षसहस्त्राणि जीवन्ति च निरामयाः
verses.transliteration: sarve dharmaparā nityaṃ nityaṃ muditamānasāḥ / pañcavarṣasahastrāṇi jīvanti ca nirāmayāḥ
verses.translation: On the mountain Sahasrasikhara (having a thousand peaks), there are eight cities of the Vidyadharas, which are fitted with jewelled staircases and are embellished with lakes.
verses.hindi: कालाय सर्वाय हराय तुभ्यम्। नमोऽग्रये देव नमः शिवाय
verses.wordMeaning: On the mountain Sahasrasikhara (having a thousand peaks), there are eight cities of the Vidyadharas, which are fitted with jewelled staircases and are embellished with lakes.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the mountain Sahasrasikhara (having a thousand peaks), there are eight cities of the Vidyadharas, which are fitted with jewelled staircases and are embellished with lakes.

verses.sanskrit: प्लक्षद्वीपप्रमाणं तु द्विगुणेन समन्ततः । संवेष्ट्येक्षुरसाम्भोधिं शाल्मलिः संव्यवस्थितः
verses.transliteration: plakṣadvīpapramāṇaṃ tu dviguṇena samantataḥ / saṃveṣṭyekṣurasāmbhodhiṃ śālmaliḥ saṃvyavasthitaḥ
verses.translation: The rivers hereof contain pure (crystal clear) water and are the receptacles of very wonderful blue lotuses. There is a divine grove of Karnikara flowers where Sankara himself (v.l. with Amba) stays.
verses.hindi: ततः स भगवान् देवः कपर्दी वृषवाहनः। संहत्य परमं रूपं प्रकृतिस्थोऽभवद् भवः
verses.wordMeaning: The rivers hereof contain pure (crystal clear) water and are the receptacles of very wonderful blue lotuses. There is a divine grove of Karnikara flowers where Sankara himself (v.l. with Amba) stays.
verses.commentary: Sense: The rivers hereof contain pure (crystal clear) water and are the receptacles of very wonderful blue lotuses. There is a divine grove of Karnikara flowers where Sankara himself (v.l. with Amba) stays.

verses.sanskrit: सप्त वर्षाणि तत्रापि सप्तैव कुलपर्वताः । ऋज्वायताः सुपर्वाणः सप्त नद्यश्च सुव्रताः
verses.transliteration: sapta varṣāṇi tatrāpi saptaiva kulaparvatāḥ / ṛjvāyatāḥ suparvāṇaḥ sapta nadyaśca suvratāḥ
verses.translation: The auspicious city of Mahalaksmi is on the moun¬ tain Parijata (v.l. Pari-patra). It is endowed with beautiful palaces and is decorated with bells and chowries.
verses.hindi: आपको अद्वितीय, कवि, एक रुद्र, प्राण, बृहत्, हरि, अग्नि, ईश, इन्द्र, मृत्यु, अनिल, चेकितान, धाता, आदित्य, और अनेकरूप कहा जाता है। आप अविनाशी और परम जानने योग्य हैं। आप ही इस विश्वके परम आश्रय हैं। आप अव्यय, शाश्वत धर्मरक्षक, सनातन और पुरुषोत्तम हैं। आप ही विष्णु और आप ही चतुर्मुख ब्रह्मा हैं। आप ही प्रधान स्वामी भगवान् रुद्र हैं। आप विश्वकी नाभि, प्रकृति, प्रतिष्ठा, सर्वेश्वर
verses.wordMeaning: The auspicious city of Mahalaksmi is on the moun¬ tain Parijata (v.l. Pari-patra). It is endowed with beautiful palaces and is decorated with bells and chowries.
verses.commentary: Sense: The auspicious city of Mahalaksmi is on the moun¬ tain Parijata (v.l. Pari-patra). It is endowed with beautiful palaces and is decorated with bells and chowries.

verses.sanskrit: कुमुदश्चोन्नतश्चैव तृतीयश्च बलाहकः । द्रोणः कङ्कस्तु महिषः ककुद्वान् सप्त पर्वताः
verses.transliteration: kumudaśconnataścaiva tṛtīyaśca balāhakaḥ / droṇaḥ kaṅkastu mahiṣaḥ kakudvān sapta parvatāḥ
verses.translation: It is beautified by the troupes of celestial damsels
verses.hindi: और परम ईश्वर हैं॥ ३४--३६ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: It is beautified by the troupes of celestial damsels
verses.commentary: Sense: It is beautified by the troupes of celestial damsels

verses.sanskrit: योनी तोया वितृष्णा च चन्द्रा शुक्ला विमोचनी । निवृत्तिश्चैति ता नद्यः स्मृता पापहरा नृणाम्
verses.transliteration: yonī toyā vitṛṣṇā ca candrā śuklā vimocanī / nivṛttiścaiti tā nadyaḥ smṛtā pāpaharā nṛṇām
verses.translation: It is crowded with Gandharvas and Kinnaras and
verses.hindi: आपको अद्वितीय, पुराणपुरुष, आदित्यके समान वर्णवाला, तमोगुणसे अतीत, चिन्मात्र, अव्यक्त, अचिन्त्यरूप, आकाश, ब्रह्म, शून्य, प्रकृति और निर्गुण कहते हैं। जिसके भीतर यह सम्पूर्ण (जगत्) प्रकाशित होता है तथा जो विकाररहित निर्मल और अद्वितीय रूप है, वह आपका रूप अचिन्त्य है और उसके भीतर समस्त तत्त्व प्रतीत होते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: It is crowded with Gandharvas and Kinnaras and
verses.commentary: Sense: It is crowded with Gandharvas and Kinnaras and

verses.sanskrit: न तेषु विद्यते लोभः क्रोधो वा द्विजसत्तमाः । न चैवास्ति युगावस्था जना जीवन्त्यनामयाः
verses.transliteration: na teṣu vidyate lobhaḥ krodho vā dvijasattamāḥ / na caivāsti yugāvasthā janā jīvantyanāmayāḥ
verses.translation: It is resorted to by the lords of Ganas.ind is
verses.hindi: आश्रयस्वरूप पवित्र ब्रह्ममूर्ति (आप)-को नमस्कार करते हैं। भूतोंके अधिपति महेश! प्रसन्न होइये, हम आपकी शरणमें हैं। आपके चरणकमलका स्मरण करनेसे सम्पूर्ण संसारका बीज (अर्थात् कर्म) नष्ट हो
verses.wordMeaning: It is resorted to by the lords of Ganas.ind is
verses.commentary: Sense: It is resorted to by the lords of Ganas.ind is

verses.sanskrit: यजन्ति सततं तत्र वर्णा वायुं सनातनम् । तेषां तस्याथ सायुज्यं सारूप्यं च सलोकता
verses.transliteration: yajanti satataṃ tatra varṇā vāyuṃ sanātanam / teṣāṃ tasyātha sāyujyaṃ sārūpyaṃ ca salokatā
verses.translation: It is impossible to enumerate those shrines. Thus the description of Jambudvipa is given in brief. It is impossible for me to recount it in detail even in hundreds of years.
verses.hindi: जाता है। मनका नियमन कर, शरीरको संयमित कर हम सभी अद्वितीय ईश्वर आपको प्रसन्न करते हैं। भव, भवोद्धव, काल, सर्व तथा हर आपको नमस्कार है। जटाधारी आप रुद्रको नमस्कार है। अग्निरूप देव शिव! आपको नमस्कार है, इस प्रकार स्तुति करनेपर उन भगवान् कपर्दी वृषवाहन देव भवने (अपने उस) उत्कृष्ट (विराद्)-रूपको समेट लिया और वे अपनी प्रकृतिमें स्थित हो गये
verses.wordMeaning: It is impossible to enumerate those shrines. Thus the description of Jambudvipa is given in brief. It is impossible for me to recount it in detail even in hundreds of years.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is impossible to enumerate those shrines. Thus the description of Jambudvipa is given in brief. It is impossible for me to recount it in detail even in hundreds of years.

verses.sanskrit: कपिला ब्राह्मणाः प्रोक्ता राजानश्चारुणास्तथा । पीता वैश्याः स्मृताः कृष्णा द्वीपे ऽस्मिन् वृषला द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: kapilā brāhmaṇāḥ proktā rājānaścāruṇāstathā / pītā vaiśyāḥ smṛtāḥ kṛṣṇā dvīpe 'smin vṛṣalā dvijāḥ
verses.translation: M. Ali decides it to be the basin of the Black Sea {Op. CiU, p -46) while V. V. Iyer identifies it with Asia Minor (Quarterly Journal of Mythical Society XV. 119-127).
verses.hindi: दृष्टा नारायणं देवं विस्मिता वाक्यमब्रुवन्
verses.wordMeaning: M. Ali decides it to be the basin of the Black Sea {Op. CiU, p -46) while V. V. Iyer identifies it with Asia Minor (Quarterly Journal of Mythical Society XV. 119-127).
verses.commentary: Sense: M. Ali decides it to be the basin of the Black Sea {Op. CiU, p -46) while V. V. Iyer identifies it with Asia Minor (Quarterly Journal of Mythical Society XV. 119-127).

verses.sanskrit: शाल्मलस्य तु विस्ताराद् द्विगुणेन समन्ततः । संवेष्ट्य तु सुरोदाब्धिं कुशद्वीपो व्यवस्थितः
verses.transliteration: śālmalasya tu vistārād dviguṇena samantataḥ / saṃveṣṭya tu surodābdhiṃ kuśadvīpo vyavasthitaḥ
verses.translation: Its description in Puranas shows it to be a Monsoon land with teak-wood forest and heavy rainfall. M. Ali identifies it with the region now known as Malaya, Thailand, Indo-China and Southern China—The ocean of Milk mentioned in V. 40, is probably the turbulent and foamy South China Sea.
verses.hindi: इदानीं श्रोतुमिच्छामो माहात्म्यं तव शंकर। भूयोऽपि तव यन्नित्यं याथात्म्यं परमेष्ठिनः स तेषां वाक्यमाकर्ण्य योगिनां योगसिद्दिदः । प्राह गम्भीरया वाचा समालोक्य च माधवम्
verses.wordMeaning: Its description in Puranas shows it to be a Monsoon land with teak-wood forest and heavy rainfall. M. Ali identifies it with the region now known as Malaya, Thailand, Indo-China and Southern China—The ocean of Milk mentioned in V. 40,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Its description in Puranas shows it to be a Monsoon land with teak-wood forest and heavy rainfall. M. Ali identifies it with the region now known as Malaya, Thailand, Indo-China and Southern China—The ocean of Milk mentioned in V. 40,…

verses.sanskrit: विद्रुमश्चैव हेमश्च द्युतिमान् पुष्पवांस्तथा । कुशेशयो हरिश्चाथ मन्दरः सप्त पर्वताः
verses.transliteration: vidrumaścaiva hemaśca dyutimān puṣpavāṃstathā / kuśeśayo hariścātha mandaraḥ sapta parvatāḥ
verses.translation: O leading sages, they have the Empire of Soma (v.l. intimate union with) and similarity of form of Soma. All of them are engaged in pious duties. All of them are delighted in their minds.
verses.hindi: मुनियोंने पहलेके समान स्थित भूतभव्येश भव और नारायणदेवको देखकर आश्चर्यचकित होकर यह वाक्य कहा--
verses.wordMeaning: O leading sages, they have the Empire of Soma (v.l. intimate union with) and similarity of form of Soma. All of them are engaged in pious duties. All of them are delighted in their minds.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading sages, they have the Empire of Soma (v.l. intimate union with) and similarity of form of Soma. All of them are engaged in pious duties. All of them are delighted in their minds.

verses.sanskrit: धुतपापा शिवा चैव पवित्रा संमता तथा । विद्युदम्भा मही चेति नद्यस्तत्र जलावहाः
verses.transliteration: dhutapāpā śivā caiva pavitrā saṃmatā tathā / vidyudambhā mahī ceti nadyastatra jalāvahāḥ
verses.translation: There is no fixation of the period for the different Yugas. People live without ailment. The people of all castes worship the eternal Vayu there.
verses.hindi: आपके परम रूपका दर्शन कर हमलोग संतुष्टचित्त हो गये हैं। आपकी कृपासे हम सभीको निर्मल, परात्पर, परमेश्वरस्वरूप आपकी अव्यभिचारिणी भक्ति उत्पन हुई है। शंकर! इस समय हमलोग आप परमेष्ठीके उस माहात्म्यको एवं जो नित्य यथार्थस्वरूप है (उसे) पुनः सुनना चाहते हैं ॥ ४४--४६॥
verses.wordMeaning: There is no fixation of the period for the different Yugas. People live without ailment. The people of all castes worship the eternal Vayu there.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no fixation of the period for the different Yugas. People live without ailment. The people of all castes worship the eternal Vayu there.

verses.sanskrit: अन्याश्च शतशोविप्रा नद्यो मणिजलाः शुभाः । तासु ब्रह्माणमीशानं देवाद्याः पर्युपासते
verses.transliteration: anyāśca śataśoviprā nadyo maṇijalāḥ śubhāḥ / tāsu brahmāṇamīśānaṃ devādyāḥ paryupāsate
verses.translation: The following are the main rivers viz. Gauri, Kumu- dvati, Sandhya, Ratri, Manojava, Kobhi and Pundarikaksa.
verses.hindi: योगसिद्धियोंको प्रदान करनेवाले उन्होंने (महेश्वरने) उन योगियोंका वचन सुनकर तथा विष्णुकी ओर देखकर गम्भीर वाणीमें कहा--
verses.wordMeaning: The following are the main rivers viz. Gauri, Kumu- dvati, Sandhya, Ratri, Manojava, Kobhi and Pundarikaksa.
verses.commentary: Sense: The following are the main rivers viz. Gauri, Kumu- dvati, Sandhya, Ratri, Manojava, Kobhi and Pundarikaksa.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणा द्रविणो विप्राः क्षत्रियाः शुष्मिणस्तथा । वैश्याः स्नेहास्तु मन्देहाः शूद्रास्तत्र प्रकीर्तिताः
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇā draviṇo viprāḥ kṣatriyāḥ śuṣmiṇastathā / vaiśyāḥ snehāstu mandehāḥ śūdrāstatra prakīrtitāḥ
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas, the four castes are Puskala, Puskara, Dhanya and Tisya respectively (in the places of) Brahmanas, Ksatriyas, Vaisyas and Sudras.
verses.hindi: ईश्वर ( शंकर )-द्वारा ऋषिगणोंको अपना सर्वव्यापी स्वरूप बतलाना तथा अपनी भगवत्ताका और इस ज्ञानसे मुक्तिकी प्रापिका निरूपण करना सर्वलोकैकनिर्माता सर्वलोकैकरक्षिता। सर्वलोकैकसंहर्ता सर्वात्माह सनातनः
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahmanas, the four castes are Puskala, Puskara, Dhanya and Tisya respectively (in the places of) Brahmanas, Ksatriyas, Vaisyas and Sudras.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmanas, the four castes are Puskala, Puskara, Dhanya and Tisya respectively (in the places of) Brahmanas, Ksatriyas, Vaisyas and Sudras.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे विज्ञानसंपन्ना मैत्रादिगुणसंयुताः । यथोक्तकारिणः सर्वे सर्वे भूतहिते रताः
verses.transliteration: sarve vijñānasaṃpannā maitrādiguṇasaṃyutāḥ / yathoktakāriṇaḥ sarve sarve bhūtahite ratāḥ
verses.translation: They worship Mahadeva by the performance of sacrifices, charitable gifts, self-control, etc., holy vows, fasts, Homas, and Tarpana rites of the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: सोऽहं कालो जगत् कृत्स्नं प्रेरयामि कलात्मकम्
verses.wordMeaning: They worship Mahadeva by the performance of sacrifices, charitable gifts, self-control, etc., holy vows, fasts, Homas, and Tarpana rites of the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: They worship Mahadeva by the performance of sacrifices, charitable gifts, self-control, etc., holy vows, fasts, Homas, and Tarpana rites of the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: यजन्ति विविधैर्यज्ञैर्ब्रह्माणं परमेष्ठिनम् । तेषां च ब्रह्मसायुज्यं सारूप्यं च सलोकता
verses.transliteration: yajanti vividhairyajñairbrahmāṇaṃ parameṣṭhinam / teṣāṃ ca brahmasāyujyaṃ sārūpyaṃ ca salokatā
verses.translation: Thanks to the grace of Rudra, they attain Rudra- Sayujya, the rarest Sarupya (with Rudra), Salokata (co-residence with Rudra in his region) and Samipya (nearness).
verses.hindi: ईश्वरने कहा--हे ऋषिगणो! आप सभी सुनें। मै परमेष्ठी ईशके उस माहात्म्यका यथावत् वर्णन कर रहा हूँ, जिसे वेदज्ञ लोग जानते हैं मैं सनातन सर्वात्मा सभी लोकोंका एकमात्र निर्माण करनेवाला, सभी लोकोंका एक अद्वितीय रक्षक और सभी लोकोंका एकमात्र संहार करनेवाला हूँ। सभी वस्तुओंका अन्तर्यामी पिता मैं ही हुँ। मध्य तथा अन्त
verses.wordMeaning: Thanks to the grace of Rudra, they attain Rudra- Sayujya, the rarest Sarupya (with Rudra), Salokata (co-residence with Rudra in his region) and Samipya (nearness).
verses.commentary: Sense: Thanks to the grace of Rudra, they attain Rudra- Sayujya, the rarest Sarupya (with Rudra), Salokata (co-residence with Rudra in his region) and Samipya (nearness).

verses.sanskrit: कुशद्वीपस्य विस्ताराद् द्विगुणेन समन्ततः । क्रौञ्चद्वीपस्ततो विप्रा वेष्टयित्वा घृतोदधिम्
verses.transliteration: kuśadvīpasya vistārād dviguṇena samantataḥ / krauñcadvīpastato viprā veṣṭayitvā ghṛtodadhim
verses.translation: The mountains thereof are, Udaya, Raivata, Syama, Kasthagiri (v.l. syamaka, Astagiri), Ambikeya, Ramya and Kesarin.
verses.hindi: सब कुछ मुझमें स्थित है, किंतु मैं सर्वत्र स्थित नहीं हूँ अर्थात् मेरी कोई सीमा नहीं है
verses.wordMeaning: The mountains thereof are, Udaya, Raivata, Syama, Kasthagiri (v.l. syamaka, Astagiri), Ambikeya, Ramya and Kesarin.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mountains thereof are, Udaya, Raivata, Syama, Kasthagiri (v.l. syamaka, Astagiri), Ambikeya, Ramya and Kesarin.

verses.sanskrit: क्रौञ्चो वामनकश्चैव तृतीयश्चान्धकारकः । देवावृच्च विविन्दश्च पुण्डरीकस्तथैव च । नाम्ना च सप्तमः प्रोक्तः पर्वतो दुन्दुभिस्वनः
verses.transliteration: krauñco vāmanakaścaiva tṛtīyaścāndhakārakaḥ / devāvṛcca vivindaśca puṇḍarīkastathaiva ca / nāmnā ca saptamaḥ proktaḥ parvato dundubhisvanaḥ
verses.translation: The main rivers are—Sukumari, Kumari, Nalini, Venuka, Iksuka, Dhenuka and Gabhasti.
verses.hindi: विप्रो! आप लोगोंने मेरे जिस अद्भुत रूपको देखा है, वह केवल मेरी उपमा (प्रतीक) है, जिसे मैंने (अपनी) मायाद्वारा दिखलाया। मैं सभी पदार्थोके भीतर स्थित (व्याप्त) रहते हुए सम्पूर्ण जगत्को प्रेरित करता हूँ। यह मेरी क्रियाशक्ति है। यह विश्व जिसके द्वारा चेष्टा करता है और जिसके स्वभावका अनुसरण करता है, कालरूप वही मैं सम्पूर्ण कलात्मक (अपने अंशरूप) जगतको प्रेरित करता हूँ॥४--६॥
verses.wordMeaning: The main rivers are—Sukumari, Kumari, Nalini, Venuka, Iksuka, Dhenuka and Gabhasti.
verses.commentary: Sense: The main rivers are—Sukumari, Kumari, Nalini, Venuka, Iksuka, Dhenuka and Gabhasti.

verses.sanskrit: गौरी कुमुद्विती चैव संध्या रात्रिर्मनोजवा । ख्यातिश्च पुण्डरीकाच नद्यः प्राधान्यतः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: gaurī kumudvitī caiva saṃdhyā rātrirmanojavā / khyātiśca puṇḍarīkāca nadyaḥ prādhānyataḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Men who drink waters of these rivers live there free from ailments, sorrow, passion and hatred.
verses.hindi: एकांशेन जगत् कृत्स्नं करोमि मुनिपुंगवाः । संहराम्येकरूपेण द्विधावस्था ममैव तु
verses.wordMeaning: Men who drink waters of these rivers live there free from ailments, sorrow, passion and hatred.
verses.commentary: Sense: Men who drink waters of these rivers live there free from ailments, sorrow, passion and hatred.

verses.sanskrit: पुष्कराः पुष्कला धन्यास्तिष्यास्तस्य क्रमेण वै । ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रिया वैश्याः शूद्राश्चैव द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: puṣkarāḥ puṣkalā dhanyāstiṣyāstasya krameṇa vai / brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrāścaiva dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: The Brahmanas, Ksatriyas, Vaisyas and Sudras are respectively called Mrga, Magadha, Manasa and Mandagas.
verses.hindi: यो हि सर्वजगत्साक्षी कालचक्रप्रवर्तकः। स मन्नियोगतो देवो ब्रह्मा मद्भावभावितः। दिव्यं तन्मामकैश्वर्यं सर्वदा वहति स्वयम्
verses.wordMeaning: The Brahmanas, Ksatriyas, Vaisyas and Sudras are respectively called Mrga, Magadha, Manasa and Mandagas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Brahmanas, Ksatriyas, Vaisyas and Sudras are respectively called Mrga, Magadha, Manasa and Mandagas.

verses.sanskrit: अर्चयन्ति महादेवं यज्ञदानसमाधिभिः । व्रतोपवासैर्विविधैर्हेमैः स्वाध्यायतर्पणैः
verses.transliteration: arcayanti mahādevaṃ yajñadānasamādhibhiḥ / vratopavāsairvividhairhemaiḥ svādhyāyatarpaṇaiḥ
verses.translation: By performing holy rites and observances of various sorts, they perpetually worship Divakara (the sun-god) the lord of Devas, the sole witness of all worlds.
verses.hindi: स सर्वलोकनिर्माता मन्नियोगेन सर्ववित्। भूत्वा चतुर्मुखः सर्ग सृजत्येवात्मसम्भवः
verses.wordMeaning: By performing holy rites and observances of various sorts, they perpetually worship Divakara (the sun-god) the lord of Devas, the sole witness of all worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: By performing holy rites and observances of various sorts, they perpetually worship Divakara (the sun-god) the lord of Devas, the sole witness of all worlds.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां वै रुद्रसायुज्यं सारूप्यं चातिदुर्लभम् । सलोकता च सामीप्यं जायते तत्प्रसादतः
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ vai rudrasāyujyaṃ sārūpyaṃ cātidurlabham / salokatā ca sāmīpyaṃ jāyate tatprasādataḥ
verses.translation: O Brahmanas, thanks to the favour of the Sun, they attain Sayujya (identity) with the sun, Samipya (nearness), Sarupata (similarity in appearance) and Salokata (residence in the solar region).
verses.hindi: योऽपि नारायणोऽनन्तो लोकानां प्रभवाव्ययः। ममैव परमा मूर्तिः करोति परिपालनम् योऽन्तकः सर्वभूतानां रुद्रः कालात्मकः प्रभुः । मदाज्ञयासौ सततं संहरिष्यति मे तनुः
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas, thanks to the favour of the Sun, they attain Sayujya (identity) with the sun, Samipya (nearness), Sarupata (similarity in appearance) and Salokata (residence in the solar region).
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas, thanks to the favour of the Sun, they attain Sayujya (identity) with the sun, Samipya (nearness), Sarupata (similarity in appearance) and Salokata (residence in the solar region).

verses.sanskrit: क्रौञ्चद्वीपस्य विस्ताराद् द्विगुणेन समन्ततः । शाकद्वीपः स्थितो विप्रा आवेष्ट्य दधिसागरम्
verses.transliteration: krauñcadvīpasya vistārād dviguṇena samantataḥ / śākadvīpaḥ sthito viprā āveṣṭya dadhisāgaram
verses.translation: Encircling the Saka Dvipa is the ocean of milk, and in its middle is Sveta dvipa. The people thereof are devoted to Narayana.
verses.hindi: हव्यं बहति देवानां कव्यं कव्याशिनामपि। पाक च कुरुते वह्निः सोऽपि मच्छक्तिचोदितः
verses.wordMeaning: Encircling the Saka Dvipa is the ocean of milk, and in its middle is Sveta dvipa. The people thereof are devoted to Narayana.
verses.commentary: Sense: Encircling the Saka Dvipa is the ocean of milk, and in its middle is Sveta dvipa. The people thereof are devoted to Narayana.

verses.sanskrit: उदयो रैवतश्चैव श्यामाको ऽस्तगिरिस्तथा । आम्बिकेयस्तथा रम्यः केशरी चेति पर्वताः
verses.transliteration: udayo raivataścaiva śyāmāko 'stagiristathā / āmbikeyastathā ramyaḥ keśarī ceti parvatāḥ
verses.translation: The territories thereof are meritorious and full of miracles. Men born there are white in complexion. They are devoted to Visnu.
verses.hindi: वैश्वानरोऽग्निर्भगवानीश्वरस्य नियोगतः योऽपि सर्वाम्भसां योनिर्वरुणो देवपुंगवः। सोऽपि संजीवयेत् कृत्स्नमीशस्यैव नियोगतः
verses.wordMeaning: The territories thereof are meritorious and full of miracles. Men born there are white in complexion. They are devoted to Visnu.
verses.commentary: Sense: The territories thereof are meritorious and full of miracles. Men born there are white in complexion. They are devoted to Visnu.

verses.sanskrit: सुकुमारी कुमारी च नलिनी रेणुका तथा । इक्षुका धेनुका चैव गभस्तिश्चेति निम्नगाः
verses.transliteration: sukumārī kumārī ca nalinī reṇukā tathā / ikṣukā dhenukā caiva gabhastiśceti nimnagāḥ
verses.translation: There is neither mental agony nor physical illness; there is no fear of old age or death. People are devoid of anger and covetousness, delusion and mutual rivalry.
verses.hindi: योऽन्तस्तिष्ठति भूतानां बहिर्देवः प्रभञ्जनः । मदाज्ञयासौ भूतानां शरीराणि बिभर्ति हि
verses.wordMeaning: There is neither mental agony nor physical illness; there is no fear of old age or death. People are devoid of anger and covetousness, delusion and mutual rivalry.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is neither mental agony nor physical illness; there is no fear of old age or death. People are devoid of anger and covetousness, delusion and mutual rivalry.

verses.sanskrit: आसां पिबन्तः सलिलं जीवन्ते तत्र मानवाः । अनामया ह्यशोकाश्च रागद्वेषविवर्जिताः
verses.transliteration: āsāṃ pibantaḥ salilaṃ jīvante tatra mānavāḥ / anāmayā hyaśokāśca rāgadveṣavivarjitāḥ
verses.translation: They are forever magnificently provided and thriving. They are devoid of dispiritedness and awe; they are perpetually delighted and they enjoy pleasures forever. They are equal to (or look like) Narayana and are devotedly attached to Narayana.
verses.hindi: योऽपि संजीवनो नृणां देवानाममृताकरः। मुनिश्रेष्ठो! में एक अंशसे सम्पूर्ण संसारकी रचना करता हूँ और दूसरे रूप(अंश)-से संहार करता हूँ इस प्रकारकी ये दोनों अवस्थाएँ मेरी ही हैं। आदि, मध्य और अन्तरहित माया-तत्त्वका प्रवर्तन करनेवाला
verses.wordMeaning: They are forever magnificently provided and thriving. They are devoid of dispiritedness and awe; they are perpetually delighted and they enjoy pleasures forever. They are equal to (or look like) Narayana and are devotedly attached to Narayana.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are forever magnificently provided and thriving. They are devoid of dispiritedness and awe; they are perpetually delighted and they enjoy pleasures forever. They are equal to (or look like) Narayana and are devotedly attached to Narayana.

verses.sanskrit: मगाश्च मगधाश्चैव मानवा मन्दगास्तथा । ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रिया वैश्याः शूद्राश्चात्र क्रमेण तु
verses.transliteration: magāśca magadhāścaiva mānavā mandagāstathā / brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrāścātra krameṇa tu
verses.translation: Some of them, Yogins of fully controlled sense-organs are always devoted to meditation. Some perform Japas. Some perform penance; while others are endowed with perfect spiri¬ tual wisdom.
verses.hindi: मै सृष्टिके आरम्भमें प्रधान तथा पुरुष-दोनोंको क्षुब्ध (प्रेरित) करता हूँ। उन दोनोंके परस्पर संयोगसे विश्व उत्पन्न होता है। महत्-तत्त्वादिके क्रमसे मेरा ही तेज विस्तारको प्राप्त होता है। जो सारे संसारके साक्षी और
verses.wordMeaning: Some of them, Yogins of fully controlled sense-organs are always devoted to meditation. Some perform Japas. Some perform penance; while others are endowed with perfect spiri¬ tual wisdom.
verses.commentary: Sense: Some of them, Yogins of fully controlled sense-organs are always devoted to meditation. Some perform Japas. Some perform penance; while others are endowed with perfect spiri¬ tual wisdom.

verses.sanskrit: यजन्ति सततं देवं सर्वलोकैकसाक्षिणम् । व्रतोपवासैर्विविधैर्देवदेवं दिवाकरम्
verses.transliteration: yajanti satataṃ devaṃ sarvalokaikasākṣiṇam / vratopavāsairvividhairdevadevaṃ divākaram
verses.translation: Others are purified by meditating upon Brahman and by observing jVtVfeja ("seedless") yoga. They meditate on the great Brahman, the eternal Vasudeva.
verses.hindi: कालचक्रको चलानेवाले हिरण्यगर्भ मार्तण्ड (सूर्य) हैं वे भी मेरे ही शरीरसे उत्पन्न हुए हैं द्विजो! कल्पके आदिमें मैने ही उन्हें अपना दिव्य, ऐश्वर्यमय सनातन ज्ञानयोग और अपनेसे उत्पन्न चारों वेद प्रदान किये। वे मेरे भावसे भावित देव ब्रह्मा मेरे आदेशसे मेरे उस दिव्य ऐश्वर्यको स्वयं सदा वहन
verses.wordMeaning: Others are purified by meditating upon Brahman and by observing jVtVfeja ("seedless") yoga. They meditate on the great Brahman, the eternal Vasudeva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Others are purified by meditating upon Brahman and by observing jVtVfeja ("seedless") yoga. They meditate on the great Brahman, the eternal Vasudeva.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां सूर्येण सायुज्यं सामीप्यं च सरूपता । सलोकता च विप्रेन्द्रा जायते तत्प्रसादतः
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ sūryeṇa sāyujyaṃ sāmīpyaṃ ca sarūpatā / salokatā ca viprendrā jāyate tatprasādataḥ
verses.translation: Others are Ekantins (followers of Ekanti-dharma) without support (solely depending on him). They are great •devotees of the lord. They see the great Brahman called Visnu beyond Tamas (of ignorance).
verses.hindi: करते हैं। सभी लोकोंका निर्माण करनेवाले और सब कुछ जाननेवाले आत्मसम्भव (मुझसे ही उत्पन्न) वे (ब्रह्मा) मेरे निर्देशसे चार मुखवाले होकर सृष्टिकी रचना करते हैँ। जो लोकोंको उत्पन्न करनेवाले अव्यय
verses.wordMeaning: Others are Ekantins (followers of Ekanti-dharma) without support (solely depending on him). They are great •devotees of the lord. They see the great Brahman called Visnu beyond Tamas (of ignorance).
verses.commentary: Sense: Others are Ekantins (followers of Ekanti-dharma) without support (solely depending on him). They are great •devotees of the lord. They see the great Brahman called Visnu beyond Tamas (of ignorance).

verses.sanskrit: शाकद्वीपं समावृत्य क्षीरोदः सागरः स्थितः । श्वेतद्वीपश्च तन्मध्ये नारायणपरायणाः
verses.transliteration: śākadvīpaṃ samāvṛtya kṣīrodaḥ sāgaraḥ sthitaḥ / śvetadvīpaśca tanmadhye nārāyaṇaparāyaṇāḥ
verses.translation: All of them have the four-armed form; They are the wielders of Sankha, Gakra and Gada (mace); all of them wear good yellow robes; their chests are marked by the line of golden liair called Srivatsa.
verses.hindi: अनन्त नारायण हैं और जगतका परिपालन करते हैं, वे भी मेरी ही परम मूर्ति हैं॥ ११--१४॥ सभी प्राणियोंका संहार करनेवाले जो प्रभु कालात्मक रुद्र हैं, वे मेरी ही आज्ञासे निरन्तर संहार करते रहते हैं, वे भी मेरी मूर्ति हैं
verses.wordMeaning: All of them have the four-armed form; They are the wielders of Sankha, Gakra and Gada (mace); all of them wear good yellow robes; their chests are marked by the line of golden liair called Srivatsa.
verses.commentary: Sense: All of them have the four-armed form; They are the wielders of Sankha, Gakra and Gada (mace); all of them wear good yellow robes; their chests are marked by the line of golden liair called Srivatsa.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र पुण्या जनपदा नानाश्चर्यसमन्विताः । श्वेतास्तत्र नरा नित्यं जायन्ते विष्णुतत्पराः
verses.transliteration: tatra puṇyā janapadā nānāścaryasamanvitāḥ / śvetāstatra narā nityaṃ jāyante viṣṇutatparāḥ
verses.translation: Others are devoted to Mahesvara. Their foreheads, are marked by Tripundras (three lines of ashes on the forehead), refulgence emanating through practice of excellent Yoga. They have great Garudas as their vehicles.
verses.hindi: जो देवताओंको हव्य (हवनीय द्रव्य) पहुँचाते हैं और कव्य ग्रहण करनेवाले पितरोंको कव्य पहुँचाते हैं तथा जो पाकमें (सब कुछ पचा लेनेमें) समर्थ हैं, वे अग्निदेव भी मेरी ही शक्तिसे प्रेरित होकर यह सब
verses.wordMeaning: Others are devoted to Mahesvara. Their foreheads, are marked by Tripundras (three lines of ashes on the forehead), refulgence emanating through practice of excellent Yoga. They have great Garudas as their vehicles.
verses.commentary: Sense: Others are devoted to Mahesvara. Their foreheads, are marked by Tripundras (three lines of ashes on the forehead), refulgence emanating through practice of excellent Yoga. They have great Garudas as their vehicles.

verses.sanskrit: नाधयो व्याधयस्तत्र जरामृत्युभयं न च । क्रोधलोभविनिर्मुक्ता मायामात्सर्यवर्जिताः
verses.transliteration: nādhayo vyādhayastatra jarāmṛtyubhayaṃ na ca / krodhalobhavinirmuktā māyāmātsaryavarjitāḥ
verses.translation: All are endowed with Sakti; they have perpetual bliss and they are pure. Persons who closely move with Visnu stay there.
verses.hindi: करते हैं। ईश्वर (शंकर)-के निर्देशसे ही भगवान् वैश्वानर अग्नि रात-दिन ग्रहण किये गये आहारको पचाते रहते हैं सम्पूर्ण जलके मूल कारण जो देवश्रेष्ठ वरुण हैं, वे भी ईश्वरके ही निर्देशसे सम्पूर्ण विश्वको जीवन (जल) प्रदान करते हैं, जो प्राणियोंके भीतर और बाहर वर्तमान रहनेवाले वायुदेव हैं, वे भी मेरी आज्ञासे
verses.wordMeaning: All are endowed with Sakti; they have perpetual bliss and they are pure. Persons who closely move with Visnu stay there.
verses.commentary: Sense: All are endowed with Sakti; they have perpetual bliss and they are pure. Persons who closely move with Visnu stay there.

verses.sanskrit: नित्यपुष्टा निरातङ्का नित्यानन्दाश्च भोगिनः । नारायणपराः सर्वे नारायणपरायणाः
verses.transliteration: nityapuṣṭā nirātaṅkā nityānandāśca bhoginaḥ / nārāyaṇaparāḥ sarve nārāyaṇaparāyaṇāḥ
verses.translation: The city of Narayana named Narayanapura is also there. It is impassable to others; it cannot be assailed or trans¬ gressed; it is heightened in beauty by means of palaces.
verses.hindi: प्राणियोंके शरीरोंको धारण करते हैं। मनुष्योंको जीवित रखनेवाले जो देवताओंके अमृतके निधान सोमदेव (चन्द्रमा) हैं, वे भी मेरे ही निर्देशसे प्रेरित होकर कार्य करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: The city of Narayana named Narayanapura is also there. It is impassable to others; it cannot be assailed or trans¬ gressed; it is heightened in beauty by means of palaces.
verses.commentary: Sense: The city of Narayana named Narayanapura is also there. It is impassable to others; it cannot be assailed or trans¬ gressed; it is heightened in beauty by means of palaces.

verses.sanskrit: केचिद् ध्यानपरा नित्यं योगिनः संयतेन्द्रियाः । केचिज्जपन्ति तप्यन्ति केचिद् विज्ञानिनो ऽपरे
verses.transliteration: kecid dhyānaparā nityaṃ yoginaḥ saṃyatendriyāḥ / kecijjapanti tapyanti kecid vijñānino 'pare
verses.translation: It is fitted with golden ramparts and crystal pandals and halls, the lustre of which is diffused in a thousand ways; it is splendid and unthwartable.
verses.hindi: य: स्वभासा जगत् कृत्स्नं प्रकाशयति सर्वदा । सूर्यो वृष्टिं वितनुते शास्त्रेणैव स्वयम्भुवः यज्चनां फलदो देवो वर्ततेऽसौ मदाज्ञया
verses.wordMeaning: It is fitted with golden ramparts and crystal pandals and halls, the lustre of which is diffused in a thousand ways; it is splendid and unthwartable.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is fitted with golden ramparts and crystal pandals and halls, the lustre of which is diffused in a thousand ways; it is splendid and unthwartable.

verses.sanskrit: अन्ये निर्बोजयोगेन ब्रह्मभावेन भाविताः । ध्यायन्ति तत् परं व्योम वासुदेवं परं पदम्
verses.transliteration: anye nirbojayogena brahmabhāvena bhāvitāḥ / dhyāyanti tat paraṃ vyoma vāsudevaṃ paraṃ padam
verses.translation: Everywhere it has streets; the steps and staircases are bedecked in jewels; it has hundreds and thousands of rivers; it is reverberating with divine songs and music.
verses.hindi: यमो वैवस्वतो देवो देवदेवनियोगतः
verses.wordMeaning: Everywhere it has streets; the steps and staircases are bedecked in jewels; it has hundreds and thousands of rivers; it is reverberating with divine songs and music.
verses.commentary: Sense: Everywhere it has streets; the steps and staircases are bedecked in jewels; it has hundreds and thousands of rivers; it is reverberating with divine songs and music.

verses.sanskrit: एकान्तिनो निरालम्बा महाभागवताः परे । पश्यन्ति परमं ब्रह्म विष्णवाख्यं तमसः परं
verses.transliteration: ekāntino nirālambā mahābhāgavatāḥ pare / paśyanti paramaṃ brahma viṣṇavākhyaṃ tamasaḥ paraṃ
verses.translation: It abounds in swans, ducks and ruddy geese; it has four main gateways; it is incomparable and inaccessible to the •enemies ofDevas.
verses.hindi: मन्नियोगादसौ देवो वर्तते निर्क्रति: सदा यो वामदेवोऽङ्गिरसः शिष्यो रुद्रगणाग्रणीः । रक्षको योगिनां नित्यं वर्ततेऽसौ मदाज्ञया
verses.wordMeaning: It abounds in swans, ducks and ruddy geese; it has four main gateways; it is incomparable and inaccessible to the •enemies ofDevas.
verses.commentary: Sense: It abounds in swans, ducks and ruddy geese; it has four main gateways; it is incomparable and inaccessible to the •enemies ofDevas.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे चतुर्भुजाकाराः शङ्खचक्रगदाधराः । सुपीतवाससः सर्वे श्रीवत्साङ्कितवक्षसः
verses.transliteration: sarve caturbhujākārāḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharāḥ / supītavāsasaḥ sarve śrīvatsāṅkitavakṣasaḥ
verses.translation: The city is beautified with parks and gardens with full blown flowers and hundreds of living beings. Innumer¬ able Devas also beautify it. It has numerous attributes.
verses.hindi: यश्च सर्वजगत्पूज्यो वर्तते विघ्नकारकः । विनायको धर्मनेता सोऽपि मद्दचनात् किल
verses.wordMeaning: The city is beautified with parks and gardens with full blown flowers and hundreds of living beings. Innumer¬ able Devas also beautify it. It has numerous attributes.
verses.commentary: Sense: The city is beautified with parks and gardens with full blown flowers and hundreds of living beings. Innumer¬ able Devas also beautify it. It has numerous attributes.

verses.sanskrit: अन्ये महेश्वरपरास्त्रिपुण्ड्राङ्कितमस्तकाः । स्वयोगोद्भूतकिरणा महागरुडवाहनाः
verses.transliteration: anye maheśvaraparāstripuṇḍrāṅkitamastakāḥ / svayogodbhūtakiraṇā mahāgaruḍavāhanāḥ
verses.translation: The city of the Lord and the consort of Sri, of un¬ measured splendour is very sacred and glorious. In its middle is a highly-splendid spot of lofty ramparts and arched ornamental gateways.
verses.hindi: योऽपि ब्रह्मविदां श्रेष्ठो देवसेनापतिः प्रभुः । स्कन्दोऽसौ वर्तति नित्यं स्वयम्भूर्विधिचोदितः सृजन्ति विविधं लोकं परस्यैव नियोगतः
verses.wordMeaning: The city of the Lord and the consort of Sri, of un¬ measured splendour is very sacred and glorious. In its middle is a highly-splendid spot of lofty ramparts and arched ornamental gateways.
verses.commentary: Sense: The city of the Lord and the consort of Sri, of un¬ measured splendour is very sacred and glorious. In its middle is a highly-splendid spot of lofty ramparts and arched ornamental gateways.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वशक्तिसमायुक्ता नित्यानन्दाश्च निर्मलाः । वसन्ति तत्र पुरुषा विष्णोरन्तरचारिणः
verses.transliteration: sarvaśaktisamāyuktā nityānandāśca nirmalāḥ / vasanti tatra puruṣā viṣṇorantaracāriṇaḥ
verses.translation: It is the abode named Vaikuntha. It is revered even by Devas. My intellect is not competent to describe the entire region.
verses.hindi: पत्नी नारायणस्यासौ वर्तते मदनुग्रहात्
verses.wordMeaning: It is the abode named Vaikuntha. It is revered even by Devas. My intellect is not competent to describe the entire region.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is the abode named Vaikuntha. It is revered even by Devas. My intellect is not competent to describe the entire region.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र नारायणस्यान्यद् दुर्गमं दुरतिक्रमम् । नारायणं नाम पुरं व्यासाद्यैरुपशोभितम्
verses.transliteration: tatra nārāyaṇasyānyad durgamaṃ duratikramam / nārāyaṇaṃ nāma puraṃ vyāsādyairupaśobhitam
verses.translation: Only this much can be said: it is indeed the city of
verses.hindi: वाचं ददाति विपुलां या च देवी सरस्वती। सापीशवरनियोगेन चोदिता सम्प्रवर्तते याशेषपुरुषान् घोरान्नरकात् तारयिष्यति। सावित्री संस्मृता देवी देवाज्ञानुविधायिनी
verses.wordMeaning: Only this much can be said: it is indeed the city of
verses.commentary: Sense: Only this much can be said: it is indeed the city of

verses.sanskrit: हेमप्राकारसंसुक्तं स्फाटिकैर्मण्डपैर्युतम् । प्रभासहस्त्रकलिलं दुराधर्षं सुशोभनम् । हर्म्यप्राकारसंयुक्तमट्टालकसमाकुलम्
verses.transliteration: hemaprākārasaṃsuktaṃ sphāṭikairmaṇḍapairyutam / prabhāsahastrakalilaṃ durādharṣaṃ suśobhanam / harmyaprākārasaṃyuktamaṭṭālakasamākulam
verses.translation: The remaining portion of this chapter tries to synthesize the Sahkhya theory with the Puranic tlieory of creation.
verses.hindi: पार्वती परमा देवी ब्रह्मविद्याप्रदायिनी। यापि ध्याता विशेषेण सापि मद्दचनानुगा
verses.wordMeaning: The remaining portion of this chapter tries to synthesize the Sahkhya theory with the Puranic tlieory of creation.
verses.commentary: Sense: The remaining portion of this chapter tries to synthesize the Sahkhya theory with the Puranic tlieory of creation.

verses.sanskrit: हेमगोपुरसाहस्त्रैर्नानारत्नोपशोभितैः । शुभ्रास्तरणसंयुक्तं विचित्रैः समलङ्कृतम्
verses.transliteration: hemagopurasāhastrairnānāratnopaśobhitaiḥ / śubhrāstaraṇasaṃyuktaṃ vicitraiḥ samalaṅkṛtam
verses.translation: O leading Brahmanas, there is only one mountain viz. Manasottara. It rises up to fifty thousand Yojanas in height.
verses.hindi: दधाति शिरसा लोकं सोऽपि देवनियोगतः जो अपने प्रकाशसे सम्पूर्ण संसारको सदा प्रकाशित करते हैं, वे सूर्यदेव भी स्वयम्भू (ईश्वर)-की आज्ञासे वृष्टिका विस्तार करते हैं। जो सारे संसारके शासक, सभी देवताओंके ईश्वर तथा यज्ञ करनेवालोंको फल
verses.wordMeaning: O leading Brahmanas, there is only one mountain viz. Manasottara. It rises up to fifty thousand Yojanas in height.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading Brahmanas, there is only one mountain viz. Manasottara. It rises up to fifty thousand Yojanas in height.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दनैर्विविधाकारैः स्त्रवन्तीभीश्च शोभितम् । सरोभिः सर्वतो युक्तं वीणावेणुनिनादितम्
verses.transliteration: nandanairvividhākāraiḥ stravantībhīśca śobhitam / sarobhiḥ sarvato yuktaṃ vīṇāveṇunināditam
verses.translation: O leading Brahmanas, there is only one mountain viz. Manasottara. It rises up to fifty thousand Yojanas in height.
verses.hindi: प्रदान करनेवाले इन्द्रदेव हैं, वे भी मेरी आज्ञासे प्रवृत्त होते हैं। जो दुष्टोंके शासक हैं और नियमके अनुसार व्यवहार करनेवाले विवस्वानूके पुत्र यमदेव हैं, वे भी देवाधिदेव (शंकर)-के निर्देशसे व्यवहार करते हैं। जो
verses.wordMeaning: O leading Brahmanas, there is only one mountain viz. Manasottara. It rises up to fifty thousand Yojanas in height.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading Brahmanas, there is only one mountain viz. Manasottara. It rises up to fifty thousand Yojanas in height.

verses.sanskrit: पताकाभिर्विचित्राभिरनेकाभिश्च शोभितम् । वीथीभिः सर्वतो युक्तं सोपानै रत्नभूषितैः
verses.transliteration: patākābhirvicitrābhiranekābhiśca śobhitam / vīthībhiḥ sarvato yuktaṃ sopānai ratnabhūṣitaiḥ
verses.translation: O leading Brahmanas, there is only one mountain viz. Manasottara. It rises up to fifty thousand Yojanas in height.
verses.hindi: सभी प्रकारके सम्पत्तियोंके स्वामी और धन प्रदान करनेवाले कुबेर हैं, वे भी ईश्वरके नियोगसे ही सदा प्रवृत्त होते हैं। जो सभी राक्षसोंके स्वामी हैं तथा तमोगुणियोंको (अपने कर्मका) फल प्रदान करनेवाले हैं, वे निर्त्रतिदेव मेरे ही निर्देशसे सदा प्रवर्तित होते हैं॥२१--२५॥
verses.wordMeaning: O leading Brahmanas, there is only one mountain viz. Manasottara. It rises up to fifty thousand Yojanas in height.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading Brahmanas, there is only one mountain viz. Manasottara. It rises up to fifty thousand Yojanas in height.

verses.sanskrit: नारीशतसहस्त्राढ्यं दिव्यगोयसमन्वितम् । हंसकारण्डवाकीर्णं चक्रवाकोपशोभितम् । चतुर्द्वारमनौपम्यमगम्यं देवविद्विषाम्
verses.transliteration: nārīśatasahastrāḍhyaṃ divyagoyasamanvitam / haṃsakāraṇḍavākīrṇaṃ cakravākopaśobhitam / caturdvāramanaupamyamagamyaṃ devavidviṣām
verses.translation: O leading Brahmanas, there is only one mountain viz. Manasottara. It rises up to fifty thousand Yojanas in height.
verses.hindi: जो बेतालगणों और भूतोंके स्वामी और भक्तोको भोगरूपी फल प्रदान करनेवाले ईशानदेव हैं, वे भी मेरी आज्ञामें स्थित रहते हैं। जो अङ्गिराके शिष्य, रुद्रदेवके गणोंमें अग्रगण्य और योगियोंके रक्षक हैं, वे वामदेव
verses.wordMeaning: O leading Brahmanas, there is only one mountain viz. Manasottara. It rises up to fifty thousand Yojanas in height.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading Brahmanas, there is only one mountain viz. Manasottara. It rises up to fifty thousand Yojanas in height.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तत्राप्सरः सङ्धैर्नृत्यद्भिरुपशोभितम् । नानागीतविधानज्ञैर्देवानामपि दुर्लभैः
verses.transliteration: tatra tatrāpsaraḥ saṅdhairnṛtyadbhirupaśobhitam / nānāgītavidhānajñairdevānāmapi durlabhaiḥ
verses.translation: O leading Brahmanas, there is only one mountain viz. Manasottara. It rises up to fifty thousand Yojanas in height.
verses.hindi: भी मेरी ही आज्ञाद्वारा नित्य व्यवहार करते हैं। जो सम्पूर्ण संसारके पूज्य, विघ्नकारक धर्मनेता विनायक हैं, वे भी मेरे आदेशसे चलते हैं। जो ब्रह्मज्ञानियोंमें श्रेष्ठ, देवोंके सेनापति स्वयम्भू प्रभु स्कन्द हैं, वे भी नित्य विधिकी प्रेरणासे प्रेरित होते हैं। जो प्रजाओंके पति मरीचि आदि महर्षि हैं, वे भी परात्पर (परमेश्वर)-की आज्ञासे ही विविध लोकोंकी सृष्टि करते हैं॥ २६--३०॥
verses.wordMeaning: O leading Brahmanas, there is only one mountain viz. Manasottara. It rises up to fifty thousand Yojanas in height.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading Brahmanas, there is only one mountain viz. Manasottara. It rises up to fifty thousand Yojanas in height.

verses.sanskrit: नानाविलाससंपन्नैः कामुकैरतिकोमलैः । प्रभूतचन्द्रवदनैर्नूपुरारावसंयुतैः
verses.transliteration: nānāvilāsasaṃpannaiḥ kāmukairatikomalaiḥ / prabhūtacandravadanairnūpurārāvasaṃyutaiḥ
verses.translation: O leading Brahmanas, there is only one mountain viz. Manasottara. It rises up to fifty thousand Yojanas in height.
verses.hindi: जो सभी प्राणियोंकी श्री (शोभा) हैं और विपुल ऐश्वर्य प्रदान करती हैं, वे नारायणकी पत्नी (लक्ष्मी) मेरै ही अनुग्रहसे व्यवहार करती हैं। जो सरस्वतीदेवी विपुल वाणी प्रदान करती हैं, वे भी ईश्वरके नियोगसे
verses.wordMeaning: O leading Brahmanas, there is only one mountain viz. Manasottara. It rises up to fifty thousand Yojanas in height.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading Brahmanas, there is only one mountain viz. Manasottara. It rises up to fifty thousand Yojanas in height.

verses.sanskrit: ईषत्स्मितैः सुबिम्बोष्ठैर्बालमुग्धमृगेक्षणैः । अशेषविभवोपेतैर्भूषितैस्तनुमध्यमैः
verses.transliteration: īṣatsmitaiḥ subimboṣṭhairbālamugdhamṛgekṣaṇaiḥ / aśeṣavibhavopetairbhūṣitaistanumadhyamaiḥ
verses.translation: O leading Brahmanas, there is only one mountain viz. Manasottara. It rises up to fifty thousand Yojanas in height.
verses.hindi: प्रेरित होकर प्रवर्तित होती हैं। जो सभी पुरुषोंको घोर नरकोंसे तारनेवाली सावित्रीदेवी कही गयी हैं, वे भी देवकी आज्ञाके अनुसार चलनेवाली हैं। ध्यान करनेपर ब्रह्मविद्याको प्रदान करनेवाली जो श्रेष्ठ पार्वती- देवी हैं, वे भी विशेषरूपसे मेरे ही वचनोंका पालन करती हैं॥ ३१--३४॥
verses.wordMeaning: O leading Brahmanas, there is only one mountain viz. Manasottara. It rises up to fifty thousand Yojanas in height.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading Brahmanas, there is only one mountain viz. Manasottara. It rises up to fifty thousand Yojanas in height.

verses.sanskrit: सुराजहंसचलनैः सुवेषैर्मधुरस्वनैः । संलापालापकुशलैर्दिव्याभरणभूषैतैः
verses.transliteration: surājahaṃsacalanaiḥ suveṣairmadhurasvanaiḥ / saṃlāpālāpakuśalairdivyābharaṇabhūṣaitaiḥ
verses.translation: O leading Brahmanas, there is only one mountain viz. Manasottara. It rises up to fifty thousand Yojanas in height.
verses.hindi: अनन्त महिमावाले और सभी देवताओंके स्वामी जो अनन्त शेष हैं, वे भी देव (शंकर)-के निर्देशसे ही संसारको सिरपर धारण करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: O leading Brahmanas, there is only one mountain viz. Manasottara. It rises up to fifty thousand Yojanas in height.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading Brahmanas, there is only one mountain viz. Manasottara. It rises up to fifty thousand Yojanas in height.

verses.sanskrit: स्तनभारविनम्रैश्च मदघूर्णितलोचनैः । नानावर्णविचित्राङ्गैर्नानाभोगरतिप्रियैः
verses.transliteration: stanabhāravinamraiśca madaghūrṇitalocanaiḥ / nānāvarṇavicitrāṅgairnānābhogaratipriyaiḥ
verses.translation: O leading Brahmanas, there is only one mountain viz. Manasottara. It rises up to fifty thousand Yojanas in height.
verses.hindi: योज्ग्रि: संवर्तको नित्यं वडवारूपसंस्थित: । जो संवर्तक अग्नि नित्य वडवाके रूपमें स्थित
verses.wordMeaning: O leading Brahmanas, there is only one mountain viz. Manasottara. It rises up to fifty thousand Yojanas in height.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading Brahmanas, there is only one mountain viz. Manasottara. It rises up to fifty thousand Yojanas in height.

verses.sanskrit: प्रफुल्लकुसुमोद्यानैरितश्चेतश्च शोभितम् । असंख्येयगुणं शुद्धमागम्यं त्रिदशैरपि
verses.transliteration: praphullakusumodyānairitaścetaśca śobhitam / asaṃkhyeyaguṇaṃ śuddhamāgamyaṃ tridaśairapi
verses.translation: O leading Brahmanas, there is only one mountain viz. Manasottara. It rises up to fifty thousand Yojanas in height.
verses.hindi: पिबत्यखिलमम्भोधिमीश्वरस्य नियोगतः॥ ३६॥  हैं, वे भी ईश्वरको आज्ञासे ही सम्पूर्ण समुद्रको पीते
verses.wordMeaning: O leading Brahmanas, there is only one mountain viz. Manasottara. It rises up to fifty thousand Yojanas in height.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading Brahmanas, there is only one mountain viz. Manasottara. It rises up to fifty thousand Yojanas in height.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीमत्पवित्रं देवस्य श्रीपतेरमितौजसः । तस्य मध्ये ऽतितेजस्कमुच्चप्राकारतोरणम्
verses.transliteration: śrīmatpavitraṃ devasya śrīpateramitaujasaḥ / tasya madhye 'titejaskamuccaprākāratoraṇam
verses.translation: O leading Brahmanas, there is only one mountain viz. Manasottara. It rises up to fifty thousand Yojanas in height.
verses.hindi: ये चतुर्दश लोकेऽस्मिन् मनवः प्रथितौजसः । अन्याश्च देवता: सर्वा मच्छास्त्रेणैव धिष्ठिता:
verses.wordMeaning: O leading Brahmanas, there is only one mountain viz. Manasottara. It rises up to fifty thousand Yojanas in height.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading Brahmanas, there is only one mountain viz. Manasottara. It rises up to fifty thousand Yojanas in height.

verses.sanskrit: स्थानं पद् वैष्णवं दिव्यं योगिनामपि दुर्लभम् । तन्मध्ये भगवानेकः पुण्डरीकदलद्युतिः । शेते ऽशेषजगत्सूतिः शेषाहिशयने हरिः
verses.transliteration: sthānaṃ pad vaiṣṇavaṃ divyaṃ yogināmapi durlabham / tanmadhye bhagavānekaḥ puṇḍarīkadaladyutiḥ / śete 'śeṣajagatsūtiḥ śeṣāhiśayane hariḥ
verses.translation: O leading Brahmanas, there is only one mountain viz. Manasottara. It rises up to fifty thousand Yojanas in height.
verses.hindi: कलाकाष्ठानिमेषाश्च मुहूर्ता दिवसाः क्षपाः ।
verses.wordMeaning: O leading Brahmanas, there is only one mountain viz. Manasottara. It rises up to fifty thousand Yojanas in height.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading Brahmanas, there is only one mountain viz. Manasottara. It rises up to fifty thousand Yojanas in height.

verses.sanskrit: विचिन्त्यमानो योगीन्द्रैः सनन्दनपुरोगमैः । स्वात्मानन्दामृतं पीत्वा परं तत् तमसः परम्
verses.transliteration: vicintyamāno yogīndraiḥ sanandanapurogamaiḥ / svātmānandāmṛtaṃ pītvā paraṃ tat tamasaḥ param
verses.translation: O leading Brahmanas, there is only one mountain viz. Manasottara. It rises up to fifty thousand Yojanas in height.
verses.hindi: पराशचैव परार्धाश्च कालभेदास्तथा परे नियोगादेव वर्तन्ते देवस्य परमात्मनः
verses.wordMeaning: O leading Brahmanas, there is only one mountain viz. Manasottara. It rises up to fifty thousand Yojanas in height.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading Brahmanas, there is only one mountain viz. Manasottara. It rises up to fifty thousand Yojanas in height.

verses.sanskrit: सुपीतवसनो ऽनन्तो महामायो महाभुजः । क्षीरोदकन्यया नित्यं गृहीतचरणद्वयः
verses.transliteration: supītavasano 'nanto mahāmāyo mahābhujaḥ / kṣīrodakanyayā nityaṃ gṛhītacaraṇadvayaḥ
verses.translation: O leading Brahmanas, there is only one mountain viz. Manasottara. It rises up to fifty thousand Yojanas in height.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्माण्डानि च वर्तन्ते सर्वाण्येव स्वयम्भुवः
verses.wordMeaning: O leading Brahmanas, there is only one mountain viz. Manasottara. It rises up to fifty thousand Yojanas in height.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading Brahmanas, there is only one mountain viz. Manasottara. It rises up to fifty thousand Yojanas in height.

verses.sanskrit: सा च देवी जगद्वन्द्या पादमूले हरिप्रिया । समास्ते तन्मना नित्यं पीत्वा नारायणामृतम्
verses.transliteration: sā ca devī jagadvandyā pādamūle haripriyā / samāste tanmanā nityaṃ pītvā nārāyaṇāmṛtam
verses.translation: O leading Brahmanas, there is only one mountain viz. Manasottara. It rises up to fifty thousand Yojanas in height.
verses.hindi: अतीतान्यप्यसंख्यानि ब्रह्माण्डानि ममाज्ञया । प्रवृत्तानि पदार्थौधैः सहितानि समन्ततः ब्रह्माण्डानि भविष्यन्ति सह वस्तुभिरात्मगैः । वहिष्यन्ति सहैवाज्ञां परस्य परमात्मनः
verses.wordMeaning: O leading Brahmanas, there is only one mountain viz. Manasottara. It rises up to fifty thousand Yojanas in height.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading Brahmanas, there is only one mountain viz. Manasottara. It rises up to fifty thousand Yojanas in height.

verses.sanskrit: न तत्राधार्मिका यान्ति न च देवान्तराश्रयाः । वैकुण्ठं नाम तत् स्थानं त्रिदशैरपि वन्दितम्
verses.transliteration: na tatrādhārmikā yānti na ca devāntarāśrayāḥ / vaikuṇṭhaṃ nāma tat sthānaṃ tridaśairapi vanditam
verses.translation: O leading Brahmanas, there is only one mountain viz. Manasottara. It rises up to fifty thousand Yojanas in height.
verses.hindi: यो वै देहभृतां देवः पुरुषः पठ्यते परः। आत्मासौ वर्तते नित्यमीश्वरस्य नियोगतः
verses.wordMeaning: O leading Brahmanas, there is only one mountain viz. Manasottara. It rises up to fifty thousand Yojanas in height.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading Brahmanas, there is only one mountain viz. Manasottara. It rises up to fifty thousand Yojanas in height.

verses.sanskrit: न मे ऽत्र भवति प्रज्ञा कृत्स्नशस्तन्निरूपणे । एतावच्छक्यते वक्तुं नारायणपुरं हि तत्
verses.transliteration: na me 'tra bhavati prajñā kṛtsnaśastannirūpaṇe / etāvacchakyate vaktuṃ nārāyaṇapuraṃ hi tat
verses.translation: O leading Brahmanas, there is only one mountain viz. Manasottara. It rises up to fifty thousand Yojanas in height.
verses.hindi: रहते हैं। इस संसारमें अत्यन्त तेजस्वी जो चौदह मनु हैं, वे सभी मुझ (ईशवर)-के आदेशसे सभी प्रजाओंका पालन करते हैं। आदित्य, वसुगण, रुद्र, मरुद्गण, अश्विनीकुमार तथा अन्य सभी देवता मेरी ही आज्ञामें प्रतिष्ठित हैं। गन्धर्व, गरुड, ऋक्ष, सिद्ध, साध्य, चारण, यक्ष, राक्षस तथा पिशाच-ये सभी स्वयम्भूको आज्ञामें ही स्थित हैं। कला, काष्ठा, निमेष, मुहूर्त, दिन, रात, ऋतुएँ, पक्ष तथा मास--ये मुझ प्रजापति (शिव)-के
verses.wordMeaning: O leading Brahmanas, there is only one mountain viz. Manasottara. It rises up to fifty thousand Yojanas in height.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading Brahmanas, there is only one mountain viz. Manasottara. It rises up to fifty thousand Yojanas in height.

verses.sanskrit: स एव परमं ब्रह्म वासुदेवः सनातनः । शेते नारायणः श्रीमान् मायया मोहयञ्जगत्
verses.transliteration: sa eva paramaṃ brahma vāsudevaḥ sanātanaḥ / śete nārāyaṇaḥ śrīmān māyayā mohayañjagat
verses.translation: O leading Brahmanas, there is only one mountain viz. Manasottara. It rises up to fifty thousand Yojanas in height.
verses.hindi: शासनमें स्थित हें
verses.wordMeaning: O leading Brahmanas, there is only one mountain viz. Manasottara. It rises up to fifty thousand Yojanas in height.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading Brahmanas, there is only one mountain viz. Manasottara. It rises up to fifty thousand Yojanas in height.

verses.sanskrit: नारायणादिदं जातं तस्मिन्नेव व्यवस्थितम् । तमेवाभ्येति कल्पान्ते स एव परमा गतिः
verses.transliteration: nārāyaṇādidaṃ jātaṃ tasminneva vyavasthitam / tamevābhyeti kalpānte sa eva paramā gatiḥ
verses.translation: O leading Brahmanas, there is only one mountain viz. Manasottara. It rises up to fifty thousand Yojanas in height.
verses.hindi: कालके सभी भेद मेरे ही शासनमें स्थित रहते हैं। प्रकारके प्राणी और स्थावर-जंगमात्मक जगत् मुझ परमात्मा देवके निर्देशसे ही प्रवर्तित होते हैं। सभी पाताल और भुवन, सभी ब्रह्माण्ड स्वयम्भू परमेशवरकी आज्ञासे प्रवर्तित हैं । बीते हुए भी जो पदार्थोके समूहोंसहित
verses.wordMeaning: O leading Brahmanas, there is only one mountain viz. Manasottara. It rises up to fifty thousand Yojanas in height.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading Brahmanas, there is only one mountain viz. Manasottara. It rises up to fifty thousand Yojanas in height.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साह्स्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे सप्तचत्वारिंशोध्यायः सूत उवाच शाकद्वीपस्य विस्ताराद् द्विगुणेन व्यवस्थितः । क्षीरार्णवं समाश्रित्य द्वीपः पुष्करसंवृतः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhstryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge saptacatvāriṃśodhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca śākadvīpasya vistārād dviguṇena vyavasthitaḥ / kṣīrārṇavaṃ samāśritya dvīpaḥ puṣkarasaṃvṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Its girth is also that much. It is globular all round. The mountain Manasottara is stationed exactly in the middle of the continent (v.l. sarhjnita —Half of the continent is called Manasottara).
verses.hindi: असंख्य ब्रह्माण्ड थे, वे मेरी ही आज्ञासे सर्वत्र प्रवृत्त थे। आगे भी जो ब्रह्माण्ड होंगे, वे भी सहैव परात्पर परमात्माकी आज्ञाका आत्मगत (अपने अधीन) वस्तुओंके द्वारा पालन करेंगे। पृथ्वी, जल, तेज, वायु, आकाश,
verses.wordMeaning: Its girth is also that much. It is globular all round. The mountain Manasottara is stationed exactly in the middle of the continent (v.l. sarhjnita —Half of the continent is called Manasottara).
verses.commentary: Sense: Its girth is also that much. It is globular all round. The mountain Manasottara is stationed exactly in the middle of the continent (v.l. sarhjnita —Half of the continent is called Manasottara).

verses.sanskrit: एक एवात्र विप्रेन्द्राः पर्वतो मानसोत्तरः । योजनानां सहस्त्राणि सार्धं पञ्चाशदुच्छ्रितः । तावदेव च विस्तीर्णः सर्वतः परिमण्डलः
verses.transliteration: eka evātra viprendrāḥ parvato mānasottaraḥ / yojanānāṃ sahastrāṇi sārdhaṃ pañcāśaducchritaḥ / tāvadeva ca vistīrṇaḥ sarvataḥ parimaṇḍalaḥ
verses.translation: The same blessed tract of land is divided into two. In that continent, two holy and splendid territories are situated.
verses.hindi: मन, बुद्धि, भूतादि' (तामस अहंकार) और आदि प्रकृति-- ये सभी मेरी आज्ञासे कार्य करते हैं॥ ४१--४६॥ जो सम्पूर्ण संसारकी योनि और सभी देहधारियोंको मोहित करनेवाली माया है, वह भी ईश्वरके निर्देशसे ही नित्य (विभिन्न रूपोंमें) विवर्तित होती रहती है। जो देहधारियोंके आत्मस्वरूप परात्पर पुरुष देव
verses.wordMeaning: The same blessed tract of land is divided into two. In that continent, two holy and splendid territories are situated.
verses.commentary: Sense: The same blessed tract of land is divided into two. In that continent, two holy and splendid territories are situated.

verses.sanskrit: स एव द्वीपः पश्चार्धे मानसोत्तरसंज्ञितः । एक एव महासानुः संनिवेशाद् द्विधा कृतः
verses.transliteration: sa eva dvīpaḥ paścārdhe mānasottarasaṃjñitaḥ / eka eva mahāsānuḥ saṃniveśād dvidhā kṛtaḥ
verses.translation: They are on either side of the mountain Manasa. They are as Mahavita Varsa and Dhataki khanda.
verses.hindi: कहे जाते हैं, वे भी नित्य ईशवरके नियोगसे ही कार्य करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: They are on either side of the mountain Manasa. They are as Mahavita Varsa and Dhataki khanda.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are on either side of the mountain Manasa. They are as Mahavita Varsa and Dhataki khanda.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन् द्वीपे स्मृतौ द्वौ तु पुण्यौ जनपदौ शुभौ । अपरौ मानसस्याथ पर्वतस्यानुमण्डलौ । महावीतं स्मृतं वर्षं धातकीखण्डमेव च
verses.transliteration: tasmin dvīpe smṛtau dvau tu puṇyau janapadau śubhau / aparau mānasasyātha parvatasyānumaṇḍalau / mahāvītaṃ smṛtaṃ varṣaṃ dhātakīkhaṇḍameva ca
verses.translation: The island continent Puskara is encircled by the ocean of sweet water. There is a great tree in that island (continent). It is the Nyagrodha (Holy Banyan) tree wor¬ shipped by the immortal.
verses.hindi: जिसके द्वारा मोहरूपी कल्मषको धोकर उस परमपदका दर्शन होता है, वह विद्या भी महेशकी आज्ञाके वशमें रहनेवाली है। इस विषयमें और अधिक क्या कहा जाय, यह संसार मेरी ही शक्तिसे शक्तिमान् है। मेरे द्वारा ही सम्पूर्ण (जगत्) प्रेरित किया जाता है और मुझमें ही उसका लय भी हो जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: The island continent Puskara is encircled by the ocean of sweet water. There is a great tree in that island (continent). It is the Nyagrodha (Holy Banyan) tree wor¬ shipped by the immortal.
verses.commentary: Sense: The island continent Puskara is encircled by the ocean of sweet water. There is a great tree in that island (continent). It is the Nyagrodha (Holy Banyan) tree wor¬ shipped by the immortal.

verses.sanskrit: स्वादूदकेनोदधिना पुष्करः परिवारितः । तस्मिन् द्वीपे महावृक्षो न्यग्रोधो ऽमरपूजितः
verses.transliteration: svādūdakenodadhinā puṣkaraḥ parivāritaḥ / tasmin dvīpe mahāvṛkṣo nyagrodho 'marapūjitaḥ
verses.translation: O tiger of a sage, (i.e. leading sage), Brahma, the Atman of the universe, the creator of the universe stays on it. At that very spot are the abodes of Siva and Narayana.
verses.hindi: १-अपने अधीन जो भी सामग्री होगी, उसमें पूर्ण समर्पणभावसे आज्ञापालन करना यहाँ अभिप्रेत है। २-तामस अहंकारकी भूतादि संज्ञा सांख्यशास्त्रमें प्रसिद्ध है--भूतादेस्तन्मात्र........' । (सांख्यकारिका २५)
verses.wordMeaning: O tiger of a sage, (i.e. leading sage), Brahma, the Atman of the universe, the creator of the universe stays on it. At that very spot are the abodes of Siva and Narayana.
verses.commentary: Sense: O tiger of a sage, (i.e. leading sage), Brahma, the Atman of the universe, the creator of the universe stays on it. At that very spot are the abodes of Siva and Narayana.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन् निवसति ब्रह्मा विश्वात्मा विश्वभावनः । तत्रैव मुनिशार्दूलाः शिवनारायणालयः
verses.transliteration: tasmin nivasati brahmā viśvātmā viśvabhāvanaḥ / tatraiva muniśārdūlāḥ śivanārāyaṇālayaḥ
verses.translation: They are devoid of ailments and sorrow; they are free from passion and hatred; neither truth nor falsehood finds a place there; there is neither excellent, nor base nor middling there.
verses.hindi: २७८  कूर्मपुराण  अहं हि भगवानीशः स्वयं ज्योति: सनातन: । मैं ही भगवान्, ईश, स्वयं प्रकाश, सनातन और
verses.wordMeaning: They are devoid of ailments and sorrow; they are free from passion and hatred; neither truth nor falsehood finds a place there; there is neither excellent, nor base nor middling there.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are devoid of ailments and sorrow; they are free from passion and hatred; neither truth nor falsehood finds a place there; there is neither excellent, nor base nor middling there.

verses.sanskrit: वसत्यत्र महादेवो हरोर्ऽद्धहरिरव्ययः । संपूज्यमानो ब्रह्माद्यैः कुमाराद्यैश्च योगिभिः । गन्धर्वैः किन्नरैर्यक्षैरीश्वरः कृष्णपिङ्गलः
verses.transliteration: vasatyatra mahādevo haror'ddhahariravyayaḥ / saṃpūjyamāno brahmādyaiḥ kumārādyaiśca yogibhiḥ / gandharvaiḥ kinnarairyakṣairīśvaraḥ kṛṣṇapiṅgalaḥ
