verses.translation: The ground, comparable to a single golden rock, and twice its size, extends everywhere. Beyond that, is the mountain, the line of demarcation of the sphere of the sun.
verses.hindi: परमात्मा परं ब्रह्म मत्तो हान्यन्न विद्यते॥ ५१ ॥  परमात्मा परम ब्रह्म हूँ, मुझसे अतिरिक्त और कुछ भी नहीं हे
verses.wordMeaning: The ground, comparable to a single golden rock, and twice its size, extends everywhere. Beyond that, is the mountain, the line of demarcation of the sphere of the sun.
verses.commentary: Sense: The ground, comparable to a single golden rock, and twice its size, extends everywhere. Beyond that, is the mountain, the line of demarcation of the sphere of the sun.

verses.sanskrit: स्वस्थास्तत्र प्रजाः सर्वा ब्रह्मणा सदृशत्विषः । निरामया विशोकाश्च रागद्वेषविवर्जिताः
verses.transliteration: svasthāstatra prajāḥ sarvā brahmaṇā sadṛśatviṣaḥ / nirāmayā viśokāśca rāgadveṣavivarjitāḥ
verses.translation: It is partly illuminated and partly dark. It is called the Lokaloka mountain. Its height is ten thousand Yojanas.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार यह परम ज्ञान मैंने आप लोगोंसे कहा, इत्येतत् परमं ज्ञानं युष्माकं कथितं मया। इसे जान लेनेसे प्राणी जन्म तथा संसारके बन्धनसे
verses.wordMeaning: It is partly illuminated and partly dark. It is called the Lokaloka mountain. Its height is ten thousand Yojanas.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is partly illuminated and partly dark. It is called the Lokaloka mountain. Its height is ten thousand Yojanas.

verses.sanskrit: सत्यानृते न तत्रास्तां नोत्तमाधममध्यमाः । न वर्णाश्रमधर्माश्च न नद्यो न च पर्वताः
verses.transliteration: satyānṛte na tatrāstāṃ nottamādhamamadhyamāḥ / na varṇāśramadharmāśca na nadyo na ca parvatāḥ
verses.translation: This highly resplendent deity himself is even in the principle called tamas (v.l. in both tamas and Sattva gums). This Supreme Person dividing himself in various bodies sports in them.
verses.hindi: ज्ञात्वा विमुच्यते जन्तुर्जन्मसंसारबन्धनात्॥ ५२॥  मुक्त हो जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: This highly resplendent deity himself is even in the principle called tamas (v.l. in both tamas and Sattva gums). This Supreme Person dividing himself in various bodies sports in them.
verses.commentary: Sense: This highly resplendent deity himself is even in the principle called tamas (v.l. in both tamas and Sattva gums). This Supreme Person dividing himself in various bodies sports in them.

verses.sanskrit: परेण पुष्करस्याथ स्थितो महान् । स्वादूदकसमुद्रस्तु समन्ताद् द्विजसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: pareṇa puṣkarasyātha sthito mahān / svādūdakasamudrastu samantād dvijasattamāḥ
verses.translation: Lord Mahesvara is beyond that unmanifest from which this Cosmic Egg has been produced. God Brahma has sprung from the Cosmic world. This Universe is created by him.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षद्साहस्रथां संहितायामुपरिविभागे ( ईश्चरगीतासु ) षद्ोऽध्यायः ईश्वर (शंकर )-द्वारा अपनी विभूतियोंका वर्णन तथा प्रकृति, महत् आदि चौबीस तत्त्वों, तीन गुणों एवं पशु, पाश और पशुपति आदिका विवेचन
verses.wordMeaning: Lord Mahesvara is beyond that unmanifest from which this Cosmic Egg has been produced. God Brahma has sprung from the Cosmic world. This Universe is created by him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Mahesvara is beyond that unmanifest from which this Cosmic Egg has been produced. God Brahma has sprung from the Cosmic world. This Universe is created by him.

verses.sanskrit: परेण तस्य महती दृश्यते लोकसंस्थितिः । काञ्चनी द्विगुणा भूमिः सर्वा चैव शिलोपमा
verses.transliteration: pareṇa tasya mahatī dṛśyate lokasaṃsthitiḥ / kāñcanī dviguṇā bhūmiḥ sarvā caiva śilopamā
verses.translation: The Dialogue between Sages and Vyasa 337
verses.hindi: ईश्वर उवाच ईश्वर बोले--ऋषियो! आप सभी परमेष्ठीके शृणुध्वमृषयः सर्वे प्रभावं परमेष्ठिनः । प्रभावको सुनें, जिसे जानकर पुरुष मुक्त हो जाता है यं ज्ञात्वा पुरुषो मुक्तो न संसारे पतेत् पुनः॥ १ ॥  और फिर संसारमें नहीं गिरता
verses.wordMeaning: The Dialogue between Sages and Vyasa 337
verses.commentary: Sense: The Dialogue between Sages and Vyasa 337

verses.sanskrit: तस्याः परेण शैलस्तु मर्यादात्मात्ममण्डलः । प्रकाशश्चाप्रकाशश्च लोकालोकः स उच्यते
verses.transliteration: tasyāḥ pareṇa śailastu maryādātmātmamaṇḍalaḥ / prakāśaścāprakāśaśca lokālokaḥ sa ucyate
verses.translation: The Yoga of Isvara 342
verses.hindi: परात् परतरं ब्रह्म शाश्वतं निष्कलं ध्रुवम्। जो परसे परतर, शाश्वत, निष्कल, धुव, नित्यानन्द, नित्यानन्दं निर्विकल्पं तद्धाम परमं मम॥ २ ॥  निर्विकल्प ब्रह्म है, वह मेरा परम धाम है। मै अहं ब्रह्मविदां ब्रह्मा स्वयम्भूर्विश्वतोमुखः । ब्रह्मज्ञानियोंमें सर्वतोमुख स्वयम्भू ब्रह्मा हूँ। मायावियोंमें मायाविनामहं देवः पुराणो हरिरव्ययः॥ ३ ॥  मैं अव्यय पुराण देव हरि हूँ। योगियोंमें मैं शम्भु योगिनामस्म्यहं शम्भुः स्त्रीणां देवी गिरीन्द्रजा! और स््त्रियोंमें गिरिराज पुत्री पार्वती हूँ। मैं (द्वादश) आदित्यानामहं विष्णुर्वसूनामस्मि पावकः ॥ ४ ॥  आदित्योंमें विष्णु तथा (अष्ट) वसुओंमें पावक हूँ। रुद्राणां शंकरश्चाहं गरुडः पततामहम्। मैं रुद्रोंमें शंकर, उड्नेवाले पक्षियोंमें गरुड, गजेद्नोंमें ऐरावतो गजेन्द्राणां रामः शस्त्रभृतामहम्॥ ५ ॥  ऐरावत तथा शस्त्रधारियोंमें परशुराम हूँ
verses.wordMeaning: The Yoga of Isvara 342
verses.commentary: Sense: The Yoga of Isvara 342

verses.sanskrit: योजनानां सहस्त्राणि दश तस्योच्छ्रयः स्मृतः । तावानेव च विस्तारो लोकालोको महागिरिः
verses.transliteration: yojanānāṃ sahastrāṇi daśa tasyocchrayaḥ smṛtaḥ / tāvāneva ca vistāro lokāloko mahāgiriḥ
verses.translation: Prakrti and Purusa 348
verses.hindi: ऋषीणां च वसिष्ठोऽहं देवानां च शतक्रतुः । ऋषियोंमें मैं वसिष्ठ, देवताओंमें इन्द्र, शिल्पियोमे शिल्पिनां विशवकमाहं प्रह्मदोऽस्म्यमरद्विषाम्॥ ६ ॥  विश्वकर्मा और सुरद्वेषी राक्षसोंमें प्रह्मद हूँ । मैं मुनियोंमें मुनीनामप्यहं व्यासो गणानां च विनायकः । व्यास, गणोंमें विनायक, वीरोंमें वीरभद्र और सिद्धोमें
verses.wordMeaning: Prakrti and Purusa 348
verses.commentary: Sense: Prakrti and Purusa 348

verses.sanskrit: समावृत्य तु तं शैलं सर्वतो वै तमः स्थितम् । तमश्चाण्डकटाहेन समन्तात् परिवेष्टितम्
verses.transliteration: samāvṛtya tu taṃ śailaṃ sarvato vai tamaḥ sthitam / tamaścāṇḍakaṭāhena samantāt pariveṣṭitam
verses.translation: The Glory of Siva 350
verses.hindi: वीराणां वीरभद्रोऽहं सिद्धानां कपिलो मुनि: वज्रं प्रहरणानां च व्रतानां सत्यमस्म्यहम्
verses.wordMeaning: The Glory of Siva 350
verses.commentary: Sense: The Glory of Siva 350

verses.sanskrit: एतै सप्त महालोकाः पातालाः सप्तकीर्तिताः । ब्रह्माण्डस्यैष विस्तारः संक्षेपेण मयोदितः
verses.transliteration: etai sapta mahālokāḥ pātālāḥ saptakīrtitāḥ / brahmāṇḍasyaiṣa vistāraḥ saṃkṣepeṇa mayoditaḥ
verses.translation: Siva's Dance—Siva eulogised by Sages 354
verses.hindi: कपिल मुनि हूँ। मैं पर्वतोंमें सुमेरु, नक्षत्रोंमें चन्द्रमा, प्रहार करनेवाले शस्त्रोमें वज्र और व्रतोंमें सत्य व्रत
verses.wordMeaning: Siva's Dance—Siva eulogised by Sages 354
verses.commentary: Sense: Siva's Dance—Siva eulogised by Sages 354

verses.sanskrit: अण्डानामीदृशानां तु कोट्यो ज्ञेयाः सहस्त्रशः । सर्वगत्वात् प्रधानस्य कारणस्याव्ययात्मनः
verses.transliteration: aṇḍānāmīdṛśānāṃ tu koṭyo jñeyāḥ sahastraśaḥ / sarvagatvāt pradhānasya kāraṇasyāvyayātmanaḥ
verses.translation: The Glory of Siva 359
verses.hindi: अनन्तो भोगिनां देवः सेनानीनां च पावकिः । हूँ। मैं सर्पोमें अनन्तदेव, सेनानियोंमें कार्तिकेय, आश्रमोंमें आश्रमाणां च गाईस्थमीश्वराणां महेश्वर: ॥ ९ ॥  गृहस्थाश्रम और ईश्वरोंमें महेश्वर हूँ। मैं कल्पोमे महाकल्पश्च कल्पानां युगानां कृतमस्म्यहम्। महाकल्प, युगोंमें सत्ययुग, सभी यक्षोंमें कुबेर और कुबेरः सर्वयक्षाणां गणेशानां च वीरकः॥ १०॥  गणेश्वरोंमें वीरक हूँ प्रजापतीनां दक्षोऽहं निरृतिः सर्वरक्षसाम्। मैं प्रजापतियोंमें दक्ष, सभी राक्षसोंमें निति,
verses.wordMeaning: The Glory of Siva 359
verses.commentary: Sense: The Glory of Siva 359

verses.sanskrit: अण्डेष्वेतेषु सर्वेषु भुवनानि चतुर्दश । तत्र तत्र चतुर्वक्त्रा रुद्रा नारायणादयः
verses.transliteration: aṇḍeṣveteṣu sarveṣu bhuvanāni caturdaśa / tatra tatra caturvaktrā rudrā nārāyaṇādayaḥ
verses.translation: The Vibhuti-Yoga of Siva: Fundamentals of
verses.hindi: वायुर्बलवतामस्मि द्वीपानां पुष्करोऽस्म्यहम्॥ ११॥  बलवानोंमें वायु और द्वीपोंमें पुष्कर द्वीप हूँ
verses.wordMeaning: The Vibhuti-Yoga of Siva: Fundamentals of
verses.commentary: Sense: The Vibhuti-Yoga of Siva: Fundamentals of

verses.sanskrit: दशोत्तरमथैकैकमण्डावरणसप्तकम् । समन्तात् संस्थितं विप्रा यत्र यान्ति मनीषिणः
verses.transliteration: daśottaramathaikaikamaṇḍāvaraṇasaptakam / samantāt saṃsthitaṃ viprā yatra yānti manīṣiṇaḥ
verses.translation: The Means of Crossing the ocean of Worldly
verses.hindi: सावित्री सर्वजप्यानां गुह्यानां प्रणवोऽस्म्यहम्। सूक्तानां पौरुषं सूक्तं ज्येष्ठसाम च सामसु सर्ववेदार्थविदुषां मनुः स्वायम्भुवोऽस्म्यहम्। ब्रह्मावर्तस्तु देशानां क्षेत्राणामविमुक्तकम्
verses.wordMeaning: The Means of Crossing the ocean of Worldly
verses.commentary: Sense: The Means of Crossing the ocean of Worldly

verses.sanskrit: अनन्तमेकमव्यक्तनादिनिधनं महत् । अतीत्य वर्तते सर्वं जगत् प्रकृतिरक्षरम्
verses.transliteration: anantamekamavyaktanādinidhanaṃ mahat / atītya vartate sarvaṃ jagat prakṛtirakṣaram
verses.translation: The Means of Crossing the ocean of Worldly
verses.hindi: भूतानामस्म्यहं व्योम सत्त्वानां मृत्युरेव च
verses.wordMeaning: The Means of Crossing the ocean of Worldly
verses.commentary: Sense: The Means of Crossing the ocean of Worldly

verses.sanskrit: अनन्तत्वमनन्तस्य यतः संख्या न विद्यते । तदव्यक्तमिति ज्ञेयं तद् ब्रह्म परमं पदम्
verses.transliteration: anantatvamanantasya yataḥ saṃkhyā na vidyate / tadavyaktamiti jñeyaṃ tad brahma paramaṃ padam
verses.translation: The Means of Crossing the ocean of Worldly
verses.hindi: पाशानामस्म्यहं माया कालः कलयतामहम्। गतीनां मुक्तिरेवाहं परेषां परमेश्वरः यच्चान्यदपि लोकेऽस्मिन् सत्त्वं तेजोबलाधिकम्। तत्सर्वं प्रतिजानीध्वं मम तेजोविजृम्भितम्
verses.wordMeaning: The Means of Crossing the ocean of Worldly
verses.commentary: Sense: The Means of Crossing the ocean of Worldly

verses.sanskrit: अनन्त एष सर्वत्र सर्वस्थानेषु पठ्यते । तस्य पूर्वं मयाप्युक्तं यत्तन्माहात्म्यमव्ययम्
verses.transliteration: ananta eṣa sarvatra sarvasthāneṣu paṭhyate / tasya pūrvaṃ mayāpyuktaṃ yattanmāhātmyamavyayam
verses.translation: The Means of Crossing the ocean of Worldly
verses.hindi: तेषां पतिरहं देवः स्मृतः पशुपतिर्बुधैः
verses.wordMeaning: The Means of Crossing the ocean of Worldly
verses.commentary: Sense: The Means of Crossing the ocean of Worldly

verses.sanskrit: गतः स एष सर्वत्र सर्वस्थानेषु वर्तते । भूमौ रसातले चैव आकाशे पवने ऽनले । अर्णवेषु च सर्वेषु दिवि चैव न सशयः
verses.transliteration: gataḥ sa eṣa sarvatra sarvasthāneṣu vartate / bhūmau rasātale caiva ākāśe pavane 'nale / arṇaveṣu ca sarveṣu divi caiva na saśayaḥ
verses.translation: The Means of Crossing the ocean of Worldly
verses.hindi: मायापाशेन बद्धानां मोचकोऽन्यो न विद्यते। मामृते परमात्मानं भूताधिपतिमव्ययम् चतुर्विशतितत्त्वानि माया कर्म गुणा इति। एते पाशा: पशुपतेः क्लेशाश्च पशुबन्धनाः
verses.wordMeaning: The Means of Crossing the ocean of Worldly
verses.commentary: Sense: The Means of Crossing the ocean of Worldly

verses.sanskrit: तथा तमसि सत्त्वे च एष एव महाद्युतिः । अनेकधा विभक्ताङ्गः क्रीडते पुरुषोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: tathā tamasi sattve ca eṣa eva mahādyutiḥ / anekadhā vibhaktāṅgaḥ krīḍate puruṣottamaḥ
verses.translation: The Means of Crossing the ocean of Worldly
verses.hindi: मनो बुद्धिरहंकारः खानिलाग्निजलानि भूः । एता प्रकृतयस्त्वष्टौ विकाराश्च तथापरे
verses.wordMeaning: The Means of Crossing the ocean of Worldly
verses.commentary: Sense: The Means of Crossing the ocean of Worldly

verses.sanskrit: महेश्वरः परो ऽव्यक्तादण्डमव्यक्तसंभवम् । अण्डाद् ब्रह्मा समुत्पन्नस्तेन सृष्टमिदं जगत्
verses.transliteration: maheśvaraḥ paro 'vyaktādaṇḍamavyaktasaṃbhavam / aṇḍād brahmā samutpannastena sṛṣṭamidaṃ jagat
verses.translation: The Means of Crossing the ocean of Worldly
verses.hindi: अनादिमध्यनिधनं कारणं जगतः परम् मैं मृगेन्द्रोंमें सिंह, यन्त्रोमें धनुष, वेदोंमें सामवेद और यजुर्मन्त्रोंमें शतरुद्रिय हूँ, मैं जपनीय सभी
verses.wordMeaning: The Means of Crossing the ocean of Worldly
verses.commentary: Sense: The Means of Crossing the ocean of Worldly

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे अष्टचत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः ऋषय ऊचुः अतीतानागतानीह यानि मन्वन्तराणि तु । तानि त्वं कथयास्माकं व्यासांश्च द्वापरे युगे
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge aṣṭacatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ṛṣaya ūcuḥ atītānāgatānīha yāni manvantarāṇi tu / tāni tvaṃ kathayāsmākaṃ vyāsāṃśca dvāpare yuge
verses.translation: The unsullied form of Siva 370
verses.hindi: सूक्तोंमें पुरुषसूक्त, साममन्त्रॉमें ज्येष्ठसाम हूँ। मैं सभी वेदके अर्थको जाननेवाले विद्वानोंमें स्वायम्भुव मनु, देशोंमें ब्रह्मावर्त और क्षेत्रोंमें अविमुक्त (वाराणसी) क्षेत्र हूँ। मैं विद्याओंमें आत्मविद्या, ज्ञानोंमें परम
verses.wordMeaning: The unsullied form of Siva 370
verses.commentary: Sense: The unsullied form of Siva 370

verses.sanskrit: वेदशाखाप्रणयनं देवदेवस्य धीमतः । तथावतारान् धर्मार्थमीशानस्य कलौ युगे
verses.transliteration: vedaśākhāpraṇayanaṃ devadevasya dhīmataḥ / tathāvatārān dharmārthamīśānasya kalau yuge
verses.translation: The form of the Supreme Brahman Siva —the
verses.hindi: ईश्वरीय ज्ञान, (पञ्च) भूतोंमें आकाश और सत्त्वोंमें मैं (बन्धनकारक) पाशोंमें माया, संहार करनेवालोंमें काल, गतियोंमें मुक्ति और उत्कृष्टोंमें परमेश्वर हूँ। इस संसारमें अन्य जो कुछ भी अधिक तेज और बलसे सम्पन्न सत्त्व पदार्थ हैं, उन सबको मेरे ही
verses.wordMeaning: The form of the Supreme Brahman Siva —the
verses.commentary: Sense: The form of the Supreme Brahman Siva —the

verses.sanskrit: कियन्तो देवदेवस्य शिष्याः कलियुगेषु वै । एतत् सर्वं समासेन सूत वक्तुमिहार्हसि
verses.transliteration: kiyanto devadevasya śiṣyāḥ kaliyugeṣu vai / etat sarvaṃ samāsena sūta vaktumihārhasi
verses.translation: The Path of liberation of the individual soul
verses.hindi: तेजसे सम्पन्न जानना चाहिए। संसारमें रहनेवाले सभी जीवोंको पशु" कहा गया है, मैं देव उनका पति (स्वामी) हूँ, इसलिये विद्दानोंद्वारा 'पशुपति' कहा जाता हूँ। मैं मायारूपी पाशके द्वारा अपनी लीलासे
verses.wordMeaning: The Path of liberation of the individual soul
verses.commentary: Sense: The Path of liberation of the individual soul

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच मनुः स्वायंभुवः पूर्वं ततः स्वारोचिषो मनुः । उत्तमस्तामसश्चैव रैवतश्चाक्षुषस्तथा
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca manuḥ svāyaṃbhuvaḥ pūrvaṃ tataḥ svārociṣo manuḥ / uttamastāmasaścaiva raivataścākṣuṣastathā
verses.translation: The Path of Action—Duties of celibate
verses.hindi: इन पशुओं (जीवों)-को बन्धनमें डालता हूँ। वेदज्ञ लोग मुझे ही पशुओंको मुक्त करनेवाला मोचक कहते हैं। मायाके पाशसे आबद्ध जीवोंको मुक्त करनेवाला मुझ भूतोंके अधिपति अव्यय परमात्माको छोड़कर अन्य कोई नहीं है
verses.wordMeaning: The Path of Action—Duties of celibate
verses.commentary: Sense: The Path of Action—Duties of celibate

verses.sanskrit: षडेते मनवो ऽतीताः सांप्रतं तु रवेः सुतः । वैवस्वतो ऽयं यस्यैतत् सप्तमं वर्तते ऽन्तरम्
verses.transliteration: ṣaḍete manavo 'tītāḥ sāṃprataṃ tu raveḥ sutaḥ / vaivasvato 'yaṃ yasyaitat saptamaṃ vartate 'ntaram
verses.translation: The Usages ofSistas. Good Conduct 395
verses.hindi: (प्रकृति-महत्-अहंकार आदि) चौबीस तत्त्व, माया, कर्म तथा गुण--ये पशुपतिके पाश और पशुओं (जीवों)- को बन्धनमें डालनेवाले क्लेश हैं। मन, बुद्धि, अहंकार, पृथ्वी, जल, तेज, वायु और आकाश--ये आठ प्रकृति
verses.wordMeaning: The Usages ofSistas. Good Conduct 395
verses.commentary: Sense: The Usages ofSistas. Good Conduct 395

verses.sanskrit: स्वायंभुवं तु कथितं कल्पादावन्तरं मया । अत ऊर्ध्वं निबोधध्वं मनोः स्वारोचिषस्य तु
verses.transliteration: svāyaṃbhuvaṃ tu kathitaṃ kalpādāvantaraṃ mayā / ata ūrdhvaṃ nibodhadhvaṃ manoḥ svārociṣasya tu
verses.translation: Duties of Brahmacarins 400
verses.hindi: हैं और दूसरे सभी पदार्थ विकार या विकृति हैं। कान, त्वचा, नेत्र, जीभ तथा पाँचवीं नासिका, गुदा, जननेन्द्रिय, हाथ, पैर तथा दसवीं इन्द्रिय वाणी और शब्द, स्पर्श, रूप, रस तथा गन्ध-ये तेईस तत्त्व प्राकृत अर्थात् प्रकृतिसे उत्पन्न होनेवाले हैं॥ २१--२४॥
verses.wordMeaning: Duties of Brahmacarins 400
verses.commentary: Sense: Duties of Brahmacarins 400

verses.sanskrit: पारावताश्च तुषिता देवाः स्वारोचिषे ऽन्तरे । विपश्चिन्नाम देवेन्द्रो बभूवासुरसूदनः
verses.transliteration: pārāvatāśca tuṣitā devāḥ svārociṣe 'ntare / vipaścinnāma devendro babhūvāsurasūdanaḥ
verses.translation: The Duties of the Householder 410
verses.hindi: चौबीसवाँ तत्त्व अव्यक्त किंवा प्रधान है, वह गुणोंसे लक्षित होनेवाला आदि, मध्य तथा अन्तसे रहित और जगतका परम कारण है। सत्त्व, रज और तम-- ये तीन गुण कहे गये हैं। इन तीनों गुणोंको साम्यावस्थाको
verses.wordMeaning: The Duties of the Householder 410
verses.commentary: Sense: The Duties of the Householder 410

verses.sanskrit: ऊर्जस्तम्भस्तथा प्राणो दान्तो ऽथ वृषभस्तथा । तिमिरश्चार्वरीवांश्च सप्त सप्तर्षयो ऽभवन्
verses.transliteration: ūrjastambhastathā prāṇo dānto 'tha vṛṣabhastathā / timiraścārvarīvāṃśca sapta saptarṣayo 'bhavan
verses.translation: The Duties of the Householder. Rules of
verses.hindi: अव्यक्त प्रकृति जानना चाहिए १-यहाँ मृत्युसे यमराज या धर्मराजको समझना चाहिए, जो प्राणिमात्रकी अन्तिम गतिके कारण एवं निर्णायक हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The Duties of the Householder. Rules of
verses.commentary: Sense: The Duties of the Householder. Rules of

verses.sanskrit: चैत्रकिंपुरुषाद्याश्च सुताः स्वारोचिषस्य तु । द्वितीयमतदाख्यातमन्तरं शृणु चोत्तरम्
verses.transliteration: caitrakiṃpuruṣādyāśca sutāḥ svārociṣasya tu / dvitīyamatadākhyātamantaraṃ śṛṇu cottaram
verses.translation: Decision about Acceptable and Prohibited Food 424
verses.hindi: २-अज्ञानसे आवृत होनेके कारण जीव पशु हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Decision about Acceptable and Prohibited Food 424
verses.commentary: Sense: Decision about Acceptable and Prohibited Food 424

verses.sanskrit: तृतीये ऽप्यन्तरे विप्रा उत्तमो नाम वै मनुः । सुशान्तिस्तत्र देवेन्द्रो बभूवामित्रकर्षणः
verses.transliteration: tṛtīye 'pyantare viprā uttamo nāma vai manuḥ / suśāntistatra devendro babhūvāmitrakarṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: Daily Duties of a Householder 430
verses.hindi: २८०  कूर्मपुराण  सत्त्वं ज्ञानं तमोऽज्ञानं रजो मिश्रमुदाहतम्। सत्त्वगुणको ज्ञानस्वरूप, तमोगुणको आज्ञानस्वरूप
verses.wordMeaning: Daily Duties of a Householder 430
verses.commentary: Sense: Daily Duties of a Householder 430

verses.sanskrit: सुधामानस्तथा सत्याः शिवाश्चाथ प्रतर्दनाः । वशवर्तिनश्च पञ्चैते गणा द्वादशकाः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: sudhāmānastathā satyāḥ śivāścātha pratardanāḥ / vaśavartinaśca pañcaite gaṇā dvādaśakāḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Daily Duties of a Householder: Mode of
verses.hindi: गुणानां बुब्द्रिवैषम्याद् वैषम्यं कवयो विदुः॥ २७॥  और रजोगुणको मिश्ररूप अर्थात् ज्ञान और अज्ञान दोनोंका मिश्रित रूप कहा गया है। बुद्धिकी विषमतासे गुणोंका भी वैषम्य होता है, ऐसा विद्वान् लोग कहते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Daily Duties of a Householder: Mode of
verses.commentary: Sense: Daily Duties of a Householder: Mode of

verses.sanskrit: रजोर्ध्वश्चोर्ध्वबाहुश्च सबलश्चानयस्तथा । सुतपाः शुक्र इत्येते सप्त सप्तर्षयो ऽभवन्
verses.transliteration: rajordhvaścordhvabāhuśca sabalaścānayastathā / sutapāḥ śukra ityete sapta saptarṣayo 'bhavan
verses.translation: Procedure of Performance of Sraddha 447
verses.hindi: धर्माधर्माविति प्रोक्तौ पाशौ द्वौ बन्धसंज्ञितो । बन्ध नामवाले दो पाशोंको धर्म और अधर्प कहा मय्यर्पितानि कर्माणि निबन्धाय विमुक्तये॥ २८॥  गया है। मुझे अर्पित किये गये कर्म बन्धनसे युक्तिके लिये होते हैं। आत्माका बन्धन करनेवाले अविद्या,
verses.wordMeaning: Procedure of Performance of Sraddha 447
verses.commentary: Sense: Procedure of Performance of Sraddha 447

verses.sanskrit: तामसस्यान्तरे देवाः सुरा वाहरयस्तथा । सत्याश्च सुधियश्चैव सप्तविंशतिका गणाः
verses.transliteration: tāmasasyāntare devāḥ surā vāharayastathā / satyāśca sudhiyaścaiva saptaviṃśatikā gaṇāḥ
verses.translation: Rules governing Sraddha 453
verses.hindi: क्लेशाख्यानचलान् प्राहुः पाशानात्मनिबन्धनान्॥ २९॥  पाँच अचल (दीर्घकालतक स्थायी-सा रहनेवाले) तत्त्वोंको पाश कहा गया है। मायाको इन (गांचों)
verses.wordMeaning: Rules governing Sraddha 453
verses.commentary: Sense: Rules governing Sraddha 453

verses.sanskrit: शिबिरिन्द्रस्तथैवासीच्छतयज्ञोपलक्षणः । बभूव शङ्करे भक्तो महादेवार्चने रतः
verses.transliteration: śibirindrastathaivāsīcchatayajñopalakṣaṇaḥ / babhūva śaṅkare bhakto mahādevārcane rataḥ
verses.translation: Rules for performance ofSraddha 460
verses.hindi: एतेषामेव पाशानां माया कारणमुच्यते। पाशोंका कारण कहा जाता है। अव्यक्त मूलप्रकृतिरूप मूलप्रकृतिरव्यक्ता सा शक्तिर्मयि तिष्ठति॥ ३०॥  शक्ति मुझमें प्रतिष्ठित रहती है
verses.wordMeaning: Rules for performance ofSraddha 460
verses.commentary: Sense: Rules for performance ofSraddha 460

verses.sanskrit: ज्योतिर्धर्मा पृथुः काव्यश्चैत्रोग्निर्वनकस्तथा । पीवरस्त्वृषयो ह्येते सप्त तत्रापि चान्तरे
verses.transliteration: jyotirdharmā pṛthuḥ kāvyaścaitrognirvanakastathā / pīvarastvṛṣayo hyete sapta tatrāpi cāntare
verses.translation: Rules regarding Impurities caused by Birth or
verses.hindi: स एव मूलप्रकृतिः प्रधानं पुरुषोऽपि च। यह मूल प्रकृति, प्रधान, पुरुष, महत्, अहंकार आदि
verses.wordMeaning: Rules regarding Impurities caused by Birth or
verses.commentary: Sense: Rules regarding Impurities caused by Birth or

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चमे चापि विप्रेन्द्रा रैवतो नाम नामतः । मनुर्वसुश्च तत्रेन्द्रो बभूवासुरमर्दनः
verses.transliteration: pañcame cāpi viprendrā raivato nāma nāmataḥ / manurvasuśca tatrendro babhūvāsuramardanaḥ
verses.translation: The Duties of Agni-hotrin 482
verses.hindi: विकारा महदादीनि देवदेवः सनातनः॥ ३१॥  विकारयुक्त तत्त्व-ये सब देवाधिदेव सनातनके ही रूप स एव बन्धः स च बन्धकर्ता हैं। यही (सनातन पुरुष) बन्धन है, यही बन्धनमें डालनेवाला स एव पाशः पशवः स एव। है। यही पाश और यही पशु है। यही सब कुछ जानता
verses.wordMeaning: The Duties of Agni-hotrin 482
verses.commentary: Sense: The Duties of Agni-hotrin 482

verses.sanskrit: अमिताभा भूतरया वैकुण्ठाः स्वच्छमेधसः । एते देवगणास्तत्र चतुर्दश चतुर्दश
verses.transliteration: amitābhā bhūtarayā vaikuṇṭhāḥ svacchamedhasaḥ / ete devagaṇāstatra caturdaśa caturdaśa
verses.translation: The Means of Livelihood of a Brahmana
verses.hindi: स वेद सर्व न च तस्य वेत्ता है, परंतु इसे जाननेवाला कोई नहीं है। इसे ही आदि
verses.wordMeaning: The Means of Livelihood of a Brahmana
verses.commentary: Sense: The Means of Livelihood of a Brahmana

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्यरोमा वेदश्रीरूर्ध्वबाहुस्तथैव च । वेदबाहुः सुधामा च पर्जन्यश्च महामुनिः । एते सप्तर्षयो विप्रास्तत्रासन् रैवते ऽन्तरे
verses.transliteration: hiraṇyaromā vedaśrīrūrdhvabāhustathaiva ca / vedabāhuḥ sudhāmā ca parjanyaśca mahāmuniḥ / ete saptarṣayo viprāstatrāsan raivate 'ntare
verses.translation: Rules of offering religious gifts 487
verses.hindi: तमाहुरग्र्यं पुरुषं पुराणम्॥ ३२॥  पुराणपुरुष कहा जाता है महेश्वरका अद्वितीय परमेश्वरके रूपमें निरूपण, सांख्य-सिद्धान्तसे तत्त्वोंका सृष्टिक्रम, महेश्वरके छः अङ्ग, महेश्वरके स्वरूपके ज्ञानसे परमपदकी प्राप्ति
verses.wordMeaning: Rules of offering religious gifts 487
verses.commentary: Sense: Rules of offering religious gifts 487

verses.sanskrit: स्वारोचिषश्चोत्तमश्च तामसो रैवतस्तथा । प्रियव्रतान्वया ह्येते चत्वारो मनवः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: svārociṣaścottamaśca tāmaso raivatastathā / priyavratānvayā hyete catvāro manavaḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Duties in Vanaprastha (Hermit's) Stage 495
verses.hindi: अन्यद् गुह्यतमं ज्ञानं वक्ष्ये ब्राह्मणपुंगवाः । ज्ञानको बताता हुँ, जिससे यह प्राणी घोर संसार-सागरको येनासौ तरते जन्तुर्घोरे संसारसागरम्॥ ९॥  पार कर लेता है
verses.wordMeaning: Duties in Vanaprastha (Hermit's) Stage 495
verses.commentary: Sense: Duties in Vanaprastha (Hermit's) Stage 495

verses.sanskrit: षष्ठे मन्वन्तरे चासीच्चाक्षुषस्तु मनुर्द्विजाः । मनोजवस्तथैवेन्द्रो देवानपि निबोधतः
verses.transliteration: ṣaṣṭhe manvantare cāsīccākṣuṣastu manurdvijāḥ / manojavastathaivendro devānapi nibodhataḥ
verses.translation: Duties of Yatis (recluses) 500
verses.hindi: अहं ब्रह्ममयः शान्तः शाश्वतो निर्मलोऽव्ययः। मैं ब्रह्ममय, शान्त, शाश्वत, निर्मल, अव्यय, एकाकी, एकाकी भगवानुक्तः केवलः परमेश्वरः॥ २॥  अद्वितीय परमेश्वर तथा भगवान् कहलाता हूँ। महद्रह्य
verses.wordMeaning: Duties of Yatis (recluses) 500
verses.commentary: Sense: Duties of Yatis (recluses) 500

verses.sanskrit: आद्याः प्रसूता भाव्याश्च पृथुगाश्च दिवौकसः । महानुभावा लेख्याश्च पञ्चैते ह्यष्टका गणाः
verses.transliteration: ādyāḥ prasūtā bhāvyāśca pṛthugāśca divaukasaḥ / mahānubhāvā lekhyāśca pañcaite hyaṣṭakā gaṇāḥ
verses.translation: Duties of an Ascetic 504
verses.hindi: मम योनिर्महद् ब्रह्म तत्र गर्भ दधाम्यहम्। मेरी योनिरूप है, मैं उसमें मूल माया नामक गर्भ धारण
verses.wordMeaning: Duties of an Ascetic 504
verses.commentary: Sense: Duties of an Ascetic 504

verses.sanskrit: सुमेधा विरजाश्चैव हविष्मानुत्तमो मधुः । अतिनामा सहिष्णुश्च सप्तासन्नृषयः शुभाः
verses.transliteration: sumedhā virajāścaiva haviṣmānuttamo madhuḥ / atināmā sahiṣṇuśca saptāsannṛṣayaḥ śubhāḥ
verses.translation: Rules of Expiation 509
verses.hindi: । मायाभिधानं तु ततो जातमिदं जगत् करता हूँ और उससे यह संसार उत्पन्न हुआ है। मूलं मायाभिधानं तु द ण्य (उसीसे) प्रधान, पुरुष, आत्मा, महत्तत्त्व, भूतादि प्रधानं पुरुषो ह्यात्मा महान् भूतादिरिव च । (तामस अहंकार), तन्मात्राएँ, पञ्चमहाभूत तथा इन्द्रिय
verses.wordMeaning: Rules of Expiation 509
verses.commentary: Sense: Rules of Expiation 509

verses.sanskrit: विवस्वतः सुतो विप्राः श्राद्धदेवो महाद्युतिः । मनुः स वर्तते धीमान् सांप्रतं सप्तमे ऽन्तरे
verses.transliteration: vivasvataḥ suto viprāḥ śrāddhadevo mahādyutiḥ / manuḥ sa vartate dhīmān sāṃprataṃ saptame 'ntare
verses.translation: Importance of Kapala-mocana Tirtha 512
verses.hindi: + यहाँ बन्धन आदिको सनातनपुरुषमें कल्पितमात्र बताकर अद्हैतभावकी प्रतिष्ठा की गयी है।
verses.wordMeaning: Importance of Kapala-mocana Tirtha 512
verses.commentary: Sense: Importance of Kapala-mocana Tirtha 512

verses.sanskrit: आदित्या वसवो रुद्रा देवास्तत्र मरुद्गणाः । पुरन्दरस्तथैवेन्द्रो बभूव परवीरहा
verses.transliteration: ādityā vasavo rudrā devāstatra marudgaṇāḥ / purandarastathaivendro babhūva paravīrahā
verses.translation: Expiatory rites 522
verses.hindi: ततोऽण्डमभवद्धैमं सूर्यकोटिसमप्रभम्। तस्मिन् जज्ञे महाब्रह्मा मच्छक्त्या चोपबंहितः स धीरः सर्वलोकेषु न मोहमधिगच्छति
verses.wordMeaning: Expiatory rites 522
verses.commentary: Sense: Expiatory rites 522

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठः कश्यपश्चात्रिर्जमदग्निश्च गौतमः । विश्वामित्रो भरद्वाजः सप्त सप्तर्षयो ऽभवन्
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭhaḥ kaśyapaścātrirjamadagniśca gautamaḥ / viśvāmitro bharadvājaḥ sapta saptarṣayo 'bhavan
verses.translation: Expiatory rites (continued) 524
verses.hindi: ओङ्कारमूर्तिर्भगवानहं ब्रह्मा प्रजापतिः
verses.wordMeaning: Expiatory rites (continued) 524
verses.commentary: Sense: Expiatory rites (continued) 524

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुशक्तिरनौपम्या सत्त्वोद्रिक्ता स्थिता स्थितौ । तदंशभूता राजानः सर्वे च त्रिदिवौकसः
verses.transliteration: viṣṇuśaktiranaupamyā sattvodriktā sthitā sthitau / tadaṃśabhūtā rājānaḥ sarve ca tridivaukasaḥ
verses.translation: Expiatory rites (continued) 529
verses.hindi: प्रधानविनियोगज्ञः परं ब्रह्माधिगच्छति १२॥ बू सप्त तत्त्वात्मकानि।
verses.wordMeaning: Expiatory rites (continued) 529
verses.commentary: Sense: Expiatory rites (continued) 529

verses.sanskrit: स्वायंभुवे ऽन्तरे पूर्वमाकूत्यां मानसः सुतः । रुचेः प्रजापतेर्यज्ञस्तदंशेनाभवद् द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: svāyaṃbhuve 'ntare pūrvamākūtyāṃ mānasaḥ sutaḥ / ruceḥ prajāpateryajñastadaṃśenābhavad dvijāḥ
verses.translation: Greatness of Gaya and other sacred places 544
verses.hindi: वेदेषूक्ता कारणं ब्रह्मयोनिः।
verses.wordMeaning: Greatness of Gaya and other sacred places 544
verses.commentary: Sense: Greatness of Gaya and other sacred places 544

verses.sanskrit: ततः पुनरसौ देवः प्राप्ते स्वारोचिषे ऽन्तरे । तुषितायां समुत्पन्नस्तुषितैः सह दैवतैः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ punarasau devaḥ prāpte svārociṣe 'ntare / tuṣitāyāṃ samutpannastuṣitaiḥ saha daivataiḥ
verses.translation: Glory of Sacred Places; the death of Kali 551
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मा योगी परमात्मा महीयान् व्योमव्यापी वेदवेद्यः पुराणः। एको रुद्रो मृत्युरव्यक्तमेकं बीजं विश्वं देव एकः स एव तदनन्तर करोडौं सूर्यके समान प्रकाशमान हिरण्मय अण्ड उत्पन्न हुआ। उस अण्डमें मेरी शक्तिसे उपबृंहित महाब्रह्मा उत्पन्न हुए। अन्य भी जो बहुतसे प्राणी हैं, वे सभी मेरे ही स्वरूप हैं। मेरी मायासे मोहित होनेके
verses.wordMeaning: Glory of Sacred Places; the death of Kali 551
verses.commentary: Sense: Glory of Sacred Places; the death of Kali 551

verses.sanskrit: औत्तमे ऽप्यन्तरे विष्णुः सत्यैः सह सुरोत्तमैः । सत्यायामभवत् सत्यः सत्यरूपो जनार्दनः
verses.transliteration: auttame 'pyantare viṣṇuḥ satyaiḥ saha surottamaiḥ / satyāyāmabhavat satyaḥ satyarūpo janārdanaḥ
verses.translation: Glory of Mahalaya and other holy centres 555
verses.hindi: कारण वे पितामह-स्वरूपको नहीं देख पाते। सभी योनियोंमें जो मूर्तियाँ उत्पन्न होती हैं, उनकी योनि परा माया है और मुझे ही पितृस्वरूप विद्वान् लोग जानते हैं। इस प्रकार जो मुझे ही बीजरूप पितृस्वरूप
verses.wordMeaning: Glory of Mahalaya and other holy centres 555
verses.commentary: Sense: Glory of Mahalaya and other holy centres 555

verses.sanskrit: तामसस्यान्तरे चैव संप्राप्ते पुनरेव हि । हर्यायां हरिभिर्देवैर्हरिरेवाभवद्धरिः
verses.transliteration: tāmasasyāntare caiva saṃprāpte punareva hi / haryāyāṃ haribhirdevairharirevābhavaddhariḥ
verses.translation: The Description of Daruvana 562
verses.hindi: प्रभु जानता है, वह सभी लोकोंमें धीर होता है और मोहको प्राप्त नहीं होता ॥ ५--८ ॥ मैं ही सभी विद्याओंका स्वामी, प्राणियोंका परम ईश्वर, ओङ्कारमूर्ति, प्रजापति भगवान् ब्रह्मा हूँ । जो पुरुष विनष्ट होनेवाले सभी (चराचर) भूतोंमें परमेश्वरको नाशरहित और समभावसे देखता है, बही यथार्थ देखता
verses.wordMeaning: The Description of Daruvana 562
verses.commentary: Sense: The Description of Daruvana 562

verses.sanskrit: रैवते ऽप्यन्तरे चैव संभूत्यां मानसो ऽभवत् । संभूतो मानसैः सार्धं देवैः सह महाद्युतिः
verses.transliteration: raivate 'pyantare caiva saṃbhūtyāṃ mānaso 'bhavat / saṃbhūto mānasaiḥ sārdhaṃ devaiḥ saha mahādyutiḥ
verses.translation: The Entry into the forest of Devadaru 570
verses.hindi: है। जो पुरुष सबमें समभावसे स्थित परमेश्वरको समानरूपसे देखता है, वह स्वयंद्वारा स्वयंको नष्ट नहीं करता; इस कारण वह परम गति प्राप्त करता है। सात सूक्ष्म तत्त्वों एवं छः अआङ्गोंवाले महेशवरको जानकर
verses.wordMeaning: The Entry into the forest of Devadaru 570
verses.commentary: Sense: The Entry into the forest of Devadaru 570

verses.sanskrit: चाक्षुषे ऽप्यन्तरे चैव वैकुण्ठः पुरुषोत्तमः । विकुण्ठायामसौ जज्ञे वैकुण्ठैर्दैवतैः सह
verses.transliteration: cākṣuṣe 'pyantare caiva vaikuṇṭhaḥ puruṣottamaḥ / vikuṇṭhāyāmasau jajñe vaikuṇṭhairdaivataiḥ saha
verses.translation: The Glory of Narmada 577
verses.hindi: प्रधान तथा विनियोगको जाननेवाला परम ब्रह्मको प्राप्त करता है अलुप्त-शक्ति तथा अनन्तशक्ति-ये विभु महेश्वरके छः अङ्ग कहे गये हैं। पाँच तन्मात्राएँ (शब्द, स्पर्श, रूप,
verses.wordMeaning: The Glory of Narmada 577
verses.commentary: Sense: The Glory of Narmada 577

verses.sanskrit: मन्वन्तरे ऽत्र संप्राप्ते तथा वैवस्वते ऽन्तरे । वामनः कश्यपाद् विष्णुरदित्यां संबभूव ह
verses.transliteration: manvantare 'tra saṃprāpte tathā vaivasvate 'ntare / vāmanaḥ kaśyapād viṣṇuradityāṃ saṃbabhūva ha
verses.translation: Glory of different sacred places on the Narmada
verses.hindi: तत्त्व कहे गये हैं। जो हेतुरूपा प्रकृति है, वह प्रधान है और उससे होनेवाले बन्धनको ही विनियोग कहा जाता है। प्रकृतिमें लीन रहनेवाली जो शक्ति है, उसे वेदोंमें ब्रह्मयोनि और कारणरूप कहा गया है।
verses.wordMeaning: Glory of different sacred places on the Narmada
verses.commentary: Sense: Glory of different sacred places on the Narmada

verses.sanskrit: त्रिभिः क्रमैरिमांल्लोकाञ्जित्वा येन महात्मना । पुरन्दराय त्रैलोक्यं दत्तं निहतकण्टकम्
verses.transliteration: tribhiḥ kramairimāṃllokāñjitvā yena mahātmanā / purandarāya trailokyaṃ dattaṃ nihatakaṇṭakam
verses.translation: Greatness of holy centres on the Narmada
verses.hindi: अद्वितीय, परमेष्ठी, परात्पर, सत्यरूप महेश्वर उसके पुरुष हैं॥ १३--१५॥ वे ही अद्वितीय देव ब्रह्मा, योगी, परमात्मा, महीयान्, व्योमव्यापी, वेदोंद्वारा ज्ञात होने योग्य, पुराण,
verses.wordMeaning: Greatness of holy centres on the Narmada
verses.commentary: Sense: Greatness of holy centres on the Narmada

verses.sanskrit: इत्येतास्तनवस्तस्य सप्त मन्वन्तरेषु वै । सप्त चैवाभवन् विप्रा याभिः संरक्षिताः प्रजाः
verses.transliteration: ityetāstanavastasya sapta manvantareṣu vai / sapta caivābhavan viprā yābhiḥ saṃrakṣitāḥ prajāḥ
verses.translation: Greatness of Naimisaranya and Japyesvara 596
verses.hindi: त्वेकात्मानं केचिदन्यत्तथाहुः!
verses.wordMeaning: Greatness of Naimisaranya and Japyesvara 596
verses.commentary: Sense: Greatness of Naimisaranya and Japyesvara 596

verses.sanskrit: यस्माद् विष्टमिदं कृत्स्नं वामनेन महात्मना । तस्मात् स वै स्मृतो विष्णुर्विशेर्धातोः प्रवेशनात्
verses.transliteration: yasmād viṣṭamidaṃ kṛtsnaṃ vāmanena mahātmanā / tasmāt sa vai smṛto viṣṇurviśerdhātoḥ praveśanāt
verses.translation: Description of sacred places (continued) 599
verses.hindi: महादेवः प्रोच्यते वेदविद्भिः प्रभुं पुराणं पुरुषं विश्वरूपम्।
verses.wordMeaning: Description of sacred places (continued) 599
verses.commentary: Sense: Description of sacred places (continued) 599

verses.sanskrit: एष सर्वं सृजत्यादौ पाति हन्ति च केशवः । भूतान्तरात्मा भगवान् नारायण इति श्रुतिः
verses.transliteration: eṣa sarvaṃ sṛjatyādau pāti hanti ca keśavaḥ / bhūtāntarātmā bhagavān nārāyaṇa iti śrutiḥ
verses.translation: Description of four types of Dissolution 602
verses.hindi: उन्हें ही कोई एक और कोई अनेक कहते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Description of four types of Dissolution 602
verses.commentary: Sense: Description of four types of Dissolution 602

verses.sanskrit: एकांशेन जगत् सर्वं व्याप्य नारायणः स्थितः । चतुर्धा संस्थितो व्यापी सगुणो निर्गुणो ऽपि च
verses.transliteration: ekāṃśena jagat sarvaṃ vyāpya nārāyaṇaḥ sthitaḥ / caturdhā saṃsthito vyāpī saguṇo nirguṇo 'pi ca
verses.translation: Description of four types of Dissolution 602
verses.hindi: दूसरे कुछ लोग उन्हें ही अद्वितीय आत्मा कहते हैं! वेदज्ञ लोग उन्हें अणुसे अणुतर और महानूसे भी महत्तर महादेव कहते हैं। हृदयरूप गुहामें स्थित, परात्पर, पुराणपुरुष, विश्वरूप, हिरण्मय और बुद्धिमानोंको परमगति प्रभुको जो इस प्रकार जानता है, वह बुद्धिमान् पुरुष बुद्धिको पार कर जाता है अर्थात् परमपद प्राप्त
verses.wordMeaning: Description of four types of Dissolution 602
verses.commentary: Sense: Description of four types of Dissolution 602

verses.sanskrit: एका भगवतो मूर्तिर्ज्ञानरूपा शिवामला । वासुदेवाभिधाना सा गुणातीता सुनिष्कला
verses.transliteration: ekā bhagavato mūrtirjñānarūpā śivāmalā / vāsudevābhidhānā sā guṇātītā suniṣkalā
verses.translation: Description of four types of Dissolution 602
verses.hindi: स बुद्धिमान् बुद्द्रिमतीत्य तिष्ठति॥ १८॥  करता है
verses.wordMeaning: Description of four types of Dissolution 602
verses.commentary: Sense: Description of four types of Dissolution 602

verses.sanskrit: द्वितीया कालसंज्ञान्या तामसी शेषसंज्ञिता । निहन्ति सकलं चान्ते वैष्णवी परमा तनुः
verses.transliteration: dvitīyā kālasaṃjñānyā tāmasī śeṣasaṃjñitā / nihanti sakalaṃ cānte vaiṣṇavī paramā tanuḥ
verses.translation: Description of four types of Dissolution 602
verses.hindi: महादेवके विश्वरूपत्वका वर्णन तथा ईश्वर-सम्बन्धी ज्ञानका प्रतिपादन तन्नो बद महादेव विश्वरूपः कथं भवान्
verses.wordMeaning: Description of four types of Dissolution 602
verses.commentary: Sense: Description of four types of Dissolution 602

verses.sanskrit: सत्त्वोद्रिक्ता तथैवान्या प्रद्युम्नेति च संज्ञिता । जगत् स्थापयते सर्वं स विष्णुः प्रकृतिर्ध्रुवा
verses.transliteration: sattvodriktā tathaivānyā pradyumneti ca saṃjñitā / jagat sthāpayate sarvaṃ sa viṣṇuḥ prakṛtirdhruvā
verses.translation: Description of four types of Dissolution 602
verses.hindi: अव्यक्तं कारणं प्राहुरानन्दं ज्योतिरक्षरम्। अहमेव परं ब्रह्म मत्तो ह्यान्यन्न विद्यते
verses.wordMeaning: Description of four types of Dissolution 602
verses.commentary: Sense: Description of four types of Dissolution 602

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्थो वासुदेवस्य मूर्तिर्ब्राह्मीति संज्ञिता । राजसी चानिरुद्धाख्या प्रद्युम्नः सृष्टिकारिका
verses.transliteration: caturtho vāsudevasya mūrtirbrāhmīti saṃjñitā / rājasī cāniruddhākhyā pradyumnaḥ sṛṣṭikārikā
verses.translation: Description of four types of Dissolution 602
verses.hindi: तस्मान्मे विश्वरूपत्वं निश्चितं ब्रह्मवादिभिः । एकत्वे च पृथक्त्वे च प्रोक्तमेतन्निदर्शनम् अहँ तत् परमं ब्रह्म परमात्मा सनातनः । अकारणं द्विजाः प्रोक्तो न दोषो ह्यात्मनस्तथा
verses.wordMeaning: Description of four types of Dissolution 602
verses.commentary: Sense: Description of four types of Dissolution 602

verses.sanskrit: यः स्वपित्यखिलं भूत्वा प्रद्युम्नेन सह प्रभुः । नारायणाख्यो ब्रह्मासौ प्रिजासर्गं करोति सः
verses.transliteration: yaḥ svapityakhilaṃ bhūtvā pradyumnena saha prabhuḥ / nārāyaṇākhyo brahmāsau prijāsargaṃ karoti saḥ
verses.translation: Description of four types of Dissolution 602
verses.hindi: ऋषियोंने पूछा- महादेव! आप परमेश्वर निष्कल, निर्मल, नित्य तथा निष्क्रिय होनेपर भी विश्वरूप कैसे हैं, इसे हम लोगोंको बतलायें
verses.wordMeaning: Description of four types of Dissolution 602
verses.commentary: Sense: Description of four types of Dissolution 602

verses.sanskrit: या सा नारायणतनुः प्रद्युम्नाख्या मुनीश्वराः । तया संमोहयेद् विश्वं सदेवासुरमानुषम्
verses.transliteration: yā sā nārāyaṇatanuḥ pradyumnākhyā munīśvarāḥ / tayā saṃmohayed viśvaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣam
verses.translation: Description of four types of Dissolution 602
verses.hindi: ईश्वर बोले--द्विजो! मैं विश्व नहीं हूँ और मुझसे अतिरिक्त विश्व भी नहीं है। यह सब मायाके निमित्तसे है और वह माया भी आत्माको आश्रित कर रहती है। आदि और अन्तसे रहित शक्तिरूप माया अव्यक्त (परमात्मा)-के आश्रित है, उसी (माया)-के कारण अव्यक्तसे यह प्रपञ्चरूप संसार उत्पन्न हुआ है। (मुझ) अव्यक्तको कारण कहा जाता है। मैं ही आनन्दस्वरूप, प्रकाशरूप, अक्षर परम ब्रह्म हूँ। मुझसे अतिरिक्त और
verses.wordMeaning: Description of four types of Dissolution 602
verses.commentary: Sense: Description of four types of Dissolution 602

verses.sanskrit: सैव सर्वजगत्सूतिः प्रकृतिः परिकीर्तिता । वासुदेवो ह्यनन्तात्मा केवलो निर्गुणो हरिः
verses.transliteration: saiva sarvajagatsūtiḥ prakṛtiḥ parikīrtitā / vāsudevo hyanantātmā kevalo nirguṇo hariḥ
verses.translation: Description of four types of Dissolution 602
verses.hindi: कुछ भी नहीं है। इसी कारण ब्रह्मवादियोंने मेरा विश्वरूपत्व निश्चित किया है। एक रूप तथा भिन्नरूपके
verses.wordMeaning: Description of four types of Dissolution 602
verses.commentary: Sense: Description of four types of Dissolution 602

verses.sanskrit: प्रधानं पुरुषः कालस्तत्त्वत्रयमनुत्तमम् । वासुदेवात्मकं नित्यमेतद् विज्ञाय मुच्यते
verses.transliteration: pradhānaṃ puruṣaḥ kālastattvatrayamanuttamam / vāsudevātmakaṃ nityametad vijñāya mucyate
verses.translation: Description of four types of Dissolution 602
verses.hindi: मैं कारणरहित, सनातन, परम ब्रह्म परमात्मा हूँ, अत: मुझमें कोई दोष नहीं है। तात्पर्य यह है कि जगतूमें विषमता, क्रूरता आदि दोषोंका असाधारण कारण मनुष्यकृत कर्म है, ईश्वर नहीं। ईश्वर तो सामान्य कारण है, अतः वह दोषरहित है॥ २--६॥
verses.wordMeaning: Description of four types of Dissolution 602
verses.commentary: Sense: Description of four types of Dissolution 602

verses.sanskrit: एकं चेदं चतुष्पादं चतुर्धा पुनरच्युतः । बिभेद वासुदेवो ऽसौ प्रद्युम्नो हरिरव्ययः
verses.transliteration: ekaṃ cedaṃ catuṣpādaṃ caturdhā punaracyutaḥ / bibheda vāsudevo 'sau pradyumno hariravyayaḥ
verses.translation: Description of four types of Dissolution 602
verses.hindi: + विवर्त विश्वकी दृष्टिसे महादेव अनेक रूप हैं तथा परमार्थत: एक होनेसे एक रूप हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Description of four types of Dissolution 602
verses.commentary: Sense: Description of four types of Dissolution 602

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णद्वैपायनो व्यासो विष्णुर्नारायणः स्वयम् । अपान्तरतमाः पूर्वं स्वेच्छया ह्यभवद्धरिः
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇadvaipāyano vyāso viṣṇurnārāyaṇaḥ svayam / apāntaratamāḥ pūrvaṃ svecchayā hyabhavaddhariḥ
verses.translation: Description of four types of Dissolution 602
verses.hindi: तस्मिन् दिवि स्थितं नित्यमव्यक्तं भाति केवलम् तदेव च जगत् कृत्स्नं तद् विज्ञाय विमुच्यते
verses.wordMeaning: Description of four types of Dissolution 602
verses.commentary: Sense: Description of four types of Dissolution 602

verses.sanskrit: अनाद्यन्तं परं ब्रह्म न देवा नर्षयो विदुः । एको ऽयं वेद भगवान् व्यासो नारायणः प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: anādyantaṃ paraṃ brahma na devā narṣayo viduḥ / eko 'yaṃ veda bhagavān vyāso nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ
verses.translation: Description of four types of Dissolution 602
verses.hindi: आनन्दं ब्रह्मणो विद्वान् बिभेति न कुतश्चन
verses.wordMeaning: Description of four types of Dissolution 602
verses.commentary: Sense: Description of four types of Dissolution 602

verses.sanskrit: इत्येतद् विष्णुमाहात्म्यमुक्तं वो मुनिपुङ्गवाः । एतत् सत्यं पुनः सत्यमेवं ज्ञात्वा न मुह्यति
verses.transliteration: ityetad viṣṇumāhātmyamuktaṃ vo munipuṅgavāḥ / etat satyaṃ punaḥ satyamevaṃ jñātvā na muhyati
verses.translation: Description of four types of Dissolution 602
verses.hindi: नित्यानन्दी भवति ब्रह्मभूतः तदेवात्मानं मन्यमानोऽथ विद्वा-
verses.wordMeaning: Description of four types of Dissolution 602
verses.commentary: Sense: Description of four types of Dissolution 602

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे एकोनपञ्चाशो ऽध्यायः सूत उवाच अस्मिन् मन्वन्तरे पूर्वं वर्तमाने महान् विभुः । द्वापरे प्रथमे व्यासो मनुः स्वायंभुवो मतः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge ekonapañcāśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca asmin manvantare pūrvaṃ vartamāne mahān vibhuḥ / dvāpare prathame vyāso manuḥ svāyaṃbhuvo mataḥ
verses.translation: Dissolution of subsidiary creation 608
verses.hindi: नात्मानन्दी भवति ब्रह्मभूतः
verses.wordMeaning: Dissolution of subsidiary creation 608
verses.commentary: Sense: Dissolution of subsidiary creation 608

verses.sanskrit: बिभेद बहुधा वेदं नियोगाद् ब्रह्मणः प्रभोः । द्वितीये द्वापरे चैव वेदव्यासः प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: bibheda bahudhā vedaṃ niyogād brahmaṇaḥ prabhoḥ / dvitīye dvāpare caiva vedavyāsaḥ prajāpatiḥ
verses.translation: This uninvited entry of Siva is a fuse to Pasupatise this text.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मानन्दममृतं वदन्त्येवं ब्राह्मणा ब्रह्मनिष्ठा हिरण्मये परमाकाशतत्त्वे
verses.wordMeaning: This uninvited entry of Siva is a fuse to Pasupatise this text.
verses.commentary: Sense: This uninvited entry of Siva is a fuse to Pasupatise this text.

verses.sanskrit: तृतीये चोशना व्यासश्चतुर्थे स्याद् बृहस्पतिः । सविता पञ्चमे व्यासः षष्ठे मृत्युः प्रकीर्तितः
verses.transliteration: tṛtīye cośanā vyāsaścaturthe syād bṛhaspatiḥ / savitā pañcame vyāsaḥ ṣaṣṭhe mṛtyuḥ prakīrtitaḥ
verses.translation: It has been mentioned by you in that connection that the Lord of Lords, the Supreme god, should be propitiated by persons of all castes who are exclusively devoted to Dharma and are always engaged in the paths of knowledge and Yoga.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मानन्दी भगवानीश एषः
verses.wordMeaning: It has been mentioned by you in that connection that the Lord of Lords, the Supreme god, should be propitiated by persons of all castes who are exclusively devoted to Dharma and are always engaged in the paths of knowledge and Yoga.
verses.commentary: Sense: It has been mentioned by you in that connection that the Lord of Lords, the Supreme god, should be propitiated by persons of all castes who are exclusively devoted to Dharma and are always engaged in the paths of knowledge and Yoga.

verses.sanskrit: सप्तमे च तथैवेन्द्रो वसिष्ठश्चाष्टमे मतः । सारस्वतश्च नवमे त्रिधामा दशमे स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: saptame ca tathaivendro vasiṣṭhaścāṣṭame mataḥ / sārasvataśca navame tridhāmā daśame smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: You have expounded to us the excellent knowledge which has Brahman as its only object and which leads to the complete annihilation of all the miseries of Saihsara (worldly existence) and where-with we can perceive that Supreme Brahman.
verses.hindi: अव्यक्तमें ही माया आदि अनन्त ध्रुव शक्तियाँ प्रतिष्ठित हैं और वह अव्यक्त अकेले ही विशुद्ध शब्दतन्मात्रारूप आकाशतत्त्वमें स्थित रहते हुए सदा प्रकाशित रहता है। स्वभावतः वह अभिन्न (अव्यक्त) तत्त्व जिनके द्वारा अनेक रूपोंमें प्रतिभासित होता है, उनकी मूल एक (परम) शक्तिसे आदि और अन्तरहित मेरा धुव सायुज्य प्राप्त होता है। पुरुषको दूसरी शक्तिसे भूति (ऐश्वर्य)-की उत्पत्ति तथा अन्य शक्तिसे उसका
verses.wordMeaning: You have expounded to us the excellent knowledge which has Brahman as its only object and which leads to the complete annihilation of all the miseries of Saihsara (worldly existence) and where-with we can perceive that Supreme Brahman.
verses.commentary: Sense: You have expounded to us the excellent knowledge which has Brahman as its only object and which leads to the complete annihilation of all the miseries of Saihsara (worldly existence) and where-with we can perceive that Supreme Brahman.

verses.sanskrit: एकादशे तु त्रिवृषः शततेजास्ततः परः । त्रयोदशे तथा धर्मस्तरक्षुस्तु चतुर्दशे
verses.transliteration: ekādaśe tu trivṛṣaḥ śatatejāstataḥ paraḥ / trayodaśe tathā dharmastarakṣustu caturdaśe
verses.translation: O holy lord, indeed you have acquired the entire perfect wisdom from Krsna Dvaipayana who is Narayana him¬ self. Hence we ask you again.
verses.hindi: (भूतिका) लोप होता है। आदि एवं मध्यरहित सर्वत्र विद्यमान (पुरुष) ही अविद्यासे (स्वेच्छया) युक्त होता हैं। प्रभामण्डलसे मण्डित वह परम व्यक्त, अक्षर, परम ज्योतिरूप है और वह विष्णुका परमपद है। उसमें
verses.wordMeaning: O holy lord, indeed you have acquired the entire perfect wisdom from Krsna Dvaipayana who is Narayana him¬ self. Hence we ask you again.
verses.commentary: Sense: O holy lord, indeed you have acquired the entire perfect wisdom from Krsna Dvaipayana who is Narayana him¬ self. Hence we ask you again.

verses.sanskrit: त्र्यारुणिर्वै पञ्चदशे षोडशे तु धनञ्जयः । कृतञ्जयः सप्तदशे ह्यष्टादशे ऋतञ्जयः
verses.transliteration: tryāruṇirvai pañcadaśe ṣoḍaśe tu dhanañjayaḥ / kṛtañjayaḥ saptadaśe hyaṣṭādaśe ṛtañjayaḥ
verses.translation: In the meanwhile, at that juncture, Vyasa, Krsna Dvaipayana, himself, arrived there where the excellent sages were performing the satra (sacrificial session).
verses.hindi: ही यह सारा जगत् ओतप्रोत है। वही सम्पूर्ण जगत् है। उसे जान लेनेसे मुक्ति प्राप्त हो जाती है मनके साथ वाणी जिसे न पाकर लौट आती हैं उस आनन्दस्वरूप ब्रह्माको जाननेवाला कहीं भयभीत नहीं होता। में इस तमोगुणसे परे आदित्यके समान वर्णवाले अर्थात् प्रकाशयुक्त महान् पुरुषको जानता हूँ,
verses.wordMeaning: In the meanwhile, at that juncture, Vyasa, Krsna Dvaipayana, himself, arrived there where the excellent sages were performing the satra (sacrificial session).
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meanwhile, at that juncture, Vyasa, Krsna Dvaipayana, himself, arrived there where the excellent sages were performing the satra (sacrificial session).

verses.sanskrit: ततो व्यासो भरद्वाजस्तस्मादूर्ध्वं तु गौतमः । राजश्रवाश्चैकविंशस्तस्माच्छुष्मायणः परः
verses.transliteration: tato vyāso bharadvājastasmādūrdhvaṃ tu gautamaḥ / rājaśravāścaikaviṃśastasmācchuṣmāyaṇaḥ paraḥ
verses.translation: On seeing Vyasa tyho was a deep scholar of the Vedas, whose lustre was like that of a black cloud and whose eyes
verses.hindi: इसे जानकर विद्वान् मुक्त हो जाता है और नित्य आनन्दस्वरूप तथा ब्रह्ममय हो जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing Vyasa tyho was a deep scholar of the Vedas, whose lustre was like that of a black cloud and whose eyes
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing Vyasa tyho was a deep scholar of the Vedas, whose lustre was like that of a black cloud and whose eyes

verses.sanskrit: तृणबिन्दुस्त्रयोविंशे वाल्मीकिस्तत्परः स्मृतः । पञ्चविशे तथा शक्तिः षड्विंशे तु पराशरः
verses.transliteration: tṛṇabindustrayoviṃśe vālmīkistatparaḥ smṛtaḥ / pañcaviśe tathā śaktiḥ ṣaḍviṃśe tu parāśaraḥ
verses.translation: On seeing him, Lomaharsana fell on the ground like a staff. After bending down the head, he dedicated himself unto him {v.l. circumambulated Vyasa and sat by his side) with the palms joined in reverence.
verses.hindi: जिससे परे और भिन्न कुछ भी नहीं है और जो द्युलोकमें स्थित सभी ज्योतियोंका एकमात्र प्रकाशक है, उसीको आत्मा माननेवाला विद्वान् नित्य आनन्द- स्वरूप ब्रह्ममय हो जाता हैं। ब्रह्मनिष्ठ ब्राह्मण उसे अविनाशी, कलिल, गूढदेह, ब्रह्मानन्द, अमृत तथा विश्वधाम कहते हैं। वहाँ पहुँचनेपर फिर लौटना नहीं पड़ता
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing him, Lomaharsana fell on the ground like a staff. After bending down the head, he dedicated himself unto him {v.l. circumambulated Vyasa and sat by his side) with the palms joined in reverence.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing him, Lomaharsana fell on the ground like a staff. After bending down the head, he dedicated himself unto him {v.l. circumambulated Vyasa and sat by his side) with the palms joined in reverence.

verses.sanskrit: सप्तविंशे तथा व्यासो जातूकर्णो महामुनिः । अष्टाविंशे पुनः प्राप्ते ह्यस्मिन् वै द्वापरे द्विजाः । पराशरसुतो व्यासः कृष्णद्वैपायनो ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: saptaviṃśe tathā vyāso jātūkarṇo mahāmuniḥ / aṣṭāviṃśe punaḥ prāpte hyasmin vai dvāpare dvijāḥ / parāśarasuto vyāsaḥ kṛṣṇadvaipāyano 'bhavat
verses.translation: Saunaka and other Brahmanas were duly enquired after their health. T1 ereupon they assured the great sage (about their health) and offered him a befitting seat.
verses.hindi: हिरण्मय प्रकाशयुक्त परम आकाशतत्त्वमें जो तेजके समान प्रतिभासित होता है, धीर जन (आत्मस्थ) विज्ञानमें उस प्रकाशमान निर्मल व्योम (ब्रह्म) एवं धाम (परम प्राप्तव्य)-का दर्शन करते हैं। तदनन्तर
verses.wordMeaning: Saunaka and other Brahmanas were duly enquired after their health. T1 ereupon they assured the great sage (about their health) and offered him a befitting seat.
verses.commentary: Sense: Saunaka and other Brahmanas were duly enquired after their health. T1 ereupon they assured the great sage (about their health) and offered him a befitting seat.

verses.sanskrit: स एव सर्ववेदानां पुराणानां प्रदर्शकः । पाराशर्यो महायोगी कृष्णद्वैपायनो हरिः
verses.transliteration: sa eva sarvavedānāṃ purāṇānāṃ pradarśakaḥ / pārāśaryo mahāyogī kṛṣṇadvaipāyano hariḥ
verses.translation: Then the holy lord, the son of Parasara, addressed these words to them, "I hope there is no deficiency or difficulty in your penance, in your learning and in your practice of the self-study of the Vedas".
verses.hindi: अपने आत्मामें आत्माका बार-बार अनुभव करके धीर पुरुष परम तत्त्वका दर्शन करते हैं और उन्हें यह ज्ञान होता है-यही (आत्मतत्त्व) स्वयं प्रकाशमान, परमेष्ठी, महान् ब्रह्मानन्दस्वरूप भगवान् ईशके रूपमें एको देवः सर्वभूतेषु गूढ:
verses.wordMeaning: Then the holy lord, the son of Parasara, addressed these words to them, "I hope there is no deficiency or difficulty in your penance, in your learning and in your practice of the self-study of the Vedas".
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the holy lord, the son of Parasara, addressed these words to them, "I hope there is no deficiency or difficulty in your penance, in your learning and in your practice of the self-study of the Vedas".

verses.sanskrit: आराध्य देवमीशानं दृष्ट्वा साम्बं त्रिलोचनम् । तत्प्रसादादसौ व्यासं वेदानामकरोत् प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: ārādhya devamīśānaṃ dṛṣṭvā sāmbaṃ trilocanam / tatprasādādasau vyāsaṃ vedānāmakarot prabhuḥ
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Suta, the saintly son of Satyavati, bowed down his head to Rudra and spoke these pleasing words of discourse.
verses.hindi: सर्वव्यापी च भगवान् न तस्मादन्यदिष्यते
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the words of Suta, the saintly son of Satyavati, bowed down his head to Rudra and spoke these pleasing words of discourse.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of Suta, the saintly son of Satyavati, bowed down his head to Rudra and spoke these pleasing words of discourse.

verses.sanskrit: अथ शिष्यान् प्रिजग्राह चतुरो वेदपारगान् । जैमिनिं च सुमन्तुं च वैशम्पायनमेव च । पैलं तेषां चतुर्थं च पञ्चमं मां महामुनिः
verses.transliteration: atha śiṣyān prijagrāha caturo vedapāragān / jaiminiṃ ca sumantuṃ ca vaiśampāyanameva ca / pailaṃ teṣāṃ caturthaṃ ca pañcamaṃ māṃ mahāmuniḥ
verses.translation: I shall now narrate to you what formerly Lord Mahadeva was asked by the leading Yogins, the chief of whom was Sanatkumara and what hehimsalfhas expounded it.
verses.hindi: इत्येतहैश्वरं ज्ञानमुक्तं वो मुनिपुंगवाः । सभी प्राणियोंके अन्तरात्मा, सर्वव्यापी एक देव ही सभी प्राणियोंमें छिपे हुए हैं। जो धीर पुरुष उन एक अद्वितीयका दर्शन करते हैं, उन्हें ही शाश्वत शान्ति प्रात होती है, दूसरोंको नहीं। वे भगवान् सभी ओर
verses.wordMeaning: I shall now narrate to you what formerly Lord Mahadeva was asked by the leading Yogins, the chief of whom was Sanatkumara and what hehimsalfhas expounded it.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall now narrate to you what formerly Lord Mahadeva was asked by the leading Yogins, the chief of whom was Sanatkumara and what hehimsalfhas expounded it.

verses.sanskrit: ऋग्वेदश्रावकं पैलं जग्राह स महामुनिः । यजुर्वेदप्रवक्तारं वैशम्पायनमेव च
verses.transliteration: ṛgvedaśrāvakaṃ pailaṃ jagrāha sa mahāmuniḥ / yajurvedapravaktāraṃ vaiśampāyanameva ca
verses.translation: They saw the sage Narayana of great Yogic power, the son of sage Dharma, devoid of beginning and end, and accompanied by Nara.
verses.hindi: मुख, सिर तथा ग्रीवावाले, सभी प्राणियोंके (हृदयरूपी) गुहामें स्थित और सर्वत्र व्याप्त रहनेवाले हैं। उनसे भिन्न कुछ नहीं है
verses.wordMeaning: They saw the sage Narayana of great Yogic power, the son of sage Dharma, devoid of beginning and end, and accompanied by Nara.
verses.commentary: Sense: They saw the sage Narayana of great Yogic power, the son of sage Dharma, devoid of beginning and end, and accompanied by Nara.

verses.sanskrit: जैमिनिं सामवेदस्य श्रावकं सोन्वपद्यत । तथैवाथर्ववेदस्य सुमन्तुमृषिसत्तमम् । इतिहासपुराणानि प्रवक्तुं मामयोजयत्
verses.transliteration: jaiminiṃ sāmavedasya śrāvakaṃ sonvapadyata / tathaivātharvavedasya sumantumṛṣisattamam / itihāsapurāṇāni pravaktuṃ māmayojayat
verses.translation: They eulogised him with various hymns taken from the Vedas. The Yogins, endowed with devotion, bowed down to the deity, the most excellent among the knowers of Yoga.
verses.hindi: मुनिश्रेष्ठो! इस प्रकार यह आपको ईश्वर-सम्बन्धी ज्ञान बतलाया। यह विशेषरूपसे गोपनीय है और गोपनीयं विशेषेण योगिनामपि दुर्लभम्॥ २०॥  योगियोंके लिये भी दुर्लभ है
verses.wordMeaning: They eulogised him with various hymns taken from the Vedas. The Yogins, endowed with devotion, bowed down to the deity, the most excellent among the knowers of Yoga.
verses.commentary: Sense: They eulogised him with various hymns taken from the Vedas. The Yogins, endowed with devotion, bowed down to the deity, the most excellent among the knowers of Yoga.

verses.sanskrit: एक आसीद्यजुर्वेदस्तं चतुर्धा व्यकल्पयत् । चातुर्हेत्रमभूद् यस्मिंस्तेन यज्ञमथाकरोत्
verses.transliteration: eka āsīdyajurvedastaṃ caturdhā vyakalpayat / cāturhetramabhūd yasmiṃstena yajñamathākarot
verses.translation: After knowing their desire, the omniscient lord spoke in a majestic tone: "Why is this penance being performed by you?"
verses.hindi: ईश्वरद्वारा परम तत्त्व तथा परम ज़ानके स्वरूपका निरूपण और उसकी प्रा्िके साधनका वर्णन
verses.wordMeaning: After knowing their desire, the omniscient lord spoke in a majestic tone: "Why is this penance being performed by you?"
verses.commentary: Sense: After knowing their desire, the omniscient lord spoke in a majestic tone: "Why is this penance being performed by you?"

verses.sanskrit: आध्वर्यवं यजुर्भिः स्यादृग्भिर्हेत्रं द्विजोत्तमाः । औद्गात्रं सामभिश्चक्रे ब्रह्मत्वं चाप्यथर्वभिः
verses.transliteration: ādhvaryavaṃ yajurbhiḥ syādṛgbhirhetraṃ dvijottamāḥ / audgātraṃ sāmabhiścakre brahmatvaṃ cāpyatharvabhiḥ
verses.translation: With delighted minds, they bowed to the eternal (lord), the Atman of the universe, lord Narayana himself who had arrived, indicating the Siddhi (achievement of their desires).
verses.hindi: अलिङ्गमेकमव्यक्तं लिङ्गं ब्रह्मेति निश्चितम्। स्वयंज्योतिः परं तत्त्वं परे व्योम्नि व्यवस्थितम् अव्यक्ते कारणं यत्तदक्षरं परमं पदम्। निर्गुणं शुद्धविज्ञानं तद् वै पश्यन्ति सूरयः
verses.wordMeaning: With delighted minds, they bowed to the eternal (lord), the Atman of the universe, lord Narayana himself who had arrived, indicating the Siddhi (achievement of their desires).
verses.commentary: Sense: With delighted minds, they bowed to the eternal (lord), the Atman of the universe, lord Narayana himself who had arrived, indicating the Siddhi (achievement of their desires).

verses.sanskrit: ततः स ऋच उद्धृत्य ऋग्वेदं कृतवान् प्रभुः । यजूंषि च यजुर्वेदं सामवेदं च सामभिः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa ṛca uddhṛtya ṛgvedaṃ kṛtavān prabhuḥ / yajūṃṣi ca yajurvedaṃ sāmavedaṃ ca sāmabhiḥ
verses.translation: "We have adopted the attitude of self-control** even though all of us are expounders of the Brahman. We have sought refuge in you, the only Purusottama.
verses.hindi: पश्यन्ति तत् परं ब्रह्म यत्तल्लिङ्गमिति श्रुतिः
verses.wordMeaning: "We have adopted the attitude of self-control** even though all of us are expounders of the Brahman. We have sought refuge in you, the only Purusottama.
verses.commentary: Sense: "We have adopted the attitude of self-control** even though all of us are expounders of the Brahman. We have sought refuge in you, the only Purusottama.

verses.sanskrit: एकविंशतिभेदेन ऋग्वेदं कृतवान् पुरा । शाखानां तु शतेनैव यजुर्वेदमथाकरोत्
verses.transliteration: ekaviṃśatibhedena ṛgvedaṃ kṛtavān purā / śākhānāṃ tu śatenaiva yajurvedamathākarot
verses.translation: You are Lord Narayana, the ancient sage, the un¬ manifest Being. You know the entire Supreme esoteric doctrine.
verses.hindi: अन्यथा नहि मां द्रष्टुं शक्यं वै मुनिपुंगवाः । नहि तद् विद्यते ज्ञानं यतस्तज्ज्ञायते परम् एतत्तत्परमं ज्ञानं केवलं कवयो विदुः। अज्ञानमितरत् सर्व यस्मान्मायामयं जगत्
verses.wordMeaning: You are Lord Narayana, the ancient sage, the un¬ manifest Being. You know the entire Supreme esoteric doctrine.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are Lord Narayana, the ancient sage, the un¬ manifest Being. You know the entire Supreme esoteric doctrine.

verses.sanskrit: सामवेदं सहस्त्रेण शाखानां प्रबिभेद सः । अथर्वाणमथो वेदं बिभेद नवकेन तु
verses.transliteration: sāmavedaṃ sahastreṇa śākhānāṃ prabibheda saḥ / atharvāṇamatho vedaṃ bibheda navakena tu
verses.translation: Excepting you, the great Isvara, there is no other knower. It behoves you, of such a nature, to dispel our formidable doubts.
verses.hindi: ममात्मासौ तदेवेदमिति प््राहुर्विपश्चितः
verses.wordMeaning: Excepting you, the great Isvara, there is no other knower. It behoves you, of such a nature, to dispel our formidable doubts.
verses.commentary: Sense: Excepting you, the great Isvara, there is no other knower. It behoves you, of such a nature, to dispel our formidable doubts.

verses.sanskrit: भेदैरष्टादशैर्व्यासः पुराणं कृतवान् प्रभुः । सो ऽयमेकश्चतुष्पादो वेदः पूर्वं पुरातनात्
verses.transliteration: bhedairaṣṭādaśairvyāsaḥ purāṇaṃ kṛtavān prabhuḥ / so 'yamekaścatuṣpādo vedaḥ pūrvaṃ purātanāt
verses.translation: Excepting you, the great Isvara, there is no other knower. It behoves you, of such a nature, to dispel our formidable doubts.
verses.hindi: ईश्वरने कहा--अलिङ्ग (चिहृरहित), अद्वितीय, अव्यक्त, लिङ्गको ब्रह्म कहा गया है। वह स्वयं प्रकाशरुप परम तत्त्व परम व्योममें अवस्थित है। जो निर्गुण, विशुद्ध विज्ञानरूप, अक्षर और अव्यक्त कारण-रूप है, उस परमपदका विद्वान् लोग साक्षात्कार करते हैं । जिसे वेदमें तल्लिङ्ग अर्थात् हेतुरूप कहा गया है, उस परम ब्रह्मका शान्तसंकल्पवाले, तत्परायण और नित्य उनके भावसे भावित लोग साक्षात्कार करते हैं॥ १--३॥
verses.wordMeaning: Excepting you, the great Isvara, there is no other knower. It behoves you, of such a nature, to dispel our formidable doubts.
verses.commentary: Sense: Excepting you, the great Isvara, there is no other knower. It behoves you, of such a nature, to dispel our formidable doubts.

verses.sanskrit: ओङ्कारो ब्रह्मणो जातः सर्वदोषविशोधनः । वेदवेद्यो हि भगवान् वासुदेवः सनातनः
verses.transliteration: oṅkāro brahmaṇo jātaḥ sarvadoṣaviśodhanaḥ / vedavedyo hi bhagavān vāsudevaḥ sanātanaḥ
verses.translation: Excepting you, the great Isvara, there is no other knower. It behoves you, of such a nature, to dispel our formidable doubts.
verses.hindi: मुनिश्रेष्ठो! अन्य किसी प्रकार मेरा दर्शन नहीं हो सकता। ऐसा कोई भी ज्ञान नहीं है, जिससे उस परम तत्त्वको जाना जा सके! इस परम ज्ञानको केवल विद्वान् ही जानते हैं। इसके अतिरिक्त सभी कुछ आज्ञानस्वरूप
verses.wordMeaning: Excepting you, the great Isvara, there is no other knower. It behoves you, of such a nature, to dispel our formidable doubts.
verses.commentary: Sense: Excepting you, the great Isvara, there is no other knower. It behoves you, of such a nature, to dispel our formidable doubts.

verses.sanskrit: स गीयते परो वेदे यो वेदैनं स वेदवित् । एतत् परतरं ब्रह्म ज्योतिरानन्दमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: sa gīyate paro vede yo vedainaṃ sa vedavit / etat parataraṃ brahma jyotirānandamuttamam
verses.translation: Excepting you, the great Isvara, there is no other knower. It behoves you, of such a nature, to dispel our formidable doubts.
verses.hindi: है, जिससे यह मायामय जगत् (उत्पन्न) है है, वही मेरा आत्मरूप है-एऐसा विद्वानोंका कहना है। जो उसे (उस परम तत्त्वको) अनेक रूपसे देखते हैं, वे भी परम निष्ठा (भक्ति)-का आश्रय ग्रहणकर अद्वितीय अविनाशी तत्त्वका ज्ञान प्राप्तकर उसी परम
verses.wordMeaning: Excepting you, the great Isvara, there is no other knower. It behoves you, of such a nature, to dispel our formidable doubts.
verses.commentary: Sense: Excepting you, the great Isvara, there is no other knower. It behoves you, of such a nature, to dispel our formidable doubts.

verses.sanskrit: वेदवाक्योदितं तत्त्वं वासुदेवः परं पदम् । वेदवेद्यमिमं वेत्ति वेदं वेदपरो मुनिः
verses.transliteration: vedavākyoditaṃ tattvaṃ vāsudevaḥ paraṃ padam / vedavedyamimaṃ vetti vedaṃ vedaparo muniḥ
verses.translation: Excepting you, the great Isvara, there is no other knower. It behoves you, of such a nature, to dispel our formidable doubts.
verses.hindi: तत्त्वको देखते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Excepting you, the great Isvara, there is no other knower. It behoves you, of such a nature, to dispel our formidable doubts.
verses.commentary: Sense: Excepting you, the great Isvara, there is no other knower. It behoves you, of such a nature, to dispel our formidable doubts.

verses.sanskrit: अवेदं परमं वेत्ति वेदनिष्ठः सदेश्वरः । स वेदवेद्यो भगवान् वेदमूर्तिर्महेश्वरः । स एव वेदो वेद्यश्च तमेवाश्रित्य मुच्यते
verses.transliteration: avedaṃ paramaṃ vetti vedaniṣṭhaḥ sadeśvaraḥ / sa vedavedyo bhagavān vedamūrtirmaheśvaraḥ / sa eva vedo vedyaśca tamevāśritya mucyate
verses.translation: Excepting you, the great Isvara, there is no other knower. It behoves you, of such a nature, to dispel our formidable doubts.
verses.hindi: भक्त्या मां सम्प्रपश्यन्ति विज्ञेयास्ते तदात्मकाः साक्षादेव प्रपश्यन्ति स्वात्मानं परमेश्वरम्। नित्यानन्दं निर्विकल्पं सत्यरूपमिति स्थितिः
verses.wordMeaning: Excepting you, the great Isvara, there is no other knower. It behoves you, of such a nature, to dispel our formidable doubts.
verses.commentary: Sense: Excepting you, the great Isvara, there is no other knower. It behoves you, of such a nature, to dispel our formidable doubts.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येदक्षरं वेद्यमोङ्कारं वेदमव्ययम् । अवेदं च विजानाति पाराशर्यो महामुनिः
verses.transliteration: ityedakṣaraṃ vedyamoṅkāraṃ vedamavyayam / avedaṃ ca vijānāti pārāśaryo mahāmuniḥ
verses.translation: Excepting you, the great Isvara, there is no other knower. It behoves you, of such a nature, to dispel our formidable doubts.
verses.hindi: निर्वाणं ब्रह्मणा चैक्यं कैवल्यं कवयो विदुः
verses.wordMeaning: Excepting you, the great Isvara, there is no other knower. It behoves you, of such a nature, to dispel our formidable doubts.
verses.commentary: Sense: Excepting you, the great Isvara, there is no other knower. It behoves you, of such a nature, to dispel our formidable doubts.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे पञ्चाशो ऽध्यायः सूत उवाच वेदव्यासावताराणि द्वापरे कथितानि तु । महादेवावताराणि कलौ शृणुत सुव्रताः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge pañcāśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca vedavyāsāvatārāṇi dvāpare kathitāni tu / mahādevāvatārāṇi kalau śṛṇuta suvratāḥ
verses.translation: What is the cause of all these (things in the world)?* Who undergoes worldly existence for ever? What is the Atman? What is salvation? What causes the rebirth or recurring worldly existence?
verses.hindi: तस्मादनादिमध्यान्तं वस्त्वेकं परमं शिवम्। स ईश्वरो महादेवस्तं विज्ञाय विमुच्यते तद्धासेदमखिलं भाति नित्यं
verses.wordMeaning: What is the cause of all these (things in the world)?* Who undergoes worldly existence for ever? What is the Atman? What is salvation? What causes the rebirth or recurring worldly existence?
verses.commentary: Sense: What is the cause of all these (things in the world)?* Who undergoes worldly existence for ever? What is the Atman? What is salvation? What causes the rebirth or recurring worldly existence?

verses.sanskrit: आद्ये कलियुगे श्वेतो देवदेवो महाद्युतिः । नाम्ना हिताय विप्राणामभूद् वैवस्वते ऽन्तरे
verses.transliteration: ādye kaliyuge śveto devadevo mahādyutiḥ / nāmnā hitāya viprāṇāmabhūd vaivasvate 'ntare
verses.translation: What is (the nature of this) worldly existence? Who is I Sana, who perceives everything? What is the supreme Brahman? It behoves you to explain everything".
verses.hindi: शुद्धं बृहन्तं परमं यहद्विभाति। अत्रान्तरं ब्रह्मविदोऽथ नित्यं
verses.wordMeaning: What is (the nature of this) worldly existence? Who is I Sana, who perceives everything? What is the supreme Brahman? It behoves you to explain everything".
verses.commentary: Sense: What is (the nature of this) worldly existence? Who is I Sana, who perceives everything? What is the supreme Brahman? It behoves you to explain everything".

verses.sanskrit: हिमवच्छिखरे रम्ये छगले पर्वतोत्तमे । तस्य शिष्याः शिखायुक्ता वभूवुरमितप्रभाः
verses.transliteration: himavacchikhare ramye chagale parvatottame / tasya śiṣyāḥ śikhāyuktā vabhūvuramitaprabhāḥ
verses.translation: After saying this, the sages stood looking at Purusottama, who shedding off his guise as an ascetic, was stationed there in his own brilliance.
verses.hindi: न भूमिरापो न मनो न वह्निः न चेतनोऽन्यत् परमाकाशमध्ये
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this, the sages stood looking at Purusottama, who shedding off his guise as an ascetic, was stationed there in his own brilliance.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this, the sages stood looking at Purusottama, who shedding off his guise as an ascetic, was stationed there in his own brilliance.

verses.sanskrit: श्वेतः श्वेतशिखश्चैव श्वेतास्यः श्वेतलोहितः । चत्वारस्ते महात्मानो ब्राह्मणा वेदपारगाः
verses.transliteration: śvetaḥ śvetaśikhaścaiva śvetāsyaḥ śvetalohitaḥ / catvāraste mahātmāno brāhmaṇā vedapāragāḥ
verses.translation: In the meanwhile, Mahesvara, the great lord, whose coronet was marked with the (crescent of the) moon, Rudra (the deity) appeared before them disposed to bestow Grace upon them.i
verses.hindi: विभाति देवः शिव एव केवलः
verses.wordMeaning: In the meanwhile, Mahesvara, the great lord, whose coronet was marked with the (crescent of the) moon, Rudra (the deity) appeared before them disposed to bestow Grace upon them.i
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meanwhile, Mahesvara, the great lord, whose coronet was marked with the (crescent of the) moon, Rudra (the deity) appeared before them disposed to bestow Grace upon them.i

verses.sanskrit: सुभानो दमनश्चाथ सुहोत्रः कङ्कणस्तथा । लोकाक्षिरथ योगीन्द्रो जैगीषव्यस्तु सप्तमे
verses.transliteration: subhāno damanaścātha suhotraḥ kaṅkaṇastathā / lokākṣiratha yogīndro jaigīṣavyastu saptame
verses.translation: On seeing the three-eyed moon-bedecked lord of the universe, Paramesvara (Siva), they were delighted in their minds. With devotion they eulogised the great lord:
verses.hindi: और जो दूसरे लोग पुनः एक या अनेक रूपोंमें परम तत्त्वरूप ईश्वरका भक्तिद्वारा साक्षात्कार करते हैं, उन्हें तदात्मक अर्थात् उस ब्रह्मका स्वरूप ही जानना चाहिए सत्यस्वरूप साक्षात् परमेश्वरको अपनी आत्मामें देखते हैं यह वस्तुस्थिति है। अपने अव्यक्त परम आत्मामें अवस्थित शान्त (योगीजन), श्रेष्ठ परम तत्त्वके परमानन्द- स्वरूप, सर्वव्यापी तदात्मक तत्त्वकी उपासना करते है ।
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing the three-eyed moon-bedecked lord of the universe, Paramesvara (Siva), they were delighted in their minds. With devotion they eulogised the great lord:
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the three-eyed moon-bedecked lord of the universe, Paramesvara (Siva), they were delighted in their minds. With devotion they eulogised the great lord:

verses.sanskrit: अष्टमे दधिवाहः स्यान्नवमे वृषभः प्रभुः । भृगुस्तु दशमे प्रोक्तस्तस्मादुग्रः परः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: aṣṭame dadhivāhaḥ syānnavame vṛṣabhaḥ prabhuḥ / bhṛgustu daśame proktastasmādugraḥ paraḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: "O Isvara, be victorious, O Mahadeva, O Siva, the lord of the goblins, be victorious; Glory unto you, O Lord of the sages, O lord worshipped by means of penance.
verses.hindi: यही परम मुक्ति है, विद्वान् इसे मेरा उत्तम सायुज्य (नामक मोक्ष), निर्वाण ब्रह्मके साथ ऐक्य और कैवल्यरूपसे जानते हैं । ये परम शिव आदि, मध्य और अन्तसे रहित अद्वितीय तत्त्व हैं। ये ही महादेव हैं, ईश्वर हैं, इसलिये
verses.wordMeaning: "O Isvara, be victorious, O Mahadeva, O Siva, the lord of the goblins, be victorious; Glory unto you, O Lord of the sages, O lord worshipped by means of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Isvara, be victorious, O Mahadeva, O Siva, the lord of the goblins, be victorious; Glory unto you, O Lord of the sages, O lord worshipped by means of penance.

verses.sanskrit: द्वादशे ऽत्रिः समाख्यातो बली चाथ त्रयोदशे । चतुर्दशे गौतमस्तु वेदशीर्षा ततः परम्
verses.transliteration: dvādaśe 'triḥ samākhyāto balī cātha trayodaśe / caturdaśe gautamastu vedaśīrṣā tataḥ param
verses.translation: O Atman of the universe, O God of thousands of forms, O activiser of the machine of the universe, O Infinite one, be victorious. Glory to you, O cause of the origin,, sustenance and annihilation of the universe.
verses.hindi: इन्हें जाननेसे मुक्ति मिल जाती है वहाँ (परम तत्त्व परमेश्वरमें) न सूर्य प्रकाशित होता है, न चन्द्रमा, न नक्षत्र, न अग्नि और न ही विद्युत्। उसीके प्रकाशसे सम्पूर्ण (विश्व) प्रकाशित होता है। वह नित्य प्रकाश अचल एवं सद्रूपसे प्रकाशित
verses.wordMeaning: O Atman of the universe, O God of thousands of forms, O activiser of the machine of the universe, O Infinite one, be victorious. Glory to you, O cause of the origin,, sustenance and annihilation of the universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Atman of the universe, O God of thousands of forms, O activiser of the machine of the universe, O Infinite one, be victorious. Glory to you, O cause of the origin,, sustenance and annihilation of the universe.

verses.sanskrit: गोकर्णश्चाभवत् तस्माद् गुहावासः शिखण्ड्यथ । जटामाल्यट्टहासश्च दारुको लाङ्गली क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: gokarṇaścābhavat tasmād guhāvāsaḥ śikhaṇḍyatha / jaṭāmālyaṭṭahāsaśca dāruko lāṅgalī kramāt
verses.translation: Be victorious O Isana, O Sambhu, O thousand¬ footed one, O deity bowed down by leading Yogins, O consort of Ambika. O lord Paramesvara, obeisance to you."
verses.hindi: होता है। जो परम बृहत् विशुद्ध तत्त्व निर्विकल्प ज्ञानस्वरूप और नित्य उदित हुआ ज्ञानसे ही प्रकाशित होता है, उसीमें ब्रह्मज्ञानी लोग जिस नित्य अचल तत्त्वका दर्शन करते हैं, वही ईश हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Be victorious O Isana, O Sambhu, O thousand¬ footed one, O deity bowed down by leading Yogins, O consort of Ambika. O lord Paramesvara, obeisance to you."
verses.commentary: Sense: Be victorious O Isana, O Sambhu, O thousand¬ footed one, O deity bowed down by leading Yogins, O consort of Ambika. O lord Paramesvara, obeisance to you."

verses.sanskrit: श्वेतस्तथा परः शूली डिण्डी मुण्डी च वै क्रमात् । सहिष्णुः सोमशर्मा च नकुलीशो ऽन्तिमे प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: śvetastathā paraḥ śūlī ḍiṇḍī muṇḍī ca vai kramāt / sahiṣṇuḥ somaśarmā ca nakulīśo 'ntime prabhuḥ
verses.translation: On being thus eulogised, the three-eyed lord Isa, favourably disposed towards the devotees, embraced Hrsikesa (lord Visnu) and addressed him in a majestic tone:
verses.hindi: सभी वेद पुरुषको नित्य आनन्दरूप, अमृतरूप और विशुद्ध सत्यस्वरूप कहते हैं। वेदार्थका निश्चय किये हुए लोग ' ३ ' इस प्रणवके द्वारा उस नियामकका ध्यान करते हैं। परम आकाशके मध्यमें एकमात्र अद्वितीय देव शिव ही प्रकाशित होते हैं; वहाँ न भूमि है, न जल है, न मन है और न अग्नि ही है। इसी प्रकार प्राण, वायु, आकाश, बुद्धि तथा अन्य कोई चेतन-तत्त्व वहाँ नहीं है
verses.wordMeaning: On being thus eulogised, the three-eyed lord Isa, favourably disposed towards the devotees, embraced Hrsikesa (lord Visnu) and addressed him in a majestic tone:
verses.commentary: Sense: On being thus eulogised, the three-eyed lord Isa, favourably disposed towards the devotees, embraced Hrsikesa (lord Visnu) and addressed him in a majestic tone:

verses.sanskrit: वैवस्वते ऽन्तरे शंभोरवतारास्त्रिशूलिनः । अष्टाविंशतिराख्याता ह्यन्ते कलियुगे प्रभोः । तीर्थे कायावतारे स्याद् देवेशो नकुलीश्वरः
verses.transliteration: vaivasvate 'ntare śaṃbhoravatārāstriśūlinaḥ / aṣṭāviṃśatirākhyātā hyante kaliyuge prabhoḥ / tīrthe kāyāvatāre syād deveśo nakulīśvaraḥ
verses.translation: "O Pundarlkaksa (lotus-eyed god), why have these leading sages, the expounders of Brahman, come to this place. O Acyuta, what is to be done for them by me?"
verses.hindi: यह मैंने सभी वेदोंमें निहित परम रहस्यमय ज्ञानरूपी अमृतका वर्णन किया। किसी निर्जन प्रदेशमें निरन्तर प्रयत्नपूर्वक साधना करनेवाला योगी ही इस ज्ञानको जानता है
verses.wordMeaning: "O Pundarlkaksa (lotus-eyed god), why have these leading sages, the expounders of Brahman, come to this place. O Acyuta, what is to be done for them by me?"
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Pundarlkaksa (lotus-eyed god), why have these leading sages, the expounders of Brahman, come to this place. O Acyuta, what is to be done for them by me?"

verses.sanskrit: तत्र देवादिदेवस्य चत्वारः सुतपोधनाः । शिष्या बभूवुश्चान्येषां प्रत्येकं मुनिपुङ्गवाः
verses.transliteration: tatra devādidevasya catvāraḥ sutapodhanāḥ / śiṣyā babhūvuścānyeṣāṃ pratyekaṃ munipuṅgavāḥ
verses.translation: On hearing those words of his, Janardana, the lord of Devas, spoke to Mahadeva who was standing there well- disposed to confer grace.
verses.hindi: योगकी महिमा, अष्टाङ्गयोग, यम, नियम आदि योगसाधनोंका लक्षण, प्राणायामका विशेष प्रतिपादन, ध्यानके विविध प्रकार, पाशुपत-योगका वर्णन, वाराणसीमें प्राणत्यागकी महिमा, शिव-आराधनको विधि, शिव और विष्णुके अभेदका प्रतिपादन, शिवज्ञान-योगकी परम्पराका वर्णन, योगाग्निर्दहति क्षिप्रमशेषं पापपञ्जरम्।
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing those words of his, Janardana, the lord of Devas, spoke to Mahadeva who was standing there well- disposed to confer grace.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing those words of his, Janardana, the lord of Devas, spoke to Mahadeva who was standing there well- disposed to confer grace.

verses.sanskrit: प्रसन्नमनसो दान्ता ऐश्वरीं भक्तिमाश्रिताः । क्रमेण तान् प्रवक्ष्यामि योगिनो योगवित्तमान्
verses.transliteration: prasannamanaso dāntā aiśvarīṃ bhaktimāśritāḥ / krameṇa tān pravakṣyāmi yogino yogavittamān
verses.translation: O Siva, indeed, you know your own Atman. No one else does so. You explain your own Atman yourself. Reveal your Atman to the leading sages".
verses.hindi: एककालं द्विकालं वा त्रिकालं नित्यमेव वा।
verses.wordMeaning: O Siva, indeed, you know your own Atman. No one else does so. You explain your own Atman yourself. Reveal your Atman to the leading sages".
verses.commentary: Sense: O Siva, indeed, you know your own Atman. No one else does so. You explain your own Atman yourself. Reveal your Atman to the leading sages".

verses.sanskrit: श्वेतः श्वेतशिखश्चैव श्वेतास्यः श्वेतलोहितः । दुन्दुभिः शतरूपश्च ऋचीकः केतुमांस्तथा । विकेशश्च विशोकश्च विशापश्शापनाशनः
verses.transliteration: śvetaḥ śvetaśikhaścaiva śvetāsyaḥ śvetalohitaḥ / dundubhiḥ śatarūpaśca ṛcīkaḥ ketumāṃstathā / vikeśaśca viśokaśca viśāpaśśāpanāśanaḥ
verses.translation: After saying thus, Hrsikesa (Narayana) looked at the bull-bannered Deity (Siva) and exhibiting his accomplishments in Yoga, instructed the great sages (as follows):
verses.hindi: सर्वे ते ब्रह्मयोगस्य कलां नाईन्ति षोडशीम्॥ ईश्वरने कहा--इसके अनन्तर उस परम दुर्लभ योगको कहता हुँ, जिससे सूर्यके समान ईश्वररूप आत्माका दर्शन होता है अर्थात् सूर्यका जैसे प्रत्यक्ष हो रहा है, वैसे ही ईश्वरका प्रत्यक्ष होता है
verses.wordMeaning: After saying thus, Hrsikesa (Narayana) looked at the bull-bannered Deity (Siva) and exhibiting his accomplishments in Yoga, instructed the great sages (as follows):
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying thus, Hrsikesa (Narayana) looked at the bull-bannered Deity (Siva) and exhibiting his accomplishments in Yoga, instructed the great sages (as follows):

verses.sanskrit: सुमुखो दुर्मुखश्चैव दुर्दमो दुरतिक्रमः । सनः सनातनश्चैव मुकारश्च सनन्दनः
verses.transliteration: sumukho durmukhaścaiva durdamo duratikramaḥ / sanaḥ sanātanaścaiva mukāraśca sanandanaḥ
verses.translation: "It behoves you to realise precisely that you are all blessed by the vision of the Trident-bearing Sankara, the great Isa. You now deserve to know precisely (the divine knowledge).
verses.hindi: योगरूपी अग्नि शीघ्र ही सम्पूर्ण पापपञ्जरको भस्म कर देता है और (उसके बाद) साक्षात् मुक्तिरूप सिद्धि प्रदान करनेवाला प्रसन्न (निर्मल) ज्ञान उत्पन्न हो जाता है। योगसे ज्ञान उत्पन्न होता है और ज्ञानसे योग प्रवर्तित
verses.wordMeaning: "It behoves you to realise precisely that you are all blessed by the vision of the Trident-bearing Sankara, the great Isa. You now deserve to know precisely (the divine knowledge).
verses.commentary: Sense: "It behoves you to realise precisely that you are all blessed by the vision of the Trident-bearing Sankara, the great Isa. You now deserve to know precisely (the divine knowledge).

verses.sanskrit: दालभ्यश्च महायोगी धर्मात्मनो महौजसः । सुधामा विरजाश्चैव शङ्खपात्रज एव च
verses.transliteration: dālabhyaśca mahāyogī dharmātmano mahaujasaḥ / sudhāmā virajāścaiva śaṅkhapātraja eva ca
verses.translation: It behoves you to see the lord of devas who stands in front and who is visible in form. He alone is capable to say precisely everything in my presence".
verses.hindi: होता है। योग तथा ज्ञानसे सम्पन्न व्यक्तिपर महेश्वर प्रसन्न होते हैं। जो नित्य एक समय, दो समय या तीनों समय मेरे योगका साधन करते हैं, उन्हें महेश्वर समझना चाहिए ॥ २--४॥ हि योग दो प्रकारका समझना चाहिए, पहला अभावयोग है और दूसरा सभी योगोंमें उत्तमोत्तम महायोग कहलाता है। जिसमें सभी आभासोंसे रहित शून्यमय (निर्विकल्पक) स्वरूपका चिन्तन होता है और जिसके द्वारा आत्माका
verses.wordMeaning: It behoves you to see the lord of devas who stands in front and who is visible in form. He alone is capable to say precisely everything in my presence".
verses.commentary: Sense: It behoves you to see the lord of devas who stands in front and who is visible in form. He alone is capable to say precisely everything in my presence".

verses.sanskrit: सारस्वतस्तथा मेघो घनवाहः सुवाहनः । कपिलश्चासुरिश्चैव वोढुः पञ्चशिखो मुनिः
verses.transliteration: sārasvatastathā megho ghanavāhaḥ suvāhanaḥ / kapilaścāsuriścaiva voḍhuḥ pañcaśikho muniḥ
verses.translation: After hearing the words of Visnu and bowing down to the bull-bannered deity, those sages the chief of whom was Sanatkumara, asked Mahesvara:
verses.hindi: साक्षात्कार होता है, वह अभावयोग कहा गया है। जिसमें नित्यानन्दस्वरूप निरञ्जन आत्माका दर्शन होता हे और मेरै साथ एकता होती है, वह परमेश्वरूप महायोग कहा गया है॥५--७॥
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing the words of Visnu and bowing down to the bull-bannered deity, those sages the chief of whom was Sanatkumara, asked Mahesvara:
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing the words of Visnu and bowing down to the bull-bannered deity, those sages the chief of whom was Sanatkumara, asked Mahesvara:

verses.sanskrit: पराशरश्च गर्गश्च भार्गवश्चाङ्गिरास्तथा । बलबन्धुर्निरामित्रः केतुशृङ्गस्तपोधनः
verses.transliteration: parāśaraśca gargaśca bhārgavaścāṅgirāstathā / balabandhurnirāmitraḥ ketuśṛṅgastapodhanaḥ
verses.translation: In the meanwhile, a holy auspicious divine seat shone there for the sake of Isvara. It appeared from the sky in an unimaginable way (lit. was beyond the ken of imagination).
verses.hindi: अन्य जिन योगियोंके योगोंका ग्रन्थोंमें विस्तार हुआ है, वे सभी ब्रह्मयोगकी सोलहवीं कलाके भी बराबर नहीं हैं। जिस योगमें मुक्त पुरुष विश्वको साक्षात् ईश्वरके रूपमें देखते हैं, वह सभी योगोंमें श्रेष्ठ योग माना जाता है। जो सैकड़ों, हजारों अन्य प्रकारके मनको संयमित करनेवाले ईश्वरबहिष्कृत (वेदबाह्य) योगी हैं, वे मुझ अद्वितीयका दर्शन नहीं करते॥ ८--१० ॥
verses.wordMeaning: In the meanwhile, a holy auspicious divine seat shone there for the sake of Isvara. It appeared from the sky in an unimaginable way (lit. was beyond the ken of imagination).
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meanwhile, a holy auspicious divine seat shone there for the sake of Isvara. It appeared from the sky in an unimaginable way (lit. was beyond the ken of imagination).
