verses.sanskrit: लम्बोदरश्च लम्बश्च लाम्बाक्षो लम्बकेशकः । सर्वज्ञः समबुद्धिश्च साध्यः सत्यस्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: lambodaraśca lambaśca lāmbākṣo lambakeśakaḥ / sarvajñaḥ samabuddhiśca sādhyaḥ satyastathaiva ca
verses.translation: The creator of the universe, the Yogic Atman, occupied it along with Visnu. Lord Mahesvara shone there filling the universe with his brilliance.
verses.hindi: समाधिश्च मुनिश्रेष्ठा यमो नियम आसनम्
verses.wordMeaning: The creator of the universe, the Yogic Atman, occupied it along with Visnu. Lord Mahesvara shone there filling the universe with his brilliance.
verses.commentary: Sense: The creator of the universe, the Yogic Atman, occupied it along with Visnu. Lord Mahesvara shone there filling the universe with his brilliance.

verses.sanskrit: शुधामा काश्यपश्चैव वसिष्ठो विरजास्तथा । अत्रिरुग्रस्तथा चैव श्रवणो ऽथ श्रविष्ठकः
verses.transliteration: śudhāmā kāśyapaścaiva vasiṣṭho virajāstathā / atrirugrastathā caiva śravaṇo 'tha śraviṣṭhakaḥ
verses.translation: Then the expounders of the Brahman saw Sankara, the overlord of the chiefs of Devas, shining brilliantly on the faultlessly pure seat.
verses.hindi: अहिंसा सत्यमस्तेयं ब्रह्मचर्यापरिग्रहौ कर्मणा मनसा वाचा सर्वभूतेषु सर्वदा। अक्लेशजननं प्रोक्तं त्वहिंसा परमर्षिभिः
verses.wordMeaning: Then the expounders of the Brahman saw Sankara, the overlord of the chiefs of Devas, shining brilliantly on the faultlessly pure seat.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the expounders of the Brahman saw Sankara, the overlord of the chiefs of Devas, shining brilliantly on the faultlessly pure seat.

verses.sanskrit: कुणिश्च कुणिबाहुश्च कुशरीरः कुनेत्रकः । कश्यपोह्युशना चैव च्यवनो ऽथ बृहस्पतिः
verses.transliteration: kuṇiśca kuṇibāhuśca kuśarīraḥ kunetrakaḥ / kaśyapohyuśanā caiva cyavano 'tha bṛhaspatiḥ
verses.translation: The Yoga of Isvara is based on Sahkhya philosophy. Isvara explains the nature of Atman (vv. 3-29) and exhorts that Atman should be meditated upon. He (Atman) is in all beings. When this specialised knowledge is realized, one becomes identical with Siva. This is the Sahkhya Philosophy (vv. 30-41). Concentration on this knowledge is Yoga. Yoga and knowledge are interdependent. fBG. 13.30
verses.hindi: अहिंसायाः परो धर्मो नास्त्यहिंसा परं सुखम्। विधिना या भवेद्धिंसा त्वहिँसैव प्रकीर्तिता
verses.wordMeaning: The Yoga of Isvara is based on Sahkhya philosophy. Isvara explains the nature of Atman (vv. 3-29) and exhorts that Atman should be meditated upon. He (Atman) is in all beings. When this specialised knowledge is realized, one becomes identical with Siva.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The Yoga of Isvara is based on Sahkhya philosophy. Isvara explains the nature of Atman (vv. 3-29) and exhorts that Atman should be meditated upon. He (Atman) is in all beings. When this specialised knowledge is realized, one becomes identical with Siva.…

verses.sanskrit: उतथ्यो वामदेवश्च महाकायो महानिलः । वाचश्रवाः सुपीकश्च श्यावाश्वः सपथीश्वरः
verses.transliteration: utathyo vāmadevaśca mahākāyo mahānilaḥ / vācaśravāḥ supīkaśca śyāvāśvaḥ sapathīśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Resorting to this perfect knowledge, excellent Brah- manas have become identical with Brahman. They, the earlier expounders of Brahman, do not undergo worldly existence i. e. Sarhsara (cycle of births & deaths consequent to sufferings).
verses.hindi: स्तेयं तस्यानाचरणादस्तेयं धर्मसाधनम् कर्मणा मनसा वाचा सर्वावस्थासु सर्वदा। सर्वत्र मैथुनत्यागं ब्रह्मचर्य प्रचक्षते १८ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Resorting to this perfect knowledge, excellent Brah- manas have become identical with Brahman. They, the earlier expounders of Brahman, do not undergo worldly existence i. e. Sarhsara (cycle of births & deaths consequent to sufferings).
verses.commentary: Sense: Resorting to this perfect knowledge, excellent Brah- manas have become identical with Brahman. They, the earlier expounders of Brahman, do not undergo worldly existence i. e. Sarhsara (cycle of births & deaths consequent to sufferings).

verses.sanskrit: हरिण्यनाभः कौशल्यो लोकाक्षिः कुथुमिस्तथा । सुमन्तुर्वर्चरी विद्वान् कबन्धः कुशिकन्धरः
verses.transliteration: hariṇyanābhaḥ kauśalyo lokākṣiḥ kuthumistathā / sumanturvarcarī vidvān kabandhaḥ kuśikandharaḥ
verses.translation: It is the secret of secrets. It must be strenuously guarded. I shall explain it to you who are expounders of Brahman and endowed with devotion.
verses.hindi: उपवासपराकादिकृच्छूचान्द्रायणादिभिः । शरीरशोषणं प्राहुस्तापसास्तप उत्तमम्
verses.wordMeaning: It is the secret of secrets. It must be strenuously guarded. I shall explain it to you who are expounders of Brahman and endowed with devotion.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is the secret of secrets. It must be strenuously guarded. I shall explain it to you who are expounders of Brahman and endowed with devotion.

verses.sanskrit: प्लक्षो दार्भायणिश्चैव केतुमान् गौतमस्तथा । भल्लापी मधुपिङ्गश्च श्वेतकेतुस्तपोनिधिः
verses.transliteration: plakṣo dārbhāyaṇiścaiva ketumān gautamastathā / bhallāpī madhupiṅgaśca śvetaketustaponidhiḥ
verses.translation: This Atman is absolute, pure, clean (v. 1. quiescent) subtle and eternal. It exists within everything. It is the pure consciousness itself. It exists beyond the darkness of ignorance.
verses.hindi: सत्त्वशुद््रिकरं पुंसां स्वाध्यायं परिचक्षते स्वाध्यायस्य त्रयो भेदा वाचिकोपांशुमानसाः । उत्तरोत्तरवैशिष्ट्यं प््राहुर्वेदार्थवेदिनः
verses.wordMeaning: This Atman is absolute, pure, clean (v. 1. quiescent) subtle and eternal. It exists within everything. It is the pure consciousness itself. It exists beyond the darkness of ignorance.
verses.commentary: Sense: This Atman is absolute, pure, clean (v. 1. quiescent) subtle and eternal. It exists within everything. It is the pure consciousness itself. It exists beyond the darkness of ignorance.

verses.sanskrit: उशिजो बृहदुक्थश्च देवलः कपिरेव च । शालिहोत्रो ऽग्निवेश्यश्च युवनाश्वः शरद्वसुः
verses.transliteration: uśijo bṛhadukthaśca devalaḥ kapireva ca / śālihotro 'gniveśyaśca yuvanāśvaḥ śaradvasuḥ
verses.translation: According to Vedas He is the immanent Being, the Purusa, the vital Breath, Mahesvara, Kala (Time). Here he is unmanifest but He knows.
verses.hindi: मुनिश्रेष्ठो! अन्य वृत्तियोंका निरोधकर मेरेमें एकचित्तता ही योग है और इस योगके जो आठ साधन मैंने आप लोगोंको बताये हैं वे ये हें-प्राणायाम, ध्यान, प्रत्याहार, धारणा, समाधि, यम, नियम तथा आसन
verses.wordMeaning: According to Vedas He is the immanent Being, the Purusa, the vital Breath, Mahesvara, Kala (Time). Here he is unmanifest but He knows.
verses.commentary: Sense: According to Vedas He is the immanent Being, the Purusa, the vital Breath, Mahesvara, Kala (Time). Here he is unmanifest but He knows.

verses.sanskrit: छगलः कुण्डकर्णश्च कुम्भश्चैव प्रवाहकः । उलूको विद्युतश्चैव शाद्वलो ह्याश्वलायनः
verses.transliteration: chagalaḥ kuṇḍakarṇaśca kumbhaścaiva pravāhakaḥ / ulūko vidyutaścaiva śādvalo hyāśvalāyanaḥ
verses.translation: The universe is born of him. In him alone it gets dissolved. He is the master of the Maya but unfettered by it (the Maya), he assumes various bodies (or forms).
verses.hindi: अहिंसा, सत्य, अस्तेय (चोरी न करना), ब्रह्मचर्य तथा अपरिंग्रह-संक्षेपमें इन्हें यम कहा गया है। ये मनुष्योंके चित्तकी शुद्धि करनेवाले हैं। मन, वाणी तथा कर्मसे सभी प्राणियोंको सर्वदा किसी भी प्रकारका क्लेश प्रदान न करना-इसे श्रेष्ठ ऋषियोंने अहिंसा कहा है। अहिंसासे श्रेष्ठ (कोई) धर्म नहीं है और अहिंसासे बढ़कर कोई सुख नहीं है। वेदविहित हिंसाको अहिंसा ही कहा गया है। सत्यके द्वारा सब कुछ प्राप्त हो
verses.wordMeaning: The universe is born of him. In him alone it gets dissolved. He is the master of the Maya but unfettered by it (the Maya), he assumes various bodies (or forms).
verses.commentary: Sense: The universe is born of him. In him alone it gets dissolved. He is the master of the Maya but unfettered by it (the Maya), he assumes various bodies (or forms).

verses.sanskrit: अक्षपादः कुमारश्च उलूको वत्स एव च । कुशिकश्चैव गर्गश्च मित्रको ऋष्य एव च
verses.transliteration: akṣapādaḥ kumāraśca ulūko vatsa eva ca / kuśikaścaiva gargaśca mitrako ṛṣya eva ca
verses.translation: He does not undergo the process of worldly existence (i. e. birth and death). The lord is not identical with the phy¬ sical world, He is neither the Earth nor the water nor the fire nor the wind nor the Ether.
verses.hindi: जाता है, सत्यमें ही सब कुछ प्रतिष्ठित है । द्विंजातियोंके द्वारा यथार्थ कथनके आचारको सत्य कहा गया है। चोरीसे अथवा बलपूर्वक दूसरेके द्रव्यका अपहरण करना स्तेय है, उसका (स्तेयका) आचरण न करना
verses.wordMeaning: He does not undergo the process of worldly existence (i. e. birth and death). The lord is not identical with the phy¬ sical world, He is neither the Earth nor the water nor the fire nor the wind nor the Ether.
verses.commentary: Sense: He does not undergo the process of worldly existence (i. e. birth and death). The lord is not identical with the phy¬ sical world, He is neither the Earth nor the water nor the fire nor the wind nor the Ether.

verses.sanskrit: शिष्या एते महात्मानः सर्वोवर्तेषु योगिनाम् । विमला ब्रह्मभूयिष्ठा ज्ञानयोगपरायणाः
verses.transliteration: śiṣyā ete mahātmānaḥ sarvovarteṣu yoginām / vimalā brahmabhūyiṣṭhā jñānayogaparāyaṇāḥ
verses.translation: He does not undergo the process of worldly existence (i. e. birth and death). The lord is not identical with the phy¬ sical world, He is neither the Earth nor the water nor the fire nor the wind nor the Ether.
verses.hindi: अस्तेय है, यह धर्मका साधन है। मन, वाणी तथा कर्मद्वारा सभी अवस्थाओंमें सर्वदा सर्वत्र मैथुनका त्याग करना ब्रह्मचर्यं कहलाता है॥ १३--१८॥ आपत्तिकालमें भी इच्छापूर्वक द्रव्योंका ग्रहण न करना 'अपरिग्रह' कहा गया है। प्रयत्रपूर्वक उस अपरिंग्रहका पालन करना चाहिए  तप, स्वाध्याय, संतोष, शौच तथा ईश्वरका पूजन-संक्षेपमें नियम बतलाये गये
verses.wordMeaning: He does not undergo the process of worldly existence (i. e. birth and death). The lord is not identical with the phy¬ sical world, He is neither the Earth nor the water nor the fire nor the wind nor the Ether.
verses.commentary: Sense: He does not undergo the process of worldly existence (i. e. birth and death). The lord is not identical with the phy¬ sical world, He is neither the Earth nor the water nor the fire nor the wind nor the Ether.

verses.sanskrit: कुर्वन्ति चावताराणि ब्राह्मणानां हिताय हि । योगेश्वराणामादेशाद् वेदसंस्थापनाय वै
verses.transliteration: kurvanti cāvatārāṇi brāhmaṇānāṃ hitāya hi / yogeśvarāṇāmādeśād vedasaṃsthāpanāya vai
verses.translation: He does not undergo the process of worldly existence (i. e. birth and death). The lord is not identical with the phy¬ sical world, He is neither the Earth nor the water nor the fire nor the wind nor the Ether.
verses.hindi: हैं, ये योगसिद्धि प्रदान करनेवाले हैं । तपस्ियोंने पराक आदि उपवासों तथा कृच्छुचान्द्रायणादि (व्रतों)-के द्वारा शरीरके शोषणको उत्तम तप कहा है
verses.wordMeaning: He does not undergo the process of worldly existence (i. e. birth and death). The lord is not identical with the phy¬ sical world, He is neither the Earth nor the water nor the fire nor the wind nor the Ether.
verses.commentary: Sense: He does not undergo the process of worldly existence (i. e. birth and death). The lord is not identical with the phy¬ sical world, He is neither the Earth nor the water nor the fire nor the wind nor the Ether.

verses.sanskrit: ये ब्राह्मणाः संस्मरन्ति नमस्यन्ति च सर्वदा । तर्पयन्त्यर्चयन्त्येतान् ब्रह्मविद्यामवाप्नुयुः
verses.transliteration: ye brāhmaṇāḥ saṃsmaranti namasyanti ca sarvadā / tarpayantyarcayantyetān brahmavidyāmavāpnuyuḥ
verses.translation: He does not undergo the process of worldly existence (i. e. birth and death). The lord is not identical with the phy¬ sical world, He is neither the Earth nor the water nor the fire nor the wind nor the Ether.
verses.hindi: आदिके जपको पुरुषोंके लिये सत्त्वकी शुद्धि करनेवाला 'स्वाध्याय' कहा है । स्वाध्यायके तीन भेद हैं-वाचिक, उपांशु और मानस । वेदार्थ जाननेवालेनि इन तीनोंमें उत्तरोत्तरका वैशिष्ट्य कहा है अर्थात् वाचिक स्वाध्यायसे उपांशु स्वाध्याय श्रेष्ठ और उपांशु स्वाध्यायसे मानस स्वाध्याय श्रेष्ठ है। दूसरे सुननेवालेको स्पष्टरूपसे शब्दका ज्ञान उत्पन्न करनेवाला स्वाध्याय 'वाचिक' कहलाता है। (अर्थात् वह स्वाध्याय वाचिक है जो दूसरोंको स्पष्ट सुनायी पड़े।) अब उपांशुका
verses.wordMeaning: He does not undergo the process of worldly existence (i. e. birth and death). The lord is not identical with the phy¬ sical world, He is neither the Earth nor the water nor the fire nor the wind nor the Ether.
verses.commentary: Sense: He does not undergo the process of worldly existence (i. e. birth and death). The lord is not identical with the phy¬ sical world, He is neither the Earth nor the water nor the fire nor the wind nor the Ether.

verses.sanskrit: इदं वैवस्वतं प्रोक्तमन्तरं विस्तरेण तु । भविष्यति च सावर्णो दक्षसावर्ण एव च
verses.transliteration: idaṃ vaivasvataṃ proktamantaraṃ vistareṇa tu / bhaviṣyati ca sāvarṇo dakṣasāvarṇa eva ca
verses.translation: He does not undergo the process of worldly existence (i. e. birth and death). The lord is not identical with the phy¬ sical world, He is neither the Earth nor the water nor the fire nor the wind nor the Ether.
verses.hindi: लक्षण बतलाया जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: He does not undergo the process of worldly existence (i. e. birth and death). The lord is not identical with the phy¬ sical world, He is neither the Earth nor the water nor the fire nor the wind nor the Ether.
verses.commentary: Sense: He does not undergo the process of worldly existence (i. e. birth and death). The lord is not identical with the phy¬ sical world, He is neither the Earth nor the water nor the fire nor the wind nor the Ether.

verses.sanskrit: दशमो ब्रह्मसावर्णो धर्मसावर्ण एव च । द्वादशो रुद्रसावर्णो रोचमानस्त्रयोदशः । भौत्यश्चतुर्दशः प्रोक्तो भविष्या मनवः क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: daśamo brahmasāvarṇo dharmasāvarṇa eva ca / dvādaśo rudrasāvarṇo rocamānastrayodaśaḥ / bhautyaścaturdaśaḥ prokto bhaviṣyā manavaḥ kramāt
verses.translation: He does not undergo the process of worldly existence (i. e. birth and death). The lord is not identical with the phy¬ sical world, He is neither the Earth nor the water nor the fire nor the wind nor the Ether.
verses.hindi: यद्यपि अष्टाङ्गयोगके साधन ऊपर निर्दिष्ट क्रमसे ही मूलमें वर्णित हैं, पर यह वर्णन छन्दकी दृष्टिसे है। वास्तवमें साधनोंका क्रम इस प्रकार है-यम, नियम, आसन, प्राणायाम, प्रत्याहार, धारणा, ध्यान एवं समाधि। ति कूर्मपुराण कं
verses.wordMeaning: He does not undergo the process of worldly existence (i. e. birth and death). The lord is not identical with the phy¬ sical world, He is neither the Earth nor the water nor the fire nor the wind nor the Ether.
verses.commentary: Sense: He does not undergo the process of worldly existence (i. e. birth and death). The lord is not identical with the phy¬ sical world, He is neither the Earth nor the water nor the fire nor the wind nor the Ether.

verses.sanskrit: अयं वः कथितो ह्यंशः पूर्वो नारायणेरितः । भूतभव्यैर्वर्तमानैराख्यानैरुपबृंहितः
verses.transliteration: ayaṃ vaḥ kathito hyaṃśaḥ pūrvo nārāyaṇeritaḥ / bhūtabhavyairvartamānairākhyānairupabṛṃhitaḥ
verses.translation: He does not undergo the process of worldly existence (i. e. birth and death). The lord is not identical with the phy¬ sical world, He is neither the Earth nor the water nor the fire nor the wind nor the Ether.
verses.hindi: उपांशुरेष निर्दिष्टः साहस्त्रो वाचिकाज्नपः
verses.wordMeaning: He does not undergo the process of worldly existence (i. e. birth and death). The lord is not identical with the phy¬ sical world, He is neither the Earth nor the water nor the fire nor the wind nor the Ether.
verses.commentary: Sense: He does not undergo the process of worldly existence (i. e. birth and death). The lord is not identical with the phy¬ sical world, He is neither the Earth nor the water nor the fire nor the wind nor the Ether.

verses.sanskrit: यः पठेच्छृणुयाद् वापि श्रावयेद् वा द्विजोत्तमान् । स सर्वपापनिर्मुक्तो ब्रह्मणा सह मोदते
verses.transliteration: yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyād vāpi śrāvayed vā dvijottamān / sa sarvapāpanirmukto brahmaṇā saha modate
verses.translation: He does not undergo the process of worldly existence (i. e. birth and death). The lord is not identical with the phy¬ sical world, He is neither the Earth nor the water nor the fire nor the wind nor the Ether.
verses.hindi: स्तुतिस्मरणपूजाभिर्वाङ्मनःकायकर्मभिः । सुनिश्चला शिवे भक्तिरेतदीश्वरपूजनम् मात्राद्lादशको मन्दश्चतुर्विशतिमात्रिकः। मध्यमः प्राणसंरोधः षदत्रिंशन्मात्रिकोत्तमः
verses.wordMeaning: He does not undergo the process of worldly existence (i. e. birth and death). The lord is not identical with the phy¬ sical world, He is neither the Earth nor the water nor the fire nor the wind nor the Ether.
verses.commentary: Sense: He does not undergo the process of worldly existence (i. e. birth and death). The lord is not identical with the phy¬ sical world, He is neither the Earth nor the water nor the fire nor the wind nor the Ether.

verses.sanskrit: पठेद् देवालये स्नात्वा नदीतीरेषु चैव हि । नारायणं नमस्कृत्य भावेन पुरुषोत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: paṭhed devālaye snātvā nadītīreṣu caiva hi / nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya bhāvena puruṣottamam
verses.translation: He does not undergo the process of worldly existence (i. e. birth and death). The lord is not identical with the phy¬ sical world, He is neither the Earth nor the water nor the fire nor the wind nor the Ether.
verses.hindi: ओठोंमें केवल स्पन्दन होनेके कारण दूसरेको शब्दका बोध न करानेवाला स्वाध्याय 'उपांशु' कहा गया है। यह वाचिक जपसे हजार गुना श्रेष्ठ है। (अर्थात् वही स्वाध्याय उपांशु है जिसमें ओठोंमें मात्र स्पन्दन हो,
verses.wordMeaning: He does not undergo the process of worldly existence (i. e. birth and death). The lord is not identical with the phy¬ sical world, He is neither the Earth nor the water nor the fire nor the wind nor the Ether.
verses.commentary: Sense: He does not undergo the process of worldly existence (i. e. birth and death). The lord is not identical with the phy¬ sical world, He is neither the Earth nor the water nor the fire nor the wind nor the Ether.

verses.sanskrit: नमो देवादिदेवाय देवानां परमात्मने । पुरुषाय पुराणाय विष्णवे कूर्मरूपिणे
verses.transliteration: namo devādidevāya devānāṃ paramātmane / puruṣāya purāṇāya viṣṇave kūrmarūpiṇe
verses.translation: He does not undergo the process of worldly existence (i. e. birth and death). The lord is not identical with the phy¬ sical world, He is neither the Earth nor the water nor the fire nor the wind nor the Ether.
verses.hindi: शब्दोंका उच्चारण न हो।) स्पन्दनरहित अक्षर एवं उस पदकी संगतिके अनुसार सभी शब्दोंके चिन्तनको विद्वान् मानस जप कहते हैं (अर्थात् मानस जप (स्वाध्याय) वही है जिसमें स्वाध्यायके शब्दोंपर केवल मत केन्द्रित हो बाकी सर्वथा व्यापारशून्य हो)  पुरुषको जो यदृच्छापूर्वक मिल जाता है, उसे ही पर्याप्त समझने- वाली बुद्धिको ऋषिलोग नित्य सुख लक्षणवाला संतोष कहते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: He does not undergo the process of worldly existence (i. e. birth and death). The lord is not identical with the phy¬ sical world, He is neither the Earth nor the water nor the fire nor the wind nor the Ether.
verses.commentary: Sense: He does not undergo the process of worldly existence (i. e. birth and death). The lord is not identical with the phy¬ sical world, He is neither the Earth nor the water nor the fire nor the wind nor the Ether.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायां पूर्वविभागे एकपञ्चाशो ऽध्यायः उपरिविभागः ऋषय ऊचुः भवता कथितः सम्यक् सर्गः स्वायंभुवस्ततः । ब्रह्माण्डस्यास्य विस्तारो मन्वन्तरविनिश्चयः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pūrvavibhāge ekapañcāśo 'dhyāyaḥ uparivibhāgaḥ ṛṣaya ūcuḥ bhavatā kathitaḥ samyak sargaḥ svāyaṃbhuvastataḥ / brahmāṇḍasyāsya vistāro manvantaraviniścayaḥ
verses.translation: He is not the Vital breath, nor the mind nor the Pradhana nor the unmanifest. It is neither the sound nor the touch nor the colour nor the form nor the taste nor the smell nor the ego nor the Agent of an act or speech.
verses.hindi: द्विजश्रेष्ठो! बाह्य और आभ्यन्तर-भेदसे शौच दो प्रकारका कहा गया है। मिट्टी और जलसे होनेवाला शौच बाह्य शौच और मनकी शुद्धि आभ्यन्तर शौच है। मन, वाणी तथा कर्मद्वारा स्तुति, स्मरण तथा पूजा करते हुए शिवमें
verses.wordMeaning: He is not the Vital breath, nor the mind nor the Pradhana nor the unmanifest. It is neither the sound nor the touch nor the colour nor the form nor the taste nor the smell nor the ego nor the Agent of an act or speech.
verses.commentary: Sense: He is not the Vital breath, nor the mind nor the Pradhana nor the unmanifest. It is neither the sound nor the touch nor the colour nor the form nor the taste nor the smell nor the ego nor the Agent of an act or speech.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रेश्वरेश्वरो देवो वर्णिभिर्धर्मतत्परैः । ज्ञानयोगरतैर्नित्यमाराध्यः कथितस्त्वया
verses.transliteration: tatreśvareśvaro devo varṇibhirdharmatatparaiḥ / jñānayogaratairnityamārādhyaḥ kathitastvayā
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas, the Atman is (not a sense organ as he is) nor the foot, neither the anus nor the genitals. He is neither the doer (the agent of an action) nor the enjoyer, neither the Prakrti nor the Purusa.
verses.hindi: अचल भक्ति रखना-यह ईश्वरका पूजन है। नियमोंके साथ यमोंको बतलाया गया, अब प्राणायामके विषयमें सुनो-अपनी देहसे उत्पन्न वायुको प्राण कहते हैं और उस वायुका निरोध करना आयाम है। उत्तम, मध्यम तथा अधमके भेदसे यह तीन प्रकारका कहा गया है। वही सगर्भ और आगर्भ-भेदसे दो प्रकारका है। द्वादश मात्रा (अर्थात् प्रणवका बारह बार जप करनेतक)-के कालको मन्द प्राणायाम, चौबीस मात्रा (-के प्राणनिरोध)-
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahmanas, the Atman is (not a sense organ as he is) nor the foot, neither the anus nor the genitals. He is neither the doer (the agent of an action) nor the enjoyer, neither the Prakrti nor the Purusa.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmanas, the Atman is (not a sense organ as he is) nor the foot, neither the anus nor the genitals. He is neither the doer (the agent of an action) nor the enjoyer, neither the Prakrti nor the Purusa.

verses.sanskrit: तद्वदाशेषसंसारदुः खनाशमनुत्तमम् । ज्ञानं ब्रह्मैकविषयं येन पश्येम तत्परम्
verses.transliteration: tadvadāśeṣasaṃsāraduḥ khanāśamanuttamam / jñānaṃ brahmaikaviṣayaṃ yena paśyema tatparam
verses.translation: He (therefore) does not comprehend that his own Atman is in reality the imperishable Brahman. (What he has then) is the (erroneous) notion of the Atman in what is the non-Atman. Hence it is misery.
verses.hindi: को मध्यम और छत्तीस मात्रातकके कालतक प्राणनिरोधको उत्तम प्राणायाम कहा जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: He (therefore) does not comprehend that his own Atman is in reality the imperishable Brahman. (What he has then) is the (erroneous) notion of the Atman in what is the non-Atman. Hence it is misery.
verses.commentary: Sense: He (therefore) does not comprehend that his own Atman is in reality the imperishable Brahman. (What he has then) is the (erroneous) notion of the Atman in what is the non-Atman. Hence it is misery.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं हि नारायणात्साक्षात् कृष्णद्वैपायनात् प्रभो । अवाप्ताखिलविज्ञानस्तत्त्वां पृच्छामहे पुनः
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ hi nārāyaṇātsākṣāt kṛṣṇadvaipāyanāt prabho / avāptākhilavijñānastattvāṃ pṛcchāmahe punaḥ
verses.translation: All defects such as passion, hatred etc., are brought about due to wrong notions. Its greatest defect is per¬ formance of actions meritorious or otherwise. This is the state.
verses.hindi: मन्द, मध्यम तथा मुख्य अर्थात् उत्तम नामके प्राणायामोंमें क्रमसे प्रस्वेद (पसीना) कम्पन तथा उत्थान होता है। इनसे तत्त्व-प्राप्तिमें क्रमशः आनन्दातिशयकी अनुभूति होती है। विद्वान् जपयुक्त प्राणायामको सगर्भ और जप-रहितको अगर्भ कहते हैं। योगियोंके प्राणायामका यही लक्षण कहा गया है। प्राणधारणपूर्वक व्याहति
verses.wordMeaning: All defects such as passion, hatred etc., are brought about due to wrong notions. Its greatest defect is per¬ formance of actions meritorious or otherwise. This is the state.
verses.commentary: Sense: All defects such as passion, hatred etc., are brought about due to wrong notions. Its greatest defect is per¬ formance of actions meritorious or otherwise. This is the state.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा मुनीनां तद् वाक्यं कृष्णद्वैपायनं प्रभुम् । सूतः पौराणिकः स्मृत्वा भाषितुं ह्युपचक्रमे
verses.transliteration: śrutvā munīnāṃ tad vākyaṃ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaṃ prabhum / sūtaḥ paurāṇikaḥ smṛtvā bhāṣituṃ hyupacakrame
verses.translation: It is due to that cause that everyone is invested with different kinds of physical bodies. The soul, however, lies con¬ cealed within, yet it is everywhere, eternal and free from blemishes.
verses.hindi: और शीर्षमन्त्रसहित गायत्रीका तीन बार जप (सगर्भ) प्राणायाम कहा जाता है। मनको संयत करनेवाले योगियोंने सभी शास्त्रोंमें रेचक, पूरक और कुम्भक प्राणायामका वर्णन किया है
verses.wordMeaning: It is due to that cause that everyone is invested with different kinds of physical bodies. The soul, however, lies con¬ cealed within, yet it is everywhere, eternal and free from blemishes.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is due to that cause that everyone is invested with different kinds of physical bodies. The soul, however, lies con¬ cealed within, yet it is everywhere, eternal and free from blemishes.

verses.sanskrit: अथास्मिन्नन्तरे व्यासः कृष्णद्वैपायनः स्वयम् । आजगाम मुनिश्रेष्ठा यत्र सत्रं समासते
verses.transliteration: athāsminnantare vyāsaḥ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaḥ svayam / ājagāma muniśreṣṭhā yatra satraṃ samāsate
verses.translation: It stands* single by his Maya power and not by its nature. Hence the sages say that non-dualism is the ultimate truth.
verses.hindi: रेचकोऽजस्त्रनिः श्वासात् पूरकस्तनत्निरोधतः। साम्येन संस्थितिर्या सा कुम्भकः परिगीयते इन्द्रियाणां विचरतां विषयेषु स्वभावतः ।
verses.wordMeaning: It stands* single by his Maya power and not by its nature. Hence the sages say that non-dualism is the ultimate truth.
verses.commentary: Sense: It stands* single by his Maya power and not by its nature. Hence the sages say that non-dualism is the ultimate truth.

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा वेदविद्वांसं कालमेघसमद्युतिम् । व्यासं कमलपत्राक्षं प्रणेमुर्द्विजपुङ्गवाः
verses.transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvā vedavidvāṃsaṃ kālameghasamadyutim / vyāsaṃ kamalapatrākṣaṃ praṇemurdvijapuṅgavāḥ
verses.translation: When one derives the perfect knowledge of the abso¬ lute Brahman, the sole panacea for the miseries of births and old age as well as ailments, he becomes Siva.
verses.hindi: हृत्पुण्डरीके नाभ्यां वा मूर्ध्नि पर्वतमस्तके । एवमादिषु देशेषु धारणा चित्तबन्धनम्
verses.wordMeaning: When one derives the perfect knowledge of the abso¬ lute Brahman, the sole panacea for the miseries of births and old age as well as ailments, he becomes Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: When one derives the perfect knowledge of the abso¬ lute Brahman, the sole panacea for the miseries of births and old age as well as ailments, he becomes Siva.

verses.sanskrit: पपात दण्डवद् भूमौ दृष्ट्वासौ रोमहर्षणः । प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य गुरुं प्राञ्जलिः पार्श्वगो ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: papāta daṇḍavad bhūmau dṛṣṭvāsau romaharṣaṇaḥ / pradakṣiṇīkṛtya guruṃ prāñjaliḥ pārśvago 'bhavat
verses.translation: Just as the rivers and rivulets get mingled with the ocean and become one, so also the Atman becomes one with the imperishable and the unsullied Brahman.
verses.hindi: एकाकारः समाधिः स्याद् देशालम्बनवर्जितः । प्रत्ययो ह्यर्थमात्रेण योगसाधनमुत्तमम् अदेशकाले योगस्य दर्शनं हि न विद्यते। अग्न्यभ्याशे जले वापि शुष्कपर्णचये तथा
verses.wordMeaning: Just as the rivers and rivulets get mingled with the ocean and become one, so also the Atman becomes one with the imperishable and the unsullied Brahman.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as the rivers and rivulets get mingled with the ocean and become one, so also the Atman becomes one with the imperishable and the unsullied Brahman.

verses.sanskrit: पृष्टास्ते ऽनामयं विप्राः शौनकाद्या महामुनिम् । समाश्वास्यासनं तस्मै तद्योग्यं समकल्पयन्
verses.transliteration: pṛṣṭāste 'nāmayaṃ viprāḥ śaunakādyā mahāmunim / samāśvāsyāsanaṃ tasmai tadyogyaṃ samakalpayan
verses.translation: Hence perfect knowledge alone exists. Neither the universe nor its existence is real. Perfect knowledge is enveloped by ignorance in this world, thereby the world gets deluded.
verses.hindi: अशुभे दुर्जनाक्रान्ते मशकादिसमन्विते । नाचरेद् देहबाधे वा दौर्मनस्यादिसम्भवे
verses.wordMeaning: Hence perfect knowledge alone exists. Neither the universe nor its existence is real. Perfect knowledge is enveloped by ignorance in this world, thereby the world gets deluded.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence perfect knowledge alone exists. Neither the universe nor its existence is real. Perfect knowledge is enveloped by ignorance in this world, thereby the world gets deluded.

verses.sanskrit: अथैतानब्रवीद् वाक्यं पराशरसुतः प्रभुः । कच्चिन्न तपसो हानिः स्वाध्यायस्य श्रुतस्य च
verses.transliteration: athaitānabravīd vākyaṃ parāśarasutaḥ prabhuḥ / kaccinna tapaso hāniḥ svādhyāyasya śrutasya ca
verses.translation: Perfect knowledge is blemishless, subtle, free from doubts and unchanging. Everything else is AjMna (Ignorance). This entire (thorough) realisation is considered Vijhana (perfect knowledge).
verses.hindi: नद्यास्तीरे पुण्यदेशे देवतायतने तथा वायुके सतत बाहर निकालनेको रेचक और उसके रोकनेको पूरक तथा बादकी सम अवस्थाकी जो स्थिति है, उसे कुम्भक कहा गया है। श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! सज्जनोने स्वभावत: विषयोंमें विचरण करनेवाली इन्द्रियोंके निग्रहको
verses.wordMeaning: Perfect knowledge is blemishless, subtle, free from doubts and unchanging. Everything else is AjMna (Ignorance). This entire (thorough) realisation is considered Vijhana (perfect knowledge).
verses.commentary: Sense: Perfect knowledge is blemishless, subtle, free from doubts and unchanging. Everything else is AjMna (Ignorance). This entire (thorough) realisation is considered Vijhana (perfect knowledge).

verses.sanskrit: ततः स सूतः स्वगुरुं प्रणम्याह महामुनिम् । ज्ञानं तद् ब्रह्मविषयं मुनीनां वक्तुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa sūtaḥ svaguruṃ praṇamyāha mahāmunim / jñānaṃ tad brahmaviṣayaṃ munīnāṃ vaktumarhasi
verses.translation: Thus the Sahkhya which is called excellent know¬ ledge has been recounted unto you. It is certainly the essence of all Vedanta (Upanisads). Yoga is the single-minded con¬ centration on this knowledge.
verses.hindi: प्रत्याहार कहा है। हृदयकमल, नाभिदेश, मूर्धा तथा पर्वतशिखर आदि स्थानोंमें चित्तके बन्धनको धारणा कहा जाता है। किसी देश (स्थान) -विशेषका अवलम्बनकर उसमें बुद्धिकी जो एकतान वृत्ति बनी रहती है और
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the Sahkhya which is called excellent know¬ ledge has been recounted unto you. It is certainly the essence of all Vedanta (Upanisads). Yoga is the single-minded con¬ centration on this knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the Sahkhya which is called excellent know¬ ledge has been recounted unto you. It is certainly the essence of all Vedanta (Upanisads). Yoga is the single-minded con¬ centration on this knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: इमे हि मुनयः शान्तास्तापसा धर्मतत्पराः । शुश्रूषा जायते चैषां वक्तुमर्हसि तत्त्वतः
verses.transliteration: ime hi munayaḥ śāntāstāpasā dharmatatparāḥ / śuśrūṣā jāyate caiṣāṃ vaktumarhasi tattvataḥ
verses.translation: Knowledge originates from Yoga and Yoga functions due to knowledge. There remains nothing unaccomplishable to one endowed with both Yoga and Knowledge.
verses.hindi: दूसरी वृत्तियोंसे कोई भी सम्बन्ध नहीं रहता है, उसे विद्वानोंने ध्यान कहा है । किसी देश या अन्य आलम्बनसे रहित चित्तकी एकाकारता समाधि है । इसमें ध्येयमात्रका भान होता है। यह योगका उत्तम साधन है। बारह बारह ध्यानपर्यन्त समाधि कही जाती है॥ ३७--४२ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Knowledge originates from Yoga and Yoga functions due to knowledge. There remains nothing unaccomplishable to one endowed with both Yoga and Knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: Knowledge originates from Yoga and Yoga functions due to knowledge. There remains nothing unaccomplishable to one endowed with both Yoga and Knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानं विमुक्तिदं दिव्यं यन्मे साक्षात् त्वयोदितम् । मुनीनां व्याहृतं पूर्वं विष्णुना कूर्मरूपिणा
verses.transliteration: jñānaṃ vimuktidaṃ divyaṃ yanme sākṣāt tvayoditam / munīnāṃ vyāhṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ viṣṇunā kūrmarūpiṇā
verses.translation: That which the Yogins attain is also attained by Sahkhyas. He who sees Sahkhya and the Yoga as one, is the knower of the real principle*.
verses.hindi: स्वस्तिकासन, पद्मासन तथा अर्धासन-भेदसे आसन (तीन प्रकारका) कहा गया है। सभी साधनोंमें यह साधन उत्तम है। विप्रेन्द्रो! अपने दोनों ऊरुओंके ऊपर दोनों पादतलोंको रखकर बैठनेको उत्तम पद्म नामक
verses.wordMeaning: That which the Yogins attain is also attained by Sahkhyas. He who sees Sahkhya and the Yoga as one, is the knower of the real principle*.
verses.commentary: Sense: That which the Yogins attain is also attained by Sahkhyas. He who sees Sahkhya and the Yoga as one, is the knower of the real principle*.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा सूतस्य वचनं मुनिः सत्यवतीसुतः । प्रणम्य शिरसा रुद्रं वचः प्राह सुखावहम्
verses.transliteration: śrutvā sūtasya vacanaṃ muniḥ satyavatīsutaḥ / praṇamya śirasā rudraṃ vacaḥ prāha sukhāvaham
verses.translation: O Brahmanas, other Yogins, very much attached to Aisvarja (prosperity and glory), get submerged in those different activities. So also those whose intellects are impeded and blunted.
verses.hindi: आसन कहा गया है। श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! एक पैरको दूसरे जाँघके ऊपर रखकर बैठनेको अर्धासन कहा जाता है। यह योगका उत्तम साधन है। दोनों पैरोंको जानुओं एवं ऊरुओंके भीतर करके बैठनेको श्रेष्ठ स्वस्तिक नामक आसन कहा जाता है॥ ४३--४६॥
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas, other Yogins, very much attached to Aisvarja (prosperity and glory), get submerged in those different activities. So also those whose intellects are impeded and blunted.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas, other Yogins, very much attached to Aisvarja (prosperity and glory), get submerged in those different activities. So also those whose intellects are impeded and blunted.

verses.sanskrit: व्यास उवाच वक्ष्ये देवो महादेवः पृष्टो योगीश्वरैः पुरा । सनत्कुमारप्रमुखैः स्वयं यत्समभाषत
verses.transliteration: vyāsa uvāca vakṣye devo mahādevaḥ pṛṣṭo yogīśvaraiḥ purā / sanatkumārapramukhaiḥ svayaṃ yatsamabhāṣata
verses.translation: At the end of the body (i. e. on death), one who is endowed with JMna and Toga shall attain the great, pure and divine Aisvarya ( prosperity and glory of Brahmahood) which is approved by all.
verses.hindi: विपरीत देश (स्थान) और विपरीत कालमें योगतत्त्वका दर्शन भी नहीं होता। अग्निके समीप, जलमें, सूखे पत्तोंके ढेरके मध्य, जन्तुओंसे भरे स्थानमें, श्मशानमें, पुराने गोष्ठमें, चौराहेमें, कोलाहल और भययुक्त
verses.wordMeaning: At the end of the body (i. e. on death), one who is endowed with JMna and Toga shall attain the great, pure and divine Aisvarya ( prosperity and glory of Brahmahood) which is approved by all.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the end of the body (i. e. on death), one who is endowed with JMna and Toga shall attain the great, pure and divine Aisvarya ( prosperity and glory of Brahmahood) which is approved by all.

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमारः सनकस्तथैव च सनन्दनः । अङ्गिरा रुद्रसहितो भृगुः परमधर्मवित्
verses.transliteration: sanatkumāraḥ sanakastathaiva ca sanandanaḥ / aṅgirā rudrasahito bhṛguḥ paramadharmavit
verses.translation: This Atman is I myself, the unmanifest Master of
verses.hindi: स्थानमें, चैत्यके समीप, दीमकोंसे पूर्ण स्थान, अशुभ स्थान, दुर्जनॉंसे व्यापत और मच्छर आदिसे भरे स्थान तथा देह-सम्बन्धी कष्ट और मनकी अस्वस्थताकी दशामें योग-साधन नहीं करना चाहिए। अच्छी प्रकार रक्षित, शुभ स्थान, पर्वतकी गुफा, नदीके किनारे, पुण्यदेश, देवमन्दिर, घर, शुभ, रमणीय, जनशून्य, जन्तुओंसे रहित स्थानोंमें योगीको सतत अपनेको मेरे परायण रखते हुए योग-साधना करनी चाहिए।
verses.wordMeaning: This Atman is I myself, the unmanifest Master of
verses.commentary: Sense: This Atman is I myself, the unmanifest Master of

verses.sanskrit: कणादः कपिलो योगी वामदेवो महामुनिः । शुक्रो वसिष्ठो भगवान् सर्वे संयतमानसाः
verses.transliteration: kaṇādaḥ kapilo yogī vāmadevo mahāmuniḥ / śukro vasiṣṭho bhagavān sarve saṃyatamānasāḥ
verses.translation: I (i. e. the Atman) have within me all forms, tastes fragrances. I am free from old age and death. I have hands and feet all round. I am the eternal immanent soul.
verses.hindi: योगीको चाहिए कि वह रिष्योंसहित श्रेष्ठ योगियों, विनायक, गुरु तथा मुझे प्रणाम करके समाहित-मन होकर योग-साधना करे॥ ४७--५२॥
verses.wordMeaning: I (i. e. the Atman) have within me all forms, tastes fragrances. I am free from old age and death. I have hands and feet all round. I am the eternal immanent soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: I (i. e. the Atman) have within me all forms, tastes fragrances. I am free from old age and death. I have hands and feet all round. I am the eternal immanent soul.

verses.sanskrit: परस्परं विचार्यैते संशयाविष्टचेतसः । तप्तवन्तस्तपो घोरं पुण्ये बदरिकाश्रमे
verses.transliteration: parasparaṃ vicāryaite saṃśayāviṣṭacetasaḥ / taptavantastapo ghoraṃ puṇye badarikāśrame
verses.translation: Though handless and feetless I am the speediest grasper, and am stationed in the heart of all. (Though) eyeless I observe and (even if) earless, I do hear.*
verses.hindi: नासिकाग्रे समां दृष्ट्रिमीषदुन्मीलितेक्षणः स्वात्मन्यवस्थितं देवं चिन्तयेत् परमेश्वरम्
verses.wordMeaning: Though handless and feetless I am the speediest grasper, and am stationed in the heart of all. (Though) eyeless I observe and (even if) earless, I do hear.*
verses.commentary: Sense: Though handless and feetless I am the speediest grasper, and am stationed in the heart of all. (Though) eyeless I observe and (even if) earless, I do hear.*

verses.sanskrit: अपश्यंस्ते महायोगमृषिं धर्मसुतं शुचिम् । नारायणमनाद्यन्तं नरेण सहितं तदा
verses.transliteration: apaśyaṃste mahāyogamṛṣiṃ dharmasutaṃ śucim / nārāyaṇamanādyantaṃ nareṇa sahitaṃ tadā
verses.translation: I know all these. No one knows me. Persons of truth¬ ful vision call me as being one, the only great Purusa.
verses.hindi: धर्मकन्दसमुद्भूतं ज्ञाननालं सुशोभनम्
verses.wordMeaning: I know all these. No one knows me. Persons of truth¬ ful vision call me as being one, the only great Purusa.
verses.commentary: Sense: I know all these. No one knows me. Persons of truth¬ ful vision call me as being one, the only great Purusa.

verses.sanskrit: संस्तूय विविधैः स्तोत्रैः सर्वे वेदसमुद्भवैः । प्रणेमुर्भक्तिसंयुक्ता योगिनो योगवित्तमम्
verses.transliteration: saṃstūya vividhaiḥ stotraiḥ sarve vedasamudbhavaiḥ / praṇemurbhaktisaṃyuktā yogino yogavittamam
verses.translation: Sages of subtle visions see the cause of the Atman (?) They see the excellent Aisvarya of the Nirguna form which is blemishless.
verses.hindi: ऐश्वर्याष्टदले शवेतं परं वैराग्यकर्णिकम्। चिन्तयेत् परमं कोशं कर्णिकायां हिरण्मयम् ओंकारवाच्यमव्यक्तं रश्मिजालसमाकुलम्
verses.wordMeaning: Sages of subtle visions see the cause of the Atman (?) They see the excellent Aisvarya of the Nirguna form which is blemishless.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sages of subtle visions see the cause of the Atman (?) They see the excellent Aisvarya of the Nirguna form which is blemishless.

verses.sanskrit: विज्ञाय वाञ्छितं तेषां भगवानपि सर्ववित् । प्राह गम्भीरया वाचा किमर्थं तप्यते तपः
verses.transliteration: vijñāya vāñchitaṃ teṣāṃ bhagavānapi sarvavit / prāha gambhīrayā vācā kimarthaṃ tapyate tapaḥ
verses.translation: I shall mention to you what Devas, deluded by my Maya, do not know. Ye all the expounders of Brahman, listen with concentration of your minds.
verses.hindi: ध्यायीताकाशमध्यस्थमीशं परमकारणम्। तदात्मा सर्वगो भूत्वा न किंचिदपि चिन्तयेत्
verses.wordMeaning: I shall mention to you what Devas, deluded by my Maya, do not know. Ye all the expounders of Brahman, listen with concentration of your minds.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall mention to you what Devas, deluded by my Maya, do not know. Ye all the expounders of Brahman, listen with concentration of your minds.

verses.sanskrit: अब्रुवन् हृष्टमनसो विश्वात्मानं सनातनम् । साक्षान्नारायणं देवमागतं सिद्धिसूचकम्
verses.transliteration: abruvan hṛṣṭamanaso viśvātmānaṃ sanātanam / sākṣānnārāyaṇaṃ devamāgataṃ siddhisūcakam
verses.translation: I am by nature beyond the ken of Maya. Hence I cannot be praised** (?) by all. I, however, urge it the reason of which the wise sages know.
verses.hindi: आत्मानमथ कर्तारं तत्रानलसमत्विषम्। मध्ये वह्विशिखाकारं पुरुषं पञ्विंशकम् ऑकारबोधितं तत्त्वं शाश्वतं शिवमच्युतम्
verses.wordMeaning: I am by nature beyond the ken of Maya. Hence I cannot be praised** (?) by all. I, however, urge it the reason of which the wise sages know.
verses.commentary: Sense: I am by nature beyond the ken of Maya. Hence I cannot be praised** (?) by all. I, however, urge it the reason of which the wise sages know.

verses.sanskrit: वयं संशयमापन्नाः सर्वे वै ब्रह्मवादिनः । भवन्तमेकं शरणं प्रपन्नाः पुरुषोत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: vayaṃ saṃśayamāpannāḥ sarve vai brahmavādinaḥ / bhavantamekaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapannāḥ puruṣottamam
verses.translation: Hence, the Yogins who have visualised Reality get into my secretmost (inner) personaliy which is omnipre¬ sent, and attain complete identity with me.
verses.hindi: ध्यायीत तन्मयो नित्यमेकरूपं महेश्वरम्। विशोध्य सर्वतत्त्वानि प्रणवेनाथवा पुनः
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, the Yogins who have visualised Reality get into my secretmost (inner) personaliy which is omnipre¬ sent, and attain complete identity with me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, the Yogins who have visualised Reality get into my secretmost (inner) personaliy which is omnipre¬ sent, and attain complete identity with me.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं हि तद् वेत्थ परमं सर्वज्ञो भगवानृषिः । नारायणः स्वयं साक्षात् पुराणो ऽव्यक्तपूरुषः
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ hi tad vettha paramaṃ sarvajño bhagavānṛṣiḥ / nārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ sākṣāt purāṇo 'vyaktapūruṣaḥ
verses.translation: Those who have crossed my Maya which is of uni¬ versal forms, attain the great and pure Nirvana (beatitude) along with me.
verses.hindi: स्वस्तिक, पद्म अथवा अर्धासन बाँधकर नासिकाके अग्रभागमें कुछ-कुछ खुली हुई आँखोंसे दृष्टिको स्थिर करके निर्भय तथा शान्त होकर मायामय संसार (-के चिन्तन)-का परित्यागकर अपने आत्मामें स्थित परमेश्वर देवका चिन्तन करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: Those who have crossed my Maya which is of uni¬ versal forms, attain the great and pure Nirvana (beatitude) along with me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who have crossed my Maya which is of uni¬ versal forms, attain the great and pure Nirvana (beatitude) along with me.

verses.sanskrit: नह्यन्यो विद्यते वेत्ता त्वामृते परमेश्वर । शुश्रूषास्माकमखिलं संशयं छेत्तुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration: nahyanyo vidyate vettā tvāmṛte parameśvara / śuśrūṣāsmākamakhilaṃ saṃśayaṃ chettumarhasi
verses.translation: They have no return (to saihsara) even in hundreds and crores of Kalpas, thanks to my favour. O leading Yogins, this is the injunction of the Vedas.
verses.hindi: शिखाके अग्रभागमें बारह अंगुलके प्रदेशमें धर्मस्वरूप कन्दसे प्रादुर्भूत, ज्ञानरूप नालवाले, ऐश्वर्यरूप आठ दलोंबाले, वैराग्यरूपी कर्णिकासे युक्त अत्यन्त श्वेत एवं सुन्दर कमलकी कल्पना करे और उस कमलकी
verses.wordMeaning: They have no return (to saihsara) even in hundreds and crores of Kalpas, thanks to my favour. O leading Yogins, this is the injunction of the Vedas.
verses.commentary: Sense: They have no return (to saihsara) even in hundreds and crores of Kalpas, thanks to my favour. O leading Yogins, this is the injunction of the Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: किं कारणमिदं कृत्स्नं को ऽनुसंसरते सदा । कश्चिदात्मा च का मुक्तिः संसारः किंनिमित्तकः
verses.transliteration: kiṃ kāraṇamidaṃ kṛtsnaṃ ko 'nusaṃsarate sadā / kaścidātmā ca kā muktiḥ saṃsāraḥ kiṃnimittakaḥ
verses.translation: The (perfect knowledge) should be imparted (only) to sons, disciples and Yogins. Thus the perfect knowledge which is a synthesis of Saiikhya and Yoga (lit. Sahkhya based on Yoga) has been expounded by me.
verses.hindi: कर्णिकामें हिरण्मय श्रेष्ठ कोशका ध्यान करे। उस (कोश)-में बिशुद्ध अविनाशी साक्षात् परम ज्योतिका ध्यान करे, जिसे सर्वशक्तिसम्पन्न, दिव्य, अव्यय, ओंकारसे वाच्य, अव्यक्त और प्रकाशको किरण- मालाओंसे व्याप्त कहा गया हैं। उस ज्योतिमें अपने आत्माकी अभेदभावना कर आकाशके मध्यमे स्थित परम कारणस्वरूप परमेश्वरका ध्यान करे और परमेश्वररूप एवं सर्वव्यापी होकर किसी भी अन्य वस्तुका चिन्तन
verses.wordMeaning: The (perfect knowledge) should be imparted (only) to sons, disciples and Yogins. Thus the perfect knowledge which is a synthesis of Saiikhya and Yoga (lit. Sahkhya based on Yoga) has been expounded by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: The (perfect knowledge) should be imparted (only) to sons, disciples and Yogins. Thus the perfect knowledge which is a synthesis of Saiikhya and Yoga (lit. Sahkhya based on Yoga) has been expounded by me.

verses.sanskrit: कः संसारयतीशानः को वा सर्वं प्रपश्यति । किं तत् परतरं ब्रह्म सर्वं नो वक्तुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration: kaḥ saṃsārayatīśānaḥ ko vā sarvaṃ prapaśyati / kiṃ tat parataraṃ brahma sarvaṃ no vaktumarhasi
verses.translation: Kala (Time), Pradhana or Prakrti and the supreme Purusa originated from the unmanifest (Brahman). All these (objects of the universe) were born of them. Hence the universe
verses.hindi: यह अत्यन्त गुह्य ध्यान है। अब दूसरा ध्यान कहा जाता है। अपने हृदयदेशमें पूर्वमें कहे गये उत्तम कमलका चिन्तनकर उस कमलमें अग्निके समान तेजस्वी, कर्तारूप, पचीसवें तत्त्व पुरुषात्मक परमात्मरूप
verses.wordMeaning: Kala (Time), Pradhana or Prakrti and the supreme Purusa originated from the unmanifest (Brahman). All these (objects of the universe) were born of them. Hence the universe
verses.commentary: Sense: Kala (Time), Pradhana or Prakrti and the supreme Purusa originated from the unmanifest (Brahman). All these (objects of the universe) were born of them. Hence the universe

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्ते तु मुनयः प्रापश्यन् पुरुषोत्तमम् । विहाय तापसं रूपं संस्थितं स्वेन तेजसा
verses.transliteration: evamukte tu munayaḥ prāpaśyan puruṣottamam / vihāya tāpasaṃ rūpaṃ saṃsthitaṃ svena tejasā
verses.translation: All round it has (the extremities of) hands and feet; it has eyes, heads and mouths on all sides; all round, it has €ars; it exists enveloping the world*.
verses.hindi: आत्माका चिन्तन करना चाहिए। उस परमात्माके भीतर परम आकाश (अवकाश) है (क्योंकि परमेश्वर विभू विराट् है) । ओंकारसे बोधित सनातन तत्त्व अच्युत शिव कहलाता है उसके भीतर अव्यक्त, प्रकृतिमें लीन, उत्तम परम ज्योति, परम तत्त्व, आत्माधार, निरञ्जन, नित्य, एकरूप महेश्वरका तन्मय होकर ध्यान करना चाहिए। अथवा प्रणवके द्वारा पुनः सभी तत्त्वोंका शोधनकर विशुद्ध
verses.wordMeaning: All round it has (the extremities of) hands and feet; it has eyes, heads and mouths on all sides; all round, it has €ars; it exists enveloping the world*.
verses.commentary: Sense: All round it has (the extremities of) hands and feet; it has eyes, heads and mouths on all sides; all round, it has €ars; it exists enveloping the world*.

verses.sanskrit: विभ्राजमानं विमलं प्रभामण्डलमण्डितम् । श्रीवत्सवक्षसं देवं तप्तजाम्बूनदप्रभम्
verses.transliteration: vibhrājamānaṃ vimalaṃ prabhāmaṇḍalamaṇḍitam / śrīvatsavakṣasaṃ devaṃ taptajāmbūnadaprabham
verses.translation: It appears to possess the attributes of the sense or¬ gans but it. is devoid of all sense-organs. It is the support of all; it is perpetual bliss, unmanifest and devoid of duality. * *
verses.hindi: परमपदरूप मुझमें अपने आत्माको स्थापित करे और उसी ज्ञानरूपी जलसे अपनी देहको आप्लावित करके मुझमें चित्त आसक्त करे तथा मेरे परायण होकर अग्निहोत्रका भस्म ग्रहण करे और 'अग्नि०' इत्यादि
verses.wordMeaning: It appears to possess the attributes of the sense or¬ gans but it. is devoid of all sense-organs. It is the support of all; it is perpetual bliss, unmanifest and devoid of duality. * *
verses.commentary: Sense: It appears to possess the attributes of the sense or¬ gans but it. is devoid of all sense-organs. It is the support of all; it is perpetual bliss, unmanifest and devoid of duality. * *

verses.sanskrit: शङ्खचक्रगदापाणिं शार्ङ्गहस्तं श्रियावृतम् । न दृष्टस्तत्क्षणादेव नरस्तस्यैव तेजसा
verses.transliteration: śaṅkhacakragadāpāṇiṃ śārṅgahastaṃ śriyāvṛtam / na dṛṣṭastatkṣaṇādeva narastasyaiva tejasā
verses.translation: It is the Atman of all living beings; he is both within and without; he is the supreme (beyond all). I am that Atman, the omnipresent, quiescent, the great Isvara and the embodi¬ ment of knowledge (consciousness).
verses.hindi: कर अपने आत्मामें परम ज्योतिस्वरूप ईशानका चिन्तन करे द्विजातीनां तु कथितं भक्तानां ब्रह्मचारिणाम्
verses.wordMeaning: It is the Atman of all living beings; he is both within and without; he is the supreme (beyond all). I am that Atman, the omnipresent, quiescent, the great Isvara and the embodi¬ ment of knowledge (consciousness).
verses.commentary: Sense: It is the Atman of all living beings; he is both within and without; he is the supreme (beyond all). I am that Atman, the omnipresent, quiescent, the great Isvara and the embodi¬ ment of knowledge (consciousness).

verses.sanskrit: तदन्तरे महादेवः शशाङ्काङ्कितशेखरः । प्रसादाभिमुखो रुद्रः प्रादुरासीन्महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: tadantare mahādevaḥ śaśāṅkāṅkitaśekharaḥ / prasādābhimukho rudraḥ prādurāsīnmaheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: All this universe consisting of the mobiles and immo- biles has been pervaded by me. All beings exist in me.j" He who has realized this knowledge is the real knower of the Vedas.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मचर्यमहिंसा च क्षमा शौचं तपो दमः। संतोषः सत्यमास्तिक्यं व्रताङ्कानि विशेषतः
verses.wordMeaning: All this universe consisting of the mobiles and immo- biles has been pervaded by me. All beings exist in me.j" He who has realized this knowledge is the real knower of the Vedas.
verses.commentary: Sense: All this universe consisting of the mobiles and immo- biles has been pervaded by me. All beings exist in me.j" He who has realized this knowledge is the real knower of the Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: निरीक्ष्य ते जगन्नाथं त्रिनेत्रं चन्द्रभूषणम् । तुष्टुवुर्हृष्टमनसो भक्त्या तं परमेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: nirīkṣya te jagannāthaṃ trinetraṃ candrabhūṣaṇam / tuṣṭuvurhṛṣṭamanaso bhaktyā taṃ parameśvaram
verses.translation: That entity is said to be both Pradhana and Purusa. Kala, manifesting through their union, is said to be the greatest and beginningless.
verses.hindi: एकेनाप्यथ हीनेन व्रतमस्य तु लुप्यते। तस्मादात्मगुणोपेतो मदव्रतं वोढुमर्हति ये यथा मां प्रपद्यन्ते तांस्तथैव भजाम्यहम्। ज्ञानयोगेन मां तस्माद् यजेत परमेश्वरम्
verses.wordMeaning: That entity is said to be both Pradhana and Purusa. Kala, manifesting through their union, is said to be the greatest and beginningless.
verses.commentary: Sense: That entity is said to be both Pradhana and Purusa. Kala, manifesting through their union, is said to be the greatest and beginningless.

verses.sanskrit: जयेश्वर महादेव जय भूतपते शिव । जयाशेषमुनीशान तपसाभिप्रपूजित
verses.transliteration: jayeśvara mahādeva jaya bhūtapate śiva / jayāśeṣamunīśāna tapasābhiprapūjita
verses.translation: All these three are devoid of beginning and end; they are stationed in the Unmanifest Brahman, but the wise sages
verses.hindi: सर्वकर्माणि संन्यस्य भिक्षाशी निष्परिग्रहः । प्रानोति मम सायुज्यं गुह्यमेतन्मयोदितम्
verses.wordMeaning: All these three are devoid of beginning and end; they are stationed in the Unmanifest Brahman, but the wise sages
verses.commentary: Sense: All these three are devoid of beginning and end; they are stationed in the Unmanifest Brahman, but the wise sages

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रमूर्ते विश्वात्मन् जगद्यन्त्रप्रवर्तक । जयानन्त जगज्जन्मत्राणसंहारकारण
verses.transliteration: sahasramūrte viśvātman jagadyantrapravartaka / jayānanta jagajjanmatrāṇasaṃhārakāraṇa
verses.translation: That which is said to be Prakrti gives birth to the entire universe beginning with Mahat and ending with Visesas {the particularised forms). It deludes all embodied beings.
verses.hindi: द्वेष्टा सर्वभूतानां मैत्रः करुण एव च। निर्ममो निरहंकारो यो मद्भक्तः स मे प्रियः यस्मान्नोद्विजते लोको लोकान्नोद्विजते च यः। हर्षामर्षभयोद्वेगैर्मुक्तो यः स हि मे प्रियः
verses.wordMeaning: That which is said to be Prakrti gives birth to the entire universe beginning with Mahat and ending with Visesas {the particularised forms). It deludes all embodied beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: That which is said to be Prakrti gives birth to the entire universe beginning with Mahat and ending with Visesas {the particularised forms). It deludes all embodied beings.

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रचरणेशान शंभो योगीन्द्रवन्दित । जयाम्बिकापते देव नमस्ते परमेश्वर
verses.transliteration: sahasracaraṇeśāna śaṃbho yogīndravandita / jayāmbikāpate deva namaste parameśvara
verses.translation: Stationed in the Prakrti, the Purusa enjoys the attri¬ butes of Prakrti.* Since it is devoid of the ego, it is called Pancavimsaka (the total of twenty-five Principles or the twenty- fifth Principle).
verses.hindi: जीवको बन्धनरूप पाशसे मुक्त करनेके लिये यह पाशुपत नामक योग कहा गया है। यह सम्पूर्ण वेदान्तका सार है और श्रुतिमें इस योगको अवस्थाको सभी आश्रमोंको अवस्थासे अतीत अवस्था (उत्कृष्ट अवस्था)
verses.wordMeaning: Stationed in the Prakrti, the Purusa enjoys the attri¬ butes of Prakrti.* Since it is devoid of the ego, it is called Pancavimsaka (the total of twenty-five Principles or the twenty- fifth Principle).
verses.commentary: Sense: Stationed in the Prakrti, the Purusa enjoys the attri¬ butes of Prakrti.* Since it is devoid of the ego, it is called Pancavimsaka (the total of twenty-five Principles or the twenty- fifth Principle).

verses.sanskrit: संस्तुतो भगवानीशस्त्र्यम्बको भक्तवत्सलः । समालिङ्ग्य हृषीकेशं प्राह गम्भीरया गिरा
verses.transliteration: saṃstuto bhagavānīśastryambako bhaktavatsalaḥ / samāliṅgya hṛṣīkeśaṃ prāha gambhīrayā girā
verses.translation: The first evolute of Prakrti is called Mahat. Through its knowledge of being endowed with knowledge, Ahamkara (ego) was evolved out of it.
verses.hindi: बतलाया गया है। इसे अत्यन्त गुह्य और द्वfजातियों, भक्तों एवं ब्रह्मचारियोंके लिये मेरा सायुज्य प्रदान करनेवाला कहा गया है। ब्रह्मचर्य, अहिंसा, क्षमा, शौच, तप, दम, संतोष, सत्य तथा आस्तिकता-ये सभी (इस पाशुपत) व्रतके विशेष अङ्ग हैं। इनमेंसे एक (अङ्ग)- के भी न होनेसे इस (योग)-का व्रत लुप्त हो जाता है। इसलिये इन आत्मगुणों (ब्रह्मचर्य, अहिंसा आदि नौ व्रतके आङ्गों)-से युक्त साधक ही मेरा (पाशुपत)
verses.wordMeaning: The first evolute of Prakrti is called Mahat. Through its knowledge of being endowed with knowledge, Ahamkara (ego) was evolved out of it.
verses.commentary: Sense: The first evolute of Prakrti is called Mahat. Through its knowledge of being endowed with knowledge, Ahamkara (ego) was evolved out of it.

verses.sanskrit: किमर्थं पुण्डरीकाक्ष मुनीन्द्रा ब्रह्मवादिनः । इमं समागता देशं किं वा कार्यं मयाच्युत
verses.transliteration: kimarthaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣa munīndrā brahmavādinaḥ / imaṃ samāgatā deśaṃ kiṃ vā kāryaṃ mayācyuta
verses.translation: The principle called Mahat is one and it is (also known as) Atman. He is also called Aharhkara (the principle individuation). It is called jiva (the individual self) and the inner soul by the thinkers of the real principles.
verses.hindi: व्रत धारण कर सकता है॥ ६७--७०॥
verses.wordMeaning: The principle called Mahat is one and it is (also known as) Atman. He is also called Aharhkara (the principle individuation). It is called jiva (the individual self) and the inner soul by the thinkers of the real principles.
verses.commentary: Sense: The principle called Mahat is one and it is (also known as) Atman. He is also called Aharhkara (the principle individuation). It is called jiva (the individual self) and the inner soul by the thinkers of the real principles.

verses.sanskrit: आकर्ण्य भगवद्वाक्यं देवदेवो जनार्दनः । प्राह देवो महादेवं प्रसादाभिमुखं स्थितम्
verses.transliteration: ākarṇya bhagavadvākyaṃ devadevo janārdanaḥ / prāha devo mahādevaṃ prasādābhimukhaṃ sthitam
verses.translation: It is through it (ego) that (the soul) experiences pleasure and misery in the (various) births. It is of the nature of Vijhana (knowledge) and the Manas (mind) is its accessory.
verses.hindi: राग, भय और क्रोधसे रहित, मत्परायण और मेरे आश्रित अनेक लोग इस (पाशुपत) योगके द्वारा मेरा भाव प्राप्तकर पवित्र हो गये हैं। जो जिस प्रकार मेरे पास आते हैं, में भी उसी प्रकार उन्हें स्वीकार करता हूँ। इसलिये ज्ञानयोगके द्वारा मुझ परमेश्वरकी आराधना करनी चाहिए। अथवा भक्तियोग, परम वैराग्य एवं ज्ञानयुक्त चित्तके द्वारा पवित्रतापूर्वक सदा मेरा पूजन करना चाहिए। सभी कर्मोका परित्यागकर,
verses.wordMeaning: It is through it (ego) that (the soul) experiences pleasure and misery in the (various) births. It is of the nature of Vijhana (knowledge) and the Manas (mind) is its accessory.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is through it (ego) that (the soul) experiences pleasure and misery in the (various) births. It is of the nature of Vijhana (knowledge) and the Manas (mind) is its accessory.

verses.sanskrit: इमे हि मुनयो देव तापसाः क्षीणकल्मषाः । अभ्यागता मां शरणं सम्यग्दर्शनकाङ्क्षिणः
verses.transliteration: ime hi munayo deva tāpasāḥ kṣīṇakalmaṣāḥ / abhyāgatā māṃ śaraṇaṃ samyagdarśanakāṅkṣiṇaḥ
verses.translation: Purusa identifies himself (with the world) even due to that (ego) and is involved in Sarhsara. That ignorance originates due to the union of Prakrti and Kala.
verses.hindi: भिक्षाका अन्न ग्रहण करते हुए अन्य कुछ भी संग्रह न करते हुए (साधना करनेवाला) साधक मेरा सायुज्य (नामक मोक्ष) प्राप्त करता है। यह मैंने गुह्य बात
verses.wordMeaning: Purusa identifies himself (with the world) even due to that (ego) and is involved in Sarhsara. That ignorance originates due to the union of Prakrti and Kala.
verses.commentary: Sense: Purusa identifies himself (with the world) even due to that (ego) and is involved in Sarhsara. That ignorance originates due to the union of Prakrti and Kala.

verses.sanskrit: यदि प्रसन्नो भगवान् मुनीनां भावितात्मनाम् । सन्निधौ मम तज्ज्ञानं दिव्यं वक्तुमिहार्हसि
verses.transliteration: yadi prasanno bhagavān munīnāṃ bhāvitātmanām / sannidhau mama tajjñānaṃ divyaṃ vaktumihārhasi
verses.translation: Purusa identifies himself (with the world) even due to that (ego) and is involved in Sarhsara. That ignorance originates due to the union of Prakrti and Kala.
verses.hindi: जो सभी प्राणियाँसे द्वेष न करनेवाला, मित्रता करनेवाला, करुणायुक्त, ममतारहित और अहंकारसे रहित है, वह मेरा भक्त मुझे प्रिय है। जो संतुष्ट रहनेवाला, निरन्तर योग-साधना करनेवाला, संयमित- चित्त, दृढनिश्चयी और मुझमें मन तथा बुद्धि अर्पण करनेवाला है, वह मेरा भक्त मुझे प्रिय है। जिससे किसी भी प्राणीको उद्देग प्राप्त नहीं होता और किसी भी प्राणीसे जो उद्विग्न नहीं होता तथा जो हर्ष, अमर्ष
verses.wordMeaning: Purusa identifies himself (with the world) even due to that (ego) and is involved in Sarhsara. That ignorance originates due to the union of Prakrti and Kala.
verses.commentary: Sense: Purusa identifies himself (with the world) even due to that (ego) and is involved in Sarhsara. That ignorance originates due to the union of Prakrti and Kala.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं हि वेत्थ स्वमात्मानं न ह्यन्यो विद्यते शिव । ततस्त्वमात्मनात्मानं मुनीन्द्रेभ्यः प्रदर्शय
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ hi vettha svamātmānaṃ na hyanyo vidyate śiva / tatastvamātmanātmānaṃ munīndrebhyaḥ pradarśaya
verses.translation: Purusa identifies himself (with the world) even due to that (ego) and is involved in Sarhsara. That ignorance originates due to the union of Prakrti and Kala.
verses.hindi: और भयसे होनेवाले उद्देगोंसे रहित है, वह मुझे प्रिय है॥ ७५--७७॥
verses.wordMeaning: Purusa identifies himself (with the world) even due to that (ego) and is involved in Sarhsara. That ignorance originates due to the union of Prakrti and Kala.
verses.commentary: Sense: Purusa identifies himself (with the world) even due to that (ego) and is involved in Sarhsara. That ignorance originates due to the union of Prakrti and Kala.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा हृषीकेशः प्रोवाच मुनिपुङ्गवान् । प्रदर्शयन् योगसिद्धिं निरीक्ष्य वृषभध्वजम्
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā hṛṣīkeśaḥ provāca munipuṅgavān / pradarśayan yogasiddhiṃ nirīkṣya vṛṣabhadhvajam
verses.translation: Purusa identifies himself (with the world) even due to that (ego) and is involved in Sarhsara. That ignorance originates due to the union of Prakrti and Kala.
verses.hindi: तुल्यनिन्दास्तुतिर्मौनी संतुष्टो येन केनचित्। अनिकेतः स्थिरमतिर्मद्भक्तो मामुपैष्यति सर्वकर्माण्यपि सदा कुर्वाणो मत्परायणः । मत्प्रसादादवाप्नोति शाश्वतं परमं पदम्
verses.wordMeaning: Purusa identifies himself (with the world) even due to that (ego) and is involved in Sarhsara. That ignorance originates due to the union of Prakrti and Kala.
verses.commentary: Sense: Purusa identifies himself (with the world) even due to that (ego) and is involved in Sarhsara. That ignorance originates due to the union of Prakrti and Kala.

verses.sanskrit: संदर्शनान्महेशस्य शङ्करस्याथ शूलिनः । कृतार्थं स्वयमात्मानं ज्ञातुमर्हथ तत्त्वतः
verses.transliteration: saṃdarśanānmaheśasya śaṅkarasyātha śūlinaḥ / kṛtārthaṃ svayamātmānaṃ jñātumarhatha tattvataḥ
verses.translation: Purusa identifies himself (with the world) even due to that (ego) and is involved in Sarhsara. That ignorance originates due to the union of Prakrti and Kala.
verses.hindi: चेतसा सर्वकर्माणि मयि संन्यस्य मत्परः।
verses.wordMeaning: Purusa identifies himself (with the world) even due to that (ego) and is involved in Sarhsara. That ignorance originates due to the union of Prakrti and Kala.
verses.commentary: Sense: Purusa identifies himself (with the world) even due to that (ego) and is involved in Sarhsara. That ignorance originates due to the union of Prakrti and Kala.

verses.sanskrit: प्रष्टुमर्हथ विश्वेशं प्रत्यक्षं पुरतः स्थितम् । ममैव सन्निधावेष यथावद् वक्तुमीश्वरः
verses.transliteration: praṣṭumarhatha viśveśaṃ pratyakṣaṃ purataḥ sthitam / mamaiva sannidhāveṣa yathāvad vaktumīśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Purusa identifies himself (with the world) even due to that (ego) and is involved in Sarhsara. That ignorance originates due to the union of Prakrti and Kala.
verses.hindi: त्यक्त्वा कर्मफलासङ्गं नित्यतृप्तो निराश्रयः । कर्मण्यभिप्रवृत्तोऽपि नैव तेन निबध्यते शारीरं केवलं कर्म कुर्वन्नाप्नोति तत्पदम्
verses.wordMeaning: Purusa identifies himself (with the world) even due to that (ego) and is involved in Sarhsara. That ignorance originates due to the union of Prakrti and Kala.
verses.commentary: Sense: Purusa identifies himself (with the world) even due to that (ego) and is involved in Sarhsara. That ignorance originates due to the union of Prakrti and Kala.

verses.sanskrit: निशम्य विष्णुवचनं प्रणम्य वृषभध्वजम् । सनत्कुमारप्रमुखाः पृच्छन्ति स्म महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: niśamya viṣṇuvacanaṃ praṇamya vṛṣabhadhvajam / sanatkumārapramukhāḥ pṛcchanti sma maheśvaram
verses.translation: Purusa identifies himself (with the world) even due to that (ego) and is involved in Sarhsara. That ignorance originates due to the union of Prakrti and Kala.
verses.hindi: कुर्वतो मत्प्रसादार्थं कर्म संसारनाशनम्
verses.wordMeaning: Purusa identifies himself (with the world) even due to that (ego) and is involved in Sarhsara. That ignorance originates due to the union of Prakrti and Kala.
verses.commentary: Sense: Purusa identifies himself (with the world) even due to that (ego) and is involved in Sarhsara. That ignorance originates due to the union of Prakrti and Kala.

verses.sanskrit: अथास्मिन्नन्तरे दिव्यमासनं विमलं शिवम् । किमप्यचिन्त्यं गगनादीश्वरार्हं समुद्बभौ
verses.transliteration: athāsminnantare divyamāsanaṃ vimalaṃ śivam / kimapyacintyaṃ gaganādīśvarārhaṃ samudbabhau
verses.translation: Purusa identifies himself (with the world) even due to that (ego) and is involved in Sarhsara. That ignorance originates due to the union of Prakrti and Kala.
verses.hindi: मन्मना मन्नमस्कारो मद्याजी मत्परायणः। मामुपैष्यति योगीशं ज्ञात्वा मां परमेश्वरम् एवं नित्याभियुक्तानां मायेयं कर्मसान्वगम्। नाशयामि तमः कृत्स्नं ज्ञानदीपेन भास्वता
verses.wordMeaning: Purusa identifies himself (with the world) even due to that (ego) and is involved in Sarhsara. That ignorance originates due to the union of Prakrti and Kala.
verses.commentary: Sense: Purusa identifies himself (with the world) even due to that (ego) and is involved in Sarhsara. That ignorance originates due to the union of Prakrti and Kala.

verses.sanskrit: तत्राससाद योगात्मा विष्णुना सह विश्वकृत् । तेजसा पूरयन् विश्वं भाति देवो महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: tatrāsasāda yogātmā viṣṇunā saha viśvakṛt / tejasā pūrayan viśvaṃ bhāti devo maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Purusa identifies himself (with the world) even due to that (ego) and is involved in Sarhsara. That ignorance originates due to the union of Prakrti and Kala.
verses.hindi: जो किसी भी प्रकारकी अपेक्षा न रखनेवाला, पवित्र, कुशल (वेदशास्त्र-निषिद्धके त्यागमें सावधान) पक्षपातसे (शत्रु-मित्रभावसे ) रहित, दुःखसे आक्रान्त होनेपर भी व्यथाका अनुभव न करनेवाला और सभी प्रकारके
verses.wordMeaning: Purusa identifies himself (with the world) even due to that (ego) and is involved in Sarhsara. That ignorance originates due to the union of Prakrti and Kala.
verses.commentary: Sense: Purusa identifies himself (with the world) even due to that (ego) and is involved in Sarhsara. That ignorance originates due to the union of Prakrti and Kala.

verses.sanskrit: तं ते देवादिदेवेशं शङ्करं ब्रह्मवादिनः । विभ्राजमानं विमले तस्मिन् ददृशुरासने
verses.transliteration: taṃ te devādideveśaṃ śaṅkaraṃ brahmavādinaḥ / vibhrājamānaṃ vimale tasmin dadṛśurāsane
verses.translation: Purusa identifies himself (with the world) even due to that (ego) and is involved in Sarhsara. That ignorance originates due to the union of Prakrti and Kala.
verses.hindi: आरम्भोंका परित्याग करनेवाला है, वह भक्तियुक्त पुरुष मेरा प्रिय है। जो निन्दा एवं स्तुतिको समान समझनेवाला, मननशील, जिस किसी भी पदार्थसे संतुष्ट रहनेवाला, गृहसे (गृहासक्तिसे) रहित है, वह स्थिर बुद्धिवाला मेरा भक्त मुझे प्राप्त करता है। मुझमें परायण रहनेवाला सभी कर्मोको सदा करते हुए भी मेरी कृपासे शाश्वत परमपद प्राप्त करता है॥७८--८०॥
verses.wordMeaning: Purusa identifies himself (with the world) even due to that (ego) and is involved in Sarhsara. That ignorance originates due to the union of Prakrti and Kala.
verses.commentary: Sense: Purusa identifies himself (with the world) even due to that (ego) and is involved in Sarhsara. That ignorance originates due to the union of Prakrti and Kala.

verses.sanskrit: यं प्रपश्यन्तियोगस्थाः स्वात्मन्यात्मानमीश्वरमा । अनन्यतेजसं शान्तं शिवं ददृशिरे किल
verses.transliteration: yaṃ prapaśyantiyogasthāḥ svātmanyātmānamīśvaramā / ananyatejasaṃ śāntaṃ śivaṃ dadṛśire kila
verses.translation: Purusa identifies himself (with the world) even due to that (ego) and is involved in Sarhsara. That ignorance originates due to the union of Prakrti and Kala.
verses.hindi: चित्तसे सभी कर्मोको मुझमें अर्पितकर मत्परायण होते हुए आशा एवं ममताकी आसक्तिसे रहित होकर एकमात्र मेरी ही शरण ग्रहण करना चाहिए। कर्मफलकी आसक्तिका सर्वथा परित्यागकर नित्य संतृप्त और
verses.wordMeaning: Purusa identifies himself (with the world) even due to that (ego) and is involved in Sarhsara. That ignorance originates due to the union of Prakrti and Kala.
verses.commentary: Sense: Purusa identifies himself (with the world) even due to that (ego) and is involved in Sarhsara. That ignorance originates due to the union of Prakrti and Kala.

verses.sanskrit: यतः प्रसूतिर्भूतानां यत्रैतत् प्रविलीयते । तमासनस्थं भूतानामीशं ददृशिरे किल
verses.transliteration: yataḥ prasūtirbhūtānāṃ yatraitat pravilīyate / tamāsanasthaṃ bhūtānāmīśaṃ dadṛśire kila
verses.translation: Purusa identifies himself (with the world) even due to that (ego) and is involved in Sarhsara. That ignorance originates due to the union of Prakrti and Kala.
verses.hindi: (अन्य) आश्रयरहित (एकमात्र परमेश्वरको ही आश्रय समझनेवाला) व्यक्ति कर्मोमें प्रवृत्त होते हुए भी उन कर्मोके द्वारा बन्धनमें नहीं पड़ता। आशारहित, संयमित चित्तवाला, सब प्रकारके परिग्रहों (संचयों)-का परित्याग- कर केवल शरीर (रक्षा)-के निमित्त कर्म करते हुए भी (व्यक्ति) उस पद (मोक्ष)-को प्राप्त कर लेता है
verses.wordMeaning: Purusa identifies himself (with the world) even due to that (ego) and is involved in Sarhsara. That ignorance originates due to the union of Prakrti and Kala.
verses.commentary: Sense: Purusa identifies himself (with the world) even due to that (ego) and is involved in Sarhsara. That ignorance originates due to the union of Prakrti and Kala.

verses.sanskrit: यदन्तरा सर्वमेतद् यतो ऽभिन्नमिदं जगत् । स वासुदेवमासीनं तमीशं ददृशुः किल
verses.transliteration: yadantarā sarvametad yato 'bhinnamidaṃ jagat / sa vāsudevamāsīnaṃ tamīśaṃ dadṛśuḥ kila
verses.translation: Purusa identifies himself (with the world) even due to that (ego) and is involved in Sarhsara. That ignorance originates due to the union of Prakrti and Kala.
verses.hindi: अनायास जो उपलब्ध हो उसीमें संतुष्ट रहनेवाले और सभी प्रकारके सुख-दुःखादि द्वन्द्वोंसे रहित रहनेवाले पुरुषके द्वारा केवल मेरी प्रसन्नताके लिये किये गये कर्म संसार (रूपी बन्धन)-का विनाश करनेवाले हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Purusa identifies himself (with the world) even due to that (ego) and is involved in Sarhsara. That ignorance originates due to the union of Prakrti and Kala.
verses.commentary: Sense: Purusa identifies himself (with the world) even due to that (ego) and is involved in Sarhsara. That ignorance originates due to the union of Prakrti and Kala.

verses.sanskrit: प्रोवाच पृष्टो भगवान् मुनीनां परमेश्वरः । निरीक्ष्य पुण्डरीकाक्षं स्वात्मयोगमनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: provāca pṛṣṭo bhagavān munīnāṃ parameśvaraḥ / nirīkṣya puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ svātmayogamanuttamam
verses.translation: Purusa identifies himself (with the world) even due to that (ego) and is involved in Sarhsara. That ignorance originates due to the union of Prakrti and Kala.
verses.hindi: मुझमें मन लगानेवाला, मुझे नमस्कार करनेवाला, मेरा पूजन करनेवाला और मुझे ही अपना परम अयन (आश्रय) समझनेवाला (योगी) मुझ योगके ईश परमेश्वरको जानकर मुझे प्राप्त कर लेता है। मुझमें बुद्धि रखनेवाले (साधक) सतत परस्पर मेरा बोध कराते हुए और नित्य मेरा वर्णन करते हुए मेरा सायुज्य प्राप्त करते हैं। इस प्रकार नित्य योगयुक्त पुरुषके माया (अज्ञान)- से उत्पन्न तथा उनसे भी उत्पन्न कर्मरूप समस्त
verses.wordMeaning: Purusa identifies himself (with the world) even due to that (ego) and is involved in Sarhsara. That ignorance originates due to the union of Prakrti and Kala.
verses.commentary: Sense: Purusa identifies himself (with the world) even due to that (ego) and is involved in Sarhsara. That ignorance originates due to the union of Prakrti and Kala.

verses.sanskrit: तच्छृणुध्वं यथान्यायमुच्यमानं मयानघाः । प्रशान्तमानसाः सर्वे ज्ञानमीश्वरभाषितम्
verses.transliteration: tacchṛṇudhvaṃ yathānyāyamucyamānaṃ mayānaghāḥ / praśāntamānasāḥ sarve jñānamīśvarabhāṣitam
verses.translation: Purusa identifies himself (with the world) even due to that (ego) and is involved in Sarhsara. That ignorance originates due to the union of Prakrti and Kala.
verses.hindi: अन्धकारका प्रकाशमान ज्ञानरूपी दीपकके द्वारा मैं नाश कर देता हुँ॥८४--८७॥
verses.wordMeaning: Purusa identifies himself (with the world) even due to that (ego) and is involved in Sarhsara. That ignorance originates due to the union of Prakrti and Kala.
verses.commentary: Sense: Purusa identifies himself (with the world) even due to that (ego) and is involved in Sarhsara. That ignorance originates due to the union of Prakrti and Kala.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे (ईश्वरगीतासु) प्रथमो ऽध्यायः ईश्वर उवाच अवाच्यमेतद् विज्ञानमात्मगुह्यं सनातनम् । यन्न देवा विजानन्ति यतन्तो ऽपि द्विजातयः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge (īśvaragītāsu) prathamo 'dhyāyaḥ īśvara uvāca avācyametad vijñānamātmaguhyaṃ sanātanam / yanna devā vijānanti yatanto 'pi dvijātayaḥ
verses.translation: Kala (Time) creates the living beings, Kala annihi¬ lates the subjects. Everything is dependent on Kala; Kala is not under the control of anyone.
verses.hindi: तेषां नित्याभियुक्तानां योगक्षेमं वहाम्यहम् येऽन्ये च कामभोगार्थ यजन्ते हान्यदेवता: । तेषां तदन्तं विज्ञेयं देवतानुगतं फलम्
verses.wordMeaning: Kala (Time) creates the living beings, Kala annihi¬ lates the subjects. Everything is dependent on Kala; Kala is not under the control of anyone.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kala (Time) creates the living beings, Kala annihi¬ lates the subjects. Everything is dependent on Kala; Kala is not under the control of anyone.

verses.sanskrit: इदं ज्ञानं समाश्रित्य ब्रह्मभूता द्विजोत्तमाः । न संसारं प्रपद्यन्ते पूर्वे ऽपि ब्रह्मवादिनः
verses.transliteration: idaṃ jñānaṃ samāśritya brahmabhūtā dvijottamāḥ / na saṃsāraṃ prapadyante pūrve 'pi brahmavādinaḥ
verses.translation: He is eternal and restrains everything from within. He is called Prana (the vital breath), omniscient, Lord Purusot- tama (The Supreme Purusa).
verses.hindi: ये चान्यदेवताभक्ताः पूजयन्तीह देवता: । मद्धावनासमायुक्ता मुच्यन्ते तेऽपि भावत:
verses.wordMeaning: He is eternal and restrains everything from within. He is called Prana (the vital breath), omniscient, Lord Purusot- tama (The Supreme Purusa).
verses.commentary: Sense: He is eternal and restrains everything from within. He is called Prana (the vital breath), omniscient, Lord Purusot- tama (The Supreme Purusa).

verses.sanskrit: गुह्याद् गुह्यतमं साक्षाद् गोपनीयं प्रयत्नतः । वक्ष्ये भक्तिमतामद्य युष्माकं ब्रह्मवादिनाम्
verses.transliteration: guhyād guhyatamaṃ sākṣād gopanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ / vakṣye bhaktimatāmadya yuṣmākaṃ brahmavādinām
verses.translation: Learned men say that Manas (mind) is superior to and beyond the sense-organs. Aharhkara is greater than and beyond Manor, and the principle Mahat is greater than Aharhkara.**
verses.hindi: तस्मादनीश्वरानन्यांस्त्यक्त्वा देवानशेषतः। मामेव संश्रयेदीशं स याति परमं पदम् त्यक्त्वा पुत्रादिषु स्नेहं निःशोको निष्परिग्रहः । यजेच्यामरणाल्लिङ्गे विरक्तः परमेश्वरम्
verses.wordMeaning: Learned men say that Manas (mind) is superior to and beyond the sense-organs. Aharhkara is greater than and beyond Manor, and the principle Mahat is greater than Aharhkara.**
verses.commentary: Sense: Learned men say that Manas (mind) is superior to and beyond the sense-organs. Aharhkara is greater than and beyond Manor, and the principle Mahat is greater than Aharhkara.**

verses.sanskrit: आत्मायः केवलः स्वस्थः शान्तः सूक्ष्मः सनातनः । अस्ति सर्वान्तरः साक्षाच्चिन्मात्रस्तमसः परः
verses.transliteration: ātmāyaḥ kevalaḥ svasthaḥ śāntaḥ sūkṣmaḥ sanātanaḥ / asti sarvāntaraḥ sākṣāccinmātrastamasaḥ paraḥ
verses.translation: Avyakta {the unmanikst Prakrti) is greater than and beyond Mahat, Purusa is Superior to and beyond Avjakta; Lord
verses.hindi: एकेन जन्मना तेषां ददामि परमैश्चरम्
verses.wordMeaning: Avyakta {the unmanikst Prakrti) is greater than and beyond Mahat, Purusa is Superior to and beyond Avjakta; Lord
verses.commentary: Sense: Avyakta {the unmanikst Prakrti) is greater than and beyond Mahat, Purusa is Superior to and beyond Avjakta; Lord

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽन्तर्यामी स पुरुषः स प्राणः स महेश्वरः । स कालो ऽग्निस्तदव्यक्तं स एवेदमिति श्रुतिः
verses.transliteration: so 'ntaryāmī sa puruṣaḥ sa prāṇaḥ sa maheśvaraḥ / sa kālo 'gnistadavyaktaṃ sa evedamiti śrutiḥ
verses.translation: Vyoman (the ether) is greater than and beyond Prana; the fire-god is beyond Vyoman; I am that unchanging Brahman; the quiescent one. This universe is beyond Maya (v.l. I am the embodiment of knowledge, the supreme lord).
verses.hindi: परानन्दात्मकं लिङ्गं केवलं सन्निरञ्जनम्। ज्ञानात्मकं सर्वगतं योगिनां हृदि संस्थितम् जले वा वह्लिमध्ये वा व्योम्नि सूर्येऽथ वान्यतः । रलादौ भावयित्वेशमर्चयेल्लिङ्गमेश्वरम्
verses.wordMeaning: Vyoman (the ether) is greater than and beyond Prana; the fire-god is beyond Vyoman; I am that unchanging Brahman; the quiescent one. This universe is beyond Maya (v.l. I am the embodiment of knowledge, the supreme lord).
verses.commentary: Sense: Vyoman (the ether) is greater than and beyond Prana; the fire-god is beyond Vyoman; I am that unchanging Brahman; the quiescent one. This universe is beyond Maya (v.l. I am the embodiment of knowledge, the supreme lord).

verses.sanskrit: अस्माद् विजायते विश्वमत्रैव प्रविलीयते । स मायी मायया बद्धः करोति विविधास्तनूः
verses.transliteration: asmād vijāyate viśvamatraiva pravilīyate / sa māyī māyayā baddhaḥ karoti vividhāstanūḥ
verses.translation: The lord, master of Maya and identical with it, is united with Kala. Due to my presence this Kala, the infinite Atman, creates the entire universe and controls it (by propel¬ ling it to work). This is the injunction (teaching) of the Vedas.
verses.hindi: मुझमें बुद्धि लगानेवाले जो मनुष्य सतत मेरी पूजा करते हैं, उन नित्य योगयुक्त पुरुषोंके योग- क्षेमका मैं निर्वाह करता हुँ और जो दूसरे लोग अभिलषित विषयोंके उपभोगके लिये ही भिन्न-भिन्न
verses.wordMeaning: The lord, master of Maya and identical with it, is united with Kala. Due to my presence this Kala, the infinite Atman, creates the entire universe and controls it (by propel¬ ling it to work). This is the injunction (teaching) of the Vedas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord, master of Maya and identical with it, is united with Kala. Due to my presence this Kala, the infinite Atman, creates the entire universe and controls it (by propel¬ ling it to work). This is the injunction (teaching) of the Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: न चाप्ययं संसरति न च संसारयेत् प्रभुः । नायं पृथ्वी न सलिलं न तेजः पवनो नभः
verses.transliteration: na cāpyayaṃ saṃsarati na ca saṃsārayet prabhuḥ / nāyaṃ pṛthvī na salilaṃ na tejaḥ pavano nabhaḥ
verses.translation: This chapter describes the Cosmic dance of Siva but takes care to emphasize the identity of Siva and Visnu (V. 17).
verses.hindi: ही समझना चाहिए, क्योंकि देवताके अनुसार ही फल भी होता है'। जो दूसरे देवोंके भक्त हैं, वे यदि मेरी भावनासे युक्त होकर (दूसरे) देवताओंकी पूजा करते हैं अर्थात् दूसरे देवोंमें मेरी ही भावना करते हैं तो वे भी (मुझमें) भावना करनेके कारण मुक्त हो जाते हैं। अतएव समस्त अनीश्वर! देवताओंका परित्यागकर जो मुझ ईशका ही आश्रय ग्रहण करता है, वह परमपदको प्रात करता है॥८८--९१॥
verses.wordMeaning: This chapter describes the Cosmic dance of Siva but takes care to emphasize the identity of Siva and Visnu (V. 17).
verses.commentary: Sense: This chapter describes the Cosmic dance of Siva but takes care to emphasize the identity of Siva and Visnu (V. 17).

verses.sanskrit: न प्राणे न मनो ऽव्यक्तं न शब्दः स्पर्श एव च । न रूपरसगन्धाश्च नाहं कर्ता न वागपि
verses.transliteration: na prāṇe na mano 'vyaktaṃ na śabdaḥ sparśa eva ca / na rūparasagandhāśca nāhaṃ kartā na vāgapi
verses.translation: They saw Isana, the greatest treasure-house of splend¬ our, the sovereign lord, dancing along with Visnu in the clear firmament.
verses.hindi: पुत्र (स्त्री, गृह) आदिमें आसक्तिका परित्यागकर और शोकरहित होकर तथा अपरिग्रही होकर विरक्त पुरुषको मृत्युपर्यन्त (शिव-) लिङ्गमें परमेश्वरको आराधना करनी चाहिए। जो सम्पूर्ण भोगोंका परित्यागकर सर्वदा
verses.wordMeaning: They saw Isana, the greatest treasure-house of splend¬ our, the sovereign lord, dancing along with Visnu in the clear firmament.
verses.commentary: Sense: They saw Isana, the greatest treasure-house of splend¬ our, the sovereign lord, dancing along with Visnu in the clear firmament.

verses.sanskrit: न पाणिपादौ नो पायुर्न चोपस्थं द्विजोत्तमाः । न कर्ता न च भोक्ता वा न च प्रकृतिपूरुषौ । न माया नैव च प्राश्चैतन्यं परमार्थतः
verses.transliteration: na pāṇipādau no pāyurna copasthaṃ dvijottamāḥ / na kartā na ca bhoktā vā na ca prakṛtipūruṣau / na māyā naiva ca prāścaitanyaṃ paramārthataḥ
verses.translation: In the firmament, they saw that lord of all living beings whom the Yogins, the knowers of the principles of Yoga who have their minds under control, realize.
verses.hindi: लिङ्गका पूजन करते रहते हैं, उन्हें मैं एक जन्ममें ही परम ऐश्वर-पद (मोक्ष) प्रदान करता हूँ। परम और सर्वत्र व्याप्त (शिव-) लिङ्ग योगियोंके हृदय- प्रदेशमें अवस्थित रहता है
verses.wordMeaning: In the firmament, they saw that lord of all living beings whom the Yogins, the knowers of the principles of Yoga who have their minds under control, realize.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the firmament, they saw that lord of all living beings whom the Yogins, the knowers of the principles of Yoga who have their minds under control, realize.

verses.sanskrit: यथा प्रकाशतमसोः सम्बन्धो नोपपद्यते । तद्वदैक्यं न संबन्धः प्रपञ्चपरमात्मनोः
verses.transliteration: yathā prakāśatamasoḥ sambandho nopapadyate / tadvadaikyaṃ na saṃbandhaḥ prapañcaparamātmanoḥ
verses.translation: The sovereign Lord of the universe who impels the world into action which is the creation of his Maya, was verily seen dancing by Brahmanas.
