verses.hindi: नियमपूर्वक भक्ति करनेवाले दूसरे लोग विधि- पूर्वक जहाॉँ-कहीं भी (शिवलिङ्गकी) भावना करते हुए उस महेश्वर-लिङ्गकी अर्चना करते हैं। जलमें, अग्निके मध्यमें, आकाशमें, सूर्यमें, रत्न आदिमें अथवा
verses.wordMeaning: The sovereign Lord of the universe who impels the world into action which is the creation of his Maya, was verily seen dancing by Brahmanas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sovereign Lord of the universe who impels the world into action which is the creation of his Maya, was verily seen dancing by Brahmanas.

verses.sanskrit: छायातपौ यथा लोके परस्परविलक्षणौ । तद्वत् प्रपञ्चपुरुषौ विभिन्नौ परमार्थतः
verses.transliteration: chāyātapau yathā loke parasparavilakṣaṇau / tadvat prapañcapuruṣau vibhinnau paramārthataḥ
verses.translation: They saw the lord oiBhutas (creatures or elements) dancing, the lord by remembering whose lotus-like feet a man can eschew the fear originating from ignorance.
verses.hindi: अन्यत्र कहीं भी ईशकी भावना करके लिङ्गरूप इश्वरको आराधना करनी चाहिए। यह सब कुछ लिङ्गमय है और सब कुछ लिङ्गमें प्रतिष्ठित है, अतएव जहाँ-कहीं भी लिङ्गरूपमें शाश्वत ईशका अर्चन १-देवताके अनुसार फलका तात्पर्य यह है कि जैसी भावनासे देवताकी आराधना की जाती है, वैसी भावनाके अनुसार ही देवता फल देते हैं, जिस रूपमें हम देवताको समझेंगे, उसी रूपमें देवता हमें लाभ देंगे। तत्-तत् फलोंके अधिष्ठाता रूपमें ही देवताकी
verses.wordMeaning: They saw the lord oiBhutas (creatures or elements) dancing, the lord by remembering whose lotus-like feet a man can eschew the fear originating from ignorance.
verses.commentary: Sense: They saw the lord oiBhutas (creatures or elements) dancing, the lord by remembering whose lotus-like feet a man can eschew the fear originating from ignorance.

verses.sanskrit: यद्यात्मा मलिनो ऽस्वस्थो विकारी स्यात् स्वभावतः । नहि तस्य भवेन्मुक्तिर्जन्मान्तरशतैरपि
verses.transliteration: yadyātmā malino 'svastho vikārī syāt svabhāvataḥ / nahi tasya bhavenmuktirjanmāntaraśatairapi
verses.translation: Those who have conquered their sleep and controlled their breath, who are quiescent and endowed with devotion, see him as full of brilliance, that is how Siva the Yogin was seen.
verses.hindi: आराधना करनेपर फलमात्र देकर देवता विरत हो जाते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Those who have conquered their sleep and controlled their breath, who are quiescent and endowed with devotion, see him as full of brilliance, that is how Siva the Yogin was seen.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who have conquered their sleep and controlled their breath, who are quiescent and endowed with devotion, see him as full of brilliance, that is how Siva the Yogin was seen.

verses.sanskrit: पश्यन्ति मुनयो युक्ताः स्वात्मानं परमार्थतः । विकारहीनं निर्दुः खमानन्दात्मानमव्ययम्
verses.transliteration: paśyanti munayo yuktāḥ svātmānaṃ paramārthataḥ / vikārahīnaṃ nirduḥ khamānandātmānamavyayam
verses.translation: In the firmament, they saw the great Rudra, the liberator, the delighted lord, favourably disposed to his devotees and who instantaneously liberates the devotees from ignorance.
verses.hindi: २-एक ही देवता पूजककी दृष्टिमें तबतक अनीश्वर है, जबतक पूजक उसे किसी तुच्छ फलका अधिष्ठाता मात्र समझता है। यदि उसी देवताको परमेश्वरके भावसे निष्काम होकर पूर्ण समर्पण-भावके साथ पूजा जाय तो वह देवता अनीश्वर नहीं है, सर्वथा सेवनीय है।
verses.wordMeaning: In the firmament, they saw the great Rudra, the liberator, the delighted lord, favourably disposed to his devotees and who instantaneously liberates the devotees from ignorance.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the firmament, they saw the great Rudra, the liberator, the delighted lord, favourably disposed to his devotees and who instantaneously liberates the devotees from ignorance.

verses.sanskrit: अहं कर्ता सुखी दुः खी कृशः स्थूलेति या मतिः । सा चाहङ्कारकर्तृत्वादात्मन्यारोप्यते जनैः
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ kartā sukhī duḥ khī kṛśaḥ sthūleti yā matiḥ / sā cāhaṅkārakartṛtvādātmanyāropyate janaiḥ
verses.translation: They saw the lord with a thousand (i.e. innumerable) heads, a thousand feet, a thousand shapes, and a thousand arms.
verses.hindi: काष्ठादिष्वेव मूर्खाणां हृदि लिडुंतु योगिनाम्
verses.wordMeaning: They saw the lord with a thousand (i.e. innumerable) heads, a thousand feet, a thousand shapes, and a thousand arms.
verses.commentary: Sense: They saw the lord with a thousand (i.e. innumerable) heads, a thousand feet, a thousand shapes, and a thousand arms.

verses.sanskrit: वदन्ति वेदविद्वांसः साक्षिणं प्रकृतेः परम् । भोक्तारमक्षरं शुद्धं सर्वत्र समवस्थितम्
verses.transliteration: vadanti vedavidvāṃsaḥ sākṣiṇaṃ prakṛteḥ param / bhoktāramakṣaraṃ śuddhaṃ sarvatra samavasthitam
verses.translation: The lord was wearing the tiger's hide; his mighty hand was holding the trident; he had a staff" in his hand; he had the sun, the moon and the fire as three eyes.
verses.hindi: यावज्जीवं जपेद् युक्तः प्रणवं ब्रह्मणो वपुः एकाकी यतचित्तात्मा स याति परमं पदम्
verses.wordMeaning: The lord was wearing the tiger's hide; his mighty hand was holding the trident; he had a staff" in his hand; he had the sun, the moon and the fire as three eyes.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord was wearing the tiger's hide; his mighty hand was holding the trident; he had a staff" in his hand; he had the sun, the moon and the fire as three eyes.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादज्ञानमूलो हि संसारः सर्वदेहिनाम् । अज्ञानादन्यथा ज्ञानं तच्च प्रकृतिसंगतम्
verses.transliteration: tasmādajñānamūlo hi saṃsāraḥ sarvadehinām / ajñānādanyathā jñānaṃ tacca prakṛtisaṃgatam
verses.translation: By his brilliance he had enveloped the whole of the cosmic egg; he was standing with a refulgence equal to that of a crore of suns; he appeared terrible due to his fearful large teeth and was unthwartable.
verses.hindi: वसेद् वामरणाद् विप्रो वाराणस्यां समाहितः । सोऽपीश्वरप्रसादेन याति तत् परमं पदम्
verses.wordMeaning: By his brilliance he had enveloped the whole of the cosmic egg; he was standing with a refulgence equal to that of a crore of suns; he appeared terrible due to his fearful large teeth and was unthwartable.
verses.commentary: Sense: By his brilliance he had enveloped the whole of the cosmic egg; he was standing with a refulgence equal to that of a crore of suns; he appeared terrible due to his fearful large teeth and was unthwartable.

verses.sanskrit: नित्योदितः स्वयं ज्योतिः सर्वगः पुरुषः परः । अहङ्काराविवेकेन कर्ताहमिति मन्यते
verses.transliteration: nityoditaḥ svayaṃ jyotiḥ sarvagaḥ puruṣaḥ paraḥ / ahaṅkārāvivekena kartāhamiti manyate
verses.translation: They saw the Lord, the creator of the universe dancing and emitting flames of fire and thereby burning (as it were) the entire universe.
verses.hindi: तत्रोत्क्रमणकाले हि सर्वेषामेव देहिनाम् । ददाति तत् परं ज्ञानं येन मुच्येत बन्धनात् तेनैव जन्मना ज्ञानं लब्ध्वा याति शिवं पदम्
verses.wordMeaning: They saw the Lord, the creator of the universe dancing and emitting flames of fire and thereby burning (as it were) the entire universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: They saw the Lord, the creator of the universe dancing and emitting flames of fire and thereby burning (as it were) the entire universe.

verses.sanskrit: पश्यन्ति ऋषयो ऽव्यक्तं नित्यं सदसदात्मकम् । प्रधानं प्रकृतिं बुद्ध्वा कारणं ब्रह्मवादिनः
verses.transliteration: paśyanti ṛṣayo 'vyaktaṃ nityaṃ sadasadātmakam / pradhānaṃ prakṛtiṃ buddhvā kāraṇaṃ brahmavādinaḥ
verses.translation: They visualised the great God, the veritable great Yoga incarnate, the divinity of celestial beings, the lord of all Pasus (individual souls), the supreme Ruler, the imperishable bliss and Light.
verses.hindi: येऽपि तत्र वसन्तीह नीचा वा पापयोनयः । सर्वे तरन्ति संसारमीश्वरानुग्रहाद् द्विजाः
verses.wordMeaning: They visualised the great God, the veritable great Yoga incarnate, the divinity of celestial beings, the lord of all Pasus (individual souls), the supreme Ruler, the imperishable bliss and Light.
verses.commentary: Sense: They visualised the great God, the veritable great Yoga incarnate, the divinity of celestial beings, the lord of all Pasus (individual souls), the supreme Ruler, the imperishable bliss and Light.

verses.sanskrit: तेनायं संगतो ह्यात्मा कूटस्थो ऽपि निरञ्जनः । स्वात्मानमक्षरं ब्रह्म नावबुद्ध्येत तत्त्वतः
verses.transliteration: tenāyaṃ saṃgato hyātmā kūṭastho 'pi nirañjanaḥ / svātmānamakṣaraṃ brahma nāvabuddhyeta tattvataḥ
verses.translation: They saw the Pinaka-bearing Lord of large eyes: the antidote for those who ail from worldly existence (saihsara), the lord who was the soul of Kala, the lord of Devas; the slayer of Kala.
verses.hindi: किन्तु विघ्ना भविष्यन्ति पापोपहतचेतसाम्। धर्म समाश्रयेत् तस्मान्मुक्तये नियतं द्विजाः १०५॥ धार्मिकायैव दातव्यं भक्ताय ब्रह्मचारिणे
verses.wordMeaning: They saw the Pinaka-bearing Lord of large eyes: the antidote for those who ail from worldly existence (saihsara), the lord who was the soul of Kala, the lord of Devas; the slayer of Kala.
verses.commentary: Sense: They saw the Pinaka-bearing Lord of large eyes: the antidote for those who ail from worldly existence (saihsara), the lord who was the soul of Kala, the lord of Devas; the slayer of Kala.

verses.sanskrit: अनात्मन्यात्मविज्ञानं तस्माद् दुः खं तथेतरम् । रगद्वेषादयो दोषाः सर्वे भ्रान्तिनिबन्धनाः
verses.transliteration: anātmanyātmavijñānaṃ tasmād duḥ khaṃ tathetaram / ragadveṣādayo doṣāḥ sarve bhrāntinibandhanāḥ
verses.translation: They saw the consort of Uma, the great deity of large eyes and full of Yogic bliss; the lord who is the abode of knowledge and detachment; the eternal lord of the path of knowledge.
verses.hindi: इत्येतदुक्त्वा भगवानात्मयोगमनुत्तमम्।
verses.wordMeaning: They saw the consort of Uma, the great deity of large eyes and full of Yogic bliss; the lord who is the abode of knowledge and detachment; the eternal lord of the path of knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: They saw the consort of Uma, the great deity of large eyes and full of Yogic bliss; the lord who is the abode of knowledge and detachment; the eternal lord of the path of knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: कर्मण्यस्य भवेद् दोषः पुण्यापुण्यमिति स्थितिः । तद्वशादेव सर्वेषां सर्वदेहसमुद्भवः
verses.transliteration: karmaṇyasya bhaved doṣaḥ puṇyāpuṇyamiti sthitiḥ / tadvaśādeva sarveṣāṃ sarvadehasamudbhavaḥ
verses.translation: At the beginning of universe, I created Brahma, Paramesthin and handed over to him the Vedas that came out of myself.
verses.hindi: व्याजहार समासीनं नारायणमनामयम् क्रियाशीलोंका (लिङ्ग) आग्निमें, मनीषियोंका' जल, आकाश और सूर्यमें, आज्ञानियोंका काष्ठ आदिमें और योगियोंका लिङ्ग हृदयमें स्थित रहता है। यदि (ब्रह्म) विज्ञान उत्पन्न न हुआ हो तो विरक्त होकर (द्विजको)
verses.wordMeaning: At the beginning of universe, I created Brahma, Paramesthin and handed over to him the Vedas that came out of myself.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the beginning of universe, I created Brahma, Paramesthin and handed over to him the Vedas that came out of myself.

verses.sanskrit: नित्यः सर्वत्रगो ह्यात्मा कूटस्थो दोषवर्जितः । एकः स भिद्यते शक्त्या मायया न स्वभावतः
verses.transliteration: nityaḥ sarvatrago hyātmā kūṭastho doṣavarjitaḥ / ekaḥ sa bhidyate śaktyā māyayā na svabhāvataḥ
verses.translation: I alone am the unchanging (eternal) preceptor of all Yogins; I am the protector of the virtuous and the slayer of those who hate the Vedas.
verses.hindi: अत्यन्त प्रीतिसे ब्रह्मके प्रणवरूपी शरीरका यावज्ीवन जप करते हुए रहना चाहिए। अथवा एकाकी एवं संयत-चित्तवाले द्विजको मरणपर्यन्त शतरुद्रियका जप करना चाहिए, इससे उसे परम पद प्राप्त होता है।
verses.wordMeaning: I alone am the unchanging (eternal) preceptor of all Yogins; I am the protector of the virtuous and the slayer of those who hate the Vedas.
verses.commentary: Sense: I alone am the unchanging (eternal) preceptor of all Yogins; I am the protector of the virtuous and the slayer of those who hate the Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादद्वैतमेवाहुर्मुनयः परमार्थतः । भेदो व्यक्तस्वभावेन सा च मायात्मसंश्रया
verses.transliteration: tasmādadvaitamevāhurmunayaḥ paramārthataḥ / bhedo vyaktasvabhāvena sā ca māyātmasaṃśrayā
verses.translation: I am the liberator of Yogins here from all worldly bondage. I am the cause as well of worldly existence though I am bereft of all worldly ties.
verses.hindi: अथवा विप्रको चाहिए कि मरणपर्यन्त समाहितचित्त होकर वाराणसीमें निवास करे। वह भी ईश्वर (शंकर)- के अनुग्रहसे उत्कृष्ट परमपदको प्राप्त करता है। वहाँ (वाराणसीमें) सभी प्राणियोंको उनके प्राण निकलते समय (भगवान् शंकर) उस परम ज्ञानको प्रदान करते हें, जिससे वे (पुनर्जन्मके) बन्धनसे मुक्त हो जाते हैं ॥ ९८--१०२॥
verses.wordMeaning: I am the liberator of Yogins here from all worldly bondage. I am the cause as well of worldly existence though I am bereft of all worldly ties.
verses.commentary: Sense: I am the liberator of Yogins here from all worldly bondage. I am the cause as well of worldly existence though I am bereft of all worldly ties.

verses.sanskrit: यथा हि धूमसंपर्कान्नाकाशो मलिनो भवेत् । अन्तः करणजैर्भावैरात्मा तद्वन्न लिप्यते
verses.transliteration: yathā hi dhūmasaṃparkānnākāśo malino bhavet / antaḥ karaṇajairbhāvairātmā tadvanna lipyate
verses.translation: I alone am the annihilator, the creator and the pro¬ tector of the universe. Maya, the enchantress of the worlds, is my own potency.
verses.hindi: सम्पूर्ण वर्णाश्रम-विधिका पालन करते हुए मेरे परायण रहनेवाला अपने उसी जन्ममें (जिस जन्ममें वर्णाश्रम-धर्मका पालन कर रहा है) ज्ञान प्राप्तकर शिवपदको प्राप्त करता है। द्विजो! नीच अथवा पापयोनिवाले
verses.wordMeaning: I alone am the annihilator, the creator and the pro¬ tector of the universe. Maya, the enchantress of the worlds, is my own potency.
verses.commentary: Sense: I alone am the annihilator, the creator and the pro¬ tector of the universe. Maya, the enchantress of the worlds, is my own potency.

verses.sanskrit: यथा स्वप्रभया भाति केवलः स्फटिको ऽमलः । उपाधिहीनो विमलस्तथैवात्मा प्रकाशते
verses.transliteration: yathā svaprabhayā bhāti kevalaḥ sphaṭiko 'malaḥ / upādhihīno vimalastathaivātmā prakāśate
verses.translation: What is called as Vidya (knowledge) is my own trans¬ cendental power. Stationed in the hearts of Yogins, I annihi¬ late that Maya.
verses.hindi: भी जो प्राणी वहाँ (वाराणसीमें) निवास करते हैं, वे सभी ईश्वर (शंकर)-के अनुग्रहसे संसारको पार कर लेते हैं, किंतु जो पापाक्रान्त चित्तवाले हैं, उन्हें बहुत विघ्न होते हैं। इसलिये द्विजो! मुक्ति प्राप्त करनेके लिये निरन्तर धर्मका आश्रय ग्रहण करना चाहिए। यह वेदोंका रहस्य है, इसे जिस किसीको नहीं देना चाहिए। धार्मिक तथा ब्रह्मचारी भक्तको ही प्रदान करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: What is called as Vidya (knowledge) is my own trans¬ cendental power. Stationed in the hearts of Yogins, I annihi¬ late that Maya.
verses.commentary: Sense: What is called as Vidya (knowledge) is my own trans¬ cendental power. Stationed in the hearts of Yogins, I annihi¬ late that Maya.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानस्वूपमेवाहुर्जगदेतद् विचक्षणाः । अर्थस्वरूपमेवाज्ञाः पश्यन्त्यन्ये कुदृष्टयः
verses.transliteration: jñānasvūpamevāhurjagadetad vicakṣaṇāḥ / arthasvarūpamevājñāḥ paśyantyanye kudṛṣṭayaḥ
verses.translation: I am the originator and restrainer of all powers. I am the support of all potencies. I am the storehouse of nectar (or immortality).
verses.hindi: व्यासजी बोले-इस प्रकार उत्तम आत्मयोगका वर्णन करके भगवान् (शंकर)-ने वहीं बैठे हुए प्रसन्नचित्त नारायणसे कहा-
verses.wordMeaning: I am the originator and restrainer of all powers. I am the support of all potencies. I am the storehouse of nectar (or immortality).
verses.commentary: Sense: I am the originator and restrainer of all powers. I am the support of all potencies. I am the storehouse of nectar (or immortality).

verses.sanskrit: कूटस्थो निर्गुणो व्यापी चैतन्यात्मा स्वभावतः । दृश्यते ह्यर्थरूपेण पुरुषैर्भ्रान्तिदृष्टिभिः
verses.transliteration: kūṭastho nirguṇo vyāpī caitanyātmā svabhāvataḥ / dṛśyate hyartharūpeṇa puruṣairbhrāntidṛṣṭibhiḥ
verses.translation: All of us bow down to you, the only supreme Ruler, the ancient Purusa, the lord of the Pranas (vital breaths), RUDRA of infinite Yogic Power. You are stationed in the cavity of the heart, you are Pracetas (of lofty mind), holy and identical with Brahman.
verses.hindi: १-'क्रियाशील'से उन द्विजोंको समझना चाहिए जो श्रौत-स्मार्त क्रियाओंमें दत्तचित्त हैं। इनका प्रमुख आराध्य अग्नि होता है। २-“मनीषी से उन्हें समझना चाहिए जो यथाविधि श्रौत-स्मार्त क्रियाओंके अनुष्ठानसे शुद्धान्तःकरण होकर ब्रह्मनिष्ठाकी ओर अग्रसर हैं। ३-' अज्ञानी ' शब्दसे उन्हें समझना चाहिए जो वेद-शास्त्रके प्रति निष्ठावान् हैं, पर ऐहलौकिक विविध ऐश्वर्योके प्रति आसक्त हैं, इन्हें प्राप्त करनेके लिये उत्कण्ठित हँ ।
verses.wordMeaning: All of us bow down to you, the only supreme Ruler, the ancient Purusa, the lord of the Pranas (vital breaths), RUDRA of infinite Yogic Power. You are stationed in the cavity of the heart, you are Pracetas (of lofty mind), holy and identical with Brahman.
verses.commentary: Sense: All of us bow down to you, the only supreme Ruler, the ancient Purusa, the lord of the Pranas (vital breaths), RUDRA of infinite Yogic Power. You are stationed in the cavity of the heart, you are Pracetas (of lofty mind), holy and identical with Brahman.

verses.sanskrit: यथा संलक्ष्यते रक्तः केवलः स्फटिको जनैः । रक्तिकाद्युपधानेन तद्वत् परमपूरुषः
verses.transliteration: yathā saṃlakṣyate raktaḥ kevalaḥ sphaṭiko janaiḥ / raktikādyupadhānena tadvat paramapūruṣaḥ
verses.translation: After meditating within their self in their (physical) bodies on the absolutely immovable or unagitated Kavi (the seer or the wise) who is supremely superior to the greatest, the quiescent sages of perfect self-control perceive you, the pure, gold-complexioned God originating from the Brahman (or the creator of God Brahma).
verses.hindi: ५-सर्वप्रमुख होनेसे यहाँ ' विप्र' मात्रका उल्लेख है। यह विप्र' शब्द प्राणिमात्रका उपलक्षक है।
verses.wordMeaning: After meditating within their self in their (physical) bodies on the absolutely immovable or unagitated Kavi (the seer or the wise) who is supremely superior to the greatest, the quiescent sages of perfect self-control perceive you, the pure,…
verses.commentary: Sense: After meditating within their self in their (physical) bodies on the absolutely immovable or unagitated Kavi (the seer or the wise) who is supremely superior to the greatest, the quiescent sages of perfect self-control perceive you, the pure,…

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादात्माक्षरः शुद्धो नित्यः सर्वगतो ऽव्ययः । उपासितव्यो मन्तव्यः श्रोतव्यश्च मुमुक्षुभिः
verses.transliteration: tasmādātmākṣaraḥ śuddho nityaḥ sarvagato 'vyayaḥ / upāsitavyo mantavyaḥ śrotavyaśca mumukṣubhiḥ
verses.translation: The mother of the universe [Prakrti) is born of you- though minute like the atom, you experience (perceive) every¬ thing. You are minuter than the minute atom and greater than the greatest being. * Sages say that you alone are all.
verses.hindi: मयेतद् भाषितं ज्ञानं हितार्थ ब्रह्मवादिनाम्। दातव्यं शान्तचित्तेभ्य: शिष्येभ्यो भवता शिवम् उक्त्वैवमथ योगीन्द्रानब्रवीद् भगवानज: । हिताय सर्वभक्तानां द्विजातीनां द्विजोत्तमा:
verses.wordMeaning: The mother of the universe [Prakrti) is born of you- though minute like the atom, you experience (perceive) every¬ thing. You are minuter than the minute atom and greater than the greatest being. * Sages say that you alone are all.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mother of the universe [Prakrti) is born of you- though minute like the atom, you experience (perceive) every¬ thing. You are minuter than the minute atom and greater than the greatest being. * Sages say that you alone are all.

verses.sanskrit: यदा मनसि चैतन्यं भाति सर्वत्रगं सदा । योगिनो ऽव्यवधानेन तदा संपद्यते स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: yadā manasi caitanyaṃ bhāti sarvatragaṃ sadā / yogino 'vyavadhānena tadā saṃpadyate svayam
verses.translation: Some perceive me through meditation, others through the path of spiritual knowledge; others through the path of devotion and still others through the path of action.
verses.hindi: अयं नारायणो योऽहमीश्वरो नात्र संशय: । नान्तरं ये प्रपश्यन्ति तेषां देयमिदं परम्
verses.wordMeaning: Some perceive me through meditation, others through the path of spiritual knowledge; others through the path of devotion and still others through the path of action.
verses.commentary: Sense: Some perceive me through meditation, others through the path of spiritual knowledge; others through the path of devotion and still others through the path of action.

verses.sanskrit: यदा सर्वाणि बूतानि स्वात्मन्येवाभिपश्यति । सर्वभूतेषु चात्मानं ब्रह्म संपद्यते तदा
verses.transliteration: yadā sarvāṇi būtāni svātmanyevābhipaśyati / sarvabhūteṣu cātmānaṃ brahma saṃpadyate tadā
verses.translation: The Vedas are born of you; and ultimately they find stability in you alone. We see that you are the cause of the universe. We see that you who abide in our own hearts, are dancing.
verses.hindi: ममेषा परमा मूर्तिर्नारायणसमाह्वया। सर्वभूतात्मभूतस्था शान्ता चाक्षरसंज्ञिता ये त्वन्यथा प्रपश्यन्ति लोके भेददूशो जनाः। न ते मां सम्प्रपश्यन्ति जायन्ते च पुनः पुनः
verses.wordMeaning: The Vedas are born of you; and ultimately they find stability in you alone. We see that you are the cause of the universe. We see that you who abide in our own hearts, are dancing.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Vedas are born of you; and ultimately they find stability in you alone. We see that you are the cause of the universe. We see that you who abide in our own hearts, are dancing.

verses.sanskrit: यदा सर्वाणि भूतानि समाधिस्थो न पश्यति । एकीभूतः परेणासौ तदा भवति केवलः
verses.transliteration: yadā sarvāṇi bhūtāni samādhistho na paśyati / ekībhūtaḥ pareṇāsau tadā bhavati kevalaḥ
verses.translation: This wheel of Brahman (the creation etc. of Brah- manda) is made to revolve by you alone. You are the master of Maya and the only lord of the worlds. We seek refuge in you and bow into you; the very soul of Yoga, who dance the divine dance.
verses.hindi: ये त्विमं विष्णुमव्यक्तं मां वा देवं महेश्वरम्। एकीभावेन पश्यन्ति न तेषां पुनरुद्भवः
verses.wordMeaning: This wheel of Brahman (the creation etc. of Brah- manda) is made to revolve by you alone. You are the master of Maya and the only lord of the worlds. We seek refuge in you and bow into you; the very soul of Yoga, who dance the divine dance.
verses.commentary: Sense: This wheel of Brahman (the creation etc. of Brah- manda) is made to revolve by you alone. You are the master of Maya and the only lord of the worlds. We seek refuge in you and bow into you; the very soul of Yoga, who dance the divine dance.

verses.sanskrit: यदा सर्वे प्रमुच्यन्ते कामा ये ऽस्य हृदि स्थिताः । तदासावमृतीभूतः क्षेमं गच्छति पण्डितः
verses.transliteration: yadā sarve pramucyante kāmā ye 'sya hṛdi sthitāḥ / tadāsāvamṛtībhūtaḥ kṣemaṃ gacchati paṇḍitaḥ
verses.translation: We perceive you who '-dance dn the rhiddle of the highest firmament and we remember your grandeur. Experienc¬ ing constantly the supreme bliss of the Brahman, youwho abide in the souls of all, permeate the universe on all sides.
verses.hindi: तस्मादनादिनिधनं विष्णुमात्मानमव्ययम्। मामेव सम्प्रपश्यध्वं पूजयध्वं तथैव हि येऽन्यथा मां प्रपश्यन्ति मत्वेमं देवतान्तरम्। ते यान्ति नरकान् घोरान् नाहं तेषु व्यवस्थित:
verses.wordMeaning: We perceive you who '-dance dn the rhiddle of the highest firmament and we remember your grandeur. Experienc¬ ing constantly the supreme bliss of the Brahman, youwho abide in the souls of all, permeate the universe on all sides.
verses.commentary: Sense: We perceive you who '-dance dn the rhiddle of the highest firmament and we remember your grandeur. Experienc¬ ing constantly the supreme bliss of the Brahman, youwho abide in the souls of all, permeate the universe on all sides.

verses.sanskrit: यदा भूतपृथग्भावमेकस्थमनुपश्यति । तत एव च विस्तारं ब्रह्म संपद्यते तदा
verses.transliteration: yadā bhūtapṛthagbhāvamekasthamanupaśyati / tata eva ca vistāraṃ brahma saṃpadyate tadā
verses.translation: The syllable OM, the seed of liberation, is your (expressive) symbol. Imperishable though you are, you lie concealed in the primordial Nature (Prakrti). Such as you are, saints here aver that you, the self-luminous one of such prowess are the Reality.
verses.hindi: मोचयामि श्वपाकं वा न नारायणनिन्दकम्
verses.wordMeaning: The syllable OM, the seed of liberation, is your (expressive) symbol. Imperishable though you are, you lie concealed in the primordial Nature (Prakrti). Such as you are, saints here aver that you, the self-luminous one of such prowess are the Reality.
verses.commentary: Sense: The syllable OM, the seed of liberation, is your (expressive) symbol. Imperishable though you are, you lie concealed in the primordial Nature (Prakrti). Such as you are, saints here aver that you, the self-luminous one of such prowess are the Reality.

verses.sanskrit: यदा पश्यति चात्मानं केवलं परमार्थतः । मायामात्रं जगत् कृत्स्नं तदा भवति निर्वृतः
verses.transliteration: yadā paśyati cātmānaṃ kevalaṃ paramārthataḥ / māyāmātraṃ jagat kṛtsnaṃ tadā bhavati nirvṛtaḥ
verses.translation: The Vedas perpetually eulogise you. The sages whose blemishes have been wiped off, bow unto you. Ascetics engrossed in Brahman, with quiescent souls and truthful as well enter unto you, the excellent one.
verses.hindi: अर्चनीयो नमस्कार्यो मत्प्रीतिजननाय हि एवमुक्त्वा समालिङ्ग्य वासुदेवं पिनाकधृक् । अन्तर्हितोऽभवत् तेषां सर्वेषामेव पश्यताम्
verses.wordMeaning: The Vedas perpetually eulogise you. The sages whose blemishes have been wiped off, bow unto you. Ascetics engrossed in Brahman, with quiescent souls and truthful as well enter unto you, the excellent one.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Vedas perpetually eulogise you. The sages whose blemishes have been wiped off, bow unto you. Ascetics engrossed in Brahman, with quiescent souls and truthful as well enter unto you, the excellent one.

verses.sanskrit: यदा जन्मजरादुः खव्याधीनामेकभेषजम् । केवलं ब्रह्मविज्ञानं जायते ऽसौ तदा शिवः
verses.transliteration: yadā janmajarāduḥ khavyādhīnāmekabheṣajam / kevalaṃ brahmavijñānaṃ jāyate 'sau tadā śivaḥ
verses.translation: You are the destroyer of the earth; you are without beginning. You have the universal form. You are Brahma the Paramesthin and Visnu the most excellent. Those who are not unsteady and those who are ever liberated, experience the bliss of their Atman and enter into you, the self-luminous one.
verses.hindi: नारायणोऽपि भगवांस्तापसं वेषमुत्तमम्। जग्राह योगिनः सर्वास्त्यक्त्वा वै परमं वपु:
verses.wordMeaning: You are the destroyer of the earth; you are without beginning. You have the universal form. You are Brahma the Paramesthin and Visnu the most excellent. Those who are not unsteady and those who are ever liberated, experience the bliss of their Atman and enter into you,…
verses.commentary: Sense: You are the destroyer of the earth; you are without beginning. You have the universal form. You are Brahma the Paramesthin and Visnu the most excellent. Those who are not unsteady and those who are ever liberated, experience the bliss of their Atman and enter into you,…

verses.sanskrit: यथा नदीनदा लोके सागरेणैकतां ययुः । तद्वदात्माक्षरेणासौ निष्कलेनैकतां व्रजेत्
verses.transliteration: yathā nadīnadā loke sāgareṇaikatāṃ yayuḥ / tadvadātmākṣareṇāsau niṣkalenaikatāṃ vrajet
verses.translation: Though one as Rudra you are, you create the universe; you protect the entire universe; with all its forms;all these (visible worlds) attain to you as their ultimate abode. We seek refuge in you and make obeisance unto you.
verses.hindi: साक्षादेव महेशस्य ज्ञानं संसारनाशनम् ्रवर्तयध्वं शिष्येभ्यो धार्मिकेभ्यो मुनीश्वराः
verses.wordMeaning: Though one as Rudra you are, you create the universe; you protect the entire universe; with all its forms;all these (visible worlds) attain to you as their ultimate abode. We seek refuge in you and make obeisance unto you.
verses.commentary: Sense: Though one as Rudra you are, you create the universe; you protect the entire universe; with all its forms;all these (visible worlds) attain to you as their ultimate abode. We seek refuge in you and make obeisance unto you.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद् विज्ञानमेवास्ति न प्रपञ्चो न संसृतिः । अज्ञानेनावृतं लोको विज्ञानं तेन मुह्यति
verses.transliteration: tasmād vijñānamevāsti na prapañco na saṃsṛtiḥ / ajñānenāvṛtaṃ loko vijñānaṃ tena muhyati
verses.translation: The Veda which has many branches and is infinite is one. It reveals you alone who are of a single form. Those Brahmanas who seek refuge in you who are worthy of being respected, cross the Maya in this very world.
verses.hindi: मैंने ब्रह्मवादियोंके कल्याणार्थ इस ज्ञानको कहा है। आप इस कल्याणकारी ज्ञानको शान्तचित्त शिष्योंको प्रदान करें। अजन्मा भगवान् (शंकर)-ने ऐसा कहनेके उपरान्त श्रेष्ठ योगियोंसे कहा-द्विजोत्तमो! सभी द्विजाति
verses.wordMeaning: The Veda which has many branches and is infinite is one. It reveals you alone who are of a single form. Those Brahmanas who seek refuge in you who are worthy of being respected, cross the Maya in this very world.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Veda which has many branches and is infinite is one. It reveals you alone who are of a single form. Those Brahmanas who seek refuge in you who are worthy of being respected, cross the Maya in this very world.

verses.sanskrit: तज्ज्ञानं निर्मलं सूक्ष्मं निर्विकल्पं यदव्ययम् । अज्ञानमितरत् सर्वं विज्ञानमिति मे मतम्
verses.transliteration: tajjñānaṃ nirmalaṃ sūkṣmaṃ nirvikalpaṃ yadavyayam / ajñānamitarat sarvaṃ vijñānamiti me matam
verses.translation: They call you the only poet (kavi), the Supreme Rudra, eulogising the Veda, Hari, fire and Isa; they call you the eternal Rudra, the wind-god; the consciousness, the creator, the sun-god of many forms.
verses.hindi: भक्तोंके कल्याणके लिये आप लोग भी मेरे कहनेसे सभी भक्त शिष्योंको मेरे ज्ञानका विधिपूर्वक उपदेश करें जो ये नारायण हैं, वह मैं ईश्वर ही हूँ। इसमें संदेह नहीं है। जो (हम दोनोंमें) कोई भेद नहीं देखता, उसीको यह परम (ज्ञान) देना चाहिए। नारायण नामवाली तथा शान्त अक्षर-संज्ञक मेरी यह परम मूर्ति
verses.wordMeaning: They call you the only poet (kavi), the Supreme Rudra, eulogising the Veda, Hari, fire and Isa; they call you the eternal Rudra, the wind-god; the consciousness, the creator, the sun-god of many forms.
verses.commentary: Sense: They call you the only poet (kavi), the Supreme Rudra, eulogising the Veda, Hari, fire and Isa; they call you the eternal Rudra, the wind-god; the consciousness, the creator, the sun-god of many forms.

verses.sanskrit: एतद् वः परमं सांख्यं भाषितं ज्ञानमुत्तमम् । सर्ववेदान्तसारं हि योगस्तत्रैकचित्तता
verses.transliteration: etad vaḥ paramaṃ sāṃkhyaṃ bhāṣitaṃ jñānamuttamam / sarvavedāntasāraṃ hi yogastatraikacittatā
verses.translation: You are the supreme imperishable one that should be realised, You are the ultimate receptable of this universe. You are the unchanging one, protecting the eternal Law (dharma). You are the most excellent Purusa, the eternal one.
verses.hindi: सभी प्राणियोंके हृदयमें स्थित है। लोकमें जो भेददृष्टिवाले लोग इसके विपरीत समझते हैं, वे मेरा दर्शन नहीं करते हैं और बार-बार (संसारमें) जन्म लेते हैं। जो इन अव्यक्त विष्णु अथवा मुझ देव महेश्वरको एकीभावसे देखते
verses.wordMeaning: You are the supreme imperishable one that should be realised, You are the ultimate receptable of this universe. You are the unchanging one, protecting the eternal Law (dharma). You are the most excellent Purusa, the eternal one.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are the supreme imperishable one that should be realised, You are the ultimate receptable of this universe. You are the unchanging one, protecting the eternal Law (dharma). You are the most excellent Purusa, the eternal one.

verses.sanskrit: योगात् संजायते ज्ञानं ज्ञानाद् योगः प्रवर्तते । योगज्ञानाभियुक्तस्य नावाप्यं विद्यते क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: yogāt saṃjāyate jñānaṃ jñānād yogaḥ pravartate / yogajñānābhiyuktasya nāvāpyaṃ vidyate kvacit
verses.translation: You alone are Visnu; you are the four-faced deity (Brahma); you alone are Rudra, the lord Isa as well; you are verily the lord of the universe; you are Prakrti, the basis of all. You are the lord of all, the supreme Isvara.
verses.hindi: हैं, उनका पुनर्जन्म नहीं होता। इसलिये अनादिनिधन (आदि और अन्तसे रहित) आत्मरूप अव्यय विष्णु मुझे ही समझो और फिर वैसे ही पूजा भी करो जो लोग इन (विष्णु)-को दूसरा देवता मानकर मुझे दूसरा देवता समझकर देखते हैं, वे घोर नरकोंमें जाते हैं, मैं उनमें स्थित नहीं रहता हूँ। मूर्ख हो, पण्डित
verses.wordMeaning: You alone are Visnu; you are the four-faced deity (Brahma); you alone are Rudra, the lord Isa as well; you are verily the lord of the universe; you are Prakrti, the basis of all. You are the lord of all, the supreme Isvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: You alone are Visnu; you are the four-faced deity (Brahma); you alone are Rudra, the lord Isa as well; you are verily the lord of the universe; you are Prakrti, the basis of all. You are the lord of all, the supreme Isvara.

verses.sanskrit: यदेव योगिनो यान्ति सांख्यैस्तदधिगम्यते । एकं सांख्यं च योगं च यः पश्यति स तत्त्ववित्
verses.transliteration: yadeva yogino yānti sāṃkhyaistadadhigamyate / ekaṃ sāṃkhyaṃ ca yogaṃ ca yaḥ paśyati sa tattvavit
verses.translation: You alone are Visnu; you are the four-faced deity (Brahma); you alone are Rudra, the lord Isa as well; you are verily the lord of the universe; you are Prakrti, the basis of all. You are the lord of all, the supreme Isvara.
verses.hindi: रहनेवाले (प्रत्येक)-को मैं मुक्त कर देता हूँ, किंतु जो नारायणकी निन्दा करनेवाला है, उसे मैं मुक्त नहीं करता। इसीलिये मेरे भक्त मुझमें प्रीति उत्पन्न करनेके लिये इन महायोगी पुरुषोत्तमकी अर्चना अवश्य करें
verses.wordMeaning: You alone are Visnu; you are the four-faced deity (Brahma); you alone are Rudra, the lord Isa as well; you are verily the lord of the universe; you are Prakrti, the basis of all. You are the lord of all, the supreme Isvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: You alone are Visnu; you are the four-faced deity (Brahma); you alone are Rudra, the lord Isa as well; you are verily the lord of the universe; you are Prakrti, the basis of all. You are the lord of all, the supreme Isvara.

verses.sanskrit: अन्ये च योगिनो विप्रा ऐश्वर्यासक्तचेतसः । मज्जन्ति तत्र तत्रैव न त्वात्मैषामिति श्रुतिः
verses.transliteration: anye ca yogino viprā aiśvaryāsaktacetasaḥ / majjanti tatra tatraiva na tvātmaiṣāmiti śrutiḥ
verses.translation: You alone are Visnu; you are the four-faced deity (Brahma); you alone are Rudra, the lord Isa as well; you are verily the lord of the universe; you are Prakrti, the basis of all. You are the lord of all, the supreme Isvara.
verses.hindi: और इन्हें नमस्कार अवश्य करें ऐसा कहकर पिनाक धारण करनेवाले भगवान् शंकर वासुदेवका आलिंगन करके उन सभीके देखते-देखते अन्तर्हित हो गये। भगवान् नारायणने भी अपने पारमार्थिक विग्रहका त्यागकर उत्तम तपस्वीका वेष धारण किया
verses.wordMeaning: You alone are Visnu; you are the four-faced deity (Brahma); you alone are Rudra, the lord Isa as well; you are verily the lord of the universe; you are Prakrti, the basis of all. You are the lord of all, the supreme Isvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: You alone are Visnu; you are the four-faced deity (Brahma); you alone are Rudra, the lord Isa as well; you are verily the lord of the universe; you are Prakrti, the basis of all. You are the lord of all, the supreme Isvara.

verses.sanskrit: यत्तत् सर्वगतं दिव्यमैश्वर्यमचलं महत् । ज्ञानयोगाभियुक्तस्तु देहान्ते तदवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: yattat sarvagataṃ divyamaiśvaryamacalaṃ mahat / jñānayogābhiyuktastu dehānte tadavāpnuyāt
verses.translation: You alone are Visnu; you are the four-faced deity (Brahma); you alone are Rudra, the lord Isa as well; you are verily the lord of the universe; you are Prakrti, the basis of all. You are the lord of all, the supreme Isvara.
verses.hindi: और सभी योगियोंसे कहा-
verses.wordMeaning: You alone are Visnu; you are the four-faced deity (Brahma); you alone are Rudra, the lord Isa as well; you are verily the lord of the universe; you are Prakrti, the basis of all. You are the lord of all, the supreme Isvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: You alone are Visnu; you are the four-faced deity (Brahma); you alone are Rudra, the lord Isa as well; you are verily the lord of the universe; you are Prakrti, the basis of all. You are the lord of all, the supreme Isvara.

verses.sanskrit: एष आत्माहमव्यक्तो मायावी परमेश्वरः । कीर्तितः सर्ववेदेषु सर्वात्मा सर्वतोमुखः
verses.transliteration: eṣa ātmāhamavyakto māyāvī parameśvaraḥ / kīrtitaḥ sarvavedeṣu sarvātmā sarvatomukhaḥ
verses.translation: You alone are Visnu; you are the four-faced deity (Brahma); you alone are Rudra, the lord Isa as well; you are verily the lord of the universe; you are Prakrti, the basis of all. You are the lord of all, the supreme Isvara.
verses.hindi: आप लोगोंने परमेष्ठी (महेश्वर)-को कृपासे संसार (बन्धन)-को नष्ट करनेवाला उन्हीं साक्षात् महेशका निर्मल ज्ञान प्राप्त किया है। इसलिये मुनीश्वरो ! विगतज्वर होकर आप सभी जायं और धार्मिक शिष्योंमें परमेष्ठीके ज्ञानको प्रवर्तित करें
verses.wordMeaning: You alone are Visnu; you are the four-faced deity (Brahma); you alone are Rudra, the lord Isa as well; you are verily the lord of the universe; you are Prakrti, the basis of all. You are the lord of all, the supreme Isvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: You alone are Visnu; you are the four-faced deity (Brahma); you alone are Rudra, the lord Isa as well; you are verily the lord of the universe; you are Prakrti, the basis of all. You are the lord of all, the supreme Isvara.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वकामः सर्वरसः सर्वगन्धो ऽजरो ऽमरः । सर्वतः पाणिपादो ऽहमन्तर्यामी सनातनः
verses.transliteration: sarvakāmaḥ sarvarasaḥ sarvagandho 'jaro 'maraḥ / sarvataḥ pāṇipādo 'hamantaryāmī sanātanaḥ
verses.translation: You alone are Visnu; you are the four-faced deity (Brahma); you alone are Rudra, the lord Isa as well; you are verily the lord of the universe; you are Prakrti, the basis of all. You are the lord of all, the supreme Isvara.
verses.hindi: इदं भक्ताय शान्ताय धार्मिकायाहिताग्रये । विज्ञानमैश्वरं देयं ब्राह्मणाय विशेषतः
verses.wordMeaning: You alone are Visnu; you are the four-faced deity (Brahma); you alone are Rudra, the lord Isa as well; you are verily the lord of the universe; you are Prakrti, the basis of all. You are the lord of all, the supreme Isvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: You alone are Visnu; you are the four-faced deity (Brahma); you alone are Rudra, the lord Isa as well; you are verily the lord of the universe; you are Prakrti, the basis of all. You are the lord of all, the supreme Isvara.

verses.sanskrit: अपाणिपादो जवनो ग्रहीता हृदि संस्थितः । अचक्षुरपि पश्यामि तथाकर्णः शृणोम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: apāṇipādo javano grahītā hṛdi saṃsthitaḥ / acakṣurapi paśyāmi tathākarṇaḥ śṛṇomyaham
verses.translation: You alone are Visnu; you are the four-faced deity (Brahma); you alone are Rudra, the lord Isa as well; you are verily the lord of the universe; you are Prakrti, the basis of all. You are the lord of all, the supreme Isvara.
verses.hindi: नारायणो महायोगी जगामादर्शनं स्वयम् तेऽपि देवादिदेवेशं नमस्कृत्य महेश्चरम्। नारायणं च भूतादिं स्वानि स्थानानि भेजिरे १२५॥।
verses.wordMeaning: You alone are Visnu; you are the four-faced deity (Brahma); you alone are Rudra, the lord Isa as well; you are verily the lord of the universe; you are Prakrti, the basis of all. You are the lord of all, the supreme Isvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: You alone are Visnu; you are the four-faced deity (Brahma); you alone are Rudra, the lord Isa as well; you are verily the lord of the universe; you are Prakrti, the basis of all. You are the lord of all, the supreme Isvara.

verses.sanskrit: वेदाहं सर्वमेवेदं न मां जानाति कश्चन । प्राहुर्महान्तं पुरुषं मामेकं तत्त्वदर्शिनः
verses.transliteration: vedāhaṃ sarvamevedaṃ na māṃ jānāti kaścana / prāhurmahāntaṃ puruṣaṃ māmekaṃ tattvadarśinaḥ
verses.translation: You alone are Visnu; you are the four-faced deity (Brahma); you alone are Rudra, the lord Isa as well; you are verily the lord of the universe; you are Prakrti, the basis of all. You are the lord of all, the supreme Isvara.
verses.hindi: सनत्कुमारो भगवान् संवर्ताय महामुनिः । दत्तवानैश्वरं ज्ञानं सोऽपि सत्यव्रताय तु
verses.wordMeaning: You alone are Visnu; you are the four-faced deity (Brahma); you alone are Rudra, the lord Isa as well; you are verily the lord of the universe; you are Prakrti, the basis of all. You are the lord of all, the supreme Isvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: You alone are Visnu; you are the four-faced deity (Brahma); you alone are Rudra, the lord Isa as well; you are verily the lord of the universe; you are Prakrti, the basis of all. You are the lord of all, the supreme Isvara.

verses.sanskrit: पश्यन्ति ऋषयो हेतुमात्मनः सूक्ष्मदर्शिनः । निर्गुणामलरूपस्य यत्तदैश्वर्यमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: paśyanti ṛṣayo hetumātmanaḥ sūkṣmadarśinaḥ / nirguṇāmalarūpasya yattadaiśvaryamuttamam
verses.translation: You alone are Visnu; you are the four-faced deity (Brahma); you alone are Rudra, the lord Isa as well; you are verily the lord of the universe; you are Prakrti, the basis of all. You are the lord of all, the supreme Isvara.
verses.hindi: पराशरोऽपि सनकात् पिता मे सर्वतत्त्वदूक् । लेभे तत्परमं ज्ञानं तस्माद् वाल्मीकिराप्तवान् मामुवाच पुरा देवः सतीदेहभवाङ्गजः। वामदेवो महायोगी रुद्रः किल पिनाकधृक्
verses.wordMeaning: You alone are Visnu; you are the four-faced deity (Brahma); you alone are Rudra, the lord Isa as well; you are verily the lord of the universe; you are Prakrti, the basis of all. You are the lord of all, the supreme Isvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: You alone are Visnu; you are the four-faced deity (Brahma); you alone are Rudra, the lord Isa as well; you are verily the lord of the universe; you are Prakrti, the basis of all. You are the lord of all, the supreme Isvara.

verses.sanskrit: यन्न देवा विजानन्ति मोहिता मम मायया । वक्ष्ये समाहिता यूयं शृणुध्वं ब्रह्मवादिनः
verses.transliteration: yanna devā vijānanti mohitā mama māyayā / vakṣye samāhitā yūyaṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ brahmavādinaḥ
verses.translation: You alone are Visnu; you are the four-faced deity (Brahma); you alone are Rudra, the lord Isa as well; you are verily the lord of the universe; you are Prakrti, the basis of all. You are the lord of all, the supreme Isvara.
verses.hindi: नारायणोऽपि भगवान् देवकीतनयो हरिः। अर्जुनाय स्वयं साक्षात् दत्तवानिदमुत्तमम्
verses.wordMeaning: You alone are Visnu; you are the four-faced deity (Brahma); you alone are Rudra, the lord Isa as well; you are verily the lord of the universe; you are Prakrti, the basis of all. You are the lord of all, the supreme Isvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: You alone are Visnu; you are the four-faced deity (Brahma); you alone are Rudra, the lord Isa as well; you are verily the lord of the universe; you are Prakrti, the basis of all. You are the lord of all, the supreme Isvara.

verses.sanskrit: नाहं प्रशास्ता सर्वस्य मायातीतः स्वभावतः । प्रेरयामि तथापीदं कारणं सूरयो विदुः
verses.transliteration: nāhaṃ praśāstā sarvasya māyātītaḥ svabhāvataḥ / prerayāmi tathāpīdaṃ kāraṇaṃ sūrayo viduḥ
verses.translation: You alone are Visnu; you are the four-faced deity (Brahma); you alone are Rudra, the lord Isa as well; you are verily the lord of the universe; you are Prakrti, the basis of all. You are the lord of all, the supreme Isvara.
verses.hindi: यदहं लब्धवान् रुद्राद् वामदेवादनुत्तमम्। विशेषाद् गिरिशे भक्तिस्तस्मादारभ्य मेऽभवत् भूतेशं गिरिशं स्थाणुं देवदेवं त्रिशूलिनम्
verses.wordMeaning: You alone are Visnu; you are the four-faced deity (Brahma); you alone are Rudra, the lord Isa as well; you are verily the lord of the universe; you are Prakrti, the basis of all. You are the lord of all, the supreme Isvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: You alone are Visnu; you are the four-faced deity (Brahma); you alone are Rudra, the lord Isa as well; you are verily the lord of the universe; you are Prakrti, the basis of all. You are the lord of all, the supreme Isvara.

verses.sanskrit: यन्मे गुह्यतमं देहं सर्वगं तत्त्वदर्शिनः । प्रविष्टा मम सायुज्यं लभन्ते योगिनो ऽव्ययम्
verses.transliteration: yanme guhyatamaṃ dehaṃ sarvagaṃ tattvadarśinaḥ / praviṣṭā mama sāyujyaṃ labhante yogino 'vyayam
verses.translation: You alone are Visnu; you are the four-faced deity (Brahma); you alone are Rudra, the lord Isa as well; you are verily the lord of the universe; you are Prakrti, the basis of all. You are the lord of all, the supreme Isvara.
verses.hindi: भवन्तोऽपि हि तं देवं शम्भुं गोवृषवाहनम्। प्रपद्यध्वं सपत्नीकाः सपुत्राः शरणं शिवम्
verses.wordMeaning: You alone are Visnu; you are the four-faced deity (Brahma); you alone are Rudra, the lord Isa as well; you are verily the lord of the universe; you are Prakrti, the basis of all. You are the lord of all, the supreme Isvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: You alone are Visnu; you are the four-faced deity (Brahma); you alone are Rudra, the lord Isa as well; you are verily the lord of the universe; you are Prakrti, the basis of all. You are the lord of all, the supreme Isvara.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां हि वशमापन्ना माया मे विश्वरूपिणी । लभन्ते परमां शुद्धिं निर्वाणं ते मया सह
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ hi vaśamāpannā māyā me viśvarūpiṇī / labhante paramāṃ śuddhiṃ nirvāṇaṃ te mayā saha
verses.translation: You alone are Visnu; you are the four-faced deity (Brahma); you alone are Rudra, the lord Isa as well; you are verily the lord of the universe; you are Prakrti, the basis of all. You are the lord of all, the supreme Isvara.
verses.hindi: वर्तध्वं तत्प्रसादेन कर्मयोगेन शंकरम्। पूजयध्वं महादेवं गोपतिं भूतिभूषणम् एवमुक्तेऽथ मुनयः शौनकाद्या महेश्वरम्। प्रणेमुः शाश्वतं स्थाणुं व्यासं सत्यवतीसुतम्
verses.wordMeaning: You alone are Visnu; you are the four-faced deity (Brahma); you alone are Rudra, the lord Isa as well; you are verily the lord of the universe; you are Prakrti, the basis of all. You are the lord of all, the supreme Isvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: You alone are Visnu; you are the four-faced deity (Brahma); you alone are Rudra, the lord Isa as well; you are verily the lord of the universe; you are Prakrti, the basis of all. You are the lord of all, the supreme Isvara.

verses.sanskrit: न तेषां पुनरावृत्तिः कल्पकोटिशतैरपि । प्रसादान्मम योगीन्द्रा एतद् वेदानुशासनम्
verses.transliteration: na teṣāṃ punarāvṛttiḥ kalpakoṭiśatairapi / prasādānmama yogīndrā etad vedānuśāsanam
verses.translation: You alone are Visnu; you are the four-faced deity (Brahma); you alone are Rudra, the lord Isa as well; you are verily the lord of the universe; you are Prakrti, the basis of all. You are the lord of all, the supreme Isvara.
verses.hindi: साक्षादेव हृषीकेशं सर्वलोकमहेश्वरम्
verses.wordMeaning: You alone are Visnu; you are the four-faced deity (Brahma); you alone are Rudra, the lord Isa as well; you are verily the lord of the universe; you are Prakrti, the basis of all. You are the lord of all, the supreme Isvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: You alone are Visnu; you are the four-faced deity (Brahma); you alone are Rudra, the lord Isa as well; you are verily the lord of the universe; you are Prakrti, the basis of all. You are the lord of all, the supreme Isvara.

verses.sanskrit: नापुत्रशिष्ययोगिभ्यो दातव्यं ब्रह्मवादिभिः । मदुक्तमेतद् विज्ञानं सांख्ययोगसमाश्रयम्
verses.transliteration: nāputraśiṣyayogibhyo dātavyaṃ brahmavādibhiḥ / maduktametad vijñānaṃ sāṃkhyayogasamāśrayam
verses.translation: You alone are Visnu; you are the four-faced deity (Brahma); you alone are Rudra, the lord Isa as well; you are verily the lord of the universe; you are Prakrti, the basis of all. You are the lord of all, the supreme Isvara.
verses.hindi: इस ईश्वर-सम्बन्धी विशिष्ट ज्ञानको विशेष रूपसे शान्त भक्त, धार्मिक तथा अग्निहोत्री ब्राह्मणको देना चाहिए। ऐसा कहकर योगियोंमें परम श्रेष्ठ वे महायोगी विश्वात्मा नारायण स्वयं अन्तर्हित हो गये वे (मुनिगण) भी देवोंके आदिदेवेश्वर महेश्वरको और भूतादि (समस्त प्रपञ्चके मूलकारण) नारायणको नमस्कार कर अपने स्थानोंकी ओर चले गये  महामुनि भगवान् सनत्कुमारने संवर्तको ईश्वरीय ज्ञान (शिवज्ञानका
verses.wordMeaning: You alone are Visnu; you are the four-faced deity (Brahma); you alone are Rudra, the lord Isa as well; you are verily the lord of the universe; you are Prakrti, the basis of all. You are the lord of all, the supreme Isvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: You alone are Visnu; you are the four-faced deity (Brahma); you alone are Rudra, the lord Isa as well; you are verily the lord of the universe; you are Prakrti, the basis of all. You are the lord of all, the supreme Isvara.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे (ईश्वरगीतासु) द्वितीयो ऽध्यायः ईश्वर उवाच अव्यक्तादभवत् कालः प्रधानं पुरुषः परः । तेभ्यः सर्वमिदं जातं तस्माद् ब्रह्ममयं जगत्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge (īśvaragītāsu) dvitīyo 'dhyāyaḥ īśvara uvāca avyaktādabhavat kālaḥ pradhānaṃ puruṣaḥ paraḥ / tebhyaḥ sarvamidaṃ jātaṃ tasmād brahmamayaṃ jagat
verses.translation: The sages say that you are the ancient Purusa, one without a second, of the brillance of the sun beyond the darkness (of ignorance). They call you, the consciousness itself the unmanifest, of infinite forms, the void, the firmament, the Brahman, the Prakrti and the Gunas (v. 1. above i. e. transcen¬ dental to the Gunas).
verses.hindi: उपदेश) प्रदान किया। उन्होंने भी (वह ज्ञान) सत्यब्रतको दिया। योगीन्द्र सनन्दनने महर्षि पुलहको और प्रजापति पुलहने गौतमको ईश्वरीय ज्ञान प्रदान किया। अङ्गिराने वेदोंके ज्ञाता भरद्वाजको और कपिलने जैगीषव्य तथा
verses.wordMeaning: The sages say that you are the ancient Purusa, one without a second, of the brillance of the sun beyond the darkness (of ignorance). They call you, the consciousness itself the unmanifest, of infinite forms, the void, the firmament, the Brahman, the Prakrti and the Gunas (v. 1.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The sages say that you are the ancient Purusa, one without a second, of the brillance of the sun beyond the darkness (of ignorance). They call you, the consciousness itself the unmanifest, of infinite forms, the void, the firmament, the Brahman, the Prakrti and the Gunas (v. 1.…

verses.sanskrit: सर्वतः पाणिपादं तत् सर्वतो ऽक्षिशिरोमुखम् । सर्वतः श्रुतिमल्लोके सर्वमावृत्य तिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: sarvataḥ pāṇipādaṃ tat sarvato 'kṣiśiromukham / sarvataḥ śrutimalloke sarvamāvṛtya tiṣṭhati
verses.translation: This form of yours is something that cannot be con¬ ceived of; within it all these (visible worlds) appear; it is un¬ changing and blemishless, but is one single form; it is beyond the ken of thought and indescribable; all that appears within it is you alone, (or; your form is so wonderfully indescribable that the Reality shines in it).
verses.hindi: पञ्चशिखको (वह ज्ञान) दिया। सभी तत्त्वोंके द्रष्टा मेरे पिता पराशरने भी वह परम ज्ञान सनकसे प्राप्त किया और उनसे वाल्मीकिने प्राप्त किया। प्राचीन कालमें अर्धनारीश्वर भगवान् शंकरके अंशसे उत्पन्न महायोगी वामदेवजीने मुझसे कहा, जो साक्षात् पिनाकधारी रुद्रस्वरूप हैं ॥ १२५--१३० ॥
verses.wordMeaning: This form of yours is something that cannot be con¬ ceived of; within it all these (visible worlds) appear; it is un¬ changing and blemishless, but is one single form; it is beyond the ken of thought and indescribable; all that appears within it is you alone, (or;…
verses.commentary: Sense: This form of yours is something that cannot be con¬ ceived of; within it all these (visible worlds) appear; it is un¬ changing and blemishless, but is one single form; it is beyond the ken of thought and indescribable; all that appears within it is you alone, (or;…

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेन्द्रियगुणाभासं सर्वेन्द्रियविवर्जितम् । सर्वाधारं सदानन्दमव्यक्तं द्वैतवर्जितम्
verses.transliteration: sarvendriyaguṇābhāsaṃ sarvendriyavivarjitam / sarvādhāraṃ sadānandamavyaktaṃ dvaitavarjitam
verses.translation: Seeking refuge in you, all of us make obeisance to you, the gracious lord of Yogas, the greatest goal of infinite power, the ancient one with the body of Brahman, O Lord of Bhutas, O Mahesa, be gracious unto us
verses.hindi: देवकीके पुत्र हरि भगवान् नारायणने भी स्वयं साक्षात् अर्जुको यह उत्तम ज्ञान प्रदान किया। जब मैंने वामदेव रुद्रसे इस श्रेष्ठ ज्ञानको प्राप्त किया, तभीसे मेरी गिरिशमें विशेष भक्ति हो गयी। मैंने शरणागतोंके
verses.wordMeaning: Seeking refuge in you, all of us make obeisance to you, the gracious lord of Yogas, the greatest goal of infinite power, the ancient one with the body of Brahman, O Lord of Bhutas, O Mahesa, be gracious unto us
verses.commentary: Sense: Seeking refuge in you, all of us make obeisance to you, the gracious lord of Yogas, the greatest goal of infinite power, the ancient one with the body of Brahman, O Lord of Bhutas, O Mahesa, be gracious unto us

verses.sanskrit: सर्वोपमानरहितं प्रमाणातीतगोचरम् । निर्विकल्पं निराभासं सर्वावासं परामृतम्
verses.transliteration: sarvopamānarahitaṃ pramāṇātītagocaram / nirvikalpaṃ nirābhāsaṃ sarvāvāsaṃ parāmṛtam
verses.translation: By remembering your lotus-like feet, the seed (cause) of the entire worldly existence becomes dissolved. After con¬ trolling the body and concentrating the mind, we propitiate you, the only Supreme Lord.
verses.hindi: रक्षक, शरण (प्राणिमात्रके आश्रय), भूतोंके ईश, गिरिश, स्थाणु, देवाधिदेव त्रिशूली रुद्रकी विशेषरूपसे शरण ग्रहण की है। पत्नी तथा पुत्रांके साथ आप सब लोग भी उन गोवृषवाहन', कल्याणकारी भगवान् शम्भुकी शरणमें जायँ। उनकी कृपासे कर्मयोगके द्वारा व्यवहार' करें और विभूतिभूषण गोपति (इन्द्रियोंके पति) महादेव शंकरकी पूजा करें॥ १३१--१३५॥
verses.wordMeaning: By remembering your lotus-like feet, the seed (cause) of the entire worldly existence becomes dissolved. After con¬ trolling the body and concentrating the mind, we propitiate you, the only Supreme Lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: By remembering your lotus-like feet, the seed (cause) of the entire worldly existence becomes dissolved. After con¬ trolling the body and concentrating the mind, we propitiate you, the only Supreme Lord.

verses.sanskrit: अभिन्नं भिन्नसंस्थानं शाश्वतं ध्रु वमव्ययम् । निर्गुणं परमं व्योम तज्ज्ञानं सूरयो विदुः
verses.transliteration: abhinnaṃ bhinnasaṃsthānaṃ śāśvataṃ dhru vamavyayam / nirguṇaṃ paramaṃ vyoma tajjñānaṃ sūrayo viduḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to Bhava, the source of origin of the worlds; to Kala,to Sarva, to you the annihilator; obeisance be to Rudra with matted hair. Obeisance to you. O Lord, who are the fire; obeisance to Siva."
verses.hindi: ने पुनः शाश्वत स्थाणु सनातन महेश्वर एवं सत्यवतीके पुत्र व्यासको प्रणाम किया और प्रसन्नमन होकर वे सभी लोकोंके महेश्वर, साक्षात् हृषीकेश, प्रभु कृष्णद्वैपायन (व्यास)-से कहने लगे--
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to Bhava, the source of origin of the worlds; to Kala,to Sarva, to you the annihilator; obeisance be to Rudra with matted hair. Obeisance to you. O Lord, who are the fire; obeisance to Siva."
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to Bhava, the source of origin of the worlds; to Kala,to Sarva, to you the annihilator; obeisance be to Rudra with matted hair. Obeisance to you. O Lord, who are the fire; obeisance to Siva."

verses.sanskrit: स आत्मा सर्वभूतानां स बाह्याभ्यन्तरः परः । सो ऽहं सर्वत्रगः शान्तो ज्ञानात्मा परमेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: sa ātmā sarvabhūtānāṃ sa bāhyābhyantaraḥ paraḥ / so 'haṃ sarvatragaḥ śānto jñānātmā parameśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, the bull-vehicled Lord with matted hair delightedly withdrew his great cosmic form. Bhava (Siva) manifested his normal (usual) form.
verses.hindi: १-'गोवृषवाहन '--धर्मस्वरूप, गोजातिके वृषको महेश्वरने अपने वाहनके रूपमें स्वीकार किया है। इसलिये महेश्वरको “गोवृषवाहन' कहा गया है।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, the bull-vehicled Lord with matted hair delightedly withdrew his great cosmic form. Bhava (Siva) manifested his normal (usual) form.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, the bull-vehicled Lord with matted hair delightedly withdrew his great cosmic form. Bhava (Siva) manifested his normal (usual) form.

verses.sanskrit: मया ततमिदं विश्वं जगदव्यक्तमूर्तिना । मत्स्थानि सर्वभूतानि यस्तं वेद स वेदवित्
verses.transliteration: mayā tatamidaṃ viśvaṃ jagadavyaktamūrtinā / matsthāni sarvabhūtāni yastaṃ veda sa vedavit
verses.translation: On seeing Bhava, the lord of everything past and future, remaining as before and lord Narayana (also in that state), the sages were struck with wonder and they spoke these words.
verses.hindi: २-'कर्मयोगके द्वारा व्यवहार” का तात्पर्य है--अनासक्त-भावसे (कर्मफलकी कामनाके बिना) कर्तव्यबुद्धिसे अधिकारानुसार
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing Bhava, the lord of everything past and future, remaining as before and lord Narayana (also in that state), the sages were struck with wonder and they spoke these words.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing Bhava, the lord of everything past and future, remaining as before and lord Narayana (also in that state), the sages were struck with wonder and they spoke these words.

verses.sanskrit: प्रधानं पुरुषं चैव तत्त्वद्वयमुदाहृतम् । तयोरनादिरुद्दिष्टः कालः संयोजकः परः
verses.transliteration: pradhānaṃ puruṣaṃ caiva tattvadvayamudāhṛtam / tayoranādiruddiṣṭaḥ kālaḥ saṃyojakaḥ paraḥ
verses.translation: "O eternal lord, O lord of the past and future, O deity marked by the emblem of the bull! On seeing your grand form we are delighted, (v. 1. attained quiescence).
verses.hindi: बेदादि शास्त्रोक्त कर्मोका पालन करना। इदानीं जायते भक्तिर्या देवैरपि दुर्लभा
verses.wordMeaning: "O eternal lord, O lord of the past and future, O deity marked by the emblem of the bull! On seeing your grand form we are delighted, (v. 1. attained quiescence).
verses.commentary: Sense: "O eternal lord, O lord of the past and future, O deity marked by the emblem of the bull! On seeing your grand form we are delighted, (v. 1. attained quiescence).

verses.sanskrit: त्रयमेतदनाद्यन्तमव्यक्ते समवस्थितम् । तदात्मकं तदन्यत् स्यात् तद्रूपं मामकं विदुः
verses.transliteration: trayametadanādyantamavyakte samavasthitam / tadātmakaṃ tadanyat syāt tadrūpaṃ māmakaṃ viduḥ
verses.translation: Thanks to your grace, there is born our unswerving devotion to you, the great Supreme lord, the blemishless one.
verses.hindi: कथयस्व मुनिश्रेष्ठ कर्मयोगमनुत्तमम्। येनासौ भगवानीशः समाराध्यो मुमुक्षुभिः
verses.wordMeaning: Thanks to your grace, there is born our unswerving devotion to you, the great Supreme lord, the blemishless one.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thanks to your grace, there is born our unswerving devotion to you, the great Supreme lord, the blemishless one.

verses.sanskrit: महदाद्यं विशेषान्तं संप्रसूते ऽखिलं जगत् । या सा प्रकृतिरुद्दिष्टा मोहिनी सर्वदेहिनाम्
verses.transliteration: mahadādyaṃ viśeṣāntaṃ saṃprasūte 'khilaṃ jagat / yā sā prakṛtiruddiṣṭā mohinī sarvadehinām
verses.translation: O Sankara, now we wish to hear about your greatness as well as the eternal reality about Paramesthin".
verses.hindi: तद्ददाखिललोकानां रक्षणं धर्मसंग्रहम् यदुक्तं देवदेवेन विष्णुना कूर्मरूपिणा। पृष्टेन मुनिभिः पूर्व शक्रेणामृतमन्थने
verses.wordMeaning: O Sankara, now we wish to hear about your greatness as well as the eternal reality about Paramesthin".
verses.commentary: Sense: O Sankara, now we wish to hear about your greatness as well as the eternal reality about Paramesthin".

verses.sanskrit: पुरुषः प्रकृतिस्थो हि भुङ्क्तेयः प्राकृतान् गुणान् । अहङ्कारविमुक्तत्वात् प्रोच्यते पञ्चविंशकः
verses.transliteration: puruṣaḥ prakṛtistho hi bhuṅkteyaḥ prākṛtān guṇān / ahaṅkāravimuktatvāt procyate pañcaviṃśakaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing their words the lord, the bestower of Yogic siddhi on the Yogins, glanced at Madhava and said in a majestic voice.
verses.hindi: श्रुत्वा सत्यवतीसूनुः कर्मयोगं सनातनम्। मुनीनां भाषितं कृष्ण: प्रोवाच सुसमाहितः
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing their words the lord, the bestower of Yogic siddhi on the Yogins, glanced at Madhava and said in a majestic voice.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing their words the lord, the bestower of Yogic siddhi on the Yogins, glanced at Madhava and said in a majestic voice.

verses.sanskrit: आद्यो विकारः प्रकृतेर्महानात्मेति कथ्यते । विज्ञानशक्तिर्विज्ञाता ह्यहङ्कारस्तदुत्थितः
verses.transliteration: ādyo vikāraḥ prakṛtermahānātmeti kathyate / vijñānaśaktirvijñātā hyahaṅkārastadutthitaḥ
verses.translation: This chapter describes the Cosmic dance of Siva but takes care to emphasize the identity of Siva and Visnu (V. 17).
verses.hindi: सनत्कुमारप्रमुखैः सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते श्रावयेद् वा द्विजान् शुद्धान् ब्रह्मचर्यपरायणान्। यो वा विचारयेदर्थ स याति परमां गतिम्
verses.wordMeaning: This chapter describes the Cosmic dance of Siva but takes care to emphasize the identity of Siva and Visnu (V. 17).
verses.commentary: Sense: This chapter describes the Cosmic dance of Siva but takes care to emphasize the identity of Siva and Visnu (V. 17).

verses.sanskrit: एक एव महानात्मा सो ऽहङ्कारो ऽभिधीयते । स जीवः सो ऽन्तरात्मेति गीयते तत्त्वचिन्तकैः
verses.transliteration: eka eva mahānātmā so 'haṅkāro 'bhidhīyate / sa jīvaḥ so 'ntarātmeti gīyate tattvacintakaiḥ
verses.translation: They saw Isana, the greatest treasure-house of splend¬ our, the sovereign lord, dancing along with Visnu in the clear firmament.
verses.hindi: सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो ब्रह्मलोके महीयते
verses.wordMeaning: They saw Isana, the greatest treasure-house of splend¬ our, the sovereign lord, dancing along with Visnu in the clear firmament.
verses.commentary: Sense: They saw Isana, the greatest treasure-house of splend¬ our, the sovereign lord, dancing along with Visnu in the clear firmament.

verses.sanskrit: तेन वेदयते सर्वं सुखं दुःखं च जन्मसु । स विज्ञानात्मकस्तस्य मनः स्यादुपकारकम्
verses.transliteration: tena vedayate sarvaṃ sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ ca janmasu / sa vijñānātmakastasya manaḥ syādupakārakam
verses.translation: In the firmament, they saw that lord of all living beings whom the Yogins, the knowers of the principles of Yoga who have their minds under control, realize.
verses.hindi: (भगवन्!) आपको ही कृपासे शरणागतोंकी रक्षा करनेवाले गोवृषध्वज (भगवान् शंकर)-की वह अविचल भक्ति हमें प्राप्त हो गयी है, जो देवताओंको भी दुर्लभ है। मुनिश्रेष्ठ! आप श्रेष्ठ कर्मयोग हमें बतलायें, जिसके द्वारा मोक्षार्थी लोग इन भगवान् ईशकी आराधना करते हैँ। आप (वेदव्यास)-को संनिधिमें ही श्रीसूतजी भगवान् (महेश्वर)-के वचनोंको सुन लें, जो वचन समस्त लोकोंके रक्षक हैं और जिनमें समस्त धर्मोका
verses.wordMeaning: In the firmament, they saw that lord of all living beings whom the Yogins, the knowers of the principles of Yoga who have their minds under control, realize.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the firmament, they saw that lord of all living beings whom the Yogins, the knowers of the principles of Yoga who have their minds under control, realize.

verses.sanskrit: तेनाविवेकतस्तस्मात् संसारः पुरुषस्य तु । स चाविवेकः प्रकृतौ सङ्गात् कालेन सो ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: tenāvivekatastasmāt saṃsāraḥ puruṣasya tu / sa cāvivekaḥ prakṛtau saṅgāt kālena so 'bhavat
verses.translation: The sovereign Lord of the universe who impels the world into action which is the creation of his Maya, was verily seen dancing by Brahmanas.
verses.hindi: संग्रह हुआ है। अत: इनका वर्णन करें  इसके अतिरिक्त आप वह भी बताये, जो पूर्वकालमें अमृतमन्थनके समय इन्द्रके द्वारा तथा मुनियोंके द्वारा पूछे जानेपर कूर्मरूपी देवाधिदेव श्रीविष्णुने कहा था (आप उसी
verses.wordMeaning: The sovereign Lord of the universe who impels the world into action which is the creation of his Maya, was verily seen dancing by Brahmanas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sovereign Lord of the universe who impels the world into action which is the creation of his Maya, was verily seen dancing by Brahmanas.

verses.sanskrit: कालः सृजति भूतानि कालः संहरति प्रजाः । सर्वे कालस्य वशगा न कालः कस्यचिद् वशे
verses.transliteration: kālaḥ sṛjati bhūtāni kālaḥ saṃharati prajāḥ / sarve kālasya vaśagā na kālaḥ kasyacid vaśe
verses.translation: They saw the lord oiBhutas (creatures or elements) dancing, the lord by remembering whose lotus-like feet a man can eschew the fear originating from ignorance.
verses.hindi: कर्मयोगका वर्णन करें) इस प्रकार मुनियोंने जो कहा उसे सुनकर सत्यवतीके पुत्र कृष्णद्वैपायन व्यासजीने समाहित होकर (मुनियोंको) सनातन कर्मयोग बतलाया
verses.wordMeaning: They saw the lord oiBhutas (creatures or elements) dancing, the lord by remembering whose lotus-like feet a man can eschew the fear originating from ignorance.
verses.commentary: Sense: They saw the lord oiBhutas (creatures or elements) dancing, the lord by remembering whose lotus-like feet a man can eschew the fear originating from ignorance.

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽन्तरा सर्वमेवेदं नियच्छति सनातनः । प्रोच्यते भगवान् प्राणः सर्वज्ञः पुरुषोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: so 'ntarā sarvamevedaṃ niyacchati sanātanaḥ / procyate bhagavān prāṇaḥ sarvajñaḥ puruṣottamaḥ
verses.translation: Those who have conquered their sleep and controlled their breath, who are quiescent and endowed with devotion, see him as full of brilliance, that is how Siva the Yogin was seen.
verses.hindi: श्रीसनत्कुमार आदि प्रमुख मुनियों एवं भगवान् कृत्तिवासा (शंकर)-के मध्य सम्पन्न इस संवादको जो नित्य पढ़ता है, वह सभी पापोंसे मुक्त हो जाता है। अथवा जो ब्रह्मचर्यपरायण विशुद्ध द्विजोंको इस (संवाद) -
verses.wordMeaning: Those who have conquered their sleep and controlled their breath, who are quiescent and endowed with devotion, see him as full of brilliance, that is how Siva the Yogin was seen.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who have conquered their sleep and controlled their breath, who are quiescent and endowed with devotion, see him as full of brilliance, that is how Siva the Yogin was seen.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेन्द्रियेभ्यः परमं मन आहुर्मनीषिणः । मनसश्चाप्यहङ्कारमहङ्कारान्महान् परः
verses.transliteration: sarvendriyebhyaḥ paramaṃ mana āhurmanīṣiṇaḥ / manasaścāpyahaṅkāramahaṅkārānmahān paraḥ
verses.translation: Those who have conquered their sleep and controlled their breath, who are quiescent and endowed with devotion, see him as full of brilliance, that is how Siva the Yogin was seen.
verses.hindi: को सुनाता है, या जो इस संवादके अर्थका अनुसंधान करता है, वह परमगतिको प्राप्त करता है। जो दृढ़व्रती भक्ति-सम्पन्न होकर इस (संवाद)-को नित्य सुनता है, वह सभी पापोंसे मुक्त होते हुए ब्रह्मलोकमें प्रतिष्ठा इसलिये विद्वानोंको सभी प्रयल्रोंके द्वारा नित्य इसका पठन, श्रवण एवं विशेषरूपसे ब्राह्मणोंको इसका सदा मनन करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: Those who have conquered their sleep and controlled their breath, who are quiescent and endowed with devotion, see him as full of brilliance, that is how Siva the Yogin was seen.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who have conquered their sleep and controlled their breath, who are quiescent and endowed with devotion, see him as full of brilliance, that is how Siva the Yogin was seen.

verses.sanskrit: महतः परमव्यक्तमव्यक्तात् पुरुषः परः । पुरुषाद् भगवान् प्राणस्तस्य सर्वमिदं जगत्
verses.transliteration: mahataḥ paramavyaktamavyaktāt puruṣaḥ paraḥ / puruṣād bhagavān prāṇastasya sarvamidaṃ jagat
verses.translation: Those who have conquered their sleep and controlled their breath, who are quiescent and endowed with devotion, see him as full of brilliance, that is how Siva the Yogin was seen.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे बद्साहस्रथां संहितायामुपरिविभागे (ईशवरगीतासु ) एकादशोऽध्यायः
verses.wordMeaning: Those who have conquered their sleep and controlled their breath, who are quiescent and endowed with devotion, see him as full of brilliance, that is how Siva the Yogin was seen.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who have conquered their sleep and controlled their breath, who are quiescent and endowed with devotion, see him as full of brilliance, that is how Siva the Yogin was seen.

verses.sanskrit: प्राणात् परतरं व्योम व्योमातीतो ऽग्निरीश्वरः । सो ऽहं सर्वत्रगः शान्तो ज्ञानात्मा परमेश्वरः । नास्ति मत्तः परं भूतं मां विज्ञाय विमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: prāṇāt parataraṃ vyoma vyomātīto 'gnirīśvaraḥ / so 'haṃ sarvatragaḥ śānto jñānātmā parameśvaraḥ / nāsti mattaḥ paraṃ bhūtaṃ māṃ vijñāya vimucyate
verses.translation: Those who have conquered their sleep and controlled their breath, who are quiescent and endowed with devotion, see him as full of brilliance, that is how Siva the Yogin was seen.
verses.hindi: इससे यह स्पष्ट हो रहा है कि वेद-शास्त्र-प्रतिपादित अपने कर्मोका फलासक्तिरहित होकर सविधि अनुष्ठान ईशकी आराधनाका शर कूर्मपुराण श्र
verses.wordMeaning: Those who have conquered their sleep and controlled their breath, who are quiescent and endowed with devotion, see him as full of brilliance, that is how Siva the Yogin was seen.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who have conquered their sleep and controlled their breath, who are quiescent and endowed with devotion, see him as full of brilliance, that is how Siva the Yogin was seen.

verses.sanskrit: नित्यं हि नास्ति जगति भूतं स्थावरजङ्गमम् । ऋते मामेकमव्यक्तं व्योमरूपं महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: nityaṃ hi nāsti jagati bhūtaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam / ṛte māmekamavyaktaṃ vyomarūpaṃ maheśvaram
verses.translation: Those who have conquered their sleep and controlled their breath, who are quiescent and endowed with devotion, see him as full of brilliance, that is how Siva the Yogin was seen.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्वाचारीका धर्म, यज्ञोपवीत आदिके सम्बन्धमें विविध विवरण, अभिवादनकी विधि, माता-पिता एवं गुरुकी महिमा, ब्रह्मचारीके सदाचारका वर्णन
verses.wordMeaning: Those who have conquered their sleep and controlled their breath, who are quiescent and endowed with devotion, see him as full of brilliance, that is how Siva the Yogin was seen.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who have conquered their sleep and controlled their breath, who are quiescent and endowed with devotion, see him as full of brilliance, that is how Siva the Yogin was seen.

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽहं सृजामि सकलं संहरामि सदा जगत् । मायी मायामयो देवः कालेन सह सङ्गतः
verses.transliteration: so 'haṃ sṛjāmi sakalaṃ saṃharāmi sadā jagat / māyī māyāmayo devaḥ kālena saha saṅgataḥ
verses.translation: Those who have conquered their sleep and controlled their breath, who are quiescent and endowed with devotion, see him as full of brilliance, that is how Siva the Yogin was seen.
verses.hindi: कर्मयोगं ब्राह्मणानामात्यन्तिकफलप्रदम्॥ आ्नायसिद्धमखिलं ब्रह्मणानृप्रदर्शितम्। सर्वपापहरं पुण्यमृषिसङ्गैर्निषेवितम्।
verses.wordMeaning: Those who have conquered their sleep and controlled their breath, who are quiescent and endowed with devotion, see him as full of brilliance, that is how Siva the Yogin was seen.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who have conquered their sleep and controlled their breath, who are quiescent and endowed with devotion, see him as full of brilliance, that is how Siva the Yogin was seen.

verses.sanskrit: मत्सन्निधावेष कालः करोति सकलं जगत् । नियोजयत्यनन्तात्मा ह्येतद् वेदानुशासनम्
verses.transliteration: matsannidhāveṣa kālaḥ karoti sakalaṃ jagat / niyojayatyanantātmā hyetad vedānuśāsanam
verses.translation: Those who have conquered their sleep and controlled their breath, who are quiescent and endowed with devotion, see him as full of brilliance, that is how Siva the Yogin was seen.
verses.hindi: दण्डी च मेखली सूत्री कृष्णाजिनधरो मुनिः।
verses.wordMeaning: Those who have conquered their sleep and controlled their breath, who are quiescent and endowed with devotion, see him as full of brilliance, that is how Siva the Yogin was seen.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who have conquered their sleep and controlled their breath, who are quiescent and endowed with devotion, see him as full of brilliance, that is how Siva the Yogin was seen.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे (ईश्वरगीतासु) तृतीयो ऽध्यायः ईश्वर उवाच वक्ष्ये समाहिता यूयं शृणुध्वं ब्रह्मवादिनः । माहात्म्यं देवदेवस्य येनेदं संप्रवर्तते
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge (īśvaragītāsu) tṛtīyo 'dhyāyaḥ īśvara uvāca vakṣye samāhitā yūyaṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ brahmavādinaḥ / māhātmyaṃ devadevasya yenedaṃ saṃpravartate
verses.translation: In the firmament, they saw the great Rudra, the liberator, the delighted lord, favourably disposed to his devotees and who instantaneously liberates the devotees from ignorance.
verses.hindi: कार्पासमुपवीतार्थ निर्मितं ब्रह्मणा पुरा। अन्यथा यत् कृतं कर्म तद् भवत्ययथाकृतम्॥ वसेदविकृतं वासः कार्पासं वा कषायकम्। तदेव परिधानीयं शुक्लमच्छिद्रमुत्तमम्॥
verses.wordMeaning: In the firmament, they saw the great Rudra, the liberator, the delighted lord, favourably disposed to his devotees and who instantaneously liberates the devotees from ignorance.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the firmament, they saw the great Rudra, the liberator, the delighted lord, favourably disposed to his devotees and who instantaneously liberates the devotees from ignorance.

verses.sanskrit: नाहं तपोभिर्विविधैर्न दानेन न चेज्यया । शक्यो हि पुरुषैर्ज्ञातुमृते भक्तिमनुत्तमाम्
verses.transliteration: nāhaṃ tapobhirvividhairna dānena na cejyayā / śakyo hi puruṣairjñātumṛte bhaktimanuttamām
verses.translation: They saw the lord with a thousand (i.e. innumerable) heads, a thousand feet, a thousand shapes, and a thousand arms.
verses.hindi: कै पित्र्ये कर्मणि योजयेत्
verses.wordMeaning: They saw the lord with a thousand (i.e. innumerable) heads, a thousand feet, a thousand shapes, and a thousand arms.
verses.commentary: Sense: They saw the lord with a thousand (i.e. innumerable) heads, a thousand feet, a thousand shapes, and a thousand arms.

verses.sanskrit: अहं हि सर्वभावानामन्तस्तिष्ठामि सर्वगः । मां सर्वसाक्षिणं लोको न जानाति मुनीश्वराः
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ hi sarvabhāvānāmantastiṣṭhāmi sarvagaḥ / māṃ sarvasākṣiṇaṃ loko na jānāti munīśvarāḥ
verses.translation: The lord was wearing the tiger's hide; his mighty hand was holding the trident; he had a staff" in his hand; he had the sun, the moon and the fire as three eyes.
verses.hindi: व्यासजी बोले--ऋषियो! आप लोग ब्राह्मणोंको आत्यन्तिक (शाश्वत) फल प्रदान करनेवाले, अभी कहे जा रहे सनातन कर्मयोगको सुर्ने पूर्वकालमें प्रजापति मनुने सुननेकी इच्छा रखनेवाले ऋषियोंको समस्त वेदोंमें प्रसिद्ध, ब्रह्माद्वारा बतलाये गये, सभी पापोंको दूर करनेवाले तथा पवित्र ऋषि-समूहोंद्वारा सेवित इस सम्पूर्ण कर्मयोगको बतलाया था। मेरे द्वारा
verses.wordMeaning: The lord was wearing the tiger's hide; his mighty hand was holding the trident; he had a staff" in his hand; he had the sun, the moon and the fire as three eyes.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord was wearing the tiger's hide; his mighty hand was holding the trident; he had a staff" in his hand; he had the sun, the moon and the fire as three eyes.

verses.sanskrit: यस्यान्तरा सर्वमिदं यो हि सर्वान्तरः परः । सो ऽहन्धाता विधाता च कालो ऽग्निर्विश्वतोमुखः
verses.transliteration: yasyāntarā sarvamidaṃ yo hi sarvāntaraḥ paraḥ / so 'handhātā vidhātā ca kālo 'gnirviśvatomukhaḥ
verses.translation: By his brilliance he had enveloped the whole of the cosmic egg; he was standing with a refulgence equal to that of a crore of suns; he appeared terrible due to his fearful large teeth and was unthwartable.
verses.hindi: कहे जानेवाले इस कर्मयोगको समाहितबुद्धि होकर आप लोग भी सुनें द्विजोत्तमो! गर्भसे आठवें अथवा (जन्मसे) आठवें वर्षकी अवस्थामें अपने-अपने गृह्यसुत्रक्त विधानके अनुसार यज्ञोपवीत-संस्कारसे युक्त होकर दण्ड,
verses.wordMeaning: By his brilliance he had enveloped the whole of the cosmic egg; he was standing with a refulgence equal to that of a crore of suns; he appeared terrible due to his fearful large teeth and was unthwartable.
verses.commentary: Sense: By his brilliance he had enveloped the whole of the cosmic egg; he was standing with a refulgence equal to that of a crore of suns; he appeared terrible due to his fearful large teeth and was unthwartable.

verses.sanskrit: न मां पश्यन्ति मुनयः सर्वे ऽपि त्रिदिवौकसः । ब्रह्मा च मनवः शक्रो ये चान्ये प्रथितौजसः
verses.transliteration: na māṃ paśyanti munayaḥ sarve 'pi tridivaukasaḥ / brahmā ca manavaḥ śakro ye cānye prathitaujasaḥ
verses.translation: They saw the Lord, the creator of the universe dancing and emitting flames of fire and thereby burning (as it were) the entire universe.
verses.hindi: मेखला, यज्ञोपवीत तथा कृष्णमृगचर्म धारणकर मुनिवृत्तिवाले (ब्राह्मण-बालक)-को चाहिए कि वह भिक्षान्न ग्रहण करते हुए, गुरुके हितमें तत्पर रहकर गुरुके समीपमें उनको ओर देखते हुए वेदोंका अध्ययन करे प्राचीन कालमें ब्रह्माने यज्ञोपवीतके लिये कपासका निर्माण किया । ब्राह्मणोंका यज्ञोपवीत तिहरा होना चाहिए, वह कुशका हो अथवा सस्त्रका हो। द्विजको सदा यज्ञोपवीत धारण करना चाहिए तथा शिखा बाँधे रखना
verses.wordMeaning: They saw the Lord, the creator of the universe dancing and emitting flames of fire and thereby burning (as it were) the entire universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: They saw the Lord, the creator of the universe dancing and emitting flames of fire and thereby burning (as it were) the entire universe.

verses.sanskrit: गृणन्ति सततं वेदा मामेकं परमेश्वरम् । यजन्ति विविधैरग्निं ब्राह्मणा वैदिकैर्मखैः
verses.transliteration: gṛṇanti satataṃ vedā māmekaṃ parameśvaram / yajanti vividhairagniṃ brāhmaṇā vaidikairmakhaiḥ
verses.translation: They visualised the great God, the veritable great Yoga incarnate, the divinity of celestial beings, the lord of all Pasus (individual souls), the supreme Ruler, the imperishable bliss and Light.
verses.hindi: चाहिए। अन्यथा (वह) जो कर्म करता है, वह न किये हुएके ही समान है अर्थात् निष्फल है
verses.wordMeaning: They visualised the great God, the veritable great Yoga incarnate, the divinity of celestial beings, the lord of all Pasus (individual souls), the supreme Ruler, the imperishable bliss and Light.
verses.commentary: Sense: They visualised the great God, the veritable great Yoga incarnate, the divinity of celestial beings, the lord of all Pasus (individual souls), the supreme Ruler, the imperishable bliss and Light.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे लोका नमस्यन्ति ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः । ध्यायन्ति योगिनो देवं भूताधिपतिमीश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: sarve lokā namasyanti brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ / dhyāyanti yogino devaṃ bhūtādhipatimīśvaram
verses.translation: They saw the Pinaka-bearing Lord of large eyes: the antidote for those who ail from worldly existence (saihsara), the lord who was the soul of Kala, the lord of Devas; the slayer of Kala.
verses.hindi: कपास या रेशमका बना हुआ विकाररहित (जला- कटा न हो) वस्त्र पहनना चाहिए। ऐसे ही स्वच्छ, छिद्ररहित तथा उत्तम (शास्त्रविधिके अनुसार) वस्त्रको धारण करना चाहिए। उत्तरीय वस्त्रके रूपमें कृष्णमृगचर्म शुभ कहा गया है। इसके अभावमें दिव्य चर्म अथवा रुरु मृगके चर्मका विधान किया गया है
verses.wordMeaning: They saw the Pinaka-bearing Lord of large eyes: the antidote for those who ail from worldly existence (saihsara), the lord who was the soul of Kala, the lord of Devas; the slayer of Kala.
verses.commentary: Sense: They saw the Pinaka-bearing Lord of large eyes: the antidote for those who ail from worldly existence (saihsara), the lord who was the soul of Kala, the lord of Devas; the slayer of Kala.

verses.sanskrit: अहं हि सर्वहविषां भोक्ता चैव फलप्रदः । सर्वदेवतनुर्भूत्वा सर्वात्मा सर्वसंस्थितः
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ hi sarvahaviṣāṃ bhoktā caiva phalapradaḥ / sarvadevatanurbhūtvā sarvātmā sarvasaṃsthitaḥ
verses.translation: They saw the consort of Uma, the great deity of large eyes and full of Yogic bliss; the lord who is the abode of knowledge and detachment; the eternal lord of the path of knowledge.
verses.hindi: दाहिना हाथ उठाकर बायें हाथके ऊपर (बायें कंधेपर) स्थापित यज्ञसूत्रको 'उपवीत' कहा जाता है। नित्य ऐसे रहना चाहिए। कण्ठमें (मालाकी तरह) लटके रहनेपर (यज्ञसूत्र) “निवीत' कहा जाता है। द्विजो! बायाँ हाथ बाहर
verses.wordMeaning: They saw the consort of Uma, the great deity of large eyes and full of Yogic bliss; the lord who is the abode of knowledge and detachment; the eternal lord of the path of knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: They saw the consort of Uma, the great deity of large eyes and full of Yogic bliss; the lord who is the abode of knowledge and detachment; the eternal lord of the path of knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: मां पश्यन्तीह विद्वांशो धार्मिका वेदवादिनः । तेषां सन्निहितो नित्यं ये भक्त्या मामुपासते
verses.transliteration: māṃ paśyantīha vidvāṃśo dhārmikā vedavādinaḥ / teṣāṃ sannihito nityaṃ ye bhaktyā māmupāsate
verses.translation: At the beginning of universe, I created Brahma, Paramesthin and handed over to him the Vedas that came out of myself.
verses.hindi: निकालकर दाहिने बाहुके ऊपर (दाहिने कंधेके ऊपर) रखे हुए यज्ञसूत्रको “प्राचीनावीत' (अपसव्य) कहा जाता है इसका प्रयोग पितृकर्ममें करना चाहिए मौञ्जी त्रिवृत् समा श्लक्ष्णा कार्या विप्रस्य मेखला । मुञ्जाभावे कुशेनाहुर्ग्रन्थिनैकेन वा त्रिभिः
verses.wordMeaning: At the beginning of universe, I created Brahma, Paramesthin and handed over to him the Vedas that came out of myself.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the beginning of universe, I created Brahma, Paramesthin and handed over to him the Vedas that came out of myself.
