verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रिया वैश्या धार्मिका मामुपासते । तेषां ददामि तत् स्थानमानन्दं परमं पदम्
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyā dhārmikā māmupāsate / teṣāṃ dadāmi tat sthānamānandaṃ paramaṃ padam
verses.translation: I alone am the unchanging (eternal) preceptor of all Yogins; I am the protector of the virtuous and the slayer of those who hate the Vedas.
verses.hindi: धारयेद् बैल्वपालाशौ दण्डौ केशान्तकौ द्विजः । यज्ञाईवुक्षजं वाथ सौम्यमत्रणमेव च
verses.wordMeaning: I alone am the unchanging (eternal) preceptor of all Yogins; I am the protector of the virtuous and the slayer of those who hate the Vedas.
verses.commentary: Sense: I alone am the unchanging (eternal) preceptor of all Yogins; I am the protector of the virtuous and the slayer of those who hate the Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: अन्ये ऽपि ये विकर्मस्थाः शूद्राद्या नीचजातयः । भक्तिमन्तः प्रमुच्यन्ते कालेन मयि संगताः
verses.transliteration: anye 'pi ye vikarmasthāḥ śūdrādyā nīcajātayaḥ / bhaktimantaḥ pramucyante kālena mayi saṃgatāḥ
verses.translation: I am the liberator of Yogins here from all worldly bondage. I am the cause as well of worldly existence though I am bereft of all worldly ties.
verses.hindi: कामाल्लोभाद् भयान्मोहात् त्यक्तेन पतितो भवेत् अग्निकार्य ततः कुर्यात् सायं प्रातः प्रसन्नधीः । स्नात्वा संतर्पयेद् देवानृषीन् पितृगणांस्तथा
verses.wordMeaning: I am the liberator of Yogins here from all worldly bondage. I am the cause as well of worldly existence though I am bereft of all worldly ties.
verses.commentary: Sense: I am the liberator of Yogins here from all worldly bondage. I am the cause as well of worldly existence though I am bereft of all worldly ties.

verses.sanskrit: न मद्भक्ता विनश्यन्ति मद्भक्ता वीतकल्मषाः । आदावेतत् प्रतिज्ञातं न मे भक्तः प्रणश्यति
verses.transliteration: na madbhaktā vinaśyanti madbhaktā vītakalmaṣāḥ / ādāvetat pratijñātaṃ na me bhaktaḥ praṇaśyati
verses.translation: I alone am the annihilator, the creator and the pro¬ tector of the universe. Maya, the enchantress of the worlds, is my own potency.
verses.hindi: अभिवादनशीलः स्यान्नित्यं वृद्धेषु धर्मतः
verses.wordMeaning: I alone am the annihilator, the creator and the pro¬ tector of the universe. Maya, the enchantress of the worlds, is my own potency.
verses.commentary: Sense: I alone am the annihilator, the creator and the pro¬ tector of the universe. Maya, the enchantress of the worlds, is my own potency.

verses.sanskrit: यो वै निन्दति तं मूढो देवदेवं स निन्दति । यो हि तं पूजयेद् भक्त्या स पूजयति मां सदा
verses.transliteration: yo vai nindati taṃ mūḍho devadevaṃ sa nindati / yo hi taṃ pūjayed bhaktyā sa pūjayati māṃ sadā
verses.translation: What is called as Vidya (knowledge) is my own trans¬ cendental power. Stationed in the hearts of Yogins, I annihi¬ late that Maya.
verses.hindi: असावहं भो नामेति सम्यक् प्रणतिपूर्वकम् । आयुरारोग्यसिद्धयर्थं तन्द्रादिपरिवर्जितः अकारश्चास्य नाम्नोऽन्ते वाच्यः पूर्वाक्षरः प्लुतः
verses.wordMeaning: What is called as Vidya (knowledge) is my own trans¬ cendental power. Stationed in the hearts of Yogins, I annihi¬ late that Maya.
verses.commentary: Sense: What is called as Vidya (knowledge) is my own trans¬ cendental power. Stationed in the hearts of Yogins, I annihi¬ late that Maya.

verses.sanskrit: पत्रं पुष्पं फलं तोयं मदाराधनकारणात् । यो मे ददाति नियतः स मे भक्तः प्रियो मतः
verses.transliteration: patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ madārādhanakāraṇāt / yo me dadāti niyataḥ sa me bhaktaḥ priyo mataḥ
verses.translation: I am the originator and restrainer of all powers. I am the support of all potencies. I am the storehouse of nectar (or immortality).
verses.hindi: व्यत्यस्तपाणिना कार्यमुपसंग्रहणं गुरोः। सव्येन सव्यः स्प्रष्टव्यो दक्षिणेन तु दक्षिण:
verses.wordMeaning: I am the originator and restrainer of all powers. I am the support of all potencies. I am the storehouse of nectar (or immortality).
verses.commentary: Sense: I am the originator and restrainer of all powers. I am the support of all potencies. I am the storehouse of nectar (or immortality).

verses.sanskrit: अहं हि जगतामादौ ब्रह्माणं परमेष्ठिनम् । विधाय दत्तवान् वेदानशेषानात्मनिः सृतान्
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ hi jagatāmādau brahmāṇaṃ parameṣṭhinam / vidhāya dattavān vedānaśeṣānātmaniḥ sṛtān
verses.translation: All of us bow down to you, the only supreme Ruler, the ancient Purusa, the lord of the Pranas (vital breaths), RUDRA of infinite Yogic Power. You are stationed in the cavity of the heart, you are Pracetas (of lofty mind), holy and identical with Brahman.
verses.hindi: एवंविधानि चान्यानि न हैवाद्येषु कर्मसु यज्ञशाला, गोशाला, होम, जप, स्वाध्याय, भोजन, ब्राह्मणोंकी संनिधि, गुरुओंकी उपासना, दोनों संध्याओं और साधुओंके समागम (सत्संग)-के समय नित्य उपवीती रहना चाहिए यह सनातन विधि है। विप्र
verses.wordMeaning: All of us bow down to you, the only supreme Ruler, the ancient Purusa, the lord of the Pranas (vital breaths), RUDRA of infinite Yogic Power. You are stationed in the cavity of the heart, you are Pracetas (of lofty mind), holy and identical with Brahman.
verses.commentary: Sense: All of us bow down to you, the only supreme Ruler, the ancient Purusa, the lord of the Pranas (vital breaths), RUDRA of infinite Yogic Power. You are stationed in the cavity of the heart, you are Pracetas (of lofty mind), holy and identical with Brahman.

verses.sanskrit: अहमेव हि सर्वेषां योगिनां गुरुरव्ययः । धार्मिकाणां च गोप्ताहं निहन्ता वेदविद्विषाम्
verses.transliteration: ahameva hi sarveṣāṃ yogināṃ gururavyayaḥ / dhārmikāṇāṃ ca goptāhaṃ nihantā vedavidviṣām
verses.translation: After meditating within their self in their (physical) bodies on the absolutely immovable or unagitated Kavi (the seer or the wise) who is supremely superior to the greatest, the quiescent sages of perfect self-control perceive you, the pure, gold-complexioned God originating from the Brahman (or the creator of God Brahma).
verses.hindi: (वटु)-की मेखला मूँजसे बनी हुई, तिहरी, बराबर तथा चिकनी बनानी चाहिए। मूँजके अभावमें कुशकी एक या तीन ग्रन्थियोंसे युक्त मेखला बनानी चाहिए। द्विजको केशान्तपर्यन्त बिल्व अथवा पलाशका चाहे
verses.wordMeaning: After meditating within their self in their (physical) bodies on the absolutely immovable or unagitated Kavi (the seer or the wise) who is supremely superior to the greatest, the quiescent sages of perfect self-control perceive you, the pure,…
verses.commentary: Sense: After meditating within their self in their (physical) bodies on the absolutely immovable or unagitated Kavi (the seer or the wise) who is supremely superior to the greatest, the quiescent sages of perfect self-control perceive you, the pure,…

verses.sanskrit: अहं वै सर्वसंसारान्मोचको योगिनामिह । संसारहेतुरेवाहं सर्वसंसारवर्जितः
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ vai sarvasaṃsārānmocako yogināmiha / saṃsāraheturevāhaṃ sarvasaṃsāravarjitaḥ
verses.translation: The mother of the universe [Prakrti) is born of you- though minute like the atom, you experience (perceive) every¬ thing. You are minuter than the minute atom and greater than the greatest being. * Sages say that you alone are all.
verses.hindi: किसी यज्ञीय वृक्षका सुन्दर (चिकना) तथा छिद्र आदिसे रहित दण्ड धारण करना चाहिए॥ १२ १५॥ द्विजको सायं तथा प्रातः समाहित होकर संध्या करनी चाहिए। काम, लोभ, भय अथवा मोहसे संध्याका त्याग करनेसे वह (द्विज) पतित हो जाता है। तदनन्तर प्रसन्न-मनसे सायं और प्रातः हवन करना
verses.wordMeaning: The mother of the universe [Prakrti) is born of you- though minute like the atom, you experience (perceive) every¬ thing. You are minuter than the minute atom and greater than the greatest being. * Sages say that you alone are all.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mother of the universe [Prakrti) is born of you- though minute like the atom, you experience (perceive) every¬ thing. You are minuter than the minute atom and greater than the greatest being. * Sages say that you alone are all.

verses.sanskrit: अहमेव हि संहर्ता स्त्रष्टाहं परिपालकः । मायावी मामीका शक्तिर्माया लोकविमोहिनी
verses.transliteration: ahameva hi saṃhartā straṣṭāhaṃ paripālakaḥ / māyāvī māmīkā śaktirmāyā lokavimohinī
verses.translation: Some perceive me through meditation, others through the path of spiritual knowledge; others through the path of devotion and still others through the path of action.
verses.hindi: चाहिए । त्रानके उपरान्त देवताओं, ऋषियों तथा पितरोंका तर्पण करना चाहिए। पत्र, पुष्प अथवा जलसे देवताओंका पूजन करना चाहिए। आयु तथा आरोग्यकी प्रासिके लिये आलस्य आदिसे सर्वथा मुक्त होकर “यह मैं
verses.wordMeaning: Some perceive me through meditation, others through the path of spiritual knowledge; others through the path of devotion and still others through the path of action.
verses.commentary: Sense: Some perceive me through meditation, others through the path of spiritual knowledge; others through the path of devotion and still others through the path of action.

verses.sanskrit: ममैव च परा शक्तिर्या सा विद्येति गीयते । नाशयामि तया मायां योगिनां हृदि संस्थितः
verses.transliteration: mamaiva ca parā śaktiryā sā vidyeti gīyate / nāśayāmi tayā māyāṃ yogināṃ hṛdi saṃsthitaḥ
verses.translation: The Vedas are born of you; and ultimately they find stability in you alone. We see that you are the cause of the universe. We see that you who abide in our own hearts, are dancing.
verses.hindi: अमुक नामवाला आपको प्रणाम करता हुँ'--इस प्रकार धर्मपूर्वक वृद्धजनोंका नित्य अभिवादन करना चाहिए। अभिवादन किये जानेपर विप्रको ' आयुष्मान् भव सौम्य' अर्थात् “सौम्य ! तुम दीर्घायु होओ' इस प्रकार अभिवादनका उत्तर देना चाहिए। उसके नामके अन्तिम स्वर अथवा नामके अन्तिम अक्षरके व्यञ्जन होनेपर उसके ठीक पूर्वके स्वरको प्लुत (दीर्घतर) स्वरमें बोलना चाहिए॥ १६--२० ॥
verses.wordMeaning: The Vedas are born of you; and ultimately they find stability in you alone. We see that you are the cause of the universe. We see that you who abide in our own hearts, are dancing.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Vedas are born of you; and ultimately they find stability in you alone. We see that you are the cause of the universe. We see that you who abide in our own hearts, are dancing.

verses.sanskrit: अहं हि सर्वशक्तीनां प्रवर्तकनिवर्तकः । आधारभूतः सर्वासां निधानममृतस्य च
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ hi sarvaśaktīnāṃ pravartakanivartakaḥ / ādhārabhūtaḥ sarvāsāṃ nidhānamamṛtasya ca
verses.translation: This wheel of Brahman (the creation etc. of Brah- manda) is made to revolve by you alone. You are the master of Maya and the only lord of the worlds. We seek refuge in you and bow into you; the very soul of Yoga, who dance the divine dance.
verses.hindi: जो द्विजं अभिवादन करनेपर प्रत्यभिवादन (अभिवादनका उत्तर) नहीं करता, उसका अभिवादन विद्वान्को नहीं करना चाहिए; क्योंकि वह शूद्रके समान ही है। अभिवादनके समय गुरुके चरणोंका
verses.wordMeaning: This wheel of Brahman (the creation etc. of Brah- manda) is made to revolve by you alone. You are the master of Maya and the only lord of the worlds. We seek refuge in you and bow into you; the very soul of Yoga, who dance the divine dance.
verses.commentary: Sense: This wheel of Brahman (the creation etc. of Brah- manda) is made to revolve by you alone. You are the master of Maya and the only lord of the worlds. We seek refuge in you and bow into you; the very soul of Yoga, who dance the divine dance.

verses.sanskrit: एका सर्वान्तरा शक्तिः करोति विविधं जगत् । आस्थाय ब्रह्माणो रूपं मन्मयी मदधिष्ठिता
verses.transliteration: ekā sarvāntarā śaktiḥ karoti vividhaṃ jagat / āsthāya brahmāṇo rūpaṃ manmayī madadhiṣṭhitā
verses.translation: We perceive you who '-dance dn the rhiddle of the highest firmament and we remember your grandeur. Experienc¬ ing constantly the supreme bliss of the Brahman, youwho abide in the souls of all, permeate the universe on all sides.
verses.hindi: स्पर्श व्यत्यस्तपाणि होकर करना चाहिए अर्थात् बायें हाथसे बायें पैरको और दाहिने हाथसे दाहिने पैरको स्पर्श करना चाहिए। जिससे लौकिक, वैदिक अथवा आध्यात्मिक ज्ञान प्राप्त किया हो, उस (गुरु)-का सर्वप्रथम अभिवादन करना चाहिए। देवपूजन (देव, पित्र्य) आदि कमाँमें भिक्षामें प्रात जल, पुष्प तथा समिधा अथवा इसी प्रकारके अन्य पदार्थोका ग्रहण (प्रयोग) नहीं करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: We perceive you who '-dance dn the rhiddle of the highest firmament and we remember your grandeur. Experienc¬ ing constantly the supreme bliss of the Brahman, youwho abide in the souls of all, permeate the universe on all sides.
verses.commentary: Sense: We perceive you who '-dance dn the rhiddle of the highest firmament and we remember your grandeur. Experienc¬ ing constantly the supreme bliss of the Brahman, youwho abide in the souls of all, permeate the universe on all sides.

verses.sanskrit: अन्या च शक्तिर्विपुला संस्थापयति मे जगत् । भूत्वा नारायणो ऽनन्तो जगन्नाथो जगन्मयः
verses.transliteration: anyā ca śaktirvipulā saṃsthāpayati me jagat / bhūtvā nārāyaṇo 'nanto jagannātho jaganmayaḥ
verses.translation: The syllable OM, the seed of liberation, is your (expressive) symbol. Imperishable though you are, you lie concealed in the primordial Nature (Prakrti). Such as you are, saints here aver that you, the self-luminous one of such prowess are the Reality.
verses.hindi: अनुवर्तनमेतेषां मनोवाक्कायकर्मभिः
verses.wordMeaning: The syllable OM, the seed of liberation, is your (expressive) symbol. Imperishable though you are, you lie concealed in the primordial Nature (Prakrti). Such as you are, saints here aver that you, the self-luminous one of such prowess are the Reality.
verses.commentary: Sense: The syllable OM, the seed of liberation, is your (expressive) symbol. Imperishable though you are, you lie concealed in the primordial Nature (Prakrti). Such as you are, saints here aver that you, the self-luminous one of such prowess are the Reality.

verses.sanskrit: तृतीया महती शक्तिर्निहन्ति सकलं जगत् । तामसी मे समाख्याता कालाख्या रुद्ररूपिणी
verses.transliteration: tṛtīyā mahatī śaktirnihanti sakalaṃ jagat / tāmasī me samākhyātā kālākhyā rudrarūpiṇī
verses.translation: The Vedas perpetually eulogise you. The sages whose blemishes have been wiped off, bow unto you. Ascetics engrossed in Brahman, with quiescent souls and truthful as well enter unto you, the excellent one.
verses.hindi: नैतैरुपविशेत् सार्ध विददेन्नात्मकारणात् यावत् पिता च माता च द्वावेतौ निर्विकारिणौ ।
verses.wordMeaning: The Vedas perpetually eulogise you. The sages whose blemishes have been wiped off, bow unto you. Ascetics engrossed in Brahman, with quiescent souls and truthful as well enter unto you, the excellent one.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Vedas perpetually eulogise you. The sages whose blemishes have been wiped off, bow unto you. Ascetics engrossed in Brahman, with quiescent souls and truthful as well enter unto you, the excellent one.

verses.sanskrit: ध्यानेन मां प्रपश्यन्ति केचिज्ज्ञानेन चापरे । अपरे भक्तियोगेन कर्मयोगेन चापरे
verses.transliteration: dhyānena māṃ prapaśyanti kecijjñānena cāpare / apare bhaktiyogena karmayogena cāpare
verses.translation: You are the destroyer of the earth; you are without beginning. You have the universal form. You are Brahma the Paramesthin and Visnu the most excellent. Those who are not unsteady and those who are ever liberated, experience the bliss of their Atman and enter into you, the self-luminous one.
verses.hindi: (मिलनेपर) ब्राह्मणसे उसका ' कुशल ' पूछना चाहिए, इसी प्रकार क्षत्रियसे 'अनामय' (रोगराहित्य), वैश्यसे ' क्षेम' और शूद्रसे ' आरोग्य’ पूछना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: You are the destroyer of the earth; you are without beginning. You have the universal form. You are Brahma the Paramesthin and Visnu the most excellent. Those who are not unsteady and those who are ever liberated, experience the bliss of their Atman and enter into you,…
verses.commentary: Sense: You are the destroyer of the earth; you are without beginning. You have the universal form. You are Brahma the Paramesthin and Visnu the most excellent. Those who are not unsteady and those who are ever liberated, experience the bliss of their Atman and enter into you,…

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषामेव भक्तानामिष्टः प्रियतरो मम । यो हि ज्ञानेन मां नित्यमाराधयति नान्यथा
verses.transliteration: sarveṣāmeva bhaktānāmiṣṭaḥ priyataro mama / yo hi jñānena māṃ nityamārādhayati nānyathā
verses.translation: Though one as Rudra you are, you create the universe; you protect the entire universe; with all its forms;all these (visible worlds) attain to you as their ultimate abode. We seek refuge in you and make obeisance unto you.
verses.hindi: उपाध्याय१, पिता, ज्येष्ठ भ्राता, राजा, मामा, ससुर, रक्षक, मातामह, पितामह, अपनेसे श्रेष्ठ वर्णवाले तथा चाचा-ये लोग गुरु कहे गये हैं। माता, मातामही, गुरुपली, पिता एवं माताकी बहिन (बुआ एवं मौसी), सास, पितामही तथा ज्येष्ठ धात्री (शैशवावस्थामें पालन करनेवाली )-ये सभी स्त्रियाँ गुरु हैं। द्विजो! माता और पिताके सम्बन्धसे यह गुरुवर्ग कहा गया है अर्थात् माताके पक्षसे तथा पिताके पक्षसे जो लोग श्रेष्ठ कोटिमे
verses.wordMeaning: Though one as Rudra you are, you create the universe; you protect the entire universe; with all its forms;all these (visible worlds) attain to you as their ultimate abode. We seek refuge in you and make obeisance unto you.
verses.commentary: Sense: Though one as Rudra you are, you create the universe; you protect the entire universe; with all its forms;all these (visible worlds) attain to you as their ultimate abode. We seek refuge in you and make obeisance unto you.

verses.sanskrit: अन्ये च ये त्रयो भक्ता मदाराधनकाङ्क्षिणः । ते ऽपि मां प्राप्नुवन्त्येव नावर्तन्ते च वै पुनः
verses.transliteration: anye ca ye trayo bhaktā madārādhanakāṅkṣiṇaḥ / te 'pi māṃ prāpnuvantyeva nāvartante ca vai punaḥ
verses.translation: Though one as Rudra you are, you create the universe; you protect the entire universe; with all its forms;all these (visible worlds) attain to you as their ultimate abode. We seek refuge in you and make obeisance unto you.
verses.hindi: हैं उन्हें बताया गया। मन, वाणी और कर्मद्वारा इनको आज्ञाका पालन करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: Though one as Rudra you are, you create the universe; you protect the entire universe; with all its forms;all these (visible worlds) attain to you as their ultimate abode. We seek refuge in you and make obeisance unto you.
verses.commentary: Sense: Though one as Rudra you are, you create the universe; you protect the entire universe; with all its forms;all these (visible worlds) attain to you as their ultimate abode. We seek refuge in you and make obeisance unto you.

verses.sanskrit: मया ततमिदं कृत्सनं प्रधानपुरुषात्मकम् । मय्येव संस्थितं विश्वं मया संप्रेर्यते जगत्
verses.transliteration: mayā tatamidaṃ kṛtsanaṃ pradhānapuruṣātmakam / mayyeva saṃsthitaṃ viśvaṃ mayā saṃpreryate jagat
verses.translation: Though one as Rudra you are, you create the universe; you protect the entire universe; with all its forms;all these (visible worlds) attain to you as their ultimate abode. We seek refuge in you and make obeisance unto you.
verses.hindi: गुरुको देखते ही आसनसे उठ जाना चाहिए और अभिवादनकी विधिसे उन्हें अभिवादन करना चाहिए, अनन्तर उनकी आज्ञा पाकर हाथ जोड़कर सम्मुख बैठना चाहिए, पर इनके साथ एक आसनपर नहीं बैठना चाहिए और अपने लिये (व्यक्तिगत स्वार्थके लिये) इनसे विवाद भी नहीं करना चाहिए। प्राणधारणके लिये भी द्वेषवश गुरुजनोंसे विवाद न करे। अन्य गुणोंके विद्यमान रहनेपर भी गुरुसे द्वेष करनेवालोंका अधःपतन होता
verses.wordMeaning: Though one as Rudra you are, you create the universe; you protect the entire universe; with all its forms;all these (visible worlds) attain to you as their ultimate abode. We seek refuge in you and make obeisance unto you.
verses.commentary: Sense: Though one as Rudra you are, you create the universe; you protect the entire universe; with all its forms;all these (visible worlds) attain to you as their ultimate abode. We seek refuge in you and make obeisance unto you.

verses.sanskrit: नाहं प्रेरयिता विप्राः परमं योगमाश्रितः । प्रेरयामि जगत्कृत्स्नमेतद्यो वेद सो ऽमृतः
verses.transliteration: nāhaṃ prerayitā viprāḥ paramaṃ yogamāśritaḥ / prerayāmi jagatkṛtsnametadyo veda so 'mṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Though one as Rudra you are, you create the universe; you protect the entire universe; with all its forms;all these (visible worlds) attain to you as their ultimate abode. We seek refuge in you and make obeisance unto you.
verses.hindi: है अर्थात् गुरुद्वेषीके सभी गुण व्यर्थ होते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Though one as Rudra you are, you create the universe; you protect the entire universe; with all its forms;all these (visible worlds) attain to you as their ultimate abode. We seek refuge in you and make obeisance unto you.
verses.commentary: Sense: Though one as Rudra you are, you create the universe; you protect the entire universe; with all its forms;all these (visible worlds) attain to you as their ultimate abode. We seek refuge in you and make obeisance unto you.

verses.sanskrit: पश्याम्यशेषमेवेदं वर्तमानं स्वभावतः । करोति कालो भगवान् महायोगेश्वरः स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: paśyāmyaśeṣamevedaṃ vartamānaṃ svabhāvataḥ / karoti kālo bhagavān mahāyogeśvaraḥ svayam
verses.translation: Though one as Rudra you are, you create the universe; you protect the entire universe; with all its forms;all these (visible worlds) attain to you as their ultimate abode. We seek refuge in you and make obeisance unto you.
verses.hindi: अभी बताये गये सभी गुरुओंमें भी पाँच विशेषरूपसे पूजनीय हैं। उनमें प्रथम तीन श्रेष्ठ हैं, उनमें भी माता अधिक पूज्य होती है। उत्पादक (पिता), उत्पन्न करनेवाली (माता), विद्याका उपदेश देनेवाले (गुरु), बड़े भाई और भरण-पोषण करनेवाले स्वामी-ये पाँच गुरु कहे गये हैं। कल्याण चाहनेवाले व्यक्तिको अपने सभी प्रयल्रोंके द्वारा प्राण ही क्यों न त्यागना पड़े, पर इन पाँचों (गुरुओं)-का विशेषरूपसे पूजन (आदर)
verses.wordMeaning: Though one as Rudra you are, you create the universe; you protect the entire universe; with all its forms;all these (visible worlds) attain to you as their ultimate abode. We seek refuge in you and make obeisance unto you.
verses.commentary: Sense: Though one as Rudra you are, you create the universe; you protect the entire universe; with all its forms;all these (visible worlds) attain to you as their ultimate abode. We seek refuge in you and make obeisance unto you.

verses.sanskrit: योगः संप्रोच्यते योगी माया शास्त्रेषु सूरिभिः । योगेश्वरो ऽसौ भगवान् महादेवो महान् प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: yogaḥ saṃprocyate yogī māyā śāstreṣu sūribhiḥ / yogeśvaro 'sau bhagavān mahādevo mahān prabhuḥ
verses.translation: Though one as Rudra you are, you create the universe; you protect the entire universe; with all its forms;all these (visible worlds) attain to you as their ultimate abode. We seek refuge in you and make obeisance unto you.
verses.wordMeaning: Though one as Rudra you are, you create the universe; you protect the entire universe; with all its forms;all these (visible worlds) attain to you as their ultimate abode. We seek refuge in you and make obeisance unto you.
verses.commentary: Sense: Though one as Rudra you are, you create the universe; you protect the entire universe; with all its forms;all these (visible worlds) attain to you as their ultimate abode. We seek refuge in you and make obeisance unto you.

verses.sanskrit: महत्त्वं सर्वतत्त्वानां परत्वात् परमेष्ठिनः । प्रोच्यते भगवान् ब्रह्मा महान् ब्रह्ममयो ऽमलः
verses.transliteration: mahattvaṃ sarvatattvānāṃ paratvāt parameṣṭhinaḥ / procyate bhagavān brahmā mahān brahmamayo 'malaḥ
verses.translation: Though one as Rudra you are, you create the universe; you protect the entire universe; with all its forms;all these (visible worlds) attain to you as their ultimate abode. We seek refuge in you and make obeisance unto you.
verses.hindi: जबतक माता और पिता ये दोनों निर्विकारी रहें, तबतक सब कुछ छोड़कर पुत्रको उनके परायण रहना चाहिए १-वेदके एकदेश मन्त्र या ब्राह्मण तथा वेदाङ्ग व्याकरण आदिका जो ब्राह्मण वृत्त्यर्थ (जीविकाके लिये) अध्यापन करते हैं,
verses.wordMeaning: Though one as Rudra you are, you create the universe; you protect the entire universe; with all its forms;all these (visible worlds) attain to you as their ultimate abode. We seek refuge in you and make obeisance unto you.
verses.commentary: Sense: Though one as Rudra you are, you create the universe; you protect the entire universe; with all its forms;all these (visible worlds) attain to you as their ultimate abode. We seek refuge in you and make obeisance unto you.

verses.sanskrit: यो मामेवं विजानाति महायोगेश्वरेश्वरम् । सो ऽविकल्पेन योगेन युज्यते नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: yo māmevaṃ vijānāti mahāyogeśvareśvaram / so 'vikalpena yogena yujyate nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Though one as Rudra you are, you create the universe; you protect the entire universe; with all its forms;all these (visible worlds) attain to you as their ultimate abode. We seek refuge in you and make obeisance unto you.
verses.hindi: २-यहाँ निर्विकारका अर्थ है गोहत्या, गुरुहत्या, ब्राह्मणहत्या-जैसे परिगणित महापातकोंसे रहित। दुर्भाग्यवश यदि माता-पिता महापातकी हो जाते हैं तो उन्हें प्रायश्चि्तके लिये पुत्रादिसे अलग रहना ही पड़ता है। उस समय उनकी सेवा आदिसे पुत्रको भी वञ्चित
verses.wordMeaning: Though one as Rudra you are, you create the universe; you protect the entire universe; with all its forms;all these (visible worlds) attain to you as their ultimate abode. We seek refuge in you and make obeisance unto you.
verses.commentary: Sense: Though one as Rudra you are, you create the universe; you protect the entire universe; with all its forms;all these (visible worlds) attain to you as their ultimate abode. We seek refuge in you and make obeisance unto you.

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽहं प्रेरयिता देवः परमानन्दमाश्रितः । नृत्यामि योगी सततं यस्तद् वेद स वेदवित्
verses.transliteration: so 'haṃ prerayitā devaḥ paramānandamāśritaḥ / nṛtyāmi yogī satataṃ yastad veda sa vedavit
verses.translation: Though one as Rudra you are, you create the universe; you protect the entire universe; with all its forms;all these (visible worlds) attain to you as their ultimate abode. We seek refuge in you and make obeisance unto you.
verses.hindi: यदि पुत्रके गुणों (सत्कर्मनिष्ठा-सेवाभाव आदि)- स पुत्रः सकलं धर्ममाप्नुयात् तेन कर्मणा॥ ३५॥  के कारण पिता-माता पुत्रपर प्रसन्न रहते हैं तो वह पुत्र
verses.wordMeaning: Though one as Rudra you are, you create the universe; you protect the entire universe; with all its forms;all these (visible worlds) attain to you as their ultimate abode. We seek refuge in you and make obeisance unto you.
verses.commentary: Sense: Though one as Rudra you are, you create the universe; you protect the entire universe; with all its forms;all these (visible worlds) attain to you as their ultimate abode. We seek refuge in you and make obeisance unto you.

verses.sanskrit: इति गुह्यतमं ज्ञानं सर्ववेदेषु निष्ठितम् । प्रसन्नचेतसे देयं धार्मिकायाहिताग्नये
verses.transliteration: iti guhyatamaṃ jñānaṃ sarvavedeṣu niṣṭhitam / prasannacetase deyaṃ dhārmikāyāhitāgnaye
verses.translation: Though one as Rudra you are, you create the universe; you protect the entire universe; with all its forms;all these (visible worlds) attain to you as their ultimate abode. We seek refuge in you and make obeisance unto you.
verses.hindi: नास्ति मातृसमं हैवं नास्ति पितृसमो गुरुः। तयोः प्रत्युपकारोऽपि न कथञ्चन विद्यते
verses.wordMeaning: Though one as Rudra you are, you create the universe; you protect the entire universe; with all its forms;all these (visible worlds) attain to you as their ultimate abode. We seek refuge in you and make obeisance unto you.
verses.commentary: Sense: Though one as Rudra you are, you create the universe; you protect the entire universe; with all its forms;all these (visible worlds) attain to you as their ultimate abode. We seek refuge in you and make obeisance unto you.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे (ईश्वरगीतासु) चतुर्थो ऽध्यायः व्यास उवाच एतावदुक्त्वा भगवान् योगिनां परमेश्वरः । ननर्त परमं भावमैश्वरं संप्रदर्शयन्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge (īśvaragītāsu) caturtho 'dhyāyaḥ vyāsa uvāca etāvaduktvā bhagavān yogināṃ parameśvaraḥ / nanarta paramaṃ bhāvamaiśvaraṃ saṃpradarśayan
verses.translation: The Veda which has many branches and is infinite is one. It reveals you alone who are of a single form. Those Brahmanas who seek refuge in you who are worthy of being respected, cross the Maya in this very world.
verses.hindi: तयोर्नित्यं प्रियं कुर्यात् कर्मणा मनसा गिरा। न ताभ्यामननुज्ञातो धर्ममन्यं समाचरेत् धर्मसारः समुद्दिष्टः प्रेत्यानन्तफलप्रदः
verses.wordMeaning: The Veda which has many branches and is infinite is one. It reveals you alone who are of a single form. Those Brahmanas who seek refuge in you who are worthy of being respected, cross the Maya in this very world.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Veda which has many branches and is infinite is one. It reveals you alone who are of a single form. Those Brahmanas who seek refuge in you who are worthy of being respected, cross the Maya in this very world.

verses.sanskrit: तं ते ददृशुरीशानं तेजसां परमं निधिम् । नृत्यमानं महादेवं विष्णुना गगने ऽमले
verses.transliteration: taṃ te dadṛśurīśānaṃ tejasāṃ paramaṃ nidhim / nṛtyamānaṃ mahādevaṃ viṣṇunā gagane 'male
verses.translation: They call you the only poet (kavi), the Supreme Rudra, eulogising the Veda, Hari, fire and Isa; they call you the eternal Rudra, the wind-god; the consciousness, the creator, the sun-god of many forms.
verses.hindi: याति दातरि लोकेऽस्मिन् उपकाराद्द्रि गौरवम्
verses.wordMeaning: They call you the only poet (kavi), the Supreme Rudra, eulogising the Veda, Hari, fire and Isa; they call you the eternal Rudra, the wind-god; the consciousness, the creator, the sun-god of many forms.
verses.commentary: Sense: They call you the only poet (kavi), the Supreme Rudra, eulogising the Veda, Hari, fire and Isa; they call you the eternal Rudra, the wind-god; the consciousness, the creator, the sun-god of many forms.

verses.sanskrit: यं विदुर्योगतत्त्वज्ञा योगिनो यतमानसाः । तमीशं सर्वभूतानामाकशे ददृशुः किल
verses.transliteration: yaṃ viduryogatattvajñā yogino yatamānasāḥ / tamīśaṃ sarvabhūtānāmākaśe dadṛśuḥ kila
verses.translation: You are the supreme imperishable one that should be realised, You are the ultimate receptable of this universe. You are the unchanging one, protecting the eternal Law (dharma). You are the most excellent Purusa, the eternal one.
verses.hindi: तेषामथाक्षयाँल्लोकान् प्रोवाच भगवान् मनु: असावहमिति ब्रूयुः प्रत्युत्थाय यवीयसः
verses.wordMeaning: You are the supreme imperishable one that should be realised, You are the ultimate receptable of this universe. You are the unchanging one, protecting the eternal Law (dharma). You are the most excellent Purusa, the eternal one.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are the supreme imperishable one that should be realised, You are the ultimate receptable of this universe. You are the unchanging one, protecting the eternal Law (dharma). You are the most excellent Purusa, the eternal one.

verses.sanskrit: यस्य मायामयं सर्वं येनेदं प्रेर्यते जगत् । नृत्यमानः स्वयं विप्रैर्विश्वेशः खलु दृश्यते
verses.transliteration: yasya māyāmayaṃ sarvaṃ yenedaṃ preryate jagat / nṛtyamānaḥ svayaṃ viprairviśveśaḥ khalu dṛśyate
verses.translation: You alone are Visnu; you are the four-faced deity (Brahma); you alone are Rudra, the lord Isa as well; you are verily the lord of the universe; you are Prakrti, the basis of all. You are the lord of all, the supreme Isvara.
verses.hindi: अपने इन सत्कर्मनिष्ठा आदि कर्म (गुणों)-से सम्पूर्ण धर्मको प्राप्त कर लेता है (अर्थात् यज्ञ, दान आदि बड़े- बड़े कर्मोसे होनेवाले सभी पुण्य माता-पिताको प्रसन्नताके कारण पुत्रको प्राप्त होते हँ) । माताके समान कोई देवता
verses.wordMeaning: You alone are Visnu; you are the four-faced deity (Brahma); you alone are Rudra, the lord Isa as well; you are verily the lord of the universe; you are Prakrti, the basis of all. You are the lord of all, the supreme Isvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: You alone are Visnu; you are the four-faced deity (Brahma); you alone are Rudra, the lord Isa as well; you are verily the lord of the universe; you are Prakrti, the basis of all. You are the lord of all, the supreme Isvara.

verses.sanskrit: यत् पादपङ्कजं स्मृत्वा पुरुषो ऽज्ञानजं भयम् । जहति नृत्यमानं तं भूतेशं ददृशुः किल
verses.transliteration: yat pādapaṅkajaṃ smṛtvā puruṣo 'jñānajaṃ bhayam / jahati nṛtyamānaṃ taṃ bhūteśaṃ dadṛśuḥ kila
verses.translation: The sages say that you are the ancient Purusa, one without a second, of the brillance of the sun beyond the darkness (of ignorance). They call you, the consciousness itself the unmanifest, of infinite forms, the void, the firmament, the Brahman, the Prakrti and the Gunas (v. 1. above i. e. transcen¬ dental to the Gunas).
verses.hindi: नहीं है, पिताके समान कोई गुरु नहीं है। उनके उपकारका कोई भी प्रत्युपकार नहीं है उन दोनों (अर्थात् माता-पिता)-का मन, वाणी तथा कर्मसे नित्य ही प्रिय करना चाहिए। मोक्षसाधक (कर्मो) और नित्य-नैमित्तिक कर्माको छोड़कर बिना उनको आज्ञा प्राप्त किये दूसरे किसी धर्मका आचरण
verses.wordMeaning: The sages say that you are the ancient Purusa, one without a second, of the brillance of the sun beyond the darkness (of ignorance). They call you, the consciousness itself the unmanifest, of infinite forms, the void, the firmament, the Brahman, the Prakrti and the Gunas (v. 1.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The sages say that you are the ancient Purusa, one without a second, of the brillance of the sun beyond the darkness (of ignorance). They call you, the consciousness itself the unmanifest, of infinite forms, the void, the firmament, the Brahman, the Prakrti and the Gunas (v. 1.…

verses.sanskrit: यं विनिद्रा जितश्वासाः शान्ता भक्तिसमन्विताः । ज्योतिर्मयं प्रपश्यन्ति स योगी दृश्यते किल
verses.transliteration: yaṃ vinidrā jitaśvāsāḥ śāntā bhaktisamanvitāḥ / jyotirmayaṃ prapaśyanti sa yogī dṛśyate kila
verses.translation: This form of yours is something that cannot be con¬ ceived of; within it all these (visible worlds) appear; it is un¬ changing and blemishless, but is one single form; it is beyond the ken of thought and indescribable; all that appears within it is you alone, (or; your form is so wonderfully indescribable that the Reality shines in it).
verses.hindi: नहीं करना चाहिए। (उनकी सेवाको) धर्मका सार और मृत्युके अनन्तर मोक्षफल देनेवाला बताया गया है। उपदेष्टा (गुरु)-को अच्छी प्रकार आराधना करनेके अनन्तर उनको आशासे ब्रह्मचर्याश्रमका परित्यागकर
verses.wordMeaning: This form of yours is something that cannot be con¬ ceived of; within it all these (visible worlds) appear; it is un¬ changing and blemishless, but is one single form; it is beyond the ken of thought and indescribable; all that appears within it is you alone, (or;…
verses.commentary: Sense: This form of yours is something that cannot be con¬ ceived of; within it all these (visible worlds) appear; it is un¬ changing and blemishless, but is one single form; it is beyond the ken of thought and indescribable; all that appears within it is you alone, (or;…

verses.sanskrit: यो ऽज्ञानान्मोचयेत् क्षिप्रं प्रसन्नो भक्तवत्सलः । तमेव मोचकं रुद्रमाकाशे ददृशुः परम्
verses.transliteration: yo 'jñānānmocayet kṣipraṃ prasanno bhaktavatsalaḥ / tameva mocakaṃ rudramākāśe dadṛśuḥ param
verses.translation: Seeking refuge in you, all of us make obeisance to you, the gracious lord of Yogas, the greatest goal of infinite power, the ancient one with the body of Brahman, O Lord of Bhutas, O Mahesa, be gracious unto us
verses.hindi: गृहस्थाश्रम स्वीकार करनेवाला स्नातक शिष्य विद्याके फलका उपभोग करता है और मृत्युके उपरान्त स्वर्गलोक प्राप्त करता है अर्थात् अभ्युदय (एऐहलौकिक उन्नति) प्राप्त करता है। जो पितृतुल्य बड़े भाईको मूर्ख समझता है, मरनेपर वह उस दोषके कारण घोर नरक प्राप्त करता है॥ ३७--४०॥
verses.wordMeaning: Seeking refuge in you, all of us make obeisance to you, the gracious lord of Yogas, the greatest goal of infinite power, the ancient one with the body of Brahman, O Lord of Bhutas, O Mahesa, be gracious unto us
verses.commentary: Sense: Seeking refuge in you, all of us make obeisance to you, the gracious lord of Yogas, the greatest goal of infinite power, the ancient one with the body of Brahman, O Lord of Bhutas, O Mahesa, be gracious unto us

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रशिरसं देवं सहस्रचरणाकृतिम् । सहस्रबाहुं जटिलं चन्द्रार्धकृतशेखरम्
verses.transliteration: sahasraśirasaṃ devaṃ sahasracaraṇākṛtim / sahasrabāhuṃ jaṭilaṃ candrārdhakṛtaśekharam
verses.translation: By remembering your lotus-like feet, the seed (cause) of the entire worldly existence becomes dissolved. After con¬ trolling the body and concentrating the mind, we propitiate you, the only Supreme Lord.
verses.hindi: अच्छे मार्गमें स्थित (सत्कर्तव्यपरायण) पुरुषके लिये भरण-पोषण करनेवाला भर्ता (स्वामी) सदा पूज्य (आदरविशेषके योग्य) होता है। उपकार करनेके कारण दाता इस लोकमें अत्यधिक गौरव प्राप्त करता
verses.wordMeaning: By remembering your lotus-like feet, the seed (cause) of the entire worldly existence becomes dissolved. After con¬ trolling the body and concentrating the mind, we propitiate you, the only Supreme Lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: By remembering your lotus-like feet, the seed (cause) of the entire worldly existence becomes dissolved. After con¬ trolling the body and concentrating the mind, we propitiate you, the only Supreme Lord.

verses.sanskrit: वसानं चर्म वैयाघ्रं शूलासक्तमहाकरम् । दण्डपाणिं त्रयीनेत्रं सूर्यसोमाग्निलोचनम्
verses.transliteration: vasānaṃ carma vaiyāghraṃ śūlāsaktamahākaram / daṇḍapāṇiṃ trayīnetraṃ sūryasomāgnilocanam
verses.translation: Obeisance to Bhava, the source of origin of the worlds; to Kala,to Sarva, to you the annihilator; obeisance be to Rudra with matted hair. Obeisance to you. O Lord, who are the fire; obeisance to Siva."
verses.hindi: ही है। जो लोग भर्तासे प्राप्त जीविकाके बदले अपने प्राणोंतकका परित्याग कर देते हैं, उन्हें अक्षय लोक प्राप्त होते हैं, ऐसा भगवान् मनुने कहा है अपनेसे अल्प अवस्थावाले मामा, चाचा, ससुर तथा ऋत्विजूके प्रति प्रत्युत्थानपूर्वक (आसनसे उठकर) “मैं अमुक नामवाला हुँ'-केवल ऐसा ही कहकर अपना सम्मानभाव व्यक्त करना चाहिए, इन्हें अभिवादन-
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to Bhava, the source of origin of the worlds; to Kala,to Sarva, to you the annihilator; obeisance be to Rudra with matted hair. Obeisance to you. O Lord, who are the fire; obeisance to Siva."
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to Bhava, the source of origin of the worlds; to Kala,to Sarva, to you the annihilator; obeisance be to Rudra with matted hair. Obeisance to you. O Lord, who are the fire; obeisance to Siva."

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्माण्डं तेजसा स्वेन सर्वमावृत्य च स्थितम् । दंष्ट्राकरालं दुर्धर्षं सूर्यकोटिसमप्रभम्
verses.transliteration: brahmāṇḍaṃ tejasā svena sarvamāvṛtya ca sthitam / daṃṣṭrākarālaṃ durdharṣaṃ sūryakoṭisamaprabham
verses.translation: Thereafter, the bull-vehicled Lord with matted hair delightedly withdrew his great cosmic form. Bhava (Siva) manifested his normal (usual) form.
verses.hindi: विधिसे अभिवादन नहीं करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, the bull-vehicled Lord with matted hair delightedly withdrew his great cosmic form. Bhava (Siva) manifested his normal (usual) form.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, the bull-vehicled Lord with matted hair delightedly withdrew his great cosmic form. Bhava (Siva) manifested his normal (usual) form.

verses.sanskrit: अण्डस्थं चाण्डबाह्यस्थं बाह्यमभ्यन्तरं परम् । सृजन्तमनलज्वालं दहन्तमखिलं जगत् । नृत्यन्तं ददृशुर्देवं विश्वकर्माणमीश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: aṇḍasthaṃ cāṇḍabāhyasthaṃ bāhyamabhyantaraṃ param / sṛjantamanalajvālaṃ dahantamakhilaṃ jagat / nṛtyantaṃ dadṛśurdevaṃ viśvakarmāṇamīśvaram
verses.translation: On seeing Bhava, the lord of everything past and future, remaining as before and lord Narayana (also in that state), the sages were struck with wonder and they spoke these words.
verses.hindi: होना ही पड़ता है। ऐसे समयसे अतिरिक्त समयमें तो पुत्रको माता-पिताके परायण अवश्य रहना ही चाहिए। माता-पिताके सविकार होनेका निर्णय शास्त्रोंके अनुसार अधिकारी विद्वान् लोग ही करते हैं। यह निर्णय पुत्रके अधीन नहीं है ।  मनुस्मृति (२। १३०) -में यही श्लोक है  वहाँ कुल्लूकभट्टने जो अर्थ किया है, तदनुसार ही यहाँ अर्थ समझना चाहिए। वहाँ जो अपनेसे छोटा भी (यज्ञादिमें) दीक्षित (पुरुष)
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing Bhava, the lord of everything past and future, remaining as before and lord Narayana (also in that state), the sages were struck with wonder and they spoke these words.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing Bhava, the lord of everything past and future, remaining as before and lord Narayana (also in that state), the sages were struck with wonder and they spoke these words.

verses.sanskrit: महादेवं महायोगं देवानामपि दैवतम् । पशूनां पतिमीशानं ज्योतिषां ज्योतिरव्ययम्
verses.transliteration: mahādevaṃ mahāyogaṃ devānāmapi daivatam / paśūnāṃ patimīśānaṃ jyotiṣāṃ jyotiravyayam
verses.translation: "O eternal lord, O lord of the past and future, O deity marked by the emblem of the bull! On seeing your grand form we are delighted, (v. 1. attained quiescence).
verses.hindi: भोभवत्पूर्वकं त्वेनमभिभाषेत धर्मवित्॥ ४४॥  हो तो उसका नाम लेकर नहीं पुकारना चाहिए। धर्मज
verses.wordMeaning: "O eternal lord, O lord of the past and future, O deity marked by the emblem of the bull! On seeing your grand form we are delighted, (v. 1. attained quiescence).
verses.commentary: Sense: "O eternal lord, O lord of the past and future, O deity marked by the emblem of the bull! On seeing your grand form we are delighted, (v. 1. attained quiescence).

verses.sanskrit: पिनाकिनं विशालाक्षं भेषजं भवरोगिणाम् । कालात्मानं कालकालं देवदेवं महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: pinākinaṃ viśālākṣaṃ bheṣajaṃ bhavarogiṇām / kālātmānaṃ kālakālaṃ devadevaṃ maheśvaram
verses.translation: Thanks to your grace, there is born our unswerving devotion to you, the great Supreme lord, the blemishless one.
verses.hindi: ब्राह्मणः क्षत्रियाद्यैश्च श्रीकामैः सादरं सदा ज्ञानकर्मगुणोपेता यद्यप्येते बहुश्रुताः
verses.wordMeaning: Thanks to your grace, there is born our unswerving devotion to you, the great Supreme lord, the blemishless one.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thanks to your grace, there is born our unswerving devotion to you, the great Supreme lord, the blemishless one.

verses.sanskrit: उमापतिं विरूपाक्षं योगानन्दमयं परम् । ज्ञानवैराग्यनिलयं ज्ञानयोगं सनातनम्
verses.transliteration: umāpatiṃ virūpākṣaṃ yogānandamayaṃ param / jñānavairāgyanilayaṃ jñānayogaṃ sanātanam
verses.translation: O Sankara, now we wish to hear about your greatness as well as the eternal reality about Paramesthin".
verses.hindi: सवर्णेषु सवर्णानां कार्यमेवाभिवादनम्
verses.wordMeaning: O Sankara, now we wish to hear about your greatness as well as the eternal reality about Paramesthin".
verses.commentary: Sense: O Sankara, now we wish to hear about your greatness as well as the eternal reality about Paramesthin".

verses.sanskrit: शाश्वतैश्वर्यविभवं धर्माधारं दुरासदम् । महेन्द्रोपेन्द्रनमितं महर्षिगणवन्दितम्
verses.transliteration: śāśvataiśvaryavibhavaṃ dharmādhāraṃ durāsadam / mahendropendranamitaṃ maharṣigaṇavanditam
verses.translation: On hearing their words the lord, the bestower of Yogic siddhi on the Yogins, glanced at Madhava and said in a majestic voice.
verses.hindi: पतिरेको गुरुः स्त्रीणां सर्वत्राभ्यागतो गुरुः विद्या कर्म वयो बन्धुर्वित्तं भवति पञ्जमम्। मान्यस्थानानि पञ्चाहुः पूर्व पूर्व गुरूत्तरात्
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing their words the lord, the bestower of Yogic siddhi on the Yogins, glanced at Madhava and said in a majestic voice.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing their words the lord, the bestower of Yogic siddhi on the Yogins, glanced at Madhava and said in a majestic voice.

verses.sanskrit: आधारं सर्वशक्तीनां महायोगेश्वरेश्वरम् । योगिनां परमं ब्रह्म योगिनां योगवन्दितम् । योगिनां हृदि तिष्ठन्तं योगमायासमावृतम्
verses.transliteration: ādhāraṃ sarvaśaktīnāṃ mahāyogeśvareśvaram / yogināṃ paramaṃ brahma yogināṃ yogavanditam / yogināṃ hṛdi tiṣṭhantaṃ yogamāyāsamāvṛtam
verses.translation: VV. 13-15 describe how creation, maintenance and destruction of the universe is due to Siva.
verses.hindi: भिक्षामाहत्य शिष्ट्रानां गृहेभ्यः प्रयतोऽन्वहम्। निवेद्य गुरवेऽश्नीयाद् वाग्यतस्तदनुज्ञया
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 13-15 describe how creation, maintenance and destruction of the universe is due to Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 13-15 describe how creation, maintenance and destruction of the universe is due to Siva.

verses.sanskrit: क्षणेन जगतो योनिं नारायणमनामयम् । ईश्वरेणैकतापन्नमपश्यन् ब्रह्मवादिनः
verses.transliteration: kṣaṇena jagato yoniṃ nārāyaṇamanāmayam / īśvareṇaikatāpannamapaśyan brahmavādinaḥ
verses.translation: In the remaining portion of the Chapter, Isvara tells that all deities function in their respective spheres due to his energy and at his behest. Nay everything that happens is at his command.
verses.hindi: पुरुषको "भो भवत्' अर्थात् ' आप' शब्दका प्रयोग कर इसके (दीक्षितके) साथ सम्भाषण करना चाहिए। ऐश्वर्यकी अभिलाषा करनेवाले क्षत्रियादिकोंके लिये ब्राह्मण सदा ही आदरपूर्वक अभिवादन करने योग्य, पूजन करने योग्य तथा सिरसे वन्दन करने योग्य हे
verses.wordMeaning: In the remaining portion of the Chapter, Isvara tells that all deities function in their respective spheres due to his energy and at his behest. Nay everything that happens is at his command.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the remaining portion of the Chapter, Isvara tells that all deities function in their respective spheres due to his energy and at his behest. Nay everything that happens is at his command.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा तदैश्वरं रूपं रुद्रनारायणात्मकम् । कृतार्थं मेनिरे सन्तः स्वात्मानं ब्रह्मवादिनः
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā tadaiśvaraṃ rūpaṃ rudranārāyaṇātmakam / kṛtārthaṃ menire santaḥ svātmānaṃ brahmavādinaḥ
verses.translation: I, Mahesvara, am the Antaryamin (the Immanent soul) of all subjects. Everything is stationed within me, but I am not everywhere in the universe.
verses.hindi: विप्रको कभी भी क्षत्रियादिका अभिवादन नहीं करना चाहिए, भले ही वे ज्ञान, कर्म एवं गुणोंकी दृष्टिसे उत्कृष्ट हों। ब्राह्मणको सभी वर्णोके प्रति ' स्वस्ति' अर्थात् कल्याण हो-एऐसा कहना चाहिए-यह विधान
verses.wordMeaning: I, Mahesvara, am the Antaryamin (the Immanent soul) of all subjects. Everything is stationed within me, but I am not everywhere in the universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: I, Mahesvara, am the Antaryamin (the Immanent soul) of all subjects. Everything is stationed within me, but I am not everywhere in the universe.

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमारः सनको भृगुश्च सनातनश्चैव सनन्दनश्च । रुद्रो ऽङ्गिरा वामदेवाथ शुक्रो महर्षिरत्रिः कपिलो मरीचिः
verses.transliteration: sanatkumāraḥ sanako bhṛguśca sanātanaścaiva sanandanaśca / rudro 'ṅgirā vāmadevātha śukro maharṣiratriḥ kapilo marīciḥ
verses.translation: A wonderful form of mine which has been seen by you is my similitude. O. Brahmanas, verily my Maya has been demonstrated by me.
verses.hindi: है। समान वर्णोमें (कनिष्ठ व्यक्तियोंको ज्येष्ठ व्यक्तियोंका) अभिवादन करना चाहिए" । द्विजातियोंके गुरु अग्नि और सभी वर्णोके गुरु ब्राह्मण हैं। स्त्रियोंके एकमात्र गुरु उनके पति हैं और अतिथि सबका गुरु है सम्मान प्राप्त करनेके पाँच स्थान कहे गये हैं। इनमें बादको अपेक्षा पूर्व-पूर्वकी गुरुतार है । (ब्राह्मणादि) तीन वर्णोके जिस व्यक्तिमें ये पाँच गुण (मान्यताके स्थान) अधिक हों तथा प्रबल हों वह अपेक्षाकृत माननीय होता है ( अर्थात्
verses.wordMeaning: A wonderful form of mine which has been seen by you is my similitude. O. Brahmanas, verily my Maya has been demonstrated by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: A wonderful form of mine which has been seen by you is my similitude. O. Brahmanas, verily my Maya has been demonstrated by me.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वाथ रुद्रं जगदीशितारं तं पद्मनाभाश्रितवामभागम् । ध्यात्वा हृदिस्थं प्रणिपत्य मूर्ध्ना बद्ध्वाञ्जलिं स्वेषु शिरःसु भूयः
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvātha rudraṃ jagadīśitāraṃ taṃ padmanābhāśritavāmabhāgam / dhyātvā hṛdisthaṃ praṇipatya mūrdhnā baddhvāñjaliṃ sveṣu śiraḥsu bhūyaḥ
verses.translation: Stationed within all beings, 1 propel the entire universe. This is my Kriy as akti (the power of action).
verses.hindi: अवस्थाको प्राप्त शूद्र भी मान देनेके योग्य हो जाता है (अर्थात् ऐसे शूद्रके आनेपर उसे बैठनेके लिये आसन आदि आदरभावपूर्वक देना चाहिए)
verses.wordMeaning: Stationed within all beings, 1 propel the entire universe. This is my Kriy as akti (the power of action).
verses.commentary: Sense: Stationed within all beings, 1 propel the entire universe. This is my Kriy as akti (the power of action).

verses.sanskrit: ओङ्कारमुच्चार्य विलोक्य देवम् अन्तःशरीरे निहितं गुहायाम् । समस्तुवन् ब्रह्ममयैर्वचोभिर् आनन्दपूर्णायतमानसास्ते
verses.transliteration: oṅkāramuccārya vilokya devam antaḥśarīre nihitaṃ guhāyām / samastuvan brahmamayairvacobhir ānandapūrṇāyatamānasāste
verses.translation: This universe stirs and moves due to me. That follows my will. I am Kala and I urge the entire universe consisting of the elements.*
verses.hindi: ब्राह्मण, स्त्री, राजा, नेत्रहीन व्यक्ति, वृद्ध, भारसे पीडित व्यक्ति, रोगी तथा दुर्बलके लिये रास्ता छोड़ देना चाहिए (अर्थात् एक ही रास्तेपर आमने-सामने होनेपर स्वयं हटकर इन्हें रास्ता दे देना चाहिए। इनके निकल जानेपर स्वयं जाना चाहिए) । (ब्रह्मचारीको) प्रयत्नपूर्वक प्रतिदिन शिष्टोंके' घरोंसे भिक्षा लाकर गुरुको निवेदितकर उनकी (गुरुको) आज्ञा प्राप्तकर मौन होकर भोजन करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: This universe stirs and moves due to me. That follows my will. I am Kala and I urge the entire universe consisting of the elements.*
verses.commentary: Sense: This universe stirs and moves due to me. That follows my will. I am Kala and I urge the entire universe consisting of the elements.*

verses.sanskrit: मुनय ऊचुः त्वामेकमीशं पुरुषं पुराणं प्राणेश्वरं रुद्रमनन्तयोगम् । नमाम सर्वे हृदि सन्निविष्टं प्रचेतसं ब्रह्ममयं पवित्रम्
verses.transliteration: munaya ūcuḥ tvāmekamīśaṃ puruṣaṃ purāṇaṃ prāṇeśvaraṃ rudramanantayogam / namāma sarve hṛdi sanniviṣṭaṃ pracetasaṃ brahmamayaṃ pavitram
verses.translation: O leading sages, with one single part of mine, 1 create the entire universe; by another form I annihilate, neverthless, my sameness (stability) is unchanged.
verses.hindi: ऋत्विक्से अतिरिक्त गुरुको नहीं गिना गया है। श्लोकमें गिनाये गये मामासे ऋत्विकृतकके लिये भी 'गुरु' शब्दका उल्लेख है। १-यहाँ अभिवादनका अर्थ इतना ही है कि दोनों हाथॉसे पादस्पर्शकर प्रणाम करे। पूर्वोक्त अभिवादन-विधिके अनुसार नाम,
verses.wordMeaning: O leading sages, with one single part of mine, 1 create the entire universe; by another form I annihilate, neverthless, my sameness (stability) is unchanged.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading sages, with one single part of mine, 1 create the entire universe; by another form I annihilate, neverthless, my sameness (stability) is unchanged.

verses.sanskrit: त्वां पश्यन्ति मुनयो ब्रह्मयोनिं दान्ताः शान्ता विमलं रुक्मवर्णम् । ध्यात्वात्मस्थमचलं स्वे शरीरे कविं परेभ्यः परमं तत्परं च
verses.transliteration: tvāṃ paśyanti munayo brahmayoniṃ dāntāḥ śāntā vimalaṃ rukmavarṇam / dhyātvātmasthamacalaṃ sve śarīre kaviṃ parebhyaḥ paramaṃ tatparaṃ ca
verses.translation: am devoid of beginning, middle and the end; I am the activisor of the principle of Maya; at the beginning of creation, I make both Pradhana and Purua co-agitate.
verses.hindi: गोत्र आदिका उच्चारण नहीं करना चाहिए। २-विद्या- वेदार्थतत्त्वज्ञान कर्म, श्रीत-स्मार्त क्रियाओंका पालन, अवस्था--अधिक वयस्क होना, बन्धु--पितृव्य (चाचा), मामा आदि, वित्तन्यायार्जित धन--ये पाँच मान्यताके कारण हैं, पर इनमें उत्तर-उत्तरकी अपेक्षा पूर्व-पूर्व श्रेष्ठ है। हो ३-अपने वर्णके तथा अपने वर्णसे उच्च वर्णके जो लोग यथासम्भव आस्तिक, सदाचारी हों, महापातक आदिसे दूषित न हों,
verses.wordMeaning: am devoid of beginning, middle and the end; I am the activisor of the principle of Maya; at the beginning of creation, I make both Pradhana and Purua co-agitate.
verses.commentary: Sense: am devoid of beginning, middle and the end; I am the activisor of the principle of Maya; at the beginning of creation, I make both Pradhana and Purua co-agitate.

verses.sanskrit: त्वत्तः प्रसूता जगतः प्रसूतिः सर्वात्मभूस्त्वं परमाणुभूतः । अणोरणीयान् महतो महीयां- स्त्वामेव सर्वं प्रवदन्ति सन्तः
verses.transliteration: tvattaḥ prasūtā jagataḥ prasūtiḥ sarvātmabhūstvaṃ paramāṇubhūtaḥ / aṇoraṇīyān mahato mahīyāṃ- stvāmeva sarvaṃ pravadanti santaḥ
verses.translation: When the pair of xhem become mutually united, the universe is born in th order oT Mahat etc. My splendour and glory become menifested therein.
verses.hindi: वे ही यहाँ शिष्टरूपमें अभिप्रेत हैँ ।
verses.wordMeaning: When the pair of xhem become mutually united, the universe is born in th order oT Mahat etc. My splendour and glory become menifested therein.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the pair of xhem become mutually united, the universe is born in th order oT Mahat etc. My splendour and glory become menifested therein.

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्यगर्भो जगदन्तरात्मा त्वत्तो ऽधिजातः पुरुषः पुराणः । संजायमानो भवता विसृष्टो यथाविधानं सकलं ससर्ज
verses.transliteration: hiraṇyagarbho jagadantarātmā tvatto 'dhijātaḥ puruṣaḥ purāṇaḥ / saṃjāyamāno bhavatā visṛṣṭo yathāvidhānaṃ sakalaṃ sasarja
verses.translation: O Brahmanas, in the beginning of the Kalpa, I who am perfectly self-possessed, gave- unto him the four Vedas, my own divine glory and the eternal path of knowledge.
verses.hindi: वेदयज्ञेरहीनानां प्रशस्तानां स्वकर्मसु! ब्रह्मचार्याहरेद् भेक्षं गृहेभ्यः प्रयतोऽन्वहम् नियम्य प्रयतो वाचं दिशस्त्वनवलोकयन्
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas, in the beginning of the Kalpa, I who am perfectly self-possessed, gave- unto him the four Vedas, my own divine glory and the eternal path of knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas, in the beginning of the Kalpa, I who am perfectly self-possessed, gave- unto him the four Vedas, my own divine glory and the eternal path of knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: त्वत्तो वेदाः सकलाः संप्रसूता- स्त्वय्येवान्ते संस्थितिं ते लभन्ते । पश्यामस्त्वां जगतो हेतुभूतं नृत्यन्तं स्वे हृदये सन्निविष्टम्
verses.transliteration: tvatto vedāḥ sakalāḥ saṃprasūtā- stvayyevānte saṃsthitiṃ te labhante / paśyāmastvāṃ jagato hetubhūtaṃ nṛtyantaṃ sve hṛdaye sanniviṣṭam
verses.translation: It is at my behest that god Brahma who has been created out of me permanently understood ( v.l. always carries) my sovereign divine glory.
verses.hindi: भैक्ष्येण वर्तयेन्नित्यं नैकान्नादी भवेद् व्रती। भैक्ष्येण व्रतिनो वृत्तिरुपवाससमा स्मृता
verses.wordMeaning: It is at my behest that god Brahma who has been created out of me permanently understood ( v.l. always carries) my sovereign divine glory.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is at my behest that god Brahma who has been created out of me permanently understood ( v.l. always carries) my sovereign divine glory.

verses.sanskrit: त्वयैवेदं भ्राम्यते ब्रह्मचक्रं मायावी त्वं जगतामेकनाथः । नमामस्त्वां शरणं संप्रपन्ना योगात्मानं चित्पतिं दिव्यनृत्यम्
verses.transliteration: tvayaivedaṃ bhrāmyate brahmacakraṃ māyāvī tvaṃ jagatāmekanāthaḥ / namāmastvāṃ śaraṇaṃ saṃprapannā yogātmānaṃ citpatiṃ divyanṛtyam
verses.translation: That self-born ornniscient god, the Creator of all the worlds, becomes a four-faced deity and brings forth the creation (of the universe) as per my command.
verses.hindi: उपनयन-संस्कार होनेपर (ब्रह्मचारी) ब्राह्मणको पूर्वमें ' भवत्' शब्दका प्रयोगकर (' भवति! भिक्षां देहि’ ऐसा कहकर) भिक्षा माँगनी चाहिए। क्षत्रियको बीचमें (भिक्षां भवति! देहि’ ऐसा कहकर) तथा वैश्यको अन्तमें ' भवत्’ शब्द कहकर ('भिक्षां देहि भवति!' ऐसा कहकर) भिक्षा माँगनी चाहिए। अपनी माता, बहन तथा मौसीसे अथवा जो इस ब्रह्मचारीकी अवमानना न करे, उससे पहली (उपनयन-संस्कारकी अङ्गभूत
verses.wordMeaning: That self-born ornniscient god, the Creator of all the worlds, becomes a four-faced deity and brings forth the creation (of the universe) as per my command.
verses.commentary: Sense: That self-born ornniscient god, the Creator of all the worlds, becomes a four-faced deity and brings forth the creation (of the universe) as per my command.

verses.sanskrit: पश्यामस्त्वां परमाकाशमध्ये नृत्यन्तं ते महिमानं स्मरामः । सर्वात्मानं बहुधा सन्निविष्टं ब्रह्मानन्दमनुभूयानुभूय
verses.transliteration: paśyāmastvāṃ paramākāśamadhye nṛtyantaṃ te mahimānaṃ smarāmaḥ / sarvātmānaṃ bahudhā sanniviṣṭaṃ brahmānandamanubhūyānubhūya
verses.translation: He who is called Narayana, the infinite one, the immutable source of all worlds and who is only another form of mine, performs the duty of protection.
verses.hindi: प्रथम) भिक्षा माँगनी चाहिएरै । अपनी जातिके घरोंसे अथवा अपनेसे उच्च वर्णवाले सभी लोगोंके घरसे भिक्षा ग्रहण करनी चाहिए, किंतु पतित आदि व्यक्तियोंके घरसे भिक्षाका ग्रहण करना वर्जित है॥५३--५५॥
verses.wordMeaning: He who is called Narayana, the infinite one, the immutable source of all worlds and who is only another form of mine, performs the duty of protection.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who is called Narayana, the infinite one, the immutable source of all worlds and who is only another form of mine, performs the duty of protection.

verses.sanskrit: ओङ्कारस्ते वाचको मुक्तिबीजं त्वमक्षरं प्रकृतौ गूढरूपम् । तत्त्वां सत्यं प्रवदन्तीह सन्तः स्वयंप्रभं भवतो यत्प्रकाशम्
verses.transliteration: oṅkāraste vācako muktibījaṃ tvamakṣaraṃ prakṛtau gūḍharūpam / tattvāṃ satyaṃ pravadantīha santaḥ svayaṃprabhaṃ bhavato yatprakāśam
verses.translation: Lord Rudra, of the nature of Kala (Death), who is the annihilator of all living beings (is also) a manifestation of mine. At my behest, he will annihilate the universe for ever.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मचारीको चाहिए कि वह प्रतिदिन प्रयत्नपूर्वक ऐसे लोगोंके घरोंसे भिक्षा ग्रहण करे, जिनके घरोंमें वेद एवं यज्ञ आदिका लोप नहीं हुआ हो और जो (वेदशास्त्रानुसार) अपने कर्मोके पालनके कारण प्रशस्त हों। गुरुके कुल (सपिण्ड) तथा (अपने) बन्धुके कुल अर्थात् अपने कुल और बान्धवों (मातुल आदिके घर)-से भिक्षा नहीं माँगनी चाहिए। दूसरोंका घर न मिलनेपर पहले-पहलेका त्याग करना चाहिए। अर्थात्
verses.wordMeaning: Lord Rudra, of the nature of Kala (Death), who is the annihilator of all living beings (is also) a manifestation of mine. At my behest, he will annihilate the universe for ever.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Rudra, of the nature of Kala (Death), who is the annihilator of all living beings (is also) a manifestation of mine. At my behest, he will annihilate the universe for ever.

verses.sanskrit: स्तुवन्ति त्वां सततं सर्ववेदा नमन्ति त्वामृषयः क्षीणदोषाः । शान्तात्मानः सत्यसंधा वरिष्ठं विशन्ति त्वां यतयो ब्रह्मनिष्ठाः
verses.transliteration: stuvanti tvāṃ satataṃ sarvavedā namanti tvāmṛṣayaḥ kṣīṇadoṣāḥ / śāntātmānaḥ satyasaṃdhā variṣṭhaṃ viśanti tvāṃ yatayo brahmaniṣṭhāḥ
verses.translation: At the behest of Isvara the firegod Vailvanara (the fire of digestion) digests the food eaten by day or by night.
verses.hindi: पहले बन्धु-बान्धवों (मातुल आदि)-के घर, यदि वहाँ भिक्षा न मिले तो अपने कुलमें और वहाँ भी न मिले तो अन्तमें गुरुके कुलमें भिक्षा माँगनी चाहिए। पहलेके कहे गये घरोंसे भी न मिलनेपर प्रयत्नपूर्वक वाणीको
verses.wordMeaning: At the behest of Isvara the firegod Vailvanara (the fire of digestion) digests the food eaten by day or by night.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the behest of Isvara the firegod Vailvanara (the fire of digestion) digests the food eaten by day or by night.

verses.sanskrit: एको वेदो बहुशाखो ह्यनन्तस् त्वामेवैकं बोधयत्येकरूपम् । वेद्यं त्वां शरणं ये प्रपन्ना- स्तेषां शान्तिः शाश्वती नेतरेषाम्
verses.transliteration: eko vedo bahuśākho hyanantas tvāmevaikaṃ bodhayatyekarūpam / vedyaṃ tvāṃ śaraṇaṃ ye prapannā- steṣāṃ śāntiḥ śāśvatī netareṣām
verses.translation: The leading god Varuna, who is the source of origin of all waters shall enliven everyone at the bidding of Isvara.
verses.hindi: नियन्त्रित कर दिशाओंमें न देखते हुए, सम्पूर्ण ग्राममें भिक्षा-हेतु विचरण करना चाहिए (पर पातकी एवं हीन जातिवालेके घरकी भिक्षा न ले) अपनी आवश्यकताके अनुसार बिना किसी छल- कपटके उस भिक्षाको एकत्रितकर प्रयत्नपूर्वक नित्य मौन होकर एकाग्रतापूर्वक भोजन करना चाहिए। (ब्रह्मचारी) नित्य भिक्षासे जीविकाका निर्वाह करे। ब्रह्मचारीको
verses.wordMeaning: The leading god Varuna, who is the source of origin of all waters shall enliven everyone at the bidding of Isvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leading god Varuna, who is the source of origin of all waters shall enliven everyone at the bidding of Isvara.

verses.sanskrit: भवानीशो ऽनादिमांस्तेजोराशिर् ब्रह्मा विश्वं परमेष्ठी वरिष्ठः । स्वात्मानन्दमनुभूयाधिशेते स्वयं ज्योतिरचलो नित्यमुक्तः
verses.transliteration: bhavānīśo 'nādimāṃstejorāśir brahmā viśvaṃ parameṣṭhī variṣṭhaḥ / svātmānandamanubhūyādhiśete svayaṃ jyotiracalo nityamuktaḥ
verses.translation: Lord Prabhanjana, (Wind god) who stays within and without the bodies of living beings, sustains the physical bodies of all living beings at my command;
verses.hindi: नित्य एक अन्न? नहीं ग्रहण करना चाहिए। ब्रह्मचारीकी भिक्षान्नसे की गयी वृत्ति उपवासके समान ही कही गयी है
verses.wordMeaning: Lord Prabhanjana, (Wind god) who stays within and without the bodies of living beings, sustains the physical bodies of all living beings at my command;
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Prabhanjana, (Wind god) who stays within and without the bodies of living beings, sustains the physical bodies of all living beings at my command;

verses.sanskrit: एको रुद्रस्त्वं करोषीह विश्वं त्वं पालयस्यखिलं विश्वरूपः । त्वामेवान्ते निलयं विन्दतीदं नमामस्त्वां शरणं संप्रपन्नाः
verses.transliteration: eko rudrastvaṃ karoṣīha viśvaṃ tvaṃ pālayasyakhilaṃ viśvarūpaḥ / tvāmevānte nilayaṃ vindatīdaṃ namāmastvāṃ śaraṇaṃ saṃprapannāḥ
verses.translation: Soma (the Moon god) who is the enlivener of men and the storehouse of nectar for Devas, is activated through my bidding.
verses.hindi: १-शास्त्रानुसार ब्रह्मचारी गृहस्थके घरमें भिक्षा माँगने जाता है। घरमें माताएँ रहती हैं, अत: ' भवति!' इस रूपमें माताओंको सम्बोधन कर भिक्षा माँगता है।
verses.wordMeaning: Soma (the Moon god) who is the enlivener of men and the storehouse of nectar for Devas, is activated through my bidding.
verses.commentary: Sense: Soma (the Moon god) who is the enlivener of men and the storehouse of nectar for Devas, is activated through my bidding.

verses.sanskrit: त्वामेकमाहुः कविमेकरुद्रं प्राणं बृहन्तं हरिमग्निमीशम् । इन्द्रं मृत्युमनिलं चेकितानं धातारमादित्यमनेकरूपम्
verses.transliteration: tvāmekamāhuḥ kavimekarudraṃ prāṇaṃ bṛhantaṃ harimagnimīśam / indraṃ mṛtyumanilaṃ cekitānaṃ dhātāramādityamanekarūpam
verses.translation: ' The sun who illuminates the entire universe every¬ where through his own refulgence, brings about the rainfall through his own rays (at the bidding) of the self-bom deity.
verses.hindi: २-उपनयन-संस्कार जब होता है तब भिक्षा माँगनेका विधान है। यह सर्वप्रथम भिक्षा माँगना है। इसीके लिये यह बचन है। ३-एक अन्न नित्य ग्रहण करनेसे उसमें आसक्ति हो जाती है और किसी भी प्रकारकी आसक्ति वर्जित है।
verses.wordMeaning: ' The sun who illuminates the entire universe every¬ where through his own refulgence, brings about the rainfall through his own rays (at the bidding) of the self-bom deity.
verses.commentary: Sense: ' The sun who illuminates the entire universe every¬ where through his own refulgence, brings about the rainfall through his own rays (at the bidding) of the self-bom deity.

verses.sanskrit: त्वमक्षरं परमं वेदितव्यं त्वमस्य विश्वस्य परं निधानम् । त्वमव्ययः शाश्वतधर्मगोप्ता सनातनस्त्वं पुरुषोत्तमो ऽसि
verses.transliteration: tvamakṣaraṃ paramaṃ veditavyaṃ tvamasya viśvasya paraṃ nidhānam / tvamavyayaḥ śāśvatadharmagoptā sanātanastvaṃ puruṣottamo 'si
verses.translation: God Sakra,. the lord of all. immortal beings, who rules over the entire universe and who is the bestower of fruits on those who perform sacrifices, functions at my bidding.
verses.hindi: ३०४  कूर्मपुराण  पूजयेदशनं नित्यमद्याच्चैतदकुत्सयन् । नित्य अन्न (प्राप्त भिक्षान्न)-का पूजन (प्राणधारक दृष्टा हृष्येत् प्रसीदेच्च प्रतिनन्देच्च सर्वश: ॥ ६१॥  रूपमें विष्णुस्वरूप समझकर ध्यान) करे और निन्दा न करते हुए उसे ग्रहण करे। (भोजनको) देखकर हर्षित और प्रसन्न होना चाहिए तथा सर्वथा उसको
verses.wordMeaning: God Sakra,. the lord of all. immortal beings, who rules over the entire universe and who is the bestower of fruits on those who perform sacrifices, functions at my bidding.
verses.commentary: Sense: God Sakra,. the lord of all. immortal beings, who rules over the entire universe and who is the bestower of fruits on those who perform sacrifices, functions at my bidding.

verses.transliteration: bhavadbhiradbhutaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ yatsvarūpaṃ tu māmakam / mamaiṣā hyupamā viprā māyayā darśitā mayā
verses.translation: Isana who is the lord of the groups of Vetalas (ghosts) and Bhutas (goblins) and who is the bestower of the fmits of enjoyment of pleasures on his devotees, also abides at my bidding.
verses.hindi: (पिछोटा) खुलनेपर, बिना पैर धोये आचमन करनेपर भी अशुद्ध रहता है (अर्थात् इन स्थितियोंमें पहले पाँवोंको धोना चाहिए । अनन्तर हाथोंको धोकर आचमन करना चाहिए)। बुद्धिमान् व्यक्तिको जूता पहने हुए, जलमें स्थित होनेपर, सिरपर पगड़ी इत्यादि धारणकर आचमन नहीं करना चाहिए। (इसी प्रकार) न वर्षाके जलसे, न खड़े होकर, न उठाये हुए जलसे, न एक हाथसे अर्पित जलसे अर्थात् किसी अन्यके द्वारा
verses.wordMeaning: Isana who is the lord of the groups of Vetalas (ghosts) and Bhutas (goblins) and who is the bestower of the fmits of enjoyment of pleasures on his devotees, also abides at my bidding.
verses.commentary: Sense: Isana who is the lord of the groups of Vetalas (ghosts) and Bhutas (goblins) and who is the bestower of the fmits of enjoyment of pleasures on his devotees, also abides at my bidding.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषामेव भावानामन्तरा समवस्थितः । प्रेरयामि जगत् कृत्स्नं क्रियाशाक्तिरियं मम
verses.transliteration: sarveṣāmeva bhāvānāmantarā samavasthitaḥ / prerayāmi jagat kṛtsnaṃ kriyāśāktiriyaṃ mama
verses.translation: Vamadeva who is the disciple of Angiras, who is the leader of groups of Rudra and who is the protector of Yogins does so far ever through my behest.
verses.hindi: अञ्जलिसे नहीं, केवल एक हाथसे दिये गये जलसे, बिना यज्ञोपवीतके, न पादुकासनपर बैठे हुए (पाँवमें धारण को जानेवाली पादुकाको आसन बनाकर उसीपर बैठकर) अथवा न जानुओंके बाहर हाथ निकाले हुए
verses.wordMeaning: Vamadeva who is the disciple of Angiras, who is the leader of groups of Rudra and who is the protector of Yogins does so far ever through my behest.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vamadeva who is the disciple of Angiras, who is the leader of groups of Rudra and who is the protector of Yogins does so far ever through my behest.

verses.sanskrit: ययेदं चेष्टते विश्वं तत्स्वभावानुवर्ति च । सो ऽहं कालो जगत् कृत्स्नं प्रेरयामि कलात्मकम्
verses.transliteration: yayedaṃ ceṣṭate viśvaṃ tatsvabhāvānuvarti ca / so 'haṃ kālo jagat kṛtsnaṃ prerayāmi kalātmakam
verses.translation: Vinayaka who is worthy of the worship of all the worlds and who is the leader of obstacles (i.e. one who dispels them) is engaged in piety evidently at my instance.
verses.hindi: बोलते हुए, हँसते हुए, देखते हुए (किसी अन्यकी ओर देखते हुए), सोते हुए और झुककर आचमन नहीं करना चाहिए। बिना देखे' हुए अथवा फेन आदिवाले जलसे आचमन नहीं करना चाहिए। शूद्र अथवा अपवित्र व्यक्तिके हाथोंसे दिये हुए एवं खारे जलसे और अंगुलियोंसे शब्द करते हुए तथा अन्यमनस्क होकर आचमन नहीं करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: Vinayaka who is worthy of the worship of all the worlds and who is the leader of obstacles (i.e. one who dispels them) is engaged in piety evidently at my instance.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vinayaka who is worthy of the worship of all the worlds and who is the leader of obstacles (i.e. one who dispels them) is engaged in piety evidently at my instance.

verses.sanskrit: एकांशेन जगत् कृत्स्नं करोमि मुनिपुङ्गवाः । संहराम्येकरूपेण द्विधावस्था ममैव तु
verses.transliteration: ekāṃśena jagat kṛtsnaṃ karomi munipuṅgavāḥ / saṃharāmyekarūpeṇa dvidhāvasthā mamaiva tu
verses.translation: The self-born-gbd Skanda who is the mpst excellent among the knowers of tfie Brahman, and who is the lord of Devasena (Goddess of that name or the army of Devas) behaves so always, oh being urged by my command.
verses.hindi: १-जलमें कोई ऐसी वस्तु नहीं होनी चाहिए जो उसे अपवित्र करती है। इसलिये अच्छी प्रकार निरीक्षित जलसे ही आचमन
verses.wordMeaning: The self-born-gbd Skanda who is the mpst excellent among the knowers of tfie Brahman, and who is the lord of Devasena (Goddess of that name or the army of Devas) behaves so always, oh being urged by my command.
verses.commentary: Sense: The self-born-gbd Skanda who is the mpst excellent among the knowers of tfie Brahman, and who is the lord of Devasena (Goddess of that name or the army of Devas) behaves so always, oh being urged by my command.

verses.sanskrit: आदिमध्यान्तनिर्मुक्तो मायातत्त्वप्रवर्तकः । क्षोभयामि च सर्गादौ प्रधानपुरुषावुभौ
verses.transliteration: ādimadhyāntanirmukto māyātattvapravartakaḥ / kṣobhayāmi ca sargādau pradhānapuruṣāvubhau
verses.translation: Marici and other great sages who are progenitors of the world create different kinds of worlds, only through the bidding of the supreme Deity.
verses.hindi: २-शक्ति रहनेपर किसी भी शूद्रके द्वारा लाये गये जलसे आचमन नहीं करना चाहिए। अशक्त होनेपर तथा त्रैवर्णिकके कथमपि उपलब्ध न होनेपर शूद्र (जिस शूद्रका पात्र धर्मशास्त्रके अनुसार ग्राह्य होता है)-के द्वारा लाये गये जलको कुश आदिसे पवित्रकर उससे आचमन किया जा सकता है।
verses.wordMeaning: Marici and other great sages who are progenitors of the world create different kinds of worlds, only through the bidding of the supreme Deity.
verses.commentary: Sense: Marici and other great sages who are progenitors of the world create different kinds of worlds, only through the bidding of the supreme Deity.

verses.sanskrit: ताभ्यां संजायते विश्वं संयुक्ताभ्यां परस्परम् । महदादिक्रमेणैव मम तेजो विजृम्भते
verses.transliteration: tābhyāṃ saṃjāyate viśvaṃ saṃyuktābhyāṃ parasparam / mahadādikrameṇaiva mama tejo vijṛmbhate
verses.translation: Sri the Goddess of Wealth who is the spouse of Xarayana and who bestows large fortune on all living beings, behaves so through my blessings.
verses.hindi: कनिष्ठामूलतः पश्चात् प्राजापत्यं प्रचक्षते। अङ्गुल्यग्रे स्मृतं हैवं तदेवार्ष प्रकीर्तितम्
verses.wordMeaning: Sri the Goddess of Wealth who is the spouse of Xarayana and who bestows large fortune on all living beings, behaves so through my blessings.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sri the Goddess of Wealth who is the spouse of Xarayana and who bestows large fortune on all living beings, behaves so through my blessings.

verses.sanskrit: यो हि सर्वजगत्साक्षी कालचक्रप्रवर्तकः । हिरण्यगर्भो मार्तण्डः सो ऽपि मद्देहसंभवः
verses.transliteration: yo hi sarvajagatsākṣī kālacakrapravartakaḥ / hiraṇyagarbho mārtaṇḍaḥ so 'pi maddehasaṃbhavaḥ
verses.translation: Goddess Sarasvati who bestows ample fluency functions, so, on being urged by the bidding of Isvara.
verses.hindi: मूले वा हैवमार्ष स्यादाग्नेयं मध्यतः स्मृतम्। तदेव सौमिकं तीर्थमेतज्ज्ञात्वा न मुह्यति कायेन वाथ हैवेन न तु पित्र्येण वै द्विजाः १९ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Goddess Sarasvati who bestows ample fluency functions, so, on being urged by the bidding of Isvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Goddess Sarasvati who bestows ample fluency functions, so, on being urged by the bidding of Isvara.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मै दिव्यं स्वमैश्वर्यं ज्ञानयोगं सनातनम् । दत्तवानात्मजान् वेदान् कल्पादौ चतुरो द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: tasmai divyaṃ svamaiśvaryaṃ jñānayogaṃ sanātanam / dattavānātmajān vedān kalpādau caturo dvijāḥ
verses.translation: Savitrl,! who, on being remembered will redeem all men from the terrible hell, is one who carries out my behests.
verses.hindi: अङ्गुष्ठानामिकाभ्यां तु स्पृशेन्नेत्रद्वयं तत: । तर्जन्यङ्गुष्ठयोगेन स्पृशेन्नासापुटद्वयम्
verses.wordMeaning: Savitrl,! who, on being remembered will redeem all men from the terrible hell, is one who carries out my behests.
verses.commentary: Sense: Savitrl,! who, on being remembered will redeem all men from the terrible hell, is one who carries out my behests.

verses.sanskrit: स मन्नियोगतो देवो ब्रह्मा मद्भावभावितः । दिव्यं तन्मामकैश्वर्यं सर्वदा वहति स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: sa manniyogato devo brahmā madbhāvabhāvitaḥ / divyaṃ tanmāmakaiśvaryaṃ sarvadā vahati svayam
verses.translation: The supreme goddess Parvati who, on being specially meditated upon, is the bestower of the spiritual love (Brahma- vidya) is also one who follows my utterances.
verses.hindi: 'कनिष्ठाङ्गुष्ठयोगेन श्रवणे समुपस्पृशेत् । जिस जलका अपना स्वाभाविक वर्ण या रस विकृत हो गया है, उससे आचमन नहीं करना चाहिए। ऐसे ही प्रदरोदक (अत्यल्प जल)-से आचमन नहीं करना चाहिए। इसके अतिरिक्त किसी पात्रमें रखे हुए
verses.wordMeaning: The supreme goddess Parvati who, on being specially meditated upon, is the bestower of the spiritual love (Brahma- vidya) is also one who follows my utterances.
verses.commentary: Sense: The supreme goddess Parvati who, on being specially meditated upon, is the bestower of the spiritual love (Brahma- vidya) is also one who follows my utterances.

verses.sanskrit: स सर्वलोकनिर्माता मन्नियोगेन सर्ववित् । भूत्वा चतुर्मुखः सर्गं सृजत्येवात्मसंभवः
verses.transliteration: sa sarvalokanirmātā manniyogena sarvavit / bhūtvā caturmukhaḥ sargaṃ sṛjatyevātmasaṃbhavaḥ
verses.translation: Ananta, the serpent Sesa who has infinite greatness, and is the lord of all immortal beings and who holds the worlds on his hoods does so at the bidding of the lord.
verses.hindi: उस जलसे भी आचमन नहीं करना चाहिए जो पूरा हाथ डालकर क्षुभित कर दिया गया हो। यदि कच्छ (पिछोटा) धोतीसे बाहर निकल जाय तो उस स्थितिमें आचमन नहीं करना चाहिए। कच्छको धोतीके
verses.wordMeaning: Ananta, the serpent Sesa who has infinite greatness, and is the lord of all immortal beings and who holds the worlds on his hoods does so at the bidding of the lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ananta, the serpent Sesa who has infinite greatness, and is the lord of all immortal beings and who holds the worlds on his hoods does so at the bidding of the lord.

verses.sanskrit: यो ऽपि नारायणो ऽनन्तो लोकानां प्रभवाव्ययः । ममैव परमा मूर्तिः करोति परिपालनम्
verses.transliteration: yo 'pi nārāyaṇo 'nanto lokānāṃ prabhavāvyayaḥ / mamaiva paramā mūrtiḥ karoti paripālanam
verses.translation: The Fire-god Saihvartaka (destroyer of the universe at the time of dissolution of the worlds) who is stationed in the form of submarine fire eternally drinks up the entire ocean at the order of Isvara.
verses.hindi: भीतर करनेके अनन्तर ही आचमन करनेका विधान है (आचमनमें) ब्राह्मण हृदयतक पहुँचनेवाले, क्षत्रिय कण्ठतक पहुँचनेवाले जलसे और वैश्य मुखके भीतर प्रविष्ट (कण्ठतक न भी पहुँचे)जलसे शुद्ध होते हैं; स्त्री, शूद्र तो केबल (जिह्वा, ओष्ठके अन्ततक) जलके
verses.wordMeaning: The Fire-god Saihvartaka (destroyer of the universe at the time of dissolution of the worlds) who is stationed in the form of submarine fire eternally drinks up the entire ocean at the order of Isvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Fire-god Saihvartaka (destroyer of the universe at the time of dissolution of the worlds) who is stationed in the form of submarine fire eternally drinks up the entire ocean at the order of Isvara.

verses.sanskrit: यो ऽन्तकः सर्वभूतानां रुद्रः कालात्मकः प्रभुः । मदाज्ञयासौ सततं संहरिष्यति मे तनुः
verses.transliteration: yo 'ntakaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ rudraḥ kālātmakaḥ prabhuḥ / madājñayāsau satataṃ saṃhariṣyati me tanuḥ
verses.translation: The fourteen Manus whose prowess is well-known, protect all subjects at his bidding.
verses.hindi: स्पर्शमात्रसे शुद्ध हो जाते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: The fourteen Manus whose prowess is well-known, protect all subjects at his bidding.
verses.commentary: Sense: The fourteen Manus whose prowess is well-known, protect all subjects at his bidding.

verses.sanskrit: हव्यं वहति देवानां कव्यं कव्याशिनामपि । पाकं च कुरुते वह्निः सो ऽपि मच्छक्तिचोदितः
verses.transliteration: havyaṃ vahati devānāṃ kavyaṃ kavyāśināmapi / pākaṃ ca kurute vahniḥ so 'pi macchakticoditaḥ
verses.translation: Adityas (sons of Aditi or the sun-god), Vasus, Rudras, Maruts and two Asvini-Kumaras and all other divinities are created (v.l. are appointed) at my command.
verses.hindi: अँगूठेके मूलकी रेखामें ब्राह्मतीर्थ, तर्जनी और अँगूठेके मध्यभागमें उत्तम पितृतीर्थ, कनिष्ठाके मूलभागमें प्राजापत्यतीर्थ कहलाता है। अँगुलियोंके अग्रभागे हैवतीर्थ और वही आर्षतीर्थ भी कहा जाता है। अथवा ( अँगुलियोंके) मूल भागको हैव या आर्षतीर्थ, मध्यभागको आग्नेयतीर्थ कहा गया है। इसी (आग्नेयतीर्थ)-को सौमिकतीर्थ कहा गया है। इसे जानकर मोह नहीँ प्राप होता अर्थात् यथाविधि इसके अनुसार अनुष्ठान करनेपर
verses.wordMeaning: Adityas (sons of Aditi or the sun-god), Vasus, Rudras, Maruts and two Asvini-Kumaras and all other divinities are created (v.l. are appointed) at my command.
verses.commentary: Sense: Adityas (sons of Aditi or the sun-god), Vasus, Rudras, Maruts and two Asvini-Kumaras and all other divinities are created (v.l. are appointed) at my command.

verses.sanskrit: भुक्तमाहारजातं च पचते तदहर्निशम् । वैश्वानरो ऽग्निर्भगवानीश्वरस्य नियोगतः
verses.transliteration: bhuktamāhārajātaṃ ca pacate tadaharniśam / vaiśvānaro 'gnirbhagavānīśvarasya niyogataḥ
verses.translation: Gandharvas, Garuda and others, Siddhas, Sadhyas Caranas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas are created by and established there as per order of the self-born deity.
verses.hindi: अन्तःकरण शुद्ध होनेसे अज्ञान नष्ट हो जाता है। द्विजो! द्विजको चाहिए कि वह ब्राह्मतीर्थसे ही नित्य आचमन करे अथवा कायतीर्थ (प्राजापत्यतीर्थ) या हैवतीर्थसे करे, पितृतीर्थसे कभी भी आचमन न करे। ब्राह्मण
verses.wordMeaning: Gandharvas, Garuda and others, Siddhas, Sadhyas Caranas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas are created by and established there as per order of the self-born deity.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gandharvas, Garuda and others, Siddhas, Sadhyas Caranas, Yaksas, Raksasas and Pisacas are created by and established there as per order of the self-born deity.

verses.sanskrit: यो ऽपि सर्वाम्भसां योनिर्वरुणो देवपुङ्गवः । सो ऽपि संजीवयेत् कृत्स्नमीशस्यैव नियोगतः
verses.transliteration: yo 'pi sarvāmbhasāṃ yonirvaruṇo devapuṅgavaḥ / so 'pi saṃjīvayet kṛtsnamīśasyaiva niyogataḥ
verses.translation: The (divisions of Time such as) Kalas, Kasthas, Nimesas, Muhurtas, days, nights, seasons, fortnights and months abide by the commandment of Prajapati.
verses.hindi: संयत होकर पहले तीन बार जलका आचमन करे, अनन्तर मुड़े हुए अँगूठेके मूलसे मुखका स्पर्श करे यही सम्मार्जन है॥ १६--२०॥ तदनन्तर अँगूठे और अनामिकासे दोनों नेत्रोंका स्पर्श करे और तर्जनी तथा अँगूठेके योगसे दोनों नासापुटों (नाक)-का स्पर्श करे। कनिष्ठा और अंगूठेके योगसे दोनों कानोंका स्पर्श करे। तदनन्तर मिली हुई
verses.wordMeaning: The (divisions of Time such as) Kalas, Kasthas, Nimesas, Muhurtas, days, nights, seasons, fortnights and months abide by the commandment of Prajapati.
verses.commentary: Sense: The (divisions of Time such as) Kalas, Kasthas, Nimesas, Muhurtas, days, nights, seasons, fortnights and months abide by the commandment of Prajapati.

verses.sanskrit: यो ऽन्तस्तिष्ठति भूतानां बहिर्देवः प्रभञ्जनः । मदाज्ञयासौ भूतानां शरीराणि बिभर्ति हि
verses.transliteration: yo 'ntastiṣṭhati bhūtānāṃ bahirdevaḥ prabhañjanaḥ / madājñayāsau bhūtānāṃ śarīrāṇi bibharti hi
verses.translation: The Yugas and the Manvantaras remain within my control. So also the Paras, Parardhas and other varieties of time-units.
verses.hindi: सभी अँगुलियोंसे अथवा हथेलीसे हृदयका स्पर्श करे। तदुपरान्त सिरका भी वैसे ही स्पर्श करे अथवा दोनों अँगूठोंसे स्पर्श करे
verses.wordMeaning: The Yugas and the Manvantaras remain within my control. So also the Paras, Parardhas and other varieties of time-units.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Yugas and the Manvantaras remain within my control. So also the Paras, Parardhas and other varieties of time-units.

verses.sanskrit: यो ऽपि संजीवनो नॄणां देवानाममृताकरः । सोमः स मन्नियोगेन चोदितः किल वर्तते
verses.transliteration: yo 'pi saṃjīvano nṝṇāṃ devānāmamṛtākaraḥ / somaḥ sa manniyogena coditaḥ kila vartate
verses.translation: The four categories of living beings, both mobile and immobile, do abide by the bidding of the lord, the supreme Atman.
verses.hindi: त्रि: प्राश्नीयाद् यदम्भस्तु सुप्रीतास्तेन देवता: । ब्रह्मा विष्णुर्महेशश्च भवन्तीत्यनुशुश्रुम संस्पृष्टयोर्लोचनयोः प्रीयेते शशिभास्करौ
verses.wordMeaning: The four categories of living beings, both mobile and immobile, do abide by the bidding of the lord, the supreme Atman.
verses.commentary: Sense: The four categories of living beings, both mobile and immobile, do abide by the bidding of the lord, the supreme Atman.

verses.sanskrit: यः स्वभासा जगत् कृत्स्नं प्रकाशयति सर्वदा । सूर्यो वृष्टिं वितनुते शास्त्रेणैव स्वयंभुवः
verses.transliteration: yaḥ svabhāsā jagat kṛtsnaṃ prakāśayati sarvadā / sūryo vṛṣṭiṃ vitanute śāstreṇaiva svayaṃbhuvaḥ
verses.translation: All the nether worlds, the upper worlds and the Brahmandas do follow the injunctions of the self-born deity.
verses.hindi: कर्णयोः स्पृष्टयोस्तद्वत् प्रीयेते चानिलानलौ
verses.wordMeaning: All the nether worlds, the upper worlds and the Brahmandas do follow the injunctions of the self-born deity.
