verses.commentary: Sense: All the nether worlds, the upper worlds and the Brahmandas do follow the injunctions of the self-born deity.

verses.sanskrit: यो ऽप्यशेषजगच्छास्ता शक्रः सर्वामरेश्वरः । यज्वनां फलदो देवो वर्तते ऽसौ मदाज्ञया
verses.transliteration: yo 'pyaśeṣajagacchāstā śakraḥ sarvāmareśvaraḥ / yajvanāṃ phalado devo vartate 'sau madājñayā
verses.translation: The innumerable universes of the past which were all over endowed with floods (multitudes) of objects functioned at my command.
verses.hindi: संस्पृष्टे हृदये चास्य प्रीयन्ते सर्वदेवताः । मधुपर्के च सोमे च ताम्बूलस्य च भक्षणे। फलमूले चेक्षुदण्डे न दोषं प्राह वै मनुः
verses.wordMeaning: The innumerable universes of the past which were all over endowed with floods (multitudes) of objects functioned at my command.
verses.commentary: Sense: The innumerable universes of the past which were all over endowed with floods (multitudes) of objects functioned at my command.

verses.sanskrit: यः प्रशास्ता ह्यसाधूनां वर्तते नियमादिह । यमो वैवस्वतो देवो देवदेवनियोगतः
verses.transliteration: yaḥ praśāstā hyasādhūnāṃ vartate niyamādiha / yamo vaivasvato devo devadevaniyogataḥ
verses.translation: The future Brahmandas, along with the Atmans present in them, will carry out the injunctions of the greatest Atman.
verses.hindi: प्रचरंश्चान्नपानेषु द्रव्यहस्तो भवेन्नरः। भूमौ निक्षिप्य तद् द्रव्यमाचम्याभ्युक्षयेत् तु तत्
verses.wordMeaning: The future Brahmandas, along with the Atmans present in them, will carry out the injunctions of the greatest Atman.
verses.commentary: Sense: The future Brahmandas, along with the Atmans present in them, will carry out the injunctions of the greatest Atman.

verses.sanskrit: यो ऽपि सर्वधनाध्यक्षो धनानां संप्रदायकः । सो ऽपीश्वरनियोगेन कुबेरो वर्तते सदा
verses.transliteration: yo 'pi sarvadhanādhyakṣo dhanānāṃ saṃpradāyakaḥ / so 'pīśvaraniyogena kubero vartate sadā
verses.translation: The Earth, the Waters, the Fire, the Wind, the Ether, the mind, the intellect, the Ahankara and the primordial Prakrti stay within my injunction.*
verses.hindi: तेजसं वै समादाय यह्युच्छिष्टो भवेद् द्विजः । भूमौ निक्षिप्य तद् द्रव्यमाचम्याभ्युक्षयेत् तु तत् आचमनमें तीन बार जो जल पिया जाता है, उससे ब्रह्मा, विष्णु तथा महेश--ये तीन देवता प्रसन्न होते हैं-एऐसा हमने सुना है  मार्जन करनेसे गङ्गा और यमुना नदियाँ प्रसन्न होती हैं। नेत्रोंके स्पर्शसे सूर्य तथा चन्द्रमा
verses.wordMeaning: The Earth, the Waters, the Fire, the Wind, the Ether, the mind, the intellect, the Ahankara and the primordial Prakrti stay within my injunction.*
verses.commentary: Sense: The Earth, the Waters, the Fire, the Wind, the Ether, the mind, the intellect, the Ahankara and the primordial Prakrti stay within my injunction.*

verses.sanskrit: यः सर्वरक्षसां नाथस्तामसानां फलप्रदः । मन्नियोगादसौ देवो वर्तते निरृतिः सदा
verses.transliteration: yaḥ sarvarakṣasāṃ nāthastāmasānāṃ phalapradaḥ / manniyogādasau devo vartate nirṛtiḥ sadā
verses.translation: Maya which is the source of origin of the entire universe and which fascinates all embodied beings, transforms itself for ever at the bidding of Isvara.
verses.hindi: प्रसन्न होते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Maya which is the source of origin of the entire universe and which fascinates all embodied beings, transforms itself for ever at the bidding of Isvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Maya which is the source of origin of the entire universe and which fascinates all embodied beings, transforms itself for ever at the bidding of Isvara.

verses.sanskrit: वेतालगणभूतानां स्वामी भोगफलप्रदः । ईशानः किल भक्तानां सो ऽपि तिष्ठन्ममाज्ञया
verses.transliteration: vetālagaṇabhūtānāṃ svāmī bhogaphalapradaḥ / īśānaḥ kila bhaktānāṃ so 'pi tiṣṭhanmamājñayā
verses.translation: Purusa who is the lord of all embodied beings, and who is cited as the supreme Atman, eternally exists and. functions as per instruction of Isvara.
verses.hindi: दोनों नासापुटोंका स्पर्श करनेसे नासत्य और दस्र (दोनों अश्विनीकुमार) प्रसन्न होते हैं, इसी प्रकार दोनों कानोंका स्पर्श करनेसे अग्नि तथा वायुदेवता प्रसन्न होते हैं। हदयके स्पर्श होनेपर सभी देवता प्रसन्न होते हैं। सिरका स्पर्श करनेसे वे अद्वितीय पुरुष विष्णु प्रसन्न होते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Purusa who is the lord of all embodied beings, and who is cited as the supreme Atman, eternally exists and. functions as per instruction of Isvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Purusa who is the lord of all embodied beings, and who is cited as the supreme Atman, eternally exists and. functions as per instruction of Isvara.

verses.sanskrit: यो वामदेवो ऽङ्गिरसः शिष्यो रुद्रगणाग्रणीः । रक्षको योगिनां नित्यं वर्तते ऽसौ मदाज्ञया
verses.transliteration: yo vāmadevo 'ṅgirasaḥ śiṣyo rudragaṇāgraṇīḥ / rakṣako yogināṃ nityaṃ vartate 'sau madājñayā
verses.translation: The intellect too, through which one observes that, region, (i.e. the supreme self), after eschewing all the confused- delusions, invariably abides by the will of the great god (Mahesa).
verses.hindi: (आचमन आदिके समय) अङ्गपर गिरे हुए जलकणोंसे शरीर उच्छिष्ट नहीं होता। दाँतोंके भीतर स्थित पदार्थ दाँतोंके समान ही होता है, परंतु जिह्वाके स्पर्श होनेपर व्यक्ति अपवित्र हो जाता है। आचमन
verses.wordMeaning: The intellect too, through which one observes that, region, (i.e. the supreme self), after eschewing all the confused- delusions, invariably abides by the will of the great god (Mahesa).
verses.commentary: Sense: The intellect too, through which one observes that, region, (i.e. the supreme self), after eschewing all the confused- delusions, invariably abides by the will of the great god (Mahesa).

verses.sanskrit: यश्च सर्वजगत्पूज्यो वर्तते विघ्नकारकः । विनायको धर्मनेता सो ऽपि मद्वचनात् किल
verses.transliteration: yaśca sarvajagatpūjyo vartate vighnakārakaḥ / vināyako dharmanetā so 'pi madvacanāt kila
verses.translation: What need there is of prolixity, the entire universe is constituted of my potency {Sakti). The whole of the universe is urged on by me and in me does it dissolve in the end.
verses.hindi: करनेके समय या दूसरोंको आचमन कराते समय पैरोंपर गिरे हुए जलको भूमिपर गिरे हुएके समान समझना चाहिए। उससे मनुष्य अपवित्र नहीं होता। सोम, ताम्बूल-भक्षण, फल, मूल तथा ईखका दण्ड ग्रहण करनेमें कोई दोष नहीं कहा है, इन्हें कोई भी दे, ग्रहण किया जा सकता है। हम चल रहे हैं तथा हमारे हाथमें ऐसी वस्तु है जो उच्छिष्टस्पर्शसे दूषित
verses.wordMeaning: What need there is of prolixity, the entire universe is constituted of my potency {Sakti). The whole of the universe is urged on by me and in me does it dissolve in the end.
verses.commentary: Sense: What need there is of prolixity, the entire universe is constituted of my potency {Sakti). The whole of the universe is urged on by me and in me does it dissolve in the end.

verses.sanskrit: यो ऽपि ब्रह्मविदां श्रेष्ठो देवसेनापतिः प्रभुः । स्कन्दो ऽसौ वर्तते नित्यं स्वयंभूर्विधिचोदितः
verses.transliteration: yo 'pi brahmavidāṃ śreṣṭho devasenāpatiḥ prabhuḥ / skando 'sau vartate nityaṃ svayaṃbhūrvidhicoditaḥ
verses.translation: I am the lord Isa, the eternal entity that is self- luminous. I am the great Atman, the supreme Brahman. There is nothing other than I.
verses.hindi: हो सकती है तो हमें अन्न, जल ग्रहण करते समय उस वस्तुको भूमिपर यथास्थान रख देना चाहिए तथा अन्न, जल ग्रहण करनेके अनन्तर आचमन करनेके बाद भूमिपर रखी हुई वस्तुका प्रोक्षण करना चाहिए,
verses.wordMeaning: I am the lord Isa, the eternal entity that is self- luminous. I am the great Atman, the supreme Brahman. There is nothing other than I.
verses.commentary: Sense: I am the lord Isa, the eternal entity that is self- luminous. I am the great Atman, the supreme Brahman. There is nothing other than I.

verses.sanskrit: ये च प्रजानां पतयो मरीच्याद्या महर्षयः । सृजन्ति विविधं लोकं परस्यैव नियोगतः
verses.transliteration: ye ca prajānāṃ patayo marīcyādyā maharṣayaḥ / sṛjanti vividhaṃ lokaṃ parasyaiva niyogataḥ
verses.translation: Thus, this greatest knowledge has been communicated to you by me. Afterknowing this, a creature is liberated from the bondage of births and worldly existence.
verses.hindi: अनन्तर उस वस्तुको लेकर चलना चाहिए॥ २७--३०॥ तैजस पदार्थ (घी) लिये हुए यदि ब्राह्मण (द्विज) (खाने-पीनेके कारण) उच्छिष्ट हो जाय तो उस तेजस द्रव्य (घी)-को भूमिपर रखकर आचमन करे, पुनः उस द्रव्य (घी)-का प्रोक्षण करे। यदि कोई (द्रव्य-
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, this greatest knowledge has been communicated to you by me. Afterknowing this, a creature is liberated from the bondage of births and worldly existence.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, this greatest knowledge has been communicated to you by me. Afterknowing this, a creature is liberated from the bondage of births and worldly existence.

verses.sanskrit: या च श्रीः सर्वभूतानां ददाति विपुलां श्रियम् । पत्नी नारायणस्यासौ वर्तते मदनुग्रहात्
verses.transliteration: yā ca śrīḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ dadāti vipulāṃ śriyam / patnī nārāyaṇasyāsau vartate madanugrahāt
verses.translation: From V. 18 to the end is the discussion on Pasupatism. Though the sect poses to be independent, the influence of the Sahkhyas is obvious (vide w. 18-27).
verses.hindi: सहित) अमत्र (पात्र) लिये हुए मनुष्य उच्छिष्ट हो जाय तो उस द्रव्य (पात्र)-को (भूमिपर) रखे बिना आचमन कर लेनेपर शुद्ध हो जाता है (पात्र अपवित्र नहीं होता) । परंतु वस्त्र आदिके सम्बन्धमें विकल्प है
verses.wordMeaning: From V. 18 to the end is the discussion on Pasupatism. Though the sect poses to be independent, the influence of the Sahkhyas is obvious (vide w. 18-27).
verses.commentary: Sense: From V. 18 to the end is the discussion on Pasupatism. Though the sect poses to be independent, the influence of the Sahkhyas is obvious (vide w. 18-27).

verses.sanskrit: वाचं ददाति विपुलां या च देवी सरस्वती । सापीश्वरनियोगेन चोदिता संप्रवर्तते
verses.transliteration: vācaṃ dadāti vipulāṃ yā ca devī sarasvatī / sāpīśvaraniyogena coditā saṃpravartate
verses.translation: That is my greatest abode, the Brahman, which is greater than the greatest, eternal, steady and immutable, of perpetual bliss, devoid of doubts and alternatives.
verses.hindi: 'तेजो वै घृतम्' के अनुसार घीको तैजस (तेजस्वी बनानेवाला) माना जाता है। अरण्येडनुदके रात्रौ चौरव्याप्राकुले पथि। कृत्वा मूत्रं पुरीषं वा द्रव्यहस्तो न दुष्यति
verses.wordMeaning: That is my greatest abode, the Brahman, which is greater than the greatest, eternal, steady and immutable, of perpetual bliss, devoid of doubts and alternatives.
verses.commentary: Sense: That is my greatest abode, the Brahman, which is greater than the greatest, eternal, steady and immutable, of perpetual bliss, devoid of doubts and alternatives.

verses.sanskrit: याशेषपुरुषान् घोरान्नरकात् तारयिष्यति । सावित्री संस्मृता देवी देवाज्ञानुविधायिनी
verses.transliteration: yāśeṣapuruṣān ghorānnarakāt tārayiṣyati / sāvitrī saṃsmṛtā devī devājñānuvidhāyinī
verses.translation: Among the knower of Brahman, I am god Brahma the self-born deity with face all round. Among the wielders of Maya, I am the ancient, imperishable god Hari.
verses.hindi: निधाय दक्षिणे कर्णे ब्रह्मसूत्रमुदङ्मुखः । अह्नि कुर्याच्छकृन्मूत्रं रात्रौ चेद् दक्षिणामुखः
verses.wordMeaning: Among the knower of Brahman, I am god Brahma the self-born deity with face all round. Among the wielders of Maya, I am the ancient, imperishable god Hari.
verses.commentary: Sense: Among the knower of Brahman, I am god Brahma the self-born deity with face all round. Among the wielders of Maya, I am the ancient, imperishable god Hari.

verses.sanskrit: पार्वती परमा देवी ब्रह्मविद्याप्रदायिनी । यापि ध्याता विशेषेण सापि मद्वचनानुगा
verses.transliteration: pārvatī paramā devī brahmavidyāpradāyinī / yāpi dhyātā viśeṣeṇa sāpi madvacanānugā
verses.translation: Among Yogins, I am Sambhu, among ladies I am god¬ dess (Parvati ), the daughter of the lord of mountains. I am Visnu among sun-gods and am the fire-god among Vasus.
verses.hindi: अन्तर्धाय महीं काष्टैः पत्रैर्लोष्ठतृणेन वा। प्रावृत्य च शिरः कुर्याद् विण्मूत्रस्य विसर्जनम् न तिष्ठन् न निर्वासा न च पर्वतमस्तके
verses.wordMeaning: Among Yogins, I am Sambhu, among ladies I am god¬ dess (Parvati ), the daughter of the lord of mountains. I am Visnu among sun-gods and am the fire-god among Vasus.
verses.commentary: Sense: Among Yogins, I am Sambhu, among ladies I am god¬ dess (Parvati ), the daughter of the lord of mountains. I am Visnu among sun-gods and am the fire-god among Vasus.

verses.sanskrit: यो ऽनन्तमहिमानन्तः शेषो ऽशेषामरप्रभुः । दधाति शिरसा लोकं सो ऽपि देवनियोगतः
verses.transliteration: yo 'nantamahimānantaḥ śeṣo 'śeṣāmaraprabhuḥ / dadhāti śirasā lokaṃ so 'pi devaniyogataḥ
verses.translation: Among Rudras, I am Sankara; among those who fly (i.e. birds), I am Garuda; among the leading elephants, I am Airavata and among those who bear weapons (warriors), I am Rama.
verses.hindi: न जीर्णदेवायतने न वल्मीके कदाचन! न ससत्त्वेषु गर्तेषु न गच्छन् वा समाचरेत्
verses.wordMeaning: Among Rudras, I am Sankara; among those who fly (i.e. birds), I am Garuda; among the leading elephants, I am Airavata and among those who bear weapons (warriors), I am Rama.
verses.commentary: Sense: Among Rudras, I am Sankara; among those who fly (i.e. birds), I am Garuda; among the leading elephants, I am Airavata and among those who bear weapons (warriors), I am Rama.

verses.sanskrit: यो ऽग्निः संवर्तको नित्यं वडवारूपसंस्थितः । पिबत्यखिलमम्भोधिमीश्वरस्य नियोगतः
verses.transliteration: yo 'gniḥ saṃvartako nityaṃ vaḍavārūpasaṃsthitaḥ / pibatyakhilamambhodhimīśvarasya niyogataḥ
verses.translation: Among the sages, I am Vasistha; among Devas, I am Satakratu (one who has performed a hundred sacrifices i.e. Devendra); among craftsmen I am Visvakarman and among the enemies ofDevas, I am Prahlada.
verses.hindi: न सोपानत्पादुको वा छत्री वा नान्तरिक्षके न देवदेवालययोरपामपि कदाचन
verses.wordMeaning: Among the sages, I am Vasistha; among Devas, I am Satakratu (one who has performed a hundred sacrifices i.e. Devendra); among craftsmen I am Visvakarman and among the enemies ofDevas, I am Prahlada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Among the sages, I am Vasistha; among Devas, I am Satakratu (one who has performed a hundred sacrifices i.e. Devendra); among craftsmen I am Visvakarman and among the enemies ofDevas, I am Prahlada.

verses.sanskrit: ये चतुर्दश लोके ऽस्मिन् मनवः प्रथितौजसः । पालयन्ति प्रजाः सर्वास्ते ऽपि तस्य नियोगतः
verses.transliteration: ye caturdaśa loke 'smin manavaḥ prathitaujasaḥ / pālayanti prajāḥ sarvāste 'pi tasya niyogataḥ
verses.translation: Among ascetics I am Vyasa; among the Ganas (at¬ tendants of Siva) I am Vinayaka; among heroes, I am Vlra- Bhadra; and among the Siddhas, I am ascetic Kapila.
verses.hindi: उसका स्पर्श होनेपर आचमन करना चाहिए। उच्छिष्ट दशामें वस्त्रका स्पर्श होनेपर आचमन एवं वस्त्रका प्रोक्षण करना चाहिए। जंगलमें, जलहीन स्थानमें, रात्रिमें और चोर तथा व्याघ्र आदिसे आक्रान्त
verses.wordMeaning: Among ascetics I am Vyasa; among the Ganas (at¬ tendants of Siva) I am Vinayaka; among heroes, I am Vlra- Bhadra; and among the Siddhas, I am ascetic Kapila.
verses.commentary: Sense: Among ascetics I am Vyasa; among the Ganas (at¬ tendants of Siva) I am Vinayaka; among heroes, I am Vlra- Bhadra; and among the Siddhas, I am ascetic Kapila.

verses.sanskrit: आदित्या वसवो रुद्रा मरुतश्च तथाश्विनौ । अन्याश्च देवताः सर्वा मच्छास्त्रेणैव धिष्ठिताः
verses.transliteration: ādityā vasavo rudrā marutaśca tathāśvinau / anyāśca devatāḥ sarvā macchāstreṇaiva dhiṣṭhitāḥ
verses.translation: Among the mountains, I am Meru; among constella¬ tions, I am the Moon; among the weapons of striking potentiality I am the thunderbolt; and among holy rites, I am truthfulness.
verses.hindi: मार्गमें मल-मूत्र करनेपर भी व्यक्ति आचमन, प्रोक्षण आदि शुद्धिके अभावमें भी दूषित नहीं होता, साथ ही उसके हाथमें रखा हुआ द्रव्य भी अशुचि नहीं होता (पर शुद्धिका अवसर मिल जानेपर यथाशास्त्र शुद्धि आवश्यक है।)
verses.wordMeaning: Among the mountains, I am Meru; among constella¬ tions, I am the Moon; among the weapons of striking potentiality I am the thunderbolt; and among holy rites, I am truthfulness.
verses.commentary: Sense: Among the mountains, I am Meru; among constella¬ tions, I am the Moon; among the weapons of striking potentiality I am the thunderbolt; and among holy rites, I am truthfulness.

verses.sanskrit: गन्धर्वा गरुडा ऋक्षाः सिद्धाः साध्याश्चचारणाः । यक्षरक्षः पिशाचाश्च स्थिताः शास्त्रे स्वयंभुवः
verses.transliteration: gandharvā garuḍā ṛkṣāḥ siddhāḥ sādhyāścacāraṇāḥ / yakṣarakṣaḥ piśācāśca sthitāḥ śāstre svayaṃbhuvaḥ
verses.translation: Among serpents, I am Ananta (§esa); among generals- of armies, I am lord Pavaki (son of the firegod.i.e. Skanda) t among the stages of life, I am the householder's stage and among Isvaras (Rulers) I am. Mahesvara.
verses.hindi: दाहिने कानपर यज्ञोपवीत चढ़ाकर दिनमें उत्तरको ओर मुख करके तथा रात्रिमें दक्षिणाभिमुख होकर मल-मूत्रका त्याग करना चाहिए। पृथ्वीको लकड़ी, पत्तों, ढेलों अथवा घाससे ढककर तथा शिरको वस्त्रसे
verses.wordMeaning: Among serpents, I am Ananta (§esa); among generals- of armies, I am lord Pavaki (son of the firegod.i.e. Skanda) t among the stages of life, I am the householder's stage and among Isvaras (Rulers) I am. Mahesvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Among serpents, I am Ananta (§esa); among generals- of armies, I am lord Pavaki (son of the firegod.i.e. Skanda) t among the stages of life, I am the householder's stage and among Isvaras (Rulers) I am. Mahesvara.

verses.sanskrit: कलाकाष्ठानिमेषाश्च मुहूर्ता दिवसाः क्षपाः । ऋतवः पक्षमासाश्च स्थिताः शास्त्रे प्रजापतेः
verses.transliteration: kalākāṣṭhānimeṣāśca muhūrtā divasāḥ kṣapāḥ / ṛtavaḥ pakṣamāsāśca sthitāḥ śāstre prajāpateḥ
verses.translation: Among serpents, I am Ananta (§esa); among generals- of armies, I am lord Pavaki (son of the firegod.i.e. Skanda) t among the stages of life, I am the householder's stage and among Isvaras (Rulers) I am. Mahesvara.
verses.hindi: आवृतकर मल-मूत्रका त्याग करना चाहिए छायामें, कूपमें या उसके अति समीप, नदीमें, गौशाला, चैत्य (गाँवके सीमाका वृक्षसमूह, ग्राम्य
verses.wordMeaning: Among serpents, I am Ananta (§esa); among generals- of armies, I am lord Pavaki (son of the firegod.i.e. Skanda) t among the stages of life, I am the householder's stage and among Isvaras (Rulers) I am. Mahesvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Among serpents, I am Ananta (§esa); among generals- of armies, I am lord Pavaki (son of the firegod.i.e. Skanda) t among the stages of life, I am the householder's stage and among Isvaras (Rulers) I am. Mahesvara.

verses.sanskrit: युगमन्वन्तराण्येव मम तिष्ठन्ति शासने । पराश्चैव परार्धाश्च कालभेदास्तथा परे
verses.transliteration: yugamanvantarāṇyeva mama tiṣṭhanti śāsane / parāścaiva parārdhāśca kālabhedāstathā pare
verses.translation: Among serpents, I am Ananta (§esa); among generals- of armies, I am lord Pavaki (son of the firegod.i.e. Skanda) t among the stages of life, I am the householder's stage and among Isvaras (Rulers) I am. Mahesvara.
verses.hindi: भस्म, अग्नि तथा श्मशानमें मल-मूत्र नहीं करना चाहिए। गोबरमें, जुती हुई भूमिमें, महान् वृक्षके नीचे, हरी घाससे युक्त मैदानमें और पर्वतको चोटीपर तथा खड़े होकर एवं नग्न होकर मल-मूत्रका त्याग नहीं
verses.wordMeaning: Among serpents, I am Ananta (§esa); among generals- of armies, I am lord Pavaki (son of the firegod.i.e. Skanda) t among the stages of life, I am the householder's stage and among Isvaras (Rulers) I am. Mahesvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Among serpents, I am Ananta (§esa); among generals- of armies, I am lord Pavaki (son of the firegod.i.e. Skanda) t among the stages of life, I am the householder's stage and among Isvaras (Rulers) I am. Mahesvara.

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्विधानि भूतानि स्थावराणि चराणि च । नियोगादेव वर्तन्ते देवस्य परमात्मनः
verses.transliteration: caturvidhāni bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca / niyogādeva vartante devasya paramātmanaḥ
verses.translation: Among serpents, I am Ananta (§esa); among generals- of armies, I am lord Pavaki (son of the firegod.i.e. Skanda) t among the stages of life, I am the householder's stage and among Isvaras (Rulers) I am. Mahesvara.
verses.hindi: करना चाहिए। न जीर्ण देवमन्दिरमें, न दीमककी बाँबीमें, न जीवोंसे युक्त गड़ेमें और न चलते हुए मल-मूत्रका त्याग करना चाहिए। धान इत्यादिकी भूसी, जलते हुए अंगार, कपाल”, राजमार्ग, खेत, गड्ढे, तीर्थ, चौराहे, उद्यान, जलके समीप, ऊसर भूमि और अत्यधिक अपवित्र स्थानमें मल-मूत्रका त्याग न करे। जूता या खड़ाऊँ पहने, छाता लिये, अन्तरिक्षमें ( भूमि-आकाशके मध्यमे), स्त्री, गुरु, ब्राह्मण, गौके सामने, देवविग्रह
verses.wordMeaning: Among serpents, I am Ananta (§esa); among generals- of armies, I am lord Pavaki (son of the firegod.i.e. Skanda) t among the stages of life, I am the householder's stage and among Isvaras (Rulers) I am. Mahesvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Among serpents, I am Ananta (§esa); among generals- of armies, I am lord Pavaki (son of the firegod.i.e. Skanda) t among the stages of life, I am the householder's stage and among Isvaras (Rulers) I am. Mahesvara.

verses.sanskrit: पातालानि च सर्वाणि भुवनानि च शासनात् । ब्रह्माण्डानि च वर्तन्ते सर्वाण्येव स्वयंभुवः
verses.transliteration: pātālāni ca sarvāṇi bhuvanāni ca śāsanāt / brahmāṇḍāni ca vartante sarvāṇyeva svayaṃbhuvaḥ
verses.translation: Among serpents, I am Ananta (§esa); among generals- of armies, I am lord Pavaki (son of the firegod.i.e. Skanda) t among the stages of life, I am the householder's stage and among Isvaras (Rulers) I am. Mahesvara.
verses.hindi: तथा देवमन्दिर और जलके समीपमें तो कभी भी मल- मूत्रका विसर्जन न करे
verses.wordMeaning: Among serpents, I am Ananta (§esa); among generals- of armies, I am lord Pavaki (son of the firegod.i.e. Skanda) t among the stages of life, I am the householder's stage and among Isvaras (Rulers) I am. Mahesvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Among serpents, I am Ananta (§esa); among generals- of armies, I am lord Pavaki (son of the firegod.i.e. Skanda) t among the stages of life, I am the householder's stage and among Isvaras (Rulers) I am. Mahesvara.

verses.sanskrit: अतीतान्यप्यसंख्यानि ब्रह्माण्डानि ममाज्ञया । प्रवृत्तानि पदार्थौघैः सहितानि समन्ततः
verses.transliteration: atītānyapyasaṃkhyāni brahmāṇḍāni mamājñayā / pravṛttāni padārthaughaiḥ sahitāni samantataḥ
verses.translation: Among serpents, I am Ananta (§esa); among generals- of armies, I am lord Pavaki (son of the firegod.i.e. Skanda) t among the stages of life, I am the householder's stage and among Isvaras (Rulers) I am. Mahesvara.
verses.hindi: नक्षत्रोंको देखते हुए, संध्याकालका समय आनेपर, सूर्य, अग्नि तथा चन्द्रमाकी ओर मुख करके मल- मूत्रका त्याग नहीं करना चाहिए + कपालके ये अर्थ हैँ-सिरकी अस्थि, घटके दोनों अर्धभाग, मिट्टीका भिक्षापात्र,यज्ञीय पुरोडाशको पकानेके लिये मिट्टीका
verses.wordMeaning: Among serpents, I am Ananta (§esa); among generals- of armies, I am lord Pavaki (son of the firegod.i.e. Skanda) t among the stages of life, I am the householder's stage and among Isvaras (Rulers) I am. Mahesvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Among serpents, I am Ananta (§esa); among generals- of armies, I am lord Pavaki (son of the firegod.i.e. Skanda) t among the stages of life, I am the householder's stage and among Isvaras (Rulers) I am. Mahesvara.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्माण्डानि भविष्यन्ति सह वस्तुभिरात्मगैः । वहिष्यन्ति सदैवाज्ञां परस्य परमात्मनः
verses.transliteration: brahmāṇḍāni bhaviṣyanti saha vastubhirātmagaiḥ / vahiṣyanti sadaivājñāṃ parasya paramātmanaḥ
verses.translation: Among serpents, I am Ananta (§esa); among generals- of armies, I am lord Pavaki (son of the firegod.i.e. Skanda) t among the stages of life, I am the householder's stage and among Isvaras (Rulers) I am. Mahesvara.
verses.hindi: बना हुआ पात्रविशेष।
verses.wordMeaning: Among serpents, I am Ananta (§esa); among generals- of armies, I am lord Pavaki (son of the firegod.i.e. Skanda) t among the stages of life, I am the householder's stage and among Isvaras (Rulers) I am. Mahesvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Among serpents, I am Ananta (§esa); among generals- of armies, I am lord Pavaki (son of the firegod.i.e. Skanda) t among the stages of life, I am the householder's stage and among Isvaras (Rulers) I am. Mahesvara.

verses.sanskrit: भूमिरापो ऽनलो वायुः खं मनो बुद्धिरेव च । भूतादिरादिप्रकृतिर्नियोगे मम वर्तते
verses.transliteration: bhūmirāpo 'nalo vāyuḥ khaṃ mano buddhireva ca / bhūtādirādiprakṛtirniyoge mama vartate
verses.translation: Among serpents, I am Ananta (§esa); among generals- of armies, I am lord Pavaki (son of the firegod.i.e. Skanda) t among the stages of life, I am the householder's stage and among Isvaras (Rulers) I am. Mahesvara.
verses.hindi: आहृत्य मृत्तिकां कूलाल्लेपगन्धापकर्षणम्। आलस्य छोड़कर (नदी या तालाबके) किनारेसे कुर्यादतन्द्रितः शौचं विशुद्धैरुद्धतोदकैः॥ ४३॥  मिट्टी लेकर उसके द्वारा तथा शुद्ध कूप आदिसे निकाले हुए जलके द्वारा (मल-मूत्र) लेप और गन्ध जबतक दूर न हो, तबतक शुद्धि करनी चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: Among serpents, I am Ananta (§esa); among generals- of armies, I am lord Pavaki (son of the firegod.i.e. Skanda) t among the stages of life, I am the householder's stage and among Isvaras (Rulers) I am. Mahesvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Among serpents, I am Ananta (§esa); among generals- of armies, I am lord Pavaki (son of the firegod.i.e. Skanda) t among the stages of life, I am the householder's stage and among Isvaras (Rulers) I am. Mahesvara.

verses.sanskrit: याशेषजगतां योनिर्मोहिनी सर्वदेहिनाम् । माया विवर्तते नित्यं सापीश्वरनियोगतः
verses.transliteration: yāśeṣajagatāṃ yonirmohinī sarvadehinām / māyā vivartate nityaṃ sāpīśvaraniyogataḥ
verses.translation: Among serpents, I am Ananta (§esa); among generals- of armies, I am lord Pavaki (son of the firegod.i.e. Skanda) t among the stages of life, I am the householder's stage and among Isvaras (Rulers) I am. Mahesvara.
verses.hindi: नाहरेन्मृत्तिकां विप्रः पांशुलान्न च कर्दमात्। विप्र (द्विज)-को चाहिए कि वह शौचके लिये
verses.wordMeaning: Among serpents, I am Ananta (§esa); among generals- of armies, I am lord Pavaki (son of the firegod.i.e. Skanda) t among the stages of life, I am the householder's stage and among Isvaras (Rulers) I am. Mahesvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Among serpents, I am Ananta (§esa); among generals- of armies, I am lord Pavaki (son of the firegod.i.e. Skanda) t among the stages of life, I am the householder's stage and among Isvaras (Rulers) I am. Mahesvara.

verses.sanskrit: यो वै देहभृतां देवः पुरुषः पठ्यते परः । आत्मासौ वर्तते नित्यमीश्वरस्य नियोगतः
verses.transliteration: yo vai dehabhṛtāṃ devaḥ puruṣaḥ paṭhyate paraḥ / ātmāsau vartate nityamīśvarasya niyogataḥ
verses.translation: Among serpents, I am Ananta (§esa); among generals- of armies, I am lord Pavaki (son of the firegod.i.e. Skanda) t among the stages of life, I am the householder's stage and among Isvaras (Rulers) I am. Mahesvara.
verses.hindi: न मार्गान्नोषराद् देशाच्छौचशिष्टा परस्य च॥ ४४॥  धूलकी ढेर एवं कीचड्युक्त स्थान, रास्ते, कसर भूमि, दूसरेके शौच करनेसे बची हुई, मन्दिर, कुएँ, ग्रामी और जलके अंदरसे मिट्टी ग्रहण न करे। शौचके न देवायतनात् कूपाद् ग्रामान्न च जलात् तथा। अनन्तर पहले बताये गये विधानके अनुसार नित्य
verses.wordMeaning: Among serpents, I am Ananta (§esa); among generals- of armies, I am lord Pavaki (son of the firegod.i.e. Skanda) t among the stages of life, I am the householder's stage and among Isvaras (Rulers) I am. Mahesvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Among serpents, I am Ananta (§esa); among generals- of armies, I am lord Pavaki (son of the firegod.i.e. Skanda) t among the stages of life, I am the householder's stage and among Isvaras (Rulers) I am. Mahesvara.

verses.sanskrit: विधूय मोहकलिलं यया पश्यति तत् पदम् । सापि विद्या महेशस्य नियोगवशवर्तिनी
verses.transliteration: vidhūya mohakalilaṃ yayā paśyati tat padam / sāpi vidyā maheśasya niyogavaśavartinī
verses.translation: Among serpents, I am Ananta (§esa); among generals- of armies, I am lord Pavaki (son of the firegod.i.e. Skanda) t among the stages of life, I am the householder's stage and among Isvaras (Rulers) I am. Mahesvara.
verses.hindi: उपस्पृशेत् ततो नित्यं पूर्वोक्तेन विधानतः॥ ४५॥  आचमन करे
verses.wordMeaning: Among serpents, I am Ananta (§esa); among generals- of armies, I am lord Pavaki (son of the firegod.i.e. Skanda) t among the stages of life, I am the householder's stage and among Isvaras (Rulers) I am. Mahesvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Among serpents, I am Ananta (§esa); among generals- of armies, I am lord Pavaki (son of the firegod.i.e. Skanda) t among the stages of life, I am the householder's stage and among Isvaras (Rulers) I am. Mahesvara.

verses.sanskrit: बहुनात्र किमुक्तेन मम शक्त्यात्मकं जगत् । मयैव प्रेर्यते कृत्स्नं मय्येव प्रलयं व्रजेत्
verses.transliteration: bahunātra kimuktena mama śaktyātmakaṃ jagat / mayaiva preryate kṛtsnaṃ mayyeva pralayaṃ vrajet
verses.translation: Among serpents, I am Ananta (§esa); among generals- of armies, I am lord Pavaki (son of the firegod.i.e. Skanda) t among the stages of life, I am the householder's stage and among Isvaras (Rulers) I am. Mahesvara.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षद्साहस्रघां संहितायामुपरिविभागे त्रयोदशोऽध्यायः ब्रह्चारीके आचारका वर्णन, गुरुसे अध्ययन आदिको विधि, ब्रह्मचारीका धर्म, गुरु तथा गुरुपत्रीके साथ व्यवहारका वर्णन, वेदाध्ययन और गायत्रीकी महिमा, अनध्यायोंका वर्णन, ब्रह्मचारी-धर्मका उपसंहार
verses.wordMeaning: Among serpents, I am Ananta (§esa); among generals- of armies, I am lord Pavaki (son of the firegod.i.e. Skanda) t among the stages of life, I am the householder's stage and among Isvaras (Rulers) I am. Mahesvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Among serpents, I am Ananta (§esa); among generals- of armies, I am lord Pavaki (son of the firegod.i.e. Skanda) t among the stages of life, I am the householder's stage and among Isvaras (Rulers) I am. Mahesvara.

verses.sanskrit: अहं हि भगवानीशः स्वयं ज्योतिः सनातनः । परमात्मा परं ब्रह्म मत्तो ह्यन्यन्न विद्यते
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ hi bhagavānīśaḥ svayaṃ jyotiḥ sanātanaḥ / paramātmā paraṃ brahma matto hyanyanna vidyate
verses.translation: Among serpents, I am Ananta (§esa); among generals- of armies, I am lord Pavaki (son of the firegod.i.e. Skanda) t among the stages of life, I am the householder's stage and among Isvaras (Rulers) I am. Mahesvara.
verses.hindi: व्यास उवाच व्यासजीने कहा--इस प्रकार दण्ड आदिसे युक्त
verses.wordMeaning: Among serpents, I am Ananta (§esa); among generals- of armies, I am lord Pavaki (son of the firegod.i.e. Skanda) t among the stages of life, I am the householder's stage and among Isvaras (Rulers) I am. Mahesvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Among serpents, I am Ananta (§esa); among generals- of armies, I am lord Pavaki (son of the firegod.i.e. Skanda) t among the stages of life, I am the householder's stage and among Isvaras (Rulers) I am. Mahesvara.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येतत् परमं ज्ञानं युष्माकं कथितं मया । ज्ञात्वा विमुच्यते जन्तुर्जन्मसंसारबन्धनात्
verses.transliteration: ityetat paramaṃ jñānaṃ yuṣmākaṃ kathitaṃ mayā / jñātvā vimucyate janturjanmasaṃsārabandhanāt
verses.translation: Among serpents, I am Ananta (§esa); among generals- of armies, I am lord Pavaki (son of the firegod.i.e. Skanda) t among the stages of life, I am the householder's stage and among Isvaras (Rulers) I am. Mahesvara.
verses.hindi: और शौचाचारसे सम्पन्न (ब्रह्मचारी)-को गुरुजीके एवं दण्डादिभिर्युक्तः शौचाचारसमन्वितः। द्वारा बुलाये जानेपर उनके अभिमुख होकर अध्ययन आहूतोऽध्ययनं कुर्याद् वीक्षमाणो गुरोर्मुखम्॥ १॥  करना चाहिए। सदाचारसम्पन्न और जितेन्द्रिय ब्रह्मचारी
verses.wordMeaning: Among serpents, I am Ananta (§esa); among generals- of armies, I am lord Pavaki (son of the firegod.i.e. Skanda) t among the stages of life, I am the householder's stage and among Isvaras (Rulers) I am. Mahesvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Among serpents, I am Ananta (§esa); among generals- of armies, I am lord Pavaki (son of the firegod.i.e. Skanda) t among the stages of life, I am the householder's stage and among Isvaras (Rulers) I am. Mahesvara.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे (ईश्वरगीतासु) षष्ठो ऽध्यायः ईश्वर उवाच शृणुध्वमृषयः सर्वे प्रभावं परमेष्ठिनः । यं ज्ञात्वा पुरुषो मुक्तो न संसारे पतेत् पुनः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge (īśvaragītāsu) ṣaṣṭho 'dhyāyaḥ īśvara uvāca śṛṇudhvamṛṣayaḥ sarve prabhāvaṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ / yaṃ jñātvā puruṣo mukto na saṃsāre patet punaḥ
verses.translation: Among Kalpas, I am Mahakalpa (the greatest' Kalpa); among the Yugas, I am Krtayuga; among the Ya- ksas, I am Kubera and among grasses, I am Virudha (plant which grows after being cut) (v.l. am Viruka among Ganesas)
verses.hindi: नित्यमुद्यतपाणिः स्यात् साध्वाचारः सुसंयतः । नित्य उत्तरीयसे दाहिना हाथ बाहर निकाले हुए
verses.wordMeaning: Among Kalpas, I am Mahakalpa (the greatest' Kalpa); among the Yugas, I am Krtayuga; among the Ya- ksas, I am Kubera and among grasses, I am Virudha (plant which grows after being cut) (v.l. am Viruka among Ganesas)
verses.commentary: Sense: Among Kalpas, I am Mahakalpa (the greatest' Kalpa); among the Yugas, I am Krtayuga; among the Ya- ksas, I am Kubera and among grasses, I am Virudha (plant which grows after being cut) (v.l. am Viruka among Ganesas)

verses.sanskrit: परात् परतरं ब्रह्म शाश्वतं निष्कलं ध्रुवम् । नित्यानन्दं निर्विकल्पं तद्धाम परमं मम
verses.transliteration: parāt parataraṃ brahma śāśvataṃ niṣkalaṃ dhruvam / nityānandaṃ nirvikalpaṃ taddhāma paramaṃ mama
verses.translation: Among the Prajapatis (progenitors of the world), I am Daksa; among the Raksasas I am Nirrti; among power¬ ful persons, I am Vayu, and among the continents, I am Puskaia.
verses.hindi: आस्यतामिति चोक्तः सन्नासीताभिमुखं गुरोः॥ २॥  गुरुके द्वारा बैठनेके लिये कहे जानेपर उनके सम्मुख" बैठे। सोते हुए, बैठे हुए, भोजन करते हुए, खड़े प्रतिश्रवणसम्भाषे शयानो न समाचरेत्। होकर तथा गुरुकी ओर पीठ करके उनकी किसी नासीनो न च भुञ्जानो न तिष्ठन्न पराङ्मुखः॥ ३॥  आज्ञाका ग्रहण या उनसे बातचीत नहीं करनी चाहिए। गुरुके पासमें शिष्यकी शय्या या आसन सदा गुरुकी शय्या एवं आसनकी अपेक्षा नीचा (कम ऊँचा)
verses.wordMeaning: Among the Prajapatis (progenitors of the world), I am Daksa; among the Raksasas I am Nirrti; among power¬ ful persons, I am Vayu, and among the continents, I am Puskaia.
verses.commentary: Sense: Among the Prajapatis (progenitors of the world), I am Daksa; among the Raksasas I am Nirrti; among power¬ ful persons, I am Vayu, and among the continents, I am Puskaia.

verses.sanskrit: अहं ब्रह्मविदां ब्रह्मा स्वयंभूर्विश्वतोमुखः । मायाविनामहं देवः पुराणो हरिरव्ययः
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ brahmavidāṃ brahmā svayaṃbhūrviśvatomukhaḥ / māyāvināmahaṃ devaḥ purāṇo hariravyayaḥ
verses.translation: Among the leaders of beasts, I am the lion; among mechanical devices (weapons), I am the bow; among the Vedas,
verses.hindi: नीचं शय्यासनं चास्य सर्वदा गुरुसंनिधौ। होना चाहिए। गुरुके देखते रहनेपर मनमाने ढंगसे गुरोस्तु चक्षुर्विषये न यथेष्टासनो भवेत्॥ ४॥  नहीं बैठना चाहिए॥ १--४॥
verses.wordMeaning: Among the leaders of beasts, I am the lion; among mechanical devices (weapons), I am the bow; among the Vedas,
verses.commentary: Sense: Among the leaders of beasts, I am the lion; among mechanical devices (weapons), I am the bow; among the Vedas,

verses.sanskrit: योगिनामस्म्यहं शंभुः स्त्रीणां देवी गिरीन्द्रजा । आदित्यानामहं विष्णुर्वसूनामस्मि पावकः
verses.transliteration: yogināmasmyahaṃ śaṃbhuḥ strīṇāṃ devī girīndrajā / ādityānāmahaṃ viṣṇurvasūnāmasmi pāvakaḥ
verses.translation: Among the Japyas (Mantras for the purpose of Japa), lam Savitrl, (RV. III. 62. 10); among mystic secret Mantras, I am Pranava {Om ), among the hymns, I am the Purusasukta (RV. X. 90) and among the Saman Mantras I am Jyestha Saman.
verses.hindi: १-प्रवाहशून्य कहीं गड्डे आदिमें एकत्र जल अपवित्र होता है। अपवित्र हाथ आदि साक्षात् नदी, तालाब आदिमें डालकर नहीं धोना चाहिए। किसी पात्रसे जल निकालकर ही धोना चाहिए। २-ग्रामके अंदरकी भूमि-लेप, चलने, थूकने आदिसे अपवित्र होती है । ग्रामके अंदरकी मिट्टी लेनेसे अनपेक्षित गड्डा आदि होता है जो लोगोंके त्रासका कारण बनता है।
verses.wordMeaning: Among the Japyas (Mantras for the purpose of Japa), lam Savitrl, (RV. III. 62. 10); among mystic secret Mantras, I am Pranava {Om ), among the hymns, I am the Purusasukta (RV. X. 90) and among the Saman Mantras I am Jyestha Saman.
verses.commentary: Sense: Among the Japyas (Mantras for the purpose of Japa), lam Savitrl, (RV. III. 62. 10); among mystic secret Mantras, I am Pranava {Om ), among the hymns, I am the Purusasukta (RV. X. 90) and among the Saman Mantras I am Jyestha Saman.

verses.sanskrit: रुद्राणां शङ्करश्चाहं गरुडः पततामहम् । ऐरावतो गजेन्द्राणां रामः शस्त्रभृतामहम्
verses.transliteration: rudrāṇāṃ śaṅkaraścāhaṃ garuḍaḥ patatāmaham / airāvato gajendrāṇāṃ rāmaḥ śastrabhṛtāmaham
verses.translation: Among the scholars of Vedic topics, I am Svayam- bhuva Manu; among territories, I am Brahmavarta and among holy centres, I am Avimuktaka (Varanasi).
verses.hindi: ३-यह श्लोक मनुस्मृति (२! १९३)-में उपलब्ध है। वहाँ ' नित्यमुद्धतपाणिः ' पाठ है। यही उपयुक्त है। इसका तात्पर्य यही है कि उत्तरीय (ऊपरसे चद्दर) धारण कर ही अध्ययन करना चाहिए तथा दाहिने हाथको चद्दरसे बाहर रखना चाहिए, क्योंकि अध्ययनमें दाहिने हाथका उपयोग होता है।
verses.wordMeaning: Among the scholars of Vedic topics, I am Svayam- bhuva Manu; among territories, I am Brahmavarta and among holy centres, I am Avimuktaka (Varanasi).
verses.commentary: Sense: Among the scholars of Vedic topics, I am Svayam- bhuva Manu; among territories, I am Brahmavarta and among holy centres, I am Avimuktaka (Varanasi).

verses.sanskrit: ऋषीणां च वसिष्ठो ऽहं देवानां च शतक्रतुः । शिल्पिनां विश्वकर्माहं प्रह्लादो ऽस्म्यमरद्विषाम्
verses.transliteration: ṛṣīṇāṃ ca vasiṣṭho 'haṃ devānāṃ ca śatakratuḥ / śilpināṃ viśvakarmāhaṃ prahlādo 'smyamaradviṣām
verses.translation: Among Vidyas (lores), I am the Atmavidya (spiri¬ tual science, leading to realization of Atman). Among types of knowledge, I am the greatest knowledge pertaining to Isvara; among the elements, I am the Ether, and among the entities (or realities) I am Mrtyu (Death).
verses.hindi: नोदाहरेदस्य नाम परोक्षमपि केवलम्। न चैवास्यानुकुर्वीत गतिभाषणचेष्टितम् कर्णौ तत्र पिधातव्यौ गन्तव्यं वा ततो5न्यतः
verses.wordMeaning: Among Vidyas (lores), I am the Atmavidya (spiri¬ tual science, leading to realization of Atman). Among types of knowledge, I am the greatest knowledge pertaining to Isvara; among the elements, I am the Ether, and among the entities (or realities) I am Mrtyu (Death).
verses.commentary: Sense: Among Vidyas (lores), I am the Atmavidya (spiri¬ tual science, leading to realization of Atman). Among types of knowledge, I am the greatest knowledge pertaining to Isvara; among the elements, I am the Ether, and among the entities (or realities) I am Mrtyu (Death).

verses.sanskrit: मुनीनामप्यहं व्यासो गणानां च विनायकः । वीराणां वीरभद्रो ऽहं सिद्धानां कपिलो मुनिः
verses.transliteration: munīnāmapyahaṃ vyāso gaṇānāṃ ca vināyakaḥ / vīrāṇāṃ vīrabhadro 'haṃ siddhānāṃ kapilo muniḥ
verses.translation: Among the nooses and fetters, I am Maya, and among the Calculators, I am Kala (Time), among goals I am
verses.hindi: दूरस्थो नार्चयेदेनं न क्रुद्धो नान्तिके स्त्रियाः । न चैवास्योत्तरं ब्रूयात् स्थितो नासीत संनिधौ
verses.wordMeaning: Among the nooses and fetters, I am Maya, and among the Calculators, I am Kala (Time), among goals I am
verses.commentary: Sense: Among the nooses and fetters, I am Maya, and among the Calculators, I am Kala (Time), among goals I am

verses.sanskrit: पर्वतानामहं मेरुर्नक्षत्राणां च चन्द्रमाः । वज्रं प्रहरणानां च व्रतानां सत्यमस्म्यहम्
verses.transliteration: parvatānāmahaṃ merurnakṣatrāṇāṃ ca candramāḥ / vajraṃ praharaṇānāṃ ca vratānāṃ satyamasmyaham
verses.translation: Whatever else be in the world that stands most pro¬ minent by means of Sattvaguna, brilliance of power, you can vouchsafe for it that it is a manifestation of brilliance.*
verses.hindi: नास्य निर्माल्यशयनं पादुकोपानहावपि। आक्रमेदासनं चास्य छायादीन् वा कदाचन साधयेद् दन्तकाष्ठादीन् लब्धं चास्मै निवेदयेत्। अनापृच्छ्य न गन्तव्यं भवेत् प्रियहिते रतः
verses.wordMeaning: Whatever else be in the world that stands most pro¬ minent by means of Sattvaguna, brilliance of power, you can vouchsafe for it that it is a manifestation of brilliance.*
verses.commentary: Sense: Whatever else be in the world that stands most pro¬ minent by means of Sattvaguna, brilliance of power, you can vouchsafe for it that it is a manifestation of brilliance.*

verses.sanskrit: अनन्तो भोगिनां देवः सेनानीनां च पावकिः । आश्रमाणां च गार्हस्थमीश्वराणां महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: ananto bhogināṃ devaḥ senānīnāṃ ca pāvakiḥ / āśramāṇāṃ ca gārhasthamīśvarāṇāṃ maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: All the Atmans existing in the world are said to be Paius. I am remembered as their lord, Pasupati by the wise sages.
verses.hindi: यथाकालमधीयीत यावन्न विमना गुरुः। आसीताधो गुरोः कूर्चे फलके वा समाहितः
verses.wordMeaning: All the Atmans existing in the world are said to be Paius. I am remembered as their lord, Pasupati by the wise sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the Atmans existing in the world are said to be Paius. I am remembered as their lord, Pasupati by the wise sages.

verses.sanskrit: महाकल्पश्च कल्पानां युगानां कृतमस्म्यहम् । कुबेरः सर्वयक्षाणां गणेशानां च वीरकः
verses.transliteration: mahākalpaśca kalpānāṃ yugānāṃ kṛtamasmyaham / kuberaḥ sarvayakṣāṇāṃ gaṇeśānāṃ ca vīrakaḥ
verses.translation: In my sportive activity, I bind all these Pasus by means of the noose of the Maya. Expounders of the Vedas say that I am the liberator of the Pasus (Individual souls).
verses.hindi: इनका (गुरुका) केवल नाम (सम्मानबोधक उपाधि आदिसे शून्य नाम) परोक्षमें भी नहीं लेना चाहिए। इनके चलनेकी क्रिया, बात करनेके ढंग और अन्य क्रियाओंको नकल उपहासकी दृष्टिसे नहीं करनी चाहिए गुरुका जहाँ परीवाद (विद्यमान दोषका कथन) हो रहा हो अथवा जहाँ उनकी निन्दा हो रही हो, वहाँ अपने दोनों कानोंको बंद कर ले अथवा वहाँसे अन्यत्र चला जाय। दूर विद्यमान शिष्य (किसी अन्यको
verses.wordMeaning: In my sportive activity, I bind all these Pasus by means of the noose of the Maya. Expounders of the Vedas say that I am the liberator of the Pasus (Individual souls).
verses.commentary: Sense: In my sportive activity, I bind all these Pasus by means of the noose of the Maya. Expounders of the Vedas say that I am the liberator of the Pasus (Individual souls).

verses.sanskrit: प्रजापतीनां दक्षो ऽहं निरृतिः सर्वरक्षसाम् । वायुर्बलवतामस्मि द्वीपानां पुष्करो ऽस्म्यहम्
verses.transliteration: prajāpatīnāṃ dakṣo 'haṃ nirṛtiḥ sarvarakṣasām / vāyurbalavatāmasmi dvīpānāṃ puṣkaro 'smyaham
verses.translation: Excepting me, the great Atman, the unchanging overlord of the Bhutas, there is no other liberator of those who are bound with the noose of the Maya.
verses.hindi: गुरुकी पूजाके लिये नियुक्त कर उसके द्वारा) गुरुको पूजा न करवाये, (यदि स्वयं गुरुके समीप जाकर पूजा करनेमें समर्थ हो। स्वयं गुरुके समीप जानेमें असमर्थ होनेपर तो अन्यके द्वारा भी गुरुकी पूजा करवायी जा
verses.wordMeaning: Excepting me, the great Atman, the unchanging overlord of the Bhutas, there is no other liberator of those who are bound with the noose of the Maya.
verses.commentary: Sense: Excepting me, the great Atman, the unchanging overlord of the Bhutas, there is no other liberator of those who are bound with the noose of the Maya.

verses.sanskrit: मृगेन्द्राणां च सिंहो ऽहं यन्त्राणां धनुरेव च । वेदानां सामवेदो ऽहं यजुषां शतरुद्रियम्
verses.transliteration: mṛgendrāṇāṃ ca siṃho 'haṃ yantrāṇāṃ dhanureva ca / vedānāṃ sāmavedo 'haṃ yajuṣāṃ śatarudriyam
verses.translation: The twenty-four principles, the Maya, the Karman and the three Gunas—these are the nooses (in the hands) of Pasupati; and distresses are the bondages of individual souls (Pasus).
verses.hindi: सकती है।) क्रोधके आवेशमें रहनेपर शिष्यको स्वयं भी गुरुकी पूजा नहीं करनी चाहिए। यदि गुरु स्त्रीके समीप हों तो उस समय उनकी पूजा नहीं करनी चाहिए। गुरुकी बातका उत्तर नहीं देना चाहिए और गुरुके निकट रहनेपर उनकी आज्ञाके बिना बैठना भी नहीं चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: The twenty-four principles, the Maya, the Karman and the three Gunas—these are the nooses (in the hands) of Pasupati; and distresses are the bondages of individual souls (Pasus).
verses.commentary: Sense: The twenty-four principles, the Maya, the Karman and the three Gunas—these are the nooses (in the hands) of Pasupati; and distresses are the bondages of individual souls (Pasus).

verses.sanskrit: सावित्री सर्वजप्यानां गुह्यानां प्रणवो ऽस्म्यहम् । सूक्तानां पौरुषं सूक्तं ज्येष्ठसाम च सामसु
verses.transliteration: sāvitrī sarvajapyānāṃ guhyānāṃ praṇavo 'smyaham / sūktānāṃ pauruṣaṃ sūktaṃ jyeṣṭhasāma ca sāmasu
verses.translation: The mind, the intellect, the ego, the firmament, the wind, the Hre, the water, and the Earth—these eight are Prakrtis (causes) and the other things are Vikaras (effects).
verses.hindi: (शिष्यको चाहिए कि ) गुरुके लिये सर्वदा जलसे
verses.wordMeaning: The mind, the intellect, the ego, the firmament, the wind, the Hre, the water, and the Earth—these eight are Prakrtis (causes) and the other things are Vikaras (effects).
verses.commentary: Sense: The mind, the intellect, the ego, the firmament, the wind, the Hre, the water, and the Earth—these eight are Prakrtis (causes) and the other things are Vikaras (effects).

verses.sanskrit: सर्ववेदार्थविदुषां मनुः स्वायंभुवो ऽस्म्यहम् । ब्रह्मावर्तस्तु देशानां क्षेत्राणामविमुक्तकम्
verses.transliteration: sarvavedārthaviduṣāṃ manuḥ svāyaṃbhuvo 'smyaham / brahmāvartastu deśānāṃ kṣetrāṇāmavimuktakam
verses.translation: The twenty-fourth principle is the Avyakta (unmani¬ fest), Pradhana characterised by its Gunas. It has neither beginning nor middle nor destruction. It is the supreme cause of the universe.
verses.hindi: उनके अङ्गोंका मार्जन (गुरुको स्नान कराना) तथा (गन्धादिद्वारा) लेपन (शरीरका सुगन्धीकरण) करे। उनके निर्माल्य (गुरुकी सेवामें समर्पित माला आदि), शय्या, खड़ाऊँ, जूता, आसन तथा छाया आदिका कभी भी लंघन नहीं करना चाहिए। गुरुके लिये दन्तका (दाँतोंको स्वच्छ करनेके लिये दतुअन) आदि लाये और (भिक्षादिमें) प्राप्त पदार्थोंको गुरुको निवेदित करे। गुरुसे बिना पूछे कहीं जाये नहीं तथा सदा गुरुके प्रिय
verses.wordMeaning: The twenty-fourth principle is the Avyakta (unmani¬ fest), Pradhana characterised by its Gunas. It has neither beginning nor middle nor destruction. It is the supreme cause of the universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: The twenty-fourth principle is the Avyakta (unmani¬ fest), Pradhana characterised by its Gunas. It has neither beginning nor middle nor destruction. It is the supreme cause of the universe.

verses.sanskrit: विद्यानामात्मविद्याहं ज्ञानानामैश्वरं परम् । भूतानामस्म्यहं व्योम सत्त्वानां मृत्युरेव च
verses.transliteration: vidyānāmātmavidyāhaṃ jñānānāmaiśvaraṃ param / bhūtānāmasmyahaṃ vyoma sattvānāṃ mṛtyureva ca
verses.translation: Sattva, Rajas and Tamas—these are called the three Gunas. The state of equilibrium of these, they know to be the Avyakta Prakrti (the unmanifest Prakrti).
verses.hindi: तथा हित करनेमें लगा रहे
verses.wordMeaning: Sattva, Rajas and Tamas—these are called the three Gunas. The state of equilibrium of these, they know to be the Avyakta Prakrti (the unmanifest Prakrti).
verses.commentary: Sense: Sattva, Rajas and Tamas—these are called the three Gunas. The state of equilibrium of these, they know to be the Avyakta Prakrti (the unmanifest Prakrti).

verses.sanskrit: पाशानामस्म्यहं माया कालः कलयतामहम् । गतीनां मुक्तिरेवाहं परेषां परमेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: pāśānāmasmyahaṃ māyā kālaḥ kalayatāmaham / gatīnāṃ muktirevāhaṃ pareṣāṃ parameśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Sattva is knowledge; the Rajas and the Tamas are ignorance (Ajndna) (v.l. Rajas is) a mixture of knowledge and ignorance. The wise sages know that the inequality of the Gunas is due to the disequilibrium in intellect.
verses.hindi: गुरुके समीप कभी भी पैर फैलाकर बैठना नहीं चाहिए और उनके समीप जँभाई, हँसी, कण्ठाच्छादन (सुन्दर माला, हार आदि गलेमें पहनना) तथा ताली इत्यादिको हलचल) न करे। अध्ययन तबतक करते रहना चाहिए जबतक गुरु बेमन न हो जाये (अध्यापनके प्रति सोत्साह रहें) । सावधानीपूर्वक गुरुके सम्मुख नीचे कुशासन या काष्ठासन इत्यादिपर बैठना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: Sattva is knowledge; the Rajas and the Tamas are ignorance (Ajndna) (v.l. Rajas is) a mixture of knowledge and ignorance. The wise sages know that the inequality of the Gunas is due to the disequilibrium in intellect.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sattva is knowledge; the Rajas and the Tamas are ignorance (Ajndna) (v.l. Rajas is) a mixture of knowledge and ignorance. The wise sages know that the inequality of the Gunas is due to the disequilibrium in intellect.

verses.sanskrit: यच्चान्यदपि लोके ऽस्मिन् सत्त्वं तेजोबलाधिकम् । तत्सर्वं प्रतिजानीध्वं मम तेजोविजृम्भितम्
verses.transliteration: yaccānyadapi loke 'smin sattvaṃ tejobalādhikam / tatsarvaṃ pratijānīdhvaṃ mama tejovijṛmbhitam
verses.translation: What are called Dharma and Adharma (Virtue and Evil) are the binding nooses called Karmans. But those Karmans dedicated unto me are conducive to liberation and not to bondage.
verses.hindi: कामं लोभं भयं निद्रां गीतवादित्रनर्तनम्।
verses.wordMeaning: What are called Dharma and Adharma (Virtue and Evil) are the binding nooses called Karmans. But those Karmans dedicated unto me are conducive to liberation and not to bondage.
verses.commentary: Sense: What are called Dharma and Adharma (Virtue and Evil) are the binding nooses called Karmans. But those Karmans dedicated unto me are conducive to liberation and not to bondage.

verses.sanskrit: आत्मानः पशवः प्रोक्ताः सर्वे संसारवर्तिनः । तेषां पतिरहं देवः स्मृतः पशुपतिर्बुधैः
verses.transliteration: ātmānaḥ paśavaḥ proktāḥ sarve saṃsāravartinaḥ / teṣāṃ patirahaṃ devaḥ smṛtaḥ paśupatirbudhaiḥ
verses.translation: Avidya (Ignorance); (Egotism), (Passion)
verses.hindi: उदकुम्भं सुमनसो गोशकृन्मृत्तिकां कुशान्। आहरेद् यावदर्थानि भैक्ष्यं चाहरहश्चरेत् एकान्तमशुचिस्त्रीभिः शूद्रान्त्यैरभिभाषणम्
verses.wordMeaning: Avidya (Ignorance); (Egotism), (Passion)
verses.commentary: Sense: Avidya (Ignorance); (Egotism), (Passion)

verses.sanskrit: मायापाशेन बध्नामि पशूनेतान् स्वलीलया । मामेव मोचकं प्राहुः पशूनां वेदवादिनः
verses.transliteration: māyāpāśena badhnāmi paśūnetān svalīlayā / māmeva mocakaṃ prāhuḥ paśūnāṃ vedavādinaḥ
verses.translation: Maya alone is called the cause of these Pasas. It is the original unmanifest Prakrti. That Sakti (divine power) stays in me.
verses.hindi: गुरूच्छिष्टं भेषजार्थं प्रयुञ्जीत न कामतः। मलापकर्षणस्नानं नाच्रेद्धि कदाचन
verses.wordMeaning: Maya alone is called the cause of these Pasas. It is the original unmanifest Prakrti. That Sakti (divine power) stays in me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Maya alone is called the cause of these Pasas. It is the original unmanifest Prakrti. That Sakti (divine power) stays in me.

verses.sanskrit: मायापाशेन बद्धानां मोचको ऽन्यो न विद्यते । मामृते परमात्मानं भूताधिपतिमव्ययम्
verses.transliteration: māyāpāśena baddhānāṃ mocako 'nyo na vidyate / māmṛte paramātmānaṃ bhūtādhipatimavyayam
verses.translation: He alone is the primordial nature or Pradhana as well as Purusa and the product such as Mahat etc. He is the eternal God of gods.
verses.hindi: कुल्लूकभट्टके अनुसार शुक्त वह वस्तु है जो स्वभावतः (मनु० २। १७७ को व्याख्या) ।
verses.wordMeaning: He alone is the primordial nature or Pradhana as well as Purusa and the product such as Mahat etc. He is the eternal God of gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: He alone is the primordial nature or Pradhana as well as Purusa and the product such as Mahat etc. He is the eternal God of gods.

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्विंशतितत्त्वानि माया कर्म गुणा इति । एते पाशाः पशुपतेः क्लेशाश्च पशुबन्धनाः
verses.transliteration: caturviṃśatitattvāni māyā karma guṇā iti / ete pāśāḥ paśupateḥ kleśāśca paśubandhanāḥ
verses.translation: He alone is the bondage and the maker of bondage; He alone is the Pasa and the sustainer of the Pasus. He knows everything but no one knows him. They call him the Primordial and ancient Purusa.
verses.hindi: गुरुके आसन, शय्या तथा यानपर कभी भी नहीं बैठना चाहिए। गुरुके दौड़नेपर उनके पीछे दौड़े और चलनेपर उनके पीछे चलना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: He alone is the bondage and the maker of bondage; He alone is the Pasa and the sustainer of the Pasus. He knows everything but no one knows him. They call him the Primordial and ancient Purusa.
verses.commentary: Sense: He alone is the bondage and the maker of bondage; He alone is the Pasa and the sustainer of the Pasus. He knows everything but no one knows him. They call him the Primordial and ancient Purusa.

verses.sanskrit: मनो बुद्धिरहङ्कारः खानिलाग्निजलानि भूः । एताः प्रकृतयस्त्वष्टौ विकाराश्च तथापरे
verses.transliteration: mano buddhirahaṅkāraḥ khānilāgnijalāni bhūḥ / etāḥ prakṛtayastvaṣṭau vikārāśca tathāpare
verses.translation: The same as BG,, XIII. 27.
verses.hindi: बैल, उँट एवं घोडेकी सवारी, प्रासाद, प्रस्तर, चटाई, शिलाखण्ड तथा नौकामें गुरुके साथ समान आसनपर बैठा जा सकता है (ऐसी जगहोंपर भी नीचे ही बैठा जाय ऐसा नियम नहीं है) । ब्रह्मचारी सदा जितेन्द्रिय रहे, अपने मनको वशमें रखे, क्रोध न करे, पवित्र रहे, सदा मधुर और हित करनेवाली वाणीका प्रयोग करे
verses.wordMeaning: The same as BG,, XIII. 27.
verses.commentary: Sense: The same as BG,, XIII. 27.

verses.sanskrit: श्रोत्रं त्वक्चक्षुषी जिह्वा घ्राणं चैव तु पञ्चमम् । पायूपस्थं करौ पादौ वाक् चैव दशमी मता
verses.transliteration: śrotraṃ tvakcakṣuṣī jihvā ghrāṇaṃ caiva tu pañcamam / pāyūpasthaṃ karau pādau vāk caiva daśamī matā
verses.translation: BG. XIII. 28.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मचारीको चाहिए कि वह प्रयत्नपूर्वक सुगन्धित
verses.wordMeaning: BG. XIII. 28.
verses.commentary: Sense: BG. XIII. 28.

verses.sanskrit: शब्दः स्पर्शश्च रूपं च रसो गन्धस्तथैव च । त्रयोविंशतिरेतानि तत्त्वानि प्राकृतानि तु
verses.transliteration: śabdaḥ sparśaśca rūpaṃ ca raso gandhastathaiva ca / trayoviṃśatiretāni tattvāni prākṛtāni tu
verses.translation: vide V, 13 below.
verses.hindi: शुक्त अर्थात् गुड आदिके मिश्रणसे बने मादक तीक्ष्ण पदार्थ, प्राणियोंकी हिंसा, तैल आदिका मर्दन, अञ्जन, जूता, छाताका धारण करना, काम, लोभ, भय, निद्रा, गायन, वादन तथा नृत्य, डाँट-फटकार लगाना, निन्दा, स्त्रीदर्शन तथा उसका स्पर्श, दूसरोंको मारना और चुगुलखोरी आदिका परित्याग करे
verses.wordMeaning: vide V, 13 below.
verses.commentary: Sense: vide V, 13 below.

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्विंशकमव्यक्तं प्रधानं गुणलक्षणम् । अनादिमध्यनिधनं कारणं जगतः परम्
verses.transliteration: caturviṃśakamavyaktaṃ pradhānaṃ guṇalakṣaṇam / anādimadhyanidhanaṃ kāraṇaṃ jagataḥ param
verses.translation: vide V, 13 below.
verses.hindi: जलका घडा, पुष्प, गोबर, मिट्टी और कुश- इन्हें प्रयोजन भर ही लाना चाहिए। प्रतिदिन भिक्षा माँगनी चाहिए। कृत्रिम लवण और जो भी बासी वस्तु हो, उन सबका त्याग करना चाहिए। (ब्रह्मचारीको)
verses.wordMeaning: vide V, 13 below.
verses.commentary: Sense: vide V, 13 below.

verses.sanskrit: सत्त्वं रजस्तमश्चेति गुणत्रयमुदाहृतम् । साम्यावस्थितिमेतेषामव्यक्तं प्रकृतिं विदुः
verses.transliteration: sattvaṃ rajastamaśceti guṇatrayamudāhṛtam / sāmyāvasthitimeteṣāmavyaktaṃ prakṛtiṃ viduḥ
verses.translation: vide V, 13 below.
verses.hindi: नृत्य नहीं देखना चाहिए और गायन आदिसे निःस्पृह रहना चाहिए। सूर्यकी ओर (उदय-अस्तके समय तथा अपवित्र दशामें) नहीं देखना चाहिए एवं दन्तधावन नहीं करना चाहिए। एकान्तमें अपवित्र स्त्रियों, शूद्रों तथा अन्त्यजोसे सम्भाषण नहीं करना चाहिए॥ १८--२० ॥
verses.wordMeaning: vide V, 13 below.
verses.commentary: Sense: vide V, 13 below.

verses.sanskrit: सत्त्वं ज्ञानं तमो ऽज्ञानं रजो मिश्रमुदाहृतम् । गुणानां बुद्धिवैषम्याद् वैषम्यं कवयो विदुः
verses.transliteration: sattvaṃ jñānaṃ tamo 'jñānaṃ rajo miśramudāhṛtam / guṇānāṃ buddhivaiṣamyād vaiṣamyaṃ kavayo viduḥ
verses.translation: vide V, 13 below.
verses.hindi: गुरुसे बचा हुआ भोजन लोभवश नहीं करना चाहिए। कभी भी शरीरके मैलको दूर करते हुए रागवश खान नहीं करना चाहिए। (ब्रह्मचर्यव्रतका अङ्गभूत स्नान ही यथाविधि करना चाहिए)। विप्रको (द्विजको)
verses.wordMeaning: vide V, 13 below.
verses.commentary: Sense: vide V, 13 below.

verses.sanskrit: धर्माधर्माविति प्रोक्तौ पाशौ द्वौ बन्धसंज्ञितौ । मय्यर्पितानि कर्माणि निबन्धाय विमुक्तये
verses.transliteration: dharmādharmāviti proktau pāśau dvau bandhasaṃjñitau / mayyarpitāni karmāṇi nibandhāya vimuktaye
verses.translation: vide V, 13 below.
verses.hindi: गुरुका कभी मनसे भी त्याग करनेका विचार नहीं करना चाहिए। मोह या लोभसे इनका (गुरुका) त्याग करनेसे वह (द्विज) पतित हो जाता है मधुर हो, पर कालवश जलमें रखने आदिसे खट्टी हो गयी हो
verses.wordMeaning: vide V, 13 below.
verses.commentary: Sense: vide V, 13 below.

verses.sanskrit: अविद्यामस्मितां रागं द्वेषं चाभिनिवेशकम् । क्लेशाख्यानचलान् प्राहुः पाशानात्मनिबन्धनान्
verses.transliteration: avidyāmasmitāṃ rāgaṃ dveṣaṃ cābhiniveśakam / kleśākhyānacalān prāhuḥ pāśānātmanibandhanān
verses.translation: vide V, 13 below.
verses.hindi: गुरोरप्यवलिप्तस्य कार्याकार्यमजानतः। उत्पथप्रतिपन्नस्य मनुस्त्यागं समब्रवीत्
verses.wordMeaning: vide V, 13 below.
verses.commentary: Sense: vide V, 13 below.

verses.sanskrit: एतेषामेव पाशानां माया कारणमुच्यते । मूलप्रकृतिरव्यक्ता सा शक्तिर्मयि तिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: eteṣāmeva pāśānāṃ māyā kāraṇamucyate / mūlaprakṛtiravyaktā sā śaktirmayi tiṣṭhati
verses.translation: vide V, 13 below.
verses.hindi: विद्यागुरुष्वेतदेव नित्या वृत्तिः स्वयोनिषु। प्रतिषेधत्सु चाधर्माद्द्रितं चोपदिशत्स्वपि बालः समानजन्मा वा शिष्यो वा यज्ञकर्मणि । अध्यापयन् गुरुसुतो गुरुवन्मानमर्हति
verses.wordMeaning: vide V, 13 below.
verses.commentary: Sense: vide V, 13 below.

verses.sanskrit: स एव मूलप्रकृतिः प्रधानं पुरुषो ऽपि च । विकारा महदादीनि देवदेवः सनातनः
verses.transliteration: sa eva mūlaprakṛtiḥ pradhānaṃ puruṣo 'pi ca / vikārā mahadādīni devadevaḥ sanātanaḥ
verses.translation: vide V, 13 below.
verses.hindi: गुरुपत्या न कार्याणि केशानां च प्रसाधनम्
verses.wordMeaning: vide V, 13 below.
verses.commentary: Sense: vide V, 13 below.

verses.sanskrit: स एव बन्धः स च बन्धकर्ता स एव पाशः पशवः स एव । स वेद सर्वं न च तस्य वेत्ता तमाहुरग्र्यं पुरुषं पुराणम्
verses.transliteration: sa eva bandhaḥ sa ca bandhakartā sa eva pāśaḥ paśavaḥ sa eva / sa veda sarvaṃ na ca tasya vettā tamāhuragryaṃ puruṣaṃ purāṇam
verses.translation: vide V, 13 below.
verses.hindi: कुर्वीत वन्दनं भूम्यामसावहमिति ब्रुवन् जिससे लौकिक, वैदिक अथवा आध्यात्मिक
verses.wordMeaning: vide V, 13 below.
verses.commentary: Sense: vide V, 13 below.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे (ईश्वरगीतासु) सप्तमो ऽध्यायः ईश्वर उवाच अन्यद् गुह्यतमं ज्ञानं वक्ष्ये ब्राह्मणपुङ्गवाः । येनासौ तरते जन्तुर्घोरं संसारसागरम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge (īśvaragītāsu) saptamo 'dhyāyaḥ īśvara uvāca anyad guhyatamaṃ jñānaṃ vakṣye brāhmaṇapuṅgavāḥ / yenāsau tarate janturghoraṃ saṃsārasāgaram
verses.translation: vide V, 14 below.
verses.hindi: किसी भी प्रकारका ज्ञान प्राप्त करे, उससे कभी भी द्रोह न करे। महापातकयुक्त कार्य और अकार्यको न जाननेवाले तथा कुमार्गगामी गुरुका त्याग करना चाहिए-एऐसा मनुका कहना है
verses.wordMeaning: vide V, 14 below.
verses.commentary: Sense: vide V, 14 below.

verses.sanskrit: अहं ब्रह्ममयः शान्तः शाश्वतो निर्मलो ऽव्ययः । एकाकी भगवानुक्तः केवलः परमेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ brahmamayaḥ śāntaḥ śāśvato nirmalo 'vyayaḥ / ekākī bhagavānuktaḥ kevalaḥ parameśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Thence a golden Egg having the luster of a crore of suns was born; the great Brahma was born of it. He was invigorated through my Sakti.
verses.hindi: गुरुके गुरुका यदि संनिधान प्राप्त हो तो उनके प्रति गुरुके समान ही अभिवादन आदि व्यवहार करा चाहिए और (गुरुगृहमें रहते हुए शिष्यको) गुरुको अनुमतिके बिना अपने (माता-पितादि) गुरुजनोंका अभिवादन नहीं करना चाहिए। विद्या देनेवाले गुरुओं (उपाध्यायों), अपने जन्मके कारण-रूप (माता-पितादि), अधर्मसे रोकनेवालों और हितकारी धर्मतत्त्वका उपदेश देनेवालोंके प्रति नित्य इसी प्रकारका गुरुके समान
verses.wordMeaning: Thence a golden Egg having the luster of a crore of suns was born; the great Brahma was born of it. He was invigorated through my Sakti.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thence a golden Egg having the luster of a crore of suns was born; the great Brahma was born of it. He was invigorated through my Sakti.

verses.sanskrit: मम योनिर्महद् ब्रह्म तत्र गर्भं दधाम्यहम् । मूलं मायाभिधानं तु ततो जातमिदं जगत्
verses.transliteration: mama yonirmahad brahma tatra garbhaṃ dadhāmyaham / mūlaṃ māyābhidhānaṃ tu tato jātamidaṃ jagat
verses.translation: Innumerable other Jivas are all identical with him. Deluded by my Maya they do not perceive me their father.
verses.hindi: ही आचरण करना चाहिए। विद्या एवं तपमें अपनी अपेक्षा अधिक समृद्ध लोगोंके प्रति, अपनी अवस्थाको दृष्टिसे बडे, समानजातीय गुरुपल्री-पुत्रोंके प्रति और गुरुकी ज्ञाति (बन्धु-बान्धव) पितृव्य (चाचा) आदिके
verses.wordMeaning: Innumerable other Jivas are all identical with him. Deluded by my Maya they do not perceive me their father.
verses.commentary: Sense: Innumerable other Jivas are all identical with him. Deluded by my Maya they do not perceive me their father.

verses.sanskrit: प्रधानं पुरुषो ह्यत्मा महान् भूतादिरेव च । तन्मात्राणि महाभूतानीन्द्रियाणि च जज्ञिरे
verses.transliteration: pradhānaṃ puruṣo hyatmā mahān bhūtādireva ca / tanmātrāṇi mahābhūtānīndriyāṇi ca jajñire
verses.translation: The sages know that (Maya) is the supreme source (Mother) and I alone am the father of the various species in which all those forms (creatures) are born in this world.
verses.hindi: प्रति सदा गुरुके समान ही आदरपूर्ण व्यवहार करना चाहिए॥ २५ २७॥ अपनेसे छोटा गुरुका पुत्र अथवा समान अवस्थावाला तथा यज्ञकर्ममें (अपना) शिष्य होनेपर भी यदि वह अध्यापन करता हो तो गुरुके समान ही सम्मान प्राप्त करने योग्य है। किंतु गुरु-पुत्रके शरीरकी मालिश, उसे
verses.wordMeaning: The sages know that (Maya) is the supreme source (Mother) and I alone am the father of the various species in which all those forms (creatures) are born in this world.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sages know that (Maya) is the supreme source (Mother) and I alone am the father of the various species in which all those forms (creatures) are born in this world.

verses.sanskrit: ततो ऽण्डमभवद्धैमं सूर्यकोटिसमप्रभम् । तस्मिन् जज्ञे महाब्रह्मा मच्छक्त्या चोपबृंहितः
verses.transliteration: tato 'ṇḍamabhavaddhaimaṃ sūryakoṭisamaprabham / tasmin jajñe mahābrahmā macchaktyā copabṛṃhitaḥ
verses.translation: He who thus knows me as the sower of the seed, the lordly father, is a hero in all the worlds and he does not get deluded.
verses.hindi: स्त्रान कराना, उसका उच्छिष्ट भोजन तथा उसके पादका प्रक्षालन नहीं करना चाहिए। गुरुकी सवर्ण? स्त्रियाँ गुरुके समान ही पूज्य हैं, पर (गुरुकी) असवर्ण पत्तियोंकी केवल प्रत्युत्थान (उनके आनेपर खड़े हो जाना) एवं
verses.wordMeaning: He who thus knows me as the sower of the seed, the lordly father, is a hero in all the worlds and he does not get deluded.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who thus knows me as the sower of the seed, the lordly father, is a hero in all the worlds and he does not get deluded.

verses.sanskrit: ये चान्ये बहवो जीवा मन्मयाः सर्व एव ते । न मां पश्यन्ति पितरं मायया मम मोहिताः
verses.transliteration: ye cānye bahavo jīvā manmayāḥ sarva eva te / na māṃ paśyanti pitaraṃ māyayā mama mohitāḥ
verses.translation: I am the lord of all lores, the supreme controller of all creatures, the veritable Pranava (the sacred syllable OM) in¬ carnate, the master endowed with six divine powers, god Brahma, the lord protector of all beings.
verses.hindi: अभिवादनके द्वारा ही पूजा करनी चाहिए गुरुपत्रीके शरीरमें उबटन लगाना, उन्हें स्रान कराना, उनके शरीरकी मालिश और केशोंके सँवारनेका कार्य नहीं करना चाहिए। यदि गुरुपत्नी युवावस्थावाली हों तो उनके चरणोंको छूकर प्रणाम नहीं करना चाहिए।
verses.wordMeaning: I am the lord of all lores, the supreme controller of all creatures, the veritable Pranava (the sacred syllable OM) in¬ carnate, the master endowed with six divine powers, god Brahma, the lord protector of all beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: I am the lord of all lores, the supreme controller of all creatures, the veritable Pranava (the sacred syllable OM) in¬ carnate, the master endowed with six divine powers, god Brahma, the lord protector of all beings.

verses.sanskrit: याश्च योनिषु सर्वासु संभवन्ति हि मूर्तयः । तासां माया परा योनिर्मामेव पितरं विदुः
verses.transliteration: yāśca yoniṣu sarvāsu saṃbhavanti hi mūrtayaḥ / tāsāṃ māyā parā yonirmāmeva pitaraṃ viduḥ
verses.translation: He who perceives Paramesvara present equally in all living beings, but as imperishable when they perish, perceives factually.1
verses.hindi: “मैं अमुक हूँ” ऐसा कहते हुए उनके सम्मुख पृथ्वीपर प्रणाम करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: He who perceives Paramesvara present equally in all living beings, but as imperishable when they perish, perceives factually.1
verses.commentary: Sense: He who perceives Paramesvara present equally in all living beings, but as imperishable when they perish, perceives factually.1

verses.sanskrit: यो मामेवं विजानाति बीजिनं पितरं प्रभुम् । स धीरः सर्वलोकेषु न मोहमधिगच्छति
verses.transliteration: yo māmevaṃ vijānāti bījinaṃ pitaraṃ prabhum / sa dhīraḥ sarvalokeṣu na mohamadhigacchati
verses.translation: Inasmuch as he perceives the lord equally present everywhere, does not injure his real self (Atman by his (lower) self, he therefore attains the greatest goal.
verses.hindi: १-यहाँ त्यागका तात्पर्य इतना ही है कि ऐसे गुरुके संसर्गसे स्वयंमें दोष आ सकते हैं, अत: अपनी रक्षाकी दृष्टिसे ऐसे गुरुके संसर्गमें नहीं रहना चाहिए तथा ऐसे गुरुके प्रति उदासीनभाव अपना लेना चाहिए, द्वेषभाव कथमपि नहीं होना चाहिए। २-कलियुगसे भिन्न युगोंमें असवर्ण विवाह किया जा सकता है  इससे न पुण्य होता है न पाप। यह असवर्ण विवाह भी अपनेसे ऊँची जातिमें नहीं होता है।
verses.wordMeaning: Inasmuch as he perceives the lord equally present everywhere, does not injure his real self (Atman by his (lower) self, he therefore attains the greatest goal.
verses.commentary: Sense: Inasmuch as he perceives the lord equally present everywhere, does not injure his real self (Atman by his (lower) self, he therefore attains the greatest goal.

verses.sanskrit: ईशानः सर्वविद्यानां भूतानां परमेश्वरः । ओङ्कारमूर्तिर्भगवानहं ब्रह्मा प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: īśānaḥ sarvavidyānāṃ bhūtānāṃ parameśvaraḥ / oṅkāramūrtirbhagavānahaṃ brahmā prajāpatiḥ
verses.translation: He who, having realized the seven subtle principles® and the great God with his six limbs* (potencies), knows the role
verses.hindi: विप्रोष्य पादग्रहणमन्वहं चाभिवादनम्। गुरुदारेषु कुर्वीत सतां धर्ममनुस्मरन्
verses.wordMeaning: He who, having realized the seven subtle principles® and the great God with his six limbs* (potencies), knows the role
verses.commentary: Sense: He who, having realized the seven subtle principles® and the great God with his six limbs* (potencies), knows the role

verses.sanskrit: समं सर्वेषु भूतेषु तिष्ठन्तं परमेश्वरम् । विनश्यत्स्वविनश्यन्तं यः पश्यति स पश्यति
verses.transliteration: samaṃ sarveṣu bhūteṣu tiṣṭhantaṃ parameśvaram / vinaśyatsvavinaśyantaṃ yaḥ paśyati sa paśyati
verses.translation: Omniscience, joy of satiety, eternal knowledge, inde¬ pendence, ever-inexhaustible power and infinite strength— these are the six 'limbs' of the great God for realization.
verses.hindi: भ्रातुर्भार्योपसंग्राह्मा सवर्णाहन्यहन्यपि। विप्रोष्य तूपसंग्राह्मा ज्ञातिसम्बन्धियोषितः वेदमध्यापयेद् धर्म पुराणाङ्गानि नित्यशः
verses.wordMeaning: Omniscience, joy of satiety, eternal knowledge, inde¬ pendence, ever-inexhaustible power and infinite strength— these are the six 'limbs' of the great God for realization.
verses.commentary: Sense: Omniscience, joy of satiety, eternal knowledge, inde¬ pendence, ever-inexhaustible power and infinite strength— these are the six 'limbs' of the great God for realization.

verses.sanskrit: समं पश्यन् हि सर्वत्र समवस्थितमीश्वरम् । न हिनस्त्यात्मनात्मानं ततो याति पराङ्गतिम्
verses.transliteration: samaṃ paśyan hi sarvatra samavasthitamīśvaram / na hinastyātmanātmānaṃ tato yāti parāṅgatim
verses.translation: They (the knowers) call the following as seven subtle principles viz. the five subtle elements, mind and the soul. That which is the cause (of this creation) is the Primordial Matter (Prakrti). It is also called Pradhana, the bondage by moral discipline (a better v. 1. viniyoga- application).
verses.hindi: शक्तोऽन्नदोऽर्थी स्वःसाधुरध्याप्या दश धर्मतः
verses.wordMeaning: They (the knowers) call the following as seven subtle principles viz. the five subtle elements, mind and the soul. That which is the cause (of this creation) is the Primordial Matter (Prakrti). It is also called Pradhana, the bondage by moral discipline (a better v. 1.…
verses.commentary: Sense: They (the knowers) call the following as seven subtle principles viz. the five subtle elements, mind and the soul. That which is the cause (of this creation) is the Primordial Matter (Prakrti). It is also called Pradhana, the bondage by moral discipline (a better v. 1.…

verses.sanskrit: विदित्वा सप्त सूक्ष्माणि षडङ्गं च महेश्वरम् । प्रधानविनियोगज्ञः परं ब्रह्माधिगच्छति
verses.transliteration: viditvā sapta sūkṣmāṇi ṣaḍaṅgaṃ ca maheśvaram / pradhānaviniyogajñaḥ paraṃ brahmādhigacchati
verses.translation: There is a Sakti (power) latent in form in the Prakrti. It is mentioned in the Vedas as the cause (of the world) and the source of origin of Brahma. In front of her is her Purusa, Paramesthi, the great God, the very embodiment of the Reality.
verses.hindi: पर यदि शिष्य प्रवाससे आये तो शिष्टोंके आचारका स्मरण करते हुए युवती गुरुपल्रीका पादग्रहणपूर्वक ही अभिवादन करे। मौसी, मामी, सास और बुआ (फुआ)-ये गुरुकी पल्रीके समान पूज्य हैं। ये सभी गुरुपत्रीके समान ही हैँ। भाईकी सवर्ण स्त्री (भाभी)- को प्रतिदिन अवश्य प्रणाम करना चाहिए। ज्ञाति (पितापक्षके चाचा आदि), सम्बन्धी (मातापक्षके नाना आदि)-को पलियोंका तो प्रवाससे आनेपर अवश्य
verses.wordMeaning: There is a Sakti (power) latent in form in the Prakrti. It is mentioned in the Vedas as the cause (of the world) and the source of origin of Brahma. In front of her is her Purusa, Paramesthi, the great God, the very embodiment of the Reality.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is a Sakti (power) latent in form in the Prakrti. It is mentioned in the Vedas as the cause (of the world) and the source of origin of Brahma. In front of her is her Purusa, Paramesthi, the great God, the very embodiment of the Reality.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वज्ञता तृप्तिरनादिबोधः स्वतन्त्रता नित्यमलुप्तशक्तिः । अनन्तशक्तिश्च विभोर्विदित्वा षडाहुरङ्गानि महेश्वरस्य
verses.transliteration: sarvajñatā tṛptiranādibodhaḥ svatantratā nityamaluptaśaktiḥ / anantaśaktiśca vibhorviditvā ṣaḍāhuraṅgāni maheśvarasya
verses.translation: He alone is Brahma, the great Yogin, the supreme Atman, the huge one pervading the sky, the ancient one com¬ prehensible only through the Vedas. He alone is the only Rudra, the cause of annihilation, the unmanifest, the sole seed, the universe itself.
verses.hindi: अभिवादन करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: He alone is Brahma, the great Yogin, the supreme Atman, the huge one pervading the sky, the ancient one com¬ prehensible only through the Vedas. He alone is the only Rudra, the cause of annihilation, the unmanifest, the sole seed, the universe itself.
verses.commentary: Sense: He alone is Brahma, the great Yogin, the supreme Atman, the huge one pervading the sky, the ancient one com¬ prehensible only through the Vedas. He alone is the only Rudra, the cause of annihilation, the unmanifest, the sole seed, the universe itself.

verses.sanskrit: तन्मात्राणि मन आत्मा च तानि सूक्ष्माण्याहुः सप्त तत्त्वात्मकानि । या सा हेतुः प्रकृतिः सा प्रधानं बन्धः प्रोक्तो विनियोगो ऽपि तेन
verses.transliteration: tanmātrāṇi mana ātmā ca tāni sūkṣmāṇyāhuḥ sapta tattvātmakāni / yā sā hetuḥ prakṛtiḥ sā pradhānaṃ bandhaḥ prokto viniyogo 'pi tena
verses.translation: He alone is Brahma, the great Yogin, the supreme Atman, the huge one pervading the sky, the ancient one com¬ prehensible only through the Vedas. He alone is the only Rudra, the cause of annihilation, the unmanifest, the sole seed, the universe itself.
verses.hindi: माता-पिताकी बहिन तथा अपनी बड़ी बहिनके प्रति भी माताके समान व्यवहार करना चाहिए, किंतु माता इनसे श्रेष्ठ होती है। इस प्रकारके सदाचारसे सम्पन्न, आत्मवान् तथा दम्भरहित (ब्रह्मचारी)-को ही नित्य वेद, धर्मशास्त्र, पुराण और देदाङ्गोंको पढ़ाना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: He alone is Brahma, the great Yogin, the supreme Atman, the huge one pervading the sky, the ancient one com¬ prehensible only through the Vedas. He alone is the only Rudra, the cause of annihilation, the unmanifest, the sole seed, the universe itself.
verses.commentary: Sense: He alone is Brahma, the great Yogin, the supreme Atman, the huge one pervading the sky, the ancient one com¬ prehensible only through the Vedas. He alone is the only Rudra, the cause of annihilation, the unmanifest, the sole seed, the universe itself.

verses.sanskrit: या सा शक्तिः प्रकृतौ लीनरूपा वेदेषूक्ता कारणं ब्रह्मयोनिः । तस्या एकः परमेष्ठी परस्ता- न्महेश्वरः पुरुषः सत्यरूपः
verses.transliteration: yā sā śaktiḥ prakṛtau līnarūpā vedeṣūktā kāraṇaṃ brahmayoniḥ / tasyā ekaḥ parameṣṭhī parastā- nmaheśvaraḥ puruṣaḥ satyarūpaḥ
verses.translation: He alone is Brahma, the great Yogin, the supreme Atman, the huge one pervading the sky, the ancient one com¬ prehensible only through the Vedas. He alone is the only Rudra, the cause of annihilation, the unmanifest, the sole seed, the universe itself.
verses.hindi: एक वर्षसे यथाविधि गुरुकी सेवा करते हुए उनके समीप निवास करनेवाले शिष्यको यदि गुरु ज्ञानका उपदेश देना प्रारम्भ नहीं करते हैं तो शिष्यके दुष्कृत उनमें आ जाते हैं। आचार्यका पुत्र, सेवा-शुश्रूषा करनेवाला,
verses.wordMeaning: He alone is Brahma, the great Yogin, the supreme Atman, the huge one pervading the sky, the ancient one com¬ prehensible only through the Vedas. He alone is the only Rudra, the cause of annihilation, the unmanifest, the sole seed, the universe itself.
verses.commentary: Sense: He alone is Brahma, the great Yogin, the supreme Atman, the huge one pervading the sky, the ancient one com¬ prehensible only through the Vedas. He alone is the only Rudra, the cause of annihilation, the unmanifest, the sole seed, the universe itself.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मा योगी परमात्मा महीयान् व्योमव्यापी वेदवेद्यः पुराणः । एको रुद्रो मृत्युरव्यक्तमेकं बीजं विश्वं देव एकः स एव
verses.transliteration: brahmā yogī paramātmā mahīyān vyomavyāpī vedavedyaḥ purāṇaḥ / eko rudro mṛtyuravyaktamekaṃ bījaṃ viśvaṃ deva ekaḥ sa eva
verses.translation: He alone is Brahma, the great Yogin, the supreme Atman, the huge one pervading the sky, the ancient one com¬ prehensible only through the Vedas. He alone is the only Rudra, the cause of annihilation, the unmanifest, the sole seed, the universe itself.
verses.hindi: ज्ञान प्रदान करनेवाला (एक विद्या देकर दूसरी विद्या लेनेवाला), धार्मिक, पवित्र, शक्तिसम्पन्न (अध्ययनके सामर्थ्यसे युक्त), अन्नदाता (गुरुको अपेक्षाके अनुसार पर्याप्त अन्न देनेवाला), अर्थी (गुरुको सेवामें पर्या दस धर्मकी मर्यादासे अध्यापन कराने योग्य हैं। कृतज्ञ, अद्रोही, मेधासम्पन्न, कल्याण करनेवाला, विश्वस्त तथा प्रिय व्यक्ति-ये छः प्रकारके द्विजाति भी विधिपूर्वक पढ़ाने योग्य हैं। इन्हें ब्रह्मज्ञान, वेदज्ञान प्रदान करना
verses.wordMeaning: He alone is Brahma, the great Yogin, the supreme Atman, the huge one pervading the sky, the ancient one com¬ prehensible only through the Vedas. He alone is the only Rudra, the cause of annihilation, the unmanifest, the sole seed, the universe itself.
verses.commentary: Sense: He alone is Brahma, the great Yogin, the supreme Atman, the huge one pervading the sky, the ancient one com¬ prehensible only through the Vedas. He alone is the only Rudra, the cause of annihilation, the unmanifest, the sole seed, the universe itself.

verses.sanskrit: तमेवैकं प्राहुरन्ये ऽप्यनेकं त्वेकात्मानं केचिदन्यत्तथाहुः । अणोरणीयान् महतो ऽसौ महीयान् महादेवः प्रोच्यते वेदविद्भिः
verses.transliteration: tamevaikaṃ prāhuranye 'pyanekaṃ tvekātmānaṃ kecidanyattathāhuḥ / aṇoraṇīyān mahato 'sau mahīyān mahādevaḥ procyate vedavidbhiḥ
verses.translation: He alone is Brahma, the great Yogin, the supreme Atman, the huge one pervading the sky, the ancient one com¬ prehensible only through the Vedas. He alone is the only Rudra, the cause of annihilation, the unmanifest, the sole seed, the universe itself.
verses.hindi: चाहिए। इनसे अतिरिक्त जो जिज्ञासु हों उन्हें अन्य यथापेक्ष ज्ञान देना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: He alone is Brahma, the great Yogin, the supreme Atman, the huge one pervading the sky, the ancient one com¬ prehensible only through the Vedas. He alone is the only Rudra, the cause of annihilation, the unmanifest, the sole seed, the universe itself.
verses.commentary: Sense: He alone is Brahma, the great Yogin, the supreme Atman, the huge one pervading the sky, the ancient one com¬ prehensible only through the Vedas. He alone is the only Rudra, the cause of annihilation, the unmanifest, the sole seed, the universe itself.

verses.sanskrit: एवं हि यो वेद गुहाशयं परं प्रभुं पुराणं पुरुषं विश्वरूपम् । हिरण्मयं बुद्धिमतां परां गतिं स बुद्धिमान् बुद्धिमतीत्य तिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: evaṃ hi yo veda guhāśayaṃ paraṃ prabhuṃ purāṇaṃ puruṣaṃ viśvarūpam / hiraṇmayaṃ buddhimatāṃ parāṃ gatiṃ sa buddhimān buddhimatītya tiṣṭhati
verses.translation: He alone is Brahma, the great Yogin, the supreme Atman, the huge one pervading the sky, the ancient one com¬ prehensible only through the Vedas. He alone is the only Rudra, the cause of annihilation, the unmanifest, the sole seed, the universe itself.
verses.hindi: आचमन करके संयत होकर उत्तरकी ओर मुख करके गुरुके चरणोंमें प्रणामकर उनके मुखकी ओर देखते हुए नित्य अध्ययन करना चाहिए। (गुरुके द्वारा) 'पढ़ो' कहनेपर अध्ययन प्रारम्भ करे और ' विराम हो' ऐसा कहनेपर अध्ययन बंद कर दे
verses.wordMeaning: He alone is Brahma, the great Yogin, the supreme Atman, the huge one pervading the sky, the ancient one com¬ prehensible only through the Vedas. He alone is the only Rudra, the cause of annihilation, the unmanifest, the sole seed, the universe itself.
verses.commentary: Sense: He alone is Brahma, the great Yogin, the supreme Atman, the huge one pervading the sky, the ancient one com¬ prehensible only through the Vedas. He alone is the only Rudra, the cause of annihilation, the unmanifest, the sole seed, the universe itself.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपाराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे (ईश्वरगीतासु) अष्टमो ऽध्यायः ऋषय ऊचुः निष्कलो निर्मलो नित्यो निष्क्रियः परमेश्वरः । तन्नो वद महादेव विश्वरूपः कथं भवान्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapārāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge (īśvaragītāsu) aṣṭamo 'dhyāyaḥ ṛṣaya ūcuḥ niṣkalo nirmalo nityo niṣkriyaḥ parameśvaraḥ / tanno vada mahādeva viśvarūpaḥ kathaṃ bhavān
verses.translation: Some say he is one; Others say that he is many. Some say that you are the self. Some say that he is another. The great God (Mahadeva) is proclaimed as minuter than an atom and greater than the greatest and omniformed (with the universe as his form).
verses.hindi: प्राणायामैस्त्रिभिः पूतस्तत ओङ्कारमर्हति
verses.wordMeaning: Some say he is one; Others say that he is many. Some say that you are the self. Some say that he is another. The great God (Mahadeva) is proclaimed as minuter than an atom and greater than the greatest and omniformed (with the universe as his form).
verses.commentary: Sense: Some say he is one; Others say that he is many. Some say that you are the self. Some say that he is another. The great God (Mahadeva) is proclaimed as minuter than an atom and greater than the greatest and omniformed (with the universe as his form).

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वर उवाच नाहं विश्वो न विश्वं च मामृते विद्यते द्विजाः । मायानिमित्तमत्रास्ति सा चात्मानमपाश्रिता
verses.transliteration: īśvara uvāca nāhaṃ viśvo na viśvaṃ ca māmṛte vidyate dvijāḥ / māyānimittamatrāsti sā cātmānamapāśritā
verses.translation: The intelligent person who realizes that supreme Master, immanent in the cavity of the heart, that ancient Purusa, whose form is the manifested universe and is the highest goal of the wise and the intelligent, transcends the sphere of Buddhi (intelligence).
verses.hindi: कुर्यादध्ययनं नित्यं स ब्रह्माञ्जलिपूर्वतः योऽधीयीत ऋचो नित्यं क्षीराहुत्या स देवताः । प्रीणाति तर्पयन्त्येनं कामैस्तृ्ताः सहैव हि
verses.wordMeaning: The intelligent person who realizes that supreme Master, immanent in the cavity of the heart, that ancient Purusa, whose form is the manifested universe and is the highest goal of the wise and the intelligent, transcends the sphere of Buddhi (intelligence).
verses.commentary: Sense: The intelligent person who realizes that supreme Master, immanent in the cavity of the heart, that ancient Purusa, whose form is the manifested universe and is the highest goal of the wise and the intelligent, transcends the sphere of Buddhi (intelligence).

verses.sanskrit: अनादिनिधना शक्तिर्मायाव्यक्तसमाश्रया । तन्निमित्तः प्रपञ्चो ऽयमव्यक्तादभवत् खलु
