verses.transliteration: anādinidhanā śaktirmāyāvyaktasamāśrayā / tannimittaḥ prapañco 'yamavyaktādabhavat khalu
verses.translation: Taittiriya Up. II. 9.
verses.hindi: यजूंष्यधीते नियतं दध्ना प्रीणाति देवताः। सामान्यधीते प्रीणाति घृताहुतिभिरन्वहम्
verses.wordMeaning: Taittiriya Up. II. 9.
verses.commentary: Sense: Taittiriya Up. II. 9.

verses.sanskrit: अव्यक्तं कारणं प्राहुरानन्दं ज्योतिरक्षरम् । अहमेव परं ब्रह्म मत्तो ह्यन्यन्न विद्यते
verses.transliteration: avyaktaṃ kāraṇaṃ prāhurānandaṃ jyotirakṣaram / ahameva paraṃ brahma matto hyanyanna vidyate
verses.translation: Svetasvatara Up. III. 8 also, III. 21.
verses.hindi: अथर्वाङ्गिरसो नित्यं मध्वा प्रीणाति देवताः । धर्माङ्गानि पुराणानि मांसैस्तर्पयते सुरान् सहस्त्रपरमां देवीं शतमध्यां दशावराम्। गायत्रीं वै जपेन्नित्यं जपयज्ञः प्रकीर्तितः ४९ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Svetasvatara Up. III. 8 also, III. 21.
verses.commentary: Sense: Svetasvatara Up. III. 8 also, III. 21.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मान्मे विश्वरूपत्वं निश्चितं ब्रह्मवादिभिः । एकत्वे च पृथक्त्वे च प्रोक्तमेतन्निदर्शनम्
verses.transliteration: tasmānme viśvarūpatvaṃ niścitaṃ brahmavādibhiḥ / ekatve ca pṛthaktve ca proktametannidarśanam
verses.translation: Maya is a Sakti (a potency) which has neither begin¬ ning nor destruction. It is supported in the Avyakta (the unmani¬ fest). This world is caused by it and is indeed born of Avyakta.
verses.hindi: ओंकारमादितः कृत्वा व्याहतीस्तदनन्तरम्। ततोऽधीयीत सावित्रीमेकाग्रः श्रद्धयान्वितः
verses.wordMeaning: Maya is a Sakti (a potency) which has neither begin¬ ning nor destruction. It is supported in the Avyakta (the unmani¬ fest). This world is caused by it and is indeed born of Avyakta.
verses.commentary: Sense: Maya is a Sakti (a potency) which has neither begin¬ ning nor destruction. It is supported in the Avyakta (the unmani¬ fest). This world is caused by it and is indeed born of Avyakta.

verses.sanskrit: अहं तत् परमं ब्रह्म परमात्मा सनातनः । अकारणं द्विजाः प्रोक्तो न दोषो ह्यात्मनस्तथा
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ tat paramaṃ brahma paramātmā sanātanaḥ / akāraṇaṃ dvijāḥ prokto na doṣo hyātmanastathā
verses.translation: They (the sages) say that the unmanifest which is bliss luminous and imperishable is the cause. I am the Supreme Brahman and nothing else exists without me.
verses.hindi: पूर्व दिशाकी ओर अग्रभागवाले कुशोंके आसनपर बैठकर, दोनों हाथोंमें विद्यमान पवित्र कुशोंसे पावित (पवित्रीकृत) होकर तथा तीन प्राणायामोंद्वारा पवित्र होनेके अनन्तर ही (द्विज) अध्ययनके लिये ओंकारके उच्चारणका अधिकारी होता है। द्विजन्मा (ब्राह्मण, क्षत्रिय, वैश्य)-को (स्वाध्यायके) आरम्भ और अन्तम विधिपूर्वक प्रणवका उच्चारण करना चाहिंये। नित्य अञ्जलिबद्ध होकर ही अध्ययन (स्वाध्याय) करा
verses.wordMeaning: They (the sages) say that the unmanifest which is bliss luminous and imperishable is the cause. I am the Supreme Brahman and nothing else exists without me.
verses.commentary: Sense: They (the sages) say that the unmanifest which is bliss luminous and imperishable is the cause. I am the Supreme Brahman and nothing else exists without me.

verses.sanskrit: अनन्ता शक्तयो ऽव्यक्ते मायाद्याः संस्थिता ध्रुवाः । तस्मिन् दिवि स्थितं नित्यमव्यक्तं भाति केवलम्
verses.transliteration: anantā śaktayo 'vyakte māyādyāḥ saṃsthitā dhruvāḥ / tasmin divi sthitaṃ nityamavyaktaṃ bhāti kevalam
verses.translation: In my unity and diversity (or apparent identity and separateness from the universe) the expounders of the Vedas have decisively concluded my being universe-formed.
verses.hindi: चाहिए। सभी प्राणियोंके लिये वेद सनातन नेत्र-रूप हैं । (ब्राह्मणको) नित्य इनका अध्ययन करना चाहिए अन्यथा वह ब्राह्मणत्वसे च्युत हो जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: In my unity and diversity (or apparent identity and separateness from the universe) the expounders of the Vedas have decisively concluded my being universe-formed.
verses.commentary: Sense: In my unity and diversity (or apparent identity and separateness from the universe) the expounders of the Vedas have decisively concluded my being universe-formed.

verses.sanskrit: याभिस्तल्लक्ष्यते भिन्नमभिन्नं तु स्वभावतः । एकया मम सायुज्यमनादिनिधनं ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration: yābhistallakṣyate bhinnamabhinnaṃ tu svabhāvataḥ / ekayā mama sāyujyamanādinidhanaṃ dhruvam
verses.translation: I am that greatest Brahman, the eternal supreme Atman. O Brahmanas. As I am said to be the non-cause, no fault can be attributed to Atman.
verses.hindi: जो द्विज नित्य ऋग्वेदका अध्ययन करता है और उसकी कामनाएँ पूर्णकर सहैव तृप्त करते हैं। (ऐसे ही) जो द्विज नियमपूर्वक याजुष मन्त्रॉका अध्ययन करता है और दधि (-की आहुतियों)-से देवताओंको प्रसन्न करता है, उसकी भी सभी कामनाएँ पूर्ण होती
verses.wordMeaning: I am that greatest Brahman, the eternal supreme Atman. O Brahmanas. As I am said to be the non-cause, no fault can be attributed to Atman.
verses.commentary: Sense: I am that greatest Brahman, the eternal supreme Atman. O Brahmanas. As I am said to be the non-cause, no fault can be attributed to Atman.

verses.sanskrit: पुंसो ऽभूदन्यया भूतिरन्यया तत्तिरोहितम् । अनादिमध्यं तिष्ठन्तं युज्यते ऽविद्यया किल
verses.transliteration: puṃso 'bhūdanyayā bhūtiranyayā tattirohitam / anādimadhyaṃ tiṣṭhantaṃ yujyate 'vidyayā kila
verses.translation: The divine powers are infinite, unmanifest, permanent and established by Maya. The absolute Avyakta (unmanifest) which is abiding in the heavenly region (beyond the reach of this world) shines eternally.
verses.hindi: हैं। इसी प्रकार जो द्विज साममन्त्रोंका अध्ययन करता और प्रतिदिन घृतकी आहुतियोंसे देवोंको प्रसन्न करता है तो उसकी भी कामनाएँ पूर्ण होती हैं। अथर्ववेदका भी अध्ययन करनेवाला (द्विज) मधु (-की आहुतियों)-
verses.wordMeaning: The divine powers are infinite, unmanifest, permanent and established by Maya. The absolute Avyakta (unmanifest) which is abiding in the heavenly region (beyond the reach of this world) shines eternally.
verses.commentary: Sense: The divine powers are infinite, unmanifest, permanent and established by Maya. The absolute Avyakta (unmanifest) which is abiding in the heavenly region (beyond the reach of this world) shines eternally.

verses.sanskrit: तदेतत् परमं व्यक्तं प्रभामण्डलमण्डितम् । तदक्षरं परं ज्योतिस्तद् विष्णोः परमं पदम्
verses.transliteration: tadetat paramaṃ vyaktaṃ prabhāmaṇḍalamaṇḍitam / tadakṣaraṃ paraṃ jyotistad viṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam
verses.translation: The unmanifest eternal Brahman which is without any beginning or end and which is permanent is united with Maya and thereby is called diverse and divided though it is an undivided whole.
verses.hindi: द्वारा देवताओंको प्रसन्नकर अभिलषित प्राप्त करता है। धर्मशास्त्र, वेदाङ्गों तथा पुराणोंका अध्ययन करनेवाले यथोपलब्ध पदार्थासे देवताओंको संतृ्तकर इष्ट प्राप्त करते हैं ॥ ४५--४७॥ नित्यकर्मकी विधिका आश्रय लेकर वनमें जाकर सावधानीपूर्वक जलके समीप नियमितरूपसे गायत्री (-मन्त्र)-का जप भी करे। गायत्रीदेवी (मन्त्र)-का हजार बार जप करना श्रेष्ठ, सौ बारका जप मध्यम तथा दस
verses.wordMeaning: The unmanifest eternal Brahman which is without any beginning or end and which is permanent is united with Maya and thereby is called diverse and divided though it is an undivided whole.
verses.commentary: Sense: The unmanifest eternal Brahman which is without any beginning or end and which is permanent is united with Maya and thereby is called diverse and divided though it is an undivided whole.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र सर्वमिदं प्रोतमोतं चैवाखिलं जगत् । तदेव च जगत् कृत्स्नं तद् विज्ञाय विमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: tatra sarvamidaṃ protamotaṃ caivākhilaṃ jagat / tadeva ca jagat kṛtsnaṃ tad vijñāya vimucyate
verses.translation: Just as the manifestation of the Purusa's one power is not concealed or obscured by another, he functions through the power of knowledge without beginning, middle and the end.
verses.hindi: बार जप करना निम्न कोटिका है। गायत्रीका नित्य जप करना चाहिए। इसे जपयज्ञ कहा गया है । ईश्वरने गायत्री और वेदोंको तुलामें तौला। तुलामें एक ओर चारों वेदोंको और एक ओर गायत्रीको रखा (समग्र वेदोंका
verses.wordMeaning: Just as the manifestation of the Purusa's one power is not concealed or obscured by another, he functions through the power of knowledge without beginning, middle and the end.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as the manifestation of the Purusa's one power is not concealed or obscured by another, he functions through the power of knowledge without beginning, middle and the end.

verses.sanskrit: यतो वाचो निवर्तन्ते अप्राप्य मनसा सह । आनन्दं ब्रह्मणो विद्वान् विभेति न कुतश्चन
verses.transliteration: yato vāco nivartante aprāpya manasā saha / ānandaṃ brahmaṇo vidvān vibheti na kutaścana
verses.translation: That is the supreme unmanifest, embellished with a halo of lustre. That is the imperishable light. That is the supreme abode ofVisnu.
verses.hindi: सार गायत्री-मन्त्र वेदोंके समान ही रहा) आदिमें ओंकार लगाकर तदनन्तर (भूर्भुवः स्वः) महाव्याहतियोंके साथ गायत्री (-मन्त्र)-का श्रद्धापूर्वक एकाग्रमनसे जप करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: That is the supreme unmanifest, embellished with a halo of lustre. That is the imperishable light. That is the supreme abode ofVisnu.
verses.commentary: Sense: That is the supreme unmanifest, embellished with a halo of lustre. That is the imperishable light. That is the supreme abode ofVisnu.

verses.sanskrit: वेदाहमेतं पुरुषं महान्त- मादित्यवर्णं तमसः परस्तात् । तद् विज्ञाय परिमुच्येत विद्वान् नित्यानन्दी भवति ब्रह्मभूतः
verses.transliteration: vedāhametaṃ puruṣaṃ mahānta- mādityavarṇaṃ tamasaḥ parastāt / tad vijñāya parimucyeta vidvān nityānandī bhavati brahmabhūtaḥ
verses.translation: Therein the entire universe is woven as if i n the warp and woof of cloth. That alone is the entire universe. Having realised this, one is liberated.
verses.hindi: प्रधानं पुरुषः कालो विष्णुर्त्रह्मा महेश्वरः ।
verses.wordMeaning: Therein the entire universe is woven as if i n the warp and woof of cloth. That alone is the entire universe. Having realised this, one is liberated.
verses.commentary: Sense: Therein the entire universe is woven as if i n the warp and woof of cloth. That alone is the entire universe. Having realised this, one is liberated.

verses.sanskrit: यस्मात् परं नापरमस्ति किञ्चित् यज्ज्योतिषां ज्योतिरेकं दिविस्थम् । तदेवात्मानं मन्यमानो ऽथ विद्वान् आत्मानन्दी भवति ब्रह्मभूतः
verses.transliteration: yasmāt paraṃ nāparamasti kiñcit yajjyotiṣāṃ jyotirekaṃ divistham / tadevātmānaṃ manyamāno 'tha vidvān ātmānandī bhavati brahmabhūtaḥ
verses.translation: Brahman is that entity from which words along with mind recede due to their inability to reach it. He who has realized the joy of the Brahman entertains no fear from any¬ where at any time.
verses.hindi: ओंकारस्तत् परं ब्रह्म सावित्री स्यात् तदक्षरम्। एष मन्त्रो महायोगः सारात् सार उदाहतः योऽधीतेऽहन्यहन्येतां गायत्रीं वेदमातरम्।
verses.wordMeaning: Brahman is that entity from which words along with mind recede due to their inability to reach it. He who has realized the joy of the Brahman entertains no fear from any¬ where at any time.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahman is that entity from which words along with mind recede due to their inability to reach it. He who has realized the joy of the Brahman entertains no fear from any¬ where at any time.

verses.sanskrit: तदव्ययं कलिलं गूढदेहं ब्रह्मानन्दममृतं विश्वधाम । वदन्त्येवं ब्राह्मणा ब्रह्मनिष्ठा यत्र गत्वा न निवर्तेत भूयः
verses.transliteration: tadavyayaṃ kalilaṃ gūḍhadehaṃ brahmānandamamṛtaṃ viśvadhāma / vadantyevaṃ brāhmaṇā brahmaniṣṭhā yatra gatvā na nivarteta bhūyaḥ
verses.translation: I know this supreme Purusa with the refulgence of the sun in front of me (v.l. beyond the darkness of ignorance). Having realized him as such, the knower is liberated (from Saihsara). Becoming identical with the Brahman, he enjoys perpetual bliss.
verses.hindi: विज्ञायार्थ ब्रह्मचारी स याति परमां गतिम्
verses.wordMeaning: I know this supreme Purusa with the refulgence of the sun in front of me (v.l. beyond the darkness of ignorance). Having realized him as such, the knower is liberated (from Saihsara). Becoming identical with the Brahman, he enjoys perpetual bliss.
verses.commentary: Sense: I know this supreme Purusa with the refulgence of the sun in front of me (v.l. beyond the darkness of ignorance). Having realized him as such, the knower is liberated (from Saihsara). Becoming identical with the Brahman, he enjoys perpetual bliss.

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्मये परमाकाशतत्त्वे यदर्चिषि प्रविभातीव तेजः । तद्विज्ञाने परिपश्यन्ति धीरा विभ्राजमानं विमलं व्योम धाम
verses.transliteration: hiraṇmaye paramākāśatattve yadarciṣi pravibhātīva tejaḥ / tadvijñāne paripaśyanti dhīrā vibhrājamānaṃ vimalaṃ vyoma dhāma
verses.translation: I know this supreme Purusa with the refulgence of the sun in front of me (v.l. beyond the darkness of ignorance). Having realized him as such, the knower is liberated (from Saihsara). Becoming identical with the Brahman, he enjoys perpetual bliss.
verses.hindi: गायत्री वेदजननी गायत्री लोकपावनी। न गायत्र्याः परं जप्यमेतद् विज्ञाय मुच्यते आषाढ्यां प्रोष्ठपद्यां वा वेदोपाकरणं स्मृतम्
verses.wordMeaning: I know this supreme Purusa with the refulgence of the sun in front of me (v.l. beyond the darkness of ignorance). Having realized him as such, the knower is liberated (from Saihsara). Becoming identical with the Brahman, he enjoys perpetual bliss.
verses.commentary: Sense: I know this supreme Purusa with the refulgence of the sun in front of me (v.l. beyond the darkness of ignorance). Having realized him as such, the knower is liberated (from Saihsara). Becoming identical with the Brahman, he enjoys perpetual bliss.

verses.sanskrit: ततः परं परिपश्यन्ति धीरा आत्मन्यात्मानमनुभूयानुभूय । स्वयंप्रभः परमेष्ठी महीयान् ब्रह्मानन्दी भगवानीश एषः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ paraṃ paripaśyanti dhīrā ātmanyātmānamanubhūyānubhūya / svayaṃprabhaḥ parameṣṭhī mahīyān brahmānandī bhagavānīśa eṣaḥ
verses.translation: I know this supreme Purusa with the refulgence of the sun in front of me (v.l. beyond the darkness of ignorance). Having realized him as such, the knower is liberated (from Saihsara). Becoming identical with the Brahman, he enjoys perpetual bliss.
verses.hindi: अधीयीत शुचौ देशे ब्रह्मचारी समाहितः
verses.wordMeaning: I know this supreme Purusa with the refulgence of the sun in front of me (v.l. beyond the darkness of ignorance). Having realized him as such, the knower is liberated (from Saihsara). Becoming identical with the Brahman, he enjoys perpetual bliss.
verses.commentary: Sense: I know this supreme Purusa with the refulgence of the sun in front of me (v.l. beyond the darkness of ignorance). Having realized him as such, the knower is liberated (from Saihsara). Becoming identical with the Brahman, he enjoys perpetual bliss.

verses.sanskrit: एको देवः सर्वभूतेषु गूढः सर्वव्यापी सर्वभूतान्तरात्मा । तमेवैकं ये ऽनुपश्यन्ति धीरास् तेषां शान्तिः शाश्वती नेतरेषाम्
verses.transliteration: eko devaḥ sarvabhūteṣu gūḍhaḥ sarvavyāpī sarvabhūtāntarātmā / tamevaikaṃ ye 'nupaśyanti dhīrās teṣāṃ śāntiḥ śāśvatī netareṣām
verses.translation: I know this supreme Purusa with the refulgence of the sun in front of me (v.l. beyond the darkness of ignorance). Having realized him as such, the knower is liberated (from Saihsara). Becoming identical with the Brahman, he enjoys perpetual bliss.
verses.hindi: माघशुक्लस्य वा प्रासे पूर्वाल्ले प्रथमेऽहनि कर्णश्रवेऽनिले रात्रौ दिवा पांशुसमूहने। विद्युत्स्तनितवर्षघु महोल्कानां च सम्प्लवे । आकालिकमनध्यायमेतेष्वाह प्रजापतिः
verses.wordMeaning: I know this supreme Purusa with the refulgence of the sun in front of me (v.l. beyond the darkness of ignorance). Having realized him as such, the knower is liberated (from Saihsara). Becoming identical with the Brahman, he enjoys perpetual bliss.
verses.commentary: Sense: I know this supreme Purusa with the refulgence of the sun in front of me (v.l. beyond the darkness of ignorance). Having realized him as such, the knower is liberated (from Saihsara). Becoming identical with the Brahman, he enjoys perpetual bliss.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वाननशिरोग्रीवः सर्वभूतगुहाशयः । सर्वव्यापी च भगवान् न तस्मादन्यदिष्यते
verses.transliteration: sarvānanaśirogrīvaḥ sarvabhūtaguhāśayaḥ / sarvavyāpī ca bhagavān na tasmādanyadiṣyate
verses.translation: I know this supreme Purusa with the refulgence of the sun in front of me (v.l. beyond the darkness of ignorance). Having realized him as such, the knower is liberated (from Saihsara). Becoming identical with the Brahman, he enjoys perpetual bliss.
verses.hindi: प्राचीन कल्पमें सभी प्रकारके अमङ्गलोको दूर करनेवाली “भू:' 'भुवः' तथा 'स्व:' ये तीन सनातन
verses.wordMeaning: I know this supreme Purusa with the refulgence of the sun in front of me (v.l. beyond the darkness of ignorance). Having realized him as such, the knower is liberated (from Saihsara). Becoming identical with the Brahman, he enjoys perpetual bliss.
verses.commentary: Sense: I know this supreme Purusa with the refulgence of the sun in front of me (v.l. beyond the darkness of ignorance). Having realized him as such, the knower is liberated (from Saihsara). Becoming identical with the Brahman, he enjoys perpetual bliss.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येतदैश्वरं ज्ञानमुक्तं वो मुनिपुङ्गवाः । गोपनीयं विशेषेण योगिनामपि दुर्लभम्
verses.transliteration: ityetadaiśvaraṃ jñānamuktaṃ vo munipuṅgavāḥ / gopanīyaṃ viśeṣeṇa yogināmapi durlabham
verses.translation: I know this supreme Purusa with the refulgence of the sun in front of me (v.l. beyond the darkness of ignorance). Having realized him as such, the knower is liberated (from Saihsara). Becoming identical with the Brahman, he enjoys perpetual bliss.
verses.hindi: प्रधान, पुरुष तथा काल और विष्णु, ब्रह्मा, महेश्वर एवं सत्त्व, रज तथा तमोगुणरूप कही गयी हैं। ओंकार परम ब्रह्मस्वरूप और सावित्री अविनश्वर परम तत्त्वरूप है। इस मन्त्रको महायोग और सारोंका भी सार-रूप कहा गया है। जो ब्रह्मचारी (गायत्री-मन्त्रके) अर्थको जानते हुए प्रत्येक दिन इन वेदमाता गायत्रीका अध्ययन करता है (जप करता है), उसे परमगति प्राप्त होती है। गायत्री वेदोंकी माता और लोकको पवित्र करनेवाली
verses.wordMeaning: I know this supreme Purusa with the refulgence of the sun in front of me (v.l. beyond the darkness of ignorance). Having realized him as such, the knower is liberated (from Saihsara). Becoming identical with the Brahman, he enjoys perpetual bliss.
verses.commentary: Sense: I know this supreme Purusa with the refulgence of the sun in front of me (v.l. beyond the darkness of ignorance). Having realized him as such, the knower is liberated (from Saihsara). Becoming identical with the Brahman, he enjoys perpetual bliss.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपाराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे (ईश्वरगीतासु) नवमो ऽध्यायः ईश्वर उवाच अलिङ्गमेकमव्यक्तं लिङ्गं ब्रह्मेति निश्चितम् । स्वयञ्ज्योतिः परं तत्त्वं परे व्योम्नि व्यवस्थितम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapārāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge (īśvaragītāsu) navamo 'dhyāyaḥ īśvara uvāca aliṅgamekamavyaktaṃ liṅgaṃ brahmeti niścitam / svayañjyotiḥ paraṃ tattvaṃ pare vyomni vyavasthitam
verses.translation: Realizing that is his self from which there is nothing that is greater, and that is the supreme light of the luminaries stationed in the heaven, the knower becomes identical with the Brahman and attains perpetual bliss.
verses.hindi: है। गायत्रीसे श्रेष्ठ कोई दूसरा मन्त्र जपने योग्य नहीं है। इसके ज्ञानसे मुक्ति मिल जाती है
verses.wordMeaning: Realizing that is his self from which there is nothing that is greater, and that is the supreme light of the luminaries stationed in the heaven, the knower becomes identical with the Brahman and attains perpetual bliss.
verses.commentary: Sense: Realizing that is his self from which there is nothing that is greater, and that is the supreme light of the luminaries stationed in the heaven, the knower becomes identical with the Brahman and attains perpetual bliss.

verses.sanskrit: अव्यक्तं कारणं यत्तदक्षरं परमं पदम् । निर्गुणं शुद्धविज्ञानं तद् वै पश्यन्ति सूरयः
verses.transliteration: avyaktaṃ kāraṇaṃ yattadakṣaraṃ paramaṃ padam / nirguṇaṃ śuddhavijñānaṃ tad vai paśyanti sūrayaḥ
verses.translation: Knowers of the Brahman (or Brahmanas) who are established in the Brahman, proclaim that I am however impenetrable, subtle-bodied, joy of the Brahman and the immor¬ tal abode of the universe, and after attaining whom one never reverts to Saihsara.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ द्विजो! श्रावण, आषाढ़ अथवा भाद्रपद मासकी पौर्णमासीको (अपने-अपने गृह्यासूत्रानुसार) वेदोंका उपाकर्म (संस्कारपूर्वक वेदग्रहण) करना बतलाया गया है। ग्राम और नगरको छोड़कर ब्रह्मचारी ब्राह्मण (द्विजमात्र)-को एकाग्रचित्तसे पवित्र स्थानमें साढे पाँच महीनेतक (वेदोंका) अध्ययन करना चाहिए। द्विजको चाहिए कि वह (पौष मासके) पुष्य नक्षत्रमें अथवा माघ मासके प्रथम दिन पूर्वाह्में (ग्रामके) बाहर वेदोंका
verses.wordMeaning: Knowers of the Brahman (or Brahmanas) who are established in the Brahman, proclaim that I am however impenetrable, subtle-bodied, joy of the Brahman and the immor¬ tal abode of the universe, and after attaining whom one never reverts to Saihsara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Knowers of the Brahman (or Brahmanas) who are established in the Brahman, proclaim that I am however impenetrable, subtle-bodied, joy of the Brahman and the immor¬ tal abode of the universe, and after attaining whom one never reverts to Saihsara.

verses.sanskrit: तन्निष्ठाः शान्तसंकल्पा नित्यं तद्भावभाविताः । पश्यन्ति तत् परं ब्रह्म यत्तल्लिङ्गमिति श्रुतिः
verses.transliteration: tanniṣṭhāḥ śāntasaṃkalpā nityaṃ tadbhāvabhāvitāḥ / paśyanti tat paraṃ brahma yattalliṅgamiti śrutiḥ
verses.translation: The lustre that appears to shine in heaven is the principle of the highest firmament of golden colour. The sages visualize it in their own supreme knowledge as the resplen¬ dent, pure (spotless) abode of heaven.
verses.hindi: उत्सर्जन (उत्सर्ग नामका संस्कारविशेष) करे। इसके बाद द्विजको शुक्लपक्षमें वेदोंका और कृष्णपक्षमें वेदाङ्गों, पुराण तथा मानवधर्मशास्त्र (मनुस्मृति आदि)- का अभ्यास करना चाहिए॥ ५७--६० ॥
verses.wordMeaning: The lustre that appears to shine in heaven is the principle of the highest firmament of golden colour. The sages visualize it in their own supreme knowledge as the resplen¬ dent, pure (spotless) abode of heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lustre that appears to shine in heaven is the principle of the highest firmament of golden colour. The sages visualize it in their own supreme knowledge as the resplen¬ dent, pure (spotless) abode of heaven.

verses.sanskrit: अन्यथा नहि मां द्रष्टुं शक्यं वै मुनिपुङ्गवाः । नहि तद् विद्यते ज्ञानं यतस्तज्ज्ञायते परम्
verses.transliteration: anyathā nahi māṃ draṣṭuṃ śakyaṃ vai munipuṅgavāḥ / nahi tad vidyate jñānaṃ yatastajjñāyate param
verses.translation: Thereafter, the bold (self-possessed) men observe it, after experiencing the (cosmic) Atman directly in their individual Atman. Paramesthin, the lord himself, is the greatest one. The Lord has the bliss of Brahman.
verses.hindi: अध्ययन करनेवालेको इन (अग्रनिर्दिष्ट) अनध्यायोंमें अध्ययनका सदा परित्याग करना चाहिए। इसी प्रकार अध्यापन और अभ्यास करते हुए भी प्रयत्रपूर्वक अनध्यायोंमें अध्ययनका त्याग करना चाहिए। प्रजापति (ब्रह्मा)-ने कहा है कि रात्रिमें कानोंसे सुने जाने योग्य वायुके बहते रहनेपर, दिनमें धूलके समूहको उड़ा लेनेमें समर्थ वायुके बहते रहनेपर, विद्युतको चमक एवं (मेघ) गर्जनके साथ वर्षा होनेपर और बड़ी-
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, the bold (self-possessed) men observe it, after experiencing the (cosmic) Atman directly in their individual Atman. Paramesthin, the lord himself, is the greatest one. The Lord has the bliss of Brahman.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, the bold (self-possessed) men observe it, after experiencing the (cosmic) Atman directly in their individual Atman. Paramesthin, the lord himself, is the greatest one. The Lord has the bliss of Brahman.

verses.sanskrit: एतत्तत्परमं ज्ञानं केवलं कवयो विदुः । अज्ञानमितरत् सर्वं यस्मान्मायामयं जगत्
verses.transliteration: etattatparamaṃ jñānaṃ kevalaṃ kavayo viduḥ / ajñānamitarat sarvaṃ yasmānmāyāmayaṃ jagat
verses.translation: That one Lord is lying hidden in all living beings. He is omnipresent, the immanent soul of all living beings. The self-possessed men who see him as one (without a second) enjoy permanent bliss and not the others.
verses.hindi: बड़ी उल्काओंके इधर-उधर गिरते रहनेपर आकालिक (जबसे ये निमित्त आरम्भ हों तबसे अग्रिम दिन सूर्योदयपर्यन्त) अनध्याय होता है
verses.wordMeaning: That one Lord is lying hidden in all living beings. He is omnipresent, the immanent soul of all living beings. The self-possessed men who see him as one (without a second) enjoy permanent bliss and not the others.
verses.commentary: Sense: That one Lord is lying hidden in all living beings. He is omnipresent, the immanent soul of all living beings. The self-possessed men who see him as one (without a second) enjoy permanent bliss and not the others.

verses.sanskrit: यज्ज्ञानं निर्मलं सूक्ष्मं निर्विकल्पं यदव्ययम् । ममात्मासौ तदेवेमिति प्राहुर्विपश्चितः
verses.transliteration: yajjñānaṃ nirmalaṃ sūkṣmaṃ nirvikalpaṃ yadavyayam / mamātmāsau tadevemiti prāhurvipaścitaḥ
verses.translation: He has heads and necks on all sides. He is the ultimate goal of all. He abides in the cavity of the heart of all
verses.hindi: एतानाकालिकान् विद्यादनध्यायानृतावपि धर्मनेपुण्यकामानां पूतिगन्धे च नित्यशः
verses.wordMeaning: He has heads and necks on all sides. He is the ultimate goal of all. He abides in the cavity of the heart of all
verses.commentary: Sense: He has heads and necks on all sides. He is the ultimate goal of all. He abides in the cavity of the heart of all

verses.sanskrit: ये ऽप्यनेकं प्रपश्यन्ति ते ऽपि पश्यन्ति तत्परम् । आश्रिताः परमां निष्ठां बुद्ध्वैकं तत्त्वमव्ययम्
verses.transliteration: ye 'pyanekaṃ prapaśyanti te 'pi paśyanti tatparam / āśritāḥ paramāṃ niṣṭhāṃ buddhvaikaṃ tattvamavyayam
verses.translation: O leading sages, thus the knowledge pertaining to Isvara has been related to you. It should be particularly guarded, as it is very difficult even for Yogis to attain.
verses.hindi: उदके मध्यरात्रे च विण्मूत्रे च विसर्जने। उच्छिष्टः श्राद्धभुक् चेव मनसापि न चिन्तयेत्
verses.wordMeaning: O leading sages, thus the knowledge pertaining to Isvara has been related to you. It should be particularly guarded, as it is very difficult even for Yogis to attain.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading sages, thus the knowledge pertaining to Isvara has been related to you. It should be particularly guarded, as it is very difficult even for Yogis to attain.

verses.sanskrit: ये पुनः परमं तत्त्वमेकं वानेकमीश्वरम् । भक्त्या मां संप्रपश्यन्ति विज्ञेयास्ते तदात्मकाः
verses.transliteration: ye punaḥ paramaṃ tattvamekaṃ vānekamīśvaram / bhaktyā māṃ saṃprapaśyanti vijñeyāste tadātmakāḥ
verses.translation: This is a synthesis of Sahkhya, Bauddha and Vedantic concept of Liberation.
verses.hindi: प्रतिगृह्य द्विजो विद्वानेकोदिष्टस्य केतनम्। त्र्यहं न कीर्तयेद् ब्रह्म राज्ञो राहोश्च सूतके यावदेकोऽनुदिष्टस्य स्नेहो गन्धश्च तिष्ठति। विप्रस्य विदुषो देहे तावद् ब्रह्म न कीर्तयेत्
verses.wordMeaning: This is a synthesis of Sahkhya, Bauddha and Vedantic concept of Liberation.
verses.commentary: Sense: This is a synthesis of Sahkhya, Bauddha and Vedantic concept of Liberation.

verses.sanskrit: साक्षादेव प्रपश्यन्ति स्वात्मानं परमेश्वरम् । नित्यानन्दं निर्विकल्पं सत्यरूपमिति स्थितिः
verses.transliteration: sākṣādeva prapaśyanti svātmānaṃ parameśvaram / nityānandaṃ nirvikalpaṃ satyarūpamiti sthitiḥ
verses.translation: The unmanifest which is the cause (of the phenomenal world) is the imperishable supreme region. Learned men perceive it as devoid of Gunas and perfect knowledge.
verses.hindi: शयानः प्रौढपादश्च कृत्वा चेवावसक्थिकाम्। नाधीयीतामिषं जग्ध्वा सूतकान्नाद्यमेव च
verses.wordMeaning: The unmanifest which is the cause (of the phenomenal world) is the imperishable supreme region. Learned men perceive it as devoid of Gunas and perfect knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: The unmanifest which is the cause (of the phenomenal world) is the imperishable supreme region. Learned men perceive it as devoid of Gunas and perfect knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: भजन्ते परमानन्दं सर्वगं यत्तदात्मकम् । स्वात्मन्यवस्थिताः शान्ताः परे ऽव्यक्ते परस्य तु
verses.transliteration: bhajante paramānandaṃ sarvagaṃ yattadātmakam / svātmanyavasthitāḥ śāntāḥ pare 'vyakte parasya tu
verses.translation: The Vedas declare that to be the Lifiga viz. the supreme Brahman which is perceived by the sages whose concept of egotism (and other doubts) is resolved (destroyed) and who are perpetually merged in its meditation.
verses.hindi: उपाकर्मणि चोत्सर्गे त्रिरात्रं क्षपणं स्मृतम्। अष्टकासु त्वहोरात्रं ऋत्वन्त्यासु च रात्रिषु अग्निहोत्रके लिये प्रज्वलित अग्रिकी अवस्था (प्रात:- सायं-संध्याकाल) -में जब ये सभी (उत्पात) एक साथ प्रकट हों और बिना ऋतुके मेघ दिखलायी पडे तो अनध्याय समझना चाहिए । वज्रपात, भूकम्प, सूर्य-चन्द्रका
verses.wordMeaning: The Vedas declare that to be the Lifiga viz. the supreme Brahman which is perceived by the sages whose concept of egotism (and other doubts) is resolved (destroyed) and who are perpetually merged in its meditation.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Vedas declare that to be the Lifiga viz. the supreme Brahman which is perceived by the sages whose concept of egotism (and other doubts) is resolved (destroyed) and who are perpetually merged in its meditation.

verses.sanskrit: एषा विमुक्तिः परमा मम सायुज्यमुत्तमम् । निर्वाणं ब्रह्मणा चैक्यं कैवल्यं कवयो विदुः
verses.transliteration: eṣā vimuktiḥ paramā mama sāyujyamuttamam / nirvāṇaṃ brahmaṇā caikyaṃ kaivalyaṃ kavayo viduḥ
verses.translation: O leading sages, it is not possible to see me otherwise* There is no knowledge whereby that great Atman is realized.
verses.hindi: ग्रहण एवं अन्य ताराओंके उपसर्ग (टूरना आदि) होनेपर, ऋतु होनेपर भी आकालिक (इन निमित्तोंके प्रारम्भसे अग्रिम दिन सूर्योदयपर्यन्त) अनध्याय समझना चाहिए। अग्निके प्रकट होने, बिजलीके चमकने तथा मेघके गर्जन
verses.wordMeaning: O leading sages, it is not possible to see me otherwise* There is no knowledge whereby that great Atman is realized.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading sages, it is not possible to see me otherwise* There is no knowledge whereby that great Atman is realized.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादनादिमध्यान्तं वस्त्वेकं परमं शिवम् । स ईश्वरो महादेवस्तं विज्ञाय विमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: tasmādanādimadhyāntaṃ vastvekaṃ paramaṃ śivam / sa īśvaro mahādevastaṃ vijñāya vimucyate
verses.translation: Only sages can know this supreme abode (v.l. knowl¬ edge ). Since the universe is the product of Maya, knowledge about it is enveloped by the darkness of ignorance.
verses.hindi: होनेपर प्रकाश रहनेपर भी अनध्याय होता है। दिनके समान ही रात्रिमें भी अनध्याय होता है धर्में निपुणता प्राप्त करनेकी इच्छावालोंके लिये नगर, ग्राम एवं दुर्गन्धयुक्त स्थानमें नित्य ही अनध्याय होता है। ग्राममें शव पड़े रहनेपर, अधार्मिक जनके समीप रहनेपर, रुदन होने और मनुष्योंका समूह
verses.wordMeaning: Only sages can know this supreme abode (v.l. knowl¬ edge ). Since the universe is the product of Maya, knowledge about it is enveloped by the darkness of ignorance.
verses.commentary: Sense: Only sages can know this supreme abode (v.l. knowl¬ edge ). Since the universe is the product of Maya, knowledge about it is enveloped by the darkness of ignorance.

verses.sanskrit: न तत्र सूर्यः प्रविभातीह चन्द्रो न नक्षत्राणि तपनो नोत विद्युत् । तद्भासेदमखिलं भाति नित्यं तन्नित्यभासमचलं सद्विभाति
verses.transliteration: na tatra sūryaḥ pravibhātīha candro na nakṣatrāṇi tapano nota vidyut / tadbhāsedamakhilaṃ bhāti nityaṃ tannityabhāsamacalaṃ sadvibhāti
verses.translation: The knowledge that is immaculate, pure, free from doubts, and unsullied is my soul. The sages declare that (supreme knowledge) to be this (my soul).
verses.hindi: (कार्यान्तरके लिये) एकत्र होनेपर अनध्याय होता है। जलके मध्य, आधी रातमें, मल-मूत्रके विसर्जनके समय, उच्छिष्ट अवस्थामें और श्राद्धमें भोजन करनेपर ( श्राद्धमे निमन्त्रणसे लेकर श्राद्ध-भोजनके दिन-राततक)
verses.wordMeaning: The knowledge that is immaculate, pure, free from doubts, and unsullied is my soul. The sages declare that (supreme knowledge) to be this (my soul).
verses.commentary: Sense: The knowledge that is immaculate, pure, free from doubts, and unsullied is my soul. The sages declare that (supreme knowledge) to be this (my soul).

verses.sanskrit: नित्योदितं संविदा निर्विकल्पं शुद्धं बृहन्तं परमं यद्विभाति । अत्रान्तरं ब्रह्मविदो ऽथ नित्यं पश्यन्ति तत्त्वमचलं यत् स ईशः
verses.transliteration: nityoditaṃ saṃvidā nirvikalpaṃ śuddhaṃ bṛhantaṃ paramaṃ yadvibhāti / atrāntaraṃ brahmavido 'tha nityaṃ paśyanti tattvamacalaṃ yat sa īśaḥ
verses.translation: The knowledge that is immaculate, pure, free from doubts, and unsullied is my soul. The sages declare that (supreme knowledge) to be this (my soul).
verses.hindi: मनसे भी (वेदादिका) चिन्तन नहीं करना चाहिए। विद्वान् द्विजको एकोदिष्टका निमन्त्रण स्वीकार कर, राजाके पुत्रजन्म आदिके सूतक तथा राहुके (ग्रहणजन्य) सूतकमें तीन दिनतक वेदका अध्ययन नहीँ करना चाहिए। ब्राह्मणके शरीरमें जबतक एकोदि्ट-श्राद्ध- सम्बन्धी  भोजनके समयका (घृत आदि) स्निग्ध द्रव्य एवं (सुगन्धित द्रव्यका) लेप रहे, तबतक विद्वान् ब्राह्मणको वेदाध्ययन नहीं करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: The knowledge that is immaculate, pure, free from doubts, and unsullied is my soul. The sages declare that (supreme knowledge) to be this (my soul).
verses.commentary: Sense: The knowledge that is immaculate, pure, free from doubts, and unsullied is my soul. The sages declare that (supreme knowledge) to be this (my soul).

verses.sanskrit: नित्यानन्दममृतं सत्यरूपं शुद्धं वदन्ति पुरुषं सर्ववेदाः । तदेवेदमिति प्रणवेनेशितारं धायायन्ति वेदार्थविनिश्चितार्थाः
verses.transliteration: nityānandamamṛtaṃ satyarūpaṃ śuddhaṃ vadanti puruṣaṃ sarvavedāḥ / tadevedamiti praṇaveneśitāraṃ dhāyāyanti vedārthaviniścitārthāḥ
verses.translation: The knowledge that is immaculate, pure, free from doubts, and unsullied is my soul. The sages declare that (supreme knowledge) to be this (my soul).
verses.hindi: सोते हुए, उकडूँ बैठे हुए (आसनारूढपाद), दोनों जानुओंको वस्त्रादिसे बाँधे हुए, मांस और सूतकादिसे सम्बन्धित अन्न खाकर, कुहरा पड़ते रहनेपर, बाणका शब्द होते समय, दोनों संध्याकालमें, अमावास्या, चतुर्दशी,
verses.wordMeaning: The knowledge that is immaculate, pure, free from doubts, and unsullied is my soul. The sages declare that (supreme knowledge) to be this (my soul).
verses.commentary: Sense: The knowledge that is immaculate, pure, free from doubts, and unsullied is my soul. The sages declare that (supreme knowledge) to be this (my soul).

verses.sanskrit: न भूमिरापो न मनो न वह्निः प्राणो ऽनिलो गगनं नोत बुद्धिः । न चेतनो ऽन्यत् परमाकाशमध्ये विभाति देवः शिव एव केवलः
verses.transliteration: na bhūmirāpo na mano na vahniḥ prāṇo 'nilo gaganaṃ nota buddhiḥ / na cetano 'nyat paramākāśamadhye vibhāti devaḥ śiva eva kevalaḥ
verses.translation: The knowledge that is immaculate, pure, free from doubts, and unsullied is my soul. The sages declare that (supreme knowledge) to be this (my soul).
verses.hindi: अतः) अध्ययन नहीं करना चाहिए। उपाकर्म और उत्सर्ग नामक कर्म करनेके अनन्तर तीन राततक अनध्याय होता है। अष्टकाओंमें' एक दिन-रात और ऋतुको अन्तिम रात्रियोंमें अनध्याय होता है॥ ७१--७३॥ १-मूलमें 'एकोऽनुदिष्ट' पाठ है। कुल्लूकभट्ट (मनुस्मृति व्याख्याकार)-के अनुसार ' अनुदिष्ट' का उच्छिष्ट अर्थ है।
verses.wordMeaning: The knowledge that is immaculate, pure, free from doubts, and unsullied is my soul. The sages declare that (supreme knowledge) to be this (my soul).
verses.commentary: Sense: The knowledge that is immaculate, pure, free from doubts, and unsullied is my soul. The sages declare that (supreme knowledge) to be this (my soul).

verses.sanskrit: इत्येतदुक्तं परमं रहस्यं ज्ञानामृतं सर्ववेदेषु गूढम् । जानाति योगी विजने ऽथ देशे युञ्जीत योगं प्रयतो ह्यजस्रम्
verses.transliteration: ityetaduktaṃ paramaṃ rahasyaṃ jñānāmṛtaṃ sarvavedeṣu gūḍham / jānāti yogī vijane 'tha deśe yuñjīta yogaṃ prayato hyajasram
verses.translation: The knowledge that is immaculate, pure, free from doubts, and unsullied is my soul. The sages declare that (supreme knowledge) to be this (my soul).
verses.hindi: मार्गशीर्ष तथा पौषे माघमासे तथेव च। तिस्त्रोऽष्टकाः समाख्याता कृष्णपक्षे तु सूरिभिः
verses.wordMeaning: The knowledge that is immaculate, pure, free from doubts, and unsullied is my soul. The sages declare that (supreme knowledge) to be this (my soul).
verses.commentary: Sense: The knowledge that is immaculate, pure, free from doubts, and unsullied is my soul. The sages declare that (supreme knowledge) to be this (my soul).

verses.sanskrit: इती श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे (ईश्वरगीतासु) दशमो ऽध्यायः ईश्वर उवाच अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि योगं परमदुर्लभम् । येनात्मानं प्रपश्यन्ति भानुमन्तमिवेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: itī śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge (īśvaragītāsu) daśamo 'dhyāyaḥ īśvara uvāca ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi yogaṃ paramadurlabham / yenātmānaṃ prapaśyanti bhānumantamiveśvaram
verses.translation: Even those who see that greatest region as multifarious understand the unity of the unchanging principle after resorting to the greatest adherence to principles.
verses.hindi: कदाचिदपि नाध्येयं कोविदारकपित्थयोः समानविद्यो च मृते तथा सब्रह्मचारिणि। आचार्ये संस्थिते वापि त्रिरात्रं क्षपणं स्मृतम्
verses.wordMeaning: Even those who see that greatest region as multifarious understand the unity of the unchanging principle after resorting to the greatest adherence to principles.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even those who see that greatest region as multifarious understand the unity of the unchanging principle after resorting to the greatest adherence to principles.

verses.sanskrit: योगाग्निर्दहति क्षिप्रमशेषं पापपञ्जरम् । प्रसन्नं जायते ज्ञानं साक्षान्निर्वाणसिद्धिदम्
verses.transliteration: yogāgnirdahati kṣipramaśeṣaṃ pāpapañjaram / prasannaṃ jāyate jñānaṃ sākṣānnirvāṇasiddhidam
verses.translation: Those devotees who perceive me, the greatest principle, the Isvara either as one or many, should be known as identical with that (Principle).
verses.hindi: छिद्राण्येतानि विप्राणां येऽनध्यायाः प्रकीर्तिताः । हिंसन्ति राक्षसास्तेषु तस्मादेतान् विवर्जयेत्
verses.wordMeaning: Those devotees who perceive me, the greatest principle, the Isvara either as one or many, should be known as identical with that (Principle).
verses.commentary: Sense: Those devotees who perceive me, the greatest principle, the Isvara either as one or many, should be known as identical with that (Principle).

verses.sanskrit: योगात्संजायते ज्ञानं ज्ञानाद् योगः प्रवर्तते । योगज्ञानाभियुक्तस्य प्रसीदति महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: yogātsaṃjāyate jñānaṃ jñānād yogaḥ pravartate / yogajñānābhiyuktasya prasīdati maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: They directly perceive their own soul (Atman), the supreme lord full of perpetual bliss, above doubt. Reality incarnate. This is the exact position (truth).
verses.hindi: नैत्यिके नास्त्यनध्यायः संध्योपासन एव च। उपाकर्मणि कर्मान्ते होममन्त्रेषु चैव हि एकामृचमथैकं वा यजुः सामाथवा पुनः। अष्ट्रकाद्यास्वधीयीत मारुते चातिवायति
verses.wordMeaning: They directly perceive their own soul (Atman), the supreme lord full of perpetual bliss, above doubt. Reality incarnate. This is the exact position (truth).
verses.commentary: Sense: They directly perceive their own soul (Atman), the supreme lord full of perpetual bliss, above doubt. Reality incarnate. This is the exact position (truth).

verses.sanskrit: एककालं द्विकालं वा त्रिकालं नित्यमेव वा । ये युञ्जन्तीह मद्योगं ते विज्ञेया महेश्वराः
verses.transliteration: ekakālaṃ dvikālaṃ vā trikālaṃ nityameva vā / ye yuñjantīha madyogaṃ te vijñeyā maheśvarāḥ
verses.translation: They who are established i n their own self which is beyond Avyakta, are quiescent, resort to enjoy the supreme bliss which permeates everything and is identical with the universe.
verses.hindi: अनध्यायस्तु नाङ्गेषु नेतिहासपुराणयोः। न धर्मशास्त्रेष्वन्येषु पर्वण्येतानि वर्जयेत्
verses.wordMeaning: They who are established i n their own self which is beyond Avyakta, are quiescent, resort to enjoy the supreme bliss which permeates everything and is identical with the universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: They who are established i n their own self which is beyond Avyakta, are quiescent, resort to enjoy the supreme bliss which permeates everything and is identical with the universe.

verses.sanskrit: योगस्तु द्विविधो ज्ञेयो ह्यभावः प्रथमो मतः । अपरस्तु महायोगः सर्वयोगोत्तमोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: yogastu dvividho jñeyo hyabhāvaḥ prathamo mataḥ / aparastu mahāyogaḥ sarvayogottamottamaḥ
verses.translation: This is the greatest liberation. This is my excellent Sayujya (Identity with me). Poets know this as Nirvana, identity with Brahman and Kaivalya (absolute oneness)
verses.hindi: एष धर्म: समासेन कीर्तितो ब्रह्मचारिणाम्। ब्रह्मणाभिहितः पूर्वमृषीणां भावितात्मनाम् पाठमात्रावसन्नस्तु पङ्के गौरिव सीदति
verses.wordMeaning: This is the greatest liberation. This is my excellent Sayujya (Identity with me). Poets know this as Nirvana, identity with Brahman and Kaivalya (absolute oneness)
verses.commentary: Sense: This is the greatest liberation. This is my excellent Sayujya (Identity with me). Poets know this as Nirvana, identity with Brahman and Kaivalya (absolute oneness)

verses.sanskrit: शून्यं सर्वनिराभासं स्वरूपं यत्र चिन्त्यते । अभावयोगः स प्रोक्तो येनात्मानं प्रपश्यति
verses.transliteration: śūnyaṃ sarvanirābhāsaṃ svarūpaṃ yatra cintyate / abhāvayogaḥ sa prokto yenātmānaṃ prapaśyati
verses.translation: Hence, the only entity devoid of beginning, middle and end and the supremely auspicious one, is Lord Mahadeva. After realising him, one is liberated.
verses.hindi: यदि त्वात्यन्तिकं वासं कर्तुमिच्छति वै गुरौ । युक्तः परिचरेदेनमाशरीरविमोक्षणात्
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, the only entity devoid of beginning, middle and end and the supremely auspicious one, is Lord Mahadeva. After realising him, one is liberated.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, the only entity devoid of beginning, middle and end and the supremely auspicious one, is Lord Mahadeva. After realising him, one is liberated.

verses.sanskrit: यत्र पश्यति चात्मानं नित्यानन्दं निरञ्जनम् । मयैक्यं स महायोगो भाषितः परमेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: yatra paśyati cātmānaṃ nityānandaṃ nirañjanam / mayaikyaṃ sa mahāyogo bhāṣitaḥ parameśvaraḥ
verses.translation: The sun does not shine there, nor does the moon, nor the group of stars nor the lightning. Illuminated by it the entire universe shines. It shines with great refulgence and is devoid of impurities. *
verses.hindi: विद्वानोंने मार्गशीर्ष (अगहन), पौष और माघमासके कुष्णपक्षमें तीन अष्टकाओंका वर्णन किया है। लिसोढ़ा, सेमल, महुआ, कचनार और कैथ वृक्षकी छायामें कभी भी (वेदका) अध्ययन नहीं करना सहपाठी ब्रह्मचारीको मृत्यु होनेपर और आचार्यके अपने यहाँ आनेपर तीन रातका अनध्याय कहा गया है । जो अनध्याय बतलाये गये हैं, ये ब्राह्मणों (द्विजों)- के छिद्र-रूप हैं। इन अवसरोंपर राक्षस प्रहार करते
verses.wordMeaning: The sun does not shine there, nor does the moon, nor the group of stars nor the lightning. Illuminated by it the entire universe shines. It shines with great refulgence and is devoid of impurities. *
verses.commentary: Sense: The sun does not shine there, nor does the moon, nor the group of stars nor the lightning. Illuminated by it the entire universe shines. It shines with great refulgence and is devoid of impurities. *

verses.sanskrit: ये चान्ये योगिनां योगाः श्रूयन्ते ग्रन्थविस्तरे । सर्वे ते ब्रह्मयोगस्य कलां नार्हन्ति षोडशीम्
verses.transliteration: ye cānye yogināṃ yogāḥ śrūyante granthavistare / sarve te brahmayogasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm
verses.translation: That which is called 'The All' (or universe) which is indivisible, immutable, pure, great, shines (brilliantly). The immovable principle which the knowers of the Brahman (or the Vedas) permanently visualize within themselves is the Isa (the Lord).
verses.hindi: हैं, इसलिये इनका परित्याग करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: That which is called 'The All' (or universe) which is indivisible, immutable, pure, great, shines (brilliantly). The immovable principle which the knowers of the Brahman (or the Vedas) permanently visualize within themselves is the Isa (the Lord).
verses.commentary: Sense: That which is called 'The All' (or universe) which is indivisible, immutable, pure, great, shines (brilliantly). The immovable principle which the knowers of the Brahman (or the Vedas) permanently visualize within themselves is the Isa (the Lord).

verses.sanskrit: यत्र साक्षात् प्रपश्यन्ति विमुक्ता विश्वमीश्वरम् । सर्वेषामेव योगानां स योगः परमो मतः
verses.transliteration: yatra sākṣāt prapaśyanti vimuktā viśvamīśvaram / sarveṣāmeva yogānāṃ sa yogaḥ paramo mataḥ
verses.translation: All the Vedas say that the Purusa is pure, nectarean, perpetual bliss and embodiment of truth. Those who have come to a definite conclusion through the study of the Vedas
verses.hindi: नित्य-कर्म, संध्योपासन, उपाकर्म, आरब्धकर्मके अन्तमें और होममन्त्रोंमें अनध्याय नहीं होता (अर्थात् अनध्यायकालमें भी इनसे सम्बद्ध मन्त्र बोले जाते हैं।) अष्टकाओं और प्रबल वायुके चलनेपर भी ऋग्वेद, यजुर्वेद अथवा सामवेदके एक मन्त्रका पाठ (अवश्य) करना चाहिए। वेदाङ्गों और इतिहास-पुराणके अध्ययन और अन्य धर्मशास्त्रोंके अध्ययनमें अनध्याय नहीं होता, किंतु पर्वोमें इनके अध्ययनका त्याग करना चाहिए।
verses.wordMeaning: All the Vedas say that the Purusa is pure, nectarean, perpetual bliss and embodiment of truth. Those who have come to a definite conclusion through the study of the Vedas
verses.commentary: Sense: All the Vedas say that the Purusa is pure, nectarean, perpetual bliss and embodiment of truth. Those who have come to a definite conclusion through the study of the Vedas

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रशो ऽथ शतशो ये चेश्वरबहिष्कृताः । न ते पश्यन्ति मामेकं योगिनो यतमानसाः
verses.transliteration: sahasraśo 'tha śataśo ye ceśvarabahiṣkṛtāḥ / na te paśyanti māmekaṃ yogino yatamānasāḥ
verses.translation: Neither the Earth, nor the waters, nor the mind, nor the fire, nor the vital breath, nor the wind, nor the sky, nor the intellect, nor the consciousness, nor does anything else shine in the firmament. Only the Lord Siva alone shines in the great sky.
verses.hindi: संक्षेपमें यह ब्रह्मचारियोंका धर्म बतलाया गया । पूर्वकालमें ब्रह्माने इसे शुद्धात्मा ऋषियोंको बतलाया था ॥ ७८--८१॥
verses.wordMeaning: Neither the Earth, nor the waters, nor the mind, nor the fire, nor the vital breath, nor the wind, nor the sky, nor the intellect, nor the consciousness, nor does anything else shine in the firmament. Only the Lord Siva alone shines in the great sky.
verses.commentary: Sense: Neither the Earth, nor the waters, nor the mind, nor the fire, nor the vital breath, nor the wind, nor the sky, nor the intellect, nor the consciousness, nor does anything else shine in the firmament. Only the Lord Siva alone shines in the great sky.

verses.sanskrit: प्राणायामस्तथा ध्यानं प्रत्याहारो ऽथ धारणा । समाधिश्च मुनिश्रेष्ठा यमो नियम आसनम्
verses.transliteration: prāṇāyāmastathā dhyānaṃ pratyāhāro 'tha dhāraṇā / samādhiśca muniśreṣṭhā yamo niyama āsanam
verses.translation: Thus has been communicated to you this topmost supreme secret, the knowledge that is sung in all the Vedas. The Yogi alone knows this. One should incessantly practise Yoga in a secluded place.
verses.hindi: जो द्विज वेदका अध्ययन न कर अन्यत्र (दूसरे शास्त्रोंको पढनेमें) प्रयत्न करता है, उस वेदबाह्य मूढ व्यक्तिके साथ द्विजातियोंको सम्भाषण नहीं करना चाहिए। द्विजको वेदके पाठमात्रसे संतुष्ट नहीं होना चाहिए। पाठमात्रसे वेदाध्ययनको समाप्त करनेवाला कीचड़में फँसी गौके समान कष्ट पाता है। जो विधिपूर्वक वेदका अध्ययन कर वेदके अर्थपर विचार नहीं करता है, वह अपने वंशके साथ शूद्रके समान
verses.wordMeaning: Thus has been communicated to you this topmost supreme secret, the knowledge that is sung in all the Vedas. The Yogi alone knows this. One should incessantly practise Yoga in a secluded place.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus has been communicated to you this topmost supreme secret, the knowledge that is sung in all the Vedas. The Yogi alone knows this. One should incessantly practise Yoga in a secluded place.

verses.sanskrit: मय्येकचित्ततायोगो वृत्त्यन्तरनिरोधतः । तत्साधनान्यष्टधा तु युष्माकं कथितानि तु
verses.transliteration: mayyekacittatāyogo vṛttyantaranirodhataḥ / tatsādhanānyaṣṭadhā tu yuṣmākaṃ kathitāni tu
verses.translation: This is how lydsa-gitd, the next section is introduced.
verses.hindi: है। वह (वास्तवमें) पात्रता (योग्यता)-को नहीं प्राप्त करता है (अर्थात् वेदाध्ययन करनेवाला वेदार्थ अवश्य जाने यही तात्पर्यं है।)
verses.wordMeaning: This is how lydsa-gitd, the next section is introduced.
verses.commentary: Sense: This is how lydsa-gitd, the next section is introduced.

verses.sanskrit: अहिंसा सत्यमस्तेयं ब्रह्मचर्यापरिग्रहौ । यमाः संक्षेपतः प्रोक्ताश्चित्तशुद्धिप्रदा नृणाम्
verses.transliteration: ahiṃsā satyamasteyaṃ brahmacaryāparigrahau / yamāḥ saṃkṣepataḥ proktāścittaśuddhipradā nṛṇām
verses.translation: Though I have followed Vehk. Edt., I think it better to take this line along with the above verse (no. 68). It would then mean: ' (This esoteric doctrine) has been conveyed to the twice-born, devotees and Brahma-carins.'
verses.hindi: यदि गुरुके पास ही जीवनपर्यन्त रहनेकी इच्छा हो तो शरीरके अन्त होनेतक बड़ी ही सावधानीपूर्वक इनकी (गुरुको) सेवा करनी चाहिए  वेदाध्ययन द्विजको शास्त्राध्ययनके पूर्व अवश्य करना चाहिए, यही तात्पर्य है
verses.wordMeaning: Though I have followed Vehk. Edt., I think it better to take this line along with the above verse (no. 68). It would then mean: ' (This esoteric doctrine) has been conveyed to the twice-born, devotees and Brahma-carins.'
verses.commentary: Sense: Though I have followed Vehk. Edt., I think it better to take this line along with the above verse (no. 68). It would then mean: ' (This esoteric doctrine) has been conveyed to the twice-born, devotees and Brahma-carins.'

verses.sanskrit: कर्मणा मनसा वाचा सर्वभूतेषु सर्वदा । अक्लेशजननं प्रोक्तं त्वहिंसा परमर्षिभिः
verses.transliteration: karmaṇā manasā vācā sarvabhūteṣu sarvadā / akleśajananaṃ proktaṃ tvahiṃsā paramarṣibhiḥ
verses.translation: w. 70-90 are borrowed from the BG., as can be seen from the footnotes.
verses.hindi: ३१८ ति कूर्मपुराण +
verses.wordMeaning: w. 70-90 are borrowed from the BG., as can be seen from the footnotes.
verses.commentary: Sense: w. 70-90 are borrowed from the BG., as can be seen from the footnotes.

verses.sanskrit: अहिंसायाः परो धर्मो नास्त्यहिंसा परं सुखम् । विधिना या भवेद्धिंसा त्वहिंसैव प्रकीर्तिता
verses.transliteration: ahiṃsāyāḥ paro dharmo nāstyahiṃsā paraṃ sukham / vidhinā yā bhaveddhiṃsā tvahiṃsaiva prakīrtitā
verses.translation: Those who practise the great Yoga once, twice or thrice everyday or continuously should be known as Mahesvaras.
verses.hindi: गत्वा वनं वा विधिवज्जुहुयाज्जातवेदसम्। अथवा (गुरु, गुरुपल्ली या उनके किसी सपिण्डके अधीयीत सदा नित्यं ब्रह्मनिष्ठः समाहितः॥ ८६॥  न रहनेपर) वनमें जाकर विधिपूर्वक अग्निमें हवन करना चाहिए और समाहित होकर ब्रह्ममें अत्यन्त निष्ठा रखते हुए नित्य वेदाभ्यास करना चाहिए। नित्य भस्म-स्नान सावित्रीं शतरुद्रीयं वेदान्तांश्च विशेषतः। करते हुए गायत्री, शतरुद्रिय और वेदान्त-शास्त्रोंका विशेष अभ्यसेत् सततं युक्तो भस्मस्नानपरायणः॥ ८७॥  रूपसे निरन्तर अभ्यास करते रहना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: Those who practise the great Yoga once, twice or thrice everyday or continuously should be known as Mahesvaras.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who practise the great Yoga once, twice or thrice everyday or continuously should be known as Mahesvaras.

verses.sanskrit: सत्येन सर्वमाप्नोति सत्ये सर्वं प्रतिष्ठितम् । यथार्थकथनाचारः सत्यं प्रोक्तं द्विजातिभिः
verses.transliteration: satyena sarvamāpnoti satye sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam / yathārthakathanācāraḥ satyaṃ proktaṃ dvijātibhiḥ
verses.translation: Yoga should be known as one of two kinds. The first one is called as Abhava Yoga. The other one is known as the Mahayoga (the great Yoga). It is the most excellent among all Yogas.
verses.hindi: एतद् विधानं परमं पुराणं वेदज्ञानकी प्राप्तिका यह सनातन विधान आप लोगोंको
verses.wordMeaning: Yoga should be known as one of two kinds. The first one is called as Abhava Yoga. The other one is known as the Mahayoga (the great Yoga). It is the most excellent among all Yogas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Yoga should be known as one of two kinds. The first one is called as Abhava Yoga. The other one is known as the Mahayoga (the great Yoga). It is the most excellent among all Yogas.

verses.sanskrit: परद्रव्यापहरणं चौर्याद् वाथ बलेन वा । स्तेयं तस्यानाचरणादस्तेयं धर्मसाधनम्
verses.transliteration: paradravyāpaharaṇaṃ cauryād vātha balena vā / steyaṃ tasyānācaraṇādasteyaṃ dharmasādhanam
verses.translation: The Yoga wherein one's own soul is meditated upon
verses.hindi: वेदागमे सम्यगिहेरितं वः। बतलाया गया, प्राचीन कालमें श्रेष्ठ महर्षियोंके पूछनेपर पुरा महर्षिप्रवराभिपुष्टः भगवान् स्वायम्भुव मनुने स्वयं ही इसे कहा था। इस स्वायम्भुवो यन्मनुराह देवः॥ ८८॥  प्रकार अपने अन्तःकरणको ईश्वरमें समर्पित करके विधानको जाननेवाले जो पुरुष इस (ब्रह्मचर्य) विधिका अनुष्ठान
verses.wordMeaning: The Yoga wherein one's own soul is meditated upon
verses.commentary: Sense: The Yoga wherein one's own soul is meditated upon

verses.sanskrit: कर्मणा मनसा वाचा सर्वावस्थासु सर्वदा । सर्वत्र मैथुनत्यागं ब्रह्मचर्यं प्रचक्षते
verses.transliteration: karmaṇā manasā vācā sarvāvasthāsu sarvadā / sarvatra maithunatyāgaṃ brahmacaryaṃ pracakṣate
verses.translation: The Yoga wherein one sees one's own self as imma¬ culate, eternal bliss and identical with me is called by me as the highest Yoga.
verses.hindi: एवमीश्वरसमर्पितान्तरो (यथावत् पालन) करता है, वह क्रमशः समस्त मोह- योऽनुतिष्ठति विधिं विधानवित्। जालका परित्यागकर, अमर होते हुए अनामय शिवपदको मोहजालमपहाय सोऽमृतो प्राप्त करता है तथा अमर हो जाता है अर्थात् ब्रह्मस्वरूप
verses.wordMeaning: The Yoga wherein one sees one's own self as imma¬ culate, eternal bliss and identical with me is called by me as the highest Yoga.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Yoga wherein one sees one's own self as imma¬ culate, eternal bliss and identical with me is called by me as the highest Yoga.

verses.sanskrit: द्रव्याणामप्यनादानमापद्यपि यथेच्छया । अपरिग्रह इत्याहुस्तं प्रयत्नेन पालयेत्
verses.transliteration: dravyāṇāmapyanādānamāpadyapi yathecchayā / aparigraha ityāhustaṃ prayatnena pālayet
verses.translation: Those other paths of Yogas practised by other Yogins and those Yogas which are heard (described) in other extensive works (on Yoga) do not deserve to be even one-six¬ teenth part of the Brahma-Yoga (Yoga leading to the realiz¬ ation of the Brahman).
verses.hindi: याति तत् पदमनामयं शिवम्॥ ८९॥  होकर कृतकृत्य हो जाता है इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे बद्साहस्रघां संहितायामुपरिविभागे चतुर्दशोऽध्यायः
verses.wordMeaning: Those other paths of Yogas practised by other Yogins and those Yogas which are heard (described) in other extensive works (on Yoga) do not deserve to be even one-six¬ teenth part of the Brahma-Yoga (Yoga leading to the realiz¬ ation of the Brahman).
verses.commentary: Sense: Those other paths of Yogas practised by other Yogins and those Yogas which are heard (described) in other extensive works (on Yoga) do not deserve to be even one-six¬ teenth part of the Brahma-Yoga (Yoga leading to the realiz¬ ation of the Brahman).

verses.sanskrit: तपः स्वाध्यायसंतोषाः शौचमीश्वरपूजनम् । समासान्नियमाः प्रोक्ता योगसिद्धिप्रदायिनः
verses.transliteration: tapaḥ svādhyāyasaṃtoṣāḥ śaucamīśvarapūjanam / samāsānniyamāḥ proktā yogasiddhipradāyinaḥ
verses.translation: The Yoga in which the liberated souls directly perceive the universe as one with Isvara, that Yoga is considered to be the greatest of all Yogas.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार छः हजार श्लोकोंवाली श्रीकूर्मपुराणसंहिताके उपरिंविभागमें चौदहवाँ अध्याय समाप्त हुआ
verses.wordMeaning: The Yoga in which the liberated souls directly perceive the universe as one with Isvara, that Yoga is considered to be the greatest of all Yogas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Yoga in which the liberated souls directly perceive the universe as one with Isvara, that Yoga is considered to be the greatest of all Yogas.

verses.sanskrit: उपवासपराकादिकृच्छ्रचान्द्रायणादिभिः । शरीरशोषणं प्राहुस्तापसास्तप उत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: upavāsaparākādikṛcchracāndrāyaṇādibhiḥ / śarīraśoṣaṇaṃ prāhustāpasāstapa uttamam
verses.translation: Thousands and numerous Yogins of controlled minds who consider themselves as excluded or different from Isvara do not perceive me as one without a second.
verses.hindi: गृहस्थधर्म तथा गृहस्थके सदाचारका वर्णन, धर्माचरण एवं सत्यधर्मकी महिमा व्यास उवाच व्यासजीने कहा--द्विजो ! द्विजोत्तमको चाहिए कि वह एक वेद, दो वेद (तीन) वेद अथवा वेदोंका अध्ययन कर और वेदके अर्थका ज्ञान प्राप्तकर खान (संस्कार-विशेष- समावर्तन) करे। गुरुको दक्षिणा
verses.wordMeaning: Thousands and numerous Yogins of controlled minds who consider themselves as excluded or different from Isvara do not perceive me as one without a second.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thousands and numerous Yogins of controlled minds who consider themselves as excluded or different from Isvara do not perceive me as one without a second.

verses.sanskrit: वेदान्तशतरुद्रीयप्रणवादिजपं बुधाः । सत्त्वशुद्धिकरं पुंसां स्वाध्यायं परिचक्षते
verses.transliteration: vedāntaśatarudrīyapraṇavādijapaṃ budhāḥ / sattvaśuddhikaraṃ puṃsāṃ svādhyāyaṃ paricakṣate
verses.translation: O excellent sages, (the following are the essential adjuncts of Yoga) viz. Pranayama, Dhyana (meditation), Pratyahara (withdrawal of the sense-organs), Dharana (reten¬ tion), Samadhi (trance), Yama (control), Niyama (Restraint and observance), Asana (posture).
verses.hindi: निवेदित कर उनकी आज्ञासे स्नान (समावर्तन) करे। व्रत (ब्रह्मचर्यब्रत) पूर्णकर उसके फलस्वरूप शक्ति-
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent sages, (the following are the essential adjuncts of Yoga) viz. Pranayama, Dhyana (meditation), Pratyahara (withdrawal of the sense-organs), Dharana (reten¬ tion), Samadhi (trance), Yama (control), Niyama (Restraint and observance), Asana (posture).
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent sages, (the following are the essential adjuncts of Yoga) viz. Pranayama, Dhyana (meditation), Pratyahara (withdrawal of the sense-organs), Dharana (reten¬ tion), Samadhi (trance), Yama (control), Niyama (Restraint and observance), Asana (posture).

verses.sanskrit: स्वाध्यायस्य त्रयो भेदा वाचिकोपांशुमानसाः । उत्तरोत्तरवैशिष्ट्यं प्राहुर्वेदार्थवेदिनः
verses.transliteration: svādhyāyasya trayo bhedā vācikopāṃśumānasāḥ / uttarottaravaiśiṣṭyaṃ prāhurvedārthavedinaḥ
verses.translation: The adjuncts of the same Yoga have been narrated to you. Yoga is the concentration! of the mind in me alone along with control of the intermediary urges.
verses.hindi: गुरवे तु वरं दत्त्वा स्नायीत तदनुज्ञया। सम्पन्न युक्तात्मा द्विज स्नान (समावर्तन)-का अधिकारी चीर्णब्रतोऽथ युक्तात्मा सशक्तः स्नातुमर्हति॥ २॥  होता है वैणवीं धारयेद् यष्ट्रिमन्तर्वासस्तथोत्तरम्। (स्नातकको) बाँसकी छड़ी, कौपीन, धोती
verses.wordMeaning: The adjuncts of the same Yoga have been narrated to you. Yoga is the concentration! of the mind in me alone along with control of the intermediary urges.
verses.commentary: Sense: The adjuncts of the same Yoga have been narrated to you. Yoga is the concentration! of the mind in me alone along with control of the intermediary urges.

verses.sanskrit: यः शब्दबोधजननः परेषां शृण्वतां स्फुटम् । स्वाध्यायो वाचिकः प्रोक्त उपांशोरथ लक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: yaḥ śabdabodhajananaḥ pareṣāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ sphuṭam / svādhyāyo vācikaḥ prokta upāṃśoratha lakṣaṇam
verses.translation: Ahimsd (non-violence), Satya (truth), Asteya (non¬ stealth), (celibacy) and (non-possession
verses.hindi: यज्ञोपवीतद्वितयं सोदकं च कमण्डलुम्॥ ३॥  तथा उत्तरीय वस्त्र (चद्दर), दो यज्ञोपवीत, जलपूर्णं
verses.wordMeaning: Ahimsd (non-violence), Satya (truth), Asteya (non¬ stealth), (celibacy) and (non-possession
verses.commentary: Sense: Ahimsd (non-violence), Satya (truth), Asteya (non¬ stealth), (celibacy) and (non-possession

verses.sanskrit: ओष्ठयोः स्पन्दमात्रेण परस्याशब्दबोधकः । उपांशुरेष निर्दिष्टः साहस्रो वाचिकाज्जपः
verses.transliteration: oṣṭhayoḥ spandamātreṇa parasyāśabdabodhakaḥ / upāṃśureṣa nirdiṣṭaḥ sāhasro vācikājjapaḥ
verses.translation: It has been declared by the great sages that Ahirhsa (non-violence) is non-causation of distress to any living being at any time physically, mentally and verbally.
verses.hindi: दो स्वर्णकुण्डल और वेद (कुशमुष्टि) धारण करना छत्रं चोष्णीषममलं पादुके चाप्युपानहौ। चाहिए तथा केश और नखोंको करवाकर स्वच्छ रौक्मे च कुण्डले वेदं कृत्तकेशनखः शुचि: ॥ ४॥  रहना चाहिए अन्यत्र काञ्चनाद् विप्रो न रक्तां बिभृयात् स्त्रजम्
verses.wordMeaning: It has been declared by the great sages that Ahirhsa (non-violence) is non-causation of distress to any living being at any time physically, mentally and verbally.
verses.commentary: Sense: It has been declared by the great sages that Ahirhsa (non-violence) is non-causation of distress to any living being at any time physically, mentally and verbally.

verses.sanskrit: यत्पदाक्षरसङ्गत्या परिस्पन्दनवर्जितम् । चिन्तनं सर्वशब्दानां मानसं तं जपं विदुः
verses.transliteration: yatpadākṣarasaṅgatyā parispandanavarjitam / cintanaṃ sarvaśabdānāṃ mānasaṃ taṃ japaṃ viduḥ
verses.translation: There is no greater Virtue than Ahirhsa; there is nothing more conducive to happiness than Ahirhsa. The Hiihsa (violence) that is committed according to the injunctions (of the Vedas) is indeed glorified as Ahirhsa.
verses.hindi: न रक्तमुल्बणं चान्यधृतं वासो न कुण्डिकाम्। नोपानहौ स्त्रजं चाथ पादुके च प्रयोजयेत्
verses.wordMeaning: There is no greater Virtue than Ahirhsa; there is nothing more conducive to happiness than Ahirhsa. The Hiihsa (violence) that is committed according to the injunctions (of the Vedas) is indeed glorified as Ahirhsa.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no greater Virtue than Ahirhsa; there is nothing more conducive to happiness than Ahirhsa. The Hiihsa (violence) that is committed according to the injunctions (of the Vedas) is indeed glorified as Ahirhsa.

verses.sanskrit: यदृच्छालाभतो नित्यमलं पुंसो भवेदिति । या धीस्तामृषयः प्राहुः संतोषं सुखलक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: yadṛcchālābhato nityamalaṃ puṃso bhavediti / yā dhīstāmṛṣayaḥ prāhuḥ saṃtoṣaṃ sukhalakṣaṇam
verses.translation: The act of stating precisely in conformity to what is factual is called Salya (truthfulness) by the twice-born ones. One obtains everything through Satya. Everything is founded on Satya.
verses.hindi: उपवीतमलंकारं दर्भान् कृष्णाजिनानि च। नापसव्यं परीदध्याद् वासो न विकृतं वसेत् ऋतुकालाभिगामी स्याद् यावत् पुत्रोऽभिजायते। वर्जयेत् प्रतिषिद्धानि प्रयत्नेन दिनानि तु
verses.wordMeaning: The act of stating precisely in conformity to what is factual is called Salya (truthfulness) by the twice-born ones. One obtains everything through Satya. Everything is founded on Satya.
verses.commentary: Sense: The act of stating precisely in conformity to what is factual is called Salya (truthfulness) by the twice-born ones. One obtains everything through Satya. Everything is founded on Satya.

verses.sanskrit: बाह्यमाभ्यन्तरं शौचं द्विधा प्रोक्तं द्विजोत्तमाः । मृज्जलाभ्यां स्मृतं बाह्यं मनःशुद्धिरथान्तरम्
verses.transliteration: bāhyamābhyantaraṃ śaucaṃ dvidhā proktaṃ dvijottamāḥ / mṛjjalābhyāṃ smṛtaṃ bāhyaṃ manaḥśuddhirathāntaram
verses.translation: Removal of another man's wealth or property either by stealth or through force is called Steya, (stealth). Refrain¬ ing from doing it is Asteya. It is a means of Virtue of merit.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मचारी भवेन्नित्यं तद्वज्जन्मत्रयाहनि
verses.wordMeaning: Removal of another man's wealth or property either by stealth or through force is called Steya, (stealth). Refrain¬ ing from doing it is Asteya. It is a means of Virtue of merit.
verses.commentary: Sense: Removal of another man's wealth or property either by stealth or through force is called Steya, (stealth). Refrain¬ ing from doing it is Asteya. It is a means of Virtue of merit.

verses.sanskrit: स्तुतिस्मरणपूजाभिर्वाङ्मनःकायकर्मभिः । सुनिश्चला शिवे भक्तिरेतदीश्वरपूजनम्
verses.transliteration: stutismaraṇapūjābhirvāṅmanaḥkāyakarmabhiḥ / suniścalā śive bhaktiretadīśvarapūjanam
verses.translation: Eschewing copulation either physically, mentally and orally in all stages, at times, and in all places is called Brahmacarya (celibacy).
verses.hindi: व्रतानि स्नातको नित्यं पावनानि च पालयेत् वेदोदितं स्वकं कर्म नित्यं कुर्यादतन्द्रितः ।
verses.wordMeaning: Eschewing copulation either physically, mentally and orally in all stages, at times, and in all places is called Brahmacarya (celibacy).
verses.commentary: Sense: Eschewing copulation either physically, mentally and orally in all stages, at times, and in all places is called Brahmacarya (celibacy).

verses.sanskrit: यमाः सनियमाः प्रोक्ताः प्राणायामं निबोधत । प्राणः स्वदेहजो वायुरायामस्तन्निरोधनम्
verses.transliteration: yamāḥ saniyamāḥ proktāḥ prāṇāyāmaṃ nibodhata / prāṇaḥ svadehajo vāyurāyāmastannirodhanam
verses.translation: Nontaking of monetary gifts voluntarily even during adversity is called Aparigraha. One should maintain it strenu¬ ously.
verses.hindi: (स्नातकको) नित्य स्वाध्याय करना चाहिए! केशकलापसे बाहर माला नहीं धारण करनी चाहिए । सोनेकी मालाको छोड़कर ब्राह्मणको रक्तवर्णकी माला धारण नहीं करनी चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: Nontaking of monetary gifts voluntarily even during adversity is called Aparigraha. One should maintain it strenu¬ ously.
verses.commentary: Sense: Nontaking of monetary gifts voluntarily even during adversity is called Aparigraha. One should maintain it strenu¬ ously.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तमाधममध्यत्वात् त्रिधायं प्रतिपादितः । स एव द्विविधः प्रोक्तः सगर्भो ऽगर्भ एव च
verses.transliteration: uttamādhamamadhyatvāt tridhāyaṃ pratipāditaḥ / sa eva dvividhaḥ proktaḥ sagarbho 'garbha eva ca
verses.translation: Tapas (penance), SvMhyaya (self-study of Vedas), Santosa (contentment), Sauca {-pwcity), livara-Pujam (worship of God) these are mentioned as Niyamas (observances) succinctly. They are the bestowers of Yogic perfection {Siddhis).
verses.hindi: उसे नित्य सफेद एवं स्वच्छ वस्त्र धारण करना चाहिए तथा सुगन्धित द्रव्य-इत्र आदि धारणकर सदा सुगन्धयुक्त एवं सुवेशसे प्रियदर्शन होना चाहिए। धन रहनेपर पुराना और मैला वस्त्र धारण नहीं करना चाहिए। उद्वेगजनक अधिक लाल और दूसरोंद्वारा प्रयोग किया हुआ वस्त्र, कमण्डलु, जूता, माला तथा खड़ाऊँ नहीं धारण करना चाहिए। इसी प्रकार उसे (स्नातकको) दूसरे द्वारा (प्रयुक्त) यज्ञोपवीत, अलङ्कार,
verses.wordMeaning: Tapas (penance), SvMhyaya (self-study of Vedas), Santosa (contentment), Sauca {-pwcity), livara-Pujam (worship of God) these are mentioned as Niyamas (observances) succinctly. They are the bestowers of Yogic perfection {Siddhis).
verses.commentary: Sense: Tapas (penance), SvMhyaya (self-study of Vedas), Santosa (contentment), Sauca {-pwcity), livara-Pujam (worship of God) these are mentioned as Niyamas (observances) succinctly. They are the bestowers of Yogic perfection {Siddhis).

verses.sanskrit: मात्राद्वादशको मन्दश्चतुर्विंशतिमात्रिकः । मध्यमः प्राणसंरोधः षट्त्रिंशन्मात्रिकोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: mātrādvādaśako mandaścaturviṃśatimātrikaḥ / madhyamaḥ prāṇasaṃrodhaḥ ṣaṭtriṃśanmātrikottamaḥ
verses.translation: Ascetics call it the excellent penance if the body is dessicated by means of fasts and observances of religious vows like Paraka, Krcchra, Candrayana etc.
verses.hindi: कुश और कृष्णमृगचर्मको धारण नहीं करना चाहिए । अपसव्य नहीँ रहना चाहिए, उसे विकृत (कटे-फटे) वस्त्रोंको धारण नहीं करना चाहिए॥ ६--८॥
verses.wordMeaning: Ascetics call it the excellent penance if the body is dessicated by means of fasts and observances of religious vows like Paraka, Krcchra, Candrayana etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ascetics call it the excellent penance if the body is dessicated by means of fasts and observances of religious vows like Paraka, Krcchra, Candrayana etc.

verses.sanskrit: प्रस्वेदकम्पनोत्थानजनकत्वं यथाक्रमम् । मन्दमध्यममुख्यानामानन्दादुत्तमोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: prasvedakampanotthānajanakatvaṃ yathākramam / mandamadhyamamukhyānāmānandāduttamottamaḥ
verses.translation: Learned men say that this is Svadhyaya if one per¬ forms the Japa of the Vedantic passages, Satarudriya (Vaj. Sarhhita XVI. 1-66), Pranava (Om) etc. It brings about the achievement of Sattva Guna in men.
verses.hindi: अपने समान (कुलके अनुरूप) शुभ, अच्छे रूप और लक्षणोंसे सम्पन्न, योनि-सम्बन्धी दोषोंसे रहित पत्नीको विधिपूर्वक ग्रहण करना चाहिए । ब्राह्मण (द्विज)- को अपनी माताके गोत्रमें जो उत्पन्न न हो तथा जो अपने आर्ष गोत्रमें उत्पन्न न हो, ऐसी शील और सदाचारसे सम्पन्न भार्याको ग्रहण करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: Learned men say that this is Svadhyaya if one per¬ forms the Japa of the Vedantic passages, Satarudriya (Vaj. Sarhhita XVI. 1-66), Pranava (Om) etc. It brings about the achievement of Sattva Guna in men.
verses.commentary: Sense: Learned men say that this is Svadhyaya if one per¬ forms the Japa of the Vedantic passages, Satarudriya (Vaj. Sarhhita XVI. 1-66), Pranava (Om) etc. It brings about the achievement of Sattva Guna in men.

verses.sanskrit: सगर्भमाहुः सजपमगर्भं विजपं बुधाः । एतद् वै योगिनामुक्तं प्राणायामस्य लक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: sagarbhamāhuḥ sajapamagarbhaṃ vijapaṃ budhāḥ / etad vai yogināmuktaṃ prāṇāyāmasya lakṣaṇam
verses.translation: There are. three types of Svadhyayas viz. Vacika (verbal), Uparhsu (inaudible muttering) axid Mdnasa (mental),
verses.hindi: पुत्रके उत्पन्न होनेतक ऋतुकालमें अपनी स्त्रीसे सहवास करना चाहिए, किंतु निषिद्ध दिनोंका प्रयत्नपूर्वक
verses.wordMeaning: There are. three types of Svadhyayas viz. Vacika (verbal), Uparhsu (inaudible muttering) axid Mdnasa (mental),
verses.commentary: Sense: There are. three types of Svadhyayas viz. Vacika (verbal), Uparhsu (inaudible muttering) axid Mdnasa (mental),

verses.sanskrit: सव्याहृतिं सप्रणवां गायत्रीं शिरसा सह । त्रिर्जपेदायतप्राणः प्राणायामः स उच्यते
verses.transliteration: savyāhṛtiṃ sapraṇavāṃ gāyatrīṃ śirasā saha / trirjapedāyataprāṇaḥ prāṇāyāmaḥ sa ucyate
verses.translation: The Svadhyaya (recitation or study of the Vedas) the words of which are clearly audible (understandable) to other listeners is called Vacika (vocal).
verses.hindi: पूर्णिमाको और इसी प्रकार जन्मदिनसे तीन दिनपर्यन्त सदा ब्रह्मचर्यं धारण करना चाहिए आवसथ्य (संस्कार-विशेषसे संस्कृत स्मार्त अग्नि) नामक अग्निको स्थापना कर उसमें प्रतिदिन हवन करना चाहिए और नित्य पवित्र व्रतोंका पालन करना चाहिए। वेदमें बतलाये गये अपने कर्माको नित्य आलस्यरहित
verses.wordMeaning: The Svadhyaya (recitation or study of the Vedas) the words of which are clearly audible (understandable) to other listeners is called Vacika (vocal).
verses.commentary: Sense: The Svadhyaya (recitation or study of the Vedas) the words of which are clearly audible (understandable) to other listeners is called Vacika (vocal).

verses.sanskrit: रेचकः पूरकश्चैव प्राणायामो ऽथ कुम्भकः । प्रोच्यते सर्वशास्त्रेषु योगिभिर्यतमानसैः
verses.transliteration: recakaḥ pūrakaścaiva prāṇāyāmo 'tha kumbhakaḥ / procyate sarvaśāstreṣu yogibhiryatamānasaiḥ
verses.translation: That which involves only the throbbing of lips but the words of which are inaudible to others is designated as Uparhsu (inaudible Svadhyaya). It is better (more efficacious) than vocal Japa.
verses.hindi: होकर करना चाहिए। इन्हें न करनेपर (स्नातक) शीघ्र
verses.wordMeaning: That which involves only the throbbing of lips but the words of which are inaudible to others is designated as Uparhsu (inaudible Svadhyaya). It is better (more efficacious) than vocal Japa.
verses.commentary: Sense: That which involves only the throbbing of lips but the words of which are inaudible to others is designated as Uparhsu (inaudible Svadhyaya). It is better (more efficacious) than vocal Japa.

verses.sanskrit: रेचको ऽजस्त्रनिश्वासात् पूरकस्तन्निरोधतः । साम्येन संस्थितिर्या सा कुम्भकः परिगीयते
verses.transliteration: recako 'jastraniśvāsāt pūrakastannirodhataḥ / sāmyena saṃsthitiryā sā kumbhakaḥ parigīyate
verses.translation: The contemplation of all the words (of the text of (prayer) in the proper sequence of words and syllables
verses.hindi: अकुर्वाणः पतत्याशु नरकानतिभीषणान्॥ १४॥  ही अत्यन्त भयंकर नरकोंमें गिरता है १-मनुस्मृति (४1 ७२)-के अनुसार 'बहिर्माल्य'का अर्थ है-केशकलापसे बाहर माला। इसका आशय यह है कि सिरके ऊपर
verses.wordMeaning: The contemplation of all the words (of the text of (prayer) in the proper sequence of words and syllables
verses.commentary: Sense: The contemplation of all the words (of the text of (prayer) in the proper sequence of words and syllables

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रियाणां विचरतां विषयेषु स्वभावतः । निग्रहः प्रोच्यते सद्भिः प्रत्याहारस्तु सत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: indriyāṇāṃ vicaratāṃ viṣayeṣu svabhāvataḥ / nigrahaḥ procyate sadbhiḥ pratyāhārastu sattamāḥ
verses.translation: Sages say that the praise-worthy attitude of the man who regards whatever wealth is acquired through luck (without striving for it)as sufficient (to him), is called contentment and it is characterised by a feeling of happiness.
verses.hindi: माला न पहने। सिरके नीचे कण्ठमें माला पहननी चाहिए।
verses.wordMeaning: Sages say that the praise-worthy attitude of the man who regards whatever wealth is acquired through luck (without striving for it)as sufficient (to him), is called contentment and it is characterised by a feeling of happiness.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sages say that the praise-worthy attitude of the man who regards whatever wealth is acquired through luck (without striving for it)as sufficient (to him), is called contentment and it is characterised by a feeling of happiness.

verses.sanskrit: हृत्पुण्डरीके नाभ्यां वा मूर्ध्नि पर्वतमस्तके । एवमादिषु देशेषु धारणा चित्तबन्धनम्
verses.transliteration: hṛtpuṇḍarīke nābhyāṃ vā mūrdhni parvatamastake / evamādiṣu deśeṣu dhāraṇā cittabandhanam
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas, Sauca (cleanliness) is said to be twofold—the external and the internal. The external clean¬ liness is by means of clay and water, while the internal one con¬ sists of the purity of the mind.
verses.hindi: २-दाहिने कंधेके ऊपर तथा बाँयें हाथके नीचे यज्ञोपवीत जब रहता है तब अपसव्य कहा जाता है  ऐसा श्राद्ध आदि विशेष अवसरपर ही विहित है।
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahmanas, Sauca (cleanliness) is said to be twofold—the external and the internal. The external clean¬ liness is by means of clay and water, while the internal one con¬ sists of the purity of the mind.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmanas, Sauca (cleanliness) is said to be twofold—the external and the internal. The external clean¬ liness is by means of clay and water, while the internal one con¬ sists of the purity of the mind.

verses.sanskrit: देशावस्थितिमालम्ब्य बुद्धेर्या वृत्तिसंततिः । वृत्त्यन्तरैरसंसृष्टा तद्ध्यानं सूरयो विदुः
verses.transliteration: deśāvasthitimālambya buddheryā vṛttisaṃtatiḥ / vṛttyantarairasaṃsṛṣṭā taddhyānaṃ sūrayo viduḥ
verses.translation: The extremely steady devotion to Siva through the Verbal, mental and physical activities such as singing eulogy, recollection (of His Name etc.) and worship (of Siva) is called Isa Pujana (Worship of God).
verses.hindi: अभ्यसेत् प्रयतो वेदं महायज्ञान् न हापयेत्। कुर्याद् गृह्याणि कर्माणि संध्योपासनमेव च
verses.wordMeaning: The extremely steady devotion to Siva through the Verbal, mental and physical activities such as singing eulogy, recollection (of His Name etc.) and worship (of Siva) is called Isa Pujana (Worship of God).
verses.commentary: Sense: The extremely steady devotion to Siva through the Verbal, mental and physical activities such as singing eulogy, recollection (of His Name etc.) and worship (of Siva) is called Isa Pujana (Worship of God).

verses.sanskrit: एकाकारः समाधिः स्याद् देशालम्बनवर्जितः । प्रत्ययो ह्यर्थमात्रेण योगसाधनमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: ekākāraḥ samādhiḥ syād deśālambanavarjitaḥ / pratyayo hyarthamātreṇa yogasādhanamuttamam
verses.translation: The Tamas and the Niyamas have been expounded. Now understand the Prandydma. Prana is the air circulating with¬ in one's own body. Its restraint is called Ayama.
verses.hindi: हैवतान्यपि गच्छेत कुर्याद् भार्याभिपोषणम् न धर्म ख्यापयेद् विद्वान् न पापं गूहयेदपि। कुर्वीतात्महितं नित्यं सर्वभूतानुकम्पकः
verses.wordMeaning: The Tamas and the Niyamas have been expounded. Now understand the Prandydma. Prana is the air circulating with¬ in one's own body. Its restraint is called Ayama.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Tamas and the Niyamas have been expounded. Now understand the Prandydma. Prana is the air circulating with¬ in one's own body. Its restraint is called Ayama.

verses.sanskrit: धारणा द्वादशायामा ध्यानं द्वादशधारणाः । ध्यानं द्वादशकं यावत् समाधिरभिधीयते
verses.transliteration: dhāraṇā dvādaśāyāmā dhyānaṃ dvādaśadhāraṇāḥ / dhyānaṃ dvādaśakaṃ yāvat samādhirabhidhīyate
verses.translation: Pranayama is three-fold, the Uttama (excellent), Madhyama (the middling) znAthc Adhama (lowly). Another two¬ fold classification of Pranayama is Sagarbha and Agarbha (i.e. Pranayama with the repetition of Om or any other Mantra bija is Sagarbha and without it is called Agarbha).
verses.hindi: वयसः कर्मणोऽर्थस्य श्रुतस्याभिजनस्य च। वेषवाग्बुब्द्रिसारूप्यमाचरन् विचरेत् सदा
verses.wordMeaning: Pranayama is three-fold, the Uttama (excellent), Madhyama (the middling) znAthc Adhama (lowly). Another two¬ fold classification of Pranayama is Sagarbha and Agarbha (i.e. Pranayama with the repetition of Om or any other Mantra bija is Sagarbha and without it is called Agarbha).
verses.commentary: Sense: Pranayama is three-fold, the Uttama (excellent), Madhyama (the middling) znAthc Adhama (lowly). Another two¬ fold classification of Pranayama is Sagarbha and Agarbha (i.e. Pranayama with the repetition of Om or any other Mantra bija is Sagarbha and without it is called Agarbha).

verses.sanskrit: आसनं स्वस्तिकं प्रोक्तं पद्ममर्धासनं तथा । साधनानां च सर्वेषामेतत्साधनमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: āsanaṃ svastikaṃ proktaṃ padmamardhāsanaṃ tathā / sādhanānāṃ ca sarveṣāmetatsādhanamuttamam
verses.translation: That Yoga is called Sunapha and is the triumph of Sagarbha type of Pranayama. O learned ones, the sages say that this is the characteristic of the breath-control of Yogins.
verses.hindi: श्रुतिस्मृत्युदितः सम्यक् साधुभिर्यश्च सेवितः। तमाचारं निषेवेत नेहेतान्यत्र कर्हिचित् नित्यं स्वाध्यायशीलः स्यान्नित्यं यज्ञोपवीतवान्। सत्यवादी जितक्रोधो ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते
verses.wordMeaning: That Yoga is called Sunapha and is the triumph of Sagarbha type of Pranayama. O learned ones, the sages say that this is the characteristic of the breath-control of Yogins.
verses.commentary: Sense: That Yoga is called Sunapha and is the triumph of Sagarbha type of Pranayama. O learned ones, the sages say that this is the characteristic of the breath-control of Yogins.

verses.sanskrit: ऊर्वोरुपरि विप्रेन्द्राः कृत्वा पादतले उभे । समासीतात्मनः पद्ममेतदासनमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: ūrvorupari viprendrāḥ kṛtvā pādatale ubhe / samāsītātmanaḥ padmametadāsanamuttamam
verses.translation: Controlling one's breath, one should repeat three times the Gayatrl Mantra along with its Vyahrtis (OM Bhuh, Bhuvah, Svah) and its head. This is called the breath-control.
verses.hindi: संध्यास्नानपरो नित्यं ब्रह्मयज्ञपरायणः। अनसूयो मुदुर्दान्तो गृहस्थः प्रेत्य वर्धते
verses.wordMeaning: Controlling one's breath, one should repeat three times the Gayatrl Mantra along with its Vyahrtis (OM Bhuh, Bhuvah, Svah) and its head. This is called the breath-control.
verses.commentary: Sense: Controlling one's breath, one should repeat three times the Gayatrl Mantra along with its Vyahrtis (OM Bhuh, Bhuvah, Svah) and its head. This is called the breath-control.

verses.sanskrit: एकं पादमथैकस्मिन् विन्यस्योरुणि सत्तमाः । आसीतार्धासनमिदं योगसाधनमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: ekaṃ pādamathaikasmin vinyasyoruṇi sattamāḥ / āsītārdhāsanamidaṃ yogasādhanamuttamam
verses.translation: It is mentioned in all scriptures by Yogins of fully controlled minds, that the Pranayama consists of three stages Recaka, Puraka and Kumbhaka.
verses.hindi: दान्तो यज्वा देवभक्तो ब्रह्मलोके महीयते त्रिबर्गसेबी सततं देवतानां च पूजनम्। कुर्यादहरहर्नित्यं नमस्येत् प्रयतः सुरान्
verses.wordMeaning: It is mentioned in all scriptures by Yogins of fully controlled minds, that the Pranayama consists of three stages Recaka, Puraka and Kumbhaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is mentioned in all scriptures by Yogins of fully controlled minds, that the Pranayama consists of three stages Recaka, Puraka and Kumbhaka.

verses.sanskrit: उभे कृत्वा पादतले जानूर्वोरन्तरेण हि । समासीतात्मनः प्रोक्तमासनं स्वस्तिकं परम्
verses.transliteration: ubhe kṛtvā pādatale jānūrvorantareṇa hi / samāsītātmanaḥ proktamāsanaṃ svastikaṃ param
