verses.translation: Recaka is exhalation of breath while its retention (in¬ halation) is called Puraka. The state of equilibrium (between the two) is spoken of as Kujnbhaka.
verses.hindi: प्रयत्नपूर्वक वेदोंका अभ्यास करे। (पञ्च) महायज्ञोंका परित्याग न करे। अपने गृह्मसूत्रोंमें प्रतिपादित कर्माको करे और संध्योपासन कर्म करे
verses.wordMeaning: Recaka is exhalation of breath while its retention (in¬ halation) is called Puraka. The state of equilibrium (between the two) is spoken of as Kujnbhaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Recaka is exhalation of breath while its retention (in¬ halation) is called Puraka. The state of equilibrium (between the two) is spoken of as Kujnbhaka.

verses.sanskrit: अदेशकाले योगस्य दर्शनं हि न विद्यते । अग्न्यभ्यासे जले वापि शुष्कपर्णचये तथा
verses.transliteration: adeśakāle yogasya darśanaṃ hi na vidyate / agnyabhyāse jale vāpi śuṣkaparṇacaye tathā
verses.translation: O excellent men, it is said by good men that the res¬ traint of the sense-organs which are naturally straying over the pleasurable objects is called Pratyahara.
verses.hindi: अपने समान अथवा श्रेष्ठ व्यक्तिसे मित्रता करे। ईश्वरकी आराधना करे। देवताओंकी भी पूजा करे और अपनी भार्याका भलीभाँति पोषण करे। विद्वान् व्यक्तिको चाहिए कि (अपने द्वारा अनुष्ठित) धर्मका वर्णन न करे और न अपने द्वारा किये गये पापको ही छिपाये। आत्मकल्याणका प्रयत्न करे और सहैव सभी प्राणियोंपर दया करे। अपनी अवस्था, कर्म, सम्पत्ति, ज्ञान और कुलके अनुसार सदा वेष धारण करे तथा संयत-वाणी
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent men, it is said by good men that the res¬ traint of the sense-organs which are naturally straying over the pleasurable objects is called Pratyahara.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent men, it is said by good men that the res¬ traint of the sense-organs which are naturally straying over the pleasurable objects is called Pratyahara.

verses.sanskrit: जन्तुव्याप्ते श्मशाने च जीर्णगोष्ठे चतुष्पथे । सशब्दे सभये वापि चैत्यवल्मीकसंचये
verses.transliteration: jantuvyāpte śmaśāne ca jīrṇagoṣṭhe catuṣpathe / saśabde sabhaye vāpi caityavalmīkasaṃcaye
verses.translation: Dharana is the fixation of the mind in the lotus of the heart, umbilical region, cerebral region limbs, forehead and such other spots.
verses.hindi: और बुद्धिसे यथोचित आचरण करते हुए लौकिक व्यवहारका निर्वाह करे। वेदों तथा धर्मशास्त्रोंमें जो कहा गया हो और जो सत्पुरुषोंसे भलीभाँति अनुष्ठित हो, उसी सदाचारका पालन करना चाहिए। इसके
verses.wordMeaning: Dharana is the fixation of the mind in the lotus of the heart, umbilical region, cerebral region limbs, forehead and such other spots.
verses.commentary: Sense: Dharana is the fixation of the mind in the lotus of the heart, umbilical region, cerebral region limbs, forehead and such other spots.

verses.sanskrit: अशुभे दुर्जनाक्रान्ते मशकादिसमन्विते । नाचरेद् देहबाधे वा दौर्मनस्यादिसंभवे
verses.transliteration: aśubhe durjanākrānte maśakādisamanvite / nācared dehabādhe vā daurmanasyādisaṃbhave
verses.translation: Learned men called Dhyana (contemplation) as the continuous concentration of mind which is fixed on particular spot (part of the body) and is undistracted by any other object nearby.
verses.hindi: अतिरिक्त कभी भी दूसरे आचारका पालन नहीँ करना चाहिए यदि शास्त्रोंसे अपने मार्गका निर्धारण करनेमें किसी कारण असामर्थ्य हो तो (शास्त्रोक्त) जिस मार्गसे माता- पिता गये हों और पितामह आदिने जिस मार्गका अवलम्बन किया हो, उसी मार्गका स्वयं भी अनुसरण
verses.wordMeaning: Learned men called Dhyana (contemplation) as the continuous concentration of mind which is fixed on particular spot (part of the body) and is undistracted by any other object nearby.
verses.commentary: Sense: Learned men called Dhyana (contemplation) as the continuous concentration of mind which is fixed on particular spot (part of the body) and is undistracted by any other object nearby.

verses.sanskrit: सुगुप्ते सुशुभे देशे गुहायां पर्वतस्य तु । नद्यास्तीरे पुण्यदेशे देवतायतने तथा
verses.transliteration: sugupte suśubhe deśe guhāyāṃ parvatasya tu / nadyāstīre puṇyadeśe devatāyatane tathā
verses.translation: The perception of one form (object of contemplation) alone is Samadhi (trance) wherein the awareness ofthe surround¬ ing place is absent. Only the object is perceived. This is the excellent injunction in the Yoga.
verses.hindi: करना चाहिए। यही सज्जनोंका मार्ग है। इस मार्गका अवलम्बन करनेवालेका पतन नहीं होता
verses.wordMeaning: The perception of one form (object of contemplation) alone is Samadhi (trance) wherein the awareness ofthe surround¬ ing place is absent. Only the object is perceived. This is the excellent injunction in the Yoga.
verses.commentary: Sense: The perception of one form (object of contemplation) alone is Samadhi (trance) wherein the awareness ofthe surround¬ ing place is absent. Only the object is perceived. This is the excellent injunction in the Yoga.

verses.sanskrit: गृहे वा सुशुभे रम्ये विजने जन्तुवर्जिते । युञ्जीत योगी सततमात्मानं मत्परायणः
verses.transliteration: gṛhe vā suśubhe ramye vijane jantuvarjite / yuñjīta yogī satatamātmānaṃ matparāyaṇaḥ
verses.translation: Twelve Pranayamas lead up to the Dharana; twelve Dharanas lead into Dhyana. Twelve such Dhyanas are said to constitute a Samadhi.
verses.hindi: नित्य स्वाध्यायपरायण रहे, नित्य यज्ञोपवीत धारण करनेवाला, ब्रह्मस्वरूप हो जाता है। नित्य स्नान और संध्या करनेवाला, ब्रह्मयज्ञ (स्वाध्याय) -परायण रहनेवाला, असूयारहित, मृदु तथा जितेन्द्रिय गृहस्थ परलोकमें अभ्युदय प्राप्त करता है। राग, भय और क्रोधसे रहित,
verses.wordMeaning: Twelve Pranayamas lead up to the Dharana; twelve Dharanas lead into Dhyana. Twelve such Dhyanas are said to constitute a Samadhi.
verses.commentary: Sense: Twelve Pranayamas lead up to the Dharana; twelve Dharanas lead into Dhyana. Twelve such Dhyanas are said to constitute a Samadhi.

verses.sanskrit: नमस्कृत्य तु योगीन्द्रान् सशिष्यांश्च विनायकम् । गुरुं चैवाथ मां योगी युञ्जीत सुसमाहितः
verses.transliteration: namaskṛtya tu yogīndrān saśiṣyāṃśca vināyakam / guruṃ caivātha māṃ yogī yuñjīta susamāhitaḥ
verses.translation: Asanas (bodily postures) are (mainly three) Svastika, Padma and Ardha. This is the most excellent of all means.
verses.hindi: लोभ एवं मोहसे शून्य, गायत्रीके जपमें तत्पर रहनेवाला और श्राद्ध करनेवाला गृहस्थ मुक्त हो जाता है। माता, पिता, गौ और ब्राह्मणके हित करनेमें निरत रहनेवाला, जितेन्द्रि यजन करनेवाला तथा देवताओंका भक्त
verses.wordMeaning: Asanas (bodily postures) are (mainly three) Svastika, Padma and Ardha. This is the most excellent of all means.
verses.commentary: Sense: Asanas (bodily postures) are (mainly three) Svastika, Padma and Ardha. This is the most excellent of all means.

verses.sanskrit: आसनं स्वस्तिकं बद्ध्वा पद्ममर्धमथापि वा । नासिकाग्रे समां दृष्टिमीषदुन्मीलितेक्षणः
verses.transliteration: āsanaṃ svastikaṃ baddhvā padmamardhamathāpi vā / nāsikāgre samāṃ dṛṣṭimīṣadunmīlitekṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: O leading Brahmanas, the soles of both the feet are placed over the thighs. Sitting thus is called the excellent Padma posture.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मलोकमें प्रतिष्ठा प्रात करता है। निरन्तर (धर्म, अर्थ एवं कामरूप) त्रिवर्गका पालन और देवताओंका पूजन करना चाहिए तथा प्रयत्नपूर्वक नित्य देवताओंको नमस्कार करना चाहिए॥ २१--२५॥ यथाशक्ति चरन् कर्म निन्दितानि विवर्जयेत्
verses.wordMeaning: O leading Brahmanas, the soles of both the feet are placed over the thighs. Sitting thus is called the excellent Padma posture.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading Brahmanas, the soles of both the feet are placed over the thighs. Sitting thus is called the excellent Padma posture.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वाथ निर्भयः शान्तस्त्यक्त्वा मायामयं जगत् । स्वात्मन्यवस्थितं देवं चिन्तयेत् परमेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: kṛtvātha nirbhayaḥ śāntastyaktvā māyāmayaṃ jagat / svātmanyavasthitaṃ devaṃ cintayet parameśvaram
verses.translation: Both the soles of the feet are placed in between the knees and the things; seating oneself in this excellent posture is called Svastika.
verses.hindi: गृहस्थो मुच्यते बन्धात् नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.wordMeaning: Both the soles of the feet are placed in between the knees and the things; seating oneself in this excellent posture is called Svastika.
verses.commentary: Sense: Both the soles of the feet are placed in between the knees and the things; seating oneself in this excellent posture is called Svastika.

verses.sanskrit: शिखाग्रे द्वादशाङ्गुल्ये कल्पयित्वाथ पङ्कजम् । धर्मकन्दसमुद्भूतं ज्ञाननालं सुशोभनम्
verses.transliteration: śikhāgre dvādaśāṅgulye kalpayitvātha paṅkajam / dharmakandasamudbhūtaṃ jñānanālaṃ suśobhanam
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas, when one sits placing one's foot on the other thigh (e.g. right foot on the left thigh), it becomes Ardhasana. It is an excellent posture for the accomplishment of Yoga.
verses.hindi: स्वदुःखेष्विव कारुण्यं परदुःखेषु सौहृदात्। दयेति मुनयः प्राहुः साक्षाद् धर्मस्य साधनम् विज्ञानमिति तद् विद्याद् येन धर्मो विवर्धते
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahmanas, when one sits placing one's foot on the other thigh (e.g. right foot on the left thigh), it becomes Ardhasana. It is an excellent posture for the accomplishment of Yoga.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmanas, when one sits placing one's foot on the other thigh (e.g. right foot on the left thigh), it becomes Ardhasana. It is an excellent posture for the accomplishment of Yoga.

verses.sanskrit: ऐश्वर्याष्टदलं श्वेतं परं वैराग्यकर्णिकम् । चिन्तयेत् परमं कोशं कर्णिकायां हिरण्मयम्
verses.transliteration: aiśvaryāṣṭadalaṃ śvetaṃ paraṃ vairāgyakarṇikam / cintayet paramaṃ kośaṃ karṇikāyāṃ hiraṇmayam
verses.translation: Yoga is not seen practised at in the improper time or in an unsuitable place; nor should it be practised near fire in water or on dried leaf-stack.
verses.hindi: धर्मकार्यान्निवृत्तश्चेन्न तद् विज्ञानमिष्यते
verses.wordMeaning: Yoga is not seen practised at in the improper time or in an unsuitable place; nor should it be practised near fire in water or on dried leaf-stack.
verses.commentary: Sense: Yoga is not seen practised at in the improper time or in an unsuitable place; nor should it be practised near fire in water or on dried leaf-stack.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वशक्तिमयं साक्षाद् यं प्राहुर्दिव्यमव्ययम् । ओङ्कारवाच्यमव्यक्तं रश्मिजालसमाकुलम्
verses.transliteration: sarvaśaktimayaṃ sākṣād yaṃ prāhurdivyamavyayam / oṅkāravācyamavyaktaṃ raśmijālasamākulam
verses.translation: After bowing down to leading Yogins,i their disciples. Lord Vinayaka, his own preceptor and me, the Yogin shall begin the practice of Yoga with full concentration of the mind.
verses.hindi: सत्येन लोकाञ्जयति सत्यं तत्परमं पदम्। यथाभूतप्रवादं तु सत्यमाहुर्मनीषिणः अपनी सम्पत्तिका (शास्त्रानुसार यथायोग्य) सदा विभाग करनेवालाः, क्षमावान्, दयायुक्त व्यक्ति ही गृहस्थ कहलाता है। केवल गृहमें रहनेसे कोई गृहस्थ नहीं कहलाता। क्षमा, दया, विशिष्ट ज्ञान (लौकिक
verses.wordMeaning: After bowing down to leading Yogins,i their disciples. Lord Vinayaka, his own preceptor and me, the Yogin shall begin the practice of Yoga with full concentration of the mind.
verses.commentary: Sense: After bowing down to leading Yogins,i their disciples. Lord Vinayaka, his own preceptor and me, the Yogin shall begin the practice of Yoga with full concentration of the mind.

verses.sanskrit: चिन्तयेत् तत्र विमलं परं ज्योतिर्यदक्षरम् । तस्मिन् ज्योतिषि विन्यस्यस्वात्मानं तदभेदतः
verses.transliteration: cintayet tatra vimalaṃ paraṃ jyotiryadakṣaram / tasmin jyotiṣi vinyasyasvātmānaṃ tadabhedataḥ
verses.translation: One should meditate on it with concentration and think of Mahesvara as a single form, after purifying all the principles through Pranava.
verses.hindi: एवं शास्त्रीय ज्ञान), सत्य, दम, शम और अध्यात्मज्ञानमें निरत होना-यह ब्राह्मणका लक्षण है। यथाशक्ति (विहित) कर्माको करते हुए निन्दित कर्मोका परित्याग करना चाहिए॥ २६--२८ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: One should meditate on it with concentration and think of Mahesvara as a single form, after purifying all the principles through Pranava.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should meditate on it with concentration and think of Mahesvara as a single form, after purifying all the principles through Pranava.

verses.sanskrit: ध्यायीताकाशमध्यस्थमीशं परमकारणम् । तदात्मा सर्वगो भूत्वा न किञ्चिदपि चिन्तयेत्
verses.transliteration: dhyāyītākāśamadhyasthamīśaṃ paramakāraṇam / tadātmā sarvago bhūtvā na kiñcidapi cintayet
verses.translation: Or the Atman should be fixed in the greatest region which is free from impurity, after purifying one's own body with the self-same water of perfect knowledge.
verses.hindi: विशेषरूपसे श्रेष्ठ द्विजको इस सम्बन्धमें प्रमाद नहीं करना चाहिए। मोहरूपी कल्मषको धोकर और श्रेष्ठ योगको प्राप्तकर गृहस्थ बन्धनसे मुक्त हो जाता है। इसमें संशय नहीं करना चाहिए। दूसरेके क्रोधसे उत्पन्न ताड्नस्वरूप दोषोंको सहना ही क्षमा है
verses.wordMeaning: Or the Atman should be fixed in the greatest region which is free from impurity, after purifying one's own body with the self-same water of perfect knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or the Atman should be fixed in the greatest region which is free from impurity, after purifying one's own body with the self-same water of perfect knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: एतद् गुह्यतमं ध्यानं ध्यानान्तरमथोच्यते । चिन्तयित्वा तु पूर्वोक्तं हृदये पद्ममुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: etad guhyatamaṃ dhyānaṃ dhyānāntaramathocyate / cintayitvā tu pūrvoktaṃ hṛdaye padmamuttamam
verses.translation: One should dedicate one's soul unto me and concentrate one's mind in me and take up the Bhasma from the
verses.hindi: सौहार्दवश अपने दुःखके समान ही दूसरोंके दुःखमें उनके प्रति करुणाभावको मुनियोंने 'दया' इस नामसे कहा है। यह धर्मका साक्षात् साधन है। चौदह विद्याओंको यथार्थरूपसे धारण करनेको ही विज्ञान
verses.wordMeaning: One should dedicate one's soul unto me and concentrate one's mind in me and take up the Bhasma from the
verses.commentary: Sense: One should dedicate one's soul unto me and concentrate one's mind in me and take up the Bhasma from the

verses.sanskrit: आत्मानमथ कर्तारं तत्रानलसमत्विषम् । मध्ये वह्निशिखाकारं पुरुषं पञ्चविंशकम्
verses.transliteration: ātmānamatha kartāraṃ tatrānalasamatviṣam / madhye vahniśikhākāraṃ puruṣaṃ pañcaviṃśakam
verses.translation: Then one should meditate upon Lord Isana in the form of the supreme light within one's own Atman. This is the Yoga, pertaining to Pasupati. It is conducive to the liberation of the Fasu from the Pasa.
verses.hindi: समझना चाहिए  इससे धर्मकी वृद्धि होती है। विधिपूर्वक विद्याको ग्रहण कर लेने और उसके अर्थको भलीभाँति जान लेनेपर भी यदि (कोई व्यक्ति) धर्म-कायाँसे निवृत्त (विरत) रहता है, उन्हें नहीं करता तो उसका वह (अध्ययन) विज्ञान नहीं कहलाता है॥ ३१--३३ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Then one should meditate upon Lord Isana in the form of the supreme light within one's own Atman. This is the Yoga, pertaining to Pasupati. It is conducive to the liberation of the Fasu from the Pasa.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then one should meditate upon Lord Isana in the form of the supreme light within one's own Atman. This is the Yoga, pertaining to Pasupati. It is conducive to the liberation of the Fasu from the Pasa.

verses.sanskrit: चिन्तयेत् परमात्मानं तन्मध्ये गगनं परम् । ओङ्करबोधितं तत्त्वं शाश्वतं शिवमच्युतम्
verses.transliteration: cintayet paramātmānaṃ tanmadhye gaganaṃ param / oṅkarabodhitaṃ tattvaṃ śāśvataṃ śivamacyutam
verses.translation: This is the path of all the Vedantas. The Sruti says that it is beyond all Asramas (stages of life). This is the greatest esoteric truth that should be concealed as it bestows Sayujya with absorption in me.
verses.hindi: सत्यके आचरणसे लोकोंपर विजय प्राप्त होती है, सत्य ही वह (सर्वोच्च) परमपद है। जो जैसा है उसका उसी रूपमें कथन ही मनीषियोंने सत्य कहा है। शरीरका उपरम (शरीरकी चेष्टाओंका नियन्त्रण अर्थात्
verses.wordMeaning: This is the path of all the Vedantas. The Sruti says that it is beyond all Asramas (stages of life). This is the greatest esoteric truth that should be concealed as it bestows Sayujya with absorption in me.
verses.commentary: Sense: This is the path of all the Vedantas. The Sruti says that it is beyond all Asramas (stages of life). This is the greatest esoteric truth that should be concealed as it bestows Sayujya with absorption in me.

verses.sanskrit: अव्यक्तं प्रकृतौ लीनं परं ज्योतिरनुत्तमम् । तदन्तः परमं तत्त्वमात्माधारं निरञ्जनम्
verses.transliteration: avyaktaṃ prakṛtau līnaṃ paraṃ jyotiranuttamam / tadantaḥ paramaṃ tattvamātmādhāraṃ nirañjanam
verses.translation: Hence, you all should worship me, the supreme Lord, by means of the path of knowledge or the path of devotion or by means of the greatest Vmagya (detachment).
verses.hindi: इन्द्रियोंका निग्रह) दम है और शम (मनका नियन्त्रण) प्रज्ञा (प्रकृष्ट ज्ञान)-के विशद अवभाससे उत्पन्न होता है। अध्यात्म (आत्म-सम्बन्धी) ज्ञानको ही अविनश्वर तत्त्व समझना चाहिए जहाँ पहुँचनेपर शोक नहीं १-सम्पत्तिका पाँच भाग--( १) धर्मके लिये, (२) यशके लिये, (३) सम्पत्तिको बढ़ानेके लिये, (४) अपने भोगके लिये, (५) स्वजनके लिये-करनेसे इस लोक तथा परलोकमें सुख प्राप्त होता है। २-चार वेद, छः वेदाङ्ग (-शिक्षा, कल्प, व्याकरण, निरुक्त, छन्दःशास्त्र, ज्योतिष), पुराण, न्यायशास्त्र, मीमांसा और
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, you all should worship me, the supreme Lord, by means of the path of knowledge or the path of devotion or by means of the greatest Vmagya (detachment).
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, you all should worship me, the supreme Lord, by means of the path of knowledge or the path of devotion or by means of the greatest Vmagya (detachment).

verses.sanskrit: ध्यायीत तन्मयो नित्यमेकरूपं महेश्वरम् । विशोध्य सर्वतत्त्वानि प्रणवेनाथवा पुनः
verses.transliteration: dhyāyīta tanmayo nityamekarūpaṃ maheśvaram / viśodhya sarvatattvāni praṇavenāthavā punaḥ
verses.translation: Ever pure, one should worship me with the mind endowed with enlightenment. He should renounce all Karmas, accept no monetary gift and should partake of the alms (volun¬ tarily given).
verses.hindi: धर्मशास्त्र-ये चौदह विद्याएँ हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Ever pure, one should worship me with the mind endowed with enlightenment. He should renounce all Karmas, accept no monetary gift and should partake of the alms (volun¬ tarily given).
verses.commentary: Sense: Ever pure, one should worship me with the mind endowed with enlightenment. He should renounce all Karmas, accept no monetary gift and should partake of the alms (volun¬ tarily given).

verses.sanskrit: संस्थाप्य मयि चात्मानं निर्मले परमे पदे । प्लावयित्वात्मनो देहं तेनैव ज्ञानवारिणा
verses.transliteration: saṃsthāpya mayi cātmānaṃ nirmale parame pade / plāvayitvātmano dehaṃ tenaiva jñānavāriṇā
verses.translation: Lihga pertaining to Isvara must be conceived of in jewels etc., and the Lord may be worshipped. All this is one with Lihga and everything is within Lihga.
verses.hindi: ३२२ + कूर्मपुराण मे यया स देवो भगवान् विद्यया वेद्यते पर: । साक्षाद् देवो महादेवस्तज्ज्ञानमिति कीर्तितम्
verses.wordMeaning: Lihga pertaining to Isvara must be conceived of in jewels etc., and the Lord may be worshipped. All this is one with Lihga and everything is within Lihga.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lihga pertaining to Isvara must be conceived of in jewels etc., and the Lord may be worshipped. All this is one with Lihga and everything is within Lihga.

verses.sanskrit: मदात्मा मन्मयो भस्म गृहीत्वा ह्यग्निहोत्रजम् । तेनोद्धृत्य तु सर्वाङ्गमग्निरित्यादिमन्त्रतः । चिन्तयेत् स्वात्मनीशानं परं ज्योतिः स्वरूपिणम्
verses.transliteration: madātmā manmayo bhasma gṛhītvā hyagnihotrajam / tenoddhṛtya tu sarvāṅgamagnirityādimantrataḥ / cintayet svātmanīśānaṃ paraṃ jyotiḥ svarūpiṇam
verses.translation: Hence, O Brahmanas, one should always resort to virtuous activities for the sake of liberation. This is the secret of the Vedas. It should not be given (indiscriminately) to any one and everyone.
verses.hindi: महायज्ञपरो विप्रो लभते तदनुत्तमम्
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, O Brahmanas, one should always resort to virtuous activities for the sake of liberation. This is the secret of the Vedas. It should not be given (indiscriminately) to any one and everyone.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, O Brahmanas, one should always resort to virtuous activities for the sake of liberation. This is the secret of the Vedas. It should not be given (indiscriminately) to any one and everyone.

verses.sanskrit: एष पाशुपतो योगः पशुपाशविमुक्तये । सर्ववेदान्तसारो ऽयमत्याश्रममिति श्रुतिः
verses.transliteration: eṣa pāśupato yogaḥ paśupāśavimuktaye / sarvavedāntasāro 'yamatyāśramamiti śrutiḥ
verses.translation: This auspicious knowledge of Brahman should be imparted by you to the disciples of quiescent minds". After mentioning this matter, the unborn Lord spoke to the leading Yogins.
verses.hindi: धर्मस्यायतनं यत्राच्छरीरं परिपालयेत्। न हि देहं विना रुद्रः पुरुषैर्विद्यते परः नित्यं धर्मार्थकामेषु युज्येत नियतो द्विज: । न धर्मवर्जितं काममर्थं वा मनसा स्मरेत्
verses.wordMeaning: This auspicious knowledge of Brahman should be imparted by you to the disciples of quiescent minds". After mentioning this matter, the unborn Lord spoke to the leading Yogins.
verses.commentary: Sense: This auspicious knowledge of Brahman should be imparted by you to the disciples of quiescent minds". After mentioning this matter, the unborn Lord spoke to the leading Yogins.

verses.sanskrit: एतत् परतरं गुह्यं मत्सायुज्योपपादकम् । द्विजातीनां तु कथितं भक्तानां ब्रह्मचारिणाम्
verses.transliteration: etat parataraṃ guhyaṃ matsāyujyopapādakam / dvijātīnāṃ tu kathitaṃ bhaktānāṃ brahmacāriṇām
verses.translation: Baudhayana Gr. S. II.5.47-53, also Manu II. 49-50.
verses.hindi: सीदन्नपि हि धर्मेण न त्वधर्म समाचरेत्। धर्मो हि भगवान् देवो गतिः सर्वेषु जन्तुषु
verses.wordMeaning: Baudhayana Gr. S. II.5.47-53, also Manu II. 49-50.
verses.commentary: Sense: Baudhayana Gr. S. II.5.47-53, also Manu II. 49-50.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मचर्यमहिंसा च क्षमा शौचं तपो दमः । संतोषः सत्यमास्तिक्यं व्रताङ्गानि विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: brahmacaryamahiṃsā ca kṣamā śaucaṃ tapo damaḥ / saṃtoṣaḥ satyamāstikyaṃ vratāṅgāni viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: This method of clasping the feet of the preceptor is prescribed in Dh. S. of Visnu (28.15), Baudhayana (1.2.24) and Manu 11.72.
verses.hindi: भूतानां प्रियकारी स्यात् न परद्रोहकर्मधीः । न वेददेवतानिन्दां कुर्यात् तैश्च न संवसेत् यस्त्विमं नियतं विप्रो धर्माध्यायं पठेच्छुचि: । अध्यापयेत् श्रावयेद् वा ब्रह्मलोके महीयते
verses.wordMeaning: This method of clasping the feet of the preceptor is prescribed in Dh. S. of Visnu (28.15), Baudhayana (1.2.24) and Manu 11.72.
verses.commentary: Sense: This method of clasping the feet of the preceptor is prescribed in Dh. S. of Visnu (28.15), Baudhayana (1.2.24) and Manu 11.72.

verses.sanskrit: एकेनाप्यथ हीनेन व्रतमस्य तु लुप्यते । तस्मादात्मगुणोपेतो मद्व्रतं वोढुमर्हति
verses.transliteration: ekenāpyatha hīnena vratamasya tu lupyate / tasmādātmaguṇopeto madvrataṃ voḍhumarhati
verses.translation: As this path dispels all sins and is meritorious and as it is resorted to by multitudes of sages, listen to it with attentive mind, even as I narrate it to all of you.
verses.hindi: जिस विद्याके द्वारा वे परात्पर देवाधिदेव साक्षात् भगवान् महादेव जाने जाते हैं, उसे ही ज्ञान कहा गया है। उनमें निष्ठा रखनेवाला, उनके परायण रहनेवाला, कभी भी क्रोध न करनेवाला, पवित्र, (पञ्च) महायज्ञोंको
verses.wordMeaning: As this path dispels all sins and is meritorious and as it is resorted to by multitudes of sages, listen to it with attentive mind, even as I narrate it to all of you.
verses.commentary: Sense: As this path dispels all sins and is meritorious and as it is resorted to by multitudes of sages, listen to it with attentive mind, even as I narrate it to all of you.

verses.sanskrit: वीतरागभयक्रोधा मन्मया मामुपाश्रिताः । बहवो ऽनेन योगेन पूता मद्भावमागताः
verses.transliteration: vītarāgabhayakrodhā manmayā māmupāśritāḥ / bahavo 'nena yogena pūtā madbhāvamāgatāḥ
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas, in the eighth year of his life from the day of conception or from the day of birth one should be invested with the sacred thread in accordance with the injunc¬ tions of one's own Sutra. He should then study the Vedas.
verses.hindi: करनेवाला विद्वान् विप्र उस श्रेष्ठ तत्त्वको प्राप्त करता है। धर्मके आयतन इस शरीरका प्रयत्नपूर्वक पालन करना चाहिए। बिना देहके मनुष्य उस परात्पर रुद्रको नहीं जान सकता। नियत (संयत) द्विजको नित्य धर्म, अर्थ एवं कामकी साधनामें लगे रहना चाहिए। धर्मे रहित काम अथवा अर्थका मनसे भी स्मरण नहीं करना चाहिए। धर्मके पालनमें कष्ट पाते हुए भी (उसका परित्यागकर) अधर्मका आचरण नहीं करना चाहिए।
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahmanas, in the eighth year of his life from the day of conception or from the day of birth one should be invested with the sacred thread in accordance with the injunc¬ tions of one's own Sutra. He should then study the Vedas.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmanas, in the eighth year of his life from the day of conception or from the day of birth one should be invested with the sacred thread in accordance with the injunc¬ tions of one's own Sutra. He should then study the Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: ये यथा मां प्रपद्यन्ते तांस्तथैव भजाम्यहम् । ज्ञानयोगेन मां तस्माद् यजेत परमेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: ye yathā māṃ prapadyante tāṃstathaiva bhajāmyaham / jñānayogena māṃ tasmād yajeta parameśvaram
verses.translation: He should have a ritualistic staff, wear a girdle and a secred thread and the skin of a black antelope, subsist on alms, observe celibacy and should stay happily in his hermitage (or stage of life).
verses.hindi: धर्मदेवता ही सभी प्राणियोंके भगवान् और गति हैं। (इसलिये) प्राणियोंका प्रिय करनेवाला बनना चाहिए। दूसरोंसे द्रोह करनेकी बुद्धिवाला नहीं होना चाहिए। वेदकी तथा देवताओंकी निन्दा नहीं करनी चाहिए और
verses.wordMeaning: He should have a ritualistic staff, wear a girdle and a secred thread and the skin of a black antelope, subsist on alms, observe celibacy and should stay happily in his hermitage (or stage of life).
verses.commentary: Sense: He should have a ritualistic staff, wear a girdle and a secred thread and the skin of a black antelope, subsist on alms, observe celibacy and should stay happily in his hermitage (or stage of life).

verses.sanskrit: अथवा भक्तियोगेन वैराग्येण परेण तु । चेतसा बोधयुक्तेन पूजयेन्मां सदा शुचिः
verses.transliteration: athavā bhaktiyogena vairāgyeṇa pareṇa tu / cetasā bodhayuktena pūjayenmāṃ sadā śuciḥ
verses.translation: Cotton thread was created formerly by Brahma for the purpose of Upavita (sacred thread). It consists of thrice- spun yarn. It should be made of Kusa grass or cotton.
verses.hindi: (जो इनकी निन्दा करता है) उसके साथ रहना (भी) नहीं चाहिए॥ ३६--४१॥ जो विप्र पवित्रतापूर्वक नित्य इस धर्माध्यायका अध्ययन, अध्यापन अथवा उपदेश करता है, वह ब्रह्मलोकमें प्रतिष्ठा प्रात करता है
verses.wordMeaning: Cotton thread was created formerly by Brahma for the purpose of Upavita (sacred thread). It consists of thrice- spun yarn. It should be made of Kusa grass or cotton.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cotton thread was created formerly by Brahma for the purpose of Upavita (sacred thread). It consists of thrice- spun yarn. It should be made of Kusa grass or cotton.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वकर्माणि संन्यस्य भिक्षाशी निष्परिग्रहः । प्राप्नोति मम सायुज्यं गुह्यमेतन्मयोदितम्
verses.transliteration: sarvakarmāṇi saṃnyasya bhikṣāśī niṣparigrahaḥ / prāpnoti mama sāyujyaṃ guhyametanmayoditam
verses.translation: A Brahmana should always wear the sacred thread and keep his tuft of hair (on the head) tied into a knot. Otherwise, whatever rite he performs shall be futile.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षद्साहक्रथां संहितायामुपरिविभागे पञ्चदशोऽध्यायः
verses.wordMeaning: A Brahmana should always wear the sacred thread and keep his tuft of hair (on the head) tied into a knot. Otherwise, whatever rite he performs shall be futile.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmana should always wear the sacred thread and keep his tuft of hair (on the head) tied into a knot. Otherwise, whatever rite he performs shall be futile.

verses.sanskrit: अद्वेष्टा सर्वभूतानां मैत्रः करुण एव च । निर्ममो निरहङ्कारो यो मद्भक्तः स मे प्रियः
verses.transliteration: adveṣṭā sarvabhūtānāṃ maitraḥ karuṇa eva ca / nirmamo nirahaṅkāro yo madbhaktaḥ sa me priyaḥ
verses.translation: He should wear unmutilated (unsewn?) cloth of cotton (which may be) ochre-coloured. White cloth without holes (i.e. not torn) is the excellent wearing apparel.
verses.hindi: नित्यं याचनको न स्यात् पुनस्तं नैव याचयेत्। प्राणानपहरत्येवं याचकस्तस्य दुर्मत्तिः न देवद्रव्यहारी स्याद् विशेषेण द्विजोत्तमः। ब्रह्मस्वं वा नापहरेदापद्यपि कदाचन
verses.wordMeaning: He should wear unmutilated (unsewn?) cloth of cotton (which may be) ochre-coloured. White cloth without holes (i.e. not torn) is the excellent wearing apparel.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should wear unmutilated (unsewn?) cloth of cotton (which may be) ochre-coloured. White cloth without holes (i.e. not torn) is the excellent wearing apparel.

verses.sanskrit: संतुष्टः सततं योगी यतात्मा दृढनिश्चयः । मय्यर्पितमनो बुद्धिर्यो मद्भक्तः स मे प्रियः
verses.transliteration: saṃtuṣṭaḥ satataṃ yogī yatātmā dṛḍhaniścayaḥ / mayyarpitamano buddhiryo madbhaktaḥ sa me priyaḥ
verses.translation: The skin of the black antelope makes an excellent upper cloth. It is auspicious. If the hide of the antelope is not available, that of Ruru deer is prescribed.
verses.hindi: न विषं विषमित्याहुर्ब्रह्मस्वं विषमुच्यते । देवस्वं चापि यत्नेन सदा परिहरेत् ततः
verses.wordMeaning: The skin of the black antelope makes an excellent upper cloth. It is auspicious. If the hide of the antelope is not available, that of Ruru deer is prescribed.
verses.commentary: Sense: The skin of the black antelope makes an excellent upper cloth. It is auspicious. If the hide of the antelope is not available, that of Ruru deer is prescribed.

verses.sanskrit: यस्मान्नोद्विजते लोको लोकान्नोद्विजते च यः । हर्षामर्षभयोद्वेगैर्मुक्तो यः स हि मे प्रियः
verses.transliteration: yasmānnodvijate loko lokānnodvijate ca yaḥ / harṣāmarṣabhayodvegairmukto yaḥ sa hi me priyaḥ
verses.translation: If the thread is placed over the left arm and under the right arm it is called Upavita.' This is the way in which it is always worn. If it is worn round the neck (like a garland) it is called JVivita.
verses.hindi: पुष्पे शाकोदके काष्ठे तथा मूले फले तृणे। अदत्तादानमस्तेयं मनुः प्राह प्रजापतिः ग्रहीतव्यानि पुष्पाणि देवार्चनविधौ द्विजाः । नैकस्मादेव नियतमननुज्ञाय केवलम्
verses.wordMeaning: If the thread is placed over the left arm and under the right arm it is called Upavita.' This is the way in which it is always worn. If it is worn round the neck (like a garland) it is called JVivita.
verses.commentary: Sense: If the thread is placed over the left arm and under the right arm it is called Upavita.' This is the way in which it is always worn. If it is worn round the neck (like a garland) it is called JVivita.

verses.sanskrit: अनपेक्षः शुचिर्दक्ष उदासीनो गतव्यथः । सर्वारम्भपरित्यागी भक्तिमान् यः स मे प्रियः
verses.transliteration: anapekṣaḥ śucirdakṣa udāsīno gatavyathaḥ / sarvārambhaparityāgī bhaktimān yaḥ sa me priyaḥ
verses.translation: O Brahmanas, if the thread is worn over the right arm and under the left arm it is called Pracindvita. It should be followed at the time of the performance of the rites for the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: तृणं काष्ठं फलं पुष्पं प्रकाशं वै हरेद् बुधः ।
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas, if the thread is worn over the right arm and under the left arm it is called Pracindvita. It should be followed at the time of the performance of the rites for the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas, if the thread is worn over the right arm and under the left arm it is called Pracindvita. It should be followed at the time of the performance of the rites for the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: तुल्यनिन्दास्तुतिर्मौनी संतुष्टो येन केनचित् । अनिकेतः स्थिरमतिर्मद्भक्तो मामुपैष्यति
verses.transliteration: tulyanindāstutirmaunī saṃtuṣṭo yena kenacit / aniketaḥ sthiramatirmadbhakto māmupaiṣyati
verses.translation: The girdle of the Brahmana should be made of the Munja grass twisted three times. It shall be soft and of equal thickness throughout. There may be one or three knots. O Brahmanas, (if Munja grass is unavailable), it may be made of Kusa grass as well.
verses.hindi: व्यासजीने कहा किसी भी प्राणीकी हिंसा नहीं करनी चाहिए और कभी भी झूठ नहीं बोलना चाहिए। अहितकर और अप्रिय वचन नहीं बोलना चाहिए और कभी भी चोरी नहीं करनी चाहिए। दूसरेके तृण, शाक, मिट्टी अथवा जलका भी अपहरण करनेवाला प्राणी नरक प्राप्त करता है। राजा, शूद्र तथा पतित व्यक्तिसे दान नहीं लेना चाहिए। अशक्त होनेपर भी दूसरेसे याचना नहीं करनी चाहिए। विद्वान् व्यक्तिको निन्तदितों
verses.wordMeaning: The girdle of the Brahmana should be made of the Munja grass twisted three times. It shall be soft and of equal thickness throughout. There may be one or three knots. O Brahmanas, (if Munja grass is unavailable), it may be made of Kusa grass as well.
verses.commentary: Sense: The girdle of the Brahmana should be made of the Munja grass twisted three times. It shall be soft and of equal thickness throughout. There may be one or three knots. O Brahmanas, (if Munja grass is unavailable), it may be made of Kusa grass as well.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वकर्माण्यपि सदा कुर्वाणो मत्परायणः । मत्प्रसादादवाप्नोति शाश्वतं परमं पदम्
verses.transliteration: sarvakarmāṇyapi sadā kurvāṇo matparāyaṇaḥ / matprasādādavāpnoti śāśvataṃ paramaṃ padam
verses.translation: A Brahmana should hold a staffs made ofBilva or Palasa tree. It should come up to his head (in height). It can be made of any other tree (prescribed as being) worthy of being used for sacrifices. It should be soft and devoid of crack in the middle.
verses.hindi: (पापमें रत)-का परित्याग करना चाहिए॥ १--३॥
verses.wordMeaning: A Brahmana should hold a staffs made ofBilva or Palasa tree. It should come up to his head (in height). It can be made of any other tree (prescribed as being) worthy of being used for sacrifices. It should be soft and devoid of crack in the middle.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmana should hold a staffs made ofBilva or Palasa tree. It should come up to his head (in height). It can be made of any other tree (prescribed as being) worthy of being used for sacrifices. It should be soft and devoid of crack in the middle.

verses.sanskrit: चेतसा सर्वकर्माणि मयि संन्यस्य मत्परः । निराशीर्निर्ममो भूत्वा मामेकं शरणं व्रजेत्
verses.transliteration: cetasā sarvakarmāṇi mayi saṃnyasya matparaḥ / nirāśīrnirmamo bhūtvā māmekaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajet
verses.translation: A should perform the 5a«(f4)'«-Prayers with
verses.hindi: नित्य याचना करनेवाला नहीं होना चाहिए और एक ही व्यक्तिसे दुबारा नहीं माँगना चाहिए। याचना करनेवाला दुर्बुद्धि व्यक्ति (दाताके) प्राणोंका ही हरण? करता हैं। विशेषरूपसे श्रेष्ठ ब्राह्मणको देवसम्बन्धी द्रव्यका अपहरण नहीं करना चाहिए। आपत्ति पड्नेपर भी ब्राह्मणके धनका कभी भी अपहरण न करे
verses.wordMeaning: A should perform the 5a«(f4)'«-Prayers with
verses.commentary: Sense: A should perform the 5a«(f4)'«-Prayers with

verses.sanskrit: त्यक्त्वा कर्मफलासङ्गं नित्यतृप्तो निराश्रयः । कर्मण्यभिप्रवृत्तो ऽपि नैव तेन निबध्यते
verses.transliteration: tyaktvā karmaphalāsaṅgaṃ nityatṛpto nirāśrayaḥ / karmaṇyabhipravṛtto 'pi naiva tena nibadhyate
verses.translation: Thereafter, he should perform the rites of the fire- worship in accordance with the injunctions, both in the morning and in the evening. He should propitiate Devas, the sages as well as the Pitrs only after taking bath.
verses.hindi: विषको विष नहीं कहा जाता बल्कि ब्राह्मणका धन ही विष-रूप है  इसी प्रकार देवसम्बन्धी स्वत्वका भी प्रयत्नपूर्वक सदा त्याग करना चाहिए। प्रजापति मनुने
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, he should perform the rites of the fire- worship in accordance with the injunctions, both in the morning and in the evening. He should propitiate Devas, the sages as well as the Pitrs only after taking bath.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, he should perform the rites of the fire- worship in accordance with the injunctions, both in the morning and in the evening. He should propitiate Devas, the sages as well as the Pitrs only after taking bath.

verses.sanskrit: निराशीर्यतचित्तात्मा त्यक्तसर्वपरिग्रहः । शारीरं केवलं कर्म कुर्वन्नाप्नोति तत्पदम्
verses.transliteration: nirāśīryatacittātmā tyaktasarvaparigrahaḥ / śārīraṃ kevalaṃ karma kurvannāpnoti tatpadam
verses.translation: He should worship the deities with flowers, leaves and water. He should invariably revere the elders, according to the prescription in dharma.
verses.hindi: इन सभी पदार्थोंको (इनके स्वामीद्वारा) बिना दिये ग्रहण कर लेनेको अस्तेय कहा है (अर्थात् पुष्प, शाक आदि यदि दूसरेके हैं तब भी अत्यावश्यक होनेपर धर्मार्थ या प्राणरक्षार्थ इनका प्रयोजनानुसार ग्रहण करनेपर चोरीका दोष नहीं लगता)
verses.wordMeaning: He should worship the deities with flowers, leaves and water. He should invariably revere the elders, according to the prescription in dharma.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should worship the deities with flowers, leaves and water. He should invariably revere the elders, according to the prescription in dharma.

verses.sanskrit: यदृच्छालाभतुष्टस्य द्वन्द्वातीतस्य चैव हि । कुर्वतो मत्प्रसादार्थं कर्म संसारनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: yadṛcchālābhatuṣṭasya dvandvātītasya caiva hi / kurvato matprasādārthaṃ karma saṃsāranāśanam
verses.translation: Desirous of* longevity and health but, excluding (request for) wealth, he should humbly bow down respectfully saying (atthe same time his name). "Sir, this I am (so and so) by name".
verses.hindi: द्विजो! देवपूजाके लिये अन्य स्वामीका पुष्प ग्रहण किया जा सकता है। परंतु केवल एक ही स्थानसे बिना आज्ञाके प्रतिदिन पुष्प नहीं ग्रहण करना चाहिए। विप्रो! विद्वान् व्यक्ति केवल धर्मकार्यके
verses.wordMeaning: Desirous of* longevity and health but, excluding (request for) wealth, he should humbly bow down respectfully saying (atthe same time his name). "Sir, this I am (so and so) by name".
verses.commentary: Sense: Desirous of* longevity and health but, excluding (request for) wealth, he should humbly bow down respectfully saying (atthe same time his name). "Sir, this I am (so and so) by name".

verses.sanskrit: मन्मना मन्नमस्कारो मद्याजी मत्परायणः । मामुपैष्यति योगीशं ज्ञात्वा मां परमेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: manmanā mannamaskāro madyājī matparāyaṇaḥ / māmupaiṣyati yogīśaṃ jñātvā māṃ parameśvaram
verses.translation: At the time of obeisance, the Brahmam should be told: O be longlived, O gentle one, at the end of his name, the long letter A should be added with the Pluta accent (of three mores) on the penultimate syllable (i.e. the vowel is prolated).
verses.hindi: लिये तृण, काष्ठ, फल, पुष्प प्रकट-रूपसे ग्रहण कर सकता है, अन्य प्रकारसे ग्रहण करनेपर वह पतित धर्मार्थ केवलं विप्रा ह्यन्यथा पतितो भवेत्॥ ९॥  हो जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: At the time of obeisance, the Brahmam should be told: O be longlived, O gentle one, at the end of his name, the long letter A should be added with the Pluta accent (of three mores) on the penultimate syllable (i.e. the vowel is prolated).
verses.commentary: Sense: At the time of obeisance, the Brahmam should be told: O be longlived, O gentle one, at the end of his name, the long letter A should be added with the Pluta accent (of three mores) on the penultimate syllable (i.e. the vowel is prolated).

verses.sanskrit: मद्बुद्धयो मां सततं बोधयन्तः परस्परम् । कथयन्तश्च मां नित्यं मम सायुज्यमाप्नुयुः
verses.transliteration: madbuddhayo māṃ satataṃ bodhayantaḥ parasparam / kathayantaśca māṃ nityaṃ mama sāyujyamāpnuyuḥ
verses.translation: If a Brahmana does not salute in return when saluted, he shall not be honoured by learned men he isjust like a Sudra.
verses.hindi: १-राजासे दान लेनेपर तेजका हास होता है-' राजान्नं हरते तेजः ' । २-पुनः-पुनः याचनासे दाताको कष्ट होना स्वाभाविक है। अतः यहाँ दाताके प्राण-हरणसे तात्पर्य कष्ट पहुँचानेसे है।
verses.wordMeaning: If a Brahmana does not salute in return when saluted, he shall not be honoured by learned men he isjust like a Sudra.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a Brahmana does not salute in return when saluted, he shall not be honoured by learned men he isjust like a Sudra.

verses.sanskrit: एवं नित्याभियुक्तानां मायेयं कर्मसान्वगम् । नाशयामि तमः कृत्स्नं ज्ञानदीपेन भास्वता
verses.transliteration: evaṃ nityābhiyuktānāṃ māyeyaṃ karmasānvagam / nāśayāmi tamaḥ kṛtsnaṃ jñānadīpena bhāsvatā
verses.translation: The hands should be cross-wise when touching the feet of a preceptor. His left foot should be touched with the left hand and the right foot should be touched with the right hand.
verses.hindi: ब्राह्मणो ! धर्म जाननेवालोंने यह मर्यादा स्थिर को क्षुधातेर्नान्यथा विप्रा धर्मविद्धिरिति स्थिति: ॥ १०॥  है कि केवल भूखसे पीड़ित व्यक्ति रास्तेमें स्थित तिल,
verses.wordMeaning: The hands should be cross-wise when touching the feet of a preceptor. His left foot should be touched with the left hand and the right foot should be touched with the right hand.
verses.commentary: Sense: The hands should be cross-wise when touching the feet of a preceptor. His left foot should be touched with the left hand and the right foot should be touched with the right hand.

verses.sanskrit: मद्बुद्धयो मां सततं पूजयन्तीह ये जनाः । तेषां नित्याभियुक्तानां योगक्षेमं वहाम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: madbuddhayo māṃ satataṃ pūjayantīha ye janāḥ / teṣāṃ nityābhiyuktānāṃ yogakṣemaṃ vahāmyaham
verses.translation: One should in the first instance make obeisance to that gentleman from whom one has acquired regular, Vedic or spiritual knowledge.
verses.hindi: न धर्मस्यापदेशेन पापं कृत्वा व्रतं चरेत्। व्रतेन पापं प्रच्छाद्य कुर्वन् स्त्रीशूद्रदम्भनम्
verses.wordMeaning: One should in the first instance make obeisance to that gentleman from whom one has acquired regular, Vedic or spiritual knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should in the first instance make obeisance to that gentleman from whom one has acquired regular, Vedic or spiritual knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: ये ऽन्ये च कामभोगार्थं यजन्ते ह्यन्यदेवताः । तेषां तदन्तं विज्ञेयं देवतानुगतं फलम्
verses.transliteration: ye 'nye ca kāmabhogārthaṃ yajante hyanyadevatāḥ / teṣāṃ tadantaṃ vijñeyaṃ devatānugataṃ phalam
verses.translation: (While paying obeisance) one should carry in one's hands, water, alms, flowers, sacrificial twigs and such other things. Now (should he do so?) when performing the rites of gods.
verses.hindi: प्रेत्येह चेदूशो विप्रो गर्ह्मते ब्रह्मवादिभिः। छदानाचरितं यच्च व्रतं रक्षांसि गच्छति बैडालब्रतिनः पापा लोके धर्मविनाशकाः। सद्यः पतन्ति पापेषु कर्मणस्तस्य तत् फलम्
verses.wordMeaning: (While paying obeisance) one should carry in one's hands, water, alms, flowers, sacrificial twigs and such other things. Now (should he do so?) when performing the rites of gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: (While paying obeisance) one should carry in one's hands, water, alms, flowers, sacrificial twigs and such other things. Now (should he do so?) when performing the rites of gods.

verses.sanskrit: ये चान्यदेवताभक्ताः पूजयन्तीह देवताः । मद्भावनासमायुक्ता मुच्यन्ते ते ऽपि भावतः
verses.transliteration: ye cānyadevatābhaktāḥ pūjayantīha devatāḥ / madbhāvanāsamāyuktā mucyante te 'pi bhāvataḥ
verses.translation: On meeting a Brahmana, one shall ask him about Kusda (welfare), a Ksatriya should be asked Anamaya ( non¬ ailment); Vaisya should be asked about his Kema (prosperity and security) and Sudra should be asked about his health.
verses.hindi: पाषण्डिनो विकर्मस्थान् वामाचारांस्तथैव च। पाञ्चरात्रान् पाशुपतान् वाङ्मात्रेणापि नार्चयेत्
verses.wordMeaning: On meeting a Brahmana, one shall ask him about Kusda (welfare), a Ksatriya should be asked Anamaya ( non¬ ailment); Vaisya should be asked about his Kema (prosperity and security) and Sudra should be asked about his health.
verses.commentary: Sense: On meeting a Brahmana, one shall ask him about Kusda (welfare), a Ksatriya should be asked Anamaya ( non¬ ailment); Vaisya should be asked about his Kema (prosperity and security) and Sudra should be asked about his health.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादनीश्वरानन्यांस्त्यक्त्वा देवानशेषतः । मामेव संश्रयेदीशं स याति परमं पदम्
verses.transliteration: tasmādanīśvarānanyāṃstyaktvā devānaśeṣataḥ / māmeva saṃśrayedīśaṃ sa yāti paramaṃ padam
verses.translation: Mentally, Verbally and Physically one should obey these. On seeing the preceptor, one shall get up and make obeis¬ ance with palms joined in reverence.
verses.hindi: बेदनिन्दारतान् मर्त्यान् देवनिन्दारतांस्तथा। द्विजनिन्दारतांश्चैव मनसापि न चिन्तयेत् देवद्रोहाद् गुरुद्रोहः कोटिकोटिगुणाधिकः । ज्ञानापवादो नास्तिक्यं तस्मात् कोटिगुणाधिकम्
verses.wordMeaning: Mentally, Verbally and Physically one should obey these. On seeing the preceptor, one shall get up and make obeis¬ ance with palms joined in reverence.
verses.commentary: Sense: Mentally, Verbally and Physically one should obey these. On seeing the preceptor, one shall get up and make obeis¬ ance with palms joined in reverence.

verses.sanskrit: त्यक्त्वा पुत्रादिषु स्नेहं निः शोको निष्परिग्रहः । यजेच्चामरणाल्लिङ्गे विरक्तः परमेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: tyaktvā putrādiṣu snehaṃ niḥ śoko niṣparigrahaḥ / yajeccāmaraṇālliṅge viraktaḥ parameśvaram
verses.translation: One should not sit along with these; one should not argue with these for the sake of money (over money matters).
verses.hindi: मूँग तथा यव आदि पदार्थोंको एक मुट्ठी मात्र ग्रहण कर सकता है  दूसरे जो भूखसे पीडित नहीं हैं, ऐसा नहीं कर सकते
verses.wordMeaning: One should not sit along with these; one should not argue with these for the sake of money (over money matters).
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not sit along with these; one should not argue with these for the sake of money (over money matters).

verses.sanskrit: ये ऽर्चयन्ति सदा लिङ्गं त्यक्त्वा भोगानशेषतः । एकेन जन्मना तेषां ददामि परमैश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: ye 'rcayanti sadā liṅgaṃ tyaktvā bhogānaśeṣataḥ / ekena janmanā teṣāṃ dadāmi paramaiśvaram
verses.translation: Even a person who has risen up by dint of other good qualities, incurs downfall if he hates elders. Among all these elders, five are particularly to be revered.
verses.hindi: पाप करके धर्मके बहाने किसी व्रतका अनुष्ठान नहीं करना चाहिए। व्रतके द्वारा पापको छिपाकर जो स्त्री और शूद्रोंका प्रबञ्चन करता है, वह विप्र इहलोक तथा परलोकमें ब्रह्मवादियोंद्वारा निन्दित होता है। छलके द्वारा किया गया व्रत राक्षसोंको प्राप्त होता है
verses.wordMeaning: Even a person who has risen up by dint of other good qualities, incurs downfall if he hates elders. Among all these elders, five are particularly to be revered.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even a person who has risen up by dint of other good qualities, incurs downfall if he hates elders. Among all these elders, five are particularly to be revered.

verses.sanskrit: परानन्दात्मकं लिङ्गं केवलं सन्निरञ्जनम् । ज्ञानात्मकं सर्वगतं योगिनां हृदि संस्थितम्
verses.transliteration: parānandātmakaṃ liṅgaṃ kevalaṃ sannirañjanam / jñānātmakaṃ sarvagataṃ yogināṃ hṛdi saṃsthitam
verses.translation: Among them the first three are the most excellent, (viz.) he who procreates, she who gives birth to and he by whom learning is imparted and among these three (at first) the mother (should be) highly respected.
verses.hindi: यदि (यज्ञोपवीतादि) लिङ्गका अनधिकारी व्यक्ति इन लिङ्गों (चिह्लों-लक्षणों)-को धारणकर वेष बनाकर जीविकाका निर्वाह करता है तो वह इन लिङ्गोंके वास्तविक अधिकारी पुरुषोंके पापोंका भागी होता है और तिर्यक्
verses.wordMeaning: Among them the first three are the most excellent, (viz.) he who procreates, she who gives birth to and he by whom learning is imparted and among these three (at first) the mother (should be) highly respected.
verses.commentary: Sense: Among them the first three are the most excellent, (viz.) he who procreates, she who gives birth to and he by whom learning is imparted and among these three (at first) the mother (should be) highly respected.

verses.sanskrit: ये चान्ये नियता भक्ता भावयित्वा विधानतः । यत्र क्वचन तल्लिङ्गमर्चयन्ति महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: ye cānye niyatā bhaktā bhāvayitvā vidhānataḥ / yatra kvacana talliṅgamarcayanti maheśvaram
verses.translation: There is no way of fully repaying their debts (by helping them in return). One should continuously do everything physically, mentally and verbally that pleases them.
verses.hindi: (पक्षी आदि) योनिको प्राप्त करता है। लोकमें धर्मके विनाशक वैडालब्रती' (ढोंगी) पापी लोग शीघ्र ही पापयोनिमें जाते हैं। उनके दुष्कर्मका यही फल है। पाखंडी (वेदशास्त्राननुमत-व्रत लिङ्गधारी), निषिद्ध कर्म करनेवाले, वाममार्गी, पाञ्चरात्र और पाशुपत व्रतवालोंका वाणीमात्रसे भी सत्कार नहीं करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: There is no way of fully repaying their debts (by helping them in return). One should continuously do everything physically, mentally and verbally that pleases them.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no way of fully repaying their debts (by helping them in return). One should continuously do everything physically, mentally and verbally that pleases them.

verses.sanskrit: जले वा वह्निमध्ये वाव्योम्नि सूर्ये ऽथवान्यतः । रत्नादौ भावयित्वेशमर्चयेल्लिङ्गमैश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: jale vā vahnimadhye vāvyomni sūrye 'thavānyataḥ / ratnādau bhāvayitveśamarcayelliṅgamaiśvaram
verses.translation: Without being permitted by these two, the son should not perform any other holy rite excepting what yields salvation as well as the Nitya and Naimittika rites.
verses.hindi: वेदकी निन्दामें परायण, देवताओंकी निन्दामें निरत और ब्राह्मणोंकी निन्दा करनेमें संलग्न मनुष्योंका मनसे भी चिन्तन नहीं करना चाहिए। इनका यज्ञ कराना, इनके साथ विवाह आदि (योनि)-का सम्बन्ध, सहवास
verses.wordMeaning: Without being permitted by these two, the son should not perform any other holy rite excepting what yields salvation as well as the Nitya and Naimittika rites.
verses.commentary: Sense: Without being permitted by these two, the son should not perform any other holy rite excepting what yields salvation as well as the Nitya and Naimittika rites.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वं लिङ्गमयं ह्येतत् सर्वं लिङ्गे प्रतिष्ठितम् । तस्माल्लिङ्गे ऽर्चयेदीशं यत्र क्वचन शाश्वतम्
verses.transliteration: sarvaṃ liṅgamayaṃ hyetat sarvaṃ liṅge pratiṣṭhitam / tasmālliṅge 'rcayedīśaṃ yatra kvacana śāśvatam
verses.translation: Those who have vast learning and are endowed with perfect knowledge, holy rites and good attributes, do worship. The Sruti says that the Brahmana should offer Svasti (Blessings, may it be well with you) to people of all castes.
verses.hindi: तथा बात करनेसे प्राणी पतित हो जाता है, अतः प्रयत्रपूर्वक इनका परित्याग करना चाहिए। देवताके द्रोहसे गुरुका द्रोह करोड़ों गुना अधिक दोषपूर्ण होता है। उस गुरुद्रोहसे भी शास्त्रीय ज्ञानको निन्दा करना और नास्तिकताका भाव करोड़ गुना अधिक दोषपूर्ण है
verses.wordMeaning: Those who have vast learning and are endowed with perfect knowledge, holy rites and good attributes, do worship. The Sruti says that the Brahmana should offer Svasti (Blessings, may it be well with you) to people of all castes.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who have vast learning and are endowed with perfect knowledge, holy rites and good attributes, do worship. The Sruti says that the Brahmana should offer Svasti (Blessings, may it be well with you) to people of all castes.

verses.sanskrit: अग्नौ क्रियावतामप्सु व्योम्नि सूर्ये मनीषिणाम् । काष्ठादिष्वेव मूर्खाणां हृदि लिङ्गन्तुयोगिनाम्
verses.transliteration: agnau kriyāvatāmapsu vyomni sūrye manīṣiṇām / kāṣṭhādiṣveva mūrkhāṇāṃ hṛdi liṅgantuyoginām
verses.translation: A Brahmacarin (a religious student) should beg for alms everyday from the houses of persons not devoid of Vedas and Yajnas and those who strictly adhere to their duties. He should be pure in mind and body.
verses.hindi: -विडालव्रतसे जो अपनी जीविका चलाता है वह वैडालव्रती है। इसका आशय यह है कि जैसे विडाल (बिल्ली) मूषक आदिको पकड़कर खानेके लिये ध्याननिष्ठकी तरह विनीतकी भांति बैठता है, वैसे ही जो दूसरोंको धोखा देकर अपने स्वार्थकी सिद्धिमात्रक लिये ध्यान, विनयभाव आदिका स्वॉग रचता है, वह वैडालव्रती है ।
verses.wordMeaning: A Brahmacarin (a religious student) should beg for alms everyday from the houses of persons not devoid of Vedas and Yajnas and those who strictly adhere to their duties. He should be pure in mind and body.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmacarin (a religious student) should beg for alms everyday from the houses of persons not devoid of Vedas and Yajnas and those who strictly adhere to their duties. He should be pure in mind and body.

verses.sanskrit: यद्यनुत्पन्नविज्ञानो विरक्तः प्रीतिसंयुतः । यावज्जीवं जपेद् युक्तः प्रणवं ब्रह्मणो वपुः
verses.transliteration: yadyanutpannavijñāno viraktaḥ prītisaṃyutaḥ / yāvajjīvaṃ japed yuktaḥ praṇavaṃ brahmaṇo vapuḥ
verses.translation: Looking at it, he should be delighted and contented.
verses.hindi: २-अतिथि-सत्कारकालमें इनके उपस्थित होनेपर अतिथिके समान इनका सत्कार नहीं करना चाहिए। जो लोग आदर योग्य नही हैं, उन्हें भी जीविका-निर्वाहके लिये यथाशक्ति देनेका विधान होनेसे जीवनोपयोगी वस्तु देनेका निषेध यहाँ नहीं है। गोभिश्च हैवतैर्विप्रे: कृष्या राजोपसेवया। कुलान्यकुलतां यान्ति यानि हीनानि धर्मतः
verses.wordMeaning: Looking at it, he should be delighted and contented.
verses.commentary: Sense: Looking at it, he should be delighted and contented.

verses.sanskrit: अथवा शतरुद्रीयं जपेदामरणाद् द्विजः । एकाकी यतचित्तात्मा स याति परमं पदम्
verses.transliteration: athavā śatarudrīyaṃ japedāmaraṇād dvijaḥ / ekākī yatacittātmā sa yāti paramaṃ padam
verses.translation: Gluttonous eating is ill for health and destructive of longevity, and it does not secure heaven. It is non-meritorious and reproached by the world. Hence, one should avoid it.
verses.hindi: कुविवाहैः क्रियालोपैर्वदानध्ययनेन च। कुलान्यकुलतां यान्ति ब्राह्मणातिक्रमेण च
verses.wordMeaning: Gluttonous eating is ill for health and destructive of longevity, and it does not secure heaven. It is non-meritorious and reproached by the world. Hence, one should avoid it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gluttonous eating is ill for health and destructive of longevity, and it does not secure heaven. It is non-meritorious and reproached by the world. Hence, one should avoid it.

verses.sanskrit: वसेद् वामरणाद् विप्रो वाराणस्यां समाहितः । सो ऽपीश्वरप्रसादेन याति तत् परमं पदम्
verses.transliteration: vased vāmaraṇād vipro vārāṇasyāṃ samāhitaḥ / so 'pīśvaraprasādena yāti tat paramaṃ padam
verses.translation: Rules regarding answering calls of nature should be a part of hygiene. But Dharma Sutras (e.g. Apastamba 1.11.30, 15-30, Vasistha VI. 10-19) and Smrtis like Manu (IV. 45-52, 56), Yaj. (I. 16-17) and
verses.hindi: अश्रौतधर्माचरणात् क्षिप्रं नश्यति वै कुलम् न शूद्रराज्ये निवसेन्न पाषण्डजनेर्वृते
verses.wordMeaning: Rules regarding answering calls of nature should be a part of hygiene. But Dharma Sutras (e.g. Apastamba 1.11.30, 15-30, Vasistha VI. 10-19) and Smrtis like Manu (IV. 45-52, 56), Yaj. (I. 16-17) and
verses.commentary: Sense: Rules regarding answering calls of nature should be a part of hygiene. But Dharma Sutras (e.g. Apastamba 1.11.30, 15-30, Vasistha VI. 10-19) and Smrtis like Manu (IV. 45-52, 56), Yaj. (I. 16-17) and

verses.sanskrit: तत्रोत्क्रमणकाले हि सर्वेषामेव देहिनाम् । ददाति तत् परं ज्ञानं येन मुच्येत बन्धनात्
verses.transliteration: tatrotkramaṇakāle hi sarveṣāmeva dehinām / dadāti tat paraṃ jñānaṃ yena mucyeta bandhanāt
verses.translation: He shall be pure if he performs the.ifcamaraa rite by means of the body belonging to the divinity (i.e. Daiva Tirtha) Pure at the outset, a Bramana should perform Acamana three times.
verses.hindi: मुक्त्वा समुद्रयोर्देशं नान्यत्र निवसेद् द्विज:
verses.wordMeaning: He shall be pure if he performs the.ifcamaraa rite by means of the body belonging to the divinity (i.e. Daiva Tirtha) Pure at the outset, a Bramana should perform Acamana three times.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall be pure if he performs the.ifcamaraa rite by means of the body belonging to the divinity (i.e. Daiva Tirtha) Pure at the outset, a Bramana should perform Acamana three times.

verses.sanskrit: वर्णाश्रमविधिं कृत्स्नं कुर्वाणो मत्परायणः । तेनैव जन्मना ज्ञानं लब्ध्वा याति शिवं पदम्
verses.transliteration: varṇāśramavidhiṃ kṛtsnaṃ kurvāṇo matparāyaṇaḥ / tenaiva janmanā jñānaṃ labdhvā yāti śivaṃ padam
verses.translation: He should touch the mouth with the root of the thumb well-covered.* (?) He should then touch the eyes by means of the thumb and the ring finger.
verses.hindi: पुण्याश्च विश्रुता नद्यस्तत्र वा निवसेद् द्विज: नान्यत्र निवसेत् पुण्यं नान्त्यजग्रामसंनिधौ
verses.wordMeaning: He should touch the mouth with the root of the thumb well-covered.* (?) He should then touch the eyes by means of the thumb and the ring finger.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should touch the mouth with the root of the thumb well-covered.* (?) He should then touch the eyes by means of the thumb and the ring finger.

verses.sanskrit: ये ऽपि तत्र वसन्तीह नीचा वा पापयोनयः । सर्वे तरन्ति संसारमीश्वरानुग्रहाद् द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: ye 'pi tatra vasantīha nīcā vā pāpayonayaḥ / sarve taranti saṃsāramīśvarānugrahād dvijāḥ
verses.translation: He should touch both the nostrils by joining together the tips of the index finger and the thumb. He should touch the ears by joining together the tips of the small finger and the thumb.
verses.hindi: न संवसेच्च पतितैर्न चण्डालैर्न पुक्कसैः। न मूखेर्नावलिप्तैश्व नान्त्यैर्नान्त्यावसायिभिः
verses.wordMeaning: He should touch both the nostrils by joining together the tips of the index finger and the thumb. He should touch the ears by joining together the tips of the small finger and the thumb.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should touch both the nostrils by joining together the tips of the index finger and the thumb. He should touch the ears by joining together the tips of the small finger and the thumb.

verses.sanskrit: किन्तु विघ्ना भविष्यन्ति पापोपहतचेतसाम् । धर्मं समाश्रयेत् तस्मान्मुक्तये नियतं द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: kintu vighnā bhaviṣyanti pāpopahatacetasām / dharmaṃ samāśrayet tasmānmuktaye niyataṃ dvijāḥ
verses.translation: He should touch the arms with all fingers and the heart with palm. He should touch the umbilical region and the head, with all fingers. Or he shall touch both of them by means of the thumb.
verses.hindi: एकादश समुद्दिष्टा दोषाः साङ्कर्यसंज्ञिताः समीपे वा व्यवस्थानात् पापं संक्रमते नृणाम्। तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन साङ्कर्यं परिवर्जयेत्
verses.wordMeaning: He should touch the arms with all fingers and the heart with palm. He should touch the umbilical region and the head, with all fingers. Or he shall touch both of them by means of the thumb.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should touch the arms with all fingers and the heart with palm. He should touch the umbilical region and the head, with all fingers. Or he shall touch both of them by means of the thumb.

verses.sanskrit: एतद् रहस्यं वेदानां न देयं यस्य कस्य चित् । धार्मिकायैव दातव्यं भक्ताय ब्रह्मचारिणे
verses.transliteration: etad rahasyaṃ vedānāṃ na deyaṃ yasya kasya cit / dhārmikāyaiva dātavyaṃ bhaktāya brahmacāriṇe
verses.translation: He should drink water three times. Thereby the deities are well delighted. We have heard that Brahma, Visnu and Mahesa are delighted thereby.
verses.hindi: गायसे, देवताओंसे, ब्राह्मणोंसे, कृषिसे तथा राजाको सेवासे जीविका-निर्वाह करनेवाले व्यक्तियोंका कुल दोषपूर्ण हो जाता है; क्योंकि ये वृत्तियाँ धर्मको दृष्टिसे हीन वृत्तियाँ हैं । कुविवाह, (नित्य अथवा धार्मिक) क्रियाओंका
verses.wordMeaning: He should drink water three times. Thereby the deities are well delighted. We have heard that Brahma, Visnu and Mahesa are delighted thereby.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should drink water three times. Thereby the deities are well delighted. We have heard that Brahma, Visnu and Mahesa are delighted thereby.

verses.sanskrit: व्यास उवाच इत्येतदुक्त्वा भगवानात्मयोगमनुत्तमम् । व्याजहार समासीनं नारायणमनामयम्
verses.transliteration: vyāsa uvāca ityetaduktvā bhagavānātmayogamanuttamam / vyājahāra samāsīnaṃ nārāyaṇamanāmayam
verses.translation: By the wiping off (Parimarjana) of mouth the Gaiiga and the Yamuna are pleased. When the eyes are wiped the moon and the sun are delighted.
verses.hindi: लोप, वेदोंके अध्ययन न करने और ब्राह्मणोंके अनादर करनेसे कुल दोषपूर्ण हो जाता है वेदविरुद्ध धर्मोका आचरण करनेसे कुल शीघ्र ही नष्ट हो जाता है। आश्रोत्रिय, शूद्र तथा विहित आचारसे रहित (द्विज)-को दान देनेसे दाताका कुल शीघ्र ही नष्ट हो जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: By the wiping off (Parimarjana) of mouth the Gaiiga and the Yamuna are pleased. When the eyes are wiped the moon and the sun are delighted.
verses.commentary: Sense: By the wiping off (Parimarjana) of mouth the Gaiiga and the Yamuna are pleased. When the eyes are wiped the moon and the sun are delighted.

verses.sanskrit: मयैतद् भाषितं ज्ञानं हितार्थं ब्रह्मवादिनाम् । दातव्यं शान्तचित्तेभ्यः शिष्येभ्यो भवता शिवम्
verses.transliteration: mayaitad bhāṣitaṃ jñānaṃ hitārthaṃ brahmavādinām / dātavyaṃ śāntacittebhyaḥ śiṣyebhyo bhavatā śivam
verses.translation: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.
verses.hindi: अधार्मिकों तथा पाखंडीजनोंसे युक्त और अत्यधिक रोगसे आक्रान्त ग्राममें तथा शूद्रके राज्यमें निवास नहीं करना चाहिए। द्विजको चाहिए कि वह हिमालय एवं विन्ध्यपर्वतके मध्यके देश और पूर्व तथा पश्चिम दिशाके
verses.wordMeaning: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.

verses.sanskrit: उक्त्वैवमथ योगीन्द्रानब्रवीद् भगवानजः । हिताय सर्वभक्तानां द्विजातीनां द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: uktvaivamatha yogīndrānabravīd bhagavānajaḥ / hitāya sarvabhaktānāṃ dvijātīnāṃ dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.
verses.hindi: समुद्रके तटवर्ती शुभ प्रदेशको छोड़कर अन्यत्र निवास नहीं करे। अथवा जहाँ स्वाभाविकरूपसे नित्य कृष्ण (कृष्णसार मृग-जातिविशेषके मृग) मृग विचरण करते होती हों, द्विजको वहाँ निवास करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.

verses.sanskrit: भवन्तो ऽपि हि मज्ज्ञानं शिष्याणां विधिपूर्वकम् । उपदेक्ष्यन्ति भक्तानां सर्वेषां वचनान्मम
verses.transliteration: bhavanto 'pi hi majjñānaṃ śiṣyāṇāṃ vidhipūrvakam / upadekṣyanti bhaktānāṃ sarveṣāṃ vacanānmama
verses.translation: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ द्विजको नदीके किनारेसे आधे कोसतकको
verses.wordMeaning: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.

verses.sanskrit: अयं नारायणो यो ऽहमीश्वरो नात्र संशयः । नान्तरं ये प्रपश्यन्ति तेषां देयमिदं परम्
verses.transliteration: ayaṃ nārāyaṇo yo 'hamīśvaro nātra saṃśayaḥ / nāntaraṃ ye prapaśyanti teṣāṃ deyamidaṃ param
verses.translation: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.
verses.hindi: रहना चाहिए और न अन्त्यजोंके ग्रामके समीपमें रहना चाहिए। पतित, चण्डाल, पुक्कस, मूर्ख, अभिमानी (धन आदिके मदसे गर्वित), अन्त्यज (म्लेच्छ, रजक आदि) और अन्त्यावसायीके साथ नहीं रहना चाहिए। (इनके पंक्तिमें बैठकर भोजन करना, बरतनों और पके हुए भोजनका मेल (मिश्रण, परस्पर आदान-प्रदान), यज्ञ करना, अध्यापन, विवाहादिका सम्बन्ध, साथमें भोजन करना और दसवाँ साथमें अध्ययन करना तथा साथमें
verses.wordMeaning: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.

verses.sanskrit: ममैषा परमा मूर्तिर्नारायणसमाह्वया । सर्वभूतात्मभूतस्था शान्ता चाक्षरसंज्ञिता
verses.transliteration: mamaiṣā paramā mūrtirnārāyaṇasamāhvayā / sarvabhūtātmabhūtasthā śāntā cākṣarasaṃjñitā
verses.translation: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.
verses.hindi: यज्ञ कराना-ये ग्यारह 'सांकर्य' नामवाले दोष बतलाये गये हैं। इन सांकर्य-दोषयुक्त व्यक्तियोंके समीपमें भी रहनेसे मनुष्यमें पापका संक्रमण हो जाता है। अतः सभी प्रकारके प्रयत्रोंसे सांकर्यं (दोष)-का परित्याग
verses.wordMeaning: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.

verses.sanskrit: ये त्वन्यथा प्रपश्यन्ति लोके भेददृशो जनाः । न ते मां संप्रपश्यन्ति जायन्ते च पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: ye tvanyathā prapaśyanti loke bhedadṛśo janāḥ / na te māṃ saṃprapaśyanti jāyante ca punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.
verses.hindi: यहाँ घृणाका भाव नहीं है। जन्मान्तरकृत क्माँके आधारपर यह केवल एक व्यवस्था है। ३२६  कूर्मपुराण  एकपङ्क्त्युपविष्टा ये न स्पृशन्ति परस्परम्। एक पंक्तिमें बैठे रहनेपर भी जो एक-दूसरेका
verses.wordMeaning: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.

verses.sanskrit: ये त्विमं विष्णुमव्यक्तं मां वा देवं महेश्वरम् । एकीभावेन पश्यन्ति न तेषां पुनरुद्भवः
verses.transliteration: ye tvimaṃ viṣṇumavyaktaṃ māṃ vā devaṃ maheśvaram / ekībhāvena paśyanti na teṣāṃ punarudbhavaḥ
verses.translation: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.
verses.hindi: भस्मना कृतमर्यादा न तेषां संकरो भवेत्
verses.wordMeaning: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादनादिनिधनं विष्णुमात्मानमव्ययम् । मामेव संप्रपश्यध्वं पूजयध्वं तथैव हि
verses.transliteration: tasmādanādinidhanaṃ viṣṇumātmānamavyayam / māmeva saṃprapaśyadhvaṃ pūjayadhvaṃ tathaiva hi
verses.translation: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.
verses.hindi: अग्निना भस्मना चैव सलिलेनावसेकतः। द्वारेण स्तम्भमार्गण षड्भिः पङ्क्तिर्विभिद्यते न संवदेत् सूतके च न कञ्चिन्मर्मणि स्पृशेत्
verses.wordMeaning: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.

verses.sanskrit: ये ऽन्यथा मां प्रपश्यन्ति मत्वेमं देवतान्तरम् । ते यान्ति नरकान् घोरान् नाहं तेषुव्यवस्थितः
verses.transliteration: ye 'nyathā māṃ prapaśyanti matvemaṃ devatāntaram / te yānti narakān ghorān nāhaṃ teṣuvyavasthitaḥ
verses.translation: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.
verses.hindi: न देवगुरुविप्राणां दीयमानं तु वारयेत्। न चात्मानं प्रशंसेद् वा परनिन्दां च वर्जयेत्। वेदनिन्दां देवनिन्दां प्रयत्नेन विवर्जयेत्
verses.wordMeaning: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.

verses.sanskrit: मूर्खं वा पण्डितं वापि ब्राह्मणं वा मदाश्रयम् । मोचयामि श्वपाकं वा न नारायणनिन्दकम्
verses.transliteration: mūrkhaṃ vā paṇḍitaṃ vāpi brāhmaṇaṃ vā madāśrayam / mocayāmi śvapākaṃ vā na nārāyaṇanindakam
verses.translation: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.
verses.hindi: यस्तु देवानृषीन् विप्रान् वेदान् वा निन्दति द्विजः । न तस्य निष्कृतिर्दृष्टा शास्त्रेष्विह मुनीश्वराः निन्दयेद् वै गुरुं देवं वेदं वा सोपबृंहणम्। कल्पकोटिशतं साग्रं रौरवे पच्यते नरः
verses.wordMeaning: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादेष महायोगी मद्भक्तैः पुरुषोत्तमः । अर्चनीयो नमस्कार्यो मत्प्रीतिजननाय हि
verses.transliteration: tasmādeṣa mahāyogī madbhaktaiḥ puruṣottamaḥ / arcanīyo namaskāryo matprītijananāya hi
verses.translation: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.
verses.hindi: कर्णौ पिधाय गन्तव्यं न चेतानवलोकयेत्
verses.wordMeaning: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा समालिङ्ग्य वासुदेवं पिनाकधृक् । अन्तर्हितो ऽभवत् तेषां सर्वेषामेव पश्यताम्
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā samāliṅgya vāsudevaṃ pinākadhṛk / antarhito 'bhavat teṣāṃ sarveṣāmeva paśyatām
verses.translation: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.
verses.hindi: स्पर्श नहीं करते हों और बीचमें भस्मके द्वारा रेखारूप मर्यादा खींचे हों, उनमें सांकर्य-दोष नहीं होता। अग्नि, भस्म, जलके छिड़काव, द्वार, स्तम्भ तथा मार्ग-इन छ:के द्वारा पंक्तिका खंडन हो जाता है। अकारण शत्रुता, विवाद तथा चुगुलखोरी नहीं करनी चाहिए। दूसरेके खेतमें चरती हुई गायको किसीको बतलाना नहीं चाहिए। सूतक (अशौच)-युक्त व्यक्तिसे बात न को और किसीके भी मर्मका स्पर्श न करे
verses.wordMeaning: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.

verses.sanskrit: नारायणो ऽपि भगवांस्तापसं वेषमुत्तमम् । जग्राह योगिनः सर्वांस्त्यक्त्वा वै परमं वपुः
verses.transliteration: nārāyaṇo 'pi bhagavāṃstāpasaṃ veṣamuttamam / jagrāha yoginaḥ sarvāṃstyaktvā vai paramaṃ vapuḥ
verses.translation: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.
verses.hindi: विद्वान् व्यक्ति दूसरोंको सूर्यमण्डल, इन्द्रधनुष, चिताग्रि
verses.wordMeaning: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञातं भवद्भिरमलं प्रसादात् परमेष्ठिनः । साक्षादेव महेशस्य ज्ञानं संसारनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: jñātaṃ bhavadbhiramalaṃ prasādāt parameṣṭhinaḥ / sākṣādeva maheśasya jñānaṃ saṃsāranāśanam
verses.translation: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.
verses.hindi: बहुत लोगोंके साथ और बन्धु-बान्धवोंके साथ विरोध नहीं करना चाहिए  स्वयंके प्रति जैसा आचरण प्रतिकूल हो, वैसा आचरण दूसरोंके प्रति न करे पक्षकी तिथिको न कहे, न नक्षत्रोंका निर्देश करे। श्रेष्ठ द्विज रजस्वला स्त्रीसे बात न करे और न ही अपवित्र व्यक्तिसे बात करे देवता, गुरु तथा ब्राह्मणोंको दी जा रही वस्तुका निषेध न करे। अपनी प्रशंसा न को
verses.wordMeaning: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.

verses.sanskrit: गच्छध्वं विज्वराः सर्वे विज्ञानं परमेष्ठिनः । प्रवर्तयध्वं शिष्येभ्यो धार्मिकेभ्यो मुनीश्वराः
verses.transliteration: gacchadhvaṃ vijvarāḥ sarve vijñānaṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ / pravartayadhvaṃ śiṣyebhyo dhārmikebhyo munīśvarāḥ
verses.translation: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.
verses.hindi: और दूसरेकी निन्दाका त्याग करे। वेदनिन्दा तथा देवनिन्दाका प्रयत्नपूर्वक (सर्वथा) परित्याग करे
verses.wordMeaning: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.

verses.sanskrit: इदं भक्ताय शान्ताय धार्मिकायाहिताग्नये । विज्ञानमैश्वरं देयं ब्राह्मणाय विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: idaṃ bhaktāya śāntāya dhārmikāyāhitāgnaye / vijñānamaiśvaraṃ deyaṃ brāhmaṇāya viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.
verses.hindi: मुनीश्वरो! जो द्विज देवताओं, ऋषियों, ब्राह्मणों अथवा वेदोंकी निन्दा करता है, उसके लिये इस लोकमें कोई प्रायश्चित्त शास्त्रोंमें दिखलायी नहीं देता। गुर, करनेवाला व्यक्ति सैकड़ों, करोड़ों वर्षोसे भी अधिक समयतक रौरव नरकमें कष्ट भोगता है । (देवता, शास्त्र आदिकी) निन्दा होनेपर (यदि उत्तर देनेका सामर्थ्य न हो तो) चुपचाप रहना चाहिए, उत्तरमें (दुराग्रहीसे)
verses.wordMeaning: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा स विश्वात्मा योगिनां योगवित्तमः । नारायणो महायोगी जगामादर्शनं स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā sa viśvātmā yogināṃ yogavittamaḥ / nārāyaṇo mahāyogī jagāmādarśanaṃ svayam
verses.translation: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.
verses.hindi: कुछ भी नहीं बोलना चाहिए। अथवा उस समय कान बंदकर अन्यत्र चला जाय और उन निन्दकोंकी ओर देखे भी नहीं॥ ३८--४०॥ विद्वान् व्यक्तिको दूसरोंके रहस्योंको जाननेका प्रयास
verses.wordMeaning: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.

verses.sanskrit: ते ऽपि देवादिदेवेशं नमस्कृत्य महेश्वरम् । नारायणं च भूतादिं स्वानि स्थानानि भेजिरे
verses.transliteration: te 'pi devādideveśaṃ namaskṛtya maheśvaram / nārāyaṇaṃ ca bhūtādiṃ svāni sthānāni bhejire
verses.translation: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.
verses.hindi: नहीं करना चाहिए और (जाननेपर) उन्हें छिपाना चाहिए। अपने आत्मीय जनोंके साथ कभी भी विवाद नहीं करना चाहिए » मर्मस्पर्शका तात्पर्यं है-किसीके रहस्यको प्रकाशित कर उसे पीड़ा पहुँचाना।
verses.wordMeaning: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमारो भगवान् संवर्ताय महामुनिः । दत्तवानैश्वरं ज्ञानं सो ऽपि सत्यव्रताय तु
verses.transliteration: sanatkumāro bhagavān saṃvartāya mahāmuniḥ / dattavānaiśvaraṃ jñānaṃ so 'pi satyavratāya tu
verses.translation: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.
verses.hindi: न पापं पापिनां ब्रूयादपापं वा द्विजोत्तमाः । स तेन तुल्यदोषः स्यान्मिथ्या द्विदोषवान् भवेत्
verses.wordMeaning: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.

verses.sanskrit: सनन्दनो ऽपि योगीन्द्रः पुलहाय महर्षये । प्रददौ गौतमायाथ पुलहो ऽपि प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: sanandano 'pi yogīndraḥ pulahāya maharṣaye / pradadau gautamāyātha pulaho 'pi prajāpatiḥ
verses.translation: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्महत्यासुरापाने स्तेयगुर्वङ्गनागमे । दृष्टं विशोधनं वृद्धैर्नास्ति मिथ्याभिशंसने नाशुचिः सूर्यसोमादीन् ग्रहानालोकयेद् बुधः
verses.wordMeaning: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गिरा वेदविदुषे भरद्वाजाय दत्तवान् । जैगीषव्याय कपिलस्तथा पञ्चशिखाय च
verses.transliteration: aṅgirā vedaviduṣe bharadvājāya dattavān / jaigīṣavyāya kapilastathā pañcaśikhāya ca
