verses.translation: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.
verses.hindi: पतितव्यङ्गचण्डालानुच्छिष्टान् नावलोकयेत् । नाभिभाषेत च परमुच्छिष्टो वावगुण्ठितः
verses.wordMeaning: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.

verses.sanskrit: पराशरो ऽपि सनकात् पिता मे सर्वतत्त्वदृक् । लेभेतत्परमं ज्ञानं तस्माद् वाल्मीकिराप्तवान्
verses.transliteration: parāśaro 'pi sanakāt pitā me sarvatattvadṛk / lebhetatparamaṃ jñānaṃ tasmād vālmīkirāptavān
verses.translation: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.
verses.hindi: नोदके चात्मनो रूपं न कूलं श्वभ्रमेव वा। न लङ्घयेच्च मूत्रं वा नाधितिष्ठेत् कदाचन हे द्विजोत्तमो! पापियोंके पापको चर्चा न करे, न अपाप (पापरहित)-पर पापी होनेका आरोप लगाये, क्योंकि ऐसा करनेसे वह उसी (पापी)-के समान दोषयुक्त होकर तथा मिथ्याभिभाषणरूप दोषसे युक्त
verses.wordMeaning: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.

verses.sanskrit: ममोवाच पुरा देवः सतीदेहभवाङ्गजः । वामदेवो महायोगी रुद्रः किल पिनाकधृक्
verses.transliteration: mamovāca purā devaḥ satīdehabhavāṅgajaḥ / vāmadevo mahāyogī rudraḥ kila pinākadhṛk
verses.translation: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.
verses.hindi: होकर दो दोषोंका भागी हो जाता है। मिथ्या दोषारोपणयुक्त व्यक्तियोंके रोनेसे जो अश्रुविन्दु गिरते हैं, वे मिथ्या दोषारोपण करनेवाले व्यक्तिके पुत्रों तथा पशुओंका नाश कर देते हैं। ब्रह्महत्या, सुरापान, चोरी और गुरुपत्रीगमन--
verses.wordMeaning: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.

verses.sanskrit: नारायणो ऽपि भगवान् देवकीतनयो हरिः । अर्जुनाय स्वयं साक्षात् दत्तवानिदमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: nārāyaṇo 'pi bhagavān devakītanayo hariḥ / arjunāya svayaṃ sākṣāt dattavānidamuttamam
verses.translation: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.
verses.hindi: इन महापापोंकी शुद्धि वृद्धजनोंद्वारा देखी गयी है (अर्थात् बतायी गयी है), किंतु मिथ्या दोषारोपण करनेवालेकी कोई शुद्धि नहीं है अर्थात् इनकी शुद्धिका कोई उपाय नहीं है॥ ४२--४४॥ बिना किसी प्रयोजनके उगते हुए सूर्य और चन्द्रमाको नहीं देखना चाहिए। (ऐसे ही अकारण) अस्त होते हुए, जलमें प्रतिबिम्बित, आकाशके मध्य स्थित, ग्रहणयुक्त, वस्त्राच्छादित अथवा दर्पण आदिमें
verses.wordMeaning: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.

verses.sanskrit: यदहं लब्धवान् रुद्राद् वामदेवादनुत्तमम् । विशेषाद् गिरिशे भक्तिस्तस्मादारभ्य मे ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: yadahaṃ labdhavān rudrād vāmadevādanuttamam / viśeṣād giriśe bhaktistasmādārabhya me 'bhavat
verses.translation: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.
verses.hindi: प्रतिबिम्बित सूर्य-चन्द्रमाको नहीं देखना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.

verses.sanskrit: शरण्यं शरणं रुद्रं प्रपन्नो ऽहं विशेषतः । भूतेशं गिरशं स्थाणुं देवदेवं त्रिशूलिनम्
verses.transliteration: śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ rudraṃ prapanno 'haṃ viśeṣataḥ / bhūteśaṃ giraśaṃ sthāṇuṃ devadevaṃ triśūlinam

verses.hindi: नग्र स्त्री अथवा पुरुषको कभी भी न देखे। मल- मूत्र विसर्जित कर रहे तथा मैथुनासक्त व्यक्तिको न देखे। बुद्धिमान् व्यक्तिको अपवित्रताकी स्थितिमें सूर्य- चन्द्रमा आदि ग्रहोंको नहीं देखना चाहिए। पतित, विकलाङ्ग, चाण्डाल एवं उच्छिष्ट (मुखवाले) व्यक्तियोंको नहीं देखना चाहिए। उच्छिष्ट दशामें अथवा मुख ढककर दूसरेसे बात नहीं करनी चाहिए। शवका स्पर्श किये हुए व्यक्तिको (जबतक स्रानादिसे शुद्ध नहीं हो

verses.transliteration: bhavanto 'pi hi taṃ devaṃ śaṃbhuṃ govṛṣavāhanam / prapadyadhvaṃ sapatnīkāḥ saputrāḥ śaraṇaṃ śivam

verses.hindi: जाता है तबतक), क्रुद्ध गुरुके मुखको, तेल या जलमें पड्नेवाली छायाको, भोजन करते समय पल्रीको, खुले हुए अङ्गोंवाली स्त्रीको, पागल एवं मतवाले व्यक्तिको नहीं देखना चाहिए। पलीके साथ भोजन नहीं करना

verses.sanskrit: वर्तध्वं तत्प्रसादेन कर्मयोगेन शङ्करम् । पूजयध्वं महादेवं गोपतिं भूतिभूषणम्
verses.transliteration: vartadhvaṃ tatprasādena karmayogena śaṅkaram / pūjayadhvaṃ mahādevaṃ gopatiṃ bhūtibhūṣaṇam

verses.hindi: चाहिए और उसे भोजन करते हुए, छींकते हुए, जम्हाई लेते हुए तथा आसनपर आरामसे बैठे रहनेकी अवस्थामें नहीं देखना चाहिए। जलमें अपना रूप तथा (नदी आदिके) किनारे और गर्त (गहरा गड्ढा)-को नहीं देखना चाहिए। मूत्रको लाँघना नहीं चाहिए और न कभी उसपर बैठना चाहिए॥ ४६--५० ॥

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्ते ऽथ मुनयः शौनकाद्या महेश्वरम् । प्रणेमुः शाश्वतं स्थाणुं व्यासं सत्यवतीसुतम्
verses.transliteration: evamukte 'tha munayaḥ śaunakādyā maheśvaram / praṇemuḥ śāśvataṃ sthāṇuṃ vyāsaṃ satyavatīsutam

verses.sanskrit: अब्रुवन् हृष्टमनसः कृष्णद्वैपायनं प्रभुम् । साक्षादेव हृषीकेशं सर्वलोकमहेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: abruvan hṛṣṭamanasaḥ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaṃ prabhum / sākṣādeva hṛṣīkeśaṃ sarvalokamaheśvaram
verses.translation: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.

verses.sanskrit: भवत्प्रसादादचला शरण्ये गोवृषध्वजे । इदानीं जायते भक्तिर्या देवैरपि दुर्लभा
verses.transliteration: bhavatprasādādacalā śaraṇye govṛṣadhvaje / idānīṃ jāyate bhaktiryā devairapi durlabhā

verses.hindi: नात्मानं चावमन्येत हैन्यं यत्नेन वर्जयेत्। न विशिष्टानसत्कुर्यात् नात्मानं वा शपेद् बुध:

verses.sanskrit: कथयस्व मुनिश्रेष्ठ कर्मयोगमनुत्तमम् । येनासौ भगवानीशः समाराध्यो मुमुक्षुभिः
verses.transliteration: kathayasva muniśreṣṭha karmayogamanuttamam / yenāsau bhagavānīśaḥ samārādhyo mumukṣubhiḥ

verses.transliteration: tvatsaṃnidhāveṣa sūtaḥ śṛṇotu bhagavadvacaḥ / tadvadākhilalokānāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ dharmasaṃgraham

verses.transliteration: yaduktaṃ devadevena viṣṇunā kūrmarūpiṇā / pṛṣṭena munibhiḥ pūrvaṃ śakreṇāmṛtamanthane

verses.transliteration: śrutvā satyavatīsūnuḥ karmayogaṃ sanātanam / munīnāṃ bhāṣitaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ provāca susamāhitaḥ

verses.transliteration: ya imaṃ paṭhate nityaṃ saṃvādaṃ kṛttivāsasaḥ / sanatkumārapramukhaiḥ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate

verses.sanskrit: यश्चैतच्छृणुयान्नित्यं भक्तियुक्तो दृढव्रतः । सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो ब्रह्मलोके महीयते

verses.hindi: १-यहाँ उपदेशका निषेध है। सलाह (सम्मति, राय) देनेका निषेध नहीं है। उपदेश द्विजको सामने करके ही करना चाहिए। शास्त्रीय व्यवस्थाके अनुसार साक्षात् उपदेश लेनेका अधिकारी शूद्र नहीं है। यह मात्र व्यवस्था है, द्वेपभाव नहीं है । “न शूद्राय मति दद्यात्’ मनुस्मृति (४। ८०)-की कुल्लूकभट्टकी व्याख्याके अनुसार।
verses.wordMeaning: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the two nostrils are touched, the Asvin gods (Nasatya and Basra) are delighted. Similarly, when the two ears are touched the wind god and the fire god are delighted.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे (ईश्वरगीतासु) एकादशो ऽध्यायः व्यास उवाच शृणुध्वमृषयः सर्वे वक्ष्यमाणं सनातनम् । कर्मयोगं ब्राह्मणानामात्यन्तिकफलप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge (īśvaragītāsu) ekādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ vyāsa uvāca śṛṇudhvamṛṣayaḥ sarve vakṣyamāṇaṃ sanātanam / karmayogaṃ brāhmaṇānāmātyantikaphalapradam
verses.translation: When the heart is touched, the deities are pleased. By touching the head, Purusa becomes delighted.
verses.hindi: २-आहुति देनेसे अवशिष्ट तिल आदि हविष्य शूद्रको नहीं देना चाहिए। ३-जो शूद्र अपना सेवक नहीं है उसे उच्छिष्ट देनेका निषेध है।
verses.wordMeaning: When the heart is touched, the deities are pleased. By touching the head, Purusa becomes delighted.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the heart is touched, the deities are pleased. By touching the head, Purusa becomes delighted.

verses.sanskrit: आम्नायसिद्धमखिलं ब्रिह्मणानुप्रदर्शितम् । ऋषीणां शृण्वतां पूर्वं मनुराह प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: āmnāyasiddhamakhilaṃ brihmaṇānupradarśitam / ṛṣīṇāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ pūrvaṃ manurāha prajāpatiḥ
verses.translation: (While performing Acamana) when the sprays (of water) touch the limbs they do not defile by means of Ucchista. One shall be impure by touching the space between the teeth, when teeth are touched as well by means of the tongue and the lips.
verses.hindi: ब्राह्मण ही अधिकारी है।
verses.wordMeaning: (While performing Acamana) when the sprays (of water) touch the limbs they do not defile by means of Ucchista. One shall be impure by touching the space between the teeth, when teeth are touched as well by means of the tongue and the lips.
verses.commentary: Sense: (While performing Acamana) when the sprays (of water) touch the limbs they do not defile by means of Ucchista. One shall be impure by touching the space between the teeth, when teeth are touched as well by means of the tongue and the lips.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वपापहरं पुण्यमृषिसङ्घैर्निषेवितम् । समाहितधियो यूयं शृणुध्वं गदतो मम
verses.transliteration: sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyamṛṣisaṅghairniṣevitam / samāhitadhiyo yūyaṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ gadato mama
verses.translation: If the drops of water touch on the feet when one per¬ forms the Acamana rite, they are not defiled. They should be known as Bhumikas (v.l. Bhumiga - existent in the earth).
verses.hindi: ५-यहाँ तात्पर्य यह है कि पुत्र एवं शिष्यको योग्य बनानेका उत्तरदायित्व होता है, अत: आवश्यक होनेपर करुणाका भाव रखते हुए ताड़न किया जा सकता है ।
verses.wordMeaning: If the drops of water touch on the feet when one per¬ forms the Acamana rite, they are not defiled. They should be known as Bhumikas (v.l. Bhumiga - existent in the earth).
verses.commentary: Sense: If the drops of water touch on the feet when one per¬ forms the Acamana rite, they are not defiled. They should be known as Bhumikas (v.l. Bhumiga - existent in the earth).

verses.sanskrit: कृतोपनयनो वेदानधीयीत द्विजोत्तमाः । गर्भाष्टमे ऽष्टमे वाब्दे स्वसूत्रोक्तविधानतः
verses.transliteration: kṛtopanayano vedānadhīyīta dvijottamāḥ / garbhāṣṭame 'ṣṭame vābde svasūtroktavidhānataḥ
verses.translation: Manu says that there is no defect (of Ucchifta) when Madhuparka (mixture of honey) or Soma is taken or when one chews the betel leaves. Nor is one defiled like this, when one eats fmits, roots or sugarcane.
verses.hindi: न शिश्नोदरचापल्ये न च श्रवणयोः क्वचित्
verses.wordMeaning: Manu says that there is no defect (of Ucchifta) when Madhuparka (mixture of honey) or Soma is taken or when one chews the betel leaves. Nor is one defiled like this, when one eats fmits, roots or sugarcane.
verses.commentary: Sense: Manu says that there is no defect (of Ucchifta) when Madhuparka (mixture of honey) or Soma is taken or when one chews the betel leaves. Nor is one defiled like this, when one eats fmits, roots or sugarcane.

verses.sanskrit: दण्डी च मेखली सूत्री कृष्णाजिनधरो मुनिः । भिक्षाहारो गुरुहितो वीक्षमाणो गुरुर्मुखम्
verses.transliteration: daṇḍī ca mekhalī sūtrī kṛṣṇājinadharo muniḥ / bhikṣāhāro guruhito vīkṣamāṇo gururmukham
verses.translation: If a Brahmana becomes defiled (while eating and drinking) food and water in plenty,* he should keep down on the ground the material (that he is carrying), perform Acamana (after eating) and (then purify that material) by sprinkling water over it.
verses.hindi: न शातयेदिष्टकाभिः फलानि न फलेन च। न म्लेच्छभाषां शिक्षेत नाकर्षेच्च पदासनम् कुर्याद् विमर्दनं धीमान् नाकस्मादेव निष्फलम्
verses.wordMeaning: If a Brahmana becomes defiled (while eating and drinking) food and water in plenty,* he should keep down on the ground the material (that he is carrying), perform Acamana (after eating) and (then purify that material) by sprinkling water over it.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a Brahmana becomes defiled (while eating and drinking) food and water in plenty,* he should keep down on the ground the material (that he is carrying), perform Acamana (after eating) and (then purify that material) by sprinkling water over it.

verses.sanskrit: कार्पासमुपवीतार्थं निर्मितं ब्रह्मणा पुरा । ब्राह्मणानां त्रिवित् सूत्रं कौशं वा वस्त्रमेव वा
verses.transliteration: kārpāsamupavītārthaṃ nirmitaṃ brahmaṇā purā / brāhmaṇānāṃ trivit sūtraṃ kauśaṃ vā vastrameva vā
verses.translation: While taking with him a bright metallic thing (such as a Pot), if Brahmana becomes defiled by Ucchista, he should place that article on the ground. He should then perform Aca¬ mana and take up that again.
verses.hindi: न लौकिकैः स्तवैर्देवांस्तोषयेद् बाह्यजैरपि
verses.wordMeaning: While taking with him a bright metallic thing (such as a Pot), if Brahmana becomes defiled by Ucchista, he should place that article on the ground. He should then perform Aca¬ mana and take up that again.
verses.commentary: Sense: While taking with him a bright metallic thing (such as a Pot), if Brahmana becomes defiled by Ucchista, he should place that article on the ground. He should then perform Aca¬ mana and take up that again.

verses.sanskrit: सदोपवीती चैव स्यात् सदा बद्धशिखो द्विजः । अन्यथा यत् कृतं कर्म तद् भवत्ययथाकृतम्
verses.transliteration: sadopavītī caiva syāt sadā baddhaśikho dvijaḥ / anyathā yat kṛtaṃ karma tad bhavatyayathākṛtam
verses.translation: If he takes anything without chanting the Mantras and then becomes defiled by Ucchista, he should become pure on performing Acamana even without placing that article (on the ground).
verses.hindi: न बालातपमासेवेत् प्रेतधूमं विवर्जयेत्। नेकः सुप्याच्छून्यगृहे स्वयं नोपानहौ हरेत् नाकारणाद् वा निष्ठीवेन्न बाहुभ्यां नदीं तरेत्। न पादक्षालनं कुर्यात् पादेनैव कदाचन
verses.wordMeaning: If he takes anything without chanting the Mantras and then becomes defiled by Ucchista, he should become pure on performing Acamana even without placing that article (on the ground).
verses.commentary: Sense: If he takes anything without chanting the Mantras and then becomes defiled by Ucchista, he should become pure on performing Acamana even without placing that article (on the ground).

verses.sanskrit: वसेदविकृतं वासः कार्पासं वा कषायकम् । तदेव परिधानीयं शुक्लमच्छिद्रमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: vasedavikṛtaṃ vāsaḥ kārpāsaṃ vā kaṣāyakam / tadeva paridhānīyaṃ śuklamacchidramuttamam
verses.translation: One shall not do so in a holy centre nor in the sac¬ red water nor in a quadrangle. He shall not discharge faeces in a garden or a nearby place; nor in a barren land nor in a very dirty place.
verses.hindi: नाग्नौ प्रतापयेत् पादौ न कांस्ये धावयेद् बुधः । नाभिप्रसारयेद् देवं ब्राह्मणान् गामथापि वा। वाखग्निगुरुविप्रान् वा सूर्य वा शशिनं प्रति
verses.wordMeaning: One shall not do so in a holy centre nor in the sac¬ red water nor in a quadrangle. He shall not discharge faeces in a garden or a nearby place; nor in a barren land nor in a very dirty place.
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall not do so in a holy centre nor in the sac¬ red water nor in a quadrangle. He shall not discharge faeces in a garden or a nearby place; nor in a barren land nor in a very dirty place.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तरं तु समाख्यातं वासः कृष्णाजिनं शुभम् । अभावे गव्यमजिनं रौरवं वा विधीयते
verses.transliteration: uttaraṃ tu samākhyātaṃ vāsaḥ kṛṣṇājinaṃ śubham / abhāve gavyamajinaṃ rauravaṃ vā vidhīyate
verses.translation: The purificatory rite shall be performed with clay brought from the banks. The stickiness and the odour shall be
verses.hindi: कभी भी हाथ,पैर, वाणी और नेत्र-सम्बन्धी चंचलताका आश्रय न ले। इसी प्रकार लिंग तथा उदर और कान- सम्बन्धी चंचलता नहीं करनी चाहिए। अंग एवं नखकी आवाज न करे। अंजलिसे (जल) न पिये। कभी भी हाथ अथवा पैरसे जलको न पीटे
verses.wordMeaning: The purificatory rite shall be performed with clay brought from the banks. The stickiness and the odour shall be
verses.commentary: Sense: The purificatory rite shall be performed with clay brought from the banks. The stickiness and the odour shall be

verses.sanskrit: उद्धृत्य दक्षिणं बाहुं सव्ये बाहौ समर्पितम् । उपवीतं भवेन्नित्यं निवीतं कण्ठसज्जने
verses.transliteration: uddhṛtya dakṣiṇaṃ bāhuṃ savye bāhau samarpitam / upavītaṃ bhavennityaṃ nivītaṃ kaṇṭhasajjane
verses.translation: A Brahmana should not bring clay from a dusty place, or a marshy place. He shall not bring it from the high way nor from barren land. Nor from the soil defiled by Ucchifta of some one else performing auca (the purificatory rite.)
verses.hindi: ईटों और फलके द्वारा फलोंको नहीं तोड़ना चाहिए। म्लेच्छ भाषाको शिक्षा न ले, पैरसे आसनको न खींचे। (नखोंद्वारा) काटने, छेदने, फोड़ने तथा लिखने-सम्बन्धी क्रियाएँ नहीं करनी चाहिए। बुद्धिमान्
verses.wordMeaning: A Brahmana should not bring clay from a dusty place, or a marshy place. He shall not bring it from the high way nor from barren land. Nor from the soil defiled by Ucchifta of some one else performing auca (the purificatory rite.)
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmana should not bring clay from a dusty place, or a marshy place. He shall not bring it from the high way nor from barren land. Nor from the soil defiled by Ucchifta of some one else performing auca (the purificatory rite.)

verses.sanskrit: सव्यं बाहुं समुद्धृत्य दक्षिणे तु धृतं द्विजाः । प्राचीनावीतमित्युक्तं पित्र्ये कर्मणि योजयेत्
verses.transliteration: savyaṃ bāhuṃ samuddhṛtya dakṣiṇe tu dhṛtaṃ dvijāḥ / prācīnāvītamityuktaṃ pitrye karmaṇi yojayet
verses.translation: He should not bring the clay from a temple nor from a well nor from the open village nor from the waterbed. In accordance with the injunction mentioned before, he should always perform the Acamana rite as well.
verses.hindi: व्यक्तिको अकस्मात् बिना प्रयोजनके शरीर या (अङ्गोंका) मर्दन (मरोड़नेकी क्रिया) नहीं करना चाहिए। (कोई पदार्थ) गोदमें रखकर नहीं खाना चाहिए। व्यर्थकी कोई चेष्टा नहीं करनी चाहिए। नृत्य, गायन तथा वादन (जब चाहे तब) नहीं करना चाहिए। दोनों हाथोंसे अपना सिर नहीं खुजलाना चाहिए। लौकिक तथा बाह्य (विदेशी) भाषाको स्तुतियोंसे देवताओंको संतुष्ट (करनेका प्रयास) नहीं करना चाहिए। पाशोंसे (जूआ) न खेले,
verses.wordMeaning: He should not bring the clay from a temple nor from a well nor from the open village nor from the waterbed. In accordance with the injunction mentioned before, he should always perform the Acamana rite as well.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should not bring the clay from a temple nor from a well nor from the open village nor from the waterbed. In accordance with the injunction mentioned before, he should always perform the Acamana rite as well.

verses.sanskrit: अग्न्यगारे गवां गोष्ठे होमे जप्ये तथैव च । स्वाध्याये भोजने नित्यं ब्राह्मणानां च सन्निधौ
verses.transliteration: agnyagāre gavāṃ goṣṭhe home japye tathaiva ca / svādhyāye bhojane nityaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca sannidhau
verses.translation: VV. 86-89 refer to life-long celibates. Sahara on Jaimini 1.3.3 remarks that such perpetual celibacy is not approved by Sruti. But Visnu as (quoted by SMC I. ) allows it to abnormal people who are not entitled to Vedic rites.
verses.hindi: न दौड़े, जलमें मल-मूत्रका विसर्जन न करे। जूठे मुख नहीं रहना चाहिए और कभी भी नग्न होकर सान नहीं करना चाहिए॥ ६१--६५॥
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 86-89 refer to life-long celibates. Sahara on Jaimini 1.3.3 remarks that such perpetual celibacy is not approved by Sruti. But Visnu as (quoted by SMC I. ) allows it to abnormal people who are not entitled to Vedic rites.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 86-89 refer to life-long celibates. Sahara on Jaimini 1.3.3 remarks that such perpetual celibacy is not approved by Sruti. But Visnu as (quoted by SMC I. ) allows it to abnormal people who are not entitled to Vedic rites.

verses.sanskrit: उपासने गुरूणां च संध्ययोः साधुसंगमे । उपवीती भवेन्नित्यं विधिरेष सनातनः
verses.transliteration: upāsane gurūṇāṃ ca saṃdhyayoḥ sādhusaṃgame / upavītī bhavennityaṃ vidhireṣa sanātanaḥ
verses.translation: VV. 2-37 give the code of conduct to be followed by a pupil during his stay at Guru's hermitage. These are based on Dharma Sutras (e.g. Gautama II. 13-25) & Smrtis like Manu (II. 177-179.)
verses.hindi: (नग्न अवस्थामें) न कहीं जाय, न पढ़े और न अपने सिरका स्पर्श करे। दाँतोंके द्वारा नख या रोमोंको नहीं काटना चाहिए। सोये हुए व्यक्तिको जगाना नहीं चाहिए। उगते हुए सूर्यके धूपका सेवन नहीं करना चाहिए। चिताके धुएँसे दूर रहना चाहिए। शून्य गृहमें अकेले नहीं सोना चाहिए। स्वयं अपने जूतोंको नहीं ढोना चाहिए। अकारण नहीं थूकना चाहिए। तैरकर नदीको पार नहीं करना चाहिए। कभी भी पैरद्वारा पैरको
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 2-37 give the code of conduct to be followed by a pupil during his stay at Guru's hermitage. These are based on Dharma Sutras (e.g. Gautama II. 13-25) & Smrtis like Manu (II. 177-179.)
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 2-37 give the code of conduct to be followed by a pupil during his stay at Guru's hermitage. These are based on Dharma Sutras (e.g. Gautama II. 13-25) & Smrtis like Manu (II. 177-179.)

verses.sanskrit: मौञ्जी त्रिवृत् समा श्लक्षणा कार्या विप्रस्य मेखला । मुञ्जाभावे कुशेनाहुर्ग्रन्थिनैकेन वा त्रिभिः
verses.transliteration: mauñjī trivṛt samā ślakṣaṇā kāryā viprasya mekhalā / muñjābhāve kuśenāhurgranthinaikena vā tribhiḥ
verses.translation: Even when not seen by him (i.e. in the absence of his guru), the preceptor's name should not be directly mentioned by the disciple. Nor should he mimic the preceptor's mode of walking or behaviour.
verses.hindi: नहीं धोना चाहिए। बुद्धिमान् व्यक्तिको अग्निसे पैर नहीं सेंकना चाहिए। काँसेके पात्रमें पैर नहीं धोना चाहिए।
verses.wordMeaning: Even when not seen by him (i.e. in the absence of his guru), the preceptor's name should not be directly mentioned by the disciple. Nor should he mimic the preceptor's mode of walking or behaviour.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even when not seen by him (i.e. in the absence of his guru), the preceptor's name should not be directly mentioned by the disciple. Nor should he mimic the preceptor's mode of walking or behaviour.

verses.sanskrit: धारयेद् बैल्वपालाशौ दण्डौ केशान्तकौ द्विजः । यज्ञार्हवृक्षजं वाथ सौम्यमव्रणमेव च
verses.transliteration: dhārayed bailvapālāśau daṇḍau keśāntakau dvijaḥ / yajñārhavṛkṣajaṃ vātha saumyamavraṇameva ca
verses.translation: If, at any place, the preceptor is found to be censured or refuted in argument, the disciple should close his ears or walk out of that place to another place.
verses.hindi: गुरु, विप्र, सूर्य तथा चन्द्रमाको ओर पैर नहीं फैलाना चाहिए। कभी भी अपवित्र अवस्थामें सोना, दूरकी यात्रा, स्वाध्याय, स्नान, सवारीपर बैठना और घरसे बाहर नहीं निकलना चाहिए  इसका तात्पर्य यह है कि जो लोग संस्कृतके अध्ययनके अधिकारी हैं, उन्हें अवश्य संस्कृतका अध्ययन करना चाहिए और वेदादिशास्त्रोमे निर्दिष्ट स्तुतियोंसे ही देवताओंकी स्तुति करनी चाहिए। अनधिकारके कारण या सर्वथा सामर्थ्यके अभावमें श्रद्धातिशयमें जिस किसी भाषाके द्वारा स्तुति करनी ही चाहिए। यहाँ यथाधिकार संस्कृत शास्त्रोंके अवश्य अध्ययनमें तात्पर्य है। लौकिक भाषा
verses.wordMeaning: If, at any place, the preceptor is found to be censured or refuted in argument, the disciple should close his ears or walk out of that place to another place.
verses.commentary: Sense: If, at any place, the preceptor is found to be censured or refuted in argument, the disciple should close his ears or walk out of that place to another place.

verses.sanskrit: सायं प्रातर्द्विजः संध्यामुपासीत समाहितः । कामाल्लोभाद् भयान्मोहात् त्यक्तेन पतितो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: sāyaṃ prātardvijaḥ saṃdhyāmupāsīta samāhitaḥ / kāmāllobhād bhayānmohāt tyaktena patito bhavet
verses.translation: When standing far away, the disciple need not worship the preceptor. He shall not revere him angrily or (while he is) in the vicinity of a woman. The preceptor should not be answered gruffly. He should not be retorted. While the teacher is standing, the disciple should not remain seated.
verses.hindi: आदिसे स्तुतिके निपेधमें तात्पर्य नहीं है ।
verses.wordMeaning: When standing far away, the disciple need not worship the preceptor. He shall not revere him angrily or (while he is) in the vicinity of a woman. The preceptor should not be answered gruffly. He should not be retorted. While the teacher is standing,…
verses.commentary: Sense: When standing far away, the disciple need not worship the preceptor. He shall not revere him angrily or (while he is) in the vicinity of a woman. The preceptor should not be answered gruffly. He should not be retorted. While the teacher is standing,…

verses.sanskrit: अग्निकार्यं ततः कुर्यात् सायं प्रातः प्रसन्नधीः । स्नात्वा संतर्पयेद् देवानृषीन् पितृगणांस्तथा
verses.transliteration: agnikāryaṃ tataḥ kuryāt sāyaṃ prātaḥ prasannadhīḥ / snātvā saṃtarpayed devānṛṣīn pitṛgaṇāṃstathā
verses.translation: For the sake of the teacher, the disciple should fetch potfulls of water, Kusa grass, flowers and sacrificial twigs. He should anoint, wipe off or massage his limbs fiequently.
verses.hindi: न चासनं पदा वापि न देवप्रतिमां स्पृशेत् नाशुद्धोऽग्निं परिचरेन्न देवान् कीर्तयेदूषीन्। नावगाहेदगाधाम्बु धारयेन्नानिमित्ततः
verses.wordMeaning: For the sake of the teacher, the disciple should fetch potfulls of water, Kusa grass, flowers and sacrificial twigs. He should anoint, wipe off or massage his limbs fiequently.
verses.commentary: Sense: For the sake of the teacher, the disciple should fetch potfulls of water, Kusa grass, flowers and sacrificial twigs. He should anoint, wipe off or massage his limbs fiequently.

verses.sanskrit: देवताभ्यर्चनं कुर्यात् पुष्पैः पत्रेण वाम्बुभिः । अभिवादनशीलः स्यान्नित्यं वृद्धेषु धर्मतः
verses.transliteration: devatābhyarcanaṃ kuryāt puṣpaiḥ patreṇa vāmbubhiḥ / abhivādanaśīlaḥ syānnityaṃ vṛddheṣu dharmataḥ
verses.translation: He should neither tread over nor step across the garland previously worn by the teacher, his bedstead, his (wooden)sandals and (leather) shoes, seat, shadow and his oblong chair.
verses.hindi: नास्थिभस्मकपालानि न केशान्न च कण्टकान्। तुषाङ्गारकरीषं वा नाधितिष्ठेत् कदाचन
verses.wordMeaning: He should neither tread over nor step across the garland previously worn by the teacher, his bedstead, his (wooden)sandals and (leather) shoes, seat, shadow and his oblong chair.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should neither tread over nor step across the garland previously worn by the teacher, his bedstead, his (wooden)sandals and (leather) shoes, seat, shadow and his oblong chair.

verses.sanskrit: असावहं भो नामेति सम्यक् प्रणतिपूर्वकम् । आयुरारोग्यसिद्ध्यर्थं तन्द्रादिपरिवर्जितः
verses.transliteration: asāvahaṃ bho nāmeti samyak praṇatipūrvakam / āyurārogyasiddhyarthaṃ tandrādiparivarjitaḥ
verses.translation: He should gather tooth-pick etc. for the sake of the preceptor. He should duly inform the preceptor about the duties carried out by himself. Without taking leave of the preceptor, he should not go anywhere. The disciple shall be engaged in activities pleasing and beneficial to the preceptor.
verses.hindi: न वहि मुखनिः श्वासैर्ज्वालयेन्नाशुचिर्बुधः । पुण्यस्थानोदकस्थाने सीमान्तं वा कृषेन्न तु दोनों संध्या-समयों तथा मध्याहरकालमें शयन, अध्ययन, स्नान, उबटन लगाना, भोजन तथा गमनका नित्य त्याग करना चाहिए। ब्राह्मणको  चाहिए कि वह जूठे मुँह-हाथसे गौ, ब्राह्मण, अग्रि, आसन तथा देव-
verses.wordMeaning: He should gather tooth-pick etc. for the sake of the preceptor. He should duly inform the preceptor about the duties carried out by himself. Without taking leave of the preceptor, he should not go anywhere.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He should gather tooth-pick etc. for the sake of the preceptor. He should duly inform the preceptor about the duties carried out by himself. Without taking leave of the preceptor, he should not go anywhere.…

verses.sanskrit: आयुष्णान् भव सौम्येति वाच्यो विप्रो ऽभिवादने । अकारश्चास्य नाम्नो ऽन्ते वाच्यः पूर्वाक्षरः प्लुतः
verses.transliteration: āyuṣṇān bhava saumyeti vācyo vipro 'bhivādane / akāraścāsya nāmno 'nte vācyaḥ pūrvākṣaraḥ plutaḥ
verses.translation: At the preceptor's instance, he may sit on a plank with mental concentration. He should not by himself ever remain in the seat, bed or a vehicle (along with the preceptor?).
verses.hindi: प्रतिमाका स्पर्श न करे। इसी प्रकार पैरसे भी इनका स्पर्श न करे। अपवित्रताकी स्थितिमें अग्निकी परिचर्या न करे, देवताओं तथा ऋषियों (-के नाम आदि)- का कीर्तन न करे। गहरे जलमें स्नान न करे और
verses.wordMeaning: At the preceptor's instance, he may sit on a plank with mental concentration. He should not by himself ever remain in the seat, bed or a vehicle (along with the preceptor?).
verses.commentary: Sense: At the preceptor's instance, he may sit on a plank with mental concentration. He should not by himself ever remain in the seat, bed or a vehicle (along with the preceptor?).

verses.sanskrit: न कुर्याद् यो ऽभिवादस्य द्विजः प्रत्यभिवादनम् । नाभिवाद्यः स विदुषा यथा शूद्रस्तथैव सः
verses.transliteration: na kuryād yo 'bhivādasya dvijaḥ pratyabhivādanam / nābhivādyaḥ sa viduṣā yathā śūdrastathaiva saḥ
verses.translation: He should collect and fetch the following things as much as necessary, viz., water pots, flowers, cowdung, clay and the Kusa grass. Everyday, he should go begging for alms.
verses.hindi: बिना कारण (मल-मूत्रादिका वेग) न रोके। बायें हाथसे उठाकर अथवा मुखसे (पशुके समान) जल नहीं पीना चाहिए। बिना आचमन किये उत्तर न दे और जलमें वीर्यका त्याग नहीं करना चाहिए। अपवित्र वस्तुसे लिप्त किसी वस्तु, रक्त (खून), विष तथा वेगवाली नदीका उल्लंघन नहीं करना चाहिए। जलमें मैथुन नहीं करना चाहिए। अश्वत्थ वृक्षको' नहीं काटना चाहिए। जलमें थूकना नहीं चाहिए॥ ७१--७५॥
verses.wordMeaning: He should collect and fetch the following things as much as necessary, viz., water pots, flowers, cowdung, clay and the Kusa grass. Everyday, he should go begging for alms.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should collect and fetch the following things as much as necessary, viz., water pots, flowers, cowdung, clay and the Kusa grass. Everyday, he should go begging for alms.

verses.sanskrit: व्यत्यस्तपाणिना कार्यमुपसंग्रहणं गुरोः । सव्येन सव्यः स्प्रष्टव्यो दक्षिणेन तु दक्षिणः
verses.transliteration: vyatyastapāṇinā kāryamupasaṃgrahaṇaṃ guroḥ / savyena savyaḥ spraṣṭavyo dakṣiṇena tu dakṣiṇaḥ
verses.translation: He should not witness dance-programmes. He should always be disinterested in songs etc. Artiflcial salt and all stale things shall be avoided. (All salted preparations, when stale, shall be avoided).
verses.hindi: हड्डी, भस्म, कपाल, केश (बाल), कण्टक, भूसी, अंगार और शुष्क गोबरपर कभी भी बैठना नहीं चाहिए। बुद्धिमान् व्यक्तिको अग्निका लंघन नहीं करना चाहिए। अग्निको कभी भी (शय्या, आसन आदिके) नीचे न
verses.wordMeaning: He should not witness dance-programmes. He should always be disinterested in songs etc. Artiflcial salt and all stale things shall be avoided. (All salted preparations, when stale, shall be avoided).
verses.commentary: Sense: He should not witness dance-programmes. He should always be disinterested in songs etc. Artiflcial salt and all stale things shall be avoided. (All salted preparations, when stale, shall be avoided).

verses.sanskrit: लौकिकं वैदिकं चापि तथाध्यात्मिकमेव वा । आददीत यतो ज्ञानं तं पूर्वमभिवादयेत्
verses.transliteration: laukikaṃ vaidikaṃ cāpi tathādhyātmikameva vā / ādadīta yato jñānaṃ taṃ pūrvamabhivādayet
verses.translation: He shall not look at the sun (at the sunrise or sunset). He should not use tooth brush twigs. He should not go to a lonely spot in the company of unclean women nor should he have lengthy conversation with low castes and Sudras.
verses.hindi: रखे, न ही पैरकी ओर रखे और न मुखसे ही फूँके। कभी भी कुएँके अंदर न उतरे और न ही अपवित्र अवस्थामें उसे देखे। अग्निमें अग्निको नहीं फेंकना चाहिए और पानीसे इसे बुझाना नहीं चाहिए। मित्रके मरण तथा उसके दुःखको, (अपने दुःखको) स्वयं दूसरोंको न
verses.wordMeaning: He shall not look at the sun (at the sunrise or sunset). He should not use tooth brush twigs. He should not go to a lonely spot in the company of unclean women nor should he have lengthy conversation with low castes and Sudras.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall not look at the sun (at the sunrise or sunset). He should not use tooth brush twigs. He should not go to a lonely spot in the company of unclean women nor should he have lengthy conversation with low castes and Sudras.

verses.sanskrit: नोदकं धारयेद् भैक्षं पुष्पाणि समिधस्तथा । एवंविधानि चान्यानि न दैवाद्येषु कर्मसु
verses.transliteration: nodakaṃ dhārayed bhaikṣaṃ puṣpāṇi samidhastathā / evaṃvidhāni cānyāni na daivādyeṣu karmasu
verses.translation: He should do everything to please the preceptor and not out of passion or his sweet will. He should perform ablution somehow to remove impurities.
verses.hindi: प्राप्त हो उसे विक्रय नहीं करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: He should do everything to please the preceptor and not out of passion or his sweet will. He should perform ablution somehow to remove impurities.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should do everything to please the preceptor and not out of passion or his sweet will. He should perform ablution somehow to remove impurities.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणं कुशलं पृच्छेत् क्षत्रबन्धुमनामयम् । वैश्यं क्षेमं समागम्य शूद्रमारोग्यमेव तु
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇaṃ kuśalaṃ pṛcchet kṣatrabandhumanāmayam / vaiśyaṃ kṣemaṃ samāgamya śūdramārogyameva tu
verses.translation: A Brahmana should not even think ofabandoning his preceptor. If out of delusion or covetousness, he abandons (the preceptor), he shall be fallen.
verses.hindi: विद्वान्को चाहिए कि वह अग्निको मुखके निः श्वाससे प्रज्वलित न करे। अपवित्रताकी स्थितिमें पवित्र तीर्थमे, जलवाले स्थानमें नहीं जाना चाहिए और (ग्राम आदिके) सीमा-समाप्तिकी भूमिको नहीं जोतना चाहिए पहले की गयी प्रतिज्ञा या नियमको कभी भी तोड़ना नहीं चाहिए। पशु, सर्प एवं पक्षियोंको परस्पर लड़ानेके लिये उत्तेजित नहीं करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: A Brahmana should not even think ofabandoning his preceptor. If out of delusion or covetousness, he abandons (the preceptor), he shall be fallen.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmana should not even think ofabandoning his preceptor. If out of delusion or covetousness, he abandons (the preceptor), he shall be fallen.

verses.sanskrit: उपाध्यायः पिता ज्येष्ठो भ्राता चैव महीपतिः । मातुलः श्वशुरस्त्राता मातामहपितामहौ । वर्णज्येष्ठः पितृव्यश्च पुंसो ऽत्र गुरवः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: upādhyāyaḥ pitā jyeṣṭho bhrātā caiva mahīpatiḥ / mātulaḥ śvaśurastrātā mātāmahapitāmahau / varṇajyeṣṭhaḥ pitṛvyaśca puṃso 'tra guravaḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: He should never antagonise that person from whom he receives knowledge, whether secular, Vedic or spiritual.
verses.hindi: कारयित्वा स्वकर्माणि कारून् पश्चान्न वञ्जयेत्। सायंप्रातर्गृहद्वारान् भिक्षार्थं नावघट्टयेत्
verses.wordMeaning: He should never antagonise that person from whom he receives knowledge, whether secular, Vedic or spiritual.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should never antagonise that person from whom he receives knowledge, whether secular, Vedic or spiritual.

verses.sanskrit: माता मातामही गुर्वो पितुर्मातुश्च सोदराः । श्वश्रूः पितामहीज्येष्ठा धात्री च गुरवः स्त्रियः
verses.transliteration: mātā mātāmahī gurvo piturmātuśca sodarāḥ / śvaśrūḥ pitāmahījyeṣṭhā dhātrī ca guravaḥ striyaḥ
verses.translation: Manu, however, has laid down that even a Guru (preceptor) can be abandoned, should he take to wrong paths, be arrogant or not know what should be done and what should not be done.
verses.hindi: स्वमग्निं नैव हस्तेन स्पृशेन्नाप्सु चिरं वसेत् न पक्षकेणोपधमेन्न शूर्पेण न पाणिना। मुखे नेव धमेदय्िं मुखादग्मिरजायत
verses.wordMeaning: Manu, however, has laid down that even a Guru (preceptor) can be abandoned, should he take to wrong paths, be arrogant or not know what should be done and what should not be done.
verses.commentary: Sense: Manu, however, has laid down that even a Guru (preceptor) can be abandoned, should he take to wrong paths, be arrogant or not know what should be done and what should not be done.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्तो गुरुवर्गो ऽयं मातृतः पितृतो द्विजाः । अनुवर्तनमेतेषां मनोवाक्कायकर्मभिः
verses.transliteration: ityukto guruvargo 'yaṃ mātṛtaḥ pitṛto dvijāḥ / anuvartanameteṣāṃ manovākkāyakarmabhiḥ
verses.translation: When the preceptor of the preceptor is nearby, the disciple should show as much devotion as towards the preceptor;
verses.hindi: न देवायतनं गच्छेत् कदाचिद् वाप्रदक्षिणम्। न वीजयेद् वा वस्त्रेण न देवायतने स्वपेत्
verses.wordMeaning: When the preceptor of the preceptor is nearby, the disciple should show as much devotion as towards the preceptor;
verses.commentary: Sense: When the preceptor of the preceptor is nearby, the disciple should show as much devotion as towards the preceptor;

verses.sanskrit: गुरुं दृष्ट्वा समुत्तिष्ठेदभिवाद्य कृताञ्जलिः । नैतैरुपविशेत् सार्धं विवदेन्नात्मकारणात्
verses.transliteration: guruṃ dṛṣṭvā samuttiṣṭhedabhivādya kṛtāñjaliḥ / naitairupaviśet sārdhaṃ vivadennātmakāraṇāt
verses.translation: This very behaviour should be constant in regard to the preceptors of other lores to one's kith and kin, to those who prevent one from Adharmas and who give instructions in bene¬ ficial things.
verses.hindi: नेकोऽध्वानं प्रपद्यत नाधार्मिकजनैः सह। न व्याधिदूषितैर्वापि न शूद्रैः पतितेन वा जल, वायु तथा धूप आदिके द्वारा किसी दूसरेको बाधा नहीं पहुँचानी चाहिए। अपने कार्योको करवाकर शिल्पियोंको बादमें ठगना नहीं चाहिए। भिक्षाके लिये सायंकाल और प्रात: (दूसरोंके) घरके दरवाजोंको
verses.wordMeaning: This very behaviour should be constant in regard to the preceptors of other lores to one's kith and kin, to those who prevent one from Adharmas and who give instructions in bene¬ ficial things.
verses.commentary: Sense: This very behaviour should be constant in regard to the preceptors of other lores to one's kith and kin, to those who prevent one from Adharmas and who give instructions in bene¬ ficial things.

verses.sanskrit: जीवितार्थमपि द्वेषाद् गुरुभिर्नैव भाषणम् । उदितो ऽपि गुणैरन्यैर्गुरुद्वेषी पतत्यधः
verses.transliteration: jīvitārthamapi dveṣād gurubhirnaiva bhāṣaṇam / udito 'pi guṇairanyairgurudveṣī patatyadhaḥ
verses.translation: It is better that one should always behave towards the sons, wives and kinsmen of the preceptors as though towards the preceptors.
verses.hindi: खटखटाना नहीं चाहिए  दूसरोंके द्वारा प्रयुक्त माला',
verses.wordMeaning: It is better that one should always behave towards the sons, wives and kinsmen of the preceptors as though towards the preceptors.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is better that one should always behave towards the sons, wives and kinsmen of the preceptors as though towards the preceptors.

verses.sanskrit: गुरूणामपि सर्वेषां पूज्याः पञ्च विशेषतः । तेषामाद्यास्त्रयः श्रेष्ठास्तेषां माता सुपूजिता
verses.transliteration: gurūṇāmapi sarveṣāṃ pūjyāḥ pañca viśeṣataḥ / teṣāmādyāstrayaḥ śreṣṭhāsteṣāṃ mātā supūjitā
verses.translation: A young disciple should honour all persons worthy of honour (or shall help them) in the Tajna rite. The son of the preceptor deserves honour like him (the preceptor), if he also begins to teach.
verses.hindi: एवं कुत्सित दरवाजेसे प्रवेश--इनका त्याग करना चाहिए बुद्धिमान् ब्राह्मणको' खाते हुए खड़ा नहीं होना चाहिए और न ही हँसते हुए बोलना चाहिए। अपने हाथोंद्वारा अपनी अग्रिका स्पर्श नहीं करना चाहिए और देरतक जलमे नहीं रहना चाहिए। अग्रिको न पंखेकी
verses.wordMeaning: A young disciple should honour all persons worthy of honour (or shall help them) in the Tajna rite. The son of the preceptor deserves honour like him (the preceptor), if he also begins to teach.
verses.commentary: Sense: A young disciple should honour all persons worthy of honour (or shall help them) in the Tajna rite. The son of the preceptor deserves honour like him (the preceptor), if he also begins to teach.

verses.sanskrit: यो भावयति या सूते येन विद्योपदिश्यते । ज्येष्ठो भ्राता च भर्ता च पञ्चैते गुरवः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: yo bhāvayati yā sūte yena vidyopadiśyate / jyeṣṭho bhrātā ca bhartā ca pañcaite guravaḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: The disciple should neither bathe the son of the pre¬ ceptor nor apply cosmetics over his body. He should not partake of his leavings, nor should he clean his feet.
verses.hindi: हवासे प्रज्वलित करना चाहिए, न सूप (-की हवा)- से और न हाथसे (हिलाकर) । मुखसे (फुँकनीद्वारा) अग्निको प्रज्वलित नहीं करना चाहिए, क्योंकि मुखसे ही अग्नि उत्पन्न हुआ है
verses.wordMeaning: The disciple should neither bathe the son of the pre¬ ceptor nor apply cosmetics over his body. He should not partake of his leavings, nor should he clean his feet.
verses.commentary: Sense: The disciple should neither bathe the son of the pre¬ ceptor nor apply cosmetics over his body. He should not partake of his leavings, nor should he clean his feet.

verses.sanskrit: आत्मनः सर्वयत्नेन प्राणत्यागेन वा पुनः । पूजनीया विशेषेण पञ्चैते भूतिमिच्छता
verses.transliteration: ātmanaḥ sarvayatnena prāṇatyāgena vā punaḥ / pūjanīyā viśeṣeṇa pañcaite bhūtimicchatā
verses.translation: The wives of the preceptors should be honoured and respected like the preceptor, if they are of his own caste. But if they belong to lower castes, they are to be honoured only by greetings and standing up (when they come).
verses.hindi: दूसरेकी स्त्रीसे बात नहीं करनी चाहिए और द्विज (ब्राह्मण)-को चाहिए कि जो यज्ञ करने योग्य नहीं है उसका यज्ञ न कराये। विप्रको अकेले सभामें नहीं जाना चाहिए और समूहका त्याग करना चाहिए । बायेंसे देव- मन्दिरमे प्रवेश नहीं करना चाहिए। अर्थात् देवमन्दिरको अपने दाहिने करके प्रवेश करना चाहिए। वस्त्रद्वारा पंखा नहीं झलना चाहिए और देवमन्दिरमें सोना नहीं चाहिए। मार्गमें अकेले नहीं चलना चाहिए और न अधार्मिक
verses.wordMeaning: The wives of the preceptors should be honoured and respected like the preceptor, if they are of his own caste. But if they belong to lower castes, they are to be honoured only by greetings and standing up (when they come).
verses.commentary: Sense: The wives of the preceptors should be honoured and respected like the preceptor, if they are of his own caste. But if they belong to lower castes, they are to be honoured only by greetings and standing up (when they come).

verses.sanskrit: यावत् पिता च माता च द्वावेतौ निर्विकारिणौ । तावत् सर्वं परित्यज्य पुत्रः स्यात् तत्परायणः
verses.transliteration: yāvat pitā ca mātā ca dvāvetau nirvikāriṇau / tāvat sarvaṃ parityajya putraḥ syāt tatparāyaṇaḥ
verses.translation: The disciple should not perform the following personal services to the wives of the preceptors, viz.: bathing them, anointing their bodies with oil, application of cosmetics over their bodies, and beautifying their tresses.
verses.hindi: व्यक्तियोंके साथ ही कहीं जाना चाहिए। इसी प्रकार व्याधिग्रस्त, शूद्र और पतितोंके साथ भी मार्गमें नहीं जाना चाहिए? । जूता और जल आदिके बिना मार्गमे नहीं चलना चाहिए। न रात्रिमें, न शत्रुके साथ और न बिना
verses.wordMeaning: The disciple should not perform the following personal services to the wives of the preceptors, viz.: bathing them, anointing their bodies with oil, application of cosmetics over their bodies, and beautifying their tresses.
verses.commentary: Sense: The disciple should not perform the following personal services to the wives of the preceptors, viz.: bathing them, anointing their bodies with oil, application of cosmetics over their bodies, and beautifying their tresses.

verses.sanskrit: पिता माता च सुप्रीतौ स्यातां पुत्रगुणैर्यदि । स पुत्रः सकलं धर्ममाप्नुयात् तेन कर्मणा
verses.transliteration: pitā mātā ca suprītau syātāṃ putraguṇairyadi / sa putraḥ sakalaṃ dharmamāpnuyāt tena karmaṇā
verses.translation: If the wife of the preceptor be a youthful maiden, she should not be bowed to by touching her feet. The disciple should touch the ground and make obeisance saying asau aham (This I am).
verses.hindi: कमण्डलुके चलना चाहिए। अग्नि, गौ, ब्राह्मण आदिके बीचमेंसे होते हुए नहीं निकलना चाहिए ॥ ८६--८९ ॥ बछड़ेको दूध पिलाती हुई गाय तथा गायको बाँधनेवाली रस्सी अथवा उसकी पूँछका उल्लंघन न करे। योगियों, सिद्धो, व्रतपरायणों तथा संन्यासियोंकी निन्दा न करे
verses.wordMeaning: If the wife of the preceptor be a youthful maiden, she should not be bowed to by touching her feet. The disciple should touch the ground and make obeisance saying asau aham (This I am).
verses.commentary: Sense: If the wife of the preceptor be a youthful maiden, she should not be bowed to by touching her feet. The disciple should touch the ground and make obeisance saying asau aham (This I am).

verses.sanskrit: नास्ति मातृसमं दैवं नास्ति पितृसमो गुरुः । तयोः प्रत्युपकारो ऽपि न कथञ्चन विद्यते
verses.transliteration: nāsti mātṛsamaṃ daivaṃ nāsti pitṛsamo guruḥ / tayoḥ pratyupakāro 'pi na kathañcana vidyate
verses.translation: After return from a journey abroad, the disciple should pay respect by touching the feet of the wives of his pre¬ ceptor (on the first day but afterwards) on every day, he should bow by touching the ground, remembering the duty (of good men).
verses.hindi: १-शब्दकल्पद्रुममें यह श्लोक है। वहाँ ' बहिर्माल्य' का अर्थ 'कण्ठसे बाहर निकाली हुई माला' किया गया है। इससे अन्यके द्वारा धारित तथा अपने द्वारा भी धारित पुष्पमालाका पुनः धारण निषिद्ध है, यह स्पष्ट होता है।
verses.wordMeaning: After return from a journey abroad, the disciple should pay respect by touching the feet of the wives of his pre¬ ceptor (on the first day but afterwards) on every day, he should bow by touching the ground, remembering the duty (of good men).
verses.commentary: Sense: After return from a journey abroad, the disciple should pay respect by touching the feet of the wives of his pre¬ ceptor (on the first day but afterwards) on every day, he should bow by touching the ground, remembering the duty (of good men).

verses.sanskrit: तयोर्नित्यं प्रियं कुर्यात् कर्मणा मनसा गिरा । न ताभ्यामननुज्ञातो धर्ममन्यं समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: tayornityaṃ priyaṃ kuryāt karmaṇā manasā girā / na tābhyāmananujñāto dharmamanyaṃ samācaret
verses.translation: Mother's sister, maternal uncle's wife, mother-in-law, father's sister and the wife of the preceptor—all these are to be fespected equally like his preceptor's wife. They are equal to the wife of the preceptor.
verses.hindi: २-सामान्य स्थितिमें यह निषेध सबके लिये है, ब्राह्मणका उल्लेख प्रमुखताकी दृष्टिसे है। ३-यहाँ घृणाका भाव नहीं है। व्यक्ति एवं समाजके दूरगामी सुपरिणाम (कल्याण)-की दृष्टिसे यह एक सुविचारित व्यवस्था है।
verses.wordMeaning: Mother's sister, maternal uncle's wife, mother-in-law, father's sister and the wife of the preceptor—all these are to be fespected equally like his preceptor's wife. They are equal to the wife of the preceptor.
verses.commentary: Sense: Mother's sister, maternal uncle's wife, mother-in-law, father's sister and the wife of the preceptor—all these are to be fespected equally like his preceptor's wife. They are equal to the wife of the preceptor.

verses.sanskrit: वर्जयित्वा मुक्तिफलं नित्यं नैमित्तिकं तथा । धर्मसारः समुद्दिष्टः प्रेत्यानन्तफलप्रदः
verses.transliteration: varjayitvā muktiphalaṃ nityaṃ naimittikaṃ tathā / dharmasāraḥ samuddiṣṭaḥ pretyānantaphalapradaḥ
verses.translation: Brother's wife of the same caste deserves greeting by touching the feet every day. The women folk of the
verses.hindi: ३३२ ति कूर्मपुराण
verses.wordMeaning: Brother's wife of the same caste deserves greeting by touching the feet every day. The women folk of the
verses.commentary: Sense: Brother's wife of the same caste deserves greeting by touching the feet every day. The women folk of the

verses.sanskrit: सम्यगाराध्य वक्तारं विसृष्टस्तदनुज्ञया । शिष्यो विद्याफलं भुङ्क्ते प्रेत्य चापद्यते दिवि
verses.transliteration: samyagārādhya vaktāraṃ visṛṣṭastadanujñayā / śiṣyo vidyāphalaṃ bhuṅkte pretya cāpadyate divi
verses.translation: One should behave towards the sisters of one's father and mother and his own elder sister as though towards his mother. Of course the mother is greater than all of them.
verses.hindi: नाक्रामेत् कामतश्छायां ब्राह्मणानां च गोरपि॥ ९१॥  ब्राह्मणों तथा गायकी परछाईंको इच्छापूर्वक लॉघना नहीं चाहिए। पतित आदिसे तथा रोगियोंसे अपनी परछाईंका उल्लंघन नहीं होने देना चाहिए। अंगार, भस्म तथा केश स्वां तु नाक्रमयेच्छायां पतिताद्येर्न रोगिभिः । आदिपर कभी भी बैठना नहीं चाहिए। झाड़को धूल,
verses.wordMeaning: One should behave towards the sisters of one's father and mother and his own elder sister as though towards his mother. Of course the mother is greater than all of them.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should behave towards the sisters of one's father and mother and his own elder sister as though towards his mother. Of course the mother is greater than all of them.

verses.sanskrit: यो भ्रातरं पितृसमं ज्येष्ठं मूर्खो ऽवमन्यते । तेन दोषेण स प्रेत्य निरयं घोरमृच्छति
verses.transliteration: yo bhrātaraṃ pitṛsamaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ mūrkho 'vamanyate / tena doṣeṇa sa pretya nirayaṃ ghoramṛcchati
verses.translation: The preceptor shall teach such a self-possessed, modest (non-arrogant) disciple, endowed with decency of conduct. He should continuously teach him the Vedas, the Dharmas (Dharma-lSastra or smrtis), the Puranas and the Ahgas (Ancillary subjects like Siksa, grammar etc.)
verses.hindi: नाङ्गारभस्मकेशादिष्वधितिष्ठेत् कदाचन॥ ९२॥  स्रानके वस्त्र तथा (स्त्नानसे बचे) घड़ेके जलके छौटैसे बचना चाहिए (उसे अपने ऊपर नहीं पड़ने देना
verses.wordMeaning: The preceptor shall teach such a self-possessed, modest (non-arrogant) disciple, endowed with decency of conduct. He should continuously teach him the Vedas, the Dharmas (Dharma-lSastra or smrtis), the Puranas and the Ahgas (Ancillary subjects like Siksa, grammar etc.)
verses.commentary: Sense: The preceptor shall teach such a self-possessed, modest (non-arrogant) disciple, endowed with decency of conduct. He should continuously teach him the Vedas, the Dharmas (Dharma-lSastra or smrtis), the Puranas and the Ahgas (Ancillary subjects like Siksa, grammar etc.)

verses.sanskrit: पुंसा वर्त्मनिविष्टेन पूज्यो भर्ता तु सर्वदा । याति दातरि लोके ऽस्मिन् उपकाराद्धि गौरवम्
verses.transliteration: puṃsā vartmaniviṣṭena pūjyo bhartā tu sarvadā / yāti dātari loke 'smin upakārāddhi gauravam
verses.translation: If the disciple has lived a disciplined life (at his residence) for a full year but the preceptor fails to impart per¬ fect knowledge to him, the preceptor incurs all the sins of the disciple.
verses.hindi: बर्जयेन्मार्जनीरेणुं स्त्रानवस्त्रघटोदकम्। अभक्षणीय पदार्थको खाये नहीं और न ही अपेय न भक्षयेदभक्ष्याणि नापेयं च पिबेद् द्विजः॥ ९३॥  पदार्थको पीये
verses.wordMeaning: If the disciple has lived a disciplined life (at his residence) for a full year but the preceptor fails to impart per¬ fect knowledge to him, the preceptor incurs all the sins of the disciple.
verses.commentary: Sense: If the disciple has lived a disciplined life (at his residence) for a full year but the preceptor fails to impart per¬ fect knowledge to him, the preceptor incurs all the sins of the disciple.

verses.sanskrit: येनरा भर्तृपिण्डार्थं स्वान् प्राणान् संत्यजन्ति हि । तेषामथाक्षयांल्लोकान् प्रोवाच भगवान् मनुः
verses.transliteration: yenarā bhartṛpiṇḍārthaṃ svān prāṇān saṃtyajanti hi / teṣāmathākṣayāṃllokān provāca bhagavān manuḥ
verses.translation: As prescribed in the dharma-sastra, a preceptor should teach the following ten persons: the preceptor's son, a person desirous of learning or one who serves the teacher, a person of the teaching profession, an abider by dharma, a (mentally and physically?) pure person, the explainer of suktas {subhdfitas?), one disinterested in erotics and a saintly person.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षद्साहस्रां संहितायामुपरिविभागे षोडशोऽध्यायः
verses.wordMeaning: As prescribed in the dharma-sastra, a preceptor should teach the following ten persons: the preceptor's son, a person desirous of learning or one who serves the teacher, a person of the teaching profession, an abider by dharma, a (mentally and physically?) pure person,…
verses.commentary: Sense: As prescribed in the dharma-sastra, a preceptor should teach the following ten persons: the preceptor's son, a person desirous of learning or one who serves the teacher, a person of the teaching profession, an abider by dharma, a (mentally and physically?) pure person,…

verses.sanskrit: मातुलांश्च पितृव्यांश्च श्वशुरानृत्विजो गुरून् । असावहमिति ब्रूयुः प्रत्युत्थाय यवीयसः
verses.transliteration: mātulāṃśca pitṛvyāṃśca śvaśurānṛtvijo gurūn / asāvahamiti brūyuḥ pratyutthāya yavīyasaḥ
verses.translation: The following six should be duly instructed viz.: A grateful person, a non-malicious one, an intelligent one, a man who has rendered help, a trustworthy person and a beloved one.
verses.hindi: भक्ष्य एवं अभक्ष्य-पदार्थोंका वर्णन व्यास उवाच व्यासजीने कहा- ब्राह्मणको मोहसे अथवा अन्य नाद्याच्छूद्रस्य विप्रोऽन्नं मोहाद् वा यदि वान्यतः । किसी दूसरे कारणसे शूद्रका अन्न नहीं खाना चाहिए।
verses.wordMeaning: The following six should be duly instructed viz.: A grateful person, a non-malicious one, an intelligent one, a man who has rendered help, a trustworthy person and a beloved one.
verses.commentary: Sense: The following six should be duly instructed viz.: A grateful person, a non-malicious one, an intelligent one, a man who has rendered help, a trustworthy person and a beloved one.

verses.sanskrit: अवाच्यो दीक्षितो नाम्ना यवीयानपि यो भवेत् । भोभवत्पूर्वकं त्वेनमभिभाषेत धर्मवित्
verses.transliteration: avācyo dīkṣito nāmnā yavīyānapi yo bhavet / bhobhavatpūrvakaṃ tvenamabhibhāṣeta dharmavit
verses.translation: The Brahman (Vedas) should be gifted to these and to others together what has already been mentioned (viz. Purana etc. Facing the north, one should begin the Vedic study after performing Acamana and remaining self-controlled.
verses.hindi: शूद्रयोनिं जो अनापत्तिकालमें शूद्रका अन्न भक्षण करता हे, वह स शूद्रयोनिं ब्रजति यस्तु भुङ्क्ते हानापदि॥ १ ॥ शूद्रयोनिको प्राप्त होता है । जो द्विज छः महीनेतक लगातार
verses.wordMeaning: The Brahman (Vedas) should be gifted to these and to others together what has already been mentioned (viz. Purana etc. Facing the north, one should begin the Vedic study after performing Acamana and remaining self-controlled.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Brahman (Vedas) should be gifted to these and to others together what has already been mentioned (viz. Purana etc. Facing the north, one should begin the Vedic study after performing Acamana and remaining self-controlled.

verses.sanskrit: अभिवाद्याश्च पूज्यश्च शिरसा वन्द्य एव च । ब्राह्मणः क्षत्रियाद्यैश्च श्रीकामैः सादरं सदा
verses.transliteration: abhivādyāśca pūjyaśca śirasā vandya eva ca / brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyādyaiśca śrīkāmaiḥ sādaraṃ sadā
verses.translation: After touching his feet and glancing at the face of the preceptor, the disciple shall say adMsva bho (Recite, O sir). He shall indicate "cessation" by using the word iti and should stop there.
verses.hindi: षण्मासान् यो द्विजो भुङ्क्ते शूद्रस्यान्नं विगर्हितम्। शूद्रका गर्हित अन्न खाता है, वह जीते हुए शूद्र हो जाता जीवन्नेव भवेच्छूद्रो मृतः श्वा चाभिजायते॥ २॥  है और मृत्युके बाद श्वान-योनिमें जन्म लेता है इनमेंसे जिसका अन्न मृत्युके समय जिसके उदरमें रहता ब्राह्मणक्षत्रियविशां शूद्रस्य च मुनीश्वराः। है, उसे उसीकी योनि प्राप्त होती है (अर्थात् ब्राह्मणका यस्यान्नेनोदरस्थेन मृतस्तद्योनिमाप्नुयात्॥ ३॥  अन्न उदरमें मृत्युके समय है तो ब्राह्मण-योनि प्राप्त होगी आदि-आदि)
verses.wordMeaning: After touching his feet and glancing at the face of the preceptor, the disciple shall say adMsva bho (Recite, O sir). He shall indicate "cessation" by using the word iti and should stop there.
verses.commentary: Sense: After touching his feet and glancing at the face of the preceptor, the disciple shall say adMsva bho (Recite, O sir). He shall indicate "cessation" by using the word iti and should stop there.

verses.sanskrit: नाभिवाद्यास्तु विप्रेण क्षत्रियाद्याः कथञ्चन । ज्ञानकर्मगुणोपेता यद्यप्येते बहुश्रुताः
verses.transliteration: nābhivādyāstu vipreṇa kṣatriyādyāḥ kathañcana / jñānakarmaguṇopetā yadyapyete bahuśrutāḥ
verses.translation: When the disciple is favourably seated, sanctified by Pavitras and rendered holy through three Pranayamas, he deserves the Orhkara.
verses.hindi: राजान्नं नर्तकान्नं च तक्ष्णोऽन्नं चर्मकारिणः। राजा, नर्तक, बढ़ई, चर्मकार, गण (सौ ब्राह्मणोंका गणान्नं गणिकान्नं च षण्ढान्नं चैव वर्जयेत्॥ ४॥  संघ), गणिका और नपुंसकके अन्नका परित्याग करना चाहिए। चक्रके आधारपर अपनी जीविका चलानेवाला
verses.wordMeaning: When the disciple is favourably seated, sanctified by Pavitras and rendered holy through three Pranayamas, he deserves the Orhkara.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the disciple is favourably seated, sanctified by Pavitras and rendered holy through three Pranayamas, he deserves the Orhkara.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणः सर्ववर्णानां स्वस्ति कुर्यादिति स्थितिः । सवर्णेषु सवर्णानां कार्यमेवाभिवादनम्
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇaḥ sarvavarṇānāṃ svasti kuryāditi sthitiḥ / savarṇeṣu savarṇānāṃ kāryamevābhivādanam
verses.translation: A Brahmana should duly repeat the Pranava at the end. A Brahmana should always perform the Vedic study with, the palms joined in reverence.
verses.hindi: चक्रोपजीविरजकतस्करध्वजिनां तथा। जीवी), गायक, लौहकार और सूतकके अन्नका त्याग गान्धर्वलोहकारान्नं सूतकान्नं च वर्जयेत्॥ ५॥  करना चाहिए १-मनुस्मृति (४।२०९)-की कुल्लूकभट्टकी व्याख्याके अनुसार 'गण' का अर्थ 'शतब्राह्मणसंघ' है शत संख्याको अनेक संख्यापरक मानकर व्राह्मग-समूहका अन्न परित्याज्य समझना चाहिए।
verses.wordMeaning: A Brahmana should duly repeat the Pranava at the end. A Brahmana should always perform the Vedic study with, the palms joined in reverence.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmana should duly repeat the Pranava at the end. A Brahmana should always perform the Vedic study with, the palms joined in reverence.

verses.sanskrit: गुरुरग्निर्द्विजातीनां वर्णानां ब्राह्मणो गुरुः । पतिरेको गुरुः स्त्रीणां सर्वत्राभ्यागतो गुरुः
verses.transliteration: gururagnirdvijātīnāṃ varṇānāṃ brāhmaṇo guruḥ / patireko guruḥ strīṇāṃ sarvatrābhyāgato guruḥ

verses.sanskrit: विद्या कर्म वयो बन्धुर्वित्तं भवति पञ्चमम् । मान्यस्थानानि पञ्चाहुः पूर्वं पूर्वं गुरूत्तरात्
verses.transliteration: vidyā karma vayo bandhurvittaṃ bhavati pañcamam / mānyasthānāni pañcāhuḥ pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ gurūttarāt
verses.translation: A Brahmana should duly repeat the Pranava at the end. A Brahmana should always perform the Vedic study with, the palms joined in reverence.

verses.transliteration: pañcānāṃ triṣu varṇeṣu bhūyāṃsi balavanti ca / yatra syuḥ so 'tra mānārhaḥ śūdro 'pi daśamīṃ gataḥ

verses.wordMeaning: A Brahmana should duly repeat the Pranava at the end. A Brahmana should always perform the Vedic study with, the palms joined in reverence.

verses.sanskrit: भिक्षामाहृत्य शिष्टानां गृहेभ्यः प्रयतो ऽन्वहम् । निवेद्य गुरवे ऽश्नीयाद् वाग्यतस्तदनुज्ञया

verses.hindi: शौण्डान्नं घाटिकान्नं च भिषजामन्नमेव च। विद्धप्रजननस्यान्नं परिवित्त्यन्नमेव च गुरोरपि न भोक्तव्यमन्नं संस्कारवर्जितम्

verses.wordMeaning: A Brahmana should duly repeat the Pranava at the end. A Brahmana should always perform the Vedic study with, the palms joined in reverence.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmana should duly repeat the Pranava at the end. A Brahmana should always perform the Vedic study with, the palms joined in reverence.

verses.sanskrit: सजातीयगृहेष्वेव सार्ववर्णिकमेव वा । भैक्ष्यस्य चरणं प्रोक्तं पतितादिषु वर्जितम्
verses.transliteration: sajātīyagṛheṣveva sārvavarṇikameva vā / bhaikṣyasya caraṇaṃ proktaṃ patitādiṣu varjitam
verses.translation: A Brahmana should duly repeat the Pranava at the end. A Brahmana should always perform the Vedic study with, the palms joined in reverence.
verses.hindi: २-मनुस्मृति (९। १७५) -के अनुसार। ३-शब्दकल्पद्रुमके अनुसार । कुम्भकार, चित्रकार, वार्धुषि (कर्ज देकर सूदसे जीविका चलानेवाले), पतित, विधवाके पुनर्विवाहके अनन्तर अथवा पति-परित्यक्तासे उत्पन्न पुरुष, छत्रिकरी (नापित), अभिशस्त (चोरी, मैथुन आदि आरोपसे

verses.sanskrit: वेदयज्ञैरहीनानां प्रशस्तानां स्वकर्मसु । ब्रह्मचर्याहरेद् भैक्षं गृहेभ्यः प्रयतो ऽन्वहम्
verses.transliteration: vedayajñairahīnānāṃ praśastānāṃ svakarmasu / brahmacaryāhared bhaikṣaṃ gṛhebhyaḥ prayato 'nvaham

verses.sanskrit: गुरोः कुले न भिक्षेत न ज्ञातिकुलबन्धुषु । अलाभे त्वन्यगेहानां पूर्वं पूर्वं विवर्जयेत्
verses.transliteration: guroḥ kule na bhikṣeta na jñātikulabandhuṣu / alābhe tvanyagehānāṃ pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ vivarjayet
verses.translation: A Brahmana should duly repeat the Pranava at the end. A Brahmana should always perform the Vedic study with, the palms joined in reverence.
verses.hindi: (दण्ड देनेवाले, नियामक-जल्लाद आदि)-का अन्न नहीं ग्रहण करना चाहिए। चोर, नास्तिक, देवनिन्दक, सोमलता-विक्रयी तथा विशेषरूपसे चाण्डालका और स्त्रीके बशीभूत तथा जिसके घरमें उस स्त्रीका उपपति करनेवालेका अन्न ग्रहण नहीं करना चाहिए॥ ६--९॥

verses.sanskrit: सर्वं वा विचरेद् ग्रामं पूर्वोक्तानामसंभवे । नियम्य प्रयतो वाचं दिशस्त्वनवलोकयन्
verses.transliteration: sarvaṃ vā vicared grāmaṃ pūrvoktānāmasaṃbhave / niyamya prayato vācaṃ diśastvanavalokayan
verses.translation: A Brahmana should duly repeat the Pranava at the end. A Brahmana should always perform the Vedic study with, the palms joined in reverence.
verses.hindi: पंक्तिसे बहिष्कृत, समूहके आश्रित, शस्त्रसे आजीविका

verses.sanskrit: समाहृत्य तु तद् भैक्षं यावदर्थममायया । भुञ्जीत प्रयतो नित्यं वाग्यतो ऽनन्यमानसः

verses.wordMeaning: A Brahmana should duly repeat the Pranava at the end. A Brahmana should always perform the Vedic study with, the palms joined in reverence.

verses.transliteration: pūjayedaśanaṃ nityamadyāccaitadakutsayan / dṛṣṭvā hṛṣyet prasīdecca pratinandecca sarvaśaḥ
verses.translation: A Brahmana should duly repeat the Pranava at the end. A Brahmana should always perform the Vedic study with, the palms joined in reverence.
verses.hindi: नहीं करना चाहिए। दो बार विवाह करनेवाली स्त्री तथा ऐसी स्त्रीके पतिका अन्न विशेषरूपसे त्याज्य है। अनादरपूर्वक दिया गया, तिरस्कारपूर्वक दिया गया, रोष एवं अभिमानपूर्वक दिया हुआ अन्न, इसी प्रकार गुरुके संस्कारहीन अन्नको ग्रहण नहीं करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: A Brahmana should duly repeat the Pranava at the end. A Brahmana should always perform the Vedic study with, the palms joined in reverence.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmana should duly repeat the Pranava at the end. A Brahmana should always perform the Vedic study with, the palms joined in reverence.

verses.sanskrit: अनारोग्यमनायुष्यमस्वर्ग्यं चातिभोजनम् । अपुण्यं लोकविद्विष्टं तस्मात् तत्परिवर्जयेत्
verses.transliteration: anārogyamanāyuṣyamasvargyaṃ cātibhojanam / apuṇyaṃ lokavidviṣṭaṃ tasmāt tatparivarjayet
verses.translation: A Brahmana should duly repeat the Pranava at the end. A Brahmana should always perform the Vedic study with, the palms joined in reverence.
verses.hindi: ४-आलसी या प्रमादी होकर श्वशुरगृहमें स्थायीरूपसे रहनेके साथ वहाँका अन्न ग्रहण करना निषिद्ध है । ५-वढ़ई, जुलाहा, नाई, धोबी और चर्मकार-इन पाँचको ' कारु' या ' शिल्पी ' कहा जाता है। ६-मूलमें ' पुनर्भू' शब्द है । इसका पर्याय ' दिधीषु' है। ये दोनों शब्द स्त्रीलिङ्ग है । इनका अर्थ दो बार विवाह करनेवाली स्त्री है
verses.wordMeaning: A Brahmana should duly repeat the Pranava at the end. A Brahmana should always perform the Vedic study with, the palms joined in reverence.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmana should duly repeat the Pranava at the end. A Brahmana should always perform the Vedic study with, the palms joined in reverence.

verses.sanskrit: प्राङ्मुखो ऽन्नानि भुञ्जीत सूर्याभिमुख एव वा । नाद्यादुदङ्मुखो नित्यं विधिरेष सनातनः
verses.transliteration: prāṅmukho 'nnāni bhuñjīta sūryābhimukha eva vā / nādyādudaṅmukho nityaṃ vidhireṣa sanātanaḥ
verses.translation: A Brahmana should duly repeat the Pranava at the end. A Brahmana should always perform the Vedic study with, the palms joined in reverence.
verses.hindi: (शब्दकल्पद्रुम, अमरकोश) । ३३४  कूर्मपुराण
verses.wordMeaning: A Brahmana should duly repeat the Pranava at the end. A Brahmana should always perform the Vedic study with, the palms joined in reverence.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmana should duly repeat the Pranava at the end. A Brahmana should always perform the Vedic study with, the palms joined in reverence.

verses.sanskrit: प्रक्षाल्य पाणिपादौ च भुञ्जानो द्विरुपस्पृशेत् । शुचौ देशे समासीनो भुक्त्वा च द्विरुपस्पृशेत्
verses.transliteration: prakṣālya pāṇipādau ca bhuñjāno dvirupaspṛśet / śucau deśe samāsīno bhuktvā ca dvirupaspṛśet
verses.translation: A Brahmana should duly repeat the Pranava at the end. A Brahmana should always perform the Vedic study with, the palms joined in reverence.
verses.hindi: दुष्कृतं हि मनुष्यस्य सर्वमन्ने व्यवस्थितम्। मनुष्यका किया हुआ सारा पाप अन्नमें स्थित रहता यो यस्यान्नं समश्नाति स तस्याश्नाति किल्बिषम्॥ १५॥  है। इसलिये जो जिसका अन्न ग्रहण करता है, वह उसके पापका ही भक्षण करता है
verses.wordMeaning: A Brahmana should duly repeat the Pranava at the end. A Brahmana should always perform the Vedic study with, the palms joined in reverence.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmana should duly repeat the Pranava at the end. A Brahmana should always perform the Vedic study with, the palms joined in reverence.

verses.sanskrit: इती श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे द्वादशो ऽध्यायः व्यास उवाच भुक्त्वा पीत्वा च सुप्त्वा च स्नात्वा रथ्योपसर्पणे । ओष्ठावलमोकौ स्पृष्ट्वा वासो विपरिधाय च
verses.transliteration: itī śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge dvādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ vyāsa uvāca bhuktvā pītvā ca suptvā ca snātvā rathyopasarpaṇe / oṣṭhāvalamokau spṛṣṭvā vāso viparidhāya ca
verses.translation: The Vedas constitute the eternal 'Eye' of all living beings. (The Brahmana should recite the Vedas everyday. Otherwise he slips and falls off from Brahminhood.
verses.hindi: आद्द्विकः कुलमित्रश्व स्वगोपालश्च नापितः । आद्धिक (जो शूद्र द्विजातिके घर हल जोतकर एते शूद्रेषु भोज्यान्ना यश्चात्मानं निवेदयेत्॥ १६॥  उसके पारिश्रमिक-रूपमें अन्न प्राप्त करता है), कुलमित्र (पिता-पितामहकी परम्परासे जो द्विजातिके घर रहता आया है तथा अभिन्न सहयोगी है), जो अपने गौओंका पालन करनेवाला है, नापित तथा जिस शूद्रने मन, वाणी और कर्मसे सर्वथा स्वयंको 'मैं आपका ही हूँ'- इस रूपमें समर्पित कर दिया है--ऐसे शूद्रका अन्न ग्रहण किया जा सकता है। बुद्धिमान् व्यक्तिको शूद्रोमे
verses.wordMeaning: The Vedas constitute the eternal 'Eye' of all living beings. (The Brahmana should recite the Vedas everyday. Otherwise he slips and falls off from Brahminhood.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Vedas constitute the eternal 'Eye' of all living beings. (The Brahmana should recite the Vedas everyday. Otherwise he slips and falls off from Brahminhood.

verses.sanskrit: रेतोमूत्रपुरीषाणामुत्सर्गे ऽयुक्तभाषणे । ष्ठीवित्वाध्ययनारम्भे कासश्वासागमे तथा
verses.transliteration: retomūtrapurīṣāṇāmutsarge 'yuktabhāṣaṇe / ṣṭhīvitvādhyayanārambhe kāsaśvāsāgame tathā
verses.translation: He who recites the rk Mantras everyday, pro¬ pitiates the deities as if by the offerings of milk Ahutis. The contented Devas delight him for ever by granting him his wishes.
verses.hindi: नाटक आदिसे जीविका चलानेवालों (चारण, कत्थक), कुम्हार और खेतमें काम करनेवालोंका अन्न थोड़ा मूल्य देकर ग्रहण करना चाहिए। द्विजातियोंद्वारा दूधका' विकार-मक्खन-खोआ आदि, घृतमें पके पदार्थ, गोरस
verses.wordMeaning: He who recites the rk Mantras everyday, pro¬ pitiates the deities as if by the offerings of milk Ahutis. The contented Devas delight him for ever by granting him his wishes.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who recites the rk Mantras everyday, pro¬ pitiates the deities as if by the offerings of milk Ahutis. The contented Devas delight him for ever by granting him his wishes.

verses.sanskrit: चत्वरं वा श्मशानं वा समाक्रम्य द्विजोत्तमः । संध्ययोरुभयोस्तद्वदाचान्तो ऽप्याचमेत् पुनः
verses.transliteration: catvaraṃ vā śmaśānaṃ vā samākramya dvijottamaḥ / saṃdhyayorubhayostadvadācānto 'pyācamet punaḥ
verses.translation: A self-controlled person following the injunctions regarding daily religious duties should, after goingto the forest and in the vicinity of water (a river, lake etc.), continuously, recite the Gayatri Mantra with concentration of mind.
verses.hindi: (दूध), सत्तू पिण्याक (खली, शिलाजीत, केसर, हींग कुशीलवः कुम्भकारः क्षेत्रकर्मक एव च। एते शूद्रेषु भोज्यान्ना दत्त्वा स्वल्पं पणं बुधेः
verses.wordMeaning: A self-controlled person following the injunctions regarding daily religious duties should, after goingto the forest and in the vicinity of water (a river, lake etc.), continuously, recite the Gayatri Mantra with concentration of mind.
verses.commentary: Sense: A self-controlled person following the injunctions regarding daily religious duties should, after goingto the forest and in the vicinity of water (a river, lake etc.), continuously, recite the Gayatri Mantra with concentration of mind.

verses.sanskrit: चण्डालम्लेच्छसंभाषे स्त्रीशूद्रोच्छिष्टभाषणे । उच्छिष्टं पुरुषं स्पृष्ट्वा भोज्यं चापि तथाविधम् । आचामेदश्रुपाते वा लोहितस्य तथैव च
verses.transliteration: caṇḍālamlecchasaṃbhāṣe strīśūdrocchiṣṭabhāṣaṇe / ucchiṣṭaṃ puruṣaṃ spṛṣṭvā bhojyaṃ cāpi tathāvidham / ācāmedaśrupāte vā lohitasya tathaiva ca
verses.translation: The lord weighed once the Gayatri Mantra and the Vedas by means of a balance. On one side was the Gayatri Mantra and on the other side were the four Vedas.
verses.hindi: पायसं स्नेहपक्वं यद् गोरसं चैव सक्तवः। इत्यादि) तथा तेल--ये पदार्थ शूद्रोंसे ग्रहण किये जा पिण्याकं चैव तैलं च शूद्राद् ग्राह्य द्विजातिभिः॥ १८ ॥  सकते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: The lord weighed once the Gayatri Mantra and the Vedas by means of a balance. On one side was the Gayatri Mantra and on the other side were the four Vedas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord weighed once the Gayatri Mantra and the Vedas by means of a balance. On one side was the Gayatri Mantra and on the other side were the four Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: भोजने संध्ययोः स्नात्वा पीत्वा मूत्रपुरीषयोः । आचान्तो ऽप्याचमेत् सुप्त्वा सकृत्सकृदथान्यतः
verses.transliteration: bhojane saṃdhyayoḥ snātvā pītvā mūtrapurīṣayoḥ / ācānto 'pyācamet suptvā sakṛtsakṛdathānyataḥ
verses.translation: He shall first recite Orhkara and thereafter the Vyahrtis. Thereafter, he shall recite the Gayatrl Mantra with full faith and great concentration.
verses.hindi: वृन्ताकं नालिकाशाकं कुसुम्भाशमन्तकं तथा । बैगन, नालिकासाग', कुसुम्भ (पुष्पविशेष), पलाण्डुं लशुनं शुक्तं निर्यासं चैव वर्जयेत्॥ १९॥  अश्मन्तकः, प्याज, लहसुन, शुक्त और वृक्षके गोंदका परित्याग करना चाहिए। छत्राक, विड्वराहं छत्राकं विड्वराहं च शेलुं पेयूषमेव च। (ग्राम्य-सूकर), शेलु" (वनमेथी), पेयूष, विलय, विलयं सुमुखं चैव कवकानि च वर्जयेत्॥ २०॥  सुमुख", कवक, (कुकुरमुत्ता), किंशुक (पलाश),
verses.wordMeaning: He shall first recite Orhkara and thereafter the Vyahrtis. Thereafter, he shall recite the Gayatrl Mantra with full faith and great concentration.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall first recite Orhkara and thereafter the Vyahrtis. Thereafter, he shall recite the Gayatrl Mantra with full faith and great concentration.

verses.sanskrit: अग्नेर्गवामथालम्भे स्पृष्ट्वा प्रयतमेव वा । स्त्रीणामथात्मनः स्पर्शे नीवीं वा परिधाय च
verses.transliteration: agnergavāmathālambhe spṛṣṭvā prayatameva vā / strīṇāmathātmanaḥ sparśe nīvīṃ vā paridhāya ca
verses.translation: The three eternal great Vyahrtis, "Bhuh, Bhuvah, Svah" originated in the former Kalpa. They quell all inaus¬ piciousness.
verses.hindi: ककुभाण्ड, उदुम्बर (गूलर) तथा अलाबु (वर्तुलाकार- गृञ्जनं किंशुकं चैव ककुभाण्डं तथैव च। गोल लौकी)-का भक्षण करनेसे द्विज पतित हो उदुम्बरमलाबुं च जग्ध्वा पतति वै द्विजः॥ २९॥  जाता है॥ १९--२१॥
verses.wordMeaning: The three eternal great Vyahrtis, "Bhuh, Bhuvah, Svah" originated in the former Kalpa. They quell all inaus¬ piciousness.
verses.commentary: Sense: The three eternal great Vyahrtis, "Bhuh, Bhuvah, Svah" originated in the former Kalpa. They quell all inaus¬ piciousness.

verses.sanskrit: उपस्पृशेज्जलं वार्द्रं तृणं वा भूमिमेव वा । केशानां चात्मनः स्पर्शे वाससो ऽक्षालितस्य च
verses.transliteration: upaspṛśejjalaṃ vārdraṃ tṛṇaṃ vā bhūmimeva vā / keśānāṃ cātmanaḥ sparśe vāsaso 'kṣālitasya ca
verses.translation: The three Vyahrtis in their order are regarded as follows:
verses.hindi: १-मूलमें 'पायस' शब्द है । इसका अर्थ खीर नहीं करना चाहिए। शब्दकल्पद्रुममें उद्धृत तिथितत्त्वके वराहपुराणीय वचनके अनुसार यहाँ पायसका अर्थ दुग्धविकार ही है। २-'नालिकाशाक' मूलमें पठित है। सुश्रुत (१। ४६) -में इसकी चर्चा है। ग्राम्य भाषामें इसे ' भँसीड़' कहते हैं। यह तालाबमें होता है। इसमें पत्ते नहीं होते हैं। मात्र डंठल होता है। डंठलके भीतर छिद्र होते हैं। आप्तपरम्परामें इसका भक्षण निषिद्ध माना जाता है।
verses.wordMeaning: The three Vyahrtis in their order are regarded as follows:
verses.commentary: Sense: The three Vyahrtis in their order are regarded as follows:

verses.sanskrit: अनुष्णाभिरफेनाबिरदुष्टाभिश्च धर्मतः । शौचेप्सुः सर्वदाचामेदासीनः प्रागुदङ्मुखः
verses.transliteration: anuṣṇābhiraphenābiraduṣṭābhiśca dharmataḥ / śaucepsuḥ sarvadācāmedāsīnaḥ prāgudaṅmukhaḥ
verses.translation: Orhkara is that great Brahman, Savitri (i.e. Gayatrl) is the imperishable one. This Mantra is of great potentiality. It is cited to be the essence of all essences.
verses.hindi: ३-अश्मन्तक--तृणविशेष ' अम्लकुचाई' लोकभाषा! पर्याय ' अम्लोटक' (रत्नमाला) इसके गुण राजनिर्घण्टमें वर्णित हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Orhkara is that great Brahman, Savitri (i.e. Gayatrl) is the imperishable one. This Mantra is of great potentiality. It is cited to be the essence of all essences.
verses.commentary: Sense: Orhkara is that great Brahman, Savitri (i.e. Gayatrl) is the imperishable one. This Mantra is of great potentiality. It is cited to be the essence of all essences.

verses.sanskrit: शिरः प्रावृत्य कण्ठं वा मुक्तकच्छसिखो ऽपि वा । अकृत्वा पादयोः शौचमाचान्तो ऽप्यशुचिर्भवेत्
verses.transliteration: śiraḥ prāvṛtya kaṇṭhaṃ vā muktakacchasikho 'pi vā / akṛtvā pādayoḥ śaucamācānto 'pyaśucirbhavet
verses.translation: Strictly observing the vow of celibacy, he who under¬ standing the meaning of the Mantra, repeats Savitri (the Gayatrl Mantra) attains the greatest of goals.
verses.hindi: ४-'शुक्त' उसे कहते हैं जो स्वभावतः मधुर हो तथा कालवश (समयानुसार) खट्टी हो जाय। जैसे काँजी (प्रायश्चित्तविवेक)! मनुस्मृति (२। १७७)-के अनुसार भी जो स्वभावतः मधुर हो, पर समयवश जल आदिमें रखनेसे अम्ल (खट्टी) हो जाय वह शुक्त है। किंतु शुक्तके रूपमें दही और दहीसे वननेवाले मठ्ठा आदि पदार्थ भक्ष्य हैं। ५-शेलु-श्लेप्मातक ( लोकभापा-लिसोढ़ा) अमरकोश।
verses.wordMeaning: Strictly observing the vow of celibacy, he who under¬ standing the meaning of the Mantra, repeats Savitri (the Gayatrl Mantra) attains the greatest of goals.
verses.commentary: Sense: Strictly observing the vow of celibacy, he who under¬ standing the meaning of the Mantra, repeats Savitri (the Gayatrl Mantra) attains the greatest of goals.

verses.sanskrit: सोपानत्को जलस्थो वा नोष्णीषी वाचमेद् बुधः । न चैव वर्षधाराभिर्न तिष्ठन् नोद्धृतोदकैः
verses.transliteration: sopānatko jalastho vā noṣṇīṣī vācamed budhaḥ / na caiva varṣadhārābhirna tiṣṭhan noddhṛtodakaiḥ
verses.translation: Gayatrl is the mother of the Vedas. Gayatrl is the sanctifier of the worlds. There is no greater Japa (Mantra for the purpose of repetition) than the Gayatrl. After realising this, one is liberated.
verses.hindi: ६-पेयूष-नवप्रसूता गौका अग्निसंयोगसे कठिन किया गया दूध (फेनृप, इन्नर लोकभाषामें) यह भैंस-बकरीका भी निषिद्ध है।
verses.wordMeaning: Gayatrl is the mother of the Vedas. Gayatrl is the sanctifier of the worlds. There is no greater Japa (Mantra for the purpose of repetition) than the Gayatrl. After realising this, one is liberated.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gayatrl is the mother of the Vedas. Gayatrl is the sanctifier of the worlds. There is no greater Japa (Mantra for the purpose of repetition) than the Gayatrl. After realising this, one is liberated.

verses.sanskrit: नैकहस्तार्पितजलैर्विना सूत्रेण वा पुनः । न पादुकासनस्थो वा बहिर्जानुरथापि वा
verses.transliteration: naikahastārpitajalairvinā sūtreṇa vā punaḥ / na pādukāsanastho vā bahirjānurathāpi vā
verses.translation: The rite of Vedopakarman (inaugural ceremony of the academic year) is to be performed on the full Moon day of the month of Sravana. Excellent Brahmanas, it may be performed on the full moon day in the month of Asadha or Bhadrapada as well.
verses.hindi: ७-सुमुख--शाकविशेष । इसका पर्याय--वनवर्व्वरिका, वर्व्वर है। (राजनिर्घण्ट) (शब्दकल्पद्रुम) । अनृपाकृतमांसं च देवान्नानि हवींषि च
verses.wordMeaning: The rite of Vedopakarman (inaugural ceremony of the academic year) is to be performed on the full Moon day of the month of Sravana. Excellent Brahmanas, it may be performed on the full moon day in the month of Asadha or Bhadrapada as well.
verses.commentary: Sense: The rite of Vedopakarman (inaugural ceremony of the academic year) is to be performed on the full Moon day of the month of Sravana. Excellent Brahmanas, it may be performed on the full moon day in the month of Asadha or Bhadrapada as well.

verses.sanskrit: न जल्पन् न हसन् प्रेक्षन् शयानः प्रह्व एव च । नावीक्षिताभिः फेनाद्यैरुपेताभिरथापि वा
verses.transliteration: na jalpan na hasan prekṣan śayānaḥ prahva eva ca / nāvīkṣitābhiḥ phenādyairupetābhirathāpi vā
verses.translation: A Brahmana should abandon the village and the city for a period of two and a half months. Observing celibacy he should study the Vedas, seated in a clean place, with full concentration and purity of the mind.
verses.hindi: पिण्याकं चोद्धूतस्नेहं देवधान्यं तथैव च। रात्रौ च तिलसम्बद्धं प्रयत्नेन दधि त्यजेत्
verses.wordMeaning: A Brahmana should abandon the village and the city for a period of two and a half months. Observing celibacy he should study the Vedas, seated in a clean place, with full concentration and purity of the mind.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmana should abandon the village and the city for a period of two and a half months. Observing celibacy he should study the Vedas, seated in a clean place, with full concentration and purity of the mind.

verses.sanskrit: शूद्राशुचिकरोन्मुक्तैर्न क्षाराभिस्तथैव च । न चैवाङ्गुलिभिः शब्दं न कुर्वन् नान्यमानसः
verses.transliteration: śūdrāśucikaronmuktairna kṣārābhistathaiva ca / na caivāṅgulibhiḥ śabdaṃ na kurvan nānyamānasaḥ
verses.translation: Persons studying the Vedas as well as those who
verses.hindi: केशकीटावपन्नं च सहुल्लेखं च नित्यशः । श्वाघ्रातं च पुनः सिद्धं चण्डालावेक्षितं तथा काककुक्कुटसंस्पृष्टं कुमिभिश्चेव संयुतम्। मनुष्यैरप्यवघ्रातं कुष्ठिना स्पृष्टमेव च
verses.wordMeaning: Persons studying the Vedas as well as those who
verses.commentary: Sense: Persons studying the Vedas as well as those who

verses.sanskrit: न वर्णरसदुष्टाभिर्न चैव प्रदरोदकैः । न पाणिक्षुभिताभिर्वा न बहिष्कक्ष एव वा
verses.transliteration: na varṇarasaduṣṭābhirna caiva pradarodakaiḥ / na pāṇikṣubhitābhirvā na bahiṣkakṣa eva vā
verses.translation: With absolute faith in the Veda, he should always study Veda with concentration of mind. Strictly adhering to
verses.hindi: कुररं च चकोरं च जालपादं च कोकिलम्
verses.wordMeaning: With absolute faith in the Veda, he should always study Veda with concentration of mind. Strictly adhering to
verses.commentary: Sense: With absolute faith in the Veda, he should always study Veda with concentration of mind. Strictly adhering to

verses.sanskrit: हृद्गाभिः पूयते विप्रः कण्ठ्याभिः क्षत्रियः शुचिः । प्राशिताभिस्तथावैश्यः स्त्रीशूद्रौ स्पर्शतो ऽन्ततः
verses.transliteration: hṛdgābhiḥ pūyate vipraḥ kaṇṭhyābhiḥ kṣatriyaḥ śuciḥ / prāśitābhistathāvaiśyaḥ strīśūdrau sparśato 'ntataḥ
verses.translation: These injuctions are great and ancient ones. They- have been well recounted in the Vedic treatises.
