This procedure is ancient and is in perfect accord with what is given in the Vedas. This is what lord Svayambhuva Manu explained in days of old, when he was requested by great and excellent sages.
verses.hindi: गये कृशरान्न (तिल-चावलके बने पदार्थ), संयाव (लपसी), खीर एवं पुआका तथा देवान्न (देवताके लिये समर्पित अन्न), हवनके योग्य द्रव्य (पुरोडाश आदि), यवागू (जौकी काजी), मातुलिंग (बिजौरा नीबू), देव-पित्र्यकर्ममें कदम्ब, कपित्थ (कैथ) और प्लक्ष (पर्कटी--पाकड़) -का प्रयत्रपूर्वक परित्याग करना चाहिए। तेल निकाली हुई खली, देवताका धान्य और रात्रिमें तिल-सम्बन्धी पदार्थ तथा दहीका प्रयत्नपूर्वक
verses.wordMeaning: These injuctions are great and ancient ones. They- have been well recounted in the Vedic treatises. This procedure is ancient and is in perfect accord with what is given in the Vedas. This is what lord Svayambhuva Manu explained in days of old,…
verses.commentary: Sense: These injuctions are great and ancient ones. They- have been well recounted in the Vedic treatises. This procedure is ancient and is in perfect accord with what is given in the Vedas. This is what lord Svayambhuva Manu explained in days of old,…

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गुष्ठमूलान्तरतो रेखायां ब्राह्ममुच्यते । अन्तराङ्गुष्ठदेशिन्यो पितॄणां तीर्थमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: aṅguṣṭhamūlāntarato rekhāyāṃ brāhmamucyate / antarāṅguṣṭhadeśinyo pitṝṇāṃ tīrthamuttamam
verses.translation: He who dedicates himself to Isvara and performs all duties in accordance with the injunctions shall ward off all the shackles of delusion and attain immortality. He shall attain the auspicious region devoid of ailment.
verses.hindi: त्याग करना चाहिए! दूधके साथ मट्टेका सेवन नहीं करना चाहिए। बीजोंके द्वारा जीविकाका निर्वाह नहीं करना चाहिए। कर्मसे दूषित और भावसे दूषित तथा दुर्जनोंसे सम्बन्धका परित्याग करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: He who dedicates himself to Isvara and performs all duties in accordance with the injunctions shall ward off all the shackles of delusion and attain immortality. He shall attain the auspicious region devoid of ailment.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who dedicates himself to Isvara and performs all duties in accordance with the injunctions shall ward off all the shackles of delusion and attain immortality. He shall attain the auspicious region devoid of ailment.

verses.sanskrit: कनिष्ठामूलतः पश्चात् प्राजापत्यं प्रचक्षते । अङ्गुल्यग्रे स्मृतं दैवं तदेवार्षं प्रकीर्तितम्
verses.transliteration: kaniṣṭhāmūlataḥ paścāt prājāpatyaṃ pracakṣate / aṅgulyagre smṛtaṃ daivaṃ tadevārṣaṃ prakīrtitam
verses.translation: This shows that the author is probably a north-Indian or a Madhyandin.
verses.hindi: केश (बाल) और कोड़ॉंसे युक्त, जिस अन्नको लेकर मनमें विचिकित्सा हो, कृत्तेद्वारा सूँघा हुआ, दुबारा पकाया गया, चाण्डाल, रजस्वला तथा पतितके सूँघा हुआ, अनादरपूर्वक प्राप्त, बासी तथा पर्यायान्नका! नित्य परित्याग करना चाहिए। कौआ एवं मुर्गासे
verses.wordMeaning: This shows that the author is probably a north-Indian or a Madhyandin.
verses.commentary: Sense: This shows that the author is probably a north-Indian or a Madhyandin.

verses.sanskrit: मूले वा दैवमार्षं स्यादाग्नेयं मध्यतः स्मृतं । तदेव सौमिकं तीर्थमेतज्ज्ञात्वा न मुह्यति
verses.transliteration: mūle vā daivamārṣaṃ syādāgneyaṃ madhyataḥ smṛtaṃ / tadeva saumikaṃ tīrthametajjñātvā na muhyati
verses.translation: In fact Vv. 17 onward form a part of Sadacara,
verses.hindi: रोगीसे स्पर्श किये गये अन्नका परित्याग करना चाहिए। रजस्वलासे प्राप्त, क्रोधयुक्त व्यभिचारिणी स्त्रीद्वारा दिया गया और मलिन वस्त्र धारण करनेवाले व्यक्तिके द्वारा (दिये अन्नका) और दूसरेके वस्त्रका परित्याग
verses.wordMeaning: In fact Vv. 17 onward form a part of Sadacara,
verses.commentary: Sense: In fact Vv. 17 onward form a part of Sadacara,

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मेणैव तु तीर्थेन द्विजो नित्यमुपस्पृशेत् । कायेन वाथ दैवेन तु पित्र्येण वै द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: brāhmeṇaiva tu tīrthena dvijo nityamupaspṛśet / kāyena vātha daivena tu pitryeṇa vai dvijāḥ
verses.translation: He should hold the staff of bamboo. He should wear the undercloth and the upper garment. He should have two sacred threads, a water-pot (Kamandalu) with water.
verses.hindi: करना चाहिए। मनुने बताया है कि बछड़े-रहित गौ, ऊँटनी और दस दिनोंके भीतर ब्यायी हुई (गौ इत्यादि)-का दूध तथा भेड़ी एवं गर्भिणी गौका दूध पीने योग्य नहीं है १-(क) मूलमें ' पर्यायान्न' शब्द है । इसका अर्थ याज्ञ० स्मृ० आचा० १६८ वें श्लोककी मिताक्षरा व्याख्याके अनुसार वह अन्न है जो अन्यस्वामिक है और अन्यको दिया जाय। जैसे ब्राह्मणस्वामिक अन्नको शूद्र दे, शूद्रस्वामिक अन्नको ब्राह्मण दे। ऐसा अन्न ग्रहण
verses.wordMeaning: He should hold the staff of bamboo. He should wear the undercloth and the upper garment. He should have two sacred threads, a water-pot (Kamandalu) with water.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should hold the staff of bamboo. He should wear the undercloth and the upper garment. He should have two sacred threads, a water-pot (Kamandalu) with water.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिः प्राश्नीयादपः पूर्वं ब्राह्मणः प्रयतस्ततः । संमृज्याङ्गुष्ठमूलेन मुखं वै समुपस्पृशेत्
verses.transliteration: triḥ prāśnīyādapaḥ pūrvaṃ brāhmaṇaḥ prayatastataḥ / saṃmṛjyāṅguṣṭhamūlena mukhaṃ vai samupaspṛśet
verses.translation: He should have an umbrella, an immaculately clean turban, sandals and shoes and golden earing and the Veda. He should be cleanly shaven, with nails clipped and thus shall be scrupulously clean.
verses.hindi: करनेपर चान्द्रायणव्रत प्रायश्चित्त है।
verses.wordMeaning: He should have an umbrella, an immaculately clean turban, sandals and shoes and golden earing and the Veda. He should be cleanly shaven, with nails clipped and thus shall be scrupulously clean.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should have an umbrella, an immaculately clean turban, sandals and shoes and golden earing and the Veda. He should be cleanly shaven, with nails clipped and thus shall be scrupulously clean.

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गुष्ठानामिकाभ्यां तु स्पृशेन्नेत्रद्वयं ततः । तर्जन्यङ्गुष्ठयोगेन स्पृशेन्नासापृटद्वयम्
verses.transliteration: aṅguṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ tu spṛśennetradvayaṃ tataḥ / tarjanyaṅguṣṭhayogena spṛśennāsāpṛṭadvayam
verses.translation: He should continuously be engaged in the self-study of the Vedas. He should not wear garland outside. A Brahmana shall not wear a red garland except that of Kancana flowers.
verses.hindi: (ख) एक दूसरे मतके अनुसार एक पंक्तिमें बैठकर भोजन करनेवालोंमें किसी एकके उठकर आचमन कर लेनेके उपरान्त सभी भोजन करनेवालोंके अन्नको 'पर्यायान्न' कहा जाता है।
verses.wordMeaning: He should continuously be engaged in the self-study of the Vedas. He should not wear garland outside. A Brahmana shall not wear a red garland except that of Kancana flowers.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should continuously be engaged in the self-study of the Vedas. He should not wear garland outside. A Brahmana shall not wear a red garland except that of Kancana flowers.

verses.sanskrit: कनिष्ठाङ्गुष्ठयोगेन श्रवणे समुपस्पृशेत् । सर्वासामथ योगेन हृदयं तु तलेन वा । संस्पृशेद् वा शिरस्तद्वदङ्गुष्ठेनाथवा द्वयम्
verses.transliteration: kaniṣṭhāṅguṣṭhayogena śravaṇe samupaspṛśet / sarvāsāmatha yogena hṛdayaṃ tu talena vā / saṃspṛśed vā śirastadvadaṅguṣṭhenāthavā dvayam
verses.translation: He should wear white garments every day. He should use perfumes and appear neat and pleasing. If he has enough means, he should not wear old dirty clothes.
verses.hindi: सिंहव्याघ्रं च मार्जारं श्वानं शूकरमेव च। शृगालं मर्कटं चैव गर्दभं च न भक्षयेत्
verses.wordMeaning: He should wear white garments every day. He should use perfumes and appear neat and pleasing. If he has enough means, he should not wear old dirty clothes.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should wear white garments every day. He should use perfumes and appear neat and pleasing. If he has enough means, he should not wear old dirty clothes.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिः प्राश्नीयाद् यदम्भस्तु सुप्रीतास्तेन देवताः । ब्रह्मा विष्णुर्महेशश्च भवन्तीत्यनुशुश्रुमः
verses.transliteration: triḥ prāśnīyād yadambhastu suprītāstena devatāḥ / brahmā viṣṇurmaheśaśca bhavantītyanuśuśrumaḥ
verses.translation: He should not wear red clothes or those of gaudy colours. Nor should he use the following things used by others: The cloth, the water-pot, leather shoes, garland sandals.
verses.hindi: गोधा कूर्मः शशः श्वाविच्छल्यकश्चेति सत्तमाः। मत्स्यान् सशल्कान् भुञ्जीयान्मांसं रौरवमेव च। निवेद्य देवताभ्यस्तु ब्राह्मणेभ्यस्तु नान्यथा
verses.wordMeaning: He should not wear red clothes or those of gaudy colours. Nor should he use the following things used by others: The cloth, the water-pot, leather shoes, garland sandals.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should not wear red clothes or those of gaudy colours. Nor should he use the following things used by others: The cloth, the water-pot, leather shoes, garland sandals.

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गा च यमुना चैव प्रीयेते परिमार्जनात् । संस्पृष्टयोर्लोचनयोः प्रीयेते शशिभास्करौ
verses.transliteration: gaṅgā ca yamunā caiva prīyete parimārjanāt / saṃspṛṣṭayorlocanayoḥ prīyete śaśibhāskarau
verses.translation: (He should not wear the following used by others, viz.: the sacred thread, ornaments as well as the skin of a black antelope. He should not wear the garment in the apasavya way (on the right shoulder and below the left arm) nor should he wear a loathsome garments.
verses.hindi: प्रोक्षितं भक्षयेदेषां मांसं च द्विजकाम्यया । यथाविधि नियुक्तं च प्राणानामपि चात्यये
verses.wordMeaning: (He should not wear the following used by others, viz.: the sacred thread, ornaments as well as the skin of a black antelope. He should not wear the garment in the apasavya way (on the right shoulder and below the left arm) nor should he wear a loathsome garments.
verses.commentary: Sense: (He should not wear the following used by others, viz.: the sacred thread, ornaments as well as the skin of a black antelope. He should not wear the garment in the apasavya way (on the right shoulder and below the left arm) nor should he wear a loathsome garments.

verses.sanskrit: नासत्यदस्त्रौ प्रीयेते स्पृष्टे नासापुटद्वये । कर्णयोः स्पृष्टयोस्तद्वत् प्रीयेते चानिलानलौ
verses.transliteration: nāsatyadastrau prīyete spṛṣṭe nāsāpuṭadvaye / karṇayoḥ spṛṣṭayostadvat prīyete cānilānalau
verses.translation: He should duly marry a girl similar to him (in caste?) of auspicious characteristics, beauty and features and suitable to him, she should not have any defect in her reproductory organs.
verses.hindi: औषधार्थमशक्तौ वा नियोगाद् यज्ञकारणात् आमन्त्रितस्तु यः श्राद्धे देवे वा मांसमुत्सृजेत्। यावन्ति पशुरोमाणि तावतो नरकान् व्रजेत्
verses.wordMeaning: He should duly marry a girl similar to him (in caste?) of auspicious characteristics, beauty and features and suitable to him, she should not have any defect in her reproductory organs.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should duly marry a girl similar to him (in caste?) of auspicious characteristics, beauty and features and suitable to him, she should not have any defect in her reproductory organs.

verses.sanskrit: संस्पृष्टे हृदये चास्य प्रीयन्ते सर्वदेवताः । मूर्ध्नि संस्पर्शनादेकः प्रीतः स पुरुषो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: saṃspṛṣṭe hṛdaye cāsya prīyante sarvadevatāḥ / mūrdhni saṃsparśanādekaḥ prītaḥ sa puruṣo bhavet
verses.translation: A Brahmana should accept as wife a girl who is not
verses.hindi: द्विजातीनामनालोक्यं नित्यं मद्यमिति स्थितिः
verses.wordMeaning: A Brahmana should accept as wife a girl who is not
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmana should accept as wife a girl who is not

verses.sanskrit: नोच्छिष्टं कुर्वते मुख्या विप्रुषो ऽङ्गं नयन्ति याः । दन्तवद् दन्तलग्नेषु जिह्वास्पर्शे ऽशुचिर्भवेत्
verses.transliteration: nocchiṣṭaṃ kurvate mukhyā vipruṣo 'ṅgaṃ nayanti yāḥ / dantavad dantalagneṣu jihvāsparśe 'śucirbhavet
verses.translation: He should go unto his wife only on those nights (sanctioned by scripture) after the monthly menses till the conception of a son. He shall scrupulously avoid the forbidden days.
verses.hindi: तस्मात् सर्वप्रकारेण मद्यं नित्यं विवर्जयेत् । पीत्वा पतति कर्मभ्यस्त्वसम्भाष्यो भवेद् द्विज: नाधिकारी भवेत् तावद् यावद् तन्न जहात्यधः
verses.wordMeaning: He should go unto his wife only on those nights (sanctioned by scripture) after the monthly menses till the conception of a son. He shall scrupulously avoid the forbidden days.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should go unto his wife only on those nights (sanctioned by scripture) after the monthly menses till the conception of a son. He shall scrupulously avoid the forbidden days.

verses.sanskrit: स्पृशान्ति बिन्दवः पादौ य आचामयतः परान् । भूमिगैस्ते समा ज्ञेया न तैरप्रयतो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: spṛśānti bindavaḥ pādau ya ācāmayataḥ parān / bhūmigaiste samā jñeyā na tairaprayato bhavet
verses.translation: He shall observe the vow of celibacy and control over his senses on the sixth, eighth, twelfth, fourteenth and fifteenth days of the lunar fortnight.
verses.hindi: द्विजोंके लिये मद्य न दान देने योग्य है, न पीने योग्य है, न स्पर्श करने योग्य है और न ही देखने योग्य है--ऐसी हमेशाके लिये मर्यादा बनी है। इसलिये सब प्रकारसे मद्यका नित्य ही परित्याग करना
verses.wordMeaning: He shall observe the vow of celibacy and control over his senses on the sixth, eighth, twelfth, fourteenth and fifteenth days of the lunar fortnight.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall observe the vow of celibacy and control over his senses on the sixth, eighth, twelfth, fourteenth and fifteenth days of the lunar fortnight.

verses.sanskrit: मदुपर्के च सोमे च ताम्बूलस्य च भक्षणे । फलमूले चेक्षुदण्डे न दोषं प्राह वे मनुः
verses.transliteration: maduparke ca some ca tāmbūlasya ca bhakṣaṇe / phalamūle cekṣudaṇḍe na doṣaṃ prāha ve manuḥ
verses.translation: He should maintain the Avasathya fire (i.e. one of the five sacred fires to be kept in the house and used in sacrifices). He shall perform Homa in the sacrificial fire. A Snataka (house-holder) should observe all holy vows.
verses.hindi: चाहिए। मद्य पीनेसे द्विज कर्मोंसे पतित और बातचीत करनेके अयोग्य हो जाता है। अभक्ष्यका भक्षण करने और अपेय पदार्थोंका पान करनेसे द्विज तबतक अपने कर्मका अधिकारी नहीं होता, जबतक उसका पाप दूर नहीं हो जाता। इसलिये प्रयलपूर्वक नित्य ही विप्र (द्विज)-को अभक्ष्य एवं अपेय पदार्थोका परित्याग करना चाहिए। यदि द्विज ऐसा करता है अर्थात् इन्हें ग्रहण करता है तो
verses.wordMeaning: He should maintain the Avasathya fire (i.e. one of the five sacred fires to be kept in the house and used in sacrifices). He shall perform Homa in the sacrificial fire. A Snataka (house-holder) should observe all holy vows.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should maintain the Avasathya fire (i.e. one of the five sacred fires to be kept in the house and used in sacrifices). He shall perform Homa in the sacrificial fire. A Snataka (house-holder) should observe all holy vows.

verses.sanskrit: प्रचरंश्चान्नपानेषु द्रव्यहस्तो भवेन्नरः । भूमौ निक्षिप्य तद् द्रव्यमाचम्याभ्युक्षयेत् तु तत्
verses.transliteration: pracaraṃścānnapāneṣu dravyahasto bhavennaraḥ / bhūmau nikṣipya tad dravyamācamyābhyukṣayet tu tat
verses.translation: He should actively perform everyday his duty as ordained by the Vedas. By not doing so, he immediately becomes fallen and goes to terrible hells.
verses.hindi: उसे रौरव नरकमें जाना पड़ता है
verses.wordMeaning: He should actively perform everyday his duty as ordained by the Vedas. By not doing so, he immediately becomes fallen and goes to terrible hells.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should actively perform everyday his duty as ordained by the Vedas. By not doing so, he immediately becomes fallen and goes to terrible hells.

verses.sanskrit: तैजसं वै समादाय यद्युच्छिष्टो भवेद् द्विजः । भूमौ निक्षिप्य तद् द्रव्यमाचम्याभ्युक्षयेत् तु तत्
verses.transliteration: taijasaṃ vai samādāya yadyucchiṣṭo bhaved dvijaḥ / bhūmau nikṣipya tad dravyamācamyābhyukṣayet tu tat
verses.translation: Pure in body and mind, he should daily practise the recitation of the Vedas. He should perform the holy rites as mentioned in the Grhyasutras as well as the Sandhya worship.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे बद्साहस्त्रथां संहितायामुपरिविभागे सपदशोउ्थ्याय: गृहस्थके नित्यकर्माका वर्णन, प्रातःस्नानकी महिमा, छः प्रकारके स्नान, संध्योपासनकी महिमा तथा संध्योपासनविधि, सूर्योपस्थानका माहात्म्य, सूर्यहदयस्तोत्र, अग्निहोत्रकी विधि, तर्पणकी विधि, नित्य किये जानेवाले पञ्चमहायञ्चोकी महिमा तथा उनका विधान
verses.wordMeaning: Pure in body and mind, he should daily practise the recitation of the Vedas. He should perform the holy rites as mentioned in the Grhyasutras as well as the Sandhya worship.
verses.commentary: Sense: Pure in body and mind, he should daily practise the recitation of the Vedas. He should perform the holy rites as mentioned in the Grhyasutras as well as the Sandhya worship.

verses.sanskrit: यद्यमत्रं समादाय भवेदुच्छेषणान्वितः । अनिधायैव तद् द्रव्यमाचान्तः शुचितामियात् । वस्त्रादिषु विकल्पः स्यात् तत्संस्पृष्ट्वाचमेदिह
verses.transliteration: yadyamatraṃ samādāya bhaveduccheṣaṇānvitaḥ / anidhāyaiva tad dravyamācāntaḥ śucitāmiyāt / vastrādiṣu vikalpaḥ syāt tatsaṃspṛṣṭvācamediha
verses.translation: He should cultivate friendship with persons of equal and superior status. He should always worship Isvara. He shall attain the blessings of deities. He should bedeck his wife with ornaments.
verses.hindi: अहन्यहनि कर्तव्यं ब्राह्मणानां महामुने। तदाचक्ष्वाखिलं कर्म येन मुच्येत बन्धनात्॥
verses.wordMeaning: He should cultivate friendship with persons of equal and superior status. He should always worship Isvara. He shall attain the blessings of deities. He should bedeck his wife with ornaments.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should cultivate friendship with persons of equal and superior status. He should always worship Isvara. He shall attain the blessings of deities. He should bedeck his wife with ornaments.

verses.sanskrit: अरण्ये ऽनुदके रात्रौ चौरव्याघ्राकुले पथि । कृत्वा मूत्रं पुरीषं वा द्रव्यहस्तो न दुष्यति
verses.transliteration: araṇye 'nudake rātrau cauravyāghrākule pathi / kṛtvā mūtraṃ purīṣaṃ vā dravyahasto na duṣyati
verses.translation: He should not loudly proclaim his religious acts nor should he conceal his sinful activities; he should always do those things that increase his welfare and be sympathetic towards all living beings.
verses.hindi: अहन्यहनि कर्तव्यं ब्राह्मणानां क्रमाद् विधिम्॥ ब्राह्मे मुहूर्ते तूत्थाय धर्ममर्थं च चिन्तयेत् । कायक्लेशं तदुद्भूतं ध्यायीत मनसेश्चरम्॥
verses.wordMeaning: He should not loudly proclaim his religious acts nor should he conceal his sinful activities; he should always do those things that increase his welfare and be sympathetic towards all living beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should not loudly proclaim his religious acts nor should he conceal his sinful activities; he should always do those things that increase his welfare and be sympathetic towards all living beings.

verses.sanskrit: निधाय दक्षिणे कर्णे ब्रह्मसूत्रमुदङ्मुखः । अह्नि कुर्याच्छकृन्मूत्रं रात्रौ चेद् दक्षिणामुखः
verses.transliteration: nidhāya dakṣiṇe karṇe brahmasūtramudaṅmukhaḥ / ahni kuryācchakṛnmūtraṃ rātrau ced dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ
verses.translation: He should not loudly proclaim his religious acts nor should he conceal his sinful activities; he should always do those things that increase his welfare and be sympathetic towards all living beings.
verses.hindi: उषःकालेऽथ सम्प्राप्ते कृत्वा चावश्यकं बुधः ।
verses.wordMeaning: He should not loudly proclaim his religious acts nor should he conceal his sinful activities; he should always do those things that increase his welfare and be sympathetic towards all living beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should not loudly proclaim his religious acts nor should he conceal his sinful activities; he should always do those things that increase his welfare and be sympathetic towards all living beings.

verses.sanskrit: अन्तर्धाय महीं काष्ठैः पत्रैर्लोष्ठतृणेन वा । प्रावृत्य च शिरः कुर्याद् विण्मूत्रस्य विसर्जनम्
verses.transliteration: antardhāya mahīṃ kāṣṭhaiḥ patrairloṣṭhatṛṇena vā / prāvṛtya ca śiraḥ kuryād viṇmūtrasya visarjanam
verses.translation: He should not loudly proclaim his religious acts nor should he conceal his sinful activities; he should always do those things that increase his welfare and be sympathetic towards all living beings.
verses.hindi: प्रातःस्नानेन पूयन्ते येऽपि पापकृतो जनाः। प्रातःस्नानं प्रशंसन्ति दृष्टादृष्टकरं शुभम्।
verses.wordMeaning: He should not loudly proclaim his religious acts nor should he conceal his sinful activities; he should always do those things that increase his welfare and be sympathetic towards all living beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should not loudly proclaim his religious acts nor should he conceal his sinful activities; he should always do those things that increase his welfare and be sympathetic towards all living beings.

verses.sanskrit: छायाकूपनदीगोष्ठचैत्याम्भः पथि भस्मसु । अग्नौ चैव श्मशाने च विण्मूत्रे न समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: chāyākūpanadīgoṣṭhacaityāmbhaḥ pathi bhasmasu / agnau caiva śmaśāne ca viṇmūtre na samācaret
verses.translation: He should not loudly proclaim his religious acts nor should he conceal his sinful activities; he should always do those things that increase his welfare and be sympathetic towards all living beings.
verses.hindi: ततो नेवाचरेत् कर्म अकृत्वा स्त्रानमादितः ॥
verses.wordMeaning: He should not loudly proclaim his religious acts nor should he conceal his sinful activities; he should always do those things that increase his welfare and be sympathetic towards all living beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should not loudly proclaim his religious acts nor should he conceal his sinful activities; he should always do those things that increase his welfare and be sympathetic towards all living beings.

verses.sanskrit: न गोमये न कृष्टे वा महावृक्षे न शाड्वले । न तिष्ठन् वा न निर्वासा न च पर्वतमस्तके
verses.transliteration: na gomaye na kṛṣṭe vā mahāvṛkṣe na śāḍvale / na tiṣṭhan vā na nirvāsā na ca parvatamastake
verses.translation: He should not loudly proclaim his religious acts nor should he conceal his sinful activities; he should always do those things that increase his welfare and be sympathetic towards all living beings.
verses.hindi: अलक्ष्मीः कालकणी च दुःस्वणं दुर्विचिन्तितम्। प्रातःस्नानेन पापानि पूयन्ते नात्र संशयः॥ न च स्नानं विना पुंसां पावनं कर्म सुस्मृतम्।
verses.wordMeaning: He should not loudly proclaim his religious acts nor should he conceal his sinful activities; he should always do those things that increase his welfare and be sympathetic towards all living beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should not loudly proclaim his religious acts nor should he conceal his sinful activities; he should always do those things that increase his welfare and be sympathetic towards all living beings.

verses.sanskrit: न जीर्णदेवायतने न वल्मीके कदाचन । न ससत्त्वेषु गर्तेषु न गच्छन् वा समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: na jīrṇadevāyatane na valmīke kadācana / na sasattveṣu garteṣu na gacchan vā samācaret
verses.translation: He should not loudly proclaim his religious acts nor should he conceal his sinful activities; he should always do those things that increase his welfare and be sympathetic towards all living beings.
verses.hindi: आद्रेण वाससा वाथ मार्जनं कापिलं स्मृतम्
verses.wordMeaning: He should not loudly proclaim his religious acts nor should he conceal his sinful activities; he should always do those things that increase his welfare and be sympathetic towards all living beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should not loudly proclaim his religious acts nor should he conceal his sinful activities; he should always do those things that increase his welfare and be sympathetic towards all living beings.

verses.sanskrit: तुषाङ्गारकपालेषु राजमार्गे तथैव च । न क्षेत्रे न विले वापि न तीर्थे न चतुष्पथे
verses.transliteration: tuṣāṅgārakapāleṣu rājamārge tathaiva ca / na kṣetre na vile vāpi na tīrthe na catuṣpathe
verses.translation: He should not loudly proclaim his religious acts nor should he conceal his sinful activities; he should always do those things that increase his welfare and be sympathetic towards all living beings.
verses.hindi: ऋषियोंने कहा--महामुने! आप द्विजोंके प्रतिदिन किये जानेवाले उन कर्मोका सम्पूर्ण-रूपसे वर्णन करें, जिनका अनुष्ठान करनेसे बन्धनसे मुक्ति प्राप्त होती है ध्यानपूर्वक मेरे द्वारा कहे जा रहे ब्राह्मणोंके प्रतिदिन किये जानेवाले कर्मोको और उनके विधानको सुनें! । ब्राह्ममुहूर्तमें उठकर धर्म और अर्थ एवं (उनकी सम्पन्नताके लिये) अपेक्षित शारीरिक आयास (क्या
verses.wordMeaning: He should not loudly proclaim his religious acts nor should he conceal his sinful activities; he should always do those things that increase his welfare and be sympathetic towards all living beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should not loudly proclaim his religious acts nor should he conceal his sinful activities; he should always do those things that increase his welfare and be sympathetic towards all living beings.

verses.sanskrit: नोद्यानोदसमीपे वा नोषरे न पराशुचौ । न सोपानत्पादुको वा छत्री वा नान्तरिक्षके
verses.transliteration: nodyānodasamīpe vā noṣare na parāśucau / na sopānatpāduko vā chatrī vā nāntarikṣake
verses.translation: He should not loudly proclaim his religious acts nor should he conceal his sinful activities; he should always do those things that increase his welfare and be sympathetic towards all living beings.
verses.hindi: कब कैसे करना है आदि)-का चिन्तन करे तथा मनसे ईश्वरका ध्यान करे। बुद्धिमानुको चाहिए कि ऊषाकाल होनेपर आवश्यक कमोंको करके विधिपूर्वक शौच आदिसे निवृत्त होकर शुद्ध जलवाली नदियोंमें स्नान
verses.wordMeaning: He should not loudly proclaim his religious acts nor should he conceal his sinful activities; he should always do those things that increase his welfare and be sympathetic towards all living beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should not loudly proclaim his religious acts nor should he conceal his sinful activities; he should always do those things that increase his welfare and be sympathetic towards all living beings.

verses.sanskrit: न चैवाभिमुखे स्त्रीणां गुरुब्राह्मणयोर्गवाम् । न देवदेवालययोरपामपि कदाचन
verses.transliteration: na caivābhimukhe strīṇāṃ gurubrāhmaṇayorgavām / na devadevālayayorapāmapi kadācana
verses.translation: He should not loudly proclaim his religious acts nor should he conceal his sinful activities; he should always do those things that increase his welfare and be sympathetic towards all living beings.
verses.hindi: करे। प्रातःस्तान करनेसे पाप करनेवाले व्यक्ति भी पवित्र हो जाते हैं। इसलिये सभी प्रकारके प्रयत्रोंसे प्रातःकाल स्नान करना चाहिए दृष्ट और अदृष्ट फल देनेवाले प्रातः कालीन शुभ स्नानकी सभी प्रशंसा करते हैं। नित्य प्रातःकाल स्नान करनेसे ही ऋषियोंका ऋषित्व है, इसमें संशय नहीं; क्योंकि सोये व्यक्तिके मुखसे निरन्तर लार बहती रहती है, अतः सर्वप्रथम
verses.wordMeaning: He should not loudly proclaim his religious acts nor should he conceal his sinful activities; he should always do those things that increase his welfare and be sympathetic towards all living beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should not loudly proclaim his religious acts nor should he conceal his sinful activities; he should always do those things that increase his welfare and be sympathetic towards all living beings.

verses.sanskrit: न ज्योतींषि निरीक्षन्वानसंध्याभिमुखो ऽपिवा । प्रत्यादित्यं प्रत्यनलं प्रतिसोमं तथैव च
verses.transliteration: na jyotīṃṣi nirīkṣanvānasaṃdhyābhimukho 'pivā / pratyādityaṃ pratyanalaṃ pratisomaṃ tathaiva ca
verses.translation: He should not loudly proclaim his religious acts nor should he conceal his sinful activities; he should always do those things that increase his welfare and be sympathetic towards all living beings.
verses.hindi: स्नान किये बिना कोई कर्म नहीं करना चाहिए। प्रात:- स्रानसे अलक्ष्मी, कालकर्णी (अलक्ष्मीविशेष) दु:स्वप्न, बुरे विचार और अन्य पाप दूर हो जाते हैं, इसमें संशय नहीं। बिना स्नानके मनुष्योंको पवित्र करनेवाला कोई
verses.wordMeaning: He should not loudly proclaim his religious acts nor should he conceal his sinful activities; he should always do those things that increase his welfare and be sympathetic towards all living beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should not loudly proclaim his religious acts nor should he conceal his sinful activities; he should always do those things that increase his welfare and be sympathetic towards all living beings.

verses.sanskrit: आहृत्य मृत्तिकां कूलाल्लेपगन्धापकर्षणम् । कुर्यादतन्द्रितः शौचं विशुद्धैरुद्धृतोदकैः
verses.transliteration: āhṛtya mṛttikāṃ kūlāllepagandhāpakarṣaṇam / kuryādatandritaḥ śaucaṃ viśuddhairuddhṛtodakaiḥ
verses.translation: He should not loudly proclaim his religious acts nor should he conceal his sinful activities; he should always do those things that increase his welfare and be sympathetic towards all living beings.
verses.hindi: कर्म नहीं बतलाया गया है। अत: होम तथा जपके समय विशेष-रूपसे स्नान करना चाहिए । असमर्थताकी स्थितिमें सिरको छोड़कर स्नान करनेका विधान किया गया है। अथवा भीगे वस्त्रसे शरीरका मार्जन करना चाहिए, इसे कपिलस्नान कहा गया है
verses.wordMeaning: He should not loudly proclaim his religious acts nor should he conceal his sinful activities; he should always do those things that increase his welfare and be sympathetic towards all living beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should not loudly proclaim his religious acts nor should he conceal his sinful activities; he should always do those things that increase his welfare and be sympathetic towards all living beings.

verses.sanskrit: नाहरेन्मृत्तिकां विप्रः पांशुलान्न च कर्दमात् । न मार्गान्नोषराद् देशाच्छौचशिष्टां परस्य च
verses.transliteration: nāharenmṛttikāṃ vipraḥ pāṃśulānna ca kardamāt / na mārgānnoṣarād deśācchaucaśiṣṭāṃ parasya ca
verses.translation: He should not loudly proclaim his religious acts nor should he conceal his sinful activities; he should always do those things that increase his welfare and be sympathetic towards all living beings.
verses.hindi: १-इस अध्यायमें गृहस्थके प्राय: सभी आनुष्ठानोंका वर्णन है, पर क्रमसे नहीं है । क्रमका ज्ञान गृह्यसूत्र, आहिकसूत्रावली, नित्यकर्मविधि आदि ग्रन्थोंसे करना चाहिए। इस अध्यायका उद्देश्य सभी कर्मोंका परिचय कराना है। कर्मोंका क्रम बताना उद्देश्य नहीं है।
verses.wordMeaning: He should not loudly proclaim his religious acts nor should he conceal his sinful activities; he should always do those things that increase his welfare and be sympathetic towards all living beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should not loudly proclaim his religious acts nor should he conceal his sinful activities; he should always do those things that increase his welfare and be sympathetic towards all living beings.

verses.sanskrit: न देवायतनात् कूपाद् ग्रामान्न च जलात् तथा । उपस्पृशेत् ततो नित्यं पूर्वोक्तेन विधानतः
verses.transliteration: na devāyatanāt kūpād grāmānna ca jalāt tathā / upaspṛśet tato nityaṃ pūrvoktena vidhānataḥ
verses.translation: He should not loudly proclaim his religious acts nor should he conceal his sinful activities; he should always do those things that increase his welfare and be sympathetic towards all living beings.
verses.hindi: २-कालकर्णी- अलक्ष्मी (शब्दकल्पद्रुम) । वारुणं यौगिकं तद्वत् षोढा स्त्रानं प्रकीर्तितम्
verses.wordMeaning: He should not loudly proclaim his religious acts nor should he conceal his sinful activities; he should always do those things that increase his welfare and be sympathetic towards all living beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should not loudly proclaim his religious acts nor should he conceal his sinful activities; he should always do those things that increase his welfare and be sympathetic towards all living beings.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे त्रयोदशो ऽध्यायः व्यास उवाच एवं दण्डादिभिर्युक्तः शौचाचारसमन्वितः । आहूतो ऽध्ययनं कुर्याद् वीक्षमाणो गुरोर्मुखम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge trayodaśo 'dhyāyaḥ vyāsa uvāca evaṃ daṇḍādibhiryuktaḥ śaucācārasamanvitaḥ / āhūto 'dhyayanaṃ kuryād vīkṣamāṇo gurormukham
verses.translation: He should always perform activities and speech suitable to and becoming in accordance with his age, duties, learning, nobility of birth, intellect and the Vedic injunctions.
verses.hindi: आग्नेयं भस्मना पादमस्तकाद्देहधूलनम्
verses.wordMeaning: He should always perform activities and speech suitable to and becoming in accordance with his age, duties, learning, nobility of birth, intellect and the Vedic injunctions.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should always perform activities and speech suitable to and becoming in accordance with his age, duties, learning, nobility of birth, intellect and the Vedic injunctions.

verses.sanskrit: नित्यमुद्यतपाणिः स्यात् साध्वाचारः सुसंयतः । आस्यतामिति चोक्तः सन्नासीताभिमुखं गुरोः
verses.transliteration: nityamudyatapāṇiḥ syāt sādhvācāraḥ susaṃyataḥ / āsyatāmiti coktaḥ sannāsītābhimukhaṃ guroḥ
verses.translation: He should resort to that way of life which has been invariably followed by good men, and ordained by the Srutis and the Smrtis. He should not wish for anything contrary to it.
verses.hindi: यौगिकं स््रानमाख्यातं योगो विष्णुविचिन्तनम् आत्मतीर्थमिति ख्यातं सेवितं ब्रह्मवादिभिः । मनःशुचिकरं पुंसां नित्यं तत् स्रानमाचरेत्
verses.wordMeaning: He should resort to that way of life which has been invariably followed by good men, and ordained by the Srutis and the Smrtis. He should not wish for anything contrary to it.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should resort to that way of life which has been invariably followed by good men, and ordained by the Srutis and the Smrtis. He should not wish for anything contrary to it.

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिश्रवणसंभाषे शयानो न समाचरेत् । नासीनो न च भुञ्जानो न तिष्ठन्न पराङ्मुखः
verses.transliteration: pratiśravaṇasaṃbhāṣe śayāno na samācaret / nāsīno na ca bhuñjāno na tiṣṭhanna parāṅmukhaḥ
verses.translation: That path through which one's fathers and grand¬ fathers have gone should be followed by one. That is the path
verses.hindi: शक्तश्चेद् वारुणं विद्वान् प्राजापत्यं तथैव च। प्रक्षाल्य दन्तकाष्ठं वै भक्षयित्वा विधानतः
verses.wordMeaning: That path through which one's fathers and grand¬ fathers have gone should be followed by one. That is the path
verses.commentary: Sense: That path through which one's fathers and grand¬ fathers have gone should be followed by one. That is the path

verses.sanskrit: नीचं शय्यासनं चास्य सर्वदा गुरुसन्निधौ । गुरोस्तु चक्षुर्विषये न यथेष्टासनो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: nīcaṃ śayyāsanaṃ cāsya sarvadā gurusannidhau / gurostu cakṣurviṣaye na yatheṣṭāsano bhavet
verses.translation: He should regularly recite passages from (one's branch of) the Vedas. He should always wear the sacred thread. One who is truthful in speech and who has conquered anger, deserves to realise Brahman.
verses.hindi: सत्वचं दन्तकाष्ठं स्यात् तदग्रेण तु धावयेत्। अपामार्ग च बिल्वं च करवीरं विशेषतः
verses.wordMeaning: He should regularly recite passages from (one's branch of) the Vedas. He should always wear the sacred thread. One who is truthful in speech and who has conquered anger, deserves to realise Brahman.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should regularly recite passages from (one's branch of) the Vedas. He should always wear the sacred thread. One who is truthful in speech and who has conquered anger, deserves to realise Brahman.

verses.sanskrit: नोदाहरेदस्य नाम परोक्षमपि केवलम् । न चैवास्यानुकुर्वोत गतिभाषणचेष्टितम्
verses.transliteration: nodāharedasya nāma parokṣamapi kevalam / na caivāsyānukurvota gatibhāṣaṇaceṣṭitam
verses.translation: He who is interested in the performance of ablutions and Sandhya-prayers everyday, who is devoted to Brahma- Yajna rite; the householder who is not malicious, who is soft and self-controlled, flourishes in heaven after death.
verses.hindi: परिहृत्य दिनं पापं भक्षयेद् वै विधानवित्
verses.wordMeaning: He who is interested in the performance of ablutions and Sandhya-prayers everyday, who is devoted to Brahma- Yajna rite; the householder who is not malicious, who is soft and self-controlled, flourishes in heaven after death.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who is interested in the performance of ablutions and Sandhya-prayers everyday, who is devoted to Brahma- Yajna rite; the householder who is not malicious, who is soft and self-controlled, flourishes in heaven after death.

verses.sanskrit: गुरोर्यत्र परीवादो निन्दा चापि प्रवर्तते । कर्णैं तत्र पिधातव्यौ गन्तव्यं वा ततो ऽन्यतः
verses.transliteration: guroryatra parīvādo nindā cāpi pravartate / karṇaiṃ tatra pidhātavyau gantavyaṃ vā tato 'nyataḥ
verses.translation: A householder devoid of passion, fear and fury, who is free from covetousness and delusion, who performs Sraddhas and who is always engaged in the Japa of the Savitri Mantra, is liberated.
verses.hindi: नोत्पाटयेद् दन्तकाष्ठं नाङ्गुल्या धावयेत् क्वचित्। प्रक्षाल्य भङ्क्त्वा तजह्याच्छुचौ देशे समाहितः स्नात्वा संतर्पयेद् देवानृषीन् पितृगणांस्तथा। आचम्य मन्त्रवन्नित्यं पुनराचम्य वाग्यतः
verses.wordMeaning: A householder devoid of passion, fear and fury, who is free from covetousness and delusion, who performs Sraddhas and who is always engaged in the Japa of the Savitri Mantra, is liberated.
verses.commentary: Sense: A householder devoid of passion, fear and fury, who is free from covetousness and delusion, who performs Sraddhas and who is always engaged in the Japa of the Savitri Mantra, is liberated.

verses.sanskrit: दूरस्थो नार्चयेदेनं न क्रुद्धो नान्तिके स्त्रियाः । न चैवास्योत्तरं ब्रूयात् स्थितो नासीत सन्निधौ
verses.transliteration: dūrastho nārcayedenaṃ na kruddho nāntike striyāḥ / na caivāsyottaraṃ brūyāt sthito nāsīta sannidhau
verses.translation: He who is engaged in the welfare of his parents, is interested in the well-being of cows and Brahmanas, has his sen¬ ses subjected, performs Yajnas and is a devotee of Devas, is honoured in the Brahmaloka.
verses.hindi: सामर्थ्य न रहनेपर यही (कपिल-) खान करना चाहिए। मनीषियोंने यथाशक्ति किये जानेवाले ब्राह्म आदि स्नानोंको बतलाया है । ब्राह्म, आग्नेय, वायव्य,
verses.wordMeaning: He who is engaged in the welfare of his parents, is interested in the well-being of cows and Brahmanas, has his sen¬ ses subjected, performs Yajnas and is a devotee of Devas, is honoured in the Brahmaloka.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who is engaged in the welfare of his parents, is interested in the well-being of cows and Brahmanas, has his sen¬ ses subjected, performs Yajnas and is a devotee of Devas, is honoured in the Brahmaloka.

verses.sanskrit: उदकुम्भं कुशान् पुष्पं समिधो ऽस्याहरेत् सदा । मार्जनं लेपनं नित्यमङ्गानां वै समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: udakumbhaṃ kuśān puṣpaṃ samidho 'syāharet sadā / mārjanaṃ lepanaṃ nityamaṅgānāṃ vai samācaret
verses.translation: He should always be engaged in the realisation of the three aims of life (Virtue, love and wealth), should perform worship of the deities; he shall be pure in the mind and body and bow to the gods everyday.
verses.hindi: हैं । कुशोंके द्वारा जलबिन्दुओंसे मन्त्रोच्चारणपूर्वक मार्जन करना ब्राह्म-स्नान कहलाता है। मस्तकसे पैरोंतक समस्त देहमें भस्मका उपलेपन करना आग्नेय-स्नान है। गायोंकी धूलसे सम्पन्न उत्तम स्नानको वायव्य- स्नान कहा गया है। धूपमें वर्षाके जलसे जो स्नान किया जाता हे, वह दिव्य-स्त्रान कहलाता है। (जलमें) डुबकी लगाकर किया गया स्नान वारुण-स्नान और मनसे आत्मतत्त्वका चिन्तन करना यौगिक-स्नान कहा
verses.wordMeaning: He should always be engaged in the realisation of the three aims of life (Virtue, love and wealth), should perform worship of the deities; he shall be pure in the mind and body and bow to the gods everyday.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should always be engaged in the realisation of the three aims of life (Virtue, love and wealth), should perform worship of the deities; he shall be pure in the mind and body and bow to the gods everyday.

verses.sanskrit: नास्य निर्माल्यशयनं पादुकोपानहावपि । आक्रमेदासनं चास्य छायादीन् वा कदाचन
verses.transliteration: nāsya nirmālyaśayanaṃ pādukopānahāvapi / ākramedāsanaṃ cāsya chāyādīn vā kadācana
verses.translation: Onecannot be called a Grhastha (householder) merely because one has a house to live in. He who temperamentally always shares everything with others, is endowed with forgive¬ ness and mercy, deserves to be called a householder.
verses.hindi: गया है । विष्णुका चिन्तन ही योग है ॥ ११--१५॥
verses.wordMeaning: Onecannot be called a Grhastha (householder) merely because one has a house to live in. He who temperamentally always shares everything with others, is endowed with forgive¬ ness and mercy, deserves to be called a householder.
verses.commentary: Sense: Onecannot be called a Grhastha (householder) merely because one has a house to live in. He who temperamentally always shares everything with others, is endowed with forgive¬ ness and mercy, deserves to be called a householder.

verses.sanskrit: साधयेद् दन्तकाष्ठादीन् लब्धं चास्मै निवेदयेत् । अनापृच्छ्य न गन्तव्यं भवेत् प्रियहिते रतः
verses.transliteration: sādhayed dantakāṣṭhādīn labdhaṃ cāsmai nivedayet / anāpṛcchya na gantavyaṃ bhavet priyahite rataḥ
verses.translation: These are the characteristic features of a Brahmana viz: forbearance, mercy, perfect knowledge, truthfulness, mental control and control over the sense-organs and interest in the spiritual knowledge.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मवादियोंसे सेवित इस (यौगिक) स्नानको आत्मतीर्थ कहा गया है। यह मनुष्योंके मनको पवित्र बनानेवाला है। इसलिये यह स्नान नित्य करना चाहिए। समर्थ होनेपर विद्वानूको वारुण तथा प्राजापत्य (ब्राह्म) -स्नान करना चाहिए  दन्तकाष्ठको धोकर विधिपूर्वक उसका भक्षण (चर्वण) करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: These are the characteristic features of a Brahmana viz: forbearance, mercy, perfect knowledge, truthfulness, mental control and control over the sense-organs and interest in the spiritual knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: These are the characteristic features of a Brahmana viz: forbearance, mercy, perfect knowledge, truthfulness, mental control and control over the sense-organs and interest in the spiritual knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: न पादौ सारयेदस्य संनिधाने कदाचन । जृम्भितं हसितं चैव कण्ठप्रावरणं तथा । वर्जयेत् सन्निधौ नित्यमवस्फोचनमेव च
verses.transliteration: na pādau sārayedasya saṃnidhāne kadācana / jṛmbhitaṃ hasitaṃ caiva kaṇṭhaprāvaraṇaṃ tathā / varjayet sannidhau nityamavasphocanameva ca
verses.translation: An excellent Brahmana specially shall not err from all these. He should perform his duties in accordance with his capacity; and shall avoid all prohibited and censured activities.
verses.hindi: (दतुअन करके) आचमनकर (मुख-प्रक्षालनकर) प्रयत्नपूर्वक नित्य प्रात:स्नान करना चाहिए । मध्यमा अंगुलिके समान मोटा और बारह अंगुलके बराबर लंबा छिलके-युक्त दन्तकाष्ठके अग्रभागसे मुखशुद्धि करनी
verses.wordMeaning: An excellent Brahmana specially shall not err from all these. He should perform his duties in accordance with his capacity; and shall avoid all prohibited and censured activities.
verses.commentary: Sense: An excellent Brahmana specially shall not err from all these. He should perform his duties in accordance with his capacity; and shall avoid all prohibited and censured activities.

verses.sanskrit: यथाकालमधीयीत यावन्न विमना गुरुः । आसीताधो गुरोः कूर्चे फलके वा समाहितः
verses.transliteration: yathākālamadhīyīta yāvanna vimanā guruḥ / āsītādho guroḥ kūrce phalake vā samāhitaḥ
verses.translation: No one need entertain any doubt for the fact that if a householder, eschewing the confused state of delusion, attains the excellent Yoga, he is liberated from the bondage of Samsara.
verses.hindi: चाहिए । विशेषरूपसे दूधवाले वृक्ष, मालती (चमेली), अपामार्ग, बिल्व तथा करवीर (कनेर)-की लकड़ीका दन्तकाष्ठ शुभ होता है। विधिके ज्ञाताको चाहिए कि दोषपूर्ण (निषिद्ध) दिनको छोड़कर तथा निन्दित काष्ठोंको छोड़कर बताये गये दन्तकाष्ठोंमेंसे किसी एकको ग्रहणकर दन्तधावन करना चाहिए। दन्तकाष्ठको उखाड्ना नहीं चाहिए (अर्थात् किसी छोटे पौधेको पूरा उखाड़कर उससे दन्तधावन नहीं करना चाहिए) और न कभी
verses.wordMeaning: No one need entertain any doubt for the fact that if a householder, eschewing the confused state of delusion, attains the excellent Yoga, he is liberated from the bondage of Samsara.
verses.commentary: Sense: No one need entertain any doubt for the fact that if a householder, eschewing the confused state of delusion, attains the excellent Yoga, he is liberated from the bondage of Samsara.

verses.sanskrit: आसने शयने याने नैव तिष्ठेत् कदाचन । धावन्तमनुधावेत गच्छन्तमनुगच्छति
verses.transliteration: āsane śayane yāne naiva tiṣṭhet kadācana / dhāvantamanudhāveta gacchantamanugacchati
verses.translation: Forbearance is the ability to endure the defects originating from others' anger, such as censure, transgression, defiance, violence, imprisonment and killing.
verses.hindi: अँगुलीसे दतुअन करना चाहिए। (मुख) धोनेके उपरान्त उसे (दन्तकाष्ठको) तोड़कर सावधानीसे किसी पवित्र स्थानमें (यथास्थान) त्याग देना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: Forbearance is the ability to endure the defects originating from others' anger, such as censure, transgression, defiance, violence, imprisonment and killing.
verses.commentary: Sense: Forbearance is the ability to endure the defects originating from others' anger, such as censure, transgression, defiance, violence, imprisonment and killing.

verses.sanskrit: गो ऽश्वोष्ट्रयानप्रासादप्रस्तरेषु कटेषु च । आसीत गुरुणा सार्धं शिलाफलकनौषु च
verses.transliteration: go 'śvoṣṭrayānaprāsādaprastareṣu kaṭeṣu ca / āsīta guruṇā sārdhaṃ śilāphalakanauṣu ca
verses.translation: The sages say that kindness is that mercifulness due to friendship (gentleness of heart) in regard to miseries of others in the same way as (in the case of) one's own miseries. It is a direct means ofDharma (piety).
verses.hindi: अनन्तर पवित्र देशमें स्नान करके आचमनपूर्वक यथाविधि तृप्त करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: The sages say that kindness is that mercifulness due to friendship (gentleness of heart) in regard to miseries of others in the same way as (in the case of) one's own miseries. It is a direct means ofDharma (piety).
verses.commentary: Sense: The sages say that kindness is that mercifulness due to friendship (gentleness of heart) in regard to miseries of others in the same way as (in the case of) one's own miseries. It is a direct means ofDharma (piety).

verses.sanskrit: जितेन्द्रियः स्यात् सततं वश्यात्माक्रोधनः शुचिः । प्रयुञ्जीत सदा वाचं मधुरां हितभाषिणीम्
verses.transliteration: jitendriyaḥ syāt satataṃ vaśyātmākrodhanaḥ śuciḥ / prayuñjīta sadā vācaṃ madhurāṃ hitabhāṣiṇīm
verses.translation: The actual retention in memory of the fourteen lores should be known as Vijnana (perfect knowledge. It is there¬ by that Dharma flourishes.
verses.hindi: ओङ्कारव्याहृतियुतां गायत्रीं वेदमातरम्। जप्वा जलाञ्जलिं दद्याद् भास्करं प्रति तन्मनाः
verses.wordMeaning: The actual retention in memory of the fourteen lores should be known as Vijnana (perfect knowledge. It is there¬ by that Dharma flourishes.
verses.commentary: Sense: The actual retention in memory of the fourteen lores should be known as Vijnana (perfect knowledge. It is there¬ by that Dharma flourishes.

verses.sanskrit: गन्धमाल्यं रसं कल्यां शुक्तं प्राणिविहिंसनम् । अभ्यङ्गं चाञ्चनोपानच्छत्रधारणमेव च
verses.transliteration: gandhamālyaṃ rasaṃ kalyāṃ śuktaṃ prāṇivihiṃsanam / abhyaṅgaṃ cāñcanopānacchatradhāraṇameva ca
verses.translation: If, after duly studing the Vedas and comprehending the meanings, one is averse to religious activities, that (which he has acquired) is not considered to be Vijnana (perfect knowledge).
verses.hindi: संध्याहीनोऽशुचिर्नित्यमनहः सर्वकर्मसु। यदन्यत् कुरुते किञ्चिन्न तस्य फलमाप्नुयात् योऽन्यत्र कुरुते यत्नं धर्मकार्ये द्विजोत्तमः। विहाय संध्याप्रणतिं स याति नरकायुतम्
verses.wordMeaning: If, after duly studing the Vedas and comprehending the meanings, one is averse to religious activities, that (which he has acquired) is not considered to be Vijnana (perfect knowledge).
verses.commentary: Sense: If, after duly studing the Vedas and comprehending the meanings, one is averse to religious activities, that (which he has acquired) is not considered to be Vijnana (perfect knowledge).

verses.sanskrit: कामं लोभं भयं निद्रां गीतवादित्रनर्तनम् । आतर्जनं परीवादं स्त्रीप्रेक्षालम्भनं तथा । परोपघातं पैशुन्यं प्रयत्नेन विवर्जयेत्
verses.transliteration: kāmaṃ lobhaṃ bhayaṃ nidrāṃ gītavāditranartanam / ātarjanaṃ parīvādaṃ strīprekṣālambhanaṃ tathā / paropaghātaṃ paiśunyaṃ prayatnena vivarjayet
verses.translation: One conquers the worlds through Satya (Truth); Truth is the excellent region. Learned men explain that the narration in the same order in which something has happened is truthfulness.
verses.hindi: उपासितो भवेत् तेन देवो योगतनुः परः
verses.wordMeaning: One conquers the worlds through Satya (Truth); Truth is the excellent region. Learned men explain that the narration in the same order in which something has happened is truthfulness.
verses.commentary: Sense: One conquers the worlds through Satya (Truth); Truth is the excellent region. Learned men explain that the narration in the same order in which something has happened is truthfulness.

verses.sanskrit: उदकुम्भं सुमनसो गोशकृन्मृत्तिकां कुशान् । आहरेद् यावदर्थानि भैक्ष्यं चाहरहश्चरेत्
verses.transliteration: udakumbhaṃ sumanaso gośakṛnmṛttikāṃ kuśān / āhared yāvadarthāni bhaikṣyaṃ cāharahaścaret
verses.translation: Dama is the subjugation of the body. Sama originates from the clarity of intellect. Adhyatma (spirituality should be known as that imperishable attainment which one does not regret.
verses.hindi: उपस्थाय महायोगं देवदेवं दिवाकरम्। कुवीत प्रणतिं भूमौ मूर्ध्ना तेनैव मन्त्रतः तदनन्तर पुनः आचमन करे और संयतवाणीवाला होकर ' आपो हिष्ठा' इत्यादि मन्त्र, व्याहृतियों, गायत्रीमन्त्र तथा वरुण-सम्बन्धी शुभ मन्त्रोंका पाठ करते हुए जलबिन्दुओंसे युक्त कुशोंके द्वारा अपना मार्जन करे।
verses.wordMeaning: Dama is the subjugation of the body. Sama originates from the clarity of intellect. Adhyatma (spirituality should be known as that imperishable attainment which one does not regret.
verses.commentary: Sense: Dama is the subjugation of the body. Sama originates from the clarity of intellect. Adhyatma (spirituality should be known as that imperishable attainment which one does not regret.

verses.sanskrit: कृतं च लवणं सर्वं वर्ज्यं पर्युषितं च यत् । अनृत्यदर्शो सततं भवेद् गीतादिनिः स्पृहः
verses.transliteration: kṛtaṃ ca lavaṇaṃ sarvaṃ varjyaṃ paryuṣitaṃ ca yat / anṛtyadarśo satataṃ bhaved gītādiniḥ spṛhaḥ
verses.translation: That learning whereby the supreme lord Mahadeva himself is known, is glorified as Jnana (knowledge).
verses.hindi: ओंकार एवं व्याहृतियोंसे युक्त वेदमाता गायत्री (-मन्त्र)-का जप करके तन्मय होकर सूर्यको जलाञ्जलि देनी चाहिए। तदनन्तर पूर्वको ओर बिछे हुए कुशासनपर सावधानीपूर्वक बैठकर तीन प्राणायाम
verses.wordMeaning: That learning whereby the supreme lord Mahadeva himself is known, is glorified as Jnana (knowledge).
verses.commentary: Sense: That learning whereby the supreme lord Mahadeva himself is known, is glorified as Jnana (knowledge).

verses.sanskrit: नादित्यं वै समीक्षेत न चरेद् दन्तधावनम् । एकान्तमशुचिस्त्रीभिः शूद्रान्त्यैरभिभाषणम्
verses.transliteration: nādityaṃ vai samīkṣeta na cared dantadhāvanam / ekāntamaśucistrībhiḥ śūdrāntyairabhibhāṣaṇam
verses.translation: The learned person who is absolutely devoted to him, wise, always free from anger and pure, is interested in (the five) "great sacrifices, becomes one with that supreme Deity.
verses.hindi: करके संध्याका ध्यान करना चाहिए। ऐसा श्रुतिका विधान है जो संध्या है वही जगत्को उत्पन्न करनेवाली है, मायातीत है, निष्कल है और तीन तत्त्वोंसे उत्पन्न होनेवाली ईश्वरकी पराशक्ति है । विद्वान् ब्राह्मण (द्विज)- को पूर्वाभिमुख होकर सूर्यमण्डलमें प्रतिष्ठित सावित्री
verses.wordMeaning: The learned person who is absolutely devoted to him, wise, always free from anger and pure, is interested in (the five) "great sacrifices, becomes one with that supreme Deity.
verses.commentary: Sense: The learned person who is absolutely devoted to him, wise, always free from anger and pure, is interested in (the five) "great sacrifices, becomes one with that supreme Deity.

verses.sanskrit: गुरूच्छिष्टं भेषजार्थं प्रयुञ्जीत न कामतः । कलापकर्षणस्नानं नाचरेद्धि कदाचन
verses.transliteration: gurūcchiṣṭaṃ bheṣajārthaṃ prayuñjīta na kāmataḥ / kalāpakarṣaṇasnānaṃ nācareddhi kadācana
verses.translation: One should maintain one's physical body with great effort as it is the abode of Dharma. Without one's physical body, Rudra, the greatest lord, cannot be known by men.
verses.hindi: (गायत्रीमन्त्र)-का ध्यानपूर्वक जप करते हुए संध्योपासना करनी चाहिए। संध्यासे हीन व्यक्ति (द्विज) नित्य अपवित्र और सभी कर्मोको करनेके लिये अयोग्य होता है। वह जो भी कार्य करता है, उसका उसे कोई
verses.wordMeaning: One should maintain one's physical body with great effort as it is the abode of Dharma. Without one's physical body, Rudra, the greatest lord, cannot be known by men.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should maintain one's physical body with great effort as it is the abode of Dharma. Without one's physical body, Rudra, the greatest lord, cannot be known by men.

verses.sanskrit: न कुर्यान्मानसं विप्रो गुरोस्त्यागे कदाचन । मोहाद्वा यदि वा लोभात् त्यक्तेन पतितो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: na kuryānmānasaṃ vipro gurostyāge kadācana / mohādvā yadi vā lobhāt tyaktena patito bhavet
verses.translation: A Brahmana should invariably be engaged inDharma (Virtue), Artha (Wealth) and Kama (Love). He should never mentally conceive of that type of love or wealth which is devoid of Dharma.
verses.hindi: फल प्राप्त नहीं होता। पूर्वकालमें वेदके पारंगत शान्त ब्राह्मणोंने अनन्य-मनसे संध्योपासना करके परम गतिको प्राप्त किया था। जो द्विजोत्तम संध्यावन्दनको छोड़कर दूसरे धार्मिक कार्योके लिये प्रयत्न करता है, वह सहस्रो नरकोंमें जाता है। इसलिये सभी प्रयत्नोंसे संध्योपासना करनी चाहिए। उस उपासनासे योगविग्रह परमदेवकी उपासना हो जाती है
verses.wordMeaning: A Brahmana should invariably be engaged inDharma (Virtue), Artha (Wealth) and Kama (Love). He should never mentally conceive of that type of love or wealth which is devoid of Dharma.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmana should invariably be engaged inDharma (Virtue), Artha (Wealth) and Kama (Love). He should never mentally conceive of that type of love or wealth which is devoid of Dharma.

verses.sanskrit: लौकिकं वैदिकं चापि तथाध्यात्मिकमेव च । आददीत यतो ज्ञानं न तं द्रुह्येत् कदाचन
verses.transliteration: laukikaṃ vaidikaṃ cāpi tathādhyātmikameva ca / ādadīta yato jñānaṃ na taṃ druhyet kadācana
verses.translation: Even if one perishes due to practice of Virtue, one should never take to Adharma. Dharma is the Lord himself. It is the goal of all creatures.
verses.hindi: विद्वान् व्यक्तिको नित्य पूर्वाभिमुख होकर सावित्री (-मन्त्र)-का सावधानीपूर्वक जप करना चाहिए। हजार बारका जप उत्कृष्ट, सौ बार किया गया जप मध्यम तथा दस बारका जप निम्नरकोटिका होता है!
verses.wordMeaning: Even if one perishes due to practice of Virtue, one should never take to Adharma. Dharma is the Lord himself. It is the goal of all creatures.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even if one perishes due to practice of Virtue, one should never take to Adharma. Dharma is the Lord himself. It is the goal of all creatures.

verses.sanskrit: गुरोरप्यवलिप्तस्य कार्याकार्यमजानतः । उत्पथप्रतिपन्नस्य मनुस्त्यागं समब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: gurorapyavaliptasya kāryākāryamajānataḥ / utpathapratipannasya manustyāgaṃ samabravīt
verses.translation: One shall always be pleasing to all living beings, he should never think of doing acts of injury against others. One
verses.hindi: इसके बाद खड़े होकर ध्यान लगाकर उदित होते हुए सूर्यकी ऋग्वेद, यजुर्वेद तथा सामवेदमें वर्णित सूर्य-सम्बन्धी विविध मन्त्रोंद्वारा उपासना करनी चाहिए। महायोगरूप देवाधिदेव दिवाकरका उपस्थान करके उसी मन्त्रद्वारा भूमिपर मस्तक झुकाकर प्रणाम करना चाहिए और निम्नलिखित मन्त्रोंसे प्रार्थना करनी चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: One shall always be pleasing to all living beings, he should never think of doing acts of injury against others. One
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall always be pleasing to all living beings, he should never think of doing acts of injury against others. One

verses.sanskrit: गुरोर्गुरौ सन्निहिते गुरुवद् भक्तिमाचरेत् । न चातिसृष्टो गुरुणा स्वान् गुरूनबिवादयेत्
verses.transliteration: gurorgurau sannihite guruvad bhaktimācaret / na cātisṛṣṭo guruṇā svān gurūnabivādayet
verses.translation: The pure Brahmana who invariably reads this chap¬ ter on Dharma, teaches it or narrates it (to others) is honoured in the Brahmaloka.
verses.hindi: ओं खखोल्काय शान्ताय कारणत्रयहेतवे
verses.wordMeaning: The pure Brahmana who invariably reads this chap¬ ter on Dharma, teaches it or narrates it (to others) is honoured in the Brahmaloka.
verses.commentary: Sense: The pure Brahmana who invariably reads this chap¬ ter on Dharma, teaches it or narrates it (to others) is honoured in the Brahmaloka.

verses.sanskrit: विद्यागुरुष्वेतदेव नित्या वृत्तिः स्वयोनिषु । प्रतिषेधत्सु चाधर्माद्धितं चोपदिशत्स्वपि
verses.transliteration: vidyāguruṣvetadeva nityā vṛttiḥ svayoniṣu / pratiṣedhatsu cādharmāddhitaṃ copadiśatsvapi
verses.translation: The 'duties' of householders are described in numerous works on Dharma-Sastra—Dharma Sutras (e.g. Apastamba II. 1-11, Vasistha VIII. 1-17, XI. 1-48), Smrtis (e.g. Manu IV, Yajnavalkya 1.96-127), Mbk-Anu- Sdsana ch. 97, Puranas (e.g. Bh. P. VII. Ch. 11, XI. Ch. 17, NP. I. Ch. 43) and digests (e. g. SMC-I. p -282, Smrtyarthasara, p -48). A number of these verses prescribing 'Do's' and 'Don'ts' are actually subhdsitds current among the ancient Indians as a number of these are common to Pali and Prakrits. These verses shed light on the customs, manners, prejudices etc. of the people of those times.
verses.hindi: नमस्ते घृणिने तुभ्यं सूर्याय ब्रह्मसूपिणे त्वमेव ब्रह्म परममापो ज्योती रसोऽमृतम्। भूर्भुवः स्वस्त्वमोङ्कारः सर्वे रुद्राः सनातनाः । पुरुषः सन्महोऽतस्त्वां प्रणमामि कपर्दिनम्
verses.wordMeaning: The 'duties' of householders are described in numerous works on Dharma-Sastra—Dharma Sutras (e.g. Apastamba II. 1-11, Vasistha VIII. 1-17, XI. 1-48), Smrtis (e.g. Manu IV, Yajnavalkya 1.96-127), Mbk-Anu- Sdsana ch. 97, Puranas (e.g. Bh. P. VII. Ch. 11, XI. Ch. 17, NP. I. Ch.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The 'duties' of householders are described in numerous works on Dharma-Sastra—Dharma Sutras (e.g. Apastamba II. 1-11, Vasistha VIII. 1-17, XI. 1-48), Smrtis (e.g. Manu IV, Yajnavalkya 1.96-127), Mbk-Anu- Sdsana ch. 97, Puranas (e.g. Bh. P. VII. Ch. 11, XI. Ch. 17, NP. I. Ch.…

verses.sanskrit: श्रेयःसु गुरुवद् वृत्तिं नित्यमेव समाचरेत् । गुरुपुत्रेषु दारेषु गुरोश्चैव स्वबन्धुषु
verses.transliteration: śreyaḥsu guruvad vṛttiṃ nityameva samācaret / guruputreṣu dāreṣu guroścaiva svabandhuṣu
verses.translation: The person who steals properties of others even if they be a blade of grass, a lump of clay, a plant or water, falls into the hell.
verses.hindi: प्रचेतसे नमस्तुभ्यं नमो मीढुष्टमाय ते। नमो नमस्ते रुद्राय त्वामहं शरणं गतः
verses.wordMeaning: The person who steals properties of others even if they be a blade of grass, a lump of clay, a plant or water, falls into the hell.
verses.commentary: Sense: The person who steals properties of others even if they be a blade of grass, a lump of clay, a plant or water, falls into the hell.

verses.sanskrit: बालः समानजन्मा वा शिष्यो वा यज्ञकर्मणि । अध्यापयन् गुरुसुतो गुरुवन्मानमर्हति
verses.transliteration: bālaḥ samānajanmā vā śiṣyo vā yajñakarmaṇi / adhyāpayan gurusuto guruvanmānamarhati
verses.translation: One should not accept monetary gifts from a fallen king, Sudra or any other person. A learned man should avoid being a suppliant in front of a blameworthy person.
verses.hindi: अम्बिकापतये तुभ्यमुमायाः पतये नमः नमस्ते वज्रहस्ताय त्र्यम्बकाय नमोऽस्तु ते
verses.wordMeaning: One should not accept monetary gifts from a fallen king, Sudra or any other person. A learned man should avoid being a suppliant in front of a blameworthy person.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not accept monetary gifts from a fallen king, Sudra or any other person. A learned man should avoid being a suppliant in front of a blameworthy person.

verses.sanskrit: उत्सादनं वै गात्राणां स्नापनोच्छिष्टभोजने । न कुर्याद् गुरुपुत्रस्य पादयोः शौचमेव च
verses.transliteration: utsādanaṃ vai gātrāṇāṃ snāpanocchiṣṭabhojane / na kuryād guruputrasya pādayoḥ śaucameva ca
verses.translation: One should never be a beggar; (if one has to beg) one should not beg the same person twice. This evil-minded beggar will deprive him of his life there-by.
verses.hindi: नमस्यामि परं ज्योतिर्ब्रह्माणं त्वां परां गतिम्। विश्वं पशुपतिं भीमं नरनारीशरीरिणम्
verses.wordMeaning: One should never be a beggar; (if one has to beg) one should not beg the same person twice. This evil-minded beggar will deprive him of his life there-by.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should never be a beggar; (if one has to beg) one should not beg the same person twice. This evil-minded beggar will deprive him of his life there-by.

verses.sanskrit: गुरुवत् परिपूज्यास्तु सवर्णा गुरुयोषितः । असवर्णास्तु संपूज्याः प्रत्युत्थानाभिवादनैः
verses.transliteration: guruvat paripūjyāstu savarṇā guruyoṣitaḥ / asavarṇāstu saṃpūjyāḥ pratyutthānābhivādanaiḥ
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas, he should not be one who misappropriates especially the properties of the deity. Even in emergency, he should never take away the wealth of a Brahmana.
verses.hindi: उग्राय सर्वभक्ताय त्वां प्रपद्ये सहैव हि एतद् वै सूर्यहृदयं जप्त्वा स्तवमनुत्तमम्। प्रातःकालेऽथ मध्याह्ने नमस्कुर्याद् दिवाकरम्
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahmanas, he should not be one who misappropriates especially the properties of the deity. Even in emergency, he should never take away the wealth of a Brahmana.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmanas, he should not be one who misappropriates especially the properties of the deity. Even in emergency, he should never take away the wealth of a Brahmana.

verses.sanskrit: अभ्यञ्जनं स्नापनं च गात्रोत्सादनमेव च । गुरुपत्न्या न कार्याणि केशानां च प्रसाधनम्
verses.transliteration: abhyañjanaṃ snāpanaṃ ca gātrotsādanameva ca / gurupatnyā na kāryāṇi keśānāṃ ca prasādhanam
verses.translation: They say that poison is not dangerous but the property of a Brahmana or that of the deity is the real poison. Hence one should scrupulously avoid these assets.
verses.hindi: मैं ओंकाररूप शान्त, कारणत्रयके हेतुरूप खखोल्क' (सूर्य) -के प्रति अपनेको समर्पित करता हूँ। ज्ञानरूपी आप (सूर्य) -को नमस्कार है। ब्रह्मरूपी घृणि सूर्य! आपको नमस्कार है। आप ही परम ब्रह्म, अप्, ज्योति,
verses.wordMeaning: They say that poison is not dangerous but the property of a Brahmana or that of the deity is the real poison. Hence one should scrupulously avoid these assets.
verses.commentary: Sense: They say that poison is not dangerous but the property of a Brahmana or that of the deity is the real poison. Hence one should scrupulously avoid these assets.

verses.sanskrit: गुरुपत्नी तु युवती नाभिवाद्येह पादयोः । कुर्वोत वन्दनं भूम्यामसावहमिति ब्रुवन्
verses.transliteration: gurupatnī tu yuvatī nābhivādyeha pādayoḥ / kurvota vandanaṃ bhūmyāmasāvahamiti bruvan
verses.translation: Manu, the Prajapati, has said that the taking of any of these things, though not handed over to one (by the owner), is not stealing viz. flowers, greens, water, firewood, roots, fruits and grass.
verses.hindi: रस और अमृतस्वरूप हैं। आप ही भूः, भुवः, स्वः, ओंकार तथा समस्त सनातन रुद्र हैं। आप सत्स्वरूप और महान् पुरुष हैं। आप कपर्दीको मैं प्रणाम करता विश्वको उत्पन्न करते हैं। सूर्यरूप रुद्रको नमस्कार हे। मैं आपकी शरणमें आया हूँ। आप प्रचेताको नमस्कार है। मीढुष्टम“! आपको नमस्कार है। रुद्रके लिये वार-बार नमस्कार है। में आपकी शरणमें आया
verses.wordMeaning: Manu, the Prajapati, has said that the taking of any of these things, though not handed over to one (by the owner), is not stealing viz. flowers, greens, water, firewood, roots, fruits and grass.
verses.commentary: Sense: Manu, the Prajapati, has said that the taking of any of these things, though not handed over to one (by the owner), is not stealing viz. flowers, greens, water, firewood, roots, fruits and grass.

verses.sanskrit: विप्रोष्य पादग्रहणमन्वहं चाभिवादनम् । गुरुदारेषु कुर्वोत सतां धर्ममनुस्मरन्
verses.transliteration: viproṣya pādagrahaṇamanvahaṃ cābhivādanam / gurudāreṣu kurvota satāṃ dharmamanusmaran
verses.translation: O Brahmanas, if deeply afflicted by hunger on the way while travelling, a handful of gingelly seeds, green gram, barley and other articles may be taken (even without the per¬ mission of the owner) by persons knowing Dharma. They should not do so otherwise. This is the established conventional practice.
verses.hindi: हूँ। आप हिरण्यबाहु तथा हिरण्यपतिको नमस्कार है। अम्बिकाके पति तथा उमाके पति आपको नमस्कार है। नीलग्रीवको नमस्कार है तथा आप पिनाकोको नमस्कार है। विलोहित, भर्ग तथा सहस्राक्ष! आपको
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas, if deeply afflicted by hunger on the way while travelling, a handful of gingelly seeds, green gram, barley and other articles may be taken (even without the per¬ mission of the owner) by persons knowing Dharma. They should not do so otherwise.…
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas, if deeply afflicted by hunger on the way while travelling, a handful of gingelly seeds, green gram, barley and other articles may be taken (even without the per¬ mission of the owner) by persons knowing Dharma. They should not do so otherwise.…

verses.sanskrit: मातृष्वसा मातुलानी श्वश्रूश्चाथ पितृष्वसा । संपूज्या गुरुपत्नीव समास्ता गुरुभार्यया
verses.transliteration: mātṛṣvasā mātulānī śvaśrūścātha pitṛṣvasā / saṃpūjyā gurupatnīva samāstā gurubhāryayā
verses.translation: If a non-lihgin (a person who is not a Sannyasin or Brahmacarin) maintains himself in the guise of a lihgin (ascetic) he shall incur the sins of those persons and shall be born as a lower animal.
verses.hindi: नमस्कार है॥ ३५--४० ॥ आप हंसको नित्य नमस्कार है। आदित्य ! आपको नमस्कार है। वज्रहस्त तथा त्र्यम्बक! आपको नमस्कार है। मैं आप विरूपाक्ष महान् परमेशवरकी शरणमें हूँ। सभी देहधारियोंके हिरण्मय गृहमें (हृदयमें) आप
verses.wordMeaning: If a non-lihgin (a person who is not a Sannyasin or Brahmacarin) maintains himself in the guise of a lihgin (ascetic) he shall incur the sins of those persons and shall be born as a lower animal.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a non-lihgin (a person who is not a Sannyasin or Brahmacarin) maintains himself in the guise of a lihgin (ascetic) he shall incur the sins of those persons and shall be born as a lower animal.

verses.sanskrit: भ्रातुर्भार्योपसंग्राह्या सवर्णाहन्यहन्यपि । विप्रोष्य तूपसंग्राह्या ज्ञातिसंबन्धियोषितः
verses.transliteration: bhrāturbhāryopasaṃgrāhyā savarṇāhanyahanyapi / viproṣya tūpasaṃgrāhyā jñātisaṃbandhiyoṣitaḥ
verses.translation: One should not even mentally think of those people who censure the Vedas, Devas and the Brahmanas.
verses.hindi: अपनेको गुह्यरूपसे प्रतिष्ठित किये हैं । परम ज्योतिरूप,
verses.wordMeaning: One should not even mentally think of those people who censure the Vedas, Devas and the Brahmanas.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not even mentally think of those people who censure the Vedas, Devas and the Brahmanas.

verses.sanskrit: पितुर्भगिन्यां मातुश्च ज्यायस्यां च स्वसर्यपि । मातृवद् वृत्तिमातिष्ठेन्मात् ताभ्यो गरीयसी
verses.transliteration: piturbhaginyāṃ mātuśca jyāyasyāṃ ca svasaryapi / mātṛvad vṛttimātiṣṭhenmāt tābhyo garīyasī
verses.translation: The creature (person) who officiates in their sacrifice, has matrimonial alliance with them, who talks to them and who stays along with them faces downfall. Hence, he should avoid it scrupulously.
verses.hindi: रूपवाले आप ब्रह्माको मैं नमस्कार करता हूँ। प्रकाशमान सूर्यरूप परमेष्ठी रुद्रको नमस्कार है। उग्र तथा सभीके भजनीय आपकी मैं सदा ही शरण ग्रहण करता इस सूर्यहृदय (नामक) उत्तम स्तोत्रका प्रातः- काल तथा मध्याहृकालमें जपकर दिवाकरको नमस्कार करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: The creature (person) who officiates in their sacrifice, has matrimonial alliance with them, who talks to them and who stays along with them faces downfall. Hence, he should avoid it scrupulously.
verses.commentary: Sense: The creature (person) who officiates in their sacrifice, has matrimonial alliance with them, who talks to them and who stays along with them faces downfall. Hence, he should avoid it scrupulously.

verses.sanskrit: एवमाचारसंपन्नमात्मवन्तमदाम्भिकम् । वेदमध्यापयेद् धर्मं पुराणाङ्गानि नित्यशः
verses.transliteration: evamācārasaṃpannamātmavantamadāmbhikam / vedamadhyāpayed dharmaṃ purāṇāṅgāni nityaśaḥ
verses.translation: Incurring the displeasure of the preceptor is a crore of times worse than incurring the displeasure of Devas. Censuring of perfect knowledge and atheism is a crore of times worse than that.
verses.hindi: १- यहाँ कारणत्रयसे मन, बुद्धि एवं अहंकार विवक्षित हैं। इन तीनोंको क्रियाशील बनानेमें सूर्य एक महत्त्वपूर्ण कारण हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Incurring the displeasure of the preceptor is a crore of times worse than incurring the displeasure of Devas. Censuring of perfect knowledge and atheism is a crore of times worse than that.
verses.commentary: Sense: Incurring the displeasure of the preceptor is a crore of times worse than incurring the displeasure of Devas. Censuring of perfect knowledge and atheism is a crore of times worse than that.

verses.sanskrit: संवत्सरोषिते शिष्ये गुरुर्ज्ञानमनिर्दिशन् । हरते दुष्कृतं तस्य शिष्यस्य वसतो गुरुः
verses.transliteration: saṃvatsaroṣite śiṣye gururjñānamanirdiśan / harate duṣkṛtaṃ tasya śiṣyasya vasato guruḥ
verses.translation: Those families which become devoid of Dharma through (sale-purchase of) cows, (paid service of) deities, and priesthood, agriculture, king's service sink to a lower status.
verses.hindi: २- खखोल्क-ख (आकाश) ख (इन्द्रियों) -में क्रमशः सूर्य तथा आत्मारूपसे जो उल्काके समान बाहर-भीतर प्रकाशक-रूपमें विद्यमान हैं, वे खखोल्क हँ । काशीखण्ड ५० वें अध्यायमें खखोल्क नामके सूर्यका वर्णन है। ये काशीमें स्थित हैं। ३-घृणि-सूर्यका नाम है-जिघर्ति दीप्यते इति घृणि:=दीसिशाली।
verses.wordMeaning: Those families which become devoid of Dharma through (sale-purchase of) cows, (paid service of) deities, and priesthood, agriculture, king's service sink to a lower status.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those families which become devoid of Dharma through (sale-purchase of) cows, (paid service of) deities, and priesthood, agriculture, king's service sink to a lower status.

verses.sanskrit: आचार्यपुत्रः शुश्रूषुर्ज्ञानदो धार्मिकः शुचिः । शक्तो ऽन्नदोर्ऽथो स्वःसाधुरध्याप्या दश धर्मतः
verses.transliteration: ācāryaputraḥ śuśrūṣurjñānado dhārmikaḥ śuciḥ / śakto 'nnador'tho svaḥsādhuradhyāpyā daśa dharmataḥ
verses.translation: Families decline in prosperity through these evil activities viz.—contracting despicable marriages, non-perform¬ ance of holy rites, non-study of the Vedas as well as by slighting the Brahmanas.
verses.hindi: ४-मीढुष्टम-शिवका नाम है (श्रीमद्भागवत स्कन्ध ४ अ० ६) । सूर्यमें सभी देवताओंकी भावना एवं उपासनाका विधान होनेसे सुर्यको मीढुष्टम कहा गया है। रुद्र आदिक रूपमें सूर्यके उल्लेखका भी यही कारण है।
verses.wordMeaning: Families decline in prosperity through these evil activities viz.—contracting despicable marriages, non-perform¬ ance of holy rites, non-study of the Vedas as well as by slighting the Brahmanas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Families decline in prosperity through these evil activities viz.—contracting despicable marriages, non-perform¬ ance of holy rites, non-study of the Vedas as well as by slighting the Brahmanas.

verses.sanskrit: कृतज्ञश्च तथाद्रोही मेधावी शुभकृन्नरः । आप्तः प्रियो ऽथ विधिवत् षडध्याप्या द्विजातयः । एतेषु ब्रह्मणो दानमन्यत्र तु यथोदितान्
verses.transliteration: kṛtajñaśca tathādrohī medhāvī śubhakṛnnaraḥ / āptaḥ priyo 'tha vidhivat ṣaḍadhyāpyā dvijātayaḥ / eteṣu brahmaṇo dānamanyatra tu yathoditān
verses.translation: A family perishes immediately due to uttering false¬ hoods, committing adultery, eating forbidden foodstuffs and by not performing the holy rites enjoined by the Srutis.
verses.hindi: ५- "सर्वः भक्तः यस्य सः' बहुत्रीहि समास हुआ है। इससे अभिप्राय यह निकलता है कि रुद्र सवके लिये भजनीय हैं। इदं पुत्राय शिष्याय धार्मिकाय द्विजातये। प्रदेयं सूर्यहदयं ब्रह्मणा तु प्रदर्शितम्
verses.wordMeaning: A family perishes immediately due to uttering false¬ hoods, committing adultery, eating forbidden foodstuffs and by not performing the holy rites enjoined by the Srutis.
verses.commentary: Sense: A family perishes immediately due to uttering false¬ hoods, committing adultery, eating forbidden foodstuffs and by not performing the holy rites enjoined by the Srutis.

verses.sanskrit: आचम्य संयतो नित्यमधीयीत उदङ्मुखः । उपसंगृह्य तत्पादौ वीक्षमाणो गुरोर्मुखम् । अधीष्व भो इति ब्रूयाद् विरामो ऽस्त्विति चारमेत्
verses.transliteration: ācamya saṃyato nityamadhīyīta udaṅmukhaḥ / upasaṃgṛhya tatpādau vīkṣamāṇo gurormukham / adhīṣva bho iti brūyād virāmo 'stviti cāramet
verses.translation: Indeed, a family perishes quickly by making chari¬ table gifts to those who are not well-read (in the Vedas) as well as to Vrsalas (Sudras), who do not strictly follow the regu¬ lations of the conduct of life.
verses.hindi: सर्वपापप्रशमनं वेदसारसमुद्धवम् । ब्राह्मणानां हितं पुण्यमृषिसङ्घैर्निषेवितम्
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, a family perishes quickly by making chari¬ table gifts to those who are not well-read (in the Vedas) as well as to Vrsalas (Sudras), who do not strictly follow the regu¬ lations of the conduct of life.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, a family perishes quickly by making chari¬ table gifts to those who are not well-read (in the Vedas) as well as to Vrsalas (Sudras), who do not strictly follow the regu¬ lations of the conduct of life.

verses.sanskrit: प्राक्कूलान् पर्युपासीनः पवित्रैश्चैव पावितः । प्राणायामैस्त्रिभिः पूतस्तत ओङ्कारमर्हति
verses.transliteration: prākkūlān paryupāsīnaḥ pavitraiścaiva pāvitaḥ / prāṇāyāmaistribhiḥ pūtastata oṅkāramarhati
verses.translation: One shall never stay in a village surrounded by unrighteous persons or afflicted by many pestilences. One shall never stay in the kingdom of a Sudra, or in a place inhabited by heretics.
verses.hindi: प्रज्चाल्य वह्निं विधिवज्जुहुयाज्ातवेदसम् अनन्यमानसो वह्निं जुहुयात् संयतेन्द्रियः
verses.wordMeaning: One shall never stay in a village surrounded by unrighteous persons or afflicted by many pestilences. One shall never stay in the kingdom of a Sudra, or in a place inhabited by heretics.
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall never stay in a village surrounded by unrighteous persons or afflicted by many pestilences. One shall never stay in the kingdom of a Sudra, or in a place inhabited by heretics.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणः प्रणवं कुर्यादन्ते च विधिवद् द्विजः । कुर्यादध्ययनं नित्यं स ब्रह्माञ्जलिपूर्वतः
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇaḥ praṇavaṃ kuryādante ca vidhivad dvijaḥ / kuryādadhyayanaṃ nityaṃ sa brahmāñjalipūrvataḥ
verses.translation: A Brahmana should not stay in any other place except in the land between the mountains Himavan and the Vindhya and between the Eastern and Western oceans.
verses.hindi: विना दर्भण यत्कर्म विना सूत्रेण वा पुनः । राक्षसं तदभवेत् सर्व नामुत्रेह फलप्रदम्
verses.wordMeaning: A Brahmana should not stay in any other place except in the land between the mountains Himavan and the Vindhya and between the Eastern and Western oceans.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmana should not stay in any other place except in the land between the mountains Himavan and the Vindhya and between the Eastern and Western oceans.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषामेव भूतानां वेदश्चक्षुः सनातनम् । अधीयीताप्ययं नित्यं ब्राह्मण्याच्च्यवते ऽन्यथा
verses.transliteration: sarveṣāmeva bhūtānāṃ vedaścakṣuḥ sanātanam / adhīyītāpyayaṃ nityaṃ brāhmaṇyāccyavate 'nyathā
verses.translation: An excellent Brahmana shall not stay anywhere else except within half a Krosa of the holy river (1 Krosa = 3 Km). He shall not stay near the village of the Sudras.
verses.hindi: हैवतानि नमस्कुर्याद् देयसारान्निवेदयेत्। दद्यात् पुष्पादिकं तेषां वृद्धांश्चैवाभिवादयेत् अवेक्षेत च शास्त्राणि धर्मादीनि द्विजोत्तमः । वैदिकांश्चैव निगमान् वेदाङ्गानि विशेषतः
verses.wordMeaning: An excellent Brahmana shall not stay anywhere else except within half a Krosa of the holy river (1 Krosa = 3 Km). He shall not stay near the village of the Sudras.
verses.commentary: Sense: An excellent Brahmana shall not stay anywhere else except within half a Krosa of the holy river (1 Krosa = 3 Km). He shall not stay near the village of the Sudras.

verses.sanskrit: यो ऽधीयीत ऋचो नित्यं क्षीराहुत्या स देवताः । प्रीणाति तर्पयन्त्येनं कामैस्तृप्ताः सदैव हि
verses.transliteration: yo 'dhīyīta ṛco nityaṃ kṣīrāhutyā sa devatāḥ / prīṇāti tarpayantyenaṃ kāmaistṛptāḥ sadaiva hi
verses.translation: He should not live in the same place with that of fallen castes, Candalas, Pukkasas, foolish fellows, arrogant
verses.hindi: ब्रह्माके द्वारा प्रदर्शित, सभी पापोंका शमन करनेवाले, वेदोंके सारसे प्रकट हुए, ब्राह्मणोंके हितकारी, पवित्र और ऋषिसमूहोंद्वारा सेवित इस सूर्यहृदय (स्तोत्र)- का द्विजाति-कुलोत्पन्न धार्मिक पुत्र एवं शिष्यके लिये
verses.wordMeaning: He should not live in the same place with that of fallen castes, Candalas, Pukkasas, foolish fellows, arrogant
verses.commentary: Sense: He should not live in the same place with that of fallen castes, Candalas, Pukkasas, foolish fellows, arrogant

verses.sanskrit: यजूंष्यधीते नियतं दध्ना प्रीणाति देवताः । सामान्यधीते प्रीणाति घृताहुतिभिरन्वहम्
verses.transliteration: yajūṃṣyadhīte niyataṃ dadhnā prīṇāti devatāḥ / sāmānyadhīte prīṇāti ghṛtāhutibhiranvaham
verses.translation: Even by staying near-by the sin is transmitted from one man to another. Hence a sensible man shall scrupulously avoid intermingling of the castes.
verses.hindi: उपदेश करना चाहिए तदनन्तर घर आकर ब्राह्मण (द्विज)-को विधिपूर्वक आचमन करके अग्नि प्रज्वलित कर यथाविधि अग्निमें हवन (अग्निहोत्र) करना चाहिए । (अग्न्याधान करनेवाला यजमान द्विजाति यदि किसी अपरिहार्य कारणवश स्वयं
verses.wordMeaning: Even by staying near-by the sin is transmitted from one man to another. Hence a sensible man shall scrupulously avoid intermingling of the castes.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even by staying near-by the sin is transmitted from one man to another. Hence a sensible man shall scrupulously avoid intermingling of the castes.

verses.sanskrit: अथर्वाङ्गिरसो नित्यं मध्वा प्रीणाति देवताः । धर्माङ्गानि पुराणानि मांसैस्तर्पयते सुरान्
verses.transliteration: atharvāṅgiraso nityaṃ madhvā prīṇāti devatāḥ / dharmāṅgāni purāṇāni māṃsaistarpayate surān
verses.translation: If the people sitting in the same row do not touch one another and if ashes mark their boundary, there is no Sarhkara defect.
verses.hindi: अग्निहोत्र नहीं कर सकता है तो उसके प्रतिनिधि- रूपमें) ऋत्विक्का पुत्र (यज्ञोपवीत-संस्कार-सम्पन्न पुत्र), पत्री, शिष्य (यज्ञोपवीती) अथवा (यज्ञोपवीती) सहोदर भाई भी विशेषरूपसे आज्ञा प्राकर विधिपूर्वक
verses.wordMeaning: If the people sitting in the same row do not touch one another and if ashes mark their boundary, there is no Sarhkara defect.
verses.commentary: Sense: If the people sitting in the same row do not touch one another and if ashes mark their boundary, there is no Sarhkara defect.

verses.sanskrit: अपां समीपे नियतो नैत्यकं विधिमाश्रितः । गायत्रीमप्यधीयीत गत्वारण्यं समाहितः
verses.transliteration: apāṃ samīpe niyato naityakaṃ vidhimāśritaḥ / gāyatrīmapyadhīyīta gatvāraṇyaṃ samāhitaḥ
verses.translation: The row can be separated by means of these six;— fire, ashes, water, door, pillar and a pathway.
verses.hindi: हवन (अग्निहोत्र) कर सकता है। हाथमें पवित्री धारणकर, पवित्रात्मा होकर, शुक्लवर्णका वस्त्र एवं उत्तरीय वस्त्र धारणकर एकाग्रमनसे इन्द्रियोंको संयमित करते हुए अग्निमें हवन करे॥ ४८--५० ॥ बिना कुशके और बिना यज्ञोपवीतके जो भी कर्म किया जाता है, बह सब राक्षसी कर्म होता है, बह न इस लोकमें फल देता है और न परलोकमें
verses.wordMeaning: The row can be separated by means of these six;— fire, ashes, water, door, pillar and a pathway.
verses.commentary: Sense: The row can be separated by means of these six;— fire, ashes, water, door, pillar and a pathway.

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रपरमां देवीं शतमध्यां दशावराम् । गायत्रीं वै जपेन्नित्यं जपयज्ञः प्रकीर्तितः
verses.transliteration: sahasraparamāṃ devīṃ śatamadhyāṃ daśāvarām / gāyatrīṃ vai japennityaṃ japayajñaḥ prakīrtitaḥ
verses.translation: One should not pursue enmity that ends in sorrow, nor indulge in argument, nor in back-biting. Nor should one communicate to others if a cow is grazing in another man's field (!)
verses.hindi: की जानेवाली (शास्त्रविहित) वस्तुओंमें उत्तमोत्तम वस्तुओंको ही निवेदित करना चाहिए। उन्हें (देवताओंको) पुष्प आदि (पदार्थ) समर्पित करना चाहिए और वृद्धजनोंका अभिवादन करना चाहिए। गुरुकी भी
