verses.wordMeaning: One should not pursue enmity that ends in sorrow, nor indulge in argument, nor in back-biting. Nor should one communicate to others if a cow is grazing in another man's field (!)
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not pursue enmity that ends in sorrow, nor indulge in argument, nor in back-biting. Nor should one communicate to others if a cow is grazing in another man's field (!)

verses.sanskrit: गायत्रीं चैव वेदांश्च तुलयातोलयत् प्रभुः । एकतश्चतुरो वेदान् गायत्रीं च तथैकतः
verses.transliteration: gāyatrīṃ caiva vedāṃśca tulayātolayat prabhuḥ / ekataścaturo vedān gāyatrīṃ ca tathaikataḥ
verses.translation: One shall not have social intercourse with a person having the impurity due to birth. One shall not touch the vulner¬ able points of others. One shall not indicate and mention to others the eclipse of the sun nor the rainbow nor the fire (con¬ suming) the dead body.
verses.hindi: उपासना करनी चाहिए, उनका हित करना चाहिए। तदनन्तर द्विजको यथाशक्ति प्रयत्नपूर्वक वेदोंका अभ्यास करना चाहिए। द्विजोत्तमको जप करना चाहिए। शिष्योंको पढ़ाना चाहिए। (पढ़े विषयोंको) धारण करना चाहिए और (उसपर) विचार करना चाहिए  शास्त्रोंका अवलोकन तथा धर्मका-विशेषरूपसे वैदिक तथा वेदसम्मत शास्त्रों और वेदाङ्गोंका चिन्तन करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: One shall not have social intercourse with a person having the impurity due to birth. One shall not touch the vulner¬ able points of others. One shall not indicate and mention to others the eclipse of the sun nor the rainbow nor the fire (con¬ suming) the dead body.
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall not have social intercourse with a person having the impurity due to birth. One shall not touch the vulner¬ able points of others. One shall not indicate and mention to others the eclipse of the sun nor the rainbow nor the fire (con¬ suming) the dead body.

verses.sanskrit: ओङ्कारमादितः कृत्वा व्याहृतीस्तदनन्तरम् । ततो ऽधीयीत सावित्रीमेकाग्रः श्रद्धयान्वितः
verses.transliteration: oṅkāramāditaḥ kṛtvā vyāhṛtīstadanantaram / tato 'dhīyīta sāvitrīmekāgraḥ śraddhayānvitaḥ
verses.translation: A learned man shall never indicate and mention the moon. No man should ever incur the antagonism of the majority at the same time.
verses.hindi: अनन्तर योग (अप्राप्तकी प्राप्ति), क्षेम (प्राप्तकी रक्षा)-के लिये ईश्वर (धार्मिक राजा अथवा श्रीमान्)- के समीप जाना चाहिए और द्विजको कुटुम्बके भरण- पोषणके लिये विविध प्रकारकी सम्पत्तियोंका ( न्यायपूर्वक)
verses.wordMeaning: A learned man shall never indicate and mention the moon. No man should ever incur the antagonism of the majority at the same time.
verses.commentary: Sense: A learned man shall never indicate and mention the moon. No man should ever incur the antagonism of the majority at the same time.

verses.sanskrit: पुराकल्पे समुत्पन्ना भूर्भुवःस्वः सनातनाः । महाव्याहृतयस्तिस्त्रः सर्वाशुभनिबर्हणाः
verses.transliteration: purākalpe samutpannā bhūrbhuvaḥsvaḥ sanātanāḥ / mahāvyāhṛtayastistraḥ sarvāśubhanibarhaṇāḥ
verses.translation: One should not do unto others what is unfavourable (or displeasing) to himself. He should not mention the Tithi (the serial number of that day in a lunar fortnight) of the fortnight nor should he point out the constellations (?)
verses.hindi: साधन (चिन्तन, अर्जन) करना चाहिए नदीषु देवखातेषु तडागेषु सरस्सु च। स्त्रानं समाचरेन्नित्यं गर्तप्रस्त्रवणेषु च
verses.wordMeaning: One should not do unto others what is unfavourable (or displeasing) to himself. He should not mention the Tithi (the serial number of that day in a lunar fortnight) of the fortnight nor should he point out the constellations (?)
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not do unto others what is unfavourable (or displeasing) to himself. He should not mention the Tithi (the serial number of that day in a lunar fortnight) of the fortnight nor should he point out the constellations (?)

verses.sanskrit: प्रधानं पुरुषः कालो विष्णुर्ब्रह्मा महेश्वरः । सत्त्वं रजस्तमस्तिस्त्रः क्रमाद् व्याहृतयः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: pradhānaṃ puruṣaḥ kālo viṣṇurbrahmā maheśvaraḥ / sattvaṃ rajastamastistraḥ kramād vyāhṛtayaḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: An excellent Brahmana should not speak to a woman in her monthly course or to an unclean person. No one should prevent anything from being given to Devas, preceptors or Brahmanas.
verses.hindi: परकीयनिपानेषु न स्त्रायाद् वै कदाचन। पञ्चपिण्डान् समुद्धृत्य स्तायाद् वासम्भवे पुन:
verses.wordMeaning: An excellent Brahmana should not speak to a woman in her monthly course or to an unclean person. No one should prevent anything from being given to Devas, preceptors or Brahmanas.
verses.commentary: Sense: An excellent Brahmana should not speak to a woman in her monthly course or to an unclean person. No one should prevent anything from being given to Devas, preceptors or Brahmanas.

verses.sanskrit: ओङ्कारस्तत् परं ब्रह्म सावित्री स्यात् तदक्षरम् । एष मन्त्रो महायोगः सारात् सार उदाहृतः
verses.transliteration: oṅkārastat paraṃ brahma sāvitrī syāt tadakṣaram / eṣa mantro mahāyogaḥ sārāt sāra udāhṛtaḥ
verses.translation: No one should praise himself. One should avoid censuring others. One should scrupulously avoid blaspheming Devas and the Vedas.
verses.hindi: मृहैकया शिरः क्षाल्यं द्वाभ्यां नाभेस्तथोपरि। अधश्च तिसृभिः कायं पादौ षड्भिस्तथैव च मृत्तिका च समुद्दिष्टा त्वारद्रामलकमात्रिका। गोमयस्य प्रमाणं तत् तेनाङ्गं लेपयेत् तत:
verses.wordMeaning: No one should praise himself. One should avoid censuring others. One should scrupulously avoid blaspheming Devas and the Vedas.
verses.commentary: Sense: No one should praise himself. One should avoid censuring others. One should scrupulously avoid blaspheming Devas and the Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: यो ऽधीते ऽहन्यहन्येतां गायत्रीं वेदमातरम् । विज्ञायार्थं ब्रह्मचारी स याति परमां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: yo 'dhīte 'hanyahanyetāṃ gāyatrīṃ vedamātaram / vijñāyārthaṃ brahmacārī sa yāti paramāṃ gatim
verses.translation: O great sages, no atonement is seen ordained in the scriptures in the case of a Brahmana who censures Devas, sages, Brahmanas or the Vedas.
verses.hindi: भावपूतस्तदव्यक्तं ध्यायन् वै विष्णुमव्ययम्
verses.wordMeaning: O great sages, no atonement is seen ordained in the scriptures in the case of a Brahmana who censures Devas, sages, Brahmanas or the Vedas.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sages, no atonement is seen ordained in the scriptures in the case of a Brahmana who censures Devas, sages, Brahmanas or the Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: गायत्री वेदजननी गायत्री लोकपावनी । न गायत्र्याः परं जप्यमेतद् विज्ञाय मुच्यते
verses.transliteration: gāyatrī vedajananī gāyatrī lokapāvanī / na gāyatryāḥ paraṃ japyametad vijñāya mucyate
verses.translation: If a man loudly decries or censures the preceptors, Devas or the Vedas, he shall be cooked in the hell Raurava for hundreds of crores of Kalpas and even more.
verses.hindi: आपो नारायणोदभूतास्ता एवास्यायनं पुन: । तस्मान्नारायणं देवं स्नानकाले स्मरेद् बुधः प्रोच्य सोंकारमादित्यं त्रिर्निमजेज्जलाशये। आचान्तः पुनराचामेन्मन्त्रेणानेन मन्त्रवित्
verses.wordMeaning: If a man loudly decries or censures the preceptors, Devas or the Vedas, he shall be cooked in the hell Raurava for hundreds of crores of Kalpas and even more.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a man loudly decries or censures the preceptors, Devas or the Vedas, he shall be cooked in the hell Raurava for hundreds of crores of Kalpas and even more.

verses.sanskrit: श्रावणस्य तु मासस्य पौर्णमास्यां द्विजोत्तमाः । आषाढ्यां प्रोष्ठपद्यां वा वेदोपाकरणं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: śrāvaṇasya tu māsasya paurṇamāsyāṃ dvijottamāḥ / āṣāḍhyāṃ proṣṭhapadyāṃ vā vedopākaraṇaṃ smṛtam
verses.translation: If anyone rebukes or censures, it is better that one keeps quiet without saying anything by way of reply (and still better) he should close his ears and go away. He should not stop even to glance at them.
verses.hindi: त्वं यज्ञस्त्वं वषट्कार आपो ज्योती रसोऽमृतम्
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone rebukes or censures, it is better that one keeps quiet without saying anything by way of reply (and still better) he should close his ears and go away. He should not stop even to glance at them.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone rebukes or censures, it is better that one keeps quiet without saying anything by way of reply (and still better) he should close his ears and go away. He should not stop even to glance at them.

verses.sanskrit: उत्सृज्य ग्रामनगरं मासान् विप्रोर्ऽद्धपञ्चमान् । अधीयीत शुचौ देशे ब्रह्मचारी समाहितः
verses.transliteration: utsṛjya grāmanagaraṃ māsān vipror'ddhapañcamān / adhīyīta śucau deśe brahmacārī samāhitaḥ
verses.translation: A sensible man should guard the secrets of others and refrain from divulging them. He should never enter into argument with his own kinsmen.
verses.hindi: द्रुपदां वा त्रिरभ्यसेद् व्याहतिप्रणवान्विताम्। सावित्रीं वा जपेद् विद्वान् तथा चेवाघमर्षणम् तदनन्तर मध्याहू-समयमें स्नानके लिये मिट्टी, पुष्प, अक्षत, कुश, तिल तथा शुद्ध गोबर लाना चाहिए। नदियों (पुराण आदिमें प्रसिद्ध देव, ऋषिनिर्मित),
verses.wordMeaning: A sensible man should guard the secrets of others and refrain from divulging them. He should never enter into argument with his own kinsmen.
verses.commentary: Sense: A sensible man should guard the secrets of others and refrain from divulging them. He should never enter into argument with his own kinsmen.

verses.sanskrit: पुष्ये तु छन्दसां कुर्याद् बहिरुत्सर्जनं द्विजः । माघशुक्लस्य वा प्राप्ते पूर्वाह्ने प्रथमे ऽहनि
verses.transliteration: puṣye tu chandasāṃ kuryād bahirutsarjanaṃ dvijaḥ / māghaśuklasya vā prāpte pūrvāhne prathame 'hani
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas, no one should call a sinner either a sinner or a sinless person. (In either case) he will be equally guilty of sins such as that of uttering falsehood.
verses.hindi: तथा बावलियोंमें नित्य स्नान करना चाहिए। दूसरोंके तालाब आदिमें कभी भी स्नान नहीं करना चाहिए। (अन्यत्र स्नान) असम्भव होनेपर (तालाब आदियेंसे) मिट्टीके पाँच पिण्डोंको निकालकर स्नान करना चाहिए।
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahmanas, no one should call a sinner either a sinner or a sinless person. (In either case) he will be equally guilty of sins such as that of uttering falsehood.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmanas, no one should call a sinner either a sinner or a sinless person. (In either case) he will be equally guilty of sins such as that of uttering falsehood.

verses.sanskrit: छन्दांस्यूर्ध्वमथोभ्यस्येच्छुक्लपक्षेषु वै द्विजः । वेदाङ्गानि पुराणानि कृष्णपक्षे च मानवम्
verses.transliteration: chandāṃsyūrdhvamathobhyasyecchuklapakṣeṣu vai dvijaḥ / vedāṅgāni purāṇāni kṛṣṇapakṣe ca mānavam
verses.translation: The tears shed by those (innocent) persons who are falsely accused and so cry, destroy the sons and animals of those false accusers.
verses.hindi: मिट्टीसे एक बार सिर धोकर दो बार नाभिके ऊपर (-के अड्रोंको) धोना चाहिए। नीचेका शरीर तीन बार तथा छ: बार पाँवोंको धोना चाहिए। आँवलेके बराबर गीली मिट्टी लेनेका विधान है। गोबरका भी इतना हो प्रमाण हे। उससे अङ्गोंका लेपन करे॥ ५६--६०॥
verses.wordMeaning: The tears shed by those (innocent) persons who are falsely accused and so cry, destroy the sons and animals of those false accusers.
verses.commentary: Sense: The tears shed by those (innocent) persons who are falsely accused and so cry, destroy the sons and animals of those false accusers.

verses.sanskrit: इमान् नित्यमनध्यायानदीयानो विवर्जयेत् । अध्यापनं च कुर्वाणो ह्यभ्यस्यन्नपि यत्नतः
verses.transliteration: imān nityamanadhyāyānadīyāno vivarjayet / adhyāpanaṃ ca kurvāṇo hyabhyasyannapi yatnataḥ
verses.translation: A way of expiation is mentioned by good men in the cases of Brahmana slaughter, addiction to wine, stealing and committing adultery with the preceptor's wife. But there is no atonement for false accusation.
verses.hindi: (नदी आदिके) किनारे बैठकर तल्लिङ्गक मन्त्रोंके द्वारा (अड़ोंमें मृत्तिका आदिका यथाविधि) लेपकर विधिपूर्वक प्रक्षालन एवं आचमन करके सावधानी- पूर्वक स्नान करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: A way of expiation is mentioned by good men in the cases of Brahmana slaughter, addiction to wine, stealing and committing adultery with the preceptor's wife. But there is no atonement for false accusation.
verses.commentary: Sense: A way of expiation is mentioned by good men in the cases of Brahmana slaughter, addiction to wine, stealing and committing adultery with the preceptor's wife. But there is no atonement for false accusation.

verses.sanskrit: कर्णश्रवे ऽनिले रात्रौ दिवा पांशुसमूहने । विद्युत्स्तनितवर्षेषु महोल्कानां च संप्लवे । आकालिकमनध्यायमेतेष्वाह प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: karṇaśrave 'nile rātrau divā pāṃśusamūhane / vidyutstanitavarṣeṣu maholkānāṃ ca saṃplave / ākālikamanadhyāyameteṣvāha prajāpatiḥ
verses.translation: One should not see the rising sun or the moon with¬ out cause. He should not see them setting, reflected in the water, stationed in the middle of the sky or under eclipse.
verses.hindi: तल्लिङ्गक शुभ वरुण-सम्बन्धी मन्त्रोके द्वारा जलका अभिमन्त्रणकर पवित्र भावसे उन अव्यक्त अविनाशी विष्णुका ध्यान करे। 'जल 'की उत्पत्ति नारायणसे ही हुई है, पुन: वही जल उन (नारायण)-का अयन (निवास) हुआ, अतः स्नानके समय विद्वान्को चाहिए कि वह नारायणदेवका स्मरण करे। ओंकारके साथ आदित्यका उच्चारण करके जलके भीतर तीन बार डुबकी लगानी चाहिए। आचमन किये रहनेपर भी मन्त्रवेत्ताको पुनः
verses.wordMeaning: One should not see the rising sun or the moon with¬ out cause. He should not see them setting, reflected in the water, stationed in the middle of the sky or under eclipse.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not see the rising sun or the moon with¬ out cause. He should not see them setting, reflected in the water, stationed in the middle of the sky or under eclipse.

verses.sanskrit: एतानभ्युदितान् विद्याद् यदा प्रादुष्कृताग्निषु । तदा विद्यादनध्यायमनृतौ चाभ्रदर्शने
verses.transliteration: etānabhyuditān vidyād yadā prāduṣkṛtāgniṣu / tadā vidyādanadhyāyamanṛtau cābhradarśane
verses.translation: He should not see (the sun or the moon) covered with a cloth (i.e. screened by a cloth), nor reflected in a mirror. No one should even see a naked woman or a man.
verses.hindi: इस मन्त्रसे आचमन करना चाहिए-अन्तश्चरसि भूतेषु गुहायां विश्वतोमुख: । त्वं यज्ञस्त्वं वषट्कार आपो ज्योती रसोऽमृतम्॥ अर्थात् (हे भगवन्!) सभी ओर मुखवाले आप सभी प्राणियोंके भीतर (हृदयरूपी) गुहामें विचरण
verses.wordMeaning: He should not see (the sun or the moon) covered with a cloth (i.e. screened by a cloth), nor reflected in a mirror. No one should even see a naked woman or a man.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should not see (the sun or the moon) covered with a cloth (i.e. screened by a cloth), nor reflected in a mirror. No one should even see a naked woman or a man.

verses.sanskrit: निर्घाते भूमिचलने ज्योतिषां चोपसर्जने । एतानाकालिकान् विद्यादनध्यायानृतावपि
verses.transliteration: nirghāte bhūmicalane jyotiṣāṃ copasarjane / etānākālikān vidyādanadhyāyānṛtāvapi
verses.translation: No one should see anyone passing urine or discharg¬ ing faeces or a couple in the act of copulation. No sensible man shall glance at the planets, the sun, the moon etc. while he is unclean.
verses.hindi: करते हैं। आप ही यज्ञ हैं और आप ही वषट्कार, जल, ज्योति, रस तथा अमृतरूप हें अथवा विद्वान् व्यक्तिको तीन बार द्रुपदा (दो चरणवाली) या व्याहति अथवा प्रणवसे युक्त गायत्री और अघमर्षण-मन्त्रका जप करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: No one should see anyone passing urine or discharg¬ ing faeces or a couple in the act of copulation. No sensible man shall glance at the planets, the sun, the moon etc. while he is unclean.
verses.commentary: Sense: No one should see anyone passing urine or discharg¬ ing faeces or a couple in the act of copulation. No sensible man shall glance at the planets, the sun, the moon etc. while he is unclean.

verses.sanskrit: प्रादुष्कृतेष्वग्निषु तु विद्युत्स्तनितनिस्वने । सज्योतिः स्यादनध्यायः शेषरात्रौ यथा दिवा
verses.transliteration: prāduṣkṛteṣvagniṣu tu vidyutstanitanisvane / sajyotiḥ syādanadhyāyaḥ śeṣarātrau yathā divā
verses.translation: One should not glance at a fallen person (outcaste) a maimed person, a Candala or a Person defiled by ucchifta. If
verses.hindi: स्मार्तकर्मोमें वे मन्त्र गृह्यसूत्रानुसार विनियुक्त होते हैं, जिनमें स्मार्तकर्म-बोधक शब्द श्रुत हों। यह आवश्यक नहीं होता कि उन मन्त्रोमें स्मार्तकर्मका प्रतिपादन हो। इसीलिये स्मार्तकर्मके मन्त्र स्मार्तकर्मविपयक नहीं, किंतु स्मार्तकर्मलिङ्गक होते हैं। ' अक्षन्नमी०' मन्त्रमें “अक्षत' शब्द कथञ्चित् श्रुत होनेसे उसका अक्षत चढ़ानेमें विनियोग होता है, वह ' अक्षत' चढ़ाने-रूप कर्मका प्रतिपादक नहीं है, अतएव 'अक्षत'-विषयक नहीं है। मात्र अक्षतलिङ्गक है।
verses.wordMeaning: One should not glance at a fallen person (outcaste) a maimed person, a Candala or a Person defiled by ucchifta. If
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not glance at a fallen person (outcaste) a maimed person, a Candala or a Person defiled by ucchifta. If

verses.sanskrit: नित्यानध्याय एव स्याद् ग्रामेषु नगरेषु च । धर्मनैपुण्यकामानां पूतिगन्धे च नित्यशः
verses.transliteration: nityānadhyāya eva syād grāmeṣu nagareṣu ca / dharmanaipuṇyakāmānāṃ pūtigandhe ca nityaśaḥ
verses.translation: One should not touch a person who has touched a dead body. One should not look at the face of the angry pre¬ ceptor. One should not see one's reflection in oil or water; one should not touch one's wife during dinner or while her limbs are exposed due to untying of knot; one should not look at a mad and elated person.
verses.hindi: इदमापः प्र वहत व्याहतिभिस्तथैव च आवर्तयेद् वा प्रणवं देवं वा संस्मरेद्धरिम्
verses.wordMeaning: One should not touch a person who has touched a dead body. One should not look at the face of the angry pre¬ ceptor. One should not see one's reflection in oil or water; one should not touch one's wife during dinner or while her limbs are exposed due to untying of knot;…
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not touch a person who has touched a dead body. One should not look at the face of the angry pre¬ ceptor. One should not see one's reflection in oil or water; one should not touch one's wife during dinner or while her limbs are exposed due to untying of knot;…

verses.sanskrit: अन्तः शवगते ग्रामे वृषलस्य च सन्निधौ । अनध्यायो रुद्यमाने समवाये जनस्य च
verses.transliteration: antaḥ śavagate grāme vṛṣalasya ca sannidhau / anadhyāyo rudyamāne samavāye janasya ca
verses.translation: One should not touch a person who has touched a dead body. One should not look at the face of the angry pre¬ ceptor. One should not see one's reflection in oil or water; one should not touch one's wife during dinner or while her limbs are exposed due to untying of knot; one should not look at a mad and elated person.
verses.hindi: अन्तर्जले त्रिरावर्त्य सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते
verses.wordMeaning: One should not touch a person who has touched a dead body. One should not look at the face of the angry pre¬ ceptor. One should not see one's reflection in oil or water; one should not touch one's wife during dinner or while her limbs are exposed due to untying of knot;…
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not touch a person who has touched a dead body. One should not look at the face of the angry pre¬ ceptor. One should not see one's reflection in oil or water; one should not touch one's wife during dinner or while her limbs are exposed due to untying of knot;…

verses.sanskrit: उदके मध्यरात्रे च विण्मूत्रे च विसर्जने । उच्छिष्टः श्राद्धबुक् चैव मनसापि न चिन्तयेत्
verses.transliteration: udake madhyarātre ca viṇmūtre ca visarjane / ucchiṣṭaḥ śrāddhabuk caiva manasāpi na cintayet
verses.translation: One should not touch a person who has touched a dead body. One should not look at the face of the angry pre¬ ceptor. One should not see one's reflection in oil or water; one should not touch one's wife during dinner or while her limbs are exposed due to untying of knot; one should not look at a mad and elated person.
verses.hindi: यथाश्वमेधः क्रतुराट् सर्वपापापनोदनः । तथाघमर्षणं सूक्तं सर्वपापापनोदनम् प्रक्षिप्यालोकयेद् देवमुद्वयं तमसस्परि
verses.wordMeaning: One should not touch a person who has touched a dead body. One should not look at the face of the angry pre¬ ceptor. One should not see one's reflection in oil or water; one should not touch one's wife during dinner or while her limbs are exposed due to untying of knot;…
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not touch a person who has touched a dead body. One should not look at the face of the angry pre¬ ceptor. One should not see one's reflection in oil or water; one should not touch one's wife during dinner or while her limbs are exposed due to untying of knot;…

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिगृह्य द्विजो विद्वानेकोदिष्टस्य केतनम् । त्र्यहं न कीर्तयेद् ब्रह्म राज्ञो राहोश्च सूतके
verses.transliteration: pratigṛhya dvijo vidvānekodiṣṭasya ketanam / tryahaṃ na kīrtayed brahma rājño rāhośca sūtake
verses.translation: One should not touch a person who has touched a dead body. One should not look at the face of the angry pre¬ ceptor. One should not see one's reflection in oil or water; one should not touch one's wife during dinner or while her limbs are exposed due to untying of knot; one should not look at a mad and elated person.
verses.hindi: अन्यैश्च वैदिकैर्मन्त्रैः सौरैः पापप्रणाशनैः । सावित्रीं वै जपेत् पश्चाज्जपयज्ञः स वै स्मृतः
verses.wordMeaning: One should not touch a person who has touched a dead body. One should not look at the face of the angry pre¬ ceptor. One should not see one's reflection in oil or water; one should not touch one's wife during dinner or while her limbs are exposed due to untying of knot;…
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not touch a person who has touched a dead body. One should not look at the face of the angry pre¬ ceptor. One should not see one's reflection in oil or water; one should not touch one's wife during dinner or while her limbs are exposed due to untying of knot;…

verses.sanskrit: यावदेको ऽनुदिष्टस्य स्नेहो गन्धश्च तिष्ठति । विप्रस्य विदुषो देहे तावद् ब्रह्म न कीर्तयेत्
verses.transliteration: yāvadeko 'nudiṣṭasya sneho gandhaśca tiṣṭhati / viprasya viduṣo dehe tāvad brahma na kīrtayet
verses.translation: One should not touch a person who has touched a dead body. One should not look at the face of the angry pre¬ ceptor. One should not see one's reflection in oil or water; one should not touch one's wife during dinner or while her limbs are exposed due to untying of knot; one should not look at a mad and elated person.
verses.hindi: प्र वहत०' इन मन्त्रों और व्याहतियोंद्वारा मार्जन करना चाहिए। तदनन्तर ' आपो हि छ्ठा०' इत्यादि मन्त्रोसे उस जल (स्नानीय नदी आदिके जल)-का अभिमन्त्रण करके जलके भीतर डुबकी लगाकर तीन बार अघमर्षण- जप करे अथवा भगवान् विष्णुका स्मरण करे
verses.wordMeaning: One should not touch a person who has touched a dead body. One should not look at the face of the angry pre¬ ceptor. One should not see one's reflection in oil or water; one should not touch one's wife during dinner or while her limbs are exposed due to untying of knot;…
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not touch a person who has touched a dead body. One should not look at the face of the angry pre¬ ceptor. One should not see one's reflection in oil or water; one should not touch one's wife during dinner or while her limbs are exposed due to untying of knot;…

verses.sanskrit: शयानः प्रौढपादश्च कृत्वा चैवावसक्थिकाम् । नाधीयीतामिषं जग्ध्वा सूतकान्नाद्यमेव च
verses.transliteration: śayānaḥ prauḍhapādaśca kṛtvā caivāvasakthikām / nādhīyītāmiṣaṃ jagdhvā sūtakānnādyameva ca
verses.translation: One should not touch a person who has touched a dead body. One should not look at the face of the angry pre¬ ceptor. One should not see one's reflection in oil or water; one should not touch one's wife during dinner or while her limbs are exposed due to untying of knot; one should not look at a mad and elated person.
verses.hindi: यजुर्वेदमें 'द्रुषदादिव०' इस प्रकारसे जो मन्त्र प्रतिष्ठित है, उसका जलके भीतर तीन बार जप करनेसे सभी पापोंसे मुक्ति हो जाती है। मार्जन करनेके बाद हाथमें जल लेकर मन्त्र (ट्रुपदादिव०) जपपूर्वक उस
verses.wordMeaning: One should not touch a person who has touched a dead body. One should not look at the face of the angry pre¬ ceptor. One should not see one's reflection in oil or water; one should not touch one's wife during dinner or while her limbs are exposed due to untying of knot;…
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not touch a person who has touched a dead body. One should not look at the face of the angry pre¬ ceptor. One should not see one's reflection in oil or water; one should not touch one's wife during dinner or while her limbs are exposed due to untying of knot;…

verses.sanskrit: नीहारे बाणशब्दे च संध्ययोरुभयोरपि । अमावास्यां चतुर्दश्यां पौर्णमास्यष्टमीषु च
verses.transliteration: nīhāre bāṇaśabde ca saṃdhyayorubhayorapi / amāvāsyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ paurṇamāsyaṣṭamīṣu ca
verses.translation: One should not touch a person who has touched a dead body. One should not look at the face of the angry pre¬ ceptor. One should not see one's reflection in oil or water; one should not touch one's wife during dinner or while her limbs are exposed due to untying of knot; one should not look at a mad and elated person.
verses.hindi: जलको सिरपर रखनेसे (अघमर्षण करनेसे) सम्पूर्ण पापोंसे मुक्ति हो जाती है। जिस प्रकार अश्वमेध- यज्ञ समस्त यज्ञोंके राजाके समान है और समस्त पापोंको दूर करनेवाला है, उसी प्रकार अघमर्षणसूक्त' भी (सभी सूक्तोंका सम्राट् और) सभी पापोंको दूर करनेवाला है ॥ ७०--७२॥
verses.wordMeaning: One should not touch a person who has touched a dead body. One should not look at the face of the angry pre¬ ceptor. One should not see one's reflection in oil or water; one should not touch one's wife during dinner or while her limbs are exposed due to untying of knot;…
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not touch a person who has touched a dead body. One should not look at the face of the angry pre¬ ceptor. One should not see one's reflection in oil or water; one should not touch one's wife during dinner or while her limbs are exposed due to untying of knot;…

verses.sanskrit: उपाकर्मणि चोत्सर्गे त्रिरात्रं क्षपणं स्मृतम् । अष्टकासु त्वहोरात्रं ऋत्वन्त्यासु च रात्रिषु
verses.transliteration: upākarmaṇi cotsarge trirātraṃ kṣapaṇaṃ smṛtam / aṣṭakāsu tvahorātraṃ ṛtvantyāsu ca rātriṣu
verses.translation: One should not touch a person who has touched a dead body. One should not look at the face of the angry pre¬ ceptor. One should not see one's reflection in oil or water; one should not touch one's wife during dinner or while her limbs are exposed due to untying of knot; one should not look at a mad and elated person.
verses.hindi: इसके बाद सूर्योपस्थान करना चाहिए। (इसकी प्रक्रिया यह है-) पुष्पयुक्त अञ्जलि मस्तकसे लगाकर उस फूलको ऊपर (सूर्य)-की ओर उछालकर उन सूर्यका दर्शन करते हुए ' उद्वयं तमसस्परि', ' चित्रं",
verses.wordMeaning: One should not touch a person who has touched a dead body. One should not look at the face of the angry pre¬ ceptor. One should not see one's reflection in oil or water; one should not touch one's wife during dinner or while her limbs are exposed due to untying of knot;…
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not touch a person who has touched a dead body. One should not look at the face of the angry pre¬ ceptor. One should not see one's reflection in oil or water; one should not touch one's wife during dinner or while her limbs are exposed due to untying of knot;…

verses.sanskrit: मार्गशीर्षे तथा पौषे माघमासे तथैव च । तिस्त्रो ऽष्टकाः समाख्याता कृष्णपक्षेतु सूरिभिः
verses.transliteration: mārgaśīrṣe tathā pauṣe māghamāse tathaiva ca / tistro 'ṣṭakāḥ samākhyātā kṛṣṇapakṣetu sūribhiḥ
verses.translation: One should not touch a person who has touched a dead body. One should not look at the face of the angry pre¬ ceptor. One should not see one's reflection in oil or water; one should not touch one's wife during dinner or while her limbs are exposed due to untying of knot; one should not look at a mad and elated person.
verses.hindi: विशेष-रूपसे सावित्री-मन्त्र और सूर्य-सम्बन्धी अन्य भी पापको नष्ट करनेवाले वैदिक मन्त्रोंके जपके द्वारा सूर्यको प्रसन्न किया जाय, यही सूर्योपस्थान है। इसके अनन्तर गायत्रीमन्त्रका जप करना चाहिए। इस (गायत्रीजपको) ही जपयज्ञ कहा गया है
verses.wordMeaning: One should not touch a person who has touched a dead body. One should not look at the face of the angry pre¬ ceptor. One should not see one's reflection in oil or water; one should not touch one's wife during dinner or while her limbs are exposed due to untying of knot;…
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not touch a person who has touched a dead body. One should not look at the face of the angry pre¬ ceptor. One should not see one's reflection in oil or water; one should not touch one's wife during dinner or while her limbs are exposed due to untying of knot;…

verses.sanskrit: श्लेष्मातकस्य छायायां शाल्मलेर्मधुकस्य च । कदाचिदपि नाध्येयं कोविदारकपित्थयोः
verses.transliteration: śleṣmātakasya chāyāyāṃ śālmalermadhukasya ca / kadācidapi nādhyeyaṃ kovidārakapitthayoḥ

verses.translation: One should not touch a person who has touched a dead body. One should not look at the face of the angry pre¬ ceptor. One should not see one's reflection in oil or water; one should not touch one's wife during dinner or while her limbs are exposed due to untying of knot; one should not look at a mad and elated person.
verses.hindi: देवर्षीस्तर्पयेद् धीमानुदकाञ्जलिभिः पितृन् यज्ञोपवीती देवानां निवीती ऋषितर्पणे। प्राचीनावीती पित्र्ये तु स्वेन तीर्थन भावतः
verses.wordMeaning: One should not touch a person who has touched a dead body. One should not look at the face of the angry pre¬ ceptor. One should not see one's reflection in oil or water; one should not touch one's wife during dinner or while her limbs are exposed due to untying of knot;…
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not touch a person who has touched a dead body. One should not look at the face of the angry pre¬ ceptor. One should not see one's reflection in oil or water; one should not touch one's wife during dinner or while her limbs are exposed due to untying of knot;…

verses.sanskrit: एवमीश्वरसमर्पितान्तरो यो ऽनुतिष्ठति विधिं विधानवित् । मोहजालमपहाय सो ऽमृतो याति तत् पदमनामयं शिवम्
verses.transliteration: evamīśvarasamarpitāntaro yo 'nutiṣṭhati vidhiṃ vidhānavit / mohajālamapahāya so 'mṛto yāti tat padamanāmayaṃ śivam
verses.translation: One should not touch a person who has touched a dead body. One should not look at the face of the angry pre¬ ceptor. One should not see one's reflection in oil or water; one should not touch one's wife during dinner or while her limbs are exposed due to untying of knot; one should not look at a mad and elated person.
verses.hindi: स्वैर्मन्रैर्चयेद् देवान् पुष्पैः पत्रैरथाम्बुभिः
verses.wordMeaning: One should not touch a person who has touched a dead body. One should not look at the face of the angry pre¬ ceptor. One should not see one's reflection in oil or water; one should not touch one's wife during dinner or while her limbs are exposed due to untying of knot;…
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not touch a person who has touched a dead body. One should not look at the face of the angry pre¬ ceptor. One should not see one's reflection in oil or water; one should not touch one's wife during dinner or while her limbs are exposed due to untying of knot;…

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे चतुर्दशो ऽध्यायः व्यास उवाच वेदं वेदौ तथा वेदान् वेदान् वा चतुरो द्विजाः । अधीत्य चाधिगम्यार्थं ततः स्नायाद् द्विजोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge caturdaśo 'dhyāyaḥ vyāsa uvāca vedaṃ vedau tathā vedān vedān vā caturo dvijāḥ / adhītya cādhigamyārthaṃ tataḥ snāyād dvijottamaḥ
verses.translation: One should not take food along with one's wife. Nor should one look at one's own wife urinating, sneezing or yawning,, nor shall one see her cosily seated at ease.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्माणं शंकरं सूर्य तथैव मधुसूदनम्। अऱ्यांश्चाभिमतान् देवान् भक्त्या चाक्रोधनोऽत्वरः आपो वा देवताः सर्वास्तेन सम्यक् समर्चिताः
verses.wordMeaning: One should not take food along with one's wife. Nor should one look at one's own wife urinating, sneezing or yawning,, nor shall one see her cosily seated at ease.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not take food along with one's wife. Nor should one look at one's own wife urinating, sneezing or yawning,, nor shall one see her cosily seated at ease.

verses.sanskrit: गुरवे तु वरं दत्त्वा स्नायीत तदनुज्ञया । चीर्णव्रतो ऽथ युक्तात्मा सशक्तः स्नातुमर्हति
verses.transliteration: gurave tu varaṃ dattvā snāyīta tadanujñayā / cīrṇavrato 'tha yuktātmā saśaktaḥ snātumarhati
verses.translation: One should not look out one's own reflection in water; one should not jump from one bank to another; one should not jump across a deep pit; one should never tread over urine or stand on it.
verses.hindi: ध्यात्वा प्रणवपूर्वं वै हैवतानि समाहितः । नमस्कारेण पुष्पाणि विन्यसेद् वै पृथक् पृथक्
verses.wordMeaning: One should not look out one's own reflection in water; one should not jump from one bank to another; one should not jump across a deep pit; one should never tread over urine or stand on it.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not look out one's own reflection in water; one should not jump from one bank to another; one should not jump across a deep pit; one should never tread over urine or stand on it.

verses.sanskrit: वैणवीं धारयेद् यष्टिमन्तर्वासस्तथोत्तरम् । यज्ञोपवीतद्वितयं सोदकं च कमण्डलुम्
verses.transliteration: vaiṇavīṃ dhārayed yaṣṭimantarvāsastathottaram / yajñopavītadvitayaṃ sodakaṃ ca kamaṇḍalum
verses.translation: One should not impart intellect (i.e. topics of lore) to a Sudra. Nor shall these things be given to him viz.—The Kriara (rice cooked with gingelly seeds), the milk-pudding, curds; nor the leavings Ucchi}fa) ghee, honey, black-antelope hide or Havis (sacrificial offerings).
verses.hindi: न विष्ण्वाराधनात् पुण्यं विद्यते कर्म वैदिकम्। तस्मादनादिमध्यान्तं नित्यमाराधयेद्धरिम् बुद्विमान् (आस्तिक अधिकारी व्यक्ति)-को सव्य (बाँयें) हाथसे अन्वारब्ध (सम्बद्ध) दाहिने हाथसे अर्थात् दोनों हाथोंको अञ्जलिद्वारा जलसे देवताओं, ऋषियों एवं पितरोंका तर्पण करना चाहिए । यज्ञोपवीती?
verses.wordMeaning: One should not impart intellect (i.e. topics of lore) to a Sudra. Nor shall these things be given to him viz.—The Kriara (rice cooked with gingelly seeds), the milk-pudding, curds; nor the leavings Ucchi}fa) ghee, honey, black-antelope hide or Havis (sacrificial offerings).
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not impart intellect (i.e. topics of lore) to a Sudra. Nor shall these things be given to him viz.—The Kriara (rice cooked with gingelly seeds), the milk-pudding, curds; nor the leavings Ucchi}fa) ghee, honey, black-antelope hide or Havis (sacrificial offerings).

verses.sanskrit: छत्रं चोष्णीषममलं पादुके चाप्युपानहौ । रौक्मे च कुण्डले वेदं कृत्तकेशनखः शुचिः
verses.transliteration: chatraṃ coṣṇīṣamamalaṃ pāduke cāpyupānahau / raukme ca kuṇḍale vedaṃ kṛttakeśanakhaḥ śuciḥ
verses.translation: Instructions regarding observance of holy vows should not be given to a Sudra: a learned man should not expound Dharma unto him. No one should submit to anger and avoid hatred and passion.
verses.hindi: अर्थात् सव्य होकर देवताओंका, निवीती? होकर अर्थात् मालाकी तरह कण्ठमें यज्ञोपवीत धारणकर ऋषियोंका और प्राचीनावीती? अर्थात् अपसव्य होकर भक्तिभावसे (देवताओं, ऋषियों तथा पितरोंके) अपने-अपने तीर्थोंसे
verses.wordMeaning: Instructions regarding observance of holy vows should not be given to a Sudra: a learned man should not expound Dharma unto him. No one should submit to anger and avoid hatred and passion.
verses.commentary: Sense: Instructions regarding observance of holy vows should not be given to a Sudra: a learned man should not expound Dharma unto him. No one should submit to anger and avoid hatred and passion.

verses.sanskrit: स्वाध्याये नित्ययुक्तः स्याद् बहिर्माल्यं न धारयेत् । अन्यत्रकाञ्चनाद् विप्रोनरक्तां बिभृयात् स्त्रजम्
verses.transliteration: svādhyāye nityayuktaḥ syād bahirmālyaṃ na dhārayet / anyatrakāñcanād vipronaraktāṃ bibhṛyāt strajam
verses.translation: Covetousness and arrogance should be avoided. One should avoid ridiculing religious travels and scorning perfect knowledge. One should desist from haughtiness and delusion, fury and hatred.
verses.hindi: तर्पण करना चाहिए स्नानके वस्त्रको' निचोड़कर संयतवाणीसे युक्त होकर आचमन करके तत्तद् मन्त्रोंसे पत्र, पुष्प तथा जलके द्वारा देवताओंका पूजन करना चाहिए। क्रोध और शीघ्रताका सर्वथा परित्यागकर भक्तिपूर्वक ब्रह्मा,
verses.wordMeaning: Covetousness and arrogance should be avoided. One should avoid ridiculing religious travels and scorning perfect knowledge. One should desist from haughtiness and delusion, fury and hatred.
verses.commentary: Sense: Covetousness and arrogance should be avoided. One should avoid ridiculing religious travels and scorning perfect knowledge. One should desist from haughtiness and delusion, fury and hatred.

verses.sanskrit: शुक्लाम्बरधरो नित्यं सुगन्धः प्रियदर्शनः । न जीर्णमलवद्वासा भवेद् वै विभवे सति
verses.transliteration: śuklāmbaradharo nityaṃ sugandhaḥ priyadarśanaḥ / na jīrṇamalavadvāsā bhaved vai vibhave sati
verses.translation: One should not inflict pain on anyone: one may however beat his son and disciple. One should never serve the mean and the base nor should he serve sharp-witted persons.
verses.hindi: शंकर, सूर्य, विष्णु तथा अन्य जो भी अभीष्ट देवता हों, उनकी पूजा करनी चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: One should not inflict pain on anyone: one may however beat his son and disciple. One should never serve the mean and the base nor should he serve sharp-witted persons.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not inflict pain on anyone: one may however beat his son and disciple. One should never serve the mean and the base nor should he serve sharp-witted persons.

verses.sanskrit: न रक्तमुल्बणं चान्यधृतं वासो न कुण्डिकाम् । नोपानहौ स्त्रजं चाथ पादुके च प्रयोजयेत्
verses.transliteration: na raktamulbaṇaṃ cānyadhṛtaṃ vāso na kuṇḍikām / nopānahau strajaṃ cātha pāduke ca prayojayet
verses.translation: One should not dishonour oneself (the Atman); one should scrupulously avoid dejectedness, (or should try to conceal one's miserable condition), one should not fail to honour one who is not one's disciple (?), a learned man should not praise himself.
verses.hindi: पुरुषसूक्तके द्वारा पुष्प अर्पित करना चाहिए। अथवा जल सभी देवताओंका स्वरूप है, अतः उसके द्वारा पूजन करनेसे सभी देवताओंकी भलीभाति पूजा हो जाती है। एकाग्रमनसे प्रणवका उच्चारण कर देबताओंका ध्यान करना चाहिए। नमस्कारकर पृथक्- पृथक् देवोंपर पुष्प चढ़ाना चाहिए। विष्णुकी आराधनासे अधिक पुण्यप्रद और कोई वैदिक कर्म नहीं है। इसलिये आदि, मध्य और अन्तसे रहित विष्णुको नित्य
verses.wordMeaning: One should not dishonour oneself (the Atman); one should scrupulously avoid dejectedness, (or should try to conceal one's miserable condition), one should not fail to honour one who is not one's disciple (?), a learned man should not praise himself.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not dishonour oneself (the Atman); one should scrupulously avoid dejectedness, (or should try to conceal one's miserable condition), one should not fail to honour one who is not one's disciple (?), a learned man should not praise himself.

verses.sanskrit: उपवीतमलङ्कारं दर्भान् कृष्णाजिनानि च । नापसव्यं परीदध्याद् वासो न विकृतं वसेत्
verses.transliteration: upavītamalaṅkāraṃ darbhān kṛṣṇājināni ca / nāpasavyaṃ parīdadhyād vāso na vikṛtaṃ vaset
verses.translation: One should not scribble on the ground with the nails; one shall not cohabit (or lie) with a cow (?); one should not speak of (another river while bathing in one) river nor should he speak (in praise of) other mountains while resting on one mountain (?)
verses.hindi: आराधना करनी चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: One should not scribble on the ground with the nails; one shall not cohabit (or lie) with a cow (?); one should not speak of (another river while bathing in one) river nor should he speak (in praise of) other mountains while resting on one mountain (?)
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not scribble on the ground with the nails; one shall not cohabit (or lie) with a cow (?); one should not speak of (another river while bathing in one) river nor should he speak (in praise of) other mountains while resting on one mountain (?)

verses.sanskrit: आहरेद् विधिवद् दारान् सदृशानात्मनः शुभान् । रूपलक्षणसंयुक्तान् योनिदोषविवर्जितान्
verses.transliteration: āhared vidhivad dārān sadṛśānātmanaḥ śubhān / rūpalakṣaṇasaṃyuktān yonidoṣavivarjitān
verses.translation: One should not abandon a fellow traveller whether one stays with him overnight or not; one should not enter water in the nude state; nor should he walk over fire.
verses.hindi: 'तद्विष्णो:०  इस मन्त्रसे तथा पुरुषसूक्तसे श्रीविष्णुकी आराधना करनी चाहिए। चारों वेदोंमें भी इन दोनों ('तदविष्णोः०' एवं “पुरुष सूक्त') मन्त्रोंके सदृश अन्य कोई मन्त्र नहीं कहा गया है १-वाँयें कंधेके ऊपर रखते हुए दाहिने हाथ (दाहिनी भुजा)-के नीचे रखे हुए ब्रह्मसूत्र (जनेऊ)-को उपवीत या यज्ञोपवीत कहते हैं और इस प्रकार ब्रह्मसूत्र धारण करनेवालेको उपवीती या यज्ञोपवीती कहते हैं। २-मालाकी तरह कण्ठसे सीधे वक्षःस्थलकी ओर लम्बित ब्रह्मसूत्र (जनेऊ)-को निवीत कहते हैं और इस ब्रह्मसूत्र धारण
verses.wordMeaning: One should not abandon a fellow traveller whether one stays with him overnight or not; one should not enter water in the nude state; nor should he walk over fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not abandon a fellow traveller whether one stays with him overnight or not; one should not enter water in the nude state; nor should he walk over fire.

verses.sanskrit: अमातृगोत्रप्रभवामसमानर्षिगोत्रजाम् । आहरेद् ब्राह्मणो भार्यां शीलशौचसमन्विताम्
verses.transliteration: amātṛgotraprabhavāmasamānarṣigotrajām / āhared brāhmaṇo bhāryāṃ śīlaśaucasamanvitām
verses.translation: One should not anoint the limbs with the oil leftover after applying it over the head; one should not play with weapons or serpents; one should not touch (i.e. scrape) the private parts of one's body (with a weapon).
verses.hindi: करनेवालेको निवीती कहते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: One should not anoint the limbs with the oil leftover after applying it over the head; one should not play with weapons or serpents; one should not touch (i.e. scrape) the private parts of one's body (with a weapon).
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not anoint the limbs with the oil leftover after applying it over the head; one should not play with weapons or serpents; one should not touch (i.e. scrape) the private parts of one's body (with a weapon).

verses.sanskrit: ऋतुकालाभिगामी स्याद् यावत् पुत्रो ऽभिजायते । वर्जयेत् प्रतिषिद्धानि प्रयत्नेन दिनानि तु
verses.transliteration: ṛtukālābhigāmī syād yāvat putro 'bhijāyate / varjayet pratiṣiddhāni prayatnena dināni tu
verses.translation: One should not keep water (in tanks or rivers) with the leg or strike it with the hand; one should not fell down fruits by hurling bricks or other fruits at them.
verses.hindi: ३-दाहिने कंधेके ऊपर रखते हुए वायें हाथ (बायीं भुजा)-के नीचे रखे हुए ब्रह्मसूत्र (जनेऊ)-को प्राचीनावीत कहते हैं और इस प्रकार ब्रह्मसूत्र धारण करनेवालेको प्राचीनावीती कहते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: One should not keep water (in tanks or rivers) with the leg or strike it with the hand; one should not fell down fruits by hurling bricks or other fruits at them.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not keep water (in tanks or rivers) with the leg or strike it with the hand; one should not fell down fruits by hurling bricks or other fruits at them.

verses.sanskrit: षष्ठ्यष्टमीं पञ्चदशीं द्वादशीं च चतुर्दशीम् । ब्रह्मचारी भवेन्नित्यं तद्वज्जन्मत्रयाहनि
verses.transliteration: ṣaṣṭhyaṣṭamīṃ pañcadaśīṃ dvādaśīṃ ca caturdaśīm / brahmacārī bhavennityaṃ tadvajjanmatrayāhani
verses.translation: One should neither dance, nor sing, nor play on mu¬ sical instruments. One should not scratch one's head with all the fingers joined together.
verses.hindi: ४-देवताओंका तर्पण देवतीर्थ ( अँगुलियोंके अग्रभाग)-से, ऋषियों-मनुष्योंका तर्पण काय-तीर्थ (कनिछिका अँगुलिके मूल) - से और पितरोंका तर्पण पितृतीर्थ (अङ्गुष्ठ तथा तर्जनी अँगुलीके मूलों)-से करना चाहिए। ५-तर्पणके पूर्व स्नानके वस्त्रोंको सुखानेके लिये निचोड़ना नहीं चाहिए अन्यथा पितर निराश होकर चले जाते हैं। इसीलिये यहाँ
verses.wordMeaning: One should neither dance, nor sing, nor play on mu¬ sical instruments. One should not scratch one's head with all the fingers joined together.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should neither dance, nor sing, nor play on mu¬ sical instruments. One should not scratch one's head with all the fingers joined together.

verses.sanskrit: आदधीतावसथ्याग्निं जुहुयाज्जातवेदसम् । व्रतानि स्नातको नित्यं पावनानि च पालयेत्
verses.transliteration: ādadhītāvasathyāgniṃ juhuyājjātavedasam / vratāni snātako nityaṃ pāvanāni ca pālayet
verses.translation: One should not try to propitiate the deities with worldly hymns or medicine; one should not play with dice; one should not rush against others for assaulting them (?); one should not urinate or discharge faeces into water.
verses.hindi: तर्पणके अनन्तर स्नानके वस्त्रोंको निचोडनेकी बात कही गयी है। अथवा देवमीशानं भगवन्तं सनातनम्। आराधयेन्महादेवं भावपूतो महेश्वरम्
verses.wordMeaning: One should not try to propitiate the deities with worldly hymns or medicine; one should not play with dice; one should not rush against others for assaulting them (?); one should not urinate or discharge faeces into water.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not try to propitiate the deities with worldly hymns or medicine; one should not play with dice; one should not rush against others for assaulting them (?); one should not urinate or discharge faeces into water.

verses.sanskrit: वेदोदितं स्वकं कर्म नित्यं कुर्यादतन्द्रितः । अकुर्वाणः पतत्याशु नरकानतिभीषणान्
verses.transliteration: vedoditaṃ svakaṃ karma nityaṃ kuryādatandritaḥ / akurvāṇaḥ patatyāśu narakānatibhīṣaṇān
verses.translation: One should not cohabit when defiled by Ucchita; one should not bathe in the nude: one should not read or touch one's head, while walking.
verses.hindi: ईशानेनाथ वा रुद्रैस्त्र्य्बकेन समाहितः
verses.wordMeaning: One should not cohabit when defiled by Ucchita; one should not bathe in the nude: one should not read or touch one's head, while walking.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not cohabit when defiled by Ucchita; one should not bathe in the nude: one should not read or touch one's head, while walking.

verses.sanskrit: अब्यसेत् प्रयतो वेदं महायज्ञान् न हापयेत् । कुर्याद् गृह्याणि कर्माणि संध्योपासनमेव च
verses.transliteration: abyaset prayato vedaṃ mahāyajñān na hāpayet / kuryād gṛhyāṇi karmāṇi saṃdhyopāsanameva ca
verses.translation: One should not cut the hairs or nails by means of the teeth; one should not waken the sleeper. One should not bask in the early morning sun; one should avoid smoke arising from the dead body.
verses.hindi: उक्त्वा नमः शिवायेति मन्त्रेणानेन योजयेत् नमस्कुर्यान्महादेवं ऋतं सत्यमितीश्वरम्। निवेदयीत स्वात्मानं यो ब्रह्माणमितीश्वरम्
verses.wordMeaning: One should not cut the hairs or nails by means of the teeth; one should not waken the sleeper. One should not bask in the early morning sun; one should avoid smoke arising from the dead body.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not cut the hairs or nails by means of the teeth; one should not waken the sleeper. One should not bask in the early morning sun; one should avoid smoke arising from the dead body.

verses.sanskrit: सख्यं समाधैकैः कुर्यादुपेयादीश्वरं सदा । दैवतान्यपि गच्छेत कुर्याद् भार्याभिपोषणम्
verses.transliteration: sakhyaṃ samādhaikaiḥ kuryādupeyādīśvaraṃ sadā / daivatānyapi gaccheta kuryād bhāryābhipoṣaṇam
verses.translation: One should not sleep alone in an empty abode; one should not bring shoes by oneself (with the hands?). One should not spit without reason; one should not cross the river by means of the arms.
verses.hindi: प्रदक्षिणं द्विजः कुर्यात् पञ्च ब्रह्माणि वै जपन्। ध्यायीत देवमीशानं व्योममध्यगतं शिवम्
verses.wordMeaning: One should not sleep alone in an empty abode; one should not bring shoes by oneself (with the hands?). One should not spit without reason; one should not cross the river by means of the arms.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not sleep alone in an empty abode; one should not bring shoes by oneself (with the hands?). One should not spit without reason; one should not cross the river by means of the arms.

verses.sanskrit: न धर्मं ख्यापयेद् विद्वान् न पापं गूहयेदपि । कुर्वोतात्महितं नित्यं सर्वभूतानिकम्पकः
verses.transliteration: na dharmaṃ khyāpayed vidvān na pāpaṃ gūhayedapi / kurvotātmahitaṃ nityaṃ sarvabhūtānikampakaḥ
verses.translation: A learned man should not wash legs with the legs; one should not warm legs in the fire; one should not wash (his feet) in a bellmetal vessel.
verses.hindi: अथावलोकयेदर्क हंसः शुचिषदित्यृचा। कुर्यात् पञ्च महायज्ञान् गृहं गत्वा समाहितः देवयज्ञं पितृयज्ञं भूतयज्ञं तथैव च। मानुष्यं ब्रह्मयज्ञं च पञ्च यज्ञान् प्रचक्षते
verses.wordMeaning: A learned man should not wash legs with the legs; one should not warm legs in the fire; one should not wash (his feet) in a bellmetal vessel.
verses.commentary: Sense: A learned man should not wash legs with the legs; one should not warm legs in the fire; one should not wash (his feet) in a bellmetal vessel.

verses.sanskrit: वयसः कर्मणोर्ऽथस्य श्रुतस्याभिजनस्य च । वेषवाग्बुद्धिसारूप्यमाचरन् विचरेत् सदा
verses.transliteration: vayasaḥ karmaṇor'thasya śrutasyābhijanasya ca / veṣavāgbuddhisārūpyamācaran vicaret sadā
verses.translation: One should not extend his feet towards the idols of gods, the Brahmanas or the cow, the wind, the fire, the precep¬ tor, the Brahmins, the sun or the moon.
verses.hindi: यदि स्यात् तर्पणादर्वाक् ब्रह्मयज्ञः कृतो न हि। कृत्वा मनुष्ययज्ञं वै ततः स्वाध्यायमाचरेत्
verses.wordMeaning: One should not extend his feet towards the idols of gods, the Brahmanas or the cow, the wind, the fire, the precep¬ tor, the Brahmins, the sun or the moon.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not extend his feet towards the idols of gods, the Brahmanas or the cow, the wind, the fire, the precep¬ tor, the Brahmins, the sun or the moon.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुतिस्मृत्युदितः सम्यक् साधुभिर्यश्च सेवितः । तमाचारं निषेवेत नेहेतान्यत्र कर्हिचित्
verses.transliteration: śrutismṛtyuditaḥ samyak sādhubhiryaśca sevitaḥ / tamācāraṃ niṣeveta nehetānyatra karhicit
verses.translation: By no means should an unclean person go to bed, travel, study the Vedas, take food without bathing or set out from the house.
verses.hindi: अग्नेः पश्चिमतो देशे भूतयज्ञान्त एव वा। शालाग्रौ लौकिके वाग्नौ जले भूम्यामथापि वा । वैश्वदेवं ततः कुर्याद् देवयज्ञः स वै स्मृतः
verses.wordMeaning: By no means should an unclean person go to bed, travel, study the Vedas, take food without bathing or set out from the house.
verses.commentary: Sense: By no means should an unclean person go to bed, travel, study the Vedas, take food without bathing or set out from the house.

verses.sanskrit: येनास्य पितरो याता येन याताः पितामहाः । तेन यायात् सतां मार्गं तेन गच्छन् न रिष्यति
verses.transliteration: yenāsya pitaro yātā yena yātāḥ pitāmahāḥ / tena yāyāt satāṃ mārgaṃ tena gacchan na riṣyati
verses.translation: One should avoid the following during the two San- dhyds (dawn and dusk) as well as at midday:—sleeping, study of the Vedas, travelling, excrement, taking food and walking.
verses.hindi: यदि स्याल्लौकिके पक्वं ततोऽन्नं तत्र हूयते। शालाग्रौ तत्र देवान्नं विधिरेष सनातनः
verses.wordMeaning: One should avoid the following during the two San- dhyds (dawn and dusk) as well as at midday:—sleeping, study of the Vedas, travelling, excrement, taking food and walking.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should avoid the following during the two San- dhyds (dawn and dusk) as well as at midday:—sleeping, study of the Vedas, travelling, excrement, taking food and walking.

verses.sanskrit: नित्यं स्वाध्यायशीलः स्यान्नित्यं यज्ञोपवीतवान् । सत्यवादी जितक्रोधो ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते
verses.transliteration: nityaṃ svādhyāyaśīlaḥ syānnityaṃ yajñopavītavān / satyavādī jitakrodho brahmabhūyāya kalpate
verses.translation: A Brahmana defiled by Ucchita shall not touch cows, Brahmanas and the fire, with the hand, nor should he touch cooked rice or the divine idol with the foot.
verses.hindi: देवेभ्यस्तु हुतादन्नाच्छेषाद् भूतबलिं हरेत्। भूतयज्ञः स वै ज्ञेयो भूतिदः सर्वदेहिनाम् १०७॥ 'तद्विष्णोः०' इस मन्त्रके द्वारा तदात्मा और तन्मय होकर शान्तिपूर्वक अपनेको विशुद्ध तेज:- स्वरूप विष्णुमें निवेदित करना चाहिए। अथवा पवित्र भावनासे सनातन भगवान् ईशान महेश्वरदेव महादेवको
verses.wordMeaning: A Brahmana defiled by Ucchita shall not touch cows, Brahmanas and the fire, with the hand, nor should he touch cooked rice or the divine idol with the foot.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmana defiled by Ucchita shall not touch cows, Brahmanas and the fire, with the hand, nor should he touch cooked rice or the divine idol with the foot.

verses.sanskrit: संध्यास्नानपरो नित्यं ब्रह्मयज्ञुपरायणः । अनसूयी मृदुर्दान्तो गृहस्थः प्रेत्य वर्धते
verses.transliteration: saṃdhyāsnānaparo nityaṃ brahmayajñuparāyaṇaḥ / anasūyī mṛdurdānto gṛhasthaḥ pretya vardhate
verses.translation: No unclean person should circumambulate the fire: nor should he glorify the gods or the sages; one should not enter deep waters; one shall not hold fire on one side (?)
verses.hindi: आराधना करनी चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: No unclean person should circumambulate the fire: nor should he glorify the gods or the sages; one should not enter deep waters; one shall not hold fire on one side (?)
verses.commentary: Sense: No unclean person should circumambulate the fire: nor should he glorify the gods or the sages; one should not enter deep waters; one shall not hold fire on one side (?)

verses.sanskrit: वीतरागभयक्रोधो लोभमोहविवर्जितः । सावित्रीजाप्यनिरतः श्राद्धकृन्मुच्यते गृही
verses.transliteration: vītarāgabhayakrodho lobhamohavivarjitaḥ / sāvitrījāpyanirataḥ śrāddhakṛnmucyate gṛhī
verses.translation: One should not drink water by lifting it up with the left hand and nor shall he drink with the mouth directly; one shall not reply (when impure) without performing the Acamana rite; nor should one discharge semen virile into the water.
verses.hindi: आदिके द्वारा महेश्वरकी आराधना करनी चाहिए और जोड़ना चाहिए। तदनन्तर ऋत एवं सत्यस्वरूप ईश्वर महादेवको नमस्कार करना चाहिए और “यो ब्रह्माणं०"' इस मन्त्रके द्वारा अपनेको ईश्वरके लिये समर्पित करे। द्विजको पाँच ब्रह्म (शिवके पाँच नामों )-का जप करते
verses.wordMeaning: One should not drink water by lifting it up with the left hand and nor shall he drink with the mouth directly; one shall not reply (when impure) without performing the Acamana rite; nor should one discharge semen virile into the water.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not drink water by lifting it up with the left hand and nor shall he drink with the mouth directly; one shall not reply (when impure) without performing the Acamana rite; nor should one discharge semen virile into the water.

verses.sanskrit: मातापित्रोर्हिते युक्तो गोब्राह्मणहिते रतः । दान्तो यज्वा देवभक्तो ब्रह्मलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: mātāpitrorhite yukto gobrāhmaṇahite rataḥ / dānto yajvā devabhakto brahmaloke mahīyate
verses.translation: One should not cast into water any other thing sme¬ ared with Amedhya (filth, rubbish), blood or poisons. One should not cross a river; one should not indulge in sexual intercourse in water.
verses.hindi: हुए प्रदक्षिणा करनी चाहिए और आकाशके मध्य स्थित ईशानदेव शिवका ध्यान करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: One should not cast into water any other thing sme¬ ared with Amedhya (filth, rubbish), blood or poisons. One should not cross a river; one should not indulge in sexual intercourse in water.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not cast into water any other thing sme¬ ared with Amedhya (filth, rubbish), blood or poisons. One should not cross a river; one should not indulge in sexual intercourse in water.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिवर्गसेवी सततं देवतानां च पूजनम् । कुर्यादहरहर्नित्यं नमस्येत् प्रयतः सुरान्
verses.transliteration: trivargasevī satataṃ devatānāṃ ca pūjanam / kuryādaharaharnityaṃ namasyet prayataḥ surān
verses.translation: One should not chop off the trees in a monastery; one should not spit into water; one should not tread on bone, ashes, skulls, hair, thorn, burning charcoal or dry balls of cowdung.
verses.hindi: इसके अनन्तर 'हंसः शुचिषद्०' इस ऋचासे सूर्यका दर्शन करे और घर जाकर ध्यानपूर्वक पञ्चयज्ञोंको करे। देवयज्ञ, पितृयज्ञ, भूतयज्ञ, मनुष्ययज्ञ तथा ब्रह्मयज्ञ- ये पाँच (महा-) यज्ञ कहे गये हैं यदि तर्पणसे पहले ब्रह्मयज्ञ न किया हो तो मनुष्ययज्ञ करनेके बाद स्वाध्याय (ब्रह्मयज्ञ) करना चाहिए अथवा भूतयज्ञके अन्तमें एकाग्रचित्त होकर हाथमें कुश लेकर अग्निके पश्चिमकी दिशामें कुशपुंजपर
verses.wordMeaning: One should not chop off the trees in a monastery; one should not spit into water; one should not tread on bone, ashes, skulls, hair, thorn, burning charcoal or dry balls of cowdung.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not chop off the trees in a monastery; one should not spit into water; one should not tread on bone, ashes, skulls, hair, thorn, burning charcoal or dry balls of cowdung.

verses.sanskrit: विभागशीलः सततं क्षमायुक्तो दयालुकः । गृहस्थस्तु समाख्यातो न गृहेण गृही भवेत्
verses.transliteration: vibhāgaśīlaḥ satataṃ kṣamāyukto dayālukaḥ / gṛhasthastu samākhyāto na gṛheṇa gṛhī bhavet
verses.translation: No sensible man should cross the burning fire, nor should he keep it anywhere beneath; No sensible man should kick it with the leg nor blow it with the mouth.
verses.hindi: बैठकर यज्ञशालाकी अग्नि, लौकिकाग्रि अथवा जलमें या भूमिपर वैश्वदेव करना चाहिए । यह देवयज्ञ कहलाता है। यदि लौकिकाग्निमें अन्न पकाया गया हो तो उसीमें हवन किया जाता है और यदि शालाकी अग्निमें अन
verses.wordMeaning: No sensible man should cross the burning fire, nor should he keep it anywhere beneath; No sensible man should kick it with the leg nor blow it with the mouth.
verses.commentary: Sense: No sensible man should cross the burning fire, nor should he keep it anywhere beneath; No sensible man should kick it with the leg nor blow it with the mouth.

verses.sanskrit: क्षमा दया च विज्ञानं सत्यं चैव दमः शमः । अध्यात्मनिरतं ज्ञानमेतद् ब्राह्मणलक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: kṣamā dayā ca vijñānaṃ satyaṃ caiva damaḥ śamaḥ / adhyātmanirataṃ jñānametad brāhmaṇalakṣaṇam
verses.translation: One should not descend into the well; an unclean person should never look into a well; one should not throw fire into fire, nor extinguish it with water.
verses.hindi: तैयार किया गया हो तो शालाग्निमें ही वैश्वदेव होम करना चाहिए। यही सनातन विधि है। वैश्वदेव होमके पश्चात् बचे हुए अन्नद्वारा भूतबलिकर्म करना चाहिए। इसे भूतयज्ञ जानना चाहिए। यह सर्वप्राणियोंको ऐश्वर्य प्रदान करता है। द्विजो्तमको (घरके बाहर) भूमिपर कुत्ता, चाण्डाल, पतित आदि तथा पक्षियोंको अनकी बलि देनी चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: One should not descend into the well; an unclean person should never look into a well; one should not throw fire into fire, nor extinguish it with water.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not descend into the well; an unclean person should never look into a well; one should not throw fire into fire, nor extinguish it with water.

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मान्न प्रमाद्येत विशेषेण द्विजोत्तमः । यथाशक्तिं चरन् कर्म निन्दितानि विवर्जयेत्
verses.transliteration: etasmānna pramādyeta viśeṣeṇa dvijottamaḥ / yathāśaktiṃ caran karma ninditāni vivarjayet
verses.translation: No one should himself tell others about the distress or death of a friend; one should not utilise for sale any article or merchandise which is unsaleable (due to its quality).
verses.hindi: १-यो ब्रह्माणं विदधाति पूर्व यो वै वेदांश्च प्रहिणोति तस्मै। तशह देवमात्मबुद्धिप्रकाशं मुमुक्षुर्वै शरणमहं प्रपच्चे॥
verses.wordMeaning: No one should himself tell others about the distress or death of a friend; one should not utilise for sale any article or merchandise which is unsaleable (due to its quality).
verses.commentary: Sense: No one should himself tell others about the distress or death of a friend; one should not utilise for sale any article or merchandise which is unsaleable (due to its quality).

verses.sanskrit: विधूय मोहकलिलं लब्ध्वा योगमनुत्तमम् । गृहस्थो मुच्यते बन्धात् नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.transliteration: vidhūya mohakalilaṃ labdhvā yogamanuttamam / gṛhastho mucyate bandhāt nātra kāryā vicāraṇā
verses.translation: No sensible man, if unclean, should kindle fire by means of wind blown from the mouth; He should plough (i.e. transgress*) a land in a holy centre, near water or on the border (of a village?).
verses.hindi: २-ईशान:  सर्वविद्यानाम् ईश्वरः  सर्वभूतानाम् । ब्रह्माधिपतिः? ब्रह्मणोऽधिपतिः ब्रह्मा“ शिवो मे अस्तु सदा शिवोम्॥ भूतयज्ञस्त्वयं नित्यं सायं प्रातर्विधीयते
verses.wordMeaning: No sensible man, if unclean, should kindle fire by means of wind blown from the mouth; He should plough (i.e. transgress*) a land in a holy centre, near water or on the border (of a village?).
verses.commentary: Sense: No sensible man, if unclean, should kindle fire by means of wind blown from the mouth; He should plough (i.e. transgress*) a land in a holy centre, near water or on the border (of a village?).

verses.sanskrit: विगर्हातिक्रमाक्षेपहिंसाबन्धवधात्मनाम् । अन्यमन्युसमुत्थानां दोषाणां मर्षणं क्षमा
verses.transliteration: vigarhātikramākṣepahiṃsābandhavadhātmanām / anyamanyusamutthānāṃ doṣāṇāṃ marṣaṇaṃ kṣamā
verses.translation: One shall not break an earlier agreement accom¬ panied by a promise; no one should rouse up animals, serpents or birds (?)
verses.hindi: नित्यश्राद्धं तदुद्दिष्टं पितृयज्ञो गतिप्रदः
verses.wordMeaning: One shall not break an earlier agreement accom¬ panied by a promise; no one should rouse up animals, serpents or birds (?)
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall not break an earlier agreement accom¬ panied by a promise; no one should rouse up animals, serpents or birds (?)

verses.sanskrit: स्वदुः खेष्विव कारुण्यं परदुः खेषु सौहृदात् । दयेति मुनयः प्राहुः साक्षाद् धर्मस्य साधनम्
verses.transliteration: svaduḥ kheṣviva kāruṇyaṃ paraduḥ kheṣu sauhṛdāt / dayeti munayaḥ prāhuḥ sākṣād dharmasya sādhanam
verses.translation: One should not inconvenience others through water¬ sheds etc., one should not cause the artisans etc. to do great jobs and then forsake them. One should keep the doors of the house shut in the morning and in the evening to prevent the beggars.
verses.hindi: मनोवाक्कर्मभिः शान्तमागतं स्वगृहं ततः हन्तकारमधाग्रं वा भिक्षां वा शक्तितो द्विज: । दद्यादतिथये नित्यं बुध्येत परमेश्वरम्

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्दशानां विद्यानां धारणं हि यतार्थतः । विज्ञानमिति तद् विद्याद् येन धर्मो विवर्धते
verses.transliteration: caturdaśānāṃ vidyānāṃ dhāraṇaṃ hi yatārthataḥ / vijñānamiti tad vidyād yena dharmo vivardhate
verses.translation: One should not inconvenience others through water¬ sheds etc., one should not cause the artisans etc. to do great jobs and then forsake them. One should keep the doors of the house shut in the morning and in the evening to prevent the beggars.
verses.hindi: पुष्कलं हन्तकारं तु तच्यतुर्गुणमुच्यते
verses.wordMeaning: One should not inconvenience others through water¬ sheds etc., one should not cause the artisans etc. to do great jobs and then forsake them. One should keep the doors of the house shut in the morning and in the evening to prevent the beggars.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not inconvenience others through water¬ sheds etc., one should not cause the artisans etc. to do great jobs and then forsake them. One should keep the doors of the house shut in the morning and in the evening to prevent the beggars.

verses.sanskrit: अधीत्य विधिवद् विद्यामर्थं चैवोपलभ्य तु । धर्मकार्यान्निवृत्तश्चेन्न तद् विज्ञानमिष्यते
verses.transliteration: adhītya vidhivad vidyāmarthaṃ caivopalabhya tu / dharmakāryānnivṛttaścenna tad vijñānamiṣyate
verses.translation: One should not inconvenience others through water¬ sheds etc., one should not cause the artisans etc. to do great jobs and then forsake them. One should keep the doors of the house shut in the morning and in the evening to prevent the beggars.
verses.hindi: गोदोहमात्रं कालं वै प्रतीक्ष्यो ह्यतिथिः स्वयम्। अभ्यागतान् यथाशक्ति पूजयेदतिथिं यथा भिक्षां वै भिक्षवे दद्याद् विधिवद् ब्रह्मचारिणे । दद्यादन्नं यथाशक्ति त्वर्थिभ्यो लोभवर्जितः
verses.wordMeaning: One should not inconvenience others through water¬ sheds etc., one should not cause the artisans etc. to do great jobs and then forsake them. One should keep the doors of the house shut in the morning and in the evening to prevent the beggars.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not inconvenience others through water¬ sheds etc., one should not cause the artisans etc. to do great jobs and then forsake them. One should keep the doors of the house shut in the morning and in the evening to prevent the beggars.

verses.sanskrit: सत्येन लोकाञ्जयति सत्यं तत्परमं पदम् । यथाभूतप्रवाद् तु सत्यमाहुर्मनीषिणः
verses.transliteration: satyena lokāñjayati satyaṃ tatparamaṃ padam / yathābhūtapravād tu satyamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ
verses.translation: One should not inconvenience others through water¬ sheds etc., one should not cause the artisans etc. to do great jobs and then forsake them. One should keep the doors of the house shut in the morning and in the evening to prevent the beggars.
verses.hindi: अकृत्वा तु द्विजः पञ्च महायज्ञान् द्विजोत्तमाः । भुञ्जीत चेत् स मूढात्मा तिर्यग्योनिं स गच्छति
verses.wordMeaning: One should not inconvenience others through water¬ sheds etc., one should not cause the artisans etc. to do great jobs and then forsake them. One should keep the doors of the house shut in the morning and in the evening to prevent the beggars.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not inconvenience others through water¬ sheds etc., one should not cause the artisans etc. to do great jobs and then forsake them. One should keep the doors of the house shut in the morning and in the evening to prevent the beggars.

verses.sanskrit: दमः शरीरोपरमः शमः प्रज्ञाप्रिसादजः । अध्यात्ममक्षरं विद्याद् यत्र गत्वा न शोचति
verses.transliteration: damaḥ śarīroparamaḥ śamaḥ prajñāprisādajaḥ / adhyātmamakṣaraṃ vidyād yatra gatvā na śocati
verses.translation: One should not inconvenience others through water¬ sheds etc., one should not cause the artisans etc. to do great jobs and then forsake them. One should keep the doors of the house shut in the morning and in the evening to prevent the beggars.
verses.hindi: वेदाभ्यासोऽन्वहं शक्त्या महायज्ञक्रिया क्षमा। नाशयत्याशु पापानि देवानामर्चनं तथा यो मोहादथवालस्यादकृत्वा देवतार्चनम्। भुङ्क्ते स याति नरकान् शूकरेष्वभिजायते
verses.wordMeaning: One should not inconvenience others through water¬ sheds etc., one should not cause the artisans etc. to do great jobs and then forsake them. One should keep the doors of the house shut in the morning and in the evening to prevent the beggars.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not inconvenience others through water¬ sheds etc., one should not cause the artisans etc. to do great jobs and then forsake them. One should keep the doors of the house shut in the morning and in the evening to prevent the beggars.

verses.sanskrit: यया स देवो भगवान् विद्यया वेद्यते परः । साक्षाद् देवो महादेवस्तज्ज्ञानमिति कीर्तितम्
verses.transliteration: yayā sa devo bhagavān vidyayā vedyate paraḥ / sākṣād devo mahādevastajjñānamiti kīrtitam
verses.translation: One should not inconvenience others through water¬ sheds etc., one should not cause the artisans etc. to do great jobs and then forsake them. One should keep the doors of the house shut in the morning and in the evening to prevent the beggars.
verses.hindi: पत्नी सायंकाल पके हुए अन्नको बलि बिना मन्त्रके प्रदान करे, यही भूतयज्ञ है, जो नित्य सायंकाल और प्रातःकाल किया जाता है। पितरोंके उद्देश्यसे एक श्रेष्ठ ब्राह्मणको प्रतिदिन भोजन कराना चाहिए, इसे नित्य-
verses.wordMeaning: One should not inconvenience others through water¬ sheds etc., one should not cause the artisans etc. to do great jobs and then forsake them. One should keep the doors of the house shut in the morning and in the evening to prevent the beggars.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not inconvenience others through water¬ sheds etc., one should not cause the artisans etc. to do great jobs and then forsake them. One should keep the doors of the house shut in the morning and in the evening to prevent the beggars.

verses.sanskrit: तन्निष्ठस्तत्परो विद्वान्नित्यमक्रोधनः शुचिः । महायज्ञपरो विप्रो लभते तदनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: tanniṣṭhastatparo vidvānnityamakrodhanaḥ śuciḥ / mahāyajñaparo vipro labhate tadanuttamam
verses.translation: One should not inconvenience others through water¬ sheds etc., one should not cause the artisans etc. to do great jobs and then forsake them. One should keep the doors of the house shut in the morning and in the evening to prevent the beggars.
verses.hindi: श्राद्ध कहा गया है। यह पितृयज्ञ (उत्तम) गति प्रदान करनेवाला है अथवा यथाशक्ति कुछ अन्न निकालकर वेदके तत्त्वार्थको जाननेवाले ब्राह्मणको समाहित होकर देना चाहिए। तदनन्तर अपने घर आये हुए शान्त द्विज अतिथिका मन, वाणी तथा कर्मके द्वारा नित्य नमस्कार,
verses.wordMeaning: One should not inconvenience others through water¬ sheds etc., one should not cause the artisans etc. to do great jobs and then forsake them. One should keep the doors of the house shut in the morning and in the evening to prevent the beggars.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not inconvenience others through water¬ sheds etc., one should not cause the artisans etc. to do great jobs and then forsake them. One should keep the doors of the house shut in the morning and in the evening to prevent the beggars.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मस्यायतनं यत्नाच्छरीरं परिपालयेत् । न हि देहं विना रुद्रः पुरुषैर्विद्यते परः
verses.transliteration: dharmasyāyatanaṃ yatnāccharīraṃ paripālayet / na hi dehaṃ vinā rudraḥ puruṣairvidyate paraḥ
verses.translation: One should not inconvenience others through water¬ sheds etc., one should not cause the artisans etc. to do great jobs and then forsake them. One should keep the doors of the house shut in the morning and in the evening to prevent the beggars.
verses.hindi: पूजन एवं अर्चन करना चाहिए। द्विज अतिथिको यथाशक्ति नित्य ' हन्तकार’, 'अग्र' अथवा भिक्षा प्रदान करे और उसे परमेश्वरका रूप समझे॥ १११--११३॥
verses.wordMeaning: One should not inconvenience others through water¬ sheds etc., one should not cause the artisans etc. to do great jobs and then forsake them. One should keep the doors of the house shut in the morning and in the evening to prevent the beggars.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not inconvenience others through water¬ sheds etc., one should not cause the artisans etc. to do great jobs and then forsake them. One should keep the doors of the house shut in the morning and in the evening to prevent the beggars.

verses.sanskrit: नित्यधर्मार्थकामेषु युज्येत नियतो द्विजः । न धर्मवर्जितं काममर्थं वा मनसा स्मरेत्
verses.transliteration: nityadharmārthakāmeṣu yujyeta niyato dvijaḥ / na dharmavarjitaṃ kāmamarthaṃ vā manasā smaret
verses.translation: One should not inconvenience others through water¬ sheds etc., one should not cause the artisans etc. to do great jobs and then forsake them. One should keep the doors of the house shut in the morning and in the evening to prevent the beggars.
verses.hindi: ग्रासमात्र (अन्न)-को भिक्षा और उसके चौगुने अर्थात् चार ग्रासके बराबर अन्नको अग्र कहा जाता है। अग्रके चौगुने अर्थात् सोलह ग्रासके बराबर पर्याप्त अन्नको हन्तकार कहा जाता है। गोदोहनकाल- पर्यन्त अतिथिकी स्वयं प्रतीक्षा करनी चाहिए। जिस प्रकार अतिथिकी पूजा की जाती है, उसी प्रकार अभ्यागतोंकी' भी यथाशक्ति पूजा (सेवा) करनी चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: One should not inconvenience others through water¬ sheds etc., one should not cause the artisans etc. to do great jobs and then forsake them. One should keep the doors of the house shut in the morning and in the evening to prevent the beggars.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not inconvenience others through water¬ sheds etc., one should not cause the artisans etc. to do great jobs and then forsake them. One should keep the doors of the house shut in the morning and in the evening to prevent the beggars.

verses.sanskrit: सीदन्नपि हि धर्मेण न त्वधर्मं समाचरेत् । धर्मो हि भगवान् देवो गतिः सर्वेषु जन्तुषु
verses.transliteration: sīdannapi hi dharmeṇa na tvadharmaṃ samācaret / dharmo hi bhagavān devo gatiḥ sarveṣu jantuṣu
verses.translation: One should not inconvenience others through water¬ sheds etc., one should not cause the artisans etc. to do great jobs and then forsake them. One should keep the doors of the house shut in the morning and in the evening to prevent the beggars.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मचारी भिक्षुकको विधिवत् भिक्षा प्रदान करे। लोभरहित होकर याचकोंको यथाशक्ति अन्न प्रदान करे, इन सभीके न मिलनेपर गौओंको अन्न निवेदित करे। तदनन्तर भोजनको निन्दा न करते हुए बन्धुओंके साथ
verses.wordMeaning: One should not inconvenience others through water¬ sheds etc., one should not cause the artisans etc. to do great jobs and then forsake them. One should keep the doors of the house shut in the morning and in the evening to prevent the beggars.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not inconvenience others through water¬ sheds etc., one should not cause the artisans etc. to do great jobs and then forsake them. One should keep the doors of the house shut in the morning and in the evening to prevent the beggars.

verses.sanskrit: भूतानां प्रियकारी स्यात् न परद्रोहकर्मधीः । न वेददेवतानिन्दां कुर्यात् तैश्च न संवसेत्
verses.transliteration: bhūtānāṃ priyakārī syāt na paradrohakarmadhīḥ / na vedadevatānindāṃ kuryāt taiśca na saṃvaset
verses.translation: One should not inconvenience others through water¬ sheds etc., one should not cause the artisans etc. to do great jobs and then forsake them. One should keep the doors of the house shut in the morning and in the evening to prevent the beggars.
verses.hindi: मौन होकर भोजन करे द्विजोत्तमो! यदि द्विज पञ्च महायज्ञोंको बिना किये ही भोजन करता है तो वह मूढात्मा तिर्यग्योनि प्राप्त करता है। प्रतिदिन यथाशक्ति किया गया वेदोंका अभ्यास, महायज्ञ कर्म, क्षमाका भाव और देवताओंका
verses.wordMeaning: One should not inconvenience others through water¬ sheds etc., one should not cause the artisans etc. to do great jobs and then forsake them. One should keep the doors of the house shut in the morning and in the evening to prevent the beggars.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not inconvenience others through water¬ sheds etc., one should not cause the artisans etc. to do great jobs and then forsake them. One should keep the doors of the house shut in the morning and in the evening to prevent the beggars.

verses.sanskrit: यस्त्विमं नियतं विप्रो धर्माध्यायं पठेच्छुचिः । अध्यापयेत् श्रावयेद् वा ब्रह्मलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: yastvimaṃ niyataṃ vipro dharmādhyāyaṃ paṭhecchuciḥ / adhyāpayet śrāvayed vā brahmaloke mahīyate
verses.translation: One should not inconvenience others through water¬ sheds etc., one should not cause the artisans etc. to do great jobs and then forsake them. One should keep the doors of the house shut in the morning and in the evening to prevent the beggars.
verses.hindi: पूजन-ये शीघ्र ही पापोंका नाश करते हैं। जो मोहपूर्वक अथवा आलस्यसे देवताओंकी पूजा किये बिना भोजन करता है, वह नरकोंको प्राप्त करता है और बादमें शूकरकी योनिमें जन्म लेता है
verses.wordMeaning: One should not inconvenience others through water¬ sheds etc., one should not cause the artisans etc. to do great jobs and then forsake them. One should keep the doors of the house shut in the morning and in the evening to prevent the beggars.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not inconvenience others through water¬ sheds etc., one should not cause the artisans etc. to do great jobs and then forsake them. One should keep the doors of the house shut in the morning and in the evening to prevent the beggars.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे पञ्चदशो ऽध्यायः व्यास उवाच न हिंस्यात् सर्वभूतानिनानृतं वावदेत् क्वचित् । नाहितं नाप्रियं वाक्यं न स्तेनः स्याद् कदाचन
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge pañcadaśo 'dhyāyaḥ vyāsa uvāca na hiṃsyāt sarvabhūtāninānṛtaṃ vāvadet kvacit / nāhitaṃ nāpriyaṃ vākyaṃ na stenaḥ syād kadācana
verses.translation: One should avoid outside (over his dress) garland, alien scents, dining in the company of one's wife, argument with quarrels and entry by the bad way?
verses.hindi: १-अज्ञातपूर्वगृहागत व्यक्ति (अकस्मात् घरपर आ जानेवाला) अतिथि है। ( श्रीधरस्वामी) २-ज्ञातपूर्वगृहागत व्यक्ति (जिसका पहलेसे घरपर आना ज्ञात है ऐसा व्यक्ति) अभ्यागत है। तस्मात् सर्वप्रयलेन कृत्वा कर्माणि वै द्विजाः ।
verses.wordMeaning: One should avoid outside (over his dress) garland, alien scents, dining in the company of one's wife, argument with quarrels and entry by the bad way?
verses.commentary: Sense: One should avoid outside (over his dress) garland, alien scents, dining in the company of one's wife, argument with quarrels and entry by the bad way?

verses.sanskrit: तृणं वा यदि वा शाकं मृदं वा जलमेव वा । परस्यापहरञ्जन्तुर्नरकं प्रतिपद्यते
verses.transliteration: tṛṇaṃ vā yadi vā śākaṃ mṛdaṃ vā jalameva vā / parasyāpaharañjanturnarakaṃ pratipadyate
verses.translation: A Brahmana should not stand up while eating. A sensible man should not spend much time prattling and laugh¬ ing. One should not touch the fire with the hand; one should not stay too long under water.
verses.hindi: द्विजो! इसलिये सभी प्रकारके प्रयक्षोंके द्वारा
verses.wordMeaning: A Brahmana should not stand up while eating. A sensible man should not spend much time prattling and laugh¬ ing. One should not touch the fire with the hand; one should not stay too long under water.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmana should not stand up while eating. A sensible man should not spend much time prattling and laugh¬ ing. One should not touch the fire with the hand; one should not stay too long under water.

verses.sanskrit: न राज्ञः प्रतिगृह्णीयान्न शूद्रपतितादपि । न चान्यस्मादशक्तश्च निन्दितान् वर्जयेद् बुधः
verses.transliteration: na rājñaḥ pratigṛhṇīyānna śūdrapatitādapi / na cānyasmādaśaktaśca ninditān varjayed budhaḥ
verses.translation: One should not kindle the fire by generating the wind with a wing, a winnowing basket or the hand. He should blow the air with his mouth and kindle the fire. (It is said in the Vedas) that Agni was born of his mouth.
verses.hindi: भुञ्जीत स्वजनैः सार्ध स याति परमां गतिम्॥ १२१॥  (नित्य) (अपने अधिकारानुसार शास्त्रविहित) कर्मोंको (श्रद्धापूर्वक) करनेके बाद स्वजनोंके साथ भोजन करना चाहिए । ऐसा करनेवाला परमगति प्राप्त करता है
verses.wordMeaning: One should not kindle the fire by generating the wind with a wing, a winnowing basket or the hand. He should blow the air with his mouth and kindle the fire. (It is said in the Vedas) that Agni was born of his mouth.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not kindle the fire by generating the wind with a wing, a winnowing basket or the hand. He should blow the air with his mouth and kindle the fire. (It is said in the Vedas) that Agni was born of his mouth.

verses.sanskrit: नित्यं याचनको न स्यात् पुनस्तं नैव याचयेत् । प्राणानपहरत्येवं याचकस्तस्य दुर्मतिः
verses.transliteration: nityaṃ yācanako na syāt punastaṃ naiva yācayet / prāṇānapaharatyevaṃ yācakastasya durmatiḥ
verses.translation: One shall not speak to another man's wife. No Brahmana should perform the Yajna on behalfofone not worthy of it. One should not enter an assembly singly. One should avoid a crowd of Brahmanas; one should never go to the shrine of a deity in an anti-clockwise direction.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीकूर्मषुराणे वद्साहस्त्र्थां संहितायामुपरिविभागे अष्टादशोउध्याय:
verses.wordMeaning: One shall not speak to another man's wife. No Brahmana should perform the Yajna on behalfofone not worthy of it. One should not enter an assembly singly. One should avoid a crowd of Brahmanas; one should never go to the shrine of a deity in an anti-clockwise direction.
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall not speak to another man's wife. No Brahmana should perform the Yajna on behalfofone not worthy of it. One should not enter an assembly singly. One should avoid a crowd of Brahmanas; one should never go to the shrine of a deity in an anti-clockwise direction.

verses.sanskrit: न देवद्रव्यहारी स्याद् विशेषेण द्विजोत्तमः । ब्रह्मस्वं वा नापहरेदापद्यपि कदाचन
verses.transliteration: na devadravyahārī syād viśeṣeṇa dvijottamaḥ / brahmasvaṃ vā nāpaharedāpadyapi kadācana
