verses.translation: One should not fan with the cloth, one should not sleep in a temple; one should not undertake a journey alone; nor should he travel with unrighteous people.
verses.hindi: भोजन-विधि, ग्रहणकालमें भोजनका निषेध, शयन-विधि, गृहस्थके नित्यकर्मोके अनुष्ठानका महत्त्व उपवासेन तत्तुल्यं मनुराह प्रजापतिः
verses.wordMeaning: One should not fan with the cloth, one should not sleep in a temple; one should not undertake a journey alone; nor should he travel with unrighteous people.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not fan with the cloth, one should not sleep in a temple; one should not undertake a journey alone; nor should he travel with unrighteous people.

verses.sanskrit: न विषं विषमित्याहुर्ब्रह्मस्वं विषमुच्यते । देवस्वं चापि यत्नेन सदा परिहरेत् ततः
verses.transliteration: na viṣaṃ viṣamityāhurbrahmasvaṃ viṣamucyate / devasvaṃ cāpi yatnena sadā pariharet tataḥ
verses.translation: One should not undertake a journey in the company of persons defiled by sickness, or of Sudras or of fallen men (out- caste). One should never travel without shoes or without taking water and other requisites.
verses.hindi: उपलिप्ते शुचौ देशे पादौ प्रक्षाल्य वै करौ। आचम्यार्द्राननोऽक्रोधः पञ्चारद्रौ भोजनं चरेत्
verses.wordMeaning: One should not undertake a journey in the company of persons defiled by sickness, or of Sudras or of fallen men (out- caste). One should never travel without shoes or without taking water and other requisites.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not undertake a journey in the company of persons defiled by sickness, or of Sudras or of fallen men (out- caste). One should never travel without shoes or without taking water and other requisites.

verses.sanskrit: पुष्पे शाक्रोदके काष्ठे तथा मूले फले तृणे । अदत्तादानमस्तेयं मनुः प्राह प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: puṣpe śākrodake kāṣṭhe tathā mūle phale tṛṇe / adattādānamasteyaṃ manuḥ prāha prajāpatiḥ
verses.translation: At night one should not travel in the company of one's enemy. One should not travel without a waterpot. One should not go between fires, Brahmanas, cows etc.
verses.hindi: महाव्याहतिभिस्त्वन्नं परिधायोदकेन तु। अमृतोपस्तरणमसीत्यापोशानक्रियां चरेत् व्यासजीने कहा--पवित्र आसनपर बैठकर पाँवोंको भूमिपर रखकर पूर्वकी ओर अथवा सूर्याभिमुख होकर अन्न (भोजन) ग्रहण करना चाहिए। पूर्वाभिमुख होकर भोजन करनेसे लम्बी आयु, दक्षिणाभिमुख होकर भोजन
verses.wordMeaning: At night one should not travel in the company of one's enemy. One should not travel without a waterpot. One should not go between fires, Brahmanas, cows etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: At night one should not travel in the company of one's enemy. One should not travel without a waterpot. One should not go between fires, Brahmanas, cows etc.

verses.sanskrit: ग्रहीतव्यानि पुष्पाणि देवार्चनविधौ द्विजाः । नैकस्मादेव नियतमननुज्ञाय केवलम्
verses.transliteration: grahītavyāni puṣpāṇi devārcanavidhau dvijāḥ / naikasmādeva niyatamananujñāya kevalam
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas, one should not transgress a woman longing for sexual intercourse. One should not censure Siddhas, Yogins and ascetics of good qualities.
verses.hindi: करनेसे यश, पश्चिमाभिमुख होकर भोजन करनेसे सम्पत्ति और उत्तरकी ओर मुख करके भोजन करनेसे सत्यकी प्राप्ति होती है
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahmanas, one should not transgress a woman longing for sexual intercourse. One should not censure Siddhas, Yogins and ascetics of good qualities.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmanas, one should not transgress a woman longing for sexual intercourse. One should not censure Siddhas, Yogins and ascetics of good qualities.

verses.sanskrit: तृणं काष्ठं फलं पुष्पं प्रकाशं वै हरेद् बुधः । धर्मार्थं केवलं विप्रा ह्यन्यथा पतितो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: tṛṇaṃ kāṣṭhaṃ phalaṃ puṣpaṃ prakāśaṃ vai hared budhaḥ / dharmārthaṃ kevalaṃ viprā hyanyathā patito bhavet
verses.translation: In the temple and in the presence of devas, one should not wantonly tread on the shadow of the Brahmanas and the cows.
verses.hindi: पाँचों अङ्गों (दोनों हाथ, दोनों पैर तथा मुख)-का प्रक्षालनकर (भोजन) पात्रको भूमिपर रखकर भोजन करना चाहिए। प्रजापति मनुने इस प्रकारके भोजनको उपवासके समान बताया है । दोनों हाथ, पैर एवं मुखको धोनेके बाद आचमनकर (गोबर इत्यादिसे) लीपे गये पवित्र स्थानमें (बैठकर) क्रोधरहित होकर भोजन करना चाहिए। महाव्याहृतियोंका उच्चारण करते हुए जलसे अन्नको परिवेष्टितकर ' अमृतोपस्तरणमसि' ऐसा कहकर
verses.wordMeaning: In the temple and in the presence of devas, one should not wantonly tread on the shadow of the Brahmanas and the cows.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the temple and in the presence of devas, one should not wantonly tread on the shadow of the Brahmanas and the cows.

verses.sanskrit: तिलमुद्गयवादीनां मुष्टिर्ग्राह्या पथि स्थितैः । क्षुधार्तैर्नान्यथा विप्रा धर्मविद्भिरिति स्थितिः
verses.transliteration: tilamudgayavādīnāṃ muṣṭirgrāhyā pathi sthitaiḥ / kṣudhārtairnānyathā viprā dharmavidbhiriti sthitiḥ
verses.translation: One should not let one's own shadow to be tread on by sick persons fallen people or others. One should never stand on burning coal or ashes or hair or similar things.
verses.hindi: आपोशान (आचमन) क्रिया (सम्पन्न) करे
verses.wordMeaning: One should not let one's own shadow to be tread on by sick persons fallen people or others. One should never stand on burning coal or ashes or hair or similar things.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not let one's own shadow to be tread on by sick persons fallen people or others. One should never stand on burning coal or ashes or hair or similar things.

verses.sanskrit: न धर्मस्यापदेशेन पापं कृत्वा व्रतं चरेत् । व्रतेन पापं प्रच्छाद्य कुर्वन् स्त्रीशूद्रदम्भनम्
verses.transliteration: na dharmasyāpadeśena pāpaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ caret / vratena pāpaṃ pracchādya kurvan strīśūdradambhanam
verses.translation: O Brahmanas, one should avoid the dust particles rising from the broom and the water that remains in a pot after washing clothes or taking bath. Forbidden foodstuffs should not be eaten nor should one drink impotable water.
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर स्वाहा एवं प्रणवके साथ 'प्राणाय' का उच्चारण कर (ॐ प्राणाय स्वाहा) कहकर पहली आहुति देनी चाहिए। तदुपरान्त ' ३ अपानाय स्वाहा' स्वाहा' और अन्तमें ' 3३७ समानाय स्वाहा' कहकर पॉचवीं आहुति देनी चाहिए। इनका रहस्य समझते हुए द्विजको आत्मामें आहुति देनी चाहिए'
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas, one should avoid the dust particles rising from the broom and the water that remains in a pot after washing clothes or taking bath. Forbidden foodstuffs should not be eaten nor should one drink impotable water.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas, one should avoid the dust particles rising from the broom and the water that remains in a pot after washing clothes or taking bath. Forbidden foodstuffs should not be eaten nor should one drink impotable water.

verses.sanskrit: प्रेत्येह चेदृशो विप्रो गर्ह्यते ब्रह्मवादिभिः । छद्मनाचरितं यच्च व्रतं रक्षांसि गच्छति
verses.transliteration: pretyeha cedṛśo vipro garhyate brahmavādibhiḥ / chadmanācaritaṃ yacca vrataṃ rakṣāṃsi gacchati
verses.translation: This injunction about the eatability of five-clawed animals appears in VR, Kiskindha 17.39, cf. MK. 2-4 which shows a common source of KP. and MK.
verses.hindi: १-भोजनके आरम्भ एवं अन्तमें आपोशान (आचमन) करके अन्नको अनग्र एवं अमृत किया जाता है २-आत्मामें आहुति देनेकी भावनासे भोजनके प्रारम्भमें छोटे-छोटे पाँच ग्रास मुखमें ' प्राणाय स्वाहा' आदि पाँच मन्त्रोंसे देना चाहिए।
verses.wordMeaning: This injunction about the eatability of five-clawed animals appears in VR, Kiskindha 17.39, cf. MK. 2-4 which shows a common source of KP. and MK.
verses.commentary: Sense: This injunction about the eatability of five-clawed animals appears in VR, Kiskindha 17.39, cf. MK. 2-4 which shows a common source of KP. and MK.

verses.sanskrit: अलिङ्गी लिङ्गिवेषेण यो वृत्तिमुपजीवति । स लिङ्गिनां हरेदेनस्तिर्यग्योनौ च जायते
verses.transliteration: aliṅgī liṅgiveṣeṇa yo vṛttimupajīvati / sa liṅgināṃ haredenastiryagyonau ca jāyate
verses.translation: Cf. Manu V. 16
verses.hindi: शेषमन्नं यथाकामं भुञ्जीतव्यं जनैर्युतम्। ध्यात्वा तन्मनसा देवमात्मानं वै प्रजापतिम् द्रुपदां वा त्रिरावर्त्य सर्वपापप्रणाशिनीम्। प्राणानां ग्रन्थिरसीत्यालभेद् हृदयं ततः
verses.wordMeaning: Cf. Manu V. 16
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. Manu V. 16

verses.sanskrit: बैडालव्रतिनः पापा लोके धर्मविनाशकाः । सद्यः पतन्ति पापेषु कर्मणस्तस्य तत् फलम्
verses.transliteration: baiḍālavratinaḥ pāpā loke dharmavināśakāḥ / sadyaḥ patanti pāpeṣu karmaṇastasya tat phalam
verses.translation: Although KP insists on acceptance of non-vegetarian food when served in a Sraddha, it staunchly prohibits wine under all circumstances. Dh. S. of Apastamba 1.7.21.8, Visnu 35.1 and Manu XI. 54 and Yaj. III. 227 hold that wine-drinking is a very grave sin.
verses.hindi: निःस्त्रावयेद् हस्तजलमूर्ध्वहस्तः समाहितः
verses.wordMeaning: Although KP insists on acceptance of non-vegetarian food when served in a Sraddha, it staunchly prohibits wine under all circumstances. Dh. S. of Apastamba 1.7.21.8, Visnu 35.1 and Manu XI. 54 and Yaj. III. 227 hold that wine-drinking is a very grave sin.
verses.commentary: Sense: Although KP insists on acceptance of non-vegetarian food when served in a Sraddha, it staunchly prohibits wine under all circumstances. Dh. S. of Apastamba 1.7.21.8, Visnu 35.1 and Manu XI. 54 and Yaj. III. 227 hold that wine-drinking is a very grave sin.

verses.sanskrit: पाषण्डिनो विकर्मस्थान् वामाचारांस्तथैव च । पञ्चरात्रान् पाशुपतान् वाङ्मात्रेणापि नार्चयेत्
verses.transliteration: pāṣaṇḍino vikarmasthān vāmācārāṃstathaiva ca / pañcarātrān pāśupatān vāṅmātreṇāpi nārcayet
verses.translation: One should avoid the cooked food of six groups of people viz.: the actor, the dancer, the carpenter, the smith, a gang of rogues and the prostitute.
verses.hindi: अथाक्षरेण स्वात्मानं योजयेद् ब्रह्मणेति हि योऽनेन विधिना कुर्यात् स याति ब्रह्मणः क्षयम्
verses.wordMeaning: One should avoid the cooked food of six groups of people viz.: the actor, the dancer, the carpenter, the smith, a gang of rogues and the prostitute.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should avoid the cooked food of six groups of people viz.: the actor, the dancer, the carpenter, the smith, a gang of rogues and the prostitute.

verses.sanskrit: वेदनिन्दारतान् मर्त्यान् देवनिन्दारतांस्तथा । द्विजनिन्दारतांश्चैव मनसापि न चिन्तयेत्
verses.transliteration: vedanindāratān martyān devanindāratāṃstathā / dvijanindāratāṃścaiva manasāpi na cintayet
verses.translation: Sahrllekha 'disgusting to the mind' e.g. faeces.
verses.hindi: यज्ञोपवीती भुञ्जीत स्त्रग्गन्धालङ्कतः शुचिः । सायंप्रातर्नान्तरा वै संध्यायां तु विशेषतः
verses.wordMeaning: Sahrllekha 'disgusting to the mind' e.g. faeces.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sahrllekha 'disgusting to the mind' e.g. faeces.

verses.sanskrit: याजनं योनिसंबन्धं सहवासं च भाषणम् । कुर्वाणः पतते जन्तुस्तस्माद् यत्नेन वर्जयेत्
verses.transliteration: yājanaṃ yonisaṃbandhaṃ sahavāsaṃ ca bhāṣaṇam / kurvāṇaḥ patate jantustasmād yatnena varjayet
verses.translation: He should avoid the food offered by a potter, a painter, a usurer, a fallen man, a goldsmith, a dancer, a hunter, an imprisoned fellow or an ailing person.
verses.hindi: ग्रहकाले च नाश्नीयात् स्त्रात्वाश्नीयात् तु मुक्तयोः न यज्ञशिष्टादन्यद् वा न क्रुद्धो नान्यमानसः
verses.wordMeaning: He should avoid the food offered by a potter, a painter, a usurer, a fallen man, a goldsmith, a dancer, a hunter, an imprisoned fellow or an ailing person.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should avoid the food offered by a potter, a painter, a usurer, a fallen man, a goldsmith, a dancer, a hunter, an imprisoned fellow or an ailing person.

verses.sanskrit: देवद्रोहाद् गुरुद्रोहः कोटिकोटिगुणाधिकः । ज्ञानापवादो नास्तिक्यं तस्मात् कोटिगुणाधिकम्
verses.transliteration: devadrohād gurudrohaḥ koṭikoṭiguṇādhikaḥ / jñānāpavādo nāstikyaṃ tasmāt koṭiguṇādhikam
verses.translation: He should avoid the food offered by a physician, an unchaste woman, a staff-bearer (a police-man?), a thief, an atheist or a person who blasphemes gods.
verses.hindi: फिर देव प्रजापति तथा आत्माका मनसे ध्यान
verses.wordMeaning: He should avoid the food offered by a physician, an unchaste woman, a staff-bearer (a police-man?), a thief, an atheist or a person who blasphemes gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should avoid the food offered by a physician, an unchaste woman, a staff-bearer (a police-man?), a thief, an atheist or a person who blasphemes gods.

verses.sanskrit: गोभिश्च दैवतैर्विप्रैः कृष्या राजोपसेवया । कुलान्यकुलतां यान्ति यानि हीनानि धर्मतः
verses.transliteration: gobhiśca daivatairvipraiḥ kṛṣyā rājopasevayā / kulānyakulatāṃ yānti yāni hīnāni dharmataḥ
verses.translation: One should avoid the food offered by a person who sells Soma juice and especially of Candala. He should avoid food offered by one who is hen-pecked or one who allows the paramour of his wife to remain in his house.
verses.hindi: करते हुए अवशिष्ट अन्न (भोजन)-का बन्धुओंके साथ इच्छानुसार भोजन करना चाहिए। (भोजन कर लेनेके बाद) ' अमृतापिधानमसि' यह मन्त्र पढ़कर जल पीना (आचमन करना) चाहिए। आचमनके उपरान्त पुनः 'आयं गौः०' इस मन्त्रको पढ़ते हुए आचमन करना चाहिए । तदनन्तर सभी प्रकारके पापॉका नाश करनेवाली 'द्रुपदा०' का तीन बार पाठकर "प्राणानां ग्रन्थिरसि ' इस मन्त्रसे हृदयका स्पर्श करे॥ ८--१०॥
verses.wordMeaning: One should avoid the food offered by a person who sells Soma juice and especially of Candala. He should avoid food offered by one who is hen-pecked or one who allows the paramour of his wife to remain in his house.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should avoid the food offered by a person who sells Soma juice and especially of Candala. He should avoid food offered by one who is hen-pecked or one who allows the paramour of his wife to remain in his house.

verses.sanskrit: कुविवाहैः क्रियालोपैर्वेदानध्ययनेन च । कुलान्यकुलतां यान्ति ब्राह्मणातिक्रमेण च
verses.transliteration: kuvivāhaiḥ kriyālopairvedānadhyayanena ca / kulānyakulatāṃ yānti brāhmaṇātikrameṇa ca
verses.translation: One should avoid taking these cooked-stuff, viz.; that of one who is defiled by Ucchifta, that of miser, that of one who partakes of the leaving of others' food-stuffs, the cooked food of a person who is inferior—not worth allowing to sit in row for dinner, the cooked food meant for a multitude and that of one who maintains himself by means of weapons.
verses.hindi: ऊपर हाथ किये हुए समाहितमन होकर आचमन करके 'अङ्कुष्ठमात्रेति' मन्त्रद्वारा दाहिने पैरके अगूठेपर हाथका जल गिराना चाहिए। ' श्रद्धायाम्०' इस मन्त्रसे हुतानुमन्त्रण करे । तदनन्तर ' ब्रह्मणा०' इस मन्त्रसे अपनी
verses.wordMeaning: One should avoid taking these cooked-stuff, viz.; that of one who is defiled by Ucchifta, that of miser, that of one who partakes of the leaving of others' food-stuffs, the cooked food of a person who is inferior—not worth allowing to sit in row for dinner,…
verses.commentary: Sense: One should avoid taking these cooked-stuff, viz.; that of one who is defiled by Ucchifta, that of miser, that of one who partakes of the leaving of others' food-stuffs, the cooked food of a person who is inferior—not worth allowing to sit in row for dinner,…

verses.sanskrit: अनृतात् पारदार्याच्च तथाभक्ष्यस्य भक्षणात् । अश्रौतधर्माचरणात् क्षिप्रं नश्यति वै कुलम्
verses.transliteration: anṛtāt pāradāryācca tathābhakṣyasya bhakṣaṇāt / aśrautadharmācaraṇāt kṣipraṃ naśyati vai kulam
verses.translation: One should avoid food offered by an ascetic, by a eunuch, the food of an insane or a drunkard fellow, of a fright¬ ened one or a crying person, the food that is of inferior quality and that offered as charitable gift.
verses.hindi: आत्माका अक्षर-तत्त्वसे योग करना चाहिए। सभी यागोंमें आत्मयाग श्रेष्ठ कहा गया है। जो इस विधिसे (आत्मयाग) करता है, वह ब्रह्मधाममें जाता है यज्ञोपवीती होकर अर्थात् सव्य होकर तथा माला (एवं चन्दनको) सुगन्धिसे अलंकृत होकर पवित्रतापूर्वक भोजन करना चाहिए । सायंकाल, प्रातःकाल, मध्याहरकाल और विशेषरूपसे संध्याकाल (प्रदोषकाल)-के समय
verses.wordMeaning: One should avoid food offered by an ascetic, by a eunuch, the food of an insane or a drunkard fellow, of a fright¬ ened one or a crying person, the food that is of inferior quality and that offered as charitable gift.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should avoid food offered by an ascetic, by a eunuch, the food of an insane or a drunkard fellow, of a fright¬ ened one or a crying person, the food that is of inferior quality and that offered as charitable gift.

verses.sanskrit: अश्रोत्रियेषु वै दानाद् वृषलेषु तथैव च । विहिताचारहीनेषु क्षिप्रं नश्यति वै कुलम्
verses.transliteration: aśrotriyeṣu vai dānād vṛṣaleṣu tathaiva ca / vihitācārahīneṣu kṣipraṃ naśyati vai kulam
verses.translation: One should avoid food offered in Sraddha or, offered by an hater of Brahmanas, one who is interested in sins and a man who is defiled by the impurity of birth (sutaka, the. food of one who cooks in vain (?) the food of a rogue and that of the shrewd fellow, (v.l. father-in-law).
verses.hindi: भोजन नहीं करना चाहिए। सूर्यग्रहणसे पहले दिनमें, चन्द्रग्रहणसे पूर्व सायंकालमें तथा ग्रहणकालमें भोजन नहीं करना चाहिए। ग्रहणको मुक्ति हो जानेपर स्नान करनेके अनन्तर भोजन करना चाहिए। चन्द्रमाके
verses.wordMeaning: One should avoid food offered in Sraddha or, offered by an hater of Brahmanas, one who is interested in sins and a man who is defiled by the impurity of birth (sutaka, the. food of one who cooks in vain (?) the food of a rogue and that of the shrewd fellow, (v.l. father-in-law).
verses.commentary: Sense: One should avoid food offered in Sraddha or, offered by an hater of Brahmanas, one who is interested in sins and a man who is defiled by the impurity of birth (sutaka, the. food of one who cooks in vain (?) the food of a rogue and that of the shrewd fellow, (v.l. father-in-law).

verses.sanskrit: नाधार्मिकैर्वृते ग्रामे न व्याधिबहुले भृशम् । न शूद्रराज्ये निवसेन्न पाषण्डजनैर्वृते
verses.transliteration: nādhārmikairvṛte grāme na vyādhibahule bhṛśam / na śūdrarājye nivasenna pāṣaṇḍajanairvṛte
verses.translation: One should avoid the cooked food of all these:—viz: women without children, a servant, a mason and one who sells weapons.
verses.hindi: ग्रहणसे मुक्त हो जानेपर यदि अर्धरात्रि न हो तो भोजन करना चाहिए। बिना ग्रहणसे मुक्त हुए चन्द्रमा और सूर्य दोनोंके अस्त हो जानेपर दूसरे दिन उनका दर्शन करके भोजन करना चाहिए देखनेवालों (भूखे व्यक्तियाँ)-को बिना दिये हुए तथा दुर्मना होकर भोजन नहीं करना चाहिए। यज्ञसे अवशिष्ट अन्नसे भिन्न अन्न ग्रहण नहीं करना चाहिए । अन्यमनस्क होकर तथा क्रुद्ध होकर भोजन नहीं करना चाहिए। जो
verses.wordMeaning: One should avoid the cooked food of all these:—viz: women without children, a servant, a mason and one who sells weapons.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should avoid the cooked food of all these:—viz: women without children, a servant, a mason and one who sells weapons.

verses.sanskrit: हिमवद्विन्ध्ययोर्मध्ये पूर्वपश्चिमयोः शुभम् । मुक्त्वा समुद्रयोर्देशं नान्यत्र निवसेद् द्विजः
verses.transliteration: himavadvindhyayormadhye pūrvapaścimayoḥ śubham / muktvā samudrayordeśaṃ nānyatra nivased dvijaḥ
verses.translation: The cooked food served by these should be avoided- one who is addicted to drinking wine, a murderer, the physi¬ cian, one whose organ of generation is mutilated and person who, though a younger brother, married earlier than the elder brother.
verses.hindi: केवल अपने लिये ही भोजन बनाता है, जो केवल कामसुखके लिये ही मेथुन करता है और जो केवल आजीविका प्राप्त हो जाय-इस उद्देश्यसे अध्ययन करता है, उसका जीवन निष्फल ही है
verses.wordMeaning: The cooked food served by these should be avoided- one who is addicted to drinking wine, a murderer, the physi¬ cian, one whose organ of generation is mutilated and person who, though a younger brother, married earlier than the elder brother.
verses.commentary: Sense: The cooked food served by these should be avoided- one who is addicted to drinking wine, a murderer, the physi¬ cian, one whose organ of generation is mutilated and person who, though a younger brother, married earlier than the elder brother.

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णो वा यत्र चरति मृगो नित्यं स्वभावतः । पुण्याश्च विश्रुता नद्यस्तत्र वा निवसेद् द्विजः
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇo vā yatra carati mṛgo nityaṃ svabhāvataḥ / puṇyāśca viśrutā nadyastatra vā nivased dvijaḥ
verses.translation: One should particularly avoid the food served by a widowed woman who has remarried, nor should he partake of the food served by one who carnally enjoys the wife of his dead brother. Similarly, he should avoid partaking of the food served with contempt or anger, spurning, dislike or arrogance or astonishment.
verses.hindi: न ब्रह्म कीर्तयन् वापि न निःशेषं न भार्यया । नान्धकारे न चाकाशे न च देवालयादिषु न पादुकानिर्गतोऽथ न हसन् विलपन्नपि
verses.wordMeaning: One should particularly avoid the food served by a widowed woman who has remarried, nor should he partake of the food served by one who carnally enjoys the wife of his dead brother. Similarly, he should avoid partaking of the food served with contempt or anger, spurning,…
verses.commentary: Sense: One should particularly avoid the food served by a widowed woman who has remarried, nor should he partake of the food served by one who carnally enjoys the wife of his dead brother. Similarly, he should avoid partaking of the food served with contempt or anger, spurning,…

verses.sanskrit: अर्धक्रोशान्नदीकूलं वर्जयित्वा द्विजोत्तमः । नान्यत्र निवसेत् पुण्यं नान्त्यजग्रामसन्निधौ
verses.transliteration: ardhakrośānnadīkūlaṃ varjayitvā dvijottamaḥ / nānyatra nivaset puṇyaṃ nāntyajagrāmasannidhau
verses.translation: Even the cooked food served by the preceptor should not be eaten if it is devoid of due consecration. All the evil deeds of man are stabilised in his food.
verses.hindi: इतिहासपुराणाभ्यां वेदार्थानृपबृंहयेत्
verses.wordMeaning: Even the cooked food served by the preceptor should not be eaten if it is devoid of due consecration. All the evil deeds of man are stabilised in his food.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even the cooked food served by the preceptor should not be eaten if it is devoid of due consecration. All the evil deeds of man are stabilised in his food.

verses.sanskrit: न संवसेच्च पतितैर्न चण्डालैर्न पुक्कसैः । न मूर्खैर्नावलिप्तैश्च नान्त्यैर्नान्त्यावसायिभिः
verses.transliteration: na saṃvasecca patitairna caṇḍālairna pukkasaiḥ / na mūrkhairnāvaliptaiśca nāntyairnāntyāvasāyibhiḥ
verses.translation: During night, he should scrupulously avoid every¬ thing connected with gingelly seeds as well as curds. One should not take in milk and butter milk together.
verses.hindi: आसीनस्तु जपेद् देवीं गायत्रीं पश्चिमां प्रति स शूद्रेण समो लोके सर्वधर्मविवर्जितः
verses.wordMeaning: During night, he should scrupulously avoid every¬ thing connected with gingelly seeds as well as curds. One should not take in milk and butter milk together.
verses.commentary: Sense: During night, he should scrupulously avoid every¬ thing connected with gingelly seeds as well as curds. One should not take in milk and butter milk together.

verses.sanskrit: एकशय्यासनं पङ्क्तिर्भाण्डपक्वान्नमिश्रणम् । याजनाध्यापने योनिस्तथैव सहभोजनम्
verses.transliteration: ekaśayyāsanaṃ paṅktirbhāṇḍapakvānnamiśraṇam / yājanādhyāpane yonistathaiva sahabhojanam
verses.translation: One should avoid food polluted by action, served indifferently (bhava-dusta) and polluted by bad contact (as with dogs) and by falling therein of hair, insects and dis¬ respectfully given.
verses.hindi: हुत्वाग्निं विधिवन्मन्त्रर्भुक्त्वा यज्ञावशिष्टकम्। सभृत्यबान्धवजनः स्वपेच्छुष्कपदो निशि
verses.wordMeaning: One should avoid food polluted by action, served indifferently (bhava-dusta) and polluted by bad contact (as with dogs) and by falling therein of hair, insects and dis¬ respectfully given.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should avoid food polluted by action, served indifferently (bhava-dusta) and polluted by bad contact (as with dogs) and by falling therein of hair, insects and dis¬ respectfully given.

verses.sanskrit: सहाध्यायस्तु दशमः सहयाजनमेव च । एकादश समुद्दिष्टा दोषाः साङ्कर्यसंज्ञिताः
verses.transliteration: sahādhyāyastu daśamaḥ sahayājanameva ca / ekādaśa samuddiṣṭā doṣāḥ sāṅkaryasaṃjñitāḥ
verses.translation: One shall avoid an article once smelt by a dog and cooked again. So also the article seen by a Candala, or a woman in her menses, or smelt by a cow, or seen by fallen men, shall be avoided.
verses.hindi: न चाकाशे न नग्नो वा नाशुचिर्नासने क्वचित् जो सिर ढककर भोजन करता है, उत्तरकी ओर मुख करके भोजन करता है और जूता पहनकर भोजन करता है, उसके इस प्रकार किये गये भोजनको आसुरी भोजन समझना चाहिए। ठीक अर्धरात्र, ठीक मध्याह,
verses.wordMeaning: One shall avoid an article once smelt by a dog and cooked again. So also the article seen by a Candala, or a woman in her menses, or smelt by a cow, or seen by fallen men, shall be avoided.
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall avoid an article once smelt by a dog and cooked again. So also the article seen by a Candala, or a woman in her menses, or smelt by a cow, or seen by fallen men, shall be avoided.

verses.sanskrit: समीपे वा व्यवस्थानात् पापं संक्रमते नृणाम् । तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन साङ्कर्यं परिवर्जयेत्
verses.transliteration: samīpe vā vyavasthānāt pāpaṃ saṃkramate nṛṇām / tasmāt sarvaprayatnena sāṅkaryaṃ parivarjayet
verses.translation: One shall eat meat in accordance with the injunc¬ tions or as enjoined at a time when life is in danger. One who eats the remainder (i.e. what is left after worship) or as a medi¬ cine or when one is powerless or is deputed, he is not affected by sin.
verses.hindi: अजीर्ण होनेपर, गीले वस्त्र धारणकर, दूसरेके लिये निर्दिष्ट आसनपर, सोते हुए, खड़े होकर, टूटे-फूरे पात्रमें, भूमिपर तथा हाथपर भोजन नहीं करना चाहिए जूठे होकर न तो घृत ग्रहण करे और न सिरका ही
verses.wordMeaning: One shall eat meat in accordance with the injunc¬ tions or as enjoined at a time when life is in danger. One who eats the remainder (i.e. what is left after worship) or as a medi¬ cine or when one is powerless or is deputed, he is not affected by sin.
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall eat meat in accordance with the injunc¬ tions or as enjoined at a time when life is in danger. One who eats the remainder (i.e. what is left after worship) or as a medi¬ cine or when one is powerless or is deputed, he is not affected by sin.

verses.sanskrit: एकपङ्क्त्युपविष्टा ये न स्पृशन्ति परस्परम् । भस्मना कृतमर्यादा न तेषां संकरो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: ekapaṅktyupaviṣṭā ye na spṛśanti parasparam / bhasmanā kṛtamaryādā na teṣāṃ saṃkaro bhavet
verses.translation: If a person invited for the Sraddha or the worship of a deity eschews meat he may have to be in the hell as many years as there are hairs on the body of the animal.®
verses.hindi: स्पर्श करे॥ १९--२१॥ (भोजन करते हुए) वेदका उच्चारण नहीं करना चाहिए और बिना कुछ” भोजन छोड़े ही अर्थात् पूर्ण भोजन न करे तथा भार्याके साथ भी भोजन न को! न अन्धकारमें, न आकाशके नीचे (शून्य स्थानमें),
verses.wordMeaning: If a person invited for the Sraddha or the worship of a deity eschews meat he may have to be in the hell as many years as there are hairs on the body of the animal.®
verses.commentary: Sense: If a person invited for the Sraddha or the worship of a deity eschews meat he may have to be in the hell as many years as there are hairs on the body of the animal.®

verses.sanskrit: अग्निना भस्मना चैव सलिलेनावसेकतः । द्वारेण स्तम्भमार्गेण षड्भिः पङ्क्तिर्विभिद्यते
verses.transliteration: agninā bhasmanā caiva salilenāvasekataḥ / dvāreṇa stambhamārgeṇa ṣaḍbhiḥ paṅktirvibhidyate
verses.translation: The established rule is that, wine should not be drunk, should not be touched and should never be thought of by the twice-born.
verses.hindi: न देवमन्दिरोमें ही भोजन करे। एक वस्त्र पहनकर, सवारी या शय्यापर बैठकर भोजन नहीं करना चाहिए। बिना खड़ाऊँ उतारे और हँसते हुए तथा रोते हुए भी भोजन नहीं करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: The established rule is that, wine should not be drunk, should not be touched and should never be thought of by the twice-born.
verses.commentary: Sense: The established rule is that, wine should not be drunk, should not be touched and should never be thought of by the twice-born.

verses.sanskrit: न कुर्याच्छुष्कवैराणि विवादं च न पैशुनम् । परक्षेत्रे गां धयन्तीं न चाचक्षीत कस्यचित् । न संवदेत् सूतके च न कञ्चिन्मर्मणि स्पृशेत्
verses.transliteration: na kuryācchuṣkavairāṇi vivādaṃ ca na paiśunam / parakṣetre gāṃ dhayantīṃ na cācakṣīta kasyacit / na saṃvadet sūtake ca na kañcinmarmaṇi spṛśet
verses.translation: Hence, one shall scrupulously avoid wine which is despicable. By drinking it, one incurs downfall and loses his merits (good acts) nor should he be talked to by Brahmin.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार भोजन करके सुखपूर्वक बैठकर उस अन्नको पचाना चाहिए और इतिहास तथा पुराणोंके द्वार वेदके रहस्योंको विस्तारपूर्वक समझना चाहिए । तदनन्तर द्विजको पूर्वमें बतलायी गयी विधिके अनुसार संध्योपासना करनी चाहिए। पश्चिमको ओर मुख करते हुए आसनपर बैठकर गायत्री देवीका जप करना चाहिए। जो व्यक्ति पूर्वकी अर्थात् प्रातःकालकी और पश्चिमकी अर्थात् सायं- कालकी संध्या नहीं करता है, वह सभी धर्मोंसे रहित
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, one shall scrupulously avoid wine which is despicable. By drinking it, one incurs downfall and loses his merits (good acts) nor should he be talked to by Brahmin.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, one shall scrupulously avoid wine which is despicable. By drinking it, one incurs downfall and loses his merits (good acts) nor should he be talked to by Brahmin.

verses.sanskrit: न सूर्यपरिवेषं वा नेन्द्रचापं शवाग्निकम् । परस्मै कथयेद् विद्वान् शशिनं वा कदाचन
verses.transliteration: na sūryapariveṣaṃ vā nendracāpaṃ śavāgnikam / parasmai kathayed vidvān śaśinaṃ vā kadācana
verses.translation: Hence, one should scrupulously avoid forbidden food¬ stuffs. He goes alone after elevation* (?). And after death goes to the hell Raurava.
verses.hindi: होता हुआ लोकमें शूद्रके समान होता है
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, one should scrupulously avoid forbidden food¬ stuffs. He goes alone after elevation* (?). And after death goes to the hell Raurava.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, one should scrupulously avoid forbidden food¬ stuffs. He goes alone after elevation* (?). And after death goes to the hell Raurava.

verses.sanskrit: न कुर्याद् बहुभिः सार्धं विरोधं बन्धुभिस्तथा । आत्मनः प्रतिकूलानि परेषां न समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: na kuryād bahubhiḥ sārdhaṃ virodhaṃ bandhubhistathā / ātmanaḥ pratikūlāni pareṣāṃ na samācaret
verses.translation: This injunction about the eatability of five-clawed animals appears in VR, Kiskindha 17.39, cf. MK. 2-4 which shows a common source of KP. and MK.
verses.hindi: बचे अन्नको बन्धु-बान्धव तथा भृत्यजनोंके साथ ग्रहणकर रात्रिमें सूखे पैर होकर (अर्थात् गीला पैर न रहे) शयन करना चाहिए। न तो उत्तरकी ओर सिर करके और न पश्चिमकी ओर सिर करके सोना चाहिए। खुले आकाशके नीचे (अथवा शून्य स्थानमें), नग्न होकर, अपवित्र अवस्थामें और बैठनेके आसनपर कभी नहीं सोना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: This injunction about the eatability of five-clawed animals appears in VR, Kiskindha 17.39, cf. MK. 2-4 which shows a common source of KP. and MK.
verses.commentary: Sense: This injunction about the eatability of five-clawed animals appears in VR, Kiskindha 17.39, cf. MK. 2-4 which shows a common source of KP. and MK.

verses.sanskrit: तिथिं पक्षस्य न ब्रूयात् न नक्षत्राणि निर्दिशेत् । नोदक्यामभिभाषेत नाशुचिं वा द्विजोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: tithiṃ pakṣasya na brūyāt na nakṣatrāṇi nirdiśet / nodakyāmabhibhāṣeta nāśuciṃ vā dvijottamaḥ
verses.translation: Cf. Manu V. 16
verses.hindi: गृहस्थको भोज्य पदार्थ यथायोग्य अवशिष्ट रखकर भोजन करना चाहिए। इसका आशय यह है कि भोजन कर लेनेके अनन्तर यदि कोई ऐसा व्यक्ति आ जाय, जिसे स्वयं भोजन कर लेनेके बाद भी उसकी अपेक्षाके अनुसार भोजन कराया जा सके, जिससे
verses.wordMeaning: Cf. Manu V. 16
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. Manu V. 16

verses.sanskrit: न देवगुरुविप्राणां दीयमानं तु वारयेत् । न चात्मानं प्रशंसेद् वा परनिन्दां च वर्जयेत् । वेदनिन्दां देवनिन्दां प्रयत्नेन विवर्जयेत्
verses.transliteration: na devaguruviprāṇāṃ dīyamānaṃ tu vārayet / na cātmānaṃ praśaṃsed vā paranindāṃ ca varjayet / vedanindāṃ devanindāṃ prayatnena vivarjayet
verses.translation: Although KP insists on acceptance of non-vegetarian food when served in a Sraddha, it staunchly prohibits wine under all circumstances. Dh. S. of Apastamba 1.7.21.8, Visnu 35.1 and Manu XI. 54 and Yaj. III. 227 hold that wine-drinking is a very grave sin.
verses.hindi: भोज्य पदार्थके अभावमें वह भूखा न रह जाय। न शीर्णायां तु खट्वायां शून्यागारे न चैव हि। टूटी-फूटी चारपाईपर, सूनसान घरमें तथा बाँस नानुवंशं न पालाशे शयनं वा कदाचन॥ २९॥  या पलाससे बनी खाटपर कभी नहीं सोना चाहिए। इस इत्येतदखिलेनोक्तमहन्यहनि वै मया। प्रकार मैंने ब्राह्मणों (द्विजों)-के मोक्षदायक प्रतिदिन
verses.wordMeaning: Although KP insists on acceptance of non-vegetarian food when served in a Sraddha, it staunchly prohibits wine under all circumstances. Dh. S. of Apastamba 1.7.21.8, Visnu 35.1 and Manu XI. 54 and Yaj. III. 227 hold that wine-drinking is a very grave sin.
verses.commentary: Sense: Although KP insists on acceptance of non-vegetarian food when served in a Sraddha, it staunchly prohibits wine under all circumstances. Dh. S. of Apastamba 1.7.21.8, Visnu 35.1 and Manu XI. 54 and Yaj. III. 227 hold that wine-drinking is a very grave sin.

verses.sanskrit: यस्तु देवानृषीन् विप्रान्वेदान् वा निन्दति द्विजः । न तस्य निष्कृतिर्दृष्टा शास्त्रेष्विह मुनीश्वराः
verses.transliteration: yastu devānṛṣīn viprānvedān vā nindati dvijaḥ / na tasya niṣkṛtirdṛṣṭā śāstreṣviha munīśvarāḥ
verses.translation: One should avoid the cooked food of six groups of people viz.: the actor, the dancer, the carpenter, the smith, a gang of rogues and the prostitute.
verses.hindi: ब्राह्मणानां कृत्यजातमपवर्गफलप्रदम्॥ ३०॥  किये जानेवाले सम्पूर्ण कृत्यों (हैनिक कर्मों)-का पूर्णरूपसे वर्णन किया। जो ब्राह्मण (द्विज) नास्तिकता अथवा आलस्यके कारण इन कर्माको नहीं करता, वह घोर नरकोंमें जाता है और काकयोनिमें जन्म लेता है।
verses.wordMeaning: One should avoid the cooked food of six groups of people viz.: the actor, the dancer, the carpenter, the smith, a gang of rogues and the prostitute.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should avoid the cooked food of six groups of people viz.: the actor, the dancer, the carpenter, the smith, a gang of rogues and the prostitute.

verses.sanskrit: निन्दयेद् वै गुरुं देवं वेदं वा सोपबृंहणम् । कल्पकोटिशतं साग्रं रौरवे पच्यते नरः
verses.transliteration: nindayed vai guruṃ devaṃ vedaṃ vā sopabṛṃhaṇam / kalpakoṭiśataṃ sāgraṃ raurave pacyate naraḥ
verses.translation: Sahrllekha 'disgusting to the mind' e.g. faeces.
verses.hindi: अपने आश्रमकी विधिको छोड़कर अन्य कोई दूसरा मुक्तिका मार्ग नहीं है। इसलिये परमेष्ठी (परब्रह्म)- नान्यो विमुक्तये पन्था मुक्त्वाश्रमविधिं स्वकम्। की प्रसन्रताके लिये (विहित) कमाँको करना तस्मात् कर्माणि कुर्वीत तुष्टये परमेष्ठिनः॥ ३२॥  चाहिए इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षद्साहस्रघां संहितायामुपारिविभागे एकोनविंशोऽध्यायः
verses.wordMeaning: Sahrllekha 'disgusting to the mind' e.g. faeces.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sahrllekha 'disgusting to the mind' e.g. faeces.

verses.sanskrit: तूष्णीमासीत निन्दायां न ब्रूयात् किञ्चिदुत्तरम् । कर्णौ पिधाय गन्तव्यं न चैतानवलोकयेत्
verses.transliteration: tūṣṇīmāsīta nindāyāṃ na brūyāt kiñciduttaram / karṇau pidhāya gantavyaṃ na caitānavalokayet
verses.translation: He should avoid the food offered by a potter, a painter, a usurer, a fallen man, a goldsmith, a dancer, a hunter, an imprisoned fellow or an ailing person.
verses.hindi: नास्तिक्यादथवालस्यात् ब्राह्मणो न करोति यः। स याति नरकान् घोरान् काकयोनौ च जायते
verses.wordMeaning: He should avoid the food offered by a potter, a painter, a usurer, a fallen man, a goldsmith, a dancer, a hunter, an imprisoned fellow or an ailing person.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should avoid the food offered by a potter, a painter, a usurer, a fallen man, a goldsmith, a dancer, a hunter, an imprisoned fellow or an ailing person.

verses.sanskrit: वर्जयेद् वै रहस्यानि परेषां गूहयेद् बुधः । विवादं स्वजनैः सार्धं न कुर्याद् वै कदाचन
verses.transliteration: varjayed vai rahasyāni pareṣāṃ gūhayed budhaḥ / vivādaṃ svajanaiḥ sārdhaṃ na kuryād vai kadācana
verses.translation: He should avoid the food offered by a physician, an unchaste woman, a staff-bearer (a police-man?), a thief, an atheist or a person who blasphemes gods.
verses.hindi: श्राद्ध-प्रकरण--श्राद्धके प्रशस्त दिन, विभिन्न तिथियों, नक्षत्रों और वारोंमें किये जानेवाले श्राद्धोंका विभिन्न फल, श्राद्धके आठ भेद, श्राद्धके लिये प्रशस्त स्थान, श्राद्धमें विहित तथा निषिद्ध पदार्थ व्यास उवाच व्यासजी बोले--द्विजोत्तमोंको अमावास्या आनेपर भक्तिपूर्वक भोग और मोक्षरूप फल प्रदान करनेवाला पिण्डान्वाहार्यक नामक श्राद्ध करना चाहिए। चन्द्रमाके क्षीण होनेपर अर्थात् अमावास्या तिथिके अपराह-
verses.wordMeaning: He should avoid the food offered by a physician, an unchaste woman, a staff-bearer (a police-man?), a thief, an atheist or a person who blasphemes gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should avoid the food offered by a physician, an unchaste woman, a staff-bearer (a police-man?), a thief, an atheist or a person who blasphemes gods.

verses.sanskrit: न पापं पापिनां ब्रूयादपापं वा द्विजात्तमाः । सतेनतुल्यदोषः स्यान्मिथ्या द्विर्देषवान् भवेत्
verses.transliteration: na pāpaṃ pāpināṃ brūyādapāpaṃ vā dvijāttamāḥ / satenatulyadoṣaḥ syānmithyā dvirdeṣavān bhavet
verses.translation: One should avoid the food offered by a person who sells Soma juice and especially of Candala. He should avoid food offered by one who is hen-pecked or one who allows the paramour of his wife to remain in his house.
verses.hindi: अथ श्राद्धममावास्यां प्राप्य कार्य द्विजोत्तमैः । पिण्डान्वाहार्यकं भक्त्या भुक्तिमुक्तिफलप्रदम्
verses.wordMeaning: One should avoid the food offered by a person who sells Soma juice and especially of Candala. He should avoid food offered by one who is hen-pecked or one who allows the paramour of his wife to remain in his house.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should avoid the food offered by a person who sells Soma juice and especially of Candala. He should avoid food offered by one who is hen-pecked or one who allows the paramour of his wife to remain in his house.

verses.sanskrit: यानि मिथ्याभिशस्तानां पतन्त्यश्रूणि रोदनात् । तानिपुत्रान् पशून्घ्निन्ति तेषां मिथ्याभिशंसिनाम्
verses.transliteration: yāni mithyābhiśastānāṃ patantyaśrūṇi rodanāt / tāniputrān paśūnghninti teṣāṃ mithyābhiśaṃsinām
verses.translation: One should avoid taking these cooked-stuff, viz.; that of one who is defiled by Ucchifta, that of miser, that of one who partakes of the leaving of others' food-stuffs, the cooked food of a person who is inferior—not worth allowing to sit in row for dinner, the cooked food meant for a multitude and that of one who maintains himself by means of weapons.
verses.hindi: पिण्डान्वाहार्यकं श्राद्धं क्षीणे राजनि शस्यते । कालमें द्विंजातियोंके लिये पिण्डान्वाहार्यक श्राद्ध करना अपराह्ले द्विजातीनां प्रशस्तेनामिषेण च॥ २॥  प्रशस्त होता है प्रतिपत्प्रभृति ह्यन्यास्तिथयः कृष्णपक्षके । कृष्णपक्षमें चतुर्दशीको छोड़कर प्रतिपदादि अन्य
verses.wordMeaning: One should avoid taking these cooked-stuff, viz.; that of one who is defiled by Ucchifta, that of miser, that of one who partakes of the leaving of others' food-stuffs, the cooked food of a person who is inferior—not worth allowing to sit in row for dinner,…
verses.commentary: Sense: One should avoid taking these cooked-stuff, viz.; that of one who is defiled by Ucchifta, that of miser, that of one who partakes of the leaving of others' food-stuffs, the cooked food of a person who is inferior—not worth allowing to sit in row for dinner,…

verses.sanskrit: ब्रिह्महत्यासुरापाने स्तेयगुर्वङ्गनागमे । दृष्टं विशोधनं वृद्धैर्नास्ति मिथ्याभिशंसने
verses.transliteration: brihmahatyāsurāpāne steyagurvaṅganāgame / dṛṣṭaṃ viśodhanaṃ vṛddhairnāsti mithyābhiśaṃsane
verses.translation: One should avoid food offered by an ascetic, by a eunuch, the food of an insane or a drunkard fellow, of a fright¬ ened one or a crying person, the food that is of inferior quality and that offered as charitable gift.
verses.hindi: चतुर्दशीं वर्जयित्वा प्रशस्ता ह्युत्तरोत्तराः॥ ३॥  तिथियाँ उत्तरोत्तर प्रशस्त हैं। पौष, माघ तथा फाल्गुन मासकी तीनों अष्टकाएँ (तीनों कृष्णाष्टमी) और
verses.wordMeaning: One should avoid food offered by an ascetic, by a eunuch, the food of an insane or a drunkard fellow, of a fright¬ ened one or a crying person, the food that is of inferior quality and that offered as charitable gift.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should avoid food offered by an ascetic, by a eunuch, the food of an insane or a drunkard fellow, of a fright¬ ened one or a crying person, the food that is of inferior quality and that offered as charitable gift.

verses.sanskrit: नेक्षेतोद्यन्तमादित्यं शशिनं चानिमित्ततः । नास्तं यान्तं न वारिस्थं नोपसृष्टं न मघ्यगम् । तिरोहितं वाससा वा नादर्शान्तरगामिनम्
verses.transliteration: nekṣetodyantamādityaṃ śaśinaṃ cānimittataḥ / nāstaṃ yāntaṃ na vāristhaṃ nopasṛṣṭaṃ na maghyagam / tirohitaṃ vāsasā vā nādarśāntaragāminam
verses.translation: One should avoid food offered in Sraddha or, offered by an hater of Brahmanas, one who is interested in sins and a man who is defiled by the impurity of birth (sutaka, the. food of one who cooks in vain (?) the food of a rogue and that of the shrewd fellow, (v.l. father-in-law).
verses.hindi: मासकी पूर्णिमा तिथि (श्राद्धके लिये) पुण्य तिथियाँ हैं। वर्षा-ऋतुमें मघा नक्षत्रयुक्त त्रयोदशी तिथि और 'फसलके पकनेका समय विशेषरूपसे श्राद्ध करनेका त्रयोदशी मघायुक्ता वर्षासु तु विशेषतः। काल होता है। ये सभी श्राद्ध नित्य और प्रतिदिन किये शस्यपाकश्राद्धकाला नित्याः प्रोक्ता दिने दिने॥ ५॥  जानेवाले नित्यश्राद्ध हैं
verses.wordMeaning: One should avoid food offered in Sraddha or, offered by an hater of Brahmanas, one who is interested in sins and a man who is defiled by the impurity of birth (sutaka, the. food of one who cooks in vain (?) the food of a rogue and that of the shrewd fellow, (v.l. father-in-law).
verses.commentary: Sense: One should avoid food offered in Sraddha or, offered by an hater of Brahmanas, one who is interested in sins and a man who is defiled by the impurity of birth (sutaka, the. food of one who cooks in vain (?) the food of a rogue and that of the shrewd fellow, (v.l. father-in-law).

verses.sanskrit: न नग्नां स्त्रियमीक्षेत पुरुषं वा कदाचन । न च मूत्रं पुरीषं वा न च संस्पृष्टमैथुनम् । नाशुचिः सूर्यसोमादीन् ग्रहानालोकयेद् बुधः
verses.transliteration: na nagnāṃ striyamīkṣeta puruṣaṃ vā kadācana / na ca mūtraṃ purīṣaṃ vā na ca saṃspṛṣṭamaithunam / nāśuciḥ sūryasomādīn grahānālokayed budhaḥ
verses.translation: One should avoid the cooked food of all these:—viz: women without children, a servant, a mason and one who sells weapons.
verses.hindi: अमावास्याष्टकास्तिस्त्रः पौषमासादिषु त्रिषु । तिस्रश्चान्वष्टकाः पुण्या माघी पञ्चदशी तथा
verses.wordMeaning: One should avoid the cooked food of all these:—viz: women without children, a servant, a mason and one who sells weapons.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should avoid the cooked food of all these:—viz: women without children, a servant, a mason and one who sells weapons.

verses.sanskrit: पतितव्यङ्गचण्डालानुच्छिष्टान् नावलोकयेत् । नाभिभाषेत च परमुच्छिष्टो वावगुण्ठितः
verses.transliteration: patitavyaṅgacaṇḍālānucchiṣṭān nāvalokayet / nābhibhāṣeta ca paramucchiṣṭo vāvaguṇṭhitaḥ
verses.translation: The cooked food served by these should be avoided- one who is addicted to drinking wine, a murderer, the physi¬ cian, one whose organ of generation is mutilated and person who, though a younger brother, married earlier than the elder brother.
verses.hindi: मनुस्मृति (३। १२२) -के अनुसार पिण्डान्वाहार्यक एक स्वतन्त्र श्राद्ध है। इसे अग्निहोत्री लोग ही कर सकते हैं। यह पिण्ड पितृयज्ञके वाद किया जाता है, इसलिये इसका नाम पिण्डान्वाहार्यक है। यह प्रतिमास किया जाता है! यह नित्यश्राद्ध है । नैमित्तिकं तु कर्तव्यं ग्रहणे चन्द्रसूर्ययोः । बान्धवानां च मरणे नारकी स्यादतोऽन्यथा
verses.wordMeaning: The cooked food served by these should be avoided- one who is addicted to drinking wine, a murderer, the physi¬ cian, one whose organ of generation is mutilated and person who, though a younger brother, married earlier than the elder brother.
verses.commentary: Sense: The cooked food served by these should be avoided- one who is addicted to drinking wine, a murderer, the physi¬ cian, one whose organ of generation is mutilated and person who, though a younger brother, married earlier than the elder brother.

verses.sanskrit: न पश्येत् प्रेतसंस्पर्शं न क्रुद्धस्य गुरोर्मुखम् । न तैलोदकयोश्छायां न पत्नीं भोजने सति । नामुक्तबन्धनाङ्गां वा नोन्मत्तं मत्तमेव वा
verses.transliteration: na paśyet pretasaṃsparśaṃ na kruddhasya gurormukham / na tailodakayośchāyāṃ na patnīṃ bhojane sati / nāmuktabandhanāṅgāṃ vā nonmattaṃ mattameva vā
verses.translation: One should particularly avoid the food served by a widowed woman who has remarried, nor should he partake of the food served by one who carnally enjoys the wife of his dead brother. Similarly, he should avoid partaking of the food served with contempt or anger, spurning, dislike or arrogance or astonishment.
verses.hindi: काम्यानि चैव श्राद्धानि शस्यन्ते ग्रहणादिषु । अयने विषुवे चैव व्यतीपातेऽप्यनन्तकम्
verses.wordMeaning: One should particularly avoid the food served by a widowed woman who has remarried, nor should he partake of the food served by one who carnally enjoys the wife of his dead brother. Similarly, he should avoid partaking of the food served with contempt or anger, spurning,…
verses.commentary: Sense: One should particularly avoid the food served by a widowed woman who has remarried, nor should he partake of the food served by one who carnally enjoys the wife of his dead brother. Similarly, he should avoid partaking of the food served with contempt or anger, spurning,…

verses.sanskrit: नाश्नीयात् भार्यया सार्धंनैनामीक्षेत चाश्नतीम् । क्षुवन्तीं जृम्भमाणां वा नासनस्थां यथासुखम्
verses.transliteration: nāśnīyāt bhāryayā sārdhaṃnaināmīkṣeta cāśnatīm / kṣuvantīṃ jṛmbhamāṇāṃ vā nāsanasthāṃ yathāsukham
verses.translation: Even the cooked food served by the preceptor should not be eaten if it is devoid of due consecration. All the evil deeds of man are stabilised in his food.
verses.hindi: नक्षत्रेषु च सर्वेषु कार्य काम्यं विशेषतः स्वर्ग च लभते कृत्वा कृत्तिकासु द्विजोत्तमः । अपत्यमथ रोहिण्यां सौम्ये तु ब्रह्मवर्चसम् ९ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Even the cooked food served by the preceptor should not be eaten if it is devoid of due consecration. All the evil deeds of man are stabilised in his food.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even the cooked food served by the preceptor should not be eaten if it is devoid of due consecration. All the evil deeds of man are stabilised in his food.

verses.sanskrit: नोदके चात्मनो रूपं न कूलं श्वभ्रमेव वा । न लङ्घयेच्च मूत्रं वा नाधितिष्ठेत् कदाचन
verses.transliteration: nodake cātmano rūpaṃ na kūlaṃ śvabhrameva vā / na laṅghayecca mūtraṃ vā nādhitiṣṭhet kadācana
verses.translation: During night, he should scrupulously avoid every¬ thing connected with gingelly seeds as well as curds. One should not take in milk and butter milk together.
verses.hindi: रौद्राणां कर्मणां सिद्धिमार्द्रायाँ शौर्यमेव च। पुनर्वसौ तथा भूमिं श्रियं पुष्ये तथैव च
verses.wordMeaning: During night, he should scrupulously avoid every¬ thing connected with gingelly seeds as well as curds. One should not take in milk and butter milk together.
verses.commentary: Sense: During night, he should scrupulously avoid every¬ thing connected with gingelly seeds as well as curds. One should not take in milk and butter milk together.

verses.sanskrit: न शूद्राय मतिं दद्यात् कृशरं पायसं दधि । नोच्छिष्टं वा मधु घृतं न च कृष्णाजिनं हविः
verses.transliteration: na śūdrāya matiṃ dadyāt kṛśaraṃ pāyasaṃ dadhi / nocchiṣṭaṃ vā madhu ghṛtaṃ na ca kṛṣṇājinaṃ haviḥ
verses.translation: One should avoid food polluted by action, served indifferently (bhava-dusta) and polluted by bad contact (as with dogs) and by falling therein of hair, insects and dis¬ respectfully given.
verses.hindi: सर्वान् कामांस्तथा सार्पे पित्र्ये सौभाग्यमेव च। अर्यम्णे तु धनं विन्द्यात् फाल्गुन्यां पापनाशनम् सर्वान् कामान् वैश्वदेवे श्रैष्ठ्यं तु श्रवणे पुन: । श्रविष्ठायां तथा कामान् वारुणे च परं बलम्
verses.wordMeaning: One should avoid food polluted by action, served indifferently (bhava-dusta) and polluted by bad contact (as with dogs) and by falling therein of hair, insects and dis¬ respectfully given.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should avoid food polluted by action, served indifferently (bhava-dusta) and polluted by bad contact (as with dogs) and by falling therein of hair, insects and dis¬ respectfully given.

verses.sanskrit: न चैवास्मै व्रतं दद्यान्न च धर्मं वदेद् बुधः । न च क्रोधवशं गच्छेद् द्वेषं रागं च वर्जयेत्
verses.transliteration: na caivāsmai vrataṃ dadyānna ca dharmaṃ vaded budhaḥ / na ca krodhavaśaṃ gacched dveṣaṃ rāgaṃ ca varjayet
verses.translation: One shall avoid an article once smelt by a dog and cooked again. So also the article seen by a Candala, or a woman in her menses, or smelt by a cow, or seen by fallen men, shall be avoided.
verses.hindi: कौजे सर्वत्र विजयं सर्वान् कामान् बुधस्य तु
verses.wordMeaning: One shall avoid an article once smelt by a dog and cooked again. So also the article seen by a Candala, or a woman in her menses, or smelt by a cow, or seen by fallen men, shall be avoided.
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall avoid an article once smelt by a dog and cooked again. So also the article seen by a Candala, or a woman in her menses, or smelt by a cow, or seen by fallen men, shall be avoided.

verses.sanskrit: लोभं दम्भं तथा यत्नादसूयां ज्ञानकुत्सनम् । ईर्ष्यां मदं तथा शोकं मोहं च परिवर्जयेत्
verses.transliteration: lobhaṃ dambhaṃ tathā yatnādasūyāṃ jñānakutsanam / īrṣyāṃ madaṃ tathā śokaṃ mohaṃ ca parivarjayet
verses.translation: One shall eat meat in accordance with the injunc¬ tions or as enjoined at a time when life is in danger. One who eats the remainder (i.e. what is left after worship) or as a medi¬ cine or when one is powerless or is deputed, he is not affected by sin.
verses.hindi: चन्द्र और सूर्यके ग्रहणकाल तथा बान्धवोंके मरनेपर नैमित्तिक श्राद्ध करना चाहिए। ऐसा न करनेपर नारकीय गति प्राप्त होती है। ग्रहण आदिके समय किये गये काम्य श्राद्ध प्रशस्त माने गये हैं। उत्तरायण एवं दक्षिणायनके समय, विषुव तथा व्यतीपात योगें किया हुआ श्राद्ध भी अनन्त फल देनेवाला होता है। संक्रान्ति तथा जन्मके समय किया गया श्राद्ध अक्षय होता है। सभी नक्षत्रोंमें विशेषरूपसे काम्य
verses.wordMeaning: One shall eat meat in accordance with the injunc¬ tions or as enjoined at a time when life is in danger. One who eats the remainder (i.e. what is left after worship) or as a medi¬ cine or when one is powerless or is deputed, he is not affected by sin.
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall eat meat in accordance with the injunc¬ tions or as enjoined at a time when life is in danger. One who eats the remainder (i.e. what is left after worship) or as a medi¬ cine or when one is powerless or is deputed, he is not affected by sin.

verses.sanskrit: न कुर्यात् कस्यचित् पीडां सुतं शिष्यं च ताडयेत् । न हीनानुपसेवेत न च तीक्ष्णमतीन् क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: na kuryāt kasyacit pīḍāṃ sutaṃ śiṣyaṃ ca tāḍayet / na hīnānupaseveta na ca tīkṣṇamatīn kvacit
verses.translation: If a person invited for the Sraddha or the worship of a deity eschews meat he may have to be in the hell as many years as there are hairs on the body of the animal.®
verses.hindi: श्राद्ध करना चाहिए॥ ६--८॥
verses.wordMeaning: If a person invited for the Sraddha or the worship of a deity eschews meat he may have to be in the hell as many years as there are hairs on the body of the animal.®
verses.commentary: Sense: If a person invited for the Sraddha or the worship of a deity eschews meat he may have to be in the hell as many years as there are hairs on the body of the animal.®

verses.sanskrit: नात्मानं चावमन्येत दैन्यं यत्नेन वर्जयेत् । न विशिष्टानसत्कुर्यात् नात्मानं वा शपेद् बुधः
verses.transliteration: nātmānaṃ cāvamanyeta dainyaṃ yatnena varjayet / na viśiṣṭānasatkuryāt nātmānaṃ vā śaped budhaḥ
verses.translation: The established rule is that, wine should not be drunk, should not be touched and should never be thought of by the twice-born.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ द्विज कृत्तिका नक्षत्रमें श्राद्ध कर स्वर्ग प्राप करता है। रोहिणीमें श्राद्ध करनेसे संतान और मृगशिरा नक्षत्रमें श्राद्ध करनेसे ब्रह्मतेजकी प्राप्ति होती है। आद्र नक्षत्रमें श्राद्ध करनेसे रौद्र कर्मोकी सिद्धि तथा शोर्यको प्राप्ति होती है। पुनर्वसु नक्षत्रमें भूमि और पुष्य नक्षत्रमे लक्ष्मीकी प्रापि होती है। आश्लेषा नक्षत्रमें (श्राद्ध करनेसे) सभी कामनाओं और मघा नक्षत्रमें सौभाग्यको प्रापि होती है। इसी प्रकार उत्तराफाल्गुनीमें धनको
verses.wordMeaning: The established rule is that, wine should not be drunk, should not be touched and should never be thought of by the twice-born.
verses.commentary: Sense: The established rule is that, wine should not be drunk, should not be touched and should never be thought of by the twice-born.

verses.sanskrit: न नखैर्विलिखेद् भूमिं गां च संवेशयेन्न हि । न नदीषु नदीं ब्रूयात् पर्वतेषु च पर्वतान्
verses.transliteration: na nakhairvilikhed bhūmiṃ gāṃ ca saṃveśayenna hi / na nadīṣu nadīṃ brūyāt parvateṣu ca parvatān
verses.translation: Hence, one shall scrupulously avoid wine which is despicable. By drinking it, one incurs downfall and loses his merits (good acts) nor should he be talked to by Brahmin.
verses.hindi: प्रापि होती है और पूर्वाफाल्गुनीमें पापका नाश होता है। हस्त नक्षत्रमें किये गये श्राद्धसे अपनी जातिमें श्रेष्ठता और चित्रामें बहुतसे पुत्रोंकी प्राप्ति होती है। स्वातीमें व्यापारकी सिद्धि और विशाखामें सुवर्णको
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, one shall scrupulously avoid wine which is despicable. By drinking it, one incurs downfall and loses his merits (good acts) nor should he be talked to by Brahmin.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, one shall scrupulously avoid wine which is despicable. By drinking it, one incurs downfall and loses his merits (good acts) nor should he be talked to by Brahmin.

verses.sanskrit: आवासे भोजने वापि न त्यजेत् हसयायिनम् । नावगाहेदपो नग्नो वह्निं नातिव्रजेत् पदा
verses.transliteration: āvāse bhojane vāpi na tyajet hasayāyinam / nāvagāhedapo nagno vahniṃ nātivrajet padā
verses.translation: Hence, one should scrupulously avoid forbidden food¬ stuffs. He goes alone after elevation* (?). And after death goes to the hell Raurava.
verses.hindi: प्रापि होती है। अनुराधामें श्राद्ध करनेसे बहुतसे मित्रोंको तथा ज्येष्ठामें राज्यकी प्राप्ति होती है। मूल नक्षत्रमें कृषि तथा पूर्वाषाढ़ामें समुद्रतककी सफल यात्रा होती है। उत्तराषाढ़ामें सभी कामनाओंकी सिद्धि और श्रवण नक्षत्रमें श्राद्ध करनेसे श्रेष्ठता प्राप्त होती है। धनिष्ठामें सभी कामनाओं और शतभिषामें परम बलको प्राप्ति होती है। पूर्वाभाद्रपद नक्षत्रमें श्राद्ध करनेसे कुप्य अर्थात् सोना-चाँदीसे भिन्न धातुएँ और उत्तराभाद्रपदमें शुभ
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, one should scrupulously avoid forbidden food¬ stuffs. He goes alone after elevation* (?). And after death goes to the hell Raurava.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, one should scrupulously avoid forbidden food¬ stuffs. He goes alone after elevation* (?). And after death goes to the hell Raurava.

verses.sanskrit: शिरो ऽभ्यङ्गावशिष्टेन तैलेनाङ्गं न लेपयेत् । न सर्पशस्त्रैः क्रीडेत स्वानि खानि न संस्पृशेत् । रोमाणि च रहस्यानि नाशिष्टेन सह व्रजेत्
verses.transliteration: śiro 'bhyaṅgāvaśiṣṭena tailenāṅgaṃ na lepayet / na sarpaśastraiḥ krīḍeta svāni khāni na saṃspṛśet / romāṇi ca rahasyāni nāśiṣṭena saha vrajet
verses.translation: Visnu Dh.S. ch. 70; Manu IV, 175-176; VP. III. II. 107-109.
verses.hindi: गृह प्राप्त होता है। रेवती नक्षत्रमें किये गये श्राद्धसे बहुत-सी गौएँ और अश्विनीमें श्राद्ध करनेसे घोड़ोंकी प्राप्ति होती है। भरणी नक्षत्रमें यदि श्राद्ध किया जाय तो आयुकी प्रापि होती है
verses.wordMeaning: Visnu Dh.S. ch. 70; Manu IV, 175-176; VP. III. II. 107-109.
verses.commentary: Sense: Visnu Dh.S. ch. 70; Manu IV, 175-176; VP. III. II. 107-109.

verses.sanskrit: न पाणिपादवाङ्नेत्रचापल्यं समुपाश्रयेत् । न शिश्नोदरचापल्यं न च श्रवणयोः क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: na pāṇipādavāṅnetracāpalyaṃ samupāśrayet / na śiśnodaracāpalyaṃ na ca śravaṇayoḥ kvacit
verses.translation: These five morsels taken in for different vital airs (like prana, Apana etc.) are called Pranahutis 'oblations to Pranas' KP. does not mention that the 6th morsel is taken for Brahman [Brahmane svaha).
verses.hindi: रविवारको (श्राद्ध करनेसे) आरोग्य, सोमवारको सौभाग्य, मंगलबारको सर्वत्र विजय और बुधवारको श्राद्धसे सभी कामनाओंकी सिद्धि होती है । बृहस्पतिवारके दिन श्राद्धसे अभीष्ट विद्या, शुक्रवारके दिन श्राद्धसे धन और शनैश्वरको (श्राद्ध करनेसे) आयु प्राप्त होती है।
verses.wordMeaning: These five morsels taken in for different vital airs (like prana, Apana etc.) are called Pranahutis 'oblations to Pranas' KP. does not mention that the 6th morsel is taken for Brahman [Brahmane svaha).
verses.commentary: Sense: These five morsels taken in for different vital airs (like prana, Apana etc.) are called Pranahutis 'oblations to Pranas' KP. does not mention that the 6th morsel is taken for Brahman [Brahmane svaha).

verses.sanskrit: न चाङ्गनखवादं वै कुर्यान्नाञ्जलिना पिबेत् । नाभिहन्याज्जलं पद्भ्यां पाणिना वा कदाचन
verses.transliteration: na cāṅganakhavādaṃ vai kuryānnāñjalinā pibet / nābhihanyājjalaṃ padbhyāṃ pāṇinā vā kadācana
verses.translation: One should take food with five things wet. The plate should be placed on the ground. Manu, the Prajapati, says that it (such manner of eating) is on a par with the observance of fasts.
verses.hindi: कन्यकां वै द्वितीयायां तृतीयायां तु वन्दिनः । पशून् ्षुदरांश्चतुर्थ्या तु पञ्चम्यां शोभनान् सुतान्
verses.wordMeaning: One should take food with five things wet. The plate should be placed on the ground. Manu, the Prajapati, says that it (such manner of eating) is on a par with the observance of fasts.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should take food with five things wet. The plate should be placed on the ground. Manu, the Prajapati, says that it (such manner of eating) is on a par with the observance of fasts.

verses.sanskrit: न शातयेदिष्टकाभिः फलानि न फलेन च । न म्लेच्छभाषां शिक्षेत नाकर्षेच्च पदासनम्
verses.transliteration: na śātayediṣṭakābhiḥ phalāni na phalena ca / na mlecchabhāṣāṃ śikṣeta nākarṣecca padāsanam
verses.translation: One should take food with five things wet as follows: the place should be well smeared (with cowdung) and clean; the hands and the feet should be washed; he should perform Acamana and keep the face wet, and he should not be furious.®
verses.hindi: एकादश्यां तथा रूप्यं ब्रह्मवर्चस्विनः सुतान् पञ्चदश्यां सर्वकामानाप्नोति श्राद्धदः सदा
verses.wordMeaning: One should take food with five things wet as follows: the place should be well smeared (with cowdung) and clean; the hands and the feet should be washed; he should perform Acamana and keep the face wet, and he should not be furious.®
verses.commentary: Sense: One should take food with five things wet as follows: the place should be well smeared (with cowdung) and clean; the hands and the feet should be washed; he should perform Acamana and keep the face wet, and he should not be furious.®

verses.sanskrit: न भेदनमवस्फोटं छेदनं वा विलेखनम् । कुर्याद् विमर्दनं धीमान् नाकस्मादेव निष्फलम्
verses.transliteration: na bhedanamavasphoṭaṃ chedanaṃ vā vilekhanam / kuryād vimardanaṃ dhīmān nākasmādeva niṣphalam
verses.translation: He should sprinkle food with water repeating the great Vjdhrtis. He should sip water ritualistically repeating the 'M.z.ntTS. Amrtopastaranamasi (you are the seat of Amrta)
verses.hindi: तस्माच्छ्राद्धं न कर्तव्यं चतुर्दश्यां द्विजातिभिः । शस्त्रेण तु हतानां वै तत्र श्राद्धं प्रकल्पयेत्
verses.wordMeaning: He should sprinkle food with water repeating the great Vjdhrtis. He should sip water ritualistically repeating the 'M.z.ntTS. Amrtopastaranamasi (you are the seat of Amrta)
verses.commentary: Sense: He should sprinkle food with water repeating the great Vjdhrtis. He should sip water ritualistically repeating the 'M.z.ntTS. Amrtopastaranamasi (you are the seat of Amrta)

verses.sanskrit: नोत्सङ्गेभक्षयेद् भक्ष्यं वृथा चेष्टां च नाचरेत् । न नृत्येदथवा गायेन्न वादित्राणि वादयेत्
verses.transliteration: notsaṅgebhakṣayed bhakṣyaṃ vṛthā ceṣṭāṃ ca nācaret / na nṛtyedathavā gāyenna vāditrāṇi vādayet
verses.translation: They praise the early morning ablution which brings forth visible and invisible benefits; there is no doubt in this that the sagehood of the sages is due to their daily ablution in the early morning.
verses.hindi: ट्रव्यब्राह्मणसम्पत्तौ न कालनियमः कृतः। तस्माद् भोगापवर्गार्थं श्राद्धं कु युरद्विजातयः कर्मारम्भेषु सर्वेषु कुर्यादाभ्युदयं पुनः। पुत्रजन्मादिषु श्राद्धं पार्वणं पर्वणि स्मृतम्
verses.wordMeaning: They praise the early morning ablution which brings forth visible and invisible benefits; there is no doubt in this that the sagehood of the sages is due to their daily ablution in the early morning.
verses.commentary: Sense: They praise the early morning ablution which brings forth visible and invisible benefits; there is no doubt in this that the sagehood of the sages is due to their daily ablution in the early morning.

verses.sanskrit: न संहताभ्यां पाणिभ्यां कण्डूयेदात्मनः शिरः । न लौकिकैः स्तवैर्देवांस्तोषयेद् बाह्यजैरपि
verses.transliteration: na saṃhatābhyāṃ pāṇibhyāṃ kaṇḍūyedātmanaḥ śiraḥ / na laukikaiḥ stavairdevāṃstoṣayed bāhyajairapi
verses.translation: When a man is asleep, the saliva drips constantly from his mouth. Hence, no one should perform any holy rite without taking bath at the outset.
verses.hindi: अहन्यहनि नित्यं स्यात् काम्यं नैमित्तिकं पुनः । एकोद्दिष्टादि विज्ञेयं वृद्धिश्राद्ध तु पार्वणम्
verses.wordMeaning: When a man is asleep, the saliva drips constantly from his mouth. Hence, no one should perform any holy rite without taking bath at the outset.
verses.commentary: Sense: When a man is asleep, the saliva drips constantly from his mouth. Hence, no one should perform any holy rite without taking bath at the outset.

verses.sanskrit: नाक्षैः क्रीडेन्न धावेत नाप्सु विण्मूत्रमाचरेत् । नोच्छिष्टः संविशेन्नित्यं न नग्नः स्नानमाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: nākṣaiḥ krīḍenna dhāveta nāpsu viṇmūtramācaret / nocchiṣṭaḥ saṃviśennityaṃ na nagnaḥ snānamācaret
verses.translation: He should eat the remaining food as he pleases, mixing it with side dishes, pickles etc. After meditating on the Devas with full concentration, he should meditate on Atman, the Prajapati.
verses.hindi: एतत् पञ्चविधं श्राद्धं मनुना परिकीर्तितम्। यात्रायां षष्ठमाख्यातं तत्प्रयत्नेन पालयेत् हैविकं चाष्टमं श्राद्धं यत्कृत्वा मुच्यते भयात्
verses.wordMeaning: He should eat the remaining food as he pleases, mixing it with side dishes, pickles etc. After meditating on the Devas with full concentration, he should meditate on Atman, the Prajapati.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should eat the remaining food as he pleases, mixing it with side dishes, pickles etc. After meditating on the Devas with full concentration, he should meditate on Atman, the Prajapati.

verses.sanskrit: न गच्छेन्न पठेद् वापि न चैव स्वशिरः स्पृशेत् । न दन्तैर्नखरोमाणि छिन्द्यात् सुप्तं न बोधयेत्
verses.transliteration: na gacchenna paṭhed vāpi na caiva svaśiraḥ spṛśet / na dantairnakharomāṇi chindyāt suptaṃ na bodhayet
verses.translation: He should then sip water ritualistically repeating the Mantra Amrtdpidhdnam asi. You are the cover of the Nectar). After performing Acamana rite, he should perform the rite once again, repeating the Mantra Ayarh gauh etc.
verses.hindi: संध्यारात्र्योर्न कर्तव्यं राहोरन्यत्र दर्शनात्। देशानां च विशेषेण भवेत् पुण्यमनन्तकम्
verses.wordMeaning: He should then sip water ritualistically repeating the Mantra Amrtdpidhdnam asi. You are the cover of the Nectar). After performing Acamana rite, he should perform the rite once again, repeating the Mantra Ayarh gauh etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should then sip water ritualistically repeating the Mantra Amrtdpidhdnam asi. You are the cover of the Nectar). After performing Acamana rite, he should perform the rite once again, repeating the Mantra Ayarh gauh etc.

verses.sanskrit: न बालातपमासेवेत् प्रेतधूमं विवर्जयेत् । नैकः सुप्याच्छून्यगृहे स्वयं नोपानहौ हरेत्
verses.transliteration: na bālātapamāsevet pretadhūmaṃ vivarjayet / naikaḥ supyācchūnyagṛhe svayaṃ nopānahau haret
verses.translation: Or he should repeat the Drupada Mantra three times. It is destructive of all sins. He should then stroke his belly repeating the Mantra Prdtidndrh granthirasi (you are the knot of vital airs).
verses.hindi: प्रतिपदा तिथिको (श्राद्ध करनेसे) शुभ पुत्र प्राप्त होते हैं। द्वितीयामें श्राद्धसे कन्या, तृतीयामें वन्दीजनों, चतुर्थीमें क्षुद्र पशु और पञ्चमीको श्राद्ध करनेसे सुन्दर पुत्रोंकी प्राप्ति होती है। षष्ठीमें श्राद्ध करनेसे द्यूत मिलते हैं। एकादशीको (श्राद्ध करनेसे) रौप्य (रजत) पदार्थ तथा ब्रह्मवर्चस्वी पुत्रोंकी प्राप्ति होती है । द्वादशीको (श्राद्ध करनेसे) जातरूप (स्वर्ण), चाँदी तथा कुप्य, त्रयोदशीको जातिमें श्रेष्ठता और चतुर्दशीको श्राद्ध करनेसे
verses.wordMeaning: Or he should repeat the Drupada Mantra three times. It is destructive of all sins. He should then stroke his belly repeating the Mantra Prdtidndrh granthirasi (you are the knot of vital airs).
verses.commentary: Sense: Or he should repeat the Drupada Mantra three times. It is destructive of all sins. He should then stroke his belly repeating the Mantra Prdtidndrh granthirasi (you are the knot of vital airs).

verses.sanskrit: नाकारणाद् वा निष्ठीवेन्न बाहुभ्यां नदीं तरेत् । न पादक्षालनं कुर्यात् पादेनैव कदाचन
verses.transliteration: nākāraṇād vā niṣṭhīvenna bāhubhyāṃ nadīṃ taret / na pādakṣālanaṃ kuryāt pādenaiva kadācana
verses.translation: (Defective verse). After performing the rite,
verses.hindi: कुप्रजाकी प्राप्ति होती है। पञ्चदशी (पूर्णिमा एवं अमावास्या)-को श्राद्ध करनेवाला सदा सभी कामनाओंको प्राप्त करता है
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective verse). After performing the rite,
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective verse). After performing the rite,

verses.sanskrit: नाग्नौ प्रतापयेत् पादौ न कांस्ये धावयेद् बुधः । नाभिप्रासरयेद् देवं ब्राह्मणान् गामथापि वा । वाय्वग्निगुरुविप्रान् वा सूर्यं वा शशिनं प्रति
verses.transliteration: nāgnau pratāpayet pādau na kāṃsye dhāvayed budhaḥ / nābhiprāsarayed devaṃ brāhmaṇān gāmathāpi vā / vāyvagniguruviprān vā sūryaṃ vā śaśinaṃ prati
verses.translation: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.
verses.hindi: इसलिये द्विजातियोंको चतुर्दशीके दिन श्राद्ध नहीं करना चाहिए। शस्त्र (आदि)-द्वारा जो मरे हुए हों, उनका श्राद्ध (इस चतुर्दशी तिथिको) करना चाहिए। द्रव्य एवं ब्राह्मणके उपलब्ध रहनेपर कालसम्बन्धी कोई नियम नहीं बताया गया है (अर्थात् कभी भी श्राद्ध किया जा सकता है)। इसलिये भोग और मोक्षकी प्राप्तिक लिये द्विजातियोंको श्राद्ध (अवश्य) करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.

verses.sanskrit: अशुद्धः शयनं यानं स्वाध्यायं स्नानवाहनम् । बहिर्निष्क्रमणं चैव न कुर्वोत कथञ्चन
verses.transliteration: aśuddhaḥ śayanaṃ yānaṃ svādhyāyaṃ snānavāhanam / bahirniṣkramaṇaṃ caiva na kurvota kathañcana
verses.translation: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.
verses.hindi: सभी (शुभ) कर्मोके प्रारम्भमें तथा पुत्रजन्म आदि समयोंमें आभ्युदयिक श्राद्ध करना चाहिए। पर्वके दिन पार्वण श्राद्ध करना चाहिए। मनुने प्रतिदिन किये जानेवाले नित्यश्राद्ध, काम्य-श्राद्ध (कामनाविशेषकी
verses.wordMeaning: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.

verses.sanskrit: स्वप्नमध्ययनं स्नानमुद्वर्तं भोजनं गतिम् । उभयोः संध्ययोर्नित्यं मध्याह्ने चैव वर्जयेत्
verses.transliteration: svapnamadhyayanaṃ snānamudvartaṃ bhojanaṃ gatim / ubhayoḥ saṃdhyayornityaṃ madhyāhne caiva varjayet
verses.translation: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.
verses.hindi: सिद्धिके लिये किया जानेवाला श्राद्ध), एकोद्दिष्टादि प्रकारके श्राद्धोंका वर्णन किया है । यात्राके समय (किया
verses.wordMeaning: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.

verses.sanskrit: न स्पृशेत् पाणिनोच्छिष्टो विप्रोगोब्राह्मणानलान् । न चासनं पदा वापि न देवप्रतिमां स्पृशेत्
verses.transliteration: na spṛśet pāṇinocchiṣṭo viprogobrāhmaṇānalān / na cāsanaṃ padā vāpi na devapratimāṃ spṛśet
verses.translation: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.
verses.hindi: करना चाहिए। ब्रह्माने शुद्धिके लिये सातवें श्राद्धका वर्णन किया है। आठवाँ हैविक नामक श्राद्ध है, जिसे करनेसे भयसे मुक्ति हो जाती है। संध्या और रात्रिमें श्राद्ध नहीं करना चाहिए। किंतु राहु और केतुद्वारा सुर्य-
verses.wordMeaning: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.

verses.sanskrit: नाशुद्धो ऽग्निं परिचरेन्न देवान् कीर्तयेदृषीन् । नावगाहेदगाधाम्बु धारयेन्नानिमित्ततः
verses.transliteration: nāśuddho 'gniṃ paricarenna devān kīrtayedṛṣīn / nāvagāhedagādhāmbu dhārayennānimittataḥ
verses.translation: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.
verses.hindi: चन्द्रके ग्रस्त किये जानेपर रात्रिमें भी श्राद्ध किया जा सकता है। देशविशेषके कारण श्राद्ध अनन्त पुण्य फल देनेवाला होता है गङ्गायामक्षयं श्राद्धं प्रयागेऽमरकण्टके । गायन्ति पितरो गाथां कीर्तयन्ति मनीषिणः
verses.wordMeaning: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.

verses.sanskrit: न वामहस्तेनोद्धत्य पिबेद् वक्त्रेण वा जलम् । नोत्तरेदनुपस्पृश्य नाप्सु रेतः समुत्सृजेत्
verses.transliteration: na vāmahastenoddhatya pibed vaktreṇa vā jalam / nottaredanupaspṛśya nāpsu retaḥ samutsṛjet
verses.translation: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.
verses.hindi: तेषां तु समवेतानां यद्येकोऽपि गयां ब्रजेत्
verses.wordMeaning: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.

verses.sanskrit: अमेध्यलिप्तमन्यद् वा लोहितं वा विषाणि वा । व्यतिक्रमेन्न स्त्रवन्तीं नाप्सु मैथुनमाचरेत् । चैत्यं वृक्षं न वै छिन्द्यान्नाप्सु ष्ठीवनमाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: amedhyaliptamanyad vā lohitaṃ vā viṣāṇi vā / vyatikramenna stravantīṃ nāpsu maithunamācaret / caityaṃ vṛkṣaṃ na vai chindyānnāpsu ṣṭhīvanamācaret
verses.translation: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.
verses.hindi: वाराणस्यां विशेषेण यत्र देवः स्वयं हरः गङ्काद्वारे प्रभासे च बिल्वके नीलपर्वते। कुरुक्षेत्रे च कुब्जाम्रे भृगुतुङ्गे महालये
verses.wordMeaning: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.

verses.sanskrit: नास्थिभस्मकपालानि न केशान्न च कण्टकान् । तुषाङ्गारकरीषं वा नाधितिष्ठेत् कदाचन
verses.transliteration: nāsthibhasmakapālāni na keśānna ca kaṇṭakān / tuṣāṅgārakarīṣaṃ vā nādhitiṣṭhet kadācana
verses.translation: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.
verses.hindi: केदारे फल्गुतीर्थे च नैमिषारण्य एव च। सरस्वत्यां विशेषेण पुष्करेषु विशेषतः
verses.wordMeaning: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.

verses.sanskrit: न चाग्निं लङ्घयेद् धीमान् नोपदध्यादधः क्वचित् । न चैनं पादतः कुर्यान्मुखेन न धमेद् बुधः
verses.transliteration: na cāgniṃ laṅghayed dhīmān nopadadhyādadhaḥ kvacit / na cainaṃ pādataḥ kuryānmukhena na dhamed budhaḥ
verses.translation: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.
verses.hindi: नर्मदायां कुशावर्ते श्रीशैले भद्रकर्णके । वेत्रवत्यां विपाशायां गोदावर्या विशेषतः आम्रान् पानेरतानिक्षून् मृद्वीकांश्च सदाडिमान्। विदार्याश्च भरण्डाश्च श्राद्धकाले प्रदापयेत्
verses.wordMeaning: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.

verses.sanskrit: न कूपमवरोहेत नावेक्षेताशुचिः क्वचित् । अग्नौ न च क्षिपेदग्निं नाद्भिः प्रशमयेत् तथा
verses.transliteration: na kūpamavaroheta nāvekṣetāśuciḥ kvacit / agnau na ca kṣipedagniṃ nādbhiḥ praśamayet tathā
verses.translation: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.
verses.hindi: लाजान् मधुयुतान् दद्यात् सक्तून् शर्करया सह। दद्याच्छाद्धे प्रयत्नेन शृङ्राटककशेरुकान्
verses.wordMeaning: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.

verses.sanskrit: सुहृन्मरणमार्तिं वा न स्वयं श्रावयेत् परान् । अपण्यं कूटपण्यं वा विक्रये न प्रयोजयेत्
verses.transliteration: suhṛnmaraṇamārtiṃ vā na svayaṃ śrāvayet parān / apaṇyaṃ kūṭapaṇyaṃ vā vikraye na prayojayet
verses.translation: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.
verses.hindi: द्वौ मासौ मत्स्यमांसेन त्रीन् मासान् हारिणेन तु। औरभ्रेणाथ चतुरः शाकुनेनेह पञ्च तु षण्मासांश्छागमांसेन पार्षतेनाथ सप्त वै। अष्टावेणस्य मांसेन रौरवेण नवैव तु
verses.wordMeaning: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.

verses.sanskrit: न वह्निं मुखनिश्वासैर् ज्वालयेन्नाशुचिर्बुधः । पुण्यस्थानोदकस्थाने सीमान्तं वा कृषेन्न तु
verses.transliteration: na vahniṃ mukhaniśvāsair jvālayennāśucirbudhaḥ / puṇyasthānodakasthāne sīmāntaṃ vā kṛṣenna tu
verses.translation: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.
verses.hindi: शशकूर्मयोर्मासेन मासानेकादशैव तु
verses.wordMeaning: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.

verses.sanskrit: न भिन्द्यात् पूर्वसमयमभ्युपेतं कदाचन । परस्परं पशून् व्यालान् पक्षिणो नावबोधयेत्
verses.transliteration: na bhindyāt pūrvasamayamabhyupetaṃ kadācana / parasparaṃ paśūn vyālān pakṣiṇo nāvabodhayet
verses.translation: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.
verses.hindi: संवत्सरं तु गव्येन पयसा पायसेन तु। वार्धीणसस्य मांसेन तृसिरद्वादशवार्षिकी
verses.wordMeaning: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.

verses.sanskrit: परबाधं न कुर्वोत जलवातातपादिभिः । कारयित्वा स्वकर्माणि कारून् पश्चान्न वञ्चयेत् । सायंप्रातर् गृहद्वारान् भिक्षार्थं नावघट्टयेत्
verses.transliteration: parabādhaṃ na kurvota jalavātātapādibhiḥ / kārayitvā svakarmāṇi kārūn paścānna vañcayet / sāyaṃprātar gṛhadvārān bhikṣārthaṃ nāvaghaṭṭayet
verses.translation: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.
verses.hindi: गङ्गा, प्रयाग तथा अमरकण्टकमें किया गया श्राद्ध अक्षय फल प्रदान करता है। पितर इस गाथाका गान करते हैं और मनीषी ऐसा कीर्तन करते रहते हैं कि 'शीलवान् तथा गुणवान् बहुतसे पुत्रोंकी इच्छा करनी
verses.wordMeaning: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.

verses.sanskrit: बहिर्माल्यं बहिर्गन्धं भार्यया सह भोजनम् । विगृह्य वादं कुद्वारप्रवेशं च विवर्जयेत्
verses.transliteration: bahirmālyaṃ bahirgandhaṃ bhāryayā saha bhojanam / vigṛhya vādaṃ kudvārapraveśaṃ ca vivarjayet
verses.translation: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.
verses.hindi: चाहिए, क्योंकि उनमेंसे कोई एक भी किसी प्रसंगवश गया चला जाय और गया पहुँचकर यदि श्राद्ध कर दे तो उसके द्वारा पितर तार दिये जाते हैं (अर्थात् पितरोंको उत्तमोत्तम गति प्राप्त होती है) और वह (श्राद्धकर्ता) परमगतिको प्राप्त करता है'
verses.wordMeaning: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.

verses.sanskrit: न खादन्ब्राह्मणस्तिष्ठेन्न जल्पेद् वा हसन् बुधः । स्वमग्निं नैव हस्तेन स्पृशेन्नाप्सु चिरं वसेत्
verses.transliteration: na khādanbrāhmaṇastiṣṭhenna jalped vā hasan budhaḥ / svamagniṃ naiva hastena spṛśennāpsu ciraṃ vaset
verses.translation: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.
verses.hindi: वराह पर्वत, विशेषरूपसे गङ्गा तथा जहाँ स्वयं भगवान् हर निवास करते हैं विशेषतया उस वाराणसी,
verses.wordMeaning: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.

verses.sanskrit: न पक्षकेणोपधमेन्न शूर्पेण न पाणिना । मुखे नैव धमेदग्निं मुखादग्निरजायत
verses.transliteration: na pakṣakeṇopadhamenna śūrpeṇa na pāṇinā / mukhe naiva dhamedagniṃ mukhādagnirajāyata
verses.translation: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.
verses.hindi: कुरुक्षेत्र, कुन्जाम्रतीर्थ, भृगुतुङ्ग, महालय, केदारपर्वत, फल्गुतीर्थ, नैमिषारण्य, विशेषरूपसे सरस्वती नदी तथा पुष्कर, नर्मदा, कुशावर्त, श्रीशैल, भद्रकर्णक, वेत्रवती, विपाशा तथा विशेषरूपसे गोदावरी नदी आदि स्थानों तथा अन्य तीर्थो, पुलिनों और नदियोंके तटोंपर किये गये श्राद्धसे पितर सदा संतुष्ट होते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.

verses.sanskrit: परस्त्रियं न भाषेत नायाज्यं याजयेद् द्विजः । नैकश्चरेत् सभां विप्रः समवायं च वर्जयेत्
verses.transliteration: parastriyaṃ na bhāṣeta nāyājyaṃ yājayed dvijaḥ / naikaścaret sabhāṃ vipraḥ samavāyaṃ ca varjayet
