verses.translation: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.
verses.hindi: तथा मुद्रद्वारा किये गये श्राद्धसे पितर एक महीनेतक प्रसन्न रहते हैं। आम, पानेरत (पानेण, करमईद अर्थात् करौंदा या करमर्द), ईख, द्राक्षा (अंगूर),
verses.wordMeaning: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.

verses.sanskrit: न देवायतनं गच्छेत् कदाचिद् वाप्रदक्षिणम् । न वीजयेद् वा वस्त्रेण न देवायतने स्वपेत्
verses.transliteration: na devāyatanaṃ gacchet kadācid vāpradakṣiṇam / na vījayed vā vastreṇa na devāyatane svapet
verses.translation: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.
verses.hindi: इन्हें आद्धके समय प्रदान करना चाहिए। मधुयुक्त लाजा, शर्कराके साथ सत्तू सिंघाड़ा तथा कसेरू-हहें श्रद्धमें प्रयत्नपूर्वक देना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.

verses.sanskrit: नैको ऽध्वानं प्रपद्येत नाधार्मिकजनैः सह । न व्याधिदूषितैर्वापि न शूद्रैः पतितेन वा
verses.transliteration: naiko 'dhvānaṃ prapadyeta nādhārmikajanaiḥ saha / na vyādhidūṣitairvāpi na śūdraiḥ patitena vā
verses.translation: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.
verses.hindi: १-वराहपर्वतकी चर्चा वहिपुराणमें तथा महाभारत (२। २१। २) -में है। २-पुलिन-(नदीके किनारेका वह भाग जहासे जल हटा हो (--तोयोत्थितं तत् पुलिनम्) । (अमरकोश)
verses.wordMeaning: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.

verses.sanskrit: नोपानद्वर्जितो वाथ जलादिरहितस्तथा । न रात्रौ नारिणा सार्धं न विना च कमण्डलुम् । नाग्निगोब्राह्मणादीनामन्तरेण व्रजेत् क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: nopānadvarjito vātha jalādirahitastathā / na rātrau nāriṇā sārdhaṃ na vinā ca kamaṇḍalum / nāgnigobrāhmaṇādīnāmantareṇa vrajet kvacit
verses.translation: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.
verses.hindi: कालशाकं महाशल्कं खड्गलोहामिषं मधु । आनन्त्यायैव कल्पन्ते मुन्यन्नानि च सर्वशः कूष्माण्डालाबुवार्ताकान् भूस्तृणं सुरसं तथा
verses.wordMeaning: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.

verses.sanskrit: न वत्सतन्त्रीं विततामतिक्रामेत् क्वचिद् द्विजः । न निन्देद् योगिनः सिद्धान् व्रतिनो वायतींस्तथा
verses.transliteration: na vatsatantrīṃ vitatāmatikrāmet kvacid dvijaḥ / na ninded yoginaḥ siddhān vratino vāyatīṃstathā
verses.translation: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.
verses.hindi: कोद्रवान् कोविदारांश्च पालक्यान् मरिंचांस्तथा। वर्जयेत् सर्वयत्नेन श्राद्धकाले द्विजोत्तमः
verses.wordMeaning: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.

verses.sanskrit: देवतायतनं प्राज्ञो देवानां चैव सत्रिणाम् । नाक्रामेत् कामतश्छायां ब्राह्मणानां च गोरपि
verses.transliteration: devatāyatanaṃ prājño devānāṃ caiva satriṇām / nākrāmet kāmataśchāyāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca gorapi
verses.translation: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.
verses.hindi: श्राद्धमें पिप्पली, सुपारी, मसूर, कूष्माण्ड, (वर्तुलाकार- गोल) लौकी, बैगन, रसयुक्त भूस्तृण, लोकभाषामें) और भेंसके दूधका प्रयोग नहीं करना चाहिए । श्रेष्ठ द्विजको श्राद्धमें कोदो, कोविदार (कचनार), पालक तथा मरिचका प्रयत्नपूर्वक त्याग करना
verses.wordMeaning: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.

verses.sanskrit: स्वां तु नाक्रमयेच्छायां पतिताद्यैर्न रोगिभिः । नाङ्गारभस्मकेशादिष्वधितिष्ठेत् कदाचन
verses.transliteration: svāṃ tu nākramayecchāyāṃ patitādyairna rogibhiḥ / nāṅgārabhasmakeśādiṣvadhitiṣṭhet kadācana
verses.translation: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे बद्साहस्त्रथां संहितायामुपरिविभागे विंशोऽध्यायः
verses.wordMeaning: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.

verses.sanskrit: वर्जयेन्मार्जनीरेणुं स्नानवस्त्रघचोदकम् । न भक्षयेदभक्ष्याणि नापेयं च पिबेद् द्विजः
verses.transliteration: varjayenmārjanīreṇuṃ snānavastraghacodakam / na bhakṣayedabhakṣyāṇi nāpeyaṃ ca pibed dvijaḥ
verses.translation: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.
verses.hindi: इक्कोसवाँ अध्याय श्राद्ध-प्रकरणमें निमन्त्रणके योग्य पंक्तिपावन ब्राह्मणों तथा त्याज्य पंक्ति-दूषकोंके लक्षण ये सोमपा विरजसो धर्मज्ञाः शान्तचेतसः। व्रतिनो नियमस्थाश्च ऋतुकालाभिगामिनः
verses.wordMeaning: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ablution can be briefly divided into six types viz.: 1) Brahma, 2) Agneya, 3) Vayavya, 4) Divya, 5) Varuna and 6) Yaugika.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे षोडशो ऽध्यायः व्यास उवाच नाद्याच्छूद्रस्य विप्रो ऽन्नं मोहाद् वा यदि वान्यतः । स शूद्रयोनिं व्रजति यस्तु भुङ्क्ते ह्यनापदि
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge ṣoḍaśo 'dhyāyaḥ vyāsa uvāca nādyācchūdrasya vipro 'nnaṃ mohād vā yadi vānyataḥ / sa śūdrayoniṃ vrajati yastu bhuṅkte hyanāpadi
verses.translation: Among all Yogas, Atmayoga is the greatest. He who shall perform everything in accordance with these injunctions is himself a wise sage.*
verses.hindi: व्यासजी बोले--द्विजको चाहिए कि चन्द्रमाके क्षय होनेपर अर्थात् अमावास्याको स्त्रानकर यथोक्त रीतिसे पितरोंका तर्पण करके शान्तचित्त होकर तथा पचित्रतापूर्वक पिण्डान्वाहार्यक श्राद्ध करे। (श्राद्धसे)
verses.wordMeaning: Among all Yogas, Atmayoga is the greatest. He who shall perform everything in accordance with these injunctions is himself a wise sage.*
verses.commentary: Sense: Among all Yogas, Atmayoga is the greatest. He who shall perform everything in accordance with these injunctions is himself a wise sage.*

verses.sanskrit: षण्मासान् यो द्विजो भुङ्क्ते शूद्रस्यान्नं विगर्हितम् । जीवन्नेव भवेच्छूद्रो मृतः श्वा चाभिजायते
verses.transliteration: ṣaṇmāsān yo dvijo bhuṅkte śūdrasyānnaṃ vigarhitam / jīvanneva bhavecchūdro mṛtaḥ śvā cābhijāyate
verses.translation: One shall take food with the sacred thread on (his left shoulder— Upavita fashion) and embellished with scented garlands. He should not take food in the twilights of the morning and evening especially at dusk.
verses.hindi: पूर्व ही वेदमें पारंगत विद्वान् ब्राह्मणका अन्वेषण करना चाहिए, क्योंकि उसे ही (वेदपारग ब्राह्मणको ही) हव्य, कव्य, तीर्थ और दानका अतिथि (अधिकारी) कहा गया है जो सोमपायी, रजोगुणसे हीन, धर्मको जाननेवाले, शान्तचित्त, व्रतपरायण, नियममें स्थित, ऋतुकालमें गमन करनेवाले हैं (वे ब्राह्मण पंक्तिपावन हैं)। पञ्चाग्रिका सेवन करनेवाला, अध्ययनशील, यजुर्वेदका ज्ञाता, बहवृच्
verses.wordMeaning: One shall take food with the sacred thread on (his left shoulder— Upavita fashion) and embellished with scented garlands. He should not take food in the twilights of the morning and evening especially at dusk.
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall take food with the sacred thread on (his left shoulder— Upavita fashion) and embellished with scented garlands. He should not take food in the twilights of the morning and evening especially at dusk.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणक्षत्रियविशां शूद्रस्य च मुनीश्वराः । यस्यान्नेनोदरस्थेन मृतस्तद्योनिमाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśāṃ śūdrasya ca munīśvarāḥ / yasyānnenodarasthena mṛtastadyonimāpnuyāt
verses.translation: One should not take food immediately before the Solar eclipse.1 If there is a lunar eclipse, he should not take food in that evening. In the course of the duration of the eclipse also, one should not take food. After the liberation (i.e. close of the eclipse), he should (first) take bath and take food.
verses.hindi: (ऋग्वेदी) त्रिसौपर्ण' तथा त्रिमधु अर्थात् ऋग्वेदके
verses.wordMeaning: One should not take food immediately before the Solar eclipse.1 If there is a lunar eclipse, he should not take food in that evening. In the course of the duration of the eclipse also, one should not take food. After the liberation (i.e. close of the eclipse),…
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not take food immediately before the Solar eclipse.1 If there is a lunar eclipse, he should not take food in that evening. In the course of the duration of the eclipse also, one should not take food. After the liberation (i.e. close of the eclipse),…

verses.sanskrit: राजान्नं नर्तकान्नं च तक्ष्णो ऽन्नं चर्मकारिणः । गणान्नं गणिकान्नं च षण्ढान्नं चैव वर्जयेत्
verses.transliteration: rājānnaṃ nartakānnaṃ ca takṣṇo 'nnaṃ carmakāriṇaḥ / gaṇānnaṃ gaṇikānnaṃ ca ṣaṇḍhānnaṃ caiva varjayet
verses.translation: When the moon is liberated, one may take food un¬ less it happens in the second or the third watch of the night. If the sun or the moon sets before liberation (i.e. if the eclipse is not over when they set), he should take food only the next day after seeing (the liberated sun or the moon as the case may be).
verses.hindi: बस्ृचश्च त्रिसौपर्णस्त्रिमधुर्वाथ यो भवेत्॥ ४॥  अंश-विशेषका अध्येता, १-ऋग्वेदका विशेष वेदभाग एवं उसका व्रत त्रिसुपर्ण कहा जाता है, अतः इसके सम्बन्धसे ब्राह्मणको त्रिसुपर्ण या त्रिसौपर्ण कहा
verses.wordMeaning: When the moon is liberated, one may take food un¬ less it happens in the second or the third watch of the night. If the sun or the moon sets before liberation (i.e. if the eclipse is not over when they set),…
verses.commentary: Sense: When the moon is liberated, one may take food un¬ less it happens in the second or the third watch of the night. If the sun or the moon sets before liberation (i.e. if the eclipse is not over when they set),…

verses.sanskrit: चक्रोपजीविरजकतस्करध्वजिनां तथा । गान्धर्वलोहकारान्नं सूतकान्नं च वर्जयेत्
verses.transliteration: cakropajīvirajakataskaradhvajināṃ tathā / gāndharvalohakārānnaṃ sūtakānnaṃ ca varjayet
verses.translation: One should not be wicked-minded enough to take foodwithout giving anything to the lookers-on. He should partake of the remainder after the Yajna. One should not take food while one is angry or when the mind is elsewhere.
verses.wordMeaning: One should not be wicked-minded enough to take foodwithout giving anything to the lookers-on. He should partake of the remainder after the Yajna. One should not take food while one is angry or when the mind is elsewhere.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not be wicked-minded enough to take foodwithout giving anything to the lookers-on. He should partake of the remainder after the Yajna. One should not take food while one is angry or when the mind is elsewhere.

verses.sanskrit: कुलालचित्रकर्मान्नं वार्धुषेः पतितस्य च । पौनर्भवच्छत्रिकयोरभिशस्तस्य चैव हि
verses.transliteration: kulālacitrakarmānnaṃ vārdhuṣeḥ patitasya ca / paunarbhavacchatrikayorabhiśastasya caiva hi
verses.translation: Indeed, one's life is in vain, if the food is solely taken only by oneself, if the intercourse is solely for sexual pleasure, if the sole purpose of learning is to take up an avocation.
verses.hindi: २-तीन वार मधु शब्द जिन ऋचाओंमें आया है, वे 'मधुव्वाता......' आदि तीन ऋचाएँ (शब्दकल्पद्रुम) । त्रिणाचिकेतच्छन्दोगो ज्येष्ठसामग एव च। अधर्वशिरसोऽध्येता रुद्राध्यायी विशेषतः
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, one's life is in vain, if the food is solely taken only by oneself, if the intercourse is solely for sexual pleasure, if the sole purpose of learning is to take up an avocation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, one's life is in vain, if the food is solely taken only by oneself, if the intercourse is solely for sexual pleasure, if the sole purpose of learning is to take up an avocation.

verses.sanskrit: सुवर्णकारशैलूषव्याधबद्धातुरस्य च । चिकित्सकस्य चैवान्नं पुंश्चल्या दण्डिकस्य च
verses.transliteration: suvarṇakāraśailūṣavyādhabaddhāturasya ca / cikitsakasya caivānnaṃ puṃścalyā daṇḍikasya ca
verses.translation: If one takes food with the head covered with a cloth, or facing the north or with the shoes on, it is an Asuraic (demonic) practice.
verses.hindi: ऋषिव्रती ऋषीकश्च तथा द्वादशवार्षिकः । ब्रह्मदेयानुसंतानो गर्भशुद्धः सहस्त्रदः
verses.wordMeaning: If one takes food with the head covered with a cloth, or facing the north or with the shoes on, it is an Asuraic (demonic) practice.
verses.commentary: Sense: If one takes food with the head covered with a cloth, or facing the north or with the shoes on, it is an Asuraic (demonic) practice.

verses.sanskrit: स्तेननास्तिकयोरन्नं देवतानिन्दकस्य च । सोमविक्रयिणश्चान्नं श्वपाकस्य विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: stenanāstikayorannaṃ devatānindakasya ca / somavikrayiṇaścānnaṃ śvapākasya viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: One should not take food at midnight or midday or when the food taken before is not digested. One should not eat food wearing a wet cloth, or sitting in a moving vehicle
verses.hindi: चान्द्रायणव्रतचरः सत्यवादी पुराणवित्। गुरुदेवाग्निपूजासु प्रसक्तो ज्ञानतत्परः विमुक्तः सर्वतो धीरो ब्रह्मभूतो द्विजोत्तमः । महादेवार्चनरतो वैष्णवः पंक्तिपावनः
verses.wordMeaning: One should not take food at midnight or midday or when the food taken before is not digested. One should not eat food wearing a wet cloth, or sitting in a moving vehicle
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not take food at midnight or midday or when the food taken before is not digested. One should not eat food wearing a wet cloth, or sitting in a moving vehicle

verses.sanskrit: भार्याजितस्य चैवान्नं यस्य चोपपतिर्गृहे । उत्सृष्टस्य कदर्यस्य तथैवोच्छिष्टभोजिनः
verses.transliteration: bhāryājitasya caivānnaṃ yasya copapatirgṛhe / utsṛṣṭasya kadaryasya tathaivocchiṣṭabhojinaḥ
verses.translation: One shall not take food from a broken vessel or from the ground or in the hands (keeping the foodstuffs in the hands).
verses.hindi: युवानः श्रोत्रियाः स्वस्था महायज्ञपरायणा: । सावित्रीजापनिरता ब्राह्मणा: पक्तिपावनाः
verses.wordMeaning: One shall not take food from a broken vessel or from the ground or in the hands (keeping the foodstuffs in the hands).
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall not take food from a broken vessel or from the ground or in the hands (keeping the foodstuffs in the hands).

verses.sanskrit: अपाङ्क्त्यान्नं च सङ्घान्नं शस्त्राजीवस्य चैव हि । क्लीबसंन्यासिनोश्चान्नं मत्तोन्मत्तस्य चैव हि । भीतस्य रुदितस्यान्नमवक्रुष्टं परिक्षुतम्
verses.transliteration: apāṅktyānnaṃ ca saṅghānnaṃ śastrājīvasya caiva hi / klībasaṃnyāsinoścānnaṃ mattonmattasya caiva hi / bhītasya ruditasyānnamavakruṣṭaṃ parikṣutam
verses.translation: (If one is defiled by Ucchista) one should not glorify (repeat) the Vedic passages. One should not take food with¬ out leaving something behind. One should not take food along with one's wife. One should not take food in darkness, or in the twilight periods or in temples (and similar places).
verses.hindi: अग्निचित्स्नातका विप्रा विज्ञेयाः पंक्तिपावनाः त्रिणाचिकेत (यजुर्वेदके अंशविशेषका अध्येता)
verses.wordMeaning: (If one is defiled by Ucchista) one should not glorify (repeat) the Vedic passages. One should not take food with¬ out leaving something behind. One should not take food along with one's wife. One should not take food in darkness,…
verses.commentary: Sense: (If one is defiled by Ucchista) one should not glorify (repeat) the Vedic passages. One should not take food with¬ out leaving something behind. One should not take food along with one's wife. One should not take food in darkness,…

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मद्विषः पापरुचेः श्राद्धान्नं सूतकस्य च । वृथापाकस्य चैवान्नं शावान्नं श्वशुरस्य च
verses.transliteration: brahmadviṣaḥ pāparuceḥ śrāddhānnaṃ sūtakasya ca / vṛthāpākasya caivānnaṃ śāvānnaṃ śvaśurasya ca
verses.translation: One should not take food with a single garment on; one should not take food in a moving vehicle or lying down in the couch; one should not take food without slipping off the sandals nor one should take food while laughing or crying.
verses.hindi: (सामगान) तथा अथर्ववेदका अध्येता और विशेषरूपसे रुद्राध्यायका अध्ययन करनेवाला (ब्राह्मण पंक्तिपावन होता है)
verses.wordMeaning: One should not take food with a single garment on; one should not take food in a moving vehicle or lying down in the couch; one should not take food without slipping off the sandals nor one should take food while laughing or crying.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not take food with a single garment on; one should not take food in a moving vehicle or lying down in the couch; one should not take food without slipping off the sandals nor one should take food while laughing or crying.

verses.sanskrit: अप्रजानां तु नारीणां भृतकस्य तथैव च । कारुकान्नं विशेषेण शस्त्रविक्रयिणस्तथा
verses.transliteration: aprajānāṃ tu nārīṇāṃ bhṛtakasya tathaiva ca / kārukānnaṃ viśeṣeṇa śastravikrayiṇastathā
verses.translation: After taking food, one should rest comfortable so that the food is well digested. One should elaborately ascertain further the meanings of the Vedic passages through (or with the help of) Itihasas (Epics) and Puranas.
verses.hindi: अग्निहोत्रपरायण, विद्वान्, न्यायवेत्ता, वेदके शिक्षा, कल्प, व्याकरण, निरुक्त, छन्द तथा ज्योतिष-इन छ: अङ्गोंको जाननेवाला, वेदके मन्त्रभाग एवं ब्राह्मण- भागको जाननेवाला तथा धर्मशास्त्रको पढ्नेवाला, ऋषियाक व्रतोंका पालन करनेवाला, ऋषीक“, बारह वर्षोतक चलनेवाले ब्रत, यज्ञ (सत्र)-का करनेवाला, ब्राह्म'- विवाहद्वारा उत्पन्न संतान, गर्भाधानादि संस्कारसे शुद्ध और सहस्रों (शिष्योंको विद्या) दान करनेवाला (ब्राह्मण)
verses.wordMeaning: After taking food, one should rest comfortable so that the food is well digested. One should elaborately ascertain further the meanings of the Vedic passages through (or with the help of) Itihasas (Epics) and Puranas.
verses.commentary: Sense: After taking food, one should rest comfortable so that the food is well digested. One should elaborately ascertain further the meanings of the Vedic passages through (or with the help of) Itihasas (Epics) and Puranas.

verses.sanskrit: शौण्डान्नं घाटिकान्नं च भिषजामन्नमेव च । विद्धप्रजननस्यान्नं परिवित्त्यन्नमेव च
verses.transliteration: śauṇḍānnaṃ ghāṭikānnaṃ ca bhiṣajāmannameva ca / viddhaprajananasyānnaṃ parivittyannameva ca
verses.translation: Then he should perform the worship of the Sandhya in accordance with the procedure mentioned before. He should be pure. Seated and facing the west, one should perform Japa of the goddess Gayatri.
verses.hindi: पंक्तिपाबन होता है । चान्द्रायणब्रत करनेवाला, सत्यवादी, पुराण जाननेवाला, गुरु, देवता और अग्निकी पूजाम आसक्त, ज्ञानपरायण, आसक्ति आदिसे सर्वथा मुक्त, धीर, ब्रह्मज्ञानी, महादेवकी पूजामें निरत रहनेवाला तथा
verses.wordMeaning: Then he should perform the worship of the Sandhya in accordance with the procedure mentioned before. He should be pure. Seated and facing the west, one should perform Japa of the goddess Gayatri.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then he should perform the worship of the Sandhya in accordance with the procedure mentioned before. He should be pure. Seated and facing the west, one should perform Japa of the goddess Gayatri.

verses.sanskrit: पुनर्भुवो विशेषेण तथैव दिधिषूपतेः । अवज्ञातं चावधूतं सरोषं विस्मयान्वितम् । गुरोरपि न भोक्तव्यमन्नं संस्कारवर्जितम्
verses.transliteration: punarbhuvo viśeṣeṇa tathaiva didhiṣūpateḥ / avajñātaṃ cāvadhūtaṃ saroṣaṃ vismayānvitam / gurorapi na bhoktavyamannaṃ saṃskāravarjitam
verses.translation: He who does not worship either the morning Sandhya or the evening Sandhya is on a par with a Sudra in this world. He is devoid of all holy rites.
verses.hindi: वैष्णव श्रेष्ठ द्विज पंक्तिपाबन होता है। नित्य अहिंसा- ब्रतपरायण, अप्रतिग्रही, यज्ञ करनेवाले और दान देने- वाले (ब्राह्मणों) -को पंक्तिपावन जानना चाहिए श्रोत्रिय, स्वस्थ, महायज्ञ -परायण, गायत्री-जप करपे निरत ब्राह्मण युवक (सामर्थ्यसम्पन्न) पंक्तिपावन होते हैं। कुलीन, ज्ञानवान्, शीलवान्, तपस्वी एवं अग्निका चयन“ करनेवाले स्नातक ब्राह्मणोंको पंक्तिपावन जानना
verses.wordMeaning: He who does not worship either the morning Sandhya or the evening Sandhya is on a par with a Sudra in this world. He is devoid of all holy rites.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who does not worship either the morning Sandhya or the evening Sandhya is on a par with a Sudra in this world. He is devoid of all holy rites.

verses.sanskrit: दुष्कृतं हि मनुष्यस्य सर्वमन्ने व्यवस्थितम् । यो यस्यान्नं समश्नाति स तस्याश्नानि किल्बिषम्
verses.transliteration: duṣkṛtaṃ hi manuṣyasya sarvamanne vyavasthitam / yo yasyānnaṃ samaśnāti sa tasyāśnāni kilbiṣam
verses.translation: After performing the Homa duly, repeating the requisite Mantras after partaking of the remainder of the Yajna, one shall retire to sleep along with the attendents and kinsman. At that time his feet should be dry.
verses.hindi: १-अध्वर्युवेदभाग (यजुर्वेदका भागविशेष) एवं उसके व्रत त्रिणाचिकेत हैं। इन दोनोंके सम्बन्धसे ब्राह्मण भी ' त्रिणाचिकेत' कहा
verses.wordMeaning: After performing the Homa duly, repeating the requisite Mantras after partaking of the remainder of the Yajna, one shall retire to sleep along with the attendents and kinsman. At that time his feet should be dry.
verses.commentary: Sense: After performing the Homa duly, repeating the requisite Mantras after partaking of the remainder of the Yajna, one shall retire to sleep along with the attendents and kinsman. At that time his feet should be dry.

verses.sanskrit: आर्धिकः कुलमित्रश्च स्वगोपालश्च नापितः । एते शूद्रेषु भोज्यान्ना यश्चात्मानं निवेदयेत्
verses.transliteration: ārdhikaḥ kulamitraśca svagopālaśca nāpitaḥ / ete śūdreṣu bhojyānnā yaścātmānaṃ nivedayet
verses.translation: One should not sleep facing (i.e. with the head in that direction) the north or the west. Nor should he lie under the open sky. One should not sleep in the nude, nor unclean (in body), nor should one sleep on a seat.
verses.hindi: जाता है (मनु० ३। १८५) । २-छन्द (वेदविशेष साम)-के गानमें कुशल अथवा सामवेदका अध्येता 'छन्दोग' है (शब्दकल्पद्रुम) ।
verses.wordMeaning: One should not sleep facing (i.e. with the head in that direction) the north or the west. Nor should he lie under the open sky. One should not sleep in the nude, nor unclean (in body), nor should one sleep on a seat.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not sleep facing (i.e. with the head in that direction) the north or the west. Nor should he lie under the open sky. One should not sleep in the nude, nor unclean (in body), nor should one sleep on a seat.

verses.sanskrit: कुशीलवः कुम्भकारः क्षेत्रकर्मक एव च । एते शूद्रेषु भोज्यान्ना दत्त्वा स्वल्पं पणं बुधैः
verses.transliteration: kuśīlavaḥ kumbhakāraḥ kṣetrakarmaka eva ca / ete śūdreṣu bhojyānnā dattvā svalpaṃ paṇaṃ budhaiḥ
verses.translation: One should not sleep in a tottering cot nor in a deserted house; one should never lie down on a bed of Palasa (wood) or of bamboos.
verses.hindi: ३-' ज्येष्ठसाम’ सामवेद या उसके अध्ययनका अङ्ग व्रत है, इसका सम्बन्ध जिस ब्राह्मणसे है वह 'ज्येष्ठसामग' है। ४-'क्रपीक' का अर्थ 'ऋपिपुत्र' है। प्रकृतमें 'ऋषि-परम्परामें उत्पन्न” अर्थ समझना चाहिए।
verses.wordMeaning: One should not sleep in a tottering cot nor in a deserted house; one should never lie down on a bed of Palasa (wood) or of bamboos.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not sleep in a tottering cot nor in a deserted house; one should never lie down on a bed of Palasa (wood) or of bamboos.

verses.sanskrit: पायसं स्नेहपक्वं यद् गोरसं चैव सक्तवः । पिण्याकं चैव तैलं च शूद्राद् ग्राह्यं द्विजातिभिः
verses.transliteration: pāyasaṃ snehapakvaṃ yad gorasaṃ caiva saktavaḥ / piṇyākaṃ caiva tailaṃ ca śūdrād grāhyaṃ dvijātibhiḥ
verses.translation: Thus the various daily activities and duties of the Brahmanas have been wholly described by me. They bestow the benefit of Apavarga (salvation).
verses.hindi: ५-मूलमें ' ब्रह्मदेयानुसंतान' शब्द है। इसका "जिसकी कुलपरम्परामें ब्रह्म (वेद)-के अध्ययनाध्यापनकी परम्परा अविच्छित्नरूपसे चल रही हो'-यह अर्थ भी किया जा सकता है।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the various daily activities and duties of the Brahmanas have been wholly described by me. They bestow the benefit of Apavarga (salvation).
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the various daily activities and duties of the Brahmanas have been wholly described by me. They bestow the benefit of Apavarga (salvation).

verses.sanskrit: वृन्ताकं नालिकाशाकं कुसुम्भाश्मन्तकं तथा । पलाण्डुं लशुनं शुक्तं निर्यासं चैव वर्जयेत्
verses.transliteration: vṛntākaṃ nālikāśākaṃ kusumbhāśmantakaṃ tathā / palāṇḍuṃ laśunaṃ śuktaṃ niryāsaṃ caiva varjayet
verses.translation: If any Brahmana does not practise his duty either due to atheism or due to lethargy, he falls into the terrible hells and is reborn as a crow.
verses.hindi: ६-मूलमें 'सत्री' शब्द है। इसका अर्थ यज्ञ, यज्ञविशेष, दान-परायण, कथाश्रवण एवं अनेक दिन-साध्य अनुष्ठान आदि हैं। इन
verses.wordMeaning: If any Brahmana does not practise his duty either due to atheism or due to lethargy, he falls into the terrible hells and is reborn as a crow.
verses.commentary: Sense: If any Brahmana does not practise his duty either due to atheism or due to lethargy, he falls into the terrible hells and is reborn as a crow.

verses.sanskrit: छत्राकं विड्वराहं च शेलं पेयूषमेव च । विलयं सुमुखं चैव कवकानि च वर्जयेत्
verses.transliteration: chatrākaṃ viḍvarāhaṃ ca śelaṃ peyūṣameva ca / vilayaṃ sumukhaṃ caiva kavakāni ca varjayet
verses.translation: There is no other way for liberation excepting perfor¬ mance of the duties of one's own Asrama (stage of life). Hence one should perform the holy rites for the satisfaction of Paramesthin (god Brahma).
verses.hindi: सबके अनुष्ठाता ब्राह्मणको “सत्री' कहा जायगा। ७-' महायज्ञ’ पञ्चमहायज्ञोंको कहा जाता है, वे इस प्रकार हैं- (१) ब्रह्मयज्ञ (वेदका अध्ययनाध्यापन), (२) पितृयज्ञ (तर्पण), (३) देवयज्ञ (होम), (४) भूतयज्ञ (भूतबलि) और (५) मनुष्ययज्ञ (अतिधि-पूजन) ।
verses.wordMeaning: There is no other way for liberation excepting perfor¬ mance of the duties of one's own Asrama (stage of life). Hence one should perform the holy rites for the satisfaction of Paramesthin (god Brahma).
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no other way for liberation excepting perfor¬ mance of the duties of one's own Asrama (stage of life). Hence one should perform the holy rites for the satisfaction of Paramesthin (god Brahma).

verses.sanskrit: गृञ्जनं किंशुकं चैव ककुभाण्डं तथैव च । उदुम्बरमलाबुं च जग्ध्वा पतति वै द्विजः
verses.transliteration: gṛñjanaṃ kiṃśukaṃ caiva kakubhāṇḍaṃ tathaiva ca / udumbaramalābuṃ ca jagdhvā patati vai dvijaḥ
verses.translation: He should then, with concentration and mental purity worship the sun, repeating the various kinds of Mantras pertaining to the sun and taken from the Rgveda, Yajurveda and the Samaveda.
verses.hindi: ८-मूलमें ' अग्निचित्’ शब्द है। इसका अर्थ है--' अग्निहोत्री '।
verses.wordMeaning: He should then, with concentration and mental purity worship the sun, repeating the various kinds of Mantras pertaining to the sun and taken from the Rgveda, Yajurveda and the Samaveda.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should then, with concentration and mental purity worship the sun, repeating the various kinds of Mantras pertaining to the sun and taken from the Rgveda, Yajurveda and the Samaveda.

verses.sanskrit: वृथा कृशरसंयावं पायसापूपमेव च । अनुपाकृतमांसं च देवान्नानि हवींषि च
verses.transliteration: vṛthā kṛśarasaṃyāvaṃ pāyasāpūpameva ca / anupākṛtamāṃsaṃ ca devānnāni havīṃṣi ca
verses.translation: After respectfully approaching the sun, the lord of Devas of great Yoga, one shall make a great bow touching the ground with the head repeating those Mantras.
verses.hindi: ९-सविधि ब्रह्मचर्यव्रत पूर्णकर ख्रानविशेषरूप संस्कारके अनन्तर गृहस्थाश्रममें प्रविष्ट या अप्रविष्ट द्विज स्नातक होता है। यहाँ ऐसे ब्राह्मणमात्रको लेना है।
verses.wordMeaning: After respectfully approaching the sun, the lord of Devas of great Yoga, one shall make a great bow touching the ground with the head repeating those Mantras.
verses.commentary: Sense: After respectfully approaching the sun, the lord of Devas of great Yoga, one shall make a great bow touching the ground with the head repeating those Mantras.

verses.sanskrit: यवागूं मातुलिङ्गं च मत्स्यानप्यनुपाकृतान् । नीपं कपित्थं प्लक्षं च प्रयत्नेन विवर्जयेत्
verses.transliteration: yavāgūṃ mātuliṅgaṃ ca matsyānapyanupākṛtān / nīpaṃ kapitthaṃ plakṣaṃ ca prayatnena vivarjayet
verses.translation: Om obeisance unto you Khakholka (the sky-meteor), the quiescent, the source of the three causes. I dedicate myself unto you; the embodiment of the universe I bow to you.
verses.hindi: अध्यात्मविन्मुनिर्दान्तो विज्ञेयः पंक्तिपावन:
verses.wordMeaning: Om obeisance unto you Khakholka (the sky-meteor), the quiescent, the source of the three causes. I dedicate myself unto you; the embodiment of the universe I bow to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: Om obeisance unto you Khakholka (the sky-meteor), the quiescent, the source of the three causes. I dedicate myself unto you; the embodiment of the universe I bow to you.

verses.sanskrit: पिण्याकं चोद्धृतस्नेहं देवधान्य तथैव च । रात्रौ च तिलसंबद्धं प्रयत्नेन दधि त्यजेत्
verses.transliteration: piṇyākaṃ coddhṛtasnehaṃ devadhānya tathaiva ca / rātrau ca tilasaṃbaddhaṃ prayatnena dadhi tyajet
verses.translation: Obeisance unto you, the compassionate one; salute to you the Sun the manifest form of Brahman. You alone are the greatest Brahman, the waters, the Brilliance, the essence, the nectar or immortal; you are the Vyahrtis Bhuh, Bhuvah, Svah. You are Oihkara, Sarva, Rudra, the eternal great god.
verses.hindi: वेदविद्यारतः स्नातो ब्रह्मचर्यपर: सदा। अथर्वणो मुमुक्षुश्च ब्राह्मण: पंक्तिपावन: असमानप्रवरको ह्यासगोत्रस्त्थैव च। असम्बन्धी च विज्ञेयो ब्राह्मण: पंक्तिपावन:
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance unto you, the compassionate one; salute to you the Sun the manifest form of Brahman. You alone are the greatest Brahman, the waters, the Brilliance, the essence, the nectar or immortal; you are the Vyahrtis Bhuh, Bhuvah, Svah. You are Oihkara, Sarva, Rudra,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance unto you, the compassionate one; salute to you the Sun the manifest form of Brahman. You alone are the greatest Brahman, the waters, the Brilliance, the essence, the nectar or immortal; you are the Vyahrtis Bhuh, Bhuvah, Svah. You are Oihkara, Sarva, Rudra,…

verses.sanskrit: नाश्नीयात् पयसा तक्रं न बीजान्युपजीवयेत् । क्रियादुष्टं भावदुष्टमसत्संसर्गि वर्जयेत्
verses.transliteration: nāśnīyāt payasā takraṃ na bījānyupajīvayet / kriyāduṣṭaṃ bhāvaduṣṭamasatsaṃsargi varjayet
verses.translation: You are Purufa of glory and brilliance. I bow unto Kapardin (god of matted hair), the immanent soul. You alone are the universe, that had originated in many ways and that is yet originating. Obeisance, to you, Rudra, the sun. I seek refuge in you.
verses.hindi: माता-पिताके हितमें लगे हुए, प्रातःस्त्रान करनेवाले, अध्यात्मवेत्ता, मुनि एवं दान्त ब्राह्मणोंको पंक्तिपावन समझना चाहिए। ज्ञाननिष्ठ, महायोगी, वेदान्तके अर्थका विशेष चिन्तन करनेवाले,
verses.wordMeaning: You are Purufa of glory and brilliance. I bow unto Kapardin (god of matted hair), the immanent soul. You alone are the universe, that had originated in many ways and that is yet originating. Obeisance, to you, Rudra, the sun. I seek refuge in you.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are Purufa of glory and brilliance. I bow unto Kapardin (god of matted hair), the immanent soul. You alone are the universe, that had originated in many ways and that is yet originating. Obeisance, to you, Rudra, the sun. I seek refuge in you.

verses.sanskrit: केशकीटावपन्नं च सहृल्लेखं च नित्यशः । श्वाघ्रातं च पुनः सिद्धं चण्डालावेक्षितं तथा
verses.transliteration: keśakīṭāvapannaṃ ca sahṛllekhaṃ ca nityaśaḥ / śvāghrātaṃ ca punaḥ siddhaṃ caṇḍālāvekṣitaṃ tathā
verses.translation: Obeisance to you Pracetas; salutation to the most bountilful god. Obeisance, obeisance to you, Rudra. I seek refuge in you. Obeisance to you Hiranyabahu (of golden arms); obeisance to Hiranyapati (the lord of gold).
verses.hindi: श्रद्धासम्पन्न तथा श्राद्धनिरत ब्राह्मण पंक्ति-पावन होते हैँ। वेदविद्यामें निरत, सदा ब्रह्मचर्य-परायण, अथर्ववेदका अध्ययन करनेवाला, मुमुक्षु, स्नातक ब्राह्मण पंक्तिपावन होता है। असमान प्रवर, असमान गोत्र (-में सम्बन्ध करनेवाला) और असम्बन्धी (निषिद्ध सम्बन्धरहित) ब्राह्मणको पंक्तिपावन समझना चाहिए ॥ १३--१६॥
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you Pracetas; salutation to the most bountilful god. Obeisance, obeisance to you, Rudra. I seek refuge in you. Obeisance to you Hiranyabahu (of golden arms); obeisance to Hiranyapati (the lord of gold).
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you Pracetas; salutation to the most bountilful god. Obeisance, obeisance to you, Rudra. I seek refuge in you. Obeisance to you Hiranyabahu (of golden arms); obeisance to Hiranyapati (the lord of gold).

verses.sanskrit: उदक्यया च पतितैर्गवा चाघ्रातमेव च । अनर्चितं पुर्युं षितं पर्यायान्नं च नित्यशः
verses.transliteration: udakyayā ca patitairgavā cāghrātameva ca / anarcitaṃ puryuṃ ṣitaṃ paryāyānnaṃ ca nityaśaḥ
verses.translation: Bow to you the lord of.'\mbika; obeisance to the consort of Uma; salutation to the blue-necked. Obeisance to you, the holder of the Pinaka Bow.
verses.hindi: सर्वप्रथम तत्त्वज्ञानमें निरत संयतचित्त योगीको भोजन कराना चाहिए। अभाव होनेपर (अर्थात् ऐसा ब्राह्मण न मिलनेपर) इन्द्रियजयी नेष्ठिक ब्रह्मचारी (जो ब्रह्मचर्य-व्रत स्वीकारकर यावजीवन गुरुकुलमें ही
verses.wordMeaning: Bow to you the lord of.'\mbika; obeisance to the consort of Uma; salutation to the blue-necked. Obeisance to you, the holder of the Pinaka Bow.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bow to you the lord of.'\mbika; obeisance to the consort of Uma; salutation to the blue-necked. Obeisance to you, the holder of the Pinaka Bow.

verses.sanskrit: काककुक्कुटसंस्पृष्टं कृमिभिश्चैव संयुतम् । मनुष्यैरप्यवघ्रातं कुष्ठिना स्पृष्टमेव च
verses.transliteration: kākakukkuṭasaṃspṛṣṭaṃ kṛmibhiścaiva saṃyutam / manuṣyairapyavaghrātaṃ kuṣṭhinā spṛṣṭameva ca
verses.translation: Hail to you Vilohita (very ruddy), Bharga (Brilliant) obeisance to you the thousand-eyed one. Obeisance to you for ever, to the dispeller of darkness, obeisance be to you Aditya.
verses.hindi: निवास करता है)-को और ऐसे ब्राह्मणके अभावमें उपकुर्वाणक (जो ब्रह्मचर्यव्रत पूर्णकर गृहस्थाश्रममें प्रवेश करनेवाला है ऐसे ब्रह्मचारी) ब्राह्मणको भोजन कराना चाहिए। उसका भी अभाव होनेपर आसक्तिरहित मुमुक्षु गृहस्थ ब्राह्मणको भोजन कराना चाहिए। इन सभीके अभाव होनेपर साधक (ब्राह्मण) गृहस्थको भोजन कराना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: Hail to you Vilohita (very ruddy), Bharga (Brilliant) obeisance to you the thousand-eyed one. Obeisance to you for ever, to the dispeller of darkness, obeisance be to you Aditya.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hail to you Vilohita (very ruddy), Bharga (Brilliant) obeisance to you the thousand-eyed one. Obeisance to you for ever, to the dispeller of darkness, obeisance be to you Aditya.

verses.sanskrit: न रजस्वलया दत्तं न पुंश्चाल्या सरोषया । मलबद्वाससा वापि परवासो ऽथ वर्जयेत्
verses.transliteration: na rajasvalayā dattaṃ na puṃścālyā saroṣayā / malabadvāsasā vāpi paravāso 'tha varjayet
verses.translation: Obeisance to you Vajrahasta (one with the thunder¬ bolt in the hand). Obeisance, again and again toTryambaka (the three-eyed god). I resort unto you, Virupaksa, the great supreme Lord.
verses.hindi: प्रकृतिके गुण ओर तत्त्वको जाननेवाला (तत्त्ववेत्ता) यति (संयतचित्त ब्राह्मण) जिस (व्यक्ति)-का भोजन करता है, उसे (सहस्रो) वेदज्ञको भोजन करानेकी अपेक्षा भी सहस्रगुना अधिक फल मिलता है। इसलिये
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you Vajrahasta (one with the thunder¬ bolt in the hand). Obeisance, again and again toTryambaka (the three-eyed god). I resort unto you, Virupaksa, the great supreme Lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you Vajrahasta (one with the thunder¬ bolt in the hand). Obeisance, again and again toTryambaka (the three-eyed god). I resort unto you, Virupaksa, the great supreme Lord.

verses.sanskrit: विवत्सायाश्च गोः क्षीरमौष्ट्रं वानिर्दशं तथा । आविकं सन्धिनीक्षीरमपेयं मनुरब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: vivatsāyāśca goḥ kṣīramauṣṭraṃ vānirdaśaṃ tathā / āvikaṃ sandhinīkṣīramapeyaṃ manurabravīt
verses.translation: I bow to the Atman well-preserved in the golden abode. I bow down to the supreme brilliance, to you, Brahma, the great and the immortal one.
verses.hindi: ईश्वरज्ञानमें तत्पर श्रेष्ठ योगीको देवकार्य एवं पितृकार्यमें प्रयत्नपूर्वक भोजन कराना चाहिए। इनकी प्राप्ति न होनेपर दूसरे ब्राह्मणोंको भोजन कराना चाहिए हव्य और कव्य प्रदान करनेमें यह प्रथम कल्प है। (इसके अभावमें) सज्जनों (वेदशास्त्रनिष्ठों )-द्वारा सदा अनुष्ठित इस अनुकल्पको जानना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: I bow to the Atman well-preserved in the golden abode. I bow down to the supreme brilliance, to you, Brahma, the great and the immortal one.
verses.commentary: Sense: I bow to the Atman well-preserved in the golden abode. I bow down to the supreme brilliance, to you, Brahma, the great and the immortal one.

verses.sanskrit: बलाकं हंसदात्यूहं कलविङ्कं शुकं तथा । कुररं च चकोरं च जालपादं च कोकिलम्
verses.transliteration: balākaṃ haṃsadātyūhaṃ kalaviṅkaṃ śukaṃ tathā / kuraraṃ ca cakoraṃ ca jālapādaṃ ca kokilam
verses.translation: I bow to Pasupati (the master of individual souls), the universe, the terrible one, having (simulaneously) the male and female forms. Obeisance to the sun, to Rudra, the shining one, to Paramesthin (the highest deity).
verses.hindi: बूआ एवं मामी आदिके पुत्र), ऋत्विक् तथा यज्ञ करानेवाले ब्राह्मणको भोजन कराया जाय
verses.wordMeaning: I bow to Pasupati (the master of individual souls), the universe, the terrible one, having (simulaneously) the male and female forms. Obeisance to the sun, to Rudra, the shining one, to Paramesthin (the highest deity).
verses.commentary: Sense: I bow to Pasupati (the master of individual souls), the universe, the terrible one, having (simulaneously) the male and female forms. Obeisance to the sun, to Rudra, the shining one, to Paramesthin (the highest deity).

verses.sanskrit: वायसं खञ्जरीटं च श्येनं गृध्रं तथैव च । उलूकं चक्रवाकं च भासं पारावतानपि । कपोतं टिट्टिभं चैव ग्रामकुक्कुटमेव च
verses.transliteration: vāyasaṃ khañjarīṭaṃ ca śyenaṃ gṛdhraṃ tathaiva ca / ulūkaṃ cakravākaṃ ca bhāsaṃ pārāvatānapi / kapotaṃ ṭiṭṭibhaṃ caiva grāmakukkuṭameva ca
verses.translation: Thereafter, the Brahmana should return home, perform the Acamana rite in accordance with the injunctions, kindle the fire duly and perform the Homa in the fire.
verses.hindi: न श्राद्धे भोजयेन्मित्रं धने: कार्योऽस्य संग्रह: । पैशाची दक्षिणा सा हि नैवामुत्र फलप्रदा कामं श्राद्धेऽर्चयेन्मित्रं नाभिरूपमपि त्वरिम्। द्विषता हि हविर्भुक्तं भवति प्रेत्य निष्फलम्
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, the Brahmana should return home, perform the Acamana rite in accordance with the injunctions, kindle the fire duly and perform the Homa in the fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, the Brahmana should return home, perform the Acamana rite in accordance with the injunctions, kindle the fire duly and perform the Homa in the fire.

verses.sanskrit: सिंहव्याघ्रं च मार्जारं श्वानं शूकरमेव च । शृगालं मर्कटं चैव गर्दभं च न भक्षयेत्
verses.transliteration: siṃhavyāghraṃ ca mārjāraṃ śvānaṃ śūkarameva ca / śṛgālaṃ markaṭaṃ caiva gardabhaṃ ca na bhakṣayet
verses.translation: The Homa can be performed by the Rtvik's son, wife, disciple or brother after obtaining the permission. It can particularly be performed by the Adhvaryu in accordance with the injunction.
verses.hindi: वबधबन्धोपजीवी च षडेते ब्रह्मबन्धवः
verses.wordMeaning: The Homa can be performed by the Rtvik's son, wife, disciple or brother after obtaining the permission. It can particularly be performed by the Adhvaryu in accordance with the injunction.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Homa can be performed by the Rtvik's son, wife, disciple or brother after obtaining the permission. It can particularly be performed by the Adhvaryu in accordance with the injunction.

verses.sanskrit: न भक्षयेत् सर्वमृगान् पक्षिणो ऽन्यान् वनेचरान् । जलेचरान् स्थलचरान् प्राणिनश्चेति धारणा
verses.transliteration: na bhakṣayet sarvamṛgān pakṣiṇo 'nyān vanecarān / jalecarān sthalacarān prāṇinaśceti dhāraṇā
verses.translation: The Homa can be performed by the Rtvik's son, wife, disciple or brother after obtaining the permission. It can particularly be performed by the Adhvaryu in accordance with the injunction.
verses.hindi: वेदविक्रयिणो होते श्राद्धादिषु विगर्हिताः ३९॥ असमानान् याजयन्ति पतितास्ते प्रकीर्तिताः
verses.wordMeaning: The Homa can be performed by the Rtvik's son, wife, disciple or brother after obtaining the permission. It can particularly be performed by the Adhvaryu in accordance with the injunction.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Homa can be performed by the Rtvik's son, wife, disciple or brother after obtaining the permission. It can particularly be performed by the Adhvaryu in accordance with the injunction.

verses.sanskrit: गोधा कूर्मः शशः श्वाविच्छल्यकश्चेति सत्तमाः । भक्ष्याः पञ्चनखा नित्यं मनुराह प्रिजापतिः
verses.transliteration: godhā kūrmaḥ śaśaḥ śvāvicchalyakaśceti sattamāḥ / bhakṣyāḥ pañcanakhā nityaṃ manurāha prijāpatiḥ
verses.translation: The Homa can be performed by the Rtvik's son, wife, disciple or brother after obtaining the permission. It can particularly be performed by the Adhvaryu in accordance with the injunction.
verses.hindi: श्राद्धमें मित्रको भोजन नहीं कराना चाहिए। इनका संरक्षण (संग्रह) धनके आदान-प्रदानद्वारा करना चाहिए। (यदि श्राद्धमें मित्रको भोजन कराकर दक्षिणा दी जाय तो) ऐसी दक्षिणा पैशाची होती है। यह परलोकमें कोई
verses.wordMeaning: The Homa can be performed by the Rtvik's son, wife, disciple or brother after obtaining the permission. It can particularly be performed by the Adhvaryu in accordance with the injunction.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Homa can be performed by the Rtvik's son, wife, disciple or brother after obtaining the permission. It can particularly be performed by the Adhvaryu in accordance with the injunction.

verses.sanskrit: मत्स्यान् सशल्कान् भुञ्जीयान् मांसं रौरवमेवच । निवेद्य देवताभ्यस्तु ब्राह्मणेभ्यस्तु नान्यथा
verses.transliteration: matsyān saśalkān bhuñjīyān māṃsaṃ rauravamevaca / nivedya devatābhyastu brāhmaṇebhyastu nānyathā
verses.translation: The Homa can be performed by the Rtvik's son, wife, disciple or brother after obtaining the permission. It can particularly be performed by the Adhvaryu in accordance with the injunction.
verses.hindi: फल नहीं देती। (किसी विशेष स्थिति या उपर्युक्त कल्प-अनुकल्पके अभावमें) श्राद्धमें भले ही मित्रका (यथोचित) सत्कार करे, किंतु अभिरूप (विद्वान् मनोज्ञ) पात्र होनेपर भी शत्रुका सत्कार नहीं करना चाहिए, (क्योंकि) द्वेष रखनेवालेके द्वारा भुक्त हवि परलोकमें निष्फल होती है
verses.wordMeaning: The Homa can be performed by the Rtvik's son, wife, disciple or brother after obtaining the permission. It can particularly be performed by the Adhvaryu in accordance with the injunction.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Homa can be performed by the Rtvik's son, wife, disciple or brother after obtaining the permission. It can particularly be performed by the Adhvaryu in accordance with the injunction.

verses.sanskrit: मयूरं तित्तिरं चैव कपोतं च कपिञ्जलम् । वाध्रीणसं बकं भक्ष्यं मीनहंसपराजिताः
verses.transliteration: mayūraṃ tittiraṃ caiva kapotaṃ ca kapiñjalam / vādhrīṇasaṃ bakaṃ bhakṣyaṃ mīnahaṃsaparājitāḥ
verses.translation: The Homa can be performed by the Rtvik's son, wife, disciple or brother after obtaining the permission. It can particularly be performed by the Adhvaryu in accordance with the injunction.
verses.hindi: (वेदादिका) अध्ययन न करनेवाला ब्राह्मण तृणमें लगी अग्निके समान शान्त (निस्तेज) हो जाता है। उसे हव्य (यथासम्भव देव-पित्र्य-कार्यमें भोजनके लिये निमन्त्रण) नहीं देना चाहिए, क्योंकि भस्ममें हवन नहीं
verses.wordMeaning: The Homa can be performed by the Rtvik's son, wife, disciple or brother after obtaining the permission. It can particularly be performed by the Adhvaryu in accordance with the injunction.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Homa can be performed by the Rtvik's son, wife, disciple or brother after obtaining the permission. It can particularly be performed by the Adhvaryu in accordance with the injunction.

verses.sanskrit: शफरं सिंहतुण्डं च तथा पाठीनरोहितौ । मत्स्याश्चैते समुद्दिष्टा भक्षणाय द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: śapharaṃ siṃhatuṇḍaṃ ca tathā pāṭhīnarohitau / matsyāścaite samuddiṣṭā bhakṣaṇāya dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: The Homa can be performed by the Rtvik's son, wife, disciple or brother after obtaining the permission. It can particularly be performed by the Adhvaryu in accordance with the injunction.
verses.hindi: किया जाता है। जिस प्रकार ऊसर भूमिमें बौज बोनेवाला कुछ फल नहीं प्राप्त करता, उसी प्रकार वेद न जाननेवालेको हवि देनेसे दाताको कोई फल नहीं मिलता। मन्त्रको न जाननेवाला वह ब्राह्मण देव और पितृकार्यमें जितने पिण्डों (ग्रासों)-को ग्रहण करता है, मृत्युके अनन्तर वह उतने ही स्थूल और प्रज्चलित लोहेके पिण्डों (ग्रासों)-का भक्षण करता है
verses.wordMeaning: The Homa can be performed by the Rtvik's son, wife, disciple or brother after obtaining the permission. It can particularly be performed by the Adhvaryu in accordance with the injunction.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Homa can be performed by the Rtvik's son, wife, disciple or brother after obtaining the permission. It can particularly be performed by the Adhvaryu in accordance with the injunction.

verses.sanskrit: प्रोक्षितं भक्षयेदेषां मांसं च द्विजकाम्यया । यथाविधि नियुक्तं च प्राणानामपि चात्यये
verses.transliteration: prokṣitaṃ bhakṣayedeṣāṃ māṃsaṃ ca dvijakāmyayā / yathāvidhi niyuktaṃ ca prāṇānāmapi cātyaye
verses.translation: The Homa can be performed by the Rtvik's son, wife, disciple or brother after obtaining the permission. It can particularly be performed by the Adhvaryu in accordance with the injunction.
verses.hindi: हे द्विजो! विद्या-सम्पन्न तथा उत्तम कुलमें उत्पन्न होनेपर भी आचारहीन नीच मनुष्य हैव और पित्र्यकार्यमे जो हव्य आदि ग्रहण करते हैं, वह (हव्यादि) आसुरी हो जाता है। जिसकी तीन पीढ़ीतक वेद और यज्ञ
verses.wordMeaning: The Homa can be performed by the Rtvik's son, wife, disciple or brother after obtaining the permission. It can particularly be performed by the Adhvaryu in accordance with the injunction.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Homa can be performed by the Rtvik's son, wife, disciple or brother after obtaining the permission. It can particularly be performed by the Adhvaryu in accordance with the injunction.

verses.sanskrit: भक्षयेन्नैव मांसानि शेषभोजी न लिप्यते । औषधार्थमशक्तौ वा नियोगाद् यज्ञकारणात्
verses.transliteration: bhakṣayennaiva māṃsāni śeṣabhojī na lipyate / auṣadhārthamaśaktau vā niyogād yajñakāraṇāt
verses.translation: The Homa can be performed by the Rtvik's son, wife, disciple or brother after obtaining the permission. It can particularly be performed by the Adhvaryu in accordance with the injunction.
verses.hindi: आदिका उच्छेद हो जाता है, वह दुर््राह्मण होता है, वह श्राद्ध आदिमें कभी भी पूजाके योग्य नहीं होता। शूद्रका नौकर, राजासे वेतन लेनेवाला, पतित (अधार्मिक), गाँवके पुरोहित, वध और बन्धनद्वारा जीविका चलानेवाले-ये छः ब्रह्मबन्धु होते हें
verses.wordMeaning: The Homa can be performed by the Rtvik's son, wife, disciple or brother after obtaining the permission. It can particularly be performed by the Adhvaryu in accordance with the injunction.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Homa can be performed by the Rtvik's son, wife, disciple or brother after obtaining the permission. It can particularly be performed by the Adhvaryu in accordance with the injunction.

verses.sanskrit: आमन्त्रितस्तु यः श्राद्धे दैवे वा मांसमुत्सृजेत् । यावन्ति पशुरोमाणि तावतो नरकान् व्रजेत्
verses.transliteration: āmantritastu yaḥ śrāddhe daive vā māṃsamutsṛjet / yāvanti paśuromāṇi tāvato narakān vrajet
verses.translation: The Homa can be performed by the Rtvik's son, wife, disciple or brother after obtaining the permission. It can particularly be performed by the Adhvaryu in accordance with the injunction.
verses.hindi: मनुने जीविकाके लिये नौकरी करनेवालेको पतित बतलाया है। ये सभी एवं वेदका विक्रय करनेवाले (ब्राह्मण) श्राद्ध आदि कार्योमें निन्दित हैं। जो वेदका विक्रय करनेवाले, हीन अथवा उच्चवर्णकी स्त्रीसे उत्पन्न
verses.wordMeaning: The Homa can be performed by the Rtvik's son, wife, disciple or brother after obtaining the permission. It can particularly be performed by the Adhvaryu in accordance with the injunction.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Homa can be performed by the Rtvik's son, wife, disciple or brother after obtaining the permission. It can particularly be performed by the Adhvaryu in accordance with the injunction.

verses.sanskrit: अदेयं चाप्यपेयं च तथैवास्पृश्यमेव च । द्विजातीनामनालोक्यं नित्यं मद्यमिति स्थितिः
verses.transliteration: adeyaṃ cāpyapeyaṃ ca tathaivāspṛśyameva ca / dvijātīnāmanālokyaṃ nityaṃ madyamiti sthitiḥ
verses.translation: The Homa can be performed by the Rtvik's son, wife, disciple or brother after obtaining the permission. It can particularly be performed by the Adhvaryu in accordance with the injunction.
verses.hindi: तथा असमान वर्णोका पौरोहित्य करनेवाले हैं, वे पतित कहे गये हैँ असंस्कृताध्यापका ये भृत्या वाध्यापयन्ति ये। अधीयते तथा वेदान् पतितास्ते प्रकीर्तिताः
verses.wordMeaning: The Homa can be performed by the Rtvik's son, wife, disciple or brother after obtaining the permission. It can particularly be performed by the Adhvaryu in accordance with the injunction.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Homa can be performed by the Rtvik's son, wife, disciple or brother after obtaining the permission. It can particularly be performed by the Adhvaryu in accordance with the injunction.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् सर्वप्रकारेण मद्यं नित्यं विवर्जयेत् । पीत्वा पतति कर्मभ्यस्त्वसंभाष्यो भवेद् द्विजः
verses.transliteration: tasmāt sarvaprakāreṇa madyaṃ nityaṃ vivarjayet / pītvā patati karmabhyastvasaṃbhāṣyo bhaved dvijaḥ
verses.translation: The Homa can be performed by the Rtvik's son, wife, disciple or brother after obtaining the permission. It can particularly be performed by the Adhvaryu in accordance with the injunction.
verses.hindi: कापालिकाः पाशुपताः पाषण्डा ये च तद्विधाः ३४॥
verses.wordMeaning: The Homa can be performed by the Rtvik's son, wife, disciple or brother after obtaining the permission. It can particularly be performed by the Adhvaryu in accordance with the injunction.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Homa can be performed by the Rtvik's son, wife, disciple or brother after obtaining the permission. It can particularly be performed by the Adhvaryu in accordance with the injunction.

verses.sanskrit: भक्षयित्वा ह्यभक्ष्याणि पीत्वापेयान्यपि द्विजः । नाधिकारी भवेत् तावद् यावद् तन्न जहात्यधः
verses.transliteration: bhakṣayitvā hyabhakṣyāṇi pītvāpeyānyapi dvijaḥ / nādhikārī bhavet tāvad yāvad tanna jahātyadhaḥ
verses.translation: The Homa can be performed by the Rtvik's son, wife, disciple or brother after obtaining the permission. It can particularly be performed by the Adhvaryu in accordance with the injunction.
verses.hindi: मिथ्याश्रमी च ते विप्रा विज्ञेयाः पंक्तिदूषकाः गीतवादित्रनिरतो व्याधितः काण एव च। हीनाङ्गश्चातिरिक्ताङ्गो ह्यवकीर्णिस्तथैव च
verses.wordMeaning: The Homa can be performed by the Rtvik's son, wife, disciple or brother after obtaining the permission. It can particularly be performed by the Adhvaryu in accordance with the injunction.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Homa can be performed by the Rtvik's son, wife, disciple or brother after obtaining the permission. It can particularly be performed by the Adhvaryu in accordance with the injunction.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् परिहरेन्नित्यमभक्ष्याणि प्रयत्नतः । अपेयानि च विप्रो वै तथा चेद् याति रौरवम्
verses.transliteration: tasmāt pariharennityamabhakṣyāṇi prayatnataḥ / apeyāni ca vipro vai tathā ced yāti rauravam
verses.translation: The Homa can be performed by the Rtvik's son, wife, disciple or brother after obtaining the permission. It can particularly be performed by the Adhvaryu in accordance with the injunction.
verses.wordMeaning: The Homa can be performed by the Rtvik's son, wife, disciple or brother after obtaining the permission. It can particularly be performed by the Adhvaryu in accordance with the injunction.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Homa can be performed by the Rtvik's son, wife, disciple or brother after obtaining the permission. It can particularly be performed by the Adhvaryu in accordance with the injunction.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे सप्तदशो ऽध्यायः ऋषय ऊचुः अहन्यहनि कर्तव्यं ब्राह्मणानां महामुने । तदाचक्ष्वाखिलं कर्म येन मुच्येत बन्धनात्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge saptadaśo 'dhyāyaḥ ṛṣaya ūcuḥ ahanyahani kartavyaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ mahāmune / tadācakṣvākhilaṃ karma yena mucyeta bandhanāt
verses.translation: (Whoever performs it) he should wear Pavitra (Kusa grass made in the form of a ring with a tail) in his hand, wear white cloth, be pure in mind and body and have full control over the sense-organs. He should perform the Homa with full concentration of the mind (which does not wander elsewhere).
verses.hindi: जो असंस्कृतों (संस्काररहितों)-के अध्यापक हे, वेतनके लिये अध्यापन तथा वेदाध्ययन करनेवाले हैं, वे पतित कहे गये हैं। वृद्ध श्रावक अर्थात् बौद्ध, निर्ग्रन्थ अर्थात् जैन, पाञ्चरात्रके ज्ञाता, कापालिक, पाशुपत (सम्प्रदायविशेषके) और उसी प्रकारके पाखंडी, तमोगुणी, दुरात्मा व्यक्ति-ये जिसके हविष्यान्नका भक्षण करते हैं, उसका किया श्राद्ध न तो इस लोकमें फल देनेवाला होता है और न परलोकमें
verses.wordMeaning: (Whoever performs it) he should wear Pavitra (Kusa grass made in the form of a ring with a tail) in his hand, wear white cloth, be pure in mind and body and have full control over the sense-organs.…
verses.commentary: Sense: (Whoever performs it) he should wear Pavitra (Kusa grass made in the form of a ring with a tail) in his hand, wear white cloth, be pure in mind and body and have full control over the sense-organs.…

verses.sanskrit: व्यास उवाच वक्ष्ये समाहिता यूयं शृणुध्वं गदतो मम । अहन्यहनि कर्तव्यं ब्राह्मणानां क्रमाद् विधिम्
verses.transliteration: vyāsa uvāca vakṣye samāhitā yūyaṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ gadato mama / ahanyahani kartavyaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ kramād vidhim
verses.translation: The rite that is performed without the Darbha grass or without the Sutra (sacred thread) shall be demonic. It does not yield any benefit either here or hereafter.
verses.hindi: जो द्विज (ब्राह्मण) यथाविधि आश्रमको स्वीकार करनेवाले नहीं हैं अथवा नाममात्रके लिये किसी आश्रमका आश्रय लिये हैं, वे मिथ्याश्रमी कहे गये हैं, उन्हें पंक्तिदूषक समझना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: The rite that is performed without the Darbha grass or without the Sutra (sacred thread) shall be demonic. It does not yield any benefit either here or hereafter.
verses.commentary: Sense: The rite that is performed without the Darbha grass or without the Sutra (sacred thread) shall be demonic. It does not yield any benefit either here or hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मे मुहूर्ते तूत्थाय धर्ममर्थं च चिन्तयेत् । कायक्लेशं तदुद्भूतं ध्यायीत मनसेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: brāhme muhūrte tūtthāya dharmamarthaṃ ca cintayet / kāyakleśaṃ tadudbhūtaṃ dhyāyīta manaseśvaram
verses.translation: He should make obeisance to all deities, should offer presents; flowers etc. should be given. He should then prostrate before elders.
verses.hindi: विकारयुक्त चर्म एवं नखवालों, कुष्ठरोगी, श्वेत कुष्ठरोगी, स्वभावतः काले दाँतवाला, विद्ध लिङ्गवाला, चोर, नपुंसक, नास्तिक, मद्य पीनेवाला, शूद्रा स्त्रीमें आसक्त, वीरहा (वह अग्निहोत्री जिसका अग्निहोत्र नष्ट हो गया है), विधवा स्त्रीसे विवाह करनेवाला, घरको जलानेवाला, कुण्ड (पतिके जीवित रहते अन्य पुरुषसे उत्पन्न संतान)-का भोजन करनेवाला तथा सोमलताका विक्रय करनेवाला-इस प्रकारके ब्राह्मण (६ श्राद्धादिमें
verses.wordMeaning: He should make obeisance to all deities, should offer presents; flowers etc. should be given. He should then prostrate before elders.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should make obeisance to all deities, should offer presents; flowers etc. should be given. He should then prostrate before elders.

verses.sanskrit: उषः काले ऽथ संप्राप्ते कृत्वा चावश्यकं बुधः । स्नायान्नदीषु सुद्धासु शौचं कृत्वा यथाविधि
verses.transliteration: uṣaḥ kāle 'tha saṃprāpte kṛtvā cāvaśyakaṃ budhaḥ / snāyānnadīṣu suddhāsu śaucaṃ kṛtvā yathāvidhi
verses.translation: He should then honour and revere his preceptor; he should do what is beneficent unto him; O Brahmanas, he should then recite the Vedic passages as much as he can, with assiduity.
verses.hindi: परिवेत्ता अर्थात् बड़े भाईके अविवाहित अथवा अनग्रिक रहते हुए विवाह तथा अग्नि स्वीकार करने- वाला छोटा भाई, हिंसा करनेवाला, परिवित्ति- (छोटे भाईके विवाहित होनेसे पहले अविवाहित रहनेवाला
verses.wordMeaning: He should then honour and revere his preceptor; he should do what is beneficent unto him; O Brahmanas, he should then recite the Vedic passages as much as he can, with assiduity.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should then honour and revere his preceptor; he should do what is beneficent unto him; O Brahmanas, he should then recite the Vedic passages as much as he can, with assiduity.

verses.sanskrit: प्रातः स्नानेन पूयन्ते ये ऽपि पापकृतो जनाः । तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन प्रातः स्नानं समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: prātaḥ snānena pūyante ye 'pi pāpakṛto janāḥ / tasmāt sarvaprayatnena prātaḥ snānaṃ samācaret
verses.translation: He should perform the Japa; he should teach his disciples; retain everything in memory and ponder over every¬ thing; O excellent Brahmanas, he should view Dharma etc. in the light of the scriptures.
verses.hindi: बड़ा भाई), निराकृति अर्थात् पञ्चमहायज्ञोंका अनुष्ठान न करनेवाला, पौनर्भव (दूसरे पतिसे उत्पन्न पुत्र), ब्याज लेनेवाला तथा नक्षत्रदर्शक (ज्योतिषसे जीविका चलानेवाले)-का श्राद्धादिमें परित्याग करना गाने-बजानेमें निरत, रोगी, काना, हीन अआङ्गोंवाला, अधिक अङ्गोंवाला, अवकीर्णी (स्त्रीसे सम्पर्क कर ब्रह्मचर्यव्रत नष्ट करनेवाला), कन्याको दूषित
verses.wordMeaning: He should perform the Japa; he should teach his disciples; retain everything in memory and ponder over every¬ thing; O excellent Brahmanas, he should view Dharma etc. in the light of the scriptures.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should perform the Japa; he should teach his disciples; retain everything in memory and ponder over every¬ thing; O excellent Brahmanas, he should view Dharma etc. in the light of the scriptures.

verses.sanskrit: प्रातः स्नानं प्रशंसन्ति दृष्टादृष्टकरं शुभम् । ऋषीणामृषिता नित्यं प्रातः स्नानान्न संशयः
verses.transliteration: prātaḥ snānaṃ praśaṃsanti dṛṣṭādṛṣṭakaraṃ śubham / ṛṣīṇāmṛṣitā nityaṃ prātaḥ snānānna saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: He should go through the Vedic Nigamas and all Vedahgas (Ancillary subjects of the Vedas). For the ac¬ hievement of Togaksema {Toga —attaining what has not been attained; Kema —preserving what has been attained) he should resort to Isvara.
verses.hindi: 'कन्यादूषी कुण्डगोलौ अभिशस्तोऽथ देवल: । मित्रध्रुक् पिशुनश्चैव नित्यं भार्यानुवर्तकः
verses.wordMeaning: He should go through the Vedic Nigamas and all Vedahgas (Ancillary subjects of the Vedas). For the ac¬ hievement of Togaksema {Toga —attaining what has not been attained; Kema —preserving what has been attained) he should resort to Isvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should go through the Vedic Nigamas and all Vedahgas (Ancillary subjects of the Vedas). For the ac¬ hievement of Togaksema {Toga —attaining what has not been attained; Kema —preserving what has been attained) he should resort to Isvara.

verses.sanskrit: मुखे सुप्तस्य सततं लाला याः संस्त्रवन्ति हि । ततो नैवाचरेत् कर्म अकृत्वा स्नानमादितः
verses.transliteration: mukhe suptasya satataṃ lālā yāḥ saṃstravanti hi / tato naivācaret karma akṛtvā snānamāditaḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, the Brahmana should gather together the various articles for his household. Then at midday, he should fetch clay for the bath.
verses.hindi: गोत्रभिद् भ्रष्टशौचश्च काण्डस्पृष्टस्तथैव च अनपत्यः कूटसाक्षी याचको रङ्गजीवकः। समुद्रयायी कृतहा तथा समयभेदकः
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, the Brahmana should gather together the various articles for his household. Then at midday, he should fetch clay for the bath.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, the Brahmana should gather together the various articles for his household. Then at midday, he should fetch clay for the bath.

verses.sanskrit: अलक्ष्मीः कालकर्णो च दुः स्वप्नं दुर्विचिन्तितम् । प्रातः स्नानेन पापानि पूयन्ते नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: alakṣmīḥ kālakarṇo ca duḥ svapnaṃ durvicintitam / prātaḥ snānena pāpāni pūyante nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: He should also fetch flowers, raw rice grains, Kusa grass, gingelly seeds as well as pure cowdung. He should always perform his ablution in rivers, in tanks, dug up by gods (i.e. natural), in lakes, in puddles or in fountains.
verses.hindi: देवनिन्दापरश्चैव वेदनिन्दारतस्तथा। द्विजनिन्दारतश्चैते वर्ज्याः श्राद्धादिकर्मसु
verses.wordMeaning: He should also fetch flowers, raw rice grains, Kusa grass, gingelly seeds as well as pure cowdung. He should always perform his ablution in rivers, in tanks, dug up by gods (i.e. natural), in lakes, in puddles or in fountains.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should also fetch flowers, raw rice grains, Kusa grass, gingelly seeds as well as pure cowdung. He should always perform his ablution in rivers, in tanks, dug up by gods (i.e. natural), in lakes, in puddles or in fountains.

verses.sanskrit: न च स्नानं विना पुंसां पावनं कर्म सुस्मृतम् । होमे जप्ये विशेषेण तस्मात् स्नानं समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: na ca snānaṃ vinā puṃsāṃ pāvanaṃ karma susmṛtam / home japye viśeṣeṇa tasmāt snānaṃ samācaret
verses.translation: One should never take bath in a water reservoir
verses.hindi: कृतघ्नः पिशुनः क्रूरो नास्तिको वेदनिन्दकः । मित्रध्रुक् कुहकश्चैव विशेषात् पंक्तिदूषकाः सर्वे पुनरभोज्यान्नास्त्वदानार्हाश्च कर्मसु। ब्रह्मभावनिरस्ताश्च वर्जनीयाः प्रयत्नतः
verses.wordMeaning: One should never take bath in a water reservoir
verses.commentary: Sense: One should never take bath in a water reservoir

verses.sanskrit: अशक्तावशिरस्कं वा स्नानमस्य विधीयते । आर्द्रेण वाससा वाथ मार्जनं कापिलं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: aśaktāvaśiraskaṃ vā snānamasya vidhīyate / ārdreṇa vāsasā vātha mārjanaṃ kāpilaṃ smṛtam
verses.translation: (He should divide the clay into many small lumps). With one of the lumps of the clay, the head is to be cleaned, with two (such lumps) he should clean the portion above the umbilical region and with three lumps he should clean the lower region. The legs and the feet shall be cleaned with six lumps of clay.
verses.hindi: महायज्ञविहीनश्च ब्राह्मणः पंक्तिदूषकः
verses.wordMeaning: (He should divide the clay into many small lumps). With one of the lumps of the clay, the head is to be cleaned, with two (such lumps) he should clean the portion above the umbilical region and with three lumps he should clean the lower region.…
verses.commentary: Sense: (He should divide the clay into many small lumps). With one of the lumps of the clay, the head is to be cleaned, with two (such lumps) he should clean the portion above the umbilical region and with three lumps he should clean the lower region.…

verses.sanskrit: असामर्थ्ये समुत्पन्ने स्नानमेवं समाचरेत् । ब्राह्मादीनि यथाशक्तौ स्नानान्याहुर्मनीषिणः
verses.transliteration: asāmarthye samutpanne snānamevaṃ samācaret / brāhmādīni yathāśaktau snānānyāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ
verses.translation: It is enjoined that the clay should be wet and of the size of a big myrobalan. The size of the cowdung is also that much. One should smear it over one's limps.
verses.hindi: करनेवाला, कुण्ड (पतिके जीवित रहते परपुरुषसे उत्पन्न संतान), गोलक (पतिकी मृत्युके वाद उपपतिसे उत्पन्न संतान), अभिशस्त ( मिथ्यापवादग्रस्त), (देवल) मन्दिर आदिसे आजीविका प्राप्त करनेवाले (पुजारी आदि), मित्रद्रोही, चुगली करनेवाला और नित्य भार्याके वशीभूत रहनेवाला-ये श्राद्धादिमें त्याज्य हैं
verses.wordMeaning: It is enjoined that the clay should be wet and of the size of a big myrobalan. The size of the cowdung is also that much. One should smear it over one's limps.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is enjoined that the clay should be wet and of the size of a big myrobalan. The size of the cowdung is also that much. One should smear it over one's limps.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्ममाग्नेयमुद्दिष्टं वायव्यं दिव्यमेव च । वारुणं यौगिकं तद्वत् षोढा स्नानं प्रकीर्तितम्
verses.transliteration: brāhmamāgneyamuddiṣṭaṃ vāyavyaṃ divyameva ca / vāruṇaṃ yaugikaṃ tadvat ṣoḍhā snānaṃ prakīrtitam
verses.translation: While standing on the bank, he should first smear the body chanting the relevant Mantras. After washing his hand and performing Acamana, he should then carefully take his bath.
verses.hindi: माता, पिता, गुरु तथा पत्रीका त्याग करनेवाला, सगोत्र (भाई-बन्धु)-में भेदबुद्धि पैदा करनेवाला,
verses.wordMeaning: While standing on the bank, he should first smear the body chanting the relevant Mantras. After washing his hand and performing Acamana, he should then carefully take his bath.
verses.commentary: Sense: While standing on the bank, he should first smear the body chanting the relevant Mantras. After washing his hand and performing Acamana, he should then carefully take his bath.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मं तु मार्जनं मन्त्रैः कुशैः सोदकबिन्दुभिः । आग्नेयं भस्मना पादमस्तकाद्देहधूलनम्
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṃ tu mārjanaṃ mantraiḥ kuśaiḥ sodakabindubhiḥ / āgneyaṃ bhasmanā pādamastakāddehadhūlanam
verses.translation: Sanctifying the water with auspicious Mantras per¬ taining to Varuna and symbolic of water, he should meditate upon the unmanifest eternal Visnu and get purified at heart while bathing.
verses.hindi: गवाही देनेवाला, याचक, रंगद्वारा जीविकोपार्जन करनेवाला (चित्रकार, नाट्यकार), समुद्रकी यात्रा करनेवाला, कृतघ्न और प्रतिज्ञा-भङ्ग करनेवाला, देवनिन्दापरायण, वेदनिन्दामें निरत तथा द्विजकी निन्दा करनेवाला-ये सभी श्राद्धादि कर्मोमें त्याज्य हैं। कृतन्न, चुगली करनेवाला, क्रूर, नास्तिक, वेदकी निन्दा करनेवाला, मित्रद्रोही तथा ऐन्द्रजालिक (मायावी, दाम्भिक)-ये विशेषरूपसे पंक्तिदूषक हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Sanctifying the water with auspicious Mantras per¬ taining to Varuna and symbolic of water, he should meditate upon the unmanifest eternal Visnu and get purified at heart while bathing.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sanctifying the water with auspicious Mantras per¬ taining to Varuna and symbolic of water, he should meditate upon the unmanifest eternal Visnu and get purified at heart while bathing.

verses.sanskrit: गवां हि रजसा प्रोक्तं वायव्यं स्नानमुत्तमम् । यत्तु सातपवर्षेण स्नानं तद् दिव्यमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: gavāṃ hi rajasā proktaṃ vāyavyaṃ snānamuttamam / yattu sātapavarṣeṇa snānaṃ tad divyamucyate
verses.translation: The waters have been originated from Narayana. Waters alone constitute his Ayana (receptacle). Hence a learned man should remember lord Narayana at the time of ablution.
verses.hindi: (उपर्युक्त) सभी प्रकारके व्यक्ति श्राद्धमें भोजन न कराने योग्य और सभी कर्मोमें दानके अयोग्य होते हैं । ब्रह्मभावसे शून्य अर्थात् ब्राह्मणत्वसे च्युत व्यक्तियोंका विशेषरूपसे त्याग करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: The waters have been originated from Narayana. Waters alone constitute his Ayana (receptacle). Hence a learned man should remember lord Narayana at the time of ablution.
verses.commentary: Sense: The waters have been originated from Narayana. Waters alone constitute his Ayana (receptacle). Hence a learned man should remember lord Narayana at the time of ablution.

verses.sanskrit: वारुणं चावगाहस्तु मानसं त्वात्मवेदनम् । यौगिकं स्नानमाख्यातं योगो विष्णुविचिन्तनम्
verses.transliteration: vāruṇaṃ cāvagāhastu mānasaṃ tvātmavedanam / yaugikaṃ snānamākhyātaṃ yogo viṣṇuvicintanam
verses.translation: After glancing at the sun with the repetitions of the Orhkara, he should dip himself in the water three times.
verses.hindi: शूद्रके अन्न एवं रससे पुष्ट हुए अङ्गोंवाला, संध्योपासनासे रहित, पञ्चमहायज्ञोसे शून्य ब्राह्मण पंक्तिदूषक होता है। पढ़े गये वेदादिका विस्मरण करनेवाला, स्नान एवं होमसे रहित, तमोगुणी तथा रजोगुणी ब्राह्मण पंक्तिदूषक होता है
verses.wordMeaning: After glancing at the sun with the repetitions of the Orhkara, he should dip himself in the water three times.
verses.commentary: Sense: After glancing at the sun with the repetitions of the Orhkara, he should dip himself in the water three times.

verses.sanskrit: आत्मतीर्थमिति ख्यातं सेवितं ब्रह्मवादिभिः । मनः शुचिकरं पुंसां नित्यं तत् स्नानमाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: ātmatīrthamiti khyātaṃ sevitaṃ brahmavādibhiḥ / manaḥ śucikaraṃ puṃsāṃ nityaṃ tat snānamācaret
verses.translation: After performing the Acamana rite twice, the knower of the Mantras should repeat the following Mantra.
verses.hindi: अधिक क्या कहा जाय । जो शास्त्रविहित स्वकर्मोको नहीं करते और शास्त्रनिषिद्ध (निन्दित) कर्मोंका आचरण
verses.wordMeaning: After performing the Acamana rite twice, the knower of the Mantras should repeat the following Mantra.
verses.commentary: Sense: After performing the Acamana rite twice, the knower of the Mantras should repeat the following Mantra.

verses.sanskrit: शक्तश्चेद् वारुणं विद्वान् प्राजापत्यं तथैव च । प्रक्षाल्य दन्तकाष्ठं वै भक्षयित्वा विधानतः
verses.transliteration: śaktaśced vāruṇaṃ vidvān prājāpatyaṃ tathaiva ca / prakṣālya dantakāṣṭhaṃ vai bhakṣayitvā vidhānataḥ
verses.translation: "You move about within the living beings, in the cavity of the heart, you have faces all round. You are Yajna; you are Vasatkara; O waters, you are the brilliance, the nectarine juice".
verses.hindi: निन्दितानाचरन्त्येते वर्जनीयाः प्रयत्नतः॥ ४९ ॥  करते हैं, वे प्रयत्नपूर्वक त्याग करने योग्य हैं इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे पट्साहर्रधां संहितायामुपरिविभागे एकविंशोउध्याय:
verses.wordMeaning: "You move about within the living beings, in the cavity of the heart, you have faces all round. You are Yajna; you are Vasatkara; O waters, you are the brilliance, the nectarine juice".
verses.commentary: Sense: "You move about within the living beings, in the cavity of the heart, you have faces all round. You are Yajna; you are Vasatkara; O waters, you are the brilliance, the nectarine juice".

verses.sanskrit: आचम्य प्रयतो नित्यं स्नानं प्रातः समाचरेत् । मध्याङ्गुलिसमस्थौल्यं द्वादशाङ्गुलसंमितम्
verses.transliteration: ācamya prayato nityaṃ snānaṃ prātaḥ samācaret / madhyāṅgulisamasthaulyaṃ dvādaśāṅgulasaṃmitam
verses.translation: He should then repeat the Drupada Mantra three times, or he sha'l repeat the Vyahrtis along with the Pranava. The learned man should repeat the Savitrl Mantra or the Aghamarfana mantra.
verses.hindi: श्राद्ध-प्रकरणमें ब्राह्मण निमन्त्रित करनेकी विधि, निमन्त्रित ब्राह्मणके कर्तव्य, श्राद्धविधि, श्राद्धमें प्रशस्त पात्र, पितरोंकी प्रार्थना, श्राद्धके दिन निषिद्ध कर्म, वृद्धिश्राद्धका विधान, श्राद्ध-प्रकरणका उपसंहार
verses.wordMeaning: He should then repeat the Drupada Mantra three times, or he sha'l repeat the Vyahrtis along with the Pranava. The learned man should repeat the Savitrl Mantra or the Aghamarfana mantra.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should then repeat the Drupada Mantra three times, or he sha'l repeat the Vyahrtis along with the Pranava. The learned man should repeat the Savitrl Mantra or the Aghamarfana mantra.

verses.sanskrit: सत्वचं दन्तकाष्ठं स्यात् तदग्रेण तु धावयेत् । क्षीरवृक्षसमुद्भूतं मालतीसंभवं शुभम् । अपामार्गं च बिल्वं च करवीरं विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: satvacaṃ dantakāṣṭhaṃ syāt tadagreṇa tu dhāvayet / kṣīravṛkṣasamudbhūtaṃ mālatīsaṃbhavaṃ śubham / apāmārgaṃ ca bilvaṃ ca karavīraṃ viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: Then he should perform the Sammarjana rite (wip¬ ing off) by repeating the Mantra, Apo hi fthd mayo bhuvak
verses.hindi: तस्य ते पितरः श्रुत्वा श्राद्धकालमुपस्थितम्। अन्योन्यं मनसा ध्यात्वा सम्पतन्ति मनोजवाः आमन्त्रिताश्च ते विप्राः श्राद्धकाल उपस्थिते । वसेयुर्नियताः सर्वे ब्रह्मचर्यपरायणाः
verses.wordMeaning: Then he should perform the Sammarjana rite (wip¬ ing off) by repeating the Mantra, Apo hi fthd mayo bhuvak
verses.commentary: Sense: Then he should perform the Sammarjana rite (wip¬ ing off) by repeating the Mantra, Apo hi fthd mayo bhuvak

verses.sanskrit: वर्जयित्वा निन्दितानि गृहीत्वैकं यथोदितम् । परिहृत्य दिनं पापं भक्षयेद् वै विधानवित्
verses.transliteration: varjayitvā ninditāni gṛhītvaikaṃ yathoditam / parihṛtya dinaṃ pāpaṃ bhakṣayed vai vidhānavit
verses.translation: With the three Mantras beginning with "Apo hi stha" RV.X. 9.1) etc. he should sanctify the water and then dip him¬ selfunder. He should then repeat the Aghamarsana Mantra (RV. X. 190-3) three times.
verses.hindi: स याति नरकं घोरं सूकरत्वं प्रयाति च
verses.wordMeaning: With the three Mantras beginning with "Apo hi stha" RV.X. 9.1) etc. he should sanctify the water and then dip him¬ selfunder. He should then repeat the Aghamarsana Mantra (RV. X. 190-3) three times.
verses.commentary: Sense: With the three Mantras beginning with "Apo hi stha" RV.X. 9.1) etc. he should sanctify the water and then dip him¬ selfunder. He should then repeat the Aghamarsana Mantra (RV. X. 190-3) three times.

verses.sanskrit: नोत्पाटयेद्दन्तकाष्टंनाङ्गुल्या धावयेत् क्वचित् । प्रक्षाल्य भङ्क्त्वा तज्जह्याच्छुचौदेशे समाहितः
verses.transliteration: notpāṭayeddantakāṣṭaṃnāṅgulyā dhāvayet kvacit / prakṣālya bhaṅktvā tajjahyācchucaudeśe samāhitaḥ
verses.translation: He should also repeat the Drupadd (Vaj. Saih. 20. 20) or the Savitri Mantra. That is the greatest world of Visnu. Or he should repeat the Pranava or remember Lord Hari.
verses.hindi: स तस्मादधिकः पापी विष्ठाकीटोऽभिजायते ब्रह्महत्यामवाप्नोति तिर्यग्योनौ च जायते
verses.wordMeaning: He should also repeat the Drupadd (Vaj. Saih. 20. 20) or the Savitri Mantra. That is the greatest world of Visnu. Or he should repeat the Pranava or remember Lord Hari.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should also repeat the Drupadd (Vaj. Saih. 20. 20) or the Savitri Mantra. That is the greatest world of Visnu. Or he should repeat the Pranava or remember Lord Hari.

verses.sanskrit: स्नात्वा संतर्पयेद् देवानृषीन् पितृगणांस्तथा । आचम्य मन्त्रवन्नित्यं पुनराचम्य वाग्यतः
verses.transliteration: snātvā saṃtarpayed devānṛṣīn pitṛgaṇāṃstathā / ācamya mantravannityaṃ punarācamya vāgyataḥ
verses.translation: (Defective) After repeating three times the Mantra established in the Yajurveda like Drupaddiva (Vaj. Saih-20.20) under the water, one is liberated from all sins.
verses.hindi: व्यासजी बोले सावधानीपूर्वक गोबर और जलसे (श्राद्ध) भूमिको शुद्धकर सभी ब्राह्मणोंकी सेवामें पहुँचकर सज्जन पुरुषोंद्वारा उन्हें निमन्त्रित करना चाहिए  श्राद्धके पहले दिन ब्राह्मणोंकी (नम्रभावसे
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective) After repeating three times the Mantra established in the Yajurveda like Drupaddiva (Vaj. Saih-20.20) under the water, one is liberated from all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective) After repeating three times the Mantra established in the Yajurveda like Drupaddiva (Vaj. Saih-20.20) under the water, one is liberated from all sins.

verses.sanskrit: संमार्ज्य मन्त्रैरात्मानं कुशैः सोदकबिन्दुभिः । आपो हिष्ठा व्याहृतिभिः सावित्र्या वारुणैः शुभैः
verses.transliteration: saṃmārjya mantrairātmānaṃ kuśaiḥ sodakabindubhiḥ / āpo hiṣṭhā vyāhṛtibhiḥ sāvitryā vāruṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ
verses.translation: He should take water in the palm, perform Japa and the MdrjancP rite and place that water (sprinkle it over the head. He is liberated from all sins.
verses.hindi: आदरपूर्वक) पूजाकर उनसे कहना चाहिए-'कल हमारे यहाँ श्राद्ध होगा (आपलोग कृपाकर पधारें)'। ऐसा असम्भव होनेपर दूसरे (दिन) अर्थात् श्राद्धके ही दिन यथोक्त लक्षणोंसे समन्वित ब्राह्मणोंको निमन्त्रित मनके समान शीघ्र गतिवाले पितर जब यह सुन लेते हैं कि श्राद्धकाल उपस्थित है, तब परस्पर विचारकर श्राद्धकर्ताके यहाँ एकत्र हो जाते हैं। अन्तरिक्षमें विचरण करनेवाले पितर वायुरूपसे स्थित रहते हैं,
verses.wordMeaning: He should take water in the palm, perform Japa and the MdrjancP rite and place that water (sprinkle it over the head. He is liberated from all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should take water in the palm, perform Japa and the MdrjancP rite and place that water (sprinkle it over the head. He is liberated from all sins.

verses.sanskrit: ओङ्कारव्याहृतियुतां गायत्रीं वेदमातरम् । जप्त्वा जलाञ्जलिं दद्याद् भास्करं प्रति तन्मनाः
verses.transliteration: oṅkāravyāhṛtiyutāṃ gāyatrīṃ vedamātaram / japtvā jalāñjaliṃ dadyād bhāskaraṃ prati tanmanāḥ
verses.translation: Just as the horse-sacrihce is the king of all sacrifices and dispels all sins, so also the Mantra Aghamarsana is said to be destructive of all sins.
verses.hindi: ब्राह्मणोंके साथ भोजन करते हैं और भोजन करके परमगति प्राप्त करते हैं। श्राद्धका समय आनेपर सभी आमन्त्रित ब्राह्मणोंको संयमी और ब्रह्मचर्यपरायण होकर रहना चाहिए॥ ३--५॥
verses.wordMeaning: Just as the horse-sacrihce is the king of all sacrifices and dispels all sins, so also the Mantra Aghamarsana is said to be destructive of all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as the horse-sacrihce is the king of all sacrifices and dispels all sins, so also the Mantra Aghamarsana is said to be destructive of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: प्राक्कूलेषु समासीनो दर्भेषु सुसमाहितः । प्राणायामत्रयं कृत्वा ध्यायेत् संध्यामिति श्रुतिः
verses.transliteration: prākkūleṣu samāsīno darbheṣu susamāhitaḥ / prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā dhyāyet saṃdhyāmiti śrutiḥ
verses.translation: He should then pray unto the sun. He should throw up flowers along with the Aksatas (raw rice grains) and glance at the lord who is above and beyond darkness.
verses.hindi: श्राद्ध करनेवालेको क्रोध, उतावलापन तथा प्रमादका त्यागकर समाहित होना चाहिए, सत्य बोलना चाहिए। उसे भारका ढोना, मैथुन, मार्गगमन (यात्रा आदि) और जपका (किसी कामनापरक यज्ञादिका श्राद्धके समय) परित्याग करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: He should then pray unto the sun. He should throw up flowers along with the Aksatas (raw rice grains) and glance at the lord who is above and beyond darkness.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should then pray unto the sun. He should throw up flowers along with the Aksatas (raw rice grains) and glance at the lord who is above and beyond darkness.

verses.sanskrit: या संध्या सा जगत्सूतिर्मायातीता हि निष्कला । ऐश्वरी तु पराशक्तिस्तत्त्वत्रयसमुद्भवा
verses.transliteration: yā saṃdhyā sā jagatsūtirmāyātītā hi niṣkalā / aiśvarī tu parāśaktistattvatrayasamudbhavā
verses.translation: He should make the rosary with crystal beads, Indra- ksas, Rudraksas or Putrajivas (Putranjiva; Rox burghii). The later ones are better than the earlier ones.
verses.hindi: (पहलेसे ही) निमन्त्रित ब्राह्मण (यदि) किसी दूसरेका निमन्त्रण स्वीकार करता है तो वह घोर नरकमें जाता है और बादमें सूकरकी योनि प्राप्त करता है। (किसी एक) ब्राह्मणको आमन्त्रित करके जो मोहसे
verses.wordMeaning: He should make the rosary with crystal beads, Indra- ksas, Rudraksas or Putrajivas (Putranjiva; Rox burghii). The later ones are better than the earlier ones.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should make the rosary with crystal beads, Indra- ksas, Rudraksas or Putrajivas (Putranjiva; Rox burghii). The later ones are better than the earlier ones.

verses.sanskrit: ध्यात्वार्ऽकमण्डलगतां सावित्रीं वै जपन् बुधः । प्राङ्मुखः सततं विप्रः संध्योपासनमाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: dhyātvār'kamaṇḍalagatāṃ sāvitrīṃ vai japan budhaḥ / prāṅmukhaḥ satataṃ vipraḥ saṃdhyopāsanamācaret
verses.translation: (Defective) while repeating Japa, the sensible man should not speak, not look at any external thing, not shake the head or the neck, nor show the teeth outside.
