verses.hindi: दूसरेको आमन्त्रित करता है, वह व्यक्ति उससे भी अधिक पापी होता है (जो निमन्त्रित होनेपर भी दूसरी जगह जाता है) और विष्ठाका कीड़ा होता है। श्राद्धमें निमन्त्रित जो ब्राह्मण मैथुन करता है, वह ब्रह्महत्या (के पाप)-को प्राप्त करता है और बादमें तिर्यकू- योनिमें उत्पन्न होता है
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective) while repeating Japa, the sensible man should not speak, not look at any external thing, not shake the head or the neck, nor show the teeth outside.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective) while repeating Japa, the sensible man should not speak, not look at any external thing, not shake the head or the neck, nor show the teeth outside.

verses.sanskrit: संध्याहीनो ऽशुचिर्नित्यमनर्हः सर्वकर्मसु । यदन्यत् कुरुते किञ्चिन्न तस्य फलमाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: saṃdhyāhīno 'śucirnityamanarhaḥ sarvakarmasu / yadanyat kurute kiñcinna tasya phalamāpnuyāt
verses.translation: Since theGuhyakas, Raksasas and the Siddhas remove the benefit, one should perform the Japa-rite in an isolated, pure place.
verses.hindi: शर कूर्मपुराण नर
verses.wordMeaning: Since theGuhyakas, Raksasas and the Siddhas remove the benefit, one should perform the Japa-rite in an isolated, pure place.
verses.commentary: Sense: Since theGuhyakas, Raksasas and the Siddhas remove the benefit, one should perform the Japa-rite in an isolated, pure place.

verses.sanskrit: अनन्यचेतसः शान्ता ब्राह्मणा वेदपारगाः । उपास्य विधिवत् संध्यां प्राप्ताः पूर्वं परां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: ananyacetasaḥ śāntā brāhmaṇā vedapāragāḥ / upāsya vidhivat saṃdhyāṃ prāptāḥ pūrvaṃ parāṃ gatim
verses.translation: On seeing a Candala or a fallen man or one with Asauca (impurity), one shall perform the Japa once again. If he talks to them, he should bathe again and perform the Japa once again.
verses.hindi: अक्रोधनः शौचपरः कर्ता चैव जितेन्द्रियः सर्वाण्यस्वामिकान्याहुर्न हि तेषु परिग्रहः
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing a Candala or a fallen man or one with Asauca (impurity), one shall perform the Japa once again. If he talks to them, he should bathe again and perform the Japa once again.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing a Candala or a fallen man or one with Asauca (impurity), one shall perform the Japa once again. If he talks to them, he should bathe again and perform the Japa once again.

verses.sanskrit: यो ऽन्यत्र कुरुते यत्नं धर्मकार्ये द्विजोत्तमः । विहाय संध्याप्रणतिं स याति नरकायुतम्
verses.transliteration: yo 'nyatra kurute yatnaṃ dharmakārye dvijottamaḥ / vihāya saṃdhyāpraṇatiṃ sa yāti narakāyutam
verses.translation: If one sees anything impure, one should immediately perform the Acamana rite and perform the Japa with purity. He should repeat Mantras pertaining to the sun in accordance to his capacity and the "Pavamani" hymns as he likes.
verses.hindi: ततोऽन्नं बहुसंस्कारं नैकव्यञ्जनमच्युतम्। चोष्यपेयसमृद्धं च यथाशक्त्या प्रकल्पयेत्
verses.wordMeaning: If one sees anything impure, one should immediately perform the Acamana rite and perform the Japa with purity. He should repeat Mantras pertaining to the sun in accordance to his capacity and the "Pavamani" hymns as he likes.
verses.commentary: Sense: If one sees anything impure, one should immediately perform the Acamana rite and perform the Japa with purity. He should repeat Mantras pertaining to the sun in accordance to his capacity and the "Pavamani" hymns as he likes.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन संध्योपासनमाचरेत् । उपासितो भवेत् तेन देवो योगतनुः परः
verses.transliteration: tasmāt sarvaprayatnena saṃdhyopāsanamācaret / upāsito bhavet tena devo yogatanuḥ paraḥ
verses.translation: If he happens to wear wet cloth, he can perform the Japa in the middle of water. Otherwise he should sit in a pure, clean place on the Darbha grass with great concentration.
verses.hindi: पात्रैरौदुम्बरैर्दद्याद् वैश्वहैवत्यपूर्वकम् ये चात्र विश्वदेवानां विप्राः पूर्व निमन्त्रिताः । प्राङ्मुखान्यासनान्येषां त्रिदर्भोपहितानि च
verses.wordMeaning: If he happens to wear wet cloth, he can perform the Japa in the middle of water. Otherwise he should sit in a pure, clean place on the Darbha grass with great concentration.
verses.commentary: Sense: If he happens to wear wet cloth, he can perform the Japa in the middle of water. Otherwise he should sit in a pure, clean place on the Darbha grass with great concentration.

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रपरमां नित्यं शतमध्यां दशावराम् । सावित्ररिं वै जपेद् विद्वान् प्राङ्मुखः प्रयतः स्थितः
verses.transliteration: sahasraparamāṃ nityaṃ śatamadhyāṃ daśāvarām / sāvitrariṃ vai japed vidvān prāṅmukhaḥ prayataḥ sthitaḥ
verses.translation: He should circumambulate, prostrate on the ground, perform the Acamaria rite in accordance with the scripture and then begin his self-study of the Vedas with devotion.
verses.hindi: श्राद्धमे निमन्त्रित जो दुर्बुद्धि ब्राह्मण यात्रा करता है, उसके पितर उस महीने धूलिका भक्षण करते हैं श्राद्धमे निमन्त्रित जो ब्राह्मण कलह करता है, उस महीनेमें उसके पितर मलका भोजन करते हैं, इसलिये श्राद्धमे
verses.wordMeaning: He should circumambulate, prostrate on the ground, perform the Acamaria rite in accordance with the scripture and then begin his self-study of the Vedas with devotion.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should circumambulate, prostrate on the ground, perform the Acamaria rite in accordance with the scripture and then begin his self-study of the Vedas with devotion.

verses.sanskrit: अथोपतिष्ठेदादित्यमुदयन्तं समाहितः । मन्त्रैस्तु विविधैः सौरेरृग्यजुः सामसंभवैः
verses.transliteration: athopatiṣṭhedādityamudayantaṃ samāhitaḥ / mantraistu vividhaiḥ saurerṛgyajuḥ sāmasaṃbhavaiḥ
verses.translation: While performing the rite of Tarpana to Devas and the sages, he should do so with his right hand supported by the left hand (below). The intelligent man should perform Tarpana rite of the Pitrs with handfuls of water. While per¬ forming Deva-Tarpana the sacred thread is worn (savja) as usual;
verses.hindi: निमन्त्रित ब्राह्मणको नियतात्मा, क्रोधशून्य तथा शौचपरायण रहना चाहिए और श्राद्धकर्ताको भी जितेन्द्रिय होना चाहिए ॥ १०--१२॥ श्राद्ध-दिनके पूर्व दिन समाहित होकर दक्षिण दिशामें जाकर अत्यन्त निर्मल, जड्सहित और दक्षिणको ओर झुके हुए कुशों और जलको लाना चाहिए। दक्षिणकी ओर झुके हुए, स्त्रि, अन्यके सम्बन्धसे
verses.wordMeaning: While performing the rite of Tarpana to Devas and the sages, he should do so with his right hand supported by the left hand (below). The intelligent man should perform Tarpana rite of the Pitrs with handfuls of water.…
verses.commentary: Sense: While performing the rite of Tarpana to Devas and the sages, he should do so with his right hand supported by the left hand (below). The intelligent man should perform Tarpana rite of the Pitrs with handfuls of water.…

verses.sanskrit: उपस्थाय महायोगं देवदेवं दिवाकरम् । कुर्वोत प्रणतिं भूमौ मूर्ध्ना तेनैव मन्त्रतः
verses.transliteration: upasthāya mahāyogaṃ devadevaṃ divākaram / kurvota praṇatiṃ bhūmau mūrdhnā tenaiva mantrataḥ
verses.translation: During the Pitrtarpana, he should wear the sacred thread on the right shoulder and under the left arm. After squeezing out the water from the cloth with which he takes bath, he should perform Acamana silently. He should worship Devas with their own Mantras by means of flowers, leaves and water.
verses.hindi: रहित (अर्थात् स्व-स्वत्ववाले) शुभ लक्षणोंवाले, पवित्र तथा एकान्त स्थानका गोमयसे उपलेपन करना चाहिए। नदियोंके किनारों, तीर्थो, अपनी भूमिमें, पर्वतके शिखरों तथा एकान्त स्थानोंपर श्राद्ध करनेसे पितर सदा संतुष्ट
verses.wordMeaning: During the Pitrtarpana, he should wear the sacred thread on the right shoulder and under the left arm. After squeezing out the water from the cloth with which he takes bath, he should perform Acamana silently. He should worship Devas with their own Mantras by means of flowers,…
verses.commentary: Sense: During the Pitrtarpana, he should wear the sacred thread on the right shoulder and under the left arm. After squeezing out the water from the cloth with which he takes bath, he should perform Acamana silently. He should worship Devas with their own Mantras by means of flowers,…

verses.sanskrit: ॐ खखोल्काय शान्ताय कारणत्रयहेतवे । निवेदयामि चात्मानं नमस्ते ज्ञानरूपिणे । नमस्ते घृणिने तुभ्यं सूर्याय ब्रह्मरूपिणे
verses.transliteration: oṃ khakholkāya śāntāya kāraṇatrayahetave / nivedayāmi cātmānaṃ namaste jñānarūpiṇe / namaste ghṛṇine tubhyaṃ sūryāya brahmarūpiṇe
verses.translation: An excellent man with good conduct and devotion should worship Brahma, Sankara, Visnu (the slayer of Madhu) and the sun. He should worship other deities also according to his desire.
verses.hindi: रहते हैं॥ १३--१५॥ दूसरेकी भूमिमें पितरोंका श्राद्ध नहीं करना चाहिए। यदि मोहवश मनुष्योंके द्वारा ऐसा किया जाता है तो वह कर्म (भूमिके) स्वामीके द्वारा विफल (नष्ट) कर दिया जाता है। जंगल, पर्वत, पुण्यतीर्थ, देवमन्दिर-
verses.wordMeaning: An excellent man with good conduct and devotion should worship Brahma, Sankara, Visnu (the slayer of Madhu) and the sun. He should worship other deities also according to his desire.
verses.commentary: Sense: An excellent man with good conduct and devotion should worship Brahma, Sankara, Visnu (the slayer of Madhu) and the sun. He should worship other deities also according to his desire.

verses.sanskrit: त्वमेव ब्रह्म परममापो ज्योती रसो ऽमृतम् । भूर्भुवः स्वस्त्वमोङ्कारः सर्वे रुद्राः सनातनाः । पुरुषः सन्महो ऽतस्त्वां प्रणमामि कपर्दिनम्
verses.transliteration: tvameva brahma paramamāpo jyotī raso 'mṛtam / bhūrbhuvaḥ svastvamoṅkāraḥ sarve rudrāḥ sanātanāḥ / puruṣaḥ sanmaho 'tastvāṃ praṇamāmi kapardinam
verses.translation: He should offer them flowers with the Puma Sukta. All the deities are well worshipped with water, as waters are all deities.
verses.hindi: ये सभी स्थान बिना स्वामीवाले (अर्थात् सार्वजनिक) कहे जाते हैं। इनपर किसीका स्वामित्व नहीं होता। (्ाद्धभूमिमें) सर्वत्र तिलोंको फैलाना चाहिए। तिलोंके द्वारा असुरोंसे उपहत अर्थात् आक्रान्त (श्राद्धभूमि) शुद्ध
verses.wordMeaning: He should offer them flowers with the Puma Sukta. All the deities are well worshipped with water, as waters are all deities.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should offer them flowers with the Puma Sukta. All the deities are well worshipped with water, as waters are all deities.

verses.sanskrit: त्वमेव विश्वं बहुधा सदसत् सूयते च यत् । नमो रुद्राय सूर्याय त्वामहं शरणं गतः
verses.transliteration: tvameva viśvaṃ bahudhā sadasat sūyate ca yat / namo rudrāya sūryāya tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ
verses.translation: One should meditate on the deities along with the Pranava, with great concentration: Repeating the word Namah (obeisance), he should offer the flowers one by one.
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर अनेक प्रकारसे शुद्ध किये गये प्रशस्त अन्नसे ऐसे अनेक प्रकारके भोज्य पक्वान्न बनाने चाहिए, जो चोष्य, पेय आदि उत्तमोत्तम व्यंजनोंसे यथाशक्ति समृद्ध हों । तदनन्तर मध्याहकाल व्यतीत होनेपर कृतक्षौर (नख और बाल कटाये हुए) द्विजों (ब्राह्मणों) -से मार्गमें मिलकर उन्हें दन्तधावन प्रदान करे
verses.wordMeaning: One should meditate on the deities along with the Pranava, with great concentration: Repeating the word Namah (obeisance), he should offer the flowers one by one.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should meditate on the deities along with the Pranava, with great concentration: Repeating the word Namah (obeisance), he should offer the flowers one by one.

verses.sanskrit: प्रचेतसे नमस्तुभ्यं नमो मीढुष्टमाय ते । नमो नमस्ते रुद्राय त्वामहं शरणं गतः
verses.transliteration: pracetase namastubhyaṃ namo mīḍhuṣṭamāya te / namo namaste rudrāya tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ
verses.translation: The holiness of all Vedic rites is due to the propitia¬ tion of Visnu. Hence, one should propitiate for ever Hari, the deity without beginning, middle, or end.
verses.hindi: वैश्वहैवत्य मन्त्रका उच्चारण कर उन्हें उदुम्बरके पात्रोंद्वारा अभ्यञ्जनके लिये उपयोगी तैल, स्रानके लिये जल अलग-अलग दे। तदुपरान्त उनके ख़ान कर लेनेपर उठकर हाथ जोडते हुए उन्हें क्रमशः पाद्य एवं
verses.wordMeaning: The holiness of all Vedic rites is due to the propitia¬ tion of Visnu. Hence, one should propitiate for ever Hari, the deity without beginning, middle, or end.
verses.commentary: Sense: The holiness of all Vedic rites is due to the propitia¬ tion of Visnu. Hence, one should propitiate for ever Hari, the deity without beginning, middle, or end.

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्यबाहवे तुभ्यं हिरण्यपतये नमः । अम्बिकापतये तुभ्यमुमायाः पतये नमः
verses.transliteration: hiraṇyabāhave tubhyaṃ hiraṇyapataye namaḥ / ambikāpataye tubhyamumāyāḥ pataye namaḥ
verses.translation: (One should propitiate Hari) with the Mantra beginning with the words Tad Visnoh (RV.I.22.20 or with the Purusa Sukta). He should do so with great concentration of mind. There is no other mantra mentioned in the four Vedas, which can be equal to these two. His soul and mind should be dedicated unto the lord. He will be calm (in mind) by (the power of) the Mantra Tad Vifnoh.
verses.hindi: आचमन देना चाहिए  विश्वेदेवोंके निमित्त जो ब्राह्मण पहले निमन्त्रित हैं, उन्हें तीन कुश रखकर पूर्वाभिमुख आसन प्रदान करना चाहिए हौ हैवे प्राङ्मुखौ पित्र्ये त्रयश्चोदङ्मुखास्तथा। एकैकं वा भवेत् तत्र देवमातामहेष्वपि
verses.wordMeaning: (One should propitiate Hari) with the Mantra beginning with the words Tad Visnoh (RV.I.22.20 or with the Purusa Sukta). He should do so with great concentration of mind. There is no other mantra mentioned in the four Vedas, which can be equal to these two.…
verses.commentary: Sense: (One should propitiate Hari) with the Mantra beginning with the words Tad Visnoh (RV.I.22.20 or with the Purusa Sukta). He should do so with great concentration of mind. There is no other mantra mentioned in the four Vedas, which can be equal to these two.…

verses.sanskrit: नमो ऽस्तु नीलग्रीवाय नमस्तुभ्यं पिनाकिने । विलोहिताय भर्गाय सहस्राक्षाय ते नमः
verses.transliteration: namo 'stu nīlagrīvāya namastubhyaṃ pinākine / vilohitāya bhargāya sahasrākṣāya te namaḥ
verses.translation: Or he should propitiate the eternal Lord Isana, Mahadeva, Mahesvara. He shall be sanctified by means of good feelings and thoughts.
verses.hindi: सत्क्रियां देशकालौ च शौचं ब्राह्माणसम्पदम्। पञ्चैतान् विस्तरो हन्ति तस्मान्नेहेत विस्तरम्
verses.wordMeaning: Or he should propitiate the eternal Lord Isana, Mahadeva, Mahesvara. He shall be sanctified by means of good feelings and thoughts.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or he should propitiate the eternal Lord Isana, Mahadeva, Mahesvara. He shall be sanctified by means of good feelings and thoughts.

verses.sanskrit: नमो हंसाय ते नित्यमादित्याय नमो ऽस्तु ते । नमस्ते वज्रहस्ताय त्र्यम्बकाय नमो ऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: namo haṃsāya te nityamādityāya namo 'stu te / namaste vajrahastāya tryambakāya namo 'stu te
verses.translation: With great concentration he should propitiate Mahesvara by means of the Pranava Mantra, Rudragayatri, Isana Mantra, Tryambaka Mantra or Rudra Mantras.
verses.hindi: प्रास्येदग्रौ तदन्नं तु दद्याद् वा ब्रह्मचारिणे। तस्मादेकमपि श्रेष्ठं विद्वांसं भोजयेद् द्विजम् भिक्षुको ब्रह्मचारी वा भोजनार्थमुपस्थितः। उपविष्टेषु यः श्राद्धे कामं तमपि भोजयेत्
verses.wordMeaning: With great concentration he should propitiate Mahesvara by means of the Pranava Mantra, Rudragayatri, Isana Mantra, Tryambaka Mantra or Rudra Mantras.
verses.commentary: Sense: With great concentration he should propitiate Mahesvara by means of the Pranava Mantra, Rudragayatri, Isana Mantra, Tryambaka Mantra or Rudra Mantras.

verses.sanskrit: प्रपद्ये त्वां विरूपाक्षं महान्तं परमेश्वरम् । हिरण्मयं गृहे गुप्तमात्मानं सर्वदेहिनाम्
verses.transliteration: prapadye tvāṃ virūpākṣaṃ mahāntaṃ parameśvaram / hiraṇmayaṃ gṛhe guptamātmānaṃ sarvadehinām
verses.translation: He should worship Mahesvara with flowers, leaves, water or sandal-paste and other articles. Or he should perform Japa by means of this Mantra Namah Sivdya (Obeisance to
verses.hindi: काकयोनिं व्रजन्त्येते दाता चैव न संशयः
verses.wordMeaning: He should worship Mahesvara with flowers, leaves, water or sandal-paste and other articles. Or he should perform Japa by means of this Mantra Namah Sivdya (Obeisance to
verses.commentary: Sense: He should worship Mahesvara with flowers, leaves, water or sandal-paste and other articles. Or he should perform Japa by means of this Mantra Namah Sivdya (Obeisance to

verses.sanskrit: नमस्यामि परं ज्योतिर्ब्रह्माणं त्वां परां गतिम् । विश्वं पशुपतिं भीमं नरनारीशरीरिणम्
verses.transliteration: namasyāmi paraṃ jyotirbrahmāṇaṃ tvāṃ parāṃ gatim / viśvaṃ paśupatiṃ bhīmaṃ naranārīśarīriṇam
verses.translation: One should make obeisance unto Mahadeva, Isvara, the conqueror of Death. He should dedicate his own self unto Isvara with the Mantra To Brahmanam. (AV. 5.18.49).
verses.hindi: कुक्कुटाः शूकरा श्वानो वर्ज्याः श्राद्धेषु दूरतः पितृ-ब्राह्मणोंको दक्षिणाग्र कुशके ऊपर तिलोदकसे प्रोक्षितकर दक्षिणाभिमुख आसन प्रदान करना चाहिए। श्राद्धकर्ता आसनका स्पर्श करते हुए 'आसध्वम्'- 'बैठिये' इस प्रकार कहकर उन पितृ-ब्राह्मणोंको
verses.wordMeaning: One should make obeisance unto Mahadeva, Isvara, the conqueror of Death. He should dedicate his own self unto Isvara with the Mantra To Brahmanam. (AV. 5.18.49).
verses.commentary: Sense: One should make obeisance unto Mahadeva, Isvara, the conqueror of Death. He should dedicate his own self unto Isvara with the Mantra To Brahmanam. (AV. 5.18.49).

verses.sanskrit: नमः सूर्याय रुद्राय भास्वते परमेष्ठिने । उग्राय सर्वभक्ताय त्वां प्रपद्ये सदैव हि
verses.transliteration: namaḥ sūryāya rudrāya bhāsvate parameṣṭhine / ugrāya sarvabhaktāya tvāṃ prapadye sadaiva hi
verses.translation: ABrahmana should circumambulate for five years (?) * He should meditate on god I Sana, Siva who is in the middle of the firmament.
verses.hindi: (विश्वेदेव) देवसम्बन्धी दो ब्राह्मणोंको पूर्वाभिमुख, पित्र्यसम्बन्धी तीन ब्राह्मणोंको उत्तराभिमुख बैठाना चाहिए अथवा देवसम्बन्धी और मातामह (पित्र्यसम्बन्धी)-के भी निमित्त एक-एक ब्राह्मणको बैठाना चाहिए । ( श्राद्धमे)
verses.wordMeaning: ABrahmana should circumambulate for five years (?) * He should meditate on god I Sana, Siva who is in the middle of the firmament.
verses.commentary: Sense: ABrahmana should circumambulate for five years (?) * He should meditate on god I Sana, Siva who is in the middle of the firmament.

verses.sanskrit: एतद् वै सूर्यहृदयं जप्त्वा स्तवमनुत्तमम् । प्रातः काले ऽथ मध्याह्ने नमस्कुर्याद् दिवाकरम्
verses.transliteration: etad vai sūryahṛdayaṃ japtvā stavamanuttamam / prātaḥ kāle 'tha madhyāhne namaskuryād divākaram
verses.translation: Afterwards, he should repeat the RK Haxhsah, Suciat (RV.IV.40.5) and look at the sun, etc.. After going home, he should perform the five great Yajna with great attention.
verses.hindi: सत्कार, देश, काल, पवित्रता और ब्राह्मणसम्पद्-इन पाँचोंका (अधिक) विस्तारके कारण नाश होता है, अतः विस्तारकी इच्छा नहीं करनी चाहिए, विस्तारकी अपेक्षा श्रुतशील आदिसे सम्पन्न अनपेक्षित क्षणोंसे रहित वेदके पारंगत एक ही ब्राह्मणको भोजन कराना उचित है
verses.wordMeaning: Afterwards, he should repeat the RK Haxhsah, Suciat (RV.IV.40.5) and look at the sun, etc.. After going home, he should perform the five great Yajna with great attention.
verses.commentary: Sense: Afterwards, he should repeat the RK Haxhsah, Suciat (RV.IV.40.5) and look at the sun, etc.. After going home, he should perform the five great Yajna with great attention.

verses.sanskrit: इदं पुत्राय शिष्याय धार्मिकाय द्विजातये । प्रदेयं सूर्यहृदयं ब्रह्मणा तु प्रदर्शितम्
verses.transliteration: idaṃ putrāya śiṣyāya dhārmikāya dvijātaye / pradeyaṃ sūryahṛdayaṃ brahmaṇā tu pradarśitam
verses.translation: They are Deva yajna, Pitr yajna, Bhuta yajna, Manusya-yajna (human beings i.e. guests) and Brahma yajna (study of the Vedas).
verses.hindi: किसी पात्रमें समस्त प्रकृत वस्तुओं (श्राद्धीय भोज्य पदार्थाँमेंसे उचित मात्रामें भोज्य लेकर) देवमन्दिरमें
verses.wordMeaning: They are Deva yajna, Pitr yajna, Bhuta yajna, Manusya-yajna (human beings i.e. guests) and Brahma yajna (study of the Vedas).
verses.commentary: Sense: They are Deva yajna, Pitr yajna, Bhuta yajna, Manusya-yajna (human beings i.e. guests) and Brahma yajna (study of the Vedas).

verses.sanskrit: सर्वपापप्रशमनं वेदसारसमुद्भवम् । ब्राह्मणानां हितं पुण्यमृषिसङ्घैर्निषेवितम्
verses.transliteration: sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ vedasārasamudbhavam / brāhmaṇānāṃ hitaṃ puṇyamṛṣisaṅghairniṣevitam
verses.translation: If, after the tarpana rite Brahma yajna rite is not performed, he should begin self-study of Vedas after performing Manusya yajna (hospitality to guests).
verses.hindi: प्रारम्भ करना चाहिए, उस (श्राद्धीय लवणरहित सिद्ध) अन्नको अग्निमें छोड़ना चाहिए अथवा ब्रह्मचारीको देना चाहिए। अतः एक भी श्रेष्ठ विद्वान् ब्राह्मणको भोजन कराना चाहिए श्राद्धमें निमन्त्रित ब्राह्मणोंके बैठ जानेपर भोजनके निमित्त उपस्थित हुए भिक्षुक अथवा ब्रह्मचारीको भी उनकी इच्छानुसार (श्राद्धमें जो यथेष्ट हो वह) भोजन कराना चाहिए। जिसके श्राद्धमें अतिथि भोजन नहीं
verses.wordMeaning: If, after the tarpana rite Brahma yajna rite is not performed, he should begin self-study of Vedas after performing Manusya yajna (hospitality to guests).
verses.commentary: Sense: If, after the tarpana rite Brahma yajna rite is not performed, he should begin self-study of Vedas after performing Manusya yajna (hospitality to guests).

verses.sanskrit: अथागम्य गृहं विप्रः समाचम्य यथाविधि । प्रज्वाल्य विह्निं विधिवज्जुहुयाज्जातवेदसम्
verses.transliteration: athāgamya gṛhaṃ vipraḥ samācamya yathāvidhi / prajvālya vihniṃ vidhivajjuhuyājjātavedasam
verses.translation: At the end of Bhuta Yajna, he should sit on a heap of Kusa grass in a spot to the west of the fire. He should be pure in mind and body and hold Kusa grass in his hand.
verses.hindi: करता, उसका श्राद्ध प्रशंसनीय नहीं होता। इसलिये द्विजोंको प्रयत्नपूर्वक श्राद्धोंमें अतिथियोंका पूजन करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: At the end of Bhuta Yajna, he should sit on a heap of Kusa grass in a spot to the west of the fire. He should be pure in mind and body and hold Kusa grass in his hand.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the end of Bhuta Yajna, he should sit on a heap of Kusa grass in a spot to the west of the fire. He should be pure in mind and body and hold Kusa grass in his hand.

verses.sanskrit: ऋत्विक्पुत्रो ऽथ पत्नी वा शिष्यो वापि सहोदरः । प्राप्यानुज्ञां विशेषेण जुहुयुर्वा यताविधि
verses.transliteration: ṛtvikputro 'tha patnī vā śiṣyo vāpi sahodaraḥ / prāpyānujñāṃ viśeṣeṇa juhuyurvā yatāvidhi
verses.translation: The Vaisvadeva rite must be performed in the sacrificial or secular fire or in water or on the ground. This is remembered as Deva Yajna.
verses.hindi: जो द्विज (ब्राह्मण) आतिथ्यरहित श्राद्धमें भोजन करते हैं, वे कौएकी योनिमें जाते हैं और दाताकी भी यही गति होती है, इसमें संदेह नहीं। श्राद्धमें हीन नास्तिक, कुक्कुट, शूकर तथा कुत्ता-ये दूरसे ही हटा देने योग्य हैं
verses.wordMeaning: The Vaisvadeva rite must be performed in the sacrificial or secular fire or in water or on the ground. This is remembered as Deva Yajna.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Vaisvadeva rite must be performed in the sacrificial or secular fire or in water or on the ground. This is remembered as Deva Yajna.

verses.sanskrit: पवित्रपाणिः पूतात्मा शुक्लाम्बरधरोत्तरः । अनन्यमानसो वह्निं जुहुयात् संयतेन्द्रियः
verses.transliteration: pavitrapāṇiḥ pūtātmā śuklāmbaradharottaraḥ / ananyamānaso vahniṃ juhuyāt saṃyatendriyaḥ
verses.translation: If the rice to be offered as oblation is cooked on secular fire, it (the oblations) be offered to that fire. If one were to cook that on sacrificial fire, that food is oblated to that sacrificial fire. This is the eternal procedure.
verses.hindi: १-सामान्यतः व्राह्मणकी जगह कुशपर श्राद्ध किया जाता है, किंतु सपात्रिक श्राद्धमें ब्राह्मणको बैठाकर श्राद्ध करनेका विधान है। २-इसका आशय यह है कि श्राद्धके अवसरपर अधिक विस्तार करनेपर यथायोग्य सत्कार, उचित देश, श्राद्धके शास्त्रविहित काल, यथाशास्त्र पवित्रता तथा श्राद्धयोग्य ब्राह्मणकी सुलभता निश्चित ही संदिग्ध हो जाती है।
verses.wordMeaning: If the rice to be offered as oblation is cooked on secular fire, it (the oblations) be offered to that fire. If one were to cook that on sacrificial fire, that food is oblated to that sacrificial fire. This is the eternal procedure.
verses.commentary: Sense: If the rice to be offered as oblation is cooked on secular fire, it (the oblations) be offered to that fire. If one were to cook that on sacrificial fire, that food is oblated to that sacrificial fire. This is the eternal procedure.

verses.sanskrit: विना दर्भेण यत्कर्म विना सूत्रेण वा पुनः । राक्षसं तद्भवेत् सर्वं नामुत्रेह फलप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: vinā darbheṇa yatkarma vinā sūtreṇa vā punaḥ / rākṣasaṃ tadbhavet sarvaṃ nāmutreha phalapradam
verses.translation: With the cooked food that remains after the offering unto Devas, one should offer Bhuta Bali. This should be known as Bhuta Yajna. It is the bestower of prosperity unto all
verses.hindi: नीलकाषायवसनं पाषण्डांश्च विवर्जयेत् यत् तत्र क्रियते कर्म पैतृकं ब्राह्मणान् प्रति। तत्सर्वमेव कर्तव्यं वैश्चहैवत्यपूर्वकम्
verses.wordMeaning: With the cooked food that remains after the offering unto Devas, one should offer Bhuta Bali. This should be known as Bhuta Yajna. It is the bestower of prosperity unto all
verses.commentary: Sense: With the cooked food that remains after the offering unto Devas, one should offer Bhuta Bali. This should be known as Bhuta Yajna. It is the bestower of prosperity unto all

verses.sanskrit: दैवतानि नमस्कुर्याद् देयसारान्निवेदयेत् । दद्यात् पुष्पादिकं तेषां वृद्धांश्चैवाभिवादयेत्
verses.transliteration: daivatāni namaskuryād deyasārānnivedayet / dadyāt puṣpādikaṃ teṣāṃ vṛddhāṃścaivābhivādayet
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas, the cooked food should be given to dogs, cookers of dogs (i.e. Candalas), fallen persons (i.e. outcastes) and birds, on the ground outside.
verses.hindi: ततस्त्वावाहयेद् देवान् ब्राह्मणानामनुञ्ञया। उदङ्मुखो यथान्यायं विश्वे देवास इत्यृचा
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahmanas, the cooked food should be given to dogs, cookers of dogs (i.e. Candalas), fallen persons (i.e. outcastes) and birds, on the ground outside.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmanas, the cooked food should be given to dogs, cookers of dogs (i.e. Candalas), fallen persons (i.e. outcastes) and birds, on the ground outside.

verses.sanskrit: गुरुं चैवाप्युपासीत हितं चास्य समाचरेत् । वेदाभ्यासं ततः कुर्यात् प्रयत्नाच्छक्तितो द्विजः
verses.transliteration: guruṃ caivāpyupāsīta hitaṃ cāsya samācaret / vedābhyāsaṃ tataḥ kuryāt prayatnācchaktito dvijaḥ
verses.translation: In the evening, his wife shall offer cooked food as Bali (offering to all beings) without uttering any Mantras. This is the Bhuta-Yajna to be performed both in the morning and in the evening.
verses.hindi: शं नो देव्या जलं क्षिप्त्वा यवोऽसीति यवांस्तथा शं नो देव्योदकं पात्रे तिलोऽसीति तिलांस्तथा
verses.wordMeaning: In the evening, his wife shall offer cooked food as Bali (offering to all beings) without uttering any Mantras. This is the Bhuta-Yajna to be performed both in the morning and in the evening.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the evening, his wife shall offer cooked food as Bali (offering to all beings) without uttering any Mantras. This is the Bhuta-Yajna to be performed both in the morning and in the evening.

verses.sanskrit: जपेदध्यापयेच्छिष्यान् धारयेच्च विचारयेत् । अवेक्षेत च शास्त्राणि धर्मादीनि द्विजोत्तमः । वैदिकांश्चैव निगमान् वेदाङ्गानि वेशिषतः
verses.transliteration: japedadhyāpayecchiṣyān dhārayecca vicārayet / avekṣeta ca śāstrāṇi dharmādīni dvijottamaḥ / vaidikāṃścaiva nigamān vedāṅgāni veśiṣataḥ
verses.translation: With the Pitrs in view, one should feed one Brah- mana daily. This Niiya Sraddha (with respect to manes) is called Pitr yajna. It is the bestower of good goals.
verses.hindi: अग्नौ करिष्येत्यादाय पृच्छत्यन्नं घृतप्लुतम् । कुरुष्वेत्यभ्यनुज्ञातो जुहुयादुपवीतवान्
verses.wordMeaning: With the Pitrs in view, one should feed one Brah- mana daily. This Niiya Sraddha (with respect to manes) is called Pitr yajna. It is the bestower of good goals.
verses.commentary: Sense: With the Pitrs in view, one should feed one Brah- mana daily. This Niiya Sraddha (with respect to manes) is called Pitr yajna. It is the bestower of good goals.

verses.sanskrit: उपेयादीश्वरं चाथ योगक्षेमप्रसिद्धये । साधयेद् विविधानर्थान् कुटुम्बार्थे ततो द्विजः
verses.transliteration: upeyādīśvaraṃ cātha yogakṣemaprasiddhaye / sādhayed vividhānarthān kuṭumbārthe tato dvijaḥ
verses.translation: One should take up some cooked rice according to his capacity and offer it to a Brahmana scholar who knows the meanings of Vedic passages.
verses.hindi: यज्ञोपवीतिना होमः कर्तव्यः कुशपाणिना। प्राचीनावीतिना पित्र्यं वैश्वदेवं तु होमवत् दक्षिणं पातयेज्जानुं देवान् परिचरन् पुमान्। पितृणां परिचर्यासु पातयेदितरं तथा
verses.wordMeaning: One should take up some cooked rice according to his capacity and offer it to a Brahmana scholar who knows the meanings of Vedic passages.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should take up some cooked rice according to his capacity and offer it to a Brahmana scholar who knows the meanings of Vedic passages.

verses.sanskrit: ततो मध्याह्नसमये स्नानार्थं मृदमाहरेत् । पुष्पाक्षतान् कुशतिलान् गोमयं शुद्धमेव च
verses.transliteration: tato madhyāhnasamaye snānārthaṃ mṛdamāharet / puṣpākṣatān kuśatilān gomayaṃ śuddhameva ca
verses.translation: One should honour one's guest verbally, mentally and physically. The lord (guest) should be bowed to and wors¬ hipped. He should be calm and should welcome the guest who has come to his house.
verses.hindi: नीला और कषाय वस्त्र धारण करनेवाले तथा पाखंडीका परित्याग करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: One should honour one's guest verbally, mentally and physically. The lord (guest) should be bowed to and wors¬ hipped. He should be calm and should welcome the guest who has come to his house.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should honour one's guest verbally, mentally and physically. The lord (guest) should be bowed to and wors¬ hipped. He should be calm and should welcome the guest who has come to his house.

verses.sanskrit: नदीषु देवखातेषु तडागेषु सरःसु च । स्नानं समाचरेन्नित्यं गर्तप्रस्त्रवणेषु च
verses.transliteration: nadīṣu devakhāteṣu taḍāgeṣu saraḥsu ca / snānaṃ samācarennityaṃ gartaprastravaṇeṣu ca
verses.translation: A Brahmana should offer the alms of any of the three types. Hantakdra, Agra or Bhiksd by means of his right hand supported by the left (below), in accordance with his capacity.
verses.hindi: श्राद्धमें पितृ-ब्राह्मणोंके प्रति जो भी कर्म किया जाता है, वह सब वैश्वदेवकर्मके अनन्तर करना चाहिए। यथाविधि (श्राद्धीय भोजनमें) बैठे हुए उन सभी (ब्राह्मणों ) को आभूषण, माला, यज्ञसूत्र, शिरोवेष्टन, धूप, वस्त्र तथा अनुलेपन आदिके द्वारा अलंकृत करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: A Brahmana should offer the alms of any of the three types. Hantakdra, Agra or Bhiksd by means of his right hand supported by the left (below), in accordance with his capacity.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmana should offer the alms of any of the three types. Hantakdra, Agra or Bhiksd by means of his right hand supported by the left (below), in accordance with his capacity.

verses.sanskrit: परकीयनिपानेषु न स्नायाद् वै कदाचन । पञ्चपिण्डान् समुद्धृत्य स्नायाद् वासंभवे पुनः
verses.transliteration: parakīyanipāneṣu na snāyād vai kadācana / pañcapiṇḍān samuddhṛtya snāyād vāsaṃbhave punaḥ
verses.translation: One should always honour and worship the guests coming to his house, in accordance with his capacity. One should give Bhiksa unto the mandicant and the Brahmacarin duly. One should be devoid of covetousness and give as much food as he can, unto the suppliants.
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर ब्राह्मणोंकी आज्ञासे उत्तराभिमुख होकर यथाविधि 'विश्वे देवास०' इस ऋचाका पाठकर देवोंका आवाहन करना चाहिए। दो पवित्र (कुश) ग्रहणकर 'शं नो देवी०'--यह मन्त्र पढ़कर प्रक्षालित
verses.wordMeaning: One should always honour and worship the guests coming to his house, in accordance with his capacity. One should give Bhiksa unto the mandicant and the Brahmacarin duly. One should be devoid of covetousness and give as much food as he can, unto the suppliants.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should always honour and worship the guests coming to his house, in accordance with his capacity. One should give Bhiksa unto the mandicant and the Brahmacarin duly. One should be devoid of covetousness and give as much food as he can, unto the suppliants.

verses.sanskrit: मृदैकया शिरः क्षाल्यं द्वाभ्यां नाभेस्तथोपरि । अधश्च तिसृभिः कायं पादौ षड्भिस्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: mṛdaikayā śiraḥ kṣālyaṃ dvābhyāṃ nābhestathopari / adhaśca tisṛbhiḥ kāyaṃ pādau ṣaḍbhistathaiva ca
verses.translation: If no guest is available, he should offer food unto the cows. One should be silent, while taking food. One should not find fault with the food served. One should take food along with many persons (v.l. with relatives).
verses.hindi: पात्रमें जल डाले और 'यबोऽसीति०' मन्त्रसे यव (जौ) भी डाले। 'या दिव्या०' इस मन्त्रसे (ब्राह्मणके) हाथपर अर्घ (अर्घपात्रका जल) छोड़े और यथाशक्ति गन्ध, माला, धूप तथा दीप आदि प्रदान करे॥ ३८--४०॥ तदनन्तर विद्वान् व्यक्तिको अपसव्य एवं दक्षिणाभिमुख होकर 'उशन्तस्त्वा०' इस ऋचासे पितरोंका आवाहन करना चाहिए। आवाहन करके उनकी आज्ञासे 'आ यन्तु नः०' इस मन्त्रका जप करना चाहिए। 'शं नो
verses.wordMeaning: If no guest is available, he should offer food unto the cows. One should be silent, while taking food. One should not find fault with the food served. One should take food along with many persons (v.l. with relatives).
verses.commentary: Sense: If no guest is available, he should offer food unto the cows. One should be silent, while taking food. One should not find fault with the food served. One should take food along with many persons (v.l. with relatives).

verses.sanskrit: मृत्तिका च समुद्दिष्टा त्वार्द्रामलकमात्रिका । गोमयस्य प्रमाणं तत् तेनाङ्गं लेपयेत् ततः
verses.transliteration: mṛttikā ca samuddiṣṭā tvārdrāmalakamātrikā / gomayasya pramāṇaṃ tat tenāṅgaṃ lepayet tataḥ
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas, if a Brahmana takes food without performing the five great Yajnas, the foolish soul shall be reborn among the animals.
verses.hindi: देवी०' इस मन्त्रसे पात्रमें जल डाले और 'तिलोऽसि०' इस मन्त्रसे तिल भी छोड़े। पहलेके समान अर्घ प्रदानकर अथवा ब्राह्मणोंके हाथमें (जलादि) प्रदानकर समाहित होकर पात्रमें संस्रव-अर्घका अवशिष्ट जल
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahmanas, if a Brahmana takes food without performing the five great Yajnas, the foolish soul shall be reborn among the animals.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmanas, if a Brahmana takes food without performing the five great Yajnas, the foolish soul shall be reborn among the animals.

verses.sanskrit: लेपयित्वा तु तीरस्थस्तल्लिङ्गैरेव मन्त्रतः । प्रक्षाल्याचम्य विधिवत् ततः स्नायात् समाहितः
verses.transliteration: lepayitvā tu tīrasthastalliṅgaireva mantrataḥ / prakṣālyācamya vidhivat tataḥ snāyāt samāhitaḥ
verses.translation: Daily study of the Vedas, the performance of Maha- Yajnas (the above-mentioned five great sacrifices)—an imperi¬ shable act—and the worship of gods quickly dispel all sins.
verses.hindi: रखे। तदनन्तर 'पितृभ्यःस्थानम्०' इस ममन्त्रसे पात्रको अधोमुख (उलटकर) रखे। घृतयुक्त अन्न लेकर 'अग्नौ करिष्ये' ऐसा पूछे और (उन ब्राह्मणोंद्वारा) ' कुरुष्व करो ' ऐसी आज्ञा प्राप्त होनेपर उपवीती (सव्य होकर) हवन (अग्नौकरण) करे! हाथमें कुश लेकर और यज्ञोपवीती (सव्य) होकर होम करना चाहिए। पितृसम्बन्धी कार्य प्राचीनावीती (अपसव्य) होकर करे और वैशवदेवसम्बन्धी कार्य होमके समान अर्थात् सव्य
verses.wordMeaning: Daily study of the Vedas, the performance of Maha- Yajnas (the above-mentioned five great sacrifices)—an imperi¬ shable act—and the worship of gods quickly dispel all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Daily study of the Vedas, the performance of Maha- Yajnas (the above-mentioned five great sacrifices)—an imperi¬ shable act—and the worship of gods quickly dispel all sins.

verses.sanskrit: अभिमन्त्र्य जलं मन्त्रैस्तल्लिङ्गैर्वारुणैः शुभैः । भावपूतस्तदव्यक्तं ध्यायन् वै विष्णुमव्ययम्
verses.transliteration: abhimantrya jalaṃ mantraistalliṅgairvāruṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ / bhāvapūtastadavyaktaṃ dhyāyan vai viṣṇumavyayam
verses.translation: There is no doubt in this that a person who, out of delusion or ignorance takes food without performing the wor¬ ship of the deities, attains the hell called Sukara (Boar).
verses.wordMeaning: There is no doubt in this that a person who, out of delusion or ignorance takes food without performing the wor¬ ship of the deities, attains the hell called Sukara (Boar).
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no doubt in this that a person who, out of delusion or ignorance takes food without performing the wor¬ ship of the deities, attains the hell called Sukara (Boar).

verses.sanskrit: आपो नारायणोद्भूतास्ता एवास्यायनं पुनः । तस्मान्नारायणं देवं स्नानकाले स्मरेद् बुधः
verses.transliteration: āpo nārāyaṇodbhūtāstā evāsyāyanaṃ punaḥ / tasmānnārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ snānakāle smared budhaḥ
verses.translation: Hence, O Brahmana, one should assiduously per¬ form all rites and take food along with his own kinsmen and he attains the greatest goal.
verses.hindi: पुरुषको दाहिना जानु जमीनपर रखकर देवोंकी परिचर्या करनी चाहिए और पितरोंकी परिचर्यामें बायाँ जानु जमीनपर रखना चाहिए महादेवान्तिके वाथ गोष्ठे वा सुसमाहितः
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, O Brahmana, one should assiduously per¬ form all rites and take food along with his own kinsmen and he attains the greatest goal.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, O Brahmana, one should assiduously per¬ form all rites and take food along with his own kinsmen and he attains the greatest goal.

verses.sanskrit: प्रोच्य स्ॐकारमादित्यं त्रिर्निमज्जेज्जलाशये । आचान्तः पुनराचामेन्मन्त्रेणानेन मन्त्रवित्
verses.transliteration: procya soṃkāramādityaṃ trirnimajjejjalāśaye / ācāntaḥ punarācāmenmantreṇānena mantravit
verses.translation: As KP. (infra II. 22. 17) states, holy places are no one's private property. Hence, vv. 28-36 recommend a list of holy places (rivers, forests, mountains, etc) where performance of sraddha is more efficacious. Vide aXso Visnu Dh. S. ch. 85, Sahkha Smr. 14. 27-29, Vayu P. Ch. 77 and Ma. P. ch. 22 for the lists of such holy places for §raddha.
verses.hindi: त्रिरुल्लिखेत् तस्य मध्यं दर्भणैकेन चैव हि
verses.wordMeaning: As KP. (infra II. 22. 17) states, holy places are no one's private property. Hence, vv. 28-36 recommend a list of holy places (rivers, forests, mountains, etc) where performance of sraddha is more efficacious. Vide aXso Visnu Dh. S. ch. 85, Sahkha Smr. 14. 27-29, Vayu P. Ch.…
verses.commentary: Sense: As KP. (infra II. 22. 17) states, holy places are no one's private property. Hence, vv. 28-36 recommend a list of holy places (rivers, forests, mountains, etc) where performance of sraddha is more efficacious. Vide aXso Visnu Dh. S. ch. 85, Sahkha Smr. 14. 27-29, Vayu P. Ch.…

verses.sanskrit: अन्तश्चरसि भूतेषु गुहायां विश्वतो मुखः । त्वं यज्ञस्त्वं वषट्कार आपो ज्योती रसो ऽमृतम्
verses.transliteration: antaścarasi bhūteṣu guhāyāṃ viśvato mukhaḥ / tvaṃ yajñastvaṃ vaṣaṭkāra āpo jyotī raso 'mṛtam
verses.translation: VV. 18-21 state the fruit of performing Sraddha on each day from the 1st to the 15th day of the dark half. Apastamba Dh. S. II. 7. 16. 8-22. Mbh. Anusasana 87, Vayu 10-19, Bd. P. Ill, 17. 10-22, Bm. 15-21 deal with same topic, though with some difference about the rewards.
verses.hindi: तत: संस्तीर्य तत्स्थाने दर्भान् वै दक्षिणाग्रकान्। उदकं निनयेच्छेषं शनैः पिण्डान्तिके पुनः। अवजिघ्रेच्च तान् पिण्डान् यथान्युप्तान् समाहितः
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 18-21 state the fruit of performing Sraddha on each day from the 1st to the 15th day of the dark half. Apastamba Dh. S. II. 7. 16. 8-22. Mbh. Anusasana 87, Vayu 10-19, Bd. P. Ill, 17. 10-22, Bm. 15-21 deal with same topic, though with some difference about the rewards.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 18-21 state the fruit of performing Sraddha on each day from the 1st to the 15th day of the dark half. Apastamba Dh. S. II. 7. 16. 8-22. Mbh. Anusasana 87, Vayu 10-19, Bd. P. Ill, 17. 10-22, Bm. 15-21 deal with same topic, though with some difference about the rewards.

verses.sanskrit: द्रुपदां वा त्रिरभ्यस्येद् व्याहृतिप्रणवान्विताम् । सावित्रीं वा जपेद् विद्वान् तथा चैवाघमर्षणम्
verses.transliteration: drupadāṃ vā trirabhyasyed vyāhṛtipraṇavānvitām / sāvitrīṃ vā japed vidvān tathā caivāghamarṣaṇam
verses.translation: All other tithis in the dark half of the month beginn¬ ing from the first, except the fourteenth day, are excellent but the later Tithi is more commendable than the former.
verses.hindi: अनं चैव यथाकामं विविधं भक्ष्यपेयकम्
verses.wordMeaning: All other tithis in the dark half of the month beginn¬ ing from the first, except the fourteenth day, are excellent but the later Tithi is more commendable than the former.
verses.commentary: Sense: All other tithis in the dark half of the month beginn¬ ing from the first, except the fourteenth day, are excellent but the later Tithi is more commendable than the former.

verses.sanskrit: ततः संमार्जनं कुर्यादापो हि ष्ठा मयोभुवः । इदमापः प्रवहत व्याहृतिभिस्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: tataḥ saṃmārjanaṃ kuryādāpo hi ṣṭhā mayobhuvaḥ / idamāpaḥ pravahata vyāhṛtibhistathaiva ca
verses.translation: The three new-moon days and the eighth day in the dark half of the three months beginning with Pausa are good days. The three Astakas are holy as well as the fifteenth day (the new moon day) in the month of Magha.
verses.hindi: धान्यांस्तिलांश्च विविधान् शर्करा विविधास्तथा तब "सोमाय वै पितृमते स्वधा नमः' इस मन्त्रका उच्चारणकर ' अग्नये कव्यवाहनाय स्वधा' ऐसा कहकर हवन करे
verses.wordMeaning: The three new-moon days and the eighth day in the dark half of the three months beginning with Pausa are good days. The three Astakas are holy as well as the fifteenth day (the new moon day) in the month of Magha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The three new-moon days and the eighth day in the dark half of the three months beginning with Pausa are good days. The three Astakas are holy as well as the fifteenth day (the new moon day) in the month of Magha.

verses.sanskrit: ततो ऽभिमन्त्र्य तत् तीर्थमापो हिष्ठादिमन्त्रकैः । अन्तर्जलगतो मग्नो जपेत् त्रिरघमर्षणम्
verses.transliteration: tato 'bhimantrya tat tīrthamāpo hiṣṭhādimantrakaiḥ / antarjalagato magno japet triraghamarṣaṇam
verses.translation: Particularly in the rainy season, the TrayodasI (thir¬ teenth day) united with the Magha constellation is good when the corn is ripe. These are prescribed as suitable for obligatory {Nitya) Sraddha.
verses.hindi: अग्निके अभाव होनेपर सावधानचित्त होकर ब्राह्मणके हाथपर, महादेवके समीप अथवा गोशालामें हवनीय द्र्य रखना चाहिए। तदनन्तर उनकी आज्ञा प्राप्तकर दक्षिण दिशामें जाकर भूमिको गोमय (गोबर) -से लीपकर
verses.wordMeaning: Particularly in the rainy season, the TrayodasI (thir¬ teenth day) united with the Magha constellation is good when the corn is ripe. These are prescribed as suitable for obligatory {Nitya) Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Particularly in the rainy season, the TrayodasI (thir¬ teenth day) united with the Magha constellation is good when the corn is ripe. These are prescribed as suitable for obligatory {Nitya) Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिपदां वाथ सावित्रीं तद्विष्णोः परमं पदम् । आवर्तयेद् वा प्रणवं देवं वा संस्मरेद्धरिम्
verses.transliteration: tripadāṃ vātha sāvitrīṃ tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam / āvartayed vā praṇavaṃ devaṃ vā saṃsmareddharim
verses.translation: During the eclipse of the moon and the sun, the Naimiitika (occasional) raddha must be performed extensively among relatives. Otherwise, one is likely to be consigned to hell.
verses.hindi: उस स्थानमें बालू बिछाये । तदनन्तर उस स्थानपर दक्षिणको ओर झुकी हुई गोल अथवा चौकोर शुभ (बालुकामय) बेदी बनाये, उस बेदीके बीचमें एक कुशसे तीन रेखा खींचे और उस स्थान (बेदी)-पर दक्षिणाग्र कुशोंको बिछाकर हविके बचे हुए अंशसे निर्मित तीन पिण्ड उस (बेदी )-पर प्रदान करे॥ ४८--५१॥
verses.wordMeaning: During the eclipse of the moon and the sun, the Naimiitika (occasional) raddha must be performed extensively among relatives. Otherwise, one is likely to be consigned to hell.
verses.commentary: Sense: During the eclipse of the moon and the sun, the Naimiitika (occasional) raddha must be performed extensively among relatives. Otherwise, one is likely to be consigned to hell.

verses.sanskrit: द्रुपदादिव यो मन्त्रो यजुर्वेदे प्रतिष्ठितः । अन्तर्जले त्रिरावर्त्य सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: drupadādiva yo mantro yajurvede pratiṣṭhitaḥ / antarjale trirāvartya sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
verses.translation: The Kdmya (urged by a desire for benefit) Sraddhas are recommended during eclipse etc. and during the Vernal and equinotical transit of the sun and during Vyatipata the last giving infinite merit.
verses.hindi: पिण्ड-प्रदानके अनन्तर लेपभागके अधिकारी  पितरोंके लिये पिण्डाधार-कुशोंके मूलमें उस (पिण्ड- शेषसे संसृष्ट) हाथका प्रोक्षण करे । तदनन्तर मन्त्रवेत्ताको चाहिए कि आचमन करे और धीरे-धीरे श्वास खींचकर
verses.wordMeaning: The Kdmya (urged by a desire for benefit) Sraddhas are recommended during eclipse etc. and during the Vernal and equinotical transit of the sun and during Vyatipata the last giving infinite merit.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Kdmya (urged by a desire for benefit) Sraddhas are recommended during eclipse etc. and during the Vernal and equinotical transit of the sun and during Vyatipata the last giving infinite merit.

verses.sanskrit: अपः पाणौ समादाय जप्त्वा वै मार्जने कृते । विन्यस्य मूर्ध्नि तत् तोयं मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः
verses.transliteration: apaḥ pāṇau samādāya japtvā vai mārjane kṛte / vinyasya mūrdhni tat toyaṃ mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ
verses.translation: The Sraddha at the time of Sariikranti (tropical transit of the sun) as well as on birthdays is of everlasting benefit. It is so particularly in all the Naksatras (constella¬ tions) and must be performed at the proper time.
verses.hindi: अपने बायेंसे पीछे मुख करके धीरे-धीरे श्वास छोड़ते हुए पिण्डोंके सामने अपना मुख कर पूरा श्वास छोड़े तथा उस अन्न एवं पितरोंको नमस्कार करे। पुनः पिण्डके समीप (ऊपर) धीरे-धीरे (अर्घपात्रका) शेष जल छोड़े (इसे अवनेजन कहते हैं) । तदनन्तर सावधानीके साथ रखे हुए उन पिण्डोंको झुककर क्रमानुसार सूँघे (और पाकपात्रमें रख दे।)
verses.wordMeaning: The Sraddha at the time of Sariikranti (tropical transit of the sun) as well as on birthdays is of everlasting benefit. It is so particularly in all the Naksatras (constella¬ tions) and must be performed at the proper time.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Sraddha at the time of Sariikranti (tropical transit of the sun) as well as on birthdays is of everlasting benefit. It is so particularly in all the Naksatras (constella¬ tions) and must be performed at the proper time.

verses.sanskrit: यथाश्वमेधः क्रतुराट् सर्वपापापनोदनः । तथाघमर्षणं सूक्तं सर्वपापापनोदनम्
verses.transliteration: yathāśvamedhaḥ kraturāṭ sarvapāpāpanodanaḥ / tathāghamarṣaṇaṃ sūktaṃ sarvapāpāpanodanam
verses.translation: By performing the Sraddha in the constellation Krttika the excellent Brahmana attains heaven; by performing it in RohinI, he obtains progeny; by performing it in Mrgasiras constellation, he obtains Brahminical splendour.
verses.hindi: पिण्डदानसे बचा हुआ अन्न ब्राह्मणोंको विधिपूर्वक खिलाना चाहिए। पूआ, कृसर, पायस (तिलके साथ पकाये चावलकी खीर), सूप, शाक, फल, ईख, दूध, दही, घृत, मधु, अन्न तथा अनेक प्रकारके खाने और
verses.wordMeaning: By performing the Sraddha in the constellation Krttika the excellent Brahmana attains heaven; by performing it in RohinI, he obtains progeny; by performing it in Mrgasiras constellation, he obtains Brahminical splendour.
verses.commentary: Sense: By performing the Sraddha in the constellation Krttika the excellent Brahmana attains heaven; by performing it in RohinI, he obtains progeny; by performing it in Mrgasiras constellation, he obtains Brahminical splendour.

verses.sanskrit: अथोपतिष्ठेदादित्यं मूर्ध्नि पुष्पान्विताञ्जलिम् । प्रक्षिप्यालोकयेद् देवमुद्वयं तमसस्परि
verses.transliteration: athopatiṣṭhedādityaṃ mūrdhni puṣpānvitāñjalim / prakṣipyālokayed devamudvayaṃ tamasaspari
verses.translation: By performing the Sraddha in the Ardra constel¬ lation, one attains the benefits of the holy rites pertaining to Rudra as well as heroism; by performing it in the Punarvasu star, he attains lands, and by performing it in Pusya he obtains glory and prosperity.
verses.hindi: पीने योग्य पदार्थ उनकी (ब्राह्मणोंकी) रुचिके अनुसार खिलाने चाहिए श्रेष्ठ ब्राह्मणोंको जो-जो रुचिकर हो (और श्राद्धमे विहित हो) वह सब देना चाहिए। साथ ही अनेक प्रकारके धान्य, तिल तथा शर्कराका दान करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: By performing the Sraddha in the Ardra constel¬ lation, one attains the benefits of the holy rites pertaining to Rudra as well as heroism; by performing it in the Punarvasu star, he attains lands, and by performing it in Pusya he obtains glory and prosperity.
verses.commentary: Sense: By performing the Sraddha in the Ardra constel¬ lation, one attains the benefits of the holy rites pertaining to Rudra as well as heroism; by performing it in the Punarvasu star, he attains lands, and by performing it in Pusya he obtains glory and prosperity.

verses.sanskrit: उदुत्यं चित्रमित्येते तच्चक्षुरिति मन्त्रतः । हंसः शुचिषदेतेन सावित्र्या च विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: udutyaṃ citramityete taccakṣuriti mantrataḥ / haṃsaḥ śuciṣadetena sāvitryā ca viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: By performing Sraddha in the constellation Anuradha, one attains many friends; in the constellation Jyestha, one attains kingdom; by performing Sraddha in Mula, one attains (flourishing) cultivation; by performing Sraddha inPurvasadha, one attains perfect knowledge and achievement.
verses.hindi: पितामहके ऊपरके प्रपितामह आदि तीसरी परम्परासे आगेके सभी पितर पिण्डके अधिकारी नहीं होते हैं, अपितु पिण्ड बनाते
verses.wordMeaning: By performing Sraddha in the constellation Anuradha, one attains many friends; in the constellation Jyestha, one attains kingdom; by performing Sraddha in Mula, one attains (flourishing) cultivation; by performing Sraddha inPurvasadha,…
verses.commentary: Sense: By performing Sraddha in the constellation Anuradha, one attains many friends; in the constellation Jyestha, one attains kingdom; by performing Sraddha in Mula, one attains (flourishing) cultivation; by performing Sraddha inPurvasadha,…

verses.sanskrit: अन्यैश्च वैदिकैर्मन्त्रैः सौरैः पापप्रणाशनैः । सावित्रीं वै जपेत् पश्चाज्जपयज्ञः स वै स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: anyaiśca vaidikairmantraiḥ sauraiḥ pāpapraṇāśanaiḥ / sāvitrīṃ vai japet paścājjapayajñaḥ sa vai smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: By performing Sraddha, in Vaisvadeva (Uttarasadha) constellation one attains all desires; in the Sravana constellation, one attains excellence; by performing Sraddha in Dhanistha one attains all desires; and in Satabhisak star, one attains the greatest strength.
verses.hindi: समय हाथमें जो पिण्डका शेष अन्न संसृष्ट (लगा) रहता है, उसीको ग्रहण करनेके अधिकारी होते हैं, अतः प्रपितामहके आगेकी पीढ़ीवाले पितरोंको 'लेपभागभुक्' कहा जाता है। इनकी तृप्ति तभी होती है, जब प्रपितामहतक तीन परम्पराको पिण्ड प्रदान कर लेनेके अनन्तर पिण्डोंके आधारकुशोंके मूलमें उन दोनों हाथोंका प्रोक्षण किया जाय, जिनसे पिण्डोंको बनाया गया है। अन्यत्र फलमूलेभ्यः पानकेभ्यस्तथैव च
verses.wordMeaning: By performing Sraddha, in Vaisvadeva (Uttarasadha) constellation one attains all desires; in the Sravana constellation, one attains excellence; by performing Sraddha in Dhanistha one attains all desires; and in Satabhisak star, one attains the greatest strength.
verses.commentary: Sense: By performing Sraddha, in Vaisvadeva (Uttarasadha) constellation one attains all desires; in the Sravana constellation, one attains excellence; by performing Sraddha in Dhanistha one attains all desires; and in Satabhisak star, one attains the greatest strength.

verses.sanskrit: विविधानि पवित्राणि गुह्यविद्यास्तथैव च । शतरुद्रीयमथर्वशिरः सौरांश्च शक्तितः
verses.transliteration: vividhāni pavitrāṇi guhyavidyāstathaiva ca / śatarudrīyamatharvaśiraḥ saurāṃśca śaktitaḥ
verses.translation: By performing Sraddha in the Purvabhadrapada constellation, one shall obtain the base metals; in the conste¬ llation of Uttara Bhadrapada, one attains excellent house; by performing Sraddha in the Revatl constellation, one attains many cows; and in the constellation Asvini one attains horses. If one offers Sraddha in the Bharanl constellation, one's life becomes perfect.
verses.hindi: न चात्र श्येनकाकादीन् पक्षिणः प्रतिषेधयेत्। तद्रूपाः पितरस्तत्र समायान्ति बुभुक्षवः
verses.wordMeaning: By performing Sraddha in the Purvabhadrapada constellation, one shall obtain the base metals; in the conste¬ llation of Uttara Bhadrapada, one attains excellent house; by performing Sraddha in the Revatl constellation, one attains many cows;…
verses.commentary: Sense: By performing Sraddha in the Purvabhadrapada constellation, one shall obtain the base metals; in the conste¬ llation of Uttara Bhadrapada, one attains excellent house; by performing Sraddha in the Revatl constellation, one attains many cows;…

verses.sanskrit: प्राक्कूलेषु समासीनः कुशेषु प्राङ्मुखः शुचिः । तिष्ठंश्चेदीक्षमाणोर्ऽकं जप्यं कुर्यात् समाहितः
verses.transliteration: prākkūleṣu samāsīnaḥ kuśeṣu prāṅmukhaḥ śuciḥ / tiṣṭhaṃścedīkṣamāṇor'kaṃ japyaṃ kuryāt samāhitaḥ
verses.translation: A person performing Sraddha on the sixth day, attains lustre as well as good cultivation; the man who gives Sraddha on the seventh day, attains wealth; \\fwh.o oilers Sraddha on the eighth day, obtains good trading transactions.
verses.hindi: न चायसेन पात्रेण न चैवाश्रद्धया पुनः काञ्चनेन तु पात्रेण राजतौदुम्बरेण वा। दत्तमक्षयतां याति खङ्गेन च विशेषतः
verses.wordMeaning: A person performing Sraddha on the sixth day, attains lustre as well as good cultivation; the man who gives Sraddha on the seventh day, attains wealth; \\fwh.o oilers Sraddha on the eighth day, obtains good trading transactions.
verses.commentary: Sense: A person performing Sraddha on the sixth day, attains lustre as well as good cultivation; the man who gives Sraddha on the seventh day, attains wealth; \\fwh.o oilers Sraddha on the eighth day, obtains good trading transactions.

verses.sanskrit: स्फाटिकेन्द्राक्षरुद्राक्षैः पुत्रजीवसमुद्भवः । कर्तव्या त्वक्षमाला स्यादुत्तरादुत्तमा स्मृता
verses.transliteration: sphāṭikendrākṣarudrākṣaiḥ putrajīvasamudbhavaḥ / kartavyā tvakṣamālā syāduttarāduttamā smṛtā
verses.translation: He who performs Sraddha on the ninth day, obtains single-hoofed animals; he who performs Sraddha on the tenth day, obtains double-hoofed animals in plenty. One who per¬ forms Sraddha on the eleventh day, obtains silver and sons of Brahmanical splendour.
verses.hindi: याचिता दापिता दाता नरकान् यान्ति दारुणान्
verses.wordMeaning: He who performs Sraddha on the ninth day, obtains single-hoofed animals; he who performs Sraddha on the tenth day, obtains double-hoofed animals in plenty. One who per¬ forms Sraddha on the eleventh day, obtains silver and sons of Brahmanical splendour.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who performs Sraddha on the ninth day, obtains single-hoofed animals; he who performs Sraddha on the tenth day, obtains double-hoofed animals in plenty. One who per¬ forms Sraddha on the eleventh day, obtains silver and sons of Brahmanical splendour.

verses.sanskrit: जपकाले न भाषेत नान्यानि प्रेक्षयेद् बुधः । न कम्पयेच्छिरोग्रीवां दन्तान्नैव प्रकाशयेत्
verses.transliteration: japakāle na bhāṣeta nānyāni prekṣayed budhaḥ / na kampayecchirogrīvāṃ dantānnaiva prakāśayet
verses.translation: One who performs Sraddha on the twelfth day, obtains gold, silver and base metals. One who performs Sraddha on the thirteenth day, obtains excellent kinsmen and one who performs Sraddha on the fourteenth day, obtains ignoble progeny. One who performs Sraddha on the fifteenth day (i.e. on the new moon day), always obtains all desires.
verses.hindi: कल्याण प्राप्त करनेकी इच्छावाले (श्राद्धकर्ताको चाहिए कि) ब्राह्मणोंको फल, मूल और पानक (विविध स्वादयुक्त पेय पदार्थविशेष)-को छोड़कर अन्य सभी अन्न उष्ण-अवस्थामें (गरम-गरम) प्रदान करे (श्राद्धकर्ता) कभी भी अश्रुपात न करे, न कोप करे, न झूठ बोले, पाँवसे अन्नको स्पर्श न को और न अन्नका (पैरोंसे) अवधूनन (मर्दन) करे। क्रोध करके जो दिया जाता है, जल्दी-जल्दी जो
verses.wordMeaning: One who performs Sraddha on the twelfth day, obtains gold, silver and base metals. One who performs Sraddha on the thirteenth day, obtains excellent kinsmen and one who performs Sraddha on the fourteenth day, obtains ignoble progeny.…
verses.commentary: Sense: One who performs Sraddha on the twelfth day, obtains gold, silver and base metals. One who performs Sraddha on the thirteenth day, obtains excellent kinsmen and one who performs Sraddha on the fourteenth day, obtains ignoble progeny.…

verses.sanskrit: गुह्यका राक्षसा सिद्धा हरन्ति प्रसभं यतः । एकान्ते सुशुभे देशे तस्माज्जप्यं समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: guhyakā rākṣasā siddhā haranti prasabhaṃ yataḥ / ekānte suśubhe deśe tasmājjapyaṃ samācaret
verses.translation: Hence Sraddha should not be performed by the twice- borns on the fourteenth day. The Sraddha pertaining to those killed by means of weapons should be assigned to that day.
verses.hindi: भोजन किया जाता है और बोलते हुए जो खाया जाता है, उस पदार्थको राक्षस हर लेते हैं। ब्राह्मणोंके समीप स्वेदयुक्त शरीरसे न रहे। श्राद्धस्थलसे श्येन, कौआ आदि पक्षियोंको हटाना नहीं चाहिए, क्योंकि
verses.wordMeaning: Hence Sraddha should not be performed by the twice- borns on the fourteenth day. The Sraddha pertaining to those killed by means of weapons should be assigned to that day.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence Sraddha should not be performed by the twice- borns on the fourteenth day. The Sraddha pertaining to those killed by means of weapons should be assigned to that day.

verses.sanskrit: चण्डालाशौचपतितान् दृष्ट्वाचम्य पुनर्जपेत् । तैरेव भाषणं कृत्वा स्नात्वा चैव जपेत् पुनः
verses.transliteration: caṇḍālāśaucapatitān dṛṣṭvācamya punarjapet / taireva bhāṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā snātvā caiva japet punaḥ
verses.translation: There is no restriction as to the time, if Brahmanas and the materials are available. Hence, the twice-borns should perform Sraddha for the purpose of worldly enjoyment as well as salvation.
verses.hindi: (सम्भव है) इनके ही रूपमें पितृगण वहाँ खानेको इच्छासे आये हों वहाँ (श्राद्धमे) हाथसे प्रत्यक्ष लवण नहीं देना चाहिए। लोहेके पात्रद्वारा और अश्रद्धासे कोई वस्तु नहीं देनी चाहिए। स्वर्ण, रजत या औदुम्बरके पात्रसे तथा विशेष रूपसे खड्ग नामके पात्रविशेषसे दिया
verses.wordMeaning: There is no restriction as to the time, if Brahmanas and the materials are available. Hence, the twice-borns should perform Sraddha for the purpose of worldly enjoyment as well as salvation.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no restriction as to the time, if Brahmanas and the materials are available. Hence, the twice-borns should perform Sraddha for the purpose of worldly enjoyment as well as salvation.

verses.sanskrit: आचम्य प्रयतो नित्यं जपेदशुचिदर्शने । सौरान् मन्त्रान् शक्तितो वै पावमानीस्तु कामतः
verses.transliteration: ācamya prayato nityaṃ japedaśucidarśane / saurān mantrān śaktito vai pāvamānīstu kāmataḥ
verses.translation: The Sraddha should be performed at the beginning of all noble enterprises. It should again be performed on the achievement of prosperity, or when a son is born and in similar instances. The Pdrvana Sraddha is to be performed in Parvans (particular holy days).
verses.hindi: हुआ पदार्थ अक्षय होता है। जो व्यक्ति श्राद्धमे मिट्टीके बर्तनोंमें पितरोंको भोजन कराता है, वह घोर नरकमें जाता है, ऐसे ही भोजन करनेवाले ब्राह्मण तथा (श्राद्ध करानेवाले) पुरोहित भी नरकमें
verses.wordMeaning: The Sraddha should be performed at the beginning of all noble enterprises. It should again be performed on the achievement of prosperity, or when a son is born and in similar instances. The Pdrvana Sraddha is to be performed in Parvans (particular holy days).
verses.commentary: Sense: The Sraddha should be performed at the beginning of all noble enterprises. It should again be performed on the achievement of prosperity, or when a son is born and in similar instances. The Pdrvana Sraddha is to be performed in Parvans (particular holy days).

verses.sanskrit: यदि स्यात् क्लिन्नवासा वै वारिमध्यगतो जपेत् । अन्यथा तु शुचौ भूम्यां दर्भेषु सुसमाहितः
verses.transliteration: yadi syāt klinnavāsā vai vārimadhyagato japet / anyathā tu śucau bhūmyāṃ darbheṣu susamāhitaḥ
verses.translation: A seventh Srdddha has been enunciated by Brahma for the achievement of purity. The eighth Srdddha is Daivika (divine) by the performance of which, one is liberated from fear.
verses.hindi: एक पंक्तिमें (भोजन करनेवालोंके साथ परोसनेमें) विषम व्यवहार नहीं करना चाहिए। सबको समान रूपसे देना चाहिए। (भोजन करनेवालोंको भी विषम दृष्टिसे) न तो माँगना चाहिए न किसी दूसरेको दिलाना चाहिए, क्योंकि ऐसा (करनेपर) माँगनेवाला, दिलानेवाला और देनेवाला--ये तीनों भीषण नरकोंमें जाते हैं। शिष्ट लोगोंको मौन होकर भोजन करना चाहिए। (अन्नके) प्राकृत गुणोंका वर्णन नहीं करना चाहिए।
verses.wordMeaning: A seventh Srdddha has been enunciated by Brahma for the achievement of purity. The eighth Srdddha is Daivika (divine) by the performance of which, one is liberated from fear.
verses.commentary: Sense: A seventh Srdddha has been enunciated by Brahma for the achievement of purity. The eighth Srdddha is Daivika (divine) by the performance of which, one is liberated from fear.

verses.sanskrit: प्रदक्षिणं समावृत्य नमस्कृत्वा ततः क्षितौ । आचम्य च यथाशास्त्रं शक्त्या स्वाध्यायमाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: pradakṣiṇaṃ samāvṛtya namaskṛtvā tataḥ kṣitau / ācamya ca yathāśāstraṃ śaktyā svādhyāyamācaret
verses.translation: A Srdddha is not to be performed either in the evening or at night except at the time of eclipse.
verses.hindi: पितर तभीतक भोजन करते हैं, जबतक भोज्य पदार्थके गुणोंका वर्णन नहीं होता
verses.wordMeaning: A Srdddha is not to be performed either in the evening or at night except at the time of eclipse.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Srdddha is not to be performed either in the evening or at night except at the time of eclipse.

verses.sanskrit: ततः संतर्पयेद् देवानृषीन् पितृगणांस्तथा । अदावोङ्कारमुच्चार्य नमो ऽन्ते तर्पयामि वः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ saṃtarpayed devānṛṣīn pitṛgaṇāṃstathā / adāvoṅkāramuccārya namo 'nte tarpayāmi vaḥ
verses.translation: The Srdddha on the Ganga, at Prayaga and at Amarakantaka is of everlasting benefit. The Pitrs sing the religious verse and the learned men dance.
verses.hindi: यो नाश्नाति द्विजो मांसं नियुक्त: पितृकर्मणि । स प्रेत्य पशुतां याति सम्भवानेकविंशतिम् स्वाध्यायं श्रावयेदेषां धर्मशास्त्राणि चैव हि। इतिहासपुराणानि श्राद्धकल्पांश्च शोभनान्
verses.wordMeaning: The Srdddha on the Ganga, at Prayaga and at Amarakantaka is of everlasting benefit. The Pitrs sing the religious verse and the learned men dance.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Srdddha on the Ganga, at Prayaga and at Amarakantaka is of everlasting benefit. The Pitrs sing the religious verse and the learned men dance.

verses.sanskrit: देवान् ब्रह्मःऋषींश्चैव तर्पयेदक्षतोदकैः । तिलोदकैः पितॄन् भक्त्या स्वसूत्रोक्तविधानतः
verses.transliteration: devān brahmaḥṛṣīṃścaiva tarpayedakṣatodakaiḥ / tilodakaiḥ pitṝn bhaktyā svasūtroktavidhānataḥ
verses.translation: "Many sons of good conduct endowed with attributes should be sought by one. Perhaps (at least) one among all those may go to Gaya.
verses.hindi: सम्पन्नमित्यभ्युदये हैवे रोचत इत्यपि
verses.wordMeaning: "Many sons of good conduct endowed with attributes should be sought by one. Perhaps (at least) one among all those may go to Gaya.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Many sons of good conduct endowed with attributes should be sought by one. Perhaps (at least) one among all those may go to Gaya.

verses.sanskrit: अन्वारब्धेन सव्येन पाणिना दक्षिणेन तु । देवर्षोस्तर्पयेद् धीमानुदकाञ्जलिभिः पितन्
verses.transliteration: anvārabdhena savyena pāṇinā dakṣiṇena tu / devarṣostarpayed dhīmānudakāñjalibhiḥ pitan
verses.translation: After reaching Gaya if one performs Srdddha incidentally, the Pitps are redeemed by him. He attains the greatest goal".
verses.hindi: विसृज्य ब्राह्मणांस्तान् वै हैवपूर्व तु वाग्यतः। दक्षिणां दिशमाकाङ्क्षन् याचेतेमान् वरान् पितृन् अग्रासनपर (प्रथम पंक्तिमें) बैठे हुए किसी एक द्विको उस पंक्ति या अन्य पंक्तिमे बैठे द्विजों (ब्राह्मणों )-के देखते-देखते (उनके द्वारा भोजन प्रारम्भ करनेके पूर्व) पहले अकेले भोजन आरम्भ नहीं करना
verses.wordMeaning: After reaching Gaya if one performs Srdddha incidentally, the Pitps are redeemed by him. He attains the greatest goal".
verses.commentary: Sense: After reaching Gaya if one performs Srdddha incidentally, the Pitps are redeemed by him. He attains the greatest goal".

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञोपवीती देवानां निवीती ऋषीतर्पणे । प्राचीनावीती पित्र्ये तु स्वेन तीर्थेन भावतः
verses.transliteration: yajñopavītī devānāṃ nivītī ṛṣītarpaṇe / prācīnāvītī pitrye tu svena tīrthena bhāvataḥ
verses.translation: One propitiates the Pitrs for a month, if the Sraddha is offered with grains, barleys, pulses, water, fruits and roots, Syamaka grains, Kasas, Nivaras, Priyahgus, wheat, gingelly seeds and green gram.i
verses.hindi: चाहिए (अर्थात् अपनी तथा अन्य पंक्तियोंमें बैठे हुए सभी ब्राह्मणोंके साथ ही भोजन आरम्भ करना चाहिए) । क्योंकि ऐसा करनेपर वह अज्ञ (द्विज) पंक्तिमें बैठे हुए देखनेवालोंके पापका भागी होता है। श्राद्धमें नियुक्त
verses.wordMeaning: One propitiates the Pitrs for a month, if the Sraddha is offered with grains, barleys, pulses, water, fruits and roots, Syamaka grains, Kasas, Nivaras, Priyahgus, wheat, gingelly seeds and green gram.i
verses.commentary: Sense: One propitiates the Pitrs for a month, if the Sraddha is offered with grains, barleys, pulses, water, fruits and roots, Syamaka grains, Kasas, Nivaras, Priyahgus, wheat, gingelly seeds and green gram.i

verses.sanskrit: निष्पीड्य स्नानवस्त्रं तु समाचम्य च वाग्यतः । स्वैर्मन्त्रैरर्चयेद् देवान् पुष्पैः पत्रैरथाम्बुभिः
verses.transliteration: niṣpīḍya snānavastraṃ tu samācamya ca vāgyataḥ / svairmantrairarcayed devān puṣpaiḥ patrairathāmbubhiḥ
verses.translation: At the time of the Sraddha, one should offer the juice of mango, sugarcane, bunches of grapes and pomegranates. He shall also give Vidalvas and Kurandas* (different kinds of grass).
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ द्विजको किसी वस्तुका बहिष्कार नहीं करना चाहिए और दूसरेके अन्नकी ओर नहीं देखना चाहिए। श्राद्धमें भोजन करते हुए ब्राह्मणोंको वेद, धर्मशास्त्र, इतिहास-पुराण तथा शुभ श्राद्धकल्पों ( श्राद्धीय नियमों)- को सुनाना चाहिए  ब्राह्मणोंके भोजन कर लेनेपर उनसे “क्या आप लोग तृप्त हो गये ?' इस प्रकार पूछना चाहिए और उनके भोजनपात्रके सम्मुख परिवेषणसे अवशिष्ट अन्नका विकिरण करना चाहिए (साथ ही वृद्ध प्रपितामह
verses.wordMeaning: At the time of the Sraddha, one should offer the juice of mango, sugarcane, bunches of grapes and pomegranates. He shall also give Vidalvas and Kurandas* (different kinds of grass).
verses.commentary: Sense: At the time of the Sraddha, one should offer the juice of mango, sugarcane, bunches of grapes and pomegranates. He shall also give Vidalvas and Kurandas* (different kinds of grass).

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्माणं शङ्करं सूर्यं तथैव मधुसूदनम् । अन्यांश्चाभिमतान् देवान् भक्त्या चाक्रोधनो ऽत्वरः
verses.transliteration: brahmāṇaṃ śaṅkaraṃ sūryaṃ tathaiva madhusūdanam / anyāṃścābhimatān devān bhaktyā cākrodhano 'tvaraḥ
verses.translation: He should give fried grains with honey, powdered 2 )ed grains with sugar, assiduously at the time of the Sraddha.
verses.hindi: आदि लेपभागके अधिकारी पितरोंके लिये श्राद्धीय सिद्ध अन्नका उत्सर्ग करना चाहिए)। तदनन्तर तृप्त ब्राह्मणोंको आचमन कराना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: He should give fried grains with honey, powdered 2 )ed grains with sugar, assiduously at the time of the Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should give fried grains with honey, powdered 2 )ed grains with sugar, assiduously at the time of the Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: प्रदद्याद् वाथ पुष्पाणि सूक्तेन पौरुषेण तु । आपो वा देवताः सर्वास्तेन सम्यक् समर्चिताः
verses.transliteration: pradadyād vātha puṣpāṇi sūktena pauruṣeṇa tu / āpo vā devatāḥ sarvāstena samyak samarcitāḥ
verses.translation: He should give fried grains with honey, powdered 2 )ed grains with sugar, assiduously at the time of the Sraddha.
verses.hindi: आचमन कर लेनेपर उन्हें 'चतुर्दिक रमण करें' ऐसा कहना चाहिए। तब ब्राह्मण उसे 'स्वधाऽस्तु' कहकर आशीर्वाद दें। उनके (ब्राह्मणोंके) भोजन करनेसे शेष बचे अन्नको (उन ब्राह्मणोंको ही) निवेदित करे। अनन्तर वे ब्राह्मण जैसा कहें, वैसा ही उनकी आज्ञासे करे,
verses.wordMeaning: He should give fried grains with honey, powdered 2 )ed grains with sugar, assiduously at the time of the Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should give fried grains with honey, powdered 2 )ed grains with sugar, assiduously at the time of the Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: ध्यात्वा प्रणवपूर्वं वै दैवतानि समाहितः । नमस्कारेण पुष्पाणि विन्यसेद् वै पृथक् पृथक्
verses.transliteration: dhyātvā praṇavapūrvaṃ vai daivatāni samāhitaḥ / namaskāreṇa puṣpāṇi vinyased vai pṛthak pṛthak
verses.translation: He should give fried grains with honey, powdered 2 )ed grains with sugar, assiduously at the time of the Sraddha.
verses.hindi: पित्र्यकार्य (माता-पिताके एकोद्दिष्ट आद्ध)-में 'स्वदितम्”, गोष्टीश्राद्धमें ' सूनृतम्’, आभ्युदयिक श्राद्धमें "सम्पन्नम्? तथा हैव (देवश्राद्ध )-में 'रोचते' ऐसा कहना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: He should give fried grains with honey, powdered 2 )ed grains with sugar, assiduously at the time of the Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should give fried grains with honey, powdered 2 )ed grains with sugar, assiduously at the time of the Sraddha.

verses.transliteration: tadviṣṇoriti mantreṇa sūktena puruṣeṇa tu / naitābhyāṃ sadṛśo mantro sūktena puruṣeṇa tu / naitābhyāṃ sadṛśo mantro vedeṣūktaścaturṣvapi

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्रेण रुद्रागायत्र्या प्रणवेनाथ वा पुनः । ईशानेनाथ वा रुद्रैस्त्र्यम्बकेन समाहितः

verses.sanskrit: पुष्पैः पत्रैरथाद्भिर्वा चन्दनाद्यैर्महेश्वरम् । उक्त्वा नमः शिवायेति मन्त्रेणानेन योजयेत्

verses.hindi: तेनाग्नौकरणं कुर्यात् पिण्डांस्तेनैव निर्वपेत्

verses.sanskrit: नमस्कुर्यान्महादेवं ऋतं सत्यमितिश्वरम् । निवेदयीत स्वात्मानं यो ब्रह्माणमितीश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: namaskuryānmahādevaṃ ṛtaṃ satyamitiśvaram / nivedayīta svātmānaṃ yo brahmāṇamitīśvaram

verses.hindi: « यह ' अग्नौकरण' ब्राह्मणके हाथपर होता है। (मनु० ३। २१२) हमारे (कुलमें) दान देनेवालोंकी, वेद (ज्ञान)- की तथा संततिकी वृद्धि हो। (शास्त्रों, ब्राह्मणों, पितरों, देवों आदिमें) हमारी श्रद्धा हटे नहीं। मेरे पास दान देनेके लिये बहुतसे पदार्थ हों

verses.sanskrit: प्रदक्षिणं द्विजः कुर्यात् पञ्च ब्रह्माणि वै जपन् । ध्यायीत देवमीशानं व्योममध्यगतं शिवम्
verses.transliteration: pradakṣiṇaṃ dvijaḥ kuryāt pañca brahmāṇi vai japan / dhyāyīta devamīśānaṃ vyomamadhyagataṃ śivam

verses.hindi: (श्राद्धके) पिण्डोंको गाय, अज (बकरा) अथवा ब्राह्मणको दे, ऐसा सम्भव न होनेपर अग्नि अथवा जलमें विसर्जित करना चाहिए। पुत्रकी इच्छा करनेवाली (श्राद्धकर्ताकी) पत्नीको मध्यम पिण्डका भक्षण करना

verses.sanskrit: अथावलोकयेदर्कं हंसः सुचिषदित्यृचा । कुर्यात् पञ्च महायज्ञान् गृहं गत्वा समाहितः
verses.transliteration: athāvalokayedarkaṃ haṃsaḥ suciṣadityṛcā / kuryāt pañca mahāyajñān gṛhaṃ gatvā samāhitaḥ

verses.hindi: चाहिए। तदनन्तर हाथोंकों धोकर आचमन करके अवशिष्ट भोज्य पदार्थोसे अपनी जातीय बान्धवोंको तृप करे, उन जातीय बन्धुओंके तृप्त हो जानेपर अपने भृत्यजनोंको भोजन कराये। तत्पश्चात् पत्नियोंके साथ स्वयं भी शेष अन्नको ग्रहण करे

verses.sanskrit: देवयज्ञं पितृयज्ञं भूतयज्ञं तथैव च । मानुष्यं ब्रह्मयज्ञं च पञ्च यज्ञान् प्रचक्षते
verses.transliteration: devayajñaṃ pitṛyajñaṃ bhūtayajñaṃ tathaiva ca / mānuṣyaṃ brahmayajñaṃ ca pañca yajñān pracakṣate

verses.hindi: है, बह महारौरव नामक नरकमें जाता है, तदुपरान्त कीड़ेकी योनिमें जन्म लेता है। श्राद्धकर्ता तथा श्राद्धके भोजन करनेवालेको पवित्र, क्रोधरहित, शान्त, सत्यवादी तथा सावधान रहना चाहिए और स्वाध्याय तथा यात्राका त्याग करना चाहिए॥ ७८--८०॥

verses.sanskrit: अग्नेः पश्चिमतो देशे भूतयज्ञान्त एव वा । कुशपुञ्जे समासीनः कुशपाणिः समाहितः

verses.hindi: किया  उदासीन (अनासक्त) तत्त्ववेत्ताको नित्य अपक्व अन्नसे श्राद्ध करना चाहिए अग्निहोत्रसे रहित, यात्रा करनेवाले अथवा व्यसनसे युक्त (किसी प्रकारको आपत्ति या रोगसे ग्रस्त) श्रद्धालु और विधिको जाननेवाले द्विजको आमश्राद्ध (अपक्व अन्नसे किया जानेवाला श्राद्ध) करना चाहिए। वह उसी

verses.sanskrit: देवेभ्यस्तु हुतादन्नाच्छेषाद् भूतबलिं हरेत् । भूतयज्ञः स वै ज्ञेयो भूतिदः सर्वदेहिनाम्

verses.transliteration: sāyaṃ cānnasya siddhasya patnyamantraṃ baliṃ haret / bhūtayajñastvayaṃ nityaṃ sāyaṃ prātarvidhīyate

verses.transliteration: ekaṃ tu bhojayed vipraṃ pitṝnuddiśya sattamam / nityaśrāddhaṃ taduddiṣṭaṃ pitṛyajño gatipradaḥ
verses.translation: He should give fried grains with honey, powdered 2 )ed grains with sugar, assiduously at the time of the Sraddha.
verses.hindi: इसलिये द्विजोत्तमको सभी प्रयल्रोसे श्राद्ध करना चाहिए। इससे सनातन ईशकी सम्यकू रूपसे आराधना हो जाती है
verses.wordMeaning: He should give fried grains with honey, powdered 2 )ed grains with sugar, assiduously at the time of the Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should give fried grains with honey, powdered 2 )ed grains with sugar, assiduously at the time of the Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: उद्धृत्य वा यथाशक्ति किञ्चिदन्नं समाहितः । वेदतत्त्वार्थविदुषे द्विजायैवोपपादयेत्
verses.transliteration: uddhṛtya vā yathāśakti kiñcidannaṃ samāhitaḥ / vedatattvārthaviduṣe dvijāyaivopapādayet
verses.translation: He should give fried grains with honey, powdered 2 )ed grains with sugar, assiduously at the time of the Sraddha.
verses.hindi: सर्वथा निर्धन द्विजको मूल अथवा फलोंसे श्राद्ध करना चाहिए। अथवा स्रानकर समाहित होकर तिल और जलद्वारा पितरोंका तर्पण करना चाहिए। जिसके पिता जीवित हों उसे श्राद्ध नहीं करना चाहिए अथवा उसके लिये होमपर्यन्त श्राद्ध करनेका विधान है। कुछ लोगोंका कहना है कि पिता जिन्हें पिण्डदान करते हों उन्हें ही (वह) पिण्डदान करे। पिता, पितामह तथा प्रपितामहमेंसे जिसकी मृत्यु हुई हो उसीके निमित्त
verses.wordMeaning: He should give fried grains with honey, powdered 2 )ed grains with sugar, assiduously at the time of the Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should give fried grains with honey, powdered 2 )ed grains with sugar, assiduously at the time of the Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: पूजयेदतिथिं नित्यं नमस्येदर्चयेद् द्विजम् । मनोवाक्कर्मभिः शान्तमागतं स्वगृह ततः
verses.transliteration: pūjayedatithiṃ nityaṃ namasyedarcayed dvijam / manovākkarmabhiḥ śāntamāgataṃ svagṛha tataḥ
verses.translation: He should give fried grains with honey, powdered 2 )ed grains with sugar, assiduously at the time of the Sraddha.
verses.hindi: श्राद्धकर्ताको पिण्डदान करना चाहिए, न कि अन्य किसी (जीवित व्यक्ति)-के निमित्त । अथवा जीवित पुरुषको इसकी अभिरुचिके अनुसार भक्तिपूर्वक भोजन कराये। श्रुतिमें कहा गया है कि (पितादि) जीवित व्यक्तिका
verses.wordMeaning: He should give fried grains with honey, powdered 2 )ed grains with sugar, assiduously at the time of the Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should give fried grains with honey, powdered 2 )ed grains with sugar, assiduously at the time of the Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: हन्तकारमथाग्रं वा भिक्षां वा शक्तितो द्विजः । दद्यादतिथये नित्यं बुध्येत परमेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: hantakāramathāgraṃ vā bhikṣāṃ vā śaktito dvijaḥ / dadyādatithaye nityaṃ budhyeta parameśvaram
verses.translation: He should give fried grains with honey, powdered 2 )ed grains with sugar, assiduously at the time of the Sraddha.
verses.hindi: अतिक्रमणकर पिण्डदान नहीं करना चाहिए॥ ८६--८९ ॥ पिताओंको पिण्डदान करे। यह पुत्र सम्पत्तिका आधा भाग ले सकता है। जो पुत्र नियोग-बिधिसे उत्पन्न नहीं है, शुल्क (मूल्य) देकर गृहीत है, वह बीजी (जिस पुरुषके बीजसे उत्पन्न हुआ है वह बीजी है)-
verses.wordMeaning: He should give fried grains with honey, powdered 2 )ed grains with sugar, assiduously at the time of the Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should give fried grains with honey, powdered 2 )ed grains with sugar, assiduously at the time of the Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: भिक्षामाहुर्ग्रासमात्रमग्रं तस्याश्चतुर्गुणम् । पुष्कलं हन्तकारं तु तच्चतुर्गुणमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: bhikṣāmāhurgrāsamātramagraṃ tasyāścaturguṇam / puṣkalaṃ hantakāraṃ tu taccaturguṇamucyate
verses.translation: He should give fried grains with honey, powdered 2 )ed grains with sugar, assiduously at the time of the Sraddha.
verses.hindi: को पिण्डदान करेगा और क्षेत्राधिकारी पिताके पिण्डदानका उसे अधिकार नहीं होता। (नियोगसे उत्पन्न पुत्रको) क्रमशः क्षेत्री और बीजीको दो पिण्ड देने चाहिए।
verses.wordMeaning: He should give fried grains with honey, powdered 2 )ed grains with sugar, assiduously at the time of the Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should give fried grains with honey, powdered 2 )ed grains with sugar, assiduously at the time of the Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: गोदोहमात्रं कालं वै प्रतीक्ष्यो ह्यतिथिः स्वयम् । अभ्यागतान् यथाशक्ति पूजयेदतिथिं यथा
verses.transliteration: godohamātraṃ kālaṃ vai pratīkṣyo hyatithiḥ svayam / abhyāgatān yathāśakti pūjayedatithiṃ yathā
verses.translation: He should give fried grains with honey, powdered 2 )ed grains with sugar, assiduously at the time of the Sraddha.
verses.hindi: दोनोंका नाम कीर्तन करना चाहिए (पिताकी) मृत्यु-तिथिमें विधिपूर्वक एको दिष्ट श्राद्ध करना चाहिए। अपना अशौच समाप्त होनेपर इच्छानुसार काम्य श्राद्ध किये जा सकते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: He should give fried grains with honey, powdered 2 )ed grains with sugar, assiduously at the time of the Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should give fried grains with honey, powdered 2 )ed grains with sugar, assiduously at the time of the Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: भिक्षां वै भिक्षवे दद्याद् विधिवद् ब्रह्मचारिणे । दद्यादन्नं यथाशक्ति त्वर्थिभ्यो लोभवर्जितः
verses.transliteration: bhikṣāṃ vai bhikṣave dadyād vidhivad brahmacāriṇe / dadyādannaṃ yathāśakti tvarthibhyo lobhavarjitaḥ
verses.translation: He should give fried grains with honey, powdered 2 )ed grains with sugar, assiduously at the time of the Sraddha.
verses.hindi: १-शास्त्रीय विधिसे विवाहके लिये किसी योग्य वरको चुना जाय और उसे यह वचन दे दिया जाय कि 'मैं अपनी कन्याका विवाह तुमसे करूँगा' वह वर हैववश यदि गत हो जाय तो शास्त्रानुसार उस वागूदत्ता कन्याका पुनर्विवाह सम्भव नहीं है, किंतु दिवंगत वरको पिण्ड देनेके लिये और उसकी सम्पत्तिके स्वामित्वके लिये पुत्रकी आवश्यकता हो तो उस वागूदत्ता कन्याका देवर या सगोत्रसे विवाह करना शास्त्रविहित है। यही नियोग-विवाह है। इससे उत्पन्न पुरुषको द्वधामुष्यायणिक कहते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: He should give fried grains with honey, powdered 2 )ed grains with sugar, assiduously at the time of the Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should give fried grains with honey, powdered 2 )ed grains with sugar, assiduously at the time of the Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषामप्यलाभे तु अन्नं गोभ्यो निवेदयेत् । भुञ्जीत बन्धुभिः सार्धं वाग्यतो ऽन्नमकुत्सयन्
verses.transliteration: sarveṣāmapyalābhe tu annaṃ gobhyo nivedayet / bhuñjīta bandhubhiḥ sārdhaṃ vāgyato 'nnamakutsayan
verses.translation: He should give fried grains with honey, powdered 2 )ed grains with sugar, assiduously at the time of the Sraddha.
verses.hindi: २-वागूदत्ता कन्यासे नियोग-विधिसे विवाह करनेवाला देवर आदि बीजी है अर्थात् विद्यमान पिता। ३-वाग्दत्ता कन्याका दिवगंत वर क्षेत्री है अर्थात् दिवङ्गत पिता।
verses.wordMeaning: He should give fried grains with honey, powdered 2 )ed grains with sugar, assiduously at the time of the Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should give fried grains with honey, powdered 2 )ed grains with sugar, assiduously at the time of the Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: अकृत्वा तु द्विजः पञ्च महायज्ञान् द्विजोत्तमाः । भृञ्जीत चेत् स मूढात्मा तिर्यग्योनिं सगच्छति
verses.transliteration: akṛtvā tu dvijaḥ pañca mahāyajñān dvijottamāḥ / bhṛñjīta cet sa mūḍhātmā tiryagyoniṃ sagacchati
verses.translation: He should give fried grains with honey, powdered 2 )ed grains with sugar, assiduously at the time of the Sraddha.
verses.hindi: ४-औरस आदि बारह प्रकारके पुत्र धर्मशास्त्रमें बताये गये हँ । उनमें एक क्रीत पुत्र होता है। यह मूल्य देकर माता-पितासे ले लिया जाता है और अपने पुत्ररूपमें स्वीकार कर लिया जाता है। यही पुत्र शुल्कसे गृहीत पुत्ररूपमें यहाँ निर्दिष्ट है।
verses.wordMeaning: He should give fried grains with honey, powdered 2 )ed grains with sugar, assiduously at the time of the Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should give fried grains with honey, powdered 2 )ed grains with sugar, assiduously at the time of the Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: वेदाभ्यासो ऽन्वहं शक्त्या महायज्ञक्रिया क्षमा । नाशयत्याशु पापानि देवानामर्चनं तथा
verses.transliteration: vedābhyāso 'nvahaṃ śaktyā mahāyajñakriyā kṣamā / nāśayatyāśu pāpāni devānāmarcanaṃ tathā
verses.translation: He should give fried grains with honey, powdered 2 )ed grains with sugar, assiduously at the time of the Sraddha.
verses.hindi: ५-क्षेत्री एवं बीजी दोनोंको पिण्डदान नियोगसे उत्पन्न वही पुत्र करेगा, जिसकी उत्पत्तिके पूर्व देवर आदि तथा वाग्दत्ता कन्याने परस्पर यह संविदा कर ली हो कि यह उत्पन्न होनेवाला पुत्र हम दोनोंका होगा। ३७० क कूर्मपुराण भ
