verses.wordMeaning: He should give fried grains with honey, powdered 2 )ed grains with sugar, assiduously at the time of the Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should give fried grains with honey, powdered 2 )ed grains with sugar, assiduously at the time of the Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: यो मोहादथवालस्यादकृत्वा देवतार्चनम् । भुङ्क्ते स याति नरकान् शूकरेष्वभिजायते
verses.transliteration: yo mohādathavālasyādakṛtvā devatārcanam / bhuṅkte sa yāti narakān śūkareṣvabhijāyate
verses.translation: He should give fried grains with honey, powdered 2 )ed grains with sugar, assiduously at the time of the Sraddha.
verses.hindi: पूर्वाह्णे चैव कर्तव्यं श्राद्धमभ्युदयार्थिना। अभ्युदयकी कामना करनेवालेको पूर्वाहमें ही देववत्सर्वमेव स्याद् यवैः कार्या तिलक्रिया॥ ९४ ॥  आभ्युदयिक (नान्दी) श्राद्ध करना चाहिए। देवकार्ये समान इसमें सभी कार्य करने चाहिए। तिलोंका कार्य जौसे करना चाहिए। इसमें सीधे कुशोंका प्रयोग करे
verses.wordMeaning: He should give fried grains with honey, powdered 2 )ed grains with sugar, assiduously at the time of the Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should give fried grains with honey, powdered 2 )ed grains with sugar, assiduously at the time of the Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन कृत्वा कर्माणि वै द्विजाः । भुञ्जीत स्वजनैः सार्धं सयाति परमां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: tasmāt sarvaprayatnena kṛtvā karmāṇi vai dvijāḥ / bhuñjīta svajanaiḥ sārdhaṃ sayāti paramāṃ gatim
verses.translation: He should give fried grains with honey, powdered 2 )ed grains with sugar, assiduously at the time of the Sraddha.
verses.hindi: (मोटकके रूपमें द्विगुणीकृत कुशोंका प्रयोग न करे) । युग्म ब्राह्मणोंको भोजन कराये और ' नान्दीमुखाः पितरः दर्भाश्च ऋजवः कार्या युग्मान् वै भोजयेद् द्विजान्। प्रीयन्ताम्' अर्थात् नान्दीमुख नामक पितर तृप्त हों- नान्दीमुखास्तु पितरः प्रीयन्तामिति वाचयेत्॥ ९५ ॥  ऐसा कहना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: He should give fried grains with honey, powdered 2 )ed grains with sugar, assiduously at the time of the Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should give fried grains with honey, powdered 2 )ed grains with sugar, assiduously at the time of the Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे अष्टादशो ऽध्यायः व्यास उवाच प्राङ्मुखो ऽन्नानि भुञ्जीत सूर्याभिमुख एव वा । आसीनस्त्वासने शुद्धे भूम्यां पादौ निधाय तु
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge aṣṭādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ vyāsa uvāca prāṅmukho 'nnāni bhuñjīta sūryābhimukha eva vā / āsīnastvāsane śuddhe bhūmyāṃ pādau nidhāya tu
verses.translation: Manes are satisfied with the meat of fish for two months; with Venison for three months; with the meat of the ram for four months; with the meat of birds for five months; with the meat of goats for six months and with the meat of the spotted antelope for seven months.
verses.hindi: मातृश्राद्धं तु पूर्व स्यात् पितृणां स्यादनन्तरम्। पहले मातृश्राद्ध तदनन्तर पितृश्राद्ध करना चाहिए।
verses.wordMeaning: Manes are satisfied with the meat of fish for two months; with Venison for three months; with the meat of the ram for four months; with the meat of birds for five months; with the meat of goats for six months and with the meat of the spotted antelope for seven months.
verses.commentary: Sense: Manes are satisfied with the meat of fish for two months; with Venison for three months; with the meat of the ram for four months; with the meat of birds for five months; with the meat of goats for six months and with the meat of the spotted antelope for seven months.

verses.sanskrit: आयुष्यं प्राङ्मुखो भुङ्क्ते यशस्यं दक्षिणामुखः । श्रियं प्रत्यङ्मुखो भुङ्क्ते ऋतं भुङ्क्ते उदङ्मुखाः
verses.transliteration: āyuṣyaṃ prāṅmukho bhuṅkte yaśasyaṃ dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ / śriyaṃ pratyaṅmukho bhuṅkte ṛtaṃ bhuṅkte udaṅmukhāḥ
verses.translation: The Pitrs are propitiated for eight months, if Sraddha is offered with the meat ofpm (deer) and for nine months with the meat of Ruru deer. With the meat of the boar and the buffalo they are propitiated for ten months.
verses.hindi: ततो मातामहानां तु वृद्धौ श्राद्धत्रयं स्मृतम्॥ ९६ ॥  उसके बाद मातामहादिका श्राद्ध होता है । वृद्धिश्राद्धमे इन्हीं तीन प्रकारके श्राद्धोंका वर्णन हुआ है । देवकार्य (विश्वेदेव कार्य) करनेके अनन्तर पिण्डदान करना चाहिए। दाहिनी ओरसे ही विश्वेदेवकार्य करना चाहिए। देवपूर्व प्रदद्याद् वै न कुर्यादप्रदक्षिणम्। एकाग्रचित्तसे' सव्य होकर पूर्वाभिमुख हो पिण्डदान प्राइमुखो निर्वपेत् पिण्डानृपवीती समाहित: ॥ ९७ ॥  करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: The Pitrs are propitiated for eight months, if Sraddha is offered with the meat ofpm (deer) and for nine months with the meat of Ruru deer. With the meat of the boar and the buffalo they are propitiated for ten months.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Pitrs are propitiated for eight months, if Sraddha is offered with the meat ofpm (deer) and for nine months with the meat of Ruru deer. With the meat of the boar and the buffalo they are propitiated for ten months.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चार्द्रे भोजनं कुर्याद् भूमौ पात्रं निधाय तु । उपवासेन तत्तुल्यं मनुराह प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: pañcārdre bhojanaṃ kuryād bhūmau pātraṃ nidhāya tu / upavāsena tattulyaṃ manurāha prajāpatiḥ
verses.translation: With the flesh of rabbit and tortoise, he should propitiate them for eleven months. With the cow's milk and
verses.hindi: पूर्व तु मातरः पूज्या भक्त्या वै सगणेश्वराः । सर्वप्रथम (नान्दीश्राद्धके पूर्व) भक्तिपूर्वक गणेश्वरोंसे
verses.wordMeaning: With the flesh of rabbit and tortoise, he should propitiate them for eleven months. With the cow's milk and
verses.commentary: Sense: With the flesh of rabbit and tortoise, he should propitiate them for eleven months. With the cow's milk and

verses.sanskrit: उपलिप्ते शुचौ देशे पादौ प्रक्षाल्य वै करौ । आचम्यार्द्राननो ऽक्रोधः पञ्चार्द्रे भोजनं चरेत्
verses.transliteration: upalipte śucau deśe pādau prakṣālya vai karau / ācamyārdrānano 'krodhaḥ pañcārdre bhojanaṃ caret
verses.translation: The Kalasaka, (?) the Mahasalka (sea-crab), the meat of rhinoceros and the red goat and the honey, —the food-stuffs of the sages are capable of being beneficent endlessly.
verses.hindi: स्थणिडलेषु विचित्रेषु प्रतिमासु द्विजातिषु॥ ९८ ॥  युक्त (षोडश) मातृकाओंका पूजन करना चाहिए। मनोरम स्थण्डिल, प्रतिमा अथवा ब्राह्मणोंमें पुष्प, धूप, पुष्पैर्धूपैश्च नेवेद्येर्गन्धाद्यैर्भूषणैरपि। नैवेद्य, गन्ध तथा अलंकारों आदिके द्वारा (षोडश पूजयित्वा मातृगणं कुर्याच्छाद्धत्रयं बुध: ॥ ९९ ॥  मातृकाओंका) पूजन करना चाहिए। मातृगणोंकी पूजाकर
verses.wordMeaning: The Kalasaka, (?) the Mahasalka (sea-crab), the meat of rhinoceros and the red goat and the honey, —the food-stuffs of the sages are capable of being beneficent endlessly.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Kalasaka, (?) the Mahasalka (sea-crab), the meat of rhinoceros and the red goat and the honey, —the food-stuffs of the sages are capable of being beneficent endlessly.

verses.sanskrit: महाव्यहृतिभिस्त्वन्नं परिधायोदकेन तु । अमृतोपस्तरणमसीत्यापोशानक्रियां चरेत्
verses.transliteration: mahāvyahṛtibhistvannaṃ paridhāyodakena tu / amṛtopastaraṇamasītyāpośānakriyāṃ caret
verses.translation: Whether by buying or securing oneself or bringing the dead body (of the animal), the Brahmana should assi¬ duously offer it in the Sraddha. It is called everlasting for him.
verses.hindi: विद्वान्को चाहिए कि वह तीनों श्राद्धे करे । मातृपूजन अकृत्वा मातृयागं तु यः श्राद्धं परिवेषयेत्। किये बिना जो श्राद्ध करता है, (षोडश) मातृकाएँ तस्य क्रोधसमाविष्टा हिंसामिच्छन्ति मातरः ॥ १०० ॥  क्रुद्ध होकर उससे अप्रसन्न हो जाती हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Whether by buying or securing oneself or bringing the dead body (of the animal), the Brahmana should assi¬ duously offer it in the Sraddha. It is called everlasting for him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Whether by buying or securing oneself or bringing the dead body (of the animal), the Brahmana should assi¬ duously offer it in the Sraddha. It is called everlasting for him.

verses.sanskrit: स्वाहाप्रणवसंयुक्तां प्राणायाद्याहुतिं ततः । अपानाय ततो हुत्वा व्यानाय तदनन्तरम्
verses.transliteration: svāhāpraṇavasaṃyuktāṃ prāṇāyādyāhutiṃ tataḥ / apānāya tato hutvā vyānāya tadanantaram
verses.translation: Here the followers of Pahca-ratra, Kapalika and Pasupata sects are disqualified as these sects were regarded to have been outside the vedic fold due to their recognition of their sectarian Agamas as against the Vedas. Pasupatas of the vedic fold described so elaborately in this Purana are different.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे द्वाविंशोऽध्यायः १-पुत्रादिकी उत्पत्तिके समय होनेवाले विशेष श्राद्धके लिये यह व्यवस्था है। सामान्यत: सभी श्राद्धोंमें प्रथम पिता आदिका, अनन्तर माता आदिका श्राद्ध होता है।
verses.wordMeaning: Here the followers of Pahca-ratra, Kapalika and Pasupata sects are disqualified as these sects were regarded to have been outside the vedic fold due to their recognition of their sectarian Agamas as against the Vedas.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Here the followers of Pahca-ratra, Kapalika and Pasupata sects are disqualified as these sects were regarded to have been outside the vedic fold due to their recognition of their sectarian Agamas as against the Vedas.…

verses.sanskrit: उदानाय ततः कुर्यात् समानायेति पञ्चमीम् । विज्ञाय तत्त्वमेतेषां जुहुयादात्मनि द्विजः
verses.transliteration: udānāya tataḥ kuryāt samānāyeti pañcamīm / vijñāya tattvameteṣāṃ juhuyādātmani dvijaḥ
verses.translation: VV. 21-22. Cf. Manu III. 138-139 but hemodifies his view and allows invitation to a friend in emergency but not an enemy however learned III. 144.
verses.hindi: २-यह किसी विशेष श्रौतकर्मके पिण्डदानकी व्यवस्था है। सामान्यत: पिण्डदान दक्षिणाभिमुख एवं अपसव्य होकर किया
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 21-22. Cf. Manu III. 138-139 but hemodifies his view and allows invitation to a friend in emergency but not an enemy however learned III. 144.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 21-22. Cf. Manu III. 138-139 but hemodifies his view and allows invitation to a friend in emergency but not an enemy however learned III. 144.

verses.sanskrit: शेषमन्नं यथाकामं भुञ्जीतव्यं जनैर्युतम् । ध्यात्वा तन्मनसा देवमात्मानं वै प्रजापतिम्
verses.transliteration: śeṣamannaṃ yathākāmaṃ bhuñjītavyaṃ janairyutam / dhyātvā tanmanasā devamātmānaṃ vai prajāpatim
verses.translation: Manu III. 133.
verses.hindi: ३-ये तीन श्राद्ध-पिता आदि तीन, माता आदि तीन तथा मातामह आदि तीनका समझना चाहिए । नान्दीश्राद्धमें ये तीनों श्राद्ध होते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Manu III. 133.
verses.commentary: Sense: Manu III. 133.

verses.sanskrit: अमृतापिधानमसीत्युपरिष्टादपः पिबेत् । आचान्तः पुनराचामेदायं गौरिति मन्त्रतः
verses.transliteration: amṛtāpidhānamasītyupariṣṭādapaḥ pibet / ācāntaḥ punarācāmedāyaṃ gauriti mantrataḥ
verses.translation: VV. 27-47 describe the disqualifications for invitation to a Sraddha. Most of these verses are common to Manu III. 151-166 Cf. Yaj. Smr. I. 222-
verses.hindi: आशौच-प्रकरणमें जननाशौच और मरणाशौचकी क्रियाविधि, शुय्द्वि-विधान, सपिण्डता, सद्यःशौच, अन्त्येष्टि-संस्कार, सपिण्डीकरण-विधि, मासिक तथा सांवत्सरिक श्राद्ध आदिका वर्णन
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 27-47 describe the disqualifications for invitation to a Sraddha. Most of these verses are common to Manu III. 151-166 Cf. Yaj. Smr. I. 222-
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 27-47 describe the disqualifications for invitation to a Sraddha. Most of these verses are common to Manu III. 151-166 Cf. Yaj. Smr. I. 222-

verses.sanskrit: द्रुपदां वा त्रिरावर्त्य सर्वपापप्रणाशनीम् । प्राणानां ग्रन्थिरसीत्यालभेद् हृदयं ततः
verses.transliteration: drupadāṃ vā trirāvartya sarvapāpapraṇāśanīm / prāṇānāṃ granthirasītyālabhed hṛdayaṃ tataḥ
verses.translation: N. of an Upanisad.
verses.hindi: नित्यानि चेव कर्माणि काम्यानि च विशेषतः । न कुर्याद् विहितं किञ्चत् स्वाध्यायं मनसापि च शुष्कान्नेन फलेर्वापि वैतानं जुहुयात् तथा
verses.wordMeaning: N. of an Upanisad.
verses.commentary: Sense: N. of an Upanisad.

verses.sanskrit: आचम्याङ्गुष्ठमात्रेति पादाङ्गुष्ठे ऽथ दक्षिणे । निः स्त्रवयेद् हस्तजलमूर्ध्वहस्तः समाहितः
verses.transliteration: ācamyāṅguṣṭhamātreti pādāṅguṣṭhe 'tha dakṣiṇe / niḥ stravayed hastajalamūrdhvahastaḥ samāhitaḥ
verses.translation: He must be devoted to the performance of Agnihotra. He must be a scholar knowing Nyayas and the six Angas
verses.hindi: सूतके तु सपिण्डानां संस्पर्शो न प्रदुष्यति। सूतकं सूतिकां चेव वर्जयित्वा नृणां पुनः
verses.wordMeaning: He must be devoted to the performance of Agnihotra. He must be a scholar knowing Nyayas and the six Angas
verses.commentary: Sense: He must be devoted to the performance of Agnihotra. He must be a scholar knowing Nyayas and the six Angas

verses.sanskrit: हुतानुमन्त्रणं कुर्यात् श्रद्धायामिति मन्त्रतः । अथाक्षरेण स्वात्मानं योजयेद् ब्रह्मणेति हि
verses.transliteration: hutānumantraṇaṃ kuryāt śraddhāyāmiti mantrataḥ / athākṣareṇa svātmānaṃ yojayed brahmaṇeti hi
verses.translation: He must be observing vows of sages and a (lit. a minor sage) prospective sage of calm mind who has subdued sense-organs. He must belong to family of hereditary Vedic Teachers. He must be pure ever since the conception. He must be a bestower of a thousand cows.
verses.hindi: व्यासजीने कहा--हे द्विजोत्तमो ! विद्वानोंने ब्राह्मणोंके लिये सपिण्डोंकी मृत्यु अथवा जन्म होनेपर दस दिनका आशौच कहा है। (आशौचमें) विशेषरूपसे विहित नित्य तथा काम्य कुछ भी कर्म न करे। मनसे भी स्वाध्याय (वेदाध्ययन) न करे
verses.wordMeaning: He must be observing vows of sages and a (lit. a minor sage) prospective sage of calm mind who has subdued sense-organs. He must belong to family of hereditary Vedic Teachers. He must be pure ever since the conception. He must be a bestower of a thousand cows.
verses.commentary: Sense: He must be observing vows of sages and a (lit. a minor sage) prospective sage of calm mind who has subdued sense-organs. He must belong to family of hereditary Vedic Teachers. He must be pure ever since the conception. He must be a bestower of a thousand cows.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषामेव यागानामात्मयागः परः स्मृतः । यो ऽनेन विधिना कुर्यात् स याति ब्रह्मणः क्षयम्
verses.transliteration: sarveṣāmeva yāgānāmātmayāgaḥ paraḥ smṛtaḥ / yo 'nena vidhinā kuryāt sa yāti brahmaṇaḥ kṣayam
verses.translation: He must regularly perform the Candrayana rite. He must be truthful in speech, a knower of the Puranas, devoted to the worship of the preceptor, Devas and the fire-god. He must be devoted to the perfect knowledge.
verses.hindi: यज्ञशालाके अग्निकार्यके लिये पवित्र, क्रोधरहित, भूमिदेवरूप ब्राह्मणोंको नियुक्त करना चाहिए। शुष्क अन्न अथवा फूलोंके द्वारा वैतानाग्निमें हवन (श्रौत होम) करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: He must regularly perform the Candrayana rite. He must be truthful in speech, a knower of the Puranas, devoted to the worship of the preceptor, Devas and the fire-god. He must be devoted to the perfect knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: He must regularly perform the Candrayana rite. He must be truthful in speech, a knower of the Puranas, devoted to the worship of the preceptor, Devas and the fire-god. He must be devoted to the perfect knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञोपवीती भुञ्जीत स्त्रग्गन्धालङ्कृतः शुचिः । सायंप्रापर्नान्तरा वै संध्यायां तु विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: yajñopavītī bhuñjīta straggandhālaṅkṛtaḥ śuciḥ / sāyaṃprāparnāntarā vai saṃdhyāyāṃ tu viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: One liberated from all sides, of firm mind, an excellent Brahmana who has realised the Brahman, and who is self- possessed, a devotee of Visnu, engaged in the worship of Maha- deva and one called Pahktipavana (one who sanctifies the row in which he sits for meals.)
verses.hindi: दूसरे लोग इन आशौचग्रस्त व्यक्तियोंको स्पर्श न करें और न कोई वस्तु ही उनसे लें। विद्वानोंने चौथे अथवा पाँचवें दिन इनके स्पर्शका विधान किया है। (सपिण्डोंके) जननाशौचमें सपिण्डोंको स्पर्श करनेमें दोष नहीं होता। तथापि उत्पन्न हुए बालक और उसे जन्म देनेवाली (सद्यः) प्रसूता स्त्रीका मनुष्योंको स्पर्श नहीं करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: One liberated from all sides, of firm mind, an excellent Brahmana who has realised the Brahman, and who is self- possessed, a devotee of Visnu, engaged in the worship of Maha- deva and one called Pahktipavana (one who sanctifies the row in which he sits for meals.)
verses.commentary: Sense: One liberated from all sides, of firm mind, an excellent Brahmana who has realised the Brahman, and who is self- possessed, a devotee of Visnu, engaged in the worship of Maha- deva and one called Pahktipavana (one who sanctifies the row in which he sits for meals.)

verses.sanskrit: नाद्यात् सूर्यग्रहात् पूर्वमह्नि सायं शशिग्रहात् । ग्रहकाले च नाश्नीयात् स्नात्वाश्नीयात् तु मुक्तयोः
verses.transliteration: nādyāt sūryagrahāt pūrvamahni sāyaṃ śaśigrahāt / grahakāle ca nāśnīyāt snātvāśnīyāt tu muktayoḥ
verses.translation: A person who is as follows, should be known as a Paiiktipavana; one who is engaged in non-violence, one who never accepts monetary gifts; one who performs Satra (sacrificial se.ssions) and one who is engaged in charitable gifts.
verses.hindi: जननाशौचमें वेदका अध्ययन करनेवाला, यज्ञ करनेवाला और वेद जाननेवाला पिता-ये सभी स्नान करनेसे स्पर्श करने योग्य हो जाते हैं। माता दस दिनोंके बाद (स्पर्श-योग्य होती है) निर्गुण अथवा अति-
verses.wordMeaning: A person who is as follows, should be known as a Paiiktipavana; one who is engaged in non-violence, one who never accepts monetary gifts; one who performs Satra (sacrificial se.ssions) and one who is engaged in charitable gifts.
verses.commentary: Sense: A person who is as follows, should be known as a Paiiktipavana; one who is engaged in non-violence, one who never accepts monetary gifts; one who performs Satra (sacrificial se.ssions) and one who is engaged in charitable gifts.

verses.sanskrit: मुक्ते शशिनि भुञ्जीत यदि न स्यान्महानिशा । अमुक्तयोरस्तङ्गतयोरद्याद् दृष्ट्वा परे ऽहनि
verses.transliteration: mukte śaśini bhuñjīta yadi na syānmahāniśā / amuktayorastaṅgatayoradyād dṛṣṭvā pare 'hani
verses.translation: A Brahmana who is engaged in what is beneficial to his parents, who regularly takes his bath early in the morning, a sage knowing spiritual topics and a person of self control should be known as Pahkti-Pavana.
verses.hindi: निर्गुण लोगोंके लिये दस दिनोंका आशौच कहा गया है। एक, दो अथवा तीन गुणवालोंके लिये चार, तीन या एक दिनमें शुद्धि होनेका विधान है। दस दिन हो जानेपर सम्यक्-रूपसे अध्ययन एवं हवन करना चाहिए। प्रजापति मनुने चौथे दिन (एक गुणवाले अशौची)-के स्पर्शका विधान किया है। क्रियाहीन, मूर्ख, महारोगी और मनमाना आचरण करनेवाले व्यक्तियोंका आशौच मरणपर्यन्त कहा? गया है
verses.wordMeaning: A Brahmana who is engaged in what is beneficial to his parents, who regularly takes his bath early in the morning, a sage knowing spiritual topics and a person of self control should be known as Pahkti-Pavana.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmana who is engaged in what is beneficial to his parents, who regularly takes his bath early in the morning, a sage knowing spiritual topics and a person of self control should be known as Pahkti-Pavana.

verses.sanskrit: नाश्नीयात् प्रेक्षमाणानामप्रदायैव दुर्मतिः । न यज्ञशिष्टादन्द् वा न क्रुद्धो नान्यमानसः
verses.transliteration: nāśnīyāt prekṣamāṇānāmapradāyaiva durmatiḥ / na yajñaśiṣṭādand vā na kruddho nānyamānasaḥ
verses.translation: A great Yogin, well-stabilised in perfect knowledge, one who ponders over the meanings of Vedantas; one who has faith, one who is engaged in Sraddha—such a Brahmana is Pahkti-Pavana.
verses.hindi: १-वेदाध्ययन एवं अग्निहोत्रादि कर्मसे रहितको निर्गुण कहा जाता है। २-जो स्मार्ताग्निमान् है वह एक गुणवाला है। जो स्मार्ताग्निमान् तथा वेदाध्ययनसम्पन्न है, वह दो गुणवाला है। जो इन दोनोंक साथ श्रौताग्निमान् है, वह तीन गुणोंवाला है। (मनु० ३। ५९ कुल्लूकभट्टी)
verses.wordMeaning: A great Yogin, well-stabilised in perfect knowledge, one who ponders over the meanings of Vedantas; one who has faith, one who is engaged in Sraddha—such a Brahmana is Pahkti-Pavana.
verses.commentary: Sense: A great Yogin, well-stabilised in perfect knowledge, one who ponders over the meanings of Vedantas; one who has faith, one who is engaged in Sraddha—such a Brahmana is Pahkti-Pavana.

verses.sanskrit: आत्मार्थं भोजनं यस्य रत्यर्थं यस्य मैथुनम् । वृत्यर्थं यस्य चाधीतं निष्फलं तस्य जीवितम्
verses.transliteration: ātmārthaṃ bhojanaṃ yasya ratyarthaṃ yasya maithunam / vṛtyarthaṃ yasya cādhītaṃ niṣphalaṃ tasya jīvitam
verses.translation: A Brahmana who is engaged in the Vedic lore, one always devoted to celibacy, who is well versed in the Atharva- veda and who desires liberation is a Pahkti-Pavana.
verses.hindi: ३-इस वचनका तात्पर्य क्रियाहीनता आदिकी "निन्दामें है। प्राक्संस्कारात् त्रिरात्रं स्यात् तस्मादूर्ध्वं दशाहकम्
verses.wordMeaning: A Brahmana who is engaged in the Vedic lore, one always devoted to celibacy, who is well versed in the Atharva- veda and who desires liberation is a Pahkti-Pavana.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmana who is engaged in the Vedic lore, one always devoted to celibacy, who is well versed in the Atharva- veda and who desires liberation is a Pahkti-Pavana.

verses.sanskrit: यद्भुङ्क्ते वेष्टितशिरा यच्च भुङ्क्ते उदङ्मुखः । सोपानत्कश्च यद् भुङ्क्ते सर्वं विद्यात् तदासुरम्
verses.transliteration: yadbhuṅkte veṣṭitaśirā yacca bhuṅkte udaṅmukhaḥ / sopānatkaśca yad bhuṅkte sarvaṃ vidyāt tadāsuram
verses.translation: A Brahmana who has no common Pravaras (with the performer of the Sraddha) and who belongs to a different Gotra and who is thus unrelated, should be regarded as Pahktipavana.
verses.hindi: ऊनद्विवार्षिके प्रेते मातापित्रोस्तदिष्यते। त्रिरात्रेण शुचिस्त्वन्यो यदि ह्यत्यन्तनिर्गुणः
verses.wordMeaning: A Brahmana who has no common Pravaras (with the performer of the Sraddha) and who belongs to a different Gotra and who is thus unrelated, should be regarded as Pahktipavana.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmana who has no common Pravaras (with the performer of the Sraddha) and who belongs to a different Gotra and who is thus unrelated, should be regarded as Pahktipavana.

verses.sanskrit: नार्धरात्रे न मध्याह्ने नाजीर्णे नार्द्रवस्त्रधृक् । न च भिन्नासनगतो न शयानः स्थितो ऽपि वा
verses.transliteration: nārdharātre na madhyāhne nājīrṇe nārdravastradhṛk / na ca bhinnāsanagato na śayānaḥ sthito 'pi vā
verses.translation: One shall feed a quiescent Yogin engaged in the perfect knowledge of the reality. In his absence, he may feed a Naisthika (perpetual) celibate sage or a religious student who has completed his religious studentship and who takes to the life of a householder.
verses.hindi: अदन्तजातमरणे पित्रोरेकाहमिष्यते । जातदन्ते त्रिरात्रं स्याद् यदि स्यातां तु निर्गुणौ आदन्तजननात् सद्य आचौलादेकरात्रकम्। त्रिरात्रमौपनयनात् सपिण्डानामुदाहतम्
verses.wordMeaning: One shall feed a quiescent Yogin engaged in the perfect knowledge of the reality. In his absence, he may feed a Naisthika (perpetual) celibate sage or a religious student who has completed his religious studentship and who takes to the life of a householder.
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall feed a quiescent Yogin engaged in the perfect knowledge of the reality. In his absence, he may feed a Naisthika (perpetual) celibate sage or a religious student who has completed his religious studentship and who takes to the life of a householder.

verses.sanskrit: न भिन्नभाजने चैव न भूम्यां न च पाणिषु । नोच्छिष्टो घृतमादद्यान्न मूर्धानं स्पृशेदपि
verses.transliteration: na bhinnabhājane caiva na bhūmyāṃ na ca pāṇiṣu / nocchiṣṭo ghṛtamādadyānna mūrdhānaṃ spṛśedapi
verses.translation: In his absence, he shall feed a householder who is desirous of salvation and who has no attachment. If all these are not available, one shall feed a householder who is an aspirant.
verses.hindi: सद्यः शौचं सपिण्डानां कर्तव्यं सोदरस्य च। ऊर्ध्व दशाहादेकाहं सोदरो यदि निर्गुणः
verses.wordMeaning: In his absence, he shall feed a householder who is desirous of salvation and who has no attachment. If all these are not available, one shall feed a householder who is an aspirant.
verses.commentary: Sense: In his absence, he shall feed a householder who is desirous of salvation and who has no attachment. If all these are not available, one shall feed a householder who is an aspirant.

verses.sanskrit: न ब्रह्म कीर्तयन् वापि न निः शेषं न भार्यया । नान्धकारे न चाकाशे न च देवालयादिषु
verses.transliteration: na brahma kīrtayan vāpi na niḥ śeṣaṃ na bhāryayā / nāndhakāre na cākāśe na ca devālayādiṣu
verses.translation: If an ascetic who knows the Gunas of the Prakrti and all the principles (tattvas) partakes of one's Hauls, the merit that one attains exceeds feeding even a thousand knowers of Vedanta.
verses.hindi: एकरात्रं निर्गुणानां चौलादूर्ध्व त्रिरात्रकम् एकरात्रं सपिण्डानां यदि तेऽत्यन्तनिर्गुणाः
verses.wordMeaning: If an ascetic who knows the Gunas of the Prakrti and all the principles (tattvas) partakes of one's Hauls, the merit that one attains exceeds feeding even a thousand knowers of Vedanta.
verses.commentary: Sense: If an ascetic who knows the Gunas of the Prakrti and all the principles (tattvas) partakes of one's Hauls, the merit that one attains exceeds feeding even a thousand knowers of Vedanta.

verses.sanskrit: नैकवस्त्रस्तु भुञ्जीत न यानशयनस्थितः । न पादुकानिर्गतो ऽथ न हसन् विलपन्नपि
verses.transliteration: naikavastrastu bhuñjīta na yānaśayanasthitaḥ / na pādukānirgato 'tha na hasan vilapannapi
verses.translation: Hence, with great effort, one should feed a leading Yogin engaged in the pursuit of perfect knowledge of Isvara (in rites pertaining to gods and Pitrs) by means of Havyas and Kauyas. In case he be not available, he should feed other Brahmanas.
verses.hindi: ब्राह्मणोंका आशौच तीन रात अथवा दस रात- तकका होता है। (उपनयन) संस्कार होनेके पूर्व (तथा चूडासंस्कारके अनन्तर मृत्यु होनेपर) तीन रातका और (उपनयन) संस्कार होनेपर दस रातका अशौच
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, with great effort, one should feed a leading Yogin engaged in the pursuit of perfect knowledge of Isvara (in rites pertaining to gods and Pitrs) by means of Havyas and Kauyas. In case he be not available, he should feed other Brahmanas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, with great effort, one should feed a leading Yogin engaged in the pursuit of perfect knowledge of Isvara (in rites pertaining to gods and Pitrs) by means of Havyas and Kauyas. In case he be not available, he should feed other Brahmanas.

verses.sanskrit: भुक्त्वैवं सुखमास्थाय तदन्नं परिणामयेत् । इतिहासपुराणाभ्यां वेदार्थानुपबृंहयेत्
verses.transliteration: bhuktvaivaṃ sukhamāsthāya tadannaṃ pariṇāmayet / itihāsapurāṇābhyāṃ vedārthānupabṛṃhayet
verses.translation: This is the best alternative in the matter of giving Havya and Kmya. The Anukalpc? (next alternative) which is always practised by pious men should be known as follows:
verses.hindi: दो वर्षसे कम अवस्थावाले बालकके मरनेपर केवल माता-पिताको तीन रातका अशौच होता है। अत्यन्त निर्गुण (सपिण्डकी मृत्यु) होनेपर तीन रातमें शुद्धि होती है। बिना दाँतवाले शिशुके मरनेपर माता- पिताको एक दिनका अशौच कहा गया है। यदि माता- पिता निर्गुण हों तो दाँत उत्पन्न हुए शिशुको मृत्यु होनेपर उन्हें तीन रातका अशौच होता है। दाँत उत्पन्न होनेके पूर्वतक बालकको मृत्यु होनेपर सद्य: चूडाकरण-
verses.wordMeaning: This is the best alternative in the matter of giving Havya and Kmya. The Anukalpc? (next alternative) which is always practised by pious men should be known as follows:
verses.commentary: Sense: This is the best alternative in the matter of giving Havya and Kmya. The Anukalpc? (next alternative) which is always practised by pious men should be known as follows:

verses.sanskrit: ततः संध्यामुपासीत पूर्वोक्तविधिना द्विजः । आसीनस्तु जपेद् देवीं गायत्रीं पश्चिमां प्रति
verses.transliteration: tataḥ saṃdhyāmupāsīta pūrvoktavidhinā dvijaḥ / āsīnastu japed devīṃ gāyatrīṃ paścimāṃ prati
verses.translation: This is the best alternative in the matter of giving Havya and Kmya. The Anukalpc? (next alternative) which is always practised by pious men should be known as follows:
verses.hindi: संस्कारके पूर्वक एक रात तथा उपनयनसे पूर्वतक तीन रातका आशौच सपिण्डोंके लिये कहा गया हैं। उत्पन्न होते ही बालककी मृत्यु होनेपर पिता और माताको अशौच होता है, किंतु पिता (स्नानके बाद)
verses.wordMeaning: This is the best alternative in the matter of giving Havya and Kmya. The Anukalpc? (next alternative) which is always practised by pious men should be known as follows:
verses.commentary: Sense: This is the best alternative in the matter of giving Havya and Kmya. The Anukalpc? (next alternative) which is always practised by pious men should be known as follows:

verses.sanskrit: न तिष्ठति तु यः पुर्वां नास्ते संध्यां तु पश्चिमाम् । स शूद्रेण समो लोके सर्वधर्मविवर्जितः
verses.transliteration: na tiṣṭhati tu yaḥ purvāṃ nāste saṃdhyāṃ tu paścimām / sa śūdreṇa samo loke sarvadharmavivarjitaḥ
verses.translation: This is the best alternative in the matter of giving Havya and Kmya. The Anukalpc? (next alternative) which is always practised by pious men should be known as follows:
verses.hindi: स्पर्शके योग्य होता है। सपिण्डों और सहोदर भाईकी (जन्मसे) दस दिनोंके भीतर मृत्यु होनेपर (स्नानमात्रसे) सद्य: पवित्रता होती है। दस दिनके पश्चात् (मृत्यु होनेपर) एक दिनका अशौच उस सहोदरको होगा जो तदनन्तर दाँत निकलनेतक निर्गुण सपिण्डोंको एक रातका अशौच होता है  चौलकर्मके उपरान्त (सपिण्डोंके मरनेपर) तीन रातका अशौच होता है। श्रेष्ठ जनो!
verses.wordMeaning: This is the best alternative in the matter of giving Havya and Kmya. The Anukalpc? (next alternative) which is always practised by pious men should be known as follows:
verses.commentary: Sense: This is the best alternative in the matter of giving Havya and Kmya. The Anukalpc? (next alternative) which is always practised by pious men should be known as follows:

verses.sanskrit: हुत्वाग्निं विधिवन्मन्त्रैर्भुक्त्वा यज्ञावशिष्टकम् । सभृत्यबान्धवजनः स्वपेच्छुष्कपदो निशि
verses.transliteration: hutvāgniṃ vidhivanmantrairbhuktvā yajñāvaśiṣṭakam / sabhṛtyabāndhavajanaḥ svapecchuṣkapado niśi
verses.translation: This is the best alternative in the matter of giving Havya and Kmya. The Anukalpc? (next alternative) which is always practised by pious men should be known as follows:
verses.hindi: निकले उनकी मृत्यु होनेपर एक रातका अशौच होता है। 'उपनयनके पूर्व सपिण्डोंकी मृत्यु होनेपर सभी गुणवामोंके लिये स्नानका विधान है, किंतु उपनयनके बाद मृत्यु होनेपर भिन्न स्थिति (अलग-अलग अशौचको
verses.wordMeaning: This is the best alternative in the matter of giving Havya and Kmya. The Anukalpc? (next alternative) which is always practised by pious men should be known as follows:
verses.commentary: Sense: This is the best alternative in the matter of giving Havya and Kmya. The Anukalpc? (next alternative) which is always practised by pious men should be known as follows:

verses.sanskrit: नोत्तराभिमुखः स्वप्यात् पश्चिमाभिमुखो न च । न चाकाशे न नग्नो वा नाशुचिर्नासने क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: nottarābhimukhaḥ svapyāt paścimābhimukho na ca / na cākāśe na nagno vā nāśucirnāsane kvacit
verses.translation: This is the best alternative in the matter of giving Havya and Kmya. The Anukalpc? (next alternative) which is always practised by pious men should be known as follows:
verses.hindi: व्यवस्था) होती है छः: महीनेसे पूर्व यदि स्त्रियोंका गर्भस्राव हो जाता है तो जितने महीनेका गर्भ रहता है, उतने ही दिनों- तकका उनका (स्त्रियोंका) अशौच कहा गया है, उसके बाद गर्भपात होनेपर स्त्रियोंके लिये बारह रात्रिका और
verses.wordMeaning: This is the best alternative in the matter of giving Havya and Kmya. The Anukalpc? (next alternative) which is always practised by pious men should be known as follows:
verses.commentary: Sense: This is the best alternative in the matter of giving Havya and Kmya. The Anukalpc? (next alternative) which is always practised by pious men should be known as follows:

verses.sanskrit: न शीर्णायां तु खट्वायां शून्यागारे न चैव हि । नानुवंशं न पालाशे शयने वा कदाचन
verses.transliteration: na śīrṇāyāṃ tu khaṭvāyāṃ śūnyāgāre na caiva hi / nānuvaṃśaṃ na pālāśe śayane vā kadācana
verses.translation: This is the best alternative in the matter of giving Havya and Kmya. The Anukalpc? (next alternative) which is always practised by pious men should be known as follows:
verses.hindi: सपिण्डोंके लिये सद्यः शौचका विधान है
verses.wordMeaning: This is the best alternative in the matter of giving Havya and Kmya. The Anukalpc? (next alternative) which is always practised by pious men should be known as follows:
verses.commentary: Sense: This is the best alternative in the matter of giving Havya and Kmya. The Anukalpc? (next alternative) which is always practised by pious men should be known as follows:

verses.sanskrit: इत्येतदखिलेनोक्तमहन्यहनि वै मया । ब्राह्मणानां कृत्यजातमपवर्गफलप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: ityetadakhilenoktamahanyahani vai mayā / brāhmaṇānāṃ kṛtyajātamapavargaphalapradam
verses.translation: This is the best alternative in the matter of giving Havya and Kmya. The Anukalpc? (next alternative) which is always practised by pious men should be known as follows:
verses.hindi: गर्भच्युतावहोरात्रै सपिण्डेउत्यन्तनिर्गुणे। यथेष्टाचरणे ज्ञातौ त्रिरात्रमिति निश्चय: यदि स्यात् सूतके सूतिर्मरणे वा मृतिर्भवेत्।
verses.wordMeaning: This is the best alternative in the matter of giving Havya and Kmya. The Anukalpc? (next alternative) which is always practised by pious men should be known as follows:
verses.commentary: Sense: This is the best alternative in the matter of giving Havya and Kmya. The Anukalpc? (next alternative) which is always practised by pious men should be known as follows:

verses.sanskrit: नास्तिक्यादथवालस्यात् ब्राह्मणो न करोति यः । स याति नरकान् घोरान् काकयोनौ च जायते
verses.transliteration: nāstikyādathavālasyāt brāhmaṇo na karoti yaḥ / sa yāti narakān ghorān kākayonau ca jāyate
verses.translation: This is the best alternative in the matter of giving Havya and Kmya. The Anukalpc? (next alternative) which is always practised by pious men should be known as follows:
verses.hindi: गर्भत्राव तथा अत्यन्त निर्गुण सपिण्डीकी मृत्यु होनेपर एक अहोरात्रका और मनमाने आचरणवाले जाति-बन्धुके (यहाँ गर्भस्राव होनेपर) तीन रातका अशौच निश्चित है। यदि जननाशौचके मध्य दूसरा
verses.wordMeaning: This is the best alternative in the matter of giving Havya and Kmya. The Anukalpc? (next alternative) which is always practised by pious men should be known as follows:
verses.commentary: Sense: This is the best alternative in the matter of giving Havya and Kmya. The Anukalpc? (next alternative) which is always practised by pious men should be known as follows:

verses.sanskrit: नान्यो विमुक्तये पन्था मुक्त्वाश्रमविधिं स्वकम् । तस्मात् कर्माणि कुर्वोत तुष्टये परमेष्ठिनः
verses.transliteration: nānyo vimuktaye panthā muktvāśramavidhiṃ svakam / tasmāt karmāṇi kurvota tuṣṭaye parameṣṭhinaḥ
verses.translation: This is the best alternative in the matter of giving Havya and Kmya. The Anukalpc? (next alternative) which is always practised by pious men should be known as follows:
verses.hindi: जननाशौच हो जाय और मरणाशौचके बीचमें दूसरा मरणाशौच पड़ जाय तो प्रथम अशौचके जितने दिन शेष रहते हैं, उतने ही दिनोंमें दूसरे अशौचकी भी - शुद्धि हो जाती है। किंतु प्रथम अशौच एक ही दिनका
verses.wordMeaning: This is the best alternative in the matter of giving Havya and Kmya. The Anukalpc? (next alternative) which is always practised by pious men should be known as follows:
verses.commentary: Sense: This is the best alternative in the matter of giving Havya and Kmya. The Anukalpc? (next alternative) which is always practised by pious men should be known as follows:

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे एकोनविंशो ऽध्यायः व्यास उवाच अथ श्राद्धममावास्यां प्राप्य कार्यं द्विजोत्तमैः । पिण्डान्वाहार्यकं भक्त्या भुक्तिमुक्तिफलप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge ekonaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ vyāsa uvāca atha śrāddhamamāvāsyāṃ prāpya kāryaṃ dvijottamaiḥ / piṇḍānvāhāryakaṃ bhaktyā bhuktimuktiphalapradam
verses.translation: One should (then) feed (one's) maternal grandfather/ maternal uncle, sisters' son, father-in-law, preceptor, daughter's son, a king, a kinsman, as well as a Rtvik and a Yajya (one on whose behalf a Yajna can be performed)
verses.hindi: अतीते सूतके प्रोक्तं सपिण्डानां त्रिरात्रकम्। तथेव मरणे स्नानमूर्ध्व॑ संवत्सराद् यदि
verses.wordMeaning: One should (then) feed (one's) maternal grandfather/ maternal uncle, sisters' son, father-in-law, preceptor, daughter's son, a king, a kinsman, as well as a Rtvik and a Yajya (one on whose behalf a Yajna can be performed)
verses.commentary: Sense: One should (then) feed (one's) maternal grandfather/ maternal uncle, sisters' son, father-in-law, preceptor, daughter's son, a king, a kinsman, as well as a Rtvik and a Yajya (one on whose behalf a Yajna can be performed)

verses.sanskrit: पिण्डान्वाहार्यकं श्राद्धं क्षीणे राजनि शस्यते । अपराह्ने द्विजातीनां प्रशस्तेनामिषेण च
verses.transliteration: piṇḍānvāhāryakaṃ śrāddhaṃ kṣīṇe rājani śasyate / aparāhne dvijātīnāṃ praśastenāmiṣeṇa ca
verses.translation: One should not feed a friend in the Sraddha. He should be pleased with wealth(?).Desire for Daksinasis demonic and is not conducive to any benefit either here or hereafter.
verses.hindi: वेदान्तविच्याधीयानो योऽग्िमान् वृत्तिकर्षितः। सद्यः शौचं भवेत् तस्य सर्वावस्थासु सर्वदा सपिण्डानां त्रिरात्रं स्यात् संस्कारे भर्तुरेव हि
verses.wordMeaning: One should not feed a friend in the Sraddha. He should be pleased with wealth(?).Desire for Daksinasis demonic and is not conducive to any benefit either here or hereafter.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not feed a friend in the Sraddha. He should be pleased with wealth(?).Desire for Daksinasis demonic and is not conducive to any benefit either here or hereafter.

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिपत्प्रभृति ह्यन्यास्तिथयः कृष्णपक्षके । चतुर्दशीं वर्जयित्वा प्रशस्ता ह्युत्तरोत्तराः
verses.transliteration: pratipatprabhṛti hyanyāstithayaḥ kṛṣṇapakṣake / caturdaśīṃ varjayitvā praśastā hyuttarottarāḥ
verses.translation: In case of non-availability of a suitable Brahmana one may very well feed and honour a friend but not an enemy, even though he may be learned and enlightened. The Havis partaken of by an enemy becomes futile after death.
verses.hindi: बचा हो तो तीन रातका आशौच होता है। मरणाशौचके मध्य जननाशौच होनेपर अथवा जननाशौचके बीचमें मरणाशौच आ जानेपर मरणाशौचके पूरा होनेपर ही शुद्धि होती है। यदि पूर्वका अशौच वृद्धिमद् (बड़ा गुरुतर)
verses.wordMeaning: In case of non-availability of a suitable Brahmana one may very well feed and honour a friend but not an enemy, even though he may be learned and enlightened. The Havis partaken of by an enemy becomes futile after death.
verses.commentary: Sense: In case of non-availability of a suitable Brahmana one may very well feed and honour a friend but not an enemy, even though he may be learned and enlightened. The Havis partaken of by an enemy becomes futile after death.

verses.sanskrit: अमावास्याष्टकास्तिस्त्रः पौषमासादिषु त्रिषु । तिस्त्रश्चान्वष्टकाः पुण्या माघी पञ्चदशी तथा
verses.transliteration: amāvāsyāṣṭakāstistraḥ pauṣamāsādiṣu triṣu / tistraścānvaṣṭakāḥ puṇyā māghī pañcadaśī tathā
verses.translation: A Brahmana who has not learned the Vedas becomes extinct like the fire of (dry) grass. Havya shall not be given unto him, ior Homa is not performed in the ashes indeed.
verses.hindi: अशौच हो तो पूर्वके अशौचकी शुद्धिसे ही दोनों अशौचोंकी शुद्धि होती है। यदि पाँचवीं रात्रि बीत जानेपर वृद्धिमद् अशौच हो तो दूसरे अशौचकी शुद्धि पूर्वके ही अशौचसे हो जाती है॥ २१--२४॥ देशान्तरमें गये हुएका जननाशौच या मरणाशौच- सम्बन्धी समाचार सुननेके बाद उतने समयतक संयम (अशौचके नियमका पालन) करना चाहिए जबतक शेष दिन समाप्त न हो जाय। (एक वर्षके भीतर)
verses.wordMeaning: A Brahmana who has not learned the Vedas becomes extinct like the fire of (dry) grass. Havya shall not be given unto him, ior Homa is not performed in the ashes indeed.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmana who has not learned the Vedas becomes extinct like the fire of (dry) grass. Havya shall not be given unto him, ior Homa is not performed in the ashes indeed.

verses.sanskrit: त्रयोदशी मघायुक्ता वर्षासु तु विशेषतः । शस्यापाकश्राद्धकाला नित्याः प्रोक्ता दिने दिने
verses.transliteration: trayodaśī maghāyuktā varṣāsu tu viśeṣataḥ / śasyāpākaśrāddhakālā nityāḥ proktā dine dine
verses.translation: Just as by sowing seeds in a barren land, the sower does not reap any fruit thereof, similarly, by offering Havis to one without Rk mantras (i.e. one who has not learned Rk mantras) one does not reap the fruit of that offer.
verses.hindi: व्यतीत हुए मरणाशौचका समाचार सुननेपर सपिण्डोंको तीन रातका अशौच होता है, उसी प्रकार एक वर्ष बीतनेके बाद समाचार मिलनेपर मरणाशौचमें स्नानमात्र करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: Just as by sowing seeds in a barren land, the sower does not reap any fruit thereof, similarly, by offering Havis to one without Rk mantras (i.e. one who has not learned Rk mantras) one does not reap the fruit of that offer.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as by sowing seeds in a barren land, the sower does not reap any fruit thereof, similarly, by offering Havis to one without Rk mantras (i.e. one who has not learned Rk mantras) one does not reap the fruit of that offer.

verses.sanskrit: नैमित्तिकं तु कर्तव्यं ग्रहणे चन्द्रसूर्ययोः । बान्धवानां च मरणे नारकी स्यादतो ऽन्यथा
verses.transliteration: naimittikaṃ tu kartavyaṃ grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ / bāndhavānāṃ ca maraṇe nārakī syādato 'nyathā
verses.translation: If a non-knower of Mantras partakes of food- oblations in Havya and Kavya (offered to gods and Pitfs), the performer of that Sraddhais compelled to swallow after death as many burning thick balls of iron (in number) as the rice- balls swallowed by that non-knower® (of mantras).
verses.hindi: वेदान्तको जाननेवाला (ब्रह्मनिष्ठ), अध्ययनकर्ता (गुरुकुलमें निवास करनेवाला ब्रह्मचारी), अग्निहोत्री तथा वृत्तिहीन लोगोंको सभी अवस्थाओंमें सदा सद्य: शौच होता है अविवाहित स्त्रियों (कन्याओं)-की पाणिग्रहणसे पूर्व मृत्यु होनेपर सपिण्डोंके निमित्त सदा तीन रातका अशौच होता है और विवाह-संस्कारके अनन्तर मृत्यु होनेपर केवल पति और पतिकुलमें अशौच होता है।
verses.wordMeaning: If a non-knower of Mantras partakes of food- oblations in Havya and Kavya (offered to gods and Pitfs), the performer of that Sraddhais compelled to swallow after death as many burning thick balls of iron (in number) as the rice- balls swallowed by that non-knower® (of mantras).
verses.commentary: Sense: If a non-knower of Mantras partakes of food- oblations in Havya and Kavya (offered to gods and Pitfs), the performer of that Sraddhais compelled to swallow after death as many burning thick balls of iron (in number) as the rice- balls swallowed by that non-knower® (of mantras).

verses.sanskrit: काम्यानि चैव श्राद्धानि शस्यान्ते ग्रहणादिषु । अयने विषुवे चैव व्यतीपाते ऽप्यनन्तकम्
verses.transliteration: kāmyāni caiva śrāddhāni śasyānte grahaṇādiṣu / ayane viṣuve caiva vyatīpāte 'pyanantakam
verses.translation: O Brahmana, that abode (place of sacrifice) becomes Asura (unholy and demonaic) where these base men of evil conduct partake of the Havya, though they may be endowed with the knowledge and birth in noble family.
verses.hindi: वाग्दानसे पूर्व कन्याओंकी मृत्यु होनेपर एक दिनका अशौच कहा गया है और दो वर्षसे कम अवस्थावाली कन्याके मरनेपर सद्य: शौच बताया गया है
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmana, that abode (place of sacrifice) becomes Asura (unholy and demonaic) where these base men of evil conduct partake of the Havya, though they may be endowed with the knowledge and birth in noble family.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmana, that abode (place of sacrifice) becomes Asura (unholy and demonaic) where these base men of evil conduct partake of the Havya, though they may be endowed with the knowledge and birth in noble family.

verses.sanskrit: संक्रान्त्यमक्षयं श्राद्धं तथा जन्मदिनेष्वपि । नक्षत्रेषु च सर्वेषु कार्यं काम्यं विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: saṃkrāntyamakṣayaṃ śrāddhaṃ tathā janmadineṣvapi / nakṣatreṣu ca sarveṣu kāryaṃ kāmyaṃ viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: * If the Vedas and Vedis (sacrificial platforms)are in disuse upto three generations, that person becomes an evil Brahmana; He never deserves invitation to feeding in Sraddhas* etc.
verses.hindi: आदन्तात् सोदरे सद्य आचौलादेकरात्रकम  आप्रदानात् त्रिरात्रं स्याद् दशरात्रमतः परम् एकोदकानां मरणे सूतके चैतदेव हि
verses.wordMeaning: * If the Vedas and Vedis (sacrificial platforms)are in disuse upto three generations, that person becomes an evil Brahmana; He never deserves invitation to feeding in Sraddhas* etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: * If the Vedas and Vedis (sacrificial platforms)are in disuse upto three generations, that person becomes an evil Brahmana; He never deserves invitation to feeding in Sraddhas* etc.

verses.sanskrit: स्वर्गं च लभते कृत्वा कृत्तिकासु द्विजोत्तमः । अपत्यमथ रोहिण्यां सौम्ये तु ब्रह्मवर्चसम्
verses.transliteration: svargaṃ ca labhate kṛtvā kṛttikāsu dvijottamaḥ / apatyamatha rohiṇyāṃ saumye tu brahmavarcasam
verses.translation: The person mentioned above, a servant of a Sudra,. a salaried attendant of the king, the sacrificial priest of Sudras, a person who sustains himself by killing and a person whose livelihood is imprisoning others—-these six are Brahmabandhus (not true Brahmanas—nominal Brahmanas).
verses.hindi: एकरात्रं समुद्दिष्टं गुरौ सब्रह्मचारिणि
verses.wordMeaning: The person mentioned above, a servant of a Sudra,. a salaried attendant of the king, the sacrificial priest of Sudras, a person who sustains himself by killing and a person whose livelihood is imprisoning others—-these six are Brahmabandhus (not true Brahmanas—nominal Brahmanas).
verses.commentary: Sense: The person mentioned above, a servant of a Sudra,. a salaried attendant of the king, the sacrificial priest of Sudras, a person who sustains himself by killing and a person whose livelihood is imprisoning others—-these six are Brahmabandhus (not true Brahmanas—nominal Brahmanas).

verses.sanskrit: रौद्राणां कर्मणां सिद्धिमार्द्रायां शौर्यमेव च । पुनर्वसौ तथा भूमिं श्रियं पुष्ये तथैव च
verses.transliteration: raudrāṇāṃ karmaṇāṃ siddhimārdrāyāṃ śauryameva ca / punarvasau tathā bhūmiṃ śriyaṃ puṣye tathaiva ca
verses.translation: (Defective verse) Manu says that they are fallen for the sake of wealth. These sellers of Vedas are not approved of for the Sraddha.
verses.hindi: गृहे मृतासु दत्तासु कन्यकासु त्र्यहं पितुः परपूर्वासु भार्यासु पुत्रेषु कृतकेषु च। त्रिरात्रं स्यात् तथाचार्ये स्वभार्यास्वन्यगासु च
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective verse) Manu says that they are fallen for the sake of wealth. These sellers of Vedas are not approved of for the Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective verse) Manu says that they are fallen for the sake of wealth. These sellers of Vedas are not approved of for the Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वान् कामांस्तथा सार्पे पित्र्ये सौभाग्यमेव च । अर्यम्णे तु धनं विन्द्यात् फाल्गुन्यां पापनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: sarvān kāmāṃstathā sārpe pitrye saubhāgyameva ca / aryamṇe tu dhanaṃ vindyāt phālgunyāṃ pāpanāśanam
verses.translation: Those who sell their sons, those who are born as sons of a remarried widow, those who perform the Yajnas of even ordinary persons—all these are spoken of as fallen ones.
verses.hindi: एकाहं स्यादुपाध्याये स्वग्रामे श्रोत्रियेऽपि च
verses.wordMeaning: Those who sell their sons, those who are born as sons of a remarried widow, those who perform the Yajnas of even ordinary persons—all these are spoken of as fallen ones.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who sell their sons, those who are born as sons of a remarried widow, those who perform the Yajnas of even ordinary persons—all these are spoken of as fallen ones.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञातिश्रैष्ठ्यं तथा हस्ते चित्रायां च बहून् सुतान् । वाणिज्यसिद्धिं स्वातौ तु विशाखासु सुवर्णकम्
verses.transliteration: jñātiśraiṣṭhyaṃ tathā haste citrāyāṃ ca bahūn sutān / vāṇijyasiddhiṃ svātau tu viśākhāsu suvarṇakam
verses.translation: Those teachers who are not cultured, those who read and teach Vedas for salary—are called fallen ones.
verses.hindi: एकाहं चास्ववर्ये स्यादेकरात्रं तदिष्यते त्रिरात्रं श्वश्रूमरणे श्वशुरे वै तदेव हि। सद्यः शौचं समुद्दिष्टं सगोत्रे संस्थिते सति
verses.wordMeaning: Those teachers who are not cultured, those who read and teach Vedas for salary—are called fallen ones.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those teachers who are not cultured, those who read and teach Vedas for salary—are called fallen ones.

verses.sanskrit: मैत्रे बहूनि मित्राणि राज्यं शाक्रे तथैव च । मूले कृषिं लभेद् यानसिद्धिमाप्ये समुद्रतः
verses.transliteration: maitre bahūni mitrāṇi rājyaṃ śākre tathaiva ca / mūle kṛṣiṃ labhed yānasiddhimāpye samudrataḥ
verses.translation: A Brahmana not belonging to any Asrama, or a non¬ performer of the prescribed duties of his own Asrama (stage of life) and who falsely poses as belonging to a particular Asrama— all these should be known as defilers of rows of people participat¬ ing in a feast.
verses.hindi: वैश्यः पञ्चदशाहेन शूद्रो मासेन शुध्यति
verses.wordMeaning: A Brahmana not belonging to any Asrama, or a non¬ performer of the prescribed duties of his own Asrama (stage of life) and who falsely poses as belonging to a particular Asrama— all these should be known as defilers of rows of people participat¬ ing in a feast.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmana not belonging to any Asrama, or a non¬ performer of the prescribed duties of his own Asrama (stage of life) and who falsely poses as belonging to a particular Asrama— all these should be known as defilers of rows of people participat¬ ing in a feast.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वान् कामान् वैश्वदेवे श्रैष्ठ्यं तु श्रवणे पुनः । श्रविष्ठायां तथा कामान् वारुणे च परं बलम्
verses.transliteration: sarvān kāmān vaiśvadeve śraiṣṭhyaṃ tu śravaṇe punaḥ / śraviṣṭhāyāṃ tathā kāmān vāruṇe ca paraṃ balam
verses.translation: The following are defilers of rows:—an ungrateful person, a back-biter, a ruthless person, an atheist, a person who censures the Vedas, a person injuring friends and a cheat.
verses.hindi: दाँत निकलनेसे पूर्व कन्याकी मृत्यु होनेपर सहोदर भाईको सद्य: शौच होता है और चूडाकरणके कालतक मृत्यु होनेपर एक रात्रिका अशोच होता है । कन्यादानके पूर्व (कन्याका मरण होनेपर) तीन रातका और विवाहके बाद मरण होनेपर दस रातका (पतिकुलमें) अशौच होता है
verses.wordMeaning: The following are defilers of rows:—an ungrateful person, a back-biter, a ruthless person, an atheist, a person who censures the Vedas, a person injuring friends and a cheat.
verses.commentary: Sense: The following are defilers of rows:—an ungrateful person, a back-biter, a ruthless person, an atheist, a person who censures the Vedas, a person injuring friends and a cheat.

verses.sanskrit: अजैकपादे कुप्यं स्यादहिर्बुध्ने गृहं शुभम् । रेवत्यां बहवो गावो ह्यश्विन्यां तुरगांस्तथा । याम्ये ऽथ जीवनं तत् स्याद्यदि श्राद्धं प्रयच्छति
verses.transliteration: ajaikapāde kupyaṃ syādahirbudhne gṛhaṃ śubham / revatyāṃ bahavo gāvo hyaśvinyāṃ turagāṃstathā / yāmye 'tha jīvanaṃ tat syādyadi śrāddhaṃ prayacchati
verses.translation: All these should not be fed (in a Sraddha). They cannot be given any gift in holy rites A murderer of a Brah- mana and a person who is accused should be avoided scrupulously.
verses.hindi: मातामहकी मृत्यु होनेपर (दोहित्रको) तीन रातका अशौच होता है । समानोदकोंके मरण या जन्ममें भी तीन रातका ही अशौच होता है। योनि-सम्बन्धवालों (भांजा, मामा, मौसी, बूआ-कुलके लोग आदि) तथा
verses.wordMeaning: All these should not be fed (in a Sraddha). They cannot be given any gift in holy rites A murderer of a Brah- mana and a person who is accused should be avoided scrupulously.
verses.commentary: Sense: All these should not be fed (in a Sraddha). They cannot be given any gift in holy rites A murderer of a Brah- mana and a person who is accused should be avoided scrupulously.

verses.sanskrit: आदित्यवारे त्वारोग्यं चन्द्रे सौभाग्यमेव च । कौजे सर्वत्र विजयं सर्वान् कामान् बुधस्य तु
verses.transliteration: ādityavāre tvārogyaṃ candre saubhāgyameva ca / kauje sarvatra vijayaṃ sarvān kāmān budhasya tu
verses.translation: A Brahmana who has fattened himself on the food and drink offered py Sudras and a person not performing Sandnya
verses.hindi: बान्धवोंकी मृत्यु होनेपर पक्षिणी (आगामी तथा वर्तमान दिनसे युक्त रात्रि)-तक अशौच होता है'। गुरु एवं सहपाठी (-के मरणमें) एक रात्रिका अशौच बतलाया गया है। जिस देशमें निवास करता हो, उस देशके राजाकी मृत्यु होनेपर सज्योतिकालतकका अशौच होता है और पिताके घरमें विवाहित कन्याकी मृत्यु होनेपर पिताको तीन रातका अशौच होता है। पूर्वमें अन्यको भार्या रहनेवाली स्त्री, उसके पुत्र तथा कृत्रिम पुत्रके
verses.wordMeaning: A Brahmana who has fattened himself on the food and drink offered py Sudras and a person not performing Sandnya
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmana who has fattened himself on the food and drink offered py Sudras and a person not performing Sandnya

verses.sanskrit: विद्यामभीष्टा जीवे तु धनं वै भार्गवे पुनः । शमैश्वरे लभेदायुः प्रतिपत्सु सुतान् शुभान्
verses.transliteration: vidyāmabhīṣṭā jīve tu dhanaṃ vai bhārgave punaḥ / śamaiśvare labhedāyuḥ pratipatsu sutān śubhān
verses.translation: ABrahmana who destroys what he has learned, one devoid of an ablution and charitable gifts and a Brahmana with predominance of Tamas and Rajas Gunas—all of these are defilers of rows.
verses.hindi: मरणमें तीन रातका आशौच होता है। इसी प्रकार आचार्यके मरणमें भी तीन रातका आशौच होता है। गुरुपुत्र तथा गुरुपत्रीका एक अहोरात्रका और उपाध्याय तथा अपने ग्राममें श्रोत्रियकी मृत्यु होनेपर भी एक
verses.wordMeaning: ABrahmana who destroys what he has learned, one devoid of an ablution and charitable gifts and a Brahmana with predominance of Tamas and Rajas Gunas—all of these are defilers of rows.
verses.commentary: Sense: ABrahmana who destroys what he has learned, one devoid of an ablution and charitable gifts and a Brahmana with predominance of Tamas and Rajas Gunas—all of these are defilers of rows.

verses.sanskrit: कन्यकां वै द्वितीयायां तृतीयायां तु वन्दिनः । पशून्क्षुद्रांश्चतुर्थ्यां तु पञ्चम्यांशोभनान् सुतान्
verses.transliteration: kanyakāṃ vai dvitīyāyāṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ tu vandinaḥ / paśūnkṣudrāṃścaturthyāṃ tu pañcamyāṃśobhanān sutān
verses.translation: Of what use is an expiation beyond limit. Those who do not perform the enjoined duties but perform those acts which are forbidden are to be scrupulously avoided in the Sraddha.
verses.hindi: दिनका आशौच होता है॥ ३१--३५॥ अपने घरमें रहनेवाले असपिण्डीकी मृत्यु होनेपर तीन रातका अशौच होता है और अपने घरमें (स्वेच्छासे रहनेवाले) अन्य किसी व्यक्तिकी मृत्यु होनेपर एक दिनका अशौच होता है। सास एवं ससुरके मरनेपर
verses.wordMeaning: Of what use is an expiation beyond limit. Those who do not perform the enjoined duties but perform those acts which are forbidden are to be scrupulously avoided in the Sraddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Of what use is an expiation beyond limit. Those who do not perform the enjoined duties but perform those acts which are forbidden are to be scrupulously avoided in the Sraddha.

verses.sanskrit: षष्ट्यां द्यूतं कृषिं चापि सप्तम्यां लभते नरः । अष्टम्यामपि वाणिज्यं लभते श्राद्धदः सदा
verses.transliteration: ṣaṣṭyāṃ dyūtaṃ kṛṣiṃ cāpi saptamyāṃ labhate naraḥ / aṣṭamyāmapi vāṇijyaṃ labhate śrāddhadaḥ sadā
verses.translation: VV. 98-100 refer to sons having two fathers: 'Though Niyoga is now an obsolete custom, the injunction regarding Pinda-dana giving priority to the procreator (4yin) first and to the Ksetrin (mother's husband) next is supported by Harita:
verses.hindi: तीन रातका और अपने घरमें स्थित रहनेवाले सगोत्रके मरणमें सद्य: शौच कहा गया है। ब्राह्मणको शुद्धि दस दिनमें, क्षत्रियकी बारह दिनमें, वैश्यकी पंद्रह दिनमें और शूद्रकी एक माहमें शुद्धि होती है। ब्राह्मणद्वारा
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 98-100 refer to sons having two fathers: 'Though Niyoga is now an obsolete custom, the injunction regarding Pinda-dana giving priority to the procreator (4yin) first and to the Ksetrin (mother's husband) next is supported by Harita:
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 98-100 refer to sons having two fathers: 'Though Niyoga is now an obsolete custom, the injunction regarding Pinda-dana giving priority to the procreator (4yin) first and to the Ksetrin (mother's husband) next is supported by Harita:

verses.sanskrit: स्यान्नवम्यामेकखुरं दशम्यां द्विखुरं बहु । एकादश्यां तथा रूप्यं ब्रह्मवर्चस्विनः सुतान्
verses.transliteration: syānnavamyāmekakhuraṃ daśamyāṃ dvikhuraṃ bahu / ekādaśyāṃ tathā rūpyaṃ brahmavarcasvinaḥ sutān
verses.translation: About the religious restrictions on the inviter and the invitee to Sraddha cf. Laghu Sankha Smr.
verses.hindi: क्षत्राणी, वैश्या और शूद्रासे उत्पन्न बान्धवोंकी मृत्यु होनेपर ब्राह्मणकी शुद्धि दस दिनोंमें होती है १-सातवीं परम्परासे चौदहवीं परम्परातकके लोग समानोदक होते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: About the religious restrictions on the inviter and the invitee to Sraddha cf. Laghu Sankha Smr.
verses.commentary: Sense: About the religious restrictions on the inviter and the invitee to Sraddha cf. Laghu Sankha Smr.

verses.sanskrit: द्वादश्यां जातरूपं च रजतं कुप्यमेव च । ज्ञातिश्रैष्ठ्यं त्रयोदश्यां चतुर्दश्यां तु क्रुप्रजाः । पञ्चदश्यां सर्वकामानाप्नोति श्राद्धदः सदा
verses.transliteration: dvādaśyāṃ jātarūpaṃ ca rajataṃ kupyameva ca / jñātiśraiṣṭhyaṃ trayodaśyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ tu kruprajāḥ / pañcadaśyāṃ sarvakāmānāpnoti śrāddhadaḥ sadā
verses.translation: Cf. Mt. 17-20; Prajapati Smr. 63.
verses.hindi: २-इस प्रसंगमें यह विवेक है-दिनमें मरण होनेपर वह दिन उसके बादकी रात्रि, उसके बाद दूसरे दिन नकषत्रदर्शनतक अशौच होगा। रात्रिमें मरण होनेपर वह रात्रि बादका दिन पुनः उसके यादकी रात्रिक पक्षिणी माना जायगा और तबतक अशौच होगा।
verses.wordMeaning: Cf. Mt. 17-20; Prajapati Smr. 63.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. Mt. 17-20; Prajapati Smr. 63.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माच्छ्राद्धं न कर्तव्यं चतुर्दश्यां द्विजातिभिः । शस्त्रेण तु हतानां वै तत्र श्राद्धं प्रकल्पयेत्
verses.transliteration: tasmācchrāddhaṃ na kartavyaṃ caturdaśyāṃ dvijātibhiḥ / śastreṇa tu hatānāṃ vai tatra śrāddhaṃ prakalpayet
verses.translation: The Pitrs take food along with those Brahmanas, though they (themselves) are in firmament. They remain in their airy state. After taking food, they attain their greatest goal.
verses.hindi: ३-दिनमें मरण होनेपर रात्रिमें स्तानसे शुद्धि और रात्रिमें मरण होनेपर दिनमें स्नानसे शुद्धि यही 'सज्योतिकाल' से अशौचमें शुद्धिका अर्थ है।
verses.wordMeaning: The Pitrs take food along with those Brahmanas, though they (themselves) are in firmament. They remain in their airy state. After taking food, they attain their greatest goal.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Pitrs take food along with those Brahmanas, though they (themselves) are in firmament. They remain in their airy state. After taking food, they attain their greatest goal.

verses.sanskrit: द्रव्यब्राह्मणसंपत्तौ न कालनियमः कृतः । तस्माद् भोगापवर्गार्थं श्राद्धं कुर्युर्द्विजातयः
verses.transliteration: dravyabrāhmaṇasaṃpattau na kālaniyamaḥ kṛtaḥ / tasmād bhogāpavargārthaṃ śrāddhaṃ kuryurdvijātayaḥ
verses.translation: The Brahmanas who have been invited shall invariab¬ ly observe celibacy, be self-controlled when the time for the Sraddha has arrived.
verses.hindi: षड्रात्रं वा त्रिरात्रं स्यादेकरात्रं क्रमेण हि। वैश्यक्षत्रियविप्राणां शूद्रेष्वाशौचमेव तु
verses.wordMeaning: The Brahmanas who have been invited shall invariab¬ ly observe celibacy, be self-controlled when the time for the Sraddha has arrived.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Brahmanas who have been invited shall invariab¬ ly observe celibacy, be self-controlled when the time for the Sraddha has arrived.

verses.sanskrit: कर्मारम्भेषु सर्वेषु कुर्यादाभ्युदयं पुनः । पुत्रजन्मादिषु श्राद्धं पार्वणं पर्वणि स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: karmārambheṣu sarveṣu kuryādābhyudayaṃ punaḥ / putrajanmādiṣu śrāddhaṃ pārvaṇaṃ parvaṇi smṛtam
verses.translation: The person who performs Sraddha must certainly avoid anger, hurry, carelessness; should speak the truth and have concentration ofthe mind, refrain from carrying heavy weight, sexual intercourse and long journey.
verses.hindi: अनदन्नन्नमह्वैव न च तस्मिन् गृहे वसेत् सोदकेष्वेतदेव स्यान्मातुराप्तेषु बन्धुषु। दशाहेन शवस्पर्शे सपिण्डश्चैव शुध्यति
verses.wordMeaning: The person who performs Sraddha must certainly avoid anger, hurry, carelessness; should speak the truth and have concentration ofthe mind, refrain from carrying heavy weight, sexual intercourse and long journey.
verses.commentary: Sense: The person who performs Sraddha must certainly avoid anger, hurry, carelessness; should speak the truth and have concentration ofthe mind, refrain from carrying heavy weight, sexual intercourse and long journey.

verses.sanskrit: अहन्यहनि नित्यं स्यात् काम्यं नैमित्तिकं पुनः । एकोद्दिष्टादि विज्ञेयं वृद्धिश्राद्धं तु पार्वणम्
verses.transliteration: ahanyahani nityaṃ syāt kāmyaṃ naimittikaṃ punaḥ / ekoddiṣṭādi vijñeyaṃ vṛddhiśrāddhaṃ tu pārvaṇam
verses.translation: If a Brahmana, invited by one accepts the invitation of another, he falls into the terrible hell and becomes a pig.
verses.hindi: अर्धमासेन वैश्यस्तु शूद्रो मासेन शुध्यति। षड्रात्रेणाथवा सर्वे त्रिरात्रेणाथवा पुनः
verses.wordMeaning: If a Brahmana, invited by one accepts the invitation of another, he falls into the terrible hell and becomes a pig.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a Brahmana, invited by one accepts the invitation of another, he falls into the terrible hell and becomes a pig.

verses.sanskrit: एतत् पञ्चविधं श्राद्धं मनुना परिकीर्तितम् । यात्रायां षष्ठमाख्यातं तत्प्रयत्नेन पालयेत्
verses.transliteration: etat pañcavidhaṃ śrāddhaṃ manunā parikīrtitam / yātrāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhamākhyātaṃ tatprayatnena pālayet
verses.translation: If the Brahmana (householder), after inviting one Brahmana for the Sraddha invites another also out of delusion he is a greater sinner. He is reborn as a worm in the faeces.
verses.hindi: क्षत्रिय और वैश्यको भी हीनवर्णकी स््त्रियोंसे उत्पन्न बान्धवोंकी मृत्यु होनेपर पूर्ण शुद्धिके लिये अपने वर्णके अनुसार विहित शौच-विधिका पालन करना चाहिए सभी वर्णके व्यक्तियोंको उत्तर वर्णके लिये विहित अशौचका आदरपूर्वक पालन करना चाहिए। किंतु अपने वर्णकी स्त्रीसे उत्पन्न बन्धुकी मृत्यु होनेपर अपने ही वर्णके अनुसार अशौचका पालन करना चाहिए।
verses.wordMeaning: If the Brahmana (householder), after inviting one Brahmana for the Sraddha invites another also out of delusion he is a greater sinner. He is reborn as a worm in the faeces.
verses.commentary: Sense: If the Brahmana (householder), after inviting one Brahmana for the Sraddha invites another also out of delusion he is a greater sinner. He is reborn as a worm in the faeces.

verses.sanskrit: शुद्धये सप्तमं श्राद्धं ब्रह्मणा परिभाषितम् । दैविकं चाष्टमं श्राद्धं यत्कृत्वा मुच्यते भयात्
verses.transliteration: śuddhaye saptamaṃ śrāddhaṃ brahmaṇā paribhāṣitam / daivikaṃ cāṣṭamaṃ śrāddhaṃ yatkṛtvā mucyate bhayāt
verses.translation: If a Brahmana invited for partaking of the Sraddha indulges in sexual intercourse, he incurs the sin of a Brahmana- slaughter. He is reborn as an animal.
verses.hindi: शूद्र सपिण्डकी मृत्यु या जन्म होनेपर वैश्य, क्षत्रिय तथा ब्राह्मणोंको क्रमानुसार छः रात, तीन रात और एक रातका आशौच होता है । द्विजश्रेष्ठो! वैश्य सपिण्डके जन्म या मृत्युपर शूद्र, क्षत्रिय और ब्राह्मणोंको क्रमशः
verses.wordMeaning: If a Brahmana invited for partaking of the Sraddha indulges in sexual intercourse, he incurs the sin of a Brahmana- slaughter. He is reborn as an animal.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a Brahmana invited for partaking of the Sraddha indulges in sexual intercourse, he incurs the sin of a Brahmana- slaughter. He is reborn as an animal.

verses.sanskrit: संध्यारात्र्योर्न कर्तव्यं राहोरन्यत्र दर्शनात् । देशानां च विशेषेण भवेत् पुण्यमनन्तकम्
verses.transliteration: saṃdhyārātryorna kartavyaṃ rāhoranyatra darśanāt / deśānāṃ ca viśeṣeṇa bhavet puṇyamanantakam
verses.translation: If a Brahmana invited for a Sraddha (accepts the invitation and) goes on a journey, the Pitrs of the wicked Brahmana subsist on sinful food that month.
verses.hindi: आधे मास, छः रात तथा तीन रातका आशौच होता है। द्विजश्रेष्ठो ! क्षत्रिय सपिण्डके जन्म या मरणमें क्रमश: ब्राह्मणको छ: दिन और वैश्य तथा शूद्रको दस दिनोंका अशौच होता है। ब्रह्माजीने कहा है कि ब्राह्मण (सपिण्ड)-का (जन्म-मरण होनेपर) शूद्र, वैश्य तथा क्षत्रियकी शुद्धि दस रातमें होती है॥ ४१--४५॥
verses.wordMeaning: If a Brahmana invited for a Sraddha (accepts the invitation and) goes on a journey, the Pitrs of the wicked Brahmana subsist on sinful food that month.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a Brahmana invited for a Sraddha (accepts the invitation and) goes on a journey, the Pitrs of the wicked Brahmana subsist on sinful food that month.

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गायामक्षयं श्राद्धं प्रयागे ऽमरकण्टके । गायन्ति पितरो गाथां कीर्तयन्ति मनीषिणः
verses.transliteration: gaṅgāyāmakṣayaṃ śrāddhaṃ prayāge 'marakaṇṭake / gāyanti pitaro gāthāṃ kīrtayanti manīṣiṇaḥ
verses.translation: If a Brahmana, invited for a Sraddha were to quarrel, the Pitrs of that Brahmana become the eaters of filth that month.
verses.hindi: असपिण्ड द्विजको मृत्यु होनेपर बन्धुवत् उसके प्रेतकर्ममें सम्मिलित होकर भोजन एवं निवास करनेवाला ब्राह्मण दस रातमें शुद्ध होता है। मृत व्यक्तिके यहाँ भोजन करनेपर तीन रातमें शुद्धि होती है। अन्न न
verses.wordMeaning: If a Brahmana, invited for a Sraddha were to quarrel, the Pitrs of that Brahmana become the eaters of filth that month.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a Brahmana, invited for a Sraddha were to quarrel, the Pitrs of that Brahmana become the eaters of filth that month.

verses.sanskrit: एष्टव्या बहवः पुत्राः शीलवन्तो गुणान्विताः । तेषां तु समवेतानां यद्येको ऽपि गायां व्रजेत्
verses.transliteration: eṣṭavyā bahavaḥ putrāḥ śīlavanto guṇānvitāḥ / teṣāṃ tu samavetānāṃ yadyeko 'pi gāyāṃ vrajet
verses.translation: Hence, the Brahmana invitee for a Sraddha should control himself, be free from anger and devoted to cleanliness. The performer (of the Sraddhd) also shall be one who has conquered his sense-organs.
verses.hindi: खानेवालेकी उसी दिन शुद्धि हो जाती है, परंतु उसके घरमें निवास नहीं करना चाहिए। समानोदक तथा माताके श्रेष्ठ बान्धवोंके मरणमें शव वहन करनेवाला सपिण्ड व्यक्ति दस दिनोंमें शुद्ध होता है। यदि कोई व्यक्ति लोभके वशीभूत हो शवको ढोता है तो वह यदि ब्राह्मण है तो दस दिनोंमें, क्षत्रिय है तो बारह दिनोंमें, वैश्य है तो आधे मासमें और शूद्र है तो एक मासमें शुद्ध होता है अथवा सभी वर्णके व्यक्ति छः
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, the Brahmana invitee for a Sraddha should control himself, be free from anger and devoted to cleanliness. The performer (of the Sraddhd) also shall be one who has conquered his sense-organs.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, the Brahmana invitee for a Sraddha should control himself, be free from anger and devoted to cleanliness. The performer (of the Sraddhd) also shall be one who has conquered his sense-organs.

verses.sanskrit: गयां प्राप्यानुषङ्गेण यदि श्राद्धं समाचरेत् । तारिताः पितरस्तेन स याति परमां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: gayāṃ prāpyānuṣaṅgeṇa yadi śrāddhaṃ samācaret / tāritāḥ pitarastena sa yāti paramāṃ gatim
verses.translation: (Defective verse). On the morning of the next day (i.e. on the Sraddha day) he should go in the southern direction and with great concentration bring the Kusa grass alongwith their roots, and (he shall place them) with their tips to the South and water (?). They shall be clean.
verses.hindi: रात या तीन रातमें शुद्ध हो जाते हैं॥४६--५० ॥
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective verse). On the morning of the next day (i.e. on the Sraddha day) he should go in the southern direction and with great concentration bring the Kusa grass alongwith their roots, and (he shall place them) with their tips to the South and water (?). They shall be clean.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective verse). On the morning of the next day (i.e. on the Sraddha day) he should go in the southern direction and with great concentration bring the Kusa grass alongwith their roots, and (he shall place them) with their tips to the South and water (?). They shall be clean.

verses.sanskrit: वराहपर्वते चैव गङ्गायां वै विशेषतः । वाराणस्यां विशेषेण यत्र देवः स्वयं हरः
verses.transliteration: varāhaparvate caiva gaṅgāyāṃ vai viśeṣataḥ / vārāṇasyāṃ viśeṣeṇa yatra devaḥ svayaṃ haraḥ
verses.translation: He shall select a clean isolated spot of all auspici¬ ous characteristics. It shall be smooth and sloping towards the South. He shall scrub it and smear cowdung over it.
verses.hindi: धनहीन अनाथ ब्राह्मणके शवका वहन आदि कर्म करनेवाले ब्राह्मणादि स्नान करके घृतका प्राशन करनेसे शुद्ध हो जाते हैँ १-यह अन्य युग-विषयक है। अपने वर्णसे इतर वर्णमें विवाह कलियुगमें सर्वथा निषिद्ध है । २-यह अशौचकी व्यवस्था घनिष्ठ सम्पर्क, एक साथ रहने अथवा परस्पर ठपकार्य-उपकारक-भाव रहनेपर है।
verses.wordMeaning: He shall select a clean isolated spot of all auspici¬ ous characteristics. It shall be smooth and sloping towards the South. He shall scrub it and smear cowdung over it.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall select a clean isolated spot of all auspici¬ ous characteristics. It shall be smooth and sloping towards the South. He shall scrub it and smear cowdung over it.

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गाद्वारे प्रभासे च बिल्वके नीलपर्वते । कुरुक्षेत्रे च कुब्जाम्रे भृगुतुङ्गे महालये
verses.transliteration: gaṅgādvāre prabhāse ca bilvake nīlaparvate / kurukṣetre ca kubjāmre bhṛgutuṅge mahālaye
verses.translation: The Pitrs are always delighted with the Sraddha offered in holy centres, on the banks of the rivers, on his plot of land in isolated places but not in waters.
verses.hindi: प्रेतीभूतं द्विजं विप्रो योऽनुगच्छेत कामत: । स्नात्वा सचेलं स्पृष्टाग्निं घृतं प्राश्य विशुध्यति
verses.wordMeaning: The Pitrs are always delighted with the Sraddha offered in holy centres, on the banks of the rivers, on his plot of land in isolated places but not in waters.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Pitrs are always delighted with the Sraddha offered in holy centres, on the banks of the rivers, on his plot of land in isolated places but not in waters.

verses.sanskrit: केदारे फल्गुतीर्थे च नैमिषारण्य एव च । सरस्वत्यां विशेषेण पुष्करेषु विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: kedāre phalgutīrthe ca naimiṣāraṇya eva ca / sarasvatyāṃ viśeṣeṇa puṣkareṣu viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: One shall never perform Sraddhas in a plot of land belonging to others. What is done by men may be obstructed by the owner out of delusion.
verses.hindi: एकाहात् क्षत्रिये शुद्धिवेश्ये स्याच्य द्व्यहेन तु। शूद्रे दिनत्रयं प्रोक्तं प्राणायामशतं पुनः त्रिरात्रं स्यात् तथाशौचमेकाहं त्वन्यथा स्मृतम्
verses.wordMeaning: One shall never perform Sraddhas in a plot of land belonging to others. What is done by men may be obstructed by the owner out of delusion.
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall never perform Sraddhas in a plot of land belonging to others. What is done by men may be obstructed by the owner out of delusion.

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदायां कुशावर्ते श्रीशैले भद्रकर्णके । वेत्रवत्यां विपाशायां गोदावर्यां विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: narmadāyāṃ kuśāvarte śrīśaile bhadrakarṇake / vetravatyāṃ vipāśāyāṃ godāvaryāṃ viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: Forests, mountains, sacred holy centres and shrines —they say that these are without owners. No one can claim these as theirs.
verses.hindi: अस्थिसंचयनादर्वागेकाहं क्षत्रवैश्ययोः । अन्यथा चैव सज्योतिर्ब्राह्मणे स्नानमेव तु
verses.wordMeaning: Forests, mountains, sacred holy centres and shrines —they say that these are without owners. No one can claim these as theirs.
verses.commentary: Sense: Forests, mountains, sacred holy centres and shrines —they say that these are without owners. No one can claim these as theirs.

verses.sanskrit: एवमादिषु चान्येषु तीर्थेषु पुलिनेषु च । नदीनां चैव तीरेषु तुष्यन्ति पितरः सदा
verses.transliteration: evamādiṣu cānyeṣu tīrtheṣu pulineṣu ca / nadīnāṃ caiva tīreṣu tuṣyanti pitaraḥ sadā
verses.translation: (Defective verse). He shall scatter gingelly seeds there all round, but see that theydo not grow (i.e. germinate?) A Sraddha affected by the Asuras becomes purified through the gingelly seeds if they do not germinate.
verses.hindi: यस्तेषामन्नमश्नाति सकृदेवापि कामतः। तदाशौचे निवृत्तेऽसौ स्त्रानं कृत्वा विशुध्यति तावन्त्यहान्यशौचं स्यात् प्रायश्चित्तं ततश्चरेत्
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective verse). He shall scatter gingelly seeds there all round, but see that theydo not grow (i.e. germinate?) A Sraddha affected by the Asuras becomes purified through the gingelly seeds if they do not germinate.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective verse). He shall scatter gingelly seeds there all round, but see that theydo not grow (i.e. germinate?) A Sraddha affected by the Asuras becomes purified through the gingelly seeds if they do not germinate.

verses.sanskrit: व्रीहिभिश्च यवैर्माषैरद्भिर्मूलफलेन वा । श्यामाकैश्च यवैः शाकैर्नोवारैश्च प्रियङ्गुभिः । गौधूमैश्च तिलैर्मुद्गैर्मासं प्रीणयते पितॄन्
verses.transliteration: vrīhibhiśca yavairmāṣairadbhirmūlaphalena vā / śyāmākaiśca yavaiḥ śākairnovāraiśca priyaṅgubhiḥ / gaudhūmaiśca tilairmudgairmāsaṃ prīṇayate pitṝn
verses.translation: (Defective verse). He shall scatter gingelly seeds there all round, but see that theydo not grow (i.e. germinate?) A Sraddha affected by the Asuras becomes purified through the gingelly seeds if they do not germinate.
verses.hindi: दाहाद्यशौचं कर्तव्यं द्विजानामग्निहोत्रिणाम्। सपिण्डानां तु मरणे मरणादितरेषु च
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective verse). He shall scatter gingelly seeds there all round, but see that theydo not grow (i.e. germinate?) A Sraddha affected by the Asuras becomes purified through the gingelly seeds if they do not germinate.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective verse). He shall scatter gingelly seeds there all round, but see that theydo not grow (i.e. germinate?) A Sraddha affected by the Asuras becomes purified through the gingelly seeds if they do not germinate.

verses.sanskrit: आम्रान् पाने रतानिक्षून् मृद्वीकांश्च सदाडिमान् । विदार्याश्च भरण्डाश्च श्राद्धकाले प्रादपयेत्
verses.transliteration: āmrān pāne ratānikṣūn mṛdvīkāṃśca sadāḍimān / vidāryāśca bharaṇḍāśca śrāddhakāle prādapayet
verses.translation: (Defective verse). He shall scatter gingelly seeds there all round, but see that theydo not grow (i.e. germinate?) A Sraddha affected by the Asuras becomes purified through the gingelly seeds if they do not germinate.
verses.hindi: स्नेहवश यदि हीनवर्णके व्यक्ति उच्च वर्णके शवका और उच्च वर्णके व्यक्ति हीनवर्णके शवका स्पर्श करते हैं तो वे उस मृतवर्णके निर्धारित अशौच (नियमपालन)- से शुद्ध होते हैं। यदि ब्राह्मण अपनी इच्छासे मरे हुए द्विजका अनुगमन करता है (शब-यात्रामें जाता है) तो वह सस्त्रसहित स्नानकर, अग्निका स्पर्श करके घृतका प्राशन करनेसे शुद्ध हो जाता है । (द्विजके शवका अनुगमन करनेपर) क्षत्रियकी शुद्धि एक दिनमें, वैश्यकी
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective verse). He shall scatter gingelly seeds there all round, but see that theydo not grow (i.e. germinate?) A Sraddha affected by the Asuras becomes purified through the gingelly seeds if they do not germinate.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective verse). He shall scatter gingelly seeds there all round, but see that theydo not grow (i.e. germinate?) A Sraddha affected by the Asuras becomes purified through the gingelly seeds if they do not germinate.

verses.sanskrit: लाजान् मधुयुतान् दद्यात् सक्तून् शर्करया सह । दद्याच्छ्राद्धे प्रयत्नेन शृङ्गाटककशेरुकान्
verses.transliteration: lājān madhuyutān dadyāt saktūn śarkarayā saha / dadyācchrāddhe prayatnena śṛṅgāṭakakaśerukān
verses.translation: (Defective verse). He shall scatter gingelly seeds there all round, but see that theydo not grow (i.e. germinate?) A Sraddha affected by the Asuras becomes purified through the gingelly seeds if they do not germinate.
verses.hindi: दो दिनमें, शूद्रकी तीन दिनोंमें कही गयी है। (अशौचके दिन बीतनेके बाद) सौ बार प्राणायाम (भी शुद्धिके लिये) करना चाहिए॥ ५२--५४॥
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective verse). He shall scatter gingelly seeds there all round, but see that theydo not grow (i.e. germinate?) A Sraddha affected by the Asuras becomes purified through the gingelly seeds if they do not germinate.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective verse). He shall scatter gingelly seeds there all round, but see that theydo not grow (i.e. germinate?) A Sraddha affected by the Asuras becomes purified through the gingelly seeds if they do not germinate.

verses.sanskrit: द्वौ मासौ मत्स्यमांसेन त्रीन् मासान् हारिणेनतु । औरभ्रेणाथ चतुरः शाकुनेनेह पञ्च तु
verses.transliteration: dvau māsau matsyamāṃsena trīn māsān hāriṇenatu / aurabhreṇātha caturaḥ śākuneneha pañca tu
verses.translation: (Defective verse). He shall scatter gingelly seeds there all round, but see that theydo not grow (i.e. germinate?) A Sraddha affected by the Asuras becomes purified through the gingelly seeds if they do not germinate.
verses.hindi: शूद्रके अस्थिसंचय होनेसे पहले यदि ब्राह्मण उसके स्वजनोंके साथ विलाप करता है तो उसे तीन रातका अशौच होता है, इसके विपरीत (अस्थि-संचयनतक प्रेतकर्म हो जानेके अनन्तर यदि शूद्रका मरण जानकर ब्राह्मण उसके बान्धवोंके साथ विलाप करता है, उनका स्पर्श करता है तो उसे) एक दिनका अशौच होता है। अस्थिसंचयके पूर्व (शूद्रके घर विलाप करनेवाले) क्षत्रिय एवं वैश्यको एक दिनका और अन्य अवस्थामें
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective verse). He shall scatter gingelly seeds there all round, but see that theydo not grow (i.e. germinate?) A Sraddha affected by the Asuras becomes purified through the gingelly seeds if they do not germinate.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective verse). He shall scatter gingelly seeds there all round, but see that theydo not grow (i.e. germinate?) A Sraddha affected by the Asuras becomes purified through the gingelly seeds if they do not germinate.

verses.sanskrit: षण्मासांश्छागमांसेन पार्षतेनाथ सप्त वै । अष्टावेणस्य मांसेन रौरवेण नवैव तु
verses.transliteration: ṣaṇmāsāṃśchāgamāṃsena pārṣatenātha sapta vai / aṣṭāveṇasya māṃsena rauraveṇa navaiva tu
verses.translation: (Defective verse). He shall scatter gingelly seeds there all round, but see that theydo not grow (i.e. germinate?) A Sraddha affected by the Asuras becomes purified through the gingelly seeds if they do not germinate.
verses.hindi: सज्योति(काल)-तकका आशौच होता है। ब्राह्मणको स्नानमात्रसे शुद्धि होती है। ब्राह्मणके अस्थिसंचयके पूर्व
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective verse). He shall scatter gingelly seeds there all round, but see that theydo not grow (i.e. germinate?) A Sraddha affected by the Asuras becomes purified through the gingelly seeds if they do not germinate.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective verse). He shall scatter gingelly seeds there all round, but see that theydo not grow (i.e. germinate?) A Sraddha affected by the Asuras becomes purified through the gingelly seeds if they do not germinate.

verses.sanskrit: दशमासांस्तु तृप्यन्ति वराहमहिषामिषैः । शशकूर्मर्योर्मांसेन मासानेकादशैव तु
verses.transliteration: daśamāsāṃstu tṛpyanti varāhamahiṣāmiṣaiḥ / śaśakūrmaryormāṃsena māsānekādaśaiva tu
verses.translation: (Defective verse). He shall scatter gingelly seeds there all round, but see that theydo not grow (i.e. germinate?) A Sraddha affected by the Asuras becomes purified through the gingelly seeds if they do not germinate.
verses.hindi: है तो वस्त्रोंसहित स्नानमात्रसे उसकी शुद्धि हो जाती है, इसमें संदेह नहीं॥ ५५--५७॥ आशौचीजनोंके साथ जो भोजन तथा शयन आदि करता है, वह चाहे बान्धव हो या कोई दूसरा, दस दिनमें शुद्ध होता है। जो इच्छापूर्वक उनका एक बार भी अन्न ग्रहण करता है तो वह अशौच पूरा होनेपर
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective verse). He shall scatter gingelly seeds there all round, but see that theydo not grow (i.e. germinate?) A Sraddha affected by the Asuras becomes purified through the gingelly seeds if they do not germinate.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective verse). He shall scatter gingelly seeds there all round, but see that theydo not grow (i.e. germinate?) A Sraddha affected by the Asuras becomes purified through the gingelly seeds if they do not germinate.

verses.sanskrit: संवत्सरं तु गव्येन पयसा पायसेन तु । वार्ध्रोणसस्य मांसेन तृप्तिर्द्वादशवार्षिकी
verses.transliteration: saṃvatsaraṃ tu gavyena payasā pāyasena tu / vārdhroṇasasya māṃsena tṛptirdvādaśavārṣikī
verses.translation: (Defective verse). He shall scatter gingelly seeds there all round, but see that theydo not grow (i.e. germinate?) A Sraddha affected by the Asuras becomes purified through the gingelly seeds if they do not germinate.
verses.hindi: स्नान करनेसे शुद्ध हो जाता है । दुर्भिक्षसे पीडित व्यक्ति जितने दिनतक उस (अशौची)-का अन्न ग्रहण करता है, उतने दिनोंतकका उसे अशौच होता है, तदनन्तर उसे प्रायश्चित्त करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective verse). He shall scatter gingelly seeds there all round, but see that theydo not grow (i.e. germinate?) A Sraddha affected by the Asuras becomes purified through the gingelly seeds if they do not germinate.
