verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective verse). He shall scatter gingelly seeds there all round, but see that theydo not grow (i.e. germinate?) A Sraddha affected by the Asuras becomes purified through the gingelly seeds if they do not germinate.

verses.sanskrit: कालशाकं महाशल्कं खङ्गलोहामिषं मधु । आनन्त्यायैव कल्पन्ते मुन्यन्नानि च सर्वशः
verses.transliteration: kālaśākaṃ mahāśalkaṃ khaṅgalohāmiṣaṃ madhu / ānantyāyaiva kalpante munyannāni ca sarvaśaḥ
verses.translation: (Defective verse). He shall scatter gingelly seeds there all round, but see that theydo not grow (i.e. germinate?) A Sraddha affected by the Asuras becomes purified through the gingelly seeds if they do not germinate.
verses.hindi: अग्निहोत्री द्विजोंका दाह-कालसे अशौच आरम्भ होता है, अतः (तभीसे इनके मरणके निमित्त) नियमका पालन करना चाहिए। सपिण्डोंके मरने तथा जन्ममें भी अशौचका पालन करना चाहिए। पुरुषकी सपिण्डता सातवीं पीढ़ीमें समाप्त हो जाती है। अपने वंशके मूल पुरुषका नाम ज्ञात न होनेपर समानोदकता नष्ट हो जाती है

verses.sanskrit: क्रीत्वा लब्ध्वा स्वयं वाथ मृतानाहृत्य वा द्विजः । दद्याच्छ्राद्धे प्रयत्नेन तदस्याक्षयमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: krītvā labdhvā svayaṃ vātha mṛtānāhṛtya vā dvijaḥ / dadyācchrāddhe prayatnena tadasyākṣayamucyate
verses.translation: (Defective verse). He shall scatter gingelly seeds there all round, but see that theydo not grow (i.e. germinate?) A Sraddha affected by the Asuras becomes purified through the gingelly seeds if they do not germinate.
verses.hindi: ऊढानां भर्तृसापिण्ड्यं प्राह देवः पितामहः
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective verse). He shall scatter gingelly seeds there all round, but see that theydo not grow (i.e. germinate?) A Sraddha affected by the Asuras becomes purified through the gingelly seeds if they do not germinate.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective verse). He shall scatter gingelly seeds there all round, but see that theydo not grow (i.e. germinate?) A Sraddha affected by the Asuras becomes purified through the gingelly seeds if they do not germinate.

verses.sanskrit: पिप्पलीं क्रमुकं चैव तथा चैव मसूरकम् । कूष्माण्डालाबुवार्ताकान् भूस्तृणं सुरसं तथा
verses.transliteration: pippalīṃ kramukaṃ caiva tathā caiva masūrakam / kūṣmāṇḍālābuvārtākān bhūstṛṇaṃ surasaṃ tathā
verses.translation: (Defective verse). He shall scatter gingelly seeds there all round, but see that theydo not grow (i.e. germinate?) A Sraddha affected by the Asuras becomes purified through the gingelly seeds if they do not germinate.
verses.hindi: ये चैकजाता बहवो भिन्नयोनय एव च। भिन्नवर्णास्तु सापिण्ड्यं भवेत् तेषां त्रिपूरुषम् कारवः शिल्पिनो वैद्या दासीदासास्तथैव च। दातारो नियमी चैव ब्रह्मविदब्रह्मचारिणौ
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective verse). He shall scatter gingelly seeds there all round, but see that theydo not grow (i.e. germinate?) A Sraddha affected by the Asuras becomes purified through the gingelly seeds if they do not germinate.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective verse). He shall scatter gingelly seeds there all round, but see that theydo not grow (i.e. germinate?) A Sraddha affected by the Asuras becomes purified through the gingelly seeds if they do not germinate.

verses.sanskrit: कुसुम्भपिण्डमूलं वै तन्दुलीयकमेव च । राजमाषांस्तथा क्षीरं माहिषं च विवर्जयेत्
verses.transliteration: kusumbhapiṇḍamūlaṃ vai tandulīyakameva ca / rājamāṣāṃstathā kṣīraṃ māhiṣaṃ ca vivarjayet
verses.translation: (Defective verse). He shall scatter gingelly seeds there all round, but see that theydo not grow (i.e. germinate?) A Sraddha affected by the Asuras becomes purified through the gingelly seeds if they do not germinate.
verses.hindi: राजा चैवाभिषिक्तश्च प्राणसत्रिण एव च
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective verse). He shall scatter gingelly seeds there all round, but see that theydo not grow (i.e. germinate?) A Sraddha affected by the Asuras becomes purified through the gingelly seeds if they do not germinate.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective verse). He shall scatter gingelly seeds there all round, but see that theydo not grow (i.e. germinate?) A Sraddha affected by the Asuras becomes purified through the gingelly seeds if they do not germinate.

verses.sanskrit: कोद्रवान् कोविदारांश्चपालक्यान् मरिचांस्तथा । वर्जयेत् सर्वयत्नेन श्राद्धकाले द्विजोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: kodravān kovidārāṃścapālakyān maricāṃstathā / varjayet sarvayatnena śrāddhakāle dvijottamaḥ
verses.translation: (Defective verse). He shall scatter gingelly seeds there all round, but see that theydo not grow (i.e. germinate?) A Sraddha affected by the Asuras becomes purified through the gingelly seeds if they do not germinate.
verses.hindi: यज्ञे विवाहकाले च देवयागे तथैव च। सद्यःशौचं समाख्यातं दुर्भिक्षे चाप्युपद्रवे डिम्बाहवहतानां च विद्युता पार्थिवैद्धिजे:। सद्यःशौचं समाख्यातं सर्पादिमरणे तथा
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective verse). He shall scatter gingelly seeds there all round, but see that theydo not grow (i.e. germinate?) A Sraddha affected by the Asuras becomes purified through the gingelly seeds if they do not germinate.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective verse). He shall scatter gingelly seeds there all round, but see that theydo not grow (i.e. germinate?) A Sraddha affected by the Asuras becomes purified through the gingelly seeds if they do not germinate.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे विशो ऽध्यायः व्यास उवाच स्नात्वा यथोक्तं संतर्प्य पितॄंश्चन्द्रक्षये द्विजः । पिण्डान्वाहार्यकं श्राद्धं कुर्यात् सौम्यमनाः शुचिः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge viśo 'dhyāyaḥ vyāsa uvāca snātvā yathoktaṃ saṃtarpya pitṝṃścandrakṣaye dvijaḥ / piṇḍānvāhāryakaṃ śrāddhaṃ kuryāt saumyamanāḥ śuciḥ
verses.translation: He shall then prepare various kinds of cooked food with diverse pickles and side dishes. In accordance with his ability, he should prepare lambatives, beverages and cooked food.
verses.hindi: अग्नौ मरुप्रपतने वीराध्वन्यप्यनाशके । ब्राह्मणार्थे च संन्यस्ते सद्यः शौचं विधीयते
verses.wordMeaning: He shall then prepare various kinds of cooked food with diverse pickles and side dishes. In accordance with his ability, he should prepare lambatives, beverages and cooked food.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall then prepare various kinds of cooked food with diverse pickles and side dishes. In accordance with his ability, he should prepare lambatives, beverages and cooked food.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वमेव परीक्षेत ब्राह्मणं वेदपारगम् । तीर्थं तद् हव्यकव्यानां प्रदाने चातिथिः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: pūrvameva parīkṣeta brāhmaṇaṃ vedapāragam / tīrthaṃ tad havyakavyānāṃ pradāne cātithiḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: (Defective verse). Then, after midday, he should approach the Brahmanas who have shaved their hairs and pared their nails and give unto them the tooth-brush twig.
verses.hindi: नेष्टिकानां वनस्थानां यतीनां ब्रह्मचारिणाम् । नाशौचं कीर्त्यते सद्भिः पतिते च तथा मृते न चाश्रुपातपिण्डौ वा कार्य श्राद्धादिकं क्वचित्
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective verse). Then, after midday, he should approach the Brahmanas who have shaved their hairs and pared their nails and give unto them the tooth-brush twig.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective verse). Then, after midday, he should approach the Brahmanas who have shaved their hairs and pared their nails and give unto them the tooth-brush twig.

verses.sanskrit: ये सोमपा विरजसो धर्मज्ञाः शान्तचेतसः । व्रतिनो नियमस्थाश्च ऋतुकालाभिगामिनः
verses.transliteration: ye somapā virajaso dharmajñāḥ śāntacetasaḥ / vratino niyamasthāśca ṛtukālābhigāminaḥ
verses.translation: When requested "Ye be seated", they will sit separately. He should give them oil for anointing themselves with as well as water for bath, and various other necessary requisites. These shall be given in vessels made ofUdumbara wood. Everything shall be given with Vaisvadaivatya rites (i.e. uttering VaiWadeva hymns).
verses.hindi: विहितं तस्य नाशौचं नाग्निर्नाप्युदकादिकम्
verses.wordMeaning: When requested "Ye be seated", they will sit separately. He should give them oil for anointing themselves with as well as water for bath, and various other necessary requisites. These shall be given in vessels made ofUdumbara wood.…
verses.commentary: Sense: When requested "Ye be seated", they will sit separately. He should give them oil for anointing themselves with as well as water for bath, and various other necessary requisites. These shall be given in vessels made ofUdumbara wood.…

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चाग्निरप्यधीयानो यजुर्वेदविदेव च । बह्वृचश्च त्रिसौपर्णस्त्रिमधुर्वाथ यो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: pañcāgnirapyadhīyāno yajurvedavideva ca / bahvṛcaśca trisauparṇastrimadhurvātha yo bhavet
verses.translation: When they return after taking bath, he should greet them with palms joined in reverence. He should offer them Padya and Acamaniya, (water for washing the feet and the Acamana) sipping water-rite in due order.
verses.hindi: तस्याशौचं विधातव्यं कार्य चैवोदकादिकम् जाते कुमारे तदहः कामं कुर्यात् प्रतिग्रहम् । हिरण्यधान्यगोवासस्तिलान्नगुडसर्पिषाम्
verses.wordMeaning: When they return after taking bath, he should greet them with palms joined in reverence. He should offer them Padya and Acamaniya, (water for washing the feet and the Acamana) sipping water-rite in due order.
verses.commentary: Sense: When they return after taking bath, he should greet them with palms joined in reverence. He should offer them Padya and Acamaniya, (water for washing the feet and the Acamana) sipping water-rite in due order.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिणाचिकेतच्छन्दोगो ज्येष्ठसामग एव च । अथर्वशिरसो ऽध्येता रुद्राध्यायी विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: triṇāciketacchandogo jyeṣṭhasāmaga eva ca / atharvaśiraso 'dhyetā rudrādhyāyī viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: The seats of those Brahmanas who had been pre¬ viously invited on behalf of Visve-Devas, are covered with three blades(?) of Darbha grass with their tips towards the East.
verses.hindi: ” भिन्न वर्णकी स्त्री होना अन्य युगमें शास्त्रानुसार सम्भव है।
verses.wordMeaning: The seats of those Brahmanas who had been pre¬ viously invited on behalf of Visve-Devas, are covered with three blades(?) of Darbha grass with their tips towards the East.
verses.commentary: Sense: The seats of those Brahmanas who had been pre¬ viously invited on behalf of Visve-Devas, are covered with three blades(?) of Darbha grass with their tips towards the East.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निहोत्रपरो विद्वान् न्यायविच्च षडङ्गवित् । मन्त्रब्राह्मणविच्चैव यश्च स्याद् धर्मपाठकः
verses.transliteration: agnihotraparo vidvān nyāyavicca ṣaḍaṅgavit / mantrabrāhmaṇaviccaiva yaśca syād dharmapāṭhakaḥ
verses.translation: The seats of the Brahmanas on behalf of the Pitrs are the Darbha grasses facing the South. They must be sprin- Med with water and gingelly seeds.
verses.hindi: पिता, पितामह तथा प्रपितामह--इन तीनोंसे आगेके पितर लेपभागी होते हें । सात पुरुषोंतक सपिण्डता होती हैं। अविवाहित कन्याओंकी सपिण्डता उसके पिताके सात पुरुषों (पीढ़ीतक)-में होती है और विवाहित स्त्रियोंकी सपिण्डता उसके पतिके साथ (सात पीढ़ीतक) होती है--ऐसा भगवान् ब्रह्माने कहा है। एक पुरुषद्वारा भिन्न वर्णकी स्त्रियाँसे उत्पन्न पुत्रोंको सपिण्डता तीन पीढीतक होती है
verses.wordMeaning: The seats of the Brahmanas on behalf of the Pitrs are the Darbha grasses facing the South. They must be sprin- Med with water and gingelly seeds.
verses.commentary: Sense: The seats of the Brahmanas on behalf of the Pitrs are the Darbha grasses facing the South. They must be sprin- Med with water and gingelly seeds.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषिव्रती ऋषीकश्च तथा द्वादशवार्षिकः । ब्रह्मदेयानुसंतानो गर्भशुद्धः सहस्रदः
verses.transliteration: ṛṣivratī ṛṣīkaśca tathā dvādaśavārṣikaḥ / brahmadeyānusaṃtāno garbhaśuddhaḥ sahasradaḥ
verses.translation: He should make them sit on these. Touching the seat he should request: "Ye be seated", They shall seat separately.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मज्ञानी, ब्रह्मचारी, यज्ञकर्ता, व्रती-ये सभी (किसीका मरण होनेपर) स्नानमात्रसे शुद्ध हो जाते हैं। इसी प्रकार अभिषिक्त राजा एवं प्राणको रक्षा करनेवाले अन्नदाताको भी सद्यः शौच होता है। यज्ञ, विवाहारम्भ, देवपूजनका
verses.wordMeaning: He should make them sit on these. Touching the seat he should request: "Ye be seated", They shall seat separately.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should make them sit on these. Touching the seat he should request: "Ye be seated", They shall seat separately.

verses.sanskrit: चान्द्रायणव्रतचरः सत्यवादी पुराणवित् । गुरुदेवाग्निपूजासु प्रसक्तो ज्ञानतत्परः
verses.transliteration: cāndrāyaṇavratacaraḥ satyavādī purāṇavit / gurudevāgnipūjāsu prasakto jñānatatparaḥ
verses.translation: Two (Brahmanas) shall represent Visvedevas (?) They shall face the east. Three Brahmanas represent the Pitrs They face the north. One shall represent PitamaAd (grandfather) and one shall represent Matamaha (maternal grandfather) Or one Brahmana represents gods and one paternal and maternal grandfather.
verses.hindi: आरम्भ हो जानेपर तथा दुर्भिक्ष और उपद्रवकी स्थितिमें सद्यः शौच होता है। क्षत्रियों तथा ब्राह्मणोंके साथ मामूली लड़ाई अथवा झडप आदिमें मरनेवालों तथा विद्युत् और सर्पादिके कारण मरनेवालोंका सद्य: शौच कहा गया है। अग्निमें गिरकर अथवा मरुस्थलमें मरनेपर, दुर्गम मार्गमें गमन और अकाल-मृत्युपर, ब्राह्मणके लिये मरनेपर तथा संन्यासी होनेके उपरान्त मृत्यु होनेपर सद्यः शौचका विधान है
verses.wordMeaning: Two (Brahmanas) shall represent Visvedevas (?) They shall face the east. Three Brahmanas represent the Pitrs They face the north.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Two (Brahmanas) shall represent Visvedevas (?) They shall face the east. Three Brahmanas represent the Pitrs They face the north.…

verses.sanskrit: विमुक्तः सर्वतो धीरो ब्रह्मभूतो द्विजोत्तमः । महादेवार्चनरतो वैष्णवः पङ्क्तिपावनः
verses.transliteration: vimuktaḥ sarvato dhīro brahmabhūto dvijottamaḥ / mahādevārcanarato vaiṣṇavaḥ paṅktipāvanaḥ
verses.translation: Five things are spoiled if performed elaborately in a crowd, viz.-hospitality, purity of the place (of respect), the time of respect, cleanliness, and the selection of a Brahmana. Hence one shall not wish for elaborateness and a big gathering.
verses.hindi: विद्वानोंने नैष्ठिक अर्थात् जीवनभर ब्रह्मचर्यका व्रत धारण करनेवाले ब्रह्मचारी, वानप्रस्थ- धर्मावलम्बी, यति तथा ब्रह्मचारीकी मृत्यु होनेपर और पतित व्यक्तिकी मृत्यु होनेपर अशौच नहीं बताया है। पतित व्यक्तियोंका
verses.wordMeaning: Five things are spoiled if performed elaborately in a crowd, viz.-hospitality, purity of the place (of respect), the time of respect, cleanliness, and the selection of a Brahmana. Hence one shall not wish for elaborateness and a big gathering.
verses.commentary: Sense: Five things are spoiled if performed elaborately in a crowd, viz.-hospitality, purity of the place (of respect), the time of respect, cleanliness, and the selection of a Brahmana. Hence one shall not wish for elaborateness and a big gathering.

verses.sanskrit: अहिंसानिरतो नित्यमप्रतिग्रहणस्तथा । सत्रिणो दाननिरता विज्ञेयाः पङ्क्तिपावनाः
verses.transliteration: ahiṃsānirato nityamapratigrahaṇastathā / satriṇo dānaniratā vijñeyāḥ paṅktipāvanāḥ
verses.translation: Or one shall feed only one Brahmana who is a master of the Vedas, endowed with learning, good conduct etc. and devoid of evil characteristics.
verses.hindi: न दाह होता है, न अन्त्येष्टि-संस्कार होता है और न अस्थिसंचय ही होता है । उनके लिये अश्रुपात, पिण्डदान तथा श्राद्धादि कार्य भी कभी नहीं करने चाहिए जो व्यक्ति अग्नि तथा विष आदिके द्वारा स्वयं अपनी आत्महत्या करता है, उसके निमित्त अशौच, दाह तथा उदकदान आदिका विधान नहीं है। यदि कोई प्रमादवश अग्नि अथवा विष आदिद्वारा मर जाता
verses.wordMeaning: Or one shall feed only one Brahmana who is a master of the Vedas, endowed with learning, good conduct etc. and devoid of evil characteristics.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or one shall feed only one Brahmana who is a master of the Vedas, endowed with learning, good conduct etc. and devoid of evil characteristics.

verses.sanskrit: युवानः श्रोत्रियाः स्वस्था महायज्ञपरायणाः । सावित्रीजापनिरता ब्राह्मणाः पङ्क्तिपावनाः
verses.transliteration: yuvānaḥ śrotriyāḥ svasthā mahāyajñaparāyaṇāḥ / sāvitrījāpaniratā brāhmaṇāḥ paṅktipāvanāḥ
verses.translation: Out of all articles of food thereof, he should take a portion (in a vessel and offer it to the Brahmana representing gods, in the shrine, and then pass it to others.
verses.hindi: है, उसके (सम्बन्धियोंके) लिये अशौचका विधान है और उदकदान आदि भी करना चाहिए। पुत्रका जन्म
verses.wordMeaning: Out of all articles of food thereof, he should take a portion (in a vessel and offer it to the Brahmana representing gods, in the shrine, and then pass it to others.
verses.commentary: Sense: Out of all articles of food thereof, he should take a portion (in a vessel and offer it to the Brahmana representing gods, in the shrine, and then pass it to others.

verses.sanskrit: कुलीनाः श्रुतवन्तश्च शीलवन्तस्तपस्विनः । अग्निचित्स्नातका विप्रा विज्ञेयाः पङ्क्तिपावनाः
verses.transliteration: kulīnāḥ śrutavantaśca śīlavantastapasvinaḥ / agnicitsnātakā viprā vijñeyāḥ paṅktipāvanāḥ
verses.translation: He shall consign that cooked food to the fire. He should give that to a Brahmacarin. Hence, one shall feed only one Brahmana but he should be an excellent scholar.
verses.hindi: गुड़ तथा घृत-इन वस्तुओंका इच्छापूर्वक (कार्पण्यरहित होकर) दान करना चाहिए फलानि पुष्पं शाकं च लवणं काष्ठमेव च।
verses.wordMeaning: He shall consign that cooked food to the fire. He should give that to a Brahmacarin. Hence, one shall feed only one Brahmana but he should be an excellent scholar.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall consign that cooked food to the fire. He should give that to a Brahmacarin. Hence, one shall feed only one Brahmana but he should be an excellent scholar.

verses.sanskrit: मातापित्रोर्हिते युक्तः प्रातः स्नायी तथा द्विजः । अध्यात्मविन्मुनिर्दान्तो विज्ञेयः पङ्क्तिपावनः
verses.transliteration: mātāpitrorhite yuktaḥ prātaḥ snāyī tathā dvijaḥ / adhyātmavinmunirdānto vijñeyaḥ paṅktipāvanaḥ
verses.translation: If a mendicant or a Brahmacarin be present for the purpose of food and he seats himself in the raddha, one should feed him also.
verses.hindi: आशचिनां गृहाद ग्राहं शुष्कान्नं चैव नित्यशः
verses.wordMeaning: If a mendicant or a Brahmacarin be present for the purpose of food and he seats himself in the raddha, one should feed him also.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a mendicant or a Brahmacarin be present for the purpose of food and he seats himself in the raddha, one should feed him also.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञाननिष्ठो महायोगी वेदान्तार्थविचिन्तकः । श्रद्धालुः श्राद्धनिरतो ब्राह्मणः पङ्क्तिपावनः
verses.transliteration: jñānaniṣṭho mahāyogī vedāntārthavicintakaḥ / śraddhāluḥ śrāddhanirato brāhmaṇaḥ paṅktipāvanaḥ
verses.translation: Sraddha wherein the guest does not partake of the food, is not praised. Hence, guests should be worshipped in the Sraddhas by the Brahmanas.
verses.hindi: अनाहिताग्निर्गृहोण लौकिकेनेतरो जनः दाहः कार्यो यथान्यायं सपिण्डैः श्रद्धयान्वितेः
verses.wordMeaning: Sraddha wherein the guest does not partake of the food, is not praised. Hence, guests should be worshipped in the Sraddhas by the Brahmanas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sraddha wherein the guest does not partake of the food, is not praised. Hence, guests should be worshipped in the Sraddhas by the Brahmanas.

verses.sanskrit: वेदविद्यारतः स्नातो ब्रह्मचर्यपरः सदा । अथर्वणो मुमुक्षुश्च ब्राह्मणः पङ्क्तिपावनः
verses.transliteration: vedavidyārataḥ snāto brahmacaryaparaḥ sadā / atharvaṇo mumukṣuśca brāhmaṇaḥ paṅktipāvanaḥ
verses.translation: Those twice-born ones who partake of the food in a Sraddha devoid of hospitality (to a guest), are reborn as crows. There is no doubt about this. The performer of the Sraddha too (is reborn as a crow).
verses.hindi: द्वितीयेऽहनि कर्तव्यं क्षुरकर्म सबान्धवैः ।
verses.wordMeaning: Those twice-born ones who partake of the food in a Sraddha devoid of hospitality (to a guest), are reborn as crows. There is no doubt about this. The performer of the Sraddha too (is reborn as a crow).
verses.commentary: Sense: Those twice-born ones who partake of the food in a Sraddha devoid of hospitality (to a guest), are reborn as crows. There is no doubt about this. The performer of the Sraddha too (is reborn as a crow).

verses.sanskrit: असमानप्रवरको ह्यसगोत्रस्तथैव च । असंबन्धी च विज्ञेयो ब्राह्मणः पङ्क्तिपावनः
verses.transliteration: asamānapravarako hyasagotrastathaiva ca / asaṃbandhī ca vijñeyo brāhmaṇaḥ paṅktipāvanaḥ
verses.translation: The following shall be shunned and kept at a great distance from Sraddhas viz. one who is deficient in any limb, a fallen one, a leper, one with running sores, an atheist, a cock, a pig and a dog.
verses.hindi: एकादशेऽह्नि कुर्वीत प्रेतमुद्दिश्य भावतः। द्वादशे वाथ कर्तव्यमनिन्द्ये त्वथवाहनि। एकं पवित्रमेकोऽर्घः पिण्डपात्रं तथैव च एवं मृताह्नि कर्तव्यं प्रतिमासं तु वत्सरम्। सपिण्डीकरणं प्रोक्तं पूर्ण संवत्सरे पुनः
verses.wordMeaning: The following shall be shunned and kept at a great distance from Sraddhas viz. one who is deficient in any limb, a fallen one, a leper, one with running sores, an atheist, a cock, a pig and a dog.
verses.commentary: Sense: The following shall be shunned and kept at a great distance from Sraddhas viz. one who is deficient in any limb, a fallen one, a leper, one with running sores, an atheist, a cock, a pig and a dog.

verses.sanskrit: भोजयेद् योगिनं पूर्वं तत्त्वज्ञानरतं यतिम् । अलाभे नैष्ठिकं दान्तमुपकुर्वाणकं तथा
verses.transliteration: bhojayed yoginaṃ pūrvaṃ tattvajñānarataṃ yatim / alābhe naiṣṭhikaṃ dāntamupakurvāṇakaṃ tathā
verses.translation: One shall avoid a loathsome fellow, an unclean fellow, the naked one, the intoxicated one, the rogue, a women in her monthly course, the blue-garmented, the ochre-garmented and the heretic.
verses.hindi: प्रेतार्घ पितृपात्रेषु पात्रमासेचयेत् ततः
verses.wordMeaning: One shall avoid a loathsome fellow, an unclean fellow, the naked one, the intoxicated one, the rogue, a women in her monthly course, the blue-garmented, the ochre-garmented and the heretic.
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall avoid a loathsome fellow, an unclean fellow, the naked one, the intoxicated one, the rogue, a women in her monthly course, the blue-garmented, the ochre-garmented and the heretic.

verses.sanskrit: तदलाभे गृहस्थं तु मुमुक्षुं सङ्गवर्जितम् । सर्वालाभे साधकं वा गृहस्थमपि भोजयेत्
verses.transliteration: tadalābhe gṛhasthaṃ tu mumukṣuṃ saṅgavarjitam / sarvālābhe sādhakaṃ vā gṛhasthamapi bhojayet
verses.translation: Whatever rite is performed in a Sraddha towards the Brahmanas shall be performed alongwith Vaisvadeva rites or invoking Visvedevas.
verses.hindi: आशौची व्यक्तियोंके घरोंसे फल, पुष्प, शाक, लवण, काष्ठ, मट्टा, दही, घी, तेल, औषधि तथा क्षीर और शुष्कान्नको नित्य ग्रहण किया जा सकता! है। आहिताग्नि श्रोत्रियका दाह-संस्कार तीनों अग्नियोंसे यथाविधि करना चाहिए और अनाहिताग्निका दाह गृह्याग्निसे तथा दूसरे सामान्य लोगोंका दाह लौकिक अग्निसे करना चाहिए। (मृत व्यक्तिके) देहका अभाव (शव न मिलनेपर) होनेपर पलाशके पत्तोंसे उसके ही
verses.wordMeaning: Whatever rite is performed in a Sraddha towards the Brahmanas shall be performed alongwith Vaisvadeva rites or invoking Visvedevas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Whatever rite is performed in a Sraddha towards the Brahmanas shall be performed alongwith Vaisvadeva rites or invoking Visvedevas.

verses.sanskrit: प्रकृतेर्गुणतत्त्वज्ञो यस्याश्नाति यतिर्हविः । फलं वेदविदां तस्य सहस्रादतिरिच्यते
verses.transliteration: prakṛterguṇatattvajño yasyāśnāti yatirhaviḥ / phalaṃ vedavidāṃ tasya sahasrādatiricyate
verses.translation: Even as they are seated, one should bedeck them in ornaments, garlands, coronets, fumigating incenses and unguents.
verses.hindi: समान आकृति बनाकर सपिण्डीजनोंको चाहिए कि वे श्रद्धायुक्त होकर विधिपूर्वक दाह-संस्कार करें
verses.wordMeaning: Even as they are seated, one should bedeck them in ornaments, garlands, coronets, fumigating incenses and unguents.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even as they are seated, one should bedeck them in ornaments, garlands, coronets, fumigating incenses and unguents.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद् यत्नेन योगीन्द्रमीश्वरज्ञानतत्परम् । भोजयेद् हव्यकव्येषु अलाभादितरान् द्विजान्
verses.transliteration: tasmād yatnena yogīndramīśvarajñānatatparam / bhojayed havyakavyeṣu alābhāditarān dvijān
verses.translation: Then with the permission of the Brahmanas, he should invoke Devas by means of the Rk Visvedevdsah (RV. II, 41. 13) etc. H e shall duly recite it and face the north.
verses.hindi: सभी बान्धवोंको संयमपूर्वक दस दिनोंतक (मृत व्यक्तिके) नाम तथा गोत्रका उच्चारण करते हुए स्नानके गीले वस्त्र पहने हुए ही एक बार जलदान करा चाहिए। प्रेतके निमित्त यथाविधि प्रातःसे सायंकाल (अर्थात् दिनमें किसी भी समय) प्रतिदिन पिण्डदान करना चाहिए और चौथे दिनसे घरके द्वारपर (अभ्यागत) ब्राह्मणोंको भोजन कराना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: Then with the permission of the Brahmanas, he should invoke Devas by means of the Rk Visvedevdsah (RV. II, 41. 13) etc. H e shall duly recite it and face the north.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then with the permission of the Brahmanas, he should invoke Devas by means of the Rk Visvedevdsah (RV. II, 41. 13) etc. H e shall duly recite it and face the north.

verses.sanskrit: एष वै प्रथमः कल्पः प्रिदाने हव्यकव्ययोः । अनुकल्पस्त्वयं ज्ञेयः सदा सद्भिरनुष्ठितः
verses.transliteration: eṣa vai prathamaḥ kalpaḥ pridāne havyakavyayoḥ / anukalpastvayaṃ jñeyaḥ sadā sadbhiranuṣṭhitaḥ
verses.translation: He shall then turn round anticlockwise and face the south, repeating the Rk. Usantas Tvd (RV. X. 16. 12) etc. the learned man shall invoke the Pitrs,
verses.hindi: दूसरे दिन बान्धवोंके साथ क्षौरकर्म करना चाहिए। चौथे दिन बन्धुओंसहित अस्थिसंचयन करना चाहिए। अस्थिसंचयनसे पूर्व श्रद्धापूर्वक पवित्र अयुग्म (विषम संख्यावाले) ब्राह्मणोंको भोजन कराना चाहिए। पाँचवें,
verses.wordMeaning: He shall then turn round anticlockwise and face the south, repeating the Rk. Usantas Tvd (RV. X. 16. 12) etc. the learned man shall invoke the Pitrs,
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall then turn round anticlockwise and face the south, repeating the Rk. Usantas Tvd (RV. X. 16. 12) etc. the learned man shall invoke the Pitrs,

verses.sanskrit: मातामहं मातुलं च स्वस्त्रीयं श्वशुरं गुरुम् । दौहित्रं विट्पतिं बन्धुमृत्विग्याज्यौ च भोजयेत्
verses.transliteration: mātāmahaṃ mātulaṃ ca svastrīyaṃ śvaśuraṃ gurum / dauhitraṃ viṭpatiṃ bandhumṛtvigyājyau ca bhojayet
verses.translation: Homa should be performed by one with the Kusa grass in the hand, wearing the sacred thread in the normal manner. All the rites of the Pitrs should be performed with the sacred thread worn over the right shoulder and under the left arm. The Vaisvadeva rite is performed like Homa.
verses.hindi: ब्राह्मणोंको भोजन कराना चाहिए। इसे नवश्राद्ध जानना चाहिए। प्रेतके निमित्त ग्यारहवें, बारहवें अथवा किसी अनिन्दित दिनमें श्रद्धापूर्वक श्राद्ध करना चाहिए। इस श्राद्धमें एक पवित्र, एक अर्घ और एक ही पिण्डपात्र इसी प्रकार एक वर्षतक प्रत्येक महीनेमें मृत्युकी तिथिको श्राद्ध करना चाहिए। संवत्सर (वर्ष)-के पूर्ण हो जानेपर सपिण्डीकरण श्राद्ध करनेका विधान किया गया है। है द्विजोत्तमो! प्रेतादि अर्थात् प्रेत, पितामह,
verses.wordMeaning: Homa should be performed by one with the Kusa grass in the hand, wearing the sacred thread in the normal manner. All the rites of the Pitrs should be performed with the sacred thread worn over the right shoulder and under the left arm. The Vaisvadeva rite is performed like Homa.
verses.commentary: Sense: Homa should be performed by one with the Kusa grass in the hand, wearing the sacred thread in the normal manner. All the rites of the Pitrs should be performed with the sacred thread worn over the right shoulder and under the left arm. The Vaisvadeva rite is performed like Homa.

verses.sanskrit: न श्राद्धे भोजयेन्मित्रं धनैः कार्यो ऽस्य संग्रहः । पैशाची दक्षिणा सा हि नैवामुत्र फलप्रदा
verses.transliteration: na śrāddhe bhojayenmitraṃ dhanaiḥ kāryo 'sya saṃgrahaḥ / paiśācī dakṣiṇā sā hi naivāmutra phalapradā
verses.translation: While rendering homage to Devas, one shall always kneel upon the right knee; and during the obeisance and service to the Pitrs one shall kneel upon the other knee.
verses.hindi: प्रपितामह तथा वृद्ध प्रपितामहके उद्देश्यसे चार अर्ध- पात्र बनाना चाहिए और पितृपात्रॉमें प्रेतपात्रका अर्घ डालना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: While rendering homage to Devas, one shall always kneel upon the right knee; and during the obeisance and service to the Pitrs one shall kneel upon the other knee.
verses.commentary: Sense: While rendering homage to Devas, one shall always kneel upon the right knee; and during the obeisance and service to the Pitrs one shall kneel upon the other knee.

verses.sanskrit: काम श्राद्धे ऽर्चयेन्मित्रं नाभिरूपमपि त्वरिम् । द्विषता हि हविर्भुक्तं भवति प्रेत्य निष्फलम्
verses.transliteration: kāma śrāddhe 'rcayenmitraṃ nābhirūpamapi tvarim / dviṣatā hi havirbhuktaṃ bhavati pretya niṣphalam
verses.translation: At the time he should repeat the Mantra Somaya vai pitrmate svadha namah [svadha and obeisance into Soma (the deity) with the Pitps]. Then he shall perform Homa by saying Agnaye kavya-vahdya svadha [svadha unto Agni (fire- god) the bearer of Kavyas].
verses.hindi: १-यहाँ नित्य ग्रहणका इतना ही अर्थ है कि अनिवार्य होनेपर ये वस्तुएँ कभी भी ली जा सकती हैं। रागतः इन्हें ग्रहण नही २-स्मार्त अग्न्याधान करनेवालेको भी अनाहिताग्नि ही माना जाता है।
verses.wordMeaning: At the time he should repeat the Mantra Somaya vai pitrmate svadha namah [svadha and obeisance into Soma (the deity) with the Pitps]. Then he shall perform Homa by saying Agnaye kavya-vahdya svadha [svadha unto Agni (fire- god) the bearer of Kavyas].
verses.commentary: Sense: At the time he should repeat the Mantra Somaya vai pitrmate svadha namah [svadha and obeisance into Soma (the deity) with the Pitps]. Then he shall perform Homa by saying Agnaye kavya-vahdya svadha [svadha unto Agni (fire- god) the bearer of Kavyas].

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणो ह्यनधीयानस्तृणाग्निरिव शाम्यति । तस्मै हव्यं न दातव्यं न हि भस्मनि हूयते
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇo hyanadhīyānastṛṇāgniriva śāmyati / tasmai havyaṃ na dātavyaṃ na hi bhasmani hūyate
verses.translation: In case fire is not available one should make use of the right hand of the Brahmanas. Or he shall perform it near god Mahadeva or in a cowshed with due concentration.
verses.hindi: सपिण्डीकरणं श्राद्धं देवपूर्व विधीयते
verses.wordMeaning: In case fire is not available one should make use of the right hand of the Brahmanas. Or he shall perform it near god Mahadeva or in a cowshed with due concentration.
verses.commentary: Sense: In case fire is not available one should make use of the right hand of the Brahmanas. Or he shall perform it near god Mahadeva or in a cowshed with due concentration.

verses.sanskrit: यथेरिणे बीजमुप्त्वा न वप्ता लभते फलम् । तथानृचे हविर्दत्त्वा न दाता लभते फलम्
verses.transliteration: yatheriṇe bījamuptvā na vaptā labhate phalam / tathānṛce havirdattvā na dātā labhate phalam
verses.translation: After placing the Pindas he shall wipe off the hand on the Darbha grass to remove the greasiness to Pitrs who partake of the Lepa?- He should then perform the Acamana rite thrice. He shall smell the cooked rice thrice slowly. The knowerof the Mantras then shall make obeisance unto the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: दद्याच्यान्नं सोदकुम्भं प्रत्यहं प्रेतधर्मतः प्रतिसंवत्सरं कार्य विधिरेष सनातनः
verses.wordMeaning: After placing the Pindas he shall wipe off the hand on the Darbha grass to remove the greasiness to Pitrs who partake of the Lepa?- He should then perform the Acamana rite thrice. He shall smell the cooked rice thrice slowly.…
verses.commentary: Sense: After placing the Pindas he shall wipe off the hand on the Darbha grass to remove the greasiness to Pitrs who partake of the Lepa?- He should then perform the Acamana rite thrice. He shall smell the cooked rice thrice slowly.…

verses.sanskrit: यावतो ग्रसते पिण्डान् हव्यकव्येष्वमन्त्रवित् । तावतो ग्रसते प्रेत्य दीप्तान् स्थूलांस्त्वयोगुडान्
verses.transliteration: yāvato grasate piṇḍān havyakavyeṣvamantravit / tāvato grasate pretya dīptān sthūlāṃstvayoguḍān
verses.translation: The remainder of the holy water, he should pour round and near the Pindas. After offering the Pindas he shall smell the Pindas with great concentration.
verses.hindi: मातापित्रोः सुतैः कार्य पिण्डदानादिकं च यत्। पत्नी कुर्यात् सुताभावे पत्यभावे सहोदरः
verses.wordMeaning: The remainder of the holy water, he should pour round and near the Pindas. After offering the Pindas he shall smell the Pindas with great concentration.
verses.commentary: Sense: The remainder of the holy water, he should pour round and near the Pindas. After offering the Pindas he shall smell the Pindas with great concentration.

verses.sanskrit: अपि विद्याकुलैर्युक्ता हीनवृत्ता नराधमाः । यत्रैते भुञ्जते हव्यं तद् भवेदासुर द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: api vidyākulairyuktā hīnavṛttā narādhamāḥ / yatraite bhuñjate havyaṃ tad bhavedāsura dvijāḥ
verses.translation: He shall then feed the Brahmanas duly with the rice other than that of the Pindas. He should also offer them meat, pies, etc. of various kinds, auspiciously prepared in accordance with the Sraddha Kalpa.
verses.hindi: सत्रीणां तु भर्तृशुश्रूषा धर्मो नान्य इहेष्यते स्वधर्मपरमो नित्यमीश्वरार्पितमानसः। प्रापनोति तत् परं स्थानं यदुक्तं वेदवादिभिः
verses.wordMeaning: He shall then feed the Brahmanas duly with the rice other than that of the Pindas. He should also offer them meat, pies, etc. of various kinds, auspiciously prepared in accordance with the Sraddha Kalpa.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall then feed the Brahmanas duly with the rice other than that of the Pindas. He should also offer them meat, pies, etc. of various kinds, auspiciously prepared in accordance with the Sraddha Kalpa.

verses.sanskrit: यस्य वेदश्च वेदी च विच्छिद्येते त्रिपूरुषम् । स वै दुर्ब्राह्मणो नार्हः श्राद्धादिषु कदाचन
verses.transliteration: yasya vedaśca vedī ca vicchidyete tripūruṣam / sa vai durbrāhmaṇo nārhaḥ śrāddhādiṣu kadācana
verses.translation: Then when they have finished taking food, he should inquire of them about the remainder of the food. On being per¬ mitted by those Brahmanas he shall do so as they say.
verses.hindi: “ये समाना:० ' इन दो मन्त्रोंका उच्चारणकर पितामहादिके पिण्डोंमें प्रेतपिण्डको मिलाना चाहिए । देवश्राद्ध करनेके अनन्तर सपिण्डीकरण श्राद्ध करना चाहिए। पहले पितरोंका आवाहनकर पुनः प्रेतका आवाहन करना
verses.wordMeaning: Then when they have finished taking food, he should inquire of them about the remainder of the food. On being per¬ mitted by those Brahmanas he shall do so as they say.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then when they have finished taking food, he should inquire of them about the remainder of the food. On being per¬ mitted by those Brahmanas he shall do so as they say.

verses.sanskrit: शूद्रप्रेष्यो भृतो राज्ञो वृषलो ग्रामयाजकः । बधबन्धोपजीवी च षडेते ब्रह्मबन्धवः
verses.transliteration: śūdrapreṣyo bhṛto rājño vṛṣalo grāmayājakaḥ / badhabandhopajīvī ca ṣaḍete brahmabandhavaḥ
verses.translation: In the Pitr rite one shall say Svaditam (May it be well tasted). In the cow-sheds it shall be mentioned thus— SuSrtam (well-cooked). In [prosperity it shall be mentioned thus; Sampannam —well endowed. In regard to a Deva iSewitoOT (served) should be mentioned.
verses.hindi: चाहिए। जिन प्रेतोंका सपिण्डीकरण कर लिया जाता है, उनकी श्राद्धक्रिया पृथक् नहीं होती। जो (सपिण्डीकृत प्रेतका) पृथक् पिण्डदान करता है, वह पितृघाती कहलाता है पिताके मर जानेपर पुत्रको वर्षपर्यन्त पिण्डदान करना चाहिए। प्रतिदिन प्रेतधर्मानुसार उदककुम्भ एवं अन्नका दान करना चाहिए। प्रत्येक वर्ष पार्वण- विधानके अनुसार सांवत्सरिक श्राद्ध करना चाहिए।
verses.wordMeaning: In the Pitr rite one shall say Svaditam (May it be well tasted). In the cow-sheds it shall be mentioned thus— SuSrtam (well-cooked). In [prosperity it shall be mentioned thus; Sampannam —well endowed. In regard to a Deva iSewitoOT (served) should be mentioned.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the Pitr rite one shall say Svaditam (May it be well tasted). In the cow-sheds it shall be mentioned thus— SuSrtam (well-cooked). In [prosperity it shall be mentioned thus; Sampannam —well endowed. In regard to a Deva iSewitoOT (served) should be mentioned.

verses.sanskrit: दत्तानुयोगान् वृत्यर्थं पतितान् मनुरब्रवीत् । वेदविक्रायिणो ह्येते श्राद्धादिषु विगर्हिताः
verses.transliteration: dattānuyogān vṛtyarthaṃ patitān manurabravīt / vedavikrāyiṇo hyete śrāddhādiṣu vigarhitāḥ
verses.translation: After bidding farewell to the Brahmanas he should stand before the Pitrs silently facing the southern direction. He shall then beg of the Pitrs the following boons:
verses.hindi: यही सनातन विधि है? । पुत्रोंको माता-पिताका पिण्डदान आदि जो कार्य है, वह सब करना चाहिए। पुत्रके अभाव होनेपर पली करे और पत्नीकै अभाव होनेपर सहोदर भाई करे। अथवा (पुत्रादि श्राद्ध न कर सकें
verses.wordMeaning: After bidding farewell to the Brahmanas he should stand before the Pitrs silently facing the southern direction. He shall then beg of the Pitrs the following boons:
verses.commentary: Sense: After bidding farewell to the Brahmanas he should stand before the Pitrs silently facing the southern direction. He shall then beg of the Pitrs the following boons:

verses.sanskrit: श्रुतिविक्रयिणो ये तु परपूर्वासमुद्भवाः । असमानान् याजयन्ति पतितास्ते प्रकीर्तिताः
verses.transliteration: śrutivikrayiṇo ye tu parapūrvāsamudbhavāḥ / asamānān yājayanti patitāste prakīrtitāḥ
verses.translation: "May the liberal person flourish. May the Vedas and our progeny flourish. May not our faith slip off. May there be much with us for giving."
verses.hindi: या इनके अभावमें) सभी दान आदि कर्म करनेके बाद समाहित होकर मनुष्यको श्रद्धापूर्वक यथाविधान जीते हुए ही श्राद्ध कर लेना चाहिए (इससे श्राद्धकी अनिवार्यता स्पष्ट है) ॥ ८८--९१॥ इस प्रकार मेने आप लोगोंको गृहस्थोंकी क्रिया- विधि सम्यक्रूपसे बतलायी। स्त्रियोंका तो पतिकी सेवा करना ही एकमात्र धर्म है, उनका अन्य कोई धर्म नहीं कहा गया है। नित्य अपने धर्मका पालन करनेवाला
verses.wordMeaning: "May the liberal person flourish. May the Vedas and our progeny flourish. May not our faith slip off. May there be much with us for giving."
verses.commentary: Sense: "May the liberal person flourish. May the Vedas and our progeny flourish. May not our faith slip off. May there be much with us for giving."

verses.sanskrit: असंस्कृताध्यापका ये भृत्या वाध्यापयन्ति ये । अधीयते तथा वेदान् पतितास्ते प्रकीर्तिताः
verses.transliteration: asaṃskṛtādhyāpakā ye bhṛtyā vādhyāpayanti ye / adhīyate tathā vedān patitāste prakīrtitāḥ
verses.translation: The Pindas may be given to cows, goats, or Brahmanas or cast into fire or water. The wife, desirous of a son, may eat the middle Pinda.
verses.hindi: और भगवानूमें समर्पित मनवाला वेदज्ञोंद्वारा बताये गये उस परम पदको प्राप्त करता है
verses.wordMeaning: The Pindas may be given to cows, goats, or Brahmanas or cast into fire or water. The wife, desirous of a son, may eat the middle Pinda.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Pindas may be given to cows, goats, or Brahmanas or cast into fire or water. The wife, desirous of a son, may eat the middle Pinda.

verses.sanskrit: वृद्धश्रावकनिर्ग्रन्थाः पञ्चरात्रविदो जनाः । कापालिकाः पाशुपताः पाषण्डा ये च तद्विधाः
verses.transliteration: vṛddhaśrāvakanirgranthāḥ pañcarātravido janāḥ / kāpālikāḥ pāśupatāḥ pāṣaṇḍā ye ca tadvidhāḥ
verses.translation: One shall not rest the knee on the ground nor shall be furious. He shall not utter a falsehood. He shall not touch food with the foot. Nor shall he shun and reject it.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे बद्साहस्रथां संहितायामुपरिविभागे त्रयोविशोऽध्यायः १-इस वचनका तात्पर्य प्रतिवर्ष पार्वणश्राद्धमें है । सांवत्सरिक (एको्दिष्टश्राद्ध)-की विधि पार्वणविधिसे भिन्न है। २-इस अध्यायमें श्राद्ध एवं अशौचका विधान संक्षेपमें सांकेतिक मात्र है। इसी आधारपर निर्णय नहीं लेना चाहिए। विभिन्न
verses.wordMeaning: One shall not rest the knee on the ground nor shall be furious. He shall not utter a falsehood. He shall not touch food with the foot. Nor shall he shun and reject it.
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall not rest the knee on the ground nor shall be furious. He shall not utter a falsehood. He shall not touch food with the foot. Nor shall he shun and reject it.

verses.sanskrit: यस्याश्नन्ति हवींष्येते दुरात्मानस्तु तामसाः । न तस्य तद् भवेच्छ्राद्धं प्रेत्य चेह फलप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: yasyāśnanti havīṃṣyete durātmānastu tāmasāḥ / na tasya tad bhavecchrāddhaṃ pretya ceha phalapradam
verses.translation: The demons take away the benefit of what is partaken of in fury or against the conventional procedure or when served by one who prattles.
verses.hindi: निवन्धग्रन्थोसे श्राद्ध एवं अशौच-सम्बन्धी समस्त वचनोंका समाकलन कर सामान्य एवं अपवाद वचनादिकोंकी व्यवस्थाकर निष्कृष्ट निर्णय किया गया है । अत: उन्हींके आधारपर अन्तिम निर्णय लेना चाहिए । निबन्ध्रन्थोंमें सभी वचनोंका समन्वयकर युग, देश, काल आदिको दृष्टिसे स्पष्ट व्यवस्था की गयी है।
verses.wordMeaning: The demons take away the benefit of what is partaken of in fury or against the conventional procedure or when served by one who prattles.
verses.commentary: Sense: The demons take away the benefit of what is partaken of in fury or against the conventional procedure or when served by one who prattles.

verses.sanskrit: अनाश्रमो यो द्विजः स्यादाश्रमी वा निरर्थकः । मिथ्याश्रमी च ते विप्रा विज्ञेयाः पङ्क्तिदूषकाः
verses.transliteration: anāśramo yo dvijaḥ syādāśramī vā nirarthakaḥ / mithyāśramī ca te viprā vijñeyāḥ paṅktidūṣakāḥ
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas one should not stand near if one perspires profusely, he should not see* the crows and other birds going contrary to the natural order. The Pitrs desirous of eating, come there assuming those forms.
verses.hindi: ३८०  कूर्मपुराण  अग्निहोत्रका माहात्म्य, अग्निहोत्रीके कर्तव्य, श्रौत एवं स्मार्तरूप द्विविध धर्म, तृतीय शिष्टराचारधर्म, वेद, धर्मशास्त्र और पुराणसे धर्मका
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahmanas one should not stand near if one perspires profusely, he should not see* the crows and other birds going contrary to the natural order. The Pitrs desirous of eating, come there assuming those forms.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmanas one should not stand near if one perspires profusely, he should not see* the crows and other birds going contrary to the natural order. The Pitrs desirous of eating, come there assuming those forms.

verses.sanskrit: दुश्चर्मा कुनखी कुष्ठी श्वित्री च श्यावदन्तकः । विद्धप्रजननश्चैव स्तेनः क्लीबो ऽथ नास्तिकः
verses.transliteration: duścarmā kunakhī kuṣṭhī śvitrī ca śyāvadantakaḥ / viddhaprajananaścaiva stenaḥ klībo 'tha nāstikaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas one should not stand near if one perspires profusely, he should not see* the crows and other birds going contrary to the natural order. The Pitrs desirous of eating, come there assuming those forms.
verses.hindi: व्यास उवाच व्यासजीने कहा--सहैव सायं और प्रातः अग्निहोत्र
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahmanas one should not stand near if one perspires profusely, he should not see* the crows and other birds going contrary to the natural order. The Pitrs desirous of eating, come there assuming those forms.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmanas one should not stand near if one perspires profusely, he should not see* the crows and other birds going contrary to the natural order. The Pitrs desirous of eating, come there assuming those forms.

verses.sanskrit: मद्यपो वृषलीसक्तो वीरहा दिधिषूपतिः । आगारदाही कुण्डाशी सोमविक्रयिणो द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: madyapo vṛṣalīsakto vīrahā didhiṣūpatiḥ / āgāradāhī kuṇḍāśī somavikrayiṇo dvijāḥ
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas one should not stand near if one perspires profusely, he should not see* the crows and other birds going contrary to the natural order. The Pitrs desirous of eating, come there assuming those forms.
verses.hindi: अग्निहोत्र करना चाहिए । पक्षके अन्तमें अमावास्या और पौर्णमासीको अग्निहोत्रं तु जुहुयादाद्यन्तेऽहर्निशोः सदा। हवन (दर्शेष्टि एवं पौर्णमासेष्टि) करना चाहिए। द्विजको दर्शेन चैव पक्षान्ते पौर्णमासेन चैव हि॥ १ ॥  फसल कट जानेपर नवशस्येष्टि, ऋतुकी समाप्तिपर शस्यान्ते नवशस्येष्टया तथर्त्वन्ते द्विजोऽध्वरः । (किया जानेवाला) यज्ञ एवं अयनके अन्तमं अर्थात् पशुना त्वयनस्यान्ते समान्ते सौमिकैर्मखैः॥ २ ॥ छः ४: महीनेपर संवत्सरके अन्तमें सौमिक याग करना चाहिए। दीर्घ आयुकी इच्छा करनेवाले अग्निहोत्री
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahmanas one should not stand near if one perspires profusely, he should not see* the crows and other birds going contrary to the natural order. The Pitrs desirous of eating, come there assuming those forms.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmanas one should not stand near if one perspires profusely, he should not see* the crows and other birds going contrary to the natural order. The Pitrs desirous of eating, come there assuming those forms.

verses.sanskrit: परिवेत्ता तथा हिंस्त्रः परिवित्तिर्निराकृतिः । पौनर्भवः कुसीदी च तथा नक्षत्रदर्शकः
verses.transliteration: parivettā tathā hiṃstraḥ parivittirnirākṛtiḥ / paunarbhavaḥ kusīdī ca tathā nakṣatradarśakaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas one should not stand near if one perspires profusely, he should not see* the crows and other birds going contrary to the natural order. The Pitrs desirous of eating, come there assuming those forms.
verses.hindi: नानिष्ठा नवशस्येष्ट्या पशुना वाग्रिमान् द्विज: । द्विजको नवशस्येष्टि किये बिना नया अन्न नहीं खाना नवान्नमद्यान्मांसं वा दीर्घमायुर्जिजीविषुः॥ ३ ॥  चाहिए। नवीन अन्नका आग्निमें हवन किये विना नवेनान्नेन चानिष्ठा पशुहव्येन चाग्नयः। नवान्न खानेका इच्छुक व्यक्ति अपने प्राणोको ही
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahmanas one should not stand near if one perspires profusely, he should not see* the crows and other birds going contrary to the natural order. The Pitrs desirous of eating, come there assuming those forms.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmanas one should not stand near if one perspires profusely, he should not see* the crows and other birds going contrary to the natural order. The Pitrs desirous of eating, come there assuming those forms.

verses.sanskrit: गीतवादित्रनिरतो व्याधितः काण एव च । हीनाङ्गश्चातिरिक्ताङ्गो ह्यवकीर्णिस्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: gītavāditranirato vyādhitaḥ kāṇa eva ca / hīnāṅgaścātiriktāṅgo hyavakīrṇistathaiva ca
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas one should not stand near if one perspires profusely, he should not see* the crows and other birds going contrary to the natural order. The Pitrs desirous of eating, come there assuming those forms.
verses.hindi: पर्वोमें सावित्रीहोम प्राणानेवात्तुमिच्छन्ति नवान्नामिषगृद्धिनः॥ ४ ॥ खाना चाहता है। प्रत्येक पर्वोमें नित्य ही सा ओं अं तु गाब्द शान्ति-होम करना चाहिए तथा अष्टकाओं और सावित्रान् शान्तिहोमांश्च कुर्यात् पर्वसु नित्यशः। अन्वष्टकाओंमें नियमसे नित्य पितरोंकी अर्चना करनी पितृंश्चैवाष्टकास्वर्चन् नित्यमन्वष्टकासु च॥ ५ ॥  चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahmanas one should not stand near if one perspires profusely, he should not see* the crows and other birds going contrary to the natural order. The Pitrs desirous of eating, come there assuming those forms.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmanas one should not stand near if one perspires profusely, he should not see* the crows and other birds going contrary to the natural order. The Pitrs desirous of eating, come there assuming those forms.

verses.sanskrit: कन्यादूषी कुण्डगोलौ अभिशस्तो ऽथ देवलः । मित्रध्रुक् पिशुनश्चैव नित्यं भार्यानुवर्तकः
verses.transliteration: kanyādūṣī kuṇḍagolau abhiśasto 'tha devalaḥ / mitradhruk piśunaścaiva nityaṃ bhāryānuvartakaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas one should not stand near if one perspires profusely, he should not see* the crows and other birds going contrary to the natural order. The Pitrs desirous of eating, come there assuming those forms.
verses.hindi: एष धर्मः परो नित्यमपधर्मोऽन्य उच्यते। गृहस्थाश्रममें निवास करनेवाले तीनों वर्णों (द्विजाति)-
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahmanas one should not stand near if one perspires profusely, he should not see* the crows and other birds going contrary to the natural order. The Pitrs desirous of eating, come there assuming those forms.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmanas one should not stand near if one perspires profusely, he should not see* the crows and other birds going contrary to the natural order. The Pitrs desirous of eating, come there assuming those forms.

verses.sanskrit: मातापित्रोर्गुरोस्त्यागी दारत्यागी तथैव च । गोत्रभिद् भ्रष्टशौचश्च काण्डस्पृष्टस्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: mātāpitrorgurostyāgī dāratyāgī tathaiva ca / gotrabhid bhraṣṭaśaucaśca kāṇḍaspṛṣṭastathaiva ca
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas one should not stand near if one perspires profusely, he should not see* the crows and other birds going contrary to the natural order. The Pitrs desirous of eating, come there assuming those forms.
verses.hindi: त्रयाणामिह वर्णानां गृहस्थाश्रमवासिनाम्॥ ६ ॥  का यह नियमित श्रेष्ठ धर्म है, अन्य धर्म अपधमं कहलाता है। नास्तिकता अथवा आलस्यके कारण जो नास्तिक्यादथवालस्याद् योऽग्रीन् नाधातुमिच्छति। अग्नियोंका आधान एवं यज्ञसे यजन नहीं करना चाहता, यजेत वा न यज्ञेन स याति नरकान् बहून्॥ ७ ॥  वह बहुतसे नरकोंमें जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahmanas one should not stand near if one perspires profusely, he should not see* the crows and other birds going contrary to the natural order. The Pitrs desirous of eating, come there assuming those forms.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmanas one should not stand near if one perspires profusely, he should not see* the crows and other birds going contrary to the natural order. The Pitrs desirous of eating, come there assuming those forms.

verses.sanskrit: अनपत्यः कूटसाक्षी याचको रङ्गजीवकः । समुद्रयायी कृतहा तथा समयभेदकः
verses.transliteration: anapatyaḥ kūṭasākṣī yācako raṅgajīvakaḥ / samudrayāyī kṛtahā tathā samayabhedakaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas one should not stand near if one perspires profusely, he should not see* the crows and other birds going contrary to the natural order. The Pitrs desirous of eating, come there assuming those forms.
verses.hindi: तामिस्त्रमन्धतामिस्त्र महारौरवरौरवौ। विप्रो! (अग्न्याधान आदि कृत्य न करनेवाला)
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahmanas one should not stand near if one perspires profusely, he should not see* the crows and other birds going contrary to the natural order. The Pitrs desirous of eating, come there assuming those forms.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmanas one should not stand near if one perspires profusely, he should not see* the crows and other birds going contrary to the natural order. The Pitrs desirous of eating, come there assuming those forms.

verses.sanskrit: देवनिन्दापरश्चैव वेदनिन्दारतस्तथा । द्विजनिन्दारतश्चैते वर्ज्याः श्राद्धादिकर्मसु
verses.transliteration: devanindāparaścaiva vedanindāratastathā / dvijanindārataścaite varjyāḥ śrāddhādikarmasu
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas one should not stand near if one perspires profusely, he should not see* the crows and other birds going contrary to the natural order. The Pitrs desirous of eating, come there assuming those forms.
verses.hindi: कुम्भीपाकं वैतरणीमसिपत्रवनं तथा॥ ८ ॥  वह दुर्मति तामिस्र, अन्धतामिस्र, महारौरव, रौरव, नरकोंको प्राकर बादमें अन्त्यजोंके कुल तथा शूद्रयोनिमें जन्म लेता है। अत: विशेषरूपसे विशुद्धात्मा ब्राह्मणोंको
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahmanas one should not stand near if one perspires profusely, he should not see* the crows and other birds going contrary to the natural order. The Pitrs desirous of eating, come there assuming those forms.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmanas one should not stand near if one perspires profusely, he should not see* the crows and other birds going contrary to the natural order. The Pitrs desirous of eating, come there assuming those forms.

verses.sanskrit: कृतघ्नः पिशुनः क्रूरो नास्तिको वेदनिन्दकः । मित्रध्रुक् कुहकश्चैव विशेषात् पङ्क्तिदूषकाः
verses.transliteration: kṛtaghnaḥ piśunaḥ krūro nāstiko vedanindakaḥ / mitradhruk kuhakaścaiva viśeṣāt paṅktidūṣakāḥ
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas one should not stand near if one perspires profusely, he should not see* the crows and other birds going contrary to the natural order. The Pitrs desirous of eating, come there assuming those forms.
verses.hindi: तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन ब्राह्मणो हि विशेषतः। सभी प्रकारके प्रयल्रोंद्वारा अग्निका आधानकर परमेश्वरका
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahmanas one should not stand near if one perspires profusely, he should not see* the crows and other birds going contrary to the natural order. The Pitrs desirous of eating, come there assuming those forms.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmanas one should not stand near if one perspires profusely, he should not see* the crows and other birds going contrary to the natural order. The Pitrs desirous of eating, come there assuming those forms.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे पुनरभोज्यान्नास्त्वदानार्हाश्च कर्मसु । ब्रह्मभावनिरस्ताश्च वर्जनीयाः प्रयत्नतः
verses.transliteration: sarve punarabhojyānnāstvadānārhāśca karmasu / brahmabhāvanirastāśca varjanīyāḥ prayatnataḥ
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas one should not stand near if one perspires profusely, he should not see* the crows and other birds going contrary to the natural order. The Pitrs desirous of eating, come there assuming those forms.
verses.hindi: आधायाग्निं विशुद्धात्मा यजेत परमेश्वरम्। यजन-पूजन करना चाहिए। द्विजोंके लिये अग्निहोत्रसे तलाक काड FRR श्रेष्ठ कोई अन्य धर्म नहीं है। इसलिये अग्निहोत्रके अग्निहोत्रात् परो धर्मो द्विजानां नेह विद्यते। द्वारा नित्य शाश्वत (पुरुष)-की आराधना करनी शाश्वतम्॥ ११॥  चाहिए। जो अग्निका आधानकर फिर आलस्यवश
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahmanas one should not stand near if one perspires profusely, he should not see* the crows and other birds going contrary to the natural order. The Pitrs desirous of eating, come there assuming those forms.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmanas one should not stand near if one perspires profusely, he should not see* the crows and other birds going contrary to the natural order. The Pitrs desirous of eating, come there assuming those forms.

verses.sanskrit: शूद्रान्नरसपुष्टाङ्गः संध्योपासनवर्जितः । महायज्ञविहीनश्च ब्राह्मणः पङ्क्तिदूषकः
verses.transliteration: śūdrānnarasapuṣṭāṅgaḥ saṃdhyopāsanavarjitaḥ / mahāyajñavihīnaśca brāhmaṇaḥ paṅktidūṣakaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas one should not stand near if one perspires profusely, he should not see* the crows and other birds going contrary to the natural order. The Pitrs desirous of eating, come there assuming those forms.
verses.hindi: यज्ञद्वारा देवताकी आराधना नहीं करना चाहता, वह
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahmanas one should not stand near if one perspires profusely, he should not see* the crows and other birds going contrary to the natural order. The Pitrs desirous of eating, come there assuming those forms.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmanas one should not stand near if one perspires profusely, he should not see* the crows and other birds going contrary to the natural order. The Pitrs desirous of eating, come there assuming those forms.

verses.sanskrit: अधीतनाशनश्चैव स्नानहोमविवर्जितः । तामसो राजसश्चैव ब्राह्मणः पङ्क्तिदूषकः
verses.transliteration: adhītanāśanaścaiva snānahomavivarjitaḥ / tāmaso rājasaścaiva brāhmaṇaḥ paṅktidūṣakaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas one should not stand near if one perspires profusely, he should not see* the crows and other birds going contrary to the natural order. The Pitrs desirous of eating, come there assuming those forms.
verses.hindi: यष्टुं देवमिच्छति। व्यक्ति मूढ़ होता है, उससे बात नहीं करनी चाहिए। सोऽसौ मूढो न सम्भाष्य: किं पुनर्नास्तिको जनः॥ १२॥  अधिक क्या, वह मनुष्य नास्तिक होता है
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahmanas one should not stand near if one perspires profusely, he should not see* the crows and other birds going contrary to the natural order. The Pitrs desirous of eating, come there assuming those forms.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmanas one should not stand near if one perspires profusely, he should not see* the crows and other birds going contrary to the natural order. The Pitrs desirous of eating, come there assuming those forms.

verses.sanskrit: बहुनात्र किमुक्तेन विहितान् ये न कुर्वते । निन्दितानाचरन्त्येते वर्जनीयाः प्रयत्नतः
verses.transliteration: bahunātra kimuktena vihitān ye na kurvate / ninditānācarantyete varjanīyāḥ prayatnataḥ
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas one should not stand near if one perspires profusely, he should not see* the crows and other birds going contrary to the natural order. The Pitrs desirous of eating, come there assuming those forms.
verses.hindi: अन्यांश्च नरकान् घोरान् सम्प्राप्यान्ते सुदुर्मतिः । अन्त्यजानां कुले विप्राः शूद्रयोनौ च जायते
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahmanas one should not stand near if one perspires profusely, he should not see* the crows and other birds going contrary to the natural order. The Pitrs desirous of eating, come there assuming those forms.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmanas one should not stand near if one perspires profusely, he should not see* the crows and other birds going contrary to the natural order. The Pitrs desirous of eating, come there assuming those forms.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे एकविशो ऽध्याय इन् रेए निछ्त् ज़ुल्äस्सिगे ज़ेइछेन्: व्यास उवाच गोमयेनोदकैर्भूमिं शोधयित्वा समाहितः । संनिपात्य द्विजान् सर्वान् साधुभिः संनिमन्त्रयेत्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge ekaviśo 'dhyāya in ree nicht zulässige zeichen: vyāsa uvāca gomayenodakairbhūmiṃ śodhayitvā samāhitaḥ / saṃnipātya dvijān sarvān sādhubhiḥ saṃnimantrayet
verses.translation: He should not directly give salt into the hand. Nor should the food be served in an iron vessel. It should never be served with carelessness.
verses.hindi: एष वै सर्वयज्ञानां सोमः प्रथम इष्यते। सोमेनाराधयेद् देवं सोमलोकमहेश्वरम् न सोमयागादधिको महेशाराधने क्रतुः। समो वा विद्यते तस्मात् सोमेनाभ्यर्चयेत् परम्
verses.wordMeaning: He should not directly give salt into the hand. Nor should the food be served in an iron vessel. It should never be served with carelessness.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should not directly give salt into the hand. Nor should the food be served in an iron vessel. It should never be served with carelessness.

verses.sanskrit: श्वो भविष्यति मे श्राद्धं पूर्वेद्युरभिपूज्य च । असंभवे परेद्युर्वा यथोक्तैर्लक्षणैर्युतान्
verses.transliteration: śvo bhaviṣyati me śrāddhaṃ pūrvedyurabhipūjya ca / asaṃbhave paredyurvā yathoktairlakṣaṇairyutān
verses.translation: What is offered in the following types of vessels yields everlasting benefit viz.—golden, silvery, made of Udumbara wood or made of horn of rhenoceros.
verses.hindi: श्रेयस्करतमः श्रौतस्तस्माच्छौतं समाच्रेत्
verses.wordMeaning: What is offered in the following types of vessels yields everlasting benefit viz.—golden, silvery, made of Udumbara wood or made of horn of rhenoceros.
verses.commentary: Sense: What is offered in the following types of vessels yields everlasting benefit viz.—golden, silvery, made of Udumbara wood or made of horn of rhenoceros.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य ते पितरः श्रुत्वा श्राद्धकालमुपस्थितम् । अन्योन्यं मनसा ध्यात्वा संपतन्ति मनोजवाः
verses.transliteration: tasya te pitaraḥ śrutvā śrāddhakālamupasthitam / anyonyaṃ manasā dhyātvā saṃpatanti manojavāḥ
verses.translation: He who feeds Brahmanas in mud pots at the time of of the Sraddha falls into the terrible hell. He who partakes of the offerings too falls into the hell.
verses.hindi: उभावभिहितौ धर्मौ वेदादेव विनिःसृतौ। धर्मेणाभिगतो यैस्तु वेदः सपरिबृंहण:। ते शिष्टा ब्राह्मणाः प्रोक्ता नित्यमात्मगुणान्विता:
verses.wordMeaning: He who feeds Brahmanas in mud pots at the time of of the Sraddha falls into the terrible hell. He who partakes of the offerings too falls into the hell.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who feeds Brahmanas in mud pots at the time of of the Sraddha falls into the terrible hell. He who partakes of the offerings too falls into the hell.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणैस्ते सहाश्नन्ति पितरो ह्यन्तरिक्षगाः । वायुभूतास्तु तिष्ठन्ति भुक्त्वा यान्ति परां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇaiste sahāśnanti pitaro hyantarikṣagāḥ / vāyubhūtāstu tiṣṭhanti bhuktvā yānti parāṃ gatim
verses.translation: One should not discriminate between persons sitting in the same row and serve irregularly. One shall not beg nor force anyone to give (?). He who begs, who forces anyone to give and who serves with partiality falls into the terrible hells.
verses.hindi: स धर्मः कथितः सद्धिर्नान्येषामिति धारणा
verses.wordMeaning: One should not discriminate between persons sitting in the same row and serve irregularly. One shall not beg nor force anyone to give (?). He who begs, who forces anyone to give and who serves with partiality falls into the terrible hells.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not discriminate between persons sitting in the same row and serve irregularly. One shall not beg nor force anyone to give (?). He who begs, who forces anyone to give and who serves with partiality falls into the terrible hells.

verses.sanskrit: आमन्त्रिताश्च ते विप्राः श्राद्धकाल उपस्थिते । वसेयुर्नियताः सर्वे ब्रह्मचर्यपरायणाः
verses.transliteration: āmantritāśca te viprāḥ śrāddhakāla upasthite / vaseyurniyatāḥ sarve brahmacaryaparāyaṇāḥ
verses.translation: They should eat the most excellent things prior to others, (v. 1. vagyatah 'observing silence'). But they should not speak out their material good qualities (?). The Pitrs partake of food only as long as the qualities of the Havis are not mentioned.
verses.hindi: पुराणं धर्मशास्त्रं च वेदानामुपबृंहणम्। एकस्माद् ब्रह्मविज्ञानं धर्मज्ञानं तथेकतः धर्म जिज्ञासमानानां तत्प्रमाणतरं स्मृतम्। धर्मशास्त्रं पुराणं तद् ब्रह्मज्ञाने परा प्रमा
verses.wordMeaning: They should eat the most excellent things prior to others, (v. 1. vagyatah 'observing silence'). But they should not speak out their material good qualities (?). The Pitrs partake of food only as long as the qualities of the Havis are not mentioned.
verses.commentary: Sense: They should eat the most excellent things prior to others, (v. 1. vagyatah 'observing silence'). But they should not speak out their material good qualities (?). The Pitrs partake of food only as long as the qualities of the Havis are not mentioned.

verses.sanskrit: अक्रोधनो ऽत्वरो ऽमत्तः सत्यवादी समाहितः । भारं मैथुनमध्वानं श्राद्धकृद् वर्जयेज्जपम्
verses.transliteration: akrodhano 'tvaro 'mattaḥ satyavādī samāhitaḥ / bhāraṃ maithunamadhvānaṃ śrāddhakṛd varjayejjapam
verses.translation: The Brahmana occupying the seat of priority should not eat it at the very outset. If he eats while many look on, he will incur the sin of all sitting in the row.
verses.hindi: नान्यतो जायते धर्मो ब्रह्मविद्या च वैदिकी। तस्माद् धर्म पुराणं च श्रद्धातव्यं द्विजातिभिः
verses.wordMeaning: The Brahmana occupying the seat of priority should not eat it at the very outset. If he eats while many look on, he will incur the sin of all sitting in the row.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Brahmana occupying the seat of priority should not eat it at the very outset. If he eats while many look on, he will incur the sin of all sitting in the row.

verses.sanskrit: आमन्त्रितो ब्राह्मणो वा यो ऽन्यस्मै कुरुते क्षणम् । स याति नरकं घोरं सूकरत्वां प्रायाति च
verses.transliteration: āmantrito brāhmaṇo vā yo 'nyasmai kurute kṣaṇam / sa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ sūkaratvāṃ prāyāti ca
verses.translation: If the Brahmana who engaged in the Pitr rite, does not partake of the meat served, he is reborn as an animal for twenty-one births.
verses.hindi: जिसके पास सेवकोंके पोषणहेतु तीन वर्षतकके लिये पर्याप्त अथवा उससे भी अधिक (भोजन) सामग्री विद्यमान हो, वह सोमपानका अधिकारी होता है। सभी यज्ञोंमें सोमयाग सबसे श्रेष्ठ है। सोमद्वारा सोमलोकमें स्थित महेश्वरदेवकी आराधना करनी चाहिए। महेश्वरकी आराधनाके लिये सोमयागसे बड़ा अथवा उसके समान कोई यज्ञ नहीं है। इसलिये सोमके द्वारा श्रे-्ठ देवकी आराधना करनी चाहिए॥ १३--१५॥
verses.wordMeaning: If the Brahmana who engaged in the Pitr rite, does not partake of the meat served, he is reborn as an animal for twenty-one births.
verses.commentary: Sense: If the Brahmana who engaged in the Pitr rite, does not partake of the meat served, he is reborn as an animal for twenty-one births.

verses.sanskrit: आमन्त्रयित्वा यो मोहादन्यं चामन्त्रयेद् द्विजम् । स तस्मादधिकः पापी विष्ठाकीटो ऽभिजायते
verses.transliteration: āmantrayitvā yo mohādanyaṃ cāmantrayed dvijam / sa tasmādadhikaḥ pāpī viṣṭhākīṭo 'bhijāyate
verses.translation: One shall read or narrate unto these Vedic passages of self-study, the Dharmasastras, Itihasas, Puranas and the auspicious Sraddhakalpas.
verses.hindi: ब्राह्मणोंकी मुक्तिके लिये साक्षात् पितामहने आरम्भमें ही शुभ धर्म बतलाया है, वह श्रौत तथा स्मार्त नामसे दो प्रकारका है। तीन (आहवनीय, दक्षिणाग्नि, गार्हपत्याग्नि) अग्नियोंके सम्बन्धसे श्रौतधर्म होता है। स्मार्तधर्मको मैंने
verses.wordMeaning: One shall read or narrate unto these Vedic passages of self-study, the Dharmasastras, Itihasas, Puranas and the auspicious Sraddhakalpas.
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall read or narrate unto these Vedic passages of self-study, the Dharmasastras, Itihasas, Puranas and the auspicious Sraddhakalpas.

verses.sanskrit: श्राद्धे निमन्त्रितो विप्रो मैथुनं यो ऽधिगच्छति । ब्रह्महत्यामवाप्नोति तिर्यग्योनौ च जायते
verses.transliteration: śrāddhe nimantrito vipro maithunaṃ yo 'dhigacchati / brahmahatyāmavāpnoti tiryagyonau ca jāyate
verses.translation: Then the partaker of the food should strew the cooked food in front on the ground. He shall ask them Svaditam? "Well tasted?". If they are satisfied, he should make them perform the Acamana rite.
verses.hindi: पूर्वमें बता दिया है। श्रौतधर्म अधिक श्रेयस्कर है, इसलिये श्रौतधर्मका पालन करना चाहिए। कहे गये ये दोनों धर्म वेदसे ही निकले हुए हैं। श्रुति तथा स्मृतिके अभाममें शिष्टाचार ही तीसरा धर्म होता है॥ १६--१८ ॥ परिबृंहण (रामायण, महाभारत एवं पुराणादि ग्रन्थ) सहित वेदोंका धर्मपूर्वक ज्ञान प्राप्त करनेवाले और (दया, अहिंसा, सत्य आदि आठ) आत्मिक गुणोंसे सम्पन्न ब्राह्मण सहैव शिष्ट कहे गये हैं। इनके (शिष्टजनोंके)
verses.wordMeaning: Then the partaker of the food should strew the cooked food in front on the ground. He shall ask them Svaditam? "Well tasted?". If they are satisfied, he should make them perform the Acamana rite.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the partaker of the food should strew the cooked food in front on the ground. He shall ask them Svaditam? "Well tasted?". If they are satisfied, he should make them perform the Acamana rite.

verses.sanskrit: निमन्त्रितस्तु यो विप्रो ह्यध्वानं याति दुर्मतिः । भवन्ति पितरस्तस्य तं मासं पांशुभोजनाः
verses.transliteration: nimantritastu yo vipro hyadhvānaṃ yāti durmatiḥ / bhavanti pitarastasya taṃ māsaṃ pāṃśubhojanāḥ
verses.translation: If they have performed the Acamana rite, he should permit them saying 'Be diverted'. Thereafter, the Brahmanas- shall say to him—"May Svadha be unto you."
verses.hindi: अन्त:करणद्वारा जो समर्थित होता है, दिद्वानोंद्वारा उसे ही धर्म कहा गया है। अन्य लोगोंके अभिमतको धर्म नहीं कहा जाता, यही निश्चित सिद्धान्त है
verses.wordMeaning: If they have performed the Acamana rite, he should permit them saying 'Be diverted'. Thereafter, the Brahmanas- shall say to him—"May Svadha be unto you."
verses.commentary: Sense: If they have performed the Acamana rite, he should permit them saying 'Be diverted'. Thereafter, the Brahmanas- shall say to him—"May Svadha be unto you."

verses.sanskrit: निमन्त्रितस्तु यः श्राद्धे प्रकुर्यात् कलहं द्विजः । भवन्ति तस्य तन्मासं पितरो मलभोजनाः
verses.transliteration: nimantritastu yaḥ śrāddhe prakuryāt kalahaṃ dvijaḥ / bhavanti tasya tanmāsaṃ pitaro malabhojanāḥ
verses.translation: When they have partaken of the food he should inform them about remaining cooked food. On being permitted by those Brahmanas, he should do as they mention.
verses.hindi: पुराण तथा धर्मशास्त्र वेदोंके उपबृंहण (विस्तार) हैं। एकसे ब्रह्मका विशेष ज्ञान होता है और दूसरेसे धर्मका ज्ञान होता है। धर्मकी जिज्ञासा करनेवालोंके लिये धर्मशास्त्र श्रेष्ठ प्रमाण कहा गया है और ब्रह्मज्ञानके लिये पुराण उत्कृष्ट प्रमाण है। वेदसे अतिरिक्त अन्य किसीसे धर्मका तथा वैदिक ब्रह्मविद्याका ज्ञान नहीं होता, इसलिये द्विजातियोंको धर्मशास्त्र तथा पुराणपर श्रद्धा रखनी चाहिए॥ २१--२३॥
verses.wordMeaning: When they have partaken of the food he should inform them about remaining cooked food. On being permitted by those Brahmanas, he should do as they mention.
verses.commentary: Sense: When they have partaken of the food he should inform them about remaining cooked food. On being permitted by those Brahmanas, he should do as they mention.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मान्निमन्त्रितः श्राद्धे नियतात्मा भवेद् द्विजः । अक्रोधनः शौचपरः कर्ता चैव जितेन्द्रियः
verses.transliteration: tasmānnimantritaḥ śrāddhe niyatātmā bhaved dvijaḥ / akrodhanaḥ śaucaparaḥ kartā caiva jitendriyaḥ
verses.translation: In the Pitr rite, the wordSvaditam is to be mentioned,,
verses.hindi: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे पट्साहर्रयां साहितायामुपरिविभागे चातुर्विशोऽध्यायः
verses.wordMeaning: In the Pitr rite, the wordSvaditam is to be mentioned,,
verses.commentary: Sense: In the Pitr rite, the wordSvaditam is to be mentioned,,

verses.sanskrit: श्वोभूते दक्षिणां गत्वा दिशं दर्भान् समाहितः । समूलानाहरेद् वारि दक्षिणाग्रान् सुनिर्मलान्
verses.transliteration: śvobhūte dakṣiṇāṃ gatvā diśaṃ darbhān samāhitaḥ / samūlānāhared vāri dakṣiṇāgrān sunirmalān
verses.translation: After eulogising and bidding farewell to the Bramanas, he should stand silently before the Pitrs facing the southern direction and beg of the Pitrs these boons.
verses.hindi: शिष्टाचारका भी मूल श्रुति एवं तन्मूलक स्मृति ही होती है। श्रुतियाँ अनन्त हैं, उनमें वर्णित धर्मोका क्रमसे प्रसंगानुसार संग्रह करनेवाली स्मृतियाँ भी अनेक हैं। अत: सभी श्रुतियों एवं तन्मूलक स्मृतियोंका ज्ञान अल्पज्ञ मानवको नहीं भी हो सकता है। ऐसी स्थितिमें धर्माधर्म-विवेकमें कठिनाई होना अस्वाभाविक नहीं है। इसीलिये शिष्टोंके आजारसे धर्माधर्मका निर्णय करना पड़ता है और इस निर्णयके मूलमें यही भाव निहित है कि शिष्ट वही आचरण करते हैं जो श्रुति एं तन्मूलक स्मृतिमें प्रतिपादित है।
verses.wordMeaning: After eulogising and bidding farewell to the Bramanas, he should stand silently before the Pitrs facing the southern direction and beg of the Pitrs these boons.
verses.commentary: Sense: After eulogising and bidding farewell to the Bramanas, he should stand silently before the Pitrs facing the southern direction and beg of the Pitrs these boons.

verses.sanskrit: दक्षिणाप्रवणं स्निग्धं विभक्तं शुभलक्षणम् । शुचिं देशं विविक्तं च गोमयेनोपलेपयेत्
verses.transliteration: dakṣiṇāpravaṇaṃ snigdhaṃ vibhaktaṃ śubhalakṣaṇam / śuciṃ deśaṃ viviktaṃ ca gomayenopalepayet
verses.translation: "May those charitable donors around flourish. May the Vedas and progeny flourish. May not our faith decrease. May there be much with us to be given."
verses.hindi: गृहस्थ ब्राह्मणकी मुख्य वृत्ति तथा आपत्कालकी वृत्ति, गृहस्थके साधक तथा असाधक दो भेद, न्यायोपार्जित धनका विभाग एवं उसका उपयोग
verses.wordMeaning: "May those charitable donors around flourish. May the Vedas and progeny flourish. May not our faith decrease. May there be much with us to be given."
verses.commentary: Sense: "May those charitable donors around flourish. May the Vedas and progeny flourish. May not our faith decrease. May there be much with us to be given."

verses.sanskrit: नदीतीरेषु तीर्थेषु स्वभूमौ चैव सानुषु । विविक्तेषु च तुष्यन्ति दत्तेन पितरः सदा
verses.transliteration: nadītīreṣu tīrtheṣu svabhūmau caiva sānuṣu / vivikteṣu ca tuṣyanti dattena pitaraḥ sadā
verses.translation: He shall give the Pindasto the cows, goats or Brah¬ manas. Or he should consign them to the fire or to the water. The wife who is desirous of a son shall partake of the middle Pinda.
verses.hindi: द्विजातेः परमो धर्मो वर्तनानि निबोधत स्वयं वा कर्षणं कुर्याद् वाणिज्यं वा कुसीदकम्। कष्टा पापीयसी वृत्तिः कुसीदं तद् विवर्जयेत्
verses.wordMeaning: He shall give the Pindasto the cows, goats or Brah¬ manas. Or he should consign them to the fire or to the water. The wife who is desirous of a son shall partake of the middle Pinda.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall give the Pindasto the cows, goats or Brah¬ manas. Or he should consign them to the fire or to the water. The wife who is desirous of a son shall partake of the middle Pinda.

verses.sanskrit: पारक्ये भूमिभागे तु पितॄणां नैव निर्वपेत् । स्वामिभिस्तद् विहन्येत मोहाद् यत् क्रियते नरैः
verses.transliteration: pārakye bhūmibhāge tu pitṝṇāṃ naiva nirvapet / svāmibhistad vihanyeta mohād yat kriyate naraiḥ
verses.translation: He should then wash his hands and perform the Acamana rite. With the food that remains, he shall feed his own servants.
verses.hindi: ्षात्रवृत्तिं परां प्राहुर्न स्वयं कर्षणं द्विजेः। तस्मात् क्षात्रेण वर्तेत वर्तनेनापदि द्विजः:
verses.wordMeaning: He should then wash his hands and perform the Acamana rite. With the food that remains, he shall feed his own servants.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should then wash his hands and perform the Acamana rite. With the food that remains, he shall feed his own servants.

verses.sanskrit: अटव्यः पर्वताः पुण्यास्तीर्थान्यायतनानि च । सर्वाण्यस्वामिकान्याहुर्न हि तेषु परिग्रहः
verses.transliteration: aṭavyaḥ parvatāḥ puṇyāstīrthānyāyatanāni ca / sarvāṇyasvāmikānyāhurna hi teṣu parigrahaḥ
verses.translation: Afterwards he himself should take the remaining food alongwith the womenfolk. One should not remove their leavings before sunset.
verses.hindi: न कथंचन कुर्वीत ब्राह्मणः कर्म कर्षीणम् लब्धलाभः पितृन् देवान् ब्राह्मणांश्चापि पूजयेत्। ते तृप्तास्तस्य तं दोषं शमयन्ति न संशय:
verses.wordMeaning: Afterwards he himself should take the remaining food alongwith the womenfolk. One should not remove their leavings before sunset.
verses.commentary: Sense: Afterwards he himself should take the remaining food alongwith the womenfolk. One should not remove their leavings before sunset.

verses.sanskrit: तिलान् प्रविकिरेत् तत्र सर्वतो बन्धयेदजान् । असुरोपहतं सर्वं तिलैः शुद्ध्यत्यजेन वा
verses.transliteration: tilān pravikiret tatra sarvato bandhayedajān / asuropahataṃ sarvaṃ tilaiḥ śuddhyatyajena vā
verses.translation: He should be pure and clean; quiescent and truth¬ ful. He should not be furious. He shall have good concentration. The performer and the partaker should avoid self-study and travel.
verses.hindi: देवेभ्यश्च पितृभ्यश्च दद्याद् भागं तु विंशकम्। त्रिंशद्धागं ब्राह्मणानां कृषिं कुर्वन् न दुष्यति
verses.wordMeaning: He should be pure and clean; quiescent and truth¬ ful. He should not be furious. He shall have good concentration. The performer and the partaker should avoid self-study and travel.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should be pure and clean; quiescent and truth¬ ful. He should not be furious. He shall have good concentration. The performer and the partaker should avoid self-study and travel.

verses.sanskrit: ततो ऽन्नं बहुसंस्कारं नैकव्यञ्जनमच्युतम् । चोष्यपेयसमृद्धं च यथाशक्त्या प्रकल्पयेत्
verses.transliteration: tato 'nnaṃ bahusaṃskāraṃ naikavyañjanamacyutam / coṣyapeyasamṛddhaṃ ca yathāśaktyā prakalpayet
verses.translation: The Brahmanas, who partake of another Sraddha (immediately) after partaking of a Sraddha, are on a par with the great sinners. They fall into many hells.
verses.hindi: व्यासजीने कहा--यह मैंने आप लोगोंको गृहस्थाश्रम- में निवास करनेवाले द्विजातियोंका सम्पूर्ण श्रेष्ठ धर्म बतलाया, अब उनको वृत्तियोंका वर्णन सुनें साधक तथा असाधक-भेदसे (ब्राह्मण) गृहस्थको दो प्रकारका समझना चाहिए। पहले (साधक गृहस्थको आजीविका) अध्ययन कराना, यज्ञ कराना और (दान लेना) है। इसके अतिरिक्त वे अपने द्वारा न किये
verses.wordMeaning: The Brahmanas, who partake of another Sraddha (immediately) after partaking of a Sraddha, are on a par with the great sinners. They fall into many hells.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Brahmanas, who partake of another Sraddha (immediately) after partaking of a Sraddha, are on a par with the great sinners. They fall into many hells.

verses.sanskrit: ततो निवृत्ते मध्याह्ने लुप्तलोमनखान् द्विजान् । अभिगम्य यथामार्गं प्रयच्छेद् दन्तधावनम्
verses.transliteration: tato nivṛtte madhyāhne luptalomanakhān dvijān / abhigamya yathāmārgaṃ prayacched dantadhāvanam
verses.translation: Thus the Sraddhakalpa has been explained briefly but clearly to you. A Brahmana in difficulties shall prosper by performing it.
verses.hindi: गये कुसीद (ब्याजका लेन-देन), कृषि तथा वाणिज्य भी अन्यके द्वारा करा सकते हैं। कृषिके अभावमें वाणिज्य और उसके अभावमें कुसीदका आश्रय लिया जा सकता है। इसे आपत्कल्प कहा गया है और
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the Sraddhakalpa has been explained briefly but clearly to you. A Brahmana in difficulties shall prosper by performing it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the Sraddhakalpa has been explained briefly but clearly to you. A Brahmana in difficulties shall prosper by performing it.

verses.sanskrit: तैलमभ्यञ्जनं स्नानं स्नानीयं च पृथग्विधम् । पात्रैरौदुम्बरैर्दद्याद् वैश्वदैवत्यपूर्वकम्
verses.transliteration: tailamabhyañjanaṃ snānaṃ snānīyaṃ ca pṛthagvidham / pātrairaudumbarairdadyād vaiśvadaivatyapūrvakam
verses.translation: When he performs Amairaddha (i.e. sraddha without cooked food) the knower of the procedure endowed with faith should perform the Agnaukarana?- rite (consigning offerings into the Are) as well as the offerings of Pindas with that alone (i.e. the material used).
verses.hindi: पहलेको मुख्यवृत्ति कही गयी है। अथवा (आपत्कालमें कुसीद-वृत्तिका आश्रय ले। कुसीद-वृत्ति (सूद लेना) अत्यन्त कष्टकारक और पापकी वृत्ति है, इसलिये इसका परित्याग करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: When he performs Amairaddha (i.e. sraddha without cooked food) the knower of the procedure endowed with faith should perform the Agnaukarana?- rite (consigning offerings into the Are) as well as the offerings of Pindas with that alone (i.e. the material used).
verses.commentary: Sense: When he performs Amairaddha (i.e. sraddha without cooked food) the knower of the procedure endowed with faith should perform the Agnaukarana?- rite (consigning offerings into the Are) as well as the offerings of Pindas with that alone (i.e. the material used).

verses.sanskrit: ततः स्नात्वा निवृत्तेभ्यः प्रत्युत्थायकृताञ्जलिः । पाद्यमाचमनीयं च संप्रयच्छेद् यथाक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ snātvā nivṛttebhyaḥ pratyutthāyakṛtāñjaliḥ / pādyamācamanīyaṃ ca saṃprayacched yathākramam
verses.translation: He whose mind is quiet, who is devoid of sins, and who performs Sraddha in accordance with this procedure shall attain the region of ascetics.
verses.hindi: ्षात्रवृत्तिको (कृषिवृत्तिकी अपेक्षा) श्रेष्ठ वृत्ति कहा गया है, किंतु द्विजोंको स्वयं कर्षण नहीं करना चाहिए। अतएव 'द्विजको आपत्तिमें (ही) क्षात्रधर्मसे भी जीविकाका निर्वाह करना चाहिए । उस क्षात्रवृत्ति (शस्त्र-जीविका)-
verses.wordMeaning: He whose mind is quiet, who is devoid of sins, and who performs Sraddha in accordance with this procedure shall attain the region of ascetics.
verses.commentary: Sense: He whose mind is quiet, who is devoid of sins, and who performs Sraddha in accordance with this procedure shall attain the region of ascetics.

verses.sanskrit: ये चात्र विश्वेदेवानां विप्राः पूर्वं निमन्त्रिताः । प्राङ्मुखान्यासनान्येषां त्रिदर्भोपहितानि च
verses.transliteration: ye cātra viśvedevānāṃ viprāḥ pūrvaṃ nimantritāḥ / prāṅmukhānyāsanānyeṣāṃ tridarbhopahitāni ca
verses.translation: Hence, an excellent Brahmana should assiduously perform the Sraddha rite. Thereby the eternal Isvara would be well-propitiated by him.
verses.hindi: द्वारा भी निर्वाह न होनेपर कृषिस्वरूप वैश्यवृत्तिका आश्रय लेना चाहिए, किंतु ब्राह्मणको कभी भी खेत जोतनेका कार्य नहीं करना चाहिए। लाभ होनेपर (विशेषकर अन्य वर्णकी जीविकासे लाभ मिलनेपर अवश्य ही) पितरों, देवताओं तथा ब्राह्मणोंका पूजन करना चाहिए। तृप्त होनेपर वे उसके उस (कर्मजन्य) दोषको शान्त कर देते हैं, इसमें संशय नहीं ॥ ५--७॥
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, an excellent Brahmana should assiduously perform the Sraddha rite. Thereby the eternal Isvara would be well-propitiated by him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, an excellent Brahmana should assiduously perform the Sraddha rite. Thereby the eternal Isvara would be well-propitiated by him.

verses.sanskrit: दक्षिणामुखयुक्तानि पितॄणामासनानि च । दक्षिणाग्रैकदर्भाणि प्रोक्षितानि तिलोदकैः
verses.transliteration: dakṣiṇāmukhayuktāni pitṝṇāmāsanāni ca / dakṣiṇāgraikadarbhāṇi prokṣitāni tilodakaiḥ
verses.translation: An indigent Brahmana may perform Sraddha even with fruits and roots after taking the ablution, with great concentration and performing the Pitr-Tarpana rites with water and gingelly seeds.
