verses.hindi: है, आशारहित है, संग्रहशून्य है, जितेन्द्रिय है तथा मोक्षकी इच्छा रखनेवाला है, बह वेदसंन्यासी कहा जाता है। जो अग्नियोंको आत्मसात्कर ब्रह्मार्पणतत्पर रहता है, उस महायज्ञपरायण (सतत ब्रह्मचिन्तन-परायण) द्विजको कर्मसंन्यासी जानना चाहिए। इन तीनोंमें ज्ञानी (ज्ञान-संन्यासी)-को अधिक श्रेष्ठ माना गया है। उस (ज्ञानी )-का न कोई कर्तव्य (शेष) रह जाता है ओर न कोई चिह्न ही होता है
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 19-34 describe the reward from dam on particular days.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 19-34 describe the reward from dam on particular days.

verses.sanskrit: मातापित्रोः सुतैः कार्यं पिण्डदानादिकं च यत् । पत्नी कुर्यात् सुताभावे पत्न्य भावे सहोदहः
verses.transliteration: mātāpitroḥ sutaiḥ kāryaṃ piṇḍadānādikaṃ ca yat / patnī kuryāt sutābhāve patnya bhāve sahodahaḥ
verses.translation: VV. 19-34 describe the reward from dam on particular days.
verses.hindi: संन्यासीको ममताशून्य, भयरहित, शान्त, द्वन्द्वोसे परे, पत्तोंका ही आहार करनेवाला, जीर्ण कौपीनको वस्त्र-रूपमें धारण करनेवाला अथवा नग्न और ध्यान- परायण होना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 19-34 describe the reward from dam on particular days.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 19-34 describe the reward from dam on particular days.

verses.sanskrit: अनेनैव विधाने जीवन् वा श्राद्धमाचरेत् । कृत्वा दानादिकं सर्वं श्रद्धायुक्तः समाहितः
verses.transliteration: anenaiva vidhāne jīvan vā śrāddhamācaret / kṛtvā dānādikaṃ sarvaṃ śraddhāyuktaḥ samāhitaḥ
verses.translation: VV. 19-34 describe the reward from dam on particular days.
verses.hindi: (संन्यासी) ब्रह्मचर्यका पालन करे, सीमित मात्रामें आहार ग्रहण करे, ग्रामसे अन्न माँगकर लाये। अध्यात्म (ज्ञान)-में बुद्धि रखे, निरपेक्ष रहे तथा निरामिष रहे। अपनी ही सहायतासे अर्थात् स्वावलम्बी होकर आत्मुष्टिके लिये इस संसारमें विचरण करे, न तो मृत्युका ही अभिनन्दन करे और न जीवनका अभिनन्दन करे। जिस प्रकार सेवक (अपने स्वामीके) आज्ञाकी प्रतीक्षा करता है, उसी प्रकार उसे भी कालकी प्रतीक्षा करनी चाहिए।
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 19-34 describe the reward from dam on particular days.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 19-34 describe the reward from dam on particular days.

verses.sanskrit: एष वः कथितः सम्यग् गृहस्थानां क्रियाविधिः । स्त्रीणां तु भर्तृशुश्रूषा धर्मो नान्य इहेष्यते
verses.transliteration: eṣa vaḥ kathitaḥ samyag gṛhasthānāṃ kriyāvidhiḥ / strīṇāṃ tu bhartṛśuśrūṣā dharmo nānya iheṣyate
verses.translation: VV. 19-34 describe the reward from dam on particular days.
verses.hindi: न कभी अध्ययन करे, न प्रवचन करे और न कुछ श्रवण ही करे। इस प्रकारका ज्ञान रखकर (आत्मनिष्ठ होकर) वह श्रेष्ठ योगी ब्रह्मस्वरूप हो जाता है॥ ११--१३॥
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 19-34 describe the reward from dam on particular days.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 19-34 describe the reward from dam on particular days.

verses.sanskrit: स्वधर्मपरमो नित्यमीश्विरार्पितमानसः । प्राप्नोति तत् परं स्थानं यदुक्तं वेदवादिभिः
verses.transliteration: svadharmaparamo nityamīśvirārpitamānasaḥ / prāpnoti tat paraṃ sthānaṃ yaduktaṃ vedavādibhiḥ
verses.translation: VV. 19-34 describe the reward from dam on particular days.
verses.hindi: विद्वान् संन्यासी (कोपीनके साथ) एक वस्त्र (उत्तरीय) धारण करे अथवा कौपीनमात्रसे शरीरका आच्छादन करे। मुण्डित सिर अथवा जटाधारी रहे। त्रिदण्डी रहे, संचयवृत्तिसे शून्य रहे। काषाय वस्त्र ही धारण करे और निरन्तर ध्यानयोगमें परायण रहे। उसे (संन्यासीको) ग्रामकी सीमापर, वृक्षके मूलमें अथवा किसी देवमन्दिरमें रहना चाहिए। शत्रु-मित्र तथा मान- अपमानमें समान रहना चाहिए। नित्य भिक्षावृत्तिसे
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 19-34 describe the reward from dam on particular days.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 19-34 describe the reward from dam on particular days.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे त्रयोविंशो ऽध्यायः व्यास उवाच अग्निहोत्रं तु जुहुयादाद्यन्ते ऽहर्निशोः सदा । दर्शेन चैव पक्षान्ते पौर्णमासेन चैव हि
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge trayoviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ vyāsa uvāca agnihotraṃ tu juhuyādādyante 'harniśoḥ sadā / darśena caiva pakṣānte paurṇamāsena caiva hi
verses.translation: VV. 4-8 give the classification of Danas as JJ'itya (daily), naimittika (occasional), Kamya {dana for obtaining a desirable object) and Vimala (pure) the last is a special class specified in the KP.
verses.hindi: निर्वाह करे। कभी भी उसे किसी एक ही व्यक्तिका अन्न खानेवाला नहीं होना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 4-8 give the classification of Danas as JJ'itya (daily), naimittika (occasional), Kamya {dana for obtaining a desirable object) and Vimala (pure) the last is a special class specified in the KP.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 4-8 give the classification of Danas as JJ'itya (daily), naimittika (occasional), Kamya {dana for obtaining a desirable object) and Vimala (pure) the last is a special class specified in the KP.

verses.sanskrit: शस्यान्ते नवशस्येष्ट्या तथर्त्वन्ते द्विजो ऽध्वरैः । पशुना त्वयनस्यान्ते समान्ते सौमिकैर्मखैः
verses.transliteration: śasyānte navaśasyeṣṭyā tathartvante dvijo 'dhvaraiḥ / paśunā tvayanasyānte samānte saumikairmakhaiḥ
verses.translation: There are three types of charitable gifts the Nitya, the Naimittika and the Kamya. A fourth type of charitable gift is also mentioned viz. Vimala (the pure one) which is the most excellent of all the charitable gifts.
verses.hindi: यस्तु मोहेन वालस्यादेकान्नादी भवेद् यतिः। न तस्य निष्कृतिः काचिद् धर्मशास्त्रेषु कथ्यते रागद्वेषविमुक्तात्मा समलोष्टाश्मकाञ्जनः । प्राणिहिंसानिवृत्तश्च मौनी स्यात् सर्वनिस्पृहः
verses.wordMeaning: There are three types of charitable gifts the Nitya, the Naimittika and the Kamya. A fourth type of charitable gift is also mentioned viz. Vimala (the pure one) which is the most excellent of all the charitable gifts.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are three types of charitable gifts the Nitya, the Naimittika and the Kamya. A fourth type of charitable gift is also mentioned viz. Vimala (the pure one) which is the most excellent of all the charitable gifts.

verses.sanskrit: नानिष्ट्वा नवशस्येष्ट्या पशुना वाग्निमान् द्विजः । नवान्नमद्यान्मांसं वा दीर्घमायुर्जिजीविषुः
verses.transliteration: nāniṣṭvā navaśasyeṣṭyā paśunā vāgnimān dvijaḥ / navānnamadyānmāṃsaṃ vā dīrghamāyurjijīviṣuḥ
verses.translation: The Nitya charitable gift is as follows: Everday some¬ thing is given to a Brahmana who does not give anything in return. Nor does the donor expect any fruit thereof.
verses.hindi: दृष्टिपूतं न्यसेत् पादं वस्त्रपूतं जलं पिबेत्। सत्यपूतां वदेद् वाणीं मनःपूतं समाचरेत्
verses.wordMeaning: The Nitya charitable gift is as follows: Everday some¬ thing is given to a Brahmana who does not give anything in return. Nor does the donor expect any fruit thereof.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Nitya charitable gift is as follows: Everday some¬ thing is given to a Brahmana who does not give anything in return. Nor does the donor expect any fruit thereof.

verses.sanskrit: नवेनान्नेन चानिष्ट्वा पशुहव्येन चागन्यः । प्राणानेवात्तुमिच्छन्ति नवान्नामिषगृद्धिनः
verses.transliteration: navenānnena cāniṣṭvā paśuhavyena cāganyaḥ / prāṇānevāttumicchanti navānnāmiṣagṛddhinaḥ
verses.translation: The Naimittika (occasional) charitable gift is that which is given to scholars for the purpose of wiping off one's sins. This h Dana (charitable gift) practised by good men.
verses.hindi: नेकत्र निवसेद् देशे वर्षाभ्योऽन्यत्र भिक्षुकः । स्नानशौचरतो नित्यं कमण्डलुकरः शुचि: ब्रह्मचर्यरतो नित्यं वनवासरतो भवेत्। मोक्षशास्त्रेषु निरतो ब्रह्मसूत्री जितेन्द्रियः
verses.wordMeaning: The Naimittika (occasional) charitable gift is that which is given to scholars for the purpose of wiping off one's sins. This h Dana (charitable gift) practised by good men.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Naimittika (occasional) charitable gift is that which is given to scholars for the purpose of wiping off one's sins. This h Dana (charitable gift) practised by good men.

verses.sanskrit: सावित्रान् शान्तिहोमांश्च कुर्यात् पर्वसु नित्यशः । पितॄंश्चैवाष्टकास्वर्चन् नित्यमन्वष्टकासु च
verses.transliteration: sāvitrān śāntihomāṃśca kuryāt parvasu nityaśaḥ / pitṝṃścaivāṣṭakāsvarcan nityamanvaṣṭakāsu ca
verses.translation: What is given for the purpose of obtaining child ern, success, prosperity and heaven is called a Kamyadana (charitable gift for the achievement of the desired object) by sages who have pondered over topics of piety.
verses.hindi: दम्भाहंकारनिर्मुक्तो निन्दापैशुन्यवर्जितः। आत्मज्ञानगुणोपेतो यतिर्मोक्षमवाप्नुयात्
verses.wordMeaning: What is given for the purpose of obtaining child ern, success, prosperity and heaven is called a Kamyadana (charitable gift for the achievement of the desired object) by sages who have pondered over topics of piety.
verses.commentary: Sense: What is given for the purpose of obtaining child ern, success, prosperity and heaven is called a Kamyadana (charitable gift for the achievement of the desired object) by sages who have pondered over topics of piety.

verses.sanskrit: एष धर्मः परो नित्यमपधर्मो ऽन्य उच्यते । त्रयाणामिह वर्णानां गृहस्थाश्रमवासिनाम्
verses.transliteration: eṣa dharmaḥ paro nityamapadharmo 'nya ucyate / trayāṇāmiha varṇānāṃ gṛhasthāśramavāsinām
verses.translation: What is handed over to the knowers of the Brahman for the propitiation of Isvara, with a righteous mind, is called the auspicious Vimala (pure) Dana.
verses.hindi: अभ्यसेत् सततं वेदं प्रणवाख्यं सनातनम्। स्नात्वाचम्य विधानेन शुचिर्देवालयादिषु यज्ञोपवीती शान्तात्मा कुशपाणिः समाहितः । धौतकाषायवसनो भस्मच्छन्नतनूरुहः
verses.wordMeaning: What is handed over to the knowers of the Brahman for the propitiation of Isvara, with a righteous mind, is called the auspicious Vimala (pure) Dana.
verses.commentary: Sense: What is handed over to the knowers of the Brahman for the propitiation of Isvara, with a righteous mind, is called the auspicious Vimala (pure) Dana.

verses.sanskrit: नास्तिक्यादथवालस्याद् यो ऽग्नीन् नाधातुमिच्छति । यजेत वा न यज्ञेन स याति नरकान् बहून्
verses.transliteration: nāstikyādathavālasyād yo 'gnīn nādhātumicchati / yajeta vā na yajñena sa yāti narakān bahūn
verses.translation: One should resort to the dharma of charitable gifts in accordance with one's capacity, after getting the deserving persons. Indeed, a deserving person will be available and he will enable one to cross the entire ocean of Existence.
verses.hindi: अधियज्ञं ब्रह्म जपेदाधिहैविकमेव च। आध्यात्मिकं च सततं वेदान्ताभिहितं च यत्
verses.wordMeaning: One should resort to the dharma of charitable gifts in accordance with one's capacity, after getting the deserving persons. Indeed, a deserving person will be available and he will enable one to cross the entire ocean of Existence.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should resort to the dharma of charitable gifts in accordance with one's capacity, after getting the deserving persons. Indeed, a deserving person will be available and he will enable one to cross the entire ocean of Existence.

verses.sanskrit: तामिस्त्रमन्धतामिस्त्रं महारौरवरौरवौ । कुम्भीपाकं वैतरणीमसिपत्रवनं तथा
verses.transliteration: tāmistramandhatāmistraṃ mahārauravarauravau / kumbhīpākaṃ vaitaraṇīmasipatravanaṃ tathā
verses.translation: What remains after providing food, clothing etc. to the family should be given as charitable gift. If it is given otherwise, that charitable gift does not yield any fruit.
verses.hindi: पुत्रेषु वाथ निवसन् ब्रह्मचारी यतिर्मुनिः। वेदमेवाभ्यसेन्नित्यं स याति परमां गतिम् अहिंसा सत्यमस्तेयं ब्रह्मचर्य तपः परम्। क्षमा दया च संतोषो व्रतान्यस्य विशेषतः
verses.wordMeaning: What remains after providing food, clothing etc. to the family should be given as charitable gift. If it is given otherwise, that charitable gift does not yield any fruit.
verses.commentary: Sense: What remains after providing food, clothing etc. to the family should be given as charitable gift. If it is given otherwise, that charitable gift does not yield any fruit.

verses.sanskrit: अन्यांश्च नरकान् घोरान् संप्राप्यान्ते सुदुर्मतिः । अन्त्यजानां कुले विप्राः शूद्रयोनौ च जायते
verses.transliteration: anyāṃśca narakān ghorān saṃprāpyānte sudurmatiḥ / antyajānāṃ kule viprāḥ śūdrayonau ca jāyate
verses.translation: Dana should be given to a noble-born Brahmana well-versed in the Vedas. He should be humble and performer of penance. He shall be indigent and one who maintains holy rites. Everything given shall be offered with due devotion.
verses.hindi: वेदान्तज्ञाननिष्ठो वा पञ्च यज्ञान् समाहितः। कुर्यादहरहः स्नात्वा भिक्षान्नेनैव तेन हि
verses.wordMeaning: Dana should be given to a noble-born Brahmana well-versed in the Vedas. He should be humble and performer of penance. He shall be indigent and one who maintains holy rites. Everything given shall be offered with due devotion.
verses.commentary: Sense: Dana should be given to a noble-born Brahmana well-versed in the Vedas. He should be humble and performer of penance. He shall be indigent and one who maintains holy rites. Everything given shall be offered with due devotion.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन ब्राह्मणो हि विशेषतः । आधायाग्निं विशुद्धात्मा यजेत परमेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: tasmāt sarvaprayatnena brāhmaṇo hi viśeṣataḥ / ādhāyāgniṃ viśuddhātmā yajeta parameśvaram
verses.translation: He who gives with great devotion a plot of land to a Brahmana who maintains the sacrificial fires, attains that great abode after reaching which one has no cause for sorrow.
verses.hindi: व्यक्तिका अन्न भक्षण करता है, उसकी मुक्तिका कोई उपाय धर्मशास्त्रोंमें नहीं बतलाया गया है । (संन्यासीको) राग-द्वेषसे मुक्त, मिट्टी, पत्थर और सोनेमें समान भाव रखनेवाला, प्राणियोंकी हिंसासे निवृत्त, मौनी और सब प्रकारसे आसक्तिशून्य होना चाहिए, अच्छी तरह देखकर पैर रखना चाहिए, वस्त्रसे छानकर जल पीना चाहिए, सत्यसे पवित्र वाणी बोलनी चाहिए और मनसे शुद्ध आचरण करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: He who gives with great devotion a plot of land to a Brahmana who maintains the sacrificial fires, attains that great abode after reaching which one has no cause for sorrow.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who gives with great devotion a plot of land to a Brahmana who maintains the sacrificial fires, attains that great abode after reaching which one has no cause for sorrow.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निहोत्रात् परो धर्मो द्विजानां नेह विद्यते । तस्मादाराधयेन्नित्यमग्निहोत्रेण शाश्वतम्
verses.transliteration: agnihotrāt paro dharmo dvijānāṃ neha vidyate / tasmādārādhayennityamagnihotreṇa śāśvatam
verses.translation: He who gives to a great scholar of Vedas a very fertile land producing barley and wheat and overgrown with sugar cane plants, is not born again.
verses.hindi: संन्यासीको वर्षा-ऋतुके अतिरिक्त (अन्य ऋतुओंमें) किसी एक ही स्थानपर नहीं रहना चाहिए। नित्य स्नान एवं शौचमें तत्पर, हाथमें कमण्डलु धारण करनेवाला तथा पवित्र होना चाहिए । नित्य ब्रह्मचर्यव्रत धारण करना
verses.wordMeaning: He who gives to a great scholar of Vedas a very fertile land producing barley and wheat and overgrown with sugar cane plants, is not born again.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who gives to a great scholar of Vedas a very fertile land producing barley and wheat and overgrown with sugar cane plants, is not born again.

verses.sanskrit: यश्चाधायाग्निमालस्यान्न यष्टुं देवमिच्छति । सो ऽसौ मूढो न संभाष्यः किं पुनर्नास्तिको जनः
verses.transliteration: yaścādhāyāgnimālasyānna yaṣṭuṃ devamicchati / so 'sau mūḍho na saṃbhāṣyaḥ kiṃ punarnāstiko janaḥ
verses.translation: He who gives at least a plot of land extending to a Gocarman* (cow's hide) to an indigent Brahmana is liberated from all sins.
verses.hindi: चाहिए, वनवासी ही रहना चाहिए तथा मोक्षविषयक शास्त्राध्ययनमें निरत रहते हुए ब्रह्मसूत्री (यज्ञोपवीतसे युक्त दण्डधारी) और जितेन्द्रिय रहना चाहिए। दम्भ- अहंकारसे मुक्त रहे, निन्दा तथा पिशुनता (चुगलखोरी)- का सर्वथा परित्याग करे। आत्मञ्ञानसम्बन्धी गुणोंसे सम्पन्न रहे--ऐसा संन्यासी मोक्ष प्राप्त करता है । विधिपूर्वक स्नानोपरान्त आचमन करके पवित्रतापूर्वक देवालयोंमें प्रणव नामक सनातन वेद (मन्त्र)-का निरन्तर अभ्यास
verses.wordMeaning: He who gives at least a plot of land extending to a Gocarman* (cow's hide) to an indigent Brahmana is liberated from all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who gives at least a plot of land extending to a Gocarman* (cow's hide) to an indigent Brahmana is liberated from all sins.

verses.sanskrit: यस्य त्रैवार्षिकं भक्तं पर्याप्तं भृत्यवृत्तये । अधिकं चापि विद्येत स सोमं पातुमर्हति
verses.transliteration: yasya traivārṣikaṃ bhaktaṃ paryāptaṃ bhṛtyavṛttaye / adhikaṃ cāpi vidyeta sa somaṃ pātumarhati
verses.translation: There is no other gift greater than the gift of lands here. The gift of cooked food is on a par with it. The gift of learning excels it.
verses.hindi: यज्ञोपवीती, शान्तात्मा, हाथमें कुश धारण करने- वाला, एकाग्रचित्त, धुला हुआ काषाय वस्त्र धारण करनेवाला और भस्मसे धूसरित देहवाला रहना चाहिए। संन्यासीको वेदान्त-प्रतिपादित अधियज्ञ, (समस्त
verses.wordMeaning: There is no other gift greater than the gift of lands here. The gift of cooked food is on a par with it. The gift of learning excels it.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no other gift greater than the gift of lands here. The gift of cooked food is on a par with it. The gift of learning excels it.

verses.sanskrit: एष वै सर्वयज्ञानां सोमः प्रथम इष्यते । सोमेनाराधयेद् देवं सोमलोकमहेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: eṣa vai sarvayajñānāṃ somaḥ prathama iṣyate / somenārādhayed devaṃ somalokamaheśvaram
verses.translation: He who duly imparts learning to a Brahmana of pure, pious conduct and excellent character, is honoured in Brahmaloka.
verses.hindi: यज्ञोंके अधिष्ठान) आधिहैविक तथा आध्यात्मिक ब्रह्म (मन्त्र-प्रणव)-का सतत जप करना चाहिए। अथवा मननशील तथा ब्रह्मचारी यतिको पुत्रोंके बीच रहते हुए नित्य वेदका ही अभ्यास करना चाहिए, इससे उसे परम गति प्राप्त होती है
verses.wordMeaning: He who duly imparts learning to a Brahmana of pure, pious conduct and excellent character, is honoured in Brahmaloka.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who duly imparts learning to a Brahmana of pure, pious conduct and excellent character, is honoured in Brahmaloka.

verses.sanskrit: न सोमयागादधिको महेशाराधने क्रतुः । समो वा विद्यते तस्मात् सोमेनाभ्यर्चयेत् परम्
verses.transliteration: na somayāgādadhiko maheśārādhane kratuḥ / samo vā vidyate tasmāt somenābhyarcayet param
verses.translation: If one gives cooked food with due faith everyday to a Brahmacarin (religious student), one shall be freed from all sins and shall attain the abode of Brahma.
verses.hindi: अहिंसा, सत्य, अस्तेय (चोरी न करना), ब्रह्मचर्य, श्रेष्ठ तप, क्षमा, दया और संतोष-ये ब्रह्मचारी यतिके विशेष व्रत हैं। अथवा वेदान्त-ज्ञानमें निष्ठाके साथ समाहित होकर स्नानादि कर भिक्षामें प्राप्त अन्नसे नित्य
verses.wordMeaning: If one gives cooked food with due faith everyday to a Brahmacarin (religious student), one shall be freed from all sins and shall attain the abode of Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: If one gives cooked food with due faith everyday to a Brahmacarin (religious student), one shall be freed from all sins and shall attain the abode of Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: पितामहेन विप्राणामादावभिहितः शुभः । धर्मो विमुक्तये साक्षाच्छ्रौतः स्मार्तो द्विधा पुनः
verses.transliteration: pitāmahena viprāṇāmādāvabhihitaḥ śubhaḥ / dharmo vimuktaye sākṣācchrautaḥ smārto dvidhā punaḥ
verses.translation: A man obtains great benefit by giving cooked food to a householder. It must be given unto him (immediately) on arrival. After giving thus one attains the greatest goal.
verses.hindi: पञ्चमहायज्ञोंका सम्पादन करना चाहिए (इसे विरक्त कर्मयोगीका धर्म समझना चाहिए)  कुटीचक संन्यासी शिखा और यज्ञोपवीत धारण करते हैं। (नारदपरिव्राजकोपनिषद्-५)
verses.wordMeaning: A man obtains great benefit by giving cooked food to a householder. It must be given unto him (immediately) on arrival. After giving thus one attains the greatest goal.
verses.commentary: Sense: A man obtains great benefit by giving cooked food to a householder. It must be given unto him (immediately) on arrival. After giving thus one attains the greatest goal.

verses.sanskrit: श्रौतस्त्रेताग्निसंबन्धात् स्मार्तः पूर्वं मयोदितः । श्रेयस्करतमः श्रौतस्तस्माच्छ्रौतं समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: śrautastretāgnisaṃbandhāt smārtaḥ pūrvaṃ mayoditaḥ / śreyaskaratamaḥ śrautastasmācchrautaṃ samācaret
verses.translation: "O Dharmaraja be pleased." Whatever is in one's mind (shall be realised). Every sin committed in the course of whole life shall perish at that very moment.
verses.hindi: ३९८  कूर्मपुराण
verses.wordMeaning: "O Dharmaraja be pleased." Whatever is in one's mind (shall be realised). Every sin committed in the course of whole life shall perish at that very moment.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Dharmaraja be pleased." Whatever is in one's mind (shall be realised). Every sin committed in the course of whole life shall perish at that very moment.

verses.sanskrit: उभावभिहितौ धर्मौ वेदादेव विनिः सृतौ । शिष्टाचारस्तृतीयः स्याच्छ्रतिस्मृत्योरलाभतः
verses.transliteration: ubhāvabhihitau dharmau vedādeva viniḥ sṛtau / śiṣṭācārastṛtīyaḥ syācchratismṛtyoralābhataḥ
verses.translation: "O Dharmaraja be pleased." Whatever is in one's mind (shall be realised). Every sin committed in the course of whole life shall perish at that very moment.
verses.hindi: होममन्त्राञ्जपेन्नित्यं काले काले समाहित: । नियत समयपर समाहित होकर नित्य होम-मन्त्रोंका स्वाध्यायं चान्वहं कुर्यात् सावित्री संध्ययोर्जपेत्॥ २८ ॥  जप करना चाहिए। प्रतिदिन स्वाध्याय को और संध्याओंमें गायत्रीका जप करे। एकान्तमें निरन्तर ध्यायीत सततं देवमेकान्ते परमेश्वरम्। परमेश्वरदेवका ध्यान करे। नित्य एक ही व्यक्तिके
verses.wordMeaning: "O Dharmaraja be pleased." Whatever is in one's mind (shall be realised). Every sin committed in the course of whole life shall perish at that very moment.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Dharmaraja be pleased." Whatever is in one's mind (shall be realised). Every sin committed in the course of whole life shall perish at that very moment.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मेणाभिगतो यैस्तु वेदः सपरिबृंहणः । ते शिष्टा ब्राह्मणाः प्रोक्ता नित्यमात्मगुणान्विताः
verses.transliteration: dharmeṇābhigato yaistu vedaḥ saparibṛṃhaṇaḥ / te śiṣṭā brāhmaṇāḥ proktā nityamātmaguṇānvitāḥ
verses.translation: "O Dharmaraja be pleased." Whatever is in one's mind (shall be realised). Every sin committed in the course of whole life shall perish at that very moment.
verses.hindi: । वर्जयेत्रित्यं + कोश अन्नका और काम, क्रोध तथा परिग्रहका त्याग करे। जयेन्नित्यं कामं क्रोधं परिग्रहम्॥ २९ ॥ १ ट TI CS एक वस्त्र अथवा दो वस्त्र धारण करे। शिखा एव
verses.wordMeaning: "O Dharmaraja be pleased." Whatever is in one's mind (shall be realised). Every sin committed in the course of whole life shall perish at that very moment.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Dharmaraja be pleased." Whatever is in one's mind (shall be realised). Every sin committed in the course of whole life shall perish at that very moment.

verses.sanskrit: तेषामभिमतो यः स्याच्चेतसा नित्यमेव हि । स धर्मः कथितः सद्भिर्नान्येषामिति धारणा
verses.transliteration: teṣāmabhimato yaḥ syāccetasā nityameva hi / sa dharmaḥ kathitaḥ sadbhirnānyeṣāmiti dhāraṇā
verses.translation: "O Dharmaraja be pleased." Whatever is in one's mind (shall be realised). Every sin committed in the course of whole life shall perish at that very moment.
verses.hindi: यज्ञोपबीत धारण करे। हाथमें कमण्डलु धारण करे, एकवासा द्विवासा वा शिखी यज्ञोपवीतवान्। ऐसा त्रिदण्डी विद्वान् भी (अनासक्त--दन्द्वातीत कर्मयोगी कमण्डलुकरो विद्वान् त्रिदण्डी याति तत्परम्॥ ३०॥  होनेके कारण) परम पदको प्राप्त करता है इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहरूयाँ संहितायामुपरिविभागेऽष्ठाबिंशोऽध्यायः
verses.wordMeaning: "O Dharmaraja be pleased." Whatever is in one's mind (shall be realised). Every sin committed in the course of whole life shall perish at that very moment.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Dharmaraja be pleased." Whatever is in one's mind (shall be realised). Every sin committed in the course of whole life shall perish at that very moment.

verses.sanskrit: पुराणं धर्मशास्त्रं च वेदानामुपबृंहणम् । एकस्माद् ब्रह्मविज्ञानं धर्मज्ञानं तथैकतः
verses.transliteration: purāṇaṃ dharmaśāstraṃ ca vedānāmupabṛṃhaṇam / ekasmād brahmavijñānaṃ dharmajñānaṃ tathaikataḥ
verses.translation: "O Dharmaraja be pleased." Whatever is in one's mind (shall be realised). Every sin committed in the course of whole life shall perish at that very moment.
verses.hindi: संन्यासाश्रमधर्म-निरूपणमें यतियोंकी भैक्ष्यवृत्तिका स्वरूप, यतियोंके लिये महेश्वरके ध्यानका प्रतिपादन, व्रतभङ्गमें प्रायश्चित्तविधान तथा पुनः यथास्थितिमें आनेकी विधि, संन्यासधर्म-प्रकरणकी समाप्ति
verses.wordMeaning: "O Dharmaraja be pleased." Whatever is in one's mind (shall be realised). Every sin committed in the course of whole life shall perish at that very moment.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Dharmaraja be pleased." Whatever is in one's mind (shall be realised). Every sin committed in the course of whole life shall perish at that very moment.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मं जिज्ञासमानानां तत्प्रमाणतरं स्मृतम् । धर्मशास्त्रं पुराणं तद् ब्रह्मज्ञाने परा प्रमा
verses.transliteration: dharmaṃ jijñāsamānānāṃ tatpramāṇataraṃ smṛtam / dharmaśāstraṃ purāṇaṃ tad brahmajñāne parā pramā
verses.translation: "O Dharmaraja be pleased." Whatever is in one's mind (shall be realised). Every sin committed in the course of whole life shall perish at that very moment.
verses.hindi: व्यास उवाच व्यासजीने कहा--इस प्रकार अपने आश्रममें स्थित नियतात्मा यतियोंके लिये भिक्षा अथवा फल- मूलद्वारा जीवन-निर्वाह करना कहा गया है। एक समय ही भिक्षा करनी चाहिए। उसके विस्तारमें आसक्त नहीं एककालं चरेद् भेक्षं न प्रसज्येत विस्तरे। होना चाहिए; क्योंकि भिक्षामें आसक्ति रखनेवाला भेक्षे प्रसक्तो हि यतिर्विषयेष्वपि सज्जति॥ २॥  संन्यासी विषयोंमें भी आसक्त हो जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: "O Dharmaraja be pleased." Whatever is in one's mind (shall be realised). Every sin committed in the course of whole life shall perish at that very moment.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Dharmaraja be pleased." Whatever is in one's mind (shall be realised). Every sin committed in the course of whole life shall perish at that very moment.

verses.sanskrit: नान्यतो जायते धर्मो ब्रह्मविद्या च वैदिकी । तस्माद् धर्मं पुराणं च श्रद्धातव्यं द्विजातिभिः
verses.transliteration: nānyato jāyate dharmo brahmavidyā ca vaidikī / tasmād dharmaṃ purāṇaṃ ca śraddhātavyaṃ dvijātibhiḥ
verses.translation: "O Dharmaraja be pleased." Whatever is in one's mind (shall be realised). Every sin committed in the course of whole life shall perish at that very moment.
verses.hindi: सप्तागारं चरेद् भेक्षमलाभात् तु पुनश्चरेत्। सात घरोंसे भिक्षा माँगनी चाहिए। (उतने घरोंमें) प्रक्षाल्य पात्रे भुञ्जीयादद्धिः प्रक्षालयेत् तु तत्॥ ३॥  न मिलनेपर पुनः भिक्षा माँगनी चाहिए। पात्रको धोकर उसमें भिक्षा ग्रहण करनी चाहिए और भिक्षाके बाद पुनः उसे जलसे धोना चाहिए। अथवा (सम्भव हो
verses.wordMeaning: "O Dharmaraja be pleased." Whatever is in one's mind (shall be realised). Every sin committed in the course of whole life shall perish at that very moment.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Dharmaraja be pleased." Whatever is in one's mind (shall be realised). Every sin committed in the course of whole life shall perish at that very moment.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे चतुर्विशो ऽध्यायः इन् रेए निछ्त् ज़ुल्äस्सिगे ज़ेइछेन्: व्यास उवाच एष वो ऽभिहितः कृत्स्नो गृहस्थाश्रमवासिनः । द्विजातेः परमो धर्मो वर्तनानि निबोधत
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge caturviśo 'dhyāyaḥ in ree nicht zulässige zeichen: vyāsa uvāca eṣa vo 'bhihitaḥ kṛtsno gṛhasthāśramavāsinaḥ / dvijāteḥ paramo dharmo vartanāni nibodhata
verses.translation: He who places gold, honey and ghee, gingelly seeds on the hide of a black antelope and gives it to a Brahmana, surmounts all evils.
verses.hindi: तो) बिना लोभके जीवन-निर्वाहमात्र करनेवाले यतिको अथवान्यदुपादाय पात्रे भुञ्जीत नित्यशः । प्रतिदिन नवीन पात्र लाकर उसमें भिक्षा ग्रहण करनी भुक्त्वा तत् संत्यजेत् पात्रं यात्रामात्रमलोलुपः॥ ४॥  चाहिए और भिक्षा ग्रहण करनेके बाद उसका परित्याग कर देना चाहिए। गृहस्थका घर धूएँसे रहित हो जानेपर, मूसलका शब्द बंद हो जानेपर, आगके न रहनेपर, सभी लोगोंके भोजन कर चुकनेपर, कसोरे विधूमे सन्नमुसले व्यङ्गारे ह हक एवं पत्रादिका ढेर लग जानेपर यतिको (गृहस्थके वृत्ते शरावसम्पाते भिक्षां नित्यं यतिश्चरेत्॥ ५॥  घर) नित्य भिक्षा माँगनी चाहिए॥ ३--५॥
verses.wordMeaning: He who places gold, honey and ghee, gingelly seeds on the hide of a black antelope and gives it to a Brahmana, surmounts all evils.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who places gold, honey and ghee, gingelly seeds on the hide of a black antelope and gives it to a Brahmana, surmounts all evils.

verses.sanskrit: द्विविधस्तु गृही ज्ञेयः साधकश्चाप्यसाधकः । अध्यापनं याजनं च पूर्वस्याहुः प्रतिग्रहम् । कुसीदकृषिवाणिज्यं प्रकुर्वोतास्वयङ्कृतम्
verses.transliteration: dvividhastu gṛhī jñeyaḥ sādhakaścāpyasādhakaḥ / adhyāpanaṃ yājanaṃ ca pūrvasyāhuḥ pratigraham / kusīdakṛṣivāṇijyaṃ prakurvotāsvayaṅkṛtam
verses.translation: Particularly on the full moon day in the month of Vaisakha, one should ritualistically offer cooked food and water pot to Dharmaraja and hand it over to Brahmanas. He shall be relieved of fear.
verses.hindi: गोदोहमात्रं तिष्ठेत कालं भिक्षुरधोमुखः। भिकषेत्युक्त्वा सकृत् तृष्णीमश्नीयाद् वाग्यतः शुचि:
verses.wordMeaning: Particularly on the full moon day in the month of Vaisakha, one should ritualistically offer cooked food and water pot to Dharmaraja and hand it over to Brahmanas. He shall be relieved of fear.
verses.commentary: Sense: Particularly on the full moon day in the month of Vaisakha, one should ritualistically offer cooked food and water pot to Dharmaraja and hand it over to Brahmanas. He shall be relieved of fear.

verses.sanskrit: कृषेरभावाद् वाणिज्यं तदभावात् कुसीदकम् । आपत्कल्पो ह्यं ज्ञेयः पूर्वोक्तो मुख्य इष्यते
verses.transliteration: kṛṣerabhāvād vāṇijyaṃ tadabhāvāt kusīdakam / āpatkalpo hyaṃ jñeyaḥ pūrvokto mukhya iṣyate
verses.translation: One shall propitiate seven or five Brahmanas with water-pots accompanied by gold and gingelly seeds. One can thereby expell the sin of even Brahmana slaughter.
verses.hindi: आचम्य देवं ब्रह्माणं ध्यायीत परमेश्वरम् संध्यास्वह्नि विशेषेण चिन्तयेन्नित्यमीश्वरम्
verses.wordMeaning: One shall propitiate seven or five Brahmanas with water-pots accompanied by gold and gingelly seeds. One can thereby expell the sin of even Brahmana slaughter.
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall propitiate seven or five Brahmanas with water-pots accompanied by gold and gingelly seeds. One can thereby expell the sin of even Brahmana slaughter.

verses.sanskrit: स्वयं वा कर्षणं कुर्याद् वाणिज्यं वा कुसीदकम् । कष्टा पापीयसी वृत्तिः कुसीदं तद् विवर्जयेत्
verses.transliteration: svayaṃ vā karṣaṇaṃ kuryād vāṇijyaṃ vā kusīdakam / kaṣṭā pāpīyasī vṛttiḥ kusīdaṃ tad vivarjayet
verses.translation: On the Dvadasi (twelfth) day in the month of Magha a Brahmana should observe fast. He should wear white garments. He should perform Homa with black gingelly seeds in the holy fire. With great concentration he should offer gifts to the Brah¬ manas well-versed in the Vedas. Whatever sin he might have committed ever since his birth, the Brahmana shall surmount it.
verses.hindi: प्रधानपुरुषातीतमाकाशं दहनं शिवम्
verses.wordMeaning: On the Dvadasi (twelfth) day in the month of Magha a Brahmana should observe fast. He should wear white garments. He should perform Homa with black gingelly seeds in the holy fire. With great concentration he should offer gifts to the Brah¬ manas well-versed in the Vedas.…
verses.commentary: Sense: On the Dvadasi (twelfth) day in the month of Magha a Brahmana should observe fast. He should wear white garments. He should perform Homa with black gingelly seeds in the holy fire. With great concentration he should offer gifts to the Brah¬ manas well-versed in the Vedas.…

verses.sanskrit: क्षात्रवृत्तिं परां प्रहुर्न स्वयं कर्षणं द्विजैः । तस्मात् क्षात्रेण वर्तेत वर्तनेनापदि द्विजः
verses.transliteration: kṣātravṛttiṃ parāṃ prahurna svayaṃ karṣaṇaṃ dvijaiḥ / tasmāt kṣātreṇa varteta vartanenāpadi dvijaḥ
verses.translation: He who takes his holy dip on the fourteenth day in the dark half of the month and propitiates the Pinaka bearing lord Siva through Brahmanas is not reborn again in the world.
verses.hindi: तदन्तः सर्वभावानामीश्चरं ब्रह्मरूपिणम्। ध्यायेदनादिमद्वैतमानन्दादिगुणालयम् महान्तं परमं ब्रह्म पुरुषं सत्यमव्ययम्। सितेतरारुणाकारं महेशं विश्वरूपिणम्
verses.wordMeaning: He who takes his holy dip on the fourteenth day in the dark half of the month and propitiates the Pinaka bearing lord Siva through Brahmanas is not reborn again in the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who takes his holy dip on the fourteenth day in the dark half of the month and propitiates the Pinaka bearing lord Siva through Brahmanas is not reborn again in the world.

verses.sanskrit: तेन चावाप्यजीवंस्तु वैश्यवृत्तिं कृषिं व्रजेत् । न कथञ्चन कुर्वोत ब्राह्मणः कर्म कर्षणम्
verses.transliteration: tena cāvāpyajīvaṃstu vaiśyavṛttiṃ kṛṣiṃ vrajet / na kathañcana kurvota brāhmaṇaḥ karma karṣaṇam
verses.translation: The three-eyed deity is to be particularly worshipped by Brahmana devotees on the fourteenth and eighth of the dark half and on the new moon day.
verses.hindi: ओंकारान्तेऽथ चात्मानं संस्थाप्य परमात्मनि। आकाशे देवमीशानं ध्यायीताकाशमध्यगम्
verses.wordMeaning: The three-eyed deity is to be particularly worshipped by Brahmana devotees on the fourteenth and eighth of the dark half and on the new moon day.
verses.commentary: Sense: The three-eyed deity is to be particularly worshipped by Brahmana devotees on the fourteenth and eighth of the dark half and on the new moon day.

verses.sanskrit: लब्धलाभः पितॄन् देवान् ब्राह्मणांश्चापि पूजयेत् । ते तृप्तास्तस्य तं दोषं शमयन्ति न संशयः
verses.transliteration: labdhalābhaḥ pitṝn devān brāhmaṇāṃścāpi pūjayet / te tṛptāstasya taṃ doṣaṃ śamayanti na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: One should observe fast on the eleventh day and wor¬ ship Purusottama on the twelfth day through a Brahmana. He shall attain the greatest region.
verses.hindi: कारणं सर्वभावानामानन्हैकसमाश्रयम्। पुराणं पुरुषं शम्भुं ध्यायन् मुच्येत बन्धनात् विचिन्त्य परमं व्योम सर्वभूतैककारणम्
verses.wordMeaning: One should observe fast on the eleventh day and wor¬ ship Purusottama on the twelfth day through a Brahmana. He shall attain the greatest region.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should observe fast on the eleventh day and wor¬ ship Purusottama on the twelfth day through a Brahmana. He shall attain the greatest region.

verses.sanskrit: देवेभ्यश्च पितृभ्यश्च दद्याद् भागं तु विंशकम् । त्रिंशद्भागं ब्राह्मणानां कृषिं कुर्वन् न दुष्यति
verses.transliteration: devebhyaśca pitṛbhyaśca dadyād bhāgaṃ tu viṃśakam / triṃśadbhāgaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ kṛṣiṃ kurvan na duṣyati
verses.translation: The twelfth day in the bright half is a Tithi belong¬ ing to Visnu. One should assiduously propitiate lord Janardana on that day.
verses.hindi: जीवनं सर्वभूतानां यत्र लोकः प्रलीयते। आनन्दं ब्रह्मणः सूक्ष्मं यत् पश्यन्ति मुमुक्षवः
verses.wordMeaning: The twelfth day in the bright half is a Tithi belong¬ ing to Visnu. One should assiduously propitiate lord Janardana on that day.
verses.commentary: Sense: The twelfth day in the bright half is a Tithi belong¬ ing to Visnu. One should assiduously propitiate lord Janardana on that day.

verses.sanskrit: वणिक् प्रदद्याद् द्विगुणं कुसीदी त्रिगुणं पुनः । कृषीवलो न दोषेण युज्यते नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: vaṇik pradadyād dviguṇaṃ kusīdī triguṇaṃ punaḥ / kṛṣīvalo na doṣeṇa yujyate nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Whatever is offered to a pure Brahmana after dedi¬ cating the same to lord Isana or Visnu yields endless (i.e. eternal) benefits.
verses.hindi: तन्मध्ये निहितं ब्रह्म केवलं ज्ञानलक्षणम्। अनन्तं सत्यमीशानं विचिन्त्यासीत संयतः एक बार 'भिक्षा' ऐसा शब्द उच्चारण कर भिक्षा माँगनेवाले संन्यासीको नीचे मुख किये हुए उतने समयतक प्रतीक्षा करनी चाहिए, जितनी देरमें गाय दुही जाती है। (भिक्षा प्राप्त होनेपर) पवित्रतापूर्वक मौन होकर
verses.wordMeaning: Whatever is offered to a pure Brahmana after dedi¬ cating the same to lord Isana or Visnu yields endless (i.e. eternal) benefits.
verses.commentary: Sense: Whatever is offered to a pure Brahmana after dedi¬ cating the same to lord Isana or Visnu yields endless (i.e. eternal) benefits.

verses.sanskrit: शिलोञ्छं वाप्याददीत गृहस्थः साधकः पुनः । विद्याशिल्पादयस्त्वन्ये बहवो वृत्तिहेतवः
verses.transliteration: śiloñchaṃ vāpyādadīta gṛhasthaḥ sādhakaḥ punaḥ / vidyāśilpādayastvanye bahavo vṛttihetavaḥ
verses.translation: A man may wish to propitiate any deity. If he is a wise scholar he should worship Brahmanas in order to satisfy that deity.
verses.hindi: भिक्षा ग्रहण करनी चाहिए। हाथ-पाँव धोकर यथाविधि आचमन कर सूर्यको ओर अन्न दिखलाकर पूर्व अथवा उत्तरको ओर मुख करके भोजन करना चाहिए । (प्राणाय स्वाहा इत्यादि) पाँच प्राणाहुति देकर समाहित होकर
verses.wordMeaning: A man may wish to propitiate any deity. If he is a wise scholar he should worship Brahmanas in order to satisfy that deity.
verses.commentary: Sense: A man may wish to propitiate any deity. If he is a wise scholar he should worship Brahmanas in order to satisfy that deity.

verses.sanskrit: असाधकस्तु यः प्रोक्तो गृहस्थाश्रमसंस्थितः । शिलोञ्छे तस्य कथिते द्वे वृत्ती परमर्षिभिः
verses.transliteration: asādhakastu yaḥ prokto gṛhasthāśramasaṃsthitaḥ / śiloñche tasya kathite dve vṛttī paramarṣibhiḥ
verses.translation: All deities assume the forms of the Brahmanas; they always exist. If Brahmanas are not available, they are- worshipped in idols etc. in some places.
verses.hindi: आठ ग्रास ग्रहण करे। तदनन्तर आचमन कर परमेश्वर देव ब्रह्मका ध्यान करे । प्रजापति मनुने संन्यासीके लिये लौकी, लकड़ी, मिट्टी तथा बाँसके बने चार प्रकारके पात्र बताये हैं । यतिको रात्रिके प्रथम भाग, अन्तिम भाग, मध्यरात्रि, संध्या-काल तथा दिनमें नित्य विशेषरूपसे ईश्वरका चिन्तन करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: All deities assume the forms of the Brahmanas; they always exist. If Brahmanas are not available, they are- worshipped in idols etc. in some places.
verses.commentary: Sense: All deities assume the forms of the Brahmanas; they always exist. If Brahmanas are not available, they are- worshipped in idols etc. in some places.

verses.sanskrit: अमृतेनाथवा जीवेन्मृतेनाप्यथवा यदि । अयाचितं स्यादमृतं मृतं भेक्षं तु याचितम्
verses.transliteration: amṛtenāthavā jīvenmṛtenāpyathavā yadi / ayācitaṃ syādamṛtaṃ mṛtaṃ bhekṣaṃ tu yācitam
verses.translation: Hence, the deities must be particularly worshipped in the Brahmanas always and very assiduously by those who wish to attain the different kinds of benefits.
verses.hindi: (संन्यासीको) हृदयकमलरूपी घरमें विश्व नामक संसारके उत्पादक, सभी भूतोंके आत्मरूप, तमोगुणसे परे रहनेवाले, सभीके आश्रय, प्राणियोंको आनन्द देनेवाले, ज्योतिःस्वरूप, अविनाशी, प्रधान एवं पुरुषसे
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, the deities must be particularly worshipped in the Brahmanas always and very assiduously by those who wish to attain the different kinds of benefits.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, the deities must be particularly worshipped in the Brahmanas always and very assiduously by those who wish to attain the different kinds of benefits.

verses.sanskrit: कुशूलधान्यको वा स्यात् कुम्भीधान्यक एव वा । त्र्यहैहिको वापि भवेदश्वस्तनिक एव च
verses.transliteration: kuśūladhānyako vā syāt kumbhīdhānyaka eva vā / tryahaihiko vāpi bhavedaśvastanika eva ca
verses.translation: A person desirous of prosperity should always wor¬ ship Purandara (god Indra). A person desirous of attaining Brahman and Brahmanical splendour should worship Brahma.
verses.hindi: अतीत, आकाशरूप, अग्नि एवं शिवरूप, वस्तुमात्रके अस्तित्वके अधिष्ठाता, ब्रह्मरूपी ईश्वर, अनादि, अद्वैत, आनन्दादि गुणोंके निधान, महान्, पुरुष, परम ब्रह्म, अरुणवर्णवाले अर्थात् सत्त्व, रज, तमोरूप त्रिगुणात्मक, विश्वरूपी महेश्वरका ध्यान करना चाहिए। ओंकारका उच्चारणकर आत्माको प्रणवके परम तात्पर्यरूप परमात्मामें प्रतिष्ठितकर आकाशके मध्यमें स्थित रहनेवाले ईशानदेवका
verses.wordMeaning: A person desirous of prosperity should always wor¬ ship Purandara (god Indra). A person desirous of attaining Brahman and Brahmanical splendour should worship Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: A person desirous of prosperity should always wor¬ ship Purandara (god Indra). A person desirous of attaining Brahman and Brahmanical splendour should worship Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्णामपि चैतेषां द्विजानां गृहमेधिनाम् । श्रेयान् परः परो ज्ञेयो धर्मतो लोकजित्तमः
verses.transliteration: caturṇāmapi caiteṣāṃ dvijānāṃ gṛhamedhinām / śreyān paraḥ paro jñeyo dharmato lokajittamaḥ
verses.translation: A person desirous of good health shall worship the- sun god; one who is desirous of cows shall worship fire and one who is desirous of the fruition of holy rites shall worship- Vinayaka.
verses.hindi: (हृदयरूपी) आकाशमें ध्यान करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: A person desirous of good health shall worship the- sun god; one who is desirous of cows shall worship fire and one who is desirous of the fruition of holy rites shall worship- Vinayaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: A person desirous of good health shall worship the- sun god; one who is desirous of cows shall worship fire and one who is desirous of the fruition of holy rites shall worship- Vinayaka.

verses.sanskrit: षट्कर्मैको भवत्येषां त्रिभिरन्यः प्रवर्तते । द्वाभ्यामेकश्चतुर्थस्तु ब्रह्मसत्रेण जीवति
verses.transliteration: ṣaṭkarmaiko bhavatyeṣāṃ tribhiranyaḥ pravartate / dvābhyāmekaścaturthastu brahmasatreṇa jīvati
verses.translation: One who is desirous of worldly pleasures should wor¬ ship the moon; a person desirous of power and strength should worship the wind-god and a person desirous of being liberated from the entire worldly existence shall worship Hari.
verses.hindi: सभी भावोंके कारणरूप, आनन्दके एकमात्र आश्रयस्वरूप पुराण-पुरुष शम्भुका ध्यान करनेसे बन्धनसे मुक्ति हो जाती है। अथवा संसारके सम्मोहनालयरूप मूलप्रकृतिरूपी गुहामें परम व्योमरूप सभी भूतोंके एकमात्र कारण, सभी प्राणियोंके जीवनरूप और संसारके विलय-स्थान, ब्रह्मानन्द-स्वरूप तथा मुमुक्षु लोग जिनका सूक्ष्मरूपसे दर्शन करते हैं, उनका (परम व्योम विराट् ब्रह्मका) ध्यानकर उनके मध्यमें स्थित शुद्ध ज्ञानस्वरूप
verses.wordMeaning: One who is desirous of worldly pleasures should wor¬ ship the moon; a person desirous of power and strength should worship the wind-god and a person desirous of being liberated from the entire worldly existence shall worship Hari.
verses.commentary: Sense: One who is desirous of worldly pleasures should wor¬ ship the moon; a person desirous of power and strength should worship the wind-god and a person desirous of being liberated from the entire worldly existence shall worship Hari.

verses.sanskrit: वर्तयंस्तु शिलोञ्छाभ्यामग्निहोत्रपरायणः । इष्टीः पार्वायणान्तीयाः केवला निर्वपेत् सदा
verses.transliteration: vartayaṃstu śiloñchābhyāmagnihotraparāyaṇaḥ / iṣṭīḥ pārvāyaṇāntīyāḥ kevalā nirvapet sadā
verses.translation: He who wishes for Yoga, salvation and that perfect knowledge of Isvara shall assiduously worship Virupaksa Mahesvara.
verses.hindi: अनन्त, सत्य एवं ईशानरूप ब्रह्मका चिन्तन करते हुए संयत होकर स्थित रहना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: He who wishes for Yoga, salvation and that perfect knowledge of Isvara shall assiduously worship Virupaksa Mahesvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who wishes for Yoga, salvation and that perfect knowledge of Isvara shall assiduously worship Virupaksa Mahesvara.

verses.sanskrit: न लोकवृतिं वर्तेत वृत्तिहेतोः कथञ्चन । अजिह्मामशठां शुद्धां जीवेद् ब्राह्मणजीविकाम्
verses.transliteration: na lokavṛtiṃ varteta vṛttihetoḥ kathañcana / ajihmāmaśaṭhāṃ śuddhāṃ jīved brāhmaṇajīvikām
verses.translation: He who wishes for Yoga, salvation and that perfect knowledge of Isvara shall assiduously worship Virupaksa Mahesvara.
verses.hindi: यतियोंका यह गुह्यसे भी गुह्यतम ज्ञान महेशने योऽनुतिष्ठेन्महेशेन सोऽश्नुते योगमैश्वरम्॥ २०॥  बतलाया है। जो इसका अनुष्ठान करता है, वह
verses.wordMeaning: He who wishes for Yoga, salvation and that perfect knowledge of Isvara shall assiduously worship Virupaksa Mahesvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who wishes for Yoga, salvation and that perfect knowledge of Isvara shall assiduously worship Virupaksa Mahesvara.

verses.sanskrit: याचित्वा वापि सद्भ्यो ऽन्नं पितॄन्देवांस्तु तोषयेत् । याचयेद् वा शुचिं दान्तं न तृप्येत स्वयं ततः
verses.transliteration: yācitvā vāpi sadbhyo 'nnaṃ pitṝndevāṃstu toṣayet / yācayed vā śuciṃ dāntaṃ na tṛpyeta svayaṃ tataḥ
verses.translation: He who wishes for Yoga, salvation and that perfect knowledge of Isvara shall assiduously worship Virupaksa Mahesvara.
verses.hindi: ज्ञानं समभ्यसेद् ब्राह्या येन मुच्येत बन्धनात्
verses.wordMeaning: He who wishes for Yoga, salvation and that perfect knowledge of Isvara shall assiduously worship Virupaksa Mahesvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who wishes for Yoga, salvation and that perfect knowledge of Isvara shall assiduously worship Virupaksa Mahesvara.

verses.sanskrit: यस्तु द्रव्यार्जनं कृत्वा गृहस्थस्तोषयेन्न तु । देवान् पितृंश्च विधिना शुनां योनिं व्रजत्यसौ
verses.transliteration: yastu dravyārjanaṃ kṛtvā gṛhasthastoṣayenna tu / devān pitṛṃśca vidhinā śunāṃ yoniṃ vrajatyasau
verses.translation: He who wishes for Yoga, salvation and that perfect knowledge of Isvara shall assiduously worship Virupaksa Mahesvara.
verses.hindi: मत्वा पृथक् स्वमात्मानं सर्वस्मादेव केवलम्। आनन्दमजरं ज्ञानं ध्यायीत च पुनः परम् स तस्मादीश्वरो देवः परस्माद् योऽधितिष्ठति
verses.wordMeaning: He who wishes for Yoga, salvation and that perfect knowledge of Isvara shall assiduously worship Virupaksa Mahesvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who wishes for Yoga, salvation and that perfect knowledge of Isvara shall assiduously worship Virupaksa Mahesvara.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मश्चार्थश्च कामश्च श्रेयो मोक्षश्चतुष्टयम् । धर्माविरुद्धः कामः स्याद् ब्राह्मणानां तु नेतरः
verses.transliteration: dharmaścārthaśca kāmaśca śreyo mokṣaścatuṣṭayam / dharmāviruddhaḥ kāmaḥ syād brāhmaṇānāṃ tu netaraḥ
verses.translation: He who wishes for Yoga, salvation and that perfect knowledge of Isvara shall assiduously worship Virupaksa Mahesvara.
verses.hindi: यदन्तरे तद् गगनं शाश्वतं शिवमव्ययम्। यदंशस्तत्परो यस्तु स देवः स्यान्महेश्वरः
verses.wordMeaning: He who wishes for Yoga, salvation and that perfect knowledge of Isvara shall assiduously worship Virupaksa Mahesvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who wishes for Yoga, salvation and that perfect knowledge of Isvara shall assiduously worship Virupaksa Mahesvara.

verses.sanskrit: योर्ऽथो धर्माय नात्मार्थः सोर्ऽथो ऽनर्थस्तथेतरः । तस्मादर्थं समासाद्य दद्याद् वै जुहुयाद् यजेत्
verses.transliteration: yor'tho dharmāya nātmārthaḥ sor'tho 'narthastathetaraḥ / tasmādarthaṃ samāsādya dadyād vai juhuyād yajet
verses.translation: He who wishes for Yoga, salvation and that perfect knowledge of Isvara shall assiduously worship Virupaksa Mahesvara.
verses.hindi: एकैकातिक्रमे तेषां प्रायश्चित्तं विधीयते उपेत्य च स्त्रियं कामात् प्रायश्चित्तं समाहितः । प्राणायामसमायुक्तं कुर्यात् सांतपनं शुचि:
verses.wordMeaning: He who wishes for Yoga, salvation and that perfect knowledge of Isvara shall assiduously worship Virupaksa Mahesvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who wishes for Yoga, salvation and that perfect knowledge of Isvara shall assiduously worship Virupaksa Mahesvara.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे पञ्चविंशो ऽध्यायः इन् रेए निछ्त् ज़ुल्äस्सिगे ज़ेइछेन्: व्यास उवाच अथातः संप्रवक्ष्यामि दानधर्ममनुत्तमम् । ब्रह्मणाभिहितं पूर्वमृषीणां ब्रह्मवादिनाम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge pañcaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ in ree nicht zulässige zeichen: vyāsa uvāca athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi dānadharmamanuttamam / brahmaṇābhihitaṃ pūrvamṛṣīṇāṃ brahmavādinām
verses.translation: He who wishes for perfect knowledge through the the great Yoga should worship Mahesvara. They shall become enjoyers of pleasures, they who worship Bhutesa and Kesava.
verses.hindi: न धर्मयुक्तमनृतं हिनस्तीति मनीषिणः। तथापि च न कर्तव्यं प्रसंगो होष दारुणः
verses.wordMeaning: He who wishes for perfect knowledge through the the great Yoga should worship Mahesvara. They shall become enjoyers of pleasures, they who worship Bhutesa and Kesava.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who wishes for perfect knowledge through the the great Yoga should worship Mahesvara. They shall become enjoyers of pleasures, they who worship Bhutesa and Kesava.

verses.sanskrit: अर्थानामुदिते पात्रे श्रद्धया प्रतिपादनम् । दानमित्यभिनिर्दिष्टं भुक्तिमुक्तिफलप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: arthānāmudite pātre śraddhayā pratipādanam / dānamityabhinirdiṣṭaṃ bhuktimuktiphalapradam
verses.translation: A person who freely gives water attains satisfac¬ tion, a person who gives cooked food attains inexhaustible happiness; a person who gives gingelly seeds obtains desirable progeny and a person who gives lamps attains excellent vision.
verses.hindi: एकरात्रोपवासश्च प्राणायामशतं तथा। उक्त्वानृतं प्रकर्तव्यं यतिना धर्मलिप्सुना घरमापदगतेनापि न कार्य स्तेयमन्यतः। स्तेयादभ्यधिकः कञश्चिन्नास्त्यधर्म इति स्मृतिः ।
verses.wordMeaning: A person who freely gives water attains satisfac¬ tion, a person who gives cooked food attains inexhaustible happiness; a person who gives gingelly seeds obtains desirable progeny and a person who gives lamps attains excellent vision.
verses.commentary: Sense: A person who freely gives water attains satisfac¬ tion, a person who gives cooked food attains inexhaustible happiness; a person who gives gingelly seeds obtains desirable progeny and a person who gives lamps attains excellent vision.

verses.sanskrit: यद् ददाति विशिष्टेभ्यः श्रद्धया परया युतः । तद् वै वित्तमहं मन्ये शेषं कस्यापि रक्षति
verses.transliteration: yad dadāti viśiṣṭebhyaḥ śraddhayā parayā yutaḥ / tad vai vittamahaṃ manye śeṣaṃ kasyāpi rakṣati
verses.translation: A person who gifts away lands obtains everything, a giver of gold attains longevity; a giver of a house attains excel¬ lent abodes and a person who gives silver attains excellent comeliness.
verses.hindi: हिंसा चैषापरा दिष्टा या चात्मज्ञाननाशिका
verses.wordMeaning: A person who gifts away lands obtains everything, a giver of gold attains longevity; a giver of a house attains excel¬ lent abodes and a person who gives silver attains excellent comeliness.
verses.commentary: Sense: A person who gifts away lands obtains everything, a giver of gold attains longevity; a giver of a house attains excel¬ lent abodes and a person who gives silver attains excellent comeliness.

verses.sanskrit: नित्यं नैमित्तिकं काम्यं त्रिविधं दानमुच्यते । चतुर्थं विमलं प्रोक्तं सर्वदानोत्तमोत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: nityaṃ naimittikaṃ kāmyaṃ trividhaṃ dānamucyate / caturthaṃ vimalaṃ proktaṃ sarvadānottamottamam
verses.translation: A person who gives clothes, attains the same world as the Moon; a person who gives horses, attains the same world as that of the Asvins; a person who gives oxen, attains well nour¬ ished glory and riches and a giver of cows attains the world of Bradhna (the sun).
verses.hindi: यदेतद् द्रविणं नाम प्राणा होते बहिश्चराः। स तस्य हरति प्राणान् यो यस्य हरते धनम् ऐश्वरयोगको प्राप्त करता है
verses.wordMeaning: A person who gives clothes, attains the same world as the Moon; a person who gives horses, attains the same world as that of the Asvins; a person who gives oxen, attains well nour¬ ished glory and riches and a giver of cows attains the world of Bradhna (the sun).
verses.commentary: Sense: A person who gives clothes, attains the same world as the Moon; a person who gives horses, attains the same world as that of the Asvins; a person who gives oxen, attains well nour¬ ished glory and riches and a giver of cows attains the world of Bradhna (the sun).

verses.sanskrit: अहन्यहनि यत् किञ्चिद् दीयते ऽनुपकारिणे । अनुद्दिश्य फलं तस्माद् ब्राह्मणाय तु नित्यकम्
verses.transliteration: ahanyahani yat kiñcid dīyate 'nupakāriṇe / anuddiśya phalaṃ tasmād brāhmaṇāya tu nityakam
verses.translation: A person who gives vehicles and coaches attains a good wife; a person who offers relief from fear, attains pros¬ perity; a person who offers food grains, obtains perpetual happiness and a person who gives Brahman (Vedas), attains identity with Brahman.
verses.hindi: अतएव नित्य ध्यानमें निरत और आत्मविद्यापणायण होते हुए ब्रह्मज्ञानका अभ्यास करते रहना चाहिए। इसके कारण बन्धनसे मुक्ति होती है। अपनी आत्माको सबसे भिन्न (शाश्वत-नित्य) समझकर उसकी अद्वितीय,
verses.wordMeaning: A person who gives vehicles and coaches attains a good wife; a person who offers relief from fear, attains pros¬ perity; a person who offers food grains, obtains perpetual happiness and a person who gives Brahman (Vedas), attains identity with Brahman.
verses.commentary: Sense: A person who gives vehicles and coaches attains a good wife; a person who offers relief from fear, attains pros¬ perity; a person who offers food grains, obtains perpetual happiness and a person who gives Brahman (Vedas), attains identity with Brahman.

verses.sanskrit: यत् तु पापोपशान्त्यर्थं दीयते विदुषां करे । नैमित्तिकं तदुद्दिष्टं दानं सद्भिरनुष्ठितम्
verses.transliteration: yat tu pāpopaśāntyarthaṃ dīyate viduṣāṃ kare / naimittikaṃ taduddiṣṭaṃ dānaṃ sadbhiranuṣṭhitam
verses.translation: One should give food-grains to the Brahmanas in accordance with one's capacity and especially to excellent ones knowing the Vedas. After death, he shall attain heaven.
verses.hindi: अजर, आनन्दरूप, श्रेष्ठ ज्ञानरूपताका पुनः-पुनः ध्यान करना चाहिए। जिनसे चर-अचर समस्त प्रपञ्चकी उत्पत्ति होती है, जिन्हें प्राकर जन्म-मरणके बन्धनसे मुक्ति हो जाती है और इसी कारण जो ईश्वर हैं, देव हैं, सर्वोत्कृष्ट हैं, सबके अधिष्ठाता हैं, वे ही महेश्वर हैं। जिनके अन्तर्गत शाश्वत, शिव, अव्यय, गगन विद्यमान है, जगन्नियन्ता परमात्मा जिनके अंश हैं, वे ही देव महेश्वर हैं (इनका पुनः-पुनः ध्यान यतिको
verses.wordMeaning: One should give food-grains to the Brahmanas in accordance with one's capacity and especially to excellent ones knowing the Vedas. After death, he shall attain heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should give food-grains to the Brahmanas in accordance with one's capacity and especially to excellent ones knowing the Vedas. After death, he shall attain heaven.

verses.sanskrit: अपत्यविजयैश्वर्यस्वर्गार्थं यत् प्रदीयते । दानं तत् काम्यमाख्यातमृषिभिर्धर्मचिन्तकैः
verses.transliteration: apatyavijayaiśvaryasvargārthaṃ yat pradīyate / dānaṃ tat kāmyamākhyātamṛṣibhirdharmacintakaiḥ
verses.translation: By giving away cows one is relieved of all sins; by the gift of fuel, a man becomes like a blazing fire.
verses.hindi: करना चाहिए) । भिक्षुओं (संन्यासियों)-के जो व्रत और उपव्रत हैं, उनमेंसे एक-एकका अतिक्रमण करनेपर प्रायश्चित्तका विधान किया गया है
verses.wordMeaning: By giving away cows one is relieved of all sins; by the gift of fuel, a man becomes like a blazing fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: By giving away cows one is relieved of all sins; by the gift of fuel, a man becomes like a blazing fire.

verses.sanskrit: यदीश्वरप्रीणनार्थं ब्रह्मवित्सु प्रदीयते । चेतसा धर्मयुक्तेन दानं तद् विमलं शिवम्
verses.transliteration: yadīśvaraprīṇanārthaṃ brahmavitsu pradīyate / cetasā dharmayuktena dānaṃ tad vimalaṃ śivam
verses.translation: One should give fruits, roots, vegetables and food¬ stuffs of various kinds to the Brahmnas, he shall himself be happy and rejoicing.
verses.hindi: कामवश स्त्रीप्रसंग करनेपर समाहित होकर प्राणायाम कर पवित्रतापूर्वक प्रायश्चित्तके लिये सांतपन नामक व्रत करना चाहिए। तदनन्तर संयतमानस होकर नियमसे कृच्छू (चान्द्रायण)-व्रत करे। पुनः अपने आश्रममें आकर आलस्यका परित्याग कर भिक्षुको आश्रमोचित आचरण करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: One should give fruits, roots, vegetables and food¬ stuffs of various kinds to the Brahmnas, he shall himself be happy and rejoicing.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should give fruits, roots, vegetables and food¬ stuffs of various kinds to the Brahmnas, he shall himself be happy and rejoicing.

verses.sanskrit: दानधर्मं निषेवेत पात्रमासाद्य शक्तितः । उत्पत्स्यते हि तत्पात्रं यत् तारयति सर्वतः
verses.transliteration: dānadharmaṃ niṣeveta pātramāsādya śaktitaḥ / utpatsyate hi tatpātraṃ yat tārayati sarvataḥ
verses.translation: A person who gives medicine, diets, oil, ghee etc. to a sick person in order to cure him of it, shall himself be free from ailments. He shall enjoy longevity and be happy.
verses.hindi: विद्वानोंका यह कहना है कि धर्मयुक्त असत्यसे व्रतभङ्ग नहीं होता, तथापि ऐसा नहीं करना चाहिए। क्योंकि इसमें आसक्ति रखना दारुण कर्म है। धर्माभिलाषी यतिको चाहिए कि वह असत्यभाषण करनेपर एक
verses.wordMeaning: A person who gives medicine, diets, oil, ghee etc. to a sick person in order to cure him of it, shall himself be free from ailments. He shall enjoy longevity and be happy.
verses.commentary: Sense: A person who gives medicine, diets, oil, ghee etc. to a sick person in order to cure him of it, shall himself be free from ailments. He shall enjoy longevity and be happy.

verses.sanskrit: कुटुम्बभक्तवसनाद् देयं यदतिरिच्यते । अन्यथा दीयते यद्धि न तद् दानं फलप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: kuṭumbabhaktavasanād deyaṃ yadatiricyate / anyathā dīyate yaddhi na tad dānaṃ phalapradam
verses.translation: A man who makes gifts of umbrellas and shoes escapes the path to hell called Asipatravana (full of edges as sharp as the edge of a razor) and surmounts severe scorching pain.
verses.hindi: रात्रि उपवास तथा सौ प्राणायाम करे। अत्यन्त संकटमें होनेपर भी भिक्षुको किसी अन्य प्रयोजनसे भी चोरी नहीं करनी चाहिए। चोरीसे बढ़कर दूसरा कोई अधर्म नहीं है, यही सबसे बड़ी हिंसा भी है, क्योंकि इससे आत्मज्ञान विनष्ट हो जाता है, ऐसा स्मृतियोंका सिद्धान्त है॥ २८--३० ॥
verses.wordMeaning: A man who makes gifts of umbrellas and shoes escapes the path to hell called Asipatravana (full of edges as sharp as the edge of a razor) and surmounts severe scorching pain.
verses.commentary: Sense: A man who makes gifts of umbrellas and shoes escapes the path to hell called Asipatravana (full of edges as sharp as the edge of a razor) and surmounts severe scorching pain.

verses.sanskrit: श्रोत्रियाय कुलीनाय विनीताय तपस्विने । वृत्तस्थाय दरिद्राय प्रदेयं भक्तिपूर्वकम्
verses.transliteration: śrotriyāya kulīnāya vinītāya tapasvine / vṛttasthāya daridrāya pradeyaṃ bhaktipūrvakam
verses.translation: Whatever is most pleasing to him in the world and whatever is excessively cherished by one in the house, should be given to a meritorious person by one who wishes the same for himself to be inexhaustible.
verses.hindi: यह जो द्रविण--धन नामकी वस्तु है, यह बाहरी प्राण ही है, इसलिये जो जिसके धनका अपहरण करता है, वह उसके प्राणोंका ही हरण करता है
verses.wordMeaning: Whatever is most pleasing to him in the world and whatever is excessively cherished by one in the house, should be given to a meritorious person by one who wishes the same for himself to be inexhaustible.
verses.commentary: Sense: Whatever is most pleasing to him in the world and whatever is excessively cherished by one in the house, should be given to a meritorious person by one who wishes the same for himself to be inexhaustible.

verses.sanskrit: यस्तु दद्यान्महीं भक्त्या ब्राह्मणायाहिताग्नये । स याति परमं स्थानं यत्र गत्वा न शोचति
verses.transliteration: yastu dadyānmahīṃ bhaktyā brāhmaṇāyāhitāgnaye / sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra gatvā na śocati
verses.translation: Whatever is given during the equinotical or tropical transit of the sun or during the eclipse of the sun or the moon or during the time of the transit of the sun from one zodiac to another, shall become everlasting.
verses.hindi: अकस्मादेव हिंसां तु यदि भिक्षुः समाचरेत्। कुर्यात् कृच्छातिकृच्छं तु चान्द्रायणमथापि वा एकान्ने मधुमांसे च नवश्राद्धे तथैव च। प्रत्यक्षलवणे चोक्तं प्राजापत्यं विशोधनम्
verses.wordMeaning: Whatever is given during the equinotical or tropical transit of the sun or during the eclipse of the sun or the moon or during the time of the transit of the sun from one zodiac to another, shall become everlasting.
verses.commentary: Sense: Whatever is given during the equinotical or tropical transit of the sun or during the eclipse of the sun or the moon or during the time of the transit of the sun from one zodiac to another, shall become everlasting.

verses.sanskrit: इक्षुभिः संततां भुमिं यवगोधूमशलिनीम् । ददाति वेदविदुषे यः स भूयो न जायते
verses.transliteration: ikṣubhiḥ saṃtatāṃ bhumiṃ yavagodhūmaśalinīm / dadāti vedaviduṣe yaḥ sa bhūyo na jāyate
verses.translation: By making gifts in the holy centres such as Prayaga etc. in the sacred shrines and near the holy rivers and forests, one obtains everlasting benefits.
verses.hindi: यद् ब्रह्म परमं ज्योतिः प्रतिष्ठाक्षरमद्वयम्। योऽन्तरात्र परं ब्रह्म स विज्ञेयो महेश्वरः
verses.wordMeaning: By making gifts in the holy centres such as Prayaga etc. in the sacred shrines and near the holy rivers and forests, one obtains everlasting benefits.
verses.commentary: Sense: By making gifts in the holy centres such as Prayaga etc. in the sacred shrines and near the holy rivers and forests, one obtains everlasting benefits.

verses.sanskrit: गोचर्ममात्रामपि वा यो भूमिं संप्रयच्छति । ब्राह्मणाय दरिद्राय सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: gocarmamātrāmapi vā yo bhūmiṃ saṃprayacchati / brāhmaṇāya daridrāya sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
verses.translation: There is no greater or meritorious act than that of making gifts in the case of any living being. Hence gifts should be made over to a Brahmana well-versed in the Vedas, by the twice-born.
verses.hindi: एष देवो महादेवः केवलः परमः शिवः। तदेवाक्षरमद्वैतं तदादित्यान्तरं परम् यस्मान्महीयते देवः स्वधाम्नि ज्ञानसंज्ञिते। आत्मयोगाह्वये तत्त्वे महादेवस्ततः स्मृतः
verses.wordMeaning: There is no greater or meritorious act than that of making gifts in the case of any living being. Hence gifts should be made over to a Brahmana well-versed in the Vedas, by the twice-born.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no greater or meritorious act than that of making gifts in the case of any living being. Hence gifts should be made over to a Brahmana well-versed in the Vedas, by the twice-born.

verses.sanskrit: भूमिदानात् परं दानं विद्यते नेह किञ्चन । अन्नदानं तेन तुल्यं विद्यादानं ततो ऽधिकम्
verses.transliteration: bhūmidānāt paraṃ dānaṃ vidyate neha kiñcana / annadānaṃ tena tulyaṃ vidyādānaṃ tato 'dhikam
verses.translation: Gifts should be made by one who wishes for heaven, longevity and prosperity and for subduing sins. Everday charitable gifts should be made unto Brahmanas by one who wishes for salvation.
verses.hindi: नान्यद् देवान्महादेवाद् व्यतिरिक्तं प्रपश्यति। तमेवात्मानमन्वेति यः स याति परं पदम्
verses.wordMeaning: Gifts should be made by one who wishes for heaven, longevity and prosperity and for subduing sins. Everday charitable gifts should be made unto Brahmanas by one who wishes for salvation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gifts should be made by one who wishes for heaven, longevity and prosperity and for subduing sins. Everday charitable gifts should be made unto Brahmanas by one who wishes for salvation.

verses.sanskrit: यो ब्राह्मणाय शान्ताय शुचये धर्मशालिने । ददाति विद्यां विधिना ब्रह्मलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: yo brāhmaṇāya śāntāya śucaye dharmaśāline / dadāti vidyāṃ vidhinā brahmaloke mahīyate
verses.translation: If out of delusion, any sinful soul prevents the gift from being given to the Brahmanas, fire-god or the Devas, shall be reborn as an animal.
verses.hindi: न ते पश्यन्ति तं देवं वृथा तेषां परिश्रमः एकमेव परं ब्रह्म विज्ञेयं तत्त्वमव्ययम्। स देवस्तु महादेवो नैतद् विज्ञाय बध्यते
verses.wordMeaning: If out of delusion, any sinful soul prevents the gift from being given to the Brahmanas, fire-god or the Devas, shall be reborn as an animal.
verses.commentary: Sense: If out of delusion, any sinful soul prevents the gift from being given to the Brahmanas, fire-god or the Devas, shall be reborn as an animal.

verses.sanskrit: दद्यादहरहस्त्वन्नं श्रद्धया ब्रह्मचारिणे । सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो ब्रह्मणः स्थानमाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: dadyādaharahastvannaṃ śraddhayā brahmacāriṇe / sarvapāpavinirmukto brahmaṇaḥ sthānamāpnuyāt
verses.translation: If after earning much wealth, anyone does not wor¬ ship Brahmanas and Devas, he must be banished from the kingdom after confiscating his property.
verses.hindi: ज्ञानयोगरतः शान्तो महादेवपरायणः
verses.wordMeaning: If after earning much wealth, anyone does not wor¬ ship Brahmanas and Devas, he must be banished from the kingdom after confiscating his property.
verses.commentary: Sense: If after earning much wealth, anyone does not wor¬ ship Brahmanas and Devas, he must be banished from the kingdom after confiscating his property.

verses.sanskrit: गृहस्थायान्नदानेन फलं प्राप्नोति मानवः । आममेवास्य दातव्यं दत्त्वाप्नोति परां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: gṛhasthāyānnadānena phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ / āmamevāsya dātavyaṃ dattvāpnoti parāṃ gatim
verses.translation: A Brahmana who does not give cooked food etc. during famines when animals die, is a despicable person.
verses.hindi: निश्चित ही धन हरण करनेवाला दुष्टात्मा आचारसे भ्रष्ट और ब्रतसे च्युत हो जाता है। श्रुतिका विधान है कि यदि कोई अपने व्रतसे च्युत व्यक्ति अपने पुन: व्रतभङ्गपर पश्चात्ताप करे तो शास्त्रानुकूल विधिसे आलस्य- रहित होकर एक वर्षतक चान्द्रायणव्रत करे
verses.wordMeaning: A Brahmana who does not give cooked food etc. during famines when animals die, is a despicable person.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmana who does not give cooked food etc. during famines when animals die, is a despicable person.

verses.sanskrit: वैशाख्यां पौर्णमास्यां तु ब्राह्मणान् सप्त पञ्च वा । उपोष्य विधिना शान्तः शुचिः प्रयतमानसः
verses.transliteration: vaiśākhyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ tu brāhmaṇān sapta pañca vā / upoṣya vidhinā śāntaḥ śuciḥ prayatamānasaḥ
verses.translation: No one should accept monetary gifts from him nor should anything be given unto him. The king should stamp his seal on him and banish him from his kingdom.
verses.hindi: यदि भिक्षुसे अकस्मात् हिंसा हो जाय तो उसे
verses.wordMeaning: No one should accept monetary gifts from him nor should anything be given unto him. The king should stamp his seal on him and banish him from his kingdom.
verses.commentary: Sense: No one should accept monetary gifts from him nor should anything be given unto him. The king should stamp his seal on him and banish him from his kingdom.

verses.sanskrit: पूजयित्वा तिलैः कृष्णैर्मधुना न विशेषतः । गन्धादिभिः समभ्यर्च्य वाचयेद् वा स्व्यं वदेत्
verses.transliteration: pūjayitvā tilaiḥ kṛṣṇairmadhunā na viśeṣataḥ / gandhādibhiḥ samabhyarcya vācayed vā svyaṃ vadet
verses.translation: The man who does not give wealth to good persons nor means of piety, is a greater sinner and he is cooked in the hell.
verses.hindi: व्रत (हिंसाके स्वरूपके अनुसार) करना चाहिए। इन्द्रियकी दुर्बलताके कारण यदि स्त्रीको देखकर यति स्खलित हो जाय तो उसे सोलह प्राणायाम करना चाहिए। दिनमें स्खलन होनेपर तीन रातका उपवास और सौ प्राणायाम करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: The man who does not give wealth to good persons nor means of piety, is a greater sinner and he is cooked in the hell.
verses.commentary: Sense: The man who does not give wealth to good persons nor means of piety, is a greater sinner and he is cooked in the hell.

verses.sanskrit: प्रीयतां धर्मराजेति यद् वा मनसि वर्तते । यावज्जीवकृतं पापं तत्क्षणादेव नश्यति
verses.transliteration: prīyatāṃ dharmarājeti yad vā manasi vartate / yāvajjīvakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tatkṣaṇādeva naśyati
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas, gifts must be made to those Brahmanas who regularly study the Vedas, who are endowed with learning, who have conquered their sense-organs and who are endowed with full self-control.
verses.hindi: एकका ही अन्न भक्षण करने, मधु ग्रहण करने,
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahmanas, gifts must be made to those Brahmanas who regularly study the Vedas, who are endowed with learning, who have conquered their sense-organs and who are endowed with full self-control.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmanas, gifts must be made to those Brahmanas who regularly study the Vedas, who are endowed with learning, who have conquered their sense-organs and who are endowed with full self-control.

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णाजिने तिलान् कृत्त्वा हिरण्यं मधुसर्पिषी । ददाति यस्तु विप्राय सर्वं तरति दुष्कृतम्
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇājine tilān kṛttvā hiraṇyaṃ madhusarpiṣī / dadāti yastu viprāya sarvaṃ tarati duṣkṛtam
verses.translation: One shall feed a learned and righteous Brahmana again even if he has already taken a hearty meal; one should not
verses.hindi: प्राजापत्यत्रतको (पापकी) शुद्धिका उपाय बतलाया गया है। निरन्तर ध्याननिष्ठ पुरुषके सभी पातक नष्ट हो जाते हैं, इसलिये महेश्वरका ज्ञान प्राप्तकर उनके ध्यानमें परायण रहना चाहिए। जो ब्रह्म परम ज्योतिरूप, सभीका अधिष्ठान, अक्षर अद्वितीय है तथा जो सभीके भीतर स्थित है, परम ब्रह्म है, उसे महेश्वर जानना चाहिए। ये ही महेश्वर देव, महादेव एवं अद्वितीय परम शिव हैं। ये ही अविनाशी, अद्वैत हैं और ये ही आदित्यके भीतर प्रतिष्ठित परम
verses.wordMeaning: One shall feed a learned and righteous Brahmana again even if he has already taken a hearty meal; one should not
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall feed a learned and righteous Brahmana again even if he has already taken a hearty meal; one should not

verses.sanskrit: कृतान्नमुदकुम्भं च वैशाख्यां च विशेषतः । निर्दिश्य धर्मराजाय विप्रेभ्यो मुच्यते भयात्
verses.transliteration: kṛtānnamudakumbhaṃ ca vaiśākhyāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ / nirdiśya dharmarājāya viprebhyo mucyate bhayāt
verses.translation: If any one makes any gift overlooking the learned Brahmana of the locality, he becomes a sinner by means of that action. He burns his family upto the seventh generation.
verses.hindi: (तत्त्व) हैं। आत्मयोग नामसे प्रसिद्ध, स्वप्रकाश, नित्य- ज्ञान नामसे भी विख्यात, परम तत्त्वरूप अपने धाममें सर्वाधिक पूजनीय-रूपसे ये महेश्वर प्रतिष्ठित हैं, इसीलिये महादेव कहे जाते हैं॥ ३६--४० ॥
verses.wordMeaning: If any one makes any gift overlooking the learned Brahmana of the locality, he becomes a sinner by means of that action. He burns his family upto the seventh generation.
verses.commentary: Sense: If any one makes any gift overlooking the learned Brahmana of the locality, he becomes a sinner by means of that action. He burns his family upto the seventh generation.

verses.sanskrit: सुवर्णतिलयुक्तैस्तु ब्राह्मणान् सप्त पञ्च वा । तर्पयेदुदपात्रैस्तु ब्रह्महत्यां व्यपोहति
verses.transliteration: suvarṇatilayuktaistu brāhmaṇān sapta pañca vā / tarpayedudapātraistu brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati
verses.translation: If the Brahmana outsider were to be superior in conduct, learning etc., gifts must be made over to him even by overlooking the man at hand.
verses.hindi: जो महादेवसे भिन्न किसी दूसरे देवको नहीं जानता और इन्हींको अपनी आत्मा मानता है, वह परम पदको प्रात होता है। जो अपनी आत्माको परमेश्वरसे भिन्न मानते हैं, वे उस देवका दर्शन नहीं करते हैं, उनका परिश्रम व्यर्थं होता है
verses.wordMeaning: If the Brahmana outsider were to be superior in conduct, learning etc., gifts must be made over to him even by overlooking the man at hand.
verses.commentary: Sense: If the Brahmana outsider were to be superior in conduct, learning etc., gifts must be made over to him even by overlooking the man at hand.

verses.sanskrit: माघमासे तु विप्रस्तु द्वादश्यां समुपोषितः । शुक्लाम्वरधरः कृष्णैस्तिलैर्हुत्वा हुताशनम्
verses.transliteration: māghamāse tu viprastu dvādaśyāṃ samupoṣitaḥ / śuklāmvaradharaḥ kṛṣṇaistilairhutvā hutāśanam
verses.translation: A person who knows Dharma should not offer even water to an atheist or a heretic or to a sceptic or to a person who does not know the Vedas.
verses.hindi: परम ब्रह्म एक ही हैं, इन्हें ही अव्यय तत्त्वके रूपमें जानना चाहिए। ये अव्यय तत्त्व ब्रह्म ही देव हैं, महादेव हैं, इन्हें जान लेनेपर बन्धन नहीं होता। इसलिये यतिको संयतमन होकर (इन्हें प्रात करनेके
verses.wordMeaning: A person who knows Dharma should not offer even water to an atheist or a heretic or to a sceptic or to a person who does not know the Vedas.
verses.commentary: Sense: A person who knows Dharma should not offer even water to an atheist or a heretic or to a sceptic or to a person who does not know the Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: प्रदद्याद् ब्राह्मणेभ्यस्तु तिलानेव समाहितः । जन्मप्रभृति यत्पापं सर्वं तरति वै द्विजः
verses.transliteration: pradadyād brāhmaṇebhyastu tilāneva samāhitaḥ / janmaprabhṛti yatpāpaṃ sarvaṃ tarati vai dvijaḥ
verses.translation: A Brahmana should try dimunition of his expenditure for livelihood but should not wish for the expansion of wealth. One who is in the clutches of covetousness for wealth falls off from Brahmanahood.
verses.hindi: लिये) प्रयत्न करना चाहिए। ज्ञानयोगमें रत रहना चाहिए, शान्त रहना चाहिए और महादेवके परायण रहना चाहिए ४०२ + कूर्मपुराण
verses.wordMeaning: A Brahmana should try dimunition of his expenditure for livelihood but should not wish for the expansion of wealth. One who is in the clutches of covetousness for wealth falls off from Brahmanahood.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmana should try dimunition of his expenditure for livelihood but should not wish for the expansion of wealth. One who is in the clutches of covetousness for wealth falls off from Brahmanahood.

verses.sanskrit: अमावस्यामनुप्राप्य ब्राह्मणाय तपस्विने । यत्किचिद् देवदेवेशं दद्याच्चोद्दिश्य शङ्करम्
verses.transliteration: amāvasyāmanuprāpya brāhmaṇāya tapasvine / yatkicid devadeveśaṃ dadyāccoddiśya śaṅkaram
verses.translation: Even after studying the Vedas and after perfor¬ ming 11 Yajnas, one does not attain that goal which one attains by means of diminution of avocatipn (i.e. curtailment of expenses).
verses.hindi: एष वः कथितो विप्रा यतीनामाश्रमः शुभः । है विप्रो! यह आप लोगोंको संन्यासियोंके कल्यागकारी
verses.wordMeaning: Even after studying the Vedas and after perfor¬ ming 11 Yajnas, one does not attain that goal which one attains by means of diminution of avocatipn (i.e. curtailment of expenses).
verses.commentary: Sense: Even after studying the Vedas and after perfor¬ ming 11 Yajnas, one does not attain that goal which one attains by means of diminution of avocatipn (i.e. curtailment of expenses).

verses.sanskrit: प्रीयतामीश्वरः सोमो महादेवः सनातनः । सप्तजन्मकृतं पापं तत्क्षणादेव नश्यति
verses.transliteration: prīyatāmīśvaraḥ somo mahādevaḥ sanātanaḥ / saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tatkṣaṇādeva naśyati
verses.translation: No Brahmana shall be excessively interested in mone¬ tary gifts; one may accept the amount required for a religious journey. A Brahmana accepting more than what is required for sustenance faces downfall.
verses.hindi: पितामहेन विभुना मुनीनां पूर्वमीरितम्॥ ४५॥  आश्रम (संन्यासाश्रम)-के विषयमें बतलाया। पूर्वकालमें पितामह विभुने मुनियोंसे इसे कहा था। ब्रह्वाजीद्वारा
verses.wordMeaning: No Brahmana shall be excessively interested in mone¬ tary gifts; one may accept the amount required for a religious journey. A Brahmana accepting more than what is required for sustenance faces downfall.
verses.commentary: Sense: No Brahmana shall be excessively interested in mone¬ tary gifts; one may accept the amount required for a religious journey. A Brahmana accepting more than what is required for sustenance faces downfall.

verses.sanskrit: यस्तु कृष्णचतुर्दश्यां स्नात्वा देवं पिनाकिनम् । आराधयेद् द्विजमुखे न तस्यास्ति पुनर्भवः
verses.transliteration: yastu kṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ snātvā devaṃ pinākinam / ārādhayed dvijamukhe na tasyāsti punarbhavaḥ
verses.translation: One who perpetually begs cannot attain heaven. Just as a thief annoys all living beings, so also the perpetual beggar.
verses.hindi: कहे गये यतिधर्मविषयक इस कल्याणकारी उत्तम
verses.wordMeaning: One who perpetually begs cannot attain heaven. Just as a thief annoys all living beings, so also the perpetual beggar.
verses.commentary: Sense: One who perpetually begs cannot attain heaven. Just as a thief annoys all living beings, so also the perpetual beggar.

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णाष्टम्यां विशेषेण धार्मिकाय द्विजातये । स्नात्वाभ्यर्च्य यथान्यायं पादप्रक्षालनादिभिः
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ viśeṣeṇa dhārmikāya dvijātaye / snātvābhyarcya yathānyāyaṃ pādaprakṣālanādibhiḥ
verses.translation: A person desirous of uplifting preceptors, elders or servants, a person desirous of worshipping deities and guests, can
verses.hindi: नापुत्रशिष्ययोगिभ्यो दद्यादिदमनुत्तमम्। ज्ञानको पुत्र, शिष्य तथा योगियोंके अतिरिक्त अन्य ज्ञानं स्वयम्भुवा प्रोक्तं यतिधर्माश्रयं शिवम्॥ ४६॥  किसीको नहीं देना चाहिए इस प्रकार संन्यासियोंके नियमोंके इस विधानको
verses.wordMeaning: A person desirous of uplifting preceptors, elders or servants, a person desirous of worshipping deities and guests, can
verses.commentary: Sense: A person desirous of uplifting preceptors, elders or servants, a person desirous of worshipping deities and guests, can

verses.sanskrit: प्रीयतां मे महादेवो दद्याद् द्रव्यं स्वकीयकम् । सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तः प्राप्नोति परमां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: prīyatāṃ me mahādevo dadyād dravyaṃ svakīyakam / sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ prāpnoti paramāṃ gatim
verses.translation: A householder with his soul absorbed in meditation, who worships deities and guests and who remains endowed with self-control, attains the greatest region.
verses.hindi: इति यतिनियमानामेतदुक्तं विधानं बतलाया गया। यह पशुपति (शंकर) -को संतुष्ट करनेका पशुपतिपरितोषे यद् भवेदेकहेतुः । एकमात्र उपाय है। जो अव्यग्रभावसे एकाग्रतापूर्वक इसका न भवति पुनरेषामुद्भवो वा विनाशः नित्य आचरण करते हैं, उनका पुनः जन्म अथवा मरण
verses.wordMeaning: A householder with his soul absorbed in meditation, who worships deities and guests and who remains endowed with self-control, attains the greatest region.
verses.commentary: Sense: A householder with his soul absorbed in meditation, who worships deities and guests and who remains endowed with self-control, attains the greatest region.

verses.sanskrit: द्विजैः कृष्णचतुर्दश्यां कृष्णाष्टम्यां विशेषतः । अमावास्यायां भक्तैस्तु पूजनीयस्त्रिलोचनः
verses.transliteration: dvijaiḥ kṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ viśeṣataḥ / amāvāsyāyāṃ bhaktaistu pūjanīyastrilocanaḥ
verses.translation: Or he should entrust everything to his son and go to the forest. As a knower of reality, he should wander alone. He should be indifferent to worldly affairs and endowed with great concentration (in spiritual activities).
verses.hindi: प्रणिहितमनसो ये नित्यमेवाचरन्ति॥ ४७ ॥  कुछ भी नहीं होता अर्थात् वे मुक्त हो जाते हैं इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षद्साहरुयाँ संहितायामुपरिविभागे एकोनत्रिँशोऽध्यायः
verses.wordMeaning: Or he should entrust everything to his son and go to the forest. As a knower of reality, he should wander alone. He should be indifferent to worldly affairs and endowed with great concentration (in spiritual activities).
verses.commentary: Sense: Or he should entrust everything to his son and go to the forest. As a knower of reality, he should wander alone. He should be indifferent to worldly affairs and endowed with great concentration (in spiritual activities).

verses.sanskrit: एकादश्यां निराहारो द्वादश्यां पुरुषोत्तमम् । अर्चयेद् बाह्मणमुखे स गच्छेत् परमं पदम्
verses.transliteration: ekādaśyāṃ nirāhāro dvādaśyāṃ puruṣottamam / arcayed bāhmaṇamukhe sa gacchet paramaṃ padam
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas, the duty of the householders has been expounded to you thus. One should abide by these after knowing them and shall make other Brahmanas follow the same.
verses.hindi: प्रायक्चित्त-प्रकरणमें प्रायश्चित्तका स्वरूपनिरूपण, पाँच महापातकोंके
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahmanas, the duty of the householders has been expounded to you thus. One should abide by these after knowing them and shall make other Brahmanas follow the same.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmanas, the duty of the householders has been expounded to you thus. One should abide by these after knowing them and shall make other Brahmanas follow the same.

verses.sanskrit: एषा तिथिर्वैष्णवीं स्याद् द्वादशी शुक्लपक्षके । तस्यामाराधयेद् देवं प्रयत्नेन जनार्दनम्
verses.transliteration: eṣā tithirvaiṣṇavīṃ syād dvādaśī śuklapakṣake / tasyāmārādhayed devaṃ prayatnena janārdanam
verses.translation: Thus, one should always worship the only primordial lord by following the duties of the householder. He shall sur¬ mount the Prakrti, the source of origin of all living beings and he does not take another birth.
verses.hindi: व्यास उवाच व्यासजीने कहा--इसके अनन्तर अब मैं सभी अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि प्रायश्चित्तविधिं शुभम्। ब्राह्मणोंके कल्याणके लिये और दोषोंके विनाशके लिये हिताय सर्वविप्राणां दोषाणामपनुत्तये॥ १॥  शुभ प्रायश्चित्त-विधिका वर्णन करूँगा अकृत्वा विहितं कर्म कृत्वा निन्दितमेव च। विहित कर्मोंको न करने और निन्दित कर्माको दोषमाप्नोति पुरुषः प्रायश्चित्तं विशोधनम्॥ २॥  करनेसे पुरुष दोष (पाप)-का भागी होता है। इसको निवृत्ति प्रायश्चित्त करनेसे होती है। ब्राह्मणको बिना प्रायश्चित्त किये कभी भी नहीं रहना चाहिंये। शान्त
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, one should always worship the only primordial lord by following the duties of the householder. He shall sur¬ mount the Prakrti, the source of origin of all living beings and he does not take another birth.
