verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, one should always worship the only primordial lord by following the duties of the householder. He shall sur¬ mount the Prakrti, the source of origin of all living beings and he does not take another birth.

verses.sanskrit: यत्किञ्चिद् देवमीशानमुद्दिश्य ब्राह्मणे शुचौ । दीयते विष्णवे वापि तदनन्तफलप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: yatkiñcid devamīśānamuddiśya brāhmaṇe śucau / dīyate viṣṇave vāpi tadanantaphalapradam
verses.translation: Manu VI. 23-24, Yaj. III. 52.
verses.hindi: एवं विद्वान् ब्राह्मण जो कहें, उसे करना चाहिए।
verses.wordMeaning: Manu VI. 23-24, Yaj. III. 52.
verses.commentary: Sense: Manu VI. 23-24, Yaj. III. 52.

verses.sanskrit: यो हि यां देवतामिच्छेत् समाराधयितुं नरः । ब्राह्मणान् पूजयेद् यत्नात् सतस्यां तोषयेत् ततः
verses.transliteration: yo hi yāṃ devatāmicchet samārādhayituṃ naraḥ / brāhmaṇān pūjayed yatnāt satasyāṃ toṣayet tataḥ
verses.translation: Manu VI. 29-30.
verses.hindi: वेदार्थवित्तमः शान्तो धर्मकामोऽय्निमान् द्विजः।  वैदार्थज्ञानियोमें श्रेष्ठ, शान्त, धर्मपालनको ही सर्वस्व स्यात् परो धर्मो यमेकोऽपि व्यवस्यति॥ ४॥ माननेवाला एक भी अग्निहोत्री ब्राह्मण जो अप ह RN आचरणमें लाता है, वही श्रेष्ठ धर्म होता है। वेदा
verses.wordMeaning: Manu VI. 29-30.
verses.commentary: Sense: Manu VI. 29-30.

verses.sanskrit: द्विजानां वपुरास्थाय नित्यं तिष्ठन्ति देवताः । पूज्यन्ते ब्राह्मणालाभे प्रतिमादिष्वपि क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: dvijānāṃ vapurāsthāya nityaṃ tiṣṭhanti devatāḥ / pūjyante brāhmaṇālābhe pratimādiṣvapi kvacit
verses.translation: He should take to a fruit diet after collecting holy fruits and roots. He should worship the Pitrs and the deities with what constitutes his controlled diet.
verses.hindi: अनाहिताग्रयो विप्रास्त्रयो वेदार्थपारगाः। पारंगत, धर्मपरायण अनाहिताग्नि तीन ब्राह्मण जो कहें, यद् ब्रूयुर्धर्मकामास्ते तज्ज्ञेयं धर्मसाधनम्॥ ५॥  उसे धर्मका साधन समझना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: He should take to a fruit diet after collecting holy fruits and roots. He should worship the Pitrs and the deities with what constitutes his controlled diet.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should take to a fruit diet after collecting holy fruits and roots. He should worship the Pitrs and the deities with what constitutes his controlled diet.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन तत् तत् फलमभीप्सता । द्विजेषु देवता नित्यं पूजनीया विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: tasmāt sarvaprayatnena tat tat phalamabhīpsatā / dvijeṣu devatā nityaṃ pūjanīyā viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: He should always worship the guests; after taking bath he should worship the gods. With great composure, he should eat only eight mouthfuls out of what he brings from the house.
verses.hindi: अनेक धर्मशास्त्रोंके ज्ञाता, ऊहापोहमें दक्ष (शास्त्रीय विभिन्न सिद्धान्तोंके आकलन तथा समन्वयमें कुशल)
verses.wordMeaning: He should always worship the guests; after taking bath he should worship the gods. With great composure, he should eat only eight mouthfuls out of what he brings from the house.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should always worship the guests; after taking bath he should worship the gods. With great composure, he should eat only eight mouthfuls out of what he brings from the house.

verses.sanskrit: विभूतिकामः सततं पूजयेद् वै पुरन्दरम् । ब्रह्मवर्चसकामस्तु ब्रह्माणं ब्रह्मकामुकः
verses.transliteration: vibhūtikāmaḥ satataṃ pūjayed vai purandaram / brahmavarcasakāmastu brahmāṇaṃ brahmakāmukaḥ
verses.translation: He should always wear the matted hair. He should not cast off (i.e. pare off) nails and hairs. He should always maintain (continue) the study of the Vedas; on other occasions he should observe restraint on his speech.
verses.hindi: अनेकधर्मशास्त्रज्ञा ऊहापोहविशारदाः। तथा वेदाध्ययनशील सात ब्राह्मण धर्में प्रमाण कहे वेदाध्ययनसम्पन्नाः सपैते परिकीर्तिताः ॥ ६॥  गये हैं
verses.wordMeaning: He should always wear the matted hair. He should not cast off (i.e. pare off) nails and hairs. He should always maintain (continue) the study of the Vedas; on other occasions he should observe restraint on his speech.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should always wear the matted hair. He should not cast off (i.e. pare off) nails and hairs. He should always maintain (continue) the study of the Vedas; on other occasions he should observe restraint on his speech.

verses.sanskrit: आरोग्यकामो ऽथ रविं धनकामो हुताशनम् । कर्मणां सिद्धिकामस्तु पूजयेद् वै विनायकम्
verses.transliteration: ārogyakāmo 'tha raviṃ dhanakāmo hutāśanam / karmaṇāṃ siddhikāmastu pūjayed vai vināyakam
verses.translation: It is with food proper for sages, with various vege¬ tables, fruits and roots grown in the forest that he should perform his daily fire-worship and also the five (great) sacrifices {panca-mahd-yajnas ).
verses.hindi: + स्मार्त अग्निहोत्र करनेवाले भी अनाहिताग्नि होते हैं। श्रौत अग्निहोत्र करनेवाले ही आहिताग्नि कहे जाते हैं। ब्रह्महा मद्यपः स्तेनो गुरुतल्पग एव च। महापातकिनस्त्वेते यश्चैतैः सह संवसेत्
verses.wordMeaning: It is with food proper for sages, with various vege¬ tables, fruits and roots grown in the forest that he should perform his daily fire-worship and also the five (great) sacrifices {panca-mahd-yajnas ).
verses.commentary: Sense: It is with food proper for sages, with various vege¬ tables, fruits and roots grown in the forest that he should perform his daily fire-worship and also the five (great) sacrifices {panca-mahd-yajnas ).

verses.sanskrit: भोगकामस्तु शशिनं बलकामः समीरणम् । मुमुक्षुः सर्वसंसारात् प्रयत्नेनार्चयेद्धरिम्
verses.transliteration: bhogakāmastu śaśinaṃ balakāmaḥ samīraṇam / mumukṣuḥ sarvasaṃsārāt prayatnenārcayeddharim
verses.translation: He should always wear bark-garments. He should be pure, taking bath three times a day. He should be kind and considerate towards all living beings. He should avoid taking Pratigrahas (monetary gifts)
verses.hindi: ब्रह्महा द्वादशाब्दानि कुटिं कृत्वा वने वसेत्। भेक्षमात्मविशुद्धयर्थ कृत्वा शवशिरोध्वजम्
verses.wordMeaning: He should always wear bark-garments. He should be pure, taking bath three times a day. He should be kind and considerate towards all living beings. He should avoid taking Pratigrahas (monetary gifts)
verses.commentary: Sense: He should always wear bark-garments. He should be pure, taking bath three times a day. He should be kind and considerate towards all living beings. He should avoid taking Pratigrahas (monetary gifts)

verses.sanskrit: यस्तु योगं तथा मोक्षमन्विच्छेज्ज्ञानमैश्वरम् । सोर्ऽचयेद् वै विरूपाक्षं प्रयत्नेनेश्वरेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: yastu yogaṃ tathā mokṣamanvicchejjñānamaiśvaram / sor'cayed vai virūpākṣaṃ prayatneneśvareśvaram
verses.translation: Even when distressed, he should not make use of the flowers and fruits produced in the villages.* He should maintain and venerate the holy fire as per injunctions in the Vaikhanasa Sutra.
verses.hindi: ब्राह्मणावसथान् सर्वान् देवागाराणि वर्जयेत्। विनिन्दन् स्वयमात्मानं ब्राह्मणं तं च संस्मरन् एककालं चरेद् भक्षं दोषं विख्यापयन् नृणाम्। वन्यमूलफलेर्वापि वर्तयेद् धैर्यमाश्रितः
verses.wordMeaning: Even when distressed, he should not make use of the flowers and fruits produced in the villages.* He should maintain and venerate the holy fire as per injunctions in the Vaikhanasa Sutra.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even when distressed, he should not make use of the flowers and fruits produced in the villages.* He should maintain and venerate the holy fire as per injunctions in the Vaikhanasa Sutra.

verses.sanskrit: ये वाञ्छन्ति महायोगान् ज्ञानानि च महेश्वरम् । ते पूजयन्ति भूतेशं केशवं चापि भोगिनः
verses.transliteration: ye vāñchanti mahāyogān jñānāni ca maheśvaram / te pūjayanti bhūteśaṃ keśavaṃ cāpi bhoginaḥ
verses.translation: He should not cause injury to any living being. He should be free from Dvandvas (mutually clashing opposites like pleasure and pain) and be free from fear as well. He should not take food during the night and be engaged in meditation during the night.
verses.hindi: कपालपाणिः खट्वाङ्गी ब्रह्मचर्यपरायणः । पूर्णे तु द्वादशे वर्ष ब्रह्महत्यां व्यपोहति
verses.wordMeaning: He should not cause injury to any living being. He should be free from Dvandvas (mutually clashing opposites like pleasure and pain) and be free from fear as well. He should not take food during the night and be engaged in meditation during the night.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should not cause injury to any living being. He should be free from Dvandvas (mutually clashing opposites like pleasure and pain) and be free from fear as well. He should not take food during the night and be engaged in meditation during the night.

verses.sanskrit: वारिदस्तृप्तिमाप्नोति सुखमक्षय्यमन्नदः । तिलप्रदः प्रजामिष्टां दीपदश्चक्षुरुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: vāridastṛptimāpnoti sukhamakṣayyamannadaḥ / tilapradaḥ prajāmiṣṭāṃ dīpadaścakṣuruttamam
verses.translation: He should be onewhohas conquered the sense-organs and restrained anger. He should ponder over the perfect know¬ ledge of Reality. He should always be celibate and not approach carnally even his wife.
verses.hindi: अकामतः कृते पापे प्रायश्चित्तमिदं शुभम्। कामतो मरणाच्छुद्धिज्ञेया नान्येन केनचित् मीमांसाज्ञानके तत्त्वज्ञ (वेदवाक्यार्थ-विचार एवं श्रौत-स्मार्त-कर्मकाण्डके रहस्यको जाननेवाले) तथा वेदान्तके ज्ञानमें कुशल (पारमार्थिक तत्त्व अद्हैतके रहस्यवेत्ता) संख्यामें इक्कीस ब्राह्मण प्रायश्चित्तका विधान
verses.wordMeaning: He should be onewhohas conquered the sense-organs and restrained anger. He should ponder over the perfect know¬ ledge of Reality. He should always be celibate and not approach carnally even his wife.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should be onewhohas conquered the sense-organs and restrained anger. He should ponder over the perfect know¬ ledge of Reality. He should always be celibate and not approach carnally even his wife.

verses.sanskrit: भूमिदः सर्वमाप्नोति दीर्घमायुर्हिरण्यदः । गृहदो ऽग्र्याणि वेश्मानि रूप्यदो रूपमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: bhūmidaḥ sarvamāpnoti dīrghamāyurhiraṇyadaḥ / gṛhado 'gryāṇi veśmāni rūpyado rūpamuttamam
verses.translation: The Brahmana, who, after going to the forest indulges in sexual intercourse with his wife passionately, violates his holy vow and has to perform expiation.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मघाती, मद्यपायी, चोर, गुरुतल्पगामी तथा इनके साथ निवास करनेवाले-(ये सभी) महापातकी होते हैं। जो एक वर्षपर्यन्त नित्य सब कुछ जानते हुए भी पतितोंके साथ यान (सवारी), शय्या तथा आसन-
verses.wordMeaning: The Brahmana, who, after going to the forest indulges in sexual intercourse with his wife passionately, violates his holy vow and has to perform expiation.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Brahmana, who, after going to the forest indulges in sexual intercourse with his wife passionately, violates his holy vow and has to perform expiation.

verses.sanskrit: वासोदश्चन्द्रसालोक्यमश्विसालोक्यमश्वदः । अनडुदः श्रियं पुष्टां गोदो व्रध्नस्य विष्टपम्
verses.transliteration: vāsodaścandrasālokyamaśvisālokyamaśvadaḥ / anaḍudaḥ śriyaṃ puṣṭāṃ godo vradhnasya viṣṭapam
verses.translation: The child born thereby cannot be touchable by Brahmanas. He is not authorised in the study of the Vedas. All the persons born in his family shall also be so.
verses.hindi: सम्बन्धी संसर्ग करता है, वह पतित हो जाता है। जानते हुए भी (पतितोंका) यज्ञ कराने, अध्यापन करने, उनके साथ योनि अर्थात् विवाह आदिका सम्बन्ध रखने और भोजन करनेसे द्विज शीघ्र ही पतित हो जो द्विज आज्ञानमें मोहवश इनके साथ अध्ययन अथवा अध्यापन करता है, वह एक वर्षमें पतित हो जाता है। आत्मशुद्धिके लिये ब्रह्मघातीको बारह वर्षोतक कुटी बनाकर वनमें रहना चाहिए और शवके
verses.wordMeaning: The child born thereby cannot be touchable by Brahmanas. He is not authorised in the study of the Vedas. All the persons born in his family shall also be so.
verses.commentary: Sense: The child born thereby cannot be touchable by Brahmanas. He is not authorised in the study of the Vedas. All the persons born in his family shall also be so.

verses.sanskrit: यानशय्याप्रदो भार्यामैश्वर्यमभयप्रदः । धान्यदः शाश्वतं सौख्यं ब्रह्मदो ब्रह्मसात्म्यताम्
verses.transliteration: yānaśayyāprado bhāryāmaiśvaryamabhayapradaḥ / dhānyadaḥ śāśvataṃ saukhyaṃ brahmado brahmasātmyatām
verses.translation: He should invariably sleep on the ground below. He should be devoted to the Japa of the Savitri Mantra. He should afford shelter unto all living beings and share things with others.
verses.hindi: सिरको ध्वजाके समान धारणकर भिक्षा माँगनी चाहिए। (ब्रह्मघातीको) ब्राह्मणोंके निवासस्थानों तथा देवमन्दिरोंमें नहीं जाना चाहिए और स्वयं अपनी आत्माकी निन्दा करते हुए तथा जिस ब्राह्मणको मारा
verses.wordMeaning: He should invariably sleep on the ground below. He should be devoted to the Japa of the Savitri Mantra. He should afford shelter unto all living beings and share things with others.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should invariably sleep on the ground below. He should be devoted to the Japa of the Savitri Mantra. He should afford shelter unto all living beings and share things with others.

verses.sanskrit: धान्यान्यपि यथाशक्ति विप्रेषु प्रतिपादयेत् । वेदवित्सु विशिष्टेषु प्रेत्य स्वर्गं समश्नुते
verses.transliteration: dhānyānyapi yathāśakti vipreṣu pratipādayet / vedavitsu viśiṣṭeṣu pretya svargaṃ samaśnute
verses.translation: He should avoid slandering and falsely accusing others; he should avoid (too much of) sleep and lethargy; he should maintain one single fire. He should have no fixed abode; he shall resort to a ground purified by sprinkling water.
verses.hindi: है, उसका स्मरण करते हुए पहलेसे असंकल्पित (अनिश्चित), धूएंसे रहित, शान्त अग्निवाले तथा जहाँ लोगोंने भोजन कर लिया है-एऐसे सात घरोंसे नित्य धीरे-धीरे भिक्षा माँगनी चाहिए। उसे मनुष्योंको अपना दोष (पाप) बताते हुए एक समय भिक्षा माँगनी चाहिए अथवा धैर्य रखते हुए वन्य मूल-फलोंद्वारा निर्वाह करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: He should avoid slandering and falsely accusing others; he should avoid (too much of) sleep and lethargy; he should maintain one single fire. He should have no fixed abode; he shall resort to a ground purified by sprinkling water.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should avoid slandering and falsely accusing others; he should avoid (too much of) sleep and lethargy; he should maintain one single fire. He should have no fixed abode; he shall resort to a ground purified by sprinkling water.

verses.sanskrit: गवां घासप्रदानेन सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते । इन्धनानां प्रदानेन दीप्ताग्निर्जायते नरः
verses.transliteration: gavāṃ ghāsapradānena sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate / indhanānāṃ pradānena dīptāgnirjāyate naraḥ
verses.translation: One should freely roam about alongwith the deer or take rest alongwith them. With very great concentration, he should lie down on a slab of stone or on the gravels.
verses.hindi: हाथमें कपाल लिये हुए और खट्वाङ्ग (चारपाईके टुकड़ेको) धारणकर ब्रह्मचर्यत्रतका पालन करते हुए बारह वर्ष व्यतीत हो जानेपर ब्रह्महत्या दूर होती है। अनिच्छापूर्वक किये गये पापका यह प्रायश्चित्त है, इससे
verses.wordMeaning: One should freely roam about alongwith the deer or take rest alongwith them. With very great concentration, he should lie down on a slab of stone or on the gravels.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should freely roam about alongwith the deer or take rest alongwith them. With very great concentration, he should lie down on a slab of stone or on the gravels.

verses.sanskrit: फलमूलानि शाकानि भोज्यानि विविधानि च । प्रदद्याद् ब्राह्मणेभ्यस्तु मुदा युक्तः सदा भवेत्
verses.transliteration: phalamūlāni śākāni bhojyāni vividhāni ca / pradadyād brāhmaṇebhyastu mudā yuktaḥ sadā bhavet
verses.translation: He should be one who washes off immediately (i.e. one who does not hoard anything) or he can hoard things necessary for a month; or he can have all the requisite things for six months or he may be one who hoards things necessary for a year.
verses.hindi: कल्याण होता है, किंतु इच्छापूर्वक किये गये पापसे शुद्धि अनेक प्रायश्चित्तके बाद मृत्युके अनन्तर ही समझनी चाहिए। इसके अतिरिक्त अन्य किसी उपायसे नहीं ब्रह्महत्यापनोदार्थमन्तरा वा मृतस्य तु
verses.wordMeaning: He should be one who washes off immediately (i.e. one who does not hoard anything) or he can hoard things necessary for a month; or he can have all the requisite things for six months or he may be one who hoards things necessary for a year.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should be one who washes off immediately (i.e. one who does not hoard anything) or he can hoard things necessary for a month; or he can have all the requisite things for six months or he may be one who hoards things necessary for a year.

verses.sanskrit: औषधं स्नेहमाहारं रोगिणे रोगशान्तये । ददानो रोगरहितः सुखी दीर्घायुरेव च
verses.transliteration: auṣadhaṃ snehamāhāraṃ rogiṇe rogaśāntaye / dadāno rogarahitaḥ sukhī dīrghāyureva ca
verses.translation: In the month of Asvayuja (September-October) one should throw away all one's hoarded things.He should also discard the old worn clothes, vegetables, roots and fmits.
verses.hindi: दत्त्वा चान्नं स दुर्भिक्षे ब्रह्महत्यां व्यपोहति
verses.wordMeaning: In the month of Asvayuja (September-October) one should throw away all one's hoarded things.He should also discard the old worn clothes, vegetables, roots and fmits.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the month of Asvayuja (September-October) one should throw away all one's hoarded things.He should also discard the old worn clothes, vegetables, roots and fmits.

verses.sanskrit: असिपत्रवनं मार्गं क्षुरधारासमन्वितम् । तीव्रितापं च तरति छत्रोपानत्प्रदो नरः
verses.transliteration: asipatravanaṃ mārgaṃ kṣuradhārāsamanvitam / tīvritāpaṃ ca tarati chatropānatprado naraḥ
verses.translation: He should be a Dantolukhalika (one who uses the teeth as mortar for chewing the grains and eating them). He should follow the practice of a pigeon. He should be an Afmakutta breaking or pounding corns etc. on stones) or he should be one who eats only what is ripened in the course of time.
verses.hindi: अश्वमेधावभृथके स्नात्वा वा शुध्यते द्विजः । सर्वस्वं वा वेदविदे ब्राह्मणाय प्रदाय तु सरस्वत्यास्त्वरुणया संगमे लोकविश्रुते। शुध्येत् त्रिषवणस्त्रानात् त्रिरात्रोपोषितो द्विजः
verses.wordMeaning: He should be a Dantolukhalika (one who uses the teeth as mortar for chewing the grains and eating them). He should follow the practice of a pigeon. He should be an Afmakutta breaking or pounding corns etc.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He should be a Dantolukhalika (one who uses the teeth as mortar for chewing the grains and eating them). He should follow the practice of a pigeon. He should be an Afmakutta breaking or pounding corns etc.…

verses.sanskrit: यद् यदिष्टतमं लोके यच्चापि दयितं गृहे । तत्तद् गुणवते देयं तदेवाक्ष्यमिच्छता
verses.transliteration: yad yadiṣṭatamaṃ loke yaccāpi dayitaṃ gṛhe / tattad guṇavate deyaṃ tadevākṣyamicchatā
verses.translation: He should eat food at night what he gathered during the day, in accordance with his capacity. He should be a Caturthakdlika (i.e. one who eats after missing three meal-times) or he shall be an Aftamakdlika (one who eats after missing seven meal-times.)
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मचर्यादिभिर्युक्तो दृष्टा रुद्रं विमुच्यते
verses.wordMeaning: He should eat food at night what he gathered during the day, in accordance with his capacity. He should be a Caturthakdlika (i.e. one who eats after missing three meal-times) or he shall be an Aftamakdlika (one who eats after missing seven meal-times.)
verses.commentary: Sense: He should eat food at night what he gathered during the day, in accordance with his capacity. He should be a Caturthakdlika (i.e. one who eats after missing three meal-times) or he shall be an Aftamakdlika (one who eats after missing seven meal-times.)

verses.sanskrit: अपने विषुवे चैव ग्रहणे चन्द्रसूर्ययोः । संक्रान्त्यादिषु कालेषु दत्तं भवति चाक्षयम्
verses.transliteration: apane viṣuve caiva grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ / saṃkrāntyādiṣu kāleṣu dattaṃ bhavati cākṣayam
verses.translation: He should perform expiatory rites in accordance with the Candrayana rites during the bright and dark halves of the month. He should take once in a fortnight boiled rice (or barley) gruel).**
verses.hindi: कपालमोचनं नाम तीर्थ देवस्य शूलिनः । स्नात्वाभ्यर्च्य पितृन् भक्त्या ब्रह्महत्यां व्यपोहति यत्र देवादिदेवेन भेरवेणामितौजसा। कपालं स्थापितं पूर्व ब्रह्मणः परमेष्ठिनः
verses.wordMeaning: He should perform expiatory rites in accordance with the Candrayana rites during the bright and dark halves of the month. He should take once in a fortnight boiled rice (or barley) gruel).**
verses.commentary: Sense: He should perform expiatory rites in accordance with the Candrayana rites during the bright and dark halves of the month. He should take once in a fortnight boiled rice (or barley) gruel).**

verses.sanskrit: प्रयागादिषु तीर्थेषु पुण्येष्वायतनेषु च । दत्त्वा चाक्षयमाप्नोति नदीषु च वनेषु च
verses.transliteration: prayāgādiṣu tīrtheṣu puṇyeṣvāyataneṣu ca / dattvā cākṣayamāpnoti nadīṣu ca vaneṣu ca
verses.translation: Established in the doctrine of Vaikhanasas one should always subsist on merely flowers, roots or fruits which have naturally fallen and withered.
verses.hindi: समभ्यर्च्य महादेवं तत्र भेरवरूपिणम्।
verses.wordMeaning: Established in the doctrine of Vaikhanasas one should always subsist on merely flowers, roots or fruits which have naturally fallen and withered.
verses.commentary: Sense: Established in the doctrine of Vaikhanasas one should always subsist on merely flowers, roots or fruits which have naturally fallen and withered.

verses.sanskrit: दानधर्मात् परो धर्मो भूतानां नेह विद्यते । तस्माद् विप्राय दातव्यं श्रोत्रियाय द्विजातिभिः
verses.transliteration: dānadharmāt paro dharmo bhūtānāṃ neha vidyate / tasmād viprāya dātavyaṃ śrotriyāya dvijātibhiḥ
verses.translation: One should roll on the ground or stand on the fore part of the foot (i.e. tip-toe) throughout the day. One should
verses.hindi: अथवा (ब्रह्मघातीको) स्वयं अनशन (ब्रत) करना चाहिए या भृगु-पतन करे (उच्च स्थानसे गिरे) अथवा प्रज्वलित अग्नि या जलमें प्रविष्ट हो जाय। दूसरे प्रकारसे अर्थात् बुद्धिपूर्वक ब्राह्मणहत्या करनेपर ब्रह्म- हत्या दूर करनेके लिये, ब्राह्मण अथवा गौके निमित्त भलीभाँति अपने प्राणोंका परित्याग कर देना चाहिए। दीर्घ रोगसे ग्रस्त ब्राह्मणको रोगसे मुक्त करने तथा दुर्भिक्षे समय अन्न प्रदान करनेसे ब्रह्महत्या दूर
verses.wordMeaning: One should roll on the ground or stand on the fore part of the foot (i.e. tip-toe) throughout the day. One should
verses.commentary: Sense: One should roll on the ground or stand on the fore part of the foot (i.e. tip-toe) throughout the day. One should

verses.sanskrit: स्वगायुर्भूतिकामेन तथा पापोपशान्तये । मुमुक्षुणा च दातव्यं ब्राह्मणेभ्यस्तथान्वहम्
verses.transliteration: svagāyurbhūtikāmena tathā pāpopaśāntaye / mumukṣuṇā ca dātavyaṃ brāhmaṇebhyastathānvaham
verses.translation: Gradually increasing his intensity in austere penance, he should get himself scorched in five fires; in the rainy season he should expose himself to showering clouds (for his shelter). He should put on wet clothes during the winter.!
verses.wordMeaning: Gradually increasing his intensity in austere penance, he should get himself scorched in five fires; in the rainy season he should expose himself to showering clouds (for his shelter). He should put on wet clothes during the winter.!
verses.commentary: Sense: Gradually increasing his intensity in austere penance, he should get himself scorched in five fires; in the rainy season he should expose himself to showering clouds (for his shelter). He should put on wet clothes during the winter.!

verses.sanskrit: दीयमानं तु यो मोहाद् गोविप्राग्निसुरेषु च । निवारयति पापात्मा तिर्यग्योनिं व्रजेत् तु सः
verses.transliteration: dīyamānaṃ tu yo mohād goviprāgnisureṣu ca / nivārayati pāpātmā tiryagyoniṃ vrajet tu saḥ
verses.translation: He should take ablutions thrice a day and propitiate the Pitrs and Devas or he should stand on a single foot and imbibe the rays then.
verses.hindi: अश्वमेध-यज्ञकी समाप्तिपर होनेवाले अवभृथ-स्नानसे अथवा वेदज्ञ ब्राह्मणको अपना सर्वस्व दान कर देनेसे द्विज (ब्रह्महत्याके पापसे) मुक्त हो जाता है। सरस्वती एवं अरुणा नदीके लोकप्रसिद्ध संगममें तीनों संध्याओंमें स्नान करने और तीन रात्रि उपवास करनेसे द्विज (ब्रह्महत्याजनित पापसे) शुद्ध हो जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: He should take ablutions thrice a day and propitiate the Pitrs and Devas or he should stand on a single foot and imbibe the rays then.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should take ablutions thrice a day and propitiate the Pitrs and Devas or he should stand on a single foot and imbibe the rays then.

verses.sanskrit: यस्तु द्रव्यार्जनं कृत्वा नार्चयेद् ब्राह्मणान् सुरान् । सर्वस्वमपहृत्यैनं राजा राष्ट्रात् प्रवासयेत्
verses.transliteration: yastu dravyārjanaṃ kṛtvā nārcayed brāhmaṇān surān / sarvasvamapahṛtyainaṃ rājā rāṣṭrāt pravāsayet
verses.translation: He should get himself surrounded by five fires. He should be an imbiber of smoke, heat or Soma juice. He should drink milk (or water) in the bright half znA Pancagavya (cow- dung, urine etc. of cows) during the dark half of the month.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मचर्य आदिसे युक्त द्विज पवित्र (तीर्थ) रामेश्वर जाकर वहाँ सागरमें स्नान करके शंकरका दर्शन करके (ब्रह्महत्याके पापसे) मुक्त हो जाता है। त्रिशूलधारी भगवान् शंकरके कपालमोचन नामक तीर्थमें स्नान
verses.wordMeaning: He should get himself surrounded by five fires. He should be an imbiber of smoke, heat or Soma juice. He should drink milk (or water) in the bright half znA Pancagavya (cow- dung, urine etc. of cows) during the dark half of the month.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should get himself surrounded by five fires. He should be an imbiber of smoke, heat or Soma juice. He should drink milk (or water) in the bright half znA Pancagavya (cow- dung, urine etc. of cows) during the dark half of the month.

verses.sanskrit: यस्तु दुर्भिक्षवेलायामन्नाद्यं न प्रयच्छति । म्रियमाणेषु विप्रेषु ब्राह्मणः स तु गर्हितः
verses.transliteration: yastu durbhikṣavelāyāmannādyaṃ na prayacchati / mriyamāṇeṣu vipreṣu brāhmaṇaḥ sa tu garhitaḥ
verses.translation: He should get himself surrounded by five fires. He should be an imbiber of smoke, heat or Soma juice. He should drink milk (or water) in the bright half znA Pancagavya (cow- dung, urine etc. of cows) during the dark half of the month.
verses.hindi: करके भक्तिपूर्वक पितरोंकी पूजा करनेसे (ब्रह्मघाती) ब्रह्महत्याके पापसे दूर हो जाता है। पूर्वकालमें वहाँ (कपालमोचन तीर्थमें) अमित तेजस्वी देवादिदेव भैरवने परमेष्ठी ब्रह्माके कपालको स्थापित किया। वहाँ स्रान करके भैरवरूपी महादेवको भलीभाँति अर्चना करके एवं पितरोंका तर्पण करके ब्रह्महत्या (-के पाप)-
verses.wordMeaning: He should get himself surrounded by five fires. He should be an imbiber of smoke, heat or Soma juice. He should drink milk (or water) in the bright half znA Pancagavya (cow- dung, urine etc. of cows) during the dark half of the month.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should get himself surrounded by five fires. He should be an imbiber of smoke, heat or Soma juice. He should drink milk (or water) in the bright half znA Pancagavya (cow- dung, urine etc. of cows) during the dark half of the month.

verses.sanskrit: न तस्मात् प्रतिगृह्णीयुर्न विशेयुश्च तेन हि । अङ्कयित्वा स्वकाद् राष्ट्रात् तं राजा विप्रवासयेत्
verses.transliteration: na tasmāt pratigṛhṇīyurna viśeyuśca tena hi / aṅkayitvā svakād rāṣṭrāt taṃ rājā vipravāsayet
verses.translation: He should get himself surrounded by five fires. He should be an imbiber of smoke, heat or Soma juice. He should drink milk (or water) in the bright half znA Pancagavya (cow- dung, urine etc. of cows) during the dark half of the month.
verses.hindi: तर्पयित्वा पितृन् स्नात्वा मुच्यते ब्रह्महत्यया ॥ २६॥  से मुक्ति हो जाती है
verses.wordMeaning: He should get himself surrounded by five fires. He should be an imbiber of smoke, heat or Soma juice. He should drink milk (or water) in the bright half znA Pancagavya (cow- dung, urine etc. of cows) during the dark half of the month.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should get himself surrounded by five fires. He should be an imbiber of smoke, heat or Soma juice. He should drink milk (or water) in the bright half znA Pancagavya (cow- dung, urine etc. of cows) during the dark half of the month.

verses.sanskrit: यस्त्वसद्भ्यो ददातीह स्वद्रव्यं धर्मसाधनम् । स पूर्वाभ्यधिकः पापी नरके पच्यते नरः
verses.transliteration: yastvasadbhyo dadātīha svadravyaṃ dharmasādhanam / sa pūrvābhyadhikaḥ pāpī narake pacyate naraḥ
verses.translation: He should get himself surrounded by five fires. He should be an imbiber of smoke, heat or Soma juice. He should drink milk (or water) in the bright half znA Pancagavya (cow- dung, urine etc. of cows) during the dark half of the month.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षद्साहस्रधां संहितायामुपरिविभागे त्रिंशोऽध्यायः प्रायक्चित्त-प्रकरणमें कपालमोचन-तीर्थका आख्यान
verses.wordMeaning: He should get himself surrounded by five fires. He should be an imbiber of smoke, heat or Soma juice. He should drink milk (or water) in the bright half znA Pancagavya (cow- dung, urine etc. of cows) during the dark half of the month.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should get himself surrounded by five fires. He should be an imbiber of smoke, heat or Soma juice. He should drink milk (or water) in the bright half znA Pancagavya (cow- dung, urine etc. of cows) during the dark half of the month.

verses.sanskrit: स्वाध्यायवन्तो ये विप्रा विद्यावन्तो जितेन्द्रियाः । सत्यसंयमसंयुक्तास्तेभ्यो दद्याद् द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: svādhyāyavanto ye viprā vidyāvanto jitendriyāḥ / satyasaṃyamasaṃyuktāstebhyo dadyād dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: He should get himself surrounded by five fires. He should be an imbiber of smoke, heat or Soma juice. He should drink milk (or water) in the bright half znA Pancagavya (cow- dung, urine etc. of cows) during the dark half of the month.
verses.hindi: कथं देवेन रुद्रेण शंकरेणामितौजसा। कपालं ब्रह्मणः पूर्व स्थापितं देहजं भुवि॥
verses.wordMeaning: He should get himself surrounded by five fires. He should be an imbiber of smoke, heat or Soma juice. He should drink milk (or water) in the bright half znA Pancagavya (cow- dung, urine etc. of cows) during the dark half of the month.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should get himself surrounded by five fires. He should be an imbiber of smoke, heat or Soma juice. He should drink milk (or water) in the bright half znA Pancagavya (cow- dung, urine etc. of cows) during the dark half of the month.

verses.sanskrit: सुभुक्तमपि विद्वांसं धार्मिकं भोजयेद् द्विजम् । न तु मूर्खमवृत्तस्थं दशरात्रमुपोषितम्
verses.transliteration: subhuktamapi vidvāṃsaṃ dhārmikaṃ bhojayed dvijam / na tu mūrkhamavṛttasthaṃ daśarātramupoṣitam
verses.translation: He should get himself surrounded by five fires. He should be an imbiber of smoke, heat or Soma juice. He should drink milk (or water) in the bright half znA Pancagavya (cow- dung, urine etc. of cows) during the dark half of the month.
verses.hindi: शृणुध्वमृषयः पुण्यां कथां पापप्रणाशिनीम्। माहात्म्यं देवदेवस्य महादेवस्य धीमतः पुरा पितामहं देवं मेरुशृङ्गे महर्षयः। प्रोचुः प्रणम्य लोकादिं किमेकं तत्त्वमव्ययम्॥
verses.wordMeaning: He should get himself surrounded by five fires. He should be an imbiber of smoke, heat or Soma juice. He should drink milk (or water) in the bright half znA Pancagavya (cow- dung, urine etc. of cows) during the dark half of the month.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should get himself surrounded by five fires. He should be an imbiber of smoke, heat or Soma juice. He should drink milk (or water) in the bright half znA Pancagavya (cow- dung, urine etc. of cows) during the dark half of the month.

verses.sanskrit: सन्निकृष्टमतिक्रम्य श्रोत्रियं यः प्रयच्छति । स तेन कर्मणा पापी दहत्यासप्तमं कुलम्
verses.transliteration: sannikṛṣṭamatikramya śrotriyaṃ yaḥ prayacchati / sa tena karmaṇā pāpī dahatyāsaptamaṃ kulam
verses.translation: He should get himself surrounded by five fires. He should be an imbiber of smoke, heat or Soma juice. He should drink milk (or water) in the bright half znA Pancagavya (cow- dung, urine etc. of cows) during the dark half of the month.
verses.hindi: स मायया महेशस्य मोहितो लोकसम्भव: । अविज्ञाय परं भावं स्वात्मानं प्राह धर्षिणम्
verses.wordMeaning: He should get himself surrounded by five fires. He should be an imbiber of smoke, heat or Soma juice. He should drink milk (or water) in the bright half znA Pancagavya (cow- dung, urine etc. of cows) during the dark half of the month.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should get himself surrounded by five fires. He should be an imbiber of smoke, heat or Soma juice. He should drink milk (or water) in the bright half znA Pancagavya (cow- dung, urine etc. of cows) during the dark half of the month.

verses.sanskrit: यदिस्यादधिको विप्रः शीलविद्यादिभिः स्वयम् । तस्मै यत्नेन दातव्यं अतिक्रम्यापि सन्निधिम्
verses.transliteration: yadisyādadhiko vipraḥ śīlavidyādibhiḥ svayam / tasmai yatnena dātavyaṃ atikramyāpi sannidhim
verses.translation: He should get himself surrounded by five fires. He should be an imbiber of smoke, heat or Soma juice. He should drink milk (or water) in the bright half znA Pancagavya (cow- dung, urine etc. of cows) during the dark half of the month.
verses.hindi: अनादिमत्परं ब्रह्म मामभ्यर्च्यं विमुच्यते अहं हि सर्वदेवानां प्रवर्तकनिवर्तकः । न विद्यते चाभ्यधिको मत्तो लोकेषु कश्चन॥ तस्यैवं मन्यमानस्य जज्ञे नारायणांशजः। प्रोवाच प्रहसन् वाक्यं रोषताम्रविलोचनः
verses.wordMeaning: He should get himself surrounded by five fires. He should be an imbiber of smoke, heat or Soma juice. He should drink milk (or water) in the bright half znA Pancagavya (cow- dung, urine etc. of cows) during the dark half of the month.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should get himself surrounded by five fires. He should be an imbiber of smoke, heat or Soma juice. He should drink milk (or water) in the bright half znA Pancagavya (cow- dung, urine etc. of cows) during the dark half of the month.

verses.sanskrit: यो ऽर्चितं प्रतिगृह्णीयाद् दद्यादर्चितमेव च । तावुभौ गच्छतः स्वर्गं नरकं तु विपर्यये
verses.transliteration: yo 'rcitaṃ pratigṛhṇīyād dadyādarcitameva ca / tāvubhau gacchataḥ svargaṃ narakaṃ tu viparyaye
verses.translation: He should get himself surrounded by five fires. He should be an imbiber of smoke, heat or Soma juice. He should drink milk (or water) in the bright half znA Pancagavya (cow- dung, urine etc. of cows) during the dark half of the month.
verses.hindi: किं कारणमिदं ब्रह्मन् वर्तते तव साम्प्रतम्। अज्ञानयोगयुक्तस्य न त्वेतदुचितं तव
verses.wordMeaning: He should get himself surrounded by five fires. He should be an imbiber of smoke, heat or Soma juice. He should drink milk (or water) in the bright half znA Pancagavya (cow- dung, urine etc. of cows) during the dark half of the month.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should get himself surrounded by five fires. He should be an imbiber of smoke, heat or Soma juice. He should drink milk (or water) in the bright half znA Pancagavya (cow- dung, urine etc. of cows) during the dark half of the month.

verses.sanskrit: न वार्यपि प्रयच्छेत नास्तिके हैतुके ऽपि च । पाषण्डेषु च सर्वेषु नावेदविदि धर्मवित्
verses.transliteration: na vāryapi prayaccheta nāstike haituke 'pi ca / pāṣaṇḍeṣu ca sarveṣu nāvedavidi dharmavit
verses.translation: He should get himself surrounded by five fires. He should be an imbiber of smoke, heat or Soma juice. He should drink milk (or water) in the bright half znA Pancagavya (cow- dung, urine etc. of cows) during the dark half of the month.
verses.hindi: अहं धाता हि लोकानां यज्ञो नारायणः प्रभुः । न मामृतेऽस्य जगतो जीवनं सर्वदा क्वचित् आजम्मुर्यत्र तौ देवौ वेदाश्चत्वार एव हि
verses.wordMeaning: He should get himself surrounded by five fires. He should be an imbiber of smoke, heat or Soma juice. He should drink milk (or water) in the bright half znA Pancagavya (cow- dung, urine etc. of cows) during the dark half of the month.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should get himself surrounded by five fires. He should be an imbiber of smoke, heat or Soma juice. He should drink milk (or water) in the bright half znA Pancagavya (cow- dung, urine etc. of cows) during the dark half of the month.

verses.sanskrit: अपूपं च हिरण्यं च गामश्वं पृथिवीं तिलान् । अविद्वान् प्रतिगृह्णानो भस्मी भवति काष्ठवत्
verses.transliteration: apūpaṃ ca hiraṇyaṃ ca gāmaśvaṃ pṛthivīṃ tilān / avidvān pratigṛhṇāno bhasmī bhavati kāṣṭhavat
verses.translation: He should get himself surrounded by five fires. He should be an imbiber of smoke, heat or Soma juice. He should drink milk (or water) in the bright half znA Pancagavya (cow- dung, urine etc. of cows) during the dark half of the month.
verses.hindi: अन्वीक्ष्य देवं ब्रह्माणं यज्ञात्मानं च संस्थितम्। प्रोचुः संविग्नहृदया याथात्म्यं परमेष्ठिनः
verses.wordMeaning: He should get himself surrounded by five fires. He should be an imbiber of smoke, heat or Soma juice. He should drink milk (or water) in the bright half znA Pancagavya (cow- dung, urine etc. of cows) during the dark half of the month.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should get himself surrounded by five fires. He should be an imbiber of smoke, heat or Soma juice. He should drink milk (or water) in the bright half znA Pancagavya (cow- dung, urine etc. of cows) during the dark half of the month.

verses.sanskrit: द्विजातिभ्यो धनं लिप्सेत् प्रशस्तेभ्यो द्विजोत्तमः । अपि वा जातिमात्रेभ्यो न तु शूद्रात् कथञ्चन
verses.transliteration: dvijātibhyo dhanaṃ lipset praśastebhyo dvijottamaḥ / api vā jātimātrebhyo na tu śūdrāt kathañcana
verses.translation: He should get himself surrounded by five fires. He should be an imbiber of smoke, heat or Soma juice. He should drink milk (or water) in the bright half znA Pancagavya (cow- dung, urine etc. of cows) during the dark half of the month.
verses.hindi: ऋषियोंने पूछा- अमित तेजस्वी देव शंकर रुद्रने पूर्वकालमें किस प्रकार ब्रह्माजीके शरीरसे उत्पन्न कपालको पृथ्वीपर स्थापित किया ? सूतजी बोले-ऋषियो! आप लोग पापको नष्ट करनेवाली इस पुण्य कथा एवं धीमान् देवाधिदेव महादेवके माहात्म्यको सुनें
verses.wordMeaning: He should get himself surrounded by five fires. He should be an imbiber of smoke, heat or Soma juice. He should drink milk (or water) in the bright half znA Pancagavya (cow- dung, urine etc. of cows) during the dark half of the month.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should get himself surrounded by five fires. He should be an imbiber of smoke, heat or Soma juice. He should drink milk (or water) in the bright half znA Pancagavya (cow- dung, urine etc. of cows) during the dark half of the month.

verses.sanskrit: वृत्तिसङ्कोचमन्विच्छेन्नेहेत धनविस्तरम् । धनलोभे प्रसक्तस्तु ब्राह्मण्यादेव हीयते
verses.transliteration: vṛttisaṅkocamanvicchenneheta dhanavistaram / dhanalobhe prasaktastu brāhmaṇyādeva hīyate
verses.translation: He should get himself surrounded by five fires. He should be an imbiber of smoke, heat or Soma juice. He should drink milk (or water) in the bright half znA Pancagavya (cow- dung, urine etc. of cows) during the dark half of the month.
verses.hindi: प्राचीन कालमें मेरुशृंगपर लोकोंके मूल कारण देव पितामहको प्रणाम कर महर्षियोंने उनसे पूछा अव्यय अद्वितीय तत्त्व क्या है? महेश्वरकी मायासे मोहित, लोकोंको उत्पन्न करनेवाले उन ब्रह्माने
verses.wordMeaning: He should get himself surrounded by five fires. He should be an imbiber of smoke, heat or Soma juice. He should drink milk (or water) in the bright half znA Pancagavya (cow- dung, urine etc. of cows) during the dark half of the month.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should get himself surrounded by five fires. He should be an imbiber of smoke, heat or Soma juice. He should drink milk (or water) in the bright half znA Pancagavya (cow- dung, urine etc. of cows) during the dark half of the month.

verses.sanskrit: वेदानधीत्य सकलान् यज्ञांश्चावाप्य सर्वशः । न तां गतिमवाप्नोति सङ्कोचाद् यामवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: vedānadhītya sakalān yajñāṃścāvāpya sarvaśaḥ / na tāṃ gatimavāpnoti saṅkocād yāmavāpnuyāt
verses.translation: He should get himself surrounded by five fires. He should be an imbiber of smoke, heat or Soma juice. He should drink milk (or water) in the bright half znA Pancagavya (cow- dung, urine etc. of cows) during the dark half of the month.
verses.hindi: (महर्षियोंके) परम भावको न जानते हुए अभिमानपूर्वक स्वयंको ही (अव्यय) तत्त्व बतलाया (और कहा) में ही जगतका मूल कारण, धाता, स्वयम्भू तथा अद्वितीय अनादि परम ब्रह्म ईश्वर हूँ। मेरी आराधना करनेसे मुक्ति हो जाती है। मैं ही सभी देवोंका प्रवर्तक तथा निवर्तक हूँ। लोकोंमें मुझसे महान् और कोई नहीं है
verses.wordMeaning: He should get himself surrounded by five fires. He should be an imbiber of smoke, heat or Soma juice. He should drink milk (or water) in the bright half znA Pancagavya (cow- dung, urine etc. of cows) during the dark half of the month.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should get himself surrounded by five fires. He should be an imbiber of smoke, heat or Soma juice. He should drink milk (or water) in the bright half znA Pancagavya (cow- dung, urine etc. of cows) during the dark half of the month.

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिग्रहरुचिर्न स्यात् यात्रार्थं तु समाहरेत् । स्थित्यर्थादधिकं गृह्णन् ब्राह्मणो यात्यधोगतिम्
verses.transliteration: pratigraharucirna syāt yātrārthaṃ tu samāharet / sthityarthādadhikaṃ gṛhṇan brāhmaṇo yātyadhogatim
verses.translation: He should get himself surrounded by five fires. He should be an imbiber of smoke, heat or Soma juice. He should drink milk (or water) in the bright half znA Pancagavya (cow- dung, urine etc. of cows) during the dark half of the month.
verses.hindi: कि नारायणके अंशसे उत्पन्न यज्ञभगवानूने क्रोधसे आरक्तनेत्र होकर परिहास करते हुए यह वाक्य कहा-ब्रह्मन्! सम्प्रति आपके ऐसे व्यवहारका क्या कारण है? आप आज्ञानसे युक्त हैं, आपके लिये यह
verses.wordMeaning: He should get himself surrounded by five fires. He should be an imbiber of smoke, heat or Soma juice. He should drink milk (or water) in the bright half znA Pancagavya (cow- dung, urine etc. of cows) during the dark half of the month.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should get himself surrounded by five fires. He should be an imbiber of smoke, heat or Soma juice. He should drink milk (or water) in the bright half znA Pancagavya (cow- dung, urine etc. of cows) during the dark half of the month.

verses.sanskrit: यस्तु याचनको नित्यं न स स्वर्गस्य भाजनम् । उद्वेजयति भूतानि यथा चौरस्तथैव सः
verses.transliteration: yastu yācanako nityaṃ na sa svargasya bhājanam / udvejayati bhūtāni yathā caurastathaiva saḥ
verses.translation: He should get himself surrounded by five fires. He should be an imbiber of smoke, heat or Soma juice. He should drink milk (or water) in the bright half znA Pancagavya (cow- dung, urine etc. of cows) during the dark half of the month.
verses.hindi: उचित नहीं है। मैं लोकोंका धाता यज्ञरूप नारायण प्रभु हुँ, मेरे बिना इस संसारमें जीवन कभी भी नहीं हूँ, मेरे द्वारा प्रेरणा प्रातकर आपने इस भुवनमण्डलकी रचना की है
verses.wordMeaning: He should get himself surrounded by five fires. He should be an imbiber of smoke, heat or Soma juice. He should drink milk (or water) in the bright half znA Pancagavya (cow- dung, urine etc. of cows) during the dark half of the month.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should get himself surrounded by five fires. He should be an imbiber of smoke, heat or Soma juice. He should drink milk (or water) in the bright half znA Pancagavya (cow- dung, urine etc. of cows) during the dark half of the month.

verses.sanskrit: गुरून् भृत्यांश्चोज्जिहीर्षुरर्चिष्यन् देवतातिथीन् । सर्वतः प्रतिगृह्णीयान्न तु तृप्येत् स्वयं ततः
verses.transliteration: gurūn bhṛtyāṃścojjihīrṣurarciṣyan devatātithīn / sarvataḥ pratigṛhṇīyānna tu tṛpyet svayaṃ tataḥ
verses.translation: He should get himself surrounded by five fires. He should be an imbiber of smoke, heat or Soma juice. He should drink milk (or water) in the bright half znA Pancagavya (cow- dung, urine etc. of cows) during the dark half of the month.
verses.hindi: परस्पर विजयके अभिलाषी उन दोनोंके मोहपूर्वक इस प्रकार विवाद करते समय ही जहाँ वे दोनों देव (पितामह एवं यज्ञभगवान्) थे, वहीं चारों वेद (मूर्तिमान् होकर) आ गये। देव ब्रह्मा तथा यज्ञात्मा विष्णुको
verses.wordMeaning: He should get himself surrounded by five fires. He should be an imbiber of smoke, heat or Soma juice. He should drink milk (or water) in the bright half znA Pancagavya (cow- dung, urine etc. of cows) during the dark half of the month.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should get himself surrounded by five fires. He should be an imbiber of smoke, heat or Soma juice. He should drink milk (or water) in the bright half znA Pancagavya (cow- dung, urine etc. of cows) during the dark half of the month.

verses.sanskrit: एवं गृहस्थो युक्तात्मा देवतातिथिपूजकः । वर्तमानः संयातात्मा याति तत् परमं पदम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ gṛhastho yuktātmā devatātithipūjakaḥ / vartamānaḥ saṃyātātmā yāti tat paramaṃ padam
verses.translation: He should get himself surrounded by five fires. He should be an imbiber of smoke, heat or Soma juice. He should drink milk (or water) in the bright half znA Pancagavya (cow- dung, urine etc. of cows) during the dark half of the month.
verses.hindi: स्थित देखकर संविग्रृदय होकर उन्होंने ब्रह्मासे यथार्थ तत्त्व कहा- यदाहुस्तत्परं तत्त्वं स देवः स्यान्महेश्वरः
verses.wordMeaning: He should get himself surrounded by five fires. He should be an imbiber of smoke, heat or Soma juice. He should drink milk (or water) in the bright half znA Pancagavya (cow- dung, urine etc. of cows) during the dark half of the month.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should get himself surrounded by five fires. He should be an imbiber of smoke, heat or Soma juice. He should drink milk (or water) in the bright half znA Pancagavya (cow- dung, urine etc. of cows) during the dark half of the month.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रे निधाय वा सर्वं गत्वारण्यं तु तत्त्ववित् । एकाकी विचरेन्नित्यमुदासीनः समाहितः
verses.transliteration: putre nidhāya vā sarvaṃ gatvāraṇyaṃ tu tattvavit / ekākī vicarennityamudāsīnaḥ samāhitaḥ
verses.translation: He should get himself surrounded by five fires. He should be an imbiber of smoke, heat or Soma juice. He should drink milk (or water) in the bright half znA Pancagavya (cow- dung, urine etc. of cows) during the dark half of the month.
verses.hindi: यो यज्ञैरखिलैरीशो योगेन च समर्च्यते।
verses.wordMeaning: He should get himself surrounded by five fires. He should be an imbiber of smoke, heat or Soma juice. He should drink milk (or water) in the bright half znA Pancagavya (cow- dung, urine etc. of cows) during the dark half of the month.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should get himself surrounded by five fires. He should be an imbiber of smoke, heat or Soma juice. He should drink milk (or water) in the bright half znA Pancagavya (cow- dung, urine etc. of cows) during the dark half of the month.

verses.sanskrit: एष वः कथितो धर्मो गृहस्थानां द्विजोत्तमाः । ज्ञात्वानुतिष्ठेन्नियतं तथानुष्ठापयेद् द्विजान्
verses.transliteration: eṣa vaḥ kathito dharmo gṛhasthānāṃ dvijottamāḥ / jñātvānutiṣṭhenniyataṃ tathānuṣṭhāpayed dvijān
verses.translation: He should get himself surrounded by five fires. He should be an imbiber of smoke, heat or Soma juice. He should drink milk (or water) in the bright half znA Pancagavya (cow- dung, urine etc. of cows) during the dark half of the month.
verses.hindi: यमाहुरीश्वरं देवं स देवः स्यात् पिनाकधृक् येनेदं भ्राम्यते चक्रं यदाकाशान्तरं शिवम्।
verses.wordMeaning: He should get himself surrounded by five fires. He should be an imbiber of smoke, heat or Soma juice. He should drink milk (or water) in the bright half znA Pancagavya (cow- dung, urine etc. of cows) during the dark half of the month.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should get himself surrounded by five fires. He should be an imbiber of smoke, heat or Soma juice. He should drink milk (or water) in the bright half znA Pancagavya (cow- dung, urine etc. of cows) during the dark half of the month.

verses.sanskrit: इति देवमनादिमेकमीशं गृहधर्मेण समर्चयेदजस्त्रम् । समतीत्य स सर्वभूतयोनिं प्रकृतिं याति परं न याति जन्म
verses.transliteration: iti devamanādimekamīśaṃ gṛhadharmeṇa samarcayedajastram / samatītya sa sarvabhūtayoniṃ prakṛtiṃ yāti paraṃ na yāti janma
verses.translation: He should get himself surrounded by five fires. He should be an imbiber of smoke, heat or Soma juice. He should drink milk (or water) in the bright half znA Pancagavya (cow- dung, urine etc. of cows) during the dark half of the month.
verses.hindi: योगिभिर्विद्यते तत्त्व महादेवः स शंकरः
verses.wordMeaning: He should get himself surrounded by five fires. He should be an imbiber of smoke, heat or Soma juice. He should drink milk (or water) in the bright half znA Pancagavya (cow- dung, urine etc. of cows) during the dark half of the month.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should get himself surrounded by five fires. He should be an imbiber of smoke, heat or Soma juice. He should drink milk (or water) in the bright half znA Pancagavya (cow- dung, urine etc. of cows) during the dark half of the month.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे षड्विंशो ऽध्यायः व्यास उवाच एवं गृहाश्रमे स्थित्वा द्वितीयं भागमायुषः । वानप्रस्थाश्रमं गच्छेत् सदारः साग्निरेव च निक्षिप्य भार्यां पुत्रेषु गच्छेद् वनमथापि वा । दृष्ट्वापत्यस्य चापत्यं जर्जरीकृतविग्रहः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge ṣaḍviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ vyāsa uvāca evaṃ gṛhāśrame sthitvā dvitīyaṃ bhāgamāyuṣaḥ / vānaprasthāśramaṃ gacchet sadāraḥ sāgnireva ca nikṣipya bhāryāṃ putreṣu gacched vanamathāpi vā / dṛṣṭvāpatyasya cāpatyaṃ jarjarīkṛtavigrahaḥ
verses.translation: Or he should eat fallen and withered dry leaves or observe penance called Krcchra. He should always practise Yoga and recite Rudra (Sukta).
verses.hindi: महेशं पुरुषं रुद्रं स देवो भगवान् भवः एवं स भगवान् ब्रह्मा वेदानामीरितं शुभम्।
verses.wordMeaning: Or he should eat fallen and withered dry leaves or observe penance called Krcchra. He should always practise Yoga and recite Rudra (Sukta).
verses.commentary: Sense: Or he should eat fallen and withered dry leaves or observe penance called Krcchra. He should always practise Yoga and recite Rudra (Sukta).

verses.sanskrit: शुक्लपक्षस्य पूर्वाह्ने प्रशस्ते चोत्तरायणे । गत्वारण्यं नियमवांस्तपः कुर्यात् समाहितः
verses.transliteration: śuklapakṣasya pūrvāhne praśaste cottarāyaṇe / gatvāraṇyaṃ niyamavāṃstapaḥ kuryāt samāhitaḥ
verses.translation: He should study Atharvasiras and be interested in practising the principles of Vedanta: he should resort restraints {Tamas) continuously; and he should alertly practise Niyarms (observances and rites).
verses.hindi: कथं तत्परमं ब्रह्म सर्वसंगविवर्जितम्।
verses.wordMeaning: He should study Atharvasiras and be interested in practising the principles of Vedanta: he should resort restraints {Tamas) continuously; and he should alertly practise Niyarms (observances and rites).
verses.commentary: Sense: He should study Atharvasiras and be interested in practising the principles of Vedanta: he should resort restraints {Tamas) continuously; and he should alertly practise Niyarms (observances and rites).

verses.sanskrit: फलमूलानि पूतानि नित्यमाहारमाहरेत् । यताहारो भवेत् तेन पूजयेत् पितृदेवताः
verses.transliteration: phalamūlāni pūtāni nityamāhāramāharet / yatāhāro bhavet tena pūjayet pitṛdevatāḥ
verses.translation: He should receive the same from other Brahmana householders residing in the forest. Himself residing in the forest, he should eat eight mouthfuls of what he brings from the village.
verses.hindi: इतीरितेऽथ भगवान् प्रणवात्मा सनातन: । न होष भगवान् पत्या स्वात्मनो व्यतिरिक्तया।
verses.wordMeaning: He should receive the same from other Brahmana householders residing in the forest. Himself residing in the forest, he should eat eight mouthfuls of what he brings from the village.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should receive the same from other Brahmana householders residing in the forest. Himself residing in the forest, he should eat eight mouthfuls of what he brings from the village.

verses.sanskrit: पूजयित्वातिथिं नित्यं स्नात्वा चाभ्यर्चयेत् सुरान् । गृहादाहृत्य चाश्नीयादष्टौ ग्रासान् समाहितः
verses.transliteration: pūjayitvātithiṃ nityaṃ snātvā cābhyarcayet surān / gṛhādāhṛtya cāśnīyādaṣṭau grāsān samāhitaḥ
verses.translation: This is strange. The recluse has to leave home, wife, children, property etc. vide Manu VI-41, 43-42.
verses.hindi: अयं स भगवानीशः स्वयंज्योतिः सनातनः। स्वानन्दभूता कथिता देवी नागन्तुका शिवा
verses.wordMeaning: This is strange. The recluse has to leave home, wife, children, property etc. vide Manu VI-41, 43-42.
verses.commentary: Sense: This is strange. The recluse has to leave home, wife, children, property etc. vide Manu VI-41, 43-42.

verses.sanskrit: जटाश्च बिभृयान्नित्यं नखरोमाणि नोत्सृजेत् । स्वाध्यायं सर्वदा कुर्यान्नियच्छेद् वाचमन्यतः
verses.transliteration: jaṭāśca bibhṛyānnityaṃ nakharomāṇi notsṛjet / svādhyāyaṃ sarvadā kuryānniyacched vācamanyataḥ
verses.translation: Manu VI. 38, Yaj III. 56 require the performance of Prajapatyesti, while Jabalopanisad 4 recommends Agneyi isli. KP synthesized both the views by giving an option.
verses.hindi: इत्येवमुक्तेऽपि तदा यज्ञमूर्तेरजस्य च। नाज्ञानमगमन्नाशमीश्वरस्यैव मायया ( मूर्तिमान् ) ऋग्वेदने कहा--जिसके भीतर सभी प्राणी प्रतिष्ठित हैं, जिससे सभीकी प्रवृत्ति होती है और जिसे परम तत्त्व कहा गया है, उन्हें ही महेश्वर देव समझना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: Manu VI. 38, Yaj III. 56 require the performance of Prajapatyesti, while Jabalopanisad 4 recommends Agneyi isli. KP synthesized both the views by giving an option.
verses.commentary: Sense: Manu VI. 38, Yaj III. 56 require the performance of Prajapatyesti, while Jabalopanisad 4 recommends Agneyi isli. KP synthesized both the views by giving an option.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निहोत्रं च जुहुयात् पञ्चयज्ञान् समाचरेत् । मुन्यन्नैंर्विविधैर्मेध्यैः शाकमूलफलेन वा
verses.transliteration: agnihotraṃ ca juhuyāt pañcayajñān samācaret / munyannaiṃrvividhairmedhyaiḥ śākamūlaphalena vā
verses.translation: People wish for Sannyasa(renunciation)when Vaitrnya (absence of thirst i.e. attachment) towards all worldly objects surges up in the mind. Otherwise one would be a fallen fellow.
verses.hindi: यजुर्वेदने कहा जो ईश सभी यज्ञों तथा योगके द्वारा अचित होते हैं और जिन देवको ईश्वर कहा गया है, वे देव ही पिनाक धारण करनेवाले (शंकर) हैं
verses.wordMeaning: People wish for Sannyasa(renunciation)when Vaitrnya (absence of thirst i.e. attachment) towards all worldly objects surges up in the mind. Otherwise one would be a fallen fellow.
verses.commentary: Sense: People wish for Sannyasa(renunciation)when Vaitrnya (absence of thirst i.e. attachment) towards all worldly objects surges up in the mind. Otherwise one would be a fallen fellow.

verses.sanskrit: चीरवासा भवेन्नित्यं स्नायात् त्रिषवणं शुचिः । सर्वभूतानुकम्पी स्यात् प्रतिग्रहविवर्जितः
verses.transliteration: cīravāsā bhavennityaṃ snāyāt triṣavaṇaṃ śuciḥ / sarvabhūtānukampī syāt pratigrahavivarjitaḥ
verses.translation: After performing the Isti of pertaining to Prajapati or Agneya* (pertaining to the fire god), he should become a Danta (one with self control.) His passions and sins get perished. He should then resort to the Brahmasrama (the stage of ren¬ unciation i.e. Sannyasa)
verses.hindi: सामवेदने कहा--जिसके द्वारा अनन्त ब्रह्माण्डरूपी चक्र प्रवर्तित है, जो (निरतिशय अवकाशस्वरूप) आकाशके मध्य प्रतिष्ठित है, शिवस्वरूप है, योगियोंके द्वारा वेद्य है, बह परम तत्त्व ही शंकर हैं, महादेव हैं अधथर्ववेदने कहा यति लोग प्रयत्नपूर्वक जिन परम योगेश्वर महेशका दर्शन करते हैं, वे पुरुष रुद्र ही देव भगवान् भव हें
verses.wordMeaning: After performing the Isti of pertaining to Prajapati or Agneya* (pertaining to the fire god), he should become a Danta (one with self control.) His passions and sins get perished. He should then resort to the Brahmasrama (the stage of ren¬ unciation i.e. Sannyasa)
verses.commentary: Sense: After performing the Isti of pertaining to Prajapati or Agneya* (pertaining to the fire god), he should become a Danta (one with self control.) His passions and sins get perished. He should then resort to the Brahmasrama (the stage of ren¬ unciation i.e. Sannyasa)

verses.sanskrit: दर्शेन पौर्णमासेन यजेत् नियतं द्विजः । ऋक्षेष्वाग्रयणे चैव चातुर्मास्यानि चाहरेत् । उत्तरायणं च क्रमशो दक्षस्यायनमेव च
verses.transliteration: darśena paurṇamāsena yajet niyataṃ dvijaḥ / ṛkṣeṣvāgrayaṇe caiva cāturmāsyāni cāharet / uttarāyaṇaṃ ca kramaśo dakṣasyāyanameva ca
verses.translation: Various types of Sannyasins are mentioned: some of them are Jriana-sannyasins, others are Veda-sannyasins while some others are Karma-sannyasins.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार विश्वात्मा होनेपर भी वे भगवान् ब्रह्मा मोहित होनेके कारण वेदोंके द्वारा बनाये गये कल्याणकारी तत्त्वको सुननेपर भी हँसते हुए कहने लगे-जब वे परम ब्रह्म महेश सभी आसक्तियोंसे रहित हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Various types of Sannyasins are mentioned: some of them are Jriana-sannyasins, others are Veda-sannyasins while some others are Karma-sannyasins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Various types of Sannyasins are mentioned: some of them are Jriana-sannyasins, others are Veda-sannyasins while some others are Karma-sannyasins.

verses.sanskrit: वासन्तैः शारदैर्मेध्यैर्मुन्यन्नैः स्वयमाहृतैः । पुरोडाशांश्चरूंश्चैव विधिवन्निर्वपेत् पृथक्
verses.transliteration: vāsantaiḥ śāradairmedhyairmunyannaiḥ svayamāhṛtaiḥ / puroḍāśāṃścarūṃścaiva vidhivannirvapet pṛthak
verses.translation: He who is free from all attachments, devoid of Dvandvas (mutually clashing opposites) and who is fearless is called the renouncer of Jnana type {Jndnasannydsin). He is stabilised in his own Atjnan.
verses.hindi: तो केसे अपनी भार्याके साथ रमण करते हैं तथा अतिगर्वित अपने प्रमथगणोंके साथ सुख-सुविधाओंका भोग करते हें? ऐसा कहे जानेपर सनातन, अमूर्त भगवान् प्रणवने मूर्तिमान् होकर पितामहसे कहा--
verses.wordMeaning: He who is free from all attachments, devoid of Dvandvas (mutually clashing opposites) and who is fearless is called the renouncer of Jnana type {Jndnasannydsin). He is stabilised in his own Atjnan.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who is free from all attachments, devoid of Dvandvas (mutually clashing opposites) and who is fearless is called the renouncer of Jnana type {Jndnasannydsin). He is stabilised in his own Atjnan.

verses.sanskrit: देवताभ्यश्च तद् हुत्वा वन्यं मेध्यतरं हविः । शेषं समुपभुञ्जीत लवणं च स्वयं कृतम्
verses.transliteration: devatābhyaśca tad hutvā vanyaṃ medhyataraṃ haviḥ / śeṣaṃ samupabhuñjīta lavaṇaṃ ca svayaṃ kṛtam
verses.translation: He who studies the Vedas solely every day, is devoid of Dvandvas and who accepts nothing (or is propertyless or has nothing) is called the renouncer of the Veda type ( Veda-Sannydsin). He is one who has conquered the sense organs and i s desirous of liberation.
verses.hindi: प्रणव बोले--ये वे महेश्वर हैं, जो स्वात्माराम हैं। ये अपनी आत्मामें ही रमण करते हैं। इनकी आत्मा ही इनकी पल्ली हैं। यही वे भगवान् ईश स्वयंज्योति, सनातन हैं और देवी शिवा आत्मानन्द-स्वरूपिणी कही
verses.wordMeaning: He who studies the Vedas solely every day, is devoid of Dvandvas and who accepts nothing (or is propertyless or has nothing) is called the renouncer of the Veda type ( Veda-Sannydsin). He is one who has conquered the sense organs and i s desirous of liberation.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who studies the Vedas solely every day, is devoid of Dvandvas and who accepts nothing (or is propertyless or has nothing) is called the renouncer of the Veda type ( Veda-Sannydsin). He is one who has conquered the sense organs and i s desirous of liberation.

verses.sanskrit: वर्जयेन्मधुमांसानि भौमानि कवकानि च । भूस्तृणं शिग्रुकं चैव श्लेष्मातकफलानि च
verses.transliteration: varjayenmadhumāṃsāni bhaumāni kavakāni ca / bhūstṛṇaṃ śigrukaṃ caiva śleṣmātakaphalāni ca
verses.translation: The Brahmana who absorbs the sacrificial fires into the Atman and who is interested in dedicating everything to Brahman, should be known as the renouncer of Karmans—as one devoted to great Tajnas.
verses.hindi: गयी हैं, वे आगन्तुक (देवी उन भगवानूसे पृथक्) नहीं हैं इस प्रकार कहे जानेपर भी उस समय ईश्वरको ही मायासे (मोहित) यज्ञमूर्ति भगवान् तथा ब्रह्माका अज्ञान नष्ट नहीं हुआ। इसी बीच विश्वभावन ब्रह्माने आकाशमध्यको व्याप्त करते हुए अद्भुत एवं दिव्य
verses.wordMeaning: The Brahmana who absorbs the sacrificial fires into the Atman and who is interested in dedicating everything to Brahman, should be known as the renouncer of Karmans—as one devoted to great Tajnas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Brahmana who absorbs the sacrificial fires into the Atman and who is interested in dedicating everything to Brahman, should be known as the renouncer of Karmans—as one devoted to great Tajnas.

verses.sanskrit: न फालकृष्टमश्नीयादुत्सृष्टमपि केनचित् । न ग्रामजातान्यार्तो ऽपि पुष्पाणि च फलानि च
verses.transliteration: na phālakṛṣṭamaśnīyādutsṛṣṭamapi kenacit / na grāmajātānyārto 'pi puṣpāṇi ca phalāni ca
verses.translation: Among these three, the Jnanin is considered to be the superior-most. He is a scholar who has no function to be per¬ formed nor has he any symbol.
verses.hindi: महाज्योतिका दर्शन किया। द्विजोत्तमो ! उस (महाज्योति)- के मध्य स्थित तेजसे उज्वल दिव्य निर्मल मण्डल आकाशके मध्यमें प्रकट हुआ
verses.wordMeaning: Among these three, the Jnanin is considered to be the superior-most. He is a scholar who has no function to be per¬ formed nor has he any symbol.
verses.commentary: Sense: Among these three, the Jnanin is considered to be the superior-most. He is a scholar who has no function to be per¬ formed nor has he any symbol.

verses.sanskrit: श्रावणेनैव विधिना वह्निं परिचरेत् सदा । न द्रुह्येत् सर्वभूतानि निर्द्वन्द्वो निर्भयो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: śrāvaṇenaiva vidhinā vahniṃ paricaret sadā / na druhyet sarvabhūtāni nirdvandvo nirbhayo bhavet
verses.translation: He would be devoid of myness; should be fearless and quiscent; he should be above Dvandvas and free from acceptance (of gifts) (or possession-less). He should wear only a ragged loin cloth or he may be naked, but he is devoted to meditation.
verses.hindi: स दृष्टा वदनं दिव्यं मूर्ध्नि लोकपितामहः । तेन तन्मण्डलं घोरमालोकयदनिन्दितम् प्रजज्चालातिकोपेन ब्रह्मणः पञ्चमं शिरः। क्षणाददृश्यत महान् पुरुषो नीललोहितः
verses.wordMeaning: He would be devoid of myness; should be fearless and quiscent; he should be above Dvandvas and free from acceptance (of gifts) (or possession-less). He should wear only a ragged loin cloth or he may be naked, but he is devoted to meditation.
verses.commentary: Sense: He would be devoid of myness; should be fearless and quiscent; he should be above Dvandvas and free from acceptance (of gifts) (or possession-less). He should wear only a ragged loin cloth or he may be naked, but he is devoted to meditation.

verses.sanskrit: न नक्तं किञ्चिदश्नीयाद् रात्रौ ध्यानपरो भवेत् । जितेन्द्रियो जितक्रोधस्तत्त्वज्ञानविचिन्तकः । ब्रह्मचारी भवेन्नित्यं न पत्नीमपि संश्रयेत्
verses.transliteration: na naktaṃ kiñcidaśnīyād rātrau dhyānaparo bhavet / jitendriyo jitakrodhastattvajñānavicintakaḥ / brahmacārī bhavennityaṃ na patnīmapi saṃśrayet
verses.translation: He should be a celibate; take in only limited mouth¬ fuls of food. He should get his food from the village. He should be engaged in reflecting on the spirit. He should not have worldly attachments. Nor does he take meat.
verses.hindi: त्रिूलपिङ्गलो देवो नागयज्ञोपबीतवान्। तं प्राह भगवान् ब्रह्मा शंकरं नीललोहितम्
verses.wordMeaning: He should be a celibate; take in only limited mouth¬ fuls of food. He should get his food from the village. He should be engaged in reflecting on the spirit. He should not have worldly attachments. Nor does he take meat.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should be a celibate; take in only limited mouth¬ fuls of food. He should get his food from the village. He should be engaged in reflecting on the spirit. He should not have worldly attachments. Nor does he take meat.

verses.sanskrit: यस्तु पत्न्या वनं गत्वा मैथुनं कामतश्चरेत् । तद् व्रतं तस्य लुप्येत प्रायश्चित्तीयते द्विजः
verses.transliteration: yastu patnyā vanaṃ gatvā maithunaṃ kāmataścaret / tad vrataṃ tasya lupyeta prāyaścittīyate dvijaḥ
verses.translation: He should seek happiness and move about here with only the Atman to assist him. He should not speak in appreciation of either death or life.
verses.hindi: जानामि भवतः पूर्व ललाटादेव शंकर। प्रादुर्भावं महेशान मामेव शरणं व्रज प्राहिणोत् पुरुषं कालं भैरवं लोकदाहकम्
verses.wordMeaning: He should seek happiness and move about here with only the Atman to assist him. He should not speak in appreciation of either death or life.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should seek happiness and move about here with only the Atman to assist him. He should not speak in appreciation of either death or life.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र यो जायते गर्भो न संस्पृश्यो द्विजातिभिः । न हि वेदे ऽधिकारो ऽस्य तद्वंशेप्येवमेव हि
verses.transliteration: tatra yo jāyate garbho na saṃspṛśyo dvijātibhiḥ / na hi vede 'dhikāro 'sya tadvaṃśepyevameva hi
verses.translation: One should set foot after purifying the place with the vision (look carefully before treading on a place); he should drink water purified by means of a cloth; he should speak words purified by a knowledge of the scriptures; he should act with a pure conscience.
verses.hindi: स कृत्वा सुमहद युद्धं ब्रह्मणा कालभैरवः । चकर्त तस्य वदनं विरिञ्जस्याथ पञ्चमम्
verses.wordMeaning: One should set foot after purifying the place with the vision (look carefully before treading on a place); he should drink water purified by means of a cloth; he should speak words purified by a knowledge of the scriptures; he should act with a pure conscience.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should set foot after purifying the place with the vision (look carefully before treading on a place); he should drink water purified by means of a cloth; he should speak words purified by a knowledge of the scriptures; he should act with a pure conscience.

verses.sanskrit: अधः शयीत सततं सावित्रीजाप्यतत्परः । शरण्यः सर्वभूतानां संविभागपरः सदा
verses.transliteration: adhaḥ śayīta satataṃ sāvitrījāpyatatparaḥ / śaraṇyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ saṃvibhāgaparaḥ sadā
verses.translation: Except during the rainy season, a mendicant should not stay for long in a single place. He should take ablutions regularly and observe cleanliness. He should always have the waterpot in the hand. He should be clean.
verses.hindi: निकृत्तवदनो देवो ब्रह्मा देवेन शम्भुना। ममार चेशयोगेन जीवितं प्राप विश्वसृक् समासीनं महादेव्या महादेवं सनातनम्
verses.wordMeaning: Except during the rainy season, a mendicant should not stay for long in a single place. He should take ablutions regularly and observe cleanliness. He should always have the waterpot in the hand. He should be clean.
verses.commentary: Sense: Except during the rainy season, a mendicant should not stay for long in a single place. He should take ablutions regularly and observe cleanliness. He should always have the waterpot in the hand. He should be clean.

verses.sanskrit: परिवादं मृषावादं निद्रालस्यं विवर्जयेत् । एकाग्निरनिकेतः स्यात् प्रोक्षितां भूमिमाश्रयेत्
verses.transliteration: parivādaṃ mṛṣāvādaṃ nidrālasyaṃ vivarjayet / ekāgniraniketaḥ syāt prokṣitāṃ bhūmimāśrayet
verses.translation: He should perpetually be devoted to celibacy and should always stay in the forest. He should be devoted to the scriptures on salvation. He should be celibate and should keep his sense-organs fully conquered.
verses.hindi: कोटिसूर्यप्रतीकाशं जटाजूटविराजितम्
verses.wordMeaning: He should perpetually be devoted to celibacy and should always stay in the forest. He should be devoted to the scriptures on salvation. He should be celibate and should keep his sense-organs fully conquered.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should perpetually be devoted to celibacy and should always stay in the forest. He should be devoted to the scriptures on salvation. He should be celibate and should keep his sense-organs fully conquered.

verses.sanskrit: मृगैः सह चरेद् वासं तैः सहैव च संवसेत् । शिलायां शर्करायां वा शयीत सुसमाहितः
verses.transliteration: mṛgaiḥ saha cared vāsaṃ taiḥ sahaiva ca saṃvaset / śilāyāṃ śarkarāyāṃ vā śayīta susamāhitaḥ
verses.translation: He should be free from haughtiness and egotism; he should be devoid of censure and backbiting. An ascetic endowed with the quality of the (realization of) knowledge of the Atman shall attain salvation.
verses.hindi: तमादिदेवं ब्रह्माणं महादेवं ददर्श ह यस्य सा परमा देवी शक्तिराकाशसंस्थिता। सोऽनन्तैश्वर्ययोगात्मा महेशो दृश्यते किल
verses.wordMeaning: He should be free from haughtiness and egotism; he should be devoid of censure and backbiting. An ascetic endowed with the quality of the (realization of) knowledge of the Atman shall attain salvation.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should be free from haughtiness and egotism; he should be devoid of censure and backbiting. An ascetic endowed with the quality of the (realization of) knowledge of the Atman shall attain salvation.

verses.sanskrit: सद्यः प्रक्षालको वा स्यान्माससंचयिको ऽपि वा । षण्मासनिचयो वा स्यात् समानिचय एव वा
verses.transliteration: sadyaḥ prakṣālako vā syānmāsasaṃcayiko 'pi vā / ṣaṇmāsanicayo vā syāt samānicaya eva vā
verses.translation: After taking bath he should perform the Acamana rite according to injunctions. Thus purified he should always study (ponder over) the eternal Veda called Pranava i.e. OM (sitting) in a temple, etc.
verses.hindi: योऽथ नाचारनिरतान् स्वभक्तानेव केवलम्। विमोचयति लोकानां नायको दूश्यते किल
verses.wordMeaning: After taking bath he should perform the Acamana rite according to injunctions. Thus purified he should always study (ponder over) the eternal Veda called Pranava i.e. OM (sitting) in a temple, etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: After taking bath he should perform the Acamana rite according to injunctions. Thus purified he should always study (ponder over) the eternal Veda called Pranava i.e. OM (sitting) in a temple, etc.

verses.sanskrit: त्यजेदाश्वयुजे मासि संपन्नं पूर्वसंचितम् । जीर्णानि चैव वासांसि शाकमूलफलानि च
verses.transliteration: tyajedāśvayuje māsi saṃpannaṃ pūrvasaṃcitam / jīrṇāni caiva vāsāṃsi śākamūlaphalāni ca
verses.translation: The ascetic observing silence and celibacy may stay with his sons* also. If he practises the study of Vedas always, he shall attain the greatest goal.
verses.hindi: वह अनिन्दित मण्डल दिव्य था और तेजोमय होनेके कारण घोर (भीषण) था तथा मूर्धापर (सबसे ऊपर) स्थित था। उसे देखकर ब्रह्माने अपने मुखको, सबसे ऊपर विद्यमान उस मण्डलके आलोकसे आलोकित किया; पर उसी समय अज्ञानवश अति कुपित ब्रह्माके
verses.wordMeaning: The ascetic observing silence and celibacy may stay with his sons* also. If he practises the study of Vedas always, he shall attain the greatest goal.
verses.commentary: Sense: The ascetic observing silence and celibacy may stay with his sons* also. If he practises the study of Vedas always, he shall attain the greatest goal.

verses.sanskrit: दन्तोलूखलिको वास्यात् कापोतीं वृत्तिमाश्रयेत् । अश्मकुट्टो भवेद् वापि कालपक्वभुगेव वा
verses.transliteration: dantolūkhaliko vāsyāt kāpotīṃ vṛttimāśrayet / aśmakuṭṭo bhaved vāpi kālapakvabhugeva vā
verses.translation: These are particularly his vows viz.: non-violence, truthfulness, non-stealing, celibacy, greatest penance; (austere- most) forbearance, mercifulness and contenment.
verses.hindi: लगा। उसी क्षण भगवान् नीललोहित रुद्र (महेश्वरके गणके देवविशेष) प्रकट हुए। वे रुद्रदेव त्रिशूल धारण किये हुए थे, पिङ्गलवर्णके थे तथा सर्पका यज्ञोपवीत धारण किये हुए थे। उन नीललोहित शंकर रुद्रसे
verses.wordMeaning: These are particularly his vows viz.: non-violence, truthfulness, non-stealing, celibacy, greatest penance; (austere- most) forbearance, mercifulness and contenment.
verses.commentary: Sense: These are particularly his vows viz.: non-violence, truthfulness, non-stealing, celibacy, greatest penance; (austere- most) forbearance, mercifulness and contenment.

verses.sanskrit: नक्तं चान्न समश्नीयाद् दिवा चाहृत्य शक्तितः । चतुर्थकालिको वा स्यात् स्याद्वाप्यष्टमकालिकः
verses.transliteration: naktaṃ cānna samaśnīyād divā cāhṛtya śaktitaḥ / caturthakāliko vā syāt syādvāpyaṣṭamakālikaḥ
verses.translation: He should adhere to the Vedantic knowledge with great concentration; he should perform the five Yajnas (Panca- maha Yajnas) It is not for the sake of alms that he should be endowed with Jnana and meditation.
verses.hindi: भगवान् ब्रह्माने कहा-हे महेशान! आपका मेरे ही 'ललाटसे सर्वप्रथम प्रादुर्भाव हुआ था, यह मैं जानता हूँ। आप मेरी शरणमें आयें तदनन्तर पद्मयोनिके गर्वयुक्त वचनको सुनकर ईश्वर (नीललोहित रुद्र)-ने लोकको जलानेवाले पुरुष कालभैरवको भेजा। उस कालभैरवने ब्रह्माके साथ महान् युद्ध किया और उन ब्रह्माके पाँचवें मुखको काटडाला
verses.wordMeaning: He should adhere to the Vedantic knowledge with great concentration; he should perform the five Yajnas (Panca- maha Yajnas) It is not for the sake of alms that he should be endowed with Jnana and meditation.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should adhere to the Vedantic knowledge with great concentration; he should perform the five Yajnas (Panca- maha Yajnas) It is not for the sake of alms that he should be endowed with Jnana and meditation.

verses.sanskrit: चान्द्रायणविधानैर्वा शुक्ले कृष्णे च वर्तयेत् । पक्षे पक्षे समश्नीयाद् यवागूं क्वथितां सकृत्
verses.transliteration: cāndrāyaṇavidhānairvā śukle kṛṣṇe ca vartayet / pakṣe pakṣe samaśnīyād yavāgūṃ kvathitāṃ sakṛt
verses.translation: He should always perform the Japa of the Homa mantras at the proper time with great concentration. He should read the Vedic passage every day. He should repeat the Savitri Mantra at the junctions (morning and evening).
verses.hindi: देव शम्भुकी प्रेरणासे कालभैरवद्दारा ब्रह्माका मस्तक काट दिये जानेपर उन देव ब्रह्माको मृत्यु हो गयी, किंतु ईश्वरके योगसे पुनः वे विश्वस्रष्टा (ब्रह्मा) जीवित हो गये। तदनन्तर (ब्रह्माने) उस मण्डलके मध्यमें स्थित सनातन
verses.wordMeaning: He should always perform the Japa of the Homa mantras at the proper time with great concentration. He should read the Vedic passage every day. He should repeat the Savitri Mantra at the junctions (morning and evening).
verses.commentary: Sense: He should always perform the Japa of the Homa mantras at the proper time with great concentration. He should read the Vedic passage every day. He should repeat the Savitri Mantra at the junctions (morning and evening).

verses.sanskrit: पुष्पमूलफलैर्वापि केवलैर्वर्तयेत् सदा । स्वाभाविकैः स्वयं शीर्णैर्वैखानसमते स्थितः
verses.transliteration: puṣpamūlaphalairvāpi kevalairvartayet sadā / svābhāvikaiḥ svayaṃ śīrṇairvaikhānasamate sthitaḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter he should meditate on Lord Paramesvara in a secluded spot. During secluded life one should avoid passion, fury and acceptance of monetary gifts.
verses.hindi: महादेव (गिरिश) महेश्वरको महादेवीके साथ विराजमान देखा। वे सर्पराजका कङ्कण पहने थे, चन्द्रमाके अवयवको (द्वितीयाके चन्द्रमाको) भूषणरूपमें धारण किये थे। करोड़ों सूर्योके समान प्रकाशमान तथा जटाजूट धारण किये हुए थे। उन्होंने व्याघ्रचर्मका वस्त्र धारण किया था, दिव्य मालाओंसे समन्वित थे, हाथमें त्रिशूल धारण किये थे, कठिनतासे देखे जा सकने योग्य तथा भस्मसे सुशोभित ऐसे योगी (शंकर)-को उन्होंने देखा। योगनिष्ठ अपने
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter he should meditate on Lord Paramesvara in a secluded spot. During secluded life one should avoid passion, fury and acceptance of monetary gifts.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter he should meditate on Lord Paramesvara in a secluded spot. During secluded life one should avoid passion, fury and acceptance of monetary gifts.

verses.sanskrit: भूमौ वा परिवर्तेत तिष्ठेद् वा प्रपदैर्दिनम् । स्थानासनाभ्यां विहरेन्न क्वचिद् धैर्यमुत्सृजेत्
verses.transliteration: bhūmau vā parivarteta tiṣṭhed vā prapadairdinam / sthānāsanābhyāṃ viharenna kvacid dhairyamutsṛjet
verses.translation: The scholar who wears one or two garments, a tuft of hair (on the head), a sacred thread and holding a Kaman- dalu (water-pot) in hand and three staffs attains the greatest Being.
verses.hindi: हृदयके मध्य जिन ईश्वरका दर्शन करते हैं, उन ब्रह्मस्वरूप आदिदेव महादेवको (ब्रह्माने) देखा
verses.wordMeaning: The scholar who wears one or two garments, a tuft of hair (on the head), a sacred thread and holding a Kaman- dalu (water-pot) in hand and three staffs attains the greatest Being.
verses.commentary: Sense: The scholar who wears one or two garments, a tuft of hair (on the head), a sacred thread and holding a Kaman- dalu (water-pot) in hand and three staffs attains the greatest Being.

verses.sanskrit: ग्रीष्मे पञ्चतपाश्च स्याद् वर्षास्वभ्रावकाशकः । आर्द्रवासास्तु हेमन्ते क्रमशो वर्धयंस्तपः
verses.transliteration: grīṣme pañcatapāśca syād varṣāsvabhrāvakāśakaḥ / ārdravāsāstu hemante kramaśo vardhayaṃstapaḥ
verses.translation: VV. 25-36 enumerate the atonements or expiations for transgression of rules by a Sannyasin,
verses.hindi: आकाशमें स्थित वे परमा देवी जिनकी शक्ति हैं, पड़ रहे हैं। जिन्हें एक बार प्रणाम मात्र कर लेनेसे ही प्रणाम करनेवालेके सम्पूर्ण मोहको उत्पन्न करनेवाला संसारका बीज विलीन हो जाता है, वे रुद्र दिखलायी पड़ रहे हैं। वे लोकोंके नायक दिखलायी पड़ रहे
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 25-36 enumerate the atonements or expiations for transgression of rules by a Sannyasin,
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 25-36 enumerate the atonements or expiations for transgression of rules by a Sannyasin,

verses.sanskrit: उपस्पृश्य त्रिषवणं पितृदेवांश्च तर्पयेत् । एकपादेन तिष्ठेत मरीचीन् वा पिबेत् तदा
verses.transliteration: upaspṛśya triṣavaṇaṃ pitṛdevāṃśca tarpayet / ekapādena tiṣṭheta marīcīn vā pibet tadā
verses.translation: VV. 25-36 enumerate the atonements or expiations for transgression of rules by a Sannyasin,
verses.hindi: हैं, जो उन लोगोंको भी मुक्त कर देते हैं जो आचारयुक्त न होनेपर भी केवल उनकी भक्ति करते हैं॥ ३६--३८ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 25-36 enumerate the atonements or expiations for transgression of rules by a Sannyasin,
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 25-36 enumerate the atonements or expiations for transgression of rules by a Sannyasin,

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चाग्निर्धूमपो वा स्यादुष्मपः सोमपो ऽपि वा । पयः पिबेच्छुक्लपक्षे कृष्णापक्षे तु गोमयम् । शीर्णपर्णाशनो वा स्यात् कृच्छ्रैर् वा वर्तयेत् सदा
verses.transliteration: pañcāgnirdhūmapo vā syāduṣmapaḥ somapo 'pi vā / payaḥ pibecchuklapakṣe kṛṣṇāpakṣe tu gomayam / śīrṇaparṇāśano vā syāt kṛcchrair vā vartayet sadā
verses.translation: VV. 25-36 enumerate the atonements or expiations for transgression of rules by a Sannyasin,
verses.hindi: यस्य वेदविदः शान्ता निर्ईन्द्वा ब्रह्मचारिणः । विदन्ति विमलं रूपं स शम्भुर्दृश्यते किल यस्य ब्रह्मादयो देवा ऋषयो ब्रह्मवादिनः । अर्चयन्ति सदा लिङ्गं विश्वेशः खलु दृश्यते
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 25-36 enumerate the atonements or expiations for transgression of rules by a Sannyasin,
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 25-36 enumerate the atonements or expiations for transgression of rules by a Sannyasin,

verses.sanskrit: योगाभ्यासरतश्च स्याद् रुद्राध्यायी भवेत् सदा । अथर्वशिरसो ऽध्येता वेदान्ताभ्यासतत्परः
verses.transliteration: yogābhyāsarataśca syād rudrādhyāyī bhavet sadā / atharvaśiraso 'dhyetā vedāntābhyāsatatparaḥ
verses.translation: VV. 25-36 enumerate the atonements or expiations for transgression of rules by a Sannyasin,
verses.hindi: विद्यासहायो भगवान् यस्यासौ मण्डलान्तरम्। हिरण्यगर्भपुत्रोऽसावीश्वरो दृश्यते किल
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 25-36 enumerate the atonements or expiations for transgression of rules by a Sannyasin,
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 25-36 enumerate the atonements or expiations for transgression of rules by a Sannyasin,

verses.sanskrit: यमान् सेवेत सततं नियमांश्चाप्यतन्द्रितः । कृष्णाजिनी सोत्तरीयः शुक्लयज्ञोपवीतवान्
verses.transliteration: yamān seveta satataṃ niyamāṃścāpyatandritaḥ / kṛṣṇājinī sottarīyaḥ śuklayajñopavītavān
verses.translation: VV. 25-36 enumerate the atonements or expiations for transgression of rules by a Sannyasin,
verses.hindi: न मुञ्चति सदा पार्श्व शंकरो5सावदृश्यत कालः किल स योगात्मा कालकालो हि दृश्यते
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 25-36 enumerate the atonements or expiations for transgression of rules by a Sannyasin,
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 25-36 enumerate the atonements or expiations for transgression of rules by a Sannyasin,

verses.sanskrit: अथ चाग्नीन् समारोप्य स्वात्मनि ध्यानतत्परः । अनग्निरनिकेतः स्यान्मुनिर्मोक्षपरो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: atha cāgnīn samāropya svātmani dhyānatatparaḥ / anagniraniketaḥ syānmunirmokṣaparo bhavet
verses.translation: VV. 25-36 enumerate the atonements or expiations for transgression of rules by a Sannyasin,
verses.hindi: जीवनं सर्वलोकानां त्रिलोकस्यैव भूषणम् । सोमः स दूश्यते देवः सोमो यस्य विभूषणम्
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 25-36 enumerate the atonements or expiations for transgression of rules by a Sannyasin,
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 25-36 enumerate the atonements or expiations for transgression of rules by a Sannyasin,
