verses.sanskrit: तापसेष्वेव विप्रेषु यात्रिकं भैक्षमाहरेत् । गृहमेधिषु चान्येषु द्विजेषु वनवासिषु
verses.transliteration: tāpaseṣveva vipreṣu yātrikaṃ bhaikṣamāharet / gṛhamedhiṣu cānyeṣu dvijeṣu vanavāsiṣu
verses.translation: VV. 25-36 enumerate the atonements or expiations for transgression of rules by a Sannyasin,
verses.hindi: देव्या सह सदा साक्षाद् यस्य योगः स्वभावतः । गीयते परमा मुक्तिः स योगी दूश्यते किल योगं ध्यायन्ति देव्याऽसौ स योगी दूश्यते किल
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 25-36 enumerate the atonements or expiations for transgression of rules by a Sannyasin,
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 25-36 enumerate the atonements or expiations for transgression of rules by a Sannyasin,

verses.sanskrit: ग्रामादाहृत्य वाश्नीयादष्टौ ग्रासान् वने वसन् । प्रतिगृह्य पुटेनैव पाणिना शकलेन वा
verses.transliteration: grāmādāhṛtya vāśnīyādaṣṭau grāsān vane vasan / pratigṛhya puṭenaiva pāṇinā śakalena vā
verses.translation: VV. 25-36 enumerate the atonements or expiations for transgression of rules by a Sannyasin,
verses.hindi: सोऽनुवीक्ष्य महादेवं महादेव्या सनातनम्। वरासने समासीनमवाप परमां स्मृतिम्
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 25-36 enumerate the atonements or expiations for transgression of rules by a Sannyasin,
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 25-36 enumerate the atonements or expiations for transgression of rules by a Sannyasin,

verses.sanskrit: विविधाश्चोपनिषद आत्मसंसिद्धये जपेत् । विद्याविशेषान् सावित्रीं रुद्राध्यायं तथैव च
verses.transliteration: vividhāścopaniṣada ātmasaṃsiddhaye japet / vidyāviśeṣān sāvitrīṃ rudrādhyāyaṃ tathaiva ca
verses.translation: VV. 25-36 enumerate the atonements or expiations for transgression of rules by a Sannyasin,
verses.hindi: लब्ध्वा माहेश्वरीं दिव्यां संस्मृतिं भगवानजः । नमो देवाय महते महादेव्यै नमो नमः ।
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 25-36 enumerate the atonements or expiations for transgression of rules by a Sannyasin,
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 25-36 enumerate the atonements or expiations for transgression of rules by a Sannyasin,

verses.sanskrit: महाप्रास्थानिकं चासौ कुर्यादनशनं तु वा । अग्निप्रवेशमन्यद् वा ब्रर्ह्मार्पणविधौ स्थितः
verses.transliteration: mahāprāsthānikaṃ cāsau kuryādanaśanaṃ tu vā / agnipraveśamanyad vā brarhmārpaṇavidhau sthitaḥ
verses.translation: VV. 25-36 enumerate the atonements or expiations for transgression of rules by a Sannyasin,
verses.hindi: नमः शिवाय शान्ताय शिवायै शान्तये नम:
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 25-36 enumerate the atonements or expiations for transgression of rules by a Sannyasin,
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 25-36 enumerate the atonements or expiations for transgression of rules by a Sannyasin,

verses.sanskrit: यस्तु सम्यगिममाश्रमं शिवं संश्रयेदशिवपुञ्जनाशनम् । तापसः स परमैश्वरं पदं याति यत्र जगतो ऽस्य संस्थितिः
verses.transliteration: yastu samyagimamāśramaṃ śivaṃ saṃśrayedaśivapuñjanāśanam / tāpasaḥ sa paramaiśvaraṃ padaṃ yāti yatra jagato 'sya saṃsthitiḥ
verses.translation: VV. 25-36 enumerate the atonements or expiations for transgression of rules by a Sannyasin,
verses.hindi: वेदोंके ज्ञाता, शान्त तथा टुन्द्ररहित ब्रह्मचारी जिनके विशुद्ध स्वरूपको जानते हैं, वे शम्भु दिखलायी पड़ रहे हैं। ब्रह्मा आदि देवता तथा ब्रह्मवादी ऋषिजन जिनके लिङ्गकी सदा आराधना करते हैं, वे विश्वेश्वर दिखलायी पड़ रहे हैं
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 25-36 enumerate the atonements or expiations for transgression of rules by a Sannyasin,
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 25-36 enumerate the atonements or expiations for transgression of rules by a Sannyasin,

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे सप्तविशो ऽध्याय व्यास उवाच एवं वनाश्रमे स्थित्वा तृतीयं भागमायुषः । चतुर्थमायुषो भागं संन्यासेन नयेत् क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge saptaviśo 'dhyāya vyāsa uvāca evaṃ vanāśrame sthitvā tṛtīyaṃ bhāgamāyuṣaḥ / caturthamāyuṣo bhāgaṃ saṃnyāsena nayet kramāt
verses.translation: Manu VI. 56, Sankha VII. 2
verses.hindi: जिन्हें एक बार प्रणाममात्र कर लेनेसे ही प्रणाम करनेवालेके सम्पूर्ण मोहको उत्पन्न करनेवाला संसारका बीज विलीन हो जाता है, वे रुद्र दिखलायी पड़ रहे हैं। जिनके मण्डलके मध्य सरस्वतीके साथ ये भगवान्
verses.wordMeaning: Manu VI. 56, Sankha VII. 2
verses.commentary: Sense: Manu VI. 56, Sankha VII. 2

verses.sanskrit: अग्नीनात्मनी संस्थाप्य द्विजः प्रव्रजितो भवेत् । योगाभ्यासरतः शान्तो ब्रह्मविद्यापरायणः
verses.transliteration: agnīnātmanī saṃsthāpya dvijaḥ pravrajito bhavet / yogābhyāsarataḥ śānto brahmavidyāparāyaṇaḥ
verses.translation: He should beg for alms only at seven houses. If nothing is received he should begin begging for alms once again. He should wash the vessel and take food in it. Then once again, he should wash it with water.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मा स्थित हैं, हिरण्यगर्भके पुत्र वे ईश्वर दिखलायी पड़ रहे हें । सम्पूर्ण संसारको उत्पन्न करनेवाली विज्ञान- तनुरूपी (विज्ञानमयी) ईश्वरी (शक्ति) जिनके पार्श्वका कभी त्याग नहीं करती, वे शंकर दिखलायी पड़ रहे हैं। जिनके चरणकमलोंमें पत्र, पुष्प अथवा जल अर्पण करनेसे (प्राणी) संसारसे पार हो जाते हैं, वे रुद्र दिखलायी पड़ रहे हैं। जिनकी संनिधिमात्रसे (अमोघशक्ति प्राप्तकर) सनातन (शाश्वतकाल) सब कुछ प्राणिमात्रको
verses.wordMeaning: He should beg for alms only at seven houses. If nothing is received he should begin begging for alms once again. He should wash the vessel and take food in it. Then once again, he should wash it with water.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should beg for alms only at seven houses. If nothing is received he should begin begging for alms once again. He should wash the vessel and take food in it. Then once again, he should wash it with water.

verses.sanskrit: यदा मनसि संजातं वैतृष्ण्यं सर्ववस्तुषु । तदा संन्यासमिच्छेच्च पतितः स्याद् विपर्यये
verses.transliteration: yadā manasi saṃjātaṃ vaitṛṣṇyaṃ sarvavastuṣu / tadā saṃnyāsamicchecca patitaḥ syād viparyaye
verses.translation: Or he should take another vessel for collecting the alms and another for taking food everyday. After taking food he should wipe off that vessel and take food only to facilitate the journey of life. He should not be covetous.
verses.hindi: प्रदान करता है, वे कालके भी काल योगात्मा महेश्वर दृष्टिगोचर हो रहे हें
verses.wordMeaning: Or he should take another vessel for collecting the alms and another for taking food everyday. After taking food he should wipe off that vessel and take food only to facilitate the journey of life. He should not be covetous.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or he should take another vessel for collecting the alms and another for taking food everyday. After taking food he should wipe off that vessel and take food only to facilitate the journey of life. He should not be covetous.

verses.sanskrit: प्राजापत्यां निरूप्येष्टिमाग्नेयीमथवा पुनः । दान्तः पक्वकषायो ऽसौ ब्रह्माश्रममुपाश्रयेत्
verses.transliteration: prājāpatyāṃ nirūpyeṣṭimāgneyīmathavā punaḥ / dāntaḥ pakvakaṣāyo 'sau brahmāśramamupāśrayet
verses.translation: The ascetic should go to collect alms when there is no smoke or burning coal, at a house where all the people have taken food and where the threshing rod is kept resting and the potsherds are disposed off.
verses.hindi: जो सम्पूर्ण लोकोंके जीवन हैं, तीनों लोकोंके भूषण हैं तथा चन्द्रमा जिनका आभूषण है, वे देव सोम (उमाके साथ महेश्वर) दिखलायी पड़ रहे हैं। देवी उमा (पार्वती)-के साथ जिनका स्वभावसे ही नित्य साक्षात् संयोग है एवं जिनके अनुग्रहसे परम मुक्तिको प्राप्ति शास्त्रोमें बतायी जाती है, वे योगी महेश्वर दिखलायी पड़ रहे हैं। वैराग्यकी ओर उन्मुख, योगके तत्त्वको जाननेवाले योगीजन देवीके साथ निरन्तर
verses.wordMeaning: The ascetic should go to collect alms when there is no smoke or burning coal, at a house where all the people have taken food and where the threshing rod is kept resting and the potsherds are disposed off.
verses.commentary: Sense: The ascetic should go to collect alms when there is no smoke or burning coal, at a house where all the people have taken food and where the threshing rod is kept resting and the potsherds are disposed off.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानसंन्यासिनः केचिद् वेदसंन्यासिनः परे । कर्मसंन्यासिनस्त्वन्ये त्रिविधाः परिकीर्तिताः
verses.transliteration: jñānasaṃnyāsinaḥ kecid vedasaṃnyāsinaḥ pare / karmasaṃnyāsinastvanye trividhāḥ parikīrtitāḥ
verses.translation: After saying "Bhiksa" (alms) once, the mendicant ascetic should stand with the head bent (facing down) for a period of a Godoha (i.e. the time taken to milk a cow). (After receiving the alms) he should eat it silently. He should be pure and restrained in speech.
verses.hindi: जिनके योगका ध्यान करते हैं, वे ही योगी (शंकर) दिखलायी पड़ रहे हैं ॥ ४६--४८॥
verses.wordMeaning: After saying "Bhiksa" (alms) once, the mendicant ascetic should stand with the head bent (facing down) for a period of a Godoha (i.e. the time taken to milk a cow). (After receiving the alms) he should eat it silently. He should be pure and restrained in speech.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying "Bhiksa" (alms) once, the mendicant ascetic should stand with the head bent (facing down) for a period of a Godoha (i.e. the time taken to milk a cow). (After receiving the alms) he should eat it silently. He should be pure and restrained in speech.

verses.sanskrit: यः सर्वसङ्गनिर्मुक्तो निर्द्वन्द्वश्चैव निर्भयः । प्रोच्यते ज्ञानसंन्यासी स्वात्मन्येव व्यवस्थितः
verses.transliteration: yaḥ sarvasaṅganirmukto nirdvandvaścaiva nirbhayaḥ / procyate jñānasaṃnyāsī svātmanyeva vyavasthitaḥ
verses.translation: He should wash his hands and feet and perform the Acamana rites in accordance with the injunctions. He should show food to the sun-god and partake of it facing the east. He should remain pure.
verses.hindi: महादेवीके साथ सनातन महादेवको श्रेष्ठ आसनपर विराजमान देखकर ब्रह्माको परम स्मृति प्राप्त हुई। भगवान् ब्रह्माने दिव्य माहेश्वरी स्मृतिको प्राप्तकर चन्द्रमाको आभूषणके रूपमें धारण करनेवाले तथा वर प्रदान करनेवाले सोम (शंकर)-को स्तुतिद्वारा प्रसन्न किया
verses.wordMeaning: He should wash his hands and feet and perform the Acamana rites in accordance with the injunctions. He should show food to the sun-god and partake of it facing the east. He should remain pure.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should wash his hands and feet and perform the Acamana rites in accordance with the injunctions. He should show food to the sun-god and partake of it facing the east. He should remain pure.

verses.sanskrit: वेदमेवाभ्यसेन्नित्यं निराशी निष्परिग्रहः । प्रोच्यते वेदसंन्यासी मुमुक्षुर्विजितेन्द्रियः
verses.transliteration: vedamevābhyasennityaṃ nirāśī niṣparigrahaḥ / procyate vedasaṃnyāsī mumukṣurvijitendriyaḥ
verses.translation: He should take in the five Prandhutis (i.e. take the five particles of food while uttering Prdmya svdhd etc.). With concentration he should take in only eight mouthfuls of food.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्माने कहा--महान् देव (महादेव)-को नमस्कार है। महादेवीको बार-बार नमस्कार है। शिवको, शान्तको नमस्कार है, शिवाको, शान्तिको नमस्कार है
verses.wordMeaning: He should take in the five Prandhutis (i.e. take the five particles of food while uttering Prdmya svdhd etc.). With concentration he should take in only eight mouthfuls of food.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should take in the five Prandhutis (i.e. take the five particles of food while uttering Prdmya svdhd etc.). With concentration he should take in only eight mouthfuls of food.

verses.sanskrit: यस्त्वग्नीनात्मसात्कृत्वा ब्रह्मार्पणपरो द्विजः । ज्ञेयः स कर्मसंन्यासी महायज्ञपरायणः
verses.transliteration: yastvagnīnātmasātkṛtvā brahmārpaṇaparo dvijaḥ / jñeyaḥ sa karmasaṃnyāsī mahāyajñaparāyaṇaḥ
verses.translation: Manu, the Prajapati, says that the following four types of vessels may be used (for begging alms) by ascetics viz.: a gourd, a wooden vessel, a mud-pot or a bamboo pot.
verses.hindi: ओं नमो ब्रह्मणे तुभ्यं विद्यायै ते नमो नमः । नमो मूलप्रकृतये महेशाय नमो नमः नमस्ते कालकालाय ईशवरायै नमो नमः
verses.wordMeaning: Manu, the Prajapati, says that the following four types of vessels may be used (for begging alms) by ascetics viz.: a gourd, a wooden vessel, a mud-pot or a bamboo pot.
verses.commentary: Sense: Manu, the Prajapati, says that the following four types of vessels may be used (for begging alms) by ascetics viz.: a gourd, a wooden vessel, a mud-pot or a bamboo pot.

verses.sanskrit: त्रयाणामपि चैतेषां ज्ञानी त्वभ्यधिको मतः । न तस्य विद्यते कार्यं न लिङ्गं वा विपश्चितः
verses.transliteration: trayāṇāmapi caiteṣāṃ jñānī tvabhyadhiko mataḥ / na tasya vidyate kāryaṃ na liṅgaṃ vā vipaścitaḥ
verses.translation: He should think of Isvara always early in the night, in the middle of the night, at the close of the night and during the Sandhyas (i.e. dawn and dusk). During the Sandhyas, he should particularly make use of sacrificial fires. *
verses.hindi: नमो नमस्ते कामाय मायायै च नमो नम:
verses.wordMeaning: He should think of Isvara always early in the night, in the middle of the night, at the close of the night and during the Sandhyas (i.e. dawn and dusk). During the Sandhyas, he should particularly make use of sacrificial fires. *
verses.commentary: Sense: He should think of Isvara always early in the night, in the middle of the night, at the close of the night and during the Sandhyas (i.e. dawn and dusk). During the Sandhyas, he should particularly make use of sacrificial fires. *

verses.sanskrit: निर्ममो निर्भयः शान्तो निर्द्वन्द्वः पर्णभोजनः । जीर्णकौपीनवासाः स्यान्नग्नो वा ध्यानतत्परः
verses.transliteration: nirmamo nirbhayaḥ śānto nirdvandvaḥ parṇabhojanaḥ / jīrṇakaupīnavāsāḥ syānnagno vā dhyānatatparaḥ
verses.translation: One meditating on the ancient pure Purusa, the cause of all beings, the only receptacle of bliss, shall be released from bondage.
verses.hindi: नियन्त्रे सर्वकार्याणां क्षोभिकायै नमो नमः । नमोऽस्तु ते प्रकृतये नमो नारायणाय च नमः कार्यविहीनाय विश्वप्रकृतये नमः
verses.wordMeaning: One meditating on the ancient pure Purusa, the cause of all beings, the only receptacle of bliss, shall be released from bondage.
verses.commentary: Sense: One meditating on the ancient pure Purusa, the cause of all beings, the only receptacle of bliss, shall be released from bondage.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मचारी मिताहारो ग्रामादन्नं समाहरेत् । अध्यात्ममतिरासीत निरपेक्षो निरामिषः
verses.transliteration: brahmacārī mitāhāro grāmādannaṃ samāharet / adhyātmamatirāsīta nirapekṣo nirāmiṣaḥ
verses.translation: After pondering over the infinite real, Isana, the Brahman that is lying hidden in its middle, the Brahman characterised by perfect knowledge, he should sit with perfect self-control.
verses.hindi: ओंकारमूर्तये तुभ्यं तदन्तःसंस्थिताय च। नमस्ते व्योमसंस्थाय व्योमशक्त्यै नमो नमः
verses.wordMeaning: After pondering over the infinite real, Isana, the Brahman that is lying hidden in its middle, the Brahman characterised by perfect knowledge, he should sit with perfect self-control.
verses.commentary: Sense: After pondering over the infinite real, Isana, the Brahman that is lying hidden in its middle, the Brahman characterised by perfect knowledge, he should sit with perfect self-control.

verses.sanskrit: आत्मनैव सहायेन सुखार्थं विचरेदिह । नाभिनन्देत मरणं नाभिनन्देत जीवितम्
verses.transliteration: ātmanaiva sahāyena sukhārthaṃ vicarediha / nābhinandeta maraṇaṃ nābhinandeta jīvitam
verses.translation: This is the greatest secret of all secrets imparted to ascetics by Mahesa. He who brings into practice the perfect knowledge, shall experience Yoga pertaining to Isvara.
verses.hindi: इति सोमाष्टकेनेशं प्रणनाम पितामहः। पपात दण्डवद् भूमौ गृणन् वै शतरुद्रियम् अथ देवो महादेवः प्रणतार्तिहरो हरः। प्रोवाचोत्थाप्य हस्ताभ्यां प्रीतोऽस्मि तव साम्प्रतम्
verses.wordMeaning: This is the greatest secret of all secrets imparted to ascetics by Mahesa. He who brings into practice the perfect knowledge, shall experience Yoga pertaining to Isvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: This is the greatest secret of all secrets imparted to ascetics by Mahesa. He who brings into practice the perfect knowledge, shall experience Yoga pertaining to Isvara.

verses.sanskrit: कालमेव प्रतीक्षेत निदेशं भृतको यथा । नाध्येतव्यं न वक्तव्यं श्रोतव्यं न कदाचन । एवं ज्ञात्वा परो योगी ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते
verses.transliteration: kālameva pratīkṣeta nideśaṃ bhṛtako yathā / nādhyetavyaṃ na vaktavyaṃ śrotavyaṃ na kadācana / evaṃ jñātvā paro yogī brahmabhūyāya kalpate
verses.translation: Hence, he should always be devoted to meditation; he should be devoted to the Atmavidya (knowledge of the soul). He should resort to the perfect knowledge of Brahman, whereby he shall be released from bondage.
verses.hindi: प्रोवाचाग्रे स्थितं देवं नीललोहितमीश्वरम्
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, he should always be devoted to meditation; he should be devoted to the Atmavidya (knowledge of the soul). He should resort to the perfect knowledge of Brahman, whereby he shall be released from bondage.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, he should always be devoted to meditation; he should be devoted to the Atmavidya (knowledge of the soul). He should resort to the perfect knowledge of Brahman, whereby he shall be released from bondage.

verses.sanskrit: एकवासाथवा विद्वान् कौपीनाच्छादनस्तथा । मुण्डी शिखी वाथ भवेत् त्रिदण्डी निष्परिग्रहः । काषायवासाः सततं ध्यानयोगपरायणः
verses.transliteration: ekavāsāthavā vidvān kaupīnācchādanastathā / muṇḍī śikhī vātha bhavet tridaṇḍī niṣparigrahaḥ / kāṣāyavāsāḥ satataṃ dhyānayogaparāyaṇaḥ
verses.translation: Realising the non-identity of the self from all other things, and that the self is pure bliss, devoid of old age, one should meditate again on that Supreme knowledge.
verses.hindi: एष ब्रह्मास्य जगतः सम्पूज्यः प्रथमः सुतः। आत्मनो रक्षणीयस्ते गुरू्ज्येष्ठः पिता तव + व्योम ब्रह्मका भी नाम है।
verses.wordMeaning: Realising the non-identity of the self from all other things, and that the self is pure bliss, devoid of old age, one should meditate again on that Supreme knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: Realising the non-identity of the self from all other things, and that the self is pure bliss, devoid of old age, one should meditate again on that Supreme knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: ग्रामान्ते वृक्षमूले वा वसेद् देवालये ऽपि वा । समः शत्रौ च मित्रे च तथा मानापमानयोः । भैक्ष्येण वर्तयेन्नित्यं नैकान्नादी भवेत् क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: grāmānte vṛkṣamūle vā vased devālaye 'pi vā / samaḥ śatrau ca mitre ca tathā mānāpamānayoḥ / bhaikṣyeṇa vartayennityaṃ naikānnādī bhavet kvacit
verses.translation: He is, therefore, the Supreme Lord as from him all beings originate, by attaining him one is not born again. He is the God who transcends and rules over all.
verses.hindi: ओंकार ब्रह्मरूप आपको नमस्कार है, विद्यारूप आपको नमस्कार है । मूलप्रकृतिको नमस्कार है, महेश्वरको बार-बार नमस्कार है । विज्ञानस्वरूप देहवाले (महेश्वर) - को नमस्कार है, चिन्तन (विचारशक्ति-चितिस्वरूप)
verses.wordMeaning: He is, therefore, the Supreme Lord as from him all beings originate, by attaining him one is not born again. He is the God who transcends and rules over all.
verses.commentary: Sense: He is, therefore, the Supreme Lord as from him all beings originate, by attaining him one is not born again. He is the God who transcends and rules over all.

verses.sanskrit: यस्तु मोहेन वालस्यादेकान्नादी भवेद् यतिः । न तस्य निष्कृतिः काचिद् धर्मशास्त्रेषु कथ्यते
verses.transliteration: yastu mohena vālasyādekānnādī bhaved yatiḥ / na tasya niṣkṛtiḥ kācid dharmaśāstreṣu kathyate
verses.translation: That Lord is Mahesvara, the journey unto whom is mentioned to be perpetual and auspicious, and whom they call as the greatest.
verses.hindi: आप (देबी)-को नमस्कार है। कालके भी काल आपको नमस्कार है, ईश्वरीको बार-बार नमस्कार है । रुद्रके लिये बार-बार नमस्कार है, रुद्राणी आपको बार- बार नमस्कार हैं। काम (समस्त प्रपञ्चको मोहित करनेवाले) आपको बार-बार नमस्कार है और मायाको बार-बार नमस्कार है  सभी कार्योके नियामक (महेश्वर) और क्षोभ उत्पन्न करनेवाली (सृष्टिके लिये कूटस्थ परब्रह्ममें उत्कट इच्छा जाग्रत् करनेवाली (उमा)-को
verses.wordMeaning: That Lord is Mahesvara, the journey unto whom is mentioned to be perpetual and auspicious, and whom they call as the greatest.
verses.commentary: Sense: That Lord is Mahesvara, the journey unto whom is mentioned to be perpetual and auspicious, and whom they call as the greatest.

verses.sanskrit: रागद्वेषविमुक्तात्मा समलोष्टाश्मकाञ्चनः । प्राणिहंसानिवृत्तश्च मौनी स्यात् सर्वनिस्पृहः
verses.transliteration: rāgadveṣavimuktātmā samaloṣṭāśmakāñcanaḥ / prāṇihaṃsānivṛttaśca maunī syāt sarvanispṛhaḥ
verses.translation: Whatever holy main vows and subsidiary vows of the mendicant ascetics have been mentioned, if any of these are transgressed, expiatory rites are enjoined.
verses.hindi: बारंबार नमस्कार है । प्रकृतिरूप आप (देवी)-को तथा नारायण (महेश्वर)-को नमस्कार है । योग प्रदान करनेवाली आपको नमस्कार है और योगियोंके गुरु (शंकर)- को नमस्कार है। संसारका विनाश (प्रलय) करनेवाले
verses.wordMeaning: Whatever holy main vows and subsidiary vows of the mendicant ascetics have been mentioned, if any of these are transgressed, expiatory rites are enjoined.
verses.commentary: Sense: Whatever holy main vows and subsidiary vows of the mendicant ascetics have been mentioned, if any of these are transgressed, expiatory rites are enjoined.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्टिपूतं न्यसेत् पादं वस्त्रपूतं जलं पिबेत् । सत्यपूतां वदेद् वाणीं मनः पूतं समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭipūtaṃ nyaset pādaṃ vastrapūtaṃ jalaṃ pibet / satyapūtāṃ vaded vāṇīṃ manaḥ pūtaṃ samācaret
verses.translation: After approaching a woman carnally, he should make amends as follows: He should control his mind, remain pure and perform Pranayama. He should then perform the expiatory rites called Krcchra* and Santapana.
verses.hindi: (महेश्वर)-को नमस्कार है तथा संसारकी उत्पत्ति करनेवाली (देवी)-को नमस्कार है । नित्यानन्द, विभु तथा आनन्दमूर्तिको नमस्कार है। कार्यविहीन (विकाररहित)- को नमस्कार है, विश्वप्रकृति (देवी)-को नमस्कार है। ओंकारमूर्ति तथा उसके भीतर प्रतिष्ठित रहनेवाले आपको नमस्कार हैं। आकाशमें स्थित व्योमशक्ति (ब्रह्मशक्ति देवी )-को बार-बार नमस्कार है ॥ ५२--५८ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: After approaching a woman carnally, he should make amends as follows: He should control his mind, remain pure and perform Pranayama. He should then perform the expiatory rites called Krcchra* and Santapana.
verses.commentary: Sense: After approaching a woman carnally, he should make amends as follows: He should control his mind, remain pure and perform Pranayama. He should then perform the expiatory rites called Krcchra* and Santapana.

verses.sanskrit: नैकत्र निवसेद् देशे वर्षाभ्यो ऽन्यत्र भिक्षुकः । स्नानशौचरतो नित्यं कमण्डलुकरः शुचिः
verses.transliteration: naikatra nivased deśe varṣābhyo 'nyatra bhikṣukaḥ / snānaśaucarato nityaṃ kamaṇḍalukaraḥ śuciḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter he should remain with perfect mental control and regularly perform the Krcchra (expiatory) rite according to injunctions. The mendicant should come to the hermitage again and perform his regular duties with alertness.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार पितामह ब्रह्माने इस सोमाष्टक (नामक स्तुति)-से ईशको प्रणाम किया और शतरुद्रियका पाठ करते हुए उन्होंने दण्डवत् भूमिपर गिरकर साष्टाङ्ग प्रणिपात किया। तदनन्तर प्रणतजनोंके कष्टको हरनेवाले
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter he should remain with perfect mental control and regularly perform the Krcchra (expiatory) rite according to injunctions. The mendicant should come to the hermitage again and perform his regular duties with alertness.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter he should remain with perfect mental control and regularly perform the Krcchra (expiatory) rite according to injunctions. The mendicant should come to the hermitage again and perform his regular duties with alertness.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मचर्यरतो नित्यं वनवासरतो भवेत् । मोक्षशास्त्रेषु निरतो ब्रह्मसूत्री जितेन्द्रियः
verses.transliteration: brahmacaryarato nityaṃ vanavāsarato bhavet / mokṣaśāstreṣu nirato brahmasūtrī jitendriyaḥ
verses.translation: Learned men say that a falsehood uttered for fun does not affect one adversely. Still it should not be pursued, as this is a serious incident.
verses.hindi: देव, हर, महादेवने दोनों हाथोंसे उन्हें (ब्रह्माको) उठाया और कहा-इस समय में आपके ऊपर प्रसन्न हूँ अनन्तर उन्हें (ब्रह्माको) परम योग और अतुल महान् ऐश्वर्य प्रदानकर महादेवने सम्मुख स्थित ईश्वर नीललोहित देवसे कहा--ये ब्रह्मा मेरे प्रथम पुत्र हैं, इस संसारके पूज्यके रूपमें प्रसिद्ध हैं। गुरु, ज्येष्ठ
verses.wordMeaning: Learned men say that a falsehood uttered for fun does not affect one adversely. Still it should not be pursued, as this is a serious incident.
verses.commentary: Sense: Learned men say that a falsehood uttered for fun does not affect one adversely. Still it should not be pursued, as this is a serious incident.

verses.sanskrit: दम्भाहङ्कारनिर्मुक्तो निन्दापैशुन्यवर्जितः । आत्मज्ञानगुणोपेतो यतिर्मोक्षमवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: dambhāhaṅkāranirmukto nindāpaiśunyavarjitaḥ / ātmajñānaguṇopeto yatirmokṣamavāpnuyāt
verses.translation: (If one speaks a lie even in joke) an ascetic desirous of piety should fast for one night and perform one hundred Pranayamas.
verses.hindi: एवं आपके पिता हैं, आपको इनकी रक्षा करनी चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: (If one speaks a lie even in joke) an ascetic desirous of piety should fast for one night and perform one hundred Pranayamas.
verses.commentary: Sense: (If one speaks a lie even in joke) an ascetic desirous of piety should fast for one night and perform one hundred Pranayamas.

verses.sanskrit: अभ्यसेत् सततं वेदं प्रणवाख्यं सनातनम् । स्नात्वाचम्य विधानेन शुचिर्देवालयादिषु
verses.transliteration: abhyaset satataṃ vedaṃ praṇavākhyaṃ sanātanam / snātvācamya vidhānena śucirdevālayādiṣu
verses.translation: One should not commit theft even if one loses one's interest* (?). The Smrti states that there is no other act of irreligion than theft.
verses.hindi: अयं पुराणपुरुषो न हन्तव्यस्त्वयानघ। स्वयोगैश्वर्यमाहात्म्यान्मामेव शरणं गतः अयं च यज्ञो भगवान् सगर्वो भवतानघ। शासितव्यो विरिञ्चस्य धारणीयं शिरस्त्वया
verses.wordMeaning: One should not commit theft even if one loses one's interest* (?). The Smrti states that there is no other act of irreligion than theft.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not commit theft even if one loses one's interest* (?). The Smrti states that there is no other act of irreligion than theft.

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञोपवीती शान्तात्मा कुशपाणिः समाहितः । धौतकाषायवसनो भस्मच्छन्नतनूरहः
verses.transliteration: yajñopavītī śāntātmā kuśapāṇiḥ samāhitaḥ / dhautakāṣāyavasano bhasmacchannatanūrahaḥ
verses.translation: One should not commit theft even if one loses one's interest* (?). The Smrti states that there is no other act of irreligion than theft.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्महत्यापनोदार्थ व्रतं लोकाय दर्शयन्। चरस्व सततं भिक्षां संस्थापय सुरद्विजान्
verses.wordMeaning: One should not commit theft even if one loses one's interest* (?). The Smrti states that there is no other act of irreligion than theft.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not commit theft even if one loses one's interest* (?). The Smrti states that there is no other act of irreligion than theft.

verses.sanskrit: अधियज्ञं ब्रह्म जपेदाधिदैविकमेव च । आध्यात्मिकं च सततं वेदान्ताभिहितं च यत्
verses.transliteration: adhiyajñaṃ brahma japedādhidaivikameva ca / ādhyātmikaṃ ca satataṃ vedāntābhihitaṃ ca yat
verses.translation: One should not commit theft even if one loses one's interest* (?). The Smrti states that there is no other act of irreligion than theft.
verses.hindi: इत्येतदुक्त्वा वचनं भगवान् परमेश्वरः । स्थानं स्वाभाविकं दिव्यं ययौ तत्परमं पदम् ततः स भगवानीशः कपर्दी नीललोहितः । ग्राहयामास वदनं ब्रह्मणः कालभेरवम्
verses.wordMeaning: One should not commit theft even if one loses one's interest* (?). The Smrti states that there is no other act of irreligion than theft.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not commit theft even if one loses one's interest* (?). The Smrti states that there is no other act of irreligion than theft.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रेषु वाथ निवसन् ब्रह्मचारी यतिर्मुनिः । वेदमेवाभ्यसेन्नित्यं स याति परमां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: putreṣu vātha nivasan brahmacārī yatirmuniḥ / vedamevābhyasennityaṃ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim
verses.translation: One should not commit theft even if one loses one's interest* (?). The Smrti states that there is no other act of irreligion than theft.
verses.hindi: चर त्वं पापनाशार्थं व्रतं लोकहितावहम्। कपालहस्तो भगवान् भिक्षां गृह्णातु सर्वतः
verses.wordMeaning: One should not commit theft even if one loses one's interest* (?). The Smrti states that there is no other act of irreligion than theft.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not commit theft even if one loses one's interest* (?). The Smrti states that there is no other act of irreligion than theft.

verses.sanskrit: अहिंसा सत्यमस्तेयं ब्रह्मचर्यं तपः परम् । क्षमा दया च सतोषो व्रतान्यस्य विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: ahiṃsā satyamasteyaṃ brahmacaryaṃ tapaḥ param / kṣamā dayā ca satoṣo vratānyasya viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: One should not commit theft even if one loses one's interest* (?). The Smrti states that there is no other act of irreligion than theft.
verses.hindi: उक्त्वैवं प्राहिणोत् कन्यां ब्रह्महत्यामिति श्रुताम्। दंष्टराकरालवदनां ज्चालामालाविभूषणाम् तावत् त्वं भीषणे कालमनुगच्छ त्रिलोचनम्
verses.wordMeaning: One should not commit theft even if one loses one's interest* (?). The Smrti states that there is no other act of irreligion than theft.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not commit theft even if one loses one's interest* (?). The Smrti states that there is no other act of irreligion than theft.

verses.sanskrit: वेदान्तज्ञाननिष्ठो वा पञ्च यज्ञान् समाहितः । कुर्यादहरहः स्नात्वा भिक्षान्नेनैव तेन हि
verses.transliteration: vedāntajñānaniṣṭho vā pañca yajñān samāhitaḥ / kuryādaharahaḥ snātvā bhikṣānnenaiva tena hi
verses.translation: One should not commit theft even if one loses one's interest* (?). The Smrti states that there is no other act of irreligion than theft.
verses.hindi: एवमाभाष्य कालाग्निं प्राह देवो महेश्वरः । अटस्व निखिलं लोकं भिक्षार्थी मन्नियोगतः
verses.wordMeaning: One should not commit theft even if one loses one's interest* (?). The Smrti states that there is no other act of irreligion than theft.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not commit theft even if one loses one's interest* (?). The Smrti states that there is no other act of irreligion than theft.

verses.sanskrit: होममन्त्राञ्जपेन्नित्यं काले काले समाहितः । स्वाध्यायं चान्वहं कुर्यात् सावित्रीं संध्ययोर्जपेत्
verses.transliteration: homamantrāñjapennityaṃ kāle kāle samāhitaḥ / svādhyāyaṃ cānvahaṃ kuryāt sāvitrīṃ saṃdhyayorjapet
verses.translation: One should not commit theft even if one loses one's interest* (?). The Smrti states that there is no other act of irreligion than theft.
verses.hindi: यदा द्रक्ष्यसि देवेशं नारायणमनामयम्। तदासौ वक्ष्यति स्पष्टमुपायं पापशोधनम् स देवदेवतावाक्यमाकर्ण्य भगवान् हरः। कपालपाणिर्विश्वात्मा चचार भुवनत्रयम्
verses.wordMeaning: One should not commit theft even if one loses one's interest* (?). The Smrti states that there is no other act of irreligion than theft.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not commit theft even if one loses one's interest* (?). The Smrti states that there is no other act of irreligion than theft.

verses.sanskrit: ध्यायीत सततं देवमेकान्ते परमेश्वरम् । एकान्नं वर्जयेन्नित्यं कामं क्रोधं परिग्रहम्
verses.transliteration: dhyāyīta satataṃ devamekānte parameśvaram / ekānnaṃ varjayennityaṃ kāmaṃ krodhaṃ parigraham
verses.translation: One should not commit theft even if one loses one's interest* (?). The Smrti states that there is no other act of irreligion than theft.
verses.hindi: कोटिसूर्यप्रतीकाशैः प्रमधैश्चातिगर्वितैः । भाति कालाग्निनयनो महादेवः समावृत्तः
verses.wordMeaning: One should not commit theft even if one loses one's interest* (?). The Smrti states that there is no other act of irreligion than theft.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not commit theft even if one loses one's interest* (?). The Smrti states that there is no other act of irreligion than theft.

verses.sanskrit: एकवासा द्विवासा वा शिखी यज्ञोपवीतवान् । कमण्डलुकरो विद्वान् त्रिदण्डी याति तत्परम्
verses.transliteration: ekavāsā dvivāsā vā śikhī yajñopavītavān / kamaṇḍalukaro vidvān tridaṇḍī yāti tatparam
verses.translation: One should not commit theft even if one loses one's interest* (?). The Smrti states that there is no other act of irreligion than theft.
verses.hindi: 'लीलाविलासबहुलो लोकानागच्छतीश्वरः अनघ! आपको इन पुराणपुरुषकी हत्या नहीं करनी चाहिए। ये अपने योगैश्वर्यके माहात्म्यसे मेरी ही शरणमें आये हैं। पुनः महेश्वरने नीललोहित रुद्रको सम्बोधित करते हुए नारायणके अंशसे उत्पन्न यज्ञभगवानूके
verses.wordMeaning: One should not commit theft even if one loses one's interest* (?). The Smrti states that there is no other act of irreligion than theft.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should not commit theft even if one loses one's interest* (?). The Smrti states that there is no other act of irreligion than theft.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे ऽष्टाविंशो ऽध्यायः व्यास उवाच एवं स्वाश्रमनिष्ठानां यतीनां नियतात्मनाम् । भैक्षेण वर्तनं प्रोक्तं फलमूलैरथापि वा
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge 'ṣṭāviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ vyāsa uvāca evaṃ svāśramaniṣṭhānāṃ yatīnāṃ niyatātmanām / bhaikṣeṇa vartanaṃ proktaṃ phalamūlairathāpi vā
verses.translation: It is spoken of as another kind of violence. It deprives one of the knowledge of the self. What is called wealth is the externally wandering life of man.
verses.hindi: मोहग्रस्त देखकर सगर्व हो गये हैं, इनका शासन करें तथा ब्रह्माके (कटे हुए) सिरको धारण करें और आप संसारको यह दिखाते हुए भिक्षाचरणपूर्वक भ्रमण करें कि मैं ब्रह्महत्याके निवारणके लिये व्रत कर रहा हूँ।
verses.wordMeaning: It is spoken of as another kind of violence. It deprives one of the knowledge of the self. What is called wealth is the externally wandering life of man.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is spoken of as another kind of violence. It deprives one of the knowledge of the self. What is called wealth is the externally wandering life of man.

verses.sanskrit: एककालं चरेद् भैक्षं न प्रसज्येत विस्तरे । भैक्षे प्रसक्तो हि यतिर्विषयेष्वपि सज्जति
verses.transliteration: ekakālaṃ cared bhaikṣaṃ na prasajyeta vistare / bhaikṣe prasakto hi yatirviṣayeṣvapi sajjati
verses.translation: He who deprives a man of his wealth, deprives him of his life. If one commits it, that extremely wicked person, fallen from his pious way of life, gets his sacred vow violated. (Repenting again if) he feels despondent, he should perform Candrayana vow.
verses.hindi: आप देवताओं एवं ब्राह्मणोंको (अर्थात् उनकी मर्यादाको) संस्थापित करें॥ ६३--६५॥ ऐसा वचन कहकर भगवान् परमेश्वर अपने परम पदरूप स्वाभाविक दिव्य स्थानको चले गये। तदनन्तर जटाधारी नीललोहित उन भगवान् ईश (रुद्र) -ने ब्रह्माका मुख कालभैरवको ग्रहण कराया (तथा कहा--) पापको
verses.wordMeaning: He who deprives a man of his wealth, deprives him of his life. If one commits it, that extremely wicked person, fallen from his pious way of life, gets his sacred vow violated. (Repenting again if) he feels despondent, he should perform Candrayana vow.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who deprives a man of his wealth, deprives him of his life. If one commits it, that extremely wicked person, fallen from his pious way of life, gets his sacred vow violated. (Repenting again if) he feels despondent, he should perform Candrayana vow.

verses.sanskrit: सप्तागारं चरेद् भैक्षमलाभात् तु पुनश्चरेत् । प्रक्षाल्य पात्रे भुञ्जीयादद्भिः प्रक्षालयेत् तु तत्
verses.transliteration: saptāgāraṃ cared bhaikṣamalābhāt tu punaścaret / prakṣālya pātre bhuñjīyādadbhiḥ prakṣālayet tu tat
verses.translation: Sruti says that he should perform (the Candrayana rite) for a year in accordance with the injunctions in the scriptures. If the mendicant ascetic should repent again, he should perform his vow alertfully.
verses.hindi: नष्ट करनेके लिये आप लोककल्याणकारी व्रतका पालन करें और कपाल हाथमें धारणकर आप भगवान् सर्वत्र जाये तथा भिक्षा ग्रहण करें। ऐसा कहकर उन्होंने भयंकर दाढ़ और मुखवाली ज्चालासमूहको ही आभूषण-
verses.wordMeaning: Sruti says that he should perform (the Candrayana rite) for a year in accordance with the injunctions in the scriptures. If the mendicant ascetic should repent again, he should perform his vow alertfully.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sruti says that he should perform (the Candrayana rite) for a year in accordance with the injunctions in the scriptures. If the mendicant ascetic should repent again, he should perform his vow alertfully.

verses.sanskrit: अथवान्यदुपादाय पात्रे भुञ्जीत नित्यशः । भुक्त्वा तत् संत्यजेत् पात्रं यात्रामात्रमलोलुपः
verses.transliteration: athavānyadupādāya pātre bhuñjīta nityaśaḥ / bhuktvā tat saṃtyajet pātraṃ yātrāmātramalolupaḥ
verses.translation: If the mendicant ascetic commits violence acciden¬ tally he should perform the expiatory rite of Krcchratikrcchra or Candrayana.
verses.hindi: रूपमें धारण करनेवाली ब्रह्महत्या नामसे प्रसिद्ध कन्याको भी यह कहकर भेजा-हे भीषण आकारवाली! ये कालभैरव त्रिलोचन जबतक दिव्य वाराणसीपुरीमें पहुँचें, तबतक तुम इनके पीछे-पीछे जाओ॥ ६६--७०॥ ऐसा कहनेके बाद महेश्वरदेवने कालाग्नि (भैरव)- से कहा- मेरे निर्देशानुसार आप भिक्षा मागते हुए सम्पूर्ण लोकमें भ्रमण करें। जब आप देवेश अनामय नारायणका दर्शन करेंगे, तब वे (श्रीनारायण) पापकी शुद्धिका स्पष्ट
verses.wordMeaning: If the mendicant ascetic commits violence acciden¬ tally he should perform the expiatory rite of Krcchratikrcchra or Candrayana.
verses.commentary: Sense: If the mendicant ascetic commits violence acciden¬ tally he should perform the expiatory rite of Krcchratikrcchra or Candrayana.

verses.sanskrit: विधूमे सन्नमुसले व्यङ्गारे भुक्तवज्जने । वृत्ते शरावसंपाते भिक्षां नित्यं यतिश्चरेत्
verses.transliteration: vidhūme sannamusale vyaṅgāre bhuktavajjane / vṛtte śarāvasaṃpāte bhikṣāṃ nityaṃ yatiścaret
verses.translation: If, on seeing a woman, an ascetic involuntarily discharges his semen virile due to his weakness, he should perform sixteen Pranayamas.
verses.hindi: उपाय (आपको) बतायेंगे
verses.wordMeaning: If, on seeing a woman, an ascetic involuntarily discharges his semen virile due to his weakness, he should perform sixteen Pranayamas.
verses.commentary: Sense: If, on seeing a woman, an ascetic involuntarily discharges his semen virile due to his weakness, he should perform sixteen Pranayamas.

verses.sanskrit: गोदोहमात्रं तिष्ठेत कालं भिक्षुरधोमुखः । भिक्षेत्युक्त्वा सकृत् तूष्णीमश्नीयाद् वाग्यतः शुचिः
verses.transliteration: godohamātraṃ tiṣṭheta kālaṃ bhikṣuradhomukhaḥ / bhikṣetyuktvā sakṛt tūṣṇīmaśnīyād vāgyataḥ śuciḥ
verses.translation: If the involuntary emission of the semen takes place during the day time, he should perform hundred Pranayamas every day for three days. If one takes to wine and flesh in secret, or takes salt openly during Navasraddha (first Sraddha after a person's death) Prdjapatya vow is the expiatory rite.
verses.hindi: देवाधिदेवका वाक्य सुनकर कपालपाणि वे विश्वात्मा भगवान् हर (कालभैरव) तीनों लोकोंमें भ्रमण करने लगे। विकृत वेष बनाकर अपने तेजसे प्रकाशित, श्रीसम्पन्न, अत्यन्त पवित्र, जटाजूटसे सुशोभित, करोड़ों सूर्योके समान प्रकाशमान, अत्यन्त गर्वित प्रमथगणोंसे आवृत, कालाग्निके समान नेत्रवाले महादेव (कालभैरव)
verses.wordMeaning: If the involuntary emission of the semen takes place during the day time, he should perform hundred Pranayamas every day for three days. If one takes to wine and flesh in secret,…
verses.commentary: Sense: If the involuntary emission of the semen takes place during the day time, he should perform hundred Pranayamas every day for three days. If one takes to wine and flesh in secret,…

verses.sanskrit: प्रक्षाल्य पाणिपादौ च समाचम्य यथाविधि । आदित्ये दर्शयित्वान्नं भुञ्जीत प्राङ्मुखोत्तरः
verses.transliteration: prakṣālya pāṇipādau ca samācamya yathāvidhi / āditye darśayitvānnaṃ bhuñjīta prāṅmukhottaraḥ
verses.translation: All the sins of a person engaged always in meditation perish. Hence, one should be engrossed in meditation on Mahesvara after realising him.
verses.hindi: परमेष्ठीके उस दिव्य अमृतस्वरूप आनन्दका पान- कर अतिशय लीला-विलास करनेवाले ईश्वर लोगोंके पास आये
verses.wordMeaning: All the sins of a person engaged always in meditation perish. Hence, one should be engrossed in meditation on Mahesvara after realising him.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the sins of a person engaged always in meditation perish. Hence, one should be engrossed in meditation on Mahesvara after realising him.

verses.sanskrit: हुत्वा प्राणाहुतीः पञ्च ग्रासानष्टौ समाहितः । आचम्य देवं ब्रह्माणं ध्यायीत परमेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: hutvā prāṇāhutīḥ pañca grāsānaṣṭau samāhitaḥ / ācamya devaṃ brahmāṇaṃ dhyāyīta parameśvaram
verses.translation: That which is the greatest Brahman, the brilliantmost light, the imperishable and unchanging support of all and is immanent in everything, should be known as Mahesvara.
verses.hindi: तं दृष्टा कालवदनं शंकरं कालभैरवम्। रूपलावण्यसम्पन्नं नारीकुलमगादनु स देवदानवादीनां देशानभ्येत्य शूलधृक् । जगाम विष्णोर्भवनं यत्रास्ते मधुसूदन:
verses.wordMeaning: That which is the greatest Brahman, the brilliantmost light, the imperishable and unchanging support of all and is immanent in everything, should be known as Mahesvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: That which is the greatest Brahman, the brilliantmost light, the imperishable and unchanging support of all and is immanent in everything, should be known as Mahesvara.

verses.sanskrit: अलाबुं दारुपात्रं च मृण्मयं वैणवं ततः । चत्वारि यतिपात्राणि मनुराह प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: alābuṃ dārupātraṃ ca mṛṇmayaṃ vaiṇavaṃ tataḥ / catvāri yatipātrāṇi manurāha prajāpatiḥ
verses.translation: This lord Mahadeva is the pure and the greatest ■iva. He alone is the non-dualistic imperishable deity within the orb of the sun.
verses.hindi: निरीक्ष्य दिव्यभवनं शंकरो लोकशंकरः । सहेव भूतप्रवरैः प्ररवष्टुमुपचक्रमे
verses.wordMeaning: This lord Mahadeva is the pure and the greatest ■iva. He alone is the non-dualistic imperishable deity within the orb of the sun.
verses.commentary: Sense: This lord Mahadeva is the pure and the greatest ■iva. He alone is the non-dualistic imperishable deity within the orb of the sun.

verses.sanskrit: प्राग्रात्रे पररात्रे च मध्यरात्रे तथैव च । संध्यास्वह्नि विशेषेण चिन्तयेन्नित्यमीश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: prāgrātre pararātre ca madhyarātre tathaiva ca / saṃdhyāsvahni viśeṣeṇa cintayennityamīśvaram
verses.translation: * (Defective verse) Since the lord is very great and is
verses.hindi: विष्वक्सेन इति ख्यातो विष्णोरंशसमुद्भवः अथैनं शंकरगणो युयुधे विष्णुसम्भवम्। भीषणो भेरवादेशात् कालवेग इति श्रुतः
verses.wordMeaning: * (Defective verse) Since the lord is very great and is
verses.commentary: Sense: * (Defective verse) Since the lord is very great and is

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा हृत्पद्मनिलये विश्वाख्यं विश्वसंभवम् । आत्मानं सर्वभूतानां परस्तात् तमसः स्थितम्
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā hṛtpadmanilaye viśvākhyaṃ viśvasaṃbhavam / ātmānaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ parastāt tamasaḥ sthitam
verses.translation: He who does not see any other lord than Mahadeva, he who realises him as the Atman, attains the greatest region.
verses.hindi: विजित्य तं कालवेगं क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनः । रुद्रायाभिमुखं रौद्रं चिक्षेप च सुदर्शनम्
verses.wordMeaning: He who does not see any other lord than Mahadeva, he who realises him as the Atman, attains the greatest region.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who does not see any other lord than Mahadeva, he who realises him as the Atman, attains the greatest region.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वस्याधारभूतानामानन्दं ज्योतिरव्ययम् । प्रधानपुरुषातीतमाकाशं दहनं शिवम्
verses.transliteration: sarvasyādhārabhūtānāmānandaṃ jyotiravyayam / pradhānapuruṣātītamākāśaṃ dahanaṃ śivam
verses.translation: Those who consider their own Atman different from Paramesvara do not realise tne lord. Their effort is futile.
verses.hindi: अथ देवो महादेवस्त्रिपुरारिस्त्रिशूलभृत्। तमापतन्तं सावज्ञमालोकयदमित्रजित् निहत्य विष्णुपुरुषं सार्ध प्रमथपुंगवैः । विवेश चान्तरगृहं समादाय कलेवरम्
verses.wordMeaning: Those who consider their own Atman different from Paramesvara do not realise tne lord. Their effort is futile.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who consider their own Atman different from Paramesvara do not realise tne lord. Their effort is futile.

verses.sanskrit: तदन्तः सर्वभावानामीश्वरं ब्रह्मरूपिणम् । ध्यायेदनादिमद्वैतमानन्दादिगुणालयम्
verses.transliteration: tadantaḥ sarvabhāvānāmīśvaraṃ brahmarūpiṇam / dhyāyedanādimadvaitamānandādiguṇālayam
verses.translation: The only Brahman is the supreme Brahman. That should be known as the unchanging principle. That lord is Mahadeva. By not realising this, one is fettered.
verses.hindi: निरीक्ष्य जगतो हेतुमीश्वरं भगवान् हरिः। शिरो ललाटात् सम्भिद्य रक्तधारामपातयत्
verses.wordMeaning: The only Brahman is the supreme Brahman. That should be known as the unchanging principle. That lord is Mahadeva. By not realising this, one is fettered.
verses.commentary: Sense: The only Brahman is the supreme Brahman. That should be known as the unchanging principle. That lord is Mahadeva. By not realising this, one is fettered.

verses.sanskrit: महान्तं परमं ब्रह्म पुरुषं सत्यमव्ययम् । सितेतरारुणाकारं महेशं विश्वरूपिणम्
verses.transliteration: mahāntaṃ paramaṃ brahma puruṣaṃ satyamavyayam / sitetarāruṇākāraṃ maheśaṃ viśvarūpiṇam
verses.translation: Hence, an ascetic of controlled mind should worship invariably. He should be quiescent, devoted to Mahadeva and ■engaged in the path of knowledge.
verses.hindi: अस्तु, उन कालात्मा महेश्वरके प्रमुख गण कालभैरव शंकरको रूप एवं लावण्यसे सम्पन्न देखकर नारी- समूह उनके पीछे चलने लगा। वे स्त्रियाँ प्रभुके सामने विविध प्रकारके गीत गाने लगीं और नृत्य करने लगीं तथा मन्द मुसकानके साथ उनके मुखको देखकर भौंहोंसे हाव-भाव प्रदर्शित करने लगी
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, an ascetic of controlled mind should worship invariably. He should be quiescent, devoted to Mahadeva and ■engaged in the path of knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, an ascetic of controlled mind should worship invariably. He should be quiescent, devoted to Mahadeva and ■engaged in the path of knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: ओङ्कारान्ते ऽथ चात्मानं संस्थाप्य परमात्मनि । आकाशे देवमीशानं ध्यायीताकाशमध्यगम्
verses.transliteration: oṅkārānte 'tha cātmānaṃ saṃsthāpya paramātmani / ākāśe devamīśānaṃ dhyāyītākāśamadhyagam
verses.translation: O Brahmanas, thus the auspicious stage of life of the ascetics has been detailed to you. This has been formerly expounded to the sages by lord Pitamaha (god Brahma).
verses.hindi: वे शूलधारी कालभेरव देवों तथा दानवों आदिके देशोंमें जानेके अनन्तर विष्णुके भवनमें गये, जहाँ मधुसूदन निवास करते हैं। उस दिव्य भवनको देखकर लोकोंके कल्याणकारी शंकर (कालभैरव) श्रेष्ठ भूतोंके
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas, thus the auspicious stage of life of the ascetics has been detailed to you. This has been formerly expounded to the sages by lord Pitamaha (god Brahma).
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas, thus the auspicious stage of life of the ascetics has been detailed to you. This has been formerly expounded to the sages by lord Pitamaha (god Brahma).

verses.sanskrit: कारणं सर्वभावानामानन्दैकसमाश्रयम् । पुराणं पुरुषं शंभुं ध्यायन् मुच्येत बन्धनात्
verses.transliteration: kāraṇaṃ sarvabhāvānāmānandaikasamāśrayam / purāṇaṃ puruṣaṃ śaṃbhuṃ dhyāyan mucyeta bandhanāt
verses.translation: This excellent knowledge, the auspicious thing based •on the duties of the ascetics, imparted by the self-bom deity, shall not be given to anyone else except to sons, disciples and Yogins.
verses.hindi: साथ ही उसमें प्रवेश करने लगे उन (कालभेरव)-के दिव्य परम पारमेश्वर भावको न समझते हुए शंख, चक्र तथा गदा हाथोंमें लिये हुए, पीत वस्त्र धारण किये, महान् भुजावाले, विष्णुके अंशसे उत्पन्न विष्वक्सेन नामसे प्रसिद्ध महाबलवान्
verses.wordMeaning: This excellent knowledge, the auspicious thing based •on the duties of the ascetics, imparted by the self-bom deity, shall not be given to anyone else except to sons, disciples and Yogins.
verses.commentary: Sense: This excellent knowledge, the auspicious thing based •on the duties of the ascetics, imparted by the self-bom deity, shall not be given to anyone else except to sons, disciples and Yogins.

verses.sanskrit: यद्वा गुहायां प्रकृतौ जगत्संमोहनालये । विचिन्त्य परमं व्योम सर्वभूतैककारणम्
verses.transliteration: yadvā guhāyāṃ prakṛtau jagatsaṃmohanālaye / vicintya paramaṃ vyoma sarvabhūtaikakāraṇam
verses.translation: Thus the rules governing the rites of the ascetics have been described. It shall be the sole cause of the propitiation of Pasupati. Those who practise this every day with concentration ■of the mind are not reborn nor shall they face destruction.
verses.hindi: द्वारपालने त्रिशूलधारी उन कालभैरवको रोका। तब भेरवकी आज्ञासे कालवेग इस नामसे प्रसिद्ध शंकरका भयंकर गण विष्णु-समुद्धूत (विष्वक्सेन)-से युद्ध करने लगा। उस कालवेगको जीतकर क्रोधसे लाल
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the rules governing the rites of the ascetics have been described. It shall be the sole cause of the propitiation of Pasupati. Those who practise this every day with concentration ■of the mind are not reborn nor shall they face destruction.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the rules governing the rites of the ascetics have been described. It shall be the sole cause of the propitiation of Pasupati. Those who practise this every day with concentration ■of the mind are not reborn nor shall they face destruction.

verses.sanskrit: जीवनं सर्वभूतानां यत्र लोकः प्रलीयते । आनन्दं ब्रह्मणः सूक्ष्मं यत् पश्यन्ति मुमुक्षवः
verses.transliteration: jīvanaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ yatra lokaḥ pralīyate / ānandaṃ brahmaṇaḥ sūkṣmaṃ yat paśyanti mumukṣavaḥ
verses.translation: VV. 9-11 state the conditions under which even an innocent man is treated as 'falllen'.
verses.hindi: हुए नेत्रोंवाला (द्वारपाल) रुद्र (कालभैरव)-की ओर भयंकर सुदर्शनचक्र फेंका। तब त्रिशूलधारी शत्रुजित् त्रिपुरारिदेव महादेव (कालभैरव)-ने उस आते हुए चक्रको अवज्ञापूर्वक देखा॥ ८१--८५॥ उसी समय महादेव (कालभेरव) -ने त्रिशूलके द्वारा प्रलयकालीन अग्रिके तुल्य अति भीषण विष्वक्सेनके वक्ष:स्थलमें प्रहारकर उसे पृथ्वीपर गिरा दिया। त्रिशूलसे आहत होनेपर अपने महान् बलका त्यागकर उस
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 9-11 state the conditions under which even an innocent man is treated as 'falllen'.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 9-11 state the conditions under which even an innocent man is treated as 'falllen'.

verses.sanskrit: तन्मध्ये निहितं ब्रह्म केवलं ज्ञानलक्षणम् । अनन्तं सत्यमीशानं विचिन्त्यासीत संयतः
verses.transliteration: tanmadhye nihitaṃ brahma kevalaṃ jñānalakṣaṇam / anantaṃ satyamīśānaṃ vicintyāsīta saṃyataḥ
verses.translation: Slaying of a Brahmana was regarded as a serious sin ( mahd-papa). VV. 12-26 describe different atonements for this great sin.
verses.hindi: विष्वक्सेनने अपने प्राणोंका उसी प्रकार परित्याग कर दिया, जैसे व्याधिसे आहत प्राणी मृत्युको देखकर अपने प्राणोंका परित्याग कर देता है
verses.wordMeaning: Slaying of a Brahmana was regarded as a serious sin ( mahd-papa). VV. 12-26 describe different atonements for this great sin.
verses.commentary: Sense: Slaying of a Brahmana was regarded as a serious sin ( mahd-papa). VV. 12-26 describe different atonements for this great sin.

verses.sanskrit: गुह्याद् गुह्यतमं ज्ञानं यतीनामेतदीरितम् । यो ऽनुतिष्ठेन्महेशेन सो ऽश्नुते योगमैश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: guhyād guhyatamaṃ jñānaṃ yatīnāmetadīritam / yo 'nutiṣṭhenmaheśena so 'śnute yogamaiśvaram
verses.translation: No Brahmana should ever remain (anywhere) without performing the expiatory rite. He should perform what quiescent, scholarly Brahmanas advise.
verses.hindi: विष्णुके पुरुष (विष्वक्सेन)-को मारकर (उसके) कलेवर (मृत शरीर)-को लेकर श्रेष्ठ प्रमथगणोंके साथ महादेव (कालभेरव) भवनके अंदर प्रविष्ट हुए। जगत्के कारणरूप ईश्वर (कालभेरव)-को देखकर भगवान् हरिने अपने ललाटका भेदनकर रक्तकी धारा गिरायी और कहा- अपरिमेय तेजरूप भगवन्! आप मेरी भिक्षा ग्रहण करें। त्रिपुरमर्दन! आपके लिये कोई अप्रकट (अमङ्गलजनक भिक्षा) नहीं है
verses.wordMeaning: No Brahmana should ever remain (anywhere) without performing the expiatory rite. He should perform what quiescent, scholarly Brahmanas advise.
verses.commentary: Sense: No Brahmana should ever remain (anywhere) without performing the expiatory rite. He should perform what quiescent, scholarly Brahmanas advise.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद् ध्यानरतो नित्यमात्मविद्यापरायणः । ज्ञानं समभ्यसेद् ब्राह्मं येन मुच्येत बन्धनात्
verses.transliteration: tasmād dhyānarato nityamātmavidyāparāyaṇaḥ / jñānaṃ samabhyased brāhmaṃ yena mucyeta bandhanāt
verses.translation: What a quiescent Brahmana, who is the most excel¬ lent among the knowers of the meanings of the Vedas, who loves dharma (virtue) and who maintains (sacrificial) fires, does, shall be the greatest virtue even if it be that he alone performs it.
verses.hindi: न सम्पूर्ण कपालं तद् ब्रह्मणः परमेष्ठिनः ।
verses.wordMeaning: What a quiescent Brahmana, who is the most excel¬ lent among the knowers of the meanings of the Vedas, who loves dharma (virtue) and who maintains (sacrificial) fires, does, shall be the greatest virtue even if it be that he alone performs it.
verses.commentary: Sense: What a quiescent Brahmana, who is the most excel¬ lent among the knowers of the meanings of the Vedas, who loves dharma (virtue) and who maintains (sacrificial) fires, does, shall be the greatest virtue even if it be that he alone performs it.

verses.sanskrit: मत्वा पृथक् स्वमात्मानं सर्वस्मादेव केवलम् । आनन्दमजरं ज्ञानं ध्यायीत च पुनः परम्
verses.transliteration: matvā pṛthak svamātmānaṃ sarvasmādeva kevalam / ānandamajaraṃ jñānaṃ dhyāyīta ca punaḥ param
verses.translation: If there are three Brahmanas who though they do not maintain sacrificial fire are but past-masters of Vedic inter¬ pretation and love Dharma, what they say should be ragarded as means of Dharma.
verses.hindi: अथाब्रवीत् कालरुद्रं हरिर्नारायणः प्रभुः । संस्तूय वैदिकैर्मन्त्रैर्बहुमानपुरःसरम् किमर्थमेतद् वदनं ब्रह्मणो भवता धृतम्। प्रोवाच वृत्तमखिलं भगवान् परमेश्वरः
verses.wordMeaning: If there are three Brahmanas who though they do not maintain sacrificial fire are but past-masters of Vedic inter¬ pretation and love Dharma, what they say should be ragarded as means of Dharma.
verses.commentary: Sense: If there are three Brahmanas who though they do not maintain sacrificial fire are but past-masters of Vedic inter¬ pretation and love Dharma, what they say should be ragarded as means of Dharma.

verses.sanskrit: यस्मात् भवन्ति भूतानि यद् गत्वा नेह जायते । स तस्मादीश्वरो देवः परस्माद् यो ऽधितिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: yasmāt bhavanti bhūtāni yad gatvā neha jāyate / sa tasmādīśvaro devaḥ parasmād yo 'dhitiṣṭhati
verses.translation: If there be twenty-one Brahmanas who know the truth about the knowledge of MImaihsa and are experts in Vedanta, can lay down the expiatory rite.
verses.hindi: समाहूय हृषीकेशो ब्रह्महत्यामथाच्युतः । प्रार्थयामास देवेशो विमुञ्चेति त्रिशूलिनम्
verses.wordMeaning: If there be twenty-one Brahmanas who know the truth about the knowledge of MImaihsa and are experts in Vedanta, can lay down the expiatory rite.
verses.commentary: Sense: If there be twenty-one Brahmanas who know the truth about the knowledge of MImaihsa and are experts in Vedanta, can lay down the expiatory rite.

verses.sanskrit: यदन्तरे तद् गगनं शाश्वतं शिवमव्ययम् । यदंशस्तत्परो यस्तु स देवः स्यान्महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: yadantare tad gaganaṃ śāśvataṃ śivamavyayam / yadaṃśastatparo yastu sa devaḥ syānmaheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: He who associates with the fallen sinners for one year by sharing their vehicles, beds and seats, with full knowledge thereof, shall also become fallen
verses.hindi: चिरं ध्यात्वा जगद्योनिः शंकरं प्राह सर्ववित् जगाम लीलया देवो लोकानां हितकाम्यया
verses.wordMeaning: He who associates with the fallen sinners for one year by sharing their vehicles, beds and seats, with full knowledge thereof, shall also become fallen
verses.commentary: Sense: He who associates with the fallen sinners for one year by sharing their vehicles, beds and seats, with full knowledge thereof, shall also become fallen

verses.sanskrit: व्रतानि यानि भिक्षूणां तथैवोपव्रतानि च । एकैकातिक्रमे तेषां प्रायश्चित्तं विधीयते
verses.transliteration: vratāni yāni bhikṣūṇāṃ tathaivopavratāni ca / ekaikātikrame teṣāṃ prāyaścittaṃ vidhīyate
verses.translation: A Brahmana who officiates as a priest contracts a marriage with the fallen out-caste and teaches them Veda or dines with them, instantly becomes fallen.
verses.hindi: तमभ्यधावद् भगवान् हरिर्नारायणः स्वयम्। अथास्थायापरं रूपं नृत्यदर्शनलालसः
verses.wordMeaning: A Brahmana who officiates as a priest contracts a marriage with the fallen out-caste and teaches them Veda or dines with them, instantly becomes fallen.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmana who officiates as a priest contracts a marriage with the fallen out-caste and teaches them Veda or dines with them, instantly becomes fallen.

verses.sanskrit: उपेत्य च स्त्रियं कामात् प्रायश्चित्तं समाहितः । प्राणायामसमायुक्तं कुर्यात् सांतपनं शुचिः
verses.transliteration: upetya ca striyaṃ kāmāt prāyaścittaṃ samāhitaḥ / prāṇāyāmasamāyuktaṃ kuryāt sāṃtapanaṃ śuciḥ
verses.translation: The Brahmana who teaches them out of delusion or not knowing (their sins) or learns alongwith them shall become fallen in the course of a year.
verses.hindi: अथ सानुचरो रुद्रः सहरिर्धर्मवाहनः। भेजे महादेवपुरीं वाराणसीमिति श्रुताम् प्रविष्टमात्रे देवेशे ब्रह्महत्या कपर्दिनि। हाहेत्युक्त्वा सनादं सा पातालं प्राप दुःखिता
verses.wordMeaning: The Brahmana who teaches them out of delusion or not knowing (their sins) or learns alongwith them shall become fallen in the course of a year.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Brahmana who teaches them out of delusion or not knowing (their sins) or learns alongwith them shall become fallen in the course of a year.

verses.sanskrit: ततश्चरेत नियमात् कृच्छ्रं संयतमानसः । पुनराश्रममागम्य चरेद् भिश्रुरतन्द्रितः
verses.transliteration: tataścareta niyamāt kṛcchraṃ saṃyatamānasaḥ / punarāśramamāgamya cared bhiśruratandritaḥ
verses.translation: The slayer of a Brahmana should construct a hut in the forest and live therein for twelve years. For self-purifi¬ cation, he should beg alms with the skull of the dead as a symbol on the flag.
verses.hindi: हजारों दिव्य वर्षातक वह (रक्तकी) धारा प्रवाहित होती रही, किंतु परमेष्ठी ब्रह्माका वह (कालभेरवके हाथमें विद्यमान) कपाल भरा नहीं। तब नारायण
verses.wordMeaning: The slayer of a Brahmana should construct a hut in the forest and live therein for twelve years. For self-purifi¬ cation, he should beg alms with the skull of the dead as a symbol on the flag.
verses.commentary: Sense: The slayer of a Brahmana should construct a hut in the forest and live therein for twelve years. For self-purifi¬ cation, he should beg alms with the skull of the dead as a symbol on the flag.

verses.sanskrit: न धर्मयुक्तमनृतं हिनस्तीति मनीषिणः । तथापि च न कर्तव्यं प्रसङ्गो ह्येष दारुणः
verses.transliteration: na dharmayuktamanṛtaṃ hinastīti manīṣiṇaḥ / tathāpi ca na kartavyaṃ prasaṅgo hyeṣa dāruṇaḥ
verses.translation: He should avoid the abodes of the Brahmanas and the shrines of deities. He should remember that Brahmana constantly and censure himself.
verses.hindi: स्तुति कर भगवान् कालरुद्रसे कहा- आपने ब्रह्माका यह सिर किस कारणसे धारण कर रखा है? तब परमेश्वर भगवान् (कालभेरव)-ने सम्पूर्ण वृत्तान्त तदनन्तर हृषीकेश देवेश भगवान् अच्युतने ब्रह्महत्याको बुलाकर प्रार्थना की--त्रिशूली (कालभेरव)-को छोड़ दो। मुरारि विष्णुद्वारा प्रार्थना करनेपर भी उसने (कालभेरवके) पार्थका त्याग नहीं किया। तब जगद्योनि सर्वज्ञ (विष्णु)-
verses.wordMeaning: He should avoid the abodes of the Brahmanas and the shrines of deities. He should remember that Brahmana constantly and censure himself.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should avoid the abodes of the Brahmanas and the shrines of deities. He should remember that Brahmana constantly and censure himself.

verses.sanskrit: एकरात्रोपवासश्च प्राणायामशतं तथा । उक्त्वानृतं प्रकर्तव्यं यतिना धर्मलिप्सुना
verses.transliteration: ekarātropavāsaśca prāṇāyāmaśataṃ tathā / uktvānṛtaṃ prakartavyaṃ yatinā dharmalipsunā
verses.translation: He should quietly and slowly enter seven houses (for begging) the worthiness of which was not (previously) con¬ sidered and which are free from smoke and fire (extinguished) and inmates whereof have taken their meals.
verses.hindi: ने देरतक ध्यानकर शंकर (कालभैरव)-से कहा- भगवन्! आप दिव्य एवं मङ्गल करनेवाली वाराणसीपुरी जायें, जहाँ ईश्वर सम्पूर्ण सांसारिक दोषोंको शीघ्र ही नष्ट कर देते हैँ
verses.wordMeaning: He should quietly and slowly enter seven houses (for begging) the worthiness of which was not (previously) con¬ sidered and which are free from smoke and fire (extinguished) and inmates whereof have taken their meals.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should quietly and slowly enter seven houses (for begging) the worthiness of which was not (previously) con¬ sidered and which are free from smoke and fire (extinguished) and inmates whereof have taken their meals.

verses.sanskrit: परमापद्गतेनापि न कार्यं स्तेयमन्यतः । स्तेयादभ्यधिकः कश्चिन्नास्त्यधर्म इति स्मृतिः । हिंसा चैषापरा दिष्टा या चात्मज्ञाननाशिका
verses.transliteration: paramāpadgatenāpi na kāryaṃ steyamanyataḥ / steyādabhyadhikaḥ kaścinnāstyadharma iti smṛtiḥ / hiṃsā caiṣāparā diṣṭā yā cātmajñānanāśikā
verses.translation: He should beg for alms only once. He should pro¬ claim his sin to all men. Or he should maintain himself with fruits and roots obtained from the forest and subsist on them.
verses.hindi: तब वे महायोगी कालभेरव अपने हाथमें (विष्णु- पार्षद विष्वक्सेनका) कलेवर लेकर वाराणसीपुरीके दर्शनकी प्रसन्नतामें नृत्य करते हुए सर्वप्रथम अति- गोपनीय सभी तीर्थो एवं देवस्थानोंमें देवताओंके हितको कामनासे गये। कालभेरवके चारों ओर महायोगी प्रमथगण उनको स्तुति करते हुए चल रहे थे। उन (कालभैरव) -का नृत्य देखनेकी लालसावाले भगवान् नारायण हरि दूसरा रूप धारणकर स्वयं उनके पीछे-
verses.wordMeaning: He should beg for alms only once. He should pro¬ claim his sin to all men. Or he should maintain himself with fruits and roots obtained from the forest and subsist on them.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should beg for alms only once. He should pro¬ claim his sin to all men. Or he should maintain himself with fruits and roots obtained from the forest and subsist on them.

verses.sanskrit: यदेतद् द्रविणं नाम प्राण ह्येते बहिश्वराः । स तस्य हरति प्राणान् यो यस्य हरते धनम्
verses.transliteration: yadetad draviṇaṃ nāma prāṇa hyete bahiśvarāḥ / sa tasya harati prāṇān yo yasya harate dhanam
verses.translation: He should hold the skull and the Khatvahga (a staff with a skull at the top) in his hands. He should observe celibacy. When the twelfth year is completed in this manner, he shall become free from the sin of Brahmana-slaughter.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ वृषभके चिहृसे अङ्कित शासन (ध्वजा)- वाले अनन्त योगात्मरूप (शंकर) गोविन्दको देखते हुए प्रसन्नतापूर्वक बार-बार नृत्य करने लगे। तदनन्तर अनुचरों और हरिके सहित धर्मरूपी वृषभको
verses.wordMeaning: He should hold the skull and the Khatvahga (a staff with a skull at the top) in his hands. He should observe celibacy. When the twelfth year is completed in this manner, he shall become free from the sin of Brahmana-slaughter.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should hold the skull and the Khatvahga (a staff with a skull at the top) in his hands. He should observe celibacy. When the twelfth year is completed in this manner, he shall become free from the sin of Brahmana-slaughter.

verses.sanskrit: एवं कृत्वा स दुष्टात्मा भिन्नवृत्तो व्रताच्च्युतः । भूयो निर्वेदमापन्नश्चरेच्चान्द्रायणव्रतम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ kṛtvā sa duṣṭātmā bhinnavṛtto vratāccyutaḥ / bhūyo nirvedamāpannaścareccāndrāyaṇavratam
verses.translation: When the sin has been committed unintentionally, this is the auspicious expiation. It should be remembered that if the sin is done intentionally, the purification is only after death, and not by any other means.
verses.hindi: वाहनके रूपमें स्वीकार करनेवाले रुद्र (कालभेरव) वाराणसी इस नामसे प्रसिद्ध महादेवकी पुरीमें पहुँचे कपर्दी देवेशके वहाँ प्रवेश करते ही वह ब्रह्महत्या तीव्र स्वरसे हाहाकार करती हुई दु:खी होकर पातालमें चली गयी
verses.wordMeaning: When the sin has been committed unintentionally, this is the auspicious expiation. It should be remembered that if the sin is done intentionally, the purification is only after death, and not by any other means.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the sin has been committed unintentionally, this is the auspicious expiation. It should be remembered that if the sin is done intentionally, the purification is only after death, and not by any other means.

verses.sanskrit: विधिना शास्त्रदृष्टेन संवत्सरमिति श्रुतिः । भूयो निर्वेदमापन्नश्चरेद् भिक्षुरतन्द्रितः
verses.transliteration: vidhinā śāstradṛṣṭena saṃvatsaramiti śrutiḥ / bhūyo nirvedamāpannaścared bhikṣuratandritaḥ
verses.translation: He should observe Anasana (fast unto death) or Bhrgupatana (fall off from a precipice) or he shall enter the burning 6re or water.
verses.hindi: प्रविश्य परमं स्थानं कपालं ब्रह्मणो हर: । गणानामग्रतो देव: स्थापयामास शंकर:
verses.wordMeaning: He should observe Anasana (fast unto death) or Bhrgupatana (fall off from a precipice) or he shall enter the burning 6re or water.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should observe Anasana (fast unto death) or Bhrgupatana (fall off from a precipice) or he shall enter the burning 6re or water.

verses.sanskrit: अकस्मादेव हिंसां तु यदि भिक्षुः समाचरेत् । कुर्यात्कृछ्रातिकृच्छ्रं तु चान्द्रायणमथापि वा
verses.transliteration: akasmādeva hiṃsāṃ tu yadi bhikṣuḥ samācaret / kuryātkṛchrātikṛcchraṃ tu cāndrāyaṇamathāpi vā
verses.translation: In order to wipe off the sin of Brahmana-slaughter, he should discard his life for the sake of a Brahmana or a cow or for the sake of the dead.
verses.hindi: स्थापयित्वा महादेवो ददौ तच्च कलेवरम्। उक्त्वा सजीवमस्त्वीशो विष्णवे स घृणानिधि: ये स्मरन्ति ममाजस्त्रं कापालं वेषमुत्तमम्। तेषां विनश्यति क्षिप्रमिहामुत्र च पातकम्
verses.wordMeaning: In order to wipe off the sin of Brahmana-slaughter, he should discard his life for the sake of a Brahmana or a cow or for the sake of the dead.
verses.commentary: Sense: In order to wipe off the sin of Brahmana-slaughter, he should discard his life for the sake of a Brahmana or a cow or for the sake of the dead.

verses.sanskrit: स्कन्देदिन्द्रियदौर्बल्यात् स्त्रियं दृष्ट्वा यतिर्यदि । तेन धारयितव्या वै प्राणायामास्तु षोडश । दिवास्कन्दे त्रिरात्रं स्यात् प्राणायामशतं तथा
verses.transliteration: skandedindriyadaurbalyāt striyaṃ dṛṣṭvā yatiryadi / tena dhārayitavyā vai prāṇāyāmāstu ṣoḍaśa / divāskande trirātraṃ syāt prāṇāyāmaśataṃ tathā
verses.translation: The sin of Brahmana-slaughter is dispelled by curing a Brahmana of his chronic illness or by giving food to a very learned person.
verses.hindi: तर्पयित्वा पितृन् देवान् मुच्यते ब्रह्महत्यया
verses.wordMeaning: The sin of Brahmana-slaughter is dispelled by curing a Brahmana of his chronic illness or by giving food to a very learned person.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sin of Brahmana-slaughter is dispelled by curing a Brahmana of his chronic illness or by giving food to a very learned person.

verses.sanskrit: एकान्ने मधुमांसे च नवश्राद्धे तथैव च । प्रत्यक्षलवणे चोक्तं प्राजापत्यं विशोधनम्
verses.transliteration: ekānne madhumāṃse ca navaśrāddhe tathaiva ca / pratyakṣalavaṇe coktaṃ prājāpatyaṃ viśodhanam
verses.translation: The sin of Brahmana-slaughter is dispelled by curing a Brahmana of his chronic illness or by giving food to a very learned person.
verses.hindi: इतीदमुक्त्वा भगवान् समालिङ्गघ जनार्दनम्। सहैव प्रमथेशानैः क्षणादन्तरधीयत स लब्ध्वा भगवान् कृष्णो विष्वक्सेनं त्रिशूलिनः । स्वं देशमगमत् तूर्णं गृहीत्वा परमं वपुः
verses.wordMeaning: The sin of Brahmana-slaughter is dispelled by curing a Brahmana of his chronic illness or by giving food to a very learned person.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sin of Brahmana-slaughter is dispelled by curing a Brahmana of his chronic illness or by giving food to a very learned person.

verses.sanskrit: ध्याननिष्ठस्य सततं नश्यते सर्वपातकम् । तस्मान्महेश्वरं ज्ञात्वा तस्य ध्यानपरो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: dhyānaniṣṭhasya satataṃ naśyate sarvapātakam / tasmānmaheśvaraṃ jñātvā tasya dhyānaparo bhavet
verses.translation: The sin of Brahmana-slaughter is dispelled by curing a Brahmana of his chronic illness or by giving food to a very learned person.
verses.hindi: कपालमोचनं तीर्थ स्थाणोः प्रियकरं शुभम्
verses.wordMeaning: The sin of Brahmana-slaughter is dispelled by curing a Brahmana of his chronic illness or by giving food to a very learned person.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sin of Brahmana-slaughter is dispelled by curing a Brahmana of his chronic illness or by giving food to a very learned person.

verses.sanskrit: यद् ब्रह्म परमं ज्योतिः प्रतिष्ठाक्षरमद्वयम् । यो ऽन्तरात्र परं ब्रह्म स विज्ञेयो महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: yad brahma paramaṃ jyotiḥ pratiṣṭhākṣaramadvayam / yo 'ntarātra paraṃ brahma sa vijñeyo maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: The sin of Brahmana-slaughter is dispelled by curing a Brahmana of his chronic illness or by giving food to a very learned person.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ स्थान (वाराणसी)-में प्रविष्ट होकर देव हर शंकर (कालभैरव) -ने गणोंके सामने ब्रह्माके कपालको स्थापित किया और उन्हीं करुणानिधि ईश महादेव (कालभेरव)-ने 'जीवित हो जाय' ऐसा कहकर (विष्वक्सेनका) कलेवर विष्णु (हरिं भगवान्)-को दे दिया
verses.wordMeaning: The sin of Brahmana-slaughter is dispelled by curing a Brahmana of his chronic illness or by giving food to a very learned person.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sin of Brahmana-slaughter is dispelled by curing a Brahmana of his chronic illness or by giving food to a very learned person.

verses.sanskrit: एष देवो महादेवः केवलः परमः शिवः । तदेवाक्षरमद्वैतं तदादित्यान्तरं परम्
verses.transliteration: eṣa devo mahādevaḥ kevalaḥ paramaḥ śivaḥ / tadevākṣaramadvaitaṃ tadādityāntaraṃ param
verses.translation: The sin of Brahmana-slaughter is dispelled by curing a Brahmana of his chronic illness or by giving food to a very learned person.
verses.hindi: मेरे इस कपालयुक्त उत्तम वेषका (रूपका) निरन्तर स्मरण करनेसे एऐहलौकिक तथा पारलौकिक सब पाप शीघ्र ही नष्ट हो जाते हैं। इस श्रेष्ठ (वाराणसीके कपालमोचन) तीर्थमें आकर स्नान करके विधिपूर्वक
verses.wordMeaning: The sin of Brahmana-slaughter is dispelled by curing a Brahmana of his chronic illness or by giving food to a very learned person.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sin of Brahmana-slaughter is dispelled by curing a Brahmana of his chronic illness or by giving food to a very learned person.

verses.sanskrit: यस्मान्महीयते देवः स्वधाम्नि ज्ञानसंज्ञिते । आत्मयोगाह्वये तत्त्वे महादेवस्ततः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: yasmānmahīyate devaḥ svadhāmni jñānasaṃjñite / ātmayogāhvaye tattve mahādevastataḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: The sin of Brahmana-slaughter is dispelled by curing a Brahmana of his chronic illness or by giving food to a very learned person.
verses.hindi: पितरों तथा देवताओंका तर्पण करनेसे ब्रह्महत्यासे मुक्ति मिल जाती हैं। संसारको अनित्य जानकर जो इस स्थानमें निवास करते हैं, उन्हें देहान्तके समयमें परम ज्ञान और परम पद प्रदान करता हूँ। ऐसा कहकर भगवान् (कालभेरव) जनार्दनका आलिंगनकर प्रमधेश्वरोंके साथ ही क्षणभरमें अन्तर्धान हो गये
verses.wordMeaning: The sin of Brahmana-slaughter is dispelled by curing a Brahmana of his chronic illness or by giving food to a very learned person.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sin of Brahmana-slaughter is dispelled by curing a Brahmana of his chronic illness or by giving food to a very learned person.

verses.sanskrit: नान्यद् देवान्महादेवाद् व्यतिरिक्तं प्रपश्यति । तमेवात्मानमन्वेति यः स याति परं पदम्
verses.transliteration: nānyad devānmahādevād vyatiriktaṃ prapaśyati / tamevātmānamanveti yaḥ sa yāti paraṃ padam
verses.translation: The sin of Brahmana-slaughter is dispelled by curing a Brahmana of his chronic illness or by giving food to a very learned person.
verses.hindi: वे भगवान् कृष्ण (हरि) त्रिशूलीसे विष्वक्सेनको प्रातकर अपना परम रूप धारणकर शीघ्र ही अपने स्थानको चले गये
verses.wordMeaning: The sin of Brahmana-slaughter is dispelled by curing a Brahmana of his chronic illness or by giving food to a very learned person.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sin of Brahmana-slaughter is dispelled by curing a Brahmana of his chronic illness or by giving food to a very learned person.

verses.sanskrit: मन्यते ये स्वमात्मानं विभिन्नं परमेश्वरात् । न ते पश्यन्ति तं देवं वृथा तेषां परिश्रमः
verses.transliteration: manyate ye svamātmānaṃ vibhinnaṃ parameśvarāt / na te paśyanti taṃ devaṃ vṛthā teṣāṃ pariśramaḥ
verses.translation: The sin of Brahmana-slaughter is dispelled by curing a Brahmana of his chronic illness or by giving food to a very learned person.
verses.hindi: आप लोगोंसे स्थाणु (शंकर)-को अत्यन्त प्रिय, महापातकोंको नष्ट करनेवाले, पवित्र एवं मङ्गलकारी इस कपालमोचन तीर्थके विषयमें मैंने बताया। जो ब्राह्मणोंके समीप इस अध्यायका पाठ करता है, वह कायिक, वाचिक तथा मानसिक (त्रिविध) पापोंसे मुक्त
verses.wordMeaning: The sin of Brahmana-slaughter is dispelled by curing a Brahmana of his chronic illness or by giving food to a very learned person.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sin of Brahmana-slaughter is dispelled by curing a Brahmana of his chronic illness or by giving food to a very learned person.

verses.sanskrit: एकमेव परं ब्रह्म विज्ञेयं तत्त्वमव्ययम् । स देवस्तु महादेवो नैतद् विज्ञाय बध्यते
verses.transliteration: ekameva paraṃ brahma vijñeyaṃ tattvamavyayam / sa devastu mahādevo naitad vijñāya badhyate
verses.translation: The sin of Brahmana-slaughter is dispelled by curing a Brahmana of his chronic illness or by giving food to a very learned person.
verses.hindi: वाचिकैर्मानसैः पापैः कायिकैश्च विमुच्यते॥ १११॥  हो जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: The sin of Brahmana-slaughter is dispelled by curing a Brahmana of his chronic illness or by giving food to a very learned person.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sin of Brahmana-slaughter is dispelled by curing a Brahmana of his chronic illness or by giving food to a very learned person.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद् यतेत नियतं यतिः संयतमानसः । ज्ञानयोगरतः शान्तो महादेवपरायणः
verses.transliteration: tasmād yateta niyataṃ yatiḥ saṃyatamānasaḥ / jñānayogarataḥ śānto mahādevaparāyaṇaḥ
verses.translation: The sin of Brahmana-slaughter is dispelled by curing a Brahmana of his chronic illness or by giving food to a very learned person.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षद्साहस्तरघां संहितायामुपरिविभागे एकत्रिंशोऽध्यायः  इसी अध्यायके ९९वें श्लोकके अनुसार श्रीहरिने दूसरा रूप धारणकर श्रीकालभैरवके साथ वाराणसीमें प्रवेश किया था, अब अपने पार्षद विष्वक्सेनके शरीरको प्राप्तकर अपने वास्तविक स्वरूपसे अपने धाम जा रहे हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The sin of Brahmana-slaughter is dispelled by curing a Brahmana of his chronic illness or by giving food to a very learned person.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sin of Brahmana-slaughter is dispelled by curing a Brahmana of his chronic illness or by giving food to a very learned person.

verses.sanskrit: एष वः कथितो विप्रो यतीनामाश्रमः शुभः । पितामहेन विभुना मुनीनां पूर्वमीरितम्
verses.transliteration: eṣa vaḥ kathito vipro yatīnāmāśramaḥ śubhaḥ / pitāmahena vibhunā munīnāṃ pūrvamīritam
verses.translation: The sin of Brahmana-slaughter is dispelled by curing a Brahmana of his chronic illness or by giving food to a very learned person.
verses.hindi: ति कूर्मपुराण रे
verses.wordMeaning: The sin of Brahmana-slaughter is dispelled by curing a Brahmana of his chronic illness or by giving food to a very learned person.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sin of Brahmana-slaughter is dispelled by curing a Brahmana of his chronic illness or by giving food to a very learned person.

verses.sanskrit: नापुत्रशिष्ययोगिभ्यो दद्यादिदमनुत्तमम् । ज्ञानं स्वयंभुवा प्रोक्तं यतिधर्माश्रयं शिवम्
verses.transliteration: nāputraśiṣyayogibhyo dadyādidamanuttamam / jñānaṃ svayaṃbhuvā proktaṃ yatidharmāśrayaṃ śivam
verses.translation: The sin of Brahmana-slaughter is dispelled by curing a Brahmana of his chronic illness or by giving food to a very learned person.
verses.hindi: प्रायश्चित्त-प्रकरणमें महापातकोंके प्रायश्चित्तका विधान तथा अन्य उपपातकोंसे शुद्धिका उपाय तया स काये निर्दग्धे मुच्यते तु द्विजोत्तमः
verses.wordMeaning: The sin of Brahmana-slaughter is dispelled by curing a Brahmana of his chronic illness or by giving food to a very learned person.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sin of Brahmana-slaughter is dispelled by curing a Brahmana of his chronic illness or by giving food to a very learned person.

verses.sanskrit: इति यतिनियमानामेतदुक्तं विधानं पशुपतिपरितोषे यद् भवेदेकहेतुः । न भवति पुनरेषामुद्भवो वा विनाशः प्रणिहितमनसो ये नित्यमेवाचरन्ति
verses.transliteration: iti yatiniyamānāmetaduktaṃ vidhānaṃ paśupatiparitoṣe yad bhavedekahetuḥ / na bhavati punareṣāmudbhavo vā vināśaḥ praṇihitamanaso ye nityamevācaranti
verses.translation: The sin of Brahmana-slaughter is dispelled by curing a Brahmana of his chronic illness or by giving food to a very learned person.
verses.hindi: पयो घृतं जलं वाथ मुच्यते पातकात् तत:
verses.wordMeaning: The sin of Brahmana-slaughter is dispelled by curing a Brahmana of his chronic illness or by giving food to a very learned person.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sin of Brahmana-slaughter is dispelled by curing a Brahmana of his chronic illness or by giving food to a very learned person.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे एकोनत्रिंशो ऽध्यायः व्यास उवाच अतः परं प्रवलक्ष्यामि प्रायश्चित्तविधिं शुभम् । हिताय सर्वविप्राणां दोषाणामपनुत्तये
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge ekonatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ vyāsa uvāca ataḥ paraṃ pravalakṣyāmi prāyaścittavidhiṃ śubham / hitāya sarvaviprāṇāṃ doṣāṇāmapanuttaye
verses.translation: Or a Brahmana is absolved of the sin of Brahmana- slaughter by taking the concluding ablutions of a horse sacri¬ fice or by giving all his possessions to a Brahmana who has mastered the Vedas.
verses.hindi: जलार्द्ववासाः प्रयतो ध्यात्वा नारायणं हरिम्। ब्रह्महत्याव्रतं चाथ चरेत् तत्पापशान्तये सुवर्णस्तेयकृद् विप्रो राजानमभिगम्य तु। स्वकर्म ख्यापयन् ब्रूयान्मां भवाननुशास्त्विति
verses.wordMeaning: Or a Brahmana is absolved of the sin of Brahmana- slaughter by taking the concluding ablutions of a horse sacri¬ fice or by giving all his possessions to a Brahmana who has mastered the Vedas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or a Brahmana is absolved of the sin of Brahmana- slaughter by taking the concluding ablutions of a horse sacri¬ fice or by giving all his possessions to a Brahmana who has mastered the Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: अकृत्वा विहितं कर्म कृत्वा निन्दितमेव च । दोषमाप्नोति पुरुषः प्रायश्चित्तं विशोधनम्
verses.transliteration: akṛtvā vihitaṃ karma kṛtvā ninditameva ca / doṣamāpnoti puruṣaḥ prāyaścittaṃ viśodhanam
verses.translation: A Brahmana should observe fast for three nights and then take three baths in the world-famous confluence of the river Sarasvati with the Aruna and he shall be purified.
verses.hindi: गृहीत्वा मुसलं राजा सकृद् हन्यात् ततः स्वयम्। वधे तु शुद्धयते स्तेनो ब्राह्मणस्तपसैव वा
verses.wordMeaning: A Brahmana should observe fast for three nights and then take three baths in the world-famous confluence of the river Sarasvati with the Aruna and he shall be purified.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmana should observe fast for three nights and then take three baths in the world-famous confluence of the river Sarasvati with the Aruna and he shall be purified.

verses.sanskrit: प्रायश्चित्तमकृत्वा तु न तिष्ठेद् ब्राह्मणः क्वचित् । यद् ब्रूयुर्ब्राह्मणाः शान्ता विद्वांसस्तत्समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: prāyaścittamakṛtvā tu na tiṣṭhed brāhmaṇaḥ kvacit / yad brūyurbrāhmaṇāḥ śāntā vidvāṃsastatsamācaret
verses.translation: By going to the holy place Ramesvara, and by taking bath in the great ocean or by seeing Rudra, he shall be rid of the sin if he observes celibacy.
verses.hindi: राजा तेन च गन्तव्यो मुक्तकेशेन धावता। आचक्षाणेन तत्पापमेवंकर्माऽस्मि शाधि माम् शासनाद् वा विमोक्षाद् वा स्तेनः स्तेयाद् विमुच्यते । अशासित्वा तु तं राजा स्तेनस्याप्नोति किल्बिषम्
verses.wordMeaning: By going to the holy place Ramesvara, and by taking bath in the great ocean or by seeing Rudra, he shall be rid of the sin if he observes celibacy.
verses.commentary: Sense: By going to the holy place Ramesvara, and by taking bath in the great ocean or by seeing Rudra, he shall be rid of the sin if he observes celibacy.

verses.sanskrit: वेदार्थवित्तमः शान्तो धर्मकामो ऽग्निमान् द्विजः । स एव स्यात् परो धर्मो यमेको ऽपि व्यवस्यति
verses.transliteration: vedārthavittamaḥ śānto dharmakāmo 'gnimān dvijaḥ / sa eva syāt paro dharmo yameko 'pi vyavasyati
verses.translation: There is the holy centre of lord Sulin (Siva) named Kapalamocana. By taking bath and propitiating the Pitrs and Devas, one dispels the sin of Brahmana-slaughter.
