verses.hindi: चीरवासा द्विजोऽरण्ये चरेद् ब्रह्महणो व्रतम्
verses.wordMeaning: There is the holy centre of lord Sulin (Siva) named Kapalamocana. By taking bath and propitiating the Pitrs and Devas, one dispels the sin of Brahmana-slaughter.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is the holy centre of lord Sulin (Siva) named Kapalamocana. By taking bath and propitiating the Pitrs and Devas, one dispels the sin of Brahmana-slaughter.

verses.sanskrit: अनाहिताग्नयो विप्रास्त्रयो वेदार्थपारगाः । यद् ब्रूयुर्धर्मकामास्ते तज्ज्ञेयं धर्मसाधनम्
verses.transliteration: anāhitāgnayo viprāstrayo vedārthapāragāḥ / yad brūyurdharmakāmāste tajjñeyaṃ dharmasādhanam
verses.translation: It was there that the skull of ParamesthinBrahma was formerly deposited by Bhairava, the overlord of Devas, of unmeasured splendour.
verses.hindi: व्यासजीने कहा--सुरापान करनेवाले द्विजोत्तमको अग्निके समान वर्णवाली प्रतप्त (अति उष्ण) सुराका स्वयं पान करना चाहिए। उससे शरीरके दग्ध होनेपर वह (पापसे) मुक्त हो जाता है। अथवा अग्निके समान रंगवाला (अति उष्ण) गोमूत्र या गोबरका रस अथवा (गौका) दुग्ध, घृत या जल पीनेपर द्विज (पापसे) मुक्त हो जाता है। उस (सुरापानजन्य) पापके शमनके लिये जलसे भींगा वस्त्र धारणकर तथा प्रयत्नपूर्वक नारायण
verses.wordMeaning: It was there that the skull of ParamesthinBrahma was formerly deposited by Bhairava, the overlord of Devas, of unmeasured splendour.
verses.commentary: Sense: It was there that the skull of ParamesthinBrahma was formerly deposited by Bhairava, the overlord of Devas, of unmeasured splendour.

verses.sanskrit: अनेकधर्मशास्त्रज्ञा ऊहापोहविशारदाः । वेदाध्ययनसंपन्नाः सप्तैते परिकीर्तिताः
verses.transliteration: anekadharmaśāstrajñā ūhāpohaviśāradāḥ / vedādhyayanasaṃpannāḥ saptaite parikīrtitāḥ
verses.translation: By worshiping Mahadeva there, in the form of Bhairava, after the bath and after performing the Tarpana rites to the Pitrs one is freed from the sin of Brahmana slaughter.
verses.hindi: हरिंका ध्यान कर पुनः ब्रह्महत्यासम्बन्धी (प्रायश्चित्त) व्रतका पालन करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: By worshiping Mahadeva there, in the form of Bhairava, after the bath and after performing the Tarpana rites to the Pitrs one is freed from the sin of Brahmana slaughter.
verses.commentary: Sense: By worshiping Mahadeva there, in the form of Bhairava, after the bath and after performing the Tarpana rites to the Pitrs one is freed from the sin of Brahmana slaughter.

verses.sanskrit: मीमांसाज्ञानतत्त्वज्ञा वेदान्तकुशला द्विजाः । एकविंशतिसंख्याताः प्रयाश्चित्तं वदन्ति वै
verses.transliteration: mīmāṃsājñānatattvajñā vedāntakuśalā dvijāḥ / ekaviṃśatisaṃkhyātāḥ prayāścittaṃ vadanti vai
verses.translation: That U'aia Gf<d b an interpolation by Pasupatas becomes evident when in place and out of place they bring their favourite Deity. This chapter illustrates how the sin of Brahma-hatya (killing a Brahmana) was absolved by taking a bath in a holy centre (Tirtha) at Varanasi and why it came to be named as Kapala-mocana (reliever from the contact of a skull). The glorifi¬ cation of Siva by embodiments of Vedas and amputation of the arrogant head of god Brahma and the final emancipation from that sin of beheading Brahma and physical separation of Brahma's skull from Bhairava's hand— all is for the glorification of Siva.
verses.hindi: सुवर्णकी चोरी करनेवाले ब्राह्मणको चाहिए कि वह राजाके पास जाकर अपने (पाप) कर्मको बताते हुए कहे-' आप मुझे दण्डित करें'। राजा मूसल लेकर स्वयं उसे एक बार मारे। इस प्रकार वध हो जानेपर ब्राह्मण चोरी-रूप (महापाप) -से शुद्ध हो जाता है अथवा तपस्या करनेसे वह शुद्ध होता है। मूसल अथवा खैरकी लकड़ीकी लाठी और दोनों ओर तीक्ष्ण धारवाली शक्ति या लोहेका दण्ड कंधेपर
verses.wordMeaning: That U'aia Gf<d b an interpolation by Pasupatas becomes evident when in place and out of place they bring their favourite Deity.…
verses.commentary: Sense: That U'aia Gf<d b an interpolation by Pasupatas becomes evident when in place and out of place they bring their favourite Deity.…

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्महा मद्यपः स्तेनो गुरुतल्पग एव च । महापातकिनस्त्वेते यश्चैतैः सह संवसेत्
verses.transliteration: brahmahā madyapaḥ steno gurutalpaga eva ca / mahāpātakinastvete yaścaitaiḥ saha saṃvaset
verses.translation: O sages, listen ye all to the meritorious story that dis¬ pels sins, and the greatness of the intelligent Mahadeva, the lord of Devas.
verses.hindi: लेकर उस (पापयुक्त ब्राह्मण)-को राजाके पास केश खोले दौड़ते हुए जाना चाहिए और अपने उस (पापकर्म)-को बताते हुए कहना चाहिए--' मैंने यह कर्म किया है, आप मुझे दण्ड दें।' दण्डसे अथवा
verses.wordMeaning: O sages, listen ye all to the meritorious story that dis¬ pels sins, and the greatness of the intelligent Mahadeva, the lord of Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sages, listen ye all to the meritorious story that dis¬ pels sins, and the greatness of the intelligent Mahadeva, the lord of Devas.

verses.sanskrit: संवत्सरं तु पतितैः संसर्गं कुरुते तु यः । यानशय्यासनैर्नित्यं जानन् वै पतितो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: saṃvatsaraṃ tu patitaiḥ saṃsargaṃ kurute tu yaḥ / yānaśayyāsanairnityaṃ jānan vai patito bhavet
verses.translation: Formerly, on the peak of Meru, the great sages bowed to the lord Pitamaha, the primordial cause of the worlds, and said "What is that one immutable Principle?"
verses.hindi: (यथाशास्त्र प्रायश्चित्तपूर्वक शरीर) परित्याग कर देनेसे सुवर्ण-चोर चोरी (-रूप पापकर्म)-से मुक्त हो जाता है। उसको दण्डित न करनेसे तो राजा चोरका पाप (स्वयं) प्राप्त कर लेता है  तपस्याद्वारा सुवर्णकी चोरीसे उत्पन्न पापको दूर करनेकी इच्छा रखनेवाले द्विजको चाहिए कि वह चीर (फटे-पुराने) वस्त्र धारण करके जंगलमें जाकर ब्रह्महत्या-सम्बन्धी (प्रायश्चित्त) व्रतका पालन करे
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly, on the peak of Meru, the great sages bowed to the lord Pitamaha, the primordial cause of the worlds, and said "What is that one immutable Principle?"
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, on the peak of Meru, the great sages bowed to the lord Pitamaha, the primordial cause of the worlds, and said "What is that one immutable Principle?"

verses.sanskrit: याजनं योनिसंबन्धं तथैवाध्यापनं द्विजः । कृत्वा सद्यः पतेज्ज्ञानात् सह भोजनमेव च
verses.transliteration: yājanaṃ yonisaṃbandhaṃ tathaivādhyāpanaṃ dvijaḥ / kṛtvā sadyaḥ patejjñānāt saha bhojanameva ca
verses.translation: The deity from whom the worlds originated was delud¬ ed by the Maya ofMahesa. Not realising the greatest Being, he was over-bearing (enough) to say that he was (the unchanging principle).
verses.hindi: 'प्रायः' का अर्थ तप है। चित्तका अर्थ निश्चय है। इसलिये दृढ-संकल्पपूर्वक तप करना ही प्रायश्चित्तका आचरण है (याह मिता० श्लोक २७५)  मनुस्मृति अ० ११ तथा याज्ञ० स्मृ० प्रायश्चित्त-प्रकरण आदिमें इस कूर्मपुराणके अध्यायके अनुसार प्रायः सूक्ष्म विचार करके प्रायक्षित्तका निर्णय किया गया है। अपेक्षानुसार प्रायश्चि्त-निर्णय वहींसे करना चाहिए। इस अध्यायमें
verses.wordMeaning: The deity from whom the worlds originated was delud¬ ed by the Maya ofMahesa. Not realising the greatest Being, he was over-bearing (enough) to say that he was (the unchanging principle).
verses.commentary: Sense: The deity from whom the worlds originated was delud¬ ed by the Maya ofMahesa. Not realising the greatest Being, he was over-bearing (enough) to say that he was (the unchanging principle).

verses.sanskrit: अविज्ञायाथ यो मोहात् कुर्यादध्यापनं द्विजः । संवत्सरेण पतति सहाध्ययनमेव च
verses.transliteration: avijñāyātha yo mohāt kuryādadhyāpanaṃ dvijaḥ / saṃvatsareṇa patati sahādhyayanameva ca
verses.translation: "I am the Creator, the source of the origin of the Universe. I am the single self-bom Isvara. I am the beginning¬ less greatest Brahman. By worshipping me, one is liberated.
verses.hindi: प्रायश्चित्तकी दिशामात्रका संक्षेपमें निर्देश है। चरेद् वा वत्सरं कृच्छं ब्रह्मचर्यपरायणः । ब्राह्मणः स्वर्णहारी तु तत्पापस्यापनुत्तये
verses.wordMeaning: "I am the Creator, the source of the origin of the Universe. I am the single self-bom Isvara. I am the beginning¬ less greatest Brahman. By worshipping me, one is liberated.
verses.commentary: Sense: "I am the Creator, the source of the origin of the Universe. I am the single self-bom Isvara. I am the beginning¬ less greatest Brahman. By worshipping me, one is liberated.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्माहा द्वादशाब्दानि कुटिं कृत्वा वने वसेत् । भैक्षमात्मविशुद्ध्यर्थं कृत्वा शवशिरोध्वजम्
verses.transliteration: brahmāhā dvādaśābdāni kuṭiṃ kṛtvā vane vaset / bhaikṣamātmaviśuddhyarthaṃ kṛtvā śavaśirodhvajam
verses.translation: I am the deity who makes all Devas function as well as desist (from functioning). There is no one in the worlds superior to me."
verses.hindi: गुरोर्भार्या समारुह्य ब्राह्मणः काममोहितः । अवगूहेत् स्त्रियं तप्तां दीप्तां कार्ष्णायसीं कृताम्
verses.wordMeaning: I am the deity who makes all Devas function as well as desist (from functioning). There is no one in the worlds superior to me."
verses.commentary: Sense: I am the deity who makes all Devas function as well as desist (from functioning). There is no one in the worlds superior to me."

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणावसथान् सर्वान् देवागाराणि वर्जयेत् । विनिन्दन् स्वयमात्मानं ब्राह्मणं तं च संस्मरन्
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇāvasathān sarvān devāgārāṇi varjayet / vinindan svayamātmānaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ taṃ ca saṃsmaran
verses.translation: While these two deities were arguing with a desire to subdue the other, the four Vedas came to the place where these two deities were present.
verses.hindi: गुर्वर्थ वा हतः शुध्येच्चरेद् वा ब्रह्महा व्रतम्। शाखां वा कण्टकोपेतां परिष्वज्याथ वत्सरम्। अधः शयीत नियतो मुच्यते गुरुतल्पगः अश्वमेधावभृथके स्नात्वा वा शुध्यते नरः
verses.wordMeaning: While these two deities were arguing with a desire to subdue the other, the four Vedas came to the place where these two deities were present.
verses.commentary: Sense: While these two deities were arguing with a desire to subdue the other, the four Vedas came to the place where these two deities were present.

verses.sanskrit: असंकल्पितयोग्यानि सप्तागाराणि संविशेत् । विधूमे शनकैर्नित्यं व्यङ्गारे भुक्तवज्जने
verses.transliteration: asaṃkalpitayogyāni saptāgārāṇi saṃviśet / vidhūme śanakairnityaṃ vyaṅgāre bhuktavajjane
verses.translation: On seeing lord Brahma and the lord identical with Yajna (i.e. Narayana) seated (there), (the Vedas) with a pain¬ ful heart declared the reality of the Supreme Lord.
verses.hindi: कालेऽष्टमे वा भुञ्जानो ब्रह्मचारी सदाव्रती। स्थानासनाभ्यां विहरेस्त्रिरह्वोऽभ्युपयन्नपः
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing lord Brahma and the lord identical with Yajna (i.e. Narayana) seated (there), (the Vedas) with a pain¬ ful heart declared the reality of the Supreme Lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing lord Brahma and the lord identical with Yajna (i.e. Narayana) seated (there), (the Vedas) with a pain¬ ful heart declared the reality of the Supreme Lord.

verses.sanskrit: एककालं चरेद् भैक्षं दोषं विख्यापयन् नृणाम् । वन्यमूलफलैर्वापि वर्तयेद् धैर्यमाक्षितः
verses.transliteration: ekakālaṃ cared bhaikṣaṃ doṣaṃ vikhyāpayan nṛṇām / vanyamūlaphalairvāpi vartayed dhairyamākṣitaḥ
verses.translation: It is lord Mahesvara, within whom are stationed all living beings from whom everything functions and which they call the Supreme principle.
verses.hindi: स तत्पापापनोदार्थं तस्यैव व्रतमाचरेत् षाण्मासिके तु संसर्गे प्रायज्षित्तार्धमर्हति
verses.wordMeaning: It is lord Mahesvara, within whom are stationed all living beings from whom everything functions and which they call the Supreme principle.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is lord Mahesvara, within whom are stationed all living beings from whom everything functions and which they call the Supreme principle.

verses.sanskrit: कपालपाणिः खट्वाङ्गी ब्रह्मचर्यपरायणः । पूर्णे तु द्वादशे वर्षे ब्रह्महत्यां व्यपोहति
verses.transliteration: kapālapāṇiḥ khaṭvāṅgī brahmacaryaparāyaṇaḥ / pūrṇe tu dvādaśe varṣe brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati
verses.translation: It is the Pinaka-bearing deity Siva who is worshipped by means of all the Yajnas and the Yoga and whom they call Lord Isvara.
verses.hindi: अथवा अश्वमेधयज्ञ-सम्बन्धी अवभृथ-स्रान करनेसे द्विज पवित्र हो जाता है। या (शुद्ध होनेके लिये) ब्राह्मणोंको अपने भारके बराबर स्वर्ण-दान करना चाहिए। अथवा सुवर्णकी चोरी करनेवाले ब्राह्मणको
verses.wordMeaning: It is the Pinaka-bearing deity Siva who is worshipped by means of all the Yajnas and the Yoga and whom they call Lord Isvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is the Pinaka-bearing deity Siva who is worshipped by means of all the Yajnas and the Yoga and whom they call Lord Isvara.

verses.sanskrit: अकामतः कृते पापे प्रायश्चित्तमिदं शुभम् । कामतो मरणाच्छुद्धिर्ज्ञेया नान्येन केनचित्
verses.transliteration: akāmataḥ kṛte pāpe prāyaścittamidaṃ śubham / kāmato maraṇācchuddhirjñeyā nānyena kenacit
verses.translation: That great Deva is Sankara by whom this Universe revolves, who is the auspicious deity within the firmament and who is the principle Reality known and realised by the Yogins.
verses.hindi: उस पापको दूर करनेके लिये एक वर्षतक ब्रह्मचर्यव्रतका पालन करते हुए कृच्छूव्रत करना चाहिए कामसे मोहित होकर गुरुको भार्याके साथ गमन करनेवाले ब्राह्मणको लोहेसे बनायी गयी कुष्णवर्णकी तप्त एवं उद्दीप्त स्त्रीका आलिङ्गन करना चाहिए। अथवा स्वयं लिङ्ग एवं अण्डकोशको काटकर और अपनी
verses.wordMeaning: That great Deva is Sankara by whom this Universe revolves, who is the auspicious deity within the firmament and who is the principle Reality known and realised by the Yogins.
verses.commentary: Sense: That great Deva is Sankara by whom this Universe revolves, who is the auspicious deity within the firmament and who is the principle Reality known and realised by the Yogins.

verses.sanskrit: कुर्यादनशनं वाथ भृगोः पतनमेव वा । ज्वलन्तं वा विशेदग्निं जलं वा प्रविशेत् स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: kuryādanaśanaṃ vātha bhṛgoḥ patanameva vā / jvalantaṃ vā viśedagniṃ jalaṃ vā praviśet svayam
verses.translation: That is lord Bhava whom the ascetics visualize and worship as the great lord of Devas, as the great Purusa, as the great Ruler Rudra.
verses.hindi: अञ्जलिमें रखकर निष्कपट-भावसे दक्षिण दिशाकी ओर तबतक जाना चाहिए, जबतक शरीरपात न हो जाय। गुरुके लिये मारे जानेसे भी गुरुपल्रीगामी शुद्ध हो जाता है अथवा ब्रह्महत्या-सम्बन्धी व्रतका पालन
verses.wordMeaning: That is lord Bhava whom the ascetics visualize and worship as the great lord of Devas, as the great Purusa, as the great Ruler Rudra.
verses.commentary: Sense: That is lord Bhava whom the ascetics visualize and worship as the great lord of Devas, as the great Purusa, as the great Ruler Rudra.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणार्थे गवार्थे वा सम्यक् प्राणान् परित्यजेत् । ब्रह्महत्यापनोदार्थमन्तरा वा मृतस्य तु
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇārthe gavārthe vā samyak prāṇān parityajet / brahmahatyāpanodārthamantarā vā mṛtasya tu
verses.translation: On hearing this auspicious utterance of the Vedas, lord Brahma laughed utterly deluded, the Atman of the Universe (i.e. Brahma) then said:
verses.hindi: करना चाहिए या एक वर्षतक काँटोंसे युक्त शाखाका आलिङ्गन करते हुए गुरुपत्रीसे गमन करनेवालेको नियमपूर्वक नीचे भूमिपर सोना चाहिए। इससे वह गुरुपत्रीगामी पापमुक्त हो जाता है। अथवा ब्राह्मणको चीर (कन्था) वस्त्र धारणकर समाहित होकर एक वर्षतक कृच्छूव्रत करना चाहिए। या अश्वमेधयज्ञके अवभृथ-स्नान करनेसे व्यक्ति शुद्ध हो जाता है। अथवा
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing this auspicious utterance of the Vedas, lord Brahma laughed utterly deluded, the Atman of the Universe (i.e. Brahma) then said:
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing this auspicious utterance of the Vedas, lord Brahma laughed utterly deluded, the Atman of the Universe (i.e. Brahma) then said:

verses.sanskrit: दीर्घामयान्वितं विप्रं कृत्वानामयमेव तु । दत्त्वा चान्नं स दुर्भिक्षे ब्रह्महत्यां व्यपोहति
verses.transliteration: dīrghāmayānvitaṃ vipraṃ kṛtvānāmayameva tu / dattvā cānnaṃ sa durbhikṣe brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati
verses.translation: On hearing this auspicious utterance of the Vedas, lord Brahma laughed utterly deluded, the Atman of the Universe (i.e. Brahma) then said:
verses.hindi: चौथे दिन, सायंकाल) -में भोजन करना चाहिए। इसके पूर्व प्रयत्रपूर्वक एक ही स्थानपर एक ही आसनसे रहकर केवल जल पीते हुए तीन दिन व्यतीत करना चाहिए। ऐसा करते हुए तीन वर्षांतक भूमिपर शयन
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing this auspicious utterance of the Vedas, lord Brahma laughed utterly deluded, the Atman of the Universe (i.e. Brahma) then said:
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing this auspicious utterance of the Vedas, lord Brahma laughed utterly deluded, the Atman of the Universe (i.e. Brahma) then said:

verses.sanskrit: अश्वमेधावभृथके स्नात्वा वा शुध्यते द्विजः । सर्वस्वं वा वेदविदे ब्राह्मणाय प्रदाय तु
verses.transliteration: aśvamedhāvabhṛthake snātvā vā śudhyate dvijaḥ / sarvasvaṃ vā vedavide brāhmaṇāya pradāya tu
verses.translation: On hearing this auspicious utterance of the Vedas, lord Brahma laughed utterly deluded, the Atman of the Universe (i.e. Brahma) then said:
verses.hindi: करनेसे उस (गुरुपल्नी-गमनरूप) पापसे छुटकारा मिलता है, अथवा चार या पाँच चान्द्रायणव्रत करना चाहिए अब पतितों (पापियों)-के साथ संसर्ग करनेवालोंके निस्तारका उपाय (प्रायश्चित्त) बतलाता हूँ। जिस पतितके साथ जो द्विज (एक वर्षतक) संसर्ग करता है, उसे उस पतितद्वारा किये गये पापको दूर करनेके लिये
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing this auspicious utterance of the Vedas, lord Brahma laughed utterly deluded, the Atman of the Universe (i.e. Brahma) then said:
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing this auspicious utterance of the Vedas, lord Brahma laughed utterly deluded, the Atman of the Universe (i.e. Brahma) then said:

verses.sanskrit: सरस्वत्यास्त्वरुणया संगमे लोकविश्रुते । शुध्येत् त्रिषवणस्नानात् त्रिरात्रोपोषितो द्विजः
verses.transliteration: sarasvatyāstvaruṇayā saṃgame lokaviśrute / śudhyet triṣavaṇasnānāt trirātropoṣito dvijaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing this auspicious utterance of the Vedas, lord Brahma laughed utterly deluded, the Atman of the Universe (i.e. Brahma) then said:
verses.hindi: विहित ब्रतका (एक वर्षतक) पालन करना चाहिए। अथवा वर्षभरतक आलस्यरहित होकर तप्तकृच्छुब्रतका पालन करना चाहिए। छः महीनोंतक संसर्ग होनेपर उपर्युक्त व्रतका आधा प्रायश्चित्त करे
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing this auspicious utterance of the Vedas, lord Brahma laughed utterly deluded, the Atman of the Universe (i.e. Brahma) then said:
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing this auspicious utterance of the Vedas, lord Brahma laughed utterly deluded, the Atman of the Universe (i.e. Brahma) then said:

verses.sanskrit: गत्वा रामेश्वरं पुण्यं स्नात्वा चैव महोदधौ । ब्रह्मचर्यादिभिर्युक्तो दृष्ट्वा रुद्रं विमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: gatvā rāmeśvaraṃ puṇyaṃ snātvā caiva mahodadhau / brahmacaryādibhiryukto dṛṣṭvā rudraṃ vimucyate
verses.translation: On hearing this auspicious utterance of the Vedas, lord Brahma laughed utterly deluded, the Atman of the Universe (i.e. Brahma) then said:
verses.hindi: ब्रह्महत्या सुरापानं स्तेयं गुर्वङ्गनागमः । कृत्वा तैश्चापि संसर्ग ब्राह्मण: कामकारतः ज्वलन्त वा विशेदग्निं ध्यात्वा देवं कपर्दिनम्
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing this auspicious utterance of the Vedas, lord Brahma laughed utterly deluded, the Atman of the Universe (i.e. Brahma) then said:
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing this auspicious utterance of the Vedas, lord Brahma laughed utterly deluded, the Atman of the Universe (i.e. Brahma) then said:

verses.sanskrit: कपालमोचनं नाम तीर्थं देवस्य शूलिनः । स्नात्वाभ्यर्च्य पितॄन् भक्त्या ब्रह्महत्यां व्यपोहति
verses.transliteration: kapālamocanaṃ nāma tīrthaṃ devasya śūlinaḥ / snātvābhyarcya pitṝn bhaktyā brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati
verses.translation: On hearing this auspicious utterance of the Vedas, lord Brahma laughed utterly deluded, the Atman of the Universe (i.e. Brahma) then said:
verses.hindi: न ह्यान्या निष्कृतिर्दृष्टा मुनिभिर्धर्मबादिभिः। तस्मात् पुण्येषु तीर्थषु दहेद् वापि स्वदेहकम्
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing this auspicious utterance of the Vedas, lord Brahma laughed utterly deluded, the Atman of the Universe (i.e. Brahma) then said:
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing this auspicious utterance of the Vedas, lord Brahma laughed utterly deluded, the Atman of the Universe (i.e. Brahma) then said:

verses.sanskrit: यत्र देवादिदेवेन भरवेणामितौजसा । कपालं स्थापितं पूर्वं ब्रह्मणः परमेष्ठिनः
verses.transliteration: yatra devādidevena bharaveṇāmitaujasā / kapālaṃ sthāpitaṃ pūrvaṃ brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing this auspicious utterance of the Vedas, lord Brahma laughed utterly deluded, the Atman of the Universe (i.e. Brahma) then said:
verses.hindi: चान्द्रायणं च कुर्वीत तस्य पापस्य शान्तये। ध्यायन् देवं जगद्योनिमनादिनिधनं परम् भ्रातृभार्या समारुह्य कुर्यात् तत्पापशान्तये। चान्द्रायणानि चत्वारि पञ्च वा सुसमाहितः
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing this auspicious utterance of the Vedas, lord Brahma laughed utterly deluded, the Atman of the Universe (i.e. Brahma) then said:
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing this auspicious utterance of the Vedas, lord Brahma laughed utterly deluded, the Atman of the Universe (i.e. Brahma) then said:

verses.sanskrit: समभ्यर्च्य महादेवं तत्र भैरवरूपिणम् । तर्पपित्वा पितॄन् स्नात्वा मुच्यते ब्रह्महत्यया
verses.transliteration: samabhyarcya mahādevaṃ tatra bhairavarūpiṇam / tarpapitvā pitṝn snātvā mucyate brahmahatyayā
verses.translation: On hearing this auspicious utterance of the Vedas, lord Brahma laughed utterly deluded, the Atman of the Universe (i.e. Brahma) then said:
verses.hindi: ब्राह्मणो ब्राह्मणीं गत्वा कृच्छुमेके समाचरेत्। कन्यकां दूषयित्वा तु चरेच्चान्द्रायणव्रतम्
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing this auspicious utterance of the Vedas, lord Brahma laughed utterly deluded, the Atman of the Universe (i.e. Brahma) then said:
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing this auspicious utterance of the Vedas, lord Brahma laughed utterly deluded, the Atman of the Universe (i.e. Brahma) then said:

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे त्रिशो ऽध्यायः ऋषय ऊचुः कथं देवेन रुद्रेण शङ्करेणामितौजसा । कपालं ब्रह्मणः पूर्वं स्थापितं देहजं भुवि
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge triśo 'dhyāyaḥ ṛṣaya ūcuḥ kathaṃ devena rudreṇa śaṅkareṇāmitaujasā / kapālaṃ brahmaṇaḥ pūrvaṃ sthāpitaṃ dehajaṃ bhuvi
verses.translation: "Why does that great Brahman who ought to be devoid of all attachments, sport about alongwith his wife and the excessively arrogant Pramathas (attendants)?"
verses.hindi: इन व्रतोंके द्वारा महापातकी अपने पापको दूर करते हैं। अथवा पृथ्वीके पुण्य-तीर्थोंकी यात्रा करनेसे भी निष्कृति (निस्तार) हो जाती है ब्रह्महत्या, सुरापान, चोरी तथा गुरुपत्रीके साथ गमन करनेवाले अथवा स्वेच्छापूर्वक उनके साथ संसर्ग करनेवाले ब्राह्मणको भी पुण्य-तीर्थमें समाहित होकर अनशनव्रत करना चाहिए अथवा कपर्दी भगवान्
verses.wordMeaning: "Why does that great Brahman who ought to be devoid of all attachments, sport about alongwith his wife and the excessively arrogant Pramathas (attendants)?"
verses.commentary: Sense: "Why does that great Brahman who ought to be devoid of all attachments, sport about alongwith his wife and the excessively arrogant Pramathas (attendants)?"

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच शृणुध्वमृषयः पुण्यां कथां पापप्रणाशनीम् । माहात्म्यं देवदेवस्य महादेवस्य धीमतः
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca śṛṇudhvamṛṣayaḥ puṇyāṃ kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśanīm / māhātmyaṃ devadevasya mahādevasya dhīmataḥ
verses.translation: When this was uttered, the eternal lord, of the nature of Pramva (OM), who is really formless, became embodied and spoke these words to Pitamaha (god Brahma).
verses.hindi: शंकरका ध्यान करते हुए जलती हुई आग्निमें प्रवेश करना चाहिए। धर्मवादी मुनियोंने (इसके अतिरिक्त) दूसरा प्रायश्चित्त नहीं बतलाया है, इसलिये पुण्य- तीर्थोमें अपना शरीर जला देना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: When this was uttered, the eternal lord, of the nature of Pramva (OM), who is really formless, became embodied and spoke these words to Pitamaha (god Brahma).
verses.commentary: Sense: When this was uttered, the eternal lord, of the nature of Pramva (OM), who is really formless, became embodied and spoke these words to Pitamaha (god Brahma).

verses.sanskrit: पुरा पितामहं देवं मेरुशृङ्गे महर्षयः । प्रोचुः प्रणम्य लोकादिं किमेकं तत्त्वमव्ययम्
verses.transliteration: purā pitāmahaṃ devaṃ meruśṛṅge maharṣayaḥ / procuḥ praṇamya lokādiṃ kimekaṃ tattvamavyayam
verses.translation: Even when this was explained, the ignorance of Aja (Brahma) whose body is Yajna, was not dispelled due to the Maya of Isvara.
verses.hindi: (जान-बूझकर) अपनी पुत्री, बहिन या पुत्रवधूके साथ गमन करनेवालेको जलती हुई प्रदीप्त आग्निमें प्रवेश करना चाहिए। ऐसी मर्यादा है। मौसी, मामी, फूआ तथा भांजीके साथ गमन करनेपर कृच्छु तथा अतिकृच्छु नामक ब्रतोंको करना चाहिए और इन पापोंको शान्तिके लिये जगद्योनि अनादिनिधन परमदेवका ध्यान करते हुए चान्द्रायणव्रत करना चाहिए। भाईकी पलीके साथ सहवास करनेपर उस पापको शान्तिके लिये अच्छी
verses.wordMeaning: Even when this was explained, the ignorance of Aja (Brahma) whose body is Yajna, was not dispelled due to the Maya of Isvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even when this was explained, the ignorance of Aja (Brahma) whose body is Yajna, was not dispelled due to the Maya of Isvara.

verses.sanskrit: स मायया महेशस्य मोहितो लोकसंभवः । अविज्ञाय परं भावं स्वात्मानं प्राह धर्षिणम्
verses.transliteration: sa māyayā maheśasya mohito lokasaṃbhavaḥ / avijñāya paraṃ bhāvaṃ svātmānaṃ prāha dharṣiṇam
verses.translation: In the meanwhile Virinca (i.e. god Brahma) the conceiver of the universe saw a divine wonderful and great brilliance filling up the space of the sky.
verses.hindi: प्रकार समाहित-मन होकर चार अथवा पाँच चान्द्रायणब्रत करना चाहिए। फूआकी लड़को, मौसीको लड़को अथवा मामाको लड़कोके साथ गमन करनेपर चान्द्रायणब्रत करना चाहिए। मित्रको पत्नी तथा सालीके साथ सहवास
verses.wordMeaning: In the meanwhile Virinca (i.e. god Brahma) the conceiver of the universe saw a divine wonderful and great brilliance filling up the space of the sky.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meanwhile Virinca (i.e. god Brahma) the conceiver of the universe saw a divine wonderful and great brilliance filling up the space of the sky.

verses.sanskrit: अहं धाता जगद्योनिः स्वयंभूरेक ईश्वरः । अनादिमत्परं ब्रह्म मामभ्यर्च्य विमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ dhātā jagadyoniḥ svayaṃbhūreka īśvaraḥ / anādimatparaṃ brahma māmabhyarcya vimucyate
verses.translation: In the middle of it (that light) was stationed a sphere of brilliance shining with splendour. O excellent Brahmanas, a divine splendour in the middle of the firmament appeared in front of him.
verses.hindi: करनेपर एक अहोरात्र उपवास करके तपतकृच्छुब्रत करना चाहिए। रजस्वलाके साथ गमन करनेपर विप्र तीन रातमें शुद्ध होता है और चाण्डालीके साथ गमन करनेपर तीन तप्तकृच्छु व्रतोंके साथ सांतपनव्रत करनेसे शुद्धि होती है। अन्य किसी प्रकारसे निष्कृति (निस्तार) नहीं कही गयी है
verses.wordMeaning: In the middle of it (that light) was stationed a sphere of brilliance shining with splendour. O excellent Brahmanas, a divine splendour in the middle of the firmament appeared in front of him.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the middle of it (that light) was stationed a sphere of brilliance shining with splendour. O excellent Brahmanas, a divine splendour in the middle of the firmament appeared in front of him.

verses.sanskrit: अहं हि सर्वदेवानां प्रवर्तकनिवर्तकः । न विद्यते चाभ्यधिको मत्तो लोकेषु कश्चन
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ hi sarvadevānāṃ pravartakanivartakaḥ / na vidyate cābhyadhiko matto lokeṣu kaścana
verses.translation: On seeing that divine face over his head, the grand¬ father of the worlds saw a sphere of splendour spotless and terrible.
verses.hindi: माताके गोत्रको अथवा समान प्रवरवाले कुलको स्त्रीसे समागम करनेपर इन्द्रियजयी होकर एकाग्रतापूर्वक चान्द्रायणब्रत करनेसे शुद्धि होती है। (समागमके अयोग्य) ब्राह्मणीके साथ समागम करनेपर ब्राह्मणको
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing that divine face over his head, the grand¬ father of the worlds saw a sphere of splendour spotless and terrible.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing that divine face over his head, the grand¬ father of the worlds saw a sphere of splendour spotless and terrible.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यैवं मन्यमानस्य जज्ञे नारायणांशजः । प्रोवाच प्रहसन् वाक्यं रोषताम्रविलोचनः
verses.transliteration: tasyaivaṃ manyamānasya jajñe nārāyaṇāṃśajaḥ / provāca prahasan vākyaṃ roṣatāmravilocanaḥ
verses.translation: (Defective verse) * O Sankara, you are bom of my forehead formerly for the sake of knowledge (?) You are called Mahesana. Hence, seek refuge in me."
verses.hindi: एक कृच्छुव्रत करना चाहिए और कन्याको दूषित करनेपर चान्द्रायणव्रत करना चाहिए। अमानुषी स्त्री, रजस्वला, अयोनि तथा जलमें वीर्यपात करनेपर पुरुषको कृच्छुसांतपनत्रत करना चाहिए॥ ३१--३३ ॥ बन्धकीगमने विप्रस्त्ररात्रेण विशुध्यति। गवि मैथुनमासेव्य चरेच्चान्द्रायण्रतम्
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective verse) * O Sankara, you are bom of my forehead formerly for the sake of knowledge (?) You are called Mahesana. Hence, seek refuge in me."
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective verse) * O Sankara, you are bom of my forehead formerly for the sake of knowledge (?) You are called Mahesana. Hence, seek refuge in me."

verses.sanskrit: किं कारणमिदं ब्रह्मन् वर्तते तव सांप्रतम् । अज्ञानयोगयुक्तस्य न त्वेतदुचितं तव
verses.transliteration: kiṃ kāraṇamidaṃ brahman vartate tava sāṃpratam / ajñānayogayuktasya na tvetaducitaṃ tava
verses.translation: On hearing the arrogant words of the lotus-born deity, Isvara depatched his man Kalabhairava, the burner of worlds
verses.hindi: अजावीमैथुनं कृत्वा प्राजापत्यं चरेद् द्विजः । पतितां च स्त्रियं गत्वा त्रिभिः कृच्छैर्विशुध्यति
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the arrogant words of the lotus-born deity, Isvara depatched his man Kalabhairava, the burner of worlds
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the arrogant words of the lotus-born deity, Isvara depatched his man Kalabhairava, the burner of worlds

verses.sanskrit: अहं धाता हि लोकानां यज्ञो नारायणः प्रभुः । न मामृते ऽस्य जगतो जीवनं सर्वदा क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ dhātā hi lokānāṃ yajño nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ / na māmṛte 'sya jagato jīvanaṃ sarvadā kvacit
verses.translation: After fighting a great battle with Brahma, Kala- Bhairava slit the fifth face of Virinca (Brahma.)
verses.hindi: नटीं शैलूषकीं चैव रजकों वेणुजीविनीम्। गत्वा चान्द्रायणं कुर्यात् तथा चर्मोपजीविनीम् ब्रह्मचारी स्त्रियं गच्छेत् कथञ्चित्काममोहितः। सप्तागारं चरेद् भैक्षं वसित्वा गर्दभाजिनम्
verses.wordMeaning: After fighting a great battle with Brahma, Kala- Bhairava slit the fifth face of Virinca (Brahma.)
verses.commentary: Sense: After fighting a great battle with Brahma, Kala- Bhairava slit the fifth face of Virinca (Brahma.)

verses.sanskrit: अहमेव परं ज्योतिरहमेव परा गतिः । मत्प्रेरितेन भवता सृष्टं भुवनमण्डलम्
verses.transliteration: ahameva paraṃ jyotirahameva parā gatiḥ / matpreritena bhavatā sṛṣṭaṃ bhuvanamaṇḍalam
verses.translation: Brahma whose face was cut by lord Sambhu, died; but by means of the Yogic power of Isa, the holder of the universe (Brahma) regained his life.
verses.hindi: उपस्पृशेत् त्रिषवणं स्वपापं परिकीर्तयन्। संवत्सरेण चैकेन तस्मात् पापात् प्रमुच्यते
verses.wordMeaning: Brahma whose face was cut by lord Sambhu, died; but by means of the Yogic power of Isa, the holder of the universe (Brahma) regained his life.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahma whose face was cut by lord Sambhu, died; but by means of the Yogic power of Isa, the holder of the universe (Brahma) regained his life.

verses.sanskrit: एवं विवदतोर्मोहात् परस्परजयैषिणोः । आजग्मुर्यत्र तौ देवौ वेदाश्चत्वार एव हि
verses.transliteration: evaṃ vivadatormohāt parasparajayaiṣiṇoḥ / ājagmuryatra tau devau vedāścatvāra eva hi
verses.translation: Then he saw Isana, the eternal Mahadeva seated alongwith the great goddess and stationed in an other sphere of light.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्महत्याव्रतं वापि षण्मासानाचरेद् यमी। मुच्यते हावकीर्णी तु ब्राह्मणानुमते स्थितः ओंकारपूर्विकाभिस्तु महाव्याहतिभिः सदा। संवत्सरं तु भुञ्जानो नक्तं भिक्षाशनः शुचिः
verses.wordMeaning: Then he saw Isana, the eternal Mahadeva seated alongwith the great goddess and stationed in an other sphere of light.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then he saw Isana, the eternal Mahadeva seated alongwith the great goddess and stationed in an other sphere of light.

verses.sanskrit: अन्वीक्ष्य देवं ब्रह्माणं यज्ञात्मानं च संस्थितम् । प्रोचुः संविग्नहृदया याथात्म्यं परमेष्ठिनः
verses.transliteration: anvīkṣya devaṃ brahmāṇaṃ yajñātmānaṃ ca saṃsthitam / procuḥ saṃvignahṛdayā yāthātmyaṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ
verses.translation: He had the royal serpents for his bracelet; the cre¬ scent-moon as an ornament; he resembled a crore of suns (in brilliance), he shone with his matted hair.
verses.hindi: नदीतीरेषु तीर्थेषु तस्मात् पापाद् विमुच्यते
verses.wordMeaning: He had the royal serpents for his bracelet; the cre¬ scent-moon as an ornament; he resembled a crore of suns (in brilliance), he shone with his matted hair.
verses.commentary: Sense: He had the royal serpents for his bracelet; the cre¬ scent-moon as an ornament; he resembled a crore of suns (in brilliance), he shone with his matted hair.

verses.sanskrit: ऋग्वेद उवाच यस्यान्तः स्थानि भूतानि यस्मात्सर्वं प्रवर्तते । यदाहुस्तत्परं तत्त्वं स देवः स्यान्महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: ṛgveda uvāca yasyāntaḥ sthāni bhūtāni yasmātsarvaṃ pravartate / yadāhustatparaṃ tattvaṃ sa devaḥ syānmaheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: He was clad in the hide of a tiger; he was bedecked in divine garlands; he held the trident in his hand; he was a Yogin who could not be looked at (due to his brilliance.)
verses.hindi: हत्वा तु क्षत्रियं विप्रः कुर्याद् ब्रह्महणो व्रतम्। अकामतो वै षण्मासान् दद्यात् पञ्चशतं गवाम् प्राजापत्यं सान्तपनं तप्तकृच्छुं तु वा स्वयम्
verses.wordMeaning: He was clad in the hide of a tiger; he was bedecked in divine garlands; he held the trident in his hand; he was a Yogin who could not be looked at (due to his brilliance.)
verses.commentary: Sense: He was clad in the hide of a tiger; he was bedecked in divine garlands; he held the trident in his hand; he was a Yogin who could not be looked at (due to his brilliance.)

verses.sanskrit: यजुर्वेद उवाच यो यज्ञैरखिलैरीशो योगेन च समर्च्यते । यमाहुरीश्वरं देवं स देवः स्यात् पिनाकधृक्
verses.transliteration: yajurveda uvāca yo yajñairakhilairīśo yogena ca samarcyate / yamāhurīśvaraṃ devaṃ sa devaḥ syāt pinākadhṛk
verses.translation: He saw the primordial deity, the first deity, great lord whom those who are stabilised in Yoga see within their hearts as Is vara and Brahman.
verses.hindi: प्रमाप्याकामतो वैश्यं कुर्यात् संवत्सरद्दयम्। गोसहस्त्रं सपादं च दद्यात् ब्रह्महणो व्रतम्। वा कुर्याच्चान्द्रायणमथापि वा
verses.wordMeaning: He saw the primordial deity, the first deity, great lord whom those who are stabilised in Yoga see within their hearts as Is vara and Brahman.
verses.commentary: Sense: He saw the primordial deity, the first deity, great lord whom those who are stabilised in Yoga see within their hearts as Is vara and Brahman.

verses.sanskrit: सामवेद उवाच येनेदं भ्राम्यते चक्रं यदाकाशान्तरं शिवम् । योगिभिर्विद्यते तत्त्वं महादेवः स शङ्करः
verses.transliteration: sāmaveda uvāca yenedaṃ bhrāmyate cakraṃ yadākāśāntaraṃ śivam / yogibhirvidyate tattvaṃ mahādevaḥ sa śaṅkaraḥ
verses.translation: Verily, the great Lord whose supreme power, the god¬ dess, is designated as the sky (v.l. established in the firmament) and whose Yogic soul (?) infinite mfcayia (divine potencies like ■omniscience, omnipresence etc.) is seen indeed.
verses.hindi: व्यभिचारिणी स्त्रीके साथ गमन करनेपर ब्राह्मण तीन रातमें शुद्ध होता है। गौके साथ मैथुन करनेपर चान्द्रायणव्रतका पालन करना चाहिए। बकरी या भेड़ीके साथ मैथुन करनेवाले द्विजको प्राजापत्य-व्रत करना चाहिए। पतित स्त्रीके साथ सहवास करनेपर तीन कृच्छत्रतोंसे शुद्धि होती है । पुल्कसी (शूद्रामें निषादसे उत्पन्न स्त्री) - के साथ गमन करनेपर कृच्छ्चान्द्रायणव्रत करना चाहिए। नटी, नर्तकी धोबिन, बाँसके द्वारा तथा चर्मके द्वारा
verses.wordMeaning: Verily, the great Lord whose supreme power, the god¬ dess, is designated as the sky (v.l. established in the firmament) and whose Yogic soul (?) infinite mfcayia (divine potencies like ■omniscience, omnipresence etc.) is seen indeed.
verses.commentary: Sense: Verily, the great Lord whose supreme power, the god¬ dess, is designated as the sky (v.l. established in the firmament) and whose Yogic soul (?) infinite mfcayia (divine potencies like ■omniscience, omnipresence etc.) is seen indeed.

verses.sanskrit: अथर्ववेद उवाच यं प्रपश्यन्ति योगेशं यतन्तो यतयः परम् । महेशं पुरुषं रुद्रं स देवो भगवान् भवः
verses.transliteration: atharvaveda uvāca yaṃ prapaśyanti yogeśaṃ yatanto yatayaḥ param / maheśaṃ puruṣaṃ rudraṃ sa devo bhagavān bhavaḥ
verses.translation: That Rudra, on merely bowing to whom once, the deluding seed of the entire universe gets dissolved, is seen indeed.
verses.hindi: जीविका निर्वाह करनेवाली स्त्रीके साथ मैथुन करनेपर चान्द्रायण्रत करना चाहिए॥ ३४--३६॥
verses.wordMeaning: That Rudra, on merely bowing to whom once, the deluding seed of the entire universe gets dissolved, is seen indeed.
verses.commentary: Sense: That Rudra, on merely bowing to whom once, the deluding seed of the entire universe gets dissolved, is seen indeed.

verses.sanskrit: एवं स भगवान् ब्रह्मा वेदानामीरितं शुभम् । श्रुत्वाह प्रहसन् वाक्यं विश्वात्मापि विमोहितः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ sa bhagavān brahmā vedānāmīritaṃ śubham / śrutvāha prahasan vākyaṃ viśvātmāpi vimohitaḥ
verses.translation: (Defective Verse). Those who do not strictly abide by rules of good conduct but who are only great devotees of him are liberated by the Atman of the worlds. That Lord is now seen, indeed.
verses.hindi: कदाचित् यदि कामसे मोहित होकर ब्रह्मचारी स्त्रीक साथ गमन करता है तो उसे गदहेका चर्म धारणकर सात घरोंसे भिक्षा माँगनी चाहिए। अपने पापको प्रकट करते हुए तीनों कालोंमें स्नान करना चाहिए। इस प्रकार एक वर्षतक करनेसे वह इस पापसे मुक्त हो जाता है। अवकीर्णी (ब्रह्मचर्यव्रतसे च्युत संन्यासी या ब्रह्मचारी) ब्राह्मणके कथनानुसार संयमपूर्वक छः मासतक ब्रह्महत्या-सम्बन्धी व्रत करनेसे (इस
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective Verse). Those who do not strictly abide by rules of good conduct but who are only great devotees of him are liberated by the Atman of the worlds. That Lord is now seen, indeed.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective Verse). Those who do not strictly abide by rules of good conduct but who are only great devotees of him are liberated by the Atman of the worlds. That Lord is now seen, indeed.

verses.sanskrit: कथं तत्परमं ब्रह्म सर्वसङ्गविवर्जितम् । रमते भार्यया सार्धं प्रमथैश्चातिगर्वितैः
verses.transliteration: kathaṃ tatparamaṃ brahma sarvasaṅgavivarjitam / ramate bhāryayā sārdhaṃ pramathaiścātigarvitaiḥ
verses.translation: That Siva whose Linga is always worshipped by Brahma and other Devas as well as by the sages, the expoun¬ ders of Brahman, has indeed become visible.
verses.hindi: पापसे) मुक्त हो जाता है। यदि सात अहोरात्रतक समर्थ रहनेपर भी भिक्षाचरण तथा अग्निहोत्र न करे तथा बुद्धिपूर्वक अपने शुक्र (वीर्य)-का परित्याग करे तो इस प्रकारका प्रायश्चित्त करना चाहिए-नदी-तीरमें
verses.wordMeaning: That Siva whose Linga is always worshipped by Brahma and other Devas as well as by the sages, the expoun¬ ders of Brahman, has indeed become visible.
verses.commentary: Sense: That Siva whose Linga is always worshipped by Brahma and other Devas as well as by the sages, the expoun¬ ders of Brahman, has indeed become visible.

verses.sanskrit: इतिरिते ऽथ भगवान् प्रणवात्मा सनातनः । अमूर्तो मूर्तिमान् भूत्वा वचः प्राह पितामहम्
verses.transliteration: itirite 'tha bhagavān praṇavātmā sanātanaḥ / amūrto mūrtimān bhūtvā vacaḥ prāha pitāmaham
verses.translation: That Sankara is seen whose side (i.e. proximity) is never left off by Isvara*, the cause of origin of the entire universe and whose body is Vijndna (Perfect knowledge).
verses.hindi: अथवा तीर्थमें एक वर्षतक शान्तभावसे पवित्रताके साथ प्रणब एवं महाव्याहतियोंसे युक्त सावित्री (गायत्री)- का निरन्तर जप करे और भिक्षामात्रसे प्राप्त अन्न केवल रात्रिमें ग्रहण करे। ऐसा करनेसे उपर्युक्त दोनों पापोंसे बुद्धिपूर्वक क्षत्रियको हत्या करनेपर ब्राह्मणको ब्रह्महत्या-सम्बन्धी व्रतका पालन करना चाहिए  अनचाहे क्षत्रियकी हत्या हो जानेपर छः महीनेतक पाँच सौ गायोंका दान करना चाहिए। अथवा स्वयं वनमें रहते हुए एक
verses.wordMeaning: That Sankara is seen whose side (i.e. proximity) is never left off by Isvara*, the cause of origin of the entire universe and whose body is Vijndna (Perfect knowledge).
verses.commentary: Sense: That Sankara is seen whose side (i.e. proximity) is never left off by Isvara*, the cause of origin of the entire universe and whose body is Vijndna (Perfect knowledge).

verses.sanskrit: प्रणव उवाच न ह्येष भगवान् पत्न्या स्वात्मनो व्यतिरिक्तया । कदाचिद् रमते रुद्रस्तादृशो हि महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: praṇava uvāca na hyeṣa bhagavān patnyā svātmano vyatiriktayā / kadācid ramate rudrastādṛśo hi maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: That Isvara is indeed seen—Isvara, the son of Hiranyagarbha, in whose circular halo of light is seen the Lord who is accompanied by Vidya.
verses.hindi: वर्षतक एकाग्रतापूर्वक संयमित होकर प्राजापत्य, सान्तपन अथवा तत्तकृच्छत्रत करना चाहिए। अनिच्छापूर्वक वैश्यकी हत्या करनेपर दो वर्षतक ब्रह्महत्या-सम्बन्धी व्रतका पालन करना चाहिए तथा एक हजार दो सौ पचास
verses.wordMeaning: That Isvara is indeed seen—Isvara, the son of Hiranyagarbha, in whose circular halo of light is seen the Lord who is accompanied by Vidya.
verses.commentary: Sense: That Isvara is indeed seen—Isvara, the son of Hiranyagarbha, in whose circular halo of light is seen the Lord who is accompanied by Vidya.

verses.sanskrit: अयं स भगवानीशः स्वयञ्ज्योतिः सनातनः । स्वानन्दभूता कथिता देवी नागन्तुका शिवा
verses.transliteration: ayaṃ sa bhagavānīśaḥ svayañjyotiḥ sanātanaḥ / svānandabhūtā kathitā devī nāgantukā śivā
verses.translation: Indeed that Rudra is seen—Rudra atwhose feet (if) anyone were to pour water or place a flower or a leaf, he crosses the ocean of existence.
verses.hindi: गायोंका दान करना चाहिए अथवा कृच्छू या अतिकृच्छुव्रत एवं चान्द्रायणव्रत करना चाहिए ॥ ४३--४५ ॥ गोसहस्त्रार्धपादं च दद्यात् तत्पापशान्तये
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed that Rudra is seen—Rudra atwhose feet (if) anyone were to pour water or place a flower or a leaf, he crosses the ocean of existence.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed that Rudra is seen—Rudra atwhose feet (if) anyone were to pour water or place a flower or a leaf, he crosses the ocean of existence.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येवमुक्ते ऽपि तदा यज्ञमूर्तेरजस्य च । नाज्ञानमगमन्नाशमीश्वरस्यैव मायया
verses.transliteration: ityevamukte 'pi tadā yajñamūrterajasya ca / nājñānamagamannāśamīśvarasyaiva māyayā
verses.translation: Due to his presence, the eternal Time controls the entire universe (and Time-units?). The god whose soul is Yoga and who is the governor ofKala*
verses.hindi: अष्टौ वर्षाणि षट् त्रीणि कुर्याद् ब्रह्महणो व्रतम्। हत्वा तु क्षत्रियं वैश्यं शूद्रं चैव यथाक्रमम्
verses.wordMeaning: Due to his presence, the eternal Time controls the entire universe (and Time-units?). The god whose soul is Yoga and who is the governor ofKala*
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to his presence, the eternal Time controls the entire universe (and Time-units?). The god whose soul is Yoga and who is the governor ofKala*

verses.sanskrit: तदन्तरे महाज्योतिर्विरिञ्चो विश्वभावनः । प्रापश्यदद्भुतं दिव्यं पूरयन् गगनान्तरम्
verses.transliteration: tadantare mahājyotirviriñco viśvabhāvanaḥ / prāpaśyadadbhutaṃ divyaṃ pūrayan gaganāntaram
verses.translation: That Soma (god Siva who is accompanied by Uma) is seen—the god whose ornament is Soma (the moon)—the life of all the worlds and an ornament unto the three worlds.
verses.hindi: पराकेणाथवा शुद्िरित्याह भगवानजः मण्डूकं नकुलं काकं दन्दशूकं च मूषिकम्। श्वानं हत्वा द्विजः कुर्यात् षोडशांशं व्रतं तत:
verses.wordMeaning: That Soma (god Siva who is accompanied by Uma) is seen—the god whose ornament is Soma (the moon)—the life of all the worlds and an ornament unto the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: That Soma (god Siva who is accompanied by Uma) is seen—the god whose ornament is Soma (the moon)—the life of all the worlds and an ornament unto the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: तन्मध्यसंस्थं विमलं मण्डलं तेजसोज्ज्वलम् । व्योममध्यगतं दिव्यं प्रादुरासीद् द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: tanmadhyasaṃsthaṃ vimalaṃ maṇḍalaṃ tejasojjvalam / vyomamadhyagataṃ divyaṃ prādurāsīd dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: The great God (Mahadeva) whose natural eternal union with goddess Uma is ever seen and the great liberation (on seeing hirri) is extolled (as being attained) is now seen.
verses.hindi: अश्रीं कार्ष्णायसीं दद्यात् सर्प हत्वा द्विजोत्तमः। पलालभारं षण्डं च सैसकं चैकमाषकम्
verses.wordMeaning: The great God (Mahadeva) whose natural eternal union with goddess Uma is ever seen and the great liberation (on seeing hirri) is extolled (as being attained) is now seen.
verses.commentary: Sense: The great God (Mahadeva) whose natural eternal union with goddess Uma is ever seen and the great liberation (on seeing hirri) is extolled (as being attained) is now seen.

verses.sanskrit: स दृष्ट्वा वदनं दिव्यं मूर्ध्नि लोकपितामहः । तेन तन्मण्जलं घोरमालोकयदनिन्दितम्
verses.transliteration: sa dṛṣṭvā vadanaṃ divyaṃ mūrdhni lokapitāmahaḥ / tena tanmaṇjalaṃ ghoramālokayadaninditam
verses.translation: (Defective) Yogins, well-versed in the principles of Yoga, always meditate upon his union with the goddess, though he always faces separation** from the world (?) That Yogin is indeed seen.
verses.hindi: हत्वा हंसं बलाकां च बकं बर्हिणमेव च। वानरं श्येनभासौ च स्पर्शयेद् ब्राह्मणाय गाम् प्रमादनश शूद्रकी हत्या करनेपर इस पापके शमनके लिये एक वर्षतक ब्रह्महत्याका व्रत करना चाहिए और एक हजार एक सौ पचीस गौओंका दान करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective) Yogins, well-versed in the principles of Yoga, always meditate upon his union with the goddess, though he always faces separation** from the world (?) That Yogin is indeed seen.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective) Yogins, well-versed in the principles of Yoga, always meditate upon his union with the goddess, though he always faces separation** from the world (?) That Yogin is indeed seen.

verses.sanskrit: प्रजज्वालातिकोपेन ब्रह्मणः पञ्चमं शिरः । क्षणाददृश्यत महान् पुरुषो नीललोहितः
verses.transliteration: prajajvālātikopena brahmaṇaḥ pañcamaṃ śiraḥ / kṣaṇādadṛśyata mahān puruṣo nīlalohitaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing the eternal Mahadeva seated in an excel¬ lent seat along with the great goddess, he attained the greatest perfect recollection.
verses.hindi: क्षत्रिय, वैश्य, शूद्र-इनमेंसे किसी एकका वध करनेपर क्रमश: आठ, छः तथा तीन वर्षतक ब्रह्महत्या- सम्बन्धी व्रतका पालन करना चाहिए। ब्राह्मणीको हत्या करनेपर ब्राह्मणको आठ वर्षतक ब्रह्महत्याके व्रतका
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing the eternal Mahadeva seated in an excel¬ lent seat along with the great goddess, he attained the greatest perfect recollection.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the eternal Mahadeva seated in an excel¬ lent seat along with the great goddess, he attained the greatest perfect recollection.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिशूलपिङ्गलो देवो नागयज्ञोपवीतवान् । तं प्राह भगवान् ब्रह्मा शङ्करं नीललोहितम्
verses.transliteration: triśūlapiṅgalo devo nāgayajñopavītavān / taṃ prāha bhagavān brahmā śaṅkaraṃ nīlalohitam
verses.translation: Gaining the divine recollection pertaining to Mahes- vara, lord Aja (Brahma) propitiated the moonbedecked lord,, the bestower of boons who was accompanied by Uma.
verses.hindi: पालन करना चाहिए। क्षत्राणीकी हत्या करनेपर छः वर्षतक और वैश्याकी हत्या होनेपर तीन वर्षतक तथा शूद्राकी हत्या होनेपर एक वर्षतक ब्रह्महत्या-सम्बन्धी ब्रतका पालन करनेसे द्विजोत्तम शुद्ध हो जाता है। प्रमादवश वैश्यकी स्त्रीकी हत्या करनेपर द्विजको किञ्चित् दान करना चाहिए। अन्त्यजोंका वध होनेपर चान्द्रायण-व्रत करना चाहिए अथवा भगवान् ब्रह्माने पराकव्रतके द्वारा शुद्धि बतलायी है ॥ ४७--४९॥
verses.wordMeaning: Gaining the divine recollection pertaining to Mahes- vara, lord Aja (Brahma) propitiated the moonbedecked lord,, the bestower of boons who was accompanied by Uma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gaining the divine recollection pertaining to Mahes- vara, lord Aja (Brahma) propitiated the moonbedecked lord,, the bestower of boons who was accompanied by Uma.

verses.sanskrit: जानामि भवतः पूर्वं ललाटादेव शङ्कर । प्रादुर्भावं महेशान् मामेव शरणं व्रज
verses.transliteration: jānāmi bhavataḥ pūrvaṃ lalāṭādeva śaṅkara / prādurbhāvaṃ maheśān māmeva śaraṇaṃ vraja
verses.translation: Obeisance|[to the great God. Repeated bows to the great goddess. Hail to Siva the quiescent; perpetual obeisance unto Siva (goddess Uma).
verses.hindi: चूहा अथवा कुत्तेकी हत्या करनेपर द्विजको व्रतके सोलहवें अंशका पालन करना चाहिए। कुत्तेकी हत्या करनेपर सावधान होकर तीन रात्रिपर्यन्त दूधमात्र पीकर रहना चाहिए। बिल्ली अथवा नेवलेका वध हो जानेपर
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance|[to the great God. Repeated bows to the great goddess. Hail to Siva the quiescent; perpetual obeisance unto Siva (goddess Uma).
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance|[to the great God. Repeated bows to the great goddess. Hail to Siva the quiescent; perpetual obeisance unto Siva (goddess Uma).

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा सगर्ववचनं पद्मयोनेरथेश्वरः । प्राहिणोत् पुरुषं कालं भैरवं लोकदाहकम्
verses.transliteration: śrutvā sagarvavacanaṃ padmayoneratheśvaraḥ / prāhiṇot puruṣaṃ kālaṃ bhairavaṃ lokadāhakam
verses.translation: Om bow unto you the Brahman, obeisance, obeis¬ ance to you who are the Vidya (Maya), Obeisance to you
verses.hindi: एक योजन (चार कोस) -तक मार्गमें (अनशनपूर्वक) चलना चाहिए। द्विजको अश्वका वध करनेपर बारह रात्रिपर्यन्त कृच्छुत्रत करना चाहिए। द्विंजोत्तमको चाहिए कि वह सर्पको मारनेपर काले लोहेकी अभ्री (तीक्ष्ण अग्रभागवाला लोहदण्ड)-की प्रतिमा दान करे। साँड्की हत्या करनेपर एक भार धानको भूसी तथा एक मासा सीसा दान देना चाहिए ॥ ५०--५२॥
verses.wordMeaning: Om bow unto you the Brahman, obeisance, obeis¬ ance to you who are the Vidya (Maya), Obeisance to you
verses.commentary: Sense: Om bow unto you the Brahman, obeisance, obeis¬ ance to you who are the Vidya (Maya), Obeisance to you

verses.sanskrit: स कृत्वा सुमहद् युद्धं ब्रह्मणा कालभैरवः । चकर्त तस्य वदनं विरिञ्चस्याथ पञ्चमम्
verses.transliteration: sa kṛtvā sumahad yuddhaṃ brahmaṇā kālabhairavaḥ / cakarta tasya vadanaṃ viriñcasyātha pañcamam
verses.translation: Salutation to one whose body is Vijnana; obeisance, obeisance to you Cinta (goddess of contemplation); Hail to the destroyer of Kala; obeisance again and again to Isvara (the goddess).
verses.hindi: वराहकी हत्या करनेपर घृतसे भरा घड़ा और तितिरकी हत्या करनेपर एक द्रोण तिल देना चाहिए। शुककी हत्या करनेपर दो वर्षतकके (गायका) बछडा, क्रौञ्चको मारनेपर तीन वर्षके (गायके ) बछड़ेका दान
verses.wordMeaning: Salutation to one whose body is Vijnana; obeisance, obeisance to you Cinta (goddess of contemplation); Hail to the destroyer of Kala; obeisance again and again to Isvara (the goddess).
verses.commentary: Sense: Salutation to one whose body is Vijnana; obeisance, obeisance to you Cinta (goddess of contemplation); Hail to the destroyer of Kala; obeisance again and again to Isvara (the goddess).

verses.sanskrit: निकृत्तवदनो देवो ब्रह्मा देवेन शंभुना । ममार चेशयोगेन जीवितं प्राप विश्वसृक्
verses.transliteration: nikṛttavadano devo brahmā devena śaṃbhunā / mamāra ceśayogena jīvitaṃ prāpa viśvasṛk
verses.translation: Obeisance, again and again to Rudra; salutations again and again to RudranI; obeisance, obeisance to you, Kala (Time or Death); Repeated bows to you, the Maya (the Deluding Potency).
verses.hindi: करना चाहिए। हंस, बलाका (वक-पंक्ति), बक (बगुला), मोर, वानर, बाज एवं गिद्धका वध करनेपर ब्राह्मणके लिये गौका दान करना चाहिए मांस भक्षण करनेवाले अरण्यके पशुओं (व्याघ्र
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance, again and again to Rudra; salutations again and again to RudranI; obeisance, obeisance to you, Kala (Time or Death); Repeated bows to you, the Maya (the Deluding Potency).
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance, again and again to Rudra; salutations again and again to RudranI; obeisance, obeisance to you, Kala (Time or Death); Repeated bows to you, the Maya (the Deluding Potency).

verses.sanskrit: अथानुपश्यद् गिरिशं मण्डलान्तरसंस्थितम् । समासीनं महादेव्या महादेवं सनातनम्
verses.transliteration: athānupaśyad giriśaṃ maṇḍalāntarasaṃsthitam / samāsīnaṃ mahādevyā mahādevaṃ sanātanam
verses.translation: Obeisance to the controller of all effects; obeisance to her who agitates. Hail to you, the Prakrti and obeisance to Narayana.
verses.hindi: अक्रव्यादान् वत्सतरीमुष्ट्रं हत्वा तु कृष्णलम् ॥ ५५॥  आदि)-की हत्या करनेपर पयस्विनी गौका दान करना
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the controller of all effects; obeisance to her who agitates. Hail to you, the Prakrti and obeisance to Narayana.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the controller of all effects; obeisance to her who agitates. Hail to you, the Prakrti and obeisance to Narayana.

verses.sanskrit: भुजङ्गराजवलयं चन्द्रावयवभूषणम् । कोटिसूर्यप्रतीकाशं जटाजूटविराजितम्
verses.transliteration: bhujaṅgarājavalayaṃ candrāvayavabhūṣaṇam / koṭisūryapratīkāśaṃ jaṭājūṭavirājitam
verses.translation: Obeisance to you the bestower of Yoga. Salutations to the preceptor of Yogins; obeisance to one abiding in the world* (?). Bow to the source of origin of the world.
verses.hindi: किञ्चिदेव तु विप्राय दद्यादस्थिमतां वधे। अनस्थ्रां चैव हिंसायां प्राणायामेन शुध्यति चाहिए। मांस न खानेवाले पशुओं--हरिण, खंजरीट आदिको हत्या करनेपर (गौकी) बछड़ीका दान करना चाहिए और ऊँटका वध करनेपर कृष्णलका (घुँघची अर्थात् एक रत्ती सुवर्णका) दान करना चाहिए। अस्थिवाले
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you the bestower of Yoga. Salutations to the preceptor of Yogins; obeisance to one abiding in the world* (?). Bow to the source of origin of the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you the bestower of Yoga. Salutations to the preceptor of Yogins; obeisance to one abiding in the world* (?). Bow to the source of origin of the world.

verses.sanskrit: शार्दूलचर्मवसनं दिव्यमालासमन्वितम् । त्रिशूलपाणिं दुष्प्रेक्ष्यं योगिनं भूतिभूषणम्
verses.transliteration: śārdūlacarmavasanaṃ divyamālāsamanvitam / triśūlapāṇiṃ duṣprekṣyaṃ yoginaṃ bhūtibhūṣaṇam
verses.translation: Obeisance be to the lord of perpetual Bliss; Hail to one whose very form is Bliss; obeisance to one devoid of actions; salutation to the material cause of the universe.
verses.hindi: पशु-पक्षीका वध करनेपर ब्राह्मणको किञ्चित् दान करना चाहिए और बिना अस्थिवाले पशु-पक्षीका वध होनेपर प्राणायाम करनेसे शुद्धि होती है
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance be to the lord of perpetual Bliss; Hail to one whose very form is Bliss; obeisance to one devoid of actions; salutation to the material cause of the universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance be to the lord of perpetual Bliss; Hail to one whose very form is Bliss; obeisance to one devoid of actions; salutation to the material cause of the universe.

verses.sanskrit: यमन्तरा योगनिष्ठाः प्रपश्यन्ति हृदीश्वरम् । तमादिदेवं ब्रह्माणं महादेवं ददर्श ह
verses.transliteration: yamantarā yoganiṣṭhāḥ prapaśyanti hṛdīśvaram / tamādidevaṃ brahmāṇaṃ mahādevaṃ dadarśa ha
verses.translation: Obeisance to you whose body is Oihkara; obeisance to you stationed therein. Hail to you stationed in the firma¬ ment; obeisance, again and again to the Sakti (potency) of the firmament.
verses.hindi: फलदार वृक्षोंके काटनेपर एक सौ ऋचाओंका जप करना चाहिए। गुल्म, वल्ली, लता तथा फूलवाले वृक्षों और अन्य सभी प्रकारके रसवाले, फल तथा पुष्प देनेवाले वृक्षोंको नष्ट करनेपर घृत-प्राशन करनेसे शुद्धि होती है। हाथीका वध करनेपर तप्तकृच्छ्व्रत करनेसे शुद्धि होती है । प्रमादवश गौकी हत्या करनेपर चान्द्रायण अथवा पराकब्रत करना चाहिए और जान-बूझकर वध
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you whose body is Oihkara; obeisance to you stationed therein. Hail to you stationed in the firma¬ ment; obeisance, again and again to the Sakti (potency) of the firmament.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you whose body is Oihkara; obeisance to you stationed therein. Hail to you stationed in the firma¬ ment; obeisance, again and again to the Sakti (potency) of the firmament.

verses.sanskrit: यस्य सा परमा देवी शक्तिराकाशसंस्थिता । सो ऽनन्तैश्वर्ययोगात्मा महेशो दृश्यते किल
verses.transliteration: yasya sā paramā devī śaktirākāśasaṃsthitā / so 'nantaiśvaryayogātmā maheśo dṛśyate kila
verses.translation: Making obeisance thus to Isa by means of "Somas- taka" (eight verses eulogising the lord accompanied by Uma) god Brahma fell on the ground like a piece of log, repeating the mantras of Satarudriya.
verses.hindi: मतिपूर्व वधे चास्याः प्रायश्चित्तं न विद्यते ॥ ५९॥  करनेपर इस हिंसाका कोई प्रायश्चित्त नहीं है
verses.wordMeaning: Making obeisance thus to Isa by means of "Somas- taka" (eight verses eulogising the lord accompanied by Uma) god Brahma fell on the ground like a piece of log, repeating the mantras of Satarudriya.
verses.commentary: Sense: Making obeisance thus to Isa by means of "Somas- taka" (eight verses eulogising the lord accompanied by Uma) god Brahma fell on the ground like a piece of log, repeating the mantras of Satarudriya.

verses.sanskrit: यस्याशेषजगद् बीजं विलयं याति मोहनम् । सकृत्प्रणाममात्रेण स रुद्रः खलु दृश्यते
verses.transliteration: yasyāśeṣajagad bījaṃ vilayaṃ yāti mohanam / sakṛtpraṇāmamātreṇa sa rudraḥ khalu dṛśyate
verses.translation: Then Lord Mahadeva, Hara, the remover of the distress of those who bow to him, raised him by means of his hands and said: "I am now pleased with you."
verses.hindi: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहरूयाँ संहितायामुपरिविभागे द्वात्रिंशोऽध्यायः प्रायश्चित्त-प्रकरणमें चोरी तथा अभक्ष्य-भक्षणका प्रायश्चित्त, प्रकीर्ण पापोंका प्रायश्चित्त, समस्त पापोंकी एकत्र मुक्तिके विविध उपाय,पतिव्रताको कोई पाप नहीं लगता, पतिब्रताके माहात्म्यमें देवी सीताका आख्यान, सौीताद्वारा अग्रिस्तुति, ज्ञानयोगकी प्रशंसा तथा प्रायश्चित्त-प्रकरणका उपसंहार
verses.wordMeaning: Then Lord Mahadeva, Hara, the remover of the distress of those who bow to him, raised him by means of his hands and said: "I am now pleased with you."
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Lord Mahadeva, Hara, the remover of the distress of those who bow to him, raised him by means of his hands and said: "I am now pleased with you."

verses.sanskrit: यो ऽथ नाचारनिरतान् स्वभक्तानेव केवलम् । विमोचयति लोकानां नायको दृश्यते किल
verses.transliteration: yo 'tha nācāraniratān svabhaktāneva kevalam / vimocayati lokānāṃ nāyako dṛśyate kila
verses.translation: After bestowing great Yoga and the great unequalled AiSvarya (prowess) on him (Brahma) he (god Siva) spoke to' Rudra, Lord Nilalohita who was standing in front of him.
verses.hindi: धान्यान्नधनचौर्य तु कृत्वा कामाद् द्विजोत्तमः । स्वजातीयगृहादेव कृच्छार्धन विशुध्यति
verses.wordMeaning: After bestowing great Yoga and the great unequalled AiSvarya (prowess) on him (Brahma) he (god Siva) spoke to' Rudra, Lord Nilalohita who was standing in front of him.
verses.commentary: Sense: After bestowing great Yoga and the great unequalled AiSvarya (prowess) on him (Brahma) he (god Siva) spoke to' Rudra, Lord Nilalohita who was standing in front of him.

verses.sanskrit: यस्य वेदविदः शान्ता निर्द्वन्द्वा ब्रह्मचारिणः । विदन्ति विमलं रूपं स शंभुर्दृश्यते किल
verses.transliteration: yasya vedavidaḥ śāntā nirdvandvā brahmacāriṇaḥ / vidanti vimalaṃ rūpaṃ sa śaṃbhurdṛśyate kila
verses.translation: This is god Brahma. He is the most venerable one unto this universe. He is the first one to stay in this universe; He is elder to you by means of the Guna; He is to be protected by you. He is your father.
verses.hindi: तृणकाष्ठद्रुमाणां च शुष्कान्नस्य गुडस्य च। व्यासजीने कहा--मनुष्य, स्त्री, गृह, वापी, कूप तथा जलाशयोंका अपहरण करनेपर चान्द्रायणव्रत करनेसे शुद्धि होती है। दूसरेके घरोंसे अल्प सारवाली अर्थात् सामान्य वस्तुओंको चोरी करनेपर उस पापसे अपनी
verses.wordMeaning: This is god Brahma. He is the most venerable one unto this universe. He is the first one to stay in this universe; He is elder to you by means of the Guna; He is to be protected by you. He is your father.
verses.commentary: Sense: This is god Brahma. He is the most venerable one unto this universe. He is the first one to stay in this universe; He is elder to you by means of the Guna; He is to be protected by you. He is your father.

verses.sanskrit: यस्य ब्रह्मादयो देवा ऋषयो ब्रह्मवादिनः । अर्चयन्ति सदा लिङ्गं विश्वेशः खलु दृश्यते
verses.transliteration: yasya brahmādayo devā ṛṣayo brahmavādinaḥ / arcayanti sadā liṅgaṃ viśveśaḥ khalu dṛśyate
verses.translation: He is the ancient Purusa; O sinless one, he should not be killed by you. Thanks to the greatness of his Yoga and Aiivarya (divine powers and faculties), he has sought refuge in me alone.
verses.hindi: शुद्धिके लिये कृच्छ्सान्तपनक्रत करना चाहिए । द्विजोत्तम यदि इच्छापूर्वक अपनी जातिवाले बान्धवोंके घरसे धान्य, अन्न अथवा धनकी चोरी करे तो अर्धकृच्छत्रतका पालन करनेसे शुद्ध होता है। भक्ष्य एवं भोज्य पदार्थो तथा
verses.wordMeaning: He is the ancient Purusa; O sinless one, he should not be killed by you. Thanks to the greatness of his Yoga and Aiivarya (divine powers and faculties), he has sought refuge in me alone.
verses.commentary: Sense: He is the ancient Purusa; O sinless one, he should not be killed by you. Thanks to the greatness of his Yoga and Aiivarya (divine powers and faculties), he has sought refuge in me alone.

verses.sanskrit: यस्याशेषजगद् बीजं विलयं याति मोहनम् । सकृत्प्रणाममात्रेण स रुद्रः खलु दृश्यते
verses.transliteration: yasyāśeṣajagad bījaṃ vilayaṃ yāti mohanam / sakṛtpraṇāmamātreṇa sa rudraḥ khalu dṛśyate
verses.translation: And he is sacrifice and that is his pride (v.l. He is the venerable sacrifice himself). His pride is to be chastened by you. You have to carry with you Brahma's head.
verses.hindi: यान, शय्या, आसन, पुष्प, मूल तथा फलोंकी चोरीकी शुद्धि पञ्चगव्य-प्राशनसे होती है। तृण, काष्ठ, वृक्ष, शुष्कान्न, गुड़, वस्त्र, चर्म तथा मांसकी चोरी करनेपर तीन रात्रितक भोजन नहीं करना चाहिए अयःकांस्योपलानां च द्वादशाहं कणाशनम्
verses.wordMeaning: And he is sacrifice and that is his pride (v.l. He is the venerable sacrifice himself). His pride is to be chastened by you. You have to carry with you Brahma's head.
verses.commentary: Sense: And he is sacrifice and that is his pride (v.l. He is the venerable sacrifice himself). His pride is to be chastened by you. You have to carry with you Brahma's head.

verses.sanskrit: विद्यासहायो भगवान् यस्यासौ मण्डलान्तरम् । हिरण्यगर्भपुत्रो ऽसावीश्वरो दृश्यते किल
verses.transliteration: vidyāsahāyo bhagavān yasyāsau maṇḍalāntaram / hiraṇyagarbhaputro 'sāvīśvaro dṛśyate kila
verses.translation: Demonstrating to the world the expiatory rite for dispelling the sin of the slaughter of a Brahmana, go abegging. You should establish Devas and the Brahmanas."
verses.hindi: कार्पासकीटजोर्णानां द्विशफैकशफस्य च। पक्षिगन्धौषधीनां च रज्ज्वाश्चैव त्र्यहं पयः
verses.wordMeaning: Demonstrating to the world the expiatory rite for dispelling the sin of the slaughter of a Brahmana, go abegging. You should establish Devas and the Brahmanas."
verses.commentary: Sense: Demonstrating to the world the expiatory rite for dispelling the sin of the slaughter of a Brahmana, go abegging. You should establish Devas and the Brahmanas."

verses.sanskrit: यस्याशेषजगत्सूतिर्विज्ञानतनुरीश्वरी । न मुञ्चति सदा पार्श्वं शङ्करो ऽसावदृश्यत
verses.transliteration: yasyāśeṣajagatsūtirvijñānatanurīśvarī / na muñcati sadā pārśvaṃ śaṅkaro 'sāvadṛśyata
verses.translation: After addressing these words to Paramesvara (i.e. Rudra), the supreme lord went to his divine natural abode, the greatest region.
verses.hindi: काकं चैव तथा शवानं जग्ध्वा हस्तिनमेव च। वराहं कुक्कुटं चाथ तप्तकृच्छ्रेण शुध्यति गोगोमायुकपीनां च तदेव व्रतमाचरेत्। उपोष्य द्वादशाहं तु कूष्माण्डैर्जुहुयाद् घृतम्
verses.wordMeaning: After addressing these words to Paramesvara (i.e. Rudra), the supreme lord went to his divine natural abode, the greatest region.
verses.commentary: Sense: After addressing these words to Paramesvara (i.e. Rudra), the supreme lord went to his divine natural abode, the greatest region.

verses.sanskrit: पुष्पं वा यदि वा पत्रं यत्पादयुगले जलम् । दत्त्वा तरति संसारं रुद्रो ऽसौ दृश्यते किल
verses.transliteration: puṣpaṃ vā yadi vā patraṃ yatpādayugale jalam / dattvā tarati saṃsāraṃ rudro 'sau dṛśyate kila
verses.translation: Thereafter, lord Isa, Nilalohita of matted hairmade Kalabhairava hold god Brahma's head.
verses.hindi: व्रतवच्यैव संस्कारं पूर्वेण विधिनैव तु
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, lord Isa, Nilalohita of matted hairmade Kalabhairava hold god Brahma's head.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, lord Isa, Nilalohita of matted hairmade Kalabhairava hold god Brahma's head.

verses.sanskrit: तत्सन्निधाने सकलं नियच्छति सनातनः । कालः किल स योगात्मा कालकालो हि दृश्यते
verses.transliteration: tatsannidhāne sakalaṃ niyacchati sanātanaḥ / kālaḥ kila sa yogātmā kālakālo hi dṛśyate
verses.translation: For the purpose of quelling the sin (of Brahmana- slaughter) you perform the beneficial holy rite in the world. With the skull in the hand, you beg for alms all round."
verses.hindi: बकं चैव बलाकं च हंसं कारण्डवं तथा। चक्रवाकं प्लवं जग्ध्वा द्वादशाहमभोजनम् जग्ध्वा चैव कटाहारमेतदेव चरेद् व्रतम्
verses.wordMeaning: For the purpose of quelling the sin (of Brahmana- slaughter) you perform the beneficial holy rite in the world. With the skull in the hand, you beg for alms all round."
verses.commentary: Sense: For the purpose of quelling the sin (of Brahmana- slaughter) you perform the beneficial holy rite in the world. With the skull in the hand, you beg for alms all round."

verses.sanskrit: जीवनं सर्वलोकानां त्रिलोकस्यैव भूषणम् । सोमः स दृश्यते देवः सोमो यस्य विभूषणम्
verses.transliteration: jīvanaṃ sarvalokānāṃ trilokasyaiva bhūṣaṇam / somaḥ sa dṛśyate devaḥ somo yasya vibhūṣaṇam
verses.translation: After saying thus, he sent his daughter well known as Brahmahatya whose face was terrible due to the curved fangs and who had clusters of flames for ornaments.
verses.hindi: कोकिलं चैव मत्स्यांश्च मण्डूकं भुजगं तथा। गोमूत्रयावकाहारो मासेनैकेन शुध्यति
verses.wordMeaning: After saying thus, he sent his daughter well known as Brahmahatya whose face was terrible due to the curved fangs and who had clusters of flames for ornaments.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying thus, he sent his daughter well known as Brahmahatya whose face was terrible due to the curved fangs and who had clusters of flames for ornaments.

verses.sanskrit: देव्या सह सदा साक्षाद् यस्य योगः स्वभावतः । गीयते परमा मुक्तिः स योगी दृश्यते किल
verses.transliteration: devyā saha sadā sākṣād yasya yogaḥ svabhāvataḥ / gīyate paramā muktiḥ sa yogī dṛśyate kila
verses.translation: Assuming a terribly hideous form follow the trident¬ bearing deity as long as he enters the divine city of Varanasi."
verses.hindi: भुवत्वा मासं चरेदेतत् तत्पापस्यापनुत्तये वार्ताकं भूस्तृणं शिगुं खुखुण्डं करकं तथा। प्राजापत्यं चरेजग्ध्वा शंखं कुम्भीकमेव च
verses.wordMeaning: Assuming a terribly hideous form follow the trident¬ bearing deity as long as he enters the divine city of Varanasi."
verses.commentary: Sense: Assuming a terribly hideous form follow the trident¬ bearing deity as long as he enters the divine city of Varanasi."

verses.sanskrit: योगिनो योगतत्त्वज्ञा वियोगाभिमुखानिशम् । योगं ध्यायन्ति देव्यासौ स योगी दृश्यते किल
verses.transliteration: yogino yogatattvajñā viyogābhimukhāniśam / yogaṃ dhyāyanti devyāsau sa yogī dṛśyate kila
verses.translation: After saying this, he spoke to Kalagni (Kala bhairava) the great Isvara of the worlds—"At my behest, wander over all the worlds seeking alms.
verses.hindi: ज्र कूर्मपुराण +
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this, he spoke to Kalagni (Kala bhairava) the great Isvara of the worlds—"At my behest, wander over all the worlds seeking alms.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this, he spoke to Kalagni (Kala bhairava) the great Isvara of the worlds—"At my behest, wander over all the worlds seeking alms.

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽनुवीक्ष्य महादेवं महादेव्या सनातनम् । वरासने समासीनमवाप परमां स्मृतिम्
verses.transliteration: so 'nuvīkṣya mahādevaṃ mahādevyā sanātanam / varāsane samāsīnamavāpa paramāṃ smṛtim
verses.translation: When you will meet Narayana, the lord of Devas, free from ailments, he will tell you clearly the means of expiation for the sin."
verses.hindi: मणि, मोती, मूँगा, ताँबा, चाँदी, लोहा, कासा तथा पत्थरको चोरी करनेपर बारह दिनतक कण (टूटे चावल) -का भक्षण करना चाहिए। कपास, रेशम, ऊन, तथा रस्सीका हरण करनेपर तीन दिनतक जलमात्र पीकर रहना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: When you will meet Narayana, the lord of Devas, free from ailments, he will tell you clearly the means of expiation for the sin."
verses.commentary: Sense: When you will meet Narayana, the lord of Devas, free from ailments, he will tell you clearly the means of expiation for the sin."

verses.sanskrit: लब्ध्वा माहेश्वरीं दिव्यां संस्मृतिं भगवानजः । तोषयामास वरदं सोमं सोमविभूषणम्
verses.transliteration: labdhvā māheśvarīṃ divyāṃ saṃsmṛtiṃ bhagavānajaḥ / toṣayāmāsa varadaṃ somaṃ somavibhūṣaṇam
verses.translation: On hearing the statement of the Lord of the deities. Lord Hara, the Atman of the universe wandered over the three worlds with the skull in his hand.
verses.hindi: मनुष्यका मांस भक्षण करनेपर चान्द्रायणव्रत करना चाहिए। कौआ, कुत्ता, हाथी, वराह और कुक्कुटका मांस खानेपर तप्तकृच्छुत्रतसे शुद्धि होती है। कच्चा मांस खानेवाले जानवरों, सिंयारों तथा बंदरोंका मांस तथा मल-मूत्र
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the statement of the Lord of the deities. Lord Hara, the Atman of the universe wandered over the three worlds with the skull in his hand.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the statement of the Lord of the deities. Lord Hara, the Atman of the universe wandered over the three worlds with the skull in his hand.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मोवाच नमो देवाय महते महादेव्यै नमो नमः । नमः शिवाय शान्ताय शिवायै शान्तये नमः
verses.transliteration: brahmovāca namo devāya mahate mahādevyai namo namaḥ / namaḥ śivāya śāntāya śivāyai śāntaye namaḥ
verses.translation: He assumed a hideous dress and form. He shone by means of his own brillance. His form was holy, comely and endowed with glory. He had three eyes.
verses.hindi: भक्षण करनेपर तप्तकच्छुत्रत करना चाहिए तथा बारह दिनोंतक उपवास करके कूष्माण्ड-संज्ञक मन्त्रोंसे घीको आहुति देनी चाहिए। नेवला, उल्लू तथा निल्लीका मांस भक्षण करनेपर सान्तपनव्रत करना चाहिए। शिकारी पशु, उँट और गदहेका मांस खानेपर तप्तकृच्छ्व्रतसे शुद्धि होती है। पहले निर्दिष्ट विधानके अनुसार व्रतके समान ही संस्कार भी करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: He assumed a hideous dress and form. He shone by means of his own brillance. His form was holy, comely and endowed with glory. He had three eyes.
verses.commentary: Sense: He assumed a hideous dress and form. He shone by means of his own brillance. His form was holy, comely and endowed with glory. He had three eyes.

verses.sanskrit: ॐ नमो ब्रह्मणे तुभ्यं विद्यायै ते नमो नमः । नमो मूलप्रकृतये महेशाय नमो नमः
verses.transliteration: oṃ namo brahmaṇe tubhyaṃ vidyāyai te namo namaḥ / namo mūlaprakṛtaye maheśāya namo namaḥ
verses.translation: That great god with eyes like the fire of universal destruction, who was surrounded by Siddhas and the leaders of Pramathas (attendants) shines (shone dazzling) like crore of suns.
verses.hindi: कारण्डव, चक्रवाक तथा प्लव पक्षीका मांस भक्षण करनेपर बारह दिनतक भोजन (अन्न ग्रहण) नहीं करना चाहिए। कपोत, टिट्रिभ, शुक, सारस, उलूक तथा कलहंसका मांस भक्षण करनेपर भी यही व्रत (बारह
verses.wordMeaning: That great god with eyes like the fire of universal destruction, who was surrounded by Siddhas and the leaders of Pramathas (attendants) shines (shone dazzling) like crore of suns.
verses.commentary: Sense: That great god with eyes like the fire of universal destruction, who was surrounded by Siddhas and the leaders of Pramathas (attendants) shines (shone dazzling) like crore of suns.

verses.sanskrit: नमो विज्ञानदेहाय चिन्तायै ते नमो नमः । नमस्ते कालकालाय ईश्वरायै नमो नमः
verses.transliteration: namo vijñānadehāya cintāyai te namo namaḥ / namaste kālakālāya īśvarāyai namo namaḥ
verses.translation: After imbibing the divine nectar, the bliss of Para- mesthin, the lord full of shining sports and pastimes, came down to the world.
verses.hindi: दिनतक उपवास) करना चाहिए। शिशुमार, नीलकण्ठ, मछलीका मांस तथा गीदड़का मांस भक्षण करनेपर भी यही (उपर्युक्त) व्रत करना चाहिए। कोयल, मत्स्य, मेढक तथा सर्प भक्षण करनेपर एक मासतक गोमूत्रमें अधपके यवका या यवके सत्तू आदिका भक्षण करनेसे शुद्धि होती है। जलचर, जलज, प्रत्तुद अर्थात् चोंचद्वारा ठोकर मारकर आहार करनेवाले कौआ आदि, नखविष्किर अर्थात् तितिर आदि और लाल पैरवाले
verses.wordMeaning: After imbibing the divine nectar, the bliss of Para- mesthin, the lord full of shining sports and pastimes, came down to the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: After imbibing the divine nectar, the bliss of Para- mesthin, the lord full of shining sports and pastimes, came down to the world.

verses.sanskrit: नमो नमो ऽस्तु रुद्राय रुद्राण्यै ते नमो नमः । नमो नमस्ते कामाय मायायै च नमो नमः
verses.transliteration: namo namo 'stu rudrāya rudrāṇyai te namo namaḥ / namo namaste kāmāya māyāyai ca namo namaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing Sankara, the black-faced Kala Bhairava, endowed with beauty and comely form, hosts of women followed him.
verses.hindi: पक्षियोंका मांस भक्षण करनेपर एक सप्ताहतक यह (उपर्युक्त) व्रत करना चाहिए। कुत्तेका मांस, सूखा
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing Sankara, the black-faced Kala Bhairava, endowed with beauty and comely form, hosts of women followed him.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing Sankara, the black-faced Kala Bhairava, endowed with beauty and comely form, hosts of women followed him.

verses.sanskrit: नियन्त्रे सर्वकार्याणां क्षोभिकायै नमो नमः । नमो ऽस्तु ते प्रकृतये नमो नारायणाय च
verses.transliteration: niyantre sarvakāryāṇāṃ kṣobhikāyai namo namaḥ / namo 'stu te prakṛtaye namo nārāyaṇāya ca
verses.translation: They began to sing different kinds of songs; they began to dance in front of the lord; looking at his smiling face, they knitted their eyebrows.
verses.hindi: पापको हटानेके लिये एक महीनेतक यह (ऊपर कहा गया) व्रत करना चाहिए। बैगन, भूस्तृण, सहजन, खुखुण्ड, करक, शङ्क और कुम्भीकका भक्षण करनेपर प्राजापत्यव्रत करना चाहिए॥ ११--१७॥ नालिकां तण्डुलीयं च प्राजापत्येन शुध्यति १८ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: They began to sing different kinds of songs; they began to dance in front of the lord; looking at his smiling face, they knitted their eyebrows.
verses.commentary: Sense: They began to sing different kinds of songs; they began to dance in front of the lord; looking at his smiling face, they knitted their eyebrows.

verses.sanskrit: योगादायै नमस्तुभ्यं योगिनां गुरवे नमः । नमः संसारनाशाय संसारोत्पत्तये नमः
verses.transliteration: yogādāyai namastubhyaṃ yogināṃ gurave namaḥ / namaḥ saṃsāranāśāya saṃsārotpattaye namaḥ
verses.translation: After passing through the lands of Devas, Danavas and others, the trident-bearing lord went to the region ofVisnu where Purusottama stayed.
verses.hindi: प्राजापत्येन शुद्धि: स्यात् कक्कुभाण्डस्य भक्षणे
verses.wordMeaning: After passing through the lands of Devas, Danavas and others, the trident-bearing lord went to the region ofVisnu where Purusottama stayed.
verses.commentary: Sense: After passing through the lands of Devas, Danavas and others, the trident-bearing lord went to the region ofVisnu where Purusottama stayed.

verses.sanskrit: नित्यानन्दाय विभवे नमो ऽस्त्वानन्दमूर्तये । नमः कार्यविहीनाय विश्वप्रकृतये नमः
verses.transliteration: nityānandāya vibhave namo 'stvānandamūrtaye / namaḥ kāryavihīnāya viśvaprakṛtaye namaḥ
verses.translation: After reaching the divine abode, Sankara, the bene¬ factor of the worlds, began to enter it along with the Prominent Bhutas.
verses.hindi: उदुम्बरं च कामेन तप्तकृच्छ्रेण शुध्यति पीत्वा क्षीराण्यपेयानि ब्रह्मचारी समाहितः । गोमूत्रयावकाहारो मासेनैकेन शुध्यति
verses.wordMeaning: After reaching the divine abode, Sankara, the bene¬ factor of the worlds, began to enter it along with the Prominent Bhutas.
verses.commentary: Sense: After reaching the divine abode, Sankara, the bene¬ factor of the worlds, began to enter it along with the Prominent Bhutas.

verses.sanskrit: ओङ्कारमूर्तये तुभ्यं तदन्तः संस्थिताय च । नमस्ते व्योमसंस्थाय व्योमशक्त्यै नमो नमः
verses.transliteration: oṅkāramūrtaye tubhyaṃ tadantaḥ saṃsthitāya ca / namaste vyomasaṃsthāya vyomaśaktyai namo namaḥ
verses.translation: Without knowing the divine and great being of Paramesvara, the powerful gatekeeper prevented the trident¬ bearing lord.
verses.hindi: एतेषां च विकाराणि पीत्वा मोहेन मानवः । गोमूत्रयावकाहारः सप्तरात्रेण शुध्यति
verses.wordMeaning: Without knowing the divine and great being of Paramesvara, the powerful gatekeeper prevented the trident¬ bearing lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: Without knowing the divine and great being of Paramesvara, the powerful gatekeeper prevented the trident¬ bearing lord.

verses.sanskrit: इति सोमाष्टकेनेशं प्रणनाम पितामहः । पपात दण्डवद् भूमौ गृणन् वै शतरुद्रियम्
verses.transliteration: iti somāṣṭakeneśaṃ praṇanāma pitāmahaḥ / papāta daṇḍavad bhūmau gṛṇan vai śatarudriyam
verses.translation: He was famous by the name of Visvaksena. He was born of a part of Visnu. He held conch, discus and the mace in his hands; he was mighty armed and clad in yellow robes. (Verse in the bracket)
verses.hindi: भुक्त्वा चैव नवश्राद्धे मृतके सूतके तथा। चान्द्रायणेन शुध्येत ब्राह्मणस्तु समाहितः बुद्धिपूर्व तु कृच्छाब्दं पुनः संस्कारमेव च
verses.wordMeaning: He was famous by the name of Visvaksena. He was born of a part of Visnu. He held conch, discus and the mace in his hands; he was mighty armed and clad in yellow robes. (Verse in the bracket)
verses.commentary: Sense: He was famous by the name of Visvaksena. He was born of a part of Visnu. He held conch, discus and the mace in his hands; he was mighty armed and clad in yellow robes. (Verse in the bracket)

verses.sanskrit: अथ देवो महादेवः प्रणतार्तिहरो हरः । प्रोवाचोत्थाप्य हस्ताभ्यां प्रतो ऽस्मि तव सांप्रतम्
verses.transliteration: atha devo mahādevaḥ praṇatārtiharo haraḥ / provācotthāpya hastābhyāṃ prato 'smi tava sāṃpratam
verses.translation: After routing Kalavega, the gatekeeper with his eyes turned red due to fury, rushed against Rudra and hurled the Sudarsana disc against him.
verses.hindi: प्याज एवं लहसुन भक्षण करनेपर चान्द्रायणव्रत करना चाहिए। नालिका शाक और तण्डुलीयक (चौलाई)- का साग खानेपर प्राजापत्य व्रतसे शुद्धि होती है। अश्मान्तक तथा पोतका भक्षण करनेपर तप्तकृच्छ्व्रत
verses.wordMeaning: After routing Kalavega, the gatekeeper with his eyes turned red due to fury, rushed against Rudra and hurled the Sudarsana disc against him.
verses.commentary: Sense: After routing Kalavega, the gatekeeper with his eyes turned red due to fury, rushed against Rudra and hurled the Sudarsana disc against him.

verses.sanskrit: दत्त्वासौ परमं योगमैश्वर्यमतुलं महत् । प्रोवाचाग्रे स्थितं देवं नीललोहितमीश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: dattvāsau paramaṃ yogamaiśvaryamatulaṃ mahat / provācāgre sthitaṃ devaṃ nīlalohitamīśvaram
verses.translation: Lord Mahadeva, the conqueror of foes, the trident¬ bearing god, the destroyer of the Tripuras, contemptuously looked at him, as he rushed against him
verses.hindi: करनेसे शुद्धि होती है। कक्कुभके अंडेका भक्षण करनेपर प्राजापत्य-व्रतसे शुद्धि होती है। अलाबु (वर्तुलाकार अर्थात् गोल लौकी) तथा किंशुक (पलाश)-का भक्षण करनेपर भी यही व्रत करना चाहिए। इच्छापूर्वक उदुम्बर (गूलर)-का भक्षण करनेपर तप्तकृच्छ्से शुद्धि होती है॥ १८--२० ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Lord Mahadeva, the conqueror of foes, the trident¬ bearing god, the destroyer of the Tripuras, contemptuously looked at him, as he rushed against him
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Mahadeva, the conqueror of foes, the trident¬ bearing god, the destroyer of the Tripuras, contemptuously looked at him, as he rushed against him

verses.sanskrit: एष ब्रह्मास्य जगतः संपूज्यः प्रथमः सुतः । आत्मनो रक्षणीयस्ते गुरुर्ज्येष्ठः पिता तव
verses.transliteration: eṣa brahmāsya jagataḥ saṃpūjyaḥ prathamaḥ sutaḥ / ātmano rakṣaṇīyaste gururjyeṣṭhaḥ pitā tava
verses.translation: In the meanwhile, a great goblin comparable to the fire at the end of the Yugas, pierced his heart by means of the trident and felled him to the ground.
verses.hindi: किसी शास्त्रीय उद्देश्यके बिना व्यर्थ ही या केवल
verses.wordMeaning: In the meanwhile, a great goblin comparable to the fire at the end of the Yugas, pierced his heart by means of the trident and felled him to the ground.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meanwhile, a great goblin comparable to the fire at the end of the Yugas, pierced his heart by means of the trident and felled him to the ground.

verses.sanskrit: अयं पुराणपुरुषो न हन्तव्यस्त्वयानघ । स्वयोगैश्वर्यमाहात्म्यान्मामेव शरणं गतः
verses.transliteration: ayaṃ purāṇapuruṣo na hantavyastvayānagha / svayogaiśvaryamāhātmyānmāmeva śaraṇaṃ gataḥ
verses.translation: Mortally struck down by the trident (the gatekeeper) lost all his great strength and abandoned his life like persons afflicted by sickness on seeing death.
