verses.hindi: मालपूआके समान पदार्थ भक्षण करनेपर तीन रात्रितक व्रत करनेसे शुद्धि होती है। पीनेके अयोग्य दूधका पान करनेपर सावधानीपूर्वक गोमूत्रमें पके यावकका आहार करनेसे एक मासमें ब्रह्मचारी शुद्ध होता है। ब्यानेके दस दिन हुए बिना अथवा गर्भिणी और बिना बच्चेवाली गौ, भेस और बकरीका दूध पीनेपर यही व्रत करना चाहिए । इनके (दूधके) विकार अर्थात् घी-दही आदिका मोहवश भक्षण करनेपर मनुष्य सात रात्रितक गोमूत्रमें
verses.wordMeaning: Mortally struck down by the trident (the gatekeeper) lost all his great strength and abandoned his life like persons afflicted by sickness on seeing death.
verses.commentary: Sense: Mortally struck down by the trident (the gatekeeper) lost all his great strength and abandoned his life like persons afflicted by sickness on seeing death.

verses.sanskrit: अयं च यज्ञो भगवान् सगर्वो भवतानघ । शासितव्यो विरिञ्चस्य धारणीयं शिरस्त्वया
verses.transliteration: ayaṃ ca yajño bhagavān sagarvo bhavatānagha / śāsitavyo viriñcasya dhāraṇīyaṃ śirastvayā
verses.translation: After killing the servant of Visnu and taking his
verses.hindi: अधपके यवका अथवा यवके सत्तू आदिका भोजन करनेसे शुद्ध होता है॥ २१--२४॥
verses.wordMeaning: After killing the servant of Visnu and taking his
verses.commentary: Sense: After killing the servant of Visnu and taking his

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्महत्यापनोदार्थं व्रतं लोकाय दर्शयन् । चरस्व सततं भिक्षां संस्थापय सुरद्विजान्
verses.transliteration: brahmahatyāpanodārthaṃ vrataṃ lokāya darśayan / carasva satataṃ bhikṣāṃ saṃsthāpaya suradvijān
verses.translation: On seeing Isvara, the cause of the universe, Lord Hari broke a vein in his forehead and let the blood flow out.
verses.hindi: (मृत्युके अनन्तर होनेवाले) नवश्राद्ध (मृत व्यक्तिके श्राद्ध), जननाशौच तथा मरणाशौचमें भोजन करनेपर ब्राह्मण समाहित होकर चान्द्रायणव्रत करनेसे शुद्ध होता है। जो (अधिकारी) न नित्य अग्निमें हवन करता है और न अग्रासन (भोजन करनेके पूर्व ब्राह्मण तथा
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing Isvara, the cause of the universe, Lord Hari broke a vein in his forehead and let the blood flow out.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing Isvara, the cause of the universe, Lord Hari broke a vein in his forehead and let the blood flow out.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येतदुक्त्वा वचनं भगवान् परमेश्वरः । स्थानं स्वाभाविकं दिव्यं ययौ तत्परमं पदम्
verses.transliteration: ityetaduktvā vacanaṃ bhagavān parameśvaraḥ / sthānaṃ svābhāvikaṃ divyaṃ yayau tatparamaṃ padam
verses.translation: "O suppressor of the Tripuras, O excessive splend- oured,(0 deity of unmeasured splendour), accept alms (offered) by me. No other kind of alms is worthy of you."
verses.hindi: अतिथिको भोजन कराता है, न गोग्रास ही निकालता है) देता है, उसका अन्न भक्षण करनेपर द्विजको चान्द्रायणव्रत करना चाहिए। जो अभोज्य हैं उन सभीका तथा अन्त्यजोंका पक्वान्न ग्रहण करनेपर
verses.wordMeaning: "O suppressor of the Tripuras, O excessive splend- oured,(0 deity of unmeasured splendour), accept alms (offered) by me. No other kind of alms is worthy of you."
verses.commentary: Sense: "O suppressor of the Tripuras, O excessive splend- oured,(0 deity of unmeasured splendour), accept alms (offered) by me. No other kind of alms is worthy of you."

verses.sanskrit: ततः स भगवानीशः कपर्दे नीललोहितः । ग्राहयामास वदनं ब्रह्मणः कालभैरवम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa bhagavānīśaḥ kaparde nīlalohitaḥ / grāhayāmāsa vadanaṃ brahmaṇaḥ kālabhairavam
verses.translation: The blood continued to flow out in a continuous stream for a thousand divine years. Still that skull of Brahma, Paramesthin could not be filled up.
verses.hindi: तप्तकृच्छूव्रतसे शुद्धि होती है। बिना जाने चाण्डालका अन्न भक्षण करके द्विजको भलीभाँति चान्द्रायणब्रत करना चाहिए और जान-बूझकर ऐसा करनेपर एक वर्षतक कृच्छूब्रतका पालन करके पुनः (द्विजत्व- प्रापिके लिये) संस्कार करना चाहिए॥ २५--२८॥
verses.wordMeaning: The blood continued to flow out in a continuous stream for a thousand divine years. Still that skull of Brahma, Paramesthin could not be filled up.
verses.commentary: Sense: The blood continued to flow out in a continuous stream for a thousand divine years. Still that skull of Brahma, Paramesthin could not be filled up.

verses.sanskrit: चर त्वं पापनाशार्थं व्रतं लोकहितावहम् । कपालहस्तो भगवान् भिक्षां गृह्णातु सर्वतः
verses.transliteration: cara tvaṃ pāpanāśārthaṃ vrataṃ lokahitāvaham / kapālahasto bhagavān bhikṣāṃ gṛhṇātu sarvataḥ
verses.translation: After eulogising him with different emotional ways
verses.hindi: अभोज्यान्नं तु भुक्त्वा च प्राजापत्येन शुध्यति
verses.wordMeaning: After eulogising him with different emotional ways
verses.commentary: Sense: After eulogising him with different emotional ways

verses.sanskrit: उक्त्वैवं प्राहिणोत् कन्यां ब्रह्महत्यामिति श्रुताम् । दंष्ट्राकरालवदनां ज्वालामालाविभूषणाम्
verses.transliteration: uktvaivaṃ prāhiṇot kanyāṃ brahmahatyāmiti śrutām / daṃṣṭrākarālavadanāṃ jvālāmālāvibhūṣaṇām
verses.translation: "Why are you carrying this skull of Brahma?" Mahesvara, the lord of Devas, recounted everything that happened.
verses.hindi: अनादिष्टेषु चैकाहं सर्वत्र तु यथार्थतः विड्वराहखरोष्ट्राणां गोमायोः कपिकाकयोः । प्राश्य मूत्रपुरीषाणि द्विजश्चान्द्रायणं चरेत्
verses.wordMeaning: "Why are you carrying this skull of Brahma?" Mahesvara, the lord of Devas, recounted everything that happened.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Why are you carrying this skull of Brahma?" Mahesvara, the lord of Devas, recounted everything that happened.

verses.sanskrit: यावद् वाराणसीं दिव्यां पुरीमेष गमिष्यति । तावत् त्वं भीषणे कालमनुगच्छ त्रिलोचनम्
verses.transliteration: yāvad vārāṇasīṃ divyāṃ purīmeṣa gamiṣyati / tāvat tvaṃ bhīṣaṇe kālamanugaccha trilocanam
verses.translation: Acyuta (Visnu), Hrsikesa (Lord of senses) called Brahmahatya (the evil spirit of the slaughter of a Brahmana) and requested her "Please let go the trident-bearing deity."
verses.hindi: पुनः संस्कारमर्हन्ति त्रयो वर्णा द्विजातयः
verses.wordMeaning: Acyuta (Visnu), Hrsikesa (Lord of senses) called Brahmahatya (the evil spirit of the slaughter of a Brahmana) and requested her "Please let go the trident-bearing deity."
verses.commentary: Sense: Acyuta (Visnu), Hrsikesa (Lord of senses) called Brahmahatya (the evil spirit of the slaughter of a Brahmana) and requested her "Please let go the trident-bearing deity."

verses.sanskrit: एवमाभाष्य कालाग्निं प्राह देवो महेश्वरः । अटस्व निखिलं लोकं भिक्षार्थो मन्नियोगतः
verses.transliteration: evamābhāṣya kālāgniṃ prāha devo maheśvaraḥ / aṭasva nikhilaṃ lokaṃ bhikṣārtho manniyogataḥ
verses.translation: Though requested by the enemy of Mura (i.e. Visnu), she did not leave off his (Rudra's) side. After meditating on the source of origin of the universe, the omniscient Lord spoke to Sankara.
verses.hindi: प्राजापत्येन शुध्येत ब्राह्मणोच्छिष्टभोजने। गोमूत्रयावकाहारः पीतशेषं च रागवान्
verses.wordMeaning: Though requested by the enemy of Mura (i.e. Visnu), she did not leave off his (Rudra's) side. After meditating on the source of origin of the universe, the omniscient Lord spoke to Sankara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Though requested by the enemy of Mura (i.e. Visnu), she did not leave off his (Rudra's) side. After meditating on the source of origin of the universe, the omniscient Lord spoke to Sankara.

verses.sanskrit: यदा द्रक्ष्यसि देवेशं नारायणमनामयम् । तदासौ वक्ष्यति स्पष्टमुपायं पापशोधनम्
verses.transliteration: yadā drakṣyasi deveśaṃ nārāyaṇamanāmayam / tadāsau vakṣyati spaṣṭamupāyaṃ pāpaśodhanam
verses.translation: "O lord, go unto the auspicious divine city of Varanasi where Isvara (god Siva) quickly destroys the sins of the worlds."
verses.hindi: तदा सांतपनं प्रोक्तं व्रतं पापविशोधनम्
verses.wordMeaning: "O lord, go unto the auspicious divine city of Varanasi where Isvara (god Siva) quickly destroys the sins of the worlds."
verses.commentary: Sense: "O lord, go unto the auspicious divine city of Varanasi where Isvara (god Siva) quickly destroys the sins of the worlds."

verses.sanskrit: स देवदेवतावाक्यमाकर्ण्य भगवान् हरः । कपालपाणिर्विश्वात्मा चचार भुवनत्रयम्
verses.transliteration: sa devadevatāvākyamākarṇya bhagavān haraḥ / kapālapāṇirviśvātmā cacāra bhuvanatrayam
verses.translation: Thereafter, the lord sportively went to the holy centres and shrines with a desire for the welfare of all the worlds.
verses.hindi: चरेत् सांतपनं कृच्छ्ं ब्राह्मणः पापशोधनम् सुराभिन्न मद्यका पान करनेपर चान्द्रायणव्रत करना चाहिए और अभोज्यान्न-भक्षण करनेपर प्राजापत्यव्रतसे शुद्धि होती है। मल, मूत्र एवं वीर्यका भक्षण करनेपर भी यही (प्राजापत्य नामक) व्रत करना चाहिए। अन्य
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, the lord sportively went to the holy centres and shrines with a desire for the welfare of all the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, the lord sportively went to the holy centres and shrines with a desire for the welfare of all the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: आस्थाय विकृतं वेषं दीप्यमानं स्वतेजसा । श्रीमत् पवित्रमतुलं जटाजूटविराजितम्
verses.transliteration: āsthāya vikṛtaṃ veṣaṃ dīpyamānaṃ svatejasā / śrīmat pavitramatulaṃ jaṭājūṭavirājitam
verses.translation: Here and there, he was eulogised by the Pramathas of great Yogic power. The great Yogin with the dead body on his hands danced.
verses.hindi: सभी न कहे गये पापोंमें यथाविधि एक दिनका उपवास करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: Here and there, he was eulogised by the Pramathas of great Yogic power. The great Yogin with the dead body on his hands danced.
verses.commentary: Sense: Here and there, he was eulogised by the Pramathas of great Yogic power. The great Yogin with the dead body on his hands danced.

verses.sanskrit: कोटिसूर्यप्रतीकाशैः प्रमथैश्चातिगर्वितैः । भाति कालाग्निनयनो महादेवः समावृतः
verses.transliteration: koṭisūryapratīkāśaiḥ pramathaiścātigarvitaiḥ / bhāti kālāgninayano mahādevaḥ samāvṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Assuming another form, lord Hari, Narayana followed him, desirous of seeing his dance.
verses.hindi: ग्रामसूकर, गदहा, ऊँट, शृगाल, बंदर तथा कोएके मल-मूत्रका भक्षण करनेपर द्विजको चान्द्रायणब्रत करना चाहिए । अज्ञानसे मल-मूत्रका भक्षण करने और सुराका स्पर्श करनेपर तीनों वर्णवाले द्विजातियोंको पुनः संस्कार करना चाहिए। अज्ञाननश कच्चा मांसभक्षी पक्षियोंके मूत्र-पुरीषका भक्षण हो जानेपर द्विजोत्तमको महासांतपन नामक व्रत करना चाहिए। गृध्र,मेढक, कुरर पक्षी एवं विष्किर (नखसे बिखेरकर खानेवाले पक्षी)-का भक्षण
verses.wordMeaning: Assuming another form, lord Hari, Narayana followed him, desirous of seeing his dance.
verses.commentary: Sense: Assuming another form, lord Hari, Narayana followed him, desirous of seeing his dance.

verses.sanskrit: पीत्वा कदमृतं दिव्यमानन्दं परमेष्ठिनः । लीलाविलासूबहुलो लोकानागच्छतीश्वरः
verses.transliteration: pītvā kadamṛtaṃ divyamānandaṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ / līlāvilāsūbahulo lokānāgacchatīśvaraḥ
verses.translation: On seeing Govinda, the bull-bannered lord of infinite Yogic soul, danced again and again smilingly.
verses.hindi: करनेपर (अथवा इनके मूत्र-पुरीषादिका भक्षण करनेपर) कृच्छुत्रत करना चाहिए॥ ३१--३३॥
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing Govinda, the bull-bannered lord of infinite Yogic soul, danced again and again smilingly.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing Govinda, the bull-bannered lord of infinite Yogic soul, danced again and again smilingly.

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा कालवदनं शङ्करं कालभैरवम् । रूपलावण्यसंपन्नं नारीकुलमगादनु
verses.transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvā kālavadanaṃ śaṅkaraṃ kālabhairavam / rūpalāvaṇyasaṃpannaṃ nārīkulamagādanu
verses.translation: Following Rudra, Hari with the Dharma as his carrier, reached the city of Mahadeva, well-known as Varanasi.
verses.hindi: ब्राह्मणका उच्छिष्ट भक्षण करनेपर प्राजापत्य-व्रतसे शुद्धि होती है। क्षत्रियोंका उच्छिष्ट भक्षण करनेपर तप्तकृच्छ नामक व्रत करना चाहिए, वैश्यका उच्छिष्ट ग्रहण करनेपर अतिकृच्छु और शूद्रका उच्छिष्ट ग्रहण करनेपर ब्राह्मणको चान्द्रायणव्रत करना चाहिए। सुराके पात्रमें जल पीनेपर चान्द्रायणव्रत करना चाहिए। कुत्तेका जूठा खानेपर द्विजको शुद्धि तीन रात्रितक उपवास करनेसे होती है। कुत्तेका पीतशेष इच्छापूर्वक ग्रहण
verses.wordMeaning: Following Rudra, Hari with the Dharma as his carrier, reached the city of Mahadeva, well-known as Varanasi.
verses.commentary: Sense: Following Rudra, Hari with the Dharma as his carrier, reached the city of Mahadeva, well-known as Varanasi.

verses.sanskrit: गायन्ति विविधं गीतं नृत्यन्ति पुरतः प्रभोः । सस्मितं प्रेक्ष्य वदनं चक्रुर्भ्रूभङ्गमेव च
verses.transliteration: gāyanti vividhaṃ gītaṃ nṛtyanti purataḥ prabhoḥ / sasmitaṃ prekṣya vadanaṃ cakrurbhrūbhaṅgameva ca
verses.translation: As soon as the lord of the universe with matted hair
verses.hindi: करनेवालेको तीन राततक गोमूत्रमें पके हुए यवान्नका आहारमात्र ग्रहण करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: As soon as the lord of the universe with matted hair
verses.commentary: Sense: As soon as the lord of the universe with matted hair

verses.sanskrit: स देवदानवादीनां देशानभ्येत्य शूलधृक् । जगाम विष्णोर्भवनं यत्रास्ते मधुसूदनः
verses.transliteration: sa devadānavādīnāṃ deśānabhyetya śūladhṛk / jagāma viṣṇorbhavanaṃ yatrāste madhusūdanaḥ
verses.translation: After entering the greatest abode, lord Kara, Sankara, placed the skull of Brahma in front of the attendants.
verses.hindi: यदि मल तथा मूत्र आदिसे दूषित जलका पान कर ले तो उस पापको शुद्धिके लिये सांतपन नामक व्रत बतलाया गया है। चाण्डालके कूपसे तथा उसके बरतनोंमें यदि ज्ञानपूर्वक ब्राह्मण जल पी ले तो उस पापकी शुद्धिके लिये कृच्छुसांतपन नामक व्रत करना चाहिए। चाण्डालके द्वारा स्पर्श हुआ जल पीनेपर द्विजोत्तम तीन रात्रितक पञ्चगव्य ग्रहण करनेसे शुद्ध होता है। महापातकीका स्पर्श होनेपर बिना स्त्रान किये
verses.wordMeaning: After entering the greatest abode, lord Kara, Sankara, placed the skull of Brahma in front of the attendants.
verses.commentary: Sense: After entering the greatest abode, lord Kara, Sankara, placed the skull of Brahma in front of the attendants.

verses.sanskrit: निरीक्ष्य दिव्यभवनं शङ्करो लोकशङ्करः । सहैव भूतप्रवरैः प्रवेष्टुमुपचक्रमे
verses.transliteration: nirīkṣya divyabhavanaṃ śaṅkaro lokaśaṅkaraḥ / sahaiva bhūtapravaraiḥ praveṣṭumupacakrame
verses.translation: After placing it (the skull), Mahadeva, the ocean of mercy, handed over the dead body to Visnu with the words "May this come to life."
verses.hindi: यदि द्विज जान-बूझकर मोहवश भोजन करता है तो उसे तप्तकृच्छू करना चाहिए। प्रमादवश महापातको, चाण्डाल या रजस्वलाका स्पर्शकर भोजन करनेपर तीन रात्रिपर्यन्त उपवाससे शुद्धि होती है॥ ३६--४०॥
verses.wordMeaning: After placing it (the skull), Mahadeva, the ocean of mercy, handed over the dead body to Visnu with the words "May this come to life."
verses.commentary: Sense: After placing it (the skull), Mahadeva, the ocean of mercy, handed over the dead body to Visnu with the words "May this come to life."

verses.sanskrit: अविज्ञाय परं भावं दिव्यं तत्पारमेश्वरम् । न्यवारयत् त्रिशूलाङ्कं द्वारपालो महाबलः
verses.transliteration: avijñāya paraṃ bhāvaṃ divyaṃ tatpārameśvaram / nyavārayat triśūlāṅkaṃ dvārapālo mahābalaḥ
verses.translation: "Those who always remember this Kapala dress of mine find their sin here and hereafter perish quickly.
verses.hindi: बुद्धिपूर्वं तु कृच्छेण भगवानाह पदाजः ब्रात्यानां यजनं कृत्वा परेषामन्त्यकर्म च। अभिचारमहीनं च त्रिभिः कृच्छर्विशुध्यति
verses.wordMeaning: "Those who always remember this Kapala dress of mine find their sin here and hereafter perish quickly.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Those who always remember this Kapala dress of mine find their sin here and hereafter perish quickly.

verses.sanskrit: शङ्खचक्रगदापाणिः पीतवासा महाभुजः । विष्वक्सेन इति ख्यातो विष्णोरंशसमुद्भवः
verses.transliteration: śaṅkhacakragadāpāṇiḥ pītavāsā mahābhujaḥ / viṣvaksena iti khyāto viṣṇoraṃśasamudbhavaḥ
verses.translation: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.
verses.hindi: ब्राह्मणादिहतानां तु कृत्वा दाहादिकाः क्रियाः । गोमूत्रयावकाहारः प्राजापत्येन शुध्यति
verses.wordMeaning: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.
verses.commentary: Sense: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.

verses.sanskrit: अथैनं शङ्करगणो युयुधे विष्णुसंभवम् । भीषणो भैरवादेशात् कालवेग इति श्रुतः
verses.transliteration: athainaṃ śaṅkaragaṇo yuyudhe viṣṇusaṃbhavam / bhīṣaṇo bhairavādeśāt kālavega iti śrutaḥ
verses.translation: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.
verses.hindi: तैलाभ्यक्तोऽथवा कुर्याद् यदि मूत्रपुरीषके । अहोरात्रेण शुध्येत श्मश्रुकर्म च मैथुनम् एकाहेन विवाहाग्निं परिहार्य द्विजोत्तमः। त्रिरात्रेण विशुध्येत त्रिरात्रात् षडहं पुनः
verses.wordMeaning: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.
verses.commentary: Sense: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.

verses.sanskrit: विजित्य तं कालवेगं क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनः । रुद्रायाभिमुखं रौद्रं चिक्षेप च सुदर्शनम्
verses.transliteration: vijitya taṃ kālavegaṃ krodhasaṃraktalocanaḥ / rudrāyābhimukhaṃ raudraṃ cikṣepa ca sudarśanam
verses.translation: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.
verses.hindi: कृच्छं चान्द्रायणं कुर्यात् तत्पापस्यापनुत्तये
verses.wordMeaning: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.
verses.commentary: Sense: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.

verses.sanskrit: अथ देवो महादेवस्त्रिपुरारिस्त्रिशूलभृत् । तमापतन्तं सावज्ञमालोकयदमित्रजित्
verses.transliteration: atha devo mahādevastripurāristriśūlabhṛt / tamāpatantaṃ sāvajñamālokayadamitrajit
verses.translation: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.
verses.hindi: चरेत् सांतपनं कृच्छूमित्याह भगवान् प्रभु: पुनश्च जातकर्मादिसंस्कारैः संस्कृता द्विजाः।
verses.wordMeaning: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.
verses.commentary: Sense: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.

verses.sanskrit: तदन्तरे महद्भूतं युगान्तदहनोपमम् । शूलेनोरसि निर्भिद्य पातयामास तं भुवि
verses.transliteration: tadantare mahadbhūtaṃ yugāntadahanopamam / śūlenorasi nirbhidya pātayāmāsa taṃ bhuvi
verses.translation: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.
verses.hindi: भगवान् ब्रह्माने कहा है कि स्त्नानके योग्य व्यक्ति यदि बिना स्नान किये भोजन करता है तो वह अहोरात्र उपवास करनेसे शुद्ध हो जाता है, किंतु ज्ञानपूर्वक भोजन करनेपर कृच्छूब्रत करनेसे शुद्धि होती है । शुष्क,
verses.wordMeaning: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.
verses.commentary: Sense: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.

verses.sanskrit: स शूलाभिहतो ऽत्यर्थं त्यक्त्वा स्वं परमं बलम् । तत्याज जीवितं दृष्ट्वा मृत्युं व्याधिहता इव
verses.transliteration: sa śūlābhihato 'tyarthaṃ tyaktvā svaṃ paramaṃ balam / tatyāja jīvitaṃ dṛṣṭvā mṛtyuṃ vyādhihatā iva
verses.translation: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.
verses.hindi: पदार्थोका भक्षण करनेपर एक दिनका उपवास अथवा कृच्छुव्रतका चतुर्थांश व्रत करना चाहिए। अज्ञानमें अभोज्य पदार्थोके भक्षणसे होनेवाले पापकी शुद्धिके लिये संवत्सरके अन्तमें ब्राह्मणको बार-बार कृच्छूत्रत करना चाहिए और जान-बूझकर ऐसा होनेपर इसे विशेषरूपसे करना चाहिए॥ ४१--४३॥
verses.wordMeaning: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.
verses.commentary: Sense: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.

verses.sanskrit: निहत्य विष्णुपुरुषं सार्धं प्रमथपुङ्गवैः । विवेश चान्तरगृहं समादाय कलेवरम्
verses.transliteration: nihatya viṣṇupuruṣaṃ sārdhaṃ pramathapuṅgavaiḥ / viveśa cāntaragṛhaṃ samādāya kalevaram
verses.translation: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.
verses.hindi: संस्कारहीन पुरुषोंका यज्ञ कराने और दूसरोंका अन्त्येष्टिकर्म तथा अभिचार-कर्म करनेपर तीन कृच्छत्रत करनेसे शुद्धि होती है। ब्राह्मण आदिके द्वारा मारे गये पुरुषोंका दाहादि कर्म करनेपर गोमूत्रमें पके यवान्नका
verses.wordMeaning: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.
verses.commentary: Sense: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.

verses.sanskrit: निरीक्ष्य जगतो हेतुमीश्वरं भगवान् हरिः । शिरो ललाटात् संभिद्य रक्तधारामपातयत्
verses.transliteration: nirīkṣya jagato hetumīśvaraṃ bhagavān hariḥ / śiro lalāṭāt saṃbhidya raktadhārāmapātayat
verses.translation: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.
verses.hindi: आहार करने और प्राजापत्य-व्रत करनेसे शुद्धि होती है। तेल लगाकर और मल-मूत्रका त्याग करने, श्मश्रुकर्म करने (दाढ़ी आदि बनाने) तथा मैथुन करनेपर अहोरात्र उपवास करनेसे शुद्धि होती है ॥ ४४--४६॥ एक दिन विवाहाग्नि (गृह्याग्नि)-का त्याग करने अर्थात् उस अग्निमें हवन न करनेसे द्विजोत्तम तीन दिन (उपवास करने)-से शुद्ध होता है और तीन दिनतक नित्य हवन न करनेपर छः दिनोंके उपवाससे
verses.wordMeaning: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.
verses.commentary: Sense: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.

verses.sanskrit: गृहाण भगवन् भिक्षां मदीयाममितद्युते । न विद्यते ऽनाभ्युदिता तव त्रिपुरमर्दन
verses.transliteration: gṛhāṇa bhagavan bhikṣāṃ madīyāmamitadyute / na vidyate 'nābhyuditā tava tripuramardana
verses.translation: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.
verses.hindi: शुद्ध होता है। प्रमादवश दस दिन अथवा बारह दिनतक गृह्याग्रिका त्याग करनेपर उस पापकी शुद्धिके लिये कुच्छ्चान्द्रायणव्रत करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.
verses.commentary: Sense: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.

verses.sanskrit: न संपूर्णं कपालं तद् ब्रह्मणः परमेष्ठिनः । दिव्यं वर्षसहस्रं तु सा च धारा प्रवाहिता
verses.transliteration: na saṃpūrṇaṃ kapālaṃ tad brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ / divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu sā ca dhārā pravāhitā
verses.translation: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.
verses.hindi: भगवान् प्रभुने बताया है कि पतित व्यक्तिसे द्रव्य लेनेपर उस द्रव्यका त्याग कर देनेसे शुद्धि होती है, साथ ही कृच्छूसांतपनत्रत करना चाहिए। प्रायोपवेशन- ब्रतसे भ्रष्ट तथा संन्यास-आश्रमसे च्युत व्यक्तिको तीन कृच्छ और तीन चान्द्रायणब्रत करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.
verses.commentary: Sense: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.

verses.sanskrit: अथाब्रवीत् कालरुद्रं हरिर्नारायणः प्रभुः । संस्तूय वैदिकैर्मन्त्रैर्बहुमानपुरः सरम्
verses.transliteration: athābravīt kālarudraṃ harirnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ / saṃstūya vaidikairmantrairbahumānapuraḥ saram
verses.translation: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.
verses.hindi: पुनः जातकर्मादि संस्कारोंद्वारा संस्कृत होनेपर धर्मकी वृद्धि चाहनेवाले द्विजोंको भलीभाँति व्रतका पालन
verses.wordMeaning: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.
verses.commentary: Sense: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.

verses.sanskrit: किमर्थमेतद् वदनं ब्रह्मणो भवता धृतम् । प्रोवाच वृत्तमखिलं भगवान् परमेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: kimarthametad vadanaṃ brahmaṇo bhavatā dhṛtam / provāca vṛttamakhilaṃ bhagavān parameśvaraḥ
verses.translation: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.
verses.hindi: शुध्येयुस्तद् व्रतं सम्यक् चरेयुर्धर्मवर्धना: ॥ ५१॥  करना चाहिए  यद्यपि अधिकारीके अभावमें किसीका अन्त्यकर्म करना पुण्यप्रद होता है, पर यदि यही अन्त्यकर्म लोभवश अधिकारीके रहते हुए भी स्वयं किया जाय तो पापका कारण होता है, अतः इसके लिये प्रायश्चित्तका विधान है।
verses.wordMeaning: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.
verses.commentary: Sense: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.

verses.sanskrit: समाहूय हृषीकेशो ब्रह्महत्यामथाच्युतः । प्रार्थयामास देवेशो विमुञ्चेति त्रिशूलिनम्
verses.transliteration: samāhūya hṛṣīkeśo brahmahatyāmathācyutaḥ / prārthayāmāsa deveśo vimuñceti triśūlinam
verses.translation: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.
verses.hindi: ४२४ + कूर्मपुराण
verses.wordMeaning: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.
verses.commentary: Sense: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.

verses.sanskrit: न तत्याजाथ सा पार्श्वं व्याहृतापि मुरारिणा । चिरं ध्यात्वा जगद्योनिः शङ्करं प्राह सर्ववित्
verses.transliteration: na tatyājātha sā pārśvaṃ vyāhṛtāpi murāriṇā / ciraṃ dhyātvā jagadyoniḥ śaṅkaraṃ prāha sarvavit
verses.translation: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.
verses.hindi: अनृपासितसंध्यस्तु तदहर्यापको वसेत्। अनश्नन् संयतमना रात्रौ चेद् रात्रिमेव हि वेदोदितानि नित्यानि कर्माणि च विलोप्य तु। स्नातकब्रतलोपं तु कृत्वा चोपवसेद् दिनम्
verses.wordMeaning: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.
verses.commentary: Sense: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.

verses.sanskrit: व्रजस्व भगवन् दिव्यां पुरीं वाराणसीं शुभाम् । यत्राखिलजगद्दोषं क्षिप्रं नाशयताश्वरः
verses.transliteration: vrajasva bhagavan divyāṃ purīṃ vārāṇasīṃ śubhām / yatrākhilajagaddoṣaṃ kṣipraṃ nāśayatāśvaraḥ
verses.translation: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.
verses.hindi: नास्तिक्यं यदि कुर्वीत प्राजापत्यं चरेद् द्विज: । देवद्रोहं गुरुद्रोहं तप्तकृच्छ्रेण शुध्यति
verses.wordMeaning: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.
verses.commentary: Sense: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.

verses.sanskrit: ततः शर्वाणि गुह्यानि तीर्थान्यायतनानि च । जगाम लीलया देवो लोकानां हितकाम्यया
verses.transliteration: tataḥ śarvāṇi guhyāni tīrthānyāyatanāni ca / jagāma līlayā devo lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā
verses.translation: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.
verses.hindi: उष्ट्रयानं समारुह्य खरयानं च कामतः। त्रिरात्रेण विशुध्येत् तु नग्नो वा प्रविशेज्जलम् षष्ठान्नकालतामासं संहिताजप एव च। होमाश्च शाकला नित्यमपांक्तातानां विशोधनम्
verses.wordMeaning: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.
verses.commentary: Sense: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.

verses.sanskrit: संस्तूयमानः प्रमथैर्महायोगैरितस्ततः । नृत्यमानो महायोगी हस्तन्यस्तकलेवरः
verses.transliteration: saṃstūyamānaḥ pramathairmahāyogairitastataḥ / nṛtyamāno mahāyogī hastanyastakalevaraḥ
verses.translation: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.
verses.hindi: बेदधर्मपुराणानां चण्डालस्य तु भाषणे।
verses.wordMeaning: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.
verses.commentary: Sense: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.

verses.sanskrit: तमभ्यधावद् भगवान् हरिर्नारायणः स्वयम् । अथास्थायापरं रूपं नृत्यदर्शनलालसः
verses.transliteration: tamabhyadhāvad bhagavān harirnārāyaṇaḥ svayam / athāsthāyāparaṃ rūpaṃ nṛtyadarśanalālasaḥ
verses.translation: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.
verses.hindi: (प्रातः) संध्या न करनेपर उस दिन वैसे ही बिना भोजन किये संयतमन होकर रहना चाहिए और सायं- संध्या न करनेपर रात्रिमें भोजन नहीं करना चाहिए। (गार्हपत्याग्निमें) समिधा न डालनेपर अर्थात् नित्य- हवन (नित्यकर्म-अग्निहोत्र) न करनेपर उस पापको शुद्धिके लिये स्नान करके पवित्रतापूर्वक समाहित होकर आठ हजार गायत्रीका जप करना चाहिए। गृहस्थाश्रममें रहते हुए भी व्यक्ति यदि प्रमादसे संध्या नहीं करता
verses.wordMeaning: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.
verses.commentary: Sense: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.

verses.sanskrit: निरीक्षमाणो नोविन्दं वृषेन्द्राङ्कितशासनः । सस्मितो ऽनन्तयोगात्मा नृत्यति स्म पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: nirīkṣamāṇo novindaṃ vṛṣendrāṅkitaśāsanaḥ / sasmito 'nantayogātmā nṛtyati sma punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.
verses.hindi: है तो स्नान करके उपवास करनेसे वह शुद्ध हो जाता है और थकानके कारण संध्या न करनेवाला संयम (मन एकाग्रकर पश्चात्तापमात्र) करनेसे शुद्ध हो जाता है। वेदमें बताये गये नित्य-कर्मोंका लोप करने तथा
verses.wordMeaning: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.
verses.commentary: Sense: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.

verses.sanskrit: अथ सानुचरो रुद्रः सहरिर्धर्मवाहनः । भेजे महादेवपुरीं वाराणसीमिति श्रुताम्
verses.transliteration: atha sānucaro rudraḥ saharirdharmavāhanaḥ / bheje mahādevapurīṃ vārāṇasīmiti śrutām
verses.translation: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.
verses.hindi: स्रातकके व्रतका लोप करनेपर स्तरातकको एक दिनका उपवास करना चाहिए॥ ५२--५५॥ अग्निका परित्याग करनेवाले द्विजोत्तमको एक वर्षतक कृच्छुत्रत करना चाहिए और संस्कारहीन व्यक्ति चान्द्रायणब्रत करने और गोदान करनेसे शुद्ध हो जाता है। नास्तिकता करनेवाले द्विजको प्राजापत्य-व्रतका पालन करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.
verses.commentary: Sense: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.

verses.sanskrit: प्रविष्टमात्रे देवेशे ब्रह्महत्या कपर्दिनि । हा हेत्युक्त्वा सनादं सा पातालं प्राप दुः खिता
verses.transliteration: praviṣṭamātre deveśe brahmahatyā kapardini / hā hetyuktvā sanādaṃ sā pātālaṃ prāpa duḥ khitā
verses.translation: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.
verses.hindi: शुद्धि होती है। इच्छापूर्वक ऊँट या गदहेकी सवारी करनेपर तीन रात्रिपर्यन्त उपवास करनेसे शुद्धि होती है। इसी प्रकार नग्न होकर जलमें प्रवेश करनेपर तीन राततक उपवास करना चाहिए॥ ५६--५८ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.
verses.commentary: Sense: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.

verses.sanskrit: प्रविश्य परमं स्थानं कपालं ब्रह्मणो हरः । गणानामग्रतो देवः स्थापयामास शङ्करः
verses.transliteration: praviśya paramaṃ sthānaṃ kapālaṃ brahmaṇo haraḥ / gaṇānāmagrato devaḥ sthāpayāmāsa śaṅkaraḥ
verses.translation: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.
verses.hindi: पंक्तिसे बहिष्कृत यदि ऐसे लोग हैं, जिनके लिये विशेष प्रायश्चित्तका उपदेश नहीं किया गया है, वे लोग एक मासतक नियमपूर्वक 'षष्ठान्रकालता' (तीन दिन भोजन न कर तीसरे दिन सायं केवल एक बार सात्त्विक (हविष्यान्न) भोजन करें, संहिताजप (वेदसंहिताके
verses.wordMeaning: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.
verses.commentary: Sense: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.

verses.sanskrit: स्थापयित्वा महादेवो ददौ तच्च कलेवरम् । उक्त्वा सजीवमस्त्वीशो विष्णवे स घृणानिधिः
verses.transliteration: sthāpayitvā mahādevo dadau tacca kalevaram / uktvā sajīvamastvīśo viṣṇave sa ghṛṇānidhiḥ
verses.translation: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.
verses.hindi: प्रश्न ४, अध्याय ३ के अनुसार) करें तो शुद्ध हो सकते हैं। नीला या लाल वस्त्र धारण करनेपर ब्राह्मण एक अहोरात्र उपवास करनेके अनन्तर स्त्रानकर पञ्चगव्यका पान करनेसे शुद्ध होता है
verses.wordMeaning: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.
verses.commentary: Sense: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.

verses.sanskrit: ये स्मरन्ति ममाजस्त्रं कापालं वेषमुत्तमम् । तेषां विनश्यति क्षिप्रमिहामुत्र च पातकम्
verses.transliteration: ye smaranti mamājastraṃ kāpālaṃ veṣamuttamam / teṣāṃ vinaśyati kṣipramihāmutra ca pātakam
verses.translation: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.
verses.hindi: चाण्डालको वेद, धर्मशास्त्रों तथा पुराणोंका उपदेश करनेपर चान्द्रायणसे शुद्धि होती है, इसके अतिरिक्त उसकी निष्कृति (निस्तार)-का कोई अन्य उपाय नहीं है चान्द्रायणेन शुद्धि: स्यात् प्राजापत्येन वा पुन:
verses.wordMeaning: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.
verses.commentary: Sense: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.

verses.sanskrit: आगम्य तीर्थप्रवरे स्नानं कृत्वा विधानतः । तर्पयित्वा पितॄन् देवान् मुच्यते ब्रह्महत्यया
verses.transliteration: āgamya tīrthapravare snānaṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ / tarpayitvā pitṝn devān mucyate brahmahatyayā
verses.translation: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.
verses.hindi: द्रुपदानां शतं वापि ब्रह्मचारी समाहितः! त्रिरात्रोपोषितः सम्यक् पञ्चगव्येन शुध्यति
verses.wordMeaning: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.
verses.commentary: Sense: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.

verses.sanskrit: अशाश्वतं जगज्ज्ञात्वा ये ऽस्मिन् स्थाने वसन्ति वै । देहान्ते तत् परं ज्ञानं ददामि परमं पदम्
verses.transliteration: aśāśvataṃ jagajjñātvā ye 'smin sthāne vasanti vai / dehānte tat paraṃ jñānaṃ dadāmi paramaṃ padam
verses.translation: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.
verses.hindi: चण्डालपतितादींस्तु कामाद् यः संस्पृशेद् द्विजः । उच्छिष्टस्तत्र कुवीत प्राजापत्यं विशुद्धये आचमेत् तद्विशुद्धयर्थ प्राह देवः पितामह:
verses.wordMeaning: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.
verses.commentary: Sense: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.

verses.sanskrit: इतीदमुक्त्वा भगवान् समालिङ्ग्य जनार्दनम् । सहैव प्रमथेशानैः क्षणादन्तरधीयत
verses.transliteration: itīdamuktvā bhagavān samāliṅgya janārdanam / sahaiva pramatheśānaiḥ kṣaṇādantaradhīyata
verses.translation: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.
verses.hindi: ब्राह्मणस्तु शुना दष्टस्त्र्यहं सायं पयः पिबेत्। नाभेरूर्ध्वं तु दष्टस्य तदेव द्विगुणं भवेत्
verses.wordMeaning: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.
verses.commentary: Sense: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.

verses.sanskrit: स लब्ध्वा भगवान् कृष्णो विष्वक्सेनं त्रिशूलिनः । स्वं देशमगत् तूर्णं गृहीत्वां परमं वपुः
verses.transliteration: sa labdhvā bhagavān kṛṣṇo viṣvaksenaṃ triśūlinaḥ / svaṃ deśamagat tūrṇaṃ gṛhītvāṃ paramaṃ vapuḥ
verses.translation: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.
verses.hindi: यथाविधि आचमनकी योग्यता स्रानके बिना नहीं होती है। उद्ठन्धन (फाँसी) आदिद्ठारा मरे व्यक्तिका कदाचित् स्पर्श होनेपर ब्राह्मण चान्द्रायण अथवा प्राजापत्यव्रत करनेसे शुद्ध होता है। प्रमादवश यदि जूठे मुँह बिना आचमन किये द्विज चाण्डाल आदिका स्पर्श करता
verses.wordMeaning: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.
verses.commentary: Sense: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.

verses.sanskrit: एतद् वः कथितं पुण्यं महापातकनाशनम् । कपालमोचनं तीर्थं स्थाणोः प्रियकरं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: etad vaḥ kathitaṃ puṇyaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam / kapālamocanaṃ tīrthaṃ sthāṇoḥ priyakaraṃ śubham
verses.translation: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.
verses.hindi: है तो उसे स्नानकर आठ हजार गायत्रीका जप करना चाहिए। ब्रह्मचारीको तो समाहित होकर तीन रात उपवास करके भलीभाति सौ बार द्रुपदा मन्त्रका जप करना चाहिए और फिर पञ्चगव्यप्राशन करनेपर उसकी
verses.wordMeaning: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.
verses.commentary: Sense: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.

verses.sanskrit: य इमं पठते ऽध्यायं ब्राह्मणानां समीपतः । वाचिकैर्मानसैः पापैः कायिकैश्च विमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: ya imaṃ paṭhate 'dhyāyaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ samīpataḥ / vācikairmānasaiḥ pāpaiḥ kāyikaiśca vimucyate
verses.translation: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.
verses.hindi: शुद्धि होती है। जो उच्छिष्टमुख द्विज इच्छापूर्वक चाण्डाल तथा पतित आदिका स्पर्श करता है, उसे शुद्धिके लिये प्राजापत्यव्रत करना चाहिए ॥ ६२--६५॥ उनसे स्पृष्ट व्यक्ति तथा पतितका स्पर्श करनेपर शुद्धिके लिये स्त्रान करना चाहिए। प्रमादवश चाण्डाल, अशौचयुक्त व्यक्ति तथा शव--इनको स्पर्श किये व्यक्तिका स्पर्श होनेपर (खानोपरान्त) आचमन करके एकाग्र होकर (गायत्री-)
verses.wordMeaning: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.
verses.commentary: Sense: After coming to the excellent holy centre and performing the ablutions duly, one should propitiate the Pitrs, manes and Devas after which one is liberated from the sin of slaughter of Brahmana.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपाराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे एकत्रिशो ऽध्यायः व्यास उवाच सुरापस्तु सुरां तप्तामग्निवर्णां स्वयं पिबेत् । तया स काये निर्दग्धे मुच्यते तु द्विजोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapārāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge ekatriśo 'dhyāyaḥ vyāsa uvāca surāpastu surāṃ taptāmagnivarṇāṃ svayaṃ pibet / tayā sa kāye nirdagdhe mucyate tu dvijottamaḥ
verses.translation: Realising that the world is transient, ye all go to the greatest city. At the time of death the perfect knowledge imparted by me yields the highest region."
verses.hindi: जप करना चाहिए। द्विजोत्तम यदि जान-बूझकर चाण्डाल आदिद्दारा स्पर्श किये व्यक्तिका स्पर्श करे तो उसे उस पापकी शुद्धिके लिये (स्नान करके) आचमन करना चाहिए-एऐसा पितामहदेवने कहा है
verses.wordMeaning: Realising that the world is transient, ye all go to the greatest city. At the time of death the perfect knowledge imparted by me yields the highest region."
verses.commentary: Sense: Realising that the world is transient, ye all go to the greatest city. At the time of death the perfect knowledge imparted by me yields the highest region."

verses.sanskrit: गोमूत्रमग्निवर्णं वा गोशकृद्रसमेव वा । पयो घृतं जलं वाथ मुच्यते पातकात् ततः
verses.transliteration: gomūtramagnivarṇaṃ vā gośakṛdrasameva vā / payo ghṛtaṃ jalaṃ vātha mucyate pātakāt tataḥ
verses.translation: After saying this and embracing Janardana (Visnu), the lord instantaneously vanished alongwith the leading attendants.
verses.hindi: भोजन करते समय ब्राह्मणके गुदामार्गसे कदाचित् मलस्राव हो जाय तो शौच करनेके अनन्तर खान करना चाहिए और उपवास करके घृतसे हवन करे। चाण्डाल एवं अन्त्यजके शवका स्पर्श करके शुद्धिके लिये कृच्छ्व्रत करना चाहिए। उबटन आदि लगानेके बाद अस्पृश्य व्यक्तिका स्पर्श होनेपर एक अहोरात्र उपवास करनेसे शुद्धि होती है
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this and embracing Janardana (Visnu), the lord instantaneously vanished alongwith the leading attendants.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this and embracing Janardana (Visnu), the lord instantaneously vanished alongwith the leading attendants.

verses.sanskrit: जलार्द्रवासाः प्रयतो ध्यात्वा नारायणं हरिम् । ब्रह्महत्याव्रतं चाथ चरेत् तत्पापशान्तये
verses.transliteration: jalārdravāsāḥ prayato dhyātvā nārāyaṇaṃ harim / brahmahatyāvrataṃ cātha caret tatpāpaśāntaye
verses.translation: After regaining his servant Visvaksena from the trident-bearing lord, the lord Krsna silently went back to his land. (?)
verses.hindi: सुराका स्पर्श करके द्विज तीन प्राणायाम करनेसे शुद्ध होता है। प्याज, लहसुनका स्पर्श होनेपर घृतका प्राशन करनेसे शुद्धि होती है । कुत्तेके काटनेपर ब्राह्मणको (कुत्तेके स्पर्शके प्रायश्चित्तके साथ) तीन दिन सायंकाल
verses.wordMeaning: After regaining his servant Visvaksena from the trident-bearing lord, the lord Krsna silently went back to his land. (?)
verses.commentary: Sense: After regaining his servant Visvaksena from the trident-bearing lord, the lord Krsna silently went back to his land. (?)

verses.sanskrit: सुवर्णस्तेयकृद् विप्रो राजानमभिगम्य तु । स्वकर्म ख्यापयन् ब्रूयान्मां भवाननुशास्त्विति
verses.transliteration: suvarṇasteyakṛd vipro rājānamabhigamya tu / svakarma khyāpayan brūyānmāṃ bhavānanuśāstviti
verses.translation: Thus the meritorious story that quells great sins has been recounted to you. The holy centre Kapalamocana is very auspicious and is extremely liked by Sthanu.
verses.hindi: केवल दूध पीना चाहिए। नाभिके ऊपरी भागमें काटनेपर यही क्रिया (प्रायश्चित्त) दो बार करनी चाहिए। इसी प्रकार बाहुमें काटनेपर यही क्रिया तीन बार और मस्तकमें काटनेपर चार बार करनी चाहिए अथवा कुत्तेके काटनेपर द्विजोत्तमको ख्नान करके गायत्रीका जप करना चाहिए॥ ७१--७३ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the meritorious story that quells great sins has been recounted to you. The holy centre Kapalamocana is very auspicious and is extremely liked by Sthanu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the meritorious story that quells great sins has been recounted to you. The holy centre Kapalamocana is very auspicious and is extremely liked by Sthanu.

verses.sanskrit: गृहीत्वा मुसलं राजा सकृद् हन्यात् ततः स्वयम् । वधे तु शुद्ध्यते स्तेनो ब्राह्मणस्तपसैव वा
verses.transliteration: gṛhītvā musalaṃ rājā sakṛd hanyāt tataḥ svayam / vadhe tu śuddhyate steno brāhmaṇastapasaiva vā
verses.translation: He who reads this chapter in the presence of Brahmanas is released from all sins mental, verbal and physical.
verses.hindi: अनिर्वर्त्य महायज्ञान् यो भुंक्ते तु द्विजोत्तमः । अनातुरः सति धने कृच्छार्धन स शुध्यति
verses.wordMeaning: He who reads this chapter in the presence of Brahmanas is released from all sins mental, verbal and physical.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who reads this chapter in the presence of Brahmanas is released from all sins mental, verbal and physical.

verses.sanskrit: स्कन्धेनादाय मुसलं लकुटं वापि खादिरम् । शक्तिं चोभयतस्तीक्ष्णामायसं दण्डमेव वा
verses.transliteration: skandhenādāya musalaṃ lakuṭaṃ vāpi khādiram / śaktiṃ cobhayatastīkṣṇāmāyasaṃ daṇḍameva vā
verses.translation: Krcchra or Prajdpatya is a general term for several kinds of expiations. It has about 12 varieties. (For details vide Kane—H. D. Vol. IV, p , 132-133).
verses.hindi: गायत्र्यष्टसहस्त्रै तु त्र्यहं चोपवसेद् व्रती मृषैव यावकान्नेन कुर्याच्चान्द्रायणं व्रतम्
verses.wordMeaning: Krcchra or Prajdpatya is a general term for several kinds of expiations. It has about 12 varieties. (For details vide Kane—H. D. Vol. IV, p , 132-133).
verses.commentary: Sense: Krcchra or Prajdpatya is a general term for several kinds of expiations. It has about 12 varieties. (For details vide Kane—H. D. Vol. IV, p , 132-133).

verses.sanskrit: राजा तेन च गन्तव्यो मुक्तकेशेन धावता । आचक्षाणेन तत्पापमेवङ्कर्मास्मि शाधि माम्
verses.transliteration: rājā tena ca gantavyo muktakeśena dhāvatā / ācakṣāṇena tatpāpamevaṅkarmāsmi śādhi mām
verses.translation: Adultery (esp. with one's preceptor's wife) was another great sin. VV. 12-18 give various expiations of unequal intensity for it.
verses.hindi: हुंकारं ब्राह्मणस्योक्त्वा त्वंकारं च गरीयसः। स्नात्वानश्नन्नहःशेषं प्रणिपत्य प्रसादयेत्
verses.wordMeaning: Adultery (esp. with one's preceptor's wife) was another great sin. VV. 12-18 give various expiations of unequal intensity for it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Adultery (esp. with one's preceptor's wife) was another great sin. VV. 12-18 give various expiations of unequal intensity for it.

verses.sanskrit: शासनाद् वा विमोक्षाद् वा स्तेनः स्तेयाद् विमुच्यते । अशासित्वा तु तं राजास्तेनस्याप्नोति किल्बिषम्
verses.transliteration: śāsanād vā vimokṣād vā stenaḥ steyād vimucyate / aśāsitvā tu taṃ rājāstenasyāpnoti kilbiṣam
verses.translation: In this expiation the intake of food—one morsel on the 1st tithi (lunar day) increases every day by one morsel upto 15 morsels on the full-
verses.hindi: ति कूर्मपुराण हम प्रतिदिन विहित पाँच महायज्ञोंको बिना सम्पन्न किये भोजन करता है, वह अर्धकृच्छ्ब्रत करनेसे शुद्ध होता है। जो अग्निहोत्री ब्राह्मण पर्वोमें उपस्थान नहीं करता और जो ऋतुकालमें भार्याके साथ सहवास नहीं करता
verses.wordMeaning: In this expiation the intake of food—one morsel on the 1st tithi (lunar day) increases every day by one morsel upto 15 morsels on the full-
verses.commentary: Sense: In this expiation the intake of food—one morsel on the 1st tithi (lunar day) increases every day by one morsel upto 15 morsels on the full-

verses.sanskrit: तपसापनुनुत्सुस्तु सुवर्णस्तेयजं मलम् । चीरवासा द्विजो ऽरण्ये चरेद् ब्रह्महणो व्रतम्
verses.transliteration: tapasāpanunutsustu suvarṇasteyajaṃ malam / cīravāsā dvijo 'raṇye cared brahmahaṇo vratam
verses.translation: A Brahmana stealing gold should approach the king and confess his guilt. He should request, "Your Majesty should chastise me."
verses.hindi: वह भी अर्धकृच्छुव्रत करनेसे शुद्ध होता है
verses.wordMeaning: A Brahmana stealing gold should approach the king and confess his guilt. He should request, "Your Majesty should chastise me."
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmana stealing gold should approach the king and confess his guilt. He should request, "Your Majesty should chastise me."

verses.sanskrit: स्नात्वाश्वमेधावभृथे पूतः स्यादथवा द्विजः । प्रदद्याद् वाथ विप्रेभ्यः स्वात्मतुल्यं हिरण्यकम्
verses.transliteration: snātvāśvamedhāvabhṛthe pūtaḥ syādathavā dvijaḥ / pradadyād vātha viprebhyaḥ svātmatulyaṃ hiraṇyakam
verses.translation: The king should take a threshing rod and should him¬ self strike him with it once. Ordinary thief becomes pure on being killed and a Brahmana by means of penance.
verses.hindi: कोई आर्त (मल-मूत्रके वेगसे आर्त-त्रस्त) व्यक्ति यदि जलके अभावमें मल-मूत्रका त्याग अकस्मात् कर देता है या जलके मध्यमें रहता हुआ मल-मूत्रके वेगसे आर्त होनेके कारण जलके मध्य ही अकस्मात् मल- मूत्रका त्याग कर देता है तो मल-मूत्रका प्रक्षालनकर ग्राम या नगर आदिके बाहर नदी आदिमें शरीरपर धारित समस्त वस्त्रोंके साथ उसे स्नान करना चाहिए तथा गौका स्पर्श करना चाहिए, तभी शुद्धि होती है।
verses.wordMeaning: The king should take a threshing rod and should him¬ self strike him with it once. Ordinary thief becomes pure on being killed and a Brahmana by means of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: The king should take a threshing rod and should him¬ self strike him with it once. Ordinary thief becomes pure on being killed and a Brahmana by means of penance.

verses.sanskrit: चरेद् वा वत्सरं कृच्छ्रं ब्रह्मचर्यपरायणः । ब्राह्मणः स्वर्णहारी तु तत्पापस्यापनुत्तये
verses.transliteration: cared vā vatsaraṃ kṛcchraṃ brahmacaryaparāyaṇaḥ / brāhmaṇaḥ svarṇahārī tu tatpāpasyāpanuttaye
verses.translation: Either by chastisement or through release the thief is liberated of the sin of theft. By not chastising him, the king- incurs the sin of the thief.
verses.hindi: जान-बूझकर (सूर्यादयकालतक शयन करनेवाले अथवा आलस्यवश सोये रहनेके कारण सूर्योदयकालीन अनुष्ठानको न करनेवाले) ब्राह्मणको सूर्योदयके समय जलमें प्रविष्ट होकर आठ हजार गायत्रीका जप तथा तीन दिनतक
verses.wordMeaning: Either by chastisement or through release the thief is liberated of the sin of theft. By not chastising him, the king- incurs the sin of the thief.
verses.commentary: Sense: Either by chastisement or through release the thief is liberated of the sin of theft. By not chastising him, the king- incurs the sin of the thief.

verses.sanskrit: गुरोर्भार्यां समारुह्य ब्राह्मणः काममोहितः । अवगूहेत् स्त्रियं तप्तां दीप्तां कार्ष्णायसीं कृताम्
verses.transliteration: gurorbhāryāṃ samāruhya brāhmaṇaḥ kāmamohitaḥ / avagūhet striyaṃ taptāṃ dīptāṃ kārṣṇāyasīṃ kṛtām
verses.translation: A Brahmana desirous of wiping off the sin incurred from the theft of gold by means of penance should wear bark- garments and perform the expiatory rite of a slayer of a Brahmana.
verses.hindi: उपवास करना चाहिए इच्छापूर्वक मृत शूद्रके शवका अनुगमन करनेपर द्विजोत्तमको नदीके किनारे आठ हजार गायत्रीका जप करना चाहिए। ब्राह्मणके वध करनेको झूठी शपथ करनेपर ब्राह्मणको यावकान्न (यवके सत्तू या उससे
verses.wordMeaning: A Brahmana desirous of wiping off the sin incurred from the theft of gold by means of penance should wear bark- garments and perform the expiatory rite of a slayer of a Brahmana.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmana desirous of wiping off the sin incurred from the theft of gold by means of penance should wear bark- garments and perform the expiatory rite of a slayer of a Brahmana.

verses.sanskrit: स्वयं वा शिश्नवृषणावुत्कृत्याधाय चाञ्चलौ । आतिष्ठेद् दक्षिणामाशामानिपातादजिह्मगः
verses.transliteration: svayaṃ vā śiśnavṛṣaṇāvutkṛtyādhāya cāñcalau / ātiṣṭhed dakṣiṇāmāśāmānipātādajihmagaḥ
verses.translation: Or the Brahmana should become purified by taking- bath in the Avabhrtha (concluding ablution) of the horse-sacrifice. Or he should give his own weight in gold to Brahmanas.
verses.hindi: बने हुए किसी अन्य पदार्थ)-से चान्द्रायणव्रत करना चाहिए। एक ही पंक्तिमें बैठे हुए ब्राह्मणोंको विषम दान करनेपर कुच्छूत्रत करनेसे शुद्धि होती है। चाण्डालकी छायाका स्पर्श होनेपर स्नान करके घृतका प्राशन करना
verses.wordMeaning: Or the Brahmana should become purified by taking- bath in the Avabhrtha (concluding ablution) of the horse-sacrifice. Or he should give his own weight in gold to Brahmanas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or the Brahmana should become purified by taking- bath in the Avabhrtha (concluding ablution) of the horse-sacrifice. Or he should give his own weight in gold to Brahmanas.

verses.sanskrit: गुर्वर्थं वा हतः शुद्ध्येच्चरेद् वा ब्रह्महा व्रतम् । शाखां वा कण्टकोपेतां परिष्वज्याथ वत्सरम् । अधः शयीत नियतो मुच्यते गुरुतल्पगः
verses.transliteration: gurvarthaṃ vā hataḥ śuddhyeccared vā brahmahā vratam / śākhāṃ vā kaṇṭakopetāṃ pariṣvajyātha vatsaram / adhaḥ śayīta niyato mucyate gurutalpagaḥ
verses.translation: The Brahmana who has stolen gold should observe celibacy and perform the Krcchra'- rite for a year, in order to quell that sin.
verses.hindi: चाहिए ॥ ७८--८० ॥ अशुद्धिकी स्थितिमें अग्नि अथवा चन्द्रमाका दर्शनकर सूर्यका दर्शन करना चाहिए। मनुष्यको हङड्डीका स्पर्श होनेपर खान करनेसे शुद्धि होती है। मिथ्या (असत्
verses.wordMeaning: The Brahmana who has stolen gold should observe celibacy and perform the Krcchra'- rite for a year, in order to quell that sin.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Brahmana who has stolen gold should observe celibacy and perform the Krcchra'- rite for a year, in order to quell that sin.

verses.sanskrit: कृच्छ्रं वाब्दं चरेद् विप्रश्चीरवासाः समाहितः । अश्वमेधावभृथके स्नात्वा वा शुद्ध्यते नरः
verses.transliteration: kṛcchraṃ vābdaṃ cared vipraścīravāsāḥ samāhitaḥ / aśvamedhāvabhṛthake snātvā vā śuddhyate naraḥ
verses.translation: If a Brahmana being infatuated with lust commits adultery with the wife of his preceptor, he should embrace a red hot and fiery image of a woman made of black iron.
verses.hindi: वर्षतक भिक्षाव्रत ग्रहण करना चाहिए। कृतन्रको (ब्रह्मचर्य) व्रतका पालन करते हुए पाँच वर्षतक ब्राह्मणके घरमें निवास करना चाहिए  ब्राह्मणको ' हुंकार' तथा गुरुजनोंको 'त्वंकार' (तुम) कहनेपर स्नान करके दिनभर भोजन
verses.wordMeaning: If a Brahmana being infatuated with lust commits adultery with the wife of his preceptor, he should embrace a red hot and fiery image of a woman made of black iron.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a Brahmana being infatuated with lust commits adultery with the wife of his preceptor, he should embrace a red hot and fiery image of a woman made of black iron.

verses.sanskrit: काले ऽष्टमे वा भुञ्जानो ब्रह्मचारी सदाव्रती । स्थानासनाभ्यां विहरंस्त्रिरह्नो ऽभ्युपयन्नपः
verses.transliteration: kāle 'ṣṭame vā bhuñjāno brahmacārī sadāvratī / sthānāsanābhyāṃ viharaṃstrirahno 'bhyupayannapaḥ
verses.translation: Or he should himself cut off his penis and scrotum, hold them in his palms and walk straight towards the southern direction till he falls down dead.
verses.hindi: नहीं करना चाहिए और उन्हें प्रणामके द्वारा प्रसन्न करना चाहिए॥ ८१--८३॥ एकरात्रं त्रिरात्रं वा तत्पापस्यापनुत्तये
verses.wordMeaning: Or he should himself cut off his penis and scrotum, hold them in his palms and walk straight towards the southern direction till he falls down dead.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or he should himself cut off his penis and scrotum, hold them in his palms and walk straight towards the southern direction till he falls down dead.

verses.sanskrit: अधः शायी त्रिभिर्वर्षैस्तद् व्यपोहति पातकम् । चान्द्रायणानि वा कुर्यात् पञ्च चत्वारि वा पुनः
verses.transliteration: adhaḥ śāyī tribhirvarṣaistad vyapohati pātakam / cāndrāyaṇāni vā kuryāt pañca catvāri vā punaḥ
verses.translation: Or he should observe four or five Candrayana® vows.
verses.hindi: देवर्षीणामभिमुखं ष्ठीवनाक्रोशने कृते। उल्मुकेन दहेज्निह्वां दातव्यं च हिरण्यकम्
verses.wordMeaning: Or he should observe four or five Candrayana® vows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or he should observe four or five Candrayana® vows.

verses.sanskrit: पतितैः संप्रयुक्तानामथ वक्ष्यामि निष्कृतिम् । पतितेन तु संसर्गं यो येन कुरुते द्विजः । स तत्पापापनोदार्थं तस्यैव व्रतमाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: patitaiḥ saṃprayuktānāmatha vakṣyāmi niṣkṛtim / patitena tu saṃsargaṃ yo yena kurute dvijaḥ / sa tatpāpāpanodārthaṃ tasyaiva vratamācaret
verses.translation: If a Brahmana has close intimacy with a fallen fellow, he should perform the expiatory rite enjoined for that person, for the purpose of wiping off that sin.
verses.hindi: देवोद्याने तु यः कुर्यान्मूत्रोच्चारं सकृद् द्विजः । छिन्द्याच्छिशनं तु शुद्ध्यर्थं चरेच्यान्द्रायणं तु वा शिश्नस्योत्कर्तनं कृत्वा चान्द्रायणमथाचरेत्
verses.wordMeaning: If a Brahmana has close intimacy with a fallen fellow, he should perform the expiatory rite enjoined for that person, for the purpose of wiping off that sin.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a Brahmana has close intimacy with a fallen fellow, he should perform the expiatory rite enjoined for that person, for the purpose of wiping off that sin.

verses.sanskrit: तप्तकृच्छ्रं चरेद् वाथ संवत्सरमतन्द्रितः । षाण्मासिके तु संसर्गे प्रायश्चित्तार्धमर्हति
verses.transliteration: taptakṛcchraṃ cared vātha saṃvatsaramatandritaḥ / ṣāṇmāsike tu saṃsarge prāyaścittārdhamarhati
verses.translation: If the close intimacy is of six months duration, he should perform Taptahrcchra rite alertfully for a year, as an expiatory rite.
verses.hindi: कृत्वा सम्यकू प्रकुवीत प्राजापत्यं द्विजोत्तमः
verses.wordMeaning: If the close intimacy is of six months duration, he should perform Taptahrcchra rite alertfully for a year, as an expiatory rite.
verses.commentary: Sense: If the close intimacy is of six months duration, he should perform Taptahrcchra rite alertfully for a year, as an expiatory rite.

verses.sanskrit: एभिर्व्रतैरपोहन्ति महापातकिनो मलम् । पुण्यतीर्थाभिगमनात् पृथिव्यां वाथ निष्कृतिः
verses.transliteration: ebhirvratairapohanti mahāpātakino malam / puṇyatīrthābhigamanāt pṛthivyāṃ vātha niṣkṛtiḥ
verses.translation: The great sinners, wipe off their sins and impurities by means of these holy rites. Or the expiation on the Earth (can be achieved) by visiting holy centres.
verses.hindi: तैस्तु सम्भाषणं कृत्वा स्नात्वा देवान् समर्चयेत्। दृष्टा वीक्षेत भास्वन्तं स्मृत्वा विश्वेश्वरं स्मरेत् न तस्य निष्कृतिः शक्या कर्तु वर्षशतेरपि
verses.wordMeaning: The great sinners, wipe off their sins and impurities by means of these holy rites. Or the expiation on the Earth (can be achieved) by visiting holy centres.
verses.commentary: Sense: The great sinners, wipe off their sins and impurities by means of these holy rites. Or the expiation on the Earth (can be achieved) by visiting holy centres.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्महत्या सुरापानं स्तेयं गुर्वङ्गनागमः । कृत्वा तैश्चापि संसर्गं ब्राह्मणः कामकारतः
verses.transliteration: brahmahatyā surāpānaṃ steyaṃ gurvaṅganāgamaḥ / kṛtvā taiścāpi saṃsargaṃ brāhmaṇaḥ kāmakārataḥ
verses.translation: Pardka is called Krcchra hy some and is said to remove all sins. It constitutes of not taking food for twelve days and remaining self-controlled and vigilant (Manu XI. 215, A 10).
verses.hindi: प्रपन्नः शरणं देवं तस्मात् पापाद् विमुच्यते
verses.wordMeaning: Pardka is called Krcchra hy some and is said to remove all sins. It constitutes of not taking food for twelve days and remaining self-controlled and vigilant (Manu XI. 215, A 10).
verses.commentary: Sense: Pardka is called Krcchra hy some and is said to remove all sins. It constitutes of not taking food for twelve days and remaining self-controlled and vigilant (Manu XI. 215, A 10).

verses.sanskrit: कुर्यादनशनं विप्रः पुण्यतीर्थे समाहितः । ज्वलन्तं वा विशेदग्निं ध्यात्वा देवं कपर्दिनम्
verses.transliteration: kuryādanaśanaṃ vipraḥ puṇyatīrthe samāhitaḥ / jvalantaṃ vā viśedagniṃ dhyātvā devaṃ kapardinam
verses.translation: If one cohabits with one's mother's sister or the wife of the maternal uncle, or the sister of one's father or a niece, one should perform the expiatory rites of Krcchra and Atikrcchra.
verses.hindi: सर्वस्वदानं विधिवत् सर्वपापविशोधनम्। चान्द्रायणं च विधिना कृच्छं चैवातिकृच्छुकम् पुण्यक्षेत्राभिगमनं सर्वपापविनाशनम्! देवताभ्यर्चनं नृणामशेषाधविनाशनम्
verses.wordMeaning: If one cohabits with one's mother's sister or the wife of the maternal uncle, or the sister of one's father or a niece, one should perform the expiatory rites of Krcchra and Atikrcchra.
verses.commentary: Sense: If one cohabits with one's mother's sister or the wife of the maternal uncle, or the sister of one's father or a niece, one should perform the expiatory rites of Krcchra and Atikrcchra.

verses.sanskrit: न ह्यन्या निष्कृतिर्दृष्टा मुनिभिर्धर्मवादिभिः । तस्मात् पुण्येषु तीर्थेषु दहेद् वापि स्वदेहकम्
verses.transliteration: na hyanyā niṣkṛtirdṛṣṭā munibhirdharmavādibhiḥ / tasmāt puṇyeṣu tīrtheṣu dahed vāpi svadehakam
verses.translation: In order to quell that sin, one should observe the Candrayana vow meditating on lord Hari, the source of origin of the universe, the lord devoid of beginning and end.
verses.hindi: तृणद्वारा भी (उनको) ताडना करनेपर, वस्त्रद्वारा कण्ठ बाँधनेपर, विवादमें पराजित करनेपर प्रणामके द्वारा उन्हें प्रसन्न करना चाहिए। ब्राह्मणको धमकानेपर कृच्छुत्रत और पटक देनेपर अतिकृच्छत्रत करना
verses.wordMeaning: In order to quell that sin, one should observe the Candrayana vow meditating on lord Hari, the source of origin of the universe, the lord devoid of beginning and end.
verses.commentary: Sense: In order to quell that sin, one should observe the Candrayana vow meditating on lord Hari, the source of origin of the universe, the lord devoid of beginning and end.

verses.sanskrit: गत्वा दुहितरं विप्रः स्वसारं वा स्नुषामपि । प्रविशेज्ज्वलनं दीप्तं मतिपूर्वमिति स्थितिः
verses.transliteration: gatvā duhitaraṃ vipraḥ svasāraṃ vā snuṣāmapi / praviśejjvalanaṃ dīptaṃ matipūrvamiti sthitiḥ
verses.translation: For the destruction of the sin of cohabiting with one's own brother's wife, one should, with great concentration perform four or five Candrayana rites.
verses.hindi: चाहिए। विप्रका रक्त बहानेपर कुच्छ तथा अतिकृच्छु दोनों ब्रत करना चाहिए गुरुको गाली या शाप देनेपर या उनसे झूठ बोलनेपर उस पापको शुद्धिके लिये (पापके तारतम्यके अनुसार) एक रात या तीन रातका उपवास रखना चाहिए। देवताओं और ऋषियोंको ओर थूकने तथा
verses.wordMeaning: For the destruction of the sin of cohabiting with one's own brother's wife, one should, with great concentration perform four or five Candrayana rites.
verses.commentary: Sense: For the destruction of the sin of cohabiting with one's own brother's wife, one should, with great concentration perform four or five Candrayana rites.

verses.sanskrit: मातृष्वसां मातुलानीं तथैव च पितृष्वसाम् । भागिनेयीं समारुह्य कुर्यात् कृच्छ्रातिकृच्छ्रकौ
verses.transliteration: mātṛṣvasāṃ mātulānīṃ tathaiva ca pitṛṣvasām / bhāgineyīṃ samāruhya kuryāt kṛcchrātikṛcchrakau
verses.translation: If one commits adultery with father's niece or mother's niece or the daughter of the maternal uncle one shall perform the Candrayana rite.
verses.hindi: (उनके प्रति) आक्रोश (आक्षेप) प्रकट करनेपर उल्मुक (अंगारवाली लकड़ी)-से जीभका दाह करना चाहिए और स्वर्णका दान करना चाहिए। जो द्विज
verses.wordMeaning: If one commits adultery with father's niece or mother's niece or the daughter of the maternal uncle one shall perform the Candrayana rite.
verses.commentary: Sense: If one commits adultery with father's niece or mother's niece or the daughter of the maternal uncle one shall perform the Candrayana rite.

verses.sanskrit: चान्द्रायणं च कुर्वोत तस्य पापस्य शान्तये । ध्यायन् देवं जगद्योनिमनादिनिधनं परम्
verses.transliteration: cāndrāyaṇaṃ ca kurvota tasya pāpasya śāntaye / dhyāyan devaṃ jagadyonimanādinidhanaṃ param
verses.translation: If one cohabits with the wife of friend or the sister of one's own wife one should observe fast for a day and a night and then perform the Krcchra rite.
verses.hindi: करता है तो शुद्धिके लिये मूत्रेन्द्रियका छेदन कर देना चाहिए अथवा चान्द्रायणव्रत करना चाहिए । जो द्विजोत्तम देवमन्दिरमें मोहवश मूत्रोत्सर्ग करता है, उसे मूत्रेन्द्रियका उच्छेद करके चान्द्रायणव्रत करना चाहिए। देवताओं, ऋषियों तथा देवों (देवतुल्य महापुरुषों-माता, पिता, गुरु आदि)-की निन्दा करनेपर द्विंजोत्तमको भलीभाँति प्राजापत्य-व्रत करना चाहिए। इनके साथ सम्भाषण करनेपर स्नान करके देवताओंकी पूजा करनी चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: If one cohabits with the wife of friend or the sister of one's own wife one should observe fast for a day and a night and then perform the Krcchra rite.
verses.commentary: Sense: If one cohabits with the wife of friend or the sister of one's own wife one should observe fast for a day and a night and then perform the Krcchra rite.

verses.sanskrit: भ्रातृभार्यां समारुह्य कुर्यात् तत्पापशान्तये । चान्द्रायणानि चत्वारि पञ्च वा सुसमाहितः
verses.transliteration: bhrātṛbhāryāṃ samāruhya kuryāt tatpāpaśāntaye / cāndrāyaṇāni catvāri pañca vā susamāhitaḥ
verses.translation: If one cohabits with a cow, one should observe the Candrayana rite. By cohabiting with a prostitute, a Brahmana (incurs sin and), he should perform the Prajapatya vow.
verses.hindi: और उन्हें देखनेपर सूर्यका दर्शन करना चाहिए तथा विश्वेश्वरका स्मरण करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: If one cohabits with a cow, one should observe the Candrayana rite. By cohabiting with a prostitute, a Brahmana (incurs sin and), he should perform the Prajapatya vow.
verses.commentary: Sense: If one cohabits with a cow, one should observe the Candrayana rite. By cohabiting with a prostitute, a Brahmana (incurs sin and), he should perform the Prajapatya vow.

verses.sanskrit: पैतृष्वस्त्रेयीं गत्वा तु स्वस्त्रेयां मातुरेव च । मातुलस्य सुतां वापि गत्वा चान्द्रायणं चरेत्
verses.transliteration: paitṛṣvastreyīṃ gatvā tu svastreyāṃ mātureva ca / mātulasya sutāṃ vāpi gatvā cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret
verses.translation: By carnally approaching a fallen woman, one shall become sinful and be purified only by three Krcchra rites. To wipe off the sin of cohabiting with a Pulkasi (Candala woman), one shall observe the vows of Krcchra and Candrayana.
verses.hindi: जो सभी प्राणियोके अधिपति विश्वेशानकी निन्दा करता है, उसके पापको शुद्धि सौ वर्षोमे भी सम्भव नहीं है, पर (पश्चात्तापपूर्वक) पहले चान्द्रायणब्रत करे, अनन्तर कृच्छू तथा अतिकृच्छूव्रतोंको श्रद्धापूर्वक करके देव (शंकर)-को शरणमें जाय। ऐसा करनेपर देव शंकरकी कृपासे ही पापसे मुक्ति हो जाती है । विधिपूर्वक अपना सर्वस्व दान करनेसे सभी पापोंकी शुद्धि हो जाती है। इसी प्रकार विधिपूर्वक चान्द्रायणव्रत करने,
verses.wordMeaning: By carnally approaching a fallen woman, one shall become sinful and be purified only by three Krcchra rites. To wipe off the sin of cohabiting with a Pulkasi (Candala woman), one shall observe the vows of Krcchra and Candrayana.
verses.commentary: Sense: By carnally approaching a fallen woman, one shall become sinful and be purified only by three Krcchra rites. To wipe off the sin of cohabiting with a Pulkasi (Candala woman), one shall observe the vows of Krcchra and Candrayana.

verses.sanskrit: सखिभार्यां समारुह्य गत्वा श्यालीं तथैव च । अहोरात्रोषितो भूत्वा तप्तकृच्छ्रं समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: sakhibhāryāṃ samāruhya gatvā śyālīṃ tathaiva ca / ahorātroṣito bhūtvā taptakṛcchraṃ samācaret
verses.translation: By cohabiting with a dancing woman, or an actress, or a washer-woman selling bamboos or working in hides for livelihood, one should perform Candrayana rite.
verses.hindi: कृच्छ और अतिकृच्छूव्रतोंको करनेसे सभी पाप दूर हो जाते हैं। पुण्य क्षेत्रोंकी यात्रा सभी पापोंको दूर कर देती है। मनुष्योंके लिये देवताओंकी आराधना करना सम्पूर्ण पापोंके नाशका अचूक साधन है
verses.wordMeaning: By cohabiting with a dancing woman, or an actress, or a washer-woman selling bamboos or working in hides for livelihood, one should perform Candrayana rite.
verses.commentary: Sense: By cohabiting with a dancing woman, or an actress, or a washer-woman selling bamboos or working in hides for livelihood, one should perform Candrayana rite.

verses.sanskrit: उदक्यागमने विप्रस्त्रिरात्रेण विशुध्यति । चाण्डालीगमने चैव तप्तकृच्छ्रत्रयं विदुः । सह सांतपनेनास्य नान्यथा निष्कृतिः स्मृता
verses.transliteration: udakyāgamane viprastrirātreṇa viśudhyati / cāṇḍālīgamane caiva taptakṛcchratrayaṃ viduḥ / saha sāṃtapanenāsya nānyathā niṣkṛtiḥ smṛtā
verses.translation: If a religious student being deluded by passion indul¬ ges in sexual intercourse with a woman, he should wear the skin of a donkey and beg for alms at seven houses.
verses.hindi: ब्राह्मणान् भोजयित्वा तु सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते कृष्णाष्टम्यां महादेवं तथा कृष्णचतुर्दशीम्। सम्पूज्य ब्राह्मणमुखे सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते
verses.wordMeaning: If a religious student being deluded by passion indul¬ ges in sexual intercourse with a woman, he should wear the skin of a donkey and beg for alms at seven houses.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a religious student being deluded by passion indul¬ ges in sexual intercourse with a woman, he should wear the skin of a donkey and beg for alms at seven houses.

verses.sanskrit: मातृगोत्रां समासाद्य समानप्रवरां तथा । चाद्रायणेन शुध्येत प्रयतात्मा समाहितः
verses.transliteration: mātṛgotrāṃ samāsādya samānapravarāṃ tathā / cādrāyaṇena śudhyeta prayatātmā samāhitaḥ
verses.translation: He should perform ablutions three times a day, pro¬ claiming his sin. He should be released from that sin in the course of a year.
verses.hindi: यमाय धर्मराजाय मृत्यवे चान्तकाय च
verses.wordMeaning: He should perform ablutions three times a day, pro¬ claiming his sin. He should be released from that sin in the course of a year.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should perform ablutions three times a day, pro¬ claiming his sin. He should be released from that sin in the course of a year.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणो ब्राह्मणीं गत्वा गृच्छ्रमेकं समाचरेत् । कन्यकां दूषयित्वा तु चरेच्चान्द्रायणव्रतम्
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇo brāhmaṇīṃ gatvā gṛcchramekaṃ samācaret / kanyakāṃ dūṣayitvā tu careccāndrāyaṇavratam
verses.translation: An Avakirnin (a religious student violating the rules of chastity) should perform the expiatory rite for Brahmana- slaughter for the period of six months. Such a person gets relieved of the sin if he abides by the advice of Brahmanas.
verses.hindi: वैवस्वताय कालाय सर्वभूतक्षयाय च। प्रत्येकं तिलसंयुक्तान् दद्यात् सप्तोदकाञ्जलीन्। ब्रह्मचर्यमधःशय्यामुपवासं द्विजार्चनम्। व्रतेष्वेतेषु कुर्वीत शान्तः संयतमानसः
verses.wordMeaning: An Avakirnin (a religious student violating the rules of chastity) should perform the expiatory rite for Brahmana- slaughter for the period of six months. Such a person gets relieved of the sin if he abides by the advice of Brahmanas.
verses.commentary: Sense: An Avakirnin (a religious student violating the rules of chastity) should perform the expiatory rite for Brahmana- slaughter for the period of six months. Such a person gets relieved of the sin if he abides by the advice of Brahmanas.

verses.sanskrit: अमानुषीषु पुरुष उदक्यायामयोनिषु । रेतः सिक्त्वा जले चैव कृच्छ्रं सान्तपनं चरेत्
verses.transliteration: amānuṣīṣu puruṣa udakyāyāmayoniṣu / retaḥ siktvā jale caiva kṛcchraṃ sāntapanaṃ caret
verses.translation: One should perform the expiatory rite for the sin of discharging semen virile. He should not beg for alms for seven days nor should he worship the fire.
verses.hindi: अमावस्यायां ब्रह्माणं समुद्दिश्य पितामहम्।
verses.wordMeaning: One should perform the expiatory rite for the sin of discharging semen virile. He should not beg for alms for seven days nor should he worship the fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should perform the expiatory rite for the sin of discharging semen virile. He should not beg for alms for seven days nor should he worship the fire.

verses.sanskrit: बन्धकीगमने विप्रस्त्रिरात्रेण विशुद्ध्यति । गवि भथुनमासेव्य चरेच्चान्द्रायणव्रतम्
verses.transliteration: bandhakīgamane viprastrirātreṇa viśuddhyati / gavi bhathunamāsevya careccāndrāyaṇavratam
verses.translation: He should repeat always (the seven) great Vyahrtis beginning with Oihkara, for the period of a year. He should take food only at night. He should not be pure and should partake of the alms received after begging.
verses.hindi: षष्ठ्यामुपोषितो देवं शुक्लपक्षे समाहितः । एकादश्यां निराहारः समभ्यर्च्य जनार्दनम्। द्वादश्यां शुक्लपक्षस्य महापापैः प्रमुच्यते
verses.wordMeaning: He should repeat always (the seven) great Vyahrtis beginning with Oihkara, for the period of a year. He should take food only at night. He should not be pure and should partake of the alms received after begging.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should repeat always (the seven) great Vyahrtis beginning with Oihkara, for the period of a year. He should take food only at night. He should not be pure and should partake of the alms received after begging.

verses.sanskrit: अजावी मैथुनं कृत्वा प्राजापत्यं चरेद् द्विजः । पतितां च स्त्रियं गत्वा त्रिभिः कृच्छ्रै र्विशुद्ध्यति
verses.transliteration: ajāvī maithunaṃ kṛtvā prājāpatyaṃ cared dvijaḥ / patitāṃ ca striyaṃ gatvā tribhiḥ kṛcchrai rviśuddhyati
verses.translation: With his anger shed off, he should perform the Japa of Savitri (Gayatri, Mantra) rapidly (?) on the bank of the river or holy places. He is thereby absolved of his sin.
verses.hindi: तपो जपस्तीर्थसेवा देवब्राह्ाणपूजनम्। ग्रहणादिषु कालेषु महापातकशोधनम्
verses.wordMeaning: With his anger shed off, he should perform the Japa of Savitri (Gayatri, Mantra) rapidly (?) on the bank of the river or holy places. He is thereby absolved of his sin.
verses.commentary: Sense: With his anger shed off, he should perform the Japa of Savitri (Gayatri, Mantra) rapidly (?) on the bank of the river or holy places. He is thereby absolved of his sin.

verses.sanskrit: पुल्कसीगमने चैव क्रच्छ्रं चान्द्रायणं चरेत् । नटीं शैलूषकीं चैव रजकीं वेणुजीविनीम् । गत्वा चान्द्रायणं कुर्यात् तथा चर्मोपजीविनीम्
