verses.transliteration: pulkasīgamane caiva kracchraṃ cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret / naṭīṃ śailūṣakīṃ caiva rajakīṃ veṇujīvinīm / gatvā cāndrāyaṇaṃ kuryāt tathā carmopajīvinīm
verses.translation: If a Brahmana unintentionally murders a Ksatriya, he should perform the expiatory rite of a Brahmana-slayer for six months or make a gift of five hundred cows.
verses.hindi: यः सर्वपापयुक्तोऽपि पुण्यतीर्थषु मानवः। नियमेन त्यजेत् प्राणान् स मुच्येत् सर्वपातकैः ब्रह्मां वा कृतघ्नं वा महापातकदूषितम् । भर्तारमुद्धरेन्नारी प्रविष्टा सह पावकम्
verses.wordMeaning: If a Brahmana unintentionally murders a Ksatriya, he should perform the expiatory rite of a Brahmana-slayer for six months or make a gift of five hundred cows.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a Brahmana unintentionally murders a Ksatriya, he should perform the expiatory rite of a Brahmana-slayer for six months or make a gift of five hundred cows.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रहामचारी स्त्रियं गच्छेत् कथञ्चित्काममोहितः । सप्तगारं चरेद् भैक्षं वसित्वा गर्दभाजिनम्
verses.transliteration: brahāmacārī striyaṃ gacchet kathañcitkāmamohitaḥ / saptagāraṃ cared bhaikṣaṃ vasitvā gardabhājinam
verses.translation: Or he should remain in a forest performing medita¬ tion with great concentration and perform Prajapatya, Santapana or Taptakrcchra rite for a year.
verses.hindi: एतदेव परं स्त्रीणां प्रायश्चित्तं विदुर्बुधाः । सर्वपापसमुदभूतौ नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.wordMeaning: Or he should remain in a forest performing medita¬ tion with great concentration and perform Prajapatya, Santapana or Taptakrcchra rite for a year.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or he should remain in a forest performing medita¬ tion with great concentration and perform Prajapatya, Santapana or Taptakrcchra rite for a year.

verses.sanskrit: उपस्पृशेत् त्रिषवणं स्वपापं परिकीर्तयन् । संवत्सरेण चैकेन तस्मात् पापात् प्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: upaspṛśet triṣavaṇaṃ svapāpaṃ parikīrtayan / saṃvatsareṇa caikena tasmāt pāpāt pramucyate
verses.translation: Either by mistake or wantonly, if he happens to kill a Vaisya, he should perform the expiatory rite of a Brahmana-slayer and make gifts of a thousand cows and a fourth of it (i.e. two hundred and fifty).
verses.hindi: अमावास्या तिथि आनेपर जो शिवकी भलीभाँति आराधना करता है और ब्राह्मणोंको भोजन कराता है, तथा कृष्णपक्षको ही चतुर्दशीको महादेव शंकरका पूजन कर ब्राह्मणको भोजन करानेसे सभी पापोंसे मुक्ति हो जाती है । त्रयोदशीकी रात्रिके प्रथम याममें उपहारसहित त्रिलोचन ईश शंकरका दर्शन करनेसे मनुष्य सभी
verses.wordMeaning: Either by mistake or wantonly, if he happens to kill a Vaisya, he should perform the expiatory rite of a Brahmana-slayer and make gifts of a thousand cows and a fourth of it (i.e. two hundred and fifty).
verses.commentary: Sense: Either by mistake or wantonly, if he happens to kill a Vaisya, he should perform the expiatory rite of a Brahmana-slayer and make gifts of a thousand cows and a fourth of it (i.e. two hundred and fifty).

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्महत्याव्रतं वापि षण्मासानाचरेद् यमी । मुच्यते ह्यवकीर्णो तु ब्राह्मणानुमते स्थितः
verses.transliteration: brahmahatyāvrataṃ vāpi ṣaṇmāsānācared yamī / mucyate hyavakīrṇo tu brāhmaṇānumate sthitaḥ
verses.translation: After killing a Sudra by mistake, one should perform expiatory rites for a year. He should perform the rites Krcchra and Atikrcchra or the rite of Candrayana.
verses.hindi: पातकोंसे मुक्त हो जाता है। कृष्णपक्षको चतुर्दशीको पूर्वाहमें समाहित होकर नदीमें सत्रानकर उपवास करके यम, धर्मराज, मृत्यु, अन्तक, वैवस्वत, काल तथा सर्वभूतविनाशक-इनमें प्रत्येकके निमित्त तिलमिश्रित
verses.wordMeaning: After killing a Sudra by mistake, one should perform expiatory rites for a year. He should perform the rites Krcchra and Atikrcchra or the rite of Candrayana.
verses.commentary: Sense: After killing a Sudra by mistake, one should perform expiatory rites for a year. He should perform the rites Krcchra and Atikrcchra or the rite of Candrayana.

verses.sanskrit: सप्तरात्रमकृत्वा तु भैक्षचर्याग्निपूजनम् । रेतसश्च समुत्सर्गे प्रायश्चित्तं समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: saptarātramakṛtvā tu bhaikṣacaryāgnipūjanam / retasaśca samutsarge prāyaścittaṃ samācaret
verses.translation: For wipping off the sin of killing a Ksatriya, a Vaisya or a Sudra, the expiatory rite in order is the gift of a thousand or five hundred or two hundred and fifty cows. Or he shall perform the expiatory rite of a Brahmana-slayer for eight or three years.
verses.hindi: सात जलाञ्जलि प्रदान करनेवाला सभी पातकोंसे मुक्त हो जाता है (प्रायश्चित्तके प्रसंगसे उपदिष्ट) इन सभी व्रतोंमें शान्त और संयतमन होकर ब्रह्मचर्य, भूमिशयन, उपवास तथा ब्राह्मणोंकी पूजा करनी चाहिए। अमावास्याको पितामह ब्रह्माको उद्दिष्ट करके तीन ब्राह्मणोंकी पूजा
verses.wordMeaning: For wipping off the sin of killing a Ksatriya, a Vaisya or a Sudra, the expiatory rite in order is the gift of a thousand or five hundred or two hundred and fifty cows. Or he shall perform the expiatory rite of a Brahmana-slayer for eight or three years.
verses.commentary: Sense: For wipping off the sin of killing a Ksatriya, a Vaisya or a Sudra, the expiatory rite in order is the gift of a thousand or five hundred or two hundred and fifty cows. Or he shall perform the expiatory rite of a Brahmana-slayer for eight or three years.

verses.sanskrit: ओङ्कारपूर्विकाभिस्तु महाव्याहृतिभिः सदा । संवत्सरं तु भुञ्जानो नक्तं भिक्षाशनः शुचिः
verses.transliteration: oṅkārapūrvikābhistu mahāvyāhṛtibhiḥ sadā / saṃvatsaraṃ tu bhuñjāno naktaṃ bhikṣāśanaḥ śuciḥ
verses.translation: After killing a Brahmana woman, aBrahmana should perform the expiatory rite for eight years; after killing a Ksa¬ triya woman, he should perform the expiatory rite for six years; after killing a Vaisya woman, he should perform the expiatory rite for three years.
verses.hindi: करनेसे सभी पातकोंसे मुक्ति हो जाती है। शुक्लपक्षकी
verses.wordMeaning: After killing a Brahmana woman, aBrahmana should perform the expiatory rite for eight years; after killing a Ksa¬ triya woman, he should perform the expiatory rite for six years; after killing a Vaisya woman, he should perform the expiatory rite for three years.
verses.commentary: Sense: After killing a Brahmana woman, aBrahmana should perform the expiatory rite for eight years; after killing a Ksa¬ triya woman, he should perform the expiatory rite for six years; after killing a Vaisya woman, he should perform the expiatory rite for three years.

verses.sanskrit: सावित्रीं च जपेच्चैव नित्यं क्रोधविवर्जितः । नदीतीरेषु तीर्थेषु तस्मात् पापाद् विमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: sāvitrīṃ ca japeccaiva nityaṃ krodhavivarjitaḥ / nadītīreṣu tīrtheṣu tasmāt pāpād vimucyate
verses.translation: After killing a Sudra woman, an excellent Brahmana shall become pure within a year. A twice-born should give something as a gift for a twice-born to wipe off the sin of killing Vaisya woman.
verses.hindi: सूर्यदेवकी पूजा करनी चाहिए, इससे सभी पापोंसे मुक्ति हो जाती है। शनिवारको भरणी नक्षत्र और चतुर्थी तिथि होनेपर (ऐसे योगमें) जो मनुष्य यमराजका पूजन करता है, बह सात जन्मोंमें किये गये पापोंसे मुक्त हो जाता है। शुक्लपक्षकी एकादशीको निराहार रहकर द्वादशीको जनार्दनकी पूजा करनेसे महापापोंसे मुक्ति मिल जाती है॥ १०१--१०५॥
verses.wordMeaning: After killing a Sudra woman, an excellent Brahmana shall become pure within a year. A twice-born should give something as a gift for a twice-born to wipe off the sin of killing Vaisya woman.
verses.commentary: Sense: After killing a Sudra woman, an excellent Brahmana shall become pure within a year. A twice-born should give something as a gift for a twice-born to wipe off the sin of killing Vaisya woman.

verses.sanskrit: हत्वा तु क्षत्रियं विप्रः कुर्याद् ब्रह्महणो व्रतम् । अकामतो वै षण्मासान् दद्यान् पञ्चशतं गवाम्
verses.transliteration: hatvā tu kṣatriyaṃ vipraḥ kuryād brahmahaṇo vratam / akāmato vai ṣaṇmāsān dadyān pañcaśataṃ gavām
verses.translation: After the murder of the outcaste also, one should per¬ form the Candrayana rite. God Brahma says that he will regain purity by means of the expiatory rite called Paraka.
verses.hindi: सूर्य तथा चन्द्रग्रहण आदि समयोंमें जप, तप, तीर्थ- सेवा और देवता तथा ब्राह्मणोंका पूजन महापातकोंसे शुद्ध करनेवाला होता है। सभी पापोंसे युक्त होनेपर भी जो मनुष्य नियमपूर्वक पुण्य तीर्थोमें प्राणोंका त्याग करता
verses.wordMeaning: After the murder of the outcaste also, one should per¬ form the Candrayana rite. God Brahma says that he will regain purity by means of the expiatory rite called Paraka.
verses.commentary: Sense: After the murder of the outcaste also, one should per¬ form the Candrayana rite. God Brahma says that he will regain purity by means of the expiatory rite called Paraka.

verses.sanskrit: अब्दं चरेत नियतो वनवासी समाहितः । प्राजापत्यं सान्तपनं तप्तकृच्छ्रं तु वा स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: abdaṃ careta niyato vanavāsī samāhitaḥ / prājāpatyaṃ sāntapanaṃ taptakṛcchraṃ tu vā svayam
verses.translation: After killing a frog, a mungoose, a crow, a cat, a mule or a mouse or a dog, a Brahmana should perform a sixteenth of the Mahavrata (great vow).
verses.hindi: है, वह समस्त पापोंसे मुक्त हो जाता है मृत पतिके साथ अग्निमें प्रवेश करनेवाली नारी ब्रह्मघाती, कृतघ्न अथवा महापातकोंसे दूषित भी पतिका उद्धार कर देती है। विद्वानोंने स्त्रीके लिये सभी प्रकारके पापोंका यही (पातित्रतधर्म-पालन ही) श्रेष्ठ प्रायश्चित्त बतलाया
verses.wordMeaning: After killing a frog, a mungoose, a crow, a cat, a mule or a mouse or a dog, a Brahmana should perform a sixteenth of the Mahavrata (great vow).
verses.commentary: Sense: After killing a frog, a mungoose, a crow, a cat, a mule or a mouse or a dog, a Brahmana should perform a sixteenth of the Mahavrata (great vow).

verses.sanskrit: प्रमाप्याकामतो वैश्यं कुर्यात् संवत्सरद्वयम् । गोसहस्रं सपादं च दद्याद् ब्रह्महणो व्रतम् । कृच्छ्रातिकृच्छ्रौ वा कुर्याच्चान्द्रायणमथावि वा
verses.transliteration: pramāpyākāmato vaiśyaṃ kuryāt saṃvatsaradvayam / gosahasraṃ sapādaṃ ca dadyād brahmahaṇo vratam / kṛcchrātikṛcchrau vā kuryāccāndrāyaṇamathāvi vā
verses.translation: After killing a frog, a mungoose, a crow, a cat, a mule or a mouse or a dog, a Brahmana should perform a sixteenth of the Mahavrata (great vow).
verses.hindi: है। इसमें विचार नहीं करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: After killing a frog, a mungoose, a crow, a cat, a mule or a mouse or a dog, a Brahmana should perform a sixteenth of the Mahavrata (great vow).
verses.commentary: Sense: After killing a frog, a mungoose, a crow, a cat, a mule or a mouse or a dog, a Brahmana should perform a sixteenth of the Mahavrata (great vow).

verses.sanskrit: संवत्सरं व्रतं कुर्याच्छूद्रं हत्वा प्रमादतः । गोसहस्रार्धपादं च दद्यात् तत्पापशान्तये
verses.transliteration: saṃvatsaraṃ vrataṃ kuryācchūdraṃ hatvā pramādataḥ / gosahasrārdhapādaṃ ca dadyāt tatpāpaśāntaye
verses.translation: After killing a frog, a mungoose, a crow, a cat, a mule or a mouse or a dog, a Brahmana should perform a sixteenth of the Mahavrata (great vow).
verses.hindi: पतित्रता तु या नारी भर्तृशुश्रूषणोत्सुका। न तस्या विद्यते पापमिह लोके परत्र च पतित्रता धर्मरता रुद्राण्येव न संशय: । नास्याः पराभवं कर्तु शक्कोतीह जन: क्वचित्
verses.wordMeaning: After killing a frog, a mungoose, a crow, a cat, a mule or a mouse or a dog, a Brahmana should perform a sixteenth of the Mahavrata (great vow).
verses.commentary: Sense: After killing a frog, a mungoose, a crow, a cat, a mule or a mouse or a dog, a Brahmana should perform a sixteenth of the Mahavrata (great vow).

verses.sanskrit: अष्टौ वर्षाणि षट् त्रीणि कुर्याद् ब्रह्महणो व्रतम् । हत्वा तु क्षत्रियं वैश्यं शूद्रं चैव यथाक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: aṣṭau varṣāṇi ṣaṭ trīṇi kuryād brahmahaṇo vratam / hatvā tu kṣatriyaṃ vaiśyaṃ śūdraṃ caiva yathākramam
verses.translation: After killing a frog, a mungoose, a crow, a cat, a mule or a mouse or a dog, a Brahmana should perform a sixteenth of the Mahavrata (great vow).
verses.hindi: यथा रामस्य सुभगा सीता त्रैलोक्यविश्रुता । पत्नी दाशरथेर्देवी विजिग्ये राक्षसेश्वरम्
verses.wordMeaning: After killing a frog, a mungoose, a crow, a cat, a mule or a mouse or a dog, a Brahmana should perform a sixteenth of the Mahavrata (great vow).
verses.commentary: Sense: After killing a frog, a mungoose, a crow, a cat, a mule or a mouse or a dog, a Brahmana should perform a sixteenth of the Mahavrata (great vow).

verses.sanskrit: निहत्य ब्राह्मणीं विप्रस्त्वष्टवर्षं व्रतं चरेत् । राजन्यां वर्षषट्कं तु वैश्यां संवत्सरत्रयम् । वत्सरेण विशुद्ध्येत शूद्रां हत्वा द्विजोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: nihatya brāhmaṇīṃ viprastvaṣṭavarṣaṃ vrataṃ caret / rājanyāṃ varṣaṣaṭkaṃ tu vaiśyāṃ saṃvatsaratrayam / vatsareṇa viśuddhyeta śūdrāṃ hatvā dvijottamaḥ
verses.translation: After killing a frog, a mungoose, a crow, a cat, a mule or a mouse or a dog, a Brahmana should perform a sixteenth of the Mahavrata (great vow).
verses.hindi: रामस्य भार्या विमलां रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः । सीतां विशालनयनां चकमे कालचोदितः समाहर्तु मतिं चक्रे तापसः किल कामिनीम्
verses.wordMeaning: After killing a frog, a mungoose, a crow, a cat, a mule or a mouse or a dog, a Brahmana should perform a sixteenth of the Mahavrata (great vow).
verses.commentary: Sense: After killing a frog, a mungoose, a crow, a cat, a mule or a mouse or a dog, a Brahmana should perform a sixteenth of the Mahavrata (great vow).

verses.sanskrit: वैश्यां हत्वा प्रमादेन किञ्चिद् दद्याद् द्विजातये । अन्त्यजानां वधे चैव कुर्याच्चान्द्रायणं व्रतम् । पराकेणाथवा शुद्धिरित्याह भगवानजः
verses.transliteration: vaiśyāṃ hatvā pramādena kiñcid dadyād dvijātaye / antyajānāṃ vadhe caiva kuryāccāndrāyaṇaṃ vratam / parākeṇāthavā śuddhirityāha bhagavānajaḥ
verses.translation: After killing a frog, a mungoose, a crow, a cat, a mule or a mouse or a dog, a Brahmana should perform a sixteenth of the Mahavrata (great vow).
verses.hindi: जगाम शरणं वह्विमावसथ्यं शुिस्मिता
verses.wordMeaning: After killing a frog, a mungoose, a crow, a cat, a mule or a mouse or a dog, a Brahmana should perform a sixteenth of the Mahavrata (great vow).
verses.commentary: Sense: After killing a frog, a mungoose, a crow, a cat, a mule or a mouse or a dog, a Brahmana should perform a sixteenth of the Mahavrata (great vow).

verses.sanskrit: मण्डूकं नकुलं काकं दन्दशूकं च मूषिकम् । श्वानं हत्वा द्विजः कुर्यात् षोडशांशं व्रतं ततः
verses.transliteration: maṇḍūkaṃ nakulaṃ kākaṃ dandaśūkaṃ ca mūṣikam / śvānaṃ hatvā dvijaḥ kuryāt ṣoḍaśāṃśaṃ vrataṃ tataḥ
verses.translation: After killing a frog, a mungoose, a crow, a cat, a mule or a mouse or a dog, a Brahmana should perform a sixteenth of the Mahavrata (great vow).
verses.hindi: दाहकं सर्वभूतानामीशानं कालरूपिणम् नमस्ये पावकं देवं साक्षिणं विश्वतोमुखम्। आत्मानं दीप्तवपुषं सर्वभूतहृदि स्थितम्
verses.wordMeaning: After killing a frog, a mungoose, a crow, a cat, a mule or a mouse or a dog, a Brahmana should perform a sixteenth of the Mahavrata (great vow).
verses.commentary: Sense: After killing a frog, a mungoose, a crow, a cat, a mule or a mouse or a dog, a Brahmana should perform a sixteenth of the Mahavrata (great vow).

verses.sanskrit: पयः पिबेत् त्रिरात्रं तु श्वानं हत्वा सुयन्त्रितः । मार्जारं वाथ नकुलं योजनं वाध्वनो व्रजेत् । कृच्छ्रं द्वादशरात्रं तु कुर्यादश्ववधे द्विजः
verses.transliteration: payaḥ pibet trirātraṃ tu śvānaṃ hatvā suyantritaḥ / mārjāraṃ vātha nakulaṃ yojanaṃ vādhvano vrajet / kṛcchraṃ dvādaśarātraṃ tu kuryādaśvavadhe dvijaḥ
verses.translation: After killing a frog, a mungoose, a crow, a cat, a mule or a mouse or a dog, a Brahmana should perform a sixteenth of the Mahavrata (great vow).
verses.hindi: प्रपद्ये शरणं वहं ब्रह्मण्यं ब्रह्मरूपिणम्। भूतेशं कृत्तिवसनं शरण्यं परमं पदम्
verses.wordMeaning: After killing a frog, a mungoose, a crow, a cat, a mule or a mouse or a dog, a Brahmana should perform a sixteenth of the Mahavrata (great vow).
verses.commentary: Sense: After killing a frog, a mungoose, a crow, a cat, a mule or a mouse or a dog, a Brahmana should perform a sixteenth of the Mahavrata (great vow).

verses.sanskrit: अभ्रीं कार्ष्णायसीं दद्यात् सर्पं हत्वा द्विजोत्तमः । पलालभारं षण्डं च सैसकं चैकमाषकम्
verses.transliteration: abhrīṃ kārṣṇāyasīṃ dadyāt sarpaṃ hatvā dvijottamaḥ / palālabhāraṃ ṣaṇḍaṃ ca saisakaṃ caikamāṣakam
verses.translation: After killing a frog, a mungoose, a crow, a cat, a mule or a mouse or a dog, a Brahmana should perform a sixteenth of the Mahavrata (great vow).
verses.hindi: महायोगेश्वरं वह्विमादित्यं परमेष्ठिनम् १२०॥ कालाग्निं योगिनामीशं भोगमोक्षफलप्रदम्
verses.wordMeaning: After killing a frog, a mungoose, a crow, a cat, a mule or a mouse or a dog, a Brahmana should perform a sixteenth of the Mahavrata (great vow).
verses.commentary: Sense: After killing a frog, a mungoose, a crow, a cat, a mule or a mouse or a dog, a Brahmana should perform a sixteenth of the Mahavrata (great vow).

verses.sanskrit: धृतकुम्भं वराहं च तिलद्रोणं च तित्तिरिम् । शुकं द्विहायनं वत्सं क्रौञ्चं हत्वा त्रिहायनम्
verses.transliteration: dhṛtakumbhaṃ varāhaṃ ca tiladroṇaṃ ca tittirim / śukaṃ dvihāyanaṃ vatsaṃ krauñcaṃ hatvā trihāyanam
verses.translation: After killing a frog, a mungoose, a crow, a cat, a mule or a mouse or a dog, a Brahmana should perform a sixteenth of the Mahavrata (great vow).
verses.hindi: जो नारी पतिव्रता है और पतिकी सेवा-शुश्रुषामें अनुरक्त है, उसके लिये न तो इस लोकमें कोई पाप है और न परलोकमें
verses.wordMeaning: After killing a frog, a mungoose, a crow, a cat, a mule or a mouse or a dog, a Brahmana should perform a sixteenth of the Mahavrata (great vow).
verses.commentary: Sense: After killing a frog, a mungoose, a crow, a cat, a mule or a mouse or a dog, a Brahmana should perform a sixteenth of the Mahavrata (great vow).

verses.sanskrit: हत्वा हंसं बलाकां च बकं बर्हिणमेव च । वानरं श्येनभासौ च स्पर्शयेद् ब्राह्मणाय गाम्
verses.transliteration: hatvā haṃsaṃ balākāṃ ca bakaṃ barhiṇameva ca / vānaraṃ śyenabhāsau ca sparśayed brāhmaṇāya gām
verses.translation: After killing a frog, a mungoose, a crow, a cat, a mule or a mouse or a dog, a Brahmana should perform a sixteenth of the Mahavrata (great vow).
verses.hindi: (पातिव्रत) धर्मपरायण पतिव्रता (स्त्री) रुद्राणी ही होती है, इसमें संदेह नहीं। इस संसारमें कोई भी मनुष्य इसे कभी भी पराजित करनेमें समर्थ नहीं है। उदाहरणके लिये दशरथके पुत्र रामको तीनों लोकोंमें प्रसिद्ध सुन्दर पत्नी देवी सीताने राक्षसेश्वर (रावण)-को पराजित कर दिया था। कालसे प्रेरित राक्षसराज रावणने रामकी सुन्दर तथा विशाल नेत्रोंवाली भार्या सीताको प्राप्त करनेकी इच्छा को। उसने मायासे तपस्वीका वेष धारणकर
verses.wordMeaning: After killing a frog, a mungoose, a crow, a cat, a mule or a mouse or a dog, a Brahmana should perform a sixteenth of the Mahavrata (great vow).
verses.commentary: Sense: After killing a frog, a mungoose, a crow, a cat, a mule or a mouse or a dog, a Brahmana should perform a sixteenth of the Mahavrata (great vow).

verses.sanskrit: क्रव्यादांस्तु मृगान् हत्वा धेनुं दद्यात् पयस्विनीम् । अक्रव्यादान् वत्सतरीमुष्ट्रं हत्वा तु कृष्णलम्
verses.transliteration: kravyādāṃstu mṛgān hatvā dhenuṃ dadyāt payasvinīm / akravyādān vatsatarīmuṣṭraṃ hatvā tu kṛṣṇalam
verses.translation: After killing a frog, a mungoose, a crow, a cat, a mule or a mouse or a dog, a Brahmana should perform a sixteenth of the Mahavrata (great vow).
verses.hindi: जनशून्य वनमें विचरण (निवास) करती हुई कामिनी (सीता)-का अपहरण करनेका विचार किया। तब पतिव्रता भगवती सीताने रावणके दुष्ट भावको समझकर अपने पति दशरथ-पुत्र रामका स्मरण किया और पवित्र
verses.wordMeaning: After killing a frog, a mungoose, a crow, a cat, a mule or a mouse or a dog, a Brahmana should perform a sixteenth of the Mahavrata (great vow).
verses.commentary: Sense: After killing a frog, a mungoose, a crow, a cat, a mule or a mouse or a dog, a Brahmana should perform a sixteenth of the Mahavrata (great vow).

verses.sanskrit: किञ्चिदेव तु विप्राय दद्यादस्थिमतां वधे । अनस्थ्नां चैव हिंसायां प्राणायामेन शुध्यति
verses.transliteration: kiñcideva tu viprāya dadyādasthimatāṃ vadhe / anasthnāṃ caiva hiṃsāyāṃ prāṇāyāmena śudhyati
verses.translation: After killing a frog, a mungoose, a crow, a cat, a mule or a mouse or a dog, a Brahmana should perform a sixteenth of the Mahavrata (great vow).
verses.hindi: मुसकानवाली उन सीतादेवीने आवसथ्य अग्निकी शरण ग्रहण को रामकी पत्नी (सीतादेवी) हाथ जोड़कर साक्षात् पतिके समान सभी दोषोंको नष्ट करनेवाले महायोगरूप अच्युत (अग्नि)-की शरणमें गयीं (और उनकी स्तुति करने लगीं-) महायोगस्वरूप, परम गहन (रहस्यस्वरूप),
verses.wordMeaning: After killing a frog, a mungoose, a crow, a cat, a mule or a mouse or a dog, a Brahmana should perform a sixteenth of the Mahavrata (great vow).
verses.commentary: Sense: After killing a frog, a mungoose, a crow, a cat, a mule or a mouse or a dog, a Brahmana should perform a sixteenth of the Mahavrata (great vow).

verses.sanskrit: फलदानां तु वृक्षाणां छेदने जप्यमृक्शतम् । गुल्मवल्लीलतानां तु पुष्पितानां च वीरुधाम्
verses.transliteration: phaladānāṃ tu vṛkṣāṇāṃ chedane japyamṛkśatam / gulmavallīlatānāṃ tu puṣpitānāṃ ca vīrudhām
verses.translation: After killing a frog, a mungoose, a crow, a cat, a mule or a mouse or a dog, a Brahmana should perform a sixteenth of the Mahavrata (great vow).
verses.hindi: कृतान्त, दहन करनेवाले, सभी प्राणियोंके नियामक कालरूपी अग्निको मैं नमस्कार करती हूँ। मैं सभी ओर मुखवाले, सभी प्राणियोंके हृदयमें स्थित, दीप्त शरीरवाले, आत्मरूप तथा साक्षीदेव पावक (अग्रि)-को
verses.wordMeaning: After killing a frog, a mungoose, a crow, a cat, a mule or a mouse or a dog, a Brahmana should perform a sixteenth of the Mahavrata (great vow).
verses.commentary: Sense: After killing a frog, a mungoose, a crow, a cat, a mule or a mouse or a dog, a Brahmana should perform a sixteenth of the Mahavrata (great vow).

verses.sanskrit: अन्येषां चैव वृक्षाणां सरसानां च सर्वशः । फलपुष्पोद्भवानां च घृतप्राशो विशोधनम्
verses.transliteration: anyeṣāṃ caiva vṛkṣāṇāṃ sarasānāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ / phalapuṣpodbhavānāṃ ca ghṛtaprāśo viśodhanam
verses.translation: After killing a frog, a mungoose, a crow, a cat, a mule or a mouse or a dog, a Brahmana should perform a sixteenth of the Mahavrata (great vow).
verses.hindi: नमस्कार करती हूँ। मैं ब्राह्मणोंके उपकारक, ब्रह्मरूपी, कृत्तिवासा,  शरणागतवत्सल, परमपदरूप भूतेश वहिकी शरण ग्रहण करती हूँ। मैं जगन्पूर्ति, सभी तेजोंके उद्धव-स्थान, महायोगेश्वर, परमेष्ठी, आदित्य और ओंकाररूप वहिदेवकी शरण ग्रहण करती हूँ
verses.wordMeaning: After killing a frog, a mungoose, a crow, a cat, a mule or a mouse or a dog, a Brahmana should perform a sixteenth of the Mahavrata (great vow).
verses.commentary: Sense: After killing a frog, a mungoose, a crow, a cat, a mule or a mouse or a dog, a Brahmana should perform a sixteenth of the Mahavrata (great vow).

verses.sanskrit: हस्तिनां च वधे दृष्टं तप्तकृच्छ्रं विशोधनम् । चान्द्रायणं पराकं वा गां हत्वा तु प्रमादतः । मतिपूर्वं वधे चास्याः प्रायश्चित्तं न विद्यते
verses.transliteration: hastināṃ ca vadhe dṛṣṭaṃ taptakṛcchraṃ viśodhanam / cāndrāyaṇaṃ parākaṃ vā gāṃ hatvā tu pramādataḥ / matipūrvaṃ vadhe cāsyāḥ prāyaścittaṃ na vidyate
verses.translation: After killing a frog, a mungoose, a crow, a cat, a mule or a mouse or a dog, a Brahmana should perform a sixteenth of the Mahavrata (great vow).
verses.hindi: मैं महाग्रास, त्रिशूली, भोग एवं मोक्षरूप फलोंके प्रदाता, योगियोंके ईश और रुद्रस्वरूप कालाग्रिकी शरण ग्रहण करती हूँ। मैं भूर्भुवः तथा स्व:स्वरूप, हिरण्मयगृहमें सुगुप्त, विरूपाक्ष तथा अमित तेजस्वी आप महानूकी
verses.wordMeaning: After killing a frog, a mungoose, a crow, a cat, a mule or a mouse or a dog, a Brahmana should perform a sixteenth of the Mahavrata (great vow).
verses.commentary: Sense: After killing a frog, a mungoose, a crow, a cat, a mule or a mouse or a dog, a Brahmana should perform a sixteenth of the Mahavrata (great vow).

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे द्वात्रिशो ऽध्यायः व्यास उवाच मनुष्याणां तु हरणं कृत्वा स्त्रीणां गृहस्य च । वापीकूपजलानां च शुध्येच्चान्द्रायणेन तु
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge dvātriśo 'dhyāyaḥ vyāsa uvāca manuṣyāṇāṃ tu haraṇaṃ kṛtvā strīṇāṃ gṛhasya ca / vāpīkūpajalānāṃ ca śudhyeccāndrāyaṇena tu
verses.translation: After killing a dog, one should alertfully drink milk (or water) for three days (?). After killing a cat or a mungoose, one should walk a distance of a Yojana ( = 12 km).
verses.hindi: शरण ग्रहण करती हूँ ५“कृत्ति' मृग आदिके चर्मको कहते हैं। अग्नि रुद्रके अंश हैं और रुद्र कृत्तिवासा हैं, इसलिये अग्निको भी कृत्तिवासा कहते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: After killing a dog, one should alertfully drink milk (or water) for three days (?). After killing a cat or a mungoose, one should walk a distance of a Yojana ( = 12 km).
verses.commentary: Sense: After killing a dog, one should alertfully drink milk (or water) for three days (?). After killing a cat or a mungoose, one should walk a distance of a Yojana ( = 12 km).

verses.sanskrit: द्रव्याणामल्पसाराणां स्तेयं कृत्वान्यवेश्मतः । चरेत् सांतपनं कृच्छ्रं तन्निर्यात्यात्मशुद्धये
verses.transliteration: dravyāṇāmalpasārāṇāṃ steyaṃ kṛtvānyaveśmataḥ / caret sāṃtapanaṃ kṛcchraṃ tanniryātyātmaśuddhaye
verses.translation: On killing a horse, a Brahmana should perform the expiation called Krcchra for twelve nights. On killing a serpent, the excellent Brahmana should make a gift of an image made of iron.
verses.hindi: हव्यकव्यवह देवं प्रपद्ये वह्विमीश्वरम्
verses.wordMeaning: On killing a horse, a Brahmana should perform the expiation called Krcchra for twelve nights. On killing a serpent, the excellent Brahmana should make a gift of an image made of iron.
verses.commentary: Sense: On killing a horse, a Brahmana should perform the expiation called Krcchra for twelve nights. On killing a serpent, the excellent Brahmana should make a gift of an image made of iron.

verses.sanskrit: धान्यान्नधनचौर्यं तु कृत्वा कामाद् द्विजोत्तमः । स्वजातीयगृहादेव कृच्छ्रार्धेन विशुद्ध्यति
verses.transliteration: dhānyānnadhanacauryaṃ tu kṛtvā kāmād dvijottamaḥ / svajātīyagṛhādeva kṛcchrārdhena viśuddhyati
verses.translation: On killing a eunuch one should make a gift of a palala (weight) of straw and a Masa weight of lead. On kill¬ ing a boar, one should gift away a jar or ghee and on killing a Tittira bird, one should make a gift of a Drona measure of gingelly seeds.
verses.hindi: इति वह्यष्टक॑ जप्त्वा रामपत्नी यशस्विनी । ध्यायन्ती मनसा तस्थौ राममुन्मीलितेक्षणा अथावसधथ्याद् भगवान् हव्यवाहो महेश्वरः । आविरासीत् सुदीप्तात्मा तेजसा प्रवहन्निव
verses.wordMeaning: On killing a eunuch one should make a gift of a palala (weight) of straw and a Masa weight of lead. On kill¬ ing a boar, one should gift away a jar or ghee and on killing a Tittira bird, one should make a gift of a Drona measure of gingelly seeds.
verses.commentary: Sense: On killing a eunuch one should make a gift of a palala (weight) of straw and a Masa weight of lead. On kill¬ ing a boar, one should gift away a jar or ghee and on killing a Tittira bird, one should make a gift of a Drona measure of gingelly seeds.

verses.sanskrit: भक्षभोज्यापहरणे यानशय्यासनस्य च । पुष्पमूलफलानां च पञ्चगव्यं विशोधनम्
verses.transliteration: bhakṣabhojyāpaharaṇe yānaśayyāsanasya ca / puṣpamūlaphalānāṃ ca pañcagavyaṃ viśodhanam
verses.translation: (Defective) On killing non-meat-eating (herbivorous) animals, one should gift away a heifer. On killing a camel one should gift away gold weighing a Gunja seed (?). On killing animals with bones (? backbones), some gift must he made over to a Brahmana.
verses.hindi: सीतामादाय धर्मिष्ठां पावकोऽन्तरधीयत
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective) On killing non-meat-eating (herbivorous) animals, one should gift away a heifer. On killing a camel one should gift away gold weighing a Gunja seed (?). On killing animals with bones (? backbones), some gift must he made over to a Brahmana.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective) On killing non-meat-eating (herbivorous) animals, one should gift away a heifer. On killing a camel one should gift away gold weighing a Gunja seed (?). On killing animals with bones (? backbones), some gift must he made over to a Brahmana.

verses.sanskrit: तृणकाष्ठद्रुमाणां च शुष्कान्नस्य गुडस्य च । चैलचर्मामिषाणां च त्रिरात्रं स्यादभोजनम्
verses.transliteration: tṛṇakāṣṭhadrumāṇāṃ ca śuṣkānnasya guḍasya ca / cailacarmāmiṣāṇāṃ ca trirātraṃ syādabhojanam
verses.translation: On causing violent injury to the boneless animals, one becomes pure by performing "Pranayama; for wiping off the sin of cutting fruit-bearing trees, one should perform the Japa of hundred Rks.
verses.hindi: तां दृष्टा तादूशीं सीतां रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः । समादाय ययौ लङ्कां सागरान्तरसंस्थिताम् समादायाभवत् सीतां शङ्काकुलितमानसः
verses.wordMeaning: On causing violent injury to the boneless animals, one becomes pure by performing "Pranayama; for wiping off the sin of cutting fruit-bearing trees, one should perform the Japa of hundred Rks.
verses.commentary: Sense: On causing violent injury to the boneless animals, one becomes pure by performing "Pranayama; for wiping off the sin of cutting fruit-bearing trees, one should perform the Japa of hundred Rks.

verses.sanskrit: मणिमुक्ताप्रवालानां ताम्रस्य रजतस्य च । अयः कांस्योपलानां च द्वादशाहं कणाशनम्
verses.transliteration: maṇimuktāpravālānāṃ tāmrasya rajatasya ca / ayaḥ kāṃsyopalānāṃ ca dvādaśāhaṃ kaṇāśanam
verses.translation: Drinking of ghee is the expiatory rite for the sins of cutting hedges, creepers and turning plants, flower-laden plants and trees, of killing birds of all types and the living beings born of sweat and destroying the outcome of fruits and flowers.
verses.hindi: दग्ध्वा मायामयीं सीतां भगवानुग्रदीधितिः । रामायादर्शयत् सीतां पावकोऽभूत् सुरप्रियः
verses.wordMeaning: Drinking of ghee is the expiatory rite for the sins of cutting hedges, creepers and turning plants, flower-laden plants and trees, of killing birds of all types and the living beings born of sweat and destroying the outcome of fruits and flowers.
verses.commentary: Sense: Drinking of ghee is the expiatory rite for the sins of cutting hedges, creepers and turning plants, flower-laden plants and trees, of killing birds of all types and the living beings born of sweat and destroying the outcome of fruits and flowers.

verses.sanskrit: कार्पासकीटजोर्णानां द्विशफैकशफस्य च । पक्षिगन्धौषधीनां च रज्वाश्चैव त्र्यहं पयः
verses.transliteration: kārpāsakīṭajorṇānāṃ dviśaphaikaśaphasya ca / pakṣigandhauṣadhīnāṃ ca rajvāścaiva tryahaṃ payaḥ
verses.translation: VV. 111-140 tell us a different story of the abduction of Sita than the one given by Valmiki. According to KP. real Sita was protected by Agni (the fire-god) the Avasathya (Household sacrificial) Fire and it was the illusory Sita) created by Agni that was abducted by Ravana. The Chaya- sita entered the fire for 'purification' and real Sita came out of the Fire-god and was accepted by Rama.
verses.hindi: प्रगृह्य भर्तुश्चरणौ कराभ्यां सा सुमध्यमा। चकार प्रणतिं भूमौ रामाय जनकात्मजा ननाम वह्निं शिरसा तोषयामास राघवः
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 111-140 tell us a different story of the abduction of Sita than the one given by Valmiki. According to KP. real Sita was protected by Agni (the fire-god) the Avasathya (Household sacrificial) Fire and it was the illusory Sita) created by Agni that was abducted by Ravana.…
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 111-140 tell us a different story of the abduction of Sita than the one given by Valmiki. According to KP. real Sita was protected by Agni (the fire-god) the Avasathya (Household sacrificial) Fire and it was the illusory Sita) created by Agni that was abducted by Ravana.…

verses.sanskrit: नरमांसाशनं कृत्वा चान्द्रायणमथाचरेत् । काकं चैव तथा श्वानं जग्ध्वा हस्तिनमेव च । वराहं कुक्कुटं चाथ तप्तकृच्छ्रेण शुध्यति
verses.transliteration: naramāṃsāśanaṃ kṛtvā cāndrāyaṇamathācaret / kākaṃ caiva tathā śvānaṃ jagdhvā hastinameva ca / varāhaṃ kukkuṭaṃ cātha taptakṛcchreṇa śudhyati
verses.translation: is a liquid preparation of five products of the cow, viz. cow's urine, dung, milk, curds and ghee. It is to be taken at the end of each Prdyascitta. It removes all petty sins (For details vide H. D. Vol. II.. p -774).
verses.hindi: उवाच वह्वे्भगवान् किमेषा वरवर्णिनी। दग्धा भगवता पूर्व दृष्टा मत्पाश्वमागता
verses.wordMeaning: is a liquid preparation of five products of the cow, viz. cow's urine, dung, milk, curds and ghee. It is to be taken at the end of each Prdyascitta. It removes all petty sins (For details vide H. D. Vol. II.. p -774).
verses.commentary: Sense: is a liquid preparation of five products of the cow, viz. cow's urine, dung, milk, curds and ghee. It is to be taken at the end of each Prdyascitta. It removes all petty sins (For details vide H. D. Vol. II.. p -774).

verses.sanskrit: क्रव्यादानां च मांसानि पुरीषं मूत्रमेव च । गोगोमायुकपीनां च तदेव व्रतमाचरेत् । उपोष्य द्वादशाहं तु कूष्माण्डैर्जुहुयाद् घृतम्
verses.transliteration: kravyādānāṃ ca māṃsāni purīṣaṃ mūtrameva ca / gogomāyukapīnāṃ ca tadeva vratamācaret / upoṣya dvādaśāhaṃ tu kūṣmāṇḍairjuhuyād ghṛtam
verses.translation: After committing the theft of grains, cooked food and cash intentionally from the houses of his fellow-caste men, an excellent Brahmana shall become purified by Krcchrardha (half a Krcchra) vow.
verses.hindi: तमाह देवो लोकानां दाहको हव्यवाहनः । यथावृत्तं दाशरथिं भूतानामेव संनिधौ सभी प्राणियोंमें अवस्थित वैश्वानरकी में शरण ग्रहण करती हूँ। मैं हव्य तथा कव्यको वहन करनेवाले ईश्वर वहिदेवकी शरणमें हूँ। मैं उस पर-तत्त्व, वरणीय, साक्षात् सविता और तेजोरूप परम ज्योति अग्निकी शरण ग्रहण
verses.wordMeaning: After committing the theft of grains, cooked food and cash intentionally from the houses of his fellow-caste men, an excellent Brahmana shall become purified by Krcchrardha (half a Krcchra) vow.
verses.commentary: Sense: After committing the theft of grains, cooked food and cash intentionally from the houses of his fellow-caste men, an excellent Brahmana shall become purified by Krcchrardha (half a Krcchra) vow.

verses.sanskrit: नकुलोलूकमार्जारं जग्ध्वा सांतपनं चरेत् । श्वापदोष्ट्रखराञ्जग्ध्वा तप्तकृच्छ्रेण शुद्ध्यति । व्रतवच्चैव संस्कारं पूर्वेण विधिनैव तु
verses.transliteration: nakulolūkamārjāraṃ jagdhvā sāṃtapanaṃ caret / śvāpadoṣṭrakharāñjagdhvā taptakṛcchreṇa śuddhyati / vratavaccaiva saṃskāraṃ pūrveṇa vidhinaiva tu
verses.translation: Drinking the Pancagavya is the expiation for the theft of food-stuffs and edibles, of vehicles, beds and seats, of flowers, roots and fruits.
verses.hindi: करती हूँ। हव्यवाहन ! आप मेरी रक्षा करें
verses.wordMeaning: Drinking the Pancagavya is the expiation for the theft of food-stuffs and edibles, of vehicles, beds and seats, of flowers, roots and fruits.
verses.commentary: Sense: Drinking the Pancagavya is the expiation for the theft of food-stuffs and edibles, of vehicles, beds and seats, of flowers, roots and fruits.

verses.sanskrit: बकं चैव बलाकं च हंसं कारण्डवं तथा । चक्रवाकं प्लवं जग्घ्वा द्वादशाहमभोजनम्
verses.transliteration: bakaṃ caiva balākaṃ ca haṃsaṃ kāraṇḍavaṃ tathā / cakravākaṃ plavaṃ jagghvā dvādaśāhamabhojanam
verses.translation: The expiation for the theft of grass, fuel and timber, of raw rice and jaggery, of robes, hides and meat, is fasting for three nights.
verses.hindi: इस वह्यष्टकका जप करके यशस्विनी उन्मीलित नेत्रोंवाली रामकी पत्नी सीता मनसे रामका ध्यान करती हुई स्थित हो गयीं स्तुति करनेके अनन्तर उस आवसथ्य आग्निसे
verses.wordMeaning: The expiation for the theft of grass, fuel and timber, of raw rice and jaggery, of robes, hides and meat, is fasting for three nights.
verses.commentary: Sense: The expiation for the theft of grass, fuel and timber, of raw rice and jaggery, of robes, hides and meat, is fasting for three nights.

verses.sanskrit: कपोतं टिट्टिभं चैव शुकं सारसमेव च । उलूकं जालपादं च जग्ध्वाप्येतद् व्रतं चरेत्
verses.transliteration: kapotaṃ ṭiṭṭibhaṃ caiva śukaṃ sārasameva ca / ulūkaṃ jālapādaṃ ca jagdhvāpyetad vrataṃ caret
verses.translation: The expiation for the theft of jewels, pearls and coral, of copper and silver and of magnetic stones is eating of food- particles for twelve days.
verses.hindi: क्रुद्ध होनेके कारण) तेजसे जलते हुएके समान भगवान् महेश्वर हव्यवाह प्रकट हो गये। रावणके वधकी इच्छासे मायामयी सीताको उत्पन्नकर वे पावक (अग्निदेव) धर्ममयी सीताको लेकर अन्तर्हित हो गये। धर्ममयी
verses.wordMeaning: The expiation for the theft of jewels, pearls and coral, of copper and silver and of magnetic stones is eating of food- particles for twelve days.
verses.commentary: Sense: The expiation for the theft of jewels, pearls and coral, of copper and silver and of magnetic stones is eating of food- particles for twelve days.

verses.sanskrit: शिशुमारं तथा चाषं मत्स्यमांसं तथैव च । जग्ध्वा चैव कटाहारमेतदेव चरेद् व्रतम्
verses.transliteration: śiśumāraṃ tathā cāṣaṃ matsyamāṃsaṃ tathaiva ca / jagdhvā caiva kaṭāhārametadeva cared vratam
verses.translation: As an expiation for the sinful act of stealing cotton, eleven-hoofed or single-hoofed animals, of flowers, scents and medicines, one should drink water (or milk) for three days.
verses.hindi: सीता-जैसी ही उस मायामयी सीताको देखकर राक्षसराज रावण उसे ही लेकर सागरके मध्यमें स्थित लंकाको चला गया। रावणका वध करके (भगवती) सीताको प्राप्तकर लक्ष्मणसहित रामका मन शांकायुक्त हो गया। जनसामान्यको विश्वास दिलानेके लिये वह मायासे निर्मित सीता उद्दस आग्निमें प्रविष्ट हो गयीं और अग्निने उन्हें अपनेमें मिला लिया
verses.wordMeaning: As an expiation for the sinful act of stealing cotton, eleven-hoofed or single-hoofed animals, of flowers, scents and medicines, one should drink water (or milk) for three days.
verses.commentary: Sense: As an expiation for the sinful act of stealing cotton, eleven-hoofed or single-hoofed animals, of flowers, scents and medicines, one should drink water (or milk) for three days.

verses.sanskrit: कोकिलं चैव मत्स्यांश्च मण्डुकं भुजगं तथा । गोमूत्रयावकाहारो मासेनैकेन शुद्ध्यति
verses.transliteration: kokilaṃ caiva matsyāṃśca maṇḍukaṃ bhujagaṃ tathā / gomūtrayāvakāhāro māsenaikena śuddhyati
verses.translation: After eating a beast of prey, camel or a mule (or donkey), one is purified by means of Taptakrcchra vow. He shall perform all rites in accordance with the procedure mentioned before.
verses.hindi: मायामयी सीताको अपनेमें लीन कर लेनेके पश्चात् उग्र किरणोंवाले भगवान् पावक (अग्नि)-ने रामको (वास्तविक) सीताका दर्शन कराया। इससे “पावक' देवताओंके प्रिय बन गये। सुन्दर मध्य-
verses.wordMeaning: After eating a beast of prey, camel or a mule (or donkey), one is purified by means of Taptakrcchra vow. He shall perform all rites in accordance with the procedure mentioned before.
verses.commentary: Sense: After eating a beast of prey, camel or a mule (or donkey), one is purified by means of Taptakrcchra vow. He shall perform all rites in accordance with the procedure mentioned before.

verses.sanskrit: जलेचरांश्च जलजान् प्रत्तुदान्नखविष्किरान् । रक्तपादांस्तथा जग्ध्वा सप्ताहं चैतदाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: jalecarāṃśca jalajān prattudānnakhaviṣkirān / raktapādāṃstathā jagdhvā saptāhaṃ caitadācaret
verses.translation: After eating the flesh of a crane, a stork, a swan, the Karandava duck and the Cakravaka (ruddy goose) bird, one should not take food for twelve days.
verses.hindi: भागवाली उन जनकको पुत्रीने अपने दोनों हाथोंसे अपने स्वामी रामके दोनों चरणोंको पकड़कर भूमिपर प्रणाम किया (सीताको) देखकर आश्चर्यचकित नेत्रोंवाले रघुवंशी रामने प्रसत्नमन हो सिरसे प्रणामकर अग्निको संतुष्ट किया। भगवान् (राम)-ने वहिसे कहा-मेरे समीपमें आयी यह दिव्यगुणोंबाली सीता किस प्रकार पहले
verses.wordMeaning: After eating the flesh of a crane, a stork, a swan, the Karandava duck and the Cakravaka (ruddy goose) bird, one should not take food for twelve days.
verses.commentary: Sense: After eating the flesh of a crane, a stork, a swan, the Karandava duck and the Cakravaka (ruddy goose) bird, one should not take food for twelve days.

verses.sanskrit: शुनो मांसं शुष्कमांसमात्मार्थं च तथा कृतम् । भुक्त्वा मासं चरेदेतत् तत्पापस्यापनुत्तये
verses.transliteration: śuno māṃsaṃ śuṣkamāṃsamātmārthaṃ ca tathā kṛtam / bhuktvā māsaṃ caredetat tatpāpasyāpanuttaye
verses.translation: After eating the dove, the Tittibha, the parrot, the drake, the owl and the web-foot, one should perform the same expiatory rite.
verses.hindi: आपद्ठारा अपनेमें लीन की जाती हुई देखी गयी। लोकोंको अपनेमें पचा लेनेबाले तथा हव्यको वहन करनेवाले अग्निने उन दशरथपुत्र रामसे सभी लोगोंकी संनिधिमें ही वह सब बताया जो पूर्वमें
verses.wordMeaning: After eating the dove, the Tittibha, the parrot, the drake, the owl and the web-foot, one should perform the same expiatory rite.
verses.commentary: Sense: After eating the dove, the Tittibha, the parrot, the drake, the owl and the web-foot, one should perform the same expiatory rite.

verses.sanskrit: वार्ताकं भुस्तृणं शिग्रुं खुखुण्डं करकं तथा । प्राजापत्यं चरेज्जग्ध्वा शङ्खं कुम्भीकमेव च
verses.transliteration: vārtākaṃ bhustṛṇaṃ śigruṃ khukhuṇḍaṃ karakaṃ tathā / prājāpatyaṃ carejjagdhvā śaṅkhaṃ kumbhīkameva ca
verses.translation: After eating the Gangetic porpoise, the blue jay, the flesh of fish and Katahara (i.e. a jackal or a crow that is feasting on dead bodies), one shall perform this expiatory rite alone.
verses.hindi: आराध्य लब्धा तपसा देव्याश्चात्यन्तवल्लभा भवानीपार्श्वमानीता मया रावणकामिता
verses.wordMeaning: After eating the Gangetic porpoise, the blue jay, the flesh of fish and Katahara (i.e. a jackal or a crow that is feasting on dead bodies), one shall perform this expiatory rite alone.
verses.commentary: Sense: After eating the Gangetic porpoise, the blue jay, the flesh of fish and Katahara (i.e. a jackal or a crow that is feasting on dead bodies), one shall perform this expiatory rite alone.

verses.sanskrit: पलाण्डुं लशुनं चैव भुक्त्वा चान्द्रायणं चरेत् । नालिकां तण्डुलीयं च प्राजापत्येन शुद्ध्यति
verses.transliteration: palāṇḍuṃ laśunaṃ caiva bhuktvā cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret / nālikāṃ taṇḍulīyaṃ ca prājāpatyena śuddhyati
verses.translation: After eating the cuckoo, the fish (animals and birds), the frog and the serpent, one shall become pure within a month, if one takes in barley boiled in cow's urine as food.
verses.hindi: या नीता राक्षसेशेन सीता भगवताहता। मया मायामयी सृष्टा रावणस्य वधाय सा
verses.wordMeaning: After eating the cuckoo, the fish (animals and birds), the frog and the serpent, one shall become pure within a month, if one takes in barley boiled in cow's urine as food.
verses.commentary: Sense: After eating the cuckoo, the fish (animals and birds), the frog and the serpent, one shall become pure within a month, if one takes in barley boiled in cow's urine as food.

verses.sanskrit: अश्मान्तकं तथा पोतं तप्तकृच्छ्रेण शुद्ध्यति । प्राजापत्येन शुद्धिः स्यात् कक्कुभाण्डस्य भक्षणे
verses.transliteration: aśmāntakaṃ tathā potaṃ taptakṛcchreṇa śuddhyati / prājāpatyena śuddhiḥ syāt kakkubhāṇḍasya bhakṣaṇe
verses.translation: On eating acquatic beings, animals born in water, gallinaceous birds (such as domestic owl, porridge etc.) red¬ footed parrots, one should observe this vow for seven days.
verses.hindi: तदर्थ भवता दुष्टो रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः। मयोपसंहता चैव हतो लोकविनाशनः गृहाण विमलामेनां जानकीं वचनान्मम। पश्य नारायणं देवं स्वात्मानं प्रभवाव्ययम्
verses.wordMeaning: On eating acquatic beings, animals born in water, gallinaceous birds (such as domestic owl, porridge etc.) red¬ footed parrots, one should observe this vow for seven days.
verses.commentary: Sense: On eating acquatic beings, animals born in water, gallinaceous birds (such as domestic owl, porridge etc.) red¬ footed parrots, one should observe this vow for seven days.

verses.sanskrit: अलाबुं किंशुकं चैव भुक्त्वा चैतद् व्रतं चरेत् । उदुम्बरं च कामेन तप्तकृच्छ्रेण शुद्ध्यति
verses.transliteration: alābuṃ kiṃśukaṃ caiva bhuktvā caitad vrataṃ caret / udumbaraṃ ca kāmena taptakṛcchreṇa śuddhyati
verses.translation: On eating dog's flesh and dried meat and on even getting them made ready for oneself, one should perform this expiatory rite for a month, in order to quell that sin.
verses.hindi: अशेषपापयुक्तस्तु पुरुषोऽपि सुसंयतः । स्वदेहं पुण्यतीर्थषु त्यक्त्वा मुच्येत किल्बिषात्
verses.wordMeaning: On eating dog's flesh and dried meat and on even getting them made ready for oneself, one should perform this expiatory rite for a month, in order to quell that sin.
verses.commentary: Sense: On eating dog's flesh and dried meat and on even getting them made ready for oneself, one should perform this expiatory rite for a month, in order to quell that sin.

verses.sanskrit: वृथा कृसरसंयावं पायसापूपसंकुलम् । भुक्त्वा चैवं विधं त्वन्नं त्रिरात्रेण विशुद्ध्यति
verses.transliteration: vṛthā kṛsarasaṃyāvaṃ pāyasāpūpasaṃkulam / bhuktvā caivaṃ vidhaṃ tvannaṃ trirātreṇa viśuddhyati
verses.translation: On eating brinjals, earth-grass, horse-radish, a tree called Kutaka, Gataka (a sparrow), the Khadga (rhinoceros) and Kumbhira (a plant Rottleria tinctoria), one shall perform the expiatory vow called Prajapatya.
verses.hindi: इत्येष मानवो धर्मो युष्माकं कथितो मया। महेशाराधनार्थाय ज्ञानयोगं च शाश्वतम् स पश्यति महादेवं नान्यः कल्पशतैरपि
verses.wordMeaning: On eating brinjals, earth-grass, horse-radish, a tree called Kutaka, Gataka (a sparrow), the Khadga (rhinoceros) and Kumbhira (a plant Rottleria tinctoria), one shall perform the expiatory vow called Prajapatya.
verses.commentary: Sense: On eating brinjals, earth-grass, horse-radish, a tree called Kutaka, Gataka (a sparrow), the Khadga (rhinoceros) and Kumbhira (a plant Rottleria tinctoria), one shall perform the expiatory vow called Prajapatya.

verses.sanskrit: पीत्वा क्षीराण्यपेयानि ब्रह्मचारी समाहितः । गोमूत्रयावकाहारो मासेनैकेन शुद्ध्यति
verses.transliteration: pītvā kṣīrāṇyapeyāni brahmacārī samāhitaḥ / gomūtrayāvakāhāro māsenaikena śuddhyati
verses.translation: On eating garlic and onion, one should observe the Candrayanavow, (on eating) Nalika (lotus-stalk) andTandulia, one becomes pure by means of the Prajapatya rite.
verses.hindi: स्थापयेद् यः परं धर्म ज्ञानं तत्पारमेश्वरम्। न तस्मादधिको लोके स योगी परमो मतः
verses.wordMeaning: On eating garlic and onion, one should observe the Candrayanavow, (on eating) Nalika (lotus-stalk) andTandulia, one becomes pure by means of the Prajapatya rite.
verses.commentary: Sense: On eating garlic and onion, one should observe the Candrayanavow, (on eating) Nalika (lotus-stalk) andTandulia, one becomes pure by means of the Prajapatya rite.

verses.sanskrit: अनिर्दशाहं गोक्षीरं माहिषं चाजमेव च । संधिन्याश्च विवत्सायाः पिबन् क्षीरमिदं चरेत्
verses.transliteration: anirdaśāhaṃ gokṣīraṃ māhiṣaṃ cājameva ca / saṃdhinyāśca vivatsāyāḥ piban kṣīramidaṃ caret
verses.translation: On eating the Asmantaka plant and the young shoot of any plant, one becomes pure by means of Taptakrcchra rite. On eating safflower, one shall become pure by means of the expiatory rite of Prajapatya.
verses.hindi: स योगयुक्तोऽपि मुनिर्नात्यर्थं भगवत्प्रियः तस्मात् सहैव दातव्यं ब्राह्मणेषु विशेषतः । धर्मयुक्तेषु शान्तेषु श्रद्धया चान्वितेषु वै
verses.wordMeaning: On eating the Asmantaka plant and the young shoot of any plant, one becomes pure by means of Taptakrcchra rite. On eating safflower, one shall become pure by means of the expiatory rite of Prajapatya.
verses.commentary: Sense: On eating the Asmantaka plant and the young shoot of any plant, one becomes pure by means of Taptakrcchra rite. On eating safflower, one shall become pure by means of the expiatory rite of Prajapatya.

verses.sanskrit: एतेषां च विकाराणि पीत्वा मोहेन मानवः । गोमूत्रयावकाहारः सप्तरात्रेण शुद्ध्यति
verses.transliteration: eteṣāṃ ca vikārāṇi pītvā mohena mānavaḥ / gomūtrayāvakāhāraḥ saptarātreṇa śuddhyati
verses.translation: If he takes that food wantonly and deliberately, he should perform the Krcchra rite for a year and he has to undergo consecration rites once again. (Defective) After taking in an intoxicating drink other than wine, he should perform the Candrayana expiation.
verses.hindi: मिथिलानरेश जनकने तपद्दारा रुद्रप्रिया पार्वतीकी आराधनाकर देवीकी अत्यन्त प्रिय जिन सीताको पुत्रीरूपमें प्रात किया था, उन पतिसेवापरायणा, सुन्दर शीलवाली पतिव्रताको रावण चाह रहा है, जब मैंने
verses.wordMeaning: If he takes that food wantonly and deliberately, he should perform the Krcchra rite for a year and he has to undergo consecration rites once again. (Defective) After taking in an intoxicating drink other than wine, he should perform the Candrayana expiation.
verses.commentary: Sense: If he takes that food wantonly and deliberately, he should perform the Krcchra rite for a year and he has to undergo consecration rites once again. (Defective) After taking in an intoxicating drink other than wine, he should perform the Candrayana expiation.

verses.sanskrit: भुक्त्वा चैव नवश्राद्धे मृतके सूतके तथा । चान्द्रायणेन शुद्ध्येत ब्राह्मणस्तु समाहितः
verses.transliteration: bhuktvā caiva navaśrāddhe mṛtake sūtake tathā / cāndrāyaṇena śuddhyeta brāhmaṇastu samāhitaḥ
verses.translation: On eating forbidden food, one becomes pure by means of the Prajapatya vow. If one (unknowingly) drinks urine, semen virile or faeces, one shall perform this rite in expiation.
verses.hindi: यह जाना तब उन्हें (भगवती सीताको) मैं पार्वतीके जिन सीताको आपने प्राप्त किया उन्हें मैंने रावणके वधके लिये मायासे निर्मित किया था, उन्हींके लिये आपने लोकोंका विनाश करनेवाले दुष्ट राक्षसराज रावणको मारा तथा मैंने उन्हीं मायामयी सीताको उपसंहृत
verses.wordMeaning: On eating forbidden food, one becomes pure by means of the Prajapatya vow. If one (unknowingly) drinks urine, semen virile or faeces, one shall perform this rite in expiation.
verses.commentary: Sense: On eating forbidden food, one becomes pure by means of the Prajapatya vow. If one (unknowingly) drinks urine, semen virile or faeces, one shall perform this rite in expiation.

verses.sanskrit: यस्याग्नौ हूयते नित्यं न यस्याग्रं न दीयते । चान्द्रायणं चरेत् सम्यक् तस्यान्नप्राशने द्विजः
verses.transliteration: yasyāgnau hūyate nityaṃ na yasyāgraṃ na dīyate / cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret samyak tasyānnaprāśane dvijaḥ
verses.translation: If a Brahmana eats the leavings of the food (of unspecified persons), he becomes purified by drinking cow's urine, eating (for food) barley cooked in cow's urine or by drinking the water that remains after cows have drunk.
verses.hindi: (अपनेमें लीन)-कर लिया है। मेरे कहनेसे आप इन विशुद्ध जानकोको ग्रहण करें और अपने-आपको प्रभव, अव्यय, नारायणदेवके रूपमें देखें
verses.wordMeaning: If a Brahmana eats the leavings of the food (of unspecified persons), he becomes purified by drinking cow's urine, eating (for food) barley cooked in cow's urine or by drinking the water that remains after cows have drunk.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a Brahmana eats the leavings of the food (of unspecified persons), he becomes purified by drinking cow's urine, eating (for food) barley cooked in cow's urine or by drinking the water that remains after cows have drunk.

verses.sanskrit: अभोज्यानां तु सर्वेषां भुक्त्वा चान्नमुपस्कृतम् । अन्तावसायिनां चैव तप्तकृच्छ्रेण शुद्ध्यति
verses.transliteration: abhojyānāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ bhuktvā cānnamupaskṛtam / antāvasāyināṃ caiva taptakṛcchreṇa śuddhyati
verses.translation: If one takes in water defiled by urine, faeces etc., the expiatory rite for the sin is Santapana or Krcchra.
verses.hindi: ऐसा कहकर सभी ओर शिखा (ज्वाला) तथा सभी ओर मुखवाले भगवान् प्रचण्ड (अमित तेजोरूप) अग्निदेव राघव (राम) तथा अन्य लोगोंद्दारा सम्मानित होकर अन्तर्धान हो गये। यह मैंने आप लोगोंको पतिव्रताओंका माहात्म्य बताया। इसे स््त्रियोंके समस्त पापोंको नष्ट करनेवाला प्रायश्चित्त कहा गया है। सम्पूर्ण पापोंसे युक्त पुरुष भी भलीभाँति संयत होकर पुण्य- तीर्थोमें अपना शरीर त्याग करके पापसे मुक्त हो
verses.wordMeaning: If one takes in water defiled by urine, faeces etc., the expiatory rite for the sin is Santapana or Krcchra.
verses.commentary: Sense: If one takes in water defiled by urine, faeces etc., the expiatory rite for the sin is Santapana or Krcchra.

verses.sanskrit: चाण्डालान्नं द्विजो भुक्त्वा सम्यक् चान्द्रायणं चरेत् । बुद्धिपूर्वं तु कृच्छ्राब्दं पुनः संस्कारमेव च
verses.transliteration: cāṇḍālānnaṃ dvijo bhuktvā samyak cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret / buddhipūrvaṃ tu kṛcchrābdaṃ punaḥ saṃskārameva ca
verses.translation: If a Brahmana, knowingly, drinks water from the well of a Candala or his water-pot, he should perform the rite of Santapana or Krcchra. That is the way to atone for the sin.
verses.hindi: जाता है। अथवा पृथ्वीके सभी पुण्य तीर्थामें स्नान करनेसे द्विज पुरुष समस्त सञ्चित पापॉंसे मुक्त हो जाता है॥ १४१--१४४॥
verses.wordMeaning: If a Brahmana, knowingly, drinks water from the well of a Candala or his water-pot, he should perform the rite of Santapana or Krcchra. That is the way to atone for the sin.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a Brahmana, knowingly, drinks water from the well of a Candala or his water-pot, he should perform the rite of Santapana or Krcchra. That is the way to atone for the sin.

verses.sanskrit: असुरामद्यपानेन कुर्याच्चान्द्रायणव्रतम् । अभोज्यान्नं तु भुक्त्वा च प्राजापत्येन शुद्ध्यति
verses.transliteration: asurāmadyapānena kuryāccāndrāyaṇavratam / abhojyānnaṃ tu bhuktvā ca prājāpatyena śuddhyati
verses.translation: On drinking the water touched by a Candala, an excellent Brahmana becomes purified by means of Pancagavya (preparation of the five products of cows viz. urine, faeces, milk, curds and ghee) as well as the chief expiatory rite for three days.
verses.hindi: व्यासजीने कहा--इस प्रकार आप लोगोंसे मैंने इस मानवधर्मका और महेश्वरको आराधनाके लिये सनातन ज्ञानयोगका वर्णन किया। जो इस विधिसे युक्त होकर ज्ञानयोगका पालन करता है, वह महादेवका दर्शन करता है। दूसरा व्यक्ति सैकड़ों कल्पोंमें भी उनका दर्शन नहीं कर सकता। जो इस परम धर्म और परमेश्वर-सम्बन्धी ज्ञानको स्थापना (अधिकारी लोगोंमें प्रतिष्ठा) करता है, संसारमें उससे बढ़कर और कोई
verses.wordMeaning: On drinking the water touched by a Candala, an excellent Brahmana becomes purified by means of Pancagavya (preparation of the five products of cows viz. urine, faeces, milk, curds and ghee) as well as the chief expiatory rite for three days.
verses.commentary: Sense: On drinking the water touched by a Candala, an excellent Brahmana becomes purified by means of Pancagavya (preparation of the five products of cows viz. urine, faeces, milk, curds and ghee) as well as the chief expiatory rite for three days.

verses.sanskrit: विण्मूत्रपाशनं कृत्वा रेतसश्चैतदाचरेत् । अनादिष्टेषु चैकाहं सर्वत्र तु यथार्थतः
verses.transliteration: viṇmūtrapāśanaṃ kṛtvā retasaścaitadācaret / anādiṣṭeṣu caikāhaṃ sarvatra tu yathārthataḥ
verses.translation: If a Brahmana knowingly or out of delusion touches a great sinner and takes food with him, he should take bath and perform Taptakrcchra.
verses.hindi: नहीं है, उसे श्रेष्ठ योगी माना गया है। इसकी स्थापना करनेमें समर्थ होनेपर भी जो व्यक्ति मोहवश धर्म एवं ज्ञानकी स्थापना नहीं करता, वह योगसम्पन्न मुनि होनेपर भी भगवानका अत्यन्त प्रिय नहीं होता। इसलिये सदा
verses.wordMeaning: If a Brahmana knowingly or out of delusion touches a great sinner and takes food with him, he should take bath and perform Taptakrcchra.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a Brahmana knowingly or out of delusion touches a great sinner and takes food with him, he should take bath and perform Taptakrcchra.

verses.sanskrit: विड्वराहखरोष्ट्राणां गोमायोः कपिकाकयोः । प्राश्य मूत्रपुरीषाणि द्विजश्चान्द्रायणं चरेत्
verses.transliteration: viḍvarāhakharoṣṭrāṇāṃ gomāyoḥ kapikākayoḥ / prāśya mūtrapurīṣāṇi dvijaścāndrāyaṇaṃ caret
verses.translation: If one touches a great sinner, a Candala, or a woman in her monthly courses and unwittingly takes food, he shall become pure (after observing fast for) three nights.
verses.hindi: ही विशेष-रूपसे धर्मयुक्त शान्त और श्रद्धासम्पन्न ब्राह्मणोंको इसका उपदेश करना चाहिए ति कूर्मपुराण के
verses.wordMeaning: If one touches a great sinner, a Candala, or a woman in her monthly courses and unwittingly takes food, he shall become pure (after observing fast for) three nights.
verses.commentary: Sense: If one touches a great sinner, a Candala, or a woman in her monthly courses and unwittingly takes food, he shall become pure (after observing fast for) three nights.

verses.sanskrit: अज्ञानात् प्राश्य विण्मूत्रं सुरासंस्पृष्टमेव च । पुनः संस्कारमर्हन्ति त्रयो वर्णा द्विजातयः
verses.transliteration: ajñānāt prāśya viṇmūtraṃ surāsaṃspṛṣṭameva ca / punaḥ saṃskāramarhanti trayo varṇā dvijātayaḥ
verses.translation: If a man fit to take bath (i.e. one who should take bath) takes food, without bathing), he shall become pure (by observing a fast) in the course of a day and a night. If he does
verses.hindi: य: पठेद् भवतां नित्यं संवादं मम चैव हि। जो मेरे एवं आपके बीच हुए इस संवादको सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो गच्छेत परमां गतिम्॥ १५०॥  नित्य पढ़ेगा, वह सभी पापोंसे मुक्त होकर परम गतिको
verses.wordMeaning: If a man fit to take bath (i.e. one who should take bath) takes food, without bathing), he shall become pure (by observing a fast) in the course of a day and a night. If he does
verses.commentary: Sense: If a man fit to take bath (i.e. one who should take bath) takes food, without bathing), he shall become pure (by observing a fast) in the course of a day and a night. If he does

verses.sanskrit: क्रव्यादां पक्षिणां चैव प्राश्य मूत्रपुरीषकम् । महासांतपनं मोहात् तथा कुर्याद् द्विजोत्तमः । भासमण्डूककुररे विष्किरे कृच्छ्रमाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: kravyādāṃ pakṣiṇāṃ caiva prāśya mūtrapurīṣakam / mahāsāṃtapanaṃ mohāt tathā kuryād dvijottamaḥ / bhāsamaṇḍūkakurare viṣkire kṛcchramācaret
verses.translation: On eating stale food-stuffs or those defiled by cows, etc, one should observe fast or perform a fourth of the Krcchra expiation.
verses.hindi: श्राद्धे वा हैविके कार्ये ब्राह्मणानां च संनिधौ । पठेत नित्यं सुमनाः श्रोतव्यं च द्विजातिभिः स दोषकञ्चुकं त्यक्त्वा याति देवं महेश्वरम्
verses.wordMeaning: On eating stale food-stuffs or those defiled by cows, etc, one should observe fast or perform a fourth of the Krcchra expiation.
verses.commentary: Sense: On eating stale food-stuffs or those defiled by cows, etc, one should observe fast or perform a fourth of the Krcchra expiation.

verses.sanskrit: प्राजापत्येन शुद्ध्येत ब्राहामणोच्छिष्टभोजने । क्षत्रिये तप्तकृच्छ्रं स्याद् वैश्ये चैवातिकृच्छ्रकम् । शूद्रोच्छिष्टं द्विजो भुक्त्वा कुर्याच्चान्द्रायणव्रतम्
verses.transliteration: prājāpatyena śuddhyeta brāhāmaṇocchiṣṭabhojane / kṣatriye taptakṛcchraṃ syād vaiśye caivātikṛcchrakam / śūdrocchiṣṭaṃ dvijo bhuktvā kuryāccāndrāyaṇavratam
verses.translation: At the end of every year, a Brahmana should observe the Krcchra vow again for the purification of the sin due to the eating of forbidden things unwittingly and particularly those taken in wantonly.
verses.hindi: एतावदुक्त्वा भगवान् व्यासः सत्यवतीसुतः ।
verses.wordMeaning: At the end of every year, a Brahmana should observe the Krcchra vow again for the purification of the sin due to the eating of forbidden things unwittingly and particularly those taken in wantonly.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the end of every year, a Brahmana should observe the Krcchra vow again for the purification of the sin due to the eating of forbidden things unwittingly and particularly those taken in wantonly.

verses.sanskrit: सुराभाण्डोदरे वारि पीत्वा चान्द्रायणं चरेत् । शुनोच्छिष्टं द्विजो भुक्त्वा त्रिरात्रेण विशुद्ध्यति । गोमूत्रयावकाहारः पीतशेषं च रागवान्
verses.transliteration: surābhāṇḍodare vāri pītvā cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret / śunocchiṣṭaṃ dvijo bhuktvā trirātreṇa viśuddhyati / gomūtrayāvakāhāraḥ pītaśeṣaṃ ca rāgavān
verses.translation: After performing the Yajnas on behalf of Vratyas (the people of the three castes who have become outcaste) and the obsequies of others as well as for exorcising (for malicious purpose), one becomes purified by means of three Krcchras.
verses.hindi: श्राद्धमे अथवा देवकार्य--पूजा आदिमें और ब्राह्मणोंके सम्मुख प्रसन्न-मनसे नित्य इसका पाठ करना चाहिए तथा द्विजातियोंको इसे सुनना चाहिए। जो योगात्मा इसके अर्थका विचारकर पवित्र ब्राह्मणोंको इसे सुनाता है, वह दोषरूपी कञ्चुक (आवरण)-का परित्याग कर भगवान् महेश्वरको प्राप्त करता है
verses.wordMeaning: After performing the Yajnas on behalf of Vratyas (the people of the three castes who have become outcaste) and the obsequies of others as well as for exorcising (for malicious purpose), one becomes purified by means of three Krcchras.
verses.commentary: Sense: After performing the Yajnas on behalf of Vratyas (the people of the three castes who have become outcaste) and the obsequies of others as well as for exorcising (for malicious purpose), one becomes purified by means of three Krcchras.

verses.sanskrit: अपो मूत्रपुरीषाद्यैर्दूषिताः प्राशयेद् यदा । तदा सांतपनं प्रोक्तं व्रतं पापविशोधनम्
verses.transliteration: apo mūtrapurīṣādyairdūṣitāḥ prāśayed yadā / tadā sāṃtapanaṃ proktaṃ vrataṃ pāpaviśodhanam
verses.translation: On performing the cremation and other rites for Brahmanas and others who are killed, a Brahmana becomes pure by means of Prajapatya expiation and eating barley cooked in cow's urine.
verses.hindi: इतना कहनेके बाद सत्यवतीके पुत्र भगवान् व्यास मुनियों तथा सूतजीको आश्वासन प्रदानकर जैसे आये
verses.wordMeaning: On performing the cremation and other rites for Brahmanas and others who are killed, a Brahmana becomes pure by means of Prajapatya expiation and eating barley cooked in cow's urine.
verses.commentary: Sense: On performing the cremation and other rites for Brahmanas and others who are killed, a Brahmana becomes pure by means of Prajapatya expiation and eating barley cooked in cow's urine.

verses.sanskrit: चाण्डालकूपभाण्डेषु यदि ज्ञानात् पिबेज्जलम् । चरेत् सांतपनं कृच्छ्रं ब्राह्मणः पापशोधनम्
verses.transliteration: cāṇḍālakūpabhāṇḍeṣu yadi jñānāt pibejjalam / caret sāṃtapanaṃ kṛcchraṃ brāhmaṇaḥ pāpaśodhanam
verses.translation: A person who has besmeared himself with oil or vomitted, passes urine or discharges faeces or shaves himself or indulges in sexual intercourse, becomes purified by observing a fast for a day and a night (i.e. one full day).
verses.hindi: समाश्वास्य मुनीन् सूतं जगाम च यथागतम्॥ १५३॥  थे वैसे ही चले गये इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहरूयां संहितायामुपरिविभागे त्रयस्त्रिशोऽध्यायः
verses.wordMeaning: A person who has besmeared himself with oil or vomitted, passes urine or discharges faeces or shaves himself or indulges in sexual intercourse, becomes purified by observing a fast for a day and a night (i.e. one full day).
verses.commentary: Sense: A person who has besmeared himself with oil or vomitted, passes urine or discharges faeces or shaves himself or indulges in sexual intercourse, becomes purified by observing a fast for a day and a night (i.e. one full day).

verses.sanskrit: चाण्डालेन तु संस्पृष्टं पीत्वा वारि द्विजोत्तमः । त्रिरात्रेण विशुद्ध्येत पञ्चगव्येन चैव हि
verses.transliteration: cāṇḍālena tu saṃspṛṣṭaṃ pītvā vāri dvijottamaḥ / trirātreṇa viśuddhyeta pañcagavyena caiva hi
verses.translation: If one abandons fire (worship) or makes another to neglect it for one day, he becomes purified (by fasting) for three nights. And (for the negligence of fire-worship) for three nights, he (should observe fast) for six days.
verses.hindi: तीर्थमाहात्म्य-प्रकरणमें प्रयाग, गया, एकाग्र तथा पुष्कर आदि विविध तीर्थोंकी महिमाका वर्णन, सप्तसारस्वत-तीर्थके वर्णनमें शिवभक्त मङ्कणक मुनिका आख्यान
verses.wordMeaning: If one abandons fire (worship) or makes another to neglect it for one day, he becomes purified (by fasting) for three nights. And (for the negligence of fire-worship) for three nights, he (should observe fast) for six days.
verses.commentary: Sense: If one abandons fire (worship) or makes another to neglect it for one day, he becomes purified (by fasting) for three nights. And (for the negligence of fire-worship) for three nights, he (should observe fast) for six days.

verses.sanskrit: महापातकिसंस्पर्शे भुङ्क्ते ऽस्नात्वा द्विजो यदि । बुद्धिपूर्वं तु मूढात्मा तप्तकृच्छ्रं समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: mahāpātakisaṃsparśe bhuṅkte 'snātvā dvijo yadi / buddhipūrvaṃ tu mūḍhātmā taptakṛcchraṃ samācaret
verses.translation: If out of blunder he forsakes the fire worship for ten days or twelve days, he should perform the Krcchra and the Candrayana expiatory rites to quell that sin.
verses.hindi: तीर्थानि यानि लोकेऽस्मिन् विश्रुतानि महान्ति च। कथितानि पुराणेषु मुनिभिर्ब्रह्मवादिभिः
verses.wordMeaning: If out of blunder he forsakes the fire worship for ten days or twelve days, he should perform the Krcchra and the Candrayana expiatory rites to quell that sin.
verses.commentary: Sense: If out of blunder he forsakes the fire worship for ten days or twelve days, he should perform the Krcchra and the Candrayana expiatory rites to quell that sin.

verses.sanskrit: स्पृष्ट्वा महापातकिनं चाण्डालं वा रजस्वलाम् । प्रमादाद् भोजनं कृत्वा त्रिरात्रेण विशुद्ध्यति
verses.transliteration: spṛṣṭvā mahāpātakinaṃ cāṇḍālaṃ vā rajasvalām / pramādād bhojanaṃ kṛtvā trirātreṇa viśuddhyati
verses.translation: On accepting a gift of wealth from a fallen man, one will become pure by abandoning the same. But lord Manu says that he should observe Krcchra vow duly.
verses.hindi: पञ्चयोजनविस्तीर्ण ब्रह्मणः परमेष्टिनः। प्रयागं प्रथितं तीर्थं तस्य माहात्म्यमीरितम्
verses.wordMeaning: On accepting a gift of wealth from a fallen man, one will become pure by abandoning the same. But lord Manu says that he should observe Krcchra vow duly.
verses.commentary: Sense: On accepting a gift of wealth from a fallen man, one will become pure by abandoning the same. But lord Manu says that he should observe Krcchra vow duly.

verses.sanskrit: स्नानार्हे यदि भुञ्जीत अहोरात्रेण शुद्ध्यति । बुद्धिपूर्वं तु कृच्छ्रेण भगवानाह पद्मजः
verses.transliteration: snānārhe yadi bhuñjīta ahorātreṇa śuddhyati / buddhipūrvaṃ tu kṛcchreṇa bhagavānāha padmajaḥ
verses.translation: Persons who have desisted from (and hence violated) the vow of fasting (before its completion) and those who have finished (i.e. abandoned) their order of mendicancy (i.e. Sannyasa) should perform three Krcchra and three Candrayana vows.
verses.hindi: अन्यच्च तीर्थप्रवरं कुरूणां देववन्दितम्। ऋषीणामाश्रमैर्जुष्टं सर्वपापविशोधनम् ऋषियोंने कहा--रोमहर्षण! अब आप हमें इस संसारमें जो महान् तथा प्रसिद्ध तीर्थ हैं, उन्हें बतलायें
verses.wordMeaning: Persons who have desisted from (and hence violated) the vow of fasting (before its completion) and those who have finished (i.e. abandoned) their order of mendicancy (i.e. Sannyasa) should perform three Krcchra and three Candrayana vows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Persons who have desisted from (and hence violated) the vow of fasting (before its completion) and those who have finished (i.e. abandoned) their order of mendicancy (i.e. Sannyasa) should perform three Krcchra and three Candrayana vows.

verses.sanskrit: शुष्कपर्युषितादीनि गवादिप्रतिदूषितम् । भुक्त्वोपवासं कुर्वोत कृच्छ्रपादमथापि वा
verses.transliteration: śuṣkaparyuṣitādīni gavādipratidūṣitam / bhuktvopavāsaṃ kurvota kṛcchrapādamathāpi vā
verses.translation: They should again get consecrated by purificatory rites beginning with Jdta-karma. Sanctified thus the Brahmanas
verses.hindi: रोमहर्षण बोले--हे श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! आप लोग सुनें, मैं पुराणोंमें ब्रह्मवादी मुनियोंद्वारा बताये गये विविध तीर्थौको बताऊँगा, जिनमें एक बार भी किया गया स्नान, जप, होम, श्राद्ध तथा दान आदि कर्म सात
verses.wordMeaning: They should again get consecrated by purificatory rites beginning with Jdta-karma. Sanctified thus the Brahmanas
verses.commentary: Sense: They should again get consecrated by purificatory rites beginning with Jdta-karma. Sanctified thus the Brahmanas

verses.sanskrit: संवत्सरान्ते कृच्छ्रं तु चरेद् विप्रः पुनः पुनः । अज्ञातभुक्तशुद्ध्यर्थं ज्ञातस्य तु विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: saṃvatsarānte kṛcchraṃ tu cared vipraḥ punaḥ punaḥ / ajñātabhuktaśuddhyarthaṃ jñātasya tu viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: A person who did not perform the Sandhya worship should observe fast for the day and remain controlled in mind. If he does not perform the Sandhya worship at night the same (i.e. fast at night) should be continued for that night.
verses.hindi: कुलोंको पवित्र कर देता है परमेष्ठी ब्रह्मका पाँच योजनमें फैला हुआ प्रयाग नामक प्रसिद्ध तीर्थ है, उसका माहात्म्य बतलाया जा चुका है। दूसरा कुरुओंका श्रेष्ठ तीर्थ (कुरुक्षेत्र) है, जो देवताओंद्वारा वन्दित, ऋषियोंके आश्रमोंसे परिपूर्ण
verses.wordMeaning: A person who did not perform the Sandhya worship should observe fast for the day and remain controlled in mind. If he does not perform the Sandhya worship at night the same (i.e. fast at night) should be continued for that night.
verses.commentary: Sense: A person who did not perform the Sandhya worship should observe fast for the day and remain controlled in mind. If he does not perform the Sandhya worship at night the same (i.e. fast at night) should be continued for that night.

verses.sanskrit: व्रात्यानां यजनं कृत्वा परेषामन्त्यकर्म च । अभिचारमहीनं च त्रिभिः कृच्छ्रैर्विशुद्ध्यति
verses.transliteration: vrātyānāṃ yajanaṃ kṛtvā pareṣāmantyakarma ca / abhicāramahīnaṃ ca tribhiḥ kṛcchrairviśuddhyati
verses.translation: A person who has not gathered sacrificial twigs and performed the Yajna should, for the purpose of purification, repeat the Gayatrl Mantra a thousand and eight times taking bath and remaining pure, with concentration of mind.
verses.hindi: और सभी पापोंको शुद्धि करनेवाला है
verses.wordMeaning: A person who has not gathered sacrificial twigs and performed the Yajna should, for the purpose of purification, repeat the Gayatrl Mantra a thousand and eight times taking bath and remaining pure, with concentration of mind.
verses.commentary: Sense: A person who has not gathered sacrificial twigs and performed the Yajna should, for the purpose of purification, repeat the Gayatrl Mantra a thousand and eight times taking bath and remaining pure, with concentration of mind.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणादिहतानां तु कृत्वा दाहादिकाः क्रियाः । गोमूत्रयावकाहारः प्राजापत्येन शुद्ध्यति
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇādihatānāṃ tu kṛtvā dāhādikāḥ kriyāḥ / gomūtrayāvakāhāraḥ prājāpatyena śuddhyati
verses.translation: (Defective verse) If out of blunder, a householder does not perform the Sandhya prayer he should take bath and observe fast. He shall become pure immediately. If he be exhausted (and does not perform Sandhya-prayer), he should remain perfectly self-controlled.
verses.hindi: (ख)-इस अध्यायमें निर्दिष्ट चान्द्रायण, सांतपन, प्राजापत्य, कृच्छू आदि ब्रतोंका स्वरूप यहाँ विस्तारके भयसे नहीं लिखा जा रहा है। यह याज्ञवल्क्यस्मृति, प्रायश्चित्ताध्यायके अन्तमें तथा अन्य स्मृतियों एवं निबन्धग्रन्थोंमें द्रष्टव्य है। तत्र लोकहितार्थाय रुद्रेण परमात्मना। शिलातले पदं न्यस्तं तत्र पितृन् प्रसादयेत्
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective verse) If out of blunder, a householder does not perform the Sandhya prayer he should take bath and observe fast. He shall become pure immediately. If he be exhausted (and does not perform Sandhya-prayer), he should remain perfectly self-controlled.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective verse) If out of blunder, a householder does not perform the Sandhya prayer he should take bath and observe fast. He shall become pure immediately. If he be exhausted (and does not perform Sandhya-prayer), he should remain perfectly self-controlled.

verses.sanskrit: तैलाभ्यक्तो ऽथवा कुर्याद् यदि मूत्रपुरीषके । अहोरात्रेण शुद्ध्येत श्मश्रुकर्म च मैथुनम्
verses.transliteration: tailābhyakto 'thavā kuryād yadi mūtrapurīṣake / ahorātreṇa śuddhyeta śmaśrukarma ca maithunam
verses.translation: Having dropped off the daily (sacred) duties prescrib¬ ed in the Vedas, a Sndtaka (one who has completed the period of studentship and is due for marriage) who (thus) violates his vow, should observe fast on that day.
verses.hindi: गयाऽभिगमनं कर्तु यः शक्तो नाभिगच्छति। शोचन्ति पितरस्तं वै वृथा तस्य परिश्रमः
verses.wordMeaning: Having dropped off the daily (sacred) duties prescrib¬ ed in the Vedas, a Sndtaka (one who has completed the period of studentship and is due for marriage) who (thus) violates his vow, should observe fast on that day.
verses.commentary: Sense: Having dropped off the daily (sacred) duties prescrib¬ ed in the Vedas, a Sndtaka (one who has completed the period of studentship and is due for marriage) who (thus) violates his vow, should observe fast on that day.

verses.sanskrit: एकाहेन विवाहाग्निं परिहार्य द्विजोत्तमः । त्रिरात्रेण विशद्ध्येत त्रिरात्रात् षडहं पुनः
verses.transliteration: ekāhena vivāhāgniṃ parihārya dvijottamaḥ / trirātreṇa viśaddhyeta trirātrāt ṣaḍahaṃ punaḥ
verses.translation: An excellent Brahmana who exterminates another* (?) should perform the Krcchra vow for one year. A Vratya should observe the Candrayana Vrata and give a cow a gift whereby he becomes purified.
verses.hindi: गायन्ति पितरो गाथाः कीर्तयन्ति महर्षयः । गयां यास्यति यः कश्चित् सोऽस्मान् संतारयिष्यति यदि स्यात् पातकोपेतः स्वधर्मरतिवर्जितः। गयां यास्यति वंश्यो यः सोऽस्मान् संतारयिष्यति
verses.wordMeaning: An excellent Brahmana who exterminates another* (?) should perform the Krcchra vow for one year. A Vratya should observe the Candrayana Vrata and give a cow a gift whereby he becomes purified.
verses.commentary: Sense: An excellent Brahmana who exterminates another* (?) should perform the Krcchra vow for one year. A Vratya should observe the Candrayana Vrata and give a cow a gift whereby he becomes purified.

verses.sanskrit: दशाहं द्वादशाहं वा परिहार्य प्रमादतः । कृच्छ्रं चान्द्रायणं कुर्यात् तत्पापस्यापनुत्तये
verses.transliteration: daśāhaṃ dvādaśāhaṃ vā parihārya pramādataḥ / kṛcchraṃ cāndrāyaṇaṃ kuryāt tatpāpasyāpanuttaye
verses.translation: If a Brahmana does anything (indicating) atheism, he shall perform the Prajapatya rite. If he does anything injurious to Devas or the preceptors, he will become pure by means of Tapta Krcchra.
verses.hindi: तेषां तु समवेतानां यद्येकोऽपि गयां व्रजेत्
verses.wordMeaning: If a Brahmana does anything (indicating) atheism, he shall perform the Prajapatya rite. If he does anything injurious to Devas or the preceptors, he will become pure by means of Tapta Krcchra.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a Brahmana does anything (indicating) atheism, he shall perform the Prajapatya rite. If he does anything injurious to Devas or the preceptors, he will become pure by means of Tapta Krcchra.

verses.sanskrit: पतिताद् द्रव्यमादाय तदुत्सर्गेण शुद्ध्यति । चरेत् सांतपनं कृच्छ्रमित्याह भगवान् प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: patitād dravyamādāya tadutsargeṇa śuddhyati / caret sāṃtapanaṃ kṛcchramityāha bhagavān prabhuḥ
verses.translation: If one willingly travels by a camel-cart or a donkey cart, or enters water in the nude, he shall become pure only (by fasting for) three nights.
verses.hindi: प्रभासमिति विख्यातं यत्रास्ते भगवान् भवः कृत्वा लोकमवाप्नोति ब्रह्मणोऽक्षय्यमुत्तमम्
verses.wordMeaning: If one willingly travels by a camel-cart or a donkey cart, or enters water in the nude, he shall become pure only (by fasting for) three nights.
verses.commentary: Sense: If one willingly travels by a camel-cart or a donkey cart, or enters water in the nude, he shall become pure only (by fasting for) three nights.

verses.sanskrit: अनाशकनिवृत्तास्तु प्रव्रज्यावसितास्तथा । चरेयुस्त्रीणि कृच्छ्राणि त्रीणि चान्द्रायणानि च
verses.transliteration: anāśakanivṛttāstu pravrajyāvasitāstathā / careyustrīṇi kṛcchrāṇi trīṇi cāndrāyaṇāni ca
verses.translation: The expiatory rite for Apdnktas (outcastes i.e. those who are not eligible to sit in the same rows for meals with others) is missing five meals and taking meal only on the sixth occasion, for one month. The Japa of the Saihhita and the Homas as per procedure laid down by Sakala, every day.
verses.hindi: तीर्थ त्रैयम्बकं नाम सर्वदेवनमस्कृतम्। पूजयित्वा तत्र रुद्रं ज्योतिष्टोमफलं लभेत्
verses.wordMeaning: The expiatory rite for Apdnktas (outcastes i.e. those who are not eligible to sit in the same rows for meals with others) is missing five meals and taking meal only on the sixth occasion, for one month.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The expiatory rite for Apdnktas (outcastes i.e. those who are not eligible to sit in the same rows for meals with others) is missing five meals and taking meal only on the sixth occasion, for one month.…

verses.sanskrit: पुनश्च जातकर्मादिसंकारैः संस्कृता द्विजाः । शुद्ध्येयुस्तद् व्रतं सम्यक् चरेयुर्धर्मवर्धनाः
verses.transliteration: punaśca jātakarmādisaṃkāraiḥ saṃskṛtā dvijāḥ / śuddhyeyustad vrataṃ samyak careyurdharmavardhanāḥ
verses.translation: On wearing a blue or red cloth, a Brahmana should observe fast for a day and a night and drink Pancagavya. He shall then be pure.
verses.hindi: सुवर्णाक्षं महादेवं समभ्यर्च्य कपर्दिनम्। ब्राह्मणान् पूजयित्वा तु गाणपत्यं लभेद् ध्रुवम् वहाँ स्नान करके विशुद्धात्मा व्यक्ति दम्भ और मात्सर्यसे रहित होकर जो कुछ भी दान करता है, उससे वह दोनों (माता-पिताके) कुलोंको पवित्र करता है
verses.wordMeaning: On wearing a blue or red cloth, a Brahmana should observe fast for a day and a night and drink Pancagavya. He shall then be pure.
verses.commentary: Sense: On wearing a blue or red cloth, a Brahmana should observe fast for a day and a night and drink Pancagavya. He shall then be pure.

verses.sanskrit: अनुपासितसंध्यस्तु तदहर्यापको वसेत् । अनश्नन् संयतमना रात्रौ चेद् रात्रिमेव हि
verses.transliteration: anupāsitasaṃdhyastu tadaharyāpako vaset / anaśnan saṃyatamanā rātrau ced rātrimeva hi
verses.translation: If one explains the Vedas, the Dharmasastras and the Puranas to a Candala, he shall become pure only by means of the Candrayana rite. There is no other means of expiation for him.
verses.hindi: गया नामक परम गुह्य तीर्थ पितरोंको अत्यन्त प्रिय है। वहाँ पिण्डदान करके मनुष्यका पुनः जन्म नहीं होता। जो एक बार भी गया जाकर पिण्डदान करता है, उसके द्वारा तारे गये पितर (नरक आदि कष्टप्रद
verses.wordMeaning: If one explains the Vedas, the Dharmasastras and the Puranas to a Candala, he shall become pure only by means of the Candrayana rite. There is no other means of expiation for him.
verses.commentary: Sense: If one explains the Vedas, the Dharmasastras and the Puranas to a Candala, he shall become pure only by means of the Candrayana rite. There is no other means of expiation for him.

verses.sanskrit: अकृत्वा समिदाधानं शुचिः स्नात्वा समाहितः । गायत्र्यष्टसहस्रस्य जप्यं कुर्याद् विशुद्धये
verses.transliteration: akṛtvā samidādhānaṃ śuciḥ snātvā samāhitaḥ / gāyatryaṣṭasahasrasya japyaṃ kuryād viśuddhaye
verses.translation: On touching a Brahmana killed by hanging etc. the purity can be regained by Candrayana or Prajapatya vows.
verses.hindi: लोकोंसे मुक्त होकर) परम गतिको प्राप्त करते हैं। वहाँ (गयामें) संसारके कल्याणकी कामनासे परमात्मा रुद्रने शिलातलपर चरण (-का चिह्न) स्थापित किया है। वहाँपर पितरोंको (पिण्डदान आदिद्वारा) प्रसन्न करना चाहिए। गयाकी यात्रा करनेमें समर्थ होनेपर भी जो वहाँ नहीं जाता, उसके सम्बन्धमें पितर शोक करते हैं, उसका (अन्य सभी) परिश्रम व्यर्थ ही होता है॥७--१०॥
verses.wordMeaning: On touching a Brahmana killed by hanging etc. the purity can be regained by Candrayana or Prajapatya vows.
verses.commentary: Sense: On touching a Brahmana killed by hanging etc. the purity can be regained by Candrayana or Prajapatya vows.

verses.sanskrit: उपासीत न चेत् संध्यां गृहस्थो ऽपि प्रमादतः । स्नात्वा विशुद्ध्यते सद्यः परिश्रान्तस्तु संयमात्
verses.transliteration: upāsīta na cet saṃdhyāṃ gṛhastho 'pi pramādataḥ / snātvā viśuddhyate sadyaḥ pariśrāntastu saṃyamāt
verses.translation: If a Brahmana defiled by Ucchista (i.e. with food particles in the mouth and on hands and) has not performed Acamana (the concluding sipping of water after meal) touches a Candala and others unwittingly, he should take bath and repeat the Gayatri Mantra a thousand and eight times.
verses.hindi: पितर इस गाथाका गान करते हैं और महर्षि इसका कीर्तन करते हैं कि जो कोई भी गया जायगा, वही हमें तारेगा अर्थात् असद्गतिसे मुक्त करेगा। मेरे वंशमें उत्पन्न व्यक्ति किसी कारण भले ही पापयुक्त हो,
verses.wordMeaning: If a Brahmana defiled by Ucchista (i.e. with food particles in the mouth and on hands and) has not performed Acamana (the concluding sipping of water after meal) touches a Candala and others unwittingly,…
verses.commentary: Sense: If a Brahmana defiled by Ucchista (i.e. with food particles in the mouth and on hands and) has not performed Acamana (the concluding sipping of water after meal) touches a Candala and others unwittingly,…

verses.sanskrit: वेदोदितानि नित्यानि कर्माणि च विलोप्य तु । स्नातकव्रतलोपं तु कृत्वा चोपवसेद् दिनम्
verses.transliteration: vedoditāni nityāni karmāṇi ca vilopya tu / snātakavratalopaṃ tu kṛtvā copavased dinam
verses.translation: Or he should repeat the Drupada Mantra a hundred times. He should maintain celibacy and good concentration of mind. He should observe fast for three nights strictly. He shall then become pure by means of the Pancagavya.
