verses.hindi: स्वधर्ममें निष्ठा न रखता हो, तब भी यदि गया-तीर्थकी यात्रा करेगा तो वह हम लोगोंका तारक होगा। शीलवान् तथा गुणवान् बहुतसे पुत्रोंकी अभिलाषा करनी चाहिए; क्योंकि उन सभीमेंसे कोई एक तो गया जायगा। इसलिये सभी प्रयत्रोंके द्वारा विशेषरूपसे ब्राह्मणको तो गया जाकर समाहित-मनसे विधिवत् पिण्डदान करना चाहिए। वे मनुष्य धन्य हैं जो गयामें पिण्डदान करते हैं। वे दोनों (माता-पिताके) कुलकी सात पीढ़ियोंका उद्धार
verses.wordMeaning: Or he should repeat the Drupada Mantra a hundred times. He should maintain celibacy and good concentration of mind. He should observe fast for three nights strictly. He shall then become pure by means of the Pancagavya.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or he should repeat the Drupada Mantra a hundred times. He should maintain celibacy and good concentration of mind. He should observe fast for three nights strictly. He shall then become pure by means of the Pancagavya.

verses.sanskrit: संवत्सरं चरेत् कृच्छ्रमग्न्युत्सादी द्विजोत्तमः । चान्द्रायणं चरेद् व्रात्यो गोप्रदानेन शुद्ध्यति
verses.transliteration: saṃvatsaraṃ caret kṛcchramagnyutsādī dvijottamaḥ / cāndrāyaṇaṃ cared vrātyo gopradānena śuddhyati
verses.translation: A Brahmana, while Ucchista (with particles offood in the mouth or on hand) willfully touches Candalas or fallen persons (outcastes) should observe the Prajapatya vow for purification.
verses.hindi: कर स्वयं भी परमगति प्राप्त करते हें
verses.wordMeaning: A Brahmana, while Ucchista (with particles offood in the mouth or on hand) willfully touches Candalas or fallen persons (outcastes) should observe the Prajapatya vow for purification.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Brahmana, while Ucchista (with particles offood in the mouth or on hand) willfully touches Candalas or fallen persons (outcastes) should observe the Prajapatya vow for purification.

verses.sanskrit: नास्तिक्यं यदि कुर्वोत प्राजापत्यं चरेद् द्विजः । देवद्रोहं गुरुद्रोहं तप्तकृच्छ्रेण शुद्ध्यति
verses.transliteration: nāstikyaṃ yadi kurvota prājāpatyaṃ cared dvijaḥ / devadrohaṃ gurudrohaṃ taptakṛcchreṇa śuddhyati
verses.translation: On touching a Candala, a Sutakin (one having the impurity due to birth or death of a relative) or a dead body, a woman in her monthly course and a fallen fellow a person touched by them, one should take bath for the sake of purity.
verses.hindi: अन्य प्रभास नामक प्रसिद्ध श्रेष्ठ तीर्थ है, जिसे सिद्धोंका निवास-स्थान बतलाया गया है। वहाँ भगवान् भव (शंकर) स्थित हैं। वहाँ स्नान, तप, श्राद्ध तथा ब्राह्मणोंका पूजन करनेसे ब्रह्माके अक्षय्य और उत्तम लोकको प्राप्ति होती है। त्रैयम्बक नामक तीर्थ सभी
verses.wordMeaning: On touching a Candala, a Sutakin (one having the impurity due to birth or death of a relative) or a dead body, a woman in her monthly course and a fallen fellow a person touched by them, one should take bath for the sake of purity.
verses.commentary: Sense: On touching a Candala, a Sutakin (one having the impurity due to birth or death of a relative) or a dead body, a woman in her monthly course and a fallen fellow a person touched by them, one should take bath for the sake of purity.

verses.sanskrit: उष्ट्रयानं समारुह्य खरयानं च कामतः । त्रिरात्रेण विशुद्ध्येत् तु नग्नो वा प्रविशेज्जलम्
verses.transliteration: uṣṭrayānaṃ samāruhya kharayānaṃ ca kāmataḥ / trirātreṇa viśuddhyet tu nagno vā praviśejjalam
verses.translation: If one touches a person touched by a Candala, Sutakin and a corpse, one should take bath and perform Acamana and Japa with great concentration.
verses.hindi: ज्योतिष्टोम-यज्ञके फलकी प्राप्ति होती है। वहाँ कपर्दी तथा सुवर्णाक्ष महादेवकी भलीभाँति आराधना करने तथा ब्राह्मणोंकी पूजा करनेसे निश्चय ही गाणपत्य-पदकी प्रापि होती है
verses.wordMeaning: If one touches a person touched by a Candala, Sutakin and a corpse, one should take bath and perform Acamana and Japa with great concentration.
verses.commentary: Sense: If one touches a person touched by a Candala, Sutakin and a corpse, one should take bath and perform Acamana and Japa with great concentration.

verses.sanskrit: षष्ठान्नकालतामासं संहिताजप एव च । होमाश्च शाकला नित्यमपाङ्क्तानां विशोधनम्
verses.transliteration: ṣaṣṭhānnakālatāmāsaṃ saṃhitājapa eva ca / homāśca śākalā nityamapāṅktānāṃ viśodhanam
verses.translation: An excellent Brahmana who knowingly touches these persons or is touched by them, should take bath and perform Acamana rite for the sake of purity. So says lord Pitamaha.
verses.hindi: सर्वव्याधिहरं पुण्यं रुद्र्सालोक्यकारणम् षण्मासान् नियताहारो ब्रह्मचारी समाहितः । उषित्वा तत्र विप्रेन्द्रा यास्यन्ति परमं पदम्
verses.wordMeaning: An excellent Brahmana who knowingly touches these persons or is touched by them, should take bath and perform Acamana rite for the sake of purity. So says lord Pitamaha.
verses.commentary: Sense: An excellent Brahmana who knowingly touches these persons or is touched by them, should take bath and perform Acamana rite for the sake of purity. So says lord Pitamaha.

verses.sanskrit: नीलं रक्तं वसित्वा च ब्राह्मणो वस्त्रमेव हि । अहोरात्रोषितः स्नातः पञ्चगव्येन शुद्ध्यति
verses.transliteration: nīlaṃ raktaṃ vasitvā ca brāhmaṇo vastrameva hi / ahorātroṣitaḥ snātaḥ pañcagavyena śuddhyati
verses.translation: If a Brahmana, taking food is accidentally touched, he should perform Sauca (purificatory rite) and then observe fast. After that he should take bath and perform Homa. This is the holy rite.
verses.hindi: एकाम्रं देवदेवस्य गाणपत्यफलप्रदम्
verses.wordMeaning: If a Brahmana, taking food is accidentally touched, he should perform Sauca (purificatory rite) and then observe fast. After that he should take bath and perform Homa. This is the holy rite.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a Brahmana, taking food is accidentally touched, he should perform Sauca (purificatory rite) and then observe fast. After that he should take bath and perform Homa. This is the holy rite.

verses.sanskrit: वेदधर्मपुराणानां चण्डालस्य तु भाषणे । चान्द्रायणेन शुद्धिः स्यान्न ह्यन्या तस्य निष्कृतिः
verses.transliteration: vedadharmapurāṇānāṃ caṇḍālasya tu bhāṣaṇe / cāndrāyaṇena śuddhiḥ syānna hyanyā tasya niṣkṛtiḥ
verses.translation: On touching the dead body and a Candala (v.l. dead body of a Candala) one shall perform the Krcchra rite.
verses.hindi: दत्त्वात्र शिवभक्तानां किञ्चिच्छश्चन्महीं शुभाम्। सार्वभौमो भवेद् राजा मुमुक्षुर्मोक्षमाप्नुयात् महानदीजलं पुण्यं सर्वपापविनाशनम्। ग्रहणे समुपस्पृश्य मुच्यते सर्वपातकेः
verses.wordMeaning: On touching the dead body and a Candala (v.l. dead body of a Candala) one shall perform the Krcchra rite.
verses.commentary: Sense: On touching the dead body and a Candala (v.l. dead body of a Candala) one shall perform the Krcchra rite.

verses.sanskrit: उद्बन्धनादिनिहतं संस्पृश्य ब्राह्मणः क्वचित् । चान्द्रायणेन शुद्धिः स्यात् प्राजापत्येन वा पुनः
verses.transliteration: udbandhanādinihataṃ saṃspṛśya brāhmaṇaḥ kvacit / cāndrāyaṇena śuddhiḥ syāt prājāpatyena vā punaḥ
verses.translation: On touching liquor, a Brahmana should perform three Pranayamas and he shall become pure. On touching garlic and onion, he should drink ghee and he shall become pure.
verses.hindi: अन्या च विरजा नाम नदी त्रैलोक्यविश्रुता । तस्यां स्नात्वा नरो विप्रा ब्रह्मलोके महीयते
verses.wordMeaning: On touching liquor, a Brahmana should perform three Pranayamas and he shall become pure. On touching garlic and onion, he should drink ghee and he shall become pure.
verses.commentary: Sense: On touching liquor, a Brahmana should perform three Pranayamas and he shall become pure. On touching garlic and onion, he should drink ghee and he shall become pure.

verses.sanskrit: उच्छिष्टो यद्यनाचान्तश्चाण्डालादीन् स्पृशेद् द्विजः । प्रमादाद् वै जपेत् स्नात्वा गायत्र्यष्टसहस्रकम्
verses.transliteration: ucchiṣṭo yadyanācāntaścāṇḍālādīn spṛśed dvijaḥ / pramādād vai japet snātvā gāyatryaṣṭasahasrakam
verses.translation: If a Brahmana is bitten by a dog, he should drink milk for three days in the evening. If he is bitten above the umbilical region, he should increase (the quantity of milk) twofold.
verses.hindi: तीर्थं नारायणस्यान्यन्नाम्ना तु पुरुषोत्तमम्। तत्र नारायणः श्रीमानास्ते परमपूरुषः पूजयित्वा परं विष्णुं स्नात्वा तत्र द्विजोत्तमः । ब्राह्मणान् पूजयित्वा तु विष्णुलोकमवाप्नुयात्
verses.wordMeaning: If a Brahmana is bitten by a dog, he should drink milk for three days in the evening. If he is bitten above the umbilical region, he should increase (the quantity of milk) twofold.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a Brahmana is bitten by a dog, he should drink milk for three days in the evening. If he is bitten above the umbilical region, he should increase (the quantity of milk) twofold.

verses.sanskrit: द्रुपदानां शतं वापि ब्रह्मचारी समाहितः । त्रिरात्रोपोषितः सम्यक् पञ्चगव्येन शुद्ध्यति
verses.transliteration: drupadānāṃ śataṃ vāpi brahmacārī samāhitaḥ / trirātropoṣitaḥ samyak pañcagavyena śuddhyati
verses.translation: This quantity of milk shall be increased threefold if he is bitten on the arms and if bitten on the head, this shall be fourfold. Or an excellent Brahmana bitten by dogs, should take bath and perform Japa of the Savitrl Mantra.
verses.hindi: तीर्थानां परमं तीर्थ गोकर्ण नाम विश्रुतम् । सर्वपापहरं शम्भोर्निवासः परमेष्ठिनः
verses.wordMeaning: This quantity of milk shall be increased threefold if he is bitten on the arms and if bitten on the head, this shall be fourfold. Or an excellent Brahmana bitten by dogs, should take bath and perform Japa of the Savitrl Mantra.
verses.commentary: Sense: This quantity of milk shall be increased threefold if he is bitten on the arms and if bitten on the head, this shall be fourfold. Or an excellent Brahmana bitten by dogs, should take bath and perform Japa of the Savitrl Mantra.

verses.sanskrit: चण्डालपतितादींस्तु कामाद् यः संस्पृशेद् द्विजः । उच्छिष्टस्तत्र कुर्वोत प्राजापत्यं विशुद्धये
verses.transliteration: caṇḍālapatitādīṃstu kāmād yaḥ saṃspṛśed dvijaḥ / ucchiṣṭastatra kurvota prājāpatyaṃ viśuddhaye
verses.translation: If an excellent Brahmana who is not sick and who has the means but does not perform great Yajnas but par¬ takes of food (and enjoys) he shall become pure by performing half of a Krcchra rite.
verses.hindi: दृष्टा लिङ्गं तु देवस्य गोकर्णेश्वरमुत्तमम्। ईप्सितांल्लभते कामान् रुद्रस्य दयितो भवेत् उत्तरं चापि गोकर्ण लिङ्गं देवस्य शूलिनः । महादेवस्यार्चयित्वा शिवसायुज्यमाप्नुयात्
verses.wordMeaning: If an excellent Brahmana who is not sick and who has the means but does not perform great Yajnas but par¬ takes of food (and enjoys) he shall become pure by performing half of a Krcchra rite.
verses.commentary: Sense: If an excellent Brahmana who is not sick and who has the means but does not perform great Yajnas but par¬ takes of food (and enjoys) he shall become pure by performing half of a Krcchra rite.

verses.sanskrit: चाण्डालसूतकशवांस्तथा नारीं रजस्वलाम् । स्पृष्ट्वा स्नायाद् विशुद्ध्यर्थं तत्स्पृष्टं पतितिं तथा
verses.transliteration: cāṇḍālasūtakaśavāṃstathā nārīṃ rajasvalām / spṛṣṭvā snāyād viśuddhyarthaṃ tatspṛṣṭaṃ patitiṃ tathā
verses.translation: If a man maintaining sacred fires does not worship them on the Parvan days or if a person does not go unto his wife during the prescribed days after menstruation, he should perform half a Krcchra.
verses.hindi: तत्र देवो महादेवः स्थाणुरित्यभिविश्रुतः । तं दृष्टा सर्वपापेभ्यो मुच्यते तत्क्षणान्नरः
verses.wordMeaning: If a man maintaining sacred fires does not worship them on the Parvan days or if a person does not go unto his wife during the prescribed days after menstruation, he should perform half a Krcchra.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a man maintaining sacred fires does not worship them on the Parvan days or if a person does not go unto his wife during the prescribed days after menstruation, he should perform half a Krcchra.

verses.sanskrit: चाण्डालसूतकशवैः संस्पृष्टं संस्पृशेद् यदि । प्रमादात् तत आचम्य जपं कुर्यात् समाहितः
verses.transliteration: cāṇḍālasūtakaśavaiḥ saṃspṛṣṭaṃ saṃspṛśed yadi / pramādāt tata ācamya japaṃ kuryāt samāhitaḥ
verses.translation: (Defective) If person even though not sick (simply) puts his body into the water without using water (for washing himself?), he should take a dip into water alongwith clothes and touch a cow and then he becomes pure.
verses.hindi: सम्पूज्य पुरुषं विष्णुं श्वेतद्वीपे महीयते यत्र नारायणो देवो रुद्रेण त्रिपुरारिणा। कृत्या यज्ञस्य मथनं दक्षस्य तु विसर्जितः
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective) If person even though not sick (simply) puts his body into the water without using water (for washing himself?), he should take a dip into water alongwith clothes and touch a cow and then he becomes pure.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective) If person even though not sick (simply) puts his body into the water without using water (for washing himself?), he should take a dip into water alongwith clothes and touch a cow and then he becomes pure.

verses.sanskrit: तत् स्पृष्टस्पर्शिनं स्पृष्ट्वा बुद्धिपूर्वं द्विजोत्तमः । आचमेत् तद् विशुद्ध्यर्थं प्राह देवः पितामहः
verses.transliteration: tat spṛṣṭasparśinaṃ spṛṣṭvā buddhipūrvaṃ dvijottamaḥ / ācamet tad viśuddhyarthaṃ prāha devaḥ pitāmahaḥ
verses.translation: (Ifanysinis committed) knowingly, a Brahmana should perform the japa after the sun has arisen, remaining in the water itself. He should then repeat the Gayatri a thousand and eight times. He should observe fast for three days.
verses.hindi: परमेष्ठी रुद्रका सोमेश्वर नामक श्रेष्ठ तीर्थ सभी प्रकारकी व्याधियोंका हरण करनेवाला, पवित्र तथा रुद्रलोककी प्राप्ति करानेका साधन है
verses.wordMeaning: (Ifanysinis committed) knowingly, a Brahmana should perform the japa after the sun has arisen, remaining in the water itself. He should then repeat the Gayatri a thousand and eight times. He should observe fast for three days.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Ifanysinis committed) knowingly, a Brahmana should perform the japa after the sun has arisen, remaining in the water itself. He should then repeat the Gayatri a thousand and eight times. He should observe fast for three days.

verses.sanskrit: भुञ्जानस्य तु विप्रस्य कदाचित् संस्त्रवेद् गुदम् । कृत्वा शौचं ततः स्नायादुपोष्य जुहुयाद् घृतम्
verses.transliteration: bhuñjānasya tu viprasya kadācit saṃstraved gudam / kṛtvā śaucaṃ tataḥ snāyādupoṣya juhuyād ghṛtam
verses.translation: On following the dead body of a Sudra out of his own free will, an excellent Brahmana should take ablutions, in rivers and perform the Japa of a thousand and eight Gayatri Mantra.
verses.hindi: विजय नामका एक सुन्दर तीर्थ है जो तीर्थोमे श्रेष्ठ है। वहाँ महेश्वरका विजय नामक प्रसिद्ध लिङ्ग है। वहाँपर छः महीनेतक संयत आहार करते हुए ब्रह्मचर्य- व्रत धारणकर, एकाग्र-मनसे उपवास कर श्रैष्ठ ब्राह्मण परम पद प्राप्त करते हैं। पूर्व दिशामें अत्यन्त सुन्दर एक दूसरा एकाम्र नामक श्रेष्ठ तीर्थ है जो देवाधिदेव (शंकर)-के गाणपत्यपदरूपी फलको प्रदान करनेवाला है। वहाँ शिवभक्तोंको थोड़ी-सी भी स्थिर तथा सुन्दर
verses.wordMeaning: On following the dead body of a Sudra out of his own free will, an excellent Brahmana should take ablutions, in rivers and perform the Japa of a thousand and eight Gayatri Mantra.
verses.commentary: Sense: On following the dead body of a Sudra out of his own free will, an excellent Brahmana should take ablutions, in rivers and perform the Japa of a thousand and eight Gayatri Mantra.

verses.sanskrit: चाण्डालान्त्यशवं स्पृष्ट्वा कृच्छ्रं कुर्याद् विशुद्धये । स्पृष्ट्वाभ्यक्तस्त्वसंस्पृश्यमहोरात्रेण शुद्ध्यति
verses.transliteration: cāṇḍālāntyaśavaṃ spṛṣṭvā kṛcchraṃ kuryād viśuddhaye / spṛṣṭvābhyaktastvasaṃspṛśyamahorātreṇa śuddhyati
verses.translation: After swearing an oath with the delimitation of another Brahmana* (?), a Brahmana should perform the Candrayana rite by means of cooked barley food.
verses.hindi: भूमि दान करनेसे (दाता) चक्रवर्ती सम्राट् होता है और मोक्षकी इच्छा रखनेवाला मोक्ष प्राप्त करता है। वहाँ महानदीका जल पवित्र और सभी पापोंको नष्ट करनेवाला है, ग्रहणके समय उसका स्पर्श (स्नान आदि)
verses.wordMeaning: After swearing an oath with the delimitation of another Brahmana* (?), a Brahmana should perform the Candrayana rite by means of cooked barley food.
verses.commentary: Sense: After swearing an oath with the delimitation of another Brahmana* (?), a Brahmana should perform the Candrayana rite by means of cooked barley food.

verses.sanskrit: सुरां स्पृष्ट्वा द्विजः कुर्यात् प्राणायामत्रयं शुचिः । पलाण्डुं लशुनं चैव घृतं प्राश्य ततः शुचिः
verses.transliteration: surāṃ spṛṣṭvā dvijaḥ kuryāt prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ śuciḥ / palāṇḍuṃ laśunaṃ caiva ghṛtaṃ prāśya tataḥ śuciḥ
verses.translation: After serving food irregularly (partially to persons sitting) in the same line, one becomes purified of the sin by means of krcchra rites. On treading the shadow of a Candala, one shall take bath and drink ghee.
verses.hindi: करनेसे सभी पातकोंसे मुक्ति हो जाती है विप्रो! दूसरी विरजा नामकी एक नदी है जो तीनों लोकोंमें विख्यात है, उसमें स्नान करके मनुष्य ब्रह्मलोकमें पूजित होता है। नारायणका पुरुषोत्तम नामक एक दूसरा तीर्थ है, वहाँ परम पुरुष श्रीमान् नारायण निवास करते
verses.wordMeaning: After serving food irregularly (partially to persons sitting) in the same line, one becomes purified of the sin by means of krcchra rites. On treading the shadow of a Candala, one shall take bath and drink ghee.
verses.commentary: Sense: After serving food irregularly (partially to persons sitting) in the same line, one becomes purified of the sin by means of krcchra rites. On treading the shadow of a Candala, one shall take bath and drink ghee.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणस्तु शुना दष्टस्त्र्यहं सायं पयः पिबेत् । नाभेरूर्ध्वं तु दष्टस्य तदेव द्विगुणं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇastu śunā daṣṭastryahaṃ sāyaṃ payaḥ pibet / nābherūrdhvaṃ tu daṣṭasya tadeva dviguṇaṃ bhavet
verses.translation: If in the stage of impurity, one looks at the fire or the moon he should look at the sun (for expiation). On touching a human bone, one should take bath and he becomes pure thereby.
verses.hindi: हैं। वहाँ स्नान करके श्रेष्ठ विष्णुकी अर्चना और ब्राह्मणोंको पूजा करनेसे द्विजोत्तम विष्णुलोक प्राप्त करता है। सभी पापोंको हरनेवाला तीर्थोमें श्रेष्ठ गोकर्ण नामका एक प्रसिद्ध तीर्थ है। वहाँ परमेष्ठी शम्भुका निवास
verses.wordMeaning: If in the stage of impurity, one looks at the fire or the moon he should look at the sun (for expiation). On touching a human bone, one should take bath and he becomes pure thereby.
verses.commentary: Sense: If in the stage of impurity, one looks at the fire or the moon he should look at the sun (for expiation). On touching a human bone, one should take bath and he becomes pure thereby.

verses.sanskrit: स्यादेतत् त्रिगुणं बाह्वोर्मूर्ध्नि च स्याच्चतुर्गुणम् । स्नात्वा जपेद् वा सावित्रीं श्वभिर्दष्टो द्विजोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: syādetat triguṇaṃ bāhvormūrdhni ca syāccaturguṇam / snātvā japed vā sāvitrīṃ śvabhirdaṣṭo dvijottamaḥ
verses.translation: Having done a false study, one should beg for alms for a year. An ungrateful person should stay in a Brahmana's house and perform sacred rites for five years.
verses.hindi: है। वहाँ देव (शंकर)-के गोकर्णेश्वर नामक उत्तम लिङ्गका दर्शनकर मनुष्य अभीप्सित कामनाओंको प्राप्त करता है और रुद्रका प्रिय होता है। उत्तर गोकर्णमें भी त्रिशूलधारी शंकर महादेवका लिङ्ग है। उसकी अर्चनासे शिव-सायुज्यकी प्राप्ति होती है
verses.wordMeaning: Having done a false study, one should beg for alms for a year. An ungrateful person should stay in a Brahmana's house and perform sacred rites for five years.
verses.commentary: Sense: Having done a false study, one should beg for alms for a year. An ungrateful person should stay in a Brahmana's house and perform sacred rites for five years.

verses.sanskrit: अनिर्वर्त्य महायज्ञान् यो भुङ्क्ते तु द्विजोत्तमः । अनातुरः सति धने कृच्छ्रार्धेन स शुद्ध्यति
verses.transliteration: anirvartya mahāyajñān yo bhuṅkte tu dvijottamaḥ / anāturaḥ sati dhane kṛcchrārdhena sa śuddhyati
verses.translation: After producing Huth sound against a Brahmana and after using Tvam (you in singular) in respect to elderly persons (i.e. instead of usmgBhavdn —your 'honour'), one should take bath and spend the remainder of the day without taking food. He should then bow down and propitiate those persons.
verses.hindi: देवाधिदेव महादेव वहाँ ' स्थाणु' इस नामसे विख्यात हैं। उनका दर्शनकर मनुष्य तत्क्षण ही सभी पापोंसे मुक्त हो जाता है। महात्मा विष्णुका एक दूसरा कुब्जाम्र नामक अतुलनीय स्थान है, वहाँ विष्णु (-स्वरूप)
verses.wordMeaning: After producing Huth sound against a Brahmana and after using Tvam (you in singular) in respect to elderly persons (i.e. instead of usmgBhavdn —your 'honour'), one should take bath and spend the remainder of the day without taking food.…
verses.commentary: Sense: After producing Huth sound against a Brahmana and after using Tvam (you in singular) in respect to elderly persons (i.e. instead of usmgBhavdn —your 'honour'), one should take bath and spend the remainder of the day without taking food.…

verses.sanskrit: आहिताग्निरुपस्थानं न कुर्याद् यस्तु पर्वणि । ऋतौ न गच्छेद् भार्यां वा सो ऽपि कृच्छ्रार्धमाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: āhitāgnirupasthānaṃ na kuryād yastu parvaṇi / ṛtau na gacched bhāryāṃ vā so 'pi kṛcchrārdhamācaret
verses.translation: If one beats (the elders) even with the blade of a grass, if one binds their neck with a piece of cloth and if one conquers them in an argument, one should propitiate the other one.
verses.hindi: पुरुषका पूजन करनेसे व्यक्ति ( भगवानूके धाम) श्वेतद्वीपमें प्रतिष्ठा प्राप्त करता है। यहाँ त्रिपुरारि रुद्रने ही दक्षके यज्ञका विध्वंस करनेके अनन्तर नारायणदेवको प्रतिष्ठित किया है अन्यत् कोकामुखं विष्णोस्तीर्थमद्भुतकर्मणः । मृतोऽत्र पातकैर्मुक्तो विष्णुसारूप्यमाप्नुयात्
verses.wordMeaning: If one beats (the elders) even with the blade of a grass, if one binds their neck with a piece of cloth and if one conquers them in an argument, one should propitiate the other one.
verses.commentary: Sense: If one beats (the elders) even with the blade of a grass, if one binds their neck with a piece of cloth and if one conquers them in an argument, one should propitiate the other one.

verses.sanskrit: विनाद्भिरप्सु नाप्यार्तः शरीरं सन्निवेश्य च । सचैलो जलमाप्लुत्य गामालभ्य विशुद्ध्यति
verses.transliteration: vinādbhirapsu nāpyārtaḥ śarīraṃ sanniveśya ca / sacailo jalamāplutya gāmālabhya viśuddhyati
verses.translation: On intimidating (by threat) a Brahmana with the intention of killing him, one should perform the krcchra rite; on felling a Brahmana to the ground, one should perform the Atikrcchra rite, and on spilling the blood of a Brahmana, one shall perform both the expiatory rites of krcchra and Atikrcchra.
verses.hindi: प्राणांस्तत्र नरस्त्यक्त्वा हुषीकेशं प्रपश्यति
verses.wordMeaning: On intimidating (by threat) a Brahmana with the intention of killing him, one should perform the krcchra rite; on felling a Brahmana to the ground, one should perform the Atikrcchra rite, and on spilling the blood of a Brahmana,…
verses.commentary: Sense: On intimidating (by threat) a Brahmana with the intention of killing him, one should perform the krcchra rite; on felling a Brahmana to the ground, one should perform the Atikrcchra rite, and on spilling the blood of a Brahmana,…

verses.sanskrit: बुद्धिपूर्वं त्वभ्युदितो जपेदन्तर्जले द्विजः । गायत्र्यष्टसहस्रं तु त्र्यहं चोपवसेद् व्रती
verses.transliteration: buddhipūrvaṃ tvabhyudito japedantarjale dvijaḥ / gāyatryaṣṭasahasraṃ tu tryahaṃ copavased vratī
verses.translation: After uttering a lie to or for reviling an elderly person (or a teacher) one should perform the expiatory rite by refraining from taking food for one night (v.l. or three nights) for dispelling that sin.
verses.hindi: आस्ते हयशिरा नित्यं तत्र नारायणः स्वयम् तीर्थ त्रैलोक्यविख्यातं ब्रह्मणः परमेष्ठिनः । पुष्करं सर्वपापघ्नं मृतानां ब्रह्मलोकदम्
verses.wordMeaning: After uttering a lie to or for reviling an elderly person (or a teacher) one should perform the expiatory rite by refraining from taking food for one night (v.l. or three nights) for dispelling that sin.
verses.commentary: Sense: After uttering a lie to or for reviling an elderly person (or a teacher) one should perform the expiatory rite by refraining from taking food for one night (v.l. or three nights) for dispelling that sin.

verses.sanskrit: अनुगम्येच्छया शूद्रं प्रेतीभूतं द्विजोत्तमः । गायत्र्यष्टसहस्रं च जप्यं कुर्यान्नदीषु च
verses.transliteration: anugamyecchayā śūdraṃ pretībhūtaṃ dvijottamaḥ / gāyatryaṣṭasahasraṃ ca japyaṃ kuryānnadīṣu ca
verses.translation: If one spits at or reviles in front of Devas and the sages, one should burn one's tongue by means of a firebrand. Gold too should be given as gift
verses.hindi: मनसा संस्मरेद् यस्तु पुष्करं वै द्विजोत्तमः ।
verses.wordMeaning: If one spits at or reviles in front of Devas and the sages, one should burn one's tongue by means of a firebrand. Gold too should be given as gift
verses.commentary: Sense: If one spits at or reviles in front of Devas and the sages, one should burn one's tongue by means of a firebrand. Gold too should be given as gift

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा तु शपथं विप्रो विप्रस्य वधसंयुतम् । मृषैव यावकान्नेन कुर्याच्चान्द्रायणं व्रतम्
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā tu śapathaṃ vipro viprasya vadhasaṃyutam / mṛṣaiva yāvakānnena kuryāccāndrāyaṇaṃ vratam
verses.translation: If any Brahmana passes urine in the garden of Devas (i.e. in the precincts of shrines) even for once, his penis
verses.hindi: तत्र देवाः सगन्धर्वाः सयक्षोरगराक्षसाः। उपासते सिद्धसङ्घा ब्रह्माणं पद्मसम्भवम् तत्र स्त्रात्वा भवेच्छुद्धो ब्रह्माणं परमेष्ठिनम्। पूजयित्वा द्विजवरान् ब्रह्माणं सम्प्रपश्यति
verses.wordMeaning: If any Brahmana passes urine in the garden of Devas (i.e. in the precincts of shrines) even for once, his penis
verses.commentary: Sense: If any Brahmana passes urine in the garden of Devas (i.e. in the precincts of shrines) even for once, his penis

verses.sanskrit: पङ्क्त्यां विषमदानं तु कृत्वा कृच्छ्रेण शुद्ध्यति । छायां श्वपाकस्यारुह्य स्नात्वा संप्राशयेद् घृतम्
verses.transliteration: paṅktyāṃ viṣamadānaṃ tu kṛtvā kṛcchreṇa śuddhyati / chāyāṃ śvapākasyāruhya snātvā saṃprāśayed ghṛtam
verses.translation: If out of delusion, an excellent Brahmana passes urine in the sanctum sanctorum of a temple; his penis should be cut off. He should perform the Candrayana rite.
verses.hindi: तत्राभिगम्य देवेशं पुरुहूतमनिन्दितम्। सुरूपो जायते मर्त्यः सर्वान् कामानवाप्नुयात्
verses.wordMeaning: If out of delusion, an excellent Brahmana passes urine in the sanctum sanctorum of a temple; his penis should be cut off. He should perform the Candrayana rite.
verses.commentary: Sense: If out of delusion, an excellent Brahmana passes urine in the sanctum sanctorum of a temple; his penis should be cut off. He should perform the Candrayana rite.

verses.sanskrit: ईक्षेदादित्यमशुचिर्दृष्ट्वाग्निं चन्द्रमेव वा । मानुषं चास्थि संस्पृश्य स्नानं कृत्वा विशुद्ध्यति
verses.transliteration: īkṣedādityamaśucirdṛṣṭvāgniṃ candrameva vā / mānuṣaṃ cāsthi saṃspṛśya snānaṃ kṛtvā viśuddhyati
verses.translation: After blaspheming and rebuking the deities, Devas and the sages, an excellent Brahmana must duly perform the Prajapatya vow.
verses.hindi: सप्तसारस्वतं तीर्थ ब्रह्माद्यैः सेवितं परम्। पूजयित्वा तत्र रूद्रमश्वमेधफलं लभेत् यत्र मङ्कणको रुद्रं प्रपन्नः परमेश्वरम्। आराधयामास हरे पञ्चाक्षरपरायणः
verses.wordMeaning: After blaspheming and rebuking the deities, Devas and the sages, an excellent Brahmana must duly perform the Prajapatya vow.
verses.commentary: Sense: After blaspheming and rebuking the deities, Devas and the sages, an excellent Brahmana must duly perform the Prajapatya vow.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा तु मिथ्याध्ययनं चरेद् भैक्षं तु वत्सरम् । कृतघ्नो ब्राह्मणगृहे पञ्च संवत्सरं व्रती
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā tu mithyādhyayanaṃ cared bhaikṣaṃ tu vatsaram / kṛtaghno brāhmaṇagṛhe pañca saṃvatsaraṃ vratī
verses.translation: On conversing with them (i.e. such) sinners one incurs sins for which he should take bath and worship the Lord. On seeing them, he should look at the sun and on remembering them he should remember Visvesvara (in order to wipe off' the respective sins.)
verses.hindi: नमः शिवायेति मुनिः जपन् पञ्चाक्षरं परम्। आराधयामास शिवं तपसा गोवृषध्वजम्
verses.wordMeaning: On conversing with them (i.e. such) sinners one incurs sins for which he should take bath and worship the Lord. On seeing them, he should look at the sun and on remembering them he should remember Visvesvara (in order to wipe off' the respective sins.)
verses.commentary: Sense: On conversing with them (i.e. such) sinners one incurs sins for which he should take bath and worship the Lord. On seeing them, he should look at the sun and on remembering them he should remember Visvesvara (in order to wipe off' the respective sins.)

verses.sanskrit: हुङ्कारं ब्राह्मणस्योक्त्वा त्वङ्कारं च गरीयसः । स्नात्वानश्नन्नहः शेषं प्रणिपत्य प्रसादयेत्
verses.transliteration: huṅkāraṃ brāhmaṇasyoktvā tvaṅkāraṃ ca garīyasaḥ / snātvānaśnannahaḥ śeṣaṃ praṇipatya prasādayet
verses.translation: Even in hundreds of years it is impossible to redeem that person from sin who censures god Siva, the ruler of the universe, the over-lord of all living beings.
verses.hindi: प्रजज्वालाथ तपसा मुनिर्मङ्कणकस्तदा। ननर्त हर्षवेगेन ज्ञात्वा रुद्रं समागतम् तं प्राह भगवान् रुद्रः किमर्थ नर्तितं त्वया। दृष्टापि देवमीशानं नृत्यति स्म पुनः पुनः
verses.wordMeaning: Even in hundreds of years it is impossible to redeem that person from sin who censures god Siva, the ruler of the universe, the over-lord of all living beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even in hundreds of years it is impossible to redeem that person from sin who censures god Siva, the ruler of the universe, the over-lord of all living beings.

verses.sanskrit: ताडयित्वा तृणेनापि कण्ठं बद्ध्वापि वाससा । विवादे वापि निर्जित्य प्रणिपत्य प्रसादयेत्
verses.transliteration: tāḍayitvā tṛṇenāpi kaṇṭhaṃ baddhvāpi vāsasā / vivāde vāpi nirjitya praṇipatya prasādayet
verses.translation: At the outset, he should observe the Candrayana vow,, then Krcchra as well as the Atikrcchra. He should then seek, refuge in the Lord whereby he shall be released from that sin.
verses.hindi: यहाँ चारों ओर एक योजनमें फैला क्षेत्र है जो सिद्धों तथा ऋषिगणोंसे वन्दित है। यहींपर विष्णुका पवित्र मन्दिर है, जिसमें पुरुषोत्तम (विष्णु) स्थित हैं
verses.wordMeaning: At the outset, he should observe the Candrayana vow,, then Krcchra as well as the Atikrcchra. He should then seek, refuge in the Lord whereby he shall be released from that sin.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the outset, he should observe the Candrayana vow,, then Krcchra as well as the Atikrcchra. He should then seek, refuge in the Lord whereby he shall be released from that sin.

verses.sanskrit: अवगूर्य चरेत् कृच्छ्रमतिकृच्छ्रं निपातने । कृच्छ्रातिकृच्छ्रौ कुर्वोत विप्रस्योत्पाद्य शोणितम्
verses.transliteration: avagūrya caret kṛcchramatikṛcchraṃ nipātane / kṛcchrātikṛcchrau kurvota viprasyotpādya śoṇitam
verses.translation: The gift of all (one's) possessions duly is the means of expiation for all sins. He should perform the rites of Candrayana duly, as well as those of Krcchra and the Atikrcchra.
verses.hindi: अद्धुतकर्मा विष्णुका एक दूसरा कोकामुख नामका तीर्थ है, यहाँ मृत मनुष्य पापोंसे मुक्त हो जाता है और विष्णुके सारूप्य (नामक मोक्ष)-को प्राप्त करता है। शालग्राम नामका महातीर्थ विष्णुको प्रीतिको बढ़ानेवाला है। वहाँ प्राणोंका त्यागकर मनुष्य हृषीकेशका दर्शन प्राप्त करता है। अश्वतीर्थ नामका एक अन्य तीर्थ है जो सिंद्धोंका निवास-स्थल तथा अत्यन्त पवित्र है। वहाँ स्वयं नारायण हयग्रीव-रूपसे नित्य स्थित रहते हैं॥ ३६--३८ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: The gift of all (one's) possessions duly is the means of expiation for all sins. He should perform the rites of Candrayana duly, as well as those of Krcchra and the Atikrcchra.
verses.commentary: Sense: The gift of all (one's) possessions duly is the means of expiation for all sins. He should perform the rites of Candrayana duly, as well as those of Krcchra and the Atikrcchra.

verses.sanskrit: गुरोराक्रोशमनृतं कृत्वा कुर्याद् विशोधनम् । एकरात्रं त्रिरात्रं वा तत्पापस्यापनुत्तये
verses.transliteration: gurorākrośamanṛtaṃ kṛtvā kuryād viśodhanam / ekarātraṃ trirātraṃ vā tatpāpasyāpanuttaye
verses.translation: By worshipping Mahadeva on the eighth day and the fourteenth day in the dark half of a month through a Brahmana, one is released from all sins.
verses.hindi: परमेष्ठी ब्रह्माका पुष्कर नामक तीर्थ तीनों लोकोंमें विख्यात है। बह सभी पापोंको नष्ट करनेवाला तथा वहाँ मरनेवालोंको ब्रह्मलोक प्रदान करनेवाला है । जो द्विजोत्तम मनसे भी पुष्करका स्मरण करता है, वह सभी पातकोंसे
verses.wordMeaning: By worshipping Mahadeva on the eighth day and the fourteenth day in the dark half of a month through a Brahmana, one is released from all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: By worshipping Mahadeva on the eighth day and the fourteenth day in the dark half of a month through a Brahmana, one is released from all sins.

verses.sanskrit: देवर्षोणामभिमुखं ष्ठीवनाक्रोशने कृते । उल्मुकेन दहेज्जिह्वां दातव्यं च हिरण्यकम्
verses.transliteration: devarṣoṇāmabhimukhaṃ ṣṭhīvanākrośane kṛte / ulmukena dahejjihvāṃ dātavyaṃ ca hiraṇyakam
verses.translation: By seeing the three-eyed Isa with offerings in the first Yama (period of three hours) of the night on the thirteenth day,, one is released from all sins.
verses.hindi: मुक्त हो जाता है और (इन्द्रलोकमें देवराज) इन्द्रके साथ आनन्द करता है। वहाँ गन्धर्वो, यक्षो, नागों, राक्षसों तथा सिंद्धोंके समूहोंके साथ देवता पद्मजन्मा ब्रह्माकी उपासना करते हैं। वहाँ स्रानसे शुद्ध होकर परमेष्ठी ब्रह्मा तथा श्रेष्ठ ब्राह्मणोंका पूजन करनेसे ब्रह्माजीका साक्षात्कार प्राप्त होता है। वहाँ जाकर अनिन्दित देवराज इन्द्रका दर्शन करनेसे मनुष्य सुन्दर रूपसे सम्पन्न हो जाता है और सभी कामनाओंको प्राप्त करता है
verses.wordMeaning: By seeing the three-eyed Isa with offerings in the first Yama (period of three hours) of the night on the thirteenth day,, one is released from all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: By seeing the three-eyed Isa with offerings in the first Yama (period of three hours) of the night on the thirteenth day,, one is released from all sins.

verses.sanskrit: देवोद्याने तु यः कुर्यान्मूत्रोच्चारं सकृद् द्विजः । छिन्द्याच्छिश्नं तु शुद्ध्यर्थं चरेच्चान्द्रायणं तु वा
verses.transliteration: devodyāne tu yaḥ kuryānmūtroccāraṃ sakṛd dvijaḥ / chindyācchiśnaṃ tu śuddhyarthaṃ careccāndrāyaṇaṃ tu vā
verses.translation: If a woman is chaste and is engaged in serving her- husband, she does not incur any sin either in this world or in the other.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मा आदिके द्वारा सेवित सप्तसारस्वत नामक एक श्रेष्ठ तीर्थ है। वहाँ रुद्रकी पूजा करनेसे अश्वमेध-यज्ञके फलकी प्रापि होती है। वहाँ मङ्कणक (नामक शिवभक्त मुनि) परमेश्वर रुद्रके शरणागत हुए थे और पञ्चाक्षर-
verses.wordMeaning: If a woman is chaste and is engaged in serving her- husband, she does not incur any sin either in this world or in the other.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a woman is chaste and is engaged in serving her- husband, she does not incur any sin either in this world or in the other.

verses.sanskrit: देवतायतने मूत्रं कृत्वा मोहाद् द्विजोत्तमः । शिश्नस्योत्कर्तनं कृत्वा चान्द्रायणमथाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: devatāyatane mūtraṃ kṛtvā mohād dvijottamaḥ / śiśnasyotkartanaṃ kṛtvā cāndrāyaṇamathācaret
verses.translation: A chaste woman devoted to piety {dharma) shall always attain welfare and happiness. No man can, by any means, create discomfiture for her.
verses.hindi: आराधना की थी। (वहाँ) मुनि (मङ्कणक)-ने "नमः शिवाय' इस श्रेष्ठ पञ्चाक्षर-मन्त्रका जप करते हुए तपस्याद्दारा गोवृषध्वज शिवको आराधना की थी॥ ४४--४६॥ तदनन्तर रुद्रको आया हुआ जानकर मङ्कणक मुनि तपस्याके तेजसे उद्दीत हो गये और आनन्दातिरेकसे नृत्य करने लगे। भगवान् रुद्रने उनसे पूछा--' आप क्यों नृत्य कर रहे हैं।' (किंतु वे कुछ बोले नहीं और) देव ईशानको देखनेपर भी (अपनी नृत्यकलाको सर्वोत्तम
verses.wordMeaning: A chaste woman devoted to piety {dharma) shall always attain welfare and happiness. No man can, by any means, create discomfiture for her.
verses.commentary: Sense: A chaste woman devoted to piety {dharma) shall always attain welfare and happiness. No man can, by any means, create discomfiture for her.

verses.sanskrit: देवतानामृषीणां च देवानां चैव कुत्सनम् । कृत्वा सम्यक् प्रकुर्वोत प्राजापत्यं द्विजोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: devatānāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca devānāṃ caiva kutsanam / kṛtvā samyak prakurvota prājāpatyaṃ dvijottamaḥ
verses.translation: Just as in the case of Sita, weU-known in the three worlds, as the charming and beloved wife of Rama, the son of Dasaratha, she conquered the king of Raksasas.
verses.hindi: समझकर) बार-बार नृत्य करते ही रहे
verses.wordMeaning: Just as in the case of Sita, weU-known in the three worlds, as the charming and beloved wife of Rama, the son of Dasaratha, she conquered the king of Raksasas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as in the case of Sita, weU-known in the three worlds, as the charming and beloved wife of Rama, the son of Dasaratha, she conquered the king of Raksasas.

verses.sanskrit: तैस्तु संभाषणं कृत्वा स्नात्वा देवान् समर्चयेत् । दृष्ट्वा वीक्षेत भास्वन्तं स्म्वत्वा विशेश्वरं स्मरेत्
verses.transliteration: taistu saṃbhāṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā snātvā devān samarcayet / dṛṣṭvā vīkṣeta bhāsvantaṃ smvatvā viśeśvaraṃ smaret
verses.translation: Urged by Kala (Death), Ravana, the king of Raksasas, desired Sita, the wide-eyed beautiful wife of Rama.
verses.hindi: सोऽन्वीक्ष्य भगवानीशः सगर्व गर्वशान्तये। स्वकं देहं विदार्यास्मै भस्मराशिमदर्शयत् यत् सगर्वं हि भवता नर्तितं मुनिपुंगव। न युक्तं तापसस्यैतत् त्वत्तोऽप्यत्राधिको हाहम्
verses.wordMeaning: Urged by Kala (Death), Ravana, the king of Raksasas, desired Sita, the wide-eyed beautiful wife of Rama.
verses.commentary: Sense: Urged by Kala (Death), Ravana, the king of Raksasas, desired Sita, the wide-eyed beautiful wife of Rama.

verses.sanskrit: यः सर्वभूताधिपतिं विश्वेशानं विनिन्दति । न तस्य निष्कृतिः शक्या कर्तुं वर्षशतैरपि
verses.transliteration: yaḥ sarvabhūtādhipatiṃ viśveśānaṃ vinindati / na tasya niṣkṛtiḥ śakyā kartuṃ varṣaśatairapi
verses.translation: It is reported that by means of his Maya, he ■disguised himself (as) an ascetic and determined to abduct that beautiful lady while she was strolling (solitarily) in the tenantless forest.
verses.hindi: इत्याभाष्य मुनिश्रेष्ठं स रुद्रः किल विश्वदूक् । आस्थाय परमं भावं ननर्त जगतो हरः
verses.wordMeaning: It is reported that by means of his Maya, he ■disguised himself (as) an ascetic and determined to abduct that beautiful lady while she was strolling (solitarily) in the tenantless forest.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is reported that by means of his Maya, he ■disguised himself (as) an ascetic and determined to abduct that beautiful lady while she was strolling (solitarily) in the tenantless forest.

verses.sanskrit: चान्द्रायणं चरेत् पूर्वं कृच्छ्रं चैवातिकृच्छ्रकम् । प्रपन्नः शरणं देवं तस्मात् पापाद् विमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret pūrvaṃ kṛcchraṃ caivātikṛcchrakam / prapannaḥ śaraṇaṃ devaṃ tasmāt pāpād vimucyate
verses.translation: The lady of pure smiles realised his intention. Remembering her husband, the son of Dasaratha, she sought refuge in the Avasathya (household) fire.
verses.hindi: दंष्टाकरालवदनो ज्वालामाली भयंकरः विशाललोचनामेकां देवीं चारुविलासिनीम्। सूर्यायुतसमप्रख्यां प्रसन्नवदनां शिवाम्
verses.wordMeaning: The lady of pure smiles realised his intention. Remembering her husband, the son of Dasaratha, she sought refuge in the Avasathya (household) fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lady of pure smiles realised his intention. Remembering her husband, the son of Dasaratha, she sought refuge in the Avasathya (household) fire.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वस्वदानं विधिवत् सर्वपापविशोधनम् । चान्द्रायणं चविधिना कृच्छ्रं चैवातिकृच्छ्रकम्
verses.transliteration: sarvasvadānaṃ vidhivat sarvapāpaviśodhanam / cāndrāyaṇaṃ cavidhinā kṛcchraṃ caivātikṛcchrakam
verses.translation: With her palms joined in devotion, Rama's wife worshipped the great Yogi, (the fire-god), the destroyer (scorcher) of the worlds as if he was her husband Rama incarnate (and prayed);
verses.hindi: प्रसन्नो भगवानीशस्त््यम्बको भक्तवत्सलः । पूर्ववेषं स जग्राह देवी चान्तर्हिताभवत्
verses.wordMeaning: With her palms joined in devotion, Rama's wife worshipped the great Yogi, (the fire-god), the destroyer (scorcher) of the worlds as if he was her husband Rama incarnate (and prayed);
verses.commentary: Sense: With her palms joined in devotion, Rama's wife worshipped the great Yogi, (the fire-god), the destroyer (scorcher) of the worlds as if he was her husband Rama incarnate (and prayed);

verses.sanskrit: पुण्यक्षेत्राभिगमनं सर्वपापविनाशनम् । देवताभ्यर्चनं नॄणामशेषाघविनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: puṇyakṣetrābhigamanaṃ sarvapāpavināśanam / devatābhyarcanaṃ nṝṇāmaśeṣāghavināśanam
verses.translation: I bow unto Krsanu (fire) of the form of Kala, of great Yogic power, the greatest riddle, the destroyer of all living beings.
verses.hindi: आलिङ्गध भक्तं प्रणतं देवदेवः स्वयं शिव: । न भेतव्यं त्वया वत्स प्राह किं ते ददाम्यहम् विज्ञापयामास तदा हृष्टः प्रष्टमना मुनिः
verses.wordMeaning: I bow unto Krsanu (fire) of the form of Kala, of great Yogic power, the greatest riddle, the destroyer of all living beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: I bow unto Krsanu (fire) of the form of Kala, of great Yogic power, the greatest riddle, the destroyer of all living beings.

verses.sanskrit: अमावस्यां तिथिं प्राप्य यः समाराधयेच्छिवम् । ब्राह्मणान् भोजयित्वा तु सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: amāvasyāṃ tithiṃ prāpya yaḥ samārādhayecchivam / brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā tu sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
verses.translation: I take shelter in lord Pavaka (the purifying deity), the eternal deity of universal forms, the Yogin who wears the (elephant) hide, the lord of the goblins the Supreme god.
verses.hindi: नमोऽस्तु ते महादेव महेश्वर नमोऽस्तु ते। किमेतद् भगवद्रूपं सुघोरं विश्वतोमुखम्
verses.wordMeaning: I take shelter in lord Pavaka (the purifying deity), the eternal deity of universal forms, the Yogin who wears the (elephant) hide, the lord of the goblins the Supreme god.
verses.commentary: Sense: I take shelter in lord Pavaka (the purifying deity), the eternal deity of universal forms, the Yogin who wears the (elephant) hide, the lord of the goblins the Supreme god.

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णाष्टम्यां महादेवं तथा कृष्णचतुर्दशीम् । संपूज्य ब्राह्मणमुखे सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ mahādevaṃ tathā kṛṣṇacaturdaśīm / saṃpūjya brāhmaṇamukhe sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
verses.translation: I resort unto the Atman of radiant blazing body abiding in the hearts of all living beings. I seek refuge in the Lord whose form is the universe, the source of all that fiery, brilliant, I resort to the fire-god, the Lord of great Yogins, the sun, the supreme god.
verses.hindi: का च सा भगवत्पाश्‍वे राजमाना व्यवस्थिता। ति कूर्मपुराण ति
verses.wordMeaning: I resort unto the Atman of radiant blazing body abiding in the hearts of all living beings. I seek refuge in the Lord whose form is the universe, the source of all that fiery, brilliant, I resort to the fire-god, the Lord of great Yogins, the sun, the supreme god.
verses.commentary: Sense: I resort unto the Atman of radiant blazing body abiding in the hearts of all living beings. I seek refuge in the Lord whose form is the universe, the source of all that fiery, brilliant, I resort to the fire-god, the Lord of great Yogins, the sun, the supreme god.

verses.sanskrit: त्रयोदश्यां तथा रात्रौ सोपहारं त्रिलोचनम् । दृष्ट्वेशं प्रथमे यामे मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः
verses.transliteration: trayodaśyāṃ tathā rātrau sopahāraṃ trilocanam / dṛṣṭveśaṃ prathame yāme mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ
verses.translation: I seek refuge in Rudra, the great swallower (destroyer), the trident-bearing Lord, the fire of the Universal destruction, the Lord of Yogins, the dispenser of fruits (in the form) of enjoyment and liberation.
verses.hindi: तब भगवान् शंकर उन्हें गर्वयुक्त देखकर उनके गर्वको दूर करनेके लिये अपने शरीरको विदीर्ण कर (उसमेंसे निकलती हुई) भस्मराशि उन्हें दिखलायी (और कहा)-हे द्विजोत्तम! मेरे शरीरसे निकलती हुई
verses.wordMeaning: I seek refuge in Rudra, the great swallower (destroyer), the trident-bearing Lord, the fire of the Universal destruction, the Lord of Yogins, the dispenser of fruits (in the form) of enjoyment and liberation.
verses.commentary: Sense: I seek refuge in Rudra, the great swallower (destroyer), the trident-bearing Lord, the fire of the Universal destruction, the Lord of Yogins, the dispenser of fruits (in the form) of enjoyment and liberation.

verses.sanskrit: उपोषितश्चतुर्दश्यां कृष्णपक्षे समाहितः । यमाच धर्मराजाय मृत्यवे चान्तकाय च
verses.transliteration: upoṣitaścaturdaśyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe samāhitaḥ / yamāca dharmarājāya mṛtyave cāntakāya ca
verses.translation: I resort unto you the diverse-eyed deity with the forms of Bhuh, Bhuvah and Svah, one who is lying hidden in the golden abode, the great one of unmeasured splendour.
verses.hindi: इस भस्मराशिको देखो। यह तपस्याका माहात्म्य है। आपके समान दूसरा भी है। मुनिपुंगव! आप (तपस्याके) गर्वसे गर्वित होकर नृत्य कर रहे हैं, यह एक तपस्वीके लिये उचित नहीं है, मैं आपसे भी अधिक (नृत्यकलामें मुनिश्रेष्ठ (मङ्कणक)-से ऐसा कहकर वे विश्वद्रष्टा तथा संसारके संहारक रुद्र परम भावमें स्थित होकर नृत्य करने लगे। (वे रुद्र) हजारों सिर, हजारों आँख और हजारों चरणवाले, भयंकर दाढोंसे युक्त मुखवाले,
verses.wordMeaning: I resort unto you the diverse-eyed deity with the forms of Bhuh, Bhuvah and Svah, one who is lying hidden in the golden abode, the great one of unmeasured splendour.
verses.commentary: Sense: I resort unto you the diverse-eyed deity with the forms of Bhuh, Bhuvah and Svah, one who is lying hidden in the golden abode, the great one of unmeasured splendour.

verses.sanskrit: वैवस्वताय कालाय सर्वभूतक्षयाय च । प्रत्येकं तिलसंयुक्तान् दद्यात् सप्तोदकाञ्जलीन् । स्नात्वा नद्यां तु पूर्वाह्ने मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः
verses.transliteration: vaivasvatāya kālāya sarvabhūtakṣayāya ca / pratyekaṃ tilasaṃyuktān dadyāt saptodakāñjalīn / snātvā nadyāṃ tu pūrvāhne mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ
verses.translation: I resort to Vaisvanara abiding in all living beings, the lord who conveys Havyas and Kavyas (i.e. offerings) (to gods and Pitrs). I resort to Lord Vahni.
verses.hindi: ज्चालामालाओंसे व्याप्त तथा अत्यन्त भीषण रूपवाले हो
verses.wordMeaning: I resort to Vaisvanara abiding in all living beings, the lord who conveys Havyas and Kavyas (i.e. offerings) (to gods and Pitrs). I resort to Lord Vahni.
verses.commentary: Sense: I resort to Vaisvanara abiding in all living beings, the lord who conveys Havyas and Kavyas (i.e. offerings) (to gods and Pitrs). I resort to Lord Vahni.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मचर्यमधः शय्यामुपवासं द्विजार्चनम् । व्रतेष्वेतेषु कुर्वोत शान्तः संयतमानसः
verses.transliteration: brahmacaryamadhaḥ śayyāmupavāsaṃ dvijārcanam / vrateṣveteṣu kurvota śāntaḥ saṃyatamānasaḥ
verses.translation: I resort to that Supreme reality, the excellent and auspicious principle of the sun. I resort to the Agni ascending to heaven, the greatest splendour, the imperishable conveyor of oblations to gods.
verses.hindi: त्रिशूलधारीके पार्श्व-भागमें विशाल नेत्रोंवाली, सुन्दर विलासयुक्त, हजारों सूर्योके समान तेजवाली और प्रसन्न मुखवाली देवी शिवाको देखा। मुसकराते हुए विश्वेश्वर (शिव) तथा अमित द्युतिसम्पन्न (शिवा)-को स्थित देखकर मुनीश्वर (मङ्कणक)-का हृदय भयभीत हो गया और वे (अपने गर्वको ध्यानमें रखकर) काँपने लगे तथा संयमित होकर रुद्राध्यायका जप करते हुए उन्होंने रुद्रको सिरसे प्रणाम किया
verses.wordMeaning: I resort to that Supreme reality, the excellent and auspicious principle of the sun. I resort to the Agni ascending to heaven, the greatest splendour, the imperishable conveyor of oblations to gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: I resort to that Supreme reality, the excellent and auspicious principle of the sun. I resort to the Agni ascending to heaven, the greatest splendour, the imperishable conveyor of oblations to gods.

verses.sanskrit: अमावस्यायां ब्रह्माणं समुद्दिश्य पितामहम् । ब्राह्मणांस्त्रीन् समभ्यर्च्य मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः
verses.transliteration: amāvasyāyāṃ brahmāṇaṃ samuddiśya pitāmaham / brāhmaṇāṃstrīn samabhyarcya mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ
verses.translation: After repeating (the prayer in) these eight (?) verses on Vahni, the famous wife of Rama mentally meditated on Rama and remained silent with her eyes closed.
verses.hindi: उन भक्तवत्सल त्र्यम्बक भगवान् शिवने प्रसन्न होकर अपना पूर्वरूप धारण किया और देवी अन्तर्हित हो गयीं। साक्षात् देवाधिदेव शिवने शरणागत भक्तका आलिङ्गनकर कहा-वत्स! तुम डरो मत! मैं तुम्हें क्या
verses.wordMeaning: After repeating (the prayer in) these eight (?) verses on Vahni, the famous wife of Rama mentally meditated on Rama and remained silent with her eyes closed.
verses.commentary: Sense: After repeating (the prayer in) these eight (?) verses on Vahni, the famous wife of Rama mentally meditated on Rama and remained silent with her eyes closed.

verses.sanskrit: षष्ठ्यामुपोषितो देवं शुक्लपक्षे समाहितः । सप्तम्यामर्चयेद् भानुं मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः
verses.transliteration: ṣaṣṭhyāmupoṣito devaṃ śuklapakṣe samāhitaḥ / saptamyāmarcayed bhānuṃ mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ
verses.translation: Then out of the Avasathya (household) fire, Lord Mahesvara (the great god), the bearer of sacrificial oblations, of resplendent soul manifested himself as if burning with his own refulgence.
verses.hindi: तब प्रसन्न मुनि (मङ्कणक)-ने त्रिपुरका नाश करनेवाले गिरिश हरको सिरसे प्रणामकर पूछनेको इच्छासे कहा-महादेव! आपको नमस्कार है। महेश्वर! आपको नमस्कार है। सभी ओर मुखवाला आपका यह भयंकर कौन-सा रूप है? और आपके पार्श्वभागमें स्थित होकर सुशोभित होनेवाली वे देवी कौन हैं?
verses.wordMeaning: Then out of the Avasathya (household) fire, Lord Mahesvara (the great god), the bearer of sacrificial oblations, of resplendent soul manifested himself as if burning with his own refulgence.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then out of the Avasathya (household) fire, Lord Mahesvara (the great god), the bearer of sacrificial oblations, of resplendent soul manifested himself as if burning with his own refulgence.

verses.sanskrit: भरण्यां च चतुर्थ्यां च शनैश्चरदिने यमम् । पूजयेत् सप्तजन्मोत्थैर्मुच्यते पातकैर्नरः
verses.transliteration: bharaṇyāṃ ca caturthyāṃ ca śanaiścaradine yamam / pūjayet saptajanmotthairmucyate pātakairnaraḥ
verses.translation: Desirous of getting Ravana killed he created an illusory Sita. Taking the real Sita the beloved of Rama, the fire-god vanished there.
verses.hindi: महेशः स्वात्मनो योगं देवीं च त्रिपुरानलः
verses.wordMeaning: Desirous of getting Ravana killed he created an illusory Sita. Taking the real Sita the beloved of Rama, the fire-god vanished there.
verses.commentary: Sense: Desirous of getting Ravana killed he created an illusory Sita. Taking the real Sita the beloved of Rama, the fire-god vanished there.

verses.sanskrit: एकादश्यां निराहारः समभ्यर्च्य जनार्दनम् । द्वादश्यां शुक्लपक्षस्य महापापैः प्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: ekādaśyāṃ nirāhāraḥ samabhyarcya janārdanam / dvādaśyāṃ śuklapakṣasya mahāpāpaiḥ pramucyate
verses.translation: On seeing such a Sita (i.e. the illusory one) Ravana the lord of Raksasas, took her and went to Lanka situated with¬ in the ocean.
verses.hindi: दाहकः सर्वपापानां कालः कालकरो हरः तस्य सा परमा माया प्रकृतिस्त्रिगुणात्मिका। प्रोच्यते मुनिभिः शक्तिर्जगद्योनिः सनातनी
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing such a Sita (i.e. the illusory one) Ravana the lord of Raksasas, took her and went to Lanka situated with¬ in the ocean.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing such a Sita (i.e. the illusory one) Ravana the lord of Raksasas, took her and went to Lanka situated with¬ in the ocean.

verses.sanskrit: तपो जपस्तीर्थसेवा देवब्राह्मणपूजनम् । ग्रहणादिषु कालेषु महापातकशोधनम्
verses.transliteration: tapo japastīrthasevā devabrāhmaṇapūjanam / grahaṇādiṣu kāleṣu mahāpātakaśodhanam
verses.translation: After killing Ravana, Rama took Sita and (came back) accompanied by Laksmana. His mind became agitated due to suspicion.
verses.hindi: नारायणः परोऽव्यक्तो मायारूप इति श्रुतिः
verses.wordMeaning: After killing Ravana, Rama took Sita and (came back) accompanied by Laksmana. His mind became agitated due to suspicion.
verses.commentary: Sense: After killing Ravana, Rama took Sita and (came back) accompanied by Laksmana. His mind became agitated due to suspicion.

verses.sanskrit: यः सर्वपापयुक्तो ऽपि पुण्यतीर्थेषु मानवः । नियमेन त्यजेत् प्राणान् स मुच्येत् सर्वपातकैः
verses.transliteration: yaḥ sarvapāpayukto 'pi puṇyatīrtheṣu mānavaḥ / niyamena tyajet prāṇān sa mucyet sarvapātakaiḥ
verses.translation: For convincing the living beings, the illusory Sita entered the fire; immediately she was consumed by the fire.
verses.hindi: एवमेतज्जगत् सर्व सर्वदा स्थापयाम्यहम्। योजयामि प्रकृत्याऽहं पुरुषं पञ्चविंशकम् तथा वै संगतो देवः कूटस्थः सर्वगोऽमलः। सृजत्यशेषमेवेदं स्वमूर्तेः प्रकृतेरजः
verses.wordMeaning: For convincing the living beings, the illusory Sita entered the fire; immediately she was consumed by the fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: For convincing the living beings, the illusory Sita entered the fire; immediately she was consumed by the fire.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मघ्नं वा कृतघ्नं वा महापातकदूषितम् । भर्तारमुद्धरेन्नारी प्रविष्टा सह पावकम्
verses.transliteration: brahmaghnaṃ vā kṛtaghnaṃ vā mahāpātakadūṣitam / bhartāramuddharennārī praviṣṭā saha pāvakam
verses.translation: After burning the illusory Sita, the lord fire-god of hot rays, showed the real Sita to Rama. The fire-god (the purifier) became a beloved of Devas.
verses.hindi: स देवो भगवान् ब्रह्मा विश्वरूपः पितामहः । तवैतत् कथितं सम्यक् स्रष्टृत्वं परमात्मनः
verses.wordMeaning: After burning the illusory Sita, the lord fire-god of hot rays, showed the real Sita to Rama. The fire-god (the purifier) became a beloved of Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: After burning the illusory Sita, the lord fire-god of hot rays, showed the real Sita to Rama. The fire-god (the purifier) became a beloved of Devas.

verses.sanskrit: एतदेव परं स्त्रीणां प्रायश्चित्तं विदुर्बुधाः । सर्वपापसमुद्भूतौ नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.transliteration: etadeva paraṃ strīṇāṃ prāyaścittaṃ vidurbudhāḥ / sarvapāpasamudbhūtau nātra kāryā vicāraṇā
verses.translation: Catching hold of the feet of her husband, the daughter of Janaka the lady of beautiful middle, made obeisance to Rama on the ground.
verses.hindi: एकोऽहं भगवान् कालो ह्यनादिश्चान्तकृद् विभुः । समास्थाय परं भावं प्रोक्तो रुद्रो मनीषिभिः मम वै सापरा शक्तिर्देवी विद्येति विश्रुता। दृष्टा हि भवता नूनं विद्यादेहस्त्वहं ततः
verses.wordMeaning: Catching hold of the feet of her husband, the daughter of Janaka the lady of beautiful middle, made obeisance to Rama on the ground.
verses.commentary: Sense: Catching hold of the feet of her husband, the daughter of Janaka the lady of beautiful middle, made obeisance to Rama on the ground.

verses.sanskrit: पतिव्रता तु या नारी भर्तृशुश्रूषणोत्सुका । न तस्या विद्यते पापमिह लोके परत्र च
verses.transliteration: pativratā tu yā nārī bhartṛśuśrūṣaṇotsukā / na tasyā vidyate pāpamiha loke paratra ca
verses.translation: On seeing it Rama was delighted in mind. Surprise was evident in his eyes. After bowing to the Vahni with bent head, Raghava propitiated him.
verses.hindi: विष्णुर्ब्रह्मा च भगवान् रुद्रः काल इति श्रुतिः
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing it Rama was delighted in mind. Surprise was evident in his eyes. After bowing to the Vahni with bent head, Raghava propitiated him.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing it Rama was delighted in mind. Surprise was evident in his eyes. After bowing to the Vahni with bent head, Raghava propitiated him.

verses.sanskrit: पतिव्रता धर्मरता रुद्राण्येव न संशयः । नास्याः पराभवं कर्तुं शक्नोतीह जनः क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: pativratā dharmaratā rudrāṇyeva na saṃśayaḥ / nāsyāḥ parābhavaṃ kartuṃ śaknotīha janaḥ kvacit
verses.translation: The lord spoke to Vahni; Was this fair-complexion- ed lady burned by you before, as she has been seen come to my side again?
verses.hindi: त्रयमेतदनाद्यन्तं ब्रह्मण्येव व्यवस्थितम्। तदात्मकं तदव्यक्तं तदक्षरमिति श्रुतिः आकाशं निष्कलं ब्रह्म तस्मादन्यन्न विद्यते
verses.wordMeaning: The lord spoke to Vahni; Was this fair-complexion- ed lady burned by you before, as she has been seen come to my side again?
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord spoke to Vahni; Was this fair-complexion- ed lady burned by you before, as she has been seen come to my side again?

verses.sanskrit: यथा रामस्य सुभगा सीता त्रैलोक्यविश्रुता । पत्नी दाशरथेर्देवी विजिग्ये राक्षसेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: yathā rāmasya subhagā sītā trailokyaviśrutā / patnī dāśaratherdevī vijigye rākṣaseśvaram
verses.translation: Lord Fire-god, the scorcher of the worlds, spoke to the son of Dasaratha, telling him everything as it had happened in the presence of all living beings.
verses.hindi: (मङ्कणकके) इतना कहनेपर त्रिपुरदाहक महेश्वर हरने मङ्कणकसे अपने योग तथा देवीका इस प्रकार
verses.wordMeaning: Lord Fire-god, the scorcher of the worlds, spoke to the son of Dasaratha, telling him everything as it had happened in the presence of all living beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Fire-god, the scorcher of the worlds, spoke to the son of Dasaratha, telling him everything as it had happened in the presence of all living beings.

verses.sanskrit: रामस्य भार्यां विमलां रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः । सीतां विशालनयनां चकमे कालचोदितः
verses.transliteration: rāmasya bhāryāṃ vimalāṃ rāvaṇo rākṣaseśvaraḥ / sītāṃ viśālanayanāṃ cakame kālacoditaḥ
verses.translation: "This beloved of yours is highly chaste as goddess Parvati. She is the greatest favourite of the goddess whom she had propitiated by means of penance (?)
verses.hindi: मुखवाला, सभी पापोंको जलानेवाला, काल, कालको भी उत्पन्न करनेवाला हर हूँ। मेरे द्वारा ही समस्त चेतन एवं अचेतन-स्वरूप (जगत्) प्रवृत्त किया जाता है। मैं ही वह अन्तर्यामी और मैं ही वह पुरुष तथा पुरुषोत्तम हूँ, जिसकी त्रिगुणात्मिका प्रकृति-रूप परम माया मुनियोंके द्वारा सनातनी शक्ति और जगतूका मूल कारण कही जाती है। मैं वही सर्वज्ञ (पुरुष) हूँ जो मायाद्वारा विश्वको व्यामोहित करता है और जिसे श्रुति नारायण,
verses.wordMeaning: "This beloved of yours is highly chaste as goddess Parvati. She is the greatest favourite of the goddess whom she had propitiated by means of penance (?)
verses.commentary: Sense: "This beloved of yours is highly chaste as goddess Parvati. She is the greatest favourite of the goddess whom she had propitiated by means of penance (?)

verses.sanskrit: गृहीत्वा मायया वेषं चरन्तीं विजने वने । समाहर्तुं मतिं चक्रे तापसः किल कामिनीम्
verses.transliteration: gṛhītvā māyayā veṣaṃ carantīṃ vijane vane / samāhartuṃ matiṃ cakre tāpasaḥ kila kāminīm
verses.translation: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.
verses.hindi: पर, अव्यक्त तथा मायारूप कहती है। मैं इसी प्रकार सदा इस जगतूकी स्थापना करता हूँ। मैं प्रकृतिसे उस पुरुषको संयुक्त करता हुँ (जो पचीस तत्त्वोंमें एक- मात्र चेतन प्रमुख तत्त्व है।)
verses.wordMeaning: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.
verses.commentary: Sense: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.

verses.sanskrit: विज्ञाय सा च तद्भावं स्मृत्वा दाशरथिं पतिम् । जगाम शरणं वह्निमावसथ्यं शुचिस्मिता
verses.transliteration: vijñāya sā ca tadbhāvaṃ smṛtvā dāśarathiṃ patim / jagāma śaraṇaṃ vahnimāvasathyaṃ śucismitā
verses.translation: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार यह देव (चेतन), कूटस्थ (निर्विकार), “प्रकृति'से संगत होकर समस्त जगतूकी सृष्टि करता है। इसी पुरुषको देव, भगवान्, ब्रह्मा, विश्वरूप एवं पितामहके रूपमें समझना चाहिए। इस प्रकार मैंने आपको भलीभाँति परमात्माके सृष्टिकर्तृत्वको बतलाया।
verses.wordMeaning: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.
verses.commentary: Sense: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.

verses.sanskrit: उपतस्थे महायोगं सर्वदोषविनाशनम् । कृताञ्जली रामपत्नी शाक्षात् पतिमिवाच्युतम्
verses.transliteration: upatasthe mahāyogaṃ sarvadoṣavināśanam / kṛtāñjalī rāmapatnī śākṣāt patimivācyutam
verses.translation: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.
verses.hindi: मैं अद्वितीय, अनादि, संहार करनेवाला, विभु तथा भगवान् काल हूँ। परम भावका आश्रय ग्रहण करनेपर मनीषी लोग मुझे रुद्र कहते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.
verses.commentary: Sense: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.

verses.sanskrit: नमस्यामि महायोगं कृतान्तं गहनं परम् । दाहकं सर्वभूतानामीशानं कालरूपिणम्
verses.transliteration: namasyāmi mahāyogaṃ kṛtāntaṃ gahanaṃ param / dāhakaṃ sarvabhūtānāmīśānaṃ kālarūpiṇam
verses.translation: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.
verses.hindi: मेरी ही अपरा शक्ति विद्यादेवीके नामसे प्रसिद्ध है। मेरे विद्या-रूप देहका और मेरा आपने दर्शन किया है। इस प्रकार ये सभी तत्त्व प्रधान, पुरुष और ईश्वररूप हैं। श्रुतिने इन्हें ही विष्णु, ब्रह्मा और कालरूप भगवान् रुद्र कहा है। ये तीनों ही अनादि तथा अनन्त ब्रह्ममें ही स्थित हैं। अतः श्रुतिका कथन है कि ये तीनों देव तदात्मक, (परमपुरुष ईश्वररूप), वही अव्यक्तरूप, वही अक्षररूप, आत्मानन्दस्वरूप, परमतत्त्व, चिन्मात्र
verses.wordMeaning: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.
verses.commentary: Sense: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.

verses.sanskrit: नमस्ये पावकं देवं साक्षिणं विश्वतोमुखम् । आत्मानं दीप्तवपुषं सर्वभूतहृदी स्थितम्
verses.transliteration: namasye pāvakaṃ devaṃ sākṣiṇaṃ viśvatomukham / ātmānaṃ dīptavapuṣaṃ sarvabhūtahṛdī sthitam
verses.translation: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.
verses.hindi: और परम पदरूप हैं, आकाशरूप एवं निष्कल ब्रह्म हैं। वास्तवमेँ परमतत्त्व ईश्वरके अतिरिक्त अन्य कुछ भी नहीं है। ऐसा जानकर आपको भक्तियोगका अवलम्बन लेकर मेरी पूजा तथा वन्दना करनी चाहिए। तदनन्तर
verses.wordMeaning: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.
verses.commentary: Sense: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.

verses.sanskrit: प्रपद्ये शरणं वह्निं ब्रह्मण्यं ब्रह्मरूपिणम् । भूतेशं कृत्तिवसनं शरण्यं परमं पदम्
verses.transliteration: prapadye śaraṇaṃ vahniṃ brahmaṇyaṃ brahmarūpiṇam / bhūteśaṃ kṛttivasanaṃ śaraṇyaṃ paramaṃ padam
verses.translation: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.
verses.hindi: आपको उस शाश्वत (पुरुष)-के दर्शन होंगे॥ ७०--७४॥ इतना कहकर भगवान् हर अदृश्य हो गये। मुनि
verses.wordMeaning: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.
verses.commentary: Sense: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.

verses.sanskrit: ॐ प्रपद्ये जगन्मूर्तिं प्रभवं सर्वतेजसाम् । महायोगेश्वरं वह्निमादित्यं परमेष्ठिनम्
verses.transliteration: oṃ prapadye jaganmūrtiṃ prabhavaṃ sarvatejasām / mahāyogeśvaraṃ vahnimādityaṃ parameṣṭhinam
verses.translation: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.
verses.hindi: तत्रैव भक्तियोगेन रूद्रमाराधयन्मुनिः॥ ७५॥  (मङ्कणक) वहीं (सप्तसारस्वत तीर्थ)-पर भक्तियोगके
verses.wordMeaning: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.
verses.commentary: Sense: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.

verses.sanskrit: प्रपद्ये शरणं रुद्रं महाग्रासं त्रिशूलिनम् । कालाग्निं योगिनामीशं भोगमोक्षफलप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: prapadye śaraṇaṃ rudraṃ mahāgrāsaṃ triśūlinam / kālāgniṃ yogināmīśaṃ bhogamokṣaphalapradam
verses.translation: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.
verses.hindi: एतत् पवित्रमतुलं तीर्थ ब्रह्मर्षिसेवितम्। द्वारा रुद्रको आराधना करने लगे। यह अतुलनीय पवित्र तीर्थ ब्रह्मर्षियांद्वारा सेवित है। इसका सेवनकर विद्वान्
verses.wordMeaning: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.
verses.commentary: Sense: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.

verses.sanskrit: प्रपद्ये त्वां विरूपाक्षं भुर्भुवः स्वः स्वरूपिणम् । हिरण्यमये गृहे गुप्तं महान्तममितौजसम्
verses.transliteration: prapadye tvāṃ virūpākṣaṃ bhurbhuvaḥ svaḥ svarūpiṇam / hiraṇyamaye gṛhe guptaṃ mahāntamamitaujasam
verses.translation: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.
verses.hindi: संसेव्य ब्राह्मणो विद्वान् मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः ॥ ७६ ॥  ब्राह्मण सभी पातकोंसे मुक्त हो जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.
verses.commentary: Sense: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.

verses.sanskrit: वैश्वानरं प्रपद्ये ऽहं सर्वभूतेष्ववस्थितम् । हव्यकव्यवहं देवं प्रपद्ये वह्निमीश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: vaiśvānaraṃ prapadye 'haṃ sarvabhūteṣvavasthitam / havyakavyavahaṃ devaṃ prapadye vahnimīśvaram
verses.translation: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपारिविभागे चतुस्त्रिंशोऽध्यायः तीर्थमाहात्म्य-प्रकरणमें विविध तीर्थांका माहात्म्य, कालञ्जर तीर्थकी महिमाके वर्णनके प्रसंगमें शिवभक्त राजा श्वेतकी कथा
verses.wordMeaning: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.
verses.commentary: Sense: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.

verses.sanskrit: प्रपद्ये तत्परं तत्त्वं वरेण्यं सवितुः स्वयम् । भर्गमग्निपरं ज्योती रक्ष मां हव्यवाहन
verses.transliteration: prapadye tatparaṃ tattvaṃ vareṇyaṃ savituḥ svayam / bhargamagniparaṃ jyotī rakṣa māṃ havyavāhana
verses.translation: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.
verses.hindi: अन्यत् पवित्रं विपुलं तीर्थ त्रैलोक्यविश्रुतम्। रुद्रकोटिरिति ख्यातं रुद्रस्य परमेष्ठिनः
verses.wordMeaning: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.
verses.commentary: Sense: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.

verses.sanskrit: इति वह्न्यष्टकं जप्त्वा रामपत्नी यशस्विनी । ध्यायन्ती मनसा तस्थौ राममुन्मीलितेक्षणा
verses.transliteration: iti vahnyaṣṭakaṃ japtvā rāmapatnī yaśasvinī / dhyāyantī manasā tasthau rāmamunmīlitekṣaṇā
verses.translation: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.
verses.hindi: पुरा पुण्यतमे काले देवदर्शनतत्पराः। कोटिब्रह्मर्षयो दान्तास्तं देशमगमन् परम् कोटिरूपोऽभवद् रुद्रो रुद्रकोटिस्ततः स्मृतः
verses.wordMeaning: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.
verses.commentary: Sense: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.

verses.sanskrit: अथावसथ्याद् भगवान् हव्यवाहो महेश्वरः । आविरासीत् सुदीप्तात्मा तेजसा प्रदहन्निव
verses.transliteration: athāvasathyād bhagavān havyavāho maheśvaraḥ / āvirāsīt sudīptātmā tejasā pradahanniva
verses.translation: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.
verses.hindi: ते स्म सर्वे महादेवं हरं गिरिगुहाशयम्।
verses.wordMeaning: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.
verses.commentary: Sense: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.

verses.sanskrit: स्वष्ट्वा मायामयीं सीतां स रावणवधेप्सया । सीतामादाय धर्मिष्ठां पावको ऽन्तरधीयत
verses.transliteration: svaṣṭvā māyāmayīṃ sītāṃ sa rāvaṇavadhepsayā / sītāmādāya dharmiṣṭhāṃ pāvako 'ntaradhīyata
verses.translation: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.
verses.hindi: अनाद्यन्तं महादेवं पूर्वमेवाहमीश्वरम्। दृष्टवानिति भक्त्या ते रुद्रन्यस्तधियोऽभवन् सूतजीने कहा--परमेष्ठी रुद्रका रुद्रकोटि नामक एक दूसरा महान् पवित्र तीर्थ है, जो तीनों लोकोंमें विख्यात है। पूर्वकालमें किसी पवित्र समयमें देव- दर्शनोंके लिये उत्सुक एक करोड़ इन्द्रियजयी ब्रह्मर्षि
verses.wordMeaning: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.
verses.commentary: Sense: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.

verses.sanskrit: तां दृष्ट्वा तादृशीं सीतां रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः । समादाय ययौ लङ्कां सागरान्तरसंस्थिताम्
verses.transliteration: tāṃ dṛṣṭvā tādṛśīṃ sītāṃ rāvaṇo rākṣaseśvaraḥ / samādāya yayau laṅkāṃ sāgarāntarasaṃsthitām
verses.translation: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.
verses.hindi: उस श्रेष्ठ स्थानपर गये। उन भक्तियुक्त महर्षियोंमें यह महान् विवाद उत्पन्न हो गया कि सबसे पहले मैं ही पिनाकी गिरिशका दर्शन करूँगा
verses.wordMeaning: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.
verses.commentary: Sense: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वाथ रावणवधं रामो लक्ष्मणसंयुतः । मसादायाभवत् सीतां शङ्काकुलितमानसः
verses.transliteration: kṛtvātha rāvaṇavadhaṃ rāmo lakṣmaṇasaṃyutaḥ / masādāyābhavat sītāṃ śaṅkākulitamānasaḥ
verses.translation: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.
verses.hindi: तब उनकी (विशेष) भक्तिको देखकर योगियोंके गुरु गिरिश रुद्र करोड़ों रूपोंमें हो गये, तभीसे वे रुद्रकोटिके नामसे स्मरण किये जाने लगे। पर्वतको गुहाके मध्य स्थित पार्वतीनाथ उन महादेव हरका दर्शनकर वे सभी हृष्ट-पुष्ट बुद्धिवाले हो गये। और मैंने ही सबसे पहले अनादि-अनन्त महादेव ईश्वरका दर्शन किया है, इस प्रकार समझकर वे भक्तिभावपूर्वक रुद्रपरायण बुद्धिवाले हो गये। तदनन्तर परम पदकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाले उन
verses.wordMeaning: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.
verses.commentary: Sense: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.

verses.sanskrit: सा प्रत्ययाय भूतानां सीता मायामीय पुनः । विवेश पावकं दीप्तं ददाह ज्वलनो ऽपि ताम्

verses.translation: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.
verses.hindi: सभीने वहीं अन्तरिक्षमें महान्-से-महान् विशुद्ध ज्योतिका दर्शन किया। यह देश (रुद्रद्वारा) निवास किया हुआ पुण्यतम शुभ तीर्थ है। यहाँ रुद्रका दर्शनकर और उनकी सम्यक् आराधना कर रुद्रका सामीप्य (सामीप्य नामक
verses.wordMeaning: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.
verses.commentary: Sense: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.

verses.sanskrit: दग्ध्वा मायामयीं सीतां भगवानुग्रदीधितिः । रामायादर्शयत् सीतां पावको ऽभूत् सुरप्रियः
verses.transliteration: dagdhvā māyāmayīṃ sītāṃ bhagavānugradīdhitiḥ / rāmāyādarśayat sītāṃ pāvako 'bhūt surapriyaḥ
verses.translation: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.
verses.hindi: मोक्ष) प्रात होता है एक दूसरा श्रेष्ठ तीर्थ है जो मधुवन नामसे कहा जाता है, नियमपूर्वक वहाँ जानेवाला (निवास करनेवाला) इन्द्रका अर्धासन प्राप्त करता है। एक अन्य पुष्पनगरी नामक देश पुण्यतम तथा शुभ है । वहाँ जाकर पितरोंकी
verses.wordMeaning: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.
verses.commentary: Sense: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.

verses.sanskrit: प्रगृह्य भर्तुश्चरणौ कराभ्यां सा सुमध्यमा । चकार प्रणतिं भूमौ रामाय जनकात्मजा
verses.transliteration: pragṛhya bhartuścaraṇau karābhyāṃ sā sumadhyamā / cakāra praṇatiṃ bhūmau rāmāya janakātmajā
verses.translation: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.
verses.hindi: पूजा करनेसे व्यक्ति सौ कुलोंको तार देता है
verses.wordMeaning: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.
verses.commentary: Sense: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा हृष्टमना रामो विस्मयाकुललोचनः । ननाम वह्निं सिरसा तोषयामास राघवः
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā hṛṣṭamanā rāmo vismayākulalocanaḥ / nanāma vahniṃ sirasā toṣayāmāsa rāghavaḥ
verses.translation: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.
verses.hindi: कालञ्जरं महातीर्थं लोके रुद्रो महेश्वरः। कालं जरितवान् देवो यत्र भक्तप्रियो हरः श्वेतो नाम शिवे भक्तो राजर्षिप्रवरः पुरा। तदाशीस्तन्नमस्कारः पूजयामास शूलिनम्
verses.wordMeaning: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.
verses.commentary: Sense: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.

verses.sanskrit: उवाच वह्नेर्भगवान् किमेषा वरवर्णिनी । दग्धा भगवता पूर्वं दृष्टा मत्पार्श्वमागता
verses.transliteration: uvāca vahnerbhagavān kimeṣā varavarṇinī / dagdhā bhagavatā pūrvaṃ dṛṣṭā matpārśvamāgatā
verses.translation: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.
verses.hindi: स तं कालोऽथ दीप्तात्मा शूलमादाय भीषणम्। नेतुमभ्यागतो देशं स राजा यत्र तिष्ठति ९४॥ वीक्ष्य राजा भयाविष्टः शूलहस्तं समागतम्। कालं कालकरं घोरं भीषणं चण्डदीधितिम्
verses.wordMeaning: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.
verses.commentary: Sense: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.

verses.sanskrit: तमाह देवो लोकानां दाहको हव्यवाहनः । यथावृत्तं दाशरथिं भूतानामेव सन्निधौ
verses.transliteration: tamāha devo lokānāṃ dāhako havyavāhanaḥ / yathāvṛttaṃ dāśarathiṃ bhūtānāmeva sannidhau
verses.translation: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.
verses.hindi: जपन्तमाह राजानं नमन्तमसकृद् भवम्। तमुवाच भयाविष्टो राजा रुद्रपरायणः। एकमीशार्चनरतं विहायान्यं निषूदय
verses.wordMeaning: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.
verses.commentary: Sense: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.

verses.sanskrit: इयं सा मिथिलेशेन पार्वतीं रुद्रवल्लभाम् । आराध्य लब्धा तपसा देव्याश्चात्यन्तवल्लभा
verses.transliteration: iyaṃ sā mithileśena pārvatīṃ rudravallabhām / ārādhya labdhā tapasā devyāścātyantavallabhā
verses.translation: This chaste lady of good conduct is endowed with the readiness to serve her husband like Bhavani in regard to Isvara. She was protected by me because she was desired by Ravana.
verses.hindi: इत्युक्तवन्तं भगवानब्रवीद भीतमानसम्। रद्रार्चनरतो वान्यो मद्वशे को न तिष्ठति
