verses.wordMeaning: On knowing that Rudra had come, he danced due to ecstatic delight. Lord Rudra spoke to him—"Why did you dance?"
verses.commentary: Sense: On knowing that Rudra had come, he danced due to ecstatic delight. Lord Rudra spoke to him—"Why did you dance?"

verses.sanskrit: एको ऽहं भगवान् कलो ह्यनादिश्चान्तकृद् विभुः । समास्थाय परं भावं प्रोक्तो रुद्रो मनीषिभिः
verses.transliteration: eko 'haṃ bhagavān kalo hyanādiścāntakṛd vibhuḥ / samāsthāya paraṃ bhāvaṃ prokto rudro manīṣibhiḥ
verses.translation: On knowing that Rudra had come, he danced due to ecstatic delight. Lord Rudra spoke to him—"Why did you dance?"
verses.hindi: देवदारुवनं पुण्यं सिद्धगन्धर्वसेवरितम्। महादेवेन देवेन तत्र दत्तं महद् वरम्
verses.wordMeaning: On knowing that Rudra had come, he danced due to ecstatic delight. Lord Rudra spoke to him—"Why did you dance?"
verses.commentary: Sense: On knowing that Rudra had come, he danced due to ecstatic delight. Lord Rudra spoke to him—"Why did you dance?"

verses.sanskrit: मम वै सापरा शक्तिर्देवी विद्येति विश्रुता । दृष्टा हि भवता नूनं विद्यादेहस्त्वहं ततः
verses.transliteration: mama vai sāparā śaktirdevī vidyeti viśrutā / dṛṣṭā hi bhavatā nūnaṃ vidyādehastvahaṃ tataḥ
verses.translation: On knowing that Rudra had come, he danced due to ecstatic delight. Lord Rudra spoke to him—"Why did you dance?"
verses.hindi: प्रसन्नो भगवानीशो मुनीन्द्रान् प्राह भावितान् येऽत्र मामर्चयन्तीह लोके धर्मपरा जना: । तेषां ददामि परमं गाणपत्यं हि शाश्वतम्
verses.wordMeaning: On knowing that Rudra had come, he danced due to ecstatic delight. Lord Rudra spoke to him—"Why did you dance?"
verses.commentary: Sense: On knowing that Rudra had come, he danced due to ecstatic delight. Lord Rudra spoke to him—"Why did you dance?"

verses.sanskrit: एवमेतानि तत्त्वानि प्रधानपुरुषेश्वराः । विष्णुर्ब्रह्मा च भगवान् रुद्रः काल इति श्रुतिः
verses.transliteration: evametāni tattvāni pradhānapuruṣeśvarāḥ / viṣṇurbrahmā ca bhagavān rudraḥ kāla iti śrutiḥ
verses.translation: On knowing that Rudra had come, he danced due to ecstatic delight. Lord Rudra spoke to him—"Why did you dance?"
verses.hindi: अत्र नित्यं वसिष्यामि सह नारायणेन च। प्राणानिह नरस्त्यक्त्वा न भूयो जन्म विन्दति
verses.wordMeaning: On knowing that Rudra had come, he danced due to ecstatic delight. Lord Rudra spoke to him—"Why did you dance?"
verses.commentary: Sense: On knowing that Rudra had come, he danced due to ecstatic delight. Lord Rudra spoke to him—"Why did you dance?"

verses.sanskrit: त्रयमेतदनाद्यन्तं ब्रह्मण्येव व्यवस्थितम् । तदात्मकं तदव्यक्तं तदक्षरमिति श्रुतिः
verses.transliteration: trayametadanādyantaṃ brahmaṇyeva vyavasthitam / tadātmakaṃ tadavyaktaṃ tadakṣaramiti śrutiḥ
verses.translation: On knowing that Rudra had come, he danced due to ecstatic delight. Lord Rudra spoke to him—"Why did you dance?"
verses.hindi: तेषां च सर्वपापानि नाशयामि द्विजोत्तमाः देवदारुवनं पुण्यं महादेवनिषेवितम्
verses.wordMeaning: On knowing that Rudra had come, he danced due to ecstatic delight. Lord Rudra spoke to him—"Why did you dance?"
verses.commentary: Sense: On knowing that Rudra had come, he danced due to ecstatic delight. Lord Rudra spoke to him—"Why did you dance?"

verses.sanskrit: आत्मानन्दपरं तत्त्वं चिन्मात्रं परमं पदम् । आकाशं निष्कलं ब्रह्म तस्मादन्यन्न विद्यते
verses.transliteration: ātmānandaparaṃ tattvaṃ cinmātraṃ paramaṃ padam / ākāśaṃ niṣkalaṃ brahma tasmādanyanna vidyate
verses.translation: On knowing that Rudra had come, he danced due to ecstatic delight. Lord Rudra spoke to him—"Why did you dance?"
verses.hindi: यत्रेश्वरो महादेवो विष्णुर्वा पुरुषोत्तमः । तत्र संनिहिता गङ्गा तीर्थान्यायतनानि च
verses.wordMeaning: On knowing that Rudra had come, he danced due to ecstatic delight. Lord Rudra spoke to him—"Why did you dance?"
verses.commentary: Sense: On knowing that Rudra had come, he danced due to ecstatic delight. Lord Rudra spoke to him—"Why did you dance?"

verses.sanskrit: एवं विज्ञाय भवता भक्तियोगाश्रयेण तु । संपूज्यो वन्दनीयो ऽहं ततस्तं पश्य शाश्वतम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ vijñāya bhavatā bhaktiyogāśrayeṇa tu / saṃpūjyo vandanīyo 'haṃ tatastaṃ paśya śāśvatam
verses.translation: On knowing that Rudra had come, he danced due to ecstatic delight. Lord Rudra spoke to him—"Why did you dance?"
verses.hindi: हिमालय तथा गङ्गा सर्वत्र ही पवित्र हैं। समुद्रमें जानेवाली नदियाँ तथा विशेषरूपसे समुद्र पवित्र हैं बदर्याश्रममें पहुँचकर मनुष्य कलिके पापसे मुक्त हो जाता है। वहाँपर सनातन नारायणदेव नरके साथ विराजमान रहते हैं। वहाँ विधिपूर्वक किया गया दान तथा जप अक्षय हो जाता है। वह पवित्र तीर्थ महादेवको
verses.wordMeaning: On knowing that Rudra had come, he danced due to ecstatic delight. Lord Rudra spoke to him—"Why did you dance?"
verses.commentary: Sense: On knowing that Rudra had come, he danced due to ecstatic delight. Lord Rudra spoke to him—"Why did you dance?"

verses.sanskrit: एतावदुक्त्वा भगवाञ्जगामादर्शनं हरः । तत्रैव भक्तियोगेन रुद्रामाराधयन्मुनिः
verses.transliteration: etāvaduktvā bhagavāñjagāmādarśanaṃ haraḥ / tatraiva bhaktiyogena rudrāmārādhayanmuniḥ
verses.translation: On knowing that Rudra had come, he danced due to ecstatic delight. Lord Rudra spoke to him—"Why did you dance?"
verses.hindi: विशेषरूपसे प्रिय है। वहाँ समाहित मनसे श्राद्ध करके मनुष्य अपने सभी पितरोंको मुक्त कर देता है
verses.wordMeaning: On knowing that Rudra had come, he danced due to ecstatic delight. Lord Rudra spoke to him—"Why did you dance?"
verses.commentary: Sense: On knowing that Rudra had come, he danced due to ecstatic delight. Lord Rudra spoke to him—"Why did you dance?"

verses.sanskrit: एतत् पवित्रमतुलं तीर्थं ब्रह्मर्षिसेवितम् । संसेव्य ब्राह्मणो विद्वान् मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः
verses.transliteration: etat pavitramatulaṃ tīrthaṃ brahmarṣisevitam / saṃsevya brāhmaṇo vidvān mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ
verses.translation: On knowing that Rudra had come, he danced due to ecstatic delight. Lord Rudra spoke to him—"Why did you dance?"
verses.hindi: सिद्ध तथा गन्धर्वोसे सेवित पवित्र देवदास-वन नामक एक तीर्थ है। देव महादेवने वहाँ महान् वर प्रदान किया था। सभी मुनियोंको मोहित करनेके अनन्तर पुनः उनके द्वारा भलीभाँति पूजित होनेपर प्रसन्न होकर भगवान् शंकरने भक्तहृदय उन मुनियोंसे कहा-- इस रमणीय तथा श्रेष्ठ आश्रममें आप लोग मेरी भक्तिसे संयुक्त होकर सदा निवास करें, इससे आप लोगोंको
verses.wordMeaning: On knowing that Rudra had come, he danced due to ecstatic delight. Lord Rudra spoke to him—"Why did you dance?"
verses.commentary: Sense: On knowing that Rudra had come, he danced due to ecstatic delight. Lord Rudra spoke to him—"Why did you dance?"

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे चतुस्त्रिंशो ऽध्यायः सूत उवाच अन्यत् पवित्रं विपुलं तीर्थं त्रैलोक्यविश्रुतम् । रुद्रकोटिरिति ख्यातं रुद्रस्य परमेष्ठिनः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge catustriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca anyat pavitraṃ vipulaṃ tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam / rudrakoṭiriti khyātaṃ rudrasya parameṣṭhinaḥ
verses.translation: "O leading sage, this is the greatness of penance, there is also another person like you, wherefore did you dance?
verses.hindi: इस लोकमें धर्मपरायण जो लोग यहाँ मेरी पूजा करते हैं, उन्हें में श्रेष्ठ शाश्वत गाणपत्य-पद प्रदान करता हूँ। में यहाँ नारायणके साथ नित्य निवास करता हूँ। जो मनुष्य यहाँ प्राणोंका परित्याग करता है, वह पुनर्जन्म
verses.wordMeaning: "O leading sage, this is the greatness of penance, there is also another person like you, wherefore did you dance?
verses.commentary: Sense: "O leading sage, this is the greatness of penance, there is also another person like you, wherefore did you dance?

verses.sanskrit: पुरा पुण्यतमे काले देवदर्शनतत्पराः । कोटिब्रह्मर्षयो दान्तास्तं देशमगमन् परम्
verses.transliteration: purā puṇyatame kāle devadarśanatatparāḥ / koṭibrahmarṣayo dāntāstaṃ deśamagaman param
verses.translation: On seeing the lord of the Universe smiling and standing there resplendently, the heart of the leading sage became agitated due to fright and he trembled.
verses.hindi: नहीं प्राप्त करता हे द्विजोत्तमो! दूसरे देशोंमें गये हुए जो लोग इस तीर्थका स्मरण करते हैं, उनके सभी पापोंको में नष्ट कर देता हूँ। यहाँ किया हुआ श्राद्ध, दान, तप, होम, पिण्डदान, ध्यान, जप तथा नियम सर्वदाके लिये अक्षय
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing the lord of the Universe smiling and standing there resplendently, the heart of the leading sage became agitated due to fright and he trembled.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the lord of the Universe smiling and standing there resplendently, the heart of the leading sage became agitated due to fright and he trembled.

verses.sanskrit: अहं द्रक्ष्यामि गिरिशं पूर्वमेव पिनाकिनम् । अन्यो ऽन्यं भक्तियुक्तानां व्याघातो जायते किल
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ drakṣyāmi giriśaṃ pūrvameva pinākinam / anyo 'nyaṃ bhaktiyuktānāṃ vyāghāto jāyate kila
verses.translation: He bent down his head before Rudra and with self- control he repeated the verses of Rudradhyaya. The three-eyed lord Isa, favourably disposed towards his devotees, became delighted.
verses.hindi: हो जाता है। इसलिये द्विजातियोंको महादेवद्दारा सेवित पुण्य देवदारु-वनका सभी प्रयत्नोंद्ारा दर्शन (सेवन) करना चाहिए। जहाँ ईश्वर महादेव अथवा पुरुषोत्तम विष्णु रहते हैं, वहाँ गङ्गा, सभी तीर्थ तथा सभी
verses.wordMeaning: He bent down his head before Rudra and with self- control he repeated the verses of Rudradhyaya. The three-eyed lord Isa, favourably disposed towards his devotees, became delighted.
verses.commentary: Sense: He bent down his head before Rudra and with self- control he repeated the verses of Rudradhyaya. The three-eyed lord Isa, favourably disposed towards his devotees, became delighted.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां भक्तिं तदा दृष्ट्वा गिरिशो योगिनां गुरुः । कोटिरूपो ऽभवद् रुद्रो रुद्रकोटिस्ततः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ bhaktiṃ tadā dṛṣṭvā giriśo yogināṃ guruḥ / koṭirūpo 'bhavad rudro rudrakoṭistataḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: The great Lord, the fire (the destroyer) of the three cities, explained to him (Mahkanaka) his own (path of) Yoga and about the goddess:
verses.hindi: मन्दिरोंकी स्थिति होती है॥५४--५७॥ इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहर्रथां संहितायामुपरिविभागे वट्त्रिंशोऽध्यायः
verses.wordMeaning: The great Lord, the fire (the destroyer) of the three cities, explained to him (Mahkanaka) his own (path of) Yoga and about the goddess:
verses.commentary: Sense: The great Lord, the fire (the destroyer) of the three cities, explained to him (Mahkanaka) his own (path of) Yoga and about the goddess:

verses.sanskrit: ते स्म सर्वे महादेवं हरं गिरिगुहाशयम् । पश्यन्तः पार्वतीनाथं हृष्टपुष्टधियो ऽभवन्
verses.transliteration: te sma sarve mahādevaṃ haraṃ giriguhāśayam / paśyantaḥ pārvatīnāthaṃ hṛṣṭapuṣṭadhiyo 'bhavan
verses.translation: I am the scorcher of all bonds. I am Kala (Time, Death), Kara and the cause of Kala. Everything consisting of the sentient and the non-sentient is urged by myself.
verses.hindi: ४४६  कूर्मपुराण
verses.wordMeaning: I am the scorcher of all bonds. I am Kala (Time, Death), Kara and the cause of Kala. Everything consisting of the sentient and the non-sentient is urged by myself.
verses.commentary: Sense: I am the scorcher of all bonds. I am Kala (Time, Death), Kara and the cause of Kala. Everything consisting of the sentient and the non-sentient is urged by myself.

verses.sanskrit: अनाद्यन्तं महादेवं पूर्वमेवाहमीश्वरम् । दृष्टवानिति भक्त्या ते रुद्रन्यस्तधियो ऽभवन्
verses.transliteration: anādyantaṃ mahādevaṃ pūrvamevāhamīśvaram / dṛṣṭavāniti bhaktyā te rudranyastadhiyo 'bhavan
verses.translation: I am that Person (soul) who is immanent in all and I am verily the Supreme Person. The deluding Potency (Greatest Maya) is the Prakrti consisting of the three Gunas.
verses.hindi: देवदारु-वनमें स्थित मुनियोंका वृत्तान्त एवं शिवलिड्रका पतन, मुनियोंको ब्रह्माका उपदेश, शिवको प्रसन्न करने-हेतु ऋषियोंद्वारा तपस्या तथा स्तुति, शिवद्वारा सांख्यका उपदेश कथं दारुवनं प्राप्तो भगवान् गोवृषध्वजः । मोहयामास विप्रेन्द्रान् सूत वक्तुमिहाईसि
verses.wordMeaning: I am that Person (soul) who is immanent in all and I am verily the Supreme Person. The deluding Potency (Greatest Maya) is the Prakrti consisting of the three Gunas.
verses.commentary: Sense: I am that Person (soul) who is immanent in all and I am verily the Supreme Person. The deluding Potency (Greatest Maya) is the Prakrti consisting of the three Gunas.

verses.sanskrit: अथान्तरिक्षे विमलं पश्यन्ति स्म महत्तरम् । ज्योतिस्तत्रैव ते सर्वे ऽभिलषन्तः परं पदम्
verses.transliteration: athāntarikṣe vimalaṃ paśyanti sma mahattaram / jyotistatraiva te sarve 'bhilaṣantaḥ paraṃ padam
verses.translation: She is described by the sages as Sakti (Potency), the eternal source of origin of the universe. The creator of the universe enchants the universe by means of the Maya.
verses.hindi: पुरा दारुवने रम्ये देवसिद्धनिषेविते। सपुत्रदारा मुनयस्तपश्चेरुः सहस्त्रशः
verses.wordMeaning: She is described by the sages as Sakti (Potency), the eternal source of origin of the universe. The creator of the universe enchants the universe by means of the Maya.
verses.commentary: Sense: She is described by the sages as Sakti (Potency), the eternal source of origin of the universe. The creator of the universe enchants the universe by means of the Maya.

verses.sanskrit: एतत् सदेशाध्युषितं तीर्थं पुण्यतमं शुभम् । दृष्ट्वा रुद्रं समभ्यर्च्य रुद्रसामीप्यमाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: etat sadeśādhyuṣitaṃ tīrthaṃ puṇyatamaṃ śubham / dṛṣṭvā rudraṃ samabhyarcya rudrasāmīpyamāpnuyāt
verses.translation: The Sruti states that the Supreme, unmanifest Narayana is of the form of Maya. In this way, I always establish the entire world.
verses.hindi: प्रवृत्तं विविधं कर्म प्रकुर्वाणा यथाविधि। यजन्ति विविधेर्यज्ञैस्तपन्ति च महर्षयः कृत्वा विश्वगुरुं विष्णुं पार्श्वे देवो महेश्वरः । ययौ निवृत्तिविज्ञानस्थापनार्थ च शंकरः
verses.wordMeaning: The Sruti states that the Supreme, unmanifest Narayana is of the form of Maya. In this way, I always establish the entire world.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Sruti states that the Supreme, unmanifest Narayana is of the form of Maya. In this way, I always establish the entire world.

verses.sanskrit: अन्यच्च तीर्थप्रवरं नाम्ना मधुवनं स्मृतम् । तत्र गत्वा नियमवानिन्द्रस्यार्धासनं लभेत्
verses.transliteration: anyacca tīrthapravaraṃ nāmnā madhuvanaṃ smṛtam / tatra gatvā niyamavānindrasyārdhāsanaṃ labhet
verses.translation: This creatorship of the great Atman has been clearly narrated to you. I am the sole lord, beginningless, the primordial Kala. the all-pervading lord, the destroyer (of the Universe).
verses.hindi: चामीकरवपुः श्रीमान् पूर्णचन्द्रनिभाननः। मत्तमातङ्गगमनो दिग्वासा जगदीश्वरः
verses.wordMeaning: This creatorship of the great Atman has been clearly narrated to you. I am the sole lord, beginningless, the primordial Kala. the all-pervading lord, the destroyer (of the Universe).
verses.commentary: Sense: This creatorship of the great Atman has been clearly narrated to you. I am the sole lord, beginningless, the primordial Kala. the all-pervading lord, the destroyer (of the Universe).

verses.sanskrit: अथान्यत्पुष्पनगरी देशः पुण्यतमः शुभः । तत्र गत्वा पितॄन् पूज्य कुलानां तारयेच्छतम्
verses.transliteration: athānyatpuṣpanagarī deśaḥ puṇyatamaḥ śubhaḥ / tatra gatvā pitṝn pūjya kulānāṃ tārayecchatam
verses.translation: (While creating and destroying) I assume the greatest form. I am mentioned as Rudra by the learned men. That supreme Potency (Para Sakti), well-known as goddess Vidya, belongs to me alone.
verses.hindi: दधानो भगवानीशः समागच्छति सस्मितः योऽनन्तः पुरुषो योनिर्लोकानामव्ययो हरिः। ्त्रीवेषं विष्णुरास्थाय सोऽनुगच्छति शूलिनम्
verses.wordMeaning: (While creating and destroying) I assume the greatest form. I am mentioned as Rudra by the learned men. That supreme Potency (Para Sakti), well-known as goddess Vidya, belongs to me alone.
verses.commentary: Sense: (While creating and destroying) I assume the greatest form. I am mentioned as Rudra by the learned men. That supreme Potency (Para Sakti), well-known as goddess Vidya, belongs to me alone.

verses.sanskrit: कालञ्जरं महातीर्थं लोके रुद्रो महेश्वरः । कालं जरितवान् देवो यत्र भक्तिप्रियो हरः
verses.transliteration: kālañjaraṃ mahātīrthaṃ loke rudro maheśvaraḥ / kālaṃ jaritavān devo yatra bhaktipriyo haraḥ
verses.translation: The person of Vidya has indeed been visualised by you. So also these principles the Pradhana, the Purusa and Isvara.
verses.hindi: ऋषियोंने कहा--सूतजी! इस समय आप यह बतलायें कि भगवान् गोवृषध्वजने दारुवनमें आकर श्रेष्ठ ब्राह्मणोंको क्यों मोहित किया ?
verses.wordMeaning: The person of Vidya has indeed been visualised by you. So also these principles the Pradhana, the Purusa and Isvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: The person of Vidya has indeed been visualised by you. So also these principles the Pradhana, the Purusa and Isvara.

verses.sanskrit: श्वेतो नाम शिवे भक्तो राजर्षिप्रवरः पुरा । तदाशीस्तन्नमस्कारः पूजयामास शूलिनम्
verses.transliteration: śveto nāma śive bhakto rājarṣipravaraḥ purā / tadāśīstannamaskāraḥ pūjayāmāsa śūlinam
verses.translation: The Sruti says; Visnu, Brahma and lord Rudra (are) Kala (?). These three deities are beginningless and end¬ less. They are stabilised in the Brahman alone.
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले--प्राचीन कालमें देवताओं तथा सिद्धोंसे सेवित रमणीय दारुवनमें हजारों मुनिजन अपने पुत्रों तथा अपनी स््त्रियोंके साथ तपस्या करते थे। विविध कर्मोमें प्रवृत्त होते हुए तथा यथाविधि उन्हें सम्पन्न करते हुए वे महर्षिगण विविध यज्ञोंसे यजन तथा तप करते थे
verses.wordMeaning: The Sruti says; Visnu, Brahma and lord Rudra (are) Kala (?). These three deities are beginningless and end¬ less. They are stabilised in the Brahman alone.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Sruti says; Visnu, Brahma and lord Rudra (are) Kala (?). These three deities are beginningless and end¬ less. They are stabilised in the Brahman alone.

verses.sanskrit: संस्थाप्य विधिना लिङ्गं भक्तियोगपुरः सरः । जजाप रुद्रमनिशं तत्र संन्यस्तमानसः
verses.transliteration: saṃsthāpya vidhinā liṅgaṃ bhaktiyogapuraḥ saraḥ / jajāpa rudramaniśaṃ tatra saṃnyastamānasaḥ
verses.translation: The Sruti says that it is unmanifest, imperishable and everything has that as its soul. The great principle is Atman and Bliss. It is consciousness alone, the greatest region.
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर त्रिशूल धारण करनेवाले वे हर प्रवृत्तिमार्गमें मन लगानेवाले उन ऋषियोंके महान् दोषका वर्णन करते हुए दारुवनमें गये। महेश्वर देव शंकर निवृत्तिविज्ञानकी स्थापना करनेके लिये विश्वके गुरु विष्णुको अपने
verses.wordMeaning: The Sruti says that it is unmanifest, imperishable and everything has that as its soul. The great principle is Atman and Bliss. It is consciousness alone, the greatest region.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Sruti says that it is unmanifest, imperishable and everything has that as its soul. The great principle is Atman and Bliss. It is consciousness alone, the greatest region.

verses.sanskrit: स तं कालो ऽथ दीप्तात्मा शूलमादाय भीषणम् । नेतुमभ्यागतो देशं स राजा यत्र तिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: sa taṃ kālo 'tha dīptātmā śūlamādāya bhīṣaṇam / netumabhyāgato deśaṃ sa rājā yatra tiṣṭhati
verses.translation: The sage propitiated Rudra in that very same place by means of the path of devotion. This holy centre is un¬ equalled, sacred and resorted to by Brahmarsis. By resort¬ ing to this, a scholarly Brahmana is released from all sins.
verses.hindi: पार्श्वमें लेकर वहाँ गये। महान् बाहुवाले, पुष्ट शरीरवाले तथा सुन्दर नेत्रवाले उन्नीस वर्षके लीलायुक्त पुरुषका वेश धारणकर श्रीशंकर वहाँ गये ॥ ४--६॥ जगदीश्वर (शंकर)-का शरीर स्वर्ण-वर्णके समान तथा श्रीसम्पन्न था। उनका मुख पूर्ण चन्द्रमाके समान, उनकी गति मतवाले हाथीके समान और दिशाएँ ही उनके वस्त्रका स्थान ले रखी थीं। सभी रत्नोंसे अलंकृत
verses.wordMeaning: The sage propitiated Rudra in that very same place by means of the path of devotion. This holy centre is un¬ equalled, sacred and resorted to by Brahmarsis. By resort¬ ing to this, a scholarly Brahmana is released from all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sage propitiated Rudra in that very same place by means of the path of devotion. This holy centre is un¬ equalled, sacred and resorted to by Brahmarsis. By resort¬ ing to this, a scholarly Brahmana is released from all sins.

verses.sanskrit: वीक्ष्य राजा भयाविष्टः शूलहस्तं समागतम् । कालं कालकरं घोरं भीषणं चण्डदीधितिम्
verses.transliteration: vīkṣya rājā bhayāviṣṭaḥ śūlahastaṃ samāgatam / kālaṃ kālakaraṃ ghoraṃ bhīṣaṇaṃ caṇḍadīdhitim
verses.translation: Near Mathura, so called as it was once the haunt of demon Madhu. It is identified with present Maholi five miles to the south-west of Mathura.
verses.hindi: कमलोंकी माला धारण किये हुए भगवान् ईश मुसकराते हुए आ रहे थे
verses.wordMeaning: Near Mathura, so called as it was once the haunt of demon Madhu. It is identified with present Maholi five miles to the south-west of Mathura.
verses.commentary: Sense: Near Mathura, so called as it was once the haunt of demon Madhu. It is identified with present Maholi five miles to the south-west of Mathura.

verses.sanskrit: उबाभ्यामथ हस्ताभ्यां स्पृट्वासौ लिङ्गमैश्वरम् । ननाम शिरसा रुद्रं जजाप शतरुद्रियम्
verses.transliteration: ubābhyāmatha hastābhyāṃ spṛṭvāsau liṅgamaiśvaram / nanāma śirasā rudraṃ jajāpa śatarudriyam
verses.translation: A hill and a fort in Bundelkhand, the capital of Chandellas. If the temple of Kala Bhairava in the fort be related to the story of King §veta given here, this identification is probable. Kane includes this Tirtha under Varanasi (HD IV. 766) The story of Sveta is narrated i n LP. chs, I. 30-34 but he is a sage there.
verses.hindi: जो सभी लोकोंके उत्पत्ति-स्थान, अनन्त अव्यय पुरुष हरि विष्णु हैं, वे स्त्री-वेष धारणकर शूली शंकरका अनुगमन कर रहे थे। उनका मुख पूर्णिमाके चन्द्रके तुल्य था। पयोधर पीन और उन्नत थे। पवित्र मुसकान थी और वे (विष्णु) अत्यन्त प्रसन्न थे। दोनों चरणोंसे नूपुरकी ध्वनि हो रही थी, सुन्दर पीताम्बर उन्होंने धारण कर रखा था। दिव्य श्यामल शरीर था। नेत्र अत्यन्त सुन्दर थे। हंसके समान उदार गति थी।
verses.wordMeaning: A hill and a fort in Bundelkhand, the capital of Chandellas. If the temple of Kala Bhairava in the fort be related to the story of King §veta given here, this identification is probable. Kane includes this Tirtha under Varanasi (HD IV.…
verses.commentary: Sense: A hill and a fort in Bundelkhand, the capital of Chandellas. If the temple of Kala Bhairava in the fort be related to the story of King §veta given here, this identification is probable. Kane includes this Tirtha under Varanasi (HD IV.…

verses.sanskrit: जपन्तमाह राजानं नमन्तमसकृद् भवम् । एह्येहीति पुरः स्थित्वा कृतान्तः प्रहसन्निव
verses.transliteration: japantamāha rājānaṃ namantamasakṛd bhavam / ehyehīti puraḥ sthitvā kṛtāntaḥ prahasanniva
verses.translation: "I will see the Pinaka-bearing lord Girisa at first" (Thus they vied with one another). A great dispute arose thus among them who were endowed with devotion.
verses.hindi: भगवान् विष्णु विलासमय एवं अति मनोहारी रूप धारण कर रखे थे
verses.wordMeaning: "I will see the Pinaka-bearing lord Girisa at first" (Thus they vied with one another). A great dispute arose thus among them who were endowed with devotion.
verses.commentary: Sense: "I will see the Pinaka-bearing lord Girisa at first" (Thus they vied with one another). A great dispute arose thus among them who were endowed with devotion.

verses.sanskrit: तमुवाच भयाविष्टो राजा रुद्रपरायणः । एकमीशार्चनरतं विहायान्यं निषूदय
verses.transliteration: tamuvāca bhayāviṣṭo rājā rudraparāyaṇaḥ / ekamīśārcanarataṃ vihāyānyaṃ niṣūdaya
verses.translation: On seeing their devotion, Rudra, the Lord of moun¬ tain, the preceptor of Yogins, assumed a crore forms. Thus he became Rudrakoti (A crore of Rudras).
verses.hindi: एवं स भगवानीशो देवदारुबने हरः। चचार हरिणा भिक्षां मायया मोहयन् जगत् मायया मोहिता नार्यो देवदेवं समन्वयुः
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing their devotion, Rudra, the Lord of moun¬ tain, the preceptor of Yogins, assumed a crore forms. Thus he became Rudrakoti (A crore of Rudras).
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing their devotion, Rudra, the Lord of moun¬ tain, the preceptor of Yogins, assumed a crore forms. Thus he became Rudrakoti (A crore of Rudras).

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्तवन्तं भगवानब्रवीद् भीतमानसम् । रुद्रार्चनरतो वान्यो मद्वशे को न तिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: ityuktavantaṃ bhagavānabravīd bhītamānasam / rudrārcanarato vānyo madvaśe ko na tiṣṭhati
verses.translation: All of them saw the consort of Parvati, the great god Kara, resident in the mountain cavity. They became delighted and well-nourished in their minds.
verses.hindi: सहेव तेन कामार्ता विलासिन्यश्चरन्ति हि
verses.wordMeaning: All of them saw the consort of Parvati, the great god Kara, resident in the mountain cavity. They became delighted and well-nourished in their minds.
verses.commentary: Sense: All of them saw the consort of Parvati, the great god Kara, resident in the mountain cavity. They became delighted and well-nourished in their minds.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा स राजानं कालो लोकप्रकालनः । बबन्ध पाशै राजापि जजाप शतरुद्रियम्
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā sa rājānaṃ kālo lokaprakālanaḥ / babandha pāśai rājāpi jajāpa śatarudriyam
verses.translation: With the devotional feeling: "O I have seen at the outset the Lord, the great god devoid of beginning and end" all of them dedicated their minds unto Rudra with devotion.
verses.hindi: ऋषीणां पुत्रका ये स्युर्युवानो जितमानसा: । अन्वगच्छन् हृषीकेशं सर्वे कामप्रपीडिताः दृष्टा सपत्नीकमतीवकान्त-
verses.wordMeaning: With the devotional feeling: "O I have seen at the outset the Lord, the great god devoid of beginning and end" all of them dedicated their minds unto Rudra with devotion.
verses.commentary: Sense: With the devotional feeling: "O I have seen at the outset the Lord, the great god devoid of beginning and end" all of them dedicated their minds unto Rudra with devotion.

verses.sanskrit: अथान्तरिक्षे विमलं दीप्यमानं तेजोराशिं भूतभर्तुः पुराणम् । ज्वालामालासंवृतं व्याप्य विश्वं प्रादुर्भूतं संस्थितं संददर्श
verses.transliteration: athāntarikṣe vimalaṃ dīpyamānaṃ tejorāśiṃ bhūtabhartuḥ purāṇam / jvālāmālāsaṃvṛtaṃ vyāpya viśvaṃ prādurbhūtaṃ saṃsthitaṃ saṃdadarśa
verses.translation: Then they saw a mass of brilliance in the firmament. They were desirous of attaining the greatest region.
verses.hindi: आलोक्य पद्यापतिमादिदेवं
verses.wordMeaning: Then they saw a mass of brilliance in the firmament. They were desirous of attaining the greatest region.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then they saw a mass of brilliance in the firmament. They were desirous of attaining the greatest region.

verses.sanskrit: तन्मध्ये ऽसौ पुरुषं रुक्मवर्णं देव्या देवं चन्द्रलेखोज्ज्वलाङ्गम् । तेजोरूपं पश्यति स्मातिहृष्टो मेने चास्मन्नाथ आगच्छतीति
verses.transliteration: tanmadhye 'sau puruṣaṃ rukmavarṇaṃ devyā devaṃ candralekhojjvalāṅgam / tejorūpaṃ paśyati smātihṛṣṭo mene cāsmannātha āgacchatīti
verses.translation: Where the lord thus revealed himself and stayed, it is considered to be an auspicious and very holy centre. After visiting this and worshipping the Rudra the devotees shall attain the Samipya (nearness) of Rudra.
verses.hindi: आसामथैषामपि वासुदेवो करोति भोगान् मनसि प्रवृत्तिं
verses.wordMeaning: Where the lord thus revealed himself and stayed, it is considered to be an auspicious and very holy centre. After visiting this and worshipping the Rudra the devotees shall attain the Samipya (nearness) of Rudra.
verses.commentary: Sense: Where the lord thus revealed himself and stayed, it is considered to be an auspicious and very holy centre. After visiting this and worshipping the Rudra the devotees shall attain the Samipya (nearness) of Rudra.

verses.sanskrit: आगच्छन्तं नातिदूरे ऽथ दृष्ट्वा कालो रुद्रं देवदेव्या महेशम् । व्यपेतभीरखिलेशैकनाथं राजर्षिस्तं नेतुमभ्याजगाम
verses.transliteration: āgacchantaṃ nātidūre 'tha dṛṣṭvā kālo rudraṃ devadevyā maheśam / vyapetabhīrakhileśaikanāthaṃ rājarṣistaṃ netumabhyājagāma
verses.translation: There is another auspicious and excellent Tirtha by the name of Madhuvana. A person who observes rules and regulations after going there, shall attain half the throne of Indra.
verses.hindi: यथैकशक्त्या सह देवदेवः
verses.wordMeaning: There is another auspicious and excellent Tirtha by the name of Madhuvana. A person who observes rules and regulations after going there, shall attain half the throne of Indra.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is another auspicious and excellent Tirtha by the name of Madhuvana. A person who observes rules and regulations after going there, shall attain half the throne of Indra.

verses.sanskrit: आलोक्यासौ भगवानुग्रकर्मा देवो रुद्रो भूतभर्ता पुराणः । एकं भक्तं मत्परं मां स्मरन्तं देहीतीमं कालमूचे ममेति
verses.transliteration: ālokyāsau bhagavānugrakarmā devo rudro bhūtabhartā purāṇaḥ / ekaṃ bhaktaṃ matparaṃ māṃ smarantaṃ dehītīmaṃ kālamūce mameti
verses.translation: There is another city named Padmanagari. The land is auspicious and highly meritorious..A.fter going there and worshipping the Pitrs, one will redeem a hundred members of his family.
verses.hindi: करोति नृत्यं परमप्रभावं तदीशवृत्तामृतमादिदेवः
verses.wordMeaning: There is another city named Padmanagari. The land is auspicious and highly meritorious..A.fter going there and worshipping the Pitrs, one will redeem a hundred members of his family.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is another city named Padmanagari. The land is auspicious and highly meritorious..A.fter going there and worshipping the Pitrs, one will redeem a hundred members of his family.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा वाख्यं गोपतेरुग्रभावः कालात्मासौ मन्यमानः स्वभावम् । बद्ध्वा भक्तं पुनरेवाथ पाशैः क्रुद्धो रुद्रमभिदुद्राव वेगात्
verses.transliteration: śrutvā vākhyaṃ gopaterugrabhāvaḥ kālātmāsau manyamānaḥ svabhāvam / baddhvā bhaktaṃ punarevātha pāśaiḥ kruddho rudramabhidudrāva vegāt
verses.translation: Kalanjara is a great holy centre in the Rudraloka* Mahesvara is the deity, Kara is fond of the devotees who worship lord Kalanjara.
verses.hindi: दृष्टा नारीकुलं रुद्रं पुत्राणामपि केशवम्। मोहयन्तं मुनिश्रेष्ठाः कोपं संदधिरे भृशम्
verses.wordMeaning: Kalanjara is a great holy centre in the Rudraloka* Mahesvara is the deity, Kara is fond of the devotees who worship lord Kalanjara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kalanjara is a great holy centre in the Rudraloka* Mahesvara is the deity, Kara is fond of the devotees who worship lord Kalanjara.

verses.sanskrit: प्रेक्ष्यायान्तं शैलपुत्रीमथेशः सो ऽन्वीक्ष्यान्ते विश्वमायाविधिज्ञः । सावज्ञं वै वामपादेन मृत्युं श्वेतस्यैनं पश्यतो व्याजघान
verses.transliteration: prekṣyāyāntaṃ śailaputrīmatheśaḥ so 'nvīkṣyānte viśvamāyāvidhijñaḥ / sāvajñaṃ vai vāmapādena mṛtyuṃ śvetasyainaṃ paśyato vyājaghāna
verses.translation: Formerly there was an excellent saintly king named Sveta. He was a devotee of Siva. He worshipped the trident¬ bearing lord with obeisances unto him and expecting his blessings.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकारके (स्त्री-वेषवाले) हरिके साथ वे भगवान् ईश हर अपनी मायासे संसारको मोहित करते हुए भिक्षाके लिये दारुवनमें विचरण करने लगे। पिनाकी विश्वेश्वरको स्थान-स्थानपर भ्रमण करते देखकर (उनकी) मायासे मोहित हो (देवदारु-वनको) स्त्रियाँ देवाधिदेवका अनुगमन करने लगीं। अस्त-व्यस्त वस्त्र तथा आभरणोंवाली ये सभी पतिव्रता स्त्रियाँ लज्जाका परित्यागकर विलासयुक्त और कामार्त होकर उन्हींके
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly there was an excellent saintly king named Sveta. He was a devotee of Siva. He worshipped the trident¬ bearing lord with obeisances unto him and expecting his blessings.
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly there was an excellent saintly king named Sveta. He was a devotee of Siva. He worshipped the trident¬ bearing lord with obeisances unto him and expecting his blessings.

verses.sanskrit: ममार सो ऽतिभीषणो महेशपादघातितः । रराज देवतापतिः सहोमया पिनाकधृक्
verses.transliteration: mamāra so 'tibhīṣaṇo maheśapādaghātitaḥ / rarāja devatāpatiḥ sahomayā pinākadhṛk
verses.translation: He installed Rudra in accordance with the injunc¬ tions, given priority to the path of devotion. With his mind dedicated unto Rudra, he performed the Japa of Rudra always.
verses.hindi: साथ भ्रमण करने लगीं। जिन्होंने अपने मनको वशमें कर रखा था, ऋषियोंके वे सभी युवा पुत्र भी कामपीडित होकर (स्त्रीरूपधारी) हृषीकेशके पीछे- पीछे चलने लगे
verses.wordMeaning: He installed Rudra in accordance with the injunc¬ tions, given priority to the path of devotion. With his mind dedicated unto Rudra, he performed the Japa of Rudra always.
verses.commentary: Sense: He installed Rudra in accordance with the injunc¬ tions, given priority to the path of devotion. With his mind dedicated unto Rudra, he performed the Japa of Rudra always.

verses.sanskrit: निरीक्ष्य देवमीश्वरं प्रहृष्टमानसो हरम् । ननाम साम्बमव्ययं स राजपुङ्गवस्तदा
verses.transliteration: nirīkṣya devamīśvaraṃ prahṛṣṭamānaso haram / nanāma sāmbamavyayaṃ sa rājapuṅgavastadā
verses.translation: Seizing a dazzling terrible trident made of steel, Kala came to that spot where the king was standing, in order to take him away.
verses.hindi: पत्नीके रूपमें श्रीविष्णुको साथमें लेकर चलनेवाले अतीव सुन्दर, मायामय, अद्वितीय ईश (श्रीशंकर)- को देखकर (महर्षियोंकी) विलासिनी स्त्रियाँ नाचने- गाने लगीं, उन्हें प्राप्त करनेकी अभिलाषा करने लगीं और उनका आलिंगन करने लगीं। लक्ष्मीके पति आदिदेव (विष्णु) -को (स्त्री-रूपमें) देखकर मुनीश्वरोंके पुत्र उनके पैरोंपर गिरने लगे, मुसकराने लगे और गीत गाने लगे। दूसरे मुनिपुत्र भ्रूविलास (कटाक्षपात) करते
verses.wordMeaning: Seizing a dazzling terrible trident made of steel, Kala came to that spot where the king was standing, in order to take him away.
verses.commentary: Sense: Seizing a dazzling terrible trident made of steel, Kala came to that spot where the king was standing, in order to take him away.

verses.sanskrit: नमो भवाय हेतवे हराय विश्वसंभवे । नमः शिवाय धीमते नमो ऽपवर्गदायिने
verses.transliteration: namo bhavāya hetave harāya viśvasaṃbhave / namaḥ śivāya dhīmate namo 'pavargadāyine
verses.translation: Seizing a dazzling terrible trident made of steel, Kala came to that spot where the king was standing, in order to take him away.
verses.hindi: हुए उनके साथ विचरण करने लगे। उन (स्त्रियों) तथा उन (पुरुषों)-के मनमें प्रविष्ट होकर मायावी मुरारि वासुदेवने उनके मनमें भोगोंके प्रति प्रवृत्ति उत्पन्न को। इस प्रकार उन सभीने भलीभाँति मायाका अनुभव
verses.wordMeaning: Seizing a dazzling terrible trident made of steel, Kala came to that spot where the king was standing, in order to take him away.
verses.commentary: Sense: Seizing a dazzling terrible trident made of steel, Kala came to that spot where the king was standing, in order to take him away.

verses.sanskrit: नमो नमो नमो ऽस्तु ते महाविभूतये नमः । विभागहीनरूपिणे नमो नराधिपाय ते
verses.transliteration: namo namo namo 'stu te mahāvibhūtaye namaḥ / vibhāgahīnarūpiṇe namo narādhipāya te
verses.translation: Seizing a dazzling terrible trident made of steel, Kala came to that spot where the king was standing, in order to take him away.
verses.hindi: स्त्रियोंके मध्य घिरे हुए समस्त देवों और प्राणियोंके स्वामी वे माधव तथा शंकर वैसे ही सुशोभित हुए जैसे समस्त शक्तियोंके आसनपर स्थित अद्वितीय शक्तिस्वरूपा पार्वतीके साथ देवाधिदेव शंकर सुशोभित होते हैं। उस समय महादेव (मुनियोंको मोहित करनेकी भावनापर) आरूढ होकर पुनः बार-बार अत्यन्त प्रभावकारी नृत्य करने लगे और आदिदेव हरि उन ईशके चरितामृत-रूप स्वभावके रहस्यको समझकर
verses.wordMeaning: Seizing a dazzling terrible trident made of steel, Kala came to that spot where the king was standing, in order to take him away.
verses.commentary: Sense: Seizing a dazzling terrible trident made of steel, Kala came to that spot where the king was standing, in order to take him away.

verses.sanskrit: नमो ऽस्तु ते गणेश्वर प्रपन्नदुः खनाशन । अनादिनित्यभूतये वराहशृङ्गधारिणे
verses.transliteration: namo 'stu te gaṇeśvara prapannaduḥ khanāśana / anādinityabhūtaye varāhaśṛṅgadhāriṇe
verses.translation: Seizing a dazzling terrible trident made of steel, Kala came to that spot where the king was standing, in order to take him away.
verses.hindi: उनके पीछे-पीछे चलने लगे
verses.wordMeaning: Seizing a dazzling terrible trident made of steel, Kala came to that spot where the king was standing, in order to take him away.
verses.commentary: Sense: Seizing a dazzling terrible trident made of steel, Kala came to that spot where the king was standing, in order to take him away.

verses.sanskrit: नमो वृषध्वजाय ते कपालमालिने नमः । नमो महानटाय ते नमो वृषध्वजाय ते
verses.transliteration: namo vṛṣadhvajāya te kapālamāline namaḥ / namo mahānaṭāya te namo vṛṣadhvajāya te
verses.translation: Seizing a dazzling terrible trident made of steel, Kala came to that spot where the king was standing, in order to take him away.
verses.hindi: स्त्री-समूहको मुग्ध कर रहे रुद्र और पुत्रोंको मोहित कर रहे (नारीरूप) विष्णुको देखकर उन श्रेष्ठ मुनियोंको अत्यन्त क्रोध हो आया अतीव परुषं वाक्यं प्रोचुर्देवं कपर्दिनम्। शेपुश्च शापैर्विविधैर्मायया तस्य मोहिताः
verses.wordMeaning: Seizing a dazzling terrible trident made of steel, Kala came to that spot where the king was standing, in order to take him away.
verses.commentary: Sense: Seizing a dazzling terrible trident made of steel, Kala came to that spot where the king was standing, in order to take him away.

verses.sanskrit: अथानुगृह्य शङ्करः प्रणामतत्परं नृपम् । स्वगाणपत्यमव्ययं सरूपतामथो ददौ
verses.transliteration: athānugṛhya śaṅkaraḥ praṇāmatatparaṃ nṛpam / svagāṇapatyamavyayaṃ sarūpatāmatho dadau
verses.translation: Seizing a dazzling terrible trident made of steel, Kala came to that spot where the king was standing, in order to take him away.
verses.hindi: तपांसि तेषां सर्वेषां प्रत्याहन्यन्त शंकरे। यथादित्यप्रकाशेन तारका नभसि स्थिताः
verses.wordMeaning: Seizing a dazzling terrible trident made of steel, Kala came to that spot where the king was standing, in order to take him away.
verses.commentary: Sense: Seizing a dazzling terrible trident made of steel, Kala came to that spot where the king was standing, in order to take him away.

verses.sanskrit: सहोमया सपार्षदः सराजपुङ्गवो हरः । मुनीशसिद्धवन्दितः क्षणाददृश्यतामगात्
verses.transliteration: sahomayā sapārṣadaḥ sarājapuṅgavo haraḥ / munīśasiddhavanditaḥ kṣaṇādadṛśyatāmagāt
verses.translation: Seizing a dazzling terrible trident made of steel, Kala came to that spot where the king was standing, in order to take him away.
verses.hindi: को भवानिति देवेशं पृच्छन्ति स्म विमोहिताः सोऽब्रवीद् भगवानीशस्तपश्चर्तुमिहागतः । इदानीं भार्यया देशे भवद्धिरिह सुत्रता:
verses.wordMeaning: Seizing a dazzling terrible trident made of steel, Kala came to that spot where the king was standing, in order to take him away.
verses.commentary: Sense: Seizing a dazzling terrible trident made of steel, Kala came to that spot where the king was standing, in order to take him away.

verses.sanskrit: काले महेशाभिहते लोकनाथः पितामहः । अयाचत वरं रुद्रं सजीवो ऽयं भवत्विति
verses.transliteration: kāle maheśābhihate lokanāthaḥ pitāmahaḥ / ayācata varaṃ rudraṃ sajīvo 'yaṃ bhavatviti
verses.translation: Seizing a dazzling terrible trident made of steel, Kala came to that spot where the king was standing, in order to take him away.
verses.hindi: तस्य ते वाक्यमाकर्ण्य भृग्वाद्या मुनिपुंगवाः । ऊचुर्गृहीत्वा वसनं त्यक्त्वा भार्या तपश्चर
verses.wordMeaning: Seizing a dazzling terrible trident made of steel, Kala came to that spot where the king was standing, in order to take him away.
verses.commentary: Sense: Seizing a dazzling terrible trident made of steel, Kala came to that spot where the king was standing, in order to take him away.

verses.sanskrit: नास्ति कश्चिदपीशान दोषलेशो वृषध्वज । कृतान्तस्यैव भवता तत्कार्ये विनियोजितः
verses.transliteration: nāsti kaścidapīśāna doṣaleśo vṛṣadhvaja / kṛtāntasyaiva bhavatā tatkārye viniyojitaḥ
verses.translation: Seizing a dazzling terrible trident made of steel, Kala came to that spot where the king was standing, in order to take him away.
verses.hindi: अथोवाच विहस्येशः पिनाकी नीललोहितः । सम्प्रेक्ष्य जगतो योनिं पार्श्वस्थं च जनार्दनम् त्यक्तव्या मम भार्येति धर्मज्ञः शान्तमानसैः
verses.wordMeaning: Seizing a dazzling terrible trident made of steel, Kala came to that spot where the king was standing, in order to take him away.
verses.commentary: Sense: Seizing a dazzling terrible trident made of steel, Kala came to that spot where the king was standing, in order to take him away.

verses.sanskrit: स देवदेववचनाद् देवदेवेश्वरो हरः । तथास्त्वित्याह विश्वात्मा सो ऽपि तादृग्विधो ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: sa devadevavacanād devadeveśvaro haraḥ / tathāstvityāha viśvātmā so 'pi tādṛgvidho 'bhavat
verses.translation: Seizing a dazzling terrible trident made of steel, Kala came to that spot where the king was standing, in order to take him away.
verses.hindi: एवमुक्ते महादेवः सत्यमेव मयेरितम्।
verses.wordMeaning: Seizing a dazzling terrible trident made of steel, Kala came to that spot where the king was standing, in order to take him away.
verses.commentary: Sense: Seizing a dazzling terrible trident made of steel, Kala came to that spot where the king was standing, in order to take him away.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येतत् परमं तीर्थं कालञ्जरमिति श्रुतम् । गत्वाभ्यर्च्य महादेवं गाणपत्यं स विन्दति
verses.transliteration: ityetat paramaṃ tīrthaṃ kālañjaramiti śrutam / gatvābhyarcya mahādevaṃ gāṇapatyaṃ sa vindati
verses.translation: Seizing a dazzling terrible trident made of steel, Kala came to that spot where the king was standing, in order to take him away.
verses.hindi: दृष्टा समागतं देवं भिक्षमाणमरुन्धती। वसिष्ठस्य प्रिया भार्या प्रत्युदगम्य ननाम तम् उन (शंकर)-की मायासे मोहित होकर मुनियोंने कपर्दीदेव (शंकर)-से अत्यन्त परुष (कठोर) वचन कहा और विविध शापोंसे उन्हें अभिशप्त किया। पर वे सभी परुष वचन एवं शाप व्यर्थ हो गये; क्योंकि उन मुनियोंकी
verses.wordMeaning: Seizing a dazzling terrible trident made of steel, Kala came to that spot where the king was standing, in order to take him away.
verses.commentary: Sense: Seizing a dazzling terrible trident made of steel, Kala came to that spot where the king was standing, in order to take him away.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे पञ्चत्रिंशो ऽध्यायः सूत उवाच इदनमन्यते परं स्थानं गुह्याद् गुह्यतमं महत् । महादेवस्य देवस्य महालयमिति श्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge pañcatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca idanamanyate paraṃ sthānaṃ guhyād guhyatamaṃ mahat / mahādevasya devasya mahālayamiti śrutam
verses.translation: On seeing the terrible and ferocious Kala, the des¬ troyer of all, approaching with the trident in his hand, the king was overwhelmed with fear.
verses.hindi: तपस्याएँ (तपस्यासे उत्पन्न शक्तियाँ) भगवान् शंकरसे प्रत्याहत होकर वैसे ही प्रभावशून्य हो गयीं, जैसे आकाशमें सूर्यके प्रकाशसे प्रत्याहत ताराएँ प्रभावशून्य हो जाती हैं
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing the terrible and ferocious Kala, the des¬ troyer of all, approaching with the trident in his hand, the king was overwhelmed with fear.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the terrible and ferocious Kala, the des¬ troyer of all, approaching with the trident in his hand, the king was overwhelmed with fear.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र देवादिदेवेन रुद्रेण त्रिपुरारिणा । शिलातले पदं न्यस्तं नास्तिकानां निदर्शनम्
verses.transliteration: tatra devādidevena rudreṇa tripurāriṇā / śilātale padaṃ nyastaṃ nāstikānāṃ nidarśanam
verses.translation: With both of his hands the King caught hold of the excellent Lihga and bowed down to Rudra with his bent head. He repeated the Satarudriya Mantra.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार अपनी तपस्याको निष्प्रभाव देखकर मोहित हुए वे मुनि वृषभध्वज देवेशके पास जाकर उनसे पूछने लगे--' आप कौन हैं ?' तब उन भगवान् ईशने कहा--सुब्रतो! इस समय आप लोगोंके इस स्थानमें मैं पत्नीसहित तपस्या करनेके लिये आया हूँ
verses.wordMeaning: With both of his hands the King caught hold of the excellent Lihga and bowed down to Rudra with his bent head. He repeated the Satarudriya Mantra.
verses.commentary: Sense: With both of his hands the King caught hold of the excellent Lihga and bowed down to Rudra with his bent head. He repeated the Satarudriya Mantra.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र पुशुपताः शान्ता भस्मोद्धूलितविग्रहाः । उपासते महादेवं वेदाध्ययनतत्पराः
verses.transliteration: tatra puśupatāḥ śāntā bhasmoddhūlitavigrahāḥ / upāsate mahādevaṃ vedādhyayanatatparāḥ
verses.translation: Standing in front of the King, Krtanta (God of Death) laughingly said to the king who was bowing down and performing the Japa of Bhava mentally "Come away, come away."
verses.hindi: उनके उस वाक्यको सुनकर उन भृगु आदि श्रेष्ठ मुनियोंने कहा--वरत्र धारणकर, भार्याका परित्यागकर तपस्या करो
verses.wordMeaning: Standing in front of the King, Krtanta (God of Death) laughingly said to the king who was bowing down and performing the Japa of Bhava mentally "Come away, come away."
verses.commentary: Sense: Standing in front of the King, Krtanta (God of Death) laughingly said to the king who was bowing down and performing the Japa of Bhava mentally "Come away, come away."

verses.sanskrit: स्नात्वा तत्र पदं शार्वं दृष्ट्वा भक्तिपुरः सरम् । नमस्कृत्वाथ शिरसा रुद्रसामीप्यमाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: snātvā tatra padaṃ śārvaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhaktipuraḥ saram / namaskṛtvātha śirasā rudrasāmīpyamāpnuyāt
verses.translation: The king who was terribly afraid but was devoted to Rudra requested him, ''Kill others after leaving off one who is engaged in the worship of Isa."
verses.hindi: तब नीललोहित पिनाकी ईश्वरने हँसकर पार्श्वभागमें स्थित संसारके मूल कारण जनार्दनको ओर देखकर इस प्रकार कहा-धर्मको जाननेवाले तथा शान्त मनवाले और अपनी भायकि पालन-पोषणमें तत्पर रहनेवाले आप लोगोंने मुझसे यह कैसे कहा कि अपनी भार्याका परित्याग कर दो
verses.wordMeaning: The king who was terribly afraid but was devoted to Rudra requested him, ''Kill others after leaving off one who is engaged in the worship of Isa."
verses.commentary: Sense: The king who was terribly afraid but was devoted to Rudra requested him, ''Kill others after leaving off one who is engaged in the worship of Isa."

verses.sanskrit: अन्यच्च देवदेवस्य स्थानं शंभोर्महात्मनः । केदारमिति विख्यातं सिद्धानामालयं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: anyacca devadevasya sthānaṃ śaṃbhormahātmanaḥ / kedāramiti vikhyātaṃ siddhānāmālayaṃ śubham
verses.translation: The lord (i.e. Kala here) said to him who was frightened and spoke as mentioned above—"Who is there who does not stand under my control whether he is engaged in worshipping Rudra or not?
verses.hindi: ऋषियोंने कहा-- (शास्त्रोंके अनुसार) पतिका कर्तव्य है कि व्यभिचारिणी पत्नीको (भरण-आच्छादनको व्यवस्था भले ही कर दे, पर) पत्नीरूपमें उसे न स्वीकार करे। अतः आपको भी इस प्रकारको इस
verses.wordMeaning: The lord (i.e. Kala here) said to him who was frightened and spoke as mentioned above—"Who is there who does not stand under my control whether he is engaged in worshipping Rudra or not?
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord (i.e. Kala here) said to him who was frightened and spoke as mentioned above—"Who is there who does not stand under my control whether he is engaged in worshipping Rudra or not?

verses.sanskrit: तत्र स्नात्वा महादेवमभ्यर्च्य वृषकेतनम् । पीत्वा चैवोदकं शुद्धं गाणपत्यमवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: tatra snātvā mahādevamabhyarcya vṛṣaketanam / pītvā caivodakaṃ śuddhaṃ gāṇapatyamavāpnuyāt
verses.translation: After saying thus, Kala, the destroyer of the worlds, bound that king by means of nooses. The king on his part continued the Japa of Satarudriya.
verses.hindi: सुन्दरीका त्याग करना चाहिए महादेव बोले--विप्रो ! यह कभी मनसे भी किसी दूसरेकी इच्छा नहीं करती और न मैं कभी इसका परित्याग करता हूँ
verses.wordMeaning: After saying thus, Kala, the destroyer of the worlds, bound that king by means of nooses. The king on his part continued the Japa of Satarudriya.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying thus, Kala, the destroyer of the worlds, bound that king by means of nooses. The king on his part continued the Japa of Satarudriya.

verses.sanskrit: श्राद्धदानादिकं कृत्वा ह्यक्ष्यं लभते फलम् । द्विजातिप्रवरैर्जुष्टं योगिभिर्यतमानसैः
verses.transliteration: śrāddhadānādikaṃ kṛtvā hyakṣyaṃ labhate phalam / dvijātipravarairjuṣṭaṃ yogibhiryatamānasaiḥ
verses.translation: Then he saw in the Firmament the enormous and brillant ancient mass of splendour of the lord of goblins. It was surrounded with clusters of flames and pervaded the universe.
verses.hindi: ऋषियोंने कहा--पुरुषाधम ! हमने इसे यहाँ व्यभिचार करते हुए देखा है। आपने असत्य कहा है। अतः शीघ्र ही यहाँसे चले जाइये
verses.wordMeaning: Then he saw in the Firmament the enormous and brillant ancient mass of splendour of the lord of goblins. It was surrounded with clusters of flames and pervaded the universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then he saw in the Firmament the enormous and brillant ancient mass of splendour of the lord of goblins. It was surrounded with clusters of flames and pervaded the universe.

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थं प्लक्षावतरणं सर्वपापविनाशनम् । तत्राभ्यर्च्य श्रीनिवासं विष्णुलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: tīrthaṃ plakṣāvataraṇaṃ sarvapāpavināśanam / tatrābhyarcya śrīnivāsaṃ viṣṇuloke mahīyate
verses.translation: In the middle thereof he saw a brilliant form a Purusa of golden colour. The lord was accompanied by the goddess. His body shone with the digit of the moon. He became much delighted. He thought that the Lord was coming to him.
verses.hindi: ऋषियोंके ऐसा कहनेपर महादेवने कहा--मैंने सत्य ही कहा है। आपको यह (मेरे पार्श्वमें विद्यमान सुन्दरी स्त्री) ऐसी प्रतीत होती है। ऐसा कहकर महादेव विचरण करने लगे। भिक्षाकी इच्छासे वे परमेश्वर विष्णुके साथ मुनिश्रेष्ठ महात्मा वसिष्ठके पवित्र आश्रममें गये। भिक्षा मागते हुए देवको आये देखकर वसिष्ठकी प्रिय पत्नी अरुन्धतीने समीपमें जाकर उन्हें प्रणाम किया॥ ३२--३४॥
verses.wordMeaning: In the middle thereof he saw a brilliant form a Purusa of golden colour. The lord was accompanied by the goddess. His body shone with the digit of the moon. He became much delighted. He thought that the Lord was coming to him.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the middle thereof he saw a brilliant form a Purusa of golden colour. The lord was accompanied by the goddess. His body shone with the digit of the moon. He became much delighted. He thought that the Lord was coming to him.

verses.sanskrit: अन्यं मगधराजस्य तीर्थं स्वर्गगतिप्रदम् । अक्षयं विन्दति स्वर्गं तत्र गत्वा द्विजोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: anyaṃ magadharājasya tīrthaṃ svargagatipradam / akṣayaṃ vindati svargaṃ tatra gatvā dvijottamaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing Rudra, the great Lord, the lord of every¬ thing, coming at not a great distance, accompanied by the goddess, the royal sage became free from fear. Kala rushed at the saintly king to take him away.
verses.hindi: चकार महतीं पूजां प्रार्थयामास भार्यया। को भवान् कुत आयातः किमाचारो भवानिति। उवाच तां महादेवः सिद्धानां प्रवरोऽस्म्यहम्
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing Rudra, the great Lord, the lord of every¬ thing, coming at not a great distance, accompanied by the goddess, the royal sage became free from fear. Kala rushed at the saintly king to take him away.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing Rudra, the great Lord, the lord of every¬ thing, coming at not a great distance, accompanied by the goddess, the royal sage became free from fear. Kala rushed at the saintly king to take him away.

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थं कनखलं पुण्यं महापातकनाशनम् । यत्र देवेन रुद्रेण यज्ञो दक्षस्य नाशितः
verses.transliteration: tīrthaṃ kanakhalaṃ puṇyaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam / yatra devena rudreṇa yajño dakṣasya nāśitaḥ
verses.translation: (Defective verse) On seeing him. Lord Rudra, the ancient leader of the goblins, of fierce activities said to Kala— "Give unto me my devotee quickly, the devotee who remembers me, O Kala. He remembers my form (?)"
verses.hindi: यदेतन्मण्डलं शुद्धं भाति ब्रह्ममयं सदा। एषैव देवता मह्यं धारयामि सहैव तत् तानब्रवीन्महायोगी करिष्यामीति शंकरः। युष्माकं मामके लिङ्गे यदि द्वेषोऽभिजायते
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective verse) On seeing him. Lord Rudra, the ancient leader of the goblins, of fierce activities said to Kala— "Give unto me my devotee quickly, the devotee who remembers me, O Kala. He remembers my form (?)"
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective verse) On seeing him. Lord Rudra, the ancient leader of the goblins, of fierce activities said to Kala— "Give unto me my devotee quickly, the devotee who remembers me, O Kala. He remembers my form (?)"

verses.sanskrit: तत्र गङ्गामुपस्पृश्य शुचिर्भावसमन्वितः । मुच्यते सर्वपापैस्तु ब्रह्मलोकं लभेन्मृतः
verses.transliteration: tatra gaṅgāmupaspṛśya śucirbhāvasamanvitaḥ / mucyate sarvapāpaistu brahmalokaṃ labhenmṛtaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing the statement of Siva (lord of the Bull), the Atman of Kala of the form of Rudra* (?) considered (his nature (himself) too high. He bound the devotee again by means of nooses. Then Rudra** rushed at him with great velocity.
verses.hindi: इत्युक्त्वोत्पाटयामास भगवान् भगनेत्रहा। नापश्यंस्तत्क्षणेनेशं केशवं लिङ्गमेव च
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the statement of Siva (lord of the Bull), the Atman of Kala of the form of Rudra* (?) considered (his nature (himself) too high. He bound the devotee again by means of nooses. Then Rudra** rushed at him with great velocity.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the statement of Siva (lord of the Bull), the Atman of Kala of the form of Rudra* (?) considered (his nature (himself) too high. He bound the devotee again by means of nooses. Then Rudra** rushed at him with great velocity.

verses.sanskrit: महातीर्थमिति ख्यातं पुण्यं नारायणप्रियम् । तत्राभ्यर्च्य हृषीकेशं श्वेतद्वीपं निगच्छति
verses.transliteration: mahātīrthamiti khyātaṃ puṇyaṃ nārāyaṇapriyam / tatrābhyarcya hṛṣīkeśaṃ śvetadvīpaṃ nigacchati
verses.translation: On seeing him (Kala) coming towards (himself to attack), the Lord then glanced at Uma, the daughter of the mountain (Himalaya). The knower of the procedure of all Mayas (Siva) contemptuously struck Kala with his left foot, while he (King Sveta) was looking on.
verses.hindi: तदोत्पाता बभूवुर्हि लोकानां भयशंसिनः । तेजसा भासयन् कृत्स्नं नारायणसहायवान्। भिक्षमाणः शिवो नूनं दृष्टोऽस्माकं गृहेष्विति
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing him (Kala) coming towards (himself to attack), the Lord then glanced at Uma, the daughter of the mountain (Himalaya). The knower of the procedure of all Mayas (Siva) contemptuously struck Kala with his left foot, while he (King Sveta) was looking on.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing him (Kala) coming towards (himself to attack), the Lord then glanced at Uma, the daughter of the mountain (Himalaya). The knower of the procedure of all Mayas (Siva) contemptuously struck Kala with his left foot, while he (King Sveta) was looking on.

verses.sanskrit: अन्यच्च तीर्थप्रवरं नाम्ना श्रीपर्वतं शुभम् । तत्र प्राणान् परित्यज्य रुद्रस्य दयितो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: anyacca tīrthapravaraṃ nāmnā śrīparvataṃ śubham / tatra prāṇān parityajya rudrasya dayito bhavet
verses.translation: That extremely terrible fellow died on being struck by the foot of Mahesa. The Pinaka-bearing great God stood shining alongwith Uma.
verses.hindi: तस्या वचनमाकर्ण्य शङ्कमाना महर्षयः । सर्वे जम्मुर्महायोगं ब्रह्माणं विश्वसम्भवम्
verses.wordMeaning: That extremely terrible fellow died on being struck by the foot of Mahesa. The Pinaka-bearing great God stood shining alongwith Uma.
verses.commentary: Sense: That extremely terrible fellow died on being struck by the foot of Mahesa. The Pinaka-bearing great God stood shining alongwith Uma.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र सन्निहितो रुद्रो देव्या सह महेश्वरः । स्नानपिण्डादिकं तत्र कृतमक्षय्यमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: tatra sannihito rudro devyā saha maheśvaraḥ / snānapiṇḍādikaṃ tatra kṛtamakṣayyamuttamam
verses.translation: On seeing the Lord Isvara, Hara, the imperishable deity, the prominent saintly king became delighted in his mind then and bowed unto him.
verses.hindi: उपास्यमानममलैर्योगिभिर्ब्रह्मवित्तमैः । चतुर्वेहैर्मर्तिमद्भिः सावित्र्या सहितं प्रभुम् (परमेश्वरके) चरणोंको धोकर और शुद्ध उत्तम आसन प्रदान कर द्विजोंके आघातसे आहत उनके शिथिल शरीरको देखकर अत्यन्त खिन्न सती (अरुन्धती) - ने (उनके व्रणोंपर) औषधि लगायी और भार्यासहित
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing the Lord Isvara, Hara, the imperishable deity, the prominent saintly king became delighted in his mind then and bowed unto him.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the Lord Isvara, Hara, the imperishable deity, the prominent saintly king became delighted in his mind then and bowed unto him.

verses.sanskrit: गोदावरी नदी पुण्या सर्वपापविनाशनी । तत्र स्नात्वा पितॄन् देवांस्तर्पयित्वा यथाविधि । सर्वपापविसुद्धात्मा गोसहस्रफलं लभेत्
verses.transliteration: godāvarī nadī puṇyā sarvapāpavināśanī / tatra snātvā pitṝn devāṃstarpayitvā yathāvidhi / sarvapāpavisuddhātmā gosahasraphalaṃ labhet
verses.translation: "Obeisance to Bhava, the cause (of the universe) to Hara, who wishes for the welfare of the whole universe. Salutation to Siva, the intelligent one. Obeisance to the bestower of Salvation.
verses.hindi: (परमेश्वरकी) उन्होंने (अरुन्धतीने) महती पूजा की तथा पूछा-- आप कौन हैं, कहाँसे आये हैं, आपका आचार क्या है ?' महादेवने उनसे कहा--'मैं सिद्धोंमें श्रेष्ठ (सिद्ध) हूँ।' जो यह ब्रह्ममय शुद्ध मण्डल सदा
verses.wordMeaning: "Obeisance to Bhava, the cause (of the universe) to Hara, who wishes for the welfare of the whole universe. Salutation to Siva, the intelligent one. Obeisance to the bestower of Salvation.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Obeisance to Bhava, the cause (of the universe) to Hara, who wishes for the welfare of the whole universe. Salutation to Siva, the intelligent one. Obeisance to the bestower of Salvation.

verses.sanskrit: पवित्रसलिला पुण्या कावेरी विपुला नदी । तस्यां स्नात्वोदकं कृत्वा मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः । त्रिरात्रोपोषितेनाथ एकरात्रोषितेन वा
verses.transliteration: pavitrasalilā puṇyā kāverī vipulā nadī / tasyāṃ snātvodakaṃ kṛtvā mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ / trirātropoṣitenātha ekarātroṣitena vā
verses.translation: Obeisance again and again (innumerable times) to the great superhuman power and prosperity. Obeisance to you, the overlord of men, of the form that is devoid of division.
verses.hindi: प्रकाशित होता है वही मेरे देवता (आस्पद) हैं! मैं सदा ही उनको धारण करता हूँ ऐसा कहकर तथा पतिव्रता (अरुन्धती)-पर कृपा करके श्रीमान् (महादेव) चल पड़े! द्विज उन्हें डंडों ढेलों तथा मुक्कोंसे मारने लगे। नग्न तथा विकृत लक्षणवाले गिरिशको घूमते हुए देखकर मुनियोंने
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance again and again (innumerable times) to the great superhuman power and prosperity. Obeisance to you, the overlord of men, of the form that is devoid of division.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance again and again (innumerable times) to the great superhuman power and prosperity. Obeisance to you, the overlord of men, of the form that is devoid of division.

verses.sanskrit: द्विजातीनां तु कथितं तीर्थानामिह सेवनम् । यस्य वाङ्मनसो शुद्धे हस्तपादौ च संस्थितौ । अलोलुपो ब्रह्मचारो तीर्थानां फलमाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: dvijātīnāṃ tu kathitaṃ tīrthānāmiha sevanam / yasya vāṅmanaso śuddhe hastapādau ca saṃsthitau / alolupo brahmacāro tīrthānāṃ phalamāpnuyāt
verses.translation: O lord of Ganas, obeisance be to you. Hail to you, O deity that dispel the misery of those who resort to you, salutation to you of eternal (primordial) beginningless prosperity, to one that holds the horn of a boar.
verses.hindi: कहा-हे दुर्मते! तुम अपने इस लिङ्गको उखाड़ो। महायोगी शंकरने उनसे कहा-आप लोगोंको यदि मेरे लिङ्गके प्रति द्वेष उत्पन्न हो गया हो तो में वैसा ही करूँगा ॥ ३८--४० ॥
verses.wordMeaning: O lord of Ganas, obeisance be to you. Hail to you, O deity that dispel the misery of those who resort to you, salutation to you of eternal (primordial) beginningless prosperity, to one that holds the horn of a boar.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord of Ganas, obeisance be to you. Hail to you, O deity that dispel the misery of those who resort to you, salutation to you of eternal (primordial) beginningless prosperity, to one that holds the horn of a boar.

verses.sanskrit: स्वामितीर्थं महातीर्थं त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतम् । तत्र सन्निहितो नित्यं स्कन्दो ऽमरनमस्कृतः
verses.transliteration: svāmitīrthaṃ mahātīrthaṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam / tatra sannihito nityaṃ skando 'maranamaskṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to you the bull-bannered Lord, bow to one that has a wreath of skulls. Salutation to you of great mountain (v.l. great actor); obeisance to you auspicious Sankara."
verses.hindi: ऐसा कहकर भगके नेत्रोंको नष्ट करनेवाले भगवानूने (अपने) लिङ्गको उखाड़ दिया। पर तत्काल ही सब कुछ अदृश्य हो गया और (मुनियोंने) न शंकरको देखा न केशवको और न लिङ्गको ही देखा और तभी पूरे लोकमें भय उत्पन्न करनेवाले उपद्रव होने लगे। सहस्रकिरण (सूर्य)-का तेज समाप्त हो गया, पृथ्वी कॉपने लगी। सभी ग्रह प्रभावहीन हो गये और समुद्रमें क्षोभ उत्पन्न हो गया
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you the bull-bannered Lord, bow to one that has a wreath of skulls. Salutation to you of great mountain (v.l. great actor); obeisance to you auspicious Sankara."
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you the bull-bannered Lord, bow to one that has a wreath of skulls. Salutation to you of great mountain (v.l. great actor); obeisance to you auspicious Sankara."

verses.sanskrit: स्नात्वा कुमारधारायां कृत्वा देवादितर्पणम् । आराध्य षण्मुखं देवं स्कन्देन सह मोदते
verses.transliteration: snātvā kumāradhārāyāṃ kṛtvā devāditarpaṇam / ārādhya ṣaṇmukhaṃ devaṃ skandena saha modate
verses.translation: Sankara then blessed the king engaged in obeisance; then he bestowed on him the chieftain-ship of his own Ganas and then (finally) his own form (identity with him).
verses.hindi: इधर अत्रिको पत्नी पतिव्रता अनसूयाने स्वप्न देखा। उनके नेत्र भयसे व्याकुल हो गये। उन्होंने ब्राह्मणोंसे (स्वप्नकी बात बताते हुए) कहा--निश्चय ही हम लोगोंके घरमें अपने तेजसे सम्पूर्ण संसारको
verses.wordMeaning: Sankara then blessed the king engaged in obeisance; then he bestowed on him the chieftain-ship of his own Ganas and then (finally) his own form (identity with him).
verses.commentary: Sense: Sankara then blessed the king engaged in obeisance; then he bestowed on him the chieftain-ship of his own Ganas and then (finally) his own form (identity with him).

verses.sanskrit: नदी त्रैलोक्यविख्याता ताम्रपर्णोति नामतः । तत्र स्नात्वा पितॄन् भक्त्या तर्पयित्वा यथाविधि । पापकर्तॄनपि पितॄस्तारयेन्नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: nadī trailokyavikhyātā tāmraparṇoti nāmataḥ / tatra snātvā pitṝn bhaktyā tarpayitvā yathāvidhi / pāpakartṝnapi pitṝstārayennātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Instantaneously Kara who was saluted by the leading- ascetics and the Siddhas became invisible along with Uma, his attendants and the leading king.
verses.hindi: प्रकाशित कर रहे शिव (भगवान् शंकर) नारायणके साथ भिक्षा मागते हुए दिखलायी पड़े थे। उनके वचन सुनकर सशंकित सभी महर्षि जगत्को उत्पन्न करनेवाले महायोगी ब्रह्माजीके पास गये॥ ४३--४५॥ वहाँ उन्होंने ब्रह्मज्ञानियोंमें श्रेष्ठ विशुद्ध योगिजनोंद्वारा तथा मूर्तिमान् चारों वेदोंद्वारा उपासित होते हुए प्रभु (त्रह्मा)-को सावित्रीके साथ देखा
verses.wordMeaning: Instantaneously Kara who was saluted by the leading- ascetics and the Siddhas became invisible along with Uma, his attendants and the leading king.
verses.commentary: Sense: Instantaneously Kara who was saluted by the leading- ascetics and the Siddhas became invisible along with Uma, his attendants and the leading king.

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्रतीर्थमिति ख्यातं कावेर्याः प्रभवे ऽक्षयम् । तीर्थं तत्र भवेद् वस्तुं मृतानां स्वर्गतिर्ध्रुवा
verses.transliteration: candratīrthamiti khyātaṃ kāveryāḥ prabhave 'kṣayam / tīrthaṃ tatra bhaved vastuṃ mṛtānāṃ svargatirdhruvā
verses.translation: When Kala was killed by Mahesa, god Brahma the lord of the worlds, begged ofRudrathe boon—"May he (Kala) come back to life.
verses.hindi: विलोक्य वेदपुरुषं प्रसन्नवदनं शुभम्। शिरोभिर्धरणीं गत्वा तोषयामासुरीश्वरम्
verses.wordMeaning: When Kala was killed by Mahesa, god Brahma the lord of the worlds, begged ofRudrathe boon—"May he (Kala) come back to life.
verses.commentary: Sense: When Kala was killed by Mahesa, god Brahma the lord of the worlds, begged ofRudrathe boon—"May he (Kala) come back to life.

verses.sanskrit: विन्ध्यपादे प्रपश्यन्ति देवदेवं सदाशिवम् । भक्त्या ये ते न पश्यन्ति यमस्य सदनं द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: vindhyapāde prapaśyanti devadevaṃ sadāśivam / bhaktyā ye te na paśyanti yamasya sadanaṃ dvijāḥ
verses.translation: O bull-bannered Isana, it is not the slightest fault of Krtanta the god of Death. He was appointed on that job (of taking away the lives of beings) by you."
verses.hindi: तान् प्रसन्नमना देवश्षतुमूर्तिश्चतुर्मुखः। व्याजहार मुनिश्रेष्ठाः किमागमनकारणम् तस्य ते वृत्तमखिलं ब्रह्मणः परमात्मनः।
verses.wordMeaning: O bull-bannered Isana, it is not the slightest fault of Krtanta the god of Death. He was appointed on that job (of taking away the lives of beings) by you."
verses.commentary: Sense: O bull-bannered Isana, it is not the slightest fault of Krtanta the god of Death. He was appointed on that job (of taking away the lives of beings) by you."

verses.sanskrit: देविकायां वृषो नाम तीर्थं सिद्धनिषेवितम् । तत्र स्नात्वोदकं दत्वा योगसिद्धिं च विन्दति
verses.transliteration: devikāyāṃ vṛṣo nāma tīrthaṃ siddhaniṣevitam / tatra snātvodakaṃ datvā yogasiddhiṃ ca vindati
verses.translation: At the instance of the lord of Devas, Hara, the lord of the chief of Devas, the Atman of the universe said—"So be it." He (Kala) too became like that (i.e. revived).
verses.hindi: कन्यकानां प्रिया चास्य दूषयामास पुत्रकान्
verses.wordMeaning: At the instance of the lord of Devas, Hara, the lord of the chief of Devas, the Atman of the universe said—"So be it." He (Kala) too became like that (i.e. revived).
verses.commentary: Sense: At the instance of the lord of Devas, Hara, the lord of the chief of Devas, the Atman of the universe said—"So be it." He (Kala) too became like that (i.e. revived).

verses.sanskrit: दशाश्वमेधिकं तीर्थं सर्वपापविनाशनम् । दशानामश्वमेधानां तत्राप्नोति फलं नरः
verses.transliteration: daśāśvamedhikaṃ tīrthaṃ sarvapāpavināśanam / daśānāmaśvamedhānāṃ tatrāpnoti phalaṃ naraḥ
verses.translation: Thus is the holy centre well known as Kalanjara. On. going there and worshipping Mahadeva one attains the chief¬ tain-ship of the Ganas.
verses.hindi: अन्तर्हितश्च भगवान् सभार्या लिङ्गमेव च। उत्पाताश्चाभवन् घोराः सर्वभूतभयंकराः क एष पुरुषो देव भीताः स्म पुरुषोत्तम। भवन्तमेव शरणं प्रपन्ना वयमच्युत
verses.wordMeaning: Thus is the holy centre well known as Kalanjara. On. going there and worshipping Mahadeva one attains the chief¬ tain-ship of the Ganas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus is the holy centre well known as Kalanjara. On. going there and worshipping Mahadeva one attains the chief¬ tain-ship of the Ganas.

verses.sanskrit: पुण्डरीकं महातीर्थं ब्राह्मणैरुपसेवितम् । तत्राभिगम्य युक्तात्मा पौण्डरीकफलं लभेत्
verses.transliteration: puṇḍarīkaṃ mahātīrthaṃ brāhmaṇairupasevitam / tatrābhigamya yuktātmā pauṇḍarīkaphalaṃ labhet
verses.translation: There is a holy centre well known in the three worlds. It is a very auspicious abode of the Siddhas. That merit bestowing holy place of Brahma, the Paramesthin is there.
verses.hindi: विज्ञापितो मुनिगणैर्विश्वात्मा कमलोद्भवः । ध्यात्वा देवं त्रिशूलाङ्कं कृताञ्जलिरभाषत
verses.wordMeaning: There is a holy centre well known in the three worlds. It is a very auspicious abode of the Siddhas. That merit bestowing holy place of Brahma, the Paramesthin is there.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is a holy centre well known in the three worlds. It is a very auspicious abode of the Siddhas. That merit bestowing holy place of Brahma, the Paramesthin is there.

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थेभ्यः परमं तीर्थं ब्रह्मतीर्थमिति श्रुतम् । ब्रह्माणमर्चयित्वा तु ब्रह्मलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: tīrthebhyaḥ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ brahmatīrthamiti śrutam / brahmāṇamarcayitvā tu brahmaloke mahīyate
verses.translation: On knowing that Rudra had come, he danced due to ecstatic delight. Lord Rudra spoke to him—"Why did you dance?"
verses.hindi: सम्प्राप्य पुण्यसंस्कारान्निधीनां परमं निधिम्। उपेक्षितं वृथाचारर्भवद्भिरिह मोहितेः नाना प्रकारके आश्चर्योसे समन्वित, हजारों प्रकारकी प्रभासे सुशोभित और ज्ञान तथा ऐश्वर्यसे युक्त रमणीय आसनपर विराजमान परम रमणीय अप्राकृत दिव्य शरीरके कारण शोभासम्पन्न, मुसकानयुक्त, उज्ज्वल नेत्रोंवाले, महाबाहु,
verses.wordMeaning: On knowing that Rudra had come, he danced due to ecstatic delight. Lord Rudra spoke to him—"Why did you dance?"
verses.commentary: Sense: On knowing that Rudra had come, he danced due to ecstatic delight. Lord Rudra spoke to him—"Why did you dance?"

verses.sanskrit: सरस्वत्या विनशनं प्लक्षप्रस्त्रवणं शुभम् । व्यासतीर्थं परं तीर्थं मैनाकं च नगोत्तमम् । यमुनाप्रभवं चैव सर्वपापविशोधनम्
verses.transliteration: sarasvatyā vinaśanaṃ plakṣaprastravaṇaṃ śubham / vyāsatīrthaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ mainākaṃ ca nagottamam / yamunāprabhavaṃ caiva sarvapāpaviśodhanam
verses.translation: "O leading sage, this is the greatness of penance, there is also another person like you, wherefore did you dance?
verses.hindi: वेदपुरुष (ब्रह्मा)-को देखकर वे (मुनिजन) भूमिपर मस्तक टेककर ईश्वरकी स्तुति करने लगे-- ॥ ४७--४९॥
verses.wordMeaning: "O leading sage, this is the greatness of penance, there is also another person like you, wherefore did you dance?
verses.commentary: Sense: "O leading sage, this is the greatness of penance, there is also another person like you, wherefore did you dance?

verses.sanskrit: पितॄणां दुहिता देवी गन्धकालीति विश्रुता । तस्यां स्नात्वा दिवं याति मृतो जातिस्मरो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: pitṝṇāṃ duhitā devī gandhakālīti viśrutā / tasyāṃ snātvā divaṃ yāti mṛto jātismaro bhavet
verses.translation: On seeing the lord of the Universe smiling and standing there resplendently, the heart of the leading sage became agitated due to fright and he trembled.
verses.hindi: चतुर्मूर्ति चतुर्मुख देवने उनपर प्रसन्न होकर पूछा-- “मुनिश्रेष्ठो। आपके आनेका क्या प्रयोजन है ?' तब सभी मुनियोंने मस्तकपर हाथ जोड़कर उन परमात्मा ब्रह्याको उस (भगवान् शंकरकी दिव्य लीलाके) सम्पूर्ण वृत्तान्तको ऋषियोंने कहा--पवित्र दारुवनमें अत्यन्त सुन्दर कोई पुरुष सम्पूर्ण सुन्दर अङ्गोंबाली अपनी भार्याके साथ नग्न ही प्रविष्ट हुआ। उस ईश्वरने अपने शरीरसे (हमारी) स्त्रियोंके समूहको तथा सभी कन्याओंमें अति
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing the lord of the Universe smiling and standing there resplendently, the heart of the leading sage became agitated due to fright and he trembled.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the lord of the Universe smiling and standing there resplendently, the heart of the leading sage became agitated due to fright and he trembled.

verses.sanskrit: कुबेरतुङ्गं पापघ्नं सिद्धचारणसेवितम् । प्राणांस्तत्र परित्यज्य कुबेरानुचरो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: kuberatuṅgaṃ pāpaghnaṃ siddhacāraṇasevitam / prāṇāṃstatra parityajya kuberānucaro bhavet
verses.translation: He bent down his head before Rudra and with self- control he repeated the verses of Rudradhyaya. The three-eyed lord Isa, favourably disposed towards his devotees, became delighted.
verses.hindi: रमणीय उसकी प्रियाने (हमारे) पुत्रोंको दूषित (अपनी ओर आकृष्ट) किया। हम लोगोंने उस पुरुषको विविध
verses.wordMeaning: He bent down his head before Rudra and with self- control he repeated the verses of Rudradhyaya. The three-eyed lord Isa, favourably disposed towards his devotees, became delighted.
verses.commentary: Sense: He bent down his head before Rudra and with self- control he repeated the verses of Rudradhyaya. The three-eyed lord Isa, favourably disposed towards his devotees, became delighted.

verses.sanskrit: उमातुङ्गमिति ख्यातं यत्र सा रुद्रवल्लभा । तत्राभ्यर्च्य महादेवीं कोसहस्रफलं लभेत्
verses.transliteration: umātuṅgamiti khyātaṃ yatra sā rudravallabhā / tatrābhyarcya mahādevīṃ kosahasraphalaṃ labhet
verses.translation: The great Lord, the fire (the destroyer) of the three cities, explained to him (Mahkanaka) his own (path of) Yoga and about the goddess:
verses.hindi: उसे बहुत मारा और उसके लिङ्गको गिरा दिया, पर तत्काल ही भार्याके साथ भगवान् और लिङ्ग अन्तर्हित हो गये। तभीसे प्राणियोंको भय प्रदान करनेवाले भीषण उत्पात होने लगे हैं॥५२--५५॥ पुरुषोत्तम! वह देव-पुरुष कौन है? हम लोग भयभीत हो गये हैं। अच्युत! हम सब आपकी शरणमें आये हैं। इस संसारमें जो कुछ भी चेष्टा होती हैं, उसे आप अवश्य जानते हैं, इसलिये विश्वेश! अनुग्रह
verses.wordMeaning: The great Lord, the fire (the destroyer) of the three cities, explained to him (Mahkanaka) his own (path of) Yoga and about the goddess:
verses.commentary: Sense: The great Lord, the fire (the destroyer) of the three cities, explained to him (Mahkanaka) his own (path of) Yoga and about the goddess:

verses.sanskrit: भृगुतुङ्गे तपस्तप्तं श्राद्धं दानं तथा कृतम् । कुलान्युभयतः सप्त पुनातीति श्रुतिर्मम
verses.transliteration: bhṛgutuṅge tapastaptaṃ śrāddhaṃ dānaṃ tathā kṛtam / kulānyubhayataḥ sapta punātīti śrutirmama
verses.translation: I am the scorcher of all bonds. I am Kala (Time, Death), Kara and the cause of Kala. Everything consisting of the sentient and the non-sentient is urged by myself.
verses.hindi: कर आप हमारी रक्षा करें
verses.wordMeaning: I am the scorcher of all bonds. I am Kala (Time, Death), Kara and the cause of Kala. Everything consisting of the sentient and the non-sentient is urged by myself.
verses.commentary: Sense: I am the scorcher of all bonds. I am Kala (Time, Death), Kara and the cause of Kala. Everything consisting of the sentient and the non-sentient is urged by myself.

verses.sanskrit: काश्यपस्य महातीर्थं कालसर्पिरिति श्रुतम् । तत्र श्राद्धानि देयानि नित्यं पापक्षयेच्छया
verses.transliteration: kāśyapasya mahātīrthaṃ kālasarpiriti śrutam / tatra śrāddhāni deyāni nityaṃ pāpakṣayecchayā
verses.translation: I am that Person (soul) who is immanent in all and I am verily the Supreme Person. The deluding Potency (Greatest Maya) is the Prakrti consisting of the three Gunas.
verses.hindi: मुनिगणोंके द्वारा इस प्रकार निवेदन किये जानेपर कमलसे उत्पन्न विश्वात्मा (ब्रह्मा)-ने त्रिशूलका चिह धारण करनेवाले देव (शंकर)-का ध्यान करते हुए हाथ जोड़कर इस प्रकार कहा- ब्रह्मा बोले आह! कष्ट है कि आज आप लोगोंका सर्वस्व नष्ट हो गया। आपके बलको धिक्कार है, तपश्चर्याको धिक्कार है, आपका यह सब मिथ्या ही हो गया। पवित्र संस्कारों और निधियोंमें परम
verses.wordMeaning: I am that Person (soul) who is immanent in all and I am verily the Supreme Person. The deluding Potency (Greatest Maya) is the Prakrti consisting of the three Gunas.
verses.commentary: Sense: I am that Person (soul) who is immanent in all and I am verily the Supreme Person. The deluding Potency (Greatest Maya) is the Prakrti consisting of the three Gunas.

verses.sanskrit: दशार्णायां तथा दानं श्राद्धं होमस्तथा जपः । अक्षयं चाव्ययं चैव कृतं भवति सर्वदा
verses.transliteration: daśārṇāyāṃ tathā dānaṃ śrāddhaṃ homastathā japaḥ / akṣayaṃ cāvyayaṃ caiva kṛtaṃ bhavati sarvadā
verses.translation: She is described by the sages as Sakti (Potency), the eternal source of origin of the universe. The creator of the universe enchants the universe by means of the Maya.
verses.hindi: निधिको प्राप्तकर वृथाचारी आप लोगोंने मोहवश उनकी उपेक्षा कर दी
verses.wordMeaning: She is described by the sages as Sakti (Potency), the eternal source of origin of the universe. The creator of the universe enchants the universe by means of the Maya.
verses.commentary: Sense: She is described by the sages as Sakti (Potency), the eternal source of origin of the universe. The creator of the universe enchants the universe by means of the Maya.

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थं द्विजातिभिर्जुष्टं नाम्ना वै कुरुजाङ्गलम् । दत्त्वा तु दानं विधिवद् ब्रह्मलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: tīrthaṃ dvijātibhirjuṣṭaṃ nāmnā vai kurujāṅgalam / dattvā tu dānaṃ vidhivad brahmaloke mahīyate
verses.translation: The Sruti states that the Supreme, unmanifest Narayana is of the form of Maya. In this way, I always establish the entire world.
verses.hindi: कांक्षन्ते योगिनो नित्यं यतन्तो यतयो निधिम्। यमेव तं समासाद्य हा भवद्धिरुपेक्षितम् यं समासाद्य देवानामैश्वर्यमखिलं जगत्। तमासाद्याक्षयनिधिं हा भवद्धिरुपेक्षितम्
verses.wordMeaning: The Sruti states that the Supreme, unmanifest Narayana is of the form of Maya. In this way, I always establish the entire world.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Sruti states that the Supreme, unmanifest Narayana is of the form of Maya. In this way, I always establish the entire world.

verses.sanskrit: वैतरण्यां महातीर्थे स्वर्णवेद्यां तथैव च । धर्मपृष्ठे च सरसि ब्रह्मणः परमे शुभे
verses.transliteration: vaitaraṇyāṃ mahātīrthe svarṇavedyāṃ tathaiva ca / dharmapṛṣṭhe ca sarasi brahmaṇaḥ parame śubhe
verses.translation: This creatorship of the great Atman has been clearly narrated to you. I am the sole lord, beginningless, the primordial Kala. the all-pervading lord, the destroyer (of the Universe).
verses.hindi: तदेवोपेक्षितं दृष्टा निधानं भाग्यवर्जितैः
verses.wordMeaning: This creatorship of the great Atman has been clearly narrated to you. I am the sole lord, beginningless, the primordial Kala. the all-pervading lord, the destroyer (of the Universe).
verses.commentary: Sense: This creatorship of the great Atman has been clearly narrated to you. I am the sole lord, beginningless, the primordial Kala. the all-pervading lord, the destroyer (of the Universe).

verses.sanskrit: भरतस्याश्रमे पुण्ये पुण्ये श्राद्धवटे शुभे । महाह्रदे च कौशिक्यां दत्तं भवति चाक्षयम्
verses.transliteration: bharatasyāśrame puṇye puṇye śrāddhavaṭe śubhe / mahāhrade ca kauśikyāṃ dattaṃ bhavati cākṣayam
verses.translation: (While creating and destroying) I assume the greatest form. I am mentioned as Rudra by the learned men. That supreme Potency (Para Sakti), well-known as goddess Vidya, belongs to me alone.
verses.hindi: एष देवो महादेवो विज्ञेयस्तु महेश्वरः। न तस्य परमं किञ्चित् पदं समधिगम्यते संहरत्येष भगवान् कालो भूत्वा महेश्वर:
verses.wordMeaning: (While creating and destroying) I assume the greatest form. I am mentioned as Rudra by the learned men. That supreme Potency (Para Sakti), well-known as goddess Vidya, belongs to me alone.
verses.commentary: Sense: (While creating and destroying) I assume the greatest form. I am mentioned as Rudra by the learned men. That supreme Potency (Para Sakti), well-known as goddess Vidya, belongs to me alone.

verses.sanskrit: मुञ्जपृष्ठे पदं न्यस्तं महादेवेन धीमता । हिताय सर्वभूतानां नास्तिकानां निदर्शनम्
verses.transliteration: muñjapṛṣṭhe padaṃ nyastaṃ mahādevena dhīmatā / hitāya sarvabhūtānāṃ nāstikānāṃ nidarśanam
verses.translation: The person of Vidya has indeed been visualised by you. So also these principles the Pradhana, the Purusa and Isvara.
verses.hindi: योगी कृतयुगे देवस्त्रेतायां यज्ञ उच्यते। द्वापरे भगवान् कालो धर्मकेतुः कलौ युगे
verses.wordMeaning: The person of Vidya has indeed been visualised by you. So also these principles the Pradhana, the Purusa and Isvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: The person of Vidya has indeed been visualised by you. So also these principles the Pradhana, the Purusa and Isvara.

verses.sanskrit: अल्पेनापि तु कालेन नरो धर्मपरायणः । पाप्मानमुत्सृजत्याशु जीर्णां त्वचमिवोरगः
verses.transliteration: alpenāpi tu kālena naro dharmaparāyaṇaḥ / pāpmānamutsṛjatyāśu jīrṇāṃ tvacamivoragaḥ
verses.translation: The Sruti says; Visnu, Brahma and lord Rudra (are) Kala (?). These three deities are beginningless and end¬ less. They are stabilised in the Brahman alone.
verses.hindi: तमो ह्याग्री रजो ब्रह्मा सत्त्ं विष्णुरिति प्रभुः ूर्तिरन्या स्मृता चास्य दिग्वासा वै शिवा धुवा । यत्र तिष्ठति तद् ब्रह्म योगेन तु समन्वितम्
verses.wordMeaning: The Sruti says; Visnu, Brahma and lord Rudra (are) Kala (?). These three deities are beginningless and end¬ less. They are stabilised in the Brahman alone.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Sruti says; Visnu, Brahma and lord Rudra (are) Kala (?). These three deities are beginningless and end¬ less. They are stabilised in the Brahman alone.

verses.sanskrit: नाम्ना कनकनन्देति तीर्थं त्रैलोक्यविश्रुतम् । उदीच्यां मुञ्जपृष्ठस्य ब्रह्मर्षिगणसेवितम्
verses.transliteration: nāmnā kanakanandeti tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam / udīcyāṃ muñjapṛṣṭhasya brahmarṣigaṇasevitam
verses.translation: The Sruti says that it is unmanifest, imperishable and everything has that as its soul. The great principle is Atman and Bliss. It is consciousness alone, the greatest region.
verses.hindi: सा हि नारायणो देवः परमात्मा सनातनः
verses.wordMeaning: The Sruti says that it is unmanifest, imperishable and everything has that as its soul. The great principle is Atman and Bliss. It is consciousness alone, the greatest region.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Sruti says that it is unmanifest, imperishable and everything has that as its soul. The great principle is Atman and Bliss. It is consciousness alone, the greatest region.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र स्नात्वा दिवं यान्ति सशरीरा द्विजातयः । दत्तं चापि सदा श्राद्धमक्षयं समुदाहृतम् । ऋणैस्त्रिभिर्नरः स्नात्वा मुच्यते क्षीणकल्मषः
