verses.transliteration: tatra snātvā divaṃ yānti saśarīrā dvijātayaḥ / dattaṃ cāpi sadā śrāddhamakṣayaṃ samudāhṛtam / ṛṇaistribhirnaraḥ snātvā mucyate kṣīṇakalmaṣaḥ
verses.translation: The sage propitiated Rudra in that very same place by means of the path of devotion. This holy centre is un¬ equalled, sacred and resorted to by Brahmarsis. By resort¬ ing to this, a scholarly Brahmana is released from all sins.
verses.hindi: योगी लोग तथा यत्न करनेवाले यति लोग जिस निधिको प्राप्त करनेकी नित्य अभिलाषा करते हैं, उसीको प्राकर आप लोगोंने उपेक्षा कर दी, यह बहुत ही कष्टकी बात है। वैदिक लोग जिसकी प्रासिके लिये अनेक प्रकारके यज्ञोंका अनुष्ठान करते हैं, बड़ा कष्ट है कि उन महानिधिको प्राप्तकर भी आप सभीने उनकी उपेक्षा कर दी। हाय! जिसे प्राप्तकर देवताओंके ऐश्वर्य- रूपमें समस्त लोक-लोकान्तर दृष्टिगोचर हो रहे हैं,
verses.wordMeaning: The sage propitiated Rudra in that very same place by means of the path of devotion. This holy centre is un¬ equalled, sacred and resorted to by Brahmarsis. By resort¬ ing to this, a scholarly Brahmana is released from all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sage propitiated Rudra in that very same place by means of the path of devotion. This holy centre is un¬ equalled, sacred and resorted to by Brahmarsis. By resort¬ ing to this, a scholarly Brahmana is released from all sins.

verses.sanskrit: मानसे सरसि स्नात्वा शक्रस्यार्धासनं लभेत् । उत्तरं मानसं गत्वा सिद्धिं प्राप्नोत्यनुत्तमाम्
verses.transliteration: mānase sarasi snātvā śakrasyārdhāsanaṃ labhet / uttaraṃ mānasaṃ gatvā siddhiṃ prāpnotyanuttamām
verses.translation: KP. and Vayu mention Kubertunga, Umatuhga, Bhrgu-tuhga as the best places for Sraddha but their location is uncertain.
verses.hindi: उन अक्षयनिधिको प्राप्तकर आपने उनकी उपेक्षा कर दी
verses.wordMeaning: KP. and Vayu mention Kubertunga, Umatuhga, Bhrgu-tuhga as the best places for Sraddha but their location is uncertain.
verses.commentary: Sense: KP. and Vayu mention Kubertunga, Umatuhga, Bhrgu-tuhga as the best places for Sraddha but their location is uncertain.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मान्निर्वर्तयेच्छ्राद्धं यथाशक्ति यथाबलम् । कामान् सलभते दिव्यान् मोक्षोपायं च विन्दति
verses.transliteration: tasmānnirvartayecchrāddhaṃ yathāśakti yathābalam / kāmān salabhate divyān mokṣopāyaṃ ca vindati
verses.translation: Kausiki, Mod. Kusi (Kosi) which flows through Nepal, Tirhut and joins the Gahga below Patna.
verses.hindi: जिनको प्राप्ति होनेसे मुझे यह विश्वैश्वरत्व प्राप्त हुआ है, उन (समस्त ऐश्वर्यके) निधानका दर्शनकर भाग्यरहित आप लोगोंने (उनको) उपेक्षा कर दी। जिनमें वह अविनाशी दिव्य ऐश्वर्य समाहित है, उन ब्रह्मरूप निधिको प्राप्तकर भी आप लोगोंने अपना सुअवसर खो दिया, यह बड़े कष्टकी बात है। इन्हीं देवको महादेव और महेश्वर समझना चाहिए। इनका परम पद (सर्वोत्कृष्ट ऐश्वर्य) किंचित् भी प्रास नहीं किया जा
verses.wordMeaning: Kausiki, Mod. Kusi (Kosi) which flows through Nepal, Tirhut and joins the Gahga below Patna.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kausiki, Mod. Kusi (Kosi) which flows through Nepal, Tirhut and joins the Gahga below Patna.

verses.sanskrit: पर्वतो हिमवान्नाम नानाधातुविभूषितः । योजनानां सहस्राणि सो ऽशीतिस्त्वायतो गिरिः । सिद्धचारणसंकीर्णो देवर्षिगणसेवितः
verses.transliteration: parvato himavānnāma nānādhātuvibhūṣitaḥ / yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi so 'śītistvāyato giriḥ / siddhacāraṇasaṃkīrṇo devarṣigaṇasevitaḥ
verses.translation: Kausiki, Mod. Kusi (Kosi) which flows through Nepal, Tirhut and joins the Gahga below Patna.
verses.hindi: सकता अर्थात् जाना नहीं जा सकता॥ ६४--६६ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Kausiki, Mod. Kusi (Kosi) which flows through Nepal, Tirhut and joins the Gahga below Patna.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kausiki, Mod. Kusi (Kosi) which flows through Nepal, Tirhut and joins the Gahga below Patna.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र पुष्करिणी रम्या सुषुम्ना नाम नामतः । तत्र गत्वा द्विजो विद्वान् ब्रह्महत्यां विमुञ्चति
verses.transliteration: tatra puṣkariṇī ramyā suṣumnā nāma nāmataḥ / tatra gatvā dvijo vidvān brahmahatyāṃ vimuñcati
verses.translation: Kausiki, Mod. Kusi (Kosi) which flows through Nepal, Tirhut and joins the Gahga below Patna.
verses.hindi: हजारों युग-पर्यन्त रहनेवाले प्रलयकालमें ये ही सनातन भगवान् महेश्वर कालरूप होकर देवताओं, ऋषियों तथा पितरों और समस्त देहधारियोंका संहार (अपनेमें लय) करते हैं। ये ही अद्वितीय अपने तेजसे समस्त प्रजाओंकी सृष्टि करते हैं। चक्र, वज्र तथा श्रीवत्सके चिह्वको धारण करनेवाले ये ही हैं (क्योंकि इनमें तथा श्रीविष्णुमें सर्वथा अभेद है), ये ही देव कृतयुगमें योगी, ्रेतामें यज्ञरूप, द्वापरमें भगवान् काल तथा कलियुगमें
verses.wordMeaning: Kausiki, Mod. Kusi (Kosi) which flows through Nepal, Tirhut and joins the Gahga below Patna.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kausiki, Mod. Kusi (Kosi) which flows through Nepal, Tirhut and joins the Gahga below Patna.

verses.sanskrit: श्राद्धं भवति चाक्षय्यं तत्र दत्तं महोदयम् । तारयेच्च पितॄन् सम्यग् दश पूर्वान् दशापरान्
verses.transliteration: śrāddhaṃ bhavati cākṣayyaṃ tatra dattaṃ mahodayam / tārayecca pitṝn samyag daśa pūrvān daśāparān
verses.translation: Kausiki, Mod. Kusi (Kosi) which flows through Nepal, Tirhut and joins the Gahga below Patna.
verses.hindi: धर्मकेतु कहलाते हैं । रुद्रकी तीन मूर्तियाँ हैं, इन्होंने ही इस विश्वको व्याप्त कर रखा है। तमोगुणके अधिष्ठाताको अग्नि, रजोगुणके अधिष्ठाताको ब्रह्मा तथा सत्त्वगुणके अधिष्ठाताको प्रभु विष्णु कहा गया है॥ ६७--७० ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Kausiki, Mod. Kusi (Kosi) which flows through Nepal, Tirhut and joins the Gahga below Patna.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kausiki, Mod. Kusi (Kosi) which flows through Nepal, Tirhut and joins the Gahga below Patna.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वत्र हिमवान् पुण्यो गङ्गा पुण्या समन्ततः । नद्यः समुद्रगाः पुण्याः समुद्रश्च विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: sarvatra himavān puṇyo gaṅgā puṇyā samantataḥ / nadyaḥ samudragāḥ puṇyāḥ samudraśca viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: Kausiki, Mod. Kusi (Kosi) which flows through Nepal, Tirhut and joins the Gahga below Patna.
verses.hindi: इनकी एक दूसरी मूर्ति है जो दिगम्बरा, शाश्वत तथा शिवात्मिका कहलाती है। उसीमें योगसे युक्त परम ब्रह्म प्रतिष्ठित रहते हैं। जिनको इनके पार्श्वभागमें स्थित भायकि रूपमें आपने देखा है, वे ही सनातन परमात्मा नारायण देव हैं। उनसे ही यह सब उत्पन्न है और उनमें ही यह सब लीन भी हो जाता है। वे ही सबको मोहित करते हैं और वे ही परम गति हैं॥ ७१--७३॥
verses.wordMeaning: Kausiki, Mod. Kusi (Kosi) which flows through Nepal, Tirhut and joins the Gahga below Patna.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kausiki, Mod. Kusi (Kosi) which flows through Nepal, Tirhut and joins the Gahga below Patna.

verses.sanskrit: बदर्याश्रममासाद्य मुच्यते कलिकल्मषात् । तत्र नारायणो देवो नरेणास्ते सनातनः
verses.transliteration: badaryāśramamāsādya mucyate kalikalmaṣāt / tatra nārāyaṇo devo nareṇāste sanātanaḥ
verses.translation: Kausiki, Mod. Kusi (Kosi) which flows through Nepal, Tirhut and joins the Gahga below Patna.
verses.hindi: एकशृङ्गो महानात्मा पुराणोऽष्टाक्षरो हरिः
verses.wordMeaning: Kausiki, Mod. Kusi (Kosi) which flows through Nepal, Tirhut and joins the Gahga below Patna.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kausiki, Mod. Kusi (Kosi) which flows through Nepal, Tirhut and joins the Gahga below Patna.

verses.sanskrit: अक्षयं तत्र दानं स्यात् जप्यं वापि तथाविधम् । महादेवप्रियं तीर्थं पावनं तद् विशेषतः । तारयेच्च पितॄन् सर्वान् दत्त्वा श्राद्धं समाहितः
verses.transliteration: akṣayaṃ tatra dānaṃ syāt japyaṃ vāpi tathāvidham / mahādevapriyaṃ tīrthaṃ pāvanaṃ tad viśeṣataḥ / tārayecca pitṝn sarvān dattvā śrāddhaṃ samāhitaḥ
verses.translation: Kausiki, Mod. Kusi (Kosi) which flows through Nepal, Tirhut and joins the Gahga below Patna.
verses.hindi: 'एकमूर्तिरमेयात्मा नारायण इति श्रुतिः ऋतस्य गर्भा भगवानापो मायातनुः प्रभुः । स्तूयते विविधैर्मन्त्रर्ब्राह्मणैर्धर्ममोक्षिभिः
verses.wordMeaning: Kausiki, Mod. Kusi (Kosi) which flows through Nepal, Tirhut and joins the Gahga below Patna.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kausiki, Mod. Kusi (Kosi) which flows through Nepal, Tirhut and joins the Gahga below Patna.

verses.sanskrit: देवदारुवनं पुण्यं सिद्धगन्धर्वसेवितम् । महादेवेन देवेन तत्र दत्तं महद् वरं
verses.transliteration: devadāruvanaṃ puṇyaṃ siddhagandharvasevitam / mahādevena devena tatra dattaṃ mahad varaṃ
verses.translation: Kausiki, Mod. Kusi (Kosi) which flows through Nepal, Tirhut and joins the Gahga below Patna.
verses.hindi: तं मां वित्त महात्मानं ब्रह्माणं विश्वतोमुखम् । महान्तं पुरुषं विश्वमपां गर्भमनुत्तमम्
verses.wordMeaning: Kausiki, Mod. Kusi (Kosi) which flows through Nepal, Tirhut and joins the Gahga below Patna.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kausiki, Mod. Kusi (Kosi) which flows through Nepal, Tirhut and joins the Gahga below Patna.

verses.sanskrit: मोहयित्वा मुनीन् सर्वान् पुनस्तैः संप्रपूजितः । प्रसन्नो भगवानीशो मुनीन्द्रान् प्राह भावितान्
verses.transliteration: mohayitvā munīn sarvān punastaiḥ saṃprapūjitaḥ / prasanno bhagavānīśo munīndrān prāha bhāvitān
verses.translation: Kausiki, Mod. Kusi (Kosi) which flows through Nepal, Tirhut and joins the Gahga below Patna.
verses.hindi: देवदेवं महादेवं भूतानामीश्वरं हरम् एष देवो महादेवो ह्यनादिर्भगवान् हरः। विष्णुना सह संयुक्तः करोति विकरोति च
verses.wordMeaning: Kausiki, Mod. Kusi (Kosi) which flows through Nepal, Tirhut and joins the Gahga below Patna.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kausiki, Mod. Kusi (Kosi) which flows through Nepal, Tirhut and joins the Gahga below Patna.

verses.sanskrit: इहाश्रमवरे रम्ये निवसिष्यथ सर्वदा । मद्भावनासमायुक्तास्ततः सिद्धिमवाप्स्यथ
verses.transliteration: ihāśramavare ramye nivasiṣyatha sarvadā / madbhāvanāsamāyuktāstataḥ siddhimavāpsyatha
verses.translation: Kausiki, Mod. Kusi (Kosi) which flows through Nepal, Tirhut and joins the Gahga below Patna.
verses.hindi: न तस्य विद्यते कार्य न तस्माद् विद्यते परम् स वेदान् प्रददौ पूर्व योगमायातनुर्मम
verses.wordMeaning: Kausiki, Mod. Kusi (Kosi) which flows through Nepal, Tirhut and joins the Gahga below Patna.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kausiki, Mod. Kusi (Kosi) which flows through Nepal, Tirhut and joins the Gahga below Patna.

verses.sanskrit: ये ऽत्र मामर्चयन्तीह लोके धर्मपरा जनाः । तेषां ददामि परमं गाणपत्यं हि शाश्वतम्
verses.transliteration: ye 'tra māmarcayantīha loke dharmaparā janāḥ / teṣāṃ dadāmi paramaṃ gāṇapatyaṃ hi śāśvatam
verses.translation: Kausiki, Mod. Kusi (Kosi) which flows through Nepal, Tirhut and joins the Gahga below Patna.
verses.hindi: महान् आत्मा पुराण (शाश्‍वत) पुरुष हरि एक श्ृंगधारी (अनन्त ब्रह्माण्डको एक श्रृंग-रूपमें धारण चरणवाले हैं। श्रुतिका कथन है कि नारायण चतुर्वेद, चतुर्मूर्ति, त्रिमूर्ति एवं त्रिगुण होते हुए भी एकमूर्ति तथा अमेयात्मा हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Kausiki, Mod. Kusi (Kosi) which flows through Nepal, Tirhut and joins the Gahga below Patna.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kausiki, Mod. Kusi (Kosi) which flows through Nepal, Tirhut and joins the Gahga below Patna.

verses.sanskrit: अत्र नित्यं वसिष्यामि सह नारायणेन च । प्राणानिह नरस्त्यक्त्वा न भूयो जन्म विन्दति
verses.transliteration: atra nityaṃ vasiṣyāmi saha nārāyaṇena ca / prāṇāniha narastyaktvā na bhūyo janma vindati
verses.translation: Kausiki, Mod. Kusi (Kosi) which flows through Nepal, Tirhut and joins the Gahga below Patna.
verses.hindi: माया (-से विविध) शरीर धारण करनेवाले तथा (समस्त जगतूके जीवन-जलको ही अपने आयतनके रूपमें स्वीकार करनेवाले) जलस्वरूप प्रभु भगवान् कर्मफलके एकमात्र अधिष्ठाता हैं। धर्म तथा मोक्षकी
verses.wordMeaning: Kausiki, Mod. Kusi (Kosi) which flows through Nepal, Tirhut and joins the Gahga below Patna.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kausiki, Mod. Kusi (Kosi) which flows through Nepal, Tirhut and joins the Gahga below Patna.

verses.sanskrit: संस्मरन्ति च ये तीर्थं देशान्तरगता जनाः । तेषां च सर्वपापानि नाशयामि द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: saṃsmaranti ca ye tīrthaṃ deśāntaragatā janāḥ / teṣāṃ ca sarvapāpāni nāśayāmi dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: Kausiki, Mod. Kusi (Kosi) which flows through Nepal, Tirhut and joins the Gahga below Patna.
verses.hindi: इच्छा करनेवाले ब्राह्मण लोग विविध मन्त्रोंके द्वारा (उनकी) स्तुति करते हैं। कल्पान्तमें समस्त विश्वका संहार करनेके अनन्तर योगामृतका पानकर पुरुषोत्तम (भगवान् शंकर) जिस सर्वाधिष्ठान, स्वप्रकाशमें शयन (परम विश्रान्तिका अनुभव) करते हैं, वही विष्णु नामका परम पद है। विश्वकी सृष्टि करनेवाले ये न जन्म लेते हैं, न मरते हैं और न वृद्धिको प्राप्त होते हैं। वैदिक लोग इन्हीं अजन्मा (भगवान्)-को अव्यक्त
verses.wordMeaning: Kausiki, Mod. Kusi (Kosi) which flows through Nepal, Tirhut and joins the Gahga below Patna.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kausiki, Mod. Kusi (Kosi) which flows through Nepal, Tirhut and joins the Gahga below Patna.

verses.sanskrit: श्राद्धं दानं तपो होमः पिण्डनिर्वपणं तथा । ध्यानं जपश्च नियमः सर्वमत्राक्षयं कृतम्
verses.transliteration: śrāddhaṃ dānaṃ tapo homaḥ piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ tathā / dhyānaṃ japaśca niyamaḥ sarvamatrākṣayaṃ kṛtam
verses.translation: Kausiki, Mod. Kusi (Kosi) which flows through Nepal, Tirhut and joins the Gahga below Patna.
verses.hindi: मूलप्रकृति कहते हैं॥ ७६--७८॥
verses.wordMeaning: Kausiki, Mod. Kusi (Kosi) which flows through Nepal, Tirhut and joins the Gahga below Patna.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kausiki, Mod. Kusi (Kosi) which flows through Nepal, Tirhut and joins the Gahga below Patna.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन द्रष्टव्यं हि द्विजातिभिः । देवदारुवनं पुण्यं महादेवनिषेवितम्
verses.transliteration: tasmāt sarvaprayatnena draṣṭavyaṃ hi dvijātibhiḥ / devadāruvanaṃ puṇyaṃ mahādevaniṣevitam
verses.translation: Kausiki, Mod. Kusi (Kosi) which flows through Nepal, Tirhut and joins the Gahga below Patna.
verses.hindi: ये महेश्वर (प्रलयरूपी) रात्रिके बीत जानेपर सम्पूर्ण जगत्को सृष्टिको इच्छासे अजकी नाभिमें इस (सृष्टि)-के बीजको स्थापित करते हैं। उन (अज)- के रूपमें मुझे ही आप लोग जानें। मैं ही समस्त लोकोंका मूल होनेके कारण महात्मा, ब्रह्मा, सर्वतोमुख,
verses.wordMeaning: Kausiki, Mod. Kusi (Kosi) which flows through Nepal, Tirhut and joins the Gahga below Patna.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kausiki, Mod. Kusi (Kosi) which flows through Nepal, Tirhut and joins the Gahga below Patna.

verses.sanskrit: यत्रेस्वरो महादेवो विष्णुर्वा पुरुषोत्तमः । तत्र सन्निहिता गङ्गातीर्थान्यायतनानि च
verses.transliteration: yatresvaro mahādevo viṣṇurvā puruṣottamaḥ / tatra sannihitā gaṅgātīrthānyāyatanāni ca
verses.translation: Kausiki, Mod. Kusi (Kosi) which flows through Nepal, Tirhut and joins the Gahga below Patna.
verses.hindi: का अधिष्ठाता सर्वोत्तम देव हूँ। अनन्त ब्रह्माण्डके बीजको मेरेमें स्थापित करनेवाले उन परमपिता देवाधिपति महादेव हरको आप लोग उनकी मायासे मोहित होनेके कारण नहीं जान सके॥ ७९--८१॥
verses.wordMeaning: Kausiki, Mod. Kusi (Kosi) which flows through Nepal, Tirhut and joins the Gahga below Patna.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kausiki, Mod. Kusi (Kosi) which flows through Nepal, Tirhut and joins the Gahga below Patna.

verses.sanskrit: इती श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे षट्त्रिशो ऽध्यायः ऋषय ऊचुः कथं दारुवनं प्राप्तो भगवान् गोवृषध्वजः । मोहयामास विप्रेन्द्रान् सूत वक्तुमिहार्हसि
verses.transliteration: itī śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge ṣaṭtriśo 'dhyāyaḥ ṛṣaya ūcuḥ kathaṃ dāruvanaṃ prāpto bhagavān govṛṣadhvajaḥ / mohayāmāsa viprendrān sūta vaktumihārhasi
verses.translation: The quiescent devotees of Pasupati, with their bodies dusted with holy ashes and engaged in the study of the Vedas, worship Mahadeva there.
verses.hindi: वे ही अनादि देव भगवान् महादेव हर विष्णुके साथ युक्त होकर सृष्टि और संहार करते रहते हैं। उनका कोई कार्य (कर्तव्य) नहीं है और उनसे श्रेष्ठ कोई नहीं है। योगमायामय शरीर धारण करनेवाले उन्होंने पूर्वकालमें स मायी मायया सर्व करोति विकरोति च। तमेव मुक्तये ज्ञात्वा ब्रजेत शरणं भवम्
verses.wordMeaning: The quiescent devotees of Pasupati, with their bodies dusted with holy ashes and engaged in the study of the Vedas, worship Mahadeva there.
verses.commentary: Sense: The quiescent devotees of Pasupati, with their bodies dusted with holy ashes and engaged in the study of the Vedas, worship Mahadeva there.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच पुरा दारुवन् रम्ये देवसिद्धनिषेविते । सपुत्रदारा मुनयस्तपश्चेरुः सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca purā dāruvan ramye devasiddhaniṣevite / saputradārā munayastapaśceruḥ sahasraśaḥ
verses.translation: One who takes his bath, sees the foot-print of god Siva with great devotion and makes obeisance with bowing head, shall attain Rudra's proximity (i.e. liberation called Samipata).
verses.hindi: प्रणम्य देवं ब्रह्माणं पृच्छन्ति स्म सुदुःखिताः
verses.wordMeaning: One who takes his bath, sees the foot-print of god Siva with great devotion and makes obeisance with bowing head, shall attain Rudra's proximity (i.e. liberation called Samipata).
verses.commentary: Sense: One who takes his bath, sees the foot-print of god Siva with great devotion and makes obeisance with bowing head, shall attain Rudra's proximity (i.e. liberation called Samipata).

verses.sanskrit: प्रवृत्तं विविधं कर्म प्रकुर्वाणा यथाविधि । यजन्ति विविधैर्यज्ञैस्तपन्ति च महर्षयः
verses.transliteration: pravṛttaṃ vividhaṃ karma prakurvāṇā yathāvidhi / yajanti vividhairyajñaistapanti ca maharṣayaḥ
verses.translation: Mainaka is located at Badari, west of Gujarat and near the Sara- svati. Dey ( ) regards the range of Sewalik hills from the Gahga to the Beas.
verses.hindi: कथं पश्येम तं देवं पुनरेव पिनाकिनम्। ब्रूहि विश्वामरेशान त्राता त्वं शरणैषिणाम् पूजयध्वं सपत्नीकाः सादरं पुत्रसंयुताः । वैदिकैरेव नियमैर्विविधैर्त्रह्मचारिणः
verses.wordMeaning: Mainaka is located at Badari, west of Gujarat and near the Sara- svati. Dey ( ) regards the range of Sewalik hills from the Gahga to the Beas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Mainaka is located at Badari, west of Gujarat and near the Sara- svati. Dey ( ) regards the range of Sewalik hills from the Gahga to the Beas.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां प्रवृत्तिविन्यस्तचेतसामथ शूलधृक् । ख्यापयन् स महादोषं ययौ दारुवनं हरः
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ pravṛttivinyastacetasāmatha śūladhṛk / khyāpayan sa mahādoṣaṃ yayau dāruvanaṃ haraḥ
verses.translation: One who takes bath there, worships the bull-bannered Mahadeva and drinks the pure water, shall attain the chief¬ tainship of the Ganas.
verses.hindi: संस्थाप्य शां करै मन्त्रैक्रग्यजुःसामसम्भवैः । तप: परं समास्थाय गृणन्तः शतरुद्वियम्
verses.wordMeaning: One who takes bath there, worships the bull-bannered Mahadeva and drinks the pure water, shall attain the chief¬ tainship of the Ganas.
verses.commentary: Sense: One who takes bath there, worships the bull-bannered Mahadeva and drinks the pure water, shall attain the chief¬ tainship of the Ganas.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा विश्वगुरुं विष्णुं पार्श्वे देवो महेश्वरः । ययौ निवृत्तविज्ञानस्थापनार्थं च शङ्करः
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā viśvaguruṃ viṣṇuṃ pārśve devo maheśvaraḥ / yayau nivṛttavijñānasthāpanārthaṃ ca śaṅkaraḥ
verses.translation: Another holy spot is Magadharanya. It bestows good goal on all the people (v.l. giving access to heavenly region). On going there, an excellent Brahmana attains everlasting heavenly pleasures.
verses.hindi: ततो द्रक्ष्यथ देवेशं दुर्दर्शमकृतात्मभि: । यं दृष्टा सर्वमज्ञानमधर्मश्च प्रणश्यति ततः प्रणम्य वरदं ब्रह्माणममितौजसम्। जग्मुः संहृष्टमनसो देवदारुवनं पुनः
verses.wordMeaning: Another holy spot is Magadharanya. It bestows good goal on all the people (v.l. giving access to heavenly region). On going there, an excellent Brahmana attains everlasting heavenly pleasures.
verses.commentary: Sense: Another holy spot is Magadharanya. It bestows good goal on all the people (v.l. giving access to heavenly region). On going there, an excellent Brahmana attains everlasting heavenly pleasures.

verses.sanskrit: आस्थाय विपुलं वेशमूनविंशतिवत्सरः । लीलालसो महाबाहुः पीनाङ्गश्चारुलोचनः
verses.transliteration: āsthāya vipulaṃ veśamūnaviṃśativatsaraḥ / līlālaso mahābāhuḥ pīnāṅgaścārulocanaḥ
verses.translation: The meritorious holy centre Kanakhala® is destructive of great sins. It was here that the sacrifice of Daksa was destroyed by Rudra.
verses.hindi: आराधयितुमारब्धा ब्रह्मणा कथितः यथा। अजानन्तः परं देवं वीतरागा विमत्सराः
verses.wordMeaning: The meritorious holy centre Kanakhala® is destructive of great sins. It was here that the sacrifice of Daksa was destroyed by Rudra.
verses.commentary: Sense: The meritorious holy centre Kanakhala® is destructive of great sins. It was here that the sacrifice of Daksa was destroyed by Rudra.

verses.sanskrit: चामीकरवपुः श्रीमान् पूर्णचन्द्रनिभाननः । मत्तमातङ्गगामनो दिग्वासा जगदीश्वरः
verses.transliteration: cāmīkaravapuḥ śrīmān pūrṇacandranibhānanaḥ / mattamātaṅgagāmano digvāsā jagadīśvaraḥ
verses.translation: By bathing in the river Gahga there, a pure man endowed with noble feelings, is freed from all sins and he shall stay in the region of god Brahma.
verses.hindi: शैवालभोजनाः केचित् केचिदन्तर्जलेशयाः । केचिदभ्रावकाशास्तु पादाङ्गष्ठाग्रविष्ठिताः वे मायी (अपनी) मायाद्वारा सभीकी सृष्टि और संहार करते हैं। उन्हें ही मुक्तिका मूल समझकर उन भवकी ही शरणमें जाना चाहिए। भगवान् (ब्रह्मा)- के ऐसा कहनेपर मरीचि आदि प्रमुख ऋषियोंने विभु
verses.wordMeaning: By bathing in the river Gahga there, a pure man endowed with noble feelings, is freed from all sins and he shall stay in the region of god Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: By bathing in the river Gahga there, a pure man endowed with noble feelings, is freed from all sins and he shall stay in the region of god Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: कुशेशयमयीं मालं सर्वरत्नैरलङ्कृताम् । दधानो भगवानीशः समागच्छति सस्मितः
verses.transliteration: kuśeśayamayīṃ mālaṃ sarvaratnairalaṅkṛtām / dadhāno bhagavānīśaḥ samāgacchati sasmitaḥ
verses.translation: The holy centre well-known as Mahatirtha is sacred and a favourite of Narayana. One who worships Hrsikesa (Visnu) there goes so Svetadvipa (the abode of Narayana).
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मदेवको प्रणामकर अत्यन्त दुःखित होकर उनसे पूछा--
verses.wordMeaning: The holy centre well-known as Mahatirtha is sacred and a favourite of Narayana. One who worships Hrsikesa (Visnu) there goes so Svetadvipa (the abode of Narayana).
verses.commentary: Sense: The holy centre well-known as Mahatirtha is sacred and a favourite of Narayana. One who worships Hrsikesa (Visnu) there goes so Svetadvipa (the abode of Narayana).

verses.sanskrit: यो ऽनन्तः पुरुषो योनिर्लोकानामव्ययो हरिः । स्त्रीवेषं विष्णुरास्थाय सो ऽनुगच्छति शूलिनम्
verses.transliteration: yo 'nantaḥ puruṣo yonirlokānāmavyayo hariḥ / strīveṣaṃ viṣṇurāsthāya so 'nugacchati śūlinam
verses.translation: Another excellent holy centre is the auspicious one by the name Sriparvata. On abandoning the vital airs here, one shall become the beloved of Rudra.
verses.hindi: मुनिजन बोले समस्त देवोंके स्वामी! उन पिनाकधारी देवका दर्शन हम पुन: किस प्रकार कर पायेंगे, आप हमें बतायें। आप शरण चाहनेवालोंकी रक्षा करनेवाले हैं पितामहने कहा--पृथ्वीपर गिराये गये उनके (महेश्‍्वरके) जिस लिङ्गको आप लोगोंने देखा था, उसी लिङ्गके समान श्रेष्ठ लिङ्ग बनाकर सपत्नीक तथा पुत्रोंसहित आदरपूर्वक विविध वैदिक मन्त्रॉसे
verses.wordMeaning: Another excellent holy centre is the auspicious one by the name Sriparvata. On abandoning the vital airs here, one shall become the beloved of Rudra.
verses.commentary: Sense: Another excellent holy centre is the auspicious one by the name Sriparvata. On abandoning the vital airs here, one shall become the beloved of Rudra.

verses.sanskrit: सम्पूर्णचन्द्रवदनं पीनोन्नतपयोधरम् । शुचिस्मितं सुप्रसन्नं रणन्नुपुरकद्वयम्
verses.transliteration: sampūrṇacandravadanaṃ pīnonnatapayodharam / śucismitaṃ suprasannaṃ raṇannupurakadvayam
verses.translation: Rudra, Mahesvara, is ever present there accom¬ panied by the goddess. Bathing there and offering Pindas etc. shall be excellent and everlasting.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मचर्यपूर्वक आप लोग उसको पूजा करें। ऋग्वेद, यजुर्वेद तथा सामवेदमें कहे गये शंकरके मन्त्रोसे (लिङ्गको) स्थापना कर परम तपका अवलम्बन कर, शतरुद्रियका जप करते हुए समाहित होकर बन्धुओं
verses.wordMeaning: Rudra, Mahesvara, is ever present there accom¬ panied by the goddess. Bathing there and offering Pindas etc. shall be excellent and everlasting.
verses.commentary: Sense: Rudra, Mahesvara, is ever present there accom¬ panied by the goddess. Bathing there and offering Pindas etc. shall be excellent and everlasting.

verses.sanskrit: सुपीतवसनं दिव्यं श्यामलं चारुलोचनम् । उदारहंसचलनं विलासि सुमनोहरम्
verses.transliteration: supītavasanaṃ divyaṃ śyāmalaṃ cārulocanam / udārahaṃsacalanaṃ vilāsi sumanoharam
verses.translation: At the source-place of Kaveri, there is a well-known holy centre named Candratirtha. What is given in that holy centre is of ever-lasting benefit. It yields good goal i.e. the heaven to those who die there.
verses.hindi: तथा पुत्रॉंसहित आप सभी लोग हाथ जोड़कर शूलपाणिकी शरणमें जायें। तदनन्तर आप लोग अकृतात्माओंके लिये दुर्दर्श उन देवेशवरका दर्शन करेंगे, जिनको देख लेनेपर सम्पूर्ण अज्ञान और अधर्म दूर हो जाता है॥ ८७--९१॥
verses.wordMeaning: At the source-place of Kaveri, there is a well-known holy centre named Candratirtha. What is given in that holy centre is of ever-lasting benefit. It yields good goal i.e. the heaven to those who die there.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the source-place of Kaveri, there is a well-known holy centre named Candratirtha. What is given in that holy centre is of ever-lasting benefit. It yields good goal i.e. the heaven to those who die there.

verses.sanskrit: एवं स भगवानीशो देवदारुवने हरः । चचार हरिणा भिक्षां मायया मोहयन् जगत्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ sa bhagavānīśo devadāruvane haraḥ / cacāra hariṇā bhikṣāṃ māyayā mohayan jagat
verses.translation: O Brahmana, those devotees who see Sadasiva the lord of Devas at the foot of the Vindhyas, do not see the face of Yama (the god of Death).
verses.hindi: तब अमित ओजस्वी वरदाता ब्रह्माको प्रणामकर प्रसन्नमनवाले वे सभी महर्षि पुनः देवदारु-वनकी ओर चले गये और परम देवको न जानते हुए भी उन महर्षियोंने राग एवं मात्सर्यसे रहित होकर
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmana, those devotees who see Sadasiva the lord of Devas at the foot of the Vindhyas, do not see the face of Yama (the god of Death).
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmana, those devotees who see Sadasiva the lord of Devas at the foot of the Vindhyas, do not see the face of Yama (the god of Death).

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा चरन्तं विश्वेशं तत्र तत्र पिनाकिनम् । मायया मोहिता नार्यो देवदेवं समन्वयुः
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā carantaṃ viśveśaṃ tatra tatra pinākinam / māyayā mohitā nāryo devadevaṃ samanvayuḥ
verses.translation: At Devika (?), there is the holy centre named Vrsa. It is resorted to by Siddhas. One who takes bath there and libation, attains perfection in Yoga.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्माजीने जैसा बताया था, तदनुसार अनेकविध यज्ञीय वेदियों, पर्वतोंकी गुफाओं तथा जनशून्य नदियोंके सुन्दर किनारोंपर भगवान् शंकरकी आराधना प्रारम्भ कर दी कुछ लोग शैवालका भोजन करते हुए, कुछ जलके अंदर शयनकी मुद्रामें स्थित रहते हुए तथा कुछ लोग खुले आकाशके नीचे पैरके अँगूठेके अग्रभागपर स्थित रहकर श्रीशंकरकी आराधनामें दत्तचित्त
verses.wordMeaning: At Devika (?), there is the holy centre named Vrsa. It is resorted to by Siddhas. One who takes bath there and libation, attains perfection in Yoga.
verses.commentary: Sense: At Devika (?), there is the holy centre named Vrsa. It is resorted to by Siddhas. One who takes bath there and libation, attains perfection in Yoga.

verses.sanskrit: विस्त्रस्तवस्त्राभरणास्त्यक्त्वा लज्जां पतिव्रताः । सहैव तेन कामार्ता विलासिन्यश्चरन्तिहि
verses.transliteration: vistrastavastrābharaṇāstyaktvā lajjāṃ pativratāḥ / sahaiva tena kāmārtā vilāsinyaścarantihi
verses.translation: The holy centre Dasasvamedhika is destructive of allusions. A man obtains the benefit of performing ten Asvamed- has (horse-sacrifices) therein.
verses.hindi: कुछ दूसरे दन्तोलूखली अर्थात् दाँतोंके ही द्वारा
verses.wordMeaning: The holy centre Dasasvamedhika is destructive of allusions. A man obtains the benefit of performing ten Asvamed- has (horse-sacrifices) therein.
verses.commentary: Sense: The holy centre Dasasvamedhika is destructive of allusions. A man obtains the benefit of performing ten Asvamed- has (horse-sacrifices) therein.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषीणां पुत्रका ये स्युर्युवानो जितमानसाः । अन्वगच्छन् हृषीकेशं सर्वे कामप्रपीडिताः
verses.transliteration: ṛṣīṇāṃ putrakā ye syuryuvāno jitamānasāḥ / anvagacchan hṛṣīkeśaṃ sarve kāmaprapīḍitāḥ
verses.translation: The holy centre named Pundarika is beautified by the Brahmanas. A person of self-control approaching it, shall obtain the benefit of Pundarika (sacrifice).
verses.hindi: शाकपर्णाशिनः केचित् सम्प्रक्षाला मरीचिपाः ९६ ॥ वृक्षमूलनिकेताश्च शिलाशय्यास्तथा परे। कालं नयन्ति तपसा पूजयन्तो महेश्वरम्
verses.wordMeaning: The holy centre named Pundarika is beautified by the Brahmanas. A person of self-control approaching it, shall obtain the benefit of Pundarika (sacrifice).
verses.commentary: Sense: The holy centre named Pundarika is beautified by the Brahmanas. A person of self-control approaching it, shall obtain the benefit of Pundarika (sacrifice).

verses.sanskrit: गायन्ति नृत्यन्ति विलासबाह्या नारीगणा मायिनमेकमीशम् । दृष्ट्वा सपत्नीकमतीवकान्त- मिच्छन्त्यथालिङ्गनमाचरन्ति
verses.transliteration: gāyanti nṛtyanti vilāsabāhyā nārīgaṇā māyinamekamīśam / dṛṣṭvā sapatnīkamatīvakānta- micchantyathāliṅganamācaranti
verses.translation: The grestest among the holy centres is named Brahmatirtha. On worshipping god Brahma here, one is honoured in the world of Brahma.
verses.hindi: चकार भगवान् बुद्धि प्रबोधाय वृषध्वजः
verses.wordMeaning: The grestest among the holy centres is named Brahmatirtha. On worshipping god Brahma here, one is honoured in the world of Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: The grestest among the holy centres is named Brahmatirtha. On worshipping god Brahma here, one is honoured in the world of Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: पदे निपेतुः स्मितमाचरन्ति गायन्ति गीतानि मुनीशपुत्राः । आलोक्य पद्मापतिमादिदेवं भ्रूभङ्गमन्ये विचरन्ति तेन
verses.transliteration: pade nipetuḥ smitamācaranti gāyanti gītāni munīśaputrāḥ / ālokya padmāpatimādidevaṃ bhrūbhaṅgamanye vicaranti tena
verses.translation: There are some holy centres as these: The Vinasana® where the river Sarasvatl lost itself in the sand, the auspicious Plaksa-prasravana (the source of the Sarasvatl), that which is known as Vyasatlrtha and the excellent mountain Mainaka.®
verses.hindi: देवः कृतयुगे ह्यस्मिन् शृङ्गे हिमवतः शुभे। देवदारुवनं प्राप्तः प्रसन्नः परमेश्वर: मायां कृत्वात्मनो रूपं देवस्तद् वनमागतः
verses.wordMeaning: There are some holy centres as these: The Vinasana® where the river Sarasvatl lost itself in the sand, the auspicious Plaksa-prasravana (the source of the Sarasvatl), that which is known as Vyasatlrtha and the excellent mountain Mainaka.®
verses.commentary: Sense: There are some holy centres as these: The Vinasana® where the river Sarasvatl lost itself in the sand, the auspicious Plaksa-prasravana (the source of the Sarasvatl), that which is known as Vyasatlrtha and the excellent mountain Mainaka.®

verses.sanskrit: आसामथैषामपि वासुदेवो मायी मुरारिर्मनसि प्रविष्टः । करोति भोगान् मनसि प्रवृत्तिं मायानुभूयन्त इतिव सम्यक्
verses.transliteration: āsāmathaiṣāmapi vāsudevo māyī murārirmanasi praviṣṭaḥ / karoti bhogān manasi pravṛttiṃ māyānubhūyanta itiva samyak
verses.translation: The Sraddha offered there is cited to be everlasting. On taking the bath, a man reduces his sins and he is freed from the threefold indebtedness to god, sages and manes.
verses.hindi: कृत्वा गिरिसुतां गौरीं पार्श्वे देवः पिनाकधृक् । सा च पूर्ववद् देवेशी देवदारुवनं गता
verses.wordMeaning: The Sraddha offered there is cited to be everlasting. On taking the bath, a man reduces his sins and he is freed from the threefold indebtedness to god, sages and manes.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Sraddha offered there is cited to be everlasting. On taking the bath, a man reduces his sins and he is freed from the threefold indebtedness to god, sages and manes.

verses.sanskrit: विभाति विश्वामरभूतभर्ता स माधवः स्त्रीगणमध्यविष्टः । अशेषशक्त्यासनसंनिविष्टो यथैकशक्त्या सह देवदेवः
verses.transliteration: vibhāti viśvāmarabhūtabhartā sa mādhavaḥ strīgaṇamadhyaviṣṭaḥ / aśeṣaśaktyāsanasaṃniviṣṭo yathaikaśaktyā saha devadevaḥ
verses.translation: By means of ablution in the Manasa-lake one shall obtain half the throne of god Indra. On going to the Uttara- manasa one achieves very excellent Siddhis (mystic powers).
verses.hindi: दृष्टा समागतं देवं देव्या सह कपर्दिनम्। प्रणेमुः शिरसा भूमौ तोषयामासुरीश्वरम् अनाजको तुष (भूसी) आदिसे रहितकर बिना पकाये खा लेते थे, कुछ दूसरे पत्थरपर ही अन्नको कूटकर खा लेते थे। कुछ शाक तथा पत्तोंका ही भोजन करते थे, कुछ लोग एक समय भोजन करके अड्भोंकी चिन्ता
verses.wordMeaning: By means of ablution in the Manasa-lake one shall obtain half the throne of god Indra. On going to the Uttara- manasa one achieves very excellent Siddhis (mystic powers).
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of ablution in the Manasa-lake one shall obtain half the throne of god Indra. On going to the Uttara- manasa one achieves very excellent Siddhis (mystic powers).

verses.sanskrit: करोति नृत्यं परमप्रभावं तदा विरूढः पुनरेव भूयः । ययौ समारुह्य हरिः स्वभावं तदीशवृत्तामृतमादिदेवः
verses.transliteration: karoti nṛtyaṃ paramaprabhāvaṃ tadā virūḍhaḥ punareva bhūyaḥ / yayau samāruhya hariḥ svabhāvaṃ tadīśavṛttāmṛtamādidevaḥ
verses.translation: Hence, one should perform Sraddha in accordance with one's capacity and physical strength, thereby he obtains divine pleasures and attains the means of salvation.
verses.hindi: (शारीरिक सौष्ठव आदिको चिन्ता) नहीं रखते थे, कुछ लोग स्नानपरायण एवं कुछ लोग सूर्य-किरणोंका ही पान करते थे। कुछ लोग वृक्षके नीचे रहते थे, दूसरे शिलारूपी शय्यापर ही सोते थे। इस प्रकार तपस्या
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, one should perform Sraddha in accordance with one's capacity and physical strength, thereby he obtains divine pleasures and attains the means of salvation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, one should perform Sraddha in accordance with one's capacity and physical strength, thereby he obtains divine pleasures and attains the means of salvation.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा नारीकुलं रुद्रं पुत्राणामपि केशवम् । मोहयन्तं मुनिश्रेष्ठाः कोपं संदधिरे भृशम्
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā nārīkulaṃ rudraṃ putrāṇāmapi keśavam / mohayantaṃ muniśreṣṭhāḥ kopaṃ saṃdadhire bhṛśam
verses.translation: The mountain named Himavan is bedecked with different kinds of minerals. That mountain is eighty thousand Yojanas in length.
verses.hindi: (विविधाके) द्वारा महेश्वरकी पूजा करते हुए वे (मुनिजन) समय व्यतीत कर रहे थे (मुनियोंको इस प्रकार पश्चात्तापपूर्वक तपस्यामें निरत देखकर) उनकी व्याकुलता दूर करनेके लिये शरणागतोंके दु:खहर्ता भगवान् वृषध्वज हरने उन्हे प्रबोधित (मोहमुक्त) करनेका विचार किया। इसलिये
verses.wordMeaning: The mountain named Himavan is bedecked with different kinds of minerals. That mountain is eighty thousand Yojanas in length.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mountain named Himavan is bedecked with different kinds of minerals. That mountain is eighty thousand Yojanas in length.

verses.sanskrit: अतीव परुषं वाक्यं प्रोचुर्देवं कपर्दिनम् । शेषुश्च शापैर्विविधैर्मायया तस्य मोहिताः
verses.transliteration: atīva paruṣaṃ vākyaṃ procurdevaṃ kapardinam / śeṣuśca śāpairvividhairmāyayā tasya mohitāḥ
verses.translation: Siddhas and Caranas live therein and the mountain is resorted to by the groups of Devas and sages. There is a beautiful Puskarini (holy lake) there named Susumna.
verses.hindi: प्रसन्न परमेश्वर वे देव (शंकर) सत्ययुगमें हिमालयके इस शुभ शिखरपर स्थित देवदारु-बनमें पुनः आये। उनके सारे अङ्ग भस्मसे उपलिप्त होनेके कारण श्वेत वर्णके थे, नग्न थे, विकृत लक्षणवाले थे, हाथमें उल्मुक
verses.wordMeaning: Siddhas and Caranas live therein and the mountain is resorted to by the groups of Devas and sages. There is a beautiful Puskarini (holy lake) there named Susumna.
verses.commentary: Sense: Siddhas and Caranas live therein and the mountain is resorted to by the groups of Devas and sages. There is a beautiful Puskarini (holy lake) there named Susumna.

verses.sanskrit: तपांसि तेषां सर्वेषां प्रत्याहन्यन्त शङ्करे । यथादित्यप्रकाशेन तारका नभसि स्थिताः
verses.transliteration: tapāṃsi teṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ pratyāhanyanta śaṅkare / yathādityaprakāśena tārakā nabhasi sthitāḥ
verses.translation: On going there, a scholarly Brahmana leaves off (is relieved of the sin of) Brahmana slaughter. The Sraddha offered there is inexhaustible and highly flourishing.
verses.hindi: (जलती लकड़ी) लेकर उसे घुमा रहे थे और उनके नेत्र लाल तथा पिंगलवर्णके थे कभी वे भयंकर रूपसे हँसते, कभी आश्चर्ययुक्त हो गान करने लगते, कभी भ्ृंगारपूर्वक नृत्य करने लगते और कभी बार-बार रोने लगते। (इस स्थितिमें भगवान्) महादेव आश्रममें आकर बार-बार भिक्षा
verses.wordMeaning: On going there, a scholarly Brahmana leaves off (is relieved of the sin of) Brahmana slaughter. The Sraddha offered there is inexhaustible and highly flourishing.
verses.commentary: Sense: On going there, a scholarly Brahmana leaves off (is relieved of the sin of) Brahmana slaughter. The Sraddha offered there is inexhaustible and highly flourishing.

verses.sanskrit: ते भग्नतपसो विप्राः समेत्य वृषभध्वजम् । को भवानिति देवेशं पृच्छन्ति स्म विमोहिताः
verses.transliteration: te bhagnatapaso viprāḥ sametya vṛṣabhadhvajam / ko bhavāniti deveśaṃ pṛcchanti sma vimohitāḥ
verses.translation: He shall redeem the Pitrs of ten previous generations and ten later generations. The Himavan is sacred everywhere. TheGahga is sacred all round.
verses.hindi: माँगने लगे। इस प्रकार अपना मायामय रूप बनाकर वे देव (शंकर) उस (देवदारु) वनमें विचरने लगे और उन पिनाकधारी देवने पर्वतपुत्री गौरीको अपने पार्श्वभागमें कर लिया था। वे देवेशी पूर्वके समान ही
verses.wordMeaning: He shall redeem the Pitrs of ten previous generations and ten later generations. The Himavan is sacred everywhere. TheGahga is sacred all round.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall redeem the Pitrs of ten previous generations and ten later generations. The Himavan is sacred everywhere. TheGahga is sacred all round.

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽब्रवीद् भगवानीशस्तपश्चर्तुमिहागतः । इदानीं भार्यया देशे भवद्भिरिह सुव्रताः
verses.transliteration: so 'bravīd bhagavānīśastapaścartumihāgataḥ / idānīṃ bhāryayā deśe bhavadbhiriha suvratāḥ
verses.translation: All the rivers flowing into the ocean are sacred and those oceans are particularly holy. On reaching the hermitage —Badaryasrama, one is released from all sins.
verses.hindi: देवदारु-वनमें महादेवके साथ आयीं देवीके साथ कपर्दी (शंकर) देवको आया देखकर उन्होंने (मुनियोंने) भूमिमें सिर रखकर ईश्वरको प्रणाम किया और स्तुति की। वे विविध वैदिक मन्त्रों, शुभ
verses.wordMeaning: All the rivers flowing into the ocean are sacred and those oceans are particularly holy. On reaching the hermitage —Badaryasrama, one is released from all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the rivers flowing into the ocean are sacred and those oceans are particularly holy. On reaching the hermitage —Badaryasrama, one is released from all sins.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य ते वाक्यमाकर्ण्य भृग्वाद्या मुनिपुङ्गवाः । ऊचुर्गृहीत्वा वसनं त्यक्त्वा भार्यां तपश्चर
verses.transliteration: tasya te vākyamākarṇya bhṛgvādyā munipuṅgavāḥ / ūcurgṛhītvā vasanaṃ tyaktvā bhāryāṃ tapaścara
verses.translation: There stays the eternal lord Narayana along with Nara. The charitable gift as well as the Sraddha offered there, is of everlasting benefit.
verses.hindi: वेदमन्त्रोंसे शंकरको स्तुति करने लगे-
verses.wordMeaning: There stays the eternal lord Narayana along with Nara. The charitable gift as well as the Sraddha offered there, is of everlasting benefit.
verses.commentary: Sense: There stays the eternal lord Narayana along with Nara. The charitable gift as well as the Sraddha offered there, is of everlasting benefit.

verses.sanskrit: अथोवाच विहस्येशः पिनाकी नीललोहितः । संप्रेक्ष्य जगतो योनिं पार्श्वस्थं च जनार्दनम्
verses.transliteration: athovāca vihasyeśaḥ pinākī nīlalohitaḥ / saṃprekṣya jagato yoniṃ pārśvasthaṃ ca janārdanam
verses.translation: That is a holy centre liked by Mahadeva. It is particularly sanctifying. On offering Sraddha with great concentration, one shall redeem the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: + भोज्य अन्नकी स्वादिष्टताके प्रति अनासक्त होनेसे अन्नके परिष्कारके साधन उलूखल तथा सिलको उपयोगमें नहीं लाते थे। (इनके उपयोगमें हिंसा भी होती हें, इसलिये तपस्वी लोग विशेषरूपसे इनका वर्जन करते हैं।) नमो देवादिदेवाय महादेवाय ते नमः। त्यम्बकाय नमस्तुभ्यं त्रिशूलवरधारिणे
verses.wordMeaning: That is a holy centre liked by Mahadeva. It is particularly sanctifying. On offering Sraddha with great concentration, one shall redeem the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: That is a holy centre liked by Mahadeva. It is particularly sanctifying. On offering Sraddha with great concentration, one shall redeem the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: कथं भवद्भिरुदितं स्वभार्यापोषणोत्सुकैः । त्यक्तव्या मम भार्येति धर्मज्ञैः शान्तमानसैः
verses.transliteration: kathaṃ bhavadbhiruditaṃ svabhāryāpoṣaṇotsukaiḥ / tyaktavyā mama bhāryeti dharmajñaiḥ śāntamānasaiḥ
verses.translation: The holy centre Devadaruvana is sacred. It is resorted to by the Siddhas and the Gandharvas as well as by the great lord of Devas. What is offered there is highly flourishing. *
verses.hindi: नमो दिग्वाससे तुभ्यं विकृताय पिनाकिने। सर्वप्रणतदेहाय स्वयमप्रणतात्मने
verses.wordMeaning: The holy centre Devadaruvana is sacred. It is resorted to by the Siddhas and the Gandharvas as well as by the great lord of Devas. What is offered there is highly flourishing. *
verses.commentary: Sense: The holy centre Devadaruvana is sacred. It is resorted to by the Siddhas and the Gandharvas as well as by the great lord of Devas. What is offered there is highly flourishing. *

verses.sanskrit: ऋषय ऊचुः व्यभिचाररता नार्यः संत्याज्याः पतिनेरिताः । अस्माभिरेषा सुभगा तादृशी त्यागमर्हति
verses.transliteration: ṛṣaya ūcuḥ vyabhicāraratā nāryaḥ saṃtyājyāḥ patineritāḥ / asmābhireṣā subhagā tādṛśī tyāgamarhati
verses.translation: After fascinating the sages and on being worship¬ ped by everyone, the delighted lord Isa spoke to the leading sages who had been sanctified.
verses.hindi: अन्तकान्तकृते तुभ्यं सर्वसंहरणाय च। नमोऽस्तु नृत्यशीलाय नमो भैरवरूपिणे विभीषणाय रूद्राय नमस्ते कृत्तिवाससे। नमस्ते लेलिहानाय शितिकण्ठाय ते नम:
verses.wordMeaning: After fascinating the sages and on being worship¬ ped by everyone, the delighted lord Isa spoke to the leading sages who had been sanctified.
verses.commentary: Sense: After fascinating the sages and on being worship¬ ped by everyone, the delighted lord Isa spoke to the leading sages who had been sanctified.

verses.sanskrit: महादेव उवाच न कदाचिदियं विप्रा मनसाप्यन्यमिच्छति । नाहमेनामपि तथा विमुञ्चामि कदाचन
verses.transliteration: mahādeva uvāca na kadācidiyaṃ viprā manasāpyanyamicchati / nāhamenāmapi tathā vimuñcāmi kadācana
verses.translation: "You all shall always stay here in this beautiful and excellent hermitage, with the devotion centering on me. There¬ by you shall obtain Siddhi.
verses.hindi: अघोरघोररूपाय वामदेवाय वै नम: । नमः कनकमालाय देव्याः प्रियकराय च
verses.wordMeaning: "You all shall always stay here in this beautiful and excellent hermitage, with the devotion centering on me. There¬ by you shall obtain Siddhi.
verses.commentary: Sense: "You all shall always stay here in this beautiful and excellent hermitage, with the devotion centering on me. There¬ by you shall obtain Siddhi.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषय ऊचुः दृष्ट्वा व्यभिचरन्तीह ह्यस्माभिः पुरुषाधम । उक्तं ह्यसत्यं भवता गम्यतां क्षिप्रमेव हि
verses.transliteration: ṛṣaya ūcuḥ dṛṣṭvā vyabhicarantīha hyasmābhiḥ puruṣādhama / uktaṃ hyasatyaṃ bhavatā gamyatāṃ kṣiprameva hi
verses.translation: Those who are devoted to Dharma in the world worship me. I grant unto them the eternal great chieftainship of the Ganas.
verses.hindi: नमो योगाधिपतये ब्रह्माधिपतये नमः प्राणाय च नमस्तुभ्यं नमो भस्माङ्करागिणे। नमस्ते घनवाहाय दंष्ट्रिणे वह्निरितसे
verses.wordMeaning: Those who are devoted to Dharma in the world worship me. I grant unto them the eternal great chieftainship of the Ganas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who are devoted to Dharma in the world worship me. I grant unto them the eternal great chieftainship of the Ganas.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्ते महादेवः सत्यमेव मयेरितम् । भवतां प्रतिभात्येषेत्युक्त्वासौ विचचार ह
verses.transliteration: evamukte mahādevaḥ satyameva mayeritam / bhavatāṃ pratibhātyeṣetyuktvāsau vicacāra ha
verses.translation: I will stay here for ever alongwith Narayana. A man abandoning his life here, is not reborn.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मणश्च शिरोहत्रे नमस्ते कालरूपिणे।
verses.wordMeaning: I will stay here for ever alongwith Narayana. A man abandoning his life here, is not reborn.
verses.commentary: Sense: I will stay here for ever alongwith Narayana. A man abandoning his life here, is not reborn.

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽगच्छद्धरिणा सार्धं मुनिन्द्रस्य महात्मनः । वसिष्ठस्याश्रमं पुण्यं भिक्षार्थो परमेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: so 'gacchaddhariṇā sārdhaṃ munindrasya mahātmanaḥ / vasiṣṭhasyāśramaṃ puṇyaṃ bhikṣārtho parameśvaraḥ
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas, those people who have gone to the other lands but who remember this holy centre, will have all their sins dispelled by me.
verses.hindi: विश्वेश्वर महादेव योऽसि सोऽसि नमोऽस्तु ते नमः कनकलिङ्काय वारिलिङ्गाय ते नमः
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahmanas, those people who have gone to the other lands but who remember this holy centre, will have all their sins dispelled by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmanas, those people who have gone to the other lands but who remember this holy centre, will have all their sins dispelled by me.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा समागतं देवं भिक्षमाणमरुन्धती । वसिष्ठस्य प्रिया भार्या प्रत्युद्गम्य ननाम नम्
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā samāgataṃ devaṃ bhikṣamāṇamarundhatī / vasiṣṭhasya priyā bhāryā pratyudgamya nanāma nam
verses.translation: Here all these holy rites are to be performed. If performed, Sraddha, Dana, Tapes (penance), Home, Pinzas, meditation, Japa and other observances are of everlasting benefit.
verses.hindi: नमो वह्नयर्कलिड्राय ज्ञानलिङ्काय ते नम: । नमो भुजंगहाराय कर्णिकारप्रियाय च। किरीटिने कुण्डलिने कालकालाय ते नमः
verses.wordMeaning: Here all these holy rites are to be performed. If performed, Sraddha, Dana, Tapes (penance), Home, Pinzas, meditation, Japa and other observances are of everlasting benefit.
verses.commentary: Sense: Here all these holy rites are to be performed. If performed, Sraddha, Dana, Tapes (penance), Home, Pinzas, meditation, Japa and other observances are of everlasting benefit.

verses.sanskrit: प्रक्षाल्य पादौ विमलं दत्त्वा चासनमुत्तमम् । संप्रेक्ष्य शिथिलं गात्रमभिघातहतं द्विजैः । संधयामास भैषज्यैर्विष्णा वदना सती
verses.transliteration: prakṣālya pādau vimalaṃ dattvā cāsanamuttamam / saṃprekṣya śithilaṃ gātramabhighātahataṃ dvijaiḥ / saṃdhayāmāsa bhaiṣajyairviṣṇā vadanā satī
verses.translation: Hence the holy Devadaruvana, resorted to by Mahadeva should be visited by the twice-born by every means.
verses.hindi: १-मेघ शंकरके वाहन हैं, इसलिये वे 'घनवाहन' है  देवोंक आदिदेवको नमस्कार है। महादेव! आपको नमस्कार है। श्रेष्ठ त्रिशूल धारण करनेवाले त्र्यम्बक! आपको नमस्कार है। दिगम्बर, (स्वेच्छासे) विकृत (रूप धारण करनेवाले) तथा पिनाकी आपको नमस्कार
verses.wordMeaning: Hence the holy Devadaruvana, resorted to by Mahadeva should be visited by the twice-born by every means.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence the holy Devadaruvana, resorted to by Mahadeva should be visited by the twice-born by every means.

verses.sanskrit: चकार महतीं पूजां प्रार्थयामास भार्यया । को भवान् कुत आयातः किमाचारो भवानिति । उवाच तां महादेवः सिद्धानां प्रवरो ऽस्म्यहम्
verses.transliteration: cakāra mahatīṃ pūjāṃ prārthayāmāsa bhāryayā / ko bhavān kuta āyātaḥ kimācāro bhavāniti / uvāca tāṃ mahādevaḥ siddhānāṃ pravaro 'smyaham
verses.translation: Wherever there is Mahadeva or Visnu, the Supreme Person, the Gahga, the holy centres and the shrines are present there.
verses.hindi: है। समस्त प्रणतजनोंके आश्रय तथा स्वयं निराश्रय (निरधिष्ठान देव)-को नमस्कार है। अन्त करनेवाले (यम)-का भी अन्त करनेवाले और सबका संहार करनेवाले आपको नमस्कार है। नृत्यपरायण और
verses.wordMeaning: Wherever there is Mahadeva or Visnu, the Supreme Person, the Gahga, the holy centres and the shrines are present there.
verses.commentary: Sense: Wherever there is Mahadeva or Visnu, the Supreme Person, the Gahga, the holy centres and the shrines are present there.

verses.sanskrit: यदेतन्मण्डलं शुद्धं भाति ब्रह्ममयं सदा । एषैव देवता मह्यं धारयामि सदैव तत्
verses.transliteration: yadetanmaṇḍalaṃ śuddhaṃ bhāti brahmamayaṃ sadā / eṣaiva devatā mahyaṃ dhārayāmi sadaiva tat
verses.translation: This chapter traces how worship of Siva's Phallus (Lihga) came to be established. The story of falling of Siva's Phallus in Daruvana is found in Siva P. IV. 12. 4. 54 and Brahmanda P. ch. 27.
verses.hindi: भेरवरूप आपको नमस्कार है। नर-नारी शरीरवाले (अर्धनारीश्वर) एवं योगियोंके गुरु आपको नमस्कार है। दान्त, शान्त, तापस (विरक्त) तथा हरको नमस्कार है। अत्यन्त भीषण, चर्माम्बरधारी रुद्रको नमस्कार है। लेलिहानको नमस्कार है, शितिकण्ठको नमस्कार है। अघोर तथा घोर रूपवाले वामदेवको नमस्कार है। धतूरेकी माला धारण करनेवाले और देवीके प्रियकर्ताको नमस्कार है। गङ्गाजलकी धाराको धारण करनेवाले
verses.wordMeaning: This chapter traces how worship of Siva's Phallus (Lihga) came to be established. The story of falling of Siva's Phallus in Daruvana is found in Siva P. IV. 12. 4. 54 and Brahmanda P. ch. 27.
verses.commentary: Sense: This chapter traces how worship of Siva's Phallus (Lihga) came to be established. The story of falling of Siva's Phallus in Daruvana is found in Siva P. IV. 12. 4. 54 and Brahmanda P. ch. 27.

verses.sanskrit: हत्युक्त्वा प्रययौ श्रीमाननुगृह्य पतिव्रताम् । ताडयाञ्चक्रिरे दण्डैर्लोष्टिभिर्मुष्टिभिद्विजाः
verses.transliteration: hatyuktvā prayayau śrīmānanugṛhya pativratām / tāḍayāñcakrire daṇḍairloṣṭibhirmuṣṭibhidvijāḥ
verses.translation: Formerly, in the beautiful Daruvana resorted to by Devas and Siddhas, thousands of sages performed penance and lived along with their wives, sons, and other kinsmen.
verses.hindi: परमेष्ठी शम्भुको नमस्कार है। योगाधिपतिको नमस्कार है तथा ब्रह्माधिपतिको नमस्कार है
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly, in the beautiful Daruvana resorted to by Devas and Siddhas, thousands of sages performed penance and lived along with their wives, sons, and other kinsmen.
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, in the beautiful Daruvana resorted to by Devas and Siddhas, thousands of sages performed penance and lived along with their wives, sons, and other kinsmen.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा चरन्तं गिरिशं नग्नं विकृतलक्षणम् । प्रोचुरेतद् भवांल्लिङ्गमुत्पाटयतु दुर्मते
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā carantaṃ giriśaṃ nagnaṃ vikṛtalakṣaṇam / procuretad bhavāṃlliṅgamutpāṭayatu durmate
verses.translation: They were engaged in doing various religious rites in accordance with the scriptural injunctions. The great sages performed various sacrifices and penances there.
verses.hindi: भस्मका अङ्गराग लगानेवाले प्राणरूप आपको बार- बार नमस्कार हैं। घनवाह! दंष्टी तथा वहिरेताको? नमस्कार है । ब्रह्माके सिंरका हरण करनेवाले कालरूपको नमस्कार है। हम आपके न आगमनको जानते हैं और न गमनको ही जानते हैं । विश्वेश्वर! महादेव! आप जिस रूपमें हैं, उसी रूपमें आपको नमस्कार है। प्रमथनाथ तथा शुभ सम्पदा देनेवालेको नमस्कार है । हाथमें कपाले धारण करनेवाले आपको तथा आप मीढुष्टम-शिवलिङ्ग-
verses.wordMeaning: They were engaged in doing various religious rites in accordance with the scriptural injunctions. The great sages performed various sacrifices and penances there.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were engaged in doing various religious rites in accordance with the scriptural injunctions. The great sages performed various sacrifices and penances there.

verses.sanskrit: तानब्रवीन्महायोगी करिष्यामीति शङ्करः । युष्माकं मामके लिङ्गे यदि द्वेषो ऽभिजायते
verses.transliteration: tānabravīnmahāyogī kariṣyāmīti śaṅkaraḥ / yuṣmākaṃ māmake liṅge yadi dveṣo 'bhijāyate
verses.translation: Desirous of pointing out their defects as they were attracted to the path of action, the trident-bearing Kara went to Daruvana.
verses.hindi: विग्रहको नमस्कार है। कनकलिङ्ग और वारिलिङ्ग' आपको नमस्कार है। अग्नि तथा सूर्यस्वरूप लिङ्गवालेको नमस्कार है, ज्ञानलिङ्ग! आपको नमस्कार है। सर्पोंकी मालावाले और कर्णिकारप्रिय' आपको नमस्कार है।
verses.wordMeaning: Desirous of pointing out their defects as they were attracted to the path of action, the trident-bearing Kara went to Daruvana.
verses.commentary: Sense: Desirous of pointing out their defects as they were attracted to the path of action, the trident-bearing Kara went to Daruvana.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वोत्पाटयामास भगवान् भगनेत्रहा । नापश्यंस्तत्क्षणेनेशं केशवं लिङ्गमेव च
verses.transliteration: ityuktvotpāṭayāmāsa bhagavān bhaganetrahā / nāpaśyaṃstatkṣaṇeneśaṃ keśavaṃ liṅgameva ca
verses.translation: In order to establish Nivrttivijnana (the perfect knowledge of renunciation), lord, the great god Sankara, went there keeping Visnu, the preceptor of the universe, at his side.
verses.hindi: किरीटी, कुण्डल धारण करनेवाले तथा कालके भी काल आपको नमस्कार है २-भगवान् शंकरके वीर्यसे स्वर्णको उत्पत्ति हुई है और स्वर्ण वहिका ही एक रूप है, इसलिये भगवान् शंकरको  वहिरेता' कहते हैं ।
verses.wordMeaning: In order to establish Nivrttivijnana (the perfect knowledge of renunciation), lord, the great god Sankara, went there keeping Visnu, the preceptor of the universe, at his side.
verses.commentary: Sense: In order to establish Nivrttivijnana (the perfect knowledge of renunciation), lord, the great god Sankara, went there keeping Visnu, the preceptor of the universe, at his side.

verses.sanskrit: तदोत्पाता बभूवुर्हि लोकानां भयशंसिनः । न राजते सहस्रांशुश्चचाल पृथिवी पुनः । निष्प्रभाश्च ग्रहाः सर्वे चुक्षुभे च महोदधिः
verses.transliteration: tadotpātā babhūvurhi lokānāṃ bhayaśaṃsinaḥ / na rājate sahasrāṃśuścacāla pṛthivī punaḥ / niṣprabhāśca grahāḥ sarve cukṣubhe ca mahodadhiḥ
verses.translation: Hari, the infinite Purusa, the unchanging source of origin of the worlds, Visnu, assumed the guise of a lady and followed the trident-bearing lord.
verses.hindi: ३-ब्रह्माके सिर-हरणकी कथा पिछले अध्यायमें आयी है। ४-वहि महादेवकी मूर्ति है और वहिका ही रूप कनक (स्वर्ण) है,
verses.wordMeaning: Hari, the infinite Purusa, the unchanging source of origin of the worlds, Visnu, assumed the guise of a lady and followed the trident-bearing lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hari, the infinite Purusa, the unchanging source of origin of the worlds, Visnu, assumed the guise of a lady and followed the trident-bearing lord.

verses.sanskrit: अपश्यच्चानुसूयात्रेः स्वप्नं भार्या पतिव्रता । कथयामास विप्राणां भयादाकुलितेक्षणा
verses.transliteration: apaśyaccānusūyātreḥ svapnaṃ bhāryā pativratā / kathayāmāsa viprāṇāṃ bhayādākulitekṣaṇā
verses.translation: On seeing the Pinaka-bearing lord of the universe walking here and there, the women were deluded by his Maya. They followed the lord of Devas.
verses.hindi: इसीलिये महादेवको 'कनकलिङ्ग' कहते हैं। ५-जल भी भगवान् महादेवकी मूर्ति है, इसलिये महादेवको वारि (जल)-की मूर्ति कहते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing the Pinaka-bearing lord of the universe walking here and there, the women were deluded by his Maya. They followed the lord of Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the Pinaka-bearing lord of the universe walking here and there, the women were deluded by his Maya. They followed the lord of Devas.

verses.sanskrit: तेजसा भासयन् कृत्स्नं नारायणसहायवान् । भिक्षमाणः शिवो नूनं दृष्टो ऽस्माकं गृहेष्विति
verses.transliteration: tejasā bhāsayan kṛtsnaṃ nārāyaṇasahāyavān / bhikṣamāṇaḥ śivo nūnaṃ dṛṣṭo 'smākaṃ gṛheṣviti
verses.translation: All those chaste ladies being afflicted with passion, abandoned their sense of bashfulness and with their ornaments slipping down, those coquettish women began to go with him.
verses.hindi: ६-कर्णिकार पुष्पविशेषका नाम है।
verses.wordMeaning: All those chaste ladies being afflicted with passion, abandoned their sense of bashfulness and with their ornaments slipping down, those coquettish women began to go with him.
verses.commentary: Sense: All those chaste ladies being afflicted with passion, abandoned their sense of bashfulness and with their ornaments slipping down, those coquettish women began to go with him.

verses.sanskrit: तस्या वचनमाकर्ण्य शङ्कमाना महर्षयः । सर्वे जग्मुर्महायोगं ब्रह्माणं विश्वसंभवम्
verses.transliteration: tasyā vacanamākarṇya śaṅkamānā maharṣayaḥ / sarve jagmurmahāyogaṃ brahmāṇaṃ viśvasaṃbhavam
verses.translation: The sons of sages, the youngsters who had not yet subdued their minds, followed Hrsikesa (who was dressed like a woman), afflicted by passionate love.
verses.hindi: वामदेव महेशान देवदेव त्रिलोचन। क्षम्यतां यत्कृतं मोहात् त्वमेव शरणं हि नः ब्रह्मादीनां च सर्वेषां दुर्विज्ञेयोऽसि शंकर
verses.wordMeaning: The sons of sages, the youngsters who had not yet subdued their minds, followed Hrsikesa (who was dressed like a woman), afflicted by passionate love.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sons of sages, the youngsters who had not yet subdued their minds, followed Hrsikesa (who was dressed like a woman), afflicted by passionate love.

verses.sanskrit: उपास्यमानममलैर्योगिभिर्ब्रह्मवित्तमैः । चतुर्वेदैर्मूर्तिमद्भिः सावित्र्या सहितं प्रभुम्
verses.transliteration: upāsyamānamamalairyogibhirbrahmavittamaiḥ / caturvedairmūrtimadbhiḥ sāvitryā sahitaṃ prabhum
verses.translation: On seeing the sole hero Isa, very comely and love¬ able, accompanied by his wife, the groups of women began to sing and dance in their sportive dalliance. They embraced him too.
verses.hindi: तत्सर्वं भगवानेव कुरुते योगमायया
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing the sole hero Isa, very comely and love¬ able, accompanied by his wife, the groups of women began to sing and dance in their sportive dalliance. They embraced him too.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the sole hero Isa, very comely and love¬ able, accompanied by his wife, the groups of women began to sing and dance in their sportive dalliance. They embraced him too.

verses.sanskrit: आसीनमासने रम्ये नानाश्चर्यसमन्विते । प्रभासहस्रकलिले ज्ञानैश्वर्यादिसंयुते
verses.transliteration: āsīnamāsane ramye nānāścaryasamanvite / prabhāsahasrakalile jñānaiśvaryādisaṃyute
verses.translation: The sons of sages too coming in groups began to singsongs smilingly; on observing the consort of Padma, of auspicious limbs, the primordial God, others in a group began to walk around with him.
verses.hindi: एवं स्तुत्वा महादेवं प्रहृष्टेनान्तरात्मना । ऊचुः प्रणम्य गिरिशं पश्यामस्त्वां यथा पुरा तेषां संस्तवमाकर्ण्य सोमः सोमविभूषणः । स्वमेव परमं रूपं दर्शयामास शंकरः
verses.wordMeaning: The sons of sages too coming in groups began to singsongs smilingly; on observing the consort of Padma, of auspicious limbs, the primordial God, others in a group began to walk around with him.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sons of sages too coming in groups began to singsongs smilingly; on observing the consort of Padma, of auspicious limbs, the primordial God, others in a group began to walk around with him.

verses.sanskrit: विभ्राजमानं वपुषा सस्तितं शुभ्रलोचनम् । चतुर्मुखं महाबाहुं छन्दोमयमजं परम्
verses.transliteration: vibhrājamānaṃ vapuṣā sastitaṃ śubhralocanam / caturmukhaṃ mahābāhuṃ chandomayamajaṃ param
verses.translation: Visnu (the slayer of Mura), the son of Vasudeva, the master of Maya (illusive potency) entered their minds.
verses.hindi: तं ते दृष्टाथ गिरिशं देव्या सह पिनाकिनम्। यथा पूर्व स्थिता विप्राः प्रणेमुर्हष्टमानसाः
verses.wordMeaning: Visnu (the slayer of Mura), the son of Vasudeva, the master of Maya (illusive potency) entered their minds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Visnu (the slayer of Mura), the son of Vasudeva, the master of Maya (illusive potency) entered their minds.

verses.sanskrit: विलोक्य वेदपुरुषं प्रसन्नवदनं शुभम् । शिरोभिर्धरणीं गत्वा तोषयामासुरीश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: vilokya vedapuruṣaṃ prasannavadanaṃ śubham / śirobhirdharaṇīṃ gatvā toṣayāmāsurīśvaram
verses.translation: The lord of the universe and all the immortal beings, accompanied by Madhava and seated in the midst of the group of women appeared to be accompanied by all Saktis, although the lord ofDevas (is usually) accompanied by only one Sakti (Uma).
verses.hindi: गौतमोऽत्रिः सुकेशश्च पुलस्त्यः पुलहः क्रतुः । प्रणम्य देवदेवेशमिदं वचनमब्रुवन्
verses.wordMeaning: The lord of the universe and all the immortal beings, accompanied by Madhava and seated in the midst of the group of women appeared to be accompanied by all Saktis, although the lord ofDevas (is usually) accompanied by only one Sakti (Uma).
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord of the universe and all the immortal beings, accompanied by Madhava and seated in the midst of the group of women appeared to be accompanied by all Saktis, although the lord ofDevas (is usually) accompanied by only one Sakti (Uma).

verses.sanskrit: तान् प्रसन्नमना देवश्चतुर्मूर्तिश्चतुर्मुखः । व्याजहार मुनिश्रेष्ठाः किमागमनकारणम्
verses.transliteration: tān prasannamanā devaścaturmūrtiścaturmukhaḥ / vyājahāra muniśreṣṭhāḥ kimāgamanakāraṇam
verses.translation: Then again mounting back, he created the permanent great principle Pradhana. * ** Lord Visnu also re-assumed his original nature (followed?) such (dancing) primordial Deity. * *
verses.hindi: कथं त्वां देवदेवेश कर्मयोगेन वा प्रभो। ज्ञानेन वाथ योगेन पूजयामः सहैव हि
verses.wordMeaning: Then again mounting back, he created the permanent great principle Pradhana. * ** Lord Visnu also re-assumed his original nature (followed?) such (dancing) primordial Deity. * *
verses.commentary: Sense: Then again mounting back, he created the permanent great principle Pradhana. * ** Lord Visnu also re-assumed his original nature (followed?) such (dancing) primordial Deity. * *

verses.sanskrit: तस्य ते वृत्तमखिलं ब्रह्मणः परमात्मनः । ज्ञापयाञ्चक्रिरे सर्वे कृत्वा शिरसि चाञ्जलिम्
verses.transliteration: tasya te vṛttamakhilaṃ brahmaṇaḥ paramātmanaḥ / jñāpayāñcakrire sarve kṛtvā śirasi cāñjalim
verses.translation: On seeing the groups of women, Rudra, their sons and Kesava who fascinated them, the excellent sages became excessively angry.
verses.hindi: केन वा देवमार्गेण सम्पूज्यो भगवानिह। किं सेव्यमसेव्यं वा सर्वमेतद् ब्रवीहि नः
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing the groups of women, Rudra, their sons and Kesava who fascinated them, the excellent sages became excessively angry.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the groups of women, Rudra, their sons and Kesava who fascinated them, the excellent sages became excessively angry.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषय ऊचुः कश्चिद् दारुवनं पुण्यं पुरुषो ऽतीवशोभनः । भार्यया चारुसर्वाङ्ग्या प्रविष्टो नग्न एव हि
verses.transliteration: ṛṣaya ūcuḥ kaścid dāruvanaṃ puṇyaṃ puruṣo 'tīvaśobhanaḥ / bhāryayā cārusarvāṅgyā praviṣṭo nagna eva hi
verses.translation: Deluded by his Maya, they spoke extremely harsh words to lord Kapardin (Siva), they swore at and cursed him with various words.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मणे कथितं पूर्वमादावेव महर्षयः
verses.wordMeaning: Deluded by his Maya, they spoke extremely harsh words to lord Kapardin (Siva), they swore at and cursed him with various words.
verses.commentary: Sense: Deluded by his Maya, they spoke extremely harsh words to lord Kapardin (Siva), they swore at and cursed him with various words.

verses.sanskrit: मोहयामास वपुषा नारीणां कुलमीश्वरः । कन्यकानां प्रिया चास्य दूषयामास पुत्रकान्
verses.transliteration: mohayāmāsa vapuṣā nārīṇāṃ kulamīśvaraḥ / kanyakānāṃ priyā cāsya dūṣayāmāsa putrakān
verses.translation: Just as the stars in the sky remain invisible in the presence of the sun, so also when Sankara came there their penances were repelled.
verses.hindi: न केवलेन योगेन दृश्यते पुरुषः परः। ज्ञानं तु केवलं सम्यगपवर्गफलप्रदम् भवन्तः केवलं योगं समाश्रित्य विमुक्तये।
verses.wordMeaning: Just as the stars in the sky remain invisible in the presence of the sun, so also when Sankara came there their penances were repelled.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as the stars in the sky remain invisible in the presence of the sun, so also when Sankara came there their penances were repelled.

verses.sanskrit: अस्माभिर्विविधाः शापाः प्रदत्ताश्च पराहताः । ताडितो ऽस्माभिरत्यर्थं लिङ्गन्तु विनिपातितम्
verses.transliteration: asmābhirvividhāḥ śāpāḥ pradattāśca parāhatāḥ / tāḍito 'smābhiratyarthaṃ liṅgantu vinipātitam
verses.translation: After reproaching him, the Brahmana ascetics ap¬ proached the bull-bannered deity. Deluded by him they asked the lord of Devas—"Who are you. Sir?"
verses.hindi: एतस्मात् कारणात् वित्रा नृणां केवलधर्मिणाम् । आगतोऽहमिमं देशं ज्ञापयन् मोहसम्भवम्
verses.wordMeaning: After reproaching him, the Brahmana ascetics ap¬ proached the bull-bannered deity. Deluded by him they asked the lord of Devas—"Who are you. Sir?"
verses.commentary: Sense: After reproaching him, the Brahmana ascetics ap¬ proached the bull-bannered deity. Deluded by him they asked the lord of Devas—"Who are you. Sir?"

verses.sanskrit: अन्तर्हितश्च भगवान् सभार्यो लिङ्गमेव च । उत्पाताश्चाभवन् घोराः सर्वभूतभयङ्कराः
verses.transliteration: antarhitaśca bhagavān sabhāryo liṅgameva ca / utpātāścābhavan ghorāḥ sarvabhūtabhayaṅkarāḥ
verses.translation: The lord replied—"O sages of holy rites, I have now come here to your land to perform penance alongwith my wife."
verses.hindi: वामदेव ! त्रिलोचन! महेशान! देवाधिदेव! मोहवश हमने जो किया, उसे आप क्षमा करें। हम सभी आपकी शरणमें हैं। आपके चरित्र विचित्र, गहन तथा गुह्य हैं। शंकर! आप ब्रह्मा आदि सभीके लिये दुविज्ञेय हैं। मनुष्य ज्ञान अथवा आज्ञानसे जो कुछ भी करता है, वह सब आप भगवान् ही अपनी योगमायासे करते हैं। इस प्रकार महादेवकी स्तुतिकर प्रसन्न-मनसे (मुनियोंने) उनको प्रणाम किया और कहा-हम लोग आपको
verses.wordMeaning: The lord replied—"O sages of holy rites, I have now come here to your land to perform penance alongwith my wife."
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord replied—"O sages of holy rites, I have now come here to your land to perform penance alongwith my wife."

verses.sanskrit: क एष पुरुषो देव भीताः स्म पुरुषोत्तम । भवन्तमेव शरणं प्रपन्ना वयमच्युत
verses.transliteration: ka eṣa puruṣo deva bhītāḥ sma puruṣottama / bhavantameva śaraṇaṃ prapannā vayamacyuta
verses.translation: On hearing his statement Bhrgu and other leading sages said; "Perform penance after putting on a garment and after abandoning your wife."
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing his statement Bhrgu and other leading sages said; "Perform penance after putting on a garment and after abandoning your wife."
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing his statement Bhrgu and other leading sages said; "Perform penance after putting on a garment and after abandoning your wife."

verses.sanskrit: त्वं हि वेत्सि जगत्यस्मिन् यत्किञ्चिदपि चेष्टितम् । अनुग्रहेण विश्वेश तदस्माननुपालय
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ hi vetsi jagatyasmin yatkiñcidapi ceṣṭitam / anugraheṇa viśveśa tadasmānanupālaya
verses.translation: Thereafter, the Pinaka-bearing lord Siva (Nilalohita) smiled. Then looking at Janardana who was sitting by his side and who was the source of origin of the worlds, he said: —
verses.hindi: उनको (मुनियोंको इस) स्तुतिको सुनकर चन्द्रभूषण सोम शंकरने अपने परम रूपका दर्शन (उन्हें) कराया। उन पिनाकी गिरिंशको देवी (पार्वती)-के साथ पहले- जैसे (मङ्गलमय) रूपमें स्थित देखकर प्रसन्न-मनवाले वसिष्ठ तथा विश्वामित्र, गौतम, अत्रि, सुकेश, पुलस्त्य,
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, the Pinaka-bearing lord Siva (Nilalohita) smiled. Then looking at Janardana who was sitting by his side and who was the source of origin of the worlds, he said: —
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, the Pinaka-bearing lord Siva (Nilalohita) smiled. Then looking at Janardana who was sitting by his side and who was the source of origin of the worlds, he said: —

verses.sanskrit: विज्ञापितो मुनिगणैर्विश्वात्मा कमलोद्भवः । ध्यात्वा देवं त्रिशूलाङ्कं कृताञ्जलिरभाषत
verses.transliteration: vijñāpito munigaṇairviśvātmā kamalodbhavaḥ / dhyātvā devaṃ triśūlāṅkaṃ kṛtāñjalirabhāṣata
verses.translation: "How is i t that you, knowers of religion, quiescent- minded sages, are eager to maintain your wives, while you advise me that I should abandon my wife?"
verses.hindi: आदि सभी ऋषियोंने महेश्वरकी स्तुतिकर उन देवदेवेशको प्रणाम किया और इस प्रकार कहा- ॥ १२१--१२४॥
verses.wordMeaning: "How is i t that you, knowers of religion, quiescent- minded sages, are eager to maintain your wives, while you advise me that I should abandon my wife?"
verses.commentary: Sense: "How is i t that you, knowers of religion, quiescent- minded sages, are eager to maintain your wives, while you advise me that I should abandon my wife?"

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मोवाच हा कष्टं भवतामद्य जातं सर्वार्थनाशनम् । धिग्बलं धिक् तपश्चर्या मिथ्यैव भवतामिह
verses.transliteration: brahmovāca hā kaṣṭaṃ bhavatāmadya jātaṃ sarvārthanāśanam / dhigbalaṃ dhik tapaścaryā mithyaiva bhavatāmiha
verses.translation: "This has been stated by us that wives who lead a lecherous life should be abandoned by the husbands. Loyal wives of good features and behaviour like these (our women) do not deserve abandonment."
verses.hindi: देवदेवेश! प्रभो! हम सब किस प्रकारसे आपको सदा पूजा करें, कर्मयोग या ज्ञानयोगसे? किस देवमार्ग (प्रशस्त मार्ग)-के द्वारा भगवानूकी पूजा करनी चाहिए, हम लोगोंके लिये क्या सेवनीय है, क्या असेवनीय है, यह सब आप हमें बतलायें
verses.wordMeaning: "This has been stated by us that wives who lead a lecherous life should be abandoned by the husbands. Loyal wives of good features and behaviour like these (our women) do not deserve abandonment."
verses.commentary: Sense: "This has been stated by us that wives who lead a lecherous life should be abandoned by the husbands. Loyal wives of good features and behaviour like these (our women) do not deserve abandonment."

verses.sanskrit: संप्राप्य पुण्यसंस्कारान्निधीनां परमं निधिम् । उपेक्षितं वृथाचारैर्भवद्भिरिह मोहितैः
verses.transliteration: saṃprāpya puṇyasaṃskārānnidhīnāṃ paramaṃ nidhim / upekṣitaṃ vṛthācārairbhavadbhiriha mohitaiḥ
verses.translation: "O Brahmanas, this lady never even mentally wishes for anyone else. Nor do I leave her off at any time."
verses.hindi: देबदेवने कहा--महर्षियो! मैं आप लोगोंको यह उत्तम और गम्भीर रहस्य बतलाता हूँ। पूर्वकालमें (मैंने) इसे ब्रह्माजीको बतलाया था
verses.wordMeaning: "O Brahmanas, this lady never even mentally wishes for anyone else. Nor do I leave her off at any time."
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Brahmanas, this lady never even mentally wishes for anyone else. Nor do I leave her off at any time."

verses.sanskrit: काङ्क्षन्ते योगिनो नित्यं यतन्तो यतयो निधिम् । यमेव तं समासाद्य हा भवद्भिरुपेक्षितम्
verses.transliteration: kāṅkṣante yogino nityaṃ yatanto yatayo nidhim / yameva taṃ samāsādya hā bhavadbhirupekṣitam
verses.translation: "O base man, she was seen by us, behaving in an unchaste manner. You have told a lie. Go away quickly."
verses.hindi: पुरुषोंके लिये साधनस्वरूप दो प्रकारका सांख्ययोग समझना चाहिए। योगसहित (कर्मयोगसहित अर्थात् अनासक्त- भावसे कर्मनिष्ठाके साथ) सांख्य (ज्ञाननिष्ठा) पुरुषोंको मुक्ति प्रदान करनेवाला है। केवल योगके द्वारा परम पुरुषका दर्शन नहीं होता। (शुद्ध) ज्ञान (ज्ञाननिष्ठा) भलीभाँति केवल मोक्षफलको देनेवाला है। आप लोग मुक्ति प्राप्त करनेके लिये विमल सांख्यका परित्याग करके केवल योगका ही अवलम्बनकर परिश्रम कर रहे थे।
verses.wordMeaning: "O base man, she was seen by us, behaving in an unchaste manner. You have told a lie. Go away quickly."
verses.commentary: Sense: "O base man, she was seen by us, behaving in an unchaste manner. You have told a lie. Go away quickly."

verses.sanskrit: यजन्ति यज्ञैर्विविधैर्यत्प्राप्त्यैर्वेदवादिनः । महानिधिं समासाद्य हा भवद्भिरुपेक्षितम्
verses.transliteration: yajanti yajñairvividhairyatprāptyairvedavādinaḥ / mahānidhiṃ samāsādya hā bhavadbhirupekṣitam
verses.translation: When addressed thus, Mahadeva replied: "Only truth has been spoken by me. It is your imagination that she appears to you." Leaving them, he moved away.
verses.hindi: ब्राह्मणो ! इसी कारणसे केवल धर्म करनेवाले (कर्ममात्रनिष्ठ- कर्मव्यसनी) मनुष्योंको मोह उत्पन्न होता है, यह बतानेके लिये मैं इस स्थानपर आया हूँ
verses.wordMeaning: When addressed thus, Mahadeva replied: "Only truth has been spoken by me. It is your imagination that she appears to you." Leaving them, he moved away.
verses.commentary: Sense: When addressed thus, Mahadeva replied: "Only truth has been spoken by me. It is your imagination that she appears to you." Leaving them, he moved away.

verses.sanskrit: यं समासाद्य देवानैमैश्वर्यमखिलं जगत् । तमासाद्याक्षयनिधिं हा भवद्भिरुपेक्षितम्
verses.transliteration: yaṃ samāsādya devānaimaiśvaryamakhilaṃ jagat / tamāsādyākṣayanidhiṃ hā bhavadbhirupekṣitam
verses.translation: In the company of Hari, Paramesvara (Siva) who sought for alms, went to the holy hermitage of Vasistha, the great souled leading sage.
verses.hindi: एकः सर्वत्रगो ह्यात्मा केवलश्चितिमात्रकः। एतदेव परं ज्ञानमेष मोक्षोऽत्र गीयते। एतत् कैवल्यममलं ब्रह्मभावश्च वर्णितः
verses.wordMeaning: In the company of Hari, Paramesvara (Siva) who sought for alms, went to the holy hermitage of Vasistha, the great souled leading sage.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the company of Hari, Paramesvara (Siva) who sought for alms, went to the holy hermitage of Vasistha, the great souled leading sage.

verses.sanskrit: यत्समापत्तिजनितं विश्वेशत्वमिदं मम । तदेवोपेक्षितं दृष्ट्वा निधानं भाग्यवर्जितैः
verses.transliteration: yatsamāpattijanitaṃ viśveśatvamidaṃ mama / tadevopekṣitaṃ dṛṣṭvā nidhānaṃ bhāgyavarjitaiḥ
verses.translation: On seeing the lord arrived begging for alms, Arun- dhatl, the beloved wife of Vasistha, respectfully welcomed him and bowed to him.
verses.hindi: एतत् तत् परमं ज्ञानं केवलं सन्निरञ्जनम्। अहं हि वेद्यो भगवान् मम मूर्तिरियं शिवा
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing the lord arrived begging for alms, Arun- dhatl, the beloved wife of Vasistha, respectfully welcomed him and bowed to him.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the lord arrived begging for alms, Arun- dhatl, the beloved wife of Vasistha, respectfully welcomed him and bowed to him.

verses.sanskrit: यस्मिन् समाहितं दिव्यमैश्वर्यं यत् तदव्ययम् । तमासाद्य निधिं ब्राह्म हा भवद्भिर्वृथाकृतम्
verses.transliteration: yasmin samāhitaṃ divyamaiśvaryaṃ yat tadavyayam / tamāsādya nidhiṃ brāhma hā bhavadbhirvṛthākṛtam
verses.translation: She washed his feet and offered him excellent seat. On seeing his body languid and enfeebled as a result of the thrashing indulged in by the Brahmanas, the chaste lady, with countenance cast down (due to dejection) in her face, applied medicines and healed his wounds.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मचर्यरतो नग्नो व्रतं पाशुपतं चरेत् यद वा कौपीनवसनः स्याद् वैकवसनो मुनिः । वेदाभ्यासरतो विद्वान् ध्यायेत् पशुपतिं शिवम्
verses.wordMeaning: She washed his feet and offered him excellent seat. On seeing his body languid and enfeebled as a result of the thrashing indulged in by the Brahmanas, the chaste lady, with countenance cast down (due to dejection) in her face, applied medicines and healed his wounds.
verses.commentary: Sense: She washed his feet and offered him excellent seat. On seeing his body languid and enfeebled as a result of the thrashing indulged in by the Brahmanas, the chaste lady, with countenance cast down (due to dejection) in her face, applied medicines and healed his wounds.

verses.sanskrit: एष देवो महादेवो विज्ञेयस्तु महेश्वरः । न तस्य परमं किञ्चित् पदं समधिगम्यते
verses.transliteration: eṣa devo mahādevo vijñeyastu maheśvaraḥ / na tasya paramaṃ kiñcit padaṃ samadhigamyate
verses.translation: She worshipped him richly and imploringly asked him,—"Who are you. Sir? Where did you come from, in the company of your wife? What are your customs and manners? May these things be mentioned." The Lord replied: T am the most excellent among the siddhas.
verses.hindi: एष पाशुपतो योगः सेवनीयो मुमुक्षुभिः । भस्मच्छन्नेर्हि सततं निष्कामैरिति विश्रुतिः
verses.wordMeaning: She worshipped him richly and imploringly asked him,—"Who are you. Sir? Where did you come from, in the company of your wife? What are your customs and manners? May these things be mentioned." The Lord replied: T am the most excellent among the siddhas.
verses.commentary: Sense: She worshipped him richly and imploringly asked him,—"Who are you. Sir? Where did you come from, in the company of your wife? What are your customs and manners? May these things be mentioned." The Lord replied: T am the most excellent among the siddhas.

verses.sanskrit: देवतानामृषीणां च पितॄणां चापि शाश्वतः । सहस्रयुगपर्यन्ते प्रलये सर्वदेहिनाम् । संहरत्येष भगवान् कालो भूत्वा महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: devatānāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ cāpi śāśvataḥ / sahasrayugaparyante pralaye sarvadehinām / saṃharatyeṣa bhagavān kālo bhūtvā maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: You see yonder, the pure shining sphere of the Brah¬ man. This is my deity. I owe to this always."
verses.hindi: अत: आप लोगोंको मोक्षके साधनरूप विशुद्ध ज्ञानको प्रयत्रपूर्वक जानना, सुनना तथा उसका साक्षात्कार करना चाहिए निर्मल, नित्य तथा एक है । यही सांख्य (ज्ञाननिष्ठाका) दर्शन है। यही परम ज्ञान है, इसीको यहाँ मोक्ष कहा गया है। यही निर्मल मोक्ष है और यही शुद्ध ब्रह्मभाव बताया गया है। इस परम (ज्ञान)-का आश्रय ग्रहणकर
verses.wordMeaning: You see yonder, the pure shining sphere of the Brah¬ man. This is my deity. I owe to this always."
verses.commentary: Sense: You see yonder, the pure shining sphere of the Brah¬ man. This is my deity. I owe to this always."

verses.sanskrit: एष चैव प्रजाः सर्वाः सृजत्येकः स्वतेजसा । एष चक्री च वज्री च श्रीवत्सकृतलक्षणः
verses.transliteration: eṣa caiva prajāḥ sarvāḥ sṛjatyekaḥ svatejasā / eṣa cakrī ca vajrī ca śrīvatsakṛtalakṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: After saying this and blessing the chaste lady, the glorious lord to whom the Brahmanas beat with sticks and their own fists and lumps of clay, went away.
verses.hindi: उसमें ही निष्ठा रखते हुए और उसीके परायण रहते हुए महात्मा तथा यतिजन मुझ विश्वरूप ईश्वरका दर्शन करते हैं॥ १३३--१३५॥
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this and blessing the chaste lady, the glorious lord to whom the Brahmanas beat with sticks and their own fists and lumps of clay, went away.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this and blessing the chaste lady, the glorious lord to whom the Brahmanas beat with sticks and their own fists and lumps of clay, went away.

verses.sanskrit: योगी कृतयुगे देवस्त्रेतायां यज्ञ उच्यते । द्वापरे भगवान् कालो धर्मकेतुः कलौ युगे
verses.transliteration: yogī kṛtayuge devastretāyāṃ yajña ucyate / dvāpare bhagavān kālo dharmaketuḥ kalau yuge
verses.translation: On seeing Girisa walking about in the nude and characterised by hideousness, they said—"O wicked minded fellow, uproot this your Lifiga (phallus)."
verses.hindi: यही वह सत्, निरञ्जन तथा अद्वितीय परम ज्ञान है। मुझे ही भगवान् जानना चाहिए और यह शिवा मेरी ही मूर्ति है। श्रेष्ठ ब्राह्मणो! सिद्धिके लिये यहाँ (शास्त्रोंमें) बहुतसे साधन बताये गये हैं, किंतु उनमें मेरे विषयका ज्ञान सर्वश्रेष्ठ है
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing Girisa walking about in the nude and characterised by hideousness, they said—"O wicked minded fellow, uproot this your Lifiga (phallus)."
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing Girisa walking about in the nude and characterised by hideousness, they said—"O wicked minded fellow, uproot this your Lifiga (phallus)."

verses.sanskrit: रुद्रस्य मूर्तयस्तिस्त्रो याभिर्विश्वमिदं ततम् । तमो ह्यग्नी रजो ब्रह्मा सत्त्वं विष्णुरिति प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: rudrasya mūrtayastistro yābhirviśvamidaṃ tatam / tamo hyagnī rajo brahmā sattvaṃ viṣṇuriti prabhuḥ
verses.translation: Saiikara, the great Yogin, said to them—"I will do so if you have hatred towards my Linga (phallus)."
verses.hindi: भस्म धारण करनेवाले, (संसारकी निःसारताको हृदयसे समझनेवाले) ज्ञानयोगपरायण, शान्त और मेरे ही शरणमें आये हुए जो लोग हृदयमें निरन्तर मेरा ही ध्यान करते हैं और नित्य मेरी परम भक्तिमें
verses.wordMeaning: Saiikara, the great Yogin, said to them—"I will do so if you have hatred towards my Linga (phallus)."
verses.commentary: Sense: Saiikara, the great Yogin, said to them—"I will do so if you have hatred towards my Linga (phallus)."

verses.sanskrit: मूर्तिरन्या स्मृता चास्य दिग्वासा वै शिवा ध्रुवा । यत्र तिष्ठति तद् ब्रह्म योगेन तु समन्वितम्
verses.transliteration: mūrtiranyā smṛtā cāsya digvāsā vai śivā dhruvā / yatra tiṣṭhati tad brahma yogena tu samanvitam
verses.translation: After saying so, the lord who had gouged the eyes of Bhaga, uprooted the Linga. Instantaneously they could see neither the lord nor Kesava nor the Linga.
verses.hindi: तत्पर हैं, कल्मषॉसे रहित एवं पूर्ण संयत हैं, उन लोगोंके घोर संसाररूपी सागरको मैं शीघ्र ही नष्ट कर देता हूँ भस्मसे धूसरित शरीरवाला होकर संयतमन तथा शान्त होकर, ब्रह्मचर्यव्रत-परायण होते हुए वस्त्रादि परिधानकी आसक्तिसे रहित होकर पाशुपत-व्रतका पालन करना चाहिए। मुक्तिप्राप्तिके लिये मैंने पूर्वकालमें
verses.wordMeaning: After saying so, the lord who had gouged the eyes of Bhaga, uprooted the Linga. Instantaneously they could see neither the lord nor Kesava nor the Linga.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying so, the lord who had gouged the eyes of Bhaga, uprooted the Linga. Instantaneously they could see neither the lord nor Kesava nor the Linga.
