verses.sanskrit: या चास्य पार्श्वगा भार्या भवद्भिरभिवीक्षिता । सा हि नारायणो देवः परमात्मा सनातनः
verses.transliteration: yā cāsya pārśvagā bhāryā bhavadbhirabhivīkṣitā / sā hi nārāyaṇo devaḥ paramātmā sanātanaḥ
verses.translation: Evil omens occurred indicating danger and fear to the worlds. The thousand-rayed sun did not shine. The earth quaked again and again. The planets became lustreless. The great ocean was agitated.
verses.hindi: गुह्यसे भी गुह्यतम, वेदके साररूप, सूक्ष्म एवं श्रेष्ठ पाशुपत-व्रतका उपदेश किया था
verses.wordMeaning: Evil omens occurred indicating danger and fear to the worlds. The thousand-rayed sun did not shine. The earth quaked again and again. The planets became lustreless. The great ocean was agitated.
verses.commentary: Sense: Evil omens occurred indicating danger and fear to the worlds. The thousand-rayed sun did not shine. The earth quaked again and again. The planets became lustreless. The great ocean was agitated.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् सर्वमिदं जातं तत्रैव च लयं व्रजेत् । स एव मोहयेत् कृत्स्नं स एव परमा गतिः
verses.transliteration: tasmāt sarvamidaṃ jātaṃ tatraiva ca layaṃ vrajet / sa eva mohayet kṛtsnaṃ sa eva paramā gatiḥ
verses.translation: Anasuya, the chaste wife of Atri, saw a dream. Highly agitated in all her senses, she narrated it to the Brahmanas.
verses.hindi: अथवा कौपीन वस्त्र या एक वस्त्र धारणकर विद्वान् मुनिको वेदाभ्यासमें रत रहते हुए पशुपति शिवका (सतत) ध्यान करना चाहिए। मोक्षकी अभिलाषावाले मुमुक्षुजनोंको सतत भस्मसे उपलिप्त रहकर निष्कामभावसे इस पाशुपतयोगका सेवन करना चाहिए। ऐसा श्रुतिका कथन है। राग, भय तथा क्रोधसे सर्वथा रहित, मुझे
verses.wordMeaning: Anasuya, the chaste wife of Atri, saw a dream. Highly agitated in all her senses, she narrated it to the Brahmanas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Anasuya, the chaste wife of Atri, saw a dream. Highly agitated in all her senses, she narrated it to the Brahmanas.

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रशीर्षा पुरुषः सहस्राक्षः सहस्रपात् । एकशृङ्गो महानात्मा पुराणो ऽष्टाक्षरो हरिः
verses.transliteration: sahasraśīrṣā puruṣaḥ sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapāt / ekaśṛṅgo mahānātmā purāṇo 'ṣṭākṣaro hariḥ
verses.translation: "Illuminating everything with his lustre, indeed it was Siva who was seen in our abodes begging for alms, accompanied by Narayana."
verses.hindi: करनेवाले बहुतसे (भक्तजन) इस योगके द्वारा पवित्र होकर मेरे भावको प्रात हुए हैं
verses.wordMeaning: "Illuminating everything with his lustre, indeed it was Siva who was seen in our abodes begging for alms, accompanied by Narayana."
verses.commentary: Sense: "Illuminating everything with his lustre, indeed it was Siva who was seen in our abodes begging for alms, accompanied by Narayana."

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्वेदश्चतुर्मूर्तिस्त्रिमूर्तिस्त्रिगुणः परः । एकमूर्तिरमेयात्मा नारायण इति श्रुतिः
verses.transliteration: caturvedaścaturmūrtistrimūrtistriguṇaḥ paraḥ / ekamūrtirameyātmā nārāyaṇa iti śrutiḥ
verses.translation: On hearing her words the sages who became terrified, wentupto Brahma ofgreat Yogic power, the creator of the universe.
verses.hindi: अन्यानि चैव शास्त्राणि लोकेऽस्मिन् मोहनानि तु । वेदवादविरुद्धानि मयैव कथितानि तु असेव्यमेतत् कथितं वेदबाह्य तथेतरम्
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing her words the sages who became terrified, wentupto Brahma ofgreat Yogic power, the creator of the universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing her words the sages who became terrified, wentupto Brahma ofgreat Yogic power, the creator of the universe.

verses.sanskrit: ऋतस्य गर्भो भगवानापो मायातनुः प्रभुः । स्तूयते विविधैर्मन्त्रैर्ब्राह्मणैर्धर्ममोक्षिभिः
verses.transliteration: ṛtasya garbho bhagavānāpo māyātanuḥ prabhuḥ / stūyate vividhairmantrairbrāhmaṇairdharmamokṣibhiḥ
verses.translation: The lord was being worshipped by pure Yogins who were the most excellent among the knowers of Brahman. He was accompanied by the four Vedas in their embodied form as by Savitri.
verses.hindi: अचिराहैश्वरं ज्ञानमुत्पत्स्यति न संशयः
verses.wordMeaning: The lord was being worshipped by pure Yogins who were the most excellent among the knowers of Brahman. He was accompanied by the four Vedas in their embodied form as by Savitri.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord was being worshipped by pure Yogins who were the most excellent among the knowers of Brahman. He was accompanied by the four Vedas in their embodied form as by Savitri.

verses.sanskrit: संहृत्य सकलं विश्वं कल्पान्ते पुरुषोत्तमः । शेते योगामृतं पीत्वा यत् तद् विष्णोः परं पदम्
verses.transliteration: saṃhṛtya sakalaṃ viśvaṃ kalpānte puruṣottamaḥ / śete yogāmṛtaṃ pītvā yat tad viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam
verses.translation: He was seated on a beautiful seat full of miracles: it shed forth myriads of rays and it was associated with Jnana (perfect knowledge), Aisvarya (prowess and glory) and other qualities.
verses.hindi: ध्यातमात्रो हि सांनिध्यं दास्यामि मुनिसत्तमाः इत्युक्त्वा भगवान् सोमस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत । तेऽपि दारुवने तस्मिन् पूजयन्ति स्म शंकरम्। ब्रह्मचर्यरताः शान्ता ज्ञानयोगपरायणाः
verses.wordMeaning: He was seated on a beautiful seat full of miracles: it shed forth myriads of rays and it was associated with Jnana (perfect knowledge), Aisvarya (prowess and glory) and other qualities.
verses.commentary: Sense: He was seated on a beautiful seat full of miracles: it shed forth myriads of rays and it was associated with Jnana (perfect knowledge), Aisvarya (prowess and glory) and other qualities.

verses.sanskrit: न जायते न म्रियते वर्धते न च विश्वसृक् । मूलप्रकृतिरव्यक्ता गीयते वैदिकैरजः
verses.transliteration: na jāyate na mriyate vardhate na ca viśvasṛk / mūlaprakṛtiravyaktā gīyate vaidikairajaḥ
verses.translation: With delighted mind the four-faced deity of four forms spoke to them—"O excellent sages, what is the reason for your visit?"
verses.hindi: समेत्य ते महात्मानो मुनयो ब्रह्मवादिनः । वितेनिरे बहून् वादानध्यात्मज्ञानसंश्रयान्
verses.wordMeaning: With delighted mind the four-faced deity of four forms spoke to them—"O excellent sages, what is the reason for your visit?"
verses.commentary: Sense: With delighted mind the four-faced deity of four forms spoke to them—"O excellent sages, what is the reason for your visit?"

verses.sanskrit: ततो निशायां वृत्तायां सिसृक्षुरखिलञ्जगत् । अजस्य नाभौ तद् बीजं क्षिपत्येष महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: tato niśāyāṃ vṛttāyāṃ sisṛkṣurakhilañjagat / ajasya nābhau tad bījaṃ kṣipatyeṣa maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: With palms joined in reverence above their heads, all intimated to the Supreme-souled Brahma of what happened.
verses.hindi: कोऽपि स्यात् सर्वभावानां हेतुरीश्वर एव च आविरासीन्महादेवी देवी गिरिवरात्मजा
verses.wordMeaning: With palms joined in reverence above their heads, all intimated to the Supreme-souled Brahma of what happened.
verses.commentary: Sense: With palms joined in reverence above their heads, all intimated to the Supreme-souled Brahma of what happened.

verses.sanskrit: तं मां वित्त महात्मानं ब्रह्माणं विश्वतो मुखम् । महान्तं पुरुषं विश्वमपां गर्भमनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: taṃ māṃ vitta mahātmānaṃ brahmāṇaṃ viśvato mukham / mahāntaṃ puruṣaṃ viśvamapāṃ garbhamanuttamam
verses.translation: A certain highly brilliant person has entered the holy Daruvana alongwith his wife, who was very beautiful in all her limbs. But he was naked.
verses.hindi: 'कोटिसूर्यप्रतीकाशा ज्वालामालासमावृता। स्वभाभिर्विमलाभिस्तु पूरयन्ती नभस्तलम्
verses.wordMeaning: A certain highly brilliant person has entered the holy Daruvana alongwith his wife, who was very beautiful in all her limbs. But he was naked.
verses.commentary: Sense: A certain highly brilliant person has entered the holy Daruvana alongwith his wife, who was very beautiful in all her limbs. But he was naked.

verses.sanskrit: न तं विदाथ जनकं मोहितास्तस्य मायया । देवदेवं महादेवं भूतानामीश्वरं हरम्
verses.transliteration: na taṃ vidātha janakaṃ mohitāstasya māyayā / devadevaṃ mahādevaṃ bhūtānāmīśvaraṃ haram
verses.translation: The Lordly person fascinated our entire women and daughters, with his charming personality. While his beloved * defiled our sons.
verses.hindi: प्रणेमुरेकामखिलेशपत्नीं जानन्ति ते तत् परमस्य बीजम् इस संसारमें मोहित करनेवाले तथा वेदमतका विरोध करनेवाले अन्य भी शास्त्र हैं, वे मेरे द्वारा ही कहे गये हैं। वाम (मार्ग), पाशुपत, सोम, लाकुल तथा भैरव (मार्ग) तथा अन्य--ये असेव्य और वेदबाह्य
verses.wordMeaning: The Lordly person fascinated our entire women and daughters, with his charming personality. While his beloved * defiled our sons.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Lordly person fascinated our entire women and daughters, with his charming personality. While his beloved * defiled our sons.

verses.sanskrit: एष देवो महादेवो ह्यनादिर्भगवान् हरः । विष्णुना सह संयुक्तः करोति विकरोति च
verses.transliteration: eṣa devo mahādevo hyanādirbhagavān haraḥ / viṣṇunā saha saṃyuktaḥ karoti vikaroti ca
verses.translation: We heaped various imprecations and curses on him but they were defied and set at nought. He was beaten soundly by us. His Lihga was struck down.
verses.hindi: ब्राह्मणो ! मैं वेदमूर्ति हूँ सनातन वेदका परित्यागकर दूसरे शास्त्रको जाननेवाले लोग मेरे स्वरूपको नहीं जान सकते। (अतः आप लोग) इस मार्गकी स्थापना करें, महेश्वरको पूजा करें (इससे) शीघ्र ही आप लोगोंको
verses.wordMeaning: We heaped various imprecations and curses on him but they were defied and set at nought. He was beaten soundly by us. His Lihga was struck down.
verses.commentary: Sense: We heaped various imprecations and curses on him but they were defied and set at nought. He was beaten soundly by us. His Lihga was struck down.

verses.sanskrit: न तस्य विद्यते कार्यं न तस्माद् विद्यते परम् । स वेदान् प्रददौ पूर्वं योगमायातनुर्मम
verses.transliteration: na tasya vidyate kāryaṃ na tasmād vidyate param / sa vedān pradadau pūrvaṃ yogamāyātanurmama
verses.translation: That lord vanished alongwith his wife and the Lihga. Terrible omens ensued, terrifying all the living beings.
verses.hindi: ईश्वर-सम्बन्धी ज्ञान प्राप्त होगा, इसमें संशय नहीं है। श्रेष्ठ जनो! आप सभीको मुझमें महान् भक्ति हो। श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! ध्यान करनेमात्रसे में आपको अपना सांनिध्य प्रदान करूँगा इतना कहकर भगवान् सोम (शंकर) वहींपर अन्तर्धान हो गये। वे शान्त महर्षि भी ब्रह्मचर्यपरायण होकर, ज्ञानयोग-परायण रहते हुए उस दारुवनमें शंकरको पूजा करने लगे। उन ब्रह्मवादी महात्मा
verses.wordMeaning: That lord vanished alongwith his wife and the Lihga. Terrible omens ensued, terrifying all the living beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: That lord vanished alongwith his wife and the Lihga. Terrible omens ensued, terrifying all the living beings.

verses.sanskrit: स मायी मायया सर्वं करोति विकरोति च । तमेव मुक्तये ज्ञात्वा व्रजेत शरणं भवम्
verses.transliteration: sa māyī māyayā sarvaṃ karoti vikaroti ca / tameva muktaye jñātvā vrajeta śaraṇaṃ bhavam
verses.translation: O excellent among men, who is this lordly person? We are all frightened. O Unerring being, we have sought refuge in you.
verses.hindi: मुनिगणोंने (स्वयं मोहरहित हो जानेके कारण) एकत्रित होकर अध्यात्मज्ञान-सम्बन्धी बहुतसे सिद्धान्तांका विस्तार किया
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent among men, who is this lordly person? We are all frightened. O Unerring being, we have sought refuge in you.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent among men, who is this lordly person? We are all frightened. O Unerring being, we have sought refuge in you.

verses.sanskrit: इतीरिता भगवता मरीचिप्रमुखा विभुम् । प्रणम्य देवं ब्रह्माणं पृच्छन्ति स्म सुदुः खिताः
verses.transliteration: itīritā bhagavatā marīcipramukhā vibhum / praṇamya devaṃ brahmāṇaṃ pṛcchanti sma suduḥ khitāḥ
verses.translation: Indeed, you know whatever happens in this universe. Protect and save us with your blessing."
verses.hindi: इस जगतका मूल (कारण) क्या है? (उत्तर) हमारी आत्मा ही इस जगतका मूल है। सभी भाव पदार्थोका हेतु कौन है? (उत्तर) ईश्वर ही सभी भावोंका जनक है। इस प्रकारको दृढ धारणाके साथ ध्यानमार्गका अवलम्बन करनेवाले उन महर्षियोंके समक्ष श्रेष्ठ पर्वत (हिमालय)-की पुत्री महादेवी पार्वती प्रकट हुई
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, you know whatever happens in this universe. Protect and save us with your blessing."
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, you know whatever happens in this universe. Protect and save us with your blessing."

verses.sanskrit: मुनय ऊचुः कथं पश्येम तं देवं पुनरेव पिनाकिनम् । ब्रूहि विश्वामरेशान त्राता त्वं शरणैषिणाम्
verses.transliteration: munaya ūcuḥ kathaṃ paśyema taṃ devaṃ punareva pinākinam / brūhi viśvāmareśāna trātā tvaṃ śaraṇaiṣiṇām
verses.translation: Thus informed by the groups of sages, the lotus-born deity, the Atman of the universe meditated on the trident-bear¬ ing lord with palms joined in reverence and said:
verses.hindi: करोड़ों सूर्यके समान, ज्चालामालाओं (तेजो- राशि)-से समावृत वे अपनी विमल प्रभासे आकाशमण्डलको आपूरित कर रही थीं। हजारों ज्वालाओं (तेजोमण्डल)-के मध्यमे प्रतिष्ठित, अतुलनीय, अद्वितीय,
verses.wordMeaning: Thus informed by the groups of sages, the lotus-born deity, the Atman of the universe meditated on the trident-bear¬ ing lord with palms joined in reverence and said:
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus informed by the groups of sages, the lotus-born deity, the Atman of the universe meditated on the trident-bear¬ ing lord with palms joined in reverence and said:

verses.sanskrit: पितामह उवाच यद् दृष्टं भवता तस्य लिङ्गं भुवि निपातितम् । तल्लिङ्गानुकृतीशस्य कृत्वा लिङ्गमनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: pitāmaha uvāca yad dṛṣṭaṃ bhavatā tasya liṅgaṃ bhuvi nipātitam / talliṅgānukṛtīśasya kṛtvā liṅgamanuttamam
verses.translation: Alas! Woe unto you! What happend today is des¬ tructive of everything of yours. Fie upon your strength and power. Fie upon your penance. It has become useless and false in regard to you in this matter.
verses.hindi: सम्पूर्ण जगतूके ईश (शंकर)-की पत्नी, उन गिरिजाका दर्शनकर मुनियोंने उन्हें प्रणाम किया  क्योंकि वे जानते हैं कि ये ही परमेश्वरी परमेश्वर महेश्वरकी मूलशक्ति (बीज) हैं तदन्तरे देवमशेषहेतुम्।
verses.wordMeaning: Alas! Woe unto you! What happend today is des¬ tructive of everything of yours. Fie upon your strength and power. Fie upon your penance. It has become useless and false in regard to you in this matter.
verses.commentary: Sense: Alas! Woe unto you! What happend today is des¬ tructive of everything of yours. Fie upon your strength and power. Fie upon your penance. It has become useless and false in regard to you in this matter.

verses.sanskrit: पूजयध्वं सपत्नीकाः सादरं पुत्रसंयुताः । वैदिकैरेव नियमैर्विविधैर्ब्रह्मचारिणः
verses.transliteration: pūjayadhvaṃ sapatnīkāḥ sādaraṃ putrasaṃyutāḥ / vaidikaireva niyamairvividhairbrahmacāriṇaḥ
verses.translation: After obtaining greatest of all treasures, thanks to the favourable impressions (results) of all (previous) merits it has been neglected by you all who are deluded and whose practice of good conduct has become useless.
verses.hindi: रुद्रं बृहन्तं पुरुषं पुराणम्
verses.wordMeaning: After obtaining greatest of all treasures, thanks to the favourable impressions (results) of all (previous) merits it has been neglected by you all who are deluded and whose practice of good conduct has become useless.
verses.commentary: Sense: After obtaining greatest of all treasures, thanks to the favourable impressions (results) of all (previous) merits it has been neglected by you all who are deluded and whose practice of good conduct has become useless.

verses.sanskrit: संस्थाप्य शाङ्करैर्मन्त्रैरृग्यजुः सामसंभवैः । तपः परं समास्थाय गृणन्तः शतरुद्रियम्
verses.transliteration: saṃsthāpya śāṅkarairmantrairṛgyajuḥ sāmasaṃbhavaiḥ / tapaḥ paraṃ samāsthāya gṛṇantaḥ śatarudriyam
verses.translation: It is for this treasure that all yogins seek and desire and all the ascetics aspire. Alas! after obtaining that very same treasure, you have neglected and lost it.
verses.hindi: आलोक्य देवीमथ देवमीशं ज्ञानं तहैशं भगवत्प्रसादा-
verses.wordMeaning: It is for this treasure that all yogins seek and desire and all the ascetics aspire. Alas! after obtaining that very same treasure, you have neglected and lost it.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is for this treasure that all yogins seek and desire and all the ascetics aspire. Alas! after obtaining that very same treasure, you have neglected and lost it.

verses.sanskrit: समाहिताः पूजयध्वं सपुत्राः सह बन्धुभिः । सर्वे प्राञ्जलयो भूत्वा शूलपाणिं प्रपद्यथ
verses.transliteration: samāhitāḥ pūjayadhvaṃ saputrāḥ saha bandhubhiḥ / sarve prāñjalayo bhūtvā śūlapāṇiṃ prapadyatha
verses.translation: A great treasure, to acquire which, the propounders of the Vedas worship by means of various Yajnas, has been neglected and lost by you, after attaining it.
verses.hindi: इयं हि सा जगतो योनिरेका
verses.wordMeaning: A great treasure, to acquire which, the propounders of the Vedas worship by means of various Yajnas, has been neglected and lost by you, after attaining it.
verses.commentary: Sense: A great treasure, to acquire which, the propounders of the Vedas worship by means of various Yajnas, has been neglected and lost by you, after attaining it.

verses.sanskrit: ततो द्रक्ष्यथ देवेशं दुर्दर्शमकृतात्मभिः । यं दृष्ट्वा सर्वमज्ञानमधर्मश्च प्रणश्यति
verses.transliteration: tato drakṣyatha deveśaṃ durdarśamakṛtātmabhiḥ / yaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarvamajñānamadharmaśca praṇaśyati
verses.translation: I have acquired this lordship of the universe after continuously worshipping the lord. But after seeing that lord you have missed him like those who are devoid of good luck (who may see) a treasure (but lose it instantaneously.)
verses.hindi: सर्वात्मिका सर्वनियामिका च। न्महेश्वरः शिव एकोऽथ रुद्रः। चकार विश्वं परशक्तिनिष्ठां
verses.wordMeaning: I have acquired this lordship of the universe after continuously worshipping the lord. But after seeing that lord you have missed him like those who are devoid of good luck (who may see) a treasure (but lose it instantaneously.)
verses.commentary: Sense: I have acquired this lordship of the universe after continuously worshipping the lord. But after seeing that lord you have missed him like those who are devoid of good luck (who may see) a treasure (but lose it instantaneously.)

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रणम्य वरदं ब्रह्माणममितौजसम् । जग्मुः संहृष्टमनसो देवदारुवनं पुनः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ praṇamya varadaṃ brahmāṇamamitaujasam / jagmuḥ saṃhṛṣṭamanaso devadāruvanaṃ punaḥ
verses.translation: You had come across that treasure-BraAman in whom divine Supremacy has been vested and who is the imperish¬ able deity; but alas you have rendered it futile after attaining it.
verses.hindi: मायामथारुहा स देवदेवः
verses.wordMeaning: You had come across that treasure-BraAman in whom divine Supremacy has been vested and who is the imperish¬ able deity; but alas you have rendered it futile after attaining it.
verses.commentary: Sense: You had come across that treasure-BraAman in whom divine Supremacy has been vested and who is the imperish¬ able deity; but alas you have rendered it futile after attaining it.

verses.sanskrit: आराधयितुमारब्धा ब्रह्मणा कथितं यथा । अजानन्तः परं देवं वीतरागा विमत्सराः
verses.transliteration: ārādhayitumārabdhā brahmaṇā kathitaṃ yathā / ajānantaḥ paraṃ devaṃ vītarāgā vimatsarāḥ
verses.translation: This god Mahadeva is the great deity who should be known and realised. There is no other greater region than his that can be attained.
verses.hindi: एको देवः सर्वभूतेषु गूढो अन्तर्हितोऽभूद् भगवानथेशो
verses.wordMeaning: This god Mahadeva is the great deity who should be known and realised. There is no other greater region than his that can be attained.
verses.commentary: Sense: This god Mahadeva is the great deity who should be known and realised. There is no other greater region than his that can be attained.

verses.sanskrit: स्थण्डिलेषु विचित्रेषु पर्वतानां गुहासु च । नदीनां च विविक्तेषु पुलिनेषु शुभेषु च
verses.transliteration: sthaṇḍileṣu vicitreṣu parvatānāṃ guhāsu ca / nadīnāṃ ca vivikteṣu pulineṣu śubheṣu ca
verses.translation: He is Cakrin (one armed with the discus); he is the Supreme Ruler. He is characterised by the Srivatsa mark. This god is a Yogin in Krta-yuga, Yajna (sacrifice) in Treta, the Lord Kala in Dvapara and in the Kaliyuga, he is the banner of virtue (Dharmaketu).
verses.hindi: देव्या भर्गः सह देवादिदेवः । आराधयन्ति स्म तमेव देवं
verses.wordMeaning: He is Cakrin (one armed with the discus); he is the Supreme Ruler. He is characterised by the Srivatsa mark. This god is a Yogin in Krta-yuga, Yajna (sacrifice) in Treta, the Lord Kala in Dvapara and in the Kaliyuga, he is the banner of virtue (Dharmaketu).
verses.commentary: Sense: He is Cakrin (one armed with the discus); he is the Supreme Ruler. He is characterised by the Srivatsa mark. This god is a Yogin in Krta-yuga, Yajna (sacrifice) in Treta, the Lord Kala in Dvapara and in the Kaliyuga, he is the banner of virtue (Dharmaketu).

verses.sanskrit: शैवालभोजनाः केचित् केचिदन्तर्जलेशयाः । केचिदभ्रावकाशास्तु पादाङ्गुष्ठाग्रविष्ठिताः
verses.transliteration: śaivālabhojanāḥ kecit kecidantarjaleśayāḥ / kecidabhrāvakāśāstu pādāṅguṣṭhāgraviṣṭhitāḥ
verses.translation: Rudra has three Murtis (forms) by whom the uni¬ verse is pervaded. The Smrti says: "Agni (The fire god) is the Tamas form, Brahma is the Rajas form and Visnu is the Sattva form.
verses.hindi: अनन्तर उन लोगोंने ऐसी भावना की-ये ही परमेश-पत्नी हम सनकी गति हैँ, आत्मा हैं, इन्हें गगन (आकाश) नामसे कहा जाता है, (क्योंकि ये महादेवी वस्तुगत्या निराकार तथा परम व्यापक हैं, अतएव परम अवकाशस्वरूप स्वाधिष्ठान होनेसे कथंचित् आकाशके द्वारा तुलनीय हैं और परब्रह्मका व्योम (आकाश) नाम है ही तथा इन महादेवी एवं परब्रह्ममें सर्वथा अभेद है।) समस्त मुनि एवं समस्त विप्र इन्हींमें अपनेको
verses.wordMeaning: Rudra has three Murtis (forms) by whom the uni¬ verse is pervaded. The Smrti says: "Agni (The fire god) is the Tamas form, Brahma is the Rajas form and Visnu is the Sattva form.
verses.commentary: Sense: Rudra has three Murtis (forms) by whom the uni¬ verse is pervaded. The Smrti says: "Agni (The fire god) is the Tamas form, Brahma is the Rajas form and Visnu is the Sattva form.

verses.sanskrit: दन्तो ऽलूखलिनस्त्वन्ये ह्यश्मकुट्टास्तथा परे । शाकपर्णाशिनः केचित् संप्रक्षाला मरीचिपाः
verses.transliteration: danto 'lūkhalinastvanye hyaśmakuṭṭāstathā pare / śākaparṇāśinaḥ kecit saṃprakṣālā marīcipāḥ
verses.translation: It is stated in Smrti that he has another eternal aus¬ picious form having the quarters for garments(i.e. nude), where abides Brahman endowed with Yoga.
verses.hindi: तथा समस्त प्रपञ्चको देखते हें । (मुनियोंके इस पवित्र भावसे संतुष्ट होकर) परमेश्वरकी पत्नी (पार्वती)-ने उन्हें (विशेषरूपसे) देखा। इसी बीच (मुनियोंने) सभीके मूल कारण, नियामक, पुराण पुरुष, बृहत् एवं
verses.wordMeaning: It is stated in Smrti that he has another eternal aus¬ picious form having the quarters for garments(i.e. nude), where abides Brahman endowed with Yoga.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is stated in Smrti that he has another eternal aus¬ picious form having the quarters for garments(i.e. nude), where abides Brahman endowed with Yoga.

verses.sanskrit: वृक्षमूलनिकेताश्च शिलाशय्यास्तथा परे । कालं नयन्ति तपसा पूजयन्तो महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: vṛkṣamūlaniketāśca śilāśayyāstathā pare / kālaṃ nayanti tapasā pūjayanto maheśvaram
verses.translation: The lady, his wife, who was seen by you near his side, and who was conversed with (v. 1. seen) by you is lord Narayana, the eternal Supreme Atman.
verses.hindi: रुद्रात्मक कवि, देव शम्भु (महादेव)-का दर्शन किया। तदनन्तर देवी (पार्वती) तथा देव (शंकर)-को देखकर उन्होंने (मुनियोंने) प्रणाम किया, उत्तम आनन्द प्राप्त किया और उनमें भगवान् (परमेश)-की कृपासे जन्मके विनाशके हेतुरूप अर्थात् पुनर्जन्म न करानेवाले ईश्वर- सम्बन्धी ज्ञानका आविर्भाव हुआ
verses.wordMeaning: The lady, his wife, who was seen by you near his side, and who was conversed with (v. 1. seen) by you is lord Narayana, the eternal Supreme Atman.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lady, his wife, who was seen by you near his side, and who was conversed with (v. 1. seen) by you is lord Narayana, the eternal Supreme Atman.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तेषां प्रसादार्थं प्रपन्नार्तिहरो हरः । चका भगवान् बुद्धिं प्रबोधाय वृषध्वजः
verses.transliteration: tatasteṣāṃ prasādārthaṃ prapannārtiharo haraḥ / cakā bhagavān buddhiṃ prabodhāya vṛṣadhvajaḥ
verses.translation: All this is born of him. It shall get dissolved only in him. He (alone) can liberate all. He alone is the great goal.
verses.hindi: (इस ज्ञानके आविर्भावके साथ ही मुनियोंने यह अनुभव किया) ये ही देवी जगत्की एकमात्र मूल कारण, सर्वात्मिका, सबका नियन्त्रण करनेवाली तथा अनादिसिंद्ध व्योम नामवाली माहेश्वरी शक्ति हैं, जो चुलोकमें
verses.wordMeaning: All this is born of him. It shall get dissolved only in him. He (alone) can liberate all. He alone is the great goal.
verses.commentary: Sense: All this is born of him. It shall get dissolved only in him. He (alone) can liberate all. He alone is the great goal.

verses.sanskrit: देवः कृतयुगे ह्यस्मिन् शृङ्गे हिमवतः शुभे । देवदारुवनं प्राप्तः प्रसन्नः परमेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: devaḥ kṛtayuge hyasmin śṛṅge himavataḥ śubhe / devadāruvanaṃ prāptaḥ prasannaḥ parameśvaraḥ
verses.translation: The Sruti says that Narayana is the thousand-(i.e.
verses.hindi: शोभित होती हुई प्रतीत हो रही हैं। देवाधिदेव महान् परमेष्ठी, परसे भी पर, अद्वितीय रुद्र महेश्वर शिवने इसी परम शक्ति (महादेवी) -में अंशरूपसे विद्यमान मायाका आश्रय ग्रहणकर विश्वको सृष्टि को ये देव ही सभी प्राणियोंमें गूढरूपसे प्रतिष्ठित हैं अर्थात् सर्वत्र सूक्ष्मरूपसे व्याप्त है । वे मायी (मायाके नियन्ता) रुद्र सकल (साकार) तथा निष्कल (निराकार) हैं। वे ही देवी (रूप) हैं, उनसे भिन्न (जगत्में और
verses.wordMeaning: The Sruti says that Narayana is the thousand-(i.e.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Sruti says that Narayana is the thousand-(i.e.

verses.sanskrit: भस्मपाण्डुरदिग्धाङ्गो नग्नो विकृतलक्षणः । उल्मुकव्यग्रहस्तश्च रक्तपिङ्गललोचनः
verses.transliteration: bhasmapāṇḍuradigdhāṅgo nagno vikṛtalakṣaṇaḥ / ulmukavyagrahastaśca raktapiṅgalalocanaḥ
verses.translation: The semen virile* becomes the foetus in him. The lord is of illusory aquatic body (?). He is being eulogised by means of various kinds of Mantras by Brahmanas who seek salvation.
verses.hindi: कुछ भी) नहीं है, ऐसा जानकर अमृतत्वकी प्राप्ति होती है। इधर भर्ग (वरेण्य तेजोरूप), देवाधिदेव, भगवान् परमेश मुनियोंके मोहको दूरकर तथा उन्हें परमज्ञानसे सम्पन्न कर महादेवीके साथ अन्तर्हित हो
verses.wordMeaning: The semen virile* becomes the foetus in him. The lord is of illusory aquatic body (?). He is being eulogised by means of various kinds of Mantras by Brahmanas who seek salvation.
verses.commentary: Sense: The semen virile* becomes the foetus in him. The lord is of illusory aquatic body (?). He is being eulogised by means of various kinds of Mantras by Brahmanas who seek salvation.

verses.sanskrit: क्वचिच्च हसते रौद्रं क्वचिद् गायति विस्मितः । क्वचिन्नृत्यति शृङ्गारी क्वचिद्रौति मुहुर्मुहुः
verses.transliteration: kvacicca hasate raudraṃ kvacid gāyati vismitaḥ / kvacinnṛtyati śṛṅgārī kvacidrauti muhurmuhuḥ
verses.translation: At the end of the Kalpa, the Supreme Person with¬ draws the entire universe in him and after drinking the Yogic nectar, he lies down to sleep in the greatest region of Visnu.
verses.hindi: गये और एकमात्र अरण्यको ही अपना घर माननेवाले वे परम ज्ञानी मुनि लोग उन परम देव रुद्रकी आराधनामें दत्तचित्त हो गये एतद् व: कथितं सर्व देवदेवविचेष्टितम्।
verses.wordMeaning: At the end of the Kalpa, the Supreme Person with¬ draws the entire universe in him and after drinking the Yogic nectar, he lies down to sleep in the greatest region of Visnu.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the end of the Kalpa, the Supreme Person with¬ draws the entire universe in him and after drinking the Yogic nectar, he lies down to sleep in the greatest region of Visnu.

verses.sanskrit: आश्रमे ऽभ्यागतो भिक्षां याचते च पुनः पुनः । मायां कृत्वात्मनो रूपं देवस्तद् वनमागतः
verses.transliteration: āśrame 'bhyāgato bhikṣāṃ yācate ca punaḥ punaḥ / māyāṃ kṛtvātmano rūpaṃ devastad vanamāgataḥ
verses.translation: Visvadrk (the seer of the universe) is neither born nor dies nor increases in size. The unborn deity is sung about as the unmanifest original Prakrti, by the followers of the Vedas.
verses.hindi: ति कूर्मपुराण कट
verses.wordMeaning: Visvadrk (the seer of the universe) is neither born nor dies nor increases in size. The unborn deity is sung about as the unmanifest original Prakrti, by the followers of the Vedas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Visvadrk (the seer of the universe) is neither born nor dies nor increases in size. The unborn deity is sung about as the unmanifest original Prakrti, by the followers of the Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा गिरिसुतां गौरीं पार्श्वेदेवः पिनाकधृक् । सा च पूर्ववद् देवेशी देवदारुवनं गता
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā girisutāṃ gaurīṃ pārśvedevaḥ pinākadhṛk / sā ca pūrvavad deveśī devadāruvanaṃ gatā
verses.translation: When the night passes on, Mahesvara becomes desirous of creating the entire universe and then sows the seed in the umbilical region of the unborn.
verses.hindi: इस तरह प्राचीन कालमें देवदारु-वनमें घटित देवदारुवने पूर्व पुराणे यन्मया श्रुतम्॥ १६३ ॥  देवाधिदेवका जो वृत्तान्त मैंने पुराणमें सुना था, वह
verses.wordMeaning: When the night passes on, Mahesvara becomes desirous of creating the entire universe and then sows the seed in the umbilical region of the unborn.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the night passes on, Mahesvara becomes desirous of creating the entire universe and then sows the seed in the umbilical region of the unborn.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा समागतं देवं देव्या सह कपर्दिनम् । प्रणेमुः शिरसा भूमौ तोषयामासुरीश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā samāgataṃ devaṃ devyā saha kapardinam / praṇemuḥ śirasā bhūmau toṣayāmāsurīśvaram
verses.translation: Know me to be the Supreme Atman, Brahma with faces on all sides, the great Purusa, Universe, the excellent foetus of water.
verses.hindi: आप लोगोंको बता दिया। जो नित्य इसका पाठ करेगा अथवा श्रवण करेगा, वह सभी पातकोंसे मुक्त हो जायगा अथवा जो शान्त द्विजोंको इसे सुनायेगा, वह
verses.wordMeaning: Know me to be the Supreme Atman, Brahma with faces on all sides, the great Purusa, Universe, the excellent foetus of water.
verses.commentary: Sense: Know me to be the Supreme Atman, Brahma with faces on all sides, the great Purusa, Universe, the excellent foetus of water.

verses.sanskrit: वैदिकैर्विविधैर्मन्त्रैः सूक्तैर्माहेश्वरैः शुभैः । अथर्वशिरसा चान्ये रुद्राद्यैर्ब्रह्मभिर्भवम्
verses.transliteration: vaidikairvividhairmantraiḥ sūktairmāheśvaraiḥ śubhaiḥ / atharvaśirasā cānye rudrādyairbrahmabhirbhavam
verses.translation: You had been deluded by his Maya, so you do not realise that progenitor, Mahadeva, the lord of Devas, Hara, the lord of all living beings.
verses.hindi: श्रावयेद् वा द्विजान् शान्तान् स याति परमां गतिम्॥ ९६४॥  परम गतिको प्राप्त होगा इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे वट्साहर्त्र्थां संहितायामुपारिविभागे सप्तत्रिंशोऽध्यायः
verses.wordMeaning: You had been deluded by his Maya, so you do not realise that progenitor, Mahadeva, the lord of Devas, Hara, the lord of all living beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: You had been deluded by his Maya, so you do not realise that progenitor, Mahadeva, the lord of Devas, Hara, the lord of all living beings.

verses.sanskrit: नमो देवादिदेवाय महादेवाय ते नमः । त्र्यम्बकाय नमस्तुभ्यं त्रिशूलवरधारिणे
verses.transliteration: namo devādidevāya mahādevāya te namaḥ / tryambakāya namastubhyaṃ triśūlavaradhāriṇe
verses.translation: This lord Mahadeva is the beginningless Lord Hara. In association with Visnu, he creates and dissolves the Universe.
verses.hindi: तीर्थमाहात्म्य-प्रकरणमें मार्कण्डेय-युधिष्ठिर-संवादका प्रारम्भ, मार्कण्डेयजीद्वारा नर्मदा तथा अमरकण्टकतीर्थके माहात्म्यका प्रतिपादन
verses.wordMeaning: This lord Mahadeva is the beginningless Lord Hara. In association with Visnu, he creates and dissolves the Universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: This lord Mahadeva is the beginningless Lord Hara. In association with Visnu, he creates and dissolves the Universe.

verses.sanskrit: नमो दिग्वाससे तुभ्यं विकृताय पिनाकिने । सर्वप्रणतदेहाय स्वयमप्रणतात्मने
verses.transliteration: namo digvāsase tubhyaṃ vikṛtāya pinākine / sarvapraṇatadehāya svayamapraṇatātmane
verses.translation: Actually he has no task to be performed; there is no greater being than he. He, of illusory Yogic body, gave the Vedas unto me, formerly.
verses.hindi: एषा पुण्यतमा देवी देवगन्धर्वसेबिता। नर्मदा लोकविख्याता तीर्थानामुत्तमा नदी युधिष्ठिराय तु शुभं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम्
verses.wordMeaning: Actually he has no task to be performed; there is no greater being than he. He, of illusory Yogic body, gave the Vedas unto me, formerly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Actually he has no task to be performed; there is no greater being than he. He, of illusory Yogic body, gave the Vedas unto me, formerly.

verses.sanskrit: अन्तकान्तकृते तुभ्यं सर्वसंहरणाय च । नमो ऽस्तु नृत्यशीलाय नमो भैरवरूपिणे
verses.transliteration: antakāntakṛte tubhyaṃ sarvasaṃharaṇāya ca / namo 'stu nṛtyaśīlāya namo bhairavarūpiṇe
verses.translation: He is the wielder (master) of Maya and through Maya, he makes and dissolves everything. Seek refuge in that Siva alone; after realising that he alone is conducive to salvation."
verses.hindi: श्रुतास्तु विविधा धर्मास्त्वत्प्रसादान्महामुने। माहात्म्यं च प्रयागस्य तीर्थानि विविधानि च
verses.wordMeaning: He is the wielder (master) of Maya and through Maya, he makes and dissolves everything. Seek refuge in that Siva alone; after realising that he alone is conducive to salvation."
verses.commentary: Sense: He is the wielder (master) of Maya and through Maya, he makes and dissolves everything. Seek refuge in that Siva alone; after realising that he alone is conducive to salvation."

verses.sanskrit: नरनारीशरीराय योगिनां गुरवे नमः । नमो दान्ताय शान्ताय तापसाय हराय च
verses.transliteration: naranārīśarīrāya yogināṃ gurave namaḥ / namo dāntāya śāntāya tāpasāya harāya ca
verses.translation: On being advised thus by the lord, the sages, the chief of whom was Marici, bowed down to lord Brahma and asked him with great concentration.
verses.hindi: नर्मदायास्तु माहात्म्यं पुराणे यन्मया श्रुतम्। इदानीं तत् प्रवक्ष्यामि शृणुष्वैकमनाः शुभम् सद्यः पुनाति गाङ्गेयं दर्शनादेव नार्मदम्
verses.wordMeaning: On being advised thus by the lord, the sages, the chief of whom was Marici, bowed down to lord Brahma and asked him with great concentration.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being advised thus by the lord, the sages, the chief of whom was Marici, bowed down to lord Brahma and asked him with great concentration.

verses.sanskrit: विभीषणाय रुद्राय नमस्ते कृत्तिवाससे । नमस्ते लेलिहानाय शितिकण्ठाय ते नमः
verses.transliteration: vibhīṣaṇāya rudrāya namaste kṛttivāsase / namaste lelihānāya śitikaṇṭhāya te namaḥ
verses.hindi: सूतजीने कहा--देवताओं तथा गन्धर्वोद्वारा सेवित ये अत्यन्त पवित्र नर्मदादेवी संसारमें प्रसिद्ध हैं तथा नदीरूपमें सभी तीर्थोमें उत्तम तीर्थ हैं। इनका वह शुभ

verses.sanskrit: अघोरघोररूपाय वामदेवाय वै नमः । नमः कनकमालाय देव्याः प्रियकराय च
verses.transliteration: aghoraghorarūpāya vāmadevāya vai namaḥ / namaḥ kanakamālāya devyāḥ priyakarāya ca
verses.hindi: युधिष्ठिरको बताया गया है तथा सभी पापोंका नाशक होनेके कारण शुभ है युधिष्ठिर बोले--महामुने! आपकी कृपासे मैंने विविध धर्मोको सुना, साथ ही प्रयागका माहात्म्य और विविध तीर्थोंका भी (माहात्म्य) श्रवण किया। आपने बतलाया कि सभी तीर्थोमें नर्मदा मुख्य हैं, अतः
verses.commentary: Sense: Mt. - 54b-55a.

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गासलिलधाराय शम्भवे परमेष्ठिने । नमो योगाधिपतये ब्रह्माधिपतये नमः
verses.transliteration: gaṅgāsaliladhārāya śambhave parameṣṭhine / namo yogādhipataye brahmādhipataye namaḥ
verses.hindi: हे सत्तम! इस समय आप उन्हींका माहात्म्य मुझे बतलायें
verses.commentary: Sense: Mt. 55b-56a.

verses.sanskrit: प्राणाय च नमस्तुभ्यं नमो भस्माङ्गरागिने । नमस्ते घनवाहाय दंष्ट्रिणे वह्निरेतसे
verses.transliteration: prāṇāya ca namastubhyaṃ namo bhasmāṅgarāgine / namaste ghanavāhāya daṃṣṭriṇe vahniretase
verses.hindi: मार्कण्डेयने कहा- रुद्रकी देहसे निकली हुई नर्मदा सभी नदियोंमें श्रेष्ठ हैं। (वे) सभी चर-अचर प्राणियोंको पार उतारनेवाली हैं। पुराणमें नर्मदाका जो माहात्म्य मैंने सुना है, उसे अब बतलाता हूँ, आप लोग एकाग्र गङ्गा कनखलमें तथा सरस्वती कुरुक्षेत्रमें पवित्र (कही गयी) हैं, किंतु ग्राम अथवा अरण्यमें सर्वत्र ही नर्मदाको पवित्र कहा गया है। सरस्वतीका जल तीन दिनोंतक, यमुनाका जल सात दिनोंतक तथा गङ्गाजल

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मणश्च शिरो हर्त्रे नमस्ते कालरूपिणे । आगतिं ते न जनीमो गतिं नैव च नैव च । विश्वेश्वर महादेव यो ऽसि सो ऽसि नमो ऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: brahmaṇaśca śiro hartre namaste kālarūpiṇe / āgatiṃ te na janīmo gatiṃ naiva ca naiva ca / viśveśvara mahādeva yo 'si so 'si namo 'stu te
verses.hindi: तत्काल स्नान-पानसे पवित्र करता है, किंतु नर्मदाका जल तो दर्शनमात्रसे ही पवित्र कर देता है
verses.commentary: Sense: Mt. 63b-64a.

verses.sanskrit: नमः प्रमथनाथाय दात्रे च शुभसंपदाम् । कपालपाणये तुभ्यं नमो मीढुष्टमाय ते । नमः कनकलिङ्गाय वारिलिङ्गाय ते नमः
verses.transliteration: namaḥ pramathanāthāya dātre ca śubhasaṃpadām / kapālapāṇaye tubhyaṃ namo mīḍhuṣṭamāya te / namaḥ kanakaliṅgāya vāriliṅgāya te namaḥ
verses.hindi: कलिङ्गदेशपश्चार्धी पर्वतेऽमरकण्टके । पुण्या च त्रिषु लोकेषु रमणीया मनोरमा सदेवसुरगन्धर्वा ऋषयश्च तपोधनाः। तपस्तप्त्वा तु राजेन्द्र सिद्धि तु परमां गताः
verses.commentary: Sense: Mt. 64b-65a.

verses.sanskrit: नमो वह्न्यर्कलिङ्गाय ज्ञानलिङ्गाय ते नमः । नमो भुजङ्गहाराय कर्णिकारप्रियाय च । किरीटिने कुण्डलिने कालकालाय ते नमः
verses.transliteration: namo vahnyarkaliṅgāya jñānaliṅgāya te namaḥ / namo bhujaṅgahārāya karṇikārapriyāya ca / kirīṭine kuṇḍaline kālakālāya te namaḥ
verses.hindi: उपोष्य रजनीमेकां कुलानां तारयेच्छतम्
verses.commentary: Sense: Mt. -65b-66a.

verses.sanskrit: वामदेव महेशान देवदेव त्रिलोचन । क्षम्यतां यत्कृतं मोहात् त्वमेव शरणं हि नः
verses.transliteration: vāmadeva maheśāna devadeva trilocana / kṣamyatāṃ yatkṛtaṃ mohāt tvameva śaraṇaṃ hi naḥ
verses.translation: The holy water of Sarasvati sanctifies one in three days; the water of Yamuna sanctifies one in seven days; the water of Ganga sanctifies immediately; but the water of Narmada sanctifies one at its very sight.®
verses.hindi: षष्टितीर्थसहस्राणि षष्टिकोट्यस्तथैव च। पर्वतस्य समन्तात् तु तिष्ठन्त्यमरकण्टके ब्रह्मचारी शुचिर्भूत्वा जितक्रोधो जितेन्द्रियः । सर्वहिंसानिवृत्तस्तु सर्वभूतहिते रतः
verses.wordMeaning: The holy water of Sarasvati sanctifies one in three days; the water of Yamuna sanctifies one in seven days; the water of Ganga sanctifies immediately; but the water of Narmada sanctifies one at its very sight.®
verses.commentary: Sense: The holy water of Sarasvati sanctifies one in three days; the water of Yamuna sanctifies one in seven days; the water of Ganga sanctifies immediately; but the water of Narmada sanctifies one at its very sight.®

verses.sanskrit: चरितानि विचित्राणि गुह्यानि गहनानि च । ब्रह्मादीनां च सर्वेषां दुर्विज्ञेयो ऽसि शङ्कर
verses.transliteration: caritāni vicitrāṇi guhyāni gahanāni ca / brahmādīnāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ durvijñeyo 'si śaṅkara
verses.translation: In the western half of Kalinga, on the mountain Amarakantaka (it has its source). It is very holy. It is the most beautiful and charming in the three worlds.*
verses.hindi: तस्य पुण्यफलं राजन् शृणुष्वावहितो नृप
verses.wordMeaning: In the western half of Kalinga, on the mountain Amarakantaka (it has its source). It is very holy. It is the most beautiful and charming in the three worlds.*
verses.commentary: Sense: In the western half of Kalinga, on the mountain Amarakantaka (it has its source). It is very holy. It is the most beautiful and charming in the three worlds.*

verses.sanskrit: अज्ञानाद् यदि वा ज्ञानाद् यत्किञ्चित्कुरुते नरः । तत्सर्वं भगवानेन कुरुते योगमायया
verses.transliteration: ajñānād yadi vā jñānād yatkiñcitkurute naraḥ / tatsarvaṃ bhagavānena kurute yogamāyayā
verses.translation: O leading king, Devas, Asuras, Gandharvas, saints and the ascetics have attained the highest Siddki by performing penance on her banks.
verses.hindi: अप्सरोगणसंकीर्णो दिव्यस्त्रीपरिवारितः क्रीडते देवलोके तु हैवतैः सह मोदते
verses.wordMeaning: O leading king, Devas, Asuras, Gandharvas, saints and the ascetics have attained the highest Siddki by performing penance on her banks.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading king, Devas, Asuras, Gandharvas, saints and the ascetics have attained the highest Siddki by performing penance on her banks.

verses.sanskrit: एवं स्तुत्वा महादेवं प्रहृष्टेनान्तरात्मना । ऊचुः प्रणम्य गिरिशं पश्यामस्त्वां यथा पुरा
verses.transliteration: evaṃ stutvā mahādevaṃ prahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā / ūcuḥ praṇamya giriśaṃ paśyāmastvāṃ yathā purā
verses.translation: O king, a person who takes his bath there, maintains all religious observances and has conquered the sense-organs shall redeem a hundred members of his family after observing fast for a night.
verses.hindi: ततः स्वर्गात् परिभ्रष्टो राजा भवति धार्मिकः । गृहं तु लभतेऽसौ वै नानारत्नसमन्वितम्
verses.wordMeaning: O king, a person who takes his bath there, maintains all religious observances and has conquered the sense-organs shall redeem a hundred members of his family after observing fast for a night.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, a person who takes his bath there, maintains all religious observances and has conquered the sense-organs shall redeem a hundred members of his family after observing fast for a night.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां संस्तवमाकर्ण्य सोमः मोमविभूषणः । स्वमेव परमं रूपं दर्शयामास शङ्करः
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ saṃstavamākarṇya somaḥ momavibhūṣaṇaḥ / svameva paramaṃ rūpaṃ darśayāmāsa śaṅkaraḥ
verses.translation: O leading king, it is heard that the excellent river is more than hundred Yojanas in length and its width is two Yojanas (1 Yojana=12 kms).®
verses.hindi: अनिवर्तिका गतिस्तस्य पवनस्याम्बरे यथा कलिंग देशके पश्चार्धमें अमरकण्टक पर्वतपर तीनों लोकोंमें पवित्र, रमणीय, मनोरम नर्मदाका उद्गम स्थल है । राजेन्द्र! वहाँ देवताओंसहित असुरों, गन्धर्वों, ऋषियों तथा तपस्वियोंने तपस्या कर परम सिद्धि प्राप्त की है।
verses.wordMeaning: O leading king, it is heard that the excellent river is more than hundred Yojanas in length and its width is two Yojanas (1 Yojana=12 kms).®
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading king, it is heard that the excellent river is more than hundred Yojanas in length and its width is two Yojanas (1 Yojana=12 kms).®

verses.sanskrit: तं ते दृष्ट्वाथ गिरिशं देव्या सह पिनाकिनम् । यथा पूर्वं स्थिता विप्राः प्रणेमुर्हृष्टमानसाः
verses.transliteration: taṃ te dṛṣṭvātha giriśaṃ devyā saha pinākinam / yathā pūrvaṃ sthitā viprāḥ praṇemurhṛṣṭamānasāḥ
verses.translation: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.hindi: राजन्! मनुष्य वहाँ (नर्मदामें) स्नान करके जितेन्द्रिय तथा नियम-परायण रहते हुए एक रात्रि उपवास करे तो अपने सौ पीढ़ियोंको तार देता है॥९--११॥
verses.wordMeaning: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.commentary: Sense: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®

verses.sanskrit: ततस्ते मुनयः सर्वे संस्तूय च महेश्वरम् । भृग्वङ्गिरोवसिष्ठास्तु विश्वामित्रस्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: tataste munayaḥ sarve saṃstūya ca maheśvaram / bhṛgvaṅgirovasiṣṭhāstu viśvāmitrastathaiva ca
verses.translation: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.hindi: राजेन्द्र! सुना जाता है कि वह श्रेष्ठ नदी सौ योजनसे कुछ अधिक लम्बी तथा दो योजन चौड़े विस्तारमें फैली है। अमरकण्टक पर्वतमें चारों ओर साठ करोड़ साठ हजार तीर्थ स्थित हैं। राजन्! जो ब्रह्मचर्यपरायण है, पवित्र है, क्रोध तथा इन्द्रियोंपर विजय प्राप्त किया है, सभी प्रकारकी हिंसाओंसे सर्वथा निवृत्त है, सभी प्राणियोंके हितमें परायण है तथा ऐसे ही सभी पवित्र आचारोंसे सम्पन्न है, वह मनुष्य यहाँ प्राणोंका परित्यागकर
verses.wordMeaning: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.commentary: Sense: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®

verses.sanskrit: गौतमो ऽत्रिः सुकेशश्च पुलस्त्यः पुलहः क्रतुः । मरीचिः कश्यपश्चापि संवर्तश्च महातपाः । प्रणम्य देवदेवेशमिदं वचनमब्रुवन्
verses.transliteration: gautamo 'triḥ sukeśaśca pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ / marīciḥ kaśyapaścāpi saṃvartaśca mahātapāḥ / praṇamya devadeveśamidaṃ vacanamabruvan
verses.translation: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.hindi: जिस पुण्य 'फलको प्राप्त करता है, उसे आप सावधान होकर सुनें-
verses.wordMeaning: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.commentary: Sense: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®

verses.sanskrit: कथं त्वां देवदेवेश कर्मयोगेन वा प्रभो । ज्ञानेन वाथ योगेन पूजयामः सदैव हि
verses.transliteration: kathaṃ tvāṃ devadeveśa karmayogena vā prabho / jñānena vātha yogena pūjayāmaḥ sadaiva hi
verses.translation: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.hindi: पाण्डव! वह पुरुष अप्सराओंके समूहोंसे व्याप्त अर्थात् सेवित तथा चारों ओर दिव्य स्त्रियोंसे आवृत रहकर स्वर्गमें सौ हजार वर्षोतक आनन्द प्राप्त करता है। दिव्य गन्ध (चन्दन)-से अनुलिप्त होकर तथा दिव्य पुष्पोंसे सुशोभित होकर देवलोकमें क्रीडा करता है और देवताओंके साथ आनन्द प्राप्त करता है। स्वर्गमें सुख भोगने योग्य पुण्योंके निःशेष होनेपर वह धार्मिक राजा होता है और नाना प्रकारके रत्रोंसे समन्वित दिव्य
verses.wordMeaning: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.commentary: Sense: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®

verses.sanskrit: केन वा देवमार्गेण संपूज्यो भगवानिह । किं तत् सेव्यमसेव्यं वा सर्वमेतद् ब्रवीहि नः
verses.transliteration: kena vā devamārgeṇa saṃpūjyo bhagavāniha / kiṃ tat sevyamasevyaṃ vā sarvametad bravīhi naḥ
verses.translation: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.hindi: मणिमय स्तम्भों, हीरे एवं वैदूर्यमणिसे विभूषित, उत्तम चित्रों तथा वाहनोंसे अलंकृत और दासी-दाससे समन्वित भवन प्राप्त करता है। वह राजराजेश्वर श्रीसम्पन्न, सभी स्त्रियोंका प्रियकर तथा भोगोंसे युक्त होकर वहाँ
verses.wordMeaning: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.commentary: Sense: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®

verses.sanskrit: देवदेव उवाच एतद् वः संप्रवक्ष्यामि गूढं गहनमुत्तमम् । ब्रह्मणे कथितं पूर्वमादावेव महर्षयः
verses.transliteration: devadeva uvāca etad vaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi gūḍhaṃ gahanamuttamam / brahmaṇe kathitaṃ pūrvamādāveva maharṣayaḥ
verses.translation: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.hindi: (पृथ्वीपर) सौ वर्षसे भी अधिक समयतक जीवित रहता है (इस तीर्थमें) अग्नि अथवा जलमें प्रवेश करने अथवा अनशन-व्रत करनेसे वैसी ही पुनरागमनरहित गति होती है, जैसी कि आकाशमें पवनकी होती है (इसका आशय यह है कि शास्त्रविहित तपके रूपमें
verses.wordMeaning: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.commentary: Sense: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®

verses.sanskrit: सांख्ययोगो द्विधा ज्ञेयः पुरुषाणां हि साधनम् । योगेन सहितं सांख्यं पुरुषाणां विमुक्तिदम्
verses.transliteration: sāṃkhyayogo dvidhā jñeyaḥ puruṣāṇāṃ hi sādhanam / yogena sahitaṃ sāṃkhyaṃ puruṣāṇāṃ vimuktidam
verses.translation: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.hindi: अग्निप्रवेश आदि तप इस तीर्थमें अक्षय पुण्य देनेवाले होते हैं)
verses.wordMeaning: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.commentary: Sense: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®

verses.sanskrit: न केवलेन योगेन दृश्यते पुरुषः परः । ज्ञानं तु केवलं सम्यगपवर्गफलप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: na kevalena yogena dṛśyate puruṣaḥ paraḥ / jñānaṃ tu kevalaṃ samyagapavargaphalapradam
verses.translation: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.hindi: पश्चिमे पर्वततटे सर्वपापविनाशनः। (अमरकण्टक) पर्वतके पश्चिमी किनारेपर सभी
verses.wordMeaning: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.commentary: Sense: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®

verses.sanskrit: भवन्तः केवलं योगं समाश्रित्य विमुक्तये । विहाय सांख्यं विमलमकुर्वन्त परिश्रमम्
verses.transliteration: bhavantaḥ kevalaṃ yogaṃ samāśritya vimuktaye / vihāya sāṃkhyaṃ vimalamakurvanta pariśramam
verses.translation: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.hindi: हृदो जलेश्वरो नाम त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतः
verses.wordMeaning: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.commentary: Sense: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मात् कारणाद् विप्रानृणां केवलधर्मिणाम् । आगतो ऽहमिमं देशं ज्ञापयन् मोहसंभवम्
verses.transliteration: etasmāt kāraṇād viprānṛṇāṃ kevaladharmiṇām / āgato 'hamimaṃ deśaṃ jñāpayan mohasaṃbhavam
verses.translation: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.hindi: तत्र पिण्डप्रदानेन संध्योपासनकर्मणा। दशवर्षाणि पितरस्तर्पिताः स्युर्न संशयः सा तु पुण्या महाभागा त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुता। तत्र कोटिशतं साग्रं तीर्थानां तु युधिष्ठिर ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.commentary: Sense: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद् भवद्भिर्विमलं ज्ञानं कैवल्यसाधनम् । ज्ञातव्यं हि प्रयत्नेन श्रोतव्यं दृश्यमेव च
verses.transliteration: tasmād bhavadbhirvimalaṃ jñānaṃ kaivalyasādhanam / jñātavyaṃ hi prayatnena śrotavyaṃ dṛśyameva ca
verses.translation: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.hindi: तस्मिंस्तीर्थ तु ये वृक्षा: पतिताः कालपर्ययात्। नर्मदातोयसंस्पृष्टास्ते यान्ति परमां गतिम्
verses.wordMeaning: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.commentary: Sense: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®

verses.sanskrit: एकः सर्वत्रगो ह्यात्मा केवलश्चितिमात्रकः । आनन्दो निर्मलो नित्यं स्यादेतत् सांख्यदर्शनम्
verses.transliteration: ekaḥ sarvatrago hyātmā kevalaścitimātrakaḥ / ānando nirmalo nityaṃ syādetat sāṃkhyadarśanam
verses.translation: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.hindi: द्वितीया तु महाभागा विशल्यकरणी शुभा। तत्र तीर्थ नरः स्नात्वा विशल्यो भवति क्षणात् ईश्वरेण पुरा प्रोक्ता लोकानां हितकाम्यया
verses.wordMeaning: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.commentary: Sense: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®

verses.sanskrit: एतदेव परं ज्ञानमेष मोक्षो ऽत्र गीयते । एतत् कैवल्यममलं ब्रह्मभावश्च वर्णितः
verses.transliteration: etadeva paraṃ jñānameṣa mokṣo 'tra gīyate / etat kaivalyamamalaṃ brahmabhāvaśca varṇitaḥ
verses.translation: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.hindi: सर्वपापविशुद्धात्मा रुद्रलोकं स गच्छति
verses.wordMeaning: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.commentary: Sense: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®

verses.sanskrit: आश्रित्य चैतत् परमं तन्निष्ठास्तत्परायणाः । पश्यन्ति मां महात्मानो यतयो विश्वमीश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: āśritya caitat paramaṃ tanniṣṭhāstatparāyaṇāḥ / paśyanti māṃ mahātmāno yatayo viśvamīśvaram
verses.translation: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.hindi: ये बसन्त्युत्तरे कूले रुद्रलोके वसन्ति ते समं स्नानं च दानं च यथा मे शंकरोऽब्रवीत्
verses.wordMeaning: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.commentary: Sense: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®

verses.sanskrit: एतत् तत् परमं ज्ञानं केवलं सन्निरञ्जनम् । अहं हि वेद्यो भगवान् मम मूर्तिरियं शिवा
verses.transliteration: etat tat paramaṃ jñānaṃ kevalaṃ sannirañjanam / ahaṃ hi vedyo bhagavān mama mūrtiriyaṃ śivā
verses.translation: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.hindi: परित्यजति यः प्राणान् पर्वतेऽमरकण्टके । वर्षकोटिशतं साग्रं रुद्रलोके महीयते
verses.wordMeaning: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.commentary: Sense: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®

verses.sanskrit: बहूनि साधनानीह सिद्धये कथितानि तु । तेषामभ्यधिकं ज्ञानं मामकं द्विजपुङ्गवाः
verses.transliteration: bahūni sādhanānīha siddhaye kathitāni tu / teṣāmabhyadhikaṃ jñānaṃ māmakaṃ dvijapuṅgavāḥ
verses.translation: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.hindi: पवित्रं शिरसावन्द्य सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते नर्मदा सर्वतः पुण्या ब्रह्महत्यापहारिणी। अहोरात्रोपवासेन मुच्यते ब्रह्महत्यया ३४॥
verses.wordMeaning: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.commentary: Sense: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानयोगरताः शान्ता मामेव शरणं गताः । ये हि मां भस्मनिरता ध्यायन्ति सततं हृदि
verses.transliteration: jñānayogaratāḥ śāntā māmeva śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ / ye hi māṃ bhasmaniratā dhyāyanti satataṃ hṛdi
verses.translation: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.hindi: जालेशवरं तीर्थवरं सर्वपापविनाशनम्। तत्र गत्वा नियमवान् सर्वकामाल्लभेन्नरः
verses.wordMeaning: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.commentary: Sense: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®

verses.sanskrit: मद्भक्तिपरमा नित्यं यतयः क्षीणकल्मषाः । नाशयाम्यचिरात् तेषां घोरं संसारसागरम्
verses.transliteration: madbhaktiparamā nityaṃ yatayaḥ kṣīṇakalmaṣāḥ / nāśayāmyacirāt teṣāṃ ghoraṃ saṃsārasāgaram
verses.translation: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.hindi: पापोंका नाश करनेवाला और तीनों लोकोंमें विख्यात जलेश्वर नामका एक हृद (तालाब) है। वहाँ पिण्डदान करने तथा संध्योपासन कर्म करनेसे दस (हजार) वर्षतक पितर तृप्त रहते हैं, इसमें संदेह नहीं नर्मदाके दक्षिण तटके समीपमें ही कपिला नामवाली महानदी स्थित है, जो साल तथा अर्जुनके वृक्षोंसे घिरी हुई है। वह महाभागा (नदी) पवित्र तथा तीनों लोकोंमें विख्यात है। युधिष्ठिर! वहाँ सौ करोड्से भी अधिक
verses.wordMeaning: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.commentary: Sense: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®

verses.sanskrit: प्रशान्तः संयतमना भस्मोद्धूलितविग्रहः । ब्रह्मचर्यरतो नग्नो व्रतं पाशुपतं चरेत्
verses.transliteration: praśāntaḥ saṃyatamanā bhasmoddhūlitavigrahaḥ / brahmacaryarato nagno vrataṃ pāśupataṃ caret
verses.translation: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.hindi: तीर्थ हैं। कालक्रमसे जो वृक्ष उस तीर्थमें गिरते हैं, वे नर्मदाके जलका स्पर्श प्रात हो जानेके कारण परम गतिको प्राप्त होते हैं। दूसरी महाभागा शुभ नदी विशल्यकरणी है, उस तीर्थमें स्नानकर मनुष्य तत्क्षण ही शल्यसे
verses.wordMeaning: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.commentary: Sense: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®

verses.sanskrit: निर्मितं हि मया पूर्वं व्रतं पाशुपतं परम् । गुह्याद् गुह्यतमं सूक्ष्मं वेदसारं विमुक्तये
verses.transliteration: nirmitaṃ hi mayā pūrvaṃ vrataṃ pāśupataṃ param / guhyād guhyatamaṃ sūkṣmaṃ vedasāraṃ vimuktaye
verses.translation: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.hindi: (सभी प्रकारके पापरूपी काँटोंसे) रहित हो जाता है। राजश्रेष्ठ! यह आप्त श्रुति है कि ईश्वरने इन कपिला तथा विशल्या नामको दोनों नदियोंको प्राणिमात्रके कल्याण करनेका आदेश पहलेसे ही दे रखा है। नराधिपति! उस तीर्थमें जो (शास्त्रीय विधिसे) अनशनव्रत करता है, वह सभी पापोंसे मुक्त होकर रुद्रलोकमें जाता है। राजन्! वहाँ सत्रानकर मनुष्य अश्वमेधका फल प्राप्त करता है और जो लोग उत्तरी तटपर निवास करते हैं, वे
verses.wordMeaning: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.commentary: Sense: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®

verses.sanskrit: यद् वा कौपीनवसनः स्याद् वैकवसनो मुनिः । वेदाभ्यासरतो विद्वान् ध्यायेत् पशुपतिं शिवम्
verses.transliteration: yad vā kaupīnavasanaḥ syād vaikavasano muniḥ / vedābhyāsarato vidvān dhyāyet paśupatiṃ śivam
verses.translation: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.hindi: रुद्रलोकमें निवास करते हैं॥ २४--३०॥
verses.wordMeaning: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.commentary: Sense: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®

verses.sanskrit: एष पाशुपतो योगः सेवनीयो मुमुक्षुभिः । भस्मच्छन्नैर्हि सततं निष्कामैरिति विश्रुतिः
verses.transliteration: eṣa pāśupato yogaḥ sevanīyo mumukṣubhiḥ / bhasmacchannairhi satataṃ niṣkāmairiti viśrutiḥ
verses.translation: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.hindi: युधिष्ठिर! शंकरने मुझे जैसा बतलाया था, उसके अनुसार गङ्गा, सरस्वती एवं नर्मदामें किया गया स्नान और दान समान फलदायक होता है। जो अमरकण्टक पर्वतपर प्राणोंका परित्याग करता है, वह सौ करोड़ वर्षासे भी अधिक समयतक रुद्रलोकमें पूजित होता है। फेन और उर्मियों (तरङ्गों)-से अलंकृत नर्मदाके पवित्र जलको पवित्रतापूर्वक सिरसे वन्दित करनेपर अर्थात् सिरपर धारण करनेसे मनुष्य सभी पापोंसे मुक्त
verses.wordMeaning: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.commentary: Sense: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®

verses.sanskrit: वीतरागभयक्रोधा मन्मया मामुपाश्रिताः । बहवो ऽनेन योगेन पूता मद्भावमागताः
verses.transliteration: vītarāgabhayakrodhā manmayā māmupāśritāḥ / bahavo 'nena yogena pūtā madbhāvamāgatāḥ
verses.translation: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.hindi: हो जाता है । नर्मदा सभी प्रकारसे पवित्र और ब्रह्महत्याको दूर करनेवाली है। वहाँ एक अहोरात्र उपवास करनेसे ब्रह्महत्या (-के पाप)-से मुक्ति हो जाती है। जालेश्वर नामका श्रेष्ठ तीर्थ सभी पापोंको नष्ट करनेवाला है।
verses.wordMeaning: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.commentary: Sense: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®

verses.sanskrit: अन्यानि चैव शास्त्राणि लोके ऽस्मिन् मोहनानितु । वेदवादविरुद्धानि मयैव कथितानि तु
verses.transliteration: anyāni caiva śāstrāṇi loke 'smin mohanānitu / vedavādaviruddhāni mayaiva kathitāni tu
verses.translation: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.hindi: वहाँ जाकर नियमसे रहनेवाला मनुष्य सभी कामनाओंको प्राप्त कर लेता है। चन्द्र तथा सूर्यग्रहणमें अमरकण्टककी यात्रा करनेसे मनुष्य अश्वमेध-यज्ञसे दस गुना अधिक पुण्य प्राप्त करता है॥ ३१--३६॥ एष पुण्यो गिरिवरो देवगन्धर्वसेवितः।
verses.wordMeaning: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.commentary: Sense: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®

verses.sanskrit: वामं पाशुपतं सोमं लाकुलं चैव भैरवम् । असेव्यमेतत् कथितं वेदवाह्यं तथेतरम्
verses.transliteration: vāmaṃ pāśupataṃ somaṃ lākulaṃ caiva bhairavam / asevyametat kathitaṃ vedavāhyaṃ tathetaram
verses.translation: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.hindi: यह पुण्यप्रद श्रेष्ठ पर्वत (अमरकण्टक) देवताओं
verses.wordMeaning: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.commentary: Sense: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®

verses.sanskrit: वेदमुर्तिरहं विप्रा नान्यशास्त्रार्थवेदिभिः । ज्ञायते मत्स्वरूपं तु मुक्त्वा वेदं सनातनम्
verses.transliteration: vedamurtirahaṃ viprā nānyaśāstrārthavedibhiḥ / jñāyate matsvarūpaṃ tu muktvā vedaṃ sanātanam
verses.translation: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.hindi: नानाद्रुमलताकीर्णो नानापुष्पोपशोभितः॥ ३७॥  तथा गन्धर्वोद्वारा सेवित, नाना प्रकारके वृक्षों और तत्र संनिहितो राजन् देव्या सह महेश्वरः । ब्रह्मा विष्णुस्तथा चेन्द्रो विद्याधरगणैः सह
verses.wordMeaning: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.commentary: Sense: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®

verses.sanskrit: स्थापयध्वमिदं मार्गं पूजयध्वं महेश्वरम् । अचिरादैश्वरं ज्ञानमुत्पत्स्यति न संशयः
verses.transliteration: sthāpayadhvamidaṃ mārgaṃ pūjayadhvaṃ maheśvaram / acirādaiśvaraṃ jñānamutpatsyati na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.hindi: पौण्डरीकस्य यज्ञस्य फलं प्राप्नोति मानवः
verses.wordMeaning: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.commentary: Sense: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®

verses.sanskrit: मयि भक्तिश्च विपुला भवतामस्तु सत्तमाः । ध्यातमात्रो हि सान्निध्यं दास्यामि मुनिसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: mayi bhaktiśca vipulā bhavatāmastu sattamāḥ / dhyātamātro hi sānnidhyaṃ dāsyāmi munisattamāḥ
verses.translation: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.hindi: कावेरी नाम विपुला नदी कल्मषनाशिनी। तत्र स्नात्वा महादेवमर्चयेद् वृषभध्वजम्। लताओँसे परिपूर्ण एवं विविध प्रकारके पुष्पोंसे सुशोभित है। राजन्! यहाँ देवी (पार्वती)-के साथ महेश्वर और विद्याधरगणोंके साथ ब्रह्मा, विष्णु तथा इन्द्र भी स्थित रहते हैं। जो मानव अमरकण्टक पर्वतकी परिक्रमा
verses.wordMeaning: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.commentary: Sense: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा भगवान् सोमस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत । तो ऽपि दारुवने तस्मिन् पूजयन्ति स्म शङ्करम् । ब्रह्मचर्यरताः शान्ता ज्ञानयोगपरायणाः
verses.transliteration: ityuktvā bhagavān somastatraivāntaradhīyata / to 'pi dāruvane tasmin pūjayanti sma śaṅkaram / brahmacaryaratāḥ śāntā jñānayogaparāyaṇāḥ
verses.translation: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.hindi: करता है, वह पौण्डरीक यज्ञका फल प्राप्त करता है। ऐसे ही कावेरी नामकी एक प्रसिद्ध नदी है। यह विशाल है तथा कल्मषोंका नाश करनेवाली है। उसमें स्नानकर तथा नर्मदाके संगममें स्नान करके वृषभध्वज
verses.wordMeaning: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.commentary: Sense: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®

verses.sanskrit: समेत्य ते महात्मानो मुनयो ब्रह्मवादिनः । वितेनिरे बहून् वादान्नध्यात्मज्ञानसंश्रयान्
verses.transliteration: sametya te mahātmāno munayo brahmavādinaḥ / vitenire bahūn vādānnadhyātmajñānasaṃśrayān
verses.translation: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.hindi: महादेवकी आराधना करनेसे रुद्रलोकमें प्रतिष्ठा प्राप्त संगमे नर्मदायास्तु रुद्रलोके महीयते॥ ४०॥  होती है॥ ३७--४०॥ इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे वट्साहस्तरघां संहितायामुपरिविभागे अद्टात्रिंशोऽध्यायः
verses.wordMeaning: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.commentary: Sense: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®

verses.sanskrit: किमस्य जगतो मूलमात्मा चास्माकमेव हि । को ऽपि स्यात् सर्वभावानां हेतुरीश्वर एव च
verses.transliteration: kimasya jagato mūlamātmā cāsmākameva hi / ko 'pi syāt sarvabhāvānāṃ heturīśvara eva ca
verses.translation: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.hindi: तीर्थमाहात्म्य-वर्णनके प्रसंगमें नर्मदाके तटवर्ती तीर्थोका विस्तारसे वर्णन
verses.wordMeaning: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.commentary: Sense: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®

verses.sanskrit: इत्येवं मन्यमानानां ध्यानमार्गावलम्बिनाम् । आविरासीन्महादेवी देवी गिरिवरात्मजा
verses.transliteration: ityevaṃ manyamānānāṃ dhyānamārgāvalambinām / āvirāsīnmahādevī devī girivarātmajā
verses.translation: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.hindi: नर्मदा सरितां श्रेष्ठा सर्वपापविनाशिनी। मुनिभिः कथिता पूर्वमीश्वरेण स्वयम्भुवा मुनिभिः संस्तुता ह्योषा नर्मदा प्रवरा नदी। रुद्रगात्राद् विनिष्क्रान्ता लोकानां हितकाम्यया
verses.wordMeaning: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.commentary: Sense: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®

verses.sanskrit: कोटिसूर्यप्रतीकाशा ज्वालामालासमावृता । स्वभाभिर्विमलाभिस्तु पूरयन्ती नभस्तलम्
verses.transliteration: koṭisūryapratīkāśā jvālāmālāsamāvṛtā / svabhābhirvimalābhistu pūrayantī nabhastalam
verses.translation: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.hindi: सर्वपापहरा नित्यं सर्वदेवनमस्कृता। संस्तुता देवगन्धर्वेरप्सरोभिस्तथैव च
verses.wordMeaning: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.commentary: Sense: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®

verses.sanskrit: तामन्वपश्यन् गिरिजाममेयां ज्वालासहस्रान्तरसन्निविष्टाम् । प्रणेमुरेकामखिलेशपत्नीं जानन्ति ते तत् परमस्य बीजम्
verses.transliteration: tāmanvapaśyan girijāmameyāṃ jvālāsahasrāntarasanniviṣṭām / praṇemurekāmakhileśapatnīṃ jānanti te tat paramasya bījam
verses.translation: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.hindi: उत्तरे चैव तत्कूले तीर्थ त्रैलोक्यविश्रुतम्। नाम्ना भद्रेशवरं पुण्यं सर्वपापहरं शुभम्। तत्र स्नात्वा नरो राजन् हैवतैः सह मोदते ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र तीर्थमाप्रातकेश्वरम्। तत्र स्नात्वा नरो राजन् गोसहस्त्रफलं लभेत्
verses.wordMeaning: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.commentary: Sense: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®

verses.sanskrit: असमाकमेषा परमेशपत्नी गतिस्तथात्मा गगनाभिधाना । पश्यन्त्यथात्मानमिदं च कृत्स्नं तस्यामथैते मुनयश्च विप्राः
verses.transliteration: asamākameṣā parameśapatnī gatistathātmā gaganābhidhānā / paśyantyathātmānamidaṃ ca kṛtsnaṃ tasyāmathaite munayaśca viprāḥ
verses.translation: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.hindi: सर्वपापविशुद्धात्मा रुद्रलोके महीयते
verses.wordMeaning: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.commentary: Sense: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®

verses.sanskrit: निरीक्षितास्ते परमेशपत्न्या तदन्तरे देवमशेषहेतुम् । पश्यन्ति शंभुं कविमीशितारं रुद्रं बृहन्तं पुरुषं पुराणम्
verses.transliteration: nirīkṣitāste parameśapatnyā tadantare devamaśeṣahetum / paśyanti śaṃbhuṃ kavimīśitāraṃ rudraṃ bṛhantaṃ puruṣaṃ purāṇam
verses.translation: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.hindi: मार्कण्डेयने कहा--मुनियोंने तथा उनसे पूर्व स्वयम्भू ईश्वरने नर्मदाका वर्णन सभी पापोंका नाश करनेवाली सर्वश्रेष्ठ नदीके रूपमें किया है। मुनियोंद्वारा स्तुति करनेपर यह श्रेष्ठ नर्मदा नदी लोगोंके कल्याणको कामनासे रुद्रके शरीरसे निकली है। यह नित्य सभी पापोंको हरनेवाली है, सभी देवोंद्वारा नमस्कृत है और देवताओं, गन्धर्वो तथा अप्सराओंके द्वारा स्तुत्य है
verses.wordMeaning: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.commentary: Sense: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®

verses.sanskrit: आलोक्य देवीमथ देवमीशं प्रणेमुरानन्दमवापुरग्र्यम् । ज्ञानं तदैशं भगवत्प्रसादा- दाविर्बभौ जन्मविनाशहेतु
verses.transliteration: ālokya devīmatha devamīśaṃ praṇemurānandamavāpuragryam / jñānaṃ tadaiśaṃ bhagavatprasādā- dāvirbabhau janmavināśahetu
verses.translation: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.hindi: इस (नर्मदा) नदीके उत्तरी किनारेपर तीनों लोकोंमें विख्यात भद्रेश्वरनामका तीर्थ है, जो पवित्र, शुभ तथा सभी पापोंका हरण करनेवाला है। राजन्! वहाँ स्नान करके मनुष्य देवताओंके साथ आनन्दित होता है।
verses.wordMeaning: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.commentary: Sense: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®

verses.sanskrit: इयं हि सा जगतो योनिरेका सर्वात्मिका सर्वनियामिका च । माहेश्वरीशक्तिरनादिसिद्धा व्योमाभिधाना दिवि राजतीव
verses.transliteration: iyaṃ hi sā jagato yonirekā sarvātmikā sarvaniyāmikā ca / māheśvarīśaktiranādisiddhā vyomābhidhānā divi rājatīva
verses.translation: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.hindi: राजेन्द्र! वहाँसे आम्रातकेश्वर तीर्थमें जाना चाहिए। राजन्! वहाँ स्नान करके मनुष्य हजार गौओंके दानका फल प्राप्त करता है तदनन्तर संयमपूर्वक नियत आहार करते हुए अङ्गारेश्वर तीर्थकी यात्रा करनी चाहिए। इससे (तीर्थ- विधि सम्पन्न करनेसे) सभी पापोंका शोधन होता है और रुद्रलोकमें प्रतिष्ठा प्रात होती है
verses.wordMeaning: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.commentary: Sense: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®

verses.sanskrit: अस्या महत्परमेष्ठी परस्ता- न्महेश्वरः शिव एको ऽथ रुद्रः । चकार विश्वं परशक्तिनिष्ठां मायामथारुह्य स देवदेवः
verses.transliteration: asyā mahatparameṣṭhī parastā- nmaheśvaraḥ śiva eko 'tha rudraḥ / cakāra viśvaṃ paraśaktiniṣṭhāṃ māyāmathāruhya sa devadevaḥ
verses.translation: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.hindi: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र केदारं नाम पुण्यदम्। तत्र स्नात्वोदकं कृत्वा सर्वान् कामानवाणुयात्
verses.wordMeaning: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.commentary: Sense: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®

verses.sanskrit: एको देवः सर्वभूतेषु गूढो मायी रुद्रः सकलो निष्कलश्च । स एव देवी न च तद्विभिन्न- मेतज्ज्ञात्वा ह्यमृतत्वं व्रजन्ति
verses.transliteration: eko devaḥ sarvabhūteṣu gūḍho māyī rudraḥ sakalo niṣkalaśca / sa eva devī na ca tadvibhinna- metajjñātvā hyamṛtatvaṃ vrajanti
verses.translation: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.hindi: पिप्पलेशं ततो गच्छेत् सर्वपापविनाशनम् । तत्र स्नात्वा महाराज रुद्रलोके महीयते तत्र प्राणान् परित्यज्य रुद्रलोकमवाप्नुयात्
verses.wordMeaning: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.commentary: Sense: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®

verses.sanskrit: अन्तर्हितो ऽभूद् भगवानथेशो देव्या भर्गः सह देवादिदेवः । आराधयन्ति स्म तमेव देवं वनौकसस्ते पुनरेव रुद्रम्
verses.transliteration: antarhito 'bhūd bhagavānatheśo devyā bhargaḥ saha devādidevaḥ / ārādhayanti sma tameva devaṃ vanaukasaste punareva rudram
verses.translation: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.hindi: ततः पुष्करिणीं गच्छेत् स्नानं तत्र समाचरेत् । स्नातमात्रो नरस्तत्र इन्द्रस्यार्धासनं लभेत्
verses.wordMeaning: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.commentary: Sense: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®

verses.sanskrit: एतद् वः कथितं सर्वं देवदेवविचेष्टितम् । देवदारुवने पूर्वं पुराणे यन्मया श्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: etad vaḥ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ devadevaviceṣṭitam / devadāruvane pūrvaṃ purāṇe yanmayā śrutam
verses.translation: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.hindi: तत्र स्नात्वार्चयेद् देवं गोसहस्त्रफलं लभेत् उपोष्य रजनीमेकां स्नानं कृत्वा यथाविधि
verses.wordMeaning: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.commentary: Sense: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®

verses.sanskrit: यः पठेच्छृणुयान्नित्यं मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः । श्रावयेद् वा द्विजान् शान्तान् स याति परमां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyānnityaṃ mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ / śrāvayed vā dvijān śāntān sa yāti paramāṃ gatim
verses.translation: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.hindi: आराधयेन्महायोगं देवं नारायणं हरिम्। गोसहस्त्रफलं प्राप्य विष्णुलोकं स गच्छति
verses.wordMeaning: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.commentary: Sense: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे सप्तत्रिंशो ऽध्यायः सूत उवाच एषा पुण्यतमा देवी देवगन्धर्वसेविता । नर्मदा लोकविख्याता तीर्थानामुत्तमा नदी
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge saptatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca eṣā puṇyatamā devī devagandharvasevitā / narmadā lokavikhyātā tīrthānāmuttamā nadī
verses.translation: In the Krta Age, God Siva the delighted Supreme Lord arrived at the forest of Devadaru trees on the auspicious peak of the Himalayas.
verses.hindi: ऋषितीर्थं ततो गत्वा सर्वपापहरं नृणाम्। स्नातमात्रो नरस्तत्र शिवलोके महीयते प्रीतस्तस्य ददौ योगं देवदेवो महेश्वरः
verses.wordMeaning: In the Krta Age, God Siva the delighted Supreme Lord arrived at the forest of Devadaru trees on the auspicious peak of the Himalayas.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the Krta Age, God Siva the delighted Supreme Lord arrived at the forest of Devadaru trees on the auspicious peak of the Himalayas.

verses.sanskrit: तस्याः शृणुध्वं माहात्म्यं मार्कण्डेयेन भाषितम् । युधिष्ठिराय तु शुभं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम्
verses.transliteration: tasyāḥ śṛṇudhvaṃ māhātmyaṃ mārkaṇḍeyena bhāṣitam / yudhiṣṭhirāya tu śubhaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam
verses.translation: He was naked and bore hideous marks. He had smeared ashes {Bhasma) all over his body. He held firebrands in. his hands. His eyes v.'ere red and tawny-coloured.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मणा निर्मितं लिङ्गं ब्रह्मोश्वरमिति श्रुतम्। यत्र स्नात्वा नरो राजन् ब्रह्मलोके महीयते
verses.wordMeaning: He was naked and bore hideous marks. He had smeared ashes {Bhasma) all over his body. He held firebrands in. his hands. His eyes v.'ere red and tawny-coloured.
verses.commentary: Sense: He was naked and bore hideous marks. He had smeared ashes {Bhasma) all over his body. He held firebrands in. his hands. His eyes v.'ere red and tawny-coloured.

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच श्रुतास्तु विविधा धर्मास्त्वत्प्रसादान्महामुने । माहात्म्यं च प्रयागस्य तीर्थानि विविधानि च
verses.transliteration: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca śrutāstu vividhā dharmāstvatprasādānmahāmune / māhātmyaṃ ca prayāgasya tīrthāni vividhāni ca
verses.translation: O son of Pandu, he rejoices in heaven for a hundred thousand years. He will be surrounded by divine damsels, the groups of Apsaras.
verses.hindi: राजेन्द्र! इसके बाद पुण्य प्रदान करनेवाले केदार नामक तीर्थमें जाना चाहिए, वहाँ स्नान करके उदकदान (तर्पण आदि क्रिया) करनेसे सभी कामनाओंको प्राप्ति होती है। तदनन्तर सभी पापोंका विनाश करनेवाले पिप्पलेश (तीर्थ)-में जाना चाहिए। महाराज! वहाँ स्नान करनेसे रुद्रलोकमें आदर प्राप्त होता है। राजेन्द्र! तदनन्तर श्रेष्ठ विमलेश्वर (तीर्थ)-में जाना चाहिए। वहाँ प्राणोंका परित्याग करनेसे रुद्रलोक प्राप्त होता है। इसके
verses.wordMeaning: O son of Pandu, he rejoices in heaven for a hundred thousand years. He will be surrounded by divine damsels, the groups of Apsaras.
verses.commentary: Sense: O son of Pandu, he rejoices in heaven for a hundred thousand years. He will be surrounded by divine damsels, the groups of Apsaras.

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदा सर्वतीर्थानां मुख्या हि भवतेरिता । तस्यास्त्विदानीं माहात्म्यं वक्तुमर्हसि सत्तम
verses.transliteration: narmadā sarvatīrthānāṃ mukhyā hi bhavateritā / tasyāstvidānīṃ māhātmyaṃ vaktumarhasi sattama
verses.translation: He will smear himself with divine scent and unguents. He will shine with divine flowers. He sports in the divine world and he rejoices alongwith Devas.
verses.hindi: बाद पुष्करिणीमें जाकर वहाँ स्नान करना चाहिए। वहाँ स्नानमात्र करनेसे मनुष्य इन्द्रका आधा आसन प्राप्त करता है॥७--१०॥
verses.wordMeaning: He will smear himself with divine scent and unguents. He will shine with divine flowers. He sports in the divine world and he rejoices alongwith Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: He will smear himself with divine scent and unguents. He will shine with divine flowers. He sports in the divine world and he rejoices alongwith Devas.

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेय उवाच नर्मदा सरितां श्रेष्ठा रुद्रदेहाद् विनिः सृता । तारयेत् सर्वभूतानि स्थावराणि चराणि च
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca narmadā saritāṃ śreṣṭhā rudradehād viniḥ sṛtā / tārayet sarvabhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca
