verses.translation: After falling off from heaven, he shall be born as a righteous king. He will obtain a house embellished in different kinds of gems and jewels.
verses.hindi: राजेन्द्र! ऐसी श्रुति है कि वहाँसे शूलभेद नामके तीर्थमें जाना चाहिए। वहाँ स्नान करके देवाराधना करनी चाहिए। इससे हजार गौओंके दानका फल प्राप्त होता है। राजेन्द्र! तदनन्तर परम उत्तम बलितीर्थमें जाना चाहिए। राजन्! वहाँ स्नान करके मनुष्य सिंहासनाधिपति अर्थात् राजा होता है। इसके उपरान्त (बलितीर्थके) दक्षिणी किनारेपर स्थित शक्रतीर्थमें जाना चाहिए। वहाँ एक रात्रि उपवास करके यथाविधि स्नान करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: After falling off from heaven, he shall be born as a righteous king. He will obtain a house embellished in different kinds of gems and jewels.
verses.commentary: Sense: After falling off from heaven, he shall be born as a righteous king. He will obtain a house embellished in different kinds of gems and jewels.

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदायास्तु माहात्म्यं पुराणे यन्मया श्रुतम् । इदानीं तत्प्रवक्ष्यामि शृणुष्वैकमनाः शुभम्
verses.transliteration: narmadāyāstu māhātmyaṃ purāṇe yanmayā śrutam / idānīṃ tatpravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvaikamanāḥ śubham
verses.translation: The house shall be shining on being bedecked in diamonds and Lapis Lazuli. The columns therein shall be made of jewels. It shall be endowed with paintings, vehicles of brilliant appearance as well as hundred of maid-servants.
verses.hindi: तथा महायोगस्वरूप नारायण हरिकी आराधना करनी चाहिए। इनसे हजार गौओंके दानका फल प्राप्तकर मनुष्य विष्णुलोकमें जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: The house shall be shining on being bedecked in diamonds and Lapis Lazuli. The columns therein shall be made of jewels. It shall be endowed with paintings, vehicles of brilliant appearance as well as hundred of maid-servants.
verses.commentary: Sense: The house shall be shining on being bedecked in diamonds and Lapis Lazuli. The columns therein shall be made of jewels. It shall be endowed with paintings, vehicles of brilliant appearance as well as hundred of maid-servants.

verses.sanskrit: पुण्या कनखले गङ्गा कुरुक्षेत्रे सरस्वती । ग्रामे वा यदि वारण्ये पुण्या सर्वत्र नर्मदा
verses.transliteration: puṇyā kanakhale gaṅgā kurukṣetre sarasvatī / grāme vā yadi vāraṇye puṇyā sarvatra narmadā
verses.translation: He shall be the emperor ruling over kings. He will be elegant and glorious and loved by all women. He will live for more than a hundred years enjoying all pleasures.
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर मनुष्योंके समस्त पापोंको हरनेवाले ऋषितीर्थमें जाकर वहाँ स्नानमात्र करनेसे मनुष्य शिवलोकमें पूजित होता है। वहींपर नारदजीका परम शोभन तीर्थ है। वहाँ स्नानमात्र करके मनुष्य हजार गोदानका फल प्राप्त करता है। पूर्वकालमें इसी तीर्थमें देवर्षि नारदने तपस्या की थी और इसी तपस्याके फलस्वरूप देवाधिदेव महेश्वरने प्रसन्न होकर उन्हें योग प्रदान किया था। राजन्! ब्रह्माके द्वारा स्थापित लिङ्ग ब्रह्मेश्वर
verses.wordMeaning: He shall be the emperor ruling over kings. He will be elegant and glorious and loved by all women. He will live for more than a hundred years enjoying all pleasures.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall be the emperor ruling over kings. He will be elegant and glorious and loved by all women. He will live for more than a hundred years enjoying all pleasures.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिभिः सारस्वतं तोयं सप्ताहेन तु यामुनम् । सद्यः पुनाति गाङ्गेयं दर्शनादेव नार्मदम्
verses.transliteration: tribhiḥ sārasvataṃ toyaṃ saptāhena tu yāmunam / sadyaḥ punāti gāṅgeyaṃ darśanādeva nārmadam
verses.translation: When (for ending his life ) he enters fire or water or when he observes fast, his departure shall be with no return (to Sarhsara) like that of the wind absorbed in the sky.
verses.hindi: नामसे प्रसिद्ध है। इस तीर्थमें स्नान करके मनुष्य ब्रह्मलोकमें प्रतिष्ठा प्रा करता है
verses.wordMeaning: When (for ending his life ) he enters fire or water or when he observes fast, his departure shall be with no return (to Sarhsara) like that of the wind absorbed in the sky.
verses.commentary: Sense: When (for ending his life ) he enters fire or water or when he observes fast, his departure shall be with no return (to Sarhsara) like that of the wind absorbed in the sky.

verses.sanskrit: कलिङ्गदेशपश्चार्धे पर्वते ऽमरकण्टके । पुण्या च त्रिषु लोकेषु रमणीया मनोरमा
verses.transliteration: kaliṅgadeśapaścārdhe parvate 'marakaṇṭake / puṇyā ca triṣu lokeṣu ramaṇīyā manoramā
verses.translation: On the ridge of the western mountain, there is a lake named Jalesvara. It is well known in the three worlds and is destructive of all sins.
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर ऋणतीर्थमें जाना चाहिए, वहाँ जानेवाला निश्चित ही ऋणसे मुक्त हो जाता है। इसके बाद महेश्वर-तीर्थमें जाना चाहिए। वहाँ जाकर तीर्थसेवन करनेसे जन्मका अन्तिम फल (महेश्वरका दर्शन) प्राप्त अहोरात्रोपवासेन त्रिरात्रफलमाप्नुयात्
verses.wordMeaning: On the ridge of the western mountain, there is a lake named Jalesvara. It is well known in the three worlds and is destructive of all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the ridge of the western mountain, there is a lake named Jalesvara. It is well known in the three worlds and is destructive of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: सदेवासुरगन्धर्वा ऋषयश्च तपोधनाः । तपस्तप्त्वा तु राजेन्द्र सिद्धिं तु परमां गताः
verses.transliteration: sadevāsuragandharvā ṛṣayaśca tapodhanāḥ / tapastaptvā tu rājendra siddhiṃ tu paramāṃ gatāḥ
verses.translation: If one offers Pindas there and performs the Sandhya worship, it is asgood as propitiating the (Pitrs) for ten thousand years. There is no doubt about this.
verses.hindi: तावद् वर्षसहर्त्राणि रुद्रलोके महीयते
verses.wordMeaning: If one offers Pindas there and performs the Sandhya worship, it is asgood as propitiating the (Pitrs) for ten thousand years. There is no doubt about this.
verses.commentary: Sense: If one offers Pindas there and performs the Sandhya worship, it is asgood as propitiating the (Pitrs) for ten thousand years. There is no doubt about this.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र स्नात्वा नरो राजन् नियमस्थो जितेन्द्रियः । उपोष्य रजनीमेकां कुलानां तारयेच्छतम्
verses.transliteration: tatra snātvā naro rājan niyamastho jitendriyaḥ / upoṣya rajanīmekāṃ kulānāṃ tārayecchatam
verses.translation: On the southern bank of Narmada, there is a great river named Kapila. It is stationed not very far. It is covered by Juicy Arjuna trees.®
verses.hindi: अक्षयं मोदते कालं यावच्यन्द्रदिवाकरौ हुंकारिता तु व्यासेन दक्षिणेन ततो गता
verses.wordMeaning: On the southern bank of Narmada, there is a great river named Kapila. It is stationed not very far. It is covered by Juicy Arjuna trees.®
verses.commentary: Sense: On the southern bank of Narmada, there is a great river named Kapila. It is stationed not very far. It is covered by Juicy Arjuna trees.®

verses.sanskrit: योजनानां शतं साग्रं श्रूयते सरिदुत्तमा । विस्तारेण तु राजेन्द्र योजनद्वयमायता
verses.transliteration: yojanānāṃ śataṃ sāgraṃ śrūyate sariduttamā / vistāreṇa tu rājendra yojanadvayamāyatā
verses.translation: That is meritorious and highly blessed. It is well- known in the three worlds. O Yudhisthira, the holy spots there number to more than a hundred crore.
verses.hindi: त्रैलोक्यविश्रुतं पुण्यं तत्र संनिहितः शिव: । तत्र स्नात्वा नरो राजन् गाणपत्यमवाप्नुयात्
verses.wordMeaning: That is meritorious and highly blessed. It is well- known in the three worlds. O Yudhisthira, the holy spots there number to more than a hundred crore.
verses.commentary: Sense: That is meritorious and highly blessed. It is well- known in the three worlds. O Yudhisthira, the holy spots there number to more than a hundred crore.

verses.sanskrit: षष्टितीर्थसहस्राणि षष्टिकोट्यस्तथैव च । पर्वतस्य समन्तात् तु तिष्ठन्त्यमरकण्टके
verses.transliteration: ṣaṣṭitīrthasahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭikoṭyastathaiva ca / parvatasya samantāt tu tiṣṭhantyamarakaṇṭake
verses.translation: The trees that fall into the holy river after growing for many years, attain great goal due to the contact of waters of Narmada.
verses.hindi: स्कन्दतीर्थं ततो गच्छेत् सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् आजन्मनः कृतं पापं स्नातस्तीव्रं व्यपोहति तत्र देवाः सगन्धर्वा भवात्मजमनुत्तमम्। उपासते महात्मानं स्कन्दं शक्तिधरं प्रभुम्
verses.wordMeaning: The trees that fall into the holy river after growing for many years, attain great goal due to the contact of waters of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: The trees that fall into the holy river after growing for many years, attain great goal due to the contact of waters of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मचारी शुचिर्भूत्वा जितक्रोधो जितेन्द्रियः । सर्वहिंसानिवृत्तस्तु सर्वभूतहिते रतः
verses.transliteration: brahmacārī śucirbhūtvā jitakrodho jitendriyaḥ / sarvahiṃsānivṛttastu sarvabhūtahite rataḥ
verses.translation: A second holy river is the blessed and auspicious. Visalyakarani. A man taking bath in that holy river becomes, free from pains, sins and grief.®
verses.hindi: गोसहस्त्रफलं प्राप्य रुद्रलोकं स गच्छति
verses.wordMeaning: A second holy river is the blessed and auspicious. Visalyakarani. A man taking bath in that holy river becomes, free from pains, sins and grief.®
verses.commentary: Sense: A second holy river is the blessed and auspicious. Visalyakarani. A man taking bath in that holy river becomes, free from pains, sins and grief.®

verses.sanskrit: एवं सर्वसमाचारो यस्तु प्राणान् समुत्सृजेत् । तस्य पुण्यफलं राजन् शृणुष्वावहितो नृप
verses.transliteration: evaṃ sarvasamācāro yastu prāṇān samutsṛjet / tasya puṇyaphalaṃ rājan śṛṇuṣvāvahito nṛpa
verses.translation: Kapila and Visalya are heard as the two excellent rivers mentioned by Isvara formerly with a desire for the well¬ being of the worlds.
verses.hindi: अङ्गिरा यत्र देवेशं ब्रह्मपुत्रो वृषध्वजम्। तपसाराध्य विश्वेशं लब्धवान् योगमुत्तमम् कुशतीर्थं ततो गच्छेत् सर्वपापप्रणाशनम्। स्नानं तत्र प्रकुर्वीत अश्वमेधफलं लभेत्
verses.wordMeaning: Kapila and Visalya are heard as the two excellent rivers mentioned by Isvara formerly with a desire for the well¬ being of the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kapila and Visalya are heard as the two excellent rivers mentioned by Isvara formerly with a desire for the well¬ being of the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: शतवर्षसहस्राणि स्वर्गे मोदति पाण्डव । सप्सरोगणसंकीर्णो दिव्यस्त्रीपरिवारितः
verses.transliteration: śatavarṣasahasrāṇi svarge modati pāṇḍava / sapsarogaṇasaṃkīrṇo divyastrīparivāritaḥ
verses.translation: O lord of men, he who gives up food until death in that Tlrtha, shall have his soul purified of all sins. He goes to the region of Rudra.*
verses.hindi: तदुपरान्त सभी व्याधियोंका विनाश करनेवाले भीमेश्वर-तीर्थमें जाना चाहिए। वहाँ स्नानमात्र करनेसे मनुष्य सभी दुःखोसे मुक्त हो जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: O lord of men, he who gives up food until death in that Tlrtha, shall have his soul purified of all sins. He goes to the region of Rudra.*
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord of men, he who gives up food until death in that Tlrtha, shall have his soul purified of all sins. He goes to the region of Rudra.*

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यगन्धानुलिप्तश्च दिव्यपुष्पोपशोभितः । क्रीडते देवलोके तु दैवतैः सह मोदते
verses.transliteration: divyagandhānuliptaśca divyapuṣpopaśobhitaḥ / krīḍate devaloke tu daivataiḥ saha modate
verses.translation: O king, on taking his bath there a man shall attain the fruit of a horse-sacrifice. Those who reside on the northern bank reside in the region of Rudra.®
verses.hindi: राजेन्द्र! तदनन्तर उत्तम पिङ्गलेश्वर (तीर्थमें) जाना चाहिए। वहाँ अहोयत्रका उपवास करनेसे त्रिरात्र (उपवास)- का फल प्राप्त होता है। राजेन्द्र उस तीर्थमें जो कपिला (गौ)-का दान करता है, वह उस कपिलाके तथा उसके कुलमें उत्पन्न संतानोंके शरीरोंपर जितने रोम होते हैं, उतने ही हजार वर्षपर्यन्त रुद्रलोकमें प्रतिष्ठित होता है। नराधिप! वहाँ जो प्राणोंका त्याग करता है, वह जबतक सूर्य-चन्द्रमा हैं, तबतक अक्षय आनन्द
verses.wordMeaning: O king, on taking his bath there a man shall attain the fruit of a horse-sacrifice. Those who reside on the northern bank reside in the region of Rudra.®
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, on taking his bath there a man shall attain the fruit of a horse-sacrifice. Those who reside on the northern bank reside in the region of Rudra.®

verses.sanskrit: ततः स्वर्गात् परिभ्रष्टो राजा भवति धार्मिकः । गृहं तु लभते ऽसौ वै नानारत्नसमन्वितम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ svargāt paribhraṣṭo rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ / gṛhaṃ tu labhate 'sau vai nānāratnasamanvitam
verses.translation: As Sankara told me, O Yudhisthira, the bath and. the charitable gift at Sarasvatl, Gahga, and Narmada are of equal efficacy.®
verses.hindi: प्रात करता है। जो मनुष्य नर्मदाके तटका आश्रयकर (वहाँ) रहते हैं, वे मरनेपर पुण्यवान् संतोंके समान स्वर्ग प्राप्त करते हैं॥ २१--२४॥
verses.wordMeaning: As Sankara told me, O Yudhisthira, the bath and. the charitable gift at Sarasvatl, Gahga, and Narmada are of equal efficacy.®
verses.commentary: Sense: As Sankara told me, O Yudhisthira, the bath and. the charitable gift at Sarasvatl, Gahga, and Narmada are of equal efficacy.®

verses.sanskrit: स्तम्भैर्मणिमयैर्दिव्यैर्वज्रवैदूर्यभूषितम् । आलेख्यवाहनैः शुभ्रैर्दासीदाससमन्वितम्
verses.transliteration: stambhairmaṇimayairdivyairvajravaidūryabhūṣitam / ālekhyavāhanaiḥ śubhrairdāsīdāsasamanvitam
verses.translation: He who abandons his life -on the mountain Amara- kantaka is honoured in the Rudraloka for hundreds of crores of years and more.''
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर व्यासतीर्थ नामक तपोवनमें स्थित दीसेश्वर (तीर्थमें) जाना चाहिए। प्राचीन कालमें वहाँ व्यासजीसे भयभीत होकर महानदी (नर्मदा) वापस हो गयी थी और व्यासके द्वारा हुंकार किये जानेपर (अर्थात् रोष प्रकट करनेपर) वहाँसे दक्षिणकी ओर चली गयी। युधिष्ठिर! उस तीर्थमें जो प्रदक्षिणा करता है, प्रसन्न होकर व्यासजी उसे अभिलषित फल प्रदान करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: He who abandons his life -on the mountain Amara- kantaka is honoured in the Rudraloka for hundreds of crores of years and more.''
verses.commentary: Sense: He who abandons his life -on the mountain Amara- kantaka is honoured in the Rudraloka for hundreds of crores of years and more.''

verses.sanskrit: राजराजेश्वरः श्रीमान् सर्वस्त्रीजनवल्लभः । जीवेद् वर्षशतं साग्रं तत्र भोगसमन्वितः
verses.transliteration: rājarājeśvaraḥ śrīmān sarvastrījanavallabhaḥ / jīved varṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ tatra bhogasamanvitaḥ
verses.translation: On sprinkling the head with the holy and sacred, water of Narmada along with its foam one is relieved of all. sins.
verses.hindi: राजेन्द्र! तदनन्तर तीनों लोकोंमें विख्यात तथा पवित्र इक्षुनदीके संगमपर जाना चाहिए। वहाँ शिव प्रतिष्ठित हैं। राजन्! वहाँ मनुष्य स्नानकर (शिवका) गाणपत्य- पद प्राप्त करता है। इसके बाद सभी पापोंका विनाश
verses.wordMeaning: On sprinkling the head with the holy and sacred, water of Narmada along with its foam one is relieved of all. sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: On sprinkling the head with the holy and sacred, water of Narmada along with its foam one is relieved of all. sins.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निप्रवेशे ऽथ जले अथवानशने कृते । अनिवर्तिका गतिस्तस्य पवनस्याम्बरे यथा
verses.transliteration: agnipraveśe 'tha jale athavānaśane kṛte / anivartikā gatistasya pavanasyāmbare yathā
verses.translation: Narmada is holy everywhere. It dispels sins of Brahmana-slaughter. By observing fast for a day and a night, one is absolved of the sin of Brahmana slaughter.
verses.hindi: करनेवाले स्कन्दतीर्थमें जाना चाहिए। वहाँ स्नान करनेसे जन्मभरका किया हुआ पाप शीघ्र ही दूर हो जाता है। वहाँ शंकरजीके पुत्र, श्रेष्ठ महात्मा, शक्तिसम्पन्न प्रभु स्कन्दकी गन्धवाँसहित देवता उपासना करते हैं। तदनन्तर आङ्गिरस तीर्थमें जाकर स्नान करना चाहिए। वहाँ स्नान करनेवाला व्यक्ति हजार गोदानका फल प्राप्त कर रुद्रलोकमें जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: Narmada is holy everywhere. It dispels sins of Brahmana-slaughter. By observing fast for a day and a night, one is absolved of the sin of Brahmana slaughter.
verses.commentary: Sense: Narmada is holy everywhere. It dispels sins of Brahmana-slaughter. By observing fast for a day and a night, one is absolved of the sin of Brahmana slaughter.

verses.sanskrit: पश्चिमे पर्वततटे सर्वपापविनाशनः । ह्रदो जलेश्वरो नाम त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतः
verses.transliteration: paścime parvatataṭe sarvapāpavināśanaḥ / hrado jaleśvaro nāma triṣu lokeṣu viśrutaḥ
verses.translation: The most excellent holy centre jalesvara is destruc¬ tive of all sins. A man who observes religious regulation and restraints on going there, attains all desires.
verses.hindi: वहाँ ब्रह्माजीके पुत्र (महर्षि) अङ्गिराने तपस्याके द्वारा देवेश वृषध्वज विश्वेशवरकी आराधना कर उत्तम योग प्रात किया था। तदनन्तर समस्त पापोंको नष्ट करनेवाले कुशतीर्थमें जाना चाहिए  वहाँ स्नान करनेसे
verses.wordMeaning: The most excellent holy centre jalesvara is destruc¬ tive of all sins. A man who observes religious regulation and restraints on going there, attains all desires.
verses.commentary: Sense: The most excellent holy centre jalesvara is destruc¬ tive of all sins. A man who observes religious regulation and restraints on going there, attains all desires.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र पिण्डप्रदानेन संध्योपासनकर्मणा । दशवर्षाणि पितरस्तर्पिताः स्युर्न संशयः
verses.transliteration: tatra piṇḍapradānena saṃdhyopāsanakarmaṇā / daśavarṣāṇi pitarastarpitāḥ syurna saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: On going to Amarakantaka during the lunar or solar eclipse, a man attains ten times the merit of an Asvamedha (horse-sacrifice).
verses.hindi: व्यक्ति अश्वमेधका फल प्राप्त करता है कोटितीर्थं ततो गच्छेत् सर्वपापप्रणाशनम्। तत्र स्नात्वा नरो राज्यं लभते नात्र संशय:
verses.wordMeaning: On going to Amarakantaka during the lunar or solar eclipse, a man attains ten times the merit of an Asvamedha (horse-sacrifice).
verses.commentary: Sense: On going to Amarakantaka during the lunar or solar eclipse, a man attains ten times the merit of an Asvamedha (horse-sacrifice).

verses.sanskrit: दक्षिणे नर्मदाकूले कपिलाख्या महानदी । सरलार्जुनसंच्छन्ना नातिदूरे व्यवस्थिता
verses.transliteration: dakṣiṇe narmadākūle kapilākhyā mahānadī / saralārjunasaṃcchannā nātidūre vyavasthitā
verses.translation: This excellent mountain is meritorious.lt is resorted to by Devas and Gandharvas. It is full of various kinds of trees and creepers. It shines with different kinds of flowers.
verses.hindi: स्नातमात्रो नरस्तत्र सोमलोके महीयते
verses.wordMeaning: This excellent mountain is meritorious.lt is resorted to by Devas and Gandharvas. It is full of various kinds of trees and creepers. It shines with different kinds of flowers.
verses.commentary: Sense: This excellent mountain is meritorious.lt is resorted to by Devas and Gandharvas. It is full of various kinds of trees and creepers. It shines with different kinds of flowers.

verses.sanskrit: सा तु पुण्या महाभागा त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुता । तत्र कोटिशतं साग्रं तीर्थानां तु युधिष्ठिर
verses.transliteration: sā tu puṇyā mahābhāgā triṣu lokeṣu viśrutā / tatra koṭiśataṃ sāgraṃ tīrthānāṃ tu yudhiṣṭhira
verses.translation: O King, Mahesvara (the great God) is present there alongwith the goddess (Uma). Brahma, Visnu, and Rudra (Indra?) (are present there) alongwith the groups of Vidyadharas.
verses.hindi: तत्र स्नात्वा नरो राजन् सर्वयज्ञफलं लभेत् दरिद्रा व्याधिता ये तु ये च दुष्कृतकारिणः। मुच्यन्ते सर्वपापेभ्यः सूर्यलोकं प्रयान्ति च
verses.wordMeaning: O King, Mahesvara (the great God) is present there alongwith the goddess (Uma). Brahma, Visnu, and Rudra (Indra?) (are present there) alongwith the groups of Vidyadharas.
verses.commentary: Sense: O King, Mahesvara (the great God) is present there alongwith the goddess (Uma). Brahma, Visnu, and Rudra (Indra?) (are present there) alongwith the groups of Vidyadharas.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिंस्तीर्थे तु ये वृक्षाः पतिताः कालपर्ययात् । नर्मदातोयसंस्पृष्टास्ते यान्ति परमां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: tasmiṃstīrthe tu ye vṛkṣāḥ patitāḥ kālaparyayāt / narmadātoyasaṃspṛṣṭāste yānti paramāṃ gatim
verses.translation: The man who circumambulates the mountain Amara¬ kantaka attains the fruit of Paundarika sacrifice.
verses.hindi: स्नातमात्रो नरस्तत्र स्वर्गलोकमवाप्नुयात्
verses.wordMeaning: The man who circumambulates the mountain Amara¬ kantaka attains the fruit of Paundarika sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: The man who circumambulates the mountain Amara¬ kantaka attains the fruit of Paundarika sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: द्वितीया तु महाभागा विशल्यकरणी शुभा । तत्र तीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा विशल्यो भवति क्षणात्
verses.transliteration: dvitīyā tu mahābhāgā viśalyakaraṇī śubhā / tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā viśalyo bhavati kṣaṇāt
verses.translation: The river Kaveri is well-known as the destructive of sins. One should take bath there and worship the bull-bannered Mahadeva. (One who takes bath) at the confluence of Narmada is honoured in the Rudraloka.
verses.hindi: काञ्चनं तु द्विजो दद्याद् यथाविभवविस्तरम्। पुष्पकेण विमानेन वायुलोकं स गच्छति स्नानमात्रादप्सरोभिर्मोदते कालमक्षयम्
verses.wordMeaning: The river Kaveri is well-known as the destructive of sins. One should take bath there and worship the bull-bannered Mahadeva. (One who takes bath) at the confluence of Narmada is honoured in the Rudraloka.
verses.commentary: Sense: The river Kaveri is well-known as the destructive of sins. One should take bath there and worship the bull-bannered Mahadeva. (One who takes bath) at the confluence of Narmada is honoured in the Rudraloka.

verses.sanskrit: कपिला च विशल्या च श्रूयते राजसत्तम । ईश्वरेण पुरा प्रोक्ता लोकानां हितकाम्यया
verses.transliteration: kapilā ca viśalyā ca śrūyate rājasattama / īśvareṇa purā proktā lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā
verses.translation: "O Lord of Devas, how shall we worship you always, by means of the path of action or by means of the path of knowledge?
verses.hindi: चैत्रमासे तु सम्प्राप्ते शुक्लपक्षे त्रयोदशी । कामदेवदिने तस्मिन्नहल्यां यस्तु पूजयेत्
verses.wordMeaning: "O Lord of Devas, how shall we worship you always, by means of the path of action or by means of the path of knowledge?
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Lord of Devas, how shall we worship you always, by means of the path of action or by means of the path of knowledge?

verses.sanskrit: अनाशकं तु यः कुर्यात् तस्मिंस्तीर्थे नराधिप । सर्वपापविशुद्धात्मा रुद्रलोकं स गच्छति
verses.transliteration: anāśakaṃ tu yaḥ kuryāt tasmiṃstīrthe narādhipa / sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā rudralokaṃ sa gacchati
verses.translation: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;
verses.hindi: स्त्रीवल्लभो भवेच्छीमान् कामदेव इवापरः स्नातमात्रो नरस्तत्र सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते
verses.wordMeaning: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;

verses.sanskrit: तत्र स्नात्वा नरो राजन्नश्वमेधफलं लभेत् । ये वसन्त्युत्तरे कूले रुद्रलोके वसन्ति ते
verses.transliteration: tatra snātvā naro rājannaśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet / ye vasantyuttare kūle rudraloke vasanti te
verses.translation: O great sages, I shall expound to you the excellent incomprehensible secret formerly narrated by Brahma to Mahadeva.
verses.hindi: सोमग्रहे तु राजेन्द्र पापक्षयकरं भवेत्। त्रैलोक्यविश्रुतं राजन् सोमतीर्थं महाफलम्
verses.wordMeaning: O great sages, I shall expound to you the excellent incomprehensible secret formerly narrated by Brahma to Mahadeva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sages, I shall expound to you the excellent incomprehensible secret formerly narrated by Brahma to Mahadeva.

verses.sanskrit: सरस्वत्यां च गङ्गायां नर्मदायां युधिष्ठिर । समं स्नानं च दानं च यथा मे शङ्करो ऽब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: sarasvatyāṃ ca gaṅgāyāṃ narmadāyāṃ yudhiṣṭhira / samaṃ snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca yathā me śaṅkaro 'bravīt
verses.translation: O great sages, I shall expound to you the excellent incomprehensible secret formerly narrated by Brahma to Mahadeva.
verses.hindi: इसके पश्चात् सभी पापोंको नष्ट करनेवाले कोटितीर्थमें जाना चाहिए। वहाँ स्नानकर मनुष्य राज्य प्राप्त कर लेता है, इसमें कोई संदेह नहीं तदुपरान्त चन्द्रभागामें स्नान करना चाहिए। वहाँ स्नानमात्रसे ही मनुष्य सोमलोकमें आदर प्राप्त करता है। राजन्! नर्मदाके दक्षिणी किनारेपर उत्तम संगमेश्वर (तीर्थ) है। वहाँ स्नान करके मनुष्य सभी यज्ञोंका
verses.wordMeaning: O great sages, I shall expound to you the excellent incomprehensible secret formerly narrated by Brahma to Mahadeva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sages, I shall expound to you the excellent incomprehensible secret formerly narrated by Brahma to Mahadeva.

verses.sanskrit: परित्यजति यः प्रणान् पर्वते ऽमरकण्टके । वर्षकोटिशतं साग्रं रुद्रलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: parityajati yaḥ praṇān parvate 'marakaṇṭake / varṣakoṭiśataṃ sāgraṃ rudraloke mahīyate
verses.translation: O great sages, I shall expound to you the excellent incomprehensible secret formerly narrated by Brahma to Mahadeva.
verses.hindi: फल प्राप्त कर लेता है। नर्मदाके उत्तरी किनारेपर अत्यन्त सुन्दर तीर्थ है। वहाँ आदित्यका रमणीय मन्दिर है। यह स्वयं ईश्वरने बताया है । राजेन्द्र! वहाँ स्नानकर यथाशक्ति दान देनेपर उस तीर्थके प्रभावसे अक्षय फल
verses.wordMeaning: O great sages, I shall expound to you the excellent incomprehensible secret formerly narrated by Brahma to Mahadeva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sages, I shall expound to you the excellent incomprehensible secret formerly narrated by Brahma to Mahadeva.

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदायां जलं पुण्यं फेनोर्मिसमलङ्कृतम् । पवित्रं शिरसा वन्द्य सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: narmadāyāṃ jalaṃ puṇyaṃ phenormisamalaṅkṛtam / pavitraṃ śirasā vandya sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
verses.translation: O great sages, I shall expound to you the excellent incomprehensible secret formerly narrated by Brahma to Mahadeva.
verses.hindi: प्राप्त होता है तथा जो लोग दरिद्र, व्याधियुक्त और दुष्कर्म करनेवाले हैँ, वे सभी पापोंसे मुक्त होकर सूर्यलोकको जाते हैं॥ ३४--३८ ॥ तदनन्तर मार्गेश्वर (तीर्थ) जाकर वहाँ स्नान करना चाहिए। वहाँ स्नानमात्र करनेसे मनुष्य स्वर्गलोक प्राप्त करता है। इसके पश्चात् पश्चिमकी ओर स्थित श्रेष्ठ मरुदालयमें (वायुके स्थानमें) जाना चाहिए। राजेन्द्र!
verses.wordMeaning: O great sages, I shall expound to you the excellent incomprehensible secret formerly narrated by Brahma to Mahadeva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sages, I shall expound to you the excellent incomprehensible secret formerly narrated by Brahma to Mahadeva.

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदा सर्वतः पुण्या ब्रह्महत्यापहारिणी । अहोरात्रोपवासेन मुच्यते ब्रह्महत्यया
verses.transliteration: narmadā sarvataḥ puṇyā brahmahatyāpahāriṇī / ahorātropavāsena mucyate brahmahatyayā
verses.translation: O great sages, I shall expound to you the excellent incomprehensible secret formerly narrated by Brahma to Mahadeva.
verses.hindi: वहाँ स्नान करके प्रयत्नपूर्वक पवित्र होकर अपनी सम्पत्तिके विस्तारके अनुसार द्विजको स्वर्ण प्रदान करना चाहिए। ऐसा करनेवाला मनुष्य पुष्पक-विमानके द्वारा वायुलोक जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: O great sages, I shall expound to you the excellent incomprehensible secret formerly narrated by Brahma to Mahadeva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sages, I shall expound to you the excellent incomprehensible secret formerly narrated by Brahma to Mahadeva.

verses.sanskrit: जालेश्वरं तीर्थवरं सर्वपापविनाशनम् । तत्र गत्वा नियमवान् सर्वकामांल्लभेन्नरः
verses.transliteration: jāleśvaraṃ tīrthavaraṃ sarvapāpavināśanam / tatra gatvā niyamavān sarvakāmāṃllabhennaraḥ
verses.translation: O great sages, I shall expound to you the excellent incomprehensible secret formerly narrated by Brahma to Mahadeva.
verses.hindi: राजेन्द्र! तदनन्तर श्रेष्ठ अहल्यातीर्थमें जाना चाहिए। वहाँ स्नानमात्रसे मनुष्य अक्षय (अनन्त) कालतक अप्सराओंके साथ आनन्द करता है। चैत्र शुक्ल पक्षको त्रयोदशी कामदेवका दिन है। उस दिन इस अहल्यातीर्थमें जो मनुष्य अहल्याकी पूजा करता है, वह जहाँ-कहीं भी उत्पन्न होता है, श्रेष्ठ तथा प्रिय होता है और विशेषरूपसे दूसरे कामदेवके समान हो जानेसे श्री- शोभासम्पन्न तथा स्त्रीवल्लभ होता है। इन्द्रके प्रसिद्ध
verses.wordMeaning: O great sages, I shall expound to you the excellent incomprehensible secret formerly narrated by Brahma to Mahadeva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sages, I shall expound to you the excellent incomprehensible secret formerly narrated by Brahma to Mahadeva.

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्रसूर्योपरागे तु गत्वा ह्यमरकण्टकम् । अश्वमेधाद् दशगुणं पुण्यमाप्नोति मानवः
verses.transliteration: candrasūryoparāge tu gatvā hyamarakaṇṭakam / aśvamedhād daśaguṇaṃ puṇyamāpnoti mānavaḥ
verses.translation: O great sages, I shall expound to you the excellent incomprehensible secret formerly narrated by Brahma to Mahadeva.
verses.hindi: तीर्थ अयोध्यामें आकर स्नानमात्र करनेवाला मनुष्य हजार गोदानका फल प्राप्त करता है॥ ४२--४५॥
verses.wordMeaning: O great sages, I shall expound to you the excellent incomprehensible secret formerly narrated by Brahma to Mahadeva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sages, I shall expound to you the excellent incomprehensible secret formerly narrated by Brahma to Mahadeva.

verses.sanskrit: एष पुण्यो गिरिवरो देवगन्धर्वसेवितः । नानाद्रुमलताकीर्णो नानापुष्पोपशोभितः
verses.transliteration: eṣa puṇyo girivaro devagandharvasevitaḥ / nānādrumalatākīrṇo nānāpuṣpopaśobhitaḥ
verses.translation: O great sages, I shall expound to you the excellent incomprehensible secret formerly narrated by Brahma to Mahadeva.
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर सोमतीर्थमें जाकर वहाँ स्नान करना चाहिए। वहाँ स्नानमात्र करनेसे मनुष्य सभी पापोंसे मुक्त हो जाता है। राजन्! तीनों लोकोंमें विख्यात सोमतीर्थं महान् फल देनेवाला है सर्वपापविशुद्धात्मा सोमलोकं स गच्छति
verses.wordMeaning: O great sages, I shall expound to you the excellent incomprehensible secret formerly narrated by Brahma to Mahadeva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sages, I shall expound to you the excellent incomprehensible secret formerly narrated by Brahma to Mahadeva.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र संनिहितो राजन् देव्या सह महेश्वरः । ब्रह्मा विष्णुस्तथा चेन्द्रो विद्याधरगणैः सह
verses.transliteration: tatra saṃnihito rājan devyā saha maheśvaraḥ / brahmā viṣṇustathā cendro vidyādharagaṇaiḥ saha
verses.translation: O great sages, I shall expound to you the excellent incomprehensible secret formerly narrated by Brahma to Mahadeva.
verses.hindi: स्नातमात्रो नरस्तत्र सोमलोके महीयते
verses.wordMeaning: O great sages, I shall expound to you the excellent incomprehensible secret formerly narrated by Brahma to Mahadeva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sages, I shall expound to you the excellent incomprehensible secret formerly narrated by Brahma to Mahadeva.

verses.sanskrit: प्रदक्षिणं तु यः कुर्यात् पर्वतं ह्यमरकण्टकम् । पौण्डरीकस्य यज्ञस्य फलं प्राप्नोति मानः
verses.transliteration: pradakṣiṇaṃ tu yaḥ kuryāt parvataṃ hyamarakaṇṭakam / pauṇḍarīkasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānaḥ
verses.translation: O great sages, I shall expound to you the excellent incomprehensible secret formerly narrated by Brahma to Mahadeva.
verses.hindi: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र विष्णुतीर्थमनुत्तमम्। असुरा योधितास्तत्र वासुदेवेन कोटिशः । तत्र तीर्थ समुत्पन्नं विष्णुश्रीको भवेदिह। अहोरात्रोपवासेन ब्रह्महत्यां व्यपोहति
verses.wordMeaning: O great sages, I shall expound to you the excellent incomprehensible secret formerly narrated by Brahma to Mahadeva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sages, I shall expound to you the excellent incomprehensible secret formerly narrated by Brahma to Mahadeva.

verses.sanskrit: कावेरी नाम विपुला नदी कल्पषनाशिनी । तत्र स्नात्वा महादेवमर्चयेद् वृषभध्वजम् । संगमे नर्मदायास्तु रुद्रलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: kāverī nāma vipulā nadī kalpaṣanāśinī / tatra snātvā mahādevamarcayed vṛṣabhadhvajam / saṃgame narmadāyāstu rudraloke mahīyate
verses.translation: O great sages, I shall expound to you the excellent incomprehensible secret formerly narrated by Brahma to Mahadeva.
verses.hindi: कामतीर्थमिति ख्यातं यत्र कामोऽर्चयद् भवम्
verses.wordMeaning: O great sages, I shall expound to you the excellent incomprehensible secret formerly narrated by Brahma to Mahadeva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sages, I shall expound to you the excellent incomprehensible secret formerly narrated by Brahma to Mahadeva.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे अष्टात्रिशो ऽध्यायः मार्कण्डेय उवाच नर्मदा सरितां श्रेष्ठा सर्वपापविनाशिनी । मुनिभिः कथिता पूर्वमीश्वरेण स्वयंभुवा
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge aṣṭātriśo 'dhyāyaḥ mārkaṇḍeya uvāca narmadā saritāṃ śreṣṭhā sarvapāpavināśinī / munibhiḥ kathitā pūrvamīśvareṇa svayaṃbhuvā
verses.translation: The means of salvation of men should be known.
verses.hindi: कुसुमायुधरूपेण रुद्रलोके महीयते ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र ब्रह्मतीर्थमनुत्तमम्। उमाहकमिति ख्यातं तत्र संतर्पयेत् पितृन्
verses.wordMeaning: The means of salvation of men should be known.
verses.commentary: Sense: The means of salvation of men should be known.

verses.sanskrit: मुनिभिः संस्तुता ह्येषा नर्मदा प्रवरा नदी । रुद्रगात्राद् विनिष्क्रान्ता लोकानां हितकाम्यया
verses.transliteration: munibhiḥ saṃstutā hyeṣā narmadā pravarā nadī / rudragātrād viniṣkrāntā lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā
verses.translation: The great Purusa is not seen by Yoga alone. But Jnana (knowledge) by itself is the bestower of salvation.
verses.hindi: तत्र स्नात्वा तु राजेन्द्र विष्णुलोके महीयते
verses.wordMeaning: The great Purusa is not seen by Yoga alone. But Jnana (knowledge) by itself is the bestower of salvation.
verses.commentary: Sense: The great Purusa is not seen by Yoga alone. But Jnana (knowledge) by itself is the bestower of salvation.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वपापहरा नित्यं सर्वदेवनमस्कृता । संस्तुता देवगन्धर्वैरप्यरोभिस्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: sarvapāpaharā nityaṃ sarvadevanamaskṛtā / saṃstutā devagandharvairapyarobhistathaiva ca
verses.translation: Eschewing the pure Saihkhya and depending solely on Yoga, ye all made your attempts for salvation.
verses.hindi: यत्र नारायणो देवो मुनीनां भावितात्मनाम् । स्वात्मानं दर्शयामास लिङ्गं तत् परमं पदम् राजेन्द्र! ! वहाँ चन्द्रग्रहण (-का स्नान) पापोंका क्षय करनेवाला होता हैं। उस तीर्थमें जो एकाग्र-मनसे चान्द्रायणव्रत करता है, वह सभी पापोंसे मुक्त हो बिशुद्ध आत्मावाला होकर सोमलोकको जाता है।
verses.wordMeaning: Eschewing the pure Saihkhya and depending solely on Yoga, ye all made your attempts for salvation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Eschewing the pure Saihkhya and depending solely on Yoga, ye all made your attempts for salvation.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तरे चैव तत्कूले तीर्थं त्रैलोक्यविश्रुतम् । नाम्ना भद्रेश्वरं पुण्यं सर्वपापहरं शुभम् । तत्र स्नात्वा नरो राजन् दैवतैः सह मोहते
verses.transliteration: uttare caiva tatkūle tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam / nāmnā bhadreśvaraṃ puṇyaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ śubham / tatra snātvā naro rājan daivataiḥ saha mohate
verses.translation: For this reason, O Brahmanas, I came here to this land to point out the delusion arising in those men who depend on Karman alone.
verses.hindi: नराधिप! जो सोमतीर्थमें अग्निप्रवेश, जलप्रवेश अथवा अनशन करता है, वह मनुष्य पुनः उत्पन्न नहीं होता। तदनन्तर स्तम्भतीर्थमें जाकर वहाँ स्नान करना चाहिए । वहाँ स्नानमात्र करनेसे मनुष्य सोमलोकमें प्रतिष्ठा प्राप्त
verses.wordMeaning: For this reason, O Brahmanas, I came here to this land to point out the delusion arising in those men who depend on Karman alone.
verses.commentary: Sense: For this reason, O Brahmanas, I came here to this land to point out the delusion arising in those men who depend on Karman alone.

verses.sanskrit: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र तीर्थमाम्रातकेश्वरम् । तत्र स्नात्वा नरो राजन् गोसहस्रफलं लभेत्
verses.transliteration: tato gaccheta rājendra tīrthamāmrātakeśvaram / tatra snātvā naro rājan gosahasraphalaṃ labhet
verses.translation: Hence, the perfect knowledge that is devoid of impurity and that is the means of salvation should be seen, heard and realised assiduously by you all.
verses.hindi: करता है अर्थात् पूजित होता है राजेन्द्र तदनन्तर परम उत्तम विष्णुतीर्थमें जाना चाहिए, वहाँ योधनीपुर नामक विष्णुका श्रेष्ठ स्थान है। वहाँ वासुदेवने करोड़ों असुरोंसे युद्ध किया था। अत: वह स्थान (वासुदेवकी पवित्र संनिधिके कारण) तीर्थ
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, the perfect knowledge that is devoid of impurity and that is the means of salvation should be seen, heard and realised assiduously by you all.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, the perfect knowledge that is devoid of impurity and that is the means of salvation should be seen, heard and realised assiduously by you all.

verses.sanskrit: ततो ऽङ्गारेश्वरं गच्छेन्नियतो नियताशनः । सर्वपापविशुद्धात्मा रुद्रलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: tato 'ṅgāreśvaraṃ gacchenniyato niyatāśanaḥ / sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā rudraloke mahīyate
verses.translation: The Atman is one and only one, omnipresent. It is of the nature of pure consciousness and bliss, free from impurity and eternal. This is indeed the Philosophy of the Saihkhyas.
verses.hindi: (पुण्यमय) हो गया है। जो मनुष्य उस तीर्थका सेवन करता है, वह विष्णुके समान श्रीसम्पन्न हो जाता है। वहाँ एक अहोरात्र उपवास करनेसे ब्रह्महत्या दूर हो जाती है। नर्मदाके दक्षिणी किनारेपर कामतीर्थ नामसे
verses.wordMeaning: The Atman is one and only one, omnipresent. It is of the nature of pure consciousness and bliss, free from impurity and eternal. This is indeed the Philosophy of the Saihkhyas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Atman is one and only one, omnipresent. It is of the nature of pure consciousness and bliss, free from impurity and eternal. This is indeed the Philosophy of the Saihkhyas.

verses.sanskrit: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र केदारं नाम पुण्यदम् । तत्र स्नात्वोदकं कृत्वा सर्वान् कामानवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: tato gaccheta rājendra kedāraṃ nāma puṇyadam / tatra snātvodakaṃ kṛtvā sarvān kāmānavāpnuyāt
verses.translation: This alone is the greatest knowledge. This is being sung about as Liberation. This is described as the pure Kaivalya and Brahmabhdva (the state of Brahman).
verses.hindi: प्रसिद्ध एक अत्यन्त सुन्दर तीर्थ है। वहाँपर कामदेवने शंकरको आराधना को थी। उस तीर्थमें स्नानकर उपवासपरायण रहनेवाला मनुष्य कामदेवके समान रूपवाला होकर रुद्रलोकमें प्रतिष्ठा प्रात करता है॥५१--५४॥ राजेन्द्र! तदनन्तर उत्तम ब्रह्मतीर्थमें जाना चाहिए। वह तीर्थ 'उमाहक' इस नामसे प्रसिद्ध है। वहाँ पितरोंका तर्पण करना चाहिए। पूर्णिमा तथा अमावास्याको विधिपूर्वक श्राद्ध करना चाहिए। वहाँ जलके भीतर
verses.wordMeaning: This alone is the greatest knowledge. This is being sung about as Liberation. This is described as the pure Kaivalya and Brahmabhdva (the state of Brahman).
verses.commentary: Sense: This alone is the greatest knowledge. This is being sung about as Liberation. This is described as the pure Kaivalya and Brahmabhdva (the state of Brahman).

verses.sanskrit: पिप्पलेशं ततो गच्छेत् सर्वपापविनाशनम् । तत्र स्नात्वा महाराज रुद्रलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: pippaleśaṃ tato gacchet sarvapāpavināśanam / tatra snātvā mahārāja rudraloke mahīyate
verses.translation: Resorting to this greatest stand-point, the great- souled ascetics strictly adhering to it and holding on to it, see me the Visva (the universe), the Isvara.
verses.hindi: हाथीके आकारकी शिला स्थित है। उस शिलापर विशेष रूपसे वैशाख पूर्णिमाको स्नानके अनन्तर दम्भ तथा मात्सर्यसे रहित होकर एकाग्रमनसे पिण्डदान करना चाहिए। इससे पिण्डदाताके पितर जबतक पृथ्वी रहती
verses.wordMeaning: Resorting to this greatest stand-point, the great- souled ascetics strictly adhering to it and holding on to it, see me the Visva (the universe), the Isvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Resorting to this greatest stand-point, the great- souled ascetics strictly adhering to it and holding on to it, see me the Visva (the universe), the Isvara.

verses.sanskrit: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र विमलेश्वरमुत्तमम् । तत्र प्राणान् परित्यज्य रुद्रलोकमवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: tato gaccheta rājendra vimaleśvaramuttamam / tatra prāṇān parityajya rudralokamavāpnuyāt
verses.translation: This is that greatest knowledge, the absolute Sat (Reality) that is unsullied. I alone am the lord to be realised. This Siva is my form.
verses.hindi: है, तबतक तृप्त रहते हैं॥ ५५--५७॥ इसके बाद सिद्धेश्वर (तीर्थमें) जाकर वहाँ स्नान करना चाहिए। वहाँ स्नानमात्र करनेसे मनुष्य गाणपत्य- पद प्राप्त करता है। राजेन्द्र! तदनन्तर जहाँ जनार्दन लिङ्गरूपमें प्रतिष्ठित हैं, वहाँ जाना चाहिए। राजेन्द्र !
verses.wordMeaning: This is that greatest knowledge, the absolute Sat (Reality) that is unsullied. I alone am the lord to be realised. This Siva is my form.
verses.commentary: Sense: This is that greatest knowledge, the absolute Sat (Reality) that is unsullied. I alone am the lord to be realised. This Siva is my form.

verses.sanskrit: ततः पुष्करिणीं गच्छेत् स्नानं तत्र समाचरेत् । स्नातमात्रो नरस्तत्र इन्द्रस्यार्धासनं लभेत्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ puṣkariṇīṃ gacchet snānaṃ tatra samācaret / snātamātro narastatra indrasyārdhāsanaṃ labhet
verses.translation: O leading Brahmanas, many means to Siddhi (realisation) have been mentioned; of them all, my perfect knowledge is the most superior.
verses.hindi: वहाँ स्नान करनेसे विष्णुलोकमें आदर प्राप्त होता है। यही एकमात्र वह स्थान है, जहाँ नारायणदेवने भक्तिपूर्ण मुनियोंको लिङ्गरूपमें अपना दर्शन कराया था। यह लिङ्ग विष्णुरूप होनेसे परमपद है ॥ ५८--६० ॥
verses.wordMeaning: O leading Brahmanas, many means to Siddhi (realisation) have been mentioned; of them all, my perfect knowledge is the most superior.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading Brahmanas, many means to Siddhi (realisation) have been mentioned; of them all, my perfect knowledge is the most superior.

verses.sanskrit: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र शूलभेदमिति श्रुतम् । तत्र स्नात्वार्चयेद् देवं गोसहस्रफलं लभेत्
verses.transliteration: tato gaccheta rājendra śūlabhedamiti śrutam / tatra snātvārcayed devaṃ gosahasraphalaṃ labhet
verses.translation: Indeed the holy Pasupata vow has been formerly designed by me for the achievement of liberation. It is the gteatest of all secrets. It is the subtlest essence of the Vedas.
verses.hindi: अङ्कोलं तु ततो गच्छेत् सर्वपापविनाशनम्। त्रैयम्बकेन तोयेन यश्चरुं श्रपयेत् तत: । अङ्कोलमूले दद्याच्च पिण्डांश्चैव यथाविधि। तारिताः पितरस्तेन तृप्यन्त्याचन्द्रतारकम्
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed the holy Pasupata vow has been formerly designed by me for the achievement of liberation. It is the gteatest of all secrets. It is the subtlest essence of the Vedas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed the holy Pasupata vow has been formerly designed by me for the achievement of liberation. It is the gteatest of all secrets. It is the subtlest essence of the Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र बलितीर्थमनुत्तम् । तत्र स्नात्वा नरो राजन् सिहासनपतिर्भवेत्
verses.transliteration: tato gaccheta rājendra balitīrthamanuttam / tatra snātvā naro rājan sihāsanapatirbhavet
verses.translation: One who performs Pasupata vow, shall be quiescent; he must have perfect self-control; he should dust his body with sacred ashes; he should observe celibacy and remain naked.
verses.hindi: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र तापसेश्वरमुत्तमम्। तत्र स्नात्वा तु राजेन्द्र प्राप्नुयात् तपसः फलम्
verses.wordMeaning: One who performs Pasupata vow, shall be quiescent; he must have perfect self-control; he should dust his body with sacred ashes; he should observe celibacy and remain naked.
verses.commentary: Sense: One who performs Pasupata vow, shall be quiescent; he must have perfect self-control; he should dust his body with sacred ashes; he should observe celibacy and remain naked.

verses.sanskrit: शक्रतीर्थं ततो गच्छेत् कूले चैव तु दक्षिणे । उपोष्य रजनीमेकां स्नानं कृत्वा यथाविधि
verses.transliteration: śakratīrthaṃ tato gacchet kūle caiva tu dakṣiṇe / upoṣya rajanīmekāṃ snānaṃ kṛtvā yathāvidhi
verses.translation: Or he should wear a loin-cloth or a single garment; he should be silent and engaged in the study of Vedas. The scholar shall meditate on Siva as Pasupati.
verses.hindi: शुक्लतीर्थं ततो गच्छेत् सर्वपापविनाशनम्। योजनं तत् स्मृतं क्षेत्रं देवगन्धर्वसेवितम्। शुक्लतीर्थमिति ख्यातं सर्वपापविनाशनम्
verses.wordMeaning: Or he should wear a loin-cloth or a single garment; he should be silent and engaged in the study of Vedas. The scholar shall meditate on Siva as Pasupati.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or he should wear a loin-cloth or a single garment; he should be silent and engaged in the study of Vedas. The scholar shall meditate on Siva as Pasupati.

verses.sanskrit: आराधयेन्महायोगं देवं नारायणं हरिम् । गोसहस्रफलं प्राप्य विष्णुलोकं स गच्छति
verses.transliteration: ārādhayenmahāyogaṃ devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ harim / gosahasraphalaṃ prāpya viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati
verses.translation: Sruti states that this Pasupata Yoga should be resort¬ ed to by the seekers of liberation; that those who maintain Pasupata rite should be free from desire.
verses.hindi: पादपाग्रेण दृष्टेन ब्रह्माहत्यां व्यपोहति। देव्या सह सदा भर्गस्तत्र तिष्ठाति शंकरः
verses.wordMeaning: Sruti states that this Pasupata Yoga should be resort¬ ed to by the seekers of liberation; that those who maintain Pasupata rite should be free from desire.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sruti states that this Pasupata Yoga should be resort¬ ed to by the seekers of liberation; that those who maintain Pasupata rite should be free from desire.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषितीर्थं ततो गत्वा सर्वपापहरं नृणाम् । स्नातमात्रो नरस्तत्र शिवलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: ṛṣitīrthaṃ tato gatvā sarvapāpaharaṃ nṛṇām / snātamātro narastatra śivaloke mahīyate
verses.translation: Freed from passion, fear and anger, filled with me, taking refuge in me, purified by penance in the fire of spiritual knowledge, many have entered my Being.
verses.hindi: देवदानवगन्धर्वाः सिद्धविद्याधरास्तथा। गणाश्चाप्सरसां नागास्तत्र तिष्ठन्ति पुंगव रजकेन यथा वस्त्रं शुक्लं भवति वारिणा। आजन्मनि कृतं पापं शुक्लतीर्थं व्यपोहति। स्नानं दानं तपः श्राद्धमनन्तं तत्र दृश्यते
verses.wordMeaning: Freed from passion, fear and anger, filled with me, taking refuge in me, purified by penance in the fire of spiritual knowledge, many have entered my Being.
verses.commentary: Sense: Freed from passion, fear and anger, filled with me, taking refuge in me, purified by penance in the fire of spiritual knowledge, many have entered my Being.

verses.sanskrit: नारदस्य तु तत्रैव तीर्थं परमशोभनम् । स्नातमात्रो नरस्तत्र गोसहस्रफलं लभेत्
verses.transliteration: nāradasya tu tatraiva tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam / snātamātro narastatra gosahasraphalaṃ labhet
verses.translation: There are other scriptures opposed to the Vedic view. They have been propounded by me alone and they are very fascinating in this world.
verses.hindi: पूर्वे वयसि कर्माणि कृत्वा पापानि मानवः। अहोरात्रोपवासेन शुक्लतीर्थ व्यपोहति
verses.wordMeaning: There are other scriptures opposed to the Vedic view. They have been propounded by me alone and they are very fascinating in this world.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are other scriptures opposed to the Vedic view. They have been propounded by me alone and they are very fascinating in this world.

verses.sanskrit: यत्र तप्तं तपः पूर्वं नारदेन सुरर्षिणा । प्रतीस्तस्य ददौ योगं देवदेवो महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: yatra taptaṃ tapaḥ pūrvaṃ nāradena surarṣiṇā / pratīstasya dadau yogaṃ devadevo maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Those cults are—Varna, Pasupata, the Soma cult, the Lakura (Lakula) and the Bhairava and such other cults which are opposed to Veda should not be resorted to.
verses.hindi: कार्तिकस्य तु मासस्य कृष्णपक्षे चतुर्दशी । घृतेन स्नापयेद् देवमुपोष्य परमेश्वरम्। एकबिंशत्कुलोपेतो न च्यवेहैश्वरात् पदात् तपसा ब्रह्मचर्येण यज्ञदानेन वा पुनः। न तां गतिमवाप्नोति शुक्लतीर्थे तु यां लभेत्
verses.wordMeaning: Those cults are—Varna, Pasupata, the Soma cult, the Lakura (Lakula) and the Bhairava and such other cults which are opposed to Veda should not be resorted to.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those cults are—Varna, Pasupata, the Soma cult, the Lakura (Lakula) and the Bhairava and such other cults which are opposed to Veda should not be resorted to.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मणा निर्मितं लिङ्गं ब्रह्मेश्वरमिति श्रुतम् । यत्र स्नात्वा नरो राजन् ब्रह्मलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: brahmaṇā nirmitaṃ liṅgaṃ brahmeśvaramiti śrutam / yatra snātvā naro rājan brahmaloke mahīyate
verses.translation: O Brahmanas, I am the embodiment of Vedas. My form cannot be understood by those who know the meanings of other scriptures. Except the eternal lord* no one knows it.
verses.hindi: क्र कूर्मपुराण ह
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas, I am the embodiment of Vedas. My form cannot be understood by those who know the meanings of other scriptures. Except the eternal lord* no one knows it.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas, I am the embodiment of Vedas. My form cannot be understood by those who know the meanings of other scriptures. Except the eternal lord* no one knows it.

verses.sanskrit: ऋणतीर्थं ततो गच्छेत् स ऋणान्मुच्यते ध्रुवम् । महेश्वरं ततो गच्छेत् पर्याप्तं जन्मनः फलम्
verses.transliteration: ṛṇatīrthaṃ tato gacchet sa ṛṇānmucyate dhruvam / maheśvaraṃ tato gacchet paryāptaṃ janmanaḥ phalam
verses.translation: Ye all establish this path; worship Mahesvara. There is no doubt in this that ere long the perfect knowledge will dawn.
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर सभी पापोंको नष्ट करनेवाले अंकोल तीर्थमें जाना चाहिए। वहाँ किया गया स्नान, दान, ब्राह्मण-भोजन तथा पिण्डदान परलोकमें अनन्त फल प्रदान करनेवाला होता है। जो त्रैयम्बक (त्र्यम्बक) के मूलमें यथाविधि पिण्डदान करता है, उसके द्वारा तारे गये पितर जबतक चन्द्रमा तथा तारे रहते हैं, तबतक तृप्त रहते हें । राजेन्द्र! तदनन्तर उत्तम तापसे श्वर (तीर्थमें) जाना चाहिए। राजेन्द्र! वहाँ स्नानमात्र करनेसे
verses.wordMeaning: Ye all establish this path; worship Mahesvara. There is no doubt in this that ere long the perfect knowledge will dawn.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ye all establish this path; worship Mahesvara. There is no doubt in this that ere long the perfect knowledge will dawn.

verses.sanskrit: भीमेश्वरं ततो गच्छेत् सर्वव्याधिविनाशनम् । स्नातमात्रो नरस्तत्र सर्वदुःखैः प्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: bhīmeśvaraṃ tato gacchet sarvavyādhivināśanam / snātamātro narastatra sarvaduḥkhaiḥ pramucyate
verses.translation: O excellent ones, may ye have extensive and deep devotion unto me; O excellent sages, I shall grant you my presence, the moment I am meditated upon.
verses.hindi: व्यक्ति तपस्याका फल प्राप्त करता है
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent ones, may ye have extensive and deep devotion unto me; O excellent sages, I shall grant you my presence, the moment I am meditated upon.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent ones, may ye have extensive and deep devotion unto me; O excellent sages, I shall grant you my presence, the moment I am meditated upon.

verses.sanskrit: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र पिङ्गलेश्वरमुत्तमम् । अहोरात्रोपवासेन त्रिरात्रफलमाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: tato gaccheta rājendra piṅgaleśvaramuttamam / ahorātropavāsena trirātraphalamāpnuyāt
verses.translation: Having said this, the lord vanished there itself along with Uma. The sages remained in Daruvana and continued the worship of Sankara.
verses.hindi: इसके पश्चात् सभी पापोंका नाश करनेवाले शुक्लतीर्थमें जाना चाहिए। युधिष्ठिर! नर्मदामें उसके समान कोई तीर्थ नहीं है। उस शुक्लतीर्थके दर्शन करने, स्पर्श करने तथा वहाँ स्नान, दान, तप, जप, होम और उपवास करनेसे महान् फल प्राप्त होता है। देवताओं तथा गन्धर्वोसे सेवित वह एक योजनका क्षेत्र शुक्लतीर्थं इस नामसे विख्यात है। वह समस्त पापोंको नष्ट करनेवाला है। (इस तीर्थमें स्थित) वृक्षके अग्रभागको भी देखनेसे
verses.wordMeaning: Having said this, the lord vanished there itself along with Uma. The sages remained in Daruvana and continued the worship of Sankara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Having said this, the lord vanished there itself along with Uma. The sages remained in Daruvana and continued the worship of Sankara.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिंमस्तीर्थे तु राजेन्द्र कपिलां यः प्रयच्छति । यावन्ति तस्या रोमाणि तत्प्रसूतिकुलेषु च । तावद् वर्षसहस्राणि रुद्रलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: tasmiṃmastīrthe tu rājendra kapilāṃ yaḥ prayacchati / yāvanti tasyā romāṇi tatprasūtikuleṣu ca / tāvad varṣasahasrāṇi rudraloke mahīyate
verses.translation: She resembled a crore suns. She was engulfed in a cluster of flames. With her pure brilliance, she filled the whole firmament.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्महत्या दूर हो जाती है, वहाँ देवी (पार्वती)-के साथ भर्ग (तेजोमय) शंकर सहैव निवास करते हैं। सुव्रत! वैशाख मासके कृष्णपक्षकी चतुर्दशीको वहाँ कैलाससे आकर हर (शंकर) स्थित होते हैं। श्रेष्ठ!
verses.wordMeaning: She resembled a crore suns. She was engulfed in a cluster of flames. With her pure brilliance, she filled the whole firmament.
verses.commentary: Sense: She resembled a crore suns. She was engulfed in a cluster of flames. With her pure brilliance, she filled the whole firmament.

verses.sanskrit: यस्तु प्राणपरित्यागं कुर्यात् तत्र नराधिप । अक्षयं मोदते कालं यावच्चन्द्रदिवाकरौ
verses.transliteration: yastu prāṇaparityāgaṃ kuryāt tatra narādhipa / akṣayaṃ modate kālaṃ yāvaccandradivākarau
verses.translation: They sought and saw the incomprehensible daughter of the mountain, encircled in the halo of a thousand flames. They bowed to this lady, the wife of the lord of all. They knew her as the seed of the Supreme.
verses.hindi: वहाँ देवता, दानव, गन्धर्व, सिद्ध, विद्याधर, अप्सराओंके समूह तथा नाग रहते हैं ॥ ६४--६९॥ जिस प्रकार रजक (धोबी)-के द्वारा जलसे (धोनेसे) सस्त्र स्वच्छ (मलरहित) हो जाता है, उसी प्रकार शुक्लतीर्थमें स्नानसे जन्मभरका किया हुआ पाप दूर हो जाता है, वहाँ किया गया स्नान, दान, तप तथा
verses.wordMeaning: They sought and saw the incomprehensible daughter of the mountain, encircled in the halo of a thousand flames. They bowed to this lady, the wife of the lord of all. They knew her as the seed of the Supreme.
verses.commentary: Sense: They sought and saw the incomprehensible daughter of the mountain, encircled in the halo of a thousand flames. They bowed to this lady, the wife of the lord of all. They knew her as the seed of the Supreme.

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदातटमाश्रित्य तिष्ठन्ते ये तु मानवाः । ते मृताः स्वर्गमायान्ति सन्तः सुकृतिनो यथा
verses.transliteration: narmadātaṭamāśritya tiṣṭhante ye tu mānavāḥ / te mṛtāḥ svargamāyānti santaḥ sukṛtino yathā
verses.translation: "This is the spouse of our Supreme Lord. She is our abode (goal) and soul. Her (other) name is Firmament; see¬ ing in her their own selves and the entire universe, the sages were overjoyed.
verses.hindi: श्राद्ध अनन्त 'फलदायक हो जाता है। शुक्लतीर्थ-सा परम तीर्थ न कोई हुआ न होगा। मनुष्य पूरी अवस्थाभरमें किये गये पापोंको शुक्लतीर्थमें एक अहोरात्रके उपवाससे दूर कर देता है। कार्तिक मासमें
verses.wordMeaning: "This is the spouse of our Supreme Lord. She is our abode (goal) and soul. Her (other) name is Firmament; see¬ ing in her their own selves and the entire universe, the sages were overjoyed.
verses.commentary: Sense: "This is the spouse of our Supreme Lord. She is our abode (goal) and soul. Her (other) name is Firmament; see¬ ing in her their own selves and the entire universe, the sages were overjoyed.

verses.sanskrit: ततो दीप्तेश्वरं गच्छेद् व्यासतीर्थं तपोवनम् । निवर्तिता पुरा तत्र व्यासभीता महानदी । हुङ्कारिता तु व्यासेन दक्षिणेन ततो गता
verses.transliteration: tato dīpteśvaraṃ gacched vyāsatīrthaṃ tapovanam / nivartitā purā tatra vyāsabhītā mahānadī / huṅkāritā tu vyāsena dakṣiṇena tato gatā
verses.translation: They were seen by the wife of the great lords. In the meanwhile, they saw the lord, the cause of everything, Sambhu, the wise sage Rudra, the lord, the ancient Purusa.
verses.hindi: कृष्णपक्षकी चतुर्दशीको उपवासकर परमेश्वर देवको घृतसे स्नान कराना चाहिए। इससे मनुष्य अपनी इक्कीस पीढ़ियोंके साथ ईश्वरके लोकमें निवास करता है। कभी भी वहाँसे च्युत नहीं होता। शुक्लतीर्थमें जो गति प्राप्त होती है, वह तपस्या, ब्रह्मचर्य, यज्ञ अथवा दानसे प्राप्त नहीं होती ॥ ७०--७३॥
verses.wordMeaning: They were seen by the wife of the great lords. In the meanwhile, they saw the lord, the cause of everything, Sambhu, the wise sage Rudra, the lord, the ancient Purusa.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were seen by the wife of the great lords. In the meanwhile, they saw the lord, the cause of everything, Sambhu, the wise sage Rudra, the lord, the ancient Purusa.

verses.sanskrit: प्रदक्षिणं तु यः कुर्यात् तस्मिंस्तीर्थे युधिष्ठिर । प्रीतस्तस्य भवेद् व्यासो वाञ्छितं लभते फलम्
verses.transliteration: pradakṣiṇaṃ tu yaḥ kuryāt tasmiṃstīrthe yudhiṣṭhira / prītastasya bhaved vyāso vāñchitaṃ labhate phalam
verses.translation: On observing the goddess and the lord Isa they bowed down and attained the greatest bliss. Thanks to the favour of the lord, the perfect knowledge, the cause of the destruction of subsequent births, dawned in them.
verses.hindi: दानं दद्याद् यथाशक्ति प्रीयेतां हरिशंकरौ। एतत् तीर्थप्रभावेण सर्व भवति चाक्षयम्
verses.wordMeaning: On observing the goddess and the lord Isa they bowed down and attained the greatest bliss. Thanks to the favour of the lord, the perfect knowledge, the cause of the destruction of subsequent births, dawned in them.
verses.commentary: Sense: On observing the goddess and the lord Isa they bowed down and attained the greatest bliss. Thanks to the favour of the lord, the perfect knowledge, the cause of the destruction of subsequent births, dawned in them.

verses.sanskrit: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र इक्षुनद्यास्तु संगमम् । त्रैलोक्यविश्रुतं पुण्यं तत्र सन्निहितः शिवः । तत्र स्तनात्वा नरो राजन् गाणपत्यमवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: tato gaccheta rājendra ikṣunadyāstu saṃgamam / trailokyaviśrutaṃ puṇyaṃ tatra sannihitaḥ śivaḥ / tatra stanātvā naro rājan gāṇapatyamavāpnuyāt
verses.translation: This potency of Lord Siva is the only source of the
verses.hindi: तावद् वर्षसहस्त्राणि रुद्रलोके महीयते कृष्णपक्षे चतुर्दश्यां माघमासे युधिष्ठिर । स्नानं कृत्वा नक्तभोजी न पश्येद् योनिसड्करम्
verses.wordMeaning: This potency of Lord Siva is the only source of the
verses.commentary: Sense: This potency of Lord Siva is the only source of the

verses.sanskrit: स्कन्दतीर्थं ततो गच्छेत् सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् । आजन्मनः कृतं पापं स्नातस्तीव्रं व्यपोहति
verses.transliteration: skandatīrthaṃ tato gacchet sarvapāpapraṇāśanam / ājanmanaḥ kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ snātastīvraṃ vyapohati
verses.translation: The great Paramesthin, Mahesvara who is beyond everything, the sole Siva, Rudra, the lord of Devas created the universe in her after mounting over the Maya that is existing in the great Sakti. (?)
verses.hindi: ब्राह्मणं भोजयेदेकं कोटिर्भवति भोजिताः
verses.wordMeaning: The great Paramesthin, Mahesvara who is beyond everything, the sole Siva, Rudra, the lord of Devas created the universe in her after mounting over the Maya that is existing in the great Sakti. (?)
verses.commentary: Sense: The great Paramesthin, Mahesvara who is beyond everything, the sole Siva, Rudra, the lord of Devas created the universe in her after mounting over the Maya that is existing in the great Sakti. (?)

verses.sanskrit: तत्र देवाः सगन्धर्वा भवात्मजमनुत्तमम् । उपासते महात्मानं स्कन्दं शक्तिधिरं प्रभुम्
verses.transliteration: tatra devāḥ sagandharvā bhavātmajamanuttamam / upāsate mahātmānaṃ skandaṃ śaktidhiraṃ prabhum
verses.translation: The Lord is one. He is hidden in all living beings. Rudra, the wielder of Maya, is entire and undivided. He and the goddess are not different or separate. On realising this, people attain immortality.
verses.hindi: मृत्तिकां शिरसि स्थाप्य अवगाह च तजलम्। नर्मदोदकसम्मिश्रं मुच्यते सर्वकिल्बिषैः ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र तीर्थ कार्णाटिकेश्वरम्। गङ्कावतरते तत्र दिने पुण्ये न संशयः
verses.wordMeaning: The Lord is one. He is hidden in all living beings. Rudra, the wielder of Maya, is entire and undivided. He and the goddess are not different or separate. On realising this, people attain immortality.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Lord is one. He is hidden in all living beings. Rudra, the wielder of Maya, is entire and undivided. He and the goddess are not different or separate. On realising this, people attain immortality.

verses.sanskrit: ततो गच्छेदाङ्गिरसं स्नानं तत्र समाचरेत् । गोसहस्रफलं प्राप्य रुद्रलोकं स गच्छति
verses.transliteration: tato gacchedāṅgirasaṃ snānaṃ tatra samācaret / gosahasraphalaṃ prāpya rudralokaṃ sa gacchati
verses.translation: Lord Mahesa then vanished. The over-lord of the Devas vanished alongwith the goddess. The dwellers of the forest propitiated again Rudra, the primordial lord.
verses.hindi: सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो ब्रह्मलोके महीयते
verses.wordMeaning: Lord Mahesa then vanished. The over-lord of the Devas vanished alongwith the goddess. The dwellers of the forest propitiated again Rudra, the primordial lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Mahesa then vanished. The over-lord of the Devas vanished alongwith the goddess. The dwellers of the forest propitiated again Rudra, the primordial lord.

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गिरा यत्र देवेशं ब्रह्मपुत्रो वृषध्वजम् । तपसाराध्य विश्वेशं लब्धवान् योगमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: aṅgirā yatra deveśaṃ brahmaputro vṛṣadhvajam / tapasārādhya viśveśaṃ labdhavān yogamuttamam
verses.translation: Thus the story of all the former exploits of the lord
verses.hindi: प्रीयते तस्य नन्दीशः सोमलोके महीयते रूपवान् जायते लोके धनभोगसमन्वितः
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the story of all the former exploits of the lord
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the story of all the former exploits of the lord

verses.sanskrit: कुशतीर्थं ततो गच्छेत् सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् । स्नानं तत्र प्रकुर्वोत अश्वमेधफलं लभेत्
verses.transliteration: kuśatīrthaṃ tato gacchet sarvapāpapraṇāśanam / snānaṃ tatra prakurvota aśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet
verses.translation: He who reads or listens to this everyday, is liberated from all sins. He who recounts this to quiescent Brahmanas, attains the greatest goal.
verses.hindi: ऋषियों तथा सिद्धोंसे सेवित शुक्लतीर्थ महान् तीर्थ है। राजन्! वहाँ स्नान करके मनुष्य पुनर्जन्म नहीं प्रात करता। वहाँ अयन, चतुर्दशी, संक्रान्ति तथा विषुव (योग)- में स्नानोपरान्त उपवास करते हुए विजितात्मा पुरुषको
verses.wordMeaning: He who reads or listens to this everyday, is liberated from all sins. He who recounts this to quiescent Brahmanas, attains the greatest goal.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who reads or listens to this everyday, is liberated from all sins. He who recounts this to quiescent Brahmanas, attains the greatest goal.

verses.sanskrit: कोटितीर्थं ततो गच्छेत् सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् । तत्र स्त्रात्वा नरो राज्यं लभते नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: koṭitīrthaṃ tato gacchet sarvapāpapraṇāśanam / tatra strātvā naro rājyaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.hindi: समाहित होकर यथाशक्ति दान देना चाहिए। इससे विष्णु तथा शिव प्रसन्न होते हैं। इस तीर्थके प्रभावसे सब कुछ अक्षय होता है। अनाथ, दुर्गतिको प्राप्त अथवा सनाथ ब्राह्मणका भी इस तीर्थमें विवाह करानेसे जो पुण्य-फल प्रात होता है, उसे सुनो-उसके (विवाह सम्पन्न करानेवालेके) शरीरमें तथा उसके कुलकी संतानोंके शरीरमें जितने रोम होते हैं, उतने हजार वर्षोतक वह रुद्रलोकमें प्रतिष्ठा प्राप्त करता है॥ ७४--७८॥

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्रभागां ततो गच्छेत् स्नानं तत्र समाचरेत् । स्नातमात्रो नरस्तत्र सोमलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: candrabhāgāṃ tato gacchet snānaṃ tatra samācaret / snātamātro narastatra somaloke mahīyate
verses.hindi: राजेन्द्र! तदनन्तर परम उत्तम यमतीर्थमें जाना चाहिए। युधिष्ठिर! माघमासके कृष्णपक्षकी चतुर्दशीको इस यमतीर्थमें स्नान करके रात्रिमें भोजन करनेवालेको गर्भके संकटका सामना नहीं करना पड़ता। राजेन्द्र!
verses.commentary: Sense: Mt. - 54b-55a.

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदादक्षिणे कूले संगमेश्वरमुत्तमम् । तत्र स्नात्वा नरो राजन् सर्वयज्ञफलं लभेत्
verses.transliteration: narmadādakṣiṇe kūle saṃgameśvaramuttamam / tatra snātvā naro rājan sarvayajñaphalaṃ labhet
verses.hindi: तदुपरान्त श्रेष्ठ एरण्डी-तीर्थमें जाना चाहिए। व्यक्ति वहाँ संगममें स्नानकर उपवासपरायण रहते हुए एक ब्राह्मणको भोजन कराये, इससे करोड़ों (ब्राह्मणों)-को भोजन करानेका फल मिलता है  एरण्डी-संगममें स्नान करके भक्तिभावसे परिपूर्ण होकर मस्तकमें वहाँकी मिट्टी लगानेसे तथा नर्मदाके जलसे मिश्रित उस (एरण्डी- संगम)-के जलमें स्नान करनेसे मनुष्य सभी पापोंसे मुक्त हो जाता है
verses.commentary: Sense: Mt. 55b-56a.

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदायोत्तरे कूले तीर्थं परमशोभनम् । आदित्यायतनं रम्यमीश्वरेण तु भाषितम्
verses.transliteration: narmadāyottare kūle tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam / ādityāyatanaṃ ramyamīśvareṇa tu bhāṣitam
verses.hindi: राजेन्द्र! इसके पश्चात् कार्णाटिकेश्वर-तीर्थमें जाना चाहिए। वहाँ पुण्य (पर्व)-दिनमें निश्चित रूपसे गङ्गा अवतरित होती हैं। वहाँ स्नानकर, (जल) पीकर और विधिपूर्वक दान देनेसे व्यक्ति सभी पापोंसे मुक्त होकर

verses.sanskrit: तत्र स्नात्वा तु राजेन्द्र दत्त्वा दानं तु शक्तितः । तस्य तीर्थप्रभावेण लभते चाक्षयं फलम्
verses.transliteration: tatra snātvā tu rājendra dattvā dānaṃ tu śaktitaḥ / tasya tīrthaprabhāveṇa labhate cākṣayaṃ phalam
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मलोकमें प्रतिष्ठा प्राप्त करता है। तदनन्तर नन्दितीर्थमें जाकर स्नान करना चाहिए। ऐसा करनेसे उसपर नन्दीश्वर प्रसन्न होते हैं और वह सोमलोकमें आदर प्रात करता है राजेन्द्र! तदुपरान्त शुभ अनरक नामक तीर्थ॑में जाना चाहिए। राजन्! वहाँ स्नान करके मनुष्य नरकका दर्शन नहीं करता। राजेन्द्र! उस तीर्थमें अपनी अस्थियोके विसर्जनकी प्रेरणा अपने परिजर्नोको देनी चाहिए। (वहाँ
verses.commentary: Sense: Mt. 63b-64a.

verses.sanskrit: दरिद्रा व्याधिता ये तु ये च दुष्कृतकारिणः । मुच्यन्ते सर्वपापेभ्यः सूर्यलोकं प्रयान्ति च
verses.transliteration: daridrā vyādhitā ye tu ye ca duṣkṛtakāriṇaḥ / mucyante sarvapāpebhyaḥ sūryalokaṃ prayānti ca
verses.hindi: जिसकी अस्थि विसर्जित होती है) वह जन्मान्तरमें दिव्य रूप एवं विविध ऐश्वर्यसे सम्पन्न होता है
verses.commentary: Sense: Mt. 64b-65a.

verses.sanskrit: मार्गेश्वरं ततो गच्छेत् स्नानं तत्र समाचरेत् । स्नातमात्रो नरस्तत्र स्वर्गलोकमवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: mārgeśvaraṃ tato gacchet snānaṃ tatra samācaret / snātamātro narastatra svargalokamavāpnuyāt
verses.hindi: ज्येष्ठमासे तु सम्प्राप्ते चतुर्दश्यां विशेषतः । तत्रोपोष्य नरो भक्त्या दद्याद् दीपं घृतेन तु सर्वाभरणसंयुक्तः सर्वदेवनमस्कृतः । शिवतुल्यबलो भूत्वा शिववत् क्रोडते चिरम्
verses.commentary: Sense: Mt. -65b-66a.

verses.sanskrit: ततः पश्चिमतो गच्छेन्मरुदालयमुत्तमम् । तत्र स्नात्वा तु राजेन्द्र शुचिर्भूत्वा प्रयत्नतः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ paścimato gacchenmarudālayamuttamam / tatra snātvā tu rājendra śucirbhūtvā prayatnataḥ
verses.translation: The holy water of Sarasvati sanctifies one in three days; the water of Yamuna sanctifies one in seven days; the water of Ganga sanctifies immediately; but the water of Narmada sanctifies one at its very sight.®
verses.hindi: स्नापयित्वा शिवं दद्याद् ब्राह्मणेभ्यस्तु भोजनम्
verses.wordMeaning: The holy water of Sarasvati sanctifies one in three days; the water of Yamuna sanctifies one in seven days; the water of Ganga sanctifies immediately; but the water of Narmada sanctifies one at its very sight.®
verses.commentary: Sense: The holy water of Sarasvati sanctifies one in three days; the water of Yamuna sanctifies one in seven days; the water of Ganga sanctifies immediately; but the water of Narmada sanctifies one at its very sight.®

verses.sanskrit: काञ्चनं तु द्विजो दद्याद् यथाविभवविस्तरम् । पुष्पकेण विमानेन वायुलोकं स गच्छति
verses.transliteration: kāñcanaṃ tu dvijo dadyād yathāvibhavavistaram / puṣpakeṇa vimānena vāyulokaṃ sa gacchati
verses.translation: In the western half of Kalinga, on the mountain Amarakantaka (it has its source). It is very holy. It is the most beautiful and charming in the three worlds.*
verses.hindi: सर्वभोगसमायुक्तो विमाने: सार्वकामिकैः । गत्वा शक्रस्य भवनं शक्रेण सह मोदते स्नातमात्रो नरस्तत्र रुद्रलोके महीयते। पितृणां तर्पणं कृत्वा मुच्यतेऽसावृणत्रयात्
verses.wordMeaning: In the western half of Kalinga, on the mountain Amarakantaka (it has its source). It is very holy. It is the most beautiful and charming in the three worlds.*
verses.commentary: Sense: In the western half of Kalinga, on the mountain Amarakantaka (it has its source). It is very holy. It is the most beautiful and charming in the three worlds.*

verses.sanskrit: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र अहल्यातीर्थमुत्तमम् । स्नानमात्रादप्सरोभिर्मोदते कालमक्षयम्
verses.transliteration: tato gaccheta rājendra ahalyātīrthamuttamam / snānamātrādapsarobhirmodate kālamakṣayam
verses.translation: O leading king, Devas, Asuras, Gandharvas, saints and the ascetics have attained the highest Siddki by performing penance on her banks.
verses.hindi: गङ्केश्वरसमीपे तु गङ्गावदनमुत्तमम्। अकामो वा सकामो वा तत्र स्नात्वा तु मानव: । आजन्मजनितैः पापैर्मुच्यते नात्र संशयः
verses.wordMeaning: O leading king, Devas, Asuras, Gandharvas, saints and the ascetics have attained the highest Siddki by performing penance on her banks.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading king, Devas, Asuras, Gandharvas, saints and the ascetics have attained the highest Siddki by performing penance on her banks.

verses.sanskrit: चैत्रमासे तु संप्राप्ते शुक्लपक्षे त्रयोदशी । कामदेवदिने तस्मिन्नहल्यां यस्तु पूजयेत्
verses.transliteration: caitramāse tu saṃprāpte śuklapakṣe trayodaśī / kāmadevadine tasminnahalyāṃ yastu pūjayet
verses.translation: O king, a person who takes his bath there, maintains all religious observances and has conquered the sense-organs shall redeem a hundred members of his family after observing fast for a night.
verses.hindi: दशाश्वमेधिकं तीर्थ त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतम् उपोष्य रजनीमेकां मासि भाद्रपदे शुभे।
verses.wordMeaning: O king, a person who takes his bath there, maintains all religious observances and has conquered the sense-organs shall redeem a hundred members of his family after observing fast for a night.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, a person who takes his bath there, maintains all religious observances and has conquered the sense-organs shall redeem a hundred members of his family after observing fast for a night.

verses.sanskrit: यत्र तत्र नरोत्पन्नो वरस्तत्र प्रियो भवेत् । स्त्रीवल्लभो भवेच्छ्रीमान् कामदेव इवापरः
verses.transliteration: yatra tatra narotpanno varastatra priyo bhavet / strīvallabho bhavecchrīmān kāmadeva ivāparaḥ
verses.translation: O leading king, it is heard that the excellent river is more than hundred Yojanas in length and its width is two Yojanas (1 Yojana=12 kms).®
verses.hindi: राजेन्द्र तदनन्तर उत्तम कपिलातीर्थमें जाना चाहिए। राजन्! वहाँ स्नानकर व्यक्ति हजार गोदानका फल प्राप्त करता है। ज्येष्ठ मासके आनेपर विशेषरूपसे चतुर्दशी तिथिको वहाँ उपवास कर मनुष्यको भक्तिपूर्वक घृतका
verses.wordMeaning: O leading king, it is heard that the excellent river is more than hundred Yojanas in length and its width is two Yojanas (1 Yojana=12 kms).®
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading king, it is heard that the excellent river is more than hundred Yojanas in length and its width is two Yojanas (1 Yojana=12 kms).®

verses.sanskrit: अयोध्यां तु समासाद्य तीर्थं शक्रस्य विश्रुतम् । स्नातमात्रो नरस्तत्र गोसहस्रफलं लभेत्
verses.transliteration: ayodhyāṃ tu samāsādya tīrthaṃ śakrasya viśrutam / snātamātro narastatra gosahasraphalaṃ labhet
verses.translation: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.hindi: दीप-दान करना चाहिए। घृतसे ही रुद्रका अभिषेक करना चाहिए, घृतयुक्त श्रीफलका हवन करना चाहिए और घंटा तथा आभरणोंसे सम्पन्न कपिला गौका दान करना चाहिए। इससे मनुष्य सभी अलंकारोंसे युक्त, सभी देवताओंके लिये वन्दनीय और शिवके समान तुल्य बलवाला होकर चिरकालतक शिवके समान क्रीडा करता है॥८७--९०॥
verses.wordMeaning: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®
verses.commentary: Sense: Sixty thousand holy centres and sixty crores of them are situated in Amarakantaka all round the mountain.®

verses.sanskrit: सोमतीर्थं ततो गच्छेत् स्नानं तत्र समाचरेत् । स्नातमात्रो नरस्तत्र सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: somatīrthaṃ tato gacchet snānaṃ tatra samācaret / snātamātro narastatra sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
verses.translation: In the Krta Age, God Siva the delighted Supreme Lord arrived at the forest of Devadaru trees on the auspicious peak of the Himalayas.
verses.hindi: विशेषरूपसे मंगलके दिन चतुर्थी पड्नेपर (इस कपिलातीर्थमे) शिवका अभिषेककर ब्राह्मणोंको भोजन कराना चाहिए। ऐसा करनेवाला मनुष्य सभी भोगोंसे समन्वित होकर अपनी इच्छाके अनुसार सर्वत्र अप्रतिहतगति
verses.wordMeaning: In the Krta Age, God Siva the delighted Supreme Lord arrived at the forest of Devadaru trees on the auspicious peak of the Himalayas.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the Krta Age, God Siva the delighted Supreme Lord arrived at the forest of Devadaru trees on the auspicious peak of the Himalayas.

verses.sanskrit: सोमग्रहे तु राजेन्द्र पापक्षयकरं भवेत् । त्रैलोक्यविश्रुतं राजन् सोमतीर्थं महाफलम्
verses.transliteration: somagrahe tu rājendra pāpakṣayakaraṃ bhavet / trailokyaviśrutaṃ rājan somatīrthaṃ mahāphalam
verses.translation: He was naked and bore hideous marks. He had smeared ashes {Bhasma) all over his body. He held firebrands in. his hands. His eyes v.'ere red and tawny-coloured.
verses.hindi: एवं सभी प्रकारकी सुविधाओंसे परिपूर्ण विमानोंके द्वारा इन्द्रके भवनमें जाकर इन्द्रके साथ आनन्दित होता है। स्वर्गसे च्युत होनेपर इस लोकमें भी धनवान् और प्रयलपूर्वक अभिषेक करनेसे व्यक्ति रूपवान् तथा सौभाग्यशाली होता है॥ ९१--९३॥
verses.wordMeaning: He was naked and bore hideous marks. He had smeared ashes {Bhasma) all over his body. He held firebrands in. his hands. His eyes v.'ere red and tawny-coloured.
verses.commentary: Sense: He was naked and bore hideous marks. He had smeared ashes {Bhasma) all over his body. He held firebrands in. his hands. His eyes v.'ere red and tawny-coloured.

verses.sanskrit: यस्तु चान्द्रायणं कुर्यात् तत्र तीर्थे समाहितः । सर्वपापविशुद्धात्मा सोमलोकं स गच्छति
verses.transliteration: yastu cāndrāyaṇaṃ kuryāt tatra tīrthe samāhitaḥ / sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā somalokaṃ sa gacchati
verses.translation: O son of Pandu, he rejoices in heaven for a hundred thousand years. He will be surrounded by divine damsels, the groups of Apsaras.
verses.hindi: राजेन्द्र! तदनन्तर उत्तम गणेश्वर (तीर्थ)-में जाना चाहिए। श्रावण मास आनेपर कृष्णपक्षकी चतुर्दशीको वहाँ स्नानमात्र करनेसे मनुष्य रुद्रलोकमें प्रतिष्ठित होता है और पितरोंका तर्पण करनेसे तीनों ऋणोंसे मुक्त हो
verses.wordMeaning: O son of Pandu, he rejoices in heaven for a hundred thousand years. He will be surrounded by divine damsels, the groups of Apsaras.
verses.commentary: Sense: O son of Pandu, he rejoices in heaven for a hundred thousand years. He will be surrounded by divine damsels, the groups of Apsaras.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निप्रवेशं यः कुर्यात् सोमतीर्थे नराधिप । जले चानशनं वापि नासौ मर्त्यो ऽभिजायते
verses.transliteration: agnipraveśaṃ yaḥ kuryāt somatīrthe narādhipa / jale cānaśanaṃ vāpi nāsau martyo 'bhijāyate
verses.translation: He will smear himself with divine scent and unguents. He will shine with divine flowers. He sports in the divine world and he rejoices alongwith Devas.
verses.hindi: गणेश्वर (तीर्थ)-के समीप श्रेष्ठ गङ्गावदन नामक तीर्थ है। वहाँ मनुष्य कामनापूर्वक अथवा निष्कामभावसे स्नान करके जन्मभरके किये गये पापोंसे मुक्त हो जाता है, इसमें संशय नहीं है उस (गङ्गावदन)-के पश्चिमी भागमें बहुत दूर नहीं अपितु समीपमें ही तीनों लोकोंमें विख्यात दशाश्वमेधिक नामक तीर्थ है। वहाँ शुभ भाद्रपद मासकी अमावास्याको एक रात्रिका उपवासकर स्नानपूर्वक वुषभध्वजका
verses.wordMeaning: He will smear himself with divine scent and unguents. He will shine with divine flowers. He sports in the divine world and he rejoices alongwith Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: He will smear himself with divine scent and unguents. He will shine with divine flowers. He sports in the divine world and he rejoices alongwith Devas.

verses.sanskrit: स्तम्भतीर्थं ततो गच्छेत् स्नानं तत्र समाचरेत् । स्नातमात्रो नरस्तत्र सोमलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: stambhatīrthaṃ tato gacchet snānaṃ tatra samācaret / snātamātro narastatra somaloke mahīyate
verses.translation: After falling off from heaven, he shall be born as a righteous king. He will obtain a house embellished in different kinds of gems and jewels.
verses.hindi: काञ्चनेन विमानेन किङ्किणीजालमालिना । ऐसा करनेसे किंकिणीके समूहसे अलंकृत सोनेके गत्वा रुद्रपुरं रम्यं रुद्रेण सह मोदते॥ ९९ ॥  विमानसे रमणीय रुद्रपुरमें पहुँचने तथा वहाँ रुद्रके साथ आनन्दानुभव करनेका सुअवसर प्राप्त होता है। उस (दशाश्वमेधिक) तीर्थमें सर्वत्र सभी दिनोंमें स्नान करना
verses.wordMeaning: After falling off from heaven, he shall be born as a righteous king. He will obtain a house embellished in different kinds of gems and jewels.
verses.commentary: Sense: After falling off from heaven, he shall be born as a righteous king. He will obtain a house embellished in different kinds of gems and jewels.

verses.sanskrit: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र विष्णुतीर्थमनुत्तमम् । योधनीपुरमाख्यातं विष्णोः स्थानमनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: tato gaccheta rājendra viṣṇutīrthamanuttamam / yodhanīpuramākhyātaṃ viṣṇoḥ sthānamanuttamam
verses.translation: The house shall be shining on being bedecked in diamonds and Lapis Lazuli. The columns therein shall be made of jewels. It shall be endowed with paintings, vehicles of brilliant appearance as well as hundred of maid-servants.
verses.hindi: सर्वत्र सर्वदिवसे स्नानं तत्र समाचरेत् । चाहिए और पितरोंका तर्पण करना चाहिए, इससे पितृणां तर्पणं कुर्यादश्चमेधफलं लभेत्॥ १००॥  अश्वमेधका फल प्राप्त होता है इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे वद्साहस्रघां साहितायामुपरिविभागे एकोनचत्वारिशोऽध्यायः
verses.wordMeaning: The house shall be shining on being bedecked in diamonds and Lapis Lazuli. The columns therein shall be made of jewels. It shall be endowed with paintings, vehicles of brilliant appearance as well as hundred of maid-servants.
verses.commentary: Sense: The house shall be shining on being bedecked in diamonds and Lapis Lazuli. The columns therein shall be made of jewels. It shall be endowed with paintings, vehicles of brilliant appearance as well as hundred of maid-servants.

verses.sanskrit: असुरा योधितास्तत्र वासुदेवेन कोटिशः । तत्र तीर्थं समुत्पन्नं विष्णुश्रीको भवेदिह । अहोरात्रोपवासेन ब्रह्महत्यां व्यपोहति
verses.transliteration: asurā yodhitāstatra vāsudevena koṭiśaḥ / tatra tīrthaṃ samutpannaṃ viṣṇuśrīko bhavediha / ahorātropavāsena brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati
verses.translation: He shall be the emperor ruling over kings. He will be elegant and glorious and loved by all women. He will live for more than a hundred years enjoying all pleasures.
verses.hindi: तीर्थमाहात्म्य-प्रकरणमें नर्मदा तथा उसके समीपवर्ती तीर्थोकी महिमा, मार्कण्डेय तथा युधिष्ठिरके संवादकी समाप्ति
verses.wordMeaning: He shall be the emperor ruling over kings. He will be elegant and glorious and loved by all women. He will live for more than a hundred years enjoying all pleasures.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall be the emperor ruling over kings. He will be elegant and glorious and loved by all women. He will live for more than a hundred years enjoying all pleasures.

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदादक्षिणे कूले तीर्थं परमशोभनम् । कामतीर्थमिति ख्यातं यत्र कामोर्ऽचयद् भवम्
verses.transliteration: narmadādakṣiṇe kūle tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam / kāmatīrthamiti khyātaṃ yatra kāmor'cayad bhavam
verses.translation: When (for ending his life ) he enters fire or water or when he observes fast, his departure shall be with no return (to Sarhsara) like that of the wind absorbed in the sky.
verses.hindi: तत्र देवो भृगुः पूर्वं रुद्रमाराधयत् पुरा दर्शनात् तस्य देवस्य सद्यः पापात् प्रमुच्यते । एतत् क्षेत्रं सुविपुलं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम्
verses.wordMeaning: When (for ending his life ) he enters fire or water or when he observes fast, his departure shall be with no return (to Sarhsara) like that of the wind absorbed in the sky.
verses.commentary: Sense: When (for ending his life ) he enters fire or water or when he observes fast, his departure shall be with no return (to Sarhsara) like that of the wind absorbed in the sky.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिंस्तीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा उपवासपरायणः । कुसुमायुधरूपेण रुद्रोलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: tasmiṃstīrthe naraḥ snātvā upavāsaparāyaṇaḥ / kusumāyudharūpeṇa rudroloke mahīyate
verses.translation: On the ridge of the western mountain, there is a lake named Jalesvara. It is well known in the three worlds and is destructive of all sins.
verses.hindi: उपानहोस्तथा युग्मं देयमन्नं सकाञ्जनम्। भोजनं च यथाशक्ति तदस्याक्षयमुच्यते
verses.wordMeaning: On the ridge of the western mountain, there is a lake named Jalesvara. It is well known in the three worlds and is destructive of all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the ridge of the western mountain, there is a lake named Jalesvara. It is well known in the three worlds and is destructive of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र ब्रह्मतीर्थमनुत्तमम् । उमाहकमिति ख्यातं तत्र संतर्पयेत् पितॄन्
verses.transliteration: tato gaccheta rājendra brahmatīrthamanuttamam / umāhakamiti khyātaṃ tatra saṃtarpayet pitṝn
verses.translation: If one offers Pindas there and performs the Sandhya worship, it is asgood as propitiating the (Pitrs) for ten thousand years. There is no doubt about this.
verses.hindi: क्षरन्ति सर्वदानानि यज्ञदानं तपः क्रिया। अक्षयं तत् तपस्तप्तं भृगुतीर्थं युधिष्ठिर काञ्चनेन विमानेन ब्रह्मलोके महीयते
