verses.wordMeaning: If one offers Pindas there and performs the Sandhya worship, it is asgood as propitiating the (Pitrs) for ten thousand years. There is no doubt about this.
verses.commentary: Sense: If one offers Pindas there and performs the Sandhya worship, it is asgood as propitiating the (Pitrs) for ten thousand years. There is no doubt about this.

verses.sanskrit: पौर्णमास्याममावास्यां श्र्धं कुर्याद् यथाविधि । गजरूपा शिला तत्र तोयमध्ये व्यवस्थिता
verses.transliteration: paurṇamāsyāmamāvāsyāṃ śrdhaṃ kuryād yathāvidhi / gajarūpā śilā tatra toyamadhye vyavasthitā
verses.translation: On the southern bank of Narmada, there is a great river named Kapila. It is stationed not very far. It is covered by Juicy Arjuna trees.®
verses.hindi: मार्कण्डेयजीने कहा--राजेन्द्र ! तदन्तर श्रेष्ठ भुगुतीर्थमें जाना चाहिए । प्राचीन कालमें यहाँ महर्षि भृगुदेवने भगवान् रुद्रकी आराधना की थी। उन देवके दर्शन करनेसे तत्काल पापसे मुक्ति हो जाती है। यह क्षेत्र बहुत बड़ा
verses.wordMeaning: On the southern bank of Narmada, there is a great river named Kapila. It is stationed not very far. It is covered by Juicy Arjuna trees.®
verses.commentary: Sense: On the southern bank of Narmada, there is a great river named Kapila. It is stationed not very far. It is covered by Juicy Arjuna trees.®

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिंस्तु दापयेत् पिण्डान् वैशाख्यान्तु विशेषतः । स्नात्वा समाहितमना दम्भमात्सर्यवर्जितः । तृप्यन्ति पितरस्तस्य यावत् तिष्ठति मेदिनी
verses.transliteration: tasmiṃstu dāpayet piṇḍān vaiśākhyāntu viśeṣataḥ / snātvā samāhitamanā dambhamātsaryavarjitaḥ / tṛpyanti pitarastasya yāvat tiṣṭhati medinī
verses.translation: That is meritorious and highly blessed. It is well- known in the three worlds. O Yudhisthira, the holy spots there number to more than a hundred crore.
verses.hindi: तथा सभी पापोंको नष्ट करनेवाला है। यहाँ स्नान कर व्यक्ति स्वर्ग जाते हैं और यहाँ मृत्युको प्राप्त होनेवालोंका पुनर्जन्म नहीं होता। यहाँ जूतेका जोड़ा तथा सोनेके साथ अन्नका दान करना चाहिए। यथाशक्ति भोजन भी कराना चाहिए। यह सब अक्षय (फलवाला) कहा गया है। युधिष्ठिर! सभी दान, यज्ञ, तप तथा कर्म नष्ट हो जाते हैं (किंतु) भृगुतीर्थमें किया हुआ तप अक्षय होता है। युधिष्ठिर! उन्हीं (महर्षि भृगु)-की उग्र तपस्यासे प्रसन्न
verses.wordMeaning: That is meritorious and highly blessed. It is well- known in the three worlds. O Yudhisthira, the holy spots there number to more than a hundred crore.
verses.commentary: Sense: That is meritorious and highly blessed. It is well- known in the three worlds. O Yudhisthira, the holy spots there number to more than a hundred crore.

verses.sanskrit: सिद्धेश्वरं ततो गच्छेत् स्नानं तत्र समाचरेत् । स्नातमात्रो नरस्तत्र गाणपत्यपदं लभेत्
verses.transliteration: siddheśvaraṃ tato gacchet snānaṃ tatra samācaret / snātamātro narastatra gāṇapatyapadaṃ labhet
verses.translation: The trees that fall into the holy river after growing for many years, attain great goal due to the contact of waters of Narmada.
verses.hindi: होकर त्रिपुरारि भगवान् शंकर भृगुतीर्थमें सहैव संनिहित रहते हैं, यह शास्त्रोंमें कहा गया है॥ १--५॥
verses.wordMeaning: The trees that fall into the holy river after growing for many years, attain great goal due to the contact of waters of Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: The trees that fall into the holy river after growing for many years, attain great goal due to the contact of waters of Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र लिङ्गो यत्र जनार्दनः । तत्र स्नात्वा तु राजेन्द्र विष्णुलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: tato gaccheta rājendra liṅgo yatra janārdanaḥ / tatra snātvā tu rājendra viṣṇuloke mahīyate
verses.translation: A second holy river is the blessed and auspicious. Visalyakarani. A man taking bath in that holy river becomes, free from pains, sins and grief.®
verses.hindi: राजेन्द्र! तदनन्तर उत्तम गौतमेशवर (तीर्थ) -में जाना चाहिए। जहाँ त्रिशूलका चिह्न धारण करनेवाले त्रिशूली (भगवान् शंकर)-की आराधनाकर (महर्षि) गौतमने सिद्धि प्रात की थी। राजन्! वहाँ (गौतमेश्वर-तीर्थमें) स्नानकर उपवासरत व्यक्ति सोनेके विमानद्वारा ब्रह्मलोक जाता है तथा वहाँ आदर प्राप्त करता है। तदुपरान्त वृषोत्सर्ग-तीर्थकी यात्रा कर शाश्वत पद प्राप्त करना चाहिए। विष्णुको मायासे मोहित मूढ व्यक्ति इस
verses.wordMeaning: A second holy river is the blessed and auspicious. Visalyakarani. A man taking bath in that holy river becomes, free from pains, sins and grief.®
verses.commentary: Sense: A second holy river is the blessed and auspicious. Visalyakarani. A man taking bath in that holy river becomes, free from pains, sins and grief.®

verses.sanskrit: यत्र नारायणो देवो मुनोनां भावितात्मनाम् । स्वात्मानं दर्शयामास लिङ्गं तत् परमं पदम्
verses.transliteration: yatra nārāyaṇo devo munonāṃ bhāvitātmanām / svātmānaṃ darśayāmāsa liṅgaṃ tat paramaṃ padam
verses.translation: Kapila and Visalya are heard as the two excellent rivers mentioned by Isvara formerly with a desire for the well¬ being of the worlds.
verses.hindi: तीर्थको नहीं जानते
verses.wordMeaning: Kapila and Visalya are heard as the two excellent rivers mentioned by Isvara formerly with a desire for the well¬ being of the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kapila and Visalya are heard as the two excellent rivers mentioned by Isvara formerly with a desire for the well¬ being of the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: अङ्कोलं तु ततो गच्छेत् सर्वपापविनाशनम् । स्नानं दानं च तत्रैव ब्राह्मणानां च भोजनम् । पिण्डप्रिदानं च कृतं प्रेत्यानन्तफलप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: aṅkolaṃ tu tato gacchet sarvapāpavināśanam / snānaṃ dānaṃ ca tatraiva brāhmaṇānāṃ ca bhojanam / piṇḍapridānaṃ ca kṛtaṃ pretyānantaphalapradam
verses.translation: O lord of men, he who gives up food until death in that Tlrtha, shall have his soul purified of all sins. He goes to the region of Rudra.*
verses.hindi: धौतपापं ततो गच्छेद् धौतं यत्र वृषेण तु। तत्र तीर्थ नरः स्नात्वा ब्रह्महत्यां व्यपोहति
verses.wordMeaning: O lord of men, he who gives up food until death in that Tlrtha, shall have his soul purified of all sins. He goes to the region of Rudra.*
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord of men, he who gives up food until death in that Tlrtha, shall have his soul purified of all sins. He goes to the region of Rudra.*

verses.sanskrit: त्रैयम्बकेन तोयेन यश्चरुं श्रपयेत् ततः । अङ्कोलमूले दद्याच्च पिण्डांश्चैव यथाविधि । तारिताः पितरस्तेन तृप्यन्त्याचन्द्रतारकम्
verses.transliteration: traiyambakena toyena yaścaruṃ śrapayet tataḥ / aṅkolamūle dadyācca piṇḍāṃścaiva yathāvidhi / tāritāḥ pitarastena tṛpyantyācandratārakam
verses.translation: O king, on taking his bath there a man shall attain the fruit of a horse-sacrifice. Those who reside on the northern bank reside in the region of Rudra.®
verses.hindi: तत्र तीर्थे तु राजेन्द्र प्राणत्यागं करोति यः। चतुर्भुजस्त्रनेत्रश्च हरतुल्यबलो भवेत्
verses.wordMeaning: O king, on taking his bath there a man shall attain the fruit of a horse-sacrifice. Those who reside on the northern bank reside in the region of Rudra.®
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, on taking his bath there a man shall attain the fruit of a horse-sacrifice. Those who reside on the northern bank reside in the region of Rudra.®

verses.sanskrit: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र तापसेश्वरमुत्तमम् । तत्र स्नात्वा तु राजेन्द्र प्राप्नुयात् तपसः फलम्
verses.transliteration: tato gaccheta rājendra tāpaseśvaramuttamam / tatra snātvā tu rājendra prāpnuyāt tapasaḥ phalam
verses.translation: As Sankara told me, O Yudhisthira, the bath and. the charitable gift at Sarasvatl, Gahga, and Narmada are of equal efficacy.®
verses.hindi: सेत् कल्पायुतं साग्रं शिवतुल्यपराक्रमः। कालेन महता जातः पृथिव्यामेकराड् भवेत् तत्र स्नात्वा नरो राजन् ब्रह्मलोके महीयते
verses.wordMeaning: As Sankara told me, O Yudhisthira, the bath and. the charitable gift at Sarasvatl, Gahga, and Narmada are of equal efficacy.®
verses.commentary: Sense: As Sankara told me, O Yudhisthira, the bath and. the charitable gift at Sarasvatl, Gahga, and Narmada are of equal efficacy.®

verses.sanskrit: शुक्लतीर्थं ततो गच्छेत् सर्वपापविनाशनम् । नास्ति तेन सम तीर्थं नर्मदायां युधिष्ठिर
verses.transliteration: śuklatīrthaṃ tato gacchet sarvapāpavināśanam / nāsti tena sama tīrthaṃ narmadāyāṃ yudhiṣṭhira
verses.translation: He who abandons his life -on the mountain Amara- kantaka is honoured in the Rudraloka for hundreds of crores of years and more.''
verses.hindi: वराहतीर्थमाख्यातं विष्णुलोकगतिप्रदम्
verses.wordMeaning: He who abandons his life -on the mountain Amara- kantaka is honoured in the Rudraloka for hundreds of crores of years and more.''
verses.commentary: Sense: He who abandons his life -on the mountain Amara- kantaka is honoured in the Rudraloka for hundreds of crores of years and more.''

verses.sanskrit: दर्शनात् स्पर्शनात् तस्य स्नानदानतपोजपात् । होमाच्चैवोपवासाच्च शुक्लतीर्थे महत् फलम्
verses.transliteration: darśanāt sparśanāt tasya snānadānatapojapāt / homāccaivopavāsācca śuklatīrthe mahat phalam
verses.translation: On sprinkling the head with the holy and sacred, water of Narmada along with its foam one is relieved of all. sins.
verses.hindi: स्नातमात्रो नरस्तत्र चन्द्रलोके महीयते स्नातमात्रो नरस्तत्र पृथिव्यामेकराड् भवेत्
verses.wordMeaning: On sprinkling the head with the holy and sacred, water of Narmada along with its foam one is relieved of all. sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: On sprinkling the head with the holy and sacred, water of Narmada along with its foam one is relieved of all. sins.

verses.sanskrit: योजनं तत् स्मृतं क्षेत्रं देवगन्धर्वसेवितम् । शुक्लतीर्थमिति ख्यातं सर्वपापविनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: yojanaṃ tat smṛtaṃ kṣetraṃ devagandharvasevitam / śuklatīrthamiti khyātaṃ sarvapāpavināśanam
verses.translation: Narmada is holy everywhere. It dispels sins of Brahmana-slaughter. By observing fast for a day and a night, one is absolved of the sin of Brahmana slaughter.
verses.hindi: देवतीर्थं ततो गच्छेत् सर्वदेवनमस्कृतम्। तत्र स्नात्वा च राजेन्द्र हैवतैः सह मोदते
verses.wordMeaning: Narmada is holy everywhere. It dispels sins of Brahmana-slaughter. By observing fast for a day and a night, one is absolved of the sin of Brahmana slaughter.
verses.commentary: Sense: Narmada is holy everywhere. It dispels sins of Brahmana-slaughter. By observing fast for a day and a night, one is absolved of the sin of Brahmana slaughter.

verses.sanskrit: पादपाग्रेण दृष्टेन ब्रह्महत्यां व्यपोहति । देव्या सह सदा भर्गस्तत्र तिष्ठति शङ्करः
verses.transliteration: pādapāgreṇa dṛṣṭena brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati / devyā saha sadā bhargastatra tiṣṭhati śaṅkaraḥ
verses.translation: The most excellent holy centre jalesvara is destruc¬ tive of all sins. A man who observes religious regulation and restraints on going there, attains all desires.
verses.hindi: यत् तत्र दीयते दानं सर्व कोटिगुणं भवेत् विधूय सर्वपापानि ब्रह्मलोके महीयते
verses.wordMeaning: The most excellent holy centre jalesvara is destruc¬ tive of all sins. A man who observes religious regulation and restraints on going there, attains all desires.
verses.commentary: Sense: The most excellent holy centre jalesvara is destruc¬ tive of all sins. A man who observes religious regulation and restraints on going there, attains all desires.

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णपक्षे चतुर्दश्यां वैशाखे मासि सुव्रत । कैलासाच्चाभिनिष्क्रम्य तत्र सन्निहितो हरः
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ vaiśākhe māsi suvrata / kailāsāccābhiniṣkramya tatra sannihito haraḥ
verses.translation: On going to Amarakantaka during the lunar or solar eclipse, a man attains ten times the merit of an Asvamedha (horse-sacrifice).
verses.hindi: तत्र स्नात्वा नरो राजन् हैवतैः सह मोदते
verses.wordMeaning: On going to Amarakantaka during the lunar or solar eclipse, a man attains ten times the merit of an Asvamedha (horse-sacrifice).
verses.commentary: Sense: On going to Amarakantaka during the lunar or solar eclipse, a man attains ten times the merit of an Asvamedha (horse-sacrifice).

verses.sanskrit: देवदानवगन्धर्वाः सिद्धविद्याधरास्तथा । गणाश्चाप्सरसां नागास्तत्र तिष्ठन्ति पुङ्गव
verses.transliteration: devadānavagandharvāḥ siddhavidyādharāstathā / gaṇāścāpsarasāṃ nāgāstatra tiṣṭhanti puṅgava
verses.translation: This excellent mountain is meritorious.lt is resorted to by Devas and Gandharvas. It is full of various kinds of trees and creepers. It shines with different kinds of flowers.
verses.hindi: स्नात्वा तत्र नरो राजन् रुद्रलोके महीयते इसके पश्चात् धौतपाप नामक तीर्थमें जाना चाहिए, जहाँ स्वयं वृष (अर्थात् भगवान् धर्म)-ने अपना (पाप) धोया था। राजन्! सभी पातकोंका नाश करनेवाला वह तीर्थ नर्मदामें स्थित है। उस तीर्थमें स्नानकर मनुष्य
verses.wordMeaning: This excellent mountain is meritorious.lt is resorted to by Devas and Gandharvas. It is full of various kinds of trees and creepers. It shines with different kinds of flowers.
verses.commentary: Sense: This excellent mountain is meritorious.lt is resorted to by Devas and Gandharvas. It is full of various kinds of trees and creepers. It shines with different kinds of flowers.

verses.sanskrit: रजकेन यथा वस्त्रं शुक्लं भवति वारिणा । आजन्मनि कृतं पापं शुक्लतीर्थे व्यपोहति । स्नानं दानं तपः श्राद्धमनन्तं तत्र दृश्यते
verses.transliteration: rajakena yathā vastraṃ śuklaṃ bhavati vāriṇā / ājanmani kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ śuklatīrthe vyapohati / snānaṃ dānaṃ tapaḥ śrāddhamanantaṃ tatra dṛśyate
verses.translation: O King, Mahesvara (the great God) is present there alongwith the goddess (Uma). Brahma, Visnu, and Rudra (Indra?) (are present there) alongwith the groups of Vidyadharas.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्महत्यासे मुक्त हो जाता है। राजेन्द्र! उस तीर्थमें जो प्राणोंका त्याग करता है, वह चार भुजावाला, तीन नेत्रोंबाला और शंकरके समान बलवाला होता है। शिवके समान पराक्रमी होकर वह दस हजार कल्पोंसे
verses.wordMeaning: O King, Mahesvara (the great God) is present there alongwith the goddess (Uma). Brahma, Visnu, and Rudra (Indra?) (are present there) alongwith the groups of Vidyadharas.
verses.commentary: Sense: O King, Mahesvara (the great God) is present there alongwith the goddess (Uma). Brahma, Visnu, and Rudra (Indra?) (are present there) alongwith the groups of Vidyadharas.

verses.sanskrit: शुक्लतीर्थात् परं तीर्थं न भूतं न भविष्यति । पूर्वे वयसि कर्माणि कृत्वा पापानि मानवः । अहोरात्रोपवासेन शुक्लतीर्थे व्यपोहति
verses.transliteration: śuklatīrthāt paraṃ tīrthaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati / pūrve vayasi karmāṇi kṛtvā pāpāni mānavaḥ / ahorātropavāsena śuklatīrthe vyapohati
verses.translation: The man who circumambulates the mountain Amara¬ kantaka attains the fruit of Paundarika sacrifice.
verses.hindi: भी अधिक समयतक शिवलोकमें निवास करता है और बहुत समयके बाद वह पृथ्वीपर एकच्छत्र सम्राट् बनकर उत्पन्न होता है॥९--११॥ राजेन्द्र! उसके बाद श्रेष्ठ हंस-तीर्थमें जाना चाहिए। राजन्! वहाँ स्नान करनेसे मनुष्य ब्रह्मलोकमें प्रतिष्ठा प्राप्त करता है। राजेन्द्र! वहाँसे विष्णुलोककी गति प्रदान करनेवाले वराहतीर्थ नामसे प्रसिद्ध तीर्थमें जाना चाहिए,
verses.wordMeaning: The man who circumambulates the mountain Amara¬ kantaka attains the fruit of Paundarika sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: The man who circumambulates the mountain Amara¬ kantaka attains the fruit of Paundarika sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: कार्तिकस्य तु मासस्य कृष्णपक्षे चतुर्दशी । घृतेन स्नापयेद् देवमुपोष्य परमेश्वरम् । एकविंशत्कुलोपेतो न च्यवेदैश्वरात् पदात्
verses.transliteration: kārtikasya tu māsasya kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśī / ghṛtena snāpayed devamupoṣya parameśvaram / ekaviṃśatkulopeto na cyavedaiśvarāt padāt
verses.translation: The river Kaveri is well-known as the destructive of sins. One should take bath there and worship the bull-bannered Mahadeva. (One who takes bath) at the confluence of Narmada is honoured in the Rudraloka.
verses.hindi: जहाँ जनार्दनने सिद्धि प्राप्त की थी। राजेन्द्र! तदनन्तर श्रेष्ठ चन्द्रतीर्थमें जाना चाहिए। वहाँ विशेषरूपसे पौर्णमासीको स्नान करना चाहिए। वहाँ स्नानमात्र करनेवाला व्यक्ति चन्द्रलोकमें प्रतिष्ठा प्रात करता है। राजेन्द्र! इसके पश्चात्
verses.wordMeaning: The river Kaveri is well-known as the destructive of sins. One should take bath there and worship the bull-bannered Mahadeva. (One who takes bath) at the confluence of Narmada is honoured in the Rudraloka.
verses.commentary: Sense: The river Kaveri is well-known as the destructive of sins. One should take bath there and worship the bull-bannered Mahadeva. (One who takes bath) at the confluence of Narmada is honoured in the Rudraloka.

verses.sanskrit: तपसा ब्रह्मचर्येण यज्ञदानेन वा पुनः । न तां गतिमवाप्नोति शुक्लतीर्थे तु यां लभेत्
verses.transliteration: tapasā brahmacaryeṇa yajñadānena vā punaḥ / na tāṃ gatimavāpnoti śuklatīrthe tu yāṃ labhet
verses.translation: "O Lord of Devas, how shall we worship you always, by means of the path of action or by means of the path of knowledge?
verses.hindi: अत्युत्तम कन्यातीर्थमें जाना चाहिए। वहाँ शुक्लपक्षकी तृतीया तिथिको स्नान करना चाहिए। वहाँ स्नानमात्र करनेसे व्यक्ति पृथ्वीमें एकमात्र सम्राट् होता है । तदनन्तर सभी देवताओंसे वन्दित देवतीर्थमें जाना चाहिए। राजेन्द्र! वहाँ स्नान करनेसे देवताओंके साथ आनन्द (-के अनुभवका अवसर) प्राप्त होता है
verses.wordMeaning: "O Lord of Devas, how shall we worship you always, by means of the path of action or by means of the path of knowledge?
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Lord of Devas, how shall we worship you always, by means of the path of action or by means of the path of knowledge?

verses.sanskrit: शुक्लतीर्थं महातीर्थमृषिसिद्धनिषेवितम् । तत्र स्नात्वा नरो राजन् पुनर्जन्म न विन्दति
verses.transliteration: śuklatīrthaṃ mahātīrthamṛṣisiddhaniṣevitam / tatra snātvā naro rājan punarjanma na vindati
verses.translation: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;
verses.hindi: राजेन्द्र! तदनन्तर श्रेष्ठ शिखितीर्थमें जाना चाहिए। वहाँ जो कुछ दान दिया जाता है, वह सब करोड़ गुना फलवाला हो जाता है। राजेन्द्र! शुभ पैतामह तीर्थमें भी जाना चाहिए। वहाँ जो श्राद्ध किया जाता
verses.wordMeaning: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;

verses.sanskrit: अयने वा चतुर्दश्यां संक्रान्तौ विषुवे तथा । स्नात्वा तु सोपवासः सन् विजितात्मा समाहितः
verses.transliteration: ayane vā caturdaśyāṃ saṃkrāntau viṣuve tathā / snātvā tu sopavāsaḥ san vijitātmā samāhitaḥ
verses.translation: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;
verses.hindi: है, वह अक्षय (फलवाला) हो जाता है। सावित्रीतीर्थमें पहुँचकर जो प्राणोंका परित्याग करता है, वह सभी पापोंको धोकर ब्रह्मलोकमें महिमा प्राप्त करता है। वहाँ मनोहर नामक परम सुन्दर तीर्थ है। राजन्! वहाँ स्नानकर मनुष्य देवताओंके साथ आनन्द प्राप्त करता है। राजेन्द्र! तदनन्तर उत्तम मानस तीर्थमें जाना चाहिए। राजन्! वहाँ स्नान करके मनुष्य रुद्रलोकमें प्रतिष्ठा प्राप्त करता है
verses.wordMeaning: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;

verses.sanskrit: दानं दद्याद् यथाशक्ति प्रीयेतां हरिशङ्करौ । एतत् तीर्थप्रभावेण सर्वं भवति चाक्षयम्
verses.transliteration: dānaṃ dadyād yathāśakti prīyetāṃ hariśaṅkarau / etat tīrthaprabhāveṇa sarvaṃ bhavati cākṣayam
verses.translation: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;
verses.hindi: स्वर्गबिन्दु ततो गच्छेत् तीर्थ देवनमस्कृतम्। तत्र स्नात्वा नरो राजन् दुर्गतिं नैव गच्छति
verses.wordMeaning: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;

verses.sanskrit: अनाथं दुर्गतं विप्रं नाथवन्तमथापि वा । उद्वादयति यस्तीर्थे तस्य पुण्यफलं शृणु
verses.transliteration: anāthaṃ durgataṃ vipraṃ nāthavantamathāpi vā / udvādayati yastīrthe tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu
verses.translation: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;
verses.hindi: क्रीडते नाकलोकस्थो ह्यप्सरोभिः स मोदते उपोषितोऽर्चयेदीशं रुद्रलोके महीयते। अस्मिंस्तीर्थे मृतो राजन् गाणपत्यमवाप्नुयात्
verses.wordMeaning: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;

verses.sanskrit: यावत् तद्रोमसंख्या तु तत्प्रसूतिकुलेषु च । तावद् वर्षसहस्राणि रुद्रलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: yāvat tadromasaṃkhyā tu tatprasūtikuleṣu ca / tāvad varṣasahasrāṇi rudraloke mahīyate
verses.translation: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;
verses.hindi: कार्तिके मासि देवेशमर्चयेत् पार्वतीपतिम्। अश्वमेधात् दशगुणं प्रवदन्ति मनीषिणः
verses.wordMeaning: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;

verses.sanskrit: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र यमतीर्थ मनुत्तमम् । कृष्णपक्षे चतुर्दश्यां माघमासे युधिष्ठिर । स्नानं कृत्वा नक्तभीजी न पश्येद् योनिसङ्कटम्
verses.transliteration: tato gaccheta rājendra yamatīrtha manuttamam / kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ māghamāse yudhiṣṭhira / snānaṃ kṛtvā naktabhījī na paśyed yonisaṅkaṭam
verses.translation: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;
verses.hindi: वृषयुक्तेन यानेन रुद्रलोकं स गच्छति सर्वपापविशुद्धात्मा रुद्रलोकं स गच्छति
verses.wordMeaning: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;

verses.sanskrit: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र एरण्डीतीर्थमुत्तमम् । संगमे तु नरः स्नायादुपवासपरायणः । ब्राह्मणं भोजयेदेकं कोटिर्भवति भोजिताः
verses.transliteration: tato gaccheta rājendra eraṇḍītīrthamuttamam / saṃgame tu naraḥ snāyādupavāsaparāyaṇaḥ / brāhmaṇaṃ bhojayedekaṃ koṭirbhavati bhojitāḥ
verses.translation: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;
verses.hindi: हंसयुक्तेन यानेन स्वर्गलोकं स गच्छति
verses.wordMeaning: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;

verses.sanskrit: एरण्डीसंगमे स्नात्वा भक्तिभावात् तुरञ्जितः । मृत्तिकां शिरसि स्थाप्य अवगाह्य च तज्जलम् । नर्मदोदकसंमिश्रं मुच्यते सर्वकिल्बिषैः
verses.transliteration: eraṇḍīsaṃgame snātvā bhaktibhāvāt turañjitaḥ / mṛttikāṃ śirasi sthāpya avagāhya ca tajjalam / narmadodakasaṃmiśraṃ mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ
verses.translation: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;
verses.hindi: एरण्ड्या नर्मदायास्तु संगमं लोकविश्रुतम्। तत्र तीर्थ महापुण्यं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् तत्र स्नात्वा तु राजेन्द्र मुच्यते ब्रह्महत्यया
verses.wordMeaning: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;

verses.sanskrit: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र तीर्थं कार्णाटिकेश्वरम् । गङ्गावतरते तत्र दिने पुण्ये न संशयः
verses.transliteration: tato gaccheta rājendra tīrthaṃ kārṇāṭikeśvaram / gaṅgāvatarate tatra dine puṇye na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;
verses.hindi: तत्र स्नात्वा नरो राजन् रुद्रलोके महीयते
verses.wordMeaning: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;

verses.sanskrit: तत्र स्नात्वा च पीत्वा च दत्त्वा चैव यथाविधि । सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो ब्रह्मलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: tatra snātvā ca pītvā ca dattvā caiva yathāvidhi / sarvapāpavinirmukto brahmaloke mahīyate
verses.translation: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;
verses.hindi: सप्तजन्मकृतं पापं हित्वा याति शिवालयम् तदुपरान्त देवताओंसे नमस्कृत स्वर्गबिन्दु नामक तीर्थमें जाना चाहिए। राजन्! वहाँ स्नान करनेसे मनुष्यको दुर्गति नहीं होती। इसके बाद अप्सरेश-तीर्थमें जाकर वहाँ स्नान करना चाहिए। इससे वह स्वर्गलोकमें
verses.wordMeaning: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;

verses.sanskrit: नन्दितीर्थं ततो गच्छेत् स्नानं तत्र समाचरेत् । प्रीयते तस्य नन्दीशः सोमलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: nanditīrthaṃ tato gacchet snānaṃ tatra samācaret / prīyate tasya nandīśaḥ somaloke mahīyate
verses.translation: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;
verses.hindi: निवास करते हुए क्रीड़ा करता है और अप्सराओंके साथ आनन्दित होता है
verses.wordMeaning: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;

verses.sanskrit: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र तीर्थं त्वनरकं शुभम् । तत्र स्नात्वा नरो राजन् नरकं नैव पश्यति
verses.transliteration: tato gaccheta rājendra tīrthaṃ tvanarakaṃ śubham / tatra snātvā naro rājan narakaṃ naiva paśyati
verses.translation: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;
verses.hindi: राजेन्द्र! तदनन्तर उत्तम भारभूति नामक तीर्थमें जाना चाहिए। वहाँ उपवास करते हुए ईशवरकी आराधना करनेसे रुद्रलोकमें प्रतिष्ठा प्राप्त होती है। राजन्! इस तीर्थमें मरनेवाला (शिवलोकमें) गाणपत्य- पद प्राप्त करता है। (यहाँ) कार्तिक मासमें पार्वतीपति
verses.wordMeaning: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिंस्तीर्थे तु राजेन्द्र स्वान्यस्थीनि विनिक्षिपेत् । रूपवान् जायते लोके धनभोगसमन्वितः
verses.transliteration: tasmiṃstīrthe tu rājendra svānyasthīni vinikṣipet / rūpavān jāyate loke dhanabhogasamanvitaḥ
verses.translation: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;
verses.hindi: फल मनीषी लोग अश्वमेधके फलसे भी दस गुना अधिक बताते हैं। जो वहाँ कुन्दपुष्प तथा इन्दु (चन्द्रमा)-के समान (श्वेत) वर्णवाले वृषभका दान करता है, वह वृषयुक्त विमानसे रुद्रलोकमें जाता है।
verses.wordMeaning: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;

verses.sanskrit: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र कपिलातीर्थ मुत्तमम् । तत्र स्नात्वा नरो राजन् गोसहस्रफलं लभेत्
verses.transliteration: tato gaccheta rājendra kapilātīrtha muttamam / tatra snātvā naro rājan gosahasraphalaṃ labhet
verses.translation: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;
verses.hindi: इस तीर्थमें पहुँचकर जो प्राणोंका परित्याग करता है, वह सभी पापोंसे मुक्त हो विशुद्ध आत्मावाला होकर रुद्रलोकमें जाता है। नराधिप! इस तीर्थमें जो जलमें प्रवेश (-कर प्राणत्याग) करता है, वह हंसयुक्त विमानसे स्वर्गलोक जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;

verses.sanskrit: ज्येष्ठमासे तु संप्राप्ते चतुर्दश्यां विशेषतः । तत्रोपोष्य नरो भक्त्या दद्याद् दीपं घृतेन तु
verses.transliteration: jyeṣṭhamāse tu saṃprāpte caturdaśyāṃ viśeṣataḥ / tatropoṣya naro bhaktyā dadyād dīpaṃ ghṛtena tu
verses.translation: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;
verses.hindi: एरण्डी तथा नर्मदाका संगम विख्यात है। वहाँ सभी पापोंको नष्ट करनेवाला महान् पुण्यप्रद तीर्थ है। राजेन्द्र! वहाँ स्नानकर उपवास करनेवाला तथा नित्य व्रतपरायण रहनेवाला व्यक्ति ब्रह्महत्या (-के
verses.wordMeaning: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;

verses.sanskrit: घृतेन स्नापयेद् रुद्रं सघृतं श्रीफलं दहेत् । घण्टाभरणसंयुक्तां कपिलां वै प्रदापयेत्
verses.transliteration: ghṛtena snāpayed rudraṃ saghṛtaṃ śrīphalaṃ dahet / ghaṇṭābharaṇasaṃyuktāṃ kapilāṃ vai pradāpayet
verses.translation: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;
verses.hindi: पाप)-से मुक्त हो जाता है। राजेन्द्र! तदनन्तर नर्मदा और सागरके संगम-स्थलमें जाना चाहिए। जहाँ जमदग्नि नामसे विख्यात जनार्दनको सिद्धि प्राप्त हुई थी। राजन्! वहाँ नर्मदा तथा सागरके संगममें स्नान करनेसे मनुष्य अश्वमेधके फलका तिगुना फल प्राप्त करता है
verses.wordMeaning: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;

verses.sanskrit: सर्वाभरणसंयुक्तः सर्वदेवनमस्कृतः । शिवतुल्यबलो भूत्वा शिववत् क्रीडते चिरम्
verses.transliteration: sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktaḥ sarvadevanamaskṛtaḥ / śivatulyabalo bhūtvā śivavat krīḍate ciram
verses.translation: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;
verses.hindi: राजेन्द्र! तदुपरान्त उत्तम पिङ्गलेश्वर तीर्थमें जाना चाहिए। राजन्! वहाँ स्नान करके मनुष्य रुद्रलोकमें प्रतिष्ठा प्रात करता है। वहाँ उपवास करके जो विमलेश्वरका दर्शन करता है, वह सात जन्मोंमें किये
verses.wordMeaning: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गारकदिने प्राप्ते चतुर्थ्यां तु विशेषतः । स्नापयित्वा शिवं दद्याद् ब्राह्मणेभ्यस्तु भोजनम्
verses.transliteration: aṅgārakadine prāpte caturthyāṃ tu viśeṣataḥ / snāpayitvā śivaṃ dadyād brāhmaṇebhyastu bhojanam
verses.translation: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;
verses.hindi: पापोंसे मुक्त होकर शिवलोकमें जाता है १४७४  कूर्मपुराण »
verses.wordMeaning: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;

verses.sanskrit: सर्वभोगसमायुक्तो विमानैः सार्वकामिकैः । गत्वा शक्रस्य भवनं शक्रेण सह मोदते
verses.transliteration: sarvabhogasamāyukto vimānaiḥ sārvakāmikaiḥ / gatvā śakrasya bhavanaṃ śakreṇa saha modate
verses.translation: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;
verses.hindi: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र आलिकातीर्थमुत्तमम्। राजेन्द्र! वहाँसे उत्तम आलिका-तीर्थमें जाना चाहिए। उपोष्य रजनीमेकां नियतो नियताशनः। इस तीर्थका माहात्म्य यह है कि यहाँ एक रात्रि उपवास
verses.wordMeaning: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;

verses.sanskrit: ततः स्वर्गात् परिभ्रष्टो धनवान् भोगवान् भवेत् । अङ्गारकनवम्यां तु अमावास्यां तथैव च । स्नापयेत् तत्र यत्नेन रूपवान् सुभगो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ svargāt paribhraṣṭo dhanavān bhogavān bhavet / aṅgārakanavamyāṃ tu amāvāsyāṃ tathaiva ca / snāpayet tatra yatnena rūpavān subhago bhavet
verses.translation: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;
verses.hindi: अस्य तीर्थस्य माहात्म्यान्मुच्यते ब्रह्महत्यया॥ ३५॥  करके संयत रहते हुए नियमपूर्वक सात्त्विक आहार करनेसे ब्रह्महत्या (-के पाप)-से मुक्ति मिल जाती है पाण्डव! संक्षेपमें मैंने प्रधान-प्रधान तीर्थोको एतानि तव संक्षेपात् प्राधान्यात् कथितानि तु। बतलाया। विस्तारपूर्वक तीर्थोकी संख्याका वर्णन नहीं न शक्या विस्तराद् वक्तुं संख्या तीर्थेषु पाण्डव॥ ३६॥  किया जा सकता
verses.wordMeaning: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;

verses.sanskrit: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र गणेश्वरमनुत्तमम् । श्रावणे मासी संप्राप्ते कृष्णपक्षे चतुर्दशी
verses.transliteration: tato gaccheta rājendra gaṇeśvaramanuttamam / śrāvaṇe māsī saṃprāpte kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśī
verses.translation: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;
verses.hindi: यह पवित्र तथा स्वच्छ जलवाली नर्मदा नदी तीनों एषा पवित्रा विमला नदी त्रैलोक्यविश्रुता। लोकोंमें विख्यात है। नर्मदा सभी नदियोंमें श्रेष्ठ है और नर्मदा सरितां श्रेष्ठा महादेवस्य वल्लभा॥ ३७॥  महादेवको अत्यन्त प्रिय है। युधिष्ठिर! जो मनसे भी नर्मदाका स्मरण करता है, वह सौ चान्द्रायण ब्रतोंसे भी
verses.wordMeaning: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;

verses.sanskrit: स्नातमात्रो नरस्तत्र रुद्रलोके महीयते । पितॄणां तर्पणं कृत्वा मुच्यते ऽसावॄणत्रयात्
verses.transliteration: snātamātro narastatra rudraloke mahīyate / pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā mucyate 'sāvṝṇatrayāt
verses.translation: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;
verses.hindi: मनसा संस्मरेद्यस्तु नर्मदां वै युधिष्ठिर। अधिक ल =e संशय pe है। UR चान्द्रायणशतं साग्रं णय. यह कहना श्रद्धासे रहित तथा घोर नास्तिकताका चान्द्रायणशतं साग्रं लभते नात्र संशय: ॥ ३८॥ जव ताल पक तनभाव गिरते ह इसलिये ऐसे पुरुषोंको नरकसे बचनेके लिये नर्मदाका दर्शन- सेवन करना चाहिए)। इसी कारण स्वयं देव महेश्वर हम लोगोंको प्रेरणा देनेके लिये नित्य नर्मदाका सेवन नर्मदां त्स करते हैं, अत: इस पवित्र नदीको ब्रह्महत्या-जैसे पापोंको नर्मदां सेवते नित्यं स्वयं देवो महेश्वरः। दूर करनेवाली समझना चाहिए (तथा पूर्ण निष्ठाके साथ
verses.wordMeaning: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गेश्वरसमीपे तु गङ्गावदनमुत्तमम् । अकामो वा सकामो वा तत्र स्नात्वा तु मानवः । आजन्मजनितैः पापैर्मुच्यते नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: gaṅgeśvarasamīpe tu gaṅgāvadanamuttamam / akāmo vā sakāmo vā tatra snātvā tu mānavaḥ / ājanmajanitaiḥ pāpairmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;
verses.hindi: तेन पुण्या नदी ज्ञेया ब्रह्महत्यापहारिणी॥ ४०॥  इसका दर्शन, सेवन अवश्य करना चाहिए) ॥ ३७--४०॥
verses.wordMeaning: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;

verses.sanskrit: तस्य वै पश्चिमे देशे समीपे नातिदूरतः । दशाश्वमेधिकं तीर्थं त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: tasya vai paścime deśe samīpe nātidūrataḥ / daśāśvamedhikaṃ tīrthaṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam
verses.translation: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;
verses.hindi: इति श्रीकूर्मषुराणे षट्साहस्त्रथां संहितायामुपरिविभागे चत्वारिशोऽध्यायः इस प्रकार छः हजार श्लोकोंवाली श्रीकूर्मपुराणसंहिताके उपरिंविभागमें चालीसवाँ अध्याय समाप्त हुआ
verses.wordMeaning: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;

verses.sanskrit: उपोष्य रजनीमेकां मासि भाद्रपदे शुभे । अमावस्यां नरः स्नात्वा पूजयेद् वृषभध्वजम्
verses.transliteration: upoṣya rajanīmekāṃ māsi bhādrapade śubhe / amāvasyāṃ naraḥ snātvā pūjayed vṛṣabhadhvajam
verses.translation: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;
verses.hindi: पतन्ति नरके घोरे इत्याह परमेशवरः
verses.wordMeaning: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;

verses.sanskrit: काञ्चनेन विमानेन किङ्किणीजालमालिना । गत्वा रुद्रपुरं रम्यं रुद्रेण सह मोदते
verses.transliteration: kāñcanena vimānena kiṅkiṇījālamālinā / gatvā rudrapuraṃ ramyaṃ rudreṇa saha modate
verses.translation: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;
verses.hindi: तीर्थमाहात्म्य-प्रकरणमें नैमिषारण्य तथा जप्येश्वर-तीर्थकी महिमा, जप्येश्वर-तीर्थमें महर्षि शिलादके पुत्र नन्दीकी तपस्या तथा उनके गणाधिपति होनेका आख्यान सूत उवाच सूतजीने कहा--तीनों लोकोंमें विख्यात यह
verses.wordMeaning: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;

verses.sanskrit: सर्वत्र सर्वदिवसे स्नानं तत्र समाचरेत् । पितॄणां तर्पणं कुर्यादश्वमेधफलं लभेत्
verses.transliteration: sarvatra sarvadivase snānaṃ tatra samācaret / pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ kuryādaśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet
verses.translation: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;
verses.hindi: + श्रेलोक्यविख्यातं उत्तम नैमिष-तीर्थ महादेवको प्रिय लगनेवाला तथा
verses.wordMeaning: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of what divine path is the lord to be worshipped here? What is it that should be resorted to? What is it that should not be resorted to? Please mention all these to us;

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे एकोनचत्वारिशो ऽध्यायः मार्कण्डेय उवाच ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र भृगुतीर्थ मनुत्तमम् । तत्र देवो भृगुः पुर्वं रुद्रमाराधयत् पुरा
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge ekonacatvāriśo 'dhyāyaḥ mārkaṇḍeya uvāca tato gaccheta rājendra bhṛgutīrtha manuttamam / tatra devo bhṛguḥ purvaṃ rudramārādhayat purā
verses.translation: O great sages, I shall expound to you the excellent incomprehensible secret formerly narrated by Brahma to Mahadeva.
verses.hindi: ड्द द तीर्थ नैमिशमुत्तमम्। महापातकोंको नष्ट करनेवाला है। द्विजोत्तमो! ब्रह्माने महादेवप्रियकरं महापातकनाशनम् ॥ १॥ इस नैमिष-तीर्थकी सृष्टि उन परमेष्ठी (ब्रह्मनिष्ठ)
verses.wordMeaning: O great sages, I shall expound to you the excellent incomprehensible secret formerly narrated by Brahma to Mahadeva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sages, I shall expound to you the excellent incomprehensible secret formerly narrated by Brahma to Mahadeva.

verses.sanskrit: दर्शनात् तस्य देवस्य सद्यः पापात् प्रमुच्यते । एतत् क्षेत्रं सुविपुलं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम्
verses.transliteration: darśanāt tasya devasya sadyaḥ pāpāt pramucyate / etat kṣetraṃ suvipulaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam
verses.translation: The means of salvation of men should be known.
verses.hindi: महादेवं दिदृक्षुणामृषीणां परमेष्ठिनाम्। ऋषियोंके लिये की है जो महादेवका दर्शन करनेकी ब्रह्मणा निर्मितं स्थानं तपस्तप्तुं द्विजोत्तमाः॥ २॥  इच्छासे तपस्या करना चाहते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: The means of salvation of men should be known.
verses.commentary: Sense: The means of salvation of men should be known.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र स्नात्वा दिवं यान्ति ये मृतास्ते ऽपुनर्भवाः । उपानहोस्तथा युग्मं देयमन्नं सकाञ्चनम् । भोजनं च यथाशक्ति तदस्याक्षयमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: tatra snātvā divaṃ yānti ye mṛtāste 'punarbhavāḥ / upānahostathā yugmaṃ deyamannaṃ sakāñcanam / bhojanaṃ ca yathāśakti tadasyākṣayamucyate
verses.translation: The great Purusa is not seen by Yoga alone. But Jnana (knowledge) by itself is the bestower of salvation.
verses.hindi: मरीचयोऽत्रयो विप्रा वसिष्ठाः क्रतवस्तथा। ब्राह्मणो! प्राचीन कालमें मरीचि, अत्रि, वसिष्ठ, भृगबोऽङ्विरसः पूर्वा ब्रह्माणं कमलोद्भवम्॥ ३॥  क्रतु भृगु तथा अंगिराके वंशमें उत्पन्न ऋषियोंने सभी
verses.wordMeaning: The great Purusa is not seen by Yoga alone. But Jnana (knowledge) by itself is the bestower of salvation.
verses.commentary: Sense: The great Purusa is not seen by Yoga alone. But Jnana (knowledge) by itself is the bestower of salvation.

verses.sanskrit: क्षरन्ति सर्वदानानि यज्ञदानं तपः क्रिया । अक्षयं तत् तपस्तप्तं भृगुतीर्थे युधिष्ठिर
verses.transliteration: kṣaranti sarvadānāni yajñadānaṃ tapaḥ kriyā / akṣayaṃ tat tapastaptaṃ bhṛgutīrthe yudhiṣṭhira
verses.translation: Eschewing the pure Saihkhya and depending solely on Yoga, ye all made your attempts for salvation.
verses.hindi: प्रकारका वर देनेवाले, कमलसे उत्पन्न चतुर्मूर्ति, चतुर्मुख,
verses.wordMeaning: Eschewing the pure Saihkhya and depending solely on Yoga, ye all made your attempts for salvation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Eschewing the pure Saihkhya and depending solely on Yoga, ye all made your attempts for salvation.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यैव तपसोग्रेण तुष्टेन त्रिपुरारिणा । सान्निध्यं तत्र कथितं भृगुतीर्थे युधिष्ठिर
verses.transliteration: tasyaiva tapasogreṇa tuṣṭena tripurāriṇā / sānnidhyaṃ tatra kathitaṃ bhṛgutīrthe yudhiṣṭhira
verses.translation: For this reason, O Brahmanas, I came here to this land to point out the delusion arising in those men who depend on Karman alone.
verses.hindi: समेत्य सर्ववरदं चतुर्मूर्ति चतुर्मुखम्। अच्युत, विश्वकर्मा ब्रह्माके पास जाकर प्रणामकर उनसे पृच्छन्ति प्रणिपत्यैनं विश्वकर्माणमच्युतम्॥ ४॥  पूछा-
verses.wordMeaning: For this reason, O Brahmanas, I came here to this land to point out the delusion arising in those men who depend on Karman alone.
verses.commentary: Sense: For this reason, O Brahmanas, I came here to this land to point out the delusion arising in those men who depend on Karman alone.

verses.sanskrit: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र गौतमेश्वरमुत्तमम् । यत्राराध्य त्रिशूलाङ्कं गौतमः सिद्धिमाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: tato gaccheta rājendra gautameśvaramuttamam / yatrārādhya triśūlāṅkaṃ gautamaḥ siddhimāpnuyāt
verses.translation: Hence, the perfect knowledge that is devoid of impurity and that is the means of salvation should be seen, heard and realised assiduously by you all.
verses.hindi: भगवन् देवमीशानं भर्गमेक॑ कपर्दिनम्। केनोपायेन पश्यामो ब्रूहि देवनमस्कृतम्
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, the perfect knowledge that is devoid of impurity and that is the means of salvation should be seen, heard and realised assiduously by you all.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, the perfect knowledge that is devoid of impurity and that is the means of salvation should be seen, heard and realised assiduously by you all.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र स्नात्वा नरो राजन् उपवासपरायणः । काञ्चनेन विमानेन ब्रह्मलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: tatra snātvā naro rājan upavāsaparāyaṇaḥ / kāñcanena vimānena brahmaloke mahīyate
verses.translation: The Atman is one and only one, omnipresent. It is of the nature of pure consciousness and bliss, free from impurity and eternal. This is indeed the Philosophy of the Saihkhyas.
verses.hindi: सिद्धचारणसंकीर्ण यक्षगन्धर्वसेवितम्। स्थानं भगवतः शम्भोरेतन्नैमिशमुत्तमम् अत्र देवाः सगन्धर्वाः सयक्षोरगराक्षसाः । तपस्तप्त्वा पुरा देवा लेभिरे प्रवरान् वरान्
verses.wordMeaning: The Atman is one and only one, omnipresent. It is of the nature of pure consciousness and bliss, free from impurity and eternal. This is indeed the Philosophy of the Saihkhyas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Atman is one and only one, omnipresent. It is of the nature of pure consciousness and bliss, free from impurity and eternal. This is indeed the Philosophy of the Saihkhyas.

verses.sanskrit: वृषोत्सर्गं ततो गच्छेच्छाश्वतं पदमाप्नुयात् । न जानन्ति नरा मूढा विष्णोर्मायाविमोहिताः
verses.transliteration: vṛṣotsargaṃ tato gacchecchāśvataṃ padamāpnuyāt / na jānanti narā mūḍhā viṣṇormāyāvimohitāḥ
verses.translation: This alone is the greatest knowledge. This is being sung about as Liberation. This is described as the pure Kaivalya and Brahmabhdva (the state of Brahman).
verses.hindi: सत्रेणाराध्य देवेशं दृष्टवन्तो महेश्वरम्
verses.wordMeaning: This alone is the greatest knowledge. This is being sung about as Liberation. This is described as the pure Kaivalya and Brahmabhdva (the state of Brahman).
verses.commentary: Sense: This alone is the greatest knowledge. This is being sung about as Liberation. This is described as the pure Kaivalya and Brahmabhdva (the state of Brahman).

verses.sanskrit: धौतपापं ततो गच्छेद् धौतं यत्र वृषेण तु । नर्मदायां स्थितं राजन् सर्वपातकनाशनम् । तत्र तीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा ब्रह्महत्यां व्यपोहति
verses.transliteration: dhautapāpaṃ tato gacched dhautaṃ yatra vṛṣeṇa tu / narmadāyāṃ sthitaṃ rājan sarvapātakanāśanam / tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati
verses.translation: Resorting to this greatest stand-point, the great- souled ascetics strictly adhering to it and holding on to it, see me the Visva (the universe), the Isvara.
verses.hindi: एकैकं पावयेत् पापं सप्तजन्मकृतं द्विजाः अत्र पूर्व स भगवानृषीणां सत्रमासताम्। प्रोवाच वायुर्ब्रह्माण्डं पुराणं ब्रह्मभाषितम्
verses.wordMeaning: Resorting to this greatest stand-point, the great- souled ascetics strictly adhering to it and holding on to it, see me the Visva (the universe), the Isvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Resorting to this greatest stand-point, the great- souled ascetics strictly adhering to it and holding on to it, see me the Visva (the universe), the Isvara.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तीर्थे तु राजेन्द्र प्राणत्यागं करोति यः । चतुर्भुजस्त्रिनेत्रश्च हरतुल्यबलो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: tatra tīrthe tu rājendra prāṇatyāgaṃ karoti yaḥ / caturbhujastrinetraśca haratulyabalo bhavet
verses.translation: This is that greatest knowledge, the absolute Sat (Reality) that is unsullied. I alone am the lord to be realised. This Siva is my form.
verses.hindi: अत्र देवो महादेवो रुद्राण्या किल विश्वकृत्। रमतेऽद्यापि भगवान् प्रमथैः परिवारितः
verses.wordMeaning: This is that greatest knowledge, the absolute Sat (Reality) that is unsullied. I alone am the lord to be realised. This Siva is my form.
verses.commentary: Sense: This is that greatest knowledge, the absolute Sat (Reality) that is unsullied. I alone am the lord to be realised. This Siva is my form.

verses.sanskrit: वसेत् कल्पायुतं साग्रं शिवतुल्यपराक्रमः । कालेन महता जातः पृथिव्यामेकराड् भवेत्
verses.transliteration: vaset kalpāyutaṃ sāgraṃ śivatulyaparākramaḥ / kālena mahatā jātaḥ pṛthivyāmekarāḍ bhavet
verses.translation: O leading Brahmanas, many means to Siddhi (realisation) have been mentioned; of them all, my perfect knowledge is the most superior.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मलोकं गमिष्यन्ति यत्र गत्वा न जायते षट्कुलोत्पन्न ऋषियोंने कहा-- भगवन्! यह बतलायें कि हम किस उपायसे देवताओंद्वारा नमस्कृत, अद्वितीय तेजस्वी कपर्दी ईशानदेवका दर्शन करें
verses.wordMeaning: O leading Brahmanas, many means to Siddhi (realisation) have been mentioned; of them all, my perfect knowledge is the most superior.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading Brahmanas, many means to Siddhi (realisation) have been mentioned; of them all, my perfect knowledge is the most superior.

verses.sanskrit: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र हंसतीर्थ मनुत्तमम् । तत्र स्नात्वा नरो राजन् ब्रह्मलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: tato gaccheta rājendra haṃsatīrtha manuttamam / tatra snātvā naro rājan brahmaloke mahīyate
verses.translation: Indeed the holy Pasupata vow has been formerly designed by me for the achievement of liberation. It is the gteatest of all secrets. It is the subtlest essence of the Vedas.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्माजी बोले आप लोग वाणी तथा मनके दोषोंसे रहित होकर हजार यज्ञविशेष-सत्र सम्पन्न करें। मैं वह देश आप लोगोंको बतलाता हूँ, जहाँ आप यज्ञ करेंगे। ऐसा कहकर उन (ब्रह्मा)-ने एक मनोमय
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed the holy Pasupata vow has been formerly designed by me for the achievement of liberation. It is the gteatest of all secrets. It is the subtlest essence of the Vedas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed the holy Pasupata vow has been formerly designed by me for the achievement of liberation. It is the gteatest of all secrets. It is the subtlest essence of the Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र सिद्धो यत्र जनार्दनः । वराहतीर्थ माख्यातं विष्णुलोकगतिप्रदम्
verses.transliteration: tato gaccheta rājendra siddho yatra janārdanaḥ / varāhatīrtha mākhyātaṃ viṣṇulokagatipradam
verses.translation: One who performs Pasupata vow, shall be quiescent; he must have perfect self-control; he should dust his body with sacred ashes; he should observe celibacy and remain naked.
verses.hindi: चक्रका निर्माण करके उन (ऋषियों)-से कहा- मेरे द्वारा छोड़े गये इस चक्रका आप लोग अनुगमन करें, विलम्ब न करें। श्रेष्ठ पुरुषो! जहाँ इस (चक्र)-की नेमि शीर्ण होगी (गिरकर टूटेगी) वही स्थान तपस्या एवं यज्ञ करनेका शुभ स्थान होगा
verses.wordMeaning: One who performs Pasupata vow, shall be quiescent; he must have perfect self-control; he should dust his body with sacred ashes; he should observe celibacy and remain naked.
verses.commentary: Sense: One who performs Pasupata vow, shall be quiescent; he must have perfect self-control; he should dust his body with sacred ashes; he should observe celibacy and remain naked.

verses.sanskrit: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र चन्द्रतीर्थमनुत्तमम् । पौर्णमास्यां विशेषेण स्नानं तत्र समाचरेत् । स्नातमात्रो नरस्तत्र चन्द्रलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: tato gaccheta rājendra candratīrthamanuttamam / paurṇamāsyāṃ viśeṣeṇa snānaṃ tatra samācaret / snātamātro narastatra candraloke mahīyate
verses.translation: Or he should wear a loin-cloth or a single garment; he should be silent and engaged in the study of Vedas. The scholar shall meditate on Siva as Pasupati.
verses.hindi: तब उन्होंने (ब्रह्माने) उस (मनोमय) चक्रको छोड़ा और वे ऋषि उस चक्रके पीछे-पीछे चलने लगे। शीघ्रतापूर्वक जा रहे उस चक्रकी नेमि जहाँ (शीर्ण हुई) गिरी, वह स्थान नैमिश नामसे प्रसिद्ध हुआ और पवित्र
verses.wordMeaning: Or he should wear a loin-cloth or a single garment; he should be silent and engaged in the study of Vedas. The scholar shall meditate on Siva as Pasupati.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or he should wear a loin-cloth or a single garment; he should be silent and engaged in the study of Vedas. The scholar shall meditate on Siva as Pasupati.

verses.sanskrit: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र कन्यातीर्थमनुत्तमम् । शुक्लपक्षे तृतीयायां स्नानं तत्र समाचरेत् । स्नातमात्रो नरस्तत्र पृथिव्यामेकराड् भवेत्
verses.transliteration: tato gaccheta rājendra kanyātīrthamanuttamam / śuklapakṣe tṛtīyāyāṃ snānaṃ tatra samācaret / snātamātro narastatra pṛthivyāmekarāḍ bhavet
verses.translation: Sruti states that this Pasupata Yoga should be resort¬ ed to by the seekers of liberation; that those who maintain Pasupata rite should be free from desire.
verses.hindi: तथा सर्वत्र पूजित हुआ। सिद्धों तथा चारणोंसे परिपूर्ण, यक्षों-गन्धर्वोसे सेवित यह उत्तम नैमिश नामक स्थान भगवान् शम्भुका स्थान है। प्राचीन कालमें यहाँपर तपस्या करके देवताओं, गन्धर्वो, यक्षों, नागों और राक्षसोंने श्रेष्ठ वरोंको प्राप्त किया था॥८--१०॥
verses.wordMeaning: Sruti states that this Pasupata Yoga should be resort¬ ed to by the seekers of liberation; that those who maintain Pasupata rite should be free from desire.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sruti states that this Pasupata Yoga should be resort¬ ed to by the seekers of liberation; that those who maintain Pasupata rite should be free from desire.

verses.sanskrit: देवतीर्थ ततो गच्छेत् सर्वदेवनमकृतम् । तत्र स्नात्वा च राजेन्द्र दैवतैः सह मोदते
verses.transliteration: devatīrtha tato gacchet sarvadevanamakṛtam / tatra snātvā ca rājendra daivataiḥ saha modate
verses.translation: Freed from passion, fear and anger, filled with me, taking refuge in me, purified by penance in the fire of spiritual knowledge, many have entered my Being.
verses.hindi: इन) छः कुलोंके ऋषियोंने इस देशमें रहते हुए एकाग्रतापूर्वक यज्ञानुष्ठानद्वारा देवेशकी आराधना कर महेश्वरका दर्शन किया था। द्विजो! यहाँ किया गया दान, तप, खान तथा जप आदि कोई भी शुभ कर्म
verses.wordMeaning: Freed from passion, fear and anger, filled with me, taking refuge in me, purified by penance in the fire of spiritual knowledge, many have entered my Being.
verses.commentary: Sense: Freed from passion, fear and anger, filled with me, taking refuge in me, purified by penance in the fire of spiritual knowledge, many have entered my Being.

verses.sanskrit: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र शिखितीर्थमनुत्तमम् । यत् तत्र दीयते दानं सर्वं कोटिगुणं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: tato gaccheta rājendra śikhitīrthamanuttamam / yat tatra dīyate dānaṃ sarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet
verses.translation: There are other scriptures opposed to the Vedic view. They have been propounded by me alone and they are very fascinating in this world.
verses.hindi: अकेला ही सात जन्मोंमें किये पापको नष्ट कर उसे पवित्र बना देता है। प्राचीन कालमें इसी तीर्थमें भगवान् वायुने यज्ञ करनेवाले ऋषियोंको ब्रह्माजीद्वारा कहे गये ब्रह्माण्डपुराणको सुनाया था। आज भी यहाँ विश्वकी सृष्टि करनेवाले भगवान् महादेव प्रमथगणोंसे घिरे रहकर रुद्राणीके साथ रमण करते हैं। (अपनी अन्तिम अवस्थामें) नियमपूर्वक यहाँ निवासकर प्राणोंका परित्याग करनेवाले द्विजाति लोग उस
verses.wordMeaning: There are other scriptures opposed to the Vedic view. They have been propounded by me alone and they are very fascinating in this world.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are other scriptures opposed to the Vedic view. They have been propounded by me alone and they are very fascinating in this world.

verses.sanskrit: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र तीर्थं पैतामहं शुभम् । यत्तत्र क्रियते श्राद्धं सर्वं तदक्षयं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: tato gaccheta rājendra tīrthaṃ paitāmahaṃ śubham / yattatra kriyate śrāddhaṃ sarvaṃ tadakṣayaṃ bhavet
verses.translation: Those cults are—Varna, Pasupata, the Soma cult, the Lakura (Lakula) and the Bhairava and such other cults which are opposed to Veda should not be resorted to.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मलोकमें जाते हैं, जहाँ जाकर पुनः जन्म नहीं
verses.wordMeaning: Those cults are—Varna, Pasupata, the Soma cult, the Lakura (Lakula) and the Bhairava and such other cults which are opposed to Veda should not be resorted to.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those cults are—Varna, Pasupata, the Soma cult, the Lakura (Lakula) and the Bhairava and such other cults which are opposed to Veda should not be resorted to.

verses.sanskrit: सावित्रीतीर्थमासाद्य यस्तु प्राणान् परित्यजेत् । विधूय सर्वपापानि ब्रह्मलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: sāvitrītīrthamāsādya yastu prāṇān parityajet / vidhūya sarvapāpāni brahmaloke mahīyate
verses.translation: O Brahmanas, I am the embodiment of Vedas. My form cannot be understood by those who know the meanings of other scriptures. Except the eternal lord* no one knows it.
verses.hindi: प्रीतस्तस्य महादेवो देव्या सह पिनाकधृक् । ददावात्मसमानत्वं मृत्युवञ्जचनमेव च अभूदूषिः स धर्मात्मा शिलादो नाम धर्मवित्। आराधयन्महादेवं पुत्रार्थं वृषभध्वजम्
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas, I am the embodiment of Vedas. My form cannot be understood by those who know the meanings of other scriptures. Except the eternal lord* no one knows it.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas, I am the embodiment of Vedas. My form cannot be understood by those who know the meanings of other scriptures. Except the eternal lord* no one knows it.

verses.sanskrit: मनोहरं तु तत्रैव तीर्थं परमशोभनम् । तत्र स्नात्वा नरो राजन् दैवतैः सह मोदते
verses.transliteration: manoharaṃ tu tatraiva tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam / tatra snātvā naro rājan daivataiḥ saha modate
verses.translation: Ye all establish this path; worship Mahesvara. There is no doubt in this that ere long the perfect knowledge will dawn.
verses.hindi: तथास्त्वित्याह भगवान् देव्या सह महेश्वरः । पश्यतस्तस्य विप्रर्षरन्तर्धानं गतो हरः
verses.wordMeaning: Ye all establish this path; worship Mahesvara. There is no doubt in this that ere long the perfect knowledge will dawn.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ye all establish this path; worship Mahesvara. There is no doubt in this that ere long the perfect knowledge will dawn.

verses.sanskrit: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र मानसं तीर्थमुत्तमम् । स्नात्वा तत्र नरो राजन् रुद्रलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: tato gaccheta rājendra mānasaṃ tīrthamuttamam / snātvā tatra naro rājan rudraloke mahīyate
verses.translation: O excellent ones, may ye have extensive and deep devotion unto me; O excellent sages, I shall grant you my presence, the moment I am meditated upon.
verses.hindi: ततो यियक्षुः स्वां भूमिं शिलादो धर्मवित्तमः । चकर्ष लाङ्गलेनोर्वी भित्त्वादूश्यत शोभन: संवर्तकानलप्रख्यः कुमारः प्रहसन्निव। रूपलावण्यसम्पन्नस्तेजसा भासयन् दिशः
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent ones, may ye have extensive and deep devotion unto me; O excellent sages, I shall grant you my presence, the moment I am meditated upon.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent ones, may ye have extensive and deep devotion unto me; O excellent sages, I shall grant you my presence, the moment I am meditated upon.

verses.sanskrit: स्वर्गबिन्दुं ततो गच्छेत्तीर्थं देवनमस्कृतम् । तत्र स्नात्वा नरो राजन् दुर्गतिं नैव गच्छति
verses.transliteration: svargabinduṃ tato gacchettīrthaṃ devanamaskṛtam / tatra snātvā naro rājan durgatiṃ naiva gacchati
verses.translation: Having said this, the lord vanished there itself along with Uma. The sages remained in Daruvana and continued the worship of Sankara.
verses.hindi: मुनिभ्यो दर्शयामास ये तदाश्रमवासिनः
verses.wordMeaning: Having said this, the lord vanished there itself along with Uma. The sages remained in Daruvana and continued the worship of Sankara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Having said this, the lord vanished there itself along with Uma. The sages remained in Daruvana and continued the worship of Sankara.

verses.sanskrit: अप्सरेशं ततो गच्छेत् स्नानं तत्र समाचरेत् । क्रीडते नाकलोकस्थो ह्यप्सरोभिः स मोदते
verses.transliteration: apsareśaṃ tato gacchet snānaṃ tatra samācaret / krīḍate nākalokastho hyapsarobhiḥ sa modate
verses.translation: She resembled a crore suns. She was engulfed in a cluster of flames. With her pure brilliance, she filled the whole firmament.
verses.hindi: जातकर्मादिकाः सर्वाः क्रियास्तस्य चकार ह। उपनीय यथाशास्त्रं वेदमध्यापयत् सुतम् अधीतवेदो भगवान् नन्दी मतिमनुत्तमाम्। चक्रे महेश्वरं द्रष्टुं जेष्ये मृत्युमिति प्रभुम्
verses.wordMeaning: She resembled a crore suns. She was engulfed in a cluster of flames. With her pure brilliance, she filled the whole firmament.
verses.commentary: Sense: She resembled a crore suns. She was engulfed in a cluster of flames. With her pure brilliance, she filled the whole firmament.

verses.sanskrit: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र भारभूतिमनुत्तमम् । उपोषितोर्ऽचयेदीशं रुद्रलोके महीयते । अस्मिंस्तीर्थे मृतो राजन् गाणपत्यमवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: tato gaccheta rājendra bhārabhūtimanuttamam / upoṣitor'cayedīśaṃ rudraloke mahīyate / asmiṃstīrthe mṛto rājan gāṇapatyamavāpnuyāt
verses.translation: They sought and saw the incomprehensible daughter of the mountain, encircled in the halo of a thousand flames. They bowed to this lady, the wife of the lord of all. They knew her as the seed of the Supreme.
verses.hindi: स गत्वा सरितं पुण्यामेकाग्रश्रद्धयान्वितः। जजाप रुद्रमनिशं महेशासक्तमानसः
verses.wordMeaning: They sought and saw the incomprehensible daughter of the mountain, encircled in the halo of a thousand flames. They bowed to this lady, the wife of the lord of all. They knew her as the seed of the Supreme.
verses.commentary: Sense: They sought and saw the incomprehensible daughter of the mountain, encircled in the halo of a thousand flames. They bowed to this lady, the wife of the lord of all. They knew her as the seed of the Supreme.

verses.sanskrit: कार्तिके मासि देवेशमर्चयेत् पार्वतीपतिम् । अश्वमेधाद् दशगुणं प्रवदन्ति मनीषिणः
verses.transliteration: kārtike māsi deveśamarcayet pārvatīpatim / aśvamedhād daśaguṇaṃ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ
verses.translation: "This is the spouse of our Supreme Lord. She is our abode (goal) and soul. Her (other) name is Firmament; see¬ ing in her their own selves and the entire universe, the sages were overjoyed.
verses.hindi: तस्य कोट्यां तु पूर्णायां शंकरो भक्तवत्सलः । आगत्य साम्बः सगणो वरदोऽस्मीत्युवाच ह ति कूर्मपुराण जर
verses.wordMeaning: "This is the spouse of our Supreme Lord. She is our abode (goal) and soul. Her (other) name is Firmament; see¬ ing in her their own selves and the entire universe, the sages were overjoyed.
verses.commentary: Sense: "This is the spouse of our Supreme Lord. She is our abode (goal) and soul. Her (other) name is Firmament; see¬ ing in her their own selves and the entire universe, the sages were overjoyed.

verses.sanskrit: वृषभं यः प्रयच्छेत तत्र कुन्देन्दुसप्रभम् । वृषयुक्तेन यानेन रुद्रलोकं स गच्छति
verses.transliteration: vṛṣabhaṃ yaḥ prayaccheta tatra kundendusaprabham / vṛṣayuktena yānena rudralokaṃ sa gacchati
verses.translation: They were seen by the wife of the great lords. In the meanwhile, they saw the lord, the cause of everything, Sambhu, the wise sage Rudra, the lord, the ancient Purusa.
verses.hindi: एक दूसरा तीर्थोमें श्रेष्ठ तीर्थ है, जो जाप्येश्वर नामसे प्रसिद्ध है। जहाँ महान् गण नन्दीने निरन्तर रुद्रका जप किया था और पिनाक धारण करनेवाले रुद्र-महादेव देवीके साथ उनपर प्रसन्न हुए और उन्होंने उन्हे
verses.wordMeaning: They were seen by the wife of the great lords. In the meanwhile, they saw the lord, the cause of everything, Sambhu, the wise sage Rudra, the lord, the ancient Purusa.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were seen by the wife of the great lords. In the meanwhile, they saw the lord, the cause of everything, Sambhu, the wise sage Rudra, the lord, the ancient Purusa.

verses.sanskrit: एतत् तीर्थं समासाद्य यस्तु प्राणान् परित्यजेत् । सर्वपापविशुद्धात्मा रुद्रलोकं स गच्छति
verses.transliteration: etat tīrthaṃ samāsādya yastu prāṇān parityajet / sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā rudralokaṃ sa gacchati
verses.translation: On observing the goddess and the lord Isa they bowed down and attained the greatest bliss. Thanks to the favour of the lord, the perfect knowledge, the cause of the destruction of subsequent births, dawned in them.
verses.hindi: (नन्दीको) अपनी समानता तथा मृत्युसे बचनेका वर प्रदान किया था (इन नन्दीके प्रादुर्भावकी कथा इस प्रकार है-) शिलाद नामके एक धर्मज्ञ धर्मात्मा ऋषि हुए, उन्होंने पुत्रप्रािके लिये वृषभध्वज महादेवकी आराधना को। तप करते हुए उन्होंने जब हजार वर्षका समय व्यतीत
verses.wordMeaning: On observing the goddess and the lord Isa they bowed down and attained the greatest bliss. Thanks to the favour of the lord, the perfect knowledge, the cause of the destruction of subsequent births, dawned in them.
verses.commentary: Sense: On observing the goddess and the lord Isa they bowed down and attained the greatest bliss. Thanks to the favour of the lord, the perfect knowledge, the cause of the destruction of subsequent births, dawned in them.

verses.sanskrit: जलप्रवेशं यः कुर्यात् तस्मिंस्तीर्थे नराधिप । हंसयुक्तेन यानेन स्वर्गलोकं स गच्छति
verses.transliteration: jalapraveśaṃ yaḥ kuryāt tasmiṃstīrthe narādhipa / haṃsayuktena yānena svargalokaṃ sa gacchati
verses.translation: This potency of Lord Siva is the only source of the
verses.hindi: कर दिया, तब गणोंसे आवृत विश्वकर्ता सोम शर्वने “मैं वर दूँगा' इस प्रकार कहा। उन्होंने (शिलाद ऋषिने) वरेण्य गिरिजापति ईशानसे वर माँगा कि मुझे आप मृत्युसे रहित अपने ही समान अयोनिज पुत्र प्रदान करें । देवीके
verses.wordMeaning: This potency of Lord Siva is the only source of the
verses.commentary: Sense: This potency of Lord Siva is the only source of the

verses.sanskrit: एरण्ड्या नर्मदायास्तु संगमं लोकविश्रुतम् । तत्र तीर्थं महापुण्यं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम्
verses.transliteration: eraṇḍyā narmadāyāstu saṃgamaṃ lokaviśrutam / tatra tīrthaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam
verses.translation: The great Paramesthin, Mahesvara who is beyond everything, the sole Siva, Rudra, the lord of Devas created the universe in her after mounting over the Maya that is existing in the great Sakti. (?)
verses.hindi: साथ भगवान् महेश्वरने-- ऐसा ही हो' कहा और उन विप्रर्षिके देखते-देखते वे अन्तर्धान हो गये तदनन्तर धर्मज्ञ शिलादने अपनी भूमिमें यज्ञ करनेकी इच्छासे हलद्वारा पृथ्वीको जोता। पृथ्वीका भेदन करनेपर उन्होंने संवर्तक नामक अग्निके समान, रूप तथा लावण्यसे सम्पन्न और अपने तेजसे दिशाओंको प्रकाशित
verses.wordMeaning: The great Paramesthin, Mahesvara who is beyond everything, the sole Siva, Rudra, the lord of Devas created the universe in her after mounting over the Maya that is existing in the great Sakti. (?)
verses.commentary: Sense: The great Paramesthin, Mahesvara who is beyond everything, the sole Siva, Rudra, the lord of Devas created the universe in her after mounting over the Maya that is existing in the great Sakti. (?)

verses.sanskrit: उपवासपरो भूत्वा नित्यं व्रतपरायणः । तत्र स्नात्वा तु राजेन्द्र मुच्यते ब्रह्महत्यया
verses.transliteration: upavāsaparo bhūtvā nityaṃ vrataparāyaṇaḥ / tatra snātvā tu rājendra mucyate brahmahatyayā
verses.translation: The Lord is one. He is hidden in all living beings. Rudra, the wielder of Maya, is entire and undivided. He and the goddess are not different or separate. On realising this, people attain immortality.
verses.hindi: करते हुए, हँसते हुए एक सुन्दर कुमारको देखा। कुमार (कार्तिकेय)-के समान उन अतुलनीय नन्दी (नामक कुमार)-ने मेघ-सदृश गम्भीर वाणीमें शिलादको बार- बार 'तात' 'तात' इस प्रकारसे कहा। आविर्भूत हुए
verses.wordMeaning: The Lord is one. He is hidden in all living beings. Rudra, the wielder of Maya, is entire and undivided. He and the goddess are not different or separate. On realising this, people attain immortality.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Lord is one. He is hidden in all living beings. Rudra, the wielder of Maya, is entire and undivided. He and the goddess are not different or separate. On realising this, people attain immortality.

verses.sanskrit: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र नर्मदोदधिसंगमम् । जमदग्निरिति ख्यातः सिद्धो यत्र जनार्दनः
verses.transliteration: tato gaccheta rājendra narmadodadhisaṃgamam / jamadagniriti khyātaḥ siddho yatra janārdanaḥ
verses.translation: The Lord is one. He is hidden in all living beings. Rudra, the wielder of Maya, is entire and undivided. He and the goddess are not different or separate. On realising this, people attain immortality.
verses.hindi: उस पुत्रको देखकर शिलादने उसका आलिंगन किया और उस आश्रममें रहनेवाले जो मुनि थे, उन्हें भी उसे दिखाया अनन्तर उन्होंने (शिलाद ऋषिने) उन नन्दीके जातकर्म आदि सभी संस्कार किये और शस्त्रविधिसे उपनयन- संस्कार कर वेद पढ़ाया। वेदका अध्ययन कर भगवान् नन्दीने यह श्रेष्ठ विचार किया कि प्रभु महेश्वरका दर्शन
verses.wordMeaning: The Lord is one. He is hidden in all living beings. Rudra, the wielder of Maya, is entire and undivided. He and the goddess are not different or separate. On realising this, people attain immortality.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Lord is one. He is hidden in all living beings. Rudra, the wielder of Maya, is entire and undivided. He and the goddess are not different or separate. On realising this, people attain immortality.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र स्नात्वा नरो राजन् नर्मदोदधिसंगमे । त्रिगुणं चाश्वमेधस्य फलं प्राप्नोति मानवः
verses.transliteration: tatra snātvā naro rājan narmadodadhisaṃgame / triguṇaṃ cāśvamedhasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ
verses.translation: The Lord is one. He is hidden in all living beings. Rudra, the wielder of Maya, is entire and undivided. He and the goddess are not different or separate. On realising this, people attain immortality.
verses.hindi: कर मैं मृत्युको जीतूँगा। उन्होंने पवित्र नदीके तटपर जाकर एकाग्र तथा श्रद्धायुक्त होकर महेश्वरमें अपने मनको आसक्तकर निरन्तर रुद्रका जप करना प्रारम्भ कर दिया। उनके द्वारा एक करोड़ जपकी संख्या पूर्ण होनेपर
verses.wordMeaning: The Lord is one. He is hidden in all living beings. Rudra, the wielder of Maya, is entire and undivided. He and the goddess are not different or separate. On realising this, people attain immortality.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Lord is one. He is hidden in all living beings. Rudra, the wielder of Maya, is entire and undivided. He and the goddess are not different or separate. On realising this, people attain immortality.

verses.sanskrit: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र पिङ्गलेश्वरमुत्तमम् । तत्र स्नात्वा नरो राजन् रुद्रलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: tato gaccheta rājendra piṅgaleśvaramuttamam / tatra snātvā naro rājan rudraloke mahīyate
verses.translation: The Lord is one. He is hidden in all living beings. Rudra, the wielder of Maya, is entire and undivided. He and the goddess are not different or separate. On realising this, people attain immortality.
verses.hindi: भक्तवत्सल शंकरने अपने गणों तथा पार्वतीके साथ वहाँ आकर “मैं वर दूंगा' इस प्रकार कहा स वब्रे पुनरेवाहं जपेयं कोटिमीश्वरम्। तावदायुर्महादेब देहीति वरमीश्वर
verses.wordMeaning: The Lord is one. He is hidden in all living beings. Rudra, the wielder of Maya, is entire and undivided. He and the goddess are not different or separate. On realising this, people attain immortality.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Lord is one. He is hidden in all living beings. Rudra, the wielder of Maya, is entire and undivided. He and the goddess are not different or separate. On realising this, people attain immortality.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रोपवासं यः कृत्वा पश्येत विमलेश्वरम् । सप्तजन्मकृतं पापं हित्वा याति शिवालयम्
verses.transliteration: tatropavāsaṃ yaḥ kṛtvā paśyeta vimaleśvaram / saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ hitvā yāti śivālayam
verses.translation: The Lord is one. He is hidden in all living beings. Rudra, the wielder of Maya, is entire and undivided. He and the goddess are not different or separate. On realising this, people attain immortality.
verses.hindi: एवमस्त्विति सम्प्रोच्य देवोऽप्यन्तरधीयत। जजाप कोटिं भगवान् भूयस्तद्गतमानसः
verses.wordMeaning: The Lord is one. He is hidden in all living beings. Rudra, the wielder of Maya, is entire and undivided. He and the goddess are not different or separate. On realising this, people attain immortality.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Lord is one. He is hidden in all living beings. Rudra, the wielder of Maya, is entire and undivided. He and the goddess are not different or separate. On realising this, people attain immortality.

verses.sanskrit: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र आलिकातीर्थमुत्तमम् । उपोष्य रजनीमेकां नियतो नियताशनः । अस्य तीर्थस्य माहात्म्यान्मुच्यते ब्रह्महत्यया
verses.transliteration: tato gaccheta rājendra ālikātīrthamuttamam / upoṣya rajanīmekāṃ niyato niyatāśanaḥ / asya tīrthasya māhātmyānmucyate brahmahatyayā
verses.translation: The Lord is one. He is hidden in all living beings. Rudra, the wielder of Maya, is entire and undivided. He and the goddess are not different or separate. On realising this, people attain immortality.
verses.hindi: द्वितीयायां च कोट्यां वै सम्पूर्णायां वृषध्वजः । आगत्य वरदोऽस्मीति प्राह भूतगणैर्वृतः तृतीयां जप्तुमिच्छामि कोटिं भूयोऽपि शंकर। तथास्त्वित्याह विश्वात्मा देवोऽप्यन्तरधीयत
verses.wordMeaning: The Lord is one. He is hidden in all living beings. Rudra, the wielder of Maya, is entire and undivided. He and the goddess are not different or separate. On realising this, people attain immortality.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Lord is one. He is hidden in all living beings. Rudra, the wielder of Maya, is entire and undivided. He and the goddess are not different or separate. On realising this, people attain immortality.

verses.sanskrit: एतानि तव संक्षेपात् प्राधान्यात् कथितानि तु । न शक्या विस्तराद् वक्तुं संख्या तीर्थेषुपाण्डव
verses.transliteration: etāni tava saṃkṣepāt prādhānyāt kathitāni tu / na śakyā vistarād vaktuṃ saṃkhyā tīrtheṣupāṇḍava
verses.translation: The Lord is one. He is hidden in all living beings. Rudra, the wielder of Maya, is entire and undivided. He and the goddess are not different or separate. On realising this, people attain immortality.
verses.hindi: कोटित्रयेऽथ सम्पूर्णे देवः प्रीतमना भृशम्। आगत्य वरदोऽस्मीति प्राह भूतगणैर्वृतः
verses.wordMeaning: The Lord is one. He is hidden in all living beings. Rudra, the wielder of Maya, is entire and undivided. He and the goddess are not different or separate. On realising this, people attain immortality.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Lord is one. He is hidden in all living beings. Rudra, the wielder of Maya, is entire and undivided. He and the goddess are not different or separate. On realising this, people attain immortality.

verses.sanskrit: एषा पवित्रा विमला नदी त्रैलोक्यविश्रुता । नर्मदा सरितां श्रेष्ठा महादेवस्य वल्लभा
verses.transliteration: eṣā pavitrā vimalā nadī trailokyaviśrutā / narmadā saritāṃ śreṣṭhā mahādevasya vallabhā
verses.translation: The Lord is one. He is hidden in all living beings. Rudra, the wielder of Maya, is entire and undivided. He and the goddess are not different or separate. On realising this, people attain immortality.
verses.hindi: जपेयं कोटिमन्यां वै भूयोऽपि तव तेजसा। इत्युक्ते भगवानाह न जप्तव्यं त्वया पुनः महागणपतिर्देव्याः पुत्रो भव महेश्वर:
verses.wordMeaning: The Lord is one. He is hidden in all living beings. Rudra, the wielder of Maya, is entire and undivided. He and the goddess are not different or separate. On realising this, people attain immortality.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Lord is one. He is hidden in all living beings. Rudra, the wielder of Maya, is entire and undivided. He and the goddess are not different or separate. On realising this, people attain immortality.

verses.sanskrit: मनसा संस्मरेद्यस्तु नर्मदां वै युधिष्ठिर । चान्द्रायणशतं साग्रं लभते नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: manasā saṃsmaredyastu narmadāṃ vai yudhiṣṭhira / cāndrāyaṇaśataṃ sāgraṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ
