verses.translation: The Lord is one. He is hidden in all living beings. Rudra, the wielder of Maya, is entire and undivided. He and the goddess are not different or separate. On realising this, people attain immortality.
verses.hindi: सर्वलोकाधिपः श्रीमान् सर्वज्ञो मदबलान्वितः
verses.wordMeaning: The Lord is one. He is hidden in all living beings. Rudra, the wielder of Maya, is entire and undivided. He and the goddess are not different or separate. On realising this, people attain immortality.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Lord is one. He is hidden in all living beings. Rudra, the wielder of Maya, is entire and undivided. He and the goddess are not different or separate. On realising this, people attain immortality.

verses.sanskrit: अश्रद्दधानाः पुरुषा नास्तिक्यं घोरमाश्रिताः । पतन्ति नरके घोरे इत्याह परमेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: aśraddadhānāḥ puruṣā nāstikyaṃ ghoramāśritāḥ / patanti narake ghore ityāha parameśvaraḥ
verses.translation: The Lord is one. He is hidden in all living beings. Rudra, the wielder of Maya, is entire and undivided. He and the goddess are not different or separate. On realising this, people attain immortality.
verses.hindi: एतदुक्त्वा महादेवो गणानाहूय शंकरः। अभिषेकेण युक्तेन नन्दीशवरमयोजयत् एतज्जप्येश्वरं स्थानं देवदेवस्य शूलिनः। यत्र तत्र मृतो मर्त्यो रुद्रलोके महीयते
verses.wordMeaning: The Lord is one. He is hidden in all living beings. Rudra, the wielder of Maya, is entire and undivided. He and the goddess are not different or separate. On realising this, people attain immortality.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Lord is one. He is hidden in all living beings. Rudra, the wielder of Maya, is entire and undivided. He and the goddess are not different or separate. On realising this, people attain immortality.

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदां सेवते नित्यं स्वयं देवो महेश्वरः । तेन पुण्या नदी ज्ञेया ब्रह्महत्यापहारिणी
verses.transliteration: narmadāṃ sevate nityaṃ svayaṃ devo maheśvaraḥ / tena puṇyā nadī jñeyā brahmahatyāpahāriṇī
verses.translation: The Lord is one. He is hidden in all living beings. Rudra, the wielder of Maya, is entire and undivided. He and the goddess are not different or separate. On realising this, people attain immortality.
verses.hindi: नन्दीने वर माँगते हुए कहा--ईश्वर ! मैं पुनः ईश्वरका एक करोड़ जप करना चाहता हूँ, अत: महादेव! आप मुझे उतनी ही लम्बी आयु प्रदान करें। “ऐसा ही हो' यह कहकर वे देव अन्तर्धान हो गये। भगवान् नन्दीने
verses.wordMeaning: The Lord is one. He is hidden in all living beings. Rudra, the wielder of Maya, is entire and undivided. He and the goddess are not different or separate. On realising this, people attain immortality.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Lord is one. He is hidden in all living beings. Rudra, the wielder of Maya, is entire and undivided. He and the goddess are not different or separate. On realising this, people attain immortality.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे चत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः सूत उवाच इदं त्रैलोक्यविख्यातं तीर्थं नैमिशमुत्तमम् । महादेवप्रियकरं महापातकनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge catvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca idaṃ trailokyavikhyātaṃ tīrthaṃ naimiśamuttamam / mahādevapriyakaraṃ mahāpātakanāśanam
verses.translation: Lord Mahesa then vanished. The over-lord of the Devas vanished alongwith the goddess. The dwellers of the forest propitiated again Rudra, the primordial lord.
verses.hindi: पुन: उनमें मन लगाते हुए एक करोड़ जप किया। दो करोड़ जप पूरा होनेपर पुन: भूतगणोंसे आवृत वृषध्वज (शंकर)-ने आकर “मैं वर प्रदान करूँगा' ऐसा कहा। (तब नन्दीने कहा--) प्रभु शंकर! मैं पुनः तीसरी बार एक करोड़ जप करना चाहता हूँ। “ऐसा ही हो” कहकर विश्वात्मा देव पुनः अन्तर्धान हो गये। तीन करोड़ जप पूरा होनेपर भूतगणोंसे आवृत, अत्यन्त प्रसन्न-मन, देव (शंकर)-ने वहाँ आकर कहा--' मैं वर
verses.wordMeaning: Lord Mahesa then vanished. The over-lord of the Devas vanished alongwith the goddess. The dwellers of the forest propitiated again Rudra, the primordial lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Mahesa then vanished. The over-lord of the Devas vanished alongwith the goddess. The dwellers of the forest propitiated again Rudra, the primordial lord.

verses.sanskrit: महादेवं दिदृक्षूणामृषीणणां परमेष्ठिनाम् । ब्रहामणा निर्मितं स्थानं तपस्तप्तुं द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: mahādevaṃ didṛkṣūṇāmṛṣīṇaṇāṃ parameṣṭhinām / brahāmaṇā nirmitaṃ sthānaṃ tapastaptuṃ dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: Thus the story of all the former exploits of the lord
verses.hindi: प्रदान करूँगा।' (इसपर नन्दीने कहा--) मैं पुनः आपके तेजसे सम्पन्न होकर करोड़की संख्यामें जप करना चाहता हूँ। ऐसा कहे जानेपर भगवानूने कहा--अब तुम्हें आगे जप नहीं करना है॥ ३०--३५॥
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the story of all the former exploits of the lord
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the story of all the former exploits of the lord

verses.sanskrit: मरीचयो ऽत्रयो विप्रा वसिष्ठाः क्रतवस्तथा । भृगवो ऽङ्गिरसः पूर्वा ब्रह्माणं कमलोद्भवम्
verses.transliteration: marīcayo 'trayo viprā vasiṣṭhāḥ kratavastathā / bhṛgavo 'ṅgirasaḥ pūrvā brahmāṇaṃ kamalodbhavam
verses.translation: He who reads or listens to this everyday, is liberated from all sins. He who recounts this to quiescent Brahmanas, attains the greatest goal.
verses.hindi: तुम जरासे (वृद्धावस्थासे) मुक्त और अमर होकर सदा मेरे समीपमें स्थित रहोगे। तुम देवी (पार्वती)- के पुत्र, महागणपति (मेरे गणके अधिपति) एवं महेश्वर होओगे! तुम योगीश्वर, योगनेता, गणोंके ईश्वरोंके भी ईश्वर, सभी लोकोंके अधिपति, श्रीमान् सर्वज्ञ और मेरे बलसे सम्पन्न रहोगे। मेरा दिव्य ज्ञान तुम्हें हस्तामलकवत् प्राप्त रहेगा। तुम महाप्रलयपर्यन्त (गणेश्वर एवं नन्दीके रूपमें) स्थित रहोगे और उसके बाद मेरे पदको प्राप्त
verses.wordMeaning: He who reads or listens to this everyday, is liberated from all sins. He who recounts this to quiescent Brahmanas, attains the greatest goal.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who reads or listens to this everyday, is liberated from all sins. He who recounts this to quiescent Brahmanas, attains the greatest goal.

verses.sanskrit: समेत्य सर्ववरदं चतुर्मूर्ति चतुर्मुखम् । पृच्छन्ति प्रणिपत्यैनं विश्वकर्माणमच्युतम्
verses.transliteration: sametya sarvavaradaṃ caturmūrti caturmukham / pṛcchanti praṇipatyainaṃ viśvakarmāṇamacyutam
verses.translation: VV. 67-84 describe the importance of Suklatirtha—on the north bank of Narmada about 10 miles north-east of Broach.
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 67-84 describe the importance of Suklatirtha—on the north bank of Narmada about 10 miles north-east of Broach.
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 67-84 describe the importance of Suklatirtha—on the north bank of Narmada about 10 miles north-east of Broach.

verses.sanskrit: षट्कुलीया ऊचुः भगवन् देवमीशानं भर्गमेकं कपर्दिनम् । केनोपायेन पश्यामो ब्रूहि देवनमस्कृतम्
verses.transliteration: ṣaṭkulīyā ūcuḥ bhagavan devamīśānaṃ bhargamekaṃ kapardinam / kenopāyena paśyāmo brūhi devanamaskṛtam
verses.translation: The excellent river Narmada has been eulogised by the sages. It flowed out of the body of Rudra with a desire for the well-being of the worlds.
verses.hindi: ऐसा कहकर महादेव शंकरने गणोंको बुलाकर उन नन्दीश्वरको गणोंके अधिपतिके पदपर अत्यन्त उपयुक्त अभिषेक-विधिसे नियुक्त कर दिया। पिनाक धारण करनेवाले शंकरने स्वयं ही मरुद्गणोंकी शुभ कन्या जो 'सुयशा' इस नामसे विख्यात थी, उसके साथ इनका विवाह कर दिया
verses.wordMeaning: The excellent river Narmada has been eulogised by the sages. It flowed out of the body of Rudra with a desire for the well-being of the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: The excellent river Narmada has been eulogised by the sages. It flowed out of the body of Rudra with a desire for the well-being of the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मोवाच सत्रं सहस्रमासध्वं वाङ्मनोदोषवर्जिताः । देशं च वः प्रवक्ष्यामि यस्मिन् देशे चरिष्यथ
verses.transliteration: brahmovāca satraṃ sahasramāsadhvaṃ vāṅmanodoṣavarjitāḥ / deśaṃ ca vaḥ pravakṣyāmi yasmin deśe cariṣyatha
verses.translation: It is destructive of all sins for ever. It is bowed to by all Devas and is eulogised by Devas and Gandharvas as well as by Apsaras (heavenly ladies).
verses.hindi: यह जप्येश्वर नामक स्थान देवाधिदेव शूली शंकरका स्थान है। यहाँ जहाँ कहीं भी शरीर त्याग करनेवाला रुद्रलोकमें प्रतिष्ठा प्रात करता है
verses.wordMeaning: It is destructive of all sins for ever. It is bowed to by all Devas and is eulogised by Devas and Gandharvas as well as by Apsaras (heavenly ladies).
verses.commentary: Sense: It is destructive of all sins for ever. It is bowed to by all Devas and is eulogised by Devas and Gandharvas as well as by Apsaras (heavenly ladies).

verses.sanskrit: उक्त्वा मनोमयं चक्रं स सृष्ट्वा तानुवाच ह । क्षिप्तमेतन्मया चक्रमनुव्रजत मा चिरम् । यत्रास्य नेमिः शीर्येत स देशः पुरुषर्षभाः
verses.transliteration: uktvā manomayaṃ cakraṃ sa sṛṣṭvā tānuvāca ha / kṣiptametanmayā cakramanuvrajata mā ciram / yatrāsya nemiḥ śīryeta sa deśaḥ puruṣarṣabhāḥ
verses.translation: On the northern bank is the Tirtha well-known in the three worlds, by the name Bhadresvara. It is holy, auspicious and destructive of all sins.
verses.hindi: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्रगं संहितायामुपरिविभागे एकचत्यारिशोऽध्यायः विविध शैव-तीर्थोंके माहात्म्यका निरूपण, तीर्थोके अधिकारी तथा तीर्थ-माहात्म्यका उपसंहार
verses.wordMeaning: On the northern bank is the Tirtha well-known in the three worlds, by the name Bhadresvara. It is holy, auspicious and destructive of all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the northern bank is the Tirtha well-known in the three worlds, by the name Bhadresvara. It is holy, auspicious and destructive of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: ततो मुमोच तच्चक्रं ते च तत्समनुव्रजन् । तस्य वै व्रजतः क्षिप्रं यत्र नेमिरशीर्यत । नैमिसं तत्स्मृतं नाम्ना पुण्यं सर्वत्र पूजितम्
verses.transliteration: tato mumoca taccakraṃ te ca tatsamanuvrajan / tasya vai vrajataḥ kṣipraṃ yatra nemiraśīryata / naimisaṃ tatsmṛtaṃ nāmnā puṇyaṃ sarvatra pūjitam
verses.translation: O king, man taking bath there, rejoices with Devas. O leading king, thereafter one should go to the excellent sacred place Vimalesvara.
verses.hindi: नाम्रा पञ्चनदं पुण्यं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम्
verses.wordMeaning: O king, man taking bath there, rejoices with Devas. O leading king, thereafter one should go to the excellent sacred place Vimalesvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, man taking bath there, rejoices with Devas. O leading king, thereafter one should go to the excellent sacred place Vimalesvara.

verses.sanskrit: सिद्धचारणसंकीर्णं यक्षगन्धर्वसेवितम् । स्थानं भगवतः शंभोरेतन्नैमिशमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: siddhacāraṇasaṃkīrṇaṃ yakṣagandharvasevitam / sthānaṃ bhagavataḥ śaṃbhoretannaimiśamuttamam
verses.translation: Thereafter, he should go to Rsitirtha which is des¬ tructive of all sins of men. As soon as a man takes his bath therein, the man is honoured in Sivaloka.
verses.hindi: सर्वपापविशुद्धात्मा रुद्रलोके महीयते अन्यच्च तीर्थप्रवरं शंकरस्यामितौजसः। महाभेरवमित्युक्तं महापातकनाशनम्
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, he should go to Rsitirtha which is des¬ tructive of all sins of men. As soon as a man takes his bath therein, the man is honoured in Sivaloka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, he should go to Rsitirtha which is des¬ tructive of all sins of men. As soon as a man takes his bath therein, the man is honoured in Sivaloka.

verses.sanskrit: अत्र देवाः सगन्धर्वाः सयक्षोरगराक्षसाः । तपस्तप्त्वा पुरा देवा लेभिरे प्रवरान् वरान्
verses.transliteration: atra devāḥ sagandharvāḥ sayakṣoragarākṣasāḥ / tapastaptvā purā devā lebhire pravarān varān
verses.translation: There itself is the holy centre of Narada. It is very auspicious. Immediately after the bath therein, a man obtains the fruit of a gift of a thousand cows.
verses.hindi: सर्वपापहरा पुण्या स्वयमेव गिरीन्द्रजा
verses.wordMeaning: There itself is the holy centre of Narada. It is very auspicious. Immediately after the bath therein, a man obtains the fruit of a gift of a thousand cows.
verses.commentary: Sense: There itself is the holy centre of Narada. It is very auspicious. Immediately after the bath therein, a man obtains the fruit of a gift of a thousand cows.

verses.sanskrit: इमं देशं समाश्रित्य षट्कुलीयाः समाहिताः । सत्रेणाराध्य देवेशं दृष्टवन्तो महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: imaṃ deśaṃ samāśritya ṣaṭkulīyāḥ samāhitāḥ / satreṇārādhya deveśaṃ dṛṣṭavanto maheśvaram
verses.translation: It was here that formerly the divine sage Narada per¬ formed penance. Mahesvara, the lord of Devas, became delighted and granted him Yoga.
verses.hindi: यत्र देवादिदेवेन चक्रार्थ पूजितो भवः मृतस्तत्रापि नियमाद् ब्रह्मलोके महीयते॥ कायावरोहणं नाम महादेवालयं शुभम्। यत्र माहेश्वरा धर्मा मुनिभिः सम्प्रवर्तिताः ७ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: It was here that formerly the divine sage Narada per¬ formed penance. Mahesvara, the lord of Devas, became delighted and granted him Yoga.
verses.commentary: Sense: It was here that formerly the divine sage Narada per¬ formed penance. Mahesvara, the lord of Devas, became delighted and granted him Yoga.

verses.sanskrit: अत्र दानं तपस्तप्तं स्नानं जप्यादिकं च यत् । एकैकं पावयेत् पापं सप्तजन्मकृतं द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: atra dānaṃ tapastaptaṃ snānaṃ japyādikaṃ ca yat / ekaikaṃ pāvayet pāpaṃ saptajanmakṛtaṃ dvijāḥ
verses.translation: A Lihga installed by Brahma is known as Brahmes- vara. O king, a man who takes his holy bath there is honoured in the Brahmaloka.
verses.hindi: परित्यजति यः प्राणान् रुद्रलोक स गच्छति
verses.wordMeaning: A Lihga installed by Brahma is known as Brahmes- vara. O king, a man who takes his holy bath there is honoured in the Brahmaloka.
verses.commentary: Sense: A Lihga installed by Brahma is known as Brahmes- vara. O king, a man who takes his holy bath there is honoured in the Brahmaloka.

verses.sanskrit: अत्र पूर्वं स भगवानृषीणां सत्रमासताम् । प्रोवाच वायुर्ब्रह्माण्डं पुराणं ब्रह्मभाषितम्
verses.transliteration: atra pūrvaṃ sa bhagavānṛṣīṇāṃ satramāsatām / provāca vāyurbrahmāṇḍaṃ purāṇaṃ brahmabhāṣitam
verses.translation: Thereafter, one should go to Rnatirtha (by visiting which) the man shall certainly be relieved from indebtedness. Thereafter, one should go to Vatesvara. He shall derive sufficient benefit of the current life.
verses.hindi: तत्र गत्वा त्यजेत् प्राणाल्लोकान् प्राप्नोति शाश्वतान् जामदग्न्यस्य तु शुभं रामस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः। तत्र स्नात्वा तीर्थवरे गोसहस्त्रफलं लभेत्
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, one should go to Rnatirtha (by visiting which) the man shall certainly be relieved from indebtedness. Thereafter, one should go to Vatesvara. He shall derive sufficient benefit of the current life.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, one should go to Rnatirtha (by visiting which) the man shall certainly be relieved from indebtedness. Thereafter, one should go to Vatesvara. He shall derive sufficient benefit of the current life.

verses.sanskrit: अत्र देवो महादेवो रुद्राण्या किल विश्वकृत् । रमते ऽध्यापि भगवान् प्रमथैः परिवारितः
verses.transliteration: atra devo mahādevo rudrāṇyā kila viśvakṛt / ramate 'dhyāpi bhagavān pramathaiḥ parivāritaḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, one should go to Bhimesvara. It is des¬ tructive of all ailments. Immediately after the bath there, a man is relieved of all miseries.
verses.hindi: महाकालमिति ख्यातं तीर्थ त्रैलोक्यविश्रुतम्। गत्वा प्राणान् परित्यज्य गाणपत्यमवाप्नुयात्
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, one should go to Bhimesvara. It is des¬ tructive of all ailments. Immediately after the bath there, a man is relieved of all miseries.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, one should go to Bhimesvara. It is des¬ tructive of all ailments. Immediately after the bath there, a man is relieved of all miseries.

verses.sanskrit: अत्र प्राणान् परित्यज्य नियमेन द्विजातयः । ब्रह्मलोकं गमिष्यन्ति यत्र गत्वा न जायते
verses.transliteration: atra prāṇān parityajya niyamena dvijātayaḥ / brahmalokaṃ gamiṣyanti yatra gatvā na jāyate
verses.translation: O leading king, thereafter one should go to the ex¬ cellent Pihgalesvara. By observing fast for a day and night, one shall attain the benefit ofTriratra sacrifice.
verses.hindi: तत्र संनिहितः श्रीमान् भगवान् नकुलीश्वरः सूतजीने कहा--जप्येश्वरके समीपमें ही पञ्चनद नामका एक दूसरा श्रेष्ठ तीर्थ है, जो पवित्र तथा सभी पापोंका नाश करनेवाला है। वहाँ तीन रात्रिपर्यन्त उपवासकर महेश्वरकी पूजा करनेसे मनुष्य सभी पापोंसे
verses.wordMeaning: O leading king, thereafter one should go to the ex¬ cellent Pihgalesvara. By observing fast for a day and night, one shall attain the benefit ofTriratra sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading king, thereafter one should go to the ex¬ cellent Pihgalesvara. By observing fast for a day and night, one shall attain the benefit ofTriratra sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: अन्यच्च तीर्थप्रवरं जाप्येश्वरमितिश्रुतम् । जजाप रुद्रमनिशं यत्र नन्दी महागणः
verses.transliteration: anyacca tīrthapravaraṃ jāpyeśvaramitiśrutam / jajāpa rudramaniśaṃ yatra nandī mahāgaṇaḥ
verses.translation: Formerly, the great river Narmada had become afraid of Vyasa. On being rebuked by Hurhkara (i.e. the sound Hurh) (by Vyasa), the river receded from that place immediately (v.l. dakfinena (flowed) to the South).
verses.hindi: मुक्त हो जाता है तथा विशुद्ध आत्मावाला होकर रुद्रलोकमें प्रतिष्ठित होता है। अमित तेजस्वी शंकरका एक दूसरा श्रेष्ठ तीर्थ है जो महाभैरव नामसे कहा गया है, वह महापातकोंका नाश करनेवाला है । वितस्ता
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly, the great river Narmada had become afraid of Vyasa. On being rebuked by Hurhkara (i.e. the sound Hurh) (by Vyasa), the river receded from that place immediately (v.l. dakfinena (flowed) to the South).
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, the great river Narmada had become afraid of Vyasa. On being rebuked by Hurhkara (i.e. the sound Hurh) (by Vyasa), the river receded from that place immediately (v.l. dakfinena (flowed) to the South).

verses.sanskrit: प्रीतस्तस्य महादेवो देव्या सह पिनाकधृक् । ददावात्मसमानत्वं मृत्युवञ्चनमेव च
verses.transliteration: prītastasya mahādevo devyā saha pinākadhṛk / dadāvātmasamānatvaṃ mṛtyuvañcanameva ca
verses.translation: O Yudhisthira, if a devotee circumambulates that place, Vyasa becomes delighted and he obtains the benefit desired.
verses.hindi: नामक श्रेष्ठ नदी तीर्थोमें परम तीर्थ है, वह सभी पापोंको हरनेवाली, पवित्र और साक्षात् पार्वतीरूप ही है अमित तेजस्वी शम्भुका पञ्चतप नामका एक तीर्थ है, जहाँ देवोंके आदिदेव (विष्णु)-ने चक्र-प्रापिके लिये शंकरकी पूजा की थी। वहाँ (पञ्चनद तीर्थमें) किया गया पिण्डदान आदि कर्म परलोकमें अनन्त फल
verses.wordMeaning: O Yudhisthira, if a devotee circumambulates that place, Vyasa becomes delighted and he obtains the benefit desired.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Yudhisthira, if a devotee circumambulates that place, Vyasa becomes delighted and he obtains the benefit desired.

verses.sanskrit: अभूदृषिः स धर्मात्मा शिलादो नाम धर्मवित् । आराधयन्महादेवं पुत्रार्थं वृषभध्वजम्
verses.transliteration: abhūdṛṣiḥ sa dharmātmā śilādo nāma dharmavit / ārādhayanmahādevaṃ putrārthaṃ vṛṣabhadhvajam
verses.translation: Approaching the Saridvara (the excellent river) (?) one should go to the well-known Tirtha of Indra. Immediately after taking bath there, one attains the benefit of the gift of a thousand cows.
verses.hindi: प्रदान करनेवाला होता है। वहाँ संकल्पपूर्वक नियमसे निवास करते हुए यथासमय प्राण-त्याग करनेवाला ब्रह्मलोकमें महिमा प्राप्त करता है
verses.wordMeaning: Approaching the Saridvara (the excellent river) (?) one should go to the well-known Tirtha of Indra. Immediately after taking bath there, one attains the benefit of the gift of a thousand cows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Approaching the Saridvara (the excellent river) (?) one should go to the well-known Tirtha of Indra. Immediately after taking bath there, one attains the benefit of the gift of a thousand cows.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य वर्षसहस्रान्ते तप्यमानस्य विश्वकृत् । शर्वः सोमो गणवृतो वरदो ऽस्मीत्यभाषत
verses.transliteration: tasya varṣasahasrānte tapyamānasya viśvakṛt / śarvaḥ somo gaṇavṛto varado 'smītyabhāṣata
verses.translation: Thereafter one should go to Somatirtha and per¬ form the rite of ablution there. Immediately after the bath therein, the man is freed from all sins.
verses.hindi: कायावरोहण नामक महादेवका एक शुभ स्थान (तीर्थ) है, जहाँ मुनियोंने माहेश्वर धर्मोका प्रवर्तन किया था। वहाँ किया गया श्राद्ध , दान, तप, होम तथा उपवास अक्षय (फल प्रदान करनेवाला) होता है। वहाँ जो प्राण परित्याग करता है, वह रुद्रलोकमें जाता है। एक दूसरा श्रेष्ठ तीर्थ है, जो कन्यातीर्थ इस नामसे विख्यात है। वहाँ जाकर प्राणोंका परित्याग करनेसे शाश्वत लोकोंकी प्राप्ति होती है। जमदग्निके
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter one should go to Somatirtha and per¬ form the rite of ablution there. Immediately after the bath therein, the man is freed from all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter one should go to Somatirtha and per¬ form the rite of ablution there. Immediately after the bath therein, the man is freed from all sins.

verses.sanskrit: स वव्रे वरमीशानं वरेण्यं गिरिजापतिम् । अयोनिजं मृत्युहीनं देहि पुत्रं त्वया समम्
verses.transliteration: sa vavre varamīśānaṃ vareṇyaṃ girijāpatim / ayonijaṃ mṛtyuhīnaṃ dehi putraṃ tvayā samam
verses.translation: During the lunar eclipse, it is destructive of sins. O king, the Somatirtha is well known in the three worlds and it yields great benefits.
verses.hindi: पुत्र अक्लिष्टकर्मा परशुरामका भी एक शुभ तीर्थ है। उस तीर्थ-श्रेष्ठमें स्नान करनेसे हजार गोदानका फल प्राप्त होता है। महाकाल इस नामसे विख्यात तीर्थ तीनों लोकोंमें प्रसिद्ध है। वहाँ जाकर प्राणोंका परित्याग
verses.wordMeaning: During the lunar eclipse, it is destructive of sins. O king, the Somatirtha is well known in the three worlds and it yields great benefits.
verses.commentary: Sense: During the lunar eclipse, it is destructive of sins. O king, the Somatirtha is well known in the three worlds and it yields great benefits.

verses.sanskrit: तथास्त्वित्याह भगवान् देव्या सह महेश्वरः । पश्यतस्तस्य विप्रर्षेरन्तर्धानं गतो हरः
verses.transliteration: tathāstvityāha bhagavān devyā saha maheśvaraḥ / paśyatastasya viprarṣerantardhānaṃ gato haraḥ
verses.translation: He v.'ho observes the vow of Candrayana with great concentration in that holy centre, shall have his soul purified of all sins. He shall go to the Somaloka.
verses.hindi: करनेसे गाणपत्य-पद प्राप्त होता है। श्रेष्ठ नकुलीश्वर तीर्थ गुह्यस्थानोंमें भी अत्यन्त गुह्य है। वहाँ श्रीमान् भगवान् नकुलीशवर विराजमान रहते हैं॥७--१२॥ देव्या सह महादेवो नित्यं शिष्यैश्च संवृतः
verses.wordMeaning: He v.'ho observes the vow of Candrayana with great concentration in that holy centre, shall have his soul purified of all sins. He shall go to the Somaloka.
verses.commentary: Sense: He v.'ho observes the vow of Candrayana with great concentration in that holy centre, shall have his soul purified of all sins. He shall go to the Somaloka.

verses.sanskrit: ततो यियक्षुः स्वां भूमिं शिलादो धर्मवित्तमः । चकर्ष लाङ्गलेनोर्व्ॐ भित्त्वादृश्यत शोभनः
verses.transliteration: tato yiyakṣuḥ svāṃ bhūmiṃ śilādo dharmavittamaḥ / cakarṣa lāṅgalenorvoṃ bhittvādṛśyata śobhanaḥ
verses.translation: O ruler of men, he who immolates himself by entering fire at this holy centre; he who drowns himself in the water thereof or he who observes fast unto death there, is never reborn as a mortal being.
verses.hindi: तत्र स्नात्वा महादेवं पूजयित्वा वृषध्वजम्। सर्वपापैर्विमुच्येत मृतस्तज्ज्ञानमाप्नुयात्
verses.wordMeaning: O ruler of men, he who immolates himself by entering fire at this holy centre; he who drowns himself in the water thereof or he who observes fast unto death there, is never reborn as a mortal being.
verses.commentary: Sense: O ruler of men, he who immolates himself by entering fire at this holy centre; he who drowns himself in the water thereof or he who observes fast unto death there, is never reborn as a mortal being.

verses.sanskrit: संवर्तकानलप्रख्यः कुमारः प्रहसन्निव । रूपलावण्यसंपन्नस्तेजसा भासयन् दिशः
verses.transliteration: saṃvartakānalaprakhyaḥ kumāraḥ prahasanniva / rūpalāvaṇyasaṃpannastejasā bhāsayan diśaḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, one should go to Stambhatirtha and perform the rite of ablution there. Immediately af ter the bath there, the man is honoured in the Somaloka.
verses.hindi: अन्यच्च देवदेवस्य स्थानं पुण्यतमं शुभम् । भीमेश्वरमिति ख्यातं गत्वा मुञ्चति पातकम् तथान्यच्चण्डवेगायाः सम्भेदः पापनाशनः । तत्र स्नात्वा च पीत्वा च मुच्यते ब्रह्महत्यया
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, one should go to Stambhatirtha and perform the rite of ablution there. Immediately af ter the bath there, the man is honoured in the Somaloka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, one should go to Stambhatirtha and perform the rite of ablution there. Immediately af ter the bath there, the man is honoured in the Somaloka.

verses.sanskrit: कुमारतुल्यो ऽप्रतिमो मेघगम्भीरया गिरा । शिलादं तात तातेति प्राह नन्दी पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: kumāratulyo 'pratimo meghagambhīrayā girā / śilādaṃ tāta tāteti prāha nandī punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: O king, thereafter one should go to the excellent Visnutirtha. That excellent abode of Visnu is called (Yodhi-) Yodhanipura.
verses.hindi: नाम्ना वाराणसी दिव्या कोटिकोट्ययुताधिका
verses.wordMeaning: O king, thereafter one should go to the excellent Visnutirtha. That excellent abode of Visnu is called (Yodhi-) Yodhanipura.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, thereafter one should go to the excellent Visnutirtha. That excellent abode of Visnu is called (Yodhi-) Yodhanipura.

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा नन्दनं जातं शिलादः परिषस्वजे । मुनिभ्यो दर्शयामास ये तदाश्रमवासिनः
verses.transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvā nandanaṃ jātaṃ śilādaḥ pariṣasvaje / munibhyo darśayāmāsa ye tadāśramavāsinaḥ
verses.translation: In the middle of the water there is a rock in the form of an elephant. One should offer Pindas therein, with great concentration (on any day) during the month of Vaisakha.
verses.hindi: एते प्राधान्यतः प्रोक्ता देशाः पापहरा नृणाम्। गत्वा संक्षालयेत् पापं जन्मान्तरशतैः कृतम् यः स्वधर्मान् परित्यज्य तीर्थसेवां करोति हि। न तस्य फलते तीर्थमिह लोके परत्र च
verses.wordMeaning: In the middle of the water there is a rock in the form of an elephant. One should offer Pindas therein, with great concentration (on any day) during the month of Vaisakha.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the middle of the water there is a rock in the form of an elephant. One should offer Pindas therein, with great concentration (on any day) during the month of Vaisakha.

verses.sanskrit: जातकर्मादिकाः सर्वाः क्रियास्तस्य चकार ह । उपनीय यथाशास्त्रं वेदमध्यापयत् सुतम्
verses.transliteration: jātakarmādikāḥ sarvāḥ kriyāstasya cakāra ha / upanīya yathāśāstraṃ vedamadhyāpayat sutam
verses.translation: After taking bath, viith concentrated mind and being devoid of arrogance and jealonsy (if the above rite is
verses.hindi: प्रायश्चित्ती च विधुरस्तथा पापचरो गृही। प्रकुर्यात् तीर्थसंसेवां ये चान्ये तादूशा जना:
verses.wordMeaning: After taking bath, viith concentrated mind and being devoid of arrogance and jealonsy (if the above rite is
verses.commentary: Sense: After taking bath, viith concentrated mind and being devoid of arrogance and jealonsy (if the above rite is

verses.sanskrit: अधीतवेदो भगवान् नन्दी मतिमनुत्तमाम् । चक्रे महेश्वरं द्रष्टुं जेष्ये मृत्युमिति प्रभुम्
verses.transliteration: adhītavedo bhagavān nandī matimanuttamām / cakre maheśvaraṃ draṣṭuṃ jeṣye mṛtyumiti prabhum
verses.translation: Thereafter, one should go to the Tirtha called Visvesvara and perform the rite of ablution there. Immediately after the bath there, the man shall obtain the chieftainship of the Ganas (attandants of Siva).
verses.hindi: सहाग्निर्वा सपत्नीको गच्छेत् तीर्थानि यलतः । सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो यथोक्तां गतिमाप्नुयात् ऋणानि त्रीण्यपाकृत्य कुर्याद् वा तीर्थसेवनम्। विधाय वृत्तिं पुत्राणां भार्या तेषु निधाय च
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, one should go to the Tirtha called Visvesvara and perform the rite of ablution there. Immediately after the bath there, the man shall obtain the chieftainship of the Ganas (attandants of Siva).
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, one should go to the Tirtha called Visvesvara and perform the rite of ablution there. Immediately after the bath there, the man shall obtain the chieftainship of the Ganas (attandants of Siva).

verses.sanskrit: स गत्वा सरितं पुण्यामेकाग्रश्रद्धयान्वितः । जजाप रुद्रमनिशं महेशासक्तमानसः
verses.transliteration: sa gatvā saritaṃ puṇyāmekāgraśraddhayānvitaḥ / jajāpa rudramaniśaṃ maheśāsaktamānasaḥ
verses.translation: O leading king, thereafter one should go where Janardana (Visnu) is (in the form of a) Liiiga. A man who takes bath there devotedly is honoured in the Visnuloka.
verses.hindi: हिमालयके रमणीय शिखरपर स्थित अत्यन्त सुन्दर गङ्गाद्वारमें शिष्योंसे घिरे हुए महादेव देवीके साथ नित्य निवास करते हैं। वहाँ स्नानकर वृषध्वज महादेवको पूजा करनेसे सभी पापोंसे मुक्ति हो
verses.wordMeaning: O leading king, thereafter one should go where Janardana (Visnu) is (in the form of a) Liiiga. A man who takes bath there devotedly is honoured in the Visnuloka.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading king, thereafter one should go where Janardana (Visnu) is (in the form of a) Liiiga. A man who takes bath there devotedly is honoured in the Visnuloka.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य कोट्यां तु पूर्णायां शङ्करो भक्तवत्सलः । आगत्य साम्बः सगणो वरदो ऽस्मीत्युवाच ह
verses.transliteration: tasya koṭyāṃ tu pūrṇāyāṃ śaṅkaro bhaktavatsalaḥ / āgatya sāmbaḥ sagaṇo varado 'smītyuvāca ha
verses.translation: It is here that Narayana manifested himself to the sages of sanctified souls, in the form of a Linga which is the highest abode.
verses.hindi: जाती है और मृत्युके बाद परम ज्ञान प्रास होता है देवाधिदेव (शंकर)-का एक दूसरा शुभ तथा पवित्रतम स्थान है जो भीमेश्वर इस नामसे विख्यात है। वहाँ जानेसे व्यक्ति पापसे मुक्त हो जाता है। इसी प्रकार चण्डवेगा नदीका उद्गम-स्थान भी
verses.wordMeaning: It is here that Narayana manifested himself to the sages of sanctified souls, in the form of a Linga which is the highest abode.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is here that Narayana manifested himself to the sages of sanctified souls, in the form of a Linga which is the highest abode.

verses.sanskrit: स वव्रे पुनरेवाहं जपेयं कोटिमीश्वरम् । तावदायुर्महादेव देहीति वरमीश्वर
verses.transliteration: sa vavre punarevāhaṃ japeyaṃ koṭimīśvaram / tāvadāyurmahādeva dehīti varamīśvara
verses.translation: O leading king, thereafter, one should go to the excellent Tirtha Tapasesvara. O leading king, on taking bath therein, one shall attain the benefit of penance.
verses.hindi: पापोंका नाश करनेवाला है। वहाँ स्नान करने तथा जलका पान करनेसे मनुष्य ब्रह्महत्यासे मुक्त हो जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: O leading king, thereafter, one should go to the excellent Tirtha Tapasesvara. O leading king, on taking bath therein, one shall attain the benefit of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading king, thereafter, one should go to the excellent Tirtha Tapasesvara. O leading king, on taking bath therein, one shall attain the benefit of penance.

verses.sanskrit: एवमस्त्विति संप्रोच्य देवो ऽप्यन्तरधीयत । जजाप कोटिं भगवान् भूयस्तद्गतमानसः
verses.transliteration: evamastviti saṃprocya devo 'pyantaradhīyata / jajāpa koṭiṃ bhagavān bhūyastadgatamānasaḥ
verses.translation: O leading king, thereafter, one should go to the excellent Tirtha Tapasesvara. O leading king, on taking bath therein, one shall attain the benefit of penance.
verses.hindi: इन सभी तीर्थोमें भी श्रेष्ठ तथा दिव्य वाराणसी नामकी पुरी हजारों कोटिगुना अधिक फलप्रदा है। पूर्वमें मैंने आप लोगोंसे उसके माहात्म्यका वर्णन किया था। योगीको भी (वाराणसीके अतिरिक्त) अन्यत्र एक जन्ममें मुक्ति नहीं मिलती
verses.wordMeaning: O leading king, thereafter, one should go to the excellent Tirtha Tapasesvara. O leading king, on taking bath therein, one shall attain the benefit of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading king, thereafter, one should go to the excellent Tirtha Tapasesvara. O leading king, on taking bath therein, one shall attain the benefit of penance.

verses.sanskrit: द्वितीयायां च कोट्यां वै संपूर्णायां वृषध्वजः । आगत्य वरदो ऽस्मीति प्राह भूतगणैर्वृतः
verses.transliteration: dvitīyāyāṃ ca koṭyāṃ vai saṃpūrṇāyāṃ vṛṣadhvajaḥ / āgatya varado 'smīti prāha bhūtagaṇairvṛtaḥ
verses.translation: O leading king, thereafter, one should go to the excellent Tirtha Tapasesvara. O leading king, on taking bath therein, one shall attain the benefit of penance.
verses.hindi: मनुष्योंके पापोंको हरनेवाले ये प्रधान-प्रधान देश (तीर्थ) बतलाये गये हैं। यहाँ जाकर सैकड़ों जन्मोंमें किये पापोंका प्रक्षालन करना चाहिए। जो अपने धर्मोका परित्यागकर तीर्थोका सेवन करता है,
verses.wordMeaning: O leading king, thereafter, one should go to the excellent Tirtha Tapasesvara. O leading king, on taking bath therein, one shall attain the benefit of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading king, thereafter, one should go to the excellent Tirtha Tapasesvara. O leading king, on taking bath therein, one shall attain the benefit of penance.

verses.sanskrit: तृतीयां जप्तुमिच्छामि कोटिं भूयो ऽपि शङ्कर । तथास्त्वित्याह विश्वात्मा देवो ऽप्यन्तरधीयत
verses.transliteration: tṛtīyāṃ japtumicchāmi koṭiṃ bhūyo 'pi śaṅkara / tathāstvityāha viśvātmā devo 'pyantaradhīyata
verses.translation: O leading king, thereafter, one should go to the excellent Tirtha Tapasesvara. O leading king, on taking bath therein, one shall attain the benefit of penance.
verses.hindi: उसके लिये तीर्थ न इस लोकमें फलदायी होते हैं न परलोकमें प्रायश्चित्ती, पत्नीसे रहित विधुर पुरुष तथा जिनके द्वारा पाप हो गया है ऐसे गृहस्थ एवं इसी प्रकारके जो अन्य लोग हैं, उन्हें (पश्चात्तापपूर्वक यथाशास्त्र) तीर्थोका सेवन करना चाहिए। प्रयत्नपूर्वक अग्नि"
verses.wordMeaning: O leading king, thereafter, one should go to the excellent Tirtha Tapasesvara. O leading king, on taking bath therein, one shall attain the benefit of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading king, thereafter, one should go to the excellent Tirtha Tapasesvara. O leading king, on taking bath therein, one shall attain the benefit of penance.

verses.sanskrit: कोटित्रये ऽथ संपूर्णे देवः प्रीतमना भृशम् । आगत्य वरदो ऽस्मीति प्राह भूतगणैर्वृतः
verses.transliteration: koṭitraye 'tha saṃpūrṇe devaḥ prītamanā bhṛśam / āgatya varado 'smīti prāha bhūtagaṇairvṛtaḥ
verses.translation: O leading king, thereafter, one should go to the excellent Tirtha Tapasesvara. O leading king, on taking bath therein, one shall attain the benefit of penance.
verses.hindi: अथवा पत्नीके साथ तीथाँमें जाना चाहिए। ऐसा करनेसे मनुष्य समस्त पापोंसे मुक्त होकर यथोक्त गति (उत्तम गति) प्राप्त करता है। अथवा तीनों ऋणोंसे मुक्त होनेके बाद पुत्रोंके लिये जीविका-सम्बन्धी वृत्तिकी
verses.wordMeaning: O leading king, thereafter, one should go to the excellent Tirtha Tapasesvara. O leading king, on taking bath therein, one shall attain the benefit of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading king, thereafter, one should go to the excellent Tirtha Tapasesvara. O leading king, on taking bath therein, one shall attain the benefit of penance.

verses.sanskrit: जपेयं कोटिमन्यां वै भूयो ऽपि तव तेजसा । इत्युक्ते भगवानाह न जप्तव्यं त्वया पुनः
verses.transliteration: japeyaṃ koṭimanyāṃ vai bhūyo 'pi tava tejasā / ityukte bhagavānāha na japtavyaṃ tvayā punaḥ
verses.translation: O leading king, thereafter, one should go to the excellent Tirtha Tapasesvara. O leading king, on taking bath therein, one shall attain the benefit of penance.
verses.hindi: व्यवस्थाकर और अपनी पत्नीको उन्हें सौंपकर तीर्थका सेवन करना चाहिए  अग्निहोत्री वानप्रस्थ-आश्रम स्वीकारकर अपनी अग्नि तथा धर्मपत्नीके साथ तीर्थमें निवास करता है!
verses.wordMeaning: O leading king, thereafter, one should go to the excellent Tirtha Tapasesvara. O leading king, on taking bath therein, one shall attain the benefit of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading king, thereafter, one should go to the excellent Tirtha Tapasesvara. O leading king, on taking bath therein, one shall attain the benefit of penance.

verses.sanskrit: अमरो जरया त्यक्तो मम पार्श्वगतः सदा । महागणपतिर्देव्याः पुत्रो भव महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: amaro jarayā tyakto mama pārśvagataḥ sadā / mahāgaṇapatirdevyāḥ putro bhava maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: O leading king, thereafter, one should go to the excellent Tirtha Tapasesvara. O leading king, on taking bath therein, one shall attain the benefit of penance.
verses.hindi: ४८०  कूर्मपुराण
verses.wordMeaning: O leading king, thereafter, one should go to the excellent Tirtha Tapasesvara. O leading king, on taking bath therein, one shall attain the benefit of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading king, thereafter, one should go to the excellent Tirtha Tapasesvara. O leading king, on taking bath therein, one shall attain the benefit of penance.

verses.sanskrit: योगीश्वरो योगनेता गणानामीश्वरेश्वरः । सर्वलोकाधिपः श्रीमान् सर्वज्ञो मद्बलान्वितः
verses.transliteration: yogīśvaro yoganetā gaṇānāmīśvareśvaraḥ / sarvalokādhipaḥ śrīmān sarvajño madbalānvitaḥ
verses.translation: O leading king, thereafter, one should go to the excellent Tirtha Tapasesvara. O leading king, on taking bath therein, one shall attain the benefit of penance.
verses.hindi: प्रायश्चित्तप्रसड़ेन तीर्थमाहात्म्यमीरितम्। प्रायश्चित्तके प्रसंगवश तीर्थोके माहात्म्यका वर्णन यः पठेच्छृणुयाद वापि मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः ॥ २४ ॥  किया गया। इसे पढ़नेवाला अथवा सुननेवाला भी सभी पातकोंसे मुक्त हो जाता है इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे पट्साहर्त्रधां संहितायामुपरिविभागे द्विचत्वारिशोउध्याय:
verses.wordMeaning: O leading king, thereafter, one should go to the excellent Tirtha Tapasesvara. O leading king, on taking bath therein, one shall attain the benefit of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading king, thereafter, one should go to the excellent Tirtha Tapasesvara. O leading king, on taking bath therein, one shall attain the benefit of penance.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानं तन्मामकं दिव्यं हस्तामलकवत् तव । आभूतसंप्लवस्थायी ततो यास्यसि मत्पदम्
verses.transliteration: jñānaṃ tanmāmakaṃ divyaṃ hastāmalakavat tava / ābhūtasaṃplavasthāyī tato yāsyasi matpadam
verses.translation: O leading king, thereafter, one should go to the excellent Tirtha Tapasesvara. O leading king, on taking bath therein, one shall attain the benefit of penance.
verses.hindi: चतुर्विध प्रलयका प्रतिपादन, नेमित्तिक प्रलयका विशेष वर्णन, विष्णुद्वारा अपने माहात्म्यका निरूपण
verses.wordMeaning: O leading king, thereafter, one should go to the excellent Tirtha Tapasesvara. O leading king, on taking bath therein, one shall attain the benefit of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading king, thereafter, one should go to the excellent Tirtha Tapasesvara. O leading king, on taking bath therein, one shall attain the benefit of penance.

verses.sanskrit: एतदुक्त्वा महादेवो गणानाहूय शङ्करः । अभिषेकेण युक्तेन नन्दीश्वरमयोजयत्
verses.transliteration: etaduktvā mahādevo gaṇānāhūya śaṅkaraḥ / abhiṣekeṇa yuktena nandīśvaramayojayat
verses.translation: O leading king, thereafter, one should go to the excellent Tirtha Tapasesvara. O leading king, on taking bath therein, one shall attain the benefit of penance.
verses.hindi: एतदाकर्ण्य विज्ञानं नारायणमुखेरितम्। कूर्मरूपधरं देवं पप्रच्छुर्मुनयः प्रभुम् कथिता भवता धर्मा मोक्षज्ञानं सविस्तरम्। लोकानां सर्गविस्तारं बंशमन्वन्तराणि च
verses.wordMeaning: O leading king, thereafter, one should go to the excellent Tirtha Tapasesvara. O leading king, on taking bath therein, one shall attain the benefit of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading king, thereafter, one should go to the excellent Tirtha Tapasesvara. O leading king, on taking bath therein, one shall attain the benefit of penance.

verses.sanskrit: उद्वाहयामास च तं स्वयमेव पिनाकधृक् । मरुतां च शुभां कन्यां सुयशेति च विश्रुताम्
verses.transliteration: udvāhayāmāsa ca taṃ svayameva pinākadhṛk / marutāṃ ca śubhāṃ kanyāṃ suyaśeti ca viśrutām
verses.translation: O leading king, thereafter, one should go to the excellent Tirtha Tapasesvara. O leading king, on taking bath therein, one shall attain the benefit of penance.
verses.hindi: श्रुत्वा तेषां तदा वाक्यं भगवान् कूर्मरूपधृक् ।
verses.wordMeaning: O leading king, thereafter, one should go to the excellent Tirtha Tapasesvara. O leading king, on taking bath therein, one shall attain the benefit of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading king, thereafter, one should go to the excellent Tirtha Tapasesvara. O leading king, on taking bath therein, one shall attain the benefit of penance.

verses.sanskrit: एतज्जप्येश्वरं स्थानं देवदेवस्य शूलिनः । यत्र तत्र मृतो मर्त्यो रुद्रलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: etajjapyeśvaraṃ sthānaṃ devadevasya śūlinaḥ / yatra tatra mṛto martyo rudraloke mahīyate
verses.translation: O leading king, thereafter, one should go to the excellent Tirtha Tapasesvara. O leading king, on taking bath therein, one shall attain the benefit of penance.
verses.hindi: चतुर्धायं पुराणेऽस्मिन् प्रोच्यते प्रतिसंचरः योऽयं संदृश्यते नित्यं लोके भूतक्षयस्त्विह। नित्यः संकीर्त्यते नाम्ना मुनिभिः प्रतिसंचरः
verses.wordMeaning: O leading king, thereafter, one should go to the excellent Tirtha Tapasesvara. O leading king, on taking bath therein, one shall attain the benefit of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading king, thereafter, one should go to the excellent Tirtha Tapasesvara. O leading king, on taking bath therein, one shall attain the benefit of penance.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे एकचत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः सूत उवाच अन्यच्च तीर्थप्रवरं जप्येश्वरसमीपतः । नाम्ना पञ्चनदं पुण्यं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge ekacatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca anyacca tīrthapravaraṃ japyeśvarasamīpataḥ / nāmnā pañcanadaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam
verses.translation: Thereafter, one shall go to Suklatlrtha that is destructive of all sins. O Yudhisthira, there is no other holy centre on a par with it on Narmada.
verses.hindi: ब्राह्मो नैमित्तिको नाम कल्पान्ते यो भविष्यति। त्रैलोक्यस्यास्य कथितः प्रतिसर्गो मनीषिभिः
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, one shall go to Suklatlrtha that is destructive of all sins. O Yudhisthira, there is no other holy centre on a par with it on Narmada.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, one shall go to Suklatlrtha that is destructive of all sins. O Yudhisthira, there is no other holy centre on a par with it on Narmada.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिरात्रोपोषितस्तत्र पूजयित्वा महेश्वरम् । सर्वपापविशुद्धात्मा रुद्रलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: trirātropoṣitastatra pūjayitvā maheśvaram / sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā rudraloke mahīyate
verses.translation: Its sight, the touching, the ablution (therein), Dana, Tapas, Japa, Homa, and observance of fast in the holy centre Suklatirtha yield great benefits.
verses.hindi: प्राकृतः प्रतिसर्गोऽयं प्रोच्यते कालचिन्तकैः प्रलयः प्रतिसर्गोऽयं कालचिन्तापरैद्विजैः
verses.wordMeaning: Its sight, the touching, the ablution (therein), Dana, Tapas, Japa, Homa, and observance of fast in the holy centre Suklatirtha yield great benefits.
verses.commentary: Sense: Its sight, the touching, the ablution (therein), Dana, Tapas, Japa, Homa, and observance of fast in the holy centre Suklatirtha yield great benefits.

verses.sanskrit: अन्यच्च तीर्थप्रवरं शङ्करस्यामितौजसः । महाभैरवमित्युक्तं महापातकनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: anyacca tīrthapravaraṃ śaṅkarasyāmitaujasaḥ / mahābhairavamityuktaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam
verses.translation: The holy centre well known as Suklatirtha is said to be a Yojana in extent. It is resorted to by Devas and Gandharvas. It is destructive of all sins.
verses.hindi: सूतजीने कहा--नारायणके मुखसे कहे गये इस विशिष्ट ज्ञानको सुनकर मुनियोंने कूर्मरूप धारण करनेवाले प्रभु देवसे पूछा--
verses.wordMeaning: The holy centre well known as Suklatirtha is said to be a Yojana in extent. It is resorted to by Devas and Gandharvas. It is destructive of all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: The holy centre well known as Suklatirtha is said to be a Yojana in extent. It is resorted to by Devas and Gandharvas. It is destructive of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थानां च परं तीर्थं वितस्ता परमा नदी । सर्वपापहरा पुण्या स्वयमेव गिरीन्द्रजा
verses.transliteration: tīrthānāṃ ca paraṃ tīrthaṃ vitastā paramā nadī / sarvapāpaharā puṇyā svayameva girīndrajā
verses.translation: Even if the holy centre is seen from the top of a tree from far, it dispels the sin of Brahmana-slaughter. God Sankara, Bharga, stays there always with the goddess.
verses.hindi: मुनियोंने कहा--(सूतजी!) आपने विस्तारपूर्वक धर्म, मोक्ष, ज्ञान, लोकोंकी सृष्टिके विस्तार, वंश और मन्वन्तराको हमें बतलाया। माधव! भूतभव्येश! जैसा आपने पूर्वमें (पुराण-लक्षणके प्रसंगसे प्रतिसर्गके विषयमें) बतलाया है, तदनुसार अब हमें प्राणियोंके प्रतिसर्गके विषयमें बतलायें
verses.wordMeaning: Even if the holy centre is seen from the top of a tree from far, it dispels the sin of Brahmana-slaughter. God Sankara, Bharga, stays there always with the goddess.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even if the holy centre is seen from the top of a tree from far, it dispels the sin of Brahmana-slaughter. God Sankara, Bharga, stays there always with the goddess.

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थं पञ्चतपं नाम शंभोरमिततेजसः । यत्र देवादिदेवेन चक्रार्थं पूजितो भवः
verses.transliteration: tīrthaṃ pañcatapaṃ nāma śaṃbhoramitatejasaḥ / yatra devādidevena cakrārthaṃ pūjito bhavaḥ
verses.translation: O king of holy rites, in the fourteenth day in the dark half of the Vaisakha month, Kara comes out of his own world to be present here.
verses.hindi: सूतजीने कहा--तब उनके उस वचनको सुनकर कूर्मरूपधारी महायोगी भगवानूने भूतोंके प्रतिसंचर अर्थात् प्रलयका वर्णन किया
verses.wordMeaning: O king of holy rites, in the fourteenth day in the dark half of the Vaisakha month, Kara comes out of his own world to be present here.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king of holy rites, in the fourteenth day in the dark half of the Vaisakha month, Kara comes out of his own world to be present here.

verses.sanskrit: पिण्डदानादिकं तत्र प्रेत्यानन्तफलप्रदम् । मृतस्तत्रापि नियमाद् ब्रह्मलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: piṇḍadānādikaṃ tatra pretyānantaphalapradam / mṛtastatrāpi niyamād brahmaloke mahīyate
verses.translation: The leading gods, demons, divine minstrels, Siddhas, Vidyadharas, the attendants of Siva and celestial damsels and the leading Nagas stay there.
verses.hindi: कूर्म बोले इस पुराणमें नित्य, नैमित्तिक, प्राकृत तथा आत्यन्तिक-इस प्रकारसे चार प्रकारका प्रतिसंचर (प्रलय) कहा गया है। लोकमें यहाँ जो प्राणियोँका नित्य क्षय दिखलायी देता है, उसे मुनियोंने नित्य- प्रलयके नामसे कहा है। कल्पान्तमें ब्रह्मा (की निद्रा)- के निमित्तसे होनेवाले तीनों लोकोंके प्रतिसर्ग-प्रलयको विद्वानोंने (नैमित्तिक प्रलय) कहा है। महत्तत्त्वसे लेकर विशेषपर्यन्त समस्त तत्त्वोंका जो क्षय हो जाता है,
verses.wordMeaning: The leading gods, demons, divine minstrels, Siddhas, Vidyadharas, the attendants of Siva and celestial damsels and the leading Nagas stay there.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leading gods, demons, divine minstrels, Siddhas, Vidyadharas, the attendants of Siva and celestial damsels and the leading Nagas stay there.

verses.sanskrit: कायावरोहणं नाम महादेवालयं शुभम् । यत्र माहेश्वरा धर्मा मुनिभिः संप्रवर्तिताः
verses.transliteration: kāyāvarohaṇaṃ nāma mahādevālayaṃ śubham / yatra māheśvarā dharmā munibhiḥ saṃpravartitāḥ
verses.translation: One dispels sins committed ever since one's birth in the Suklatirtha just as a coloured cloth turns white by washing in water.
verses.hindi: उसे कालचिन्तकोंने प्राकृत प्रतिसर्ग कहा है और ज्ञानद्वारा परमात्मामें होनेवाले योगियोंके आत्यन्तिक प्रलयको कालचिन्तक द्विज आत्यन्तिक प्रतिसर्ग (प्रलय) कहते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: One dispels sins committed ever since one's birth in the Suklatirtha just as a coloured cloth turns white by washing in water.
verses.commentary: Sense: One dispels sins committed ever since one's birth in the Suklatirtha just as a coloured cloth turns white by washing in water.

verses.sanskrit: श्राद्धं दानं तपो होम उपवासस्तथाक्षयः । परित्यजति यः प्राणान् रुद्रलोकं स गच्छति
verses.transliteration: śrāddhaṃ dānaṃ tapo homa upavāsastathākṣayaḥ / parityajati yaḥ prāṇān rudralokaṃ sa gacchati
verses.translation: The ablution, Dana, penance and Sraddha appear to be infinite. There will never be a holier Tirtha than the Suklatirtha.
verses.hindi: + यहाँ “प्रलय' का तात्पर्य परमात्मतत्त्वके साथ एकरूपतामें है। स्वात्मसंस्थाः प्रजाः कर्तृ प्रतिपेदे प्रजापति:
verses.wordMeaning: The ablution, Dana, penance and Sraddha appear to be infinite. There will never be a holier Tirtha than the Suklatirtha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The ablution, Dana, penance and Sraddha appear to be infinite. There will never be a holier Tirtha than the Suklatirtha.

verses.sanskrit: अन्यच्च तीर्थप्रवरं कन्यातीर्थमिति श्रुतम् । तत्र गत्वा त्यजेत् प्राणांल्लोकान् प्राप्नोति शाश्वतान्
verses.transliteration: anyacca tīrthapravaraṃ kanyātīrthamiti śrutam / tatra gatvā tyajet prāṇāṃllokān prāpnoti śāśvatān
verses.translation: A man who commits sinful deeds earlier in his life dispels them by observing fast for a day and a night in iSuklatirtha.
verses.hindi: ततो भवत्यनावृष्टिस्तीव्रा सा शतवार्षिकी । भूतक्षयकरी घोरा सर्वभूतक्षयंकरी
verses.wordMeaning: A man who commits sinful deeds earlier in his life dispels them by observing fast for a day and a night in iSuklatirtha.
verses.commentary: Sense: A man who commits sinful deeds earlier in his life dispels them by observing fast for a day and a night in iSuklatirtha.

verses.sanskrit: जामदग्न्यस्य तु शुभं रामस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः । तत्र स्नात्वा तीर्थ वरे गोसहस्रफलं लभेत्
verses.transliteration: jāmadagnyasya tu śubhaṃ rāmasyākliṣṭakarmaṇaḥ / tatra snātvā tīrtha vare gosahasraphalaṃ labhet
verses.translation: O leading king, thereafter one should go to the holy centre Kallolakesvara. There is no doubt in this that Gahga. descends into it on the auspicious days.
verses.hindi: सप्तरश्मिरथो भूत्वा समुत्तिष्ठन् दिवाकरः । असह्यरश्मिर्भवति पिबन्नम्भो गभस्तिभिः चतुर्लोकमिदं सर्व दहन्ति शिखिनस्तथा
verses.wordMeaning: O leading king, thereafter one should go to the holy centre Kallolakesvara. There is no doubt in this that Gahga. descends into it on the auspicious days.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading king, thereafter one should go to the holy centre Kallolakesvara. There is no doubt in this that Gahga. descends into it on the auspicious days.

verses.sanskrit: महाकालमिति ख्यातं तीर्थं त्रैलोक्यविश्रुतम् । गत्वा प्राणान् परित्यज्य गाणपत्यमवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: mahākālamiti khyātaṃ tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam / gatvā prāṇān parityajya gāṇapatyamavāpnuyāt
verses.translation: After bathing in it and drinking its water, one should make charitable gifts in accordance with the injunctions. He shall be freed from all sins and be honoured in the Brahmaloka.
verses.hindi: दीप्यन्ते भास्कराः सप्त युगान्ताग्निप्रतापिनः
verses.wordMeaning: After bathing in it and drinking its water, one should make charitable gifts in accordance with the injunctions. He shall be freed from all sins and be honoured in the Brahmaloka.
verses.commentary: Sense: After bathing in it and drinking its water, one should make charitable gifts in accordance with the injunctions. He shall be freed from all sins and be honoured in the Brahmaloka.

verses.sanskrit: गुह्याद् गुह्यतमं तीर्थं नकुलीश्वरमुत्तमम् । तत्र सन्निहितः श्रीमान् भगवान् नकुलीश्वरः
verses.transliteration: guhyād guhyatamaṃ tīrthaṃ nakulīśvaramuttamam / tatra sannihitaḥ śrīmān bhagavān nakulīśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, one should go to Nanditirtha and per¬ form the rite of ablution there. Nandisa is pleased and the devotee is honoured in the Somaloka.
verses.hindi: सर्वलोकप्रणाशश्च सोऽग्निभूत्वा सुकुण्डली। चतुर्लोकमिदं सर्व निर्दहत्यात्मतेजसा यहाँ साधनसहित आत्यन्तिक प्रलय अर्थात् मोक्षका वर्णन किया गया है। अब मैं संक्षेपमें आप लोगोंको नैमित्तिक प्रलयके विषयमें बतलाऊँगा
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, one should go to Nanditirtha and per¬ form the rite of ablution there. Nandisa is pleased and the devotee is honoured in the Somaloka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, one should go to Nanditirtha and per¬ form the rite of ablution there. Nandisa is pleased and the devotee is honoured in the Somaloka.

verses.sanskrit: हिमवच्छिखरे रम्ये गङ्गाद्वारे सुशोभने । देव्या सह महादेवो नित्यं शिष्यैश्च संवृतः
verses.transliteration: himavacchikhare ramye gaṅgādvāre suśobhane / devyā saha mahādevo nityaṃ śiṣyaiśca saṃvṛtaḥ
verses.translation: O leading king, thereafter one should go to the auspicious Tirtha Anaraka. O king, a man taking a bath there never sees hell.
verses.hindi: कलियुग)-के अन्तमें प्रलयकाल उपस्थित होनेपर प्रजापति समस्त प्रजाको आत्मस्थ करनेकी इच्छा करते हैं। इसके बाद सौ वर्षोंतक तीव्र अनावृष्टि होती है, वह भूतों एवं सभी प्राणियोंका विनाश करनेवाली तथा
verses.wordMeaning: O leading king, thereafter one should go to the auspicious Tirtha Anaraka. O king, a man taking a bath there never sees hell.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading king, thereafter one should go to the auspicious Tirtha Anaraka. O king, a man taking a bath there never sees hell.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र स्नात्वा महादेवं पूजयित्वा वृषध्वजम् । सर्वपापैर्विमुच्येत मृतस्तज्ज्ञानमाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: tatra snātvā mahādevaṃ pūjayitvā vṛṣadhvajam / sarvapāpairvimucyeta mṛtastajjñānamāpnuyāt
verses.translation: O leading king, one shall deposit one's bones in that holy centre. He is born in the world again as a beautiful person endowed with riches and worldly pleasures.
verses.hindi: अत्यन्त भयंकर होती है । तदनन्तर भूमिपर जो अल्पसार अर्थात् निर्बल प्राणी होते हैं, सबसे पहले उनका लय होता है और वे भूमिमें मिल जाते हैं। तब सात रश्मियोंवाले रथपर आरूढ होकर सूर्य उदित होते हैं। उनकी किरणें असह्य हो जाती हैं, वे अपनी किरणोंद्वारा जल पीने लगते हैं। उनकी वे सातों रश्मियाँ महासमुद्रमें स्थित जलको पीती हैं। उस आहारसे उद्दीप्त होकर वे (सात) रश्मियाँ पुनः सात सूर्य बन जाती
verses.wordMeaning: O leading king, one shall deposit one's bones in that holy centre. He is born in the world again as a beautiful person endowed with riches and worldly pleasures.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading king, one shall deposit one's bones in that holy centre. He is born in the world again as a beautiful person endowed with riches and worldly pleasures.

verses.sanskrit: अन्यच्च देवदेवस्य स्थानं पुण्यतमं शुभम् । भीमेश्वरमिति ख्यातं गत्वा मुञ्चति पातकम्
verses.transliteration: anyacca devadevasya sthānaṃ puṇyatamaṃ śubham / bhīmeśvaramiti khyātaṃ gatvā muñcati pātakam
verses.translation: O leading king, thereafter one shall go to the excellent Kapilatirtha. O king, a man taking bath there shall obtain the benefit of the gift of thousand cows.
verses.hindi: हैं। तदनन्तर सूर्यरूप वे सातो रश्मियाँ चारों दिशाओं तथा सम्पूर्ण इस चतुर्लोकको अग्निके समान दग्ध करने लगती हैं
verses.wordMeaning: O leading king, thereafter one shall go to the excellent Kapilatirtha. O king, a man taking bath there shall obtain the benefit of the gift of thousand cows.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading king, thereafter one shall go to the excellent Kapilatirtha. O king, a man taking bath there shall obtain the benefit of the gift of thousand cows.

verses.sanskrit: तथान्यच्चण्डवेगायाः संभेदः पापनाशनः । तत्र स्नात्वा च पीत्वा च मुच्यते ब्रह्महत्यया
verses.transliteration: tathānyaccaṇḍavegāyāḥ saṃbhedaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ / tatra snātvā ca pītvā ca mucyate brahmahatyayā
verses.translation: He shall himself become endowed with all ornaments, and will be respected by all Devas. He shall become strong as Siva, and will be sporting always like Siva.
verses.hindi: ब्राह्मणो ! प्रलयकालीन अग्निके तेजसे युक्त वे सातों सूर्य अपनी-अपनी रश्मियोके द्वारा ऊर्ध्व तथा अधोभागको व्याकर अतिशय उद्दीस हो जाते हैं। जलसे प्रदीप्त अनेक सहस्र रश्मियोंवाले वे सूर्य आकाशको आवृतकर स्थित रहते हैं और पृथिवीको जलाने लगते हैं । तदनन्तर उनके तेजसे जलती हुई पृथ्वी पर्वतों, नदियों, समुद्रों तथा ट्वीपोंके साथ स्नेह (द्रवभाव)-से रहित हो जाती है अर्थात् अत्यन्त सूख जाती है । सतत प्रदीप्त रहनेवाली
verses.wordMeaning: He shall himself become endowed with all ornaments, and will be respected by all Devas. He shall become strong as Siva, and will be sporting always like Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall himself become endowed with all ornaments, and will be respected by all Devas. He shall become strong as Siva, and will be sporting always like Siva.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषामपि चैतेषां तीर्थानां परमा पुरी । नाम्नावाराणसी दिव्या कोटिकोट्ययुताधिका
verses.transliteration: sarveṣāmapi caiteṣāṃ tīrthānāṃ paramā purī / nāmnāvārāṇasī divyā koṭikoṭyayutādhikā
verses.translation: On Tuesdays and CaturthI days in particular, one should perform ablution rite of Siva and feed Brahmanas.
verses.hindi: व्याप्त हो जाती हैं
verses.wordMeaning: On Tuesdays and CaturthI days in particular, one should perform ablution rite of Siva and feed Brahmanas.
verses.commentary: Sense: On Tuesdays and CaturthI days in particular, one should perform ablution rite of Siva and feed Brahmanas.

verses.sanskrit: तस्याः पुरस्तान्माहात्म्यं भाषितं वो मया त्विह । नान्यत्र लभ्यते मुक्तिर्योगिनाप्येकजन्मना
verses.transliteration: tasyāḥ purastānmāhātmyaṃ bhāṣitaṃ vo mayā tviha / nānyatra labhyate muktiryogināpyekajanmanā
verses.translation: Near it on the western side, not very far from it, is the Tirtha Dasasvamedhika which is well-known in the three worlds.
verses.hindi: सूर्यरूप अग्निके द्वारा प्रकृष्टरूपसे शोधित और परस्पर संसृष्ट संसारके समस्त पदार्थ एक ज्वालाके रूपमें एकाकार हो जाते हैं। सभी लोकोंको नष्ट करनेवाली वह सूर्यरूप अग्नि एक मण्डलके रूपें होकर अपने तेजसे इस सम्पूर्ण चतुर्लोकको दग्ध करने लगती है
verses.wordMeaning: Near it on the western side, not very far from it, is the Tirtha Dasasvamedhika which is well-known in the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Near it on the western side, not very far from it, is the Tirtha Dasasvamedhika which is well-known in the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: एते प्राधान्यतः प्रोक्ता देशाः पापहरा नृणाम् । गत्वा संक्षालयेत् पापं जन्मान्तरशतैः कृतम्
verses.transliteration: ete prādhānyataḥ proktā deśāḥ pāpaharā nṛṇām / gatvā saṃkṣālayet pāpaṃ janmāntaraśataiḥ kṛtam
verses.translation: Near it on the western side, not very far from it, is the Tirtha Dasasvamedhika which is well-known in the three worlds.
verses.hindi: निर्वक्षा निस्तृणा भूमिः कूर्मपृष्ठा प्रकाशते
verses.wordMeaning: Near it on the western side, not very far from it, is the Tirtha Dasasvamedhika which is well-known in the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Near it on the western side, not very far from it, is the Tirtha Dasasvamedhika which is well-known in the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: यः स्वधर्मान् परित्यज्य तीर्थसेवां करोति हि । न तस्य फलते तीर्थमहि लोके परत्र च
verses.transliteration: yaḥ svadharmān parityajya tīrthasevāṃ karoti hi / na tasya phalate tīrthamahi loke paratra ca
verses.translation: Near it on the western side, not very far from it, is the Tirtha Dasasvamedhika which is well-known in the three worlds.
verses.hindi: लोकान् दहति दीप्तात्मा रुद्रतेजोविजुम्भितः स दग्ध्वा पृथिवीं देवो रसातलमशोषयत्।
verses.wordMeaning: Near it on the western side, not very far from it, is the Tirtha Dasasvamedhika which is well-known in the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Near it on the western side, not very far from it, is the Tirtha Dasasvamedhika which is well-known in the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: प्रायश्चित्ती च विधुरस्तथा पापचरो गृही । प्रकुर्यात् तीर्थसंसेवां ये चान्ये तादृशा जनाः
verses.transliteration: prāyaścittī ca vidhurastathā pāpacaro gṛhī / prakuryāt tīrthasaṃsevāṃ ye cānye tādṛśā janāḥ
verses.translation: Near it on the western side, not very far from it, is the Tirtha Dasasvamedhika which is well-known in the three worlds.
verses.hindi: उत्तिष्ठन्ति शिखास्तस्य वह्नेः संवर्तकस्य तु
verses.wordMeaning: Near it on the western side, not very far from it, is the Tirtha Dasasvamedhika which is well-known in the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Near it on the western side, not very far from it, is the Tirtha Dasasvamedhika which is well-known in the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: सहाग्निर्वा सपत्नीको गच्छेत् तीर्थानि यत्नतः । सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो यथोक्तां गतिमाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: sahāgnirvā sapatnīko gacchet tīrthāni yatnataḥ / sarvapāpavinirmukto yathoktāṃ gatimāpnuyāt
verses.translation: Near it on the western side, not very far from it, is the Tirtha Dasasvamedhika which is well-known in the three worlds.
verses.hindi: तदा दहत्यसौ दीप्तः कालरुद्रप्रचोदितः भूर्लोकं च भुवर्लोकं स्वर्लोकं च तथा महः। दहेदशेषं कालाग्निः कालो विश्वतनुः स्वयम्
verses.wordMeaning: Near it on the western side, not very far from it, is the Tirtha Dasasvamedhika which is well-known in the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Near it on the western side, not very far from it, is the Tirtha Dasasvamedhika which is well-known in the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: ऋणानि त्रीण्यपाकृत्य कुर्याद् वा तीर्थसेवनम् । विधाय वृत्तिं पुत्राणां भार्यां तेषु निधाय च
verses.transliteration: ṛṇāni trīṇyapākṛtya kuryād vā tīrthasevanam / vidhāya vṛttiṃ putrāṇāṃ bhāryāṃ teṣu nidhāya ca
verses.translation: Near it on the western side, not very far from it, is the Tirtha Dasasvamedhika which is well-known in the three worlds.
verses.hindi: व्याप्तेष्वेतेषु लोकेषु तिर्यगूर्ध्वमथाग्निना।
verses.wordMeaning: Near it on the western side, not very far from it, is the Tirtha Dasasvamedhika which is well-known in the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Near it on the western side, not very far from it, is the Tirtha Dasasvamedhika which is well-known in the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: प्रायश्चित्तप्रसङ्गेन तीर्थमाहात्म्यमीरितम् । यः पठेच्छृणुयाद् वापि मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः
verses.transliteration: prāyaścittaprasaṅgena tīrthamāhātmyamīritam / yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyād vāpi mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ
verses.translation: Near it on the western side, not very far from it, is the Tirtha Dasasvamedhika which is well-known in the three worlds.
verses.hindi: अयोगुडनिभं सर्व तदा चैकं प्रकाशते उत्तिष्ठन्ति तदा व्योग्नि घोराः संवर्तका घनाः
verses.wordMeaning: Near it on the western side, not very far from it, is the Tirtha Dasasvamedhika which is well-known in the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Near it on the western side, not very far from it, is the Tirtha Dasasvamedhika which is well-known in the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे द्विचत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः सूत उवाच एतदाकर्ण्य विज्ञानं नारायणमुखेरितम् । कूर्मरूपधरं देवं पप्रच्छुर्मुनयः प्रभुम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge dvicatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta uvāca etadākarṇya vijñānaṃ nārāyaṇamukheritam / kūrmarūpadharaṃ devaṃ papracchurmunayaḥ prabhum
verses.translation: After observing fast for a night in the auspicious month of Bhadrapada, one should perform the ablution rite and the worship of the bull-bannered deity Hara on the new moon day.
verses.hindi: तब सम्पूर्ण स्थावर एवं जंगम पदार्थोके लीन हो जानेपर वृक्षों तथा तृणॉंसे रहित भूमि कछुएके पीठके समान दिखलायी देती है। (किरणोंसे) व्याप्त समस्त जगत् अम्बरीष (भड्-भूजेकी कड़ाही)-के सदृश
verses.wordMeaning: After observing fast for a night in the auspicious month of Bhadrapada, one should perform the ablution rite and the worship of the bull-bannered deity Hara on the new moon day.
verses.commentary: Sense: After observing fast for a night in the auspicious month of Bhadrapada, one should perform the ablution rite and the worship of the bull-bannered deity Hara on the new moon day.

verses.sanskrit: मुनय ऊचुः कथिता भवता धर्मा मोक्षज्ञानं सविस्तरम् । लोकानां सर्गविस्तारं वंशमन्वन्तराणि च
verses.transliteration: munaya ūcuḥ kathitā bhavatā dharmā mokṣajñānaṃ savistaram / lokānāṃ sargavistāraṃ vaṃśamanvantarāṇi ca
verses.translation: He shall then go to Rudra's city by means of golden aerial chariot decorated with clusters of tinkling bells. He shall then rejoice with Rudra.
verses.hindi: वर्णवाला दिखलायी देता है। उन ज्वालाओंके द्वारा सभी कुछ पूर्णरूपसे प्रज्वलित होने लगता है तदनन्तर पातालमें तथा महासमुद्रोंमें जो प्राणी रहते हैं, उनका लय होता है और वे सभी भूमिके रूपमें परिवर्तित हो जाते हैं। सात (सूर्यो)-के रूपमें प्रदीप्त हो रहे प्रभु पावक (अग्निदेव) उन सभी द्वोपों,
verses.wordMeaning: He shall then go to Rudra's city by means of golden aerial chariot decorated with clusters of tinkling bells. He shall then rejoice with Rudra.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall then go to Rudra's city by means of golden aerial chariot decorated with clusters of tinkling bells. He shall then rejoice with Rudra.

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिसर्गमिदानीं नो वक्तुमर्हसी माधव । भूतानां भूतभव्येश यथा पूर्वं त्वयोदितम्
verses.transliteration: pratisargamidānīṃ no vaktumarhasī mādhava / bhūtānāṃ bhūtabhavyeśa yathā pūrvaṃ tvayoditam
verses.translation: He should perform the rite of ablution on any day at any place. After performing Tarpana rites for the Pitrs, he shall derive the benefit of horse sacrifice.
verses.hindi: पर्वतों, वर्षों तथा महासमुद्रोंको भस्मसात् कर देते हैं। समुद्रों, नदियों तथा पातालोंके सम्पूर्ण जलका शोषण करती हुई प्रदीप्त अग्नि (सूर्यको ज्वाला) पृथ्वीपर प्रज्वलित होने लगती है अर्थात् पृथ्वीको
verses.wordMeaning: He should perform the rite of ablution on any day at any place. After performing Tarpana rites for the Pitrs, he shall derive the benefit of horse sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should perform the rite of ablution on any day at any place. After performing Tarpana rites for the Pitrs, he shall derive the benefit of horse sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच श्रुत्वा तेषां तदा वाक्यं भगवान् कूर्मरूपधृक् । व्याजहार महायोगी भूतानां प्रतिसंचरम्
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca śrutvā teṣāṃ tadā vākyaṃ bhagavān kūrmarūpadhṛk / vyājahāra mahāyogī bhūtānāṃ pratisaṃcaram
verses.translation: Bhrgu Tirtha—Bhera-ghat 12 miles to the West of Jabalpur (De, ). It has now a temple of 64 Yoginis. Here Parasurama regained his energy taken away by Rama the son of Dasaratha.
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर महान् संवर्तक नामक अग्नि पर्वतोंका अतिक्रमण करते हुए रुद्रके तेजसे पुष्ट होनेके कारण दीप्त आत्मावाला होकर लोकोंको जलाने लगती है। (सम्पूर्ण) पृथ्वीको दग्धकर वे अग्निदेव रसातलको शोषित करते हैं। पृथ्वीके नीचेके भागको जलाकर ऊपरके द्युलोकको जलाने लगते हैं। उस संवर्तक अग्रिकी शिखाएँ सैकड़ों, हजारों तथा दस हजार योजन ऊपरतक उठने लगती हैं॥ २८--३०॥
verses.wordMeaning: Bhrgu Tirtha—Bhera-ghat 12 miles to the West of Jabalpur (De, ). It has now a temple of 64 Yoginis. Here Parasurama regained his energy taken away by Rama the son of Dasaratha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhrgu Tirtha—Bhera-ghat 12 miles to the West of Jabalpur (De, ). It has now a temple of 64 Yoginis. Here Parasurama regained his energy taken away by Rama the son of Dasaratha.

verses.sanskrit: कूर्म उवाच नित्यो नैमित्तिकश्चैव प्राकृतात्यन्तिकौ तथा । चतुर्धायं पुराणे ऽस्मिन् प्रोच्यते प्रतिसंचरः
verses.transliteration: kūrma uvāca nityo naimittikaścaiva prākṛtātyantikau tathā / caturdhāyaṃ purāṇe 'smin procyate pratisaṃcaraḥ
verses.translation: By visiting that lord, one is immediately freed from sins. This holy centre is very large and destructive of all sins.
verses.hindi: तब कालरुद्रद्वारा प्रेरित होकर यह उद्दीप्त अग्नि गन्धर्वो, पिशाचों, यक्षों, नागों तथा राक्षसोंको जलाती है। कालाग्निस्वरूप विश्वात्मा स्वयं काल भूलोक, भुवर्लोक, स्वर्लोक तथा महर्लोकको सम्पूर्णरूपसे जला
verses.wordMeaning: By visiting that lord, one is immediately freed from sins. This holy centre is very large and destructive of all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: By visiting that lord, one is immediately freed from sins. This holy centre is very large and destructive of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: यो ऽयं संदृश्यते नित्यं लोके भूतक्षयस्त्विह । नित्यः संकीर्त्यते नाम्ना मुनिभिः प्रतिसंचरः
verses.transliteration: yo 'yaṃ saṃdṛśyate nityaṃ loke bhūtakṣayastviha / nityaḥ saṃkīrtyate nāmnā munibhiḥ pratisaṃcaraḥ
verses.translation: O leading king, he who abandons his life there in that holy centre, shall be blessed with four arms and three eyes. He shall be as mighty as Kara.
verses.hindi: देता है। इन लोकोंमें तिरछे तथा ऊँचे सब जगह अग्निके द्वारा व्याप्त कर दिये जानेपर यह सम्पूर्ण जगत् उस तेजसे धीरे-धीरे पूरित होकर (जलते हुए) एक अयःपिण्ड (लोहपिण्ड)-के समान प्रकाशित होने लगता है॥ ३१--३३॥
verses.wordMeaning: O leading king, he who abandons his life there in that holy centre, shall be blessed with four arms and three eyes. He shall be as mighty as Kara.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading king, he who abandons his life there in that holy centre, shall be blessed with four arms and three eyes. He shall be as mighty as Kara.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मो नैमित्तिको नाम कल्पान्ते यो भविष्यति । त्रैलोक्यस्यास्य कथितः प्रतिसर्गो मनीषिभिः
verses.transliteration: brāhmo naimittiko nāma kalpānte yo bhaviṣyati / trailokyasyāsya kathitaḥ pratisargo manīṣibhiḥ
verses.translation: He shall reside in the Sivaloka for ten thousand Kalpas and more with exploits similar to that of Siva. After a long time, he is born on the Earth. He shall then be a sole Emperor over the world.
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर हाथियोंके समूहके समान नाद करनेवाले विद्युत्से अलंकृत संवर्तक नामक भयंकर मेघ आकाशमें प्रकट होते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: He shall reside in the Sivaloka for ten thousand Kalpas and more with exploits similar to that of Siva. After a long time, he is born on the Earth. He shall then be a sole Emperor over the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall reside in the Sivaloka for ten thousand Kalpas and more with exploits similar to that of Siva. After a long time, he is born on the Earth. He shall then be a sole Emperor over the world.

verses.sanskrit: महादाद्यां विशेषान्तं यदा संयाति संक्षयम् । प्राकृतः प्रतिसर्गो ऽयं प्रोच्यते कालचिन्तकैः
verses.transliteration: mahādādyāṃ viśeṣāntaṃ yadā saṃyāti saṃkṣayam / prākṛtaḥ pratisargo 'yaṃ procyate kālacintakaiḥ
verses.translation: O leading king, thereafter, one should go to the excellent Tirtha called Hastatirtha (v.l. Harhsa-Tirtha). O king, a man who takes bath there, is honoured in the Brahmaloka.
verses.hindi: केचिन्नीलोत्पलश्यामा: केचित् कुमुदसंनिभाः। धूप्रवर्णास्तथा केचित् केचित् पीताः पयोधराः केचिद् रासभवर्णास्तु लाक्षारसनिभास्तथा। शङ्खकुन्दनिभाश्चान्ये जात्यञ्जननिभाः परे
verses.wordMeaning: O leading king, thereafter, one should go to the excellent Tirtha called Hastatirtha (v.l. Harhsa-Tirtha). O king, a man who takes bath there, is honoured in the Brahmaloka.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading king, thereafter, one should go to the excellent Tirtha called Hastatirtha (v.l. Harhsa-Tirtha). O king, a man who takes bath there, is honoured in the Brahmaloka.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानादात्यन्तिकः प्रोक्तो योगिनः परमात्मनि । प्रलयः प्रतिसर्गो ऽयं कालचिन्तापरैर्द्विजैः
verses.transliteration: jñānādātyantikaḥ prokto yoginaḥ paramātmani / pralayaḥ pratisargo 'yaṃ kālacintāparairdvijaiḥ
verses.translation: O leading king, thereafter, one should go to that holy centre where Janardana is settled. It is called Varaha tirtha. It yields the capacity to go to Visnuloka.
verses.hindi: इन्द्रगोपनिभाः केचिद्धरितालनिभास्तथा। इन्द्रचापनिभाः केचिदुत्तिष्ठन्ति घना दिवि
verses.wordMeaning: O leading king, thereafter, one should go to that holy centre where Janardana is settled. It is called Varaha tirtha. It yields the capacity to go to Visnuloka.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading king, thereafter, one should go to that holy centre where Janardana is settled. It is called Varaha tirtha. It yields the capacity to go to Visnuloka.

verses.sanskrit: आत्यन्तिकश्च कथितः प्रलयो ऽत्र ससाधनः । नैमित्तिकमिदानीं वः कथयिष्ये समासतः
verses.transliteration: ātyantikaśca kathitaḥ pralayo 'tra sasādhanaḥ / naimittikamidānīṃ vaḥ kathayiṣye samāsataḥ
verses.translation: In the month of Karttika, one shall worship the lord of Devas, the consort of Parvatl. Learned men assert that it is ten times more beneficial horse-sacrifice.
verses.hindi: केचित् पर्वतसंकाशाः केचिद् गजकुलोपमा: । कूटाङ्कारनिभाश्चान्ये केचिन्मीनकुलोद्वहाः । बहुरूपा घोररूपा घोरस्वरनिनादिनः ततस्ते जलदा घोरा राविणो भास्करात्मजाः। सप्तधा संवृतात्मानस्तमग्निं शमयन्त्युत
verses.wordMeaning: In the month of Karttika, one shall worship the lord of Devas, the consort of Parvatl. Learned men assert that it is ten times more beneficial horse-sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the month of Karttika, one shall worship the lord of Devas, the consort of Parvatl. Learned men assert that it is ten times more beneficial horse-sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्युगसहस्रान्ते संप्राप्ते प्रतिसंचरे । स्वात्मसंस्थाः प्रजाः कर्तुं प्रतिपेदे प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: caturyugasahasrānte saṃprāpte pratisaṃcare / svātmasaṃsthāḥ prajāḥ kartuṃ pratipede prajāpatiḥ
verses.translation: O ruler of men, he who enters water (and drowns himself) in that holy centre goes to the heavenly world by means of a vehicle to which swans are yoked.
verses.hindi: सुघोरमशिवं सर्व नाशयन्ति च पावकम्
verses.wordMeaning: O ruler of men, he who enters water (and drowns himself) in that holy centre goes to the heavenly world by means of a vehicle to which swans are yoked.
verses.commentary: Sense: O ruler of men, he who enters water (and drowns himself) in that holy centre goes to the heavenly world by means of a vehicle to which swans are yoked.

verses.sanskrit: ततो भवत्यनावृष्टिस्तीव्रा सा शतवार्षिकी । भूतक्षयकरी घोरा सर्वभूतक्षयङ्करी
verses.transliteration: tato bhavatyanāvṛṣṭistīvrā sā śatavārṣikī / bhūtakṣayakarī ghorā sarvabhūtakṣayaṅkarī
verses.translation: The Confluence of the rivers Erandi and Narmada is well-known in the world. That holy centre is also highly meritorious and destructive of all sins.
verses.hindi: उन मेघोंमेंसे कुछ नीलकमलके समान श्यामवर्णके, कुछ कुमुदके समान श्वेत वर्णके, कुछ धूम्रवर्णके, कुछ पीतवर्णके, कुछ रासभ (धूसर) वर्णके, कुछ लाक्षारसके समान, कुछ दूसरे शंख तथा कुन्द (पुष्प)-के समान रंगवाले, कुछ जाती पुष्प (चमेली)-के तथा अञ्जन (काजल)-के समान, कुछ मनःशिला (मैनसिल)-के समान रंगवाले और कुछ दूसरे कपोतके समान वर्णवाले, कुछ इन्द्रगोप (बीरबहूटी कीट)-के समान, कुछ
verses.wordMeaning: The Confluence of the rivers Erandi and Narmada is well-known in the world. That holy centre is also highly meritorious and destructive of all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Confluence of the rivers Erandi and Narmada is well-known in the world. That holy centre is also highly meritorious and destructive of all sins.

verses.sanskrit: ततो यान्यल्पसाराणि सत्त्वानि पृथिवीतले । तानि चाग्रे प्रलीयन्ते भूमित्वमुपयान्ति च
verses.transliteration: tato yānyalpasārāṇi sattvāni pṛthivītale / tāni cāgre pralīyante bhūmitvamupayānti ca
verses.translation: One who regularly observes fasts and performs holy rites devotedly, O king, is freed even from the sin of Brahmana-slaughter after taking bath there.
verses.hindi: हरतालके समान और कुछ इन्द्रधनुषके समान वर्णवाले मेघ आकाशमें प्रकट होते हैं॥ ३५--३७॥
verses.wordMeaning: One who regularly observes fasts and performs holy rites devotedly, O king, is freed even from the sin of Brahmana-slaughter after taking bath there.
verses.commentary: Sense: One who regularly observes fasts and performs holy rites devotedly, O king, is freed even from the sin of Brahmana-slaughter after taking bath there.

verses.sanskrit: सप्तरश्मिरथो भूत्वा समुत्तिष्ठन् दिवाकरः । असह्यरश्मिर्भवति पिबन्नम्भो गभस्तिभिः
verses.transliteration: saptaraśmiratho bhūtvā samuttiṣṭhan divākaraḥ / asahyaraśmirbhavati pibannambho gabhastibhiḥ
verses.translation: O leading king, thereafter one should go to the con¬ fluence of Narmada and the ocean. It is famous as Jamadagni and there Janardana is present.
verses.hindi: कुछ मेघ पर्वतके तुल्य, कुछ हाथियोंके समूहके समान, कुछ कूटाङ्गारके समान और कुछ मछलियोंके समूहके आकारके होते हैं। वे मेघ अनेक रूप धारण करनेवाले, भयंकर आकारवाले तथा घोर गर्जना-जैसी ध्वनि करनेवाले होते हैं। उस समय वे सभी बादल आकाशको व्याप्त कर लेते हैं, तदनन्तर भास्करसे उत्पन्न गर्जना करनेवाले वे सात प्रकारके भयंकर बादल एकत्रित होकर उस अग्निको शान्त करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: O leading king, thereafter one should go to the con¬ fluence of Narmada and the ocean. It is famous as Jamadagni and there Janardana is present.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading king, thereafter one should go to the con¬ fluence of Narmada and the ocean. It is famous as Jamadagni and there Janardana is present.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य ते रश्मयः सप्त पिबन्त्यम्बु महार्णवे । तेनाहारेण ता दीप्ताः सूर्याः सप्त भवन्त्युत
verses.transliteration: tasya te raśmayaḥ sapta pibantyambu mahārṇave / tenāhāreṇa tā dīptāḥ sūryāḥ sapta bhavantyuta
verses.translation: O king, a man who takes bath in the meeting point of Narmada and the ocean obtains three times the benefit of a horse-sacrifice.
verses.hindi: तदुपरान्त वे मेघ महान् बाढ़के समान जलको वर्षा करते हैं और अत्यन्त भयंकर, अकल्याणकारी उस सम्पूर्ण अग्निको नष्ट कर देते हैं। अतिशय वृष्टि होनेके कारण जगत् जलसे परिपूर्ण हो जाता है। जलके
verses.wordMeaning: O king, a man who takes bath in the meeting point of Narmada and the ocean obtains three times the benefit of a horse-sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: O king, a man who takes bath in the meeting point of Narmada and the ocean obtains three times the benefit of a horse-sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्ते रश्मयः सप्त सूर्या भूत्वा चतुर्दिशम् । चतुर्लोकमिदं सर्वं दहन्ति शिखिनस्तथा
verses.transliteration: tataste raśmayaḥ sapta sūryā bhūtvā caturdiśam / caturlokamidaṃ sarvaṃ dahanti śikhinastathā
verses.translation: O leading king, thereafter one should go to the excellent Pihgalesvara. O king, a man who takes his bath there, is honoured in the Brahmaloka.
verses.hindi: द्वारा तेज (अग्नि)-के अभिभूत होनेके कारण उस समय वह अग्नि जलमें प्रविष्ट हो जाता है इस तरह अग्निके शान्त हो जानेपर स्वयम्भू ब्रह्माके द्वारा प्रेरित मेघ अत्यधिक जलके प्रवाहोंसे समस्त भुवनको आप्लावित करते हुए वैसे ही अपनी जलधाराओंसे इस भुवनको परिपूर्ण कर देते हैं, जैसे
verses.wordMeaning: O leading king, thereafter one should go to the excellent Pihgalesvara. O king, a man who takes his bath there, is honoured in the Brahmaloka.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading king, thereafter one should go to the excellent Pihgalesvara. O king, a man who takes his bath there, is honoured in the Brahmaloka.

verses.sanskrit: व्याप्नुवन्तश्च ते विप्रास्तूर्ध्वं चाधश्च रश्मिभिः । दीप्यन्ते भास्कराः सप्त युगान्ताग्निप्रतापिनः
verses.transliteration: vyāpnuvantaśca te viprāstūrdhvaṃ cādhaśca raśmibhiḥ / dīpyante bhāskarāḥ sapta yugāntāgnipratāpinaḥ
verses.translation: He who visits Vimalesvara after observing fast there, dispels sins committed in seven births and goes to Siva's abode.
verses.hindi: समुद्र अत्यधिक जलोंके प्रवाहोंसे अपने तटांको आप्लावित कर देता है। ये मेघ इतने जलसे भरपूर हैं कि इनका क्षय दिव्य सैकड़ों वर्षामें कदाचित् सम्भव है
verses.wordMeaning: He who visits Vimalesvara after observing fast there, dispels sins committed in seven births and goes to Siva's abode.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who visits Vimalesvara after observing fast there, dispels sins committed in seven births and goes to Siva's abode.

verses.sanskrit: ते सूर्या वारिणा दीप्ता बहुसाहस्त्ररश्मयः । खं समावृत्य तिष्ठन्ति निर्दहन्तो वसुंधराम्
verses.transliteration: te sūryā vāriṇā dīptā bahusāhastraraśmayaḥ / khaṃ samāvṛtya tiṣṭhanti nirdahanto vasuṃdharām
verses.translation: The location of Japyesvara or Japyesvara is doubtful. According to De, , Japyesvara of the LP I.ch. 43 & Siva P. is the same as Jalpisa of the Kalika P. (ch. 77) and is situated to the west of the river Tista in the Jalapaiguri dist. of Bengal. Kalika Purana locates it to the northwest of Kama-rupa and the five rivers forming Panca-nada are Jatodaka, Trisrota, Vrsadvani, Svarnodaka and Jambunadi. But KP. hints (v. 29) that it is near the sea. In that case Panca-nada must be taken as the land of five- rivers (Punjab) where the five rivers meet. But the Tirtha must be near the sea where Sindhu falls in the sea as Nandin went near the sea (v. 29) for his Japa.
verses.hindi: धीरे-धीरे पर्वतों तथा द्वीपोंवाली पृथ्वी जलसे ढक जाती है और सूर्यकी रश्मियोंद्रारा गृहीत वह जल बादलोंमें स्थित रहता है  पुनः वह जल पृथ्वीपर गिरता है और उससे समुद्र इतने आपूरित हो जाते हैं कि सर्वत्र अपने तटोंका अतिक्रमण कर वे जलमय हो जाते हैं, पर्वत जलमें विलीन हो जाते हैं और पृथ्वी भी जलमें डूब जाती है
verses.wordMeaning: The location of Japyesvara or Japyesvara is doubtful. According to De, , Japyesvara of the LP I.ch. 43 & Siva P. is the same as Jalpisa of the Kalika P. (ch. 77) and is situated to the west of the river Tista in the Jalapaiguri dist. of Bengal.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The location of Japyesvara or Japyesvara is doubtful. According to De, , Japyesvara of the LP I.ch. 43 & Siva P. is the same as Jalpisa of the Kalika P. (ch. 77) and is situated to the west of the river Tista in the Jalapaiguri dist. of Bengal.…
