verses.sanskrit: ततस्तेषां प्रतापेन दह्यमाना वसुंधरा । साद्रिनद्यर्णवद्वीपा निस्नेहा समपद्यत
verses.transliteration: tatasteṣāṃ pratāpena dahyamānā vasuṃdharā / sādrinadyarṇavadvīpā nisnehā samapadyata
verses.translation: For the story of Silada cf. L.P. I. chs. 41-44. But according to L.P. I. 42. 11-15, it was god Siva who was born as Nandin.
verses.hindi: तस्मिन्नेकार्णवे घोरे नष्टे स्थावरजङ्गमे । योगनिद्रां समास्थाय शेते देवः प्रजापतिः
verses.wordMeaning: For the story of Silada cf. L.P. I. chs. 41-44. But according to L.P. I. 42. 11-15, it was god Siva who was born as Nandin.
verses.commentary: Sense: For the story of Silada cf. L.P. I. chs. 41-44. But according to L.P. I. 42. 11-15, it was god Siva who was born as Nandin.

verses.sanskrit: दीप्ताभिः संतताभिश्च रश्मिभिर्वै समन्ततः । अधश्चोर्ध्वं च लग्नाभिस्तिर्यक् चैव समावृतम्
verses.transliteration: dīptābhiḥ saṃtatābhiśca raśmibhirvai samantataḥ / adhaścordhvaṃ ca lagnābhistiryak caiva samāvṛtam
verses.translation: Here Naimisa h etymologically connected with nemi 'rim' of a wheel. Bd. P. and other Puranas mentioned above endorse the same.
verses.hindi: असंख्यातास्तथा कल्पा ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवात्मकाः। कथिता हि पुराणेषु मुनिभिः कालचिन्तकैः सात्तिचकेष्वथ कल्पेषु माहात्म्यमधिकं हरे: । तामसेषु हरस्योक्तं राजसेषु प्रजापतेः
verses.wordMeaning: Here Naimisa h etymologically connected with nemi 'rim' of a wheel. Bd. P. and other Puranas mentioned above endorse the same.
verses.commentary: Sense: Here Naimisa h etymologically connected with nemi 'rim' of a wheel. Bd. P. and other Puranas mentioned above endorse the same.

verses.sanskrit: सूर्याग्निना प्रमृष्टानां संसृष्टानां परस्परम् । एकत्वमुपयातानामेकज्वालं भवत्युत
verses.transliteration: sūryāgninā pramṛṣṭānāṃ saṃsṛṣṭānāṃ parasparam / ekatvamupayātānāmekajvālaṃ bhavatyuta
verses.translation: (Defective verse) O lord, obeisance to you. Please recount, by what means can we see the only lord I Sana, the god with matted hair.
verses.hindi: योऽयं प्रवर्तते कल्पो वाराहः सात्तिचको मत: । अन्ये च सात्त्विका: कल्पा मम तेषु परिग्रहः
verses.wordMeaning: (Defective verse) O lord, obeisance to you. Please recount, by what means can we see the only lord I Sana, the god with matted hair.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Defective verse) O lord, obeisance to you. Please recount, by what means can we see the only lord I Sana, the god with matted hair.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वलोकप्रणाशश्च सो ऽग्निर्भूत्वा सुकुण्डली । चतुर्लोकमिदं सर्वं निर्दहत्यात्मतेजसा
verses.transliteration: sarvalokapraṇāśaśca so 'gnirbhūtvā sukuṇḍalī / caturlokamidaṃ sarvaṃ nirdahatyātmatejasā
verses.translation: "Perform a Satra (a sacrificial session) of the duration of one thousand years with your speech and mind free from defects. I shall tell you the place where you will perform the same."
verses.hindi: एकार्णवे जगत्यस्मिन् योगनिद्रां ब्रजामि तु मां पश्यन्ति महात्मानः सुप्तं कालं महर्षयः । जनलोके वर्तमानास्तपसा योगचक्षुषा
verses.wordMeaning: "Perform a Satra (a sacrificial session) of the duration of one thousand years with your speech and mind free from defects. I shall tell you the place where you will perform the same."
verses.commentary: Sense: "Perform a Satra (a sacrificial session) of the duration of one thousand years with your speech and mind free from defects. I shall tell you the place where you will perform the same."

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रलीने सर्वस्मिञ् जङ्गमे स्थावरे तथा । निर्वृक्षा निस्तृणा भूमिः कूर्मपृष्ठा प्रकाशते
verses.transliteration: tataḥ pralīne sarvasmiñ jaṅgame sthāvare tathā / nirvṛkṣā nistṛṇā bhūmiḥ kūrmapṛṣṭhā prakāśate
verses.translation: He touched the mind-wheel and let it go. Thereafter, he told them "This wheel has been discharged by me. Follow it. Do not delay.
verses.hindi: अहं पुराणपुरुषो भूर्भुवः प्रभवो विभुः। सहस्त्रचरण: श्रीमान् सहस्त्रांशुः सहर्त्रदृक्
verses.wordMeaning: He touched the mind-wheel and let it go. Thereafter, he told them "This wheel has been discharged by me. Follow it. Do not delay.
verses.commentary: Sense: He touched the mind-wheel and let it go. Thereafter, he told them "This wheel has been discharged by me. Follow it. Do not delay.

verses.sanskrit: अम्बरीषमिवाभाति सर्वमापूरितं जगत् । सर्वमेव तदर्चिर्भिः पूर्णं जाज्वल्यते पुनः
verses.transliteration: ambarīṣamivābhāti sarvamāpūritaṃ jagat / sarvameva tadarcirbhiḥ pūrṇaṃ jājvalyate punaḥ
verses.translation: Where the rim of this wheel gets shattered is the auspicious place for the purpose of penance."® Thereafter he let the wheel go and they followed it.
verses.hindi: प्रोक्षणी च स्त्रुवश्चैव सोमो घृतमथास्म्यहम् संवर्तको महानात्मा पवित्रं परमं यशः। वेदो वेद्यं प्रभुर्गोप्ता गोपतिर्ब्रह्मणो मुखम्
verses.wordMeaning: Where the rim of this wheel gets shattered is the auspicious place for the purpose of penance."® Thereafter he let the wheel go and they followed it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Where the rim of this wheel gets shattered is the auspicious place for the purpose of penance."® Thereafter he let the wheel go and they followed it.

verses.sanskrit: पाताले यानि सत्त्वानि महोदधिगतानि च । ततस्तानि प्रलीयन्ते भूमित्वमुपयान्ति च
verses.transliteration: pātāle yāni sattvāni mahodadhigatāni ca / tatastāni pralīyante bhūmitvamupayānti ca
verses.translation: As it rolled on, its rim got shattered at a place which came to be remembered by the name Naimisa. It is very holy and is honoured everywhere.
verses.hindi: अनन्तस्तारको योगी गतिर्गतिमतां वरः।
verses.wordMeaning: As it rolled on, its rim got shattered at a place which came to be remembered by the name Naimisa. It is very holy and is honoured everywhere.
verses.commentary: Sense: As it rolled on, its rim got shattered at a place which came to be remembered by the name Naimisa. It is very holy and is honoured everywhere.

verses.sanskrit: द्वीपांश्च पर्वतांश्चैव वर्षाण्यथ महोदधीन् । तान् सर्वान् भस्मसात् कृत्वा सप्तात्मा पावकः प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: dvīpāṃśca parvatāṃścaiva varṣāṇyatha mahodadhīn / tān sarvān bhasmasāt kṛtvā saptātmā pāvakaḥ prabhuḥ
verses.translation: It is full of Siddhas and Caranas. It is resorted to by Yaksas and Gandharvas. This excellent holy centre Naimisa is the abode of lord Sambhu.
verses.hindi: क्षेत्रज्ञ: प्रकृतिः कालो जगद्बीजमथामृतम्। माता पिता महादेवो मत्तो ह्यन्यन्न विद्यते उस भयंकर एकार्णव (महासमुद्र) -में स्थावर- जंगम सभीके लीन हो जानेपर योगनिद्राका आश्रय ग्रहणकर देव प्रजापति शयन करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: It is full of Siddhas and Caranas. It is resorted to by Yaksas and Gandharvas. This excellent holy centre Naimisa is the abode of lord Sambhu.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is full of Siddhas and Caranas. It is resorted to by Yaksas and Gandharvas. This excellent holy centre Naimisa is the abode of lord Sambhu.

verses.sanskrit: समुद्रेभ्यो नदीभ्यश्च पातालेभ्यश्च सर्वशः । पिबन्नपः समिद्धो ऽग्निः पृथिवीमाश्रितो ज्वलन्
verses.transliteration: samudrebhyo nadībhyaśca pātālebhyaśca sarvaśaḥ / pibannapaḥ samiddho 'gniḥ pṛthivīmāśrito jvalan
verses.translation: Formerly, Devas, alongwith Gandharvas, Yaksas,. serpents and the Raksasas performed their penance here and attained excellent boons.
verses.hindi: महर्षियोंने एक हजार चतुर्युगीका एक कल्प कहा है। अभी जिसका विस्तार बतलाया गया है, वह वाराह कल्प इस समय चल रहा है। ब्रह्मा, विष्णु तथा शिवात्मक असंख्य कल्प हैं। पुराणोंमें काल-
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly, Devas, alongwith Gandharvas, Yaksas,. serpents and the Raksasas performed their penance here and attained excellent boons.
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, Devas, alongwith Gandharvas, Yaksas,. serpents and the Raksasas performed their penance here and attained excellent boons.

verses.sanskrit: ततः संवर्तकः शैलानतिक्रम्य महांस्तथा । लोकान् दहति दीप्तात्मा रुद्रतेजोविजॄम्भितः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ saṃvartakaḥ śailānatikramya mahāṃstathā / lokān dahati dīptātmā rudratejovijṝmbhitaḥ
verses.translation: Resorting to this place, the Satkullyas (the Brahmanas of the six families) propitiated the lord of Devas with great concentration, by means of Satra and perceived Mahesvara.
verses.hindi: चिन्तक मुनियोंने उनका वर्णन किया है। सात्त्विक (सत्त्वप्रधान) कल्योंमें हरिका अधिक माहात्म्य होता है। तामस (तमः:प्रधान) कल्पोंमें शंकरका और राजस (रज:-प्रधान) कल्योंमें प्रजापति ब्रह्माका अधिक माहात्म्य होता है। इस समय प्रवर्तमान वाराह कल्प सात्त्विक कल्प है। अन्य भी सात्त्विक कल्प हैँ, उनमें मुझे कूर्मभगवानूका आश्रय ग्रहण करना चाहिए ॥ ४७--५०॥
verses.wordMeaning: Resorting to this place, the Satkullyas (the Brahmanas of the six families) propitiated the lord of Devas with great concentration, by means of Satra and perceived Mahesvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Resorting to this place, the Satkullyas (the Brahmanas of the six families) propitiated the lord of Devas with great concentration, by means of Satra and perceived Mahesvara.

verses.sanskrit: स दग्ध्वा पृथिवीं देवो रसातलमशोषयत् । अधस्तात् पृथिवीं दग्ध्वा दिवमूर्ध्वं दहिष्यति
verses.transliteration: sa dagdhvā pṛthivīṃ devo rasātalamaśoṣayat / adhastāt pṛthivīṃ dagdhvā divamūrdhvaṃ dahiṣyati
verses.translation: Each of the following holy rites here shall destroy the sin committed in the course of seven births viz. = the Dana rite, the penance performed, the Sraddha offered and the Yajna. performed.
verses.hindi: उन कल्पोंमें योगीजन ध्यान, तप तथा ज्ञान प्राप्तकर उनके द्वारा शंकरकी तथा मेरी आराधना करके परमपदको प्राप्त करते हें । जगत्के एकार्णव हो जानेपर मायाका अधिष्ठाता मैं सत्त्वका आश्रय ग्रहणकर मायामय योगनिद्रामें
verses.wordMeaning: Each of the following holy rites here shall destroy the sin committed in the course of seven births viz. = the Dana rite, the penance performed, the Sraddha offered and the Yajna. performed.
verses.commentary: Sense: Each of the following holy rites here shall destroy the sin committed in the course of seven births viz. = the Dana rite, the penance performed, the Sraddha offered and the Yajna. performed.

verses.sanskrit: योजनानां शतानीह सहस्राण्ययुतानि च । उत्तिष्ठन्ति शिखास्तस्य वह्नेः संवर्तकस्य तु
verses.transliteration: yojanānāṃ śatānīha sahasrāṇyayutāni ca / uttiṣṭhanti śikhāstasya vahneḥ saṃvartakasya tu
verses.translation: Formerly, it was here that the lord, (Brahma) recounted the Brahmanda Purana purified (sanctified) by the (description of the) Brahman, to the sages who were performing the Satra.
verses.hindi: स्थित हो जाता हूँ। उस समय जनलोकमें विद्यमान महात्मा, महर्षिगण तपस्या तथा योगरूपी नेत्रोंके द्वारा निद्रालीन कालस्वरूप मेरा दर्शन करते हैं॥ ५१--५३॥ मैं पुराणपुरुष, भूर्भुवः, प्रभव तथा विभु हूँ, मैं कुश एवं समिधा हूँ और प्रोक्षणी, स्रुव (यज्ञीय पात्र)
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly, it was here that the lord, (Brahma) recounted the Brahmanda Purana purified (sanctified) by the (description of the) Brahman, to the sages who were performing the Satra.
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, it was here that the lord, (Brahma) recounted the Brahmanda Purana purified (sanctified) by the (description of the) Brahman, to the sages who were performing the Satra.

verses.sanskrit: गन्धर्वांश्च पिशाचांश्च सयक्षोरगराक्षसान् । तदा दहत्यसौ दीप्तः कालरुद्रप्रचोदितः
verses.transliteration: gandharvāṃśca piśācāṃśca sayakṣoragarākṣasān / tadā dahatyasau dīptaḥ kālarudrapracoditaḥ
verses.translation: Even till this day, lord Mahadeva of universal vision sports about alongwith his spouse Rudrani, while the Pramathas surround him as attendants.
verses.hindi: (जिसे जाना जाता है), प्रभु, गोप्ता (रक्षक), गोपति (इन्द्रियों एवं वाणीके स्वामी) और ब्रह्माका मुख
verses.wordMeaning: Even till this day, lord Mahadeva of universal vision sports about alongwith his spouse Rudrani, while the Pramathas surround him as attendants.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even till this day, lord Mahadeva of universal vision sports about alongwith his spouse Rudrani, while the Pramathas surround him as attendants.

verses.sanskrit: भूर्लोकं च भुवर्लोकं स्वर्लोकं च तथा महः । दहेदशेषं कालाग्निः कालो विश्वतनुः स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: bhūrlokaṃ ca bhuvarlokaṃ svarlokaṃ ca tathā mahaḥ / dahedaśeṣaṃ kālāgniḥ kālo viśvatanuḥ svayam
verses.translation: Giving up their lives here by means of obser¬ vances, the twice-born will go to the Brahmaloka, after which they are not born again.
verses.hindi: योगी, गति, गतिशीलोंमें श्रेष्ठ, हंस, प्राण, कपिल, विश्वमूर्ति, सनातन, क्षेत्रज्ञ, प्रकृति, काल, जगद्वीज और अमृतस्वरूप हूँ। मैं ही माता, पिता तथा महादेव हूँ, मुझसे अतिरिक्त कुछ भी नहीं है नारायणः पुरुषो योगमूर्तिः।
verses.wordMeaning: Giving up their lives here by means of obser¬ vances, the twice-born will go to the Brahmaloka, after which they are not born again.
verses.commentary: Sense: Giving up their lives here by means of obser¬ vances, the twice-born will go to the Brahmaloka, after which they are not born again.

verses.sanskrit: व्याप्तेष्वेतेषु लोकेषु तिर्यगूर्ध्वमथाग्निना । तत् तेजः समनुप्राप्य कृत्स्नं जगदिदं शनैः । अयोगुडनिभं सर्वं तदा चैकं प्रकाशते
verses.transliteration: vyāpteṣveteṣu lokeṣu tiryagūrdhvamathāgninā / tat tejaḥ samanuprāpya kṛtsnaṃ jagadidaṃ śanaiḥ / ayoguḍanibhaṃ sarvaṃ tadā caikaṃ prakāśate
verses.translation: Another excellent holy centre is what is well-known
verses.hindi: मैं आदित्यके समान वर्णवाला, भुवनोंका रक्षक, नारायण पुरुष तथा योगमूर्ति हूँ। योगपरायण यतिजन मेरा दर्शन करते हैं और अपनी आत्माका ज्ञान प्राप्तकर
verses.wordMeaning: Another excellent holy centre is what is well-known
verses.commentary: Sense: Another excellent holy centre is what is well-known

verses.sanskrit: ततो गजकुलोन्नादास्तडिद्भिः समलङ्कृताः । उत्तिष्ठन्ति तदा व्योम्नि घोराः संवर्तका घनाः
verses.transliteration: tato gajakulonnādāstaḍidbhiḥ samalaṅkṛtāḥ / uttiṣṭhanti tadā vyomni ghorāḥ saṃvartakā ghanāḥ
verses.translation: Mahadeva, the Pinaka-bearing lord, became pleased with him alongwith the goddess. He granted him similarity with himself and ability to defy death.
verses.hindi: व्रजन्ति॥ ५९ ॥  अमृतत्व (मोक्ष)-को प्राप्त करते हैं इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे पट्साहरत्रशं संहितायामुपारिविभागे त्रिचत्वारिँशोऽध्यायः
verses.wordMeaning: Mahadeva, the Pinaka-bearing lord, became pleased with him alongwith the goddess. He granted him similarity with himself and ability to defy death.
verses.commentary: Sense: Mahadeva, the Pinaka-bearing lord, became pleased with him alongwith the goddess. He granted him similarity with himself and ability to defy death.

verses.sanskrit: केचिन्नीलोत्पलश्यामाः केचित् कुमुदसन्निभाः । धूम्रवर्णास्तथा केचित् केचित् पीताः पयोधराः
verses.transliteration: kecinnīlotpalaśyāmāḥ kecit kumudasannibhāḥ / dhūmravarṇāstathā kecit kecit pītāḥ payodharāḥ
verses.translation: There was a virtuous pious-souled sage named 6ilada. In order to acquire His blessing, he worshipped the the bull-bannered Mahadeva.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार छः हजार श्लोकोंवाली श्रीकूर्मपुराणसंहिताके उपरिंविभागमें तैंतालीसवाँ अध्याय समाप्त हुआ
verses.wordMeaning: There was a virtuous pious-souled sage named 6ilada. In order to acquire His blessing, he worshipped the the bull-bannered Mahadeva.
verses.commentary: Sense: There was a virtuous pious-souled sage named 6ilada. In order to acquire His blessing, he worshipped the the bull-bannered Mahadeva.

verses.sanskrit: केचिद् रासभवर्णास्तु लाक्षारसनिभास्तथा । शङ्खकुन्दनिभाश्चान्ये जात्यञ्जननिभाः परे
verses.transliteration: kecid rāsabhavarṇāstu lākṣārasanibhāstathā / śaṅkhakundanibhāścānye jātyañjananibhāḥ pare
verses.translation: At the end of a thousand years since (Silada) he began his austere penance. Sarva, the sustainer of the universe, came to him accompanied by Uma and surrounded by the Ganas and spoke—"I am the granter of boons."
verses.hindi: प्राकृत प्रलयका वर्णन, शिवके विविध रूपों और विविध शक्तियोंका वर्णन, शिवकी आराधनाकी विधि, मुनियोंद्वारा कूर्मरूपधारी विष्णुकी स्तुति, कूर्मपुराणकी वक्तु-श्रोतृपरम्पराका प्रतिपादन, महर्षि व्यास तथा नारायणकी वन्दनाके साथ पुराणकी पूर्णताका कथन
verses.wordMeaning: At the end of a thousand years since (Silada) he began his austere penance. Sarva, the sustainer of the universe, came to him accompanied by Uma and surrounded by the Ganas and spoke—"I am the granter of boons."
verses.commentary: Sense: At the end of a thousand years since (Silada) he began his austere penance. Sarva, the sustainer of the universe, came to him accompanied by Uma and surrounded by the Ganas and spoke—"I am the granter of boons."

verses.sanskrit: मनः शिलाभास्त्वन्ये च कपोतसदृशाः परे । इन्द्रगोपनिभाः केचिद्धरितालनिभास्तथा । इन्द्रचापनिभाः केचिदुत्तिष्ठन्ति घना दिवि
verses.transliteration: manaḥ śilābhāstvanye ca kapotasadṛśāḥ pare / indragopanibhāḥ keciddharitālanibhāstathā / indracāpanibhāḥ keciduttiṣṭhanti ghanā divi
verses.translation: Of I Sana, the foremost deity, the consort of the daughter of the mountain, he begged as follows;—'I request for a son like you who is not born from a womb and who is deathless (immortal).
verses.hindi: प्राकृतं हि समासेन शृणुध्वं गदतो मम
verses.wordMeaning: Of I Sana, the foremost deity, the consort of the daughter of the mountain, he begged as follows;—'I request for a son like you who is not born from a womb and who is deathless (immortal).
verses.commentary: Sense: Of I Sana, the foremost deity, the consort of the daughter of the mountain, he begged as follows;—'I request for a son like you who is not born from a womb and who is deathless (immortal).

verses.sanskrit: केचित् पर्वतसंकाशाः केचिद् गजकुलोपमाः । कूटाङ्गारनिभाश्चान्ये केचिन्मीनकुलोद्वहाः । बहूरूपा घोरूपा घोरस्वरनिनादिनः
verses.transliteration: kecit parvatasaṃkāśāḥ kecid gajakulopamāḥ / kūṭāṅgāranibhāścānye kecinmīnakulodvahāḥ / bahūrūpā ghorūpā ghorasvaraninādinaḥ
verses.translation: Lord Mahesvara accompanied by the goddess said— 'So be it'. Even as the Brahminical sage was looking on, Hara vanished from the scene.
verses.hindi: गते परार्धद्वितये कालो लोकप्रकालनः । कालाग्निर्भस्मसात् कर्तु करोति निखिलं मतिम् स्वात्मन्यात्मानमावेश्य भूत्वा देवो महेश्वरः । दहेदशेषं ब्रह्माण्डं सदेवासुरमानुषम्
verses.wordMeaning: Lord Mahesvara accompanied by the goddess said— 'So be it'. Even as the Brahminical sage was looking on, Hara vanished from the scene.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Mahesvara accompanied by the goddess said— 'So be it'. Even as the Brahminical sage was looking on, Hara vanished from the scene.

verses.sanskrit: तदा जलधराः सर्वे पूरयन्ति नभः स्थलम् । ततस्ते जलदा घोरा राविणो भास्करात्मजाः । सप्तधा संवृतात्मानस्तमग्निं शमयन्त्युत
verses.transliteration: tadā jaladharāḥ sarve pūrayanti nabhaḥ sthalam / tataste jaladā ghorā rāviṇo bhāskarātmajāḥ / saptadhā saṃvṛtātmānastamagniṃ śamayantyuta
verses.translation: On seeing that son born, Silada embraced him. He showed him to the sages who resided in the hermitages there.
verses.hindi: तमाविश्य महादेवो भगवान्नीललोहितः । करोति लोकसंहारं भीषणं रूपमाश्रितः
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing that son born, Silada embraced him. He showed him to the sages who resided in the hermitages there.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing that son born, Silada embraced him. He showed him to the sages who resided in the hermitages there.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्ते जलदा वर्षं मुञ्चन्तीह महौघवत् । सुघोरमशिवं सर्वं नाशयन्ति च पावकम्
verses.transliteration: tataste jaladā varṣaṃ muñcantīha mahaughavat / sughoramaśivaṃ sarvaṃ nāśayanti ca pāvakam
verses.translation: He performed the post-natal and all other rites for him. After investing him with a sacred thread in accordance with the Sastras, he taught his son the Vedas himself.
verses.hindi: निर्दहत्यखिलं लोकं सप्तसप्तिस्वरूपधृक् स दग्ध्वा सकलं सत्त्वमस्त्रं ब्रह्मशिरो महत्।
verses.wordMeaning: He performed the post-natal and all other rites for him. After investing him with a sacred thread in accordance with the Sastras, he taught his son the Vedas himself.
verses.commentary: Sense: He performed the post-natal and all other rites for him. After investing him with a sacred thread in accordance with the Sastras, he taught his son the Vedas himself.

verses.sanskrit: प्रवृष्टे च तदात्यर्थमम्भसा पूर्यते जगत् । अद्भिस्तेजोभिभूतत्वात् तदाग्निः प्रविशत्यपः
verses.transliteration: pravṛṣṭe ca tadātyarthamambhasā pūryate jagat / adbhistejobhibhūtatvāt tadāgniḥ praviśatyapaḥ
verses.translation: Holy lord Nandin, after the study of the Vedas came to an excellent decision. "After seeing lord Mahesvara, I will conquer Mrtyu (death)."
verses.hindi: दग्धेष्वशेषदेवेषु देवी गिरिवरात्मजा। एका सा साक्षिणी शम्भोस्तिष्ठत वैदिकी श्रुति॥७॥  पास स्थित रहती हैंएऐेसी बदक न साक्षिणी शम्भोस्तिष्ठते वैदिकी श्रुति:
verses.wordMeaning: Holy lord Nandin, after the study of the Vedas came to an excellent decision. "After seeing lord Mahesvara, I will conquer Mrtyu (death)."
verses.commentary: Sense: Holy lord Nandin, after the study of the Vedas came to an excellent decision. "After seeing lord Mahesvara, I will conquer Mrtyu (death)."

verses.sanskrit: नष्टे चाग्नौ वर्षशतैः पयोदाः क्षयसंभवाः । प्लावयन्तो ऽथ भुवनं महाजलपरिस्त्रवैः
verses.transliteration: naṣṭe cāgnau varṣaśataiḥ payodāḥ kṣayasaṃbhavāḥ / plāvayanto 'tha bhuvanaṃ mahājalaparistravaiḥ
verses.translation: Endowed with faith and concentration of the mind, he went to the holy ocean and continuously performed the Japa of Rudra with his mind attached to Mahesa.
verses.hindi: ( भगवान्) कूर्मने कहा--इसके अनन्तर अब मैं उत्तम प्राकृत प्रलयका संक्षेपमें वर्णन करूँगा। उसे आप सब श्रवण करें द्वितीय" परार्ध (अर्थात् ब्रह्माजीकी परमायु-दिव्य १०० वर्षका समय)-के बीत जानेपर समस्त लोकोंका लय करनेवाला कालरूप कालाग्नि सम्पूर्ण जगत्को भस्मसात् करनेका निश्चय करता है। महेश्वर देव अपनी
verses.wordMeaning: Endowed with faith and concentration of the mind, he went to the holy ocean and continuously performed the Japa of Rudra with his mind attached to Mahesa.
verses.commentary: Sense: Endowed with faith and concentration of the mind, he went to the holy ocean and continuously performed the Japa of Rudra with his mind attached to Mahesa.

verses.sanskrit: धाराभिः पूरयन्तीदं चोद्यमानाः स्वयंभुवा । अत्यन्तसलिलौघैश्च वेला इव महोदधिः
verses.transliteration: dhārābhiḥ pūrayantīdaṃ codyamānāḥ svayaṃbhuvā / atyantasalilaughaiśca velā iva mahodadhiḥ
verses.translation: When he had completed a crore of Japas, Sankara, favourably disposed to his devotees, came there accompanied by all his Ganas and said—"I am the granter of boons."
verses.hindi: आत्मामें आत्मा (जीवात्मा)-को आविष्टकर देवताओं, असुरों तथा मनुष्योंसे युक्त सम्पूर्ण ब्रह्माण्डको दग्ध करते हैं। भगवान् नीललोहित महादेव भीषण रूप धारणकर उस अग्निमें प्रविष्ट होकर अर्थात् महाकालरूप
verses.wordMeaning: When he had completed a crore of Japas, Sankara, favourably disposed to his devotees, came there accompanied by all his Ganas and said—"I am the granter of boons."
verses.commentary: Sense: When he had completed a crore of Japas, Sankara, favourably disposed to his devotees, came there accompanied by all his Ganas and said—"I am the granter of boons."

verses.sanskrit: साद्रिद्वीपा तथा पृथ्वी जलैः संच्छाद्यते शनैः । आदित्यरश्मिभिः पीतं जलमभ्रेषु तिष्ठति । पुनः पतति तद् भूमौ पूर्यन्ते तेन चार्णवाः
verses.transliteration: sādridvīpā tathā pṛthvī jalaiḥ saṃcchādyate śanaiḥ / ādityaraśmibhiḥ pītaṃ jalamabhreṣu tiṣṭhati / punaḥ patati tad bhūmau pūryante tena cārṇavāḥ
verses.translation: He requested lord Mahadeva the supreme God. Please grant me the boon. I shall perform again a crore of this Japa, which will completely consume worldly existence.
verses.hindi: होकर लोकका संहार करते हैं। सौर-मण्डलमें प्रविष्ट होकर उसे पुनः अनेक रूपवाला बनाकर सात-सात किरणोंबाले सूर्यरूपधारी वे महेश्वर सम्पूर्ण लोकोंको दग्ध करते हैं समस्त सत्त्व (पदार्थो)-को दग्ध करके वे महेश्वर
verses.wordMeaning: He requested lord Mahadeva the supreme God. Please grant me the boon. I shall perform again a crore of this Japa, which will completely consume worldly existence.
verses.commentary: Sense: He requested lord Mahadeva the supreme God. Please grant me the boon. I shall perform again a crore of this Japa, which will completely consume worldly existence.

verses.sanskrit: ततः समुद्राः स्वां वेलामतिक्रान्तास्तु कृत्स्नशः । पर्वताश्च विलीयन्ते मही चाप्सु निमज्जति
verses.transliteration: tataḥ samudrāḥ svāṃ velāmatikrāntāstu kṛtsnaśaḥ / parvatāśca vilīyante mahī cāpsu nimajjati
verses.translation: He requested lord Mahadeva the supreme God. Please grant me the boon. I shall perform again a crore of this Japa, which will completely consume worldly existence.
verses.hindi: नामक महान् अस्त्रको छोड़ते हैं। सम्पूर्ण देवताओंके दग्ध हो जानेपर श्रेष्ठ पर्वत (हिमवान्)-की पुत्री देवी पार्वती अकेली ही साक्षीके रूपमें उन (शिव) -के पास स्थित रहती हैं--ऐसी वैदिकी श्रुति है
verses.wordMeaning: He requested lord Mahadeva the supreme God. Please grant me the boon. I shall perform again a crore of this Japa, which will completely consume worldly existence.
verses.commentary: Sense: He requested lord Mahadeva the supreme God. Please grant me the boon. I shall perform again a crore of this Japa, which will completely consume worldly existence.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्नेकार्णवे घोरे नष्टे स्थावरजङ्गमे । योगनिन्द्रां समास्थाय शेते देवः प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: tasminnekārṇave ghore naṣṭe sthāvarajaṅgame / yoganindrāṃ samāsthāya śete devaḥ prajāpatiḥ
verses.translation: He requested lord Mahadeva the supreme God. Please grant me the boon. I shall perform again a crore of this Japa, which will completely consume worldly existence.
verses.hindi: अ० ५) शब्दकल्पद्रुममें उद्धृत। शिरःकपालैर्देवानां कृतस्त्रग्वरभूषणः । आदित्यचन्द्रादिगणैः पूरयन् व्योममण्डलम्
verses.wordMeaning: He requested lord Mahadeva the supreme God. Please grant me the boon. I shall perform again a crore of this Japa, which will completely consume worldly existence.
verses.commentary: Sense: He requested lord Mahadeva the supreme God. Please grant me the boon. I shall perform again a crore of this Japa, which will completely consume worldly existence.

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्युगसहस्रान्तं कल्पमाहुर्महर्षयः । वाराहो वर्तते कल्पो यस्य विस्तार ईरितः
verses.transliteration: caturyugasahasrāntaṃ kalpamāhurmaharṣayaḥ / vārāho vartate kalpo yasya vistāra īritaḥ
verses.translation: He requested lord Mahadeva the supreme God. Please grant me the boon. I shall perform again a crore of this Japa, which will completely consume worldly existence.
verses.hindi: सहरस्त्रनयनो देवः सहस्त्राकृतिरीश्वरः। सहस्त्रहस्तचरणः सहस्त्राचिर्महाभुजः
verses.wordMeaning: He requested lord Mahadeva the supreme God. Please grant me the boon. I shall perform again a crore of this Japa, which will completely consume worldly existence.
verses.commentary: Sense: He requested lord Mahadeva the supreme God. Please grant me the boon. I shall perform again a crore of this Japa, which will completely consume worldly existence.

verses.sanskrit: असंख्यातास्तथा कल्पा ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवात्मकाः । कथिता हि पुराणेषु मुनिभिः कालचिन्तकैः
verses.transliteration: asaṃkhyātāstathā kalpā brahmaviṣṇuśivātmakāḥ / kathitā hi purāṇeṣu munibhiḥ kālacintakaiḥ
verses.translation: He requested lord Mahadeva the supreme God. Please grant me the boon. I shall perform again a crore of this Japa, which will completely consume worldly existence.
verses.hindi: दंष्ट्राकरालवदनः प्रदीप्तानललोचनः। करोति ताण्डवं देवीमालोक्य परमेश्वरः
verses.wordMeaning: He requested lord Mahadeva the supreme God. Please grant me the boon. I shall perform again a crore of this Japa, which will completely consume worldly existence.
verses.commentary: Sense: He requested lord Mahadeva the supreme God. Please grant me the boon. I shall perform again a crore of this Japa, which will completely consume worldly existence.

verses.sanskrit: सात्त्विकेष्वथ कल्पेषु माहात्म्यमधिकं हरेः । तामसेषु हरस्योक्तं राजसेषु प्रजापतेः
verses.transliteration: sāttvikeṣvatha kalpeṣu māhātmyamadhikaṃ hareḥ / tāmaseṣu harasyoktaṃ rājaseṣu prajāpateḥ
verses.translation: He requested lord Mahadeva the supreme God. Please grant me the boon. I shall perform again a crore of this Japa, which will completely consume worldly existence.
verses.hindi: पीत्वा नृत्तामृतं देवी भर्तुः परममङ्गला। योगमास्थाय देवस्य देहमायाति शूलिनः
verses.wordMeaning: He requested lord Mahadeva the supreme God. Please grant me the boon. I shall perform again a crore of this Japa, which will completely consume worldly existence.
verses.commentary: Sense: He requested lord Mahadeva the supreme God. Please grant me the boon. I shall perform again a crore of this Japa, which will completely consume worldly existence.

verses.sanskrit: यो ऽयं प्रवर्तते कल्पो वाराहः सात्त्विको मतः । अन्ये च सात्त्विकाः कल्पा मम तेषु परिग्रहः
verses.transliteration: yo 'yaṃ pravartate kalpo vārāhaḥ sāttviko mataḥ / anye ca sāttvikāḥ kalpā mama teṣu parigrahaḥ
verses.translation: He requested lord Mahadeva the supreme God. Please grant me the boon. I shall perform again a crore of this Japa, which will completely consume worldly existence.
verses.hindi: ज्योतिः स्वभावं भगवान् दग्ध्वा ब्रह्माण्डमण्डलम् संस्थितेष्वथ देवेषु ब्रह्मविष्णुपिनाकिषु। गुणैरशेषैः पृथिवी विलयं याति वारिषु
verses.wordMeaning: He requested lord Mahadeva the supreme God. Please grant me the boon. I shall perform again a crore of this Japa, which will completely consume worldly existence.
verses.commentary: Sense: He requested lord Mahadeva the supreme God. Please grant me the boon. I shall perform again a crore of this Japa, which will completely consume worldly existence.

verses.sanskrit: ध्यानं तपस्तथा ज्ञानं लब्ध्वा तेष्वेव योगिनः । आराध्य गिरिशं मां च यान्ति तत् परमं पदम्
verses.transliteration: dhyānaṃ tapastathā jñānaṃ labdhvā teṣveva yoginaḥ / ārādhya giriśaṃ māṃ ca yānti tat paramaṃ padam
verses.translation: He requested lord Mahadeva the supreme God. Please grant me the boon. I shall perform again a crore of this Japa, which will completely consume worldly existence.
verses.hindi: आकाशे सगुणो वायुः प्रलयं याति विश्वभृत्। भूतादौ च तथाकाशं लीयते गुणसंयुतम्
verses.wordMeaning: He requested lord Mahadeva the supreme God. Please grant me the boon. I shall perform again a crore of this Japa, which will completely consume worldly existence.
verses.commentary: Sense: He requested lord Mahadeva the supreme God. Please grant me the boon. I shall perform again a crore of this Japa, which will completely consume worldly existence.

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽहं सत्त्वं समास्थाय मायी मायामयीं स्वयम् । एकार्णवे जगत्यस्मिन् योगनिद्रां व्रजामि तु
verses.transliteration: so 'haṃ sattvaṃ samāsthāya māyī māyāmayīṃ svayam / ekārṇave jagatyasmin yoganidrāṃ vrajāmi tu
verses.translation: He requested lord Mahadeva the supreme God. Please grant me the boon. I shall perform again a crore of this Japa, which will completely consume worldly existence.
verses.hindi: इन्द्रियाणि च सर्वाणि तैजसे यान्ति संक्षयम्। वैकारिके देवगणाः प्रलयं यान्ति सत्तमाः वैकारिकस्तैजसश्च भूतादिश्चेति सत्तमाः। त्रिविधोऽयमहंकारो महति प्रलयं व्रजेत्
verses.wordMeaning: He requested lord Mahadeva the supreme God. Please grant me the boon. I shall perform again a crore of this Japa, which will completely consume worldly existence.
verses.commentary: Sense: He requested lord Mahadeva the supreme God. Please grant me the boon. I shall perform again a crore of this Japa, which will completely consume worldly existence.

verses.sanskrit: मां पश्यन्ति महात्मानः सुप्तं कालं महर्षयः । जनलोके वर्तमानास्तपसा योगचक्षुषा
verses.transliteration: māṃ paśyanti mahātmānaḥ suptaṃ kālaṃ maharṣayaḥ / janaloke vartamānāstapasā yogacakṣuṣā
verses.translation: He requested lord Mahadeva the supreme God. Please grant me the boon. I shall perform again a crore of this Japa, which will completely consume worldly existence.
verses.hindi: महान्तमेभिः सहितं ब्रह्माणमतितेजसम्। अव्यक्तं जगतो योनिः संहरेदेकमव्ययम्
verses.wordMeaning: He requested lord Mahadeva the supreme God. Please grant me the boon. I shall perform again a crore of this Japa, which will completely consume worldly existence.
verses.commentary: Sense: He requested lord Mahadeva the supreme God. Please grant me the boon. I shall perform again a crore of this Japa, which will completely consume worldly existence.

verses.sanskrit: अहं पुराणपुरुषो भूर्भुवः प्रभवो विभुः । सहस्रचरणः श्रीमान् सहस्रांशुः सहस्रदृक्
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ purāṇapuruṣo bhūrbhuvaḥ prabhavo vibhuḥ / sahasracaraṇaḥ śrīmān sahasrāṃśuḥ sahasradṛk
verses.translation: He requested lord Mahadeva the supreme God. Please grant me the boon. I shall perform again a crore of this Japa, which will completely consume worldly existence.
verses.hindi: आभूषणरूपमें धारण करनेवाले, हजारों नेत्रवाले, हजारों भीषण दंष्ट्रा (दाढ)-के कारण भयंकर मुखोंबाले, प्रदीप्त अग्निके समान नेत्रोंवाले, त्रिशूली चर्माम्बरधारी वे देव महेश्वर अनन्त सूर्य एवं चन्द्रके समूहोंसे समस्त आकाशमण्डलको व्याप्तकर ऐश्वरयोगमें स्थित हो
verses.wordMeaning: He requested lord Mahadeva the supreme God. Please grant me the boon. I shall perform again a crore of this Japa, which will completely consume worldly existence.
verses.commentary: Sense: He requested lord Mahadeva the supreme God. Please grant me the boon. I shall perform again a crore of this Japa, which will completely consume worldly existence.

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्रो ऽग्निर्ब्राह्मिणा गावः कुशाश्च समिधो ह्यहम् । प्रोक्षणी च श्रुवश्चैव सोमो घृतमथास्म्यहम्
verses.transliteration: mantro 'gnirbrāhmiṇā gāvaḥ kuśāśca samidho hyaham / prokṣaṇī ca śruvaścaiva somo ghṛtamathāsmyaham
verses.translation: He requested lord Mahadeva the supreme God. Please grant me the boon. I shall perform again a crore of this Japa, which will completely consume worldly existence.
verses.hindi: जाते हें और भगवती पार्वतीको देखते हुए परमानन्दमय अमृतका पानकर स्वयं ताण्डव नृत्य करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: He requested lord Mahadeva the supreme God. Please grant me the boon. I shall perform again a crore of this Japa, which will completely consume worldly existence.
verses.commentary: Sense: He requested lord Mahadeva the supreme God. Please grant me the boon. I shall perform again a crore of this Japa, which will completely consume worldly existence.

verses.sanskrit: संवर्तको महानात्मा पवित्रं परमं यशः । वेदो वेद्यं प्रभुर्गोप्ता गोपतिर्ब्रह्मणो मुखम्
verses.transliteration: saṃvartako mahānātmā pavitraṃ paramaṃ yaśaḥ / vedo vedyaṃ prabhurgoptā gopatirbrahmaṇo mukham
verses.translation: He requested lord Mahadeva the supreme God. Please grant me the boon. I shall perform again a crore of this Japa, which will completely consume worldly existence.
verses.hindi: पतिके नृत्यरूपी अमृतका पानकर परम कल्याणरूपिणी देवी (पार्वती) योगका आश्रय लेते हुए त्रिशूली शिवके शरीरमें प्रविष्ट हो जाती हैं। ब्रह्माण्डमण्डलको दग्ध करनेके अनन्तर पिनाक धारण करनेवाले भगवान् (शिव) अपनी इच्छासे ही ताण्डव (-के आनन्द)- रसका परित्यागकर ज्योति:स्वरूप अपने भावमें स्थित हो जाते हैं। ब्रह्मा, विष्णु तथा पिनाकी शिवके इस प्रकार स्थित हो जानेपर अपने सम्पूर्ण गुणोंके साथ
verses.wordMeaning: He requested lord Mahadeva the supreme God. Please grant me the boon. I shall perform again a crore of this Japa, which will completely consume worldly existence.
verses.commentary: Sense: He requested lord Mahadeva the supreme God. Please grant me the boon. I shall perform again a crore of this Japa, which will completely consume worldly existence.

verses.sanskrit: अनन्तस्तारको योगी गतिर्गतिमतां वरः । हंसः प्राणो ऽथ कपिलो विश्वमूर्तिः सनातनः
verses.transliteration: anantastārako yogī gatirgatimatāṃ varaḥ / haṃsaḥ prāṇo 'tha kapilo viśvamūrtiḥ sanātanaḥ
verses.translation: He requested lord Mahadeva the supreme God. Please grant me the boon. I shall perform again a crore of this Japa, which will completely consume worldly existence.
verses.hindi: पृथ्वी जलमें विलीन हो जाती है। अपने गुणोंसहित उस जल-तत्त्वको हव्यवाहन अग्नि ग्रहण कर लेता है और अपने गुणोंसहित वह तेज (अग्नि) वायुमें विलीन हो जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: He requested lord Mahadeva the supreme God. Please grant me the boon. I shall perform again a crore of this Japa, which will completely consume worldly existence.
verses.commentary: Sense: He requested lord Mahadeva the supreme God. Please grant me the boon. I shall perform again a crore of this Japa, which will completely consume worldly existence.

verses.sanskrit: क्षेत्रज्ञः प्रकृतिः कालो जगद्बीजमथामृतम् । माता पिता महादेवो मत्तो ह्यन्यन्न विद्यते
verses.transliteration: kṣetrajñaḥ prakṛtiḥ kālo jagadbījamathāmṛtam / mātā pitā mahādevo matto hyanyanna vidyate
verses.translation: He requested lord Mahadeva the supreme God. Please grant me the boon. I shall perform again a crore of this Japa, which will completely consume worldly existence.
verses.hindi: विश्वका भरण-पोषण करनेवाला वायु अपने गुणोंके साथ आकाश (तत्त्व)-में लीन हो जाता है और अपने गुणसहित वह आकाश भूतादि अर्थात् तामस अहंकारमें लीन हो जाता है। सत्तमो! सभी इन्द्रियाँ तैजस अर्थात् राजस अहंकारमें विलीन हो जाती हैं और (इन्द्रियोंके अधिष्ठाता) देवगण वैकारिक अर्थात् सात्त्विक अहंकारमें प्रलीन हो जाते हैं। श्रेष्ठो! वैकारिक, तैजस तथा भूतादि (तामस) नामक तीन प्रकारका अहंकार महत्तत्त्वमें
verses.wordMeaning: He requested lord Mahadeva the supreme God. Please grant me the boon. I shall perform again a crore of this Japa, which will completely consume worldly existence.
verses.commentary: Sense: He requested lord Mahadeva the supreme God. Please grant me the boon. I shall perform again a crore of this Japa, which will completely consume worldly existence.

verses.sanskrit: आदित्यवर्णो भुवनस्य गोप्ता नारायणः पुरुषो योगमूर्तिः । मां पश्यन्ति यतयो योगनिष्ठा ज्ञात्वात्मानममृतत्वं व्रजन्ति
verses.transliteration: ādityavarṇo bhuvanasya goptā nārāyaṇaḥ puruṣo yogamūrtiḥ / māṃ paśyanti yatayo yoganiṣṭhā jñātvātmānamamṛtatvaṃ vrajanti
verses.translation: He requested lord Mahadeva the supreme God. Please grant me the boon. I shall perform again a crore of this Japa, which will completely consume worldly existence.
verses.wordMeaning: He requested lord Mahadeva the supreme God. Please grant me the boon. I shall perform again a crore of this Japa, which will completely consume worldly existence.
verses.commentary: Sense: He requested lord Mahadeva the supreme God. Please grant me the boon. I shall perform again a crore of this Japa, which will completely consume worldly existence.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षट्साहस्त्र्यां संहितायामुपरिविभागे त्रिचत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः कूर्म उवाच अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि प्रतिसर्गमनुत्तमम् । प्राकृतं हि समासेन शृणुध्वं गदतो मम
verses.transliteration: iti śrīkūrmapurāṇe ṣaṭsāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāmuparivibhāge tricatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ kūrma uvāca ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi pratisargamanuttamam / prākṛtaṃ hi samāsena śṛṇudhvaṃ gadato mama
verses.translation: After saying "So be it" the lord vanished from the scene. The holy one (i.e. Nandin) performed a crore of Japa with his mind centred on him.
verses.hindi: यह महत्तत्त्व पृथ्वीसे अहंकारपर्यन्त समस्त तत्त्वोंका मूल होनेके कारण एक प्रकारसे अमित तेजस्वी ब्रह्मा ही हैं। अतः ब्रह्मारूप तथा अपनेमें पृथ्वी आदि समस्त तत्त्वोंको समाविष्ट कर लेनेवाले इस अद्वितीय महत्तत्त्वका संहार वह प्रकृति कर देती है, जो अव्यक्त है एवं समस्त जगतूका मूल कारण है। इस प्रकार (पञ्च) भूतों तथा तत्त्वोंका संहारकर महेश्वर प्रधान--प्रकृति और पुरुषको परस्पर वियुक्त कर देते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: After saying "So be it" the lord vanished from the scene. The holy one (i.e. Nandin) performed a crore of Japa with his mind centred on him.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying "So be it" the lord vanished from the scene. The holy one (i.e. Nandin) performed a crore of Japa with his mind centred on him.

verses.sanskrit: गते परार्धद्वितये कालो लोकप्रकालनः । कालाग्निर्भस्मसात् कर्तुं करोति निकिलं मतिम्
verses.transliteration: gate parārdhadvitaye kālo lokaprakālanaḥ / kālāgnirbhasmasāt kartuṃ karoti nikilaṃ matim
verses.translation: When the second crore was completed, the bull- bannered lord came there surrounded by the groups of Bhutas (goblins) and said—"I am the granter of boons".
verses.hindi: कूटस्थश्चिन्मयो ह्यात्मा केवलः पञ्चविंशकः । गीयते मुनिभिः साक्षी महानेकः पितामहः
verses.wordMeaning: When the second crore was completed, the bull- bannered lord came there surrounded by the groups of Bhutas (goblins) and said—"I am the granter of boons".
verses.commentary: Sense: When the second crore was completed, the bull- bannered lord came there surrounded by the groups of Bhutas (goblins) and said—"I am the granter of boons".

verses.sanskrit: स्वात्मन्यात्मानमावेश्य भूत्वा देवो महेश्वरः । दहेदशेषं ब्रह्माण्डं सदेवासुरमानुषम्
verses.transliteration: svātmanyātmānamāveśya bhūtvā devo maheśvaraḥ / dahedaśeṣaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣam
verses.translation: (Nandin said) "O Sankara, I wish to perform the third crore of Japa too" The Atman of the universe said—"So be it." and vanished alongwith the goddess.
verses.hindi: एवं संहारकरणी शक्तिमहिश्चरी ध्षुवा। प्रधानाद्यं विशेषान्तं दहेद् रुद्र इति श्रुतिः आत्यन्तिकं चैव लयं विदधातीह शंकरः
verses.wordMeaning: (Nandin said) "O Sankara, I wish to perform the third crore of Japa too" The Atman of the universe said—"So be it." and vanished alongwith the goddess.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Nandin said) "O Sankara, I wish to perform the third crore of Japa too" The Atman of the universe said—"So be it." and vanished alongwith the goddess.

verses.sanskrit: तमाविश्य महादेवो भगवान्नीललोहितः । करोति लोकसंहारं भीषणं रूपमाश्रितः
verses.transliteration: tamāviśya mahādevo bhagavānnīlalohitaḥ / karoti lokasaṃhāraṃ bhīṣaṇaṃ rūpamāśritaḥ
verses.translation: When the third crore of Japa was completed, the lord was much delighted in the mind. He came there surrounded by the Bhutas and said—"I am the granter of boons".
verses.hindi: इत्येष भगवान् रुद्रः संहारं कुरुते वशी। स्थापिका मोहनी शक्तिर्नारायण इति श्रुति:
verses.wordMeaning: When the third crore of Japa was completed, the lord was much delighted in the mind. He came there surrounded by the Bhutas and said—"I am the granter of boons".
verses.commentary: Sense: When the third crore of Japa was completed, the lord was much delighted in the mind. He came there surrounded by the Bhutas and said—"I am the granter of boons".

verses.sanskrit: प्रविश्य मण्डलं सौरं कृत्वासौ बहुधा पुनः । निर्दहत्यखिलं लोकं सप्तसप्तिस्वरूपधृक्
verses.transliteration: praviśya maṇḍalaṃ sauraṃ kṛtvāsau bahudhā punaḥ / nirdahatyakhilaṃ lokaṃ saptasaptisvarūpadhṛk
verses.translation: (Nandin said), "I shall perform a crore more of the Japa with thy brilliance". When this was said the lord said:— You must not perform the Japa further.
verses.hindi: हिरण्यगर्भो भगवान् जगत् सदसदात्मकम्। सृजेदशेषं प्रकृतेस्तन्मयः पञ्चविंशकः शक्तयो ब्रह्मविष्णवीशा भुक्तिमुक्तिफलप्रदाः
verses.wordMeaning: (Nandin said), "I shall perform a crore more of the Japa with thy brilliance". When this was said the lord said:— You must not perform the Japa further.
verses.commentary: Sense: (Nandin said), "I shall perform a crore more of the Japa with thy brilliance". When this was said the lord said:— You must not perform the Japa further.

verses.sanskrit: स दग्ध्वा सकलं सत्त्वमस्त्रं ब्रह्मशिरो महत् । देवतानां शरीरेषु क्षिपत्यखिलदाहकम्
verses.transliteration: sa dagdhvā sakalaṃ sattvamastraṃ brahmaśiro mahat / devatānāṃ śarīreṣu kṣipatyakhiladāhakam
verses.translation: The perfect knov/ledge pertaining to me and named after me shall be accessible to you as easily as the fruit of the myrobalan in the palm. You will be alive till the dissolution of all living beings. Thereafter you shall attain my region."
verses.hindi: इज्यन्ते विविधेर्यज्ञेः शक्रादित्यादयोऽमराः
verses.wordMeaning: The perfect knov/ledge pertaining to me and named after me shall be accessible to you as easily as the fruit of the myrobalan in the palm. You will be alive till the dissolution of all living beings. Thereafter you shall attain my region."
verses.commentary: Sense: The perfect knov/ledge pertaining to me and named after me shall be accessible to you as easily as the fruit of the myrobalan in the palm. You will be alive till the dissolution of all living beings. Thereafter you shall attain my region."

verses.sanskrit: दग्धेष्वशेषदेवेषु देवी गिरिवरात्मजा । एकासा साक्षिणी शंभोस्तिष्ठते वैदिकी श्रुतिः
verses.transliteration: dagdheṣvaśeṣadeveṣu devī girivarātmajā / ekāsā sākṣiṇī śaṃbhostiṣṭhate vaidikī śrutiḥ
verses.translation: This Japyesvara is the abode of the trident-bearing lord of Devas. The man who dies here is honoured in the Rudra-loka.
verses.hindi: इस (प्रकृति-पुरुष वियोगको) ही अनादि प्रकृति और पुरुषका संहार कहा जाता है (क्योंकि सांख्यशास्त्रके अनुसार इन दोनोंके नित्य होनेसे इनका लय कहीं नहीं हो सकता) । यह (वियोगरूप) लय भी महेश्वरकी इच्छासे ही होनेवाला है, स्वयं नहीं हो सकता। गुणोंकी साम्यावस्था ही प्रकृति है और अव्यक्त है। जगतका मूल कारण प्रधान है। वह अचेतन है, इसे मायाके रूपमें समझना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: This Japyesvara is the abode of the trident-bearing lord of Devas. The man who dies here is honoured in the Rudra-loka.
verses.commentary: Sense: This Japyesvara is the abode of the trident-bearing lord of Devas. The man who dies here is honoured in the Rudra-loka.

verses.sanskrit: शिरः कपालैर्देवानां कृतस्त्रग्वरभूषणः । आदित्यचन्द्रादिगणैः पूरयन् व्योममण्डलम्
verses.transliteration: śiraḥ kapālairdevānāṃ kṛtastragvarabhūṣaṇaḥ / ādityacandrādigaṇaiḥ pūrayan vyomamaṇḍalam
verses.translation: VV. 140b-146a describe the three oral traditions of the KP as follows:
verses.hindi: चेतन होता है। मुनिगण इसे साक्षी, महान् तथा पितामह कहते हैं । इतनेसे यह स्पष्ट है कि महेश्वरकी शाश्वत शक्ति ही संहार करती है। श्रुतिका भी यही कथन है कि रुद्र प्रधान अर्थात् प्रकृतिसे विशेष अर्थात् स्थूल-
verses.wordMeaning: VV. 140b-146a describe the three oral traditions of the KP as follows:
verses.commentary: Sense: VV. 140b-146a describe the three oral traditions of the KP as follows:

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रनयनो देवः सहस्राकृतिरिश्वरः । सहस्रहस्तचरणः सहस्रार्चिर्महाभुजः
verses.transliteration: sahasranayano devaḥ sahasrākṛtiriśvaraḥ / sahasrahastacaraṇaḥ sahasrārcirmahābhujaḥ
verses.translation: The concluding verse confirms the original Vaisnavite form of this Purana.
verses.hindi: भूतपर्यन्त सभी तत्त्वोंको दग्ध करते हैं। ज्ञानपरायण सभी योगियोंका आत्यन्तिक प्रलय भी शंकर ही करते हैं इस प्रकार सबको अपने वशमें रखनेवाले ये भगवान् रुद्र ही संहार करते हैं। श्रुतिके अनुसार (जगत्की) स्थापना करनेवाली (रुद्रकी) मोहनी शक्तिको ही नारायण कहते हैं। पचीसवें तत्त्व अर्थात् पुरुषस्वरूप भगवान्
verses.wordMeaning: The concluding verse confirms the original Vaisnavite form of this Purana.
verses.commentary: Sense: The concluding verse confirms the original Vaisnavite form of this Purana.

verses.sanskrit: दंष्ट्राकरालवदनः प्रदीप्तानललोचनः । त्रिशूली कृत्तिवसनो योगमैश्वरमास्थितः
verses.transliteration: daṃṣṭrākarālavadanaḥ pradīptānalalocanaḥ / triśūlī kṛttivasano yogamaiśvaramāsthitaḥ
verses.translation: After projecting the Atman (his self) into Atman, and having become lord Mahesvara, he (Kala) burns the entire cosmic egg including Devas, Asuras and human beings.
verses.hindi: हिरण्यगर्भ प्रकृतिसे तन्मय (संयुक्त) होकर सम्पूर्ण सत्- असदात्मक जगतूकी सृष्टि करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: After projecting the Atman (his self) into Atman, and having become lord Mahesvara, he (Kala) burns the entire cosmic egg including Devas, Asuras and human beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: After projecting the Atman (his self) into Atman, and having become lord Mahesvara, he (Kala) burns the entire cosmic egg including Devas, Asuras and human beings.

verses.sanskrit: पीत्वा तत्परमानन्दं प्रभूतममृतं स्वयम् । करोति ताण्डवं देवीमालोक्य परमेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: pītvā tatparamānandaṃ prabhūtamamṛtaṃ svayam / karoti tāṇḍavaṃ devīmālokya parameśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Having entered into him (Kalagni), lord Mahadeva, Nilalohita, assumes a terrible form and annihilates the worlds.
verses.hindi: अपनी आत्मामें ही व्यवस्थित रहनेवाली (अर्थात् स्वयंमें ही अधिष्ठित वस्तुतः निरधिष्ठान) ब्रह्मा, विष्णु तीन शक्तियाँ भोग तथा मोक्षरूप फलको देनेवाली हैं । ये शक्तियाँ सर्वेश्वरस्वरूप, सभीके द्वारा वन्दनीय, शाश्वत और अनन्त भोगोंसे सम्पन्न हैं। अद्वितीय अक्षर तत्त्व ही पुरुष, प्रधान और ईश्वररूप है
verses.wordMeaning: Having entered into him (Kalagni), lord Mahadeva, Nilalohita, assumes a terrible form and annihilates the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Having entered into him (Kalagni), lord Mahadeva, Nilalohita, assumes a terrible form and annihilates the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: पीत्वा नृत्तामृतं देवी भर्तुः परममङ्गला । योगमास्थाय देवस्य देहमायाति शूलिनः
verses.transliteration: pītvā nṛttāmṛtaṃ devī bhartuḥ paramamaṅgalā / yogamāsthāya devasya dehamāyāti śūlinaḥ
verses.translation: Entering the solar sphere and manifesting himself in various ways, he assumes the form of the scven-steeded deity (i.e. the sun) and burns the entire world.
verses.hindi: उस परमात्मा (अव्यक्त अक्षर-तत्त्व)-में अन्य भी इन्द्र, सूर्य आदि हजारों दिव्य शक्तियाँ हैं। इनकी भी विविध यज्ञोंके द्वारा आराधना की जाती है। इन इन्द्र, सूर्य आदि एक-एक देवका भी ऐसा माहात्म्य
verses.wordMeaning: Entering the solar sphere and manifesting himself in various ways, he assumes the form of the scven-steeded deity (i.e. the sun) and burns the entire world.
verses.commentary: Sense: Entering the solar sphere and manifesting himself in various ways, he assumes the form of the scven-steeded deity (i.e. the sun) and burns the entire world.

verses.sanskrit: संत्यक्त्वा ताण्डवरसं स्वेच्छयैव पिनाकधृक् । ज्योतिः स्वभावं भगवान् दग्ध्वा ब्रह्माण्डमण्डलम्
verses.transliteration: saṃtyaktvā tāṇḍavarasaṃ svecchayaiva pinākadhṛk / jyotiḥ svabhāvaṃ bhagavān dagdhvā brahmāṇḍamaṇḍalam
verses.translation: After burning the entire universe, he d ischarges the great miraculous weapon Brahmasiras, that burns everything, on the bodies of deities.
verses.hindi: है कि इनके सेकड़ों-हजारों अर्थात् अनन्त शरीर हैं और इन शरीरोंमें लोक-कल्याणके लिये अनन्त शक्तियाँ हैं, पर वस्तुतः इन सबका मूल एक ही निर्गुण शक्ति है- तां तां शक्ति समाधाय स्वयं देवो महेश्वरः । करोति देहान् विविधान् ग्रसते चैव लीलया
verses.wordMeaning: After burning the entire universe, he d ischarges the great miraculous weapon Brahmasiras, that burns everything, on the bodies of deities.
verses.commentary: Sense: After burning the entire universe, he d ischarges the great miraculous weapon Brahmasiras, that burns everything, on the bodies of deities.

verses.sanskrit: संस्थितेष्वथ देवेषु ब्रह्मविष्णुपिनाकिषु । गुणैरशेषैः पृथिवीविलयं याति वारिषु
verses.transliteration: saṃsthiteṣvatha deveṣu brahmaviṣṇupinākiṣu / guṇairaśeṣaiḥ pṛthivīvilayaṃ yāti vāriṣu
verses.translation: When all Devas had been burnt, the goddess, the daughter of the most excellent of the mountains, stands by as the sole witness of Sambhu. So says the Vedic Srutis.
verses.hindi: इज्यते सर्वयज्ञेषु ब्राह्मणैर्वदवादिभिः। सर्वकामप्रदो रुद्र इत्येषा वैदिकी श्रुतिः
verses.wordMeaning: When all Devas had been burnt, the goddess, the daughter of the most excellent of the mountains, stands by as the sole witness of Sambhu. So says the Vedic Srutis.
verses.commentary: Sense: When all Devas had been burnt, the goddess, the daughter of the most excellent of the mountains, stands by as the sole witness of Sambhu. So says the Vedic Srutis.

verses.sanskrit: स वारितत्त्वं सगुणं ग्रसते हव्यवाहनः । तेजस्तु गुणसंयुक्तं वायौ संयाति संक्षयम्
verses.transliteration: sa vāritattvaṃ saguṇaṃ grasate havyavāhanaḥ / tejastu guṇasaṃyuktaṃ vāyau saṃyāti saṃkṣayam
verses.translation: The lord makes an excellent garland of the skulls of the heads of Devas and decorates himself with it. He fills the sphere of the firmament by the multitudes of suns and moons etc.
verses.hindi: सर्वासामेव शक्तीनां ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वराः। प्राधान्येन स्मृता देवाः शक्तयः परमात्मनः आद्य: परस्ताद् भगवान् परमात्मा सनातनः । गीयते सर्वशक्त्यात्मा शूलपाणिर्महेश्वरः
verses.wordMeaning: The lord makes an excellent garland of the skulls of the heads of Devas and decorates himself with it. He fills the sphere of the firmament by the multitudes of suns and moons etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord makes an excellent garland of the skulls of the heads of Devas and decorates himself with it. He fills the sphere of the firmament by the multitudes of suns and moons etc.

verses.sanskrit: आकाशे सगुणो वायुः प्रलयं याति विश्वभृत् । भूतादौ च तथाकाशं लीयते गुणसंयुतम्
verses.transliteration: ākāśe saguṇo vāyuḥ pralayaṃ yāti viśvabhṛt / bhūtādau ca tathākāśaṃ līyate guṇasaṃyutam
verses.translation: The lord has a thousand (i.e. innumerable) eyes and a thousand eyelids (v. 1. thousand forms), a thousand hands and feet and a thousand rays of splendour. He is mightily-armed.
verses.hindi: एनमेके वदन्त्यग्निं नारायणमथापरे। इन्द्रमेके परे विश्वान् ब्रह्माणमपरे जगुः
verses.wordMeaning: The lord has a thousand (i.e. innumerable) eyes and a thousand eyelids (v. 1. thousand forms), a thousand hands and feet and a thousand rays of splendour. He is mightily-armed.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord has a thousand (i.e. innumerable) eyes and a thousand eyelids (v. 1. thousand forms), a thousand hands and feet and a thousand rays of splendour. He is mightily-armed.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रियाणि च सर्वाणि तैजसे यान्ति संक्षयम् । वैकारिके देवगणाः प्रलंय यान्ति सत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: indriyāṇi ca sarvāṇi taijase yānti saṃkṣayam / vaikārike devagaṇāḥ pralaṃya yānti sattamāḥ
verses.translation: His face is terrible due to the curved fangs. His eyes shine like blazing fires. Holding the trident and wearing the elephant hide, he is established in his lordly Yoga.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मविष्णवग्निवरुणाः सर्वे देवास्तथर्षयः। एकस्यैवाथ रुद्रस्य भेदास्ते परिकीर्तिताः तत् तद् रूपं समास्थाय प्रददाति फलं शिव:
verses.wordMeaning: His face is terrible due to the curved fangs. His eyes shine like blazing fires. Holding the trident and wearing the elephant hide, he is established in his lordly Yoga.
verses.commentary: Sense: His face is terrible due to the curved fangs. His eyes shine like blazing fires. Holding the trident and wearing the elephant hide, he is established in his lordly Yoga.

verses.sanskrit: वैकारिकस्तैजसश्च भूतादिश्चेति सत्तमाः । त्रिविधो ऽयमहङ्कारो महति प्रलंय व्रजेत्
verses.transliteration: vaikārikastaijasaśca bhūtādiśceti sattamāḥ / trividho 'yamahaṅkāro mahati pralaṃya vrajet
verses.translation: Imbibing the great Bliss, the prolific effusion of the nectar, Isvara glances at the goddess and performs a Tanijava dance by himself.
verses.hindi: आराधयन्महादेवं याति तत्परमं पदम्
verses.wordMeaning: Imbibing the great Bliss, the prolific effusion of the nectar, Isvara glances at the goddess and performs a Tanijava dance by himself.
verses.commentary: Sense: Imbibing the great Bliss, the prolific effusion of the nectar, Isvara glances at the goddess and performs a Tanijava dance by himself.

verses.sanskrit: महान्तमेभिः सहितं ब्रह्माणमतितेजसम् । अव्यक्तं जगतो योनिः संहरेदेकमव्ययम्
verses.transliteration: mahāntamebhiḥ sahitaṃ brahmāṇamatitejasam / avyaktaṃ jagato yoniḥ saṃharedekamavyayam
verses.translation: The goddess imbibes the highly auspicious Nectar of dances of her lord. She adopts Yoga and becomes one with the body of the Trident-bearing Lord.
verses.hindi: किन्तु देवं महादेवं सर्वशक्तिं सनातनम्। आराधयेद् वै गिरिशं सगुणं वाथ निर्गुणम् पद्मासनस्थं रुक्माभं चिन्तयेद् वैदिकी श्रुतिः
verses.wordMeaning: The goddess imbibes the highly auspicious Nectar of dances of her lord. She adopts Yoga and becomes one with the body of the Trident-bearing Lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: The goddess imbibes the highly auspicious Nectar of dances of her lord. She adopts Yoga and becomes one with the body of the Trident-bearing Lord.

verses.sanskrit: एवं संहृत्य भूतानि तत्त्वानि च महेश्वरः । वियोजयति चान्योन्यं प्रधानं पुरुषं परम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ saṃhṛtya bhūtāni tattvāni ca maheśvaraḥ / viyojayati cānyonyaṃ pradhānaṃ puruṣaṃ param
verses.translation: After burning the sphere of the cosmic egg, which is naturally fiery, the Pinaka-bearing Lord enjoys the pleasures of Tandava dance out of his own will.
verses.hindi: अव्यक्त अक्षर अद्वितीय तत्त्व। उन-उन शक्तियोंका आश्रयण कर महेश्वरदेव स्वयं लीलापूर्वक विविध देहोंको सृष्टि करते हैं और उनका संहार भी करते हैं। वेदवादी (वेदज्ञ) ब्राह्मणोंके द्वारा समस्त यज्ञोंमें उन (महेश्वर)-
verses.wordMeaning: After burning the sphere of the cosmic egg, which is naturally fiery, the Pinaka-bearing Lord enjoys the pleasures of Tandava dance out of his own will.
verses.commentary: Sense: After burning the sphere of the cosmic egg, which is naturally fiery, the Pinaka-bearing Lord enjoys the pleasures of Tandava dance out of his own will.

verses.sanskrit: प्रधानपुंसोरजयोरेष संहार ईरितः । महेश्वरेच्छाजनितो न स्वयं विद्यते लयः
verses.transliteration: pradhānapuṃsorajayoreṣa saṃhāra īritaḥ / maheśvarecchājanito na svayaṃ vidyate layaḥ
verses.translation: When Devas had been annihilated and Brahma, Visnu and the Pinaka-bearing lord Siva (are unified in a resting position), the element of earth gets dissolved in the waters alongwith its attributes.
verses.hindi: का पूजन किया जाता है। ये ही रुद्र हैं तथा सम्पूर्ण कामनाओंको प्रदान करनेवाले हें-एऐसा वेदका कथन है। परमात्माकी सभी शक्तियोंमें ब्रह्मा, विष्णु एवं महेश्वर- देव प्रधान शक्तिके रूपमें माने गये हें शूलपाणि महेश्वर (कारणब्रह्म-तुरीय तत्त्व) तो आद्य, सबसे परे, भगवान्, परमात्मा, सनातन एवं सर्वशक्त्यात्मा (समस्त शक्तियोंके मूल उदम एवं अधिष्ठान) -के रूपमें वेदोंमें वर्णित हैं। इसलिये कुछ
verses.wordMeaning: When Devas had been annihilated and Brahma, Visnu and the Pinaka-bearing lord Siva (are unified in a resting position), the element of earth gets dissolved in the waters alongwith its attributes.
verses.commentary: Sense: When Devas had been annihilated and Brahma, Visnu and the Pinaka-bearing lord Siva (are unified in a resting position), the element of earth gets dissolved in the waters alongwith its attributes.

verses.sanskrit: गुणसाम्यं तदव्यक्तं प्रकृतिः परिगीयते । प्रधानं जगतो योनिर्मायातत्त्वमचेतनम्
verses.transliteration: guṇasāmyaṃ tadavyaktaṃ prakṛtiḥ parigīyate / pradhānaṃ jagato yonirmāyātattvamacetanam
verses.translation: Havyavahana (Fire) swallows the principle of water alongwith its attributes. The element of Tejas (fire) accompa¬ nied by all its attributes undergoes dissolution in the element of Vayu (wind).
verses.hindi: लोग इन्हें अग्नि तथा कुछ लोग नारायण कहते हैं। ऐसे ही कोई इन्हें इन्द्र, कोई विश्वेदेव तथा कोई ब्रह्मा कहते हें
verses.wordMeaning: Havyavahana (Fire) swallows the principle of water alongwith its attributes. The element of Tejas (fire) accompa¬ nied by all its attributes undergoes dissolution in the element of Vayu (wind).
verses.commentary: Sense: Havyavahana (Fire) swallows the principle of water alongwith its attributes. The element of Tejas (fire) accompa¬ nied by all its attributes undergoes dissolution in the element of Vayu (wind).

verses.sanskrit: कूटस्थश्चिन्मयो ह्यात्मा केवलः पञ्चविंशकः । गीयते मुनिभिः साक्षी महानेकः पितामहः
verses.transliteration: kūṭasthaścinmayo hyātmā kevalaḥ pañcaviṃśakaḥ / gīyate munibhiḥ sākṣī mahānekaḥ pitāmahaḥ
verses.translation: (ii) A Tirtha—11.41.31-33 Aparanta—N. of a people—1.47.42 Arjuna—A Pandava—After Krsna's death meets Vyasa and discusses 1.29 Aruna—a sacred river—11.30.22 Arundhati—(i) Vasistha's wife—I. 19, 20, 23—an ideal chaste woman X:1.12.223 (ii) Wife of Dharma— _ 1.16.7-11
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मा, विष्णु, अग्नि, वरुण तथा अन्य सभी देवता और महर्षिगण एक ही रुद्र (महेश्वर)-के विभिन्न स्वरूप कहे गये हैं। मनुष्य इन स्वरूपोमेंसे जिस भेद (स्वरूप)-का अवलम्बन कर परमेश्वरको आराधना करते हैं, शिव (महेश्वर) उसी स्वरूपको ग्रहणकर फल प्रदान करते हैं। अत: इनमेंसे किसी एक भी भेद (स्वरूप)-का अवलम्बन कर सनातन महादेवको आराधना करनेवालेको उस परम (शिब) पदको प्राप्ति
verses.wordMeaning: (ii) A Tirtha—11.41.31-33 Aparanta—N. of a people—1.47.42 Arjuna—A Pandava—After Krsna's death meets Vyasa and discusses 1.29 Aruna—a sacred river—11.30.22 Arundhati—(i) Vasistha's wife—I. 19, 20, 23—an ideal chaste woman X:1.12.223 (ii) Wife of Dharma— _ 1.16.7-11
verses.commentary: Sense: (ii) A Tirtha—11.41.31-33 Aparanta—N. of a people—1.47.42 Arjuna—A Pandava—After Krsna's death meets Vyasa and discusses 1.29 Aruna—a sacred river—11.30.22 Arundhati—(i) Vasistha's wife—I. 19, 20, 23—an ideal chaste woman X:1.12.223 (ii) Wife of Dharma— _ 1.16.7-11

verses.sanskrit: एवं संहारकरणी शक्तिर्माहेश्वरी ध्रुवा । प्रधानाद्यं विशेषान्तं दहेद् रुद्र इति श्रुतिः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ saṃhārakaraṇī śaktirmāheśvarī dhruvā / pradhānādyaṃ viśeṣāntaṃ dahed rudra iti śrutiḥ
verses.translation: All the sense-organs become dissolved in the Taijasa (Rajasa Aharhkara). O excellent ones, the Vaikarika (Sattvika Aharhkara) gets dissolved alongwith the groups of Devas.
verses.hindi: होती है। निष्कर्ष यह है कि सर्वशक्तिसम्पन्न सनातन, देव, गिरिश महादेवकी सगुण अथवा निर्गुण किसी भी रूपमें आराधना अवश्य करनी चाहिए ॥ ३७--४०॥
verses.wordMeaning: All the sense-organs become dissolved in the Taijasa (Rajasa Aharhkara). O excellent ones, the Vaikarika (Sattvika Aharhkara) gets dissolved alongwith the groups of Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the sense-organs become dissolved in the Taijasa (Rajasa Aharhkara). O excellent ones, the Vaikarika (Sattvika Aharhkara) gets dissolved alongwith the groups of Devas.

verses.sanskrit: योगिनामथ सर्वेषां ज्ञानविन्यस्तचेतसाम् । आत्यन्तिकं चैव लयं विदधातीह शङ्करः
verses.transliteration: yogināmatha sarveṣāṃ jñānavinyastacetasām / ātyantikaṃ caiva layaṃ vidadhātīha śaṅkaraḥ
verses.translation: The three types of Ahaihkara (ego) get dissolved in the principle Mahat. The Mahat (Intellect) principle gets dissolved in Brahma of unmeasured prowess, alongwith these.
verses.hindi: मैंने आप लोगोंको निर्गुण-योग (निर्बीज समाधि) पहले ही बता दिया है। सगुणरूप (-की उपासना)- में आरूढ़ होनेको इच्छा करनेवालेको भी परमेश्वरकी पूजा (आराधना) करनी चाहिए। वेदके कथनके अनुसार पिनाक नामक धनुष धारण करनेवाले, तीन नेत्रवाले, जटाधारी, चर्माम्बरधारी, पद्मासनमें स्थित तथा स्वर्णिम आभावाले (शंकर) -का ध्यान करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: The three types of Ahaihkara (ego) get dissolved in the principle Mahat. The Mahat (Intellect) principle gets dissolved in Brahma of unmeasured prowess, alongwith these.
verses.commentary: Sense: The three types of Ahaihkara (ego) get dissolved in the principle Mahat. The Mahat (Intellect) principle gets dissolved in Brahma of unmeasured prowess, alongwith these.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येष भगवान् रुद्रः संहारं कुरुते वशी । स्थापिका मोहनी शक्तिर्नारायण इति श्रुतिः
verses.transliteration: ityeṣa bhagavān rudraḥ saṃhāraṃ kurute vaśī / sthāpikā mohanī śaktirnārāyaṇa iti śrutiḥ
verses.translation: Being burnt by their brilliance, the Earth alongwith the mountains, rivers, oceans and continents becomes devoid of moisture.
verses.hindi: १-महेश्वर कार्यब्रह्म एवं कारणत्रह्म-रूपमें शास्त्रोंमें वर्णित हैं। अव्यक्ततत्त्वकी शक्तिरूपमें जिन महेश्वरकी चर्चा अभी ऊपर की गयी है, वे कार्यब्रह्म हैं। अव्यक्त अक्षर-तत्त्व कारणब्रह्म महेशवरको समझना चाहिए। इन्हीं कारणब्रह्मको तुरीय (चतुर्थ) अद्वैत
verses.wordMeaning: Being burnt by their brilliance, the Earth alongwith the mountains, rivers, oceans and continents becomes devoid of moisture.
verses.commentary: Sense: Being burnt by their brilliance, the Earth alongwith the mountains, rivers, oceans and continents becomes devoid of moisture.

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्यगर्भा भगवान् जगत् सदसदात्मकम् । सृजेदशेषं प्रकृतेस्तन्मयः पञ्चविंशकः
verses.transliteration: hiraṇyagarbhā bhagavān jagat sadasadātmakam / sṛjedaśeṣaṃ prakṛtestanmayaḥ pañcaviṃśakaḥ
verses.translation: The holy centres are not fruitful to him who forsakes his duties and goes on pilgrimage to various holy centres. The holy centres do not benefit him either in this world or in the other world.
verses.hindi: या तत्त्व कहा जाता ह। 'निर्बीज समाधि' साधककी वह अवस्था है, जिसमें कोई भी संस्कार शेष नहीं रहता। इसीलिये इस अवस्थामें किसी भी प्रकारकी चित्तवृत्तिका अस्तित्व नहीं रहता। इसी कारण इस निर्बीज समाधिको कैवल्यावस्था कहते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The holy centres are not fruitful to him who forsakes his duties and goes on pilgrimage to various holy centres. The holy centres do not benefit him either in this world or in the other world.
verses.commentary: Sense: The holy centres are not fruitful to him who forsakes his duties and goes on pilgrimage to various holy centres. The holy centres do not benefit him either in this world or in the other world.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वज्ञाः सर्वगाः शान्ताः स्वात्मन्येवव्यवस्थिताः । शक्तयो ब्रह्मविण्वीशा भुक्तिमुक्तिफलप्रदाः
verses.transliteration: sarvajñāḥ sarvagāḥ śāntāḥ svātmanyevavyavasthitāḥ / śaktayo brahmaviṇvīśā bhuktimuktiphalapradāḥ
verses.translation: The dissolution does not exist by itself. It originates from the will of Mahesvara. When Pradhana is in a state of equilibrium of gunas, it is mentioned as unmanifested Prakrti.
verses.hindi: एष योगः समुद्दिष्टः सबीजो मुनिसत्तमाः । तस्मात् सर्वान् परित्यज्य देवान् ब्रहापुरोगमान्। आराधयेद् विरूपाक्षमादिमध्यान्तसंस्थितम्
verses.wordMeaning: The dissolution does not exist by itself. It originates from the will of Mahesvara. When Pradhana is in a state of equilibrium of gunas, it is mentioned as unmanifested Prakrti.
verses.commentary: Sense: The dissolution does not exist by itself. It originates from the will of Mahesvara. When Pradhana is in a state of equilibrium of gunas, it is mentioned as unmanifested Prakrti.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेश्वराः सर्ववन्द्याः शाश्वतानन्तभोगिनः । एकमेवाक्षरं तत्त्वं पुंप्रधानेश्वरात्मकम्
verses.transliteration: sarveśvarāḥ sarvavandyāḥ śāśvatānantabhoginaḥ / ekamevākṣaraṃ tattvaṃ puṃpradhāneśvarātmakam
verses.translation: Pradhana, the principle of Maya, is insentient and the source of origin of the universe. The Atman, the twentyfifth (principle) is stationed within the hearts of all. It is the pure consciousness and knowledge.
verses.hindi: भक्नतियोगसमायुक्तः स्वधर्मनिरतः शुचिः । तादृशं रूपमास्थाय समायात्यन्तिकं शिवम् अत्राप्यशक्तोऽथ हरं विष्णुं ब्रह्माणमर्चयेत्। अथ चेदसमर्थः स्यात् तत्रापि मुनिपुंगवाः । ततो वाय्वग्निशक्रादीन् पूजयेद् भक्तिसंयुतः
verses.wordMeaning: Pradhana, the principle of Maya, is insentient and the source of origin of the universe. The Atman, the twentyfifth (principle) is stationed within the hearts of all. It is the pure consciousness and knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: Pradhana, the principle of Maya, is insentient and the source of origin of the universe. The Atman, the twentyfifth (principle) is stationed within the hearts of all. It is the pure consciousness and knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: अन्याश्च शक्तयो दिव्याः सन्ति तत्र सहस्रशः । इज्यन्ते विविधैर्यज्ञैः शक्रादित्यादयो ऽमराः
verses.transliteration: anyāśca śaktayo divyāḥ santi tatra sahasraśaḥ / ijyante vividhairyajñaiḥ śakrādityādayo 'marāḥ
verses.translation: It is sung about by sages as the Saksin (cosmic Wit¬ ness), the great Pitamaha (grandfather). The power of Annihilation is certainly the Sakti of Mahesvara.
verses.hindi: विष्णुं रुद्रं विरञ्चिँ च सबीजं भावयेद् बुधः । अथवाग्न्यादिकान् देवांस्तत्परः संयतेन्द्रियः
verses.wordMeaning: It is sung about by sages as the Saksin (cosmic Wit¬ ness), the great Pitamaha (grandfather). The power of Annihilation is certainly the Sakti of Mahesvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is sung about by sages as the Saksin (cosmic Wit¬ ness), the great Pitamaha (grandfather). The power of Annihilation is certainly the Sakti of Mahesvara.

verses.sanskrit: एकैकस्य सहस्राणि देहानां वै शतानि च । कथ्यन्ते चैव माहात्म्याच्छक्तिरेकैव निर्गुणाः
verses.transliteration: ekaikasya sahasrāṇi dehānāṃ vai śatāni ca / kathyante caiva māhātmyācchaktirekaiva nirguṇāḥ
verses.translation: The entire universe appears like a frying pan. The rays completely burn everything down again and again.
verses.hindi: पूजयेत् पुरुषं विष्णुं चतुर्मूर्तिधरं हरिम्। अनादिनिधनं देवं वासुदेवं सनातनम् नारायणं जगदयोनिमाकाशं परमं पदम्।
verses.wordMeaning: The entire universe appears like a frying pan. The rays completely burn everything down again and again.
verses.commentary: Sense: The entire universe appears like a frying pan. The rays completely burn everything down again and again.

verses.sanskrit: तां तां शक्तिं समाधाय स्वयं देवो महेश्वरः । करोति देहान् विविधान् ग्रसते चैव लीलया
verses.transliteration: tāṃ tāṃ śaktiṃ samādhāya svayaṃ devo maheśvaraḥ / karoti dehān vividhān grasate caiva līlayā
verses.translation: Thereafter, the animals in the netherworlds as well as those in the great oceans become destroyed and dissolved. They crumble and get mixed into the earth.
verses.hindi: एष एव विधिब्राह्यो भावने चान्तिके मतः
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, the animals in the netherworlds as well as those in the great oceans become destroyed and dissolved. They crumble and get mixed into the earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, the animals in the netherworlds as well as those in the great oceans become destroyed and dissolved. They crumble and get mixed into the earth.

verses.sanskrit: इज्यते सर्वयज्ञेषु ब्राह्मणैर्वेदवादिभिः । सर्वकामप्रदो रुद्र इत्येषा वैदिकी श्रुतिः
verses.transliteration: ijyate sarvayajñeṣu brāhmaṇairvedavādibhiḥ / sarvakāmaprado rudra ityeṣā vaidikī śrutiḥ
verses.translation: Lord Fire, with seven souls, reduces everything to ashes—the continents, the mountains, the Varsas (subconti¬ nents) and the great oceans.
verses.hindi: मुनिश्रेष्ठो! इस प्रकार इस सबीज योगका वर्णन महेश्वरतत्त्व ही सर्वस्व, परम ध्येय है) इसलिये ब्रह्मा आदि प्रधान सभी देवोंको छोड़कर आदि, मध्य तथा अन्तमें रहनेवाले (शाश्वत तत्त्व) विरूपाक्ष (शंकर)- की आराधना करनी चाहिए। अपने धर्में निरत
verses.wordMeaning: Lord Fire, with seven souls, reduces everything to ashes—the continents, the mountains, the Varsas (subconti¬ nents) and the great oceans.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Fire, with seven souls, reduces everything to ashes—the continents, the mountains, the Varsas (subconti¬ nents) and the great oceans.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वासामेव शक्तीनां ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वराः । प्राधान्येन स्मृता देवाः शक्तयः परमात्मनः
verses.transliteration: sarvāsāmeva śaktīnāṃ brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ / prādhānyena smṛtā devāḥ śaktayaḥ paramātmanaḥ
verses.translation: The flourishing fire drinks up the waters from the- oceans and rivers. It blazes up resting on the Earth.
verses.hindi: ही (शंकरके समान) रूप धारणकर शिवके समीप आता है । अत्यन्त भावना--ध्येयाकार चित्तवृत्तिवाले इस सबीज योगका वर्णन किया गया। इसका यथाविधि अनुष्ठान करता हुआ व्यक्ति ऐश्वर (ईश्वर)-पदको प्राप्त
verses.wordMeaning: The flourishing fire drinks up the waters from the- oceans and rivers. It blazes up resting on the Earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: The flourishing fire drinks up the waters from the- oceans and rivers. It blazes up resting on the Earth.

verses.sanskrit: आद्यः परस्ताद् भगवान् परमात्मा सनातनः । गीयते सर्वशक्त्यात्मा शूलपाणिर्महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: ādyaḥ parastād bhagavān paramātmā sanātanaḥ / gīyate sarvaśaktyātmā śūlapāṇirmaheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: They are all powerful, binding everything, (v.l. worthy of salute by all) perpetual and infinite in their enjoy¬ ments of pleasures. They form one imperishable principle in the nature ofLord Purusa, Pradhana.
verses.hindi: करता है॥ ४३--४५॥ मुनिश्रेष्ठो! यदि मनुष्य इसमें भी असमर्थ हो तो उसे हर, विष्णु एवं ब्रह्माकी आराधना करनी चाहिए और उसमें भी असमर्थ होनेपर भक्तियुक्त होकर (कार्यब्रह्मको शक्ति) वायु, अग्नि तथा इन्द्र आदि
verses.wordMeaning: They are all powerful, binding everything, (v.l. worthy of salute by all) perpetual and infinite in their enjoy¬ ments of pleasures. They form one imperishable principle in the nature ofLord Purusa, Pradhana.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are all powerful, binding everything, (v.l. worthy of salute by all) perpetual and infinite in their enjoy¬ ments of pleasures. They form one imperishable principle in the nature ofLord Purusa, Pradhana.

verses.sanskrit: एनमेके वदन्त्यग्निं नारायणमथापरे । इन्द्रमेके परे विश्वान् ब्रह्माणमपरे जगुः
verses.transliteration: enameke vadantyagniṃ nārāyaṇamathāpare / indrameke pare viśvān brahmāṇamapare jaguḥ
verses.translation: After burning the Earth, it burns up Rasatala. After burning the Earth down below, it burns the heaven above.
verses.hindi: जो दो शुद्ध भावनाएं बतायी गयी हैं (वे भी कल्याणकर हैं) । साथ ही निर्बीज तथा सबीज योगका भी वर्णन किया गया है (ये भी परम उपादेय हैं)। मैंने पूर्वमें भी यह निर्बीज ज्ञान (योग) आप लोगोंको बताया
verses.wordMeaning: After burning the Earth, it burns up Rasatala. After burning the Earth down below, it burns the heaven above.
verses.commentary: Sense: After burning the Earth, it burns up Rasatala. After burning the Earth down below, it burns the heaven above.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मविष्णवग्निवरुणाः सर्वे देवास्तथर्षयः । एकस्यैवाथ रुद्रस्य भेदास्ते परिकीर्तिताः
verses.transliteration: brahmaviṣṇavagnivaruṇāḥ sarve devāstatharṣayaḥ / ekasyaivātha rudrasya bhedāste parikīrtitāḥ
verses.translation: The flames of that Sarhvartaka fire leap up hundreds, thousands and ten thousands of Yojanas.
verses.hindi: था। बुद्धिमान् व्यक्तिको सर्वप्रथम सबीज (साकाररूपमें) ब्रह्मा, विष्णु तथा रुद्रको भावना करनी चाहिए अथवा प्रारम्भमें जितेन्द्रिय होकर अग्नि आदि देवताओंकी तत्परतापूर्वक (इन देवताओंको ही परम ध्येय मानकर) आराधना करनी चाहिए। विष्णुके भक्त एवं विष्णुपरायण पुरुषको वैष्णव चिह्न (शंख-चक्रादि) धारणकर नियमपूर्वक (नारायण, संकर्षण, प्रद्युम्न और अनिरुद्धरूप) चार मूर्ति धारण करनेवाले, अनादिनिधन, जगद्योनि, आकाशरूप,
verses.wordMeaning: The flames of that Sarhvartaka fire leap up hundreds, thousands and ten thousands of Yojanas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The flames of that Sarhvartaka fire leap up hundreds, thousands and ten thousands of Yojanas.

verses.sanskrit: यं यं भेदं समाश्रित्य यजन्ति परमेश्वरम् । तत् तद् रूपं समास्थाय प्रददाति फलं शिवः
verses.transliteration: yaṃ yaṃ bhedaṃ samāśritya yajanti parameśvaram / tat tad rūpaṃ samāsthāya pradadāti phalaṃ śivaḥ
verses.translation: Becoming more brilliant by being urged by Kala- rudra (Rudra, the destroyer) it burns the Gandharvas, Pisacas, Yaksas, serpents and Raksasas.
verses.hindi: परमपदरूप सनातन देव वासुदेव पुरुष विष्णुकी पूजा करनी चाहिए! ब्राह्मी भावना (विष्णुको ही ब्रह्म माननेकी भावना)-में भी यही विधि श्रीविष्णुका सामीप्य प्राप्त करनेके लिये मान्य है
verses.wordMeaning: Becoming more brilliant by being urged by Kala- rudra (Rudra, the destroyer) it burns the Gandharvas, Pisacas, Yaksas, serpents and Raksasas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Becoming more brilliant by being urged by Kala- rudra (Rudra, the destroyer) it burns the Gandharvas, Pisacas, Yaksas, serpents and Raksasas.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादेकतरं भेदं समाश्रित्यापि शाश्वतम् । आराधयन्महादेवं याति तत्परमं पदम्
verses.transliteration: tasmādekataraṃ bhedaṃ samāśrityāpi śāśvatam / ārādhayanmahādevaṃ yāti tatparamaṃ padam
verses.translation: The Kalagni (the fire of destruction) whose body has been pervaded by Kala entirely consumes Bhurloka Bhuvarloka and Maharloka.
verses.hindi: 'सबीज योग' का अर्थ है-सबीज समाधि। वह समाधि सबीज है, जिसमें बीज रहता है। बीजका अर्थ है--ध्येयाकार चित्तवृत्ति। इसका आशय यह है कि स्वयंसे पृथक् ध्येय तत्वको समझकर उसका अनुसंधान यदि साधक कर रहा है तो ध्येयाकार चित्तवृत्तिका अस्तित्व रहनेसे साधककी यह समाधि-अवस्था सबीज ही है। (इसे कैवल्यावस्था नहीं कह सकते, क्योंकि चित्तवृत्तिका पृथक् अस्तित्व रहनेसे साधकमें कैवल्य भाव नहीं है।)
verses.wordMeaning: The Kalagni (the fire of destruction) whose body has been pervaded by Kala entirely consumes Bhurloka Bhuvarloka and Maharloka.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Kalagni (the fire of destruction) whose body has been pervaded by Kala entirely consumes Bhurloka Bhuvarloka and Maharloka.

verses.sanskrit: किन्तु देवं महादेवं सर्वशक्तिं सनातनम् । आराधयेद् वै गिरिशं सगुणं वाथ निर्गुणम्
verses.transliteration: kintu devaṃ mahādevaṃ sarvaśaktiṃ sanātanam / ārādhayed vai giriśaṃ saguṇaṃ vātha nirguṇam
verses.hindi: ४९२० कूर्मपुराण कर

verses.sanskrit: मया प्रोक्तो हि भवतां योगः प्रागेव निर्गुणः । आरुरुक्षुस्तु सगुणं पूजयेत् परमेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: mayā prokto hi bhavatāṃ yogaḥ prāgeva nirguṇaḥ / ārurukṣustu saguṇaṃ pūjayet parameśvaram
verses.translation: Some are like mountains; some are comparable to- huge herds of elephants. Others are like heaps of burning coal and some like shoals of fishes.
verses.hindi: इन्द्रद्युश्ाय मुनये कथितं यन्मया पुरा इस प्रकार यह पवित्र भावनापर आश्रित परम ज्ञान बतलाया गया। प्राचीन कालमें मैंने इस ज्ञानको इन्द्रद्युम्न
verses.wordMeaning: Some are like mountains; some are comparable to- huge herds of elephants. Others are like heaps of burning coal and some like shoals of fishes.
verses.commentary: Sense: Some are like mountains; some are comparable to- huge herds of elephants. Others are like heaps of burning coal and some like shoals of fishes.

verses.sanskrit: पिनाकिनं त्रिनयनं जटिलं कृत्तिवाससम् । पद्मासनस्थं रुक्माभं चिन्तयेद् वैदिकी श्रुतिः
verses.transliteration: pinākinaṃ trinayanaṃ jaṭilaṃ kṛttivāsasam / padmāsanasthaṃ rukmābhaṃ cintayed vaidikī śrutiḥ
verses.translation: The devotee desirous of climbing (or attaining) to the Yoga of Saguna type should worship paramesvara (the supreme Ruler) in the Saguna form—the form with three eyes, bearing Pinaka with matted hair and clad in elephant hide.
verses.hindi: तदीश्वरः परं ब्रह्म तस्माद् ब्रहामयं जगत्
verses.wordMeaning: The devotee desirous of climbing (or attaining) to the Yoga of Saguna type should worship paramesvara (the supreme Ruler) in the Saguna form—the form with three eyes, bearing Pinaka with matted hair and clad in elephant hide.
verses.commentary: Sense: The devotee desirous of climbing (or attaining) to the Yoga of Saguna type should worship paramesvara (the supreme Ruler) in the Saguna form—the form with three eyes, bearing Pinaka with matted hair and clad in elephant hide.

verses.sanskrit: एष योगः समुद्दिष्टः सबीजो मुनिसत्तमाः । तस्मात् सर्वान् परित्यज्य देवान् ब्रह्मपुरोगमान् । आराधयेद् विरूपाक्षमादिमध्यान्तसंस्थितम्
verses.transliteration: eṣa yogaḥ samuddiṣṭaḥ sabījo munisattamāḥ / tasmāt sarvān parityajya devān brahmapurogamān / ārādhayed virūpākṣamādimadhyāntasaṃsthitam
verses.translation: Or he should meditate on Rudra with golden lustre or shining like a thousand suns: So it is heard (mentioned) in the Vedas. O leading sages, this is pointed out as Sabija Toga (i.e. the Yoga with the seed).
verses.hindi: एतावदुक्त्वा भगवान् विरराम जनार्दनः । तुष्टुवुर्मुनयो विष्णुं शक्रेण सह माधवम्
verses.wordMeaning: Or he should meditate on Rudra with golden lustre or shining like a thousand suns: So it is heard (mentioned) in the Vedas. O leading sages, this is pointed out as Sabija Toga (i.e. the Yoga with the seed).
verses.commentary: Sense: Or he should meditate on Rudra with golden lustre or shining like a thousand suns: So it is heard (mentioned) in the Vedas. O leading sages, this is pointed out as Sabija Toga (i.e. the Yoga with the seed).

verses.sanskrit: भक्तियोगसमायुक्तः स्वधर्मनिरतः शुचिः । तादृशं रूपमास्थाय समायात्यन्तिकं शिवम्
verses.transliteration: bhaktiyogasamāyuktaḥ svadharmanirataḥ śuciḥ / tādṛśaṃ rūpamāsthāya samāyātyantikaṃ śivam
verses.translation: Like a flood water gushes out from them as rain. The terrible and inauspicious rain destroys the fire.
verses.hindi: नमस्ते कूर्मरूपाय विष्णवे परमात्मने।
verses.wordMeaning: Like a flood water gushes out from them as rain. The terrible and inauspicious rain destroys the fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like a flood water gushes out from them as rain. The terrible and inauspicious rain destroys the fire.

verses.sanskrit: एष योगः समुद्दिष्टः सबीजो ऽत्यन्तभावने । यथाविधि प्रकुर्वाणः प्राप्नुयादैश्वरं पदम्
verses.transliteration: eṣa yogaḥ samuddiṣṭaḥ sabījo 'tyantabhāvane / yathāvidhi prakurvāṇaḥ prāpnuyādaiśvaraṃ padam
verses.translation: The entire universe is filled with water of enormous quantities. On being thus overpowered by water the fire merges itself into the water.
verses.hindi: नारायणाय विश्वाय वासुदेवाय ते नमः माधवाय नमस्तुभ्यं नमो यज्ञेश्वराय च
verses.wordMeaning: The entire universe is filled with water of enormous quantities. On being thus overpowered by water the fire merges itself into the water.
verses.commentary: Sense: The entire universe is filled with water of enormous quantities. On being thus overpowered by water the fire merges itself into the water.

verses.sanskrit: अत्राप्यशक्तो ऽथ हरं विष्णुं बह्माणमर्चयेत् । अथ चेदसमर्थः स्यात् तत्रापि मुनिपुङ्गवाः । ततो वाय्वग्निशक्रादीन् पूजयेद् भक्तिसंयुतः
verses.transliteration: atrāpyaśakto 'tha haraṃ viṣṇuṃ bahmāṇamarcayet / atha cedasamarthaḥ syāt tatrāpi munipuṅgavāḥ / tato vāyvagniśakrādīn pūjayed bhaktisaṃyutaḥ
