verses.translation: Due to the waters showered by the clouds the fire is subdued in hundreds of years. The flood envelops the entire universe with huge currents of water.
verses.hindi: सहस्त्रशिरसे तुभ्यं सहस्त्राक्षाय ते नमः।
verses.wordMeaning: Due to the waters showered by the clouds the fire is subdued in hundreds of years. The flood envelops the entire universe with huge currents of water.
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to the waters showered by the clouds the fire is subdued in hundreds of years. The flood envelops the entire universe with huge currents of water.

verses.sanskrit: ये चान्ये भावने शुद्धे प्रागुक्ते भवतामिह । अथापि कथितो योगो निर्बोजश्च सबीजकः
verses.transliteration: ye cānye bhāvane śuddhe prāgukte bhavatāmiha / athāpi kathito yogo nirbojaśca sabījakaḥ
verses.translation: Impelled by the self-born deity, these showers fill the earth with huge floods of water like the flow-tide of an ocean.
verses.hindi: पुरुषाय पुराणाय सत्तामात्रस्वरूपिणे नमः सांख्याय योगाय केवलाय नमोऽस्तु ते। धर्मज्ञानाधिगम्याय निष्कलाय नमो नमः
verses.wordMeaning: Impelled by the self-born deity, these showers fill the earth with huge floods of water like the flow-tide of an ocean.
verses.commentary: Sense: Impelled by the self-born deity, these showers fill the earth with huge floods of water like the flow-tide of an ocean.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानं तदुक्तं निर्बोजं पूर्वं हि भवतां मया । विष्णुं रुद्रं विरञ्चिं च सबीजं भावयेद् बुधः । सथवाग्न्यादिकान् देवांस्तत्परः संयतेन्द्रियः
verses.transliteration: jñānaṃ taduktaṃ nirbojaṃ pūrvaṃ hi bhavatāṃ mayā / viṣṇuṃ rudraṃ virañciṃ ca sabījaṃ bhāvayed budhaḥ / sathavāgnyādikān devāṃstatparaḥ saṃyatendriyaḥ
verses.translation: The whole Earth alongwith the mountains and continents is slowly covered with water. The water drunk by the rays of the sun remains in the clouds.
verses.hindi: नमो नमो नमस्तुभ्यं मायिने वेधसे नमः
verses.wordMeaning: The whole Earth alongwith the mountains and continents is slowly covered with water. The water drunk by the rays of the sun remains in the clouds.
verses.commentary: Sense: The whole Earth alongwith the mountains and continents is slowly covered with water. The water drunk by the rays of the sun remains in the clouds.

verses.sanskrit: पूजयेत् पुरुषं विष्णुं चतुर्मूर्तिधरं हरिम् । अनादिनिधनं देवं वासुदेवं सनातनम्
verses.transliteration: pūjayet puruṣaṃ viṣṇuṃ caturmūrtidharaṃ harim / anādinidhanaṃ devaṃ vāsudevaṃ sanātanam
verses.translation: Again it falls on the Earth whereby the oceans are filled up. Thereafter the oceans go beyond their shores everywhere.
verses.hindi: वामनाय नमस्तुभ्यं हृषीकेशाय ते नमः नमोऽस्तु कालरुद्राय कालरूपाय ते नमः। स्वर्गापवर्गदात्रे च नमोऽप्रतिहतात्मने
verses.wordMeaning: Again it falls on the Earth whereby the oceans are filled up. Thereafter the oceans go beyond their shores everywhere.
verses.commentary: Sense: Again it falls on the Earth whereby the oceans are filled up. Thereafter the oceans go beyond their shores everywhere.

verses.sanskrit: नारायणं जगद्योनिमाकाशं परमं पदम् । तल्लिङ्गधारी नियतं तद्भक्तस्तदपाश्रयः । एष एव विधिर्ब्राह्मे भावने चान्तिके मतः
verses.transliteration: nārāyaṇaṃ jagadyonimākāśaṃ paramaṃ padam / talliṅgadhārī niyataṃ tadbhaktastadapāśrayaḥ / eṣa eva vidhirbrāhme bhāvane cāntike mataḥ
verses.translation: A sensible man should practise the worship ofVisnu, Rudra and Virinci in the Sabija Toga, or he may worship Vayu and other Devas with due attachment to them and with his self controlled.
verses.hindi: मुनिसे कहा था। यह चेतनात्मक एवं अचेतनात्मक
verses.wordMeaning: A sensible man should practise the worship ofVisnu, Rudra and Virinci in the Sabija Toga, or he may worship Vayu and other Devas with due attachment to them and with his self controlled.
verses.commentary: Sense: A sensible man should practise the worship ofVisnu, Rudra and Virinci in the Sabija Toga, or he may worship Vayu and other Devas with due attachment to them and with his self controlled.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येतत् कथितं ज्ञानं भावनासंश्रयं परम् । इन्द्रद्युम्नाय मुनये कथितं यन्मया पुरा
verses.transliteration: ityetat kathitaṃ jñānaṃ bhāvanāsaṃśrayaṃ param / indradyumnāya munaye kathitaṃ yanmayā purā
verses.translation: He should worship Visnu, Hari, who assumes the four Murtis (vyuhas) who has neither beginning nor destruction and who is the eternal lord Vasudeva.
verses.hindi: ही है। वह ईश्वर (महेश्वर) ही परम ब्रह्म है, इसलिये यह जगत् ब्रह्ममय है सूतजीने कहा--इतना कहकर भगवान् जनार्दन (कूर्म) चुप हो गये। तब इन्द्रके साथ मुनिगण माधव विष्णु (कूर्म)-की स्तुति करने लगे-
verses.wordMeaning: He should worship Visnu, Hari, who assumes the four Murtis (vyuhas) who has neither beginning nor destruction and who is the eternal lord Vasudeva.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should worship Visnu, Hari, who assumes the four Murtis (vyuhas) who has neither beginning nor destruction and who is the eternal lord Vasudeva.

verses.sanskrit: अव्यक्तात्मकमेवेदं चेतनाचेतनं जगत् । तदीश्वरः परं ब्रह्म तस्माद् ब्रह्ममयं जगत्
verses.transliteration: avyaktātmakamevedaṃ cetanācetanaṃ jagat / tadīśvaraḥ paraṃ brahma tasmād brahmamayaṃ jagat
verses.translation: He should worship Narayana who is the source of origin of the universe, whose greatest region is in the firmament.
verses.hindi: मुनियोंने कहा--कूर्मरूपधारी परमात्मा विष्णुको नमस्कार है। विश्वरूप नारायण वासुदेव! आपको नमस्कार है। कृष्णको बार-बार नमस्कार है। गोविन्दको बारम्बार नमस्कार है। माधव! आपको नमस्कार है।
verses.wordMeaning: He should worship Narayana who is the source of origin of the universe, whose greatest region is in the firmament.
verses.commentary: Sense: He should worship Narayana who is the source of origin of the universe, whose greatest region is in the firmament.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच एतावदुक्त्वा भगवान् विरराम जनार्दनः । तुष्टुवुर्मुनयो विष्णुं शक्रेण सह माधवम्
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca etāvaduktvā bhagavān virarāma janārdanaḥ / tuṣṭuvurmunayo viṣṇuṃ śakreṇa saha mādhavam
verses.translation: The same procedure is to be followed in the final Brahma-Bhavana (meditation of Brahman). Thus the perfect knowledge related to Bhavana (meditation) has been explained by me.
verses.hindi: यज्ञेश्वरको नमस्कार है हजारों सिरवाले तथा हजारों नेत्रवाले आपको नमस्कार है। हजारों हाथ तथा हजारों चरणवाले आपको नमस्कार है। प्रणवस्वरूप-ज्ञानरूप परमात्माको नमस्कार है। आनन्दरूप आपको नमस्कार है। आप मायातीतको
verses.wordMeaning: The same procedure is to be followed in the final Brahma-Bhavana (meditation of Brahman). Thus the perfect knowledge related to Bhavana (meditation) has been explained by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: The same procedure is to be followed in the final Brahma-Bhavana (meditation of Brahman). Thus the perfect knowledge related to Bhavana (meditation) has been explained by me.

verses.sanskrit: मुनय ऊचुः नमस्ते कूर्मरूपाय विष्णवे परमात्मने । नारायणाय विश्वाय वासुदेवाय ते नमः
verses.transliteration: munaya ūcuḥ namaste kūrmarūpāya viṣṇave paramātmane / nārāyaṇāya viśvāya vāsudevāya te namaḥ
verses.translation: It is said that (the greatness) of Hara (predominates) in the Tamasa Kalpas and (the greatness) of Prajapati (pre¬ dominates) in the Rajasa Kalpa. The Varaha Kalpa that is current now is considered to be Sattvika.
verses.hindi: नमस्कार है। गूढ (रहस्यमय) शरीरवाले आपको नमस्कार है। आप निर्गुणको नमस्कार है। पुराणपुरुष तथा सत्तामात्र स्वरूपवाले आपको नमस्कार है। सांख्य तथा योगरूप आपको नमस्कार है । अद्वितीय (तत्त्वरूप)
verses.wordMeaning: It is said that (the greatness) of Hara (predominates) in the Tamasa Kalpas and (the greatness) of Prajapati (pre¬ dominates) in the Rajasa Kalpa. The Varaha Kalpa that is current now is considered to be Sattvika.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is said that (the greatness) of Hara (predominates) in the Tamasa Kalpas and (the greatness) of Prajapati (pre¬ dominates) in the Rajasa Kalpa. The Varaha Kalpa that is current now is considered to be Sattvika.

verses.sanskrit: नमो नमस्ते कृष्णाय गोविन्दाय नमो नमः । माधवाय नमस्तुभ्यं नमो यज्ञेश्वराय च
verses.transliteration: namo namaste kṛṣṇāya govindāya namo namaḥ / mādhavāya namastubhyaṃ namo yajñeśvarāya ca
verses.translation: Obeisance to you, to Visnu, the great Atman of the form of the tortoise. Hail to Vasudeva, to omnipresent Narayana.
verses.hindi: आपको नमस्कार है। धर्म तथा ज्ञानद्वारा प्राप्त होनेवाले आपको तथा निष्कल आपको बार-बार नमस्कार है। व्योमतत्त्वरूप महायोगेश्वरको नमस्कार है। पर तथा अवर पदार्थोको उत्पन्न करनेवाले वेदद्वारा वेद्य आपको शुद्ध (निराकारस्वरूप) आपको नमस्कार है, बुद्ध (ज्ञानस्वरूप) आपको नमस्कार है। योगयुक्त तथा हेतु (अनन्त प्रपञ्चके मूल कारण)-रूपको नमस्कार है। आपको बार-बार नमस्कार है। मायावी (मायाके नियन्त्रक)
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you, to Visnu, the great Atman of the form of the tortoise. Hail to Vasudeva, to omnipresent Narayana.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you, to Visnu, the great Atman of the form of the tortoise. Hail to Vasudeva, to omnipresent Narayana.

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रशिरसे तुभ्यं सहस्राक्षाय ते नमः । नमः सहस्रहस्ताय सहस्रचरणाय च
verses.transliteration: sahasraśirase tubhyaṃ sahasrākṣāya te namaḥ / namaḥ sahasrahastāya sahasracaraṇāya ca
verses.translation: Obeisance, again and again to you, to Krsna, and to Govinda, Obeisance always to you, to Madhava, to the lord of Yajnas.
verses.hindi: वेधा (विश्व-प्रपञ्चके स्रष्टा)-को नमस्कार है
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance, again and again to you, to Krsna, and to Govinda, Obeisance always to you, to Madhava, to the lord of Yajnas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance, again and again to you, to Krsna, and to Govinda, Obeisance always to you, to Madhava, to the lord of Yajnas.

verses.sanskrit: ॐ नमो ज्ञानरूपाय परमात्मस्वरूपिणे । आनन्दाय नमस्तुभ्यं मायातीताय ते नमः
verses.transliteration: oṃ namo jñānarūpāya paramātmasvarūpiṇe / ānandāya namastubhyaṃ māyātītāya te namaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to you with a thousand (i.e. innumer¬ able) heads. Salutation to you with a thousand eyes. Obeisance to one with a thousand hands and to one with a thousand feet.
verses.hindi: वराहरूप आपको नमस्कार है। आप नरसिंह- रूपधारीको नमस्कार है। वामनरूप आपको नमस्कार है। आप हृषीकेश (इन्द्रियके ईश)-को नमस्कार है। कालरुद्रको नमस्कार है। कालरूप आपको नमस्कार है। स्वर्ग तथा अपवर्ग प्रदान करनेवाले और अप्रतिहत आत्मा (शाश्वत अद्वितीय)-को नमस्कार है
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you with a thousand (i.e. innumer¬ able) heads. Salutation to you with a thousand eyes. Obeisance to one with a thousand hands and to one with a thousand feet.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you with a thousand (i.e. innumer¬ able) heads. Salutation to you with a thousand eyes. Obeisance to one with a thousand hands and to one with a thousand feet.

verses.sanskrit: नमो गूढशरीराय निर्गुणाय नमो ऽस्तु ते । पुरुषाय पुराणाय सत्तामात्रस्वरूपिणे
verses.transliteration: namo gūḍhaśarīrāya nirguṇāya namo 'stu te / puruṣāya purāṇāya sattāmātrasvarūpiṇe
verses.translation: Om! Hail to Visnu of the embodiment of perfect knowledge, to the great Atman. Obeisance to you, the Bliss. Bow to you who are beyond the pale of Maya.
verses.hindi: देवानां पतये तुभ्यं देवार्तिशमनाय ते
verses.wordMeaning: Om! Hail to Visnu of the embodiment of perfect knowledge, to the great Atman. Obeisance to you, the Bliss. Bow to you who are beyond the pale of Maya.
verses.commentary: Sense: Om! Hail to Visnu of the embodiment of perfect knowledge, to the great Atman. Obeisance to you, the Bliss. Bow to you who are beyond the pale of Maya.

verses.sanskrit: नमः सांख्याय योगाय केवलाय नमो ऽस्तु ते । धर्मज्ञानाधिगम्याय निष्कलाय नमो नमः
verses.transliteration: namaḥ sāṃkhyāya yogāya kevalāya namo 'stu te / dharmajñānādhigamyāya niṣkalāya namo namaḥ
verses.translation: Salutation to you of concealed body (or O Kurma- Tortoise), to you the attributeless (Nirguna) one, to the ancient Purusa, of the form of only pure Existence.
verses.hindi: श्रुतास्तु विविधा धर्मा वंशा मन्वन्तराणि च। सर्गश्च प्रतिसर्गश्च ब्रह्माण्डस्यास्य विस्तरः त्वं हि सर्वजगत्साक्षी विश्वो नारायणः परः। त्रातुमर्हस्यनन्तात्मंस्त्वमेव शरणं गतिः
verses.wordMeaning: Salutation to you of concealed body (or O Kurma- Tortoise), to you the attributeless (Nirguna) one, to the ancient Purusa, of the form of only pure Existence.
verses.commentary: Sense: Salutation to you of concealed body (or O Kurma- Tortoise), to you the attributeless (Nirguna) one, to the ancient Purusa, of the form of only pure Existence.

verses.sanskrit: नमोस्तु व्योमतत्त्वाय महायोगेश्वराय च । परावराणां प्रभवे वेदवेद्याय ते नमः
verses.transliteration: namostu vyomatattvāya mahāyogeśvarāya ca / parāvarāṇāṃ prabhave vedavedyāya te namaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to Sankhya; Bow to the pure Yoga, obeisance to you, comprehensible through the meditation on Dharma; salutation be to the unsullied one.
verses.hindi: एतद् वः कथितं विप्रा योगमोक्षप्रदायकम्। कौर्म पुराणमखिलं यज्जगाद गदाधरः
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to Sankhya; Bow to the pure Yoga, obeisance to you, comprehensible through the meditation on Dharma; salutation be to the unsullied one.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to Sankhya; Bow to the pure Yoga, obeisance to you, comprehensible through the meditation on Dharma; salutation be to the unsullied one.

verses.sanskrit: नमो बुद्धाय शुद्धाय नमो युक्ताय हेतवे । नमो नमो नमस्तुभ्यं मायिने वेधसे नमः
verses.transliteration: namo buddhāya śuddhāya namo yuktāya hetave / namo namo namastubhyaṃ māyine vedhase namaḥ
verses.translation: Hail to you the principle of Yoga; obeisance to the Isvara of great Yoga; obeisance to the lord of the greater and
verses.hindi: अस्मिन् पुराणे लक्ष्म्यास्तु सम्भवः कथितः पुरा। मोहायाशेषभूतानां वासुदेवेन योजनम् प्रजापतीनां सर्गस्तु वर्णधर्माश्च वृत्तयः। धर्मार्थकाममोक्षाणां यथावल्लक्षणं शुभम्
verses.wordMeaning: Hail to you the principle of Yoga; obeisance to the Isvara of great Yoga; obeisance to the lord of the greater and
verses.commentary: Sense: Hail to you the principle of Yoga; obeisance to the Isvara of great Yoga; obeisance to the lord of the greater and

verses.sanskrit: नमो ऽस्तु ते वराहाय नारसिंहाय ते नमः । वामनाय नमस्तुभ्यं हृषीकेशाय ते नमः
verses.transliteration: namo 'stu te varāhāya nārasiṃhāya te namaḥ / vāmanāya namastubhyaṃ hṛṣīkeśāya te namaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to the enlightened one, to the pure one; Bows again and again to you, the wielder of Maya. Obeisance to Vedhas.
verses.hindi: हिरण्यगर्भसर्गश्च कीर्तितो मुनिपुंगवाः
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the enlightened one, to the pure one; Bows again and again to you, the wielder of Maya. Obeisance to Vedhas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the enlightened one, to the pure one; Bows again and again to you, the wielder of Maya. Obeisance to Vedhas.

verses.sanskrit: नमो ऽस्तु कालरुद्राय कालरूपाय ते नमः । स्वर्गापवर्गदात्रे च नमो ऽप्रतिहतात्मने
verses.transliteration: namo 'stu kālarudrāya kālarūpāya te namaḥ / svargāpavargadātre ca namo 'pratihatātmane
verses.translation: Hail to you Varaha; obeisance to you Nara- simha; bow to you Vamana; obeisance to you Hrsikesa.
verses.hindi: कालसंख्याप्रकथनं माहात्म्यं चेश्वरस्य च। ब्रह्मणः शयनं चाप्सु नामनिर्वचनं तथा मुख्यादिसर्गककथनं मुनिसर्गस्तथापरः
verses.wordMeaning: Hail to you Varaha; obeisance to you Nara- simha; bow to you Vamana; obeisance to you Hrsikesa.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hail to you Varaha; obeisance to you Nara- simha; bow to you Vamana; obeisance to you Hrsikesa.

verses.sanskrit: नमो योगाधिगम्याय योगिने योगदायिने । देवानां पतये तुभ्यं देवार्तिशमनाय ते
verses.transliteration: namo yogādhigamyāya yogine yogadāyine / devānāṃ pataye tubhyaṃ devārtiśamanāya te
verses.translation: Obeisance to the bestower of heavenly pleasures and salvation; salutation to one whose Atman is un-obstructed. Obeisance to one attainable through Yoga; obeisance to the Yogin, to the bestower of Yogas.
verses.hindi: व्याख्यातो रुद्रसर्गश्व ऋषिसर्गश्च तापसः। धर्मस्य च प्रजासर्गस्तामसात् पूर्वमेव तु
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the bestower of heavenly pleasures and salvation; salutation to one whose Atman is un-obstructed. Obeisance to one attainable through Yoga; obeisance to the Yogin, to the bestower of Yogas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the bestower of heavenly pleasures and salvation; salutation to one whose Atman is un-obstructed. Obeisance to one attainable through Yoga; obeisance to the Yogin, to the bestower of Yogas.

verses.sanskrit: भगवंस्त्वत्प्रसादेन सर्वसंसारनाशनम् । अस्माभिर्विदितं ज्ञानं यज्ज्ञात्वामृतमश्नुते
verses.transliteration: bhagavaṃstvatprasādena sarvasaṃsāranāśanam / asmābhirviditaṃ jñānaṃ yajjñātvāmṛtamaśnute
verses.translation: The granting of divine vision unto Brahma, the supreme god (Paramesthin); the eulogy of the lord of Devas by Brahma, Paramesthin.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मविष्णुविवादः स्यादन्तर्देहप्रवेशनम्। पद्योद्धवत्वं देवस्य मोहस्तस्य च धीमतः दर्शनं च महेशस्य माहात्म्यं विष्णुनेरितम्। दिव्यदृष्टरिप्रदानं च ब्रह्मणः परमेष्ठिनः
verses.wordMeaning: The granting of divine vision unto Brahma, the supreme god (Paramesthin); the eulogy of the lord of Devas by Brahma, Paramesthin.
verses.commentary: Sense: The granting of divine vision unto Brahma, the supreme god (Paramesthin); the eulogy of the lord of Devas by Brahma, Paramesthin.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुतास्तु विविधा धर्मा वंशा मन्वन्तराणि च । सर्गश्च प्रतिसर्गश्च ब्रह्माण्यस्यास्य विस्तरः
verses.transliteration: śrutāstu vividhā dharmā vaṃśā manvantarāṇi ca / sargaśca pratisargaśca brahmāṇyasyāsya vistaraḥ
verses.translation: The incarnation of lord Brahma from the umbilical lotus of Visnu is described. So also the unification of the lord with Brahma formerly has been narrated.
verses.hindi: योगाधिगम्य, योगी और योगदाताको नमस्कार है।
verses.wordMeaning: The incarnation of lord Brahma from the umbilical lotus of Visnu is described. So also the unification of the lord with Brahma formerly has been narrated.
verses.commentary: Sense: The incarnation of lord Brahma from the umbilical lotus of Visnu is described. So also the unification of the lord with Brahma formerly has been narrated.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं हि सर्वजगत्साक्षी विश्वो नारायणः परः । त्रातुमर्हस्यनन्तात्मंस्त्वमेव शरणं गतिः
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ hi sarvajagatsākṣī viśvo nārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ / trātumarhasyanantātmaṃstvameva śaraṇaṃ gatiḥ
verses.translation: The delusion of Brahma and then the recognition of Hari has been described; the performance of the penance by the intelligent lord of Devas has been narrated.
verses.hindi: करनेवाले आपको नमस्कार है भगवन्! आपकी कृपासे समस्त संसार (भवबन्धन)- का नाश हो जाता है। हमें आपसे वह ज्ञान प्राप्त हुआ है, जिसे जानकर अमृतत्वकी प्रासि होती है। हम लोगोंने विविध धर्म, वंश, मन्वन्तर, सर्ग, प्रतिसर्ग तथा इस
verses.wordMeaning: The delusion of Brahma and then the recognition of Hari has been described; the performance of the penance by the intelligent lord of Devas has been narrated.
verses.commentary: Sense: The delusion of Brahma and then the recognition of Hari has been described; the performance of the penance by the intelligent lord of Devas has been narrated.

verses.sanskrit: सूत उवाच एतद् वः कथितं विप्रा योगमोक्षप्रदायकम् । कौर्मं पुराणमखिलं यज्जगाद गदाधरः
verses.transliteration: sūta uvāca etad vaḥ kathitaṃ viprā yogamokṣapradāyakam / kaurmaṃ purāṇamakhilaṃ yajjagāda gadādharaḥ
verses.translation: The appearance of Mahesa from the forehead of Brahma is mentioned thereafter; the creative activity of the Rudras and its prohibition of the same by Brahma is told.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्माण्डके विस्तारके विषयमें आपसे सुना। आप ही सम्पूर्ण जगतूके साक्षी, विश्वरूप और परम नारायण हैं। अनन्तात्मन्! आप ही हम लोगोंकी शरण और गति हैं। आप हमारी रक्षा करें॥ ६५--६७॥
verses.wordMeaning: The appearance of Mahesa from the forehead of Brahma is mentioned thereafter; the creative activity of the Rudras and its prohibition of the same by Brahma is told.
verses.commentary: Sense: The appearance of Mahesa from the forehead of Brahma is mentioned thereafter; the creative activity of the Rudras and its prohibition of the same by Brahma is told.

verses.sanskrit: अस्मिन् पुराणे लक्ष्म्यास्तु संभवः कथितः पुरा । मोहायाशेषभूतानां वासुदेवेन योजनम्
verses.transliteration: asmin purāṇe lakṣmyāstu saṃbhavaḥ kathitaḥ purā / mohāyāśeṣabhūtānāṃ vāsudevena yojanam
verses.translation: Afterwards the daughtership of the goddess of Daksa as well as that of Himalaya is described alongwith the reality of the goddess.
verses.hindi: सूतजीने कहा--विप्रो ! योग तथा मोक्ष प्रदान करनेवाले उस सम्पूर्ण कूर्मपुराणको मैंने आप लोगोंको बतलाया, जिसे गदाधर (कूर्मभगवान्)-ने कहा था। पहले इस पुराणमें सम्पूर्ण प्राणियोंको मोहित करनेके लिये लक्ष्मीकी उत्पत्ति तथा वासुदेवके साथ उनके संयोगका वर्णन किया गया है। तदनन्तर प्रजापतियोंकी सृष्टि, वर्णोंके धर्मों और उनकी वृत्तियोंका वर्णन तथा धर्म, अर्थ, काम एवं मोक्षके शुभ लक्षणोंका यथावत् वर्णन किया गया है। इसमें पितामह
verses.wordMeaning: Afterwards the daughtership of the goddess of Daksa as well as that of Himalaya is described alongwith the reality of the goddess.
verses.commentary: Sense: Afterwards the daughtership of the goddess of Daksa as well as that of Himalaya is described alongwith the reality of the goddess.

verses.sanskrit: प्रजापतीनां सर्गस्तु वर्णधर्माश्च वृत्तयः । धर्मार्थकाममोक्षाणां यथावल्लक्षणं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: prajāpatīnāṃ sargastu varṇadharmāśca vṛttayaḥ / dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ yathāvallakṣaṇaṃ śubham
verses.translation: The manifestation of the divine and the universe- form, the thousand names of the goddess are enumerated by the father Himavan himself.
verses.hindi: (ब्रह्मा), विष्णु तथा धीमान् महेश्वरके एकत्व, पृथकृत्व और वैशिष्ट्यका वर्णन हुआ है  भक्तोंके लक्षण तथा सुन्दर सदाचारको कहा गया है। साथ ही वर्णों तथा आश्रमोंके लक्षणोंको शास्त्रानुसार बतलाया गया है ॥ ६८--७२॥
verses.wordMeaning: The manifestation of the divine and the universe- form, the thousand names of the goddess are enumerated by the father Himavan himself.
verses.commentary: Sense: The manifestation of the divine and the universe- form, the thousand names of the goddess are enumerated by the father Himavan himself.

verses.sanskrit: पितामहस्य विष्णोश्च महेशस्य च धीमतः । एकत्वं च पृथक्त्वं च विशेषश्चोपवर्णितः
verses.transliteration: pitāmahasya viṣṇośca maheśasya ca dhīmataḥ / ekatvaṃ ca pṛthaktvaṃ ca viśeṣaścopavarṇitaḥ
verses.translation: The advice given by the great goddess; the grant¬ ing of the boons; The creation of subjects by Bhrgu and others; the detailed narration of the race of kings.
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर आदिसर्ग पुन: सात आवरणयुक्त ब्रह्माण्डका वर्णन हुआ है। मुनिश्रेष्ठो! फिर हिरण्यगर्भसर्ग कहा गया है। काल-गणनाका विवरण, ईश्वरका माहात्म्य, ब्रह्माका जलमें शयन तथा भगवान्के नामोंकी निरुक्तिका वर्णन हुआ है। (विष्णुद्वारा) वराह-शरीर धारणकर भूमि (पृथ्वी)- के उद्धार करनेका भी इसमें वर्णन हुआ है। तदनन्तर पहले मुख्यसर्ग आदि और पुनः मुनिसर्ग बताया गया है। (इस पुराणमें) रुद्रसर्ग, ऋषिसर्ग, तापससर्ग और तामससर्गसे
verses.wordMeaning: The advice given by the great goddess; the grant¬ ing of the boons; The creation of subjects by Bhrgu and others; the detailed narration of the race of kings.
verses.commentary: Sense: The advice given by the great goddess; the grant¬ ing of the boons; The creation of subjects by Bhrgu and others; the detailed narration of the race of kings.

verses.sanskrit: भक्तानां लक्षणं प्रोक्तं समाचारश्च शोभनः । वर्णाश्रमाणां कथितं यथावदिह लक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: bhaktānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ samācāraśca śobhanaḥ / varṇāśramāṇāṃ kathitaṃ yathāvadiha lakṣaṇam
verses.translation: The Pracetasatva (the state of being the son of Pracetas) of Daksa, the destruction of Yajna of Daksa, the dispute between Dadhica and Daksa is then narrated.
verses.hindi: पहले धर्मका प्रजासर्ग बताया गया है॥ ७३--७६ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: The Pracetasatva (the state of being the son of Pracetas) of Daksa, the destruction of Yajna of Daksa, the dispute between Dadhica and Daksa is then narrated.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Pracetasatva (the state of being the son of Pracetas) of Daksa, the destruction of Yajna of Daksa, the dispute between Dadhica and Daksa is then narrated.

verses.sanskrit: आदिसर्गस्ततः पश्चादण्डावरणसप्तकम् । हिरण्यगर्भसर्गश्च कीर्तितो मुनिपुङ्गवाः
verses.transliteration: ādisargastataḥ paścādaṇḍāvaraṇasaptakam / hiraṇyagarbhasargaśca kīrtito munipuṅgavāḥ
verses.translation: O leading sages, thereafter the imprecation of the sages (by Dadhica) has been mentioned; then the arrival of Rudra, his grace and the vanishment of the Pinaka-bearing lord.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मा एवं विष्णुके विवाद और (परस्पर) एक- दूसरेके देहके अन्तर्गत प्रविष्ट होने, ब्रह्मके कमलसे उत्पन्न होने और धीमान् देव (ब्रह्मा)-के मोहका (इस पुराणमें) वर्णन हुआ है तत्पश्चात् (ब्रह्माद्वारा) महेशका दर्शन करने, विष्णु- द्वारा कहे गये उनके माहात्म्य और परमेष्ठी ब्रह्माको दिव्य
verses.wordMeaning: O leading sages, thereafter the imprecation of the sages (by Dadhica) has been mentioned; then the arrival of Rudra, his grace and the vanishment of the Pinaka-bearing lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading sages, thereafter the imprecation of the sages (by Dadhica) has been mentioned; then the arrival of Rudra, his grace and the vanishment of the Pinaka-bearing lord.

verses.sanskrit: कालसंख्याप्रकथनं माहात्म्यं चेश्वरस्य च । ब्रह्मणः शयनं चाप्सु नामनिर्वचनं तथा
verses.transliteration: kālasaṃkhyāprakathanaṃ māhātmyaṃ ceśvarasya ca / brahmaṇaḥ śayanaṃ cāpsu nāmanirvacanaṃ tathā
verses.translation: Then the advice to Pitamaha for the protection is described {ranaya* 'for fighting'), the creation of the subjects by Daksa and Kasyapa, the great Atman.
verses.hindi: संस्तवो देवदेवस्य ब्रह्मणा परमेष्टिना। प्रसादो गिरिशास्याथ वरदानं तथैव च
verses.wordMeaning: Then the advice to Pitamaha for the protection is described {ranaya* 'for fighting'), the creation of the subjects by Daksa and Kasyapa, the great Atman.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the advice to Pitamaha for the protection is described {ranaya* 'for fighting'), the creation of the subjects by Daksa and Kasyapa, the great Atman.

verses.sanskrit: वराहवपुषा भूयो भूमेरुद्धरणं पुनः । मुख्यादिसर्गकथनं मुनिसर्गस्तथापरः
verses.transliteration: varāhavapuṣā bhūyo bhūmeruddharaṇaṃ punaḥ / mukhyādisargakathanaṃ munisargastathāparaḥ
verses.translation: The slaying of Hiranyakasipu and then that of Hiranyaksa, thereafter, the curse to the dwellers of the Devadaru forest is mentioned.
verses.hindi: संवादो विष्णुना सार्ध शंकरस्य महात्मनः । वरदानं तथापूर्वमन्तर्धानं पिनाकिनः अवतारोऽथ देवस्य ब्रह्मणो नाभिपङ्कजात्
verses.wordMeaning: The slaying of Hiranyakasipu and then that of Hiranyaksa, thereafter, the curse to the dwellers of the Devadaru forest is mentioned.
verses.commentary: Sense: The slaying of Hiranyakasipu and then that of Hiranyaksa, thereafter, the curse to the dwellers of the Devadaru forest is mentioned.

verses.sanskrit: व्याख्यतो रुद्रसर्गश्च ऋषिसर्गश्च तापसः । धर्मस्य च प्रजासर्गस्तामसात् पूर्वमेव तु
verses.transliteration: vyākhyato rudrasargaśca ṛṣisargaśca tāpasaḥ / dharmasya ca prajāsargastāmasāt pūrvameva tu
verses.translation: Then the subjugation ofAndhaka and the (granting of) the excellent chieftainship of the Ganas. The curbing of Prahlada and the binding over of Bali.
verses.hindi: एकीभावश्च देवस्य विष्णुना कथितस्ततः। विमोहो ब्रह्मणश्चाथ संज्ञालाभो हरेस्तत: ८२॥ तपश्चरणमाख्यातं देवदेवस्य धीमतः। प्रादुर्भावो महेशस्य ललाटात् कथितस्ततः
verses.wordMeaning: Then the subjugation ofAndhaka and the (granting of) the excellent chieftainship of the Ganas. The curbing of Prahlada and the binding over of Bali.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the subjugation ofAndhaka and the (granting of) the excellent chieftainship of the Ganas. The curbing of Prahlada and the binding over of Bali.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मविष्णुविवादः स्यादन्तर्देहप्रवेशनम् । पद्मोद्भवत्वं देवस्य मोहस्तस्य च धीमतः
verses.transliteration: brahmaviṣṇuvivādaḥ syādantardehapraveśanam / padmodbhavatvaṃ devasya mohastasya ca dhīmataḥ
verses.translation: The defeat of Bana and the grace shown to him by the trident-bearing lord; the detailed narration of the families of the sages; the races of the king are glorified.
verses.hindi: रुद्राणां कथिता सूष्टिरब्रह्मणः प्रतिषेधनम्। भूतिश्च देवदेवस्य वरदानोपदेशकौ दर्शनं देवदेवस्य नरनारीशरीरता
verses.wordMeaning: The defeat of Bana and the grace shown to him by the trident-bearing lord; the detailed narration of the families of the sages; the races of the king are glorified.
verses.commentary: Sense: The defeat of Bana and the grace shown to him by the trident-bearing lord; the detailed narration of the families of the sages; the races of the king are glorified.

verses.sanskrit: दर्शनं च महेशस्य माहात्म्यं विष्णुनेरितम् । दिव्यदृष्टिप्रदानं च ब्रह्मणः परमेष्ठिनः
verses.transliteration: darśanaṃ ca maheśasya māhātmyaṃ viṣṇuneritam / divyadṛṣṭipradānaṃ ca brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ
verses.translation: The birth of Hari, Visnu out of his own free will from Vasudeva, visit to Upamanyu and the performance of penance.
verses.hindi: देव्या विभागकथनं देवदेवात् पिनाकिनः । देव्यास्तु पश्चात् कथितं दक्षपुत्रीत्वमेब च
verses.wordMeaning: The birth of Hari, Visnu out of his own free will from Vasudeva, visit to Upamanyu and the performance of penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: The birth of Hari, Visnu out of his own free will from Vasudeva, visit to Upamanyu and the performance of penance.

verses.sanskrit: संस्तवो देवदेवस्य ब्रह्मणा परमेष्ठिना । प्रसादो गिरिशस्याथ वरदानं तथैव च
verses.transliteration: saṃstavo devadevasya brahmaṇā parameṣṭhinā / prasādo giriśasyātha varadānaṃ tathaiva ca
verses.translation: The acquisition of the boon after seeing the three¬ eyed Mahadeva accompanied by Amba; the departure to Kailasa and staying there by Sarngin (Krsna).
verses.hindi: हिमवददुहितृत्वं च देव्या माहात्म्यमेव च। दर्शनं दिव्यरूपस्य वैश्वरूपस्य दर्शनम् उपदेशो महादेव्या वरदानं तथैव च
verses.wordMeaning: The acquisition of the boon after seeing the three¬ eyed Mahadeva accompanied by Amba; the departure to Kailasa and staying there by Sarngin (Krsna).
verses.commentary: Sense: The acquisition of the boon after seeing the three¬ eyed Mahadeva accompanied by Amba; the departure to Kailasa and staying there by Sarngin (Krsna).

verses.sanskrit: संवादो विष्णुना सार्धं शङ्करस्य महात्मनः । वरदानं तथापूर्वमन्तर्धानं पिनाकिनः
verses.transliteration: saṃvādo viṣṇunā sārdhaṃ śaṅkarasya mahātmanaḥ / varadānaṃ tathāpūrvamantardhānaṃ pinākinaḥ
verses.translation: Then the fear of the dwellers of Dvaravatl, their protection by Garuda after conquering the powerful enemies are described.
verses.hindi: प्राचेतसत्वं दक्षस्य दक्षयज्ञविमर्दनम्
verses.wordMeaning: Then the fear of the dwellers of Dvaravatl, their protection by Garuda after conquering the powerful enemies are described.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the fear of the dwellers of Dvaravatl, their protection by Garuda after conquering the powerful enemies are described.

verses.sanskrit: वधश्च कथितो विप्रा मधुकैटभयोः पुरा । अवतारो ऽथ देवस्य ब्रह्मणो नाभिपङ्कजात्
verses.transliteration: vadhaśca kathito viprā madhukaiṭabhayoḥ purā / avatāro 'tha devasya brahmaṇo nābhipaṅkajāt
verses.translation: The arrival of Narada and the journey of Garutman (Garuda), thereafter the arrival of Krsna to the hermitage of the sages.
verses.hindi: ततश्च शापः कथितो मुनीनां मुनिपुंगवाः पितामहस्योपदेशः कीर्त्यते रक्षणाय तु
verses.wordMeaning: The arrival of Narada and the journey of Garutman (Garuda), thereafter the arrival of Krsna to the hermitage of the sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: The arrival of Narada and the journey of Garutman (Garuda), thereafter the arrival of Krsna to the hermitage of the sages.

verses.sanskrit: एकीभावश्च देवस्य विष्णुना कथितस्ततः । विमोहो ब्रह्मणश्चाथ संज्ञालाभो हरेस्ततः
verses.transliteration: ekībhāvaśca devasya viṣṇunā kathitastataḥ / vimoho brahmaṇaścātha saṃjñālābho harestataḥ
verses.translation: The daily routine of Vasudeva. His worship of Sivalinga. Thereafter, the questions put by the sage Mar- kandeya have been mentioned.
verses.hindi: ततश्च शापः कथितो देवदारुवनौकसाम्। निग्रहश्चान्धकस्याथ गाणपत्यमनुत्तमम्
verses.wordMeaning: The daily routine of Vasudeva. His worship of Sivalinga. Thereafter, the questions put by the sage Mar- kandeya have been mentioned.
verses.commentary: Sense: The daily routine of Vasudeva. His worship of Sivalinga. Thereafter, the questions put by the sage Mar- kandeya have been mentioned.

verses.sanskrit: तपश्चरणमाख्यातं देवदेवस्य धीमतः । प्रादुर्भावो महेशस्य ललाटात् कथितस्ततः
verses.transliteration: tapaścaraṇamākhyātaṃ devadevasya dhīmataḥ / prādurbhāvo maheśasya lalāṭāt kathitastataḥ
verses.translation: The narration of the precise nature of the Linga and the Lingin as a sequel to the narration of the worship of Linga, the fear arising out of Linga. *
verses.hindi: दृष्टि प्रदान करनेका वर्णन हुआ है । परमेष्ठी ब्रह्माद्वारा देवाधिदेव (महेश्वर)-की स्तुति, (प्रसन्न होकर) गिरिंशद्वारा अनुग्रह तथा वर प्रदान करनेका भी वर्णन हुआ है। विष्णुके साथ महात्मा शंकरके संवाद, पिनाकीद्वारा वर प्रदान करने और उनके अन्तर्धान होनेका वर्णन हुआ है
verses.wordMeaning: The narration of the precise nature of the Linga and the Lingin as a sequel to the narration of the worship of Linga, the fear arising out of Linga. *
verses.commentary: Sense: The narration of the precise nature of the Linga and the Lingin as a sequel to the narration of the worship of Linga, the fear arising out of Linga. *

verses.sanskrit: रुद्राणां कथिता सृष्टिर्ब्रह्मणः प्रतिषेधनम् । भूतिश्च देवदेवस्य वरदानोपदेशकौ
verses.transliteration: rudrāṇāṃ kathitā sṛṣṭirbrahmaṇaḥ pratiṣedhanam / bhūtiśca devadevasya varadānopadeśakau
verses.translation: O leading sages, in the middle, the delusion of Brahma and Visnu has been described and their departure up and down the Linga has been related.
verses.hindi: विप्रो! इसमें प्राचीन कालमें हुए मधुकैटभके वधका तथा देव (विष्णु)-के नाभिकमलसे ब्रह्माके अवतारका वर्णन हुआ है । तदनन्तर विष्णुसे देव ब्रह्माके एकीभावको कहा गया है और ब्रह्माका मोहित होना
verses.wordMeaning: O leading sages, in the middle, the delusion of Brahma and Visnu has been described and their departure up and down the Linga has been related.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading sages, in the middle, the delusion of Brahma and Visnu has been described and their departure up and down the Linga has been related.

verses.sanskrit: अन्तर्धानं च रुद्रस्य तपश्चर्याण्डजस्य च । दर्शनं देवदेवस्य नरनारीशरीरता
verses.transliteration: antardhānaṃ ca rudrasya tapaścaryāṇḍajasya ca / darśanaṃ devadevasya naranārīśarīratā
verses.translation: The eulogy of the lord of Devas, the grace of supreme deity Siva, vanishment of the Linga and the birth of Samba thereafter.
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर हरिसे चेतनाप्रापिको बताया गया है तदुपरान्त धीमान् देवाधिदेवकी तपश्चर्याका वर्णन है और फिर उनके (ब्रह्माके) मस्तकसे महेश्वरके प्रादुर्भावका वर्णन किया गया है। रुद्रोंकी सृष्टि करनेपर ब्रह्माके द्वारा उसके प्रतिषेधका वर्णन हुआ है। देवाधिदेव (शंकर)-
verses.wordMeaning: The eulogy of the lord of Devas, the grace of supreme deity Siva, vanishment of the Linga and the birth of Samba thereafter.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eulogy of the lord of Devas, the grace of supreme deity Siva, vanishment of the Linga and the birth of Samba thereafter.

verses.sanskrit: देव्या विभागकथनं देवदेवात् पिनाकिनः । देव्यास्तु पश्चात् कथितं दक्षपुत्रीत्वमेव च
verses.transliteration: devyā vibhāgakathanaṃ devadevāt pinākinaḥ / devyāstu paścāt kathitaṃ dakṣaputrītvameva ca
verses.translation: O excellent Brahmanas, thereafter Aniruddha's birth has been glorified, (then) the inclination of Krsna to¬ wards departure (thence), and the arrival of the sages.
verses.hindi: के ऐश्वर्य एवं ब्रह्माको वरदान और उपदेश देनेका वर्णन हुआ है। इसके पश्चात् रुद्रके अन्तर्धान होने, ब्रह्माकी तपश्चर्या, देवाधिदेवके दर्शन और उनके नर-नारी-शरीर धारण करनेका वर्णन किया गया है॥ ८३--८५॥
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Brahmanas, thereafter Aniruddha's birth has been glorified, (then) the inclination of Krsna to¬ wards departure (thence), and the arrival of the sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Brahmanas, thereafter Aniruddha's birth has been glorified, (then) the inclination of Krsna to¬ wards departure (thence), and the arrival of the sages.

verses.sanskrit: हिमवद्दुहितृत्वं च देव्या माहात्म्यमेव च । दर्शनं दिव्यरूपस्य वैश्वरूपस्य दर्शनम्
verses.transliteration: himavadduhitṛtvaṃ ca devyā māhātmyameva ca / darśanaṃ divyarūpasya vaiśvarūpasya darśanam
verses.translation: The laying down of precepts by Krsna; the grant¬ ing of the boons by the great Atman, Krsna's departure and visit of Partha (Arjuna).
verses.hindi: देवाधिदेव पिनाकीसे देवी (सती)-के अलगावका कथन हुआ है और फिर देवीका दक्षपुत्रीके रूपमें जन्म लेनेका वर्णन हुआ है। देवीकी हिमवानूकी पुत्री होना और उनके माहात्म्यका वर्णन किया गया है तथा (उनके) दिव्यरूपके दर्शन और विश्वरूपके दर्शनका वर्णन हुआ है। तदुपरान्त स्वयं पिता हिमालयद्वारा कहे गये (देवीके) सहस्रनाम, महादेवीके द्वारा प्रदत्त उपदेश और वरदानका भी वर्णन हुआ है
verses.wordMeaning: The laying down of precepts by Krsna; the grant¬ ing of the boons by the great Atman, Krsna's departure and visit of Partha (Arjuna).
verses.commentary: Sense: The laying down of precepts by Krsna; the grant¬ ing of the boons by the great Atman, Krsna's departure and visit of Partha (Arjuna).

verses.sanskrit: नाम्नां सहस्रं कथितं पित्रा हिमवता स्वयम् । उपदेशो महादेव्या वरदानं तथैव च
verses.transliteration: nāmnāṃ sahasraṃ kathitaṃ pitrā himavatā svayam / upadeśo mahādevyā varadānaṃ tathaiva ca
verses.translation: Narration of the eternal characteristics ofYugasby Krsnadvaipayana; the benediction to Partha and his departure to Varanasi thence.
verses.hindi: भृगु आदि ऋषिर्योका प्रजासर्ग, राजाओंके वंशका विस्तार, दक्षके प्रचेताके पुत्र होने और दक्षयज्ञ-विध्वंसका वर्णन हुआ है। मुनिश्रेष्ठो ! तदनन्तर दधीच और दक्षके विवादको बतलाया गया है, फिर मुनियोंके शापका वर्णन हुआ है
verses.wordMeaning: Narration of the eternal characteristics ofYugasby Krsnadvaipayana; the benediction to Partha and his departure to Varanasi thence.
verses.commentary: Sense: Narration of the eternal characteristics ofYugasby Krsnadvaipayana; the benediction to Partha and his departure to Varanasi thence.

verses.sanskrit: भृग्वादीनां प्रजासर्गो राज्ञां वंशस्य विस्तरः । प्राचेतसत्वं दक्षस्य दक्षयज्ञविमर्दनम्
verses.transliteration: bhṛgvādīnāṃ prajāsargo rājñāṃ vaṃśasya vistaraḥ / prācetasatvaṃ dakṣasya dakṣayajñavimardanam
verses.translation: (The departure to Varanasi) by Vyasa the saintly son of Parasara, the worker of miracles, the greatness of Varanasi and the description of holy centres.
verses.hindi: तदुपरान्त रुद्रके आगमन एवं अनुग्रह और उन पिनाकी रुद्रके अन्तर्धान होने तथा (दक्षकी) रक्षाके लिये पितामहद्दारा उपदेश करनेका वर्णन हुआ है तदुपरान्त दक्षके तथा महात्मा कश्यपसे होनेवाली प्रजासृष्टिका वर्णन है। हिरण्यकशिपुके नष्ट होने तथा हिरण्याक्षके वधका वर्णन हुआ है। इसके बाद देवदारुवनमें निवास करनेवाले मुनिर्योकी शापप्रासिका कथन है,
verses.wordMeaning: (The departure to Varanasi) by Vyasa the saintly son of Parasara, the worker of miracles, the greatness of Varanasi and the description of holy centres.
verses.commentary: Sense: (The departure to Varanasi) by Vyasa the saintly son of Parasara, the worker of miracles, the greatness of Varanasi and the description of holy centres.

verses.sanskrit: दधीचस्य च दक्षस्य विवादः कथितस्तदा । ततश्च शापः कथितो मुनीनां मुनिपुङ्गवाः
verses.transliteration: dadhīcasya ca dakṣasya vivādaḥ kathitastadā / tataśca śāpaḥ kathito munīnāṃ munipuṅgavāḥ
verses.translation: Vyasa's pilgrimage, vision of the goddess, his banishment and granting of the boons (have been mentioned).
verses.hindi: अन्धकके निग्रह और उसको श्रेष्ठ गाणपत्यपद प्रदान करनेका वर्णन हुआ है
verses.wordMeaning: Vyasa's pilgrimage, vision of the goddess, his banishment and granting of the boons (have been mentioned).
verses.commentary: Sense: Vyasa's pilgrimage, vision of the goddess, his banishment and granting of the boons (have been mentioned).

verses.sanskrit: रुद्रागतिः प्रसादश्च अन्तर्धानं पिनाकिनः । पितामहस्योपदेशः कीर्त्यते रक्षणाय तु
verses.transliteration: rudrāgatiḥ prasādaśca antardhānaṃ pinākinaḥ / pitāmahasyopadeśaḥ kīrtyate rakṣaṇāya tu
verses.translation: The greatness of Prayaga; the narration of various holy centres, O Brahmanas, and the enormous benefit therefrom and the going away of Markandeya, O Brahmanas.
verses.hindi: ऋषीणां वंशविस्तारो राज्ञां वंशा: प्रकीर्तिताः । वसुदेवात् ततो विष्णोरुत्पत्ति: स्वेच्छया हरे: वरलाभो महादेवं दृष्टा साम्बं त्रिलोचनम्
verses.wordMeaning: The greatness of Prayaga; the narration of various holy centres, O Brahmanas, and the enormous benefit therefrom and the going away of Markandeya, O Brahmanas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The greatness of Prayaga; the narration of various holy centres, O Brahmanas, and the enormous benefit therefrom and the going away of Markandeya, O Brahmanas.

verses.sanskrit: दक्षस्य च प्रजासर्गः कश्यपस्य महात्मनः । हिरण्यकशिपोर्नाशो हिरण्याक्षवधस्तथा
verses.transliteration: dakṣasya ca prajāsargaḥ kaśyapasya mahātmanaḥ / hiraṇyakaśipornāśo hiraṇyākṣavadhastathā
verses.translation: The nature of the worlds, the arrangement of the luminaries, the decisive position of the sub-continents and the rivers therein.
verses.hindi: नैत्यकं वासुदेवस्य शिवलिङ्कार्चनं तथा
verses.wordMeaning: The nature of the worlds, the arrangement of the luminaries, the decisive position of the sub-continents and the rivers therein.
verses.commentary: Sense: The nature of the worlds, the arrangement of the luminaries, the decisive position of the sub-continents and the rivers therein.

verses.sanskrit: ततश्च शापः कथितो देवदारुवनौकसाम् । निग्रहश्चान्धकस्याथ गाणपत्यमनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: tataśca śāpaḥ kathito devadāruvanaukasām / nigrahaścāndhakasyātha gāṇapatyamanuttamam
verses.translation: The enumeration of the mountains; the abodes of heaven-dwellers; the classification of continents and the description of Sveta Dvipa.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मविष्णवोस्तथा मध्ये कीर्तितो मुनिपुंगवाः १०९॥ संस्तवो देवदेवस्य प्रसादः परमेष्ठिनः १०२ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: The enumeration of the mountains; the abodes of heaven-dwellers; the classification of continents and the description of Sveta Dvipa.
verses.commentary: Sense: The enumeration of the mountains; the abodes of heaven-dwellers; the classification of continents and the description of Sveta Dvipa.

verses.sanskrit: प्रह्रादनिग्रहश्चाथ बलेः संयमनं ततः । बाणस्य निग्रहश्चाथ प्रसादस्तस्य शूलिनः
verses.transliteration: prahrādanigrahaścātha baleḥ saṃyamanaṃ tataḥ / bāṇasya nigrahaścātha prasādastasya śūlinaḥ
verses.translation: The lying (sleeping) ofVisnu, the greatness of the great Atman; the narration of the Manvantaras and the grandeur of Visnu.
verses.hindi: कीर्तिता चानिरुद्धस्य समुत्पत्तिद्विजोत्तमा:
verses.wordMeaning: The lying (sleeping) ofVisnu, the greatness of the great Atman; the narration of the Manvantaras and the grandeur of Visnu.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lying (sleeping) ofVisnu, the greatness of the great Atman; the narration of the Manvantaras and the grandeur of Visnu.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषीणां वंशविस्तारो राज्ञां वंशाः प्रकीर्तिताः । वसुदेवात् ततो विष्णोरुत्पत्तिः स्वेच्छया हरेः
verses.transliteration: ṛṣīṇāṃ vaṃśavistāro rājñāṃ vaṃśāḥ prakīrtitāḥ / vasudevāt tato viṣṇorutpattiḥ svecchayā hareḥ
verses.translation: The classification of the Vedas into Sakhas (branches); the enumeration of Vyasas; O leading sages, (the details) of non-vedas (Puranas etc.) and Vedas have been mentioned.
verses.hindi: कृष्णद्वैपायनस्योक्ता युगधर्माः सनातनाः पाराशर्यस्य च मुनेर्व्यासस्यादभुतकर्मणः
verses.wordMeaning: The classification of the Vedas into Sakhas (branches); the enumeration of Vyasas; O leading sages, (the details) of non-vedas (Puranas etc.) and Vedas have been mentioned.
verses.commentary: Sense: The classification of the Vedas into Sakhas (branches); the enumeration of Vyasas; O leading sages, (the details) of non-vedas (Puranas etc.) and Vedas have been mentioned.

verses.sanskrit: दर्शनं चोपमन्योर्वै तपश्चरणमेव च । वरलाभो महादेवं दृष्ट्वा साम्बं त्रिलोचनम्
verses.transliteration: darśanaṃ copamanyorvai tapaścaraṇameva ca / varalābho mahādevaṃ dṛṣṭvā sāmbaṃ trilocanam
verses.translation: The story of Yogesvaras and the glorification of their disciples. The various mystic Gitas ofisvara have been glorified.
verses.hindi: तीर्थयात्रा च व्यासस्य देव्याश्चैवाथ दर्शनम् । उद्वासनं च कथितं वरदानं तथैव च
verses.wordMeaning: The story of Yogesvaras and the glorification of their disciples. The various mystic Gitas ofisvara have been glorified.
verses.commentary: Sense: The story of Yogesvaras and the glorification of their disciples. The various mystic Gitas ofisvara have been glorified.

verses.sanskrit: कैलासगमनं चाथ निवासस्तत्र शार्ङ्गिणः । ततश्च कथ्यते भीतिर्द्वारिवत्या निवासिनाम्
verses.transliteration: kailāsagamanaṃ cātha nivāsastatra śārṅgiṇaḥ / tataśca kathyate bhītirdvārivatyā nivāsinām
verses.translation: The conduct of life of the castes and stages of life; the mode of expiatory rites; the Kdpalitva (the state of holding the skull) of Rudra and his begging for alms.
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर प्रह़ादके निग्रह, बलिके बाँधे जाने, त्रिशूली (शंकर)-द्वारा बाणासुरके निग्रह और फिर उसपर कृपा करनेका वर्णन हुआ है। इसके पश्चात् ऋषियोंके वंशका विस्तार तथा राजाओंके वंशका वर्णन हुआ है और फिर स्वेच्छासे वसुदेवके पुत्रके रूपमें हरिविष्णुकी उत्पत्तिका वर्णन है
verses.wordMeaning: The conduct of life of the castes and stages of life; the mode of expiatory rites; the Kdpalitva (the state of holding the skull) of Rudra and his begging for alms.
verses.commentary: Sense: The conduct of life of the castes and stages of life; the mode of expiatory rites; the Kdpalitva (the state of holding the skull) of Rudra and his begging for alms.

verses.sanskrit: रक्षणं गरुडेनाथ जित्वा शत्रून् महाबलान् । नारादागमनं चैव यात्रा चैव गरुत्मतः
verses.transliteration: rakṣaṇaṃ garuḍenātha jitvā śatrūn mahābalān / nārādāgamanaṃ caiva yātrā caiva garutmataḥ
verses.translation: The narration of the chaste ladies and the discussion (and decision) about sacred places, the restraint of Mahkanaka. All these have been described.
verses.hindi: उपमन्युका दर्शन करने और तपश्चर्या करनेका वर्णन है। तत्पश्चात् अम्बासहित त्रिलोचन महादेवका दर्शनकर वर प्राप्त करनेका वर्णन हुआ है । तदनन्तर शाङ्गी (कृष्ण)- का कैलासपर जाने और वहाँ निवास करनेका वर्णन
verses.wordMeaning: The narration of the chaste ladies and the discussion (and decision) about sacred places, the restraint of Mahkanaka. All these have been described.
verses.commentary: Sense: The narration of the chaste ladies and the discussion (and decision) about sacred places, the restraint of Mahkanaka. All these have been described.

verses.sanskrit: ततश्च कृष्णागमनं मुनीनामागतिस्ततः । नैत्यकं वासुदेवस्य शिवलिङ्गार्चनं तथा
verses.transliteration: tataśca kṛṣṇāgamanaṃ munīnāmāgatistataḥ / naityakaṃ vāsudevasya śivaliṅgārcanaṃ tathā
verses.translation: O Brahmanas, the killing of Kala is succinctly mentioned. So also the entry of Sambhu as well as of Visnu into the forest of Devadaru trees.
verses.hindi: है फिर द्वारबती-निवासियोंके भयभीत होनेका वर्णन है। इसके बाद महाबलशाली रात्रुओंको जीतकर गरुडके द्वारा (द्वारकावासियोंकी ) रक्षा करने, नारद-आगमन और गरुडकी यात्राका वर्णन हुआ है तदनन्तर कृष्णके आगमन, मुनियोंके आने और वासुदेव (विष्णु)-द्वारा नित्य किये जानेवाले शिव- लिंङ्गार्चनका वर्णन है। तदुपरान्त मुनि मार्कण्डेयजीद्वारा (लिङ्गके विषयमें) प्रश्न करने तथा (वासुदेवद्दारा)
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas, the killing of Kala is succinctly mentioned. So also the entry of Sambhu as well as of Visnu into the forest of Devadaru trees.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas, the killing of Kala is succinctly mentioned. So also the entry of Sambhu as well as of Visnu into the forest of Devadaru trees.

verses.sanskrit: मार्कण्डेयस्य च मुनेः प्रश्नः प्रोक्तस्ततः परम् । लिङ्गार्चननिमित्तं च लिङ्गस्यापि सलिङ्गिनः
verses.transliteration: mārkaṇḍeyasya ca muneḥ praśnaḥ proktastataḥ param / liṅgārcananimittaṃ ca liṅgasyāpi saliṅginaḥ
verses.translation: The manifestation to the sages of the six clans by the intelligent lord of Devas; the granting of boons by the lore to Nandin has been glorified.
verses.hindi: लिङ्गार्चनके प्रयोजन और लिङ्गी (शंकर)-के लिङ्गके स्वरूपका निरूपण हुआ है
verses.wordMeaning: The manifestation to the sages of the six clans by the intelligent lord of Devas; the granting of boons by the lore to Nandin has been glorified.
verses.commentary: Sense: The manifestation to the sages of the six clans by the intelligent lord of Devas; the granting of boons by the lore to Nandin has been glorified.

verses.sanskrit: यथात्म्यकथनं चाथ लिङ्गाविर्भाव एव च । ब्रह्मविष्णोस्तथा मध्ये कीर्तितो मुनिपुङ्गवाः
verses.transliteration: yathātmyakathanaṃ cātha liṅgāvirbhāva eva ca / brahmaviṣṇostathā madhye kīrtito munipuṅgavāḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, the Naimittika dissolution has been described; subsequently the Prakrta dissolution as well as the Sabija yoga has been explained.
verses.hindi: मुनिश्रेष्ठो ! फिर ब्रह्मा तथा विष्णुके मध्य ज्योतिर्लिङ्गके आविर्भाव तथा उसके वास्तविक स्वरूपका वर्णन हुआ है। तदुपरान्त उन दोनोंके मोहित होने तथा (लिङ्गका परिमाण जाननेके लिये) ऊर्ध्वलोक एवं अधोलोकमें जाने, पुनः परमेष्ठी देवाधिदेव (महादेव)-की स्तुति करने और उनके द्वारा अनुग्रह प्रदान करनेका वर्णन हुआ है
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, the Naimittika dissolution has been described; subsequently the Prakrta dissolution as well as the Sabija yoga has been explained.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, the Naimittika dissolution has been described; subsequently the Prakrta dissolution as well as the Sabija yoga has been explained.

verses.sanskrit: मोहस्तयोस्तु कथितो गमनं चोर्ध्वतो ऽप्यधः । संस्तवो देवदेवस्य प्रसादः परमेष्ठिनः
verses.transliteration: mohastayostu kathito gamanaṃ cordhvato 'pyadhaḥ / saṃstavo devadevasya prasādaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ
verses.translation: He who is glorified in the Purana after understanding its summary, thus, becomes freed from all sins and is honoured in the Brahmaloka.
verses.hindi: द्विजोत्तमो! तदनन्तर लिङ्गके अन्तर्धान होने और फिर साम्ब तथा अनिरुद्धकी उत्पत्तिका वर्णन हुआ है। तदुपरान्त महात्मा कृष्णका (अपने लोक) जानेका निश्चय, ऋषियोंका (द्वारकामें) आगमन, कृष्णद्वारा उन्हें उपदेश
verses.wordMeaning: He who is glorified in the Purana after understanding its summary, thus, becomes freed from all sins and is honoured in the Brahmaloka.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who is glorified in the Purana after understanding its summary, thus, becomes freed from all sins and is honoured in the Brahmaloka.

verses.sanskrit: अन्तर्धानं च लिङ्गस्य साम्बोत्पत्तिस्ततः परम् । कीर्तिता चानिरुद्धस्य समुत्पत्तिर्द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: antardhānaṃ ca liṅgasya sāmbotpattistataḥ param / kīrtitā cāniruddhasya samutpattirdvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: The whole of this Purana was directly narrated by Visnu who had assumed the form of the tortoise, who is the over- lord of Devas and the source of origin of the universe.
verses.hindi: तथा वरदान देनेका वर्णन किया गया है इसके अनन्तर कृष्णका (स्वधाम) गमन, अर्जुनद्वारा कृष्णद्वैपायनका दर्शन एवं उनके द्वारा कहे गये सनातन युगधमाँका वर्णन हुआ है। आगे अर्जुनके ऊपर (व्यासद्वार) अनुग्रह और पराशरपुत्र अद्धुतकर्मा व्यास
verses.wordMeaning: The whole of this Purana was directly narrated by Visnu who had assumed the form of the tortoise, who is the over- lord of Devas and the source of origin of the universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: The whole of this Purana was directly narrated by Visnu who had assumed the form of the tortoise, who is the over- lord of Devas and the source of origin of the universe.

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णस्य गमने बुद्धिरृषीणामागतिस्तथा । अनुवशासितं च कृष्णेन वरदानं महात्मनः
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇasya gamane buddhirṛṣīṇāmāgatistathā / anuvaśāsitaṃ ca kṛṣṇena varadānaṃ mahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: O Brahmanas, he who regularly reads this (through) succinctly becomes freed from all sins and is honoured in the Brahmaloka.
verses.hindi: मुनिका वाराणसीमें जानेका वर्णन है
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahmanas, he who regularly reads this (through) succinctly becomes freed from all sins and is honoured in the Brahmaloka.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahmanas, he who regularly reads this (through) succinctly becomes freed from all sins and is honoured in the Brahmaloka.

verses.sanskrit: गमनं चैव कृष्णस्य पार्थस्यापि च दर्शनम् । कृष्णद्वैपायनस्योक्ता युगधर्माः सनातनाः
verses.transliteration: gamanaṃ caiva kṛṣṇasya pārthasyāpi ca darśanam / kṛṣṇadvaipāyanasyoktā yugadharmāḥ sanātanāḥ
verses.translation: Understand the merit accruing to the person who copies this and presents it to a Brahmana well versed in the Vedas, in the month of Vaisakha or Karttika.
verses.hindi: तदुपणन्त वारणसीका माहात्म्य, तीथाँका वर्णन, व्यासकी तीर्थयात्रा और देवीके दर्शन करनेका वर्णन है। साथ प्रयागस्य च माहात्म्यं क्षेत्राणामथ कीर्तनम्। फलं च विपुलं विप्रा मार्कण्डेयस्य निर्गमः
verses.wordMeaning: Understand the merit accruing to the person who copies this and presents it to a Brahmana well versed in the Vedas, in the month of Vaisakha or Karttika.
verses.commentary: Sense: Understand the merit accruing to the person who copies this and presents it to a Brahmana well versed in the Vedas, in the month of Vaisakha or Karttika.

verses.sanskrit: अनुग्रहो ऽथ पार्थस्य वाराणसीगतिस्ततः । पाराशर्यस्य च मुनेर्व्यासस्याद्भुतकर्मणः
verses.transliteration: anugraho 'tha pārthasya vārāṇasīgatistataḥ / pārāśaryasya ca munervyāsasyādbhutakarmaṇaḥ
verses.translation: On reading even a single chapter, he is freed from all sins. He who ponders over the meaning properly attains the greatest region.
verses.hindi: कीर्त्यन्ते चैव वर्षाणि नदीनां चैव निर्णयः
verses.wordMeaning: On reading even a single chapter, he is freed from all sins. He who ponders over the meaning properly attains the greatest region.
verses.commentary: Sense: On reading even a single chapter, he is freed from all sins. He who ponders over the meaning properly attains the greatest region.

verses.sanskrit: वारणस्याश्च माहात्म्यं तीर्थानां चैव वर्णनम् । तीर्थयात्रा च व्यासस्य देव्याश्चैवाथ दर्शनम् । उद्वासनं च कथितं वरदानं तथैव च
verses.transliteration: vāraṇasyāśca māhātmyaṃ tīrthānāṃ caiva varṇanam / tīrthayātrā ca vyāsasya devyāścaivātha darśanam / udvāsanaṃ ca kathitaṃ varadānaṃ tathaiva ca
verses.translation: This holy text should be studied by the Brahmanas at every Parvan (festive occasion). O excellent Brahmanas it should be heard also, as it is destructive of great sins.
verses.hindi: शयनं केशवस्याथ माहात्म्यं च महात्मनः । मन्वन्तराणां कथनं विष्णोर्माहात्म्यमेव च अवेदस्य च वेदानां कथनं मुनिपुंगवाः
verses.wordMeaning: This holy text should be studied by the Brahmanas at every Parvan (festive occasion). O excellent Brahmanas it should be heard also, as it is destructive of great sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: This holy text should be studied by the Brahmanas at every Parvan (festive occasion). O excellent Brahmanas it should be heard also, as it is destructive of great sins.

verses.sanskrit: प्रयागस्य च माहात्म्यं क्षेत्राणामथ कीर्तिनम् । फलं च विपुलं विप्रा मार्कण्डेयस्य निर्गमः
verses.transliteration: prayāgasya ca māhātmyaṃ kṣetrāṇāmatha kīrtinam / phalaṃ ca vipulaṃ viprā mārkaṇḍeyasya nirgamaḥ
verses.translation: If all the Puranas and the Itihasas were placed on one pan and the greatest Veda* on another pan, the former alone is the weightier.
verses.hindi: योगेश्वराणां च कथा शिष्याणां चाथ कीर्तनम्। गीताश्च विविधा गुह्या ई श्वरस्याथ कीर्तिताः
verses.wordMeaning: If all the Puranas and the Itihasas were placed on one pan and the greatest Veda* on another pan, the former alone is the weightier.
verses.commentary: Sense: If all the Puranas and the Itihasas were placed on one pan and the greatest Veda* on another pan, the former alone is the weightier.

verses.sanskrit: भुवनानां स्वरूपं च ज्योतिषां च निवेशनम् । कीर्त्यन्ते चैव वर्षाणि नदीनां चैव निर्णयः
verses.transliteration: bhuvanānāṃ svarūpaṃ ca jyotiṣāṃ ca niveśanam / kīrtyante caiva varṣāṇi nadīnāṃ caiva nirṇayaḥ
verses.translation: If any one of deluded souls studies so, he falls into many hells. In the course of a Sraddha or any other rites per¬ taining to gods, this scripture must be caused to be read by the twice-born.
verses.hindi: तथा मङ्कणकस्याथ निग्रहः कीर्त्यते द्विजाः वधश्च कथितो विप्राः कालस्य च समासतः । देवदारुवने शम्भोः प्रवेशो माधवस्य च
verses.wordMeaning: If any one of deluded souls studies so, he falls into many hells. In the course of a Sraddha or any other rites per¬ taining to gods, this scripture must be caused to be read by the twice-born.
verses.commentary: Sense: If any one of deluded souls studies so, he falls into many hells. In the course of a Sraddha or any other rites per¬ taining to gods, this scripture must be caused to be read by the twice-born.

verses.sanskrit: पर्वतानां च कथनं स्थानानि च दिवौकसाम् । द्वीपानां प्रविभागश्च श्वेतद्वीपोपवर्णनम्
verses.transliteration: parvatānāṃ ca kathanaṃ sthānāni ca divaukasām / dvīpānāṃ pravibhāgaśca śvetadvīpopavarṇanam
verses.translation: Especially, at the end of a Yajna (it should be read). It wipes off all defects. This scripture must particularly be studied by those who seek salvation.
verses.hindi: दर्शनं षट्कुलीयानां देवदेवस्य धीमतः । वरदानं च देवस्य नन्दिने तु प्रकीर्तितम्
verses.wordMeaning: Especially, at the end of a Yajna (it should be read). It wipes off all defects. This scripture must particularly be studied by those who seek salvation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Especially, at the end of a Yajna (it should be read). It wipes off all defects. This scripture must particularly be studied by those who seek salvation.

verses.sanskrit: शयनं केशवस्याथ माहात्म्यं च महात्मनः । मन्वन्तराणां कथनं विष्णोर्माहात्म्यमेव च
verses.transliteration: śayanaṃ keśavasyātha māhātmyaṃ ca mahātmanaḥ / manvantarāṇāṃ kathanaṃ viṣṇormāhātmyameva ca
verses.translation: Especially, at the end of a Yajna (it should be read). It wipes off all defects. This scripture must particularly be studied by those who seek salvation.
verses.hindi: एवं ज्ञात्वा पुराणस्य संक्षेपं कीर्तयेत् तु यः। सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो ब्रह्मलोके महीयते एवमुक्त्वा श्रियं देवीमादाय पुरुषोत्तमः । संत्यज्य कूर्मसंस्थानं स्वस्थानं च जगाम ह
verses.wordMeaning: Especially, at the end of a Yajna (it should be read). It wipes off all defects. This scripture must particularly be studied by those who seek salvation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Especially, at the end of a Yajna (it should be read). It wipes off all defects. This scripture must particularly be studied by those who seek salvation.

verses.sanskrit: वेदशाखाप्रणयनं व्यासानां कथनं ततः । अवेदस्य च वेदानां कथनं मुनिपुङ्गवाः
verses.transliteration: vedaśākhāpraṇayanaṃ vyāsānāṃ kathanaṃ tataḥ / avedasya ca vedānāṃ kathanaṃ munipuṅgavāḥ
verses.translation: Especially, at the end of a Yajna (it should be read). It wipes off all defects. This scripture must particularly be studied by those who seek salvation.
verses.hindi: देवाश्च सर्वे मुनयः स्वानि स्थानानि भेजिरे। प्रणम्य पुरुषं विष्णुं गृहीत्वा ह्यमृतं द्विजाः १२१॥
verses.wordMeaning: Especially, at the end of a Yajna (it should be read). It wipes off all defects. This scripture must particularly be studied by those who seek salvation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Especially, at the end of a Yajna (it should be read). It wipes off all defects. This scripture must particularly be studied by those who seek salvation.

verses.sanskrit: योगेश्वराणां च कथा शिष्याणां चाथ कीर्तनम् । गीताश्च विविधागुह्या ईश्वरस्याथ कीर्तिताः
verses.transliteration: yogeśvarāṇāṃ ca kathā śiṣyāṇāṃ cātha kīrtanam / gītāśca vividhāguhyā īśvarasyātha kīrtitāḥ
verses.translation: Especially, at the end of a Yajna (it should be read). It wipes off all defects. This scripture must particularly be studied by those who seek salvation.
verses.hindi: एतत् पुराणं परमं भाषितं कूर्मरूपिणा। साक्षाद देवादिदेवेन विष्णुना विश्वयोनिना ही (देवीद्वारा वाराणसीसे व्यासके) निष्कासन और वरदान देनेका वर्णन हुआ है। ब्राह्मणो  तदनन्तर प्रयागका माहात्म्य, (पुण्य) क्षेत्रोंका वर्णन, (तीर्थोका) महान् फल और मार्कण्डेय मुनिके निगमनका वर्णन है
verses.wordMeaning: Especially, at the end of a Yajna (it should be read). It wipes off all defects. This scripture must particularly be studied by those who seek salvation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Especially, at the end of a Yajna (it should be read). It wipes off all defects. This scripture must particularly be studied by those who seek salvation.

verses.sanskrit: वर्णाश्रमाणामाचाराः प्रायश्चित्तविधिस्ततः । कपालित्वं च रुद्रस्य भिक्षाचरणमेव च
verses.transliteration: varṇāśramāṇāmācārāḥ prāyaścittavidhistataḥ / kapālitvaṃ ca rudrasya bhikṣācaraṇameva ca
verses.translation: Especially, at the end of a Yajna (it should be read). It wipes off all defects. This scripture must particularly be studied by those who seek salvation.
verses.hindi: (इसके पश्चात्) भुवनोंके स्वरूप, ग्रहों तथा नक्षत्रोंकी स्थिति और वर्षो तथा नदियोंके निर्णयका वर्णन किया गया है। पर्वतों तथा देवताओंके स्थानों, द्वीपोंके विभाग तथा श्वेतद्वीपका वर्णन किया गया है
verses.wordMeaning: Especially, at the end of a Yajna (it should be read). It wipes off all defects. This scripture must particularly be studied by those who seek salvation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Especially, at the end of a Yajna (it should be read). It wipes off all defects. This scripture must particularly be studied by those who seek salvation.

verses.sanskrit: पतिव्रतायाश्चाख्यानं तीर्थानां च विनिर्णयः । तथा मङ्कणकस्याथ निग्रहः कीर्त्यते द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: pativratāyāścākhyānaṃ tīrthānāṃ ca vinirṇayaḥ / tathā maṅkaṇakasyātha nigrahaḥ kīrtyate dvijāḥ
verses.translation: Especially, at the end of a Yajna (it should be read). It wipes off all defects. This scripture must particularly be studied by those who seek salvation.
verses.hindi: महात्मा केशवके शयन, उनके माहात्म्य, मन्वन्तरों और विष्णुके माहात्म्यका निरूपण हुआ है। मुनिश्रेष्ठो! तदनन्तर वेदकी शाखाओंका प्रणयन, व्यासोंका नाम- परिगणन और अवेद (वेदबाह्य सिंद्धान्तों) तथा वेदोंका कथन किया गया है। (इसके अनन्तर) योगेश्वरोंको कथा, (उनके) शिष्योंका वर्णन और ईश्वर-सम्बन्धी अनेक गुह्य गीताओंका उल्लेख हुआ है
verses.wordMeaning: Especially, at the end of a Yajna (it should be read). It wipes off all defects. This scripture must particularly be studied by those who seek salvation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Especially, at the end of a Yajna (it should be read). It wipes off all defects. This scripture must particularly be studied by those who seek salvation.

verses.sanskrit: वधश्च कथितो विप्राः कालस्य च समासतः । देवदारुवने शंभोः प्रवेशो माधवस्य च
verses.transliteration: vadhaśca kathito viprāḥ kālasya ca samāsataḥ / devadāruvane śaṃbhoḥ praveśo mādhavasya ca
verses.translation: Especially, at the end of a Yajna (it should be read). It wipes off all defects. This scripture must particularly be studied by those who seek salvation.
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर वर्णो और आश्रमोंके सदाचार, प्रायक्चित्तविधि, रुद्रके कपाली होने और (उनके) भिक्षा माँगनेका वर्णन हुआ है। द्विजो! इसके बाद पतिव्रताके आख्यान, तीर्थोके निर्णय और मङ्कणक मुनिके निग्रह करनेका
verses.wordMeaning: Especially, at the end of a Yajna (it should be read). It wipes off all defects. This scripture must particularly be studied by those who seek salvation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Especially, at the end of a Yajna (it should be read). It wipes off all defects. This scripture must particularly be studied by those who seek salvation.

verses.sanskrit: दर्शनं षट्कुलीयानां देवदेवस्य धीमतः । वरदानं च देवस्य नन्दिने तु प्रकीर्तितम्
verses.transliteration: darśanaṃ ṣaṭkulīyānāṃ devadevasya dhīmataḥ / varadānaṃ ca devasya nandine tu prakīrtitam
verses.translation: Especially, at the end of a Yajna (it should be read). It wipes off all defects. This scripture must particularly be studied by those who seek salvation.
verses.hindi: ब्राह्मणो! (तदनन्तर) संक्षेपमें कालके वध और शंकर तथा विष्णुके देवदारुवनमें प्रवेश करनेका उल्लेख है। छः कुलोंमें उत्पन्न ऋषियोंद्वारा धीमान् देवाधिदेवके दर्शन करने और महादेवद्वारा नन्दीको वरदान देनेका वर्णन हुआ है। इसके बाद नैमित्तिक प्रलय कहा गया है और फिर आगे प्राकृत प्रलय एवं सबीज योग बतलाया गया है
verses.wordMeaning: Especially, at the end of a Yajna (it should be read). It wipes off all defects. This scripture must particularly be studied by those who seek salvation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Especially, at the end of a Yajna (it should be read). It wipes off all defects. This scripture must particularly be studied by those who seek salvation.

verses.sanskrit: नैमित्तिकस्तु कथितः प्रतिसर्गस्ततः परम् । प्राकृतः प्रलयश्चोर्ध्वं सबीजो योग एव च
verses.transliteration: naimittikastu kathitaḥ pratisargastataḥ param / prākṛtaḥ pralayaścordhvaṃ sabījo yoga eva ca
verses.translation: Especially, at the end of a Yajna (it should be read). It wipes off all defects. This scripture must particularly be studied by those who seek salvation.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार संक्षेपमें (इस कूर्म) पुराणको जानकर जो उसका उपदेश करता है, वह सभी पापोंसे मुक्त होकर ब्रह्मलोकमें प्रतिष्ठा प्रास करता है
verses.wordMeaning: Especially, at the end of a Yajna (it should be read). It wipes off all defects. This scripture must particularly be studied by those who seek salvation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Especially, at the end of a Yajna (it should be read). It wipes off all defects. This scripture must particularly be studied by those who seek salvation.

verses.sanskrit: एवं ज्ञात्वा पुराणस्य संक्षेपं कीर्तयेत् तु यः । सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो ब्रह्मलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: evaṃ jñātvā purāṇasya saṃkṣepaṃ kīrtayet tu yaḥ / sarvapāpavinirmukto brahmaloke mahīyate
verses.translation: Especially, at the end of a Yajna (it should be read). It wipes off all defects. This scripture must particularly be studied by those who seek salvation.
verses.hindi: इतना कहकर कूर्मरूपका परित्यागकर देवी लक्ष्मीके साथ पुरुषोत्तम (विष्णु) अपने धामको चले गये। द्विजो ! सभी देवता तथा मुनिगण भी परम पुरुष विष्णुके (उपदेशरूपी) अमृतको प्राकर तथा उन्हें प्रणामकर अपने-अपने स्थानोंको चले गये। यह श्रेष्ठ (कूर्म-) पुराण कूर्मरूपधारी विश्वयोनि साक्षात् देवोंके आदिदेव विष्णुद्वारा कहा गया है
verses.wordMeaning: Especially, at the end of a Yajna (it should be read). It wipes off all defects. This scripture must particularly be studied by those who seek salvation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Especially, at the end of a Yajna (it should be read). It wipes off all defects. This scripture must particularly be studied by those who seek salvation.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा श्रियं देवीमादाय पुरुषोत्तमः । संत्यज्य कूर्मसंस्थानं स्वस्थानं च जगाम ह
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā śriyaṃ devīmādāya puruṣottamaḥ / saṃtyajya kūrmasaṃsthānaṃ svasthānaṃ ca jagāma ha
verses.translation: Especially, at the end of a Yajna (it should be read). It wipes off all defects. This scripture must particularly be studied by those who seek salvation.
verses.hindi: सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो ब्रह्मलोके महीयते
verses.wordMeaning: Especially, at the end of a Yajna (it should be read). It wipes off all defects. This scripture must particularly be studied by those who seek salvation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Especially, at the end of a Yajna (it should be read). It wipes off all defects. This scripture must particularly be studied by those who seek salvation.

verses.sanskrit: देवाश्च सर्वे मुनयः स्वानि स्थानानि भेजिरे । प्रणम्य पुरुषं विष्णुं गृहीत्वा ह्यमृतं द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: devāśca sarve munayaḥ svāni sthānāni bhejire / praṇamya puruṣaṃ viṣṇuṃ gṛhītvā hyamṛtaṃ dvijāḥ
verses.translation: Especially, at the end of a Yajna (it should be read). It wipes off all defects. This scripture must particularly be studied by those who seek salvation.
verses.hindi: सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तः सर्वैश्वर्यसमन्वितः। भुक्त्वा च विपुलान् स्वर्गे भोगान् दिव्यान् सुशोभनान् पूर्वसंस्कारमाहात्म्याद् ब्रह्मविद्यामवाप्नुयात्
verses.wordMeaning: Especially, at the end of a Yajna (it should be read). It wipes off all defects. This scripture must particularly be studied by those who seek salvation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Especially, at the end of a Yajna (it should be read). It wipes off all defects. This scripture must particularly be studied by those who seek salvation.

verses.sanskrit: एतत् पुराणं परमं भाषितं कूर्मरूपिणा । साक्षाद् देवादिदेनेन विष्णुना विश्वयोनिना
verses.transliteration: etat purāṇaṃ paramaṃ bhāṣitaṃ kūrmarūpiṇā / sākṣād devādidenena viṣṇunā viśvayoninā
verses.translation: Especially, at the end of a Yajna (it should be read). It wipes off all defects. This scripture must particularly be studied by those who seek salvation.
verses.hindi: पठित्वाध्यायमेवैकं सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते । योऽर्थ विचारयेत् सम्यक् स प्राप्नोति परं पदम्
verses.wordMeaning: Especially, at the end of a Yajna (it should be read). It wipes off all defects. This scripture must particularly be studied by those who seek salvation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Especially, at the end of a Yajna (it should be read). It wipes off all defects. This scripture must particularly be studied by those who seek salvation.

verses.sanskrit: यः पठेत् सततं मर्त्यो नियमेन समाहितः । सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो ब्रह्मलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: yaḥ paṭhet satataṃ martyo niyamena samāhitaḥ / sarvapāpavinirmukto brahmaloke mahīyate
verses.translation: Especially, at the end of a Yajna (it should be read). It wipes off all defects. This scripture must particularly be studied by those who seek salvation.
verses.hindi: एकतस्तु पुराणानि सेतिहासानि कृत्स्नशः । एकत्र चेदं परममेतदेवातिरिच्यते धर्मनेपुण्यकामानां ज्ञाननैपुण्यकामिनाम्। इदं पुराणं मुक्त्वैकं नास्त्यन्यत् साधनं परम्
verses.wordMeaning: Especially, at the end of a Yajna (it should be read). It wipes off all defects. This scripture must particularly be studied by those who seek salvation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Especially, at the end of a Yajna (it should be read). It wipes off all defects. This scripture must particularly be studied by those who seek salvation.

verses.sanskrit: लिखित्वा चैव यो दद्याद् वैशाखे मासि सुव्रतः । विप्राय वेदविदुषे तस्य पुण्यं निबोधत
verses.transliteration: likhitvā caiva yo dadyād vaiśākhe māsi suvrataḥ / viprāya vedaviduṣe tasya puṇyaṃ nibodhata
verses.translation: Especially, at the end of a Yajna (it should be read). It wipes off all defects. This scripture must particularly be studied by those who seek salvation.
verses.hindi: यथावदत्र भगवान् देवो नारायणो हरिः। कथ्यते हि यथा विष्णुर्न तथान्येषु सुत्रता: १३१ ॥ ब्राह्मी पौराणिकी चेयं संहिता पापनाशिनी । अत्र तत् परमं ब्रह्म कीर्त्यते हि यथार्थतः
verses.wordMeaning: Especially, at the end of a Yajna (it should be read). It wipes off all defects. This scripture must particularly be studied by those who seek salvation.

verses.sanskrit: पठित्वाध्यायमेवैकं सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते । योर्ऽथं विचारयेत् सम्यक् स प्राप्नोति परं पदम्

verses.sanskrit: एकतस्तु पुराणानि सेतिहासानि कृत्स्नशः । एकत्र चेदं परममेतदेवातिरिच्यते
verses.transliteration: ekatastu purāṇāni setihāsāni kṛtsnaśaḥ / ekatra cedaṃ paramametadevātiricyate

verses.transliteration: dharmanaipuṇyakāmānāṃ jñānanaipuṇyakāminām / idaṃ purāṇaṃ muktvaikaṃ nāstyanyat sādhanaṃ param

verses.sanskrit: यथावदत्र भगवान् देवो नारायणो हरिः । कथ्यते हि यथा विष्णुर्न तथान्येषु सुव्रताः

verses.transliteration: śrutvā nārāyaṇād divyāṃ nārado bhagavānṛṣiḥ / gautamāya dadau pūrvaṃ tasmāccaiva parāśaraḥ
verses.translation: Especially, at the end of a Yajna (it should be read). It wipes off all defects. This scripture must particularly be studied by those who seek salvation.
verses.hindi: पाराशर्याय शान्ताय नमो नारायणात्मने नमस्तस्मै सुरेशाय विष्णवे कूर्मरूपिणे
verses.wordMeaning: Especially, at the end of a Yajna (it should be read). It wipes off all defects. This scripture must particularly be studied by those who seek salvation.

verses.sanskrit: पराशरो ऽपि भगवान गङ्गाद्वारे मुनीश्वराः । मुनिभ्यः कथयामास धर्मकामार्थमोक्षदम्
verses.transliteration: parāśaro 'pi bhagavāna gaṅgādvāre munīśvarāḥ / munibhyaḥ kathayāmāsa dharmakāmārthamokṣadam

verses.hindi: इसका ठीक-ठीक ज्ञान प्राकर भक्तियुक्त श्रेष्ठ ब्राह्मणोंको इसे (सबको) सुनाना चाहिए। इससे वह व्यक्ति सभी पापोसे मुक्त होकर ब्रह्म-सायुज्य प्राप्त करता है। जो (व्यक्ति) श्रद्धारहित तथा अधार्मिक

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मणा कथितं पूर्वं सनकाय च धीमते । सनत्कुमाराय तथा सर्वपापप्रणाशनम्
verses.transliteration: brahmaṇā kathitaṃ pūrvaṃ sanakāya ca dhīmate / sanatkumārāya tathā sarvapāpapraṇāśanam
verses.translation: Especially, at the end of a Yajna (it should be read). It wipes off all defects. This scripture must particularly be studied by those who seek salvation.
verses.hindi: पुरुषको इसका उपदेश देता है, वह परलोकमें जाकर नरकोंका भोग भोगकर पुनः मृत्युलोकमें कुत्तेकी योनिमें जन्म लेता है। “संसारके मूल कारण सनातन हरि विष्णु तथा कृष्णद्वैपायन व्यासजीको नमस्कार करके इस शास्त्र (पुराण)-का अध्ययन करना चाहिए '--अमित तेजस्वी देवाधिदेव विष्णु और पराशरके पुत्र महात्मा विप्रर्षि व्यासकी ऐसी आज्ञा है॥ १३६--१४०॥
verses.wordMeaning: Especially, at the end of a Yajna (it should be read). It wipes off all defects. This scripture must particularly be studied by those who seek salvation.

verses.sanskrit: सनकाद् भगवान् साक्षाद् देवलो योगवित्तमः । अवाप्तवान् पञ्चशिखो देवलादिदमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: sanakād bhagavān sākṣād devalo yogavittamaḥ / avāptavān pañcaśikho devalādidamuttamam

verses.hindi: नारायणसे इस दिव्य संहिताको सुनकर भगवान् नारद ऋषिने पूर्वकालमें गौतमको इसका उपदेश दिया था और उनसे पराशरको यह (शस्त्र) प्राप्त हुआ। मुनीश्वरो! भगवान् पराशरने भी गङ्गाद्वार (हरिद्वार) -में धर्म, अर्थ,

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमाराद् भगवान् मुनिः सत्यवतीसुतः । लेभे पुराणं परमं व्यासः सर्वार्थसंचयम्
verses.transliteration: sanatkumārād bhagavān muniḥ satyavatīsutaḥ / lebhe purāṇaṃ paramaṃ vyāsaḥ sarvārthasaṃcayam
verses.translation: Especially, at the end of a Yajna (it should be read). It wipes off all defects. This scripture must particularly be studied by those who seek salvation.
verses.hindi: काम तथा मोक्षरूप चतुर्विध पुरुषार्थको देनेवाले इस पुराणको मुनियोंसे कहा। पूर्वकालमें धीमान् सनक और सनत्कुमारको सभी पापोंका नाश करनेवाले इस शास्त्रका उपेदश ब्रह्माने दिया था। सनकसे योगज्ञानियोंमें श्रेष्ठ साक्षात् भगवान् देवलने और देवलसे पञ्चशिखने इस उत्तम शास्त्रको प्राप्त किया। सत्यवतीके पुत्र भगवान् व्यास मुनिने सभी अर्थोंका संचय करनेवाले इस श्रेष्ठ पुराणको सनत्कुमारसे प्रा किया
verses.wordMeaning: Especially, at the end of a Yajna (it should be read). It wipes off all defects. This scripture must particularly be studied by those who seek salvation.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद् व्यासादहं श्रुत्वा भवतां पापनाशनम् । ऊचिवान् वै भवद्भिश्च दातव्यं धार्मिके जने
verses.transliteration: tasmād vyāsādahaṃ śrutvā bhavatāṃ pāpanāśanam / ūcivān vai bhavadbhiśca dātavyaṃ dhārmike jane
verses.translation: Especially, at the end of a Yajna (it should be read). It wipes off all defects. This scripture must particularly be studied by those who seek salvation.
verses.hindi: उन व्याससे सुनकर मैंने आप लोगोंसे पापोंका नाश करनेवाले इस पुराणको कहा है। आप लोगोंको भी धार्मिक व्यक्तिको (इसका उपदेश) प्रदान करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: Especially, at the end of a Yajna (it should be read). It wipes off all defects. This scripture must particularly be studied by those who seek salvation.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मै व्यासाय गुरवे सर्वज्ञाय महर्षये । पाराशर्याय शान्ताय नमो नारायणात्मने
verses.transliteration: tasmai vyāsāya gurave sarvajñāya maharṣaye / pārāśaryāya śāntāya namo nārāyaṇātmane
verses.translation: Especially, at the end of a Yajna (it should be read). It wipes off all defects. This scripture must particularly be studied by those who seek salvation.
verses.hindi: पराशरके पुत्र सर्वज्ञ, गुरु, शान्त तथा नारायणस्वरूप महर्षि व्यासको नमस्कार है। जिनसे सम्पूर्ण संसारको उत्पत्ति होती है और जिनमें यह सब लीन हो जाता है, उन देवताओंके स्वामी कूर्मरूप धारण करनेवाले भगवान् श्रीविष्णुको नमस्कार है

verses.transliteration: yasmāt saṃjāyate kṛtsanaṃ yatra caiva pralīyate / namastasmai sureśāya viṣṇave kūrmarūpiṇe

verses.hindi: इति श्रीकूर्मपुराणे षद्साहर्त्र्धां संहितायामुपरिविभागे चतुश्चत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः
